source: Atilin Pathen'in van le leiset aseme.
target: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

source: Chuleh leiset chu agong umlou le agohkeo ahin; twi thuhtah chunga chun muthim akikhange. Chule Pathen lhagao chu twiho chunga chun alenglen ahi.
target: Now the earth was formless and empty, darkness was over the surface of the deep, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the waters.

source: Chuin Pathen'in, Vah umhen atile, vah chu aumtan ahi.
target: And God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

source: Chuin Pathen'in vah chu amun, hichu pha asan: hichun Pathen'in vah chu muthima konin akhen tan ahi.
target: God saw that the light was good, and he separated the light from the darkness.

source: Chuin Pathen'in vah chu sun asah in, muthim chu jan asah tai. Hitichun nilhah le jingkah chu ni masa ni ahitai.
target: God called the light “day,” and the darkness he called “night.” And there was evening, and there was morning—the first day.

source: Chujouvin Pathen'in, Twilah-a chun vanlaijol hung umhen, chule hichun twiho chu twiho-a konin homkhenhen, ati.
target: And God said, “Let there be a vault between the waters to separate water from water.”

source: Hitichun Pathen'in vanlaijol chu asemin, vanlaijol noija um twiho chu vanlaijol chunga um twiho-a kon chun ahomkhenin ahi. Chuin chuti chun aumtan ahi.
target: So God made the vault and separated the water under the vault from the water above it. And it was so.

source: Chuin Pathen'in vanlaijol chu van asah tai. Hitichun nilhah le jingkah chu ni nina ahitai.
target: God called the vault “sky.” And there was evening, and there was morning—the second day.

source: Chuin Pathen'in, Vannoi'a twi ho chu mun khatna kigom khom henlang, gamgo hung kisepdoh hen, ati. Chuin chuti chun aumtan ahi.
target: And God said, “Let the water under the sky be gathered to one place, and let dry ground appear.” And it was so.

source: Chuin Pathen'in gamgo chu leiset asah-in, chule twi kigom khom hochu twikhanglen asah tai. Chuin Pathen'in hichu amun, pha asan ahi.
target: God called the dry ground “land,” and the gathered waters he called “seas.” And God saw that it was good.

source: Chuin Pathen'in, leisetnin hampa, achi nei hamkung, chule ama ama chi dungjuija aganei theiphung, aga sunga achi um leisetna hin hinsepdoh hen, ati. Chuin chuti chun aumtan ahi.
target: Then God said, “Let the land produce vegetation: seed-bearing plants and trees on the land that bear fruit with seed in it, according to their various kinds.” And it was so.

source: Chuin leiset nin hampa, chule ama ama chi dung juija ga, aga sunga achi um thingphung ganei ahin sodoh tan ahi. Chuin Pathen'in hichu amun pha asan ahi.
target: The land produced vegetation: plants bearing seed according to their kinds and trees bearing fruit with seed in it according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.

source: Hiti chun nilhah le jingkah chu nithum ni ahitai.
target: And there was evening, and there was morning—the third day.

source: Chuin Pathen'in, Sun chu jana kona chomkhen dingin van'a vanlaijola vah ho umhen; chule hiho chu melchihna ho, phat bihho, chule nikhoho hetna dingin pangu hen.
target: And God said, “Let there be lights in the vault of the sky to separate the day from the night, and let them serve as signs to mark sacred times, and days and years,

source: Chule hiho chu leiset chunga vah pedingin van'a vanlaijola vahho hiuhen ati. Chuin chuti chun aumtan ahi.
target: and let them be lights in the vault of the sky to give light on the earth.” And it was so.

source: Hiche chun Pathen'in vah lentah ni asemin; vah lenjo chu sun vaipo dingin, chule vah neojo chu jan vaipo dingin apansahtan ahi. Aman ahsi ho jong aseme.
target: God made two great lights—the greater light to govern the day and the lesser light to govern the night. He also made the stars.

source: Pathen'in hiho chu leiset chunga vah peding van'a vanlaijola chu akoijin,
target: God set them in the vault of the sky to give light on the earth,

source: Chule sun le jan chunga vaipo ding le muthima kona vah khendingin akoitan ahi. Chuin Pathen'in hichu amun pha asan ahi.
target: to govern the day and the night, and to separate light from darkness. And God saw that it was good.

source: Hiti chun nilhah le jingkah chu nili ni ahitai.
target: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fourth day.

source: Chuin Pathen'in, Twiho chun achat loh thei hinna nei ganhing tamtah hinsepdoh henlang, vachate jong leiset chung van'a vanlaijol onghom-ah leng leuhen, ati.
target: And God said, “Let the water teem with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the vault of the sky.”

source: Hiti chun Pathen'in ngapi lentah ho asemin, chule twijin ama ama chi dungjuija ninglhing setna ahinsepdoh achatloh thei hinna nei ganhing namkim le lhaving nei vacha namkim chu ama ama chi dungjui jin asemin ahi. Chuin Pathen'in hichu amun pha asan ahi.
target: So God created the great creatures of the sea and every living thing with which the water teems and that moves about in it, according to their kinds, and every winged bird according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.

source: Chule Pathen'in amaho chu phatthei aboh-in, Chiphaovin lang pung theijun, twikhanglen twiho lo dimun, chule vachate jong leiset chunga punguhen, ati.
target: God blessed them and said, “Be fruitful and increase in number and fill the water in the seas, and let the birds increase on the earth.”

source: Hitichun nilhah le jingkah chu ni ngani ahitai.
target: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fifth day.

source: Chuin Pathen'in, leisetnin ama ama chi dungjui cheh in hinna nei ganhing, gancha hon, akithol tho ganhing, chule leisetna gamsaho ama ama chi dungjui jin hin sepdoh hen ati. Chuin chuti chun aumtan ahi.
target: And God said, “Let the land produce living creatures according to their kinds: the livestock, the creatures that move along the ground, and the wild animals, each according to its kind.” And it was so.

source: Chuin Pathen'in leisetna gamsa ama ama chi dung juijin, ganchaho ama ama achi dung jui cheh-un, leiset chunga akithol tho ganhing namkim ama ama chi dung jui cheh-in asemtan ahi. Chuin Pathen'in hichu amun pha asai.
target: God made the wild animals according to their kinds, the livestock according to their kinds, and all the creatures that move along the ground according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.

source: Chuin Pathen'in, Eihon eiho lim bangin, eiho bangtah-in mihem semu hitin; chule amahon twikhanglen na ngaho, vanlaijola vachate, ganchaho, chule leiset pumpi chung le leichunga akitholtho ganhing namkim chungah vaihomu hen, ati.
target: Then God said, “Let us make mankind in our image, in our likeness, so that they may rule over the fish in the sea and the birds in the sky, over the livestock and all the wild animals, and over all the creatures that move along the ground.”

source: Chuti chun Pathen'in ama lim bangin mihem asemin, aman amapa chu Pathen lim bangin asemin ahi; aman amani chu pasal le numei jin aseme.
target: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.

source: Chujou phatnin Pathen'in amani chu phatthei aboh-in, chule Pathen'in amani jah-a chun, Chipha lhonin, pung lhonin, vannoi leiset lodimsoh lhonin lang, nathun nunsah lhonin; chule twikhanglen na ngaho, vanlaijola vachate, chule leiset chunga vahle hinna nei ganhing jouse chungah thuneina neilhonin, ati.
target: God blessed them and said to them, “Be fruitful and increase in number; fill the earth and subdue it. Rule over the fish in the sea and the birds in the sky and over every living creature that moves on the ground.”

source: Chuin Pathen'in, Ven, vannoi leiset pumpi chunga amunei hampa jouse le, asunga amu um thingphung gathei jouse kapeh lhon ahin; hichu nangni dinga na an lhon hiding ahi.
target: Then God said, “I give you every seed-bearing plant on the face of the whole earth and every tree that has fruit with seed in it. They will be yours for food.

source: Chule leiset na gamsa namkim, vanlaijola vacha namkim, leiset chunga a-opma kithol ganhing namkim, hinna nei jouse dinga hampa louhing eng jouse a-an diuva kapeh ahitai, ati. Chuin chuti chun aumtan ahi.
target: And to all the beasts of the earth and all the birds in the sky and all the creatures that move along the ground—everything that has the breath of life in it—I give every green plant for food.” And it was so.

source: Chuti chun athilsem namkim chu aven, chule veuvin, hichu aphalheh jengin ahi. Chuin nilhah le jingkah chu nigup ni ahitai.
target: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good. And there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.

source: Chuti chun vanho le leiset, chule asunga um jouse chu akisem chaitan ahi.
target: Thus the heavens and the earth were completed in all their vast array.

source: Chuin ani sagi nin Pathen'in athilsem anatoh chu achaijin; chule ni sagi nin athilsem anatoh jouse-a konin akicholdon ahi.
target: By the seventh day God had finished the work he had been doing; so on the seventh day he rested from all his work.

source: Chuin Pathen'in nisagi ni chu phatthei aboh-in, asuthengtan ahi. Ajeh chu chuche nikho-a chu Pathen athilsem le athilbol anatoh jouse-a kicholdo-a ahi.
target: Then God blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it he rested from all the work of creating that he had done.

source: Hiche hohi akisem laijuva van le leiset khanggui chu ahi; Pakai Pathen'in leiset le vanho asem nikho,
target: This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created, when the Lord God made the earth and the heavens.

source: Alei laija thingphung namkim leiset chunga aum masang, chule aleija hampa louhing namkim akedoh masang, (akisem laijuva van le leiset khanggui chu ahi.) Ajeh chu Pakai Pathen'in leisetna go ajuhsah hihlaijin, alei lhouding jong mi khatcha anaum hih laijin ahi.
target: Now no shrub had yet appeared on the earth and no plant had yet sprung up, for the Lord God had not sent rain on the earth and there was no one to work the ground,

source: Ahin leisetna konin twimei ahungdohjin, chule leiset chung jouse achapkot jin ahi.
target: but streams came up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground.

source: Chuin Pakai Pathen'in tolla leivuija konin mihem asemin, anahhom sunga chun hinna hu alhakhumin ahile, hichun mipa chu hinna nei mihing ahung hitai.
target: Then the Lord God formed a man from the dust of the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living being.

source: Chuin Pakai Pathen'in solama Eden'a chun honkhat asemin; aman sem mipa chu hikoma chun akoi tai.
target: Now the Lord God had planted a garden in the east, in Eden; and there he put the man he had formed.

source: Chuin Pakai Pathen'in leisetna konin vetdinga hoitah, chule nehdinga tuitah theiphung namkim akedoh sah-in; chule honsung lailunga chun hinthing le ase apha hetna thing jong akedoh sah-in ahi.
target: The Lord God made all kinds of trees grow out of the ground—trees that were pleasing to the eye and good for food. In the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

source: Chule hon chu chapkot dingin Eden'a kon chun vadunglen khat along doh-in; chule chua kon chun akikhenin vadung ka-li akiso tan ahi.
target: A river watering the garden flowed from Eden; from there it was separated into four headwaters.

source: Amasa pen chu amin Pishon ahin; hichu sana umna Havilah gam kolkhumin alongin ahi.
target: The name of the first is the Pishon; it winds through the entire land of Havilah, where there is gold.

source: Chule chuche Gama Sana chu aphan; chukoma chu bdellium le songgel jong aumin ahi.
target: (The gold of that land is good; aromatic resin and onyx are also there.)

source: Vadung nina chu Gihon ahin; Ethiopia gam kolkhuma longa chu hiche hi ahi.
target: The name of the second river is the Gihon; it winds through the entire land of Cush.

source: Athumna vadung minchu Hiddekel ahin; Assyria gam solama longa chu ahi. Chule vadung lina chu Euphrates ahi.
target: The name of the third river is the Tigris; it runs along the east side of Ashur. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.

source: Chujouvin Pakai Pathen'in mipa chu aleilhou natong dingle angah dingin Eden hona chun akoitai
target: The Lord God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.

source: Chuin Pakai Pathen'in mipa chu thupeh apen, Nangman honsunga thingga jouse chamlhat tah-a naneh thei ahi:
target: And the Lord God commanded the man, “You are free to eat from any tree in the garden;

source: Amavang ase apha hetna thingga vang chu naneh louding ahi; ajeh chu hichu naneh ninileh thonlouva nangma nathi tei ding ahi, ati.
target: but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, for when you eat from it you will certainly die.”

source: Chule Pakai Pathen'in, Mipa hi achanga aum ding aphapoi, keiman ama dingin akithopi ding akilompi khat sempeh-ing kate, ati.
target: The Lord God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper suitable for him.”

source: Pakai Pathen'in leisetna konin gamsa jouse, chunga leng vachate jouse asemin; hicheng chu Adam'in amin asah dingin ahengah chun ahinpuijin ahi. Chuin Adam'in ganhing namkim amin asahbang cheh-in, aminu chu akisah dentai.
target: Now the Lord God had formed out of the ground all the wild animals and all the birds in the sky. He brought them to the man to see what he would name them; and whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.

source: Hiti chun Adam'in ganchaho, vanlaijola vachate, chule gamsaho jouse chu amin asahsoh keijin; ahivangin ama kithopi ding akilompi aumpon ahi.
target: So the man gave names to all the livestock, the birds in the sky and all the wild animals. But for Adam no suitable helper was found.

source: Chuin Pakai Pathen'in Adam chu a-imutmil sah-in ahile, ama a-imutan ahi. Chuin aman anahgu holah-a khat aladoh-in, hilaimun chu aphe-in ahuh bitnin ahi.
target: So the Lord God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep; and while he was sleeping, he took one of the man’s ribs and then closed up the place with flesh.

source: Chujouvin Pakai Pathen'in mihempa-a kona alahdoh anahgu chun, numei khat asemin, amanu chu mihempa henga chun ahinpuijin ahi.
target: Then the Lord God made a woman from the rib he had taken out of the man, and he brought her to the man.

source: Chuin Adam'in, Tuvangin hichehi keima gua kona gu, chule kaphe-a kona phe ahi. Amanuhi numei kisah ding ahi, ajehchu ama pasal'a kona kiladoh ahi, ati.
target: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called ‘woman,’ for she was taken out of man.”

source: Hijeh-a chu pasal'in anu le apa adalhah-a, ajia beh ding ahi; chule amani chu tikhat hilhon ding ahi.
target: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.

source: Chule mipa le a-inneipi chu ani lhonin sagoh keo ahilhonin, ahin ajahcha lhonpon ahi.
target: Adam and his wife were both naked, and they felt no shame.

source: Tun Pakai Pathen thilsem gamsaho jouse lah-a chun gul ajonchih penin ahi. Chuin aman numeinu jah-a, Pathen'in honsunga thingga khatcha jong naneh lhon lou ding ahi, tia aseijem? ati.
target: Now the serpent was more crafty than any of the wild animals the Lord God had made. He said to the woman, “Did God really say, ‘You must not eat from any tree in the garden’?”

source: Hichun numei nun gul jah-a, Keinin honsunga theiga ho kanethei lhonai;
target: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees in the garden,

source: Ahivangin hon lailunga um theiga vangkhu, Pathen'in, naneh lhon lou ding, tohjong natohkhah lhon louding ahi, achuti loule nathi lhonding ahi, tin aseije ati.
target: but God did say, ‘You must not eat fruit from the tree that is in the middle of the garden, and you must not touch it, or you will die.’ ”

source: Chuin gul chun numei nu jah-a, Nathi tahbeh lhon louding ahi;
target: “You will not certainly die,” the serpent said to the woman.

source: Ajehchu hichu naneh lhon ni nileh namitlhon hahdoh ding, Pathen toh nabah lhona, apha ase nahet lhon ding ahi chu Pathen'in ahet ahi, tin aseitai.
target: “For God knows that when you eat from it your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”

source: Chuin numei nu chun theiphung chu neh dinga aphat le, mitna dinga vetnom aum, chule mikhat chihsah nadinga dei umtah ahichu amuphatnin, amanun aga chu alouvin, anetan; chule a-inneipu jong chu apen ahile, amapan jong anetai.
target: When the woman saw that the fruit of the tree was good for food and pleasing to the eye, and also desirable for gaining wisdom, she took some and ate it. She also gave some to her husband, who was with her, and he ate it.

source: Chuin amani amitlhon ahung hahdoh tan, chule sagohkeu ahilhon ahelhon tai; chuin amanin theichang naho akilmat lhonin, vonin akivon lhontan ahi.
target: Then the eyes of both of them were opened, and they realized they were naked; so they sewed fig leaves together and made coverings for themselves.

source: Chuin ni ahung daijin amanin hona chun Pakai Pathen kholhah husa gin aja lhontan; chuin Adam le a-inneipi chu Pakai Pathen umna-a kon chun honsunga thinglah-a chun akisel lhontan ahi.
target: Then the man and his wife heard the sound of the Lord God as he was walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and they hid from the Lord God among the trees of the garden.

source: Chuin Pakai Pathen'in Adam chu ahin kouvin, ajah-a, Hoija um nahim? ati.
target: But the Lord God called to the man, “Where are you?”

source: Chuin aman, Keiman honsunga nahusagin kajan, kasagoh keo kahijeh-in kakichan, kakisel ahi, ati.
target: He answered, “I heard you in the garden, and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid.”

source: Chuin aman, Sagohkeo nahi kon naseipeh ham? Nehih-in tia kathupeh thingga chu naneh hitam? ati.
target: And he said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”

source: Hichun mihem pan, Nangman kaumpi dinga neipeh numeinu hin thingga chu eipeh-a, kana neh ahitai, ati.
target: The man said, “The woman you put here with me—she gave me some fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”

source: Chuin Pakai Pathen'in numeinu jah-a, Nangman nabolhi ipi hitam ati. Chuin numeinu chun, gul'in eilhepma, kana neh ahitai, ati.
target: Then the Lord God said to the woman, “What is this you have done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

source: Chuin Pakai Pathen'in gul jah-a chun, Nangman hitobanghi nabol jeh hin, ganchaho jouse chungle, jaova gamsa jouse chungvuma gaosap changa nahitai; Nangman na-oija lam najot ding, chule nahinlai sungse-a leivui naneh ding ahi.
target: So the Lord God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, “Cursed are you above all livestock and all wild animals! You will crawl on your belly and you will eat dust all the days of your life.

source: Chule nangma le numei nu kikah-a, chule nachilhah le amanu chilhah kah-a kidouna kakoi ding; chule aman nalu asuh chipma, nangman ama khotaljum nasuhchip ding ahi, ati.
target: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and hers; he will crush your head, and you will strike his heel.”

source: Aman numei nu jah-a chun, Keiman nalung gentheina le nanaovopna chu nasatah-a kapunsah ding; nangman nat thoh gim tah-a cha nahin ding; nalung ngaichat chu na inneipu-a ding hiding, chule aman nachunga vai ahomding ahi, ati.
target: To the woman he said, “I will make your pains in childbearing very severe; with painful labor you will give birth to children. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”

source: Chule aman Adam jah-a, Nangman na inneipi thu nangaija, nangman nanehlou ding ahi, tia kathupeh thingga chu naneh tah jehchun: Nangma jala leiset kigaosapmah ahitai; nangman nahin laisungse-a, gimtah-a na natoh-a aga naneh ding ahi.
target: To Adam he said, “Because you listened to your wife and ate fruit from the tree about which I commanded you, ‘You must not eat from it,’ “Cursed is the ground because of you; through painful toil you will eat food from it all the days of your life.

source: Chule nangma-a dinga ling le meithai seltholing ahin kedohsah ding; chule nangman loujaova hampa louhing naneh ding ahi.
target: It will produce thorns and thistles for you, and you will eat the plants of the field.

source: Nangma leisetna kona kiladoh nahin, leisetna nakilekit kahse-a namaija ulsa soh-a kona anneh naneh ding ahi. Ajehchu nangma leivui nahin, leivuija nakile kitding ahi, ati.
target: By the sweat of your brow you will eat your food until you return to the ground, since from it you were taken; for dust you are and to dust you will return.”

source: Chuin Adam'in a-inneipi min chu Eve asahtai; ajeh chu amanu mihing jouse Nu ahi
target: Adam named his wife Eve, because she would become the mother of all the living.

source: Chuin Pakai Pathen'in Adam le a-inneipi chu savunin sangkhol asempeh-in, avon pehtan ahi.
target: The Lord God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife and clothed them.

source: Chuin Pakai Pathen'in, Vetan, mihem khu eiho lah-a khat bangin ase apha ahetthei tai. Chule tun, ijemtin akhut hinlhang dohhen lang, hing thingga jongkhu hinlou henlang, netaleh, tonsotna hingding ahitai, ati.
target: And the Lord God said, “The man has now become like one of us, knowing good and evil. He must not be allowed to reach out his hand and take also from the tree of life and eat, and live forever.”

source: Hijeh chun akilahdohna leiset chu laibot-a natong dingin, Pakai Pathen'in ama chu Eden hona konin asoldoh tan ahi.
target: So the Lord God banished him from the Garden of Eden to work the ground from which he had been taken.

source: Chuti chun mipa chu anodoh-in; chule hinthing lampi chu ngahdingin Cherubim le akipei lele meikou chemjam chu Eden hon solama akoitan ahi.
target: After he drove the man out, he placed on the east side of the Garden of Eden cherubim and a flaming sword flashing back and forth to guard the way to the tree of life.

source: Chuin Adam chun a-inneipi Eve chu akitimat pin ahile, amanun nao avopmin, Cain ahingin, chule amanun, Pakaiya konin pasal khat kaneitai, ati.
target: Adam made love to his wife Eve, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Cain. She said, “With the help of the Lord I have brought forth a man.”

source: Chuin amanun anaopa Abel ahing kitnin ahi. Chuin Abel chu kelngoi vah-in apangin, ahin Cain vang chu loulhou natongin apangin ahi.
target: Later she gave birth to his brother Abel. Now Abel kept flocks, and Cain worked the soil.

source: Chuin khonung phasah-in, Cain'in alhosoh alouga chu ahin choijin, Pakai henga atohtan ahi.
target: In the course of time Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil as an offering to the Lord .

source: Chuin Abel jong chun akelngoihon asoh masapen lah-a athaopen chu ahin choijin ahi. Chuin Pakai chu Abel le athilto-a chun alung lhaijin ahi.
target: And Abel also brought an offering—fat portions from some of the firstborn of his flock. The Lord looked with favor on Abel and his offering,

source: Ahin Cain le athilto chunga vang alung lhai tapon ahi. Chuphat nin Cain chu alungsa talheh jengin, chule amai athim jengtan ahi.
target: but on Cain and his offering he did not look with favor. So Cain was very angry, and his face was downcast.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Cain jah-a, Ibola nalungsat ham? Chule ibola namai thima ham?
target: Then the Lord said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why is your face downcast?

source: Nangman phatah-a nabola ahile, nangma sanlouva naum dehding ham? Ahin phatah-a nabol lou vangle, chonsetnin kot bula nachang jinge. Chule angaichat chu nangma-a ding ahin, hijongle nangman ama chunga vai nahom ding ahi, ati.
target: If you do what is right, will you not be accepted? But if you do not do what is right, sin is crouching at your door; it desires to have you, but you must rule over it.”

source: Chuin Cain'in anaopa Abel chu akihoulimpin; chuin ahitin ahi, amani gamlah-a aumpet lhonin, Cain chu anaopa Abel chunga achun, athat tai.
target: Now Cain said to his brother Abel, “Let’s go out to the field.” While they were in the field, Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Cain jah-a, nanaopa Abel hoija umham? ati. Chuin aman, kahepoi; keima kanaopa ching beh kahim? ati.
target: Then the Lord said to Cain, “Where is your brother Abel?” “I don’t know,” he replied. “Am I my brother’s keeper?”

source: Chuin aman, Ipi nabol hitam? Nanaopa thisan aw chu leisetna konin kahengah ahung pengdoh-e.
target: The Lord said, “What have you done? Listen! Your brother’s blood cries out to me from the ground.

source: Chule tun nakhutna kona nanaopa thisan choplutna leisetna kona nangma kigaosap ma nahitai.
target: Now you are under a curse and driven from the ground, which opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.

source: Nangman lei nalaija na natoh tengle, nangma-a dinga ahina banga ga ahinsepdoh tahlou ding; nangma leiset chunga jamlele leh vahlele mi nahiding ahi, ati.
target: When you work the ground, it will no longer yield its crops for you. You will be a restless wanderer on the earth.”

source: Chuin Cain'in Pakai jah-a, Ka talen mat hi kathoh jou kal val ahitai.
target: Cain said to the Lord , “My punishment is more than I can bear.

source: Vetan, nangman tunin leiset chunga konin neinodoh tan; chule nangma maikoh-a kona selmanga umding kahitai; chule keima leiset chunga ajamlele leh vahle-le kahiding ahitan; chule hung hiti ding ahi, keima eimu mu-a chun eithading ahitai, ati.
target: Today you are driving me from the land, and I will be hidden from your presence; I will be a restless wanderer on the earth, and whoever finds me will kill me.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin ajah-a, Hijeh chun koihile Cain that chan chu, ajat sagi-a achunga phu kilading ahi, ati. Chuin koiman ama amua atha louna dingin, Pakaiyin Cain chunga chun melchihna akoitan ahi.
target: But the Lord said to him, “Not so; anyone who kills Cain will suffer vengeance seven times over.” Then the Lord put a mark on Cain so that no one who found him would kill him.

source: Chuin Cain Pakai angsunga konin apotdoh-in, Eden solama Nod Gama achengtai.
target: So Cain went out from the Lord ’s presence and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

source: Chuin Cain'in a-inneipi akitimatpin ahile, amanu agaijin Enoch ahingin ahi. Chuin aman khopi khat asemin, achapa min dungjuijin khopi chu Enoch asahtai
target: Cain made love to his wife, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Enoch. Cain was then building a city, and he named it after his son Enoch.

source: Chuin Enoch chun Irad ahingin; Irad chun Mehujael ahingin; Mehujael'in Methushael ahingin; chule Methushael'in Lamech ahingin, ahi.
target: To Enoch was born Irad, and Irad was the father of Mehujael, and Mehujael was the father of Methushael, and Methushael was the father of Lamech.

source: Chuin Lamech chun jini akipuijin: khatnu min chu Adah ahin, khat joh nu min chu Zillah ahi.
target: Lamech married two women, one named Adah and the other Zillah.

source: Chuin Adah chun Jabal ahingin; ama chu pon in'a chenghole gancha vulteho bulpipa ahi.
target: Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the father of those who live in tents and raise livestock.

source: Chule anaopa min chu Jubal ahin; amachu saiging le gosem mut teho jouse bulpipa ahi.
target: His brother’s name was Jubal; he was the father of all who play stringed instruments and pipes.

source: Chule Zillah'in jong Tubal-Cain ahingin; ama chu sum-eng le thih manchah semho hila pang ahi.Chule Tubal-Cain sopinu chu Naamah ahi.
target: Zillah also had a son, Tubal-Cain, who forged all kinds of tools out of bronze and iron. Tubal-Cain’s sister was Naamah.

source: Chuin Lamech chun ajiteni jah-a chun, Adah le Zillah ka-aw ngai lhonin, nangni Lamech inneipi teni, kathusei ngailhonin. Ajehchu mikhat eimavo jeh-in kathatnin, chule gollhang khat eisuhkhah jeh-in kathatnin ahi.
target: Lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, listen to me; wives of Lamech, hear my words. I have killed a man for wounding me, a young man for injuring me.

source: Cain chunga ajat sagi-a phu kilading ahile, tahbeh-a Lamech chunga sagi mun somsagi vei kilading ahi, ati.
target: If Cain is avenged seven times, then Lamech seventy-seven times.”

source: Chuin Adam'in a-inneipi chu akitimatpi kitnin ahile, amanun chapa khat ahingin, amin Seth asahtai. Ajehchu amanun, Cain'in atha Abel khel chun, Pathen'in chikhai ding khat eipetai, ati.
target: Adam made love to his wife again, and she gave birth to a son and named him Seth, saying, “God has granted me another child in place of Abel, since Cain killed him.”

source: Chuin Seth amatah jong chun chapa khat ahingin, amin Enosh asah tai. Hiche-a pat chun mihem ten Pakai min akoupan taovin ahi.
target: Seth also had a son, and he named him Enosh. At that time people began to call on the name of the Lord .

source: Hichehi Adam khangguiho lekhabu ahi. Pathen'in mihem asemni chun, aman Pathen tobangin amachu asemin ahi.
target: This is the written account of Adam’s family line. When God created mankind, he made them in the likeness of God.

source: Aman amani chu Pasal le numei jin asemin; chuin phatthei aboh-in, chule amani asem nikho chun aminlhon chu Adam asah tan ahi.
target: He created them male and female and blessed them. And he named them “Mankind” when they were created.

source: Chuin Adam kum jakhat le kum somthum alhinin, ama tobang le ama lim bangin chapa khat ahingin; amin Seth asahtan ahi.
target: When Adam had lived 130 years, he had a son in his own likeness, in his own image; and he named him Seth.

source: Chuin Seth ahin nungin Adam kum jaget ahingin, chapate le chanute ahingin ahi.
target: After Seth was born, Adam lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.

source: Chule Adam damsung hinkho chu abonchan kum jako le kum somthum ahi. Chuin ama athitai.
target: Altogether, Adam lived a total of 930 years, and then he died.

source: Chuin Seth kum jakhatle kum nga alhinin, Enosh ahingin ahi
target: When Seth had lived 105 years, he became the father of Enosh.

source: Enosh ahin nungin Seth kum jagetle kum sagi ahingin, chapate le chanute ahingin ahi.
target: After he became the father of Enosh, Seth lived 807 years and had other sons and daughters.

source: Chule Seth damsung hinkho chu abonchan kum jako le kum somleni ahin. Chuin ama athitai.
target: Altogether, Seth lived a total of 912 years, and then he died.

source: Chuin Enosh kum somko alhinin, Cainan ahinge.
target: When Enosh had lived 90 years, he became the father of Kenan.

source: Chuin Cainan ahin nungin, Enosh kum jaget leh kum somlenga ahingin, chapate le chanute ahingin ahi.
target: After he became the father of Kenan, Enosh lived 815 years and had other sons and daughters.

source: Chule Enosh damsung hinkho chu abonchan kum jakole kumnga ahi. Chuin ama athitai.
target: Altogether, Enosh lived a total of 905 years, and then he died.

source: Chuin Cainan kum somsagi alhinin, Mahalalel ahinge.
target: When Kenan had lived 70 years, he became the father of Mahalalel.

source: Chuin Mahalalel ahin nungin Cainan kum jaget le kum somli ahingin, chapate le chanute ahingin ahi.
target: After he became the father of Mahalalel, Kenan lived 840 years and had other sons and daughters.

source: Chule Cainan damsung hinkho chu abonchan kum jakole som ahi. Chuin ama athitai.
target: Altogether, Kenan lived a total of 910 years, and then he died.

source: Chuin Mahalalel kum somgup le kum nga alhinin, Jared ahinge.
target: When Mahalalel had lived 65 years, he became the father of Jared.

source: Chuin Jared ahin nungin Mahalalel kum jaget le kum somthum ahingin, chapate le chanute ahingin ahi.
target: After he became the father of Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters.

source: Chule Mahalalel damsung hinkho chu abonchan kum jaget le kum somko le kum nga ahi. Chuin ama athitai.
target: Altogether, Mahalalel lived a total of 895 years, and then he died.

source: Chuin Jared kum jakhat le kum somgup le kumni alhinin, Enoch ahingin ahi.
target: When Jared had lived 162 years, he became the father of Enoch.

source: Chuin Enoch ahin nungin, Jared kum jaget ahingin, chapate le chanute ahingin ahi.
target: After he became the father of Enoch, Jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.

source: Chuin Jared damsung hinkho abonchan kum jakole kum somgup le kumni ahi. Chuin ama athitai.
target: Altogether, Jared lived a total of 962 years, and then he died.

source: Chuin Enoch kum somgup le kumnga alhinin, Methuselah ahinge.
target: When Enoch had lived 65 years, he became the father of Methuselah.

source: Chuin Methuselah ahin nungin, Enoch kum jathum Pathen toh alhonlen, chapate le chanute ahingin ahi.
target: After he became the father of Methuselah, Enoch walked faithfully with God 300 years and had other sons and daughters.

source: Chule Enoch hinkho damsung chu abonchan kum jathum le kum somgup le kum nga ahi.
target: Altogether, Enoch lived a total of 365 years.

source: Chule Enoch chu Pathen toh analhon len; chuin ama aum tapoi: ajehchu Pathen'in ama alamang ahitai.
target: Enoch walked faithfully with God; then he was no more, because God took him away.

source: Chuin Methuselah kum jakhat le kum somget le kum sagi alhinin, Lamech ahingin ahi.
target: When Methuselah had lived 187 years, he became the father of Lamech.

source: Chuin Lamech ahin nungin Methuselah kum jasagi le kum somget le kumni ahingin, chapate le chanute ahingin ahi.
target: After he became the father of Lamech, Methuselah lived 782 years and had other sons and daughters.

source: Chule Methuselah hinkho damsung chu abonchan kum jako le kum somgup toh kum ko ahi. Chuin ama athitai.
target: Altogether, Methuselah lived a total of 969 years, and then he died.

source: Chuin Lamech chu kum jakhatle kum somget le kumni alhinin, chapa khat ahinge.
target: When Lamech had lived 182 years, he had a son.

source: Chuin aman, Amahin Pakaiyin leiset agaosapma kona ikhutnuva inatoh le itohgim naova kona eilung monsah dingu ahi atin, amin Noah asahtai.
target: He named him Noah and said, “He will comfort us in the labor and painful toil of our hands caused by the ground the Lord has cursed.”

source: Chuin Noah ahin nungin Lamech kum janga le kum somko le kum nga ahingin, chapate le chanute ahingin ahi.
target: After Noah was born, Lamech lived 595 years and had other sons and daughters.

source: Chule Lamech hinkho damsung chu abonchan kum jasagi le kum somsagi le kum sagi ahi. Chuin ama athitai.
target: Altogether, Lamech lived a total of 777 years, and then he died.

source: Chuin Noah kum janga alhinin, Shem, Ham chule Japheth ahingin ahi.
target: After Noah was 500 years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham and Japheth.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, leiset chunga mihemho ahung pun patnuva, amaho-a dinga chanute ahungpen phatnin,
target: When human beings began to increase in number on the earth and daughters were born to them,

source: Pathen chapate chun mihem chanute amel hoithei lheh-u chu amuvin; chuin amahon adei deiju chu ji dingin akilah taovin ahi.
target: the sons of God saw that the daughters of humans were beautiful, and they married any of them they chose.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin, Kalhagao a-itih-in mihemte toh boijing ponte, ajeh chu ama tahsa phe ahin; hijongle ahinkho chu kum jakhatle kum somni hiding ahi, ati.
target: Then the Lord said, “My Spirit will not contend with humans forever, for they are mortal; their days will be a hundred and twenty years.”

source: Chuche nikho laichun leiset chunga mihat ho aumun; chule hiche nung jong chun, Pathen chapate mihem chanute koma ahung tengule, amahon amaho dingchun chate ahinpeh jiuvin; amaho chu gollui laija mihat ho, chule mi minthangho ahiuvin ahi.
target: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days—and also afterward—when the sons of God went to the daughters of humans and had children by them. They were the heroes of old, men of renown.

source: Chuin Pathen'in leiset chunga mihem khan gitlouna anasalheh jenge ti le, tantih neilouva alunggil sunga athil ngaito jouse gitlouna jeng ahi chu amutan ahi.
target: The Lord saw how great the wickedness of the human race had become on the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of the human heart was only evil all the time.

source: Chuin hichun Pathen'in leisetna mihem asem chu akisih sahtan; chule lungsung asuna lheh-in ahi.
target: The Lord regretted that he had made human beings on the earth, and his heart was deeply troubled.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin, Keiman leiset chunga konhin kasemsa mihemhi sumanghel tange; mihem ahin, gamsa ahin, akithol tho ganhing ahin, chule vanlaijola leng vacha ahin; ajehchu amaho kanasem hi kakisih tai, ati.
target: So the Lord said, “I will wipe from the face of the earth the human race I have created—and with them the animals, the birds and the creatures that move along the ground—for I regret that I have made them.”

source: Ahivangin Pakai mitmun Noah chu lunglhaina ana changin ahi.
target: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord .

source: Hichehohi Noah khangguiho chu ahi: Noah chu michondih tah le khanga miho lah-a nolnabei ahin, chule Noah Pathen toh analhon len ahi.
target: This is the account of Noah and his family. Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time, and he walked faithfully with God.

source: Chule Noah'in chapa thum, Shem, Ham chule Japheth ahingin ahi.
target: Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham and Japheth.

source: Leiset chu Pathen mitmun asedehtan, leiset chu hunamna-in adimset jeng tan ahi.
target: Now the earth was corrupt in God’s sight and was full of violence.

source: Chuin Pathen'in leiset chu aven ahile, veuvin, hichu asedeh tan ahi; ajehchu tahsa jousen leiset chunga alampiu asuboh taovin ahi.
target: God saw how corrupt the earth had become, for all the people on earth had corrupted their ways.

source: Chuin Pathen'in Noah jah-a, Tahsaphe jouse kichaina chu ka-angsung ahung lhung tai; ajehchu amaho jeh-in leiset chunghi hunam adimtan; chule ven, keiman amahohi leiset toh kasuhmang thading ahitai.
target: So God said to Noah, “I am going to put an end to all people, for the earth is filled with violence because of them. I am surely going to destroy both them and the earth.

source: Nangman Gopher thingin Kong innei khat kisemin, kong sunga chun indanho semin, chule asung apo thingnaijin loijin.
target: So make yourself an ark of cypress wood; make rooms in it and coat it with pitch inside and out.

source: Chule hichehi nangman nasem dingdan agong chu ahi: Kong innei chu adung, tong jathum, avai tong somnga chule atun tong somthum hiding ahi.
target: This is how you are to build it: The ark is to be three hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide and thirty cubits high.

source: Nangman kong innei ja chu bangkot khat nasem ding, chule hichu achung lama kon tong khatna najoding; chule kong innei kot pi chu apanga nahon ding; chule dan noinung, dan nina, chule dan thumna nasem ding ahi.
target: Make a roof for it, leaving below the roof an opening one cubit high all around. Put a door in the side of the ark and make lower, middle and upper decks.

source: Chule ven, Keima, keimatah ngeijin vannoi'a hinna hunei tahsaphe jouse sumang dinga leiset chunga twisang kahin letsah ding; chule leisetna um jouse thigam ding ahi.
target: I am going to bring floodwaters on the earth to destroy all life under the heavens, every creature that has the breath of life in it. Everything on earth will perish.

source: Ahivangin nangma toh kakitepna kaphudoh ding; chule nangma nachapate, na inneipi, chule nachapate inneipite toh Kong'a nalut dingu ahi.
target: But I will establish my covenant with you, and you will enter the ark—you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you.

source: Chule tahsaphe-a hing jouse-a kona ganhing namkim lah-a akoptocheh nangma toh hing khom dinga, Kong innei sunga chu anu khat le achal khatcheh nahinpuilut ding ahi.
target: You are to bring into the ark two of all living creatures, male and female, to keep them alive with you.

source: Vachate amaho jat dungjuija, ganchaho ama ama jat dungjui cheh-a, chule leisetna vah ganhing ama jat dungjui cheh-a, ajat jouse akopto cheh-a vah hing dinga nahenga hung diu ahi.
target: Two of every kind of bird, of every kind of animal and of every kind of creature that moves along the ground will come to you to be kept alive.

source: Chule nangman nangma dinga nehthei an jouse nalah-a, chule nakoma nakhol khom ding; chule hichu nangma le amaho dinga an hiding ahi, ati.
target: You are to take every kind of food that is to be eaten and store it away as food for you and for them.”

source: Chutichun Noah'in Pathen'in athu apeh jouse bangtah-in aboltan ahi.
target: Noah did everything just as God commanded him.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Noah jah-a, Nangma le na-insung mite nabonchaovin Kong innei sunga hunglut nun; ajehchu hiche khangmite lah-a hin kamitmun nangma michonpha nahi.
target: The Lord then said to Noah, “Go into the ark, you and your whole family, because I have found you righteous in this generation.

source: Sa theng jouse lah-a kona anu le achal to-sagi; chule sathenglou jouse lah-a kona anule achal to-ni cheh nangma toh umkhom dinga nalah ding;
target: Take with you seven pairs of every kind of clean animal, a male and its mate, and one pair of every kind of unclean animal, a male and its mate,

source: Vanlaijola leng vachate jong leiset chung pumpi-a achilhah-u aumjing nadinga, anu le achal to-sagi nalah ding ahi.
target: and also seven pairs of every kind of bird, male and female, to keep their various kinds alive throughout the earth.

source: Ni sagi joule keiman leiset chunga nisomli le jan somli go kajuhsah ding; chule keiman kasemsa ahingthei jouse leisetna kona kasuhmang ding ahi, ati.
target: Seven days from now I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, and I will wipe from the face of the earth every living creature I have made.”

source: Chuin Noah'in Pakaiyin thu apeh jouse bangtah chun aboltan ahi.
target: And Noah did all that the Lord commanded him.

source: Chule leiset chunga twisanglet chun Noah kum jagup alhingtan ahi.
target: Noah was six hundred years old when the floodwaters came on the earth.

source: Chuin Noah chu achapate toh, a-inneipi toh, chule achapate inneipiho toh twisang letding jeh chun kong innei sunga alut taovin ahi.
target: And Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives entered the ark to escape the waters of the flood.

source: Satheng lah-a kon, sathenglou lah-a kon, vachate lah-a kon, chule leiset na akitholtho ganhing jouse lah-a konin,
target: Pairs of clean and unclean animals, of birds and of all creatures that move along the ground,

source: Pathen'in Noah koma athupeh bangtah chun, anu le achal akopto cheh-in Noah koma kong innei sunga chun alut taovin ahi.
target: male and female, came to Noah and entered the ark, as God had commanded Noah.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, ni sagi jouchun leiset chunga chun twi chu ahung lentan ahi.
target: And after the seven days the floodwaters came on the earth.

source: Noah hinkho kum jagup alhinna, alhani channa, nisom le nisagi ni, chuche nitah chun twipi thuhtah nah ho jouse-a ajaltan, chule van bangkot ho akihongtan ahi.
target: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, on the seventeenth day of the second month—on that day all the springs of the great deep burst forth, and the floodgates of the heavens were opened.

source: Chule vannoi leiset chunga chun nisomli le jan somli go aju tan ahi.
target: And rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.

source: Chuche nitah chun Noah le Noah chapate Shem, Ham chule Japheth, chule Noah inneipi le achapate inneipi thum chu kong innei sunga chun alut taove.
target: On that very day Noah and his sons, Shem, Ham and Japheth, together with his wife and the wives of his three sons, entered the ark.

source: Amaho, chule gamsa jouse ama ama jat dungjui cheh-in, gancha jouse ama ama jat dungjui cheh-in, leiset na a-opma kitholtho ganhing jouse ama ama jat dungjui cheh, chule vacha namkim ama ama jat dung jui cheh-in alutsoh keijun ahi.
target: They had with them every wild animal according to its kind, all livestock according to their kinds, every creature that moves along the ground according to its kind and every bird according to its kind, everything with wings.

source: Chuin hinnahu nei tahsaphe chengse chu akopto cheh-in, Noah henga kong innei sunga chun alut taove.
target: Pairs of all creatures that have the breath of life in them came to Noah and entered the ark.

source: Chuin Pathen'in ama thu apeh bangtah-in, alut chasun chu tahsaphe pojouse anu le apa akopcheh-in alutnun ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin kot chu akhah tan ahi.
target: The animals going in were male and female of every living thing, as God had commanded Noah. Then the Lord shut him in.

source: Chuin leiset chunga chun nisomli twisang alenin; chuin twi akhang cheh cheh-in, kong innei chu aletdoh-in, chule tolla konin akikhang doh tan ahi.
target: For forty days the flood kept coming on the earth, and as the waters increased they lifted the ark high above the earth.

source: Chule twi chu akhangin, chule leiset chunga chun hatah-in akhang tan; chuin kong innei chu twi chungah akitol len ahi.
target: The waters rose and increased greatly on the earth, and the ark floated on the surface of the water.

source: Chule leiset chunga twi chu nasatah-in akhang jengtan; chuin van noija lhangsang ho jouse chu achuptan ahi.
target: They rose greatly on the earth, and all the high mountains under the entire heavens were covered.

source: Mol jouse chupmin, tong som le tong nga geijin twi chu akikhang tan ahi.
target: The waters rose and covered the mountains to a depth of more than fifteen cubits.

source: Hichun leiset chunga vahle tahsaphe po jouse, vachate jong, ganchaho jong, gamsa hojong, tolla a-opma kithol ganhing hojong, mihem jouse jong athigam heltan ahi.
target: Every living thing that moved on land perished—birds, livestock, wild animals, all the creatures that swarm over the earth, and all mankind.

source: Anah hom sunga hinna hunei, tolgoa umjouse athigam tan ahi.
target: Everything on dry land that had the breath of life in its nostrils died.

source: Hitichun leiset na cheng ahingthei jouse, mihem, gancha, a-opma kithol jouse, chule vanlaijola vachate abonchan leisetna konin akisumang tan ahi. Noah le kong innei sunga umho bouchu ahingin aumun ahi.
target: Every living thing on the face of the earth was wiped out; people and animals and the creatures that move along the ground and the birds were wiped from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those with him in the ark.

source: Chuti chun ni jakhat le nisomnga geijin, leiset chunga twi avei denin ahi.
target: The waters flooded the earth for a hundred and fifty days.

source: Chuin Pathen'in Noah le Kong innei sunga aumpi hinna nei ganhing chengse le ganchaho abonchan ageldoh-in ahi. Hichun Pathen'in vannoi leiset na hui anunsah in ahile, twi chu akemsuh tan ahi.
target: But God remembered Noah and all the wild animals and the livestock that were with him in the ark, and he sent a wind over the earth, and the waters receded.

source: Twipi thuhtah nah-ho leh van bangkot hochu akikhahtan, chule van'a kona go hungju chu atang tan ahi.
target: Now the springs of the deep and the floodgates of the heavens had been closed, and the rain had stopped falling from the sky.

source: Chuin twiho chu leisetna konin tanglouvin akemsuh-in: chule ni jakhat le nisomnga jouvin twi chu akang tan ahi.
target: The water receded steadily from the earth. At the end of the hundred and fifty days the water had gone down,

source: Chuin lhasagi channa, nisom le nisagi nin kong innei chu Ararat molchunga chun akingatan ahi.
target: and on the seventeenth day of the seventh month the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.

source: Chuin lhasom channa geijin twi chu tanglouvin akemsuh suh-in; lhasom channa nimasa ni chun molvum chu akimutan ahi.
target: The waters continued to recede until the tenth month, and on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains became visible.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, nisomli jouvin Noah'in asem kong innei bangkot chu ahongin;
target: After forty days Noah opened a window he had made in the ark

source: Chule va-ah khat alendoh sah-in ahile, leiset na kona twi chu akan kahsen alengle len ahi.
target: and sent out a raven, and it kept flying back and forth until the water had dried up from the earth.

source: Chuin leiset na twi chu kangtam ti hetna dingin ama-a konin vakhu khat alendoh sah kitnin ahi.
target: Then he sent out a dove to see if the water had receded from the surface of the ground.

source: Ahivangin leiset pumpi chunga twi aum nahlai jeh-in, vakhu chun akenga chuh-a kingah na ding mun amujoupon, ama heng lam Kong inneija chun ahung kile kittan ahi. Chuin aman akhut alhangdoh in vakhu chu Kong innei sunga chun alalut tai.
target: But the dove could find nowhere to perch because there was water over all the surface of the earth; so it returned to Noah in the ark. He reached out his hand and took the dove and brought it back to himself in the ark.

source: Chuin ama ni sagi akhongai kitnin; chuin vakhu chu kong innei sunga konin alhadoh kitnin ahi.
target: He waited seven more days and again sent out the dove from the ark.

source: Chuin nilhah lamin vakhu chu ahenga ahung kile kitnin; chule veuvin, amuh-a Olive na kiloulha thah aumin ahi. Hichun Noah'in leiset na konin twi akangtai ti ahetan ahi.
target: When the dove returned to him in the evening, there in its beak was a freshly plucked olive leaf! Then Noah knew that the water had receded from the earth.

source: Chuin ni sagima akhongai be kitnin; chuin vakhu chu alendohsah kitnin ahile, ahengah ahung kilekit tapon ahi.
target: He waited seven more days and sent the dove out again, but this time it did not return to him.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, kum jagup le kum khat na, lhamasa, chule ni masapen nichun leiset na konin twi chu akangtan ahi. Chuin Noah'in akong innei khuna chu ahohlhan, aven ahile, veuvin, leiset chunga twi chu akang tan ahi.
target: By the first day of the first month of Noah’s six hundred and first year, the water had dried up from the earth. Noah then removed the covering from the ark and saw that the surface of the ground was dry.

source: Chuin alhani channa, nisomni le ni sagi ni chun tol chu agotan ahi.
target: By the twenty-seventh day of the second month the earth was completely dry.

source: Chuin Pathen'in Noah jah-a hitin thu aseije,
target: Then God said to Noah,

source: Kong innei sunga konin nangma, na inneipi, nachapate, chule nachapate inneipi te toh potdoh taovin.
target: “Come out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and their wives.

source: Naumpi hinna nei jouse, ganhing namkim, vacha ho, gancha ho, chule tolla vah jouse chu leiset chunga chilhah tamtah neiding, hinpha ding, chule pungjal dingin kong'a konin hinpuidoh tan, ati.
target: Bring out every kind of living creature that is with you—the birds, the animals, and all the creatures that move along the ground—so they can multiply on the earth and be fruitful and increase in number on it.”

source: Hichun Noah chu achapate, a-inneipi, chule achapate inneipite toh apotdoh taovin ahi.
target: So Noah came out, together with his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives.

source: Gamsa jouse, a-opma kithol ganhing jouse, vachate jouse, chule leiset na akithol jouse chu, ama ama jat dung jui cheh-in kong innei ja konin apotdoh taove.
target: All the animals and all the creatures that move along the ground and all the birds—everything that moves on land—came out of the ark, one kind after another.

source: Chuin Noah'in Pakaiya dingin maicham khat asemin; satheng jouse-a konle vacha theng jouse-a konin alan, maicham chunga govam thilton atoh tan ahi.
target: Then Noah built an altar to the Lord and, taking some of all the clean animals and clean birds, he sacrificed burnt offerings on it.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin agimnam tuitah chu ajan, Pakaiyin alungthimin, keiman mihem jeh-in leiset gaosap kit taponge; ajehchu mihem lungsunga angaitona jouse hi achapana pat phaloupan ahitai; chule keiman kanabol banghin avelin hinna nei ganhing ho sumang taponge.
target: The Lord smelled the pleasing aroma and said in his heart: “Never again will I curse the ground because of humans, even though every inclination of the human heart is evil from childhood. And never again will I destroy all living creatures, as I have done.

source: Vannoi leiset aumlai chansea, muchi tu phat le chang-at phat, dap le sat, phalbi le nipi, sun le jan tang talou ding ahi, ati.
target: “As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night will never cease.”

source: Chuin Pathen'in Noah le achapate chu phatthei aboh-in, ajah uvah, Hin phaovin lang pungthei jun, chule leiset lodim soh-un.
target: Then God blessed Noah and his sons, saying to them, “Be fruitful and increase in number and fill the earth.

source: Chule leiset chunga gamsa jouse, vanlaijola leng vachate jouse, chule tolla vah ganhing jouse, twikhanglen na nga jouse chunga nangho ginna le kichatna umcheh ding ahi; amaho khu nangho khutna kapehdoh ahitai.
target: The fear and dread of you will fall on all the beasts of the earth, and on all the birds in the sky, on every creature that moves along the ground, and on all the fish in the sea; they are given into your hands.

source: Achatloh thei ganhing jouse nangho an ding ahi, anche louhing kapeh banga thil jouse kapeh nahiuve.
target: Everything that lives and moves about will be food for you. Just as I gave you the green plants, I now give you everything.

source: Amavang sa chu ahinna puma, hichu athisan ahin, naneh lou dingu ahi.
target: “But you must not eat meat that has its lifeblood still in it.

source: Chule thonlouva nahinnao thisan phu chu kalah ding; gamsa jouse khutna kon le, mihem khutna kona kalah ding; mitin sopi jouse khutna kona keiman mihem hinna phu chu kalah ding ahi
target: And for your lifeblood I will surely demand an accounting. I will demand an accounting from every animal. And from each human being, too, I will demand an accounting for the life of another human being.

source: Koi hile mihem thisan so-a chu ama thisan jong mihemin asoding ahi. Ajehchu aman Pathen lim banga mihem asem ahi.
target: “Whoever sheds human blood, by humans shall their blood be shed; for in the image of God has God made mankind.

source: Chule nangho, hinpha uvin, chule punguvin; leiset chunga hin chilhah tamtah hinguvin, chule asunga hin hapunin pungun, ati.
target: As for you, be fruitful and increase in number; multiply on the earth and increase upon it.”

source: Chuin Pathen'in Noah le aumpi achapate jah-a thu aseijin,
target: Then God said to Noah and to his sons with him:

source: Veuvin, keiman nangho le nangho nunga nachilhah teo toh kakitepna kaphutdetne;
target: “I now establish my covenant with you and with your descendants after you

source: Chule nangma toh uma hinna nei ganhing jouse, vachate, ganchate, chule leisetna naumpi gamsa chengse; Kong innei sunga kona hung potdoh jouse-a kona leiset chunga gamsa jouse toh kakitepna kaphutdetnin ahi.
target: and with every living creature that was with you—the birds, the livestock and all the wild animals, all those that came out of the ark with you—every living creature on earth.

source: Chule keiman nangma toh kakitepna kaphudet ding; tahsaphe pojouse twisang letna avela kisumang kit talou ding; chule leiset sumang dinga jong twisang lenkit talou ding ahi, ati.
target: I establish my covenant with you: Never again will all life be destroyed by the waters of a flood; never again will there be a flood to destroy the earth.”

source: Chuin Pathen'in, Hichehi keima le nangma chule nangma toh umkhom hinna nei ganhing jouse toh akhang akhanga dinga kakitepna melchihna ahi:
target: And God said, “This is the sign of the covenant I am making between me and you and every living creature with you, a covenant for all generations to come:

source: Keiman ka lhagui meilah-a kakoije, hichehi keima le leiset kah-a kitepna melchihna ahi.
target: I have set my rainbow in the clouds, and it will be the sign of the covenant between me and the earth.

source: Chule hitiding ahi, Keiman leiset chunga meibol kahin kaisah teng, meilah-a chu lhagui kimuding ahin;
target: Whenever I bring clouds over the earth and the rainbow appears in the clouds,

source: Chule keiman nangho le tahsaphe po hinna nei ganhing jouse toh kakitepna chu kageldoh ding; twi chu tahsaphe pojouse sumang dinga lenkit talou ding ahi.
target: I will remember my covenant between me and you and all living creatures of every kind. Never again will the waters become a flood to destroy all life.

source: Chule lhagui chu meilah-a umding, Pathen le leiset chunga tahsaphe po hinna nei ganhing jouse toh tonsotna dinga kakitepna chu kageldohna dinga, hichu kahin vetding ahi, ati.
target: Whenever the rainbow appears in the clouds, I will see it and remember the everlasting covenant between God and all living creatures of every kind on the earth.”

source: Chuin Pathen'in Noah jah-a, hichehi keima le leiset chunga tahsaphe po jouse kikah-a kaphudoh kakitepna melchihna ahi, ati.
target: So God said to Noah, “This is the sign of the covenant I have established between me and all life on the earth.”

source: Kong innei sunga kona potdoh Noah chapate chu Shem, Ham chule Japheth ahiuve: chule Ham chu Canaan pa ahi.
target: The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham and Japheth. (Ham was the father of Canaan.)

source: Hiche hohi Noah chapate thumho chu ahiuvin; chule amaho-a kona hi leiset pumpi losoh-a uma ahi.
target: These were the three sons of Noah, and from them came the people who were scattered over the whole earth.

source: Chuin Noah'in loulhou mi ahunghi panin, chule lengpilei abolin ahi.
target: Noah, a man of the soil, proceeded to plant a vineyard.

source: Chuin aman lengpitwi adonin ahile akhamtan; apon in sunga chun pon sillouvin aumtan ahi.
target: When he drank some of its wine, he became drunk and lay uncovered inside his tent.

source: Chuin Canaan pa Ham chun apa sagohkeu chu amun, inpo-a um asopiteni jah-a chun aseijin ahi.
target: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father naked and told his two brothers outside.

source: Chuin Shem le Japheth'in pon alalhonin, alengkou gela abang lhonin, anungtoi lhonin, apao sagohkeu chu pon aga khu lhonin; chule amailhon anung ngat lhonin, apao sagohkeu chu amulhon pon ahi.
target: But Shem and Japheth took a garment and laid it across their shoulders; then they walked in backward and covered their father’s naked body. Their faces were turned the other way so that they would not see their father naked.

source: Chuin Noah alengpitwi khama konin ahung limdoh-in, achapa neojon abolna chu ahetan ahi.
target: When Noah awoke from his wine and found out what his youngest son had done to him,

source: Chuin aman, Canaan chungah gaosap lhunghen, asopi teni henga soh ho soh hihen, ati.
target: he said, “Cursed be Canaan! The lowest of slaves will he be to his brothers.”

source: Chuin aman, Shem Pakai Pathen chu nunnom hen, chule Canaan chu asoh-in panghen.
target: He also said, “Praise be to the Lord , the God of Shem! May Canaan be the slave of Shem.

source: Pathen'in Japheth khantousah hen, chule ama Shem pon in ho-a chengding; chule Canaan chu asoh hiding ahi.
target: May God extend Japheth’s territory; may Japheth live in the tents of Shem, and may Canaan be the slave of Japheth.”

source: Chuin twisanglet nungin Noah kum jathum le kum somnga ahing nalaijin ahi.
target: After the flood Noah lived 350 years.

source: Chule Noah hinkho abonchan kum jakole kum somnga ahi. Chuin ama athitan ahi.
target: Noah lived a total of 950 years, and then he died.

source: Hichehi Noah chapate Shem, Ham chule Japheth akhanggui lhah-u ahi: Twisanglet nung chun amahon chapate ahingun ahi.
target: This is the account of Shem, Ham and Japheth, Noah’s sons, who themselves had sons after the flood.

source: Japheth achapate chu, Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech chule Tiras ahiuve.
target: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek and Tiras.

source: Chule Gomer chapate chu, Ashkenaz, Riphath, chule Togarmah ahiuve.
target: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath and Togarmah.

source: Chule Javan chapate chu, Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim chuleh Dodanim ahiuve.
target: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites and the Rodanites.

source: Hiteho-a kon chun twikol gama cheng chidang namdangho chu apao dungjui cheh le ama inko dungjui cheh, chule anam dung jui cheh-un ahung kikhen jal taovin ahi.
target: (From these the maritime peoples spread out into their territories by their clans within their nations, each with its own language.)

source: Chule Ham chapate chu, Cush, Mizraim, Put chule Canaan ahiuve.
target: The sons of Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put and Canaan.

source: Chule Cush chapate chu, Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, chuleh Sabtecha ahiuve. Chule Raamah chapateni chu, Sheba le Dedan ahilhone.
target: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah and Sabteka. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

source: Chuin Cush'in Nimrod ahingin; ama chu leiset chunga mi thahat tahkhat ahung hitan ahi.
target: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who became a mighty warrior on the earth.

source: Ama chu Pakai mitmun gamleng hattah ahin; hijeh chun, Pakai mitmu-a gamleng hattah Nimrod bangin, tin akiseijin ahi.
target: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord ; that is why it is said, “Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the Lord .”

source: Chule alenggam kipatna chu Shinar gamsunga um Babel, Erech, Accad, chule Calneh ahi.
target: The first centers of his kingdom were Babylon, Uruk, Akkad and Kalneh, in Shinar.

source: Chuche gama kon chun Assyria gama alutnin, Nineveh, Rehoboth, chule Calah khopi asadoh-in,
target: From that land he went to Assyria, where he built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah

source: Chule Nineveh le Calah kikah-a chun Resen atungdoh-e; hichu khopi lentah ahi.
target: and Resen, which is between Nineveh and Calah—which is the great city.

source: Chuin Mizraim'in Ludim, Anamin, Lehabim, chule Naphtuhim,
target: Egypt was the father of the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites,

source: Pathrusim chule Casluhim, (ama-a kona chu Philistine te hungdoh ahi,) chule Caphtorim ahingin ahi.
target: Pathrusites, Kasluhites (from whom the Philistines came) and Caphtorites.

source: Chuin Canaan'in apeng masa pen Sidon ahingin, chuin Heth;
target: Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,

source: Jebus miho, Amor miho, Girgas miho,
target: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,

source: Hiv miho, Ark miho, Sin miho,
target: Hivites, Arkites, Sinites,

source: Arvad miho, Zemar miho, chule Hamath miho ahingin ahi. Chule khonungin Canaan mite insungmi ho gamtinnah akithejal taovin ahi.
target: Arvadites, Zemarites and Hamathites. Later the Canaanite clans scattered

source: Chule Canaan mite gamgi chu Sidon'a pat Gerar lang jonin Gaza geijin akilhunglut peh-in, Sodom lam jonin akilhungin, Gomorrah aphan, Admah ahinphan, chule Zeboiim ahopan, Lasha geijin akilhunglut peh-e.
target: and the borders of Canaan reached from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and then toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboyim, as far as Lasha.

source: Hite hohi aphung aphung cheh, apao apao cheh, agam agam cheh, chule anam dol cheh-a Ham son ahiuve.
target: These are the sons of Ham by their clans and languages, in their territories and nations.

source: Japheth upa, Eber chate pubulpi Shem jong chun chanute chapate ahingin ahi.
target: Sons were also born to Shem, whose older brother was Japheth; Shem was the ancestor of all the sons of Eber.

source: Shem chapate chu, Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, chule Aram ahiuve.
target: The sons of Shem: Elam, Ashur, Arphaxad, Lud and Aram.

source: Chule Aram chate chu, Uz, Hul, Gether chule Mash ahiuve.
target: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether and Meshek.

source: Chuin Arphaxad'in Shelah ahingin, chule Shelah'in Eber ahinge.
target: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah the father of Eber.

source: Chuin Eber'in chapa ni ahingin: khatpa min chu Peleg ahi, ajehchu ama khanga vannoi leiset kikhen ahi; chule asopipa min chu Joktan ahi.
target: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided; his brother was named Joktan.

source: Chuin Joktan'in Almodad, Shaleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
target: Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

source: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
target: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

source: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
target: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

source: Ophir, Havilah, chule Jobab ahinge: hichengse hi Joktan chapate ahiuve.
target: Ophir, Havilah and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.

source: Chule achennao gam chu Mesha'a patna Sephar lam jotna solam molsang chan ahi.
target: The region where they lived stretched from Mesha toward Sephar, in the eastern hill country.

source: Hichenghi hi aphung dung jui cheh-u, apao dung jui cheh-u, agamkai dung jui cheh-u, chule anam dung jui cheh uva Shem chapate chu ahiuve.
target: These are the sons of Shem by their clans and languages, in their territories and nations.

source: Hicheng hi Noah chate insungmi, akhang dung juile anam dung juija ahiuve: chule amaho-a kona hi twisanglet nunga vannoi leiset na namtin hi kihom khena ahi.
target: These are the clans of Noah’s sons, according to their lines of descent, within their nations. From these the nations spread out over the earth after the flood.

source: Chule vannoi leiset pumpi chun paokhat hamkhat athouvin ahi.
target: Now the whole world had one language and a common speech.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, amaho solama acheuvin ahile, Shinar gama phaicham khat amuvin; hia chun amaho acheng taovin ahi.
target: As people moved eastward, they found a plain in Shinar and settled there.

source: Chuin amahole ama ho akihouvun, Hungun, eihon cheh dengu hitin, phatah in goutah-u hite, akitiuve. Chuin amahon song khelin cheh amangun, athoimatna khelin vahaibon amangun ahi.
target: They said to each other, “Come, let’s make bricks and bake them thoroughly.” They used brick instead of stone, and tar for mortar.

source: Chuin amahon, Hungun, eihon eiho dingin khopi khat le insang tah khat, aleh van ho sunphan sao hitin; chule iminu thansah-u hite, achuti louleh eiho vannoi leiset pumpi-ah kithecheh getnu hite, atiuve.
target: Then they said, “Come, let us build ourselves a city, with a tower that reaches to the heavens, so that we may make a name for ourselves; otherwise we will be scattered over the face of the whole earth.”

source: Chuin mihem chate khopi leh insang sah chu ve dingin Pakai chu ahung kum lhan ahi.
target: But the Lord came down to see the city and the tower the people were building.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin, Veuvin, mihohi pumkhat le paokhat ahiuvin; chule hichehi amahon abol patnu ahitai: chule tu-a amahon boldinga alunggotnu chu imachan asuhtang loudiu ahi.
target: The Lord said, “If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.

source: Hungun, eiho kumsuh-u hitin, khatnin khat thusei ahetmo na diuvin, khu kom akhun apaovu gasucheh uhite, ati.
target: Come, let us go down and confuse their language so they will not understand each other.”

source: Chuti chun Pakaiyin amaho chu chua kon chun vannoi leiset pumpi chungah akhenchehtan ahi. Chuin amahon akhopi sah-u chu adalha taove.
target: So the Lord scattered them from there over all the earth, and they stopped building the city.

source: Hijeh chun chukom mun chu Babel asah taove; ajehchu chukom munna Pakaiyin vannoi pumpi pao asuhcheh-a; chule chukoma kona chu Pakaiyin amaho chu vannoi leiset pumpi-a athecheh ahi.
target: That is why it was called Babel—because there the Lord confused the language of the whole world. From there the Lord scattered them over the face of the whole earth.

source: Hiche hohi Shem khanggui hochu ahiuve: Shem kum jakhat alhinin, twisanglet nung kumni jouvin Arphaxad ahingin ahi
target: This is the account of Shem’s family line. Two years after the flood, when Shem was 100 years old, he became the father of Arphaxad.

source: Chule Arphaxad ahin nungin Shem kum janga ahingin, chapate le chanute ahingin ahi.
target: And after he became the father of Arphaxad, Shem lived 500 years and had other sons and daughters.

source: Chuin Arphaxad kum jathum le somthum le nga alhinin, Shelah ahingin ahi.
target: When Arphaxad had lived 35 years, he became the father of Shelah.

source: Chule Shelah ahin nungin Arphaxad kum jali le kum thum ahingin, chapate le chanute ahingin ahi.
target: And after he became the father of Shelah, Arphaxad lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.

source: Chuin Shelah kum somthum alhinin, Eber ahingin ahi.
target: When Shelah had lived 30 years, he became the father of Eber.

source: Chuin Eber ahin nungin Shelah kum jali le kum somthum ahing nalaijin, chanute le chapate ahingin ahi.
target: And after he became the father of Eber, Shelah lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.

source: Chuin Eber kum somthum le kum li alhinin, Peleg ahingin ahi.
target: When Eber had lived 34 years, he became the father of Peleg.

source: Chule Peleg ahin nungin, Eber kum jali le kum somthum ahing nalaijin, chapate le chanute ahingin ahi.
target: And after he became the father of Peleg, Eber lived 430 years and had other sons and daughters.

source: Chuin Peleg kum somthum alhinin, Reu ahingin ahi.
target: When Peleg had lived 30 years, he became the father of Reu.

source: Chule Reu ahin nungin Peleg kum jani le kum ko ahing nalaijin, chapate le chanute ahingin ahi
target: And after he became the father of Reu, Peleg lived 209 years and had other sons and daughters.

source: Chuin Reu kum somthum le kum ni alhinin, Serug ahingin ahi.
target: When Reu had lived 32 years, he became the father of Serug.

source: Chule Serug ahin nungin Reu kum jani le kum sagi ahing nalaijin, chapate le chanute ahingin ahi.
target: And after he became the father of Serug, Reu lived 207 years and had other sons and daughters.

source: Chuin Serug kum somthum alhinin, Nahor ahingin ahi.
target: When Serug had lived 30 years, he became the father of Nahor.

source: Chule Nahor ahin nungin Serug kum jani ahing nalaijin, chapate le chanute ahingin ahi.
target: And after he became the father of Nahor, Serug lived 200 years and had other sons and daughters.

source: Chuin Nahor kum somni le kum ko alhinin, Terah ahingin ahi.
target: When Nahor had lived 29 years, he became the father of Terah.

source: Chule Terah ahin nungin, Nahor kum jakhat le kum somleko ahing nalaijin, chapate le chanute ahingin ahi.
target: And after he became the father of Terah, Nahor lived 119 years and had other sons and daughters.

source: Chuin Terah kum somsagi alhinin Abram, Nahor, chule Haran ahingin ahi.
target: After Terah had lived 70 years, he became the father of Abram, Nahor and Haran.

source: Tun hicheng hi Terah khanggui ahi: Terah in Abram, Nahor chule Haran ahingin, chule Haran-in Lot ahingin, ahi.
target: This is the account of Terah’s family line. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor and Haran. And Haran became the father of Lot.

source: Chuin Haran chu apa Terah athi masangin apenna Chaldea gama Ur kho-a chun athitan.
target: While his father Terah was still alive, Haran died in Ur of the Chaldeans, in the land of his birth.

source: Abram le Nahor vang chun ji anei gel lhonin: Abram jinu chu amin Sarai ahin, Nahor jinu min chu Milkah ahin, Haran chanu ahi; amahi Milkah le Iscah hingah apalhon ahi.
target: Abram and Nahor both married. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milkah; she was the daughter of Haran, the father of both Milkah and Iskah.

source: Ahivangin Sarai chu aching ahin, cha neilou ahi.
target: Now Sarai was childless because she was not able to conceive.

source: Chuin Terah chun achapa Abram, atupa Haran chapa Lot, chule amounu Sarai, Abram inneipi chu apuijin, amaho chu Chaldea gama Ur'a konchun Canaan gama dingin ache taovin ahi. Chuin Amaho Haran alhungun, chukoma chun acheng taovin ahi.
target: Terah took his son Abram, his grandson Lot son of Haran, and his daughter-in-law Sarai, the wife of his son Abram, and together they set out from Ur of the Chaldeans to go to Canaan. But when they came to Harran, they settled there.

source: Chuin Terah hinkho chu kum jani le kum nga ahin; Terah Haran mun'a athitan ahi.
target: Terah lived 205 years, and he died in Harran.

source: Tun Pakaiyin Abram jah-a, Nagama kon, naphung chanpi ho-a kon, chule napa insunga konin potdoh inlang, keiman nangma kavetsah ding gama chun chen;
target: The Lord had said to Abram, “Go from your country, your people and your father’s household to the land I will show you.

source: Chule keiman nangma nam lentah khatna kasemding, chule keiman nangma phatthei kaboh-a, namin kaloupisah ding; chule nangma phatthei boh chang nahiding, ahi.
target: “I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, and you will be a blessing.

source: Chule nangma phatthei naboh ho chu keiman phatthei kabohding, chule na gaosap hochu kagaosap ding ahi; chule nangma-a kona leisetna insung jouse phatthei chang diu ahi, ati.
target: I will bless those who bless you, and whoever curses you I will curse; and all peoples on earth will be blessed through you.”

source: Chuti chun Pakaiyin ajah-a aseibang chun Abram akipatdoh tan; chule Lot jong amatoh akilhonin ahi. Chule Haran'a kona akipatdoh chun Abram kum somsagi le kum nga ahitai.
target: So Abram went, as the Lord had told him; and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he set out from Harran.

source: Chuin Abram'in a-inneipi Sarai, asopipa chapa Lot, alamdoh thil jouse, chule Haran'a peng amite jouse chu akipuijin; Canaan gam jonin akipat doh-un; chule Canaan gam chu ahung lhung taove.
target: He took his wife Sarai, his nephew Lot, all the possessions they had accumulated and the people they had acquired in Harran, and they set out for the land of Canaan, and they arrived there.

source: Chuin Abram'in gamsung chu Shechem gei, gangpi thing kena Moreh gei achonsoh-in ahi. Chuche laichun agama chun Canaan miho achengun ahi.
target: Abram traveled through the land as far as the site of the great tree of Moreh at Shechem. At that time the Canaanites were in the land.

source: Chuin Pakai chu Abram henga akilah-in, ajah-a, Hiche gamhi nachilhah te henga kapeh ding ahi, ati. Chuin aman ahenga hung kilah Pakai ding chun chukoma chun maicham khat asemin ahi.
target: The Lord appeared to Abram and said, “To your offspring I will give this land.” So he built an altar there to the Lord , who had appeared to him.

source: Chuin ama chukoma konchun Bethel solama Molsang khat na akichonin, Bethel lhumlam le Ai solam kah-a apon in asongin ahi; chukoma chun Pakai dingin maicham asemin, Pakai min akouvin ahi.
target: From there he went on toward the hills east of Bethel and pitched his tent, with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to the Lord and called on the name of the Lord .

source: Chuin Abram chu lhanglam jonin achepeh nalaijin ahi.
target: Then Abram set out and continued toward the Negev.

source: Chuin gamsunga chun kel alhan: chule Abram Egypt gama cham dingin achesuh tan ahi; ajehchu gam sunga chun kel akhoh lheh jengin ahi.
target: Now there was a famine in the land, and Abram went down to Egypt to live there for a while because the famine was severe.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Egypt gam alutding konin, a-inneipi Sarai jah-a, Tun vetan, nangma vetdinga numei melhoitah nahi ti kahei.
target: As he was about to enter Egypt, he said to his wife Sarai, “I know what a beautiful woman you are.

source: Chuti ahijeh-a chu hung hiti ding ahi, Egypt mihon namu tenguleh, hiche hi a-inneipi ahi, atidiu; chule amahon keima eitha uva, nangma vang nahinghoi dingu ahi.
target: When the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ Then they will kill me but will let you live.

source: Nangma vanga phatah-a kaum theina dingle, nangma jala kahinthei na dingin, anaonu kahi tin seijin, tia katao ahi, ati.
target: Say you are my sister, so that I will be treated well for your sake and my life will be spared because of you.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Abram Egypt gam alhun phatnin, Egypt mihon numei chu amuvin, amel chu hoi asalheh jengun ahi.
target: When Abram came to Egypt, the Egyptians saw that Sarai was a very beautiful woman.

source: Pharoah semanghon jong amanu chu amuvin, chule Pharoah jah-a aseiphaovin ahi. Chuin numeinu chu Pharoah insunga apuilut taovin ahi.
target: And when Pharaoh’s officials saw her, they praised her to Pharaoh, and she was taken into his palace.

source: Chuin aman Abram chu amanu jal chun abol pha lheh-in ahi. Chule aman kelngoi, bongchal, sanganchal, soh pasal, soh numei, sangan nu, chule sangongsao aneitan ahi.
target: He treated Abram well for her sake, and Abram acquired sheep and cattle, male and female donkeys, male and female servants, and camels.

source: Ahivangin Abram inneipi Sarai jeh chun Pakai chun Pharoah leh a-insung mite chu hise nasatah-in asugenthei tan ahi.
target: But the Lord inflicted serious diseases on Pharaoh and his household because of Abram’s wife Sarai.

source: Chuin Pharoah'in Abram chu akouvin, ajah-a, Kachunga nathil bol hi ipi hitam? Na-inneipi ahichu ipi dinga neisei peh lou ham?
target: So Pharaoh summoned Abram. “What have you done to me?” he said. “Why didn’t you tell me she was your wife?

source: Ipi dinga kanaonu ahi nati ham? Hijehchu ahi ka-inneipi dinga kana kipui lona chu; hijeh chun tun na inneipi hi ven, kipuijin lang chemang tan, ati.
target: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now then, here is your wife. Take her and go!”

source: Chuin Pharoah'in ama chung changa chun amite chu thu apen; amahon amachu a-inneipi toh, anei chengse toh asolmang taovin ahi.
target: Then Pharaoh gave orders about Abram to his men, and they sent him on his way, with his wife and everything he had.

source: Chuin Abram Egypt gama konin apotnin, a-inneipi, anei chengse, chuleh Lot toh lhanglam ajon taove.
target: So Abram went up from Egypt to the Negev, with his wife and everything he had, and Lot went with him.

source: Chuin Abram chu gancha, dangka chule sana in ahao lheh jengin ahi.
target: Abram had become very wealthy in livestock and in silver and gold.

source: Chuin ama lhanglama kon chun Bethel geijin achepeh-in, Bethel le Ai kah-a atilla apon in sonna mun geichun achen;
target: From the Negev he went from place to place until he came to Bethel, to the place between Bethel and Ai where his tent had been earlier

source: Amasa-a maicham asem na mun chu ahung lhun tan ahi. Chukoma chun Abram Pakai minin ataovin ahi.
target: and where he had first built an altar. There Abram called on the name of the Lord .

source: Chule Abram toh lhonle Lot jong chun kelngoi hon, bonghon, chule pon in aneitan ahi.
target: Now Lot, who was moving about with Abram, also had flocks and herds and tents.
