source: Chule amani chenkhom lhona dingin, agam chun adoltapon ahi: ajehchu aneilhon atam behseh jeh-in, amani achengkhom theilhon tapon ahi.
target: But the land could not support them while they stayed together, for their possessions were so great that they were not able to stay together.

source: Chuin Abram gancha ching hole Lot gancha chingho kah-a kinah na aumtan ahi. Chule chuche laichun gam sunga chun Canaan miho le Perizz miho achengun ahi.
target: And quarreling arose between Abram’s herders and Lot’s. The Canaanites and Perizzites were also living in the land at that time.

source: Chuin Abram'in Lot jah-a, Nahenga katao ahi, nangle kei kah-a, chule kagan ching te le nangma gan ching te kah-a kinah na umdahen, ajehchu eini sopikhat ihi.
target: So Abram said to Lot, “Let’s not have any quarreling between you and me, or between your herders and mine, for we are close relatives.

source: Gam apumpia namasanga um hilouham? Katao ahi, keima-a konin achomin umdoh tan; nangman veilam nakilhen leh, keima jetlama chengting; achuti louva nangma jetlama nache le, keima veilama cheng kate, ati.
target: Is not the whole land before you? Let’s part company. If you go to the left, I’ll go to the right; if you go to the right, I’ll go to the left.”

source: Lot akhodah-in, Jordan phaicham chengse chu aven ahile muntin chu twi anengin, (Pakaiyin Sodom le Gomorrah asuhmang masang ahin,) Zoar jotna geichun Egypt gam toh abangin, Pakai hon toh abangin ahi.
target: Lot looked around and saw that the whole plain of the Jordan toward Zoar was well watered, like the garden of the Lord , like the land of Egypt. (This was before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.)

source: Chujouvin Lot'in Jordan phaicham pumpi chu akilhenin, solam ngan achetan ahi. Chule amani khat chu khatna konin akikhen lhontan ahi.
target: So Lot chose for himself the whole plain of the Jordan and set out toward the east. The two men parted company:

source: Abram chu Canaan gama chun achengin, Lot chu phaichama khopi ho-a chun achengin, chuin apon in chu Sodom lam ngan asongin ahi.
target: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, while Lot lived among the cities of the plain and pitched his tents near Sodom.

source: Ahin Sodom miho chu Pakai mitmu-a khang giloutah leh chonsetah ahiuve.
target: Now the people of Sodom were wicked and were sinning greatly against the Lord .

source: Chuin Abram'a kona Lot akikhendoh jouvin, Pakaiyin Abram jah-a, Tun khodah inlang, naum namun na kon chun sahlam, lhanglam, solam, chule lhumlam vetemin,
target: The Lord said to Abram after Lot had parted from him, “Look around from where you are, to the north and south, to the east and west.

source: Ajehchu nangman namu gam chengse apumpia nangma le nachilhahte tonsotna dinga kapeh ding ahi.
target: All the land that you see I will give to you and your offspring forever.

source: Chule keiman nachilhah te leisetna leivuijat kahisah ding; chule mikhatnin leiset chunga leivui asimjouva ahileh nangma chilhahte jong kisimjou ding ahi.
target: I will make your offspring like the dust of the earth, so that if anyone could count the dust, then your offspring could be counted.

source: Kipat doh-in, hiche gam hi adung avai chonchan len, ajehchu keiman hichehi nangma kapeh ding nahi, ati.
target: Go, walk through the length and breadth of the land, for I am giving it to you.”

source: Chujouvin Abram'in apon in chu achonin, ache achen Hebron gama Mamre gangpi phaicham koma chun achengin, chule chukoma chun Pakai dingin maicham khat asemin ahi.
target: So Abram went to live near the great trees of Mamre at Hebron, where he pitched his tents. There he built an altar to the Lord .

source: Chuin Shinar lengpa Amraphel, Ellasar lengpa Arioch, Elam lengpa Chedorlaomer, chule namho lengpa Tidal alal laijuvin ahitin ahi.
target: At the time when Amraphel was king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Kedorlaomer king of Elam and Tidal king of Goyim,

source: Hicheho hin Sodom lengpa Bera, Gomorrah lengpa Birsha, Admah lengpa Shinab, Zeboiim lengpa Shenaber, chule Zoar kiti Bela lengpa akisat piuvin ahi.
target: these kings went to war against Bera king of Sodom, Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, Shemeber king of Zeboyim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar).

source: Amaho abonun chi dillen pang Shiddim phaichama chun akikhomun ahi.
target: All these latter kings joined forces in the Valley of Siddim (that is, the Dead Sea Valley).

source: Amahon kum somle kum ni Chedorlaomer anajenu ahin, kum som le kum thum channa-in akiphin taovin ahi.
target: For twelve years they had been subject to Kedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

source: Chuin kum som le kum li alhin kum-in Chedorlaomer lengpan aumpi leng dang ho toh ahung konun, Ashteroth Karnaim gama Rephaim mite, Ham gama Juzim mite, Shaveh Kiriathaim gama Emim mite athat uvin,
target: In the fourteenth year, Kedorlaomer and the kings allied with him went out and defeated the Rephaites in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzites in Ham, the Emites in Shaveh Kiriathaim

source: Chule Hor mite chu aum nau Seir Molsang gei le, gamthip gamgia um El Paran changei jin athat taovin ahi.
target: and the Horites in the hill country of Seir, as far as El Paran near the desert.

source: Chuin amaho ahung kileuvin En-mishpat (hichu Kadesh ahi,) 'ah ahungun, Amalek mite gam pumpi le Hazezon-tamar-a cheng Amor mite chu athat kitnun ahi.
target: Then they turned back and went to En Mishpat (that is, Kadesh), and they conquered the whole territory of the Amalekites, as well as the Amorites who were living in Hazezon Tamar.

source: Chuphat nin Sodom lengpa, Gomorrah lengpa, Admah lengpa, Zeboiim lengpa, chule Bela lengpa (Bela chu Zoar ahi;) chu akipat doh-un, amaho chutoh kisat dingin Siddim phaichama apangkhomun,
target: Then the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboyim and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) marched out and drew up their battle lines in the Valley of Siddim

source: Elam lengpa Chedorlaomer, namtin lengpa Tidal, Shinar lengpa Amraphel, chule Ellasar lengpa Arioch dounan, lengli chu leng nga chutoh akisat taovin ahi.
target: against Kedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goyim, Amraphel king of Shinar and Arioch king of Ellasar—four kings against five.

source: Siddim phaichama chu vahaibon dimset ahin; hia chun Sodom lengpa le Gomorrah lengpa ajam nalam lhonna alhalut lhontan; chuleh amoh chengse chu molsang lamah ajam taovin ahi.
target: Now the Valley of Siddim was full of tar pits, and when the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, some of the men fell into them and the rest fled to the hills.

source: Chuin amahon Sodom le Gomorrah neile gou jouse, chule aneh achah jouse apouvin, achemang taove.
target: The four kings seized all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their food; then they went away.

source: Chuin amahon Sodom'a cheng Abram sopipa chapa Lot jong chu anei chengse toh apuimang taovin ahi.
target: They also carried off Abram’s nephew Lot and his possessions, since he was living in Sodom.

source: Chuin asohcha khatnin Hebrew mi Abram jah-a chun thu ahung lhutnin ahi; hichepetna chu ama Eshcol le Aner sopipa, Amor mi hotoh Mamre gangpi phaicham koma chun achengun ahi. Chule amaho chu Abram toh thukhat kisa-a ahiuve.
target: A man who had escaped came and reported this to Abram the Hebrew. Now Abram was living near the great trees of Mamre the Amorite, a brother of Eshkol and Aner, all of whom were allied with Abram.

source: Chuin Abram'in asopipa gal hinga akaiju ajah phatnin, ama insunga pengcheh, hilthemsa cheh asohte jathum le somleget akipuijin, Dan geijin anung deltan ahi.
target: When Abram heard that his relative had been taken captive, he called out the 318 trained men born in his household and went in pursuit as far as Dan.

source: Chuin jan-in amaho nokhum dingin amale asohte chu akihom khenun, chuin amaho chu athatnun, Damascus sahlama um Hobah chan geijin adelun ahi.
target: During the night Abram divided his men to attack them and he routed them, pursuing them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus.

source: Chuin aman neile gou jouse, asopipa Lot jong chu aneile gou chengse toh, chule numei hole miho jong chu ahin lepuikit tan ahi.
target: He recovered all the goods and brought back his relative Lot and his possessions, together with the women and the other people.

source: Chuin aman Chedorlaomer le aumpi lengho chu atha jouva ahung kile kit phatnin, Sodom lengpa chu Abram lamto dingin Shaveh phaichama achen ahi (hichu leng phaicham ahi).
target: After Abram returned from defeating Kedorlaomer and the kings allied with him, the king of Sodom came out to meet him in the Valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).

source: Chuin Shalem lengpa Melchizedec'in changlhah le lengpitwi ahin choijin ahi; ama chu chungnung pen Pathen Thempu ahi.
target: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High,

source: Chule Aman Abram chu phatthei aboh-in, Van le lei neipa chungnung pen Pathen'a konin Abram phatthei changhen.
target: and he blessed Abram, saying, “Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth.

source: Chule nagal mite nakhutna pedoh-a chungnung pen Pathen nunnom hen, ati. Chuin Abram'in amachu aneijouse hopsom-a hopkhat apen ahi.
target: And praise be to God Most High, who delivered your enemies into your hand.” Then Abram gave him a tenth of everything.

source: Chuin Sodom lengpan Abram jah-a, Miho chu keima neipen lang, thilkeo hochu nangma changtan, ati.
target: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people and keep the goods for yourself.”

source: Chuin Abram'in Sodom lengpa jah-a chun, Keima van le leiset neipa, chungnung pen Pakai Pathen henga kakhut kadop sang ahi.
target: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, “With raised hand I have sworn an oath to the Lord , God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,

source: Keiman pat jang kengchot khao te jeng jong, nanga pou pou chu kalah louding ahi, atiloule, Keiman Abram kahao sahtai, tiget nin nate.
target: that I will accept nothing belonging to you, not even a thread or the strap of a sandal, so that you will never be able to say, ‘I made Abram rich.’

source: Gollhang hon aneh mangu chule kalhonpi Aner, Eshcol, chule Mamre hiteho chu achan ding dol changu hen, ati.
target: I will accept nothing but what my men have eaten and the share that belongs to the men who went with me—to Aner, Eshkol and Mamre. Let them have their share.”

source: Hicheho nunghin Pakai thu chu Abram henga gaovin ahungin, ajah-a, Kicha hih-in, Abram, keima nalumdal le nakipa man lentah chu kahi, ati.
target: After this, the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision: “Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward.”

source: Chuin Abram'in, Pakai Pathen, chabeija kaum dending namu nunga nangman keima ipi neipeh ding ham? Chule ka-insunga goulo dingla hiche Damascus mi Eliezar ahibouvin, ati.
target: But Abram said, “Sovereign Lord , what can you give me since I remain childless and the one who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”

source: Chuin Abram'in, Vetan, nangman keima chi neikhaisah pon; chule Ven, ka-insunga penga chu kagou loding ahi, ati.
target: And Abram said, “You have given me no children; so a servant in my household will be my heir.”

source: Chuphatnin veuvin, Pakai thu chu ahenga ahung lhungin, ajah-a, Amachu nagoulo hilouding; amavang nangma taiguija penga bou chun nagou alo ding ahi, ati.
target: Then the word of the Lord came to him: “This man will not be your heir, but a son who is your own flesh and blood will be your heir.”

source: Chuin ama chu inpolama apuidoh-in, ajah-a, Vanlam khu vetemin, ahsi khu nasimjou dingle simtemin, ati. Chuin aman ajah-a, Nachilhah jong hijat khu hiding ahi, ati.
target: He took him outside and said, “Look up at the sky and count the stars—if indeed you can count them.” Then he said to him, “So shall your offspring be.”

source: Chuin aman Pakai chu atahsan nin; chule aman hichu ama dingin chonphat na-in asimpeh tan ahi.
target: Abram believed the Lord , and he credited it to him as righteousness.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin ajah-a, Keima hiche gamhi gouva nalo dinga Chaldea gam Ur khopi-a kona nahin puidohpa Pakai chu kahi, ati.
target: He also said to him, “I am the Lord , who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to take possession of it.”

source: Chuin aman, Pakai Pathen hiche kaloding chu iti kahet dingham? ati.
target: But Abram said, “Sovereign Lord , how can I know that I will gain possession of it?”

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, Nangman kumthum lhingsa bongla khat toh, kumthum lhingsa kel-la khat toh, kumthum lhingsa kelngoichal khat toh, vakhu khat toh, vapal noukhat kahenga hinchoijin, ati.
target: So the Lord said to him, “Bring me a heifer, a goat and a ram, each three years old, along with a dove and a young pigeon.”

source: Chuin aman hicheng jouse chu ahin choijin, hiho chu ahapsatnin, hap langkhat le hap langkhat kingatton akoijin, ahin vachaho vang chu ahapsatpon ahi.
target: Abram brought all these to him, cut them in two and arranged the halves opposite each other; the birds, however, he did not cut in half.

source: Chule muthong ho chu ahung len uva sathilong chunga chu achuh ji tengule, Abram'in adel mangjin ahi.
target: Then birds of prey came down on the carcasses, but Abram drove them away.

source: Chuin nisa alhum konin, Abram chunga imut milna achutan; chule veuvin, kichat umtah muthim nasatah-in ahinkhutan ahi.
target: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and a thick and dreadful darkness came over him.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Abram jah-a, Nachilhah te chu amaho gam hilou gamkhatna maljinna gaum diu; chule amahon amaho chu ajendiu; chule amahon amaho chu kum jali abolgenthei diu ahi tihi kichentah-in hen, ati.
target: Then the Lord said to him, “Know for certain that for four hundred years your descendants will be strangers in a country not their own and that they will be enslaved and mistreated there.

source: Chule keiman aga jenu nam jong chu athu-u katan ding; chule amaho chu khonungle neile gou ninglhing setna hung potdoh diu ahi.
target: But I will punish the nation they serve as slaves, and afterward they will come out with great possessions.

source: Chule nangma napu napa te henga lhamonga nache ding; chule nangma natehkem kei teng vuija naum ding ahi.
target: You, however, will go to your ancestors in peace and be buried at a good old age.

source: Amavang khang li lhin nale amaho chu hikoma hung kile kit diu ahi: ajeh chu Amor mite khangitlouna abulhing hih laije, ati.
target: In the fourth generation your descendants will come back here, for the sin of the Amorites has not yet reached its full measure.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Nisa alhumma, mu ahung thim phatnin, veuvin, lhummei khucheichoi le meisel al lenglung chu sahap sat ho kahlah-a kitolin ahi.
target: When the sun had set and darkness had fallen, a smoking firepot with a blazing torch appeared and passed between the pieces.

source: Chuche nichun Pakaiyin Abram toh kitepna khat asemin, hitin aseije, Keiman nachilhahte henga hiche gamhi Egypt vadunga pat luilen, Euphrates vadunglen gei;
target: On that day the Lord made a covenant with Abram and said, “To your descendants I give this land, from the Wadi of Egypt to the great river, the Euphrates—

source: Ken mite, Keniz mite, Kadmon mite,
target: the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites,

source: Hit mite, Perizz mite, Rephaim mite,
target: Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites,

source: Chule Amor mite, Canaan mite, chule Jebus mite abonchauva kapeh ahitai, ati.
target: Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites and Jebusites.”

source: Tun Abram inneipi Sarai'in amachu cha ahin peh pon ahi. Chule amanun Egypt mi amin Hagar kiti soh numei khat aneijin ahi.
target: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, had borne him no children. But she had an Egyptian slave named Hagar;

source: Chuin Sarai'in Abram jah-a, Tun vetan, Pakaiyin keima chahing dingin eiphaltapoi: nahenga katao ahi, amanu-a kona chapang kaneithei khatle, kasohnu koma galut nin ati. Chuin Abram'in Sarai thu chu angaitan ahi.
target: so she said to Abram, “The Lord has kept me from having children. Go, sleep with my slave; perhaps I can build a family through her.” Abram agreed to what Sarai said.

source: Chuin Abram Canaan gama kumsom achen jouvin, Abram inneipi Sarai'in asohnu Egypt mi Hagar chu apuijin, a-inneipu Abram jidingin agapetan ahi.
target: So after Abram had been living in Canaan ten years, Sarai his wife took her Egyptian slave Hagar and gave her to her husband to be his wife.

source: Chuin ama Hagar henga chun alutnin ahile, amanun nao avoptan ahi. Chuin amanun anaovop akihet phatnin, apinu chu anoisetan ahi.
target: He slept with Hagar, and she conceived. When she knew she was pregnant, she began to despise her mistress.

source: Chuin Sarai'in Abram jah-a, Kabolkhel hi nangma mopohna ahi: Kasohnu na-angsunga dingin kapein; chule aman anaovop akihet phatnin einoisetai. Pakaiyin nang le kei kah-a thu tanhen, ati.
target: Then Sarai said to Abram, “You are responsible for the wrong I am suffering. I put my slave in your arms, and now that she knows she is pregnant, she despises me. May the Lord judge between you and me.”

source: Ahin Abram 'in Sarai jah-a, Ven nasohnu nakhut na um ahi; nangman pha nasah bang chun achunga boltan, ati. Chuin Sarai'in amanu chu abolgenthei lhehjeng phatnin, amanu ama angsunga konin ajamtai.
target: “Your slave is in your hands,” Abram said. “Do with her whatever you think best.” Then Sarai mistreated Hagar; so she fled from her.

source: Chuin Pakai vantil'in amanu chu Shur jotna lampi pam, gamthipma twikhuh khat koma amudoh tan ahi.
target: The angel of the Lord found Hagar near a spring in the desert; it was the spring that is beside the road to Shur.

source: Chuin aman, Sarai sohnu Hagar, hoija hungkon nahi-a, chule hoija cheding nahim? ati. Chuin amanun, keima kapi nu Sarai angsunga kona jam-a kahi, ati.
target: And he said, “Hagar, slave of Sarai, where have you come from, and where are you going?” “I’m running away from my mistress Sarai,” she answered.

source: Chuin Pakai vantil chun amanu jah-a, napinu henga kilekitnin, chule akhut noija kipelutnin, ati.
target: Then the angel of the Lord told her, “Go back to your mistress and submit to her.”

source: Chuin Pakai vantil chun amanu ajah-a, Keiman nachilhah hapuna kapunsah ding; atam behseh jeh uva simseng hilou dingu ahi, ati.
target: The angel added, “I will increase your descendants so much that they will be too numerous to count.”

source: Chuin Pakai vantil chun amanu jah-a, Ven, nangma naovop nahin, chule chapa khat nahin ding ahi: Nangman amin Ishmael nasahding ahi, ajehchu Pakaiyin nakibol hesohna najahpeh tai.
target: The angel of the Lord also said to her: “You are now pregnant and you will give birth to a son. You shall name him Ishmael, for the Lord has heard of your misery.

source: Chule amachu miphamo tah hiding; aman mijouse douna akhut alapding, chule ama douna-a mijousen akhut alapdiu ahi. Chule ama asopite jouse angsunga chengding ahi, ati.
target: He will be a wild donkey of a man; his hand will be against everyone and everyone’s hand against him, and he will live in hostility toward all his brothers.”

source: Chuin amanun akihoupi Pakai minchu, nangma eimu-a Pathen tin asah tai. Ajehchu amanun, keima eimu-a amachu keiman jong kamu hitam? ati.
target: She gave this name to the Lord who spoke to her: “You are the God who sees me,” for she said, “I have now seen the One who sees me.”

source: Chuche jeh chun chukom twikhuh minchu Beer-Lahai-Roi akisah tai. Veuvin, hichu Kadesh le Bered kah-a um ahi.
target: That is why the well was called Beer Lahai Roi; it is still there, between Kadesh and Bered.

source: Chuin Hagar'in Abram chapa khat ahinpehtan; chule Abram'in Hagar toh ahin achapa min chu Ishmael asahtai.
target: So Hagar bore Abram a son, and Abram gave the name Ishmael to the son she had borne.

source: Chule Hagar'in Abram dinga Ishmael ahinpeh chun, Abram kum somget le kum gup alhingtai.
target: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore him Ishmael.

source: Chuin Abram kum somko le kumko alhinin, ahenga Pakai ahung kilah-in, ajah-a, Keima hat chungnung Pathen kahi, kamasanga kitah tah-in lamlhan lang, nangma chamkimin.
target: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the Lord appeared to him and said, “I am God Almighty; walk before me faithfully and be blameless.

source: Chule keiman keimale nangma kah-a kakitepna kasemdoh ding, chule nangma hapuna kapunsah ding nahi, ati.
target: Then I will make my covenant between me and you and will greatly increase your numbers.”

source: Chuin Abram'in tolla amai asulut tan ahi. Chuin Pathen'in amachu akihoupin, ajah-a,
target: Abram fell facedown, and God said to him,

source: Keima thudol vang, ven, kakitepna chu nakoma aume, chule nangma nam tamtah pa nahi ding ahi.
target: “As for me, this is my covenant with you: You will be the father of many nations.

source: Namin jong Abram tia kikou talou ding, amavang namin Abraham tia kikou ding ahitai; ajehchu nangma namtin pa-a kasem nahitai.
target: No longer will you be called Abram; your name will be Abraham, for I have made you a father of many nations.

source: Chule keiman nangma hapuna kapunsah ding, chule nangma-a kona nam ho kasemdoh-a, chule nangma-a kona lengho hungdoh ding ahi.
target: I will make you very fruitful; I will make nations of you, and kings will come from you.

source: Keima nangma le nanunga nachilhah te-a dinga Pathen kahina dingin, keima le nangma kah-a, chule khonunga nachilhah te akhang akhanguva tonsot kitepna-a dinga kakitepna kaphudoh ding ahi.
target: I will establish my covenant as an everlasting covenant between me and you and your descendants after you for the generations to come, to be your God and the God of your descendants after you.

source: Chule keiman nakholjinna Kanaan gam pumpi hi, nangma le khonunga nachilhahte henga tonsotna nalo diuva kapeh ding; chule keima amaho Pathen kahiding ahi, ati.
target: The whole land of Canaan, where you now reside as a foreigner, I will give as an everlasting possession to you and your descendants after you; and I will be their God.”

source: Chuin Pathen'in Abraham jah-a, Nangman kakitepna hi nanitding, nangma le khonunga nachilhah ten akhang akhanguva anit diu ahi.
target: Then God said to Abraham, “As for you, you must keep my covenant, you and your descendants after you for the generations to come.

source: Keima le nangma chule nanunga nachilhahte kah-a nanitdiu kakitepna chu hiche hi ahi: Nalah uva pasal tapou chun chep atan cheh ding ahi.
target: This is my covenant with you and your descendants after you, the covenant you are to keep: Every male among you shall be circumcised.

source: Chule nanghon natahsao nachep vunnu chu natan dingu; hichu keima le nangho kah-a kitepna melchihna hiding ahi.
target: You are to undergo circumcision, and it will be the sign of the covenant between me and you.

source: Chule nalah uva mi niget lhing tapou, nason nachilhah-a pasal tapou, na-in'a peng hihen, nachilhah hilou gamdang mi nasuma nachoh hijongle, pasal tapou chu chep kitan cheh ding ahi.
target: For the generations to come every male among you who is eight days old must be circumcised, including those born in your household or bought with money from a foreigner—those who are not your offspring.

source: Na-in'a peng hihen lang, nasuma nachoh hijong leh chep kitan teiding ahi; chule kakitepna chu tonsot kitepna-a dinga natahsaova umding ahi.
target: Whether born in your household or bought with your money, they must be circumcised. My covenant in your flesh is to be an everlasting covenant.

source: Koi hijongle cheptan lou pasal chapang atahsa-a achepvun cheptan lou chu, chuche mipa chu amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi; amachun kakitepna asuhkeh ahi, ati.
target: Any uncircumcised male, who has not been circumcised in the flesh, will be cut off from his people; he has broken my covenant.”

source: Chuin Pathen'in Abraham jah-a, Na-inneipi Sarai thudol vang, Nangman amin Sarai nati tahlou ding; amavang amin Sarah hijoding ahitai.
target: God also said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you are no longer to call her Sarai; her name will be Sarah.

source: Chule keiman amanu chu phatthei kabohding, chule tahbeh-a keiman nangma amanu-a kona chapa khat jong kapeh ding nahi. Keiman amanu phatthei kabohding, chule amanu namtin nu hung hiding; chule amanu-a kona mihemte lengho hungdoh ding ahi, ati.
target: I will bless her and will surely give you a son by her. I will bless her so that she will be the mother of nations; kings of peoples will come from her.”

source: Chuin Abraham'in tolla amai asulutnin, anuijin ahi, chule alungthimin, kum jakhat mi-a dinga cha peng ding ham? Chule kum somko mi Sarah'in cha ahin nahlai ding ham? ati.
target: Abraham fell facedown; he laughed and said to himself, “Will a son be born to a man a hundred years old? Will Sarah bear a child at the age of ninety?”

source: Chuin Abraham'in Pathen henga, aw! Ishmael chu namitmu-a hingding hingta vele, ati.
target: And Abraham said to God, “If only Ishmael might live under your blessing!”

source: Chuin Pathen'in, Na-inneipi Sarah'in tahbeh-a nangma chapa khat nahin peh ding, chule nangman amin Isaac nasah ding ahi. Chule kakitepna chu amale ama nunga achilhahte dinga tonsot kitepna hidinga kasuhdet ding ahi.
target: Then God said, “Yes, but your wife Sarah will bear you a son, and you will call him Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him as an everlasting covenant for his descendants after him.

source: Chule Ishmael thudol vang, keiman nathu kangaipeh ahitai: Ven keiman ama phatthei kaboh ahitan; chule achilhah tamtah kahisah-a, hapuna kapunsah ding ahi. Aman vaipi somleni ahin ding, chule keiman ama nam lentah-a kasemding ahi.
target: And as for Ishmael, I have heard you: I will surely bless him; I will make him fruitful and will greatly increase his numbers. He will be the father of twelve rulers, and I will make him into a great nation.

source: Ahin kakitepna vang chu Sarah'in khovei tuphat teng ahinding Isaac toh kasuhdet ding ahi.
target: But my covenant I will establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you by this time next year.”

source: Chuin amatoh akihou chai phatnin, Abraham koma konin Pathen achetoutan ahi.
target: When he had finished speaking with Abraham, God went up from him.

source: Chuin Abraham'in achapa Ishmael, chule a-insung peng jouse, chule suma achohtho jouse, Abraham'in a-insunga pasal tapou chu apuijin, Pathen'in ahenga aseibangin chuche ni lele chun atahsao achep vunu atanpeh tan ahi.
target: On that very day Abraham took his son Ishmael and all those born in his household or bought with his money, every male in his household, and circumcised them, as God told him.

source: Chule Abraham chu atahsa achepvun akitan chun kum somko le ko alhingtai.
target: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised,

source: Chule achapa Ishmael chu atahsa achepvun akitan chun kum somlethum ahitai.
target: and his son Ishmael was thirteen;

source: Chuche nilele chun Abraham le achapa Ishmael'in chep atan lhon tan ahi.
target: Abraham and his son Ishmael were both circumcised on that very day.

source: Chule a-insunga pasal jouse, a-in'a pengho le gamdang mi suma kichoho jong chun amatoh chep atan cheh-un ahi.
target: And every male in Abraham’s household, including those born in his household or bought from a foreigner, was circumcised with him.

source: Chuin ama Mamre gangpi kom aponbuh kotbul-ah sun nisat petna atoupet nin Pakai chu ahengah ahung kilah-in;
target: The Lord appeared to Abraham near the great trees of Mamre while he was sitting at the entrance to his tent in the heat of the day.

source: Chuin ama akhodah-in avetna ahile, Veovin, akomtah-a chun mi thum ana dingun; chuin aman amaho chu amuphatnin, apon-inna konchun amaho lemdingin alhaijelin, tolla aboh khupmin, chibai aboh-in ahi.
target: Abraham looked up and saw three men standing nearby. When he saw them, he hurried from the entrance of his tent to meet them and bowed low to the ground.

source: Chuin aman, Ka Pakai, tu-a hi namitmu-a lunglhaina kachana ahile; katao ahi, nasoh-a konin chepai hih-in.
target: He said, “If I have found favor in your eyes, my lord, do not pass your servant by.

source: Nahenga katao ahi, twi themkhat beh hin kidomintin, chule nakengu kisilun lang, thingphung noija hin kicholdouvin,
target: Let a little water be brought, and then you may all wash your feet and rest under this tree.

source: Chule nalungthimu akitha-ol theina dingin, changlhah themkhat beh nagalah peh uvinge; chujouteng nangho chepan naovin nate: ajehchu nasoh henga hunga nahi tangalun, ati. Chuin amahon, nasei bangin boltan, atiuve.
target: Let me get you something to eat, so you can be refreshed and then go on your way—now that you have come to your servant.” “Very well,” they answered, “do as you say.”

source: Chuin Abraham pon insunga Sarah henga alhailut jel-in, ajah-a, Changbong phatah atena dimthum tenlang, hichu mehin lang, gangtah-in thuh chunga changlhah semin, ati.
target: So Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah. “Quick,” he said, “get three seahs of the finest flour and knead it and bake some bread.”

source: Chuin Abraham bonghon lama alhai jel-in, bongnou nouchet hoitah khat alan, hichu gollhang khat apen, aman hichu gangtah-in agasemin ahi.
target: Then he ran to the herd and selected a choice, tender calf and gave it to a servant, who hurried to prepare it.

source: Chuin aman bongnoi ha le bongnoi chule bongnou sa asem chu achoijin, a-angsung uva aluipeh-in chule amahon anehpetnu chun, ama akomuva thingphung noija chun adingin ahi.
target: He then brought some curds and milk and the calf that had been prepared, and set these before them. While they ate, he stood near them under a tree.

source: Chuin amahon ajah-a, Na-inneipi Sarah hoija umam? atiuve. Chuin aman, Pon insunga khun aume, ati.
target: “Where is your wife Sarah?” they asked him. “There, in the tent,” he said.

source: Chuin aman, Keima nahenga hinkho phat chedung juija thonlouva kahung kile kitding ahi; chule ven, Sarah na-inneipin chapa khat ahinding ahi, ati. Chule Sarah'in anunglama pon in kotna konchun hichu anajan ahi.
target: Then one of them said, “I will surely return to you about this time next year, and Sarah your wife will have a son.” Now Sarah was listening at the entrance to the tent, which was behind him.

source: Tun Abraham le Sarah chu upatah le kum tamtah ahilhontan; chule numei hina ngaidol chu sarah chunga tanga ahitai.
target: Abraham and Sarah were already very old, and Sarah was past the age of childbearing.

source: Chuti ahijeh chun Sarah chu alungthimin anuijin, katehset jounung sanga hi thanopna kanei ding ham? Ka pakai jongla tehse ahitan, ati.
target: So Sarah laughed to herself as she thought, “After I am worn out and my lord is old, will I now have this pleasure?”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Abraham jah-a, ibola na-inneipi Sarah'in, kitehta-a chapa kanei mongding ham? atia nuija ham?
target: Then the Lord said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh and say, ‘Will I really have a child, now that I am old?’

source: Pakai dinga thil ahahsa behseh umam? Hinkho phat che dungjuija akitepsa phat tahle keima naheng-ah kahung kilekit ding, chule Sarah'in chapakhat ahinding ahi, ati.
target: Is anything too hard for the Lord ? I will return to you at the appointed time next year, and Sarah will have a son.”

source: Chuin Sarah akichat jeh chun, akilepmin, keima kanuipoi, ati. Ahin aman, ahipoi, nanui naije, ati.
target: Sarah was afraid, so she lied and said, “I did not laugh.” But he said, “Yes, you did laugh.”

source: Chuin miho chu chua konchun akipatdoh uvin, chule Sodom lam agahveuvin; chule Abraham'in amaho achenadiu lampia lhadoh dingin akilhonpin ahi.
target: When the men got up to leave, they looked down toward Sodom, and Abraham walked along with them to see them on their way.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin, kathil bol ding hi Abraham koma kona ka-im dingham?
target: Then the Lord said, “Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do?

source: Abraham hi nam lentah le thahat tah hung hiding, chule vannoi leiset namjouse ama-a phattheiboh changdiu ahingalin?
target: Abraham will surely become a great and powerful nation, and all nations on earth will be blessed through him.

source: Ajehchu achate le ama nunga a-insung mite chu thu apeh-a, Pakaiyin Abraham chungchanga athusei chu atohdoh nadinga, chonphatah le chondih tah-a na atoh uva, Pakai lamlhah ajui diu ahi ti keiman kahen ahi, ati.
target: For I have chosen him, so that he will direct his children and his household after him to keep the way of the Lord by doing what is right and just, so that the Lord will bring about for Abraham what he has promised him.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin, Sodom le Gomorrah pen awgin anasat behset jeh le, achonsetnao anasat behset jeh-in;
target: Then the Lord said, “The outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is so great and their sin so grievous

source: Tun keima chesuh ingting, chule apen awginu kaheng ahunglhun banga hi chonuvam, chonhih uvam gave inge; chuti ahilou jongle gahe-ing kate, ati.
target: that I will go down and see if what they have done is as bad as the outcry that has reached me. If not, I will know.”

source: Chuin miho chu chua kon chun akiheijun, Sodom lam jonin achetauve. Ahivangin Abraham chu Pakai masanga ading jing nalaijin ahi.
target: The men turned away and went toward Sodom, but Abraham remained standing before the Lord .

source: Chuin Abraham'in agah naijin, ahenga, michonpha ho chu migilou toh nasuhmang tha ding ham?
target: Then Abraham approached him and said: “Will you sweep away the righteous with the wicked?

source: Ijem tin khopi sunga chun michonpha somnga umtale, hiche asunga um michonpha somnga jal chun hiche munchu khenlouvin nasumang jeng dem?
target: What if there are fifty righteous people in the city? Will you really sweep it away and not spare the place for the sake of the fifty righteous people in it?

source: Hitobanga bolding chu nangma-a konin gamla hen; michonpha hochu migilou hotoh suhmangtha-a, michonpha hon migilou ho banga athohdiu nanga konin gamlahen; vannoi pumpi thutanpa chun adih-a thu atanlou ding ham? ati.
target: Far be it from you to do such a thing—to kill the righteous with the wicked, treating the righteous and the wicked alike. Far be it from you! Will not the Judge of all the earth do right?”

source: Chuin Pakai chun, keiman Sodom khopi sunga michonpha somnga kamuleh, amaho jalchun khopi chu hoidohsah nange, ati.
target: The Lord said, “If I find fifty righteous people in the city of Sodom, I will spare the whole place for their sake.”

source: Chuin Abraham'in adonbutnin, Tun vetan, keima leivui le meivambou kahin, Pakai henga thusei dingin kana kipantai.
target: Then Abraham spoke up again: “Now that I have been so bold as to speak to the Lord, though I am nothing but dust and ashes,

source: Ijem tin michonpha somnga lah-a chun nga lhasam taleh, mi nga alhahsam jehchun nangman khopi chu nasumang jeng dem? ati. Chuin aman, keiman chua chu michonpha somli le nga kamule, sumang ponge, ati.
target: what if the number of the righteous is five less than fifty? Will you destroy the whole city for lack of five people?” “If I find forty-five there,” he said, “I will not destroy it.”

source: Chuin aman ama jah-a, aseikitnin, Ijem tin chua chun somli kimu tale la, ati. Chuin aman, keiman somli ho jalchun sumang ponge, ati.
target: Once again he spoke to him, “What if only forty are found there?” He said, “For the sake of forty, I will not do it.”

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, Ka Pakai lunghang loujenin, keiman seikit inge, Ijemtin chua chun somthum bou kimu talela, ati. Chuin aman, keiman chua chu somthum kamule sumang ponge, ati.
target: Then he said, “May the Lord not be angry, but let me speak. What if only thirty can be found there?” He answered, “I will not do it if I find thirty there.”

source: Chuin aman, Tun vetan, keima Pakai henga thuseidin kana kipantai; Ijemtin chua chun somni bou kimu talela, ati. Chuin aman, somni jalchun keiman sumang pongkate, ati.
target: Abraham said, “Now that I have been so bold as to speak to the Lord, what if only twenty can be found there?” He said, “For the sake of twenty, I will not destroy it.”

source: Chuin aman, aw! Pakai lunghang loujenin, khatvei seikit inge, chua chun somkhat sehbou kimu talela, ati. Chuin aman, Keiman somkhat jalchun sumang ponge, ati.
target: Then he said, “May the Lord not be angry, but let me speak just once more. What if only ten can be found there?” He answered, “For the sake of ten, I will not destroy it.”

source: Chuin Pakai chu Abraham toh akihouchai phatnin achena dinga achetan; chule Abraham a-in lama ahung kile tai.
target: When the Lord had finished speaking with Abraham, he left, and Abraham returned home.

source: Chuin nilhah lamin vantil ni Sodom ahunglhung lhonin; chule Lot chu Sodom khopi kotpi bula chun anatouvin ahi. Chuin Lot'in amani chu amuphat nin alemdingin akipatdoh-in, chule tolla aboh khupmin;
target: The two angels arrived at Sodom in the evening, and Lot was sitting in the gateway of the city. When he saw them, he got up to meet them and bowed down with his face to the ground.

source: Chuin aman, Veuvin tun, ka Pakai teni, katao ahi, nasoh in'a hunglut lhonin lang, jan khovah geijin gehlhonin, chule nakeng kisil lhonin lang, jingkah teng le matah-in thoulhonin natin, chekit lhon tan nate, ati. Chuin amanin, Ahipoi, keini jan khovah keija lamlena kaum lhon ding ahi, atilhone.
target: “My lords,” he said, “please turn aside to your servant’s house. You can wash your feet and spend the night and then go on your way early in the morning.” “No,” they answered, “we will spend the night in the square.”

source: Chuin aman aha ngeh behseh jeh-in, amani akihei lhonin, a-insunga alut lhontai. Chuin aman amani golvah abolpin, cholsolou changlhah akangin, aneuvin ahi.
target: But he insisted so strongly that they did go with him and entered his house. He prepared a meal for them, baking bread without yeast, and they ate.

source: Ahivangin amaho alup masangun, khopi sunga miho, Sodom miho tah chu alen aneo, vengtinna kona mihem jousen in chu ahin umtaovin;
target: Before they had gone to bed, all the men from every part of the city of Sodom—both young and old—surrounded the house.

source: Chule amahon Lot chu ahin kouvun, ajah-a, Tujana nahenga hung miteni chu hoija umlhon tam? Kahenguva hinpui doh-un, amani chu jonpiuvinge, atiuve.
target: They called to Lot, “Where are the men who came to you tonight? Bring them out to us so that we can have sex with them.”

source: Chuin Lot kotna konchun amaho henga apotdoh-in, kot chu anungkha-in,
target: Lot went outside to meet them and shut the door behind him

source: Ajah uva, Sopite, naheng uva katao ahi, chuti lomin khanggilou hih-un.
target: and said, “No, my friends. Don’t do this wicked thing.

source: Tun veuvin, pasal heloulaihel chanu ni kaneije; katao ahi, namit mu uva pha nasah bangtah uva naboldiuvin amani chu naheng uva hin puidoh peh uvinge; hiche teni chunga vanghin imacha bolhih-un; ajehchu amani ka-in lhalim noija hunglut ahilhone, ati.
target: Look, I have two daughters who have never slept with a man. Let me bring them out to you, and you can do what you like with them. But don’t do anything to these men, for they have come under the protection of my roof.”

source: Chuin amahon, Kinung khinin, atiuve. Chuin amahon aseikitnun, Hiche mipa hi ahung pemlutnin, thutan din akigoi; tunvang amani chunga kabol sang uva nangma chunga phalou cheh-a kaboldiu ahi, atiuve. Chuin amahon mipa, Lot chu hatah-in ahin sonnun, kotkhah chu suhhong dingin ahin naitaove.
target: “Get out of our way,” they replied. “This fellow came here as a foreigner, and now he wants to play the judge! We’ll treat you worse than them.” They kept bringing pressure on Lot and moved forward to break down the door.

source: Ahivangin miteni chun akhut ahin lhangdoh lhonin, Lot chu amani henga dingin insunga akailut lhonin, kot chu akhah taovin ahi.
target: But the men inside reached out and pulled Lot back into the house and shut the door.

source: Chuin kot bula um miho chu alen aneo abonun amitnu achotsah lhonin; chutichun amahon kotkhah chu aholdoh jou tapouvin ahi.
target: Then they struck the men who were at the door of the house, young and old, with blindness so that they could not find the door.

source: Chuin miteni chun Lot jah-a, Nangman hikoma hi insungmi dang naneijem? Namahpate, nachapate, nachanute, chule khopi sunga koihileh naneichan chu hiche mun'a konhin puidoh-in.
target: The two men said to Lot, “Do you have anyone else here—sons-in-law, sons or daughters, or anyone else in the city who belongs to you? Get them out of here,

source: Ajeh chu Pakai anga apen awgin chu anasa behseh jengtan, hijeh-a chu hiche munhi kasuhmang lhonding ahi; Pakaiyin hiche sumang dinga eihinsol lhon ahi, ati lhonne.
target: because we are going to destroy this place. The outcry to the Lord against its people is so great that he has sent us to destroy it.”

source: Chuin Lot apotdoh-in, achanute kichenpi amah-pate henga achen, ajah uva, Kipat un, hiche mun'a konhin potdoh-un, Ajehchu Pakaiyin hiche khopi hi asuhmang ding ahi, ati. Ahivangin amachu amah-pate koma totna thusei abangbep tan ahi.
target: So Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters. He said, “Hurry and get out of this place, because the Lord is about to destroy the city!” But his sons-in-law thought he was joking.

source: Chuin jingkho ahung vah phatnin, Vantil teni chun Lot chu akinosah-in, ajah-a, Kipatdoh-in, hikoma um na-inneipi le nachanu teni kipuijin; achuti loule hiche khopi khangitlouna-a hin mantha tha getnin nate, ati.
target: With the coming of dawn, the angels urged Lot, saying, “Hurry! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, or you will be swept away when the city is punished.”

source: Chuin ama akhongai nalaijin, Pakaiyin ahepi jehchun miteni chun amakhut, a-inneipi khut chule achanu teni khut aman lhonin; apuidoh lhonin, khopi pamlama chun akoilhonin ahi.
target: When he hesitated, the men grasped his hand and the hands of his wife and of his two daughters and led them safely out of the city, for the Lord was merciful to them.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, amanin amaho polama ahin puidoh honchun, ajah uva, Nakihinso nadiuvin jamun; nanung lamu vehih-un, chujongle phaicham mun khatcha ajong kingapa hih-un; molsang lama jamun, ajole mangthah getnun nate, ati.
target: As soon as they had brought them out, one of them said, “Flee for your lives! Don’t look back, and don’t stop anywhere in the plain! Flee to the mountains or you will be swept away!”

source: Chuin Lot'in amani jah-a, Ka Pakai, chuti chu hida hen.
target: But Lot said to them, “No, my lords, please!

source: Vetan, namitmun nasoh hin namitmun lungsetna kachangin, chule nangman kahinkho neihuhdoh peh-in, nami khotona chu nadomsang tai; ahivangin molsang lama chun hoidohna din jamjou ponge, ajo thil gilou khatnin eihin phantin thilo getninge.
target: Your servant has found favor in your eyes, and you have shown great kindness to me in sparing my life. But I can’t flee to the mountains; this disaster will overtake me, and I’ll die.

source: Tun ven, hiche khopi khu jamlutna dingin anaijin, chule neocha jong ahi; hilama khun neijam sah-in, (hikhu neocha hilou ham?) chutile kahinna hinghoija umding ahi, ati.
target: Look, here is a town near enough to run to, and it is small. Let me flee to it—it is very small, isn’t it? Then my life will be spared.”

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, Vetan, hiche thudola jonghin na-ngehna kaphal peh-in, nangman nasei hiche khopi chu sumang ponge.
target: He said to him, “Very well, I will grant this request too; I will not overthrow the town you speak of.

source: Nangma kinonlang, khulama khun jamlut-in; ajeh chu khuchemun nalhun kahse-a imacha kabol theilou ahi, ati. Hijeh chun chuche khopi min chu Zoar akisah tai.
target: But flee there quickly, because I cannot do anything until you reach it.” (That is why the town was called Zoar.)

source: Lot chu Zoar alut chun nisa leiset chunga asohdoh tai.
target: By the time Lot reached Zoar, the sun had risen over the land.

source: Chujouvin Pakaiyin Sodom le Gomorrah chunga Kaat le meikong van'a Pakaiya konin ajuhsah tan ahi.
target: Then the Lord rained down burning sulfur on Sodom and Gomorrah—from the Lord out of the heavens.

source: Chuin aman chuche khopi teni, phaicham jouse, khopi sunga cheng jouse, chule leiset chunga kehdoh ho jouse abonchan asumangsoh keitan ahi.
target: Thus he overthrew those cities and the entire plain, destroying all those living in the cities—and also the vegetation in the land.

source: Ahivangin inneipi chun Lot nunga konin anunglam aven ahileh, chi khompi asohtan ahi.
target: But Lot’s wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.

source: Chuin Abraham jingpi tah-in athouvin, Pakai angsunga adinna mun'a chun achen;
target: Early the next morning Abraham got up and returned to the place where he had stood before the Lord .

source: Chuin Sodom le Gomorrah lam, chule phaicham gamlam jouse chu aven; chule veuvin, hiche gam meikhu chu thih kisou jolna munna meikhu bangin akitung veng vung jengin ahi
target: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah, toward all the land of the plain, and he saw dense smoke rising from the land, like smoke from a furnace.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Pathen'in phaicham khopi ho asuhmang chun, Pathen'in Abraham chu ageldoh in, Lot chenna khopiho asuhmang chun Lot chu akisuhmang ho lah-a konchun asoldoh-in ahi.
target: So when God destroyed the cities of the plain, he remembered Abraham, and he brought Lot out of the catastrophe that overthrew the cities where Lot had lived.

source: Chuin Lot chu Zoar kho-a kon chun molsang lama achetouvin, achanu teni toh achengtai; ajehchu ama Zoar kho-a chending chu kicha-a ahi. Chuin ama achanu teni toh song ko-a acheng taovin ahi.
target: Lot and his two daughters left Zoar and settled in the mountains, for he was afraid to stay in Zoar. He and his two daughters lived in a cave.

source: Chuin apeng masa nuchun aneojonu jah-a, Ipahi atehtan, vannoi leiset dan ngaija ihenguva hung ding leisetna pasal khatcha jong aumtapoi.
target: One day the older daughter said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is no man around here to give us children—as is the custom all over the earth.

source: Hungin, ipahi lengpitwi donsah hitin, chuleh ipa chilhah manglouva i-umsah theina dingin luppi hite, ati.
target: Let’s get our father to drink wine and then sleep with him and preserve our family line through our father.”

source: Chuin amanin chuche jan chun apalhon chu lengpitwi adonsah lhonin ahi. Chuin apeng masa nuchu ache lutnin, apa chu aluppin; ahin aman amanu itih-a ahunglup, chule itih-a athodoh ahepon ahi.
target: That night they got their father to drink wine, and the older daughter went in and slept with him. He was not aware of it when she lay down or when she got up.

source: Chuin ajingin ahitin ahi, apeng masa nuchun aneojonu jah-a, Vetan janhi jan chun kapa kaluppi tai. Tujanin jong einin lengpitwi donsah hitin; chule ipa chilhah manglouva i-umsah theina dingin, nangma lutnin lang galuppin, ati.
target: The next day the older daughter said to the younger, “Last night I slept with my father. Let’s get him to drink wine again tonight, and you go in and sleep with him so we can preserve our family line through our father.”

source: Chuin amanin chuche jan chun apahon chu lengpitwi adonsah lhontan ahi. Chuin aneojonu chu akipatdoh-in, aga luppin; ahin aman amanu itih-a ahunglup, chule itih-a athodoh ahepon ahi.
target: So they got their father to drink wine that night also, and the younger daughter went in and slept with him. Again he was not aware of it when she lay down or when she got up.

source: Chuti chun Lot chanu teni chun apalhona konin nao avopgel lhontai.
target: So both of Lot’s daughters became pregnant by their father.

source: Chuin apeng masa jonu chun chapa khat ahingin, amin Moab asahtai. Amachu tunikho geija Moab mite pa chu ahitai.
target: The older daughter had a son, and she named him Moab; he is the father of the Moabites of today.

source: Chuin aneojonu jong chun chapa khat ahingin, amin Ben-Ammi asahtai. Amachu tunikho geija Ammon miho pa chu ahitai.
target: The younger daughter also had a son, and she named him Ben-Ammi; he is the father of the Ammonites of today.

source: Chuin Abraham chua kon chun lhanglam gamah achesuh-in, Kadesh le Shur kikah-a achengin, chujouvin Gerar gama apemlutnin ahi.
target: Now Abraham moved on from there into the region of the Negev and lived between Kadesh and Shur. For a while he stayed in Gerar,

source: Chuin Abraham'in a-inneipi Sarah chu kanaonu ahi atin ahi. Chuin Gerar lengpa Abimelech chun mi asolin, Sarah chu agapui sah tan ahi.
target: and there Abraham said of his wife Sarah, “She is my sister.” Then Abimelek king of Gerar sent for Sarah and took her.

source: Ahin Abimelech henga chun ajan amangin Pathen ahungin, ajah-a, Vetan nangman nakipui numeinu jehchun nangma mithisa tobang nahitai; ajehchu amanu mikhat ji ahi, ati.
target: But God came to Abimelek in a dream one night and said to him, “You are as good as dead because of the woman you have taken; she is a married woman.”

source: Ahivangin Abimelech chun amanu chu anailut loulai ahin; chuin aman, Pakai nangman nam chonpha hojong nathajeng ding ham?
target: Now Abimelek had not gone near her, so he said, “Lord, will you destroy an innocent nation?

source: Aman kahenga, amanu hi kanaonu ahi, ati hilouham? Chule amanu jengin jong, amahi kasopipa ahi, ati ahi. Chule lung thengsel le khuttheng tah-a hichehi kanabol ahi, ati.
target: Did he not say to me, ‘She is my sister,’ and didn’t she also say, ‘He is my brother’? I have done this with a clear conscience and clean hands.”

source: Chuin Pathen'in ahenga amangin, Ahinai, hichehi lungdihtah pu-a nanabol ahi ti kahei. Ajehchu keima douna chonset nabol louna dinga keiman jong nangma kasuh tang nahi; hiche jeh-a chu keiman amanu chu katoh khah sah lou nahi.
target: Then God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know you did this with a clear conscience, and so I have kept you from sinning against me. That is why I did not let you touch her.

source: Chuti ahijeh chun tun mipa chu a-inneipi lepeh kittan; ajehchu ama themgao ahin, chule aman nangma taopeh-in natin, nangma nahinding ahi. Nangman amanu chu nalepeh kitlou vangleh, nangma thonlouva nathi teiding ahi, ti kihetnin, nangma le nenei chengse jong, atin ahi.
target: Now return the man’s wife, for he is a prophet, and he will pray for you and you will live. But if you do not return her, you may be sure that you and all who belong to you will die.”

source: Hiche jehchun Abimelech jingpitah-in athouvin, asohte jouse hiche thilho jouse hi aseipeh tan ahi. Chuin miho chu akichalheh jengun ahi.
target: Early the next morning Abimelek summoned all his officials, and when he told them all that had happened, they were very much afraid.

source: Chujouvin Abimelech'in Abraham chu akouvin, ajah-a, Kachunguva hi ipi bola nahi hitam? Chule nangma chunga ipi kasuhkhel uma, keima chungle kalenggam chunga chonsetna lentah hi nahin lhut lut hitam? Nangman kachunga bol louhel ding thil chu naboltai, ati.
target: Then Abimelek called Abraham in and said, “What have you done to us? How have I wronged you that you have brought such great guilt upon me and my kingdom? You have done things to me that should never be done.”

source: Chuin Abimelech'in Abraham henga, Ipi namu-a hiche thil hi nabol hitam? ati.
target: And Abimelek asked Abraham, “What was your reason for doing this?”

source: Chuin Abraham'in, Hiche mun'a hin Pathen ginna him him umpontin, ka-inneipi jeh hin eithat nun nate tia kagel ahi.
target: Abraham replied, “I said to myself, ‘There is surely no fear of God in this place, and they will kill me because of my wife.’

source: Chujongleh atahbeh-in amanu hi kasopinu ahi ngutnai; amanu hi kapa chanu ahin, hinla kanu chanu vang ahipoi; chua amanu ka-inneipi hung hia ahitai.
target: Besides, she really is my sister, the daughter of my father though not of my mother; and she became my wife.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Pathen'in kapa in'a kona eiva lesah chun, keiman amanu henga, hichehi kadinga khotona namusahna ding chu ahi; ichena muntina, amahi kasopipa ahi neiti ding ahi, tia kanasei ahi, ati.
target: And when God had me wander from my father’s household, I said to her, ‘This is how you can show your love to me: Everywhere we go, say of me, “He is my brother.” ’ ”

source: Chuin Abimelech'in Kelngoi, bongchal, chule soh pasal ho leh soh numei ho apuijin, Abraham chu apen, chule a-inneipi Sarah chu alepeh kittan ahi.
target: Then Abimelek brought sheep and cattle and male and female slaves and gave them to Abraham, and he returned Sarah his wife to him.

source: Chuin Abimelech'in, Vetan, kagam hi namasanga aume; nadeina mun mun'a chengin, ati.
target: And Abimelek said, “My land is before you; live wherever you like.”

source: Chuin aman Sarah henga, Ven, keiman nasopipa dangka sangkhat kapen ahi; vetan, nakoma umho jouse le midang jouse lah-a amapa hi nangma dinga mitkhuna ahi, ati. Chuti chun amanu chu themchan sah-in aumtai.
target: To Sarah he said, “I am giving your brother a thousand shekels of silver. This is to cover the offense against you before all who are with you; you are completely vindicated.”

source: Chuti chun Abraham Pathen henga ataovin ahile, Pathen'in Abimelech, a-inneipi, chule asoh numei ho chu adamsahtan ahi. Chuin amahon chate ahing taovin ahi.
target: Then Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelek, his wife and his female slaves so they could have children again,

source: Ajehchu Abraham inneipi Sarah jala chu Pakaiyin Abimelech insunga naobu jouse anakha ahitai.
target: for the Lord had kept all the women in Abimelek’s household from conceiving because of Abraham’s wife Sarah.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin aseibang chun Sarah avilin, phatthei aboh-in, chule aseibang chun Pakaiyin Sarah chunga amolsotan ahi.
target: Now the Lord was gracious to Sarah as he had said, and the Lord did for Sarah what he had promised.

source: Hitichun Sarah'in nao avoptan, Chule Pathen'in ahenga asei phattah chun Abraham ateh nungin chapa khat ahinpehtai.
target: Sarah became pregnant and bore a son to Abraham in his old age, at the very time God had promised him.

source: Chuin Abraham'in adinga hung peng, Sarah'in ahinpeh achapa min chu Isaac asah tan ahi.
target: Abraham gave the name Isaac to the son Sarah bore him.

source: Chuin Pathen'in athupeh bangin Abraham'in achapa Isaac chu niget alhinin chep atan peh tan ahi.
target: When his son Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, as God commanded him.

source: Chule achapa Isaac ahungpen chun Abraham kum jakhat alhingtan ahi..
target: Abraham was a hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.

source: Chuin Sarah'in, Pathen'in einui sahtan, chule koihileh aja jousen einuihu dingu ahi, ati.
target: Sarah said, “God has brought me laughter, and everyone who hears about this will laugh with me.”

source: Chuin amanun, Sarah'in naonoi hinchepsah inte, tin Abraham henga kon ana seithei jintem? Ahin ama ateh nungin keiman chapa khat kahin pehtai, ati.
target: And she added, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? Yet I have borne him a son in his old age.”

source: Chuin chapang chu ahung khang khangin anoichep abang tan ahi. Chuin Abraham'in Isaac noichep ban nikho chun golvah loupitah abolin ahi.
target: The child grew and was weaned, and on the day Isaac was weaned Abraham held a great feast.

source: Chuin Sarah'in Egypt mi Hagar'in Abraham ahinpeh achapa chun anuisat chu amun ahi.
target: But Sarah saw that the son whom Hagar the Egyptian had borne to Abraham was mocking,

source: Hijeh chun amanun Abraham henga, Hiche soh numeinu le achapa hi nodohtan; ajehchu hiche soh numeinu chapa hin kachapa Isaac toh gou alokhom theilou ding ahi, ati.
target: and she said to Abraham, “Get rid of that slave woman and her son, for that woman’s son will never share in the inheritance with my son Isaac.”

source: Chule achapa jalchun hichu Abraham mitmun lungnopmona tah ahitan ahi.
target: The matter distressed Abraham greatly because it concerned his son.

source: Chuin Pathen'in Abraham jah-a, Chapang jal le soh numeinu jal chun lung nomotah-in umhih-in; ajehchu Isaac'a kona bou nachilhah kasim ding ahi.
target: But God said to him, “Do not be so distressed about the boy and your slave woman. Listen to whatever Sarah tells you, because it is through Isaac that your offspring will be reckoned.

source: Chule keiman nasoh numeinu chapa-a kona jong namkhat kasem doh ding ahi, ajehchu ama nangma chilhah ahi, ati.
target: I will make the son of the slave into a nation also, because he is your offspring.”

source: Chuin Abraham jingpitah-in athouvin, changlhah le twipai khat alan, Hagar chu apen, hichu alengkouva akhaipeh-in, chapang chutoh amanu asoldohtai. Chuin amanu apotdoh-in, Beersheba gamthipma avahle letan ahi.
target: Early the next morning Abraham took some food and a skin of water and gave them to Hagar. He set them on her shoulders and then sent her off with the boy. She went on her way and wandered in the Desert of Beersheba.

source: Chuin twipai'a twi chu ahung beitan ahile, amanun chapang chu hambohnoi khatna akoitan ahi.
target: When the water in the skin was gone, she put the boy under one of the bushes.

source: Chuin amanu achen, gamla thim tah thalpi kap phahna bepma chun agatoutan ahi: ajehchu amanun, chapang thi chu muda inge ati ahi. Chuin amanu amajonna chun atouvin, hakan akaptan ahi.
target: Then she went off and sat down about a bowshot away, for she thought, “I cannot watch the boy die.” And as she sat there, she began to sob.

source: Chuin Pathen'in chapang aw chu ajan; van'a konin Pathen vantil chun Hagar chu ahin kouvin, ajah-a, Ipi nathoh lel ham, Hagar? Kicha hih-in, ajehchu chapangpa aumna-a kon a-awgin chu Pathen'in ajatai.
target: God heard the boy crying, and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven and said to her, “What is the matter, Hagar? Do not be afraid; God has heard the boy crying as he lies there.

source: Kipat doh-in, chapang chu kaithouvin, chule nakhutna tuh-in, ajehchu keiman amachu nam lentah khatna kasem ding ahi, ati.
target: Lift the boy up and take him by the hand, for I will make him into a great nation.”

source: Chuin Pathen'in amanu mit avahsah-in ahile, amanun twikhuh khat amutan ahi. Chuin amanu achen, twipai'a chun twi athaldim-in, chapang chu adonsah tai.
target: Then God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water. So she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink.

source: Chuin Pathen'in chapang chu aumpin; chule ama ahung khang khangin, gamthipma chun achengin, thalkap themtah ahung hitai.
target: God was with the boy as he grew up. He lived in the desert and became an archer.

source: Chuin ama Paran gamthipma achengin; chule anun Egypt gama konin ajiding apui peh tan ahi.
target: While he was living in the Desert of Paran, his mother got a wife for him from Egypt.

source: Chuche laichun ahitin ahi, Abimelech le asepai hon lamkai Phicol chun Abraham henga, Natohna jouse-a Pathen'in nang naumpi jinge.
target: At that time Abimelek and Phicol the commander of his forces said to Abraham, “God is with you in everything you do.

source: Hijeh chun tun, nangman keima le kachapate, chule kachapate chapate chunga dihlou tah-a na natoh louna ding le, keiman nangma kalungset bangahi keima chule nahung pemlutna gamhi lungsetna naneina dingin, hikoma hin Pathen minin kahenga kihahsel in, ati.
target: Now swear to me here before God that you will not deal falsely with me or my children or my descendants. Show to me and the country where you now reside as a foreigner the same kindness I have shown to you.”

source: Chuin Abraham'in, Kaki hahsel ding ahi, ati.
target: Abraham said, “I swear it.”

source: Chuin Abimelech sohten twikhuh khat hunama alahpeh jeh uvin, Abraham'in Abimelech chu aphohtan ahi.
target: Then Abraham complained to Abimelek about a well of water that Abimelek’s servants had seized.

source: Chuin Abimelech'in, Keiman hiche thil bola hi koi ahi kahepoi; nangman jong neiseipeh khah pon, chule tunia kajah tilou, kajakha hihbeh-e, ati.
target: But Abimelek said, “I don’t know who has done this. You did not tell me, and I heard about it only today.”

source: Chuin Abraham'in Kelngoile bongchal akaijin, Abimelech chu apen; anigel lhonin kitepna asemlhontai.
target: So Abraham brought sheep and cattle and gave them to Abimelek, and the two men made a treaty.

source: Chuin Abraham'in kelngoihon lah-a konchun kelngoinou anu sagi atumin akoidoh-in ahi.
target: Abraham set apart seven ewe lambs from the flock,

source: Chuin Abimelech'in Abraham henga, Kelngoinou anu sagi atuma nakoidoh hi ipi tina ham? Ati.
target: and Abimelek asked Abraham, “What is the meaning of these seven ewe lambs you have set apart by themselves?”

source: Chuin aman, Hiche twikhuh hi keima lai ahi ti hettohsah nadinga hiche kelngoinou anu sagi hi kakhutna kona nakilah ding ahi, ati.
target: He replied, “Accept these seven lambs from my hand as a witness that I dug this well.”

source: Hiche jeh chun aman chuche munchu chu Beersheba asahtai; ajehchu hikoma chun amani akihahsel gel lhona ahi.
target: So that place was called Beersheba, because the two men swore an oath there.

source: Chutichun amanin Beersheba mun'a chun kitepna asemlhontan ahi. Chujouvin Abimelech le asepaihon gal lamkai Phicol akipatdoh lhonin, Philistine gam lama akile lhontai.
target: After the treaty had been made at Beersheba, Abimelek and Phicol the commander of his forces returned to the land of the Philistines.

source: Chuin Abraham'in Beersheba'a chun thingphung khat aphutnin, chua chun Pakai tonsot Pathen min chu akoutan ahi.
target: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of the Lord , the Eternal God.

source: Chutichun Abraham Philistine gama nikho sottah akhopemin ahi.
target: And Abraham stayed in the land of the Philistines for a long time.

source: Chuin chucheng nung chun ahitin ahi, Pathen'in Abraham chu apatepmin, ahenga, Abraham, tin akouvin ahile; aman, Ven, hikoma kaume, ati.
target: Some time later God tested Abraham. He said to him, “Abraham!” “Here I am,” he replied.

source: Chuin aman, Nachapa, nachapa changkhatseh, nangailut tah Isaac chu puijin lang, Moriah gama chen; chule chukom achun keiman kahilding molsang khatna amachu govam thilton gatoh-in, ati.
target: Then God said, “Take your son, your only son, whom you love—Isaac—and go to the region of Moriah. Sacrifice him there as a burnt offering on a mountain I will show you.”

source: Chuin Abraham jingpi matah-in athouvin, asangan chu agongin, aumpi gollhang ho mi nile achapa Isaac chu apuijin, chule govam thiltona ding thing a-eh-in, chuin akipatdoh-in, Pathen'in ahilna munlam jonchun achetan ahi.
target: Early the next morning Abraham got up and loaded his donkey. He took with him two of his servants and his son Isaac. When he had cut enough wood for the burnt offering, he set out for the place God had told him about.

source: Chuin, anithum chanin Abraham akhodah-in ahile, amun chu gamla tah-a agahmun ahi
target: On the third day Abraham looked up and saw the place in the distance.

source: Chuin Abraham'in agollhang teni henga, hikoma hin nangni sangan toh ana um lhonin, keimale chapang hi khukoma khun gache lhoningting, Pathen kagahou lhonding, chuteng naheng lhona kahungkit lhonding ahi, ati.
target: He said to his servants, “Stay here with the donkey while I and the boy go over there. We will worship and then we will come back to you.”

source: Chuin Abraham'in govam thilto ding thingchu alan, achapa Isaac aputsah-in; chule aman meile chemcha akhutna achoijin, chuin amani thakhat nin akilhon khom lhontai.
target: Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and placed it on his son Isaac, and he himself carried the fire and the knife. As the two of them went on together,

source: Chuin Isaac'in apa Abraham henga, Hepa, atile, aman, Chapa hikoma kaume, ati. Chuin aman, Ven, mei le thing la aumnan, govam thilto ding kelngoi hoiba ham? ati.
target: Isaac spoke up and said to his father Abraham, “Father?” “Yes, my son?” Abraham replied. “The fire and wood are here,” Isaac said, “but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?”

source: Chuin Abraham'in, Kachapa, govam thilto ding kelngoinou chu Pathen amatah-in hinpenante, ati. Chutichun amani thakhat nin achekhom lhonin ahi.
target: Abraham answered, “God himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son.” And the two of them went on together.

source: Chuin Pathen'in ama ahilna mun chu alhung lhontan; Abraham'in maicham khat atungdoh-in, chule thing chu asetoh-in, chuin achapa Isaac chu akanin, maicham chunga chun alupsahtan ahi.
target: When they reached the place God had told him about, Abraham built an altar there and arranged the wood on it. He bound his son Isaac and laid him on the altar, on top of the wood.

source: Chuin Abraham'in akhut alhangin, achapa thana ding chun chemcha chu alatan ahi.
target: Then he reached out his hand and took the knife to slay his son.

source: Chuin Pakai Vantil'in van'a konin ahin samin, Abraham, Abraham, atin ahi. Chuin aman, Hikoma kaume, ati.
target: But the angel of the Lord called out to him from heaven, “Abraham! Abraham!” “Here I am,” he replied.

source: Chuin aman, Chapang chunga chun nakhut lha hih-in, chujong le ama chu imacha lohih-in: ajehchu nangman nacha changkhat seh jong keima dinga itlouhela neipeh chu kamun, Pathen naginge ti tun kahetai, ati.
target: “Do not lay a hand on the boy,” he said. “Do not do anything to him. Now I know that you fear God, because you have not withheld from me your son, your only son.”

source: Chuin Abraham akhodah-in aven ahile, anunglama chun kelngoichal khat nang lah-a aki-a oh amun ahi. Chuin Abraham achen, kelngoi chal chu agamanin, hichu achapa khelin govam thilto ding chun atohtan ahi.
target: Abraham looked up and there in a thicket he saw a ram caught by its horns. He went over and took the ram and sacrificed it as a burnt offering instead of his son.

source: Chuin Abraham'in chumun chu Jehovah Jireh asahtai: chule tuni chan geihin, Pakai molsanga hichu kipeding ahi, tin akiseijing nalaijin ahi.
target: So Abraham called that place The Lord Will Provide. And to this day it is said, “On the mountain of the Lord it will be provided.”

source: Chuin Pakai Vantil'in aniveina-in van'a konin Abraham chu ahinkou kitnin,
target: The angel of the Lord called to Abraham from heaven a second time

source: Ajah-a, Keima le keima-a kihahsel kahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije; Ajehchu nangman hiche hi nabola, chule nachapa, nachapa changkhat na-it louhel jeh-a;
target: and said, “I swear by myself, declares the Lord , that because you have done this and have not withheld your son, your only son,

source: Keiman phattheiboh na-a nangma phatthei kaboh ding, chule hapuna punsah na-a nachilhahte van'a ahsijat, twikhanglen kama neldi jat na kapunsah ding; chule nachilhahte chun amelmateu kotpiho alodingu ahi.
target: I will surely bless you and make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as the sand on the seashore. Your descendants will take possession of the cities of their enemies,

source: Chule nangman kathu nangai tah jeh-a, nachilhahte akona vannoi leiset chitin namtin jouse phatthei boh changding ahiuve, ati.
target: and through your offspring all nations on earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed me.”

source: Chuti chun Abraham gollhang teni henga ahung kilen; chuin amaho akipat doh-un Beersheba lam jonin thakhatnin acheuvin; chule Abraham Beersheba'a achengtan ahi.
target: Then Abraham returned to his servants, and they set off together for Beersheba. And Abraham stayed in Beersheba.

source: Thil hicheng jouchun ahitin ahi, Abraham henga, Vetan, Milkah'in jong nasopipa Nahor dingin chate ahinpehtai, tin thu aseipeh-un ahi.
target: Some time later Abraham was told, “Milkah is also a mother; she has borne sons to your brother Nahor:

source: Achapa peng masa chu Huz ahin, anaopa Buz ahin, chule Aram pa Kemuel,
target: Uz the firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel (the father of Aram),

source: Chule Chessad, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph chule Bethuel ahi.
target: Kesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph and Bethuel.”

source: Chule Bethuel'in Rebekah ahingin ahi. Hicheng get hi Milkah'in Abraham sopipa Nahor ahinpeh ahi.
target: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. Milkah bore these eight sons to Abraham’s brother Nahor.

source: Chuin athaikemnu Reumah chun Tebah, Gaham, Thahash chule Maachah ahingin ahi.
target: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also had sons: Tebah, Gaham, Tahash and Maakah.

source: Chule Sarah chu kum jakhat le kum somni le kum sagi alhingtan ahi; hicheng hi Sarah hinkho kumho chu ahi.
target: Sarah lived to be a hundred and twenty-seven years old.

source: Chuin Sarah chu Kirjath-Arba'a chun athitan; hichu Canaan gama Hebron chu ahi. Chuin Abraham chu Sarah op ding le ka dingin ahungin ahi.
target: She died at Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham went to mourn for Sarah and to weep over her.

source: Chuin Abraham amithilong masanga chun adingdoh-in, Heth chapate henga chun thu aseijin,
target: Then Abraham rose from beside his dead wife and spoke to the Hittites. He said,

source: Keimahi nalah uva um maljin le khopem bou kahi: kami thi hi kamit mu-a kona kavui doh theina dingin, gouva kanei dingin kivuina ding mun phabep khat neipeuvin, ati.
target: “I am a foreigner and stranger among you. Sell me some property for a burial site here so I can bury my dead.”

source: Chuin Heth chapate chun Abraham adonbutnun, ajah-a,
target: The Hittites replied to Abraham,

source: Ka pakai, nei ngaipeh temun: nangma kalah uva leng chapa loupitah nahi: kalhan hou nadei nalai tah-a namithi chu vuijengtan; namithi navuina dingin kalah uva hin koimachan kalhan nu pehdoh ding itpou vinge, atiuve.
target: “Sir, listen to us. You are a mighty prince among us. Bury your dead in the choicest of our tombs. None of us will refuse you his tomb for burying your dead.”

source: Chuin Abraham ading doh-in, chuche gam mite, Heth chapate anga chun akuntan ahi.
target: Then Abraham rose and bowed down before the people of the land, the Hittites.

source: Chuin amaho chutoh akihouvin, ajah uva, Kami thi kamitmu-a kona kavuiding nalungu ahile, neingaipeh-un, chule keima dingin Zohar chapa Ephron henga neithum peh-un,
target: He said to them, “If you are willing to let me bury my dead, then listen to me and intercede with Ephron son of Zohar on my behalf

source: Nalah uva kivuina munna gouva kanei dingin, aman lhingset pedingin, aman anei alou bantah-a um Machpelah songko chu eipehen, ati.
target: so he will sell me the cave of Machpelah, which belongs to him and is at the end of his field. Ask him to sell it to me for the full price as a burial site among you.”

source: Chuin Ephron chu Heth chapate lah-a cheng ahi: chuin Hit mi Ephron chun Heth chate jahdingle khopi kul kotpi sunga lut jouse jahding chun Abraham chu adonbutnin,
target: Ephron the Hittite was sitting among his people and he replied to Abraham in the hearing of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city.

source: Ahipoi ka pakai, ngaitemin; louchu kapeh nahitan, chule asunga um songko jong chu kapeh tha nahitai; kamite chapate masanga hi nangma kapeh nahitai: namithi chu kivuitan, ati.
target: “No, my lord,” he said. “Listen to me; I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. I give it to you in the presence of my people. Bury your dead.”

source: Chuin Abraham chuche gam mite angsunga chun aboh khupmin ahi.
target: Again Abraham bowed down before the people of the land

source: Chuin aman chuche gam mite jah ding chun Ephron henga, Nangman neipeh ahile katao ahi, neingaipeh-in: keiman gamman ding chun nangma sum peng kate; hichu keija konin kilah-in, chule keiman chukoma chun kami thi chu vuijing kate, ati.
target: and he said to Ephron in their hearing, “Listen to me, if you will. I will pay the price of the field. Accept it from me so I can bury my dead there.”

source: Chuin Ephron'in Abraham chu adonbutnin, ajah-a,
target: Ephron answered Abraham,

source: Ka pakai, kasei neingaipeh-in: gam chu dangka shekel jali man bep ahin, hichu nangle kei kah-a itah ham? Hiche jehchun namithi chu kivuitan, ati.
target: “Listen to me, my lord; the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver, but what is that between you and me? Bury your dead.”

source: Chuin Abraham'in Ephron thusei chu angaipeh-in; chule Abraham'in Heth chapate hetnin Ephron'in aseijat dangka shekel jali chu, chuche laija sumkol veihon amanjiu dungjui chun Ephron chu atepeh tan ahi.
target: Abraham agreed to Ephron’s terms and weighed out for him the price he had named in the hearing of the Hittites: four hundred shekels of silver, according to the weight current among the merchants.

source: Chuin Mamre kom Machpelah gamsunga um Ephron loumun chu, alou le asunga um songko, chule louva um thing jouse, chule alou kimvela um thing jouse chu,
target: So Ephron’s field in Machpelah near Mamre—both the field and the cave in it, and all the trees within the borders of the field—was deeded

source: Heth chate angsung le khopi kul kotpi sunga lut jouse mitmun Abraham nei dingin pehdoh-in aumtan ahi.
target: to Abraham as his property in the presence of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of the city.

source: Chujouvin Abraham'in a-inneipi Sarah chu Canaan gama Mamre (hichu Hebron ahi) jona um Machpelah lou munna songkoa chun avuitan ahi.
target: Afterward Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the cave in the field of Machpelah near Mamre (which is at Hebron) in the land of Canaan.

source: Chuche lou munle asunga songko chu kivuina mun'a anei dingin, Abraham henga Heth chapate chun apedoh taovin ahi.
target: So the field and the cave in it were deeded to Abraham by the Hittites as a burial site.

source: Chuin Abraham chu a-upa lhehtan, akumjong atamlheh jengtan; chule Abraham chu Pakaiyin thil jouse-a phatthei aboh-in ahi.
target: Abraham was now very old, and the Lord had blessed him in every way.

source: Chuin Abraham'in a-insunga asoh upapen, anei jouse chunga vaihompa henga chun, Nahenga katao ahi, nakhut chu kaphei noija koijin;
target: He said to the senior servant in his household, the one in charge of all that he had, “Put your hand under my thigh.

source: Chule Pakai, Van Pathen le lei Pathen min paning ting, kachenna Canaan mite chanute lah-ahi kachapa jiding napuipeh louna dingin nangma kihahsel sah inge.
target: I want you to swear by the Lord , the God of heaven and the God of earth, that you will not get a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I am living,

source: Ahin kagam lama, ka-inkote lah-a nache-a kachapa Isaac jiding nagapuijoh ding ahi, ati.
target: but will go to my country and my own relatives and get a wife for my son Isaac.”

source: Chuin sohpa chun ahenga, Ijemtin numei chun hiche gamlama hin eihin juinom tahih le, nachapa hi nahungdoh na gamlama chu kalepuikit ngai jin tem? ati.
target: The servant asked him, “What if the woman is unwilling to come back with me to this land? Shall I then take your son back to the country you came from?”

source: Chuin Abraham'in amapa henga, Kachapa hi chulama nalepui louna dingin nangma chingthei jin.
target: “Make sure that you do not take my son back there,” Abraham said.

source: Pakai van Pathen, kapa in'a konle ka sopite gama kona eipuidohpa, chule kahenga, Hiche gamhi nachilhahte kapeh ding ahi; tia kihahsel pachun avantil namasanga solintin, chua kona chu kachapa jiding napuipeh ding ahi.
target: “The Lord , the God of heaven, who brought me out of my father’s household and my native land and who spoke to me and promised me on oath, saying, ‘To your offspring I will give this land’—he will send his angel before you so that you can get a wife for my son from there.

source: Chule ijemtia numei chun najui nomlou tah-a ahile, hiche kihahsel na-a kona hi ongdoh-a nahi; kachapa vanghi chulama chu nalepui lou ding ahi, ati.
target: If the woman is unwilling to come back with you, then you will be released from this oath of mine. Only do not take my son back there.”

source: Chuin asohpa chun apu Abraham phei noija chun akhut akoijin, chule chuche thudola chun ahenga akihahseltan ahi.
target: So the servant put his hand under the thigh of his master Abraham and swore an oath to him concerning this matter.

source: Chuin asohpa chun sangongsao ho lah-a chun sangongsao som akipuijin akipatdoh tai; ajehchu apupa neile gou jouse chu akhutna uma ahi. Chuin akipatdoh-in, Mesopotamia gam, Nahor khopi jonin achetan ahi.
target: Then the servant left, taking with him ten of his master’s camels loaded with all kinds of good things from his master. He set out for Aram Naharaim and made his way to the town of Nahor.

source: Chuin nilhah lam, numei ho twi thal dinga apotdoh phat dontah chun, khopi pama twikhuh koma asangongsao hochu akolsah-in ahi.
target: He had the camels kneel down near the well outside the town; it was toward evening, the time the women go out to draw water.

source: Chuin ama, Vo Pakai, kapu Abraham Pathen, nahenga katao ahi, tunin lolhinna neihinpen, chule kapu Abraham lungsetna musah-in.
target: Then he prayed, “ Lord , God of my master Abraham, make me successful today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

source: Vetan, twikhuh koma hin kadingin, chule hiche khopi miho chanute twithal dingin ahungdoh-ui;
target: See, I am standing beside this spring, and the daughters of the townspeople are coming out to draw water.

source: Chule hiti hi hisah-in, nungah koikom hijongleh, Katao ahi, kadon dingin atwibel hin nemsah-in, kati-a, chule amanun, Donin, chule keiman nasangongsao hojong adondiu penange, tia seipen pen chu nasoh Isaac dinga nami got chu hijenghen. Chule nangman hichea kona chu kapu chunga hepina namusah-e ti kahet ding ahi, ati.
target: May it be that when I say to a young woman, ‘Please let down your jar that I may have a drink,’ and she says, ‘Drink, and I’ll water your camels too’—let her be the one you have chosen for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, chuche aseijou masang chun, veuvin, Abraham naopa, Nahor inneipi Milkah chapa Bethuel chanu Rebekah chun alengkouva twibel ahinpun, ahung potdoh-in ahi.
target: Before he had finished praying, Rebekah came out with her jar on her shoulder. She was the daughter of Bethuel son of Milkah, who was the wife of Abraham’s brother Nahor.

source: Chule nungah nu chu amel ahoilheh jengin, nungah theng ahin, pasal koimachan akihetpi loulai ahi. Chuin amanu twikhuh-a chun akumlhan, atwibel chu athaldim-in ahung potdoh-in ahi.
target: The woman was very beautiful, a virgin; no man had ever slept with her. She went down to the spring, filled her jar and came up again.

source: Chuin sohpa chu amanu chutoh kimuto ding chun alhaijelin, ajah-a, Katao ahi, natwi bela twi chu themkhat neidonsah-in, ati.
target: The servant hurried to meet her and said, “Please give me a little water from your jar.”

source: Chuin amanun, Donin, ka pakai, ati. Chuin amanun gangtah-in atwibel chu akhutnin adomlhan, amapa chu adonsah tai.
