target: “Drink, my lord,” she said, and quickly lowered the jar to her hands and gave him a drink.

source: Chuin amapa chu twi adonsah jou phatnin, amanun, Nasangongsao hon jong adonkhop kahseovin, keiman twi thalpeh nange, ati.
target: After she had given him a drink, she said, “I’ll draw water for your camels too, until they have had enough to drink.”

source: Chuti chun amanun atwibel chu gankonga chun asunglha loijin, twi thal dingin twikhuh lama chun alhaijel kitnin, asangongsao ho jouse ding chun athal pehtan ahi.
target: So she quickly emptied her jar into the trough, ran back to the well to draw more water, and drew enough for all his camels.

source: Chuin mipa chun Pakaiyin ajina chu alolhinsah ding le alolhinsah lou ding hetna din, kidangsa tah-in amanu chu thipbeh chan avejing tan ahi.
target: Without saying a word, the man watched her closely to learn whether or not the Lord had made his journey successful.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Sangongsao ho chun adonkhop phatnun, mipa chun sana bilba shekel keh gih le, amanun akhutna abu ding sana chao shekel som gih aladoh-in,
target: When the camels had finished drinking, the man took out a gold nose ring weighing a beka and two gold bracelets weighing ten shekels.

source: Amanu henga, Koi chanu nahim? katao ahi, neisei peh-in; napa in'a keiho din gena ding mun umin tem? ati.
target: Then he asked, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me, is there room in your father’s house for us to spend the night?”

source: Chuin amanun ajah-a, Keima Milcah'in Nahor dinga ahinpeh achapa Bethuel chanu kahi, ati.
target: She answered him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son that Milkah bore to Nahor.”

source: Chuin amanu chun ahenga aseiben, Changpol le gancha a-an ding anneh nengtah-in kaneijui, chule genading mun jong kaneijuve, ati.
target: And she added, “We have plenty of straw and fodder, as well as room for you to spend the night.”

source: Chuin mipa chu akunin, Pakai chu ahou tan ahi.
target: Then the man bowed down and worshiped the Lord ,

source: Chuin aman, Kapu chunga hepina le akitahna nungsun loupa Pakai kapu Abraham Pathen chu nunnom hen: keijeng jong hi Pakai chun lamdunga eipuijin, kapu sopite in geijin eipuilutai, ati.
target: saying, “Praise be to the Lord , the God of my master Abraham, who has not abandoned his kindness and faithfulness to my master. As for me, the Lord has led me on the journey to the house of my master’s relatives.”

source: Chuin nungah nuchu alhaijelin, hiche ho chu anu insung mite agahiltai.
target: The young woman ran and told her mother’s household about these things.

source: Chule Rebekah chun sopi khat aneijin, chule amin Laban ahin; chuin Laban chu twikhuh lama mipa henga chun alhaijelin ahi.
target: Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban, and he hurried out to the man at the spring.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, aman bilba le asopinu khutna chaochu amu-a, chule asopinu Rebekah'in, Mipa chun kakoma hitihin thu aseije, tia asei ajah phatnin; mipa koma chun ahungin ahile; veuvin, amapa chu twikhuh koma sangongsao holah-a chun adingin ahi.
target: As soon as he had seen the nose ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s arms, and had heard Rebekah tell what the man said to her, he went out to the man and found him standing by the camels near the spring.

source: Chuin aman, Hunglutnin, nangma Pakai phatthei boh changpa, iti dana pama nadin ham? Ajehchu keiman in le sangongsao ho ding mun kagotsa ahitai, ati.
target: “Come, you who are blessed by the Lord ,” he said. “Why are you standing out here? I have prepared the house and a place for the camels.”

source: Chuin mipa chu in'a chun ahung luttan ahi. Chuin Laban'in sangongsao thilho chu alhamlhan, sangongsao hoding changpol le gan an chu apen, chule ama keng le anungjui ho keng silna ding twi apen ahi.
target: So the man went to the house, and the camels were unloaded. Straw and fodder were brought for the camels, and water for him and his men to wash their feet.

source: Chuin a-anga chun nehding an aluipeh-un; ahin amapan, Kaseiding dol kasei masangin neponge, ati. Chuin aman, Seitang em, ati.
target: Then food was set before him, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told you what I have to say.” “Then tell us,” Laban said.

source: Chuin aman, Keima Abraham sohpa kahi.
target: So he said, “I am Abraham’s servant.

source: Chule Pakaiyin kapu Abraham chu nasatah-in phatthei aboh-in, ama milentah ahung hitai. Chule Pakaiyin amachu kelngoi hon le bong hon, dangka le Sana, soh pasal le soh numei ho, sangongsao ho le Sangan ho apen ahi.
target: The Lord has blessed my master abundantly, and he has become wealthy. He has given him sheep and cattle, silver and gold, male and female servants, and camels and donkeys.

source: Chule kapu inneipi Sarah chun ateh nungin kapu dingin chapa khat ahinpeh-in; ama koma chun aman anei jouse apesoh keijin ahi.
target: My master’s wife Sarah has borne him a son in her old age, and he has given him everything he owns.

source: Chule kapun keima eikihahsel sah-in, Kachenna Canaan mite chanute lah-a kona hi kachapa jiding napui lou ding ahi.
target: And my master made me swear an oath, and said, ‘You must not get a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,

source: Amavang nangma kapa in lama, kasopite lah-a naga chea, kachapa jiding nagapui ding ahi, atin ahi.
target: but go to my father’s family and to my own clan, and get a wife for my son.’

source: Chuin keiman kapu henga, Ijemtin numei chun eihin juinom tahih le, katin ahi.
target: “Then I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not come back with me?’

source: Ahin aman kahenga, amasanga kalamlhah jing Pakai chun avantil nalhonpi sah intin, nalampi chu alolhinsah ding; chule nangman kasopite le kapa insunga kona kachapa jiding napuiding ahi.
target: “He replied, ‘The Lord , before whom I have walked faithfully, will send his angel with you and make your journey a success, so that you can get a wife for my son from my own clan and from my father’s family.

source: Nangma kasopite heng nalhun teng le, hiche kihahsel na-a kona hi na-ondoh ding; chule amahon amanu nangma henga apehlou uva ahile, hiche kahahsel na-a kona hi na-ondoh ding ahi, atin ahi.
target: You will be released from my oath if, when you go to my clan, they refuse to give her to you—then you will be released from my oath.’

source: Chule tuni luikhuh kahung lhunin keiman, Vo Pakai kapu Abraham Pathen, nangma tu-a hi kachena lampi hi nalolhinsah dinga ahile,
target: “When I came to the spring today, I said, ‘ Lord , God of my master Abraham, if you will, please grant success to the journey on which I have come.

source: Vetan, keima twikhuh kom ahin kading-e; chule hung hiti ding ahi, nungah theng chu twi thaldinga ahunga, chule keiman ahenga, Katao ahi, natwi bela twi donding themkhat neipen, kati-a,
target: See, I am standing beside this spring. If a young woman comes out to draw water and I say to her, “Please let me drink a little water from your jar,”

source: Chule amanun kahenga, Donin, keiman na sangongsao ho ding jong gathal nange, tia seija amanu chu kapu chapa dinga Pakaiyin agon numei chu hihen katin ahi.
target: and if she says to me, “Drink, and I’ll draw water for your camels too,” let her be the one the Lord has chosen for my master’s son.’

source: Chuin hichu kalung sunga kaseijou masangin, veuvin, Rebekah hin alengkouva twibel ahinpun, ahung doh-in; chule amanu twikhuh-a chun akumlhan, twi chu agathal tai. Chuin keiman ahenga, Katao ahi, twi neidon sah-in kati.
target: “Before I finished praying in my heart, Rebekah came out, with her jar on her shoulder. She went down to the spring and drew water, and I said to her, ‘Please give me a drink.’

source: Chuin aman gangtah-in alengkouva twibel chu adomlhan, Donin, keiman na sangongsao ho jong donsah inge, atin ahi. Chuti chun keiman twi chu kadonin, chule aman sangongsao ho jong adonsah tai.
target: “She quickly lowered her jar from her shoulder and said, ‘Drink, and I’ll water your camels too.’ So I drank, and she watered the camels also.

source: Chuin keiman ama chu kadongin, ajah-a, Koi chanu nahim? kati. Chuin amanun, Milcah'in Nahor'a dinga ahinpeh chapa Bethuel chanu kahi, ati. Chuin keiman amaija bilba kabapeh in, akhutna chao kabupeh-in ahi.
target: “I asked her, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ “She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel son of Nahor, whom Milkah bore to him.’ “Then I put the ring in her nose and the bracelets on her arms,

source: Chuin kakunin, Pakai chu kahouvin, kapu sopipa chanu kapu chapa ji-a puipeh dinga lamdih-a eipuija Pakai kapu Abraham Pathen chu phatthei kabohtan ahi.
target: and I bowed down and worshiped the Lord . I praised the Lord , the God of my master Abraham, who had led me on the right road to get the granddaughter of my master’s brother for his son.

source: Chule tun, jetlam ham, veilam hama kakihei thei na dingin, kapu chu lungsettah le dihtah-a naboldiu le neisei peh-un: nabol loudiu jongle neisei peh-un, ati.
target: Now if you will show kindness and faithfulness to my master, tell me; and if not, tell me, so I may know which way to turn.”

source: Chuin Laban le Bethuel'in adonbut lhonin, Hiche thil hi Pakaiya kon ahin; keihon ase, apha nahenga kaseithei pouve.
target: Laban and Bethuel answered, “This is from the Lord ; we can say nothing to you one way or the other.

source: Ven, Rebekah na-angsunga aume, kipuijin lang chen, chuleh Pakaiyin aseibang chun, napu chapa jiding hitahen, atilhone.
target: Here is Rebekah; take her and go, and let her become the wife of your master’s son, as the Lord has directed.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Abraham sohpa chun athuseiju ajah phatnin, tolla aboh khupmin Pakai chu ahoutan ahi.
target: When Abraham’s servant heard what they said, he bowed down to the ground before the Lord .

source: Chuin Sohpa chun dangka kijep na, sana-a kijepna, chule ponsil ho aladoh-in, Rebekah chu apetan ahi. Aman asopipa leh anujong thil lutahtah apen ahi.
target: Then the servant brought out gold and silver jewelry and articles of clothing and gave them to Rebekah; he also gave costly gifts to her brother and to her mother.

source: Chuin amale aumpiho chun aneovin chule adonun, jankhovah keijin aumtaovin ahi. Chuin amaho jingkah-in athouvun, chule aman, Kapu henglama neisol taovin, ati.
target: Then he and the men who were with him ate and drank and spent the night there. When they got up the next morning, he said, “Send me on my way to my master.”

source: Chuin asopi pa le anun, Boinu hi ni chomkhat, nisombeh kaheng uvah umtadi hen; chujouteng leh che nante, atilhonne.
target: But her brother and her mother replied, “Let the young woman remain with us ten days or so; then you may go.”

source: Ahivangin amapan ahenguva, Pakaiyin kachena alolhinsah namu nungun, neikho ngaisah tahih-un; kapu henglama kache theina dingin neisoldoh taovin, ati.
target: But he said to them, “Do not detain me, now that the Lord has granted success to my journey. Send me on my way so I may go to my master.”

source: Chuin amahon, Keihon boinu kou ungting, ama dongnao vinge, atiuve.
target: Then they said, “Let’s call the young woman and ask her about it.”

source: Chuin amahon Rebekah chu akouvun, ajah-a, Hichepa toh nalhonna nache ding ham? atiuve. Chuin amanun, Kache ding ahi, ati.
target: So they called Rebekah and asked her, “Will you go with this man?” “I will go,” she said.

source: Chuin amahon anaonu Rebekah le ajenlenu, chule Abraham sohpa le aloite chu alhadoh taove.
target: So they sent their sister Rebekah on her way, along with her nurse and Abraham’s servant and his men.

source: Chuin amahon Rebekah chu phatthei aboh-un, ahenga, Nangma kasopinu-u nahi, nangma nelsang tamtah nu hunghin lang, chule nachilhahte chun amelmateu kotpi hinlouhen, atiuve.
target: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, “Our sister, may you increase to thousands upon thousands; may your offspring possess the cities of their enemies.”

source: Chuin Rebekah chu asoh nungah hotoh akipat doh-un, sangongsao ho chunga chun atouvun, mipa chu ajuitaove. Chutichun sohpa chun Rebekah chu akipuijin, achetan ahi.
target: Then Rebekah and her attendants got ready and mounted the camels and went back with the man. So the servant took Rebekah and left.

source: Chuin Isaac chu Beer-lahai-roi twikhuh lampia konchun ahungin ahi; ajehchu ama lhanglam gama chu chenga ahi.
target: Now Isaac had come from Beer Lahai Roi, for he was living in the Negev.

source: Chuin Isaac chu nilhah lamin loujaova lunggel dingin ahung potdoh-in; chuin ama akhodah-in aven ahile, veuvin, sangongsao ho ahung kijotnun ahi.
target: He went out to the field one evening to meditate, and as he looked up, he saw camels approaching.

source: Chuin Rebekah akhodah-in, chuin Isaac chu amuphatnin, sangongsao chunga konin akumlhan ahi.
target: Rebekah also looked up and saw Isaac. She got down from her camel

source: Ajehchu amanun sohpa henga chu, loujaova eilamdot diuva hung khu koi ham? tia anadoh-a; chule sohpa chun, Kapu ahi, anati ahi. Hijeh chun aman ponlukhuh alan, akikhuh tan ahi.
target: and asked the servant, “Who is that man in the field coming to meet us?” “He is my master,” the servant answered. So she took her veil and covered herself.

source: Chuin sohpa chun athilbol jouse chu Isaac aseipeh tan ahi.
target: Then the servant told Isaac all he had done.

source: Chuin Isaac'in ama chu anu Sarah pon insunga chun apuilutnin, chule Rebekah chu akipuijin, chuin amanu a-inneipi ahitan; chule aman amanu chu angailu lheh-in ahi. Chuin Isaac chu anu thi nungin lhamongin aumtan ahi.
target: Isaac brought her into the tent of his mother Sarah, and he married Rebekah. So she became his wife, and he loved her; and Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.

source: Chuin Abraham'in ji khat akipui kitnin, amin Keturah ahi.
target: Abraham had taken another wife, whose name was Keturah.

source: Chule amanun amachu Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak chule Shuah ahinpeh-in ahi.
target: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuah.

source: Chuin Jokshan'in Sheba le Dedan ahingin, chule Dedan chapate chu Asshurim, Lethushim chule Leummim ahiuve.
target: Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan; the descendants of Dedan were the Ashurites, the Letushites and the Leummites.

source: Chule Midian chapate chu, Ephah, Epher Hanoch, Abidah chule Eldaah ahiuve. Hichengse hi Keturah chate ahiuve.
target: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanok, Abida and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Keturah.

source: Chuin Abraham'in anei jouse chu Isaac apetan ahi.
target: Abraham left everything he owned to Isaac.

source: Chule ahin laijin Abraham'in athaikem chapate hojong thilpeh apen, chuin amaho chu achapa Isaac koma konin solamsang, solam gama asolmang tan ahi.
target: But while he was still living, he gave gifts to the sons of his concubines and sent them away from his son Isaac to the land of the east.

source: Chule Abraham hinkho kum nikho ho chu kum jakhat le kum somsagi le nga ahi.
target: Abraham lived a hundred and seventy-five years.

source: Chuin Abraham'in alhagao alhadoh-in, ateh kemset, tehsetah, chule kum lhingsetnin athin; amite toh gopkhomin aumtan ahi.
target: Then Abraham breathed his last and died at a good old age, an old man and full of years; and he was gathered to his people.

source: Chuin achapateni Isaac le Ishmael chun Hit mi Zohar chapa Ephron loumuna, Mamre koma Machpelah songkoa chun amachu avui lhontan ahi.
target: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre, in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite,

source: Chuche loumun chu Abraham'in Heth chapate-a kona anachohdoh ahi. Chua chun Abraham chu a-inneipi Sarah toh akivuitan ahi.
target: the field Abraham had bought from the Hittites. There Abraham was buried with his wife Sarah.

source: Chuin Abraham athi nungin ahitin ahi, Pathen'in achapa, Isaac chu phatthei aboh-in; chule Isaac chu Beer-lahai-roi twikhuh koma chun achengin ahi.
target: After Abraham’s death, God blessed his son Isaac, who then lived near Beer Lahai Roi.

source: Tun hiche hohi Abraham chapa, Ishmael Sarah sohnu, Egypt mi Hagar'in Abraham ahinpeh chilhah ho akhanggui chu ahi.
target: This is the account of the family line of Abraham’s son Ishmael, whom Sarah’s slave, Hagar the Egyptian, bore to Abraham.

source: Chule hiche ho hi akhanggui dungjui cheh uva Ishmael chapate min chu ahi. Ishmael cha apeng masa pen Nebaioth ahin, Abana Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
target: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, listed in the order of their birth: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

source: Mishma, Dumah, Nassa,
target: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,

source: Hadar, Tema, Jetur, Naphish chule Kedemah ahiuve.
target: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish and Kedemah.

source: Hichengse hi Ishmael chapate min chu ahin, chule hichengse hi akhopiu dungjui le akulpiu dungjuija amin; chule avaipiu dungjuijin leng som le leng ni chu ahiuve.
target: These were the sons of Ishmael, and these are the names of the twelve tribal rulers according to their settlements and camps.

source: Chule Ishmael hinkho kumho chu kum jakhat le kum somthum le sagi ahi. Chuin aman alhagao alhadoh-in athitan; chule amite toh gopkhomin aumtan ahi.
target: Ishmael lived a hundred and thirty-seven years. He breathed his last and died, and he was gathered to his people.

source: Chule amaho chu Havilah'a patnin Shur geijin achengun, hichu Egypt solam Assyria jotna-a um ahi. Chuin ama asopite jouse mitmun athitan ahi.
target: His descendants settled in the area from Havilah to Shur, near the eastern border of Egypt, as you go toward Ashur. And they lived in hostility toward all the tribes related to them.

source: Chule hicheng hi Abraham chapa, Isaac khanggui hochu ahiuve: Abraham'in Isaac ahingin ahi.
target: This is the account of the family line of Abraham’s son Isaac. Abraham became the father of Isaac,

source: Chule Isaac'in Padan Aram gama Syria mi Bethuel chanu, Syria mi Laban sopinu Rebekah aji dinga akipui chun, kum somli alhing tai.
target: and Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan Aram and sister of Laban the Aramean.

source: Chule a-inneipi chin jehchun Isaac'in Pakai henga ataopeh-in ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin ataona asanpeh-in, a-inneipi Rebekah chun nao avoptan ahi.
target: Isaac prayed to the Lord on behalf of his wife, because she was childless. The Lord answered his prayer, and his wife Rebekah became pregnant.

source: Chuin chapang teni chu asunga chun ahung kidel lhonin ahile, amanun, Hitiding ahi-a ahile, ibola hiti kahim? ati. Chuin amanu Pakai dong dingin achetai.
target: The babies jostled each other within her, and she said, “Why is this happening to me?” So she went to inquire of the Lord .

source: Chuin Pakaiyin amanu henga, Nanaobu sunga hi nam ni uma ahin; chule na-oisunga kona hi hina chomcheh nei mini khendoh-a umding ahi; chule khatjo chu khatjoh sanga chu hatjo ding, chule a-upa johchun anaopa ajending ahi.
target: The Lord said to her, “Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples from within you will be separated; one people will be stronger than the other, and the older will serve the younger.”

source: Chuin amanu asophat alhin phatnin, veuvin anaobu sunga chun naosen ni anaumin ahi.
target: When the time came for her to give birth, there were twin boys in her womb.

source: Chule ahungpot masa chu asanin, samul pon bangin amulin; chule amin Esau asah-un ahi.
target: The first to come out was red, and his whole body was like a hairy garment; so they named him Esau.

source: Chuche jouchun anaopa ahungpotnin, akhutnin Esau khotal jum ahintuh-in; chule amin Jacob asah-un ahi. Rebekah'in amani ahinpeh chun Isaac kum somgup alhingtan ahi.
target: After this, his brother came out, with his hand grasping Esau’s heel; so he was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when Rebekah gave birth to them.

source: Chutichun chapang teni chu ahung khangdoh lhonin; chule Esau chu sakap themtah mi gamlah mi ahin, Jacob vang chu mi-ummong pon in'a cheng ahi.
target: The boys grew up, and Esau became a skillful hunter, a man of the open country, while Jacob was content to stay at home among the tents.

source: Chuin asakap sa anehji jeh-in, Isaac chun Esau angailun, Rebekah'in vang Jacob angailun ahi.
target: Isaac, who had a taste for wild game, loved Esau, but Rebekah loved Jacob.

source: Khatvei hi Jacob'in annoi ahonin; chule Esau gama konin ahungin, agilkel lheh jengin ahi.
target: Once when Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau came in from the open country, famished.

source: Chuin Esau'in Jacob henga, Katao ahi, na annoi hon san peh chu neineh sah-in, ajehchu keima kel lih paiding kahitai, ati. Hijeh-a chu amin Edom kisah ahi.
target: He said to Jacob, “Quick, let me have some of that red stew! I’m famished!” (That is why he was also called Edom.)

source: Chuin Jacob'in, Na-upat chu tunin neichoh sah-in, ati.
target: Jacob replied, “First sell me your birthright.”

source: Chuin Esau'in, Athipai ding kahitai, keima dinga upat hi ija phachom dingham? ati.
target: “Look, I am about to die,” Esau said. “What good is the birthright to me?”

source: Chuin Jacob'in, Tunin kahenga kihahsel in ati: chuin ama ahenga akihahselin, a-upat chu Jacob henga akijoh tai.
target: But Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” So he swore an oath to him, selling his birthright to Jacob.

source: Chujouvin Jacob'in Esau chu changlhah le bechimnoi chu apen; chuin aman anen adonin, chuin akipatdoh-in, achemang tan ahi. Hitichun Esau'in a-upat na chu iman ageltapoi.
target: Then Jacob gave Esau some bread and some lentil stew. He ate and drank, and then got up and left. So Esau despised his birthright.

source: Chuin chuche gama chun Abraham nikho laija kellhah masa chu hilouvin, kel ahung lhatan ahi. Chuin Isaac chu Philistine lengpa Abimelech henga Gerar mun'a agachen ahi.
target: Now there was a famine in the land—besides the previous famine in Abraham’s time—and Isaac went to Abimelek king of the Philistines in Gerar.

source: Chuin Pakai ahenga ahung kilah-in, ajah-a, Egypt gama chesuh hih-in, keiman kaseipeh ding gama chun chengin.
target: The Lord appeared to Isaac and said, “Do not go down to Egypt; live in the land where I tell you to live.

source: Hiche gama hin khopemin, chule keiman nangma umping ting, phatthei kaboh ding nahi; ajehchu nangma le nachilhahte henga hiche gamjouse hi kapeh ding; chutia chu keiman napa Abraham henga kaki hahsel na chu kasuh bulhit ding ahi.
target: Stay in this land for a while, and I will be with you and will bless you. For to you and your descendants I will give all these lands and will confirm the oath I swore to your father Abraham.

source: Chule keiman nachilhahte van'a ahsi jatnin punsah ingting, chule hiche gam jouse hi nachilhahte kapeh ding; chule nachilhahte-a kona vannoi namtin jouse phatthei boh chang ding ahiuve.
target: I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and will give them all these lands, and through your offspring all nations on earth will be blessed,

source: Ajehchu Abraham'in kathu angaijin chule kathuhil ho, kathupeh ho, kachondan ho, chule kadanthu ho anitnin ahi, ati.
target: because Abraham obeyed me and did everything I required of him, keeping my commands, my decrees and my instructions.”

source: Chuti chun Isaac Gerar mun'a chun achengtan ahi.
target: So Isaac stayed in Gerar.

source: Chuin chuche mun'a cheng ho chun a-inneipi thudol adongun ahile, aman, Kanaonu ahi, ati. Ajehchu amanu ahoijeh chun chuche munna miho chun Rebekah jal chun eithat getnunte, tia ageljeh-a, Ka-inneipi ahi, ati ngamlou ahi.
target: When the men of that place asked him about his wife, he said, “She is my sister,” because he was afraid to say, “She is my wife.” He thought, “The men of this place might kill me on account of Rebekah, because she is beautiful.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, ama chukoma sottah aumjouvin, Philistine lengpa Abimelech'in bangkotna konin ahinven ahile, Isaac'in Rebekah anoupet amun ahi.
target: When Isaac had been there a long time, Abimelek king of the Philistines looked down from a window and saw Isaac caressing his wife Rebekah.

source: Chuin Abimelech'in Isaac chu akouvin, ahenga, Vetan, amanuhi na-inneipi ahimonge; achutile itidana, Kanaonu ahi, nati ham? ati. Chuin Isaac'in ahenga, Ajehchu keiman ajole amanu jal hin thilo getninge, tia kagel jeh ahi, ati.
target: So Abimelek summoned Isaac and said, “She is really your wife! Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’?” Isaac answered him, “Because I thought I might lose my life on account of her.”

source: Chuin Abimelech'in, Kachunguva nathil bol hi ipi hitam? Miho lah-a khattou hin na-inneipi hi bailam tah-a aluppi jeng thei ahin, chutia chu kachunguva hi themona nahin lhunsah jengthei ahi, ati.
target: Then Abimelek said, “What is this you have done to us? One of the men might well have slept with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us.”

source: Chuin Abimelech'in amite jouse chu agih-in ahenguva, Koi hile mipa ahilou le, a-inneipi tongkha chan chu kithat teiding ahi, ati.
target: So Abimelek gave orders to all the people: “Anyone who harms this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.”

source: Chujouvin Isaac'in chuche gama chun muchi athen ahile, chuche kum chun ajat ja a-atdoh-in ahi; chule Pakaiyin amachu phatthei aboh-in ahi.
target: Isaac planted crops in that land and the same year reaped a hundredfold, because the Lord blessed him.

source: Chuin mipa chu ahung haolheh jengtan mihao nasatah ahung hi kahsen ahao tultul jengin ahi.
target: The man became rich, and his wealth continued to grow until he became very wealthy.

source: Ajehchu aman kelngoihon, bonghon, chule soh tamtah aneitan ahi. Chuin Philistine mihon amitthip taovin ahi.
target: He had so many flocks and herds and servants that the Philistines envied him.

source: Ajehchu apa Abraham hinlaija apa sohten analaiju twikhuh jouse chu Philistine mihon asuhtanguva, chule leija adipdim gamu ahitai.
target: So all the wells that his father’s servants had dug in the time of his father Abraham, the Philistines stopped up, filling them with earth.

source: Chuin Abimelech'in Isaac henga, Keiho-a konin chemang taovin, ajehchu nangma keiho sangin gamchengin nahat tai, ati.
target: Then Abimelek said to Isaac, “Move away from us; you have become too powerful for us.”

source: Chuin Isaac chua kon chun akichonin, Gerar phaichama pon in asongin chua chun achengtai.
target: So Isaac moved away from there and encamped in the Valley of Gerar, where he settled.

source: Chuin Isaac'in apa Abraham hinlaija atuikhuh laiho chu alai kittan ahi; ajehchu Philistine miten Abraham thinunga anasuh tang gamu ahitai. Chule apan ana minsah bang cheh chun, amin sah cheh kittan ahi.
target: Isaac reopened the wells that had been dug in the time of his father Abraham, which the Philistines had stopped up after Abraham died, and he gave them the same names his father had given them.

source: Chuin Isaac sohten phaicham chu alaijun ahile, twinah put khat amutaove.
target: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley and discovered a well of fresh water there.

source: Chuin Gerar mun'a ganchingho chun, Twi hi keiho-a ahi atiuvin, Isaac ganching ho chu akinah pi taovin ahi. Chuin amahon akinahpi jeh-u chun twikhuh minchu Esek asahtai.
target: But the herders of Gerar quarreled with those of Isaac and said, “The water is ours!” So he named the well Esek, because they disputed with him.

source: Chujouvin amahon twikhuh chomkhat alaikitnun ahile, hiche chunga jong chun akina kit taove. Hijeh chun aman chuche minchu Sitnah asahtai.
target: Then they dug another well, but they quarreled over that one also; so he named it Sitnah.

source: Chuin ama chua konchun akichon kitnin, twikhuh khat alaikitnin ahile hiche chunga vang chun akina tapouve. Hijeh chun hiche mun chu Rehoboth asahtai; ajehchu tunvang Pakaiyin eihodin mun eipe taovin, chule hiche gamahi hatah-a ipundiu ahitai, ati.
target: He moved on from there and dug another well, and no one quarreled over it. He named it Rehoboth, saying, “Now the Lord has given us room and we will flourish in the land.”

source: Chuin hichea kon chun ama Beersheba'a achetou tan ahi.
target: From there he went up to Beersheba.

source: Chuin chuche janchun ahenga Pakai ahung akilah-in, Keima hi napa Abraham Pathen chu kahi; kicha hih-in, ajehchu keiman nangma kaumpinai; chule kasoh Abraham jala nangma phatthei kaboh ding, chule nachilhah kapunsah ding ahi, ati.
target: That night the Lord appeared to him and said, “I am the God of your father Abraham. Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bless you and will increase the number of your descendants for the sake of my servant Abraham.”

source: Hijeh chun aman chua chun maicham khat asemin, Pakai minchu akouvin, chule chua chun apon in asongin ahi. Chuin chua chun Isaac sohte chun twikhuh khat alaijun ahi.
target: Isaac built an altar there and called on the name of the Lord . There he pitched his tent, and there his servants dug a well.

source: Chujouvin Abimelech Gerar'a konin agolho lah-a khat Ahuzzath le, asepai lamkai Phicol toh ahenga agacheuvin ahi.
target: Meanwhile, Abimelek had come to him from Gerar, with Ahuzzath his personal adviser and Phicol the commander of his forces.

source: Chuin Isaac'in amaho henga, Neivetda jeh uva naheng uva kona neisol doh-u ahitan, ipi dinga kahenga hung nahiuvem? ati.
target: Isaac asked them, “Why have you come to me, since you were hostile to me and sent me away?”

source: Chuin amahon, Pakaiyin, naumpi-e ti kichentah-in kamuve. Hijeh-a chu keihon, Tun eiho kah-a, keihole nangma kah ngeija kihahselna umhen lang, nangma toh kitepna neileuhen katiu ahi.
target: They answered, “We saw clearly that the Lord was with you; so we said, ‘There ought to be a sworn agreement between us’—between us and you. Let us make a treaty with you

source: Chutia chu keihon nangma katohkhah daova, chule apha tailou imacha dang kabol daova, chule lungmong tah-a kasolmang bangu chu, nangman jong neisuhset louna dingu ahi. Tun nangma Pakai phatthei boh chang nahitai, atiuve.
target: that you will do us no harm, just as we did not harm you but always treated you well and sent you away peacefully. And now you are blessed by the Lord .”

source: Chuin aman amaho ding chun golvah abolin, chuin amahon aneuvin, adonnuvin ahi.
target: Isaac then made a feast for them, and they ate and drank.

source: Chuin jingkah matah in athouvun, amaho khat le khat akihahsel uvin ahi. Chuin Isaac'in amaho chu asoldoh-in, chule amaho ama-a konin lung mongin achedoh taove.
target: Early the next morning the men swore an oath to each other. Then Isaac sent them on their way, and they went away peacefully.

source: Chuin chuche ni mama chun ahitin ahi, Isaac sohte ahungun, atuikhuh laiju chungchang thu chu ahung seijun, ahenga, Twi kamutaove, ahung tiuve.
target: That day Isaac’s servants came and told him about the well they had dug. They said, “We’ve found water!”

source: Chuin aman hichu Shebah asahtai. Hijeh chun chuche khopi minchu tu nikho geijin Beersheba ahung hitai.
target: He called it Shibah, and to this day the name of the town has been Beersheba.

source: Chuin Esau kum somli alhinin, Hit mi Beeri chanu Judith, chule Hit mi Elon chanu Bashemath jin aneijin ahi.
target: When Esau was forty years old, he married Judith daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and also Basemath daughter of Elon the Hittite.

source: Chule amani chu Isaac le Rebekah dingin lungnatna ahi lhonin ahi.
target: They were a source of grief to Isaac and Rebekah.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Isaac chu ateh-a khomutheilou khopma amit athim phatnin, achapa lenjo Esau chu akouvin, ahenga, Kachapa, atin ahile, aman adonbutnin, Ven, hikoma kaume, ati.
target: When Isaac was old and his eyes were so weak that he could no longer see, he called for Esau his older son and said to him, “My son.” “Here I am,” he answered.

source: Chuin aman, Tun vetan, keima katehtan, itih nikho-a kathi dingham kahepon ahi.
target: Isaac said, “I am now an old man and don’t know the day of my death.

source: Hijeh chun katao ahi, tun nagalvonho, nalivathei le nathalpi kikenin lang, gamlah-a chen, chule keimadin sa gakaptan.
target: Now then, get your equipment—your quiver and bow—and go out to the open country to hunt some wild game for me.

source: Chule kathi masanga kahinnan phatthei nabohthei nadingin, kadulamtah-in, tuitah-in neihon peh-in lang, kaneh dingin kahenga hinchoijin, ati.
target: Prepare me the kind of tasty food I like and bring it to me to eat, so that I may give you my blessing before I die.”

source: Chule Isaac'in achapa Esau henga athusei chu Rebekah'in ajatan ahi. Chuin Esau sakap ding le ahinpo dingin gamlah-a achetan ahi.
target: Now Rebekah was listening as Isaac spoke to his son Esau. When Esau left for the open country to hunt game and bring it back,

source: Chuin Rebekah'in achapa Jacob henga, Ven, napa keiman na-upa henga,
target: Rebekah said to her son Jacob, “Look, I overheard your father say to your brother Esau,

source: Sa gakap minlang, chule me tuitah-in neihon peh-in, chule hichu nengting, kathi masangin Pakai masanga phathei naboh inge, tia asei kajai, ati.
target: ‘Bring me some game and prepare me some tasty food to eat, so that I may give you my blessing in the presence of the Lord before I die.’

source: Hijeh chun tun, kachapa, nangman kathupeh dungjuijin kathu ngaijin.
target: Now, my son, listen carefully and do what I tell you:

source: Tun gan hon lah-a chenlang, alah-a kelnou phatahtah ni hinchoijin; chule keiman hichu adulam tah-in, napa dingin me tuitah honpeh-ing kate.
target: Go out to the flock and bring me two choice young goats, so I can prepare some tasty food for your father, just the way he likes it.

source: Chule aman aneh-a, athi masanga phatthei naboh nadinga, hichu napa henga nachoipeh ding ahi, ati.
target: Then take it to your father to eat, so that he may give you his blessing before he dies.”

source: Chuin Jacob'in anu Rebekah henga, Ven, ka-upa Esau hi mimul ahin, keimala minam kahi ngalin,
target: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, “But my brother Esau is a hairy man while I have smooth skin.

source: Ijemtin kapan eihin tham tale, ama dinga keima hi milhemtoh kabah ding ahin, phatthei boh hijolouvin, gaosap najoh kaki buh khum ding ahi, ati.
target: What if my father touches me? I would appear to be tricking him and would bring down a curse on myself rather than a blessing.”

source: Chuin anun ahenga, Kachapa nakigaosap nachu keima chunga chumaihen; kathuhi ngaipou pouvin, chenlang neigalah pehtan, ati.
target: His mother said to him, “My son, let the curse fall on me. Just do what I say; go and get them for me.”

source: Chuin ama achen, agalan, hichu anu henga ahinchoitan ahi. Chuin anun apa dulamtah in me chu ahontan ahi.
target: So he went and got them and brought them to his mother, and she prepared some tasty food, just the way his father liked it.

source: Chuin Rebekah'in achapa lenjo Esau von phaho in'a akoma umho chu alan, achapa neojo Jacob chu avonpehtan ahi.
target: Then Rebekah took the best clothes of Esau her older son, which she had in the house, and put them on her younger son Jacob.

source: Chuin amanun kelnou vunho chu akhut teni le angong nam laija chun atom pehtan ahi.
target: She also covered his hands and the smooth part of his neck with the goatskins.

source: Chuin amanun ame hon tuitah le changlhah chu achapa Jacob khutna apetan ahi.
target: Then she handed to her son Jacob the tasty food and the bread she had made.

source: Chuin ama apa henga ahungin, ajah-a, Hepa, atin ahile; aman, Hikoma kaume, koi nahim kachapa, ati.
target: He went to his father and said, “My father.” “Yes, my son,” he answered. “Who is it?”

source: Chuin Jacob'in apa henga, Keima nachapa apeng masa Esau chu kahi; nangman neithupeh bangin kagaboltai. Katao ahi, thouvin, chule touvin lang, phatthei neibohnadin kasakap hi netan, ati.
target: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done as you told me. Please sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may give me your blessing.”

source: Chuin Isaac'in achapa henga chun, kachapa, chubang loma gangtah-a nagamu jeng chu iti danham? ati. Chuin aman, Pakai na Pathen'in kahenga ahinchoijeh ahi, ati.
target: Isaac asked his son, “How did you find it so quickly, my son?” “The Lord your God gave me success,” he replied.

source: Chuin Isaac'in Jacob henga, Katao ahi, kachapa Esau mong mong nahi nahilou katham theina dingin, hungnai temin, ati.
target: Then Isaac said to Jacob, “Come near so I can touch you, my son, to know whether you really are my son Esau or not.”

source: Chuin Jacob'in apa Isaac ahin naijin, chuin aman amachu achulin, A-aw hila Jacob aw ahin, ahin akhut ho hila Esau khut ahingalin, ati.
target: Jacob went close to his father Isaac, who touched him and said, “The voice is the voice of Jacob, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”

source: Akhut hochu a-upa Esau khut banga amuljeh chun, koi ahi ahekhen thei tapon ahi. Hijeh chun aman amachu phatthei aboh tan ahi.
target: He did not recognize him, for his hands were hairy like those of his brother Esau; so he proceeded to bless him.

source: Chuin aman, Nangma kachapa Esau nahi mong mong hinam? ati. Chuin aman adonbutnin, Kahimonge ati.
target: “Are you really my son Esau?” he asked. “I am,” he replied.

source: Chuin aman, Kahenga hinchoi naijin, kahinnan phatthei kaboh thei nadingin, kachapa sakap nenge, ati. Chuin aman ahinchoi naipeh-in, anetan; chuin lengpitwi jong ahin choipeh-in, adontan ahi.
target: Then he said, “My son, bring me some of your game to eat, so that I may give you my blessing.” Jacob brought it to him and he ate; and he brought some wine and he drank.

source: Chuin apa Isaac'in ahenga, Kachapa, tun hung naijin lang, neichopmin, ati.
target: Then his father Isaac said to him, “Come here, my son, and kiss me.”

source: Chuin ama ahung naijin, achopmin; chuin aman avonho namchu anah-in, amachu phatthei aboh-in, hitin ati, Ven kachapa gimnam hi Pakai phatthei boh gam gimnam ahi.
target: So he went to him and kissed him. When Isaac caught the smell of his clothes, he blessed him and said, “Ah, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field that the Lord has blessed.

source: Chuti ahijeh chun Pathen'in nangma van daitwi le leipha, chule chang le lengpitwi ninglhing setnin napehen.
target: May God give you heaven’s dew and earth’s richness— an abundance of grain and new wine.

source: Mitinin nangma najenu hen, chule namtin nangma anga kuncheh-u hen. Nasopite chunga a-pakaiyun uminlang, nanu chapate na anga kun uhen. Nangma nagaosap chanchu gaosap chang hen lang, nangma phatthei naboh chanchu phatthei boh changhen, ati.
target: May nations serve you and peoples bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers, and may the sons of your mother bow down to you. May those who curse you be cursed and those who bless you be blessed.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Isaac'in Jacob phatthei aboh jou chun, Jacob apa Isaac henga konin anapotdoh man hamhamin, a-upa Esau asadela konin ahung lhung paitan ahi.
target: After Isaac finished blessing him, and Jacob had scarcely left his father’s presence, his brother Esau came in from hunting.

source: Chuin aman jong me tuitah in ahonin, apa henga ahin domin; chule apa henga, Kapa, thouvin lang nahinnan phatthei neiboh nadingin, nachapa sakap hi netan, ati.
target: He too prepared some tasty food and brought it to his father. Then he said to him, “My father, please sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may give me your blessing.”

source: Chuin apa Isaac'in ahenga, Nangma koi nahim? ati. Chuin aman, Keima nachapa apeng masa Esau kahi, ati.
target: His father Isaac asked him, “Who are you?” “I am your son,” he answered, “your firstborn, Esau.”

source: Chuin Isaac nasatah in ati akithing jengtan, koiham? Sa gakapma kahenga asa hinchoija, nahung lhun masanga kana nehjou hella, phatthei kana bohchaisa chu hoilamba hitam? Tahbeh-a amachu phattheiboh changding ahitai, ati.
target: Isaac trembled violently and said, “Who was it, then, that hunted game and brought it to me? I ate it just before you came and I blessed him—and indeed he will be blessed!”

source: Chuin Esau'in apa thusei ajah phatnin, nasatah le lhasetah in akaplutlut jengtan, apa henga, Vo hepa, phatthei neiboh-in, keimatah ngeijong hi phatthei neibohteijin, ati.
target: When Esau heard his father’s words, he burst out with a loud and bitter cry and said to his father, “Bless me—me too, my father!”

source: Chuin aman, nanaopa kahenga doha themtah-in ahungin, na phatthei chanding chu akilahdoh tai, ati.
target: But he said, “Your brother came deceitfully and took your blessing.”

source: Chuin aman Jacob kisah chu dih lheh hilou ham? Ajehchu aman niveijen ei dohabol ahitai. Aman ka-upat eilah peh-in, chule ven tun kaphatthei chanding eilahmang peh kit tai, ati. Chuin aman, Phattheina neikhen peh louhel hitam? ati.
target: Esau said, “Isn’t he rightly named Jacob? This is the second time he has taken advantage of me: He took my birthright, and now he’s taken my blessing!” Then he asked, “Haven’t you reserved any blessing for me?”

source: Chuin Isaac'in Esau chu adonbutnin, ahenga, Vetan, amachu napakai din kasemtan, chule asopite jouse asohdin kapetan; chule ama chang le lengpitwi jin kavangboh tai. Achutile kachapa nangdinga ipi kabolpeh ding hitam? ati.
target: Isaac answered Esau, “I have made him lord over you and have made all his relatives his servants, and I have sustained him with grain and new wine. So what can I possibly do for you, my son?”

source: Chuin Esau'in apa henga, Phattheina khatseh bou nanei hija ham? Vo hepa, keimahi, keima ngeijong hi phatthei neiboh teijin, ati. Chuin Esau chu hatah-in akaptan ahi.
target: Esau said to his father, “Do you have only one blessing, my father? Bless me too, my father!” Then Esau wept aloud.

source: Chuin apa Isaac'in adonbutnin, ahenga, Vetan, nachenna ding chu leiphatna le chunga kona van daitwi umna mun hiding ahi.
target: His father Isaac answered him, “Your dwelling will be away from the earth’s richness, away from the dew of heaven above.

source: Chule nangma nachem jama nahina, chule nanaopa najending; chule hung hitiding ahi: nangma vaihom na nahin nei teng le, nangonga kona anamkoljon chu nasuhboh ding ahi, ati.
target: You will live by the sword and you will serve your brother. But when you grow restless, you will throw his yoke from off your neck.”

source: Chuin apan phatthei aboh jeh chun, Esau'in Jacob ahotan ahi. Chuin Esau'in alungsunga, Kapa chunga lunghemna nikho anaitan; chujoule kanaopa Jacob hi that ning kate, ati.
target: Esau held a grudge against Jacob because of the blessing his father had given him. He said to himself, “The days of mourning for my father are near; then I will kill my brother Jacob.”

source: Chuin achapa lenjo Esau thusei chu Rebekah chu aseipeh taovin ahi. Hichun aman achapa neojo Jacob chu akouvin, ahenga, Vetan, na-upa Esau'in nangma thading nagon, amale ama akilhamonin ahi.
target: When Rebekah was told what her older son Esau had said, she sent for her younger son Jacob and said to him, “Your brother Esau is planning to avenge himself by killing you.

source: Hijeh chun tun, kachapa kathu ngaijin, kipat ninlang Haran'a kasopipa Laban heng lama jamtan.
target: Now then, my son, do what I say: Flee at once to my brother Laban in Harran.

source: Chule na-upa lungsat nahi abei kahsen, ama chutoh nichom khat ga umtan.
target: Stay with him for a while until your brother’s fury subsides.

source: Nachunga na-upa lunghan nahi abeija achunga nathilbol hi asuhmil tengleh, mi hinsoling ting, chua kon chun hung puidoh sah nange. Ipi dinga hi nikhat tah-a nani lhonna kachan ding ham? ati.
target: When your brother is no longer angry with you and forgets what you did to him, I’ll send word for you to come back from there. Why should I lose both of you in one day?”

source: Chuin Rebekah'in Isaac henga, Heth chanute jal hin kahinkho ahesoh lheh jenge, Jacob hin hiche gama Heth chanute lah-a hi ji aneikit dingle, kahin hi keidinga ipi phatna ding umem? ati.
target: Then Rebekah said to Isaac, “I’m disgusted with living because of these Hittite women. If Jacob takes a wife from among the women of this land, from Hittite women like these, my life will not be worth living.”

source: Chuin Isaac'in Jacob akouvin, phatthei aboh-in, thu apen ahenga, Nangman Canaan mite chanuho naji dinga nakipui theilou ding ahi.
target: So Isaac called for Jacob and blessed him. Then he commanded him: “Do not marry a Canaanite woman.

source: Kipat in, Padan Aram lama nanu pa Bethuel in'a chen; chua kon chun nanu sopipa Laban chanute khat naji ding gakipuijin.
target: Go at once to Paddan Aram, to the house of your mother’s father Bethuel. Take a wife for yourself there, from among the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

source: Chule nangma vaipi khat nahi thei nadingin, hat chungnung Pathen'in phatthei naboh hen, nachi phatsah henlang, hapunin napunsah hen.
target: May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and increase your numbers until you become a community of peoples.

source: Chule hiche nakholjinna gam, Pathen'in Abraham henga anapehsa gamhi nalotheina din, Abraham phatthei kiboh na chu nangma le nachilhahte napeu hen, ati.
target: May he give you and your descendants the blessing given to Abraham, so that you may take possession of the land where you now reside as a foreigner, the land God gave to Abraham.”

source: Chuin Isaac'in Jacob asolmang tan ahi. Chuin ama Jacob le Esau nu Rebekah sopipa, Syria mi Bethuel chapa Laban henglam Padan Aram lama achetan ahi.
target: Then Isaac sent Jacob on his way, and he went to Paddan Aram, to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, who was the mother of Jacob and Esau.

source: Esau'in, Isaac'in Jacob phatthei aboh-a Padan-Aram'a ji kipui dingin asol le, aman amachu phatthei aboh-a, Canaan chanute nakichenpi louding ahi, tia thu apeh chu amun,
target: Now Esau learned that Isaac had blessed Jacob and had sent him to Paddan Aram to take a wife from there, and that when he blessed him he commanded him, “Do not marry a Canaanite woman,”

source: Chule Jacob in anule apa thu angaija, Padan Aram-a ache chu amun;
target: and that Jacob had obeyed his father and mother and had gone to Paddan Aram.

source: Chule Esau'in Canaan chanute chun apa Isaac alung lhaisah pouve, ti amu phatnin;
target: Esau then realized how displeasing the Canaanite women were to his father Isaac;

source: Chuin Esau Ishmael henga achen, Abraham chapa, Ishmael chanu Mahalath, Nebojoth sopinu chu ji aneisaho chung chon chun akichenpi kitnin ahi.
target: so he went to Ishmael and married Mahalath, the sister of Nebaioth and daughter of Ishmael son of Abraham, in addition to the wives he already had.

source: Chuin Jacob Beersheba'a konin akipat doh-in, Haran lam jonin achetai.
target: Jacob left Beersheba and set out for Harran.

source: Chuin ama munkhat alhun phatnin, nisa alhumtah jehchun ageh khovahtan ahi. Chuin aman chuche munna songkhat chu alan, lukhapmin aneijin, chukoma ihmuding chun alumtan ahi.
target: When he reached a certain place, he stopped for the night because the sun had set. Taking one of the stones there, he put it under his head and lay down to sleep.

source: Chuin aman mang aneijin, Vetan, leiset chunga kalbilei akidon, chule hiche mong chun van aphan, chule Pathen vantil ho akumsuh akaltou chu amun ahi
target: He had a dream in which he saw a stairway resting on the earth, with its top reaching to heaven, and the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

source: Chuin vetan, chuche vuma chun Pakai adingin, Keima hi Pakai, napu Abraham Pathen, chule Isaac Pathen chu kahi; nalupna gamhi nangma le na chilhahte henga kapeh ding ahi, ati.
target: There above it stood the Lord , and he said: “I am the Lord , the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac. I will give you and your descendants the land on which you are lying.

source: Chule nachilhahte chu leisetna leivuijat hung hintin, chule nangma lhumlam le solama, chule sahlam leh lhanglama naki thejao ding ahi. Chule nangma le nachilhahte-a kona vannoi'a namtin phattheiboh chang dingu ahi.
target: Your descendants will be like the dust of the earth, and you will spread out to the west and to the east, to the north and to the south. All peoples on earth will be blessed through you and your offspring.

source: Chule vetan, Keiman nangma kaumpinai, chule nachena chana kachintupma, hiche gama hi kahin nungpui kitding nahi; ajehchu nahenga kasei hi kamolso masangsen nangma dalhapong kate.
target: I am with you and will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you.”

source: Chuin Jacob a-ihmutna konin ahung khangdoh-in; chule aman, Hiche mun'a hin Pakai aum monge; hichu keiman kana hetlou ahi, ati.
target: When Jacob awoke from his sleep, he thought, “Surely the Lord is in this place, and I was not aware of it.”

source: Chuin ama akichatan, Hiche mun hi tijat iti umtam! hikom hi Pathen in tailou adang ima ahipoi, hiche hi van kotpi phung ahi, atitai.
target: He was afraid and said, “How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God; this is the gate of heaven.”

source: Chuin Jacob jingpitah-in athouvin, lukhapma akoi song chu alan, song khom-in aphutnin, achungvuma chun thao asungin ahi.
target: Early the next morning Jacob took the stone he had placed under his head and set it up as a pillar and poured oil on top of it.

source: Chuin aman chumun chu Bethel asah tai. Ahin atila chu chuche khopi chu Luz anakisah ahi.
target: He called that place Bethel, though the city used to be called Luz.

source: Chuin Jacob'in kitepna aneijin, Pathen'in eiumpia, kachena lampia hi eichintupma, nehding changlhah le kivon nading sil le chen eipeh-a,
target: Then Jacob made a vow, saying, “If God will be with me and will watch over me on this journey I am taking and will give me food to eat and clothes to wear

source: Hitia chu kapa in'a lungmong tah-a kahung kilekitna ahile, Pakai chu ka Pathen hiding ahi.
target: so that I return safely to my father’s household, then the Lord will be my God

source: Chule hiche song khoma katun hi Pathen In hiding; chule nangman neipeh jouse-a kona hi somakhat thonlou hela kapeh ding nahi, ati.
target: and this stone that I have set up as a pillar will be God’s house, and of all that you give me I will give you a tenth.”

source: Chujouvin Jacob akholche achepeh-in, chule solam mite gam agalhungtai.
target: Then Jacob continued on his journey and came to the land of the eastern peoples.

source: Chuin aman agahven ahile, gamlah-a twikhuh khat amun, chule veuvin, akoma chun kelngoi honthum akolun ahi; ajehchu twikhuh-a kona chu amahon kelngoi honchu twi adonsah jiu ahi. Chule song lentah khat twikhuh kama chun akikoijin ahi.
target: There he saw a well in the open country, with three flocks of sheep lying near it because the flocks were watered from that well. The stone over the mouth of the well was large.

source: Chule chua chu kelngoi hon jouse kikhom khom jiuva, chule achinghon twikhuh kama kona chu song chu atahdoh jiuva, kelngoi ho chu twi adonsah jiu ahin; chujouteng, song chu twikhuh kama aum na-a chu akoikit jiu ahi.
target: When all the flocks were gathered there, the shepherds would roll the stone away from the well’s mouth and water the sheep. Then they would return the stone to its place over the mouth of the well.

source: Chuin Jacob'in amaho jah-a, Kasopite, nangho hoilamkon mi nahiuvem? ati. Chuin amahon, Haran'a kon kahiuve, atiuve.
target: Jacob asked the shepherds, “My brothers, where are you from?” “We’re from Harran,” they replied.

source: Chuin aman ahenguva, Nahor chapa, Laban chu nahet uvem? ati. Chuin amahon, Kaheuve, atiuve.
target: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, Nahor’s grandson?” “Yes, we know him,” they answered.

source: Chuin aman ahenguva, Amachu damnam? ati. Chuin amahon, Adamnai, chule ven, achanu Rachel'in kelngoi ahinpuijin ahunge, atiuve.
target: Then Jacob asked them, “Is he well?” “Yes, he is,” they said, “and here comes his daughter Rachel with the sheep.”

source: Chuin aman, Veuvin, nisa khu asang lheh nalaijin, gancha puikhom phatjong ahihihlaije. Kelngoi hohi twi chipsah unlang, an ganehsah kit taovin, ati.
target: “Look,” he said, “the sun is still high; it is not time for the flocks to be gathered. Water the sheep and take them back to pasture.”

source: Chuin amahon, kelngoihon jouse hung kikhop khom soh-a, twikhuh kama song akilahdoh masangsen, keiho chedoh thei pouvinge. Hiche jouteng chulebou keihon ka kelngoihou twi kadonsahjiu ahi, atiuve.
target: “We can’t,” they replied, “until all the flocks are gathered and the stone has been rolled away from the mouth of the well. Then we will water the sheep.”

source: Chuin ama amaho chutoh akihou nalaijin, Rachel apa kelngoi ho chutoh lhonin ahungin ahi; ajehchu aman kelngoiho chu achinji ahi.
target: While he was still talking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she was a shepherd.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Jacob'in anu sopipa Laban chanu Rachel le, anu sopipa Laban kelngoi hochu amuphatnin, Jacob chu agache naijin, song chu twikhuh kama konin atangdoh-in, anu sopipa Laban kelngoihon chu twi achip sah-in ahi.
target: When Jacob saw Rachel daughter of his uncle Laban, and Laban’s sheep, he went over and rolled the stone away from the mouth of the well and watered his uncle’s sheep.

source: Chuin Jacob in Rachel chu achopmin hatah in akaptan ahi.
target: Then Jacob kissed Rachel and began to weep aloud.

source: Chuin Jacob'in ama amanu pa sopipa ahi le, Rebekah chapa ahichu Rachel aseipeh tan ahi. Chuin amanu alhaijelin apa agahiltan ahi.
target: He had told Rachel that he was a relative of her father and a son of Rebekah. So she ran and told her father.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Laban'in asopinu chapa Jacob thu ajah phatnin, ama kimupi ding chun alhaijelin, amachu apomin, achopmin, a-in'a ahinpuitai. Chuin aman Laban chu thu jouse ahiltan ahi.
target: As soon as Laban heard the news about Jacob, his sister’s son, he hurried to meet him. He embraced him and kissed him and brought him to his home, and there Jacob told him all these things.

source: Chuin Laban'in ahenga, tahbeh-in nangma kagu le kaphe mong nahi, ati. Chuin ama akoma chun lhakhat aumtan ahi.
target: Then Laban said to him, “You are my own flesh and blood.” After Jacob had stayed with him for a whole month,

source: Chuin Laban'in Jacob henga, Nangma katupa nahimana keima mohseh-a neijen ding ham? Natoh man ipi hiding ham, neisei peh-in? ati.
target: Laban said to him, “Just because you are a relative of mine, should you work for me for nothing? Tell me what your wages should be.”

source: Tun Laban'in chanu ni aneijin, alen jonu minchu Leah ahin, aneo jonu minchu Rachel ahi.
target: Now Laban had two daughters; the name of the older was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

source: Leah chu amit agelin, Rachel vang chu mel hoitah le dei umtah ahi.
target: Leah had weak eyes, but Rachel had a lovely figure and was beautiful.

source: Chuin Jacob'in Rachel chu angailun, hijeh chun aman, Keiman nachanu neojo Rachel lonan kum sagi nangma jen inge ati.
target: Jacob was in love with Rachel and said, “I’ll work for you seven years in return for your younger daughter Rachel.”

source: Chuin Laban'in, Keiman amanu midang kapeh sangin, nangma kapeh ding aphajoi. Kakoma umtan ati.
target: Laban said, “It’s better that I give her to you than to some other man. Stay here with me.”

source: Chuin Jacob'in Rachel dingin kum sagi ajenin, ahin amanu angailut jehchun hiho chu amadin ni chomkhat to abang bepmin ahi.
target: So Jacob served seven years to get Rachel, but they seemed like only a few days to him because of his love for her.

source: Chuin Jacob'in Laban henga, Ahenga kalut theina dingin, ka-inneipi chu neipetan; ajehchu kanikho ho abulhing tai, ati.
target: Then Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife. My time is completed, and I want to make love to her.”

source: Chuin Laban'in chuche munna mijouse akhomin golvah abolin ahi.
target: So Laban brought together all the people of the place and gave a feast.

source: Chuin nilhah ahiphat nin ahitin ahi, aman achanu Leah chu apuijin, Jacob henga apuilut tan; chule amapa jong amanu henga aluttan ahi.
target: But when evening came, he took his daughter Leah and brought her to Jacob, and Jacob made love to her.

source: Chuin Laban'in asohnu Zilpah chu achanu Leah sohnu din apetai.
target: And Laban gave his servant Zilpah to his daughter as her attendant.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, jingkah ahunghi phatnin, Veuvin, Leah ana hitai. Chuin aman Laban henga, kachunga nabol hi ipi ham? Rachel dinga nangma kajen hilou ham? Achuti le ipi dinga nei dohabol ham? ati.
target: When morning came, there was Leah! So Jacob said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? I served you for Rachel, didn’t I? Why have you deceived me?”

source: Chuin Laban'in, kagam uva hi apeng masa masanga aneojo pehdoh chu kibol jilou hel ahi, ati.
target: Laban replied, “It is not our custom here to give the younger daughter in marriage before the older one.

source: Amanu hapta hi subulhitnin, chule kum sagi dang neijen kitding manin amanu jonghi nangma pekit naovinge, ati.
target: Finish this daughter’s bridal week; then we will give you the younger one also, in return for another seven years of work.”

source: Chuin Jacob'in chuti chun abolin, amanu hapta chu asubulhit tai. Chuin aman achanu Rachel chu aji dingin apetan ahi.
target: And Jacob did so. He finished the week with Leah, and then Laban gave him his daughter Rachel to be his wife.

source: Chuin Laban'in asohnu Bilhah chu achanu Rachel sohdin apetan ahi.
target: Laban gave his servant Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as her attendant.

source: Hitichun ama Rachel henga jong alutnin, aman Rachel chu Leah sangin angailu jon, chule amachu kum sagi dang ajenbe kitnin ahi.
target: Jacob made love to Rachel also, and his love for Rachel was greater than his love for Leah. And he worked for Laban another seven years.

source: Chuin Leah hotbola aumchu Pakaiyin amuphatnin, anaobu ahonpehtai. Ahin Rachel vangchu achingin ahi.
target: When the Lord saw that Leah was not loved, he enabled her to conceive, but Rachel remained childless.

source: Chuin Leah'in nao avopmin chapa khat ahingin, amin Reuben asah tai. Ajehchu amanun, tahbeh-in Pakaiyin kahesohna amutan; tunvang ka-inneipun eingailu tante, ati.
target: Leah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Reuben, for she said, “It is because the Lord has seen my misery. Surely my husband will love me now.”

source: Chuin amanun nao avop kitnin chapa khat ahingin, Pakaiyin hotna kaum ahetjeh-a, hiche chapa jong hi eipeh ahi, ati. Chuin aman amin Simeon asahtai.
target: She conceived again, and when she gave birth to a son she said, “Because the Lord heard that I am not loved, he gave me this one too.” So she named him Simeon.

source: Chuin amanun nao avop kitnin chapa khat ahingin, Tunvang chapa thum kahin pehtah jeh-in ka-inneipu keija beh tante, ati. Hijeh chun amin Levi asahtai.
target: Again she conceived, and when she gave birth to a son she said, “Now at last my husband will become attached to me, because I have borne him three sons.” So he was named Levi.

source: Chuin amanun nao avopkit leuvin chapa khat ahing kitnin, chuin amanun, Tunvang keiman Pakai chu vahchoi tange, atin ahi. Hijeh chun amanun amin Judah asahtai: chujouvin amanun acha hin abangtai.
target: She conceived again, and when she gave birth to a son she said, “This time I will praise the Lord .” So she named him Judah. Then she stopped having children.

source: Chuin Rachel'in Jacob cha ahinpeh lou chu amuphatnin, Rachel'in a-unu athangset tan ahi. Chuin amanun Jacob henga, Cha neipen, achuti louleh kathi ding ahi, ati.
target: When Rachel saw that she was not bearing Jacob any children, she became jealous of her sister. So she said to Jacob, “Give me children, or I’ll die!”

source: Chuin Jacob Rachel chunga alunghan akoujah jengin, ajah-a, Keima nanaobu khahtang-a, Pathen thalhenga uma kahim? ati.
target: Jacob became angry with her and said, “Am I in the place of God, who has kept you from having children?”

source: Chuin amanun, Ven, hikoma hin kasohnu Bilhah aume, amanu henga galut tan, chutia chu keiman jong amanu-a kona chate kaneija, chule amanun kaphei chunga cha ahinding ahi, ati.
target: Then she said, “Here is Bilhah, my servant. Sleep with her so that she can bear children for me and I too can build a family through her.”

source: Chuin amanun asohnu Bilhah chu a-inneipi dingin apetan, chule Jacob jong amanu henga agalut tan ahi.
target: So she gave him her servant Bilhah as a wife. Jacob slept with her,

source: Chuin Bilhah'in nao avopmin, Jacob chu chapa khat ahinpeh tai.
target: and she became pregnant and bore him a son.

source: Chuin Rachel'in, Pathen'in kathu atantan, chule ka aw jong ajan, chapa khat eipetai, ati. Hijeh chun amanun amin Dan asahtai.
target: Then Rachel said, “God has vindicated me; he has listened to my plea and given me a son.” Because of this she named him Dan.

source: Chuin Rachel sohnu Bilhah'in nao avop kitnin, Jacob chu chapa nina ahinpehtai.
target: Rachel’s servant Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.

source: Chuin Rachel'in, Kibotna nasatah-in ka-unu kabon-in, kajoutai, ati. Chuin amin Naphtali asah tai.
target: Then Rachel said, “I have had a great struggle with my sister, and I have won.” So she named him Naphtali.

source: Leah'in cha ahintah louding ahet phatnin, asohnu Zilpah chu Jacob henga apuijin, ajidin apetan ahi.
target: When Leah saw that she had stopped having children, she took her servant Zilpah and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

source: Chuin Leah sohnu Zilpah chun Jacob chapa khat ahin peh-in ahi.
target: Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a son.

source: Chuin Leah'in, Kavang phalheh-e, ati. Chuin amanun amin Gad asahtan ahi.
target: Then Leah said, “What good fortune!” So she named him Gad.

source: Chuin Leah sohnu Zilpah chun Jacob chu chapa nina ahinpeh-in ahi.
target: Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a second son.

source: Chuin Leah'in, Keima kakipah lheh jenge, ajehchu numei hon anunnom eitidiu ahitai, ati. Chuin amanun amin Asher asahtai.
target: Then Leah said, “How happy I am! The women will call me happy.” So she named him Asher.

source: Chuin suhlou chang at laijin Reuben avah len ahile, hamlah-a joldei-ai ahinmun, anu Leah henga ahin choijin ahi. Chujouvin Rachel'in Leah henga, Katao ahi, nachapa joldei-ai chu neipen, ati.
target: During wheat harvest, Reuben went out into the fields and found some mandrake plants, which he brought to his mother Leah. Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”

source: Chuin amanun ahenga, Ka-inneipu neichudoh peh jong hi thil neocha nahisah-a, kachapa joldei-ai kisan jonghi chudoh ding neigot kit ham? ati. Chuin Rachel'in, Hijeh chun nachapa joldei-ai manin aman tujan nangman luppi nan nate, ati.
target: But she said to her, “Wasn’t it enough that you took away my husband? Will you take my son’s mandrakes too?” “Very well,” Rachel said, “he can sleep with you tonight in return for your son’s mandrakes.”

source: Chuin nilhah lamin, Jacob louva kona ahungphatnin, Leah alamdot dingin apotdoh-in, ahenga, Keima henga nahunglut teiding ahi; ajehchu kachapa joldei-ai ja kalodoh nahitai, ati. Chuin aman chuche jan chun amanu aluppitan ahi.
target: So when Jacob came in from the fields that evening, Leah went out to meet him. “You must sleep with me,” she said. “I have hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” So he slept with her that night.

source: Chuin Pathen'in Leah taona chu asangin, chule amanun nao avopmin, Jacob chu chapa nga channa ahinpeh tai.
target: God listened to Leah, and she became pregnant and bore Jacob a fifth son.

source: Chuin Leah'in, Kasohnu chu ka-inneipu kapeh jeh-a, Pathen'in kalo eipeh ahitai, ati. Chuin amin chu Issachar asahtai.
target: Then Leah said, “God has rewarded me for giving my servant to my husband.” So she named him Issachar.

source: Chuin Leah'in nao avop kitnin, Jacob chu chapa gupna ahinpeh tai.
target: Leah conceived again and bore Jacob a sixth son.

source: Chuin Leah'in, Pathen'in keima thilken phatah eipetai; keiman chapa gup kahin peh tah jeh-in, tunvang ka-inneipun eichen khompi tante, ati. Chuin amin Zebulun asahtai.
target: Then Leah said, “God has presented me with a precious gift. This time my husband will treat me with honor, because I have borne him six sons.” So she named him Zebulun.

source: Chuin khonungin amanun chanu khat ahingin, amin Dinah asahtai.
target: Some time later she gave birth to a daughter and named her Dinah.

source: Chuin Pathen'in Rachel ageldoh-in, ataona asanpeh-in, anaobu ahonpeh tai.
target: Then God remembered Rachel; he listened to her and enabled her to conceive.

source: Chuin amanun nao avopmin, chapa khat ahingtai. Chuin amanun, Pathen'in noise-a kaumna aladohtai, ati.
target: She became pregnant and gave birth to a son and said, “God has taken away my disgrace.”

source: Hijeh chun amin Joseph asahtai, chule amanun, Pakaiyin chapa khat eipeh beding ahi, ati.
target: She named him Joseph, and said, “May the Lord add to me another son.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Rachel'in Joseph ahin nungin, Jacob'in Laban henga, keima kho mong le kagam lama kache theina din neisol dohtan.
target: After Rachel gave birth to Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me on my way so I can go back to my own homeland.

source: Nangma kajena kalodoh kajite le kachate neipenlang, neichesah tan. Ajehchu nangma dinga kanatoh ho chu nahenai, ati.
target: Give me my wives and children, for whom I have served you, and I will be on my way. You know how much work I’ve done for you.”

source: Chuin Laban'in ahenga, katao ahi, namitmu-a lungsetna kachana ahile, umtadin; ajehchu nangma jal-in Pakaiyin phatthei eiboh-e ti kahe doh-in ahi, ati.
target: But Laban said to him, “If I have found favor in your eyes, please stay. I have learned by divination that the Lord has blessed me because of you.”

source: Chuin aman, Nalo ding chu neisei peh-in, keiman penange, ati.
target: He added, “Name your wages, and I will pay them.”

source: Chuin aman ahenga, Nangma iti kajena, chule nagancha te kakoma iti umam, ti nangma tah-in nahet ahi.
target: Jacob said to him, “You know how I have worked for you and how your livestock has fared under my care.

source: Ajehchu keima hung masanga chu lhomcha bou nanei ahin, tunvang tamtah-in apung taove; chule kahunga patnin Pakaiyin nangma phatthei naboh-in ahi. Ahin tun, itih leba keima insung tum ding kakingaito ding ham? ati.
target: The little you had before I came has increased greatly, and the Lord has blessed you wherever I have been. But now, when may I do something for my own household?”

source: Chuin aman, Nangma ipi kapeh ding ham? ati. Chuin Jacob in, Nangman imacha neipeh louding ahi. Hichehi neibolpeh dinga ahileh, keiman nagancha hon vah ingting, chingkit nange.
target: “What shall I give you?” he asked. “Don’t give me anything,” Jacob replied. “But if you will do this one thing for me, I will go on tending your flocks and watching over them:

source: Tunin nagancha hon jouse gachonsoh ingting, kengoi lah-a avompol chit chet leh apol phet phut jouse le kelngoinou asan gao jouse, chule kelcha lah-a akang polphet phut le apol chitchet jouse lhengdoh ingting, hichu katohman ding hihen.
target: Let me go through all your flocks today and remove from them every speckled or spotted sheep, every dark-colored lamb and every spotted or speckled goat. They will be my wages.

source: Chuti chun khonungle katohman chu namai koh-a ahung kilah teng leh, kachon phatnan keima dinga donbutna apehding ahi. Kelcha ho lah-a apol chitchet le apol phetphut lou jouse le kelngoi lah-a asan gao loujouse chu kaguh-a nalah jeng ding ahi, ati.
target: And my honesty will testify for me in the future, whenever you check on the wages you have paid me. Any goat in my possession that is not speckled or spotted, or any lamb that is not dark-colored, will be considered stolen.”

source: Chuin Laban'in, vetan nasei bangchun hihen, ati.
target: “Agreed,” said Laban. “Let it be as you have said.”

source: Chuin chuche nichun aman kelchal akihalpol, apoltan le apol phet phut chule kelnu apolchit chet le apolphet phut jouse le achunga akang umjouse, chule kelngoi asan gao jouse chu alhengdoh in, achapate vettupdin apedoh tai.
target: That same day he removed all the male goats that were streaked or spotted, and all the speckled or spotted female goats (all that had white on them) and all the dark-colored lambs, and he placed them in the care of his sons.

source: Chuin aman nithum lam gamlan Jacob chu akikhenpin, chule Jacob chun Laban gancha hon dang jouse chu avah-in ahi.
target: Then he put a three-day journey between himself and Jacob, while Jacob continued to tend the rest of Laban’s flocks.

source: Chuin Jacob'in navolthing, bulthing, chule thalthing a-eng tenggol hing asatnin, ahoh chu akhoh kangin, tenggol ho-a chun akangchu akido sah-in ahi.
target: Jacob, however, took fresh-cut branches from poplar, almond and plane trees and made white stripes on them by peeling the bark and exposing the white inner wood of the branches.

source: Chutichun ganchaho chu twichipma ahung tengule agaipa nadiuvin, aman ahoh akho tenggol hochu gancha honnin achipnajiu twi donna ho-a chun, gancha hon twi chipma ahung tengule amasanguva chun akoijin ahi.
target: Then he placed the peeled branches in all the watering troughs, so that they would be directly in front of the flocks when they came to drink. When the flocks were in heat and came to drink,

source: Chuin gancha hon chu tenggol masanga chun nou anei jiuvin, chule ganchaho chun ajinlha-a pol, apoltan, apol chitchet chule apol phetphut ahing jiuvin ahi.
target: they mated in front of the branches. And they bore young that were streaked or speckled or spotted.

source: Chule Jacob'in Kelngoinou hochu atumin akhendoh-in, chule gancha hon chu Laban ganchahon ajinglha, apoltan ho le asan gao jouse lamchu angatsah jin ahi. Chule aman ama ganchahon chu atumin akoijin, Laban gancha hontoh akoitha pon ahi.
target: Jacob set apart the young of the flock by themselves, but made the rest face the streaked and dark-colored animals that belonged to Laban. Thus he made separate flocks for himself and did not put them with Laban’s animals.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, ganchahon lah-a ahatdom hochu agai tengle tenggol ho lah-a agai theina diuvin, Jacob'in tenggol hochu twilonna-a chun ganchaho mitmun akoijin ahi.
target: Whenever the stronger females were in heat, Jacob would place the branches in the troughs in front of the animals so they would mate near the branches,

source: Ahivangin gancha hatmodom ho ding chun hichu akoi jipoi. Chutichun ahatmo ho chu Laban'a ahijin, ahatho chu Jacob'a ahijitai.
target: but if the animals were weak, he would not place them there. So the weak animals went to Laban and the strong ones to Jacob.

source: Chuin mipa chu nasatah-in ahung haodoh tan, ganchahon tamtah, soh numei tamtah, soh pasal tamtah, chule sangongsao le sangan tamtah aneitan ahi.
target: In this way the man grew exceedingly prosperous and came to own large flocks, and female and male servants, and camels and donkeys.

source: Chuin Laban chapaten, Jacob'in i-pau thil jouse akilahdoh tan; chule ipauva kona hiche loupina nasatah hi akimudoh ahi, tia aseiju chu Jacob'in ajatan ahi.
target: Jacob heard that Laban’s sons were saying, “Jacob has taken everything our father owned and has gained all this wealth from what belonged to our father.”

source: Chuin Jacob'in Laban maiso chu aven ahile, veuvin, masanga toh abang tapon ahi.
target: And Jacob noticed that Laban’s attitude toward him was not what it had been.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Jacob henga, Napu napate gamle nasopite henga kiletan, chule keiman nangma umpi nange, ati.
target: Then the Lord said to Jacob, “Go back to the land of your fathers and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”

source: Hijeh chun Jacob'in gamlah-a agancha hon umna-a chun Rachel le Leah chu agakou sah-in ahi.
target: So Jacob sent word to Rachel and Leah to come out to the fields where his flocks were.

source: Chuin aman aheng lhona, Napau maiso kaven ahile, masanga bangin kachunga ahoi tapon ahi; ahivangin kapa Pathen chun eiumpi jingnai.
target: He said to them, “I see that your father’s attitude toward me is not what it was before, but the God of my father has been with me.

source: Chule katha neina jouse-a napau kajen chu nahe lhon nai.
target: You know that I’ve worked for your father with all my strength,

source: Ahivangin napau vin dohan eihabolin, katohman chu somvei jen eina khelpeh-e; ahivangin aman eisuhset ding chu Pathen'in ana phalpoi.
target: yet your father has cheated me by changing my wages ten times. However, God has not allowed him to harm me.

source: Aman, Apol chit chet ho chu natohman ding ahi atile, ganchahon jouse chun apol chit chet ahing jitauvin; chule aman apoltan ho chu natohman ding ahi atile, ganchaho chun apoltan jeng ahing jitauve.
target: If he said, ‘The speckled ones will be your wages,’ then all the flocks gave birth to speckled young; and if he said, ‘The streaked ones will be your wages,’ then all the flocks bore streaked young.

source: Chutichun Pathen'in napau ganchaho chu alamangin, hiho chu keima eipetai.
target: So God has taken away your father’s livestock and has given them to me.

source: Chuin ahung hitin ahi, Ganchaho gai phat laichun, kamangin ka khodah-in ahile, veuvin, ganchahon matna kelngoi chal hochu apoltan, apoltan chit chet chule ajem chom choma pol ngenin kamun ahi.
target: “In breeding season I once had a dream in which I looked up and saw that the male goats mating with the flock were streaked, speckled or spotted.

source: Chuin Pathen vantil chun kamangin kahenga, Jacob, atin; chuin keiman, Hikoma kaume, kati.
target: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob.’ I answered, ‘Here I am.’

source: Chuin aman, Tun nangma khodah inlang ven, ganchahon matna kelngoi chal jouse khu apoltan, apol chit chet chule ajem chom choma polngen ahiuve. Ajehchu Laban'in nachunga abol jouse kamutai.
target: And he said, ‘Look up and see that all the male goats mating with the flock are streaked, speckled or spotted, for I have seen all that Laban has been doing to you.

source: Keima hi nangman songphu chunga thao nanu-a, chule ahenga kitepna naneina Bethel Pathen chu kahi. Tun kipatdoh-in, hiche gama konhin nangma potnin lang, nasopite gamlama kiletan, eitin ahi.
target: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar and where you made a vow to me. Now leave this land at once and go back to your native land.’ ”

source: Chuphatnin Rachel le Leah'in adonbut lhonin, ahenga, Kapao insunga keini chanding ahiloule kagoulo lhon ding ipi umnalai beh-em?
target: Then Rachel and Leah replied, “Do we still have any share in the inheritance of our father’s estate?

source: Aman keini maljin bangbepma eigelhon hilouham? Ajehchu aman eikijoh honin, chule kasum hon jong anemang sohtai.
target: Does he not regard us as foreigners? Not only has he sold us, but he has used up what was paid for us.

source: Ajehchu Pathen'in kapauva kona alahmang gou jouse chu keini le kachateuva ahi. Achuti le tun, Pathen'in nahenga aseichan chu boltan, ati lhone.
target: Surely all the wealth that God took away from our father belongs to us and our children. So do whatever God has told you.”

source: Chujouvin Jacob akipatnin, achapate le a-inneipi hochu sangongsao chunga atousah-in;
target: Then Jacob put his children and his wives on camels,

source: Canaan gama apa Isaac henga chedingin agancha jouse, alamdoh anei jouse, chule Padan Aram gama alamdoh agancha neiho chu akitolmang soh keitan ahi.
target: and he drove all his livestock ahead of him, along with all the goods he had accumulated in Paddan Aram, to go to his father Isaac in the land of Canaan.

source: Chuin Laban akelngoiho mulvou dingin achedoh-in; chuin Rachel'in apa milim ho chu agutan ahi.
target: When Laban had gone to shear his sheep, Rachel stole her father’s household gods.

source: Chuin Jacob Syria mi Laban hetlouvin akigodoh-in, aman ajam chu anasei peh pon ahi.
target: Moreover, Jacob deceived Laban the Aramean by not telling him he was running away.

source: Chuti chun ama aneijouse toh ajam than; chule akipatnin vadung chu agalkaijin, Gilead molsang lama akiheitan ahi.
target: So he fled with all he had, crossed the Euphrates River, and headed for the hill country of Gilead.

source: Chuin anithum channin Jacob ajamtai, ti chu Laban aseipeh taovin ahi.
target: On the third day Laban was told that Jacob had fled.

source: Chuin aman asopite akipuijin, amachu ni sagi lama anungdelin: chuin amahon ama chu Gilead molsang chun aphapa taovin ahi.
target: Taking his relatives with him, he pursued Jacob for seven days and caught up with him in the hill country of Gilead.

source: Chuin Pathen'in Syria mi Laban henga chun ajan mangin ahungin, ajah-a, Jacob henga ase apha imacha nasei louna din kichih theijin, ati.
target: Then God came to Laban the Aramean in a dream at night and said to him, “Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.”

source: Chuin Laban'in Jacob chu aphapatan ahi. Tun Jacob chun apon in chu chuche molsanga chun asongin; chule Laban le asopite chun Gilead molsanga chun asongun ahi.
target: Jacob had pitched his tent in the hill country of Gilead when Laban overtook him, and Laban and his relatives camped there too.

source: Chuin Laban'in Jacob henga, Ipi bola nahi-a, kahetlouva nakiguh doh-a, kachanute chu chemjam'a gal hinga kiman banga puimanga nahim? ati.
target: Then Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done? You’ve deceived me, and you’ve carried off my daughters like captives in war.

source: Iti dana guhthim cha najam manga, keija kona nakiguh doh-a; kipana la, khongcha, chule tumgintheito tho-a kilhahdoh nadinga neihetsah louham?
target: Why did you run off secretly and deceive me? Why didn’t you tell me, so I could send you away with joy and singing to the music of timbrels and harps?

source: Chule katute le kachanu te kachop ding naphal lou ham? Nangman tun ngol hoitah in thil naboltai.
target: You didn’t even let me kiss my grandchildren and my daughters goodbye. You have done a foolish thing.

source: Nangma suhset thei na dingin tha kaneije; ahivangin napa Pathen chun janhi jan chun kahenga, nangman Jacob henga ase apha nasei lounadin kichih theijin, eitin ahi.
target: I have the power to harm you; but last night the God of your father said to me, ‘Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.’

source: Chule tun nangman napa in nangai behseh jeh-a chu che tahbeh-a nahitan, ipi dinga ka pathenho chu neiguh peh ham? ati.
target: Now you have gone off because you longed to return to your father’s household. But why did you steal my gods?”

source: Chuin Jacob'in Laban chu adonbutnin, ahengah, Kakichat jeh ahi; ajehchu keiman, Nachanute hi acham louvin keija konin neilah peh getnin nate kati ahi.
target: Jacob answered Laban, “I was afraid, because I thought you would take your daughters away from me by force.

source: Na pathen ho namuna penpen chu koi hijongle kihinghoi louding ahi. Kasopiteu mitmu hin nathil kakoma umchu holdoh inlang kilah jengin, ati. Ajehchu Rachel'in chuche ho aguh chu Jacob'in ahetlou ahi.
