target: The next day Moses took his seat to serve as judge for the people, and they stood around him from morning till evening.

source: Chuin Mosi nupapa chun mipi ho chunga athilbol jouse chu amuphatnin, ajah-a, Mipi ho chunga nathilbol hi ipiham? Ipidinga nangma nachang seh-a natouva, mipi ho chu jingkah-a pat nilhah geija nakimvela dinguva ham? ati.
target: When his father-in-law saw all that Moses was doing for the people, he said, “What is this you are doing for the people? Why do you alone sit as judge, while all these people stand around you from morning till evening?”

source: Chuin Mosi'n anupapa henga, Mipi hi Pathen lunglam dong dinga kahenga ahung jeh-u ahi.
target: Moses answered him, “Because the people come to me to seek God’s will.

source: Amahon thu aneitengule kahenga hung jiuva; chule keiman khatle khat kah-a thu katanji-a, chule Pathen chondan thuhou le adanthu ho kahetsah ji ahi, ati.
target: Whenever they have a dispute, it is brought to me, and I decide between the parties and inform them of God’s decrees and instructions.”

source: Chuin Mosi nupapan ahenga, Hiche nathilbol hi aphapoi.
target: Moses’ father-in-law replied, “What you are doing is not good.

source: Nangma nahin nakoma um mipi ho ahiuvin nachol val dingu ahi. Ajehchu hiche thil hi nangma dingin agihsa behseh-in ahi; nangma changin nabol jouhoi ahipoi.
target: You and these people who come to you will only wear yourselves out. The work is too heavy for you; you cannot handle it alone.

source: Tun kaseihi ngaijin, keiman nangma thumopming kating, Pathen'in nangma naumpi ding ahi: thunoh ho chu Pathen henga napohlut theina dingin, nangma Pathen masanga mipi ho-a dingin thalheng hi-in.
target: Listen now to me and I will give you some advice, and may God be with you. You must be the people’s representative before God and bring their disputes to him.

source: Chule nangman amaho chu chondan thuho le danthu ho nahilding, chule amahon ajot teidiu lampi le abol teidiu natoh chu nahil ding ahi.
target: Teach them his decrees and instructions, and show them the way they are to live and how they are to behave.

source: Chuche chungchona chun mipi ho jouse lah-a kona thil bolthei, Pathen ging mi, mi thudih, kiloset thetbol mi lhengdoh-in lang; amaho chu sangkhat chunga vaihom, jakhat chunga vaihom, somnga chunga vaihom, chule som chunga vaihom dingin pansah-in.
target: But select capable men from all the people—men who fear God, trustworthy men who hate dishonest gain—and appoint them as officials over thousands, hundreds, fifties and tens.

source: Chule amaho chun mipi ho chunga phatseh-in vaihomu hen; chule hichehi hiding ahi, thulen ho chu nahenga ahinlhut diu, amavang thu neo neo ho chu amahon atandingu ahi. Chuti henlang hile nangma dinga olna hiding, chule amahon pohgih chu napoh hu dingu ahi.
target: Have them serve as judges for the people at all times, but have them bring every difficult case to you; the simple cases they can decide themselves. That will make your load lighter, because they will share it with you.

source: Nangman hiche thilhi nabola, chule Pathen'in jong chutia chu nathupeh-a ahile nangman nadoujou ding, chule hiche mipi ho jouse jonghi mongtah-a aumna mun uva kile dingu ahi, ati.
target: If you do this and God so commands, you will be able to stand the strain, and all these people will go home satisfied.”

source: Chuti chun Mosi'n anupapa seichu angaijin, asei jouse chu aboltan ahi.
target: Moses listened to his father-in-law and did everything he said.

source: Chuin Mosi'n Israel pumpi lah-a konin thilbolthei mi alheng doh-in, amaho chu mipi luchang hidingin sangkhat chunga vaihom, jakhat chunga vaihom, somnga chunga vaihom, chule somkhat chunga vaihom dingin akoitan ahi.
target: He chose capable men from all Israel and made them leaders of the people, officials over thousands, hundreds, fifties and tens.

source: Hitichun amaho chun phat tinin mipi ho thu atan taovin: thu hahsa ho chu Mosi henga ahinlhut nun, ahin thuneo jouse chu amaho tah-in atanjiuvin ahi.
target: They served as judges for the people at all times. The difficult cases they brought to Moses, but the simple ones they decided themselves.

source: Chuin Mosi'n anupapa chu asoldohtan; hitichun ama aumna gam lama achetai.
target: Then Moses sent his father-in-law on his way, and Jethro returned to his own country.

source: Israelte Egypt gama kona apotdoh uva pat lha thumna, chuche nitah chun amaho Sinai gamthip ahunglhung taove.
target: On the first day of the third month after the Israelites left Egypt—on that very day—they came to the Desert of Sinai.

source: Ajehchu amaho Rephidim'a kona hung kipatdoh uva, Sinai neldi gam hung lhunguva, hiche gamthipma chu ponbuh akison ahi; hitichun Israel ten molsang bula chun gebuh akison taovin ahi.
target: After they set out from Rephidim, they entered the Desert of Sinai, and Israel camped there in the desert in front of the mountain.

source: Chuin Mosi chu Pathen henga achetouvin, chule molsanga konchun Pakaiyin ahin kouvin, Jacob insung henga hitia hi naseija, chule Israel chate henga nasei ding ahi;
target: Then Moses went up to God, and the Lord called to him from the mountain and said, “This is what you are to say to the descendants of Jacob and what you are to tell the people of Israel:

source: Nanghon Egypt mite chunga ipi kana bola, chule iti nangho muvanlai lhaving chunga kapoh-a, keimatah henga kapuilut ham namutaove.
target: ‘You yourselves have seen what I did to Egypt, and how I carried you on eagles’ wings and brought you to myself.

source: Hijeh chun tun, nanghon kathu nangai tahbeh uva, kakitepna hi nanit tahbeh uva ahile, namdang jouse chungvuma nangho hi kagou tumbeh nahi dingu ahi; ajehchu leiset pumpi hi keija ahi.
target: Now if you obey me fully and keep my covenant, then out of all nations you will be my treasured possession. Although the whole earth is mine,

source: Chule nangho keima dingin lenggam thempuho le namtheng nahi dingu ahi. Hiche thuho hi ahi nangman Israel chate henga nasei ding chu, ati.
target: you will be for me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words you are to speak to the Israelites.”

source: Chuin Mosi ahungin, mipi lah-a upaho chu akou khomin, Pakaiyin athupeh hiche thuho jouse chu a-angsung uva atahlangtan ahi.
target: So Moses went back and summoned the elders of the people and set before them all the words the Lord had commanded him to speak.

source: Chuin mipi jouse chun thakhat tah-in adonbutnun, ahenga, Pakaiyin asei jouse chu kabol dingu ahi, atiuve. Chuin Mosi'n mipi thusei ho chu Pakai henga alhuttan ahi.
target: The people all responded together, “We will do everything the Lord has said.” So Moses brought their answer back to the Lord .

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Ven, nangma toh ikihou teng mipin ajahtheina dingu leh tonsotna nangma natahsan theina diuva, nahenga meilhang satah-a kahung ding ahi, ati. Chuin Mosi'n mipi ho thusei ho chu Pakai ahetsah tan ahi.
target: The Lord said to Moses, “I am going to come to you in a dense cloud, so that the people will hear me speaking with you and will always put their trust in you.” Then Moses told the Lord what the people had said.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Mipi henga chenlang amaho chu tuni le jingle suthengin, chule amahon avonhou kisop thengu henlang,
target: And the Lord said to Moses, “Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow. Have them wash their clothes

source: Anithum ni-a dingin kigosa demin umuhen: ajehchu anithum nileh mijouse mitmu-a Sinai molsang chunga chu Pakai hungkumlha ding ahi, ati.
target: and be ready by the third day, because on that day the Lord will come down on Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people.

source: Chule nangman mipi dinga akimveluva gamgi nasempeh ding, chule ajah uva, Nangho molsang chunga nakaltou louna dingu le agamgi natohkhah louna dingun chingtheijun; koihileh molsang tongkha chan chu kithat tei ding ahi.
target: Put limits for the people around the mountain and tell them, ‘Be careful that you do not approach the mountain or touch the foot of it. Whoever touches the mountain is to be put to death.

source: Khut khatchan jong atohkhah louding, amavang ama chu songa selih ding ham, ahiloule thalpi-a kaplih ding ham hitei ding ahi; gancha hihen mihem hijongleh hichu hinglou ding ahi. Sumkon chu sottah agin tengleh amaho molsang lama hungtou dingu ahi, ati.
target: They are to be stoned or shot with arrows; not a hand is to be laid on them. No person or animal shall be permitted to live.’ Only when the ram’s horn sounds a long blast may they approach the mountain.”

source: Chuin Mosi molsanga konchun mipi ho henga akumsuh-in, mipi ho chu asuthengin; chule amahon avonhou asopmun ahi.
target: After Moses had gone down the mountain to the people, he consecrated them, and they washed their clothes.

source: Chule aman mipi ho henga chun, Anithum channia dingin kigosa demin umun: na-inneipiteu koma jong luthih-un, ati.
target: Then he said to the people, “Prepare yourselves for the third day. Abstain from sexual relations.”

source: Chuin anithum ni jingkah-in ahitin ahi, van ahung gingin kol aphen, molchunga chun meilhang satah aumin, chule sumkon thongje jun ahung gingin; chutichun gebuh-a mipi umho chu akihot lhul gam taovin ahi.
target: On the morning of the third day there was thunder and lightning, with a thick cloud over the mountain, and a very loud trumpet blast. Everyone in the camp trembled.

source: Chuin Mosi'n mipi ho chu Pathen toh kimuto dingin gebuh-a kon ahinpui doh-in; chule amaho molsang bula chun adingun ahi.
target: Then Moses led the people out of the camp to meet with God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.

source: Chuin Pakai chu meikonga ahung kumlhah jehchun, Sinai molsang pumpi chu mei akhu jengin: chule akhu chu lhum meikhu bangin akitung doh-in, molsang pumpi chu nasatah-in akihotnin ahi.
target: Mount Sinai was covered with smoke, because the Lord descended on it in fire. The smoke billowed up from it like smoke from a furnace, and the whole mountain trembled violently.

source: Chuin sumkon chu sottah agina, ahagin cheh cheh phatnin, Mosi'n thu aseijin ahile Pathen'in aw gingin ahindonbut nin ahi.
target: As the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke and the voice of God answered him.

source: Chuin Pakai chu Sinai molchunga, amolsang chungvuma chun ahungkum suhtan ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi chu molchung vuma chun akoutouvin; chule Mosi akaltoutan ahi.
target: The Lord descended to the top of Mount Sinai and called Moses to the top of the mountain. So Moses went up

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Kumsuh inlang mipi chu gagih-in, ajole mipi khu avedingin Pakai henglam hinphukeh untin, mi tamtah manthah lo getnunte.
target: and the Lord said to him, “Go down and warn the people so they do not force their way through to see the Lord and many of them perish.

source: Chule Pakai kom hinaija thempuho jong chu kisuthengu hen, ajole Pakai chu achunguva hetman louvin chuget ninte, ati.
target: Even the priests, who approach the Lord , must consecrate themselves, or the Lord will break out against them.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Pakai henga, Mipi chu Sinai molsanga hungkaltou thei pouvinte; ajehchu nangman, Molsang kimvela chun gamgi semun lang, hichu suthengun, tia neithu peh-u ahi, ati.
target: Moses said to the Lord , “The people cannot come up Mount Sinai, because you yourself warned us, ‘Put limits around the mountain and set it apart as holy.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin ajah-a, Chen, kumsuh tan, chule Aaron toh nahung kaltou lhonding ahi: ahivangin thempuho le mipi chu Pakai henga hung dingin hinphukeh hih-uhen, ajole ama achunguva chuget ninte, ati.
target: The Lord replied, “Go down and bring Aaron up with you. But the priests and the people must not force their way through to come up to the Lord , or he will break out against them.”

source: Chuti chun Mosi chu mipi ho henga achesuh-in, ahenguva thu jouse chu aseitan ahi.
target: So Moses went down to the people and told them.

source: Chuin Pathen'in hiche thuho jouse aseijin, hitin ati.
target: And God spoke all these words:

source: Keima Egypt gama kon le nasohchana in'a kona napui dohpa Pakai na-Pathen chu kahi.
target: “I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

source: Keima angsunga nangman Pathen dangho nanei louding ahi.
target: “You shall have no other gods before me.

source: Nangman imacha alim semthu, van chunga um hihen, lei noija um hihen, leinoi'a twisunga um hijongleh akibahpi imalim nasemthu louding ahi:
target: “You shall not make for yourself an image in the form of anything in heaven above or on the earth beneath or in the waters below.

source: Nangma hicheho masanga chu nakun louding, jen jong najen louding ahi: ajehchu Pakai na-Pathen keima hi thangthip Pathen kahin, keima eithet bola pate khansetna chu khangthum akhangli chan geija chate chunga phulajia;
target: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God, punishing the children for the sin of the parents to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me,

source: Chule eingailua chule kadan thupeh nit ho sang tamtah chunga hepina musah-a chu kahi.
target: but showing love to a thousand generations of those who love me and keep my commandments.

source: Nangman Pakai na-Pathen min chu mohseh-a napat louding ahi; ajehchu mohseh-a amin pana chu Pakaiyin themona beija alha louding ahi.
target: “You shall not misuse the name of the Lord your God, for the Lord will not hold anyone guiltless who misuses his name.

source: Cholngah nikho thengtah-a nitding ahi geldoh jingin.
target: “Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.

source: Nigup sung na natoh-a, natoh ding jouse natoh chaiding ahi:
target: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

source: Amavang nisagi nichu Pakai na-Pathen cholngah ni ahi: hiche nikho chule na kiti natoh louding, nangma nahin, nachapa ahin, nachanu ahin, nasohpa ahin, nasohnu ahin, nagancha hon ahin, chule nakotpi sunga um namaljin ho ahiuva jong atoh louhel dingu ahi.
target: but the seventh day is a sabbath to the Lord your God. On it you shall not do any work, neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your male or female servant, nor your animals, nor any foreigner residing in your towns.

source: Ajehchu nigup sunga Pakaiyin van le leiset, twikhanglen, chuleh asunga um jouse chu asema, nisagi ni kicholdo ahi. Hijeh-a chu Pakaiyin choldo nichu phatthei aboh-a asuhtheng ahi.
target: For in six days the Lord made the heavens and the earth, the sea, and all that is in them, but he rested on the seventh day. Therefore the Lord blessed the Sabbath day and made it holy.

source: Pakai na-Pathen'in nangma napehna leichunga nahinkho asot theina dingin: nanu napa jabolin.
target: “Honor your father and your mother, so that you may live long in the land the Lord your God is giving you.

source: Tol natha louding ahi.
target: “You shall not murder.

source: Na jon louding ahi.
target: “You shall not commit adultery.

source: Na guchat louding ahi.
target: “You shall not steal.

source: Naheng nakom douna-a jouthu-a hettohsah-a napan louding ahi.
target: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

source: Nangman naheng nakom in nathangset louding, naheng nakom inneipi jong nathangset louding, asohpa ahin, asohnu ahin, abongchal ahin, asangan hijongle, naheng nakom thil kiti tapou chu nathangset louding ahi.
target: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, or his male or female servant, his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.”

source: Chuin mipi jouse chun van ginho, kolphet ho, sumkon gin, chule molsang meikhut chu amuvin ahi. Chuin mipi chun hichu amuphatnun, akichonun, gamlatah-a ading taove.
target: When the people saw the thunder and lightning and heard the trumpet and saw the mountain in smoke, they trembled with fear. They stayed at a distance

source: Chuin amahon Mosi henga, Nangman kahenguva thu seijin, keihon ngainao vinge: Ahin Pathen'in vang kahenguva thu seidahen, ajole kathilo dingu ahi, atiuve.
target: and said to Moses, “Speak to us yourself and we will listen. But do not have God speak to us or we will die.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n mipi ho henga, Kicha hih-un: ajehchu ama kichatna chu namasang uva auma, nachonset louna dinguva, nangho patep dinga Pathen chu hunga ahibouve, ati.
target: Moses said to the people, “Do not be afraid. God has come to test you, so that the fear of God will be with you to keep you from sinning.”

source: Chuin mipi chu gamlatah-a adingun; Mosi'n Pathen umna muthim satah lamchu anailutnin ahi.
target: The people remained at a distance, while Moses approached the thick darkness where God was.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Hitia hi Israel chate henga naseiding ahi, Nanghon van'a kona nangho kahoupiu chu namu taove.
target: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Tell the Israelites this: ‘You have seen for yourselves that I have spoken to you from heaven:

source: Nanghon kakoma dangka pathenho nasem loudingu, chule nangho dinga jong sana pathenho nasem lou dingu ahi.
target: Do not make any gods to be alongside me; do not make for yourselves gods of silver or gods of gold.

source: Keima dinga leisetna maicham khat nasem uva, chule hiche chunga chu nagovam thiltohou, nachamna thiltohou, chule nakelngoi hou le nabongchal hou nato dingu ahi. Kamin kigeldohna dinga kalhen namun jouse-a chu naheng uva kahunga, phatthei kaboh ding nahiuve.
target: “ ‘Make an altar of earth for me and sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, your sheep and goats and your cattle. Wherever I cause my name to be honored, I will come to you and bless you.

source: Chule nangman keima song maicham neisem peh-a ahile, song kikhenga nasem louding ahi: ajehchu nangman hiche chunga chu namanchah chu nalapma ahile, hichu nasuhboh ahitai.
target: If you make an altar of stones for me, do not build it with dressed stones, for you will defile it if you use a tool on it.

source: Na sagohkeo chu akimulouna dinga, ka-maicham'a kalbia chu nakal lou ding ahi.
target: And do not go up to my altar on steps, or your private parts may be exposed.’

source: Tun nangman amaho masanga nakoi ding thutanna ho chu hiche hohi ahi.
target: “These are the laws you are to set before them:

source: Nangman Hebrew mi soh-a nachoh-a ahileh, kumgup sung aman najending: akum sagi channa leh imacha ngailouva chamlhat dinga chedoh jeng ding ahi.
target: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he is to serve you for six years. But in the seventh year, he shall go free, without paying anything.

source: Ama achanga hung lut ahile, achanga potdoh ding: ama jinei ahileh, a-inneipi toh pottha ding ahi.
target: If he comes alone, he is to go free alone; but if he has a wife when he comes, she is to go with him.

source: A-pakai pan ama chu ji apuipeh ahia, amanun chanu chapa ahinpeh-a ahileh; a-inneipi leh achate chu a-pakai pa-a hiding, chule amachu achanga potdoh ding ahi.
target: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the woman and her children shall belong to her master, and only the man shall go free.

source: Amavang sohpa chun kichentah-a, Keiman ka pakaipa, ka-inneipi, chule kachate chu kangailui; chamlhatdin potdoh ponge atia ahile:
target: “But if the servant declares, ‘I love my master and my wife and children and do not want to go free,’

source: Chuteng a-pakaipa chun amachu thutan ho henga ahin puiding; chujongle amachu kotkhah ham, kotbeng hama apui ding; a-pakaipa chun thil kijumhem khatna abil avupeh ding; chule amachu tonsotna ajending ahitai.
target: then his master must take him before the judges. He shall take him to the door or the doorpost and pierce his ear with an awl. Then he will be his servant for life.

source: Chule pasal khatnin achanu chu sohnu dinga ajoh-a ahile, soh pasal ho bangin amanu chu potdoh louding ahi.
target: “If a man sells his daughter as a servant, she is not to go free as male servants do.

source: Amanu chun a-pakaipa, ama kichenpi dinga jihol pa chu alunglhaisah joulouva ahile, akilhatdoh sah kitding ahi. Amapan amanu chu doha-a aboljeh-a, gamdangmi koma johna ding tha anei louding ahi.
target: If she does not please the master who has selected her for himself, he must let her be redeemed. He has no right to sell her to foreigners, because he has broken faith with her.

source: Chule amapan achapa dinga anahol ahileh, amapa chun chanuho bangtah-a abolding ahi.
target: If he selects her for his son, he must grant her the rights of a daughter.

source: Chule amapan jichom dang akipuija ahileh; amanu neh le chah, ponsil, chule nupa hina-a athaneina chu asuhlhompeh louding ahi.
target: If he marries another woman, he must not deprive the first one of her food, clothing and marital rights.

source: Chule aman hicheng thilthumhi amanu chunga abol louva ahileh; amanu dangka ngailouva potdoh jeng ding ahi.
target: If he does not provide her with these three things, she is to go free, without any payment of money.

source: Min mikhat avoh-a, amachu athitah-a ahile, amajong thonlouva thatei ding ahi.
target: “Anyone who strikes a person with a fatal blow is to be put to death.

source: Ahin mikhatnin achanlhih hilouva, Pathen'in amachu akhutna apehdohjoh ahileh; keiman ajamlut nading munkhat kagonpeh ding ahi.
target: However, if it is not done intentionally, but God lets it happen, they are to flee to a place I will designate.

source: Ahinla mikhat chu ahenasa-a a-inheng chunga achuh-a, doha bola tha agotna ahile; amachu athi teina dinga, ka-maicham'a kona nakaidoh dingu ahi.
target: But if anyone schemes and kills someone deliberately, that person is to be taken from my altar and put to death.

source: Koihileh anuham, apaham vo-a chu tha teiding ahi.
target: “Anyone who attacks their father or mother is to be put to death.

source: Koihile mihem khat gua, kijoh, ahilouleh akhutna aum petna kimudoh aumle; amachu thonlouva thatei ding ahi.
target: “Anyone who kidnaps someone is to be put to death, whether the victim has been sold or is still in the kidnapper’s possession.

source: Koihile anuham, apaham gaosapma chu thonlouva thatei ding ahi.
target: “Anyone who curses their father or mother is to be put to death.

source: Chule mi akinah-a, khat chun khatjoh chu songtum ahiloule akhut tuma asuh-a, amachu athilouva, ajalkhuna alupma:
target: “If people quarrel and one person hits another with a stone or with their fist and the victim does not die but is confined to bed,

source: Ama chu ahung thodoh kitna, atenggol akiphu-a avahle theileh, mivopa chun aphat suhmang man apeh ding, ajendam selding ahi.
target: the one who struck the blow will not be held liable if the other can get up and walk around outside with a staff; however, the guilty party must pay the injured person for any loss of time and see that the victim is completely healed.

source: Khattouvin asohpa ahilouleh asohnu mola avoh-a, akhut luma alouva ahile; amachun thonlouva talen amat ding ahi.
target: “Anyone who beats their male or female slave with a rod must be punished if the slave dies as a direct result,

source: Amavang nikhat ham, nini ham ahinna ahile, amachun talen amatlou ding ahi; ajehchu amachu adangka man ahi.
target: but they are not to be punished if the slave recovers after a day or two, since the slave is their property.

source: Chule pasal le pasal akinah-a, numei naovop asuhkhah lhona, agai ajula, ahia la amanu chu ima atilouva ahile; numeinu inneipun achunga chu adeljat dungjuija talen amatding; chule thutan hon aphatsah dungjuija aditding ahi.
target: “If people are fighting and hit a pregnant woman and she gives birth prematurely but there is no serious injury, the offender must be fined whatever the woman’s husband demands and the court allows.

source: Amavang setna-in ajuikhah tah-a ahileh, nangman hikho khela hikho napehding ahi.
target: But if there is serious injury, you are to take life for life,

source: Mit khela mit, ha khela ha, khut khela khut keng khela keng,
target: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

source: Meija kihal meija, maha khela maha, kijep khela kijep napeh ding ahi.
target: burn for burn, wound for wound, bruise for bruise.

source: Mikhatnin asohpa mit ahim, asohnu mit ahim abehpeh-a, hichu achot tah-a ahile; amitjeh-a chu ama chamlhat dinga alhadoh ding ahi.
target: “An owner who hits a male or female slave in the eye and destroys it must let the slave go free to compensate for the eye.

source: Chule asohpa ha ahim, asohnu ha ahim avohlhoh-a ahile; aha jeh-a ama chu chamlhat dinga alhadoh ding ahi.
target: And an owner who knocks out the tooth of a male or female slave must let the slave go free to compensate for the tooth.

source: Bongchal khatnin pasal ham, numei khat apih-a, amachu athia ahile; bongchal chu thonlouva songa selih teiding ahin, chule asa chu nehlou ding; ahinla bongchal neipa vang chu lha-ong ding ahi.
target: “If a bull gores a man or woman to death, the bull is to be stoned to death, and its meat must not be eaten. But the owner of the bull will not be held responsible.

source: Ahin chuche bongchal chu masanga jong mipih ngai ahia, aneipa chu kihetsah sa ahitah-a, aman in'a achintup loujeh-a pasal ham numei ham khat atha-a ahileh; bongchal chu songa selih ding, chule aneipa jong tha ding ahi.
target: If, however, the bull has had the habit of goring and the owner has been warned but has not kept it penned up and it kills a man or woman, the bull is to be stoned and its owner also is to be put to death.

source: Sum joh-a leosah ding chu achunga achuh tah-a ahile; ahinna akichoh dohna dinga chu akitep jat chu apeh ding ahi.
target: However, if payment is demanded, the owner may redeem his life by the payment of whatever is demanded.

source: Apih chu chapa hihen chanu hijongleh, hiche thutanna banga hi achunga kibol ding ahi.
target: This law also applies if the bull gores a son or daughter.

source: Bongchal chun soh pasal ham, soh numei hamkhat apih-a ahileh; bong neipa chun apihpa pakaipa chu dangka shekel somthum apehding, chule bongchal chu selih ding ahi.
target: If the bull gores a male or female slave, the owner must pay thirty shekels of silver to the master of the slave, and the bull is to be stoned to death.

source: Mi khattouvin kotong ahon ham, ahiloule kotong alaija, kotong sinlouva akoija, bongchal ham, Sangan ham khat alhahlut na ahile;
target: “If anyone uncovers a pit or digs one and fails to cover it and an ox or a donkey falls into it,

source: Kotong neipa chun aman chu aditding, gancha neipa chu sum apeh-a, gancha thi chu ama changding ahi.
target: the one who opened the pit must pay the owner for the loss and take the dead animal in exchange.

source: Chule mikhat bongchal'in midang khat bongchal asuh khah-a, athia ahile; bongchal ahing nalai chu ajoh lhonding, aman kihom lhonding ahi; chule bongchal thisa jong chu asa kihom lhonding ahi.
target: “If anyone’s bull injures someone else’s bull and it dies, the two parties are to sell the live one and divide both the money and the dead animal equally.

source: Ahilouva chuche bongchal chun masangin jong gancha apihji ti kihesa ahia, aneipan achintup lou ahile; aman thonlouva bongchal khela bongchal apehding; chule athipa vangchu ama chang ding ahi.
target: However, if it was known that the bull had the habit of goring, yet the owner did not keep it penned up, the owner must pay, animal for animal, and take the dead animal in exchange.

source: Khattouvin bongchal ham, kelngoi ham khat aguh-a, hichu atha ham, ahiloule akijohdoh ham ahile; aman bongchal khat chu bongchal nga-a asahding, chule kelngoi khat chu kelngoi li-a asah ding ahi.
target: “Whoever steals an ox or a sheep and slaughters it or sells it must pay back five head of cattle for the ox and four sheep for the sheep.

source: Gucha khatnin in aphet vangpet akimudoh-a, akivohna-a athitah-a ahile, amajeh-a thisan kiso louding ahi.
target: “If a thief is caught breaking in at night and is struck a fatal blow, the defender is not guilty of bloodshed;

source: Chule nisan asokhum tah-a ahile, ama-a dinga thisan kiso ding; aman alhingsetna aditding ahi; itihama imacha aneilouva ahileh, athilguh mana chu ama kijoh ding ahi.
target: but if it happens after sunrise, the defender is guilty of bloodshed. “Anyone who steals must certainly make restitution, but if they have nothing, they must be sold to pay for their theft.

source: Chule athilguh chu bongchal hihen, sangan hihen, ahiloule kelngoi hihjongle, hichu ahinga akhutna akimudoh-a ahivangle; ajat ni-a aledit ding ahi.
target: If the stolen animal is found alive in their possession—whether ox or donkey or sheep—they must pay back double.

source: Mi khattouvin louham, lengpilei ham khat anehsah-a, agancha chu alhatlutna, midang lou chu aneh sah-a ahile; alou aphapen tah leh alengpilei phapena chu aditding ahi.
target: “If anyone grazes their livestock in a field or vineyard and lets them stray and they graze in someone else’s field, the offender must make restitution from the best of their own field or vineyard.

source: Mei ahung kah-a, linglah akahmatna, changphal setlomsa ham, chang atlhuh loulai ham, ahiloule louham akah mangsoh jeng tah-a ahile; meihal pa chun thonlouva adit teiding ahi.
target: “If a fire breaks out and spreads into thornbushes so that it burns shocks of grain or standing grain or the whole field, the one who started the fire must make restitution.

source: Mikhatnin a-inhengpa koma dangka ham, nehding ham chin dinga apeh-a, chuche mipa in'a kona chu akiguhmang tah-a; gucha chu akimat doh-a ahile ajatnia asah ding ahi.
target: “If anyone gives a neighbor silver or goods for safekeeping and they are stolen from the neighbor’s house, the thief, if caught, must pay back double.

source: Chule gucha chu akimatdoh louva ahile, a-inneipa chu a-inhengpa thilho chunga chu akhut anat anatlou hetna dinga thutan ho henga puiding ahi.
target: But if the thief is not found, the owner of the house must appear before the judges, and they must determine whether the owner of the house has laid hands on the other person’s property.

source: Suhkhelna jouse, bongchal thu hihen, sangan hihen, kelngoi hihen, ponsil hihen, itobang thil mang hijongle, hichu midang khatnin keija ahi tia aseija ahile, alang teni chu thutan ho anga hunglhon ding; chule thutan hon themo achan penpen chun a-inhengpa chu jatni-a asahding ahi.
target: In all cases of illegal possession of an ox, a donkey, a sheep, a garment, or any other lost property about which somebody says, ‘This is mine,’ both parties are to bring their cases before the judges. The one whom the judges declare guilty must pay back double to the other.

source: Mikhatnin a-inhengpa koma asangan ahim, bongchal ahim, kelngoi ahim, gancha poupou achin dinga apehdoh-a; hichu koima mulouva athi ham, akitongkha-a ham, akinomanga ham ahile;
target: “If anyone gives a donkey, an ox, a sheep or any other animal to their neighbor for safekeeping and it dies or is injured or is taken away while no one is looking,

source: A-inheng thilkeo chunga kakhut anatpoi ti hetna-a, Pakaiya kihahselna chu akahlah lhona umding; hichu agan neipa jong noma, aman jong hichu aditlou ding ahi.
target: the issue between them will be settled by the taking of an oath before the Lord that the neighbor did not lay hands on the other person’s property. The owner is to accept this, and no restitution is required.

source: Ahin hichu akoipa koma kona kigumanga ahivangle, aman aneipa chu aditding ahi.
target: But if the animal was stolen from the neighbor, restitution must be made to the owner.

source: Hichu akimal tel soh ahi tah-a ahile, aman hichu hettohsahna dingin hinchoi hen, aman akimaltelsa chu aditlou ding ahi.
target: If it was torn to pieces by a wild animal, the neighbor shall bring in the remains as evidence and shall not be required to pay for the torn animal.

source: Mikhatnin a-inhengpa gancha khat chu man dinga alah-a, hichu athi ham, akisukha ham ahile; aman adit teiding ahi.
target: “If anyone borrows an animal from their neighbor and it is injured or dies while the owner is not present, they must make restitution.

source: Ahin aneipa chu akoma um ahivangle, aman adit louding ahi: hichu apa kila ahile, aman peh dinga kithalah ahi-a ahile, akithalah man chutoh kitoh ding ahi.
target: But if the owner is with the animal, the borrower will not have to pay. If the animal was hired, the money paid for the hire covers the loss.

source: Mikhatnin nungah mi jihol hiloulai khat alheplhah-a, aluppi-a ahile; amapan amanu chu ajiman ding apeh-a akichenpi teiding ahi.
target: “If a man seduces a virgin who is not pledged to be married and sleeps with her, he must pay the bride-price, and she shall be his wife.

source: Amavang nungahnu pa chun ama chutoh akichensah nomlouva ahile, aman nungah theng man dungjuija hichu apeh ding ahi.
target: If her father absolutely refuses to give her to him, he must still pay the bride-price for virgins.

source: Nangman mitphel doi choi chu nahinghoi louding ahi.
target: “Do not allow a sorceress to live.

source: Koi hileh ganchatoh lumkhoma chu thatei ding ahi.
target: “Anyone who has sexual relations with an animal is to be put to death.

source: Koihile Pakai khatseh heng tilouva, pathen dang pou pou henga ganlhaina bol tapou chu suhmang hel ding ahi.
target: “Whoever sacrifices to any god other than the Lord must be destroyed.

source: Nangman kholjin mi na-engbol louding, boljong nabol genthei lou helding ahi: ajehchu nangho jong Egypt gama kholjin nanahiu ahi.
target: “Do not mistreat or oppress a foreigner, for you were foreigners in Egypt.

source: Nanghon meithai tapou le paneilou chapang chu nasuh genthei loudiu ahi.
target: “Do not take advantage of the widow or the fatherless.

source: Nanghon iti ham khatna amaho chu nasuh genthei juva, kahenga ahung ka poupou uva ahileh, keiman akanao chu kangaipeh tei teiding;
target: If you do and they cry out to me, I will certainly hear their cry.

source: Chule kalung hanna hung soudoh-a, chemjam'a kathagam dingu; chuteng na-inneipi teo chu meithai soh uva, nachateo chu pabei sohgam ding ahiuve.
target: My anger will be aroused, and I will kill you with the sword; your wives will become widows and your children fatherless.

source: Nakoma um kamite mivaicha khattou chu sumpa napeh-a ahile, ama-a dinga chu sumthoi lami nabahlou ding, chuleh achunga athoi jong nakoi louding ahi.
target: “If you lend money to one of my people among you who is needy, do not treat it like a business deal; charge no interest.

source: Nangman na-inheng ponsil chu abat mana nalah tah-a ahile, nangman nisalhum masanga nalepeh teiding ahi.
target: If you take your neighbor’s cloak as a pledge, return it by sunset,

source: Ajehchu hiche bou chu akitomna aneisun ahin, avun dinga ponsil ahi. Ama hoilaija lumding hitam? chule hung hiti ding ahi, kahenga ahung ka teng, keiman kajahpeh ding ahi; ajehchu keima lungset themtah kahi.
target: because that cloak is the only covering your neighbor has. What else can they sleep in? When they cry out to me, I will hear, for I am compassionate.

source: Nangman Pathen nahouset louding, namite lah-a vaihomho jong nagaosap louding ahi.
target: “Do not blaspheme God or curse the ruler of your people.

source: Nangma natheiga min masa holeh nalengpi twiho tohdinga nageisang louding ahi. Nachapa te lah-a apeng masapen chu keima neipeh ding ahi.
target: “Do not hold back offerings from your granaries or your vats. “You must give me the firstborn of your sons.

source: Chutobang ma-a chu bongchal ho le nakelngoi ho nabolding: ni sagi apitoh uma; niget nileh keima neipeh ding ahi.
target: Do the same with your cattle and your sheep. Let them stay with their mothers for seven days, but give them to me on the eighth day.

source: Chule nangho keima dinga mitheng nahidiu ahi: nanghon gamsa hon gama amaltel sao sapou pou naneh louhel dingu; uicha ho naselhah peh dingu ahi.
target: “You are to be my holy people. So do not eat the meat of an animal torn by wild beasts; throw it to the dogs.

source: Nangman jouthu nalhut louding ahi: chonphalou hettohsah hidinga migilouho toh naki khutjop louding ahi.
target: “Do not spread false reports. Do not help a guilty person by being a malicious witness.

source: Thilse bolna dinga mipi chu najui louding; chuleh mipi chun thudih tah chu adihlou sosahna ding agot naova jongchu thu nasei louding ahi.
target: “Do not follow the crowd in doing wrong. When you give testimony in a lawsuit, do not pervert justice by siding with the crowd,

source: Ahiloule mivaicha jong achungthu kitan na-a langneina namusah ding ahipoi.
target: and do not show favoritism to a poor person in a lawsuit.

source: Nangman namelma bongchal ham, sangan ham ava mang namu-a ahileh, thonlouhela ama koma nahin puikit ding ahi.
target: “If you come across your enemy’s ox or donkey wandering off, be sure to return it.

source: Nangma vetda mikhat sangan chu apohgih noija opden namu-a, kithopi ding nada-a ahijongle, thonlouva nakithopi ding ahi.
target: If you see the donkey of someone who hates you fallen down under its load, do not leave it there; be sure you help them with it.

source: Nangman nami vaicha kiheh na-a adihna chu nahei mangpeh louding ahi.
target: “Do not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.

source: Jouthu-a konin nangma gamlatah in kikangsen; chule themona neilou le mi kitah chu that hih-in: ajehchu keiman migilou chu them kachansah louding ahi.
target: Have nothing to do with a false charge and do not put an innocent or honest person to death, for I will not acquit the guilty.

source: Chule nangman nehguh nabol louding ahi: ajehchu nehguh chun michingho mit achot sah-in, michonpha ho thuseidoh chu aheimangjin ahi.
target: “Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the innocent.

source: Chujongle nangman kholjin mi nasuh genthei louding ahi: ajehchu nangma Egypt gama kholjin nahi jeh-in, kholjin mi lungthim nahen ahi.
target: “Do not oppress a foreigner; you yourselves know how it feels to be foreigners, because you were foreigners in Egypt.

source: Kumgup sunga nangman nagamsunga muchi natu ding, chule muchi gaho chu nalo khomding ahi.
target: “For six years you are to sow your fields and harvest the crops,

source: Ahin kum sagi chana leh, namite lah-a mivaicha hon aneh theina diule, amahon adalhah hou chu gamsa hon aneh theina diuva, nangman gam chu nakicholdo sah-a nakoithim ding ahi. Chutobang ma-a chu nalengpilei le Olive lei jong nabolding ahi.
target: but during the seventh year let the land lie unplowed and unused. Then the poor among your people may get food from it, and the wild animals may eat what is left. Do the same with your vineyard and your olive grove.

source: Nigup sunga nana nakitoh ding, ni sagi channi leh nabongchal leh na sangan acholdo theina dingleh, nasohnu chapa le kholjin jong akitha-ol theina diuva, nacholdo ding ahi.
target: “Six days do your work, but on the seventh day do not work, so that your ox and your donkey may rest, and so that the slave born in your household and the foreigner living among you may be refreshed.

source: Nahenga kaseisa thil jouse-a hin nangma chingthei tah-in umin; chule pathen dangho min him him chu phapoh hih-in, nakama konin jong kijadoh hihhen.
target: “Be careful to do everything I have said to you. Do not invoke the names of other gods; do not let them be heard on your lips.

source: Nangman kum khat sunga keima dinga kut thumvei nanit ding ahi.
target: “Three times a year you are to celebrate a festival to me.

source: Nangman cholsolou changlhah kut nanit ding ahi: (Keiman nangman kathupeh banga phat kitepna Abib lha sunga chu cholsolou changlhah nisagi naneh ding ahi; ajehchu chuche lha sung chu Egypt gama kona nahungdoh ahi. Chule koimacha kamasanga khutgoh keova hungkilah louding ahi).
target: “Celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread; for seven days eat bread made without yeast, as I commanded you. Do this at the appointed time in the month of Aviv, for in that month you came out of Egypt. “No one is to appear before me empty-handed.

source: Chule louva natuho natoh gimna ga masapen lholhun kut nanit ding: chule kumlhun na louva kona natoh gimna ga jouse khopkhomna lhosoh khoptup kut nanit ding ahi.
target: “Celebrate the Festival of Harvest with the firstfruits of the crops you sow in your field. “Celebrate the Festival of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather in your crops from the field.

source: Kumkhat sunga napasal hou jouse Pakai Pathen angsunga thumvei kilahsoh keidiu ahi.
target: “Three times a year all the men are to appear before the Sovereign Lord .

source: Kahenga kilhaina nabolnao thisan chu chol kiso changlhah toh natotha louding; chule ganna eikilhaina sathao chu jingkah geija umden louding ahi.
target: “Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to me along with anything containing yeast. “The fat of my festival offerings must not be kept until morning.

source: Nagamga masaho lah-a aga masapen chu Pakai na-Pathen in'a nahinchoi ding ahi. Nangman kelnou chu api noitwija nahon louding ahi.
target: “Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the Lord your God. “Do not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.

source: Ven, lampia naching dingle keiman kagotpehna munna napuilut dingin namasanga vantil khat kasole.
target: “See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.

source: Ama chunga chingthei jinlang athu ngaijin, chule lunghansah hih-in; ajehchu aman nasuhkhel naho angaidam louding ahi. Ajehchu ama-a chu kamin uma ahi.
target: Pay attention to him and listen to what he says. Do not rebel against him; he will not forgive your rebellion, since my Name is in him.

source: Ahin nangman ama thu nangai tahbeh-a, kasei jousehi nabola ahile; namelmaho dinga melma kahiding, nadouho dinga akidoupiu kahiding ahi.
target: If you listen carefully to what he says and do all that I say, I will be an enemy to your enemies and will oppose those who oppose you.

source: Ajehchu ka vantil na masanga che-a, Ammon miho, Amor miho, Hit miho, Perizz miho, Canaan miho, Hiv miho chule Jebus miho henga chun napuilut ding: chule keiman amaho chu kasatgam ding ahi.
target: My angel will go ahead of you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.

source: A-pathen hou henga nakun louding, jen jong najen louding, chule athilbol banguva jong nabol louding ahi. Amavang hicheho chu nasuhmang hel ding, chule amilim hou chu nasuhchip sohkei ding ahi.
target: Do not bow down before their gods or worship them or follow their practices. You must demolish them and break their sacred stones to pieces.

source: Chule nanghon Pakai na Pathen'u chu najendiu; aman nachanglhah le natwi phatthei abohding; chule nalah-a kona natna kalahmang ding ahi.
target: Worship the Lord your God, and his blessing will be on your food and water. I will take away sickness from among you,

source: Nagam sunga koimacha ajula leh achinga umloulou ding; keiman nahin nikho hou chu kasuh bulhing peh ding ahi.
target: and none will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will give you a full life span.

source: Kichat ka umna chu namasanga kasol ding, akomuva nahung nading mi jouse chu kasuh mang ding, chule namelma te ho jouse kanung ngat sah ding nahi.
target: “I will send my terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter. I will make all your enemies turn their backs and run.

source: Chule keiman namasanga khoingal ho kasol ding, hiho chun Hiv mite, Canaan mite, chule Hit mite na-angsunga kona adelmang diu ahi.
target: I will send the hornet ahead of you to drive the Hivites, Canaanites and Hittites out of your way.

source: Namasanga kona kumkhat sunga kadel mangsoh louding ahi; achuti louleh gamsung chu kamhelin tin, nangma doudinga gamsaho hungpung dingu ahi.
target: But I will not drive them out in a single year, because the land would become desolate and the wild animals too numerous for you.

source: Nangma nahung punna, gam chu nalosoh kahse-a, amaho chu lhomcha cha-a namasanga kona kadelmang ding ahi.
target: Little by little I will drive them out before you, until you have increased enough to take possession of the land.

source: Chule nagamgi chu twipi sana kona Philistine twipi chan, nelphaija kona vadung chana kasem ding ahi: ajehchu keiman chugama chengho chu nakhutna kapehdoh ding; chule nangman amaho chu namasanga kona nadel mang ding ahi.
target: “I will establish your borders from the Red Sea to the Mediterranean Sea, and from the desert to the Euphrates River. I will give into your hands the people who live in the land, and you will drive them out before you.

source: Nangman amaho le a-pathenhou toh kitepna imacha nasem louding ahi.
target: Do not make a covenant with them or with their gods.

source: Amaho nagam sunga chenglouhel diu ahi; achuti loule amahon keima dounan nachonset sah dingu ahi. Ajehchu nangman a-pathen hou najenna ahile, hichu nangma dinga thang hitei ding ahi.
target: Do not let them live in your land or they will cause you to sin against me, because the worship of their gods will certainly be a snare to you.”

source: Chuin aman Mosi henga, Nangma Aaron toh, Nadab toh, Abihu toh, chule upa somsagi toh Pakai hengah hung kaltouvun; chule gamlatah-a konin neihin houvun.
target: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Come up to the Lord , you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel. You are to worship at a distance,

source: Chule Mosi changseh bouvin Pakai kom ahin nai ding ahi: ahin amahon vang ahin nailou dingu; chule mipi chu amatoh chetou loudiu ahi, ati.
target: but Moses alone is to approach the Lord ; the others must not come near. And the people may not come up with him.”

source: Chuin Mosi ahungin, Pakai thu jouse le thutanna jouse chu mipi aseipeh tan ahi. Chuin mipi chun aw khat tah-in adonbutnun, ajah-a, Pakaiyin thusei ho jouse chu kabol dingu ahi, atiuve.
target: When Moses went and told the people all the Lord ’s words and laws, they responded with one voice, “Everything the Lord has said we will do.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Pakai thusei ho jouse chu asunin, jingpi matah in athouvin, lhang noija chun maicham khat le Israel phung somle phung ni dungjuijin khompi somleni aphutnin ahi.
target: Moses then wrote down everything the Lord had said. He got up early the next morning and built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up twelve stone pillars representing the twelve tribes of Israel.

source: Chuin aman Israel chate lah-a gollhang ho asolin, amahon Pakai henga pumgo thilto atoh-un, chule bongchal khatna chamna thilto ganlhaina abolun ahi.
target: Then he sent young Israelite men, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as fellowship offerings to the Lord .

source: Chuin Mosi'n thisan akehkhat chu alan, twikong ho-a chun akoijin; chule thisan akehkhat chu maicham chung chu athe khumin ahi.
target: Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls, and the other half he splashed against the altar.

source: Chuin aman kitepna lekhabu chu alan, mipi ho jahdin asimdoh-in ahi. Chuin amahon, Pakaiyin asei jouse chu kabol dingu, chule asei kangai dingu ahi, atiuve.
target: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it to the people. They responded, “We will do everything the Lord has said; we will obey.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n thisan chu alan mipi ho chu athe khumin, ajah uva, Veuvin, hicheng thuho jouse thudola Pakaiyin thisan kitepna asem hi, ati.
target: Moses then took the blood, sprinkled it on the people and said, “This is the blood of the covenant that the Lord has made with you in accordance with all these words.”

source: Chujouvin Mosi toh, Aron toh, Nadab toh, Abihu toh, chule Israel upa somsagi toh achetou taovin ahi.
target: Moses and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and the seventy elders of Israel went up

source: Chuin amahon Israel Pathen chu amuvin: Akengto chotpha chu khi-eng song lhong kisem bangleh, athendan chu van then bangin athengin ahi.
target: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something like a pavement made of lapis lazuli, as bright blue as the sky.

source: Chuin aman Israel milen milal ho chunga akhut angampon ahi: chujongle amahon Pathen chu amuvin, chule aneovin, adonun ahi.
target: But God did not raise his hand against these leaders of the Israelites; they saw God, and they ate and drank.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Molsang chunga hin kahenga hungkaltou vinlang, chua chun umin: chule keiman nangma danthu le songpheng hochunga kasut kathupeh chu amaho nahil dinga kapeh ding nahi, ati.
target: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain and stay here, and I will give you the tablets of stone with the law and commandments I have written for their instruction.”

source: Chuin Mosi le alhacha Joshua chu akipatdoh lhonin; chule Mosi chu Pathen molsanga chun akaltou tan ahi.
target: Then Moses set out with Joshua his aide, and Moses went up on the mountain of God.

source: Chuin aman upa ho henga, Naheng uva kahung kile kahseovin hikoma hin keini eina ngah jingun: chule veuvin, Aaron le Hur nakom uva aumlhone: koihile thunoh nei na-umuleh, amani henga chehen, ati.
target: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us until we come back to you. Aaron and Hur are with you, and anyone involved in a dispute can go to them.”

source: Chuin Mosi molsang chunga akaltouvin, chuin molsang chu meilom'in atomchah tan ahi.
target: When Moses went up on the mountain, the cloud covered it,

source: Chuin Pakai loupina chu Sinai molsanga chun aumjingin, nigup sung chu meilom'in atomchah-in ahi. Chuin nisagi chanin aman Mosi chu meilom lah-a konchun ahinkouvin ahi.
target: and the glory of the Lord settled on Mount Sinai. For six days the cloud covered the mountain, and on the seventh day the Lord called to Moses from within the cloud.

source: Chuin molsang chung vuma Pakai loupina chu Israel chate mitmun kavamthei meikong abangin ahi.
target: To the Israelites the glory of the Lord looked like a consuming fire on top of the mountain.

source: Chuin Mosi chu meilom lah-a chun alutnin, molsanga chun akaltou tai. Chuin Mosi chu nisomli le jan somli molsanga chun aumtan ahi.
target: Then Moses entered the cloud as he went on up the mountain. And he stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate henga chun keima dingin thilto ahin choina dingun seijin: mitin alungcham tah-a peho-a kona keima dinga thilto chu nalahding ahi.
target: “Tell the Israelites to bring me an offering. You are to receive the offering for me from everyone whose heart prompts them to give.

source: Chule nangman amaho-a kona thilto nalahding chu hichehi ahi; sana, dangka, sum-eng,
target: These are the offerings you are to receive from them: gold, silver and bronze;

source: Pat adumloi, asandup loi, asanthip loi, patngat, kelmul,
target: blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen; goat hair;

source: Kelngoichal vun kidesan, satuilut vun, thinggi thing,
target: ram skins dyed red and another type of durable leather; acacia wood;

source: Vahding thao le gimnamtui thaova nuding thil namtui,
target: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;

source: Boitong sangkhol le a-ompho chunga behding khisonggel le songho ahi.
target: and onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.

source: Chule amaho lah-a kachenthei nadingin, amahon keima dingin muntheng eisempeh uhen.
target: “Then have them make a sanctuary for me, and I will dwell among them.

source: Houbuh kigon limleh amanchah ho jouse chu kigon lim kavetsah sa jouse bangtah-a nasah dingu ahi.
target: Make this tabernacle and all its furnishings exactly like the pattern I will show you.

source: Chule amahon thinggi thinga kitepna thingkhong asemdiu: adung tong ni le akeh, avai tong khat le akeh, chule atun chu tong khat le akeh hiding ahi.
target: “Have them make an ark of acacia wood—two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

source: Chule nangman hichu sana thengtah-a asungleh apo nalonkhum ding, chule achung kimvela chu sana lallukhuh lim nasem ding ahi.
target: Overlay it with pure gold, both inside and out, and make a gold molding around it.

source: Chule nangman hiche dinga chu sana chaokol li nalhah ding, chule chuche ningli-a chu hicheho chu nabuding ahin; chaokol ni chu asih lang khat na, chule chaokol ni ma chu asih langkhat na nabuding ahi.
target: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, with two rings on one side and two rings on the other.

source: Chule nangman thinggi thing mol lhon ni nalah-a, hichu sana-a nalonkhum ding ahi.
target: Then make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

source: Chule thingkhong chu amahon ajontheina diuva, kitepna thingkhong sih-a chaokol ho sunga chu mol lhon teni chu nagol lutding ahi.
target: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry it.

source: Mol lhon ho chu kitepna thingkhong chaokol ho sunga chu chuti umden ding; hiche teni chu kiladoh louhel ding ahi.
target: The poles are to remain in the rings of this ark; they are not to be removed.

source: Chule kitepna thingkhong sunga chu kapeh ding hettohsahna chu nakoilut ding ahi.
target: Then put in the ark the tablets of the covenant law, which I will give you.

source: Chule nangman sana thenga hepi touna nasemding, asao tong ni le akeh, chule avai tongkhat le akeh hiding ahi.
target: “Make an atonement cover of pure gold—two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

source: Chule nangman hepi touna mong teni-a chu thih kikhetna-a kikheng sana-a kisem Cherub ni nasem ding ahi.
target: And make two cherubim out of hammered gold at the ends of the cover.

source: Chule Cherub khat chu alangkhat monga nasemding, khat chu achom langkhat monga nasemding; hepi touna chunga chu among langto-a Cherub ni nasem ding ahi.
target: Make one cherub on one end and the second cherub on the other; make the cherubim of one piece with the cover, at the two ends.

source: Chule Cherub teni chun sangtah-in alha ajal lhonding, alhaho chun hepi touna chu akhuding, chuleh amailhon chu kingatto gelding; Cherub teni mai chun hepi touna lam chu angat lhon ding ahi.
target: The cherubim are to have their wings spread upward, overshadowing the cover with them. The cherubim are to face each other, looking toward the cover.

source: Chule nangman thingkhong chunga chu hepi touna chu nakoiding; chule thingkhong sunga chu keiman kapeh ding hettohsahna chu nakoiding ahi.
target: Place the cover on top of the ark and put in the ark the tablets of the covenant law that I will give you.

source: Chule chukoma chu nangma kimutopi ding, Israel chate henga kathupeh ding jouse chu hettohsahna thingkhong chunga um hepi touna chunga Cherub teni kikah-a kona chu kaki houpi ding nahi.
target: There, above the cover between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the covenant law, I will meet with you and give you all my commands for the Israelites.

source: Nangman thinggi thinga dokhang khat nasemding: adung tongni, avai tong khat, atun tong khat le akeh hiding ahi.
target: “Make a table of acacia wood—two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high.

source: Chule hichu sana thenga nalonkhum ding, chule agei kimvela sana lallukhuh lim nasemding ahi.
target: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.

source: Chule nangman akimvela chu khutpeh te agei nasemin ding, agei kimvela sana lallukhuh lim nasem ding ahi.
target: Also make around it a rim a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.

source: Chule sana chaokol li nasema, akeng li kimvel aning li ho-a chu chaokol hochu nabu ding ahi.
target: Make four gold rings for the table and fasten them to the four corners, where the four legs are.

source: Dokhang jon nading mol lhon khumlutna dinga chaokol ho chu ageichin na nabuding ahi.
target: The rings are to be close to the rim to hold the poles used in carrying the table.

source: Chule thinggi thinga mol lhon nasem ding, hiche teni-a chu dokhang chu akijon theina dinga, sana-a nalonkhum ding ahi.
target: Make the poles of acacia wood, overlay them with gold and carry the table with them.

source: Chule hiche-a dinga chu akongho, akheho, asinho, chule twikongho nasem ding; chuleh hicheho chu sana thengsela nalonkhum ding ahi.
target: And make its plates and dishes of pure gold, as well as its pitchers and bowls for the pouring out of offerings.

source: Chule vetsahna changlhah chu kamasanga dokhang chunga nakoijing ding ahi.
target: Put the bread of the Presence on this table to be before me at all times.

source: Chule sana thengtah-a thaomei khom khat nasem ding: thaomei khom chu akhetna-a kikhenga nasem ding ahi. Atunna atopal, abahho, alhengho, amumho, chule apahcha ho chengse chu pumkhatna nasemding ahi.
target: “Make a lampstand of pure gold. Hammer out its base and shaft, and make its flowerlike cups, buds and blossoms of one piece with them.

source: Chule chuche asih langto-a kona chu abah gup hungdoh ding; asih khatna kona thaomei khom abah thumna umding, asih khatna kona chu thaomei khom bah thum ma umding ahi.
target: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand—three on one side and three on the other.

source: Chule abah khatna chun jonmot ga banga kisem lheng thum, apah mun le apah pahlhah umding, chule abah dang khatna jong chu jonmot ga banga kisem lheng thum, apah mun le apah pahlhah umding; chutia chu thaomei khoma kona hungdoh abah gup ho-a chu umcheh ding ahi.
target: Three cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms are to be on one branch, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches extending from the lampstand.

source: Chule thaomei khoma chu jonmot ga banga kisem lheng li, amum hole apah ho puma umding ahi.
target: And on the lampstand there are to be four cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms.

source: Chule abah chungnung pen teni noija chu aboh khat umding, anina abah teni noija jong chu aboh khat, chule athumna abah ni noija chu aboh khat umding, hitia chu thaomeija kona hungdoh abah gup dungjuija chu umcheh ding ahi.
target: One bud shall be under the first pair of branches extending from the lampstand, a second bud under the second pair, and a third bud under the third pair—six branches in all.

source: Akhom ho le abahho chu sana pumkhatna kona kisem, sana thengtah-a kikheng hiding ahi.
target: The buds and branches shall all be of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.

source: Chule hiche-a dinga chu thaomei sagi nasem ding; chule meivah chun amasang chu asalvah theina dinga amahon thaomei chu ahal dingu ahi.
target: “Then make its seven lamps and set them up on it so that they light the space in front of it.

source: Chule chuche-a achaiche ho le ameivam dolna kongho chu sana thengsela kikheng hiding ahi.
target: Its wick trimmers and trays are to be of pure gold.

source: Hicheng um le bel ho jouse hi sana thengsel talent khat toh kikotna agih-a kona semding ahi.
target: A talent of pure gold is to be used for the lampstand and all these accessories.

source: Chule molsang chunga alim kigondan kavetsah bang banga chu nasem nadin chingtheijin.
target: See that you make them according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.

source: Chuche kalvala jong nangman houbuh chu tupat ngatsel kilhuh cheh adum, asandup chule asanthip pondal soma nasemding: hicheng chunga chu khut them tah-a Cherub ho lim nasemding ahi.
target: “Make the tabernacle with ten curtains of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, with cherubim woven into them by a skilled worker.

source: Pondal khat chu atun tong somni le tong get, chule pondal khatchu avai tong li hiding; chule pondal jouse chu kibang chehdiu ahi.
target: All the curtains are to be the same size—twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide.

source: Pondal nga chu khat le khat kijopmat sah ding; chule pondal dang ngajong chu chutima chu kijop matsah ding ahi.
target: Join five of the curtains together, and do the same with the other five.

source: Akimatna sunga agola kona chu pondal khat geija a-enga abil nasemding, chutobanga chu anina gola aponung pen geija jong nasem ding ahi.
target: Make loops of blue material along the edge of the end curtain in one set, and do the same with the end curtain in the other set.

source: Pondal khatna geija chun abil somnga nasemding, chule pondal ani chana gola aponungpen pondal geija chun abil somnga nasemding, abilho chu khat le khat kikoimat ding ahi.
target: Make fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the other set, with the loops opposite each other.

source: Chule sana-a ponche chahna somnga nasema, chule pon chechah na ho-a chu pondal ho chu achemat toding: chutengleh houbuh khat hung hiding ahitai.
target: Then make fifty gold clasps and use them to fasten the curtains together so that the tabernacle is a unit.

source: Chule houbuh chung khuna dinga chu kelmula kisem pondal ho nasemding: pondal somlekhat nasemding ahi.
target: “Make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven altogether.

source: Pondal khat chu tong somthum cheh saoding; chule pondal khat avaichu tong li cheh hiding: chule pondal somlekhat chu kibang chehdiu ahi.
target: All eleven curtains are to be the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.

source: Chule pondal ngaho chu khatle khat kikoimat ding: chule pondal gupho jongchu khatle khat kikoimat ding: chule houbuh mailam pondal gupna chu thoni hiding ahi.
target: Join five of the curtains together into one set and the other six into another set. Fold the sixth curtain double at the front of the tent.

source: Chule akil matna ponungpen pondal geija chu abil somnga nasema, chule akoimatna ani channa pondal geija jong abil somnga ma nasemding ahi.
target: Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in one set and also along the edge of the end curtain in the other set.

source: Chule sum-enga ponche chahna somnga nasema, ponche chahna hochu abil ho-a chu nathilding: pon in ahithei na dinga nakoimat sohkei ding ahi.
target: Then make fifty bronze clasps and put them in the loops to fasten the tent together as a unit.

source: Pon in'a pondal ho aval chengse, pondal akeh valdoh chengse chu houbuh tomlama kikhaiding ahi.
target: As for the additional length of the tent curtains, the half curtain that is left over is to hang down at the rear of the tabernacle.

source: Chule alang khatna tongkhat, alang chom khatna tong khat, pon in pondal ho adungjuija avaldoh chu, houbuh hilam pang le khulam panga akhudinga kikhai lhato gelding ahilhone.
target: The tent curtains will be a cubit longer on both sides; what is left will hang over the sides of the tabernacle so as to cover it.

source: Chule chuche pon in chung khuna ding chun kelngoichal vunho akide san nasemding, hiche chungvuma achung khuna ding chun satuilut vunho nasemding ahi.
target: Make for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of the other durable leather.

source: Chule houbuh thingpeh ho chu thinggi thing ading jang keija nasemding ahi.
target: “Make upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.

source: Thingpeh khat chu adung tong som, chule thingpeh khat chu availam tong khat le akeh hiding ahi.
target: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide,

source: Thingpeh khat cheh-a chu butonako dinga aki-at kot ni cheh umding: chutia chu houbuh thingpeh jouse chu nasemding ahi.
target: with two projections set parallel to each other. Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.

source: Chule nangman thingpeh somni chu lhanglama pangdinga, houbuh thingpeh ho nasemding ahi.
target: Make twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle

source: Chule thingpeh somni ho noija chun dangka khombul butona ding ko somli nasemding; thingpeh khat noija butonako ni dingin khombul kigeitong ni, chule thingpeh chom dang noija butona ko hidingin khombul kigeitong ni ma nasem kitding ahi.
target: and make forty silver bases to go under them—two bases for each frame, one under each projection.

source: Houbuh pang ani chana sahlam panga chu thingpeh somni hiding ahi.
target: For the other side, the north side of the tabernacle, make twenty frames

source: Chule dangka khombul kigeitong somli ho, thingpeh khat noija khombul butona ko ni, chule thingpeh chomdang khat noija khombul butonako ni cheh nasem ding ahi.
target: and forty silver bases—two under each frame.

source: Chule houbuh tomlama, lhumlam sanga chu thingpeh gup nasem ding ahi.
target: Make six frames for the far end, that is, the west end of the tabernacle,

source: Chule houbuh tomlam aning ni-a dinga thingpeh ni nasemding ahi.
target: and make two frames for the corners at the far end.

source: Chule hiteni chu anoilama chu kithokop lhonding, chule achunglama chu achina thih chaokol khatna tuhmat hiding ahi. Chutia chu anigel lhona dinga chu chutiding; hiteni chu aning teni-a ding hiding ahi.
target: At these two corners they must be double from the bottom all the way to the top and fitted into a single ring; both shall be like that.

source: Hitia chu thingpeh getna chu sana butonako ho, thingpeh khat noija chu abutona ko ni, adang thingpeh noija jong chu nima abona somlegup umding ahi.
target: So there will be eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.

source: Chule thinggi thinga banggol ho nasem ding; houbuh pang langkhatna thingpeh ho-a ding chu banggol nga,
target: “Also make crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,

source: Chule houbuh pang langkhatna thingpehho dinga chu banggol ngama; chule lhanglam houbuh tomlama thingpeh ho dingin banggol ngama nasemding ahi.
target: five for those on the other side, and five for the frames on the west, at the far end of the tabernacle.

source: Chule thingpeh ho lah-a akima banggol chu among khatna pat among langkhat geija kigolpai ding ahi.
target: The center crossbar is to extend from end to end at the middle of the frames.

source: Chule thingpeh ho chu sana-a nalonkhum ding, abangolho thunlutna dinga chu chaokol nasemding: chule abanggol jong chu sana-a nalonkhum ding ahi.
target: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Also overlay the crossbars with gold.

source: Chule houbuh chu molsang chunga nakimusah lim bang banga chu nasah ding ahi.
target: “Set up the tabernacle according to the plan shown you on the mountain.

source: Chule pondala dinga pat adum, asandup, asanthip, chule tupat ngatsel akilhuh-a kikhong nasemding: chule Cherub limho chu khut them tah-a nasemding ahi.
target: “Make a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, with cherubim woven into it by a skilled worker.

source: Chule sana kilonkhum dangka khombul ho-a kiphut thinggi thing khom li chunga chu nakhai ding; koikaho chu sana hiding, dangka-a kisem butonako li chunga chu kibut ding ahi.
target: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases.

source: Chule hettohsahna thingkhong chu pondal sunga napohlut theina dinga, pondal chu pon chechahna ho noija chu nakhai ding, chule pondal chun munthengle muntheng chungnung chu nahopkhen pehding ahi.
target: Hang the curtain from the clasps and place the ark of the covenant law behind the curtain. The curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.

source: Chule muntheng chungnung sunga chu hepi touna chu hettohsahna thingkhong chunga nakoiding ahi.
target: Put the atonement cover on the ark of the covenant law in the Most Holy Place.

source: Chule pondal polama chu dokhang chu nakoiding, chule meivah khom chu dokhang jon, houbuh pang lhanglam sanga nakoiding: chule dokhang chu sahlam sanga nakoiding ahi.
target: Place the table outside the curtain on the north side of the tabernacle and put the lampstand opposite it on the south side.

source: Chule houbuh kotna dinga chu ponjal adumloi, asandup, asanthip, chule tupat ngatsel kilhuh-a kikhong, heova kijemhoiho chu kikhai ding ahi.
target: “For the entrance to the tent make a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen—the work of an embroiderer.

source: Chule akikhai nading chu thinggi thinga khom nga nasemding, chule sana nalonkhum ding, akoika hojong chu sana kisem hiding ahi. Chule hicheho dinga chu sum-enga khombul butonako nga nalhah ding ahi.
target: Make gold hooks for this curtain and five posts of acacia wood overlaid with gold. And cast five bronze bases for them.

source: Chule thinggi thinga kisem maicham khat nasemding, hichu adung tong nga, avai tong nga hiding; chule maicham chu aningli kibang hiding: chule asan tong thum hiding ahi.
target: “Build an altar of acacia wood, three cubits high; it is to be square, five cubits long and five cubits wide.

source: Chule aning li ho chunga chu akiho nasemding, akiho chu kithakhat ding; chule hichu sum-enga nalonkhum ding ahi.
target: Make a horn at each of the four corners, so that the horns and the altar are of one piece, and overlay the altar with bronze.

source: Chule avutvam ho dona ding kongho nasemding, vut lona kheho, akongtong, asakoika ho, chule achaiche ho jong, hiche um le bel ho jouse chu sum-enga nasemding ahi.
target: Make all its utensils of bronze—its pots to remove the ashes, and its shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks and firepans.

source: Chule hicheng ding chu sum-eng kiphan len nasemding; chule len chunga aning liho-a chu sum-eng chaokol nabuding ahi.
target: Make a grating for it, a bronze network, and make a bronze ring at each of the four corners of the network.

source: Len chun maicham noilam gei ahin phahna dinga, len chun maicham kim aphah ding ahi.
target: Put it under the ledge of the altar so that it is halfway up the altar.

source: Chule maicham putna dinga chu mol lhon, thinggi thing mol lhon nasemding; chule hiho chu sum-enga nalonkhum ding ahi.
target: Make poles of acacia wood for the altar and overlay them with bronze.

source: Chule mol lhon hochu chaokol hom sunga chu nathil lut ding, chule aputna dinga maicham langto-a mol lhon chu umding ahi.
target: The poles are to be inserted into the rings so they will be on two sides of the altar when it is carried.

source: Thingpeh hochu alai homa nasemding: molsang chunga nakimusah banga chu asem dingu ahi.
target: Make the altar hollow, out of boards. It is to be made just as you were shown on the mountain.

source: Chule houbuh hong sung nasemding: lhanglam panga hongsung dinga chu tupat ngatsel kilhuhkop, langkhat pang dinga tong jakhat sao ponjal kikhai ding ahi.
target: “Make a courtyard for the tabernacle. The south side shall be a hundred cubits long and is to have curtains of finely twisted linen,

source: Chule akhom somni chule khom butona koho somni chu sum-eng hiding: akhom koikaho le agol laiho chu dangka kilonkhumsah hiding ahi.
target: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

source: Chutobang machu sahlamsanga dinga adung tong jakhat sao kikhai pondal le khom somni, chule sum-eng khom butona koho somni umding ahi. Akhom koikaho le agol laiho chu dangka kilonkhum hiding ahiuve.
target: The north side shall also be a hundred cubits long and is to have curtains, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

source: Chule lhumlam sang hongsung availam ding akikhai pondal kikhai tong somnga hiding: akhom som le khom bul butona ko som hiding ahi.
target: “The west end of the courtyard shall be fifty cubits wide and have curtains, with ten posts and ten bases.

source: Chule solama um hongsung availam solamsang chu tong somnga hiding ahi.
target: On the east end, toward the sunrise, the courtyard shall also be fifty cubits wide.

source: Kotpi sihlang khatna pondal kikhai chu tong somlenga hiding, chule akhom thumtoh akhombul butona ko thum toh hiding ahi.
target: Curtains fifteen cubits long are to be on one side of the entrance, with three posts and three bases,

source: Chule asih chomlang khatna chu pondal kikhai tong somlenga umding: akhomho thumtoh akhombul butona ko thumtoh umdiu ahi.
target: and curtains fifteen cubits long are to be on the other side, with three posts and three bases.

source: Chule ahongsung kotpi dinga chu pondal kikhai tong somni, adum, asandup, asanthip, tupat ngatsela kilhuh khutthem tah-a kijemho chu kidah ding ahi. Akhomho chu li hiding, akhombul butona ko chu li ma hiding ahi.
target: “For the entrance to the courtyard, provide a curtain twenty cubits long, of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen—the work of an embroiderer—with four posts and four bases.

source: Ahongsung kimvela khomho jouse chu dangka kilonkhum hicheh ding, akoikaho chu dangka-a kisem hiding; chule akhombul butonaho chu sum-eng hidiu ahi.
target: All the posts around the courtyard are to have silver bands and hooks, and bronze bases.

source: Ahongsung chu adung tong jakhat, availam chu tong somnga, chule asan ngatsela kikhuh kopma kikhong tupat pon chu tong nga hiding; chule akhombul butonako hochu sum-eng hiding ahi.
target: The courtyard shall be a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide, with curtains of finely twisted linen five cubits high, and with bronze bases.

source: Houbuh kinbolna jouse-a kongle bel ho jouse le athil kilnaho jouse, chule hongsung kilna ho jouse chu sum-eng hiding ahi.
target: All the other articles used in the service of the tabernacle, whatever their function, including all the tent pegs for it and those for the courtyard, are to be of bronze.

source: Chule thaomei chu avahjing theina dinga, Israel chate chun olive thaochim kiheh lha nahenga ahinchoi jingna dinguva nathupeh ding ahi.
target: “Command the Israelites to bring you clear oil of pressed olives for the light so that the lamps may be kept burning.

source: Mipi kikhopna houbuh hettohsahna masanga pondal polama chu Aaron le achapate chun Pakai angsunga nilhah-a pat jingkah changeija avet tup dingu ahi. Israel chate thalhenga akhang lhumkei juva chona dan hiding ahi.
target: In the tent of meeting, outside the curtain that shields the ark of the covenant law, Aaron and his sons are to keep the lamps burning before the Lord from evening till morning. This is to be a lasting ordinance among the Israelites for the generations to come.

source: Chule Israel chate lah-a konin nasopipa Aaron le akoma um achapate chun thempu tohmuna eijen theina dingun, Aaron le chapate Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar chule Ithamar chu nakoma lhengdoh-in.
target: “Have Aaron your brother brought to you from among the Israelites, along with his sons Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, so they may serve me as priests.

source: Chule nasopipa Aaron loupina le vet hoina dinga vontheng nagon pehding ahi.
target: Make sacred garments for your brother Aaron to give him dignity and honor.

source: Chule alungthim them le chihna lhagaova kadip dimho jouse henga chun nangman thu seijin lang, Aaron chun thempu tohmuna chu keima eijen theina dinga suhthenga aum theina dingin avonho chu sempeh uhen.
target: Tell all the skilled workers to whom I have given wisdom in such matters that they are to make garments for Aaron, for his consecration, so he may serve me as priest.

source: Chule amahon asemdiu vonho chu: ompho, boitong sangkhol, sangkhol len, akijempah delkop, konggah hiding; hitia chu amahon thempu tohmuna keima eijentheina diuva, amahon Aaron le achapatea dinga vontheng ho asempeh dingu ahi.
target: These are the garments they are to make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban and a sash. They are to make these sacred garments for your brother Aaron and his sons, so they may serve me as priests.

source: Chule amahon sana, pondum, ponsandup, ponsanthip, chule tupat naljet amandiu ahi.
target: Have them use gold, and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and fine linen.

source: Chule amahon sana le pondum, ponsandup, ponsanthip, chule tupat naljetna boitong sangkhol chu khut themtah-a asemdiu ahi.
target: “Make the ephod of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen—the work of skilled hands.

source: Akijopmat theina dinga chu alengkou teni chunga agenhon kikilmatna aneiding ahi.
target: It is to have two shoulder pieces attached to two of its corners, so it can be fastened.

source: Chule boitong sangkhol chunga um akijempah konggah jong chu thakhat hiding; sana, pondum, ponsandup, ponsanthip, chule tupat naljetna akisem hiding ahi.
target: Its skillfully woven waistband is to be like it—of one piece with the ephod and made with gold, and with blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and with finely twisted linen.

source: Chule khisonggel ni nalah-a achunga chu Israel chate min nasutding ahi.
target: “Take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel

source: Aminu gup chu songkhat chunga chu nasutna, adang minchom gup chu apendolu dungjuija songchom chunga chu nasutding ahi.
target: in the order of their birth—six names on one stone and the remaining six on the other.

source: Min kitana mohor chunga songkheng themin akhenji banga, songpheng teni-a chu Israel chate minho nakhet ding: hiho chu sana jemho-a nasemdoh ding ahi.
target: Engrave the names of the sons of Israel on the two stones the way a gem cutter engraves a seal. Then mount the stones in gold filigree settings

source: Chule Israel chate dinga hetjingna songho hidinga, chuche song teni chu boitong sangkhol lengkoupeh teni-a chu nakoiding; chule Aaron'in hetjingna dinga alengkou teni chunga minho chu Pakai masanga apohjing ding ahi.
target: and fasten them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel. Aaron is to bear the names on his shoulders as a memorial before the Lord .

source: Chule nangman sana jemkoho semin,
target: Make gold filigree settings

source: Chule nangman sana chaokol thengtah jangni pahvui kithil banga nasema, jemkoho-a chu nahenchah ding ahi.
target: and two braided chains of pure gold, like a rope, and attach the chains to the settings.

source: Chule thutana ompho khut themtah-a nasem ding: boitong sangkhol kisem bang banga sana, pondum, ponsandup, ponsanthip, chule tupat naljetna nasem ding ahi.
target: “Fashion a breastpiece for making decisions—the work of skilled hands. Make it like the ephod: of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.

source: Aning li kibanga atho-a kilhep ding; adung khapkhat, avai khapkhat ma hiding ahi.
target: It is to be square—a span long and a span wide—and folded double.

source: Chule chua chu song buding ho chu nabuding; song chu gol li-a nabuding ahi. Agol masa chu songsan, song-eng, chule song santhip hiding: hichu agol masa hiding ahi.
target: Then mount four rows of precious stones on it. The first row shall be carnelian, chrysolite and beryl;

source: Chule agol nina chu song engsel, song dumjet, chule song mantam hidiu ahi.
target: the second row shall be turquoise, lapis lazuli and emerald;

source: Chule agolthum na chu song sandang, song vom, chule song sandup hiding ahi.
target: the third row shall be jacinth, agate and amethyst;

source: Chule agol lina chu song engdum, khisonggel, chule khi song pol hiding ahi. Hiho chu akiphunao muncheh-a sana lonkhumcheh ding ahi.
target: the fourth row shall be topaz, onyx and jasper. Mount them in gold filigree settings.
