source: Chule song ho chu Israel chate dungjuija, amin dungjui cheh uva somleni hiding: mohor kikheng ho banga phung som le phungni dungjuija khatcheh chu amintoh umcheh ding ahi.
target: There are to be twelve stones, one for each of the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.

source: Chule ompho chunga chu sana chaokol thengtah pahvui kithil banga sana sumgui nasemding ahi.
target: “For the breastpiece make braided chains of pure gold, like a rope.

source: Chule ompho chunga chu sana chaokol ni nasema, chaokol teni chu ompho ning teni-a chu nabuding ahi.
target: Make two gold rings for it and fasten them to two corners of the breastpiece.

source: Chule pahvui banga kisem sana sumgui teni chu ompho ning gela um thih chaokol sunga chu thillut ding ahi.
target: Fasten the two gold chains to the rings at the corners of the breastpiece,

source: Chule pahvui banga kisem thih chaokol mong teni chu jemko ni-a chu nahetlut ding, boitong sangkhol lengkou anglam sanga chu nakhichah ding ahi.
target: and the other ends of the chains to the two settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.

source: Chule sana chaokol ni nasema, hichu boitong sangkhol bantah-a, asungnung geija ompho ning teni-a chu nabuding ahi.
target: Make two gold rings and attach them to the other two corners of the breastpiece on the inside edge next to the ephod.

source: Chule sana chaokol chomdang ni nasemding, boitong sangkhol lengkou teni noilamsang, amasanglam, atho-a kilhepna noi, boitong sangkhol khut kijempah-a konggah chung laitah-a chu nabuding ahi.
target: Make two more gold rings and attach them to the bottom of the shoulder pieces on the front of the ephod, close to the seam just above the waistband of the ephod.

source: Chule amahon ompho chaokol ho le boitong sangkhol chaokol ho chu amahon patdum kipheh khatna akan matdiu, hiche chu phatah-a kipheh boitong sangkhol konggah chunga aumtheina ding le boitong sangkhola kona chu akikan louna dinga ahi.
target: The rings of the breastpiece are to be tied to the rings of the ephod with blue cord, connecting it to the waistband, so that the breastpiece will not swing out from the ephod.

source: Chule Aaron chun Pakai masanga hetjingna dinga munthenga chu achelut seh a-op phang dontah-a Israel chate min kijihna thutana ompho chu tantih neilouva apoh jingding ahi.
target: “Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he will bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of decision as a continuing memorial before the Lord .

source: Chule nangman Urim le Thummim chu thutana ompho sunga chu nakoilut ding, chule Aaron Pakai anga ache tengle hichu alungchang dontah-a umding ahi. Hitia chu Aaron'in Israel chate thutana chu alung chung dontah-a imatih chana Pakai anga apohding ahi.
target: Also put the Urim and the Thummim in the breastpiece, so they may be over Aaron’s heart whenever he enters the presence of the Lord . Thus Aaron will always bear the means of making decisions for the Israelites over his heart before the Lord .

source: Chule nanghon chuche boitong sangkhol chol chu adum jenga nasem dingu ahi.
target: “Make the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth,

source: Chule hichu achung le alai dona ahom khat umding; chule ahom kimvela chu a-eh louna dinga akhichahna tupat sangkhol ponung ngong khina khaokipheh detchet umding ahi.
target: with an opening for the head in its center. There shall be a woven edge like a collar around this opening, so that it will not tear.

source: Chule chuche geiho-a chu adum, asandup, asanthipma kolbuthei ho nasemding: chule akahho kimvela sana changeng ho nakhai ding ahi.
target: Make pomegranates of blue, purple and scarlet yarn around the hem of the robe, with gold bells between them.

source: Sangkhol len gei kimvela chu sana changeng le kolbutheiga, sana changeng le kolbutheiga nasem ding ahi.
target: The gold bells and the pomegranates are to alternate around the hem of the robe.

source: Hichu kinbolna dinga Aaron'in akivon ding; chule athi louna dinga, Pakai anga munthenga alutle apotle tengle agin kija ding ahi.
target: Aaron must wear it when he ministers. The sound of the bells will be heard when he enters the Holy Place before the Lord and when he comes out, so that he will not die.

source: Chule sana thengsela kong khat nasemding, achunga chun mohor kikhen banga PAKAIYA DINGA ATHENG tia nakhet ding ahi.
target: “Make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it as on a seal: holy to the Lord .

source: Chule hichu delkop chunga aumtheina dinga patkhao dum khatna nabuding: hichu delkop masang jontah-a chu umding ahi.
target: Fasten a blue cord to it to attach it to the turban; it is to be on the front of the turban.

source: Chule Aaron'in Israel chaten athiltheng tohouva athensona diu akhan gitlouna hou chu apoh nadinga hichu Aaron chalpanga umding ahi. Chule amaho chu Pakai anga san ahitheina dinguva hichu achalpanga apoh jingding ahi.
target: It will be on Aaron’s forehead, and he will bear the guilt involved in the sacred gifts the Israelites consecrate, whatever their gifts may be. It will be on Aaron’s forehead continually so that they will be acceptable to the Lord .

source: Chule tupat ngatsela sangkhol chol chungnung chu khut themtah-a najep hoi ding, tupat ngatsela delkop nasemding, chule konggah chu hoitah-a nakhui ding ahi.
target: “Weave the tunic of fine linen and make the turban of fine linen. The sash is to be the work of an embroiderer.

source: Chule Aaron chapate dinga loupina ding le hoina dinga sangkhol sungnung nasema, amaho dinga konggah ho nasemding, chule delkop ho jong nasem ding ahi.
target: Make tunics, sashes and caps for Aaron’s sons to give them dignity and honor.

source: Chule hicheho chu nasopipa Aaron le aumpi achapate navonpeh ding; chule amaho chun kamasanga thempu tohmuna keima eijentheina diuva thao nanu-a nasuhtheng ding, chule nachom khending ahi.
target: After you put these clothes on your brother Aaron and his sons, anoint and ordain them. Consecrate them so they may serve me as priests.

source: Chule asagoh-u khukhumna dingin amaho chu tupat pon tokaho nasempeh ding; hichu akonga pat apheigei lhungding ahi.
target: “Make linen undergarments as a covering for the body, reaching from the waist to the thigh.

source: Chule hichu Aaron le achapaten houbuh ahunglut phatnu ham, ahiloule munthenga lhacha dinga maicham ahinnai phatnu ham tengule, khangit louna apoh uva athi louna dinguva achen chehdiu ahi. Hichu amale anunga achilhah channa jong a-itih-a dinga chonna dan kisun hiding ahi.
target: Aaron and his sons must wear them whenever they enter the tent of meeting or approach the altar to minister in the Holy Place, so that they will not incur guilt and die. “This is to be a lasting ordinance for Aaron and his descendants.

source: Thempu tohmuna eijen theina diuva suhtheng ahina diuva amaho chunga nabolding chu hiche hi ahi: nolna beihel bongchalgol khat le kelngoichal ni nalah ding,
target: “This is what you are to do to consecrate them, so they may serve me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams without defect.

source: Chule cholsolou changlhah, thao toh kihal cholsolou changlhah le changlhah lum, chule thao toh kihal changlhah pheng nalah ding; hicheho chu suhlou changbong nelsela nasemding ahi.
target: And from the finest wheat flour make round loaves without yeast, thick loaves without yeast and with olive oil mixed in, and thin loaves without yeast and brushed with olive oil.

source: Hicheng chu nangman pocha sung khatna nakhol khoma, pocha puma nahin todoh ding; chule bongchal le kelngoichal teni jong chu nahin kailut paipai ding ahi.
target: Put them in a basket and present them along with the bull and the two rams.

source: Chule Aaron le achapate chu houbuh mun'a chu nahinpuija, twija nakisil sah ding ahi.
target: Then bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the tent of meeting and wash them with water.

source: Chuteng le vonho chu nalah-a, Aaron chu boitong sangkhol leh pon sangkholen, boitong sangkhol le ompho chu navonpeh ding: chule khut themtah-a kijempah boitong sangkhol khaigahna-a chu akong nagehpeh ding ahi.
target: Take the garments and dress Aaron with the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod itself and the breastpiece. Fasten the ephod on him by its skillfully woven waistband.

source: Chule aluchanga chun delkop nakop peh-a, lukhuh theng chu delkop chunga chu nakhuhsah ding ahi.
target: Put the turban on his head and attach the sacred emblem to the turban.

source: Chuteng nuding thao chu nalah ding, alu chunga nalhei lhah-a, amachu thao nanuding ahi.
target: Take the anointing oil and anoint him by pouring it on his head.

source: Chule achapate chu hinpuilut nahin puilut ding, sangkhol chol chungnung na-ah peh ding ahi.
target: Bring his sons and dress them in tunics

source: Chule Aaron le achapate chu konggah ho nageh peh-a, delkop nakoppeh ding: chule thempu tohmun chu amahoa dinga a-itih-a chonna dan khatna umding ahitai. Chule nangman Aaron le achapate chu nathenso ding ahi.
target: and fasten caps on them. Then tie sashes on Aaron and his sons. The priesthood is theirs by a lasting ordinance. “Then you shall ordain Aaron and his sons.

source: Chule bongchal chu houkhom ho houbuh masanga nahin kailut sah ding; chule Aaron le achapaten bongchal luchunga chu akhutnu angapdiu ahi.
target: “Bring the bull to the front of the tent of meeting, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.

source: Chule houkhom ho houbuh kotphung Pakai angsunga chu bongchal chu nathading ahi.
target: Slaughter it in the Lord ’s presence at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

source: Chule bongchal thisan chu nalah-a, nakhut junga maicham sakiho chunga chu nakoiding; chule thisan jouse chu maicham bula chu nasunlhah ding ahi.
target: Take some of the bull’s blood and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger, and pour out the rest of it at the base of the altar.

source: Chule asunga beh athao jouse nalah-a, athin chunga athaolom, akalteni chule achunga thao ho chu maicham chunga nahalding ahi.
target: Then take all the fat on the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, and both kidneys with the fat on them, and burn them on the altar.

source: Ahin chuche bongchal saphe le avun, chule a-eh chu gebuh polama meija nagovam ding ahi. Hichu chonset thilto ahi.
target: But burn the bull’s flesh and its hide and its intestines outside the camp. It is a sin offering.

source: Chule kelngoichal chu nalah-a, Aaron le achapate chun kelngoichal luchanga chu akhutnu angapdiu ahi.
target: “Take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.

source: Chule kelngoichal chu nathading, chule athisan chu nalah-a maicham chung kimvel chu nathekhum ding ahi.
target: Slaughter it and take the blood and splash it against the sides of the altar.

source: Chule kelngoichal chu ahal ahalla nasem nonga, asung ho le akeng ho chu nasopding, ahal hala asa semnong sa le alu chutoh nakoitha ding ahi.
target: Cut the ram into pieces and wash the internal organs and the legs, putting them with the head and the other pieces.

source: Chule kelngoichal chu apumpia maicham chunga nagoding ahi. Hichu Pakai dinga govam thilto ahin; hichu Pakaiya dinga meija kisem thilto, gimnamtui tah chu ahi.
target: Then burn the entire ram on the altar. It is a burnt offering to the Lord , a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord .

source: Chule kelngoichal dang khat chu nalah-a, Aaron le achapate chun kelngoichal luchanga chu akhutnu angapdiu ahi.
target: “Take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.

source: Chuteng nangman kelngoichal chu natha ding, chule athi chu nalah-a Aaron jetlam bilkol monga, achate jetlam bilkol monga, akhut jetlamu khutpi chung, chule akeng jetlamu kengpi chunga chun nanuding, chule athisan chu maicham kimvela nathe ding ahi.
target: Slaughter it, take some of its blood and put it on the lobes of the right ears of Aaron and his sons, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Then splash blood against the sides of the altar.

source: Chule maicham chunga um thisan le kinuding thao chu nalah-a, Aaron chung, avon chung, achate chung, aumpi achate von chunga nathekhum ding; chuteng amajong, avonjong, achate jong, chule aumpi achate von jong chu thengding ahi.
target: And take some blood from the altar and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments and on his sons and their garments. Then he and his sons and their garments will be consecrated.

source: Nangman Kelngoichal thao le ameithao, asunga kai athaoho, ala kimvela athao le akalteni tom athao, chule alengkou jetlama chu nalah ding ahi; ajehchu kelngoichal chu ganlhaina dia kipesa ahi.
target: “Take from this ram the fat, the fat tail, the fat on the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, both kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh. (This is the ram for the ordination.)

source: Chule Pakai angsunga um changlhah lum khat, thaova kikang changlhah khat, pocha sunga kon cholsolou changlhah kikang peh khat nalah ding:
target: From the basket of bread made without yeast, which is before the Lord , take one round loaf, one thick loaf with olive oil mixed in, and one thin loaf.

source: Aaron le achate khutna aboncha nakoiding; chule Pakai angsunga jap thilto-a dinga najap ding ahi.
target: Put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and have them wave them before the Lord as a wave offering.

source: Chule hichu nangman amaho khutna kona chu nalah-a, Pakai angsunga gimnamtui tah hidinga maicham chunga chu nago ding ahi: hichu Pakaiya dinga meija kisem thilto ahi.
target: Then take them from their hands and burn them on the altar along with the burnt offering for a pleasing aroma to the Lord , a food offering presented to the Lord .

source: Chule Aaron'in kipehthenga atodohsa kelngoi om chu nalah-a, Pakai angsunga jap thilto-a dinga najap ding ahi: chule hiche chu nang chan hiding ahi.
target: After you take the breast of the ram for Aaron’s ordination, wave it before the Lord as a wave offering, and it will be your share.

source: Chule Aaron'a ding le achate-a dinga kithensona kelngoija kona chu jap thilto a-om le, thilto adah bul chu nathenso ding; hichu jap thilto le dop thilto ahi.
target: “Consecrate those parts of the ordination ram that belong to Aaron and his sons: the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented.

source: Hichu Israel chate-a kona tonsot chondan dinga Aaron le achapate chan hiding ahi. Ajehchu dop thilto ahin: chule hichu Israel chaten Pakaiya dinga adop thiltou, achamna thiltou ganlhaina-a kona dop thilto dingu chu ahi.
target: This is always to be the perpetual share from the Israelites for Aaron and his sons. It is the contribution the Israelites are to make to the Lord from their fellowship offerings.

source: Chule hichea chu thao akinu uva chule akipehtheng nadinguva, Aaron vontheng hochu ama nungteng achate-a hiding ahi.
target: “Aaron’s sacred garments will belong to his descendants so that they can be anointed and ordained in them.

source: Chule acha ama khela thempu-a pangpa chun muntheng mun'a natong dinga houkhom na houbuh-a mun'a chu ahung tengleh, vonho chu nisagi akivon ding ahi.
target: The son who succeeds him as priest and comes to the tent of meeting to minister in the Holy Place is to wear them seven days.

source: Chule kipeh thengna kelngoi chu nangin nalah-a, chule apheho chu munthenga chu nahon ding ahi.
target: “Take the ram for the ordination and cook the meat in a sacred place.

source: Chule Aaron le achapaten kelngoi sa chu pocha sunga kikoi changlhah chutoh, houbuhho houbuh kot koma chu anehdiu ahi.
target: At the entrance to the tent of meeting, Aaron and his sons are to eat the meat of the ram and the bread that is in the basket.

source: Chule amahon longlhenna kibolho chu akipehtheng nadiu le akisuhtheng nadiuva anehdiu: amavang thiltheng ahijeh-a, gamdang mi vang anehsah loudiu ahi.
target: They are to eat these offerings by which atonement was made for their ordination and consecration. But no one else may eat them, because they are sacred.

source: Ijemtia kipeh thengna saphe le changlhah chu jingkah geija aval aumle, nangman hicheho chu meija nahalvam ding ahi: ajehchu atheng ahi jeh-a nehlou ding ahi.
target: And if any of the meat of the ordination ram or any bread is left over till morning, burn it up. It must not be eaten, because it is sacred.

source: Chule keiman kathupeh banga nangman Aaron le achapate chunga nabol ding ahi: nisagi sung amaho dinga kipeh thengna nabolpeh ding ahi.
target: “Do for Aaron and his sons everything I have commanded you, taking seven days to ordain them.

source: Chule nangnam niseh le longlhen na-a dinga chonset thilto-a bongchal khat natoding: chule nangman hiche-a dinga chu longlhena naboljou tengle maicham chu nasop thengding; chule suhthengna dinga thao nanu ding ahi.
target: Sacrifice a bull each day as a sin offering to make atonement. Purify the altar by making atonement for it, and anoint it to consecrate it.

source: Nangman ni sagi sunga maichama dinga longlhenna nabola chule nasuhtheng ding; chutengle maicham thengchung nung hiding ahitai: ipi hijongle maicham tongkha chanchu thengjeng ding ahi.
target: For seven days make atonement for the altar and consecrate it. Then the altar will be most holy, and whatever touches it will be holy.

source: Tun maichama natoding chu hiche hi ahi: kum khat lhingbep kelngoi ni niseh-a nato ding ahi.
target: “This is what you are to offer on the altar regularly each day: two lambs a year old.

source: Kelngoi khat chu jingkah lamleh natoding; chule kelngoi dang khat chu nilhah lamle natoding ahi.
target: Offer one in the morning and the other at twilight.

source: Chule kelngoi khat dinga chu changbong neljet ephah hopsom-a hopkhat le thao kihehdoh hin khat hopli hopkhat hiding; chule don thilto-a dinga lengpitwi hin hopli-a hopkhat hiding ahi.
target: With the first lamb offer a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil from pressed olives, and a quarter of a hin of wine as a drink offering.

source: Chule kelngoi khat jopa chu nilhah lamle natoding, chule jingkah-a anneh thilto kitoh bang le don thilto kitoh banga Pakaiya dinga meija kisem thilto, gimnamtui tah hidinga nato ding ahi.
target: Sacrifice the other lamb at twilight with the same grain offering and its drink offering as in the morning—a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord .

source: Hiche hi nangma kihoupi dinga kakimuto pina ding mun Pakai angsunga houkhom ho houbuh kotphunga nakhang khanguva dinga tanglouva govam thilto kiboljing chu hiding ahi.
target: “For the generations to come this burnt offering is to be made regularly at the entrance to the tent of meeting, before the Lord . There I will meet you and speak to you;

source: Chule hiche mun'a chu Israel chatetoh kakimuto ding, chule houbuh chu kaloupi na-a suhthenga umding ahi.
target: there also I will meet with the Israelites, and the place will be consecrated by my glory.

source: Chule keiman houkhom ho houbuh le maicham chu kasuhtheng ding: chujongle Aaron le achapate chu thempu natohna mun'a keima lhacha natong dinga kasuhtheng ding ahi.
target: “So I will consecrate the tent of meeting and the altar and will consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve me as priests.

source: Chule keima Israel chate lah-a kachena, chule a-Pathen'u kahiding ahi.
target: Then I will dwell among the Israelites and be their God.

source: Chule amahon amaho lah-a kachen theina dinga, Egypt gama kona amaho hinpui dohpa, Pakai a-Pathen'u kahi ahet dingu ahi: keima Pakai a-Pathen'u chu kahi.
target: They will know that I am the Lord their God, who brought them out of Egypt so that I might dwell among them. I am the Lord their God.

source: Chule nangman gimnamtui halna maicham nasem ding: hichu nangman thinggi thinga nasemding ahi.
target: “Make an altar of acacia wood for burning incense.

source: Hichu adung tongkhat chule avai tong khat hiding; aningli hiding, chule atun tongni hiding, akijong hitobangma chu sangding ahi.
target: It is to be square, a cubit long and a cubit wide, and two cubits high—its horns of one piece with it.

source: Chule nangman achungvum, avel pumpi-a, chule akiho chu sana-a natomding; chule nangman akimvel chu sana lallukhuh-a nasemding ahi.
target: Overlay the top and all the sides and the horns with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

source: Chule nangman sana chaokol ni lallukhuh lim noija chun nasemding, aningtenia jong, apangtenia jong, chule hicheho chu amoljolho kithilna hiding ahi.
target: Make two gold rings for the altar below the molding—two on each of the opposite sides—to hold the poles used to carry it.

source: Chule nangman amoljolho chu thinggi thinga nasema, sana-a nalonkhum ding ahi.
target: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

source: Chule nangman hichu kakimutopi nading mun, hettohsahna thingkhong kom, hepi touna maija, hiche pondal maija chu nakoiding ahi.
target: Put the altar in front of the curtain that shields the ark of the covenant law—before the atonement cover that is over the tablets of the covenant law—where I will meet with you.

source: Chule Aaron'in hikoma chu jingkah sehleh gimnamtui ahalding; thaomei avahjou tengle, achunga gimnamtui ahalding ahi.
target: “Aaron must burn fragrant incense on the altar every morning when he tends the lamps.

source: Chule Aaron'in nilhah lama thaomei avahteng le gimnamtui chu ahalding, nakhang lhumkei uva Pakai masanga gimnamtui kihal hiding ahi.
target: He must burn incense again when he lights the lamps at twilight so incense will burn regularly before the Lord for the generations to come.

source: Nangman hiche chunga chu gimnamtui chomdang khat nahal lou ding, govam thilto, anneh thilto jong nato louding, chule achunga don thilto jong nasunlhah louding ahi.
target: Do not offer on this altar any other incense or any burnt offering or grain offering, and do not pour a drink offering on it.

source: Chule longlhena chonset thilto-a chu Aaron'in kumkhat le saki chunga chu longlhenna khatvei abolding; akhang akhanga chu kumkhatna khatvei hiche chunga chu longlhenna abolding ahi: hichu Pakaiya dinga atheng chungnung ahi.
target: Once a year Aaron shall make atonement on its horns. This annual atonement must be made with the blood of the atoning sin offering for the generations to come. It is most holy to the Lord .”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: Then the Lord said to Moses,

source: Nangman Israel chate chu ajatnu hetna dinga aminu nasim tengle, nangman nasim tengu le alah uva hise aumlouna dinga; ajatnu nasim dungjuija amitakipmin amading cheh-a Pakai henga ahinna man dingu apeh cheh dingu ahi.
target: “When you take a census of the Israelites to count them, each one must pay the Lord a ransom for his life at the time he is counted. Then no plague will come on them when you number them.

source: Apeh dingu chu hichehi ahi, akisim sahho lah-a lutding jouse chun muntheng shekel dungjuija shekel kehkhat cheh apehdiu ahi: (shekel khat chu gerah somni ahi:) Shekel keh chu Pakaiya thilto hiding ahi.
target: Each one who crosses over to those already counted is to give a half shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs. This half shekel is an offering to the Lord .

source: Akisim saho lah-a lutding jouse, kum somni apat chunglang sechun Pakaiya dinga thilto apeh cheh dingu ahi.
target: All who cross over, those twenty years old or more, are to give an offering to the Lord .

source: Nahinna longlhenna dinga Pakai koma thilto abol tengule, ahaovin jong shekel kehval apehlou ding, chule avaijin jong shekel keh lhinglou apehlou ding ahi.
target: The rich are not to give more than a half shekel and the poor are not to give less when you make the offering to the Lord to atone for your lives.

source: Chule nangman Israelte longlhenna sum chu nalahding, hichu houkhomna houbuh natohna-a naman ding ahi; hichu nahinnao longlhenna bolna dinga, Pakai angsung Israel chatea dinga melchihna hiding ahi.
target: Receive the atonement money from the Israelites and use it for the service of the tent of meeting. It will be a memorial for the Israelites before the Lord , making atonement for your lives.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: Then the Lord said to Moses,

source: Nangman kisilnading sum-enga kisem, akeng jongchu sum-eng hiding, twidol khat nasem ding ahi: chule hichu houkhom ho houbuh le maicham kah-a nakoija, chule asunga twi nakoi ding ahi.
target: “Make a bronze basin, with its bronze stand, for washing. Place it between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it.

source: Ajehchu hichea chu Aaron le achapaten akhut akeng akisilngim ji dingu ahi:
target: Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and feet with water from it.

source: Amaho mipi houkhom na houbuh sunga alut tengule, ahiloule Pakaiya dinga meija kisem thilto hal dinga maichama ahung tengule; athilouna dinguva chu akhut akeng akisildiu ahi.
target: Whenever they enter the tent of meeting, they shall wash with water so that they will not die. Also, when they approach the altar to minister by presenting a food offering to the Lord ,

source: Hitia chu athi louna dinguva akhut akengu akisildiu: chule hichu akhang khanguva a-itih-a dinga ama le achate-a dinga tonsot chondan hijing ding ahitai.
target: they shall wash their hands and feet so that they will not die. This is to be a lasting ordinance for Aaron and his descendants for the generations to come.”

source: Chukalvalin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: Then the Lord said to Moses,

source: Nangman gimnamtui loupiho, myrrh thengtah-a kisem shekel janga, chule thingthal namtui tah-a kisem shekel jani leh somnga, chule kolchu lhum shekel jani le somnga jong,
target: “Take the following fine spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, half as much (that is, 250 shekels) of fragrant cinnamon, 250 shekels of fragrant calamus,

source: Chule munthenga shekel dungjuijin halnamtui shekel janga, chule olive thao hin khat nahenga lan.
target: 500 shekels of cassia—all according to the sanctuary shekel—and a hin of olive oil.

source: Chule nangman hicheho-a chu lou sem themho sem banga thaotheng nasem ding; hichu kinuding thao theng hiding ahi.
target: Make these into a sacred anointing oil, a fragrant blend, the work of a perfumer. It will be the sacred anointing oil.

source: Chule nangman hichea chu houkhom ho houbuh le hettohsahna thingkhong chu thao nanu ding ahi.
target: Then use it to anoint the tent of meeting, the ark of the covenant law,

source: Chule dokhang le akong le bel jouse, athaomei khomle avahna lhengho, chule gimnamtui halna maicham,
target: the table and all its articles, the lampstand and its accessories, the altar of incense,

source: Chule govam thiltona maicham le akong le bel jouse, chule sum-eng twidol le akhomjong hiche thao chu nanu ding ahi.
target: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand.

source: Chule theng chungnung ahina dinguva nangman nasuhtheng ding; chule hicheho atongkha jouse atheng hiding ahi.
target: You shall consecrate them so they will be most holy, and whatever touches them will be holy.

source: Chule amaho thempu mun'a kalhacha na atoh theina dinguva, Aaron le achapate jong chu thao nanu-a nasuh theng ding ahi.
target: “Anoint Aaron and his sons and consecrate them so they may serve me as priests.

source: Chule nangman Israel chate koma hitia naseiding ahi, Hichehi nakhang khanguva keima-a dinga kinu ding thao theng ahitai.
target: Say to the Israelites, ‘This is to be my sacred anointing oil for the generations to come.

source: Hichehi mihem tahsaphe chunga nasunlhah loudiu, ahiloule hitobanga kihal thao tobang hi adang jong nasemlou dingu ahi: atheng ahin, nangho-a dinga atheng hiding ahi.
target: Do not pour it on anyone else’s body and do not make any other oil using the same formula. It is sacred, and you are to consider it sacred.

source: Koi hijongle hiche tobanga kihal thao sema, ahiloule hetlou mi chunga sunglha-a aumleh, amachu amite lah-a kona kipaidoh ding ahi.
target: Whoever makes perfume like it and puts it on anyone other than a priest must be cut off from their people.’ ”

source: Chule Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, Nangman gimnamtui ho, thingnai, ngavun namtui, ankam namtui; hicheho tohin bego thengtah agih danu kibang chetnin lan.
target: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Take fragrant spices—gum resin, onycha and galbanum—and pure frankincense, all in equal amounts,

source: Chule nangman lou semhon phatah-a asem bangun, phatechan ngimsel le thengselin gimnamtui semin.
target: and make a fragrant blend of incense, the work of a perfumer. It is to be salted and pure and sacred.

source: Chule nangman phabep chu navoh bongselin lang, nangma kakimutopi nading mun, houkhom ho houbuh sunga hettohsahna masanga chun koijin: hichu nangma dinga theng chungnung hiding ahi.
target: Grind some of it to powder and place it in front of the ark of the covenant law in the tent of meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.

source: Chule hiche gimnamtui nasem banga chu, nangman nangma-a dinga hitobanga kihal gimnamtui nasem louding ahi: hichu nangma-a dinga Pakaiya atheng ahi.
target: Do not make any incense with this formula for yourselves; consider it holy to the Lord .

source: Koi hijongleh manchah dinga hitobang thao chu asema aumle, amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi.
target: Whoever makes incense like it to enjoy its fragrance must be cut off from their people.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: Then the Lord said to Moses,

source: Ven Keiman Judah phunga kon Uri chapa, Hur chapa, Bezalel chu aminin kakouve;
target: “See, I have chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,

source: Chule amachu chihna-in, hetna-in, lungthimin, chule tohna dan jouse-a Pathen lhagaova kadimsah-in,
target: and I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, with understanding, with knowledge and with all kinds of skills—

source: Khut them natoh ho hichu sana, dangka, chule sum-eng,
target: to make artistic designs for work in gold, silver and bronze,

source: Song tanboh le settoh, thingpeh vutoh, chule khut them natoh jouse tongdingin.
target: to cut and set stones, to work in wood, and to engage in all kinds of crafts.

source: Chule ven, Dan phunga kon Ahisamach chapa Aholiab chu ahenga kapetai. Chule keiman nangma kapeh thupeh jouse chu amahon aboltheina dingun miching jouse lungsunga chihna kakoipehtan ahi.
target: Moreover, I have appointed Oholiab son of Ahisamak, of the tribe of Dan, to help him. Also I have given ability to all the skilled workers to make everything I have commanded you:

source: Houkhom ho houbuh le hettohsahna thingkhong, chule hiche chunga um hepi touna le houbuh manchah jouse chu,
target: the tent of meeting, the ark of the covenant law with the atonement cover on it, and all the other furnishings of the tent—

source: Chule dokhang le amanchah jouse, thaomei khom tuna theng le amanchah jouse, chule gimnamtui halna maicham,
target: the table and its articles, the pure gold lampstand and all its accessories, the altar of incense,

source: Chule govam thiltona maicham le amanchah jouse, twidol le akeng,
target: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, the basin with its stand—

source: Lhacha natohna ponho, Aaron thempu von thengho, thempuho natohna mun'a akivondiu achate von,
target: and also the woven garments, both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when they serve as priests,

source: Chule nuding thao le munthenga dinga gimnamtui: hicheho jouse hi keiman thu kapeh jouse dungjuija amahon aboldingu ahi, ati.
target: and the anointing oil and fragrant incense for the Holy Place. They are to make them just as I commanded you.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: Then the Lord said to Moses,

source: Nangman Israel chate jah-a jong hitihin seijin, Tahbeh-a nanghon kacholngah nikhoho nanit dingu ahi: ajehchu nanghon keimahi nasutheng uva Pakai kahi ti nahettheina dinguva; hichu nakhangu lhumkeija keima le nangho kikah-a melchihna hiding ahi.
target: “Say to the Israelites, ‘You must observe my Sabbaths. This will be a sign between me and you for the generations to come, so you may know that I am the Lord , who makes you holy.

source: Hijeh-a chu nanghon Sabbath nanitdiu ahi; ajehchu hichu nangho dinga atheng ahi. Koi hijongleh asuboh chanchu kithat ding ahi: ajehchu chuche nikho-a natonga tapou chu, hiche hinna chu amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi.
target: “ ‘Observe the Sabbath, because it is holy to you. Anyone who desecrates it is to be put to death; those who do any work on that day must be cut off from their people.

source: Nigup sunga na natohdiu ahin, ni sagi ni vang chu choldo nadinga cholngahni, Pakaiya dinga atheng ahi: koi hijongle cholngah nikho-a natoh kiti tapou tonga chu thatei ding ahi.
target: For six days work is to be done, but the seventh day is a day of sabbath rest, holy to the Lord . Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day is to be put to death.

source: Hijeh-a chu Israel chaten kumkho-a kitepna hidinga akhang khanguva cholngah nikho chu anit theina dinguva, cholngahni chu anit dingu ahi.
target: The Israelites are to observe the Sabbath, celebrating it for the generations to come as a lasting covenant.

source: Hichu a-itih-a dinga keima le Israelte kikah-a melchihna hiding ahi: ajehchu nigup sungin Pakaiyin van le lei asemin, chule nisagi nin akicholdon, akitha-olin ahi.
target: It will be a sign between me and the Israelites forever, for in six days the Lord made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day he rested and was refreshed.’ ”

source: Chuin Sinai molsang chunga akihoupi jou phatchun, aman Mosi henga hettohsahna songpheng ni, Pathen khutna kisun songpheng chu apetan ahi.
target: When the Lord finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two tablets of the covenant law, the tablets of stone inscribed by the finger of God.

source: Chuin mipi chun Mosi molsanga kona ahung kumlhah vahlou amu phatnun, mipi chu Aaron koma ahung kikhom khomun, ahenga, Kipatdoh-in, keiho masanga che dingin pathenho neisem peh-un: ajehchu Egypt gama kona eihin puidoh uva hiche Mosi hi iti hitam kahe tapouve, atiuvin ahi.
target: When the people saw that Moses was so long in coming down from the mountain, they gathered around Aaron and said, “Come, make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who brought us up out of Egypt, we don’t know what has happened to him.”

source: Chuin Aaron'in amaho jah-a, Nanghon na inneipi teo, nachapa teo, nachanu teo sana bilba chu abonchan ladoh-un lang, hicheho chu kahenga hinchoijun, ati.
target: Aaron answered them, “Take off the gold earrings that your wives, your sons and your daughters are wearing, and bring them to me.”

source: Chuin mipi jouse chun abiluva um sana bilba jouse chu aladoh-un, Aaron henga ahinchoi taove.
target: So all the people took off their earrings and brought them to Aaron.

source: Chuin aman amaho khutna konchun hicheho chu alan, asemna manchah mangin asemin, bongnou lim khat asemin ahi. Chuin amahon, Vo Israel, hichehi Egypt gama kona nahin puidoh uva na pathen hou chu hihen ati.
target: He took what they handed him and made it into an idol cast in the shape of a calf, fashioning it with a tool. Then they said, “These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt.”

source: Chuin Aaron'in hichu amuphatnin, amasanga maicham khat asemin; chule Aaron'in, Jing nikho khu Pakaiya dinga kut ahi, tin aphongdoh tan ahi.
target: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar in front of the calf and announced, “Tomorrow there will be a festival to the Lord .”

source: Chuin amaho ajingin matah-in athoudoh-un, govam thilto atoh-un, chule chamna thilto ahinchoijun; chuin mipi ho chu adon dingle ane dingin atouvun, chule alam dingin akipat doh-un ahi.
target: So the next day the people rose early and sacrificed burnt offerings and presented fellowship offerings. Afterward they sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in revelry.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Chen, kumlhan: ajehchu Egypt gama kona nahin puidoh namite khu akisuboh gam taovin ahi.
target: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Go down, because your people, whom you brought up out of Egypt, have become corrupt.

source: Amaho gangtah-in keiman kathupeh-a konchun lamchom beh-a akihei taovin: amahon bongnou kilhajol asemun, hichu ahouvun, chule ahenga kilhaina abolun, Vo Israel, hichehi Egypt gama kona nahin puidoh uva na pathen hou chu hihen atiuvin ahi, ati.
target: They have been quick to turn away from what I commanded them and have made themselves an idol cast in the shape of a calf. They have bowed down to it and sacrificed to it and have said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt.’

source: Chule Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Hiche miho hi ken kamutan, chule ven, amaho hi milouchal tah te ahiuve.
target: “I have seen these people,” the Lord said to Moses, “and they are a stiff-necked people.

source: Hijeh chun tun achunguva kalunghan na asoudoh-a, amaho kasuh manghel nadingin, keima neichang lhan: chule keiman nanga kona nam lentah khat kasem ding ahi, ati.
target: Now leave me alone so that my anger may burn against them and that I may destroy them. Then I will make you into a great nation.”

source: Chuin Mosi Pakai a-Pathen henga ataovin, Pakai, thilboltheina nasatah le khut thahat tah-a Egypt gama kona nahin puidoh namite chunga ibola nalunghanna soudoh jenga ham?
target: But Moses sought the favor of the Lord his God. “ Lord ,” he said, “why should your anger burn against your people, whom you brought out of Egypt with great power and a mighty hand?

source: Ipi dinga Egypt miten, Molsang ho-a thagam dingle, leiset chunga kona suhmang dinga aman dihlou tah-a amaho khu apuidoh ahi, ati dingu ham? Nalunghan na nasatah-a konin kile heijinlang, namite douna-a thil gilou na ngaitona-a konhin nalung hinheijin.
target: Why should the Egyptians say, ‘It was with evil intent that he brought them out, to kill them in the mountains and to wipe them off the face of the earth’? Turn from your fierce anger; relent and do not bring disaster on your people.

source: Chule keiman nachilhah kapunsah-a, van'a ahsijat kaphahsah ding, chule keiman kasei hiche gam jouse hi nachilhahte kapeh ding, amahon atonsotna alo dingu ahi tia Abraham, Isaac, chule Jacob henga nangma le nangma nana kihahsela nasei chu geldoh-in, ati.
target: Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac and Israel, to whom you swore by your own self: ‘I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and I will give your descendants all this land I promised them, and it will be their inheritance forever.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin amite chunga thilphalou bol ding angaitona-a konin alung aheitan ahi.
target: Then the Lord relented and did not bring on his people the disaster he had threatened.

source: Chuin Mosi akiheijin, molsanga konchun achesuh-in, hettohsahna songpheng teni chu akhutna achoijin ahi. Songpheng chu ani lang to-a kisun ahin; langkhat le akileh lang panga chu akisuna ahi.
target: Moses turned and went down the mountain with the two tablets of the covenant law in his hands. They were inscribed on both sides, front and back.

source: Chule songpheng chu Pathen khutsoh ahin, akisun chu Pathen khutsut, songpheng chunga chu kisuna ahi.
target: The tablets were the work of God; the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.

source: Chuin Joshua'n mipi awgin thong chu ajah phatnin, Mosi jah-a, Gebuh-a gal husa aume, ati.
target: When Joshua heard the noise of the people shouting, he said to Moses, “There is the sound of war in the camp.”

source: Ahin aman, Galjona-a kisam awgin ahipon, chule gal lelna-a kisam awgin jong ahipoi, amavang keiman kajah hi la kisa awgin ahi, ati.
target: Moses replied: “It is not the sound of victory, it is not the sound of defeat; it is the sound of singing that I hear.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, ama gebuh ahungnai phatnin, bongnou lim kisem le alamu chu amutai. Chuin Mosi alunghana asoudoh tan, akhutna songpheng ni chu aseplhan, chule mol bula chun asukehtan ahi.
target: When Moses approached the camp and saw the calf and the dancing, his anger burned and he threw the tablets out of his hands, breaking them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.

source: Chuin aman asemu bongnou lim chu alan, meija agouvin, chule asubong selin, twi chunga athen, Israel chate chu adonsah-in ahi.
target: And he took the calf the people had made and burned it in the fire; then he ground it to powder, scattered it on the water and made the Israelites drink it.

source: Chuin Mosi'n Aaron jah-a, Mipi hohin nachunga ipi aboluva, nangman hitobang chonset nasatah hi achunguva nalhunsah ham? ati.
target: He said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you led them into such great sin?”

source: Chuin Aaron'in, Ka pakai lunghanna hi soudoh hih hen: nangman hiche mite hi thilphalou bolnom mi ahiu nahen ahi.
target: “Do not be angry, my lord,” Aaron answered. “You know how prone these people are to evil.

source: Ajehchu amahon kahenga, Keiho masanga che dingin pathenho neisem peh-un: ajehchu Egypt gama kona eihin puidoh uva hiche Mosi hi iti hitam kihe tapouve, atiu ahi.
target: They said to me, ‘Make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who brought us up out of Egypt, we don’t know what has happened to him.’

source: Hichun keiman amaho koma, Koi hijongle sana neijousen hinsut lhaohen, kati. Hitichun amahon keima eipeovin: chule keiman hichu meija kalelut le hiche bongnou hi hungsoh doh-a ahi, ati.
target: So I told them, ‘Whoever has any gold jewelry, take it off.’ Then they gave me the gold, and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf!”

source: Chuin Mosi'n mipi ho chu sagoh keuva aumu amu phatnin; (ajehchu Aaron'in amaho chu agalmite lah-a ajachat na dinguva von beija akoi ahi.)
target: Moses saw that the people were running wild and that Aaron had let them get out of control and so become a laughingstock to their enemies.

source: Hichun Mosi gebuh kotpi phunga adingin, Pakai lama panga umem? amaho chu kahenga hunghen, ati. Chuin Levi chapate jouse chu ahenga akikhom khom taovin ahi.
target: So he stood at the entrance to the camp and said, “Whoever is for the Lord , come to me.” And all the Levites rallied to him.

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Israel Pakai Pathen'in hitin ati, Amitakipmin apanga chemjam kikocheh henlang, gebuh sung jouse-a kotpi khatna konin kotpi khatna lutle potleu hen, chule amitakipmin asopi, amitakipmin akivop piho, chule amitakipmin aheng akom that hen, tin aseije, ati.
target: Then he said to them, “This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘Each man strap a sword to his side. Go back and forth through the camp from one end to the other, each killing his brother and friend and neighbor.’ ”

source: Chuin Levi chapate chun Mosi thu seibangin abol taovin: hiche nikho-a chun mi sangthum tobang athin ahi.
target: The Levites did as Moses commanded, and that day about three thousand of the people died.

source: Hitichun Mosi'n, Tunia hi aman nangho phatthei naboh theina dingun, tunikho hin nangho amitakip achapa chungle asopipa chunga Pakaiya dingin kithensouvin ati.
target: Then Moses said, “You have been set apart to the Lord today, for you were against your own sons and brothers, and he has blessed you this day.”

source: Chuin ajingin ahitin ahi, Mosi'n mipi ho jah-a chun, Nangho nasatah-in nachonse taove: chule tu-a hi keima Pakai henga kache touva; ahitheile nachonset nao longlhenna kagabol ding ahi, ati.
target: The next day Moses said to the people, “You have committed a great sin. But now I will go up to the Lord ; perhaps I can make atonement for your sin.”

source: Chuin Mosi Pakai henglama ahung kilen, ahenga, Ohe, hiche miho hin chonset nasatah abol taovin, chule sana-in bongnou pathenho akisem taove.
target: So Moses went back to the Lord and said, “Oh, what a great sin these people have committed! They have made themselves gods of gold.

source: Hijongle tun, nangman achonsetnao nangaidam dinga ahile -; chule nangaidam louding ahile, katao ahi, nangman nasutsa lekhabua konin kamin ladohtan, ati.
target: But now, please forgive their sin—but if not, then blot me out of the book you have written.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Koi hijongle keima douna-a chonse chan chu, kalekhabua kona kalahdoh ding ahi.
target: The Lord replied to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me I will blot out of my book.

source: Hijeh chun tun chen, mipi ho chu keiman nahenga kaseipehna mun'a chun puitan: ven, kavantil namasanga cheding ahi: hijeng jongle keiman kavil nikho leh achunguva chonset naho chu kavil ding ahi, ati.
target: Now go, lead the people to the place I spoke of, and my angel will go before you. However, when the time comes for me to punish, I will punish them for their sin.”

source: Chuin Aaron'in asempeh-u bongnou chunga athilbol jeh-u chun, Pakaiyin mipi ho chu hise-in agot tan ahi.
target: And the Lord struck the people with a plague because of what they did with the calf Aaron had made.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Kipatdoh-in, keiman Abraham, Isaac, chule Jacob henga kana kihahsela, Keiman nachilhahte kapeh ding ahi, tia kaseina gama chun, nangma le Egypt gama kona nahin puidoh mipi ho chu hikoma konhin chetou taovin.
target: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Leave this place, you and the people you brought up out of Egypt, and go up to the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’

source: Chule keiman namasanguva vantil kasolding; chule keiman Canaan mite, Amor mite, Hit mite, Perizz mite, Hiv mite, chule Jebus mite chu kadeldoh ding ahi.
target: I will send an angel before you and drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.

source: Khoiju le bongnoi lona gama chun chetouvun; keiman nalah uva nangho to kachetou louding ahi; ajehchu nangho milouchal tahte nahiu ahi: achuti loule lampia sumangpa getnung kate, ati.
target: Go up to the land flowing with milk and honey. But I will not go with you, because you are a stiff-necked people and I might destroy you on the way.”

source: Chule mipi chun hitobang thugilou ajah phatnun, amaho alunghemun; koimacha akijema aum tapouvin ahi.
target: When the people heard these distressing words, they began to mourn and no one put on any ornaments.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Israel chateho koma hitihin seijin, Nangho milouchal te nahiuve: chomlouva nalahtah uva kahungtouva, kasuhmang ding nahiuve. Hijeh chun tun nachung uva ipi kabolding kahet theina dingin, nakijepnao jouse chu nangho-a konin sutlhaovin, ati ahi.
target: For the Lord had said to Moses, “Tell the Israelites, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go with you even for a moment, I might destroy you. Now take off your ornaments and I will decide what to do with you.’ ”

source: Chuin Israel chate ho chun Horeb molsanga chun akijepnao jouseu asutlhagam taovin ahi.
target: So the Israelites stripped off their ornaments at Mount Horeb.

source: Chuin Mosi'n houbuh chu alan, gebuh pam lam gebuh-a kona gam latah in asongin; hichu houkhom ho houbuh tin aminvo tan ahi. Chuin ahung hitin ahi, amitakip Pakai holchan chu gebuh pama um houkhom ho houbuh-a chun acheuvin ahi.
target: Now Moses used to take a tent and pitch it outside the camp some distance away, calling it the “tent of meeting.” Anyone inquiring of the Lord would go to the tent of meeting outside the camp.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Mosi houbuh-a dinga ahungdoh chun, mipi chu akipat doh-un, amitakip amaho gena ponbuh kotbul cheh-a adingun, Mosi chu houbuh-a alutkahsen avetaovin ahi.
target: And whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people rose and stood at the entrances to their tents, watching Moses until he entered the tent.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Mosi houbuh-a alut tolhonin, meilom khompi khat ahung kumlhan, houbuh kotphunga chun ading denin; chuin Pakai chu Mosi to akihoulim lhontan ahi.
target: As Moses went into the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down and stay at the entrance, while the Lord spoke with Moses.

source: Chule mipi chun houbuh kotphunga meilom khompi akitun chu amuvin ahi. Chuin mijouse akipat doh-un, amaho ponbuh kotpi cheh-a konchun Pakai chu ahou taovin ahi.
target: Whenever the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance to the tent, they all stood and worshiped, each at the entrance to their tent.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi chu mikhatnin agolpa akihoupi bangin kimaiton akihoupin ahi. Chuin ama gebuh mun lama chun ahungtai: ahinla asohpa Nun chapa Joshua, golhangpa vang chu houbuh-a konin ahung doh tapon ahi.
target: The Lord would speak to Moses face to face, as one speaks to a friend. Then Moses would return to the camp, but his young aide Joshua son of Nun did not leave the tent.

source: Chuin Mosi'n Pakai henga, Ven nangman kahenga, Hiche mipi ho hinpui touvin natin, chule kakilhonpi dinga koi neisolpeh got ham neihetsah pon; ahinla nangman, Keiman nangma naminin kahei, chule kamitmu-a lungsetna nachange, natin ahi.
target: Moses said to the Lord , “You have been telling me, ‘Lead these people,’ but you have not let me know whom you will send with me. You have said, ‘I know you by name and you have found favor with me.’

source: Hijeh chun tun katao ahi, namitmu-a lungsetna kachana ahile, nangma kahetna ding le nangma mitmu-a lungsetna kachan nadingin nalampi neihilin; chule hiche nam mite hi namite ahi tin gelin, ati.
target: If you are pleased with me, teach me your ways so I may know you and continue to find favor with you. Remember that this nation is your people.”

source: Chuin aman, kaumpinan nalhonpiu vintin, chule cholngahna kapeh ding nahiuve, ati.
target: The Lord replied, “My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”

source: Chuin aman ajah-a aseijin, Na-umpinan eilhonpi louleh hia konhin neipuitou datao vin.
target: Then Moses said to him, “If your Presence does not go with us, do not send us up from here.

source: Ajehchu nangman neilhonpi lou uva ahile keima le namitehin namitmu-a lungsetna kachang-uve tihi iti kahetthei ding ham? Chutile keiho, keima le namite hi leiset chunga um miho-a kona sepkhena kaum dingu ahi, ati.
target: How will anyone know that you are pleased with me and with your people unless you go with us? What else will distinguish me and your people from all the other people on the face of the earth?”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Nangman nasei thilho jonghi kabol ding ahi: ajehchu kamitmun lungsetna nachangin, chule keiman nangma naminin kahen ahi, ati.
target: And the Lord said to Moses, “I will do the very thing you have asked, because I am pleased with you and I know you by name.”

source: Chule aman, Nahenga katao ahi, naloupi na chu neimusah-in, ati.
target: Then Moses said, “Now show me your glory.”

source: Chuin aman, Keiman kaphatna jouse namasanga kichesah ding, na-angsunga Pakai minchu kaphonjal ding ahi. Chule keiman kalungset ding chu kalungsetna, chule hepina kamusah ding pa chu hepina kamusah ding ahi, ati.
target: And the Lord said, “I will cause all my goodness to pass in front of you, and I will proclaim my name, the Lord , in your presence. I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.

source: Chuin aman, Nangman kamai namuthei louding ahi: ajehchu eimu-a chu koima ahinga umlou ding ahi, ati.
target: But,” he said, “you cannot see my face, for no one may see me and live.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin, Ven, kakoma mun khat aume, chule nangma songpi chunga nadin ding ahi.
target: Then the Lord said, “There is a place near me where you may stand on a rock.

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, kaloupinan nahin jotpa tengle, nangma songpi khikeh kah khatna kakoiding, nangma kapal galkai kahse-a kakhutna kakhuding:
target: When my glory passes by, I will put you in a cleft in the rock and cover you with my hand until I have passed by.

source: Chule keiman kakhut kalah doh-a, nangman kanunglam namu ding ahi: kamai vang namu louding ahi, ati.
target: Then I will remove my hand and you will see my back; but my face must not be seen.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Nangman amasa bang bang chun songpheng ni khengin; chule nangman nasuhchip songpheng chunga kisun thu tobang bang chu hiche songpheng teni chunga chu kasut ding ahi.
target: The Lord said to Moses, “Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones, and I will write on them the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

source: Chuleh jingkah leh kigonlang Sinai molsanga hungin, chule molsang vuma khun kakoma hung kilah-in.
target: Be ready in the morning, and then come up on Mount Sinai. Present yourself to me there on top of the mountain.

source: Chule koimacha nangma toh hunglhon tou louding, chule molsang pumpi-a jong koimacha kimulou ding; chule kelngoi hon ho le ganchahon jong hiche molsang panga chu an nanehsah lou dingu ahi, ati.
target: No one is to come with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain; not even the flocks and herds may graze in front of the mountain.”

source: Chuin aman amasa bangin songpheng ni akhengin ahi. Chuin Mosi jingpitah-in athouvin, Pakaiyin athupeh bangin Sinai molsanga chun akaltouvin, songpheng ni chu akhutna achoijin ahi.
target: So Moses chiseled out two stone tablets like the first ones and went up Mount Sinai early in the morning, as the Lord had commanded him; and he carried the two stone tablets in his hands.

source: Chuin Pakai chu meibol lah-a ahung kumlhah, amatoh chua ading khomin, chule Pakai minchu aphongjal tan ahi.
target: Then the Lord came down in the cloud and stood there with him and proclaimed his name, the Lord .

source: Chuin Pakaiyin amasang ahin jotpan, Pakai, Pakai Pathen, lungset le hepina-a dim, chule phatna le thutah-a bulhingset,
target: And he passed in front of Moses, proclaiming, “The Lord , the Lord , the compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness,

source: Sang tamtah chunga hepina nei, khangilouna, suhkhelna le chonsete ngaidam, themona mohseh-a subeilou; pate khangit louna chate chung le achate chateho chunga khangthum khangli changeija viljing, tin aphongjalin ahi.
target: maintaining love to thousands, and forgiving wickedness, rebellion and sin. Yet he does not leave the guilty unpunished; he punishes the children and their children for the sin of the parents to the third and fourth generation.”

source: Chuin Mosi mangang tah-in tollah akunin, ama chu ahoutan ahi.
target: Moses bowed to the ground at once and worshiped.

source: Chuin aman, Vo Pakai, tu-a hi namitmu-a lungsetna kachana ahile, nahenga katao ahi, ka pakai chu keihotoh lhonkhom hen; ajehchu milouchal tahte ahiuve; chule kakhangit lounao le kachonsetnao ngaidamin lang, nagou lodin neilaovin, ati.
target: “Lord,” he said, “if I have found favor in your eyes, then let the Lord go with us. Although this is a stiff-necked people, forgive our wickedness and our sin, and take us as your inheritance.”

source: Chuin aman, Ven, keiman kitepna kaseme: keima namite jouse masanga leiset chung jouse-a koima nam lah-a jong ana kibol khalou thil kidang kabol ding: chule naumna namite jousen Pakai natoh chu amudingu ahi. Ajehchu nangtoh katoh ding chu tijat umtah thil hiding ahi.
target: Then the Lord said: “I am making a covenant with you. Before all your people I will do wonders never before done in any nation in all the world. The people you live among will see how awesome is the work that I, the Lord , will do for you.

source: Tunia nahenga kathupeh hi nitnin: ven, keiman Amor mite, Canaan mite, Hit mite, Perizz mite, Hiv mite chule Jebus mite chu nangho masanga kadelmang ding ahi.
target: Obey what I command you today. I will drive out before you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.

source: Kichih theijin, achutiloule nachena gama miho toh kitepna semun natin, ajole hichu nalah uva thang hung hikha ding ahi.
target: Be careful not to make a treaty with those who live in the land where you are going, or they will be a snare among you.

source: Amavang nanghon amaichamu nasuh mangdiu, amilim hou navoh bohdiu, chule adoikhom hou chu naphuh lhuh diu ahi.
target: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones and cut down their Asherah poles.

source: Chule pathen dangho nahou loudiu ahi: ajehchu Pakai amin thangthip kitipa chu, thangthip Pathen ahi:
target: Do not worship any other god, for the Lord , whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.

source: Achuti loule agama cheng hotoh kitepna neijin natin, amahon a-pathenhou toh jonthanhoi aboluva, a-pathenhou henga ganlhaina aboldingu, chule khat touvin nahin kou-a, aganlhaina sachu naganeh khah dingu;
target: “Be careful not to make a treaty with those who live in the land; for when they prostitute themselves to their gods and sacrifice to them, they will invite you and you will eat their sacrifices.

source: Chule nangman nachapate dinga achanu teo nalah-a, chule achanuteu chu a-pathenhou henga jonthanhoi boldinga chediu, chuteng nachapateo jong a-pathenhou henga ajonthanhoi sah dingu ahi.
target: And when you choose some of their daughters as wives for your sons and those daughters prostitute themselves to their gods, they will lead your sons to do the same.

source: Nangho-a dinga semthu pathen nakisem lou dingu ahi.
target: “Do not make any idols.

source: Nanghon cholsolou changlhah kut nabol jing dingu ahi. Abib lha phat sunga keiman kathupeh dungjuija, nisagi cholsolou changlhah naneh dingu ahi: ajehchu nangho Egypt gama kona Abib lha-a nahung doh-u ahi.
target: “Celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread. For seven days eat bread made without yeast, as I commanded you. Do this at the appointed time in the month of Aviv, for in that month you came out of Egypt.

source: Naobu hinphukeh tapou chu keija ahin; chule gancha lah-a apeng masapen jouse, bong hihen, kelngoi hijongleh achal jouse chu keija ahi.
target: “The first offspring of every womb belongs to me, including all the firstborn males of your livestock, whether from herd or flock.

source: Ahivangin sangan apeng masapen jouse chu kelngoija nalhatdoh dingu ahi: ijemtia nalhatdoh lou dinga ahileh, angong naheboh dingu ahi. Nachateo asoh masa jouse chu nalhatdoh dingu ahi. Chule koimacha akhutgoh-a ka-angsunga kilah louding ahi.
target: Redeem the firstborn donkey with a lamb, but if you do not redeem it, break its neck. Redeem all your firstborn sons. “No one is to appear before me empty-handed.

source: Nigup sunga na natoh ding ahin, amavang nisagi chan nileh nacholdo ding: loukai laile chang-at laija jong nacholdo dingu ahi.
target: “Six days you shall labor, but on the seventh day you shall rest; even during the plowing season and harvest you must rest.

source: Chule nanghon suhlou chang gamasapen ahunglhun tengle hapta kut nanit dingu, chule kum kichai tengle lhoga khoptup kut nanit dingu ahi.
target: “Celebrate the Festival of Weeks with the firstfruits of the wheat harvest, and the Festival of Ingathering at the turn of the year.

source: Nachapateo jouse chu kumkhat sunga thumvei Pakai Pathen, Israel Pathen masanga hungkilah chehdiu ahi.
target: Three times a year all your men are to appear before the Sovereign Lord , the God of Israel.

source: Ajehchu namasanga kona namtinho chu kadeldoh ding, nagamgiho kakehlet ding ahi. Chuche kumkhat sunga Pakai na-Pathen angsunga kilah dinga thumvei nachetou kah-a chu, koimachan jong nagam avetlel louding ahi.
target: I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your territory, and no one will covet your land when you go up three times each year to appear before the Lord your God.

source: Nangman keima dinga ganlhaina kibol thisan chu chol toh natotha louhel ding; chule kalchuh kut ganlhaina ho jong chu jingkah geija nakoi louding ahi.
target: “Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to me along with anything containing yeast, and do not let any of the sacrifice from the Passover Festival remain until morning.

source: Nagam ga masaho lah-a aga masapen chu Pakai na-Pathen in'a nahinchoi ding ahi. Nangman kelnou sa chu api noitwija nahonlou ding ahi, ati.
target: “Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the Lord your God. “Do not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Nangman hiche thuho hi sunin: ajehchu hiche thuho banga hi nangma le Israelte toh kitepna kasem ahi, ati.
target: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Write down these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”

source: Chuin ama chua chun Pakai toh nisomli le jan somli aumin; aman changlhah jong anepon twi jong adonpon ahi. Chule aman songpheng chunga chun kitepna thu, thupeh som chu asuntan ahi.
target: Moses was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking water. And he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant—the Ten Commandments.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Mosi Sinai molsang kona kitepna songpheng teni akhutna ahinchoija ahungsuh phatnin, molsang chunga kona ahung kumsuh chun, amatoh akihoupetna amai vah chu Mosi'n ahepon ahi.
target: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant law in his hands, he was not aware that his face was radiant because he had spoken with the Lord .

source: Chuin Aaron le Israel chate jousen Mosi amuphatnuvin, veuvin, amaiso chu avah-in, amahon ama kom naiding akichauvin ahi.
target: When Aaron and all the Israelites saw Moses, his face was radiant, and they were afraid to come near him.

source: Chuin Mosi'n amaho akouvin ahile, Aaron le mipi kikhomho lah-a lamkaiho jouse chu ahenga ahung kinungleu vin; Mosi'n amaho akihoupitan ahi.
target: But Moses called to them; so Aaron and all the leaders of the community came back to him, and he spoke to them.

source: Chuchejouvin Israel chate jouse chu ahung naijun: chuin aman Sinai molsanga Pakaiyin asei jouse chu amaho koma thupeh-in apetan ahi.
target: Afterward all the Israelites came near him, and he gave them all the commands the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.

source: Chule Mosi'n athusei ajo kahsen, amai chu maikhu akhun ahi.
target: When Moses finished speaking to them, he put a veil over his face.

source: Ahivangin Mosi Pakai kihoupi dinga a-angsunga achelut tengle ahungdoh kit kahsen amai ahohdohjin ahi. Chule ahungdohjin ama thu kipe chu Israel chate aseipeh jin ahi.
target: But whenever he entered the Lord ’s presence to speak with him, he removed the veil until he came out. And when he came out and told the Israelites what he had been commanded,

source: Chule Israel chate chun Mosi maiso chu amu phat uvin, Mosi maiso chu avah-in ahi: chuin Mosi amatoh kihou dinga alutkit kahsen, amaija maikhu akhukit tan ahi.
target: they saw that his face was radiant. Then Moses would put the veil back over his face until he went in to speak with the Lord .

source: Chuin Mosi'n Israel chate houkhom ho jouse akoukhomin, ajah uva, Nanghon nabol dinguva Pakaiyin nathupeh-u thuho chu hicheho hi ahi.
target: Moses assembled the whole Israelite community and said to them, “These are the things the Lord has commanded you to do:

source: Nigup sunga na natoh dingu ahin, ni sagini vang chu nangho dinga nitheng ni hiding, Pakai dinga kicholdona cholngahna ni hiding ahi. Chuche ni-a natong chanchu thading ahi.
target: For six days, work is to be done, but the seventh day shall be your holy day, a day of sabbath rest to the Lord . Whoever does any work on it is to be put to death.

source: Nangho nachennao gam pumpiuva cholngahni le mei nati louhel dingu ahi.
target: Do not light a fire in any of your dwellings on the Sabbath day.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Israel chate mipi houkhom ho jouse jah-a hitin ati, Hichehi Pakai thupeh ahi,
target: Moses said to the whole Israelite community, “This is what the Lord has commanded:

source: Nanghon nalah uva konin Pakai henga toding thilpeh khat choicheh-un: koi hijongleh alungsunga penom channin Pakai henga thilpeh hinchoi hen; sana, dangka, sum-eng,
target: From what you have, take an offering for the Lord . Everyone who is willing is to bring to the Lord an offering of gold, silver and bronze;

source: Pon dum, ponsandup, ponsanthip, ponnem, chule kelmul,
target: blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen; goat hair;

source: Kelngoichal vun kidesan, satuilut vun, chule thinggi thing,
target: ram skins dyed red and another type of durable leather; acacia wood;

source: Vahding thaotwi, nuding thao namtui, chule gimnamtui,
target: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;

source: Khisonggel ho, boitong sangkhol le ompho-a behding songho.
target: and onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.

source: Chule nalah uva mi lungching chengse hunguntin, chule Pakai thupeh jouse hi aboldingu ahi.
target: “All who are skilled among you are to come and make everything the Lord has commanded:

source: Houbuh le achungkhu chule athingpehho, abanggol ho, akhom ho, achechah naho,
target: the tabernacle with its tent and its covering, clasps, frames, crossbars, posts and bases;

source: Thingkhong, mol lhon ho, hepi tounamun, chule achung khuna pon,
target: the ark with its poles and the atonement cover and the curtain that shields it;

source: Dokhang le mol lhon ho, akong ho jouse, chule vetsahna changlhah,
target: the table with its poles and all its articles and the bread of the Presence;

source: Avah dinga khoilu thaomei jong, athil le lo, athaomeiho, vahding thaotwi ho toh,
target: the lampstand that is for light with its accessories, lamps and oil for the light;

source: Chule gimnamtui halna maicham mol lhonho, akinu ding thao, gimnamtui ho, chule houbuh lutna kotna kikhai ding pondal,
target: the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil and the fragrant incense; the curtain for the doorway at the entrance to the tabernacle;

source: Govam thiltona maicham, asum-eng ho, amol lhon ho, chule aum le abelho jouse le twiluina kong le akeng,
target: the altar of burnt offering with its bronze grating, its poles and all its utensils; the bronze basin with its stand;

source: Ahong sunga pondal kikhainaho le, akhomho akibutona ho, ahong kotpi pondal ho,
target: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases, and the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard;

source: Houbuh kilnaho, ahong kilna, chule akhaoho,
target: the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the courtyard, and their ropes;

source: Munthenga kinbolna ding, kinbolna ponho, thempu dinga vontheng ho le achapate vonho, thempu natohna mun'a kinbol nading, tin aseijin ahi.
target: the woven garments worn for ministering in the sanctuary—both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when they serve as priests.”

source: Chule Israel chate houkhom ho jouse chu Mosi angsunga konin apotdoh taove.
target: Then the whole Israelite community withdrew from Moses’ presence,

source: Chule alung kisuhthou le alhagaovin peh nomna apehchu ahungun, akinbolna ngaicha ding jouse le von thengho jouse din, mipi houkhom ho houbuh natohna-a Pakaiya thilto chu ahinchoijun ahi.
target: and everyone who was willing and whose heart moved them came and brought an offering to the Lord for the work on the tent of meeting, for all its service, and for the sacred garments.

source: Chuin pasal ahin numei ahin alungsunga peh nomna nei jouse ahunguvin, chaojangho, bilbaho, khutjemho, khiho, chule sana kijepnaho jouse chu ahinchoijun: thilpeh pejouse chun Pakai henga thilto dingin sana atoh uvin ahi.
target: All who were willing, men and women alike, came and brought gold jewelry of all kinds: brooches, earrings, rings and ornaments. They all presented their gold as a wave offering to the Lord .

source: Chuin amijouse chun, koihile pon dum, ponsandup, ponsanthip, tupat ponnem, kelchavun, kelngoichal vun san theng, satuilut vunho neijousen ahin choijun ahi.
target: Everyone who had blue, purple or scarlet yarn or fine linen, or goat hair, ram skins dyed red or the other durable leather brought them.

source: Amitakip dangka le sum-eng thilto pechan chun Pakaiya thilpeh ahin choijun: chule amitakip thinggi thing neijouse chun lhacha kinbolna din ahin choijun ahi.
target: Those presenting an offering of silver or bronze brought it as an offering to the Lord , and everyone who had acacia wood for any part of the work brought it.

source: Chule numei lungching jouse chun akhutnuva akheh-un pon dum, ponsandup, ponsanthip, tupat ponnem hochu ahin choijun ahi.
target: Every skilled woman spun with her hands and brought what she had spun—blue, purple or scarlet yarn or fine linen.

source: Chule chihna-a alungthimu kisuthou numei ho chun kelcha mul akheh-un ahi.
target: And all the women who were willing and had the skill spun the goat hair.

source: Chule vaipoho chun khi songgel hole songdang dangho chu boitong sangkhol le ompho-a beh dingin ahin choijun;
target: The leaders brought onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.

source: Lou namtui, vah-a ding thao, kinuding thao, chule gimnamtuija ding ahin choijun ahi.
target: They also brought spices and olive oil for the light and for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense.

source: Israel chaten Pakai henga lungcham thilto hochu ahinchoijun; numei ahin pasal ahin, alungin peh nomna aneisah jouse chun Pakaiyin Mosi khutna boldinga athupeh jouse bolna dingin ahin choijun ahi.
target: All the Israelite men and women who were willing brought to the Lord freewill offerings for all the work the Lord through Moses had commanded them to do.

source: Chuin Mosi'n Israel chate koma, Veuvin, Pakaiyin Judah phunga, Hur chapa, Uri chapa Belzalel aminin akouvin;
target: Then Moses said to the Israelites, “See, the Lord has chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,

source: Chuin aman amachu chihna-in, hethemna-in, lungthim themna-in, chule natoh dan jouse-a dingin Pathen lhagaovin adimsah-in;
target: and he has filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, with understanding, with knowledge and with all kinds of skills—

source: Sana, dangka, chule sum-eng natoh kidangho gongtoh dingin,
target: to make artistic designs for work in gold, silver and bronze,

source: Chule songho at-tan dingdan, asettoh dingdan, thing-at dan, chule khutthem natoh jouse-a dingin Pathen lhagaovin adipmin ahi.
target: to cut and set stones, to work in wood and to engage in all kinds of artistic crafts.

source: Aman ama le Dan phungmi Ahisamach chapa Aholiab chu mihil thei ahilhona dingin alungsung lhona chihna akhumpeh tan ahi.
target: And he has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamak, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach others.

source: Aman amanichu natohna jouse tohtheina, khutthem nale natoh themnalna, thil jih themna, pon dum, ponsandup, ponsanthip chule tupat ponnem jepthemna, ponkhom themna, mihemin abolthei jouse boltheina le, khutthem jouse thepna-in alungsunghon chihnan adipmin ahi, ati.
target: He has filled them with skill to do all kinds of work as engravers, designers, embroiderers in blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen, and weavers—all of them skilled workers and designers.

source: Hichun Pakaiyin athupeh dungjuijin, Pakaiyin muntheng natohna-a natoh dingdan jouse hetthemna dinga chihna le hetna apeh miching jouse, chule Belzalel le Aholiab'in natoh chu apan taovin ahi.
target: So Bezalel, Oholiab and every skilled person to whom the Lord has given skill and ability to know how to carry out all the work of constructing the sanctuary are to do the work just as the Lord has commanded.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Belzalel le Aholiab, chule Pakaiyin alungthim uva chihna apeh michingho, chule natohna-a hunga na hungtong dinga alungthim kisuthou chan chu akouvin:
target: Then Moses summoned Bezalel and Oholiab and every skilled person to whom the Lord had given ability and who was willing to come and do the work.

source: Chule amahon muntheng sahna dingle asunga natoh thilbol na-a dinga Israel chaten ahin tokhom houchu Mosi khutna konin alauvin ahi. Chule amahon jingkah seh le ama henga lungcham thilpeh ahin choijing nalaijun ahi.
target: They received from Moses all the offerings the Israelites had brought to carry out the work of constructing the sanctuary. And the people continued to bring freewill offerings morning after morning.

source: Chuin munthenga natohho jouse tonga miching jouse amitakip anatohna-a konin ahungun;
target: So all the skilled workers who were doing all the work on the sanctuary left what they were doing

source: Chuin amahon Mosi henga, Miho hin natohna-a dinga Pakai thupeh sanga tamjo ahinchoi taovin ahi, atiuve.
target: and said to Moses, “The people are bringing more than enough for doing the work the Lord commanded to be done.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n thupeh apen, hichu amahon gebuh jouse, Nangho pasal hihen numei hijongle koimachan muntheng natohna-a dinga ima natobe lou dingu ahitai, tin aphongjal leuvin ahi. Hitichun mipi chu athilto naova konchun asutang taovin ahi.
target: Then Moses gave an order and they sent this word throughout the camp: “No man or woman is to make anything else as an offering for the sanctuary.” And so the people were restrained from bringing more,

source: Ajehchu athilnei houchu natohna dinga lhingset ahin, chule avalset ahitai.
target: because what they already had was more than enough to do all the work.

source: Chuin alah uva milungching takip houbuh-a natong ho chun tupat pon hoile mantam tah-in ponjal som adum, asanthip le asandup asemun; khutthem tah-in Cherub ho pumin hiho chu asemun ahi.
target: All those who were skilled among the workers made the tabernacle with ten curtains of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, with cherubim woven into them by expert hands.

source: Ponjal khatchu asao tong somni le get, ponjal khatchu avai tongli ahin, ponjal jouse chu akibangsoh-e.
target: All the curtains were the same size—twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide.

source: Chuin ponjal nga ho chu akhuimat nin, chule adang ponjal nga jong chu akhuimat nin ahi.
target: They joined five of the curtains together and did the same with the other five.

source: Chuin aman ni kisuhmatna ageilom laija konchun ponjal khat geija chun adum ajolkhat abil hom asemin ahi. Hibang chun aman anina kisuhtona sunga chun adang ponjal pamnung pena chun abollin ahi.
target: Then they made loops of blue material along the edge of the end curtain in one set, and the same was done with the end curtain in the other set.

source: Aman ponjal khatna chun abil somnga asemin, chule aman ani lhina ponjal patoh akisuhtona-a jong chun ponjal geilaijah abil somnga asemin, ponjal liho chu khatle khat akimatnin ahi.
target: They also made fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the other set, with the loops opposite each other.

source: Chuin aman chechahna somnga sana-in asemin achechah sah-in ahi. Chule ponjal chu hiche achechahna mun'a chun akikolmat tan ahile hitichun houbuh khat asohtan ahi.
target: Then they made fifty gold clasps and used them to fasten the two sets of curtains together so that the tabernacle was a unit.

source: Chuin aman houbuh chunglama chun pon in dingin kelmullin ponjal asemin ahi. Aman ponjal somlekhat asemin ahi.
target: They made curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven altogether.

source: Ponjal asaodan chu tong somthum ahin, chule aponjal aletdan chu tong li ahi, ponjal somlekhat chu akibangsoh-in ahi.
target: All eleven curtains were the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.

source: Chuin aman ponjal nga chu akhuimat nin, chule adang gup jong chu akhuimat nin ahi.
target: They joined five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another set.

source: Chuin aman ponjal kikilmatho mongpena chun abilhom somnga asemin chujongle ani lhina ponjal kikil monga jong chun abil hom somnga asemin ahi.
target: Then they made fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in one set and also along the edge of the end curtain in the other set.

source: Chuin aman khatseh ahitheina dingin chechahna somnga sum-eng in asemin ahi.
target: They made fifty bronze clasps to fasten the tent together as a unit.

source: Chule aman pon-in khukhumna dingin kelngoivun kinusan asemin, chule achunga chun satuilut vun akhun ahi.
target: Then they made for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of the other durable leather.

source: Chule aman houbuh-a din thinggi thingpeh asemin, atungin ahi.
target: They made upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.

source: Thingpeh saodan chu tong som ahin, chule avai chu tong khatle akeh ahi.
target: Each frame was ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide,

source: Thingpeh khat chun ako le abil kibangchet ni aneijin, hitobang chun aman houbuh thingpeh jouse chu asemin ahi.
target: with two projections set parallel to each other. They made all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.

source: Chule aman houbuh-a din thingpeh asemin; chule thingpeh somni chu noilam sanga noilam panga din aseme.
target: They made twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle

source: Chule aman hichu thingpeh somni noijachun dangka-a kisem kibutona somli asemin; akibuto naho ni-a ding chun thingpeh khat noija chun akibutona kohomni asemin; chule bulutna muh ni chu adang thingpeh-a bulutna muh ni ding ahi.
target: and made forty silver bases to go under them—two bases for each frame, one under each projection.

source: Chule houbuh pang langkhat sahlang ninga chun thingpeh somni asemin ahi.
target: For the other side, the north side of the tabernacle, they made twenty frames

source: Chule dangka-a abil somli kisem achun akibutona ko ni chu thingpeh khat ding ahin, chule adang akibutona ko ni chu thingpeh adang ding ahi.
target: and forty silver bases—two under each frame.

source: Chule lhumlang sang houbuh panga chun aman thingpeh gup asemin ahi.
target: They made six frames for the far end, that is, the west end of the tabernacle,

source: Chule aman thingpeh ni chu houbuh apang teni aning ni-a dingin asemin ahi.
target: and two frames were made for the corners of the tabernacle at the far end.

source: Chule amaho chu anoija akimatnin, chule achung chu chaokollin akimatnin; hitichun aning jouse-a chun abollin ahi.
target: At these two corners the frames were double from the bottom all the way to the top and fitted into a single ring; both were made alike.

source: Chule hichun thingpeh get asemin, chule akibuto naho chu dangka-a kisem akisuhto naho somlegup ahi, thingpeh khat khat noija chun akibutona ko ni ni aumin ahi.
target: So there were eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.

source: Chule aman thinggi thingpeh in banggol ho asemin; houbuh pang lang khatna din thingpeh nga,
target: They also made crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,

source: Chule adang thingpeh banggol nga chu houbuh alangkhat nading ahin, chukit le adang thing banggol nga chu houbuh lhumlang sanga ding ahi.
target: five for those on the other side, and five for the frames on the west, at the far end of the tabernacle.

source: Chule aman akima che banggol jong abollin, hichun thingpeh jouse chu akima avut vangin among geijin aumin ahi.
