target: They made the center crossbar so that it extended from end to end at the middle of the frames.

source: Chule thingpeh ho chu sanatwi jin aloijin, chule banggol jouse matchahna din sana chaokol akisemin, chule banggol ho chu sanatwi jin aloijin ahi.
target: They overlaid the frames with gold and made gold rings to hold the crossbars. They also overlaid the crossbars with gold.

source: Chule aman ponjal hochu pondum, ponsandup, ponsanthip, chule tupat ponnemin asemin, thilbol kidang tah-in Cherubim limin ajemin ahi.
target: They made the curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, with cherubim woven into it by a skilled worker.

source: Chule hichea chun aman thinggi thingin khom li asemin, hicheho chu sana twijin aloijin; akoika ho chu sana-a kisem ahin, chule aman dangka-in akibutona ko li akoipeh-in ahi.
target: They made four posts of acacia wood for it and overlaid them with gold. They made gold hooks for them and cast their four silver bases.

source: Chule aman houbuh kotna din pondal adum, asandup, asanthip chule tupat ponnema kisem phatah-a kikhui akhaijin ahi.
target: For the entrance to the tent they made a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen—the work of an embroiderer;

source: Chule khom nga ho-a chun koika aumcheh-in, chule aman alupal jouse le agolho jouse sana twijun aloi jolin ahi. Ahivangin akibutona ko nga ho vang chu sum-enga kisem ahi.
target: and they made five posts with hooks for them. They overlaid the tops of the posts and their bands with gold and made their five bases of bronze.

source: Chule Belzalel'in thinggi thingin thingkhong chu asemin; adung tongni le akeh avai tong khatle akeh, chule atun tong khatle akeh ahi.
target: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood—two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

source: Chule aman asung le apose chu sana thengselin aloijin; chujongle agei kimvel chu sana lallukhuh limin ajemin ahi.
target: He overlaid it with pure gold, both inside and out, and made a gold molding around it.

source: Chule aman sana chaokol li akoijin, amaho chu aning li-a koiding ahi. Chaokol ni chu alangkhat na chule adang chaokol ni chu khatna akoijin ahi.
target: He cast four gold rings for it and fastened them to its four feet, with two rings on one side and two rings on the other.

source: Chuin aman thinggi thingin mol lhon asemin, chule sana twijin aloijin ahi.
target: Then he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

source: Chuin aman thingkhong chu aputna dingin thingkhong panga agollutnin ahi.
target: And he inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry it.

source: Chuin aman sana thenga kisem hepi touna chu asemin; chule adung chu tong ni le akeh chule avai tong khat le akeh ahi.
target: He made the atonement cover of pure gold—two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

source: Chuin aman sana hal khatna kona kikheng Cherub ni hepi touna mong teni-a chun asemin ahi.
target: Then he made two cherubim out of hammered gold at the ends of the cover.

source: Cherub khat chu among langkhatna, chule Cherub khat chu alang khat mongah hepi touna mong teni-a chun Cherubim asemin ahi.
target: He made one cherub on one end and the second cherub on the other; at the two ends he made them of one piece with the cover.

source: Chule Cherubim teni chun alha sangtah-in ajal lhonnin, chule alha teni chun hepi touna chu akhukhum lhonnin, amani akimaingat to lhonnin, hepi touna lamchu anga lhonnin ahi.
target: The cherubim had their wings spread upward, overshadowing the cover with them. The cherubim faced each other, looking toward the cover.

source: Chule aman thinggi thingin dokhang asemin, adung tong ni ahin, avai tongkhat, atun tong khat le akeh ahi.
target: They made the table of acacia wood—two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high.

source: Chuin aman hichu sana thengin aloijin, chujongle avelchu sana lallukhuh limin ajemin ahi.
target: Then they overlaid it with pure gold and made a gold molding around it.

source: Chujongleh hiche chunga chun khutpheng tebep akol kimvel asemin, chule agei kimvel chu sana lallukhuh limin ajemin ahi.
target: They also made around it a rim a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.

source: Chule aman hiho ding chun sana thih chaokol li alhan, akeng liho umna aning li-a chun abupeh in ahi.
target: They cast four gold rings for the table and fastened them to the four corners, where the four legs were.

source: Akimvela chun Dokhang putna mol lhon thilna ding chaokol ho chu aumin ahi.
target: The rings were put close to the rim to hold the poles used in carrying the table.

source: Chuin aman dokhang putna dingin thinggi thingin mol lhon asemin, hiche chu sana twijin aloijin ahi.
target: The poles for carrying the table were made of acacia wood and were overlaid with gold.

source: Chule aman dokhang chunga kongle bel hochu asemin, akongho, asumkheho, asum lhengho, asinho abona sana thenga kisem ahi.
target: And they made from pure gold the articles for the table—its plates and dishes and bowls and its pitchers for the pouring out of drink offerings.

source: Chule aman sana theng thaomei khom asemin, atopal khoilu thaomei khom chu asemin, alhongpi le abahho, alheng ho, abohdoh ho chule apah ho chu kibang cheh ahiuve.
target: They made the lampstand of pure gold. They hammered out its base and shaft, and made its flowerlike cups, buds and blossoms of one piece with them.

source: Chule abah gup chu asih-a konin ajamdoh-in, thaomei khom apang langkhat chun abah thum aneijin, chujongle apang lang khat chun abah thum aneijin ahi.
target: Six branches extended from the sides of the lampstand—three on one side and three on the other.

source: Alang khatna chun abo khat le apah khattoh almond limin khonthum aumin, chule aleng langkhatna abo khat le apah khattoh almond jih bangin alheng thum aumin, hitichun alhung lhonin, thaomei khom abah gup ajamdoh-in ahi.
target: Three cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms were on one branch, three on the next branch and the same for all six branches extending from the lampstand.

source: Chule thaomei khoma chun almond limin alheng lile abo chule apah ho aumin ahi.
target: And on the lampstand were four cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms.

source: Chule amasa abah ni noija chun aboh khatma aumin, chule abanna ni noija aboh khatma aumin, chule athumna abah ni noima-a chun aboh khat ma aumkitnin, hicheho hi abah gup jamdoh dungjui ahi.
target: One bud was under the first pair of branches extending from the lampstand, a second bud under the second pair, and a third bud under the third pair—six branches in all.

source: Abo hole abahho chu tikhat ahiuvin, hicheho jouse chu sana thenga kikheng ngen ahi.
target: The buds and the branches were all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.

source: Chule aman thaomei sagi, achena manchah ho, meivah koina kongho jouse sana thengin asemin ahi.
target: They made its seven lamps, as well as its wick trimmers and trays, of pure gold.

source: Hiche hole kong le bel ho jouse semna dingchun sana thengsel talent khat amangin ahi.
target: They made the lampstand and all its accessories from one talent of pure gold.

source: Chule aman thinggi thingin gimnamtui halna maicham asemin adung tong khat, avai tong khat ahin aningli kibangcheh tong ni ahin akiho jong akibangin ahi.
target: They made the altar of incense out of acacia wood. It was square, a cubit long and a cubit wide and two cubits high—its horns of one piece with it.

source: Chuin aman achung teni le akimvel ki hochu sanan aloijin; chule akimvel chu lallukhuh limin ajemin ahi.
target: They overlaid the top and all the sides and the horns with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.

source: Chuin aman aputna mol lhon thilna dingin apangteni chunga aning teni-a lallukhuh noija chun sana chaokol ni asemin ahi.
target: They made two gold rings below the molding—two on each of the opposite sides—to hold the poles used to carry it.

source: Chule aman amol lhon jongchu thinggi thingin asemin, chule sana twijin aloijin ahi.
target: They made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

source: Chule aman gimnamtui thengsel jong halnam dingin asemin, thaosempa thilsem bangtah-in asemdohtan ahi.
target: They also made the sacred anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense—the work of a perfumer.

source: Chule aman thinggi thingin govam thiltona maicham chu asemin, adung tong nga, avai tong nga atun tong thum ahi.
target: They built the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood, three cubits high; it was square, five cubits long and five cubits wide.

source: Chule aning li-a aki asemin, akiho chu akibangin, achung sum-eng in aloijin ahi.
target: They made a horn at each of the four corners, so that the horns and the altar were of one piece, and they overlaid the altar with bronze.

source: Chule aman maicham kongho, abelho, akheho, vutlonaho, meitina belho, kong dang jouse sum-eng in asemin ahi.
target: They made all its utensils of bronze—its pots, shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks and firepans.

source: Chuin aman maicham lailung tah-a asandan vetna noitah-a chun sum-enga kisem thihvang khat maicham ding chun asemin ahi.
target: They made a grating for the altar, a bronze network, to be under its ledge, halfway up the altar.

source: Chuin aman mol lhonho thilnading sum-eng thihvang mongli-a chun chaokol li asemin ahi.
target: They cast bronze rings to hold the poles for the four corners of the bronze grating.

source: Chule aman mol lhonho chu thinggi thingin asemin, sum-eng in alutnin ahi.
target: They made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.

source: Chule aman thingpeh aputna din maicham sih-a chaokol ho-a chun agolho chu athilin alaihomin asemin ahi.
target: They inserted the poles into the rings so they would be on the sides of the altar for carrying it. They made it hollow, out of boards.

source: Chule aman houbuh maija mipi ahung kikhop tengleh numei ho dingin twikholna kong le akengho chu sum-eng val leh phatvetnin asemin ahi.
target: They made the bronze basin and its bronze stand from the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

source: Chule aman lhang lama chun ahongsung asemin, hiche tupat ponnem tong jakhat-in hong chu akai kullin ahi.
target: Next they made the courtyard. The south side was a hundred cubits long and had curtains of finely twisted linen,

source: Akhomho chu somni, akibutona koho jong somni asemin chule akhomho akoikahou le agolho chu sum-enga kisem ahi.
target: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

source: Sahlang sanga kikhailha ding chun tupat ponnem tong jakhat-in akisemuvin, akhom jong somni chule sum-enga kisem akibuto naho jong somni ahicheh in, chule akhomho akoikaho le agolho dangka-a kisem ahi.
target: The north side was also a hundred cubits long and had twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

source: Chule lhumlang sanga akikhai ponchu tong somnga ahin, akhomle akibutona koho chu som cheh ahi, akhomho akoikaho le agolho chu dangka-a kisem ahi.
target: The west end was fifty cubits wide and had curtains, with ten posts and ten bases, with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

source: Chule solama chu tong somnga ahi.
target: The east end, toward the sunrise, was also fifty cubits wide.

source: Akotpi panga kikhai ponho chu tong somnga ahin, akhom thum ahin chule akibutona kothum ahi.
target: Curtains fifteen cubits long were on one side of the entrance, with three posts and three bases,

source: Chule ahongsung mun langkhat kotna ponjal chu tong somlenga akikhaijin chule akibutona ko-hole khomho chu thum thum ahi.
target: and curtains fifteen cubits long were on the other side of the entrance to the courtyard, with three posts and three bases.

source: Ahongsung kimvella kikhai pon jouse chu tupat kilhuh pona kisem cheh ahi.
target: All the curtains around the courtyard were of finely twisted linen.

source: Chule akhom kibutonaho jouse chu sum-eng in asemin, sutkhom bille agolho jouse dangkan asemin, amuhhal jouse chu dangkan aloijin ahi. Chule ahongsung sutkhom ho jouse chu dangkan akitomin ahi.
target: The bases for the posts were bronze. The hooks and bands on the posts were silver, and their tops were overlaid with silver; so all the posts of the courtyard had silver bands.

source: Chule ahongsung kotpi-a kikhai pondal hochu akikhontho ahin, adum, asandup, asanthip chule tupat kilhuh pon ahin; chule adung tong somni, availam le asan tong nga ahin, hiho chu ahongsung mun'a pon kikhai ho toh kitoh ahi.
target: The curtain for the entrance to the courtyard was made of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen—the work of an embroiderer. It was twenty cubits long and, like the curtains of the courtyard, five cubits high,

source: Chule akhomho chu li ahin, asunga kisem butona koho chu li, akoika chu dangka-a kisem ahin, chule achungho jouse le agolho chu dangka-a kilonkhum ahi.
target: with four posts and four bronze bases. Their hooks and bands were silver, and their tops were overlaid with silver.

source: Chule houbuh kilnaho jouse le ahongsung kimvel kikilna jouse chu sum-enga kisem ahi.
target: All the tent pegs of the tabernacle and of the surrounding courtyard were bronze.

source: Hiche hi houbuh thudol chu ahi, hettohsahna houbuh ngei jong chu Mosi thupeh dungjuija Aaron thempupa chapa Ithamar khutna chu Levi ho kinbolna dinga kisema ahi.
target: These are the amounts of the materials used for the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the covenant law, which were recorded at Moses’ command by the Levites under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Mosi koma athupeh jouse chu Juda phunga um, Hur chapa Uri chapa Bezalel'in abolsoh keijin ahi.
target: (Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything the Lord commanded Moses;

source: Chule aman akilhonpi chu Dan phunga Ahisamach chapa Aholiab, song geithem natong khutthem chule pondum, ponsandup, ponsanthip chule tupat ponnem hoitah jempahthei ahi.
target: with him was Oholiab son of Ahisamak, of the tribe of Dan—an engraver and designer, and an embroiderer in blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen.)

source: Munthenga natohna-a dinga kisulut sana jouse, thilto sanaho geijin, munthenga kimang shekel dungjuijin, abonin talent somni le ko leh shekel jasagi le somthum ahi.
target: The total amount of the gold from the wave offering used for all the work on the sanctuary was 29 talents and 730 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.

source: Chule mipi kikhom simsaho lah-a kisundoh dangka ho jouse chu talent jakhat ahin, chule munthenga ding chu shekel sangkhat le jasagi le somsagi le nga ahi.
target: The silver obtained from those of the community who were counted in the census was 100 talents and 1,775 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel—

source: Munthenga shekel kitena dungjui chun mikhat dingin bekah khat hichu shekel keh ahi. Koi hijongle kum somni-a pat chunglama kisim ho chu khat khatnin abonun mi sangjagup le sangthum le janga le somnga ahiuvin ahi.
target: one beka per person, that is, half a shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, from everyone who had crossed over to those counted, twenty years old or more, a total of 603,550 men.

source: Ponjal butona koho le muntheng butona koho sunga chun dangka talent jakhat akileh lutnin, butonako khat khat dinga talent khat ahijehchun butonako jakhatna chun talent jakhat ahi.
target: The 100 talents of silver were used to cast the bases for the sanctuary and for the curtain—100 bases from the 100 talents, one talent for each base.

source: Chule akhomho, koikaho, alupal chule apehkhat akikhukhum asemin, hiho-a chun shekel sangkhat le jasagi le somsagi le nga alutnin ahi.
target: They used the 1,775 shekels to make the hooks for the posts, to overlay the tops of the posts, and to make their bands.

source: Chule sum-eng kitohdoh ho chu talent somsagi le shekel sangni le jali ahi.
target: The bronze from the wave offering was 70 talents and 2,400 shekels.

source: Chule hikoma chun mipi houkhom ho houbuh mun nachun butona koho le sum-eng maicham, sum-eng thihvang chule maicham kong dangho,
target: They used it to make the bases for the entrance to the tent of meeting, the bronze altar with its bronze grating and all its utensils,

source: Chule ahongsung kimvella akibutonako, ahongsung kotpi-a koho, chule houbuh kihena akilho chule hongsung avel pumpi-a akihena thihkil hochu asemin ahi.
target: the bases for the surrounding courtyard and those for its entrance and all the tent pegs for the tabernacle and those for the surrounding courtyard.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh dungjuijin, Aaron din vontheng ho asemun, chule munthenga natohna din, kinbolna pon adum, asandup, chule asanthip min asemin ahi.
target: From the blue, purple and scarlet yarn they made woven garments for ministering in the sanctuary. They also made sacred garments for Aaron, as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chule aman sana adum, asandup, asanthip chule tupat ponnemin boitong sangkhol ho asemin ahi.
target: They made the ephod of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.

source: Chuin amahon pondum, ponsandup, ponsanthip chule tupat ponnem khutthem tah-a kikhongho chunga kaidin sana chu pasetnin akhengun, ajangin alheh-un ahi.
target: They hammered out thin sheets of gold and cut strands to be worked into the blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen—the work of skilled hands.

source: Amahon hiche ding chun lengkou tomho asemun, akimatsah un, aguiteni chu akilmatnun ahi.
target: They made shoulder pieces for the ephod, which were attached to two of its corners, so it could be fastened.

source: Chule boitong sangkhol chunga konggah kidangtah chu Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh dungjuija kisem pon adum, asandup, asanthip, tupat kilhuh pon kisem chuto thakhat ahi.
target: Its skillfully woven waistband was like it—of one piece with the ephod and made with gold, and with blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and with finely twisted linen, as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Israel chate minho jouse chu mutheitah in sana jemkoa Mohor namna bangin songgel chunga anamin ahi.
target: They mounted the onyx stones in gold filigree settings and engraved them like a seal with the names of the sons of Israel.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangin, Israel chate geldoh jingna song dingin boitong sangkhol lengkouva chun abeh-in ahi.
target: Then they fastened them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chule aman boitong sangkhol ompho jong chu sana-in pondum, ponsandup, ponsanthip, chule tupat kilhuh ponnem bang chun khutthem tah-in ompho chu asemin ahi.
target: They fashioned the breastpiece—the work of a skilled craftsman. They made it like the ephod: of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.

source: Hiche chu aning li ahin, Ompho chu akithop ahin adung khap khat chule avai khap khat ahi.
target: It was square—a span long and a span wide—and folded double.

source: Chule amahon song gol li-in akoijun; golphei masa chu; songsan, song-eng, chule song santhip ahin: hiche hi gol masa ahi.
target: Then they mounted four rows of precious stones on it. The first row was carnelian, chrysolite and beryl;

source: Chule golphei nina chu; song engsel, song dumjet, chule song mantam ahi.
target: the second row was turquoise, lapis lazuli and emerald;

source: Chule golphei thumna chu; song sandang, song vom, chule song sandup ahi.
target: the third row was jacinth, agate and amethyst;

source: Chule golphei alina chu; song engdum, khisonggel, chule khi song pol ahi. Hicheho hi abonchan sana khaoguija akanbeh sohkeijun ahi.
target: the fourth row was topaz, onyx and jasper. They were mounted in gold filigree settings.

source: Chule songho chu Israel chate dungjuijin, aminu somleni dungjuijin mohor'a amin kitat bangin amitakip amin cheh-in phung somleni dungjuijin aumin ahi.
target: There were twelve stones, one for each of the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.

source: Chule amahon sana-a kisem pahvui bangin ompho mongteni-a chun sana chaokol theng asemun ahi.
target: For the breastpiece they made braided chains of pure gold, like a rope.

source: Chule amahon sana jemko ni le thih chaokol ni asemin, chule ompho mong teni-a chun thih chaokol ni chu abut touvin ahi.
target: They made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings, and fastened the rings to two of the corners of the breastpiece.

source: Chule amahon ompho mong teni geija sana pahvui banga kisem sana chaokol akoijun ahi.
target: They fastened the two gold chains to the rings at the corners of the breastpiece,

source: Chule thih chaokol mong teni-a jemko teni-a chun pahvui ahenbeh-un, chule boitong sangkhol lengkou tom chunga amalama chun akoijun ahi.
target: and the other ends of the chains to the two settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.

source: Chule amahon boitong sangkhol sungnung langa agei chunga um ompho mongteni chunga chun sana chaokol ni asemun akoijun ahi.
target: They made two gold rings and attached them to the other two corners of the breastpiece on the inside edge next to the ephod.

source: Chule amahon sana in chaokol ni asemuvin, hichu boitong sangkhol anoilanga chun abutnun ahi. Hichu amai langa mutheija kikhui boitong sangkhol konggah kijemhoi chunga akoijun ahi.
target: Then they made two more gold rings and attached them to the bottom of the shoulder pieces on the front of the ephod, close to the seam just above the waistband of the ephod.

source: Chule amahon boitong sangkhol chunga chun thih chaokol kil aumin, thih chaokol maman ompho-a chun akilbeh un; hiche boitong sangkhol chunga konggah phatah ahi. Hiche hi Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh dungjuija boitong sangkhola kona chu ompho chu kikangdoh louding ahi.
target: They tied the rings of the breastpiece to the rings of the ephod with blue cord, connecting it to the waistband so that the breastpiece would not swing out from the ephod—as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chule aman adumngen na kikhong boitong sangkhol akon sangkhol len asemin ahi.
target: They made the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth—the work of a weaver—

source: Chule sangkhol len laija chun alai khat aumin, akikhen louna dingin sangkhol ngong hom bangin ahom kimvela chun akanchahna aum me.
target: with an opening in the center of the robe like the opening of a collar, and a band around this opening, so that it would not tear.

source: Chule amahon sangkhol len mongchep chunga chun, kolbuthei limin pondum, ponsandup, ponsanthip, chule tupat kilhuh ponnemin asemun ahi.
target: They made pomegranates of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen around the hem of the robe.

source: Chule amahon sanatheng changengho asemun, sangkhol len mong jouse kolbuthei limho chun asemsao changeng chu akoijun ahi.
target: And they made bells of pure gold and attached them around the hem between the pomegranates.

source: Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh dungjuija kintheng bolna din sangkhol len pamchep kimvella chun changengin kolbuthei chu kikahhalchet nin aumin ahi.
target: The bells and pomegranates alternated around the hem of the robe to be worn for ministering, as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chule amahon Aaron le achate dingin sangkhol chol tupat ponnemin khonthon asempeh un ahi.
target: For Aaron and his sons, they made tunics of fine linen—the work of a weaver—

source: Chule thempu delkop tupat ponnem, ponnema kisem sangkhol sungnung, chule tupat ponnema kisem lukhuh hoiho chule tupat lhuhsa ponnem thempu delchen,
target: and the turban of fine linen, the linen caps and the undergarments of finely twisted linen.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh dungjui jin tupat lhuhsa patjang le patdum, patsandup, chule patsanthipmin konggah asemun ahi.
target: The sash was made of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn—the work of an embroiderer—as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chule amahon sana thenga kisem lallukhuh theng chunga chun melchihna mohor chunga kisun bangin, PAKAIYA ATHENG tin asunun ahi.
target: They made the plate, the sacred emblem, out of pure gold and engraved on it, like an inscription on a seal: Holy to the Lord .

source: Chule amahon Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh dungjuijin, hichu thempu delkop chunga sangtah-a kandetna dingin patdum kipheh-in akanun ahi.
target: Then they fastened a blue cord to it to attach it to the turban, as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Hitichun houkhom na houbuh-a natohho jouse chu akijoutan; Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangchun Israel chaten abol taovin ahi.
target: So all the work on the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, was completed. The Israelites did everything just as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chule amahon houbuh pon in, amanchah le achechah naho, thingpeh banggolho, akhomho chule akibutona koho,
target: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent and all its furnishings, its clasps, frames, crossbars, posts and bases;

source: Chule akhuna kelngoichal vuna kidesan, akhuna satuilut vunho chule pondal kikhai,
target: the covering of ram skins dyed red and the covering of another durable leather and the shielding curtain;

source: Hettohsahna thingkhong le mol lhon ho, chule hepi touna,
target: the ark of the covenant law with its poles and the atonement cover;

source: Dokhang kongle belho chule vetsahna changlhah,
target: the table with all its articles and the bread of the Presence;

source: Khoilu thaomei khom theng, athaomeiho le thaomei ho geichu asemtoh un, chule kongle belho chule vahding thaotwi,
target: the pure gold lampstand with its row of lamps and all its accessories, and the olive oil for the light;

source: Chule sana maicham, le nuding thao namtui le houbuh kotna kikhaiho,
target: the gold altar, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the entrance to the tent;

source: Sum-eng maicham le sum-eng tengsa, amollhon ho le abelho jouse, twidolna le akitunna akengho,
target: the bronze altar with its bronze grating, its poles and all its utensils; the basin with its stand;

source: Hongsunga kikhaiho le khomho chule akibutonakoho chule houkhom ho houbuh kinbolna ding kongle belho jouse,
target: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases, and the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard; the ropes and tent pegs for the courtyard; all the furnishings for the tabernacle, the tent of meeting;

source: Muntheng sunga natohna ding vonho, kintheng tohna dinga thempupa vontheng ho Aaron le achapate vonho Pathen na atohna diuva kipe hochu Mosi henga ahin choijun ahi.
target: and the woven garments worn for ministering in the sanctuary, both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when serving as priests.

source: Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh jouse dungjuijin Israel chaten aboldoh sohkeitaove.
target: The Israelites had done all the work just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

source: Chuin Mosi'n akitongho jouse chu amun, aman, veuvin Pakai thupeh bang bangin nanghon natongun ahi tin Mosi'n amaho chu phatthei aboh tan ahi.
target: Moses inspected the work and saw that they had done it just as the Lord had commanded. So Moses blessed them.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati,
target: Then the Lord said to Moses:

source: Lha masapen, nikho masapen ni chule houkhom ho houbuh chu natundoh dingu ahi.
target: “Set up the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, on the first day of the first month.

source: Chule asunga chu hettohsahna thingkhong chu nakoi ding, chule thingkhong chu pondal nakhu khum ding ahi.
target: Place the ark of the covenant law in it and shield the ark with the curtain.

source: Chule dokhang chu nahin putlut ding, achunga goltoh ding thilho chu nagoltoh ding; chule thaomei khom chu nahin pohlutna, thaomei ho chu navah ding ahi.
target: Bring in the table and set out what belongs on it. Then bring in the lampstand and set up its lamps.

source: Chule nangman hettohsahna thingkhong masanga chu gimnamtui halna sana maicham chu nakoiding; chule houbuh kotpi-a chu pondal nakhai ding ahi.
target: Place the gold altar of incense in front of the ark of the covenant law and put the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.

source: Chule houkhom ho houbuh kotphung masanga chu govam thiltona maicham nakoiding ahi.
target: “Place the altar of burnt offering in front of the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting;

source: Chule twikholna kong chu houkhom ho houbuh le maicham kikah-a nakoija, asunga chu twi nasunding ahi.
target: place the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar and put water in it.

source: Chule akimvela chu ahongsung nasem ding, chule hong sung kimvel kotpi-a chu pondal hochu nakhai ding ahi.
target: Set up the courtyard around it and put the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard.

source: Chule nangman nuding thao chu nalah-a, houbuh le asunga umho jouse nanu-a, nasuhtheng ding, chule asunga kong le belho jouse toh: chuteng atheng hiding ahi.
target: “Take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it; consecrate it and all its furnishings, and it will be holy.

source: Chule govam thiltona maicham le akongho jong chu thao nanu-a nasuhtheng ding: chutengle maicham thengpen hiding ahitai.
target: Then anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils; consecrate the altar, and it will be most holy.

source: Chule nangman twikholna kong le akeng chu thao nanu-a nasuhtheng ding ahi.
target: Anoint the basin and its stand and consecrate them.

source: Chule nangman Aaron le achapate chu houkhom ho houbuh kotphunga nahinpui ding, chule amahochu twija nasil ding ahi.
target: “Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the tent of meeting and wash them with water.

source: Chule nangman Aaron chu vontheng navonpeh ding; thempu natohna mun'a atoh theina dinga thao nanu-a, nasuhtheng ding ahi.
target: Then dress Aaron in the sacred garments, anoint him and consecrate him so he may serve me as priest.

source: Chule nangman achapate chu nahinpui ding, sangkhol chol na-ahpeh ding:
target: Bring his sons and dress them in tunics.

source: Chule nangman apao nabol banga amahon thempu natohna munthenga na atoh theina dinguva, amaho jong thao nanu ding ahi: hiche athao kinu-u chu akhang khanguva atonsotna thempu ahi nadingu ahitai, ati.
target: Anoint them just as you anointed their father, so they may serve me as priests. Their anointing will be to a priesthood that will continue throughout their generations.”

source: Hitichun Pakaiyin athupeh bangchun Mosi'n atongsoh keijin, chutobang chun aboltan ahi.
target: Moses did everything just as the Lord commanded him.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, akum nina lhamasa penna nikho masapen nin houbuh chu akitungdoh tan ahi.
target: So the tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month in the second year.

source: Chule Mosi'n houbuh chu atungdoh-in, akibutona koho akanchah-in, athingpehho, abanggol ho, chule akhomho chu atundoh-in ahi.
target: When Moses set up the tabernacle, he put the bases in place, erected the frames, inserted the crossbars and set up the posts.

source: Chule aman houbuh chunga chun ponjal chu ajalin, chule ponjal chu achungvuma akhun, Pakaiyin Mosi koma athupeh bang chun aboltanin ahi.
target: Then he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering over the tent, as the Lord commanded him.

source: Chuin aman hettohsahna chu alan, thingkhong sunga akhumin, amol lhonho chu thingkhonga abutona ding kisem chaokol sunga chun ahenglutnin, chule hepi touna chu thingkhong chunga chun akoijin ahi.
target: He took the tablets of the covenant law and placed them in the ark, attached the poles to the ark and put the atonement cover over it.

source: Chule aman thingkhong chu houbuh sunga ahin polutnin, chule akhuna pondal chu akhaijin, hettohsahna thingkhong chu akhun; Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangchun aboltan ahi.
target: Then he brought the ark into the tabernacle and hung the shielding curtain and shielded the ark of the covenant law, as the Lord commanded him.

source: Chule houkhom ho ponbuh in sung, houbuh sahlam sang, pondal polama chun dokhang chu akoijin ahi.
target: Moses placed the table in the tent of meeting on the north side of the tabernacle outside the curtain

source: Chuin aman Pakaiyin Mosi henga athupeh dungjuijin, Pakai angsunga chun changlhah chu agoltan ahi.
target: and set out the bread on it before the Lord , as the Lord commanded him.

source: Chuin aman houkhom ho ponbuh lhanglam sang, dokhang maijona chun thaomei khom chu akoitan ahi.
target: He placed the lampstand in the tent of meeting opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga athupeh bangin aman thaomei chu Pakai masanga chun avahtan ahi.
target: and set up the lamps before the Lord , as the Lord commanded him.

source: Chule aman houkhom ho pon in sunga pondal masanga chun sana maicham chu akoitan ahi.
target: Moses placed the gold altar in the tent of meeting in front of the curtain

source: Pakaiyin Mosi henga athupeh dungjujin aman gimnamtui chu ahaltan ahi.
target: and burned fragrant incense on it, as the Lord commanded him.

source: Chule aman houbuh kot maija chun pondal chu akhaitan ahi.
target: Then he put up the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.

source: Chule aman houkhom ho houbuh kot koma chun govam thiltona maicham chu akoijin, chule hia chun Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh dungjuijin aman govam thilto le anneh thilto atohtan ahi.
target: He set the altar of burnt offering near the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, and offered on it burnt offerings and grain offerings, as the Lord commanded him.

source: Chule aman kisuhthengna ding twikholna chu mipi houkhom ho pon-in le maicham kikah-a chun akoijin, kisil thengna din hia chun twi akoijin ahi.
target: He placed the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar and put water in it for washing,

source: Chule Mosi, Aaron, chule achapate chun hichea chun akhut akeng akisilun ahi.
target: and Moses and Aaron and his sons used it to wash their hands and feet.

source: Amaho houkhom ho pon-in sunga alut tengu, chule maicham anai tengule, Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh dungjuijin akisil jiuvin ahi.
target: They washed whenever they entered the tent of meeting or approached the altar, as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chuin aman houbuh le maicham vela chun ahongsung asemin, kotpi chungjola chun pondal akhaitai. Hitichun Mosi'n anatoh ajoutan ahi.
target: Then Moses set up the courtyard around the tabernacle and altar and put up the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard. And so Moses finished the work.

source: Hichun houkhom ho pon-in chu meilom'in ahinkhun, Pakai loupina chun houbuh chu adiptan ahi.
target: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.

source: Chuin Mosi chu houkhom ho pon in'a chun alut thei tapon ahi; ajehchu meilom chu aumdentan, Pakai loupina chun houbuh chu adiptan ahi.
target: Moses could not enter the tent of meeting because the cloud had settled on it, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.

source: Houbuh chunga kona meilom chu akilahdoh phatnin, Israel chate chun akholjina ajomtaovin ahi.
target: In all the travels of the Israelites, whenever the cloud lifted from above the tabernacle, they would set out;

source: Amavang meilom chu akitoldoh louva ahile, akitoldoh kahsen amaho akholjinji pouvin ahi.
target: but if the cloud did not lift, they did not set out—until the day it lifted.

source: Ajehchu Israel insung pumpi mitmun akholjina sung seuvin Houbuh chunga chun sunle Pakai meilom chu aumjin, chule jan le meikongin aumjin ahi.
target: So the cloud of the Lord was over the tabernacle by day, and fire was in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the Israelites during all their travels.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi chu akouvin, houkhom ho houbuh-a kona chun ahenga thu ahin seijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord called to Moses and spoke to him from the tent of meeting. He said,

source: Israel chate ho henga seijin lang, ajah uva, Nalah uva khattouvin Pakai henga thilpeh ahin choija ahile, athilpeh hinchoi houchu gancha lah uva kon, bonghon lah-a kon, chule kel hon lah-a kon hitei ding.
target: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When anyone among you brings an offering to the Lord , bring as your offering an animal from either the herd or the flock.

source: Amapa thilpeh chu bonghon lah-a kona govam thilto ahile, achal nolna beihel pehen: aman houkhom ho houbuh kotkhah phunga hing jing Pakai anga ama lungcham tah-a apehding ahi.
target: “ ‘If the offering is a burnt offering from the herd, you are to offer a male without defect. You must present it at the entrance to the tent of meeting so that it will be acceptable to the Lord .

source: Aman hiche govam thilto luchang chunga chu akhut angap ding, chuteng hichu ama dinga longlhena bolpehna dinga kisanpeh ding ahi.
target: You are to lay your hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it will be accepted on your behalf to make atonement for you.

source: Aman bongchal chu Pakai anga atha ding: chule thempu, Aaron chapate chun thisan ahinchoi dingu, chule houkhom ho houbuh kotkhah phunga um maicham chung kimvela chu thisan chu athe chansoh dingu ahi.
target: You are to slaughter the young bull before the Lord , and then Aaron’s sons the priests shall bring the blood and splash it against the sides of the altar at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

source: Aman govam thilto chu avun alipma, hal hala achenbong ding ahi.
target: You are to skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

source: Chule Aaron thempu chapate chun maicham chunga mei akoidingu, chule chuche mei chunga chu thing gol kitoh chetna aset dingu,
target: The sons of Aaron the priest are to put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.

source: Chule Thempu Aaron chapateho chun akichen bong ho, aluchang, chule athao chu maicham mei kikoi chunga kise thing chunga chu kitohchetna aset dingu ahi.
target: Then Aaron’s sons the priests shall arrange the pieces, including the head and the fat, on the wood that is burning on the altar.

source: Ahinla asungho le akengho vang chu aman twija asoptheng ding: chule thempu chun govam thilto, meija kisem thilpeh, Pakai henga gimnamtui hidinga maicham chunga chu aboncha keija ahalding ahi.
target: You are to wash the internal organs and the legs with water, and the priest is to burn all of it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

source: Ama thilpeh chu kelngoi hon ahilou leh keltah hon lah-a kona govam ganlhaina ding ahile; aman nolna beihel, achal ahin kaiding ahi.
target: “ ‘If the offering is a burnt offering from the flock, from either the sheep or the goats, you are to offer a male without defect.

source: Aman hichu maicham sahlam panga chu Pakai angsunga atha ding; chule thempuho, Aaron chapate chun maicham chung kimvela chu thisan chu athe chansoh dingu ahi.
target: You are to slaughter it at the north side of the altar before the Lord , and Aaron’s sons the priests shall splash its blood against the sides of the altar.

source: Aman hichu aluchang le athao toh puma achen bonga; chule thempu chun hicheho chu maicham chunga mei kihalna chunga thing kigoltoh chunga chu akoitoh chet ding ahi.
target: You are to cut it into pieces, and the priest shall arrange them, including the head and the fat, on the wood that is burning on the altar.

source: Ahinla aman asungho le akengho chu twija asopding; chule thempu chun hichu aboncha ahinchoija maicham chunga ahalding ahi: hichu govam thilto, meija kisem thilpeh, Pakai henga gimnamtui chu hiding ahi.
target: You are to wash the internal organs and the legs with water, and the priest is to bring all of them and burn them on the altar. It is a burnt offering, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

source: Pakai henga govam thilto-a dinga athilto chu vachaho ahitah-a ahileh, aman vakhu ahiloule vapal nou ahinchoi ding ahi.
target: “ ‘If the offering to the Lord is a burnt offering of birds, you are to offer a dove or a young pigeon.

source: Thempu chun hichu maichama ahinchoija, alu ahetana, maicham chunga ahal ding ahi. Chule athisan chu maicham panga alhoh lhahding ahi.
target: The priest shall bring it to the altar, wring off the head and burn it on the altar; its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar.

source: Aman achang oi le amul ho chu aloidoh ding, chule maicham solam sanga vut ho umna-a chu apaiding ahi.
target: He is to remove the crop and the feathers and throw them down east of the altar where the ashes are.

source: Chule aman alha teni chu aloikeh ding, ahivanga aloikhen pai louding; thempu chun hichu maicham chung, mei chunga um thing chunga chu ahal ding: hichu govam thilto, meija kisem thilto, Pakai henga gimnamtui chu hiding ahi.
target: He shall tear it open by the wings, not dividing it completely, and then the priest shall burn it on the wood that is burning on the altar. It is a burnt offering, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

source: Chule khat touvin Pakai henga anneh thilto atoa ahile, ama thilpeh chu changbong neljet hiding; achunga chu thao alheija, chule bego akoiding:
target: “ ‘When anyone brings a grain offering to the Lord , their offering is to be of the finest flour. They are to pour olive oil on it, put incense on it

source: Aman hichu Aaron chapate thempuho henga ahinchoi ding: aman hichea kona chu changbong nel chu thao toh, bego jouse toh akhut dimkhat alahdoh ding; chule thempu chun hetjingna hidinga meija kisem thilto, Pakai henga gimnamtui hidinga maicham chunga chu ahalding ahi.
target: and take it to Aaron’s sons the priests. The priest shall take a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense, and burn this as a memorial portion on the altar, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

source: Chule a-anneh thilpeh amoh chu Aaron le achapatea hiding ahi: hichu meija kisem Pakaiya thiltoho lah-a athengpen ahi.
target: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the food offerings presented to the Lord .

source: Nangman thuhkhuh-a kihonmin anneh thilto nahin choija ahileh, hichu changbong neljetna kisem cholsolou changlhah thao kihal hiding, ahilouleh cholsolou changlhah paset thao kinu hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘If you bring a grain offering baked in an oven, it is to consist of the finest flour: either thick loaves made without yeast and with olive oil mixed in or thin loaves made without yeast and brushed with olive oil.

source: Chule nathilto chu bela kikang anneh thilto ahile, hichu thao toh kihal cholsolou changbong neljet hiding ahi.
target: If your grain offering is prepared on a griddle, it is to be made of the finest flour mixed with oil, and without yeast.

source: Nangman hichu ahal hala nakhenna, chule achunga thao nalhei ding, hichu anneh thilto hiding ahi.
target: Crumble it and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.

source: Na thilto chu thil kanna bela kikang ahile, hichu thao toh changbong neljet na kibol hiding ahi.
target: If your grain offering is cooked in a pan, it is to be made of the finest flour and some olive oil.

source: Chule nangman hiche ho-a kisem anneh thilto chu Pakai henga nahinchoi ding; hichu thempu henga akipeh tengle, aman maicham phung ahinchoilut ding ahi.
target: Bring the grain offering made of these things to the Lord ; present it to the priest, who shall take it to the altar.

source: Thempu chun hiche anneh thilto-a kona chu hetjingna dinga phabep alahdoh-a, maicham chunga chu ahalding: hichu meija kisem thilto, Pakai henga gimnamtui chu hiding ahi.
target: He shall take out the memorial portion from the grain offering and burn it on the altar as a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

source: Hiche anneh thilto amoh chu Aaron le achapatea hiding ahi: hichu meija kisem Pakaiya thiltoho lah-a athengpen hiding ahi.
target: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the food offerings presented to the Lord .

source: Pakai henga nahinpoh anneh thilto nahinchoi chanchu chola kisem hilou ding ahi: ajehchu nangman meija kisem Pakaiya thilto tapou lah-a chu chol ahiloule khoiju nahal louding ahi.
target: “ ‘Every grain offering you bring to the Lord must be made without yeast, for you are not to burn any yeast or honey in a food offering presented to the Lord .

source: Ahin ga masaho thilto-a vang chun, hiho chu Pakai henga napeh dingu ahi: hijongle hiho chu gimnamtui hidinga maichama kihal louding ahi.
target: You may bring them to the Lord as an offering of the firstfruits, but they are not to be offered on the altar as a pleasing aroma.

source: Anneh thilto napeh chan chu nangman chi naso cheh ding; na anneh thilto-a chu na Pakai toh nakitepna chi chu na lhahsam sah louding ahi: nathilto jouse chu chito natotha cheh ding ahi.
target: Season all your grain offerings with salt. Do not leave the salt of the covenant of your God out of your grain offerings; add salt to all your offerings.

source: Chule Pakai henga anneh thilto-a ga masaho nato-a ahileh, na gamasa anneh thilto nato ding chu changvui hing meija kisang go, akunga kona ki-atlha avui lhingset hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘If you bring a grain offering of firstfruits to the Lord , offer crushed heads of new grain roasted in the fire.

source: Chule achunga chu thao nasuna, chule chuche chunga chu thao namtui nakoi ding: hichu anneh thilto hiding ahi.
target: Put oil and incense on it; it is a grain offering.

source: Chule thempu chun hetjingna dinga changvuija kona phabep, thao phabep le bego jouse chu ahal ding: hichu Pakai henga meija kisem thilto hiding ahi.
target: The priest shall burn the memorial portion of the crushed grain and the oil, together with all the incense, as a food offering presented to the Lord .

source: Chule ama thilto chu chamna thilto ganlhaina ahia, ganhon lah-a kona ato-a ahile: hichu achal hihen lang anu hijongle, Pakai anga atodoh ding chu nolnabei ahi.
target: “ ‘If your offering is a fellowship offering, and you offer an animal from the herd, whether male or female, you are to present before the Lord an animal without defect.

source: Chule aman athilto luchanga akhut angapma, houkhom ho houbuh kot phunga atha ding; chule Aaron chapate thempuho chun athisan chu maicham chung kimvela chu athekhum diu ahi.
target: You are to lay your hand on the head of your offering and slaughter it at the entrance to the tent of meeting. Then Aaron’s sons the priests shall splash the blood against the sides of the altar.

source: Chule aman chamna thilto ganlhaina chu Pakai henga meija kisem thilto-a apehding; asungho toma athao le asungho chunga athaova kaijouse,
target: From the fellowship offering you are to bring a food offering to the Lord : the internal organs and all the fat that is connected to them,

source: Akal teni leh akong vel lah-a kai athao, chule athin chunga kai athao chu akal teni puma alahdoh ding ahi.
target: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which you will remove with the kidneys.

source: Chule Aaron chapaten hichu maicham meichunga um thing chunga govam ganlhaina chunga chu ahal dingu ahi: hichu meija kisem thilto Pakai henga gimnamtui chu ahi.
target: Then Aaron’s sons are to burn it on the altar on top of the burnt offering that is lying on the burning wood; it is a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

source: Chamna thilto ganlhaina-a Pakai henga ato chu kelngoihon lah-a kona ahile; hichu achal hihen anu hijongle nolna beihel ato ding ahi.
target: “ ‘If you offer an animal from the flock as a fellowship offering to the Lord , you are to offer a male or female without defect.

source: Aman athilto dinga chu kelngoi nou ato-a ahile, aman hichu Pakai anga atoding ahi.
target: If you offer a lamb, you are to present it before the Lord ,

source: Aman athilto doh luchang chunga chu akhut angapma, chule houkhom ho houbuh masanga hichu athading: chule Aaron chapaten chuche thisan chu maicham chung kimvel athinkhum dingu ahi.
target: lay your hand on its head and slaughter it in front of the tent of meeting. Then Aaron’s sons shall splash its blood against the sides of the altar.

source: Aman chamna thilto ganlhaina-a kona chu Pakai henga meija kisem thilto atoding; chua um athao le amei geija athao jouse chu ating juija lahdoh ding; chule asunga kai athao le asungho toma pang athao jouse,
target: From the fellowship offering you are to bring a food offering to the Lord : its fat, the entire fat tail cut off close to the backbone, the internal organs and all the fat that is connected to them,

source: Chule akalteni leh akong vel lah-a kai athao, chule athin chunga kai athao chu akal teni puma alahdoh ding ahi.
target: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which you will remove with the kidneys.

source: Thempu chun hichu maicham chunga ahalding: hichu Pakai henga meija kisem anneh thilto chu ahi.
target: The priest shall burn them on the altar as a food offering presented to the Lord .

source: Chule athilto chu kelcha ahia ahile, aman hichu Pakai anga atoding ahi.
target: “ ‘If your offering is a goat, you are to present it before the Lord ,

source: Aman chuche luchang chunga chu akhut angapma, houkhom ho houbuh masanga athading; chule Aaron chapaten chuche thisan chu maicham kimvela athekhum dingu ahi.
target: lay your hand on its head and slaughter it in front of the tent of meeting. Then Aaron’s sons shall splash its blood against the sides of the altar.

source: Aman hiche athilto-a kona chu Pakai henga meija kisem thilto atoding; asungho toma athao le asung chunga kai athao jouse,
target: From what you offer you are to present this food offering to the Lord : the internal organs and all the fat that is connected to them,

source: Chule akalteni leh akong vel lah-a kai athao, chule athin chunga kai athao chu akal teni puma alahdoh ding ahi.
target: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which you will remove with the kidneys.

source: Chule thempu chun hichu maicham chunga ahalding: hichu gimnamtui hidinga meija kisem anneh ahi: athao jouse chu Pakaiya ahi.
target: The priest shall burn them on the altar as a food offering, a pleasing aroma. All the fat is the Lord ’s.

source: Nanghon thao hileh thisan hileh naneh louhel dingu ahi tihi nachennao mun jouse-a akum kho-a nakhang uva chondan hijing ding ahi.
target: “ ‘This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live: You must not eat any fat or any blood.’ ”

source: Chule Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati.
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate henga seipeh-in, Mihem khattouvin Pakaiyin bollou dinga athupehho khattou abola, hettoh lou jeh-a bollou dingho lah-a khat penpen chu anabola achonset tah-a:
target: “Say to the Israelites: ‘When anyone sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord ’s commands—

source: Thao kinu thempu chu mipi ho chonset dungjuija achonset tah-a ahileh; ama chun anabolna chonset jehchun chonset thilto dingin Pakai henga nolna beihel bongchalnou khat hinkaihen.
target: “ ‘If the anointed priest sins, bringing guilt on the people, he must bring to the Lord a young bull without defect as a sin offering for the sin he has committed.

source: Aman bongchal chu Pakai anga houkhom ho houbuh kot phunga ahin kaiding, chule chuche bongchal luchang chunga chu akhut angapma, chule Pakai anga abongchal chu atha ding ahi.
target: He is to present the bull at the entrance to the tent of meeting before the Lord . He is to lay his hand on its head and slaughter it there before the Lord .

source: Thao kinu thempu chun chuche bongchal thisan chu alah-a, chule hichu houkhom ho houbuh-a ahin choiding:
target: Then the anointed priest shall take some of the bull’s blood and carry it into the tent of meeting.

source: Thempu chun chuche thisanna chu akhut jung adelut ding, chule thisan chu muntheng pondal masang, Pakai angsunga chu sagivei athe ding ahi.
target: He is to dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle some of it seven times before the Lord , in front of the curtain of the sanctuary.

source: Thempu chun thisan phabep houkhom ho houbuh sunga um, Pakai anga gimnamtui maicham sakiho chunga chu akoiding; chule bongchal thisan jouse chu houkhom ho houbuh kotkhah phunga govam thilto maicham bula chu asunlhah ding ahi.
target: The priest shall then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense that is before the Lord in the tent of meeting. The rest of the bull’s blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

source: Chule aman chuche-a kona chu bongchal thao jouse chu chonset thilto dinga alahdoh ding; asungho toma athao le asungho chunga kai athao jouse,
target: He shall remove all the fat from the bull of the sin offering—all the fat that is connected to the internal organs,

source: Chule akalteni leh akong vel lah-a kai athao, chule athin chunga kai athao chu akal teni puma alahdoh ding,
target: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys—

source: Chamna thilto ganlhaina bongchala kona akilahdoh banga chu alahdoh ding: chule thempu chun hiche ho chu govam thilto maicham chunga ahal ding ahi.
target: just as the fat is removed from the ox sacrificed as a fellowship offering. Then the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

source: Chule bongchal vun le aphe jouse, aluchangl e akengho, chule asungho le a-eh,
target: But the hide of the bull and all its flesh, as well as the head and legs, the internal organs and the intestines—

source: Abongchal pumpi chu aman gebuh pam vut ho kiboh lhahna munthenga chu apohdoh-a, hichu thingchunga meija ahal ding: vut ho kisun lhah na-a chu ahal ding ahi.
target: that is, all the rest of the bull—he must take outside the camp to a place ceremonially clean, where the ashes are thrown, and burn it there in a wood fire on the ash heap.

source: Chule Israel houkhom ho chu apumpiuva hettohlou jeh-a achonset tah uva, chule athil chu houkhom mipi ho mitna kona akisela, chule amahon bol louding dol thilho chungchanga Pakai thupeh ho lah-a khatpen chu anaboluva, chule athemmo tah uva ahile;
target: “ ‘If the whole Israelite community sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord ’s commands, even though the community is unaware of the matter, when they realize their guilt

source: Chonset abolnao chonsetna chu akihetdoh teng, houkhom ho chun chuche chonsetna jeh-a chu houkhom ho houbuh masanga bongchal nou khat ahinkai dingu ahi.
target: and the sin they committed becomes known, the assembly must bring a young bull as a sin offering and present it before the tent of meeting.

source: Houkhom upaho chun akhutnu chu bongchal luchang chunga Pakai angsunga angap diu: chule bongchal chu Pakai angsunga kithat ding ahi.
target: The elders of the community are to lay their hands on the bull’s head before the Lord , and the bull shall be slaughtered before the Lord .

source: Chule thao kinu thempu chun bongchal thisan chu houkhom ho houbuh-a ahin choiding:
target: Then the anointed priest is to take some of the bull’s blood into the tent of meeting.

source: Chule thempu chun chuche thisan phabep lah-a chu akhutjung adelutna, pondal masanga Pakai angsunga chu sagivei athinlhah ding ahi.
target: He shall dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle it before the Lord seven times in front of the curtain.

source: Chule aman thisan phabep houkhom ho houbuh sunga um, Pakai anga gimnamtui maicham sakiho chunga chu akoiding; chule bongchal thisan jouse chu abona houkhom ho houbuh kotkhah phunga govam thilto maicham bula chu asunlhah ding ahi.
target: He is to put some of the blood on the horns of the altar that is before the Lord in the tent of meeting. The rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

source: Aman hichea kona chu athao jouse alahdoh sohding, chule hichu maicham chunga ahalding ahi.
target: He shall remove all the fat from it and burn it on the altar,

source: Aman hiche bongchal chu chonset thilto bongchal abolna bang banga abolding, hitobanga chu hiche chunga hi abolding ahi: chule thempu chun amaho dinga longlhenna abolpeh-a, chule amaho kingaidam ding ahi.
target: and do with this bull just as he did with the bull for the sin offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the community, and they will be forgiven.

source: Chule aman bongchal chu gebuh pama apohdoh-a, bongchal masajo ahal banga chu ahalding ahi: hichehi houkhom ho dinga chonset thilto ahi.
target: Then he shall take the bull outside the camp and burn it as he burned the first bull. This is the sin offering for the community.

source: Vaihom khat achonsetna, chule aman bol louding dol thilho chungchanga Pakai thupeh ho lah-a khatpen chu anabola, chule athemmo tah-a ahile;
target: “ ‘When a leader sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the commands of the Lord his God, when he realizes his guilt

source: Ahilouleh, chonsetna anabol achonsetna chu ahin kihetdoh-a ahile; aman athilto-a dinga nolna beihel kelcha nou achal khat ahinkai ding;
target: and the sin he has committed becomes known, he must bring as his offering a male goat without defect.

source: Chule hiche kelcha luchanga chu akhut angapma, chule amahon Pakai angsunga govam thilto athanao mun'a athading ahi; hichu chonset thilto ahi.
target: He is to lay his hand on the goat’s head and slaughter it at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered before the Lord . It is a sin offering.

source: Chule thempu chun hiche chonset thilto thisan chu akhutjunga alah-a, govam thilto maicham sakiho chunga chu akoiding, chule athisan chu abona govam thilto maicham bula chu asunlhah ding ahi.
target: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

source: Chule aman chamna thilto ganlhaina thao ahal banga, hiche thao jouse chu maicham chunga ahalding: chule thempu chun ama-a dinga achonsetna chungchanga longlhen abolpeh ding, chule ama ngaidam hiding ahi.
target: He shall burn all the fat on the altar as he burned the fat of the fellowship offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the leader’s sin, and he will be forgiven.

source: Chule milham ho lah-a khattou achonsetna, chule aman bol louding dol thilho chungchanga Pakai thupeh ho lah-a khatpen chu anabola, chule athemmo tah-a ahile:
target: “ ‘If any member of the community sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord ’s commands, when they realize their guilt

source: Ahilouleh, chonsetna anabol achonsetna chu ahin kihetdoh-a ahile; aman chonsetna anabol achonsetna jeh-a chu, athilto-a dinga nolna beihel kelcha nou anu khat ahinkai ding ahi.
target: and the sin they have committed becomes known, they must bring as their offering for the sin they committed a female goat without defect.

source: Chule aman chonset thilto luchang chunga chu akhut angapma, chonset thilto chu govam thiltona munna chu athading ahi.
target: They are to lay their hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it at the place of the burnt offering.

source: Chule thempu chun chuche thisan phabep chu akhut junga alah-a, govam thilto maicham kiho chunga akoiding, chule chuche thisan jouse chu abona maicham bula asunlhah ding ahi.
target: Then the priest is to take some of the blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

source: Aman chuche thao ho jouse chu chamna thilto ganlhai thao akilahdoh banga alahdoh ding, chule thempu chun hichu Pakai henga gimnamtui dinga maicham chunga ahalding ahi.
target: They shall remove all the fat, just as the fat is removed from the fellowship offering, and the priest shall burn it on the altar as an aroma pleasing to the Lord . In this way the priest will make atonement for them, and they will be forgiven.

source: Aman chonset thilto dinga kelngoi nou khat ahinpohle, aman nolna beihel anu khat ahinpoh ding ahi.
target: “ ‘If someone brings a lamb as their sin offering, they are to bring a female without defect.

source: Aman chuche chonset thilto luchunga chu akhut angapma chule chonset thilpeh dinga amahon govam thilto abolnao munna chu hichu atha dingu ahi.
target: They are to lay their hand on its head and slaughter it for a sin offering at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered.

source: Thempu chun chonset thilto thisan chu akhut junga alah-a chule govam thilpeh maicham kiho chunga chu anuding, chule maicham bulla chu chuche thisan jouse chu asunlhah sohding:
target: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

source: Aman chuche-a kona athao jouse chu, chamna thilto ganlhaina-a kona kelngoinou thao akilahdoh banga alahdoh-a; chule thempu chun Pakai henga meija kisem thilto ho kibol dungjuija maicham chunga ahalding ahi: chule thempu chun amapan anabol achonsetna jeh-a chu longlhena abolpeh-a, chule ama chu kingaidam ding ahi.
target: They shall remove all the fat, just as the fat is removed from the lamb of the fellowship offering, and the priest shall burn it on the altar on top of the food offerings presented to the Lord . In this way the priest will make atonement for them for the sin they have committed, and they will be forgiven.

source: Mi khattou amu ahiloule ahet thilkhat chunga hettohsah-a apana, kihahselna aw ajah-a jong phongdoh louva a-ima kona achonset tah-a ahile; amatah-in themona akipoh ding ahi.
target: “ ‘If anyone sins because they do not speak up when they hear a public charge to testify regarding something they have seen or learned about, they will be held responsible.

source: Ahiloule mi khattouvin thilthenglou khattou, sathenglou thilong hihen, ahiloule ganthenglou thilong hihen, ahiloule athenglou tolla kithol thoho thilong hijongle atoh khah-a, chule hichu aman ahetdohlou ahileh; amajong athenglou hiding, chule themmo chang hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘If anyone becomes aware that they are guilty—if they unwittingly touch anything ceremonially unclean (whether the carcass of an unclean animal, wild or domestic, or of any unclean creature that moves along the ground) and they are unaware that they have become unclean, but then they come to realize their guilt;

source: Ahiloule aman mihem khat thenlouna atoh khah-a, itobang thenlouna hijongle mihem khat suhboh theija chu atohkhah-a, chule hichu aman ahetdohlou ahileh; aman hichu ahetdoh teng, ama themmo chang hiding ahi.
target: or if they touch human uncleanness (anything that would make them unclean) even though they are unaware of it, but then they learn of it and realize their guilt;

source: Ahiloule mi khattou aphalou hihen, apha hijongle bolding akama akihahsela, itobang kihahselna hijongle akama aphondoh-a, hichu aman ahetdohlou ahileh; hichu aman ahetdoh teng, hicheho khatpen pena themo changding ahi.
target: or if anyone thoughtlessly takes an oath to do anything, whether good or evil (in any matter one might carelessly swear about) even though they are unaware of it, but then they learn of it and realize their guilt—

source: Chule hitiding ahi, ama hiche thilho khatpen pena themo achanteng, aman chuche thilla chun kachonse tai tia aphondoh ding ahi.
target: when anyone becomes aware that they are guilty in any of these matters, they must confess in what way they have sinned.

source: Chule aman chonsetna abol achonsetna jeh-a chu Pakai henga athemona thilto, chonset thilto-a dinga ahonlah-a kona anu, kelngoinou ahiloule kelcha nou khat ahinkai ding; chule thempu chun ama-a dinga achonsetna chungchanga chu longlhenna abolpeh ding ahi.
target: As a penalty for the sin they have committed, they must bring to the Lord a female lamb or goat from the flock as a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for them for their sin.

source: Chule ijemtia aman kelngoinou chu ahinpoh theilou tah-a ahileh, aman anabol chonsetna jeh-a chu vakhu ni ahiloule vapal nou ni, khat chu chonset thilto dinga, chule adang khat chu govam thilto dinga Pakai henga ahinchoi ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Anyone who cannot afford a lamb is to bring two doves or two young pigeons to the Lord as a penalty for their sin—one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.

source: Chule aman hiche ho chu thempu koma ahinchoi ding, thempu chun chonset thilto ding joh chu atodoh masatna, chule angonga kona alu ahepela ahetan pai louding ahi.
target: They are to bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one for the sin offering. He is to wring its head from its neck, not dividing it completely,

source: Chule aman chonset thilto thisan chu maicham chung apanga athinlhah ding; chule thisan umnalai jouse dangho jouse chu maicham bula athin lhah ding ahi: hichehi chonset thilto chu ahi.
target: and is to splash some of the blood of the sin offering against the side of the altar; the rest of the blood must be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

source: Chule aman anina chu govam thilto-a dinga akibolji ngaibanga atoding: chule thempu chun chonset anabol chonsetna jeh-a chu ama dinga longlhenna abolpeh ding, chule ama kingaidam ding ahi.
target: The priest shall then offer the other as a burnt offering in the prescribed way and make atonement for them for the sin they have committed, and they will be forgiven.

source: Ahinla aman vakhu ni ahiloule vapal nou ni chu ahinchoi jou tah louva ahileh, achonsepa chun athilto dinga changbong neljet ephah dimkhat hopsom-a hopkhat chu chonset thilto-a dinga ahinchoi ding; hiche chunga chu thao asunlou ding, chule bego jong akoilou ding ahi; ajehchu hichu chonset thilto ahi.
target: “ ‘If, however, they cannot afford two doves or two young pigeons, they are to bring as an offering for their sin a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour for a sin offering. They must not put olive oil or incense on it, because it is a sin offering.

source: Chujou tengle aman hichu thempu henga ahinchoi ding, chule thempu chun melchihna dinga hichea kona chu akhut dimkhat alah-a, Pakai henga meija kisem thiltoho kibol banga, maicham chunga ahalding ahi: hichu chonset thilpeh ahi.
target: They are to bring it to the priest, who shall take a handful of it as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar on top of the food offerings presented to the Lord . It is a sin offering.

source: Thempu chun hiche thilho lah-a achonsetna penpen jeh-a chu longlhena abolpeh ding, chule ama chu kingaidam ding ahi: chuleh amohcheng chu anneh thilpeh banga thempu-a ding hiding ahitai.
target: In this way the priest will make atonement for them for any of these sins they have committed, and they will be forgiven. The rest of the offering will belong to the priest, as in the case of the grain offering.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses:

source: Mi khattouvin suhkhel ana neija, chule hettohlou jeh-a Pakai thil thengho chunga ana chonset tah-a ahile; chuteng aman Pakai henga asuhkhel jeh-a kelngoihon ho lah-a kona nolna beihel achal khat ahinkai ding, aman chu nangman muntheng thil tena dungjuija dangka shekel nateppeh ding: hichu suhkhel thilto hiding ahi.
target: “When anyone is unfaithful to the Lord by sinning unintentionally in regard to any of the Lord ’s holy things, they are to bring to the Lord as a penalty a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value in silver, according to the sanctuary shekel. It is a guilt offering.

source: Chule aman thiltheng chunga anasuhkhel na chu adit ding, chule nga-a khat abe-a hichu thempu henga apehding: chule thempu chun ama dinga suhkhel thilto kelngoichala chu longlhenna abolpeh ding, chule ama chu kingaidam ding ahi.
target: They must make restitution for what they have failed to do in regard to the holy things, pay an additional penalty of a fifth of its value and give it all to the priest. The priest will make atonement for them with the ram as a guilt offering, and they will be forgiven.

source: Chule mi khattou achonsetna, chule Pakai thupeh-in boldinga aphal lou thilho lah-a khattou anabol tah-a ahileh; aman kihet hih jongle themmo chang ahin, chule akhangit louna chu akipoh ding ahi.
target: “If anyone sins and does what is forbidden in any of the Lord ’s commands, even though they do not know it, they are guilty and will be held responsible.

source: Chule aman kelngoihon lah-a kona nolna beihel achal khat, aman chu nangman kilom nasah dungjuija natanpeh-a, suhkhel thilto dinga thempu henga ahinkai ding: chule thempu chun ama dinga akihetdoh lou asuhkhelna chungchanga chu longlhena abolpeh ding, chule ama chu kingaidam ding ahi.
target: They are to bring to the priest as a guilt offering a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value. In this way the priest will make atonement for them for the wrong they have committed unintentionally, and they will be forgiven.

source: Hichu suhkhel thilto ahi: aman tahbeh-a Pakai douna-a asuhkhel ahi.
target: It is a guilt offering; they have been guilty of wrongdoing against the Lord .”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses:

source: Mi khattou achonsetna, Pakai douna-a suhkhel khat aneija, chule aheng akoma thil le lo avop dinga kikoisah chungham, ahiloule kiloikhomna chungham, ahiloule pum hatna kiladoh thil kila chunghama jou abola, ahiloule aheng akom adoha bola ahile;
target: “If anyone sins and is unfaithful to the Lord by deceiving a neighbor about something entrusted to them or left in their care or about something stolen, or if they cheat their neighbor,

source: Ahiloule thil mangkhat amudoh-a, hiche chungchanga chu jou aseija, chule jouva kihahsela ahile, hitiho jouse lah-a khatpenpen abola, achonsetna ahile:
target: or if they find lost property and lie about it, or if they swear falsely about any such sin that people may commit—

source: Chuteng hitiding ahi, ama achonset, athemo tah jeh-a chu aman pumhatna alah ham, ahiloule doha-a kona amu ham, ahilouleh aman avop dinga kikoisah ham, ahiloule amang akimu chu hijongle alepeh ding,
target: when they sin in any of these ways and realize their guilt, they must return what they have stolen or taken by extortion, or what was entrusted to them, or the lost property they found,

source: Ahiloule ajouva ana kihahselna jouse chu hijongle; abonchang keija alhingsetna alepeh ding, chule hichea chu nga-a khat abe ding, chule suhkhel thilto ato nikho le hichu aneipa alepeh ding ahi.
target: or whatever it was they swore falsely about. They must make restitution in full, add a fifth of the value to it and give it all to the owner on the day they present their guilt offering.

source: Chule aman Pakai henga asuhkhel thilto-a dinga kelngoihon lah-a kona nolna beihel achal khat, aman chu nangman kilom nasah dungjuija natanpeh ding, thempu henga suhkhel thilto dinga ahinkai ding ahi.
target: And as a penalty they must bring to the priest, that is, to the Lord , their guilt offering, a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value.

source: Chule thempu chun Pakai angsunga amapa dinga chu longlhena abolpeh ding: chule aman suhkhela anaboldoh hicheho khatpenpen jeh-a chu ngaidam changding ahi.
target: In this way the priest will make atonement for them before the Lord , and they will be forgiven for any of the things they did that made them guilty.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses:

source: Aaron le achapate thu penlang, hitin seijin, Hichehi govam thilto thudola dan kipe chu ahi: maicham chunga jan khovah kei jingkah geija akihala, chule maicham meikong chu hiche sunga chu koujing jengding ahi jeh-a chu govam thilto kiti ahi.
target: “Give Aaron and his sons this command: ‘These are the regulations for the burnt offering: The burnt offering is to remain on the altar hearth throughout the night, till morning, and the fire must be kept burning on the altar.

source: Chule thempu chun atupatpon von chu akivon ding, chule tupat pon delchen chu akichen ding, chule maicham chunga govam thilto meikouvin akahvam vut hochu alodoh-a, hicheho chu maicham panga akoiding ahi.
target: The priest shall then put on his linen clothes, with linen undergarments next to his body, and shall remove the ashes of the burnt offering that the fire has consumed on the altar and place them beside the altar.

source: Chule aman avonho chu asutlhah-a, chule von dangho akivon ding, chule avutho chu gebuh pam muntheng khatna apohdoh ding ahi.
target: Then he is to take off these clothes and put on others, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a place that is ceremonially clean.

source: Chule maicham chunga meichu asunga chu koujing ding; hichu kisumit louding ahi: chule thempu chun jingkah sehleh hiche chunga chu thing atiding, hiche chunga chu govam thilto chu akoitoh ding; chule hiche chunga chu chamna thiltoho thao chu ahal ding ahi.
target: The fire on the altar must be kept burning; it must not go out. Every morning the priest is to add firewood and arrange the burnt offering on the fire and burn the fat of the fellowship offerings on it.

source: Mei chu maicham chunga chu a-itih-a koujing ding; hichu mitlouhel ding ahi.
target: The fire must be kept burning on the altar continuously; it must not go out.

source: Chule hichehi anneh thilto chunga danthu ahi; Aaron chapaten Pakai angsung maicham masanga chu atodoh dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘These are the regulations for the grain offering: Aaron’s sons are to bring it before the Lord , in front of the altar.

source: Chule aman anneh thilto changbong le athao chu anneh thilto chunga kikoi bego jouse puma akhutna ahamdoh ding, hichu Pakai henga gimnamtui dinga maicham chunga hetjingna dinga ahal ding ahi.
target: The priest is to take a handful of the finest flour and some olive oil, together with all the incense on the grain offering, and burn the memorial portion on the altar as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

source: Chule hichea kona amohse chu Aaron le achapaten aneh dingu: hichu muntheng phunga cholsolou changlhah toh amediu, houkhom ho houbuh hongsunga chu aneh dingu ahi.
target: Aaron and his sons shall eat the rest of it, but it is to be eaten without yeast in the sanctuary area; they are to eat it in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.

source: Hichu chol toh kikantha louding ahi. Keiman hichehi eikipe meija kisem thilto lah-a kona amaho chan dinga amaho kapeh ahitai; hichehi chonset thilto le suhkhel thilto banga atheng chungnung ahi.
target: It must not be baked with yeast; I have given it as their share of the food offerings presented to me. Like the sin offering and the guilt offering, it is most holy.

source: Hichu Aaron chapate lah-a pasal jousen aneh dingu ahi. Hichehi meija kisem Pakaiya thiltoho chungchanga nakhang khanguva a-itih-a dinga chondan kipe chu ahi: hicheho tongkha tapou chu atheng hiding ahi.
target: Any male descendant of Aaron may eat it. For all generations to come it is his perpetual share of the food offerings presented to the Lord . Whatever touches them will become holy.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord also said to Moses,

source: Hiche thilto hi thao akinu nikhouva patna Aaron le achapaten Pakai henga ato dingu thilto chu ahi; anneh thilto-a niseh-a atojing dingu chu changbong neljet ephah khat hopsom-a hopkhat hiding, akehkhat chu jingkah lamle atouva, chule akehkhat chu janle ato dingu ahi.
target: “This is the offering Aaron and his sons are to bring to the Lord on the day he is anointed: a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour as a regular grain offering, half of it in the morning and half in the evening.

source: Hichu khangbela thao toh kibol ding; chule hichu akikan joutengleh nangman nahin choilut ding: chule anneh thilto apheng penga kikang jousaho chu nangman Pakai henga gimnamtui hidinga nato ding ahi.
target: It must be prepared with oil on a griddle; bring it well-mixed and present the grain offering broken in pieces as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

source: Chule ama khela thao kinu achapate lah-a kona thempupa chun ato ding ahi: hichehi Pakai henga a-itih-a dinga chondan kisem chu ahi; hichu aboncha halchai helding ahi.
target: The son who is to succeed him as anointed priest shall prepare it. It is the Lord ’s perpetual share and is to be burned completely.

source: Ajehchu thempu-a ding anneh thilto tapou chu aboncha halchai ding ahi: hichu nehlou ding ahi.
target: Every grain offering of a priest shall be burned completely; it must not be eaten.”

source: Chule Pakaiyin hichu Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Aaron le achapateho henga hitihin seijin, Hichehi chonset thilto thudola dan kipe chu ahi; Govam thilto akithana mun tah-a chu chonset thilto chu Pakai angsunga kithat ding ahi: hichehi atheng chungnung ahi.
target: “Say to Aaron and his sons: ‘These are the regulations for the sin offering: The sin offering is to be slaughtered before the Lord in the place the burnt offering is slaughtered; it is most holy.

source: Chonset thilto toh-a pang thempu chun hichu anehding ahi: hichu houkhom ho houbuh hongsung munthenga kineding ahi.
target: The priest who offers it shall eat it; it is to be eaten in the sanctuary area, in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.

source: Ipi hitale chuche saphe tongkha tapou chu atheng hiding ahi: chule hiche thisan chu von khattou chunga akithekhum teng, nangman ana kithekhum von chu munthenga nasopding ahi.
target: Whatever touches any of the flesh will become holy, and if any of the blood is spattered on a garment, you must wash it in the sanctuary area.

source: Ahinla chuche kihona leibel chu kisukeh ding ahi: ijemtia hichu sumsan bela kihon ahile, abel chu not thenga chule twija lhaotheng ding ahi.
target: The clay pot the meat is cooked in must be broken; but if it is cooked in a bronze pot, the pot is to be scoured and rinsed with water.

source: Thempuho lah-a pasal jouse chun hichu aneh diu ahi: hichu atheng chungnung ahi.
target: Any male in a priest’s family may eat it; it is most holy.

source: Chule munthenga kichamna bolna dinga houkhom ho houbuh sunga thisan kipolut chonset thilto tapou chu nehlouhel ding ahi: hichu meija govam ding ahi.
target: But any sin offering whose blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place must not be eaten; it must be burned up.

source: Chutobangma chun, hichehi suhkhel thilto thudola dan kipe chu ahi: hichehi atheng chungnung ahi.
target: “ ‘These are the regulations for the guilt offering, which is most holy:

source: Amahon govam thilto athanao muntah-a chu suhkhel thilto chu atha dingu ahi: chule athi chu maicham chung kimvela athe dingu ahi.
target: The guilt offering is to be slaughtered in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, and its blood is to be splashed against the sides of the altar.
