source: Chule aman chuche thao jouse chu atodoh ding, amei thao le asung toma athao jouse,
target: All its fat shall be offered: the fat tail and the fat that covers the internal organs,

source: Chule akalteni leh akong vel lah-a kai athao, chule athin chunga kai athao chu akal teni puma alahdoh ding:
target: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the long lobe of the liver, which is to be removed with the kidneys.

source: Chule thempu chun hicheho chu Pakai henga meija kisem thilto hidinga ahalding ahi: hichehi suhkhel thilto ahi.
target: The priest shall burn them on the altar as a food offering presented to the Lord . It is a guilt offering.

source: Thempuho lah-a Pasal tapouvin hiche chu anehdingu: hichu munthenga kineding ahi. Hichu atheng chungnung ahi.
target: Any male in a priest’s family may eat it, but it must be eaten in the sanctuary area; it is most holy.

source: Suhkhel thilto jong hi chonset thilto kibol banga kibol ding ahi: hiche teni-a dinga hi dan khatbou uma ahi: chumuna longlhena bol thempupa chun hichu akilah ding ahi.
target: “ ‘The same law applies to both the sin offering and the guilt offering: They belong to the priest who makes atonement with them.

source: Chule mi koija hijongle agovam thilto tohdoh peh-a pang thempupa chun, aman atodoh govam thilto vun chu akilah ahi.
target: The priest who offers a burnt offering for anyone may keep its hide for himself.

source: Chule thuh-a kikang anneh thilto jouse le thil kana bel ahiloule khangbela kisem jouse chu, apehdoh-a pang thempupa changding ahi.
target: Every grain offering baked in an oven or cooked in a pan or on a griddle belongs to the priest who offers it,

source: Chule anneh thilto thao toh kihala kigotsah tapou chu, Aaron chapate jouse chang dingu, khat le khat kibang cheh-a changding ahiuve.
target: and every grain offering, whether mixed with olive oil or dry, belongs equally to all the sons of Aaron.

source: Chule hichehi aman Pakai henga atoding chamna thilto ganlhaina thudola dan kipe chu ahi.
target: “ ‘These are the regulations for the fellowship offering anyone may present to the Lord :

source: Aman hichu thangvah na-a ato ahile, aman thangvahna ganlhai chutoh thao toh kihal chol solou changlhah lumho, chule thao kinu changlhah phengho, chule changbong neljet na kisem le kikang changlhah lum thao toh kihal apehtha ding ahi.
target: “ ‘If they offer it as an expression of thankfulness, then along with this thank offering they are to offer thick loaves made without yeast and with olive oil mixed in, thin loaves made without yeast and brushed with oil, and thick loaves of the finest flour well-kneaded and with oil mixed in.

source: Hiche changlhah lumho tailouva chu, achamna thilto thangvahna ganlhaina-a dinga chu chol kiso changlhah atotha ding ahi.
target: Along with their fellowship offering of thanksgiving they are to present an offering with thick loaves of bread made with yeast.

source: Chule hiche thilto jouse lah-a kona chu changlhah khatcheh Pakai henga jap thilto hidinga atoding; hichu chamna thilto ho thisan the-a pang thempupa changding ahi.
target: They are to bring one of each kind as an offering, a contribution to the Lord ; it belongs to the priest who splashes the blood of the fellowship offering against the altar.

source: Chule thangvah na-a dinga chamna thilto ganlhaina saphe chu akitodoh nikho mama-a chu nehding ahi; chule aman hichu jingkah geija akhen louhel ding ahi.
target: The meat of their fellowship offering of thanksgiving must be eaten on the day it is offered; they must leave none of it till morning.

source: Ahinla aganlhaina thilto chu kihahselna, ahiloule lungcham thilto ahile, aman aganlhaina thilto atodoh nikho mama-a chu kineding: chule amoh chu ajing geija jong kineding ahi.
target: “ ‘If, however, their offering is the result of a vow or is a freewill offering, the sacrifice shall be eaten on the day they offer it, but anything left over may be eaten on the next day.

source: Ahinla ganlhaina sa amoh chengse chu anithum channi le meija halding ahitai.
target: Any meat of the sacrifice left over till the third day must be burned up.

source: Chule ijemtia achamna thilto ganlhaina sa chu themkhat tou nithum chan ni-a ana kineh khah tah-a ahile, hichu kisanpeh louding, atohdoh pa-a dinga jong kitaipeh louding: hichu thilthet umtah hiding; chule chuche ana nepa chun akhangit louna akipoh ding ahi.
target: If any meat of the fellowship offering is eaten on the third day, the one who offered it will not be accepted. It will not be reckoned to their credit, for it has become impure; the person who eats any of it will be held responsible.

source: Chule thilthenglou khattou tongkha tapou sa chu nehlou ding; hichu meija halding ahi, chule satheng vangchu atheng jousen aneh dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘Meat that touches anything ceremonially unclean must not be eaten; it must be burned up. As for other meat, anyone ceremonially clean may eat it.

source: Ahinla mihem khattou athenlouna achunga umpuma Pakaiya dinga kipedoh chamna thilto ganlhaina sa ne-a chu, hiche mipa ngeichu amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi.
target: But if anyone who is unclean eats any meat of the fellowship offering belonging to the Lord , they must be cut off from their people.

source: Chujongle mihem khattou thilthenglou, mithenglou ham, ahiloule sathenglou ham, ahiloule thet umtah thilthenglou ham tongkha-a, ahia Pakaiya dinga kipedoh chamna thilto ganlhaina sa ne-a chu, hiche mipa ngeichu amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi.
target: Anyone who touches something unclean—whether human uncleanness or an unclean animal or any unclean creature that moves along the ground—and then eats any of the meat of the fellowship offering belonging to the Lord must be cut off from their people.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate henga hitin seijin, Nanghon athao kitipou chu, bongchala hihen, kelngoija hihen, ahiloule kelcha-a hijongleh naneh lou dingu ahi.
target: “Say to the Israelites: ‘Do not eat any of the fat of cattle, sheep or goats.

source: Chule gamsa thikam thao le gamsa hon atha sathao chu thildang danga manthei ahi; ahinla iti nama jongle hichu nanghon naneh lou dingu ahi.
target: The fat of an animal found dead or torn by wild animals may be used for any other purpose, but you must not eat it.

source: Ijeh inem itile koihileh mihon Pakai henga meija kisem thilto-a dinga atou sa athao nechan chu,hiche mipa ngeichu amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi.
target: Anyone who eats the fat of an animal from which a food offering may be presented to the Lord must be cut off from their people.

source: Chujongle nanghon nachenna mun jouseuva thisan kiti pou pou, vacha-a hihen, ahiloule sa-a hijongle naneh lou dingu ahi.
target: And wherever you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal.

source: Koitobang mi hijongle thisan kiti netapou chu, hiche mipa ngeichu amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi.
target: Anyone who eats blood must be cut off from their people.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chateho henga hitin seijin, Koi hile Pakai henga chamna thiltoh ganlhaina pechan chun, achamna thiltoh ganlhaina-a kona chu athilto chu Pakai henga apohlut ding ahi.
target: “Say to the Israelites: ‘Anyone who brings a fellowship offering to the Lord is to bring part of it as their sacrifice to the Lord .

source: Akhut tah-a meija kisem Pakaiya thiltoho chu ahin choiding, a-om chu Pakai angsunga jap thilto-a jap dinga, a-om chu athaotoh ahinchoi ding ahi.
target: With their own hands they are to present the food offering to the Lord ; they are to bring the fat, together with the breast, and wave the breast before the Lord as a wave offering.

source: Chule thempu chun athao chu maicham chunga ahalding; amavang a-om chu Aaron le achapate chang dingu ahi.
target: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast belongs to Aaron and his sons.

source: Chule nanghon adah jetlam chu nachamna thilto hou longlhen belap thilto dinga thempu chu napeh dingu ahi.
target: You are to give the right thigh of your fellowship offerings to the priest as a contribution.

source: Aaron chateho lah-a chamna thilto thisan le thao pe-a pang amachun adah jetlam chu ama channa changding ahi.
target: The son of Aaron who offers the blood and the fat of the fellowship offering shall have the right thigh as his share.

source: Ijeh inem itile Israel chateho chamna thilto ganlhaina ho-a kona keiman jap thilto-a kon a-om le dop thilto-a kon adah chu kalah-a, Israel chate lah-a kona atonsotna chondan hidinga Aaron thempu leh achapate chu kapeh ahitai.
target: From the fellowship offerings of the Israelites, I have taken the breast that is waved and the thigh that is presented and have given them to Aaron the priest and his sons as their perpetual share from the Israelites.’ ”

source: Hichehi thempu natong dinga Pakai henga apehlut nikho-a kona Pakai henga meija kisem thiltoho lah-a kona, thao kinu-a Aaron le thao kinu-a achapate chanding chu ahin;
target: This is the portion of the food offerings presented to the Lord that were allotted to Aaron and his sons on the day they were presented to serve the Lord as priests.

source: Hichu Israel chateho-a kona pehding ahi tia Pakaiyin amaho thao anu nikho-a chu akhang khanguva chondan khatna aneidiuva athupeh ahi.
target: On the day they were anointed, the Lord commanded that the Israelites give this to them as their perpetual share for the generations to come.

source: Hichehi govam thilto, anneh thilto, chonset thilto, suhkhel thilto, kipeh thengna le chamna thilto ganlhainaho-a dinga dan chu ahin;
target: These, then, are the regulations for the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the guilt offering, the ordination offering and the fellowship offering,

source: Hichu Pakaiyin Sinai molsanga Mosi henga, Israel chatehon Pakai henga athilto hou ato dingu ahi tia Sinai gamthipma thu apeh chunga athupeh chu ahi.
target: which the Lord gave Moses at Mount Sinai in the Desert of Sinai on the day he commanded the Israelites to bring their offerings to the Lord .

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Aaron le achapate chu puijin lang, chule vonho, kinuding thao, chule chonset thilto dingin bongchal khat chule kelngoichal ni le cholsolou changlhah ephah khat kengin,
target: “Bring Aaron and his sons, their garments, the anointing oil, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams and the basket containing bread made without yeast,

source: Chule mipi ho jouse chu houkhom ho Houbuh kotphunga chun khom khomin.
target: and gather the entire assembly at the entrance to the tent of meeting.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Pakaiyin athupeh bangchun anabolin; chule mipi ho chu houkhom ho Houbuh kotphunga akikhom khom taovin ahi.
target: Moses did as the Lord commanded him, and the assembly gathered at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

source: Chuin Mosi'n houkhom ho henga, Hichehi Pakaiyin boldinga athupeh chu ahi, ati.
target: Moses said to the assembly, “This is what the Lord has commanded to be done.”

source: Chule Mosi'n Aaron le achapate chu ahinpuijin, amaho chu twijin asilin ahi.
target: Then Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward and washed them with water.

source: Chuin aman sangkhol chu a-ah peh-in, konggah chu akonga agahsah-in, sangkhol cho chu a-ah peh-in, thempu sangkhol chu a-ah peh-in, phatah-a kikhong thempu sangkhola gahna-a chun agah-in, chule hiche-a chun thempu sangkhol chu achunga akhitnin ahi.
target: He put the tunic on Aaron, tied the sash around him, clothed him with the robe and put the ephod on him. He also fastened the ephod with a decorative waistband, which he tied around him.

source: Chuin aman a-ompho chu a-ah peh-in; chule aman ompho-a chun Urim le Thummim akoijin ahi.
target: He placed the breastpiece on him and put the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece.

source: Chule aman alua thempu lukhuh akhuhpeh-in: chule Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangin alukhuh achalpang lama chun sana lheng, lallukhuh theng chu akoijin ahi.
target: Then he placed the turban on Aaron’s head and set the gold plate, the sacred emblem, on the front of it, as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chuin Mosi'n nuding thao chu alan, chule Houbuh leh asunga umjouse chu thao anun, abonin asuthengin ahi.
target: Then Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and everything in it, and so consecrated them.

source: Chule aman hichea chun maicham chung chu sagivei athin khumin, maicham le akongle bel, atwi luina kongle akeng geijin asuthenna dingin thao anun ahi.
target: He sprinkled some of the oil on the altar seven times, anointing the altar and all its utensils and the basin with its stand, to consecrate them.

source: Chuin aman kinuding thao chu Aaron lujanga asunglha-in, suhthengna dingin thao anutan ahi.
target: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed him to consecrate him.

source: Chule Mosi'n Aaron chapate chu ahinpuijin, Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangin sangkhol hochu a-ah peh-in, konggah-in akongu agah-in, chule alu uva lukop akop peh-in ahi.
target: Then he brought Aaron’s sons forward, put tunics on them, tied sashes around them and fastened caps on them, as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chuin chonset thilto dingin bongchal chu ahin kaijin; chule Aaron le achapate chun chonset thilto-a dingin chuche bongchal luchanga chun akhutnu angam mun ahi.
target: He then presented the bull for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

source: Chule aman hichu athatnin; chule Mosi'n thisan chu alan, maicham sakiho chunga chun akhut jungin akoikimvelin, maicham chu asuthengin, chule thisan chu maicham bula asunglhan, achunga kichamna bolna dingin asuthengin ahi.
target: Moses slaughtered the bull and took some of the blood, and with his finger he put it on all the horns of the altar to purify the altar. He poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar. So he consecrated it to make atonement for it.

source: Chule aman asunga athao beh jouse le athin chunga athao aumho, chule akal teni le athao chu alan, chule hichu Mosi'n maicham chunga ahaltan ahi.
target: Moses also took all the fat around the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, and both kidneys and their fat, and burned it on the altar.

source: Ahinla bong chal le avun, aphe leh a-eh chu, Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangchun gebuh pama meijin ahaltan ahi.
target: But the bull with its hide and its flesh and its intestines he burned up outside the camp, as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chule aman govam thilto-a dingin kelngoi chal chu ahinkaijin: chule Aaron le achapaten hiche kelngoi chal luchanga chun akhutnu angamun ahi.
target: He then presented the ram for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

source: Chuin aman hichu athatnin, chuleh Mosi'n thisan chu maicham chung kimvel athekhumin ahi.
target: Then Moses slaughtered the ram and splashed the blood against the sides of the altar.

source: Chuin aman kelngoichal chu a-at tel telin, chuin Mosi'n aluchang, ahal holeh athao chu ahaltai.
target: He cut the ram into pieces and burned the head, the pieces and the fat.

source: Chule aman asunglam ho le akengho chu twijin asopthengin; chuin Mosi'n kelngoi chal chu apumpin maicham chunga ahaltai. Hichu Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh banga, Pakai henga dinga meija kisem thilto, gimnamtui hidinga govam thilto chu ahi.
target: He washed the internal organs and the legs with water and burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord , as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chuin aman kelngoichal dang khat, kipeh thengna kelngoichal chu ahin kaijin: chule Aaron le achapate chun hichu kelngoichal luchanga akhutnu angamun
target: He then presented the other ram, the ram for the ordination, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

source: Chuin aman hiche chu athatnin; chule Mosi'n chuche-a konchun thisan chu alan, Aaron bilkol mong jetlam le akhut jetlam khutpi chunga, chule akeng jetlam khopi chungah anun ahi.
target: Moses slaughtered the ram and took some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron’s right ear, on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

source: Chujouvin aman Aaron chapate chu ahinpui doh-in, chule Mosi'n thisan chu abilkol mong jetlamu le akhut jetlamu khutpi chunga, chule akeng jetlamu khopi chungah anun ahi: chuin Mosi'n thisan chu maicham chung kimvela athin khumin ahi.
target: Moses also brought Aaron’s sons forward and put some of the blood on the lobes of their right ears, on the thumbs of their right hands and on the big toes of their right feet. Then he splashed blood against the sides of the altar.

source: Chuin aman thao, amei thao le asunga kai athao jouse, athin chunga athao lom, chule akal teni le athao chule adah jetlam chu alan:
target: After that, he took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat around the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, both kidneys and their fat and the right thigh.

source: Chule Pakai angsunga um cholsolou changlhah kikoina Pocha-a konchun, cholsolou changlhah lumkhat, chuleh thao kinu changlhah lumkhat, chule changlhah paset khat alan, hicheho chu athao le adah jetlam chunga chun akoijin ahi.
target: And from the basket of bread made without yeast, which was before the Lord , he took one thick loaf, one thick loaf with olive oil mixed in, and one thin loaf, and he put these on the fat portions and on the right thigh.

source: Chule aman abonchan Aaron khut chung le achate khutchunga akoijin, Pakai angsunga jap thilto hi dingin hicheho chu ajapmin ahi.
target: He put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons, and they waved them before the Lord as a wave offering.

source: Chuin Mosi'n hicheho chu amaho khutna konin alan, chule maicham chungah govam thiltoho chunga chun ahaltan ahi. Hicheho hi gimnamtui hidinga kipetheng ho chu ahi. Hichehi Pakai henga dinga meija kisem thilto chu ahi.
target: Then Moses took them from their hands and burned them on the altar on top of the burnt offering as an ordination offering, a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord .

source: Chuin Mosi'n a-om chu alan, Pakai anga jap thilto dingin ajapmin ahi: ajehchu Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh banga, kipeh thengna kelngoichala kona chu Mosi chan ding uma ahi.
target: Moses also took the breast, which was his share of the ordination ram, and waved it before the Lord as a wave offering, as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chule Mosi'n kinuding thaova kon phabep leh maicham chunga um thisan phabep alan, chule hichu Aaron le avon chung, achapate chung le achapate avonhou chunga athin khumin, chule Aaron le avonho, chule achapate le achapate aumpiho von chu asuthengin ahi.
target: Then Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood from the altar and sprinkled them on Aaron and his garments and on his sons and their garments. So he consecrated Aaron and his garments and his sons and their garments.

source: Chule Mosi'n Aaron le achapate henga, Houkhom ho houbuh kotkhah phunga chun asa chu honun; chule keiman Aaron le achapaten anehdiu ahi tia kathupeh bangchun, chua chun kipehthenga pocha sunga um changlhah chutoh neuvin.
target: Moses then said to Aaron and his sons, “Cook the meat at the entrance to the tent of meeting and eat it there with the bread from the basket of ordination offerings, as I was commanded: ‘Aaron and his sons are to eat it.’

source: Chule asa-a kon le changlhah-a kona akinemoh chengse chu nanghon meija nahal dingu ahi.
target: Then burn up the rest of the meat and the bread.

source: Chule nangho ni sagi sung nakipeh theng nao nikho akichai tokahse-a houkhom ho houbuh kotphunga kona napotdoh louhel dingu ahi: ajehchu nangho ni sagi nakisuh theng dingu ahi.
target: Do not leave the entrance to the tent of meeting for seven days, until the days of your ordination are completed, for your ordination will last seven days.

source: Aman tunia abol banga hi, chutobanga chu nangho-a dinga longlhen bolna dinga Pakaiyin bol dinga ana thupeh ahi.
target: What has been done today was commanded by the Lord to make atonement for you.

source: Hijeh-a chu nangho nisagi sung sun le jana houkhom ho houbuh kotphunga naum uva, Pakaiyin nanganse nao chu nathilouna dinguva nanit dingu ahi: ajehchu chutia chu keima eina kithupeh-a ahi, ati.
target: You must stay at the entrance to the tent of meeting day and night for seven days and do what the Lord requires, so you will not die; for that is what I have been commanded.”

source: Hitichun Aaron le achapate chun Pakaiyin Mosi khutna athupehho jouse bangchun abol taovin ahi.
target: So Aaron and his sons did everything the Lord commanded through Moses.

source: Chuin aniget lhinin ahitin, Mosi'n Aaron le achapate chule Israel lamkaiho akoukhomin,
target: On the eighth day Moses summoned Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.

source: Chule Aaron henga, Nangman chonset thilto dingin bongnou khat chule govam thilto dingin kelngoichal khat, nolna beihel lanlang, hicheho chu Pakai anga tohdoh-in.
target: He said to Aaron, “Take a bull calf for your sin offering and a ram for your burnt offering, both without defect, and present them before the Lord .

source: Chule nangman Israel chate henga, Nanghon chonset thilto dingin kelchaho nou khat; chule govam thilto dingin bongnou khat le kelngoinou khat, ania kumkhat lhingbep chule nolna beihel cheh kilah-un;
target: Then say to the Israelites: ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering, a calf and a lamb—both a year old and without defect—for a burnt offering,

source: Chule Pakai anga ganlhaina le chamna thilto dingin bongchal khat le kelngoichal khat jong; chule thao toh kihal anneh thilto jong hinlaovin: ijeh inem itile tunia hi nangho henga Pakai hungkilah ding ahi, tin seipeh-in ati.
target: and an ox and a ram for a fellowship offering to sacrifice before the Lord , together with a grain offering mixed with olive oil. For today the Lord will appear to you.’ ”

source: Chule amahon Mosi'n athupeh jouse chu houkhom ho houbuh maija ahinkai taovin: chule houkhom ho jouse chu ahung naijun Pakai anga ading taove.
target: They took the things Moses commanded to the front of the tent of meeting, and the entire assembly came near and stood before the Lord .

source: Chuin Mosi'n, Hichehi Pakaiyin nanghon nabol diuva nathupeh-u chu ahi: chutile Pakai loupina chu nangho henga hungkilah ding ahi, ati.
target: Then Moses said, “This is what the Lord has commanded you to do, so that the glory of the Lord may appear to you.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Aaron henga, Maicham phunglama chen, chule nachonsetna thilto le nagovam thilto gatoh-in, chule nangma dingle mipi ho dingin longlhena gabolin: chule mipi ho thilto chu toh-in lang, Pakai thupeh bangin amaho dingin longlhena gabolpeh-in, ati.
target: Moses said to Aaron, “Come to the altar and sacrifice your sin offering and your burnt offering and make atonement for yourself and the people; sacrifice the offering that is for the people and make atonement for them, as the Lord has commanded.”

source: Hitichun Aaron maicham phung lama achen, chule ama chang dingin chonset thilto bongnou chu athat tan ahi.
target: So Aaron came to the altar and slaughtered the calf as a sin offering for himself.

source: Chule Aaron chapaten ama henga thisan chu ahinchoijun: chule aman thisana chun akhutjung adelutnin, chule hichu maicham sakiho chunga akoijin, chule thisan chu maicham bula asunglhan ahi.
target: His sons brought the blood to him, and he dipped his finger into the blood and put it on the horns of the altar; the rest of the blood he poured out at the base of the altar.

source: Ahinla chonset thilto thao leh akal teni, chule athin chunga thao umchu, Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh dungjuijin maicham chunga ahaltai.
target: On the altar he burned the fat, the kidneys and the long lobe of the liver from the sin offering, as the Lord commanded Moses;

source: Chule aphe le avun chu aman gebuh pamlamah meijin ahallin ahi.
target: the flesh and the hide he burned up outside the camp.

source: Chuin aman govam thilto chu athatnin, chule Aaron chapaten thisan chu ama henga ahinpeuvin, aman hichu maicham chung kimvela chun athen ahi.
target: Then he slaughtered the burnt offering. His sons handed him the blood, and he splashed it against the sides of the altar.

source: Chule aman govam thilto chu ahal ho le alutoh pumin ama apeovin: chule aman hicheho chu maicham chunga ahalin ahi.
target: They handed him the burnt offering piece by piece, including the head, and he burned them on the altar.

source: Chule aman asung ho le akeng ho chu asopthengin, chule hicheho chu maicham chunga govam thilto chunga chun ahaltai.
target: He washed the internal organs and the legs and burned them on top of the burnt offering on the altar.

source: Chuin aman mipite thilto chu ahin choijin, chule mipi ho dinga chonset thilto kelcha chu amanin, chule athatnin, hichu amasa-a bangin chonset thilton atoh-in ahi.
target: Aaron then brought the offering that was for the people. He took the goat for the people’s sin offering and slaughtered it and offered it for a sin offering as he did with the first one.

source: Chule aman govam thilto chu ahin choijin, akibol ding dungjuijin atoh-in ahi.
target: He brought the burnt offering and offered it in the prescribed way.

source: Chule aman anneh thilto chu ahin choijin, chuche-a konchun khut dimkhat alan, chule jingkah govam ganlhaina koma chun hichu maicham chunga ahalin ahi.
target: He also brought the grain offering, took a handful of it and burned it on the altar in addition to the morning’s burnt offering.

source: Aman mipi ho chamna ganlhai thilto dingin bongchal le kelngoichal jong chu athatnin: Aaron chapaten thisan chu ama ahin peovin, hichu aman maicham chung kimvela chun athen ahi.
target: He slaughtered the ox and the ram as the fellowship offering for the people. His sons handed him the blood, and he splashed it against the sides of the altar.

source: Chule chuche bongchal le kelngoichal thao, amei thao le asunga kai athaoho, akal teni le athin chunga athao;
target: But the fat portions of the ox and the ram—the fat tail, the layer of fat, the kidneys and the long lobe of the liver—

source: Chuin amahon athao chu a-om chunga akoijun, aman athao chu maicham chunga ahalin ahi.
target: these they laid on the breasts, and then Aaron burned the fat on the altar.

source: Chule Mosi'n athupeh bangin, a-om le adah jetlam chu Pakai anga jap thilto dingin Aaron'in ajapmin ahi.
target: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh before the Lord as a wave offering, as Moses commanded.

source: Chuin Aaron'in mipi lam ngan akhut adomsangin, amaho chu phatthei aboh-in, chuin chonset thilto, govam thilto chule chamna thilto atona-a konin ahung kumlhatan ahi.
target: Then Aaron lifted his hands toward the people and blessed them. And having sacrificed the sin offering, the burnt offering and the fellowship offering, he stepped down.

source: Chuin Mosi le Aaron chu houkhom ho houbuh sunga alut lhonin, chuin ahungdoh lhonin, mipi ho chu phatthei aboh lhonin ahi: chuin Pakai loupina chu mipi ho jouse henga ahung kilahtan ahi.
target: Moses and Aaron then went into the tent of meeting. When they came out, they blessed the people; and the glory of the Lord appeared to all the people.

source: Chule Pakai anga konin meikou khat ahung doh-in, maicham chunga govam thilto le athao chu akavam tai. Mipi ho jousen hichu amu phatnun apengun, amaiju asulutnun abohkhup taove.
target: Fire came out from the presence of the Lord and consumed the burnt offering and the fat portions on the altar. And when all the people saw it, they shouted for joy and fell facedown.

source: Chuin Aaron chapate Nadab le Abihu'in alheng cheh ala lhonin, asunga mei akoi lhonin, chuin asunga chun gimnamtui akoi lhonin, aman athupeh-u hilou Pakai angsunga mei kidangtah atohdoh lhontan ahi.
target: Aaron’s sons Nadab and Abihu took their censers, put fire in them and added incense; and they offered unauthorized fire before the Lord , contrary to his command.

source: Chuin Pakaiya konin meikou ahungdoh-in, amani chu akan, Pakai angsunga chun athi lhontan ahi.
target: So fire came out from the presence of the Lord and consumed them, and they died before the Lord .

source: Hichun Mosi'n Aaron henga, Hichehi Pakaiyin anasei, Keima eihin naiho-a chu suhthenga kaum ding, chule mipi ho jouse angsunga loupisah-a kaum ding ahi, tia aseichu ahi, ati. Chuin Aaron athipbeh tan ahi.
target: Moses then said to Aaron, “This is what the Lord spoke of when he said: “ ‘Among those who approach me I will be proved holy; in the sight of all the people I will be honored.’ ” Aaron remained silent.

source: Chuin Mosi'n Aaron paneopa Uzziel chapateni Mishael le Elzaphan chu akouvin, ajah lhona, Hungnai lhonin, munthenga konin nasopite niu hi gemun pamlama podoh lhonin atin ahi.
target: Moses summoned Mishael and Elzaphan, sons of Aaron’s uncle Uzziel, and said to them, “Come here; carry your cousins outside the camp, away from the front of the sanctuary.”

source: Hitichun amani achenai lhonin, Mosi'n aseibang chun asangkhol lhona aman lhonin, apumin gebuh pama apodoh lhontai.
target: So they came and carried them, still in their tunics, outside the camp, as Moses ordered.

source: Chuin Mosi'n Aaron le achapateni Eleazar le Ithamar henga, Naluchungu hohdoh hih-un, naponu jong botkeh hih-un; achuti loule thi khaovin natin, chule mipi ho jouse chunga lunghanna hunglhung khante: ahinla nasopiteu, Israel insung pumpi hin Pakaiyin achokou meikong hi lhasetpi joh-u hen.
target: Then Moses said to Aaron and his sons Eleazar and Ithamar, “Do not let your hair become unkempt and do not tear your clothes, or you will die and the Lord will be angry with the whole community. But your relatives, all the Israelites, may mourn for those the Lord has destroyed by fire.

source: Chule nangho houkhom ho houbuh kotna kona nachedoh louhel dingu ahi, achuti loule thikhaovin nate: ijeh inem itile nachung uva Pakai thaonu chu uma ahi, ati. Chule amahon Mosi thusei bangchun abolcheh-un ahi.
target: Do not leave the entrance to the tent of meeting or you will die, because the Lord ’s anointing oil is on you.” So they did as Moses said.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Aaron henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: Then the Lord said to Aaron,

source: Nangma nahin, naumpi nachate ahiuvin, houkhom ho houbuh sunga nachelut tenguleh ju ahiloule khamnathei nadonlou dingu ahi, achuti loule nathi dingu ahi: hichehi nakhang khanguva a-itih-a dinga chonna dan hiding,
target: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or other fermented drink whenever you go into the tent of meeting, or you will die. This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come,

source: Chutia chu nanghon atheng le athenglou, chule angim le angimlou nase khen theijuva,
target: so that you can distinguish between the holy and the common, between the unclean and the clean,

source: Chule nanghon Israel chateho chu Pakaiyin Mosi khutna amaho aseipeh chondan jouse nahil theina dingu ahi, ati.
target: and so you can teach the Israelites all the decrees the Lord has given them through Moses.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Aaron le akidalha achapateni Eleazar le Ithamar henga, Meija kisem Pakai henga thilto lah-a aval anneh thilto chu laovin lang, hichu chol beijin maicham panga chun neovin: ajehchu hichu atheng chungnung ahi.
target: Moses said to Aaron and his remaining sons, Eleazar and Ithamar, “Take the grain offering left over from the food offerings prepared without yeast and presented to the Lord and eat it beside the altar, for it is most holy.

source: Chule nanghon hichu muntheng mun'a chu naneh dingu ahi: ajehchu hichu meija kisem Pakai henga ganlhaina ho lah-a nangma chan chule nachapate chan hija ahi: hitia hi keima eina kithupeh ahi.
target: Eat it in the sanctuary area, because it is your share and your sons’ share of the food offerings presented to the Lord ; for so I have been commanded.

source: Chule jap thilto a-op le dop thilto adahbul chu nangma le nachapaten, chule nangma toh umkhom nachanuten muntheng khatna naneh diu ahi: ajehchu hicheho chu Israel chate chamna thilto ganlhainaho-a kona kipedoh nangma chan chule nachapate chan chu ahi.
target: But you and your sons and your daughters may eat the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented. Eat them in a ceremonially clean place; they have been given to you and your children as your share of the Israelites’ fellowship offerings.

source: Dop thilto adahbul le jap thilto a-op chu amahon Pakai anga jap thilto-a ajap dinga meija kisem athao thilto chutoh ahin choitha dingu; chule hichu Pakai athupeh dungjuija a-itih-a chondan hidinga, nangma le naumpi nachapate chanding hiding ahi, ati.
target: The thigh that was presented and the breast that was waved must be brought with the fat portions of the food offerings, to be waved before the Lord as a wave offering. This will be the perpetual share for you and your children, as the Lord has commanded.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n chonset thilto kelcha chu hoitah-in akholin ahile, veuvin, hichu akahvam tan ahi: hichun ahing nalai Aaron chapateni Eleazar le Ithamar chunga chun alung ahangin, hitihin aseitai,
target: When Moses inquired about the goat of the sin offering and found that it had been burned up, he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s remaining sons, and asked,

source: Ipiding jeh penna nanghon chonset thilto chu theng chungnung ahi ti henasa le Pathen'in hichu houkhom ho chonkhelna poding le Pakai anga amaho dinga longlhenna bolna dinga nangho napeh-u ahi ti henasa-a munthenga naneh lou uham?
target: “Why didn’t you eat the sin offering in the sanctuary area? It is most holy; it was given to you to take away the guilt of the community by making atonement for them before the Lord .

source: Veovin, athisan chu muntheng sunga ahin kichoilut poi: keiman kathupeh banga, tahbeh-a nanghon hichu munthenga nananeh ding dolu ahi, ati.
target: Since its blood was not taken into the Holy Place, you should have eaten the goat in the sanctuary area, as I commanded.”

source: Chuin Aaron'in Mosi henga, Ven, tuni kho-a hi amahon achonset thiltou leh agovam thiltou Pakai anga atou ahin chule hitobang thil hohin eilhun khumtai. Chule keiman tuni hin chonset thilto chu ana netaleng, hichu Pathen mitmun san hinantem? ati.
target: Aaron replied to Moses, “Today they sacrificed their sin offering and their burnt offering before the Lord , but such things as this have happened to me. Would the Lord have been pleased if I had eaten the sin offering today?”

source: Chuin Mosi'n hichu ajah phatnin, alunglhai tan ahi.
target: When Moses heard this, he was satisfied.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

source: Israel chate henga hitihin seipeh lhonin, Hiche hohi leiset chunga sa ho jouse lah-a naneh diu saho chu ahiuve.
target: “Say to the Israelites: ‘Of all the animals that live on land, these are the ones you may eat:

source: Sa jouse lah-a kon akengtin kikhena, atin ni-a kika, chule anehsa ihdoh kitna lhaikit tapou chu naneh dingu ahi.
target: You may eat any animal that has a divided hoof and that chews the cud.

source: Hijeng jongle hiche hohin anehsa ihdoh kitna lhaikitnu henglang, atinnu kika jong le naneh lou dingu ahi: Sangongsang hin anehsa a-ihdoh kitnin alhainan, ahin akengtin akikah loujeh-in; ama chu nangho dinga athenglou ahi.
target: “ ‘There are some that only chew the cud or only have a divided hoof, but you must not eat them. The camel, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is ceremonially unclean for you.

source: Chule jupi khun anehsa a-ihdoh kitnin alhainan, ahin atin akikah loujeh-in, ama chu nangho dinga athenglou ahi.
target: The hyrax, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.

source: Chule telep khun anehsa a-ihdoh kitnin alhainan, atin akikah loujeh-in, ama chu nangho dinga athenglou ahi.
target: The rabbit, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.

source: Chule vohcha khu akengtin akikhena atin akikah jeng vangin, anehsa a-ihdoh-a alhailou jeh-in, ama chu nangho dinga thenglou ahi.
target: And the pig, though it has a divided hoof, does not chew the cud; it is unclean for you.

source: Amaho sa naneh lou dingu, chuleh athilong jong natohkhah lou dingu ahi. Amaho nangho dinga athenglou ahiuve.
target: You must not eat their meat or touch their carcasses; they are unclean for you.

source: Hichehohi twilah-a um naneh dingu jouse chu ahi: twilah-a um alha le alip neitapou, twikhanglen ho-a um hihen, vadung ho-a um hijongle, hicheho chu naneh dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘Of all the creatures living in the water of the seas and the streams you may eat any that have fins and scales.

source: Chule alha le alip neilou ho jouse, twikhanglen ho-a um hihen, chule vadung ho-a um hijongle, twi lah-a chatle thei jouse le twilah-a um ahingthei jouse chu, nangho-a dinga thet umtah hiding ahi.
target: But all creatures in the seas or streams that do not have fins and scales—whether among all the swarming things or among all the other living creatures in the water—you are to regard as unclean.

source: Amachu nangho dinga thet umtah hiding ahin; nanghon asa-u chu naneh loudiu, athilong hou chu thet uma nahet joh dingu ahi.
target: And since you are to regard them as unclean, you must not eat their meat; you must regard their carcasses as unclean.

source: Twilah-a um alha le alip neilou tapou hu nangho dinga thet umtah hiding ahi.
target: Anything living in the water that does not have fins and scales is to be regarded as unclean by you.

source: Chule hiche hohi vachaho lah-a nanghon thil thet uma nahet dingu chu ahi; nanghon hicheho chu nanehlou dingu ahin, amaho thet umtah ahiuve: mulaopi, muvanlai chule mungagal.
target: “ ‘These are the birds you are to regard as unclean and not eat because they are unclean: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,

source: Muthong le, mu chilhah jouse:
target: the red kite, any kind of black kite,

source: Va-ah tincheng le achilhah jouse;
target: any kind of raven,

source: sumbupi, lhang simbu le kakhut, chule muthi le achilhah jouse,
target: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

source: Chuleh sumbu neo, twivatot vom, chule sumbupi,
target: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,

source: Chule twivatot, twilen vamuhsao, chule chammu,
target: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey,

source: Twiva, Vakengsang chule achilhah jouse, chule Vashonglhu chule bah.
target: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe and the bat.

source: Tolla vah vacha jouse, akeng li-a che ho jouse chu nangho dinga thet umtah hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are to be regarded as unclean by you.

source: Hijongle nanghon nanehthei tolla vah kengli nei ahia lengle thei hochu, lei chunga chople nathei ding akengphang chunguva kengho neichan chu;
target: There are, however, some flying insects that walk on all fours that you may eat: those that have jointed legs for hopping on the ground.

source: Amaho lah-a kona hicheho hi naneh thei dingu ahi; khaokho leh achilhah, khaonam leh achilhah, lhenglhe le achilhah, chule khaokhopi le achilhah.
target: Of these you may eat any kind of locust, katydid, cricket or grasshopper.

source: Ahinla adang tolla vah kengli nei ahia lengthei jouse chu nangho dinga thet umtah hiding ahi.
target: But all other flying insects that have four legs you are to regard as unclean.

source: Chule hicheho jeh-a hi nangho athenglou nahi dingu ahi: koi hile amaho thilong tongkha chu nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘You will make yourselves unclean by these; whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean till evening.

source: Chule koi hileh amaho thilong pokha chun apon akisop ding ahin, chule nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: Whoever picks up one of their carcasses must wash their clothes, and they will be unclean till evening.

source: Sa akeng tin kikah-a ahia ni kisolou leh anehsa ihdoh-a lhailou taphot thilong chu nangho dinga aboh ahin; atongkha tapou chu aboh hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘Every animal that does not have a divided hoof or that does not chew the cud is unclean for you; whoever touches the carcass of any of them will be unclean.

source: Chule akeng li-a che gamsa jouse lah-a, akhophanga chetapou chu nangho dinga aboh ahi; koi hileh amaho thilong tongkha chan chu nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: Of all the animals that walk on all fours, those that walk on their paws are unclean for you; whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean till evening.

source: Chule amaho thilong pokha chanchun aponho akisop ding, chule nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi; amaho chu nangho dinga aboh ahi.
target: Anyone who picks up their carcasses must wash their clothes, and they will be unclean till evening. These animals are unclean for you.

source: Hicheho jong hi leichunga vah ganhingho lah-a nangho dinga aboh hiding ahiuve; kongkoi, jucha, sumkong le achilhah,
target: “ ‘Of the animals that move along the ground, these are unclean for you: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,

source: Chule khoili, thangkip, tangnam, dahdeng chule bui,
target: the gecko, the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink and the chameleon.

source: Hicheho hi avathoho jouse lah-a nangho dinga aboh hochu ahiuve: koi hileh amaho athi nunguva tongkha chan chu nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: Of all those that move along the ground, these are unclean for you. Whoever touches them when they are dead will be unclean till evening.

source: Chule ipi hitaleh hicheho hin athi nungule alhah khum pennu chu aboh hiding ahi: thinga kisem umle bel hihen, von hihen, vun hihen, dip hihen, chule itobang umle bel hihen ipi tobang bolna-a kimangcha hijongle, hichu twija delut ding ahin, chule hichu nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi; chutengle atheng hibep ding ahi.
target: When one of them dies and falls on something, that article, whatever its use, will be unclean, whether it is made of wood, cloth, hide or sackcloth. Put it in water; it will be unclean till evening, and then it will be clean.

source: Chule hicheho chun akheh khum leibel tapou chu, asunga chu ipi uma hijongle aboh hiding; chuleh nanghon leibel chu nasukeh dingu ahi.
target: If one of them falls into a clay pot, everything in it will be unclean, and you must break the pot.

source: Nehthei anneh jouse lah-a chutobang twijin ajotkhum tapou chu aboh hiding: chule chutobang lhenga kona kidon tapou jongchu aboh hiding ahi.
target: Any food you are allowed to eat that has come into contact with water from any such pot is unclean, and any liquid that is drunk from such a pot is unclean.

source: Chule hicheho thilong halkhat nin alhahkhum thil tapou chu aboh hiding ahin; tapkong hihen, bel kitunggol hijongle, hicheho chu suhset hiding ahi: ajehchu hicheho chu aboh ahin, chule nangho dinga aboh hiding ahiuve.
target: Anything that one of their carcasses falls on becomes unclean; an oven or cooking pot must be broken up. They are unclean, and you are to regard them as unclean.

source: Hijeng jongle twinah ahiloule komtong twi nengtah-a aumna mun chu atheng hiding ahi: ahinla ipi hijongle hicheho thilong tongkha chan chu aboh hiding ahi.
target: A spring, however, or a cistern for collecting water remains clean, but anyone who touches one of these carcasses is unclean.

source: Chule hicheho thilong halkhat chun tuding muchi khattou akheh khuma ahile, hiche chu atheng hiding ahi.
target: If a carcass falls on any seeds that are to be planted, they remain clean.

source: Ahinla amuchi chunga chun twi themkhat akikoija, chule hicheho thilong halkhat chu hiche chunga chu achuh-a ahile, hichu nangho dinga aboh hiding ahi.
target: But if water has been put on the seed and a carcass falls on it, it is unclean for you.

source: Chule naneh theiju saho lah-a kona khattou athia ahile; athilong tongkha chanchu nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘If an animal that you are allowed to eat dies, anyone who touches its carcass will be unclean till evening.

source: Chule chuche thilong nekha chun aponho akisop ding, nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi. Chule chuche thilong popa jongchun aponho akisop ding, chule nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: Anyone who eats some of its carcass must wash their clothes, and they will be unclean till evening. Anyone who picks up the carcass must wash their clothes, and they will be unclean till evening.

source: Chule leichunga kitholtho ganhing tapou chu thet um hiding ahi; hichu nehlou helding ahi.
target: “ ‘Every creature that moves along the ground is to be regarded as unclean; it is not to be eaten.

source: Ipi hitaleh a-oija kithol, kenglia chetho, ahilouleh leichunga kithol tho ganhingho lah-a keng tampi neija kitholtho ho, hicheho chu nanehlou dingu ahi; ajehchu hicheho chu nangho dinga thet um ahiuve.
target: You are not to eat any creature that moves along the ground, whether it moves on its belly or walks on all fours or on many feet; it is unclean.

source: Nangho akitholtho ganhing tapouva naki suhboh louhel dingu, chule naboh louna dinguva amaho-a kona jong nakisuhnet lou dingu ahi.
target: Do not defile yourselves by any of these creatures. Do not make yourselves unclean by means of them or be made unclean by them.

source: Ijeh inem itile keima Pakai na Pathen'u kahi. Hijeh-a chu nangho nakisuh thenguva, atheng nahi dingu ahi; ajehchu Keima atheng kahi. Chule leichunga kitholtho ganhing tapouva nangho le nangho naki suhboh lou dingu ahi.
target: I am the Lord your God; consecrate yourselves and be holy, because I am holy. Do not make yourselves unclean by any creature that moves along the ground.

source: Ijeh inem itile keima na-Pathen'u hidinga Egypt gama kona nahin puidoh uva Pakai chu kahi; Hiche jeh-a chu nangho nathen dingu ahi; ajehchu keima atheng kahi.
target: I am the Lord , who brought you up out of Egypt to be your God; therefore be holy, because I am holy.

source: Hichehi saho, vachaho, twilah-a vahle ahingthei jouse, chule leichunga kitholthoho chung changa dan chu ahi;
target: “ ‘These are the regulations concerning animals, birds, every living thing that moves about in the water and every creature that moves along the ground.

source: Aboh le atheng khenna dingle, sa nehthei le nehtheilou kisekhen theina dinga ahi.
target: You must distinguish between the unclean and the clean, between living creatures that may be eaten and those that may not be eaten.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati.
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate henga hitihin seijin, Numei khatnin nao avopma cha pasal ahina ahile, amanu chu ni sagi aboh hiding; anumei hina-a athenlou nikhoho dungjuija aboh hiding ahi.
target: “Say to the Israelites: ‘A woman who becomes pregnant and gives birth to a son will be ceremonially unclean for seven days, just as she is unclean during her monthly period.

source: Chule niget chan nileh naosen chep chu kitanding ahi.
target: On the eighth day the boy is to be circumcised.

source: Chule amanu chun athisan kisuhtheng na-a nisomthum le nithum gei ajomding; akisuh thengna nikho alhin kahse-a munthenga jong lut louding chule thiltheng tapou jong atoh khah thei lou ding ahi.
target: Then the woman must wait thirty-three days to be purified from her bleeding. She must not touch anything sacred or go to the sanctuary until the days of her purification are over.

source: Ahinla amanun numei ahina ahile, anumei hina athenlouna nikho dungjuija hapta ni aboh hiding ahi. Chule amanu chun thisana akisuh thengna chu ni somgup le nigup ajompeh ding ahi.
target: If she gives birth to a daughter, for two weeks the woman will be unclean, as during her period. Then she must wait sixty-six days to be purified from her bleeding.

source: Chule amanu kisuhthengna nikhoho alhin tengle, amanun chapa-a ding, ahiloule chanua dinga govam thilto dinga kelngoinou kumkhat lhingbep khat; chule chonset thilto dinga vakhu nou ahiloule vapal khat houkhom ho Houbuh phunga chu thempupa henga ahinchoi ding:
target: “ ‘When the days of her purification for a son or daughter are over, she is to bring to the priest at the entrance to the tent of meeting a year-old lamb for a burnt offering and a young pigeon or a dove for a sin offering.

source: Aman hichu Pakai anga ato-a, amanu dinga longlhena abolpeh ding: chule amanu chu athilonna-a kona chu suhtheng hiding ahi. Hiche cha pasal ahilouleh cha numei hingnu-a dinga dan chu ahi.
target: He shall offer them before the Lord to make atonement for her, and then she will be ceremonially clean from her flow of blood. “ ‘These are the regulations for the woman who gives birth to a boy or a girl.

source: Chule ijemtia amanun kelngoinou ahinchoi joutah louva ahileh, amanun vapal ni ahiloule vakhu nou ni; khat govam thilto ding chule adang khat chu chonsetna thilto dinga ahinchoi ding: thempu chun amanu dinga longlhena abolpeh-a, chule amanu chu theng ding ahi.
target: But if she cannot afford a lamb, she is to bring two doves or two young pigeons, one for a burnt offering and the other for a sin offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for her, and she will be clean.’ ”

source: Chule Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

source: Mikhatnin atahsa chung avuna abohdoh khat, akhih khat, ahiloule akangdoh laikhat ahin neija, chule hichu atahsa vunna phah natna tobang ahia ahile, chuteng ama chu Aaron thempupa ahilouleh achapate thempupaho henga nahin pui dingu ahi.
target: “When anyone has a swelling or a rash or a shiny spot on their skin that may be a defiling skin disease, they must be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons who is a priest.

source: Chule thempupa chun tahsa vuna hise chu avetding; chule natna laija timul chu ahung kana, chule natna kimuchu atahsa vun sanga athuh johle, hiche chu phahna hise ahi: chule thempupan ama chu avetna, chule amachu aboh ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi.
target: The priest is to examine the sore on the skin, and if the hair in the sore has turned white and the sore appears to be more than skin deep, it is a defiling skin disease. When the priest examines that person, he shall pronounce them ceremonially unclean.

source: Ijemtia atahsa vuna ahung ngoudoh lai chu ahung kana, chule mutheija avun sanga athuhjoh louva, chule atimul chu ahung kan louva ahile, thempupa chun chuche hise neipa chu ni sagi akhatup ding:
target: If the shiny spot on the skin is white but does not appear to be more than skin deep and the hair in it has not turned white, the priest is to isolate the affected person for seven days.

source: Chule ni sagi lhin nileh thempupa chun amachu avetna, chule veuvin, anatna chu amitmua atan dena, chule hise chu avuna chal louva amule, thempupa chun amachu ni sagi akhatup beding ahi.
target: On the seventh day the priest is to examine them, and if he sees that the sore is unchanged and has not spread in the skin, he is to isolate them for another seven days.

source: Chule ni sagi lhin nileh thempupa chun amachu avetkitna, chule veuvin, hise chu avomthima, chule hise chu avuna chal louva amule, thempupa chun ama chu atheng ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi: akhihbou ahi; amachun aponho akisopma, atheng hiding ahi.
target: On the seventh day the priest is to examine them again, and if the sore has faded and has not spread in the skin, the priest shall pronounce them clean; it is only a rash. They must wash their clothes, and they will be clean.

source: Ahinla akisuhtheng nadinga thempupa akimupi jouva, akhih chu avuna achallheh jenga ahile, amachu thempupan avetkit ding:
target: But if the rash does spread in their skin after they have shown themselves to the priest to be pronounced clean, they must appear before the priest again.

source: Chule thempupa chun avetna, akhih chu avuna challa amuleh, chutengle thempupan amachu aboh ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi: hichu phahnat ahi.
target: The priest is to examine that person, and if the rash has spread in the skin, he shall pronounce them unclean; it is a defiling skin disease.

source: Phahna hise chu mikhat chunga aumteng, amachu thempupa henga kipuiding ahin;
target: “When anyone has a defiling skin disease, they must be brought to the priest.

source: Chule thempupan amachu avetna, veuvin, avuna apomdoh lai vun chu akana, hichun amul chu akansah-a, chule apomdoh laija chu vouthah-a amua ahile,
target: The priest is to examine them, and if there is a white swelling in the skin that has turned the hair white and if there is raw flesh in the swelling,

source: Amapa vuna chu phahna lui uma ahin, thempupan amachu aboh ahi tia aphondoh-a, akhatup louding ahi: ajehchu ama phah-a ahi.
target: it is a chronic skin disease and the priest shall pronounce them unclean. He is not to isolate them, because they are already unclean.

source: Chule phahna chu avuna ahung jaldoh-a, chule phahna chun hise neipa vun chu thempupan avetna lam jouse aluchanga patna akeng phang geija atomsoh hela ahile,
target: “If the disease breaks out all over their skin and, so far as the priest can see, it covers all the skin of the affected person from head to foot,

source: Chutengle thempupan angaito ding: chule veuvin, phahna chun amapa tahsa pumpi chu atoma ahile, thempupan hise veipa chu atheng ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi. Aboncha keija hung kang soh-a ahitan, amachu atheng hiding ahitai.
target: the priest is to examine them, and if the disease has covered their whole body, he shall pronounce them clean. Since it has all turned white, they are clean.

source: Ahinla ama-a chu vouthah ahungdoh-a ahile, amachu aboh hiding ahi.
target: But whenever raw flesh appears on them, they will be unclean.

source: Chule thempupan hiche vouthah chu avetna, amachu aboh ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi: ajehchu vouthah chu aboh-a ahin, hichu phahnat ahi.
target: When the priest sees the raw flesh, he shall pronounce them unclean. The raw flesh is unclean; they have a defiling disease.

source: Ahiloule vouthah chu ahung kikhel kitna, chule akang ahung kiso kitna ahile, amachu thempupa henga hung ding;
target: If the raw flesh changes and turns white, they must go to the priest.

source: Chule thempupan ama avetding; chuleh veuvin, hise chu akanga ahung kikhel kitna ahile, thempupan hise veipa chu atheng ahitai tia aphondoh ding ahi: amachu thenga ahitai.
target: The priest is to examine them, and if the sores have turned white, the priest shall pronounce the affected person clean; then they will be clean.

source: Atahsa ativuna chu uilut ahungdoh-a, chule hichu adam tah-a,
target: “When someone has a boil on their skin and it heals,

source: Chule uilut umna mun'a chu ahung pomdoh akang, ahiloule ahung ngoudoh laikhat auma, chule iti hama santhim dana auma ahileh, hichu thempupa henga vetsah ding ahi:
target: and in the place where the boil was, a white swelling or reddish-white spot appears, they must present themselves to the priest.

source: Chule hichu thempupan avetna, avun sanga thuhjoa amua, chulai mun'a amulchu akanga kikhela ahile, thempupan amachu aboh ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi: hichu uilutna kona hung sohdoh phahna hise chu ahi.
target: The priest is to examine it, and if it appears to be more than skin deep and the hair in it has turned white, the priest shall pronounce that person unclean. It is a defiling skin disease that has broken out where the boil was.

source: Ahinla, thempupan hichu avetna, chule veuvin, hia chu amul akang aumlouva, chule hichu avun sanga athuhjoh louva, avomthima ahile, chuteng chule thempupan amachu ni sagi akhatup ding:
target: But if, when the priest examines it, there is no white hair in it and it is not more than skin deep and has faded, then the priest is to isolate them for seven days.

source: Chule hichu avuna akithe jala ahile, thempupan amachu aboh ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi: hichu hise ahi.
target: If it is spreading in the skin, the priest shall pronounce them unclean; it is a defiling disease.

source: Ahinla ahung ngoudoh laichu angai ngai ahijinga, achal louva ahile, hichu uilut ahibouvin; chule thempupan amachu atheng ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi.
target: But if the spot is unchanged and has not spread, it is only a scar from the boil, and the priest shall pronounce them clean.

source: Ahiloule mihem khat meijin atahsa akah-a, meijin akahna aphelai laijachu ahung vamdoh, asanthim ahiloule akang auma ahile,
target: “When someone has a burn on their skin and a reddish-white or white spot appears in the raw flesh of the burn,

source: Chutengle hichu thempupan avetding, chule veuvin, ahung vamdohdoh laija amulchu ahung kana, chule avun sanga agathuh lutna ahileh, hichu meikah-a kona hung potdoh phahnat ahi. Hiteng chule thempupan amachu athenglou ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi: hichu phah hise ahi.
target: the priest is to examine the spot, and if the hair in it has turned white, and it appears to be more than skin deep, it is a defiling disease that has broken out in the burn. The priest shall pronounce them unclean; it is a defiling skin disease.

source: Ahinla thempupan hichu avetna, chuleh ahung vamdoh laija chu amulkang umlouva, chule hichu avun dangho sanga athuhjoh louva, avomthima ahile, thempupan amachu ni sagi akhatup ding:
target: But if the priest examines it and there is no white hair in the spot and if it is not more than skin deep and has faded, then the priest is to isolate them for seven days.

source: Chule ni sagi lhin nile thempupan amachu avetding, chule veuvin, avun sunga chu hichu nasatah-a akithejala ahile, thempupan amachu aboh ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi: hichu phahna hise ahi.
target: On the seventh day the priest is to examine that person, and if it is spreading in the skin, the priest shall pronounce them unclean; it is a defiling skin disease.

source: Chule ahung vamdoh laichu angai ahijinga, chule avuna akithejal louva, ahia hichu avom thima ahile, hichu meikah-a kona hung duldoh ahin: thempupan amachu atheng ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi; ajehchu meikah jeh-a hung khidoh ahibouve.
target: If, however, the spot is unchanged and has not spread in the skin but has faded, it is a swelling from the burn, and the priest shall pronounce them clean; it is only a scar from the burn.

source: Pasal ham numei ham aluchang ham ahilouleh akhamul hama chu hise aneija ahile,
target: “If a man or woman has a sore on their head or chin,

source: Chuteng thempupan hise chu avetding, chule veuvin, hichu avun sanga agathuhlut joh-a, chule chua chu ai-eng ena eng mulngat khat auma ahile; chuteng thempupan amachu aboh ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi: hichu tithah luchunga ahilouleh khamula um phahna ahi.
target: the priest is to examine the sore, and if it appears to be more than skin deep and the hair in it is yellow and thin, the priest shall pronounce them unclean; it is a defiling skin disease on the head or chin.

source: Chule thempupan tithah hise chu avetna, chule veuvin, hichu avun sanga agathuh lutjoh louva, chule chuche-a chu mulvom aumlouva ahile, thempupan tithah hise neipa chu ni sagi akhatup ding ahi.
target: But if, when the priest examines the sore, it does not seem to be more than skin deep and there is no black hair in it, then the priest is to isolate the affected person for seven days.

source: Chule ni sagi lhin nileh thempupan hise chu avetding, chule veuvin, tithah chu kithejal louva, chule hichea chu ai-eng enna eng amul jong aumlouva, chule tithah chu avun sanga agathuh lutjoh louva ahile;
target: On the seventh day the priest is to examine the sore, and if it has not spread and there is no yellow hair in it and it does not appear to be more than skin deep,

source: Amachu amul hetngima umding, amavang tithah laichu ahetngim louding ahi; chule thempupan tithah neipa chu nisagi akhatup beding ahi.
target: then the man or woman must shave themselves, except for the affected area, and the priest is to keep them isolated another seven days.

source: Chule ni sagi alhin nile thempupan tithah chu avetding, chule veuvin, tithah chu avuna akithejal louva, ahiloule avun sanga jong agathuh lutlouva ahile, thempupan amachu atheng ahi tia aphondoh ding; chule amachun aponho akisopma, chule atheng hiding ahitai.
target: On the seventh day the priest is to examine the sore, and if it has not spread in the skin and appears to be no more than skin deep, the priest shall pronounce them clean. They must wash their clothes, and they will be clean.

source: Ahinla akisuhngim jouva tithah chu avuna akithejala ahileh;
target: But if the sore does spread in the skin after they are pronounced clean,

source: Chuteng thempu pan ama avet ding, chule veuvin, tithah chu avuna akithejala ahile, thempu pan ai-eng eng mul aholkhoh louding ahi: ama athenglou ahitai.
target: the priest is to examine them, and if he finds that the sore has spread in the skin, he does not need to look for yellow hair; they are unclean.

source: Ahinla tithah chu aumdenna, chule chuche mun'a chu mulvom ahung kedoh-a, chule tithah chu adam tah-a ahile, amachu atheng ahitai: thempupan amachu atheng ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi.
target: If, however, the sore is unchanged so far as the priest can see, and if black hair has grown in it, the affected person is healed. They are clean, and the priest shall pronounce them clean.

source: Pasal ham ahiloule numei hamin atahsa vuna chu ahung vamdoh, akang hung vamdoh aneija ahile;
target: “When a man or woman has white spots on the skin,

source: Chuteng thempupan avetding ahi: chule ativun ahung vamdoh hochu akangdup leh, hichu avuna tikang hung umdoh-a ahin; ama atheng ahi.
target: the priest is to examine them, and if the spots are dull white, it is a harmless rash that has broken out on the skin; they are clean.

source: Chule pasal alua kona asam pullha-a chu luchai ahin, atheng ahi.
target: “A man who has lost his hair and is bald is clean.

source: Chule pasal alujang mailam panga asam pullha-a chu dehchai ahin; ama atheng ahi.
target: If he has lost his hair from the front of his scalp and has a bald forehead, he is clean.

source: Chule ijemtia aluchai ahiloule adehchai laija chu tina sandang khat ahung bohdoh-a ahile, hichu aluchai ahiloule adehchai laija phahnat hung pongdoh chu ahi.
target: But if he has a reddish-white sore on his bald head or forehead, it is a defiling disease breaking out on his head or forehead.

source: Chuteng thempupan hichu avetding, chule veuvin, aluchai ahiloule dehchai laija tina hung bohdoh chu tivun danga phahna hung pongdoh tobanga asandang ahile;
target: The priest is to examine him, and if the swollen sore on his head or forehead is reddish-white like a defiling skin disease,

source: Amachu miphah ahin, aboh ahitai: thempupan amachu aboh tahbeh ahi tia aphondoh ding ahi; hise chu alujanga uma ahitai.
target: the man is diseased and is unclean. The priest shall pronounce him unclean because of the sore on his head.

source: Chule hise neija miphah chun aponho abokeh ding, chule alu tol puma ane chunglam akhu ding, chuleh athenglou, athenglou, tia asapding ahi.
target: “Anyone with such a defiling disease must wear torn clothes, let their hair be unkempt, cover the lower part of their face and cry out, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’

source: Ama-a hise chu aum laisung nikhoho lhungkeija amachu suhboh hiding ahi; ama athenglou ahin; achanga chengding ahi: gebuh pamlam chu ama chenna ding ahi.
target: As long as they have the disease they remain unclean. They must live alone; they must live outside the camp.

source: Phahna hise umna von jong chu, samul von hihen, tupat ponnel von, hijongleh,
target: “As for any fabric that is spoiled with a defiling mold—any woolen or linen clothing,

source: Akikhonto hihen akisahtho hihen, tupatpon hihen, samul pon hijongleh, savun hihen ahilouleh savuna kisem thilkhat pou pou hijongleh,
target: any woven or knitted material of linen or wool, any leather or anything made of leather—

source: Hise chu von akikhontho ham, akisahtho ham, savun ham, savun thil itobang khat pou pouva eng danga ahilouleh sandanga abe-a ahile, hichu phahna hise ahin; chule thempupa henga vetsah ding ahi.
target: if the affected area in the fabric, the leather, the woven or knitted material, or any leather article, is greenish or reddish, it is a defiling mold and must be shown to the priest.

source: Chule thempupan hise chu avetding, chule hise po-a von chu ni sagi akhatup ding ahi.
target: The priest is to examine the affected area and isolate the article for seven days.

source: Chule hise chu ni sagi lhin nileh avetding; hise chu von akikhontho ahiloule akisahtho chung, samul chung, savun chung, ahiloule savuna kisem ipi chung hijongle, hise chu akithe jala ahile; hise chu tijat umtah phahnat ahi: hichu aboh ahi.
target: On the seventh day he is to examine it, and if the mold has spread in the fabric, the woven or knitted material, or the leather, whatever its use, it is a persistent defiling mold; the article is unclean.

source: Hijeh-a chu aman chuche von chu akikhontho hihen, akisahtho hile, samula hihen, tupatna hile, ahilouleh savun thil ipi hitaleh ahallhah ding ahi; ajehchu tijat umtah phahnat ahin; hichu meija hallhah ding ahi.
target: He must burn the fabric, the woven or knitted material of wool or linen, or any leather article that has been spoiled; because the defiling mold is persistent, the article must be burned.

source: Chule thempupan avetna, chule hise chu von akikhongtho hihen, akisahtho hileh, ahilouleh savun thil kiti pou pouva chu kithejal louva ahile;
target: “But if, when the priest examines it, the mold has not spread in the fabric, the woven or knitted material, or the leather article,

source: Chutengle thempupa chun hise umna thil chu asop dinguva amaho athupeh ding, chule ni sagima hichu akhatup beding:
target: he shall order that the spoiled article be washed. Then he is to isolate it for another seven days.

source: Chule hichu akisop jouteng thempupan hise chu avetding, chule veuvin, hise chu avouso akikhelchom louva, chule hise chu akithejal louva ahile; hichu aboh ahin; nangman hichu meija nahalding ahi: hichu asunglama tijat umtah ahin; asung hihen apolam hijongle aneh ahitai.
target: After the article has been washed, the priest is to examine it again, and if the mold has not changed its appearance, even though it has not spread, it is unclean. Burn it, no matter which side of the fabric has been spoiled.

source: Chule thempupan avetna, chule veuvin, hise chu akisop jouva avom thima ahile, chuteng hichu vona kona, savuna kona, ahilouleh akikhontho le akisahtho-a kona asalhah ding ahi.
target: If, when the priest examines it, the mold has faded after the article has been washed, he is to tear the spoiled part out of the fabric, the leather, or the woven or knitted material.

source: Chule hichu von chunga akikhontho hihen, akisahtho hijongleh, chule savun pon pou pou chunga chu akilah nahlaija ahile, hichu akithejal hise ahin; nangman hise chu meija nahalding ahi.
target: But if it reappears in the fabric, in the woven or knitted material, or in the leather article, it is a spreading mold; whatever has the mold must be burned.

source: Chule von, akikhontho hihen, akisahtho hileh, ahilouleh savuna kisem itobang von hitaleh nasop ding, chule hichea kona chu hise chu apotdoh-a ahile, ani veina nasop kitding; chutengle atheng hiding ahitai.
target: Any fabric, woven or knitted material, or any leather article that has been washed and is rid of the mold, must be washed again. Then it will be clean.”

source: Hiche hohi von samula hihen, tupatna hile, akikhontho hihen, akisahtho hijongleh, ahilouleh savun thilkhat pou pouva phahna hise umchu atheng ahi, ahilouleh athenglou ahi tia phondohna ding dan chu ahi.
target: These are the regulations concerning defiling molds in woolen or linen clothing, woven or knitted material, or any leather article, for pronouncing them clean or unclean.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Hichehi miphah kisuhtheng nikho-a juiding dan chu ahi. Amachu thempupa henga ahinpui dingu;
target: “These are the regulations for any diseased person at the time of their ceremonial cleansing, when they are brought to the priest:

source: Chule thempupa chun gebuh-a kona potdoh ding; chule thempupa chun avetding, chule veuvin miphahpa chunga hise chu adam tah-a ahile;
target: The priest is to go outside the camp and examine them. If they have been healed of their defiling skin disease,

source: Chuteng thempupan akisuhtheng dingpa henga kona chu vacha theng ahing ni, chuleh Cedar thing, ponsanthip le Hyssop lah dinga athupeh ding ahi.
target: the priest shall order that two live clean birds and some cedar wood, scarlet yarn and hyssop be brought for the person to be cleansed.

source: Chule thempupa chun vacha ho lah-a khat chu leibel sunga twi lona chunga nathadiu ahi, tia athupeh ding ahi.
target: Then the priest shall order that one of the birds be killed over fresh water in a clay pot.

source: Vacha ahingpa chu ahile, cedar thing, Ponsandup chule Hyssop chu alah-a, hicheho chu vacha hing chutoh twi long chunga kithat vacha thisana chu adelut ding ahi.
target: He is then to take the live bird and dip it, together with the cedar wood, the scarlet yarn and the hyssop, into the blood of the bird that was killed over the fresh water.

source: Chule aman aphahna akona kisutheng dingpa chunga sagi vei athin ding, chule amapa chu atheng ahitai tia aphondoh ding, chule vacha hing chu gam onga alha mang ding ahi.
target: Seven times he shall sprinkle the one to be cleansed of the defiling disease, and then pronounce them clean. After that, he is to release the live bird in the open fields.

source: Chule akisutheng dingpa chun aponho asopma, chule asam jouse ahet tolla, ama athen theina dinga twija gakisil ding ahi. Chujou teng chule ama gebuh sunga hunglut ding, aponbuh pama ni sagi khongai nalai ding ahi.
target: “The person to be cleansed must wash their clothes, shave off all their hair and bathe with water; then they will be ceremonially clean. After this they may come into the camp, but they must stay outside their tent for seven days.

source: Ahinla ni sagi lhin ni-a chu aman aluchanga asam jouse, akhamul chuleh amitchung mul jouse, amulho jouse ahet ngima, chule aman aponho asopma, ama tahsa jeng jong twija asil ding ahi, chule ama theng ding ahi.
target: On the seventh day they must shave off all their hair; they must shave their head, their beard, their eyebrows and the rest of their hair. They must wash their clothes and bathe themselves with water, and they will be clean.

source: Chule niget lhin nileh aman nolna beihel kelngoinou chal ni leh, nolna beihel kelngoinou anu kumkhat lhingbep khat, chule anneh thilto ding changbong nel thao toh kihal ephah hopsom-a hopthum, chule thao log khat ahin choiding ahi.
target: “On the eighth day they must bring two male lambs and one ewe lamb a year old, each without defect, along with three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil for a grain offering, and one log of oil.

source: Chule ama suthenga pang thempupa chun akisutheng dingpa le chuche thil ho chu houkhom ho houbuh kotphunga apehlut ding ahi.
target: The priest who pronounces them clean shall present both the one to be cleansed and their offerings before the Lord at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

source: Chule thempupa chun kelngoinou khat chule thao log khat chu alah-a, suhkhel thilto dinga ato-a, chule Pakai angsunga jap thilto-a ajap ding ahi.
target: “Then the priest is to take one of the male lambs and offer it as a guilt offering, along with the log of oil; he shall wave them before the Lord as a wave offering.

source: Chule aman kelngoinou chu chonset thilto chule govam thilto athana ding munthenga mun'a chu athading ahi; ajehchu chonset thilto thempupa-a ahibanga, suhkhel thilto jong chutobangma chu hija ahin; hichu atheng chungnung ahi.
target: He is to slaughter the lamb in the sanctuary area where the sin offering and the burnt offering are slaughtered. Like the sin offering, the guilt offering belongs to the priest; it is most holy.

source: Chule thempupa chun suhkhel thilto thisan chu phabep alah-a, thempupan hichu akisutheng dingpa jetlam bilmong, akhut jetlam khutpi chung, le akeng jetlam kengpi chunga anuding ahi.
target: The priest is to take some of the blood of the guilt offering and put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot.

source: Chule thempupan thao log khatna kona chu phabep alah-a, aveilam khutphang chunga alheilhah ding ahi.
target: The priest shall then take some of the log of oil, pour it in the palm of his own left hand,

source: Chule thempupan akhut veilama um thaova chu akhut jetlam khut jung adelutna, akhut junga thao chu Pakai anga sagivei athe ding ahi.
target: dip his right forefinger into the oil in his palm, and with his finger sprinkle some of it before the Lord seven times.

source: Chule akhutna umnalai thao amohse chu thempupa chun akisutheng dingpa jetlam bilmong, ajetlam khutpi, ajetlam kengpi chunga, chule suhkhel thilto thisan chunga chu anuding ahi.
target: The priest is to put some of the oil remaining in his palm on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot, on top of the blood of the guilt offering.

source: Chule thempupa khutna thao umnalai amohchu aman akisutheng dingpa lujanga asunlhah ding, chule thempupan ama dinga chu Pakai anga longlhena abolpeh ding ahi.
target: The rest of the oil in his palm the priest shall put on the head of the one to be cleansed and make atonement for them before the Lord .

source: Chule thempupa chun chonset thilto chu ato-a, athen louna-a kona kisutheng dingpa-a dinga longlhenna abolpeh ding; chule aman govam thilto chu athading ahi.
target: “Then the priest is to sacrifice the sin offering and make atonement for the one to be cleansed from their uncleanness. After that, the priest shall slaughter the burnt offering

source: Chule thempupan maicham chunga um govam thilto le anneh thilto chu atoding, chule thempupan ama dinga longlhena abolpeh ding: chuteng ama atheng hiding ahitai.
target: and offer it on the altar, together with the grain offering, and make atonement for them, and they will be clean.

source: Ahinla ama chu mivaicha ahia, chuchengpi chu atojou louva ahile, aman alonglhena kibolna dinga suhkhel thilto-a jap dinga kelngoinou khat ahin kaiding; chule anneh thilto-a dinga changbong neljet thao toh kihal ephah hopsom-a hopkhat le thao log khat,
target: “If, however, they are poor and cannot afford these, they must take one male lamb as a guilt offering to be waved to make atonement for them, together with a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil for a grain offering, a log of oil,

source: Chule aman amujou dandana vapal ni ahiloule vakhu nou ni; khat chu chonset thilto ding le adang khat chu govam thilto dinga ahinchoi ding ahi.
target: and two doves or two young pigeons, such as they can afford, one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.

source: Chule hicheho chu aman niget lhin nileh akisuhtheng nadinga thempupa henga, houkhom ho Houbuh kotphunga Pakai angsunga chu ahin choiding ahi.
target: “On the eighth day they must bring them for their cleansing to the priest at the entrance to the tent of meeting, before the Lord .

source: Chule thempupa chun suhkhel thilto kelngoinou leh thao log dimkhat chu alah ding, chule thempupa chun hichu Pakai anga jap thilto ato ding;
target: The priest is to take the lamb for the guilt offering, together with the log of oil, and wave them before the Lord as a wave offering.

source: Chuteng aman suhkhel thilto kelngoinou chu athading, chule thempupa chun chuche suhkhel thilto thisan phabep chu alah-a, akisutheng dingpa jetlam bilmong chunga, ajetlam khutpi chunga, chule ajetlam kengpi chunga anuding ahi.
target: He shall slaughter the lamb for the guilt offering and take some of its blood and put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot.

source: Chule thempupa chun thao chu ama khutphang veilam chunga alheilhah ding,
target: The priest is to pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand,

source: Chule thempupa chun akhut veilama um thao chu ajetlam khutjunga sagi vei Pakai angsunga athe ding,
target: and with his right forefinger sprinkle some of the oil from his palm seven times before the Lord .

source: Chule thempupa chun akhutna thao chu akisutheng dingpa jetlam bilmong chunga, ajetlam akhutpi chung, ajetlam kengpi chunga, chule suhkhel thilto thisan chunga chu anuding ahi.
target: Some of the oil in his palm he is to put on the same places he put the blood of the guilt offering—on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot.

source: Chule thempupa khutna aum nalaiho sechu, aman akisutheng dingpa lujanga anua, amapa-a dinga chu Pakai anga longlhena abolpeh ding ahi.
target: The rest of the oil in his palm the priest shall put on the head of the one to be cleansed, to make atonement for them before the Lord .

source: Chule aman amapan amujou dungjuija ahinchoi vakhu teni ahilou leh vapal nou teni chu lah-a, khat chu atoding,
target: Then he shall sacrifice the doves or the young pigeons, such as the person can afford,

source: Amapan amujou dungjuija khat chonset thilto dinga, chule adang khat chu anneh thilto le govam thilto dinga ahinchoi ding, chule thempupa chun Pakai anga akisutheng dingpa chu longlhena abolpeh ding ahi.
target: one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, together with the grain offering. In this way the priest will make atonement before the Lord on behalf of the one to be cleansed.”

source: Hichehi koi hileh phah hise veija, akhutna akisuhtheng nadinga kimujou louho chunga kimang ding dan chu ahi.
target: These are the regulations for anyone who has a defiling skin disease and who cannot afford the regular offerings for their cleansing.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

source: Keiman nalodiuva kapeh-u Canaan gam nahung lutnuva, chule keiman nalonao gamsunga chu insung khatna phah hise kachuhsah tengleh;
target: “When you enter the land of Canaan, which I am giving you as your possession, and I put a spreading mold in a house in that land,

source: Chuche inneipa chu thempupa henga hunga, Insunga hin hise khat um bangin kahe-e, tia aseiding ahi.
target: the owner of the house must go and tell the priest, ‘I have seen something that looks like a defiling mold in my house.’

source: Chutengle thempupa chun chuche insunga umjouse chu abona aboh ahilouna dinga, ama hise phochen dinga insunga asunglhah masanga, a-in chu amahon asuh-ong nadiuva thupeh apehding ahi. Chujou tengle thempupa chu insung vedinga sunglha ding ahi.
target: The priest is to order the house to be emptied before he goes in to examine the mold, so that nothing in the house will be pronounced unclean. After this the priest is to go in and inspect the house.

source: Chule aman hise avetna, chule veuvin, hise chu in-bang dunga auma, engdang ahilouleh sandang banga akilah-a, bang sanga athuhlut joh-a ahile,
