target: He is to examine the mold on the walls, and if it has greenish or reddish depressions that appear to be deeper than the surface of the wall,

source: Chuteng thempupa chu insunga kona kotphunga hungdoh-a, a-in chu nisagi akhatup ding ahi.
target: the priest shall go out the doorway of the house and close it up for seven days.

source: Chule thempupa chu nisagi nile hungkitna, avetding, chule hise chu chuche inbang ho-a ana challa ahile;
target: On the seventh day the priest shall return to inspect the house. If the mold has spread on the walls,

source: Chuteng thempupa chun hise umna in'a song ho chu alahdoh diuva athupeh ding, chule amahon song ho chu khopi pam muntheng lou khatna aselut dingu;
target: he is to order that the contaminated stones be torn out and thrown into an unclean place outside the town.

source: Chule aman a-insung kimvel chu ahet theng sah ding, chule amahon ahet lhah-u vutvai chu khopi pam muntheng lou mun khatna agasun lhah dingu ahi.
target: He must have all the inside walls of the house scraped and the material that is scraped off dumped into an unclean place outside the town.

source: Chule amahon song chombeh alah uva, chuche songho umna-a chu akoikhel dingu, chule aman leingan dang alah-a, in chu aloithah ding ahi.
target: Then they are to take other stones to replace these and take new clay and plaster the house.

source: Chule ijemtia aman songho alahdoh-a, a-in chu ahet ngima, chule aloithah kit jouva, hise chu ahungkitna chuche insunga chu ahung sokitna ahile;
target: “If the defiling mold reappears in the house after the stones have been torn out and the house scraped and plastered,

source: Chutengle thempupa chu hunga avetding, chule hise chu insunga kithe jalsoh-a ahile; insunga chu tijat umtah hise chua ahitan; chule hichu athenglou ahitai.
target: the priest is to go and examine it and, if the mold has spread in the house, it is a persistent defiling mold; the house is unclean.

source: Chule aman a-in, asongho, athing ho, chule aloina jouse asuhsetna, chule khopi polam muntheng lou laija apohdoh ding ahi.
target: It must be torn down—its stones, timbers and all the plaster—and taken out of the town to an unclean place.

source: Chujongle chuche in khachah-a aum laisungse-a chu koitobang agalutna aumle, amachu nilhah tokah-a atheng louva umding ahi.
target: “Anyone who goes into the house while it is closed up will be unclean till evening.

source: Chule chuche insunga galum kha-a chun aponho akisopma, chule chuche insunga gane kha-a chun aponho akisop ding ahi.
target: Anyone who sleeps or eats in the house must wash their clothes.

source: Chule a-in kiloithah jouva chu thempupa ahung lutna, ahungvetna, chuleh a-insunga hise chu kithejal soh louva ahile; thempupa chun in chu atheng ahi tia aphonding ahi: ajehchu hise chu dama ahitai.
target: “But if the priest comes to examine it and the mold has not spread after the house has been plastered, he shall pronounce the house clean, because the defiling mold is gone.

source: Chule aman in suhtheng nadinga vacha ni, Cedar thing le Ponsanthip, chuleh Hyssop alah ding,
target: To purify the house he is to take two birds and some cedar wood, scarlet yarn and hyssop.

source: Chule vacha teni lah-a khat chu leibel sunga twilong chunga athading,
target: He shall kill one of the birds over fresh water in a clay pot.

source: Chule aman cedar thing, hyssop, ponsanthip, chule vahing chu alah-a, vacha kithat thisan sungle twi longa adelut ding, chule in chu sagi vei athekhum ding;
target: Then he is to take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet yarn and the live bird, dip them into the blood of the dead bird and the fresh water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

source: Chule aman vacha thisana, twilonga, Cedar thinga, hyssopma, chule ponsanthipma in chu asuhtheng ding ahi.
target: He shall purify the house with the bird’s blood, the fresh water, the live bird, the cedar wood, the hyssop and the scarlet yarn.

source: Ahin aman vacha hing vangchu khopi pampeh gam onga agalha doh ding; chule chuche insung dinga chu longlhena abolding; chule hichu atheng hiding ahitai.
target: Then he is to release the live bird in the open fields outside the town. In this way he will make atonement for the house, and it will be clean.”

source: Hiche hi phah hise jouse le tithah jouse,
target: These are the regulations for any defiling skin disease, for a sore,

source: Chule vonphah, inphah,
target: for defiling molds in fabric or in a house,

source: Apomdoh, akhihdoh, chule avamdoh-a dinga dan chu ahin,
target: and for a swelling, a rash or a shiny spot,

source: Athenlou pet le athen pet kihetna dinga kihilna chu ahi: hiche hi phah chung changa dan chu ahi.
target: to determine when something is clean or unclean. These are the regulations for defiling skin diseases and defiling molds.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

source: Israel chate henga thu seilhonin lang, ajah uva hitin seilhonin, Pasal khattou atahsa-a kona longdoh thi neija ahile, hiche athi lonjeh-a chu amachu aboh hiding ahi.
target: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When any man has an unusual bodily discharge, such a discharge is unclean.

source: Hiche hi athilong doh-a kona abohna hiding ahi: athi longdoh atahsa-a kona ahung londoh jenga, ahiloule atahsa-a kona alondohsah da-a ahijongle, amachu athenglou ahi.
target: Whether it continues flowing from his body or is blocked, it will make him unclean. This is how his discharge will bring about uncleanness:

source: Thilongdoh neipa galupna jalkhun tapou chu aboh ahin, chule ama toupha thil jouse jongchu aboh hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘Any bed the man with a discharge lies on will be unclean, and anything he sits on will be unclean.

source: Chule thilongdohpa lupna tongkha tapou chun aponho asop ding, amatah twija kisil ding, chule nilhah kah-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: Anyone who touches his bed must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

source: Chule thilongdoh pa toupha thil tapou chunga gatouva chun aponho asop ding, amatah twija kisil ding, chule nilhah kah-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: Whoever sits on anything that the man with a discharge sat on must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

source: Chule thilongdoh neipa tahsa tongkha tapou chun aponho akisop ding, amatah twija kisil ding, chule nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘Whoever touches the man who has a discharge must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

source: Chule thilongdohpa chun mi atheng khattou achil aset khum khah-a ahileh, amapan aponho asopding, amatah twija kisil, chule nilhah kah-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘If the man with the discharge spits on anyone who is clean, they must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

source: Chule thilongdohpa touna tapou chu aboh hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘Everything the man sits on when riding will be unclean,

source: Chule koi hile ama delpha thil tapou gatongkha chan chu nilhah kahse-a aboh hiding; chutobang thilho tapou pole-a chun aponho akisop ding, amatah twija kisil, chule nilhah kah-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: and whoever touches any of the things that were under him will be unclean till evening; whoever picks up those things must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

source: Koihileh thilongdohpa tongkha-a twija akhut teni soplou chun, aponho akisop ding, amatah twija kisil, chule nilhah kah-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘Anyone the man with a discharge touches without rinsing his hands with water must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

source: Chule thilongdoh pan atohkhah leija kisem umle bel tapou chu suhkeh ding, chule thinga kisem umle bel tapou chu twija silding ahi.
target: “ ‘A clay pot that the man touches must be broken, and any wooden article is to be rinsed with water.

source: Chule thilong neipa chu athilon na-a kona suhthenga aumteng, aman akisuhtheng nading nisagi akisimdoh ding, aponho asopma, chule atahsa chu twilonga asil ding, chule atheng hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘When a man is cleansed from his discharge, he is to count off seven days for his ceremonial cleansing; he must wash his clothes and bathe himself with fresh water, and he will be clean.

source: Chule aniget chan nileh aman vapal nou ni ahiloule vakhu ni akilah-a Pakai anga houkhom ho Houbuh kotphunga hunga chule hichu thempu apeh ding ahi.
target: On the eighth day he must take two doves or two young pigeons and come before the Lord to the entrance to the tent of meeting and give them to the priest.

source: Chule thempu chun khat chu chonset thilto-a, chule adangkhat chu govam thilto-a atoding; chule thempupa chun Pakai anga athilondoh jeh-a chu ama dinga longlhena abolpeh ding ahi.
target: The priest is to sacrifice them, the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. In this way he will make atonement before the Lord for the man because of his discharge.

source: Chule pasal khattou abotwi achedoh tah-a ahile, aman atahsa twija asilding, chule nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘When a man has an emission of semen, he must bathe his whole body with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

source: Chule chuche abotwi chuhna pon le savunho jouse chu twija sopding, chule nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: Any clothing or leather that has semen on it must be washed with water, and it will be unclean till evening.

source: Chujongle numei chu pasal to alupkhoma, amapa botwi chu apotdoh-a ahile, anilhona twija kisilding, chule nilhah kahse-a aboh hilhon ding ahi.
target: When a man has sexual relations with a woman and there is an emission of semen, both of them must bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

source: Chule numei jin ama-a kona thil longdoh aneija, chule atahsa-a kona longdoh chu thisan ahia ahile; amanu chu ni sagi chom koidoh ding ahi: chule koi hileh amanu tongkha-a chu nilhah kahse-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘When a woman has her regular flow of blood, the impurity of her monthly period will last seven days, and anyone who touches her will be unclean till evening.

source: Chule amanun aga chom um sunga agalup pha chule aga toupha thil tapou ho chu aboh hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘Anything she lies on during her period will be unclean, and anything she sits on will be unclean.

source: Koi hileh amanu jalkhun gatongkha tapou chun aponho asopding, amatah twija kisil ding, chule nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: Anyone who touches her bed will be unclean; they must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

source: Koihileh amanun atoupha thil tapou gatongkha chun, aponho asopding, amatah twija kisil ding, chule nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: Anyone who touches anything she sits on will be unclean; they must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

source: Amanu jalkhun chunga um hihen, atoupha thil khattou hileh, amapan agatoh khah leh, amapa chu nilhah kahse-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: Whether it is the bed or anything she was sitting on, when anyone touches it, they will be unclean till evening.

source: Chule pasal'in amanu aluppi jengtah-a, amanu thi chu amapa chunga abeleh, amapa chu ni sagi aboh hiding; chule alupna jalkhun jouse chu aboh hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘If a man has sexual relations with her and her monthly flow touches him, he will be unclean for seven days; any bed he lies on will be unclean.

source: Chule numei khatnin angaina banglouva nitamtah thi aneija, ahiloule achoma aumna phat valsetna thi aneija ahile; athilon na-a athenlouna nikhosung sese chu amanu achoma aumna nikho hiding ahi; amanu chu aboh hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘When a woman has a discharge of blood for many days at a time other than her monthly period or has a discharge that continues beyond her period, she will be unclean as long as she has the discharge, just as in the days of her period.

source: Thilonga aumsung se-a alupna jalkhun tapou chu amanu dinga chom koidoh-a aumna jalkhun tobang ding ahi. Chuleh amanun atoupha thil tapou chu, achoma aum sunga aboh banga aboh hiding ahi.
target: Any bed she lies on while her discharge continues will be unclean, as is her bed during her monthly period, and anything she sits on will be unclean, as during her period.

source: Chule koihile chuche thilho tongkha-a chu aboh hiding ahin, aponho akisopma, amatah jong twija kisila, chule nilhah tokah-a aboh hiding ahi.
target: Anyone who touches them will be unclean; they must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

source: Ahinla athilonna-a kona chu athen tah-a ahile, amanun ama-a dinga nisagi akisimdoh ding, chujouteng amanu atheng hiding ahitai.
target: “ ‘When she is cleansed from her discharge, she must count off seven days, and after that she will be ceremonially clean.

source: Chule aniget chanileh amanun vapal ni ahilouleh vapal nou ni akilah-a, houkhom ho houbuh kotkhah phunga thempupa henga ahin choiding ahi.
target: On the eighth day she must take two doves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

source: Chuteng thempupa chun khat chu chonset thilto-a, chule khat chu govam thilto-a ato ding, amanu thenlouna thilongdoh jeh-a chu amanu-a dinga Pakai angsunga longlhena abolpeh ding ahi.
target: The priest is to sacrifice one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. In this way he will make atonement for her before the Lord for the uncleanness of her discharge.

source: Chutia chu amahon alah uva um houkhom ho houbuh chu asuhboh tenguleh, athenlou naova athilouna dinguva, nanghon Israel chate chu thenlouna-a kona nakhendoh dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘You must keep the Israelites separate from things that make them unclean, so they will not die in their uncleanness for defiling my dwelling place, which is among them.’ ”

source: Hichehi ama-a kona thilondoh jeh le, abotwi chedoh jeh-a thenglouho,
target: These are the regulations for a man with a discharge, for anyone made unclean by an emission of semen,

source: Chule athilon jeh-a dammo-a numei, chuleh athi longa pasal le numei, chule thinei numei lupia pasal ho-a dinga danthu chu ahi.
target: for a woman in her monthly period, for a man or a woman with a discharge, and for a man who has sexual relations with a woman who is ceremonially unclean.

source: Aaron chapaten Pakai angsunga thilto aneipet lhona athilhon jouvin, Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin,
target: The Lord spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron who died when they approached the Lord .

source: nasopi Aaron henga, athilouna dingin thingkhong chunga hepi touna masanga ponjal sunga um muntheng sunga aphat jouse-a ahunglut louna dingin seipeh-in; ajehchu hepi touna chunga chu keima meiloma kahung kilah ding ahi, ati.
target: The Lord said to Moses: “Tell your brother Aaron that he is not to come whenever he chooses into the Most Holy Place behind the curtain in front of the atonement cover on the ark, or else he will die. For I will appear in the cloud over the atonement cover.

source: Aaron chu muntheng sunga hitia hi hunglut ding ahi: chonset thilto dinga bongchalnou khat, govam thilto dinga kelngoichal khat.
target: “This is how Aaron is to enter the Most Holy Place: He must first bring a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

source: Aman tupat sangkhol theng chu aki-ah-a, atahsa chunga chu tupat pon chu akichen ding, tupat konggah akigah-a, chule tupat lukhuh chu akikhuh ding ahi: hichehohi vontheng ahin, hijeh-a chu aman atahsa twija akisila, chuleh akivon ding bou ahi.
target: He is to put on the sacred linen tunic, with linen undergarments next to his body; he is to tie the linen sash around him and put on the linen turban. These are sacred garments; so he must bathe himself with water before he puts them on.

source: Chule Israel chate houkhom ho-a kona chu chonset thilto-a dinga kelnou ni leh govam thilto-a dinga kelngoichal khat alahding ahi.
target: From the Israelite community he is to take two male goats for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

source: Chule Aaron'in ama chonset thilto bongchal chu ama dinga atoa, ama-a dingle a-insung dinga longlhena abolding ahi.
target: “Aaron is to offer the bull for his own sin offering to make atonement for himself and his household.

source: Chuteng aman kelcha ni chu alah-a, houkhom ho Houbuh kotkhah phunga Pakai angsunga apehdoh ding ahi.
target: Then he is to take the two goats and present them before the Lord at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

source: Chule Aaron'in kelcha ni chunga chu, khatchu Pakaiya dinga, chule adangkhat chu keldai dinga vangvetna aneiding ahi.
target: He is to cast lots for the two goats—one lot for the Lord and the other for the scapegoat.

source: Chule Aaron'in Pakaiya dinga vang chuhna kelcha chu ahinkaija, chonset thilto-a atoding ahi.
target: Aaron shall bring the goat whose lot falls to the Lord and sacrifice it for a sin offering.

source: Ahinla keldai dinga achunga vang chuhna kelcha chu, longlhenna bolna-a mandinga ahinga Pakaiya apehlut ding, chule keldai dinga gamthipma agalhadoh ding ahi.
target: But the goat chosen by lot as the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the Lord to be used for making atonement by sending it into the wilderness as a scapegoat.

source: Chule Aaron'in ama chonset thilto-a ding bongchal chu ahin kaija, ama le a-insung dinga longlhenna abolding, chule ama chonset thilto-a ding bongchal chu athading:
target: “Aaron shall bring the bull for his own sin offering to make atonement for himself and his household, and he is to slaughter the bull for his own sin offering.

source: Chule aman Pakai angsung maichama kona chu mei-am lhengkhat dim leh akhut dimsetna gimnamtui dimset kisubong chu alah ding, chule pondal sunga achoilut ding ahi.
target: He is to take a censer full of burning coals from the altar before the Lord and two handfuls of finely ground fragrant incense and take them behind the curtain.

source: Chuteng aman hiche gimnamtui khu chun hettohsahna thingkhong chunga um hepi touna chu akhu-a chutia chu ama athi louna dinga, Pakai angsunga gimnamtui chu meisunga akoilutding ahi.
target: He is to put the incense on the fire before the Lord , and the smoke of the incense will conceal the atonement cover above the tablets of the covenant law, so that he will not die.

source: Chule aman bongchal thisan chu alah-a, hichu akhutjunga hepi touna chung solam sanga atheding; chule hepi touna maija chu thisan chu akhut junga sagivei atheding ahi.
target: He is to take some of the bull’s blood and with his finger sprinkle it on the front of the atonement cover; then he shall sprinkle some of it with his finger seven times before the atonement cover.

source: Chujouteng aman chonset thilto kelcha chu mipi ho-a dinga atha-a, athisan chu ponbuh sunga ahin choilutna, bongchal thisan abol banga chu abolding, chule hepi touna chung le hepi touna maija chu atheding ahi.
target: “He shall then slaughter the goat for the sin offering for the people and take its blood behind the curtain and do with it as he did with the bull’s blood: He shall sprinkle it on the atonement cover and in front of it.

source: Chule aman Israel chateho chu athenlou jeh-u le asuhkhel uva achonset jeh uva, munthenga dinga chu longlhenna abolpeh ding ahi: chule hitia chu athenlou nalah uva um houkhom ho houbuh-a dinga chu abolding ahi.
target: In this way he will make atonement for the Most Holy Place because of the uncleanness and rebellion of the Israelites, whatever their sins have been. He is to do the same for the tent of meeting, which is among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

source: Chule ama muntheng sunga ama le a-insung ding, chule Israel houkhom ho jouse dinga longlhenna boldinga agalutna chule ahungdoh kahse-a, koimacha houkhom ho Houbuh sunga chu umlou ding ahi.
target: No one is to be in the tent of meeting from the time Aaron goes in to make atonement in the Most Holy Place until he comes out, having made atonement for himself, his household and the whole community of Israel.

source: Chule Pakai angsunga um maicham mun'a chu che-a, hiche dinga chu longlhenna aga bolding; chule bongchal thisan le kelcha thisan chu phabep alah-a, maicham sakiho chunga chu akoi kimvel ding ahi.
target: “Then he shall come out to the altar that is before the Lord and make atonement for it. He shall take some of the bull’s blood and some of the goat’s blood and put it on all the horns of the altar.

source: Chule aman hiche chunga chu akhutjunga thisan sagivei athea, asuhthenga, Israel chate athenlou naova kona asuhtheng ding ahi.
target: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times to cleanse it and to consecrate it from the uncleanness of the Israelites.

source: Chule aman muntheng le houkhom ho Houbuh chule maicham chu kichamna aboljou tengleh, kelcha hing chu ahin kaiding:
target: “When Aaron has finished making atonement for the Most Holy Place, the tent of meeting and the altar, he shall bring forward the live goat.

source: Chule Aaron'in akhut teni chu kelcha lujanga angapma, achunga chu Israel chateho khangitlouna jouse, asuhkhel nao jouse leh achonsetnao jouse aphondoh-a, kelcha lujanga akoija, chule mihem aboldinga kilom khat khutna gamthipma aga lhadohsah ding ahi.
target: He is to lay both hands on the head of the live goat and confess over it all the wickedness and rebellion of the Israelites—all their sins—and put them on the goat’s head. He shall send the goat away into the wilderness in the care of someone appointed for the task.

source: Kelcha chun amaho khangitlouna jouse chu achunga apoh-a, koima chen louna gama apohlut ding; chule mipa chun kelcha chu gamthipma agalha ding ahi.
target: The goat will carry on itself all their sins to a remote place; and the man shall release it in the wilderness.

source: Chujouteng Aaron chu houkhom ho houbuh sunga hunga, munthenga agalut petna avonho, tupat vonho chu asuhlhah-a, chua chu adalhah ding ahi.
target: “Then Aaron is to go into the tent of meeting and take off the linen garments he put on before he entered the Most Holy Place, and he is to leave them there.

source: Chule aman munthenga um twija atahsa akisila, avonho akivona, chule hungdoh-a govam thilto, mipi ho govam thilto chu atoding, chule ama-a ding le mipi ho-a dinga longlhenna abolding ahi.
target: He shall bathe himself with water in the sanctuary area and put on his regular garments. Then he shall come out and sacrifice the burnt offering for himself and the burnt offering for the people, to make atonement for himself and for the people.

source: Chule chonset thilto thao chu maicham chunga agoding ahi.
target: He shall also burn the fat of the sin offering on the altar.

source: Chule keldai dinga kelcha galhadohpa chun aponho akisop ding, chule atahsa twija asila, chujouteng gebuh sunga hunglut ding ahi.
target: “The man who releases the goat as a scapegoat must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water; afterward he may come into the camp.

source: Chule thisan munthenga longlhen bolna-a kipolut chonset thilto-a ding bongchal le chonset thilto-a ding kelcha chu khatnin gebuh pama apohdoh ding; chule amahon avunho, apheho le a-eh ho chu meija agodiu ahi.
target: The bull and the goat for the sin offerings, whose blood was brought into the Most Holy Place to make atonement, must be taken outside the camp; their hides, flesh and intestines are to be burned up.

source: Hitiho meija gagoupa chun aponho asopding, ama chu twija atahsa akisil ding, chujouteng leh gebuh sunga hunglut ding ahi.
target: The man who burns them must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water; afterward he may come into the camp.

source: Chule hichehi nangho dinga a-itih-a chondan hiding ahi: lhasagi chana nisom lhin nikhole nanghon nahinnao nakisuh gim dingu, nagamsung miu hihen lang, gamdangmi nalah uva khopen hijongle natoh kiti him him natohlou dingu ahi.
target: “This is to be a lasting ordinance for you: On the tenth day of the seventh month you must deny yourselves and not do any work—whether native-born or a foreigner residing among you—

source: Ijeh inem itileh Pakai angsunga nachonset nahou jouse-a kona nathen theina dinguva, chuche nikho teng chuleh nangho suhthengna dinga thempun nangho dinga longlhenna nabolpeh dingu ahi.
target: because on this day atonement will be made for you, to cleanse you. Then, before the Lord , you will be clean from all your sins.

source: Hiche nikho chu nangho dinga choldona dinga cholngah ni hiding, chule a-itih-a chondan hidinga nahinnao nasuh gim dingu ahi.
target: It is a day of sabbath rest, and you must deny yourselves; it is a lasting ordinance.

source: Chule aman apa khela thempu tohmuna natong dinga thao anua, akatdoh thempupa chun longlhenna chu abolding, chule tupat ponho le vontheng ho jeng jong chu akivon ding ahi.
target: The priest who is anointed and ordained to succeed his father as high priest is to make atonement. He is to put on the sacred linen garments

source: Chule aman munthenga dinga longlhenna abolding, maicham leh houkhom ho houbuh-a dinga longlhenna abolding, chule thempuho leh houkhom mipi ho-a dinga longlhenna abolding ahi.
target: and make atonement for the Most Holy Place, for the tent of meeting and the altar, and for the priests and all the members of the community.

source: Hichehi Israel chatea dinga kumkhatna khatvei achonset nahou jouse jeh-a longlhenna bolna dinga, nangho-a kipe a-itih-a chondan hiding chu ahi. Chuin aman Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangin aboltan ahi.
target: “This is to be a lasting ordinance for you: Atonement is to be made once a year for all the sins of the Israelites.” And it was done, as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Aaron, achapate, chule Israel chate jouse henga hitin seijin; Hichehi Pakaiyin athupeh hochu ahi,
target: “Speak to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites and say to them: ‘This is what the Lord has commanded:

source: Israel insung mi koihileh gebuh sung ahiloule gebuh pama bongchal ham, kelngoi ham, ahilouleh kelcha ham thatna auma,
target: Any Israelite who sacrifices an ox, a lamb or a goat in the camp or outside of it

source: Pakai Houbuh masanga Pakai henga thilto-a to dinga houkhom ho houbuh kotphunga ahinchoi louva ahileh; thisan kiso mona chu aman akipoh ding ahi; aman thisan aso ahin; hiche mipa chu amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding:
target: instead of bringing it to the entrance to the tent of meeting to present it as an offering to the Lord in front of the tabernacle of the Lord —that person shall be considered guilty of bloodshed; they have shed blood and must be cut off from their people.

source: Hichu Israel chaten gam onga ganlhainaho abol hou chu ahin choijuva, Pakai henga, houkhom ho houbuh kotphung, thempupa henga ahin choijuva, Pakai henga chamna thilto-a dinga ato theina dingu ahi.
target: This is so the Israelites will bring to the Lord the sacrifices they are now making in the open fields. They must bring them to the priest, that is, to the Lord , at the entrance to the tent of meeting and sacrifice them as fellowship offerings.

source: Chule thempu chun thisan chu houkhom ho houbuh kot phunga Pakai maicham chunga athea, chule athao chu Pakai henga gimnamtui hidinga ahalding ahi.
target: The priest is to splash the blood against the altar of the Lord at the entrance to the tent of meeting and burn the fat as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

source: Chule amahon anajonpiu thilhaho henga chu ganlhaina abolkit loudiu ahitai. Hichehi amaho dinga akhang akhanga a-itih-a chondanu hiding ahi.
target: They must no longer offer any of their sacrifices to the goat idols to whom they prostitute themselves. This is to be a lasting ordinance for them and for the generations to come.’

source: Chule nangham amaho henga chu, Israel insungmi hihen ahiloule gamdang mi nangho lah-a hung khopem hijongle, koitobang govam thilto ganlhaina toh-a,
target: “Say to them: ‘Any Israelite or any foreigner residing among them who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice

source: Pakai henga todoh dinga houkhom ho houbuh kotphunga hinchoilou auma ahile; hiche mipa ngei chu amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi.
target: and does not bring it to the entrance to the tent of meeting to sacrifice it to the Lord must be cut off from the people of Israel.

source: Chule koitobang Israel insung mi hihen,ahilouleh gamdang mi nangho lah-a khopem hijongle thisan ne aumleh; thisan ne mi chu keiman kamaingat ding, chule amite lah-a kona kapaidoh ding ahi.
target: “ ‘I will set my face against any Israelite or any foreigner residing among them who eats blood, and I will cut them off from the people.

source: Ijehnem itile tahsa hinna hi thisana um ahin: chule hichu nahinna uva dinga longlhen bolna dinga maicham chunga nangho kapeh nahiuve: ijeh inem itile hinna-a dinga longlhen bola chu thisan ahi.
target: For the life of a creature is in the blood, and I have given it to you to make atonement for yourselves on the altar; it is the blood that makes atonement for one’s life.

source: Hijeh-a chu, Nangho koimachan thisan nanehlou dingu, chule nalah uva khopem gamdangmi koimachan jong thisan anehlou ding ahi, tia Israel chate henga kasei ahi.
target: Therefore I say to the Israelites, “None of you may eat blood, nor may any foreigner residing among you eat blood.”

source: Chule Israel chate lah-a kon hihen, ahiloule nalah uva khopem gamdangmi koihile gam galenga nehthei sa ahilouleh vacha gamana chun: athisan chu avatlhah sah-a, leivui avuhkhum ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Any Israelite or any foreigner residing among you who hunts any animal or bird that may be eaten must drain out the blood and cover it with earth,

source: Ajehchu hichu tahsa jouse hinna ahi; athisan chu ahinna ahi. Hijeh-a chu, Nanghon tahsa jouse hinna hi athisanu ahijeh-a, itobang tahsa thisan hileh naneh louhel dingu ahi: koihileh anea aumle amachu paidoh hiding ahi, tia Israelte henga keiman kasei ahi.
target: because the life of every creature is its blood. That is why I have said to the Israelites, “You must not eat the blood of any creature, because the life of every creature is its blood; anyone who eats it must be cut off.”

source: Chule nagam miteo hihen, ahilouleh gamdangmi hijongle, koitobang athikam ahilouleh gamsan athasa ne-a chun, aponho asopding, ama chu twija kisil ding, chule nilhah tokah-a athenglou hiding: chujou tengleh atheng hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘Anyone, whether native-born or foreigner, who eats anything found dead or torn by wild animals must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and they will be ceremonially unclean till evening; then they will be clean.

source: Ahinla aman aponho soplouva, atahsa akisil louva ahileh; akhangit louna akipoh ding ahi.
target: But if they do not wash their clothes and bathe themselves, they will be held responsible.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate henga thu seijin lang, ajah uva hitin seijin, Keima Pakai na Pathen'u kahi.
target: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘I am the Lord your God.

source: Nana chenao Egypt gam chonna banga nangho nachon loudiu, chule keiman nangho kahin lhutna Canaan gam chonna banga jong nachon louhel dingu: chule amaho chona dan jong najuilou dingu ahi.
target: You must not do as they do in Egypt, where you used to live, and you must not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. Do not follow their practices.

source: Nangho kathulhah ho-a nachon uva, chule hicheho-a chu nalam lhah theina dinguva kachona danho nanit dingu ahi; Keima Pakai na Pathen nu kahi.
target: You must obey my laws and be careful to follow my decrees. I am the Lord your God.

source: Hijeh-a chu nanghon ka chondan kisun hole keima thutanna ho nanitdiu: hichu mikhatnin anitleh ama hicheho-a chu hing ding ahi; keima Pakai kahi.
target: Keep my decrees and laws, for the person who obeys them will live by them. I am the Lord .

source: Nangho koimachan akinaipi a-insungmi sagohkeo hodohpeh dinga najot lou dingu ahi: Keima Pakai kahi.
target: “ ‘No one is to approach any close relative to have sexual relations. I am the Lord .

source: Nangman napa sagohkeo hina ahilouleh nanu sagohkeo hina chu naho dohpeh louding ahi: amanu nanu ahin, amanu sagohkeo hina chu nangman naho dohpeh louding ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not dishonor your father by having sexual relations with your mother. She is your mother; do not have relations with her.

source: Nangman napa jinu sagohkeo hina naho dohpeh louding ahi: Hichu napa sagohkeo hina ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not have sexual relations with your father’s wife; that would dishonor your father.

source: Nangman nasopi, napa chanu hihen, nanu chanu hijongle, in'a peng hihen mun danga peng hijongleh, asagohkeo hina chu naho dohpeh louding ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not have sexual relations with your sister, either your father’s daughter or your mother’s daughter, whether she was born in the same home or elsewhere.

source: Nangman nachapa chanu hihen, nachanu chanu hijongle, asagohkeo hina chu naho dohpeh louding ahi. Ajehchu amaho sagohkeo hina chu nangma sagohkeo hina ahibouve.
target: “ ‘Do not have sexual relations with your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter; that would dishonor you.

source: Napa jinu chanu, napan ahinchu nasopinu ahi, nangman amanu sagohkeo hina naho dohpeh louding ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not have sexual relations with the daughter of your father’s wife, born to your father; she is your sister.

source: Nangman napa sopinu sagohkeo hina chu naho dohpeh louding ahi. Amanu chu napa kinaipi asopinu ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not have sexual relations with your father’s sister; she is your father’s close relative.

source: Nangman nanu sopinu sagohkeo hina naho dohpeh louding ahi. Ajehchu amanu chu nanu kinaipi asopinu ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not have sexual relations with your mother’s sister, because she is your mother’s close relative.

source: Nangman napa sopipa sagohkeo hina naho dohpeh louding, nangman ama jinu jong nagajot lutlou ding ahi: amanu chu nanungah ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not dishonor your father’s brother by approaching his wife to have sexual relations; she is your aunt.

source: Nangman namounu sagohkeo hina naho dohpeh louding ahi: amanu chu nachapa jinu ahin; nangman amanu sagohkeo hina naho dohpeh louding ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not have sexual relations with your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife; do not have relations with her.

source: Nangman nasopipa jinu sagohkeo hina naho dohpeh louding ahi: nasopipa sagohkeo hina ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not have sexual relations with your brother’s wife; that would dishonor your brother.

source: Nangman numei khatleh achanu sagohkeo hina naho dohpeh louding, chule achapa chanu ahilouleh achanu chanu jeng jong asagohkeo hinao hodohpeh dinga nakipui louding ahi: ajehchu amanu kiguijoppi numei ho ahiuve: hichehi gitlouna ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not have sexual relations with both a woman and her daughter. Do not have sexual relations with either her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter; they are her close relatives. That is wickedness.

source: Chule nangman numei khatchu asopinu hinlai sungse-a, amanu suhgentheina ding le ama sagohkeo hina hodoh peh dinga asopinu chu nakipuithei louhel ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not take your wife’s sister as a rival wife and have sexual relations with her while your wife is living.

source: Chujoule athenlou jeh-a chomkoija aumlai sungse-a, nangman amanu sagohkeo hina hodoh peh dinga najot louhel ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not approach a woman to have sexual relations during the uncleanness of her monthly period.

source: Chukalvala jong nangman nakisuhboh na dinga naheng nakom inneipi chu aluppi louding ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not have sexual relations with your neighbor’s wife and defile yourself with her.

source: Chule nangman nachilhah lah-a khatcha jong Molech houna dinga meija govam dinga naphal doh louhel ding, na Pathen min jong nasuh minset louding ahi: keima Pakai kahi.
target: “ ‘Do not give any of your children to be sacrificed to Molek, for you must not profane the name of your God. I am the Lord .

source: Nangman numei toh nalupkhom banga pasal toh nalupkhom louding ahi: hiche chu thet umtah ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not have sexual relations with a man as one does with a woman; that is detestable.

source: Chule nangma nakisuhboh nadinga ganhing kiti tapou toh nalupkhom louding ahi. Numei tapou jongchu ganhing khat anga aluppi dinga gaum lou ding ahi: hichehi jon chungnung ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not have sexual relations with an animal and defile yourself with it. A woman must not present herself to an animal to have sexual relations with it; that is a perversion.

source: Hiche thil ho kiti tapouva hin nangho kisuboh hih-un: ajehchu nangho masanga kana paidoh namho chu hicheho jouse-a hi kisuboh ahiuvin:
target: “ ‘Do not defile yourselves in any of these ways, because this is how the nations that I am going to drive out before you became defiled.

source: Chule gam chu suhboh-in aumtan: hijeh-a chu keiman akhangitlou naochu talen kamat sah-a, gamsung amatah-in achengho chu ahin lohdoh ahi.
target: Even the land was defiled; so I punished it for its sin, and the land vomited out its inhabitants.

source: Hijeh-a chu nanghon keima chondanho le kathu tan naho nanit tei dingu, chule nanam mite ahiuva, gamdang mi nalah uva khopemho ahiuva jong, hiche kidah umho hi khatcha jong nabol lou dingu ahi:
target: But you must keep my decrees and my laws. The native-born and the foreigners residing among you must not do any of these detestable things,

source: (Ijeh inem itile nangho masanga agama um miho chun hiche kidah umhohi ana bolu ahin, chule gamsunghi suhboh-a anaum ahi;)
target: for all these things were done by the people who lived in the land before you, and the land became defiled.

source: Agam min nangho masanga anaumho analodoh banga, nanghon jong nasuhboh tengule nalohdoh louna diuvin.
target: And if you defile the land, it will vomit you out as it vomited out the nations that were before you.

source: Ajehchu koihile hiche kidah umho lah-a khat bolla chu, hiche tobang bola mihem chu amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi.
target: “ ‘Everyone who does any of these detestable things—such persons must be cut off from their people.

source: Hijeh-a chu namasanguva ana kibol hitobang thet umtah chonnaho hi nabol louna dingule, hitiho-a hi suhboh-a naum louna dinguva, ka thupeh hohi nanit dingu ahi: keima Pakai na Pathen'u kahi.
target: Keep my requirements and do not follow any of the detestable customs that were practiced before you came and do not defile yourselves with them. I am the Lord your God.’ ”

source: Chule Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseije, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate houkhom ho jouse henga hitihin seijin, Nangho nathen dingu ahi: ajehchu keima Pakai na Pathen'u hi atheng kahi.
target: “Speak to the entire assembly of Israel and say to them: ‘Be holy because I, the Lord your God, am holy.

source: Nangho amitakipmin nanu le napa naginuva, chule kacholngah nikho ho nanit dingu ahi, keima Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi.
target: “ ‘Each of you must respect your mother and father, and you must observe my Sabbaths. I am the Lord your God.

source: Milimho lama kihei hih-un lang, alim semthu pathen ho jong kisem hih-un: keima Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi.
target: “ ‘Do not turn to idols or make metal gods for yourselves. I am the Lord your God.

source: Nanghon Pakai henga chamna thilto longlhenna nato uva ahile, nanghon hichu nalungcham tah uva nato dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘When you sacrifice a fellowship offering to the Lord , sacrifice it in such a way that it will be accepted on your behalf.

source: Hichu natodoh nikhou le ajing nikho-a nanehjou tei dingu ahi: ijemtia ani thum ni geija um nalaija ahile, hichu meija goding ahi.
target: It shall be eaten on the day you sacrifice it or on the next day; anything left over until the third day must be burned up.

source: Chule hichu anithum ni-a akineh poupouva ahile, kidah umtah ahin; hichu kisang louding ahitai.
target: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is impure and will not be accepted.

source: Hijeh-a chu ane jouse chun Pakai thiltheng asuh minset jeh uva, akhangit lounao akipoh cheh dingu: chule hiche mihem chu amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi.
target: Whoever eats it will be held responsible because they have desecrated what is holy to the Lord ; they must be cut off from their people.

source: Nangman nagam ga na-at teng le, nangman nalou ningho jouse chu na-at sohkei louding, chule na-at na-a alhajah ho chu nakichom ngim louding ahi.
target: “ ‘When you reap the harvest of your land, do not reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest.

source: Chule nangman nalengpi thei gaho nachom ngimsel louding, nalengpi thei gaho jong aboncha nalotheng louding; hitiho chu vaichate le gamdang mi dinga nakhenpeh ding ahi: keima Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi.
target: Do not go over your vineyard a second time or pick up the grapes that have fallen. Leave them for the poor and the foreigner. I am the Lord your God.

source: Nangma naguchat louding, dihlou tah-a jong nabol louding, chule khat le khat kah-a jong jou nasei louding ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not steal. “ ‘Do not lie. “ ‘Do not deceive one another.

source: Chule nangma kamin panna jouva nakihahsel louding, na-Pathen minjong nasuh minset louding ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi.
target: “ ‘Do not swear falsely by my name and so profane the name of your God. I am the Lord .

source: Nangman naheng nakom najoulhep louding, chomjong nachom louding ahi. Akigoipa lo chu jan khovah-a jingkah geija nakoma naumsah louding ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not defraud or rob your neighbor. “ ‘Do not hold back the wages of a hired worker overnight.

source: Nangman na-ngong nagaosap louding, mitcho masanga jong kipal lhuh theina nakoi louding ahi, na-Pathen joh nagin ding ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi.
target: “ ‘Do not curse the deaf or put a stumbling block in front of the blind, but fear your God. I am the Lord .

source: Nathu tan na-a chonphat louna nabol louding ahi: nangman mivaichate chu nakhohsah chom louding, ahiloule mithaneite jong najabol chom louding: amavang chonphatah-a naheng nakom thu natan ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not pervert justice; do not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the great, but judge your neighbor fairly.

source: Chule nangma namite lah-a thuse seija nachesuh nachetouna louding: chule naheng nakom thisan thua jong jouthu-a napan louding ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi.
target: “ ‘Do not go about spreading slander among your people. “ ‘Do not do anything that endangers your neighbor’s life. I am the Lord .

source: Nangman nalungsunga nasopipa nahotbol louding: iti nama jongle nangman naheng nakom naphosal louding, chule chonset nabolsah louding ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not hate a fellow Israelite in your heart. Rebuke your neighbor frankly so you will not share in their guilt.

source: Nangman phu nalah louding, namite chateho chunga thangthipna jong nanei louding ahi, amavang nangman naheng nakom chu nangma naki ngailut banga nangailut ding ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi.
target: “ ‘Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against anyone among your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the Lord .

source: Nanghon kachondan ho nanit diu ahi. Nanghon nagancha hou chu gancha dangto nakimatsah lou dingu ahi: nanghon nalou uva muchi natu hal lou dingu ahi. Chule tupat le samul kihal von jong nachunga nakaisah louding ahi.
target: “ ‘Keep my decrees. “ ‘Do not mate different kinds of animals. “ ‘Do not plant your field with two kinds of seed. “ ‘Do not wear clothing woven of two kinds of material.

source: Chule soh numei, pasal khat dinga khao khisa, lhadoh loulai le chamlhatna peh loulai khat chu tahsa ngaichatna jeh-a khattouvin aluppia ahile, amanu chu kijepding ahi: amanu chamlhat ahiloujeh-a anilhona vang kithat louding ahi
target: “ ‘If a man sleeps with a female slave who is promised to another man but who has not been ransomed or given her freedom, there must be due punishment. Yet they are not to be put to death, because she had not been freed.

source: Chule amapa chun asuhkhelna thilto chu Pakai henga houkhom ho houbuh kotkhah bula chu ahinchoi ding, suhkhkelna thilto dinga kelngoi chal khat ahinkai ding ahi.
target: The man, however, must bring a ram to the entrance to the tent of meeting for a guilt offering to the Lord .

source: Chuteng thempupa chun amapan anabol chonsetna jeh-a chu, amapa dinga suhkhel thilto kelngoi chal chu Pakai anga atodoh-a, amapa dinga longlhenna abolpeh ding ahi: chutengle amapan anabol chonsetna chu kingaidam ding ahi.
target: With the ram of the guilt offering the priest is to make atonement for him before the Lord for the sin he has committed, and his sin will be forgiven.

source: Chule nangho chuche gama nalut uva, chule nanghon nehdinga thing namkim naphu tengule, aga chu cheptan louva nasim dingu: hichu nangho dinga kum thum cheptan lou hiding; hichu nanehlou dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘When you enter the land and plant any kind of fruit tree, regard its fruit as forbidden. For three years you are to consider it forbidden; it must not be eaten.

source: Ahinla akum li na-a vang chuche gaho jouse chu, Pakai vahchoina dinga atheng hiding ahitai.
target: In the fourth year all its fruit will be holy, an offering of praise to the Lord .

source: Chule akum nga na vang, nangho-a dinga aga asodoh thei nadinga aga naneh dingu ahi: keima Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi.
target: But in the fifth year you may eat its fruit. In this way your harvest will be increased. I am the Lord your God.

source: Nanghon imacha athisan puma nanehtha lou dingu: chule mitpheldoi le ailhim namanchah lou dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not eat any meat with the blood still in it. “ ‘Do not practice divination or seek omens.

source: Nanghon nasamu nahet tol kimvel lou dingu, chule nabeng mul hou jong aning navoset lou dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not cut the hair at the sides of your head or clip off the edges of your beard.

source: Nanghon mithiho jeh-a natahsao na-at pop lou dingu, chule nati chunguva jong imacha lim nasemlou dingu ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi.
target: “ ‘Do not cut your bodies for the dead or put tattoo marks on yourselves. I am the Lord .

source: Nangman jonthanhoi sahna dinga nachanu noti'a napansah louding ahi; achuti loule gamsung hi jonthanhoina-a hunglhun tin, gamsunghi gitlouna-a dim ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not degrade your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will turn to prostitution and be filled with wickedness.

source: Nanghon kacholngah ho nanit diu; chule kamun theng naja dingu ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi.
target: “ ‘Observe my Sabbaths and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the Lord .

source: Nanghon amaho-a kona nakisuhboh louna dingun lhakou mangchaho ngaisang hih-un, chule doithemho jong hol hih-un: keima Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi.
target: “ ‘Do not turn to mediums or seek out spiritists, for you will be defiled by them. I am the Lord your God.

source: Nangma lukangho masanga nadin doh ding, tehse mai najading, chule na Pathen nagin ding ahi: keima Pakai kahi.
target: “ ‘Stand up in the presence of the aged, show respect for the elderly and revere your God. I am the Lord .

source: Chule namdang khat nagam sunga nangho toh akhopem khoma ahile, ama chu dihlou tah-a nabol lou dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them.

source: Amavang gamdang mi nangho toh chengkhoma chu nangho-a dinga nalah uva peng tobang hiding, nangho naki ngailut banguva nangailut dingu ahi: ajehchu nangho jong Egypt gama gamdang mi nana hiu ahi: keima Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi.
target: The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt. I am the Lord your God.

source: Nanghon thutanna lam, asaotena ahin, agih tena ahin, ahiloule asan tena hijongle chonphat louna nabol lou dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not use dishonest standards when measuring length, weight or quantity.

source: Khaikot dih, gihtum dih, Ephah dih, chule hin dih nanei diu ahi: keima Egypt gama kona nahin puidoh uva Pakai na Pathen'u kahi.
target: Use honest scales and honest weights, an honest ephah and an honest hin. I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt.

source: Hijeh-a chu nanghon kachondan ho le kathutan jouse najuidiu, chule naboldiu ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi.
target: “ ‘Keep all my decrees and all my laws and follow them. I am the Lord .’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chateho henga hitihin seikitnin, Israel chate lah-a kona ahin, Israel gama khopem gamdang mi lah-a kon hijongle, koitobang Molech henga acha pe-a chu; ama chu thatei teiding ahi: agam mite chun ama chu songa asediu ahi.
target: “Say to the Israelites: ‘Any Israelite or any foreigner residing in Israel who sacrifices any of his children to Molek is to be put to death. The members of the community are to stone him.

source: Keiman amapa douna-a kamaingat ding, chule amite lah-a kona kapaidoh ding ahi; ajeh chu aman keima muntheng suhbohna ding le keima mintheng suhminset nadingin acha Molech henga apen ahi.
target: I myself will set my face against him and will cut him off from his people; for by sacrificing his children to Molek, he has defiled my sanctuary and profaned my holy name.

source: Chule itiham khatna agam mite chun amapan acha Molech henga apeh chu akimumo sah uva, chule amapa chu atha lou uva ahileh,
target: If the members of the community close their eyes when that man sacrifices one of his children to Molek and if they fail to put him to death,

source: Chuteng chule keiman amapa le a-insung mite douna-a kamaingat ding, chule Molech to jonthanhoi dinga amatoh jong jouse chu amite lah-a kona kapaidoh ding ahi.
target: I myself will set my face against him and his family and will cut them off from their people together with all who follow him in prostituting themselves to Molek.

source: Chule koi hile amaho to jong dinga lhakou ho le doithemho lama kihei tapou chu, amapa douna-a kamaingat ding, chule amite lah-a kona kapaidoh ding ahi
target: “ ‘I will set my face against anyone who turns to mediums and spiritists to prostitute themselves by following them, and I will cut them off from their people.

source: Hijeh chun nangho kisuthengun lang atheng hiuvin: ajeh chu keima Pakai na-Pathen'u kahi.
target: “ ‘Consecrate yourselves and be holy, because I am the Lord your God.

source: Chule nanghon keima chondan ho nanit uva, natohdoh dingu ahi: ajehchu keima nangho suthengpa Pakai chu kahi.
target: Keep my decrees and follow them. I am the Lord , who makes you holy.

source: Koi hile apa ahiloule anu gaosapma chu thonlouva thatei ding ahi: aman apa ahiloule anu agaosap ahin; athisan chu ama chunga chuding ahi.
target: “ ‘Anyone who curses their father or mother is to be put to death. Because they have cursed their father or mother, their blood will be on their own head.

source: Chule pasal khat pasal dang ji to jonga, aheng akompa jinu to jonga chu, ajongpa le ajongnu anilhona thatei ding ahi.
target: “ ‘If a man commits adultery with another man’s wife—with the wife of his neighbor—both the adulterer and the adulteress are to be put to death.

source: Chule pasal khat apa jinu to lumkhoma, apa sagohkeo hina hodohpeh-a chu, amani chu anilhona thatei ding ahi; amani thisan chu amani chunga chuding ahi.
target: “ ‘If a man has sexual relations with his father’s wife, he has dishonored his father. Both the man and the woman are to be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.

source: Chule pasal khat amounu to alupkhoma ahile, amani chu anilhona thatei ding ahi; amanin kidah umtah aboldoh lhon ahitai; amani thisan chu amani chunga chuding ahi.
target: “ ‘If a man has sexual relations with his daughter-in-law, both of them are to be put to death. What they have done is a perversion; their blood will be on their own heads.

source: Pasal khat apasal chanpi khattoh numei to lupkhom banga alup khoma ahile, amani chun kidah umtah abol lhon ahitan; amani chu thatei ding ahi: amani thisan amani chunga chuding ahi.
target: “ ‘If a man has sexual relations with a man as one does with a woman, both of them have done what is detestable. They are to be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.

source: Chule pasal khatnin ajinu le ajinu nu ji-a anei kopma ahile, hichu gitlouna ahi: nalah uva gitlouna aumlouna dinga amapa le amani chu meija hala umdingu ahi.
target: “ ‘If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is wicked. Both he and they must be burned in the fire, so that no wickedness will be among you.

source: Chule pasal khat gancha khattoh alupkhoma ahile, amapa chu thatei ding: chule nanghon agancha jong chu atha dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘If a man has sexual relations with an animal, he is to be put to death, and you must kill the animal.

source: Chule numei khatnin gancha khat ajotlutna, chuche tochun alupkhoma ahile, nangman numeinu le gancha chu nathatei ding ahi: amani chu thitei ding ahilhone; amani thisan chu amani chunga chuding ahi.
target: “ ‘If a woman approaches an animal to have sexual relations with it, kill both the woman and the animal. They are to be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.

source: Chule pasal khatnin asopinu, apa chanu hihen anu chanu hile akichenpi-a, aman amanu sagohkeo amua, amanun amapa sagohkeo amua ahile; hichu gilouna ahi; amani chu amiteu mitmu-a paidoh-a umlhon ding ahi: amapan asopinu sagohkeo hina chu ahodoh peh ahitan; amapan akhangit louna chu akipoh ding ahi.
target: “ ‘If a man marries his sister, the daughter of either his father or his mother, and they have sexual relations, it is a disgrace. They are to be publicly removed from their people. He has dishonored his sister and will be held responsible.

source: Chule pasal khatnin numei anatna neipet khat alupia, amanu sagoh hina ahodoh peh-a ahile; amapan amanu twinah ahodoh peh ahin, amanun athisan twinah chu ahodoh ahitai: chule amani chu anilhona amiteu lah-a kona paidoh-a umlhon ding ahi.
target: “ ‘If a man has sexual relations with a woman during her monthly period, he has exposed the source of her flow, and she has also uncovered it. Both of them are to be cut off from their people.

source: Nangman nanu sopinu ahin, napa sopinu hile asagokeo hina naho dohpeh louding ahi: ajeh chu amapan akinaipi a-insungmi ahodoh ahi: amanin achonset nalhon akipoh lhonding ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not have sexual relations with the sister of either your mother or your father, for that would dishonor a close relative; both of you would be held responsible.

source: Chule pasal khatnin apa-ngahpa jinu alupkhom pia ahile, aman apa-ngahpa sagohkeo hina chu ahodohpeh ahitan: amanin achonset nalhon akipoh lhonding, chabeija thilhon ding ahi.
target: “ ‘If a man has sexual relations with his aunt, he has dishonored his uncle. They will be held responsible; they will die childless.

source: Chule pasal khatnin asopipa jinu akipuija ahile, hichu thilthenglou ahin: aman asopipa sagohkeo hina ahodohpeh ahi; amani chabeija umlhon ding ahi.
target: “ ‘If a man marries his brother’s wife, it is an act of impurity; he has dishonored his brother. They will be childless.

source: Hijeh-a chu keiman nangho kahin puilut nadingu gam chun nangho nalohdoh louna dingun; nanghon kachondan ho le kathutana ho nitnun lang chule bolun.
target: “ ‘Keep all my decrees and laws and follow them, so that the land where I am bringing you to live may not vomit you out.

source: Chule nangho masanga keiman kakaidoh nam chondan bangin chonhih-un: ajeh chu amahon hitiho jouse hi anabolun, hijeh-a chu keiman amaho chu kahot ahi.
target: You must not live according to the customs of the nations I am going to drive out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.

source: Ahinla keiman nangho henga, Nanghon amaho gam chu nalo diu, chule hiche bongnoi le khoiju lona gam chu nalo diuva kapeh ding nahiuve, kati ahi. Keima nangho namdang ho-a kona khendoh-a Pakai Pathen chu kahi.
target: But I said to you, “You will possess their land; I will give it to you as an inheritance, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am the Lord your God, who has set you apart from the nations.

source: Hijeh-a chu nanghon satheng le saboh, vacha boh le atheng nakhen dingu ahi: chule sa hile vacha hile chule tolla kitholtho ho hijongle keiman nangho-a kona athenglou ahi tia kakhendoh ho-a kona chu nahinnao thet umtah nasolou dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘You must therefore make a distinction between clean and unclean animals and between unclean and clean birds. Do not defile yourselves by any animal or bird or anything that moves along the ground—those that I have set apart as unclean for you.

source: Chule nangho keima dinga atheng nahi dingu ahi: ijeh-inem itile Pakai keima hi atheng kahin, chule keima-a tum hidinga nanghohi midang ho-a kona kakhen doh nahiuve.
target: You are to be holy to me because I, the Lord , am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be my own.

source: Pasal hihen numei hile, lhakou ahiloule doithem hia chu thonlouva thading ahi: amahon amaho chu songa asediu ahi: amaho thisan chu amaho chung mama-a chuding ahi.
target: “ ‘A man or woman who is a medium or spiritist among you must be put to death. You are to stone them; their blood will be on their own heads.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Aaron chapate thempuho henga hitihin seijin, Koimacha amite lah-a mithiho jeh-a kisuboh louding ahi:
target: The Lord said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them: ‘A priest must not make himself ceremonially unclean for any of his people who die,

source: Ahin a-insungmi amato kinai, anu-a ding, apa-a ding, achapa-a ding, achanu-a ding, chule asopipa-a ding,
target: except for a close relative, such as his mother or father, his son or daughter, his brother,

source: Chule asopinu nungah theng, ama to kinaija um, jinei loulaija ding; hichenga dinga vanghi kisuboh thei ahi.
target: or an unmarried sister who is dependent on him since she has no husband—for her he may make himself unclean.

source: Ahinla amite lah-a aluchangpen ahi jeh-in, athenlou nadinga ama le ama kisuboh louding ahi.
target: He must not make himself unclean for people related to him by marriage, and so defile himself.

source: Amahon aluchangu avotol loudingu, abengmulu mongjong avoset lou dingu, chule atahsao jong a-atpop loudiu ahi.
target: “ ‘Priests must not shave their heads or shave off the edges of their beards or cut their bodies.

source: Amaho chu a-Pathen'uva ding atheng hidiu, chule a-Pathen'u min jong asuhboh loudiu ahi. Ajeh amahon meija kisem Pakai henga thilto le a-Pathen'u changlhah chu atojiu ahi: hijeh-a chu amaho atheng hidingu ahi.
target: They must be holy to their God and must not profane the name of their God. Because they present the food offerings to the Lord , the food of their God, they are to be holy.

source: Amahon ji dinga noti ahiloule athenglou chu akipui loudiu; chule ajipan adasa numei jong akipui lou dingu ahi: ajehchu amapa chu a-Pathen'a dinga atheng hija ahi.
target: “ ‘They must not marry women defiled by prostitution or divorced from their husbands, because priests are holy to their God.

source: Nangman hijeh-a chu amachu nasuhtheng ding ahi; ajehchu aman nangma Pathen changlhah chu atodoh ahi: amapa chu nangma dinga atheng hiding ahi: ijeh inem itile nangma suthenga Pakai keima atheng kahi.
target: Regard them as holy, because they offer up the food of your God. Consider them holy, because I the Lord am holy—I who make you holy.

source: Chule thempu khat penpen chanu chu noti'a apana amale ama akisuhboh-a ahile, apa asuhboh ahin: amanu chu meija halding ahi.
target: “ ‘If a priest’s daughter defiles herself by becoming a prostitute, she disgraces her father; she must be burned in the fire.

source: Chule asopite lah-a thempu chungnunga pang, alua thao kinu, thempu vonho von dinga kisuthenga chun, alu ahodoh louding, aponho jong abokeh louding;
target: “ ‘The high priest, the one among his brothers who has had the anointing oil poured on his head and who has been ordained to wear the priestly garments, must not let his hair become unkempt or tear his clothes.

source: Thilong kiti tapou anailut louding, apa-a ding le anu-a dinga jong kisuboh louding;
target: He must not enter a place where there is a dead body. He must not make himself unclean, even for his father or mother,

source: Munthenga kona jong potdoh louding, a-Pathen muntheng jong asuhboh louding ahi; ijeh inem itile a-Pathen thao kinu lallukhuh chu achunga um ahi: Keima Pakai chu kahi.
target: nor leave the sanctuary of his God or desecrate it, because he has been dedicated by the anointing oil of his God. I am the Lord .

source: Chule aman ajinu chu nungah theng ahi petna akipui ding ahi.
target: “ ‘The woman he marries must be a virgin.

source: Meithai, akidasa numei, akisubohsa, ahiloule noti, hicheho hi akipui louding ahi; amavang amite lah-a kona nungah theng khat akipui ding ahi.
target: He must not marry a widow, a divorced woman, or a woman defiled by prostitution, but only a virgin from his own people,

source: Amite lah-a jong achilhah asuhboh louding ahi; ajehchu Pakai keiman ama kasuhtheng ahi.
target: so that he will not defile his offspring among his people. I am the Lord , who makes him holy.’ ”

source: Chule Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Aaron henga hitin seijin, Nakhang sunguva nachilhah hou lah-a nolna nei poupou chun, a-Pathen changlhah toh dingin galut dahen.
target: “Say to Aaron: ‘For the generations to come none of your descendants who has a defect may come near to offer the food of his God.

source: Koi hile nolna neichan chu lut louding ahi: amitcho, a-elbai, anahkui soi, ahiloule atichunga aval nei,
target: No man who has any defect may come near: no man who is blind or lame, disfigured or deformed;

source: Pasal akengbong, ahilouleh akhutbong,
target: no man with a crippled foot or hand,

source: Atingbong, mineo, ahiloule amitna nolna um, tipat, tibol, ahiloule atilchangkeh hijongle;
target: or who is a hunchback or a dwarf, or who has any eye defect, or who has festering or running sores or damaged testicles.

source: Aaron chilhah ho nolna nei koimachan Pakai henga dinga meija kisem thilto toh dinga hungnailut lou dingu ahi: aman achunga nolna anei ahi: a-Pathen changlhah tohdinga hungnailut lou ding ahi.
target: No descendant of Aaron the priest who has any defect is to come near to present the food offerings to the Lord . He has a defect; he must not come near to offer the food of his God.

source: Aman a-Pathen changlhah athengpen le atheng chu ania anehthei ding ahi.
target: He may eat the most holy food of his God, as well as the holy food;

source: Aman nolna khat aneijeh-a chu keima muntheng aman asuhboh louna dinga, ama pondal sunga chu lutlou ding, maicham naija jong hunglut lou ding ahi: ajehchu Pakai keiman amaho kasuhtheng ahi.
target: yet because of his defect, he must not go near the curtain or approach the altar, and so desecrate my sanctuary. I am the Lord , who makes them holy.’ ”

source: Chuin Mosi'n hichehi Aaron le achapate chule Israel chate jouse henga aseipeh tan ahi.
target: So Moses told this to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites.

source: Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Aaron le achapate henga chun amaho Israel chate thil thengho-a kona akikang seova, chule keima henga amahon athensosao hiche thilho-a chu keima mintheng asuhboh louna dingun seipeh-in: Keima Pakai chu kahi.
target: “Tell Aaron and his sons to treat with respect the sacred offerings the Israelites consecrate to me, so they will not profane my holy name. I am the Lord .

source: Amaho henga hitihin seijin, Koi hijongle nakhanggui jouseuva nachilhah jouse lah-a kon achunga thenlouna aumpetna Israel chaten Pakai henga akatdoh-u thilthengho henga galutna chu, amachu keima angsunga kona kipaidoh ding ahi: Keima Pakai chu kahi.
target: “Say to them: ‘For the generations to come, if any of your descendants is ceremonially unclean and yet comes near the sacred offerings that the Israelites consecrate to the Lord , that person must be cut off from my presence. I am the Lord .

source: Aaron chilhahte lah-a kon koitobang miphah hihen lang, ahiloule thilong hijongle, akisuhtheng kahse-a thil thengho lah-a kona imacha aneh louding ahi. Chule koi hile thilonga kona kisuboh thilkhat tongkha-a, ahiloule ama-a kona abotwi chedoh-a chu,
target: “ ‘If a descendant of Aaron has a defiling skin disease or a bodily discharge, he may not eat the sacred offerings until he is cleansed. He will also be unclean if he touches something defiled by a corpse or by anyone who has an emission of semen,

source: Ahiloule akisuhbohna thei ding akitholtho, ahiloule thenlouna akilahson nathei mi, itobang thenlouna nei hijongle;
target: or if he touches any crawling thing that makes him unclean, or any person who makes him unclean, whatever the uncleanness may be.

source: Chutobang khattou tongkha tapou chu nilhah tokah-a thenglouva umding, chule aman atahsa twija asop masangse-a thil thengho lah-a kona imacha aneh louding ahi.
target: The one who touches any such thing will be unclean till evening. He must not eat any of the sacred offerings unless he has bathed himself with water.

source: Chule nisa ahung lhumteng, ama theng ding ahitan, chujou tengle thiltheng lah-a kona chu anehding ahitai: ajehchu hichu ama an ahi.
target: When the sun goes down, he will be clean, and after that he may eat the sacred offerings, for they are his food.

source: Akisuhboh nadinga achama thia ham, san apelih ham chu aneh louding ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi.
target: He must not eat anything found dead or torn by wild animals, and so become unclean through it. I am the Lord .

source: Hijeh-a chu amahon kachondanho anit dingu ahi, achuti louva ahile hiche chonsetna chu apoh uva, hichu asuhboh uva ahile thi dingu ahi: keima Pakai amaho suthenga chu kahi.
target: “ ‘The priests are to perform my service in such a way that they do not become guilty and die for treating it with contempt. I am the Lord , who makes them holy.

source: Gamdang mi kiti tapouvin thiltheng chu aneh louding ahi: thempute henga khopem hihen, soh thalah hijongle thiltheng chu aneh theilou ding ahi.
target: “ ‘No one outside a priest’s family may eat the sacred offering, nor may the guest of a priest or his hired worker eat it.

source: Ahinla thempu chun asuma mikhat achoh-a ahile, amapa chun hichu anehding, chule a-insunga penga jong chun: amahon ama anneh chu anehthei dingu ahi.
target: But if a priest buys a slave with money, or if slaves are born in his household, they may eat his food.

source: Thempu chanu khattou gamdang mi toh akichena ahile, amanun thiltheng kitoh ho lah-a kona chu ima anehthei louding ahi.
target: If a priest’s daughter marries anyone other than a priest, she may not eat any of the sacred contributions.

source: Ahinla thempu chanu chu meithai ahiloule akida ahia, chabei ahia, chule anungah lai banga apa insunga umdinga ahung nungkih ahile, amanun apa anneh chu aneh teiding ahi: amavang gamdang min hichu aneh louding ahi.
target: But if a priest’s daughter becomes a widow or is divorced, yet has no children, and she returns to live in her father’s household as in her youth, she may eat her father’s food. No unauthorized person, however, may eat it.

source: Chule pasal khattouvin hetlouva thiltheng lah-a kona ima aneh-a ahile, aman thiltheng chu thempu henga aledit kitding, hopnga-a hopkhat apehbe ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Anyone who eats a sacred offering by mistake must make restitution to the priest for the offering and add a fifth of the value to it.

source: Chule amahon, Israel chateho thiltheng ho, Pakai anga ato houchu asuhboh lou dingu;
target: The priests must not desecrate the sacred offerings the Israelites present to the Lord

source: Ahiloule athiltheng houchu aneh tengule suhkhelna khangitlouna chu apohsah lou dingu ahi: ajehchu keiman amaho suthenga Pakai chu ahi.
target: by allowing them to eat the sacred offerings and so bring upon them guilt requiring payment. I am the Lord , who makes them holy.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Aaron heng le achapate heng, chule Israel chate jouse henga hitihin seijin, Israel insunga kona hihen, Israel lah-a um gamdang mi hijongle, koitobang akitepna khattouva dinga ganlhaina, ahiloule lungcham thilto-a dinga Pakai henga govam thilto tohding auma ahile,
target: “Speak to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites and say to them: ‘If any of you—whether an Israelite or a foreigner residing in Israel—presents a gift for a burnt offering to the Lord , either to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering,

source: Nanghon nalungcham tah uva bongho, kelngoiho, ahiloule kelcha ho-a kona nolna beihel achal napeh dingu ahi.
target: you must present a male without defect from the cattle, sheep or goats in order that it may be accepted on your behalf.

source: Ahinla nolna neitapou chu natolou dingu ahi: ajehchu hichu nangho-a dinga kisanpeh louding ahi.
target: Do not bring anything with a defect, because it will not be accepted on your behalf.

source: Koi hijongle akitepna suhbulhit nading ham, ahiloule lungcham thilto dinga bong ham, ahiloule kelngoi hama Pakai henga chamna thilto ganlhaina toh chan chun, athilto chu sanpeh ahina dinga ahoi chamkim atoding ahi: achunga chu nolna imacha umlou ding ahi.
target: When anyone brings from the herd or flock a fellowship offering to the Lord to fulfill a special vow or as a freewill offering, it must be without defect or blemish to be acceptable.

source: Mitcho, kengbong, atipat, tahsa-a apomdoh nei, tina-a kon anai long, ahiloule tipat tapou chu nanghon Pakai henga nato lou diu, chule Pakaiya dinga maicham chunga meija kisem thilto-a nato lou dingu ahi.
target: Do not offer to the Lord the blind, the injured or the maimed, or anything with warts or festering or running sores. Do not place any of these on the altar as a food offering presented to the Lord .

source: Bongchal ahiloule kelngoinou atahsa tibah-a aval, ahiloule alhasam auma ahile, nangman hichu lungcham thilto-a nato thei ahi: ahinla kitepna-a dinga vang hichu kisang louding ahi.
target: You may, however, present as a freewill offering an ox or a sheep that is deformed or stunted, but it will not be accepted in fulfillment of a vow.

source: Nangman gancha atilchang kisuhchip, kitatkeh, kisukeh, le ki-atkeh kiti tapou chu Pakai henga nato louding ahi; chule hitobang ho-a chu nagamsunga jong thilto imacha nabol lou dingu ahi.
target: You must not offer to the Lord an animal whose testicles are bruised, crushed, torn or cut. You must not do this in your own land,

source: Gamdang mi khutna kona hicheho chu na-Pathen changlhah hidinga nato louding ahi: ajeh chu amaho-a bohna aumin, chule amaho-a nolna aumin ahi: hicheho chu nangho dinga kisanpeh louding ahiuve.
target: and you must not accept such animals from the hand of a foreigner and offer them as the food of your God. They will not be accepted on your behalf, because they are deformed and have defects.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Bongchal ham, kelngoi ham, ahiloule kelcha ham ahung so tengle amachu ni sagi api toh umkhom ding ahi: chule niget channi-a patna Pakai henga meija kisem thilto-a dinga kisang ding ahitai.
target: “When a calf, a lamb or a goat is born, it is to remain with its mother for seven days. From the eighth day on, it will be acceptable as a food offering presented to the Lord .

source: Chule bongpi hihen kelngoipi hile, anouho toh nikhat sunga nathalou diu ahi.
target: Do not slaughter a cow or a sheep and its young on the same day.

source: Chule nanghon Pakai henga thangvahna ganlhaina nato tengule, nalungcham tah uva nato dingu ahi.
target: “When you sacrifice a thank offering to the Lord , sacrifice it in such a way that it will be accepted on your behalf.

source: Anikho mama-a chu hiche chu nehjou keiding ahi: ajing geija dinga imacha khenlou ding ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi.
target: It must be eaten that same day; leave none of it till morning. I am the Lord .

source: Hijeh chun nanghon kathupeh ho nanit uva, chule hicheho chu nabol dingu ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi.
target: “Keep my commands and follow them. I am the Lord .

source: Chule nanghon ka mintheng jong nasuhboh loudiu; amavang Israel chate lah-a keima suhthenga kaumding ahi: keima nangho suthenga Pakai chu kahin,
target: Do not profane my holy name, for I must be acknowledged as holy by the Israelites. I am the Lord , who made you holy

source: Egypt gama kona na-Pathen'u hidinga hinpui dohpa chu kahi: Keima Pakai chu kahi.
target: and who brought you out of Egypt to be your God. I am the Lord .”

source: Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate henga thu seijin lang, ajah uva hitin seijin, Pakai kut ho thudola, nanghon kikhoppi theng ahi tia naphondoh dinghou chu, hichehohi keima kut ho chu ahi.
target: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘These are my appointed festivals, the appointed festivals of the Lord , which you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies.

source: Nigup sunga na kitong ding ahin: nisagi ni vang chu cholngah ni ahin, kikhoppi theng ahi; hiche nikho-a hi natoh imacha natoh lou dingu ahi: hiche hi nachen namun jouseuva Pakai cholngah ni ahi.
target: “ ‘There are six days when you may work, but the seventh day is a day of sabbath rest, a day of sacred assembly. You are not to do any work; wherever you live, it is a sabbath to the Lord .

source: Hiche hohi aphat ahunglhun dungjuija nanghon naphon lediu Pakai Kut ho, kikhoppi thengho chu ahi.
target: “ ‘These are the Lord ’s appointed festivals, the sacred assemblies you are to proclaim at their appointed times:

source: Lha masapen nisom le nili nilhah chu Pakai kalchuh Kut ahi.
target: The Lord ’s Passover begins at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month.

source: Chuche lha mama nisom le ninga ni chu Pakai dinga cholsolou changlhah Kut ahi. Nisagi cholsolou changlhah naneh diu ahi.
target: On the fifteenth day of that month the Lord ’s Festival of Unleavened Bread begins; for seven days you must eat bread made without yeast.

source: Nimasa pen nile nanghon kikhoppi theng khat nanei diu, chule hiche sunga chu natoh imacha natohlou dingu ahi.
target: On the first day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.

source: Ahinla nisagi sunga chu Pakai henga meija kisem thilto nato dingu ahi: nisagi ni chu kikhoppi theng ahin, nanghon hiche sunga chu natoh imacha natohlou dingu ahi.
target: For seven days present a food offering to the Lord . And on the seventh day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate henga hitin seijin, Keiman nangho kapehnao gamsunga nahung lutnuva, chule aga na-at tengule, nanghon nachang-at doh-u aga masapen ho phalkhat chu thempu henga nahin choi dingu ahi.
target: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you enter the land I am going to give you and you reap its harvest, bring to the priest a sheaf of the first grain you harvest.

source: Chule aman nangho dinga santhei ahina dinga aphal chu Pakai anga ajap ding: cholngahni jou ajing le thempu chun ajap ding ahi.
target: He is to wave the sheaf before the Lord so it will be accepted on your behalf; the priest is to wave it on the day after the Sabbath.

source: Chule nanghon aphal najap niu chule, Pakai henga govam thilto-a dinga kumkhat lhingset nolnabei kelngoi nou achal khat nahin kai dingu ahi.
target: On the day you wave the sheaf, you must sacrifice as a burnt offering to the Lord a lamb a year old without defect,

source: Chuche-a dinga anneh thilto chu thao toh kihal changbong neljet ephah hopsom-a hopni, Pakai henga gimnamtui hidinga meija kisem thilto hiding: chule adonding thilto chu lengpitwi hin khat hoplia khat hiding ahi.
target: together with its grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil—a food offering presented to the Lord , a pleasing aroma—and its drink offering of a quarter of a hin of wine.

source: Chule nanghon na-Pathen'u henga thilto nahinchoi nikhou mamachu ahunglhun masanga, changlhah hile, kanpoh hile, changvui hile naneh loudiu ahi. Hichehi nachen namun jouseova a-itih-a nakhang khanguva chondana naman diu ahi.
target: You must not eat any bread, or roasted or new grain, until the very day you bring this offering to your God. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.

source: Nanghon cholngah ni jou ajinga pat, jap thilto-a dinga changhal nahinchoi niuva pat nasim dingu; choldoni sagi nasuhlhing diu ahi:
target: “ ‘From the day after the Sabbath, the day you brought the sheaf of the wave offering, count off seven full weeks.

source: Cholngah sagina jou ajinga pat nisom nga-a nasim uva; Pakai henga anneh thilto thah nato diu ahi.
target: Count off fifty days up to the day after the seventh Sabbath, and then present an offering of new grain to the Lord .

source: Nanghon nachen namun houva kona ephah hopsom-a hopni-a kisem japtho changlhah lumni nahin choidiu; hichu changbong neljetna kon hiding, chol toh kikantha ding; hichu Pakai henga dinga ga masaho ahiuve.
target: From wherever you live, bring two loaves made of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour, baked with yeast, as a wave offering of firstfruits to the Lord .

source: Chule nanghon changlhah chutoh kumkhat lhingbep nolnabei kelngoinou sagi, bongchalnou khat, chule kelngoichal ni natotha diu; hicheho chu Pakai henga govam thilto le a-anneh thiltoho, adon thilto ho, Pakai henga gimnamtui hidinga meija kisem thito ding ahi.
target: Present with this bread seven male lambs, each a year old and without defect, one young bull and two rams. They will be a burnt offering to the Lord , together with their grain offerings and drink offerings—a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

source: Chujouteng nanghon chonset thilto-a dinga kelchaho noukhat natodiu, chule chamna thilto-a dinga kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou ni natodiu ahi.
target: Then sacrifice one male goat for a sin offering and two lambs, each a year old, for a fellowship offering.

source: Chule thempupa chun hicheho chu gamasaho changlhah le kelngoinou ni chutoh Pakai henga jap thilto hiding ajapding: hichu Pakaiya dinga atheng thempupa kipe chu ahi.
target: The priest is to wave the two lambs before the Lord as a wave offering, together with the bread of the firstfruits. They are a sacred offering to the Lord for the priest.

source: Chule nanghon chuche nikho mama chule, hichu nangho dinga kikhoppi theng ahi tia naphondoh diu: hiche sunga chu nanghon natoh imacha natoh lou dingu ahi. Hichehi nachen namun jouseuva nakhang khanguva a-itih-a dinga chondan hiding ahi.
target: On that same day you are to proclaim a sacred assembly and do no regular work. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.
