source: Chule nanghon nagam gao na-at tengule, na-atpet nuva chu naloulai ninghou na-at ngimsel loudiu, na-at naova alhajah jong nachom khom loudiu ahi: hicheho chu vaichate le gamdang mi dinga nakhenpeh dingu ahi: keima Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi.
target: “ ‘When you reap the harvest of your land, do not reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest. Leave them for the poor and for the foreigner residing among you. I am the Lord your God.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate henga hitihin seijin, lhasagi channa nikho masapen nileh nanghon choldona nanitdiu, sumkon mut hetjingna kikhoppi theng naman dingu ahi.
target: “Say to the Israelites: ‘On the first day of the seventh month you are to have a day of sabbath rest, a sacred assembly commemorated with trumpet blasts.

source: Hiche sunga chu nanghon natoh imacha natohlou dingu; amavang nanghon Pakai henga meija kisem thilto nato dingu ahi.
target: Do no regular work, but present a food offering to the Lord .’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Hiche lhasagi channa nisom lhin ni chu longlhenna nikho hiding: hichu nangho dinga kikhoppi theng hiding; chule nanghon nahinnao nasuh gimuva, Pakai henga meija kisem thilto nato dingu ahi.
target: “The tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement. Hold a sacred assembly and deny yourselves, and present a food offering to the Lord .

source: Hiche ni-a chu nanghon natoh kiti natohlou diu ahi: ajehchu hichu longlhenna nikho ahin, Pakai na-Pathen'u anga nangho ding longlhenna kibol nikho ahi.
target: Do not do any work on that day, because it is the Day of Atonement, when atonement is made for you before the Lord your God.

source: Ijeh inem itile koihile hiche nikho-a ngeija ahinna suhgim lou chu, amachu amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi.
target: Those who do not deny themselves on that day must be cut off from their people.

source: Chule koihile hiche nikho ngeija natoh khattou tonga chu, amachu amite lah-a kona keiman kasuhmang ding ahi.
target: I will destroy from among their people anyone who does any work on that day.

source: Nanghon itobang natoh hile natoh louhel dingu ahi: hichehi nachen namun jouseova nakhang khanguva a-itih-a ding chondan hiding ahi.
target: You shall do no work at all. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.

source: Hichehi nangho dinga cholngahna choldoni hiding, chule nanghon nahinnao nasuh gim dingu ahi: hiche lha niko ni nilhah-a pat ajing nilhah geija nangho cholngahni nanitdiu ahi.
target: It is a day of sabbath rest for you, and you must deny yourselves. From the evening of the ninth day of the month until the following evening you are to observe your sabbath.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate henga hitihin seipeh-in, hiche lhasagi channa nisom le ni ngani hi Pakai henga nisagi sung Houbuh Kut hiding ahi.
target: “Say to the Israelites: ‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month the Lord ’s Festival of Tabernacles begins, and it lasts for seven days.

source: Ani masapen nikho-a chu kikhoppi theng umding: hiche sunga chu natoh imacha natoh loudiu ahi.
target: The first day is a sacred assembly; do no regular work.

source: Nanghon nisagi sung Pakai henga meija kisem thilto nato diu: nigetni chu nangho dinga kikhoppi theng hiding; Pakai henga meija kisem thilto nato diu ahi; hichehi kipun khomna loupitah ahin; chule hiche sunga hi nangho koimachan na natoh loudiu ahi.
target: For seven days present food offerings to the Lord , and on the eighth day hold a sacred assembly and present a food offering to the Lord . It is the closing special assembly; do no regular work.

source: Hichehohi Pakaiya ding kut ho, Pakai henga meija kisem thilto, govam thilto, anneh thilto, ganlhaina, don thilto anikho dungjuijuva tona dinga kikhoppi theng ahi tia naphondoh dinghou:
target: (“ ‘These are the Lord ’s appointed festivals, which you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies for bringing food offerings to the Lord —the burnt offerings and grain offerings, sacrifices and drink offerings required for each day.

source: Pakai cholngah niho, na thiltohou, na kitepnahou jouse, chule na lungcham thiltohou, Pakai henga napeh hou simlouva mandingho chu ahi.
target: These offerings are in addition to those for the Lord ’s Sabbaths and in addition to your gifts and whatever you have vowed and all the freewill offerings you give to the Lord .)

source: Chujongle lhasagi channa nisom le ninga ni, nanghon nagam gahou nakhop khom tengule, nanghon Pakaiya dinga kut nisagi naman diu ahi; animasa pen ni chu cholngahni hiding, chule nigetni jong chu cholngahni hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘So beginning with the fifteenth day of the seventh month, after you have gathered the crops of the land, celebrate the festival to the Lord for seven days; the first day is a day of sabbath rest, and the eighth day also is a day of sabbath rest.

source: Chule nimasa pen nile nanghon thingpha gaho, lusu doho, thingdo aboh phaho boh, vachadung panga keh huisum ho nalah diu, chule Pakai anga nisagi nakipa thanop diu ahi.
target: On the first day you are to take branches from luxuriant trees—from palms, willows and other leafy trees—and rejoice before the Lord your God for seven days.

source: Chule hiche hi Pakai dinga kut tia kum khat sunga nisagi naman diu ahi. Hichehi nakhang khanguva dinga a-itih-a chondan kipe-a chu ahi: hichehi nanghon lhasagi channa sunga nanit jingdiu ahi.
target: Celebrate this as a festival to the Lord for seven days each year. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come; celebrate it in the seventh month.

source: Nangho nisagi lhambuh sunga nachendiu; Israel chate apeng jouse lhambuh-a cheng dingu ahi.
target: Live in temporary shelters for seven days: All native-born Israelites are to live in such shelters

source: Chutia chu nakhang khanguva nanghon Israel chate Egypt gama kona kahinpuidoh chun amaho lhambuh-a kana chensah-e ti nahet themna diu ahi: keima Pakai na Pathen'u chu kahi.
target: so your descendants will know that I had the Israelites live in temporary shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.’ ”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Israel chate henga Pakai kut ho chu aphongdoh tan ahi.
target: So Moses announced to the Israelites the appointed festivals of the Lord .

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati;
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate henga meivah ho avah jomjing theina dingin, vahding monga kiheh Olive thao thengseh chu nahenga ahin choina diuvin thupeh neijin.
target: “Command the Israelites to bring you clear oil of pressed olives for the light so that the lamps may be kept burning continually.

source: Hichu Aaron nin Pakai anga nilhah-a pat jingkah geija tanglouva hettohsahna pondal pamlam, houkhom ho houbuh sunga agoltoh ding ahi; hiche hi nakhang khanguva a-itih-a dinga nachondanu hiding ahi.
target: Outside the curtain that shields the ark of the covenant law in the tent of meeting, Aaron is to tend the lamps before the Lord from evening till morning, continually. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come.

source: Aman Pakai angsunga meivah khom theng chunga meivah ho chu tanglouva agoltoh ding ahi.
target: The lamps on the pure gold lampstand before the Lord must be tended continually.

source: Chule nangman changbong neljet nalah-a, hichea kona chu changlhah lum somleni nasemding, lumkhat khatna ephah hopsom-a hopni nalutsah cheh ding ahi.
target: “Take the finest flour and bake twelve loaves of bread, using two-tenths of an ephah for each loaf.

source: Chule hicheho chu Pakai angsung dokhang theng chunga nangman golkhatna gup cheh-a golnia nagol ding ahi.
target: Arrange them in two stacks, six in each stack, on the table of pure gold before the Lord .

source: Chule hetjingna changlhah, Pakai henga meija kisem thilto hidinga nangman agolni chunga chu bego thengsel nakoi ding ahi.
target: By each stack put some pure incense as a memorial portion to represent the bread and to be a food offering presented to the Lord .

source: Atonsot kitepna-a dinga Israel chate-a kona kila ahito lhona, cholngahni sehle aman hiche chu tanglouva Pakai anga phatecha agontup jing ding ahi.
target: This bread is to be set out before the Lord regularly, Sabbath after Sabbath, on behalf of the Israelites, as a lasting covenant.

source: Chule hiche chu Aaron le achapatea hiding, amahon hichu munthenga aneh diu ahi; ajeh chu a-itih-a chondan hijing dinga Pakaiya dinga meija kisem thilto chu ama dinga thengtah hija ahi.
target: It belongs to Aaron and his sons, who are to eat it in the sanctuary area, because it is a most holy part of their perpetual share of the food offerings presented to the Lord .”

source: Chule Israel numei khat chapa, apa chu Egypt mi ahin, ama chu Israel chate lah-a achedoh-in: hiche Israel numeinu chapa leh Israel mi khat gebuh sunga akidel lhonin;
target: Now the son of an Israelite mother and an Egyptian father went out among the Israelites, and a fight broke out in the camp between him and an Israelite.

source: Chuin Israel numeinu chapa chun Pakai min chu ataitomin, agaosap tan ahi. Chuin amahon amapa chu Mosi henga ahin puijuvin: (anu min chu Shelomith, Debri chanu, Dan phunga kon ahi).
target: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name with a curse; so they brought him to Moses. (His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri the Danite.)

source: Amahon Pakai lunggel amaho henga vetsah-a aum theina din, amapa chu vetsuijin akoijuve.
target: They put him in custody until the will of the Lord should be made clear to them.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: Then the Lord said to Moses:

source: Agaosap mipa chu gebuh pama puidoh-in; chule athusei jaho jouse chun alujang chunga chun akhutnu ngamuhen, chule houkhom ho jouse chun songin sepmuhen.
target: “Take the blasphemer outside the camp. All those who heard him are to lay their hands on his head, and the entire assembly is to stone him.

source: Chule Israel chate henga chu, Koi hile a-Pathen gaosap chan chun achonset akipoh ding ahi, tia naseipeh ding ahi.
target: Say to the Israelites: ‘Anyone who curses their God will be held responsible;

source: Chule Pakai min taitompa chu thonlouva thatei ding ahin, chule houkhom ho jousen amachu songa ase dingu ahi: gamdangmi jong chu agam sunga pengpa banga Pakai min ataitoma ahile thading ahi.
target: anyone who blasphemes the name of the Lord is to be put to death. The entire assembly must stone them. Whether foreigner or native-born, when they blaspheme the Name they are to be put to death.

source: Chule koi hile mithat tapou chu thonlouva thatei ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Anyone who takes the life of a human being is to be put to death.

source: Chule koihile gancha thatna chun, gan chu gan'a aditding ahi.
target: Anyone who takes the life of someone’s animal must make restitution—life for life.

source: Chule khattouvin aheng akom chunga nolna khat achuhsah-a ahile, aman abol tobang banga chu ama chunga kibol ding ahi.
target: Anyone who injures their neighbor is to be injured in the same manner:

source: Gubong chu gubonga, mit chu mitna, ha chu ha-a; aman mikhat chunga nolna asosah banga ama chunga jong kisosah kitding ahi.
target: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. The one who has inflicted the injury must suffer the same injury.

source: Chule gancha thatna chun, adit ding; chule mihem thatna vang chu, ama thatei ding ahi.
target: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution, but whoever kills a human being is to be put to death.

source: Nanghon gamdang mi-a ding ahin, nagam mihou khatna ding ahin, dan khatbou naneidiu ahi. Ajehchu keima Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi, ati.
target: You are to have the same law for the foreigner and the native-born. I am the Lord your God.’ ”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Israel chate henga, amahon agaosap pa chu gebuh pama ahinpuidoh uva, chule ama chu songa ase diuvin aseipehtai. Chule Israel chaten Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bang chun abol taovin ahi.
target: Then Moses spoke to the Israelites, and they took the blasphemer outside the camp and stoned him. The Israelites did as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Sinai molsanga Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati.
target: The Lord said to Moses at Mount Sinai,

source: Israel chate henga thu seijin lang, ajah uva hitin seijin, Nangho keiman kapeh-u gam nahunglut tengule, agam pumpin Pakai henga cholngahni anitding ahi.
target: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you enter the land I am going to give you, the land itself must observe a sabbath to the Lord .

source: Nangman kumgup nalouva muchi natuding, chule kum gup nalengpilei nalhongim ding ahi, chule aga naki chopkhom ding,
target: For six years sow your fields, and for six years prune your vineyards and gather their crops.

source: Ahinla kum sagi lhinkum chu agam pumpi dinga cholngahna, Pakaiya dinga cholngah hiding ahi. Nangman nalouva muchi natulou ding, nalengpilei nalhongim louding ahi.
target: But in the seventh year the land is to have a year of sabbath rest, a sabbath to the Lord . Do not sow your fields or prune your vineyards.

source: Nangman nachang atna nunga changson chu na-at louding, nalengpigui malngim lou ga jong nalokhom louding ahi; ajehchu agam pumpi dinga cholngah kum ahi.
target: Do not reap what grows of itself or harvest the grapes of your untended vines. The land is to have a year of rest.

source: Chule gam pumpi cholngah kum-a achama hung kehdohho chu nangho dinga anneh hiding; nangma-a ding, nasohnu-a ding, nasoh thalah-a ding, chule nangma toh khopem khom gamdangmi-a ding,
target: Whatever the land yields during the sabbath year will be food for you—for yourself, your male and female servants, and the hired worker and temporary resident who live among you,

source: Chule nagancha-a ding, chule nagamsunguva um saho-a dinga, chua kona hung gadoh jouse chu nangho anneh hiding ahi.
target: as well as for your livestock and the wild animals in your land. Whatever the land produces may be eaten.

source: Chule nangman cholngah kum sagi nakisim ding, kum sagi sagivei; chule cholngah kumho kikah sungse chu nangma dinga kum somli le kumko hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘Count off seven sabbath years—seven times seven years—so that the seven sabbath years amount to a period of forty-nine years.

source: Chuteng lhasagi channa nisom lhinni le nangman Jubilee sumkon namutging sah ding, longlhenna nikhoteng sumkon chu nagam pumpiu sunga namut ging sah ding ahi.
target: Then have the trumpet sounded everywhere on the tenth day of the seventh month; on the Day of Atonement sound the trumpet throughout your land.

source: Chule nanghon kum somnga kum chu nathenso diu, chule gamsung pumpi sunga chengho jouse henga chamlhatna naphondoh dingu ahi. Hichu nangho dinga Jubilee hiding; mitinin ama ama neilegou akinungmu kitding, chule mitin a-insung mite henga kile kitding ahi.
target: Consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee for you; each of you is to return to your family property and to your own clan.

source: Kum somnga channa chu nangho dinga Jubilee hiding: nanghon natuloudiu, chua kona achama hung khangdoh jong na-at loudiu, chom ngimlou nalengpi leija kona lengpi ga hojong nalokhom louding ahi.
target: The fiftieth year shall be a jubilee for you; do not sow and do not reap what grows of itself or harvest the untended vines.

source: Ajehchu Jubilee ahin; nangho dinga atheng hiding ahi: nanghon gamsunga kona achama hung kehdoh hochu naneh dingu ahi.
target: For it is a jubilee and is to be holy for you; eat only what is taken directly from the fields.

source: Hiche Jubilee kum-a hi mitin ama ama neilegou nalepeh dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘In this Year of Jubilee everyone is to return to their own property.

source: Chule nangman naheng nakom henga thilkhat tou najoh-a, ahiloule naheng nakom khutna kona thilkhat tou nachoh-a ahile, nangho khatle khat naki suhgentheito lou dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘If you sell land to any of your own people or buy land from them, do not take advantage of each other.

source: Jubilee jou kum jat dungjuija nangman naheng nakoma kona nachoh ding, chule aga kum jat dungjuija nangman ama henga ajoh ding ahi.
target: You are to buy from your own people on the basis of the number of years since the Jubilee. And they are to sell to you on the basis of the number of years left for harvesting crops.

source: Akumho atam dungjuija nangman chuche man chu nakalsah ding, chule akum alhom dungjuija chuche man chu nasuhlhom ding; ajehchu aga na kumho dungjuija aman nangma henga ajoh ahi.
target: When the years are many, you are to increase the price, and when the years are few, you are to decrease the price, because what is really being sold to you is the number of crops.

source: Hijeh-a chu nangho khat le khat nakisuh gentheito loudiu; amavang Pathen nagin joh dingu ahi: ajehchu keima Pakai na Pathen'u chu kahi.
target: Do not take advantage of each other, but fear your God. I am the Lord your God.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu nanghon kachondan ho najuijuva, kathu tanho nanit uva, natoh dingu ahi; chutile nangho gamsunga bitkeija nachen dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘Follow my decrees and be careful to obey my laws, and you will live safely in the land.

source: Chuteng gamchun aga ahinso sah-a, nanghon vasetna nanehdiu, chule asunga chu bitkeija nachen dingu ahi.
target: Then the land will yield its fruit, and you will eat your fill and live there in safety.

source: Chule nanghon, Veuvin, keihon tujong katu daova, agaho jong kalokhom daova ahile, Kum sagi lhinna-a chu ipi kanehdiu ham? nati uva ahile,
target: You may ask, “What will we eat in the seventh year if we do not plant or harvest our crops?”

source: Chuteng keiman kum gup channa-a chu kavangbohna nachung uva kathupeh ding, chule hichun kumthum sung ding ga asodoh ding ahi.
target: I will send you such a blessing in the sixth year that the land will yield enough for three years.

source: Chutia chu nanghon kum get channa le muchi natu dingu, ahivanga kumko channa geija aga lui chu naneh dingu; aga ahung lhun kahse-a nanghon alui kikhola kona chu naneh dingu ahi.
target: While you plant during the eighth year, you will eat from the old crop and will continue to eat from it until the harvest of the ninth year comes in.

source: Gam chu a-itih-a dinga johdoh louding ahi: ajehchu gamchu keija ahibouve; chule nangho hi keima koma gamdangmi le hungkhopem nahibou uve.
target: “ ‘The land must not be sold permanently, because the land is mine and you reside in my land as foreigners and strangers.

source: Chule nanghon nalonao gamsung jouse-a chu, gam kilhatdoh hi naphal dingu ahi.
target: Throughout the land that you hold as a possession, you must provide for the redemption of the land.

source: Nasopipa chu hung vaicha lheh tah-a, chule aman aneilegou phabep chu ajohdoh-a, akinaipi a-insungmi khat chuche lhatdoh dinga ahunga ahile, ama chun asopipan ajoh chu alhatdoh ding ahi.
target: “ ‘If one of your fellow Israelites becomes poor and sells some of their property, their nearest relative is to come and redeem what they have sold.

source: Chule mipa chun koimacha alhatdoh ding nei hih-a, chule ama tah-in alhatdoh jouding ahi tahle,
target: If, however, there is no one to redeem it for them but later on they prosper and acquire sufficient means to redeem it themselves,

source: Chuteng aman anei alahkit theina dingin, ajoh dohna kumho kisim henlang, aval chu ajoh napa henga lepehkit hen.
target: they are to determine the value for the years since they sold it and refund the balance to the one to whom they sold it; they can then go back to their own property.

source: Ahinla aman amapa henga chu alepeh joulou tah-a ahile, athil kijohdoh chu amapa khutna Jubilee kum ahikahsea umden ding ahi: chule Jubilee teng hiche lahdohna hung umding, chule amapa chun anei ahinle neikit ding ahi.
target: But if they do not acquire the means to repay, what was sold will remain in the possession of the buyer until the Year of Jubilee. It will be returned in the Jubilee, and they can then go back to their property.

source: Chule mikhatnin kulbang kikai khum khopi sunga um chenna in khat ajoh-a ahile, aman hichu ajohdoh jou kumkhat guilhungset sunga akilhatdoh thei ding; kum khat lhingset sunga aman alhatdoh thei ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Anyone who sells a house in a walled city retains the right of redemption a full year after its sale. During that time the seller may redeem it.

source: Ahinla hichu kum khat lhingset sunga akilhatdoh tahlouva ahile, kulbang kikai khum khopi sunga in chu akhang khanga achopa-a dinga kiphutdet ding: chule Jubilee teng jongle pehdoh louding ahitai.
target: If it is not redeemed before a full year has passed, the house in the walled city shall belong permanently to the buyer and the buyer’s descendants. It is not to be returned in the Jubilee.

source: Ahinla kulbangin akolkhumlou khoneo ho-a um inho vangchu gamsunga um louho dana kisimding: hicheho chu lhatdoh thei hiding, chule Jubilee tengle pehdoh hiding ahi.
target: But houses in villages without walls around them are to be considered as belonging to the open country. They can be redeemed, and they are to be returned in the Jubilee.

source: Hijeng jongle Levi mite khopiho le agoulou khopiho-a inho vangchu, Levi miten itih phat hijongle alhatdoh theiju ahi.
target: “ ‘The Levites always have the right to redeem their houses in the Levitical towns, which they possess.

source: Chule mikhatnin Levi miho-a kona thilkhat achoh-a ahile, agou lona khopi-a akijohdoh in chu Jubilee kum tengle pehdoh hiding ahi. Ijeh inem itile Levi phungho khopi ho-a in ho chu Israel chate lah-a amahon aneiju chu ahi.
target: So the property of the Levites is redeemable—that is, a house sold in any town they hold—and is to be returned in the Jubilee, because the houses in the towns of the Levites are their property among the Israelites.

source: Ahinla akhopiu pamho-a um louho chu kijoh theilou ding ahi; ajeh chu hichu a-itih-a dinga amaho gouchan ahi.
target: But the pastureland belonging to their towns must not be sold; it is their permanent possession.

source: Chule nasopipa chu ahung vaicha tah-a, chule nalah uva chu vaichatna alhuhlhah tah-a ahile, nangman amachu nakithopi ding ahi: henge, gamdangmi le khopem banga nangma koma nachen sah ding ahi.
target: “ ‘If any of your fellow Israelites become poor and are unable to support themselves among you, help them as you would a foreigner and stranger, so they can continue to live among you.

source: Ama-a konin nangman akan ahiloule apung lahih-in: nasopipa chu nangma toh achenkhom theina dingin, na Pathen gingin.
target: Do not take interest or any profit from them, but fear your God, so that they may continue to live among you.

source: Nangman nasum chu akan dinga napeh louding; naneh nachah jong apung dinga napeh louding ahi.
target: You must not lend them money at interest or sell them food at a profit.

source: Canaan gam peh dingle na-Pathen'u hidinga, Egypt gama kona nahin puidohpao Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi.
target: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.

source: Chule nakoma cheng nasopi khat chu ahung vaichatna, nangma henga ahung kijoh-a ahile; nangman ama chu soh banga na natohsah louding:
target: “ ‘If any of your fellow Israelites become poor and sell themselves to you, do not make them work as slaves.

source: Amavang soh thalah bang le khopem banga nahenga umding, Jubilee kum geija nangma najen ding ahi.
target: They are to be treated as hired workers or temporary residents among you; they are to work for you until the Year of Jubilee.

source: Chujouteng aman nanga kona potdoh ding, ama le aumpi achate abonuva, chule a-insung mite henga kinungle kitnuva, apu apate goulona gama chu kile kitding ahi.
target: Then they and their children are to be released, and they will go back to their own clans and to the property of their ancestors.

source: Ijeh inem itile amahohi Egypt gama kona kahin puidoh keima sohte ahiuve: amaho soh-a kijoh lou dingu ahi.
target: Because the Israelites are my servants, whom I brought out of Egypt, they must not be sold as slaves.

source: Nangma ama chunga hunam tah-a navaihom louding; amavang na-Pathen nagin johding ahi.
target: Do not rule over them ruthlessly, but fear your God.

source: Soh pasal le soh numei nanghon naneikop dinghou chu, nakimvel uva um Pathen houlou ho hidiu ahi: amaho lah-a kona nanghon soh pasal le soh numei nakichoh dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘Your male and female slaves are to come from the nations around you; from them you may buy slaves.

source: Chujongle nalah uva khopem gamdangmi chateho-a kona le, nagam sunguva peng nangho toh umkhom amaho insung mite chu nachoh theiju ahi: chule amaho chu nangho neilegou hiding ahiuve.
target: You may also buy some of the temporary residents living among you and members of their clans born in your country, and they will become your property.

source: Chule amaho chu nangho nunga nachateo goulo dinga, nei le gou alo diuva nalah dingu ahi; amaho chu a-itih-a nangho soh hiding ahiuve: ahinla nasopiten Israel chate chunga vang, nangho khatnin khat chunga hunam tah-a navai homlou dingu ahi.
target: You can bequeath them to your children as inherited property and can make them slaves for life, but you must not rule over your fellow Israelites ruthlessly.

source: Chule nakoma khopemho le gamdangmi khat chu ahung haodoh-a, chule ama koma cheng nasopipa chu ahung vaichatna, chule nakoma um gamdangmi ahiloule khopempa heng, ahiloule gamsungmi khat henga ahung kijoh tah-a ahile;
target: “ ‘If a foreigner residing among you becomes rich and any of your fellow Israelites become poor and sell themselves to the foreigner or to a member of the foreigner’s clan,

source: Ama chu akijoh jouteng lhatdoh kit thei hiding ahi; asopite ho lah-a khatnin ama alhatdoh thei ahi.
target: they retain the right of redemption after they have sold themselves. One of their relatives may redeem them:

source: Apa-ngahpa ahiloule apa-ngahpa chapa chun ama alhatdoh theiding ahin, ahiloule ama insungmi akinaipi khatnin alhatdoh thei; ahiloule ajo lhangle ama le ama akilhatdoh thei ahi.
target: An uncle or a cousin or any blood relative in their clan may redeem them. Or if they prosper, they may redeem themselves.

source: Chule aman ama chapa chu ama akichohna kum-apat Jubilee kum gei dinga chu akihoupi ding ahi: chule ama akijohdohna manchu akum kisim dungjuija, amatoh ana umkhom soh thalah khat phat dungjuija kitepding ahi.
target: They and their buyer are to count the time from the year they sold themselves up to the Year of Jubilee. The price for their release is to be based on the rate paid to a hired worker for that number of years.

source: Kum tamtah aum nahlaija ahile, hicheho dungjuija chu akilhatdohna man chu akichohna suma kona apehding ahi.
target: If many years remain, they must pay for their redemption a larger share of the price paid for them.

source: Chule Jubilee kum lhinna ding chu kum phabep bou avatna ahile, ama amapa toh asimding, akumho dungjuija chu akilhatdohna man chu apeh ding ahi.
target: If only a few years remain until the Year of Jubilee, they are to compute that and pay for their redemption accordingly.

source: Akum kum-a soh thalah banga amapa chuto umding: chule akhatpa chun nangma angsunga ama chunga chu hunam tah-a vai ahomlou ding ahi.
target: They are to be treated as workers hired from year to year; you must see to it that those to whom they owe service do not rule over them ruthlessly.

source: Chule hiche kumho sunga hi ama lhatdoh-a aumlouva ahile, Jubilee kum tengle potdoh ding, ama le aumpi achate chu potdoh ding ahiuve.
target: “ ‘Even if someone is not redeemed in any of these ways, they and their children are to be released in the Year of Jubilee,

source: Ajeh chu Israel chate chu keima dingin kasohte ahiuvin; Egypt gama kona kahin puidoh kasohte ahiuve: keima Pakai na Pathen'u chu kahi.
target: for the Israelites belong to me as servants. They are my servants, whom I brought out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.

source: Nanghon nangho semthu lim, ahiloule khenthu lim nakisem loudiu, lim kituntho jong natundoh loudiu, songa kisem limpou pou jong a-anga kun nadinga naphudoh lou dingu ahi: ajehchu keima Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi.
target: “ ‘Do not make idols or set up an image or a sacred stone for yourselves, and do not place a carved stone in your land to bow down before it. I am the Lord your God.

source: Nanghon kacholngah nikhoho nanit uva, kamun theng najaboldiu ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi.
target: “ ‘Observe my Sabbaths and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the Lord .

source: Nanghon kachondan ho-a nachon uva, kathupeh ho nanit uva, chule nabol uva ahile;
target: “ ‘If you follow my decrees and are careful to obey my commands,

source: Keiman nangho aphatcha gotwi kapeh diu, chule gamsung chun aga ahinsodoh ding, loujaova thingphung hon jong agau ahin sepdoh dingu ahi.
target: I will send you rain in its season, and the ground will yield its crops and the trees their fruit.

source: Chule nachang voh-u chu lengpigui lokhomto kikaimatna, nalengpiga lokhomu chu muchi lhah phattoh kikaimat ding: nanghon na annu vasetna naneh uva, chule nagam sunguva bitkeija nachen diu ahi.
target: Your threshing will continue until grape harvest and the grape harvest will continue until planting, and you will eat all the food you want and live in safety in your land.

source: Chule keiman gamsunga chamna kalensah-a, chule nalup uva, koimachan nasuh kichat lou dingu ahi: chule gamsunga kona gamsa gilouho chu kano manga, chemjam minjong na gamsungu apal louding ahi.
target: “ ‘I will grant peace in the land, and you will lie down and no one will make you afraid. I will remove wild beasts from the land, and the sword will not pass through your country.

source: Chule nanghon namelma teo nadel uva, amaho nangho masanga chemjam'a loudingu ahi.
target: You will pursue your enemies, and they will fall by the sword before you.

source: Nalah uva mi nga-in jakhat nadel uva, mi jakhat nin sangsom nadel jamdiu: namelma teu chu namasanguva chemjam'a loudingu ahi.
target: Five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred of you will chase ten thousand, and your enemies will fall by the sword before you.

source: Ajehchu keiman nangho kajabol uva, kaphat theisah dingu, chule kapunsah uva, nangho to kakitepna naphudoh ding ahi.
target: “ ‘I will look on you with favor and make you fruitful and increase your numbers, and I will keep my covenant with you.

source: Chule nanghon akikhol chu naneh uva, athah jeh-a aluichu nahin pohdoh dingu ahi.
target: You will still be eating last year’s harvest when you will have to move it out to make room for the new.

source: Chule keiman ka houbuh nalah uva katundoh ding: kahinnan nangho ahot louding ahi.
target: I will put my dwelling place among you, and I will not abhor you.

source: Keima nalah uva kache le-a, na Pathen'u kahiding, chule nangho kamite nahi dingu ahi.
target: I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be my people.

source: Nanghon amaho soh nahilou na dinguva, Egypt gama kona nangho hinpui dohpa Pakai na-Pathen'u chu kahi; chule keiman nanamkol jon khaovu kasuhtana, dingjanga kachesah nahitaove.
target: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt so that you would no longer be slaves to the Egyptians; I broke the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk with heads held high.

source: Ahinla, nanghon kathu nangailou uva, chule hiche thupeh ho jouse nabol lou uva;
target: “ ‘But if you will not listen to me and carry out all these commands,

source: Chule kachondan ho nanah sahmo uva, nahinnaovin kathutan naho ahotbola, chutia chu kathupeh ho jouse nabol daova, kakitepna nasuhkeh uva ahile;
target: and if you reject my decrees and abhor my laws and fail to carry out all my commands and so violate my covenant,

source: Hichehi keiman jong nangho chunga kabolding ahi; namit teniu kamang ding le nalungsungu sugenthei dinga, nachung uva tijatna, khutsao le khosihpi kachuhsah ding ahi. Chule mohseh-a muchi nalhah dingu ahi, ajehchu namelmate nehding bep ahibouve.
target: then I will do this to you: I will bring on you sudden terror, wasting diseases and fever that will destroy your sight and sap your strength. You will plant seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.

source: Chule keiman nangho douna-a kamai kangat ding, chule nangho namelma teu masanga naloudiu: nangho hinmuda hochun nachung uva vai ahomdiu; chule nangho koima del louva najam dingu ahi.
target: I will set my face against you so that you will be defeated by your enemies; those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee even when no one is pursuing you.

source: Chule hicheho jouse jeh-a jong kathu nangailou nahlai uva ahile, nachonset jeh uva sagi vei kasuh gentheibe ding nahiuve.
target: “ ‘If after all this you will not listen to me, I will punish you for your sins seven times over.

source: Chule nakiletsah piu nathanei nao chu kasuhkeh ding; chule navan-u chu thih, chule na leiset nu chu sum-eng kaso ding ahi.
target: I will break down your stubborn pride and make the sky above you like iron and the ground beneath you like bronze.

source: Chuteng nathahat naochu mohjen seh-a kisumang ding ahi; ajehchu naleiset un aga asolou ding, gamsunga thingphung honjong aga aseplou dingu ahi.
target: Your strength will be spent in vain, because your soil will not yield its crops, nor will the trees of your land yield their fruit.

source: Chule nangho keito kikala nacheova, kathu nangailou uva ahile; nachonset nahou dungjuija chan sagi-a tam hise nachung uva kalensah ding ahi.
target: “ ‘If you remain hostile toward me and refuse to listen to me, I will multiply your afflictions seven times over, as your sins deserve.

source: Keiman nachateo chom mang ding, nagancha hou sumang ding, chule lhomcha naso dinguva gamsaho jong kahinsol ding; chule nalam lhongpiu hou chu agohkeo hiding ahi.
target: I will send wild animals against you, and they will rob you of your children, destroy your cattle and make you so few in number that your roads will be deserted.

source: Chule hiche ho-a jonghi nangho nakisem thah lou nahlai juva, chule keima toh kikala nachon nahlai uva ahile;
target: “ ‘If in spite of these things you do not accept my correction but continue to be hostile toward me,

source: Keima jong nangho to kikala kacheding, chule nachonset nahou jeh-a sagivei kasuhgimbe ding nahiuve.
target: I myself will be hostile toward you and will afflict you for your sins seven times over.

source: Chule keiman kakitepna nelkalna phula dinga, nachung uva chemjam kachuh sah ding ahi: chule nakhopi hou sunga nangho nakikhop khom tengule, nalah uva natset kalensah ding; chule nangho namelma teu khutna kipedoh ding nahiuve.
target: And I will bring the sword on you to avenge the breaking of the covenant. When you withdraw into your cities, I will send a plague among you, and you will be given into enemy hands.

source: Chule keiman na-an neh-u hungkon dohna kasuhtan tengle, numei somin thuh khatna nachang lhah-u akandiu, chule amahon nachang lhah-u chu agih dungjuija napehdiu; nanghon naneh uva, ahivanga nava loudiu ahi.
target: When I cut off your supply of bread, ten women will be able to bake your bread in one oven, and they will dole out the bread by weight. You will eat, but you will not be satisfied.

source: Chule hicheho jouse jenga jonghi nanghon kathu nangailou uva, chule keima toh kikala nache nahlai juva ahile;
target: “ ‘If in spite of this you still do not listen to me but continue to be hostile toward me,

source: Chuteng keima nangho toh kikala lungsa tah-a kacheding; chule keima, keimatah-in nachonset nahou jeh-a sagivei kagimbol ding nahiuve.
target: then in my anger I will be hostile toward you, and I myself will punish you for your sins seven times over.

source: Chuteng nanghon nachapateo tahsa naneh dingu, chule nachanuteu tahsa jong naneh dingu ahi.
target: You will eat the flesh of your sons and the flesh of your daughters.

source: Chule keima namun sanghou kasuhsetna, nalimsem hou kasuh boh-a, nalongu chu namilim hou long chunga kaselhah ding, chule kahinnan nangho ahotding ahi.
target: I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars and pile your dead bodies on the lifeless forms of your idols, and I will abhor you.

source: Keiman nakhopi hou agoh-a kakoija, namun theng hou chu agohkeova kakoiding, chule nathil namtui hou nam chu kanahpeh louding nahiuve.
target: I will turn your cities into ruins and lay waste your sanctuaries, and I will take no delight in the pleasing aroma of your offerings.

source: Chule keiman gamsung chu agohkeova kakoiding: chule namelma teu asunga chengho chun hichu kidang asahdiu ahi.
target: I myself will lay waste the land, so that your enemies who live there will be appalled.

source: Chule keiman Pathen helouho lah-a nangho kathecheh ding, nanung uva chemjam'a kalap ding ahi: chule nagamu chu agohkeova uma, nakhopi hou chu ahomkeo hiding ahi.
target: I will scatter you among the nations and will draw out my sword and pursue you. Your land will be laid waste, and your cities will lie in ruins.

source: Chuteng gamsung chu agohkeova aumsungse-a acholngah nikhoho amanding, chule nangho namelma teu gamsunga naum dingu ahi; chutengle gamsung chu kicholdo ding, acholngah nikhoho aman ding ahi.
target: Then the land will enjoy its sabbath years all the time that it lies desolate and you are in the country of your enemies; then the land will rest and enjoy its sabbaths.

source: Agohkeova aumlai sungse-a kicholdo ding ahi; ajehchu nangho asunga nachen laijun, cholngah nikho hon akicholdo pon ahi.
target: All the time that it lies desolate, the land will have the rest it did not have during the sabbaths you lived in it.

source: Chule nangho lah-a ahingdoh amoh chasun chunga chu, aumnao amelmateu gamsunga chu alungsunga kichatna kachuh sah ding; thingdo kilin ginin jong amaho adel ding; chule chemjam masanga jam banga jam dingu; chule koiman adellou tengu jongle amaho lhuding ahiuve.
target: “ ‘As for those of you who are left, I will make their hearts so fearful in the lands of their enemies that the sound of a windblown leaf will put them to flight. They will run as though fleeing from the sword, and they will fall, even though no one is pursuing them.

source: Chule koiman adellou tengu jongle amaho chemjam masanga jam banga, khat chu khat chunga lhuding ahiuve: chule nanghon namelma teu masanga dinjou nathei tha nanei loudiu ahi.
target: They will stumble over one another as though fleeing from the sword, even though no one is pursuing them. So you will not be able to stand before your enemies.

source: Nangho Pathen helouho lah-a namanthah heldiu, chule namelma teu gamin nangho naneh jouhel dingu ahi.
target: You will perish among the nations; the land of your enemies will devour you.

source: Chule nangho lah-a ahoidoh hochun namelma teu gamsunga ana khangitlou naho anguipi diu; chule apu apateu khangitlou naho jong chu angui mangpi dingu ahi.
target: Those of you who are left will waste away in the lands of their enemies because of their sins; also because of their ancestors’ sins they will waste away.

source: Iti hama amahon akhangit lounao le apu apateu khangitlouna, asuhkhel nao keima douna-a asuhkhelna hou, chule keima toh kikala alamlhah nahou aphondoh uva ahile;
target: “ ‘But if they will confess their sins and the sins of their ancestors—their unfaithfulness and their hostility toward me,

source: Chule keima jong amaho toh kikalin kanachen, chule amelmateu gamsunga kana puilut tan; ijemtia alungsung cheptan louho chu asuhnemuva, chule akhangit lounao talen chu akisanuva ahile;
target: which made me hostile toward them so that I sent them into the land of their enemies—then when their uncircumcised hearts are humbled and they pay for their sin,

source: Keiman Jacob to kakitepna, Isaac to kakitepna, chule Abraham to kakitepna chu kageldoh kitding; chule gamsung chu kahin geldoh ding ahi.
target: I will remember my covenant with Jacob and my covenant with Isaac and my covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.

source: Gamsung jong amahon adalhah uva, gamsung chun amaho beija agohkeova aum sunga chu acholngah nikhoho aman ding: chule amahon akhangitlou naova atalen matnu chu asandiu ahi: ajehchu amahon kathu tanho anahsah loujeh uva, chule amahon keima chondan ho ahotbol jeh-u ahi.
target: For the land will be deserted by them and will enjoy its sabbaths while it lies desolate without them. They will pay for their sins because they rejected my laws and abhorred my decrees.

source: Chule hiche ho jouse jeh-a hi amelmateu gamsunga aumtengule, keiman amaho kapaidoh louding, suhmanghel ding le kakitepna suhkeh nadinga kahot loudingu ahi: ajehchu keima Pakai a-Pathen'u chu kahi.
target: Yet in spite of this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them or abhor them so as to destroy them completely, breaking my covenant with them. I am the Lord their God.

source: Hijongle keiman amaho jala hi, a-Pathen'u kahi theina dinga Pathen helouho mitmu-a Egypt gama kona kahungpuidoh aputeo apateu to kakitepna chu kageldohkit ding ahi: keima Pakai chu kahi.
target: But for their sake I will remember the covenant with their ancestors whom I brought out of Egypt in the sight of the nations to be their God. I am the Lord .’ ”

source: Hicheho hi chondanho, thutan naho, danthuho, Pakaiyin amale Israel chate kah-a Sinai molsanga Mosi khutna asemchu ahi.
target: These are the decrees, the laws and the regulations that the Lord established at Mount Sinai between himself and the Israelites through Moses.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate henga thu seijin lang, ajah uva hitin seijin, Mikhatnin mihem khat chu Pakaiya katdoh nadinga kitepna aneija ahile, nangman nahisah sah chu hiding ahi
target: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘If anyone makes a special vow to dedicate a person to the Lord by giving the equivalent value,

source: Nangman nahisah ding dan chu pasal kum somni apat kum somgup upa ahile, amachu munthenga shekel dungjuija dangka somnga hiding ahi.
target: set the value of a male between the ages of twenty and sixty at fifty shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel;

source: Numei ahile nangman nahisah ding chu shekel somthum hiding ahi.
target: for a female, set her value at thirty shekels;

source: Chule kum nga-a pat akum somni sung ahile, nangman pasal la chu shekel somni, chule numeija chu shekel som nahisah ding ahi.
target: for a person between the ages of five and twenty, set the value of a male at twenty shekels and of a female at ten shekels;

source: Chule lhakhat napat kum nga gei ahile, pasal ho dinga natepeh dingchu shekel nga hiding, numei hoding chu shekel thum hiding ahi.
target: for a person between one month and five years, set the value of a male at five shekels of silver and that of a female at three shekels of silver;

source: Chule kum somgup mapat chunglam ahia, pasal ahile, shekel somlenga nahisah ding, numei ahile shekel som nahisah ding ahi.
target: for a person sixty years old or more, set the value of a male at fifteen shekels and of a female at ten shekels.

source: Ahinla nangman nahisah sanga ama anavaichat johle, amachu amale ama thempu henga hung kipelut ding, chule thempun aman atepding ahi. Akihahselpa hijouna dungjuija, thempun aman atepding ahi.
target: If anyone making the vow is too poor to pay the specified amount, the person being dedicated is to be presented to the priest, who will set the value according to what the one making the vow can afford.

source: Chule Pakaiya thilto dinga ahin kaiju chu gancha ahia ahile, mitinin Pakaiya dinga ahin to jouseu chu atheng hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘If what they vowed is an animal that is acceptable as an offering to the Lord , such an animal given to the Lord becomes holy.

source: Aman hichu akhel louding, aphalou chu apha-a jong alheh louding ahi: chule ijemtia gan chu gana alheh tah-a ahile, hiche chule alhetna chu ania atheng hiding ahi.
target: They must not exchange it or substitute a good one for a bad one, or a bad one for a good one; if they should substitute one animal for another, both it and the substitute become holy.

source: Chule hichu Pakai henga ganlhaina atoji louvu sathenglou ahia ahile, aman gan chu thempu anga ahin pehlut ding:
target: If what they vowed is a ceremonially unclean animal—one that is not acceptable as an offering to the Lord —the animal must be presented to the priest,

source: Chule hichu thempun hichu apha hile ase hile aman atepding; thempu nangman aman natep jat jat chu aman hijeng ding ahi
target: who will judge its quality as good or bad. Whatever value the priest then sets, that is what it will be.

source: Ahinla aman hichu alhatdoh dinga ahile, nangman aman natep chunga chu nga-a khat abelap ding ahi.
target: If the owner wishes to redeem the animal, a fifth must be added to its value.

source: Chule mikhatnin a-in chu Pakaiya atheng hidinga asuhtheng tengle, thempun hichu apha hile ase hile aman atepding: thempun atep jatjat chu hijeng ding ahi.
target: “ ‘If anyone dedicates their house as something holy to the Lord , the priest will judge its quality as good or bad. Whatever value the priest then sets, so it will remain.

source: Chule a-in suthengpa chun a-in chu alhatdoh dinga ahile, nangman aman natep chunga chu nga-a khat abelap ding, chule hichu ama-a hiding ahi.
target: If the one who dedicates their house wishes to redeem it, they must add a fifth to its value, and the house will again become theirs.

source: Chule mikhatnin agoulo loumun behkhat chu Pakai henga asuhtheng tah-a ahile, aman dingchu chuche-a muchi kilhah dungjuija nangman natepding ahi; sakolchang chi homer khat chu dangka shekel som nga-a kitepding ahi.
target: “ ‘If anyone dedicates to the Lord part of their family land, its value is to be set according to the amount of seed required for it—fifty shekels of silver to a homer of barley seed.

source: Aman alou chu Jubilee kum-a pat asuhthenga ahile, nangman aman natep jatchu hijing ding ahi.
target: If they dedicate a field during the Year of Jubilee, the value that has been set remains.

source: Ahinla aman alou chu Jubilee jouva asuhtheng ahile, thempun apehding sum avat chu Jubilee hunglhun nading kum avatho dungjuija asimdoh pehding, chule hichu nangman nateppeh jatna kona kisulhom ding ahi.
target: But if they dedicate a field after the Jubilee, the priest will determine the value according to the number of years that remain until the next Year of Jubilee, and its set value will be reduced.

source: Chule lou suthengpa chun ipijeh hama alhatdoh dinga ahile, nangman aman natep chunga chu nga-a khat abelap ding, chuteng hichu ama-a dinga kisuhdet pehding ahi.
target: If the one who dedicates the field wishes to redeem it, they must add a fifth to its value, and the field will again become theirs.

source: Chule aman alou chu alhatdoh louding ahia, ahiloule alou chu midang khat henga ajohdoh-a ahile, kilhatdoh kit louding ahitai.
target: If, however, they do not redeem the field, or if they have sold it to someone else, it can never be redeemed.

source: Ahinla louchu Jubilee sunga pehdoh ahia ahile, akikatdoh lou banga hichu Pakaiya atheng hiding ahi; hichu thempu gouchan hiding ahi.
target: When the field is released in the Jubilee, it will become holy, like a field devoted to the Lord ; it will become priestly property.

source: Chule khattouvin ama neilegou hilou, amavang achohtho loumun chu Pakai henga asuhthenga ahile;
target: “ ‘If anyone dedicates to the Lord a field they have bought, which is not part of their family land,

source: Chuteng thempun Jubilee kum geija dinga nangman natep chu ama dinga asimpeh-a, chule hiche nikho mama chule amapan nangman natep jat chu thiltheng banga Pakai henga apeh ding ahi.
target: the priest will determine its value up to the Year of Jubilee, and the owner must pay its value on that day as something holy to the Lord .

source: Jubilee kum tengle alou chu akichohna pa henga kile kitding, masanga agam neipa heng ngeija chu kile kitding ahi.
target: In the Year of Jubilee the field will revert to the person from whom it was bought, the one whose land it was.

source: Chule nangman natep ho jouse chu munthenga shekel dungjui hicheh ding, gerah somni chu shekel hiding ahi.
target: Every value is to be set according to the sanctuary shekel, twenty gerahs to the shekel.

source: Gancha peng masapen, Pakaiya dinga apeng masapen hidingho bouchu koimachan asuhtheng louding ahi; bongchal hihen, ahiloule kelngoiho hijongle; hichu Pakaiya ahi.
target: “ ‘No one, however, may dedicate the firstborn of an animal, since the firstborn already belongs to the Lord ; whether an ox or a sheep, it is the Lord ’s.

source: Ahinla hichu gantheng louva kon ahile, natep dungjuija amapan alhatding, chule achunga nga-a khat abelap ding; ahiloule hichu akilhat lou dinga ahile, nangman aman natep dungjuija kijohdoh ding ahi.
target: If it is one of the unclean animals, it may be bought back at its set value, adding a fifth of the value to it. If it is not redeemed, it is to be sold at its set value.

source: Hijeng jongle thil kikatdoh tapou, mikhatnin aneiho jouse lah-a kon mihem le gancha lah-a kon hihen, agouchan alouva kon hijongle Pakaiya dinga akatdoh chan chu kijoh louding, lhatjong kilhatdoh louding ahi: thil kikatdoh jouse chu Pakaiya ding atheng chungnung hia ahi.
target: “ ‘But nothing that a person owns and devotes to the Lord —whether a human being or an animal or family land—may be sold or redeemed; everything so devoted is most holy to the Lord .

source: Mihem lah-a kona suhmang dinga kikatdohsa mihem vangchu koiman alhatdoh louding, amavang kithat teiding ahi.
target: “ ‘No person devoted to destruction may be ransomed; they are to be put to death.

source: Chule gamsunga somma khat jouse, gamsung muchi-a kon hihen, ahiloule agam theiga lah-a kon hijongle, Pakaiya ahi: Pakaiya dinga atheng ahi.
target: “ ‘A tithe of everything from the land, whether grain from the soil or fruit from the trees, belongs to the Lord ; it is holy to the Lord .

source: Chule mikhatnin asoma khat hochu lhatdoh ding agotna ahile, aman hiche chunga chu nga-a khat abelap ding ahi.
target: Whoever would redeem any of their tithe must add a fifth of the value to it.

source: Chule bonghon, ahiloule kelngoi hon thudola somakhat chu, moljol noija lut tapou asom lhina jouse chu Pakai henga dinga atheng hiding ahi.
target: Every tithe of the herd and flock—every tenth animal that passes under the shepherd’s rod—will be holy to the Lord .

source: Aman hichu aphaham ahiloule aseham akholkhoh louding, chule khel jong akhel louding ahi: chule iham tia aman akhel khah tah-a ahile, hiche chu le akhelpa chu ania atheng hiding ahi; hichu kilhatdoh louding ahi.
target: No one may pick out the good from the bad or make any substitution. If anyone does make a substitution, both the animal and its substitute become holy and cannot be redeemed.’ ”

source: Hicheho hi Sinai molsanga Israel chatea dinga Pakaiyin Mosi henga athupeh chu ahi.
target: These are the commands the Lord gave Moses at Mount Sinai for the Israelites.

source: Egypt gama kona ahungdoh kalu kumni channa, alhani lhinna nimasa pen nin Sinai gamthipma kikhopna houbuh sunga chun Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a thu ahin seijin, hitin ati.
target: The Lord spoke to Moses in the tent of meeting in the Desert of Sinai on the first day of the second month of the second year after the Israelites came out of Egypt. He said:

source: Israel chate houkhom ho jouse chu a-in ko kon, aphung phunga apate kailhah cheh-in, amin jatnu dungjui cheh-in pasal jouse abonchan simsoh keijin.
target: “Take a census of the whole Israelite community by their clans and families, listing every man by name, one by one.

source: Israel sunga galsat dinga manthei jouse kum somni-a pat achunglam sechu nangma toh Aaron'in aloi loija sim sohkei lhonin.
target: You and Aaron are to count according to their divisions all the men in Israel who are twenty years old or more and able to serve in the army.

source: Chule aphung phunga apate kailhah-a insung luchang pentah mikhat cheh nakithopi lhon dinga nalhen doh lhon ding ahi.
target: One man from each tribe, each of them the head of his family, is to help you.

source: Chule hicheng jouse hi nangni kithopi ding miho minchu ahi: Reuben phunga kon; Shedeur chapa Elizur.
target: These are the names of the men who are to assist you: from Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur;

source: Simeon phunga kon, Zurishaddai chapa Shelumiel.
target: from Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;

source: Judah phunga kon, Amminadab chapa Nahshon.
target: from Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;

source: Issachar phunga kon, Zuar chapa Nethaneel.
target: from Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;

source: Zebulun phunga kon, Helon chapa Eliab.
target: from Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon;

source: Joseph chate holah-a kon: Ephraim phunga kon, Amihud chapa Elishama: Manesseh phung kon, Pedahzur chapa Gamaliel.
target: from the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud; from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;

source: Benjamin phunga kon Gideoni chapa Abidan.
target: from Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni;

source: Dan phunga kon, Ammishaddai chapa Ahiezar.
target: from Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;

source: Asher phunga kon, Ocran chapa Pegiel.
target: from Asher, Pagiel son of Okran;

source: Gad phunga kon, Deuel chapa Eliasaph.
target: from Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel;

source: Naphtali phunga kon, Enan chapa Ahira hiding ahi.
target: from Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan.”

source: Hichenghi houkhom na lah-a kona aminche cheh ahiuvin, apu apateu phung kaija pipu cheh, Israel asang sang luchang ho ahiuve.
target: These were the men appointed from the community, the leaders of their ancestral tribes. They were the heads of the clans of Israel.

source: Chuin Mosi le Aaron chun hiche amin kisimdoh chengse hi apuidoh lhonin;
target: Moses and Aaron took these men whose names had been specified,

source: Chule houkhom ho jouse chu lhani lhinna nimasa pen nichun akhom khomun, amahon apu apaova a-inko dungjui cheh-in, kum somni-a lhah chunglamse chu asimun, amin jatnu dungjui cheh-in aphung guiju chu aphongdoh taove.
target: and they called the whole community together on the first day of the second month. The people registered their ancestry by their clans and families, and the men twenty years old or more were listed by name, one by one,

source: Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangin, aman jong Sinai gamthipma chun aminu asimtan ahi.
target: as the Lord commanded Moses. And so he counted them in the Desert of Sinai:

source: Israel chapa alenpen Reuben chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkei tan ahi.
target: From the descendants of Reuben the firstborn son of Israel: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, one by one, according to the records of their clans and families.

source: Reuben phunga kon akisimdoh amaho chengse chu; sangsomli le sanggup toh janga ahi.
target: The number from the tribe of Reuben was 46,500.

source: Simeon chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;
target: From the descendants of Simeon: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were counted and listed by name, one by one, according to the records of their clans and families.

source: Simeon phunga kon akisimdoh amaho chengse chu sangsomnga le sangko toh jathum ahi.
target: The number from the tribe of Simeon was 59,300.

source: Gad chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;
target: From the descendants of Gad: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

source: Gad phunga kon akisimdoh amaho chengse chu sangsomli le sangnga toh jagup le somnga ahi.
target: The number from the tribe of Gad was 45,650.

source: Judah chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;
target: From the descendants of Judah: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

source: Judah phunga kon akisimdoh amaho chengse chu sangsomsagi le sangli toh jagup ahi.
target: The number from the tribe of Judah was 74,600.

source: Issachar chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;
target: From the descendants of Issachar: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

source: Issachar phunga kon akisimdoh amaho chengse chu sangsomnga le sangli toh jali ahi.
target: The number from the tribe of Issachar was 54,400.

source: Zebulun chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;
target: From the descendants of Zebulun: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

source: Zebulun phunga kon akisimdoh amaho chengse chu sangsomnga le sagi toh jali ahi.
target: The number from the tribe of Zebulun was 57,400.

source: Joseph chate, aminso dinga Ephraim chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;
target: From the sons of Joseph: From the descendants of Ephraim: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

source: Ephraim phunga kon akisimdoh chengse chu sangsomli toh janga ahi.
target: The number from the tribe of Ephraim was 40,500.

source: Manasseh chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;
target: From the descendants of Manasseh: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

source: Manasseh phunga kon akisimdoh chengse chu sangsomthum le sangni toh jani ahi.
target: The number from the tribe of Manasseh was 32,200.

source: Benjamin chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;
target: From the descendants of Benjamin: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

source: Benjamin phunga kon akisimdoh chengse chu sangsomthum le sangnga toh jali ahi.
target: The number from the tribe of Benjamin was 35,400.

source: Dan chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;
target: From the descendants of Dan: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

source: Dan phunga kon akisimdoh chengse chu sangsomgup le sangni toh jasagi ahi.
target: The number from the tribe of Dan was 62,700.

source: Asher chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;
target: From the descendants of Asher: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

source: Asher phunga kon akisimdoh chengse chu sangsomli le sangkhat toh janga ahi.
target: The number from the tribe of Asher was 41,500.

source: Naphtali chate chu akhangu dungjui, a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh le, aminu kisim dungjui cheh-in pasal takip kum somni-a lhah chunglam sese galla konthei cheh chu asimtoh sohkeijun ahile;
target: From the descendants of Naphtali: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

source: Naphtali phunga kon akisimdoh chengse chu sangsomnga le sangthum toh jali ahi.
target: The number from the tribe of Naphtali was 53,400.

source: Hichenghi Mosi le Aaron nin asimdoh lhon chu ahin, Israel pipuho chu mi som le mini ahin; mikhat cheh chu phung khat cheh-a ding ahi.
target: These were the men counted by Moses and Aaron and the twelve leaders of Israel, each one representing his family.

source: Hijeh chun hichengho jouse hi Israel chate ho, apu apateu insung dungjui cheh-a kumsom ni-a lhah chunglamse, Israel sunga gal konthei cheh akisimdoh hochu ahiuvin;
target: All the Israelites twenty years old or more who were able to serve in Israel’s army were counted according to their families.

source: Aboncha akisimdoh jouse chu, sangjagup toh sangthum toh janga le somnga ahi.
target: The total number was 603,550.

source: Ahivangin Levi ho chu apu apateu kailhah phung lah ahin akisimtha pon ahi.
target: The ancestral tribe of the Levites, however, was not counted along with the others.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord had said to Moses:

source: Levi phung bou chu nasimtha louding, Israel chate kisim na-a jong nasimtha louding ahi.
target: “You must not count the tribe of Levi or include them in the census of the other Israelites.

source: Ahivangin nangman Levi ho chu hettohsahna houbuh chung le asunga um sumlheng ho chung, chule thildang aum jouse vetupma napansah ding ahi; amahon houbuh le asunga sumlheng ho jouse apoh dingu; chule hicheho chunga chu lhacha-a pangdiu, chujongle houbuh kimvela chu gebuh akison dingu ahi.
target: Instead, appoint the Levites to be in charge of the tabernacle of the covenant law—over all its furnishings and everything belonging to it. They are to carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; they are to take care of it and encamp around it.

source: Houbuh chu malama akichon ding tengle, Levi miten aphetlhah dingu: chule houbuh chu sonding ahitengle, Levi mihon atundoh dingu ahi: chule hetkhahlou mi anaija hunga aumle thajeng ding ahi.
target: Whenever the tabernacle is to move, the Levites are to take it down, and whenever the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall do it. Anyone else who approaches it is to be put to death.

source: Chule Israel chate chun ama ama ponbuh cheh chu abung abunga akisah diu, amitakipmin ajanelu dungjuija aponlap kom cheh uva akisah dingu ahi.
target: The Israelites are to set up their tents by divisions, each of them in their own camp under their standard.

source: Amavang Levi ho chun Israel houkhom ho chunga lungsatna aumlouna dinga, hettohsahna houbuh vela chu akisah dingu ahi. Chule Levi ho chun hettohsahna houbuh chunga mopohna anei dingu ahi.
target: The Levites, however, are to set up their tents around the tabernacle of the covenant law so that my wrath will not fall on the Israelite community. The Levites are to be responsible for the care of the tabernacle of the covenant law.”

source: Chuin hitichun Israel chate chun Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh jouse dungjui chun abol taovin ahi.
target: The Israelites did all this just as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron jah-a thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:

source: Israel chate jouse chun apu apateu insung melchihna kom, aponlap kom cheh uva pon in akison cheh dingu; amahon houkhom ho houbuh-a kona gamlatah-a pon in chu akison dingu ahi.
target: “The Israelites are to camp around the tent of meeting some distance from it, each of them under their standard and holding the banners of their family.”

source: Chule nisa hung sodoh na solam sanga chu ajanelu kihop khen dungjuija Judah le ajanel hon gebuh ason dingu ahi: chule Amminadab chapa Nahshon chu Judah chate chunga gal lamkai hiding ahin,
target: On the east, toward the sunrise, the divisions of the camp of Judah are to encamp under their standard. The leader of the people of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab.

source: Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomsagi le sangli toh jagup ahi.
target: His division numbers 74,600.

source: Chule ama banna gebuh kison dinga chu Issachar phung hiding: chule Zuar chapa Nethanel chu Issachar chate chunga gal lamkaija pangding ahi.
target: The tribe of Issachar will camp next to them. The leader of the people of Issachar is Nethanel son of Zuar.

source: Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomnga le sangli toh jali ahi.
target: His division numbers 54,400.

source: Chujoule Zebulun phung hintin: chule Helon chapa Eliab chu Zebulun chate chunga gal lamkaija pang ding ahi.
target: The tribe of Zebulun will be next. The leader of the people of Zebulun is Eliab son of Helon.

source: Chule ami janel, jatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomsagi le sangli toh jali ahi.
target: His division numbers 57,400.

source: Chule Judah gebuh-a kisimdoh chengse chu, sangjakhat le sangsomget le sanggup toh jali ahi. Amahohi kipatdoh masadiu ahi.
target: All the men assigned to the camp of Judah, according to their divisions, number 186,400. They will set out first.

source: Chule noilam sanga chu ajanelu kihop khen dungjuija Reuben le ajanel hon gebuh ason dingu ahi: chule Shedeur chapa Elizur chu Reuben chate chunga gal lamkai hiding ahi.
target: On the south will be the divisions of the camp of Reuben under their standard. The leader of the people of Reuben is Elizur son of Shedeur.

source: Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomli le sanggup toh janga ahi.
target: His division numbers 46,500.

source: Chule ama koma gebuh kisonho chu Simeon phung hiding ahi: chule Zurishaddai chapa Shelumiel chu Simeon chate chunga gal lamkai hiding ahi.
target: The tribe of Simeon will camp next to them. The leader of the people of Simeon is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.

source: Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomnga le sangko toh jathum ahi.
target: His division numbers 59,300.

source: Chubanna chu Gad phung hiding: chule Deuel chapa Eliasaph chu Gad chate chunga gal lamkai hiding ahi.
target: The tribe of Gad will be next. The leader of the people of Gad is Eliasaph son of Deuel.

source: Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomli le sanga toh jagup le somnga ahi.
target: His division numbers 45,650.

source: Chule Reuben gebuh sunga kisimdoh chengse chu sangjakhat le sangsomnga le sangkhat toh jali le somnga ahi, chule amaho chu agolni chana kipatdoh dingu ahi.
target: All the men assigned to the camp of Reuben, according to their divisions, number 151,450. They will set out second.

source: Chuteng houkhom ho houbuh chu gebuh lailunga Levi ho gebuh chutoh kitoldoh thading; amitakip amun cheh-a aponlap-u dungjuija, aponbuh-u ason bang banguva chu kitol dingu ahi.
target: Then the tent of meeting and the camp of the Levites will set out in the middle of the camps. They will set out in the same order as they encamp, each in their own place under their standard.

source: Chule lhumlam sanga chu ajanelu kihop khen dungjuija Reuben le ajanel hon gebuh ason dingu ahi: chule Ephraim chate chunga gal lamkai ding chu Ammihud chapa Elishama hiding ahi.
target: On the west will be the divisions of the camp of Ephraim under their standard. The leader of the people of Ephraim is Elishama son of Ammihud.

source: Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomli le janga ahi.
target: His division numbers 40,500.

source: Chule akoma chu Manasseh phung hiding: chule Pedahzur chapa Gamaliel chu Manasseh chate chunga gal lamkai hiding ahi.
target: The tribe of Manasseh will be next to them. The leader of the people of Manasseh is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.

source: Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomthum le sangni toh jani ahi.
target: His division numbers 32,200.

source: Chubanna chun Benjamin phung hintin: chule Gedeoni chapa Abidan chu Benjamin chate chunga gal lamkai hiding ahi.
target: The tribe of Benjamin will be next. The leader of the people of Benjamin is Abidan son of Gideoni.

source: Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomthum le sangnga toh jali ahi.
target: His division numbers 35,400.

source: Chule Ephraim gebuh sunga kisimdoh chengse chu sangjakhat toh sangget toh jakhat ahi. Chule amaho chu malam no-a agolthum channa-a chedingu ahi.
target: All the men assigned to the camp of Ephraim, according to their divisions, number 108,100. They will set out third.

source: Chule Dan le ajanel ho gebuh chu ajanelu kihop khen dungjuija sahlam sanga umding ahi: chule Ammishaddai chapa Ahiezer chu Dan chate chunga gal lamkai hiding ahi.
target: On the north will be the divisions of the camp of Dan under their standard. The leader of the people of Dan is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.

source: Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomgup le sangni toh jasagi ahi.
target: His division numbers 62,700.

source: Chule akoma gebuh kison dinga chu Asher phung hiding: chule Ocran chapa Pagiel chu Asher chate chunga gal lamkai hiding ahi.
target: The tribe of Asher will camp next to them. The leader of the people of Asher is Pagiel son of Okran.

source: Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomli le sangkhat toh janga ahi.
target: His division numbers 41,500.

source: Chubanna chun Naphtali phung hintin: Enan chapa Ahira chu Naphtali chate chunga gal lamkai hiding ahi.
target: The tribe of Naphtali will be next. The leader of the people of Naphtali is Ahira son of Enan.

source: Chule ami janel, ajatnu kisimdoh chengse chu sangsomnga le sangthum toh jali ahi.
target: His division numbers 53,400.

source: Chule Dan gebuh-a kisimdoh jouse chu sangjakhat le sangsomnga le sangsagi toh jagup ahi. Chule amaho chu aponlap utoh anunung pena cheding ahiuve.
target: All the men assigned to the camp of Dan number 157,600. They will set out last, under their standards.

source: Chule hichengse hi Israel chate lah-a apu apateu insung dungjuija kisimdoh chu ahi: agebuh uva ajanel pumpiu akisimdoh chengse chu abonchang keijin sangjagup leh sangthum to janga le somnga ahi.
target: These are the Israelites, counted according to their families. All the men in the camps, by their divisions, number 603,550.

source: Ahivangin Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangin, Levi ho chu Israel chate lah-a chun akisimtha pon ahi.
target: The Levites, however, were not counted along with the other Israelites, as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chutichun Israel chaten Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bang chun abol taovin; aponlap kom cheh uva pon in akisonun, amaho insung kailhah dungjui cheh le apu apateu insung dungjui cheh-in malama akitolun ahi.
target: So the Israelites did everything the Lord commanded Moses; that is the way they encamped under their standards, and that is the way they set out, each of them with their clan and family.

source: Hichehohi Pakaiyin Sinai molsanga Mosi henga thu anasei nikho-a Mosi le Aaron chilhah ho chu ahiuve.
target: This is the account of the family of Aaron and Moses at the time the Lord spoke to Moses at Mount Sinai.

source: Chule hicheho hi Aaron chapate min chu ahi: apeng masapen Nadab, chule Abihu, Eleazer chule Ithamar ahiuve.
target: The names of the sons of Aaron were Nadab the firstborn and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

source: Hichehohi thempu natohna-a lhacha natoh tong dinga aman akatdoh, thempu dinga thao kinu Aaron chapate ho min chu ahi.
target: Those were the names of Aaron’s sons, the anointed priests, who were ordained to serve as priests.

source: Chule Nadab le Abihu chu Sinai gamthipma Pakai masanga dan ngailouva gimnamtui ahalpet lhonin, Pakai angsunga athi lhontan, chule amanin cha aneilhon pon ahi: chule Eleazer le Ithamar chun apao Aaron mitmun thempu natohna lhachana chu atong lhontan ahi.
target: Nadab and Abihu, however, died before the Lord when they made an offering with unauthorized fire before him in the Desert of Sinai. They had no sons, so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during the lifetime of their father Aaron.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Levi phung chu hinpui naijin lang, amahon ama henga lhacha na atohtheina diuvin Aaron thempu masanga hinpui lutnin.
target: “Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him.

source: Chule amahon houbuh lhacha natoh nadinga, houkhom ho houbuh maija chu ama le houkhom pumpiho kin aboldingu ahi.
target: They are to perform duties for him and for the whole community at the tent of meeting by doing the work of the tabernacle.

source: Chule amahon houbuh lhacha natohna dinga, houkhom ho houbuh manchah jouse achin uva, Israel chate jouse tohding kin chanchu atoh dingu ahi.
target: They are to take care of all the furnishings of the tent of meeting, fulfilling the obligations of the Israelites by doing the work of the tabernacle.

source: Chule nangman Levi mite chu Aaron le achapate henga napehdoh ding ahi: amaho chu Israel chate lah-a kona apumpiuva ahenga dinga pehdoh ahiuve.
target: Give the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they are the Israelites who are to be given wholly to him.

source: Chule nangman Aaron le achapate chu thempu-a napan sah-a, chule amahon thempu tohmun chu angatup diu: chule hetkhahlou mi ahung naija aumle kithat ding ahi, ati.
target: Appoint Aaron and his sons to serve as priests; anyone else who approaches the sanctuary is to be put to death.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord also said to Moses,

source: Chule keima, ven, keiman Israel chate lah-a naobu phukeh-a apeng masaho jouse khela Levi mitehi Israel lah-a kona kalahdoh ahitai: hijeh chun Levi mite chu keija hidingu ahi.
target: “I have taken the Levites from among the Israelites in place of the first male offspring of every Israelite woman. The Levites are mine,

source: Ajehchu apengmasa jouse chu keija ahi; ijeh inem itile keiman Egypt gama apengmasa jouse katha nikho-a chu, Israelte lah-a apengmasa jouse mihem hihen gancha hijongle keima-a dinga kana suhtheng ahitai: amaho keija hiding ahiuve: keima Pakai chu kahi, ati.
target: for all the firstborn are mine. When I struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, I set apart for myself every firstborn in Israel, whether human or animal. They are to be mine. I am the Lord .”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Sinai gamthipma chun Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses in the Desert of Sinai,

source: Levi chateho jouse a-inko kou-a, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjuija, pasal takip lhakhatna pat chunglamse nasim ding ahi.
target: “Count the Levites by their families and clans. Count every male a month old or more.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Pakaiyin athupeh bangin amaho chu asimtan ahi.
target: So Moses counted them, as he was commanded by the word of the Lord .

source: Chule hicheho hi aminu dungjuija Levi chapate chu ahiuvin; Gershon, Kohath, chule Merari ahiuve.
target: These were the names of the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

source: Chule hiche hohi a-inkou dungjuijin Gershon chapate ahiuve; Libni chule Shimei ahilhone.
target: These were the names of the Gershonite clans: Libni and Shimei.

source: Chule a-insungu dungjuija Kohath chapate chu; Amram, Izehar, Hebron, chule Uzziel ahiuve.
target: The Kohathite clans: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.

source: Chule a-inkou dungjuija Merari chapate chu; Mahli chule Mushi ahiuve. Apu pateu insung kailhah dungjuija hiche hohi Levi insung mite ahiuve.
target: The Merarite clans: Mahli and Mushi. These were the Levite clans, according to their families.

source: Gershon'a kon hochu Libni insung mite le Shim insung mite ahiuvin; amaho hi Gershon insung miho chu ahiuve.
target: To Gershon belonged the clans of the Libnites and Shimeites; these were the Gershonite clans.

source: Amaho-a kon kisimdoh, pasal jouse kisim dungjuija lhakhat napat achunglam akisimdoh ho chu sangsagi le janga ahi.
target: The number of all the males a month old or more who were counted was 7,500.

source: Gershon insung mite chun houbuh tomlam, lhumlam sanga houbuh akisondiu ahi.
target: The Gershonite clans were to camp on the west, behind the tabernacle.

source: Chule Gershon insung mite pipuding chu Lael chapa Eliasaph hiding ahi.
target: The leader of the families of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.

source: Chule Gershon le achapaten houkhom ho houbuh sunga atohdiu chu houbuh, ponbuh, chule achung khuna, houkhom ho houbuh kotna khai ding ponjal,
target: At the tent of meeting the Gershonites were responsible for the care of the tabernacle and tent, its coverings, the curtain at the entrance to the tent of meeting,

source: Chule inhong sunga kikhai pondal ho, houbuh koma umle maicham kimvella um inhong kotna ding pondal, chule akhaoho jouse le hichea pangthei jouse chu ahi.
target: the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard surrounding the tabernacle and altar, and the ropes—and everything related to their use.

source: Chule Kohath insungmiho chu Amram insungmi, Izehar insungmi, Hebron insungmi, chule Uzziel insungmi ahiuve: hichenghi Kohath insungmi ahiuve.
target: To Kohath belonged the clans of the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites and Uzzielites; these were the Kohathite clans.

source: Muntheng vetup ding mi pasal lhakhat napat achunglamse akisim doh sangget le jagup ahi.
target: The number of all the males a month old or more was 8,600. The Kohathites were responsible for the care of the sanctuary.

source: Kohath chapateho insungmi chun houbuh pang lhanglam sanga chu pon in akisondiu ahi.
target: The Kohathite clans were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle.

source: Kohath chilhah insung mite pipupen ding chu Uzziel chapa Elizaphan hiding ahi.
target: The leader of the families of the Kohathite clans was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.

source: Chule amopoh diu chu Pathen thingkhong, dokhang, meivah khom, maicham ho, akin bolnadiu munthenga sumlheng ho, pondal, chule chua kin kibolding jouse chu ahi.
