target: They were responsible for the care of the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the articles of the sanctuary used in ministering, the curtain, and everything related to their use.

source: Chule Aaron thempupa chapa Eleazar chu Levi ho pipuiho chunga pipui pen hiding, chule muntheng vetupma pangho vesuile hiding ahi.
target: The chief leader of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest. He was appointed over those who were responsible for the care of the sanctuary.

source: Merari'a kon hochu Mahli insungmite le Mushi insungmite ahiuvin; hichengse hi Merari insungmi ho ahiuve.
target: To Merari belonged the clans of the Mahlites and the Mushites; these were the Merarite clans.

source: Chule amaho-a kon kisimdoh, pasal jouse kisim dungjuija lhakhat napat achunglam akisimdoh ho chu sang gupto jani ahi.
target: The number of all the males a month old or more who were counted was 6,200.

source: Merari chilhahte insung pipupen chu Abihail chapa Zuriel ahi; hicheho hin houbuh pang sahlam sanga chu pon in akison dingu ahi.
target: The leader of the families of the Merarite clans was Zuriel son of Abihail; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.

source: Chule Merari chapate vetup dinga kinganse chu houbuh thingpeh ho, chua kimang banggol ho, akhomho, akhom tunnaho, sumlheng ho, chule hicheho to kisai thil jouse,
target: The Merarites were appointed to take care of the frames of the tabernacle, its crossbars, posts, bases, all its equipment, and everything related to their use,

source: Chule ahongsung kimvella akhomho, akhom tunnaho, akilbeh naho leh akhaojangho chu ahi.
target: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs and ropes.

source: Ahinla solam sanga Houbuh maija, houkhom ho houbuh mai tah-a solam sanga ponbuh song ding chu Mosi le Aaron chule achapateho hiding, Israel chatehoa dinga muntheng mopohna chu atohdiu ahi; chule midang akom naija hung aumleh thajeng ding ahi.
target: Moses and Aaron and his sons were to camp to the east of the tabernacle, toward the sunrise, in front of the tent of meeting. They were responsible for the care of the sanctuary on behalf of the Israelites. Anyone else who approached the sanctuary was to be put to death.

source: Pakai thupeh-a Mosi le Aaron'in asimdoh lhon Levi mite akisimdoh jouse chu, a-inko pumpiuva, pasal lhakhatna pat chunglam jouse chu sangsomni le sangni ahi.
target: The total number of Levites counted at the Lord ’s command by Moses and Aaron according to their clans, including every male a month old or more, was 22,000.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Israel chate apengmasa pasal jouse lhakhat napat chunglam jouse simdoh inlang, aminhou jatchu simdoh-in.
target: The Lord said to Moses, “Count all the firstborn Israelite males who are a month old or more and make a list of their names.

source: Chule nangman Levi mite chu keija dinga Israel chate apeng masaho jouse khella nalahding, (keima Pakai kahi); chule Israel chate gancha apengmasa jouse khela Levi mite gancha chu nalah ding ahi.
target: Take the Levites for me in place of all the firstborn of the Israelites, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock of the Israelites. I am the Lord .”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Pakai thupeh bangin Israel achate lah-a apengmasa ho jouse chu asimdohtan ahi.
target: So Moses counted all the firstborn of the Israelites, as the Lord commanded him.

source: Chule apengmasa pasal jouse min kisim dungjuijin lhakhatna pat achunglam jouse chu sangsomni le sangni toh jani le somsagi le thum ahi.
target: The total number of firstborn males a month old or more, listed by name, was 22,273.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord also said to Moses,

source: Israel chate lah-a apengmasa jouse khelin Levi mite, aganchaho khellin Levi mite ganchaho lan; chule Levi mite chu keija hidingu ahi: Keima Pakai chu kahi.
target: “Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock. The Levites are to be mine. I am the Lord .

source: Chule lhatdoh-a umding Israel chate apengmasa Levi miho sanga jani le somsagi le thuma tamho chu;
target: To redeem the 273 firstborn Israelites who exceed the number of the Levites,

source: Nangman mikhat na Shekel nga cheh, munthenga shekel kila dungjuija nalahding ahin; (Shekel khat chu gerah somni ahi.)
target: collect five shekels for each one, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs.

source: Chule nangman sum chu avalho lhatdohna dinga Aaron le achapate napehding ahi, ati.
target: Give the money for the redemption of the additional Israelites to Aaron and his sons.”

source: Chuin Levi mite sanga tamjoho kilhatdohna ding sum chu Mosi'n alatan ahi.
target: So Moses collected the redemption money from those who exceeded the number redeemed by the Levites.

source: Munthenga shekel dungjuijin Israel chate apengmasa ho-a konin aman sum shekel sangkhat le jathum le somgup le nga alatan ahi.
target: From the firstborn of the Israelites he collected silver weighing 1,365 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangin, Mosi'n lhatdamna sum chu Pakai thu dungjuijin Aaron le chapate apetan ahi.
target: Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons, as he was commanded by the word of the Lord .

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga asejin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:

source: Kohath chapate mijat chu Levi chapaho lah-a kon le a-insung chule apu apateo insung dungjuijin,
target: “Take a census of the Kohathite branch of the Levites by their clans and families.

source: Kum somthuma lhah chunglam kum somnga gei houkhom ho houbuh sunga natohna tongdinga pangthei nalai jouse chu simdoh lhonnin.
target: Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work at the tent of meeting.

source: Hichehi houkhom ho houbuh sunga Kohath chapaten thiltheng chungnung penho chungchanga atohdiu kin chu hiding ahi:
target: “This is the work of the Kohathites at the tent of meeting: the care of the most holy things.

source: Houbuh chu akichondoh ding tengle, Aaron le achapate chu hunguva muntheng chungnunga kikhai pondal chu aloilhah uva, hettohsahna thingkhong chu akhukhum dingu ahi.
target: When the camp is to move, Aaron and his sons are to go in and take down the shielding curtain and put it over the ark of the covenant law.

source: Chule hichu satwilut vuna akhu khumuva, chule apumpia chu pondum khat akhukhum diu, chutengle ajolho chu athollut dingu ahi.
target: Then they are to cover the curtain with a durable leather, spread a cloth of solid blue over that and put the poles in place.

source: Chule vetsahna changlhah dokhang chunga chu pondum khat apha uva, chule hiche achunga chu kongho, thihkheho, sum lhengho, chule asinna ding asinho akoi dingu: chule tanglouhela kikoijing changlhah chu chuche chunga umding ahi.
target: “Over the table of the Presence they are to spread a blue cloth and put on it the plates, dishes and bowls, and the jars for drink offerings; the bread that is continually there is to remain on it.

source: Chule amahon hicheho chunga chu ponsanthip khat aphadiu, chule hichemama chu satuilut vunho-a akhukhum muva, chule ajolho chu athollut dingu ahi..
target: They are to spread a scarlet cloth over them, cover that with the durable leather and put the poles in place.

source: Chule amahon pondum khat alah uva alhacha natoh naova kimangcha meivah khom le athaomei, avutloho, akongho, chule chua um athaobelho jouse chu akhukhum diu:
target: “They are to take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand that is for light, together with its lamps, its wick trimmers and trays, and all its jars for the olive oil used to supply it.

source: Chule amahon hiche chu le umle belho jouse chu satuilut vunho-a akhukhum uva, ajol chunga chu akoidiu ahi.
target: Then they are to wrap it and all its accessories in a covering of the durable leather and put it on a carrying frame.

source: Chule sana maicham chung chu pondum khat na akhu khumuva, hichu satuilut vun khuna-a akhudiu, chule ajolho chu avodiu ahi.
target: “Over the gold altar they are to spread a blue cloth and cover that with the durable leather and put the poles in place.

source: Chule amahon munthenga akin bolnaova kinbolna manchaho jouse chu pondum khatna akoijuva, satuilut vun khuna akhudiu, chule moljol chunga akoidiu ahi.
target: “They are to take all the articles used for ministering in the sanctuary, wrap them in a blue cloth, cover that with the durable leather and put them on a carrying frame.

source: Chule amahon maichama kona vut hochu alahdoh uva, chule achunga ponsandup khat apha diu:
target: “They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and spread a purple cloth over it.

source: Chule hiche chunga chu amahon kinbolna-a amanchah-u umle belho jouse, gimnamtui halnaho, sathuhna thihkhe kaho, vutloho, twibel ho, chule maichama um thiljouse chu satuilut vun khuna ho-a akhuva, moljol ho avodiu ahi.
target: Then they are to place on it all the utensils used for ministering at the altar, including the firepans, meat forks, shovels and sprinkling bowls. Over it they are to spread a covering of the durable leather and put the poles in place.

source: Chule houbuh chu akichondohna dinga, Aaron le achapaten muntheng le asunga um le bel jouse akhukhum jou tengule; Kohath chapate chu apudinga hungdiu: amavang amahon athilouna dinguva thiltheng tapou chu atohkhah loudiu ahi. Hichehohi houkhom ho houbuh-a Kohath chapate pohding chu ahi.
target: “After Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy furnishings and all the holy articles, and when the camp is ready to move, only then are the Kohathites to come and do the carrying. But they must not touch the holy things or they will die. The Kohathites are to carry those things that are in the tent of meeting.

source: Chule Aaron thempupa chapa Eleazar tohding chu; meija vahding thao, gimnamtui, nitin anneh thilto, nuding thao, chule houbuh pumpi leh asunga um jouse, munthenga thil umjouse le chua um le bel ho jouse vetsui ding chu ahi.
target: “Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, is to have charge of the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the regular grain offering and the anointing oil. He is to be in charge of the entire tabernacle and everything in it, including its holy furnishings and articles.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

source: Levi miho lah-a konin Kohath phung insungmite chu paidoh lhon hih-in;
target: “See that the Kohathite tribal clans are not destroyed from among the Levites.

source: Ahinla amahon thiltheng chung nungho anaitengule thilouva ahinthei nadinguva hitia hi nabolpeh lhon ding ahi. Aaron le achapate chu lutnuntin, atohdiu kin le apohdiu cheh agotpeh diu:
target: So that they may live and not die when they come near the most holy things, do this for them: Aaron and his sons are to go into the sanctuary and assign to each man his work and what he is to carry.

source: Amavang thilthengho akikhukhum pet teng, athilouna diuva avedinga lutlou diu ahi.
target: But the Kohathites must not go in to look at the holy things, even for a moment, or they will die.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Gershon chapate mijat chu apu apateo insung pumpi le a-insungu dungjuijin simdoh-in;
target: “Take a census also of the Gershonites by their families and clans.

source: Lhacha kin bola lutna, houkhom ho houbuh sunga natohna tongthei jouse chu kum somthuma lhah chunglam kum somnga gei jouse chu nasimdoh ding ahi.
target: Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work at the tent of meeting.

source: Kinbol le pohgih pohna lam hi Gershon insung mite tohding kin ahi.
target: “This is the service of the Gershonite clans in their carrying and their other work:

source: Chule amahon houbuh pondal ho, houkhom ho houbuh, achung khuna, achunga um satuilut vun chung khuna, chule houkhom ho houbuh kotna kikhai pondal,
target: They are to carry the curtains of the tabernacle, that is, the tent of meeting, its covering and its outer covering of durable leather, the curtains for the entrance to the tent of meeting,

source: Chule inhong sunga pondal ho, houbuh kom le maicham kimvela um inhongsung kotpi kotkhah-a pondal kikhaiho, akhaoho, chule akinbol naova manchah jouse le amaho dinga kisem jouse chu apohdiu ahi. Hitia chu amahon kin chu aboldiu ahi.
target: the curtains of the courtyard surrounding the tabernacle and altar, the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard, the ropes and all the equipment used in the service of the tent. The Gershonites are to do all that needs to be done with these things.

source: Gershon chapate natoh jouse, apohdiu jouse le akinboldiu jouse chu Aaron le achapate thupeh-a kona aboldingu ahi: chule nangman apohdiu jouse-a dinga thuneina napehding ahi.
target: All their service, whether carrying or doing other work, is to be done under the direction of Aaron and his sons. You shall assign to them as their responsibility all they are to carry.

source: Hiche hi Gershon insung chapatehon houbuh sunga atohdiu kin chu ahi. Chule amaho natoh jouse chu Aaron thempupa chapa Ithamar mopohna noija umding ahi.
target: This is the service of the Gershonite clans at the tent of meeting. Their duties are to be under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.

source: Merari chapate chu ahile, a-insung hou le apu apateo insung kailhah dungjuija nasimding;
target: “Count the Merarites by their clans and families.

source: Kum somthuma pat chunglam kum somnga gei, houkhom ho houbuh sunga natong dinga, kinbolna-a lutsese chu nasimding ahi.
target: Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work at the tent of meeting.

source: Chule amaho mopohna chu hichehi hiding ahi; houkhom ho houbuh sunga anatohnao dungjuija, houbuh thingpehho, chua um banggol ho, akhompiho, akhom tunnaho,
target: As part of all their service at the tent, they are to carry the frames of the tabernacle, its crossbars, posts and bases,

source: Chule ahongsung kimvela khompiho, akhom tunnaho, akilnaho leh akhaoho, amanchahho jouse pum leh anatohna hou jouse toh pohding ahin; amin cheh uva apoh diu manchah cheh chu nagonpeh ding ahi.
target: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, ropes, all their equipment and everything related to their use. Assign to each man the specific things he is to carry.

source: Hichehi Aaron thempu chapa Ithamar khut noija houkhom ho houbuh sunga akin jouseu dungjuija Merari chapate insung tohding kin chu ahi.
target: This is the service of the Merarite clans as they work at the tent of meeting under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.”

source: Chuin Mosi le Aaron chule houkhom pipuihon Kohath chapate chu a-insungu dungjui le apu apateo insung kailhah dungjuijin asimtaovin,
target: Moses, Aaron and the leaders of the community counted the Kohathites by their clans and families.

source: Kum somthuma pat chunglam kum somnga gei houkhom ho houbuh sunga natong dinga, kinbolna-a lutsese chu,
target: All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to serve in the work at the tent of meeting,

source: Amaho insung kailhah cheh-a kisimdoh-a chu sangni le jasagi toh somnga ahi.
target: counted by clans, were 2,750.

source: Hiche hohi Pakaiyin Mosi khutna kona athupeh dungjuija Mosi le Aaron'in Kohath insungmi teho jouse houkhom ho houbuh sunga kin natong dinga asimdoh lhon chu ahi.
target: This was the total of all those in the Kohathite clans who served at the tent of meeting. Moses and Aaron counted them according to the Lord ’s command through Moses.

source: Chule Gershon chapateho a-insung pumpiu, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjuija kisimdoh ho,
target: The Gershonites were counted by their clans and families.

source: Kum somthuma pat chunglam kum somnga gei, houkhom ho houbuh sunga natong dinga kinbolna-a lutsese chu,
target: All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to serve in the work at the tent of meeting,

source: Chuti chun a-insungu pumpi le apu apateu insung kailhah-a kona kisimdoh chu sangni le jagup toh somthum ahi.
target: counted by their clans and families, were 2,630.

source: Hichengse hi Gershon chapate insungho-a houkhom ho houbuh sunga kinbolna jouse-a natongthei cheh dinga Mosi le Aaron'in Pakai thupeh dungjuija asimdoh lhon chu ahi.
target: This was the total of those in the Gershonite clans who served at the tent of meeting. Moses and Aaron counted them according to the Lord ’s command.

source: Chule Merari chapate insung, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjuija a-insung pumpiu kisimdoh ho chu ahi.
target: The Merarites were counted by their clans and families.

source: Kum somthuma pat chunglam kum somnga gei houkhom ho houbuh sunga natong dinga, kinbolna-a lutsese chu,
target: All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to serve in the work at the tent of meeting,

source: Hitichun a-insungu dungjuija kisimdoh chengse chu sangthum le jani ahi.
target: counted by their clans, were 3,200.

source: Hichengse hi Pakaiyin Mosi khutna kona athupeh dungjuija Mosi le Aaron'in Merari chapate insung anasimdoh lhon chengse chu ahi.
target: This was the total of those in the Merarite clans. Moses and Aaron counted them according to the Lord ’s command through Moses.

source: Mosi, Aaron chule Israel lamkai pipuihon a-insungu dungjui, apu apateu insung kailhah dungjui cheh-a anasimdoh hou chengse chu,
target: So Moses, Aaron and the leaders of Israel counted all the Levites by their clans and families.

source: Kum somthuma lhah chunglam kum somnga gei, kinbolna lhacha natohna le houkhom ho houbuh sunga lhacha kinbona dinga hungchan chu,
target: All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to do the work of serving and carrying the tent of meeting

source: Hitia amahoa kona kisimdoh jouse chu sang get le janga toh somget ahi.
target: numbered 8,580.

source: Pakai thupeh dungjuijin Mosi khutna konin amitakip chu atohdiu kin dungjui cheh leh apohdiu dungjui cheh-in asimdoh un, hitichun Pakaiyin Mosi anathupeh bangin amaho chu asimdoh tan ahi.
target: At the Lord ’s command through Moses, each was assigned his work and told what to carry. Thus they were counted, as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Miphah takip, athilong takip le, thilonga suboh chan chu ponbuh polama anodoh nadiuvin Israel chate thu pen:
target: “Command the Israelites to send away from the camp anyone who has a defiling skin disease or a discharge of any kind, or who is ceremonially unclean because of a dead body.

source: Alaitah-a ka chenna aponbuh hou asuhboh louna diuva, nangma pasal le numei agoma nanodoh-a, ponbuh polama nakoidoh ding ahi, ati.
target: Send away male and female alike; send them outside the camp so they will not defile their camp, where I dwell among them.”

source: Chuin Israel chaten chutichun abolun, amaho chu ponbuh polama akoitaove. Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a anasei bang chun Israel chaten aboltauvin ahi.
target: The Israelites did so; they sent them outside the camp. They did just as the Lord had instructed Moses.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate jah-a seipeh in, Pasal ahiloule numei khattouvin Pakai douna-a mihemin abolji chonset itobang hijongle abol tengle, hitobang mi chu themmo changa ahin,
target: “Say to the Israelites: ‘Any man or woman who wrongs another in any way and so is unfaithful to the Lord is guilty

source: Chutengle amahon achonset bolu chu aphondoh dingu, chule aman asuhkhelna chu lhingsetna aledit ding, hichea chu hopnga-a hopkhat abe-a, anasuhkhelna pa chu apehding ahi.
target: and must confess the sin they have committed. They must make full restitution for the wrong they have done, add a fifth of the value to it and give it all to the person they have wronged.

source: Ahinla asuhkhel ditdohna ding mipa chu inko neilou ahile, asuhkhelna chu Pakai hengle thempu heng ngeija ledit hen; longlhenna kelngoichal simlouva, ama dinga longlhenna khat semding ahi.
target: But if that person has no close relative to whom restitution can be made for the wrong, the restitution belongs to the Lord and must be given to the priest, along with the ram with which atonement is made for the wrongdoer.

source: Chule Israel chatehon thempu henga ahinchoi ju ahintou thiltheng hou jouse chu ama-a hiding ahi.
target: All the sacred contributions the Israelites bring to a priest will belong to him.

source: Chule amitakip thilto kisuthengho chu ama-a hiding; itobang hile mi khattouvin thempupa apeh tapou chu, ama-a hiding ahi.
target: Sacred things belong to their owners, but what they give to the priest will belong to the priest.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: Then the Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate jah-a seipeh in lang hitihin tin, Pasal khattou aji ajammanga, amapa douna-a suhkhel abola,
target: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘If a man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him

source: Pasal khattou amanutoh alup khoma, hichu ajipa mitmu-a kona akisel manga, aki-imchah-a, chule amanu akisuhboh-a, amanu chunga ahetoh aumlouva, chule amanu matdoh ahilouva;
target: so that another man has sexual relations with her, and this is hidden from her husband and her impurity is undetected (since there is no witness against her and she has not been caught in the act),

source: Chule amapa chunga thangthipna lhagao achuh-a, akisuboh-a a-inneipi chu athang thippi khah tah-a; ahiloule amapa chunga thangthipna lhagao achuh-a, ana kisubohlou a-inneipi chu athang thippi khah tah-a ahile;
target: and if feelings of jealousy come over her husband and he suspects his wife and she is impure—or if he is jealous and suspects her even though she is not impure—

source: Chuteng mipa chun a-inneipi chu thempupa henga apuiding, amanu dinga thilpeh suhlou chang anneh ephah hopsom ma hopkhat ahinchoi ding; amapan achunga thao asunlou ding, bego jong akoilou ding ahi; ajehchu hichehi thangthip thilpeh, hetjingna thilpeh le, khanset geldoh jingna thilpeh ahi.
target: then he is to take his wife to the priest. He must also take an offering of a tenth of an ephah of barley flour on her behalf. He must not pour olive oil on it or put incense on it, because it is a grain offering for jealousy, a reminder-offering to draw attention to wrongdoing.

source: Chule thempupa chun amanu chu akom naija apuilutna, Pakai masanga adinsah ding:
target: “ ‘The priest shall bring her and have her stand before the Lord .

source: Chule thempupa chun twitheng leibela ahindopma; houbuh lhonga leivui chu alah-a, twilah-a chu alhahlut ding;
target: Then he shall take some holy water in a clay jar and put some dust from the tabernacle floor into the water.

source: Chule thempupa chun numeinu chu Pakai anga adinsah-a, asam alhaplhah peh-a, akhutna chu thangthipna thilpeh, hetjingna thilto chu akoi ding: chule thempupa chun akhutna sapset konsah twikha chu akidop ding ahi.
target: After the priest has had the woman stand before the Lord , he shall loosen her hair and place in her hands the reminder-offering, the grain offering for jealousy, while he himself holds the bitter water that brings a curse.

source: Chutengle thempun amanu kihahsel sah-a, amanu jah-a chu, Koimachan naluppi louva, na-inneipu khela midangtoh thanhoi na-a navamang lou ahile, hiche sapset konsah twikha-a konhin ongtholin:
target: Then the priest shall put the woman under oath and say to her, “If no other man has had sexual relations with you and you have not gone astray and become impure while married to your husband, may this bitter water that brings a curse not harm you.

source: Amavang na-inneipu khela midang henga vahmanga, nakisuh boh-a, chule na inneipu tailou midang khattouvin naluppi-a ahileh:
target: But if you have gone astray while married to your husband and you have made yourself impure by having sexual relations with a man other than your husband”—

source: Chutengle thempupa chun numeinu chu sapsetna kitepna khatna akitepsah-a, chule thempu chun numeinu jah-a, Pakaiyin napheipi amonsah-a, chule na-oipi apohsah tengle, Pakaiyin namite lah-a nangma gaosap le hahselna nachansah hen;
target: here the priest is to put the woman under this curse—“may the Lord cause you to become a curse among your people when he makes your womb miscarry and your abdomen swell.

source: Chule hiche sapset kona twihin na-oipi pohsah ding le napheipi monsah dinga na-oipi sunga lutding ahi, atiding; chule numeinu chun Amen, Amen, atiding ahi.
target: May this water that brings a curse enter your body so that your abdomen swells or your womb miscarries.” “ ‘Then the woman is to say, “Amen. So be it.”

source: Chule thempupa chun hiche sapsetna hochu lekhabu khatna ajihlutna, chule aman hicheho chu twikha-a chu asoplhah ding ahi.
target: “ ‘The priest is to write these curses on a scroll and then wash them off into the bitter water.

source: Chule aman numeinu chu sapset konsah twikha chu adonsah ding, chule sapset konsah twi chu amanu sunga lutna hungkha ding ahi.
target: He shall make the woman drink the bitter water that brings a curse, and this water that brings a curse and causes bitter suffering will enter her.

source: Chujouteng thempu chun thangthipna thilpeh chu numeinu khutna kona alah-a, thilto chu Pakai masanga ajapma, maicham chunga ato ding ahi.
target: The priest is to take from her hands the grain offering for jealousy, wave it before the Lord and bring it to the altar.

source: Chule thempu chun thil kitohdoh, hetjingna ngeitah chu khutdim khat achoija, maicham chunga ahalvam ding, chujou tengle aman numeinu chu adonsah ding ahi.
target: The priest is then to take a handful of the grain offering as a memorial offering and burn it on the altar; after that, he is to have the woman drink the water.

source: Chule aman amanu chu twi adonsah tengle hitiding ahi, hichu, amanu kisuboh ahia, a-inneipu douna-a suhkhel nei ahile, sapset konsah twi chu asunga lutna, hungkha-a, a-oipi hungpoma, chuleh apheipi hungmon lhading: chuleh numeinu chu amite lah-a sapset chang hitading ahi.
target: If she has made herself impure and been unfaithful to her husband, this will be the result: When she is made to drink the water that brings a curse and causes bitter suffering, it will enter her, her abdomen will swell and her womb will miscarry, and she will become a curse.

source: Ahinla numeinu chu akisuhboh lou ahi-a, athensel ahivangle; amanu chu ongthola, son le pah aneiding ahi.
target: If, however, the woman has not made herself impure, but is clean, she will be cleared of guilt and will be able to have children.

source: Hichehi inneipi khat a-inneipu khela michom henga achea akisuboh tenga dinga thangthipna dan ahin,
target: “ ‘This, then, is the law of jealousy when a woman goes astray and makes herself impure while married to her husband,

source: Ahiloule ama chunga thangthipna lhagao ahung uma, ajinu chunga thangthipna nei ahile, numeinu chu Pakai masanga adinsah ding, thempupa chun amanu chunga hiche dan jousehi atoh bulhit ding ahi.
target: or when feelings of jealousy come over a man because he suspects his wife. The priest is to have her stand before the Lord and is to apply this entire law to her.

source: Chutengle mipa chu khangitlouna-a kona ongthola, numeinu chun ama khangitlouna chu akipoh ding ahi.
target: The husband will be innocent of any wrongdoing, but the woman will bear the consequences of her sin.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate lah-a seipeh-in lang, ajah uva, Pasal ahiloule numei Pakaiya dinga atumbeh hiding, Nazir mikhat hina dinga kitepna-a kitep dinga akichomkhen tengule;
target: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘If a man or woman wants to make a special vow, a vow of dedication to the Lord as a Nazirite,

source: Amachu ju le khamna theija kona kikangse ding, juthuh ahiloule khamnathei juthuh adonlou ding, lengpiga ju tapou hijongle adonlou ding, chule lengpiga athah hihen alui hijongle anehlou ding ahi.
target: they must abstain from wine and other fermented drink and must not drink vinegar made from wine or other fermented drink. They must not drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins.

source: Akichom khenna nikhoho jouse-a chu lengpiguija kona kisem, amuho-a patna ahoh changeija kisem ipi hijongle anehlou ding ahi.
target: As long as they remain under their Nazirite vow, they must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine, not even the seeds or skins.

source: Akichom khenna akitepna nikhoho jouse-a chu aluchanga samchem chulouding ahi. Chule Pakaiya dinga akipehdohna nikhoho abulhit masangse-a ama chu atheng hiding, chule alua asamlom jong akhansah ding ahi.
target: “ ‘During the entire period of their Nazirite vow, no razor may be used on their head. They must be holy until the period of their dedication to the Lord is over; they must let their hair grow long.

source: Pakaiya dinga akichom khenna nikhoho sungse-a chu aman mithilong anailou ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Throughout the period of their dedication to the Lord , the Nazirite must not go near a dead body.

source: Aman apa ham, anuham, asopipa ham ahiloule asopinu ham athi tengle, amale ama kisuboh louding ahi; ajehchu a-Pathen suhthengna chu aluchanga uma ahi.
target: Even if their own father or mother or brother or sister dies, they must not make themselves ceremonially unclean on account of them, because the symbol of their dedication to God is on their head.

source: Akichom khenna nikhoho sungse-a chu ama Pakaiya dinga atheng ahi.
target: Throughout the period of their dedication, they are consecrated to the Lord .

source: Ahin mikhattou akoma photlotna athi jeng tah-a, Pathen'a akipeh thengna aluchu abohtah-a ahile, akisuhtheng nikho nile alu ahettol ding, anisagi nile ahettol ding ahi.
target: “ ‘If someone dies suddenly in the Nazirite’s presence, thus defiling the hair that symbolizes their dedication, they must shave their head on the seventh day—the day of their cleansing.

source: Chule aniget lhin nile aman houkhom ho houbuh kotbula thempu henga chu vakhu nou ni ahiloule vapal nou ni ahinchoi ding;
target: Then on the eighth day they must bring two doves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

source: Chule thempupa chun khatchu chonset thilto-a ato-a, chule khat chu govam thilto-a atoding, chule amadinga chu longlhena abolding ahi; ajehchu mithilong jeh-a achonsea ahin, chule hiche nima ma-a chu aman alu akisuhtheng ding ahi.
target: The priest is to offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to make atonement for the Nazirite because they sinned by being in the presence of the dead body. That same day they are to consecrate their head again.

source: Chule akichomkhena nikho hochu Pakai henga suhthengna dinga, kumkhat lhingsa kelngoinou chal khat suhkhel thilto-a dinga ahinkai ding ahi. Amavang akichom khenna abohtah jeh-a chu amasanga nikhoho chu moh hiding ahitai.
target: They must rededicate themselves to the Lord for the same period of dedication and must bring a year-old male lamb as a guilt offering. The previous days do not count, because they became defiled during their period of dedication.

source: Chule hichehi Nazir mikhatnin akichom khenna nikhoho alhin teng abolding dan chu ahi: amachu kimutona houkhom ho houbuh kotna chu hung kipui ding:
target: “ ‘Now this is the law of the Nazirite when the period of their dedication is over. They are to be brought to the entrance to the tent of meeting.

source: Chule aman Pakai henga govam thilto-a todinga kumkhat lhingsa nolnabei kelngoinou chal khat, chonset thilto-a dinga kumkhat lhingsa nolnabei kelngoinou chal khat, chule chamna thilto-a dinga kumkhat lhingsa nolnabei kelngoinou chal khat apehding,
target: There they are to present their offerings to the Lord : a year-old male lamb without defect for a burnt offering, a year-old ewe lamb without defect for a sin offering, a ram without defect for a fellowship offering,

source: Chule cholsolou changlhah pocha khat, thao toh kihal changbong neljet changlhah phengkhat, thao kinu-a pasetna kisem cholsolou changlhah khat toh, anneh thilto le donding thilto apehding ahi.
target: together with their grain offerings and drink offerings, and a basket of bread made with the finest flour and without yeast—thick loaves with olive oil mixed in, and thin loaves brushed with olive oil.

source: Chule thempu pan hicheho chu Pakai masanga ahinchoi ding, chule aman chonset thilto le govam thilto chu atoding:
target: “ ‘The priest is to present all these before the Lord and make the sin offering and the burnt offering.

source: Chule aman kelngoichal chu Pakai anga chamna ganlhaina thilto-a dinga cholsolou changlhah pocha khattoh atoding: Thempu pa chun a-anneh thilto le adon thilto jong atoding ahi.
target: He is to present the basket of unleavened bread and is to sacrifice the ram as a fellowship offering to the Lord , together with its grain offering and drink offering.

source: Chule Nazir mi chun houkhom ho houbuh kotna chu akichom khenna lu chu akivoding, chule akichom khenna melchihna asam chu alah-a, hichu gan lhaina chamna thilto ho noija um meisunga aselut ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Then at the entrance to the tent of meeting, the Nazirite must shave off the hair that symbolizes their dedication. They are to take the hair and put it in the fire that is under the sacrifice of the fellowship offering.

source: Chule thempu pa chun akihonminsa kelngoichal chu adah khatle pocha-a cholsolou changlhah lum khat, chule cholsolou changlhah paset khat alah-a, hicheho chu akichom khenna sam avojou tengle Nazir pa khutna apehding ahi.
target: “ ‘After the Nazirite has shaved off the hair that symbolizes their dedication, the priest is to place in their hands a boiled shoulder of the ram, and one thick loaf and one thin loaf from the basket, both made without yeast.

source: Chule thempu pa chun hicheho chu Pakai anga jap thilto-a dinga ajapding ahi: hiche hi le jap thilto-a dinga kitoh a-om le amal chu thempu-a dinga atheng ahi. Chujouteng lehin Nazir mi chun lengpitwi adonthei ding ahitai.
target: The priest shall then wave these before the Lord as a wave offering; they are holy and belong to the priest, together with the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented. After that, the Nazirite may drink wine.

source: Hichehi akitepma Nazir mi-a dinga dan le, akhutnin aphal dungjuija apeh ho simlouva, akichom khenna-a dinga Pakai henga athilpeh ding chu ahi: kitepna-a akitep banga chu akichom khenna dan dungjuija aboltei ding ahi.
target: “ ‘This is the law of the Nazirite who vows offerings to the Lord in accordance with their dedication, in addition to whatever else they can afford. They must fulfill the vows they have made, according to the law of the Nazirite.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Aaron le achapate jah-a chun hin seijin, Hiche dungjuija hi Israel chate chu phatthei naboh uva, ahenguva hitia nasei dingu ahi,
target: “Tell Aaron and his sons, ‘This is how you are to bless the Israelites. Say to them:

source: Pakaiyin nangma phatthei naboh henlang, naching jinghen,
target: “ ‘ “The Lord bless you and keep you;

source: Pakaiyin nachunga amai vahsah henlang, nachunga lungsetna neijinghen,
target: the Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you;

source: Pakaiyin nachunga amai hinlah henlang, chamna napejing hen.
target: the Lord turn his face toward you and give you peace.” ’

source: Chutia chu amahon Israel chate chunga kamin akoidiu; chule keiman amaho phatthei kabohding ahi.
target: “So they will put my name on the Israelites, and I will bless them.”

source: Mosi'n Houbuh lhingsetna atundoh-a, thao anua, chule asuh thenga, asunga um amanchah jouse, maicham le um le bel ho jouse toh agoma thao anua asuhtheng phatnin, ahitin ahi.
target: When Moses finished setting up the tabernacle, he anointed and consecrated it and all its furnishings. He also anointed and consecrated the altar and all its utensils.

source: Phungho pipui, akisimdoh saho chunga lamkai, Israel pipui ho, apu apateu insunga aluchangho chun thilpeh aneijun ahi.
target: Then the leaders of Israel, the heads of families who were the tribal leaders in charge of those who were counted, made offerings.

source: Chule amahon athilto hou; kangtalai innei gup le bongchal somleni hochu Pakai anga ahinchoijun; kangtalai khat chu pipui ni-a ding, chule bongchal khat chu mikhat cheh-a ding ahin: chule amahon hichu houbuh maija ahin choijun ahi.
target: They brought as their gifts before the Lord six covered carts and twelve oxen—an ox from each leader and a cart from every two. These they presented before the tabernacle.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Hiche hohi houkhom ho houbuh kinbol na-a manchah dingin amaho-a konin lanlang, amitakip ama ama tohding kin dungjui cheh-in Levi ho chu pen, ati.
target: “Accept these from them, that they may be used in the work at the tent of meeting. Give them to the Levites as each man’s work requires.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n kangtalai hole bongchal ho chu alan Levi ho apetan ahi.
target: So Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites.

source: Kangtalai ni le bongchal li chu Gershon chapateho atohdiu kin dungjui cheh-in apen:
target: He gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites, as their work required,

source: Chule kangtalai li le bongchal get chu Aaron thempupa chapa Ithamar khut noija um Marari chapateho chu atohdiu kin dungjui cheh-in apen ahi.
target: and he gave four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites, as their work required. They were all under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.

source: Ahin aman Kohath chapateho chu imacha apepon ahi; ajehchu amahon alengkou uva aput tho uchu munthenga atohdingu kin chu ahi.
target: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were to carry on their shoulders the holy things, for which they were responsible.

source: Chuin pipui hon thao kinu nikho chun maicham katdohna-a dingin thilto aneijun; hitichun pipuiho jengin jong maicham maija chun thilto aneijun ahi.
target: When the altar was anointed, the leaders brought their offerings for its dedication and presented them before the altar.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, maicham katdohna-a dinga chu pipui khat cheh-in ama ama nikho-a athilto dingu chu apeh cheh dingu ahi.
target: For the Lord had said to Moses, “Each day one leader is to bring his offering for the dedication of the altar.”

source: Anikho masapen ni-a thilpeh pe-a chu Juda phunga Aminadab chapa Nahshon ahin:
target: The one who brought his offering on the first day was Nahshon son of Amminadab of the tribe of Judah.

source: Ama thilpeh chu muntheng shekel dungjuija shekel jakhat le somthuma gih dangka kongtong khat, shekel somsagi-a gih dangka sumlheng khat ahin; aninia chu anneh thilpeh-a ding changbong neljet thao toh kihal dimset cheh ahi.
target: His offering was one silver plate weighing a hundred and thirty shekels and one silver sprinkling bowl weighing seventy shekels, both according to the sanctuary shekel, each filled with the finest flour mixed with olive oil as a grain offering;

source: Gimnamtui dimset shekel soma gih sana thihkhe khat:
target: one gold dish weighing ten shekels, filled with incense;

source: Govam thilto-a ding bongchal nou khat, kelngoichal khat, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou khat:
target: one young bull, one ram and one male lamb a year old for a burnt offering;

source: Chonset thilto-a ding kelchaho nou khat:
target: one male goat for a sin offering;

source: Chule chamna ganlhaina thilto-a ding bongchal ni, kelngoichal nga, kelchal nga, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou nga ahi: hichenghi Aminadab chapa Nahshon thilto ahi.

source: Hichehi Israel pipuhon thao anu nikhouva maicham kithensona chu ahi: dangka kongtong somleni, dangka sumlheng somleni toh, sana thihkhe somleni ahi.
target: These were the offerings of the Israelite leaders for the dedication of the altar when it was anointed: twelve silver plates, twelve silver sprinkling bowls and twelve gold dishes.

source: Dangka kongtong ho chu shekel jakhat le somthum cheh-a gih ahin, sumlheng ho chu shekel somsagi cheh-a gih ahi. Dangka um le bel jouse chu muntheng shekel dungjuia shekel sangni le jali gih ahi.
target: Each silver plate weighed a hundred and thirty shekels, and each sprinkling bowl seventy shekels. Altogether, the silver dishes weighed two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.

source: Gimnamtui dimset sana thihkhe chu somleni ahin, munthenga shekel dungjuijin shekel som gih cheh ahi. Thihkhe-a sana ho jouse gihdan chu shekel jakhat le somni ahi.
target: The twelve gold dishes filled with incense weighed ten shekels each, according to the sanctuary shekel. Altogether, the gold dishes weighed a hundred and twenty shekels.

source: Govam thilto dinga bongchal jouse chu bongchal somnileli, kelngoichal somgup, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou somgup, an neh thilpeh jouse toh; chule chonset thilto-a ding kelchaho nou chu somleni ahi.
target: The total number of animals for the burnt offering came to twelve young bulls, twelve rams and twelve male lambs a year old, together with their grain offering. Twelve male goats were used for the sin offering.

source: Chule chamna ganlhai thilto-a ding bongchal jouse chu bongchal somnileli, kelngoichal somgup, kelchal somgup, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou somgup ahi. Hichehi thao akinu jouva maicham thensona chu ahi.
target: The total number of animals for the sacrifice of the fellowship offering came to twenty-four oxen, sixty rams, sixty male goats and sixty male lambs a year old. These were the offerings for the dedication of the altar after it was anointed.

source: Chuin Mosi Ama toh kihou dinga houkhom ho houbuh sunga alutphatnin, Cherub teni kikah-a, hettohsahna thingkhong chunga hepi touna-a kon ahenga thu kisei aw khat ajan, chuin ama koma chun thu aseitan ahi.
target: When Moses entered the tent of meeting to speak with the Lord , he heard the voice speaking to him from between the two cherubim above the atonement cover on the ark of the covenant law. In this way the Lord spoke to him.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Aaron jah-a thu seijin lang, Nangman meivah navah tengle, meivah sagi chun meivah khom masangtah chu asalvah ding ahi, tin seijin ati.
target: “Speak to Aaron and say to him, ‘When you set up the lamps, see that all seven light up the area in front of the lampstand.’ ”

source: Chuin Aaron'in hitichun abolin, Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangchun meivah ho chu meivah khom masanga avahtan ahi.
target: Aaron did so; he set up the lamps so that they faced forward on the lampstand, just as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Hiche meivah khom kisem dan chu sana kikheng ahin, akhom topala pat apah geichu akikheng ahi: Pakaiyin Mosi anavetsah dan bang bang chun, aman meivah khom chu asemin ahi.
target: This is how the lampstand was made: It was made of hammered gold—from its base to its blossoms. The lampstand was made exactly like the pattern the Lord had shown Moses.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati.
target: The Lord said to Moses:

source: Israel chate lah-a konin Levi ho chu lhengdoh inlang amaho chu suthengin.
target: “Take the Levites from among all the Israelites and make them ceremonially clean.

source: Chule amaho suhthenga aumna diuva hitia hi nabolding ahi: achunguva suhthengna twi chu thekhumin lang, amahon atipum piuva amul jouseu chu avolhah diu, chule aponsilu akisop uva, hitia chu amaho kisuhtheng dingu ahi.
target: To purify them, do this: Sprinkle the water of cleansing on them; then have them shave their whole bodies and wash their clothes. And so they will purify themselves.

source: Chutengle amaho chun bongchalgol khat le anneh thilto, thao toh kihal changbong neljet ngei chu kilah-uhen, chule nangman bongchalgol dang khat chonset thilto dinga nalah ding ahi.
target: Have them take a young bull with its grain offering of the finest flour mixed with olive oil; then you are to take a second young bull for a sin offering.

source: Chule nangman Levi ho chu houkhom ho houbuh maija nahinpui ding: chule Israel chate khoppi pumpi chu nakhop khom sohkei ding ahi.
target: Bring the Levites to the front of the tent of meeting and assemble the whole Israelite community.

source: Chule nangman Levi ho chu Pakai anga nahin puija, chule Israel chaten amaho chunga chu akhut angap dingu ahi.
target: You are to bring the Levites before the Lord , and the Israelites are to lay their hands on them.

source: Chule Pakai lhacha na atoh doh theina dinguva, Aaron'in Levi ho chu Israel chate-a kon thilto khat banga Pakai angsunga atodoh ding ahi.
target: Aaron is to present the Levites before the Lord as a wave offering from the Israelites, so that they may be ready to do the work of the Lord .

source: Chule Levi hon akhutnu chu bongchal teni luchunga angapdiu; chule nangman Levi ho longlhenna dinga bongchal khat chu chonset thilto-a dinga nato-a, chule khatpa chu govam thilto-a dinga nato ding ahi.
target: “Then the Levites are to lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, using one for a sin offering to the Lord and the other for a burnt offering, to make atonement for the Levites.

source: Chule nangman Levi ho chu Aaron le achapate masanga natousah-a, amaho chu Pakai henga thilto banga natodoh ding ahi.
target: Have the Levites stand in front of Aaron and his sons and then present them as a wave offering to the Lord .

source: Hitia chu Levi hochu Israel chate lah-a kona nakhendoh ding: chule Levi ho chu keija hiding ahiuve.
target: In this way you are to set the Levites apart from the other Israelites, and the Levites will be mine.

source: Chujou tengle Levi ho chu houkhom ho houbuh lhacha natong dinga lutdiu: chule nangin amaho chu nasuh thenga, thilto khat banga natodoh ding ahi.
target: “After you have purified the Levites and presented them as a wave offering, they are to come to do their work at the tent of meeting.

source: Ajehchu amaho apumpiuva Israel chate lah-a kona keima eikipe ahitan; naobu takip phukeh ho jouse khel, apeng masa jouse khela keiman amaho keija dinga kana kilah ahitai.
target: They are the Israelites who are to be given wholly to me. I have taken them as my own in place of the firstborn, the first male offspring from every Israelite woman.

source: Ajehchu Israel chate lah-a kon apeng masa jouse mihem hihen lang, gancha hile keija ahi. Keiman Egypt gama apeng masa jouse kathagam nikho-a chu amahohi keija dinga kasuhtheng ahitai.
target: Every firstborn male in Israel, whether human or animal, is mine. When I struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, I set them apart for myself.

source: Chule keiman Levi hohi Israel chate apeng masa ho jouse khela kalah ahi.
target: And I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn sons in Israel.

source: Chule Israel chaten muntheng ahinnai tengule, Israel chate lah-a hise umlouna dinga; keiman Levi ho hi Israel chate lah-a kona Aaron le achapate henga houkhom ho houbuh-a Israel chate lhacha natong ding le Israel chate-a dinga longlhenna boldinga thilpeh banga kapeh ahitai.
target: From among all the Israelites, I have given the Levites as gifts to Aaron and his sons to do the work at the tent of meeting on behalf of the Israelites and to make atonement for them so that no plague will strike the Israelites when they go near the sanctuary.”

source: Mosi le Aaron chule Israel chate houkhom ho jouse chun Levi mite chungchanga Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh jouse bangin Levi ho chunga chun abolun, Israel chate chun amaho chunga chutichun abol taovin ahi.
target: Moses, Aaron and the whole Israelite community did with the Levites just as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chuin Levi miho akisuthengun, avonhou akisop thengun; Aaron'in amaho chu Pakai angsunga thilto bangin atoh doh-in; chule Aaron'in amaho suhtheng nadingin longlhenna abolpeh tan ahi.
target: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes. Then Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the Lord and made atonement for them to purify them.

source: Chuin hiche jou chun Levi miho chu houkhom ho houbuh sunga Aaron le achapate masanga lhacha natong dingin alut taovin ahi: Pakaiyin Levi ho chung changa Mosi athupeh bangin, amahon hitichun achunguva abol taovin ahi.
target: After that, the Levites came to do their work at the tent of meeting under the supervision of Aaron and his sons. They did with the Levites just as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Hiche hi Levi mite thudol ahi: kum somni le nga-a lhah chunglamse houkhom ho houbuh-a sunga lhacha natong dinga lutdiu ahi.
target: “This applies to the Levites: Men twenty-five years old or more shall come to take part in the work at the tent of meeting,

source: Chule kumsom nga alhin tengule lhacha natohna-a kona kicholdodiu, atohbe loudiu ahitai.
target: but at the age of fifty, they must retire from their regular service and work no longer.

source: Hijongle houkhom ho houbuh-a chu asopi hotoh ngaichat ahinaova lhachana atoh khomdiu, amavang lhacha kin abol loudiu ahi. Hitia chu Levi miho chu atohdiu nagonpeh ding ahi, ati.
target: They may assist their brothers in performing their duties at the tent of meeting, but they themselves must not do the work. This, then, is how you are to assign the responsibilities of the Levites.”

source: Egypt gama kona ahung potdoh nungu kumni lhinna, lha masapen-in Pakaiyin Sinai gamthipma Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ati.
target: The Lord spoke to Moses in the Desert of Sinai in the first month of the second year after they came out of Egypt. He said,

source: Israel chaten akitep phat dungjuijin kalchuh kut mang jingu hen.
target: “Have the Israelites celebrate the Passover at the appointed time.

source: Hiche lha nisom le nili ni, nilhah lam, akitep phat tah-a hi naman dingu; chondan kisun jouse le akibolding dan jouse dunjuija naman dingu ahi, ati.
target: Celebrate it at the appointed time, at twilight on the fourteenth day of this month, in accordance with all its rules and regulations.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Israel chate chu kalchuh kut aman nadingun aseipeh tan ahi.
target: So Moses told the Israelites to celebrate the Passover,

source: Chuin amahon lhamasa nisom le nili ni nilhah-in Sinai gamthipma chun kalchuh kut chu amangun, Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh jouse dungjuijin, Israel ten hitichun abol taovin ahi.
target: and they did so in the Desert of Sinai at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month. The Israelites did everything just as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chule mi phabep mithilong jeh-a kisuboh aumun, hicheni chun kalchuhkut anitthei tapouvin ahi. Chuin amaho hicheni chun Mosi le Aaron masanga ahungun;
target: But some of them could not celebrate the Passover on that day because they were ceremonially unclean on account of a dead body. So they came to Moses and Aaron that same day

source: Chule hiche miho chun ajah-a, Mithilong jeh-a suhboh-a um kahiuvin; ibola Israel chate lah-a akitep phat sunga Pakaiya thilpeh kapediu kijahda ham? atiuve.
target: and said to Moses, “We have become unclean because of a dead body, but why should we be kept from presenting the Lord ’s offering with the other Israelites at the appointed time?”

source: Chuin Mosi'n ajah uva, Khongaita diuvin, keiman nangho chung changa Pakaiyin thupeh aneijam ngaijing kate, ati.
target: Moses answered them, “Wait until I find out what the Lord commands concerning you.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati,
target: Then the Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate jah-a seipeh inlang, hitin seijin, Nalah uva ahiloule nachilhah hou lah-a mikhattou thilong khat jeh-a athenlouva, ahiloule kholgamla tah-a um hijongle, amachun Pakaiya kalchuhkut aman thouthou ding ahi.
target: “Tell the Israelites: ‘When any of you or your descendants are unclean because of a dead body or are away on a journey, they are still to celebrate the Lord ’s Passover,

source: Lhani lhinna nisom le nili nilhah lamle aman dingu, cholsolou changlhah le anche kha toh amediu ahi.
target: but they are to do it on the fourteenth day of the second month at twilight. They are to eat the lamb, together with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

source: Amahon hichu khatcha jong jingkah geija akhenlou diu, agujong khatcha asuhboh loudiu: kalchuhkut kiman dingdan jouse dungjuija aman diu ahi.
target: They must not leave any of it till morning or break any of its bones. When they celebrate the Passover, they must follow all the regulations.

source: Ahin mikhat chu atheng ahia, chule kholgama che jong ahilouva, ahia kalchuhkut mangding anoplouva ahile: amatah chu amite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ahi; ajeh chu aman akitep phat sungin Pakaiya dingin thilpeh ahinchoipon, hichepa chun achonset akipoh ding ahi.
target: But if anyone who is ceremonially clean and not on a journey fails to celebrate the Passover, they must be cut off from their people for not presenting the Lord ’s offering at the appointed time. They will bear the consequences of their sin.

source: Chule nalah uva namdang mi ahung kholjin auma, ama chun Pakaiya kalchuhkut manding anople, kalchuhkut kiman dingdan dungjuija le chonna ngai dungjuija amanding ahi: nanghon namdang mi ding le agama peng denpa-a dinga dan khatseh naneidiu ahi.
target: “ ‘A foreigner residing among you is also to celebrate the Lord ’s Passover in accordance with its rules and regulations. You must have the same regulations for both the foreigner and the native-born.’ ”

source: Chuin houbuh kitundoh ni chun ponbuh, hettohsahna ponbuh chu meilom'in atomin ahi. Chule nilhah lamin houbuh chung chu meikong bangin, jingkah geijin aumin ahi.
target: On the day the tabernacle, the tent of the covenant law, was set up, the cloud covered it. From evening till morning the cloud above the tabernacle looked like fire.

source: Chutobang chun aumjing jengin ahi: sunle meilom'in atomin chule jan le meikongin akilangjin ahi.
target: That is how it continued to be; the cloud covered it, and at night it looked like fire.

source: Chule meilom chu houbuh akona lahtouva aum tengle, Israel chate chu akitol jiuvin, chutengle meilom kingahna mun'a chun Israel chaten ponbuh akison jiuvin ahi.
target: Whenever the cloud lifted from above the tent, the Israelites set out; wherever the cloud settled, the Israelites encamped.

source: Pakai thupeh dungjuijin Israel chate akitol jiuvin, chule Pakai thupeh dungjuijin gehbuh akison jiuvin; meilom chu houbuh chunga aum laisen apon in houva akicholnga jiuvin ahi.
target: At the Lord ’s command the Israelites set out, and at his command they encamped. As long as the cloud stayed over the tabernacle, they remained in camp.

source: Chule houbuh chunga meilom chu nitampi aumteng le, Israel chaten Pakai thupeh anitnun, akitoldohji pouvin ahi.
target: When the cloud remained over the tabernacle a long time, the Israelites obeyed the Lord ’s order and did not set out.

source: Meilom chu houbuh chunga chu ni lhomcha aum kom jongle chutobang chun abolun ahi; Pakai thupeh dungjuijin amaho aponbuh uva aumun, chule Pakai thupeh dungjuijin akitol jiuvin ahi.
target: Sometimes the cloud was over the tabernacle only a few days; at the Lord ’s command they would encamp, and then at his command they would set out.

source: Hitichu ahin, meilom chu nilhah-a pat jingkah gei auma, hiche meilom chu jingkah-a akilah-a ahile amaho akitol jiuvin ahi. Sun hihen jan hijong le meilom chu akilahdoh tihtih le amaho akitol jiuvin ahi.
target: Sometimes the cloud stayed only from evening till morning, and when it lifted in the morning, they set out. Whether by day or by night, whenever the cloud lifted, they set out.

source: Ahiloule nini hihen, lhakhat hihen, ahiloule kumkhat hijongle, meilom chu houbuh chunga auma, aumdena ahile, Israel chate chu aponbuh houva aumun, akitol ji pouve: ahin hichu akilah doh tengle, akitol jiuvin ahi.
target: Whether the cloud stayed over the tabernacle for two days or a month or a year, the Israelites would remain in camp and not set out; but when it lifted, they would set out.

source: Pakai thupeh dungjuijin amaho ponbuh-a akicholdo jiuvin, Pakai thupeh dungjuijin akitol jiuvin ahi; Pakaiyin Mosi khutna athupeh dungjuijun, amahon Pakai thu chu anitjiuvin ahi.
target: At the Lord ’s command they encamped, and at the Lord ’s command they set out. They obeyed the Lord ’s order, in accordance with his command through Moses.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati.
target: The Lord said to Moses:

source: Mipi ho koukhom nading le ngahmun ho kitoldoh na-a naman theina dingin dangka sumkon ni semin, hichu sehcha-a nakhetna nasem ding ahi.
target: “Make two trumpets of hammered silver, and use them for calling the community together and for having the camps set out.

source: Hichu ania amahon amut tengule mipi ho jouse chu nahenga houkhom ho houbuh kotna chu hung kikhom diu ahi.
target: When both are sounded, the whole community is to assemble before you at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

source: Chule amahon sumkon khatbou amutnuva ahile, Israel asang asang luchang ho, pipuiho chu nakoma hung kikhom diu ahi.
target: If only one is sounded, the leaders—the heads of the clans of Israel—are to assemble before you.

source: Nanghon kigina khatvei namut tengule, solam sanga um gebuh hochu kitolmasa diu ahi.
target: When a trumpet blast is sounded, the tribes camping on the east are to set out.

source: Nanghon kigina aniveina namut tengule, lhanglam sanga gebuhho kitoldiu ahi; amahon akitol nadiuva kigina amutdiu ahi.
target: At the sounding of a second blast, the camps on the south are to set out. The blast will be the signal for setting out.

source: Ahinla houkhom ho chu akikhop khom ding tengule nanghon namut diu, amavang kigina namut banguva naginsah lou dingu ahi.
target: To gather the assembly, blow the trumpets, but not with the signal for setting out.

source: Chule Aaron thempu chapate chun sumkon chu amut dingu; chule nakhang lhumkei uva a-itih-a dinga chonna dan hiding ahi.
target: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, are to blow the trumpets. This is to be a lasting ordinance for you and the generations to come.

source: Chule nagamsunguva nasugenthei uva namelma teu satdinga nacheuva ahile, nanghon sumkona chu kigina namut diu; chutile Pakai Pathen angsunga goldoh-a naum diu, chule namelma teova kona huhdohna-a naum diu ahi.
target: When you go into battle in your own land against an enemy who is oppressing you, sound a blast on the trumpets. Then you will be remembered by the Lord your God and rescued from your enemies.

source: Chujongle nakipa nikhou le, naniloupi nikho hou, chule lha kipatseh le napumgo thiltou le nachamna thiltou ganlhaina chunga chu, hicheho chu nangho dinga Pathen angsunga geldoh ahitheina dinga sumkon ho namut dingu ahi. Keima na Pakai Pathen'u kahi.
target: Also at your times of rejoicing—your appointed festivals and New Moon feasts—you are to sound the trumpets over your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, and they will be a memorial for you before your God. I am the Lord your God.”

source: Chuin akum nina, alhani lhina, nisomni channi chun ahitin ahi, meilom chu hettohsahna houbuh-a konin akiladoh tan ahi.
target: On the twentieth day of the second month of the second year, the cloud lifted from above the tabernacle of the covenant law.

source: Chuin Sinai gamthipma konin Israel chate akitolun; Paran gamthipma chun meilom chu akingatan ahi.
target: Then the Israelites set out from the Desert of Sinai and traveled from place to place until the cloud came to rest in the Desert of Paran.

source: Chuin Mosi khutna Pakai thupeh dungjuijin amahon akholjinu masapen chu apan taovin ahi.
target: They set out, this first time, at the Lord ’s command through Moses.

source: Amasa penin agalsat miteo dungjuijin Judah chate houbuh ponlap chu achen; chule janel ho chunga lamkaija chu Amminadab chapa Nashon ahi.
target: The divisions of the camp of Judah went first, under their standard. Nahshon son of Amminadab was in command.

source: Issachar chate phunga janel ho chunga lamkai chu Zuar chapa Nathaneel ahi.
target: Nethanel son of Zuar was over the division of the tribe of Issachar,

source: Chule Zebulun chate phunga janel ho chunga lamkai chu Helon chapa Eliab ahi.
target: and Eliab son of Helon was over the division of the tribe of Zebulun.

source: Chuin houbuh chu aphelhauvin; Gershon chapate le Merari chapaten houbuh chu apouvin malam ajon taovin ahi.
target: Then the tabernacle was taken down, and the Gershonites and Merarites, who carried it, set out.

source: Chuin agalsat miteu dungjuijin Reuben ponbuh ponlap chu akitolin, chule Shedeur chapa Elizur chu janel chunga lamkai ahi.
target: The divisions of the camp of Reuben went next, under their standard. Elizur son of Shedeur was in command.

source: Simeon chate phunga janel ho chunga lamkai chu Zurishaddai chapa Shelumiel ahi.
target: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was over the division of the tribe of Simeon,

source: Chule Gad chate phunga janel ho chunga lamkai chu Deuel chapa Eliasaph ahi.
target: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was over the division of the tribe of Gad.

source: Chuin Kohath miho chun muntheng chu apouvin akitolun ahi. Chule adangho chun amaho hunglhun masangin houbuh chu anatung doh masaovin ahi.
target: Then the Kohathites set out, carrying the holy things. The tabernacle was to be set up before they arrived.

source: Chuin agalsat miteu dungjuijin Ephraim chate ponbuh ponlap chu akitolin; chule Ammihud chapa Elishama chu ajanel hou chunga lamkai ahi.
target: The divisions of the camp of Ephraim went next, under their standard. Elishama son of Ammihud was in command.

source: Chule Manasseh chate phunga janel ho chunga lamkai chu Pedahzur chapa Gamaliel ahi.
target: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was over the division of the tribe of Manasseh,

source: Chule Benjamin chate phunga janel ho chunga lamkai chu Gideoni chapa Abidan ahi.
target: and Abidan son of Gideoni was over the division of the tribe of Benjamin.

source: Chuin Dan chate gebuh ponlap chu akitolin, hichu ami janel hou sunga gebuh nunungpen ahin ahi: chule Amishaddai chapa Ahiezer chu janel chunga lamkai ahi.
target: Finally, as the rear guard for all the units, the divisions of the camp of Dan set out under their standard. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was in command.

source: Chule Asher chate phunga janel ho chunga lamkai Ocran chapa Pagiel ahi.
target: Pagiel son of Okran was over the division of the tribe of Asher,

source: Chule Naphtali chate phunga janel chunga lamkai chu Enan chapa Ahira ahi.
target: and Ahira son of Enan was over the division of the tribe of Naphtali.

source: Hiche hi akitol laijuva agalsat miteu dungjuija Israel chate kitoldan ahi.
target: This was the order of march for the Israelite divisions as they set out.

source: Chuin Mosi'n anupapa, Midian mi Raguel chapa Hobab jah-a, Pakaiyin nangho kapeh ding nahiuve tia aseina mun jona che kahiuve; hungin kilhonnute, keihon na bolpha naovinge, ajeh chu Pakaiyin Israelte thudola thilpha aseije, ati.
target: Now Moses said to Hobab son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are setting out for the place about which the Lord said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us and we will treat you well, for the Lord has promised good things to Israel.”

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, Kahung louding ahi; ahin keima kagam le ka-inkote koma kache johding ahi, ati.
target: He answered, “No, I will not go; I am going back to my own land and my own people.”

source: Chuin aman, Katao ahi, neidalha hih-un; ajehchu nangman keihon gamthipma gebuh iti kason diu nahen, nangma keiho mitna napan ding ahi.
target: But Moses said, “Please do not leave us. You know where we should camp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.

source: Chule hitiding ahi, nangma keihotoh nalhon khomma ahile, henge, hitiding ahi, Pakaiyin keiho chunga phatna abolding chanchu keihon jong nangma chunga kaboldiu ahi, ati.
target: If you come with us, we will share with you whatever good things the Lord gives us.”

source: Chuin amaho Pakai molsanga kon chun nithum lampia chun akipat doh-un: chule Pakai kitepna thingkhong chu nithum lampia chun amaho kingahna ding mun hol dingin amasanguva achen ahi.
target: So they set out from the mountain of the Lord and traveled for three days. The ark of the covenant of the Lord went before them during those three days to find them a place to rest.

source: Chule amaho ngahmuna kona achedoh tengule Pakai meilom chu sun le achunguva aumjin ahi.
target: The cloud of the Lord was over them by day when they set out from the camp.

source: Chule ahitin ahi, thingkhong chu akitol tengle Mosi'n, Pakai, kipatdoh-in, chule namelmaho chu kithecheh-u henlang; nangma nahotbolte chu na angsung jamuhen, atijin ahi.
target: Whenever the ark set out, Moses said, “Rise up, Lord ! May your enemies be scattered; may your foes flee before you.”

source: Chule hichu akingah tengle, aman, O Pakai, Israel sangtamtah henga hung kile kitnin atijin, ahi.
target: Whenever it came to rest, he said, “Return, Lord , to the countless thousands of Israel.”

source: Chuin mipi chu aphun phatnun, Pakai alunglhai tapon: chule hichu Pakaiyin ajan, alung akoujah jengtai; chuin Pakai lunghanna chu amaho lah-a akoudoh tan, gebuh pammong penna umho chu aka mangtan ahi.
target: Now the people complained about their hardships in the hearing of the Lord , and when he heard them his anger was aroused. Then fire from the Lord burned among them and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.

source: Chuin mipi chu Mosi hengah apengjah taovin ahile, Mosi Pakai henga ataovin, hichun meichu amit tai.
target: When the people cried out to Moses, he prayed to the Lord and the fire died down.

source: Mipi lah uva chu Pakai meija ahung kou jehchun, aman hiche munchu Taberah asahtai.
target: So that place was called Taberah, because fire from the Lord had burned among them.

source: Chuin choplop mihonpi lah-a chun sa ducha-a aumtan; chule Israel chate jong chu akapkit taovin; Kon eiho nehding sa eipeh dingu ham?
target: The rabble with them began to crave other food, and again the Israelites started wailing and said, “If only we had meat to eat!

source: Egypt gama manbeija ineh-u nga ho, changmai ho, donkho ho, louthul ho, louthul tilnei ho, louthul chang neiho chu igel doh-un ahi.
target: We remember the fish we ate in Egypt at no cost—also the cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions and garlic.

source: Ahinla tun ihinnao agolhatan; chule imitmu uva manna tilou imacha aumpon ahi, atiuve.
target: But now we have lost our appetite; we never see anything but this manna!”

source: Chule manna chu pathikhomu toh abangin, chule avoupoh chu thingnaidol toh abangin ahi.
target: The manna was like coriander seed and looked like resin.

source: Chule miho chu cheova, alokhomuva, sumheija agoibongu, ahiloule songlhenga avoh bonguva, khangbela akanuva, chutengle hiche-a chu changlhah asemjiu ahi: hichu atuidan thaothah kikang changlhah toh abangin ahi.
target: The people went around gathering it, and then ground it in a hand mill or crushed it in a mortar. They cooked it in a pot or made it into loaves. And it tasted like something made with olive oil.

source: Chule jana gebuh chunga daitwi ahunglhah tengle, manna chu alhahtha jin ahi.
target: When the dew settled on the camp at night, the manna also came down.

source: Chuin Mosi'n mipi ho jouse a-inko ko-a, ami takip ponbuh kotna akau ajatan; Pakai lunghanna chu nasatah-in ahung kong dohtan, Mosi jong chu alung nommo lheh tan ahi.
target: Moses heard the people of every family wailing at the entrance to their tents. The Lord became exceedingly angry, and Moses was troubled.

source: Chuin Mosi'n Pakai henga, Ipi dinga nasoh hi nagimbol ham? Ipi jeh-a kachunga mipi jouse pohgih hi nangapma, nangma mitmu-a nalungsetna kachan leltam?
target: He asked the Lord , “Why have you brought this trouble on your servant? What have I done to displease you that you put the burden of all these people on me?

source: Keiman hiche miho jouse hi kanavop ham? Keima hinbeh hiuva Nangma kahenga, Mipan naosen noichep lai apom bangin nangman amahohi na-angsunga pomin lang, apu apateu kateppeh gamma puilutnin neitiham?
target: Did I conceive all these people? Did I give them birth? Why do you tell me to carry them in my arms, as a nurse carries an infant, to the land you promised on oath to their ancestors?

source: Keiman mipi jouse pehdinga sa hoija kalah ding ham? Ajehchu amaho kahenga akapmun, Kaneh diuvin sa neipeuvin, atiuve.
target: Where can I get meat for all these people? They keep wailing to me, ‘Give us meat to eat!’

source: Mipi hijatpi hi kachang seh-in pojou ponge, ajehchu keidingin agihsa behseh-e.
target: I cannot carry all these people by myself; the burden is too heavy for me.

source: Hitia hi neibolding ahile, katao ahi, namit mu-a lungsetna kachana ahile, hilai munahin tule tun neithat jengin; kamanthahna muda jenginge, ati.
target: If this is how you are going to treat me, please go ahead and kill me—if I have found favor in your eyes—and do not let me face my own ruin.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Nangman mipi ho chunga lamkai le upa ahi tia nahet Israel upaho mi somsagi kahenga hinkhomin; chule amaho chun nangma to adinkhom theina diuvin houkhom ho houbuh-a hinpuijin.
target: The Lord said to Moses: “Bring me seventy of Israel’s elders who are known to you as leaders and officials among the people. Have them come to the tent of meeting, that they may stand there with you.

source: Chule keima kahung kumlhah-a hikoma chu nangma kakihoupi ding: chule nachunga um lhagao chu kalah-a amaho chunga kakoiding; chule nangman mipi ho pohgih chu nachang seh-a napoh louna dinga amahon napoh hu dingu ahi.
target: I will come down and speak with you there, and I will take some of the power of the Spirit that is on you and put it on them. They will share the burden of the people with you so that you will not have to carry it alone.

source: Chule nangman mipi ho jah-a, Jing nikho-a dingin nangma cheh kisutheng uvin, nanghon sa naneh dingu ahitai. Ajehchu nangho Pakai nakhanga nakapmun, kon keiho nehding sa eipeh diu ham? Egypt gama kaumu chun nom kasajouve, nati uve: hijeh-a chu Pakaiyin nangho sa napeh uva naneh diu ahitai.
target: “Tell the people: ‘Consecrate yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, when you will eat meat. The Lord heard you when you wailed, “If only we had meat to eat! We were better off in Egypt!” Now the Lord will give you meat, and you will eat it.

source: Nanghon nikhat jong hilou, nini jong hilou, ninga jong hilou, nisom jong hilou, chule nisomni hilou;
target: You will not eat it for just one day, or two days, or five, ten or twenty days,

source: Ahinla lha lungkeija nanah hom sunguva ahungdoh-a, naloh-u asotokah seuva ding ahi. Ajeh chu nanghon nalah uva um Pakai chu nanotthap uvin, a-angsunga nakamun, Ipidinga Egypt gama kona ihung doh uham? nati uve, tin seipeh-in, ati.
target: but for a whole month—until it comes out of your nostrils and you loathe it—because you have rejected the Lord , who is among you, and have wailed before him, saying, “Why did we ever leave Egypt?” ’ ”

source: Chuin Mosi'n, Alah uva kaumna mipi, kenga lamjotthei cheh sangjagup hiuva; nangman, Amahon lhakhat lhungkeija aneh diuva sa kapeh ding ahi, tin naseije.
target: But Moses said, “Here I am among six hundred thousand men on foot, and you say, ‘I will give them meat to eat for a whole month!’

source: Anehkhop nadiuva kelngoihon le gancha honho chu kithapeh ding hiuvem? ahiloule anehkhop nadiuva twikhanglen'a nga jouse kimatkhom peh ding hiuvem? ati.
target: Would they have enough if flocks and herds were slaughtered for them? Would they have enough if all the fish in the sea were caught for them?”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Pakai khut chu kisuchoma hitam? tu-a hi nangman kathusei nachunga aguilhun aguilhun lou namu ding ahi, ati.
target: The Lord answered Moses, “Is the Lord ’s arm too short? Now you will see whether or not what I say will come true for you.”

source: Chuin Mosi apotdoh-in, mipi ho chu Pakai thu chu aseipeh-in, chule mipi lah-a upa somsagi ho chu akhomin, houbuh kimvella chun adinsah tai.
target: So Moses went out and told the people what the Lord had said. He brought together seventy of their elders and had them stand around the tent.

source: Chuin Pakai meilom'in ahung kumlhan, ajah-a thu aseijin, chule achunga um lhagao chu aladoh-in, upa somsagi ho apetan ahi. Chuin ahitin ahi, lhagao achunguva achuh phatnin, gaothu aseijun, atang tapouvin ahi.
target: Then the Lord came down in the cloud and spoke with him, and he took some of the power of the Spirit that was on him and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied—but did not do so again.

source: Ahin mi ni chu gebuh-a umden ahin, khatpa minchu Eldan ahin, khat chu Medad ahi: chuin Lhagao chu achung lhona achun; amanihi amin kilakhom lah-a chu jao ahilhonin, houbuh-a potdoh lou ahilhone. Chuin amanin gebuh sunga gaothu aseilhon tan ahi.
target: However, two men, whose names were Eldad and Medad, had remained in the camp. They were listed among the elders, but did not go out to the tent. Yet the Spirit also rested on them, and they prophesied in the camp.

source: Chuin gollhang khat ahunglhaijin, Mosi jah-a, Eldad le Medad-in gebuh sunga gaothu aseilhone, ahungtin ahi.
target: A young man ran and told Moses, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp.”

source: Chuin agollhangho lah-a khat, Mosi lhacha Nun chapa Joshua'n adonbutnin, kapu Mosi, amani khu phohthipmin, ati.
target: Joshua son of Nun, who had been Moses’ aide since youth, spoke up and said, “Moses, my lord, stop them!”

source: Chuin Mosi'n ajah-a, Keima jala namit thip ham? Pakai mite jouse themgao hiuhenlang, Pakaiyin achunguva alhagao koi tavele kati, ati.
target: But Moses replied, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the Lord ’s people were prophets and that the Lord would put his Spirit on them!”

source: Chuin Mosi le Israel upa hochu gebuh sunga aluttaovin ahi.
target: Then Moses and the elders of Israel returned to the camp.

source: Chuin Pakaiya konin hui ahung nungin, twikhanglen'a konin vamim ahinlhoh-in, gebuh kom, hilama kona nikhat lampi, khulama kona nikhat lampi tobang gei, gebuh kimvela, chule hichu leiset chunga kon tongni geija sangin alhahsah-in ahi.
target: Now a wind went out from the Lord and drove quail in from the sea. It scattered them up to two cubits deep all around the camp, as far as a day’s walk in any direction.

source: Chuin mipi ho chu adingdoh-un, nilhum keile jan khovah-in, chule ajing nilhum keijin, vamim hochu aloh-un: alohlhom pen pan pocha som alohdoh-in; chule hicheho chu ama ama ding cheh-in gebuh kimvela chun thejaovun ahi.
target: All that day and night and all the next day the people went out and gathered quail. No one gathered less than ten homers. Then they spread them out all around the camp.

source: Chuin ahakah uva sa chu aumnalaija, alhaigoi masangun, Pakai lunghanna chu mipi dounan ahung kongdoh tan, Pakaiyin mipi chunga chun hise nasatah achuhsah tan ahi.
target: But while the meat was still between their teeth and before it could be consumed, the anger of the Lord burned against the people, and he struck them with a severe plague.

source: Chule hiche mun'a chu sa-a lop miho avuitah jeh-un, hiche mun chu Kibroth-hatta-avah asahtai.
target: Therefore the place was named Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had craved other food.

source: Chuin mipi chu Kibroth-hatta-avah'a konin Hazeroth jonin akitolun, Hazeroth'a gebuh asemtaovin ahi.
target: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth and stayed there.

source: Chuin Mosi'n Ethiopia numei khat akichenpi jeh-in Miriam le Aaron'in ama douna thu aseilhontan ahi: ajehchu aman Ethiopia numei khat ana kichenpin ahi.
target: Miriam and Aaron began to talk against Moses because of his Cushite wife, for he had married a Cushite.

source: Chuin amanin, Tahbeh monga Pakaiyin Mosi'a kona bou thu aseiham? eini-a kona jong asei hilouham? atilhone. Chule hichu Pakaiyin ajatan ahi.
target: “Has the Lord spoken only through Moses?” they asked. “Hasn’t he also spoken through us?” And the Lord heard this.

source: (Tuhin Mosi kiti mipahi leiset chunga mijouse lah-a alungneng pen ahi).
target: (Now Moses was a very humble man, more humble than anyone else on the face of the earth.)

source: Chuin phulou helouvin Pakaiyin Mosi, Aaron, chule Miriam henga thu ahin seijin, Nangho thum houkhom ho houbuh lama hungun, ati. Chuin amaho ahung taovin ahi.
target: At once the Lord said to Moses, Aaron and Miriam, “Come out to the tent of meeting, all three of you.” So the three of them went out.

source: Chuin Pakai chu meilhang khompin ahung kumlhan, houbuh kotna chun adingin, Aaron le Miriam chu ahin kouvin: chuin amani ahung potdoh lhonin ahi.
target: Then the Lord came down in a pillar of cloud; he stood at the entrance to the tent and summoned Aaron and Miriam. When the two of them stepped forward,

source: Chuin aman, Tun kathu ngailhonin: nalah uva themgao auma ahile, keima Pakaiyin amachu gaova kakihetsah-a, chule manga akoma thu kasei ahi.
target: he said, “Listen to my words: “When there is a prophet among you, I, the Lord , reveal myself to them in visions, I speak to them in dreams.

source: Ka-insung pumpi-a tahsan umtah, kalhacha Mosi chunga vang chutobang ahipoi.
target: But this is not true of my servant Moses; he is faithful in all my house.

source: Ama hitoh kikam sanna, kicheh tah-a, thu ki-im beija kakihoupiji ahi; chule aman Pakai melso jong amu ahi; chuti ahile ibola kalhacha Mosi douna-a thusei ding kichalou nahi lhonham? ati.
target: With him I speak face to face, clearly and not in riddles; he sees the form of the Lord . Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?”

source: Chuin Pakai lunghanna chu amani dounan ahung koudoh-in; chuin adalhatan ahi.
target: The anger of the Lord burned against them, and he left them.

source: Chuin meilhang chu houbuh-a konin akihohdoh tan; veuvin, Miriam chu ahung phah-in, buhbang bangin abangtan: chuin Aaron'in Miriam chu aven, chuin veuvin, amanu aphah ahitai.
target: When the cloud lifted from above the tent, Miriam’s skin was leprous—it became as white as snow. Aaron turned toward her and saw that she had a defiling skin disease,

source: Chuin Aaron'in Mosi jah-a, Ohe, ka Pakai, nahenga katao ahi, ngolhoi tah-a kanachon lhona, kaboldoh lhon chonsetna, hiche chonsetna hi kachung lhona ngam loujenin.
target: and he said to Moses, “Please, my lord, I ask you not to hold against us the sin we have so foolishly committed.

source: Mi anu sunga atipum akehkhat beisa-a hungpenga bangin, amanu hi athisa bangin umsah hih-in, ati.
target: Do not let her be like a stillborn infant coming from its mother’s womb with its flesh half eaten away.”

source: Chuin Mosi Pakai henga ataovin, Vo Pakai, nahenga katao ahi, amanu hi tun damsah-in, ati.
