target: So Moses cried out to the Lord , “Please, God, heal her!”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Amanuhi apan amaichanga achil asetkhuma ahile amanu nisagi sung jahchalou ding ham? gebuh-a konin nisagi kaidoh-unlang, hiche jou chule puilut hikit hen, ati.
target: The Lord replied to Moses, “If her father had spit in her face, would she not have been in disgrace for seven days? Confine her outside the camp for seven days; after that she can be brought back.”

source: Chuin Miriam chu nisagi gebuh pama akoijun; Miriam ahung kipui lut kit kahsen mipi chu akitol tapouve.
target: So Miriam was confined outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not move on till she was brought back.

source: Hichejou mipi chu Hazeroth'a konin akichonun, Paran gamthipma chun ponbuh asong taove.
target: After that, the people left Hazeroth and encamped in the Desert of Paran.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate kanapeh, Canaan gam kholtoh dingin, apu apateu kailhah cheh-a mi khatcheh, alah uva vaipo khatcheh chu solin, ati.
target: “Send some men to explore the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites. From each ancestral tribe send one of its leaders.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Pakai thupeh bang chun amaho chu Paran gamthipma konin asoltai. Hiche miho chu Israel chate aluchang ho ahiuvin ahi.
target: So at the Lord ’s command Moses sent them out from the Desert of Paran. All of them were leaders of the Israelites.

source: Chule hichengsehi amaho min ahi: Reuben phunga Zaccur chapa Shammua.
target: These are their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua son of Zakkur;

source: Simeon phunga, Hori chapa Shaphat.
target: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Hori;

source: Judah phunga Jephunneh chapa Caleb.
target: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;

source: Issachar phunga, Joseph chapa Igal.
target: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal son of Joseph;

source: Ephraim phunga, Nun chapa Oshea.
target: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun;

source: Benjamin phunga, Raphu chapa Palti.
target: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu;

source: Zebulun phunga, Sodi chapa Gaddiel.
target: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel son of Sodi;

source: Joseph phunga, tichu Manesseh phunga Susi chapa Gaddi.
target: from the tribe of Manasseh (a tribe of Joseph), Gaddi son of Susi;

source: Dan phunga, Gemalli chapa Ammiel.
target: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gemalli;

source: Asher phunga, Michael chapa Sethur.
target: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael;

source: Naphtali phunga, Vophsi chapa Nahbi.
target: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi son of Vophsi;

source: Gad phunga, Michi chapa Geuel ahi.
target: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Maki.

source: Hiche hohi Mosi'n gam velhi dinga asol miho min chu ahi. Chuin Mosi'n Nun chapa Oshea chu Jehoshua tin asah-in ahi.
target: These are the names of the men Moses sent to explore the land. (Moses gave Hoshea son of Nun the name Joshua.)

source: Chuin Mosi'n amaho chu Canaan gam velhi dingin asolin, ahenguva hitin aseije, Lhanglam sanga kon khun chetouvun lang, molchunga khun kaldoh-un;
target: When Moses sent them to explore Canaan, he said, “Go up through the Negev and on into the hill country.

source: Chule gavechenun agam chu itobang ham, chule asunga chengho chu hatnaovem ahiloule hatmovem, lhomuvem ahiloule tamuvem;
target: See what the land is like and whether the people who live there are strong or weak, few or many.

source: Chule achennao gamchu itobang ham, pha-am ahiloule se-ham, achennao khopiho-a chu itobang khopi ho-a chenguva, pon in'a cheng hiuvem ahiloule kulpi-a cheng hiuvem;
target: What kind of land do they live in? Is it good or bad? What kind of towns do they live in? Are they unwalled or fortified?

source: Chule agam chu itobang gam ham, leipha ham ahiloule leiphalou ham, hichea chu thing umam ahiloule umhih-am gaveovin. Nangho hangsanun lang agamga hinpouvin. Hichelai phat tah chu lengpithei ga masapen minphat tah ahi.
target: How is the soil? Is it fertile or poor? Are there trees in it or not? Do your best to bring back some of the fruit of the land.” (It was the season for the first ripe grapes.)

source: Chutichun amaho achetouvun, agam chu Zin gamthipma pat Hamath lutna Rehob geijin akhol taovin.
target: So they went up and explored the land from the Desert of Zin as far as Rehob, toward Lebo Hamath.

source: Chuin amaho lhanglama konin achetouvun, Anak chate ho Ahinam, Sheshai, chule Talmai umna mun Hebron ahung lhungun ahi. (Tun Hebron chu Egypt gama Zoan kisahdoh ma kum sagi masanga kisadoh ahitai.)
target: They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, lived. (Hebron had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

source: Chuin amaho Eshcol vachadung ahung lhungun, hichea konchun amahon lengpi theiboh khat aboh pumin asat lhaovin, minin moljolin ahinjong lhonin; chule kolbuthei ho le thei changho ahin pouvin ahi.
target: When they reached the Valley of Eshkol, they cut off a branch bearing a single cluster of grapes. Two of them carried it on a pole between them, along with some pomegranates and figs.

source: Hiche munna kona chu Israel chaten lengpiga boh asatlhah jeh-un, hiche mun chu Eshcol vachadung akisahtan ahi.
target: That place was called the Valley of Eshkol because of the cluster of grapes the Israelites cut off there.

source: Chuin amahon gam chu agakhol toh-u nisomli jouvin ahung kilekit taovin ahi.
target: At the end of forty days they returned from exploring the land.

source: Chuin amaho acheuvin Mosi le Aaron henga, chule Kadesh mun'a um Paran gamthipma Israel chate houkhom ho jouse henga ahungun; chule amaho hengle houkhom ho jouse henga thu ahin pouvin, agamga jong chu amaho avetsah-un ahi.
target: They came back to Moses and Aaron and the whole Israelite community at Kadesh in the Desert of Paran. There they reported to them and to the whole assembly and showed them the fruit of the land.

source: Chule amahon ama henga, Keiho nangman neisolnao gama chu kacheuvin, tahbeh mongin agam chu khoiju le bongnoi lonna gam ahi; chule hiche hi agamga chu ahi.
target: They gave Moses this account: “We went into the land to which you sent us, and it does flow with milk and honey! Here is its fruit.

source: Ahijeng vangin agama chengho chu mihat ahiuvin, akhopihou chu kulpi kikai khum ahin, chule aletna lenthei ahi; chukalvalin keihon chukoma chun Anak chateho kamuvin ahi.
target: But the people who live there are powerful, and the cities are fortified and very large. We even saw descendants of Anak there.

source: Amalek miho chu lhanglama achengun; Hit miho, Jebus miho, chule Amor miho chu molsang ho-a achengun; chule Canaan miho chu twikhanglen pang le Jordan panga achengun ahi, atiuve.
target: The Amalekites live in the Negev; the Hittites, Jebusites and Amorites live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live near the sea and along the Jordan.”

source: Chuin Caleb min mipi ho chu Mosi angsunga chun aphoh thipmin, Eiho mangang tah-in cheu hitin, galo jengu hite; ajehchu eihon ijo teitei dingu ahi, ati.
target: Then Caleb silenced the people before Moses and said, “We should go up and take possession of the land, for we can certainly do it.”

source: Ahivangin ama chekhom piho chun, Eiho amaho igajo lou dingu ahi; ajehchu amaho eiho sanga hatjo ahiuve, atiuve.
target: But the men who had gone up with him said, “We can’t attack those people; they are stronger than we are.”

source: Amaho chun agakhol tohnao gamchung chang thudola chun Israel chate henga thulhut phalou ahin pouvin, Keiho kacheuva kaga kholtoh nao gam chu agama chengho negamhel thei gam ahin; chule chua kaga mu-u mijouse chu milen ngen ahiuve.
target: And they spread among the Israelites a bad report about the land they had explored. They said, “The land we explored devours those living in it. All the people we saw there are of great size.

source: Chule keihon chumuna chun milen tahtah ho, Anak chapate, milen tahtah ho chilhah-a kon hungpengho chu kagamuve: chule keiho mitmun keihochu khaokhopi bangbep kahiuvin, amaho mitmu-a jong chutobangma chu kahiuve, atiuvin ahi.
target: We saw the Nephilim there (the descendants of Anak come from the Nephilim). We seemed like grasshoppers in our own eyes, and we looked the same to them.”

source: Chuin houkhom ho jouse chun aw sangtah-in asamun, apengun; hiche janchun mipi chu akaptaovin,
target: That night all the members of the community raised their voices and wept aloud.

source: Chuin Israel chate jouse chu Mosi le Aaron chunga aphun taovin: houkhom pumpi chun ajah lhona, Pathen'in Egypt gama eina thisah-u hitavele! Ahiloule Pathen'in hiche gamthipma hi eina thisah-u hitavele!
target: All the Israelites grumbled against Moses and Aaron, and the whole assembly said to them, “If only we had died in Egypt! Or in this wilderness!

source: Chule ipi dinga Pakaiyin hiche gamahi chemjam'a lougam ding le, kaji kachateu hi gal anchah hiding bepma eipuilutnu hitam? eiho dinga Egypt gama kilekit phajo louding ham? atiuve.
target: Why is the Lord bringing us to this land only to let us fall by the sword? Our wives and children will be taken as plunder. Wouldn’t it be better for us to go back to Egypt?”

source: Chuin amaho khatle khat akihouvun, Eihon lamkai khat kilhenu hitin, Egypt gam lama kilekit tao hite, atiuve.
target: And they said to each other, “We should choose a leader and go back to Egypt.”

source: Hichun Mosi le Aaron chu Israel chate houkhom kikhomho jouse angsunga chun abohkhup lhontan ahi.
target: Then Moses and Aaron fell facedown in front of the whole Israelite assembly gathered there.

source: Chuin gam kholtoh-a cheloi lah-a pang Nun chapa Joshua le Jephunneh chapa Caleb chun aponsil lhon abot-eh lhonin:
target: Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had explored the land, tore their clothes

source: Israel chate houkhom ho jouse henga chun, Kholtoh dinga kachot lenao gamchu gampha tah mongmong ahi.
target: and said to the entire Israelite assembly, “The land we passed through and explored is exceedingly good.

source: Pakai ichunguva alunglhaina ahile hiche gama chu eipuilut nuva, khoiju le bongnoi lonna gam chu eipeh diu ahi.
target: If the Lord is pleased with us, he will lead us into that land, a land flowing with milk and honey, and will give it to us.

source: Pakai dounan kiphinda poupou vunlang, chuche gam mite jong kicha hih-un; ajehchu amaho i-anchah dingu ahiuve: akihon bitnao chu amaho-a kona chedoh ahitan, chule eihovang Pakaiyin eiumpiuve: amaho chu kicha hih-un, tin aseilhonin ahi.
target: Only do not rebel against the Lord . And do not be afraid of the people of the land, because we will devour them. Their protection is gone, but the Lord is with us. Do not be afraid of them.”

source: Ahinla houkhom ho jouse chun songa sedingin agaotaovin ahi. Chuin Pakai loupina Israel chate jouse angsung, houkhom ho houbuh-a chun ahung kilahtan ahi.
target: But the whole assembly talked about stoning them. Then the glory of the Lord appeared at the tent of meeting to all the Israelites.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Itihchan hiche mipi ho hin eilung hansah diuham? Chule alah uva melchihna hijatpi kamusah nunguva jong, itihchan eitahsan da diuham?
target: The Lord said to Moses, “How long will these people treat me with contempt? How long will they refuse to believe in me, in spite of all the signs I have performed among them?

source: Keiman amaho chu natsetna kajepma, kasuhmang ding; chule keiman nangma amaho sanga lenjole hatjo nam khatna kasemding nahi ati.
target: I will strike them down with a plague and destroy them, but I will make you into a nation greater and stronger than they.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Pakai henga, Chuteng Egypt mihon hichehi ajah diu, (ajehchu nangman hiche mihohi nathahatna amaho lah-a kona nahinpuidoh ahi;)
target: Moses said to the Lord , “Then the Egyptians will hear about it! By your power you brought these people up from among them.

source: Chule amahon hiche gama cheng miho henga aseidiu ahi. Ajeh chu amahon, Pakai nangma hiche miho lah-a naum, Pakai nangma chu kimaito-a akimupiu, nameiloma achungu na-opkhum, chule amasanguva sunle meiloma nache-a, janle meikonga nacheji chu ajataovin ahi.
target: And they will tell the inhabitants of this land about it. They have already heard that you, Lord , are with these people and that you, Lord , have been seen face to face, that your cloud stays over them, and that you go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night.

source: Tun nangman hiche mite jousehi mikhat bangin that talechun, nangma minthan ja-a namho chun,
target: If you put all these people to death, leaving none alive, the nations who have heard this report about you will say,

source: Pakaiyin hiche mihohi ahahselna gama apuilut jou tahlou jeh-a, gamthipma athagam ahi atudiu ahi.
target: ‘The Lord was not able to bring these people into the land he promised them on oath, so he slaughtered them in the wilderness.’

source: Chule tun, nahenga katao ahi, ka Pakai thilboltheina chu loupi hen, nangman hitia nasei bangin,
target: “Now may the Lord’s strength be displayed, just as you have declared:

source: Pakai chu thoh hattah, hepina lentah nei, khangitlouna le suhkhelna ngaidam ji, chule themona chu donlouva koilou, pate khangitlouna chate chunga khangthum khangli geija viljing nahi.
target: ‘The Lord is slow to anger, abounding in love and forgiving sin and rebellion. Yet he does not leave the guilty unpunished; he punishes the children for the sin of the parents to the third and fourth generation.’

source: Katao ahi, hiche mipi ho Egypt'a pat tuni geija nangaidam bangin, nahepina lentah dungjuijin hiche mipite khangitlouna hi ngaidamtan, ati.
target: In accordance with your great love, forgive the sin of these people, just as you have pardoned them from the time they left Egypt until now.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin, nangma thu dungjuijin amaho hi kangaidam tai;
target: The Lord replied, “I have forgiven them, as you asked.

source: Ahinla keima tahbeh-a kahinjing bangin, leiset pumpihi Pakai loupina-a dimset ding ahi.
target: Nevertheless, as surely as I live and as surely as the glory of the Lord fills the whole earth,

source: Ajehchu hiche mite Egypt gam le gamthip laija kaloupina le kathilbol kidang bolho mujouse, chule tu-a som veijen eipatepma, ka aw ngailou jouse hin;
target: not one of those who saw my glory and the signs I performed in Egypt and in the wilderness but who disobeyed me and tested me ten times—

source: Thonlou hela amahon apu apateo kahahselna gam chu amu louhel diu, chule eilung hansah jousen jong amulou diu ahi:
target: not one of them will ever see the land I promised on oath to their ancestors. No one who has treated me with contempt will ever see it.

source: Kalhacha Caleb vangin lunggel chom neija, eijui lhingset jeh-a, agachena gama chu kapuilutding, chule achilhah ten alodiu ahi.
target: But because my servant Caleb has a different spirit and follows me wholeheartedly, I will bring him into the land he went to, and his descendants will inherit it.

source: (Tun Amalek miho le Canaan miho chu phaichama chun achengun ahi.) Jingle kiheijun lang, twipisan jotna lampia konin gamthipma lut taovin, ati.
target: Since the Amalekites and the Canaanites are living in the valleys, turn back tomorrow and set out toward the desert along the route to the Red Sea.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:

source: Hiche houkhom gilouho keima douna aphun phun uhi itihchan kathoh ding ham? keima chunga Israel chate phunna hohi kajatan ahi.
target: “How long will this wicked community grumble against me? I have heard the complaints of these grumbling Israelites.

source: Amaho chu seipeh-in, keima tahbeh-a kahinjing bangin tin Pakaiyin aseije, Nanghon kana benga nasei jouseu banga hi, nachung uva keiman kabolding ahi.
target: So tell them, ‘As surely as I live, declares the Lord , I will do to you the very thing I heard you say:

source: Nalongu hiche gamthipma hi lhukam ding ahi: keima douna phunna, kum somni-a lhah chunglam, nami jatnu dungjuija nalah uva kona kisim doh jouse chu,
target: In this wilderness your bodies will fall—every one of you twenty years old or more who was counted in the census and who has grumbled against me.

source: Jephunneh chapa Caleb le Nun chapa Joshua tailou, nangho chensahna dinga kahahselna gama chu khatcha nalutlou dingu ahi.
target: Not one of you will enter the land I swore with uplifted hand to make your home, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

source: Ahinla mi anchah ding bep natiu nachasen hou, amaho chu kapuilutna, nanghon nanot thapmu gam chu ahetdiu ahi.
target: As for your children that you said would be taken as plunder, I will bring them in to enjoy the land you have rejected.

source: Nangho thudol vang, nalongu hiche gamthipma hi lhuchap ding ahi.
target: But as for you, your bodies will fall in this wilderness.

source: Chule nachateo chu gamthipma kum somli vahle leova, nalongu gamthipma hi abeihel kahse-a najon thanhoi naochu athoh diu ahi.
target: Your children will be shepherds here for forty years, suffering for your unfaithfulness, until the last of your bodies lies in the wilderness.

source: Gam nagakhol nao nikhojat dungjuija, nisomli ngeichu, nikho khat nakhangitlou naochu kumkhat nakipoh diu, kum somli sunga, chutengle keima hi aki pampai teng iti ji-am nahetdiu ahi.
target: For forty years—one year for each of the forty days you explored the land—you will suffer for your sins and know what it is like to have me against you.’

source: Pakai Keima kaseidoh ahin, douna-a kikhom khom hiche houkhom gilouho jouse chunga hi katohdoh tahbeh ding ahi: hiche gamthipma hi mangthah uva, thigam ding ahiuve, ati.
target: I, the Lord , have spoken, and I will surely do these things to this whole wicked community, which has banded together against me. They will meet their end in this wilderness; here they will die.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n gamkholtoh dinga asol miho, ahung kile kitnuva gamthudol akaleh-a thu ahinpoh jeh uva, houkhom ho jouse phunchel sahho,
target: So the men Moses had sent to explore the land, who returned and made the whole community grumble against him by spreading a bad report about it—

source: Chule gam chunga thudola thulhut phalou hinpoho ngei chu, Pakai angsunga hisen athigam taovin ahi.
target: these men who were responsible for spreading the bad report about the land were struck down and died of a plague before the Lord .

source: Ahinla gamkhol dinga cheho lah-a pang, Nun chapa Joshua le Jephunneh chapa Caleb vang ahing lhon nalaije.
target: Of the men who went to explore the land, only Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh survived.

source: Chuin Mosi'n hiche thukisei hohi Israel chate chu aseipeh tai: chuin mipi chu alung hem cheh taovin ahi.
target: When Moses reported this to all the Israelites, they mourned bitterly.

source: Chuin jingpitah-in athoudoh un, molsang vuma akaldoh-un, Veuvin, eiho hikoma i-umuve, Pakaiyin eitep pehnao mun'a ichetou dingu ahi: ajehchu eiho ichonse taove, atiuve.
target: Early the next morning they set out for the highest point in the hill country, saying, “Now we are ready to go up to the land the Lord promised. Surely we have sinned!”

source: Chuin Mosi'n ipi dinga Pakai thupeh napalkeh-u ham? Hiche nathil gonuhi lolhing louding ahi.
target: But Moses said, “Why are you disobeying the Lord ’s command? This will not succeed!

source: Namelma teu masanga tha-a naum louna dingun, chetou hih-un; ajehchu nalah uva Pakai aumtapoi.
target: Do not go up, because the Lord is not with you. You will be defeated by your enemies,

source: Ajehchu Amalek mihole Canaan miho namasanguva aumun, achemjam muva nalou gamdiu ahi: ajehchu nangho Pakaiya kona kiheimang nahitaovin, hijeh-a chu Pakaiyin naumpi lou dingu ahi, ati.
target: for the Amalekites and the Canaanites will face you there. Because you have turned away from the Lord , he will not be with you and you will fall by the sword.”

source: Ahin amaho lhangvuma kaltou dingin akigotei teijun: ahivangin Pakai kitepna thingkhong le Mosi la gebuh-a konin akipatdoh pon ahi.
target: Nevertheless, in their presumption they went up toward the highest point in the hill country, though neither Moses nor the ark of the Lord ’s covenant moved from the camp.

source: Chuphatnin Amalek miho le chucheng lhangvuma cheng Canaan miho chu ahungkum lhaovin, amaho chu athagtnun, Hormah geijin asatpeh-un ahi.
target: Then the Amalekites and the Canaanites who lived in that hill country came down and attacked them and beat them down all the way to Hormah.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate chu seipeh in lang, ajah uva hitin seijin, Keiman nangho kapeh, nachenna diu gam nalhun tengule,
target: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘After you enter the land I am giving you as a home

source: Ganhon ahiloule kelngoi honna kona Pakai henga gimnamtui dinga, Pakaiya dinga meija kitohdoh thilto govam thilto ham, kitepna guilhunsah ganlhaina ham, lungcham thilto ham, ahiloule nakut loupiho ham napeh tengule,
target: and you present to the Lord food offerings from the herd or the flock, as an aroma pleasing to the Lord —whether burnt offerings or sacrifices, for special vows or freewill offerings or festival offerings—

source: Chutengleh Pakai henga thilto pedingpa chun anneh thilto-a dinga changbong neljet ephah hopsom-a hopkhat toh kihal thaotwi hin khat hoplia hopkhat ahinchoi ding;
target: then the person who brings an offering shall present to the Lord a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of olive oil.

source: Chule donding thilto lah-a lengpitwi hin khat hoplia hopkhat chu govam thilto ham, ganlhaina ham toh kelngoinou khatna dinga nagon ding ahi.
target: With each lamb for the burnt offering or the sacrifice, prepare a quarter of a hin of wine as a drink offering.

source: Ahiloule kelngoichal khat dinga, nangman changbon neljet hopsom-a hopni, thaotwi hin khat hopthum-a hopkhat toh kihal anneh thilto nagon ding ahi.
target: “ ‘With a ram prepare a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a third of a hin of olive oil,

source: Chule donding thilto dinga chu lengpitwi hin khat hopthum-a hopkhat Pakaiya henga gimnamtui tah hidinga nato ding ahi.
target: and a third of a hin of wine as a drink offering. Offer it as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

source: Chule govam thilto dinga bongchal nagon tengle, ahiloule kitepna suhbulhit na dinga ganlhaina ham, ahiloule Pakai henga chamna thilto ham nagon tengle;
target: “ ‘When you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering or sacrifice, for a special vow or a fellowship offering to the Lord ,

source: Chutengle nangman thaotwi hin keh khat toh kihal changbong nelsel hopsom-a hopthum, bongchal tochun anneh thilto ding nahin kaiding ahi.
target: bring with the bull a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with half a hin of olive oil,

source: Chule donding thilto-a lengpitwi hin keh khat, Pakai henga gimnamtui tah hidinga meija kitohdoh thilto nahinchoi ding ahi.
target: and also bring half a hin of wine as a drink offering. This will be a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

source: Hitia chu bongchal khat ham, ahiloule kelngoichal khat ham, kelngoinou khat ham, ahiloule kelnou khat hama dinga nabol ding ahi.
target: Each bull or ram, each lamb or young goat, is to be prepared in this manner.

source: Nagondiu jat dungjuija, amitakip henga ajatnu dungjuija naboldiu ahi.
target: Do this for each one, for as many as you prepare.

source: Chule agama peng jouse chun, Pakai henga gamnamtui tah hidinga meija thilto apeh tengule hitia hi aboldiu ahi.
target: “ ‘Everyone who is native-born must do these things in this way when they present a food offering as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

source: Chule namdang mi nangho toh akholjin khoma, ahiloule nakhang khanguva nalah uva khosaden chan chun, Pakai henga dinga gimnamtui thilto meija kitohdoh thilto apeh noma ahile, nangho bolbang banga aman jong abolding ahi.
target: For the generations to come, whenever a foreigner or anyone else living among you presents a food offering as an aroma pleasing to the Lord , they must do exactly as you do.

source: Chule nangho houkhom ho le namdang mi nalah uva khopem hon pomding chondan khat naneidiu, nakhang khanguva a-itih-a chondan khatbou nanei dingu ahi: namdang miho chu Pakai anga nangho bang bang hidingu ahi.
target: The community is to have the same rules for you and for the foreigner residing among you; this is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come. You and the foreigner shall be the same before the Lord :

source: Nangho le nalah uva khopem namdang miho-a dinga dan khatseh le chonna dan khatseh umding ahi.
target: The same laws and regulations will apply both to you and to the foreigner residing among you.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate henga thu seijin lang, ajah uva seipeh-in, Nangho keiman kapuilut na ding gama chu nalhun tengule,
target: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you enter the land to which I am taking you

source: Chutengle hitiding ahi, nanghon agam changlhah naneh tengule, Pakai henga jap thilto nato dingu ahi.
target: and you eat the food of the land, present a portion as an offering to the Lord .

source: Nachanglhah meh masapenu chu jap thilto-a natodiu: changphola jap thilto nabol banguva chutia chu nabol dingu ahi.
target: Present a loaf from the first of your ground meal and present it as an offering from the threshing floor.

source: Nakhang khanguva nachanglhah mehmasa penu chu Pakai henga jap thilto-a nato dingu ahi.
target: Throughout the generations to come you are to give this offering to the Lord from the first of your ground meal.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Mosi henga anasei hiche thupeh jouse hi nasuhkhel uva, nanit lou uva ahile,
target: “ ‘Now if you as a community unintentionally fail to keep any of these commands the Lord gave Moses—

source: Pakaiyin Mosi ana thupeh ni-a kipat amasanglam nakhang lhungkeijuva Pakaiyin Mosi khutna kona nangho nathupeh jouse geija chu;
target: any of the Lord ’s commands to you through him, from the day the Lord gave them and continuing through the generations to come—

source: Chutengle hung hitiding ahi, houkhom ho hetlouva hetlou jeh-a suhkhel ahile, houkhom ho jousen bongchal golkhat Pakai henga gam namtuitah hidinga govam thilto-a ding, a-anneh thilto le adonding thilto toh dan dungjuija atotha diu, chule chonset thilto-a dinga kelnou khat atodiu ahi.
target: and if this is done unintentionally without the community being aware of it, then the whole community is to offer a young bull for a burnt offering as an aroma pleasing to the Lord , along with its prescribed grain offering and drink offering, and a male goat for a sin offering.

source: Chule thempupa chun Israel chate houkhom ho jouse dinga longlhenna abolding, hetlouva kibol ahijeh-a kingaidam ding ahiuve. Chule ahetlou jeh uva Pakai henga meija kitohdoh ganlhaina thilto ahinchoi uva, Pakai henga achonsetnao thilto ahinchoi dingu ahi.
target: The priest is to make atonement for the whole Israelite community, and they will be forgiven, for it was not intentional and they have presented to the Lord for their wrong a food offering and a sin offering.

source: Chule Israel chate houkhom ho jouse le amaho lah-a khopem namdang mipi jouse chu kingaidam ding ahiuve; ajehchu mijouse chun ahetlouvu ahi.
target: The whole Israelite community and the foreigners residing among them will be forgiven, because all the people were involved in the unintentional wrong.

source: Chule mikhat tou hetlou jeh-a achonsetna ahile, amachun kelcha anu kumkhat lhingbep khat chonset thilto-a dinga ahinchoi ding ahi.
target: “ ‘But if just one person sins unintentionally, that person must bring a year-old female goat for a sin offering.

source: Chutengle thempupa chun hetlou jeh-a chonsepa dinga chu longlhenna abolding ahi, chule aman Pakai anga hetlou jeh-a chonset abola alonglhena abol tengle amachu kingaidam ding ahi.
target: The priest is to make atonement before the Lord for the one who erred by sinning unintentionally, and when atonement has been made, that person will be forgiven.

source: Nanghon Israel chate lah-a peng hihen, nalah uva hung khopem namdang mi hijongle, hetlou jeh-a chonset bolpa dinga dan khat nanei dingu ahi.
target: One and the same law applies to everyone who sins unintentionally, whether a native-born Israelite or a foreigner residing among you.

source: Ahivangin henasa-a bolpa chu, gamsunga penga hihen lang, namdang mi hijongle, amachun Pakai i-sah louva abol ahin; amachu amite lah-a kona kipaimang ding ahi.
target: “ ‘But anyone who sins defiantly, whether native-born or foreigner, blasphemes the Lord and must be cut off from the people of Israel.

source: Ajehchu aman Pakai thu chu anot thapma, athupeh apalkeh ahin, hichepa chu paimanga umding ahi; akhangit louna chu ama chunga chuding ahi.
target: Because they have despised the Lord ’s word and broken his commands, they must surely be cut off; their guilt remains on them.’ ”

source: Chule Israel chate gamthipma aumpetnun, choldo ni-a thingkang chom mikhat amutaovin ahi.
target: While the Israelites were in the wilderness, a man was found gathering wood on the Sabbath day.

source: Chuin thingkang chom muho chun amachu Mosi le Aaron chule houkhom ho jouse henga ahin puitaovin ahi.
target: Those who found him gathering wood brought him to Moses and Aaron and the whole assembly,

source: Chuin iloding akiphondoh loulai jeh-in, amachu mihen na-a akoi taove.
target: and they kept him in custody, because it was not clear what should be done to him.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Mipa chu thatei ding ahi: houkhom ho jousen gebuh polama songa asediu ahi, ati.
target: Then the Lord said to Moses, “The man must die. The whole assembly must stone him outside the camp.”

source: Chuin mipi chun Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangin amachu gebuh pama ahin puidoh-un, songa aseplih taovin ahi.
target: So the assembly took him outside the camp and stoned him to death, as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate jah-a chun akhang khanguva apon geihou ajeppah nadiu le, agei ajep pahnao chunga chu adumpol aba diuvin seipeh-in,
target: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘Throughout the generations to come you are to make tassels on the corners of your garments, with a blue cord on each tassel.

source: Chule nanghon najeppah nao chu nangho dinga, hichu navet nuva, Pakai thupeh jouse chu nageldoh uva nabol nadiu hidin: chule jonthanhoi boldinga anung najuijiu nalung ngaichatnu le namit vetnu chu najuilou nadiu ahi.
target: You will have these tassels to look at and so you will remember all the commands of the Lord , that you may obey them and not prostitute yourselves by chasing after the lusts of your own hearts and eyes.

source: Chutia chu kathupeh jouse nageldoh uva, nabol uva, na Pathen'u dinga atheng nahinadiu ahi.
target: Then you will remember to obey all my commands and will be consecrated to your God.

source: Keima Pakai na Pathen'u kahin, na Pathen'u hidinga Egypt gama kona nahin puidohpao chu kahi: keima Pakai na Pathen'u kahi.
target: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt to be your God. I am the Lord your God.’ ”

source: Tun Izhar chapa, Kohath chapa, Levi chapa Korah le Reuben chapate Eliab chapa teni Dathan le Abiram, chule Peleth chapa On chun miho apuijun,
target: Korah son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and certain Reubenites—Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, and On son of Peleth—became insolent

source: Chuin houkhom ho sunga um loupileh, minche cheh akikhom khomho pipui jani le somnga le Israel chate phabep toh Mosi maija adingdoh-un,
target: and rose up against Moses. With them were 250 Israelite men, well-known community leaders who had been appointed members of the council.

source: Chuin amaho Mosi le Aaron dounan akikhomun, aheng lhona, Houkhom ho jouse, amitakip athengun alah uva Pakai aume ti hena sasan nakibolthei sah behseh lhone. Ibola Pakai houkhom ho chung vuma kidomsang jeng nahi lhonham? atiuve.
target: They came as a group to oppose Moses and Aaron and said to them, “You have gone too far! The whole community is holy, every one of them, and the Lord is with them. Why then do you set yourselves above the Lord ’s assembly?”

source: Chuin Mosi'n hichu ajah phatnin, tolla aboh khupmin:
target: When Moses heard this, he fell facedown.

source: Korah le aloiho jouse jah-a chun aseijin, hitin ati, Jingkah le Pakaiyin koi chu ama-a hija, koi chu atheng hijaham avetsah-a; chule amachu aheng anailut sah ding ahi: chule ama alhenpa tah ngeichu akinailut sah ding ahi.
target: Then he said to Korah and all his followers: “In the morning the Lord will show who belongs to him and who is holy, and he will have that person come near him. The man he chooses he will cause to come near him.

source: Hiche hi bolun: Korah le aloiho jousen gimnamtui lheng ho kilah-un;
target: You, Korah, and all your followers are to do this: Take censers

source: Chule Asunga chun mei hallun lang, jingteng Pakai angsunga asunga chun gimnamtui koijun; chule hitiding ahi, Pakaiyin alhen amapa chu atheng hiding ahi. Nangho Levi chate, nakibolthei sah behseh taovin ahi.
target: and tomorrow put burning coals and incense in them before the Lord . The man the Lord chooses will be the one who is holy. You Levites have gone too far!”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Korah jah-a, Ngaijun, katao ahi, nangho Levi chapate;
target: Moses also said to Korah, “Now listen, you Levites!

source: Ama henga puinaja, Pakai houbuh lhachana tongding le, houkhom ho masanga akinthengu bol dinga ding dinga Israelte Pathen'in Israel houkhom ho-a kona nachomkhenu hi nangho dinga thil neocha bou hia nagelu ham?
target: Isn’t it enough for you that the God of Israel has separated you from the rest of the Israelite community and brought you near himself to do the work at the Lord ’s tabernacle and to stand before the community and minister to them?

source: Chule aman nangma le nasopi ho Levi chapate jouse ama henga napuinai taove: achutile nanghon themputna jong nahol nahlaiju ham?
target: He has brought you and all your fellow Levites near himself, but now you are trying to get the priesthood too.

source: Hijeh chun nangma le naloiho jouse Pakai dounan nakikhom khomun: ahi. Aaron chu ipi hija ama douna-a naphunu ham? ati.
target: It is against the Lord that you and all your followers have banded together. Who is Aaron that you should grumble against him?”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Eliah chatehi Dathan le Abiram koudin mi asolin ahile, amanin, hungtou lhon ponge:
target: Then Moses summoned Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab. But they said, “We will not come!

source: Khoiju le bongnoi lonna gama kona gamthipma thadinga neihin puidoh-u hi thilneocha hija, kachunguva naki piput sah ham?
target: Isn’t it enough that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the wilderness? And now you also want to lord it over us!

source: Chukal vallin nangman khoiju le bongnoi lonna gama neipuilut pouvin, ahiloule lou le lengpilei la neilosah deh pouve: hicheng miho jouse mit hi kaldoh nagot ham? kahung tou lhon louding ahi, ati lhontan ahi.
target: Moreover, you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey or given us an inheritance of fields and vineyards. Do you want to treat these men like slaves? No, we will not come!”

source: Chuin Mosi alung ahang lheh jengtan, Pakai henga, Athil toujong sanghih-in; keiman amaho-a konin sangan khatjong kalapon, amaho khatcha jong kasuna pon ahi, ati.
target: Then Moses became very angry and said to the Lord , “Do not accept their offering. I have not taken so much as a donkey from them, nor have I wronged any of them.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Korah jah-a, Nangma le naloiho jouse, nangma le amahose chu Aaron toh jingle Pakai angsunga naum diu ahi:
target: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your followers are to appear before the Lord tomorrow—you and they and Aaron.

source: Chule amitakipmin nagimnamtui lheng cheh kilah unlang, asunga gimnamtui koijun, chule amitakipmin nagimnamtui lheng cheh-u gimnamtui lhengcheh-u, jani le somnga chu Pakai anga hinchoijun; nangma le Aaron'in jong nagimnamtui lheng cheh nakichoi lhonding ahi, ati.
target: Each man is to take his censer and put incense in it—250 censers in all—and present it before the Lord . You and Aaron are to present your censers also.”

source: Chuin amitakip min agimnamtui lheng cheh akilah-un, asunga mei akoijun, achunga gimnamtui akoijun, houkhom ho houbuh kotphunga chun Mosi le Aaron toh ading khom taovin ahi.
target: So each of them took his censer, put burning coals and incense in it, and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

source: Chuin Korah chun amaho dounan houkhom ho jouse houkhom na ponbuh kotphunga akhomin ahi: chuin Pakai loupina chu houkhom ho jouse henga ahung kilah tan ahi.
target: When Korah had gathered all his followers in opposition to them at the entrance to the tent of meeting, the glory of the Lord appeared to the entire assembly.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron jah-a thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

source: Hetmanlouva amaho kasuhmang theina dingin, hiche houkhom ho-a konin kikhindal lhonin ati.
target: “Separate yourselves from this assembly so I can put an end to them at once.”

source: Chuin amani abohkhup lhonin, Vo Pathen, tahsa jouse lhagao ho Pathen, mikhat chonset jeh-a houkhom ho jouse chunga lunghang ding nahi hitam? atilhon tan ahi.
target: But Moses and Aaron fell facedown and cried out, “O God, the God who gives breath to all living things, will you be angry with the entire assembly when only one man sins?”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin,
target: Then the Lord said to Moses,

source: Houkhom ho jah-a chun, Korah, Dathan chule Abiram houbuh-a konin kikhin doh-un tin seijin ati.
target: “Say to the assembly, ‘Move away from the tents of Korah, Dathan and Abiram.’ ”

source: Chuin Mosi akipatdoh-in Dathan le Abiram henga achen; chule Israel upahon anung ajuijun ahi.
target: Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the elders of Israel followed him.

source: Chuin aman houkhom ho jah-a, Naheng uva katao ahi, hiche miphalou ho ponbuh ho-a konin kikhin doh-un, chule a-imachao tongkha hih-un, achuti loule achonsetnao jouse-a mangthah getnun nate, ati.
target: He warned the assembly, “Move back from the tents of these wicked men! Do not touch anything belonging to them, or you will be swept away because of all their sins.”

source: Chutichun amaho Korah, Dathan chule Abiram houbuh ningtina konin akipat doh-un ahi. Chuin Dathan le Abiram ahungdoh lhonin, aponbuh-u kotphunga chun ajiteu, achateu, chule achasen houtoh ading taovin ahi.
target: So they moved away from the tents of Korah, Dathan and Abiram. Dathan and Abiram had come out and were standing with their wives, children and little ones at the entrances to their tents.

source: Chuin Mosi'n hichea kona hi Pakaiyin keima hicheng na jouse tong dinga eisol ahi nahet dingu ahi; ajeh chu keiman hiche hohi kalung chama kabol ahipoi.
target: Then Moses said, “This is how you will know that the Lord has sent me to do all these things and that it was not my idea:

source: Hiche miho hi mijouse thi ngaija athiuva, ahiloule miho kivil banga akiviluva ahile, Pakaiyin eihin sol hilou ding ahi.
target: If these men die a natural death and suffer the fate of all mankind, then the Lord has not sent me.

source: Ahinla Pakaiyin thilthah abola, leiset akam katna, amaho hi aneijouseu toh aval lhuma, chule kotong sunga gangtah-a alhah lhumuva ahile; hiche miho hin Pakai alung hansah uve ti nahet chet dingu ahi, ati.
target: But if the Lord brings about something totally new, and the earth opens its mouth and swallows them, with everything that belongs to them, and they go down alive into the realm of the dead, then you will know that these men have treated the Lord with contempt.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, aman hicheng thuhi aseijou jouvin, anoijuva leiset chu ahung keh-in akikhen totan ahi.
target: As soon as he finished saying all this, the ground under them split apart

source: Chuin Leisetnin akam ahin kathom sah-in, amaho le a-inhou, chule Korah loiho jouse le athilkeo jouseu chu aval lhumtan ahi.
target: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and their households, and all those associated with Korah, together with their possessions.

source: Amahole aneijouseu ahingin kokhuh sunga chun alhalutnun, chule achunguva leiset akichin; amaho houkhom ho lah-a konin amangthah taovin ahi.
target: They went down alive into the realm of the dead, with everything they owned; the earth closed over them, and they perished and were gone from the community.

source: Chuin avela um Israel ho chu amaho pen gin chun ajam gamtaovin ahi. Ajehchu amahon, Eiho jong leijin eival lhum getnunte atiu ahi.
target: At their cries, all the Israelites around them fled, shouting, “The earth is going to swallow us too!”

source: Chuin Pakaiya konin meikong ahungdoh-in, gimnamtui hal mi jani le somnga chu akavamtan ahi.
target: And fire came out from the Lord and consumed the 250 men who were offering the incense.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Aaron thempu pa chapa Eleazar jah-a, gimnamtui lhengho chu meikong lah-a kona ladoh nadin seipeh-in, ajehchu hicheho chu atheng ahi; chule meichu gamlha thim tah-a thaijah-in.
target: “Tell Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, to remove the censers from the charred remains and scatter the coals some distance away, for the censers are holy—

source: Amaho hinna douna-a chonseteho gimnamtui lheng ho chu maicham khuna kongdalin semuhen; ajehchu amahon Pakai anga ato-u ahin, hijeh-a chu hicheho chu thenga ahi. Chule hicheho chu Israel chate dinga melchhihna hiding ahi, ati.
target: the censers of the men who sinned at the cost of their lives. Hammer the censers into sheets to overlay the altar, for they were presented before the Lord and have become holy. Let them be a sign to the Israelites.”

source: Chuin Eleazar thempupan meikavam hon thiltona amanu sum-eng gimnamtui lheng ho chu alan, hiche ho chu maicham khuna kongdalin asemin;
target: So Eleazar the priest collected the bronze censers brought by those who had been burned to death, and he had them hammered out to overlay the altar,

source: Hichu Aaron chilhah hilou namdang mi koimachan Pakai angsunga gimnamtui hal dinga ahung nai louna diu; Pakaiyin Mosi khutna kona ahenga aseibanga, Korah le aloiho abah louna diuva, Israel chate dinga hetjingna hiding ahi.
target: as the Lord directed him through Moses. This was to remind the Israelites that no one except a descendant of Aaron should come to burn incense before the Lord , or he would become like Korah and his followers.

source: Ahivangin ajingin Israel chate houkhom ho jouse chu Mosi douna le Aaron dounan aphunuvin, Nangman Pakai miho nathatne atiuvin ahi.
target: The next day the whole Israelite community grumbled against Moses and Aaron. “You have killed the Lord ’s people,” they said.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, houkhom ho chu Mosi le Aaron douna-a akikhop petnun, houkhom ho houbuh lam chu aveovin ahile: veuvin, hichu meilom'in atomin, chule Pakai loupi chu ahung kilah-in ahi.
target: But when the assembly gathered in opposition to Moses and Aaron and turned toward the tent of meeting, suddenly the cloud covered it and the glory of the Lord appeared.

source: Chuin Mosi le Aaron chu houkhom ho houbuh maija chun ahung lhonin ahi.
target: Then Moses and Aaron went to the front of the tent of meeting,

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a thu aseijin,
target: and the Lord said to Moses,

source: Amaho chu hetmanlouva kasuhmang thei nadin, hiche houkhom ho lah-a konhin hung doh-in, ati, chuin amaho chu abohkhup gam taovin ahi.
target: “Get away from this assembly so I can put an end to them at once.” And they fell facedown.

source: Chuin Mosi'n Aaron jah-a, Gimnamtui lheng kilah-inlang, asunga chun maichama kon mei koilutnin, chule gimnamtui hal loijin lang, mangang tah-in houkhom ho henga chenlang, amaho dingin longlhenna gabolin: ajehchu Pakaiya konin lunghanna ahungdoh tan, hise akipantan ahi, ati.
target: Then Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer and put incense in it, along with burning coals from the altar, and hurry to the assembly to make atonement for them. Wrath has come out from the Lord ; the plague has started.”

source: Chuin Aaron'in Mosi'n athupeh bangchun alan, houkhom ho lah-a alhailuttai; chule veuvin, mipi ho lah-a chun hise chu anakipantan ahi. Chuin aman gimnamtui ahalin, mipi ho dinga chun longlhenna aboltan ahi.
target: So Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the midst of the assembly. The plague had already started among the people, but Aaron offered the incense and made atonement for them.

source: Chuin ama athiho le ahingho kikah achun adingin ahile, hise chu atangtan ahi.
target: He stood between the living and the dead, and the plague stopped.

source: Tun Korah chungchang thua thiho tilouvin, hise-a thichu sangsom le sangli le jasagi ahi.
target: But 14,700 people died from the plague, in addition to those who had died because of Korah.

source: Chuin Aaron chu houkhom ho houbuh kotphung lama Mosi henga akiletan: chule hise chu atangtan ahi.
target: Then Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance to the tent of meeting, for the plague had stopped.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate jah-a seijin lang, apu apateu insung kailhah mikhat cheh-a kon tenggol khatcheh, apipuhou jouse apu apateo insung kailhah cheh-a kon tenggol somleni lan lang; chule nangman amitakip min chu atenggol chung cheh uva chun sunnin.
target: “Speak to the Israelites and get twelve staffs from them, one from the leader of each of their ancestral tribes. Write the name of each man on his staff.

source: Chule nangman Aaron min chu Levi tenggol chunga nasutding ahi; ajeh chu tenggol khat cheh chu apateo insung luchang cheh-a ding ahi.
target: On the staff of Levi write Aaron’s name, for there must be one staff for the head of each ancestral tribe.

source: Chule nangman hiche ho chu nangma kakimupina houkhom ho houbuh sung hettohsahna maija chu nakoi ding ahi.
target: Place them in the tent of meeting in front of the ark of the covenant law, where I meet with you.

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi, keiman kalhen pen tenggol chu hungpah ding ahi: chutengle Israel chate aphun nao, nangni douna-a aphunao chu keija kona kasuh tang ding ahi, ati.
target: The staff belonging to the man I choose will sprout, and I will rid myself of this constant grumbling against you by the Israelites.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Israel chate henga chun aseijin ahile, pipuho chu aman tenggol khatcheh apeuvin, apu apateo insung dungjuijin tenggol somleni apeuvin ahi. Chule Aaron tenggol chu amaho-a tenggol lah-a chun aumin ahi.
target: So Moses spoke to the Israelites, and their leaders gave him twelve staffs, one for the leader of each of their ancestral tribes, and Aaron’s staff was among them.

source: Chuin Mosi'n hettohsahna houkhom ho houbuh sunga Pakai anga chun tenggol ho chu akoitan ahi.
target: Moses placed the staffs before the Lord in the tent of the covenant law.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, ajingin Mosi hettohsahna houbuh sunga chun alutnin ahile, veuvin, Levi insung dinga Aaron tenggol chu anadonin, amumdoh-in, chule ahungpah-in, jonmot anagan ahi.
target: The next day Moses entered the tent and saw that Aaron’s staff, which represented the tribe of Levi, had not only sprouted but had budded, blossomed and produced almonds.

source: Chuin Mosi'n tenggol ho chu Pakai angsunga konin Israel chate henga ahinpodoh-in; chule amahon aveovin, amitakipmin atenggol cheh akilah taovin ahi.
target: Then Moses brought out all the staffs from the Lord ’s presence to all the Israelites. They looked at them, and each of the leaders took his own staff.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Aaron tenggol chu akiphinho hetna-a hettohsahna maija koidin hinlechoi kitnin; chutengle amaho keima douna-a aphunchel naova athilou nadinguva nasuhthip ding ahi, ati.
target: The Lord said to Moses, “Put back Aaron’s staff in front of the ark of the covenant law, to be kept as a sign to the rebellious. This will put an end to their grumbling against me, so that they will not die.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n hiti chun abolin, Pakaiyin thu apeh bang chun aboltan ahi.
target: Moses did just as the Lord commanded him.

source: Chuin Israel chaten Mosi jah-a, Ven, keiho kathigamun, kamang thah-un, kamanthah gamhelu ahitai.
target: The Israelites said to Moses, “We will die! We are lost, we are all lost!

source: Koi hijongle Pakai houbuh hinnai jouse chu thiding ahi: thina-a chu imanthah dingu hitam? atiuve.
target: Anyone who even comes near the tabernacle of the Lord will die. Are we all going to die?”

source: Pakaiyin Aaron jah-a, Nangma le nachapa, chule napu napateu insungin munthenga khangitlouna chu napohdiu, chule nangma le nachapate nangma toh na themputnao khangitlouna chu napohdiu ahi.
target: The Lord said to Aaron, “You, your sons and your family are to bear the responsibility for offenses connected with the sanctuary, and you and your sons alone are to bear the responsibility for offenses connected with the priesthood.

source: Chule Nangma le nachapaten hettohsahna houbuh maija lhachana natoh naova nakithopi theina dinguvin, Levi phunga nasopi ho, napa phungmi hochu hin kipuijin.
target: Bring your fellow Levites from your ancestral tribe to join you and assist you when you and your sons minister before the tent of the covenant law.

source: Chule amahon nangma natoh ding le houbuh natohding jouse chu avetup dingu ahi: amaho ahia nangma nahi-a jong nathilou na dinguva munthenga bel hole maicham bou chu ahin nailou dingu ahi.
target: They are to be responsible to you and are to perform all the duties of the tent, but they must not go near the furnishings of the sanctuary or the altar. Otherwise both they and you will die.

source: Chule amahon nangma nakitho piuva, houkhom ho houbuh natoh le houbuh lhacha natoh jouse atohdiu: chule namdang min vang nahinnai louding ahi.
target: They are to join you and be responsible for the care of the tent of meeting—all the work at the tent—and no one else may come near where you are.

source: Chutia chu Israel chate chunga lunghanna aumbe louna dinga, nangman muntheng natoh le maicham natoh chu natoh ding ahi.
target: “You are to be responsible for the care of the sanctuary and the altar, so that my wrath will not fall on the Israelites again.

source: Chule keima, ven, keiman nasopi ho Levi chate chu Israel chate lah-a konin kalheng doh-in; houkhom ho houbuh-a natong dingin Pakai dinga thilpeh khat bangin nangma nakipe taove.
target: I myself have selected your fellow Levites from among the Israelites as a gift to you, dedicated to the Lord to do the work at the tent of meeting.

source: Hijeh chun nangma le nangma to umkhom nachapaten maicham le pondal sunglam thua thempu tohmuna na natoh diu ahi: nathempu tohmun natohhi nalhacha natohdiu thilpeh-a kapeh-u nahiuve: namdang mi ahin naija chu thiding ahi, ati.
target: But only you and your sons may serve as priests in connection with everything at the altar and inside the curtain. I am giving you the service of the priesthood as a gift. Anyone else who comes near the sanctuary is to be put to death.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Aaron jah-a, Ven, keiman jap thilto, Israel chaten thiltheng jouse chu nangma mopohna jong kapen; hicheho jouse chu thaokinu ahijeh-a nangma le nachapate a-itih-a chondan khat hidinga kapeh nahi.
target: Then the Lord said to Aaron, “I myself have put you in charge of the offerings presented to me; all the holy offerings the Israelites give me I give to you and your sons as your portion, your perpetual share.

source: Hiche hi meija kona amoh, nanga dinga thiltheng chungnung ho chu ahi: athil tohou jouse anneh thilto jouse, achonset thiltou jouse, asuhkhel thiltou jouse-a keima eipehdiu jouse chu nangma le nachapate dinga theng chungnung hiding ahi.
target: You are to have the part of the most holy offerings that is kept from the fire. From all the gifts they bring me as most holy offerings, whether grain or sin or guilt offerings, that part belongs to you and your sons.

source: Muntheng chungnunga chu nangman nanehding; pasal takipmin anehdingu ahi: hichu nangma dinga atheng hiding ahi.
target: Eat it as something most holy; every male shall eat it. You must regard it as holy.

source: Hichehi nanga ding ahi; Israel chaten dopkhang thilto dinga athilto hou, ajap thilto hou jouse toh, nangma le nangma toh umkhom nachapate le nachanute henga a-itih-a chondan hidinga kapeh nahiuve: na-insunga atheng tapouvin hichu aneh dingu ahi.
target: “This also is yours: whatever is set aside from the gifts of all the wave offerings of the Israelites. I give this to you and your sons and daughters as your perpetual share. Everyone in your household who is ceremonially clean may eat it.

source: Thao apha pentah le, lengpitwi apha pentah, chule suhlou chang, aga masapen ho Pakai henga apehdingu hou jouse chu nangma kapeh nahi.
target: “I give you all the finest olive oil and all the finest new wine and grain they give the Lord as the firstfruits of their harvest.

source: Chule Pakai henga ahin choi dingu gamsunga amin masapen chan chu nanga ding ahin; na-insunga atheng takipmin hichu aneh dingu ahi.
target: All the land’s firstfruits that they bring to the Lord will be yours. Everyone in your household who is ceremonially clean may eat it.

source: Israel gamsunga thilto jouse nanga hiding ahi.
target: “Everything in Israel that is devoted to the Lord is yours.

source: Pakai henga apeh-u, tipum jouse-a naobu phukeh masa chan chu mihem hihen gancha hile nanga hiding ahi: ahivanga cha masapen chu nalhatdoh teiding ahin, chule gancha thenglou apeng masapen ho chu nalhat doh ding ahi.
target: The first offspring of every womb, both human and animal, that is offered to the Lord is yours. But you must redeem every firstborn son and every firstborn male of unclean animals.

source: Chule lhakhat ahia patna alhatdohna ding ho chu nalhatdoh ding, alhatna man nangma gon dungjuija, muntheng shekel dungjuija shekel chu gerah somni ahin, shekel nga-a nalhat ding ahi.
target: When they are a month old, you must redeem them at the redemption price set at five shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs.

source: Ahivangin bongnou masapen, kelngoi masapen le kelcha masapen chu nalhatdoh louding ahi; amaho atheng ahiuve: athisanu chu maicham chunga nathe-a, athao chu Pakai henga gimnamtui tah hidinga meija kitoh thilto dinga nagoding ahi.
target: “But you must not redeem the firstborn of a cow, a sheep or a goat; they are holy. Splash their blood against the altar and burn their fat as a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

source: Chule a-om kijap le adah jetlam nanga ahibanga, atipum chu nangma ding ahi.
target: Their meat is to be yours, just as the breast of the wave offering and the right thigh are yours.

source: Israel chaten Pakai henga lhuh thilto apeh-u thil thengho jouse chu, nangma le nangma toh umkhom nachapate le nachanute henga a-itih-a chondan hidinga kapeh nahiuve. Hiche hi Pakai anga a-imatih chana dinga nangma le nachilhahte henga chi-a kitepna hiding ahi.
target: Whatever is set aside from the holy offerings the Israelites present to the Lord I give to you and your sons and daughters as your perpetual share. It is an everlasting covenant of salt before the Lord for both you and your offspring.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Aaron henga thu aseijin, ajah-a, Nangman amaho gamsunga gou naneilou ding, chule alah uva chan jong naneilou ding ahi: Keimahi Israel chate lah-a nagou le nachan chu kahi.
target: The Lord said to Aaron, “You will have no inheritance in their land, nor will you have any share among them; I am your share and your inheritance among the Israelites.

source: Chule ven, keiman Levi chate chu Israel gamsunga hopsom jouse chu, atoh-u lhacha natoh, houkhom ho houbuh-a alhacha natoh-u jehtah chun agoulo diuvin kapen ahi.
target: “I give to the Levites all the tithes in Israel as their inheritance in return for the work they do while serving at the tent of meeting.

source: Tua patna Israel chaten chonset apoh uva athilouna dinguva, houkhom ho houbuh aga nailou dingu ahi.
target: From now on the Israelites must not go near the tent of meeting, or they will bear the consequences of their sin and will die.

source: Amavang Levi ho chun houkhom ho houbuh lhachana atoh uva, athemo nao chu apohdiu ahi. Hichehi a-itih-a nakhang lhum keijuva dinga chondan hiding, chutia chu Israel chate lah-a goulo naneilou diu ahi.
target: It is the Levites who are to do the work at the tent of meeting and bear the responsibility for any offenses they commit against it. This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come. They will receive no inheritance among the Israelites.

source: Amavang Israel chaten Pakai henga lhuh thilpeh-a apeh-u ahopsom hou chu Levi hon gouva alodiuva kapeh ahitai; hijeh-a chu keiman ajah uva, Israel chate lah-a amahon goulo aneilou diu ahi, kati ahi.
target: Instead, I give to the Levites as their inheritance the tithes that the Israelites present as an offering to the Lord . That is why I said concerning them: ‘They will have no inheritance among the Israelites.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Nangman Levi ho kihoupin lang, ajah uva, Nanghon Israel chate hopsom, keiman nagoulo diuva kapeh chu amaho-a kon nalah tengule, hopsom-a hop khat ngeichu Pakai dinga lhuh thilto-a napehdiu ahi, ati.
target: “Speak to the Levites and say to them: ‘When you receive from the Israelites the tithe I give you as your inheritance, you must present a tenth of that tithe as the Lord ’s offering.

source: Chule hiche nalhuh thilto hou chu pholla chang leh lengpi chilhahna-a pum dimset banga kisimding ahi.
target: Your offering will be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing floor or juice from the winepress.

source: Hita chu Israel chate hopsom nalah jouse chu Pakai henga lhuh thilto-a nato diu; chule chuche Pakaiya lhuh thilto chu Aaron thempupa napeh diu ahi.
target: In this way you also will present an offering to the Lord from all the tithes you receive from the Israelites. From these tithes you must give the Lord ’s portion to Aaron the priest.

source: Nathilto hou jouse lah-a kon aphapen le, atheng chengse chu Pakai henga lhuh thilto-a nato teidiu ahi.
target: You must present as the Lord ’s portion the best and holiest part of everything given to you.’

source: Hiche jeh-a chu nangman amaho jah-a hitia nasei ding ahi, Nanghon aphapen ho nalhuhdoh tenguleh Levi ho dinga hiche hi changphol le lengpitwi kiheh na-a kona agasoh-a kisim ding ahi.
target: “Say to the Levites: ‘When you present the best part, it will be reckoned to you as the product of the threshing floor or the winepress.

source: Chule hiche hi nangma le na-insung miten mun jouse-a naneh thei dingu ahi: ajeh chu hichehi houkhom houbuh-a nalhacha natoh manuva kipe tohman ahi.
target: You and your households may eat the rest of it anywhere, for it is your wages for your work at the tent of meeting.

source: Chule hichea kona aphapen nalhuh tengule, hiche jeh-a chu nanghon chonset napoh loudiu: chule nathi louna dinguva Israel chateho thiltheng jouse chu nasuhboh theilou dingu ahi.
target: By presenting the best part of it you will not be guilty in this matter; then you will not defile the holy offerings of the Israelites, and you will not die.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron jah-a aseijin, hitin ati.
target: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:

source: Hichehi Pakai thupeh chona danthu ahin, Israel chate henga chun bongla asan, pol lou, achunga nolna beihel, achunga namkoljon kibut khalou, nahin kaipeh nadiuvin seijin.
target: “This is a requirement of the law that the Lord has commanded: Tell the Israelites to bring you a red heifer without defect or blemish and that has never been under a yoke.

source: Chule hiche chu Eleazar thempupan gebuh pama ahin kaidoh dinga napeh ding, chule mikhatnin a-angsung laitah-a atha ding ahi.
target: Give it to Eleazar the priest; it is to be taken outside the camp and slaughtered in his presence.

source: Chutengle Eleazar thempupa chun athisan chu akhutjunga alah-a, houkhom ho houbuh masanga sagivei atheding ahi.
target: Then Eleazar the priest is to take some of its blood on his finger and sprinkle it seven times toward the front of the tent of meeting.

source: Chule khatnin ama mitmu-a bongla chu agoding; avunjong, atipum jong, athijong chule a-eh jong ahalding;
target: While he watches, the heifer is to be burned—its hide, flesh, blood and intestines.

source: Chutengle thempu chun Cedar thing le hyssop chule asandup alah-a, bongla kigona meikong lah-a chu aselut ding ahi.
target: The priest is to take some cedar wood, hyssop and scarlet wool and throw them onto the burning heifer.

source: Chule thempu chun aponho akisopma, atahsa twija akisil ding, chujoule gebuh-a hunglut ding, chule thempupa chu nilhah geija thenglou ding ahi.
target: After that, the priest must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water. He may then come into the camp, but he will be ceremonially unclean till evening.

source: Hitia bongla gou penpen chu twija avon asopma, amajong twija kisilding, chule nilhah geija thenglou ding ahi.
target: The man who burns it must also wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he too will be unclean till evening.

source: Chule mitheng khatnin bongla kigona vutvam chu alokhoma, gebuh pam muntheng lai khatna akoiding, chule Israel chate houkhom ho-a dinga kisekhena twija mandinga koiding ahi: hichu chonset suhtheng na hiding ahi.
target: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer and put them in a ceremonially clean place outside the camp. They are to be kept by the Israelite community for use in the water of cleansing; it is for purification from sin.

source: Chule bongla kigona vutvam lohkhompa chun avon asopma, nilhah geija atheng louva umding ahi: chule hichu Israel chate le alah uva namdang akholjin khompiu ho-a dinga a-itih-a dinga dan hiding ahi.
target: The man who gathers up the ashes of the heifer must also wash his clothes, and he too will be unclean till evening. This will be a lasting ordinance both for the Israelites and for the foreigners residing among them.

source: Koi hile thilong tongkha-a chu nisagi thenglouva umding ahi.
target: “Whoever touches a human corpse will be unclean for seven days.

source: Chule hiche twija chu anithum nile kisuthenga, anisagi nile amachu thengding ahi; ahin ama anithum nile akisuhtheng louva ahile, anisagi lhinni jongle thenglou ding ahi.
target: They must purify themselves with the water on the third day and on the seventh day; then they will be clean. But if they do not purify themselves on the third and seventh days, they will not be clean.

source: Mi khattou mithi long tongkha-a, chule kisutheng louchun, Pakai houbuh asuhboh ahin; amachu Israel chate lah-a kona kipaimang ding ahi. Ajeh chu achunga kise khenna twi akithe khumpon, ama chu athenglou hiding; athenlouna chu achunga umnalai ahi.
target: If they fail to purify themselves after touching a human corpse, they defile the Lord ’s tabernacle. They must be cut off from Israel. Because the water of cleansing has not been sprinkled on them, they are unclean; their uncleanness remains on them.

source: Hichehi mikhat pon in'a athi tenga dan ding chu ahi: pon in sunga hunglutho jouse le, pon in sunga um jouse chu nisagi thenglou diu ahi.
target: “This is the law that applies when a person dies in a tent: Anyone who enters the tent and anyone who is in it will be unclean for seven days,

source: Chule asunga um kong le bel asin umlouva kihong jouse chu athenglou hiding ahi.
target: and every open container without a lid fastened on it will be unclean.

source: Chule koi hijongle tol lhanga chemjam'a kithat, ahiloule mithilong, ahiloule mithigu, ahiloule lhankhuh tongkha-a chu nisagi athenglou hiding ahi.
target: “Anyone out in the open who touches someone who has been killed with a sword or someone who has died a natural death, or anyone who touches a human bone or a grave, will be unclean for seven days.

source: Chule hiche athengloupa dinga chu amahon chonset thensona bongla kigona vutvam hochu alahdiu, chule twi longlai toh kongsunga ahaldiu,
target: “For the unclean person, put some ashes from the burned purification offering into a jar and pour fresh water over them.

source: Chutengle mitheng khatnin hyssop alah-a, twija chu adelutna, ponbuh chung le kongho chung jouse le mi aumho chung jouse-a, migu, ahiloule akithat, ahiloule mithi, ahiloule lhankhuh tongkhapa chu athinkhum ding:
target: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to take some hyssop, dip it in the water and sprinkle the tent and all the furnishings and the people who were there. He must also sprinkle anyone who has touched a human bone or a grave or anyone who has been killed or anyone who has died a natural death.

source: Chule mithengpa chun athengloupa chu anithum channi, chule anisagi channile athin khum ding ahi: chule anisagi channi le amajong kisuthenga, avon asopma, atahsa twija kisilngim ding, chule nilhah lam lebou thengding ahi.
target: The man who is clean is to sprinkle those who are unclean on the third and seventh days, and on the seventh day he is to purify them. Those who are being cleansed must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and that evening they will be clean.

source: Ahin mi athenglou, ama le ama kisutheng lou chu, houkhom ho lah-a kona kipaimang ding ahi; ajehchu mipa chu Pakai muntheng asuhboh ahi: achunga kisekhena twi akithin khumlou ahin; amachu athenglou ahi.
target: But if those who are unclean do not purify themselves, they must be cut off from the community, because they have defiled the sanctuary of the Lord . The water of cleansing has not been sprinkled on them, and they are unclean.

source: Chule hichu amaho dinga a-imatih channa dinga chondan hiding ahi. Chule kisekhena twi chapma pangpen pen chun apon akisop ding; chule kisekhena twi tongkha penpen chu anilhah geija aboh-a umding ahi.
target: This is a lasting ordinance for them. “The man who sprinkles the water of cleansing must also wash his clothes, and anyone who touches the water of cleansing will be unclean till evening.

source: Chule ipi hijongle atheng loupan athamkhah tapou chu aboh hiding ahin; chule chuche thil tongkha pa chu nilhah geija bohding ahi.
target: Anything that an unclean person touches becomes unclean, and anyone who touches it becomes unclean till evening.”

source: Chujouvin Israel chate, houkhom ho pumpi ngei chu lha masa sungin Zin gamthip ahung lhungun ahi. Chuin mipi ho chu Kadesh'a gebuh akisonun; chule hia chun Miriam athin, hia chun avuitaovin ahi.
target: In the first month the whole Israelite community arrived at the Desert of Zin, and they stayed at Kadesh. There Miriam died and was buried.

source: Chule hia chun houkhom ho ding twi aumtapon; chuin amaho Mosi le Aaron dounan akikhom khom taovin ahi.
target: Now there was no water for the community, and the people gathered in opposition to Moses and Aaron.

source: Chuin mipin Mosi akinah piuvin, hitin atiuve, Isopihou Pakai angsunga anathi laijuva chu Pathen'in eina thisah-u hitavele!
target: They quarreled with Moses and said, “If only we had died when our brothers fell dead before the Lord !

source: Chule ipidinga keiho le kagancha hou hi hikoma thi dinga, nangman Pakai houkhom ho hi hiche gamthima neipuidoh-u ham?
target: Why did you bring the Lord ’s community into this wilderness, that we and our livestock should die here?

source: Chule ipi dinga keiho hiche gitlouna muna hi puilut dinga Egypt gama kona neihung doh sah-u ham? Hiche hi muchi, thei changho, lengpitheiho, kolbuthei ho mun jong ahipon; twidon ding jeng jong aumpoi, atiuvin ahi.
target: Why did you bring us up out of Egypt to this terrible place? It has no grain or figs, grapevines or pomegranates. And there is no water to drink!”

source: Chuin Mosi le Aaron chu mipi kikhom mitmu tah-a chun houkhom ho houbuh kot lama chun achelhon tan, amai tolla asulut lhonin ahi: chuin Pakai loupina chu ahenguva ahung kilahtan ahi.
target: Moses and Aaron went from the assembly to the entrance to the tent of meeting and fell facedown, and the glory of the Lord appeared to them.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati.
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Tenggol chu kilah-in, chule nangma le nasopipa Aaron'in mipi chu khomkhom lhoninlang, amitmu tah-un songpi jah-a chun thu seilhonin; hichun atwi ahin putdoh sah-a, chutia chu nangman songpi-a kona chu twi naputdoh sah ding ahi. Chutengle nangman houkhom ho le aganchahou twi napeh ding ahi, ati.
target: “Take the staff, and you and your brother Aaron gather the assembly together. Speak to that rock before their eyes and it will pour out its water. You will bring water out of the rock for the community so they and their livestock can drink.”

source: Chuin ama thupeh bangin Mosi'n tenggol chu Pakai angsunga konin akilahtan ahi.
target: So Moses took the staff from the Lord ’s presence, just as he commanded him.

source: Chuin Mosi le Aaron'in houkhom ho chu songpi masanga chun akhom lhonin; chule ajah uva, Tun doumah bolho nanghon ngaijun; hiche songpi-a kona hi twi kalon dohsah teitei lhonding ham? ati lhone.
target: He and Aaron gathered the assembly together in front of the rock and Moses said to them, “Listen, you rebels, must we bring you water out of this rock?”

source: Chuin Mosi'n akhut chu adomsangin, atenggolin songpi chu nivei avon ahi. Chuin twi chu neng jengjungin ahung longdoh tan, hitichun houkhom ho le agancha houvin jong adonun ahi.
target: Then Moses raised his arm and struck the rock twice with his staff. Water gushed out, and the community and their livestock drank.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron jah-a, Nangnin Israel chate mitmu-a suhtheng dinga neitahsan lhonlou jehchun; hiche mihohi keiman kapeh gamsunga chu napuilut lhon louding ahitai, ati.
target: But the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you did not trust in me enough to honor me as holy in the sight of the Israelites, you will not bring this community into the land I give them.”

source: Hiche hi Meribah twi ahi; ajehchu Israel chaten Pakai chu akidou piuvin, chuin Ama amaho-a chun suhthengin aumin ahi.
target: These were the waters of Meribah, where the Israelites quarreled with the Lord and where he was proved holy among them.

source: Chuin Mosi'n thupole ho chu Kadesh'a konin Edom lengpa koma asolin, ahenga, Nasopipa Israel'in hitin aseije, nangman kachunguva lhung hahsatna ho jouse nahesoh keijin:
target: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “This is what your brother Israel says: You know about all the hardships that have come on us.

source: Itobanga kapu kapateu chu Egypt gama anachesuh uva, chule keiho Egypt gama phat sottah kana chennuva; chule Egypt mihon keiho le kapu kapateu einabol genthei danhou;
target: Our ancestors went down into Egypt, and we lived there many years. The Egyptians mistreated us and our ancestors,

source: Chule keihon Pakai henga kapen phatnun, aman ka aw-u ajatan, vantil khat ahin solin, Egypt gama konin eipuidoh-un ahi. Chule ven, keiho Kadesh mun, nagamgi china um khopi khatna kaumuvin ahi.
target: but when we cried out to the Lord , he heard our cry and sent an angel and brought us out of Egypt. “Now we are here at Kadesh, a town on the edge of your territory.

source: Katao ahi, Nagamsung neijot galkaisah-un: keihon loulai ahiloule lengpithei leiho lah kajot loudiu, twikul ho-a twi jong kadon loudiu ahi: lengpa lamlena bou kacheuva, nagamgi sung kagalkai kahseuva jetle veija jong kakihei loudingu ahi, ati.
target: Please let us pass through your country. We will not go through any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will travel along the King’s Highway and not turn to the right or to the left until we have passed through your territory.”

source: Chuin Edom'in ahenga, nahung galkai theilou dingu ahi, achutiloule nangdouna-a chemjam toh kahung konding ahi, ati.
target: But Edom answered: “You may not pass through here; if you try, we will march out and attack you with the sword.”

source: Chuin Israel chate chun ajah-a, Keiho lamlena chu kache dingu ahi: chule ijemtia kei le kagancha hon natwi kadon uva ahile, aman kapeh dingu ahi: imacha dang bollouva kenga bou kache galkai dingu ahi, atiuve.
target: The Israelites replied: “We will go along the main road, and if we or our livestock drink any of your water, we will pay for it. We only want to pass through on foot—nothing else.”

source: Chuin aman, Nagalkai theilou ding ahi, ati. Chuin Edom chu amaho dou dingin mi tamtah le galsatmi hat tahho toh ahung kon taovin ahi.
target: Again they answered: “You may not pass through.” Then Edom came out against them with a large and powerful army.

source: Hitichun Israel gamgi galkaisah ding Edom anomtapon; hijeh chun Israel chu ama-a konin achoma akihei mangtai.
target: Since Edom refused to let them go through their territory, Israel turned away from them.

source: Chuin Israel chate, houkhom ho jouse ngei chu Kadesh'a konin ahung kitolun, Hor molsang ahung lhung taovin ahi.
target: The whole Israelite community set out from Kadesh and came to Mount Hor.

source: Chuin Edom gamgia Hor molsanga chun Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron henga chun aseijin, hitin ati.
target: At Mount Hor, near the border of Edom, the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

source: Aaron amitetoh kigom khom ding ahitai; ajehchu ama Israel chate kana peh gama chu lutlou ding ahi, ajehchu Meribah twija chun kathu dounan nakiphin lhonin ahi.
target: “Aaron will be gathered to his people. He will not enter the land I give the Israelites, because both of you rebelled against my command at the waters of Meribah.

source: Aaron le Achapa Eleazar chu kouvun lang, Hor molsanga hinpui touvin:
target: Get Aaron and his son Eleazar and take them up Mount Hor.

source: Chule Aaron vonho chu sutlhan lang, achapa Eleazar vonpeh-in: chule Aaron amitetoh kigoma khoma, hia chu thiden ding ahi, ati.
target: Remove Aaron’s garments and put them on his son Eleazar, for Aaron will be gathered to his people; he will die there.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Pakai thupeh bangin abolin: houkhom ho jouse mitmu-a chun amaho Hor molsang lama akaltou taovin ahi.
target: Moses did as the Lord commanded: They went up Mount Hor in the sight of the whole community.

source: Chuin Mosi'n Aaron vonho chu asutlhan, achapa Eleazar chu avonpeh-in; chule hiche molsang chunga chun Aaron athitan ahi: Chuin Mosi le Eleazar chu molchunga kon chun ahung kumsuh lhontan ahi.
target: Moses removed Aaron’s garments and put them on his son Eleazar. And Aaron died there on top of the mountain. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain,

source: Chuin houkhom ho chun Aaron thi chu amu phatnun, amaho Israel insung pumpi ngei chun Aaron chu nisomthum alunghem piuvin ahi.
target: and when the whole community learned that Aaron had died, all the Israelites mourned for him thirty days.

source: Chuin lhanglama cheng Canaan mi Arad lengpa chun gam velhi lampia ahunguve tia kisei ajah phatnin; Israel chu akisatpin, amaho lah-a phabep jong gal hingin ahinkaijin ahi.
target: When the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev, heard that Israel was coming along the road to Atharim, he attacked the Israelites and captured some of them.

source: Chuin Israel chu Pakai henga kihahsel in, Tahbeh-a nangman hiche mihohi kakhutna neipeh doh-a ahile, keiman akhopihou kasuhmang hel ding ahi, ati.
target: Then Israel made this vow to the Lord : “If you will deliver these people into our hands, we will totally destroy their cities.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Israel aw chu angaipeh-in, Canaan miho chu akhutna apedoh tan; chuin amahon amaho le akhopi hou chu asumang hel taovin ahi. Chule aman hiche munchu Hormah tin asahtai.
target: The Lord listened to Israel’s plea and gave the Canaanites over to them. They completely destroyed them and their towns; so the place was named Hormah.

source: Chuin amaho Hor molsanga konin Edom gam velkolna dingin twipisan jotna lampi lamchu ajonkit taovin; chule mipi ho chu lampi jeh-in alungu alha lheh jengtan ahi.
target: They traveled from Mount Hor along the route to the Red Sea, to go around Edom. But the people grew impatient on the way;

source: Chuin mipi ho chun Pathen le Mosi dounan thu aseitaovin, Ipi dinga nangnin Egypt gama kon hiche gamthipma thiding gunsetna neipuidoh uham? Ajehchu changlhah jong aumpon, chule twi jongla aumhih-in, kahinna-un hiche changlhah jangthet thut hi akidah tan ahi, atiuve.
target: they spoke against God and against Moses, and said, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? There is no bread! There is no water! And we detest this miserable food!”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin mipi lah-a chun gulgu khohtah ahin lansahtan ahileh, hicheho chun mipi ho achu-in: Israel mi tamtah athitan ahi.
target: Then the Lord sent venomous snakes among them; they bit the people and many Israelites died.

source: Hijeh chun mipi ho chu Mosi henga ahungun, Keihon Pakai le nangma dounan thu kaseijun kachonse taovin ahi; Aman gul hohi keiho lah-a kona alahmang nadingin Pakai henga taovin, atiuve. Chuin Mosi mipi dingin ataotan ahi.
target: The people came to Moses and said, “We sinned when we spoke against the Lord and against you. Pray that the Lord will take the snakes away from us.” So Moses prayed for the people.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Gulse khohtah khat lim seminlang, hichu mol lhon leh-a tahdoh-in, chule hitiding ahi, gul'in achuh tapou chun sum-eng gul chu avetna ahile hingding ahi, ati.
target: The Lord said to Moses, “Make a snake and put it up on a pole; anyone who is bitten can look at it and live.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n sum-eng in gullim khat asemin, hichu mol lhon leh-a atah-in, chuin ahitin ahi, gul chun khat tou achuh-a, achuhpa chun sum-eng gullim chu avetteng ahingjin ahi.
target: So Moses made a bronze snake and put it up on a pole. Then when anyone was bitten by a snake and looked at the bronze snake, they lived.

source: Chuin Israel chate chu akitollun, Oboth munna pon-in akison taovin ahi.
target: The Israelites moved on and camped at Oboth.

source: Amaho Oboth'a konin akitolun, Moab toh kigalsai nisolam Ije-abarim gamthipma pon-in akisonun ahi.
target: Then they set out from Oboth and camped in Iye Abarim, in the wilderness that faces Moab toward the sunrise.

source: Hichea konchun amaho akichonun, Zared phaichama pon-in akisonun ahi.
target: From there they moved on and camped in the Zered Valley.

source: Hichea konchun amaho akichonun, gamthipma um, Amor mite gamsunga kona hungdoh Arnon gal langkhat lama chun pon-in akisonun ahi. Ajeh chu Arnon hi Moab le Amor kikah-a um Moab gamgi ahi.
