target: They set out from there and camped alongside the Arnon, which is in the wilderness extending into Amorite territory. The Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai galsatnaho lekhabu sunga, Aman twipisan le Arnon vachaho-a athilbol,
target: That is why the Book of the Wars of the Lord says: “…Zahab in Suphah and the ravines, the Arnon

source: Chule Moab gamgia um Ar chenna mun'a lunglha vachaho-a athilbol, tin akisunin ahi.
target: and the slopes of the ravines that lead to the settlement of Ar and lie along the border of Moab.”

source: Chuin hichea konchun amaho Beer'a achetouvun ahi: hichemun chu Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Miho chu khom khomin, chule keiman amaho chu twi kapeh ding ahi, tia aseina twikhuh chu ahi.
target: From there they continued on to Beer, the well where the Lord said to Moses, “Gather the people together and I will give them water.”

source: Chuphatnin Israel ten hiche la hi asaovin; Vo twikul, twiput sah-in, nanghon ahenga la saovin:
target: Then Israel sang this song: “Spring up, O well! Sing about it,

source: Danthu pepa thupeh dungjuijin, atenggolun pipuihon twikhuh alaijun, miloupi hon twikhuh alaijun ahi. Chuin amaho gamthipma konin Mattahan'a achetauve ahi.
target: about the well that the princes dug, that the nobles of the people sank— the nobles with scepters and staffs.” Then they went from the wilderness to Mattanah,

source: Chuin Mattanah'a konin Nahaliel: chule Nahaliel'a konin Bamoth:
target: from Mattanah to Nahaliel, from Nahaliel to Bamoth,

source: Chule Moab gamsunga phaichama um Bamoth'a konin Jeshimon kimu phahna Pisgah molvum alhungun ahi.
target: and from Bamoth to the valley in Moab where the top of Pisgah overlooks the wasteland.

source: Chuin Israel ten Amor mite lengpa Sihon koma thupo ho asolun, ajah-a,
target: Israel sent messengers to say to Sihon king of the Amorites:

source: Nagamsung neijot galkai sah-un; keiho loulai le lengpilei laija kakiheilut loudiu; twikhuh-a twiho jong kadon loudiu: gamgi kakhelto kahseuva lengpa lamlen bou kajot dingu ahi, atiuvin ahi.
target: “Let us pass through your country. We will not turn aside into any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will travel along the King’s Highway until we have passed through your territory.”

source: Chule Sihon'in Israelte chu gamsung agalkai diu chu aphaltapon; ahin Sihon'in amite jouse akhom khomin, gamthipma Israel sat dingin akontan ahi. Chuin ama Jahaz'a ahungin, Israelte toh akisattai.
target: But Sihon would not let Israel pass through his territory. He mustered his entire army and marched out into the wilderness against Israel. When he reached Jahaz, he fought with Israel.

source: Chuin Israel ten amachu chemjamin athat uvin; agam chu Arnon'a pat Jabbok gei, Ammon chate gam geijin alotaovin ahi. Ajeh chu Ammon chate gamgi chu hat tah ahi.
target: Israel, however, put him to the sword and took over his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, but only as far as the Ammonites, because their border was fortified.

source: Chuin Israel ten hiche khopi ho chu alauvin; chule Israelte chu Amor miho khopi jouse, chule Heshbon le akhoneo jouseuva acheng taovin ahi.
target: Israel captured all the cities of the Amorites and occupied them, including Heshbon and all its surrounding settlements.

source: Heshbon hi Moab leng masapa galla anasatna, agam jouse Arnon geija akhutna kona analahpeh-a Amor mite lengpa Sihon khopi ahi.
target: Heshbon was the city of Sihon king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab and had taken from him all his land as far as the Arnon.

source: Hijeh chun amahon thuchih-in aseijun, Heshbon'a hungun, Sihon khopi kigong henlang kisahen:
target: That is why the poets say: “Come to Heshbon and let it be rebuilt; let Sihon’s city be restored.

source: Ajehchu Heshbon'a konin mei ahungkan, Sihon khopi-a konin meikou ahung kongdoh-in; hichun Moab gama um Ar, chule Arnon munsanga pakaiho chu akavamtan ahi.
target: “Fire went out from Heshbon, a blaze from the city of Sihon. It consumed Ar of Moab, the citizens of Arnon’s heights.

source: Moab, nangma ada nahi! Vo Chemosh mite amangthah nahitaove: aman asohcha achapateho le achanute chu Amor mite lengpa Sihon henga gal hinga kaidin apetan ahi.
target: Woe to you, Moab! You are destroyed, people of Chemosh! He has given up his sons as fugitives and his daughters as captives to Sihon king of the Amorites.

source: Keihon amaho kakapmun; Heshbon chu Dibon geijin amangthah tan, chule keihon Medeba lhunna Nophah geijin kamhellin kalha taove, tin aseijun ahi.
target: “But we have overthrown them; Heshbon’s dominion has been destroyed all the way to Dibon. We have demolished them as far as Nophah, which extends to Medeba.”

source: Hitichun Israelte chu Amor miho gama acheng taovin ahi.
target: So Israel settled in the land of the Amorites.

source: Chuin Mosi'n Jaazer velhiding mi asoldoh-in, chule amahon hiche khoho chu alauvin, chua cheng Amor miho chu anodoh taovin ahi.
target: After Moses had sent spies to Jazer, the Israelites captured its surrounding settlements and drove out the Amorites who were there.

source: Chuin amaho ahung kile kitnun Bashan jotna lampia akaltouvun ahi. Chuin Bashan lengpa Og chu amaho satdin, amale amite jousetoh Edrei galmuna galsatdin ahung kondoh taovin ahi.
target: Then they turned and went up along the road toward Bashan, and Og king of Bashan and his whole army marched out to meet them in battle at Edrei.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Amakhu kicha hih-in: ajehchu keiman amale amite jouse, chule agam khu nakhutna kapeh doh ahitai; nangman amakhu Heshbon'a um Amor mite lengpa Sihon nabolna bang banga nabolding ahi, ati.
target: The Lord said to Moses, “Do not be afraid of him, for I have delivered him into your hands, along with his whole army and his land. Do to him what you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon.”

source: Hijeh chun amahon amale achapate chule amiteho jouse chu khatcha jong ahing doh abeihel kahsen athatgamun ahi: chuin amahon agam chu alotaovin ahi.
target: So they struck him down, together with his sons and his whole army, leaving them no survivors. And they took possession of his land.

source: Chuin Israel chaten malam anouvin, Jericho kom Jordan gal Moab phaichama chun gebuh akison taovin ahi.
target: Then the Israelites traveled to the plains of Moab and camped along the Jordan across from Jericho.

source: Chuin Zipper chapa Balak chun Israel ten Amor miho chunga anabol jouse chu amusoh keijin ahi.
target: Now Balak son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites,

source: Chuin Moab chun miho chu atamjeh-un akicha lheh jengtan: chule Moab miho chu Israel chate jeh-in alungu athoilheh jengtan ahi.
target: and Moab was terrified because there were so many people. Indeed, Moab was filled with dread because of the Israelites.

source: Chuin Moab'in Midian upaho henga chun, Tu-a hi bongchalin loujaova hampa aneh jouhel banga, hiche mihonpi hin iveluva umjouse hi aneh jouhel dingu ahi, ati. Chule chuphat laija chu Zippor chapa Balak hi Moab mite lengpa hija ahi.
target: The Moabites said to the elders of Midian, “This horde is going to lick up everything around us, as an ox licks up the grass of the field.” So Balak son of Zippor, who was king of Moab at that time,

source: Hijeh chun aman ama miho chate gam, vapi panga um Pethor kho-a Boer chapa Balaam koudin sotol ho asolin, ahenga, Vetan Egypt gama kon hungpot doh mihon khat aume: ven, amahon leiset chung alodimun, chule amaho keimatoh kimaito tah-in aumuve;
target: sent messengers to summon Balaam son of Beor, who was at Pethor, near the Euphrates River, in his native land. Balak said: “A people has come out of Egypt; they cover the face of the land and have settled next to me.

source: Hijeh chun tun, katao ahi, keiman amahohi kajo-a, katha gamuva, hiche gama kona kadelmang thei nadingun, hungin lang hiche mihohi hung gaosapmin; ajehchu amahohi keima dingin ahatbeh seh-un ahi: ijeh inem itile nangman phatthei naboh mi chu phatthei achangin, koihile nagaosap mi chu gaosap achange ti kahei.
target: Now come and put a curse on these people, because they are too powerful for me. Perhaps then I will be able to defeat them and drive them out of the land. For I know that whoever you bless is blessed, and whoever you curse is cursed.”

source: Chuin Moab upaho le Midian upaho chun aisan kipa manding hochu achoijun, akipat doh-un, Balaam henga ahungun, Balak thusei chu ajah-a asei taovin ahi.
target: The elders of Moab and Midian left, taking with them the fee for divination. When they came to Balaam, they told him what Balak had said.

source: Chuin aman amaho koma, Tujan hikoma hin geh-un lang, Pakaiyin keima koma aseibang bangin keiman nangho koma thu hinpokit nange ati. Hitichun Moab puiho chu Balaam toh agehkhom taovin ahi.
target: “Spend the night here,” Balaam said to them, “and I will report back to you with the answer the Lord gives me.” So the Moabite officials stayed with him.

source: Chuin Pathen chu Balaam henga ahungin, ajah-a, Naum khompi miho khu koi hiuvem? ati.
target: God came to Balaam and asked, “Who are these men with you?”

source: Chuin Balaam'in Pathen henga, Moab lengpa Zippor chapa Balak-in kahenga ahinsola,
target: Balaam said to God, “Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, sent me this message:

source: Ven, Egypt gama kona hungpot doh-a leiset chung lodima mihon khat aumuve: Tun hungin lang amahohi eihung gaosap peh-in, keiman amaho kajo-a, kadeldoh jou thei khat le gatin tia ahinsol ahi, ati.
target: ‘A people that has come out of Egypt covers the face of the land. Now come and put a curse on them for me. Perhaps then I will be able to fight them and drive them away.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Balaam jah-a, Nangma amaho hitoh nakilhon louding; chule nangman hiche mihohi nagaosap louding ahi; ajehchu amaho phattheiboh chang ahiuve, ati.
target: But God said to Balaam, “Do not go with them. You must not put a curse on those people, because they are blessed.”

source: Chuin jingkah-in Balaam athoudoh-in, Balak pipuiho jah-a, Nagam lamuva kilekit taovin; ajehchu nangho toh lhonkhoma chedingin Pakaiyin eija nompoi, tin aseitan ahi.
target: The next morning Balaam got up and said to Balak’s officials, “Go back to your own country, for the Lord has refused to let me go with you.”

source: Chuin Moab pipuiho chu akipat doh-un, Balak henglama acheuvin, Balaam keihotoh hungding anompoi, agatiuve.
target: So the Moabite officials returned to Balak and said, “Balaam refused to come with us.”

source: Chuin Balak in pipuiho amaho sanga ja-umtah cheh asolkit nalaijin ahi.
target: Then Balak sent other officials, more numerous and more distinguished than the first.

source: Chuin amaho Balaam henga ahungun, ahengah, Zippor chapa Balak'in hitin aseije, Katao ahi, kahenga nahung nadingin imacha kidal tansah hih-in;
target: They came to Balaam and said: “This is what Balak son of Zippor says: Do not let anything keep you from coming to me,

source: Ajehchu keiman nangma jana lentah kapeh-a kachoi sang ding, chule nangman kahenga nasei chan chu kabolding ahi: hijeh chun hungin lang hiche mitehi neihung gaosap peh-in, atie atiuve.
target: because I will reward you handsomely and do whatever you say. Come and put a curse on these people for me.”

source: Chuin Balaam'in Balak sohte henga chun adonbutnin ajah uva, Balak'in a-in dimset sana dangka eipeh ding hijongle, keima Pakai ka Pathen thu kalvalin tamtah bolding hihen, lhomcha bolding hijongle che ponge;
target: But Balaam answered them, “Even if Balak gave me all the silver and gold in his palace, I could not do anything great or small to go beyond the command of the Lord my God.

source: Hijeh chun tun, naheng uva katao ahi, Pakaiyin kahenga ipi aseibe-am kahet theina dingin, tujan jong hi-ah geh kitnun, ati.
target: Now spend the night here so that I can find out what else the Lord will tell me.”

source: Chuin jan-in Pathen chu Balaam henga ahungin, ajah-a, Miho chu nangma kou-a hung ahiule kipat in lang amahotoh kilhonin, amavang keiman nahenga kasei thubou chu nabol ding ahi, ati.
target: That night God came to Balaam and said, “Since these men have come to summon you, go with them, but do only what I tell you.”

source: Chuin Balaam jingkah-in athoudoh in, asangan pho asepdoh in, Moab pipuiho chutoh alhontai.
target: Balaam got up in the morning, saddled his donkey and went with the Moabite officials.

source: Chuin ama ache jehchun Pathen lungsat asoujahtan: Pakai Vantil chu ama douna-a kimaitopi din lampia chun anadingtan ahi. Hichepet nahi ama sangan chunga touva, asoh minin akilhonpi ahi.
target: But God was very angry when he went, and the angel of the Lord stood in the road to oppose him. Balaam was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

source: Chuin sangan chun Pakai Vantil khatnin akhutna chemjam achoija lampia adin amutan ahi; chuin sangan chu lamsih lama akiheidoh-in, loulai langa achetan ahi. Chuin Balaam'in sangan chu lampia heilutna din avon ahi.
target: When the donkey saw the angel of the Lord standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand, it turned off the road into a field. Balaam beat it to get it back on the road.

source: Ahin Pakai Vantil chu alang teni-a bang umgel lengpilei lampia chun ana dingin ahi.
target: Then the angel of the Lord stood in a narrow path through the vineyards, with walls on both sides.

source: Chuin sangan nin Pakai Vantil chu amuphatnin bang suhnan akineijin, Balaam kengchu bang toh atat cheptan ahile, aman avokitnin ahi.
target: When the donkey saw the angel of the Lord , it pressed close to the wall, crushing Balaam’s foot against it. So he beat the donkey again.

source: Chuin Pakai Vantil chu ache gamla jepmin, jetle vei akiheina ding lampi umlou munneo laitah khatna anading tan ahi.
target: Then the angel of the Lord moved on ahead and stood in a narrow place where there was no room to turn, either to the right or to the left.

source: Chuin sangan chun Pakai Vantil chu amuphatnin, Balaam noija a-optan ahi. Chuin Balaam lungsat chu akoujah tan, aman sangan chu tenggolin avon ahi.
target: When the donkey saw the angel of the Lord , it lay down under Balaam, and he was angry and beat it with his staff.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin sangan chu ahin paosah-in, aman Balaam jah-a, Keiman nangma chunga ipi kabola hitia hi thumveijen neivoh ham? ati.
target: Then the Lord opened the donkey’s mouth, and it said to Balaam, “What have I done to you to make you beat me these three times?”

source: Chuin Balaam'in sangan jah-achun, Nangin neidai chatvai jeh ahi, kakhutna chemjam umlebon kathading nahi, ati.
target: Balaam answered the donkey, “You have made a fool of me! If only I had a sword in my hand, I would kill you right now.”

source: Chuin sangan chun Balaam henga, Keima nasangan kahilou hija, nanga kahia patna tuni chan geija kachunga nahung tou jing hilouham? hitobanga hi masanga nachunga kanabol khah-em? ati. Chuin aman, Nabolkhapoi, ati.
target: The donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your own donkey, which you have always ridden, to this day? Have I been in the habit of doing this to you?” “No,” he said.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Balaam mit ahadohsah-in ahile, aman Pakai Vantil lampia adina akhutna chemjam adopchu amutan ahi. Chuin ama akunin, tolla aboh khupmin chibai aboh tan ahi.
target: Then the Lord opened Balaam’s eyes, and he saw the angel of the Lord standing in the road with his sword drawn. So he bowed low and fell facedown.

source: Chuin Pakai Vantil chun ajah-a, Ipi dinga nangman sangan chu thumvei jen navoh ham? Ven, nalampi hi kamitmu-a akaleh lam ahi jeh-a, nangma lamtin dinga hungkon doh-a kahi;
target: The angel of the Lord asked him, “Why have you beaten your donkey these three times? I have come here to oppose you because your path is a reckless one before me.

source: Ahin sangan chun keima eimu-a, keija kona thumveijen kihei doh ahin, ama kiheidoh lou hile tu-a hi thonlouva nangma katha-a ama kahinghoi ding ahi, ati.
target: The donkey saw me and turned away from me these three times. If it had not turned away, I would certainly have killed you by now, but I would have spared it.”

source: Chuin Balaam'in Pakai Vantil hengah, Keima kachonse tai: ajehchu keiman douna-a lampia nadinna nei lamtin chu kahetlou ahi. Hijeh chun tun, hiche nangma lunglhai louna ahile, keima kilekit tange, ati.
target: Balaam said to the angel of the Lord , “I have sinned. I did not realize you were standing in the road to oppose me. Now if you are displeased, I will go back.”

source: Chuin Pakai Vantil chun Balaam henga, Miho khutoh lhonin, amavang keiman kaseipeh ding thubou chu nasei ding ahi, ati. Hitichun Balaam chu Balak pipuiho chutoh alhontan ahi.
target: The angel of the Lord said to Balaam, “Go with the men, but speak only what I tell you.” So Balaam went with Balak’s officials.

source: Chuin Balak in Balaam hungchu ajah phatnin, Arnon gamgi mong lhapeh-a um Moab khopi khatna ana kimutopi dingin ahungdoh-in ahi.
target: When Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went out to meet him at the Moabite town on the Arnon border, at the edge of his territory.

source: Chuin Balak'in Balaam henga, Keiman nangma kou dinga lungnem tah-a mi kahinsol hilouham? Ipi dinga kahenga hunglou nahim? Keiman nangmahi ja-um tah-a katunmo-a nabol ham? ati.
target: Balak said to Balaam, “Did I not send you an urgent summons? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I really not able to reward you?”

source: Chuin Balaam'in Balak henga, Ven, keima nahenga kahungtai; keiman tu-a hi ipi hijongle seina ding tha kaneibeh-em? Pathen'in kakama akhum thu bou chu kaseiding ahi, ati.
target: “Well, I have come to you now,” Balaam replied. “But I can’t say whatever I please. I must speak only what God puts in my mouth.”

source: Chuin Balaam chu Balak toh akilhonin, Kirjath-huzoth'a ahunglhon tan ahi.
target: Then Balaam went with Balak to Kiriath Huzoth.

source: Chuin Balak'in bongchal ho le kelngoi ho atohdoh-in, Balaam le aumpi pipuiho henga chun athot tan ahi.
target: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and gave some to Balaam and the officials who were with him.

source: Chuin ajingin ahitin ahi, Balak'in Balaam chu apuijin, mipi ho jouse amutheina dingin, Baal munsang ho-a chun apuitou tan ahi.
target: The next morning Balak took Balaam up to Bamoth Baal, and from there he could see the outskirts of the Israelite camp.

source: Chuin Balaam'in Balak henga, Hikomahin keima dingin maicham sagi seminlang, chule bongchal sagi le kelngoichal sagi neigot peh-in, ati.
target: Balaam said, “Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me.”

source: Chuin Balaam'in aseibang chun Balak'in aboltan: Balak le Balaam chun maicham chung tinna chun bongchal khat le kelngoichal khat atohdoh lhontan ahi.
target: Balak did as Balaam said, and the two of them offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

source: Chuin Balaam'in Balak henga, Nagovam thilpeh koma hin ding jingin, keima kimupi dinga Pakai ahung khattoule, keima gacheng ting, chule aman eimusah tapou chu seipeh nange, ati. Chuin ama munsang khatna achetan ahi.
target: Then Balaam said to Balak, “Stay here beside your offering while I go aside. Perhaps the Lord will come to meet with me. Whatever he reveals to me I will tell you.” Then he went off to a barren height.

source: Chuin Pathen'in Balaam akimupin ahi. Chuin aman ahenga, Keiman maicham sagi kagongin, maicham jouse chunga chun bongchal khatle kelngoichal khat cheh katoh-in ahi, ati.
target: God met with him, and Balaam said, “I have prepared seven altars, and on each altar I have offered a bull and a ram.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Balaam kamsunga thu akoipeh-in, ajah-a, Balak henga kilekit ninlang, gaseipeh in, ati.
target: The Lord put a word in Balaam’s mouth and said, “Go back to Balak and give him this word.”

source: Chuin ama ahenga akile kitnin ahile, veuvin ama le Moab pipuiho jouse chu govam ganlhaina koma chun anadingun ahi.
target: So he went back to him and found him standing beside his offering, with all the Moabite officials.

source: Chuin aman athulemin thu aseipaijin, hitin ati, Moab lengpa Balak'in Aram gam solamsang molsang ho-a konin eihin puijin, kajah-a, Hungin lang Jacob neihung gaosappeh-in, hungin lang Israel hung chouvin, ati.
target: Then Balaam spoke his message: “Balak brought me from Aram, the king of Moab from the eastern mountains. ‘Come,’ he said, ‘curse Jacob for me; come, denounce Israel.’

source: Pathen'in agaosap louho chu ken iti kagaosap dingham? ahiloule Pakaiyin achoulou chu ken iti kachou ding ham?
target: How can I curse those whom God has not cursed? How can I denounce those whom the Lord has not denounced?

source: Ajehchu keiman songpiho chungvuma konin ama kamun, chule lhang ho-a konin ama chu kaven ahi: veuvin, mipichu achanguva chengdio, namtin lah-a kisim thei louding ahiuve.
target: From the rocky peaks I see them, from the heights I view them. I see a people who live apart and do not consider themselves one of the nations.

source: Koiham Jacob leivui simjou ding le Israelte hoplia hopkhat simjou dinga? michonpha thin neithisah inlang, kahinkho bei danjong ama-a tobang hihen, ati.
target: Who can count the dust of Jacob or number even a fourth of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and may my final end be like theirs!”

source: Chuin Balak'in Balaam jah-a, Kachunga hi ipi nabol hitam? Keiman kamelmate gaosap dinga kapui nahin, ahin, vetan, nangman amaho phatthei naboh jotan ahi, ati.
target: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I brought you to curse my enemies, but you have done nothing but bless them!”

source: Chuin aman adonbutnin, Pakaiyin kakama eikhumpeh hohi kaseidoh nadinga kachihthei ngailou dingham? ati.
target: He answered, “Must I not speak what the Lord puts in my mouth?”

source: Chuin Balak'in ajah-a, Katao ahi, hungin, chukoma kona chu amaho namuthei nadin, keimatoh munchom khatna che hite; chua kona chu nangman apamnung pen hobou namu ding, abonchauva namulou ding ahin, amaho chu keima-a dingin neigaosap peh-in, ati.
target: Then Balak said to him, “Come with me to another place where you can see them; you will not see them all but only the outskirts of their camp. And from there, curse them for me.”

source: Chuin aman ama chu Sophim loulai, Pisgah molsang vuma chun apuijin; chule maicham sagi asemin, chule bongchal khat le kelngoichal khatcheh maicham takip chunga atoh-in ahi.
target: So he took him to the field of Zophim on the top of Pisgah, and there he built seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

source: Chuin aman Balak henga, Keima Pakai to gallanga kakimuto laisen, nangma govam thilto phunga ding jingin, ati.
target: Balaam said to Balak, “Stay here beside your offering while I meet with him over there.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Balaam akimupin, akama thu akhumpeh-in, ajah-a, Balak henga chekitnin lang, hitin seijin ati.
target: The Lord met with Balaam and put a word in his mouth and said, “Go back to Balak and give him this word.”

source: Chuin ama ahenga ahunga ahile, veuvin, ama thilto phunga chun Moab pipui hotoh anadingun ahi. Chuin Balak'in ahenga, Pakaiyin ipi aseijem? ati.
target: So he went to him and found him standing beside his offering, with the Moabite officials. Balak asked him, “What did the Lord say?”

source: Chuin aman thulem aseipanin, hitin ati, Kipatdoh-in Balak, ngaijin; nangma Zippor chapa, kathusei hi ngaijin:
target: Then he spoke his message: “Arise, Balak, and listen; hear me, son of Zippor.

source: Pathen chu jou seiji-a mihem ahipon; chule lungheiji-a mihem chapa jong ahipoi; Aman aseisa chu abolda dingham? ahiloule aseidohsa chu abolphat lou dingham?
target: God is not human, that he should lie, not a human being, that he should change his mind. Does he speak and then not act? Does he promise and not fulfill?

source: Vetan, keiman phatthei bohna ding thupeh kamutan' chule aman phatthei aboh ahitan, keiman lehei thei ponge.
target: I have received a command to bless; he has blessed, and I cannot change it.

source: Aman Jacob khangitlouna, chule Israel'a jong chonvalna amupoi: Pakai a-Pathen chun aumpin, chule lengpa khosap awgin chu alah uva aumin ahi.
target: “No misfortune is seen in Jacob, no misery observed in Israel. The Lord their God is with them; the shout of the King is among them.

source: Pathen'in amaho chu Egypt'a kona ahin puidoh ahin; aman sakol kinei thahat tobang aneijin ahi.
target: God brought them out of Egypt; they have the strength of a wild ox.

source: Jacob douna ding themthu aumpon, chule Israel douna dingin aisan theina jong aumpoi: Tu-a hi Jacob le Israel thudola Pathen'in ipi abol hitam! kiti ding ahi.
target: There is no divination against Jacob, no evil omens against Israel. It will now be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘See what God has done!’

source: Vetan, hiche mite hi keipi bahkai lentah banga thoudoh dingu, keipi bahkai khangdong banga dingdoh ding ahi: aman a-anchah aneh masangse le asatha thisan adon masangse-a kol louding ahi, ati.
target: The people rise like a lioness; they rouse themselves like a lion that does not rest till it devours its prey and drinks the blood of its victims.”

source: Chuin Balak'in Balaam henga, Amaho hi gaosap jong gaosap hih-in, phatthei jong phatthei boh hih-in, ati.
target: Then Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all nor bless them at all!”

source: Ahivangin Balaam'in Balak adonbutnin, Pakaiyin asei jouse chu kaboltei ding ahi, tia kaseipeh nahilou ham? ati.
target: Balaam answered, “Did I not tell you I must do whatever the Lord says?”

source: Chuin Balak'in Balaam henga, Hungin, katao ahi, munchom khatna napui jing kate; chua konchun amaho neigaosap peh lechun Pathen lunglhai maithei ding ahi, ati.
target: Then Balak said to Balaam, “Come, let me take you to another place. Perhaps it will please God to let you curse them for me from there.”

source: Chuin Balak'in Balaam chu Jeshimon lam kimuna Peor molsang vuma apuijin ahi.
target: And Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, overlooking the wasteland.

source: Chuin Balaam'in Balak henga, Hikoma hin maicham sagi neigon peh-in lang, kelngoichal sagi gotsan neikoi peh-in, ati.
target: Balaam said, “Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me.”

source: Chuin Balak'in Balaam seibang chun abolin, maicham takip chunga chun bongchal khat cheh le kelngoichal khat cheh atohtan ahi.
target: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

source: Chuin Balaam'in Israel chapate phatthei abohding chu Pakai lungdei ahi, ti ahet phatnin, phatdang bangin themthu holin achedoh tapon, gamthip lam johchu amaingat tan ahi.
target: Now when Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord to bless Israel, he did not resort to divination as at other times, but turned his face toward the wilderness.

source: Chuin Balaam akhodah-in ahile, Israel chu aphung dungjui cheh-a agebuh uva aumu amun ahi, chuin Pathen lhagao chu achunga ahung chutan ahi.
target: When Balaam looked out and saw Israel encamped tribe by tribe, the Spirit of God came on him

source: Chuin aman athulem aseipanin, hitin ati, Boer chapa Balaam thuseidoh; amit kihadoh sahpa thuseidoh:
target: and he spoke his message: “The prophecy of Balaam son of Beor, the prophecy of one whose eye sees clearly,

source: Pathen thuho ja-a, hat chungnungpa gaothilmu-a mupa, kipal lhu-a ahivanga amit hahjingpa thuseidoh ho:
target: the prophecy of one who hears the words of God, who sees a vision from the Almighty, who falls prostrate, and whose eyes are opened:

source: Vo Jacob, naponbuh ho iti hoi hitam! Chule vo Israel, nahoubuh ho iti hoi hitam!
target: “How beautiful are your tents, Jacob, your dwelling places, Israel!

source: Phaicham bangin akiphajal deh-in, vadung panga honleiho abangin; Pakai phudoh Aloes thingphung hole, twipanga Cedar thingphung ho toh abangin ahi.
target: “Like valleys they spread out, like gardens beside a river, like aloes planted by the Lord , like cedars beside the waters.

source: Aman atwibel ho-a konin twi hinbung lhantin, achilhahte chu twi tampi lah-a umdiu; alengpa jong Agag sanga sangjo ding, chule alenggam chu kichoisang ding ahi.
target: Water will flow from their buckets; their seed will have abundant water. “Their king will be greater than Agag; their kingdom will be exalted.

source: Pathen'in ama Egypt gama kona ahin puidoh ahin, aman sakol kinei thahat tobang aneijin ahi: akidoupi namtin vaipiho anehjou ding, aguhou ahe ngema, athalchanga athilpai dingu ahi.
target: “God brought them out of Egypt; they have the strength of a wild ox. They devour hostile nations and break their bones in pieces; with their arrows they pierce them.

source: Ama aboh-in, keipi bahkai bangin, chule keipi bahkai lentah bangin akole: kon ama asuhthou ngam ding ham? Nangman phatthei naboh chan phatthei changhen lang, nagaosap chan chu gaosap changhen, ati.
target: Like a lion they crouch and lie down, like a lioness—who dares to rouse them? “May those who bless you be blessed and those who curse you be cursed!”

source: Chuin Balaam chunga chun Balak lungsat akoujahtan, akhut teni abengton ahi: chuin Balak'in Balaam jah-a, Kamelmate gaosap dinga kakou nahin; ahin, vetan, nangman amaho thumvei jen hi phatthei nabohtan ahi.
target: Then Balak’s anger burned against Balaam. He struck his hands together and said to him, “I summoned you to curse my enemies, but you have blessed them these three times.

source: Hijeh chun tun naumna lama jamtan: keiman jana lentah chang dinga tundoh kagot nahin; ahivangin, vetan Pakaiyin nangma jabola naumna dinga konin natingtan tan ahi, ati.
target: Now leave at once and go home! I said I would reward you handsomely, but the Lord has kept you from being rewarded.”

source: Chuin Balaam'in Balak henga, Kahenga nahinsol miho henga jong kaseisa hitalou ham?
target: Balaam answered Balak, “Did I not tell the messengers you sent me,

source: Balak'in keima sana dangka a-in dimsetna eipeh ding hijongle, Pakai thupeh kalvala kachama aphabolna hihen, asebolna ding hijongle kabollou ding ahi; amavang Pakaiyin aseiho bouchu kaseiding ahi, kati hilou ham?
target: ‘Even if Balak gave me all the silver and gold in his palace, I could not do anything of my own accord, good or bad, to go beyond the command of the Lord —and I must say only what the Lord says’?

source: Chule tun, vetan keima kamite henga kache ding ahitai; hijeh chun hungin, hiche miho hin ni nunung nile namite henga ahin thilbol dinghou chu seipeh-inge, ati.
target: Now I am going back to my people, but come, let me warn you of what this people will do to your people in days to come.”

source: Chuin aman athulem aseipanin, hitin ati, Beor chapa Balaam thusei ho, chule amit kihadoh sahpan thusei ho:
target: Then he spoke his message: “The prophecy of Balaam son of Beor, the prophecy of one whose eye sees clearly,

source: Pathen thupeh ho japa le chungnung pen hetna thudol hepa, hat chungnung pen gaothilmu-a mupa, kipal lhu-a ahivanga hahjingpa thuseidoh ho:
target: the prophecy of one who hears the words of God, who has knowledge from the Most High, who sees a vision from the Almighty, who falls prostrate, and whose eyes are opened:

source: Keiman ama chu kamuding ahin, tuvang hilouding; keiman amachu kavet ding ahin, naicha vang ahipoi: Jacob'a kona Ahsi khat hungdoh-a, Israel lah-a kona leng tenggol khat hung kitungdoh ding; hichun Moab ningkoi ho avoh-a, chule Seth chateho jouse asuhmang ding ahi.
target: “I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob; a scepter will rise out of Israel. He will crush the foreheads of Moab, the skulls of all the people of Sheth.

source: Chule Edom chu chanvou hung hiding, Seir jong amelmateuva dinga chanvou hung hiding ahi: chule Israel ten hangsan tah-a aboldingu ahi.
target: Edom will be conquered; Seir, his enemy, will be conquered, but Israel will grow strong.

source: Lengvai podingpa chu Jacob'a kona hungdoh-a, khopi-a umdenpa chu asuhmang ding ahi, ati.
target: A ruler will come out of Jacob and destroy the survivors of the city.”

source: Chuin aman Amalek lam aven athulem aseipanin, hitin ati, Amalek hi chitin namtin bulpi ahinan, amavang akichaina ding chu tonsotna manthah na hiding ahi, ati.
target: Then Balaam saw Amalek and spoke his message: “Amalek was first among the nations, but their end will be utter destruction.”

source: Chuin aman Ken miteho aven, athulem aseipanin, hitin ati, Nachenna mun chu dettah ahin, nabuh chu songpi chunga nakiset in ahi:
target: Then he saw the Kenites and spoke his message: “Your dwelling place is secure, your nest is set in a rock;

source: Hijeng jongle Asshur'in gal hinga nakaimang kahse-a, Ken chu suhsetna umding ahi, ati.
target: yet you Kenites will be destroyed when Ashur takes you captive.”

source: Chuin aman athulem aseikitnin, Ohe! Pathen'in hitia hi ahinbol tengle, koi hingjou tantem!
target: Then he spoke his message: “Alas! Who can live when God does this?

source: Chule Chittim gamkaija konin kong inneiho hunguntin, Asshur le Eber chu asuh gentheidiu, chule amajong a-itih-a dinga mangthah ding ahi, ati.
target: Ships will come from the shores of Cyprus; they will subdue Ashur and Eber, but they too will come to ruin.”

source: Chuin Balaam akipatdoh-in, aumna lama akile kit tai. Chule Balak jong alampia achetan ahi.
target: Then Balaam got up and returned home, and Balak went his own way.

source: Chuin Israelte chu Shittima achengun, chule miho chun Moab chanute toh jonthanhoi abolpan taovin ahi.
target: While Israel was staying in Shittim, the men began to indulge in sexual immorality with Moabite women,

source: Chuin amaho chun Israelte chu a-pathen hou ganlhaina-a akoutaovin; chule miho chun aneovin, a-pathenhou anga abohkhup taovin ahi.
target: who invited them to the sacrifices to their gods. The people ate the sacrificial meal and bowed down before these gods.

source: Chuin Israel chun Baal-Peor chu ajoptan ahile, Pakai lungsat chu Israel chunga akongjah tan ahi.
target: So Israel yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor. And the Lord ’s anger burned against them.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga, Mipi lamkaiho jouse chu puijin lang, tijat umtah Pakai lungsatna chu Israel te-a kona akichon mangtheina dingin, Pakai masang nisanoi tah-a khailih-in ati.
target: The Lord said to Moses, “Take all the leaders of these people, kill them and expose them in broad daylight before the Lord , so that the Lord ’s fierce anger may turn away from Israel.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Israel thutan ho henga, Nangho amitakipmin Baal-Peor jopma amite jousechu that cheh hen, ati.
target: So Moses said to Israel’s judges, “Each of you must put to death those of your people who have yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor.”

source: Chuin veuvin, Israel chate lah-a mi khat ahungin, Mosi mitmule Israel chate houkhom ho houbuh kot maija kapma-um miteho mitmu-a chun Midian mi numei khat asopiho henga ahin puijin ahi.
target: Then an Israelite man brought into the camp a Midianite woman right before the eyes of Moses and the whole assembly of Israel while they were weeping at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

source: Chuin Aaron thempu chapa, Eleazar chapa Phinehas in hichu amuphatnin, houkhom ho lah-a konchun akipatdoh-in, akhutna tengcha khat akichoijin;
target: When Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, the priest, saw this, he left the assembly, took a spear in his hand

source: Chule Israel mipa chu pon in sunga ajuilutnin, anilhonin Israel mipale numeinu chu a-oipi laitah chu asunpai tan ahi. Chutichun Israel lah-a konin hise chu atangtan ahi.
target: and followed the Israelite into the tent. He drove the spear into both of them, right through the Israelite man and into the woman’s stomach. Then the plague against the Israelites was stopped;

source: Chule hiche hise-a thi chu sangsomni toh sangli ahi.
target: but those who died in the plague numbered 24,000.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga aseijin, hitin ahi.
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Aaron thempupa chapa Eleazar chapa Phinehas'in kalung hanna chu Israel te-a konin aheimangin ahi; ajehchu kathangthipna-a Israel chate kasuhmang lounadin, amaho lah-a keiding jal-in athang thipmin ahi.
target: “Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, the priest, has turned my anger away from the Israelites. Since he was as zealous for my honor among them as I am, I did not put an end to them in my zeal.

source: Hijeh chun hitin seijin, Ven kachamna kakitepna chu ama kapetan ahi;
target: Therefore tell him I am making my covenant of peace with him.

source: Chule hichu ama le ama nunga achilhah hon anei dingu, a-itih-a thempu hina dinga kitepna ahi; ajehchu ama a-Pathen'a dingin athang thipmin, Israel chate-a dingin longlhenna chu abolin ahi, ati.
target: He and his descendants will have a covenant of a lasting priesthood, because he was zealous for the honor of his God and made atonement for the Israelites.”

source: Tun akithatna Israel mipa, Midian numei nutoh kithat koppa min chu, Zimri ahin, Salu chapa Simeon miho lah-a insungmi upa khat ahi.
target: The name of the Israelite who was killed with the Midianite woman was Zimri son of Salu, the leader of a Simeonite family.

source: Chule Midian numei akithatnu minchu Cozbi ahin, apa Zur chu mipi chunga lamkai, Midian miho insunga mi upa khat ahi.
target: And the name of the Midianite woman who was put to death was Kozbi daughter of Zur, a tribal chief of a Midianite family.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati.
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Midian ho chu sunohphah inlang, chule sugammin:
target: “Treat the Midianites as enemies and kill them.

source: Ajehchu amahon Peor chungchang le, Peor jeh-a hise lan mikho-a kithat Median pipupa chanu Cozbi le asopinu chungchanga alungthim gilouvun nasunoh phah-un ahi, ati.
target: They treated you as enemies when they deceived you in the Peor incident involving their sister Kozbi, the daughter of a Midianite leader, the woman who was killed when the plague came as a result of that incident.”

source: Chuin hise umjou chun ahitin ahi, Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron thempupa chapa Eleazar henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: After the plague the Lord said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest,

source: Israel chate houkhom ho lah-a konin apu apateo insung kailhah-a, Israelte galsatna konthei cheh kum somni-a pat chunglam sese simdoh lhonin, ati.
target: “Take a census of the whole Israelite community by families—all those twenty years old or more who are able to serve in the army of Israel.”

source: Chuin Mosi le Eleazar thempupan amaho chu Moab phaicham Jordan pang Jericho naija chun akihoupi lhonin,
target: So on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them and said,

source: Pakaiyin Mosi le Egypt gama kona hung potdoh Israel chateho thu apeh bangin, mipi ho kum somni apat chunglamse chu simdoh-un, atilhone.
target: “Take a census of the men twenty years old or more, as the Lord commanded Moses.” These were the Israelites who came out of Egypt:

source: Reuben, Israel chapa lenpen: Reuben chateho chu: Hanoch'a kon Hanoch insung mite ahung kondoh-un: Pallu'a kon Pallu insung mite ahung kondoh-un ahi.
target: The descendants of Reuben, the firstborn son of Israel, were: through Hanok, the Hanokite clan; through Pallu, the Palluite clan;

source: Hezron'a kon Hezron insung mite: Karmi'a kon Karmi insung mite ahiuve.
target: through Hezron, the Hezronite clan; through Karmi, the Karmite clan.

source: Hichengse hi Reuben inko ahiuvin: chule amaho akisimdoh sese chu sangsomli le sangthum toh jasagi le somthum ahiuve.
target: These were the clans of Reuben; those numbered were 43,730.

source: Chule Pallu chapa chu Eliab ahi.
target: The son of Pallu was Eliab,

source: Chule Eliab chapate chu Nemuel, Dathan, chule Abiram ahiuve. Hiche Dathan le Abiram hi ahi houkhom ho lah-a minthang tah Korah le akiloipihon Pakai anelkal laijuva amahoto ana kiloija Mosi le Aaron ana nelkala teni chu.
target: and the sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan and Abiram. The same Dathan and Abiram were the community officials who rebelled against Moses and Aaron and were among Korah’s followers when they rebelled against the Lord .

source: Chule hicheho loi athiu chun leisetnin akam akan, amaho chu Korah toh avallhum than, meijin mi janitoh somnga akalih-in, amaho chu melchihna khatnin ahung pangtaove.
target: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them along with Korah, whose followers died when the fire devoured the 250 men. And they served as a warning sign.

source: Achuti jeng vang chun Korah chate chu athipon ahi.
target: The line of Korah, however, did not die out.

source: Simeon chapate chu insungu dungjuijin: Nemuel'a kon Nemuel insung mite: Jamin'a kon Jamin insung mite: Jachin'a kon Jachin insung mite:
target: The descendants of Simeon by their clans were: through Nemuel, the Nemuelite clan; through Jamin, the Jaminite clan; through Jakin, the Jakinite clan;

source: Zerah'a kon Zerah insung mite: Shaul'a kon Shaul insung mite ahiuve.
target: through Zerah, the Zerahite clan; through Shaul, the Shaulite clan.

source: Hichehohi Simeon insungmiho ahiuvin, Sangsomni le sangni toh jani ahiuve.
target: These were the clans of Simeon; those numbered were 22,200.

source: Gad chateho chu a-insungu dungjuijin: Zephon'a kon Zephon insung mite: Haggi'a kon Haggi insung mite: Shuni'a kon Shuni insung mite:
target: The descendants of Gad by their clans were: through Zephon, the Zephonite clan; through Haggi, the Haggite clan; through Shuni, the Shunite clan;

source: Ozni'a kon Ozni insung mite: Eri'a kon Eri insung mite:
target: through Ozni, the Oznite clan; through Eri, the Erite clan;

source: Arod'a kon Arod insung mite: Arali'a kon Areli insung mite ahiuve.
target: through Arodi, the Arodite clan; through Areli, the Arelite clan.

source: Hiche hohi Gad chate insungmihi akisimdoh dungjuija ahiuvin, Sangsomli toh janga ahiuve.
target: These were the clans of Gad; those numbered were 40,500.

source: Juda chapate chu Er le Onan ahilhonin; chuin Er le Onan chu Canaan gama athilhon tan ahi.
target: Er and Onan were sons of Judah, but they died in Canaan.

source: Chule Juda chapate chu a-insungu dungjuijin: Shelah'a kon Shelah insung mite: Pharez'a kon Pharez insung mite: Zerah'a kon Zerah insung mite ahiuve.
target: The descendants of Judah by their clans were: through Shelah, the Shelanite clan; through Perez, the Perezite clan; through Zerah, the Zerahite clan.

source: Chuleh Pharez chapate chu: Hezron'a kon Hezron insung mite: Hamul'a kon Hamul insung mite ahiuve.
target: The descendants of Perez were: through Hezron, the Hezronite clan; through Hamul, the Hamulite clan.

source: Hiche hohi amaho akisim doh dungjuija Juda insung mite ahiuvin, sangsomsagi le sanggup toh janga ahiuve.
target: These were the clans of Judah; those numbered were 76,500.

source: Issachar chapate chu a-insungu dungjuijin: Tola'a kon Tolla insung mite: Pua'a kon Pua insung mite:
target: The descendants of Issachar by their clans were: through Tola, the Tolaite clan; through Puah, the Puite clan;

source: Jashub'a kon Jashub insung mite: Shimron'a kon Shimron insung mite ahiuve.
target: through Jashub, the Jashubite clan; through Shimron, the Shimronite clan.

source: Hichehohi Issachar insung mite akisimdoh-u dungjuija amijat-u chu ahin, sangsomgup le sangli toh jathum ahiuve.
target: These were the clans of Issachar; those numbered were 64,300.

source: Zebulun chapate chu a-insungu dungjuijin: Sered'a kon Sered insung mite: Elon'a kon Elon insung mite: Jahleel'a kon Jahleel insung mite ahiuve.
target: The descendants of Zebulun by their clans were: through Sered, the Seredite clan; through Elon, the Elonite clan; through Jahleel, the Jahleelite clan.

source: Hicheho hi Zebulun insung miho akisimdoh-u dungjuija amijatnu chu ahin, sangsomgup toh janga ahi.
target: These were the clans of Zebulun; those numbered were 60,500.

source: Joseph chapate chu a-insungu dungjuijin, Manasseh le Ephraim ahilhone.
target: The descendants of Joseph by their clans through Manasseh and Ephraim were:

source: Manasseh chapate chu: Machir'a kon Machir insung mite: Machir'in Gilead ahingin, Gilead'a konin Gilead insung miho ahungdoh-in ahi.
target: The descendants of Manasseh: through Makir, the Makirite clan (Makir was the father of Gilead); through Gilead, the Gileadite clan.

source: Hichehohi Gilead chapate ahi: Jeezer'a kon Jeezer insung mite: Helek'a kon Helek insung mite:
target: These were the descendants of Gilead: through Iezer, the Iezerite clan; through Helek, the Helekite clan;

source: Asriel'a kon Asriel insung mite: Shechem'a kon Shechem insung mite:
target: through Asriel, the Asrielite clan; through Shechem, the Shechemite clan;

source: Shemida'a kon Shemida insung mite: Hepher'a kon Hepher insung mite ahiuve.
target: through Shemida, the Shemidaite clan; through Hepher, the Hepherite clan.

source: Chuin Hepher chapa Zelophehad chun chapa aneitapon, chanu ho bou aneijin ahi. Chule Zelophehad chanute min chu Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah chule Tirzah ahi.
target: (Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons; he had only daughters, whose names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah and Tirzah.)

source: Hichehohi Manasseh insung miho ahin, chule akisimdoh amaho chengse chu, sangsomnga le sangni toh jasagi ahiuve.
target: These were the clans of Manasseh; those numbered were 52,700.

source: Hiche hohi Ephraim chapate chu a-insungu dungjuijin, Shuthelah'a kon Shuthelah insung mite: Becher'a kon Becher insung mite: Tahan'a kon Tahan insung mite ahiuve.
target: These were the descendants of Ephraim by their clans: through Shuthelah, the Shuthelahite clan; through Beker, the Bekerite clan; through Tahan, the Tahanite clan.

source: Chule hichehohi Shuthelah chapateho ahi: Eran'a kon Eran insung mite ahiuve.
target: These were the descendants of Shuthelah: through Eran, the Eranite clan.

source: Hichehohi amaho akisim doh-u dungjuija Ephraim chapate insung miho ahiuvin, sangsomthum le sangni toh janga ahi. Hichehohi a-insungu kailhah cheh-a Joseph chapate ahiuve.
target: These were the clans of Ephraim; those numbered were 32,500. These were the descendants of Joseph by their clans.

source: Benjamin chapate chu a-insungu dungjuijin: Bela'a kon Bela insung mite: Ashbel'a kon Ashbel insung mite: Ahiram'a kon Ahiram insung mite:
target: The descendants of Benjamin by their clans were: through Bela, the Belaite clan; through Ashbel, the Ashbelite clan; through Ahiram, the Ahiramite clan;

source: Shupham'a kon Shupham insung mite: Hupham'a kon Hupham insung mite: Naaman'a kon Naaman insung mite ahiuve.
target: through Shupham, the Shuphamite clan; through Hupham, the Huphamite clan.

source: Chule Bela chapateni chu Ard le Naaman ahilhone: Ard'a kon Ard insung mite: Naaman'a kon Naaman insung mite ahiuve.
target: The descendants of Bela through Ard and Naaman were: through Ard, the Ardite clan; through Naaman, the Naamite clan.

source: Hicheho hi a-insungu kailhah cheh-a Benjamin chapate ahiuvin, chule akisimdoh-u dungjuijin amaho chu sangsomli le sangnga toh jagup ahi.
target: These were the clans of Benjamin; those numbered were 45,600.

source: Hicheho hi Dan chapate a-insungu dungjuija ahiuve: Shuham'a kon Shuham insung mite ahiuve. Hiche hohi a-insungu kailhah cheh-a Dan insung miho ahiuve.
target: These were the descendants of Dan by their clans: through Shuham, the Shuhamite clan. These were the clans of Dan:

source: Shuham insung mite jouse, akisimdoh dungjuijin amaho chu sangsomgup le sangli toh jali ahi.
target: All of them were Shuhamite clans; and those numbered were 64,400.

source: Asher chateho chu a-insungu dungjuijin; Jimna'a kon Jimna insung mite: Jesui'a kon Jesui insung mite: Beriah'a kon Beriah insung mite ahiuve.
target: The descendants of Asher by their clans were: through Imnah, the Imnite clan; through Ishvi, the Ishvite clan; through Beriah, the Beriite clan;

source: Beriah chapateho chu; Heber'a kon Heber insung mite: Malchiel'a kon Malchiel insung mite ahiuve.
target: and through the descendants of Beriah: through Heber, the Heberite clan; through Malkiel, the Malkielite clan.

source: Chule Asher chanu min chu Sarah ahi.
target: (Asher had a daughter named Serah.)

source: Hichehohi Asher chapate insung miho ahiuvin, akisimdoh-u dungjuijin, sangsomnga le sangthum toh jali ahiuve.
target: These were the clans of Asher; those numbered were 53,400.

source: Chule Naphtali chapate chu a-insungu dungjuijin; Jahzeel'a kon Jahzeel insung mite: Guni'a kon Guni insung mite:
target: The descendants of Naphtali by their clans were: through Jahzeel, the Jahzeelite clan; through Guni, the Gunite clan;

source: Jazer'a kon Jezer insung mite: Shillem'a kon Shillem insung mite ahiuve.
target: through Jezer, the Jezerite clan; through Shillem, the Shillemite clan.

source: Hichehohi a-insungu dungjuija Naphtali insung miho ahiuvin, amaho akisim doh hochu sangsomli le sangnga toh jali ahi.
target: These were the clans of Naphtali; those numbered were 45,400.

source: Hiche hohi Israel chateho jat ahin, sangjagup toh sangkhat toh jasagi le somthum ahiuve.
target: The total number of the men of Israel was 601,730.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a thu aseijin, hitin ati.
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Hicheho henga hi gam chu alodinguva aminu kisimdoh dungjuija kihoppeh ding ahiuve.
target: “The land is to be allotted to them as an inheritance based on the number of names.

source: Atamho henga chu nangman alodiu lentah napehding, chule alhomho henga alodiu neocha napeh ding ahi. Amitakip henga chu amijat kisimdoh dungjuija alodiu kipeding ahi.
target: To a larger group give a larger inheritance, and to a smaller group a smaller one; each is to receive its inheritance according to the number of those listed.

source: Hijeng jongle gam chu vang sanna kihomding ahin, apu apateu phungmin kailhah dungjuija amahon alodingu ahi.
target: Be sure that the land is distributed by lot. What each group inherits will be according to the names for its ancestral tribe.

source: Vang kisan dungjuija gam chu atam le alhom kikah-a kihom khen ding ahi.
target: Each inheritance is to be distributed by lot among the larger and smaller groups.”

source: Chule hiche hohi Levi ho a-insungu dungjuija kisimdoh hochu ahiuve; Gershon'a kon Gershon insung mite: Kohath'a kon Kohath insung mite: Merari'a kon Merari insung mite ahiuve.
target: These were the Levites who were counted by their clans: through Gershon, the Gershonite clan; through Kohath, the Kohathite clan; through Merari, the Merarite clan.

source: Hiche hohi Levi mite insung miho ahiuvin, Libni mite insung, Hebron insung mite, Mahli insung mite, Mushi insung mite, Kohath insung mite ahiuve. Chule Kohath'in Amram ahingin ahi.
target: These also were Levite clans: the Libnite clan, the Hebronite clan, the Mahlite clan, the Mushite clan, the Korahite clan. (Kohath was the forefather of Amram;

source: Chule Amram jinu minchu Jochebed ahin, Levi chanu, anun Egypt gama Levi'a dinga ahinpeh ahi: chule amanun Amram chu Aaron le Mosi chule asopinu lhon Miriam ahinpeh-in ahi.
target: the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, a descendant of Levi, who was born to the Levites in Egypt. To Amram she bore Aaron, Moses and their sister Miriam.

source: Chule Aaron'in Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar le Ithmar ahingin ahi.
target: Aaron was the father of Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

source: Ahin Nadab le Abihu chu Pakai anga mei thenglou ato pet lhonin athilhon tan ahi.
target: But Nadab and Abihu died when they made an offering before the Lord with unauthorized fire.)

source: Chule amaho Pasal lha khatna pat chunglamse akisimdoh hochu sangsomni le sangthum ahiuve. Ajehchu amaho chu Israel chate lah-a goulo ding akipeh lou jeh-un, Israel chate lah-a akisimtha pouvin ahi.
target: All the male Levites a month old or more numbered 23,000. They were not counted along with the other Israelites because they received no inheritance among them.

source: Hichehohi Mosi le Eleazar thempupan, Moab phaicham, Jordan pang, Jericho naija asimdoh lhon Israel chate chu ahiuve.
target: These are the ones counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest when they counted the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

source: Ahivangin Mosi le Aaron thempupan Sinai gamthipma Israel chate anasim lhon miho chu amaho lah-a hin khatcha beh jong aumtapon ahi.
target: Not one of them was among those counted by Moses and Aaron the priest when they counted the Israelites in the Desert of Sinai.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin amaho thudola chun, Amaho thonlouva gamthipma thiding ahiuve, anati ahi. Chutia chu Jephunneh chapa Caleb leh Nun chapa Joshua tilou adang khatcha jong kikhenlou anahitan ahi.
target: For the Lord had told those Israelites they would surely die in the wilderness, and not one of them was left except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

source: Chujouvin Joseph chapa Manasseh insunga Manasseh chapa, Machir chapa, Hepher chapa, Gilead chapa, Zelophehad chapa ahungun: chule achanute min chu Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah chule Tirzah ahi.
target: The daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, belonged to the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph. The names of the daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah and Tirzah. They came forward

source: Chuin amaho Mosi le Eleazar thempupa masang, pipui hole houkhom ho jouse masang-ah, houkhom ho houbuh kotbula chun adingun, hitin aseijuve,
target: and stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders and the whole assembly at the entrance to the tent of meeting and said,

source: Kapao chu gamthipma athin, chule Korah loiho lah-a Pakai douna-a kichom khomho loi lah-a chun ana pangpoi; amavang ama chonset na-a thi anahin, chapaho ana neipon ahi.
target: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among Korah’s followers, who banded together against the Lord , but he died for his own sin and left no sons.

source: Chapa neilou jeh-a kapamin chu ipi dinga a-insung mite lah-a kona paidoh-a umding ham? Hijeh chun kapao sopi holah-a chankhat neipeuvin atiuve.
target: Why should our father’s name disappear from his clan because he had no son? Give us property among our father’s relatives.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n athu chu Pakai henga alhuttan ahi.
target: So Moses brought their case before the Lord ,

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu seijin, hitin ati.
target: and the Lord said to him,

source: Zelophehad chanute sei chun adih aseiju ahi: apao sopiho lah-a gou chanding napeh tei dingu ahi; chule apao gou chanding chu amaho napeh ding ahi.
target: “What Zelophehad’s daughters are saying is right. You must certainly give them property as an inheritance among their father’s relatives and give their father’s inheritance to them.

source: Chule nangman Israel chate jah-a hitia naseiding ahi; Pasal khat chu chapa beija athia ahile, apa gouchu achanu teo napeh dingu ahi.
target: “Say to the Israelites, ‘If a man dies and leaves no son, give his inheritance to his daughter.

source: Ahinla amachun chanu aneilouva ahile, nanghon ama gouchu asopiho napeh dingu ahi.
target: If he has no daughter, give his inheritance to his brothers.

source: Chule aman sopi aneilouva ahile, ama gouchu apa sopiho napeh dingu ahi.
target: If he has no brothers, give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

source: Chule apao chun sopi aneilouva ahile, nanghon agouchu a-insunguva akinaipi pa henga napeh diu, ama chun aloding ahi. Hichu Pakaiyin Mosi athueh banga Israel chate dinga thutanna chondan hiding ahi.
target: If his father had no brothers, give his inheritance to the nearest relative in his clan, that he may possess it. This is to have the force of law for the Israelites, as the Lord commanded Moses.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Nangma hiche Abarim molsanga hin kaldoh-in lang, Israel chate kanapeh gam khu gaven.
target: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Go up this mountain in the Abarim Range and see the land I have given the Israelites.

source: Chule nangman hichu navetjou tengle, nasopipa Aaron kagop khom banga nangma jong namite toh kagop khom ding nahi.
target: After you have seen it, you too will be gathered to your people, as your brother Aaron was,

source: Ajehchu Zin nelgama houkhom ho phunchel laijun, twiphunga amitmu uva suhthenga kaumna dinga kathupeh napalkeh lhonin ahi. Hichu Zin gamthipma um Kadesh mun'a Meribah twi chu ahi, ati.
target: for when the community rebelled at the waters in the Desert of Zin, both of you disobeyed my command to honor me as holy before their eyes.” (These were the waters of Meribah Kadesh, in the Desert of Zin.)

source: Chuin Mosi'n Pakai henga thu aseijin, hitin ati.
target: Moses said to the Lord ,

source: Pakai tipum jouse-a um lhagao Pathen chun houkhom ho chunga mikhat tunghen,
target: “May the Lord , the God who gives breath to all living things, appoint someone over this community

source: Chutia chu Pakai houkhom ho hi achingbei kelngoi abah louna dinguva amasanguva potdoh-a, amasanguva chelut ding, chule amaho puidoh dingle amaho puilut dingin, ati.
target: to go out and come in before them, one who will lead them out and bring them in, so the Lord ’s people will not be like sheep without a shepherd.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Asunga lhagao um mipa, Nun chapa Joshua chu kipuijin lang achunga nakhut ngamin;
target: So the Lord said to Moses, “Take Joshua son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit of leadership, and lay your hand on him.

source: Chule amachu Eleazar thempupa le houkhom ho jouse masanga dinsah inlang, amitmuva chun mopohna pen.
target: Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and the entire assembly and commission him in their presence.

source: Israel chate houkhom ho jouse seingai ahina diuva, ja naumna phabep chu achunga nakoiding ahi.
target: Give him some of your authority so the whole Israelite community will obey him.

source: Chule ama Eleazar thempupa anga ding ding, chule amachun Pakai angsunga Urim thutanna dungjuija ama-a dinga thumop athumpeh ding ahi. Ama le Israel chate jouse, houkhom ho jouse ngeichu ama thusah-a potnuva, chule ama thusah-a lut ding ahiuve, ati.
target: He is to stand before Eleazar the priest, who will obtain decisions for him by inquiring of the Urim before the Lord . At his command he and the entire community of the Israelites will go out, and at his command they will come in.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Pakaiyin athupeh bangchun abolin; Joshua chu Eleazar thempupa le houkhom ho jouse masanga adinsah tan ahi.
target: Moses did as the Lord commanded him. He took Joshua and had him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole assembly.

source: Chuin aman achunga chun akhut angamin, Pakaiyin Mosi khutna athupeh bangin amachu mopohna apetan ahi.
target: Then he laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the Lord instructed through Moses.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a thu aseijin, hitin ati.
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate chu thu penlang, hitin seijin, Keima-a dinga thil kitoh ho, keima henga gimnamtui tah hidinga meija kisem kaganlhaina ka changlhah hochu, kahenga akitep phat dungjuija natona dingun chingtheijun.
target: “Give this command to the Israelites and say to them: ‘Make sure that you present to me at the appointed time my food offerings, as an aroma pleasing to me.’

source: Chule nangman ajah uva, Hiche hi Pakai henga dinga meija kisem thilto nato dingu chu ahi; jomjing govam thilto-a ding chu, nolnabei kelngoinou kumkhat lhingbep ni hiding ahi.
target: Say to them: ‘This is the food offering you are to present to the Lord : two lambs a year old without defect, as a regular burnt offering each day.

source: Kelngoi nou khat chu jingkah lamle nato dingu, chule kelngoi nou adang khatma chu nilhah lamleh nato dingu ahi.
target: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight,

source: Chule a-anneh thilto ding chu thao kimehdoh hin khat hopli-a hopkhat toh kihal changbong nel Ephah khat hopsom-a hopkhat hiding ahi.
target: together with a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil from pressed olives.

source: Hiche hi Pakai henga gimnamtui tah hidinga meija kisem kilhaina, Sinai molsanga kisudetsa jomjing govam thilto chu ahi.
target: This is the regular burnt offering instituted at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord .

source: Chule donding thilto ding chu kelngoinou khatna dinga hin khat hoplia hopkhat hiding; munthenga chu lengpitwi chihtah chu Pakai henga donding thito hidinga nasunlhah dingu ahi.
target: The accompanying drink offering is to be a quarter of a hin of fermented drink with each lamb. Pour out the drink offering to the Lord at the sanctuary.

source: Chule kelngoi dang chu nilhah lamleh natodiu ahin; jingkah lama anneh thilto bangle donding thilto banga chu Pakai henga gimnamtui hidinga meija kisem kilhaina nato dingu ahi.
target: Offer the second lamb at twilight, along with the same kind of grain offering and drink offering that you offer in the morning. This is a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

source: Chule cholngahni leh kumkhat lhingbep nolna beihel kelngoinou ni, chule anneh thilto dinga thao toh kihal changbong nel hopsom-a hopni, chule adonding thilto toh nato tha dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘On the Sabbath day, make an offering of two lambs a year old without defect, together with its drink offering and a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil.

source: Hiche hi jomjing govam thilto le adonding thilto tilouva jong, hiche hi cholngah niseh-a govam thilto ding chu ahi.
target: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

source: Chule nangho lha kipat sehleh Pakaiya govam thilto natodiu; bongchal gol ni, kelngoi chal khat, nolna beihel kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou sagi nato dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘On the first of every month, present to the Lord a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

source: Chule bongchal khatna dinga, a-anneh thilto ding chu thao toh kihal changbongnel ephah hopsom ma hopthum; chule kelngoichal khatna dinga a-anneh thilpe ding chu, thao to kihal changbongnel ephah khat hopsom-a hopni hiding ahi.
target: With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil;

source: Chule kelngoinou khatna dinga a-anneh thilto dingachu thao to kihal changbongnel ephah hopsom-a hopkhat hiding ahi; hiche hi Pakaiya dinga meija kisem kilhaina govam thilto gimnamtui chu ahi.
target: and with each lamb, a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil. This is for a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord .

source: Chule adonding thilto houchu bongchal khatna dinga lengpitwi hin keh khat, kelngoichal khatna dinga hin khat hopthum-a hopkhat, chule kelngoinou khatna dinga hin khat hoplia hopkhat hiding ahi. Hichehi lhaseh-a pumgo thilto, kumlhung keija lhaseh-a bolding ahi.
target: With each bull there is to be a drink offering of half a hin of wine; with the ram, a third of a hin; and with each lamb, a quarter of a hin. This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon during the year.

source: Chule jomjing govam thilto le adongding thilto tilouva jong, kelchanou khat chu chonset thilto-a dinga Pakaiya nato dingu ahi.
target: Besides the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the Lord as a sin offering.

source: Chule lhamasa pen nisomle nili ni chu Pakai dinga kalchuh kut ahi.
target: “ ‘On the fourteenth day of the first month the Lord ’s Passover is to be held.

source: Chule hiche lha nisom le ninga nichu kut ahin; nisagi chol solou changlhah nehdingu ahi.
target: On the fifteenth day of this month there is to be a festival; for seven days eat bread made without yeast.

source: Nikho masapen nile kikhoppi theng umding; hiche sunga chu natoh imacha natoh lou dingu ahi;
target: On the first day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.

source: Amavang Pakai henga govam thilto-a dinga meija kisem kilhaina naboldiu, bongchal gol ni le kelngoichal khat, chule kum khatbep kelngoinou sagi nato diu, hiche hochu nolna beihel hidingu ahi;
target: Present to the Lord a food offering consisting of a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

source: Chule a-anneh thilto-u chu changbongnel thao toh kihal hiding, bongchal khatna dinga ephah hopsom ma hopthum, kelngoichal khatna dinga ephah hopsom ma hopni hiding ahi;
target: With each bull offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;

source: Kelngoinou sagiho jouse dinga chu kelngoinou khat cheh dinga ephah hopsom-a hopkhat hiding ahi.
target: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.

source: Chule nangma longlhen bolna-a kelcha khat chonset thilto dinga nato dingu ahi.
target: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.

source: Jomjing govam thilto, jingkah-a govam thilto tilouva jong hichengho jonghi nato dingu ahi.
target: Offer these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.

source: Pakai henga gamnamtui hidinga meija kisem kilhaina sa chu hiche banga hi aniseh-a, nisagi lhumkeija nato dingu ahi: hichehi jomjing govam thilto le adonding thilto tilouva jong pehtei dingu ahi.
target: In this way present the food offering every day for seven days as an aroma pleasing to the Lord ; it is to be offered in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

source: Chule nisagi nile kikhoppi theng khat nanei uva, natoh imacha natohlou dingu ahi.
target: On the seventh day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.

source: Ga masa nikho, hapta kut sunga Pakai henga anneh thilto thah nahin to tengu jongleh, nanghon kikhoppi theng nanei diu, natoh imacha natoh lou dingu ahi;
target: “ ‘On the day of firstfruits, when you present to the Lord an offering of new grain during the Festival of Weeks, hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.

source: Amavang Pakai henga gimnamtui hidinga govam thilto natodiu; bongchal gol ni, kelngoichal khat, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou sagi nato dingu ahi;
target: Present a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

source: Chule a-anneh thilto diu chu changbongnel thao toh kihal hiding, bongchal khatna dinga ephah hopsom-a hopthum, kelngoichal khatna dinga ephah hopsom-a hopni,
target: With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;

source: Kelngoi sagiho jouse dinga chu kelngoinou khatna dinga ephah hopsom-a hopkhat hiding ahi.
target: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.

source: Chule nangma longlhen bolna dinga kelchaho nou khat nato dingu ahi.
target: Include one male goat to make atonement for you.

source: Jomjing govam thilto le, a-anneh thilto-u (hicheho chu nolna beihel hidiu,) chule adonding thilto hou tilouva jong hicheho chu nato diu ahi.
target: Offer these together with their drink offerings, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering. Be sure the animals are without defect.

source: Chule lhasagi channa, hiche lha nimasa nileh nanghon kikhoppi theng khat nanei diu; natoh imacha natohlou diu ahi; hichu nangho dinga sumkon ho mut nikho ahi.
target: “ ‘On the first day of the seventh month hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work. It is a day for you to sound the trumpets.

source: Chule nanghon Pakai henga gimnamtui tah hidinga govam thilto nato dingu; bongchal golkhat, Kelngoichal khat, Chule kum khat lhingbep nolna beihel kelngoinou sagi nato dingu ahi.
target: As an aroma pleasing to the Lord , offer a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

source: Chule a-anneh thilto-u chu thao toh kihal changbongnel hiding; bongchal khatna dinga ephah hopsom-a hopthum, chule kelngoichal khatna dinga ephah hopsom-a hopni hiding,
target: With the bull offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil; with the ram, two-tenths;

source: Kelngoinou sagi ho jouse-a dinga chu kelngoi khat cheh dinga ephah hopsom-a hopkhat khat hiding ahi.
target: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.

source: Chule nangma longlhen bolna dinga kelcha nou khat chu chonset thilto-a nato ding ahi.
target: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.

source: Lhaseh-a govam thilto le a-anneh thilto, niseh govam thilto le adonding thilto, chule ajatnu dungjuija Pakai henga gimnamtui tah hidinga meija kisem kilhaina tilouva jong, hicheho hi nato dingu ahi.
target: These are in addition to the monthly and daily burnt offerings with their grain offerings and drink offerings as specified. They are food offerings presented to the Lord , a pleasing aroma.

source: Chule nanghon hiche lhasagi channa nisom channi le kikhoppi theng khat nanei diu; chule nanghon nahinnao nasuhgim diu; chule hiche sunga natoh imacha natoh loudiu ahi.
target: “ ‘On the tenth day of this seventh month hold a sacred assembly. You must deny yourselves and do no work.

source: Ahinla nanghon Pakai henga gimnamtui tah hidinga pumgo thilto natodiu, bongchal golkhat ,kelngoichal khat, kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou sagi nato dingu ahi. Hicheho chu nolna beihel hidingu ahi.
target: Present as an aroma pleasing to the Lord a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

source: Chule a-anneh thilto-u chu thao toh kihal changbongnel hiding, bongchal khatna dinga ephah hopsom-a hopthum, chule kelngoichal khatna dinga ephah hopsom-a hopni hiding;
target: With the bull offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;

source: Kelngoi sagi ho jouse-a dinga chu kelngoinou khatna dinga ephah hopsom-a hopkhat khat hiding ahi;
target: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.

source: Longlhenna chonset thilto leh jomjing pumgo thilto, chule a-anneh thilto le adonding thilto hou tilouva jong, kelchanou khat jong chonset thilto-a nato dingu ahi.
target: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering for atonement and the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.

source: Chule lhasagi channa nisom le ninga nile kikhoppi theng khat naneidiu; natoh imacha natoh loudiu, Pakai henga ni sagi kut nabol diu ahi.
target: “ ‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work. Celebrate a festival to the Lord for seven days.

source: Chule nanghon Pakai henga gimnamtui tah hidinga meija kisem kilhaina pumgo thilto natodiu, bongchal gol somlethum, kelngoichal ni, kum khatbep kelngoi somleli: hicheho chu nolna beihel cheh hiding ahi.
target: Present as an aroma pleasing to the Lord a food offering consisting of a burnt offering of thirteen young bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

source: Chule a-anneh thilto-u chu thao toh kihal changbongnel hiding, bongchal somle thuma dinga chu, bongchal takipma dinga ephah hopsom-a hopthum, kelngoichal ni-a dinga chu kelngoichal khatna dinga ephah hopsom-a hopni hiding,
target: With each of the thirteen bulls offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with each of the two rams, two-tenths;

source: Chule kelngoi somleli ho jouse-a dinga chu kelngoinou khat dinga ephah hopsom-a hopkhat cheh hidingu ahi;
target: and with each of the fourteen lambs, one-tenth.

source: Chule jomjing pumgo thilto, a-anneh thilto-u le adonding thilto-u tilouva jong, kelngoiho noukhat chonset thilto-a nato dingu ahi.
target: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

source: Chule anini lhin nile nanghon bongchal gol somleni, kelngoi chal ni, kumkhat bep nolna beihel kelngoi nou somleli nato diu ahi.
target: “ ‘On the second day offer twelve young bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

source: Chule bongchal ho-a ding, kelngoichal ho-a ding, kelngoichal hole kelngoinou ho-a ding, ajatnu dungjuija angaina dungjuija, a-anneh thilto-u le adonding thilto-u nato dingu ahi;
target: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

source: Chule jomjing pumgo thilto le a-anneh thilto-u, chule adonding athilto-u tilouva jong, kelcha ho nou khat chu chonset thilto-a nato dingu ahi.
target: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.

source: Chule anithum nile bongchal somlekhat, kelngoichal ni, chule nolna beihel kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou somleli nato dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘On the third day offer eleven bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

source: Chule bongchal ho-a ding, kelngoi chalho-a ding, chule kelngoiho-a dinga ajatnu dungjuija, angaina dungjuija, a-anneh thilto-u le adonding thilto-u nato dingu;
target: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

source: Chule jomjing pumgo thilto le a-anneh thilto-u, chule adonding athilto-u tilouva jong, chonset thilto-a dinga kelcha khat hiding ahi.
target: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

source: Chule anili nile bongchal som, kelngoi chal ni, chule nolna beihel kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou somleli nato dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘On the fourth day offer ten bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

source: Chule bongchal ho-a ding, kelchal ho-a ding, chule kelngoiho-a dinga ajatnu dungjuija angaina banga, a-anneh thilto-u le adonding athilto-u nato dingu;
target: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

source: Chule jomjing pumgo thilto le a-anneh thilto-u chule adonding athilto-u tilouva jong, kelchaho nou khat chonset thilto-a apehdingu ahi.
target: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

source: Chule ani nga nile bongchal ko, kelngoichal ni, chule apolkom beihel kum khat lhingbep kelngoinou somleli nato dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘On the fifth day offer nine bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

source: Chule bongchal ho-a ding, kelngoi chal ho-a ding, chule kelngoi nou ho-a dinga chu, amaho ajatnu dungjui le angaina banga a-anneh thilto-u le adonding athilto-u nato dingu;
target: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

source: Chule jomjing pumgo thilto le a-anneh thilto-u, chuleh adonding athilto-u tilouva jong, chonset thilto dinga kelcha khat nato dingu ahi.
target: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

source: Chule anigup nile bongchal get, kelngoichal ni, chule nolna bei kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou somleli nato dingu;
target: “ ‘On the sixth day offer eight bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

source: Chule bongchal ho-a ding, kelngoichal ho-a ding, chule kelngoinou ho-a dinga chu amaho jat dungjui le angaina banga a-anneh thilto-u leh adonding thilto-u nato dingu ahi.
target: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

source: Chule jomjing pumgo thilto le a-anneh thilto-u, chule adonding athilto-u tilouva jong, chonset thilto dinga kelngoi khat nato dingu ahi.
target: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

source: Chule ani sagi lhin nile bongchal sagi, kelngoichal ni, chule nolna beihel kumkhat lhingbep kelngoinou sagi nato dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘On the seventh day offer seven bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

source: Chule bongchal ho-a ding, kelngoichal ho-a ding, chule kelngoinou ho-a ding, ajatnu dungjuija leh angaina banga, a-anneh-u thilto-u le adonding thilto-u nato dingu;
target: With the bulls, rams and lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

source: Chule jomjing pumgo thilto le a-anneh thilto-u chule adonding athilto-u tilouva jong, chonset thilto dinga kelcha khat nato dingu ahi.
target: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

source: Aniget nile kikhoppi loupitah khat naneidiu; hiche sunga nanghon natoh imacha natoh loudiu ahi.
target: “ ‘On the eighth day hold a closing special assembly and do no regular work.

source: Ahin Pakai henga gimnamtui tah hidinga, meija kisem kilhaina govam thilto natodiu; bongchal khat, kelngoichal khat, nolna beihel kelngoi sagi kumkhat lhingbep nato dingu ahi.
target: Present as an aroma pleasing to the Lord a food offering consisting of a burnt offering of one bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

source: Chule bongchal ho-a ding, kelngoichal ho-a ding, chule kelngoinou ho-a dinga amaho jat dungjuile angaina banga a-anneh thilto-u leh donding athilto-u nato dingu;
target: With the bull, the ram and the lambs, offer their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

source: Chule jomjing pumgo thilto le a-anneh thilto-u, chule adonding thilto-u tilouva jong, chonset thilto dinga kelcha khat nato dingu ahi.
target: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

source: Chule nakitep nahou, nalung cham thilto hou, napumgo thilto houding, na anneh thilto hou ding, nadon ding nathilto hou ding, nachamna thilto hou ding tilouva jong, hicheng hi Pakaiya dinga na kut houva chu nabol dingu ahi, ati.
target: “ ‘In addition to what you vow and your freewill offerings, offer these to the Lord at your appointed festivals: your burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings and fellowship offerings.’ ”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Pakaiyin athupeh jouse dungjuijin Israel chate henga aseitan ahi.
target: Moses told the Israelites all that the Lord commanded him.

source: Chuin Mosi'n phung lamkai ho jah-a, Israel chate chungchang thudol aseijin, hitin ati; Hichehi Pakai thupeh ahi.
target: Moses said to the heads of the tribes of Israel: “This is what the Lord commands:

source: Mikhattou Pakai henga kitepna khatna akitepma, ahiloule ahinna kikanna dinga kihahselna khatna akihahsela ahile, athusei chu apalkeh louding, akama aseidoh dungjuija atohding ahi.
target: When a man makes a vow to the Lord or takes an oath to obligate himself by a pledge, he must not break his word but must do everything he said.

source: Numei khattou Pakai henga kitepna khatna akitepma, anungah laija apa in'a ana umlaija, kikanna khatna amanu akikana;
