target: “When a young woman still living in her father’s household makes a vow to the Lord or obligates herself by a pledge

source: Chule apan akitepna le ahinna kikan nadinga akikan nachu ajah-a, apan amanu athipsan jeng ahile; akitepna jouse chu ding jing ding ahin, chule ahinna anakanna akihahselna jouse jong chu ding jing ding ahi.
target: and her father hears about her vow or pledge but says nothing to her, then all her vows and every pledge by which she obligated herself will stand.

source: Amavang apachun ajah nikho-a chu ajahda-a ahile; amanu kitepna ho, ahiloule ahinna kikan nadinga akikannaho chu dinglou ding ahi; chule apan ajahda jeh-a, Pakaiyin amanu chu angaidam ding ahi.
target: But if her father forbids her when he hears about it, none of her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand; the Lord will release her because her father has forbidden her.

source: Chule amanu akitepet ahiloule amanun ahina akana dia akamsunga thu hungpotdoh laija chu jinei ahitah-a;
target: “If she marries after she makes a vow or after her lips utter a rash promise by which she obligates herself

source: Chule hichu ajipan ajah-a, chule ajah nikho-a chu amanu ana thipsanna ahile; amanu kitepnaho chu ding jing ding; chule ahinna kikana dinga akihahsel naho chu ding ding ahi.
target: and her husband hears about it but says nothing to her, then her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand.

source: Ahinla ajipan hichu ajahdoh nikho-a ajahda-a ahile, amanu kitepna khatna anakitepna, chule ahinna akikana akamsunga kona thu hungpot doh ho chu asuhmang pehding; Pakaiyin amanu chu angaidam ding ahi.
target: But if her husband forbids her when he hears about it, he nullifies the vow that obligates her or the rash promise by which she obligates herself, and the Lord will release her.

source: Amavang meithai le akidasa numei jin ahinna kikan nadinga akitepna tapou chu amanu chunga ding jing ding ahi.
target: “Any vow or obligation taken by a widow or divorced woman will be binding on her.

source: Chule amanu chu ajipa in'a kitep ahia, ahiloule ahinna chu kihahsel na-a akan ahi-a,
target: “If a woman living with her husband makes a vow or obligates herself by a pledge under oath

source: Chule ajipan hichu ajah-a, amanu athip sana, ajahda louva ahile, akitepna jouse chu dingjing ding, ahinna kikan nadinga akihahselna takip chu ding jing ding ahi.
target: and her husband hears about it but says nothing to her and does not forbid her, then all her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand.

source: Ahinla ajipan hiho chu ajahdoh nikho-a ajah da-a ahile; akitepna thudola akama kona potchan, ahiloule ahinna kikana thudol chu dinglou ding ahi. A-inneipun ajahda ahin, Pakaiyin amanu angaidam ding ahi.
target: But if her husband nullifies them when he hears about them, then none of the vows or pledges that came from her lips will stand. Her husband has nullified them, and the Lord will release her.

source: Kitepna tapou le ahinna sugentheina dinga kikana tapou chu ajipan aphudet thei, ahiloule asuhmang thei ahi.
target: Her husband may confirm or nullify any vow she makes or any sworn pledge to deny herself.

source: Amavang a-inneipun ani ania amanu henga chu imacha seilouva auma ahile; amanu akitepnaho le amanu chunga akikana jouse chu aphudet peh ahi. Amapan hicheho chu ajahdoh nikho-a athipsan jeh-a chu, hicheho chu anamdet ahi.
target: But if her husband says nothing to her about it from day to day, then he confirms all her vows or the pledges binding on her. He confirms them by saying nothing to her when he hears about them.

source: Ahinla amapan hicheho ajahdoh nunga asuhmanga ahile; amapan amanu chonsetna chu akipoh ding ahi.
target: If, however, he nullifies them some time after he hears about them, then he must bear the consequences of her wrongdoing.”

source: Hicheho hi Pakaiyin Mosi ana thupeh, pasal le a-inneipi kikah-a, chule amanu khangdong ahilai, apa in'a aumlaija amanu le apa kikah-a dinga chondan apeh chu ahi.
target: These are the regulations the Lord gave Moses concerning relationships between a man and his wife, and between a father and his young daughter still living at home.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,.
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Midia mite chunga Israel chate phu lanlang, chujouteng na mite toh gopkhoma naum ding ahitai.
target: “Take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites. After that, you will be gathered to your people.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n mipi ho henga chun aseijin, hitin ati; Nangho lah-a mi phabep galsat dingin galvon kivonu henlang, Midia mite doudin cheohen, chule Midia mite chungah Pakai phuba galao hen.
target: So Moses said to the people, “Arm some of your men to go to war against the Midianites so that they may carry out the Lord ’s vengeance on them.

source: Israel phung jouse-a kon, phung khatna kon sangkhat cheh chu galkon dinga nasol dingu ahi, ati.
target: Send into battle a thousand men from each of the tribes of Israel.”

source: Hitichun Israel sangtamtah ho lah-a konin phung khatna kon sangkhat cheh, galkon dinga galvon kivon mi sangsom le sangni alhengdoh taovin ahi.
target: So twelve thousand men armed for battle, a thousand from each tribe, were supplied from the clans of Israel.

source: Chuin Mosi'n amaho chu manchah thengtah hole mutding sumkon ho chu akhutnuva akichoisah-in, chule Israelte phungtina sangkhat cheh le Eleazar thempu chapa Phinehas chu galsat din asoltan ahi.
target: Moses sent them into battle, a thousand from each tribe, along with Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, who took with him articles from the sanctuary and the trumpets for signaling.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bang chun, amahon Midia mite asat taovin; chule pasal jouse athat taovin ahi.
target: They fought against Midian, as the Lord commanded Moses, and killed every man.

source: Chuin adang athahou tilouvin jong amahon Midia leng ngaho athatnun, amaho chu: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur chule Reba ahiuve. Beor chapa Balaam jong chu chemjamin athatnun ahi.
target: Among their victims were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur and Reba—the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.

source: Chuin Israel chate chun Midia numei ho le achasen hou jouse gal hingin ahin kaijun ahi, chule agancha hou jouse, akelngoi hou jouse, chule athilkeo jouseu ahin chomun ahi.
target: The Israelites captured the Midianite women and children and took all the Midianite herds, flocks and goods as plunder.

source: Chuin amahon achennao khopi jouse le akulpiu phatah ho jouse chu meijin ahal lha uvin ahi.
target: They burned all the towns where the Midianites had settled, as well as all their camps.

source: Chuin amahon galthil achom jouseu, mihem le ganhing agomin apui taovin ahi.
target: They took all the plunder and spoils, including the people and animals,

source: Chuin amahon gal hinga kiman jouse le thil achomdoh hou jouse chu Mosi le Eleazar thempupa, chule Israel chate houkhom ho henga Jericho naija um, Jordan pang Moab phaichama gebuh-ah ahinpui taovin ahi.
target: and brought the captives, spoils and plunder to Moses and Eleazar the priest and the Israelite assembly at their camp on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan across from Jericho.

source: Chuin Mosi le Eleazar thempupa, chule houkhom ho lah-a lamkai pipuiho chu amaho kimupi din gebuh pama apotdoh-un ahi.
target: Moses, Eleazar the priest and all the leaders of the community went to meet them outside the camp.

source: Chuin galmuna kona hung janel lamkaiho, sepai asang sang lamkai ho, chule aja aja chunga lamkai ho chunga chun Mosi alunghang tan ahi.
target: Moses was angry with the officers of the army—the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds—who returned from the battle.

source: Chuin Mosi'n amaho henga, Nanghon numei ho jouse hi hinghoi nahiuvem?
target: “Have you allowed all the women to live?” he asked them.

source: Veovin, hiche numei ho hin Balaam thumopma kona Israel chate hi Peor chungchanga Pakai douna asuhkhel sah-u ahin, chule Pakai houkhom ho lah-a chu hise analanga ahi.
target: “They were the ones who followed Balaam’s advice and enticed the Israelites to be unfaithful to the Lord in the Peor incident, so that a plague struck the Lord ’s people.

source: Hijeh chun tun chapangho lah-a pasal takip chu thatnun lang, chule numei takip pasal toh lupkhom kha jouse chu thatnun,
target: Now kill all the boys. And kill every woman who has slept with a man,

source: Amavang numei chapang jouse, pasal toh lumkhom khalou jouse chu nangho-a dingin hinghoijun;
target: but save for yourselves every girl who has never slept with a man.

source: Chule nangho gebuh pama ni sagi naum dingu: koi hijongleh mi that tapou, chule koi hijongle mithilong tongkha tapou chu, nangho le nami mat hou agoma nithum ni leh ni sagi ni-a naki suhtheng dingu ahi.
target: “Anyone who has killed someone or touched someone who was killed must stay outside the camp seven days. On the third and seventh days you must purify yourselves and your captives.

source: Chule navon jouseu, savuna kisem jouse, kelmulla kisem jouse, chule thinga kisem jouse chu sutheng uvin, ati.
target: Purify every garment as well as everything made of leather, goat hair or wood.”

source: Chuin Eleazar thempupan galsatna che galsat miho henga chun, Hichehi Pakaiyin Mosi henga athupeh danthua chondan ahi;
target: Then Eleazar the priest said to the soldiers who had gone into battle, “This is what is required by the law that the Lord gave Moses:

source: Sana, dangka, sum-eng, thih, tin chule ngen hobou,
target: Gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, lead

source: Meija katheilou thil jouse chu nanghon meija nahal diu, chuteng hichu atheng hiding ahi. Hijeng jongle kisekhena twija suhtheng hiding ahi. Chule mei kahthei jouse chu twija nadediu ahi,
target: and anything else that can withstand fire must be put through the fire, and then it will be clean. But it must also be purified with the water of cleansing. And whatever cannot withstand fire must be put through that water.

source: Chule nanghon napon hou chu ani sagi nile nasop theng diu, chuteng atheng nahi dingu ahitai. Chujou tengle nangho gebuh-a nahung lut dingu ahi, ati.
target: On the seventh day wash your clothes and you will be clean. Then you may come into the camp.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,.
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Nangmale Eleazar thempupa, chule houkhom ho lah-a lamkai pipuihon, galla kichom doh chu mihem hihen sa hijongle ajat simtoh-un.
target: “You and Eleazar the priest and the family heads of the community are to count all the people and animals that were captured.

source: Chule galsat dinga galmuna konho le houkhom ho jouse kah-ah galthil chu hopnin hoppeh-un:
target: Divide the spoils equally between the soldiers who took part in the battle and the rest of the community.

source: Chule galsat dinga galmuna konho-a konin Pakaiya dingin kai dongun; mihem'a kon, bongchal ho-a kon, sangan ho-a kon, chule kelngoi ho-a konin agomun janga lah-a khatcheh laovin;
target: From the soldiers who fought in the battle, set apart as tribute for the Lord one out of every five hundred, whether people, cattle, donkeys or sheep.

source: Pakaiya lhuh thilto dingin, akehkhat chu lanlang, Eleazar thempupa chu pen.
target: Take this tribute from their half share and give it to Eleazar the priest as the Lord ’s part.

source: Chule Israel chate chan akeh khatna konin, somnga lah-a konin khat ladoh-un lang, mihem'a kon, bongchal ho-a kon, sangan ho-a kon, kelngoiho-a kon, gamsa jouse-a konin laovin lang, chule Pakai houbuh chingtup-a pang Levi ho henga peuvin.
target: From the Israelites’ half, select one out of every fifty, whether people, cattle, donkeys, sheep or other animals. Give them to the Levites, who are responsible for the care of the Lord ’s tabernacle.”

source: Chuin Mosi le Eleazar thempupan Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangchun abol lhontan ahi.
target: So Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chule galsat mihon ahinlah-u galthil kichomho simlouvin, kelngoi chu sangjagup toh sangsomsagi le sangnga ahin,
target: The plunder remaining from the spoils that the soldiers took was 675,000 sheep,

source: Bong sangsomsagi le sangni,
target: 72,000 cattle,

source: Sangan sangsomgup le sangkhat,
target: 61,000 donkeys

source: Chule pasal to kitimat khalou numei chu sangsomthum le sangni ahi.
target: and 32,000 women who had never slept with a man.

source: Chule akeh khat, galsatna konho chan chu: kelngoi sangjathum le sangsomthum le sangsagi le janga ahin;
target: The half share of those who fought in the battle was: 337,500 sheep,

source: Chule Pakaiya dinga kelngoi kai kipe chu jagup le somsagi le nga ahi.
target: of which the tribute for the Lord was 675;

source: Chule bongchal ho chu sangsomthum le sanggup ahin; hicheho lah-a kona Pakaiya dinga kai kipe chu somsagi le ni ahi.
target: 36,000 cattle, of which the tribute for the Lord was 72;

source: Chule sangan ho chu sangsomthum le janga ahin; Pakaiya dinga kai kipe chu somgup le khat ahi.
target: 30,500 donkeys, of which the tribute for the Lord was 61;

source: Chule mihem chu sangsom le sanggup ahin; hicheng lah-a Pakaiya dinga kai kipe chu mi somthum le ni ahi.
target: 16,000 people, of whom the tribute for the Lord was 32.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangchun, Pakaiya lhuh thilpeh kai chu Mosi'n Eleazar thempupa apetan ahi.
target: Moses gave the tribute to Eleazar the priest as the Lord ’s part, as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chule Israel chate chan akehkhat, galsatna konho lah-a kona Mosi'n ahopkhenho chu;
target: The half belonging to the Israelites, which Moses set apart from that of the fighting men—

source: (Tun houkhom ho chan akeh khatna chu: kelngoi sangjathum le sangsomthum le sangsagi to janga ahin,
target: the community’s half—was 337,500 sheep,

source: Chule bongchal sangsomthum le gup,
target: 36,000 cattle,

source: Chule sangan sangsomthum le janga,
target: 30,500 donkeys

source: Chule mihem sangsom le sang gup ahi.)
target: and 16,000 people.

source: Israel chate-a chan akeh khatna konin, Mosi'n mihem le gancha agomin somnga-a khat alan, chule Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangchun Pakai houbuh ngahtup Levi miho chu apen ahi.
target: From the Israelites’ half, Moses selected one out of every fifty people and animals, as the Lord commanded him, and gave them to the Levites, who were responsible for the care of the Lord ’s tabernacle.

source: Chuin janel asang sangho chunga lamkai, asang sang lamkaiho le, ajaja lamkaihon, Mosi ahin naijun,
target: Then the officers who were over the units of the army—the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds—went to Moses

source: Chuin amahon Mosi henga, Nasoh keihon mi keiho mopohna noija um galsat miho sese kasimun ahile, mi khatcha akisam aumpoi.
target: and said to him, “Your servants have counted the soldiers under our command, and not one is missing.

source: Hijeh chun amitakip min Pakai henga thilpeh dingin kanei hou, sana-a kisem kijepna ho, sumguiho, chaoho, khutjemho, bilbaho, chule khiho Pakai anga kahinna uva dinga longlhenna bolna dingin kahin choijun ahi, atiuve.
target: So we have brought as an offering to the Lord the gold articles each of us acquired—armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings and necklaces—to make atonement for ourselves before the Lord .”

source: Chuin Mosi le Eleazar thempupa chun amaho-a konin sana jouse, sana-a kisem kijepna jouse ala lhontan ahi.
target: Moses and Eleazar the priest accepted from them the gold—all the crafted articles.

source: Chule Pakaiya dinga asangsang lamkaiho le ajaja lamkaihon apehdoh-u thilpeh sanaho jouse chu, shekel sangsom le sanggup toh jasagi le somnga ahi.
target: All the gold from the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds that Moses and Eleazar presented as a gift to the Lord weighed 16,750 shekels.

source: (Ajehchu galkon miho amitakip min ama ding cheh-a thil ahin kichomu ahi.)
target: Each soldier had taken plunder for himself.

source: Chuin Mosi le Eleazar thempupan asangsang lamkai ho le jalamkai ho sana chu ala lhonin, Pakai angsunga Israel chate-a dinga melchihna khat hidingin, houkhom ho houbuh sunga achoilut lhontan ahi.
target: Moses and Eleazar the priest accepted the gold from the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds and brought it into the tent of meeting as a memorial for the Israelites before the Lord .

source: Tun Reuben chate le Gad chate chun gancha atama tam aneijun: chule amahon Jazer gam le Gilead gam amuphatnun, veuvin, amun chu gancha vahna dinga mun phatah ahijeh-in,
target: The Reubenites and Gadites, who had very large herds and flocks, saw that the lands of Jazer and Gilead were suitable for livestock.

source: Gad chate chule Reuben chate chu ahungun, Mosi le Eleazer thempupa, chule houkhom lamkai pipuiho henga aseijun, hitin atiuve,
target: So they came to Moses and Eleazar the priest and to the leaders of the community, and said,

source: Ataroth, Dibon, Jezer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Shebam, Nebo chule Beon,
target: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo and Beon—

source: Pakaiyin Israel houkhom ho masang tah-a anasuhmang gamhi gancha vahna dinga phatah ahin; nasoh houhin gancha kaneijun ahi:
target: the land the Lord subdued before the people of Israel—are suitable for livestock, and your servants have livestock.

source: Hijeh chun amahon, Keiho namitmu-a lungsetna kachan uva ahile, hiche gam hi nasohte lo dingin nei pedoh jengun, chule keiho Jordan gal lama neipuilut da taovin, atiuvin ahi.
target: If we have found favor in your eyes,” they said, “let this land be given to your servants as our possession. Do not make us cross the Jordan.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Gad chate le Reuben chate jah-a chun, Nasopi ho gal kona cheova, nangho hilaija hi natou thim dingu ham?
target: Moses said to the Gadites and Reubenites, “Should your fellow Israelites go to war while you sit here?

source: Chule ibola nanghon Israel chate chu Pakaiyin apehnao gam agalkai diuva kona nalung lhahsah uham?
target: Why do you discourage the Israelites from crossing over into the land the Lord has given them?

source: Kadesh-bernea'a kona agam vedinga kasolai chun napateu vin hitihin anabolun ahi.
target: This is what your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to look over the land.

source: Ajehchu amaho Eshcol phaichama acheuva, agam agamu-u chun, amahon Israel chate chu Pakaiyin apehnao gama alut louna diuvin alunglhah sah-un ahi.
target: After they went up to the Valley of Eshkol and viewed the land, they discouraged the Israelites from entering the land the Lord had given them.

source: Chuin Pakai lunghanna chu hiche pet chun ahung koudohtan, chule ama akihah sellin, hitin ati.
target: The Lord ’s anger was aroused that day and he swore this oath:

source: Thonlouva Egypt gama kona hungdoh miho kumsom ni-a lhah chunglamse koimachan keiman Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob henga kanatep gam chu amutheilou dingu ahi, ajehchu amahon eijui bulhing pouve;
target: ‘Because they have not followed me wholeheartedly, not one of those who were twenty years old or more when they came up out of Egypt will see the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob—

source: Kenez mi Jephunneh chapa Caleb le Nun chapa Joshua tilou; ajehchu amanin Pakai ajui bukim lhonin ahi.
target: not one except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun, for they followed the Lord wholeheartedly.’

source: Chuin Pakai lunghanna chu Israel chate chunga akoudoh tan, Pakai mitmu-a thilse bolho khang jouse chu abeisoh kahsen amaho chu gamthipma kum somli avavai sah-in ahi.
target: The Lord ’s anger burned against Israel and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until the whole generation of those who had done evil in his sight was gone.

source: Chule veuvin, chonset punna mite, Israel chunga Pakai lunghan punbesah nadingin, nangho napateu khelin nahung kisepdoh-un ahi.
target: “And here you are, a brood of sinners, standing in the place of your fathers and making the Lord even more angry with Israel.

source: Ajehchu nangho ama najuinaova kona nakihei manguva ahile, aman amaho hi gamthipma adalhah kit ding, chule nanghon hiche miho jouse hi nasuh mangdiu ahi, ati.
target: If you turn away from following him, he will again leave all this people in the wilderness, and you will be the cause of their destruction.”

source: Chuin amahon ama ahin naijun, Keihon hilaija hi kagancha ho hongding le kachateu ho-a ding khopiho chu kasahdiu:
target: Then they came up to him and said, “We would like to build pens here for our livestock and cities for our women and children.

source: Amavang keiho tah hi Israel chate cheng achen nadiu gamsunga kapuilut kahseuva amasanguva manchah puma kigosa kachediu ahi: chule agama cheng miho jeh-a hi kachateu kul kikai khum khopiho-a kachen sahdiu ahi, atiuve.
target: But we will arm ourselves for battle and go ahead of the Israelites until we have brought them to their place. Meanwhile our women and children will live in fortified cities, for protection from the inhabitants of the land.

source: Israel chate amichang cheh-in aloding cheh-u alo kahseuva keiho ka in'uva kahung kile loudiu ahi.
target: We will not return to our homes until each of the Israelites has received their inheritance.

source: Ijeh inem itile keihon amaho toh Jordan gallang, ahiloule akal lam chu kalokhom loudiu ahi; ajeh chu keiho gamloding chu hilam Jordan solamsang ahi, atiuve.
target: We will not receive any inheritance with them on the other side of the Jordan, because our inheritance has come to us on the east side of the Jordan.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n amaho henga, Hitobang thil hi nabol uva, Pakai angsunga galsatna nakon uva,
target: Then Moses said to them, “If you will do this—if you will arm yourselves before the Lord for battle

source: Chule Pakaiyin amelmate a-angsung kona adelmang kahse-a, nangho galvon kivon jouse Pakai angsunga Jordan nagal kaijuva,
target: and if all of you who are armed cross over the Jordan before the Lord until he has driven his enemies out before him—

source: Chule Pakai angsung tah-a agam chu suhnema auma ahile; chujouteng chule nangho nakinungle uva, chule nangho Pakai angle Israelte anga themona bei nahi dingu; chule agam chu Pakai angsunga nangho loding hiding ahi.
target: then when the land is subdued before the Lord , you may return and be free from your obligation to the Lord and to Israel. And this land will be your possession before the Lord .

source: Ahinla nanghon hitia chu nabol lou uva ahile, veuvin, nangho Pakai douna-a chonse nahiuvin, thonlouva nachonset nao chun nahin holdoh dingu ahi.
target: “But if you fail to do this, you will be sinning against the Lord ; and you may be sure that your sin will find you out.

source: Nachasen teo dingin khopi saovin lang, nakelngoi houva din kelngoi hong saovin, hitichun nakam muva thupot dungjui chun bollun, ati.
target: Build cities for your women and children, and pens for your flocks, but do what you have promised.”

source: Chuin Gad chate le Reuben chate chun Mosi henga, ka Pakai thupeh banga nasohten kabol dingu ahi.
target: The Gadites and Reubenites said to Moses, “We your servants will do as our lord commands.

source: Kachasen hou, ka-inneipiteu, kakelngoi hon hou, chule kagancha hou, hiche Gilead khopiho sunga umdingu ahin,
target: Our children and wives, our flocks and herds will remain here in the cities of Gilead.

source: Ahin ka pakai pa seibanga, nasohte amitakip galsat dinga galvon kivon chengse, galsatna Pakai angsunga kache dingu ahi, atiuve.
target: But your servants, every man who is armed for battle, will cross over to fight before the Lord , just as our lord says.”

source: Hijeh chun amaho chung thua hin Mosi'n Eleazar thempupa le Nun chapa Joshua, chule Israel chate phung lamkai ho thu apen:
target: Then Moses gave orders about them to Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun and to the family heads of the Israelite tribes.

source: Chule Mosi'n amaho jah-a, Gad chate le Reuben chate hi nangho toh Pakai angsunga amitakip galvon akivon uva, Jordan agalkaijuva, gamchu namasanguva suhnema auma ahileh; chuteng nanghon Gilead gam chu amaho lodinga napeh dingu ahi.
target: He said to them, “If the Gadites and Reubenites, every man armed for battle, cross over the Jordan with you before the Lord , then when the land is subdued before you, you must give them the land of Gilead as their possession.

source: Ahin amaho galvon puma nangho toh agalkai khom lou uva ahile, amahon Canaan gama nangho lah-a loding anei dingu ahi, ati.
target: But if they do not cross over with you armed, they must accept their possession with you in Canaan.”

source: Chuin Gad chatele Reuben chate chun adonbutnun, Pakaiyin nasohte henga asei banga chu keihon kabol dingu ahi.
target: The Gadites and Reubenites answered, “Your servants will do what the Lord has said.

source: Kachan dingu kagoulo diu chu Jordan hilamsang ahitheina dinga keiho galvon kivon puma Pakai angsunga Canaan gamsunga kagalkai dingu ahi, atiuve.
target: We will cross over before the Lord into Canaan armed, but the property we inherit will be on this side of the Jordan.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Amor mite lengpa Sihon gam le Bashan lengpa Og gam, agamgi sunga khopi ho, gamsung kimvella khopiho chu Gad chate, Reuben chate chule Joseph chapa Manasseh phung akehkhat hochu apetai.
target: Then Moses gave to the Gadites, the Reubenites and the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan—the whole land with its cities and the territory around them.

source: Chuin Gad chate chun Dibon, Ataroth le Aroer,
target: The Gadites built up Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

source: Chule Atroth, Shophan, Jazer le Jogbehah,
target: Atroth Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

source: Beth-nimrah chule Beth-haran, kul kikai khum khopiho, chule kelngoi hongho asadoh-un ahi.
target: Beth Nimrah and Beth Haran as fortified cities, and built pens for their flocks.

source: Chule Reuben chaten Heshbon, Elealeh le Kirjathaim,
target: And the Reubenites rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh and Kiriathaim,

source: Nebo, Baal-meon (amin ho kikhela ahitai,) chule Shibmah khopiho asadoh-un, chule amahon asahdoh-u khopiho chu minchom asah-un ahi.
target: as well as Nebo and Baal Meon (these names were changed) and Sibmah. They gave names to the cities they rebuilt.

source: Chuin Manasseh chapa Machir chate hochu Gilead'a acheuvin, agalaovin, chule asunga um Amor miho chu anodoh-un ahi.
target: The descendants of Makir son of Manasseh went to Gilead, captured it and drove out the Amorites who were there.

source: Chuin Mosi'n Gilead chu Manasseh chapa Michir apen, ama chua achengtan ahi.
target: So Moses gave Gilead to the Makirites, the descendants of Manasseh, and they settled there.

source: Chuin Manasseh chapa Jair chu achen, chua khopi neoho chu alan, chule hicheho chu Havoth-Jair asahtai.
target: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, captured their settlements and called them Havvoth Jair.

source: Chule Nobah achen Kenath le chua kho neoho chu alan, ama min aputsah-in, Nobah asahtan ahi.
target: And Nobah captured Kenath and its surrounding settlements and called it Nobah after himself.

source: Hicheng hi Mosi le Aaron khut noija Israel chate asepai ho toh Egypt gama kona akholjin nao chu ahi.
target: Here are the stages in the journey of the Israelites when they came out of Egypt by divisions under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.

source: Chule Mosi'n Pakai thupeh-a konin akholjin nao dungjuijin achedoh nao asunne: chule hicheng hi achedoh nau dungjuija akholjinu chu ahi.
target: At the Lord ’s command Moses recorded the stages in their journey. This is their journey by stages:

source: Chuin Ramases'a konin alha masapen nisomle ninga channa lha masapen, kalchuh kut ni ajingin Israel chate chu Egypt miho jouse mitmun khut thahat tah-in ahung kitoldoh taovin ahi.
target: The Israelites set out from Rameses on the fifteenth day of the first month, the day after the Passover. They marched out defiantly in full view of all the Egyptians,

source: Ajehchu Egypt miho chun achateu apeng masapen jouse Pakaiyin athaho chu avuijun, a-pathenhou chunga jong Pakaiyin thu atan ahi.
target: who were burying all their firstborn, whom the Lord had struck down among them; for the Lord had brought judgment on their gods.

source: Chuin Israel chate chu Ramseses'a konin ahung kitoldoh-un, Succoth'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: The Israelites left Rameses and camped at Sukkoth.

source: Chuin amaho Succoth'a konin akipat doh-un gamthip monglha Ethama gebuh akisonuve.
target: They left Sukkoth and camped at Etham, on the edge of the desert.

source: Chuin amaho Etham'a konin akipat doh-un, Baal-Zephon maija um Pi-hahiroth lamma akile heijun, Migdol'a gebuh akison taovin ahi.
target: They left Etham, turned back to Pi Hahiroth, to the east of Baal Zephon, and camped near Migdol.

source: Chuin amaho Pi-hahiroth maija chun akipat doh-un, dillen lah-a achepeh-un, gamthipma chun alutnun, hitichun amaho Etham gamthipma chun nithum akitolun, chuin Marah'a gebuh akison taovin ahi.
target: They left Pi Hahiroth and passed through the sea into the desert, and when they had traveled for three days in the Desert of Etham, they camped at Marah.

source: Chuin Marah'a konin akipat doh-un, Elim'a ahung lutnun, Elim'a chun twinah somleni le lusu phung somsagi aumin, hia chun amahon gebuh akison taovin ahi.
target: They left Marah and went to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.

source: Chuin amaho Elima konin ahung kipatdoh-un, twipisan panga gebuh akison taovin ahi.
target: They left Elim and camped by the Red Sea.

source: Chuin amaho twipisan panga konin akipat doh-un, Sin gamthipma gebuh akison taovin ahi.
target: They left the Red Sea and camped in the Desert of Sin.

source: Chuin amaho Sin gamthipma konin akitolun, Dophkah'a gebuh akison taovin ahi.
target: They left the Desert of Sin and camped at Dophkah.

source: Chuin amaho Dophkah'a konin akipat doh-un, Alush'a gebuh akison taovin ahi.
target: They left Dophkah and camped at Alush.

source: Chuin amaho Alush'a konin akichonun, mipi ho donding twi umlouna mun Rephidim'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

source: Chuin amaho Rephidim'a konin akipat doh-un, Sinai gamthipma chun gebuh akison taovin ahi.
target: They left Rephidim and camped in the Desert of Sinai.

source: Chuin Sinai nelphaija konin akichonun, Kibroth-hatta-avah'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left the Desert of Sinai and camped at Kibroth Hattaavah.

source: Chuin amaho Kibroth-hatta-avah'a konin akipat doh-un, Hezeroth'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Kibroth Hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.

source: Chule amaho Hazeroth na konin akipat doh-un, Rithmah'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.

source: Chuin amaho Rithmah'a konin akipat doh-un, Rimmon-parez'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Rithmah and camped at Rimmon Perez.

source: Chuin Rimmon-parez'a konin akipat doh-un, Libnah'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Rimmon Perez and camped at Libnah.

source: Chuin Libnah'a konin akichonun, Rissah'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Libnah and camped at Rissah.

source: Chuin Rissah'a konin akitollun, Kehelathah'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.

source: Chuin Kehelathah'a konin achekitnun, Shapher molsanga gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.

source: Chuin Shapher molsanga konin akitolun, Haradah'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.

source: Chuin Haradah'a konin akitolun, Makheloth'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Haradah and camped at Makheloth.

source: Chuin Makheloth'a konin akitolun, Tahath'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Makheloth and camped at Tahath.

source: Chuin Tahath'a konin akipat doh-un, Tarah'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Tahath and camped at Terah.

source: Chuin Tarah'a konin akipat doh-un, Mithkah'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Terah and camped at Mithkah.

source: Chuin Mithkah'a konin acheuvin, Hashmonah'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.

source: Chuin Hashmonah'a konin akipat doh-un, Mosiroth'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.

source: Chuin Mosiroth'a konin akipat doh-un, Bene-ja-akan'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Moseroth and camped at Bene Jaakan.

source: Chuin Bene-ja-akan'a konin akichonun, Hor-hagidgad'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Bene Jaakan and camped at Hor Haggidgad.

source: Chuin Hor-hagidgad'a konin acheuvin, Jotbathah'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Hor Haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.

source: Chuin Jotbathah'a konin akitolun, Ebronah'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.

source: Chuin Ebronah'a konin akipatdoh-in, Ezion-gaber'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Abronah and camped at Ezion Geber.

source: Chuin Ezion-gaber'a konin akichonun, Kadesh kiti Zin gamthipma chun gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Ezion Geber and camped at Kadesh, in the Desert of Zin.

source: Chuin Kadesh'a konin akichonun, Edom gam monga um Hor molsanga gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the border of Edom.

source: Chuin Aaron thempupa chu Pakai thupeh dungjuijin Hor molsang chunga akaltouvin, chuin hia chun Israel chate Egypt gama kona ahungdoh-u kum somli lhinni, lha-nga channa nimasani chun athitan ahi.
target: At the Lord ’s command Aaron the priest went up Mount Hor, where he died on the first day of the fifth month of the fortieth year after the Israelites came out of Egypt.

source: Chule Aaron Hor molsang athi chun kum jakhat le somni le thum ahitai.
target: Aaron was a hundred and twenty-three years old when he died on Mount Hor.

source: Chule Canaan lengpa Arad chu Canaan gam lhanglama cheng ahin, Israel chate hung chu ajatan ahi.
target: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev of Canaan, heard that the Israelites were coming.

source: Chuin amaho Hor molsanga konin akipat doh-un, Zalmonah'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.

source: Chuin Zalmonah'a konin akipat doh-un, Punon'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Zalmonah and camped at Punon.

source: Chuin Punon'a konin akipat doh-un, Oboth'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Punon and camped at Oboth.

source: Chuin Oboth'a konin akipat doh-un, Moab gamgia Ije-abarim'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Oboth and camped at Iye Abarim, on the border of Moab.

source: Chuin Iim'a konin akipat doh-un, Dibongad mun'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Iye Abarim and camped at Dibon Gad.

source: Chuin Dibongad'a konin akichon kitnun, Almon-diblath-aim mun'a gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Dibon Gad and camped at Almon Diblathaim.

source: Chuin Almon-diblath-aim'a konin akichonun, Nebo masanga Abarim molsang ho-a chun gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left Almon Diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim, near Nebo.

source: Chuin Abarim molsang ho-a kon chun Moab phaicham Jordan gal Jericho naijah gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: They left the mountains of Abarim and camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

source: Chuin Jordan gal Moab phaichama um Beth-jesimoth apat Abel-shittim geichun gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: There on the plains of Moab they camped along the Jordan from Beth Jeshimoth to Abel Shittim.

source: Chuin Moab phaicham, Jordan gal, Jericho naija chun Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,.
target: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho the Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate henga chun seipeh inlang, hitihin seijin, Nangho Jordan nagalkaijuva Canaan gamsung nalhun tenguleh;
target: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you cross the Jordan into Canaan,

source: Nanghon namasanguva um agam neiho chu nadeldoh uva, chule amilim hou nasuhmang peh dingu, alim semthu a-pathen hou nasuhmanguva, chule amun thenghou nasuhlhuh diu ahi:
target: drive out all the inhabitants of the land before you. Destroy all their carved images and their cast idols, and demolish all their high places.

source: Chule agama cheng miho chu nadeldoh uva, hia chu nachendiu ahi: ajehchu keiman gam chu nalo dinguva kapeh-u nahi.
target: Take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given you the land to possess.

source: Chule nanghon agam chu vang nasan uva na-insung kailhah dungjui cheh-a nakihop dingu ahi. Chule atamte chu natam peh uva, chule alhomte chu nalhom pehdiu: amitakip min avang san dungjui cheh-a mun chu aloding, napu napateu phung dungjuija nalo dingu ahi.
target: Distribute the land by lot, according to your clans. To a larger group give a larger inheritance, and to a smaller group a smaller one. Whatever falls to them by lot will be theirs. Distribute it according to your ancestral tribes.

source: Ahinla nanghon agama cheng miho na masang uva kona nadeldoh louvule, hung hiti ding ahi: nanghon na-umden sahhou chun namit uva dinga moljuma panguva, napang peh uva dinga linga pangdingu, chule nachen nao gama chu nasunoh phah uva hungpang diu ahi.
target: “ ‘But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land, those you allow to remain will become barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will give you trouble in the land where you will live.

source: Chukalvalla jong hung hitiding ahi, amaho chunga boldinga kanagel banga chu nangho chunga kabolding ahi.
target: And then I will do to you what I plan to do to them.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati.
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate thu penlang, chule ajah uva hitin seijin, Nangho Canaan gamsunga nalut tengule, (hichehi nangho lodinga hunglha ding gam chu ahin, Canaan gam agamgi chin hotoh hitha ding ahi).
target: “Command the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you enter Canaan, the land that will be allotted to you as an inheritance is to have these boundaries:

source: Lhanglama nagamgi dingu chu Zin gamthipma pat Edom gamgi chin gei hiding, chule lhanglam sang gamgi chu Chi dil solam among gei hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘Your southern side will include some of the Desert of Zin along the border of Edom. Your southern boundary will start in the east from the southern end of the Dead Sea,

source: Chule nagamgiu chu lhanglama Akrabbim kaltouna-a patna hung kiheidoh-a, Zina galkai ding; chule Kadesh-barnea lhanglama chepeh ding, chule Hazar-addar'a cheding, chule Azmon galkai ding ahi.
target: cross south of Scorpion Pass, continue on to Zin and go south of Kadesh Barnea. Then it will go to Hazar Addar and over to Azmon,

source: Chule agamu ngahna chu Azmon'a patna Egypt vadung geija akolding, ahung kikhodoh ho chu twipia kinga ding ahi.
target: where it will turn, join the Wadi of Egypt and end at the Mediterranean Sea.

source: Chule lhumlam gamgi ding chu, agamgi-a dinga twipilen naman diu; hichehi lhumlama nagamgiu hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘Your western boundary will be the coast of the Mediterranean Sea. This will be your boundary on the west.

source: Chule nangho sahlam gamgi ding chu, twipilen'a kona Hor molsang chan hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘For your northern boundary, run a line from the Mediterranean Sea to Mount Hor

source: Hor molsanga kona nanghon Hamath lutna geichu namelchih peh dingu; nangho gamgi kilhungdoh chu Zedad'a kilhung lutding ahi.
target: and from Mount Hor to Lebo Hamath. Then the boundary will go to Zedad,

source: Chule agamgi chu Ziphron geija kilhunga, Hazarenan'a kilhunglut ding; hichu sahlama nagamgiu hiding ahi.
target: continue to Ziphron and end at Hazar Enan. This will be your boundary on the north.

source: Chule nangho solam gamgi chu Hazarenan'a patna Shepham geija namelchih diu,
target: “ ‘For your eastern boundary, run a line from Hazar Enan to Shepham.

source: Chule gamgi chu Shepham'a pat A-in solam sanga Riblah'a kilhunglha ding, chule agamgi chu kilhungsuh-a, Chinnereth solam dil gei lhungding,
target: The boundary will go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain and continue along the slopes east of the Sea of Galilee.

source: Chule agamgi chu Jordan geija kilhung lha-a, chule akilhungdoh ho Chi twipia kilhunglut ding; hichu nangma gam kimvela nagamgi hiding ahi.
target: Then the boundary will go down along the Jordan and end at the Dead Sea. “ ‘This will be your land, with its boundaries on every side.’ ”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Israel chate thu apen, Hiche gamhi nanghon vang sanna nalodiuva Pakaiyin phung ko hole phung kehkhat ho anapeh chu ahi.
target: Moses commanded the Israelites: “Assign this land by lot as an inheritance. The Lord has ordered that it be given to the nine-and-a-half tribes,

source: Reuben chate aphung kailhah le apu apateu insung dungjuija, chule Gad chate aphung kailhah le apu apateu insung dungjuija, amahon alodingu gou chu amu-u ahitai, chule Manasseh phung keh khat jong aloding dolu chu changa ahitaove:
target: because the families of the tribe of Reuben, the tribe of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.

source: Phung nile phung keh khat hochun achandingu chu Jordan hilamsang, Jericho nai solamsang, nisa sona lamsang amutaovin ahi, ati.
target: These two-and-a-half tribes have received their inheritance east of the Jordan across from Jericho, toward the sunrise.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,.
target: The Lord said to Moses,

source: Hichehohi nanghon nalodingu gam nahop khenpeh dinghou min chu: Eleazar thempupa le Nun chapa Joshua ahi.
target: “These are the names of the men who are to assign the land for you as an inheritance: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.

source: Chule nangman nalodiu gam hopkhen peh dinga aphung takipma kona pipui khat cheh nalhendoh dingu ahi.
target: And appoint one leader from each tribe to help assign the land.

source: Amaho min chu hiche hi ahi: Judah phunga Jephunneh chapa Caleb;
target: These are their names: Caleb son of Jephunneh, from the tribe of Judah;

source: Simeon chate phunga, Ammihud chapa Shemuel;
target: Shemuel son of Ammihud, from the tribe of Simeon;

source: Benjamin phunga kona Chislon chapa Elidad;
target: Elidad son of Kislon, from the tribe of Benjamin;

source: Chule Dan chate phung lamkai Jogli chapa Bukki;
target: Bukki son of Jogli, the leader from the tribe of Dan;

source: Joseph chate phung lamkai, Manasseh chate phunga dingin, Ephod chapa Hanniel;
target: Hanniel son of Ephod, the leader from the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph;

source: Chule Ephraim chate aphung lamkai, Shiphtan chapa Kemuel;
target: Kemuel son of Shiphtan, the leader from the tribe of Ephraim son of Joseph;

source: Chule Zebulun chate phung lamkai, Parnach chapa Elizaphan;
target: Elizaphan son of Parnak, the leader from the tribe of Zebulun;

source: Chule Issachar chate phung lamkai, Azzan chapa Paltiel;
target: Paltiel son of Azzan, the leader from the tribe of Issachar;

source: Chule Asher chate phung lamkai, Shelomi chapa Ahihud;
target: Ahihud son of Shelomi, the leader from the tribe of Asher;

source: Chule Naphtali chate phung lamkai, Ammihud chapa Pedahel ahi.
target: Pedahel son of Ammihud, the leader from the tribe of Naphtali.”

source: Hichehohi Pakaiyin Canaan gama Israel chate gouchan hoppeh dinga athupeh hochu ahi.
target: These are the men the Lord commanded to assign the inheritance to the Israelites in the land of Canaan.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Moab phaicham Jordan gal Jericho naija chun Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati.
target: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, the Lord said to Moses,

source: Israel chate chu agou chanhou lah-a kona Levi miho chen nading khopi apeh nadingun thu pen, chule nanghon Levi miho chu khopiho kimvela gam op-ho chu napeh dingu ahi.
target: “Command the Israelites to give the Levites towns to live in from the inheritance the Israelites will possess. And give them pasturelands around the towns.

source: Chule khopiho chu achenna dingu hintin, chule agam op-hou chu agancha hou, athilkeu hou, aganhing hou jouse-a ding hiding ahi.
target: Then they will have towns to live in and pasturelands for the cattle they own and all their other animals.

source: Chule nanghon Levi miho napeh dingu gam op-ho chu, khopi kulbanga pat polam tong sangkhat kimvel hiding ahi.
target: “The pasturelands around the towns that you give the Levites will extend a thousand cubits from the town wall.

source: Chule khopiho pamlam chu nate dingu, solam sanga tong sangni, lhanglam sanga tong sangni, lhumlam sanga tong sangni, chule chunglam sanga tong sangni hiding, akhopi chu alailunga umding, hichehohi amaho dinga khopiho gam-op hiding ahi.
target: Outside the town, measure two thousand cubits on the east side, two thousand on the south side, two thousand on the west and two thousand on the north, with the town in the center. They will have this area as pastureland for the towns.

source: Chule nangman Levi miho napehding khopiho lah-a chu hoidohna khopi gup, tolthatpa jamlutna dinga nalhendoh ding; chule amaho dinga khopi somlileni nabedingu ahi.
target: “Six of the towns you give the Levites will be cities of refuge, to which a person who has killed someone may flee. In addition, give them forty-two other towns.

source: Chitia chu Levi miho napeh dingu khopiho jouse chu khopi somlileget hiding, amaho chu agam op-toh napehtha diu ahi.
target: In all you must give the Levites forty-eight towns, together with their pasturelands.

source: Chule nanghon napeh diu khopiho chu Israel chate losa ho-a kon hiding; atam neiho-a kona natampeh diu, alhom neiho-a kona nalhom pehdiu: amitakip min Levi miho chu analo akhopihou dungjui cheh-a apeh dingu ahi, ati.
target: The towns you give the Levites from the land the Israelites possess are to be given in proportion to the inheritance of each tribe: Take many towns from a tribe that has many, but few from one that has few.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi henga thu aseijin, hitin ati,.
target: Then the Lord said to Moses:

source: Israel chate henga thu seijin lang, ajah uva, Nangho Jordan gal Canaan gamsung nahung galkai tengule,
target: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you cross the Jordan into Canaan,

source: Nanghon nangho dinga hoidohna khopi dinga khopiho na kilhendoh diu; chutia chu kiningman louva khattou tolthatna chu chulama jamthei ding ahi.
target: select some towns to be your cities of refuge, to which a person who has killed someone accidentally may flee.

source: Chule hicheho chu nangho-a dinga phula dingho-a kona nahoidohna diu hiding; houkhom ho thutanna anga adin tokahse-a mithat chu athi louna ding hiding ahi.
target: They will be places of refuge from the avenger, so that anyone accused of murder may not die before they stand trial before the assembly.

source: Chule nanghon napehdiu khopi holah-a kona gup chu nangho dinga hoidohna hiding ahi.
target: These six towns you give will be your cities of refuge.

source: Nanghon Jordan hilam sanga khopi thum napeh uva, Canaan gamsunga khopi thum napeh diu; hichu hoidohna khopi ho hiding ahi.
target: Give three on this side of the Jordan and three in Canaan as cities of refuge.

source: Hicheng khopi gup chu, Israel chate le namdang hoding, chule alah uva khopemdenho agomuva dinga hoidohna hiding, kiningman louva tolthat chan chulama jamthei ahi.
target: These six towns will be a place of refuge for Israelites and for foreigners residing among them, so that anyone who has killed another accidentally can flee there.

source: Chule aman thih manchah khatna amachu avoh-a, athitah-a ahile, ama chu tolthat ahitan; tolthat chu thatei teiding ahi.
target: “ ‘If anyone strikes someone a fatal blow with an iron object, that person is a murderer; the murderer is to be put to death.

source: Chule athina theija, aman songa asekhah-a, athitah-a ahile, ama chu tolthat ahitan; tolthat chu thatei tei ding ahi.
target: Or if anyone is holding a stone and strikes someone a fatal blow with it, that person is a murderer; the murderer is to be put to death.

source: Ahiloule aman thina khopma thing manchah khutchoi khatna avoh-a, ama athi tah-a ahile, ama chu tolthat ahintan; tolthat chu thatei teiding ahi.
target: Or if anyone is holding a wooden object and strikes someone a fatal blow with it, that person is a murderer; the murderer is to be put to death.

source: Thisan phulapa amatah chun tolthatpa athading; aman ama chu amu mule atha ding ahi.
target: The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death; when the avenger comes upon the murderer, the avenger shall put the murderer to death.

source: Ahinla muda mana asotlhuh ham, ahiloule achanlhih-a thilkhat touva asea, athitah-a ahile,
target: If anyone with malice aforethought shoves another or throws something at them intentionally so that they die

source: Ahiloule kidouna jeh-a akhutna avoh-a, ama athitah le; ama vopenpa chu thatei teiding ahi. Ajehchu ama tolthat ahitan: thisan phulapa chun amuteng le atha ding ahi.
target: or if out of enmity one person hits another with their fist so that the other dies, that person is to be put to death; that person is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when they meet.

source: Ahinla aman amachu kidouna beija hetman louva asotlhuh ham, ahiloule changlhi louva ama chunga thil khattou asekhuma ahile,
target: “ ‘But if without enmity someone suddenly pushes another or throws something at them unintentionally

source: Ahiloule mikhat thinathei khop song khat touva amapa chu mulouva asekhah-a, ama athitah-a; ahia ama chu akidoupi jong hilou chule suhgenthei dia jong ahol hilou ahile,
target: or, without seeing them, drops on them a stone heavy enough to kill them, and they die, then since that other person was not an enemy and no harm was intended,

source: Houkhom ho chun mithat pale thisan phulapa kikah-a thutanna dan dungjuija thu atan dingu ahi.
target: the assembly must judge between the accused and the avenger of blood according to these regulations.

source: Chule houkhom ho chun mi thatpa chu thisan phulapa khutna kona ahuhdoh uva, houkhom ho chun ama chu ajamna hoidohna khopi-a chu agathah diu; chule ama chukoma chu thaotheng kinu thempu chungnungpa thi kahse-a umjing ding ahi.
target: The assembly must protect the one accused of murder from the avenger of blood and send the accused back to the city of refuge to which they fled. The accused must stay there until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

source: Ahinla tolthat pa chu ajamna lam, ahoidohna khopi gamgi pam polama, ahungpotdoh khah-a;
target: “ ‘But if the accused ever goes outside the limits of the city of refuge to which they fled

source: Chule thisan phulapa chun hoidohna khopi polama amapa chu amua, thisan phulapan mithatpa chu atha-a ahile; amachu thisana themmo chang louding ahi.
target: and the avenger of blood finds them outside the city, the avenger of blood may kill the accused without being guilty of murder.

source: Ajehchu ama hoidohna khopi sunga chu thempu chungnung thi tokahse-a umthim behding ahin, thempu chungnung thi nung teng vangle mithatpa chu alosa agam sunga hung kinung lekit ding ahi.
target: The accused must stay in the city of refuge until the death of the high priest; only after the death of the high priest may they return to their own property.

source: Chutichun hicheng jousehi nangho dinga nakhang khanguva, nachena mun jouseuva chondan hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘This is to have the force of law for you throughout the generations to come, wherever you live.

source: Koi hijongle mi khattou thatna aumle tolthatpa chu ahetoh ho kama kona thajeng ding ahi. Ahinla mikhattou thana dinga achunga hettohsah khatnin photchena aneilou ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Anyone who kills a person is to be put to death as a murderer only on the testimony of witnesses. But no one is to be put to death on the testimony of only one witness.

source: Chukal vallin nanghon thinakhop hella mochang tolthat chu lhatdohna dinga kilhatdohna nalah lou dingu ahi, ajehchu ama chu thatei teiding joh ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not accept a ransom for the life of a murderer, who deserves to die. They are to be put to death.

source: Chule hoidohna kulpi-a jampa chu thempupa thikah-a, gamsunga chengdia ahung kile theina dinga, ama dinga kilhatdohna nalah theilou diu ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not accept a ransom for anyone who has fled to a city of refuge and so allow them to go back and live on their own land before the death of the high priest.

source: Hitia chu nanghon nachen nao gam chu nasuh boh loudiu, thisan jeh-a gam chu boh-a ahin; thisan lonna gam chu kisutheng joulou ahin; amavang thisan sopa thisana bou kisutheng thei ahi.
target: “ ‘Do not pollute the land where you are. Bloodshed pollutes the land, and atonement cannot be made for the land on which blood has been shed, except by the blood of the one who shed it.

source: Hijeh chun nachena diu gam, keima chenna chu suboh hih-un: ajehchu keima Pakai Israel chate lah-a cheng jinga chu kahi.
target: Do not defile the land where you live and where I dwell, for I, the Lord , dwell among the Israelites.’ ”

source: Chuin Gilead chate insung mi upaho, Machir chapa Manasseh chapa Joseph chapate insung miho chun, Mosi angle lamkai ho anga, Israel chate upaho masang ahin naijun, aseitaovin ahi:
target: The family heads of the clan of Gilead son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, who were from the clans of the descendants of Joseph, came and spoke before Moses and the leaders, the heads of the Israelite families.

source: Chuin amahon, Chaten vang sanna alodiu gam chu pedingin Pakaiyin ka pakai thu anapen; chule kasopipa Zelophehad gouchan chu achanute pehdingin ka pakai hi Pakaiyin ana thupeh tai.
target: They said, “When the Lord commanded my lord to give the land as an inheritance to the Israelites by lot, he ordered you to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.

source: Tun amaho chu Israel chate phung dangho chatetoh kicheng tale, agou loding hou chu kapa tehouva kona kiladoh-a amaho kichenpi phungho gouchan chuto kigoppeh ding ahin; chutia chu vang dungjuija kagou chanuva kona kiladoh ding ahitai;
target: Now suppose they marry men from other Israelite tribes; then their inheritance will be taken from our ancestral inheritance and added to that of the tribe they marry into. And so part of the inheritance allotted to us will be taken away.

source: Chule Israel chate Jubilee ahunghi tengle, amaho gouchu amahon akichenpiu phungho gou chutoh kigop thading ahitan; chutia chu amaho gou chu kapu kapatehou phungho goulah-a kona kiladoh ding ahitai, atiuve.
target: When the Year of Jubilee for the Israelites comes, their inheritance will be added to that of the tribe into which they marry, and their property will be taken from the tribal inheritance of our ancestors.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Israel chate chu Pakai thupeh dungjuijin thu apen, hitin ati, Joseph chapateho phungin aseiju chu adih lheh-e.
target: Then at the Lord ’s command Moses gave this order to the Israelites: “What the tribe of the descendants of Joseph is saying is right.

source: Zelophehad chanuho chungchanga Pakaiyin thu apeh chu hitihi ahi, Amaho pha asah penpenu chutoh kichengu hen, ahinla apu apateu phung sunga ho kichen piu hen:
target: This is what the Lord commands for Zelophehad’s daughters: They may marry anyone they please as long as they marry within their father’s tribal clan.

source: Chuti chu Israel chate gouchan chu phung khatna kona phung khatna kichon lele louding ahi; ajehchu Israel chate tapou chun amatah-in apu apatehou gou chu anga dingu ahi.
target: No inheritance in Israel is to pass from one tribe to another, for every Israelite shall keep the tribal inheritance of their ancestors.

source: Chule chanu tapou, Israel chate sung koiphung hitale gouloa chun, hiche apa phung insung khatna chu inneipi hiding, hitia chu Israel chate takip min apu apateu gou chu alothei dingu ahi.
target: Every daughter who inherits land in any Israelite tribe must marry someone in her father’s tribal clan, so that every Israelite will possess the inheritance of their ancestors.

source: Gou chu phung khatna kona phung khatna kichon lele louding; amavang Israel chate phung khat cheh chun ama ama gou akinga dingu ahi, ati.
target: No inheritance may pass from one tribe to another, for each Israelite tribe is to keep the land it inherits.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh bangchun Zelophehad chanute chun abol taove;
target: So Zelophehad’s daughters did as the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Ajehchu Zelophehad chanute Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milkah, Noah chu apateo sopiho chapate toh akicheng taovin ahi.
target: Zelophehad’s daughters—Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milkah and Noah—married their cousins on their father’s side.

source: Chuin amaho Joseph chapa Manasseh chapate insung miho toh akicheng taovin, agouhou chu apateu insung phunga chun aumdentan ahi.
target: They married within the clans of the descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in their father’s tribe and clan.

source: Hicheho hi Jericho naija Jordan pang Moab phaija Israel chate henga Mosi khutna Pakai thupeh, thupeh ho le thutannaho chu ahi.
target: These are the commands and regulations the Lord gave through Moses to the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

source: Hiche thuho hi Mosi'n Israelte jouse henga Jordan gal gamthip hilam sang, twipisan gal Paran le Tophel, Laban le Hazeroth, chule Dizahah kikah phaichama asei ahi.
target: These are the words Moses spoke to all Israel in the wilderness east of the Jordan—that is, in the Arabah—opposite Suph, between Paran and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth and Dizahab.

source: (Seir molsang lampi jotna-a ichele Horeb'a pat Kadesh-barnea gei chu nisomle nikhat lam ahi.)
target: (It takes eleven days to go from Horeb to Kadesh Barnea by the Mount Seir road.)

source: Chuin kum somli lhin na-in ahitin ahi, lhasom le lhakhat lhina, chuche lha nimasa nichun, Pakaiyin amaho peh dinga ahenga athupeh jouse dungjui chun Mosi'n Israel chate henga aseijin,
target: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses proclaimed to the Israelites all that the Lord had commanded him concerning them.

source: Hichu Heshbon'a cheng Amor lengpa Sihon le, Edrei sunga Astaroth'a cheng Bashan lengpa Og atha jou ahi.
target: This was after he had defeated Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, and at Edrei had defeated Og king of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth.

source: Moab gam sung Jordan pang hilam sanga, Mosi'n hiche danthu hi aphongdoh panin, hitin ati.
target: East of the Jordan in the territory of Moab, Moses began to expound this law, saying:

source: Pakai i-Pathen'un Horeb molsanga chun ijah uva aseijin, Nangho hiche molsanga nachamsot behseh taove:
target: The Lord our God said to us at Horeb, “You have stayed long enough at this mountain.

source: Kiheijun lang, nakholjin ban jom taovin, chule Amor mite molsang le akom naija um mun jouse-a, phaichama, thinglhanga, dama, lhanglama, chule twilen panga, Canaan mite gama, chule Lebanon gei, twipi, Euphrate vapi geijin cheovin.
target: Break camp and advance into the hill country of the Amorites; go to all the neighboring peoples in the Arabah, in the mountains, in the western foothills, in the Negev and along the coast, to the land of the Canaanites and to Lebanon, as far as the great river, the Euphrates.

source: Veovin namasanguva gam kakoi peh uve; Pakaiyin napu napateu Abraham, Isaac, Jacob henga pehding le amaho nunga achilhahte peh dinga ana kihahsel nagam chu galo taovin.
target: See, I have given you this land. Go in and take possession of the land the Lord swore he would give to your fathers—to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob—and to their descendants after them.”

source: Chule hiche laichun naheng uva kana seijin, Keiman kachang seh-in nangho napojou pou vinge;
target: At that time I said to you, “You are too heavy a burden for me to carry alone.

source: Pakai na Pathen'un nangho napunsah taovin, chule veuvin, tunvang natam danu chu van'a ahsi ho jatjen nahitaove.
target: The Lord your God has increased your numbers so that today you are as numerous as the stars in the sky.

source: (Napu napateu Pakai Pathen'u chun athutep bangin tu-a sanghin ajat sang khatnin napunsah beu henlang, phatthei naboh-u hen.)
target: May the Lord , the God of your ancestors, increase you a thousand times and bless you as he has promised!

source: Kei changseh in naboinao, napohgih-u, nakiphin nao iti kapohjou dingham?
target: But how can I bear your problems and your burdens and your disputes all by myself?

source: Nanghon naphung sunguva michingho, ahethemho, chule mihet ho lhengdoh unlang, keiman amaho chu nachung uva vaihomin seminge, tin kanaseijin ahi.
target: Choose some wise, understanding and respected men from each of your tribes, and I will set them over you.”

source: Chule nanghon, Nangman naseiho hi keihon kabol dinguva pha ahi, tin neidonbut un ahi.
target: You answered me, “What you propose to do is good.”

source: Hijeh chun keiman naphung pipuihou, michingho, mihet ho chu kalheng doh-in, nachung uva vaihomin kapansah-in, sangkhat chunga, jakhat chunga, somnga chunga, chule somkhat chunga lamkai dingleh, naphung sunguva vaipon kapansah tan ahi.
target: So I took the leading men of your tribes, wise and respected men, and appointed them to have authority over you—as commanders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties and of tens and as tribal officials.

source: Chule hiche laichun keiman nathutan vaihomhou chu thu kanapen, ajah uva, Nasopi ho kah-a aboina hou chu ngaipeh unlang, mijouse leh asopipa kikah, ahiloule nalah uva um gamdangmi kikah-a chun chonphat na-in thu tanun.
target: And I charged your judges at that time, “Hear the disputes between your people and judge fairly, whether the case is between two Israelites or between an Israelite and a foreigner residing among you.

source: Thutan na-a maipha navetlou dingu; amavang alen thu nangai banguva aneo thujong nangaidiu; mihem maija kichatna naneilou dingu ahi; ajehchu thutanna chu Pathen'a ahi. Chule nangho dinga thuhahsa behsetho chu kaheng hinlhutnun, keiman ngailha nange, tin kana seijin ahi.
target: Do not show partiality in judging; hear both small and great alike. Do not be afraid of anyone, for judgment belongs to God. Bring me any case too hard for you, and I will hear it.”

source: Chule hiche laichun keiman naboldiu jouse kana thupeh jiuvin ahi.
target: And at that time I told you everything you were to do.

source: Chuin Pakai i-Pathen'uvin thu einapeh bangun, Horeb molsanga kon ikipatdoh-un, Amor mite molsang lampia namu-u gamthip lentah le gimneitah jouse chu ijot lhung keijun, chuin Kadesh-barnea iga lhung taove.
target: Then, as the Lord our God commanded us, we set out from Horeb and went toward the hill country of the Amorites through all that vast and dreadful wilderness that you have seen, and so we reached Kadesh Barnea.

source: Chuin keiman naheng uva, Nangho Pakai i-Pathen'uvin eipehnao Amor mite molsang chu nalhung taove.
target: Then I said to you, “You have reached the hill country of the Amorites, which the Lord our God is giving us.

source: Veovin, Pakai na Pathen'un namasanguva gamchu nakoipeh uve. Chetou vinlang napu napateu Pathen'in naheng uva aseibangin galo jengun; kicha hih-un, lungjong lungthoi hih-un, tin kanaseijin ahi.
target: See, the Lord your God has given you the land. Go up and take possession of it as the Lord , the God of your ancestors, told you. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged.”

source: Chule amitakip kahenga nahungnaijun, kajah-a, Keihon imasanguva mi solung ting, amahon gam chu gakhol toh-uhen lang, ipi lampia ichetou uva, ipi khopi-a ilut diuham? tithu hinpo hen, nati uvin ahi.
target: Then all of you came to me and said, “Let us send men ahead to spy out the land for us and bring back a report about the route we are to take and the towns we will come to.”

source: Chule akisei chun eilung lhaisah lheh-in; chuin keiman nalah uva mi somleni, phung khatna mikhat cheh kalheng doh-in ahi.
target: The idea seemed good to me; so I selected twelve of you, one man from each tribe.

source: Chuin amaho akiheijun, molsang lama chun akal touvun, Eshcol phaichama ahungun, akholle taovin ahi.
target: They left and went up into the hill country, and came to the Valley of Eshkol and explored it.

source: Chule amahon agamga akhutnun ahin loh-un, ihenguva ahin pohsuh peh-un, chule thu ahinpouvin, Pakai i-Pathen'un eipeh-u chu gampha ahi, atiuve.
target: Taking with them some of the fruit of the land, they brought it down to us and reported, “It is a good land that the Lord our God is giving us.”

source: Achuti vangin nangho chetou ding nanom pouvin, Pakai i-Pathen'u thupeh chu nadou jouvin ahi.
target: But you were unwilling to go up; you rebelled against the command of the Lord your God.

source: Chule napon in sunguva naphun chelun, Pakaiyin eithet jeh uva suhmang dinga Amor mite khutna pehlut dinga, Egypt gama kona eipuidoh-u ahi.
target: You grumbled in your tents and said, “The Lord hates us; so he brought us out of Egypt to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites to destroy us.

source: Hoilama ichetou diuham? Isopihou vin, Miho chu alentheijun, eiho sangin asang jouvin, khopi hochu alentheijin, van geija pal akikho touvin ahi; chukal valin chua chun Anakim chapate kaga mu uvin ahi, tin ilungu asudoijun ahi, nati uve.
target: Where can we go? Our brothers have made our hearts melt in fear. They say, ‘The people are stronger and taller than we are; the cities are large, with walls up to the sky. We even saw the Anakites there.’ ”

source: Chujouvin keiman najah uva, Amaho chu ginghih-un, kijong kicha hih-un.
target: Then I said to you, “Do not be terrified; do not be afraid of them.

source: Namasanguva che Pakai na Pathen'u chun namitmu tah uva Egypt gama nangho dinga nabolpeh hou jouse dungjuijin gal satpeh naovin nate.
target: The Lord your God, who is going before you, will fight for you, as he did for you in Egypt, before your very eyes,

source: Chule gamthipma min acha apoh banga, Pakai na Pathen'un hiche munhi nalhun kahseuva, lampi jouse-a iti napoh-u ham chu namu taove.
target: and in the wilderness. There you saw how the Lord your God carried you, as a father carries his son, all the way you went until you reached this place.”

source: Ahin hichan geihin jong Pakai na Pathen'u chu natahsan pouvin;
target: In spite of this, you did not trust in the Lord your God,

source: Naponbuh son nadiu mun holdohpeh dingle, nachenao lampi musah dinga, jan le meikonga, sunle meilhanga namasang uva chepa chu natahsan deh pouve.
target: who went ahead of you on your journey, in fire by night and in a cloud by day, to search out places for you to camp and to show you the way you should go.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin nathu seiju ajan, alungsatan, akihah selin, hitin ati.
target: When the Lord heard what you said, he was angry and solemnly swore:

source: Tahbeh-a hiche khang gilou mite khatchan jong napu napateu pehdia kahah selna gampha chu amulou heldiu ahi.
target: “No one from this evil generation shall see the good land I swore to give your ancestors,

source: Jephunneh chapa Kaleb tailou: aman hichu amuding, chule agachotsa gam chu amale achilhahte kapeh ding ahi; ajehchu aman Pakai chu ajuikim helin ahi, ati.
target: except Caleb son of Jephunneh. He will see it, and I will give him and his descendants the land he set his feet on, because he followed the Lord wholeheartedly.”

source: Nangho jal-in Pakai chu keichunga alung hangin, Nangma jengjong chumuna chu nalut louding ahi.
target: Because of you the Lord became angry with me also and said, “You shall not enter it, either.

source: Ahin namasanga ding Nun chapa Joshua, amachu lutding ahi. Ama chu tilkhouvin; ajehchu aman hiche gam chu Israel alosah ding ahi.
target: But your assistant, Joshua son of Nun, will enter it. Encourage him, because he will lead Israel to inherit it.

source: Chukal valin, Anchah dingbep ahi natiu nachasen houleh, chuche laija sele pha hekhen loulai nachateo hochu chua lut dingu, chule keiman kapeh-a, amahon alo dingu ahi.
target: And the little ones that you said would be taken captive, your children who do not yet know good from bad—they will enter the land. I will give it to them and they will take possession of it.

source: Ahin nangho vang kiheijunlang, twipisan lampi gamthip lama nakholjin ban jom taovin, ati.
target: But as for you, turn around and set out toward the desert along the route to the Red Sea.”

source: Chuphatnin nanghon nei donbutnun, kahenga, Pakai dounan kachonse taove, Pakai ka Pathen'un eithupeh jouseu dungjuijin chetaoving ting, galsatnu vinge, nati uve. Chuin amitakip min agalvon nakivoncheh phatnun, thinglhang lama kaldin phasademin na-umtaove.
target: Then you replied, “We have sinned against the Lord . We will go up and fight, as the Lord our God commanded us.” So every one of you put on his weapons, thinking it easy to go up into the hill country.

source: Ahin Pakaiyin kahenga, Chetou hih-un, chule galjong gasat hih-un; ajehchu keima nalah uva kaumpoi: achutiloule nagalteu masanga gal lel getnun nate, tin seipeh-in eiti.
target: But the Lord said to me, “Tell them, ‘Do not go up and fight, because I will not be with you. You will be defeated by your enemies.’ ”

source: Hijeh chun najah uva kaseipeh-un; chule nanghon nangai pouvin, ahin Pakai thupeh dounan nagolkeh-un, hangtah-in thinglhang lama nakaltou taove.
target: So I told you, but you would not listen. You rebelled against the Lord ’s command and in your arrogance you marched up into the hill country.

source: Chuin hiche molsanga cheng Amor mite chu nangho dou dingin ahungkon doh-un, khoihon mi adel bangin nahin delun, Seir gei le Hormah geijin nathatnun ahi.
target: The Amorites who lived in those hills came out against you; they chased you like a swarm of bees and beat you down from Seir all the way to Hormah.

source: Chuin nahung kileuvin, Pakai masanga nakap-un; ahinla Pakaiyin na-aw-u nangaipeh pouvin, anakhang jong nasunpeh pouve.
target: You came back and wept before the Lord , but he paid no attention to your weeping and turned a deaf ear to you.

source: Chuti chun chuche mun'a nagasuhmangu nikhoho dungjuijin Kadesh mun'a nisot tah naum denun ahi.
target: And so you stayed in Kadesh many days—all the time you spent there.

source: Chujouvin Pakaiyin kahenga asei bangin iki heijun, twipisan lampia gamthiplam jonin ikhol jinun, chule Seir molsang chu nikho tamtah ivelkolun ahi.
target: Then we turned back and set out toward the wilderness along the route to the Red Sea, as the Lord had directed me. For a long time we made our way around the hill country of Seir.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga aseijin, hitin ati;
target: Then the Lord said to me,

source: Nanghon hiche molsang hi navelsot behset taove; sahlam sanga kiheijun,
target: “You have made your way around this hill country long enough; now turn north.

source: Chule nangman mipi chu thu penlang, Seir'a cheng nasopi hou Esau chate gamsung najotdiu; amahon nakichat diu ahi; hijeh chun nangho chingthei tah-in umun;
target: Give the people these orders: ‘You are about to pass through the territory of your relatives the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. They will be afraid of you, but be very careful.

source: Amaho toh kina hih-un, ajehchu keiman agamu chu nangho kapeh louding, kengphang te jong kapeh louhel ding nahiuve; ajehchu Seir molsang chu Esau lodia kanapeh ahitai.
target: Do not provoke them to war, for I will not give you any of their land, not even enough to put your foot on. I have given Esau the hill country of Seir as his own.

source: Nanghon naneh dingu an-neh chu amahoa kona suma nakichoh uva nanehdiu, chule nadon diu jong suma nakichoh uva nadondiu ahi.
target: You are to pay them in silver for the food you eat and the water you drink.’ ”

source: Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'un nakhut uva natoh jouseu phatthei aboh-in, chule gamthip lentah najotnu chu ahen ahi. Hiche kum somli sunghin Pakai na Pathen'un na-umpiuvin, lhahsamna imacha nanei pouvin ahi.
target: The Lord your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has watched over your journey through this vast wilderness. These forty years the Lord your God has been with you, and you have not lacked anything.

source: Chuin Eloth le Ezion-gober'a pat phaicham lampi jotna-in Seir'a cheng Esau chilhah isopiteu gamchu ipal pouvin, ikiheijun Moab gamthip lampia iki tolun ahi.
target: So we went on past our relatives the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. We turned from the Arabah road, which comes up from Elath and Ezion Geber, and traveled along the desert road of Moab.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga, Moab chu sugim hih-un, gal'in jong kisatpi hih-un; ajehchu agamu chu nalodiuva kapeh louding nahiuve; ajehchu Ar chu Lot chilhahte kapeh ahitai, ati.
target: Then the Lord said to me, “Do not harass the Moabites or provoke them to war, for I will not give you any part of their land. I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as a possession.”

source: Masangin chua chun Anakim te banga len, tam le, sanga Emim mite ana chengun ahi.
target: (The Emites used to live there—a people strong and numerous, and as tall as the Anakites.

source: Amaho jong chu Anakim ho banga mihatna sim ahiuvin; Moab miten vang, Emim tin amin sah-un ahi.
target: Like the Anakites, they too were considered Rephaites, but the Moabites called them Emites.

source: Masangin Seir'a hin Hor miho jong anachengun; ahinla Pakaiyin amaho apeh gam Israel'in analo bang chun, Esau chaten amasanguva konin asumangin, alopaijun, amaho khelin acheng taove.
target: Horites used to live in Seir, but the descendants of Esau drove them out. They destroyed the Horites from before them and settled in their place, just as Israel did in the land the Lord gave them as their possession.)

source: Tun kipatdoh-un lang Zered vachadung chu galkaijuvin, tin kaseijin; chuin Zered vachadung chu igalkai taove.
target: And the Lord said, “Now get up and cross the Zered Valley.” So we crossed the valley.

source: Chule Kadesh-barnea idalhah uva pat Zered vacha igalkai geiju, Pakaiyin ahahsel nao banga janel lah-a kona gal hat ho khang kichaihel tokah chu kum somthum le kumget ahi.
target: Thirty-eight years passed from the time we left Kadesh Barnea until we crossed the Zered Valley. By then, that entire generation of fighting men had perished from the camp, as the Lord had sworn to them.

source: Ajehchu amanthah hel tokah uva, janel lah-a kona sumang dinga Pakai khut chun amaho anadou tahbeh ahi.
target: The Lord ’s hand was against them until he had completely eliminated them from the camp.

source: Hijeh chun ahitin ahi, eiho lah-a kona galsat ho jouse amanthah heluva, chule athigam phatnun,
target: Now when the last of these fighting men among the people had died,

source: Pakaiyin kahenga hitin aseijin, hitin ati,
target: the Lord said to me,

source: Tunia hi nangman Moab gamsung Ar najotpaija nagalkai ding ahi;
target: “Today you are to pass by the region of Moab at Ar.

source: Chule Ammon chate naija nahung tengle, amaho chu sugenthei hih-in, chule kinah jong kinahpi hih-in; ajehchu Ammon chate gamchu nalodinga kapeh louding ahi; ajehchu Lot chate lo dia kanapehsa ahitai, ati.
target: When you come to the Ammonites, do not harass them or provoke them to war, for I will not give you possession of any land belonging to the Ammonites. I have given it as a possession to the descendants of Lot.”

source: (Hiche gam jongchu mihat ho gama anakisim ahin; hia chu mihat ho masang laija anacheng ahiuve; chule amaho chu Ammom miten Zamzummim anasah-uvin ahi.
target: (That too was considered a land of the Rephaites, who used to live there; but the Ammonites called them Zamzummites.

source: Anakim ho banga len, tam le sang ahiuve: ahinla Pakaiyin amaho chu amasanguva asumangin, amahon alopaijun, chule chu-a chun achengun:
target: They were a people strong and numerous, and as tall as the Anakites. The Lord destroyed them from before the Ammonites, who drove them out and settled in their place.

source: Seir'a cheng Esau chate-a dinga amasanguva kona Hor mite asuhmangpeh bangin abolpeh-in ahi: chuin amahon alopaijun, tuni geihin amaho khelin achengun ahi.
target: The Lord had done the same for the descendants of Esau, who lived in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them. They drove them out and have lived in their place to this day.

source: Chuin Hazerim le Azzah geipeh-a cheng Avim miho chu Caphtor-a kona hungdoh Caphtor miho chun asumangun, chule amaho khelin acheng taove).
target: And as for the Avvites who lived in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorites coming out from Caphtor destroyed them and settled in their place.)

source: Kipatdoh-un, nakholjin ban jomun lang, Arnon vapi galkaijun: veuvin, Amor mi Heshbon lengpa Sihon le agam chu nakhut na kapeh ahitai. Hichu lopanun lang gal'in kidoupiuvin.
target: “Set out now and cross the Arnon Gorge. See, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his country. Begin to take possession of it and engage him in battle.

source: Tunia hi vannoi pumpi-a um namho chunga nangma kichatna le ginna kakoi patding ahin; amahon nangma chungchang thu kilhut jaovintin, nangma jeh-a kithing uva, lung gentheidiu ahi.
target: This very day I will begin to put the terror and fear of you on all the nations under heaven. They will hear reports of you and will tremble and be in anguish because of you.”

source: Chuin Kedemoth gamthipma konin Heshbon lengpa Sihon henga chamna thu kengin sottol kasolin,
target: From the Desert of Kedemoth I sent messengers to Sihon king of Heshbon offering peace and saying,

source: Nagam sungu neijotpai sah-in, lamlhonga bou chengkatin, jet le veija jong kiheiponge;
target: “Let us pass through your country. We will stay on the main road; we will not turn aside to the right or to the left.

source: Nangman kaneh ding an sumin neichoh sah inlang, chule kadon ding twi jong sumin neichoh sah-in: kenga bou kagalkai dingu ahi.
target: Sell us food to eat and water to drink for their price in silver. Only let us pass through on foot—

source: (Seir'a cheng Esau chate le Ar'a cheng Moab chaten eibolna bangin,) Pakai ka Pathen'un eipehnao gam Jordan kagalkai kahseuva dingbou ahi, kati.
target: as the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir, and the Moabites, who live in Ar, did for us—until we cross the Jordan into the land the Lord our God is giving us.”

source: Ahinla Heshbon lengpa Sihon'in agam ijot galkai diuchu eiphalpeh pouve. Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen uvin tunikho-a banga hi nakhut nuva apehlut theina dinga alungu asuh tah-a, alouchal sah ahi.
target: But Sihon king of Heshbon refused to let us pass through. For the Lord your God had made his spirit stubborn and his heart obstinate in order to give him into your hands, as he has now done.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga, Vetan keiman Sihon le agam chu namasanga kape pantai: agama nachenthei nadin lo pantan, eiti.
target: The Lord said to me, “See, I have begun to deliver Sihon and his country over to you. Now begin to conquer and possess his land.”

source: Chujouvin Sihon amale amite jouse Jahaza'a eiho douna-a galsat din ahung kondoh taove.
target: When Sihon and all his army came out to meet us in battle at Jahaz,
