source: Chuin Pakai i-Pathen'un amaho chu imasanguva ahinpedoh-in, chuin eihon ama le achapate, chule amite jouse ithatgam taove.
target: the Lord our God delivered him over to us and we struck him down, together with his sons and his whole army.

source: Chuin hiche petchun akhopi jouseu ilaovin, khopi tinna mihem jouse pasal, numei, chule naosen ho isumang helun, khatcha jong ihinghoi pouvin,
target: At that time we took all his towns and completely destroyed them—men, women and children. We left no survivors.

source: Eiho-a dingin aganchahou le akhopihouva kichomho bou ilaovin ahi.
target: But the livestock and the plunder from the towns we had captured we carried off for ourselves.

source: Arnon vapi pamchina um Aroer'a pat, vapi chinna um khopi-a kipat Gilead chan geijin, eiho dinga hetbeh seh khopi khatcha aumpoi. Ajehchu Pakai i-Pathen'un abonchauvin eiho eipe soh hel taovin,
target: From Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the gorge, even as far as Gilead, not one town was too strong for us. The Lord our God gave us all of them.

source: Ammon chate gam sese le Jabbok vapi gamkaiho, molsang ho-a khopiho le Pakai i-Pathen'un eijahda nao mun ho-a bou chu nahunglut louvu ahi.
target: But in accordance with the command of the Lord our God, you did not encroach on any of the land of the Ammonites, neither the land along the course of the Jabbok nor that around the towns in the hills.

source: Chujouvin ikiheijun, Bashan jotna lampia ichetouvun, chuin Bashan lengpa Og le amite jouse eihotoh Edrei mun'a kisatdin ahung konun ahi.
target: Next we turned and went up along the road toward Bashan, and Og king of Bashan with his whole army marched out to meet us in battle at Edrei.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga, Amachu kicha hih-in; ajehchu keiman amale amite jouse, chule agam nakhutna kapeh ding ahin; chule Heshbon'a cheng Amor lengpa Sihon nabol banga amachu nabolding ahi, ati.
target: The Lord said to me, “Do not be afraid of him, for I have delivered him into your hands, along with his whole army and his land. Do to him what you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon.”

source: Chutichun Pakai i-Pathen'un Bashan lengpa Og le amite jouse jong ikhutnuva eipeuvin; mikhatcha jong hinghoi louvin ithat gamun ahi.
target: So the Lord our God also gave into our hands Og king of Bashan and all his army. We struck them down, leaving no survivors.

source: Chule hichepet chun akhopiho jouse ilaovin, Bashan'a Og lenggam Argob gamkai jouse-a khopi somgup lah-a ilah louvu khatcha aumpon ahi.
target: At that time we took all his cities. There was not one of the sixty cities that we did not take from them—the whole region of Argob, Og’s kingdom in Bashan.

source: Hiche khopi jousehi kulbang sangtah tah-a kiget khum le, kotpi neicheh, chule kotgol ho-a kikam ngen ahin; hiche tilouvin kul kiget khumlou khopineo tamtah jong ahi.
target: All these cities were fortified with high walls and with gates and bars, and there were also a great many unwalled villages.

source: Chule Heshbon lengpa Sihon ibolnao bangin khopi tinna pasal hole numei ho chule chapangho isumang hel jengun ahi.
target: We completely destroyed them, as we had done with Sihon king of Heshbon, destroying every city—men, women and children.

source: Gancha jouse le khopiho-a thil kichomho vang eiho chantumdin ikilah-uve.
target: But all the livestock and the plunder from their cities we carried off for ourselves.

source: Chule hichepet chun Amor mite lengni-a konin Jordan hilam panga galla um gam Arnon vapi'a pat Harmon molsang geijin ilaovin;
target: So at that time we took from these two kings of the Amorites the territory east of the Jordan, from the Arnon Gorge as far as Mount Hermon.

source: (Harmon chu Sidon miten Sirion asah-un, Amor miten Shenir asah-un),
target: (Hermon is called Sirion by the Sidonians; the Amorites call it Senir.)

source: Phaicham khopi jousele, Gilead gam jouse, chule Bashan gam jouse Salcah le Edrei geijin, Bashan'a Og lenggam sunga khopiho chu inalaovin ahi.
target: We took all the towns on the plateau, and all Gilead, and all Bashan as far as Salekah and Edrei, towns of Og’s kingdom in Bashan.

source: Ajehchu Bashan lengpa Og bou chu mihat milenho lah-a ahingdoh amoh hija ahi. Veovin, ajalkhun chu thih jalkhun ahin, Ammon chate kho Rabbath-a um hilou ham? mihem tong dungjuijin adung chu tongko ahin, avai tongli ahi.
target: (Og king of Bashan was the last of the Rephaites. His bed was decorated with iron and was more than nine cubits long and four cubits wide. It is still in Rabbah of the Ammonites.)

source: Chuche petna inalo-u hiche gamhi Arnon vapi panga um Aroer'a patna Gilead molsang kehkhat le, asunga khopi hochu Reuben mite le Gad mite kana petan ahi.
target: Of the land that we took over at that time, I gave the Reubenites and the Gadites the territory north of Aroer by the Arnon Gorge, including half the hill country of Gilead, together with its towns.

source: Gilead gam adang sese le Og lenggam Bashan pumpi chu Manasseh phung kehkhat kanapen; Argob gamkai jouse le Bashan pumpi chu mihat le milenho gam anakiti.
target: The rest of Gilead and also all of Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh. (The whole region of Argob in Bashan used to be known as a land of the Rephaites.

source: Manasseh chapa Jair'in Argob gam pumpi, Geshuri le Maachathi gamgi geijin alan, hichu ama min aputsah-in, tuni geijin Bashan Havoth-jair akiti.
target: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, took the whole region of Argob as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maakathites; it was named after him, so that to this day Bashan is called Havvoth Jair.)

source: Chuin Gilead chu Machir kanapetai.
target: And I gave Gilead to Makir.

source: Chuin Reuben mite le Gad mite henga Gilead'a pat Arnon vapi phaicham kehkhat, chule agamgi diuvin Jabbok vapi geijin kapen, hichu Ammon chate gamgi ahi.
target: But to the Reubenites and the Gadites I gave the territory extending from Gilead down to the Arnon Gorge (the middle of the gorge being the border) and out to the Jabbok River, which is the border of the Ammonites.

source: Phaicham jong, Jordan le apanga um gamho, Chinnereth'a pat Ashdoth-pisgah solam sanga um phaicham twipi, chituipi geijin kanapen ahi.
target: Its western border was the Jordan in the Arabah, from Kinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (that is, the Dead Sea), below the slopes of Pisgah.

source: Hiche laichun nangma thu kanapen, Pakai na Pathen'un hiche gamhi nalodiuva anapeh ahi. Nasopi hou Israel chate masanga namihang hou jouse chu galvon vonpuma nagalkai diu ahi.
target: I commanded you at that time: “The Lord your God has given you this land to take possession of it. But all your able-bodied men, armed for battle, must cross over ahead of the other Israelites.

source: Ahinla najiteu, nachasenhou, chule nagancha hou, (ajehchu gancha nahao lheh-uve ti kahen,) keiman kapeh-u nakhopi houva chu umden dingu,
target: However, your wives, your children and your livestock (I know you have much livestock) may stay in the towns I have given you,

source: Nangho banga Pakaiyin nasopiteu acholngah sah kahseu le Jordan galla Pakai na Pathen'un napeh-u gam alo kahseuva umdingu ahi. Chujou tengle amitakipmin keiman kapeh gamchu nahung lokit chehdiu ahi, kati.
target: until the Lord gives rest to your fellow Israelites as he has to you, and they too have taken over the land that the Lord your God is giving them across the Jordan. After that, each of you may go back to the possession I have given you.”

source: Chule hiche laichun Joshua thu kapen, Pakai na Pathen'un hiche lengteni abolna jouse chu namitnin namutan, chutobang ma-a chu Pakaiyin nalo dingu lenggam ho chu abolding ahi.
target: At that time I commanded Joshua: “You have seen with your own eyes all that the Lord your God has done to these two kings. The Lord will do the same to all the kingdoms over there where you are going.

source: Pakai na Pathen'un nangho dinga gal nasatpeh ding jeh-un, nanghon amaho chu kicha hih-un kati.
target: Do not be afraid of them; the Lord your God himself will fight for you.”

source: Chule hiche laichun Pakai henga ngehna kana neijin, hitin kati;
target: At that time I pleaded with the Lord :

source: Vo Pakai Pathen, nangman nasoh hi nalet je le nakhut thahat je neimusah pantai; ajehchu leile van'a nathilbol bang le thahat bang bolthei Pathen koi umam?
target: “Sovereign Lord , you have begun to show to your servant your greatness and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or on earth who can do the deeds and mighty works you do?

source: Katao ahi, neigalkai sah inlang, Jordan galla gam phatah molsang hoitah le Lebanon chu neimusah-in, kanati.
target: Let me go over and see the good land beyond the Jordan—that fine hill country and Lebanon.”

source: Ahinla nangho jeh-in Pakaiyin eina lunghan khumin, eingaipeh nompoi: chule Pakaiyin kahenga, Phaset tante, hiche thuhi kahenga seikit tahih-in.
target: But because of you the Lord was angry with me and would not listen to me. “That is enough,” the Lord said. “Do not speak to me anymore about this matter.

source: Pisgah molvum'a kaldoh inlang lhumlam, sahlam, lhanglam chule solama khodah-in lang, hichu namit-in ven; ajehchu nangma hiche Jordan hi nagalkai louding ahi.
target: Go up to the top of Pisgah and look west and north and south and east. Look at the land with your own eyes, since you are not going to cross this Jordan.

source: Ahin Joshua ngansen lang, tilkhouvin, chule hatsah-in; ajehchu ama hiche miho masanga hi galkaija, nagamu ding gamchu amaho alosah ding ahi, ati.
target: But commission Joshua, and encourage and strengthen him, for he will lead this people across and will cause them to inherit the land that you will see.”

source: Chuti chun Beth-peor maijon phaichama chun i-um taovin ahi.
target: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

source: Hijeh chun tun, vo Israel, nahin theijuva, napu napateu Pakai Pathen'in napeh-u gamchu nagalo theina dingun, najui diuva kahil masah dem chondanho leh thutannaho hi ngaijuvin.
target: Now, Israel, hear the decrees and laws I am about to teach you. Follow them so that you may live and may go in and take possession of the land the Lord , the God of your ancestors, is giving you.

source: Keiman nangho kathupeh hi nakoibe loudiu, chule chua kona jong nalahdoh louhel diu, chutia chu keiman kapeh-u Pakai na Pathen'u thupeh chu nanit diu ahi.
target: Do not add to what I command you and do not subtract from it, but keep the commands of the Lord your God that I give you.

source: Baal-peor jeh-a Pakai thilbol chu namitnun namutaove. Ajeh chu Baal-peor jui jouse chu Pakai na Pathen'un nalah uva konin asumangtai.
target: You saw with your own eyes what the Lord did at Baal Peor. The Lord your God destroyed from among you everyone who followed the Baal of Peor,

source: Ahinla nanghon Pakai na Pathen'u heng lama behho vang amitakip tunigei hin nahingjing naove.
target: but all of you who held fast to the Lord your God are still alive today.

source: Veovin, Pakai Pathen'in eithupeh bangtah chun, lodinga nachenna diu gama naboldiuvin, keiman chondan le thutanna chu kahil taove.
target: See, I have taught you decrees and laws as the Lord my God commanded me, so that you may follow them in the land you are entering to take possession of it.

source: Hijeh chun hicheho chu nit unlang bolun; ajehchu hichu namtin ho mitmu-a nachih naole nahet them nao ahin, amahon chondan kisun jouse hi ajah uva, Tahbeh-in hiche nam lentehi aching le ahechen mite ahiuve, atidiu ahi.
target: Observe them carefully, for this will show your wisdom and understanding to the nations, who will hear about all these decrees and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”

source: Ikouna chanuva einaijiu Pakai i-Pathen'u tobanga amaho naiji Pathen nei chutobang namlen koi umam?
target: What other nation is so great as to have their gods near them the way the Lord our God is near us whenever we pray to him?

source: Chule tulaija namasanguva kakoi dan kisun jouse banga hititah-a chondan hole thutan na nei namlen dang koi umam?
target: And what other nation is so great as to have such righteous decrees and laws as this body of laws I am setting before you today?

source: Kichih thei pou pouvun lang, gunchu tah-in nalhagaovu hongphaovin, achuti louleh namitnun amu thilho chu sumilun natin, nahinlai nikho sungseuvin nalungsunguva konin mangthah get ninte: ahin nachapate le nachapate chate chu hiljouvin.
target: Only be careful, and watch yourselves closely so that you do not forget the things your eyes have seen or let them fade from your heart as long as you live. Teach them to your children and to their children after them.

source: Adeh deh-in Horeb molsanga Pakai na Pathen anga nadin nikhou, chule Pakaiyin kahenga anasei, Mipi ho chu neikhop khompeh-in, leiset chunga ahinlai nikho sungseuva keima ginje akihil theina diule, achateu ahiltheina diuvin kathu jahsah inge ati nikho chu.
target: Remember the day you stood before the Lord your God at Horeb, when he said to me, “Assemble the people before me to hear my words so that they may learn to revere me as long as they live in the land and may teach them to their children.”

source: Chuin nahin naijun molsang bula nadinguvin, chule molsang chu vanlaijol geijin muthim, meilhang, chule thimletlut nin meijin akan ahi.
target: You came near and stood at the foot of the mountain while it blazed with fire to the very heavens, with black clouds and deep darkness.

source: Chuin meikong lah-a konchun Pakaiyin naheng uvah thu aseijin, a-aw cheng chu najaovin, alim vang namupouve; a-aw sehseh najaovin ahi.
target: Then the Lord spoke to you out of the fire. You heard the sound of words but saw no form; there was only a voice.

source: Chuin aman naheng uva thuson, najui diuva athupeh akitepna chu aphongdoh-in, song pheng ni chunga asunin ahi.
target: He declared to you his covenant, the Ten Commandments, which he commanded you to follow and then wrote them on two stone tablets.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin hichepet chun lodinga nachennao gama nabol diuvin, chondan kisunho le thutan naho chu nangho kahil diuvin eina thupeh-in ahi.
target: And the Lord directed me at that time to teach you the decrees and laws you are to follow in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.

source: Hijeh chun nangho kichihtheijun, ajehchu Horeb'a meikong lah-a Pakaiyin naheng uva thu asei nikho chun, nanghon alim namu pouve.
target: You saw no form of any kind the day the Lord spoke to you at Horeb out of the fire. Therefore watch yourselves very carefully,

source: Achutiloule nakisuhboh uva, alim semthu, ipi lim hamkhat toh kilou, pasal ham, numei ham tobang kisem getnun natin,
target: so that you do not become corrupt and make for yourselves an idol, an image of any shape, whether formed like a man or a woman,

source: Leichunga um ganhing khat tou tobang, vanlaijola lengle alhanei vacha khat tou tobang,
target: or like any animal on earth or any bird that flies in the air,

source: Leichunga a-opma kithol ganhing khat tou tobang, leinoi twilah-a nga khat lim tobang, kisemthu getnun nate.
target: or like any creature that moves along the ground or any fish in the waters below.

source: Chule achutiloule namitna vanlam navet uva, nisa, lhathah,ahsi ho, chule van janelpi namu tengule, Pakai na Pathen'un vannoi pumpi-a nam jouse-a dinga apeh chu houding le jendingin kiheilut getnun nate.
target: And when you look up to the sky and see the sun, the moon and the stars—all the heavenly array—do not be enticed into bowing down to them and worshiping things the Lord your God has apportioned to all the nations under heaven.

source: Ahinla Pakaiyin tunikho-a nahi nao banga hi agoulo ama mite hidinga nalah uva, thih meilhum sung, Egypt gama kona nana puidoh-u ahi.
target: But as for you, the Lord took you and brought you out of the iron-smelting furnace, out of Egypt, to be the people of his inheritance, as you now are.

source: Chukalvalin nangho jeh-in Pakai keima chunga alunghangin, Jordan kagalkai louna dingle, Pakai na Pathen'un lo dinga napeh-u gam phatah-a chu kalut louna din akihah selin ahi.
target: The Lord was angry with me because of you, and he solemnly swore that I would not cross the Jordan and enter the good land the Lord your God is giving you as your inheritance.

source: Keima vang hiche gama kathi-a, Jordan hi galkai louding kahitai; ahin nangho nagalkaijuva chuche gam phatah chu nagalo diu ahi.
target: I will die in this land; I will not cross the Jordan; but you are about to cross over and take possession of that good land.

source: Nangho kichih theijun, ajole Pakai na Pathen'un nang hotoh akitepna sumil khaovin natin; Pakai na Pathen'un ajahda alim semthu ham, ahiloule ipiham khat toh kilou kisemthu getnun nate.
target: Be careful not to forget the covenant of the Lord your God that he made with you; do not make for yourselves an idol in the form of anything the Lord your God has forbidden.

source: Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'u hi kavamhel mei ahin, thangthip tah Pathen ahi.
target: For the Lord your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.

source: Nanghon chate le chateho chate nahin neijuva, gamsunga chu sottah nachen uva, nakisuhboh uva, alim semthu, ahiloule ipihamkhat toh kibang lim nakisem thuva, Pakai na Pathen'u mitmu-a thilse nabol uva, nalung hansah uva ahile,
target: After you have had children and grandchildren and have lived in the land a long time—if you then become corrupt and make any kind of idol, doing evil in the eyes of the Lord your God and arousing his anger,

source: Lo dinga Jordan nagalkai nao gama kona chu naman thah helnadiuva, tunikho-a hi nachung uva ahetoh dinga van le lei kakou ahin; chukoma chu nachensot loudiu, suhmang hela naum johdiu ahi.
target: I call the heavens and the earth as witnesses against you this day that you will quickly perish from the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess. You will not live there long but will certainly be destroyed.

source: Chule Pakaiyin namtin lah-a nathe cheh uva, Pakaiyin napuinadiu Pathen helouho lah-a chu lhomcha naphah diu ahi.
target: The Lord will scatter you among the peoples, and only a few of you will survive among the nations to which the Lord will drive you.

source: Chule chua chu mutheilou, jatheilou, netheilou, thilnam jalou, mihem khutsem thing le song pathen lhachana natoh dingu ahi.
target: There you will worship man-made gods of wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or eat or smell.

source: Hijongle chua kona Pakai na Pathen'u chu nahol uva, nalungthim pumpiu le nahinnao pumpi-a nahol ule, namu dingu ahi.
target: But if from there you seek the Lord your God, you will find him if you seek him with all your heart and with all your soul.

source: Hesoh genthei natouva, ni nunungni le hicheng thil jouse nachung uva achuhteng, Pakai na Pathen lama nakiheijuva, a-aw nangai uva ahile,
target: When you are in distress and all these things have happened to you, then in later days you will return to the Lord your God and obey him.

source: (Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'u chu hepina-a dim Pathen ahi,) aman nadalhah loudiu, nasuhmang louheldiu, napu napateu henga akihahselna le akitepna chu asuhmil louhel ding ahi.
target: For the Lord your God is a merciful God; he will not abandon or destroy you or forget the covenant with your ancestors, which he confirmed to them by oath.

source: Ajehchu nikho che masaho, nangho masanga Pathen'in leichunga mihem asem nikho-a pat, chule van langkhatna pat alangkhat geija, hiche tobang thil nasa adang anaum kha-a, ahiloule hitobang hikija khatam? dong temun.
target: Ask now about the former days, long before your time, from the day God created human beings on the earth; ask from one end of the heavens to the other. Has anything so great as this ever happened, or has anything like it ever been heard of?

source: Nanghon najah uva nathilou banguva, meikong lah-a kona Pathen thusei aw min ajahkhah em?
target: Has any other people heard the voice of God speaking out of fire, as you have, and lived?

source: Ahiloule Pakai Pathen'in Egypt gama namitmuva abol hojouse dungjuija, Pathen'in lhepna-a, melchih na-a, thil kidang, khut thahatna, ban jahdoh-a, tijatna nasatah-a, namkhat lah-a kona namkhat lahdoh dinga cheding agot khah-em?
target: Has any god ever tried to take for himself one nation out of another nation, by testings, by signs and wonders, by war, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, or by great and awesome deeds, like all the things the Lord your God did for you in Egypt before your very eyes?

source: Pakai chu Pathen ahi ti nahet theina dinguva, naheng uva kimusah ahi. Amalou koima dang aumpoi.
target: You were shown these things so that you might know that the Lord is God; besides him there is no other.

source: Aman nahil theina diuva, van'a kona a-aw najah sah uva; chule leichunga ameikou loupitah chu namusah-u ahi; chule nanghon meikou lah-a konchun athu najaovin ahi.
target: From heaven he made you hear his voice to discipline you. On earth he showed you his great fire, and you heard his words from out of the fire.

source: Chule napateu angailut jehchun, amaho nungin achilhahte alhengin, chule Egypt gama konin athahat thilbol theina-a chun amitmu-a konin napui doh-un;
target: Because he loved your ancestors and chose their descendants after them, he brought you out of Egypt by his Presence and his great strength,

source: Tunikho-a banga hi nangho puilutna, agamu gouva lodinga peh dingin, nangho sanga lenjole hatjo namho namasanguva konin anodoh-in ahi.
target: to drive out before you nations greater and stronger than you and to bring you into their land to give it to you for your inheritance, as it is today.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai hi vanchung le leichung Pathen ahi ti hi tuni hin heuvin lang, nalungun ngai touvin; Amalou adang khatcha aumpoi.
target: Acknowledge and take to heart this day that the Lord is God in heaven above and on the earth below. There is no other.

source: Hijeh chun nangho le nanung uva nachateo aphatthei na dingu leh, a-itih-a dinga Pakai na Pathen'un napeh-u leiset chunga hi nahinkhou asotna dingin, tunikho-a kathupeh-u ama chona dan kisemho le athupehho hi nit jingun, ati.
target: Keep his decrees and commands, which I am giving you today, so that it may go well with you and your children after you and that you may live long in the land the Lord your God gives you for all time.

source: Chujouvin Mosi'n Jordan hilam pang nisolam panga khopi thum akhendoh-in,
target: Then Moses set aside three cities east of the Jordan,

source: Tolthat ho, gutuhna neilou, masanga jong hotna neilou tosoija aheng akom that ho ajamlutna ding; chule hiche khopiho khatna ajamlut le ahintheina din akhendoh-in:
target: to which anyone who had killed a person could flee if they had unintentionally killed a neighbor without malice aforethought. They could flee into one of these cities and save their life.

source: Hicheho chu Reuben mite-a dingin phaicham gamthipma um Bezer ahin, Gad mite-a dingin Gilead gama um Ramoth ahin, chule Manasseh mite-a dingin Bashan gama um Golan ahi.
target: The cities were these: Bezer in the wilderness plateau, for the Reubenites; Ramoth in Gilead, for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.

source: Chule hiche hi Mosi'n Israel chate angsunga apeh danthu chu ahi.
target: This is the law Moses set before the Israelites.

source: Hicheho hi Egypt'a kona ahungdoh nunguva Mosi'n Israel chate jah-a anasei, hettohsah le, dan kisemho, chule thutan ho chu ahin,
target: These are the stipulations, decrees and laws Moses gave them when they came out of Egypt

source: Mosi le Israel chaten Egypt gama kona ahung potdoh nunguva anatha-u Hesbon'a cheng Amor mite lengpa Sihon gamsung Jordan pang hilam sang, Beth-peor maijona um phaichama apeh ahi.
target: and were in the valley near Beth Peor east of the Jordan, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon and was defeated by Moses and the Israelites as they came out of Egypt.

source: Chuin amahon ama gam le Bashan lengpa Og gam, Jordan hilam pang nisolam sanga cheng Amor mite lengni gamchu alouvin,
target: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan.

source: Arnon vapi panga um Areor'a pat, Hermon'a um Sion molsang chan,
target: This land extended from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge to Mount Sirion (that is, Hermon),

source: Chule Jordan hilam pang solam sanga phaicham jouse, Pisgah twinah phung noija um twikhanglen phaicham geijin alouvin ahi.
target: and included all the Arabah east of the Jordan, as far as the Dead Sea, below the slopes of Pisgah.

source: Chuin Mosi'n Israelte jouse akouvin, ahenguva, Vo Israel, nakihil uva, nachintup uva, chule nabol diuvin, tunia naheng uva kasei chonna danho leh thutannaho hi ngaijun.
target: Moses summoned all Israel and said: Hear, Israel, the decrees and laws I declare in your hearing today. Learn them and be sure to follow them.

source: Pakai i-Pathen'uvin Horeb'a eihotoh kitepna khat anaseme.
target: The Lord our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.

source: Pakaiyin hiche kitepna hi ipateu toh abol ahipon, tunia ahingnalai jouse eihotah tojoh abol ahi.
target: It was not with our ancestors that the Lord made this covenant, but with us, with all of us who are alive here today.

source: Pakaiyin nang hotoh kimaiton molsanga chun meikong lah-a konin thu anaseijin,
target: The Lord spoke to you face to face out of the fire on the mountain.

source: (Hiche pet chun Pakai thu chu nangho hetsah dingin Pakai le nangho kah-a kana dinge. Ajehchu meikong jehchun nana kichauvin, molsanga chun nakaltou pouvin;) hitin ati,
target: (At that time I stood between the Lord and you to declare to you the word of the Lord , because you were afraid of the fire and did not go up the mountain.) And he said:

source: Keima Pakai na Pathen kahin, nakihenna in, Egypt gama kona nahin puidohpa chu kahi.
target: “I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

source: Nangman Keima ansunga Pathen dangho nanei louding ahi.
target: “You shall have no other gods before me.

source: Nangman alim semthu, chung van'a um hihen, ahiloule noi leisetna um hihen, ahiloule leinoi'a twisunga um hijongle, akibahpi ima lim nasem louding ahi.
target: “You shall not make for yourself an image in the form of anything in heaven above or on the earth beneath or in the waters below.

source: Nangma hitobangho anga nakun louding, alhacha-a jong napan louding ahi. Ajehchu keima Pakai na Pathen hi thangthip tah Pathen kahin, keima eihot bola pate khansetna chu achate khangthum khangli chan geija vila, achunguva phulajia kahin,
target: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God, punishing the children for the sin of the parents to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me,

source: Keima eingailua chule kathupeh nit chu sang tamtah ho chunga khotona musah-a kahi.
target: but showing love to a thousand generations of those who love me and keep my commandments.

source: Nangman Pakai na Pathen minchu mohseh-a napat louding ahi. Ajehchu mohseh-a amin pana chu Pakaiyin themona beija alhalou ding ahi.
target: “You shall not misuse the name of the Lord your God, for the Lord will not hold anyone guiltless who misuses his name.

source: Pakai na Pathen'in nathupeh banga cholngah ni chu athengin mangin.
target: “Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy, as the Lord your God has commanded you.

source: Nigup sunga na natoh-a, natohding jouse chu natoh ding,
target: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

source: Amavang nisagi ni chu Pakai na Pathen cholngah ni ahi. Hiche nikho-a hi nangma nahin, nachapate ahin, nachanute ahin, nasohpa ahin, nasohnu ahin, nabongchal ahin, nasangan ahin, nagancha poupou ahin, nakotpi sunga um namaljin hijongle ima natoh loudiu; nangma bang banga nasohpa le nasohnu jong kicholdodiu ahi.
target: but the seventh day is a sabbath to the Lord your God. On it you shall not do any work, neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your male or female servant, nor your ox, your donkey or any of your animals, nor any foreigner residing in your towns, so that your male and female servants may rest, as you do.

source: Chule Egypt gama soh-a um nanahin, chule Pakai na Pathen'in chua kona khut hattah le ban jahdoh-a nahin puidoh ahi chu geldoh-in. Hijeh-a chu Pakai na Pathen'in cholngah ni nitdinga nathupeh ahi.
target: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and that the Lord your God brought you out of there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. Therefore the Lord your God has commanded you to observe the Sabbath day.

source: Pakai na Pathen'in thu nathupeh bangin nanu napa jabolin, chutile Pakai na Pathen'in napehna leisetna chun nahinkho sotnintin, naphatthei ding ahi.
target: “Honor your father and your mother, as the Lord your God has commanded you, so that you may live long and that it may go well with you in the land the Lord your God is giving you.

source: Tol natha louding ahi.
target: “You shall not murder.

source: Jon jong nabol louding ahi.
target: “You shall not commit adultery.

source: Gujong naguchat louding ahi.
target: “You shall not steal.

source: Naheng nakom chunga hettohsah dihlouva jong napan louding ahi.
target: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

source: Naheng nakom ji jong nadeichat louding, naheng nakom in ahin, alou ahin, asohpa ahin, asohnu ahin, abongchal ahin, asangan ahin, naheng nakoma thilpou pou chu nathangset louding ahi.
target: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. You shall not set your desire on your neighbor’s house or land, his male or female servant, his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.”

source: Hiche thuho hi Pakaiyin molsanga meikong lah-a kon, meilom lah-a kon, chule muthim satah lah-a kona aw gingtah-a houkhom ho nabon uva henga anasei ahin; abelap tapoi. Chule hicheho chu songpheng ni-a asunin, kahenga einapen ahi.
target: These are the commandments the Lord proclaimed in a loud voice to your whole assembly there on the mountain from out of the fire, the cloud and the deep darkness; and he added nothing more. Then he wrote them on two stone tablets and gave them to me.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, nanghon muthim lah-a kona aw najah-u chun, (ajehchu molsang chu meikonga ka ahi,) nangho nahiuvin, naphung uva aluchangho ahiuvin, chule nalamkai jouseu ahin kaheng neihin naijun,
target: When you heard the voice out of the darkness, while the mountain was ablaze with fire, all the leaders of your tribes and your elders came to me.

source: Chule hitin naseijui, Vetemin, Pakai i-Pathen'un aloupina le aletna eimusah-un, chule meikong lah-a konin a-aw ijaovin ahi. Tunikho hin eihon Pathen'in mihem akihoupia, ahivanga ahin chu imu taove.
target: And you said, “The Lord our God has shown us his glory and his majesty, and we have heard his voice from the fire. Today we have seen that a person can live even if God speaks with them.

source: Hijeh chun tu-a ibola ithijeng diuham? Ajehchu hiche meikou nasatah hin eikahvam dingu ahi; eihon Pakai i-Pathen'u aw jahbe leuhen ithi teidingu ahi.
target: But now, why should we die? This great fire will consume us, and we will die if we hear the voice of the Lord our God any longer.

source: Ajehchu eiho banga meikong lah-a kona hingjing Pathen aw ja-a, hing nalai tahsa pujouse lah-a koi umam?
target: For what mortal has ever heard the voice of the living God speaking out of fire, as we have, and survived?

source: Nangman ganai jinlang, Pakai i-Pathen'uvin asei ding chu gangai jin; chule Pakai i-Pathen'uvin nahenga aseijouse chu nangin kabonchao jah-a seijin lang, keihon ngai ungting, bolu vinge, nati uve.
target: Go near and listen to all that the Lord our God says. Then tell us whatever the Lord our God tells you. We will listen and obey.”

source: Chule kahenga nathusei petnuchun Pakaiyin nathuseihou chu ajan; Pakaiyin kahenga, Keiman mipin nahenga athuseiju aw chu kajan ahi. Amahon athuseihou jouse chu aseidih lheh uve.
target: The Lord heard you when you spoke to me, and the Lord said to me, “I have heard what this people said to you. Everything they said was good.

source: Kaden, amaho ding le achateu dinga a-itih-a aphalheh jing nadin, a-itih laijin jong hitobang lungchu pujingu henlang, eigingu henlang, kathupeh jouse anit jing jeng taveleu!
target: Oh, that their hearts would be inclined to fear me and keep all my commands always, so that it might go well with them and their children forever!

source: Chenlang ahenguva, Napon in nuva lutkit taovin, gatipeh-in.
target: “Go, tell them to return to their tents.

source: Nangma vang kakoma dingin lang, alodiuva kapehna gama abol theina diuva amaho nahil dinga thupeh jouse, chonna dan kisemho, chule thutanna ho nahenga kasei ding ahi, ati.
target: But you stay here with me so that I may give you all the commands, decrees and laws you are to teach them to follow in the land I am giving them to possess.”

source: Hijeh chun Pakai na Pathen'un nathupeh banguva nabolna diuvin chingtheijun; nangho jetle veija nakihei mang lou dingu ahi.
target: So be careful to do what the Lord your God has commanded you; do not turn aside to the right or to the left.

source: Nalodiu gama naphat theijuva, nahinkhou asotna dinga, Pakai na Pathen'un nathupeh-u lampi jouse chu najot sohkei dingu ahi.
target: Walk in obedience to all that the Lord your God has commanded you, so that you may live and prosper and prolong your days in the land that you will possess.

source: Tun hichehohi nacheuva nagalo diu gama naboldiuva Pakai na Pathen'un nangho hil dinga thupeh eipeh dan thupeh ho, chondan ho, chule thutanna hochu ahi,
target: These are the commands, decrees and laws the Lord your God directed me to teach you to observe in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess,

source: Chutia chu nahinkhou asotna dinga keiman nangma le nachapa chule nachapa chapate kathupeh achondanho le athupehho chu nahinkho lhumkei uva nanit uva, Pakai na Paten chu nagin dingu ahi.
target: so that you, your children and their children after them may fear the Lord your God as long as you live by keeping all his decrees and commands that I give you, and so that you may enjoy long life.

source: Hijeh chun, vo Israel, Pakai napu napateu Pathen'in athutep banga khoiju le bongnoi lona gama chu naphat theijuva chule hatah-a napun nadiuvin, ngaijin lang, naboldoh nadin chingtheijin.
target: Hear, Israel, and be careful to obey so that it may go well with you and that you may increase greatly in a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the Lord , the God of your ancestors, promised you.

source: Ngaijin, vo Israel, Pakai na Pathen'u chu Pakai khat seh ahi.
target: Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one.

source: Chule nangman Pakai na Pathen chu nalung pumpi-a, nalhagao pumpi-a chule nathaneina pumpi-a nangailut ding ahi.
target: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.

source: Chule tu nikho-a nangma kathupeh hohi nalung sunga nachin jing ding ahi.
target: These commandments that I give you today are to be on your hearts.

source: Chule nangman hicheho hi nachate henga tomngai tah-a nahilding, na-insunga natoupet tengle, lamdunga nachepet tengle, naluppet tengle, chule nathodoh teng jongle naseipeh ding ahi.
target: Impress them on your children. Talk about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.

source: Chule hicheho chu melchihna dinga nakhutna nabua, chule namit teni kikah-a thuchihbom tobang hiding ahi.
target: Tie them as symbols on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.

source: Chule hicheho chu na-in khomhou le nakotpi hou chunga nasut dingu ahi.
target: Write them on the doorframes of your houses and on your gates.

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, Pakai na Pathen'un napu napateu Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob henga pehdinga akihahselna gam, nangma sahdoh hilou khopi lentah le phatah ho-a chu nahin puilutna,
target: When the Lord your God brings you into the land he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, to give you—a land with large, flourishing cities you did not build,

source: Nangma dimsah hilou thilpha jouse dimna inho, nangman nalai hilou twikul kilaiho, nangma phu hilou lengpilei le Olive thingphung ho chu nangman naneh-a nava teng le,
target: houses filled with all kinds of good things you did not provide, wells you did not dig, and vineyards and olive groves you did not plant—then when you eat and are satisfied,

source: Chuteng chingtheijin, ajole Egypt gam kihenna in'a kona nahin puidoh Pakai chu sumil getnin nate.
target: be careful that you do not forget the Lord , who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

source: Pakai na Pathen chu nagin na, ama najena, chule ama minna nakihahsel ding ahi.
target: Fear the Lord your God, serve him only and take your oaths in his name.

source: Nanghon pathen dang, nakimvel uva cheng miho pathen nung najui loudiu ahi.
target: Do not follow other gods, the gods of the peoples around you;

source: (Ajehchu nalah uva Pakai na Pathen chu thangthip Pathen ahin,) ajole Pakai na Pathen lungsat nachung uva koujah-intin, leiset chunga konin nasumang hel getnunte.
target: for the Lord your God, who is among you, is a jealous God and his anger will burn against you, and he will destroy you from the face of the land.

source: Nanghon Massah mun'a nana patep banguva Pakai Pathen chu na patep loudiu ahi.
target: Do not put the Lord your God to the test as you did at Massah.

source: Nanghon Pakai na Pathen'un thupeh napeh-u adan thupeh ho, ahettohsah ho, chule achonna dan kisunho chu gunchu tah-a nanit dingu ahi.
target: Be sure to keep the commands of the Lord your God and the stipulations and decrees he has given you.

source: Chule Pakaiyin napu napateu henga ana kihahselna gama nagacheuva naga lona dingu le naphat theina dinguva Pakai mitmu-a adih le apha chu nabol diu,
target: Do what is right and good in the Lord ’s sight, so that it may go well with you and you may go in and take over the good land the Lord promised on oath to your ancestors,

source: Pakaiyin anasei banga namelma teu jouse chu namasang uva kona nomanga umdingu ahi.
target: thrusting out all your enemies before you, as the Lord said.

source: Chule ahunglhung ding phat teng nachapan nahenga, Pakai i-Pathen'un nana thupeh hettohsah ho, dan kisunho, thutanna ho chu ipi kiseina ham? tia nadoh tengleh,
target: In the future, when your son asks you, “What is the meaning of the stipulations, decrees and laws the Lord our God has commanded you?”

source: Chuteng nachapa henga chu, Keiho Egypt'a Pharaoh soh kana hiuvin, Pakaiyin Egypt'a kona khut thahat tah-a eipuidoh-u ahi;
target: tell him: “We were slaves of Pharaoh in Egypt, but the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

source: Pakaiyin kamit mutah-un Egypt chung leh Pharaoh chung, chule a-insung pumpi chunga, melchihna ho, thilkidang ho, thina, chule thohtheilou hel lungkhamna eimu sah-un ahi.
target: Before our eyes the Lord sent signs and wonders—great and terrible—on Egypt and Pharaoh and his whole household.

source: Chule pehdinga ipu ipateu anahahselna gama eipuilut theina diuvin, hia konchun eina puidoh-un ahi.
target: But he brought us out from there to bring us in and give us the land he promised on oath to our ancestors.

source: Chule tunikho-a banga hi eihinghoi theina dingu le, a-itih-a iphat theina dingu, chule Pakai i-Pathen'u igin na dinguva, Pakaiyin hiche chondan jousehi ibol diuva eina peh-u ahi.
target: The Lord commanded us to obey all these decrees and to fear the Lord our God, so that we might always prosper and be kept alive, as is the case today.

source: Chule aman eithupeh banguva, Pakai i-Pathen'u masanga hiche thupeh ho jouse chu initnuva ahile, hichu ichon phatnao hiding ahi, tia naseipeh dingu ahi.
target: And if we are careful to obey all this law before the Lord our God, as he has commanded us, that will be our righteousness.”

source: Chule lodinga nachenao gama chu Pakai na Pathen'un napuilut nuva, na angsunguva nam tamtah Hit mite, Girgash mite, Amor mite, Canaan mite, Perizz mite, Hiv mite chule Jebus mite nangho sanga tamjole hatjo nampi sagi anodoh tengle,
target: When the Lord your God brings you into the land you are entering to possess and drives out before you many nations—the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites, seven nations larger and stronger than you—

source: Chule Pakai na Pathen'un amaho chu namasanguva apehdoh tengle, nanghon amaho chu natha uva nasuhmang heldiu, amahotoh kitepna nasem loudiu, hepina jong namusah louhel dingu ahi.
target: and when the Lord your God has delivered them over to you and you have defeated them, then you must destroy them totally. Make no treaty with them, and show them no mercy.

source: Amaho tojong nakichenlou ding, nachanu jong achapa dinga napehlou diu, chule achanu jong nachapa ji dinga nalah louding ahi.
target: Do not intermarry with them. Do not give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons,

source: Ajehchu amahon nachapa chu pathen dangho lhacha-a apan theina dinga keima eijui na-a kona aheimangdiu: chutia chu Pakai lungsatna chu nachungah deujah-a, photlotna nasuhmang ding ahi.
target: for they will turn your children away from following me to serve other gods, and the Lord ’s anger will burn against you and will quickly destroy you.

source: Ahinla nanghon amaho chu hitia hi naboldingu ahi: amaichamu nasuhmang pehdiu, amilimhou nasuhboh diu, athingbom hou chu naphuh lhuh pehdiu, chule alim semthu milimho chu meija nahalvam dingu ahi.
target: This is what you are to do to them: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones, cut down their Asherah poles and burn their idols in the fire.

source: Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen uva dinga namtheng nahiu ahin, Pakai na Pathen'un leiset chunga nam jouse chungvuma ama-a dinga nam tumbeh hidinga nalhen doh-u ahi.
target: For you are a people holy to the Lord your God. The Lord your God has chosen you out of all the peoples on the face of the earth to be his people, his treasured possession.

source: Namdang sanga natamjoh jeh uva Pakaiyin nachung uva ngailutna akoija, nalhenu ahipoi; ajehchu nangho nam jouse lah-a alhompen nanahiu ahi.
target: The Lord did not set his affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than other peoples, for you were the fewest of all peoples.

source: Ahinla Pakaiyin nangailut jeh-u le, napu napateu henga akihahselna asuh bulhit nom jeh-a Pakaiyin khut thahat tah-a napui doh uva, soh channa in'a konleh, Egypt lengpa Pharaoh khutna kona nalhatdoh-u ahi.
target: But it was because the Lord loved you and kept the oath he swore to your ancestors that he brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the land of slavery, from the power of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai na Pathen chu Pathen ahin, kitahtah Pathen, ama ngailuho le athupeh nit ho henga khang sangkhat geija akitepna le akhotona koijing,
target: Know therefore that the Lord your God is God; he is the faithful God, keeping his covenant of love to a thousand generations of those who love him and keep his commandments.

source: Chule ama hotbolpa chu sumang dinga amai uva lethuh jia Pathen ahi: ama ahotbol pa chu adep jing louding, amaikoh tah-a alethuh ding ahi, ti kihetnin.
target: But those who hate him he will repay to their face by destruction; he will not be slow to repay to their face those who hate him.

source: Hijeh-a chu nangman tunikho-a kathupeh danthupeh ho, chonna dan kisunho, chule thutanna ho hi nanit ding ahi.
target: Therefore, take care to follow the commands, decrees and laws I give you today.

source: Chutengle hung hitiding ahi, nangman hiche thutanna hohi nangaija, nanitna, chule nabola ahileh, Pakai na Pathen'in napu napate henga akihahselna, akitepna le ahepina chu anit jingding ahi.
target: If you pay attention to these laws and are careful to follow them, then the Lord your God will keep his covenant of love with you, as he swore to your ancestors.

source: Chule aman nangma nangailutna, phatthei naboh ding, chule napunsah ding; nangma pehdinga napu napateu henga akihahselna leisetna chu nalaigilga le naleiset ga, nachang, nalengpi thei, nathao nabong hole kelngoihon ho phatthei abohding ahi.
target: He will love you and bless you and increase your numbers. He will bless the fruit of your womb, the crops of your land—your grain, new wine and olive oil—the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks in the land he swore to your ancestors to give you.

source: Nangma nam jouse chungvuma phatthei nachan ding; nangho lah-a kon, ahiloule nagancha lah uva kona anu hijongle apaham hijongle achinga umlou helding ahi.
target: You will be blessed more than any other people; none of your men or women will be childless, nor will any of your livestock be without young.

source: Pakaiyin nangma-a kona natna jouse alahmanga, nangman nahet Egypt hiveiho jouse chu nachunga khatcha akoilou ding; nangma nahot bolte jouse chunga akoijoh ding ahi.
target: The Lord will keep you free from every disease. He will not inflict on you the horrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but he will inflict them on all who hate you.

source: Chule Pakai Pathen'in napehdoh ding miho jouse chu nasuhmang hela, achunguva khotona naneilou ding, a-pathen'u jong najen louding ahi; ajeh chu hichu nangma dinga thanga hungpang ding ahi.
target: You must destroy all the peoples the Lord your God gives over to you. Do not look on them with pity and do not serve their gods, for that will be a snare to you.

source: Nangman nalungthima, Hiche namho hi keisangin atamjon, iti kanomang jou ding ham? nati-a ahile,
target: You may say to yourselves, “These nations are stronger than we are. How can we drive them out?”

source: Amaho chu nakichat louding; amavang Pakai na Pathen'in Pharaoh leh Egypt mite jouse chunga anatoh jouse chu nageldoh joh-a,
target: But do not be afraid of them; remember well what the Lord your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt.

source: Nangman namitna namu patepna nasatah ho, melchihna ho, thil kidangho, khut thahat tah le ban jahdoh-a Pakai na Pathen'in napuidoh chu nageldoh ding ahi: Pakai na Pathen'in nakichat miho jouse chunga chutobanga chu abolding ahi.
target: You saw with your own eyes the great trials, the signs and wonders, the mighty hand and outstretched arm, with which the Lord your God brought you out. The Lord your God will do the same to all the peoples you now fear.

source: Chukal vala jong Pakai na Pathen'in nangma-a kona kisel ahingdoh amoh ho chu asuhmang kahse-a alah uva khoi-ngal alhakhum ding ahinalaije.
target: Moreover, the Lord your God will send the hornet among them until even the survivors who hide from you have perished.

source: Nangman amaho chu nakichat louding ahi: ajehchu tijat umtah le hat chungnung Pakai na Pathen'u nalah uva aume.
target: Do not be terrified by them, for the Lord your God, who is among you, is a great and awesome God.

source: Chule Pakai na Pathen'in namasanga hiche namho chu athem thema anodoh ding ahi. Nangman khatvei phulsuh-a nasuhmang thei louding ahi; achuti loule gamsa ho nachunga hungpung getnunte.
target: The Lord your God will drive out those nations before you, little by little. You will not be allowed to eliminate them all at once, or the wild animals will multiply around you.

source: Ahinla Pakai na Pathen'in amaho chu nangma henga hinpe doh intin, chule suhmang hela aumkah seuva manthah na-a nasatah-a asuhmang ding ahi.
target: But the Lord your God will deliver them over to you, throwing them into great confusion until they are destroyed.

source: Chule aman aleng hou chu nakhutna ahin pehdoh ding, nangman amin'u vannoi'a kona nasuhmang ding ahi. Amaho nasuhmang hel tokah se-a koimacha namasanga dingjou louding ahi.
target: He will give their kings into your hand, and you will wipe out their names from under heaven. No one will be able to stand up against you; you will destroy them.

source: Alim semthu pathen ho chu meija nahalding, achung kai sana ahiloule adangka ho chu nadeichat louding, lah jong nakilah louhel ding ahi; atiloule chua ohkhan nate: ajehchu Pakai na Pathen dinga thet umtah ahi.
target: The images of their gods you are to burn in the fire. Do not covet the silver and gold on them, and do not take it for yourselves, or you will be ensnared by it, for it is detestable to the Lord your God.

source: Chule na-insunga thil thet um napohlut louhel ding ahi; atiloule hiche tobang chun sapsetna-in umkhan nate. Amavang nangman hichu nasatah-a nathetna, nakidah johding ahi: ajehchu hichu sapset thil ahi.
target: Do not bring a detestable thing into your house or you, like it, will be set apart for destruction. Regard it as vile and utterly detest it, for it is set apart for destruction.

source: Nahin uva, napun uva, napu napateu henga Pakaiyin ana hahselna gama chu nalut uva nalotheina dingun, tunia kapeh thupeh jouse hi nabolna dingun chingtheijun.
target: Be careful to follow every command I am giving you today, so that you may live and increase and may enter and possess the land the Lord promised on oath to your ancestors.

source: Chule nangho suhnem nading, photchetna ding, nalungsunguva ipi umam hetdohna dingle, aman nathupeh hou chu najuidiu najui loudiu hetna dinga, Pakai na Pathen'un kum somli sung gamthipma nahinpui nao lampiho chu geldoh-un.
target: Remember how the Lord your God led you all the way in the wilderness these forty years, to humble and test you in order to know what was in your heart, whether or not you would keep his commands.

source: Mihem changlhah seh-in ahingpon, Pakai kamsunga kona hungpotdoh thucheng jouse-a bou hingding ahi ti nangho nahetsah theina dinguva, aman nasuhnem uva, gilkel nathoh dingu aphala, nangho nahiuva, napu napateu ahia jong ahet khahlouvu manna-a navah-u ahi.
target: He humbled you, causing you to hunger and then feeding you with manna, which neither you nor your ancestors had known, to teach you that man does not live on bread alone but on every word that comes from the mouth of the Lord .

source: Hiche kum somli sunghin natahsa chunguva navonu achulpon, nakengu jong apom pon ahi.
target: Your clothes did not wear out and your feet did not swell during these forty years.

source: Mihemin achapa asehgim jibanga, Pakai na Pathen'in nasehgim chu, nalunga jong nangaito ding ahi.
target: Know then in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so the Lord your God disciplines you.

source: Hijeh-a chu alampia nachena dingu le, ama nagin na dinguva Pakai na Pathen'u thupeh ho chu nanit dingu ahi.
target: Observe the commands of the Lord your God, walking in obedience to him and revering him.

source: Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'un gamphatah, thinglhang le phaichama kona hunglong doh twinah le twisam putdohna gam, vachadung ho lona gama napuilut uva,
target: For the Lord your God is bringing you into a good land—a land with brooks, streams, and deep springs gushing out into the valleys and hills;

source: Suhlou chang, sakol chang, lengpigui ho, theichang phungho, kolbuthei ho, Olive thao le khoiju lona gam,
target: a land with wheat and barley, vines and fig trees, pomegranates, olive oil and honey;

source: Lhasam louva changlhah naneh nadingu, asunga chu imacha nalhahsam loudingu; asong ho thih hija, alhangho-a kona sum-eng laidoh theina gamphatah-a napuilut dingu ahi.
target: a land where bread will not be scarce and you will lack nothing; a land where the rocks are iron and you can dig copper out of the hills.

source: Nanghon naneh uva nava tengule, aman gam phatah napeh jeh uva Pakai na Pathen'u chu nathangvah dingu ahi.
target: When you have eaten and are satisfied, praise the Lord your God for the good land he has given you.

source: Tunia nangho henga kathupeh; adan thupeh ho, athutan naho, achonna danho hi nanit daova, Pakai na Pathen'u chu nasuhmil louna dingun chingtheijun.
target: Be careful that you do not forget the Lord your God, failing to observe his commands, his laws and his decrees that I am giving you this day.

source: Achuti loule naneh-a nava tengle, chule in hoitah nakisah-a asunga nachen tengle,
target: Otherwise, when you eat and are satisfied, when you build fine houses and settle down,

source: Chule nagancha honu le nakelngoi hon hou ahung puna, nasanao le nadangka hou ahung puna, naneijouseu ahung punteng,
target: and when your herds and flocks grow large and your silver and gold increase and all you have is multiplied,

source: Chuteng le nalungthimu hung kichoisanga, henkola na-umnao in, Egypt gama kona nahin puidoh-a Pakai na Pathen chu sumil khaovin natin;
target: then your heart will become proud and you will forget the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

source: Gulse le aipi umna, Twi umlouna gamgo gamthip lentah le tijat umtah lhungkeija nahin pui galkaija, meituh songpi-a kona twi nape pao;
target: He led you through the vast and dreadful wilderness, that thirsty and waterless land, with its venomous snakes and scorpions. He brought you water out of hard rock.

source: Nahinkho nunung lamle naphat theina diuva nasuhnem theina diule naphotchet theina diuva gamthipma napute napateu vin ahetkhah louvu manna-a navahpao chu sumil khaovin natin;
target: He gave you manna to eat in the wilderness, something your ancestors had never known, to humble and test you so that in the end it might go well with you.

source: Chule nangman nalungthima, Kathil boltheina le kakhut thahat na-in hiche haona hohi eilampeh ahi, tigetnin nate.
target: You may say to yourself, “My power and the strength of my hands have produced this wealth for me.”

source: Amavang Pakai na Pathen chu nageldoh ding ahi: ajehchu tunikho-a banga hi napateu henga ana kihahselna akitepna chu aphudet theina dinga thahat nape-a chu ama ahi.
target: But remember the Lord your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth, and so confirms his covenant, which he swore to your ancestors, as it is today.

source: Chule hitiding ahi, Pakai na Pathen'u chu nasuhmil heluva, Pathen dang nung najuijuva, alhacha na natoh uva, nahou uva ahile, tunikho-a hi kagihsal nahiuve, nangho namanthai teidingu ahi.
target: If you ever forget the Lord your God and follow other gods and worship and bow down to them, I testify against you today that you will surely be destroyed.

source: Pakai na Pathen'u aw najuinom loujeh uva, namasanguva namdangho asuhmang banga, chutobanga chu namanthah dingu ahi.
target: Like the nations the Lord destroyed before you, so you will be destroyed for not obeying the Lord your God.

source: Ngaijun, Vo Israel: Tunia hi nangho sanga nasajo le hatjo, khopi lentah le van geija akulbang kisaho lodinga Jordan nagalkai ding ahin,
target: Hear, Israel: You are now about to cross the Jordan to go in and dispossess nations greater and stronger than you, with large cities that have walls up to the sky.

source: Nangin nanahetsa-u Anakim chate, Anak chate masanga koiham ading joudinga? tia miseina-a nanajah sao milentah tah le sangtah ho masanga nachedingu ahi.
target: The people are strong and tall—Anakites! You know about them and have heard it said: “Who can stand up against the Anakites?”

source: Hijeh chun tunikho hin namasanguva che-a chu Pakai na Pathen'u ahi ti heuvin; aman amaho chu kavamthei mei banga asuhmanga, na-angsung laitah uva asuhnem dingu ahi. Hitia chu Pakaiyin najah uva asei banga, amaho chu nanodoh uva, nasuhmang loi jeng dingu ahi.
target: But be assured today that the Lord your God is the one who goes across ahead of you like a devouring fire. He will destroy them; he will subdue them before you. And you will drive them out and annihilate them quickly, as the Lord has promised you.

source: Pakai na Pathen'in namasanga kona amaho anodoh nung tengle, Kachon phatna jeh-a Pakaiyin hiche gam lodinga eipuilut ahi, tin seihih-in; hiche nampiho gitlou jeh joh-a Pakaiyin namasanguva kona amaho anodoh ahibouve.
target: After the Lord your God has driven them out before you, do not say to yourself, “The Lord has brought me here to take possession of this land because of my righteousness.” No, it is on account of the wickedness of these nations that the Lord is going to drive them out before you.

source: Nachon phatna jeh, ahiloule nalungthima chondihna nanei jeh-a agamu lodia nache ahipoi: amavang hiche nam mite gitlou jeh le, Pakaiyin napu naputeu Abraham, Isaac, chule Jacob henga akihahselna asuh bulhitna dinga, Pakai na Pathen'un namasanguva kona amaho anodoh joh ahibouve.
target: It is not because of your righteousness or your integrity that you are going in to take possession of their land; but on account of the wickedness of these nations, the Lord your God will drive them out before you, to accomplish what he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

source: Hijeh chun hiche gampha hi nachon phatnao jeh-a Pakai na Pathen'un nalodiuva napeh-u ahipoi ti kihet un; ajehchu nangho milouchalte nahi bouvui.
target: Understand, then, that it is not because of your righteousness that the Lord your God is giving you this good land to possess, for you are a stiff-necked people.

source: Gamthip laija chu iti dana Pakai na Pathen'u nalunghansah-u ham geldoh-un lang, sumil hih-un; Egypt gama kona nakipat doh nikhouva pat, hiche mun nahunglhun geijun, nangho Pakai dounan nkiphinun ahi.
target: Remember this and never forget how you aroused the anger of the Lord your God in the wilderness. From the day you left Egypt until you arrived here, you have been rebellious against the Lord .

source: Horeb'a jong Pakai chu nalunghan sah uvin, chutichun nangho suhmangna ding khopmin Pakai chu alungsan ahi.
target: At Horeb you aroused the Lord ’s wrath so that he was angry enough to destroy you.

source: Songpheng teni, Pakaiyin nang hotoh akitepna songpheng teni chu ladinga molchunga kakaltou chun, nisomli le jan somli kaga umin, an kanepon, twi jong kadonpon ahi.
target: When I went up on the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant that the Lord had made with you, I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights; I ate no bread and drank no water.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Pathen khutjunga kisun songpheng ni eipen; hichea chun kikhoppi nikho-a Pakaiyin molsanga meikong lah-a kona nangho jah-a athusei jouse dungjuijin achunga chun akisunin ahi.
target: The Lord gave me two stone tablets inscribed by the finger of God. On them were all the commandments the Lord proclaimed to you on the mountain out of the fire, on the day of the assembly.

source: Chuin nisomli le jan somli kichai nichun ahitin ahi, Pakaiyin songpheng ni, kitepna songpheng teni ngei chu eipen ahi.
target: At the end of the forty days and forty nights, the Lord gave me the two stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin kajah-a, Kipatdoh-in, hikoma konhin chesuh loijin; ajehchu Egypt'a kona nahin puidoh namite khu amaho le amaho akisuboh-un; kathupeh lampi-a konin gangtah-in akihei mangun, amaho dingin akilhajol milim akisem taove, ati.
target: Then the Lord told me, “Go down from here at once, because your people whom you brought out of Egypt have become corrupt. They have turned away quickly from what I commanded them and have made an idol for themselves.”

source: Chukal valin Pakaiyin kahenga, Hiche mitehi kaven ahile, vetan, milouchalte ahiuve.
target: And the Lord said to me, “I have seen this people, and they are a stiff-necked people indeed!

source: Amaho hi kasuh manga, aminu vannoi'a kona kanoimang nadin kalolo neilosah jengin; chule nangma-a kona amaho sanga nasajole hatjo namkhat kasem ding ahi, ati.
target: Let me alone, so that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under heaven. And I will make you into a nation stronger and more numerous than they.”

source: Hijeh chun kakiheijin molsanga konin kahung kumlhan, chuin molsang chu meijin akan; chule kitepna songpheng teni chu kakhut teni-a aumin ahi.
target: So I turned and went down from the mountain while it was ablaze with fire. And the two tablets of the covenant were in my hands.

source: Chuin kaven ahile, veuvin, Pakai na Pathen'u dounan nachon seovin, bongnou lim kilhajol nana kisemun; Pakaiyin nathupeh-u lampia konin gangtah-in nakihei mangun ahi.
target: When I looked, I saw that you had sinned against the Lord your God; you had made for yourselves an idol cast in the shape of a calf. You had turned aside quickly from the way that the Lord had commanded you.

source: Chuin songpheng teni chu kalan, kakhut teni-a konin kaseplhan, namitmu tah-un kasuchip min ahi.
target: So I took the two tablets and threw them out of my hands, breaking them to pieces before your eyes.

source: Chuin amasa-a bang chun nisomli le jan somli Pakai angsunga kaboh khupmin; ama lunghansah dinga Pakai mitmu-a giloutah-a chonset nabol hou jouseu jehchun, an neloule twi donlouvin kaumin ahi.
target: Then once again I fell prostrate before the Lord for forty days and forty nights; I ate no bread and drank no water, because of all the sin you had committed, doing what was evil in the Lord ’s sight and so arousing his anger.

source: Ajehchu nangho sumang dinga nachung uva Pakai lunghanna, alungsatna le alunglhai louna chu kakichan ahi. Ahivangin Pakaiyin hichepet jong chun kathu angaijin ahi.
target: I feared the anger and wrath of the Lord , for he was angry enough with you to destroy you. But again the Lord listened to me.

source: Chuin Pakai chu Aaron chunga suhmang na ding khopmin alunghangin; Aaron dinjong hiche petchun kataovin ahi.
target: And the Lord was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him, but at that time I prayed for Aaron too.

source: Chuin nachonset nao, na bongnou kisemu chu kalan, meija kagouvin, leivui banga adi kahsen kachil goijin; chule adi chu molsanga kona longlha vachadunga chun kalehlut tai.
target: Also I took that sinful thing of yours, the calf you had made, and burned it in the fire. Then I crushed it and ground it to powder as fine as dust and threw the dust into a stream that flowed down the mountain.

source: Chule Teberah'a, Massah'a, Kibroth-hatta-avah'a jong Pakai chu nalunghansah-uvin ahi.
target: You also made the Lord angry at Taberah, at Massah and at Kibroth Hattaavah.

source: Chutobang chun Pakaiyin Kadesh-barnea'a kona nasol uva, Chetouvun lang keiman kapehnao gamchu galo taovin ati chun; Pakai na Pathen'u thupeh dounan nakiphin un, ama natahsan hih-un, athujong nangai pouvin ahi.
target: And when the Lord sent you out from Kadesh Barnea, he said, “Go up and take possession of the land I have given you.” But you rebelled against the command of the Lord your God. You did not trust him or obey him.

source: Nanghohi kahet nikhouva patnin Pakai dounan nakiphin un ahi.
target: You have been rebellious against the Lord ever since I have known you.

source: Chutia Pakaiyin nangho suhmang ding ahi atijeh chun, amasa-a kabohkhup bangchun, nisomli le jan somli Pakai anga kaboh khupmin ahi.
target: I lay prostrate before the Lord those forty days and forty nights because the Lord had said he would destroy you.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai henga kataovin, Vo Pakai Pathen, naloupina vanga nalhat doh-a, khut thahat tah-a Egypt'a kona napuidoh nam mite le nagoulote hi sumanghih-in.
target: I prayed to the Lord and said, “Sovereign Lord , do not destroy your people, your own inheritance that you redeemed by your great power and brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

source: Nasoh Abraham, Isaac, chule Jacob chu geldoh inlang, hiche mite lungtahna, agitlouna le, achonset naohi vehih beh-in.
target: Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. Overlook the stubbornness of this people, their wickedness and their sin.

source: Achuti loule neihin puidohnao gam miten, Pakaiyin ateppehna gama apuilut theilou jeh le, aman amaho ahot jeh-a, gamthipma thagam dinga ahin puidoh-u ahi, tigetnunte.
target: Otherwise, the country from which you brought us will say, ‘Because the Lord was not able to take them into the land he had promised them, and because he hated them, he brought them out to put them to death in the wilderness.’

source: Amavang nathahat thilboltheina le naban najahdoh-a nahinpuidoh namite le nagoulote ahiuve, katin ahi.
target: But they are your people, your inheritance that you brought out by your great power and your outstretched arm.”

source: Hiche laichun Pakaiyin kahenga, Amasa-a bangin songpheng ni khengin lang, molsang chunga kaheng lama hungtouvin lang, thing thingkhong khat semin.
target: At that time the Lord said to me, “Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones and come up to me on the mountain. Also make a wooden ark.

source: Chule nangin nasechip songphenga kisun thucheng hochu songpheng teni chunga chu kasutding, chule hichu thingkhong sunga nakoiding ahi, ati.
target: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke. Then you are to put them in the ark.”

source: Chuin Shittim thingin thingkhong kasemin, chule amasa bangin songpheng ni kakhengin, chule songpheng teni chu kakhutna choipumin molsanga chun kakal toutai.
target: So I made the ark out of acacia wood and chiseled out two stone tablets like the first ones, and I went up on the mountain with the two tablets in my hands.

source: Chuin songpheng chunga chun akisun masa bangin, khoppi nikho-a molsanga meikong lah-a kona Pakaiyin naheng uva asei thupeh som chu asunin; chule hichu Pakaiyin keima eipetai.
target: The Lord wrote on these tablets what he had written before, the Ten Commandments he had proclaimed to you on the mountain, out of the fire, on the day of the assembly. And the Lord gave them to me.

source: Chuin kaki heijin molsanga konin kahung kumlhan, songpheng chu kasem thingkhong sunga chun kakhumin; Pakaiyin eithupeh bangin chua chun aumjing tan ahi.
target: Then I came back down the mountain and put the tablets in the ark I had made, as the Lord commanded me, and they are there now.

source: Chuin Israel chate chu Jaakan chate kho Beeroth'a konin Mosera alhungun; chua chun Aaron athin, chumun mama-a chun avui taovin; chule ama khelin achapa Eleazer'in thempu tohmun lhachana chu atongtai.
target: (The Israelites traveled from the wells of Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died and was buried, and Eleazar his son succeeded him as priest.

source: Chua konchun amaho Gudgodah'a alhungun, Gudgodah-a konin vapi twiho umna gam Jotbath alhungun ahi.
target: From there they traveled to Gudgodah and on to Jotbathah, a land with streams of water.

source: Hiche laichun Pakai kitepna thingkhong puding le, Pakai angsunga dinga lhachana tong dingin, chule tunichan geija amin phatthei boh dingin Pakaiyin Levi phung chu achom khenin ahi.
target: At that time the Lord set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the Lord , to stand before the Lord to minister and to pronounce blessings in his name, as they still do today.

source: Hijeh-a chu Levi'n asopite lah-a chan jong, gou jong aneilou ahi; Pakai na Pathen'un athupeh banga, Pakai chu agoulo hija ahi.
target: That is why the Levites have no share or inheritance among their fellow Israelites; the Lord is their inheritance, as the Lord your God told them.)

source: Chuin phat masa-a bang chun nisomli le jan somli molsanga chun kaumin; chule hichepet jong chun Pakaiyin eingaipeh-a, Pakaiyin nangho nasumang tapouvin ahi.
target: Now I had stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights, as I did the first time, and the Lord listened to me at this time also. It was not his will to destroy you.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga, Kipatdoh-in, Apu apateu pehdinga kaki hahsel na gamchu alutnuva agalo theina diuvin, mipi ho chu lamkaijin, eiti.
target: “Go,” the Lord said to me, “and lead the people on their way, so that they may enter and possess the land I swore to their ancestors to give them.”

source: Chule tun, Israel, Pakai na Pathen'in nanga kona angeh chu ipiham, Pakai na Pathen chu naginna, alampi jouse-a najuija, ama nangailutna, nalung pumpi le nathaneina pumpi-a Pakai na Pathen najena,
target: And now, Israel, what does the Lord your God ask of you but to fear the Lord your God, to walk in obedience to him, to love him, to serve the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

source: Naphat theina dinga tunia kathupeh, Pakai thupeh hole achonna dan kisunho nanitding hi hilouham?
target: and to observe the Lord ’s commands and decrees that I am giving you today for your own good?

source: Veuvin, van le vanho jouse van, chule leiset le asunga umjouse jonghi Pakai na Pathen uva ahi.
target: To the Lord your God belong the heavens, even the highest heavens, the earth and everything in it.

source: Ahinla napu napateu ngailut ding bou chu Pakai lunglhaina ahin, amaho nunga achilhahteu, nangho jeng jong tunia nahinao bangahi mijouse chungvuma nalhenu ahi.
target: Yet the Lord set his affection on your ancestors and loved them, and he chose you, their descendants, above all the nations—as it is today.

source: Hijeh chun nalungsung chep tanun lang, louchal tahih-un.
target: Circumcise your hearts, therefore, and do not be stiff-necked any longer.

source: Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'u hi pathenho Pathen, pakai ho Pakai, Pathen loupitah, hat chungnung, tijat umtah, mihem mai velou le, lepthol lalou ahi.
target: For the Lord your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, mighty and awesome, who shows no partiality and accepts no bribes.

source: Aman paneilou le meithai thu dihtah-in atanin, gamdangmi nehding le vonding apen angailun ahi.
target: He defends the cause of the fatherless and the widow, and loves the foreigner residing among you, giving them food and clothing.

source: Hijeh chun nanghon gamdangmi ngailuvin; ajehchu nangho jong Egypt gama gamdangmi nanahiu ahi.
target: And you are to love those who are foreigners, for you yourselves were foreigners in Egypt.

source: Nangman Pakai na Pathen nagin ding; ama najena, ama-a nabe ding, chule amina nakitep ding ahi.
target: Fear the Lord your God and serve him. Hold fast to him and take your oaths in his name.

source: Amachu navahchoi dingpa ahin, chule namit teni-a namu hiche thil loupile tijat umtahho nangma dinga ana bola na Pathen chu ahi.
target: He is the one you praise; he is your God, who performed for you those great and awesome wonders you saw with your own eyes.

source: Napu napateu chu Egypt gama mi somsagi toh anachesuh-un; chule tun Pakai na Pathen'un natamdanu chu van'a ahsi ho banga tamin nasemtaove.
target: Your ancestors who went down into Egypt were seventy in all, and now the Lord your God has made you as numerous as the stars in the sky.

source: Hijeh-a chu nangman Pakai na Pathen chu na ngailutna, aman nanganse na ho, achona dan kisunho, athutanna ho, chule athupehho nanit jingding ahi.
target: Love the Lord your God and keep his requirements, his decrees, his laws and his commands always.

source: Chule tunikhon heuvin, ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'u gimbolna, aloupina, akhut thahat, chule aban jahdohna hekhalou le mukhalou nachateo henga thu kasei ahipoi;
target: Remember today that your children were not the ones who saw and experienced the discipline of the Lord your God: his majesty, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm;

source: Chule Egypt mite lailung tah-a Egypt lengpa Pharaoh chung le agamsung pumpi-a athilkidang bol ho le anatohho,
target: the signs he performed and the things he did in the heart of Egypt, both to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his whole country;

source: Egypt sepai ho chung le asakol hou chung, chule akangtalai chunga anabol ho, amahon nahin nungdel naova twipisan iti achupsah-u, chule iti dana Pakaiyin amaho tunigeija asuhmang ham,
target: what he did to the Egyptian army, to its horses and chariots, how he overwhelmed them with the waters of the Red Sea as they were pursuing you, and how the Lord brought lasting ruin on them.

source: Chule hiche munna nahunglhun kahseuva gamthipma chu naheng uva ipi abol,
target: It was not your children who saw what he did for you in the wilderness until you arrived at this place,

source: Chule Reuben chapa Eliab chapateni Dathan le Abiram chunga ipi abol, leisetnin akam iti ahinkah-a amaho le a-insungu pumpi, chule apon inhou le Israelte lah-a anei jouseu aval lhum ham ti hekhalou le mukhalou nachateo henga thu kasei ahipoi.
target: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab the Reubenite, when the earth opened its mouth right in the middle of all Israel and swallowed them up with their households, their tents and every living thing that belonged to them.

source: Ahin nangho mitnin vang Pakai thilbol loupiho jouse chu amun ahi.
target: But it was your own eyes that saw all these great things the Lord has done.

source: Hijeh-a chu nahat theijuva, lodinga nachennao gam chu nagalo theina dinguvin, keiman tunia kathupeh, dan thupeh ho jousehi nanit dingu ahi.
target: Observe therefore all the commands I am giving you today, so that you may have the strength to go in and take over the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess,

source: Chutile Pakaiyin napu napateu leh achilhah teo pehdinga ahahselna, bongnoi le khoiju lonna gama chu nahinkhou sot thei ding ahi.
target: and so that you may live long in the land the Lord swore to your ancestors to give to them and their descendants, a land flowing with milk and honey.

source: Ajehchu galo dinga nachenao gamchu nahungdohnao Egypt gam, anche louhing hon, muchi natheuva nakenga twi nachap jinao tobang ahipoi.
target: The land you are entering to take over is not like the land of Egypt, from which you have come, where you planted your seed and irrigated it by foot as in a vegetable garden.

source: Ahinla galo dinga nachenao gam chu thinglhang le phaicham umna, van gotuijin achap nou jingna gam,
target: But the land you are crossing the Jordan to take possession of is a land of mountains and valleys that drinks rain from heaven.

source: Pakai na Pathen'un avettup jingna gam, Pakai na Pathen'u mit chu kum kipatna pat kum kichaigeija achunga aum jingna gam ahi.
target: It is a land the Lord your God cares for; the eyes of the Lord your God are continually on it from the beginning of the year to its end.

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi, Pakai na Pathen chu nangailutna nalung pumpi le nalhagao pumpi-a ama jen dinga tunia kapeh thupeh hi chingthei tah-a nangaija ahile,
target: So if you faithfully obey the commands I am giving you today—to love the Lord your God and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul—

source: Nachang, na lengpithei, chule nathao twi naki khoptup theina dinga van gotwi masale gotwi nunung aphatcha kapeh dingu ahi.
target: then I will send rain on your land in its season, both autumn and spring rains, so that you may gather in your grain, new wine and olive oil.

source: Chule naneh uva nava theina dinguva, nagancha teo dinga nagamsunguva hamhing kaphatsah ding ahi.
target: I will provide grass in the fields for your cattle, and you will eat and be satisfied.

source: Nalungsungu lheplhah-a aumlouna dingle, nakihei manguva pathen dang ho najen uva nahoulou nadingun chingtheijun.
target: Be careful, or you will be enticed to turn away and worship other gods and bow down to them.

source: Chutile Pakai lunghan nachunga koujah intin, gojuh louna din van khah intin, leijin aga asodoh louding,Pakaiyin napeh-u gam phatah-a konin mangthah loi getnun nate.
target: Then the Lord ’s anger will burn against you, and he will shut up the heavens so that it will not rain and the ground will yield no produce, and you will soon perish from the good land the Lord is giving you.

source: Hijeh chun hiche kathuho hi nalungthim le nahinna-in vop inlang, namit teni kah-a thuchih bom tobang ahitheina din, nakhut chunga melchihna hidingin kanbeh-in.
target: Fix these words of mine in your hearts and minds; tie them as symbols on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.

source: Chule hicheho chu nachateo nahil dingu, na-in'uva natou petnu, nalam jot petnu, nalup petnu chule natho tengu jongle nahil jingdiu ahi.
target: Teach them to your children, talking about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.

source: Chule na-inkot khomho chung le nakotpiho chunga hichehi nasut dingu ahi.
target: Write them on the doorframes of your houses and on your gates,

source: Chutia chu napu napateu pehdinga Pakaiyin ahahselnau gama chu nahinkhou le nachateo hinkhoho chu leichunga vangam nikhoho banga sotding ahi.
target: so that your days and the days of your children may be many in the land the Lord swore to give your ancestors, as many as the days that the heavens are above the earth.

source: Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen chu ngailut ding, alampi jouse jotdinga chule ama-a behjing dinga kathupeh ho chu chingthei tah-a nanitna ahile,
target: If you carefully observe all these commands I am giving you to follow—to love the Lord your God, to walk in obedience to him and to hold fast to him—

source: Pakaiyin namasanguva konin hiche nam jousehi anodoh ding, nangho sanga nasajole hatjo namho nahin lodiu ahi.
target: then the Lord will drive out all these nations before you, and you will dispossess nations larger and stronger than you.

source: Nakeng phanguva nachot phahna chanu chu nangho-a hiding, gamthip le Lebanon'a pat, luipilen, Euphrates luipi-a pat twikhanglen mong gei sana nangho-a hiding ahi.
target: Every place where you set your foot will be yours: Your territory will extend from the desert to Lebanon, and from the Euphrates River to the Mediterranean Sea.

source: Namasanguva ding ngam koimacha umlou ding ahi. Ajehchu aman naheng uva anasei banga, nachot phahdiu gamjousea chu Pakai na Pathen'un nangho gin nale kichatna akoiding ahi.
target: No one will be able to stand against you. The Lord your God, as he promised you, will put the terror and fear of you on the whole land, wherever you go.

source: Veuvin, tunin namasanguva phattheina le gaosapna kakoije.
target: See, I am setting before you today a blessing and a curse—

source: Pakai na Pathen nu thupeh ho, tu-a kapeh hohi nanit nuva ahile phattheina hintin,
target: the blessing if you obey the commands of the Lord your God that I am giving you today;

source: Chule Pakai na Pathen'u thupeh nanit lou uva, nahetkhah lou pathen dangho houdinga, tunia kathupeh lampia kona nakihei manguva ahile gaosapna hiding ahi.
target: the curse if you disobey the commands of the Lord your God and turn from the way that I command you today by following other gods, which you have not known.

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, galo dinga nachenao gama chu Pakai Pathen'in napuilut tengu le, Gerizim molsang chunga chu phat theina nakoi uva, Ebal molsang chunga gaosapna nakoi dingu ahi.
target: When the Lord your God has brought you into the land you are entering to possess, you are to proclaim on Mount Gerizim the blessings, and on Mount Ebal the curses.

source: Hichu Jordan gal langkhat, nisa lhumna lamsanga Moreh phaicham kom, Gilgal maijon muncham dunglaija Canaan mite chena gama chu uma hilouham?
target: As you know, these mountains are across the Jordan, westward, toward the setting sun, near the great trees of Moreh, in the territory of those Canaanites living in the Arabah in the vicinity of Gilgal.

source: Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'un napehnao gamchu galo dinga Jordan nagalkai diu ahin, chule hichu nalouva, asunga nachendiu ahi.
