target: You are about to cross the Jordan to enter and take possession of the land the Lord your God is giving you. When you have taken it over and are living there,

source: Chule tunia namasanguva kakoi chonna dan kisun hole thutanna hochu nanitna dinguva nachihthei dingu ahi.
target: be sure that you obey all the decrees and laws I am setting before you today.

source: Hichehohi napu napateu Pakai Pathen'in leisetna nahin laiseuva nalodiuva anapehnao gama nanitdiu chonna dan le thutan naho chu ahi.
target: These are the decrees and laws you must be careful to follow in the land that the Lord , the God of your ancestors, has given you to possess—as long as you live in the land.

source: Nagalo diu gama namhon molsang ho chung le lhangho chunga, chule thinghing phung engsel noitina, a-pathen hou anajen nau munho jouse chu nasuhmang soh heldiu ahi.
target: Destroy completely all the places on the high mountains, on the hills and under every spreading tree, where the nations you are dispossessing worship their gods.

source: Chule amaicham ho nasuh chimuva, asong phu hou navohboh uva, athingbom hou meija nahaldiu, semthu milim pathenho naphuh lhuh uva, chuche munna kona chu aminu nasuhmang diu ahi.
target: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones and burn their Asherah poles in the fire; cut down the idols of their gods and wipe out their names from those places.

source: Pakai na Pathen'u henga vang chutia nabol loudiu ahi.
target: You must not worship the Lord your God in their way.

source: Ahinla Pakai na Pathen'un naphung jouseu lah-a kona amin umna dinga alhendoh ding mun, hiche mun ngeichu nahol diu, hiche mun'a chu nahung diu ahi.
target: But you are to seek the place the Lord your God will choose from among all your tribes to put his Name there for his dwelling. To that place you must go;

source: Chule hilama chu nagovam thiltohou, naganlhai na hou, na somakhat hou, nakhutjap thilpeh hou, nakitep nahou, nalung cham tah uva thilto natohou, nagan honu le na kelngoi hon lah uva apeng masapen ho chu nahin choidiu ahi.
target: there bring your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and special gifts, what you have vowed to give and your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks.

source: Chule chua chu Pakai na Pathen'u masanga naneh uva Pakai na Pathen'in nanatohna jouse-a phatthei nabohna chung changa nangma le na-insung mite jouse nakipa diu ahi.
target: There, in the presence of the Lord your God, you and your families shall eat and shall rejoice in everything you have put your hand to, because the Lord your God has blessed you.

source: Tunikho-a hilai mun'a mitinin ama mitmu-a dih asah chan abol banga hi nabol loudingu ahi.
target: You are not to do as we do here today, everyone doing as they see fit,

source: Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'un napeh-u choldona le gou lona munchu nalhung hihlai tadiuve.
target: since you have not yet reached the resting place and the inheritance the Lord your God is giving you.

source: Ahinla nangho Jordan nagalkaijuva, Pakai na Pathen'un lodinga nana peh-u gama nachen tengule, chule nakimvel uva namelma teu jouse-a kona choldona napeh tengule, bitkeija nachendiu ahitan;
target: But you will cross the Jordan and settle in the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, and he will give you rest from all your enemies around you so that you will live in safety.

source: Chutengle Pakai na Pathen'un amin umna dinga alhending munkhat umintin; hilama chu kathupeh jouse, nagovam thiltohou, naganlhai nahou, nahopsom hou, nakhutjap thilpeh hou, Pakai henga nakitepnao deilhen kitepna jouse nahinchoi dingu ahi;
target: Then to the place the Lord your God will choose as a dwelling for his Name—there you are to bring everything I command you: your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and special gifts, and all the choice possessions you have vowed to the Lord .

source: Chule nangho Pakai na Pathen'u masanga, nangho le nachapateo le nachanuteu, nasoh pasal ho leh nasoh numei hou, chule nakotpi sunguva um Levi miteho toh nakipa khomdiu ahi; ajehchu amaho nang hotoh chan le gou neikhomlou ahiuve.
target: And there rejoice before the Lord your God—you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levites from your towns who have no allotment or inheritance of their own.

source: Mun namuna jouse-a govam thilto nato louna dingin chingtheijin.
target: Be careful not to sacrifice your burnt offerings anywhere you please.

source: Ahinla Pakaiyin naphung sungu khat penpena kona alhendoh ding munna chu govam thilto nato uva, chua chu kathupeh jouse nabolding ahi.
target: Offer them only at the place the Lord will choose in one of your tribes, and there observe everything I command you.

source: Ahivanga Pakai na Pathen'u phattheiboh dungjuija aman napeh jouseu chu nalungin angaichat dungjuija nakotpi phung jouse-a natha-a, asa naneh theiding ahi. Mi atheng le atheng louvin jong, sapengchal le sakhichal hijongle aneh theiding ahi.
target: Nevertheless, you may slaughter your animals in any of your towns and eat as much of the meat as you want, as if it were gazelle or deer, according to the blessing the Lord your God gives you. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat it.

source: Thisan bou naneh loudiu, twibanga tolla nasunlhah diu ahi.
target: But you must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.

source: Nakotpi hou sunga chu nachang hopsom-u, nalengpi gao hopsom, nathao twi'u hopsom, nagancha houlah-a apeng masaho ahiloule nakelngoi hon lah uva apeng masaho, kitepna-a nakitepna hou, nalungcham thilto hou, nakhutna najap thiltohou chu naneh theilou dingu ahi.
target: You must not eat in your own towns the tithe of your grain and new wine and olive oil, or the firstborn of your herds and flocks, or whatever you have vowed to give, or your freewill offerings or special gifts.

source: Amavang Pakai na Pathen'un alhending mun'a chu Pakai na Pathen'u masanga vang ,nang le nachapate le nachanute, nasoh pasal le nasoh numei ho, chule nakotpi hou sunga um Levi hotoh naneh teidiu ahi. Chule Pakai na Pathen'u masanga nakhut nangapna jouse-a chu nakipa diu ahi.
target: Instead, you are to eat them in the presence of the Lord your God at the place the Lord your God will choose—you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levites from your towns—and you are to rejoice before the Lord your God in everything you put your hand to.

source: Leichunga nahinlai chansea Levi mite nanot thap lounadin chingtheijin.
target: Be careful not to neglect the Levites as long as you live in your land.

source: Pakai na Pathen'un nana teppeh-u banga nagamgi akehletna, chule, Nahinna-in sa nehding ngaichat jeh-a sa nenge nati tengle, nahinnan aduchat sa chan chu naneh thei ahi.
target: When the Lord your God has enlarged your territory as he promised you, and you crave meat and say, “I would like some meat,” then you may eat as much of it as you want.

source: Pakai na Pathen'in amin koina dinga analhen munchu nanga kona agamlat behsetna ahile, keiman kathupeh banga, Pakaiyin napeh nagancha hon le nakelngoihona kona natha-a, nakotpi phunga chu nahinna-in aduchat channa naneh ding ahi.
target: If the place where the Lord your God chooses to put his Name is too far away from you, you may slaughter animals from the herds and flocks the Lord has given you, as I have commanded you, and in your own towns you may eat as much of them as you want.

source: Sapeng chal leh sakhichal kineh banga naneh ding ahi; athengle atheng louvin kibanga aneh dingu ahi.
target: Eat them as you would gazelle or deer. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat.

source: Thisan bou chu naneh louhelna dingin chingtheijin; ajehchu thisan chu hinna ahin; chule hina chu asa toh naneh koptha theilou ding ahi.
target: But be sure you do not eat the blood, because the blood is the life, and you must not eat the life with the meat.

source: Nanghon hichu naneh loudiu, twibanga tolla nasunlhah dingu ahi.
target: You must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.

source: Pakai mitmu-a thildih nabol tengle, nangma le nanunga nachate naphat theina dinguva hichu naneh lou dingu ahi.
target: Do not eat it, so that it may go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is right in the eyes of the Lord .

source: Nathil theng neiho le nakitep naho bou chu nachoija, Pakaiyin alhending mun'a chu nache ding ahi.
target: But take your consecrated things and whatever you have vowed to give, and go to the place the Lord will choose.

source: Chule na govam thilto chu asa le athisan agoma Pakai na Pathen'u maicham chunga na nato-a, chule aganlhaina thisan chu Pakai na Pathen maicham chunga kisung lhading, asachu naneh ding ahi.
target: Present your burnt offerings on the altar of the Lord your God, both the meat and the blood. The blood of your sacrifices must be poured beside the altar of the Lord your God, but you may eat the meat.

source: Pakai na Pathen mitmu-a apha le adih nabol tengle, nangma le nanunga nachate dinga a-itih-a naphat theina dinguva, nangman kathupeh jouse hi lunglutna nangaija nanitding ahi.
target: Be careful to obey all these regulations I am giving you, so that it may always go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is good and right in the eyes of the Lord your God.

source: Pakai na Pathen'in galo dinga nachenao gama nampiho chu namasanguva kona asuhmanga, nanghon amaho najo uva, agamuva nachen tengule;
target: The Lord your God will cut off before you the nations you are about to invade and dispossess. But when you have driven them out and settled in their land,

source: Namasanguva kona akisuhmang banguva, amaho nung najuina-a na-o louna ding le, hiche namhohin itobanga a-pathen'u ajenum? amaho bolbangin eihon jong bolute, tia a-pathen'u thudol hou nakhol louna dingun chingtheijun.
target: and after they have been destroyed before you, be careful not to be ensnared by inquiring about their gods, saying, “How do these nations serve their gods? We will do the same.”

source: Hitobanga chu Pakai na Pathen'u henga nabol loudingu ahi. Ajehchu amahon Pakaiya thet umjouse, ahot ho chu abol jiuvin, achapateu le achanuteu san a-pathen dingun meijin ahal jiuve.
target: You must not worship the Lord your God in their way, because in worshiping their gods, they do all kinds of detestable things the Lord hates. They even burn their sons and daughters in the fire as sacrifices to their gods.

source: Boldinga thu kapeh chanchu nabolding ahi; hichea kona chu nabelap louding, lah jong nalahdoh louding ahi.
target: See that you do all I command you; do not add to it or take away from it.

source: Nalah uva themgao ham, mang neiham asodoh-a, melchihna ham, thil kidang namusah uva,
target: If a prophet, or one who foretells by dreams, appears among you and announces to you a sign or wonder,

source: Chule melchihna ham, thil kidang ham chu aguilhuna, chule naheng uva, Nahet khahlouvu pathen dangho juiju hitin, amaho jennu hite tia aseile;
target: and if the sign or wonder spoken of takes place, and the prophet says, “Let us follow other gods” (gods you have not known) “and let us worship them,”

source: Nanghon chuche themgao ham, mang neipa ham thuchu ngaihih-un; ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'in nalung pumpile nalhagao pumpiuva Pakai na Pathen'u chu nangailut nangailut lou hetna dia napatepmu ahi.
target: you must not listen to the words of that prophet or dreamer. The Lord your God is testing you to find out whether you love him with all your heart and with all your soul.

source: Nanghon Pakai na Pathen'u nung najuijuva, naginuva, athupeh ho nanit uva, athu naman uva, ama najen uva, chule ama-a nabediu ahi.
target: It is the Lord your God you must follow, and him you must revere. Keep his commands and obey him; serve him and hold fast to him.

source: Chule chuche themgao ham, mangnei ham pachu tha jengding ahi; ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'u Egypt gama nahinpuidoh uva, sohchana in'a kona nalhatdoh paova kona kihei mangna ding thu aseijin, Pakai Pathen'in chedinga thu napehnao lampia kona kiheimang ding nagouvin ahi. Chutia chu nanghon agilou chu nalah uva kona chu nasuhmang diu ahi.
target: That prophet or dreamer must be put to death for inciting rebellion against the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt and redeemed you from the land of slavery. That prophet or dreamer tried to turn you from the way the Lord your God commanded you to follow. You must purge the evil from among you.

source: Nanu chapa nasopipa ham, nachapa ham, nachanu ham, na-angkoi na-inneipi ham, nagol napai ham, nahinna tobang hela nagel khatnin guhthima najola, nahenga, Nangman nahetkhah lou, nangma le napaten ahetkhah louvu pathen dangho gahouvu hite;
target: If your very own brother, or your son or daughter, or the wife you love, or your closest friend secretly entices you, saying, “Let us go and worship other gods” (gods that neither you nor your ancestors have known,

source: Nakimvel uva mite, nakom naiham, gamlatah-a umham, kolmonga pat kolmong langkhat gei pathen ho chu gahouvu hite tia aseija ahileh,
target: gods of the peoples around you, whether near or far, from one end of the land to the other),

source: Nangman amachu nanoppeh louding, ngaijong nangaipeh louhel ding; namitnin jong akhotolou ding, kheh jong nakheh louding, chule imjong na-im mang lou ding;
target: do not yield to them or listen to them. Show them no pity. Do not spare them or shield them.

source: Amavang natha teitei joh ding; nangman ama thana dinga achunga nakhut nalhah masat pending, chujoule mipijouse khut chu achunga chuding ahi.
target: You must certainly put them to death. Your hand must be the first in putting them to death, and then the hands of all the people.

source: Chule ama chu songa nase-a naselih dingu ahi; ajehchu aman Egypt gamsunga sohchana in'a kona nahin puidoh Pakai na Pathen'a kon heimang ding nagon ahi.
target: Stone them to death, because they tried to turn you away from the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

source: Chutia chu Israel jousen ajah uva, kicha diu, chule nalah uva hitobang gitlounahi abolkit tah loudingu ahi.
target: Then all Israel will hear and be afraid, and no one among you will do such an evil thing again.

source: Pakai na Pathen'in chenna dinga nanapeh khopiho khatna thu kisei;
target: If you hear it said about one of the towns the Lord your God is giving you to live in

source: Nalah uva kon mi phabep, Belial chate achedoh-un, akhopi sunguva mite chu ajol lhaovin, ajah uva, Nanahet khah louvu pathen dangho lhachana tong dingin cheohite, tia kisei najah-a ahile;
target: that troublemakers have arisen among you and have led the people of their town astray, saying, “Let us go and worship other gods” (gods you have not known),

source: Chuteng nangman nadoh toh ding, nakhol ding, gunchutah tah-a nadoh ding, chule ven, hichu thutah ahia, chutobang thet umchu nalah uva akibol tahbeh ahi-a ahile;
target: then you must inquire, probe and investigate it thoroughly. And if it is true and it has been proved that this detestable thing has been done among you,

source: Chuche khopi-a chengho chu chemjam hema natha teiding, chua cheng jousele, chua ganchahon chu chemjam hema nasuhmang hel ding ahi.
target: you must certainly put to the sword all who live in that town. You must destroy it completely, both its people and its livestock.

source: Chule chua galthil kichom jouse chu kholai lamlena nakhop sohkeija, chuche khopi le thilkichom takip chu Pakai na Pathen dinga meija nahalding ahi. Chule hichu a-itih-a dinga kisevuma, avela kisadohkit louhel ding ahitai.
target: You are to gather all the plunder of the town into the middle of the public square and completely burn the town and all its plunder as a whole burnt offering to the Lord your God. That town is to remain a ruin forever, never to be rebuilt,

source: Chule nakhutna gaosap thil natohkhah louding ahi: chutile Pakai chu tijat umtah alungsatna-a kona akileheija, napu napateu henga anamusah banga hepina namusah-a, nachunga lainatna aneija, napunsah ding ahi;
target: and none of the condemned things are to be found in your hands. Then the Lord will turn from his fierce anger, will show you mercy, and will have compassion on you. He will increase your numbers, as he promised on oath to your ancestors—

source: Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen mitmu-a adih bolna dinga tunia keiman thu kapeh ama thupeh jouse nanitna dingin, Pakai na Pathen aw nangaijin ahi.
target: because you obey the Lord your God by keeping all his commands that I am giving you today and doing what is right in his eyes.

source: Nangho Pakai na Pathen'u chate nahiuve: mithi puldou na-a nangho le nangho naki-at chen loudingu, chule namitmulu jong nahet tol louhel dingu ahi.
target: You are the children of the Lord your God. Do not cut yourselves or shave the front of your heads for the dead,

source: Ajehchu nangho Pakai na Pathen uva dinga mitheng nahiu ahin, chule Pakaiyin leichunga um nam jouse chungvuma ama-a tum hidinga achombeh-a nalhenu ahi.
target: for you are a people holy to the Lord your God. Out of all the peoples on the face of the earth, the Lord has chosen you to be his treasured possession.

source: Nanghon thet um kiti mongmong naneh louhel dingu ahi.
target: Do not eat any detestable thing.

source: Nanghon naneh dingu saho chu: bongchal, kelngoi, chule kelcha.
target: These are the animals you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,

source: Sakhichal, sapengchal, sajuh, gamkel, gambongchal chule gamkelngoi.
target: the deer, the gazelle, the roe deer, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope and the mountain sheep.

source: Chule sa jouse lah-a kon akengtin kikhena atin ni-a kika, chule anehsa ihdoh kitna lhaikit tapou chu naneh dingu ahi.
target: You may eat any animal that has a divided hoof and that chews the cud.

source: Hijongle anehsa ihdoh kit ahiloule atin kikhenkah lah-a kon sangongsang, telep, jupi, hichehohi naneh loudiu ahi; ajehchu amahon anehsa a-ihdoh-un alhaikit naovin ahin atinnu vang akika pon ahi. Hijeh-a chu nangho dinga athenglou hiuva ahi.
target: However, of those that chew the cud or that have a divided hoof you may not eat the camel, the rabbit or the hyrax. Although they chew the cud, they do not have a divided hoof; they are ceremonially unclean for you.

source: Chule vohcha jong atin akikah vangin anehsa a-ihdoh-a alhaikit lou jeh-in nangho dinga athenglou ahi. Nanghon asao naneh loudiu, athilongu jong natohkhah loudiu ahi.
target: The pig is also unclean; although it has a divided hoof, it does not chew the cud. You are not to eat their meat or touch their carcasses.

source: Twilah-a ganhing nenehthei houchu hichehohi ahi: alha nei le alipnei jouse naneh diu ahi.
target: Of all the creatures living in the water, you may eat any that has fins and scales.

source: Chule alha le alip neilou jouse chu naneh loudingu ahi; hicheho chu nangho dinga thenglou ahi.
target: But anything that does not have fins and scales you may not eat; for you it is unclean.

source: Vacha theng jouse naneh dingu ahi.
target: You may eat any clean bird.

source: Ahin naneh loudiu hochu: muvanlai, mungagal, muthong
target: But these you may not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,

source: Muvom, mubong, chule muthong toh kilimlo jouse.
target: the red kite, the black kite, any kind of falcon,

source: Va-ah le amatoh kilimlo jouse,
target: any kind of raven,

source: Chule sumbu, vabah, kakhut, chule mu toh kilimlo jouse.
target: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

source: Sumbuchanglit, sumbupi, twivatot,
target: the little owl, the great owl, the white owl,

source: Chule twivamuhsao, muthong lhem, vatot muhkon
target: the desert owl, the osprey, the cormorant,

source: Chule twilungva, twivakang le akilimlo jouse, vakhong lhu le bah,
target: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe and the bat.

source: Chule a-opma kitholtho-a lengthei takip nangho dinga athenglou ahi: hicheho chu nehlou ding ahiuve.
target: All flying insects are unclean to you; do not eat them.

source: Ahinla vacha thengho jouse chu naneh theiju ahi.
target: But any winged creature that is clean you may eat.

source: Nanghon athikam imacha naneh loudingu ahi: hichu nakotpi phunga um kholjin mihon anehdiuva napeh ding; ahiloule gamchom mi henga najohthei ahi. Ajehchu nangho Pakai na Pathen'u dinga mitheng nahiu ahi. Nanghon api noitwija kelnou nahon loudingu ahi.
target: Do not eat anything you find already dead. You may give it to the foreigner residing in any of your towns, and they may eat it, or you may sell it to any other foreigner. But you are a people holy to the Lord your God. Do not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.

source: Akumtina nalouvin asodoh namuchi-a kona hungpeng doh jouse hopsom-a hopkhat thonlouva napeh ding ahi.
target: Be sure to set aside a tenth of all that your fields produce each year.

source: Pakai na Pathen ginje nakihil jing theina dinga, nachang hopsom, nalengpi theiga hopsom, nathao twi hopsom, nabonghon le nakelngoi hon na kona peng masaho chu amin umna dinga alhendohna munachu Pakai na Pathen angsunga naneh ding ahi.
target: Eat the tithe of your grain, new wine and olive oil, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks in the presence of the Lord your God at the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name, so that you may learn to revere the Lord your God always.

source: Pakai na Pathen'in phatthei naboh teng, Pakai na Pathen'in amin umna dinga alhendohna mun chu nanga kona agamlhat behsetna, ahiloule alampi chu asao behsetna, chutia chu napoh joulouva ahile;
target: But if that place is too distant and you have been blessed by the Lord your God and cannot carry your tithe (because the place where the Lord will choose to put his Name is so far away),

source: Nangman athil chu sum nasosah-a, sum chu nahin choija, Pakai na Pathen'in alhendohna mun'a chu nacheding ahi.
target: then exchange your tithe for silver, and take the silver with you and go to the place the Lord your God will choose.

source: Chule hiche sum chu nahinna-in angaichat jouse bongchal ham, kelngoi ham, lengpithei ham, ahiloule zuchih ham, nahinnan angaichat jouse chohna-a namana; chukoma chu Pakai na Pathen angsunga naneh-a, nangma le na-insung mite kipah tah-a naum dingu ahi.
target: Use the silver to buy whatever you like: cattle, sheep, wine or other fermented drink, or anything you wish. Then you and your household shall eat there in the presence of the Lord your God and rejoice.

source: Chule nakotpi sunga um Levi mite chu nanot thap louding ahi; ajehchu aman nangma toh chan le goulo aneikhom pon ahi.
target: And do not neglect the Levites living in your towns, for they have no allotment or inheritance of their own.

source: Kumthum akichai sehle chuche kum-a nathilsoh jouse hopsom nahin choija, nakotpi sunga nasetkhom ding,
target: At the end of every three years, bring all the tithes of that year’s produce and store it in your towns,

source: Chule Levi mite (ajehchu amahon nangma toh chan le goulo aneikhom lou ahi,) le na kotpi sunga um namdang mi, pabeiho, chule meithaiho chun aneh uva vading ahiuve; chutile Pakai na Pathen'in nakhutna natoh jouse chu phatthei abohna ding ahi.
target: so that the Levites (who have no allotment or inheritance of their own) and the foreigners, the fatherless and the widows who live in your towns may come and eat and be satisfied, and so that the Lord your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.

source: Kum sagi kichai sehle lha ongna nabolji ding ahi.
target: At the end of every seven years you must cancel debts.

source: Chule lha ongna umdan chu hichehi hiding ahi: aheng akom batna pechanin alha-ong ding ahi; aheng akom ahiloule asopi batna homa chun alahpeh teitei louding ahi; ajehchu hichehi Pakai lha-ongna kiti chu ahi.
target: This is how it is to be done: Every creditor shall cancel any loan they have made to a fellow Israelite. They shall not require payment from anyone among their own people, because the Lord ’s time for canceling debts has been proclaimed.

source: Gamdang mi batna napeh vang chu nalelah kit thei ahi, ahinla ipi hile nangma-a nasopi henga umchu nalha-ong ding ahi.
target: You may require payment from a foreigner, but you must cancel any debt your fellow Israelite owes you.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu nalah uva koima avaicha umlou ding ahi; ajehchu lodinga Pakai Pathen'in napeh gama chu Pakaiyin nasatah-a phatthei naboh ding ahi;
target: However, there need be no poor people among you, for in the land the Lord your God is giving you to possess as your inheritance, he will richly bless you,

source: Tunia thu kapeh hiche thupeh ho jouse jui dinga Pakai na Pathen aw chu kituptah-a nangaija ahile.
target: if only you fully obey the Lord your God and are careful to follow all these commands I am giving you today.

source: Ajehchu aman nana thutep banga Pakai na Pathen'in phatthei naboh ding ahin: nangman nam tamtah henga nahop ding, amavang nangman apa nalah louding; nam tamtah chunga vai nahom ding, amavang amahon nang chunga vai ahomloudiu ahi.
target: For the Lord your God will bless you as he has promised, and you will lend to many nations but will borrow from none. You will rule over many nations but none will rule over you.

source: Pakai na Pathen'in napehna gama nakotpi sunga chu nasopite khattou nalah uva vaicha auma ahile, nangman nalung natahsah louding, nasopi vaicha-a kona nakhut nakihsah louding ahi.
target: If anyone is poor among your fellow Israelites in any of the towns of the land the Lord your God is giving you, do not be hardhearted or tightfisted toward them.

source: Amavang ahenga naphalna khut nalhana, alhahsamna-a angaichat lhingsetna napehjoh ding ahi.
target: Rather, be openhanded and freely lend them whatever they need.

source: Nangman nalungsung gilouva chun Kum sagina lha ongna kum anaitai tia nagel louna dingle; nasopi chunga namit thipma ima pelouva naum louna din chingtheijin; chutile nangma dounan Pakai kou intin, nadingin chonset hikhante.
target: Be careful not to harbor this wicked thought: “The seventh year, the year for canceling debts, is near,” so that you do not show ill will toward the needy among your fellow Israelites and give them nothing. They may then appeal to the Lord against you, and you will be found guilty of sin.

source: Nangman ama napeh teitei ding; chule ama napeh tengle nalung nanatsah louhel ding ahi. Ajehchu hiche-a ding tah-a chu Pakai na Pathen'in natoh jouse le nakhutna nabol jouse chu phatthei aboh ahi.
target: Give generously to them and do so without a grudging heart; then because of this the Lord your God will bless you in all your work and in everything you put your hand to.

source: Ajehchu gamsunga kona migenthei beitih umlou ding ahi. Hijeh-a chu nagamsunga nasopipa, nami vaichapa, namilhasampa chunga nakhut hongphalin tia thu kapeh nahi.
target: There will always be poor people in the land. Therefore I command you to be openhanded toward your fellow Israelites who are poor and needy in your land.

source: Chule nasopi Hebrew mi pasal ham, ahiloule numei ham nahenga hung kijoh auma, kumgup nangma najentah-a ahile; akum sagi lhinnale nanga kona ongthola nalhadoh ding ahi.
target: If any of your people—Hebrew men or women—sell themselves to you and serve you six years, in the seventh year you must let them go free.

source: Chule nanga kona ongthola nasoldoh tengle, agohkeova nachemang sah louding ahi.
target: And when you release them, do not send them away empty-handed.

source: Nakelngoi hona kon, nachang phola kon, nalengpi ga chilna-a kona itlou hella napeh ding; Pakai na Pathen'in phatthei naboh na-a kona chu ama napeh ding ahi.
target: Supply them liberally from your flock, your threshing floor and your winepress. Give to them as the Lord your God has blessed you.

source: Chule nangman jong Egypt gama soh nanahi-a, Pakai Pathen'in nalhatdoh ahi chu nageldoh ding ahi; hijeh-a chu tunia hichehi kathupeh nahi.
target: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and the Lord your God redeemed you. That is why I give you this command today.

source: Chule hitiding ahi, nangma le na-insungmi angainat jeh, nangma toh umkhom nop asah jeh-a, amachun nahenga, Nanga konin chemang ponge ati-a ahileh;
target: But if your servant says to you, “I do not want to leave you,” because he loves you and your family and is well off with you,

source: Nangman thih hemkhat nalah ding, kotkhah phunga abil navuding, chule amachu a-itih a dinga nasoh hiding ahi. Chule nasoh numei chunga jong chutobang ma-a chu nabol ding ahi.
target: then take an awl and push it through his earlobe into the door, and he will become your servant for life. Do the same for your female servant.

source: Nanga kona ongthola nasoldoh chu nang dinga thil hahsatah tobang hilouding ahi; ajehchu thalah soh natoh chan ni atoh-a kum gup set nangman najen ahi. Chutia chu Pakai na Pathen'in natohna channa phatthei naboh ding ahi.
target: Do not consider it a hardship to set your servant free, because their service to you these six years has been worth twice as much as that of a hired hand. And the Lord your God will bless you in everything you do.

source: Nagancha hole nakelngoi hon lah-a achal pengmasa ho jong chu Pakai na Pathen dinga nathenso ding: nabongchal peng masapen chu na natoh sah louding, nakelngoi honlah-a apeng masapen jong chu amul navo louding ahi.
target: Set apart for the Lord your God every firstborn male of your herds and flocks. Do not put the firstborn of your cows to work, and do not shear the firstborn of your sheep.

source: Chule hichu nangma le na insung miten kumsehle Pakaiyin alhenna mun'a chu Pakai na Pathen angsunga naneh dingu ahi.
target: Each year you and your family are to eat them in the presence of the Lord your God at the place he will choose.

source: Chule alah-a nolna nei auma, akengbai ham, amitcho ham, deimotah-a nolna nei umtapou chu Pakai na Pathen henga ganlhaina-a nato louding ahi.
target: If an animal has a defect, is lame or blind, or has any serious flaw, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.

source: Nangin hichu nakotpi ho sunga naneh ding: mi aboh le athengin kibang tah-a sapeng chal le sakhichal sa kineh banga anehdiu ahi.
target: You are to eat it in your own towns. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat it, as if it were gazelle or deer.

source: Athisan bou chu naneh louding, twi banga tolla nasunlhah ding ahi.
target: But you must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.

source: Abib lhachu nit inlang, Pakai na Pathen henga kalchuhkut bolin: ajehchu Abib lha jan laija chu Pakai na Pathen'in Egypt'a kona nahin pui ahi.
target: Observe the month of Aviv and celebrate the Passover of the Lord your God, because in the month of Aviv he brought you out of Egypt by night.

source: Hijeh-a chu Pakaiyin amin umna dinga alhena mun'a chu ganchahon le kelngoi hon lah-a kona Pakai na Pathen henga kalchuh kut ganlhaina nabol ding ahi.
target: Sacrifice as the Passover to the Lord your God an animal from your flock or herd at the place the Lord will choose as a dwelling for his Name.

source: Nangman hichu chol kiso changlhah toh naneh louding; Egypt'a kona nahung dohlai nikho chu geldohna dinga nahinlaise-a cholsolou changlhah, gimbolna changlhah ngei chu nisagi naneh ding ahi; ajehchu Egypt gama kona kinotah-a hung doh-a nahi.
target: Do not eat it with bread made with yeast, but for seven days eat unleavened bread, the bread of affliction, because you left Egypt in haste—so that all the days of your life you may remember the time of your departure from Egypt.

source: Chule nagamsunguva chu nisagi sung chol kiso changlhah himhim kimulouding; chule nimasani nilhah lama naganlhai sa chu jankhovah jingkah geija umlou ding ahi.
target: Let no yeast be found in your possession in all your land for seven days. Do not let any of the meat you sacrifice on the evening of the first day remain until morning.

source: Pakai na Pathen'in napehna kotpi sung khat penpena chu kalchuhkut ganlhaina nabolthei louding ahi.
target: You must not sacrifice the Passover in any town the Lord your God gives you

source: Amavang Pakai na Pathen'in amin umnadia alhending mun'a chu, Egypt gama kona hungpotdoh phattah, nilhumdon, nilhah lama chu kalchuhkut ganlhaina nabolding ahi.
target: except in the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name. There you must sacrifice the Passover in the evening, when the sun goes down, on the anniversary of your departure from Egypt.

source: Chule Pakai na Pathen'in alhending mun'a chu asa chu nago-a naneh ding, jingkah le nakile-a, naponbuh-a nache ding ahi.
target: Roast it and eat it at the place the Lord your God will choose. Then in the morning return to your tents.

source: Nigup sunga cholsolou changlhang naneh ding; nisagi nile Pakai na Pathen'a dinga kikhop loupi umding ahi. Hiche sunga chu na natoh louding ahi.
target: For six days eat unleavened bread and on the seventh day hold an assembly to the Lord your God and do no work.

source: Nangman hapta sagi nasimdoh ding: hapta sagi chu chang-atna dia koite nalap pat ni-a patna nasim ding ahi.
target: Count off seven weeks from the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain.

source: Pakai na Pathen henga nakhut tah-a lungcham thilto nato-a haptaho kut chu nanit ding, Pakai na Pathen'in phatthei naboh dungjui bangtah-a Pakai na Pathen henga napeh ding ahi.
target: Then celebrate the Festival of Weeks to the Lord your God by giving a freewill offering in proportion to the blessings the Lord your God has given you.

source: Chule Pakai na Pathen'in amin umna dinga adeilhen mun'a chu Pakai na Pathen angsunga nangma nahin, nachapa ahin, nachanu ahin, nasohpa ahin, nasohnu ahin, nakotpi sunga um Levi mite ahin, nangma to umkhom namdang mi ahin, pabeiho ahin, meithai ahin, nakipa dingu ahi.
target: And rejoice before the Lord your God at the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name—you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, the Levites in your towns, and the foreigners, the fatherless and the widows living among you.

source: Chule nangma tahjong Egypt gama sohchanga ana um nahi nageldoh-a: hiche dan kisunhohi nanitna nabol ding ahi.
target: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and follow carefully these decrees.

source: Nachang le nalengpi ga nakhoptup jou tengle, nisagi sung lhambuh kut naman ding ahi.
target: Celebrate the Festival of Tabernacles for seven days after you have gathered the produce of your threshing floor and your winepress.

source: Chule na kut sunga chu nangma nahin, nachapa ahin, nachanu ahin, nasohpa ahin, nasohnu ahin, chule nakotpi sunga um Levi mite ahin, gamdangmi ahin, paneilou ahin, meithai ahin nakipa dingu ahi.
target: Be joyful at your festival—you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levites, the foreigners, the fatherless and the widows who live in your towns.

source: Pakaiyin adeilhen na ding mun'a chu Pakai na Pathen'u henga nisagi sung kut loupi nabol dingu ahi. Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'in nalhosoh jouse le nakhutsoh jouse chunga phatthei naboh ding ahin, hijeh-a chu nakipa teiding ahi.
target: For seven days celebrate the festival to the Lord your God at the place the Lord will choose. For the Lord your God will bless you in all your harvest and in all the work of your hands, and your joy will be complete.

source: Kumkhat sunga na pasal jouseu Pakai masanga aman adeilhen mun'a chu thumvei gaki lulah dingu ahi; cholsolou kutna, haptaho kutna, chule lhambuh kutna: chule Pakai masanga khutgoh keova kilulah loudingu ahi.
target: Three times a year all your men must appear before the Lord your God at the place he will choose: at the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the Festival of Weeks and the Festival of Tabernacles. No one should appear before the Lord empty-handed:

source: Mitinin Pakai na Pathen'un apeh phatthei bohna dungjuija ajokham cheh apehding ahi.
target: Each of you must bring a gift in proportion to the way the Lord your God has blessed you.

source: Pakai na Pathen'in napeh nakul kotpi jouse-a, naphung jouse-a thutan hole vaipoho natundoh ding: chule amaho chun mipi thuchu dihtah-a atanpeh dingu ahi.
target: Appoint judges and officials for each of your tribes in every town the Lord your God is giving you, and they shall judge the people fairly.

source: Dihlou tah-a thu natan louding; mihem mai vea jatum na neilou ding; nehguh jong nalah louding ahi: ajehchu nehguh chun miching mit asuchon, michonpha ho thusei jong aheikon jin ahi.
target: Do not pervert justice or show partiality. Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the innocent.

source: Pakai Pathen'in napehna gam chu nalo theija, nachen theina dinga, adih bouchu najui ding ahi.
target: Follow justice and justice alone, so that you may live and possess the land the Lord your God is giving you.

source: Pakai na Pathen maicham nasem nading vella chu ipi thing hitaleh thingbul naphu louding ahi.
target: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole beside the altar you build to the Lord your God,

source: Pakai na Pathen'in ahot milim tapou natundoh louding ahi.
target: and do not erect a sacred stone, for these the Lord your God hates.

source: Bongchal ahiloule kelngoi chunga nolna nei, ahiloule deimona um tapou chu Pakai na Pathen henga ganlhaina-a nato louding ahi. Ajehchu hichu Pakai na Pathen dinga thet umtah ahi.
target: Do not sacrifice to the Lord your God an ox or a sheep that has any defect or flaw in it, for that would be detestable to him.

source: Pakai na Pathen'un napeh-u kotpi sung hoichepen hijongle, nalah uva Pakai na Pathen thutep sukeh-a amitmua gitlouna bol pasal ahiloule numei akimu doh-a,
target: If a man or woman living among you in one of the towns the Lord gives you is found doing evil in the eyes of the Lord your God in violation of his covenant,

source: Pathen dangho agajena, keiman kathupeh hilou nisa ham, lhathah ham, van janel khattou ahouva;
target: and contrary to my command has worshiped other gods, bowing down to them or to the sun or the moon or the stars in the sky,

source: Chule hichu nangma nakisei peh-a, nangman najah-a, gunchu tah-a nadoh toh-a, chule ven, hichu adih ahia, Israel sunga chutobang thil thet um bolla aum chu akiphotchetna ahile:
target: and this has been brought to your attention, then you must investigate it thoroughly. If it is true and it has been proved that this detestable thing has been done in Israel,

source: Chutobang thilse bol pasal ahiloule numei chu nakul kotpi phunglama napui doh-a, chuche pasal ahiloule numei ngeichu, chule athikah seuva songa nase dingu ahi.
target: take the man or woman who has done this evil deed to your city gate and stone that person to death.

source: Ahetoh mini, ahiloule mi thum kama kona thidinga lompa chu tha hiding ahi; ahin ahettohsah mi khat kama vang amachu kithat louding ahi.
target: On the testimony of two or three witnesses a person is to be put to death, but no one is to be put to death on the testimony of only one witness.

source: Ama thana dinga chu ahettohsah hon akhut alap masat pen dingu, chujoule mipi jousen khut alhahdiu ahi. Chutia chu nalah uva thilphalou chu nasuhmang diu ahi.
target: The hands of the witnesses must be the first in putting that person to death, and then the hands of all the people. You must purge the evil from among you.

source: Thisan kiso thu, them kichu thua, kivohto thu, nakotpi sunga kinel nohphah na thu nang dinga ageltoh hahsa behseh ahung sodoh-a ahile: nakipat doh-a, Pakai na Pathen'in adeilhen ding mun'a chu nache ding;
target: If cases come before your courts that are too difficult for you to judge—whether bloodshed, lawsuits or assaults—take them to the place the Lord your God will choose.

source: Chuche laija Levi thempuho le thutana pang ding pa henga nahunga, nadoh tohding; chule amahon athutan lhuhnao chu namusah dingu ahi.
target: Go to the Levitical priests and to the judge who is in office at that time. Inquire of them and they will give you the verdict.

source: Chule Pakaiyin adeilhen ding mun'a mihon namusahdiu dungjuija chu nabolding; chule nahetsah-u jouse dungjuija nabolna dinga nachih theiding ahi.
target: You must act according to the decisions they give you at the place the Lord will choose. Be careful to do everything they instruct you to do.

source: Amahon thulhuh dan nahil dungjui le, thutan dan nahil dingu dungjuija nabol ding; amahon namusahdiu thu lhuhsah-a kona chu jetlam le veilama napeldoh louding ahi.
target: Act according to whatever they teach you and the decisions they give you. Do not turn aside from what they tell you, to the right or to the left.

source: Chule Pakai na Pathen anga kinbola pangji thempu thu le thutanpa thu ngailouva ama kisongpa ngei chu thi ding ahi: chule Israel lah-a kona aphalou chu nasuhmang ding ahi.
target: Anyone who shows contempt for the judge or for the priest who stands ministering there to the Lord your God is to be put to death. You must purge the evil from Israel.

source: Chutile mijousen jaovintin, kichaovintin, ama le ama kisongin ima boltapou vinte.
target: All the people will hear and be afraid, and will not be contemptuous again.

source: Pakai Pathen'in napehna gam chu nahung lhuna, hichu nalo-a, asunga nachenna, Avela namho jouse bangin kachunga lengkhat kisem inge nati tengle;
target: When you enter the land the Lord your God is giving you and have taken possession of it and settled in it, and you say, “Let us set a king over us like all the nations around us,”

source: Pakai na Pathen'in alhendingpa tahchu iti jongle lenga natunding ahi: nasopite lah-a kona mikhat chu nachunga lenga natunding ahin; nasopi hilou namdang mi chu nachunga natunlou ding ahi.
target: be sure to appoint over you a king the Lord your God chooses. He must be from among your fellow Israelites. Do not place a foreigner over you, one who is not an Israelite.

source: Ahinla aman ama dinga sakol apunsah louding, ahiloule sakol apunsahna dinga mite chu Egypt gama akilesah louhel ding ahi: ajehchu Pakaiyin naheng uva, Nangho hiche lampia chu nakilekit louheldiu ahi, anatin ahi.
target: The king, moreover, must not acquire great numbers of horses for himself or make the people return to Egypt to get more of them, for the Lord has told you, “You are not to go back that way again.”

source: Alung kiheimang louna dinga jijong tampi anei louding; chule sana dangka jong nasatah-a apunsah louhel ding ahi.
target: He must not take many wives, or his heart will be led astray. He must not accumulate large amounts of silver and gold.

source: Chule hiti ding ahi, ama alenggam laltouna-a atouteng, Levi mite le thempuho angsung um hiche dan thuhi lekhabu khatna akijih dohding:
target: When he takes the throne of his kingdom, he is to write for himself on a scroll a copy of this law, taken from that of the Levitical priests.

source: Chule hichu amatoh umkhom ding, ahinkho lhum keija asimding ahi: chuti henglang hile Pakai ginje ahetna, chule hiche danthu-a thuchengho le dan kisunho chu atohdoh na dinga chingthei ding,
target: It is to be with him, and he is to read it all the days of his life so that he may learn to revere the Lord his God and follow carefully all the words of this law and these decrees

source: Asopiho chunga alungthima akichoisang lou ding, chule thupeh-a kona jetlam ahiloule veilama akihei manglou ding; achaina geija Israelte lah-a ama ahin achate ahin alenggam sunga ahinkho sot thei ding ahi.
target: and not consider himself better than his fellow Israelites and turn from the law to the right or to the left. Then he and his descendants will reign a long time over his kingdom in Israel.

source: Thempuho le Levi ho, chule Levi phung jouse chun chanle gou Israel toh aneikhom theilou diu ahi; amahon meija kigou Pakaiya dinga thiltoho le Ama chanho chu aneh dingu ahi.
target: The Levitical priests—indeed, the whole tribe of Levi—are to have no allotment or inheritance with Israel. They shall live on the food offerings presented to the Lord , for that is their inheritance.

source: Hijeh-a chu amahon asopite lah-a gou aneiloudiu ahi: aman ahenguva aseibanga, Pakai chu agoulou ahi.
target: They shall have no inheritance among their fellow Israelites; the Lord is their inheritance, as he promised them.

source: Chule mipi-a kona thempu chanding chu hicheho hi ahi, bong ahiloule kelngoija ganlhaina thilto hintoh hochun thempupa chu adah, akhalhang, chule agilpi apeh dingu ahi.
target: This is the share due the priests from the people who sacrifice a bull or a sheep: the shoulder, the internal organs and the meat from the head.

source: Nangman na chang ga masapen, lengpitwi masapen, thaotwi masapen, chule na kelngoimul kivou masapen jong ama napeh ding ahi.
target: You are to give them the firstfruits of your grain, new wine and olive oil, and the first wool from the shearing of your sheep,

source: Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'in amale achapate chu a-itih-a Pakai mina lhacha na tong dinga naphung jouseu lah-a kona ana lhendoh ahi.
target: for the Lord your God has chosen them and their descendants out of all your tribes to stand and minister in the Lord ’s name always.

source: Chule Levi mikhat chu akhopemna Israel jouse lah-a khopi khatpen pena kona ahunga, Pakaiyin alhending mun chu alungpumpia ngailutna neija ahunga ahile;
target: If a Levite moves from one of your towns anywhere in Israel where he is living, and comes in all earnestness to the place the Lord will choose,

source: Chuteng Pakai anga dingjing asopi Levi hon abol bang banga Pakai a-Pathen mina lhacha-a pangding ahi.
target: he may minister in the name of the Lord his God like all his fellow Levites who serve there in the presence of the Lord .

source: Agouchan kijohna-a kona amu tilou amahon nehding chan kibang aneicheh dingu ahi.
target: He is to share equally in their benefits, even though he has received money from the sale of family possessions.

source: Pakai na Pathen'in napehna gam chu nalhun tengle, chuche namho chonna thet umtah hochu boldinga naki themchuh louhel ding ahi.
target: When you enter the land the Lord your God is giving you, do not learn to imitate the detestable ways of the nations there.

source: Nalah uva achapa ham ahiloule achanu ham mei pal galkaisah, ahiloule ailhim mangcha, gaothusei, mitpheldoi mangcha, ahiloule doichoi,
target: Let no one be found among you who sacrifices their son or daughter in the fire, who practices divination or sorcery, interprets omens, engages in witchcraft,

source: Ahiloule milhimthei, lhagao bohtoh kijol, doi-aithem, mithilha koutheiho chu nalah uva umloubeh ding ahi.
target: or casts spells, or who is a medium or spiritist or who consults the dead.

source: Ajehchu hiche thilho boljouse chu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin; chule hiche thet umtahho jeh-a hi Pakai na Pathen'un na-angsung uva kona amaho anodoh ahi.
target: Anyone who does these things is detestable to the Lord ; because of these same detestable practices the Lord your God will drive out those nations before you.

source: Nangma Pakai na Pathen angsunga pha chamkim nahiding ahi.
target: You must be blameless before the Lord your God.

source: Ajehchu naloding hiche namhohin gaothusei ho le aisan ho thu angaiju ahin; nangma vang Pakai na Pathen'in chutia boldin naphalpoi.
target: The nations you will dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery or divination. But as for you, the Lord your God has not permitted you to do so.

source: Pakai na Pathen'in nalah uva kon, nasopite lah-a kona keima tobang themgao khat nahin tundoh pehdingu ahin; amathu chu nangaidiu ahi.
target: The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among you, from your fellow Israelites. You must listen to him.

source: Horeb mun'a kikhopi nikho-a, Kathi louna din Pakai ka Pathen aw neijah sahkit danlang, hiche meikong nasatah hi neimusah kit hih-in, tia Pakai na Pathen nangaichatna jouse dungjui chun.
target: For this is what you asked of the Lord your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly when you said, “Let us not hear the voice of the Lord our God nor see this great fire anymore, or we will die.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga, Amahon aseiju chu aseikha lheh-uve ati.
target: The Lord said to me: “What they say is good.

source: Keiman asopiteu lah-a konin nangma tobang khat themgao khat tundoh peh ungting, akamsunga kathu kakhum ding; keiman ama kathupeh ding jouse chu aman ajah uva aseipeh ding ahi.
target: I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their fellow Israelites, and I will put my words in his mouth. He will tell them everything I command him.

source: Chule hitiding ahi, aman kamina aseiding kathu hohi angailou chanchu, keiman ama-a kona hichu kangeh ding ahi.
target: I myself will call to account anyone who does not listen to my words that the prophet speaks in my name.

source: Ahinla aseidinga thu kapehlou kamina achama thusei themgao, ahiloule pathen dangho mina thusei chanchu, chuche themgao ngeichu thiding ahi.
target: But a prophet who presumes to speak in my name anything I have not commanded, or a prophet who speaks in the name of other gods, is to be put to death.”

source: Chule nangman nalungthima, Thu chu Pakaiyin asei ahipoi ti iti kahet ding ham? nati-a ahile,
target: You may say to yourselves, “How can we know when a message has not been spoken by the Lord ?”

source: Themgao khatnin Pakai mina thu aseija, aseidoh thilho chun anung ajui louva, ahung guilhun louva ahile, hiche thilchu Pakaiyin asei hilou ahin; amavang themgaopa chun hichu ama lungchama asei ahi: nangman ama chu nakichat louding ahi.
target: If what a prophet proclaims in the name of the Lord does not take place or come true, that is a message the Lord has not spoken. That prophet has spoken presumptuously, so do not be alarmed.

source: Pakai Pathen'in agamu napeh amaho chu Pakai na Pathen'in asuhmanga, chule nangman agamu natoupha-a, akhopi hou le a-inhouva nachen tengle;
target: When the Lord your God has destroyed the nations whose land he is giving you, and when you have driven them out and settled in their towns and houses,

source: Pakai Pathen'in lodinga napehna gam lailunga chu khopi thum nakhendoh ding ahi.
target: then set aside for yourselves three cities in the land the Lord your God is giving you to possess.

source: Pakai Pathen'in lodinga napehna gam pumpi chu hopthum-a nahopkhen na, tolthat takip jamlut theina dinga lampi nagon ding ahi.
target: Determine the distances involved and divide into three parts the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, so that a person who kills someone may flee for refuge to one of these cities.

source: Chule tolthat ahintheina dinga chumuna jamlut dingho thudol chu hichehi ahi: amasanga kihot tona umlouva tosoija aheng akom that ho;
target: This is the rule concerning anyone who kills a person and flees there for safety—anyone who kills a neighbor unintentionally, without malice aforethought.

source: Mi aheng akom toh gam manga thingphuh dinga achea, thingchu phuhlhuh nadinga aheicha chu alap donga, achang chu aga-a kona alendoh-a, aheng akompa chunga achuh-a, athi-a ahile; hiche khopiho khatna chu jamlutna hingding ahi.
target: For instance, a man may go into the forest with his neighbor to cut wood, and as he swings his ax to fell a tree, the head may fly off and hit his neighbor and kill him. That man may flee to one of these cities and save his life.

source: Amasa hotna aneiloujeh-a ama chu thidinga lom ahilou vangin, thisan phu lapan tolthatpa chu alungsat petnin nungdel intin, lampi asaojeh-a phapantin, that getninte.
target: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue him in a rage, overtake him if the distance is too great, and kill him even though he is not deserving of death, since he did it to his neighbor without malice aforethought.

source: Hijeh-a chu khopi thum nakise khen ding ahi, tia thu kapeh nahi.
target: This is why I command you to set aside for yourselves three cities.

source: Chule Pakai na Pathen'in napu napate henga peh dinga anahahselna gamchu akehletna, napu napate pehdinga athutep gam apumpi chu napeh-a ahile;
target: If the Lord your God enlarges your territory, as he promised on oath to your ancestors, and gives you the whole land he promised them,

source: Pakai na Pathen chu ngailut ding le alampi jot jing dinga, tunia thu kapeh hiche thupeh jousehi nanitna ahile; hiche khopi thum tilouva khopidang thum jong nakibelap thei ding ahi.
target: because you carefully follow all these laws I command you today—to love the Lord your God and to walk always in obedience to him—then you are to set aside three more cities.

source: Chutia chu Pakai Pathen'in lodinga napehna gamsunga chu thisan phu nachunga aumlouna dinga, monabei thisan kiso umlou ding ahi.
target: Do this so that innocent blood will not be shed in your land, which the Lord your God is giving you as your inheritance, and so that you will not be guilty of bloodshed.

source: Ahinla khat touvin aheng akom ahotna amachu achanlhih-a, ama douna-a akipatdoh-a, thina theija avoh-a, athitah-a, hiche khopiho sung khatna chu ajamlutna ahile;
target: But if out of hate someone lies in wait, assaults and kills a neighbor, and then flees to one of these cities,

source: Chuteng akhopi upaho chun mi asola chua kona ahinpuijuva, athi theina dinga thisan phulapa khutna chu apehdoh diu ahi.
target: the killer shall be sent for by the town elders, be brought back from the city, and be handed over to the avenger of blood to die.

source: Namit nin ama chu akhoto louding, amavang aphatna dinga themona bei thisan kiso chu Israel'a kona nasuhmang ding ahi.
target: Show no pity. You must purge from Israel the guilt of shedding innocent blood, so that it may go well with you.

source: Pakai Pathen'in lodinga napeh nagoulona gamsunga malaija mihon anaphu sao, naheng nakom gamgi chu nachondoh louding ahi.
target: Do not move your neighbor’s boundary stone set up by your predecessors in the inheritance you receive in the land the Lord your God is giving you to possess.

source: Mihem khat themona ahin, ahiloule chonsetna ahin, itobang chonsetna bola hijongle, mikhat douna-a hettohsah khat kipanlou ding ahi. Hettohsah mini ham ahiloule mi thum ham kama bou athudol chu kisudet ding ahi.
target: One witness is not enough to convict anyone accused of any crime or offense they may have committed. A matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.

source: Hettohsah lhem khatnin mikhat thilbol adihlouva ngoh dinga ahung kipatdoh-a ahile;
target: If a malicious witness takes the stand to accuse someone of a crime,

source: Akinel teni chu anilhona chuche nikho laija thempu le, thutanpa masang Pakai angsunga chu ding lhonding;
target: the two people involved in the dispute must stand in the presence of the Lord before the priests and the judges who are in office at the time.

source: Thutanpa chun gunchu tah-a kholtoh ding: chule veuvin hettohsah chu hettohsah lhem ahia, asopi chunga dihlou tah-a ahettohsah ahile;
target: The judges must make a thorough investigation, and if the witness proves to be a liar, giving false testimony against a fellow Israelite,

source: Chutengle asopi chunga bolding agot bang banga chu, amachunga naboldiu ahi. Hitia chu nalah uva kona thilse chu nasuhmang diu ahi.
target: then do to the false witness as that witness intended to do to the other party. You must purge the evil from among you.

source: Chule aumnalai ho chun ajah diu, kichadiu, chukalle chutobang thilse chu nalah uva abolkit loudiu ahi.
target: The rest of the people will hear of this and be afraid, and never again will such an evil thing be done among you.

source: Chule namitnin akhoto louding; hinkho khela hinkho, mit khela mit, ha khela ha, khut khela khut, chule keng khela keng kila ahi.
target: Show no pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

source: Namelmate sat dinga nakon doh-a, sakol ho, akangtalai ho, mipi nang sanga tamjo namuteng, amaho chu kicha hih-in; ajehchu Egypt gama kona nahinpuidoh-a Pakai na Pathen chun naumpi jingnai.
target: When you go to war against your enemies and see horses and chariots and an army greater than yours, do not be afraid of them, because the Lord your God, who brought you up out of Egypt, will be with you.

source: Chule hitiding ahi, gal nasatdiu konle, thempu chun mipi ho chu anailutna akihoupi ding,
target: When you are about to go into battle, the priest shall come forward and address the army.

source: Chule ajah uva, Ngaijun, Vo Israel, tunia hi namelma teu satdia nahung naiju ahita: nalungu lhahsah hih-un, kicha hih-un, hot jong kihot hih-un, chule amaho jeh-in tijong tija hih-un;
target: He shall say: “Hear, Israel: Today you are going into battle against your enemies. Do not be fainthearted or afraid; do not panic or be terrified by them.

source: Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen chu nangho huhhing dinga, nangho dinga namelma teu satdinga nangho toh lhonkhoma ahi, atiding ahi.
target: For the Lord your God is the one who goes with you to fight for you against your enemies to give you victory.”

source: Chule gal lamkai ho chun mipi jah-a, Inthah sa-a thensolou mi koi naum uvem? Ama chu a-in lama chedin kilekit tahen, achuti loule gala thi intin, midangin kithenso getninte.
target: The officers shall say to the army: “Has anyone built a new house and not yet begun to live in it? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else may begin to live in it.

source: Chule lengpihon sema aga neloulai naum uvem? Ama jongchu a-in lama chedin kilekit hen, achuti loule gala thi intin, midangin aga kineh getninte.
target: Has anyone planted a vineyard and not begun to enjoy it? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else enjoy it.

source: Chule jihol neija kichenpi loulai naum uvem? Ama chu a-in lama chedin kilekit tahen, achuti loule gala thi intin, midangin kichenpi getninte.
target: Has anyone become pledged to a woman and not married her? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else marry her.”

source: Chule lamkai ho chun mipi ho henga asebe nahlai ding, Akichale alungthoi naum uvem? Ama chu a-in lama chedin kilekit tahen, achuti loule ama lungbang bangin asopite lungthoi getninte, atidiu ahi.
target: Then the officers shall add, “Is anyone afraid or fainthearted? Let him go home so that his fellow soldiers will not become disheartened too.”

source: Chule hitiding ahi, lamkai hon mipi henga thu aseichai tengule, agalsat lamkaiho chu mipi amakaisah ding ahi.
target: When the officers have finished speaking to the army, they shall appoint commanders over it.

source: Khopi khat satdinga nahungnai tengle, ahenguva chamnathu seiphongin.
target: When you march up to attack a city, make its people an offer of peace.

source: Chule hitiding ahi, chamna thua nahin donbut nuva, nahenga ahung kihon uva ahileh, hiti ding ahi: chua um mijouse chu nanoija hiuva, nangma najen dingu ahi.
target: If they accept and open their gates, all the people in it shall be subject to forced labor and shall work for you.

source: Ahin nakichampi nomlouva, nangma nanasat thuh-a ahi vangle, nangman hichu na-umkhum ding ahi.
target: If they refuse to make peace and they engage you in battle, lay siege to that city.

source: Chule Pakai na Pathen'in nakhutna napehdoh tengle, chua pasal jouse chemjam'a monghema nathagam ding ahi.
target: When the Lord your God delivers it into your hand, put to the sword all the men in it.

source: Ahinla numei ho le naosen ho, ganchaho le khopi sunga umjouse, chua thil kichom jouse geija nakilah ding; Pakai na Pathen'in nanapeh namelma teu thil nachomho chu naneh ding ahi.
target: As for the women, the children, the livestock and everything else in the city, you may take these as plunder for yourselves. And you may use the plunder the Lord your God gives you from your enemies.

source: Hiche nam miteho khopi hilou, nanga kona gamlatah-a um khopiho jouse chunga chutia chu nabol ding ahi.
target: This is how you are to treat all the cities that are at a distance from you and do not belong to the nations nearby.

source: Ahinla Pakai na Pathen'in nagou loding napeh hiche khopi ho-a mite chu, ahaithei khatcha nahinghoi louding ahi.
target: However, in the cities of the nations the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, do not leave alive anything that breathes.

source: Hit mite, Amor mite, Canaan mite, Perizz mite, Hiv mite, Jebus mite chu Pakai na Pathen'in nathupeh banga nasuhmang helding ahi.
target: Completely destroy them—the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites—as the Lord your God has commanded you.

source: Chutia chu amahon a-pathen hou chunga abolu thet umtah chonnaho chu nahil louna ding ahi; achuti loule Pakai na Pathen'u chunga nachonset khah ding ahi.
target: Otherwise, they will teach you to follow all the detestable things they do in worshiping their gods, and you will sin against the Lord your God.

source: Khopi khat lah dinga achunga gal nabola, phat sottah na-umkhum teng, chukoma thingphung ho chu heicha-a naphuh-a nasuh manglou ding ahi. Ajehchu naneh thei ahin, kulpi umna-a pangdinga naphuh lhuh louding ahi, (ajehchu loujaova thingphung ho hi mihem hinkho ahi).
target: When you lay siege to a city for a long time, fighting against it to capture it, do not destroy its trees by putting an ax to them, because you can eat their fruit. Do not cut them down. Are the trees people, that you should besiege them?

source: Nemse ahikah seuva nangma kisatpi khopi chu umkhum na dinga, aga kinelouva nahet thingho bou chu nasuhmanga naphuh lhuh ding ahi.
target: However, you may cut down trees that you know are not fruit trees and use them to build siege works until the city at war with you falls.

source: Pakai Pathen'in lodinga napeh gamsunga chu mikhat kithatna, loujaova along luma, koitha ahi kihelouva aumle:
target: If someone is found slain, lying in a field in the land the Lord your God is giving you to possess, and it is not known who the killer was,

source: Chuteng na upahou le nathutan hou hunguva, akithatpa-a kona akimvela khopiho chu atediu;
target: your elders and judges shall go out and measure the distance from the body to the neighboring towns.

source: Chule hitiding ahi, akithatpa-a kona khopi naipen, hiche khopi-a um upaho ngeichun bongla natong loulai, koljon kaikha loulai khat ahinkaijuva;
target: Then the elders of the town nearest the body shall take a heifer that has never been worked and has never worn a yoke

source: Chule chuche khopi upaho chun bongla chu loukikai loulai le ima tuloulai phaichama chu akai lhah uva, chuche phaichama chu angong atan lhahdiu ahi.
target: and lead it down to a valley that has not been plowed or planted and where there is a flowing stream. There in the valley they are to break the heifer’s neck.

source: Chule thempuho Levi chapaten ahin nai dingu ahi; ajehchu amaho chu Pakai na Pathen'un akin bol dingle, Pakai mina phattheiboh dinga alhendoh ahin; kinohphahna tin le kivohtona thutin chu athuva kona kitan ding ahi.
target: The Levitical priests shall step forward, for the Lord your God has chosen them to minister and to pronounce blessings in the name of the Lord and to decide all cases of dispute and assault.

source: Chule akithatpa-a kona khopi naipen upaho jouse chun phaichama angong kitan bongla chunga chu akhutnu akisop uva,
target: Then all the elders of the town nearest the body shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley,

source: Chule amahon hitia hi adonbut uva aseidingu ahi, Kakhut uvin hiche thisan hi aso ahipon, chule kamitnun jong amupon ahi.
target: and they shall declare: “Our hands did not shed this blood, nor did our eyes see it done.

source: Vo Pakai, nalhatdohsa nami Israelte henga hepina neijinlang, chule themona neilou thisan kiso hi nami Israelte chunga nga hih-in, atidiu ahi. Chutile thisan kiso chu ngaidama umding ahi.
target: Accept this atonement for your people Israel, whom you have redeemed, Lord , and do not hold your people guilty of the blood of an innocent person.” Then the bloodshed will be atoned for,

source: Chutia chu Pakai mitmu-a apha naboltengle, nalah uva kona mona neilou thisan kisochu nakoimang dingu ahi.
target: and you will have purged from yourselves the guilt of shedding innocent blood, since you have done what is right in the eyes of the Lord .

source: Namelmate chunga galbol dinga nakon doh-a, Pakai na Pathen'in amaho chu nakhutna napeh doh-a, gal hinga nakaija,
target: When you go to war against your enemies and the Lord your God delivers them into your hands and you take captives,

source: Chule sohchangho lah-a chu numei melhoi namu-a, deichatna naneija, naji dinga nangaito-a ahile;
target: if you notice among the captives a beautiful woman and are attracted to her, you may take her as your wife.

source: Nangman amanu chu na-in lama napui ding, alu akivo tolding, chule atinho atan ding;
target: Bring her into your home and have her shave her head, trim her nails

source: Chule amanun asoh channa von chu ama-a kona aholhah-a, na-inna umden ding, lhakhat lhingset anu le apa pul adou ding ahi: chujouteng amanu henga nalutna, a-inneipu nahi-a, chule amanu na-inneipi hiding ahi.
target: and put aside the clothes she was wearing when captured. After she has lived in your house and mourned her father and mother for a full month, then you may go to her and be her husband and she shall be your wife.

source: Chule hitiding ahi, nangman amanu-a kipana naneilouva ahile, anop nopna-a nasolding; amavang sum manavang najoh louhel ding, kiveina-a nanei louhel ding ahi; ajehchu amanu nasuhnem ahitai. Chapa Lenpen Goulo Thudol;
target: If you are not pleased with her, let her go wherever she wishes. You must not sell her or treat her as a slave, since you have dishonored her.

source: Pasal khatnin jini aneija, khat angailutna, khat ahotna, amani adeinu le ahotnu chun chate ahinpeh gel lhona; achapa masapen chu ahotnu hin ahile,
target: If a man has two wives, and he loves one but not the other, and both bear him sons but the firstborn is the son of the wife he does not love,

source: Chuteng hitiding ahi, aman anei agou chu chapate losah dinga agot teng, ahotnu chapa apeng masa sanga chu adeinu chapa apeng nukhahjo chu apengmasa-a asem louhel ding ahi.
target: when he wills his property to his sons, he must not give the rights of the firstborn to the son of the wife he loves in preference to his actual firstborn, the son of the wife he does not love.

source: Aneijouse lah-a channi apeh-a kona ahotnu chapa chu apeng masa-a asim ding ahi. Ajehchu amapa chu thahat kipatna ahin; pen masatna chanvou chu ama-a hija ahi.
target: He must acknowledge the son of his unloved wife as the firstborn by giving him a double share of all he has. That son is the first sign of his father’s strength. The right of the firstborn belongs to him.

source: Mikhatnin chapa louchal le kiphinhat aneija, apaham anuham thu ngailouva, gimbolna apeh teng jongle athuhon angailouva ahile,
target: If someone has a stubborn and rebellious son who does not obey his father and mother and will not listen to them when they discipline him,

source: Chuteng anu le apan amatlhona, akhopi upaho heng le aumnao kotpi phunga ahinpuidoh lhonding;
target: his father and mother shall take hold of him and bring him to the elders at the gate of his town.

source: Chule amanin khopi upaho henga chu, Hiche kachapa lhonhi louchal le kiphinhat ahin, kathulhon ngaiding anompoi; amahi neh hatle julop ahi atilhonding ahi.
target: They shall say to the elders, “This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey us. He is a glutton and a drunkard.”

source: Chule akhopi sunga pasal ho jouse chun athina dinga songa asediu ahi. Chutia chu nalah uva kona agilou chu nakoi mangdiu; Israelte jousen ajah uva, kichadiu ahi.
target: Then all the men of his town are to stone him to death. You must purge the evil from among you. All Israel will hear of it and be afraid.

source: Chule pasal khatnin thinalom chonset abola, amachu thading ahia, amachu thinga nakhai lih-a ahile;
target: If someone guilty of a capital offense is put to death and their body is exposed on a pole,

source: Along chu jankhovah-a thing chunga umden louding, hiche nima ma chu navuitei ding ahi; (ajehchu akikhai chu Pathen gaosop changa ahi;) Pakai Pathen'in goulo dinga napeh gamchu akisuboh louding ahi.
target: you must not leave the body hanging on the pole overnight. Be sure to bury it that same day, because anyone who is hung on a pole is under God’s curse. You must not desecrate the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance.

source: Nasopipa bongchal ahiloule kelngoi vahmang namu-a ahile nakimu mosah louding ahi: iti nama jongle nasopite henga nahinpuilut teiding ahi.
target: If you see your fellow Israelite’s ox or sheep straying, do not ignore it but be sure to take it back to its owner.

source: Nasopipa chu nanaija umlou ahia, ahiloule nahetlou ahia ahile, na-in'a nahin kaija, nasopin ahinhol kahse-a naumpi-a, chule amachu nalepeh kitding ahi.
target: If they do not live near you or if you do not know who owns it, take it home with you and keep it until they come looking for it. Then give it back.

source: Chutobang ma-a chu asangan chunga nabolding; aponsil chunga nabol ding; nasopipa mansah thil mang jouse nangin namu chasun chu chutobanga chu nabolding; nangman nakiselden louding ahi.
target: Do the same if you find their donkey or cloak or anything else they have lost. Do not ignore it.

source: Nasopi ho sangan ahiloule bongchal lamsih-a lhu-a namu-a ahile nakimu mosah louding ahi: nangman amaho akaidoh-a aumkitna dinga nakithopi tei teiding ahi.
target: If you see your fellow Israelite’s donkey or ox fallen on the road, do not ignore it. Help the owner get it to its feet.

source: Numei jin pasal von akivon louding, pasal'in jong numei von akivon louding ahi. Ajehchu chutia boljouse chu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahi.
target: A woman must not wear men’s clothing, nor a man wear women’s clothing, for the Lord your God detests anyone who does this.

source: Lamdunga nache na-a vachabuh thingchung ham, tollhang hama anou ham atwi ham um nato-a, apin anou ham, atuiham chu aopkhuma ahile, api chu anou toh nalahkop louding ahi.
target: If you come across a bird’s nest beside the road, either in a tree or on the ground, and the mother is sitting on the young or on the eggs, do not take the mother with the young.

source: Amavang api chu itijong le nalhadoh-a anou vang chu nakilah ding ahi; chutile nangdin phantin, chutia chu nahinkho sotding ahi.
target: You may take the young, but be sure to let the mother go, so that it may go well with you and you may have a long life.

source: In thah nasah teng, chua kona mikhatou alhah-a na-in chu thisan sona-in ahilouna dinga, na-in chungdal nasem ding ahi.
target: When you build a new house, make a parapet around your roof so that you may not bring the guilt of bloodshed on your house if someone falls from the roof.

source: Nalengpi leija muchi dang chomchom natulou ding ahi; achuti loule namuchi tu ga chun nalengpi theiga chu asuboh ding ahi.
target: Do not plant two kinds of seed in your vineyard; if you do, not only the crops you plant but also the fruit of the vineyard will be defiled.

source: Bongchal le sangan mang kopma lou nakai louding ahi.
target: Do not plow with an ox and a donkey yoked together.

source: Nangin samul le tupat kihal tobang, pat jatchom chom kihal ponsil nasil louding ahi.
target: Do not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.

source: Nangman nakivon ponsil mongchep munlia chun ponjem semin.
target: Make tassels on the four corners of the cloak you wear.

source: Mikhatnin ji aneija, amanu henga alutna, avetda-a,
target: If a man takes a wife and, after sleeping with her, dislikes her

source: Amanu chunga nolna thusei phat akipeh-a, amanu asuh minsetna, Hichenu hi kakipuijin, ahenga kahung phatnin nungah ahipoi ti kamu doh-e atia ahile;
target: and slanders her and gives her a bad name, saying, “I married this woman, but when I approached her, I did not find proof of her virginity,”

source: Chuteng nungahnu nule pa chun chuche khopi-a kotpi phunga upaho henga chu nungah theng ahina melchihna amusah lhonding;
target: then the young woman’s father and mother shall bring to the town elders at the gate proof that she was a virgin.

source: Chule nungahnu pa chun upaho jah-a chu, Hichepa hi aji dinga kachanu kanapen ahile, amapan ahotbol tan;
target: Her father will say to the elders, “I gave my daughter in marriage to this man, but he dislikes her.

source: Chule veuvin, amapan amanu chunga nolna thu aseijin, Nachanu anungah hina kahepoi ati; ahinla hichehohi kachanu nungah theng ahina melchihna ahi, atiding ahi. Chule khopi upaho angsunga chu ponchu aphajal lhonding ahi.
target: Now he has slandered her and said, ‘I did not find your daughter to be a virgin.’ But here is the proof of my daughter’s virginity.” Then her parents shall display the cloth before the elders of the town,

source: Chule chuche khopi upa hochun mipa chu amatnuva asehgimdiu;
target: and the elders shall take the man and punish him.

source: Chule amahon amapa chu dangka shekel jakhatna agapmuva, hichu nungahnu pa apeh diu ahi; ajehchu aman Israel nungah theng khat aminset sah ahi: chule amanu chu amapa ji hikit ding; aman amanu ahinlaisea ada louhel ding ahi.
target: They shall fine him a hundred shekels of silver and give them to the young woman’s father, because this man has given an Israelite virgin a bad name. She shall continue to be his wife; he must not divorce her as long as he lives.

source: Ahinla hichu adih ahia, nungahnu dinga chu nungah theng ahina melchihna akimulouva ahile,
target: If, however, the charge is true and no proof of the young woman’s virginity can be found,

source: Chutengle nungahnu chu apa inkot phunga akaidoh uva, khopi pasal hon amanu chu athina dinga songa ase ding ahi; ajehchu amanun apa insung jonthanhoi apatna, Israel sunga ngolhoi thil abol ahi: chutia chu nalah uva kona thil gilou chu nasuhmang dingu ahi.
target: she shall be brought to the door of her father’s house and there the men of her town shall stone her to death. She has done an outrageous thing in Israel by being promiscuous while still in her father’s house. You must purge the evil from among you.

source: Numei aji um luppi pasal akimule, anilhona numei luppi pasal le numei chu thikop ding ahi. Chutia chu Israel lah-a kona thil gilou chu nasuhmang diu ahi.
target: If a man is found sleeping with another man’s wife, both the man who slept with her and the woman must die. You must purge the evil from Israel.

source: Pasal khat dinga jiholsa nungah theng chu mikhatnin khopi sunga amua, amanu aluppia ahile,
target: If a man happens to meet in a town a virgin pledged to be married and he sleeps with her,

source: Chuche khopi kotpi polama anilhona nahin kaidoh uva, athilhonna dinga songa nase dingu ahi; numeinu chu khosunga umngala apen loujeh, chule pasalpa chu aman aheng akom ji asetpi jeh ahi. Chutia chu nalah uva kona thil gilou chu na suhmang diu ahi.
target: you shall take both of them to the gate of that town and stone them to death—the young woman because she was in a town and did not scream for help, and the man because he violated another man’s wife. You must purge the evil from among you.

source: Ahin mikhatnin loujaova mijihol amua, mipa chun acham louva abola, aluppi le; amanu luppi mipa bouchu thiding ahi.
target: But if out in the country a man happens to meet a young woman pledged to be married and rapes her, only the man who has done this shall die.

source: Amavang nungahnu chu imacha nalo louding ahi; nungahnu chunga chu thina theilom chonset umlou ahi: ajehchu hiche thudol hi mikhatnin aheng akom adouva atha tobang ahi.
target: Do nothing to the woman; she has committed no sin deserving death. This case is like that of someone who attacks and murders a neighbor,

source: Ajehchu aman amanu loujaova amu ahin, mijihol nungah chu apengin, ahuhhing ding koimacha aumpoi.
target: for the man found the young woman out in the country, and though the betrothed woman screamed, there was no one to rescue her.

source: Min nungah theng mijihol hilou amua, amanu amatna, aluppia, chule amani chu akimudoh-a ahile,
target: If a man happens to meet a virgin who is not pledged to be married and rapes her and they are discovered,

source: Chutengle aluppi mipa chun nungahnu pa chu dangka shekel somnga apeh-a, amanu chu aji hiding ahi; ajehchu aman amanu asuhboh ahitan, ahinlai sungse-a amanu adathei louding ahi.
target: he shall pay her father fifty shekels of silver. He must marry the young woman, for he has violated her. He can never divorce her as long as he lives.

source: Min apaji akichenpi louding, apa deljong ahodohpeh louding ahi.
target: A man is not to marry his father’s wife; he must not dishonor his father’s bed.

source: Mi atilchang keh, ahiloule ajang ki-at tan chu Pakai houkhom na-a lutlou ding ahi.
target: No one who has been emasculated by crushing or cutting may enter the assembly of the Lord .

source: Pakai houkhom ho lah-a jaocha kiti lutlou ding; ama khangsom changei jenga jong Pakai houkhom holah-a lutlou ding ahi.
target: No one born of a forbidden marriage nor any of their descendants may enter the assembly of the Lord , not even in the tenth generation.

source: Ammon mi ahiloule Moab mi chu Pakai houkhom na-a lutlou ding; khangsom geija jong Pakai houkhom na-a a-imatih channa lutloudiu ahi.
target: No Ammonite or Moabite or any of their descendants may enter the assembly of the Lord , not even in the tenth generation.

source: Ajehchu Egypt gama kona nahung doh-un lamdunga chun changlhah le twisih jengchan jong nana lamdot pouvin; chule Mesopotamia gam, Pethor kho-a Beor chapa Balaam chu nangma douna-a nagaosap dinga athalah jeh-u ahi.
target: For they did not come to meet you with bread and water on your way when you came out of Egypt, and they hired Balaam son of Beor from Pethor in Aram Naharaim to pronounce a curse on you.

source: Hijeng jongle Pakai na Pathen'in Balaam thu angaipon; ahinla Pakai na Pathen'in nalungset jeh-in, Pakai na Pathen'in gaosapna chu nangma dingin phattheiboh na-in aheidohtai.
target: However, the Lord your God would not listen to Balaam but turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the Lord your God loves you.

source: Nahinlaisea a-itih-a amaho dinga chamna le aphattheina dingu nahol louhel ding ahi.
target: Do not seek a treaty of friendship with them as long as you live.

source: Nangman Edom michu nathet louding ahi; ajehchu ama nasopipa ahi. Nangman Egypt michu nathet louding ahi; ajehchu agamsung uva kholjin mi nanahi ahi.
target: Do not despise an Edomite, for the Edomites are related to you. Do not despise an Egyptian, because you resided as foreigners in their country.

source: Amaho chate chu akhang thum channa teng Pakai houkhom ho lah-a lutdiu ahi.
target: The third generation of children born to them may enter the assembly of the Lord .

source: Namelmate doudinga janel akon tengle, thil gilou tin chenga konin kitimin.
target: When you are encamped against your enemies, keep away from everything impure.

source: Nalah uva mikhattou janlaija thenlounan aphah jeh-a aboh-a aumle, amachu janna gebuh-a kona potdoh-a, gebuh sunga hunglut louding ahi.
target: If one of your men is unclean because of a nocturnal emission, he is to go outside the camp and stay there.

source: Amavang hitiding ahi, nilhah lam ahunghi tengle twija kisila; nisa alhum tengle gebuh sunga hunglut kitding ahi.
