target: But as evening approaches he is to wash himself, and at sunset he may return to the camp.

source: Nangin gebuh pamlama jong eh thahna munkhat nanei ding, chua chu nacheji ding ahi.
target: Designate a place outside the camp where you can go to relieve yourself.

source: Chule namanchah lah-a chu lei lona khat naneiding; chule hitiding ahi, nangma pamlama naposo tengle hichea chu lei nalaija, nakiheija nanga kona hungpotdoh chu navuh khum ding ahi.
target: As part of your equipment have something to dig with, and when you relieve yourself, dig a hole and cover up your excrement.

source: Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen chu nahuhdoh ding le namelmate pedoh dinga nagebuh lah-a vahle jia ahi; hijeh-a chu nachunga aboh ima amu louva, nanga kona akiheimang louna dinga, nagebuh chu atheng hiding ahi.
target: For the Lord your God moves about in your camp to protect you and to deliver your enemies to you. Your camp must be holy, so that he will not see among you anything indecent and turn away from you.

source: Soh apu-a kona kiteldoh nahenga hunga chu apu henga napehdoh kit louding ahi.
target: If a slave has taken refuge with you, do not hand them over to their master.

source: Nakotpi hou sunga akilhen ding adeinapen na mun'a chu nalah uva nangma toh chengding ahin; ama nasuh genthei louhel ding ahi.
target: Let them live among you wherever they like and in whatever town they choose. Do not oppress them.

source: Israel chanute lah-a noti, ahiloule Israel chapate lah-a Sodom mi umthei louhel ding ahi.
target: No Israelite man or woman is to become a shrine prostitute.

source: Noti man le uicha man chu Pakai na Pathen in'a kitepna khattouva dinga nahin poh louding ahi. Ajehchu hiteni chu Pakai na Pathen dinga thet umtah ahi.
target: You must not bring the earnings of a female prostitute or of a male prostitute into the house of the Lord your God to pay any vow, because the Lord your God detests them both.

source: Nasopi henga apung dinga thilpa napeh louding; sum pung ahin, neh le chah-a apung ahin, chule ipi hijongle apung dinga kipe thil himhim napeh louding ahi.
target: Do not charge a fellow Israelite interest, whether on money or food or anything else that may earn interest.

source: Namdang henga vang apung dingin thil napeh thei ahi; amavang nasopi henga apung dinga thil apa-a napeh louding ahi. Hitia chu nagoulo ding gama nakhut lhahna pou pouva Pakai na Pathen'in phatthei naboh theina ding ahi.
target: You may charge a foreigner interest, but not a fellow Israelite, so that the Lord your God may bless you in everything you put your hand to in the land you are entering to possess.

source: Nangman Pakai na Pathen henga kitepna-a nakitep teng, pe dinga nangongkai louding ahi; ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'in thonlouva nahenga angeh ding ahin; hichu nadinga chonset hiding ahi.
target: If you make a vow to the Lord your God, do not be slow to pay it, for the Lord your God will certainly demand it of you and you will be guilty of sin.

source: Ahinla kitepna lama nakikangse-a ahile, hichu nanga dinga chonset hilouding ahi.
target: But if you refrain from making a vow, you will not be guilty.

source: Nakama nakihahsel sa lungcham thilto ngei chu, Pakai na Pathen henga nakitep dungjuija, nakama kona potdoh sachu nanitna nabol ding ahi.
target: Whatever your lips utter you must be sure to do, because you made your vow freely to the Lord your God with your own mouth.

source: Naheng nakom lengpi leija nahung tengle, lengpiga chu nagot channa navasetna nanehthei ahin; amavang nabella nakoi louding ahi.
target: If you enter your neighbor’s vineyard, you may eat all the grapes you want, but do not put any in your basket.

source: Naheng nakom changkung ding lah-a nahung tengle, changvui chu nakhutna nakisi thei ahin; amavang naheng nakom chang dinglai chu koite-a na-at theilou ding ahi.
target: If you enter your neighbor’s grainfield, you may pick kernels with your hands, but you must not put a sickle to their standing grain.

source: Pasal khatnin ji akipuija akichenpia, amanu chunga thenlouna amujeh-a amitmua lunglhaina achan joulou tah-a ahile; amapan kidana lekha asutna, amanu khutna apeh-a, a-in'a kona asoldoh ding ahi.
target: If a man marries a woman who becomes displeasing to him because he finds something indecent about her, and he writes her a certificate of divorce, gives it to her and sends her from his house,

source: Chule amanu a-in'a kona apotdoh teng, che-a pasal chomkhat ji hithei ding ahi.
target: and if after she leaves his house she becomes the wife of another man,

source: Chule a-inneipu nunung joh chun ahotna, kidana lekha asutna, akhutna apeh-a, a-in'a kona asoldoh ham; ahiloule ajidinga amanu akipuija a-inneipu nunung chu athia ahile;
target: and her second husband dislikes her and writes her a certificate of divorce, gives it to her and sends her from his house, or if he dies,

source: Amanu ana soldoh-a a-inneipu masa chun, amanu kisuhboh nunga chu jidinga akipuikit thei lou ding ahi; ajehchu hichu Pakai anga dinga thet umtah ahi. Chule Pakai na Pathen'in lodinga napeh gamsunga chonset nalutsah louding ahi.
target: then her first husband, who divorced her, is not allowed to marry her again after she has been defiled. That would be detestable in the eyes of the Lord . Do not bring sin upon the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance.

source: Pasal khatnin ji anei tille galsatna konlouding, natoh khatpou pouva tong dinga jong goi hilouding ahi. Amavang in'a ongthol tah-a kumkhat uma, ajinu alunglhaisah ding ahi.
target: If a man has recently married, he must not be sent to war or have any other duty laid on him. For one year he is to be free to stay at home and bring happiness to the wife he has married.

source: Koimachan sumhei song anoinung ahiloule achungnung thil mana kitungchu alah louhel ding ahi; ajehchu aman mihem hinkho chu thil mana alah ahi.
target: Do not take a pair of millstones—not even the upper one—as security for a debt, because that would be taking a person’s livelihood as security.

source: Mi khattouvin Israel chate asopiho aguh-a, akiveina anei ham, ahiloule ajoh ham akimudoh-a ahile; chuche gucha chu thiding ahin; chule thilse chu nalah uva kona nasuhmang ding ahi.
target: If someone is caught kidnapping a fellow Israelite and treating or selling them as a slave, the kidnapper must die. You must purge the evil from among you.

source: Phah hise thudolla Levi thempuho jousen nahil dingu dungjuija pontho tah-a nitna dingin chingtheijun; keiman amaho kathupeh banga nangman boldinga nanit ding ahi.
target: In cases of defiling skin diseases, be very careful to do exactly as the Levitical priests instruct you. You must follow carefully what I have commanded them.

source: Egypt gama kona nanahung doh jou uva, lampi-a Pakai na Pathen'un Miriam abolna chu geldoh-un.
target: Remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam along the way after you came out of Egypt.

source: Nasopi thil khattou apa-a napeh tengle, athil tun ladinga a-in sunga nalut louding ahi.
target: When you make a loan of any kind to your neighbor, do not go into their house to get what is offered to you as a pledge.

source: Nangma inpoa nadinding, apa-a napeh mipa chun athiltun chu nahenga ahinchoidoh ding ahi.
target: Stay outside and let the neighbor to whom you are making the loan bring the pledge out to you.

source: Amapa chu mivaicha ahile, athiltun chu najan gepi louding ahi.
target: If the neighbor is poor, do not go to sleep with their pledge in your possession.

source: Chutia chu apon noija nomtah-a alupma, phatthei naboh theina dinga, nisa alhum tengle athiltun chu iti nama jongle ama napehkit ding ahi. Hichu Pakai na Pathen angsunga nachon phatna hiding ahi.
target: Return their cloak by sunset so that your neighbor may sleep in it. Then they will thank you, and it will be regarded as a righteous act in the sight of the Lord your God.

source: Nangman soh kithalah avaicha le alhasam chu nasopi hihen lang, ahiloule nagam sunga nakotpi sunga um namaljin ho hijeng jongle, nasuh genthei louding ahi.
target: Do not take advantage of a hired worker who is poor and needy, whether that worker is a fellow Israelite or a foreigner residing in one of your towns.

source: Atoh ni-a chu alo napehding, nisan alhumkhum louding ahi; ajehchu genthei ahin, hichea chu alung angah ahi; achuti loule nangma dounan Pakai henga peng tale, hichu nang dinga chonset hiding ahi.
target: Pay them their wages each day before sunset, because they are poor and are counting on it. Otherwise they may cry to the Lord against you, and you will be guilty of sin.

source: Chate jala pate kithat louding, pate jala chate kithat louding ahi. Amitakip chu ama ama chonset jeh-a kithat ding ahi.
target: Parents are not to be put to death for their children, nor children put to death for their parents; each will die for their own sin.

source: Nangman kholjin mi le paneiloute thu dihlouva natan louding, meithai ponsil jong thiltun mana nalah louhel ding ahi.
target: Do not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, or take the cloak of the widow as a pledge.

source: Ahinla nangma Egypt gama sohchanga nana um ahin, Pakai na Pathen'in chua kona nalhatdoh ahi chu nageldoh ding ahi. Hijeh-a chu hichehi naboldinga kathupeh nahi.
target: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and the Lord your God redeemed you from there. That is why I command you to do this.

source: Nangman nalouva chang na-atna, loulaija changphal nahaimil tengle, gala dinga nachekit louding ahi: hichu kholjin miho, paneilou ho, meithai ho-a ding ahi. Chutile Pakai na Pathen'in nakhut natoh jouse phatthei abohding ahi.
target: When you are harvesting in your field and you overlook a sheaf, do not go back to get it. Leave it for the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow, so that the Lord your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.

source: Nangman na Olive thing navoh tengle, abahho chu naveiboh louding ahi: hichu kholjin mite, paneiloute chule meithai ho ding ahi.
target: When you beat the olives from your trees, do not go over the branches a second time. Leave what remains for the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow.

source: Nangman na lengpi leija aga nalokhom teng, akhai nahol louding ahi: hichu gamdang mite, paneiloute chule meithai ho ding ahi.
target: When you harvest the grapes in your vineyard, do not go over the vines again. Leave what remains for the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow.

source: Chule nangma Egypt gama sohchang nana hichu nageldoh ding ahi. Hijeh-a chu hiche boldinga hi kathupeh nahi.
target: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt. That is why I command you to do this.

source: Pasal ho kahlah-a kinahna auma, thutan ho henga athu-u tansah dinga ahung tengule; amahon michonpha ho chu them achanuva, migilou chu themmo achan dingu ahi.
target: When people have a dispute, they are to take it to court and the judges will decide the case, acquitting the innocent and condemning the guilty.

source: Chule hitiding ahi, migilou chu vohdinga lom ahile, thutanpa chun alupsah-a, ama angsung laitah-a ijatvei ham athemona dungjuija vohding ahi.
target: If the guilty person deserves to be beaten, the judge shall make them lie down and have them flogged in his presence with the number of lashes the crime deserves,

source: Aman somlivei avohding; avala avoh thei louding ahi; avalin vohen, hicheng kalval chun tamtah vei votaleh, nasopipa chu namit mu-a kijumso behseh ding ahi.
target: but the judge must not impose more than forty lashes. If the guilty party is flogged more than that, your fellow Israelite will be degraded in your eyes.

source: Bongchal chang chilpet amuh nakan louding ahi.
target: Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain.

source: Sopiho achenkhomuva, alah uva khat athia, cha aneilouva ahile, athipa jinu chu pama midangtoh kichenglou ding ahi. A-inneipu sopipan avetna, akichenpi ding, amanu chunga chu asopipa tohding kin chu atohding ahi.
target: If brothers are living together and one of them dies without a son, his widow must not marry outside the family. Her husband’s brother shall take her and marry her and fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law to her.

source: Chule hitiding ahi, amanun cha ahin masah pen chun Israelte lah-a amin manlouna dinga asopi thisapa munchu aloding ahi.
target: The first son she bears shall carry on the name of the dead brother so that his name will not be blotted out from Israel.

source: Chule mipa chun asopipa jichu akichenpi nomloule, asopipa jinu chu kotpi phunga upaho henga chea, ka-inneipu asopipa Israelte lah-a asopipa min tundoh ding anomhih-in, ka-inneipu sopipa kin abol nompoi agati ding ahi.
target: However, if a man does not want to marry his brother’s wife, she shall go to the elders at the town gate and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to carry on his brother’s name in Israel. He will not fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law to me.”

source: Chutengle khopi upahon amapa akou uva, akihoulimpi diu, chule ama ada teiteija, kakichenpi nompoi ati-a ahile,
target: Then the elders of his town shall summon him and talk to him. If he persists in saying, “I do not want to marry her,”

source: Asopipa jinu chu upaho angsunga amapa henga hungding, amapa kenga kona kengkoh chu asutna, amaija chil asetkhuma, Asopipa insung atungdoh nomloupa chu hitia hi bolding ahi, tia adonbutna aseiding ahi.
target: his brother’s widow shall go up to him in the presence of the elders, take off one of his sandals, spit in his face and say, “This is what is done to the man who will not build up his brother’s family line.”

source: Chule amapa minchu Israel lah-a, Akengkoh kisutpehpa insungmi kisah ding ahi.
target: That man’s line shall be known in Israel as The Family of the Unsandaled.

source: Pasal ho kahlah-a kina auma, khatjopa jinu chun a-inneipu chu avopa khutna kona huhdoh dinga ahung naija, amanun akhut alhandoh-a, amapa chu ajanga amatna ahile,
target: If two men are fighting and the wife of one of them comes to rescue her husband from his assailant, and she reaches out and seizes him by his private parts,

source: Amanu khut chu natanboh peh-a, amanu chu nakhoto louhel ding ahi.
target: you shall cut off her hand. Show her no pity.

source: Nadipma khaikot jatni, agihle ajang naneilou ding ahi.
target: Do not have two differing weights in your bag—one heavy, one light.

source: Na-insung jong thil tena jatni, alen le aneo naneilou ding ahi.
target: Do not have two differing measures in your house—one large, one small.

source: Ahinla Pakai na Pathen'in napehna gamsunga nahinkho asotna dinga agih tena le asao tena chamkimle dihtah naneiding ahi.
target: You must have accurate and honest weights and measures, so that you may live long in the land the Lord your God is giving you.

source: Ajehchu chutobanga bol ho jouse le chonphat louna thil boljouse chu Pakai na Pathen dinga thet umtah ahi.
target: For the Lord your God detests anyone who does these things, anyone who deals dishonestly.

source: Egypt'a kona nahungdoh laijuva lamdunga Amalek ten nabolnao,
target: Remember what the Amalekites did to you along the way when you came out of Egypt.

source: Pathen jong ginglouva, nalhahsam le nachol laitah-a iti nakimaito pia, nanunga hung achatmo jouse, anu nungpen geija iti atha gam ham chu geldoh-in.
target: When you were weary and worn out, they met you on your journey and attacked all who were lagging behind; they had no fear of God.

source: Hijeh-a chu hitiding ahi, Pakai na Pathen'in gouloa nanei dinga napehna gama chu, Pakai na Pathen'in nakimvela namelmate jouse-a kona nacholdosah tengle, vannoi'a kona Amalek kihetna chu nanoimang ding ahi. Hichehi nasuhmil louding ahi.
target: When the Lord your God gives you rest from all the enemies around you in the land he is giving you to possess as an inheritance, you shall blot out the name of Amalek from under heaven. Do not forget!

source: Chule hitiding ahi, Pakai na Pathen'in goulo dinga napehna gam chu nahung lhuna, nalo-a, nachenlut tengle,
target: When you have entered the land the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance and have taken possession of it and settled in it,

source: Pakai na Pathen'in napehna gama kona leiset ga jouse lah-a kona amasapen chu pocha sunga nakoija, Pakai na Pathen'in amin umsahna dinga adeilhen mun'a chu nahinchoi ding ahi.
target: take some of the firstfruits of all that you produce from the soil of the land the Lord your God is giving you and put them in a basket. Then go to the place the Lord your God will choose as a dwelling for his Name

source: Chule chuche nikho-a thempu hidingpa henga chu nache-a, ajah-a, Eipeh dinguva ipu ipateu henga Pakaiyin anahahsel leimuna chun kahung lhuntai tia tunia hi Pakai na Pathen henga kaphondoh ahi, tia nagasei ding ahi.
target: and say to the priest in office at the time, “I declare today to the Lord your God that I have come to the land the Lord swore to our ancestors to give us.”

source: Chuteng thempu chun nakhutna kona pocha chu alah-a, Pakai na Pathen maicham masang tah-a chu aluiding ahi.
target: The priest shall take the basket from your hands and set it down in front of the altar of the Lord your God.

source: Chule Pakai na Pathen anga chu thu naseija, hitia hi nasei ding ahi, Mangthah dinga gotsa Syria mipa chu kapa ahin, Egypt ma anachesuh-in, milhomcha toh anapem lutnin, chuin chua chun nam lentah, thaneitah, chuleh tamtah ahung hidoh-in;
target: Then you shall declare before the Lord your God: “My father was a wandering Aramean, and he went down into Egypt with a few people and lived there and became a great nation, powerful and numerous.

source: Chuin Egypt miten eina bolseuvin, eibol gimun, sohna hahsatah kachunga akoijun;
target: But the Egyptians mistreated us and made us suffer, subjecting us to harsh labor.

source: Chuin Pakai kapu kapateu Pathen henga chun kakapmun ahile, Pakaiyin kakounao aw ajan, kathohnatna houle kathoh gimnao, eikisuh genthei naochu aven;
target: Then we cried out to the Lord , the God of our ancestors, and the Lord heard our voice and saw our misery, toil and oppression.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Egypt'a konin khut thahat tahle ban lhang doh-in, tijat nasatah hole melchihna ho, chule thil kidangho pumin eihin puidoh taovin;
target: So the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, with great terror and with signs and wonders.

source: Hiche mun'a hin eina puilutnun, hiche gam khoijule bongnoi lonna gam ngeihi eipe taovin ahi.
target: He brought us to this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey;

source: Chule tun, vetan, vo Pakai, nangman neipeh leiset ga masapen chu kahinchoi tai, nati ding ahi. Chule hichu nangin Pakai na Pathen masanga natuna, Pakai na Pathen chu nahou ding ahi.
target: and now I bring the firstfruits of the soil that you, Lord , have given me.” Place the basket before the Lord your God and bow down before him.

source: Chule Pakai na Pathen'in nangma le na-insungmi napeh thilpha takip chunga chu, nangma le nalah uva um Levi te, chule kholjin miho nakipa cheh dingu ahi.
target: Then you and the Levites and the foreigners residing among you shall rejoice in all the good things the Lord your God has given to you and your household.

source: Hopsom peh kum, nalhosoh hopsom jouse napeh jou kum thumna, Levi ho, namdang miho paneilouho, meithaiho chun nakotpi hongsunga aneh uva, avatheina diuva napeh joutengle,
target: When you have finished setting aside a tenth of all your produce in the third year, the year of the tithe, you shall give it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow, so that they may eat in your towns and be satisfied.

source: Chuiteng nangman Pakai na Pathen henga, Ka-in'a konin thil thengho kahinpodoh-in, chujongle Levi ho, kholjin miho, paneilou ho, meithai ho jong nangman neipeh thupeh dungjuijin kanapen, nathupeh ho jouse kasukhel pon, sujong kasumil pon:
target: Then say to the Lord your God: “I have removed from my house the sacred portion and have given it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow, according to all you commanded. I have not turned aside from your commands nor have I forgotten any of them.

source: Hia konchun kalunghem petnin kana nepon, hia konchun thil aboh tapouva mandingin jong kana lamangpon, chule hia konchun mithi ho dingin jong kana pepoi: amavang Pakai ka Pathen aw joh chu lunglutnin kana ngaijin, chule nangman neina thupeh jouse dungjuijin kaboltan ahi.
target: I have not eaten any of the sacred portion while I was in mourning, nor have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor have I offered any of it to the dead. I have obeyed the Lord my God; I have done everything you commanded me.

source: Nachenna theng, van'a konin hin vesuh-in lang, nami Israelte le kapu kapateu henga khoiju le bongnoi lonna gam pehdia nanahahsella neina peh-u gamhi phatthei hinboh-in, natiding ahi.
target: Look down from heaven, your holy dwelling place, and bless your people Israel and the land you have given us as you promised on oath to our ancestors, a land flowing with milk and honey.”

source: Tunikho-a hi Pakai na Pathen'in hiche chon dan kisunho le thutan ho nabol dinga nathupeh ahi. Hijeh-a chu nangin hicheho chu nalung pumpile nahinna pumpi-a nanitna, najui ding ahi.
target: The Lord your God commands you this day to follow these decrees and laws; carefully observe them with all your heart and with all your soul.

source: Tunia hi nangin Pakai chu na Pathen hidinga, alampiho-a chedinga, adan kisunho, athupeh hole, athutan naho nitna dingle, athu ngaidinga naphondoh ahitai.
target: You have declared this day that the Lord is your God and that you will walk in obedience to him, that you will keep his decrees, commands and laws—that you will listen to him.

source: Chule tunikho-a hi Pakaiyin nana thutepsa banga ama mite chombeh hidingle, athupeh jouse nitding,
target: And the Lord has declared this day that you are his people, his treasured possession as he promised, and that you are to keep all his commands.

source: Chule vahchoina, minthana le, jabolna-a asemsa nam jouse chungvuma choi-at dingle, aman aseisa banga Pakai na Pathen henga vaipi theng khat hidinga naphondoh ahitai.
target: He has declared that he will set you in praise, fame and honor high above all the nations he has made and that you will be a people holy to the Lord your God, as he promised.

source: Chuin Mosi'n Israel upaho toh mipi chu thu apen, Tunia nangho kapeh thupeh jouse hi nit uvin.
target: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people: “Keep all these commands that I give you today.

source: Chule Pakai na Pathen'in napeh gam Jordan gal nakai nitengleh hitiding ahi, song lentah ho naphu-a, hiho chu songlou nanu ding ahi.
target: When you have crossed the Jordan into the land the Lord your God is giving you, set up some large stones and coat them with plaster.

source: Chule napu napateu Pakai Pathen'in nathutep jouse banga, Pakai na Pathen'in napeh-u bongnoi le khoiju lonna gamchu nalut theina dinga, nagalkai tengle achung ho-a chu hiche danthu thucheng jouse hi nasut dingu ahi.
target: Write on them all the words of this law when you have crossed over to enter the land the Lord your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the Lord , the God of your ancestors, promised you.

source: Hijeh-a chu Jordan nagalkai joutengle hitiding ahi, tunia kathupeh hiche song hohi Ebal molsanga naphu-a, songlouva naloijol ding ahi.
target: And when you have crossed the Jordan, set up these stones on Mount Ebal, as I command you today, and coat them with plaster.

source: Chule chua chu Pakai na Pathen henga maicham, song maicham khat nasem ding; achunga chu thih manchah imacha nalap louhel ding ahi.
target: Build there an altar to the Lord your God, an altar of stones. Do not use any iron tool on them.

source: Pakai na Pathen maicham chu khetlou songho-a kona nasem ding ahi. Hiche chunga chu Pakai na Pathen henga govam thilto nato ding;
target: Build the altar of the Lord your God with fieldstones and offer burnt offerings on it to the Lord your God.

source: Chule chamna thilto nato-a, chua chu naneh ding, chule Pakai na Pathen anga nakipa ding ahi.
target: Sacrifice fellowship offerings there, eating them and rejoicing in the presence of the Lord your God.

source: Chule songho chunga chu hiche danthu jouse hi kichehtah-a nasut ding ahi, ati.
target: And you shall write very clearly all the words of this law on these stones you have set up.”

source: Chuin Mosi le Levi thempuhon Israel jouse lah-a aseijun, Vo Israel, chingthei jinlang ngaiphan; tunia hi Pakai na Pathen mite nahung hi ahitai.
target: Then Moses and the Levitical priests said to all Israel, “Be silent, Israel, and listen! You have now become the people of the Lord your God.

source: Hijeh-a chu Pakai na Pathen aw nangai ding, tunia nangma kathupeh thupeh ho le adan kisunho hi nabolding ahi, atiuve.
target: Obey the Lord your God and follow his commands and decrees that I give you today.”

source: Chuin hiche nikho mama chun Mosi in mipi thu apen, hitin aseije,
target: On the same day Moses commanded the people:

source: Jordan nagalkai tengule mipi ho phatthei bohdinga hiteho Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, chule Benjamin hi Gerizim molsang chunga dingden dingu ahi.
target: When you have crossed the Jordan, these tribes shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph and Benjamin.

source: Chule hiteho Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, chule Naphtali hi agaosap dinga Ebel molsang chunga ding dingu ahi.
target: And these tribes shall stand on Mount Ebal to pronounce curses: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan and Naphtali.

source: Chule Levi hon thu aseijuva, Israel mite jouse henga aw sangtah-a asapmuva,
target: The Levites shall recite to all the people of Israel in a loud voice:

source: Khutthemho khutna kisem, Pakai dinga thet umtah alim semthu ahiloule lhahtho ham anakoigu aumle gaosap changin umhen, atidiu; chule mipi jousen, Amen, atiuva adonbut dingu ahi.
target: “Cursed is anyone who makes an idol—a thing detestable to the Lord , the work of skilled hands—and sets it up in secret.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”

source: Anu ahiloule apa jabol louva chu gaosap changhen, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.
target: “Cursed is anyone who dishonors their father or mother.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”

source: Aheng akom gamgi chondohpa chu sapset changhen, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.
target: “Cursed is anyone who moves their neighbor’s boundary stone.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”

source: Mitcho lampia kona vaveisah-a chu gaosap changhen, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.
target: “Cursed is anyone who leads the blind astray on the road.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”

source: Kholjin mi, paneilou, chule meithai thutana akaleh-a heidoh chanchu gaosap changhen, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.
target: “Cursed is anyone who withholds justice from the foreigner, the fatherless or the widow.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”

source: Apa ji luppi-a chu gaosap changhen, ajehchu aman apa del ahopeh ahi, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.
target: “Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his father’s wife, for he dishonors his father’s bed.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”

source: Gancha poupou jonpia chu gaosap changhen, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.
target: “Cursed is anyone who has sexual relations with any animal.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”

source: Asopinu, apa chanu, ahiloule anu chanu luppi-a chu gaosap changhen, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.
target: “Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”

source: A-inneipi nu luppi-a chu gaosap changhen, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.
target: “Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his mother-in-law.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”

source: Aheng akom guhthima philla chu gaosap changhen, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.
target: “Cursed is anyone who kills their neighbor secretly.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”

source: Monabei mi thana dinga thilpeh la-a chu gaosap changhen, atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.
target: “Cursed is anyone who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”

source: Hiche danthu jouse boldinga sudet loupa chu gaosap changhen atidiu; chule mipi ho jousen Amen, atidiu ahi.
target: “Cursed is anyone who does not uphold the words of this law by carrying them out.” Then all the people shall say, “Amen!”

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi, tunia nangma kathupeh jouse nitna dingle juina dinga Pakai na Pathen aw chu gen ngaitah-a nangaija ahile, Pakai na Pathen'in leiset chunga nam jouse vuma nachoisang ding ahi.
target: If you fully obey the Lord your God and carefully follow all his commands I give you today, the Lord your God will set you high above all the nations on earth.

source: Pakai na Pathen aw nangaija ahile hiche phattheina jouse hi nachunga hung chua, nachuphel ding ahi.
target: All these blessings will come on you and accompany you if you obey the Lord your God:

source: Nangma khopi sunga phatthei nachan ding; nangma loujaova phatthei nachan ding ahi.
target: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.

source: Nachilhah, naleiset ga, nagancha hon, nabongpi hon, chule nakelngoi hon ho phatthei changdiu ahi.
target: The fruit of your womb will be blessed, and the crops of your land and the young of your livestock—the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.

source: Na palbom le nathil kholna jong phatthei changding ahi.
target: Your basket and your kneading trough will be blessed.

source: Nahung vailhun teng phatthei nachan ding, navaikon doh teng jong le phatthei nachan ding ahi.
target: You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.

source: Nangma doudinga hungkon namelmate chu Pakaiyin namai koh-a athagam ding: nangma dou dinga lampi khatna hungdoh uva, namai koh-a lampi sagi-a jamcheh diu ahi.
target: The Lord will grant that the enemies who rise up against you will be defeated before you. They will come at you from one direction but flee from you in seven.

source: Pakai chun nathil kholna in le nakhut natoh jouse chunga phattheina chu thu apeh ding; Pakai na Pathen'in napeh gamsunga chu aman phatthei nabohding ahi.
target: The Lord will send a blessing on your barns and on everything you put your hand to. The Lord your God will bless you in the land he is giving you.

source: Nangman Pakai na Pathen thupeh ho nanitna, alampiho-a nache-a ahile, aman nahahsel na banga Pakaiyin ama ding tuma namtheng khatna natundoh ding ahi.
target: The Lord will establish you as his holy people, as he promised you on oath, if you keep the commands of the Lord your God and walk in obedience to him.

source: Chule leiset mite jousen Pakai mina nakikou chu amuva, nangma nakichat dingu ahi.
target: Then all the peoples on earth will see that you are called by the name of the Lord , and they will fear you.

source: Chule Pakaiyin napu napate henga nangma pehdinga anahahselna gama chu, Pakaiyin thil le lo, nachilhah, nagancha, naleiset ga-a nanen jengjung sah ding ahi.
target: The Lord will grant you abundant prosperity—in the fruit of your womb, the young of your livestock and the crops of your ground—in the land he swore to your ancestors to give you.

source: Pakaiyin nangma dinga nagamsunga aphatcha gotwi peding le, nakhutna nanatoh jouse phattheiboh dinga, agou kholna phatah vanchu nahonpeh ding; nangman nam tamtah henga thil apan homin natin, nangin thil apa-a nalah louding ahi.
target: The Lord will open the heavens, the storehouse of his bounty, to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands. You will lend to many nations but will borrow from none.

source: Tunia kathupeh Pakai na Pathen thupeh hohi nitding le juidinga nangaija ahile, Pakaiyin amei hilouva alua nakoija, chule anoinung hilouva achunga bou nakoiding ahi.
target: The Lord will make you the head, not the tail. If you pay attention to the commands of the Lord your God that I give you this day and carefully follow them, you will always be at the top, never at the bottom.

source: Chule tunia kathupeh thuho-a kona pathen dangho jenna dinga anungu juina-a jetlam ahiloule veilama nakihei louhel ding ahi.
target: Do not turn aside from any of the commands I give you today, to the right or to the left, following other gods and serving them.

source: Amavang hung hitiding ahi, tunia kathupeh athupeh jouse le, achonna dan kisunho jouse juidinga Pakai na Pathen aw chu nangailouva ahile; hiche gaosapna jouse hi nachunga hungchua, nachup helding ahi.
target: However, if you do not obey the Lord your God and do not carefully follow all his commands and decrees I am giving you today, all these curses will come on you and overtake you:

source: Khopi sunga gaosapna nachan ding, chule loujaova jong gaosapna nachan ding ahi.
target: You will be cursed in the city and cursed in the country.

source: Na palbom le nathil kholna jong gaosap changding ahi.
target: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.

source: Nachilhah, naleiset ga, nabongpi hon, nakelngoi honho jong gaosap changding ahi.
target: The fruit of your womb will be cursed, and the crops of your land, and the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.

source: Nahung vailhun tengle sapset nachana, navai kondohteng jongle sapset nachan ding ahi.
target: You will be cursed when you come in and cursed when you go out.

source: Nathilbol gitlouna-a kona neidalhah jeh-a nangma nakisuh manga namanthah hel loi kahse-a Pakaiyin na natohna chunga, nakhut lhahna jouse-a, gaosapna, suhnohna, housetna jouse ahinchuhsah ding ahi.
target: The Lord will send on you curses, confusion and rebuke in everything you put your hand to, until you are destroyed and come to sudden ruin because of the evil you have done in forsaking him.

source: Galo dinga nachena gama kona aman nasuhmang hel kahse-a, Pakaiyin nachunga natset alenden sah ding ahi.
target: The Lord will plague you with diseases until he has destroyed you from the land you are entering to possess.

source: Pakaiyin hihet, khosih, tipom chetchut, tisat val, chemjam, huise, chule motna-a najepma, namanthah hel kahse-a hicheng hin najuiding ahi.
target: The Lord will strike you with wasting disease, with fever and inflammation, with scorching heat and drought, with blight and mildew, which will plague you until you perish.

source: Naluvuma um van chu sum-eng soh-a, nanoija leiset chu thih hungsoh ding ahi.
target: The sky over your head will be bronze, the ground beneath you iron.

source: Pakaiyin nagama gotwi chu leivui le vutvai aso-a, namanthah hel kahse-a nachunga van'a kona hung julha ding ahi.
target: The Lord will turn the rain of your country into dust and powder; it will come down from the skies until you are destroyed.

source: Namelmate masanga Pakaiyin gal nalelsah ding; amaho sat dinga lampi khatna nakon doh-a, amasanguva lampi sagi-a najam ding ahi. Chule leiset lenggam jouse-a nakichonle ding ahi.
target: The Lord will cause you to be defeated before your enemies. You will come at them from one direction but flee from them in seven, and you will become a thing of horror to all the kingdoms on earth.

source: Chule nalong chu chungleng vacha jouse le leiset gamsa dinga anneh hiding, chule koimachan anomang loudiu ahi.
target: Your carcasses will be food for all the birds and the wild animals, and there will be no one to frighten them away.

source: Pakaiyin Egypt gam uilutna, thilona, tinakhih neija, tithah na-a najep natna, chuho-a kona chu nadamdoh louhel ding ahi.
target: The Lord will afflict you with the boils of Egypt and with tumors, festering sores and the itch, from which you cannot be cured.

source: Pakaiyin ngolna-a, mitchot na-a, lungkidanna-a najepding ahi.
target: The Lord will afflict you with madness, blindness and confusion of mind.

source: Muthim noija mitcho akimai banga sunchang noija nakimai ding, nalampi-a nalolhin louding: a-itih-a bolgenthei le chom mangbou nahi-a, koimachan nahuhhing louding ahi.
target: At midday you will grope about like a blind person in the dark. You will be unsuccessful in everything you do; day after day you will be oppressed and robbed, with no one to rescue you.

source: Nangin jihol neijin natin, midangin amanu aluppi ding: nangin in kisah-in natin, nangla chua nachen louding: nangin lengpilei kibolin natin, chua kona lengpiga nalo louding ahi.
target: You will be pledged to be married to a woman, but another will take her and rape her. You will build a house, but you will not live in it. You will plant a vineyard, but you will not even begin to enjoy its fruit.

source: Namitmu na-angsung laitah-a nabongchal kithat ding, hichu nanehlou ding: namaikoh tah-a kona nasangan pumhatna kikai mang ding, nakilepeh louding: nakelngoi chu namelmate kipe ding, ahuhdoh ding koimacha naneilou ding ahi.
target: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes, but you will eat none of it. Your donkey will be forcibly taken from you and will not be returned. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and no one will rescue them.

source: Nachapate le nachanute midangho kipe ding, namitna navetna, nilhumkeija amaho lhangai na-a natha beiding: nakhutna hatna himhim umlou ding ahi.
target: Your sons and daughters will be given to another nation, and you will wear out your eyes watching for them day after day, powerless to lift a hand.

source: Naleiset ga le natoh gim ga jouse chu nahet khahlou nam khatnin anehchai ding; nangma suhgenthei le noigep vou nahiding ahi.
target: A people that you do not know will eat what your land and labor produce, and you will have nothing but cruel oppression all your days.

source: Chutia chu namitnin avet nathilmu ho jala chu nangolding ahi.
target: The sights you see will drive you mad.

source: Pakaiyin suhdam theilou uilut khohtah-a nakhup teni le kengteni, nakengto-a pat nalujang gei anatsah ding ahi.
target: The Lord will afflict your knees and legs with painful boils that cannot be cured, spreading from the soles of your feet to the top of your head.

source: Pakaiyin nangma le nachunga atunding nalengpa chu nangma le napu napateu jong anahet khahlou beh namkhat henga napuilut dingu ahin; chuachu thih le song pathen dangho bou nagajen dingu ahi.
target: The Lord will drive you and the king you set over you to a nation unknown to you or your ancestors. There you will worship other gods, gods of wood and stone.

source: Chule Pakaiyin napuina ding namtin lah-a chu nangma datmo umtah, paochamtuh, chule seichah bep nahungso ding ahi.
target: You will become a thing of horror, a byword and an object of ridicule among all the peoples where the Lord will drive you.

source: Nangman muchi tamtah loujaova napohlut ding, amavang themcha bou nalokhum ding ahi; ajehchu khaokhopin anehchai ding ahi.
target: You will sow much seed in the field but you will harvest little, because locusts will devour it.

source: Nangman lengpilei nabola, nalho ngim ding, amavang alengpitwi chu nadonlou ding, chule lengpiga jong nalo khom louding ahi; ajehchu lungin anehdiu ahi.
target: You will plant vineyards and cultivate them but you will not drink the wine or gather the grapes, because worms will eat them.

source: Nangman nagamsung jouse-a Olive thing nanei ding, amavang athao chu nakinu louding ahi; ajehchu na Olive chu aga pulgam ding ahi.
target: You will have olive trees throughout your country but you will not use the oil, because the olives will drop off.

source: Nangman chapate le chanute hingin tin, ahinla nanopsahna hilouding ahi; ajehchu gal hinga chegamdiu ahi.
target: You will have sons and daughters but you will not keep them, because they will go into captivity.

source: Nagamsunga thingphung jousele aga jouse chu khaokhon anehgamhel ding ahi.
target: Swarms of locusts will take over all your trees and the crops of your land.

source: Nalah-a um namdang mi chu nang vuma hatah-a hung kichoisang ding; nangma hatah-a nanemsuh ding ahi.
target: The foreigners who reside among you will rise above you higher and higher, but you will sink lower and lower.

source: Aman nangma apa-a napeh ding, nangman vang ama apa-a napeh louding: ama aluchangin pangintin, nangma ameija nahung panding ahi.
target: They will lend to you, but you will not lend to them. They will be the head, but you will be the tail.

source: Chukal vala jong Aman nathupeh athupeh ho le adan kisunho nitna dinga Pakai na Pathen aw nangailou jeh-a, namanthah hel kahse-a hiche gaosap nahohi nachunga hungchua, nanung ajuija, nachup mangding ahi.
target: All these curses will come on you. They will pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, because you did not obey the Lord your God and observe the commands and decrees he gave you.

source: Chule hicheho chu nangma le nachilhahte chunga a-itih-a dinga melchihna le thil kidanga umding ahi.
target: They will be a sign and a wonder to you and your descendants forever.

source: Thiljouse anen jeh-a Pakai na Pathen chu lungsung thanom tah le kipah tah-a najenlou jeh-a;
target: Because you did not serve the Lord your God joyfully and gladly in the time of prosperity,

source: Hijeh-a chu Pakaiyin nangma doudinga ahinsol ding namelmate chu gilkel le dangchah-a, sagohkeu le ijakai lhasama najending: aman nangma nasuhmang hel kahse-a nangonga thih namkoljon napohsah ding ahi.
target: therefore in hunger and thirst, in nakedness and dire poverty, you will serve the enemies the Lord sends against you. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.

source: Pakaiyin nangma doudinga gamlatah-a kon,leiset kolmanga kon namkhat, mulaopi banga gangjet; apaovu jong nahetlouhel nam khat ahinpui ding ahi.
target: The Lord will bring a nation against you from far away, from the ends of the earth, like an eagle swooping down, a nation whose language you will not understand,

source: Kichat umtah melpu, tehse ja-ngaina neilouhel, chapang jong lungset chomlou nam;
target: a fierce-looking nation without respect for the old or pity for the young.

source: Chule amachun namanhel kahse-a nagancha hon le nagamga aneh ding: aman nasuhmang hel kahse-a chang, lengpithei, thao, nabongnou, ahiloule nakelngoi hon ho-a kona apungdoh hojong nakhenpeh louhel ding ahi.
target: They will devour the young of your livestock and the crops of your land until you are destroyed. They will leave you no grain, new wine or olive oil, nor any calves of your herds or lambs of your flocks until you are ruined.

source: Natahsan nangapna nagamsung pumpi-a kulpi kikai khum sangtah ho chu achimlhahsoh kahse-a, aman nakotpi jouse-a na-umkul ding: Pakai na Pathen'in napeh gamsung pumpi nakul kotpiho jouse na-umkul khumdiu ahi.
target: They will lay siege to all the cities throughout your land until the high fortified walls in which you trust fall down. They will besiege all the cities throughout the land the Lord your God is giving you.

source: Namelmate bol hesohna-a naki-um kul le nakineh chintona-a chu, Pakai na Pathen'in napeh nangmatah chilhah, nachapate le nachanute sa chu nanehding:
target: Because of the suffering your enemy will inflict on you during the siege, you will eat the fruit of the womb, the flesh of the sons and daughters the Lord your God has given you.

source: Chutia chu nalah-a um lungnem le hongphal pa jongchun asopipa le a-angkoi ajinu, chule achate lah-a, ahinghoi ding amohpen jeng jong chu amuset ding:
target: Even the most gentle and sensitive man among you will have no compassion on his own brother or the wife he loves or his surviving children,

source: Chutia chu amaho khatcha jong anehding achate sa chu apehlou ding ahi: ajehchu nakotpi phung jouse-a namelma ten umkulna le nehchep na-a nasuhgenthei ding jeh-a imacha akikhenlou ahitai.
target: and he will not give to one of them any of the flesh of his children that he is eating. It will be all he has left because of the suffering your enemy will inflict on you during the siege of all your cities.

source: Nalah uva um numei lungnemle lungneng pen, alung nemle alungnet behseh jeh-a akengkho taljum jong tolla chuhsah nomlou numei jong chun a-angkoi ajipa le achapa chule achanu chu amuset ding,
target: The most gentle and sensitive woman among you—so sensitive and gentle that she would not venture to touch the ground with the sole of her foot—will begrudge the husband she loves and her own son or daughter

source: Chule akengteni kah-a hung pengdoh-a chasen le ahin hinding achate jong, amuset ding ahi: ajehchu umkulna le gotchep na-a namelma ten nakotpi phung jouseuva nasuh genthei jeh uva, ijakai lhahsap jeh-a amanun amaho chu guhthima anehgam ding ahi.
target: the afterbirth from her womb and the children she bears. For in her dire need she intends to eat them secretly because of the suffering your enemy will inflict on you during the siege of your cities.

source: PAKAI NA PATHEN kiti min loupitah le tijat umtah hi nagin theina dinga hiche lekhabu sunga kisun danthuho jouse chingthei tah-a najui louva ahile;
target: If you do not carefully follow all the words of this law, which are written in this book, and do not revere this glorious and awesome name—the Lord your God—

source: Pakaiyin nangma hise le nachilhahte hise chu hise kidangtah, hise nasatah, sottah umding hise, natna khohtahden, sottah umjom jingding asosah ding ahi.
target: the Lord will send fearful plagues on you and your descendants, harsh and prolonged disasters, and severe and lingering illnesses.

source: Chukalvala jong nangman nagin Egypt gama hise jouse chu, nachung uva alensah ding; hicheho chun nakolchah ding ahi.
target: He will bring on you all the diseases of Egypt that you dreaded, and they will cling to you.

source: Chule hiche danthu lekhabu sunga kisun lou natna tincheng le hise tincheng ho jong chu Pakaiyin namanthah hel kahse-a nachunga ahinlhut ding ahi.
target: The Lord will also bring on you every kind of sickness and disaster not recorded in this Book of the Law, until you are destroyed.

source: Chule natam jeh-un van'a ahsi jat ana hijongleu chun, lhomcha bou kikhen ding nahiuve; ajehchu Pakai na Pathen aw nangaipon ahi.
target: You who were as numerous as the stars in the sky will be left but few in number, because you did not obey the Lord your God.

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi, naphatna bolding le nangma suhpung ding chu Pakai kipana ahi banga; chutia chu nangma suhmang dingle manlou soding chu Pakai kipah hiding ahitai; chule galo dinga nachena gama kona chu nakibotdoh dingu ahi.
target: Just as it pleased the Lord to make you prosper and increase in number, so it will please him to ruin and destroy you. You will be uprooted from the land you are entering to possess.

source: Chule Pakaiyin mijouse lah, leiset kolmong langkhatna pat langkhat geija nathe cheh uva; chua chu nangma nahi-a napu napate ahiuva jong anahet ngailou thing le song pathen ngeichu najending ahi.
target: Then the Lord will scatter you among all nations, from one end of the earth to the other. There you will worship other gods—gods of wood and stone, which neither you nor your ancestors have known.

source: Chule hiche namho lah-a chu choldona namu louding, nakengto jengin jong olna amulou ding: Pakaiyin lungsung linglaona, mit setna, chule lungkhamna napeh johding ahi.
target: Among those nations you will find no repose, no resting place for the sole of your foot. There the Lord will give you an anxious mind, eyes weary with longing, and a despairing heart.

source: Chule namalam hinkho chu lung opkaina hiding, sunle jana nakichat na, nahinkho dinga dettah-a ngamna nanei louding ahi.
target: You will live in constant suspense, filled with dread both night and day, never sure of your life.

source: Kichatna nalunga nagel ding jeh le namitna namu ding thilmujeh-a, jingkah teng, Pathen'in nilhah hisah taveleh! nati-a, nilhah teng, Pathen'in jingkah hisah taveleh! natiding ahi.
target: In the morning you will say, “If only it were evening!” and in the evening, “If only it were morning!”—because of the terror that will fill your hearts and the sights that your eyes will see.

source: Chule hichehi namukit louding ahitai tia kaseina lampia chu Pakaiyin Egypt gama kong inneija nale puilut kitding: chua chu namelma te henga sohpa le sohnu-a vuldinga nakijoh diu ahin, koimachan nakichoh loudiu ahi.
target: The Lord will send you back in ships to Egypt on a journey I said you should never make again. There you will offer yourselves for sale to your enemies as male and female slaves, but no one will buy you.

source: Hichehohi Horeb'a amahotoh kitepna asem tilouva, Moab gama Israel chate toh neidinga Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh kitepna thuchengho chu ahi.
target: These are the terms of the covenant the Lord commanded Moses to make with the Israelites in Moab, in addition to the covenant he had made with them at Horeb.

source: Chuin Mosi'n Israelte jouse akouvin, ajah uva, Nanghon Egypt gama Pharaoh chung, asohte jouse chung, chule agampumpi chunga Pakai thilbol jouse chu namitmu tah uva namu taovin;
target: Moses summoned all the Israelites and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that the Lord did in Egypt to Pharaoh, to all his officials and to all his land.

source: Patepna nasatah ho, melchihna ho, chule thilkidang nasatah ho chu namit uva namutaovin:
target: With your own eyes you saw those great trials, those signs and great wonders.

source: Ahijeng vangin Pakaiyin hetchetna lungthim, muchetna mit, chule jahchetna nakhang tunigeijin napehih laijuve.
target: But to this day the Lord has not given you a mind that understands or eyes that see or ears that hear.

source: Chule keiman gamthipma kum somli kana lamkaijun: nachung uva naponsilu achulpon, nakenguva nakengkoh-u jong aluipon ahi.
target: Yet the Lord says, “During the forty years that I led you through the wilderness, your clothes did not wear out, nor did the sandals on your feet.

source: Keima hi Pakai na Pathen'u kahi nahet theina diuvin, nanghon changlhah nane pouvin, lengpitwi le khamna thei jong nanadon pouve.
target: You ate no bread and drank no wine or other fermented drink. I did this so that you might know that I am the Lord your God.”

source: Chuin hiche mun'a nahunglhun phatnun, Heshbon lengpa Shihon le Bashan lengpa Og chu eiho satdin ahung kondoh lhonin, eihon ina joutaove.
target: When you reached this place, Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out to fight against us, but we defeated them.

source: Chule agamhou ilaovin, Reuben mite, Gad mite, chule Manasseh phung kehkhat goulodin ipetaove.
target: We took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

source: Hijeh chun nabol jouseuva nakhantou theina diuvin, hiche kitepna thuho hi nitnun lang juijun.
target: Carefully follow the terms of this covenant, so that you may prosper in everything you do.

source: Tunin nabonchaovin, naphung lamkai hou, na-upahou, napipu hou, chule Israel mite jouse toh Pakai na Pathen'u anga nading sohkeijun,
target: All of you are standing today in the presence of the Lord your God—your leaders and chief men, your elders and officials, and all the other men of Israel,

source: Nacha senteu, na-inneipi teu, napon in sunguva um nakhopem hou, na thing tuh houva pat twikhai ho geijin:
target: together with your children and your wives, and the foreigners living in your camps who chop your wood and carry your water.

source: Tunia Pakai na Pathen'un nangho toh asem, Pakai na Pathen to akitepna le akihahselna sunga nalut theina dingun;
target: You are standing here in order to enter into a covenant with the Lord your God, a covenant the Lord is making with you this day and sealing with an oath,

source: Aman nahenga aseibanga le, napu napateu Abraham, Isaac, Jacob henga anakihahsel banga, Tunikho-a hi aman nangho ama mite hidinga natundoh theina dingu le, ama nangho Pathen ahitheina ding ahi.
target: to confirm you this day as his people, that he may be your God as he promised you and as he swore to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

source: Hiche kitepnale kihahselna hi nangma changseh toh kasem ahipon,
target: I am making this covenant, with its oath, not only with you

source: Tunia Pakai i-Pathen'u anga ilah uva hikoma umpa, chule tunia hikoma ilah uva umloupa to jong ahi:
target: who are standing here with us today in the presence of the Lord our God but also with those who are not here today.

source: (Ajehchu Egypt gama iti ina chen uva, chule ihin jotpao nampiho iti ihin palpao ham naheuvin,
target: You yourselves know how we lived in Egypt and how we passed through the countries on the way here.

source: Chule alah uva um athet umtah hou, amilimhou, thing le song, dangka le sana hochu namuvin ahi.)
target: You saw among them their detestable images and idols of wood and stone, of silver and gold.

source: Ijemtia nalah uva pasal ham, numei ham, insungham, inkoham, phungham, Pakai i-Pathen'uva kona, hiche nam mite pathenho gajen dinga alunghei manga ummaithei ahin; achuti loule nalah uva thingkha le hampa kha jungnei hung umdoh getninte;
target: Make sure there is no man or woman, clan or tribe among you today whose heart turns away from the Lord our God to go and worship the gods of those nations; make sure there is no root among you that produces such bitter poison.

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, hitobang michun hiche gaosapna thuho hi ajah tengle, Dangchah chu khamna-a akibelap bangin, kalung ngaito dandanin umjong leng chamna neinange, tin alungsunga ama le ama phatthei kiboh henlang hileh,
target: When such a person hears the words of this oath and they invoke a blessing on themselves, thinking, “I will be safe, even though I persist in going my own way,” they will bring disaster on the watered land as well as the dry.

source: Pakaiyin amachu akhen louhel ding, ahinla Pakai lungsatna le athang thipna chu amapa chunga chu meikhu-a kitungdoh-a, hiche lekhabua kisun gaosapna ho jousehi achunga chuding, chule Pakaiyin aminchu vannoi'a kona hi anoimang ding ahi.
target: The Lord will never be willing to forgive them; his wrath and zeal will burn against them. All the curses written in this book will fall on them, and the Lord will blot out their names from under heaven.

source: Chule Pakaiyin amachu hiche dan lekhabu sunga kisun kitepna chunga gaosapna ho jouse dungjuija, Israel phung jouse-a kona hamsetna chang dinga akhendoh ding:
target: The Lord will single them out from all the tribes of Israel for disaster, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this Book of the Law.

source: Chutia chu nanunga hung pengdoh ding nachate khang hunglhung dingho le, gamlatah-a kona hung ding namdang mi hon Pakaiyin achunga achuhsah chuche gamna hise le natna ho chu amutengule;
target: Your children who follow you in later generations and foreigners who come from distant lands will see the calamities that have fallen on the land and the diseases with which the Lord has afflicted it.

source: Chuche gam pumpi chu kath, chi, meikah, ima kitu lou, ima galou, asunga hampa jong kehlou, Pakaiyin alungsatna le alunghana asumangsa Sodom le Gomorrah, Admah le Zeboiim tobang ahi atidiu:
target: The whole land will be a burning waste of salt and sulfur—nothing planted, nothing sprouting, no vegetation growing on it. It will be like the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboyim, which the Lord overthrew in fierce anger.

source: Chule namtinho jouse jengin jong, Ipibola Pakaiyin hiche gamhi ahitibol hintem? hiche lunghanna nasatah hi ipi tina ahidem? atidiu ahi.
target: All the nations will ask: “Why has the Lord done this to this land? Why this fierce, burning anger?”

source: Chutengle mihon, Egypt gama kona amaho ahinpuidoh laijuva amaho toh anasem, apu apateu Pakai Pathen kitepna chu adalhah jeh-u ahi;
target: And the answer will be: “It is because this people abandoned the covenant of the Lord , the God of their ancestors, the covenant he made with them when he brought them out of Egypt.

source: Ajehchu Aman amaho henga apeh hilouho pathen dangho, ahetkhah louvu pathen ho henga acheuvin agajenun, ahou jeh uva;
target: They went off and worshiped other gods and bowed down to them, gods they did not know, gods he had not given them.

source: Hiche lekhabu sunga kisun gaosapna jouse pohlut khum dinga Pakai lunghanna chu hiche gam chunga koujah-a ahitai;
target: Therefore the Lord ’s anger burned against this land, so that he brought on it all the curses written in this book.

source: Chule Pakaiyin amaho chu lungsatna, lunghanna, chule lungphatmona nasatah, tunikho banga hi, agamma kona ajung aja-a abodoh-a mi gamdanga aselut ahitai, atidiu ahi.
target: In furious anger and in great wrath the Lord uprooted them from their land and thrust them into another land, as it is now.”

source: Thil kiselho chu Pakai i-Pathen uva ahin: ahin akiphongdoh saho chu hiche danthua thuho jouse hi ijuitheina diuva a-itih-a dinga eihole ichateuva ding ahi.
target: The secret things belong to the Lord our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may follow all the words of this law.

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi, namasanga kakoi hiche phattheina le gaosapnaho jouse hi nachunga ahung lhuna, Pakai na Pathen'in nadel lutna namho jouse lah-a kona chu nahin geldoh-a,
target: When all these blessings and curses I have set before you come on you and you take them to heart wherever the Lord your God disperses you among the nations,

source: Chule Pakai na Pathen henga nahung kile-a, nangma le nachaten nalung pumpiu le nahinna pumpiuva tunia nangma thu kapeh jouse dungjuija hi a-aw nangai uva ahile;
target: and when you and your children return to the Lord your God and obey him with all your heart and with all your soul according to everything I command you today,

source: Pakai na Pathen'in gal hinga nakikaina chu aleheija, nachunga lainatna aneija, chule hung kileheija Pakai na Pathen'in nathe chehna namho jouse lah-a kona nachopkhom kitding ahi.
target: then the Lord your God will restore your fortunes and have compassion on you and gather you again from all the nations where he scattered you.

source: Na mi khattou chu van mong geija ana kinodoh-a ahijongle, chua kona Pakai na Pathen'in nalonkhoma, chua kona nahin puidoh ding ahi;
target: Even if you have been banished to the most distant land under the heavens, from there the Lord your God will gather you and bring you back.

source: Chule Pakai Pathen'in napu napateu vin alonao gamsunga chu nahin puilutna, nangman hichu naloding; Aman nabol phatna, napu napateu chungvuma napunsah ding ahi.
target: He will bring you to the land that belonged to your ancestors, and you will take possession of it. He will make you more prosperous and numerous than your ancestors.

source: Chule Pakai na Pathen'in nahin theina ding, nalungthim pumpile nahinna pumpi-a Pakai na Pathen nangailutna dinga, nalungsung le nachilhahte lungsung chep atan ding ahi.
target: The Lord your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, so that you may love him with all your heart and with all your soul, and live.

source: Chule Pakai na Pathen'in hiche gaosapna jousehi namelmate le nahotbol te, chule nabolsete chunga akoiding ahi.
target: The Lord your God will put all these curses on your enemies who hate and persecute you.

source: Chule nangma nahung kile-a Pakai aw chu nangaiding, tunia nangma kathupeh ama thupeh jouse hi nabolding ahi.
target: You will again obey the Lord and follow all his commands I am giving you today.

source: Chule Pakai na Pathen'in nakhutna athilbol jouse, nachilhahte, nagancha ho, chule nagamga aphatna dinga hatah-a asuhpung ding ahi: ajehchu Pakai chu napu napateu chunga athanop banga, naphatna dinga nangma chunga thanom kitding ahi.
target: Then the Lord your God will make you most prosperous in all the work of your hands and in the fruit of your womb, the young of your livestock and the crops of your land. The Lord will again delight in you and make you prosperous, just as he delighted in your ancestors,

source: Hiche dan lekhabu sunga kisun athupeh hole adan kisunho nitna dinga Pakai na Pathen thu nangaija; chule Pakai na Pathen henglama nalungthim pumpile nahinna pumpi-a nakihei ja ahile chuti ding ahi.
target: if you obey the Lord your God and keep his commands and decrees that are written in this Book of the Law and turn to the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

source: Ajehchu tunia nang kathupeh hiche thupeh hi nanga kona kisel ahipon, chule gamlapi-a umjong ahipoi.
target: Now what I am commanding you today is not too difficult for you or beyond your reach.

source: Ijah uva, ibol theina diuva, eiho dinga van'a koi gakal touva, eiho henga ahin pohlhah ding ham? natina diuva hichu van'a uma ahipoi.
target: It is not up in heaven, so that you have to ask, “Who will ascend into heaven to get it and proclaim it to us so we may obey it?”

source: Ijah uva, ibol theina diuva, eiho dinga twikhanglen galla koi gachea, ihenguva ahinpoh galkai ding ham? natina diuva hichu twikhanglen galla um jong ahipoi.
target: Nor is it beyond the sea, so that you have to ask, “Who will cross the sea to get it and proclaim it to us so we may obey it?”

source: Ahinla thuchu nanit theina dinga, nakom naicha, nakam sungle nalungsung um ahibouve.
target: No, the word is very near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart so you may obey it.

source: Ven, tuni hin namasanga hinna le thilpha, thina le thilse kakoipeh-e.
target: See, I set before you today life and prosperity, death and destruction.

source: Pakai na Pathen chu nangailut nading, alampiho juina ding, athupeh hole achondan ho chule athutan ho nitna dinga tunia kathupeh hohi nanitna ahile nahina, napuntheina ding: chule lodinga nachenna gama chu Pakai na Pathen'in phatthei nabohding ahi.
target: For I command you today to love the Lord your God, to walk in obedience to him, and to keep his commands, decrees and laws; then you will live and increase, and the Lord your God will bless you in the land you are entering to possess.

source: Amavang najahlouna dinga nalungthim akihei manga, puimanga naum joh-a, pathen dang nahouva, najena ahile,
target: But if your heart turns away and you are not obedient, and if you are drawn away to bow down to other gods and worship them,

source: Namanthah teidiu ahi tia tunia hi kaphondoh ahi; galo dinga Jordan nagalkaina gama chu nahinsot louheldiu ahi.
target: I declare to you this day that you will certainly be destroyed. You will not live long in the land you are crossing the Jordan to enter and possess.

source: Namasanguva hinna le thina, phattheina le gaosapna kakoije ti nangho douna-a ahetoh dinga tunia hi van le lei kakou ahi; hijeh chun nangma le nachilhahte nahinthei dingu hinna kilhenun:
target: This day I call the heavens and the earth as witnesses against you that I have set before you life and death, blessings and curses. Now choose life, so that you and your children may live

source: Chutia chu Pakai na Pathen nangailutna, a-aw nangaija, chule ama nakolchah theinadin: ajehchu ama nahinna ahin, nahinkho sotna ahi: chutia chu Pakaiyin napu napa te Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob peh dinga ahahselna gama chu nachen theiding ahi.
target: and that you may love the Lord your God, listen to his voice, and hold fast to him. For the Lord is your life, and he will give you many years in the land he swore to give to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

source: Chuin Mosi achen, Israel miho jouse henga chun hiche thuho hi aseije,
target: Then Moses went out and spoke these words to all Israel:

source: Chuin ajah uva, Tuni hin keima kum jankhat le kum somni kalhingtan; kalut le kapot le joutapon ahi: chujongle Pakaiyin jong kajah-a, Nangma hiche Jordan hi nagalkai louding ahi, eiti.
target: “I am now a hundred and twenty years old and I am no longer able to lead you. The Lord has said to me, ‘You shall not cross the Jordan.’

source: Pakai na Pathen'u chu namasanguva lamkaijin tin, aman hiche namhohi namasanguva kona asumang ding, chule nanghon amaho gamchu nalo dingu ahi. Chule Pakaiyin ana seibanga, Joshua'in nalamkai dingu ahi.
target: The Lord your God himself will cross over ahead of you. He will destroy these nations before you, and you will take possession of their land. Joshua also will cross over ahead of you, as the Lord said.

source: Chule Pakaiyin amaho chu Amor miho lengteni Sihon le Og abol banga abolding, chule aman asuhmang gamho banga abolding ahi.
target: And the Lord will do to them what he did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, whom he destroyed along with their land.

source: Chule keiman nangho thu kapeh-u thupeh ho jouse dungjuija ahenguva nabol theina dinguva, Pakaiyin amaho chu namaikoh uva napehdoh dingu ahi.
target: The Lord will deliver them to you, and you must do to them all that I have commanded you.

source: Hatnunlang hanguvin, kicha hih-un, amaho khu ging jong ging hih-un: ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'u, nangho nalhonpia chu ama ahi; Aman nalosam sah loudingu, dajong nadalhah louheldiu ahi, ati.
target: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or terrified because of them, for the Lord your God goes with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Joshua akouvin, Israelte jouse mitmu-a chun ajah-a, hatninlang hangin; ajehchu nangma Pakaiyin apu apateu pehdinga anahahsel gama chu hiche mipite hitoh nalhona, nangman amahohi nalosah teiding ahi.
target: Then Moses summoned Joshua and said to him in the presence of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you must go with this people into the land that the Lord swore to their ancestors to give them, and you must divide it among them as their inheritance.

source: Chule namasanga chea amachu Pakai ahi, aman aumpi ding, aman nalosamsah louding, dajong nadalhah louding ahi.
target: The Lord himself goes before you and will be with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n hiche danhi asunin, Pakai kitepna thingkhong poleji Levi chapate thempuho le, Israel upaho jouse henga apen ahi.
target: So Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the Levitical priests, who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord , and to all the elders of Israel.

source: Chuin Mosi'n amaho thu apen, ajah uva, Kum sagi kichaiseh, kilhadohna kum le lhambuh kut laile,
target: Then Moses commanded them: “At the end of every seven years, in the year for canceling debts, during the Festival of Tabernacles,

source: Ama deilhen nading mun'a Israel chate jouse Pakai na Pathen anga kilah dinga ahung tengule, hiche danthu hi Israelte jouse masanga ajahdiuva nasimpoh ding ahi.
target: when all Israel comes to appear before the Lord your God at the place he will choose, you shall read this law before them in their hearing.

source: Amahon ajah uva, ahetnuva, Pakai na Pathen'u chu aginuva, hiche danthu-a um thu jouse hi anitna dingun, mijouse, numei ahin, pasal ahin, chapang ahin, nakotpi sunga um gamdang mi ahin khomkhom soh keijin:
target: Assemble the people—men, women and children, and the foreigners residing in your towns—so they can listen and learn to fear the Lord your God and follow carefully all the words of this law.

source: Chule imacha heloulai nachateo chun lodinga nachenao Jordan gal gamsunga chu nachen laiseuva Pakai na Pathen ginje ahettheina diuva ajahdiu ahi.
target: Their children, who do not know this law, must hear it and learn to fear the Lord your God as long as you live in the land you are crossing the Jordan to possess.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Ven, nathi nading nikho ahung naitai; mopohna kapehthei nadin Joshua chu kouvin lang houkhom na pon in sunga hung kilah lhonin ati. Chuin Mosi le Joshua ache lhonin, houkhom ho ponbuh sunga agakilah lhontai.
target: The Lord said to Moses, “Now the day of your death is near. Call Joshua and present yourselves at the tent of meeting, where I will commission him.” So Moses and Joshua came and presented themselves at the tent of meeting.

source: Chuin Pakai chu houbuh sunga meibang khomin ahungkilah-in: meibang khompi chu houbuh kotchung tah-a chun adingden tai.
target: Then the Lord appeared at the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the cloud stood over the entrance to the tent.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a, Vetan, nangma napu napate toh nalupkhom ding ahitan; hiche mipihohi kipat uva, aga umnadingu mite lah-a gamdang mite pathenho nung ajuijuva noti'a gapangdiu, chule keima eidalhah uva, amahotoh kanabol kitepna chu apalkehdiu ahi.
target: And the Lord said to Moses: “You are going to rest with your ancestors, and these people will soon prostitute themselves to the foreign gods of the land they are entering. They will forsake me and break the covenant I made with them.

source: Chuteng hiche nikho chule achunguva kalungsatna deujah ding, amaho kadalhah-a, amaho-a kona kamai kasel ding, amaho bahgama umdiu, thilse tamtah le hesohnahon alhun khumdiu; chutia chu hiche nikho chule, I-Pathen'u ilah uva aumloujeh-a thilse hohi ichunguva hunglhung hilouham? atidiu ahi.
target: And in that day I will become angry with them and forsake them; I will hide my face from them, and they will be destroyed. Many disasters and calamities will come on them, and in that day they will ask, ‘Have not these disasters come on us because our God is not with us?’

source: Pathen dangho lama akihei nalam uva thilse jouse ahin boldiu ho jeh-a chu, hiche nikho chule kamai kaseltei ding ahi.
target: And I will certainly hide my face in that day because of all their wickedness in turning to other gods.

source: Hijeh chun tun hiche la hi nangma dingin kisut in lang, Israel chate hilin; hiche la hi Israel chate chunga keima dinga hettohsahna dingin akam sunguva khumpeh-in.
target: “Now write down this song and teach it to the Israelites and have them sing it, so that it may be a witness for me against them.

source: Ajehchu apu apateu kahahselna, bongnoi le khoiju lona gama amaho kapuilut teng, amahon aneh uva, vaset uva, chule hungthao diu; chutengle pathen dangho lama kiheijuva, hiho chu ajendiu, keima eilunghan sah uva, kathupeh apalkehdiu ahi.
target: When I have brought them into the land flowing with milk and honey, the land I promised on oath to their ancestors, and when they eat their fill and thrive, they will turn to other gods and worship them, rejecting me and breaking my covenant.

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi, thilse tamtah le lungkhamna tamtah-in aphah tengule, achunguva hettohsah khat banga hiche la hin ahettohsah ding ahi; ajehchu achilhahteu kama kona hiche la hi suhmila umlou ding ahi: ajehchu tujeng jonghin kahahselna gama kapuilut masanga achele nadinguva alung ngaitohou chu kahen ahi.
target: And when many disasters and calamities come on them, this song will testify against them, because it will not be forgotten by their descendants. I know what they are disposed to do, even before I bring them into the land I promised them on oath.”

source: Hijeh chun Mosi'n hiche la hi hiche ni mama chun asunin, Israel chate chu ahiltai.
target: So Moses wrote down this song that day and taught it to the Israelites.

source: Chuin Aman Nun chapa Joshua chu mopohna apen, ajah-a, Hatninlang hangin, ajeh chu nangman Israel chate chu amaho kahahselna gama chu napuilut ding ahi; keiman nangma ka umpi ding nahi, ati.
target: The Lord gave this command to Joshua son of Nun: “Be strong and courageous, for you will bring the Israelites into the land I promised them on oath, and I myself will be with you.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Mosi'n hiche danthu hohi lekhabu khatna asutchaija, jo ahi phatnin,
target: After Moses finished writing in a book the words of this law from beginning to end,

source: Mosi'n Pakai kitepna thingkhong pu-a pang Levi ho chu thu apen, hitin aseije,
target: he gave this command to the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord :

source: Hiche danthu lekhabu hi laovinlang, nachung uva hettohsah dingin Pakai na Pathen'u kitepna thingkhong koma chun koijun.
target: “Take this Book of the Law and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God. There it will remain as a witness against you.

source: Ajehchu nakiphin hat danule nalouchal danu kahei: veuvin, tunikho-a nang hotoh kahin khomlai petna bon Pakai douna-a nakiphin uva ahile; kathinung teng ijat nabolbe tadiuvem?
target: For I know how rebellious and stiff-necked you are. If you have been rebellious against the Lord while I am still alive and with you, how much more will you rebel after I die!

source: Hiche thuho hi anakhang uva kaseija, ahetoh dinga vanle lei kakou theina dingin, naphung houva upaho le nalamkai hou jouse kahenga hinkhomun.
target: Assemble before me all the elders of your tribes and all your officials, so that I can speak these words in their hearing and call the heavens and the earth to testify against them.

source: Ajehchu kathi nungle nangho le nangho nasatah-a nakisuhset nuva, nangho kathupeh-u lampia kona nakihei mangdiu; chule ninunung lamle thilphalouvin nalhah khumdiu ahi; ajehchu nakhut soh-u thilbola kona suh lunghangna dinga Pakai mitmu-a thilphalou nabol dingu ahi ti kahei, ati.
target: For I know that after my death you are sure to become utterly corrupt and to turn from the way I have commanded you. In days to come, disaster will fall on you because you will do evil in the sight of the Lord and arouse his anger by what your hands have made.”

source: Chuin Mosi'n Israel houkhom ho jouse nakhanga chun hiche lacheng hi akichai kahsen asei pehtan ahi.
target: And Moses recited the words of this song from beginning to end in the hearing of the whole assembly of Israel:

source: Vo vanho, nana hinsungun, keiman thu seijinge; chule vo leiset, kakama thupot ho ngaijin.
target: Listen, you heavens, and I will speak; hear, you earth, the words of my mouth.

source: Kathuhil hi gotwi bangin juntin, kathusei daitwi bangin chimintin, hamnel chunga gophin bangle, hampa chunga gohongju banginte.
target: Let my teaching fall like rain and my words descend like dew, like showers on new grass, like abundant rain on tender plants.

source: Ajehchu Pakai min kaphongdoh ahi: Nanghon Pathen loupina seichoi leuvin.
target: I will proclaim the name of the Lord . Oh, praise the greatness of our God!

source: Ama songpi ahin, anatoh ho achamkime; ajehchu alamlhah jouse thudih ahi: khansetna beihel le thutah Pathen, chondih le chonpha chu ama ahi.
target: He is the Rock, his works are perfect, and all his ways are just. A faithful God who does no wrong, upright and just is he.

source: Ama hole amaho akisuboh-un, amonao chu achate mona ahipoi: amaho khanglamvai le lungput janglou khang ahiuve.
target: They are corrupt and not his children; to their shame they are a warped and crooked generation.

source: Vo mingol le mitanangte, chutia chu Pakai nalethuh diuham? Ama nachodoh pao napao hilouham? Ama nasem paole natungdoh pao hilouham?
target: Is this the way you repay the Lord , you foolish and unwise people? Is he not your Father, your Creator, who made you and formed you?

source: Gollui lai geldoh inlang, khang tamtah-a kumho chu ngaito temin; napa dongle chun navetsah ding ahin, na upate dongle chun naseipeh taovinte.
target: Remember the days of old; consider the generations long past. Ask your father and he will tell you, your elders, and they will explain to you.

source: Hatchung nungin namho agoulo diu ahoppeh lai, aman Adam chapate asekhen laichun, Israel chate ajatnu dungjuijin mipite gamgi chu anasepeh-e.
target: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when he divided all mankind, he set up boundaries for the peoples according to the number of the sons of Israel.

source: Ajehchu Pakai chanvou chu amite ahin, Jacob hi agouchan ahi.
target: For the Lord ’s portion is his people, Jacob his allotted inheritance.

source: Aman amachu neldi gam, agohkeo gamthip ginghou hou lah-a amu ahi; Aman ahinpuidoh-a, ahila, ama mitchang banga avettup ahi.
target: In a desert land he found him, in a barren and howling waste. He shielded him and cared for him; he guarded him as the apple of his eye,

source: Mulaopi in abuh aphetlhah-a, anou chunga akijapma, alha ajahkhuma, amat ji-a, alha chunga apoh banga;
target: like an eagle that stirs up its nest and hovers over its young, that spreads its wings to catch them and carries them aloft.

source: Chutia chu Pakai bouvin ama apuile-a, gamdang pathen toh umkhom lou ahi.
target: The Lord alone led him; no foreign god was with him.

source: Louvin asepdoh ga aneh theina dingin leiset mun sangho chunga atousah-in; songpi-a konin khoiju achepdoh sah-in, meituh songa konin thaotwi aputdoh sah-in;
target: He made him ride on the heights of the land and fed him with the fruit of the fields. He nourished him with honey from the rock, and with oil from the flinty crag,

source: Bongnoiha le kelngoi noi, kelngoinou thaotah, chule Bashan kelngoi chalho, le kelho, suhlou chang phapen tah; chule lengpitwi thisan thengtah ju in nadonin ahi.
target: with curds and milk from herd and flock and with fattened lambs and goats, with choice rams of Bashan and the finest kernels of wheat. You drank the foaming blood of the grape.

source: Ahin Jeshurun athao behsettan, akeng apeh pehtai; nathaovin, nasalha jengin, thaovin natome; chuin asempa Pathen adalhan, alhatdamna songpi chu totnopnan aneitai.
target: Jeshurun grew fat and kicked; filled with food, they became heavy and sleek. They abandoned the God who made them and rejected the Rock their Savior.

source: Amahon namchom pathenho jeh-in athangthip sah-un; thet umtah ho-a konin alunghan sah-un ahi.
target: They made him jealous with their foreign gods and angered him with their detestable idols.

source: Amahon Pathen kom hilouvin thilha ho, ahetkhah louvu pathenho, napu napateu vin anagin louva athah beh-a hungpot pathen thah ho henga ganlhai abolun ahi.
target: They sacrificed to false gods, which are not God— gods they had not known, gods that recently appeared, gods your ancestors did not fear.

source: Nahinga Songpi chu iman nagelpon, nahin semdoh-a Pathen chu nasumil tai.
target: You deserted the Rock, who fathered you; you forgot the God who gave you birth.

source: Pakaiyin hichu amuphatnin, Achapate le achanuteu suhlunghan sahna jeh chun amaho chu akidahtai.
target: The Lord saw this and rejected them because he was angered by his sons and daughters.

source: Chuin aman, amahoa kona kamai kaselding, akichainao ipi soh mongam kavet ding ahi: Ajehchu amaho khang lamvai mite ahiuvin, tahsanna umlou chate ahiuve.
target: “I will hide my face from them,” he said, “and see what their end will be; for they are a perverse generation, children who are unfaithful.

source: Amahon Pathen hilouho-a eithangthip sah-un; apannabei houva eichou lunghangun; kenjong nam hilouho-a kona athangthip nadiuva kachouthou uva, nam ngoltah-a kona kachou lunghang dingu ahi.
target: They made me jealous by what is no god and angered me with their worthless idols. I will make them envious by those who are not a people; I will make them angry by a nation that has no understanding.

source: Ajehchu kalunghana-a mei akongdoh-in, thikholkhul geija akahlhah ding, hichun leiset le asunng keh jouse akah lhah-a, molsang bulho jouse meijin akahding ahi.
target: For a fire will be kindled by my wrath, one that burns down to the realm of the dead below. It will devour the earth and its harvests and set afire the foundations of the mountains.
