source: Achunguva setna kaset thopma, achunguva kathal chang ho kamanchah ding ahi.
target: “I will heap calamities on them and spend my arrows against them.

source: Amaho gilkelin akah uva, meika nasatah le suhgamna nasatah-in aval lhum diu ahi: leivui lah-a kitol gulgu toh kilhona achunguva gamsaho ha hemtah kasolpeh ding ahi
target: I will send wasting famine against them, consuming pestilence and deadly plague; I will send against them the fangs of wild beasts, the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.

source: Polama chemjamin, sunglama tijatna-in, gollhang le nungah theng, noicheplai le samkangsa jong asuhmang ding ahi.
target: In the street the sword will make them childless; in their homes terror will reign. The young men and young women will perish, the infants and those with gray hair.

source: Aning ninga kathecheh-a, mihem lah-a kona hetjinga aumnao kichaina kabolding ahi, kati;
target: I said I would scatter them and erase their name from human memory,

source: Akidoupi houvin agelkhel uva, Kakhutnu hi choisangin aumin, hiche ho jouse hi Pakaiyin abol ahipoi, tia aseiuva melma lunghanna chu kaginlou hile.
target: but I dreaded the taunt of the enemy, lest the adversary misunderstand and say, ‘Our hand has triumphed; the Lord has not done all this.’ ”

source: Ajehchu amaho thumopbei nam ahiuvin, chule amaho-a hetkhena himhim aumpon ahi.
target: They are a nation without sense, there is no discernment in them.

source: O, hichehi ahetkhen na dinguva ching hitaveleu, khonunga akichaina dingu angaito dingu hija!
target: If only they were wise and would understand this and discern what their end will be!

source: A songpiuvin amaho akijohdoh-a, Pakaiyin amaho akhakhum ahilou ngale; mikhatnin sangkhat iti adela, minin sangsom iti adeljam ding ham?
target: How could one man chase a thousand, or two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, unless the Lord had given them up?

source: Ajehchu amaho songpi chu eiho Songpi tobang ahipon, imelmateu amaho le amaho jengjong thutan ho ahiuve.
target: For their rock is not like our Rock, as even our enemies concede.

source: Ajehchu alengpi guiju chu Sodom lengpigui le Gomorrah loujaova kon ahi: alengpi ga houchu gilkha lengpiga ahin, aga bohho chu akhan ahi.
target: Their vine comes from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are filled with poison, and their clusters with bitterness.

source: Alengpitwi houchu dragon gu le gulgu phaloutah ahi.
target: Their wine is the venom of serpents, the deadly poison of cobras.

source: Hichehi kakoma kikhol hilou hija, kagou ho lah-a kikha khum hilou ham?
target: “Have I not kept this in reserve and sealed it in my vaults?

source: Phulahna le lethuhna chu keima-a ahin; aphat tahle akengto-u kithol ding ahi: ajehchu amanthah nao nikho anaitan, achunguva hunglhung ding thilho chu gangtah-a hunglhung ding ahi.
target: It is mine to avenge; I will repay. In due time their foot will slip; their day of disaster is near and their doom rushes upon them.”

source: Ajehchu athahatnao abeisoh-a, akikhu khumle akidalha abeihel tengule; Pakaiyin amite thu tan intin, asohte-a dinga alung aheiding ahi.
target: The Lord will vindicate his people and relent concerning his servants when he sees their strength is gone and no one is left, slave or free.

source: Chule aman hitia aseiding ahi, A-pathenhou, atahsanu angapnao asongpiu chu hoiba hitam?
target: He will say: “Now where are their gods, the rock they took refuge in,

source: Aganlhainao sathao ne-a, adon thilto lengpitwi donho chu? amaho chu hung thoudoh uhenlang nakithopiu hen, chule nahongbit nun pangu hen.
target: the gods who ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up to help you! Let them give you shelter!

source: Tun veuvin, kei, keimamong monghi Ama chu kahi, Keima toh pathen hikhom adang aumpoi: Keiman kathatjin, chule kahinsah jin; Keiman kamavojin, chule kadamsah kitjin ahi: kakhutna kona huhdoh jouding koimacha aumpoi.
target: “See now that I myself am he! There is no god besides me. I put to death and I bring to life, I have wounded and I will heal, and no one can deliver out of my hand.

source: Ajehchu Keiman van lama kakhut kadom sangin, tonsotna kahing jinge katin ahi.
target: I lift my hand to heaven and solemnly swear: As surely as I live forever,

source: Kachemjam duljeju chu kanola, kakhutnin thutanna atuh-a ahile; kamelmate chunga phu kalah ding, eihot bolte kalethuh ding ahi.
target: when I sharpen my flashing sword and my hand grasps it in judgment, I will take vengeance on my adversaries and repay those who hate me.

source: Akithatho le sohchangho thisan le, melmate lamkaiho luchanga kon, Ka thalchang ho thisan kadonkham sah-a, kachemjamin saphe avalhum ding ahi.
target: I will make my arrows drunk with blood, while my sword devours flesh: the blood of the slain and the captives, the heads of the enemy leaders.”

source: Vo namtinho, hiche amitetoh hin kipah-un: ajehchu aman asohte thisan phu alah-a, akidoupi ho chunga phu alah ding, chule agam le amite chunga hepina anei ding ahi, ati.
target: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants; he will take vengeance on his enemies and make atonement for his land and people.

source: Chuin Mosi amatah chu Nun chapa Hoshea toh ahungin, hiche la thu jouse chu mipi ho nabenga aseijin ahi.
target: Moses came with Joshua son of Nun and spoke all the words of this song in the hearing of the people.

source: Chuin Mosi'n hiche thuho jouse hi Israel pumpi jah-a asei aseichaijin,
target: When Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel,

source: Chuin amaho jah-a, Tunia nalah uva kaphondoh thu jouse-a hin nalungu koijun lang, hiche danthu jouse hi chingthei tah-a ajuidiuva nachateo nathupeh dingu ahi.
target: he said to them, “Take to heart all the words I have solemnly declared to you this day, so that you may command your children to obey carefully all the words of this law.

source: Hichehi nangho-a dinga mohthil ahipoi; ajehchu hiche hi nahinkhou ahi: chule hicheho jala hi lodinga Jordan nagalkai nao gama chu nahinkhou sotding ahi.
target: They are not just idle words for you—they are your life. By them you will live long in the land you are crossing the Jordan to possess.”

source: Chuin hiche nikho mama chun Pakaiyin Mosi jah-a aseijin, hitin ati,
target: On that same day the Lord told Moses,

source: Jericho toh kigalsai, Moab gama um Abarim molsanga um Nebo molsanga khun kaltouvin lang; Israel chaten alo dinguva kapeh Canaan gamchu gaven:
target: “Go up into the Abarim Range to Mount Nebo in Moab, across from Jericho, and view Canaan, the land I am giving the Israelites as their own possession.

source: Nasopipa Aaron Hor molsanga athia amitetoh akigop bangin, nakaltouna lama chun hungthiden ninlang namite toh kigomtan.
target: There on the mountain that you have climbed you will die and be gathered to your people, just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people.

source: Ajehchu Zin gamthip, Kadesh mun Meribah twiphunga Israel chate lah-a keima douna in nachonkhela; Israel chate lah-a neijabol loujeh ahi.
target: This is because both of you broke faith with me in the presence of the Israelites at the waters of Meribah Kadesh in the Desert of Zin and because you did not uphold my holiness among the Israelites.

source: Hijeng jongle agam chu namasangtah-a nagamu ding, amavang Israel chate kapeh gamsunga vang chu nalut louding ahi, ati.
target: Therefore, you will see the land only from a distance; you will not enter the land I am giving to the people of Israel.”

source: Chule hichehi Pathen mipa Mosi'n athi masanga Israel chate phatthei abohna, phattheina chu ahi.
target: This is the blessing that Moses the man of God pronounced on the Israelites before his death.

source: Chuin aman, Sinai'a konin Pakai ahungin, Seir'a konin ahenguva dingin akipatdoh-e; aman Paran molsanga konin asalvah-in, mitheng sangsom to ahunge: akhutjet lama konin amahodin danthu khaotah apotne.
target: He said: “The Lord came from Sinai and dawned over them from Seir; he shone forth from Mount Paran. He came with myriads of holy ones from the south, from his mountain slopes.

source: Ahi, aman mipi angailun, amithengte jouse nakhutna aumui: chule amaho nakengbulla atouvun, mitinin nathu akisandiu ahi.
target: Surely it is you who love the people; all the holy ones are in your hand. At your feet they all bow down, and from you receive instruction,

source: Jacob mipite agoudiuva apeh danthu chu Mosi'n einapeuve.
target: the law that Moses gave us, the possession of the assembly of Jacob.

source: Mipi lamkaiho le Israel phungho akikhop khom phatnun, ama Jeshurun'a aleng changin ahi.
target: He was king over Jeshurun when the leaders of the people assembled, along with the tribes of Israel.

source: Reuben hingjing henlang thihih hen; chule amite jong lhomcha hihih hen.
target: “Let Reuben live and not die, nor his people be few.”

source: Hichehi Judah phatthei kibohna ahi, chuin aman, Pakai, Judah aw hi ngaijin lang, amite henga puijin; amadin akhut teni hi bulhingset henlang, amelmate-a kona kithopi-a chu nangma hin, ati.
target: And this he said about Judah: “Hear, Lord , the cry of Judah; bring him to his people. With his own hands he defends his cause. Oh, be his help against his foes!”

source: Levi thudolla aman, Massah mun'a naphotchet pa, Meribah twiphunga nakibaopi pa, na mithengpa henga na Thummim le na Urim chu umhen.
target: About Levi he said: “Your Thummim and Urim belong to your faithful servant. You tested him at Massah; you contended with him at the waters of Meribah.

source: Aman anu le apa henga, Keiman ama kanamupon, aman asopite jong ahekhenpon, chule achate tahjong ahepoi: ajehchu amahon nathu amangun, nakitepna anitnun ahi.
target: He said of his father and mother, ‘I have no regard for them.’ He did not recognize his brothers or acknowledge his own children, but he watched over your word and guarded your covenant.

source: Amahon nathutanna chu Jacob ahiluva, chule na danthu chu Israel ahil dingu; namasanga gimnamtui akoijuva, na maicham chunga pumgo ganlhai aboldiu ahi.
target: He teaches your precepts to Jacob and your law to Israel. He offers incense before you and whole burnt offerings on your altar.

source: Pakai, anei agouhou phatthei boh-inlang, akhutna anatohhou sanpeh-in; ama mudaho le ama douna-a hung kipan hochu akipat doh kit louna diuvin akongu jeppeh-in, ati.
target: Bless all his skills, Lord , and be pleased with the work of his hands. Strike down those who rise against him, his foes till they rise no more.”

source: Benjamin thudolla aman, Pakai ngailutna chu akoma bitkeija chengding; chule Pakaiyin nilhum keija akhu-a, alengkou teni kikah-a chengding ahi, ati.
target: About Benjamin he said: “Let the beloved of the Lord rest secure in him, for he shields him all day long, and the one the Lord loves rests between his shoulders.”

source: Chule Joseph thudolla aman, Agam chu van thilluho-in, daitwi ho-in, leinoi thuhtah-a umho-in Pakai phattheiboh changhen,
target: About Joseph he said: “May the Lord bless his land with the precious dew from heaven above and with the deep waters that lie below;

source: Chule nisan asodoh ga thillu ho le lhathah-a asodoh thil luho-in,
target: with the best the sun brings forth and the finest the moon can yield;

source: Chule tonlai molsangho thilgun holeh kemlou lhang ho-a thil manlu ho,
target: with the choicest gifts of the ancient mountains and the fruitfulness of the everlasting hills;

source: Chule leiset le athil manlu holeh, asung dima umho-in; chule hamboh lah-a chengpa lungdeijin: Joseph lamkaipa luchang le asopite-a kona kikhendohpa luchanga phattheibohna hunglhung hen.
target: with the best gifts of the earth and its fullness and the favor of him who dwelt in the burning bush. Let all these rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the prince among his brothers.

source: Aloupina chu abongchal sohmasa pen abangin, akiho chu gambong ki ho abange: hicheho-a chu aman mite chu kolmong geija anokhom ding; chule amaho chu Ephraim mi sangsom le Manasseh mi asang sang chu ahiuve.
target: In majesty he is like a firstborn bull; his horns are the horns of a wild ox. With them he will gore the nations, even those at the ends of the earth. Such are the ten thousands of Ephraim; such are the thousands of Manasseh.”

source: Chule Zebulun thudolla aman, Zebulun nangma napotdoh na-a kipah inlang, chule Issachar nangma naponbuh sunga kipah-in.
target: About Zebulun he said: “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out, and you, Issachar, in your tents.

source: Amahon miho chu molsang lama akoudiu, hia chu chonphatna ganlhai atodiu ahi. Ajehchu amahon twikhanglen ninglhina le, nellah-a kiselgu gou ho chu achopdiu ahi, ati.
target: They will summon peoples to the mountain and there offer the sacrifices of the righteous; they will feast on the abundance of the seas, on the treasures hidden in the sand.”

source: Chule Gad thudolla aman, Gad kehlena chu nunnom hen: ama keipi bahkai bangin achengin, banjang le lu-a lallukhuh chu amaltelin ahi.
target: About Gad he said: “Blessed is he who enlarges Gad’s domain! Gad lives there like a lion, tearing at arm or head.

source: Chule chua danthu pepa chanvou mun'a chu ama atou jeh-in, ahop masapen ama akichantan: chule mipi lamkaiho chutoh ama ahungin, aman Pakai dihna le Israelte chunga athutanna atongdoh-in ahi, ati.
target: He chose the best land for himself; the leader’s portion was kept for him. When the heads of the people assembled, he carried out the Lord ’s righteous will, and his judgments concerning Israel.”

source: Chule Dan thudolla aman, Danhi keipi bahkai nou ahin, Beshan'a kona hungchom doh ding ahi, ati.
target: About Dan he said: “Dan is a lion’s cub, springing out of Bashan.”

source: Chule Naphtali thudolla aman, Vo Naphtali, lungdeija lunglhaile Pakai phatthei boh-a dim, lhumlamle lhanglam gam lotan, ati.
target: About Naphtali he said: “Naphtali is abounding with the favor of the Lord and is full of his blessing; he will inherit southward to the lake.”

source: Chule Asher thudolla aman, Asher hi chilhah in phatthei changhen lang, asopite henga lahthei dol hihen, chule akeng thaotwija dehen.
target: About Asher he said: “Most blessed of sons is Asher; let him be favored by his brothers, and let him bathe his feet in oil.

source: Nakengchot thih le sum-eng hiding, nahinlai nikhoho banga nahatna jong umding ahi.
target: The bolts of your gates will be iron and bronze, and your strength will equal your days.

source: Nangma napanpi dinga vanlaijola touva, chule aloupina-a meibol chunga um Jeshurun Pathen tobang khatcha aumpoi.
target: “There is no one like the God of Jeshurun, who rides across the heavens to help you and on the clouds in his majesty.

source: Tonsot Pathen chu nakiselna ahin, chule noilama atonsot bannang aumin ahi: Aman namasanga kona melmate adelmang ding, amaho chu sumangin atiding ahi.
target: The eternal God is your refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He will drive out your enemies before you, saying, ‘Destroy them!’

source: Chutengle Israel changseh bitkeija chengding, Jacob twinah chu changle lengpithei gama umding; chule avanin jong daitwi alhahsah ding ahi.
target: So Israel will live in safety; Jacob will dwell secure in a land of grain and new wine, where the heavens drop dew.

source: Vo Israel, anunom nahi: nangma tobang koi umam, Vo napanpi nao lumdal le na loupina chemjam, Pakai huhhing mite! Namelmate nahenga ajounao kimuntin, nangman amun sanghou nachotpha ding ahi.
target: Blessed are you, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the Lord ? He is your shield and helper and your glorious sword. Your enemies will cower before you, and you will tread on their heights.”

source: Chule Mosi Moab phaicham konin Nebo molsang, Pisgah vuma akaldoh-in, hichu Jericho jontah ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin Gilead gam jouse chu Dan geijin avetsah-in,
target: Then Moses climbed Mount Nebo from the plains of Moab to the top of Pisgah, across from Jericho. There the Lord showed him the whole land—from Gilead to Dan,

source: Chule Naphtali gam jouse, Ephraim gam, Manasseh le Judah gam pumpi, twikhanglen mong geijin,
target: all of Naphtali, the territory of Ephraim and Manasseh, all the land of Judah as far as the Mediterranean Sea,

source: Chule lhanglama Jericho phaicham, tumthing kena khopi Zoar geijin avetsahtan ahi.
target: the Negev and the whole region from the Valley of Jericho, the City of Palms, as far as Zoar.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin ajah-a, Nachilhah te kapeh ding ahi tia Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob henga kana kihahselna gamchu hichehi ahi: keiman hichehi namitnin ka musahtan, amun vang nalhun louding ahi, ati.
target: Then the Lord said to him, “This is the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob when I said, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’ I have let you see it with your eyes, but you will not cross over into it.”

source: Chuti chun Pakai thu dungjuijin, Pakai soh Mosi chu Moab gama chun athiden tai.
target: And Moses the servant of the Lord died there in Moab, as the Lord had said.

source: Chuin Aman Moab gamsunga phaicham khat Beth-peor jona chun avuijin, ahinla tuni geihin alhan chu koimachan ahepoi.
target: He buried him in Moab, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, but to this day no one knows where his grave is.

source: Chule Mosi athichun kum jakhat le kum somni ahitan; amit athimpon, athahat jong alha dehpoi.
target: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died, yet his eyes were not weak nor his strength gone.

source: Chuin Moab phaichama chun Israel chaten Mosi chu nisomthum akauvin; chuti chun Mosi dinga kana le lunghemna chu akichaitai.
target: The Israelites grieved for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the time of weeping and mourning was over.

source: Chuin Nun chapa Joshua chu Mosi'n achunga akhut angap jeh-in, chihna lhagao adimset tan: Israel chaten athu angaijun, Pakaiyin Mosi thu apehbangin abolun ahi.
target: Now Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him. So the Israelites listened to him and did what the Lord had commanded Moses.

source: Chule chucheng nunga pat chun Pakaiyin kimaito tah-a anahet Mosi tobang Israel sunga themgao khatcha asohdoh kit tapon,
target: Since then, no prophet has risen in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,

source: Egypt gamsunga Pharaoh heng le asohte jouse heng, chule agamsung pumpi-a, melchihna ho le thil kidangho jouse chu boldinga Pakaiyin anasol,
target: who did all those signs and wonders the Lord sent him to do in Egypt—to Pharaoh and to all his officials and to his whole land.

source: Chule Israel jouse mitmu tah-a Mosi'n anavetsah chuche khut thahat tah jouse-a le chuche tijat umtah jouse boldoh-a khatcha asohdoh kit tapon ahi.
target: For no one has ever shown the mighty power or performed the awesome deeds that Moses did in the sight of all Israel.

source: Pakai soh Mosi athijouvin ahitin ahi, Mosi lhacha Nun chapa Joshua henga Pakaiyin hitin ati.
target: After the death of Moses the servant of the Lord , the Lord said to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ aide:

source: Kasoh Mosi athitan, hijeh chun tun kipat in, nangmale hiche mipi jouse, amaho Israel chate dinga kapeh gam jondingin hiche Jordan hi galkaijun lang cheovin.
target: “Moses my servant is dead. Now then, you and all these people, get ready to cross the Jordan River into the land I am about to give to them—to the Israelites.

source: Mosi henga kana seibangin, nakengton achotphana chanchu nang kapeh nahitai.
target: I will give you every place where you set your foot, as I promised Moses.

source: Gamthiple hiche Lebanon apat Euphrates vadunglen, Hit mite gamjouse chuleh nilhum lama twikhanglen gei nangma gamsung hiding ahi.
target: Your territory will extend from the desert to Lebanon, and from the great river, the Euphrates—all the Hittite country—to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.

source: Nahinlai sungse-a koimacha namasanga ding joulou ding, Mosi kana umpi banga nangma jong kaumpi ding nahin, nangma nadalha pongting, nujong nanuse ponge.
target: No one will be able to stand against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you.

source: Hatninlang hangsanin, ajehchu apateu pehdinga kana kihahsel gam chu alodiuva hiche mitehohi nahoppeh ding ahi.
target: Be strong and courageous, because you will lead these people to inherit the land I swore to their ancestors to give them.

source: Kasoh Mosi juidinga kapeh dan jouse nabola nachintup theina dingin, nangma hatpou pouvin lang hangtah-in umin. Nachena channa naphattheina dingin, chua kon chun jet le veija kihei mang loujenin.
target: “Be strong and very courageous. Be careful to obey all the law my servant Moses gave you; do not turn from it to the right or to the left, that you may be successful wherever you go.

source: Hiche danthupeh buhi nakamtoh kikhenkah hih hen, amavang asunga kisunho dungjuija nabola nachintup theina dingin sunle jan-in lunggiltah-in ngaiton. Chutile nalampi lamjangpeh a nalolhinsah ding ahi.
target: Keep this Book of the Law always on your lips; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. Then you will be prosperous and successful.

source: Keiman nangma kanathupeh hilouham? hatninlang hangin, kicha hih-in, lungjong lungthoi hih-in. Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'in nachena chana naumpi jinge.
target: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.”

source: Chuin Joshua chun mipi vaipoho jouse chu thu apen aseije,
target: So Joshua ordered the officers of the people:

source: Gebuh lailunga cheovinlang mipi jah-a nehlechah kigot tupmun, ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'in lodinga napeh-u gamchu che-a galodinga, nithum sunga hiche Jordan hi nagalkai dingu ahi, tin mipi thu gapeuvin, ati.
target: “Go through the camp and tell the people, ‘Get your provisions ready. Three days from now you will cross the Jordan here to go in and take possession of the land the Lord your God is giving you for your own.’ ”

source: Chule Reuben mite, Gad mite chule Manasseh phung akehkhat ho henga Joshua'n hitin aseijin,
target: But to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said,

source: Pakai na Pathen'un nakicholdo sah un, chule hiche gamhi napetaove, tia Pakai lhacha Mosi'n nangho henga napeh-u thuchu geldoh un.
target: “Remember the command that Moses the servant of the Lord gave you after he said, ‘The Lord your God will give you rest by giving you this land.’

source: Na-inneipiteu, nachasenhou chule nagancha hou Mosi'n napehnao Jordan gal hilama umden hen. Ahinla manchah choi miho galhangho jouse, masanga anacheuva, amaho na kithopi diu,
target: Your wives, your children and your livestock may stay in the land that Moses gave you east of the Jordan, but all your fighting men, ready for battle, must cross over ahead of your fellow Israelites. You are to help them

source: nangho napeh banga Pakaiyin nasopi hou akicholdosah masangse-a, chule Pakai na Pathen'in amaho apeh-u gamchu alo masangseuva naki thopi diu ahi. Chujoule Jordan solama umna gam nalo diuva Pakai soh Mosi'n napeh-u gama chu nakile uva nalodiu ahi.
target: until the Lord gives them rest, as he has done for you, and until they too have taken possession of the land the Lord your God is giving them. After that, you may go back and occupy your own land, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you east of the Jordan toward the sunrise.”

source: Chuin amahon neithupeh jouseu chu bolungting neisolnao channa cheovinge tin Joshua adonbutnun ahi.
target: Then they answered Joshua, “Whatever you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.

source: Imajousea Mosi thu kanangai bangun nangma thujong lunglut tah-in ngai uvinge, Pakai Pathen'in Mosi aumpi bangin nangma jong naumpi teihen atiuve.
target: Just as we fully obeyed Moses, so we will obey you. Only may the Lord your God be with you as he was with Moses.

source: Nathupeh douva chule nathupeh ngailou koi hijongle kithat ding ahi, hang pou pouvin lang hattah-in umin, atiuve.
target: Whoever rebels against your word and does not obey it, whatever you may command them, will be put to death. Only be strong and courageous!”

source: Nun chapa Joshua'n Shittim'a konin mini guhthimin gam velhi dingin asollin, chelhon inlang gamchu adeh-in Jericho gave lhonin tin aseipeh-in ahi. Chule amani amin Rahab kiti notinu in'a chun ahunglhonin, ageh lhontai.
target: Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim. “Go, look over the land,” he said, “especially Jericho.” So they went and entered the house of a prostitute named Rahab and stayed there.

source: Chule veuvin, tujanhin gam velhi dingin Israel chilhah ho hikoma ahunguve, tin Jericho khopi lengpa chu thu ahilun ahi.
target: The king of Jericho was told, “Look, some of the Israelites have come here tonight to spy out the land.”

source: Hichun Jericho lengpan nahenga na-inna hunglut miteni chu hinpui doh-in; ajehchu amani gamjouse velhi dinga hunglhon ahi ti seidingin Rahab henga mi asolle.
target: So the king of Jericho sent this message to Rahab: “Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house, because they have come to spy out the whole land.”

source: Chuin numeinu chun miteni apuidoh-in, asellin, henge kahenga mini ahunge, ahinla hoija hungkon ahilhon vang kahepoi, tin aseije.
target: But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them. She said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I did not know where they had come from.

source: Chule ahitin ahi, kotpi khachah phat don, khothim phatnin, miteni chu achedoh lhontan, hoija achelhon kahepoi. Mangang tah-in amani chu nungdelun, ajehchu phapaovin nate ati.
target: At dusk, when it was time to close the city gate, they left. I don’t know which way they went. Go after them quickly. You may catch up with them.”

source: Ahinla amanun, amani chu in chunga apuitouvin, akisetoh changpol lah-a chun aseltai.
target: (But she had taken them up to the roof and hidden them under the stalks of flax she had laid out on the roof.)

source: Chuin mihochun miteni chu Jordan kaimun lampi geipeh chun anungdellun, chule anungdelho chu apotphatnun kul kotkhah chu akhah taovin ahi.
target: So the men set out in pursuit of the spies on the road that leads to the fords of the Jordan, and as soon as the pursuers had gone out, the gate was shut.

source: Chuin amani ahung kumlhon masangin in chunga amanu akaldoh-in,
target: Before the spies lay down for the night, she went up on the roof

source: chule amanun Pakaiyin hiche gam napeh-u ahitai, nangho gin nahi kachunguva achun, chule nangho jeh-a hiche gama chengho jouse kihotlhugam dingu ahitai ti kahei, tin miteni chu aseipehtai.
target: and said to them, “I know that the Lord has given you this land and that a great fear of you has fallen on us, so that all who live in this country are melting in fear because of you.

source: Ajehchu Egypt'a kona nahungpot doh uva Pakaiyin twipisan chu nangho dinga iti akansah-a, chule nanghon nathagamhelu Jordan gal langkhatna um Amor leng teni Sihon le Og chunga ipi nabolu chu kanajaove.
target: We have heard how the Lord dried up the water of the Red Sea for you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to Sihon and Og, the two kings of the Amorites east of the Jordan, whom you completely destroyed.

source: Chule hichehi kajahjah-un kalungu ajunlha tai, nangho jeh-in koimacha chunga hanna himhim aumtapoi. Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'u chu chunga leh noija Pathen ahi.
target: When we heard of it, our hearts melted in fear and everyone’s courage failed because of you, for the Lord your God is God in heaven above and on the earth below.

source: Hijeh chun tun kangeh nahi lhone, Pakai minin kahenga kihahsel lhonin, keiman nangni lungsetna kamusah tah jeh-in, Nangnin jong kapa insung chunga lungsetna neimusah lhoninlang, melchihna dihtah neipe lhonnin.
target: “Now then, please swear to me by the Lord that you will show kindness to my family, because I have shown kindness to you. Give me a sure sign

source: Chuti chun, kanule kapa, kasopi numei ho le pasal ho, chule aneijouseu neihinghoi peh-un lang, kahinkhouhi thina-a konin neihuhdoh peh-un, ati.
target: that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them—and that you will save us from death.”

source: Chuin miteni chun amanu jah-a, kathilbol lhonhi naseidohlouva ahile nanghodin kahinna tohlhoninge. Chule hung hitiding ahi, Pakaiyin hiche gamhi eipeh tengule lungsetna neitahle dihtah-in nangma nabollunge tin adonbut lhone.
target: “Our lives for your lives!” the men assured her. “If you don’t tell what we are doing, we will treat you kindly and faithfully when the Lord gives us the land.”

source: Chujouvin amanun amani chu bangkotna konin khaovin akhailhatai. Ajehchu amanu in chu khopi kulchunga kisa ahin, chule ama kul chunga chu chenga ahi.
target: So she let them down by a rope through the window, for the house she lived in was part of the city wall.

source: Chuin amanun, amani jah-a, mol langa lampia khun chelhonin, nanungdel hon mugetnun nate. Chule nanungdel ho akilekit kahseovin nithum sung gakisel lhonin, chule chujou tengle chethei lhontan nate.
target: She said to them, “Go to the hills so the pursuers will not find you. Hide yourselves there three days until they return, and then go on your way.”

source: Hichun miteni chun amanu jah-a, neiki hahsel sah nalhon kitepna achun mona neilhon hih inge.
target: Now the men had said to her, “This oath you made us swear will not be binding on us

source: Vetan, keiho hiche gam kahunglut tengule, hiche neikhai lhah nalhon bangkotna hi patkhao santhip nakhiding, chule nanule napa nasopi pasal ho, chule napa insungmite jouse na-inna anapuikhomin,
target: unless, when we enter the land, you have tied this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you have brought your father and mother, your brothers and all your family into your house.

source: chule hitiding ahi. Koi hijongle na-inna kona kholaija potdoh aumleh mona thisan chu aman akipoh ding, keiho themmo hilouding ahi. Chule koihile na-inna naumpi chunga khutlha aumle athisan chu kaluchunguva chuhen,
target: If any of them go outside your house into the street, their blood will be on their own heads; we will not be responsible. As for those who are in the house with you, their blood will be on our head if a hand is laid on them.

source: chule kathilbol lhonhi naseidoh a ahile, neiki hahsel sah lhon kitepna-a kona chu mo kachan lhon louding ahi atilhone.
target: But if you tell what we are doing, we will be released from the oath you made us swear.”

source: Chuin amanun nasei bang banglhon chu hitahen, ati. Chuin amanun amani chu asolmangin apotdoh lhontai. Chuin amanun pat santhip chu bangkotna akhaitan, ahi.
target: “Agreed,” she replied. “Let it be as you say.” So she sent them away, and they departed. And she tied the scarlet cord in the window.

source: Chuin amani mollama chun achelhonin, anungdelho akinungle kahseovin chua chun nithum agaum lhone. Chuin anungdelho ahung kinungle uvin lamjousea aholun amutapouve.
target: When they left, they went into the hills and stayed there three days, until the pursuers had searched all along the road and returned without finding them.

source: Hichun miteni chu molla konin ahung kumsuh lhonin, agalkai lhonin akilekit lhontai. Chuin Nun chapa Joshua henga ahunglhonin, achung lhona thilsoh jouse chu ahenga aseipeh lhontai.
target: Then the two men started back. They went down out of the hills, forded the river and came to Joshua son of Nun and told him everything that had happened to them.

source: Chuin amanin tahbeh-in Pakaiyin gamjousehi ikhutnuva eipehdoh-u ahitai. Ajeh chu agama cheng jouse chu eihojeh-in akihot lhugam taove tin Joshua henga aseipeh lhone.
target: They said to Joshua, “The Lord has surely given the whole land into our hands; all the people are melting in fear because of us.”

source: Chuin Joshua jingpitah in athouvin, chule Shittim'a konin akipat doh-un, Jordan lui ahunglhung taove. Amale Israel chate jouse agalkai masangun chua chun ageh taove.
target: Early in the morning Joshua and all the Israelites set out from Shittim and went to the Jordan, where they camped before crossing over.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi. Nithum jouvin lamkaiho chu gebuh lah-a chun acheuvin;
target: After three days the officers went throughout the camp,

source: Chule amahon mipi ho chu Pakai na Pathen thulhun thingkhong chu Levi thempuhon aput namu phat tengule naum naova konin kichon unlang chuche nungchu najuidingu ahi, tin thu apeuve.
target: giving orders to the people: “When you see the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, and the Levitical priests carrying it, you are to move out from your positions and follow it.

source: Ahinla nanghole hiche kikah chu tong sangni tobanga nakigamlat diu, nachenadiu lampi nahet theina dingun, nai hihhelun. Ajehchu tumasangin hiche lampia hin nanache khapouve.
target: Then you will know which way to go, since you have never been this way before. But keep a distance of about two thousand cubits between you and the ark; do not go near it.”

source: Chule Joshua'n mipi jah-a, nangho kisuthengun ajehchu Pakaiyin jingleh nalah uva thilkidang abolding ahi, ati.
target: Joshua told the people, “Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do amazing things among you.”

source: Chuin Joshua'n thempuho jah-a, thulhun thingkhong chu puvinlang mipi masanga chun cheovin, ati. Chuin amahon thulhun thingkhong chu apuvin mipi masanga chun achetauve.
target: Joshua said to the priests, “Take up the ark of the covenant and pass on ahead of the people.” So they took it up and went ahead of them.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a, keiman Mosi kana umpi bang banga nangma jong kaumpi ding nahi, ti amahon ahetheina dingun tunia hi Israel pumpi mitmu-a kachoi sang panding nahi, ati.
target: And the Lord said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to exalt you in the eyes of all Israel, so they may know that I am with you as I was with Moses.

source: Chule nangman thulhun thingkhong pu-a pang thempuho jah-a, Jordan vapam chin nagei phat nule Jordan'a nadindendiu ahi, tin thu pen, ati.
target: Tell the priests who carry the ark of the covenant: ‘When you reach the edge of the Jordan’s waters, go and stand in the river.’ ”

source: Hitichun Joshua'n Israel chate jah-a, hilama hungun lang Pakai na Pathen'u thuhi ngaijun, ati.
target: Joshua said to the Israelites, “Come here and listen to the words of the Lord your God.

source: Chule Joshua'n hia konahi hingjing Pathen nalah uva aume ti nahet dingu ahi. Chule aman Kanaan mihole Hit miho, Hiv miho Perizz miho, chule Girgash mihole Amor miho chule Jebus miho thonlou hela namasanguva adeldoh ding ahi, ati.
target: This is how you will know that the living God is among you and that he will certainly drive out before you the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites and Jebusites.

source: Veovin, leiset pumpi Pakai thulhun thingkhong chu namasanguva Jordan lui galkai ding ahi.
target: See, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth will go into the Jordan ahead of you.

source: Hijeh chun tun phung khatna mikhatcheh Israel phungho-a konin somleni lhengdoh-un.
target: Now then, choose twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one from each tribe.

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi. Pakai leiset pumpi Pakai thulhun thingkhong pu-a thempuho kengin achot chot nuleh Jordan twipi chu kiting tanding sahlama kona hunglong twipia kona chu kikhendoh ding, chule hichu aloma kiting dending ahi.
target: And as soon as the priests who carry the ark of the Lord —the Lord of all the earth—set foot in the Jordan, its waters flowing downstream will be cut off and stand up in a heap.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, mipihole mipi masanga thulhun thingkhong pu-a thempuho Jordan galkai nadinga aponbuh uva kona akipatdoh phatnun,
target: So when the people broke camp to cross the Jordan, the priests carrying the ark of the covenant went ahead of them.

source: Chule thingkhong puho Jordan lui aga lhunuva, thingkhong pu thempuho keng chun twi agahchot lutnule, (ajehchu chang atlai sungsele Jordan luihi longletji ahi).
target: Now the Jordan is at flood stage all during harvest. Yet as soon as the priests who carried the ark reached the Jordan and their feet touched the water’s edge,

source: Sahlama kona hunglong suh twi chu akiting denin, Zarethan koma um Adam khopi geijin gamlatah-in akidilin ahi. Chule phaicham gamlatah twipi lamsanga chi twipi lama longsuh laichu atantan, hitichun mipi ho chu Jericho khopi dontah-a chun agalkai taove.
target: the water from upstream stopped flowing. It piled up in a heap a great distance away, at a town called Adam in the vicinity of Zarethan, while the water flowing down to the Sea of the Arabah (that is, the Dead Sea) was completely cut off. So the people crossed over opposite Jericho.

source: Pakai thulhun thingkhong pu-a thempuho chu Jordan lui mipi ho chu agalkaisoh kahseovin, Jordan lailunga tolgoa chun ading detnun, chule Israelte jouse chu tolgoa agalkai taovin ahi.
target: The priests who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord stopped in the middle of the Jordan and stood on dry ground, while all Israel passed by until the whole nation had completed the crossing on dry ground.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi. Mipi jouse Jordan agalkai sohkei phatnun, Pakaiyin Joshua henga,
target: When the whole nation had finished crossing the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua,

source: Phung khatna konin Pasal khat cheh, mipi lah-a pasal somleni lhengdoh-in,
target: “Choose twelve men from among the people, one from each tribe,

source: Chule ajah uva, thempuho dettah a adinnau mun Jordan lailunga konchun song somleni laovin. Chule hicheho chu pogalkai junlang tujana nagenadiu munachun koijun, tin thu pen, tin aseipeh-in ahi.
target: and tell them to take up twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, from right where the priests are standing, and carry them over with you and put them down at the place where you stay tonight.”

source: Chuin Joshua'n Israel chate lah-a phung khatna kon mikhat cheh analhendoh mi somleni chu akouvin,
target: So Joshua called together the twelve men he had appointed from the Israelites, one from each tribe,

source: Chule Joshua'n ajah uva, Jordan lailung Pakai na Pathen'u thulhun thingkhong masanga chun gacheuvin lang Israel chate phungjat dungjuijin nangho mikhatnin, song khat cheh nalenguva hinpuvin, ati.
target: and said to them, “Go over before the ark of the Lord your God into the middle of the Jordan. Each of you is to take up a stone on his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the Israelites,

source: Hiti achu hichehi nalah uva melchihna hunghia, khonung tengle, nachateovin apateu henga hiche songhohi ipi kihetna ham? tia nadoh tengule
target: to serve as a sign among you. In the future, when your children ask you, ‘What do these stones mean?’

source: Nanghon Pakai thulhun thingkhong masanga Jordan lui alonglai adinjeh ahi. Jordan agalkai laijun Jordan twi chu akangtanin, chujeh-in hiche songhohi Israel chate dinga a-itih a dinga hetjingna hiding ahi, tia amahochu nadonbut diu, ahi ati.
target: tell them that the flow of the Jordan was cut off before the ark of the covenant of the Lord . When it crossed the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off. These stones are to be a memorial to the people of Israel forever.”

source: Chule Israel chaten Joshua thupeh bangin abollun, Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a anasei bangin, Israelte phungjat dungjuijin alauvin, agenao mun geijin apogal kaijun, chuachun akoitauvin ahi.
target: So the Israelites did as Joshua commanded them. They took twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, according to the number of the tribes of the Israelites, as the Lord had told Joshua; and they carried them over with them to their camp, where they put them down.

source: Chule Joshua'n thulhun thingkhong pu-a thempuho dinna Jordan lailunga chun song somleni aphutnin, hihochu tunichanin aumjinge.
target: Joshua set up the twelve stones that had been in the middle of the Jordan at the spot where the priests who carried the ark of the covenant had stood. And they are there to this day.

source: Ajehchu tulhun thingkhong pu-a thempuho chu Mosi'n Joshua henga thu anapeh jouse dungjuijin mipi henga seipehdin Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a thu anapeh chu akichai kahsen Jordan lailunga chun adingdenun ahi. Chuin mipi chu kinotah-in agalkai taovin ahi.
target: Now the priests who carried the ark remained standing in the middle of the Jordan until everything the Lord had commanded Joshua was done by the people, just as Moses had directed Joshua. The people hurried over,

source: Chule ahitin ahi, mipi ho chu agalkai sohkei phatnun Pakai thulhun thingkhong le thempuho chu mipi mitmun agalkai taove.
target: and as soon as all of them had crossed, the ark of the Lord and the priests came to the other side while the people watched.

source: Chule Reuben chate, Gad chate chule Manasseh phung kehkhat gal manchah pumin, Mosi'n ahenguva aseipeh bangin Israel chate masanga anagalkaijun ahi.
target: The men of Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over, ready for battle, in front of the Israelites, as Moses had directed them.

source: Galvona kivonjousadem mi sangsomli tobang gal satdingin Jericho phaicham ho-a Pakai masanga akitolun, ahi.
target: About forty thousand armed for battle crossed over before the Lord to the plains of Jericho for war.

source: Hicheni chun Pakaiyin Israel pumpi mitmu-a chun Joshua achoisangin ahi. Chuin amahon Mosi agin bangun amachu ahinlai sungsen agingun ahi.
target: That day the Lord exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they stood in awe of him all the days of his life, just as they had stood in awe of Moses.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Joshua henga aseijin,
target: Then the Lord said to Joshua,

source: Hettohsahna thingkhong pu-a thempuho chu Jordan'a kona ahungdoh nadiuvin thu pen, ati.
target: “Command the priests carrying the ark of the covenant law to come up out of the Jordan.”

source: Hijeh chun Joshua'n Jordan'a konin hungdoh taovin, tin thempuho thu apetan ahi.
target: So Joshua commanded the priests, “Come up out of the Jordan.”

source: Chule ahitin ahi, Pakai thulhun thingkhong pu-a thempuho chu Jordan lailunga kona ahungdoh uva, chule tolgo akaidoh phatnun angai bang bangin Jordan luichu alongkittan, vadung pangho chu aletkittan, ahi.
target: And the priests came up out of the river carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord . No sooner had they set their feet on the dry ground than the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and ran at flood stage as before.

source: Chuin mipi chu lha masapen nisom channin Jordan luija konin ahungdoh un, Jericho gam solamsang Gilgal'a chun gebuh asong taovin ahi.
target: On the tenth day of the first month the people went up from the Jordan and camped at Gilgal on the eastern border of Jericho.

source: Chule song somleni Jordan luija kona alahdoh uchu Gilgal'a chun Joshua'n aphuttan ahi.
target: And Joshua set up at Gilgal the twelve stones they had taken out of the Jordan.

source: Chule aman Israel chate jah-a, khonung tengle nachateovin apateu henga, hiche songhohi ipi kihetna ham? tia nadoh tenguleh,
target: He said to the Israelites, “In the future when your descendants ask their parents, ‘What do these stones mean?’

source: Nanghon nachateo henga, Israel chu hiche Jordan'a hin tolgon anagalkaijun ahi, ti nahetsah dingu ahi.
target: tell them, ‘Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground.’

source: Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'un twipisan kagalkai kahseuva kamasanguva agotsah bangchun, Pakai na Pathen'un Jordan twi chu nagalkai kahseovin akansah-in, ahi.
target: For the Lord your God dried up the Jordan before you until you had crossed over. The Lord your God did to the Jordan what he had done to the Red Sea when he dried it up before us until we had crossed over.

source: Hiti achu leiset mite jousen Pakai khut chu hattah ahi, ti ahetheijuva, nanghon Pakai na Pathen'u chu a-imatih chana nagin theina dingu ahi tin aseipeh-in ahi.
target: He did this so that all the peoples of the earth might know that the hand of the Lord is powerful and so that you might always fear the Lord your God.”

source: Chuleh ahitin ahi, Jordan gal lhumlam sanga um Amor mite leng jouse le, twipi panga um Kanaan mite leng jousen Israel chate masanga Jordan agalkaisoh kahseovin Pakaiyin Jordan luichu akansah-e, ti ajah phatnun alungu ajunlha gamtan, Israel chate jehchun amaho-ah hanna lung him him aumtapoi.
target: Now when all the Amorite kings west of the Jordan and all the Canaanite kings along the coast heard how the Lord had dried up the Jordan before the Israelites until they had crossed over, their hearts melted in fear and they no longer had the courage to face the Israelites.

source: Hichepet chun Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a, chemcha hem hinsem munlang, Israel chate chu aniveina-a din achepmu tanpeh kitnin, ati.
target: At that time the Lord said to Joshua, “Make flint knives and circumcise the Israelites again.”

source: Chuin Joshua chun chemcha hem asemin, Israel chate chu achepmu atanpehtan ahi.
target: So Joshua made flint knives and circumcised the Israelites at Gibeath Haaraloth.

source: Chule Joshua'n chep atanna ajehchu hichehi ahi. Egypt'a kona ahungdoh nungun mipi jouse galmiho jengjong, Egypt'a kona ahungdoh jouvun, gamthip lampia athigam taovin, ahi.
target: Now this is why he did so: All those who came out of Egypt—all the men of military age—died in the wilderness on the way after leaving Egypt.

source: Egypt'a kona hungpotdoh jouse chu cheptansa ahiuvin ahi. Ahinla ahungdoh nunguva gamthipma lamkah-a pengho jouse chu chep tanlou ahiuve.
target: All the people that came out had been circumcised, but all the people born in the wilderness during the journey from Egypt had not.

source: Egypt'a kona hungdoh Israel chate galmi jousen Pakai aw lunglut tah-a angailou jeh-un, suhmanga aumkah seovin gamthipma kum somli athammun, Pakaiyin apateu pehdinga anatepsa khoijule bongnoi lonna gam chu amaho musahlou dingin ana kihahselin, ahi.
target: The Israelites had moved about in the wilderness forty years until all the men who were of military age when they left Egypt had died, since they had not obeyed the Lord . For the Lord had sworn to them that they would not see the land he had solemnly promised their ancestors to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.

source: Hijeh chun akheluva atundoh achateu chu Joshua'n achepmu atanpehtan ahi. Ajehchu amaho lamdunga chep ana tanpeh loujeh-un, chep tanlou anahiuve.
target: So he raised up their sons in their place, and these were the ones Joshua circumcised. They were still uncircumcised because they had not been circumcised on the way.

source: Chule ahitin ahi, mipi jouse chep akitanjou phatnin, adam kahseovin aumnao gebuh a chun aumun ahi.
target: And after the whole nation had been circumcised, they remained where they were in camp until they were healed.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a, tunia nangho-a kona Egypt te i-sah louna chu katolmang ahitai, ati. Hijeh chun tuni geihin hiche munchu Gilgal akisahtan ahi.
target: Then the Lord said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.” So the place has been called Gilgal to this day.

source: Chuin Israel chaten Gilgal'a chun gebuh akisonun, hiche lha nisomlenili channi nilhah lamin Jericho phaicham ho-a chun kalchuh kut anit taove.
target: On the evening of the fourteenth day of the month, while camped at Gilgal on the plains of Jericho, the Israelites celebrated the Passover.

source: Chule kalchuh kut jou ajing nikhotah chun amahon hiche gama mimle chang leija kona cholsolou changlhah chule changkanpoh chucheni mama chun anetaovin, ahi.
target: The day after the Passover, that very day, they ate some of the produce of the land: unleavened bread and roasted grain.

source: Chule chuche gam changvui anehjouvu ajing chun Mana chu akichaitan, Israel chaten Mana chu nejong anetapouve. Ahinla amahon hiche kum-a pat chun Kanaan gam gachu anetaovin, ahi.
target: The manna stopped the day after they ate this food from the land; there was no longer any manna for the Israelites, but that year they ate the produce of Canaan.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Joshua Jericho naija aumpet chun akhodah-in aven ahile, veuvin, amasanga mikhat achemjam sadohsan akhutna achoijin adingin ahi. Chuin Joshua'n akom anaijin ajah-a, keiho lama pang nahim, ahiloule kamelmate lama panga nahim? ati.
target: Now when Joshua was near Jericho, he looked up and saw a man standing in front of him with a drawn sword in his hand. Joshua went up to him and asked, “Are you for us or for our enemies?”

source: Chuin aman ahipoi, Pakai janel lamkaija hungjoh kahi ati. Chuin Joshua tolla aboh khupmin ahouvin, ajah-a, Pakaiyin nasoh henga ipi seinom naneijem? atin ahi.
target: “Neither,” he replied, “but as commander of the army of the Lord I have now come.” Then Joshua fell facedown to the ground in reverence, and asked him, “What message does my Lord have for his servant?”

source: Chuin Pakai janel gallamkai chun Joshua jah-a, nakengchot sutlhan, ajehchu nadinna mun chu muntheng ahi, ati. Chuin Joshua'n chuti chun aboltan, ahi.
target: The commander of the Lord ’s army replied, “Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy.” And Joshua did so.

source: Tun Jericho chu Israel chate jehchun akikhahchahtan, koimacha alutle apotle aumtapoi.
target: Now the gates of Jericho were securely barred because of the Israelites. No one went out and no one came in.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a, vetan, Jericho le alengpau chule mihat mihangsan tamtah hohi nakhutna kapeh ahitai.
target: Then the Lord said to Joshua, “See, I have delivered Jericho into your hands, along with its king and its fighting men.

source: Chule nangho galmi jousen khopihi naum uva, hitia chu khatvei navelsoh diu ahi. Chule chutobangma chu nigup sunga naboldingu ahi.
target: March around the city once with all the armed men. Do this for six days.

source: Chule thempu sagin kelngoichal ki-a kisem sumkon sagi kitepna thulhun thingkhong masanga achoijuva, chule anisagi ni-a chu khopi chu vel sagivei navelsoh dingu, chuteng thempuhon sumkon ho chu amutdiu ahi.
target: Have seven priests carry trumpets of rams’ horns in front of the ark. On the seventh day, march around the city seven times, with the priests blowing the trumpets.

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi. Amahon kelngoichal ki-a kisem sumkon chu amut huilhung jenjunu gin najah tenguleh mipi chun ha-aova na-aodiu, chutahle khopi kulchu chimlhading ahi. Chule mipi chu ama ama majon cheh a jangjela kaltou dingu ahi, ati.
target: When you hear them sound a long blast on the trumpets, have the whole army give a loud shout; then the wall of the city will collapse and the army will go up, everyone straight in.”

source: Chuin Nun chapa Joshua'n thempuho chu akouvin, ajah uvah, thulhun thingkhong hi jong unlang, thempu sagin Pakai kitepna thingkhong masang lama chun kelngoichal ki-a kisem sumkon sagi choijuhen ati.
target: So Joshua son of Nun called the priests and said to them, “Take up the ark of the covenant of the Lord and have seven priests carry trumpets in front of it.”

source: Chuin aman mipi jah-a, chepeh unlang khopi chu velkolun lang, chule galvona kivonta pouchu Pakai kitepna thingkhong masanga chun cheohen, ati.
target: And he ordered the army, “Advance! March around the city, with an armed guard going ahead of the ark of the Lord .”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi. Joshua'n mipi henga thu aseijou phatnin, kelngoichal ki-a kisem sumkon sagi choija thempuho chun Pakai masanga achoiju sumkon ho chu amut taovin, chule Pakai thulhun thingkhong chun anungu ajuitan ahi.
target: When Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests carrying the seven trumpets before the Lord went forward, blowing their trumpets, and the ark of the Lord ’s covenant followed them.

source: Chule galvon kivon hochu sumkon ho mut thempuho masanga chun acheuvin, chule anungthop ho chu thulhun thingkhong nunga ahungun, thempuho chun ache pumu chun sumkon ho chu amutnun ahi.
target: The armed guard marched ahead of the priests who blew the trumpets, and the rear guard followed the ark. All this time the trumpets were sounding.

source: Chuin Joshua'n na aona dinguva thu kapeh ding nikho alhin tokahse-a, na ao-loudingu, chule nahusat loudingu ahi. Chule thujong nasei loudingu, thu kapeh tenglebou na aodiu ahi, tin mipi chu thu apetan, ahi.
target: But Joshua had commanded the army, “Do not give a war cry, do not raise your voices, do not say a word until the day I tell you to shout. Then shout!”

source: Chutichun Pakai thulhun thingkhong chu khopi chu khatvei avelsah un, chule gebuh a ahung kilekitnun, agehjiuve.
target: So he had the ark of the Lord carried around the city, circling it once. Then the army returned to camp and spent the night there.

source: Chule Joshua jingpitah-in athouvin, thempuho chun Pakai thulhun thingkhong chu apuve.
target: Joshua got up early the next morning and the priests took up the ark of the Lord .

source: Chuin Pakai thingkhong masanga kelngoichal ki-a kisem sumkon ho choija thempu sagiho chu tanglouvin acheuvin ahi. Chule galvona kivonho chu amasanguva acheuve. Ahinla anungthop ho chu Pakai thulhun thingkhong nunga ahungun, thempuho chun chepumin sumkon ho amut jingun ahi.
target: The seven priests carrying the seven trumpets went forward, marching before the ark of the Lord and blowing the trumpets. The armed men went ahead of them and the rear guard followed the ark of the Lord , while the trumpets kept sounding.

source: Chuin anini channin khopi chu velkhat avellun gebuh a ahungkile uvin ahi. Chutichun nigup abolluve.
target: So on the second day they marched around the city once and returned to the camp. They did this for six days.

source: Chuin anisagi channin ahitin ahi, khovah then thenin athouvun, abol ngaima bangun khopi chu vel sagi avelun ahi. Hichenia bou chu khopi chu vel sagivei avelu ahi.
target: On the seventh day, they got up at daybreak and marched around the city seven times in the same manner, except that on that day they circled the city seven times.

source: Chuin avel sagi chana-in ahitin ahi, thempuhon sumkon ho amut phatnun Joshua'n mipi jah-a hatah-in aovun ajehchu Pakaiyin khopihi nangho napeh-u ahitai atin, ahi.
target: The seventh time around, when the priests sounded the trumpet blast, Joshua commanded the army, “Shout! For the Lord has given you the city!

source: Chule khopile asunga umjouse ngeichu sapsetna dinga Pakaiya kipedoh ahitai. Rahab noti le a-insunga aumpi chengse bouchu sohcha ding ahi. Ajehchu amanun imisolte niu anaselin ahi.
target: The city and all that is in it are to be devoted to the Lord . Only Rahab the prostitute and all who are with her in her house shall be spared, because she hid the spies we sent.

source: Chule sapset thilho-a konin kikang seuvin. Achutiloule sapset thilho chu lakhaovin natin, sapset changkhaovin nate. Chule Israel gebuh a jong sapsetna lhungintin, boina umgetninte.
target: But keep away from the devoted things, so that you will not bring about your own destruction by taking any of them. Otherwise you will make the camp of Israel liable to destruction and bring trouble on it.

source: Ahinla sana dangka, thihle sum-eng bel jouse Pakai dinga kisuthenga ahi. Hicheho chu Pakai goukhol na-a kikoiding ahi, ati.
target: All the silver and gold and the articles of bronze and iron are sacred to the Lord and must go into his treasury.”

source: Chutichun thempuhon sumkon ho amutphatnun ahitin ahi. Mipin sumkon ho gin ajah phatnun ha aovin a-aovun ahileh, kulpi chu achimlhatan, chuphatnin mipi chu amaho doncheh a jangjelin alhai touvun khopi chu alataove.
target: When the trumpets sounded, the army shouted, and at the sound of the trumpet, when the men gave a loud shout, the wall collapsed; so everyone charged straight in, and they took the city.

source: Chuin amahon khopi sunga um numeile pasal nungah le gollhang abonin, ateh akhang chule bongchal le kelngoi, chule sangan abonchan chemjamin athat gamhel taovin ahi.
target: They devoted the city to the Lord and destroyed with the sword every living thing in it—men and women, young and old, cattle, sheep and donkeys.

source: Ahinla Joshua'n gamvelhi teni jah-a, notinu in'a chun lut lhonin lang amanule aneijouse chu ahenga nana kihahselna lhon bang chun gapuidoh lhonin, ati.
target: Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, “Go into the prostitute’s house and bring her out and all who belong to her, in accordance with your oath to her.”

source: Chuin gollhang gamvelhi teni chu ahunglhonin, Rahab, anule apa, asopiho chule aneijouse toh apuidoh lhontan, ahi. Chule amanin a inkote jouse apuidoh lhonin Israel gebuh pama adalha lhontan, ahi.
target: So the young men who had done the spying went in and brought out Rahab, her father and mother, her brothers and sisters and all who belonged to her. They brought out her entire family and put them in a place outside the camp of Israel.

source: Chuin amahon khopi chu asunga thil umjouse toh meijin ahalvamun, sana dangka, thihle sum-eng belho bouchu Pakai in'a gou kholna-a akoitaovin, ahi.
target: Then they burned the whole city and everything in it, but they put the silver and gold and the articles of bronze and iron into the treasury of the Lord ’s house.

source: Chuin Joshua'n Rahab notinu le aneijouse, chule apa insung ahuhhingin ahi. Chule amanu tuni geijin Israelte lah-a acheng nalaije. Ajehchu amanun Joshua'n Jericho gavelhi dinga asolteni chu ana selin, ahi.
target: But Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute, with her family and all who belonged to her, because she hid the men Joshua had sent as spies to Jericho—and she lives among the Israelites to this day.

source: Chuti chun Joshua'n amaho chu ahahselin, hitin aseije: hiche Jericho khopi hintungdoh kitna chu Pakai masanga sapset chenghen. Abul phutna chun achapa lenpen achan ding, chule akotpiho atundoh tengle achapa lhumpen achan ding ahi,
target: At that time Joshua pronounced this solemn oath: “Cursed before the Lord is the one who undertakes to rebuild this city, Jericho: “At the cost of his firstborn son he will lay its foundations; at the cost of his youngest he will set up its gates.”

source: Hitichun Pakaiyin Joshua aumpin, gam jouse-a amin chu akithangtan ahi.
target: So the Lord was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout the land.

source: Ahin Israel chaten sapsetna thil chungah asukhel taove. Ajehchu Judah phunga Zerah chapa Zabdi chapa Karmi chapa Achan'in sapsetna thilchu alan ahi. Chuin Israel chate chunga Pakai lunghana chu akoudoh jahtan ahi.
target: But the Israelites were unfaithful in regard to the devoted things; Achan son of Karmi, the son of Zimri, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of them. So the Lord ’s anger burned against Israel.

source: Chuin Joshua'n Jericho akonin Bethel solam Bethaven koma um Ai kho-a mi asolin, ajah uvah, chetou vunlang gamchu gaveovin tin aseijin ahi. Chuin miho chu acheuvin Ai khochu agave taove.
target: Now Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is near Beth Aven to the east of Bethel, and told them, “Go up and spy out the region.” So the men went up and spied out Ai.

source: Chuin amaho chu Joshua henga ahung kilekitnun, ajah-a, mijouse kontousah datan, ahinla sangni sangthum tou kontouvu henlang Ai khochu nokhumu hen, mijouse suhthachol datan, ajeh chu lhomcha bou ahiuve, atiuvin ahi.
target: When they returned to Joshua, they said, “Not all the army will have to go up against Ai. Send two or three thousand men to take it and do not weary the whole army, for only a few people live there.”

source: Hichun mipi ho lah-a mi sangthum tobang akontou taove. Ahin amaho Ai miho masanga ajamtaovin ahi.
target: So about three thousand went up; but they were routed by the men of Ai,

source: Chuin Ai miten amaho mi somthumlegup tobang athatnun ahi. Ajehchu kotpi-a kona Shebarim geipeh a ahindelsuh uva, ajamsuh nalam uva athao ahi. Hijeh chun miho lung chu alhoplhatan, twibang ahijengtai.
target: who killed about thirty-six of them. They chased the Israelites from the city gate as far as the stone quarries and struck them down on the slopes. At this the hearts of the people melted in fear and became like water.

source: Chuin Joshua'n avonho abottelin Pakai thulhun thingkhong masanga chun nilhah geijin aboh khupmin, tolla amai asulutnin, amale Israel upaho chun, aluchung uva leivui akinutaove.
target: Then Joshua tore his clothes and fell facedown to the ground before the ark of the Lord , remaining there till evening. The elders of Israel did the same, and sprinkled dust on their heads.

source: Chuin Joshua'n, vo Pakai Pathen, ipidinga hiche mipihohi Amor mite khutna napeh doh-a thagam dingbepma Jordan napui galkai mongham? Jordan gal langkhatna lungmonga kanaum hitaleh!
target: And Joshua said, “Alas, Sovereign Lord , why did you ever bring this people across the Jordan to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites to destroy us? If only we had been content to stay on the other side of the Jordan!

source: Vo Pakai, Israelte hi amelmate masanga kinungchon jing tale ipi seitang em?
target: Pardon your servant, Lord. What can I say, now that Israel has been routed by its enemies?

source: Ajehchu Kanaan mihole hiche gama cheng jousehin hichu jaovintin, eium kimvel untin kaminuhi leisetna kona asuhmang diu ahitai. Chutengle Namin loupitah hi inaloding hitam? ati.
target: The Canaanites and the other people of the country will hear about this and they will surround us and wipe out our name from the earth. What then will you do for your own great name?”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a, thoudoh-in, ipi dinga hiti achu nabohkhupma nalup ham? ati.
target: The Lord said to Joshua, “Stand up! What are you doing down on your face?

source: Israel achonvaltan, kathupeh kathulhun jong eisuhkeh peh-un, amahon sapsetna thil jengjong alauvin, aguvin, aselguvin, athilkeo lah uva aselun ahi.
target: Israel has sinned; they have violated my covenant, which I commanded them to keep. They have taken some of the devoted things; they have stolen, they have lied, they have put them with their own possessions.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu Israel chate amelmateu masanga ding joulouva galte masanga nungjam joh ahiuve. Ajehchu amaho chu sapset changa ahitaovin, nalah uva kona sapset thilchu nasuhmang lou uleh kaumpi louding nahitaove.
target: That is why the Israelites cannot stand against their enemies; they turn their backs and run because they have been made liable to destruction. I will not be with you anymore unless you destroy whatever among you is devoted to destruction.

source: Kipat in mipi ho sutheng inlang ajah uva, jing nikho-a dingin kisuthengun; ajehchu Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin ati, Israel nalah uva kona sapsetsa thilchu nasuhmang kahseuva namelma teu masanga nadin jouloudiu ahi, tin seipeh-in.
target: “Go, consecrate the people. Tell them, ‘Consecrate yourselves in preparation for tomorrow; for this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: There are devoted things among you, Israel. You cannot stand against your enemies until you remove them.

source: Hiche jehchun jingkah tengle naphungu dungjuija naki khopdiu, chule hitiding ahi. Pakaiyin alhendoh phung chu abom dungjuija hungdiu ahi. Chule Pakaiyin alhendoh bom chu a-insung dungjuija hungdiu, chule Pakaiyin alhendoh dungjuija amichangcheh hungdiu ahi.
target: “ ‘In the morning, present yourselves tribe by tribe. The tribe the Lord chooses shall come forward clan by clan; the clan the Lord chooses shall come forward family by family; and the family the Lord chooses shall come forward man by man.

source: Chule hitiding ahi, sapset thiltoh kimattha pen penchu amale aneijouse meija kigouvam ding ahi. Ajehchu aman Pakai thulhun asukhelin, Israel lah-a chonval tah-in thil abole, ati.
target: Whoever is caught with the devoted things shall be destroyed by fire, along with all that belongs to him. He has violated the covenant of the Lord and has done an outrageous thing in Israel!’ ”

source: Chuin Joshua jingpitah-in athouvin, Israelte chu aphung phungin ahinpuijin ahile Judah phungchu alheng dohtai.
target: Early the next morning Joshua had Israel come forward by tribes, and Judah was chosen.

source: Chuin aman Judah sunga abom bomin ahinpuijin, Zarhi bom chu alhengdoh-in ahi. Chuin Zarhi bom chu mikhat khatnin ahinpuijin ahile Zabdi chu alheng dohtan ahi.
target: The clans of Judah came forward, and the Zerahites were chosen. He had the clan of the Zerahites come forward by families, and Zimri was chosen.

source: Chuin a-inkouvin mikhat khatnin ahinpuijin ahile Judah phunga Zarah chapa Zabdi chapa Karmi chapa Achan chu amandohtan ahi.
target: Joshua had his family come forward man by man, and Achan son of Karmi, the son of Zimri, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was chosen.

source: Chuin Joshua'n Achan jah-a, kangeh nahi, kachapa Pakai Israel Pathen chu loupi chamkim jana penlang nachonsetna phongin, chule ipi nanabol tun imlouvin kakoma seijin, ati.
target: Then Joshua said to Achan, “My son, give glory to the Lord , the God of Israel, and honor him. Tell me what you have done; do not hide it from me.”

source: Chuin Achan'in Joshua chu adonbutnin, ajah-a, tahbeh mongin Pakai Israel Pathen dounan kana chonsetan, hitihin kanaboltai.
target: Achan replied, “It is true! I have sinned against the Lord , the God of Israel. This is what I have done:

source: Keiman thil kichomho lah-a chun Babylon von hoitah khatle dangka shekel jani, chule shekel somnga-a gih sana lhon khat kamun ahile, kavejou tahih-in, kakilahtan ahi. Chule vetan, hicheho chu kaponbuh lailung leinoi'a kaselin, dangka chu anoija aume, atin ahi.
target: When I saw in the plunder a beautiful robe from Babylonia, two hundred shekels of silver and a bar of gold weighing fifty shekels, I coveted them and took them. They are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath.”

source: Chuin Joshua'n mi asolin, amaho chu ponbuh lama alhaijun, chule vetan, hichu aponbuh sunga anaselin, dangka anoinunga anaume.
target: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent, and there it was, hidden in his tent, with the silver underneath.

source: Chuin amahon ponbuh a konin hicheho chu aladoh-un, Joshua le Israel chate jouse henga ahinchoijun Pakai angsunga akoitaove.
target: They took the things from the tent, brought them to Joshua and all the Israelites and spread them out before the Lord .

source: Chuin Joshua le aumpi Israel pumpin Zarah chapa Achan dangka, von, sana lhon, achapate le achanute, abongchalho, asanganho le akelngoiho, aponbuh chule aneijouse ahintolun Achor phaicham ahinlhut taove.
target: Then Joshua, together with all Israel, took Achan son of Zerah, the silver, the robe, the gold bar, his sons and daughters, his cattle, donkeys and sheep, his tent and all that he had, to the Valley of Achor.

source: Chuin Joshua'n ibola neisuh lunggimu ham? Pakaiyin tunia nangjong nasuh lunggim ding ahitai, ati. Chuin Israel mipin amale aumpi jousen songin asepmun, asejou phatnun meijin ahalvam taove.
target: Joshua said, “Why have you brought this trouble on us? The Lord will bring trouble on you today.” Then all Israel stoned him, and after they had stoned the rest, they burned them.

source: Chuin amahon achunga chun songlhuh lentah atungdoh-un, hichu tunigei hin aumjing nalaije. Hitichun alungset tijat umtah-a konin Pakai akileheitai. Hijeh chun hiche munchu tunigeijin Achor phaicham akisahtai.
target: Over Achan they heaped up a large pile of rocks, which remains to this day. Then the Lord turned from his fierce anger. Therefore that place has been called the Valley of Achor ever since.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a, kicha hih-in, lungjong lunglha hih-in, galmi jouse puijin kipat inlang Ai kho-a chetouvin, ven, Ai lengpa le amite chule akhopile agam nakhutna kapeh nahitai.
target: Then the Lord said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Take the whole army with you, and go up and attack Ai. For I have delivered into your hands the king of Ai, his people, his city and his land.

source: Chule Jericho le alengpa chunga nabol banga Ai le alengpa chunga jong nabolding ahi. Chule thilkichomhole ganchaho chu nangho ding ahin, khopi nunglama chu achanglhi nakoiding ahi, ati.
target: You shall do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king, except that you may carry off their plunder and livestock for yourselves. Set an ambush behind the city.”

source: Chutichun Joshua le galmiho jouse Ai satna chedin akipat doh-un ahi. Chuin Joshua'n mihat, mihang sangsomthum alhengdoh-in, jannin asoldohtan, ahi.
target: So Joshua and the whole army moved out to attack Ai. He chose thirty thousand of his best fighting men and sent them out at night

source: Chuin amaho chu thu apen, veuvin, khopi nunglama nachanlhih diu ahi. Khopi-a kona chegamla behseh louva, kigosa dema naum johdiu ahi.
target: with these orders: “Listen carefully. You are to set an ambush behind the city. Don’t go very far from it. All of you be on the alert.

source: Chule keimale kaumpi chengse chun khopi chu hinnai lutnung kating, chule hung hitiding ahi. Keiho doudinga ahungdoh tengule, amasa bangchun keiho amasanguvah jamung ting,
target: I and all those with me will advance on the city, and when the men come out against us, as they did before, we will flee from them.

source: (ajehchu amaho keiho nunga hungdoh ding,) amaho khopisunga kapuidoh kahseovin, ajehchu amahon amasa-a bangin, amaho amasanguvah ajamtaove atidiu ahin, hijeh-a chu amasanguva kajamdiu ahi.
target: They will pursue us until we have lured them away from the city, for they will say, ‘They are running away from us as they did before.’ So when we flee from them,

source: Chuteng nanghon nachanlhih naova kona nakipat doh uva, khopi chu nalahdiu ahi. Ajehchu Pakai Pathen'in nakhut uva apehding ahi.
target: you are to rise up from ambush and take the city. The Lord your God will give it into your hand.

source: Chule hitiding ahi, nanghon khopi chu nalah tengule nahal dingu ahi. Pakai thupeh dungjuija nabol dingu ahi. Veovin, thu kapeh nahiuve, ati.
target: When you have taken the city, set it on fire. Do what the Lord has commanded. See to it; you have my orders.”

source: Hichun Joshua chun amaho chu asoldoh-in, chule amaho changpang dingin acheuvin, Ai khole Bethel kikah Ai lhumlama chun aga umun, Joshua vang hiche janchun mipi lah-a agehtan, ahi.
target: Then Joshua sent them off, and they went to the place of ambush and lay in wait between Bethel and Ai, to the west of Ai—but Joshua spent that night with the people.

source: Chuin Joshua jingpitah-in athouvin, mihochu asimin, amale Israel upaho mipi masanga chun Ai kho jonin akitoltou taove.
target: Early the next morning Joshua mustered his army, and he and the leaders of Israel marched before them to Ai.

source: Chuin mipi jouse ahenga amatoh umkhom galmiho jouse chu chetouvun, chule ahin naijun khopi masanga ahunglhung uvin, Ai khopi sahlama chun ponbuh asonguve. Tun amahole Ai kikah-a chu phaicham khat umah ahi.
target: The entire force that was with him marched up and approached the city and arrived in front of it. They set up camp north of Ai, with the valley between them and the city.

source: Chuin aman mi sangnga tobang apuijin, khopi lhumlam sang Bethel le Ai kikah-a chun changlhi-a kisel dingin akoitan ahi.
target: Joshua had taken about five thousand men and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, to the west of the city.

source: Chuin amahon khopi sahlama um mipi janel, chule khopi lhumlama changpangho geija agontohsoh phatnin, hiche janchun Joshua phaicham lailunga achetan ahi.
target: So the soldiers took up their positions—with the main camp to the north of the city and the ambush to the west of it. That night Joshua went into the valley.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Ai lengpan hichu amuphat chun, kinotah-in ama athouvin, khopi miho, amale amite jouse chu phaichama chun Israelte satdingin ahung kondoh taove. Ahinla khopi nunglama asat ding achanglhi aume tichu ahepouvin, ahi.
target: When the king of Ai saw this, he and all the men of the city hurried out early in the morning to meet Israel in battle at a certain place overlooking the Arabah. But he did not know that an ambush had been set against him behind the city.

source: Chuin Joshua le Israel mijouse chu gallel bangin amaho masanga chun gamthip lama chun ajamtaove.
target: Joshua and all Israel let themselves be driven back before them, and they fled toward the wilderness.

source: Chuin Ai kho-a um mijouse chu amaho nungdel dingin akikoukhomun, Joshua nung adelun khopi-a konin akitolmang taove.
target: All the men of Ai were called to pursue them, and they pursued Joshua and were lured away from the city.

source: Chuin Ai khole Bethel kho-a chun Israelte nungdela chelou khatchabeh aumpouve. Chule khopi kot chu honsan adalhaovin Israelte chu adeltaove.
target: Not a man remained in Ai or Bethel who did not go after Israel. They left the city open and went in pursuit of Israel.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a, Ai kholam ngan nakhutna tengcha chu gah lhandoh-in, ajehchu hichu nakhutna kapeh ding ahi, ati. Chuin Joshua'n akhutna um tengcha chu khopi lam ngan alhang dohtan ahi.
target: Then the Lord said to Joshua, “Hold out toward Ai the javelin that is in your hand, for into your hand I will deliver the city.” So Joshua held out toward the city the javelin that was in his hand.

source: Chuin changpangho chu aumna mun uva konin akipatdoh loijun, akhut alhandoh doh chun alhaijun, khopi-a chun alutnun hichun alauvin gangtah-in ahallha taove.
target: As soon as he did this, the men in the ambush rose quickly from their position and rushed forward. They entered the city and captured it and quickly set it on fire.

source: Chuin Ai kho miho chu akiheijun anung lamu agah vetnule, veuvin, khopi meikhu van'a akitungdoh amuvin, hoilampena jamding ham ahetapouve. Chuin gamthip lama jam mipi ho chu ahung kilekitnun, anungdelhou chunga chun achutaove.
target: The men of Ai looked back and saw the smoke of the city rising up into the sky, but they had no chance to escape in any direction; the Israelites who had been fleeing toward the wilderness had turned back against their pursuers.

source: Chuin Joshua le Israel pumpi, achanglhi hon khopi alah-u chule khopi meikhu kitungdoh chu amuphatnun akiheijun Ai kho miho chu athatgam taove.
target: For when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city and that smoke was going up from it, they turned around and attacked the men of Ai.

source: Chuin adangho chu amaho satdin khopi-a konin ahung kitoldoh-un, hitichun amaho alang alanga Israelte lailung tah-a aumtaove. Chuin akihinghoile ajamdoh khatcha aumsah tapouve.
target: Those in the ambush also came out of the city against them, so that they were caught in the middle, with Israelites on both sides. Israel cut them down, leaving them neither survivors nor fugitives.

source: Chuin Ai khopi lengpa chu ahingin amanun, Joshua henga ahinkai taovin ahi.
target: But they took the king of Ai alive and brought him to Joshua.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Israel ten gamlah le anungdel nao gamthipma Ai kho mijouse chemjam'a akitha-a akisuh gamhel phatchun, Israelte jouse Ai kho-a akileuvin chemjamin asumang taovin ahi.
target: When Israel had finished killing all the men of Ai in the fields and in the wilderness where they had chased them, and when every one of them had been put to the sword, all the Israelites returned to Ai and killed those who were in it.

source: Chule hiche nikho-a Ai khopi-a thijouse chu anumei apasal'in sangsom le sangni ahiuve.
target: Twelve thousand men and women fell that day—all the people of Ai.

source: Joshua'n ateng alhandoh chu Ai kho-a miho athajou tokahseochun akhut alha lhapon ahi.
target: For Joshua did not draw back the hand that held out his javelin until he had destroyed all who lived in Ai.

source: Pakaiyin Joshua henga athupeh bangin hiche khopi-a ganchaho le thil kichomho bou chu Israel ten ama ama chanding dola akilah-u ahi.
target: But Israel did carry off for themselves the livestock and plunder of this city, as the Lord had instructed Joshua.

source: Chuin Joshua Ai kho chu ahalin, a-itih-a dingin alhuh-in asemin, tunichan hin ahomkeo ahijinge.
target: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a permanent heap of ruins, a desolate place to this day.

source: Chule Ai kho lengpa chu nilhah geijin thingleh-a akhaijin, chule nilhum ding konin Joshua'n thu apen, thilong chu thingleh-a konin alalhauvin khopi lamlen lutna bulla apaijun achunga song atungdoh-un tunichanhin aum nalaije.
target: He impaled the body of the king of Ai on a pole and left it there until evening. At sunset, Joshua ordered them to take the body from the pole and throw it down at the entrance of the city gate. And they raised a large pile of rocks over it, which remains to this day.

source: Chujouvin Joshua'n Ebal lhanga Israel Pakai Pathen dingin maicham asemin ahi.
target: Then Joshua built on Mount Ebal an altar to the Lord , the God of Israel,

source: Mosi dan lekhabua kisun bangin Pakai soh Mosi'n Israel chilhah ho thu anapeh bangchun, hiche maicham chu songa kisem ahin, koiman achunga thih alhahkhum loulaiju ahi. Hichea chun Pakai dingin govam thilto le chamna thiltoho atoh-in ahi.
target: as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded the Israelites. He built it according to what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses—an altar of uncut stones, on which no iron tool had been used. On it they offered to the Lord burnt offerings and sacrificed fellowship offerings.

source: Chuin aman hiche songa chun Mosi danho chu Israel chate mitmun asunin ahi.
target: There, in the presence of the Israelites, Joshua wrote on stones a copy of the law of Moses.

source: Chule Israelte jouse, a-upahou, thutan vaihomho, Levi te thempuho chu Pakai thingkhong jongho masanga, thulhun thingkhong sihtoa chun phung chomho le chuche gama pengho jouse jongchu ading khom sohkeijun, akehkhat Gerezim molpangah adingun, Pakai soh Mosi'n Israelte chu vang aboh tahdi ding ahi tia thu anapeh bangchun, akeh khat chu Ebal jonna aumun ahi.
target: All the Israelites, with their elders, officials and judges, were standing on both sides of the ark of the covenant of the Lord , facing the Levitical priests who carried it. Both the foreigners living among them and the native-born were there. Half of the people stood in front of Mount Gerizim and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of the Lord had formerly commanded when he gave instructions to bless the people of Israel.

source: Chule chujouchun danthua thujouse danthu bu-a kisun jouse dungjuijin vangbohna le sapsetna thuho chu asimdoh-in ahi.
target: Afterward, Joshua read all the words of the law—the blessings and the curses—just as it is written in the Book of the Law.

source: Mosi thupeh jouse chu Israelte houkhom ho jousele, numei ho le chapang neocha cha hole amaho lah-a chidang namdang chengho hetnin Joshua'n simlou khatchabeh aneipon ahi.
target: There was not a word of all that Moses had commanded that Joshua did not read to the whole assembly of Israel, including the women and children, and the foreigners who lived among them.
