source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Jordan hilamsang thinglhang, phaicham chule twipilen Lebanon geija cheng jouse Hit mi, Amor mi, Kanaan mi, Perizz mi, Hiv mi chule Jebus mi lengho jouse chun ajah phatnun,
target: Now when all the kings west of the Jordan heard about these things—the kings in the hill country, in the western foothills, and along the entire coast of the Mediterranean Sea as far as Lebanon (the kings of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites)—

source: Amaho Joshua le Israel satdingin lungkhat tah-in akikhom khomtaove.
target: they came together to wage war against Joshua and Israel.

source: Chuin Gibeon na chengho chun Joshua'n Jericho le Ai kho abolnaho chu ajah phatnun,
target: However, when the people of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,

source: Amahon doha abolun palaija kisol bangin acheuvin, asanganhou chunga khaodip pon luiho aphaovin, jupenglui asesaho le akikanchomho apouvin,
target: they resorted to a ruse: They went as a delegation whose donkeys were loaded with worn-out sacks and old wineskins, cracked and mended.

source: Chule kengchotlui abehbeh a pol akiseovin, vonlui akivonun, anehdiuva changlhah ahinkipoh hou jong agon, a-ap gamtan ahi.
target: They put worn and patched sandals on their feet and wore old clothes. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.

source: Chuin amaho Gilgal gebuh-a Joshua henga acheuvin, amale Israel mite henga, keiho kholgam latah-a kona hung kahiuvin, hijeh chun tun neikicham piuvin, atiuve.
target: Then they went to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal and said to him and the Israelites, “We have come from a distant country; make a treaty with us.”

source: Chuin Israel miten Hit mite jah-a, nangho kalah uva cheng hikhatnun nate. Achutile nang hotoh thulhunna iti kasem dinguham? atiuve.
target: The Israelites said to the Hivites, “But perhaps you live near us, so how can we make a treaty with you?”

source: Chuin amahon Joshua jah-a nasohte kahiuhi atiuve, chuin Joshua'n ajah uva, nangho koi nahiuva hoijakona hung nahiuvem? ati.
target: “We are your servants,” they said to Joshua. But Joshua asked, “Who are you and where do you come from?”

source: Chuin amahon ajah-a, Pakai na Pathen min jala nasohte hi kholgam latah a kona hunga kahiuve. Ajehchu keihon aminthangjele Egypt gama athilbol jouse kaja taove,
target: They answered: “Your servants have come from a very distant country because of the fame of the Lord your God. For we have heard reports of him: all that he did in Egypt,

source: chule Jordan galla um Amor mite lengni Heshbon lengpa Sihon le Ashtaroth na cheng Bashan lengpa Og chunga athilbol jouse phatah-in kajaovin, ahi.
target: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites east of the Jordan—Sihon king of Heshbon, and Og king of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth.

source: Hijeh chun ka-upahou le kagamsunga cheng mijousen kajah uvah, nanehdiu kipoh unlang, amaho kimupi dingin cheovin, chule alah uva keihohi nasohte kahiuve. Hijeh chun tun nanghon neikichampiuvin gatiuvin tin eihilun ahi, atiuve.
target: And our elders and all those living in our country said to us, ‘Take provisions for your journey; go and meet them and say to them, “We are your servants; make a treaty with us.” ’

source: Naheng uva hungdinga kakigot uva pat kanehdiuva kahinpoh-u hiche changlhah hohi sapeh-ah ahi. Ahinla tun veuvin, agopmin a-ap tai.
target: This bread of ours was warm when we packed it at home on the day we left to come to you. But now see how dry and moldy it is.

source: Chule ju kahin kikhum nao penghohi athahleh ahin, veuvin tun, asegamtai. Hiche kavon houleh ka kengchot-u jonghi lamsaotah kahinjot jeh uva luigama ahitai, atiuve.
target: And these wineskins that we filled were new, but see how cracked they are. And our clothes and sandals are worn out by the very long journey.”

source: Chuin mihochun Pakai chu dong louvin an anehkhompi taovin ahi.
target: The Israelites sampled their provisions but did not inquire of the Lord .

source: Chuin Joshua'n amahochu hinghoi dingin chamna asemin, akitep pitan ahi. Chule mipi kikhomho lamkaiho jong ahenguva akitep taovin, ahi.
target: Then Joshua made a treaty of peace with them to let them live, and the leaders of the assembly ratified it by oath.

source: Chuin amato akitep nungu nithum jouvin ahitin ahi. Amahochu alah uva chengah akhovelhou ahiuchu ahedoh taovin ahi.
target: Three days after they made the treaty with the Gibeonites, the Israelites heard that they were neighbors, living near them.

source: Chuin Israel chate akitolun, anithum chanin akhopihou alhung taovin ahi. Tun akhopihou chu Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth chule Kirjath-jearim ahi.
target: So the Israelites set out and on the third day came to their cities: Gibeon, Kephirah, Beeroth and Kiriath Jearim.

source: Chuin mipi kikhomho pipuiho Pakai Israel Pathen minna akihahsel tahjeh-un, Israel chaten amaho chu asumang tapouve. Chuin houkhom ho jouse chu pipuiho chunga chun aphuntaove.
target: But the Israelites did not attack them, because the leaders of the assembly had sworn an oath to them by the Lord , the God of Israel. The whole assembly grumbled against the leaders,

source: Ahinla pipuiho jousen houkhom hojouse henga, tonsot Pakai Pathen minna ahenguva kihahsela akihitai. Hijeh chun tun eihon amaho itohkhah theilou diu ahi.
target: but all the leaders answered, “We have given them our oath by the Lord , the God of Israel, and we cannot touch them now.

source: Eihon amaho chunga hitihin boluhite, eiho amaho chunga ina kihahsel taovin, amahohi ihinghoi teidiu ahi. Achutiloule ichunguva lunghana hunglhung getninte.
target: This is what we will do to them: We will let them live, so that God’s wrath will not fall on us for breaking the oath we swore to them.”

source: Chuin pipuiho chun amaho chu hinghoijun atiuvin, ahin pipuiho kitepna bangin mipi kikhomho dingin thingpo twikhaijin panguhen atiuve.
target: They continued, “Let them live, but let them be woodcutters and water carriers in the service of the whole assembly.” So the leaders’ promise to them was kept.

source: Chuin Joshua'n amaho chu akouvin, ajah uva, kalah uva cheng hiuva, ipidia nangho-a kona gamlatah-a chenga kahiuve tia neijoulhep muham? ati.
target: Then Joshua summoned the Gibeonites and said, “Why did you deceive us by saying, ‘We live a long way from you,’ while actually you live near us?

source: Hijeh chun tun nangho gaosap changa nahitaove. Soh nahinaole Pathen in dinga thingpole, twikhailea napan naova kona khatcha jong ongthol naum lou dingu ahi, tin aseitan ahi.
target: You are now under a curse: You will never be released from service as woodcutters and water carriers for the house of my God.”

source: Chuin amahon Joshua chu adonbutnun, Pakai na Pathen'in asoh Mosi henga hiche gam jouse nangma pehdinga thu napeh chule acheng jousehi namasanga nasuhgam ding ahi ti soh hohin kichentah-in eina hilui. Nangho jeh-in kahinkhouhi suhmanga aumdinghi kakicha behsetnun, hiti ahi kana bollu ahitai.
target: They answered Joshua, “Your servants were clearly told how the Lord your God had commanded his servant Moses to give you the whole land and to wipe out all its inhabitants from before you. So we feared for our lives because of you, and that is why we did this.

source: Chule tun vetan, keihohi nakhutna um kahiuvin, kachunguva boldingin aphai, adih-e, natichu boljengin, atiuve.
target: We are now in your hands. Do to us whatever seems good and right to you.”

source: Chuin hitichun aman amaho chu abolin Israel chate khutna konin ahuhdoh un, amaho chu athat tapouve.
target: So Joshua saved them from the Israelites, and they did not kill them.

source: Chuin Joshua'n hiche nikho chun amaho chu houkhom ho Pakai maichama dinga thingpole twikhaija alhendohna mun'a chun tuni geijin, apansahtan ahi.
target: That day he made the Gibeonites woodcutters and water carriers for the assembly, to provide for the needs of the altar of the Lord at the place the Lord would choose. And that is what they are to this day.

source: Tun ahitin ahi, Jerusalem lengpa Adonizedek'in Joshua'n Ai kho alah a asuhmanghela Jericho khopi le alengpa asuhmang banga Ai khole alengpa abol chule Gibeon'a chenghon Israel toh kichamna asemuva alah uva aum ajah phatchun,
target: Now Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had taken Ai and totally destroyed it, doing to Ai and its king as he had done to Jericho and its king, and that the people of Gibeon had made a treaty of peace with Israel and had become their allies.

source: Akichalheh jengun, ajehchu Gibeon hi lengte khopiho khat banga khopi lenkhat ahin, hichu Ai kho sangin jong alenjon asunga chengjouse hattah ahiuve.
target: He and his people were very much alarmed at this, because Gibeon was an important city, like one of the royal cities; it was larger than Ai, and all its men were good fighters.

source: Hijeh chun Jerusalem lengpa Adonizedek chun Hebron lengpa Hoham le Jarmuth lengpa Piram chule Lachish lengpa Japhia chule Eglon lengpa Debir henga mi asolin,
target: So Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem appealed to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish and Debir king of Eglon.

source: Hungun lang eihung kithopiuvin, Gibeon sumangu hite. Ajehchu Joshua le Israel chatetoh kichamna asemtaove, ati.
target: “Come up and help me attack Gibeon,” he said, “because it has made peace with Joshua and the Israelites.”

source: Hijeh chun, Amor te leng ngaho: Jerusalem leng, Hebron leng, Jarmuth leng, Lachish leng chule Eglon leng akikhom khomun, amahole asepai janel jouse akontouvun, Gibeon koma gebuh asemun, akisatpi taove.
target: Then the five kings of the Amorites—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish and Eglon—joined forces. They moved up with all their troops and took up positions against Gibeon and attacked it.

source: Chuin Gibeon mihochun Gilgal gebuh-a Joshua henga mi asolun, nasohte-a dingin nakhut lhang thase hih-in. Kahenguva hungtou loijinglang nei hung kithopiuvin, neihuhhing jengun ati. Ajehchu thinglhanga cheng Amor te lengho jouse keiho doudin akikhom taove.
target: The Gibeonites then sent word to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal: “Do not abandon your servants. Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us, because all the Amorite kings from the hill country have joined forces against us.”

source: Chutichun Joshua Gilgal'a konchun amale agalsatmi jouse, mihat mihangho jouse chu akontou taovin ahi.
target: So Joshua marched up from Gilgal with his entire army, including all the best fighting men.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Joshua henga amaho chu kicha hihbeh-in, amaho chu nakhutna kapehdoh nahitai, namasanga miho khatcha dingjou louding ahi, ati.
target: The Lord said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them; I have given them into your hand. Not one of them will be able to withstand you.”

source: Hijeh chun hetman louvin Joshua Gilgal'a konin ahenguva jankhovah in achetouvin, ahi.
target: After an all-night march from Gilgal, Joshua took them by surprise.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin amaho chu Israelte masanga chun amaimoh sah-in, chule Gibeon'a chun mitamtah athatnun ahi. Bethhoron jottouna lampi lhungkeijin adeltaovin, Azekah le Makkedah geijin agathatnun ahi.
target: The Lord threw them into confusion before Israel, so Joshua and the Israelites defeated them completely at Gibeon. Israel pursued them along the road going up to Beth Horon and cut them down all the way to Azekah and Makkedah.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Israelte masanga ajammuva Beth-horon lama achesuh petnun, Pakaiyin Azekah geijin van'a konin achunguva gel len tahtah alhahsah in athiuvin ahi. Israel chaten chemjam'a atha sangun gel selih chu atamjon ahi.
target: As they fled before Israel on the road down from Beth Horon to Azekah, the Lord hurled large hailstones down on them, and more of them died from the hail than were killed by the swords of the Israelites.

source: Chujouvin Pakaiyin Amor mite chu Israelte khutna apehdoh nichun Joshua'n Pakai jah-a, hitin aseijin, Israel chate mitmun; Nisa nangma Gibeon chunga dingdenin, chule lha jong Aijalon damjola dingdenin, ati.
target: On the day the Lord gave the Amorites over to Israel, Joshua said to the Lord in the presence of Israel: “Sun, stand still over Gibeon, and you, moon, over the Valley of Aijalon.”

source: Chuin mipi chun amelmateu chunga phu alahjou masang seochun nisa chu adingden tan, chule lhajong chu aumden tai, hiche hi Jasher lekhabua kisuna hilouham? Hitichun vantham jola nisa ading denin, nikhat lhumkei tobang lhumvah louvin aumin ahi.
target: So the sun stood still, and the moon stopped, till the nation avenged itself on its enemies, as it is written in the Book of Jashar. The sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day.

source: Chule chuche masang ahiloule chuche nungin jong chutabong nikho, Pakaiyin mihem khat aw angaipehna aumkhapoi. Ajehchu Pakaiyin Israelte dinga gal anasat ahi.
target: There has never been a day like it before or since, a day when the Lord listened to a human being. Surely the Lord was fighting for Israel!

source: Chuin Joshua le aumkhompi Israel jouse Gilgal gebuh a akilekit taove.
target: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.

source: Ahin chuche leng ngaho chu ajamun Makkedah songkoa akisel taove.
target: Now the five kings had fled and hidden in the cave at Makkedah.

source: Chuin Joshua henga hiche leng ngaho chu Mekkedah songko khatna akiseluve, tin ahungseipeh taove.
target: When Joshua was told that the five kings had been found hiding in the cave at Makkedah,

source: Chuin Joshua'n songko kotna chun song len tahtah tanglut unlang amaho ngahtup din mi koijun ati.
target: he said, “Roll large rocks up to the mouth of the cave, and post some men there to guard it.

source: Chule nangho umden louvin, nagalmiteo nungdelun, chule amaho lah-a anungthop ho geijin thatnun amaho akhopi houva lutsah hih-un. Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'in amaho chu nakhut uva apehdoh ahitai, ati.
target: But don’t stop; pursue your enemies! Attack them from the rear and don’t let them reach their cities, for the Lord your God has given them into your hand.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Joshua le Israel chaten amaho chu asuhmanghel nadiuvin hathan athatnun, amoh chengchu kul kikai khum khopiho-a chun aluttaovin ahi.
target: So Joshua and the Israelites defeated them completely, but a few survivors managed to reach their fortified cities.

source: Chuin mijouse chu Mekkedah gebuh a Joshua henga lung mongtah-in akileuvin ahi. Koiman Israel chate chung kitimong monga akam akeh tapouve.
target: The whole army then returned safely to Joshua in the camp at Makkedah, and no one uttered a word against the Israelites.

source: Hiche jouchun Joshua'n songkotkhah chu hongunlang leng ngaho chu kahenga hinpuijun, atin ahi.
target: Joshua said, “Open the mouth of the cave and bring those five kings out to me.”

source: Chuin chutichun abolun songkoa konchun leng ngaho Jerusalem lengpa, Hebron lengpa, Jarmuth lengpa, Lachish lengpa chule Eglon lengpa chu ahenga ahinpui taove.
target: So they brought the five kings out of the cave—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish and Eglon.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, hiche lengho chu Joshua henga ahinpui phatnun, Joshua'n Israel mipi jouse chu akouvin, amatoh kilhon galmi lamkaiho jouse jah-achun hung naijun lang hiche lengho ngong nakengun chonun ati. Chuin amaho ahung naijun amaho ngong chu akenguva achon taove.
target: When they had brought these kings to Joshua, he summoned all the men of Israel and said to the army commanders who had come with him, “Come here and put your feet on the necks of these kings.” So they came forward and placed their feet on their necks.

source: Chuin Joshua'n ajah uva, kicha hih-un, lungjong lunglha hih-un, hatnunlang hangsan uvin ati. Ajehchu Pakaiyin nakisatpiu namelma teu jouse chu hitia chu abolding ahi, ati.
target: Joshua said to them, “Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Be strong and courageous. This is what the Lord will do to all the enemies you are going to fight.”

source: Chule hiche jouchun Joshua'n amahochu asatnin, athatnin thingphung nga chunga akhaijin ahi. Chule amahochu thingchunga nilhah geijin akhaijun ahi.
target: Then Joshua put the kings to death and exposed their bodies on five poles, and they were left hanging on the poles until evening.

source: Chuin nilhum dingkonin ahitin ahi, Joshua'n thu apen, amahochu thingleh-a konchun alalhauvin, akiselnao songkoa chun alehlutnun ahi. Songho chu song lenpipin asingun, hichu tunigeijin jong aumnalaije.
target: At sunset Joshua gave the order and they took them down from the poles and threw them into the cave where they had been hiding. At the mouth of the cave they placed large rocks, which are there to this day.

source: Chuin chuche nichun Joshua'n Makkedah chu alan, hichu chemjamin asumangin, mihing jouse asugamhelin khatcha jong ahinghoipoi. Chule Jericho lengpa chunga anabol bangchun Makkedah lengpa chunga jong aboltai.
target: That day Joshua took Makkedah. He put the city and its king to the sword and totally destroyed everyone in it. He left no survivors. And he did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.

source: Chujouvin Joshua'n aumpi Israel chate jousetoh Makkedah'a patnin Libnah lama acheuvin, Libnah chu asat taove.
target: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Makkedah to Libnah and attacked it.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Libnah le alengpa chu Israelte khutna apedoh-in, asunga cheng miho jouse chemjamin athat gamin, khatcha jong ahinghoipoi. Chutichun Jericho lengpa abolna bang chun chuche lengpa jong chu aboltan ahi.
target: The Lord also gave that city and its king into Israel’s hand. The city and everyone in it Joshua put to the sword. He left no survivors there. And he did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.

source: Chuin Joshua'n Libnah'a konin aumpi Israel jousetoh Lachish'a acheuvin, chuin gebuh asongun asattaove.
target: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Libnah to Lachish; he took up positions against it and attacked it.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Lachish chu Israelte khutna apedoh-in, hichu nini channin alan ahi. Libnah anabolna jouse bangchun akhopile asunga cheng mihing jouse chu chemjamin asumangtai.
target: The Lord gave Lachish into Israel’s hands, and Joshua took it on the second day. The city and everyone in it he put to the sword, just as he had done to Libnah.

source: Chujouchun Gezer leng Horam chu Lachish kithopi dingchun ahung touvin ahile, Joshua'n amale amite chu khatcha khen neilou helin athatgamtai.
target: Meanwhile, Horam king of Gezer had come up to help Lachish, but Joshua defeated him and his army—until no survivors were left.

source: Chuin Lachish'a konin aumpi Israel jousetoh Joshua chu Eglon'a acheuvin, gebuh asongun asat taove.
target: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Lachish to Eglon; they took up positions against it and attacked it.

source: Chuin chuche nichun amahon alauvin, chule asunga mihing umjouse chu chemjamin asatnun, hiche nikho mama chun Lachish abolna bangun athatgam heltai.
target: They captured it that same day and put it to the sword and totally destroyed everyone in it, just as they had done to Lachish.

source: Chuin Joshua chu aumpi Israel jousetoh Eglon'a konin acheuvin Hebron ho chu asat taove.
target: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron and attacked it.

source: Chule amahon hichu alauvin, Eglon anabolna jouse bang chun, Hebron le alengpa aumpi jousele, asunga cheng mihing jouse chu chemjamin athatgam heltan ahi.
target: They took the city and put it to the sword, together with its king, its villages and everyone in it. They left no survivors. Just as at Eglon, they totally destroyed it and everyone in it.

source: Chuin aumpi Israel jousetoh Joshua Debir lama acheuvin, asatnun,
target: Then Joshua and all Israel with him turned around and attacked Debir.

source: Aman Debir le alengpa chule khopi jouse chu alan, chule amahon amahochu chemjamin asatnun, asunga cheng mihing jouse chu athatnun, khatcha ahinghoi pouve. Hebron abolna bangle Libnah le alengpa abolna bangchun Debir le alengpa jongchu aboltan ahi.
target: They took the city, its king and its villages, and put them to the sword. Everyone in it they totally destroyed. They left no survivors. They did to Debir and its king as they had done to Libnah and its king and to Hebron.

source: Hitichun Joshua'n lhanglam gam hihen agam pumpin, sim gamho phaigam chule twiputna chana lengte jouse chu asugam sohkeijin, Pakai Israel Pathen thupeh bangin khatcha khenlouvin, ahaithei jouse athat gamheltan ahi.
target: So Joshua subdued the whole region, including the hill country, the Negev, the western foothills and the mountain slopes, together with all their kings. He left no survivors. He totally destroyed all who breathed, just as the Lord , the God of Israel, had commanded.

source: Chule Joshua'n Kadesh-barne'a pat Gazah channin, Goshen gam jouse toh Gibeon channin asumang heltan ahi.
target: Joshua subdued them from Kadesh Barnea to Gaza and from the whole region of Goshen to Gibeon.

source: Pakai Israel Pathen'in Israel dinga gal asat jeh-in, Joshua'n hiche lenghole agam jouseu chu khatvei lah-in alatai.
target: All these kings and their lands Joshua conquered in one campaign, because the Lord , the God of Israel, fought for Israel.

source: Chuin Joshua aumpi Israel jousetoh Gilgal gebuh-a chun ahung kilekit taove.
target: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Hezor lengpa Jabin'in hicheho chu ajah phatnin, Madon lengpa Jobab, Shimrom lengpa chule Achshaph henga,
target: When Jabin king of Hazor heard of this, he sent word to Jobab king of Madon, to the kings of Shimron and Akshaph,

source: chule sahlang thinglhang gamle Chinnereth lhanglam phaichamle dam chule lhumlam Dor gamgi-a cheng lengho henga,
target: and to the northern kings who were in the mountains, in the Arabah south of Kinnereth, in the western foothills and in Naphoth Dor on the west;

source: chule solamle lhumlama Kanaan mi, Amor mi, Hit mi, Perizz mi chule thinglhanga um Jebus mi chule Mizpeh gam Hermon noilam Hiv mite henga mi asoltan ahi.
target: to the Canaanites in the east and west; to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites and Jebusites in the hill country; and to the Hivites below Hermon in the region of Mizpah.

source: Chule asepai jouseu toh mitampi atama tam, atam dannu chu luikama nel simsenlou jatjen sakol kangtalai tamtah toh akondoh taove.
target: They came out with all their troops and a large number of horses and chariots—a huge army, as numerous as the sand on the seashore.

source: Chuin hiche lengho jouse chu akisuhkhom phatnun Israel doudingin Merom twipanga gebuh asongkhom taove.
target: All these kings joined forces and made camp together at the Waters of Merom to fight against Israel.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Joshua henga, amaho jehchun kicha hih-in, ajehchu jing nikho tuphat donle amaho Israel masanga thagam dinga kapehdoh ding nahi. Nangman asakolu aja nabana akangtalaihou meija nahalvam ding ahi, ati.
target: The Lord said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them, because by this time tomorrow I will hand all of them, slain, over to Israel. You are to hamstring their horses and burn their chariots.”

source: Hijeh chun Joshua'n agalsat miho jousetoh amaho satdingin phulou helouvin Merom twilah-a chun ahungun, amaho chu anokhom taove.
target: So Joshua and his whole army came against them suddenly at the Waters of Merom and attacked them,

source: Chuin Pakaiyin amahochu Israelte khutna apedoh-in, amahon amaho chu athatnun Zidon gei, Misrephoth-maim gei chule solam Mizpeh phaicham geijin adelun, khatcha khenlou helin athat gamtaove.
target: and the Lord gave them into the hand of Israel. They defeated them and pursued them all the way to Greater Sidon, to Misrephoth Maim, and to the Valley of Mizpah on the east, until no survivors were left.

source: Chule Pakai thupeh bangchun Joshua'n amaho chunga abolin, asakolhou ja abanin, asakol kangtalai hou meijin ahalvamtan ahi.
target: Joshua did to them as the Lord had directed: He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots.

source: Chuin Joshua hichepet chun akinunglen, Hazor chu alan, alengpa chu chemjamin athat tai. Ajehchu chuche masang chun Hazor chu chuche lenggam jouse chunga alenpen anahi.
target: At that time Joshua turned back and captured Hazor and put its king to the sword. (Hazor had been the head of all these kingdoms.)

source: Chuin chuche sunga um mihing jouse chu chemjamin athatnun, amaho chu asugam helun, khatcha ahinghoi pouve. Chule aman Hazor chu meijin ahal lhatai.
target: Everyone in it they put to the sword. They totally destroyed them, not sparing anyone that breathed, and he burned Hazor itself.

source: Chuin chugama lengho khopi jousele alengteu jouse chu Joshua'n amanin chemjamin athat tai. Chule Pakai soh Mosi'n athupeh bangin amaho chu asumang heltai.
target: Joshua took all these royal cities and their kings and put them to the sword. He totally destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded.

source: Ahinla Joshua'n anahallhah Hazor seh tilouvin molvum'a dingjing khopiho chu Israel ten khatcha anahal lhapouve.
target: Yet Israel did not burn any of the cities built on their mounds—except Hazor, which Joshua burned.

source: Chuin chuche khopiho-a thilkichom jousele ganchaho chu Israel chaten galla kichom thilin akilah-un ahi. Ahivangin amahon amitakip asuhmang tokahseovin chemjamin athatnun khatcha jong ahinghoi pouve.
target: The Israelites carried off for themselves all the plunder and livestock of these cities, but all the people they put to the sword until they completely destroyed them, not sparing anyone that breathed.

source: Pakaiyin asoh Mosi henga thu anapeh bangin Mosi'n Joshua koma thu anapen, chutobangma chun Joshua'n abolin Pakaiyin Mosi thu anapeh jouse chu bolouva akhen khatcha aumpoi.
target: As the Lord commanded his servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua, and Joshua did it; he left nothing undone of all that the Lord commanded Moses.

source: Chutichun Joshua'n chuche gam jouse thinglhang gamho, lhanglam gamkai jousele Goshen gam jouse, phaichamle phaitong jouse chule Israel molle chuche molsanga damjol jouse alan,
target: So Joshua took this entire land: the hill country, all the Negev, the whole region of Goshen, the western foothills, the Arabah and the mountains of Israel with their foothills,

source: Seir lhang geija kikhotou Halak molsanga pat Hermon mol noilam Lebanon phaichama um Baalgad chan geijin alahpeh-in, alengho jouse amanin asatnin athatgamtan, ahi.
target: from Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir, to Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon below Mount Hermon. He captured all their kings and put them to death.

source: Joshua'n chuche lengho chu phat sottah anakidoupin, ahi.
target: Joshua waged war against all these kings for a long time.

source: Gibeon'a cheng Hiv miteho tailou Israel chate toh kichamna sema khopi khatcha jong aumpoi. Adang jouse galla chu alah ngenchangu ahi.
target: Except for the Hivites living in Gibeon, not one city made a treaty of peace with the Israelites, who took them all in battle.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin Mosi anathupeh bangin aman amahochu lungsetna beihela asuhmanghel theina dinga, amahon Israel ahung kidoupina dinguva alungu kitahsah chu Pakaiya kon ahi.
target: For it was the Lord himself who hardened their hearts to wage war against Israel, so that he might destroy them totally, exterminating them without mercy, as the Lord had commanded Moses.

source: Chuin chuphat chun Joshua ahungin molsang ho-a konchun Hebron, Debir le Anaba konin Judah molsangho jouse-a konle Israel moljouse-a konin Anakim te chu athatnin, Joshua'n amaho chu akhopihou pumin asumang heltan, ahi.
target: At that time Joshua went and destroyed the Anakites from the hill country: from Hebron, Debir and Anab, from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel. Joshua totally destroyed them and their towns.

source: Israelte gamsunga chun Anakim te khatcha thalouva kihinghoi aumtapoi. Gaza, Gath, chule Ashdod nabou aumtaove.
target: No Anakites were left in Israelite territory; only in Gaza, Gath and Ashdod did any survive.

source: Chutichun Pakaiyin Mosi henga anasei jouse dungjuijin Joshua'n gampumpi chu alan ahi. Chuin Joshua'n amaho aphungu kikhen dungjuijin hichu alodiuvin Israelte apetan ahi. Chule agamchu galla konin akicholdotai.
target: So Joshua took the entire land, just as the Lord had directed Moses, and he gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to their tribal divisions. Then the land had rest from war.

source: Tun nisolam Jordan gal langkhat Arnon vapidunga kipat Hermon lhang gei, chule solam phaicham jouse Israel ten asuh manguva atouphao gama lengho chu hitehohi ahiuve.
target: These are the kings of the land whom the Israelites had defeated and whose territory they took over east of the Jordan, from the Arnon Gorge to Mount Hermon, including all the eastern side of the Arabah:

source: Heshbon'a cheng Amor mite lengpa Sihon, Arnon vapidung panga um Aroer'a pat, chule vapidung lailunga pat, Gilead gamsung kehkhatna pat, Ammon chate gamgia um Jabbok vapidung chan geipeh-a anavaihom,
target: Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon. He ruled from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge—from the middle of the gorge—to the Jabbok River, which is the border of the Ammonites. This included half of Gilead.

source: chule phaichama pat solama Chinnereth twipi geile Phaicham twipi gei Beth-jeshimoth jotna lampia solam chi twipi geipeh chule Ashdoth-pisgah noi lhanglama pat,
target: He also ruled over the eastern Arabah from the Sea of Galilee to the Sea of the Arabah (that is, the Dead Sea), to Beth Jeshimoth, and then southward below the slopes of Pisgah.

source: Ashtaroth le Edrei'a cheng amoh ho lah-a Amoth Bashan lengpa Og gamsung,
target: And the territory of Og king of Bashan, one of the last of the Rephaites, who reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei.

source: Chule Hermon lhanga Salcah a Bashan gam jouse, Geshur mitele Maachath mite chule Gilead gamgi kehkhat Heshbon lengpa Sihon Gamgi geijin vai anahome.
target: He ruled over Mount Hermon, Salekah, all of Bashan to the border of the people of Geshur and Maakah, and half of Gilead to the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

source: Amahochu Pakai soh Mosi le Israel chatehon anatha gamuva, chule Pakai soh Mosi'n Reuben te le Gad te chule Manasseh phung kehkhat-ho lodinga anapeh ahi.
target: Moses, the servant of the Lord , and the Israelites conquered them. And Moses the servant of the Lord gave their land to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh to be their possession.

source: Chule Joshua to Israel chaten Jordan gal hilam lhumlamsanga atha gamu chuche lengho chu ahiuvin, agammu chu Lebanon phaicham Baalgad'apat Halak lhang, Seir geija kikhotou ahi. Hichehi Joshua'n kihop khen dungjuija alodiuva Israelte phungho anapeh gamhochu ahi.
target: Here is a list of the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites conquered on the west side of the Jordan, from Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir. Joshua gave their lands as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel according to their tribal divisions.

source: Molsangho le damphai, phaichamle twinah ho-a chule gamthip gamle lhanglam gama Hit miho, Amor miho chule Kanaan miho, Perizz miho, Hiv miho chule Jebus miho gamchu ahi.
target: The lands included the hill country, the western foothills, the Arabah, the mountain slopes, the wilderness and the Negev. These were the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites. These were the kings:

source: Jericho lengpa, khat; Bethel koma um Ai kho lengpa, khat;
target: the king of Jericho one the king of Ai (near Bethel) one

source: Jerusalem lengpa, khat; Hebron lengpa, khat;
target: the king of Jerusalem one the king of Hebron one

source: Jarmuth lengpa, khat; Lachish lengpa, khat;
target: the king of Jarmuth one the king of Lachish one

source: Eglon lengpa, khat; Gezer lengpa, khat;
target: the king of Eglon one the king of Gezer one

source: Debir lengpa, khat; Geder lengpa, khat;
target: the king of Debir one the king of Geder one

source: Hormah lengpa, khat; Arad lengpa, khat;
target: the king of Hormah one the king of Arad one

source: Libnah lengpa, khat; Adullam lengpa, khat;
target: the king of Libnah one the king of Adullam one

source: Makkedah lengpa, khat; Bethel lengpa, khat;
target: the king of Makkedah one the king of Bethel one

source: Tappuah lengpa, khat; Hapher lengpa, khat;
target: the king of Tappuah one the king of Hepher one

source: Aphek lengpa, khat; Lasharon lengpa, khat;
target: the king of Aphek one the king of Lasharon one

source: Madon lengpa, khat; Hazor lengpa, khat;
target: the king of Madon one the king of Hazor one

source: Shimronmeron lengpa, khat; Achshaph lengpa, khat;
target: the king of Shimron Meron one the king of Akshaph one

source: Taanach lengpa, khat; Megiddo lengpa, khat;
target: the king of Taanach one the king of Megiddo one

source: Kadesh lengpa, khat; Karmel gam Jokneam lengpa, khat;
target: the king of Kedesh one the king of Jokneam in Carmel one

source: Dor panga Dor lengpa, khat; Gilgal nam miho lengpa, khat;
target: the king of Dor (in Naphoth Dor) one the king of Goyim in Gilgal one

source: Tirzah lengpa, khat; Lengho jouse abonchauvin somthumle khat ahiuve.
target: the king of Tirzah one thirty-one kings in all.

source: Tun Joshua chu ateh-in, akumjong atamlheh tan, chule Pakaiyin ajah-a nangla natehkem tan, nakum atamlhehtan, gamtamtah lahding aumnalaijin ahi, ati.
target: When Joshua had grown old, the Lord said to him, “You are now very old, and there are still very large areas of land to be taken over.

source: Lahmoh chu hiche gamhohi ahi. Philistine le Geshur gamgichin jouse,
target: “This is the land that remains: All the regions of the Philistines and Geshurites,

source: Egypt masanga um Shihora pat sahlam Kanaan mihon atouphao Ekron gamgidung geija umho, Philistine te leng ngaho, Gazeth te Ashdod te, Eshkalon ho, Gitt ho, Ekron ho chule Avi te jong ahiuve,
target: from the Shihor River on the east of Egypt to the territory of Ekron on the north, all of it counted as Canaanite though held by the five Philistine rulers in Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron; the territory of the Avvites

source: Lhanglama Kanaan miho gam jouse chule Sidon miho koma um Meareh apat Aphek lama Amor miho gamgi changei,
target: on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, from Arah of the Sidonians as far as Aphek and the border of the Amorites;

source: chule Gibli miho gamle Lebanon pumpi, nisolam sanga, Hermon lhangnoija Baal-gad'apat Hamath lutna changei ahi.
target: the area of Byblos; and all Lebanon to the east, from Baal Gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo Hamath.

source: Lebanon'apat Misrephoth-maim changei, thinglhang gam cheng jousele amaho chu Israel chate masanga kona kadeldoh ding ahi. Sidon miho jouse, nangma kathupeh bangchun vangvet na-a konin Israel chate henga achenna diuvin ahoppeh poupouvin ahi.
target: “As for all the inhabitants of the mountain regions from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, that is, all the Sidonians, I myself will drive them out before the Israelites. Be sure to allocate this land to Israel for an inheritance, as I have instructed you,

source: Hijeh chun tun hiche gamhi phung ko hole Manasseh phung kehkhat ho henga agoulo diuvin hoppeh-in ati.
target: and divide it as an inheritance among the nine tribes and half of the tribe of Manasseh.”

source: Amaho chutoh Reuben te le Gad te chun Jordan sahlama achan dinguva Mosi'n anapeh chu anakisan taovin, Pakai soh Mosi amatah-in anapeh bang ngeichu ahi.
target: The other half of Manasseh, the Reubenites and the Gadites had received the inheritance that Moses had given them east of the Jordan, as he, the servant of the Lord , had assigned it to them.

source: Arnon vapidung panga um, Aroer le vadung lailunga um khopi medeba phaicham jouse-a pat Dibon changei,
target: It extended from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the middle of the gorge, and included the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon,

source: chule Heshbon'a lengchang Sihon, Amor mite lengpa khopi jouse Ammon chate gamgi gei,
target: and all the towns of Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, out to the border of the Ammonites.

source: chule Gilead le Geshur mite chule Maachath'te gamgisungho leh Hermon lhang pumpi chule Bashan pumpi Salcah changei,
target: It also included Gilead, the territory of the people of Geshur and Maakah, all of Mount Hermon and all Bashan as far as Salekah—

source: Milen mihat amoh umnalai, Ashtaroth le Edrei leng Bashan na Og lenggam jouse, hicheho jeh-a hi Mosi'n amaho ana douva anadeldoh ahi.
target: that is, the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan, who had reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei. (He was the last of the Rephaites.) Moses had defeated them and taken over their land.

source: Ahijeng vangin Israel chatehon anadeldoh pouve. Geshur mite ahilou jongle Maachath mite, Geshur mitele Maachath mitechu tuni geijin Israelte lah-a acheng nalai juve.
target: But the Israelites did not drive out the people of Geshur and Maakah, so they continue to live among the Israelites to this day.

source: Aman amaho koma ana seibang chun, Levi phunga miho vangchu chenna ding gam ana kipepoi. Israel Pakai Pathen'a dinga meija kigou ganlhainaho bouchu amaho gou ahi.
target: But to the tribe of Levi he gave no inheritance, since the food offerings presented to the Lord , the God of Israel, are their inheritance, as he promised them.

source: Chule Mosi'n Reuben chateho chu a-insungu dungjui cheh in chenna ding gam anapei.
target: This is what Moses had given to the tribe of Reuben, according to its clans:

source: Chule amaho gamding chu Arnon luipanga um Aroer'apat chule alailunga um khopilen Medeba phaicham jouse jong ahi.
target: The territory from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the middle of the gorge, and the whole plateau past Medeba

source: Heshbon chule phaichama um akhopilen hochu Dibon le Bamoth-baal chule Beth-baal-meon,
target: to Heshbon and all its towns on the plateau, including Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,

source: chule Jahezah le Kedemoth chule Mephaath,
target: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,

source: chule damjolla um lhang chunga Kirjathaim le Sibnah chule Zareth-shahar,
target: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar on the hill in the valley,

source: chule Beth-peor le Ashdoth-pisgah chule Beth-jeshimoth,
target: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth Jeshimoth—

source: chule phaichama um khopilen jouse Heshbonna leng Amor mite lengpa Sihon lenggam jouse Mosi'n Midia ho leng chapa jousetoh anathakhom, Evi, Rekan, Zur chule Reba chuche gama cheng Sihon leng noidouho chu ahiuve.
target: all the towns on the plateau and the entire realm of Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled at Heshbon. Moses had defeated him and the Midianite chiefs, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur and Reba—princes allied with Sihon—who lived in that country.

source: Beor chapa Balaam doithempa jong chu Israel chaten midang atha nalah uva chun chemjamin anatha thaovin ahi.
target: In addition to those slain in battle, the Israelites had put to the sword Balaam son of Beor, who practiced divination.

source: Reuben chateho gamgi chu Jordan le anaivelse chu ahi. Hiche khopihole khohohi Reuben chate a-insungu dungjuija achenna dinguva alou gam chu ahi.
target: The boundary of the Reubenites was the bank of the Jordan. These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the Reubenites, according to their clans.

source: Chule Mosi'n Gad phunga Gad chateho ngeichu, a-insungu dungjuijin achenna dingu gam anapen, ahi.
target: This is what Moses had given to the tribe of Gad, according to its clans:

source: Chule agamsunga chu Jazer le Gilead khopilenho jouse, Ammon chateho gam akehkhat Aroer geile masanga Rabbah changei ahi.
target: The territory of Jazer, all the towns of Gilead and half the Ammonite country as far as Aroer, near Rabbah;

source: Chule Heshbon'a pat Ramath-mizpeh le Betonim chule Mahanaim apat Dabir gamgi gei ahi.
target: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpah and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the territory of Debir;

source: Chule damjol Beth-aram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth chule Zephon, Heshbon lengpa Sihon lenggam sunga amoh jouse Jordan le agamsung, Chinnereth twikhanglen pamchin geija gal langkhat Jordan solam chan ahi.
target: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Sukkoth and Zaphon with the rest of the realm of Sihon king of Heshbon (the east side of the Jordan, the territory up to the end of the Sea of Galilee).

source: Hichehi Gad chate a-insung dungjuija agoulo dinguva kigotpeh khopilen hole akhoneoho chu ahi.
target: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the Gadites, according to their clans.

source: Chuin Mosi'n Manasseh phung kehkhat chu alodiu gam anapei. Chule hichehi Manasseh chate phung kehkhatnin a-insungu dungjui cheh a analo chu ahi.
target: This is what Moses had given to the half-tribe of Manasseh, that is, to half the family of the descendants of Manasseh, according to its clans:

source: Chule hiche Mahanaim apat, Bashan pumpi gamsung Bashan leng Og gam jousele Bashan gama Jair khopi jousetoh, hichu khopilen somgup ahi.
target: The territory extending from Mahanaim and including all of Bashan, the entire realm of Og king of Bashan—all the settlements of Jair in Bashan, sixty towns,

source: Chule Gilead gam kehkhat le Ashtaroth chule Edrei Bashan Og lenggam khopi lenho Manasseh chapa Machir chateho-a ahin, Machir chatedia a-insungu dungjui cheh a kigotpeh ahi.
target: half of Gilead, and Ashtaroth and Edrei (the royal cities of Og in Bashan). This was for the descendants of Makir son of Manasseh—for half of the sons of Makir, according to their clans.

source: Hichehohi Moab phaicham ho-a, Jordan gal langkhatna Jericho solam sanga Mosi'n achenna diuva ana hoppeh gamho chu ahi.
target: This is the inheritance Moses had given when he was in the plains of Moab across the Jordan east of Jericho.

source: Ahinla Mosi'n Levi phung chu goulo gam khatcha anapepoi. Ahenguva ana seibangin, Israel Pakai Pathen chu agoulou ahijenge.
target: But to the tribe of Levi, Moses had given no inheritance; the Lord , the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he promised them.

source: Chule hiche gamhohi Israel chaten Kanaan gam alonao gamho chu ahin, Eleazar thempule Nun chapa Joshua, chule Israel phungho pate lamkaihon alo diuva anahoppeh-u ahi.
target: Now these are the areas the Israelites received as an inheritance in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the tribal clans of Israel allotted to them.

source: Pakaiyin Mosi khutna thu anapeh banga, phung ko le akehkhat dinga vang asanuva analou ahi
target: Their inheritances were assigned by lot to the nine-and-a-half tribes, as the Lord had commanded through Moses.

source: Ajehchu Mosi'n Jordan gal langkhatna chu phung nile phung kehkhat ho chu achen nadiu anapeh ahitai. Levi te goulo ding khatcha anapepon ahi.
target: Moses had granted the two-and-a-half tribes their inheritance east of the Jordan but had not granted the Levites an inheritance among the rest,

source: Ajehchu Joseph chate chu phungni, Manasseh le Ephraim ahin, hijeh chun Levi ho chu achen nadiu khopilen hole khopamvel ganlhat lena ding munle anachenau inmun tilou chu anape pouve.
target: for Joseph’s descendants had become two tribes—Manasseh and Ephraim. The Levites received no share of the land but only towns to live in, with pasturelands for their flocks and herds.

source: Pakaiyin Mosi thu anapeh bangchun Israel chateho jong hiti chun anaboluvin gamchu ana kihom uve.
target: So the Israelites divided the land, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

source: Chujouvin Gilgal'a Joshua henga chun Judah chate ahungun, chule Kenimi Jephunneh chapa Kaleb chun ahenga, Pathen mi Mosi henga Pakaiyin keimale nangma chungchang Kadesh-barnea'a aseichu nahenai, ati.
target: Now the people of Judah approached Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know what the Lord said to Moses the man of God at Kadesh Barnea about you and me.

source: Pakai soh Mosi'n Kadesh-barnea'a kona gam velhi dinga eisol chun kum somlia upa kahitan, kalung ngaito bangin ahenga thu kalhut kitne.
target: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the Lord sent me from Kadesh Barnea to explore the land. And I brought him back a report according to my convictions,

source: Ahijeng vangin, kalhonpi kasopiho chun mipilung ajunlhah sah-un, kenvang Pakai ka Pathen chu kajuilhum keije.
target: but my fellow Israelites who went up with me made the hearts of the people melt in fear. I, however, followed the Lord my God wholeheartedly.

source: Chule hicheni chun Mosi akihahselin, nangin Pakai ka Pathen najui lhumkei jeh-in, nakengin achotphah gamchu a-itih a nangmale nachate goulo gam hiding ahi, ati.
target: So on that day Moses swore to me, ‘The land on which your feet have walked will be your inheritance and that of your children forever, because you have followed the Lord my God wholeheartedly.’

source: Chule tun vetan, Israel chate gamthipma avavei laijuva Mosi henga Pakaiyin hiche thuhi Mosi henga anaseija patchun hiche kum somli le kum nga hi aseibangin Pakai chun eina hinghoijin chule tun vetan, tunin keima kum somget le kum nga kahitai.
target: “Now then, just as the Lord promised, he has kept me alive for forty-five years since the time he said this to Moses, while Israel moved about in the wilderness. So here I am today, eighty-five years old!

source: Mosi'n eina solni-a bangchun tuni geijin kahat jing nalaije. Galkon nale lhunkit theina jenga jong chupetna kathahatna bang ngeichun tunjong katha ahat jing nalaije.
target: I am still as strong today as the day Moses sent me out; I’m just as vigorous to go out to battle now as I was then.

source: Hijeh chun tun chuche ni-a Pakaiyin anasei bangin, hiche molsangho neipetan ati. Ajehchu nangman chuche laichun Anakim miho chutobanga akhopilen nasatah tahho kulpi kiget khum ahiuchu najatai. Chutia Pakaiyin ei umpile Pakai seibanga keiman amaho chu kadeldoh ding ahi.
target: Now give me this hill country that the Lord promised me that day. You yourself heard then that the Anakites were there and their cities were large and fortified, but, the Lord helping me, I will drive them out just as he said.”

source: Chuin Joshua'n amachu phatthei aboh-in, chule Hebron chu Jephunneh chapa Kaleb chu alodingin apetai.
target: Then Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave him Hebron as his inheritance.

source: Hijeh chun Aman Pakai Israel Pathen chu ajuilhumkei jeh-in, Hebron chu tunigeijin Kenizz mi Jephunneh chapa Kaleb goulo gam ahunghitai.
target: So Hebron has belonged to Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite ever since, because he followed the Lord , the God of Israel, wholeheartedly.

source: Chule Hebron minhi masangin Kirjath-arba anahin, hiche Arba chu Anakim miho lah-a milentah anahi. Chule agam chu galla konin akicholnga tai.
target: (Hebron used to be called Kiriath Arba after Arba, who was the greatest man among the Anakites.) Then the land had rest from war.

source: Chujouvin hichehi Judah phungmi chateho insungho vangsan na-a kona achanu chu ahi. Lhanglam sanga atonungpen Zin gamthip gamgi Edom gamsung geichu ahi.
target: The allotment for the tribe of Judah, according to its clans, extended down to the territory of Edom, to the Desert of Zin in the extreme south.

source: Chule noilama agamgi chu chituipi pamchina pat ahin, twipama kona gah suhvetna lhanglam sang chu ahin,
target: Their southern boundary started from the bay at the southern end of the Dead Sea,

source: chule lhanglam ngan Mealeh-acrabbin jonnin akikhosuh-in, Zin lam ajuipeh-in, lhanglam panga Kadesh-barnea geijin akikhotouvin, Hezron jonna achen, Adar geijin achen chule Karkea vella akiheitai.
target: crossed south of Scorpion Pass, continued on to Zin and went over to the south of Kadesh Barnea. Then it ran past Hezron up to Addar and curved around to Karka.

source: Chua konin Azmon lam ajonin, Egypt luipi lama akikhotouvin, hichu vapidunga akikholutnin, hichu lhanglam sanga nagamgi ngahna hiding ahi.
target: It then passed along to Azmon and joined the Wadi of Egypt, ending at the Mediterranean Sea. This is their southern boundary.

source: Chule solam gamgi chu chi twipi gei ahin, Jordan kichaina gei, chule sahlama gamgi chu twininglut Jordan sodohna chu ahi.
target: The eastern boundary is the Dead Sea as far as the mouth of the Jordan. The northern boundary started from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan,

source: Chule gamgi chu Beth-hoglah'a achetoupeh-in, Beth-arabah sahlama achepeh-in, chule gamgi chu Reuben chapa Bohan songphung geijin akikhotou peh-in,
target: went up to Beth Hoglah and continued north of Beth Arabah to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.

source: chule gamgi chu Achor damjolla patna Debir lama akikho toupeh-in, chutimachun sahlama Gilgal lam gahvetna vapidung lhanglam sanga um Adummin jottouna masang chu ahi. Chule gamgi ngahna chu Enshemesh twiho lamsanga akikhopeh-in, chua kona kikhodoh chu Enrogel geipeh ahi.
target: The boundary then went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor and turned north to Gilgal, which faces the Pass of Adummim south of the gorge. It continued along to the waters of En Shemesh and came out at En Rogel.

source: Chule gamgi chu Hinnom chapa gom'ah akikho touvin, Jabush miho lhanglam gamgi geipehchu agasun, hichu Jerusalem ahi. Chule gamgi chu Hinnom lhumlam gom masanga molvum geipeh chun akikhotouvin, hichu mihat ho umna chunglama damjol monglha sahlama uma ahi.
target: Then it ran up the Valley of Ben Hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem). From there it climbed to the top of the hill west of the Hinnom Valley at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.

source: Chule gamgi chu lhangvuma kona Nephtoah twinah geijah achesah-in Kirjath-jearim kiti Baalah lama chu kikaipeh ahi.
target: From the hilltop the boundary headed toward the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, came out at the towns of Mount Ephron and went down toward Baalah (that is, Kiriath Jearim).

source: Chule gamgi chun Baalah lhumlam sanga patna Seir lhang geija chu agah kolkhum peh-a, Jearim lhang panglam ahopeh, hichu sahlama Chesalon ahin Beth-shemesh'a chesuh-a Timnah geija ajotpeh ahi.
target: Then it curved westward from Baalah to Mount Seir, ran along the northern slope of Mount Jearim (that is, Kesalon), continued down to Beth Shemesh and crossed to Timnah.

source: Chule gamgi chu Ekron pang sahlam sanga kikho-a, chule gamgi chu Shicron geija kikhanga, Baalah mollam ajotpeh-a, Jabneel geija kikho-a, chule akondohna gamgi chu twikhanglen chu hija ahitai.
target: It went to the northern slope of Ekron, turned toward Shikkeron, passed along to Mount Baalah and reached Jabneel. The boundary ended at the sea.

source: Chule lhumlam gamgi chu twipilen le apangchingei ahin, hichehi Judah chate insung dungjuija agam hopmu chu ahi.
target: The western boundary is the coastline of the Mediterranean Sea. These are the boundaries around the people of Judah by their clans.

source: Chule Jephunneh chapa Kaleb henga chun, Joshua henga Pakai thupeh dungjuijin Judah chate lah-a chan khat Anak pa khopi Arba Hebron kiti khopi jengjong chu apen ahi.
target: In accordance with the Lord ’s command to him, Joshua gave to Caleb son of Jephunneh a portion in Judah—Kiriath Arba, that is, Hebron. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)

source: Chuin Kaleb'in Anak chapa thum Sheshai, Ahiman, chule Talmai, Anak chate chu adeldoh-in,
target: From Hebron Caleb drove out the three Anakites—Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai, the sons of Anak.

source: chuin ama chua konchun Debir'a chengho henga achetouvin, chule Debir hi masang laijin Kirjath-sepher anakitin ahi.
target: From there he marched against the people living in Debir (formerly called Kiriath Sepher).

source: Chuin Kaleb'in Kirjath-espher sumanga, agajou theija chu kachanu Achsah hi ajidinga kapeh ding ahi, ati.
target: And Caleb said, “I will give my daughter Aksah in marriage to the man who attacks and captures Kiriath Sepher.”

source: Chuin Kaleb sopipa Kenaz chapa Othniel'in hichu alatan, aman achanu Achsah chu ajidingin apetan ahi.
target: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s brother, took it; so Caleb gave his daughter Aksah to him in marriage.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, aheng agalhun chun apa henga lou thumdingin ajolin ahi. Chuin amanu a-sangan chunga akumlhan, Kaleb'in amanu jah-a, ipi nadeijem? ati.
target: One day when she came to Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What can I do for you?”

source: Aman adonbutnin vang neiboh-in, ajehchu nangman lhanglam gam neipetan, twinah neiho neipehthan ati. Chuin aman sahlama twinahhole lhanglam twinahho chu apetai.
target: She replied, “Do me a special favor. Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me also springs of water.” So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.

source: Hichehi Judah chate phung a-insung dungjuija goulo gam ahi.
target: This is the inheritance of the tribe of Judah, according to its clans:

source: Chule Judah chate phung khopilenho Edom gamgi lamsanga lhanglam sanga gam monglha penho chu Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
target: The southernmost towns of the tribe of Judah in the Negev toward the boundary of Edom were: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,

source: chule Kinah, Dimonah chule Adadah,
target: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,

source: chule Kadesh, Hazorle Ithnan,
target: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,

source: Ziph, Telam, Bealot,
target: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,

source: chule Hazor, Hadattah, Kerioth, Hezron, hichu Hazor,
target: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (that is, Hazor),

source: Amam, Shema le Moladah,
target: Amam, Shema, Moladah,

source: chule Hazargaddah, Hashmonle Bethpelet,
target: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,

source: chule Hazar-shual, Beer-sheba le Bizjothjah,
target: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,

source: Baalah le Ijim le Azem,
target: Baalah, Iyim, Ezem,

source: chule Eltolad le Chesil le Hormah,
target: Eltolad, Kesil, Hormah,

source: chule Ziklag le Madmannaah le Sansannah,
target: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,

source: chule Lebaoth le Shilhim, A-in le Rimmon khopi lenho jouse chu somni le kole akhodang danghotoh,
target: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain and Rimmon—a total of twenty-nine towns and their villages.

source: chule phaichama chun Eshtaol, Zorah le Ashnah,
target: In the western foothills: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,

source: chule Zanoah, Engannim, Tappuah le Enam,
target: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,

source: Jarmuth, Adullam, Sokoh le Azekah,
target: Jarmuth, Adullam, Sokoh, Azekah,

source: chule Sharaim chule Adithaim, Gederah chule Gederothaim, khopilen somleli le akho dangdang hotoh,
target: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim)—fourteen towns and their villages.

source: Senan, Hasashah le Migdalgad,
target: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,

source: chule Dilean le Mizpeh le Joktheel,
target: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,

source: Lachish, Bozkath le Eglon,
target: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,

source: chule Kabbon, Lahmam le Kithlish,
target: Kabbon, Lahmas, Kitlish,

source: chule Gederoth, Bethdagon, Naamah, Makkedah, khopilen somlegup le akho dang dang hotoh,
target: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah and Makkedah—sixteen towns and their villages.

source: Libnah, Ether le Ashan,
target: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,

source: chule Jiphtah le Ashnah le Nezib,
target: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,

source: chule Keilah, Achzib le Mareshah khopilen ko le akho dang dang hotoh,
target: Keilah, Akzib and Mareshah—nine towns and their villages.

source: Ekron khopilen le akhodang dang hotoh,
target: Ekron, with its surrounding settlements and villages;

source: Ekron'a pat twikhanglen chanpeh Ashdod naija umjouse, akhodang dang hotoh,
target: west of Ekron, all that were in the vicinity of Ashdod, together with their villages;

source: Ashdod le akhopi hole akhodang danghou, chule akhodang dangho Egypt vapidung le twipilen chule chuche gamgi ngahna changei.
target: Ashdod, its surrounding settlements and villages; and Gaza, its settlements and villages, as far as the Wadi of Egypt and the coastline of the Mediterranean Sea.

source: Chule thinglhang gama Shamir le Jattir le Sokoh,
target: In the hill country: Shamir, Jattir, Sokoh,

source: chule Dannah le Kirjath-sannah, Debir kiti jongchu ahi.
target: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (that is, Debir),

source: Chule Anab le Eshtemoh le Anim,
target: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,

source: chule Goshen, Holon chule Giloh, khopilen somlekhat le akhodang dang hotoh,
target: Goshen, Holon and Giloh—eleven towns and their villages.

source: Arab, Dumah le Eshean,
target: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,

source: chule Janum, Beth-tappuah le Aphekah,
target: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,

source: chule Humtah, Kirjath-arba hichu Hebron kiti ahin chule Zior khopi len ko hole akho dang dangho,
target: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) and Zior—nine towns and their villages.

source: Maon, Karmel, Ziph le Juttah,
target: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah,

source: chule Jezreel le Jokdeam le Zanoah,
target: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,

source: Kain, Gibeah, Timnah, khopi somle kho dang dangho,
target: Kain, Gibeah and Timnah—ten towns and their villages.

source: Halhul, Beth-zur le Gedor,
target: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,

source: chule Maarath le Beth-anoth le Eltekon khopilen gupleh khodang dang hotoh,
target: Maarath, Beth Anoth and Eltekon—six towns and their villages.

source: Kirjath-jearim kiti Kirjath-baal le Rabbah khopilen nile akhodang danghotoh,
target: Kiriath Baal (that is, Kiriath Jearim) and Rabbah—two towns and their villages.

source: Gamthip machun Beth-arabah, Middin le Secacah,
target: In the wilderness: Beth Arabah, Middin, Sekakah,

source: chule Nibshan chule chi khopi Engedi khopilen gup leh khoneo hotoh ahiuve.
target: Nibshan, the City of Salt and En Gedi—six towns and their villages.

source: Jerusalem'a cheng Jebus mite vangchu Judah chaten adeldoh joupouvin, hijeh chun Jebus mite chu tuni geijin Jerusalem'a Judah chate lah-a achenghal jinguvin ahi.
target: Judah could not dislodge the Jebusites, who were living in Jerusalem; to this day the Jebusites live there with the people of Judah.

source: Chule Joseph chate vang chuhna chu, Jericho koma Jordan'a pat solama Jericho twi umnagei, Jericho a kipatna gamthip geija kikhotou Bethel mol pumpi chu ahi.
target: The allotment for Joseph began at the Jordan, east of the springs of Jericho, and went up from there through the desert into the hill country of Bethel.

source: Chule Bethel'a pat Luz geija akikhodoh in, Archi gamsung Ataroth geijin akikhopeh in, ahi.
target: It went on from Bethel (that is, Luz), crossed over to the territory of the Arkites in Ataroth,

source: Chule lhumlam panga Japhleti mite gamgi Beth-horon lhang nemjo gamsung Gezer channin akikhosuh in, hichu twikhanglen'a alutnin ahi.
target: descended westward to the territory of the Japhletites as far as the region of Lower Beth Horon and on to Gezer, ending at the Mediterranean Sea.

source: Hitichun Joseph chate Manasseh le Ephraim'in agam chu alotaove.
target: So Manasseh and Ephraim, the descendants of Joseph, received their inheritance.

source: Chule a-insungu dungjuijin Ephraim chate gamgi chu hitihi ahi. Solam sanga agoulou gamgi Ataroth-addar a pat Beth-horon sahlam gei ahi.
target: This was the territory of Ephraim, according to its clans: The boundary of their inheritance went from Ataroth Addar in the east to Upper Beth Horon

source: Chule gamgi chu twikhanglen sahlam sanga Michmethah geijin akikhodoh-in, chule solama Taanath-shiloh geijin ahung kikhodoh-in, hichu ajotpeh-in, solama Janoah chan akikho lhungpeh-in ahi.
target: and continued to the Mediterranean Sea. From Mikmethath on the north it curved eastward to Taanath Shiloh, passing by it to Janoah on the east.

source: Chuin hiche Janohah'a pat Ataroth le Naarah changei akikhosuh-in, Jericho ahopan chule Jordan'a akikholutne.
target: Then it went down from Janoah to Ataroth and Naarah, touched Jericho and came out at the Jordan.

source: Gampumpi chu Tappuah konin lhumlam sanga Kanah vapidung geijin akilhungdoh-in, hichu twikhanglen'a akikholutne. Hichehi Ephraim chate phung a-insung dungjuijuva agoulou gamchu ahi.
target: From Tappuah the border went west to the Kanah Ravine and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the Ephraimites, according to its clans.

source: Chule Manasseh chate goulah-a Ephraim chate goulo ding khopilen kikhendohho chu akhopilen jouseule akhodang dangho chu ahi.
target: It also included all the towns and their villages that were set aside for the Ephraimites within the inheritance of the Manassites.

source: Chule amahon Gezer'a cheng Kanaan miho chu ananodoh pouve. Hijeh chun Kanaan miho chu Ephraim mite lah-a tuni geijin achengun kai apeovin, ajenun ahi.
target: They did not dislodge the Canaanites living in Gezer; to this day the Canaanites live among the people of Ephraim but are required to do forced labor.

source: Manasseh phung dingin chan khat ana umin ahi, ajehchu ama Joseph cha masapen ahi. Gilead pa Manasseh chapa masapen Machir chu ahi. Hijeh chun ama galhat ahijeh-in Gilead le Bashan gama achenge, ajehchu amaho gal hat ahi.
target: This was the allotment for the tribe of Manasseh as Joseph’s firstborn, that is, for Makir, Manasseh’s firstborn. Makir was the ancestor of the Gileadites, who had received Gilead and Bashan because the Makirites were great soldiers.

source: A-insungu dungjuija Manasseh chilhah dangho Abiezer chate, Helek chate, Asriel chate, Shechem chate, Hepher chate chule Shemida chate dingin jong chan khat anaume. Amahohi a-insungu dungjuija Joseph chapa Manasseh chapate ahiuve.
target: So this allotment was for the rest of the people of Manasseh—the clans of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher and Shemida. These are the other male descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph by their clans.

source: Ahinla Manasseh chapa Machir, Machir chapa Gilead chapa Hepher, Hepher chapa Zelophehad'in achanute tilou chapa aneipon, achanuteu minho chu Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah le Tirzah ahi.
target: Now Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons but only daughters, whose names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah and Tirzah.

source: Chuin amahon Eliazer thempu, Nun chapa Joshua chule pipuiho ang ahin naijun kasopihou lah-a goulo eipehna dingun Pakaiyin Mosi thu anapeh ahi, agatiuve. Hijeh chun Pakai thupeh dungjuijin Joshua'n apateo sopiho lah-a agoulo dingu anapetan ahi.
target: They went to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders and said, “The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our relatives.” So Joshua gave them an inheritance along with the brothers of their father, according to the Lord ’s command.

source: Hitichun Jordan gal langkhatna um Gilead le Bashan tilouvin Manasseh chu chan som achange.
target: Manasseh’s share consisted of ten tracts of land besides Gilead and Bashan east of the Jordan,

source: Ajehchu Manasseh chanuten achapate lah-a gou alo khomun, chule Manasseh chapa dangho chu Gilead achang taove.
target: because the daughters of the tribe of Manasseh received an inheritance among the sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the descendants of Manasseh.

source: Manasseh gamchu Ashera pat Michmethah changei ahin, Shechem masanga um agamgi chu lhanglam En-tappuah mite chenna gam geijin akikhosuh-in ahi.
target: The territory of Manasseh extended from Asher to Mikmethath east of Shechem. The boundary ran southward from there to include the people living at En Tappuah.

source: Tun Tappuah gam Manasseh achangin, ahinla Manasseh gamgi chinna um Tappuah kho chu Ephraim chate-a ahi.
target: (Manasseh had the land of Tappuah, but Tappuah itself, on the boundary of Manasseh, belonged to the Ephraimites.)

source: Chuin agamgi chu Kanah vapidung lhanglama chun akilhungsuh-in, hiche Ephriam khopiho chu Manasseh khopiho lah-a aumin, chule Manasseh gamgi ngahna jongchu vapidung sahlam pang ahin, chule twikhanglen changei ahi.
target: Then the boundary continued south to the Kanah Ravine. There were towns belonging to Ephraim lying among the towns of Manasseh, but the boundary of Manasseh was the northern side of the ravine and ended at the Mediterranean Sea.

source: Lhanglam sang chu Ephraim ahin, sahlam gam chu Manasseh'a ahin, chule twikhanglen chu agamgi ahi. Chule sahlama Asher chule niso lama Issachar gamchan chu ahi.
target: On the south the land belonged to Ephraim, on the north to Manasseh. The territory of Manasseh reached the Mediterranean Sea and bordered Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.

source: Chule Manasseh chu Issachar le Asher gama Beth-shean le akhopiho, Ibleam le akhopiho Dor'a chenghole akhopiho, Endorra chenghole akhopiho, Taanach a chenghole akhopiho, Negiddo'a chenghole akhopiho, agamhou thum geijin achangin ahi.
target: Within Issachar and Asher, Manasseh also had Beth Shan, Ibleam and the people of Dor, Endor, Taanach and Megiddo, together with their surrounding settlements (the third in the list is Naphoth).

source: Ahijeng vangin Manasseh chapate chun chuche khopi lenho-a chengho chu anodoh joupouve. Hitichun Kanaan mite chu hiche gama chun achengden taove.
target: Yet the Manassites were not able to occupy these towns, for the Canaanites were determined to live in that region.

source: Ahijeng vangin ahitin ahi. Israel chate chu ahung hatdoh phatnun, amahon Kanaan mite chu kai apehsah-un, ahinla agama konin anodoh theng theipouve.
target: However, when the Israelites grew stronger, they subjected the Canaanites to forced labor but did not drive them out completely.

source: Chuin Joseph chaten Joshua jah-a, tunigeija Pakaiyin phatthei eiboh jeh uva mipi hijatpi kahiu henasa-a ibola kalodiu vang khat, chan khatsehbou neipeh uham, atiuve.
target: The people of Joseph said to Joshua, “Why have you given us only one allotment and one portion for an inheritance? We are a numerous people, and the Lord has blessed us abundantly.”

source: Chuin Joshua'n amaho chu adonbutnin, nangho natamlheh uva Ephraim lhanga chu natehbehseh tah uva ahile, Perizz mitele milen mihat ho gamsunga gammang lama nangho chetouvun lang gakituhchai taovin, ati.
target: “If you are so numerous,” Joshua answered, “and if the hill country of Ephraim is too small for you, go up into the forest and clear land for yourselves there in the land of the Perizzites and Rephaites.”

source: Chuin Joseph chate chun thinglhang gamchu keiho-a dingin alhingpoi. Jangcham gama cheng Kanaan mite jousele Bethshean le khopiho chengse chule Jezreel damjola chenghon thih kangtalai anei cheh uve atiuve.
target: The people of Joseph replied, “The hill country is not enough for us, and all the Canaanites who live in the plain have chariots fitted with iron, both those in Beth Shan and its settlements and those in the Valley of Jezreel.”

source: Chuin Joshua'n Joseph insung mite Ephraim le Manasseh henga, nangho mitamle thahat tahte nahiuvin chankhat sehbou chang pouvin nate,
target: But Joshua said to the tribes of Joseph—to Ephraim and Manasseh—“You are numerous and very powerful. You will have not only one allotment

source: ahinla molsang hi nangho ding ahi, gammang ahijeh-in kivatchaijun lang, agamgijui chan chu nangho ding ahi. Kanaan mite chun thih kangtalai neijuhen hatlheh jongleu nanodoh dingu ahi tin aseipeh-e.
target: but the forested hill country as well. Clear it, and its farthest limits will be yours; though the Canaanites have chariots fitted with iron and though they are strong, you can drive them out.”

source: Chuin Israel chate kikhom pumpi chu Shiloh a akikhom khomun, chua chun houkhom ho houbuh atungdoh-un ahi. Chule amasanguva gamchu athunoijuva aumtai.
target: The whole assembly of the Israelites gathered at Shiloh and set up the tent of meeting there. The country was brought under their control,

source: Chule Israel chate lah-a agou chanding muloulai phung sagi aum nalaijun ahi.
target: but there were still seven Israelite tribes who had not yet received their inheritance.

source: Chuin Joshua'n Israel chate jah-a, Pakai napateu Pathen'in napeh-u gam galo ding chu itihchan nahsah louva na-umsahdiu ham?
target: So Joshua said to the Israelites: “How long will you wait before you begin to take possession of the land that the Lord , the God of your ancestors, has given you?

source: Nalah uva phungkhat cheh-a konin mi thum lhengdoh-un, chule keiman amaho kasola amaho kipat uva gamchu agachotnuva, alodiu dungjuija agasuh chetnuva kahenga hungkilekit dingu ahiuve.
target: Appoint three men from each tribe. I will send them out to make a survey of the land and to write a description of it, according to the inheritance of each. Then they will return to me.

source: Chule amahon hichu hop sagi-a ahopdiu, Judah lhanglam gamsunga umding, Joseph insungin sahlam gamsung alodiu ahi.
target: You are to divide the land into seven parts. Judah is to remain in its territory on the south and the tribes of Joseph in their territory on the north.

source: Hitichun gam umchan chu hopsagi-a photchetna nanei uva, Pakai i-Pathen'u anga nangho dinga vang kavetpeh theina dinga hiche photchetna chu kahenga nahin lhut dingu ahi.
target: After you have written descriptions of the seven parts of the land, bring them here to me and I will cast lots for you in the presence of the Lord our God.

source: Ahinla Levi miten nalah uva chan aneipouve, ajehchu Pakai thempu natoh chu amaho chan ahijenge. Chule Gad le Reuben chule Manasseh phung kehkhat vang chun Pakai lhacha Mosi'n apehnao gam Jordan gal solam chu alodiu ahi.
target: The Levites, however, do not get a portion among you, because the priestly service of the Lord is their inheritance. And Gad, Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh have already received their inheritance on the east side of the Jordan. Moses the servant of the Lord gave it to them.”

source: Chuin mihochu akipat doh-un, achetauve ahi. Gam phochenna cheho chu Joshua'n thu apen, cheovin, gamchu gachonun, gapho chenun lang hiche Shiloh-a hi nangho dinga Pakai anga vang kavet theina dingin kahenga hung kile kitnun, ati.
target: As the men started on their way to map out the land, Joshua instructed them, “Go and make a survey of the land and write a description of it. Then return to me, and I will cast lots for you here at Shiloh in the presence of the Lord .”

source: Chuin mihochu acheuvin, gamchu agachon sohkeijun, khopilen hochu lekhabua asunlutnun, mun sagin akhenun ahi. Chule Shiloh lama chun alhonpiuvin Joshua henga ahungkile kitnun ahi.
target: So the men left and went through the land. They wrote its description on a scroll, town by town, in seven parts, and returned to Joshua in the camp at Shiloh.

source: Chuin Joshua'n Shiloh-a Pakai masanga amaho dingin vang asantan ahi. Chule chuachun Joshua'n gamchu Israel chate kihop khen dungjuijin ahoppehtan ahi.
target: Joshua then cast lots for them in Shiloh in the presence of the Lord , and there he distributed the land to the Israelites according to their tribal divisions.

source: Chule Benjamin phung chilhah ho chan chu a-insung dungjuijin ahungdohtan, achandiu gamsung Judah chatele Joseph chate gam kikah chu ahung hikhatan ahi.
target: The first lot came up for the tribe of Benjamin according to its clans. Their allotted territory lay between the tribes of Judah and Joseph:

source: Chule Sahlama agamgiu chu Jordan'a pat sahlam sanga Jericho lhang panga akikho touvin, Lhumlam molla chun akikho lutnin, Beth-aven gamthipma akilhung lutnin ahi.
target: On the north side their boundary began at the Jordan, passed the northern slope of Jericho and headed west into the hill country, coming out at the wilderness of Beth Aven.

source: Chule gamgi chu chu-a konchun Luz lam, lhanglama Luz kiti Bethel lhang panga akikhon, hichu Beth-horon noilam lhanglam sanga Ataroth-adar lama achesuh-in,
target: From there it crossed to the south slope of Luz (that is, Bethel) and went down to Ataroth Addar on the hill south of Lower Beth Horon.

source: chuin agamgi chu chua konin akikhon Beth-horon toh akigalsai lhanglam sanga um molsanga pat twipilen ning chu lhum-lhanglam sanga akikho kimvelin, Judah chate khopi khat Kirjath-baal, Kirjath-jearim kiti chu ahi. Hichu nilhumlama agamgiu chu ahi.
target: From the hill facing Beth Horon on the south the boundary turned south along the western side and came out at Kiriath Baal (that is, Kiriath Jearim), a town of the people of Judah. This was the western side.

source: Chule lhanglama agammu chu Kirjath-kearim monga kipat in agamgiu chu lhumlama akikhon Nephtoah twikulho-a akikholutnin ahi.
target: The southern side began at the outskirts of Kiriath Jearim on the west, and the boundary came out at the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

source: Chule agamgiu chu sahlama milen mihat ho damjola um Hinnom chapa jangcham masanga um molsanga akikho doh-in, lhanglam Jebus lhangpang Hinnom gom geijin akikhon Enrogel'a akikholutne.
target: The boundary went down to the foot of the hill facing the Valley of Ben Hinnom, north of the Valley of Rephaim. It continued down the Hinnom Valley along the southern slope of the Jebusite city and so to En Rogel.

source: Chule sahlama konin akikho kimvelin, Enshemesh-a akilhung lutnin, Adummin gam kentoh kigalsai Gelioth lama akilhungin chule Reuben chapa Bohan songphu-a akikholutne.
target: It then curved north, went to En Shemesh, continued to Geliloth, which faces the Pass of Adummim, and ran down to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.

source: Chule Arabah sah lamsang toh kigalsaijin akilhungpeh in, chule Arabah'a ahung kilhunglhan,
target: It continued to the northern slope of Beth Arabah and on down into the Arabah.

source: chuin agamgi chu Bethhoglah sahlam panga ahung kilhungin, chule gamgi akilhung doh hochu Jordan mong lhanglam chi twipi pang sahlama aumin, hichu lhanglam gamgi ahi.
target: It then went to the northern slope of Beth Hoglah and came out at the northern bay of the Dead Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan in the south. This was the southern boundary.

source: Chule Jordan chu solam sanga gamgi ahi. A-insung dung juijin hiche gamgi jousehi Benjamin chate goulo ding chu ahi.
target: The Jordan formed the boundary on the eastern side. These were the boundaries that marked out the inheritance of the clans of Benjamin on all sides.

source: Tun a-insungu dungjuija Benjamin chate phunga khopi lenho chu Jericho, Beth-hoglah, Keziz phaicham,
target: The tribe of Benjamin, according to its clans, had the following towns: Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,

source: chule Beth-arabah, Zemaraim le Bethel,
target: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,

source: chule Avim, Parah le Ophrah,
target: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,

source: chule Chephar-haammonai, Ophi le Geba khopilen somlenile akhoneo hotoh,
target: Kephar Ammoni, Ophni and Geba—twelve towns and their villages.

source: Gibeon, Ramah le Beeroth,
target: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,

source: chule Mizpeh, Chephirah le Mozah,
target: Mizpah, Kephirah, Mozah,

source: chule Rekem, Irpeel le Taralah,
target: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,

source: chule Zelah, Eleph chule Jebus hichu Jerusalem Gibeath le Kirjath ahin khopilen somleli le akhoneo hotoh ahi. A-insung dung juija Benjamin chaten alodingu chu ahi.
target: Zelah, Haeleph, the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah and Kiriath—fourteen towns and their villages. This was the inheritance of Benjamin for its clans.

source: Chuin anivei channa vangvetna chu Simeon henga, a-insungu dungjuijin Simeon chate phung dingngei chun ahungdoh-in ahi. Chule agoulo chu Judah chate goulo sunga uma ahi.
target: The second lot came out for the tribe of Simeon according to its clans. Their inheritance lay within the territory of Judah.

source: Chule amahon agoulo naova aneiju chu Beersheba ahiloule Sheba le Moladah,
target: It included: Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,

source: chule Hazashul, Balah le Azem,
target: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,

source: chule Eltolad, Bethul le Hormah,
target: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,

source: chule Siklag, Beth-marcaboth le Hazar-susah,
target: Ziklag, Beth Markaboth, Hazar Susah,

source: chule Beth-lebaoth, Sharuhen khopilen somlethum le akhoneoho,
target: Beth Lebaoth and Sharuhen—thirteen towns and their villages;

source: Ain, Remmon, Ether le Ashan, khopilen lile khoneoho,
target: Ain, Rimmon, Ether and Ashan—four towns and their villages—

source: chule lhanglama Baalath-beer, Ramath geijin hiche khopi lenho kimvela khoneoho jouse chu ahi. Hichehi a-insung dungjuija Simeon chate phungho gam lo chu ahi.
target: and all the villages around these towns as far as Baalath Beer (Ramah in the Negev). This was the inheritance of the tribe of the Simeonites, according to its clans.

source: Judah chateho chanding lah-a chu Simeon chate goulo uma ahin, ajehchu Judah chate chanchu amaho dinga lenbehseh ahin, hijeh-a chu Simeon chate goulo chu amaho goulo sunga chu aneiju ahi.
target: The inheritance of the Simeonites was taken from the share of Judah, because Judah’s portion was more than they needed. So the Simeonites received their inheritance within the territory of Judah.

source: Chuin a-insungu dungjuijin vangvet thumna chu Zebulun chate chunga achutai. Chule agoulo gamgi chu Sarid chan ahi.
target: The third lot came up for Zebulun according to its clans: The boundary of their inheritance went as far as Sarid.

source: Chule agamgiu chu twipia Meralah lama akilhung touvin, Dabbashath alhungin, chule Jokneam masanga vapidung chu alhungin ahi.
target: Going west it ran to Maralah, touched Dabbesheth, and extended to the ravine near Jokneam.

source: Chuin Sarid na konin Chisloth-tabor gamsung geijin nisolam sanga akiheijin, chuin Cabarathna achedoh-in Japhia geijin achetouvin ahi.
target: It turned east from Sarid toward the sunrise to the territory of Kisloth Tabor and went on to Daberath and up to Japhia.

source: Chule chua konin solam juijin Gittah-hepher le Ittah-kazin ajotpeh in, chule Remmon-mathoar'a Neah geijin achen,
target: Then it continued eastward to Gath Hepher and Eth Kazin; it came out at Rimmon and turned toward Neah.

source: chule agamgi chun Hannathon sahlam akhokhelin, chule akilhungdoh hochu Jiphtah-el phaicham ageijin,
target: There the boundary went around on the north to Hannathon and ended at the Valley of Iphtah El.

source: chule Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron le Idalah chule Bethlehem khopilen somlenitoh khopineoho ahiuve.
target: Included were Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah and Bethlehem. There were twelve towns and their villages.

source: Hiche khopilenle akhoneo hohi a-insungu dungjuija Zebulun chate goulo chu ahi.
target: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of Zebulun, according to its clans.

source: Chuin vangvet alina chu Issachar chunga, a-insungu dungjuijin Issachar chate dingin achutan ahi.
target: The fourth lot came out for Issachar according to its clans.

source: Chule agamsung chu Jezreel lamsanga Chesulloth le Shunem,
target: Their territory included: Jezreel, Kesulloth, Shunem,

source: chule Hapharaim, Shihon le Anaharath,
target: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

source: chule Rabbith, Kishon le Abez,
target: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

source: Chule Remeth, Engannim, En-haddah le Beth-Pazzez,
target: Remeth, En Gannim, En Haddah and Beth Pazzez.
