source: chule agamgi chu Tabor, Shahazimah le Beth-shemesh alhungin, chule agamgi ngahha kilhungdohho chu Jordan ageijin ahi. Khopilen somlegup le akhoneoho chu ahi.
target: The boundary touched Tabor, Shahazumah and Beth Shemesh, and ended at the Jordan. There were sixteen towns and their villages.

source: Khopihole akhoneoho, a-insungu dungjuija Issachar chate goulo chu hichehi ahi.
target: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Issachar, according to its clans.

source: Chuin vangvet a-nga channa chu a-insungu dungjuija Asher chate phung dingin ahungdoh tan ahi.
target: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of Asher according to its clans.

source: Chule agamgi ngahna chu Helkath, Hali, Reten le Achshaph,
target: Their territory included: Helkath, Hali, Beten, Akshaph,

source: chule Allammalech, Amad, Mishal, lhumlama Karmel le Shihor-libnahth gei ahin,
target: Allammelek, Amad and Mishal. On the west the boundary touched Carmel and Shihor Libnath.

source: chule nisolam sanga Beth-dago na akiheijin, Zebulun alhungin, Jiphthah-el gom Beth-emek le Neiel sahlama achen, veilamsang Cabulla achedoh-in,
target: It then turned east toward Beth Dagon, touched Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtah El, and went north to Beth Emek and Neiel, passing Kabul on the left.

source: chule Hebron, Rehod, Hammon le Kanah, Zidon len geijin jong,
target: It went to Abdon, Rehob, Hammon and Kanah, as far as Greater Sidon.

source: chujouvin agamgi chu Ramah-a akiheijin, khopidet Tyre le Hosah'a akiheijin, chule akilhungdoh ho chu Achzib geija konin twikhanglen chan alhunge.
target: The boundary then turned back toward Ramah and went to the fortified city of Tyre, turned toward Hosah and came out at the Mediterranean Sea in the region of Akzib,

source: Ummah jong, Aphek, Rehob, khopilen somnileni toh akhoneoho,
target: Ummah, Aphek and Rehob. There were twenty-two towns and their villages.

source: Hiche khopihole akhohohi a-insung dungjuija Asher chate phungin alouchu ahi.
target: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Asher, according to its clans.

source: Vangvet gupvei channa chu a-insunga dungjuijin Naphtali chate dingin ahungdoh-in ahi.
target: The sixth lot came out for Naphtali according to its clans:

source: Chuin agamgiu chu Heleph-a kon, Allon, Zaanannim, Adammi-nekeb, Jabneel, Lakum gei ahin, chule akilhungdoh ho chu Jordan geijin aumin ahi.
target: Their boundary went from Heleph and the large tree in Zaanannim, passing Adami Nekeb and Jabneel to Lakkum and ending at the Jordan.

source: Chukitnin agamgiu chu lhumlama Aznoth-tabor lama akiheijin, chua konin Hukkok alhungin, Zebulun lhanglam sang alhungin, chuin Asher lhumlam sanga achen, nisolam Jordan chunga Judah alhungin ahi.
target: The boundary ran west through Aznoth Tabor and came out at Hukkok. It touched Zebulun on the south, Asher on the west and the Jordan on the east.

source: Chule kul kikhokhum khopiho chu Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath Chinnereth,
target: The fortified towns were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Kinnereth,

source: chule Adamah, Ramah le Hezor,
target: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

source: chule Kedesh, Edrei le Enhazor,
target: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,

source: chule Iron le Migdalel, Horam, Beth-anath le Beth-shemesh khopilen somleko le khoneoho,
target: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath and Beth Shemesh. There were nineteen towns and their villages.

source: hiche khopihole khoneoho a-insung dungjuija Naphtali chate phung goulo chu ahi.
target: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Naphtali, according to its clans.

source: Chuin a-insung dungjuijin vangvetna sagina chu Dan chate dingin ahungdohtan,
target: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of Dan according to its clans.

source: chule alodingu agamsungu chu Zorah, Eshtaol le Ir-shemesh,
target: The territory of their inheritance included: Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir Shemesh,

source: chule Shaalabbin, Aijalon le Ithlah,
target: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,

source: chule Elon le Thimnathah le Ekron,
target: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,

source: chule Eltekeh le Gibbethhon le Baalath,
target: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

source: chule Jehud le Bene-berak le Gathrimmon,
target: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,

source: chule Me-jarkon le Rakkon Japho naija gamgi ahi.
target: Me Jarkon and Rakkon, with the area facing Joppa.

source: Chule Dan chate gamsung amaho dingin aneobehseh-in hijeh chun Dan chateho Leshem chate sat dingin akonun, chule ajouvun chemjamin athat gamun, chule gamchu alotaovin, achengun, Leshem chu apao min Dan alauvin Dan asah un ahi.
target: (When the territory of the Danites was lost to them, they went up and attacked Leshem, took it, put it to the sword and occupied it. They settled in Leshem and named it Dan after their ancestor.)

source: Hichehi akhopihole khoneohotoh a-insung dungjuijin Dan chate phungin gouva alodingu chu ahi.
target: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Dan, according to its clans.

source: Amahon gampumpi achanding dolcheh gamgi asekhennuva akihop jouphat un, Israel chaten alah uva Nun chapa Joshua chu agam loding apetaovin, ahi.
target: When they had finished dividing the land into its allotted portions, the Israelites gave Joshua son of Nun an inheritance among them,

source: Pakai thu dungjuijin aman athum Ephraim molla Timnath-serah geichun apeovin ahi. Chule aman khopilen chu asadoh-in chua chun achengtan ahi.
target: as the Lord had commanded. They gave him the town he asked for—Timnath Serah in the hill country of Ephraim. And he built up the town and settled there.

source: Hiche hohi agamlo dinguva Eleazar thempu le Nun Chapa Joshua, chule Israel chate aphunguva apa teovin, mipi ho houbuh kotpi phung, Pakai masang Siloh mun'a vangvet na-a agamlo dinguva ana hoppeh-u chu ahi. Hitihin amaho gamchu akihom jou taovin ahi.
target: These are the territories that Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the tribal clans of Israel assigned by lot at Shiloh in the presence of the Lord at the entrance to the tent of meeting. And so they finished dividing the land.

source: Pakaiyin Joshua jah-a aseijin, hitin ati.
target: Then the Lord said to Joshua:

source: Israel chate henga hitihin seijin, nanghon Mosi jah-a kasei bangin kiselna khopi lenho semmun ati.
target: “Tell the Israelites to designate the cities of refuge, as I instructed you through Moses,

source: Mikhatnin dihloutah a koiham khat atha-a ahile kiselna dinga hicheho chu nangho-a dinga thisan so-a phulading pa-a kona hoidohna hiding ahi.
target: so that anyone who kills a person accidentally and unintentionally may flee there and find protection from the avenger of blood.

source: Chule hitia chu ama chutobang khopilenho khatna chu jamlutna, khopi kotpiphunga adina chule chuche khopi-a um upaho jah-a ajeh aseiphongleh, amahon amachu khopi sunga alah lutnuva mun apeh dingu, hiti achu amahotoh chengding ahi.
target: When they flee to one of these cities, they are to stand in the entrance of the city gate and state their case before the elders of that city. Then the elders are to admit the fugitive into their city and provide a place to live among them.

source: Chule thisan phulading pachun, ahin nungdela ahile amahon mithatpa chu ama khutna apehdoh loudingu ahi. Ajehchu aman aheng akom chu hotna nei masalouva tosoija atha ahi.
target: If the avenger of blood comes in pursuit, the elders must not surrender the fugitive, because the fugitive killed their neighbor unintentionally and without malice aforethought.

source: Chule amachu mipi angsunga athu tandinga adin kahse-a chule hiche laija thempu chungnung thikahsea hiche khopi-a chu chengding ahi. Chutengle mithatpa chu ama khopilen ajamdohna khopi a-in'a chu kilekit ding ahi.
target: They are to stay in that city until they have stood trial before the assembly and until the death of the high priest who is serving at that time. Then they may go back to their own home in the town from which they fled.”

source: Chule amahon Naphtali molla um Galilee'a Kadesh, Ephraim molla Schechem chule Hebron kiti Judah molla um Kirjath-arba chu alhengun ahi.
target: So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

source: Chule Jericho solam Jordan gal langkhatna chun Reuben phungho lah-a phaicham gamthipma Bezer, Gad phungho lah-a Gilead'a Ramoth chule Manasseh phungho lah-a Bashan gama Golan apeovin ahi.
target: East of the Jordan (on the other side from Jericho) they designated Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau in the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead in the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan in the tribe of Manasseh.

source: Hichehohi Israel chate jousele alah uva khopem tosoija mithatchan chulama ajama thisan phulapa khutna kona athilouna dinga mipi ho masanga adin kahse-a akiselna dinga kilhengdoh khopiho chu ahi.
target: Any of the Israelites or any foreigner residing among them who killed someone accidentally could flee to these designated cities and not be killed by the avenger of blood prior to standing trial before the assembly.

source: Chujouvin Levi pateho luchangho chu Eleazar thempu heng, Nun chapa Joshua heng, Israel chate phung luchangho henga ahungun,
target: Now the family heads of the Levites approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the other tribal families of Israel

source: chule amahon Kanaan gamsunga um Shiloh a amaho henga kachena dingun khopi lenho chule kagancha ho dingun akhovelho eipehtha dinguva Mosi henga Pakaiyin thu anapehsa ahitai atiuve.
target: at Shiloh in Canaan and said to them, “The Lord commanded through Moses that you give us towns to live in, with pasturelands for our livestock.”

source: Chuin Pakai thupeh bangchun akhopilen houle akhoveluva ho jouse chu Israel chaten agoulouva konin Levi mite chandingin apeovin ahi.
target: So, as the Lord had commanded, the Israelites gave the Levites the following towns and pasturelands out of their own inheritance:

source: Chule Kohath te insung midingin vangvetna ahungdoh in, chule Aaron thempu chate amaho chu Levi mite ahiuvin, Judah phunga konle Simeon phunga konin chule Benjamin phunga konin khopilen somlethum vangvet na-a konin achangun ahi.
target: The first lot came out for the Kohathites, according to their clans. The Levites who were descendants of Aaron the priest were allotted thirteen towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin.

source: Chule Kohath chate amoh chengse chun Ephraim phung insungho-a konle, Dan phunga konin chule Manasseh phung kehkhatna konin khopilen som vangvet na-a konin achang taovin ahi.
target: The rest of Kohath’s descendants were allotted ten towns from the clans of the tribes of Ephraim, Dan and half of Manasseh.

source: Chule Gershon chateho chun vangvet na-a konin Issachar phung insungho-a kon, Asher phunga kon, Naphtali phunga kon, chule Bashan'a um Manasseh phung akehkhatna konin khopilen somlethum achangun ahi.
target: The descendants of Gershon were allotted thirteen towns from the clans of the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

source: Merari chaten a-insungu dungjuijin Reuben phunga kon, Gad phunga kon chule Zebulun phunga konin khopi somleni achangun ahi.
target: The descendants of Merari, according to their clans, received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Mosi athupeh dungjuijin khopilen hole akhovelho chu Israel chaten vangvet na-a konin Levi mite apetaovin ahi.
target: So the Israelites allotted to the Levites these towns and their pasturelands, as the Lord had commanded through Moses.

source: Chule amahon hichea amin kisei khopilenho hi Judah chate phunga konin Simeon chate phunga konin apedoh-un;
target: From the tribes of Judah and Simeon they allotted the following towns by name

source: Hichu Levi chate lah-a, Kohath Insunga kon Aaron chate chan chu ahi. Ajeh chu amaho chu vangvetna masapen changa ahiuve.
target: (these towns were assigned to the descendants of Aaron who were from the Kohathite clans of the Levites, because the first lot fell to them):

source: Chule amahon Judah thinglhang gama akhopi Hebron chu akimvela akhovelho pumin Anak pa Arba chu apetaovin ahi.
target: They gave them Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron), with its surrounding pastureland, in the hill country of Judah. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)

source: Ahin khopilen loujaohole khoho vangchu Jephunneh chapa Kaleb lodingin apetaovin ahi.
target: But the fields and villages around the city they had given to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his possession.

source: Hitichun amahon Aaron thempupa chate chu mithat ho kisellutna khopilen hidingin, Hebron le akhovelho chule Libnah le akhovelho pumin,
target: So to the descendants of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron (a city of refuge for one accused of murder), Libnah,

source: chule Jattir le akhovelho pumin Eshtemoa le akhoheng pumin,
target: Jattir, Eshtemoa,

source: chule Holon le akhovelho pumin, Debir le akhovelho pumin,
target: Holon, Debir,

source: chule a-in le akhovelho pumin, Juttah le akhovelho pumin, Beth-shemesh le akhovelho pumin, phungnia konchun khopilen ko apetaovin ahi.
target: Ain, Juttah and Beth Shemesh, together with their pasturelands—nine towns from these two tribes.

source: Chule Benjamin phunga konin Gibeon le akhovelho, Geba le akhovel ho,
target: And from the tribe of Benjamin they gave them: Gibeon, Geba,

source: Anathoth le akhovelho chule Almon le akhovel hotoh khopilen li ahi.
target: Anathoth and Almon, together with their pasturelands—four towns.

source: Aaron thempu chate khopilen abonin akhovelho pumin somlethum ahi.
target: The total number of towns for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, came to thirteen, together with their pasturelands.

source: Chule Kohath chate insungho, Kohath chate amoh Levi ho chun, Ephraim phunga kona avang vetnuva kon amu-u khopilenho chu aneijun ahi.
target: The rest of the Kohathite clans of the Levites were allotted towns from the tribe of Ephraim:

source: Ajehchu amahon Ephraim lhanga Shechem le akhovelho pumpin, mitha-a kona hoidohna khopilen hidingin Gezer jong akhovelho pumin,
target: In the hill country of Ephraim they were given Shechem (a city of refuge for one accused of murder) and Gezer,

source: Chule Kibzaim le akhovelho pumin, Beth-horon le akhovelho pumin, khopilen li amaho apeovin ahi.
target: Kibzaim and Beth Horon, together with their pasturelands—four towns.

source: Chule Dan phunga kon Eltekeh le akhovelho pumin, Gibethon le akhovelho pumin,
target: Also from the tribe of Dan they received: Eltekeh, Gibbethon,

source: Aijalon le akhovelho pumin, Gathrimmon le akhovel ho pumin khopilen li ahi.
target: Aijalon and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands—four towns.

source: Chule Manasseh phung kehkhatna kon Tanach le akhovel ho, chule Gathrimmon le akhovel ho pumin khopilen ni ahi.
target: From half the tribe of Manasseh they received: Taanach and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands—two towns.

source: Hiche kho jousele akhovelho jouse-a chenghi Kohath chate insung miho amohho dingchu khosom ahi.
target: All these ten towns and their pasturelands were given to the rest of the Kohathite clans.

source: Chule Gershon chateho Levi phungho chu Manasseh phung kehkhat ho channa-a kon, mithat ho kisellutna khopi Bashan gama Golan chu akhovel hotoh Beesh-terah khole akhovel hotoh, khopilen ni apetaovin ahi.
target: The Levite clans of the Gershonites were given: from the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan (a city of refuge for one accused of murder) and Be Eshterah, together with their pasturelands—two towns;

source: Chule Issachar phunga konin Kishon le akhovel hotoh, Dabareth le akhovel hotoh,
target: from the tribe of Issachar, Kishion, Daberath,

source: Jarmuth le akhovel hotoh, Engannim le akhovel hotoh, khopi li ahi.
target: Jarmuth and En Gannim, together with their pasturelands—four towns;

source: Chule Asher phunga kon Mishal le akhovel hotoh, Abdon le akhovel hotoh,
target: from the tribe of Asher, Mishal, Abdon,

source: Helkath le akhovel hotoh, Rahob le akhovel hotoh khopilen li ahi.
target: Helkath and Rehob, together with their pasturelands—four towns;

source: Chule Naphtali phunga konin Galilee sunga um Kedesh le akhovelho pumin, mithat ho kisellutna khopilen hidingin; chule Hammoth-dor le akhovelho pumin, Kartan le akhovelho pumin khopilen thum ahi.
target: from the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee (a city of refuge for one accused of murder), Hammoth Dor and Kartan, together with their pasturelands—three towns.

source: Gershon mite insungho khopilen jousele akhovelho pumin, khopilen somlethum ahi.
target: The total number of towns of the Gershonite clans came to thirteen, together with their pasturelands.

source: Chule Zebulun phunga kon, Levi mite amohse Merari chate insungho henga Jokneam le akhovel hotoh, Kartah le akhovel hotoh,
target: The Merarite clans (the rest of the Levites) were given: from the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam, Kartah,

source: Dimnah le akhovelho pumin, Nahalal le akhovelho pumin khopilen li ahi.
target: Dimnah and Nahalal, together with their pasturelands—four towns;

source: Chule Reuben phunga konin Bezer le akhovel hotoh, Zehazag le akhovel hotoh,
target: from the tribe of Reuben, Bezer, Jahaz,

source: Kedemoth le akhovel hotoh, Mephaath le akhovel hotoh khopilen lima ahi.
target: Kedemoth and Mephaath, together with their pasturelands—four towns;

source: Chule Gad phunga kon mithat ho hoidohna khopi Gilead gama Ramoth le akhovelho toh Mahanaim khole akhovel hotoh,
target: from the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead (a city of refuge for one accused of murder), Mahanaim,

source: Heshbon le akhovel hotoh, Jazer akhovel hotoh abona khopilen li ahi.
target: Heshbon and Jazer, together with their pasturelands—four towns in all.

source: Chutichun Levi insungmi amohse Merari chate insung mihon vangvet na-a kona amu khopilen jouse chu somleni ahi.
target: The total number of towns allotted to the Merarite clans, who were the rest of the Levites, came to twelve.

source: Israel chaten alo sunga um Levi mite khopilen jouse chu akhovelho hop pummin somlileget ahi.
target: The towns of the Levites in the territory held by the Israelites were forty-eight in all, together with their pasturelands.

source: Hiche khopilenho hin akimvel aneisoh keijun; hiche khopi jouse chu chutabanga chu umcheh ahi.
target: Each of these towns had pasturelands surrounding it; this was true for all these towns.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin apateo henga ana kihahsel nasa gamjouse chu Israel henga apetan, chuin amahon alovin chua acheng taovin ahi.
target: So the Lord gave Israel all the land he had sworn to give their ancestors, and they took possession of it and settled there.

source: Chule Pakaiyin apateo henga akihahsel dungjuijin, amaho akicholdosah tai. Chule amaho masanga amelmateu jouse apedohtai.
target: The Lord gave them rest on every side, just as he had sworn to their ancestors. Not one of their enemies withstood them; the Lord gave all their enemies into their hands.

source: Pakaiyin Israel insung henga thupha aseichan chu athonna um umlouvin, aguilhung sohkeijin ahi.
target: Not one of all the Lord ’s good promises to Israel failed; every one was fulfilled.

source: Hichun Joshua'n Reuben mite, Gad mite Manasseh phung akehkhat akouvin,
target: Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh

source: chule ahenguva, nanghon Pakai lhacha Mosi thupeh jouse nanit sohkeijun, chule kathupeh ka aw gin jouse chu nanit un ahi.
target: and said to them, “You have done all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded, and you have obeyed me in everything I commanded.

source: Nanghon nasopi ho ni hijatpihi, tuni geijin nadalha pouve. Amavang Pakai na Pathen'u thupeh chu nachingtup jingun ahi.
target: For a long time now—to this very day—you have not deserted your fellow Israelites but have carried out the mission the Lord your God gave you.

source: Chule amaho henga akitepna bangin tun Pakai na Pathen'un nasopi hou cholngahna apetan ahi. Hichejeh chun tun, nangho Jordan gal langkhat lama Pakaiyin asoh Mosi anapeh gama chun kile taovin.
target: Now that the Lord your God has given them rest as he promised, return to your homes in the land that Moses the servant of the Lord gave you on the other side of the Jordan.

source: Ahinla Pakai na Pathen'u ngailu dingle, alampi jouse jot dingle, athupeh ho juidingle, ama-a behjing dingle, nalhagao pumpiule nalungthimu pumpi-a jen dinga Pakai lhacha Mosi'n nathupeh-u danho tongdoh dingin chingtheijun, ati.
target: But be very careful to keep the commandment and the law that Moses the servant of the Lord gave you: to love the Lord your God, to walk in obedience to him, to keep his commands, to hold fast to him and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.”

source: Hitichun Joshua'n amaho phatthei aboh-in, asoldohtai. Chule amaho aponbuh uva akile taovin ahi.
target: Then Joshua blessed them and sent them away, and they went to their homes.

source: Tun Manasseh phung kehkhat chu Mosi in Bashan alodiuvin, anapen, ahivangin Joshua'n Jordan panga lhumlam sangchu asopite henga akehkhat chu apen ahi. Chuin Joshua'n amaho jongchu phatthei aboh-in aponbuh cheh uva asoldoh tan ahi.
target: (To the half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given land in Bashan, and to the other half of the tribe Joshua gave land on the west side of the Jordan along with their fellow Israelites.) When Joshua sent them home, he blessed them,

source: Chule amaho henga, von tamtah toh thih sum-eng, sana, dangka, gancha tamtah toh gou tamtah pumin naponbuh uva kileovin, nagalteova nalah-u thilkichom nasopi houtoh kihom uvin, ati.
target: saying, “Return to your homes with your great wealth—with large herds of livestock, with silver, gold, bronze and iron, and a great quantity of clothing—and divide the plunder from your enemies with your fellow Israelites.”

source: Chuin Reuben chate Gad chate chule Manasseh phung akehkhat akileuvin, Mosi khutna Pakaiyin athupeh banga amahon alodingu gamchu, Gilead gama chenna dinga Shiloh kiti Kanaan gama Israel chate-a konin apotdoh-un ahi.
target: So the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh left the Israelites at Shiloh in Canaan to return to Gilead, their own land, which they had acquired in accordance with the command of the Lord through Moses.

source: Chuin amahon Kanaan gamsunga um Jordan gamgi chin alhun phatnun, Reuben chate, Gad chatele Manasseh phung akeh in, Jordan pama vet dinga maicham khat asemun ahi.
target: When they came to Geliloth near the Jordan in the land of Canaan, the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an imposing altar there by the Jordan.

source: Chuin Israel chaten ajah phatnun, veuvin, Reuben chate, Gad chatele Manasseh phung keh khatnin Israel lampi laija Kanaan gamtoh kigalsaija Jordan pama chun maicham khat asemuvin ahi, ti thu ajaove.
target: And when the Israelites heard that they had built the altar on the border of Canaan at Geliloth near the Jordan on the Israelite side,

source: Hichu Israel chaten ajah phatnun, Israel chate abonchauvin amahotoh kidouva chedingin Shiloh a chun mipi akikhom taovin ahi.
target: the whole assembly of Israel gathered at Shiloh to go to war against them.

source: Chuin Israel chate chun Eleazar thempupa chapa Phinehas chu Gilead gamsunga um Reuben chate, Gad chate le Manasseh phung akehkhat henga chun asolun ahi.
target: So the Israelites sent Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, to the land of Gilead—to Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

source: Chule amaho chu Israel phung jouse lah-a inpi ngah cheh leng chapa som chule Israel asang asang lah-a apateo insunga a-upapen cheh ahiuve.
target: With him they sent ten of the chief men, one from each of the tribes of Israel, each the head of a family division among the Israelite clans.

source: Chule amaho Gilead gama um Reuben chate Gad chatele Manasseh phung akeh khat henga ahungun amahotoh akihouvun aseijuve.
target: When they went to Gilead—to Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh—they said to them:

source: Pakai Mipi kikhomte chun hitin atiuve, Israel Pakai Pathen chunga ipi nasuhkhelu hitam, Pakai nung najuinaova kona nakihei mang jenguva, Pakai douna-a maicham nakitundoh jenguhi.
target: “The whole assembly of the Lord says: ‘How could you break faith with the God of Israel like this? How could you turn away from the Lord and build yourselves an altar in rebellion against him now?

source: Peor'a chonsetna chu eiho dinga lhing loulai ham? Hiche-a kona chu eiho tuni geija thengloulai ihiuvin, hicheni chun Pakai mipite lah-a natset ana lengin ahi.
target: Was not the sin of Peor enough for us? Up to this very day we have not cleansed ourselves from that sin, even though a plague fell on the community of the Lord !

source: Amavang nangho tunia Pakai nung juina-a kona hi nakihei mang got teiteiju hitam? Tunia nanghon Pakai nadou ule jing nikhole Israel mipi chunga ama lunghana hung chuding ahi.
target: And are you now turning away from the Lord ? “ ‘If you rebel against the Lord today, tomorrow he will be angry with the whole community of Israel.

source: Hitajengjongle, nalonao gamchu athenlouva ahile, Pakai lona gam Pakai houbuh umna keiholah-a hungcheng jengun, amavang Pakai dounale keiho douna-in Pakai i-Pathen'u maicham tilou maicham dang semhih-un.
target: If the land you possess is defiled, come over to the Lord ’s land, where the Lord ’s tabernacle stands, and share the land with us. But do not rebel against the Lord or against us by building an altar for yourselves, other than the altar of the Lord our God.

source: Zarah chapa Achan'in sapset thil le suhkhel aneija kona, Israel mipikikhom chunga lunghana anachu-a hilouham? Chule hiche mipa chu ama khangitlou jeh-a achangseh-a thilouva hilou ham? atiuve.
target: When Achan son of Zerah was unfaithful in regard to the devoted things, did not wrath come on the whole community of Israel? He was not the only one who died for his sin.’ ”

source: Chuin Reuben chate, Gad chate, chule Manasseh phung akeh khatnin adonbutnun, chule Israel asang asang luchangho henga aseijun
target: Then Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh replied to the heads of the clans of Israel:

source: Pakai, Pathen ho Pathen, Pakai Pathenho Pathen chun ahei, chule Israel honjong ahetdingu ahi, hichehi douna ahia, ahiloule Pakai douna-a suhkhel ahile, (tunin neihinghoi hih-un),
target: “The Mighty One, God, the Lord ! The Mighty One, God, the Lord ! He knows! And let Israel know! If this has been in rebellion or disobedience to the Lord , do not spare us this day.

source: Keihon Pakai nungjui na-a kona kihei mangna dinga maicham kasemuva, ahiloule achunga govam thilto katouva, chuche-a chu chamna thilto katouva ahileh Pakaiyin eiphulah-u hen.
target: If we have built our own altar to turn away from the Lord and to offer burnt offerings and grain offerings, or to sacrifice fellowship offerings on it, may the Lord himself call us to account.

source: Chule hiche kichatnajeh-a hiche chu kabollou-uleh, phat ahunglhun phatleh nachateovin kachateu henga, Israel Pakai Pathen chu ilonge nati uham? tia ahinsei theiju ahi.
target: “No! We did it for fear that some day your descendants might say to ours, ‘What do you have to do with the Lord , the God of Israel?

source: Reuben chate, Gad chate, nanghole keiho kikah-a Pakaiyin Jordan hi gamgia asem ahin, nanghon Pakaiya chan naneipouve, atiuva, nachateovin, kachateu Pakai ginna asuhtang theidiu ginna-a kabolu ahi.
target: The Lord has made the Jordan a boundary between us and you—you Reubenites and Gadites! You have no share in the Lord .’ So your descendants might cause ours to stop fearing the Lord .

source: Hichejeh chun keihon tun eiho govam thilto tona ding hilou, chule ganlhai thilto tona ding hilouvin maicham khat semdingin kigongu hite, katiuvin,
target: “That is why we said, ‘Let us get ready and build an altar—but not for burnt offerings or sacrifices.’

source: ahinla keihon govam thilto le, kilhaina thilto chuleh chamna thilto hotoh Pakai anga kilhaina kaboluhi khonunga hungding ichateu dinga hettohsahna hung hiding ahi. Khonungle nachateovin kachateu henga nangho Pakaiya chan naneipouve, atilounadiu ahi.
target: On the contrary, it is to be a witness between us and you and the generations that follow, that we will worship the Lord at his sanctuary with our burnt offerings, sacrifices and fellowship offerings. Then in the future your descendants will not be able to say to ours, ‘You have no share in the Lord .’

source: Hiche jeh-a chu keihon hung hitiding ahi katiuve, amahon keiho koma ahiloule khonungle kasonho koma aseitengule; Veovin kapu kapa teovin Pakai maicham lim kigong abollu chu govam thiltona ding ahipon, ganlhaina ding jong ahipoi. Amavang keihole nangho kikah-a hettohsahna ahi, tia keihon kaseipeh dingu ahi.
target: “And we said, ‘If they ever say this to us, or to our descendants, we will answer: Look at the replica of the Lord ’s altar, which our ancestors built, not for burnt offerings and sacrifices, but as a witness between us and you.’

source: Keihon tunia Pakai kadou uva, ama-a kon kiheimanga, ahoubuh masanga um Pakai i-Pathen'u maicham tilouva govam thiltoho, nehding thilto ahilouleh ganlhaina ding dang kasem louhel dingu ahi.
target: “Far be it from us to rebel against the Lord and turn away from him today by building an altar for burnt offerings, grain offerings and sacrifices, other than the altar of the Lord our God that stands before his tabernacle.”

source: Chuin Phinehas thempupa aumpihon Israel asang asang luchangho le mipi kikhomho vaipohon Reuben chate, Gad chate, Manasseh chaten aseiju chu ajah phatnun, alungu alhaitan ahi.
target: When Phinehas the priest and the leaders of the community—the heads of the clans of the Israelites—heard what Reuben, Gad and Manasseh had to say, they were pleased.

source: Chuin Eliazar thempupa chapa Phinehas chun Reuben chate, Gad chate, Manasseh chate henga, tuni hin keihon ilah uva Pakai aume ti kaheuve; ajeh chu Pakai douna-in suhkhel nabol pouvin ahi. Tun nanghon Pakai khutna konin Israel chate chu nahuhdoh taovin ahi.
target: And Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, said to Reuben, Gad and Manasseh, “Today we know that the Lord is with us, because you have not been unfaithful to the Lord in this matter. Now you have rescued the Israelites from the Lord ’s hand.”

source: Chule Eliazar thempu chapa Phinehas chun vaipoho Reuben chate, Gad chate umna Gilead gama konin Kanaan gam Israel chate henga, thu ahinpo taovin ahi.
target: Then Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, and the leaders returned to Canaan from their meeting with the Reubenites and Gadites in Gilead and reported to the Israelites.

source: Chule hicheho chun Israel asulunglhai lheh in, chule Israel chate chun Pathen avahchoi taovin ahi. Chule Reuben chate chenna gam suhmangna dinga galsatna cheding agotapouvin ahi.
target: They were glad to hear the report and praised God. And they talked no more about going to war against them to devastate the country where the Reubenites and the Gadites lived.

source: Chuin Reuben chate, Gad chaten, maicham chu hettohsah asah-un ahi. Ajehchu hichehi eiho kah-a Pakai chu Pathen ahi ti melchihna hiding ahi.
target: And the Reubenites and the Gadites gave the altar this name: A Witness Between Us—that the Lord is God.

source: Chule Israelte avelluva adou miho-a kona Pakaiyin choldona apehjou nungpeh-in, Joshua chu ateh lhehtan, chule akum atamin avoilhatan ahi.
target: After a long time had passed and the Lord had given Israel rest from all their enemies around them, Joshua, by then a very old man,

source: Chuin Joshua'n Israel jouse, a-upahou, aluchanghou, avaipohou, akouvin amaho henga keima katehtan, kakum jong atamtan ahi, ati.
target: summoned all Israel—their elders, leaders, judges and officials—and said to them: “I am very old.

source: Chule Pakai na Pathen'un nangho jeh-a hiche namho jouse chunga abol hojouse hi namuvin ahi. Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'u chu gal nasatpehpao chu ahi.
target: You yourselves have seen everything the Lord your God has done to all these nations for your sake; it was the Lord your God who fought for you.

source: Veovin, keiman twipilen lhumlam gei jenga jong Jordan'a kona naphung houvin alotheina dinguva, keiman nam jouse kasuhmanga, hiche nam amoh ho chu vangvet na-a kahop peh-u nahi, ati.
target: Remember how I have allotted as an inheritance for your tribes all the land of the nations that remain—the nations I conquered—between the Jordan and the Mediterranean Sea in the west.

source: Chule Pakai na Pathen'un na masang uva kona amaho anomanga, namitmuva kona akaidoh-a; Pakai na Pathen'u naheng uva akitepna banga chu nanghon agamu chu nalo dingu ahi.
target: The Lord your God himself will push them out for your sake. He will drive them out before you, and you will take possession of their land, as the Lord your God promised you.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu nangho jetlam ahiloule veilama nakiheile louna dinguva, lekha-a kisun Mosi danthu jouse jui dingle tongdoh dingin hangsanun.
target: “Be very strong; be careful to obey all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, without turning aside to the right or to the left.

source: Chule nangho lah-a umden namho lah-a chehih-un, a-pathen'u minjong pan hih-un; amaho mina kihahsel hih-un, jen jong jen hih-un, a-angsung uva jong bohkhup hih-un.
target: Do not associate with these nations that remain among you; do not invoke the names of their gods or swear by them. You must not serve them or bow down to them.

source: Ahinla tuni chana nabol bangun Pakai na Pathen'u chu kolchah jingun.
target: But you are to hold fast to the Lord your God, as you have until now.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin namlenle namhat ho namasanguva adeldohtai. Ahin nangho dingin tunigeijin namasanguva koimacha adingjou pon,
target: “The Lord has driven out before you great and powerful nations; to this day no one has been able to withstand you.

source: nalah uva mikhatnin mi sangkhat adelthei ahi. Ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'un, nangho dinga ama kitepna banga gal nabolpeh-u ahi.
target: One of you routs a thousand, because the Lord your God fights for you, just as he promised.

source: Pakai na Pathen'u nangailut nadingun nangho nasatah-in kigingphaovin lang hiuvin.
target: So be very careful to love the Lord your God.

source: Ahiloule nangho nakinung leuva, akidalha namho nalah uva cheng nalaiho hi nakivop piuva, amahotoh jilecha-a nakilah taouva, amahotoh nakiloi uva, amahon jong nakivop piuva ahile,
target: “But if you turn away and ally yourselves with the survivors of these nations that remain among you and if you intermarry with them and associate with them,

source: Pakai na Pathen'un leiset phatah napeh-u, hiche munna hi namanthah tokah seova amahochu nangho dinga thangle pel hiding, chule napangteni-a dinga kivohna mol, chule namit dinguva ling hunghijo ding ahi. Hijeh chun kihetchen uvin.
target: then you may be sure that the Lord your God will no longer drive out these nations before you. Instead, they will become snares and traps for you, whips on your backs and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land, which the Lord your God has given you.

source: Chule veuvin, tunia keima leiset mijouse lampia chemang ding kahi, chule nalungsungu le nalhagao uvin naheuve. Pakai na-Pathen'un nangho chunga asei thilho chu thil khatjong athon aumpon ahi.
target: “Now I am about to go the way of all the earth. You know with all your heart and soul that not one of all the good promises the Lord your God gave you has failed. Every promise has been fulfilled; not one has failed.

source: Hijeh-a chu hung hitiding ahi, Pakai na Pathen'un nateppeh dungjui uva, thil jouse chu nangho dinga apha ahunglhun banga, Pakai na Pathen'un leiset phatah napehna uva kona nasuh manghel kahseuva Pakai na Pathen'un thilphalou jouse nachunga ahinlhun sah ding ahi.
target: But just as all the good things the Lord your God has promised you have come to you, so he will bring on you all the evil things he has threatened, until the Lord your God has destroyed you from this good land he has given you.

source: Aman nahenga nathupeh Pakai na Pathen thulhun, chu chonval tah-a nasuhkeh uva, nacheuva pathen dang naga jenuva, chule amaho anga nagabokhup-uleh, Pakai lunghanna chu hungkong jalintin, aman napeh-u gampha-a chu mangang tah-a namanthah dingu ahi.
target: If you violate the covenant of the Lord your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, the Lord ’s anger will burn against you, and you will quickly perish from the good land he has given you.”

source: Chuin Joshua'n Israel phung jouse Shechem'a akhomin, Israel upaho jouse phung bulpiho athutanhou, avaipohou jouse akouvin chule amaho Pathen anga akipelut taovin ahi.
target: Then Joshua assembled all the tribes of Israel at Shechem. He summoned the elders, leaders, judges and officials of Israel, and they presented themselves before God.

source: Chuin Joshua'n mipi ho henga hitin aseije, Israelte Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, nidang laijin napateu chu vadunglen gal langkhatna ana chengun, Abraham pa le, Nahor pa Terah tah-in jong, abonun pathen dang ana jenun, ahi.
target: Joshua said to all the people, “This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘Long ago your ancestors, including Terah the father of Abraham and Nahor, lived beyond the Euphrates River and worshiped other gods.

source: Chuin keiman napau Abraham chu vadunglen gal langkhatna kapuidoh-in, Kanaan gamsung pumpi-a kapuijin, achilhah kapunsah-in chule Isaac kapen ahi.
target: But I took your father Abraham from the land beyond the Euphrates and led him throughout Canaan and gave him many descendants. I gave him Isaac,

source: Chule keiman Isaac chu Jacob le Esau kapen, chule alodingin Esau chu Seir mol kapen ahinla Jacob le achate vang Egypt'a achesuh taovin ahi.
target: and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I assigned the hill country of Seir to Esau, but Jacob and his family went down to Egypt.

source: Keiman Mosi le Aaron kasollin, Egypt gama chun alah uva thil kidang kabolin hise kalansah in chule hiche jouchun kapuidoh in ahi.
target: “ ‘Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I afflicted the Egyptians by what I did there, and I brought you out.

source: Chule keiman napateu chu Egypt'a konin kahin puidoh-in, chule nangho twipi lama nahungun, chule Egypt miho chun twipisan geijin napateu chu kangtalai le sakol in ahin nungdelun ahi.
target: When I brought your people out of Egypt, you came to the sea, and the Egyptians pursued them with chariots and horsemen as far as the Red Sea.

source: Chule amaho Pakai henga akau le nangho le Egypt miho kikah-a aman muthim ajinsah-in, twipi chu achunguva alonsah-in, amaho akhukhumin, chule Egypt mite chunga ipi katoh ham tichu namitnun naveovin ahi. Chule nangho phat sottah gamthipma naum taovin ahi.
target: But they cried to the Lord for help, and he put darkness between you and the Egyptians; he brought the sea over them and covered them. You saw with your own eyes what I did to the Egyptians. Then you lived in the wilderness for a long time.

source: Chuin Jordan gal langa um Amor mite gama kapuilutnun, amahon nangho nakisat piuvin, chuin agamu chu nalotheina dingun amahochu nakhut uva kapen, chuin nangho masanga kasumangin ahi.
target: “ ‘I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived east of the Jordan. They fought against you, but I gave them into your hands. I destroyed them from before you, and you took possession of their land.

source: Hichun Moab lengpa Zippor chapa Balak akipatnin Israel asatnin, chuin Beor chapa Balaam chu nagaosap dingun akousah-in,
target: When Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, prepared to fight against Israel, he sent for Balaam son of Beor to put a curse on you.

source: ahivangin ken Balaam thu kangaipon, hichejeh chun aman nang phatthei naboh jingin, hitia chu ama-a kona kahuhdoh nahi.
target: But I would not listen to Balaam, so he blessed you again and again, and I delivered you out of his hand.

source: Chuin nangho Jordan galla nacheovin, Jericho'a nahungun, Amor mi Perizz mi, Kanaan mi, Hit mi, Girgash mi, Hiv mi, Jebus miho chule Jericho hon nasatnun, ahin ken amaho, nangho khutna kapen ahi.
target: “ ‘Then you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. The citizens of Jericho fought against you, as did also the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites and Jebusites, but I gave them into your hands.

source: Chuin nangho masanga amaho delmang dingin khoingal ho kasolin; Amor lengteni chunga jong, hichu nangho chemjamle thal'a kon ahipon ahi.
target: I sent the hornet ahead of you, which drove them out before you—also the two Amorite kings. You did not do it with your own sword and bow.

source: Chule nangho ngaito hilouhelin ken nangho gam kapen, chule nasah louhelu khopi-a nacheng uvin, chule naphu louhelu lengpi theile Olive thei naneovin ahi.
target: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities you did not build; and you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.’

source: Hiche jehchun tun, Pakai ginguvin, lunglut tahle dihtah-in jen'uvin, napa teovin vadunglen gal langkhat le Egypt gama anahouvu pathen dangho chu paimangun chule Pakai jen'uvin.
target: “Now fear the Lord and serve him with all faithfulness. Throw away the gods your ancestors worshiped beyond the Euphrates River and in Egypt, and serve the Lord .

source: Chule nangho dinga Pakai jen chu aphalou abahle, tunin najen ding chu nangman lhengdoh-in, Vadunglen gal lama napateovin anajen a-pathen hou chu najendingu ham? Ahiloule agama nana chennu Amor miho pathen chu najen dingu ham? Amavang keile ka-insung mite vangin Pakai kajen dingu ahi.
target: But if serving the Lord seems undesirable to you, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your ancestors served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you are living. But as for me and my household, we will serve the Lord .”

source: Chuin mihochun adonbutnun, Pakai Pathen'in ajahda keihon pathen dang iti nama jongle jenpou vinge atiuve.
target: Then the people answered, “Far be it from us to forsake the Lord to serve other gods!

source: Ajehchu Egypt gama keiho le kapateu soh in'a kona eipuidoh uva chu Pakai Ka Pathen'u ahin, kamit mutah uva melchihna loupitah tah abolin, chuleh kachena chanule kajotpanao miho-a konin eihuhdoh-uve.
target: It was the Lord our God himself who brought us and our parents up out of Egypt, from that land of slavery, and performed those great signs before our eyes. He protected us on our entire journey and among all the nations through which we traveled.

source: Chule Pakaiyin mijouse, agama cheng Amor mite jengjong, kama sang uva adeldoh-in; hiche jeh-a chun keihon Pakai kajen dingu ahi, ajehchu Amachu ka Pathen'u ahi.
target: And the Lord drove out before us all the nations, including the Amorites, who lived in the land. We too will serve the Lord , because he is our God.”

source: Chuin Joshua'n miho henga chun Pakai chu najen theilou dingu ahi, ajehchu ama Pathen theng ahin, thangthip Pathen ahin, nagolkeh naole nachonset nahou angaidam louding ahi ati.
target: Joshua said to the people, “You are not able to serve the Lord . He is a holy God; he is a jealous God. He will not forgive your rebellion and your sins.

source: Nanghon Pakai chu nadalhah uva gamdang pathen najen uva ahile, nangho dinga thilpha abolnunga, nachunga khansetna ahinlhun sah jeng ding ahi.
target: If you forsake the Lord and serve foreign gods, he will turn and bring disaster on you and make an end of you, after he has been good to you.”

source: Chuin mipihon Joshua henga, ahipoi, keihon Pakai bou kajendingu ahi, atiuve.
target: But the people said to Joshua, “No! We will serve the Lord .”

source: Chuin Joshua'n mipi ho henga, nanghon Pakai jending joh tunin nakilhen taovin ahi, ti hettohsah chu nanghotah nahiuve atile amahon keihotah ahettohsah kahitaove, atiuvin ahi.
target: Then Joshua said, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the Lord .” “Yes, we are witnesses,” they replied.

source: Hichejeh chun tun nalah uva um gamdang pathenho chu paidoh-un, chule Pakai Israel Pathen henga nalungu koijun, ati.
target: “Now then,” said Joshua, “throw away the foreign gods that are among you and yield your hearts to the Lord , the God of Israel.”

source: Chuin mipihon Joshua henga, Pakai ka Pathen'u chu jenung kating, ama thu jengbou kangai dingu ahi atiuve.
target: And the people said to Joshua, “We will serve the Lord our God and obey him.”

source: Hicheni chun Joshua'n mipitoh thulhun asemin, chule kitepnadan kisun khatle chondan khat Shechem'a aphutdoh-in ahi.
target: On that day Joshua made a covenant for the people, and there at Shechem he reaffirmed for them decrees and laws.

source: Chuin Joshua'n hiche thuho chu Pathen dan lekhabua ajihlutnin, chuin song lenpitah khat alan, gangpi phungnoi khatna atungin, hiche chu Pakai muntheng kom ahi.
target: And Joshua recorded these things in the Book of the Law of God. Then he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak near the holy place of the Lord .

source: Chuin Joshua'n mipi ho henga, veuvin, hiche songhi eiho kah-a hettohsah chu ahi. Pakaiyin ihenguva aseijouse chu hiche hin ajatan ahi; hijeh-a chu hichehi nangho dinga hettohsah hiding, achutiloule na Pathen chu nuse khagetnun nate, ati.
target: “See!” he said to all the people. “This stone will be a witness against us. It has heard all the words the Lord has said to us. It will be a witness against you if you are untrue to your God.”

source: Hitichun Joshua'n mipi ho chu a-inuva kilecheh dingin akikhensahtan ahi.
target: Then Joshua dismissed the people, each to their own inheritance.

source: Chule ahung hitin ahi, hiche jouchun Nun chapa Joshua Pakai soh chu kum jakhat le kumsom ahin athitan ahi.
target: After these things, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the Lord , died at the age of a hundred and ten.

source: Gaash lhang sahlam sanga, Ephraim molla um Timnath-serah sunga ama chandinga kisem gamgi chinna chun avuitaovin ahi.
target: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath Serah in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

source: Chuin Joshua hinsungsen chule upaho, Joshua sanga upajoho Pakaiyin Israelte dinga anatoh jouse anaheho adam sungu chun Israel mipi ho chun Pakai anajui sohkeijun ahi.
target: Israel served the Lord throughout the lifetime of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had experienced everything the Lord had done for Israel.

source: Chule Israel chaten Egypt'a kona Joseph guho apoh touvu chu, Shechem pa Hamor chate-a kona Jacob'in dangka jakhatna anachoh achun avuijun, chule hichu Joseph chate lonamun ahitan ahi.
target: And Joseph’s bones, which the Israelites had brought up from Egypt, were buried at Shechem in the tract of land that Jacob bought for a hundred pieces of silver from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem. This became the inheritance of Joseph’s descendants.

source: Chuin Aaron chapa Eleazar athitan, chuin amahon Ephraim lhanga achapa Phinehas anapehnao agamsung lhanga chun avuitaovin ahi.
target: And Eleazar son of Aaron died and was buried at Gibeah, which had been allotted to his son Phinehas in the hill country of Ephraim.

source: Tun Joshua thi nungin ahitin ahi, Israel miten Pakai henga, Keiho-a dinga Canaan mite douva kisatpi dinga koi che masapen dingham? tin adongun ahi.
target: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites asked the Lord , “Who of us is to go up first to fight against the Canaanites?”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin, Judah chetou ding ahi; Ven, keiman gamsunghi akhutna kapehdoh ahitai ati.
target: The Lord answered, “Judah shall go up; I have given the land into their hands.”

source: Chuin Judah'in asopipa Simeon hengah, Canaan mite eisat khompi dingin keima eikipe kagam lona-a hungtouvin; chule chutobangma chun nangma nakipe nagam lona-a jong kilhonpinge, ati. Hitichun Simeon'in akilhonpin ahi.
target: The men of Judah then said to the Simeonites their fellow Israelites, “Come up with us into the territory allotted to us, to fight against the Canaanites. We in turn will go with you into yours.” So the Simeonites went with them.

source: Chuin Judah achetouvin, chule Pakaiyin Canaan mite le Perizz mite chu akhutna apehdoh tan: chule amahon Bezek'a chun mi sangsom athat uvin ahi.
target: When Judah attacked, the Lord gave the Canaanites and Perizzites into their hands, and they struck down ten thousand men at Bezek.

source: Chule amahon Adonibezek chu Bezek'a amuvin, ama chu akisat piuvin, chule Canaan mite le Perizz mite chu athatnun ahi.
target: It was there that they found Adoni-Bezek and fought against him, putting to rout the Canaanites and Perizzites.

source: Ahivangin Adonibezek ajamin; chuin amahon anungdelun, amanun, chule akhutpi le akeng khopiho atanpeh-un ahi.
target: Adoni-Bezek fled, but they chased him and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.

source: Chule Adonibezek'in, Leng somsagi akhutpiu le akengpiu kitanlhaho chun kadokhang noija anmal akilokhomu ahin: keiman kana bol bang banga chu Pathen'in kachunga eilethuh ahitai ati. Chule amahon ama chu Jerusalem'a ahinpuijun, chua chun ama athitai.
target: Then Adoni-Bezek said, “Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off have picked up scraps under my table. Now God has paid me back for what I did to them.” They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

source: Tun Judah chatehon Jerusalem asatnun, alauvin, chemjamin asatnun, chule khopi chu meijin ahal lhaovin ahi.
target: The men of Judah attacked Jerusalem also and took it. They put the city to the sword and set it on fire.

source: Chule hiche nungchun Judah chate chu molsanga cheng, lhanglama cheng, chule phaichama cheng Canaan mite toh kisat dingin achesuh-un ahi.
target: After that, Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites living in the hill country, the Negev and the western foothills.

source: Chuin Judah'in Hebron'a cheng Canaan miho akisatpin; (tun Hebron hi masangin Kirjath-arba ana kiti:) chuin amahon Sheshai, Ahiman, chule Talmai chu athatnun ahi.
target: They advanced against the Canaanites living in Hebron (formerly called Kiriath Arba) and defeated Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai.

source: Chuin chua konchun Debir'a chengho akisatpin ahi: masangin Debir min chu Kirjath-sepher anahi.
target: From there they advanced against the people living in Debir (formerly called Kiriath Sepher).

source: Chule Caleb'in, Koihile Kirjath-sepher gasatna, gala-a aumleh, amachu ajidinga kachanu Achsah kapeh ding ahi, ati.
target: And Caleb said, “I will give my daughter Aksah in marriage to the man who attacks and captures Kiriath Sepher.”

source: Chuin Caleb naopa Kenaz chapa Othniel'in hichu agalatan; chuin aman achanu Achsah chu ajidin apetan ahi.
target: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it; so Caleb gave his daughter Aksah to him in marriage.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, amanu amapa henga ahung phatnin, amanun apa henga gam athumdin angehtai. Chuin amanu asangan'a konin akumlhan ahile, Caleb'in amanu henga, Ipi nadeijem? anati.
target: One day when she came to Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What can I do for you?”

source: Chuin amanun ahenga, Phatthei neiboh-in: Nangman lhanglam gam neipeh ahi ngaleh, twinahho jong neipen, ati. Chuin Caleb'in twinah sahnung le lhangnung chu apetai.
target: She replied, “Do me a special favor. Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me also springs of water.” So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.

source: Chuin Mosi nupapa Ken mipa chate chu tumthing kena khopi-a konchun Judah chate toh apotdoh-un, Arad lhanglama um Juda gamthipma alutnun; chule acheuvin miho lah-a chun agacheng taovin ahi.
target: The descendants of Moses’ father-in-law, the Kenite, went up from the City of Palms with the people of Judah to live among the inhabitants of the Desert of Judah in the Negev near Arad.

source: Chuin Judah chu asopipa Simeon toh achen, Zaphath'a cheng Canaan mite athat nun, asugam helun ahi. Chule akhopi minchu Hormah akitin ahi.
target: Then the men of Judah went with the Simeonites their fellow Israelites and attacked the Canaanites living in Zephath, and they totally destroyed the city. Therefore it was called Hormah.

source: Chule Judah'in Gaza chu agamsung pumpi toh, Askelon chu agamsung pumpi toh, Ekron chu agamsung pumpi toh alan ahi.
target: Judah also took Gaza, Ashkelon and Ekron—each city with its territory.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Judah aumpin; aman molsanga chengho chu adelmangin; amavang phaichama chengho chun thih sakol kangtalai aneijeh-un adeldoh joupon ahi.
target: The Lord was with the men of Judah. They took possession of the hill country, but they were unable to drive the people from the plains, because they had chariots fitted with iron.

source: Chule Mosi'n anasei bangin Hebron chu Caleb apeuvin ahi. Chuin aman chukoma konchun Anak chate thumho chu adeldoh-in ahi.
target: As Moses had promised, Hebron was given to Caleb, who drove from it the three sons of Anak.

source: Chule Jerusalem'a chenga Jebus mite chu Benjamin chaten adeldoh pouvin; amavang tunigeijin Jebus mite chu Benjamin chatetoh Jerusalem'a achengkhom nalaijun ahi.
target: The Benjamites, however, did not drive out the Jebusites, who were living in Jerusalem; to this day the Jebusites live there with the Benjamites.

source: Chule Joseph insung miho jong chu Bethel satnin akonun; chule Pakaiyin amaho aumpin ahi.
target: Now the tribes of Joseph attacked Bethel, and the Lord was with them.

source: Chule Joseph insung miho chun Bethel gavelhi din mi asolun ahi. (Masangin hiche khopi minchu Luz anakisah-in ahi.)
target: When they sent men to spy out Bethel (formerly called Luz),

source: Chuin gam velhihon khopi-a kona hungdoh mikhat amuvin, ahengah, Kataovu ahi, khopi lutna hoilang ham neihilun, chutile hepina kamusah dingu nahi, atiuve.
target: the spies saw a man coming out of the city and they said to him, “Show us how to get into the city and we will see that you are treated well.”

source: Chuin aman khopi lutna avetsah phatnin, amahon khopi chu chemjamin asumangun; mipa vang chu a-insung mite toh asoldoh taovin ahi.
target: So he showed them, and they put the city to the sword but spared the man and his whole family.

source: Chuin mipa chu Hit miho gama achen, khopi khat agatungdoh-in, hichu Luz asah-in: tuni geijin hiche minchu apujing nalaijin ahi.
target: He then went to the land of the Hittites, where he built a city and called it Luz, which is its name to this day.

source: Manasseh'in Bethshean'a chenghole akhopi, Taanach'a chengho le akhopiho, Dor'a chengho le akhopiho, Ibleam'a chengho le akhopiho, Megiddo'a chengho le akhopiho chu anodoh pon; amavang gamsunga chun Canaan miho acheng jouvin ahi.
target: But Manasseh did not drive out the people of Beth Shan or Taanach or Dor or Ibleam or Megiddo and their surrounding settlements, for the Canaanites were determined to live in that land.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Israelte ahunghat phatnun Canaan miho chu hunama natongin apansah-un, adeldoh sohkei pouvin ahi.
target: When Israel became strong, they pressed the Canaanites into forced labor but never drove them out completely.

source: Ephraim'in jong Gazer'a cheng Canaan miho chu adeldoh pon; amavang Canaan miho chu Gezer'a amaho lah-a achengun ahi.
target: Nor did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer, but the Canaanites continued to live there among them.

source: Zebulun'in jong Kitron'a cheng miho ahin, chule Nahalol'a cheng miho ahin adeldoh pon; amavang Canaan miho chu alah uva achengun, hunam natongin apansah uvin ahi.
target: Neither did Zebulun drive out the Canaanites living in Kitron or Nahalol, so these Canaanites lived among them, but Zebulun did subject them to forced labor.

source: Asher'in jong Accho'a cheng miho, Zidon'a cheng miho, Ahlab'a, Achzib'a, Helbah'a, Aphik'a, chule Rehob'a cheng miho chu adeldoh pon ahi.
target: Nor did Asher drive out those living in Akko or Sidon or Ahlab or Akzib or Helbah or Aphek or Rehob.

source: Amavang agama cheng Canaan miho lah-a chun Asher mite chu achengun ahi. Ajehchu amaho adeldoh louvu ahi.
target: The Asherites lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land because they did not drive them out.

source: Naphtali'in jong Beth-shemesh'a chengho ahin, chule Beth-anath'a chengho chu adeldoh pon; amavang agama cheng Canaan miholah-a chun ama achengun ahi. Ahijeng vangin Beth-shemesh le Beth-anath'a chengho chun amaho henga kai apeuvin ahi.
target: Neither did Naphtali drive out those living in Beth Shemesh or Beth Anath; but the Naphtalites too lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, and those living in Beth Shemesh and Beth Anath became forced laborers for them.

source: Chule Amor mite chun Dan chate chu molsang lama adel touvun, phaichama hungjong ahungsah pouvin ahi.
target: The Amorites confined the Danites to the hill country, not allowing them to come down into the plain.

source: Ahin Amor mite chu Aijalon'a um Heres molsang le Shaalbim'a achengun ahi. Ahivangin Joseph insung mite khutnin amaho chu ajouvin, hitichun amaho hunam natongin apangtaovin ahi.
target: And the Amorites were determined also to hold out in Mount Heres, Aijalon and Shaalbim, but when the power of the tribes of Joseph increased, they too were pressed into forced labor.

source: Chule Amor miho gamgi chu Akrabbim lam chetou na-a pat, songpi-a pat achunglam ahi.
target: The boundary of the Amorites was from Scorpion Pass to Sela and beyond.

source: Chuin Pakai vantil khat Gilgal'a konin Bochim'a ahungtouvin, hitin aseije, Keiman Egypt'a konin kapotdoh sah-in, napu napateu kahahselna gamsunga kahin puilutnin; chule keiman kanaseijin, Nang hotoh kakitepna imatih-a jong kasukeh louding ahi.
target: The angel of the Lord went up from Gilgal to Bokim and said, “I brought you up out of Egypt and led you into the land I swore to give to your ancestors. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you,

source: Chule nangho hiche gama cheng miho toh kijop matna naneilou diu; amaicham nasuhchim pehdiu ahi kanati. Ahinla nanghon ka aw nangaipouve. Ibola hiche hi nabolu hitam?
target: and you shall not make a covenant with the people of this land, but you shall break down their altars.’ Yet you have disobeyed me. Why have you done this?

source: Hijeh chun hiti jonghin kaseije, Namasanguva kona amaho kadeldoh louding; amavang amaho chu naveluva ling banga umdiu, chule a-pathen houchu nangho dinga thang hiding ahiuve, ati.
target: And I have also said, ‘I will not drive them out before you; they will become traps for you, and their gods will become snares to you.’ ”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Pakai vantil chun Israel chate jouse henga hiche thu asei pet chun, amaho awsang tah-in akap taovin ahi.
target: When the angel of the Lord had spoken these things to all the Israelites, the people wept aloud,

source: Chuin amahon hiche mun minchu Bochim asah-un; chule chukoma chun Pakai henga kilhaina abolun ahi.
target: and they called that place Bokim. There they offered sacrifices to the Lord .

source: Chuin Joshua'n mipi ho chu alhadoh phatnin, Israel mite amichangcheh chu agamu lodin a-inlam cheh uva ache taovin ahi.
target: After Joshua had dismissed the Israelites, they went to take possession of the land, each to their own inheritance.

source: Chuin miho chun Joshua hinlaise le, Israelte dinga Pakai natoh loupitahho anamu-a Joshua sanga hingsot upaho hinlaise chun Pakai chu ajenun ahi.
target: The people served the Lord throughout the lifetime of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had seen all the great things the Lord had done for Israel.

source: Chuin Pakai lhacha Nun chapa Joshua chu kum jakhatle somkhat alhin phatnin athitan ahi.
target: Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the Lord , died at the age of a hundred and ten.

source: Chuin amahon Gaash sahlam Ephraim molsanga um agoulo Timnath-heres gamgi-a chun avuitaovin ahi.
target: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath Heres in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

source: Chuin chuche khang miho jouse jong chu apu apateu toh gopkhomin aumgam taovin; chule amaho nungin Pakai helou, chule Israelte dinga anatohho hephalou khangchom ahung umdoh tan ahi.
target: After that whole generation had been gathered to their ancestors, another generation grew up who knew neither the Lord nor what he had done for Israel.

source: Chuin Israel chate chun Pakai mitmun thilse abolun, Baal ajenun ahi.
target: Then the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord and served the Baals.

source: Chule amahon Egypt gama kona hinpuidoh-a apu apateu Pakai Pathen chu adalhaovin, aveluva um mihemho pathenho lah-a pathen dangho chu ajuijun, hicheho anga chun aboh khupmun, Pakai chu alunghansah taovin ahi.
target: They forsook the Lord , the God of their ancestors, who had brought them out of Egypt. They followed and worshiped various gods of the peoples around them. They aroused the Lord ’s anger

source: Chule amahon Pakai adalhaovin, Baal le Astaroth chu ajen taovin ahi.
target: because they forsook him and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.

source: Hichun Pakai lunghanna chu Israelte chunga ahung soudohtan, amaho achomgam hou khutna chun achomgam dingun apedohtan; chule amaho agal miteu masanga adin joulou nadingun, aveluva um agal miteu khutna ajohdoh tan ahi.
target: In his anger against Israel the Lord gave them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, whom they were no longer able to resist.

source: Pakaiyin aseibang le amaho chunga akihahselna bangchun, achedohna chanuva Pakai khut chu amaho dounan aphalou lama achun; amaho nasatah-in agenthei taovin ahi.
target: Whenever Israel went out to fight, the hand of the Lord was against them to defeat them, just as he had sworn to them. They were in great distress.

source: Ahivangin Pakaiyin thutan ho atundoh peh-in, amaho chun achomgam hou khutna konin ahuhdoh jiuvin ahi.
target: Then the Lord raised up judges, who saved them out of the hands of these raiders.

source: Ahijeng vangin amahon athutanhou thu chu angai pouvin, pathen dangho nung juijun noti'n apangun, a-anguva aboh khupmun ahi. Amaho apu apa teovin Pakai thupeh angaijuva achenau lampia konchun gangtah-in akihei mangun, hibang chun abolpouvin ahi.
target: Yet they would not listen to their judges but prostituted themselves to other gods and worshiped them. They quickly turned from the ways of their ancestors, who had been obedient to the Lord ’s commands.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin thutan ho atundohpeh phatnin, Pakaiyin thutan ho aumpin, thutan ho nikholaisen agalteu khutna konin ahuhhingin ahi. Ajehchu amaho suhgenthei le bol hesoh-a aum uva apen pennao jehchun Pakaiyin alung aheitan ahi.
target: Whenever the Lord raised up a judge for them, he was with the judge and saved them out of the hands of their enemies as long as the judge lived; for the Lord relented because of their groaning under those who oppressed and afflicted them.

source: Chule ahitin ahi, thutanpa athi phat phatle amaho akilehei jiuvin, pathen dangho chu jending le a-anga bohkhup dingin apu apateu sangin abohjo jiuvin; acham tah uva anatoh uva konle, alouchal uva konin atang deh pouvin ahi.
target: But when the judge died, the people returned to ways even more corrupt than those of their ancestors, following other gods and serving and worshiping them. They refused to give up their evil practices and stubborn ways.

source: Chuin Pakai lunghana chu Israelte chunga ahung soudoh-in, hitin aseije, Hiche mite hin apu apateu henga thupeh kanapeh kakitepna asuhkeh uva, chule kathu angailou jeh-un,
target: Therefore the Lord was very angry with Israel and said, “Because this nation has violated the covenant I ordained for their ancestors and has not listened to me,

source: Keiman jong Joshua athia adalhah namhohi amasanguva kona khatcha kadeldoh louding ahi.
target: I will no longer drive out before them any of the nations Joshua left when he died.

source: Chutia chu amaho-a kona hi, apu apa teovin anajui banguva Israel ten Pakai lampi chu ajuijuvem ajuihih uvem kaphotchet ding ahi, ati.
target: I will use them to test Israel and see whether they will keep the way of the Lord and walk in it as their ancestors did.”

source: Hichejeh-a chu Pakaiyin hiche namho chu mangang tah-a delmang louva akoija, chule Joshua khutna jong ana pehdoh lou ahi.
target: The Lord had allowed those nations to remain; he did not drive them out at once by giving them into the hands of Joshua.

source: Pakaiyin Israelte, Canaan gamsunga galkisat hekha loulai Israel mi tampiho patep nadia akhen namtin vaipiho chu hichenghi ahiuvin;
target: These are the nations the Lord left to test all those Israelites who had not experienced any of the wars in Canaan

source: Israel chate khangguihon galsat dan ahetna dingu leh, tumasanga ima anahe loulaihon ahetna dinguva kikhena ahiuve;
target: (he did this only to teach warfare to the descendants of the Israelites who had not had previous battle experience):

source: Hiche ho chu, Philistinte leng nga ho, Canaan miho jouse, Sidon miho, Baal-hermon molsanga patna Hamath lutna geija Lebanon molsanga cheng Hiv miho ahiuve.
target: the five rulers of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites living in the Lebanon mountains from Mount Baal Hermon to Lebo Hamath.

source: Chule Israel ten Pakai thupeh, Mosi khutna kona apu apateu henga ana thupeh chu angainah uvem ti photchetna dinga amaho chu kikhendoh ahiuve.
target: They were left to test the Israelites to see whether they would obey the Lord ’s commands, which he had given their ancestors through Moses.

source: Chuin Israel chate chu Canaan miho, Hit miho, Amor miho, Perizz miho, Hiv miho, Jebus miho lah-a achengun;
target: The Israelites lived among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.

source: Chule amahon achanuteu ajidingun alauvin, achanuteu amaho chapate dingin apeuvin, chule a-pathen hou jong ajenun ahi.
target: They took their daughters in marriage and gave their own daughters to their sons, and served their gods.

source: Chule Israel chate chun Pakai mitmun thilse abolun, Pakai a-Pathen'u asumilun, Baal le Asherah ajenun ahi.
target: The Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord ; they forgot the Lord their God and served the Baals and the Asherahs.

source: Hichejeh chun Pakai lunghana chu Israelte chunga asoudoh tan, hijeh chun Mesopotamia lengpa Chushan-rishathaim khutna amaho ajohdoh tan; hitichun Israel ten Chushan-rishathaim chu kumget ajenun ahi.
target: The anger of the Lord burned against Israel so that he sold them into the hands of Cushan-Rishathaim king of Aram Naharaim, to whom the Israelites were subject for eight years.

source: Chuin Israel chate Pakai henga apen phat uvin, Pakaiyin Israelte huhdoh ding khat, Caleb naopa Kanez chapa Othniel ngeichu atungdoh-in, amachun amaho ahuhdoh-in ahi.
target: But when they cried out to the Lord , he raised up for them a deliverer, Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, who saved them.

source: Chuin Pakai lhagao chu achunga achun, aman Israelte thu atanin, galsat din akondoh-in: chule Pakaiyin Mesopotamia lengpa Chushan-rishathaim chu akhutna apedoh-in; chule akhutnin Chushan-rishathaim chu ajoutan ahi.
target: The Spirit of the Lord came on him, so that he became Israel’s judge and went to war. The Lord gave Cushan-Rishathaim king of Aram into the hands of Othniel, who overpowered him.

source: Chuin gamsung chu kum somli akicholdon ahi. Chuin Kenaz chapa Othniel chu athitai.
target: So the land had peace for forty years, until Othniel son of Kenaz died.

source: Chuin Israel chaten Pakai mitmun thilse abolkit taovin; chule amaho Pakai mitmu-a thilse jeng abol jeh-u chun, Pakaiyin Israelte dounan Moab lengpa Eglon chu athahatsah tan ahi.
target: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord , and because they did this evil the Lord gave Eglon king of Moab power over Israel.

source: Chuin aman Ammon le Amalek chate ahenga akhomin, akondoh-in Israelte agajouvin, tumthing khopi chu alotan ahi.
target: Getting the Ammonites and Amalekites to join him, Eglon came and attacked Israel, and they took possession of the City of Palms.

source: Hitichun Israel chaten Moab lengpa Eglon chu kum somleget ajenun ahi.
target: The Israelites were subject to Eglon king of Moab for eighteen years.

source: Ahivangin Israel chate Pakai henga aka phatnun, Pakaiyin Benjamin mi Gera chapa Ehud, mi veikolong pa chu ahuhdoh dingun atundohpeh-in; chule ama khutna chun Israel chaten Moab lengpa Eglon henga thilpeh athotnun ahi.
target: Again the Israelites cried out to the Lord , and he gave them a deliverer—Ehud, a left-handed man, the son of Gera the Benjamite. The Israelites sent him with tribute to Eglon king of Moab.

source: Ahinla Ehud'in hemto chemjam tongkhatna sao akisemin, ajetlam malpi chunga avonnoija akigah-in ahi.
target: Now Ehud had made a double-edged sword about a cubit long, which he strapped to his right thigh under his clothing.

source: Chuin aman thilpeh chu Moab lengpa Eglon henga ahin choijin: chule Eglon chu mithaotah ahi.
target: He presented the tribute to Eglon king of Moab, who was a very fat man.

source: Chuin aman thilpeh apeh jou phatnin, thilpeh hinpoho chu asolmangtai.
target: After Ehud had presented the tribute, he sent on their way those who had carried it.

source: Ahivangin amatah Gilgal'a song kikhena mun'a konchun akileheijin, ahenga, Vo lengpa keiman nahenga dingin guhthim thusei ding kaneije atile, aman thipmin atin ahi. Chuin akoma ding jouse chu ama-a konin achemang taovin ahi.
target: But on reaching the stone images near Gilgal he himself went back to Eglon and said, “Your Majesty, I have a secret message for you.” The king said to his attendants, “Leave us!” And they all left.

source: Chuin Ehud ahenga ahungin; chule ama chu amachang dingabou anei nipilai touna indan-a chun atouvin ahi. Chuin Ehud'in ahenga, Nahenga seiding Pathen'a kon thukhat kaneije ati. Hichun ama atouna-a konchun akipatdoh-in ahi.
target: Ehud then approached him while he was sitting alone in the upper room of his palace and said, “I have a message from God for you.” As the king rose from his seat,

source: Chuin Ehud'in akhut veilam ahin lhang doh-in, ajetlam pheichunga chem chu alan, a-oija adotlut tai.
target: Ehud reached with his left hand, drew the sword from his right thigh and plunged it into the king’s belly.

source: Chule achem nunga chun achemkung jong alutthan; chem chu athaovin atomin ahile aman chem chu a-oija konin asatdoh joutapon; chule a-eh ahungdoh-in ahi.
target: Even the handle sank in after the blade, and his bowels discharged. Ehud did not pull the sword out, and the fat closed in over it.

source: Chujouvin Ehud hongcha lama apotdoh-in, touna danho kotho chu akha khumin, akam khumtan ahi.
target: Then Ehud went out to the porch; he shut the doors of the upper room behind him and locked them.

source: Ama achedoh phatnin asohteho ahungun, chule touna danho kot kikam chu amuphatnun, Amahin thonlouva nipilai indan sunga akeng akikhu hinte atiuvin ahi.
target: After he had gone, the servants came and found the doors of the upper room locked. They said, “He must be relieving himself in the inner room of the palace.”

source: Chuin amahon jachat umleuvin angah-un; chule veuvin, aman indan kot chu ahongtapon ahi. Hijeh chun amahon aheh hongna alauvin, ahongdoh-un; chule veuvin a pakaiyu chu tolla athisan analumin ahi.
target: They waited to the point of embarrassment, but when he did not open the doors of the room, they took a key and unlocked them. There they saw their lord fallen to the floor, dead.

source: Chule amaho khongai kahchun Ehud ahoidohtan, song kikhetna mun akhelin, Seirah geijin ajamdoh tan ahi.
target: While they waited, Ehud got away. He passed by the stone images and escaped to Seirah.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, ama ahung phatnin, Ephraim molchunga chun sumkon ahin mutnin, chule Israel chate chu amatoh mola konin ahungsuh-un, ama amasan ahi.
target: When he arrived there, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites went down with him from the hills, with him leading them.

source: Chuin aman amaho henga, Kanung hinjuijun: ajehchu Pakaiyin namelmao Moab mite chu nakhut nuva apehdohtai, ati. Chule amahon anung ajui suh-un, Moab mai naija um Jordan gal kulho chu alauvin, koimacha agalkaisah pouvin ahi.
target: “Follow me,” he ordered, “for the Lord has given Moab, your enemy, into your hands.” So they followed him down and took possession of the fords of the Jordan that led to Moab; they allowed no one to cross over.

source: Chuin amahon hiche pettah chun Moab mite sangsom tobang athat uvin, amaho chu mihat cheh le mihangsan cheh ahiuve; koimacha ahoidoh aumpon ahi.
target: At that time they struck down about ten thousand Moabites, all vigorous and strong; not one escaped.

source: Hitichun hiche nikho chun Moab chu Israel khutnoija suhnemin aumin ahi. Chuin gamsung chu kum somget acholngan ahi.
target: That day Moab was made subject to Israel, and the land had peace for eighty years.

source: Chule amanungin Anath chapa Shamgar ahin, amapan bong sutna tengcha-in Philistine te mi jagup athatnin: chule Israelte jong ahuhdoh-in ahi.
target: After Ehud came Shamgar son of Anath, who struck down six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad. He too saved Israel.

source: Chuin Ehud athi phatnin, Israel chate chun Pakai mitmun thilse abolkit taovin ahi.
target: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord , now that Ehud was dead.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin amaho chu Hazor mun'a vaihompa, Canaan lengpa Jabin khutnah ajohdoh tan ahi. Ajanel lamkai chu Sisera ahin, amachu Gentile ho umna Harosheth'a cheng ahi.
target: So the Lord sold them into the hands of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor. Sisera, the commander of his army, was based in Harosheth Haggoyim.

source: Chuin Israel chate chu Pakai henga atao taovin ahi. Ajehchu aman thih-a kisem sakol kangtalai jako aneijin; chule aman kum somni Israelte chu nasatah-a asuh genthei ahi.
target: Because he had nine hundred chariots fitted with iron and had cruelly oppressed the Israelites for twenty years, they cried to the Lord for help.

source: Chule Lapidoth jinu Deborah themgaonu chun hiche laija chu Israelte thu atan ahi.
target: Now Deborah, a prophet, the wife of Lappidoth, was leading Israel at that time.

source: Chule amanu chu Ephraim molsanga um Ramah le Bethel kikah-a Deborah tumthing noija chu chenga ahin; chule Israel chate chu athu-u tansah dinga ahenga hungjiuva ahi.
target: She held court under the Palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites went up to her to have their disputes decided.

source: Chuin amanun Kadesh-napthtali'a kon Abinoam chapa Barak agakou sah-in, ajah-a, Israel Pakai Pathen'in, Tabor molsang lama chun chenlang, Naphtali chatele Zebulun chate sangsom kipuijin,
target: She sent for Barak son of Abinoam from Kedesh in Naphtali and said to him, “The Lord , the God of Israel, commands you: ‘Go, take with you ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun and lead them up to Mount Tabor.

source: Chule keiman Jabin gal lamkaipa Sisera chu asakol kangtalai le amihonpi to nangma heng Kidron vapidung lama kahin puiding; amachu nakhutna kapehdoh ding ahi, tia thu napeh hilouham? ati.
target: I will lead Sisera, the commander of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his troops to the Kishon River and give him into your hands.’ ”

source: Chuin Barak'in amanu henga, Nangman nei kilhonpi leh chenange; amavang nei kilhonpi lou dinga ahile kache louding ahi, ati.
target: Barak said to her, “If you go with me, I will go; but if you don’t go with me, I won’t go.”

source: Chuin amanun, Keiman thonlouva kalhonpi ding nahi; ahivanga nakalsona lampia hi nangma dinga loupina umlou ding ahi; ajehchu Pakaiyin Sisera chu numei khat khutna ajohdoh ding ahi, ati. Chuin Deborah akipatnin Barak toh akilhonin Kadesh lama achelhontan ahi.
target: “Certainly I will go with you,” said Deborah. “But because of the course you are taking, the honor will not be yours, for the Lord will deliver Sisera into the hands of a woman.” So Deborah went with Barak to Kedesh.

source: Chuin Barak'in Zebulun le Naphtali chu Kadesh'a akouvin; mi sangsom toh alhon touvin: chule Deborah'in alhon toupin ahi.
target: There Barak summoned Zebulun and Naphtali, and ten thousand men went up under his command. Deborah also went up with him.

source: Tun Mosi nupapa Hobab chate lah-a Ken mi Heber chu Ken miho-a konin akitumse-in, Kedesh koma um Zaanaim phaichama chun ponbuh akisontan ahi.
target: Now Heber the Kenite had left the other Kenites, the descendants of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law, and pitched his tent by the great tree in Zaanannim near Kedesh.

source: Chule amahon Tabor molsanga chun Abinoam chapa Barak chu achetoutai ti Sisera henga aseipeh taovin ahi.
target: When they told Sisera that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor,

source: Chuin Sisera'in akangtalai jouse, athih kangtalai jako geijin, chule Gentile ho umna Harosheth'a kon Kishon vapidung geija akoma um mijouse chu akhom khomin ahi.
target: Sisera summoned from Harosheth Haggoyim to the Kishon River all his men and his nine hundred chariots fitted with iron.

source: Chuin Deborah'in Barak henga, Kipat in, ajehchu tunihi Pakaiyin nakhutna Sisera apehdoh nikho ahi; Pakai chu namasanga che hilouham? ati. Hitichun Barak Tabor molsanga konin achesuh-in, mi sangsomin anung ajuijun ahi.
target: Then Deborah said to Barak, “Go! This is the day the Lord has given Sisera into your hands. Has not the Lord gone ahead of you?” So Barak went down Mount Tabor, with ten thousand men following him.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Barak masanga Sisera le akangtalai ho, chule aumpiho chu chemjam monghemin amaimoh sahtan; hitichun Sisera chu akangtalaija konchun akumlhan akengin ajammang tan ahi.
target: At Barak’s advance, the Lord routed Sisera and all his chariots and army by the sword, and Sisera got down from his chariot and fled on foot.

source: Ahivangin Barak'in Gentile ho umna Harosheth geijin kangtalai ho le janelho chu anungdelin; Sisera sepai jouse chu chemjam monghemin alhusoh keijun, khatcha asohcha aumpouvin ahi.
target: Barak pursued the chariots and army as far as Harosheth Haggoyim, and all Sisera’s troops fell by the sword; not a man was left.

source: Ahivangin Sisera chu Ken mi Heber inneipi Jael ponbuh geijin akengin ajamlutnin ahi. Ajehchu Hazor lengpa Jabin le Ken mi Heber insung kikah-a chamna uma ahi.
target: Sisera, meanwhile, fled on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, because there was an alliance between Jabin king of Hazor and the family of Heber the Kenite.

source: Chule Jael chu Sisera lamto dingin ahungdoh-in, Hunglutnin, ka pakai, kahenga hunglutnin, kicha hih-in ati. Chuin amapa amanu ponbuh sunga ahunglut phatnin, amanun ama chu pon akhu khumin ahi.
target: Jael went out to meet Sisera and said to him, “Come, my lord, come right in. Don’t be afraid.” So he entered her tent, and she covered him with a blanket.
