target: So the assembly sent twelve thousand fighting men with instructions to go to Jabesh Gilead and put to the sword those living there, including the women and children.

source: Chule hichehi nabolding dolu chu ahi: nanghon pasal takip, chule pasal toh lumkhomsa numei takip chu natha gamheldiu ahi, atiuve.
target: “This is what you are to do,” they said. “Kill every male and every woman who is not a virgin.”

source: Chuin amahon Jabesh Gilead'a kon chun pasal hekhalou nungah theng jali amudoh-un ahi. Chuin amahon amaho chu Canaan gama Shiloh gebuh-a ahin puijun ahi.
target: They found among the people living in Jabesh Gilead four hundred young women who had never slept with a man, and they took them to the camp at Shiloh in Canaan.

source: Chuin houkhom pumpi chun Rimmon songpi-a um Benjamin chatetoh kihou dingle, amaho lungmong tah-a kou dingin mi phabep asolun ahi.
target: Then the whole assembly sent an offer of peace to the Benjamites at the rock of Rimmon.

source: Hijeh chun Benjamin chu ahungkit tan; chule amahon amaho chu Jabesh Gilead miho-a kona ahinghoiju numei ho chu ajidingun apeuvin; ahinla hicheho chun atohjou pon ahi.
target: So the Benjamites returned at that time and were given the women of Jabesh Gilead who had been spared. But there were not enough for all of them.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Israel phungho sunga chun kikhenna aumsah jehchun, mipi ho chu Benjamin jeh-in alunghemun ahi.
target: The people grieved for Benjamin, because the Lord had made a gap in the tribes of Israel.

source: Chujouvin mipi kikhomho lah-a upaho chun, Benjamin'a konin numei ho akisumang tai ti imu utoh lhona, ahing nalaiho ji dinga hi ipi ibol dingu hitam? atiuve.
target: And the elders of the assembly said, “With the women of Benjamin destroyed, how shall we provide wives for the men who are left?

source: Chuin amahon, Israel lah-a kona phungkhat suhmanga aumlou nadinga, Benjamin miho lah-a kona ahingdoh hohin goulo aneitei dingu ahi.
target: The Benjamite survivors must have heirs,” they said, “so that a tribe of Israel will not be wiped out.

source: Ahinla eihon amaho chu aji dinguva ichanuteu ipehthei loudingu ahi: ajehchu Israel chate chun kihahselna ananeijuva, Benjamin mi jidinga achanu pechan chu sapset changhen anatiu ahi, atiuve.
target: We can’t give them our daughters as wives, since we Israelites have taken this oath: ‘Cursed be anyone who gives a wife to a Benjamite.’

source: Chujouchun amahon, Veuvin Bethel sahlam, Bethel'a kona Sheshem jotna lamlhong solam, chule Lebonah lhanglam Shilloh mun'a khun kumseh le Pakai golvah akiboljin ahi.
target: But look, there is the annual festival of the Lord in Shiloh, which lies north of Bethel, east of the road that goes from Bethel to Shechem, and south of Lebonah.”

source: Hichejeh chun amahon Benjamin chate chu athupeh-un, ahenguva, Cheovin lang lengpi leija khun gachang pangun;
target: So they instructed the Benjamites, saying, “Go and hide in the vineyards

source: Chule ana veuvin lang, veuvin, Shiloh kho-a nungah ho chu lamna-a lamdinga ahungule, lengpi leija konchun hungpot unlang, amitakipmin Shiloh chanute-a konchun naji ding cheh-u kimatnun lang, chule Benjamin gam lama chepiovin.
target: and watch. When the young women of Shiloh come out to join in the dancing, rush from the vineyards and each of you seize one of them to be your wife. Then return to the land of Benjamin.

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi, apatehou ahiloule asopitehou kehenguva kiphinna thu seidinga ahung tengule, keihon amaho henga, Keiho jal-in amaho chunga khun khohsahna neijun, ajehchu gal kisatna-a chu eihon amitakip ajidingu ikhendoh peh pouvin, chule nanghon tu-a jonghi amaho napeh-u ahilou jeh-in, themmo chang pouvin nate, tin seinao vinge, atiuve.
target: When their fathers or brothers complain to us, we will say to them, ‘Do us the favor of helping them, because we did not get wives for them during the war. You will not be guilty of breaking your oath because you did not give your daughters to them.’ ”

source: Chuin Benjamin chate chun hitichun aboltauvin, amahon amijat dungjuijun alama hungdohho aji dinga akimat hou chu akipuijun; chule agoulonao gama akileuvin, khopi ho chu asaphaovin, acheng taovin ahi.
target: So that is what the Benjamites did. While the young women were dancing, each man caught one and carried her off to be his wife. Then they returned to their inheritance and rebuilt the towns and settled in them.

source: Chuin hichephat chun Israel chate chu hiche mun'a konchun akipat doh-un, amijouse ama phungle insung, chule agou lona mun cheh-a achedoh taovin ahi.
target: At that time the Israelites left that place and went home to their tribes and clans, each to his own inheritance.

source: Hichelai chun Israelte lah-a leng aumpon: amijousen ama mitmu-a pha asah chu abol jengu ahi.
target: In those days Israel had no king; everyone did as they saw fit.

source: Tun thutan ho vaihomho nikho laijin, gamsunga kel analhan ahi. Chuin Judah gam Bethlehem'a pasal khat a-inneipi le achapa teni toh Moab gama phat chomkhat cheng dingin anacheuvin ahi.
target: In the days when the judges ruled, there was a famine in the land. So a man from Bethlehem in Judah, together with his wife and two sons, went to live for a while in the country of Moab.

source: Pasalpa minchu Elimelech ahin, a-inneipi minchu Naomi ahi, chule achapa teni minchu Mahlon chule Chilion ahin, Judah gam Bethlehem kho-a um Ephrath mi ahiuve. Amaho Moab gama acheuvin agaum taove.
target: The man’s name was Elimelek, his wife’s name was Naomi, and the names of his two sons were Mahlon and Kilion. They were Ephrathites from Bethlehem, Judah. And they went to Moab and lived there.

source: Chuin Naomi inneipu Elimelech chu athitan; amanu le achapateni adalhatan ahi.
target: Now Elimelek, Naomi’s husband, died, and she was left with her two sons.

source: Chuin achapa tenin Moab numei ji-in akipui lhonin; Khatnu minchu Orpah ahin, khajonu minchu Ruth ahi. Chutichun hiche gama chun kumsom tobang anachengun ahi.
target: They married Moabite women, one named Orpah and the other Ruth. After they had lived there about ten years,

source: Chuin Mahlon le Chilion jong ani lhonin athi lhontan; hitichun Naomi chu a-inneipu le achapa tenin adalhatan ahi.
target: both Mahlon and Kilion also died, and Naomi was left without her two sons and her husband.

source: Chujouvin Naomi Moab gama kona kilekit dingin amou tenitoh akipat dohtan ahi. Ajehchu Pakaiyin amite nehding apen aviltai ti Moab gama konin ajan ahi.
target: When Naomi heard in Moab that the Lord had come to the aid of his people by providing food for them, she and her daughters-in-law prepared to return home from there.

source: Hijeh chun amanu amou teni toh aumna-a konin akipatdoh-in; Judah gam kilekit nading lampi-a chun achetauve.
target: With her two daughters-in-law she left the place where she had been living and set out on the road that would take them back to the land of Judah.

source: Chuin Naomi in amouteni jah-a, chelhonin, nanuteni incheh-a kinungle lhontan; nangnin athiho le keima neibolna lhon bangin Pakaiyin lungsetna-in nabol lhonhen.
target: Then Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, “Go back, each of you, to your mother’s home. May the Lord show you kindness, as you have shown kindness to your dead husbands and to me.

source: Na-inneipu teni incheh-a lung kicholdona namulhon nadingin, Pakaiyin phatthei nape lhonhen, ati. Chujouvin abenglhon chu achopmin, athummun aw sangtah-in akap taove.
target: May the Lord grant that each of you will find rest in the home of another husband.” Then she kissed them goodbye and they wept aloud

source: Chuin amanin amanu jah-a, keini namite henga nangma toh kakile tei lhonding ahi, atilhon tai.
target: and said to her, “We will go back with you to your people.”

source: Ahin Naomi'in, kachanu teni kinungle lhontan; Ibola keima toh nakilhon hon dingham? Kanaobua ji-a nanei theilhon ding chapa um nalaija ham?
target: But Naomi said, “Return home, my daughters. Why would you come with me? Am I going to have any more sons, who could become your husbands?

source: Kinungle lhonin, kachanu teni, chelhontan; ajehchu ji neikit dingin kateh behsehtai. Keiman kinepna kaneije tin seijing ting, tujan mamahin ji neijingting, chapate hingkit jongleng;
target: Return home, my daughters; I am too old to have another husband. Even if I thought there was still hope for me—even if I had a husband tonight and then gave birth to sons—

source: Nangnin amaho kikhan lhit gei nangajou lhonding hinam? jineilouva amaho nangalhon dingham? Hitheiponte, kachanu teni; ajehchu Pakaiyin akhut keima douna-a alapjeh hin, nangni-a ding gelnan kalung ana tangeije, ati.
target: would you wait until they grew up? Would you remain unmarried for them? No, my daughters. It is more bitter for me than for you, because the Lord ’s hand has turned against me!”

source: Chutichun amaho aw sangtah-in akap kit taove. Chuin Orpah in atehpi lhahnan achopmin; Ruth vang chun akolchahtan ahi.
target: At this they wept aloud again. Then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law goodbye, but Ruth clung to her.

source: Chuin Naomi in hitin aseije, ven na-unu amitele a-pathenho henga akilekit tai. Nangjong na-unu nung juijin kiletan, ati.
target: “Look,” said Naomi, “your sister-in-law is going back to her people and her gods. Go back with her.”

source: Ahinla Ruth'in, nangma dalha dingle nanung kajuina-a kona kinungle kit dingin neijol hih-in: ajehchu nache che na-a kache ding, nachen chenna-a kachen ding; namite chu kamite hia, na Pathen chu ka Pathen hiding;
target: But Ruth replied, “Don’t urge me to leave you or to turn back from you. Where you go I will go, and where you stay I will stay. Your people will be my people and your God my God.

source: Nathi thi na-a kathi-a, hiche munna chu eikivui ding ahi. Thina tilouvin thil dangin eikhen lhonna ahile, Pakaiyin kachungah abolnom nom bolhen, achungnung jo cheh-in jong chuhsah jenghen, tin aseitai.
target: Where you die I will die, and there I will be buried. May the Lord deal with me, be it ever so severely, if even death separates you and me.”

source: Naomi'in amounu amatoh kilhon dinga dettah-a apan amu phatchun, ajah-a imacha aseitapon ahi.
target: When Naomi realized that Ruth was determined to go with her, she stopped urging her.

source: Hitichun amani Bethlehem alhunlhon kahsen achepeh lhontan ahi. Chuin ahitin ahi, Bethlehem alhunlhon phatchun, khosung pumpi chu amani jeh-in akiling soh jengin; chule numei hon, hichehi Naomi hilouham? atiuve.
target: So the two women went on until they came to Bethlehem. When they arrived in Bethlehem, the whole town was stirred because of them, and the women exclaimed, “Can this be Naomi?”

source: Chuin amanun ajah uva, Naomi neiti hih-un, Mara neitijouvin; ajehchu Hatchung nungin nasatah in eisugenthei tan ahi.
target: “Don’t call me Naomi,” she told them. “Call me Mara, because the Almighty has made my life very bitter.

source: Ninglhinga potdoh-a kahin, Pakaiyin ahomkeovin in eihin lepui kit tai. Pakaiyin keima douna ahet tohsah-a, Hatchung nungin kachungah gentheina achuhsah namu nunguva, ipi dinga Naomi neiti nahlaiju ham?
target: I went away full, but the Lord has brought me back empty. Why call me Naomi? The Lord has afflicted me; the Almighty has brought misfortune upon me.”

source: Hitichun Naomi chu ahung kile kitnin, Moab numei amounu Ruth toh Moab gama konin ahung kile lhontan ahi. Chuin sakol chang ki-at patlaijin Bethlehem ahunglhung lhontai.
target: So Naomi returned from Moab accompanied by Ruth the Moabite, her daughter-in-law, arriving in Bethlehem as the barley harvest was beginning.

source: Tun, Naomi'in a-inneipu sopi mihaotah khat aneijin; ama chu Elimelech insunga kon ahin, amin chu Boaz ahi.
target: Now Naomi had a relative on her husband’s side, a man of standing from the clan of Elimelek, whose name was Boaz.

source: Chuin Moab numei Ruth'in Naomi jah-a, tun keima louva cheng kating, koihile amitmua lungset eichan penpen louva changkhai gaholinge, ati. Chuin Naomi'in ajah-a, kontan kachanu, ati.
target: And Ruth the Moabite said to Naomi, “Let me go to the fields and pick up the leftover grain behind anyone in whose eyes I find favor.” Naomi said to her, “Go ahead, my daughter.”

source: Chuin amanu apotdoh-in, achen, louva chang at-ho nunga changkhai aholtan ahi. Chule amanu chu Elimelech insungmi Boaz loulaija avahlut khatan ahi.
target: So she went out, entered a field and began to glean behind the harvesters. As it turned out, she was working in a field belonging to Boaz, who was from the clan of Elimelek.

source: Chuin veuvin, Bethlehem'a konin Boaz ahungin, chang at-ho jah-a, Pakaiyin na-umpiu hen, ati. Chuin amahon jong Pakai;in nangma phatthei naboh hen, tin adonbutnuve.
target: Just then Boaz arrived from Bethlehem and greeted the harvesters, “The Lord be with you!” “The Lord bless you!” they answered.

source: Chuin Boaz in chang at-ho vesuija pang sohpa jah-a, hichenu hi hoi koi nungah ham? ati.
target: Boaz asked the overseer of his harvesters, “Who does that young woman belong to?”

source: Chuin chang at-ho vesuija pang sohpa chun adonbutnin, amanu hi Moab gama kon Naomi toh hung kinungle khangdong Moab nungahnu chu ahi.
target: The overseer replied, “She is the Moabite who came back from Moab with Naomi.

source: Amanun, katao ahi, chang at-hon adalhah-u changphal lah-a changkhai neihol khom sah-in, atin; hitichun amanu ahungin, in'a chomcha akicholdo tilouvin, jingpi-a pat tuchan geihin achomkhom peh-in ahi, tin adonbutne.
target: She said, ‘Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves behind the harvesters.’ She came into the field and has remained here from morning till now, except for a short rest in the shelter.”

source: Chujouvin Boaz chun Ruth jah-a hitin aseije, kachanu, kathusei nangai nah louding ham? Midang louva changkhai holdin chehih-in, hikoma konin jong potdoh hih'in, ahin ka numei ho toh kikhen louvin kivop jingin.
target: So Boaz said to Ruth, “My daughter, listen to me. Don’t go and glean in another field and don’t go away from here. Stay here with the women who work for me.

source: Amahon a-atnao loulai chu velhin lang, anungu juijin. Gollhang hon nangma natohkhah louna dinga thu kapeh louva nabol ham? nadang achah teng twibel phunga chenlang, gollhang hon ahinkhaiju twi chu donjin.
target: Watch the field where the men are harvesting, and follow along after the women. I have told the men not to lay a hand on you. And whenever you are thirsty, go and get a drink from the water jars the men have filled.”

source: Chuin amanu tollah aboh khupmin, amapa jah-a, keima gamdang mi kahi munasa-a, ipijeh-a neihet thema, namitmu-a hibanga lungsetna kachan ham? ati.
target: At this, she bowed down with her face to the ground. She asked him, “Why have I found such favor in your eyes that you notice me—a foreigner?”

source: Chuin Boaz'in adonbutnin, amanu jah-a, na-inneipu thinunga natehpi najennaho; nanule napa, napenna gam nahin dalhah-a, masanga nahet khahlou miho lah-a nahung thu kichentah-a eikihetsah ahitai.
target: Boaz replied, “I’ve been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband—how you left your father and mother and your homeland and came to live with a people you did not know before.

source: Pakaiyin natohna chunga lethuhna napehen lang, chule kicholdo nadinga alhaving noi nahinjot Pakai Israel Pathen chun, kipaman lhingsetnin napehen, ati.
target: May the Lord repay you for what you have done. May you be richly rewarded by the Lord , the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.”

source: Chuin amanun, ka Pakai, na mitmu-a lungsetna changjing inge; ajehchu nasoh numei ho lah-a khatbeh hihih jongleng, nangman neilhamon in, nasohnu hi lungset tah in nei kihoulim pitai, ati.
target: “May I continue to find favor in your eyes, my lord,” she said. “You have put me at ease by speaking kindly to your servant—though I do not have the standing of one of your servants.”

source: Chuin an aneh phatnun, Boaz'in amanu jah-a, hungin lang an hungnen, chule nachanglhah halchu lengpitwi thuh-a hin hung kide-in, ati. Chuin amanu chu chang at-ho koma atoutan; amapa chun amanu chu changkanpoh apen, amanun ane vasetnin, amoh phabep akhenin ahi.
target: At mealtime Boaz said to her, “Come over here. Have some bread and dip it in the wine vinegar.” When she sat down with the harvesters, he offered her some roasted grain. She ate all she wanted and had some left over.

source: Chuin amanu changkhaiho lohkhom dingin akipatdoh phatnin, Boaz'in asoh pasal ho athupeh-in, ajah uva, hichenu hi changphal ho lah jenga jong kilokhom sah-un, phohsal hih-un.
target: As she got up to glean, Boaz gave orders to his men, “Let her gather among the sheaves and don’t reprimand her.

source: Chule changphal loma konin jong amanu kilokhom dingin phabep lhahsahthu jiuvin lang, phoh hih-un, ati.
target: Even pull out some stalks for her from the bundles and leave them for her to pick up, and don’t rebuke her.”

source: Chuti chun amanun nilhah geijin loulaija chun changkhai aholin, chule changkhai alokhom chengse chu avolhan ahileh, hichu sakol chang ephah khat tobang ahi.
target: So Ruth gleaned in the field until evening. Then she threshed the barley she had gathered, and it amounted to about an ephah.

source: Chuin amanun hichu apon khopi sungah alutnin; atehpin achangkhai hinpoh chu amutan ahi. Chuin amanun anehvaset jouva anehval akhen chu atehpi apetan ahi.
target: She carried it back to town, and her mother-in-law saw how much she had gathered. Ruth also brought out and gave her what she had left over after she had eaten enough.

source: Chuin atehpin ajah-a, tunia hoilama changkhai nahol em? hoija na nagatoh em? Nangma nahin hethempa chu nunnom hen, ati. Chuin Ruth'in aloukona mipa chu atehpi jah-a aseipeh-in, ajah-a, tunia kakonna louneipa chu Boaz ahi, ati.
target: Her mother-in-law asked her, “Where did you glean today? Where did you work? Blessed be the man who took notice of you!” Then Ruth told her mother-in-law about the one at whose place she had been working. “The name of the man I worked with today is Boaz,” she said.

source: Chuin Naomi'in amounu jah-a, Athiho le ahing nalaiho chungah lungsetna nungsun lou Pakai chu nunnom hen ati. Chuin Naomi'in ajah-a, hiche mipa chu eiho dinga isopiu, inko ikinaipi penhou lah-a khat ahi, ati.
target: “The Lord bless him!” Naomi said to her daughter-in-law. “He has not stopped showing his kindness to the living and the dead.” She added, “That man is our close relative; he is one of our guardian-redeemers.”

source: Chuin Moab numeinu Ruth'in, amapa chun kahengah, kachang a-at jou kahseovin, ka gollhangho toh kikhen louvin ummin, tin aseije ati.
target: Then Ruth the Moabite said, “He even said to me, ‘Stay with my workers until they finish harvesting all my grain.’ ”

source: Chuin Naom'in amounu Ruth jah-ah, kachanu, amapa numei ho toh nakon khomchu aphai. Ajehchu midang louva kon le chun hitabang chu namu louding ahi, ati.
target: Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, “It will be good for you, my daughter, to go with the women who work for him, because in someone else’s field you might be harmed.”

source: Hitichun amanu Sakol chang le suhlou chang ki-atchai kahsen changkhai holdingin Boaz numei ho toh kikhen louvin aumkhomin; chule atehpi toh achengkhom lhontan ahi.
target: So Ruth stayed close to the women of Boaz to glean until the barley and wheat harvests were finished. And she lived with her mother-in-law.

source: Chuin atehpi Naomi'in amanu jah-a, kachanu, nangdia thilpha asotheina dinga, nakicholdo nading kangaito peh louding ham?
target: One day Ruth’s mother-in-law Naomi said to her, “My daughter, I must find a home for you, where you will be well provided for.

source: Chule nangman anumeiho nakivop piji Boaz khu i-inkopau hilouham? Ven, tujan tengle phola sakolchang ajapchil ding ahi.
target: Now Boaz, with whose women you have worked, is a relative of ours. Tonight he will be winnowing barley on the threshing floor.

source: Hijeh chun kisilngimin lang, thao kinun, navon phapen kivonin lang, pholla chesuh-in: ahin amapan neh le don achai masangsen akoma chun kiphong hih-in.
target: Wash, put on perfume, and get dressed in your best clothes. Then go down to the threshing floor, but don’t let him know you are there until he has finished eating and drinking.

source: Chule hitiding ahi, alupna ding munchu melchih inlang, ama aluptengleh, chu-a chun lutnin, chule akeng hohdoh inlang chu-a chun lumin; chutengle aman nabolding nahil nante, ati.
target: When he lies down, note the place where he is lying. Then go and uncover his feet and lie down. He will tell you what to do.”

source: Chuin Ruth'in amanu jah-a, kahenga nasei jouse kabolding ahi, ati.
target: “I will do whatever you say,” Ruth answered.

source: Chuin amanu pholla achesuh-in, atehpin asei bangin agaboltai.
target: So she went down to the threshing floor and did everything her mother-in-law told her to do.

source: Chuin Boaz'in nehle don achai phatnin, lung kipah tah-in chang kisevum banna chun lum dingin achetan ahi; chuin amanu kangchan ahungin, amapa kengchu ahohdoh-in, chu-a chun alumtai.
target: When Boaz had finished eating and drinking and was in good spirits, he went over to lie down at the far end of the grain pile. Ruth approached quietly, uncovered his feet and lay down.

source: Chuin khangkimin ahitin ahi, amapa chu akinin, agah kiheileh; ven, numei khat akeng todopmah alumin ahi.
target: In the middle of the night something startled the man; he turned—and there was a woman lying at his feet!

source: Chuin amapan koi nahim? ati. Amanun adonbutnin, nasohnu Ruth kahi; hijeh chun nasohnu hi naponmong neisilpeh in; ajehchu nangma kasopi kinaipi nahi, ati.
target: “Who are you?” he asked. “I am your servant Ruth,” she said. “Spread the corner of your garment over me, since you are a guardian-redeemer of our family.”

source: Chuin aman, kachanu, Pakaiyin phatthei naboh hen; ajehchu gollhang ahao hihen, avai hijongle anungu najuilou hin, amasalama sangin ajona lamah khotona namusah cheh-in ahi.
target: “The Lord bless you, my daughter,” he replied. “This kindness is greater than that which you showed earlier: You have not run after the younger men, whether rich or poor.

source: Chule tun, kachanu, kicha hih-in; keiman na-ngeh jouse kabolpeh ding nahi: ajehchu kakhopi sunga kamite jousen numei chondihtah nahi ahesoh keijuve.
target: And now, my daughter, don’t be afraid. I will do for you all you ask. All the people of my town know that you are a woman of noble character.

source: Tun keima nakinaipi nasopi kahichu adih-e; ahin keima sanga sopi kinaipi aumnalaije.
target: Although it is true that I am a guardian-redeemer of our family, there is another who is more closely related than I.

source: Tujan gehden tan, jingkah tengle hitiding ahi, amapa chun sopi khat boldingdol kinchu nangma chunga abola ahile, aphai; sopi boldingdol kinchu bolhen. Amavang aman hiche sopi boldingdol kinchu nangma chunga abol louva ahile, Pakai ahinjing bangin, keiman sopi boldingdol kinchu nangma chunga bolnange. Jing khovah kahsen gehdentan, ati.
target: Stay here for the night, and in the morning if he wants to do his duty as your guardian-redeemer, good; let him redeem you. But if he is not willing, as surely as the Lord lives I will do it. Lie here until morning.”

source: Chutichun amanu chu amapa kengdopmah jingkah geijin alumtan; jingkah phalvah then masangin athoudohtan ahi. Chuin amapan, pholla numei ahunge ti koiman hetdahen, ati.
target: So she lay at his feet until morning, but got up before anyone could be recognized; and he said, “No one must know that a woman came to the threshing floor.”

source: Aman amanu jah-a, naponsil chu hinchoijin lang, do-in, ati. Chuin aman ponchu adon ahile sakol chang tena gup atepeh-in, apohsahtai. Chuin amanu khopi sunglama aluttan ahi.
target: He also said, “Bring me the shawl you are wearing and hold it out.” When she did so, he poured into it six measures of barley and placed the bundle on her. Then he went back to town.

source: Chuin amanu atehpi kom agalhun phat chun, atehpin, kachanu, ito nahungbah hinam? ati. Chuin amanun mipa chun ama dinga abolpeh jouse chu aseipehtan ahi.
target: When Ruth came to her mother-in-law, Naomi asked, “How did it go, my daughter?” Then she told her everything Boaz had done for her

source: Chule amanun, hiche sakol chang tena gup hi amapan eipeh ahi; ajehchu amapan kajah-a, natehpi henga khut gohkeovin chehih-in eiti, ati.
target: and added, “He gave me these six measures of barley, saying, ‘Don’t go back to your mother-in-law empty-handed.’ ”

source: Chuin amanun, kachanu, hiche thua hi ipi ahungso nahetchet kah-in khongaijin; ajehchu tunia hiche thuhi asuhchet masangse-a amapa kicholdo louding ahi, ati.
target: Then Naomi said, “Wait, my daughter, until you find out what happens. For the man will not rest until the matter is settled today.”

source: Chujouvin Boaz kotpi phung-ah achetouvin, chua chun atoutan ahi. Chuin ven, Boaz'in anasei akinaipi asopipa chu ahungin; Boaz'in ajah-a, golpa hung kiheijin lang, hikoma hin hungtouvin, ati. Chuin amajong akiheijin atoutai.
target: Meanwhile Boaz went up to the town gate and sat down there just as the guardian-redeemer he had mentioned came along. Boaz said, “Come over here, my friend, and sit down.” So he went over and sat down.

source: Chuin aman khopi sunga upa som akouvin, ajah uva, hikoma hin touvun, ati. Chuin amaho atou taove.
target: Boaz took ten of the elders of the town and said, “Sit here,” and they did so.

source: Hichun aman akinaipipen asopipa jah-a, Moab gamma kona hungkile kit Naomi'in, isopipao Elimelech gam behkhat ajoh-in:
target: Then he said to the guardian-redeemer, “Naomi, who has come back from Moab, is selling the piece of land that belonged to our relative Elimelek.

source: Hiche thuhi nangma hetsah dinga kagel ahi, hikoma chengho le kamite upaho anga hichu kichohtan. Nangman nalhat dinga ahile, lhatnin; nalhat louding ahile, kahet thei nadin neisei peh-in; ajehchu nang tailou hiche lhatding chu koimacha aumpon, Keihi nang bantah-a kahi, ati. Chuin amapan, hichu lhatnange, ati.
target: I thought I should bring the matter to your attention and suggest that you buy it in the presence of these seated here and in the presence of the elders of my people. If you will redeem it, do so. But if you will not, tell me, so I will know. For no one has the right to do it except you, and I am next in line.” “I will redeem it,” he said.

source: Chuin Boaz'in, Naomi khutna kona louchu nachoh ninile, agoulo chunga athipa min chu aumjing theina dinga, athipa inneipi Moab numei Ruth jong nachohtha ding ahi, ati.
target: Then Boaz said, “On the day you buy the land from Naomi, you also acquire Ruth the Moabite, the dead man’s widow, in order to maintain the name of the dead with his property.”

source: Hichun asopi kinaipipa chun, keima dingin lhat thei ponge, atiloule keima neilegou ngeijong kisuh chatvai ding ahi. Lhatdohna tha kanei jonghi nangma chang maijin, ajehchu keiman kalhat thei louding ahi, ati.
target: At this, the guardian-redeemer said, “Then I cannot redeem it because I might endanger my own estate. You redeem it yourself. I cannot do it.”

source: Masanglaijin Israelte lah-a lhatdohna le kilhet tona chung changa chonna ngai dan chu hiti ahi: ipi thu hitale suhchetna dinga chu, pasal khatnin akengkoh asutlhah-a, michom khatpa chu apehji ahi: hichu Israelte lah-a suhdetna hija ahi.
target: (Now in earlier times in Israel, for the redemption and transfer of property to become final, one party took off his sandal and gave it to the other. This was the method of legalizing transactions in Israel.)

source: Hijeh chun asopi kinaipi penpa chun Boaz jah-a, nangma dingin kilhattan, ati. Chuti chun aman akengkoh asutlhan ahi.
target: So the guardian-redeemer said to Boaz, “Buy it yourself.” And he removed his sandal.

source: Chuin Boaz'in upaho le mipi jouse jah-a, tunia hi nangho hichehi ahetoh nahiuve, keiman Naomi khutna konin Elimelech gou jouse, chule Chilion le Mahlon neijouse aboncha kachoh ahitai.
target: Then Boaz announced to the elders and all the people, “Today you are witnesses that I have bought from Naomi all the property of Elimelek, Kilion and Mahlon.

source: Hiche chungvum chun, athipa minchu agouva aumjinga, hitia chu athipa min chu asopiho lah-a kon leh aumna mun kotpi phunga kona kahlhah-a aumlouna dingin, Moab numei Ruth, Mahlon inneipi jong kajidingin kachoh thatai; tunia hi ahetoh-a nangho nahiuve, ati.
target: I have also acquired Ruth the Moabite, Mahlon’s widow, as my wife, in order to maintain the name of the dead with his property, so that his name will not disappear from among his family or from his hometown. Today you are witnesses!”

source: Chuin kotpi phunga um mijouse le upaho chun ajah-a, keiho ahetoh kahiuve. Pakaiyin na-insunga hunglut numeinu hi Israel insung tungdoh teni, Rachel le Leah tobang hisah hen; chule nangma jong Ephrathah'a phathei jin lang, Bethlehem'a namin kithang hen.
target: Then the elders and all the people at the gate said, “We are witnesses. May the Lord make the woman who is coming into your home like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the family of Israel. May you have standing in Ephrathah and be famous in Bethlehem.

source: Pakaiyin hiche khangdong numeinu chilhah-a kona napehding na-insung chu, Judah dinga Tamar ahinpeh Pharez insung tobang chu hihen, atiuve.
target: Through the offspring the Lord gives you by this young woman, may your family be like that of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah.”

source: Hitichun Boaz'in Ruth akipuijin, ji-in aneitai. Chuin ama amanu koma alut phatnin, Pakaiyin amanu chu nao avopsah-in, chapa khat ahingtan ahi.
target: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife. When he made love to her, the Lord enabled her to conceive, and she gave birth to a son.

source: Chuin numei hon Naomi jah-a, Tuni tah ngeija sopi kinaipi beija nadalha louva Pakai chu nunnom hen; chule amapa hi Israel sunga amin kithang hen.
target: The women said to Naomi: “Praise be to the Lord , who this day has not left you without a guardian-redeemer. May he become famous throughout Israel!

source: Chule amapa hi nahinkho kiledohsah le nateh nunga navah-a hungpang hen; ajehchu nangma nangailu-a, nangma dinga chapa sagi sanga phachomjo namounun amahi ahin ahi, atiuve.
target: He will renew your life and sustain you in your old age. For your daughter-in-law, who loves you and who is better to you than seven sons, has given him birth.”

source: Chuin Naomi'in naosen chu alan, a-angah apomin, adonin apangtan ahi.
target: Then Naomi took the child in her arms and cared for him.

source: Chuin a-inheng numei hon naocha min asah-un, Naomi'a dingin chapa khat apenge, atiuvin; Obed asahtaove. Amahi David pa, Jesse pa ahi.
target: The women living there said, “Naomi has a son!” And they named him Obed. He was the father of Jesse, the father of David.

source: Tun hicheho hi Perez chilhah ahiuve. Perez in Hezron ahingin,
target: This, then, is the family line of Perez: Perez was the father of Hezron,

source: Hezron'in Ram ahingin, Ram'in Amminadab ahingin,
target: Hezron the father of Ram, Ram the father of Amminadab,

source: Amminadab'in Nahshon ahingin, Nahshon'in Salmon ahingin,
target: Amminadab the father of Nahshon, Nahshon the father of Salmon,

source: Salmon'in Boaz ahingin, Boaz in Obed ahingin,
target: Salmon the father of Boaz, Boaz the father of Obed,

source: Obed'in Jesse ahingin, Chule Jesse'in David ahinge.
target: Obed the father of Jesse, and Jesse the father of David.

source: Tun Ephraim molsang Ramathiam Zophim mun'a Ephrath mi, Zuph chapa, Tohu chapa, Elihu chapa, Jeroham chapa, amin Elkanah kiti mikhat anaumin ahi.
target: There was a certain man from Ramathaim, a Zuphite from the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Elkanah son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.

source: Chule aman ji ni aneijin, khatnu minchu Hannah ahin, achom khatjonu minchu Peninnah ahi. Chule Peninnah chun cha aneijin, ahinla Hannah'in vang cha aneipoi.
target: He had two wives; one was called Hannah and the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had none.

source: Chule hiche mipahi akhopia konin kumsehle Shiloh'a janel Pakai houding le ganlhai boldin achetoujin ahi. Chule Pakai thempu Eli chapateni Hophni le Phinehas chu hia chu umji lhon ahi.
target: Year after year this man went up from his town to worship and sacrifice to the Lord Almighty at Shiloh, where Hophni and Phinehas, the two sons of Eli, were priests of the Lord .

source: Chuin Elkanah hin thilto aneiphat tengle a-inneipi Peninnah le achapate le achanute jouse chu chan apejin,
target: Whenever the day came for Elkanah to sacrifice, he would give portions of the meat to his wife Peninnah and to all her sons and daughters.

source: Ahinla Hannah vang chun achanding doltah apejin ahi: ajehchu aman Hannah angailun, ahinla amanu chu Pakaiyin anaobu akhapeh ahi.
target: But to Hannah he gave a double portion because he loved her, and the Lord had closed her womb.

source: Chule Pakaiyin anaobu akhapeh jehchun khatjonu chun alungnat nadingin nasatah-in alunghansah jin ahi.
target: Because the Lord had closed Hannah’s womb, her rival kept provoking her in order to irritate her.

source: Chule chutia chu kumseh-a aboljing ahin, Pakai in'a amanu achetou tengle amanu aphinsejin; hijeh chun amanu akapmin anjong aneji tapoi.
target: This went on year after year. Whenever Hannah went up to the house of the Lord , her rival provoked her till she wept and would not eat.

source: Chujouvin Elkanah'in a-inneipi Hannah hengah, Ibola naka ham? ebola an nelouva um nahim? chule ibola lungkhama uma nahim? Keima nang dinga chapa som sanga phajoa kahi louham? ati.
target: Her husband Elkanah would say to her, “Hannah, why are you weeping? Why don’t you eat? Why are you downhearted? Don’t I mean more to you than ten sons?”

source: Chutia amahon Shiloh'a an aneh uva, chule twi adonjou phatnun, Hannah akipatdoh tan ahi. Tun Eli thempu chu Pakai houin khom khat bula touna chunga touva ahi.
target: Once when they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh, Hannah stood up. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his chair by the doorpost of the Lord ’s house.

source: Chuin amanu chu ahinna ahesoh lheh jengin, Pakai henga ataovin, chule laina tah-in akapmin ahi.
target: In her deep anguish Hannah prayed to the Lord , weeping bitterly.

source: Chuin amanu kitepna khatna akitepmin, Vo janel Pakai, nasohnu thohgimnahi neivet peh-a, neihet jinga, nasohnu hi nasuhmil louva, nasohnu hi chapa khat neipeh-a ahile, chuteng ahinkho lhumkeija Pakaiya kapeh ding, alua samchem kilamlou ding ahi, ati.
target: And she made a vow, saying, “ Lord Almighty, if you will only look on your servant’s misery and remember me, and not forget your servant but give her a son, then I will give him to the Lord for all the days of his life, and no razor will ever be used on his head.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, amanu Pakai anga ataojom jing laihin, Eli'n amuh phunchu anaven ahi.
target: As she kept on praying to the Lord , Eli observed her mouth.

source: Tun Hannah hin alungsunga asei ahijeh-in, amuh bouchu aphunin, ahin a-aw vang akijapoi. Hijeh chun Eli'n amanu jukhamin agelin ahi.
target: Hannah was praying in her heart, and her lips were moving but her voice was not heard. Eli thought she was drunk

source: Chuin Eli'n amanu jah-a, Itihchan nakham dingham? Naju chu nanga konin koimangin, ati.
target: and said to her, “How long are you going to stay drunk? Put away your wine.”

source: Chuin Hannah'in adonbutnin, Ahipoi, ka pakai, keima lungkham na-a dim numei kahi; keiman ju le khamnathei jong kadonpoi, amavang Pakai anga kahina kabuhlhah joh ahi.
target: “Not so, my lord,” Hannah replied, “I am a woman who is deeply troubled. I have not been drinking wine or beer; I was pouring out my soul to the Lord .

source: Nasohnu hi Belial chanun neisim hih-in, ajehchu kakiphina le kahesohna tambehseh jenga tuchana hi thu kasei ahi, ati.
target: Do not take your servant for a wicked woman; I have been praying here out of my great anguish and grief.”

source: Chuphatnin Eli'n adonbutnin, Lung mongin chetan: Israel Pathen'in nathilthum chu naphal pehtai ati.
target: Eli answered, “Go in peace, and may the God of Israel grant you what you have asked of him.”

source: Chuin amanun, Nasohnu hi namitnun lungsetna neimusah-in, ati. Chutichun hiche numei chu achena ding lampia achen, an anen, chule lungkham mel aputapon ahi.
target: She said, “May your servant find favor in your eyes.” Then she went her way and ate something, and her face was no longer downcast.

source: Chuin amaho jingkah matah-in athouvun, Pakai ahouvun, akileuvin, a-in'u Ramah'ah ahung taove. Chuin Elkanah'in a-inneipi Hannah chu aluppin; chule Pakaiyin amanu chu ageldoh tan ahi.
target: Early the next morning they arose and worshiped before the Lord and then went back to their home at Ramah. Elkanah made love to his wife Hannah, and the Lord remembered her.

source: Hijeh chun ahung hitin ahi, Hannah'in nao avopma, aphat ahunglhin tah-in chapa khat ahingin, Pakai henga kanathum ahi atin, amin Samuel asahtai.
target: So in the course of time Hannah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Samuel, saying, “Because I asked the Lord for him.”

source: Chuin Elkanah kitipa le a-insung mijouse chu Pakaiya kumtin ganlhai le akitepna tohdohdin achetou taove.
target: When her husband Elkanah went up with all his family to offer the annual sacrifice to the Lord and to fulfill his vow,

source: Ahinla Hannah achetoupoi; ajehchu amanun a-inneipu henga, Naosen in noi abankahsea kachetou louding ahi, Pakai anga gaki lahthei ahi-a, chule chumuna a-itih-a aumden theiding teng kahinpui ding ahi, ati.
target: Hannah did not go. She said to her husband, “After the boy is weaned, I will take him and present him before the Lord , and he will live there always.”

source: Chuin a-inneipu Elkanah'in ajah-a, Nangman phante nati bangchun boltan; noi aban kahsen khongai jengin; Pakaiyin bou athu chu phutdet hen, ati. Chutichun amanu aum denin, chule achapan noi aban kahsen avah-in ahi.
target: “Do what seems best to you,” her husband Elkanah told her. “Stay here until you have weaned him; only may the Lord make good his word.” So the woman stayed at home and nursed her son until she had weaned him.

source: Chuin amanun noi abansah phatnin, ama chu alhontoupin; bongchal thumtoh, changbong ephah khat le lengpitwi haikhat toh Shiloh'a Pakai in'a ahinpuitai: chule chapang chu khangdong cha ahi nalaije.
target: After he was weaned, she took the boy with her, young as he was, along with a three-year-old bull, an ephah of flour and a skin of wine, and brought him to the house of the Lord at Shiloh.

source: Chuin bongchal khat athatnun, naosen chu Eli henga apuitaovin ahi.
target: When the bull had been sacrificed, they brought the boy to Eli,

source: Chuin amanun, Vo ka pakai, nangma nahinjing bangin, ka pakai, hilaimuna nangma koma ana dinga Pakai henga anataova numei chu keima kahi.
target: and she said to him, “Pardon me, my lord. As surely as you live, I am the woman who stood here beside you praying to the Lord .

source: Hiche chapang dinga hi anataova kahin; Pakaiyin ahenga kanathum kataona chu eipetai.
target: I prayed for this child, and the Lord has granted me what I asked of him.

source: Hijeh chun keiman jong amahi Pakai henga kapeh ahi; ama ahinlai chansea Pakaiya hiding ahi, ati. Chuin amapan chukoma chun Pakai ahoutan ahi.
target: So now I give him to the Lord . For his whole life he will be given over to the Lord .” And he worshiped the Lord there.

source: Chuin Hannah ataovin, Kalungsung Pakaiya akipah lheh-in, Pakaiya ka ki hi choisangin aumin ahi: nami huhhingna-a chu kakipa jeh-in, kamelmate chunga kakam akikeh lenin ahi.
target: Then Hannah prayed and said: “My heart rejoices in the Lord ; in the Lord my horn is lifted high. My mouth boasts over my enemies, for I delight in your deliverance.

source: Pakai banga thenga koima aumpoi: ajehchu nang tailou koimacha dang aumpon; i-Pathen'u tobang songpi jong aumpoi.
target: “There is no one holy like the Lord ; there is no one besides you; there is no Rock like our God.

source: Kiletsah valin thu seitahih-in; nakamin hoithona thu pothih hen: ajehchu Pakai chu hetna Pathen ahin, chule aman thil kibol jouse aleptohji ahi.
target: “Do not keep talking so proudly or let your mouth speak such arrogance, for the Lord is a God who knows, and by him deeds are weighed.

source: Mihatte thalpi abong gamin, chule akipal lhuho chu hatna-in ataiju akigah pehtai.
target: “The bows of the warriors are broken, but those who stumbled are armed with strength.

source: Ana oivaho-a chu neh holnan amaho le amaho changlhah mandin akipedoh-un, anakel ho akelkit tapouve: chutichun achingan cha sagi ahingtan, chatam neinuchu alhasamtai.
target: Those who were full hire themselves out for food, but those who were hungry are hungry no more. She who was barren has borne seven children, but she who has had many sons pines away.

source: Pakaiyin athatnin achoh hingjin: chule thikholkhul'a apuisuh-in apuidoh kitjin ahi.
target: “The Lord brings death and makes alive; he brings down to the grave and raises up.

source: Pakaiyin avaichatsah-in chule ahaosahjin; aman asunemin chule adomsang jin ahi.
target: The Lord sends poverty and wealth; he humbles and he exalts.

source: Aman mivaicha chu leivuija konin akaithouvin; leng chapate lah-a tousah dingle, loupina laltouna losah dingin; khutdo chu eh lah-a konin adom doh-in ahi. Ajehchu leiset khompi jouse Pakaiya ahin, achunguva chu vannoihi atun ahi.
target: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap; he seats them with princes and has them inherit a throne of honor. “For the foundations of the earth are the Lord ’s; on them he has set the world.

source: Aman amithengte kengchu achintup ding; chule migiloupa chu muthima thipbeh-a umding ahi; ajehchu thahatna koima dingjou louding ahi.
target: He will guard the feet of his faithful servants, but the wicked will be silenced in the place of darkness. “It is not by strength that one prevails;

source: Pakai douho chu ahal hala kisuchipdiu; amaho chunga Ama van'a kona hung kitumding ahi. Pakaiyin leiset kolmong gei thu atan ding; aman alengpa chu thahat apehding, athaonupa ki chu achoisang ding ahi, ati.
target: those who oppose the Lord will be broken. The Most High will thunder from heaven; the Lord will judge the ends of the earth. “He will give strength to his king and exalt the horn of his anointed.”

source: Chuin Elkanah a-in lam Ramah kho-a achetai. Chule chapang chun Eli thempu masanga Pakai kin aboltan ahi.
target: Then Elkanah went home to Ramah, but the boy ministered before the Lord under Eli the priest.

source: Tun Eli chapa teni chu Belial chapate ahilhonin, amanin Pakai ahe lhonpon ahi.
target: Eli’s sons were scoundrels; they had no regard for the Lord .

source: Chule mipi ho lah-a thempuho bolding chu, khattouvin akilhaina atodoh teng, sa chu asou laitah le thempu sohpa chun satul kathum neikhat ahinchoija;
target: Now it was the practice of the priests that, whenever any of the people offered a sacrifice, the priest’s servant would come with a three-pronged fork in his hand while the meat was being boiled

source: Chule aman hichu bel bilnei, khangbel len, ahiloule bel sunga chu asutlutna, satul ka-a ahin khaidoh jouse chu thempupan ama dinga akilahji ahi. Hitia hi Shiloh'a hung Israelte jouse henga aboljiu ahi.
target: and would plunge the fork into the pan or kettle or caldron or pot. Whatever the fork brought up the priest would take for himself. This is how they treated all the Israelites who came to Shiloh.

source: Sathao chu ago masang uva jong thempu sohpa chu hunga, ganlhaina bolpa jah-a chu, Thempupa-a dinga gopeh dingin saphe chu neipen; ajehchu aman nanga kona akihon minsa alah louding, asel bou alahding ahi, atiji ahi.
target: But even before the fat was burned, the priest’s servant would come and say to the person who was sacrificing, “Give the priest some meat to roast; he won’t accept boiled meat from you, but only raw.”

source: Chule khattouvin ahenga, Amahon athao ago masat teiju ngai ahi, chujou tengle nahinnan adeijat jat kilah-in tia aseija ahileh; aman, Ahipoi, tu-a hi neipeh teiding ahi, achuti loule thahatsana kalahding ahi, tia adonbut ji ahi.
target: If the person said to him, “Let the fat be burned first, and then take whatever you want,” the servant would answer, “No, hand it over now; if you don’t, I’ll take it by force.”

source: Chuti chun gollhangho chonsetna chu Pakai masanga anasalheh jengtan; mihon Pakaiya thilto chu athetlo taovin ahi.
target: This sin of the young men was very great in the Lord ’s sight, for they were treating the Lord ’s offering with contempt.

source: Amavang chapangchan Samuel'in tupat ponnem thempu boitong sangkhol aki-ah in, Pakai anga lhacha na atongin ahi.
target: But Samuel was ministering before the Lord —a boy wearing a linen ephod.

source: Chukalvalin anun sangkhol chol neokhat akhuipeh-in, kumsehle ganlhaina boldinga a-inneipu toh ahungtou lhonteng ahinchoi pehjin ahi.
target: Each year his mother made him a little robe and took it to him when she went up with her husband to offer the annual sacrifice.

source: Chuin Eli'n Elkanah le a-inneipi phatthei aboh-in, Pakai henga thilpeh jalchun hiche numeija hin Pakaiyin sonle pah napelhon hen, ati. Chuin a-in lhona achelhon tai.
target: Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife, saying, “May the Lord give you children by this woman to take the place of the one she prayed for and gave to the Lord .” Then they would go home.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Hannah ahung vilin ahile amanun nao avopmin, chapa thumle chanu ni ahingin ahi. Chule chapang Samuel chu Pakai angsunga akhanglenin ahi.
target: And the Lord was gracious to Hannah; she gave birth to three sons and two daughters. Meanwhile, the boy Samuel grew up in the presence of the Lord .

source: Tun Eli atehlheh jengtan, Israelte jouse chunga achapateni thilbol jouse; houkhom ho houbuh kotphunga numei hung kikhom ho iti alup piji lhonham ti ajatan ahi.
target: Now Eli, who was very old, heard about everything his sons were doing to all Israel and how they slept with the women who served at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

source: Chuin aman aheng lhonna, Ibola chutobang thil nabolhon ham? Ajehchu nakhanset bollhon chu hiche miho-a konhin kajan ahi.
target: So he said to them, “Why do you do such things? I hear from all the people about these wicked deeds of yours.

source: Ahipoi, kachateni; kajahhi thulhut phaloutah ahi: nangnin Pakai mite chu nachon khelsah lhon ahitai.
target: No, my sons; the report I hear spreading among the Lord ’s people is not good.

source: Mikhat tou midang douna-a achonsetna ahile, thutanpan athu atan ding ahin: ahin mikhat tou Pakai douna-a achonsetna ahile, kon ama dinga ataopeh dingham? ati. Ahijeng vangin Pakaiyin amani thading atup jeh chun, apao thusei chu angaideh lhonpon ahi.
target: If one person sins against another, God may mediate for the offender; but if anyone sins against the Lord , who will intercede for them?” His sons, however, did not listen to their father’s rebuke, for it was the Lord ’s will to put them to death.

source: Chuin chapang Samuel chu akhang akhangin, Pakai le mihem deisah-in aumtan ahi.
target: And the boy Samuel continued to grow in stature and in favor with the Lord and with people.

source: Chuin Pathen mikhat Eli henga ahungin, ajah-a hitin ati, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Amaho Egypt gama Pharaoh insunga aum laijuva chu napa insunga kichentah-a kana phondoh hitalou ham?
target: Now a man of God came to Eli and said to him, “This is what the Lord says: ‘Did I not clearly reveal myself to your ancestor’s family when they were in Egypt under Pharaoh?

source: Chule Israel phung jouse-a kona kathempu hiding, ka-maicham chunga thilto ding, gimnamtui halding, chule kamasanga thempu boitong sangkhol kivon dinga kana lhendoh hilouham? Chule Israel chate meija kigou thilpeh jouse napa insung kanapeh hilouham?
target: I chose your ancestor out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to burn incense, and to wear an ephod in my presence. I also gave your ancestor’s family all the food offerings presented by the Israelites.

source: Ipi dinga kaumna-a kathupeh kaganlhaina le kathilto napeh manga, kami Israelte thilpeh jouse-a kon ahoipen chun nathao dohsah nadinga keisanga nachapateni najabol joh ham?
target: Why do you scorn my sacrifice and offering that I prescribed for my dwelling? Why do you honor your sons more than me by fattening yourselves on the choice parts of every offering made by my people Israel?’

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Israel Pathen'in, Keiman nangma insungle napa insungchu a-imatih chana kamasanga vahle diu ahi, tia anasei ahin: ahinla tun Pakaiyin, Hichu keija konin gamla tahen; ajehchu eijabol ho chu kajabol ding, chule nahsah louva eibolho chu nahsah louva kabolding ahi, ati.
target: “Therefore the Lord , the God of Israel, declares: ‘I promised that members of your family would minister before me forever.’ But now the Lord declares: ‘Far be it from me! Those who honor me I will honor, but those who despise me will be disdained.

source: Vetan, na-insunga tehse khatcha aumlouna dinga, nangma ban le napa insung mite ban kasatlhah nading nikhoho chu ahung lhungtai.
target: The time is coming when I will cut short your strength and the strength of your priestly house, so that no one in it will reach old age,

source: Chule Kachen namun le Pathen'in Israel apehding gou jouse-a chu melma khat aum namu ding: chule a-imatih chana na-insunga tehse umta louhel ding ahi.
target: and you will see distress in my dwelling. Although good will be done to Israel, no one in your family line will ever reach old age.

source: Chule ka-maicham'a kona kasatlhah louding namipa chu namitlhi sosah dingle nalungsung suna dinga kakoiding: chule na-inna peng jouse chu adonglai cheh-a thiding ahiuve.
target: Every one of you that I do not cut off from serving at my altar I will spare only to destroy your sight and sap your strength, and all your descendants will die in the prime of life.

source: Chule hichehohi nachapateni Hopni le Phinehas chunga thil hunglhung dingho namelchihna ahi; nikhat sunga anilhona thilhon ding ahi.
target: “ ‘And what happens to your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, will be a sign to you—they will both die on the same day.

source: Chule keiman kalungthim le kangaito dungjuija tongding, keima dinga thempu tahsan umtah khat kitundoh ding: chule keiman a-insung dettah-a katundohpeh ding; chule ama a-itih-a kathaonupa masanga vahle jing ding ahi.
target: I will raise up for myself a faithful priest, who will do according to what is in my heart and mind. I will firmly establish his priestly house, and they will minister before my anointed one always.

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi, na-in'a umnalai chasun chu ahenga hunguva dangka pehkhat le changlhah kamkhat athum diu, ahenga, Changlhah halkhat kaneh theina dingin, thempu natoh khat neipen, tia asei dingu ahi, ati.
target: Then everyone left in your family line will come and bow down before him for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread and plead, “Appoint me to some priestly office so I can have food to eat.” ’ ”

source: Chapang Samuel chu Eli masanga Pakai kin bolin apangin ahi. Chule hichelai chun Pakai thuchu amantam lheh jengin; phongtah-a kilahna anaumpoi.
target: The boy Samuel ministered before the Lord under Eli. In those days the word of the Lord was rare; there were not many visions.

source: Chuin hiche laichun ahitin ahi, Eli chu aumna-a alupma, kho muthei lou leuva amitchu ahung thima;
target: One night Eli, whose eyes were becoming so weak that he could barely see, was lying down in his usual place.

source: Chule Pathen kitepna thingkhong umna Pakai houin'a Pathen thaomei chu amit masang, chule Samuel chu imu ding aluplhah petnin;
target: The lamp of God had not yet gone out, and Samuel was lying down in the house of the Lord , where the ark of God was.

source: Chutichun Pakaiyin Samuel akouvin ahile aman, Hikoma kaume, tin adonbutnin ahi.
target: Then the Lord called Samuel. Samuel answered, “Here I am.”

source: Chuin ama Eli henga alhaijelin, Hikoma kaume; ajehchu nangman neikouve, agatin ahi. Chuin aman, Kakoupoi, galumkit tan, ati. Chuin ama achen alumtai.
target: And he ran to Eli and said, “Here I am; you called me.” But Eli said, “I did not call; go back and lie down.” So he went and lay down.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin avelin akoukitnin, Samuel, ati. Chuin Samuel athouvin, Eli henga chun achekitnin, Hikoma kaume; ajehchu nangman neikou monge, ati. Chuin aman adonbutnin, Kakoupoi, kachapa; galum kittan, ati.
target: Again the Lord called, “Samuel!” And Samuel got up and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; you called me.” “My son,” Eli said, “I did not call; go back and lie down.”

source: Tun Samuel'in Pakai chu ahehih laijin, Pakai thujong chu ahenga akiphong hihlaije.
target: Now Samuel did not yet know the Lord : The word of the Lord had not yet been revealed to him.

source: Chuin athumvei channa-in Pakaiyin Samuel akoukitnin ahi. Chuin ama athouvin, Eli henga achen, ajah-a, Hikoma kaume; ajehchu nangman neikou monge, ati. Chuin Eli'n Pakaiyin chapang chu akou ahi ahedohtan ahi.
target: A third time the Lord called, “Samuel!” And Samuel got up and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; you called me.” Then Eli realized that the Lord was calling the boy.

source: Hijeh chun Eli'n Samuel henga, Chen, galum kittan; chule hitiding ahi, aman nahinkou kitna ahileh, nangman, Seijin, Pakai, nasoh in kajanai natiding ahi, ati. Chutichun Samuel aumna-a agalumtai.
target: So Eli told Samuel, “Go and lie down, and if he calls you, say, ‘Speak, Lord , for your servant is listening.’ ” So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

source: Chuin Pakai ahungin, adingin, amasa-a bangchun, Samuel, Samuel, tin akouvin ahi. Hichun Samuel'in adonbutnin, Seijin; ajehchu nasoh-in kajanai, ati.
target: The Lord came and stood there, calling as at the other times, “Samuel! Samuel!” Then Samuel said, “Speak, for your servant is listening.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Samuel jah-a, Ven Israel sunga thilkhat kabolding ahin, hichun ajachan nakhang asutding ahi.
target: And the Lord said to Samuel: “See, I am about to do something in Israel that will make the ears of everyone who hears about it tingle.

source: Hiche nikho chule Eli douna-a a-insung chungchanga kanasei jousechu kaboldoh ding; kakipat tengle achaina jong kabolding ahi.
target: At that time I will carry out against Eli everything I spoke against his family—from beginning to end.

source: Ajehchu aman ahetsa khansetna jeh-a, a-insung chu a-imatih chana athu katan ding ahi tia kahilsa ahitai. Ajehchu achapa tenin thilse abol lhonin, aman amani anaphoh tangpoi.
target: For I told him that I would judge his family forever because of the sin he knew about; his sons blasphemed God, and he failed to restrain them.

source: Chule hichejeh-a chu keiman Eli insung chunga kana kihahsela, Eli insung khansetna chu ganlhai le anneh thilto-a jong a-itih-a suhtheng thei hilouding ahi, kanati ahi, ati.
target: Therefore I swore to the house of Eli, ‘The guilt of Eli’s house will never be atoned for by sacrifice or offering.’ ”

source: Chuin Samuel chu jingkah geijin alumin, Pakai in kot ho ahongin ahi. Chule Samuel'in Eli henga athilmu hetsah dingchu akichalheh-in ahi.
target: Samuel lay down until morning and then opened the doors of the house of the Lord . He was afraid to tell Eli the vision,

source: Hichun Eli'n Samuel akouvin, ajah-a, Kachapa Samuel ati. Chuin Samuel'in adonbutnin, hikoma kaume, ati.
target: but Eli called him and said, “Samuel, my son.” Samuel answered, “Here I am.”

source: Chuin aman, Pakaiyin nahenga aseichu ipithu ham? kangeh nahi, Keija konin imhih-in: nahenga aseijouse chu kahenga na-im auma ahile, Pathen'in nahenga chutobang chun chule akhohcheh-in jong bolhen, ati.
target: “What was it he said to you?” Eli asked. “Do not hide it from me. May God deal with you, be it ever so severely, if you hide from me anything he told you.”

source: Chuin Samuel'in thujouse chu ahilin, chule ahenga imacha a-im aumpoi. Chuin aman, Ama Pakai ahin, aman pha asah sah chun bolmaihen, ati.
target: So Samuel told him everything, hiding nothing from him. Then Eli said, “He is the Lord ; let him do what is good in his eyes.”

source: Chuin Samuel chu ahung khanglen jep jepmin, Pakaiyin aumpin, chule ama thuho chu khatcha jong tolla alhah sahpon ahi.
target: The Lord was with Samuel as he grew up, and he let none of Samuel’s words fall to the ground.

source: Chuin Dan'a pat Beersheba geijin Israelte jousen Samuel chu Pakai themgao khatnin akitung dohtai ti ahetauve.
target: And all Israel from Dan to Beersheba recognized that Samuel was attested as a prophet of the Lord .

source: Chuin Shiloh'a chun Pakai ahung kilah kitnin ahi: ajehchu Pakai thu dungjuija Shiloh'a chu Pakai amatah Samuel henga kiphongdoh ahi.
target: The Lord continued to appear at Shiloh, and there he revealed himself to Samuel through his word.

source: Chuin Samuel thu chu Israelte jouse henga ahung lhungtan ahi. Tun Israelte chu Philistine te satdin akondoh taovin, Ebenezer panga ponbuh asongun: Philistine te chun Aphek mun'a ponbuh asongun ahi.
target: And Samuel’s word came to all Israel. Now the Israelites went out to fight against the Philistines. The Israelites camped at Ebenezer, and the Philistines at Aphek.

source: Chuin Philistine te chu Israelte satdingin amaho le amaho akigol toh-un: chuin gal akisat phatnun Israelte chu Philistine te masanga agallel taovin; chule amahon galmuna chun galsat mi sangli tobang athat taovin ahi.
target: The Philistines deployed their forces to meet Israel, and as the battle spread, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand of them on the battlefield.

source: Chuin mipi chu gebuh ahunglhun phatnun Israel upaho chun, Ipijeh-a tunia Pakaiyin Philistine te masanga eigol lel sah-u ham? Shiloh'a konin Pakai kitepna thingkhong chu eiho henga dingin gapodoh-u hitin, hichu ilah uva ahungteng, hichun igalmiteu khutna konin eihuhdoh theijunte, atiuve.
target: When the soldiers returned to camp, the elders of Israel asked, “Why did the Lord bring defeat on us today before the Philistines? Let us bring the ark of the Lord ’s covenant from Shiloh, so that he may go with us and save us from the hand of our enemies.”

source: Hijeh chun mipichun Cherub teni kikah-a cheng janel Pakai kitepna thingkhong chu chua kona agapoh theina diuvin Shiloh'a mi asolun: chule Eli chapateni Hophni le Phinehas chu Pathen kitepna thingkhong chutoh chukoma chun aum lhonin ahi.
target: So the people sent men to Shiloh, and they brought back the ark of the covenant of the Lord Almighty, who is enthroned between the cherubim. And Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.

source: Chuin Pakai thingkhong chu gebuh ahunglhun phatnin Israelte jousen ha aovin a-aovun, hitichun leiset akithong leovin ahi.
target: When the ark of the Lord ’s covenant came into the camp, all Israel raised such a great shout that the ground shook.

source: Chuin Philistine ten gingleng lunga a-ao ginu ajah phatnun, Hebrew miho gebuh-a ging lenglung khu ipithu hitam, akitiuvin ahi. Chuin amahon Pakai kitepna thingkhong gebuh hunglhung ahi ti ahechen taove.
target: Hearing the uproar, the Philistines asked, “What’s all this shouting in the Hebrew camp?” When they learned that the ark of the Lord had come into the camp,

source: Chuin Philistine ten Gebuh-a Pathen hunglut ahi atiuvin akicha taovin ahi. Chuin amahon, Ohe idau ahi! ajehchu tumasangin hitobang thil anasoh khapoi.
target: the Philistines were afraid. “A god has come into the camp,” they said. “Oh no! Nothing like this has happened before.

source: Ohe idau ahi! hiche hat chungnung Pathenho khutna kona kon eihuhdoh diuham? Hichehohi gamthipma Egypt mite hivei jouse-a sugama Pathenho chu ahiuve.
target: We’re doomed! Who will deliver us from the hand of these mighty gods? They are the gods who struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.

source: Vo nangho Philistine te, nangho soh-a ana um banguva, Hebrew mite soh-a naum louna dingun hatnunlang, kipasal sah-un: nangho kipasal sah-un lang, satnun atiuve.
target: Be strong, Philistines! Be men, or you will be subject to the Hebrews, as they have been to you. Be men, and fight!”

source: Chuin Philistine techun asatnun, Israelte chu jo-in aum taovin, chule amaho amitakip aponbuh lam cheh uva ajam taovin; chule nasatah-a kithana aumin ahi: ajehchu Israelte chu keng sepai sangsomthum athiuvin ahi.
target: So the Philistines fought, and the Israelites were defeated and every man fled to his tent. The slaughter was very great; Israel lost thirty thousand foot soldiers.

source: Chule Pathen kitepna thingkhong chu alah peh-un; chule Eli chapateni Hophni le Phinehas jong athat taovin ahi.
target: The ark of God was captured, and Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, died.

source: Chuin sepai lah-a konin Benjamin phunga kon mikhat alhaijelin, apon teldehduh le aluchanga leiset pumin hicheni mama chun Shiloh'a alhailutnin ahi.
target: That same day a Benjamite ran from the battle line and went to Shiloh with his clothes torn and dust on his head.

source: Chuin ama ahungphatnin, veuvin, Eli chu lampamah touna chung khatna atouvin, anaven ahi: ajehchu Pathen kitepna thingkhong jeh chun alungsung akithingin ahi. Chule mipa khopi sunga ahunglut phatchun aseijin ahile khopi pumpi mihochu hakan akaptaovin ahi.
target: When he arrived, there was Eli sitting on his chair by the side of the road, watching, because his heart feared for the ark of God. When the man entered the town and told what had happened, the whole town sent up a cry.

source: Chule Eli'n ka awgin chu ajah phatnin, Hiche awging lullul khu ipithu hitam? ati. Chuin mipa chun kinotah-in ahungin, Eli ahung hiltai.
target: Eli heard the outcry and asked, “What is the meaning of this uproar?” The man hurried over to Eli,

source: Tun Eli chu kum somko le kumget ahitan; amit athimin, kho amuthei tapon ahi.
target: who was ninety-eight years old and whose eyes had failed so that he could not see.

source: Chuin mipan Eli jah-a, Keima sepai lah-a kona hungdoh-a kahin, tunia hi sepaiho lah-a kona hungjam doh kahi, ati. Chuin aman, Kachapa, chukoma chu ipi soh em? ati.
target: He told Eli, “I have just come from the battle line; I fled from it this very day.” Eli asked, “What happened, my son?”

source: Chuin thupopan adonbutnin ajah-a, Philistine te masanga chun Israelte ajamun, mipi lah-a chun nasatah-a kithana aumin, chule nachapa teni Hophni le Phinehas jong athi lhonin, Pathen kitepna thingkhong jongchu alataove, ati.
target: The man who brought the news replied, “Israel fled before the Philistines, and the army has suffered heavy losses. Also your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God has been captured.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, aman Pathen kitepna thingkhong aphahpoh phatnin, kotpi phung sih-a chun atouna-a konin anung lhuh-in, angong atat bongin, athitan ahi; ajehchu ama tehse ahin, gih-a ahi. Chule aman kum somli Israelte thu anatanin ahi.
target: When he mentioned the ark of God, Eli fell backward off his chair by the side of the gate. His neck was broken and he died, for he was an old man, and he was heavy. He had led Israel forty years.

source: Chule amounu Phinehas inneipi chu naovopma soh koncha ahi: chuin aman Pathen kitepna thingkhong kilahle atehpu le a-inneipu thithu ajah phatnin, ama abungin nao aneitan ahi. Ajehchu anatchu achunga hunglhung ahitai.
target: His daughter-in-law, the wife of Phinehas, was pregnant and near the time of delivery. When she heard the news that the ark of God had been captured and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she went into labor and gave birth, but was overcome by her labor pains.

source: Chuin ama athikon chun akoma ding numei ho chun, Kicha hih-in; ijeh inem itile chapa khat nahin ahi, atiuve. Ahinla amanun adonbut tapon, ngaijong angaisah tapoi.
target: As she was dying, the women attending her said, “Don’t despair; you have given birth to a son.” But she did not respond or pay any attention.

source: Hichun amanun naosen min chu Ichabod asah-in, Loupina chu Israel'a konin akitol mangtai ati: Pakai kitepna thingkhong kilahpeh jeh le, atehpu le a-inneipu jeh ahi.
target: She named the boy Ichabod, saying, “The Glory has departed from Israel”—because of the capture of the ark of God and the deaths of her father-in-law and her husband.

source: Chuin amanun, Loupina chu Israel'a kon kitolmang ahitai: ajeh chu Pathen thingkhong kilahmanga ahitai, ati.
target: She said, “The Glory has departed from Israel, for the ark of God has been captured.”

source: Chuin Philistine ten Pathen thingkhong chu alauvin, Ebenezer'a konin Ashdod'a ahinpouvin ahi.
target: After the Philistines had captured the ark of God, they took it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.

source: Philistine ten Pathen thingkhong ahinlah phatnun, Dagon in'a ahinpouvin, Dagon koma akoi taovin ahi.
target: Then they carried the ark into Dagon’s temple and set it beside Dagon.

source: Chule ajing jingkah matah-a Ashdod miho atho phatnun, veuvin, Dagon chu Pakai thingkhong masanga chun amai tollam ngan analhutan ahi. Chuin amahon Dagon chu adomdoh-un akitunna mama-a chun atung kitnun ahi.
target: When the people of Ashdod rose early the next day, there was Dagon, fallen on his face on the ground before the ark of the Lord ! They took Dagon and put him back in his place.

source: Chuin ajing jingkah matah-a atho phatnun, veuvin, Dagon chu Pakai thingkhong masanga chun amai tollam ngan analhun; chule Dagon luchang le akhutphang teni chu tanbohsan kotbula chun anaumin, Dagon tahsa chubou ana kidalhan ahi.
target: But the following morning when they rose, there was Dagon, fallen on his face on the ground before the ark of the Lord ! His head and hands had been broken off and were lying on the threshold; only his body remained.

source: Hijeh chun Dagon thempupa hihen lang, Dagon insunga hung koi hijongle, Ashdod'a Dagon kotphung chu tuni geijin achon pouvin ahi.
target: That is why to this day neither the priests of Dagon nor any others who enter Dagon’s temple at Ashdod step on the threshold.

source: Ahinla Pakai khutchu Ashdod mite chunga gihsatah-in achun, chule amaho chu asumangin, Ashdod le agam kimvela chengho chu uilutnin ajepmin ahi.
target: The Lord ’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod and its vicinity; he brought devastation on them and afflicted them with tumors.

source: Chuin Ashdod miten hichu amuphatnun, Israel Pathen thingkhong hi eihotoh umthei ponte: ajehchu ama khut chu eiho chungle i-pathen'u Dagon chunga anasa behseh jengin ahi, atiuve.
target: When the people of Ashdod saw what was happening, they said, “The ark of the god of Israel must not stay here with us, because his hand is heavy on us and on Dagon our god.”

source: Hijeh chun amahon Philistine te milen milal jouse ahenguva akou khomun, Israel Pathen thingkhong hi i-ilo diuham? atiuve. Chuin amahon adonbutnun, Israel Pathen thingkhong chu Gath lama kipotahen, atiuve. Chuin Israel Pathen thingkhong chu chulama chun apotaove.
target: So they called together all the rulers of the Philistines and asked them, “What shall we do with the ark of the god of Israel?” They answered, “Have the ark of the god of Israel moved to Gath.” So they moved the ark of the God of Israel.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, hichu chulama apoh nungun, Pakai khutchu suhgamna nasatah-in khopi dounan achun; khopi sunga mite chu alen aneo abonun ajepmin, achunguva uilut achutan ahi.
target: But after they had moved it, the Lord ’s hand was against that city, throwing it into a great panic. He afflicted the people of the city, both young and old, with an outbreak of tumors.

source: Hijeh chun amahon Pathen thingkhong chu Ekron'a asoltaove. Chuin ahitin ahi, Ekron'a Pathen thingkhong ahunglhun phatnin, Ekron mite chu apeng jah-un, Amahon eiho le imiteu thatgam dingin Pathen thingkhong chu eiho henga ahinpouve, atiuvin ahi.
target: So they sent the ark of God to Ekron. As the ark of God was entering Ekron, the people of Ekron cried out, “They have brought the ark of the god of Israel around to us to kill us and our people.”

source: Hijeh chun Philistine milen milal ho jouse chu agakoukhom sah-un, ahenguva, Israel Pathen thingkhong hi solmangun, chule eiho imiteu eitha louna dingin aum namun mama-a chekit tahen, atiuve. Ajehchu hiche khopi jouse sunga chu suhgamna nasatah uma ahitan; Pathen khut chu gihsatah-a chua ahitai.
target: So they called together all the rulers of the Philistines and said, “Send the ark of the god of Israel away; let it go back to its own place, or it will kill us and our people.” For death had filled the city with panic; God’s hand was very heavy on it.

source: Chule mihem athilouho chunga chun uilut achun; chule khopi-a kana awgin chu van alhung touvin ahi.
target: Those who did not die were afflicted with tumors, and the outcry of the city went up to heaven.

source: Pakai thingkhong chu Philistine gama lhasagi aga umin ahi.
target: When the ark of the Lord had been in Philistine territory seven months,

source: Chuin Philistine ten thempuho le doithemho akouvun, ahenguva, Pakai thingkhong chu ikalodiuham? Aumna ngaija chu iti kasol diuham? neisei peh-un, atiuve.
target: the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners and said, “What shall we do with the ark of the Lord ? Tell us how we should send it back to its place.”

source: Chuin amahon, Israelte Pathen thingkhong chu nasol ule agoh-in solhih-un, ahinla suhkhel thilto khattoh nalesoltha teidiu ahi; chuteng nadam uva, ipijeh-a nangho-a kona akhut achondoh louham ti nahet dingu ahi, atiuve.
target: They answered, “If you return the ark of the god of Israel, do not send it back to him without a gift; by all means send a guilt offering to him. Then you will be healed, and you will know why his hand has not been lifted from you.”

source: Hichun amahon, Amatoh kalesol tha dingu suhkhel thilpeh dingchu ipi hiding ham? atiuve. Amahon adonbutnun, Philistine te milal ho jat dungjuija uilut lim sanatum ngale sana jucha lim nga; ajehchu nabon chaova chungle namilen milal hou chunga chu natna kibang chua ahi.
target: The Philistines asked, “What guilt offering should we send to him?” They replied, “Five gold tumors and five gold rats, according to the number of the Philistine rulers, because the same plague has struck both you and your rulers.

source: Hijeh chun gamsung suse na-uilutnu limle najucha limu chu nasem uva; chule Israel Pathen chu loupina napeh dingu ahi. Chuti henlang hile nanghole na-pathen hou, chule nagam uva konin akhut ajangkhaisah domding ahi.
target: Make models of the tumors and of the rats that are destroying the country, and give glory to Israel’s god. Perhaps he will lift his hand from you and your gods and your land.

source: Chuti ahile ibola Egypt mite leh Pharaoh banga nalungu natahsah uham? Aman alah uva kidangtah-a na atoh phatna chu amahon mipi achedohsah uva, chule amaho potdoh-u hilouham?
target: Why do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh did? When Israel’s god dealt harshly with them, did they not send the Israelites out so they could go on their way?

source: Hijeh chun tun kangtalai thah khat semun lang, namkoljon pokhalou bongpi noi kilhohlai ni kaijun, chule bong kang chuto sutouvin lang, anouteni chu amani-a konin inlama hinkaijun.
target: “Now then, get a new cart ready, with two cows that have calved and have never been yoked. Hitch the cows to the cart, but take their calves away and pen them up.

source: Chule Pakai thingkhong chu domun lang bongkang chunga koijun; chule suhkhel thilpeh ding sana tum amato nung soltha dinga nasemhou chu thingkhong khatna khumun lang apanga koijun; chule achemang nadingin solmangun.
target: Take the ark of the Lord and put it on the cart, and in a chest beside it put the gold objects you are sending back to him as a guilt offering. Send it on its way,

source: Chule Beth-shemesh lampia ama gamkaija chu chetoupeh-am veuvin; achetou peh-a ahile hiche thilse khohtahhi amabol hija ahi; amavang achetoupeh louva ahile, eisugimuva chu ama khut ahipon, achama ichunguva hungsoh ahi ti ihetdiu ahi, atiuve.
target: but keep watching it. If it goes up to its own territory, toward Beth Shemesh, then the Lord has brought this great disaster on us. But if it does not, then we will know that it was not his hand that struck us but that it happened to us by chance.”

source: Chuin mihon achuti bolun, bongpi noi kilhohlai ni akaijun, chule bongkang chuto asutouvin, chule anouteni chu in'a ahentup taove.
target: So they did this. They took two such cows and hitched them to the cart and penned up their calves.

source: Chuin Pakai thingkhong le sana jucha lim le uilut lim umna thingkhong chu bongkang chunga chun akhangdoh taove.
target: They placed the ark of the Lord on the cart and along with it the chest containing the gold rats and the models of the tumors.

source: Chuin bongpi tenichun Beth-shemesh jotna lamchu ajonjang lhonin, kun pumin lamlhongpi chu ajotpeh lhonin, jetle veija apetdoh lhonpoi; chule Philistine milal hochun Beth-shemesh gamgi geijin ajuipeh-un ahi.
target: Then the cows went straight up toward Beth Shemesh, keeping on the road and lowing all the way; they did not turn to the right or to the left. The rulers of the Philistines followed them as far as the border of Beth Shemesh.

source: Chule Beth-shemesh mihochun phaichama chu asuhlou changu ana-atnu ahin: amaho akhoda uva ahile thingkhong chu amutaovin, hiche amujeh-u chun akipah lheh-un ahi.
target: Now the people of Beth Shemesh were harvesting their wheat in the valley, and when they looked up and saw the ark, they rejoiced at the sight.

source: Chuin bongkang chu Beth-shemesh khomi Joshua lou ahung lutnin, chua songpi lentah khat umna-a chun adingtai. Chuin amahon bongkang thingchu a-eh un, bongpi tenichu Pakai henga govam thilto-in atoh taove.
target: The cart came to the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh, and there it stopped beside a large rock. The people chopped up the wood of the cart and sacrificed the cows as a burnt offering to the Lord .

source: Chuin Levi hon Pakai thingkhong le aumpi sana manluho umna thingkhong chu alalhauvin, songpilen chunga chun akoitaove. Chule Beth-shemesh mihon hiche nikho mama chun Pakai henga govam thiltoho le ganlhainaho abol taovin ahi.
target: The Levites took down the ark of the Lord , together with the chest containing the gold objects, and placed them on the large rock. On that day the people of Beth Shemesh offered burnt offerings and made sacrifices to the Lord .

source: Chuin Philistine milal ngahon hiche amuphatnun, hicheni mama chun Ekhron'a akile taove.
target: The five rulers of the Philistines saw all this and then returned that same day to Ekron.

source: Chule Philistine ten Pakai henga suhkhel thilto dinga ahin nungsolu uilut lim sanatumho chu ahile; Ashdod dinga khat, Gaza dinga khat, Ashkelon dinga khat, Gath dinga khat, chule Ekron dinga khat ahin;
target: These are the gold tumors the Philistines sent as a guilt offering to the Lord —one each for Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron.

source: Chule sana jucha limho chu, kul kikai khum khopiho le thinglhang khoneoho puma Philistine te milen milal nga ho khopi jouse jat dungjuija ahin, Pakai thingkhong akoilhahnao Abel songpilen chung geichu ahi. Hiche songpi chu Beth-shemesh mite Joshua loulaija chu tuni geijahi umjing nalai ahi.
target: And the number of the gold rats was according to the number of Philistine towns belonging to the five rulers—the fortified towns with their country villages. The large rock on which the Levites set the ark of the Lord is a witness to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.

source: Chuin amahon Pakai thingkhong sung avetjeh-un, Aman Bethshemesh mihochu athatnin; mipi ho lah-a mi sangsomnga le somsagi jen athatnin ahi. Pakaiyin mipichu tamtah atha jeh-in mipi chu alunghem taovin ahi.
target: But God struck down some of the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, putting seventy of them to death because they looked into the ark of the Lord . The people mourned because of the heavy blow the Lord had dealt them.

source: Chuin Beth-shemesh miho chun, Hiche Pakai Pathen thengtah masanga hi koiham adingjou dinga? Chule eihoa kona ama koihenga chedoh dingham? atiuve.
target: And the people of Beth Shemesh asked, “Who can stand in the presence of the Lord , this holy God? To whom will the ark go up from here?”

source: Chuin amahon Kirjath-jearim kho miho henga thupole ho asolun, ahenguva, Philistine ten Pakai thingkhong ahinpokit taove; hungsuh-un lang naheng uva potaovin, atiuve.
target: Then they sent messengers to the people of Kiriath Jearim, saying, “The Philistines have returned the ark of the Lord . Come down and take it up to your town.”

source: Chuin Kirjath-jearim miho chu ahungun, Pakai thingkhong chu apotouvun, thinglhanga Abinadab insunga apolutnun, achapa Eleazar chu Pakai thingkhong chingtup dingin athenso taove.
target: So the men of Kiriath Jearim came and took up the ark of the Lord . They brought it to Abinadab’s house on the hill and consecrated Eleazar his son to guard the ark of the Lord .

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Kirjath-jearim'a thingkhong chu phat sottah aumin ahi; ajehchu kum somni jen uma ahi. Hitichun Israel insung pumpi chun Pakai lhangaijin akachamun ahi.
target: The ark remained at Kiriath Jearim a long time—twenty years in all. Then all the people of Israel turned back to the Lord .

source: Chuin Samuel'in Israel insung jouse jah-a, Nangho nalung pumpiuva Pakai henga hungkile nahiuva ahile, nalah uva konin gamchom pathenho le Ashtaroth chu koimangun; chule Pakaiya din nalungu gongtup unlang, amabou jenun: chutile aman Philistine te khutna kona nahuhdoh dingu ahi, ati.
target: So Samuel said to all the Israelites, “If you are returning to the Lord with all your hearts, then rid yourselves of the foreign gods and the Ashtoreths and commit yourselves to the Lord and serve him only, and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.”

source: Hichun Israel ten Baalim le Ashtaroth chu akoimangun, Pakai bou ajentaove.
target: So the Israelites put away their Baals and Ashtoreths, and served the Lord only.

source: Chuin Samuel'in, Israelte chu abonchauvin Mizpeh'a khom khomun, chule keiman Pakai henga nataopeh uvinge, ati.
target: Then Samuel said, “Assemble all Israel at Mizpah, and I will intercede with the Lord for you.”

source: Chuin Mizpeh'a akikhom khomun, twi athalun, Pakai angsunga asunglhaovin, hiche nikho chun an angolun, Keiho Pakai dounan kachonse taove, atiuve. Chuti chun Samuel'in Israelte chu Mizpeh'a athu-u atanin ahi.
target: When they had assembled at Mizpah, they drew water and poured it out before the Lord . On that day they fasted and there they confessed, “We have sinned against the Lord .” Now Samuel was serving as leader of Israel at Mizpah.

source: Chuin Philistine ten Israelte Mizpeh'a akikhom khomuve ti ajah phatnun, Philistine milal ho chu Israelte doudingin akontouvin ahi. Chuin Israel chaten hichu ajah phatnun, Philistine te chu akicha taovin ahi.
