target: When the Philistines heard that Israel had assembled at Mizpah, the rulers of the Philistines came up to attack them. When the Israelites heard of it, they were afraid because of the Philistines.

source: Chuin Israel chaten Samuel henga, Philistine te khutna kona eihuhdoh nadingun Pakai ka-Pathen'u hengu keiho dingin tanglouvin neitao peh-un, atiuve.
target: They said to Samuel, “Do not stop crying out to the Lord our God for us, that he may rescue us from the hand of the Philistines.”

source: Chuin Samuel'in kelngoinou noicheplai khat alan, apumin Pakai henga govam thilto-in atohdoh-in: Israelte din Pakai henga ataovin; Pakaiyin asanpehtan ahi.
target: Then Samuel took a suckling lamb and sacrificed it as a whole burnt offering to the Lord . He cried out to the Lord on Israel’s behalf, and the Lord answered him.

source: Chuin Samuel'in govam thilto ato laijin, Philistine te chu Israel satdin ahung naijun ahi. Ahinla Pakaiyin hiche nikho chun Philistine te chunga vangin nasatah aginsah-in, alungboi sah-in, Israelte masanga agal lel taovin ahi.
target: While Samuel was sacrificing the burnt offering, the Philistines drew near to engage Israel in battle. But that day the Lord thundered with loud thunder against the Philistines and threw them into such a panic that they were routed before the Israelites.

source: Chuin Israel mite chu Mizpeh'a konin apotdoh-un, Philistine te chu anungdelun, Beth-car aphah kahseovin athatpeh-un ahi.
target: The men of Israel rushed out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, slaughtering them along the way to a point below Beth Kar.

source: Chujouvin Samuel'in song khat alan, Mizpeh le Shen kah-a atungin, chuin Hichan geijahi Pakaiyin eipanpiu ahi atin, aminchu Ebenezer asahtai.
target: Then Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Shen. He named it Ebenezer, saying, “Thus far the Lord has helped us.”

source: Chutichun Philistine te chu suhnemin aumun, chule amaho Israelte gamsunga ahungkit tapouve. Samuel nikho laisen Pakai khutchun Philistine te adou jingin ahi.
target: So the Philistines were subdued and they stopped invading Israel’s territory. Throughout Samuel’s lifetime, the hand of the Lord was against the Philistines.

source: Chule Philistine ten Israel te-a kona analah khopiho chu Ekron'a pat Gath geijin Israelte alepeh kit tan; chule agam kimvelho jouse jongchu Philistine te khutna konin Israel ten alelah kit taovin ahi. Chule Israelte le Amor mite kah-a chun chamna aumin ahi.
target: The towns from Ekron to Gath that the Philistines had captured from Israel were restored to Israel, and Israel delivered the neighboring territory from the hands of the Philistines. And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.

source: Chule Samuel'in ahinlai sungin Israelte thu anatanin ahi.
target: Samuel continued as Israel’s leader all the days of his life.

source: Chule akumseh'in Bethel le Gilgal, chule Mizpeh'a achekol lejingin, hiche munho-a chun Israelte thu atanjin ahi
target: From year to year he went on a circuit from Bethel to Gilgal to Mizpah, judging Israel in all those places.

source: Chule Ramah'a chun a-in aumjeh'in ahungkile kitjin; chule hia chun Israelte thu anatanjin; hia chun Pakai dingin maicham khat asemin ahi.
target: But he always went back to Ramah, where his home was, and there he also held court for Israel. And he built an altar there to the Lord .

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Samuel ateh phatnin achapa teni chu Israelte chunga thutandin apansah tan ahi.
target: When Samuel grew old, he appointed his sons as Israel’s leaders.

source: Tun achapa lenpenpa minchu Joel ahin; aninapa minchu Abiah ahi: amanichu Beersheba-a thutan ahilhone.
target: The name of his firstborn was Joel and the name of his second was Abijah, and they served at Beersheba.

source: Chule achapa teni chu ama lampia achelhonpon; ahin alam louva sum muding agolhonin, nehguh akilah lhonin, chule thudih chu aheikon lhonin ahi.
target: But his sons did not follow his ways. They turned aside after dishonest gain and accepted bribes and perverted justice.

source: Hichun Israel upaho jouse chu akikhom khomun, Samuel henga Ramah'a ahungun,
target: So all the elders of Israel gathered together and came to Samuel at Ramah.

source: Chule ajah-a, Ven, nangla natehtan, nachapa tenila nang lampiho-a achelhon poi; tun namdangho jouse bangin kathu-u tanding leng khat neisem peh-un, atiuve.
target: They said to him, “You are old, and your sons do not follow your ways; now appoint a king to lead us, such as all the other nations have.”

source: Ahinla amahon, Kathu-u tanding lengkhat neipeuvin, tia aseiju chun Samuel alung phatmo sah-in ahi. Chuin Samuel Pakai henga ataotan ahi.
target: But when they said, “Give us a king to lead us,” this displeased Samuel; so he prayed to the Lord .

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Samuel henga, Mihon nahenga aseijouse chu ngaipehtan, ajehchu amahon nangma napaiju ahipon; amavang achunguva vai kahom louna dinga keimajoh eipaiju ahibouve.
target: And the Lord told him: “Listen to all that the people are saying to you; it is not you they have rejected, but they have rejected me as their king.

source: Egypt gama kona kahinpuidoh-a pat tuni geija athilbol jouseu dungjuija keima eidalhah uva, pathen dang ajenjiu banga chu, nangma henga jong abolu ahi.
target: As they have done from the day I brought them up out of Egypt until this day, forsaking me and serving other gods, so they are doing to you.

source: Hijeh chun tun amaho thuchu ngaipeh-in: ahijeng vangin amahochu gihsalin lang, achunguva leng changdingpa thutan dingdan chu musah-in, ati.
target: Now listen to them; but warn them solemnly and let them know what the king who will reign over them will claim as his rights.”

source: Chuin Samuel'in Pakai thuho jouse chu leng neipeuvin tia ngeh-a mipi ho henga chun ahiltan ahi.
target: Samuel told all the words of the Lord to the people who were asking him for a king.

source: Chuin aman, Hichehi nachung uva lengchang dingpa thutan dingdan chu hiding ahi: aman nachapateo chu ama-a dinga alah-a, akangtalaiho-a ding le asakol sepai dinga apansah ding, chule abang asakol kangtalai masanga lhaiding ahiuve.
target: He said, “This is what the king who will reign over you will claim as his rights: He will take your sons and make them serve with his chariots and horses, and they will run in front of his chariots.

source: Chule aman asang chunga gallamkai, somnga chunga gallamkai dinga apansah ding; chule amaho chu alou lhouding, achang atding, agalmanchah semding, chule asakol kangtalai ho manchah sema apansah ding ahi.
target: Some he will assign to be commanders of thousands and commanders of fifties, and others to plow his ground and reap his harvest, and still others to make weapons of war and equipment for his chariots.

source: Aman nachanuteu chu gimnamtui semding, anhon ding, chule changlhah semdinga akilahding ahi.
target: He will take your daughters to be perfumers and cooks and bakers.

source: Chule aman nalouhou, nalengpi leihou, chule na-olive honhou chu aphapenho kisana alah-a, asohte apehding ahi.
target: He will take the best of your fields and vineyards and olive groves and give them to his attendants.

source: Chule aman namuchi houle nalengpigao somakhat alah-a, avaipoho le asohte apehding ahi.
target: He will take a tenth of your grain and of your vintage and give it to his officials and attendants.

source: Chule aman nasoh pasal hou le nasoh numei hou, chule nagollhang phapenhou le nasangan hou chu alah-a, ama na atohsah ding ahi.
target: Your male and female servants and the best of your cattle and donkeys he will take for his own use.

source: Aman nakelngoi honhou somakhat alahding: chule nangho ama soh-a napan dingu ahi.
target: He will take a tenth of your flocks, and you yourselves will become his slaves.

source: Chule hiche nikho chule nanakilhenu lengpa jeh-a chu nahung ka diu; chule hiche nikho chule Pakaiyin nanangai peh loudingu ahi, ati.
target: When that day comes, you will cry out for relief from the king you have chosen, but the Lord will not answer you in that day.”

source: Ahijeng vangin mipichu Samuel thusei chu ngaiding anompouvin; amahon, Ahipoi, kachunguva leng khat kaneitei dingu ahi.
target: But the people refused to listen to Samuel. “No!” they said. “We want a king over us.

source: Chutia chu keiho jong namdangho jouse tobang kahidiu; chule kalengpaovin kathu-u eitan pehdiu, chule kamasanguva lamkaija kagalu eisatpeh dingu ahi, atiuve.
target: Then we will be like all the other nations, with a king to lead us and to go out before us and fight our battles.”

source: Chuin Samuel'in mipi ho thujouse chu angaijin, chuin abonchan Pakai nakhang sunga akhumsoh kitnin ahi.
target: When Samuel heard all that the people said, he repeated it before the Lord .

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Samuel henga, athuseiju ngaipeh inlang leng khat tundoh pehtan, ati. Chuin Samuel'in Israel miho henga chun, Amitakip nakhopi cheh uva chetaovin, ati.
target: The Lord answered, “Listen to them and give them a king.” Then Samuel said to the Israelites, “Everyone go back to your own town.”

source: Tun hichelai chun Benjamin mikhat amin Kish kiti Abiel chapa, Zeror chapa, Bechorath chapa, Aphiah chapa, Benjamin mi, mihat thuneitah khat aumin ahi.
target: There was a Benjamite, a man of standing, whose name was Kish son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Bekorath, the son of Aphiah of Benjamin.

source: Chule aman gollhang dei umtah le hoitah amin Saul kiti chapa khat aneijin: chule Israel chate lah-a chun ama sanga hoija mi aumpoi. Alengkouva pat chunglamse chu midangho vuma sangdoh ahi.
target: Kish had a son named Saul, as handsome a young man as could be found anywhere in Israel, and he was a head taller than anyone else.

source: Chuin Saul pa Kish sanganho chu amangin ahile Kish'in achapa Saul jah-a, Tun kipat in, nasoh ho lah-a khat kipuijin lang, sanganho holin chen, ati.
target: Now the donkeys belonging to Saul’s father Kish were lost, and Kish said to his son Saul, “Take one of the servants with you and go and look for the donkeys.”

source: Chuin aman Ephraim molsang ajotpeh-in, Shalisha gamsung ajotnin, ahinla amanin amujou lhonpon ahi. Chuin Shalim gamsung ajotpeh lhonin, chua jong chun anaum pouvin ahi. Chuin Benjamin gamsung ajotpeh lhonin, ahinla amudeh lhonpoi.
target: So he passed through the hill country of Ephraim and through the area around Shalisha, but they did not find them. They went on into the district of Shaalim, but the donkeys were not there. Then he passed through the territory of Benjamin, but they did not find them.

source: Chuin amani Zuph gam ahunglhung lhon phatnin, Saul'in ahin kilhonpi asohpa jah-a, Hungin, kileta hite, achuti loule kapa sanganho chung sangin eini chunga lungkham jogetninte, ati.
target: When they reached the district of Zuph, Saul said to the servant who was with him, “Come, let’s go back, or my father will stop thinking about the donkeys and start worrying about us.”

source: Chuin aman ahenga, Ven, tuhin hiche khopi sungahin Pathen mi khat aume, chule amachu ja umtah mi ahin; aman asei jouse guilhung jengji ahi. Tun hilama chun chehite; ijem atile ichena lhonding lampi eihil theilhon khattou vinte, ati.
target: But the servant replied, “Look, in this town there is a man of God; he is highly respected, and everything he says comes true. Let’s go there now. Perhaps he will tell us what way to take.”

source: Hichun Saul'in asohpa jah-a, Ahinla ven, eini chelehen mipa chu ipi ichoipeh dingham? Ajehchu ibelsung lhona changlhah la abeisohtan, Pathen mipa choipehding thilpeh dingla aumpon: ipi ineijem, ati.
target: Saul said to his servant, “If we go, what can we give the man? The food in our sacks is gone. We have no gift to take to the man of God. What do we have?”

source: Chuin sohpa chun Saul adonbut kitnin, Ven, keiman kakhutna dangka shekel khat hoplia hopkhat aume; ilampi lhonding eihil lhon nadingin, hichehi Pathen mipa chu petange, ati.
target: The servant answered him again. “Look,” he said, “I have a quarter of a shekel of silver. I will give it to the man of God so that he will tell us what way to take.”

source: (Masanglaijin Israel gama Pathen thudoh neidinga mi achetengle, Hungin, mitvah neipa henga chehite, ana tijiuve. Ajehchu tu-a themgao kitihi masanga chu mitvah neipa kitiji ahi).
target: (Formerly in Israel, if someone went to inquire of God, they would say, “Come, let us go to the seer,” because the prophet of today used to be called a seer.)

source: Chuin Sual'in asohpa henga, Naseidih-e; hungin, chehite, ati. Chuti chun Pathen mipa umna khopi-a chun achelhon tai.
target: “Good,” Saul said to his servant. “Come, let’s go.” So they set out for the town where the man of God was.

source: Chuin khopi jotna lhanga chu akaltou lhona ahile, soh nungah ho twithal dinga hungpot dohho amulhonin, ahenguva chun, Mitvah neipa chu umam? atilhone.
target: As they were going up the hill to the town, they met some young women coming out to draw water, and they asked them, “Is the seer here?”

source: Chuin amahon amani chu adonbutnun, Aumnai, ven, ama namasang lhona ache-e; tun kikinsah lhonin, ajehchu ama tunia hi khopi-a hunga ahi; ajehchu tunia hi munsanga mipi ganlhaina umding ahi:
target: “He is,” they answered. “He’s ahead of you. Hurry now; he has just come to our town today, for the people have a sacrifice at the high place.

source: Khopisung nalut lhonlhonle munsanga an ne-a ache masanga namupai jeng lhonding ahi: ajehchu ama ahunglhun masanga mipihon an anehlou dingu ahi, ajehchu aman ganlhaina chu phatthei aboh-a, chujou teng akikouho chun anehdiu ahi. Hijeh chun tun chetou lhonin, tuphat donnahi ama namu lhonding ahi, atiuve.
target: As soon as you enter the town, you will find him before he goes up to the high place to eat. The people will not begin eating until he comes, because he must bless the sacrifice; afterward, those who are invited will eat. Go up now; you should find him about this time.”

source: Chuin khopi sunga chun achetou lhontai: amani khopisung ahunglut lhon phatnin, veuvin, munsanga cheding chun Samuel chu amani henglam jonin ahunge.
target: They went up to the town, and as they were entering it, there was Samuel, coming toward them on his way up to the high place.

source: Saul hunglhun masanga nikho-a chu Pakaiyin Samuel nabenga hitia anasei ahitai,
target: Now the day before Saul came, the Lord had revealed this to Samuel:

source: Jing nikho tuphat don hileh Benjamin gama kon mikhat kahinsol ding ahin, amachun Philistine te khutna kona kamite ahuhdoh theina dinga, kami Israelte chunga gallamkai dinga amachu thao nananu ding ahi: ajehchu akanao kaheng ahunglhun tahjeh-in, kamite chu kakhohsah tan ahi, ati.
target: “About this time tomorrow I will send you a man from the land of Benjamin. Anoint him ruler over my people Israel; he will deliver them from the hand of the Philistines. I have looked on my people, for their cry has reached me.”

source: Chuin Samuel'in Saul amuphatnin, Pakaiyin ahenga, Ven! keiman nahenga kanasei mipa chu, hiche mipa hin kamite chunga vai apohding ahi, ati.
target: When Samuel caught sight of Saul, the Lord said to him, “This is the man I spoke to you about; he will govern my people.”

source: Chuin Sual'in kotpi phunga chun Samuel chu agah naijin, Katao ahi, mitvah neipa in chu hoilaiham neihilin, ati.
target: Saul approached Samuel in the gateway and asked, “Would you please tell me where the seer’s house is?”

source: Chuin Samuel'in Saul adonbutnin, Keima mitvah neipa chu kahi: munsang lama chun kamasanga chetouvin; ajehchu nangman tunia hi keima toh an ineh khomding, chule jingtengle kasol bepding; nalungsunga um jouse chu kahil ding nahi.
target: “I am the seer,” Samuel replied. “Go up ahead of me to the high place, for today you are to eat with me, and in the morning I will send you on your way and will tell you all that is in your heart.

source: Chule nithum masanga anamanga nasangan hou thudola vang, amaho chunga chun lungkham hih-in; ajehchu amahochu amutaove. Chule Israelte ngaichat ho jouse chu koichunga umam? Nangmale napa insung pumpi chunga uma hilouham? ati.
target: As for the donkeys you lost three days ago, do not worry about them; they have been found. And to whom is all the desire of Israel turned, if not to you and your whole family line?”

source: Chuin Saul'in adonbutnin, Keima Israel phung jouse lah-a aneopen Benjamin mi kahi louham? chule ka-insung jong Benjamin phunga alhumpen hilouham? achutile ipijeh-a kahenga hitobang chu naseiham? ati.
target: Saul answered, “But am I not a Benjamite, from the smallest tribe of Israel, and is not my clan the least of all the clans of the tribe of Benjamin? Why do you say such a thing to me?”

source: Chuin Samuel'in Saul le asohpa chu kikhopna in'a ahin puilutnin, akikouho lah-a mun loupi pena atousah-in ahi: amaho chu somthum tobang ahiuve.
target: Then Samuel brought Saul and his servant into the hall and seated them at the head of those who were invited—about thirty in number.

source: Chuin Samuel'in anhonpa jah-a, Nahenga, Atum beh-in koijin, tia kapeh sachan chu hinchoitan, ati.
target: Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the piece of meat I gave you, the one I told you to lay aside.”

source: Chuin anhonpan adah le achunga umhochu adomdoh-in, Saul anga aluitai. Chuin Samuel'in, Ven, anakikhen khenna chu hiche hi ahi, na-anga akiluije; ne-in; ajehchu, Keiman mipi ho kakouve kati-a pat tuchana hi nangma dinga anakikoi ahi, ati. Chutichun hiche nikho chun Saul'in Samuel to anekhomin ahi.
target: So the cook took up the thigh with what was on it and set it in front of Saul. Samuel said, “Here is what has been kept for you. Eat, because it was set aside for you for this occasion from the time I said, ‘I have invited guests.’ ” And Saul dined with Samuel that day.

source: Chuin munsanga kona khopi sunga ahungsuh phatnun, Samuel'in indan chunga chun Saul akihoulimpin ahi.
target: After they came down from the high place to the town, Samuel talked with Saul on the roof of his house.

source: Chuin matah-in athouvun; nisa sophat donin ahitin ahi, Samuel'in Saul chu indan chunga chun akou touvin, ajah-a chun, Kasoldoh theina dingin thouvin, ati. Chuin Saul athouvin, amale Samuel chu achedoh gel lhontai.
target: They rose about daybreak, and Samuel called to Saul on the roof, “Get ready, and I will send you on your way.” When Saul got ready, he and Samuel went outside together.

source: Chuin khopi pam geija achesuh lhon laijin, Samuel'in Saul jah, Sohpa hi imasang lam lhona ache nadingin solin, (ama achetai,) ahin nangma vang Pathen thu kamusah theinadin chomkhat dingdenin, ati.
target: As they were going down to the edge of the town, Samuel said to Saul, “Tell the servant to go on ahead of us”—and the servant did so—“but you stay here for a while, so that I may give you a message from God.”

source: Chujouvin Samuel'in thaothei khat alan, aluchunga asunglhan, amachu achopmin, ajah-a, Pakaiyin agoulote chunga gallamkai dinga thao nanu hilouham?
target: Then Samuel took a flask of olive oil and poured it on Saul’s head and kissed him, saying, “Has not the Lord anointed you ruler over his inheritance?

source: Tunia hi nangma keima-a kona nachedoh tengle, Benjamin gamgi Zelzah'a Rachel lhan koma mini namu ding; chule amanin nangma henga, Ahol dinga nache lona sanganho chu akimutai: chule ven, napan sanganho khohsah ding anga-in, nangma dingin alungkhamin, Kachapa dinga hi ipi kabol dingham? atie, ati lhonding ahi.
target: When you leave me today, you will meet two men near Rachel’s tomb, at Zelzah on the border of Benjamin. They will say to you, ‘The donkeys you set out to look for have been found. And now your father has stopped thinking about them and is worried about you. He is asking, “What shall I do about my son?” ’

source: Chuteng chua konchun masanglama chebe lechun Tabor phaicham lhungin natin, chua chu Bethel'a Pathen henga chetou mi thum nakimuto piding, khatpan kelnou thum, khatpan changlhah thum, chule khatpan lengpitwi haikhat achoiding ahi.
target: “Then you will go on from there until you reach the great tree of Tabor. Three men going up to worship God at Bethel will meet you there. One will be carrying three young goats, another three loaves of bread, and another a skin of wine.

source: Chule amaho chun chibai naboh diu, changlhah ni napeh dingu; hichu akhutnuva kona nakisan ding ahi.
target: They will greet you and offer you two loaves of bread, which you will accept from them.

source: Chujou tengle Philistine sepaiho umna Pathen lhang chu nahung ding; chule hitiding ahi, hiche khopi-a chu nahungtengle, tumging le khongcha, kuli, chule selangdah amasanguva hintho-a munsanga kona hung kumlha themgao honkhat nakitopi ding; amaho chun gaothu asei dingu ahi.
target: “After that you will go to Gibeah of God, where there is a Philistine outpost. As you approach the town, you will meet a procession of prophets coming down from the high place with lyres, timbrels, pipes and harps being played before them, and they will be prophesying.

source: Chule Pakai lhagao nachunga hungchu ding, amahoto gaothu nasei khomding, chule michombeh nakiso ding ahi.
target: The Spirit of the Lord will come powerfully upon you, and you will prophesy with them; and you will be changed into a different person.

source: Chule hung hitihen, hiche melchihnahohi nachunga ahunglhun tengle, thil hungso dungjuija nabol jengding ahi; ajehchu Pathen'in na-umpinai.
target: Once these signs are fulfilled, do whatever your hand finds to do, for God is with you.

source: Chule nangma kamasanga Gilgal'a nachesuh ding; chule ven, govam thiltoho tohdingle chamna thilto ganlhaina toh dinga nahenga kahungsuh ding ahi. Nangman ipi nabolding musah dinga nahenga kahung kahse-a, nisagi nakhongai ding ahi, ati.
target: “Go down ahead of me to Gilgal. I will surely come down to you to sacrifice burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, but you must wait seven days until I come to you and tell you what you are to do.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, ama Samuel'a kona kinungle dinga che akigotchun, Pathen'in ama lungchom khat apen; hicheni chun melchihna jouse chu aguilhung soh heltai.
target: As Saul turned to leave Samuel, God changed Saul’s heart, and all these signs were fulfilled that day.

source: Chuin amani chuche lhang lama chu ahung lhona ahile, veuvin themgao honkhat toh akitoh lhonin; chule Pathen lhagao achunga ahung chutan, chuin aman alah uva chun gaothu aseitan ahi.
target: When he and his servant arrived at Gibeah, a procession of prophets met him; the Spirit of God came powerfully upon him, and he joined in their prophesying.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, masanga ama anahesa jouse chun aman themgaoho lah-a gaothu asei chu amuphatnun, miho chu khatle khat akihouvun, Kish chapa chunga khu ipi hungsoh-a hitam? Saul jong themgaoho lah-a panga hitam? atiuve.
target: When all those who had formerly known him saw him prophesying with the prophets, they asked each other, “What is this that has happened to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?”

source: Chuin chukoma mikhatnin adonbutnin, Ahin apao chu koiham? ati, hijeh chun Saul jong themgaoho lah-a panga ham? kitihi thuchih ahung hidohtan ahi.
target: A man who lived there answered, “And who is their father?” So it became a saying: “Is Saul also among the prophets?”

source: Chuin athemgao thusei kichai chaijin, ama munsang lama ahungtai.
target: After Saul stopped prophesying, he went to the high place.

source: Chuin Saul pangahpa chun amale asohpa henga, Hoilama nache lhonham? ati. Chuin aman, Sangan hola che kahi lhonin: chule hoimacha kamu lhonlou phatnin, Samuel henga kahunglhone, ati.
target: Now Saul’s uncle asked him and his servant, “Where have you been?” “Looking for the donkeys,” he said. “But when we saw they were not to be found, we went to Samuel.”

source: Chuin Saul pangah pan, Katao ahi, Samuel'in nahenga ipi aseijem neihilin, ati.
target: Saul’s uncle said, “Tell me what Samuel said to you.”

source: Chuin Saul'in apangahpa henga, Aman sanganho chu akimutai tin kichentah-in eihil lhone, ati. Ahinla lenggam thudol Samuel'in aseivang chu ahilpoi.
target: Saul replied, “He assured us that the donkeys had been found.” But he did not tell his uncle what Samuel had said about the kingship.

source: Chuin Samuel'in mipichu Mizpeh'a Pakai henga akoukhomin;
target: Samuel summoned the people of Israel to the Lord at Mizpah

source: Israel chate jah-a chun, Israel Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, keiman Egypt'a konin Israel kahin puidoh-in, Egypt mite khutna konle lenggam jouse-a kon, chule nasugenthei houva konin kahuh doh-in ahi.
target: and said to them, “This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘I brought Israel up out of Egypt, and I delivered you from the power of Egypt and all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’

source: Ahin tunin nahesoh naole nagenthei nao jouse-a kona nahuhdoh uva Pathen nanotthap taovin; chule nanghon ama henga, Ahipoi, kachunguva leng khat neitun peh-un, nati uve. Hijeh chun tun nangho tah Pakai masanga aphung phungin, asang sangin hungkipe doh-un, ati.
target: But you have now rejected your God, who saves you out of all your disasters and calamities. And you have said, ‘No, appoint a king over us.’ So now present yourselves before the Lord by your tribes and clans.”

source: Chuin Samuel'in Israel phung jouse aheng ahin naisah phatnun, Benjamin phungchu alhengtai.
target: When Samuel had all Israel come forward by tribes, the tribe of Benjamin was taken by lot.

source: Benjamin phung chu a-inko kou-a aheng ahin nai phatnun, Matri insungchu lhen ahin, Kish chapa Saul chu lhendoh ahitai. Ahinla amachu aholule amujou pouve.
target: Then he brought forward the tribe of Benjamin, clan by clan, and Matri’s clan was taken. Finally Saul son of Kish was taken. But when they looked for him, he was not to be found.

source: Hijeh chun amahon mi ahung be ding umnalai em, tin Pakai chu avelin adong kitnun ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin adonbutnin, Veuvin, ama thilkeu lah-a akisele, ati.
target: So they inquired further of the Lord , “Has the man come here yet?” And the Lord said, “Yes, he has hidden himself among the supplies.”

source: Chuin amaho alhaijun chua konin agapuidoh taovin ahi: chuin ama mipi lah-a adin phatnin, alengkouva pat chunglamse chu mijouse sangin asangjon ahi.
target: They ran and brought him out, and as he stood among the people he was a head taller than any of the others.

source: Chuin Samuel'in mijouse jah-a chun, Pakaiyin alhenpa, mijouse lah-a amatobang aumlou khu namu uvem? ati. Chuin mijouse chun hatah in asamun, Pathen'in lengpa huhhing hen, atiuve.
target: Samuel said to all the people, “Do you see the man the Lord has chosen? There is no one like him among all the people.” Then the people shouted, “Long live the king!”

source: Chujouvin Samuel'in mipi chu lenggam thudol ahilin, lekhabu khatna asun lutnin, Pakai angsunga chun akoitai. Chuin Samuel'in mipi ho chu ama ama incheh-a asolmangtai.
target: Samuel explained to the people the rights and duties of kingship. He wrote them down on a scroll and deposited it before the Lord . Then Samuel dismissed the people to go to their own homes.

source: Chuin Saul jong Gibeah'a a-in'a achetan; chule Pathen'in alungu atohkhah mi honkhatnin alhonpiuvin ahi.
target: Saul also went to his home in Gibeah, accompanied by valiant men whose hearts God had touched.

source: Ahinla Belial chate chun, Hiche pan iti eihuhdoh diuham? atiuve. Chuin amahon ama nahsahmon abolun, thilpeh imacha ahinchoipeh pouve. Ahinla ama athipbeh-in ahi.
target: But some scoundrels said, “How can this fellow save us?” They despised him and brought him no gifts. But Saul kept silent.

source: Chujouvin Ammon mi Nahasah chu ahung konin, Jabesh-Gilead dounan gebuh asongin ahi. Chuin Jabesh mijouse chun Nahash jah-a, Keihotoh kitepna khat semin, chule keihon nangma kajen dingu ahi, atiuve.
target: Nahash the Ammonite went up and besieged Jabesh Gilead. And all the men of Jabesh said to him, “Make a treaty with us, and we will be subject to you.”

source: Chuin Ammon mi Nahash chun adonbutnin, Hitia hi nang hotoh kitepna kasem ding ahi, namit jetlam jouseu kakaldoh-a, Israel jouse-a dinga jum na hiding ahi, ati.
target: But Nahash the Ammonite replied, “I will make a treaty with you only on the condition that I gouge out the right eye of every one of you and so bring disgrace on all Israel.”

source: Chuin Jabesh upahon ajah-a, Israel gamkai jouse thangkou kasolthei nadiuvin, ni sagi neikhongai jun; chujouteng eihuhdoh dingu mi aumlouva ahile nahenga kahung kipehlut dingu ahi, atiuve.
target: The elders of Jabesh said to him, “Give us seven days so we can send messengers throughout Israel; if no one comes to rescue us, we will surrender to you.”

source: Hichun thupole ho chu Saul chenna Gibeah ahung lhungun, thuchu miho jah-a aseitaovin ahi. Chuin mijouse awgingin akaptaove.
target: When the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul and reported these terms to the people, they all wept aloud.

source: Chuin veuvin, Saul chu louva konin ganchahon nunga ahungin ahi; chuin Saul'in, Ipi hahsatna uma mipi ho khu kapma hiuvam? ati. Chuin amahon Gibeah miho thupoh chu aseipeh taove.
target: Just then Saul was returning from the fields, behind his oxen, and he asked, “What is wrong with everyone? Why are they weeping?” Then they repeated to him what the men of Jabesh had said.

source: Chuin Saul'in chuche thuho chu ajah phatnin Pathen lhagao achunga ahungchun, alunghana chu nasatah-in akoujah jengtan ahi.
target: When Saul heard their words, the Spirit of God came powerfully upon him, and he burned with anger.

source: Chuin bongchal ni alan, achenbong bongin, Israel gamkai jouse-a thupole ho khutna athotnin, Saul le Samuel nung hinjuilou chanchu hitabonga hi abongchal chunga kibolding ahi, ati. Chuin mipi chunga chun Pakai ginna achutan, amaho lungkhat tah-in ahung kondoh taove.
target: He took a pair of oxen, cut them into pieces, and sent the pieces by messengers throughout Israel, proclaiming, “This is what will be done to the oxen of anyone who does not follow Saul and Samuel.” Then the terror of the Lord fell on the people, and they came out together as one.

source: Chuin aman amahochu Bejek mun'a asimin ahile, Israel chate chu sangjathum ahin, Judah miho chu sangsomthum ahiuve.
target: When Saul mustered them at Bezek, the men of Israel numbered three hundred thousand and those of Judah thirty thousand.

source: Chuin amahon thupole mi ahungho henga, Jabesh Gilead miho henga chun, Jing nikho nisasat laitahle kithopina namu dingu ahi, tin gaseipeh-un atiuve. Chuin thupole ho chu ahungun, Jabesh miho chu aseipeh-un ahile, amaho akipah lheh-un ahi.
target: They told the messengers who had come, “Say to the men of Jabesh Gilead, ‘By the time the sun is hot tomorrow, you will be rescued.’ ” When the messengers went and reported this to the men of Jabesh, they were elated.

source: Hijeh chun Jabesh mihon, Jingle naheng uva kahungdoh dingu ahin, nanghon kilominte tia pha nasah bangun kachungu boltaovin, atiuve.
target: They said to the Ammonites, “Tomorrow we will surrender to you, and you can do to us whatever you like.”

source: Chuin ajingin ahitin ahi, Saul'in mipi chu loithumin ahom khenin; jingpi phalvah-in amaho janel lailung tah-a chun alutnun, Ammon miho chu nisa asatdoh kahsen athatnun ahi. Chuin ahitin ahi, mi ni kidalha khoma aumlou kahsen, amoh chengse chu akithe cheh-un ahi.
target: The next day Saul separated his men into three divisions; during the last watch of the night they broke into the camp of the Ammonites and slaughtered them until the heat of the day. Those who survived were scattered, so that no two of them were left together.

source: Chuin mipi chun Samuel henga, Saul chu ichunguva lengchang mongding ham tia seija chu koiham? keihon katha theina dinguvin, amaho chu hinpuijun atiuve.
target: The people then said to Samuel, “Who was it that asked, ‘Shall Saul reign over us?’ Turn these men over to us so that we may put them to death.”

source: Chuin Saul'in, Tunia hi mi khatcha kithat theilou ding ahi; ajehchu tunia hi Pakaiyin Israel sunga huhhingna na atoh ahi, ati.
target: But Saul said, “No one will be put to death today, for this day the Lord has rescued Israel.”

source: Chujouvin Samuel'in mipi ho jah-a, Hungun, Gilgal'a cheohitin, chule chua chun lengam gasemthah-u hite, ati.
target: Then Samuel said to the people, “Come, let us go to Gilgal and there renew the kingship.”

source: Chuin mipi ho jouse chu Gilgal'a acheuvin; chule Gilgal'a chun Pakai masanga Saul chu lengin asemtaove. Chule hiche mun'a chun Pakai angsunga chamna thilto ganlhaina apeuvin; chuachun Saul le Israel mite jouse nasatah-in akipah-un ahi.
target: So all the people went to Gilgal and made Saul king in the presence of the Lord . There they sacrificed fellowship offerings before the Lord , and Saul and all the Israelites held a great celebration.

source: Chuin Samuel'in Israelte jouse jah-a, Veovin kahenga nasei jouseu chu kangaijin, nachung uva lengkhat kasempeh taove.
target: Samuel said to all Israel, “I have listened to everything you said to me and have set a king over you.

source: Chule tun veuvin, lengpa chu namasanguva achei: chule keima tehse lukang kahitan; chule veuvin, kachapate nang hotoh aumui: chule keima kachapan laijapat tunigeija hi namasanguva chejing kahi.
target: Now you have a king as your leader. As for me, I am old and gray, and my sons are here with you. I have been your leader from my youth until this day.

source: Veuvin, keima hikoma kaume; Pakai le athao nupa anga kachung chang thu hettoh sah-un: koi bongchal kalahpeh umkham? koi sangan kalahpeh umkham? koi kajoulhep umkham? koi kasuhgenthei umkham? ahiloule koi khutna kona kamit chotna dinga nehguh kalah umkham? Keiman hichu nangho kalepeh dingu ahi, ati.
target: Here I stand. Testify against me in the presence of the Lord and his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken? Whom have I cheated? Whom have I oppressed? From whose hand have I accepted a bribe to make me shut my eyes? If I have done any of these things, I will make it right.”

source: Chuin amahon, Nangman neijoulhep khapouve, nei sugenthei kha pouvin, chule koima khutna konin jong nala khapoi, atiuve.
target: “You have not cheated or oppressed us,” they replied. “You have not taken anything from anyone’s hand.”

source: Chuin aman ajah uvah, Kakhutnahin adihlou ima namupouve tihi Pakai chu nachung uva ahetoh ahin, athao nupa hi tunia ahetoh ahi, ati. Chuin amahon, Amachu ahetoh ahi, atiuve.
target: Samuel said to them, “The Lord is witness against you, and also his anointed is witness this day, that you have not found anything in my hand.” “He is witness,” they said.

source: Chuin Samuel'in mipi jah-a, Mosi le Aaron ana gonga, chule Egypt gama kona napu napateu hinpuidoh-a chu Pakai ahi.
target: Then Samuel said to the people, “It is the Lord who appointed Moses and Aaron and brought your ancestors up out of Egypt.

source: Hijeh chun tun nanghole napu napateu chunga anabol Pakai chonphatna natoh jouse chu, Pakai masanga nangho toh kagelkhom theina dingin dingdet nun.
target: Now then, stand here, because I am going to confront you with evidence before the Lord as to all the righteous acts performed by the Lord for you and your ancestors.

source: Egypt'a Jacob alut nungin, napu napateu chun Pakai akouvun, chuin Pakaiyin Mosi le Aaron asolin, amanin napu napateu chu Egypt'a kona apuidoh lhona, hiche munahi achensah lhon ahi.
target: “After Jacob entered Egypt, they cried to the Lord for help, and the Lord sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your ancestors out of Egypt and settled them in this place.

source: Chuin amahon Pakai a-Pathen'u chu asuhmil phatnun, aman Sisera Hazor janel gallamkai khut le Philistine te khutna, chule Moab lengpa khutna ajoh doh-in, chuin amahon amaho asatnun ahi.
target: “But they forgot the Lord their God; so he sold them into the hand of Sisera, the commander of the army of Hazor, and into the hands of the Philistines and the king of Moab, who fought against them.

source: Chuin amaho Pakai henga akapmun, ahenga, Keihon Pakai kadalhah uva Baal lim le Ashtaroth kajen jeh-un kachonse taove: ahinla tun kamelma teo khutna konin neihuhdoh uvin, chutile nangma kajen diu ahitai, atiuve.
target: They cried out to the Lord and said, ‘We have sinned; we have forsaken the Lord and served the Baals and the Ashtoreths. But now deliver us from the hands of our enemies, and we will serve you.’

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Jerubbaal, Bedan, Jephthah chule Samuel asolin, ningtina namelmate hou khutna konin nahuhdoh-un, lung mongin nacheng taove.
target: Then the Lord sent Jerub-Baal, Barak, Jephthah and Samuel, and he delivered you from the hands of your enemies all around you, so that you lived in safety.

source: Chuin nanghon Ammon chate lengpa Nahash nangho douna-a ahung namu phatnun, Pakai na Pathen'u chu nalengpao ahilaijin, nanghon kahenga, Ahipoi; leng khatnin kachunguva vai ahomding ahibouve, nati uve.
target: “But when you saw that Nahash king of the Ammonites was moving against you, you said to me, ‘No, we want a king to rule over us’—even though the Lord your God was your king.

source: Hijeh chun tun veuvin, nanghon nalhen ule nangaichatnu lengpa chu hikoma aume; chule veuvin, Pakaiyin nachung uvah leng khat atungtai.
target: Now here is the king you have chosen, the one you asked for; see, the Lord has set a king over you.

source: Nanghon Pakai nagin uva, ama najen uva, a-aw nangai uva, chule Pakai thupeh chu nadou daova ahile, nangho le nachung uva vaipo lengpan jong Pakai Pathen chu najuijom jing dingu ahi.
target: If you fear the Lord and serve and obey him and do not rebel against his commands, and if both you and the king who reigns over you follow the Lord your God—good!

source: Ahinla Pakai awchu nangailou uva, Pakai thupeh chu nadou uva ahile, Pakai khutchu napu napateu chunga anachuh banga, nangho chunga hungchu ding ahi.
target: But if you do not obey the Lord , and if you rebel against his commands, his hand will be against you, as it was against your ancestors.

source: Hijeh chun tun, dingun lang hiche thil loupitah Pakaiyin namitmuva namasanguva abol dinghi veuvin.
target: “Now then, stand still and see this great thing the Lord is about to do before your eyes!

source: Tunihi suhlou chang atni hilouham? leng nakithum jeh uva Pakai mitmu-a nathilbolu nagitlou nao chu lentah ahi ti nahetdoh uva chule namutheina diuva keiman Pakai kakou ding; aman van ginle go ahinsolding ahi, ati.
target: Is it not wheat harvest now? I will call on the Lord to send thunder and rain. And you will realize what an evil thing you did in the eyes of the Lord when you asked for a king.”

source: Chutichun Samuel'in Pakai akouvin ahi; chuin hiche nikho chun Pakaiyin van ginle go ahinsolin: chuin mijousen Pakai le Samuel chu nasatah-in aging taovin ahi.
target: Then Samuel called on the Lord , and that same day the Lord sent thunder and rain. So all the people stood in awe of the Lord and of Samuel.

source: Chuin mipi jouse chun Samuel henga, Kathi louna diuvin Pakai na Pathen henga nasohtedin neitao peh-un; ajehchu kachonsetnau jouse belapma hiche lenghi kaki thumu ahi, atiuve.
target: The people all said to Samuel, “Pray to the Lord your God for your servants so that we will not die, for we have added to all our other sins the evil of asking for a king.”

source: Chuin Samuel'in mipi ho henga, Kicha hih-un: nanghon hiche gitlouna jousehi nabolu ahitai: hitajongle Pakai juina-a konin kiheimang daovinlang, nalung pumpiuvin Pakai chu jenuvin;
target: “Do not be afraid,” Samuel replied. “You have done all this evil; yet do not turn away from the Lord , but serve the Lord with all your heart.

source: Chule kiheimang hih-un; phatchomnabei le huhhing theilou pannabei thilho najui louheldiu ahi; ajehchu hihochu ahomkeo ahiuve.
target: Do not turn away after useless idols. They can do you no good, nor can they rescue you, because they are useless.

source: Chutile Pakaiyin amin loupina jala amite adalhah louding ahi: ajehchu nangho amite-a semdinghi Pakai kipana ahi.
target: For the sake of his great name the Lord will not reject his people, because the Lord was pleased to make you his own.

source: Chukalvalin keiman vang, nangho dinga kataona man kangah-a Pakai chunga kachonset dingchu Pathen'in jahda hen; amavang keiman apha le lamdih chu kahil dingu ahi.
target: As for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the Lord by failing to pray for you. And I will teach you the way that is good and right.

source: Pakai bou gingun lang, nalung pumpiuvin thutah-in ama jenun: itobang thil loupitah nanabolpeh-u hitam ngaitouvin.
target: But be sure to fear the Lord and serve him faithfully with all your heart; consider what great things he has done for you.

source: Ahinla nangho gilou tah-a nachon jingule, nangho le nalengpau nagom uva namanthah dingu ahi, ati.
target: Yet if you persist in doing evil, both you and your king will perish.”

source: Saul kumkhat aleng changin; chuin Israelte chunga kumni alengchan phatnin;
target: Saul was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned over Israel forty- two years.

source: Saul'in ama dingin Israelte lah-a konin pasal sangthum alhengdoh-in; sangni chu Saul'in Michmash le Bethel molsanga aumpin; sangkhat chu Jonathan toh Benjamin gam Gibeah'a aumun: chule mipi amohho chu apon in cheh uvah asoltan ahi.
target: Saul chose three thousand men from Israel; two thousand were with him at Mikmash and in the hill country of Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan at Gibeah in Benjamin. The rest of the men he sent back to their homes.

source: Chuin Jonathan'in Gebah'a Philistine sepai touho chu asatnin, hichu Philistine ten ajataove. Chuin Saul'in, Hebrew miten anajaohen atin, gamsung jouse-a chun sumkon amutnin ahi.
target: Jonathan attacked the Philistine outpost at Geba, and the Philistines heard about it. Then Saul had the trumpet blown throughout the land and said, “Let the Hebrews hear!”

source: Chuin Israelte jousen Saul'in Philistine sepai honkhat abulu-in, chule Israelte chu Philistine te hot ahung hitaove ti ajataovin ahi. Chuin mipi ho chu Saul lengpa henga Gilgal'a akikhom taove.
target: So all Israel heard the news: “Saul has attacked the Philistine outpost, and now Israel has become obnoxious to the Philistines.” And the people were summoned to join Saul at Gilgal.

source: Chuin Philistine te chu Israelte toh kisatdin akikhom khomun, sakol kangtalai sangsomthum, sakol sepai sanggup, chule mipi chu twikhanglen kama neldi jat helin atamun ahi. Chuin amaho ahung kondoh-un, Beth-aven'a pat solama um Michmash'a pannun asemun ahi.
target: The Philistines assembled to fight Israel, with three thousand chariots, six thousand charioteers, and soldiers as numerous as the sand on the seashore. They went up and camped at Mikmash, east of Beth Aven.

source: Chutia Israel miten nochinto-a aumu amuphatnun, (ajehchu mipi chu lungdong lheh jenguva ahi,) mipi chu songko sung, hambohlah, songpiho-a, munsang ho-a, chule kotong dunga akisel gamtaove.
target: When the Israelites saw that their situation was critical and that their army was hard pressed, they hid in caves and thickets, among the rocks, and in pits and cisterns.

source: Chule Hebrew mi phabep Jordan agalkai jun, Gad le Gilead gama acheuvin ahi. Saul vangchu Gilgal'a aum nalaijin, mipihon kihotpum pummin anung ajuijun ahi.
target: Some Hebrews even crossed the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. Saul remained at Gilgal, and all the troops with him were quaking with fear.

source: Chuin Samuel'in phat ateppeh dungjuijin, nisagi aumin: ahin Samuel chu Gilgal'a ahunglou phatnin; mipi ho chu ama-a konin akithecheh taovin ahi.
target: He waited seven days, the time set by Samuel; but Samuel did not come to Gilgal, and Saul’s men began to scatter.

source: Chuin Saul'in, Hikoma hin kahenga govam thilto le chamna thilto hinchoijun, ati. Chuin aman govam thilto aboltai.
target: So he said, “Bring me the burnt offering and the fellowship offerings.” And Saul offered up the burnt offering.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, aman govam thilto atojou jouvin, veuvin, Samuel ahung lhung paijin; chule Saul chu amatoh kimuto-a chibai bohdin apotdoh-in ahi.
target: Just as he finished making the offering, Samuel arrived, and Saul went out to greet him.

source: Chuin Samuel'in, Ipi bola nahim? ati. Chuin Saul'in, Mipi ho keija kona akithe cheh uva, nangla nikho kitep sunga nahung da-a, chule Philistine te Michmash'a akichop khomu kamuphatna;
target: “What have you done?” asked Samuel. Saul replied, “When I saw that the men were scattering, and that you did not come at the set time, and that the Philistines were assembling at Mikmash,

source: Hichejeh-a keiman, Tu-a hi Philistine te keima doudinga Gilgal'a hungdiu ahitan, keimanla Pakai henga ngehna kanei louding ahi katin: hijeh-a chu keile kei kachamlouva kakibola, govam thilto kanato ahi, ati.
target: I thought, ‘Now the Philistines will come down against me at Gilgal, and I have not sought the Lord ’s favor.’ So I felt compelled to offer the burnt offering.”

source: Chuin Samuel'in Saul henga, Nangin ngol hoitah thil nabol ahitai: nangman thupeh nape-a Pakai na Pathen'in nathupeh chu nanit tapoi: ajehchu tuahi Pakaiyin nalenggam chu Israel chunga a-itih-a dinga phudet ding agot ahin;
target: “You have done a foolish thing,” Samuel said. “You have not kept the command the Lord your God gave you; if you had, he would have established your kingdom over Israel for all time.

source: Amavang tun nalenggam hi chejom louding ahitai: ajehchu nangman Pakaiyin nathupeh chu nanit lou jeh-a, Pakaiyin ama lungput tobang pumi akihol ahitai, chule Pakaiyin ama chu amite chunga lamkai dinga athupeh ahitai, ati.
target: But now your kingdom will not endure; the Lord has sought out a man after his own heart and appointed him ruler of his people, because you have not kept the Lord ’s command.”

source: Chuin Samuel akipat doh-in Gilgal'a konin Benjamin gam Gibeah'a achetoutai. Chuin Saul'in amatoh umkhom miho chu pasal jagup tobang asimdohtai.
target: Then Samuel left Gilgal and went up to Gibeah in Benjamin, and Saul counted the men who were with him. They numbered about six hundred.

source: Chuin Saul le achapate Jonathan, chule amanito umkhom miho chu Benjamin gam Gibeah'a chun aumtaove; ahinla Philistine mihon Michmash'a panmun asemun ahi.
target: Saul and his son Jonathan and the men with them were staying in Gibeah in Benjamin, while the Philistines camped at Mikmash.

source: Chuin Philistine te pan mun'a konchun michom dingho chu loithumin ahung potdoh-un: loikhat chun Shual gam Ophrah jotna lampi chu ajotnun;
target: Raiding parties went out from the Philistine camp in three detachments. One turned toward Ophrah in the vicinity of Shual,

source: Chule loikhat chun Beth-horon jotna lampi ajotnun; chule loikhat chun gamthip Zeboiim phaicham ngatna gamgi chin jotna lampi ajotnun ahi.
target: another toward Beth Horon, and the third toward the borderland overlooking the Valley of Zeboyim facing the wilderness.

source: Tun Israel gampumpia chun thihkheng khatcha anaumpon ahi: ajehchu Philistine ten, Achuti loule Hebrew miten chemjam le tengcha kikhen getnunte, atiu ahi.
target: Not a blacksmith could be found in the whole land of Israel, because the Philistines had said, “Otherwise the Hebrews will make swords or spears!”

source: Chule Israelte jouse chu amitakip alangkon thih-u, alou kalnao, aheichao, chule atuphenghou khenghem dinga Philistinte henga chesuhji ahiuve.
target: So all Israel went down to the Philistines to have their plow points, mattocks, axes and sickles sharpened.

source: Achutijeng vangin amahon tupheng, langkon thih, thihka, heicha, chule gancha hoina thihmol suhhemna aneijun ahi.
target: The price was two-thirds of a shekel for sharpening plow points and mattocks, and a third of a shekel for sharpening forks and axes and for repointing goads.

source: Chutichun chuche ni-a kidouna-a chun ahitin ahi, Saul le Jonathan toh kiloi miho khutna chun chemjam le tengcha khatcha muding aumpon ahi. Ahinla Saul le achapa Jonathan'in vang aneijin ahi.
target: So on the day of the battle not a soldier with Saul and Jonathan had a sword or spear in his hand; only Saul and his son Jonathan had them.

source: Chuin Philistine sepaihon ho chu Michmash lampi lama achedoh-un ahi.
target: Now a detachment of Philistines had gone out to the pass at Mikmash.

source: Tun nikhat chu ahitin ahi, Saul chapa Jonathan'in agalvon po-a pang gollhangpa jah-a, Hungin, Philistine sepaihon ho umna apang langkhatna khun gache galkai hite, ati. Ahinla apa henga anahet sahpon ahi.
target: One day Jonathan son of Saul said to his young armor-bearer, “Come, let’s go over to the Philistine outpost on the other side.” But he did not tell his father.

source: Chule Saul chu Gibeah khopam ningkoi Migron'a um kolbuthei phung noikhatna atouvin ahi. Chule ama umpi mihochu pasal jagup tobang ahiuve.
target: Saul was staying on the outskirts of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree in Migron. With him were about six hundred men,

source: Chuin Shiloh'a chun Pakai thempu Eli chapa, Phinehas chapa, Ichabod sopipa Ahitub chapa Ahiah chu boitong sangkhol akivonin ahi. Chule mipi chun Jonathan chelam chu ahepouve.
target: among whom was Ahijah, who was wearing an ephod. He was a son of Ichabod’s brother Ahitub son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the Lord ’s priest in Shiloh. No one was aware that Jonathan had left.

source: Chuin Jonathan'in Philistine te sepaihon ho galkai agotna lampi kikah jetle veija chun songpihem ni aumin, khatpa minchu Bozez ahin, khatjopa min chu Seneh ahi.
target: On each side of the pass that Jonathan intended to cross to reach the Philistine outpost was a cliff; one was called Bozez and the other Seneh.

source: Tomasah pachun Michmash sahlam angan, khatjopa chun Gibeah jotna lhanglam angan ahi.
target: One cliff stood to the north toward Mikmash, the other to the south toward Geba.

source: Chuin Jonathan'in agalvon po-a pang golhangpa henga, Hungin, hiche cheptanlou sepaihon ho heng lama khun galkai hite: Pakaiyin eini dinga na eitoh pehlhon thei ahi. Ajehchu Pakaiya dingin huhdohna natohna-a hin tam le lhomin ima apopon ahi, ati.
target: Jonathan said to his young armor-bearer, “Come, let’s go over to the outpost of those uncircumcised men. Perhaps the Lord will act in our behalf. Nothing can hinder the Lord from saving, whether by many or by few.”

source: Chuin agalvon popan ajah-a, Nalungsunga umjouse chu bolin: kiheijin; ven, nalungdei banga umdingin keima nakoma kaume, ati.
target: “Do all that you have in mind,” his armor-bearer said. “Go ahead; I am with you heart and soul.”

source: Chuphatnin Jonathan'in, Ven miho henga khun galkai hitin, amaho gakimusah hite.
target: Jonathan said, “Come on, then; we will cross over toward them and let them see us.

source: Amahon eini henga, Naheng lhona kahung kahseovin umtadi lhonin atiuva ahile, i-umna mun lhona idinden lhonding, ahenguva ichetou louding ahi.
target: If they say to us, ‘Wait there until we come to you,’ we will stay where we are and not go up to them.

source: Ahinla amahon, Kahenguva hungtou lhonin, atiuva ahile ichetou ding ahi: ajehchu Pakaiyin ikhutna amahochu eipehdoh lhon ahitan: hiche hi amelchihna hiding ahi, ati.
target: But if they say, ‘Come up to us,’ we will climb up, because that will be our sign that the Lord has given them into our hands.”

source: Chuin anilhonin Philistine sepaihon ho aga kimusah lhontan ahi. Chuin Philistine ten, Veuvin, Hebrew ho khu akiselnao kohoma konin ahungdoh uve, atiuve.
target: So both of them showed themselves to the Philistine outpost. “Look!” said the Philistines. “The Hebrews are crawling out of the holes they were hiding in.”

source: Chuin sepaiho chun Jonathan le agalvon popa chu ahin donbutnun, Kahenguva hungtou lhonin, thilkhat vetsah-unge atiuve. Chuin Jonathan'in agalvon popa jah-a, Neihin juitouvin: ajehchu Pakaiyin amahokhu Israelte khutna apehdoh ahitai, ati.
target: The men of the outpost shouted to Jonathan and his armor-bearer, “Come up to us and we’ll teach you a lesson.” So Jonathan said to his armor-bearer, “Climb up after me; the Lord has given them into the hand of Israel.”

source: Chuin Jonathan'in akhutle akeng tho-a akaltouva ahile, agalvon popan anung ajuitan ahi. Chuin amaho Jonathan masanga chu alhu taovin; anunga agalvon popa chun ahin that peh-in ahi.
target: Jonathan climbed up, using his hands and feet, with his armor-bearer right behind him. The Philistines fell before Jonathan, and his armor-bearer followed and killed behind him.

source: Chuin Jonathan le agalvon popa mitha masatpen hochu mi somni bang ahin, gamneocha bongchal tokhat khoijou theibep acre keh sungbou ahi.
target: In that first attack Jonathan and his armor-bearer killed some twenty men in an area of about half an acre.

source: Chuin loujauva mipi janel lah leh mipi ho jouselah'a chun tijatna nasatah aumtan; sepaihon ho le thilchomho jong akihotnun: chule ling akihotnin, chutichun tijatna nasatah aumtan ahi.
target: Then panic struck the whole army—those in the camp and field, and those in the outposts and raiding parties—and the ground shook. It was a panic sent by God.

source: Chuin Benjamin gama Gibeah'a Saul'in khongah akoiho chun aveovin; chuin veuvin, mihopi chu achat melmulun, khat le khat akiphuto saosaovun ahi.
target: Saul’s lookouts at Gibeah in Benjamin saw the army melting away in all directions.

source: Chuin Saul'in aumpi mipi ho jah-a, Tun kisim unlang ilah uva koi potdoh am veuvin, ati. Chuin amahon asimphatnun, veuvin Jonathan le agalvon popa anaum tapoi.
target: Then Saul said to the men who were with him, “Muster the forces and see who has left us.” When they did, it was Jonathan and his armor-bearer who were not there.

source: Chuin Saul'in Ahiah jah-a, Pathen thingkhong chu hilama hinpon, ati. Ajehchu hichepetna chu Pathen thingkhong chu Israelte toh uma ahi.
target: Saul said to Ahijah, “Bring the ark of God.” (At that time it was with the Israelites.)

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Saul'in thempu henga thu aseipet chun, Philistine te janel husa chu ahagincheh cheh jengtan: chuin Saul'in thempupa jah-a, Nakhut ladohtan, ati.
target: While Saul was talking to the priest, the tumult in the Philistine camp increased more and more. So Saul said to the priest, “Withdraw your hand.”

source: Chuin Saul le akoma um mijouse chu akikhom khomun, galmuna chun ahungtaove. Chule veuvin, mitin chemjam chu aloipa chunga achun, chule boina nasatah aumin ahi.
target: Then Saul and all his men assembled and went to the battle. They found the Philistines in total confusion, striking each other with their swords.

source: Chukalvalin chuche masanga Hebrew miho Philistine te toh ana umkhomho, chuche gamkimvela kona agebuh uva amahotoh anachetouho chu, amaho jongchu Israelte toh apangkhomun, Saul le Jonathan to apangkhom taovin ahi.
target: Those Hebrews who had previously been with the Philistines and had gone up with them to their camp went over to the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

source: Chubangma chun Ephraim molsanga anakisel Israel mite jouse chun, Philistine te ajam taove tithu ajah phatnun, amaho jong chun galsat na-a amaho chu hatah in anungdelun ahi.
target: When all the Israelites who had hidden in the hill country of Ephraim heard that the Philistines were on the run, they joined the battle in hot pursuit.

source: Chutichun Pakaiyin chuche nikho chun Israel ahuhdoh-in, chule gal kisat chu Beth-aven geijin agalkaijun ahi.
target: So on that day the Lord saved Israel, and the battle moved on beyond Beth Aven.

source: Chule hiche nikho chun Israelte chu alung genthei lheh-un ahi: ajehchu Saul'in, Kamelmate phu kalahthei nadin, nilhah ahi kahse-a an ne-a chu sapset changhen, tia mipi chu ahahsel ahi. Chutichun koimachan an kiti atep pouvin ahi.
target: Now the Israelites were in distress that day, because Saul had bound the people under an oath, saying, “Cursed be anyone who eats food before evening comes, before I have avenged myself on my enemies!” So none of the troops tasted food.

source: Chuin gamsung mi jouse chu gamlah ahunglhung taovin; chule leichunga chun khoiju anaumin ahi.
target: The entire army entered the woods, and there was honey on the ground.

source: Chuin mipi ho jouse chu gamlah ahunglut phatnun, veuvin, khoiju anakaijin; ahin koiman akhutna alan anepon ahi: ajehchu mipi chun hahselna chu akichatnu ahi.
target: When they went into the woods, they saw the honey oozing out; yet no one put his hand to his mouth, because they feared the oath.

source: Ahinla Jonathan'in apan mipi hahselna-a ahahsel chu anajapon; hijeh chun akhutna achoi molmuh-a chun khoiju lah chu asunlutnin, chuin akhutnin alan akama ahengtan ahile, amitchu hoitah-in ahung hahdoh theitan ahi.
target: But Jonathan had not heard that his father had bound the people with the oath, so he reached out the end of the staff that was in his hand and dipped it into the honeycomb. He raised his hand to his mouth, and his eyes brightened.

source: Chuphatnin mipi lah-a khatnin adonbutnin, Napan mipi nasatah-a hahselna-a ahahsela, Tunia an ne-a michu sapset changhen ati ahi, ati. Chutichun mipi alhasam tan ahi.
target: Then one of the soldiers told him, “Your father bound the army under a strict oath, saying, ‘Cursed be anyone who eats food today!’ That is why the men are faint.”

source: Chuphatnin Jonathan'in, Kapan gamsunghi agentheisah ahi: Katao ahi, vetemin, hiche khoiju themkhat katep jeh-a kamithi iti hungha doh-a hitam.
target: Jonathan said, “My father has made trouble for the country. See how my eyes brightened when I tasted a little of this honey.

source: Mipi jonghin amelmateu thil achom naova amuhouhi aning anopmin nomtah-in neleu phacheh louding ham? hijeh-a chu tugeija Philistine te tamtah itha theilouvu hilouham? ati.
target: How much better it would have been if the men had eaten today some of the plunder they took from their enemies. Would not the slaughter of the Philistines have been even greater?”

source: Chule hicheni chun Michmash'a pat Aijalon geijin Philistine te chu athat peh-un; chule mipi chu alhasamlheh taovin ahi.
target: That day, after the Israelites had struck down the Philistines from Mikmash to Aijalon, they were exhausted.

source: Chuin mipi chu thil kichom chunga achuvin, kelngoiho, bongchalho, bongnouho chu tollhanga athatnun: athisan pumchun anetaovin ahi.
target: They pounced on the plunder and, taking sheep, cattle and calves, they butchered them on the ground and ate them, together with the blood.

source: Chuphatnin amahon Saul jah-a, Vetan, mipin thisan aneh uva konin Pakai dounan achonse taove, atiuve. Chuin aman, Nanghon nasukhelun; tuni hin songtum lentah neitahkhum taove, ati.
target: Then someone said to Saul, “Look, the men are sinning against the Lord by eating meat that has blood in it.” “You have broken faith,” he said. “Roll a large stone over here at once.”

source: Chuin Saul'in, Mipi lah-a kithecheh unlang, ajah uvah, Amitakipmin nabongchalu, nakelngoiju hinkaijun, chule hikoma hin thatnuvin lang neuvin; thisan puma ne-in Pakai dounan chonse hih-un, ati. Chuin chuche jan chun mipi jouse amitakipmin abongchalu chu ahinkaijun, hikoma chun athat taove.
target: Then he said, “Go out among the men and tell them, ‘Each of you bring me your cattle and sheep, and slaughter them here and eat them. Do not sin against the Lord by eating meat with blood still in it.’ ” So everyone brought his ox that night and slaughtered it there.

source: Chuin Saul'in Pakai dingin maicham khat asemin; hiche chu Pakai dinga maicham asem masat pentah ahi.
target: Then Saul built an altar to the Lord ; it was the first time he had done this.

source: Chuin Saul'in, Eihon janlaijin Philistine te nung delsuh-u hitin, jingkhovah kahsen chommu hitin, chule amaho khatcha hinghoi pouhite, ati. Chuin amahon, Nangman phante nati tichu bolin, atiuve. Chuphatnin thempupan, Hilamhin Pathen naitadiu hite, ati.
target: Saul said, “Let us go down and pursue the Philistines by night and plunder them till dawn, and let us not leave one of them alive.” “Do whatever seems best to you,” they replied. But the priest said, “Let us inquire of God here.”

source: Chuin Saul'in Pathen adongin; Philistine te satna kakonsuh dingham? Nangman amaho chu Israelte khutna napehdoh dingham? ati. Ahinla hiche nikho chun adonbut tapoi.
target: So Saul asked God, “Shall I go down and pursue the Philistines? Will you give them into Israel’s hand?” But God did not answer him that day.

source: Chuin Saul'in, Mipi ho pipui jousen hilam hinai cheh-un: chule tunia hiche chonset hi hoilaija umham heuvin lang vetemun.
target: Saul therefore said, “Come here, all you who are leaders of the army, and let us find out what sin has been committed today.

source: Ajehchu Israel huhhing-a hingjing Pakai mina kasei ahi, kachapa Jonathan chunga uma hijongle, ama thonlouva thiding ahi, ati. Ahinla mipi ho jouse lah-a konin khatchan adonbut pon ahi.
target: As surely as the Lord who rescues Israel lives, even if the guilt lies with my son Jonathan, he must die.” But not one of them said a word.

source: Chuphatnin aman Israelte jouse jah-a, Nangho langkhatna umunlang, keile kachapa Jonathan langkhatna kaum lhonding ahi, ati. Chuin mipin Saul jah-a, Nangman phante nati tichu boltan atiuve.
target: Saul then said to all the Israelites, “You stand over there; I and Jonathan my son will stand over here.” “Do what seems best to you,” they replied.

source: Hijeh chun Saul'in Israelte Pakai Pathen henga, Vang kisan dihtah hintah langin, ati. Chuin Saul le Jonathan chunga achutan, mipi vang ahoidohtai.
target: Then Saul prayed to the Lord , the God of Israel, “Why have you not answered your servant today? If the fault is in me or my son Jonathan, respond with Urim, but if the men of Israel are at fault, respond with Thummim.” Jonathan and Saul were taken by lot, and the men were cleared.

source: Chuin Saul'in, Keile kachapa Jonathan kah-a vang san uvin, ati. Chuin Jonathan chunga achutai.
target: Saul said, “Cast the lot between me and Jonathan my son.” And Jonathan was taken.

source: Chuphatnin Saul'in Jonathan jah-a, Ipi nabolham neihilin, ati. Chuin Jonathan'in, Kakhutna um mol leh-a khoiju themcha khat katep ahi, chule ven, kathi teiding ahi, tin ahiltan ahi.
target: Then Saul said to Jonathan, “Tell me what you have done.” So Jonathan told him, “I tasted a little honey with the end of my staff. And now I must die!”

source: Chuin Saul'in, Pathen'in hitichun chule akalvalin jong boljenghen, ajehchu Jonathan, nangma nathi teiding ahi, ati.
target: Saul said, “May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if you do not die, Jonathan.”

source: Chuin mipi ho chun Saul jah-a, Israelte lah-a huhhingna loupitah bolla Jonathan hi thiding ham? Pathen'in jahda hen: Pakai hingjing mina kaseiju ahi, aluchunga kon samjang khatjon tolla lhalouding ahi; ajehchu tunin aman Pathen toh atongkhomin ahi, atiuve. Chutichun mipin Jonathan chu athilou nadin ahuhdoh taove.
target: But the men said to Saul, “Should Jonathan die—he who has brought about this great deliverance in Israel? Never! As surely as the Lord lives, not a hair of his head will fall to the ground, for he did this today with God’s help.” So the men rescued Jonathan, and he was not put to death.

source: Chujouvin Saul chu Philistine te nung adelna-a konin ache toutan; chule Philistine te jong aumnaova achetauve.
target: Then Saul stopped pursuing the Philistines, and they withdrew to their own land.

source: Chuti chun Saul'in Israelte chunga lengvai apon, ningtina amelmate jouse, Moab, Ammon chate, Edom, Zobah lengho, chule Philistine mite to akidouvin: chule akiheina lam tina gal ajoupeh-in ahi.
target: After Saul had assumed rule over Israel, he fought against their enemies on every side: Moab, the Ammonites, Edom, the kings of Zobah, and the Philistines. Wherever he turned, he inflicted punishment on them.

source: Chuin aman mipi janel akhomin, Amalek mite asatnin, chule amaho chom gama miho khutna konin Israelte ahuhdoh-in ahi.
target: He fought valiantly and defeated the Amalekites, delivering Israel from the hands of those who had plundered them.

source: Tun Saul chapate chu Jonathan, Ishui, chule Melchishua ahiuvin, chule achanu teni minchu hiche ahi; apeng masa nu min Merab ahin, chule aneojonu min Michal ahi.
target: Saul’s sons were Jonathan, Ishvi and Malki-Shua. The name of his older daughter was Merab, and that of the younger was Michal.

source: Chule Saul inneipi min Ahinoam ahin, Ahimaaz chanu ahi. Chule ajanel gal lamkaipa minchu Abner ahin, Saul pangahpa Ner chapa ahi.
target: His wife’s name was Ahinoam daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the commander of Saul’s army was Abner son of Ner, and Ner was Saul’s uncle.

source: Chule Kish chu Saul pa ahin, chule Abner pa Ner chu Abiel chapa ahi.
target: Saul’s father Kish and Abner’s father Ner were sons of Abiel.

source: Chule Saul nikholai sungse chun Philistine mite toh kidouna chu anasalheh jengin ahi: chutichun Saul'in mihat le mihangsan amu poupouva ahile, amanin ama-a dingin akipui jengjin ahi.
target: All the days of Saul there was bitter war with the Philistines, and whenever Saul saw a mighty or brave man, he took him into his service.

source: Samuel'in jong Saul jah-a, Pakaiyin ami Israelte chunga leng dinga nangma thao nudingin einasol ahin, hijeh chun tun Pakai thusei hi ngaijin.
target: Samuel said to Saul, “I am the one the Lord sent to anoint you king over his people Israel; so listen now to the message from the Lord .

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Amalek'in Israel chunga ana thilbol, Egypt'a kona ahungtouva chu lampia iti ana lamtin ham ti kahe jingin ahi.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘I will punish the Amalekites for what they did to Israel when they waylaid them as they came up from Egypt.

source: Tun chenlang Amalek gasatnin, chule aneijouseu sumanghelin lang, amaho khatcha khenhih-in; pasal le numei agomin, naosen le noicheplai, bong le kelngoi, sangongsang le sanganho abonin thatgamin, ati.
target: Now go, attack the Amalekites and totally destroy all that belongs to them. Do not spare them; put to death men and women, children and infants, cattle and sheep, camels and donkeys.’ ”

source: Chuin Saul'in mipi ho chu akhom khomin, Telaim mun'a chun keng sepaiho sangjani leh, Judah mi sangsom asimdoh-in ahi.
target: So Saul summoned the men and mustered them at Telaim—two hundred thousand foot soldiers and ten thousand from Judah.

source: Chuin Saul Amalek khopi khatna ahungin, phaichama chun achangpang tan ahi.
target: Saul went to the city of Amalek and set an ambush in the ravine.

source: Chuin Saul'in Ken miho jah-a, Cheovin, kipatdoh-un, Amelek mite-a kon chun chesuh-un, achuti loule keiman amahotoh kasuh mangtha dingu ahi: ajehchu Egypt'a kona Israelte ahungtouvu chun hepina nana musah-un ahi, ati. Hijeh chun Ken miho chu Amalek miho-a konin apotdoh taove.
target: Then he said to the Kenites, “Go away, leave the Amalekites so that I do not destroy you along with them; for you showed kindness to all the Israelites when they came up out of Egypt.” So the Kenites moved away from the Amalekites.

source: Chuin Saul'in Amalek mite chu Havilah'a pat Egypt toh kigalsai Shur lutna geijin anasuhmang pehtan ahi.
target: Then Saul attacked the Amalekites all the way from Havilah to Shur, near the eastern border of Egypt.

source: Chuin aman Amalek mite lengpa Agag chu ahingin amanin, mijouse chu chemjam monghemin asumang sohkeijin ahi.
target: He took Agag king of the Amalekites alive, and all his people he totally destroyed with the sword.

source: Ahin Saul le mipi chun Agag le kelngoi hoipenho, bongchal thao ho, kelngoithao ho le anouhose chu ahing hoijun, ahin aphalou le dei umlou sechu asumang heltan ahi.
target: But Saul and the army spared Agag and the best of the sheep and cattle, the fat calves and lambs—everything that was good. These they were unwilling to destroy completely, but everything that was despised and weak they totally destroyed.

source: Hichun Samuel henga Pakai thu ahung lhungin, hitin ati,
target: Then the word of the Lord came to Samuel:

source: Saul lenga kanatundoh hi kakisih tai: ajehchu ama eijui na-a konin akileheijin, kathupeh ho atongdoh tapoi, ati. Hichun Samuel alungkham sahtan; jankhovah helin Pakai henga ataotai.
target: “I regret that I have made Saul king, because he has turned away from me and has not carried out my instructions.” Samuel was angry, and he cried out to the Lord all that night.

source: Chuin Saul kimupi dinga Samuel jingpitah-a athochun, Samuel henga, Saul chu Carmel lhanga ahungin, chule vetan, minkhat akisemin, chule ache lelen, achedoh-in, Gilgal'a achesuhtai, tin aseipeh-uvin ahi.
target: Early in the morning Samuel got up and went to meet Saul, but he was told, “Saul has gone to Carmel. There he has set up a monument in his own honor and has turned and gone on down to Gilgal.”

source: Chuin Saul henga Samuel ahungin: chule Saul'in ahenga, Pakai phattheiboh chang nahi; keiman Pakai thupeh chu kamolso tai, ati.
target: When Samuel reached him, Saul said, “The Lord bless you! I have carried out the Lord ’s instructions.”

source: Chuin Samuel'in, Kanakhanga kelngoi hamgin le bongchal hamgin kajah hi ipi thu hitam? ati.
target: But Samuel said, “What then is this bleating of sheep in my ears? What is this lowing of cattle that I hear?”

source: Chuin Saul'in, Amahon Amalek mite-a kona ahinkaiju ahi: ajehchu mipihon kelngoiho le bongchalho aphapenho chu Pakai na Pathen lhaina dinga ahing hoiju ahi; adangse vang kasumanghel taove, ati.
target: Saul answered, “The soldiers brought them from the Amalekites; they spared the best of the sheep and cattle to sacrifice to the Lord your God, but we totally destroyed the rest.”

source: Chuphatnin Samuel'in Saul henga, Khongaijin, tujana Pakaiyin kahenga ipi anaseijem nahilinge, ati. Chuin aman, Seijin, ati.
target: “Enough!” Samuel said to Saul. “Let me tell you what the Lord said to me last night.” “Tell me,” Saul replied.

source: Chuin Samuel'in, Namitmu-a neocha nahilaija chu Israel phungpi luchanga nakisema, Pakaiyin Israel pumpi chunga leng dinga thao nananu hilouham?
target: Samuel said, “Although you were once small in your own eyes, did you not become the head of the tribes of Israel? The Lord anointed you king over Israel.

source: Chule Pakaiyin kholjinin nasolin, nahenga, Chenlang michonse Amalek mitekhu gasumangsoh helin, chule abeitheng tokah seuvin amaho chu satnin, ati.
target: And he sent you on a mission, saying, ‘Go and completely destroy those wicked people, the Amalekites; wage war against them until you have wiped them out.’

source: Achutile ibola Pakai awchu ngailouva, thil kichom chunga nachuhjoh-a, chule Pakai mitmu-a thilse nabol ham? ati.
target: Why did you not obey the Lord ? Why did you pounce on the plunder and do evil in the eyes of the Lord ?”

source: Chuin Saul'in Samuel jah-a, henge, keiman Pakai thusei kanitnin, Pakaiyin eisolna lampia chun kachen, Amalek lengpa Agag chu kahinpuijin, Amalek mite chu kasumang heltai.
target: “But I did obey the Lord ,” Saul said. “I went on the mission the Lord assigned me. I completely destroyed the Amalekites and brought back Agag their king.

source: Ahin mipi hin suhmang heldingsa thilkichom kelngoiho le bongchalho, thil lah-a apha chung nungho chu Gilgal'a Pakai na Pathen henga ganlhaina-a dinga ahin kilah-u ahi, ati.
target: The soldiers took sheep and cattle from the plunder, the best of what was devoted to God, in order to sacrifice them to the Lord your God at Gilgal.”

source: Chuin Samuel'in, Pakaiyin Pakai thusei ngai akipapi banga, govam thilpeh le ganlhainaho akipapi hinam? ven, thuman hi ganlhaina sanga phajo ahin, chule thusei kingaipeh hi kelngoichal thaotah sanga phajo ahi.
target: But Samuel replied: “Does the Lord delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obeying the Lord ? To obey is better than sacrifice, and to heed is better than the fat of rams.

source: Ijeh inem itile golkeh hi aisana-a chonsetna toh kibang ahin, louchal kitihi khangitlouna le milim houna toh kibang ahi. Ajehchu nangman Pakai thusei napaidoh tah jeh-in, Aman jong leng nahina-a kona napaidoh ahitai, ati.
target: For rebellion is like the sin of divination, and arrogance like the evil of idolatry. Because you have rejected the word of the Lord , he has rejected you as king.”

source: Chuin Saul'in Samuel henga, Keima kachonse tai: ijeh inem itile Pakai thupeh hole nangma thuho kapalkeh tai. Ajehchu mipi kakichatna, athu-u kanangai ahitai.
target: Then Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned. I violated the Lord ’s command and your instructions. I was afraid of the men and so I gave in to them.

source: Hijeh chun, tun, nahenga katao ahi, kachonsetna neingaidamin lang, Pakai chu kahouthei nadingin keima toh kinungle kitnin, ati.
target: Now I beg you, forgive my sin and come back with me, so that I may worship the Lord .”

source: Chuin Samuel'in Saul jah-a, Keima nang toh kakinungle kit louding ahi: ajehchu nangman Pakai thu napaidoh ahitan, Pakaiyin Israelte chunga leng nahina-a kona napaidoh ahitai, ati.
target: But Samuel said to him, “I will not go back with you. You have rejected the word of the Lord , and the Lord has rejected you as king over Israel!”

source: Chuin Samuel chu chemang dinga akiheija ahile, aman asangkhol chol mong chu amanin, aloi-eh tan ahi.
target: As Samuel turned to leave, Saul caught hold of the hem of his robe, and it tore.

source: Chuin Samuel'in ajah-a, Tunia hi Pakaiyin Israel lenggam chu nanga kona alhetela, nangma sanga phajo naheng nakom khat henga apeh ahitai.
target: Samuel said to him, “The Lord has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today and has given it to one of your neighbors—to one better than you.

source: Chujongle Israel Thahatna chu jou louding, alung jong aheilou ding ahi; ajehchu ama lunghei ding mihem ahipoi, ati.
target: He who is the Glory of Israel does not lie or change his mind; for he is not a human being, that he should change his mind.”

source: Chuphatnin aman, Keima kachonse tai: hitajongle katao ahi, kamite upaho masang le Israelte masanga neijabolin lang, Pakai na Pathen chu kahouthei nadingin keima toh kinungle kitnin, ati.
target: Saul replied, “I have sinned. But please honor me before the elders of my people and before Israel; come back with me, so that I may worship the Lord your God.”

source: Chuti chun Samuel chu Saul toh akinunglen, chuin Saul'in Pakai ahou tai.
target: So Samuel went back with Saul, and Saul worshiped the Lord .

source: Hichun Samuel'in, Amalek mite lengpa Agag chu kahenga hinpuijun ati. Chuin Agag chu ahenga ti kithing pumin ahungin ahi. Chule Agag chun, Thina tijat umtah chu chemanga ahitai, ati.
target: Then Samuel said, “Bring me Agag king of the Amalekites.” Agag came to him in chains. And he thought, “Surely the bitterness of death is past.”

source: Chuin Samuel'in, Nachemjam chun numei ho chabei aso banga, numei lah-a nanujong chabei hiding ahitai, ati. Chuin Samuel'in Gilgal'a Pakai masanga chun Agag chu ahal halin asattel tan ahi.
target: But Samuel said, “As your sword has made women childless, so will your mother be childless among women.” And Samuel put Agag to death before the Lord at Gilgal.

source: Chujouvin Samuel chu Ramah'a achetan; chule Saul jong Saul umna Gibeah ah achetoutan ahi.
target: Then Samuel left for Ramah, but Saul went up to his home in Gibeah of Saul.

source: Chuin Samuel chu athi nikho geijin Saul kimupi dingin ahungkit tapoi; ahijeng vangin Samuel chu Saul dingin alunghem jingin ahi. Chule Saul chu Israelte chunga lenga anatun chu Pakai akisih tan ahi.
target: Until the day Samuel died, he did not go to see Saul again, though Samuel mourned for him. And the Lord regretted that he had made Saul king over Israel.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Samuel jah-a, Israelte chunga alengchana kona kapaidoh henasa itihchan Saul dinga nalunghem dingham? nasaki-a thao sungdim minlang chen, keiman Bethlehem mi Jesse henga kasolding nahi: ajehchu achapate lah-a khu lengchang ding khat keiman gotsa kakoi ahitai, ati.
target: The Lord said to Samuel, “How long will you mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him as king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil and be on your way; I am sending you to Jesse of Bethlehem. I have chosen one of his sons to be king.”

source: Chuin Samuel'in, Iti kachethei dingham? Saul'in jadoh leh eithading ahi, ati. Chuin Pakaiyin, Bongla khat kaijinlang, Pakai henga ganlhaina neidinga hung kahi, tin.
target: But Samuel said, “How can I go? If Saul hears about it, he will kill me.” The Lord said, “Take a heifer with you and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to the Lord .’

source: Chule ganlhaina-a chun Jesse kouvin, chule keiman nabolding chu kahilding ahi: chule nahenga kaminphah pachu keima dinga thao nanu ding ahi, ati.
target: Invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what to do. You are to anoint for me the one I indicate.”

source: Chuin Samuel'in Pakai seibang chun abolin, Bethlehem'a ahungtan ahi. Chuin khopi-a upaho chu ahung jehchun atiu akithingin, Chamna-a hunga nahi hinam? atiuve.
target: Samuel did what the Lord said. When he arrived at Bethlehem, the elders of the town trembled when they met him. They asked, “Do you come in peace?”

source: Chuin aman, Chamna ahinai: Pakai henga ganlhai bola hunga kahi: nangho kisuthengun lang kahenga ganlhaina-a hungun, ati. Chuin Jesse le achapate chu asuthengin, ganlhaina-a din akoutai.
target: Samuel replied, “Yes, in peace; I have come to sacrifice to the Lord . Consecrate yourselves and come to the sacrifice with me.” Then he consecrated Jesse and his sons and invited them to the sacrifice.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, amaho ahung phatnun, aman Eliab chu aven, Pakai thaonupa chu amasanga umpa hi hiteijinte ati.
target: When they arrived, Samuel saw Eliab and thought, “Surely the Lord ’s anointed stands here before the Lord .”

source: Ahivangin Pakaiyin Samuel jah-a, Nangman amaiso ahiloule asandan chu vehih-in, ajehchu keiman amachu kadeilou ahi; ijeh inem itile Pakaiyin mihem thilvet banga avet ahipoi; ajehchu mihemin polam melput avet ahin, Pakaiyin vang lungsung avet ahi, atipeh-e.
target: But the Lord said to Samuel, “Do not consider his appearance or his height, for I have rejected him. The Lord does not look at the things people look at. People look at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart.”

source: Chujouvin Jesse'n Abinadad akouvin, Samuel anga asolin ahi. Chuin aman, Hichepa jong Pakaiyin alhengpoi, ati.
target: Then Jesse called Abinadab and had him pass in front of Samuel. But Samuel said, “The Lord has not chosen this one either.”

source: Chujouvin Jesse'n Shammah asolkitnin ahi. Chuin aman, Hichepa jong Pakaiyin alhengpoi atipeh-e.
target: Jesse then had Shammah pass by, but Samuel said, “Nor has the Lord chosen this one.”

source: Avelin Jesse'n achapate sagiho chu Samuel anga asolin, ahi. Chuin Samuel'in Jesse jah-a, Hicheho hi Pakaiyin alhengpoi, ati.
target: Jesse had seven of his sons pass before Samuel, but Samuel said to him, “The Lord has not chosen these.”

source: Chuin Samuel'in Jesse jah-a, Hiche mun'a hi nachate jouse umkim sohkeiju vaham? ati. Chuin aman, Aneopenpa avat nalaije, chule ven ama kelngoi ching ahi, ati. Chuin Samuel'in Jesse jah-a, Gakousah-in; ajehchu ama hikoma ahunglhun masangse-a eiho itou loudiu ahi, ati.
target: So he asked Jesse, “Are these all the sons you have?” “There is still the youngest,” Jesse answered. “He is tending the sheep.” Samuel said, “Send for him; we will not sit down until he arrives.”
