source: Chuin aman agakou sah-in, ahinpui taove. Tun amachu tahsa phatah, mitha hoitah, chule vetnom umtah ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin, Kipatdoh-in, thao nutan; ajehchu hichehi amapa chu ahi, ati.
target: So he sent for him and had him brought in. He was glowing with health and had a fine appearance and handsome features. Then the Lord said, “Rise and anoint him; this is the one.”

source: Hichun Samuel'in saki-a thaochu alan, asopite lah-a amachu thao anutai. Chuin chuche nikho-a patnin Pakai lhagao David chunga achutai. Hitichun Samuel akipatdoh-in, Ramah'a achetai.
target: So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of his brothers, and from that day on the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon David. Samuel then went to Ramah.

source: Ahinla Pakai lhagao chu Saul'a konin achemang tan, chule Pakaiya kon lhagao gilou khatnin asugimtan ahi.
target: Now the Spirit of the Lord had departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the Lord tormented him.

source: Chuin Saul sohten ahenga, Ven, tuahi Pathen'a kon lhagao gilou khatnin nasuhgim ahitai.
target: Saul’s attendants said to him, “See, an evil spirit from God is tormenting you.

source: Tun ka-pakaiyun namasanga um nasohte hin semjang saithem mikhat agahol nadiuvin thupeh neijin; chule hung hitiding ahi, Pathen'a kon lhagao gilou chu nachunga ahung umteng, aman semjang asai ding, chutengle nangma naphat jiding ahi, atiuve.
target: Let our lord command his servants here to search for someone who can play the lyre. He will play when the evil spirit from God comes on you, and you will feel better.”

source: Chuin Saul'in asohte jah-a, Tun asai themtah mikhat neipeuvin, amachu kahenga hinpuijun, ati.
target: So Saul said to his attendants, “Find someone who plays well and bring him to me.”

source: Chuin sohte lah-a khatnin adonbutnin, Ven, Bethlehem mi Jesse chapa semjang saithemtah, gal hat mihangsan, galbolmi, ijakaija hekhen themtah, chule melhoitah, Pakaiyin aumpi khat kamui, ati.
target: One of the servants answered, “I have seen a son of Jesse of Bethlehem who knows how to play the lyre. He is a brave man and a warrior. He speaks well and is a fine-looking man. And the Lord is with him.”

source: Hijeh chun Saul'in Jesse henga thupole ho solin, ahenga, Kelngoiho toh umkhom nachapa David chu neihinsol peh-in, ati.
target: Then Saul sent messengers to Jesse and said, “Send me your son David, who is with the sheep.”

source: Chuin Jesse'n changlhah toh lengpitwi haikhat, chule kelnou khat sangan apohsah-in, achapa David khutna Saul athot tai.
target: So Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, a skin of wine and a young goat and sent them with his son David to Saul.

source: Chuin David Saul henga ahungin, amasanga adingtai: chule aman nasatah-in alungsetnin, agalvonpon ahung pangtai.
target: David came to Saul and entered his service. Saul liked him very much, and David became one of his armor-bearers.

source: Chuin Saul'in Jesse henga, Katao ahi, David hi kamasanga dingjing hen; ajehchu ama kamitmun lungsetna achange, ati.
target: Then Saul sent word to Jesse, saying, “Allow David to remain in my service, for I am pleased with him.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Pathen'a kon lhagao gilou chu Saul chunga aumtengle, David'in semjang alan, akhutna asaijin ahi: hitichun Saul chu alimdohjin, aphajitan, chule lhagao gilou chun adalhaji tan ahi.
target: Whenever the spirit from God came on Saul, David would take up his lyre and play. Then relief would come to Saul; he would feel better, and the evil spirit would leave him.

source: Tun Judah gam Shochoh mun'a chun Philistine galsat ho chu galbol din akikhomun, chule Ephes-damim'a um Shochoh le Azekah kikah-ah ponbuh asongun ahi.
target: Now the Philistines gathered their forces for war and assembled at Sokoh in Judah. They pitched camp at Ephes Dammim, between Sokoh and Azekah.

source: Chuin Saul le Israelte jong akikhom khomun, Elah phaicham panga aponbuh-u asongun, Philistine te douna-a galsatdin akigongtoh taove.
target: Saul and the Israelites assembled and camped in the Valley of Elah and drew up their battle line to meet the Philistines.

source: Chuin Philistine te chu molpang langkhatna adingun, chule Israelte chu molpang khatlama adingun ahi. Chule akah uva chun phaicham khat aume.
target: The Philistines occupied one hill and the Israelites another, with the valley between them.

source: Chuin Philistine te gebuh-a konin Gath khomi amin Goliath kiti mihat tah khat, tong gup le khap khatna sang ahungdoh-in ahi.
target: A champion named Goliath, who was from Gath, came out of the Philistine camp. His height was six cubits and a span.

source: Chule aman aluchunga sum-eng lukhuh akhuh-in, thih sangkhol aki-ah-in, asangkhol gihdan chu sum-eng shekel sanga agih ahi.
target: He had a bronze helmet on his head and wore a coat of scale armor of bronze weighing five thousand shekels;

source: Akengteni sum-eng ngaltomin akitomin, chule alengkou teni kikah-a sum-eng tengcha aumin ahi.
target: on his legs he wore bronze greaves, and a bronze javelin was slung on his back.

source: Chule atenglung chu ponkhong ho talhang abangin, atengpeh gih chu thih shekel jagup ahi: chule mikhatnin apho apon amasanga achen ahi.
target: His spear shaft was like a weaver’s rod, and its iron point weighed six hundred shekels. His shield bearer went ahead of him.

source: Chuin ama adingin Israel galsat miho jah-a chun asamin, Ipi dinga galsat dinga hung kigola nahiuvem? keima Philistine kahi, nangho Saul sohte nahiu hilouham? nanghodin mikhat lheng unlang, amachu kahenga hungsuh hen.
target: Goliath stood and shouted to the ranks of Israel, “Why do you come out and line up for battle? Am I not a Philistine, and are you not the servants of Saul? Choose a man and have him come down to me.

source: Aman eihung kisatpi jouva, eitha-a ahile, keiho nasoh-u hiuvingting; ahinla ken kajo-a, amachu katha-a ahile nangho kasoh nahiuva, neijen dingu ahi, ati.
target: If he is able to fight and kill me, we will become your subjects; but if I overcome him and kill him, you will become our subjects and serve us.”

source: Chuin Philistine mipa chun, Tunia hi Israel galsat miho kataitom nahiuve; kaki satpi dingin, mi khat neipeuvin, ati.
target: Then the Philistine said, “This day I defy the armies of Israel! Give me a man and let us fight each other.”

source: Saul le Israel mijousen Philistine mipa thusei chu ajah phatnun, alungu alhan, akichalheh jengun ahi.
target: On hearing the Philistine’s words, Saul and all the Israelites were dismayed and terrified.

source: Tun David chu Judah gam Bethlehem'a Ephrath mi Jesse chapa ahi; amapan chapa get aneijin, chule ama Saul nikholaija chun tehsetah ahitai.
target: Now David was the son of an Ephrathite named Jesse, who was from Bethlehem in Judah. Jesse had eight sons, and in Saul’s time he was very old.

source: Chule Jesse chapa lenpen thumho chu acheuvin galmuna chun Saul ajuijun ahi. Chule achapa thum galmuna cheho minchu, achapa lenpen Eliab, abanna Abinadad, athumna Shammah ahiuve.
target: Jesse’s three oldest sons had followed Saul to the war: The firstborn was Eliab; the second, Abinadab; and the third, Shammah.

source: Chule David chu alhumpen ahin, chule alenpen thumin Saul ajuiju ahi.
target: David was the youngest. The three oldest followed Saul,

source: Ahinla David chu achen Saul'a konin apa kelngoi ching dingin Bethlehem'a ahung kile kit tai.
target: but David went back and forth from Saul to tend his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.

source: Chule Philistine mipa chun jingkah nilhah-in ahin naijin, nisomli sungin ahung kilah jingin ahi.
target: For forty days the Philistine came forward every morning and evening and took his stand.

source: Chuin Jesse'in achapa David jah-a, Tun na-ute dingin changkanpoh ephah khatle changlhah lhon somkhat choi jinlang, na-ute gebuh lama lhaijin,
target: Now Jesse said to his son David, “Take this ephah of roasted grain and these ten loaves of bread for your brothers and hurry to their camp.

source: Chule hiche bongnoiha somkhat hi sangkhat chunga gal lamkaipa pohpeh-in, chule nasopite iti umuvem gavenlang thu hinle poh-in, ati.
target: Take along these ten cheeses to the commander of their unit. See how your brothers are and bring back some assurance from them.

source: Tun Saul le Israel mite jouse chu Elah phaichama Philistine tetoh kisatdinga uma ahiuve.
target: They are with Saul and all the men of Israel in the Valley of Elah, fighting against the Philistines.”

source: Chuin David chu jingkah matah-in athouvin, kelngoiho chu achingtup ding khattoh adalhan, Jesse'n athupeh bangchun thilho chu apon achetai. Chuin janelho galkula kon galsat dinga akijotdoh uva, galsat dinga a-ao laitah-un, ngahphol chu agalhungtai.
target: Early in the morning David left the flock in the care of a shepherd, loaded up and set out, as Jesse had directed. He reached the camp as the army was going out to its battle positions, shouting the war cry.

source: Ajehchu Israelte le Philistine te chu galsat mi le galsat mi kisatto din akigol cheh taove.
target: Israel and the Philistines were drawing up their lines facing each other.

source: Chuin David'in thil chingtuppa henga athilpohho chu adalhan, galsat miho lah-a alhailutnin, a-ute chu chibai agabohtai.
target: David left his things with the keeper of supplies, ran to the battle lines and asked his brothers how they were.

source: Chuin amahotoh akihou laijin, veuvin, Gath mi Philistine mihatpa, amin Goliath kitipa chu Philistine galsat mihon lah-a konin ahungdoh-in, athusei ngaibang chun ahinsei kitnin ahile, hichu David'in ajatai.
target: As he was talking with them, Goliath, the Philistine champion from Gath, stepped out from his lines and shouted his usual defiance, and David heard it.

source: Chuin Israel mite jousen mipa chu amuphatnun, ama-a konchun ajamun, hatah-in akichao vin ahi.
target: Whenever the Israelites saw the man, they all fled from him in great fear.

source: Chuin Israel miho chun, Ahungdoh mipa khu namuvem? Israelte sujum ding mongmonga hungdoh-a ahi; chule hiti ding ahi, ama that penpen chu lengpan haona nasatah-a ahaosah ding, chule amachu achanu jong apeh-a, apate insung chu Israel lah-a a-onthol sah ding ahi, atiuve.
target: Now the Israelites had been saying, “Do you see how this man keeps coming out? He comes out to defy Israel. The king will give great wealth to the man who kills him. He will also give him his daughter in marriage and will exempt his family from taxes in Israel.”

source: Chuin David'in akoma dingho jah-a chun, hiche Philistine mipa thatna, Israel te-a kona minsetna lamangpa chu i-kilo dingham? ajehchu hiche cheptanlou Philistine mipa hi hoi koi hija, Pathen hing galsat miho hi ajumso ham? ati.
target: David asked the men standing near him, “What will be done for the man who kills this Philistine and removes this disgrace from Israel? Who is this uncircumcised Philistine that he should defy the armies of the living God?”

source: Chuin mihochun hitihin adonbutnun, Amapa that penpen chunga chu, akisei bang banga kibolding ahi, atiuve.
target: They repeated to him what they had been saying and told him, “This is what will be done for the man who kills him.”

source: Chuin a-upa alenpen Eliab'in miho toh akihoulim chu ajan; David chunga chun Eliab lunghanna chu akoujah jengtan, ajah-a, Ibola hikoma hungsuh nahim? chule kelngoi lhomcha khat chu gamthipma koi nahin chin sah ham? naki letsah na le naphatlou kahei; ajehchu kidouna munoma hungsuh nahi, ati.
target: When Eliab, David’s oldest brother, heard him speaking with the men, he burned with anger at him and asked, “Why have you come down here? And with whom did you leave those few sheep in the wilderness? I know how conceited you are and how wicked your heart is; you came down only to watch the battle.”

source: Chuin David'in tu-a hi ipi kabol em? ajeh uma hilouham? ati.
target: “Now what have I done?” said David. “Can’t I even speak?”

source: Chuin ama-a konin adangho lama akiheijin, chutobangma chun aseijin ahi: chuin mipin amachu amasa bangma chun adonbutnun ahi.
target: He then turned away to someone else and brought up the same matter, and the men answered him as before.

source: Chuin David thusei ho ajah phatnun, Saul henga aga hetsah taovin ahile, aman akouding ahinsol tai.
target: What David said was overheard and reported to Saul, and Saul sent for him.

source: Chuin David'in Saul jah-a, Ama jehkhun koimacha lunglha hihhel hen, nasohhi kache-a hiche Philistine mipa tokhun kaga kisat ding ahi, ati.
target: David said to Saul, “Let no one lose heart on account of this Philistine; your servant will go and fight him.”

source: Chuin Saul'in David jah-a, Hiche Philistine mipa kidoupi dingkhun chethei pon nate: ajehchu nangma khangdong chabou nahin, amakhu aneova patna galbolmi hung hija ahi, ati.
target: Saul replied, “You are not able to go out against this Philistine and fight him; you are only a young man, and he has been a warrior from his youth.”

source: Chuin David'in Saul jah-a, Nasohhin apa kelngoi ana chingin, hia chun keipi bahkai le vompi ahunga kelngoihon lah-a konin kelngoi nouho ahunglhoh jiteng;
target: But David said to Saul, “Your servant has been keeping his father’s sheep. When a lion or a bear came and carried off a sheep from the flock,

source: Anung kadel jin, kakidel pin, akama konin kaloidoh-in kahuh dohjin ahi: chule keima thatdinga ahung kipatdoh-a ahile, akhamula kamanin, kajepmin, kathatjitai, ati.
target: I went after it, struck it and rescued the sheep from its mouth. When it turned on me, I seized it by its hair, struck it and killed it.

source: Nasoh hin keipi bahkai le vompi ani-in kathatnin ahi: chule hiche cheptanlou Philistine mipa hi Pathen hing galsat mite ajumso kimu ahin, hiteho khat tobang chu hiding ahi, ati.
target: Your servant has killed both the lion and the bear; this uncircumcised Philistine will be like one of them, because he has defied the armies of the living God.

source: David'in aseiben, Pakaiyin keipi khophanga konle vompi khophanga kona eina huhdoh ahin, aman hiche Philistine mipa khutna kona jong eihuhdoh ding ati. Chuin Saul'in David henga, Chen, Pakaiyin naumpi hen, ati.
target: The Lord who rescued me from the paw of the lion and the paw of the bear will rescue me from the hand of this Philistine.” Saul said to David, “Go, and the Lord be with you.”

source: Chuin Saul'in agalvon chu David avonpeh'in, aluchanga chun sum-eng lukhuh akhuhpeh-in, thih sangkhol a-ah peh-in ahi.
target: Then Saul dressed David in his own tunic. He put a coat of armor on him and a bronze helmet on his head.

source: Chuin David'in achemjam chu agalvon chunga akojin, cheding agon ahi; ajehchu hichu anapatep khahlou ahi. Chuin David'in Saul jah-a, Hicheho pumin chethei ponge, ajehchu hichehohi kamangkhapoi, ati. Chuti chun David'in asutlha gamtai.
target: David fastened on his sword over the tunic and tried walking around, because he was not used to them. “I cannot go in these,” he said to Saul, “because I am not used to them.” So he took them off.

source: Chuin atenggol akhutna achoijin, vachadunga konin songchang jolsel changnga alhengin, akelngoi chinna sakhao neo sunga akhumin; akhutna ahsongse achoijin, Philistine mipa chu anailut tan ahi.
target: Then he took his staff in his hand, chose five smooth stones from the stream, put them in the pouch of his shepherd’s bag and, with his sling in his hand, approached the Philistine.

source: Chuin Philistine mipa ahungin, David chu ahin naipheijin; chule apho popa chu amasanga achen ahi.
target: Meanwhile, the Philistine, with his shield bearer in front of him, kept coming closer to David.

source: Chule Philistine mipan avetle David amuphatnin, amachu anoiselheh-in ahi: ajehchu ama khangdong ahin, tahsa phatah le maiso hoitah ahi.
target: He looked David over and saw that he was little more than a boy, glowing with health and handsome, and he despised him.

source: Chuin Philistine mipan David jah-a, Keima uicha kahia kahenga tenggol toh nahungham? ati. Chuin Philistine mipa chun a-pathenhou min panin David chu agaosaptai.
target: He said to David, “Am I a dog, that you come at me with sticks?” And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.

source: Chuin Philistine mipan David jah-a, Kahenga hungin, keiman naphe chu chunga leng vachate le gamlah-a gamsaho kapeh ding ahi, ati.
target: “Come here,” he said, “and I’ll give your flesh to the birds and the wild animals!”

source: Chuin David'in Philistine mipa jah-a, Nangma kahenga chemjam le tengcha chule lum tho-a nahung ahin, hinlah keima vang nangin nataitom Israel galsat mite Pathen, janel Pakai mina chu hunga kahi.
target: David said to the Philistine, “You come against me with sword and spear and javelin, but I come against you in the name of the Lord Almighty, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.

source: Tunia hi Pakaiyin nangma kakhutna eipehdoh ding; chule nangma katha-a, nalu kalahding; chule leiset pumpin Israelte lah-a Pathen aumme ti ahetna diuva, Philistine sepai janel longchu tunia hi chunga leng vachate le leija gamsaho kapeh ding ahi.
target: This day the Lord will deliver you into my hands, and I’ll strike you down and cut off your head. This very day I will give the carcasses of the Philistine army to the birds and the wild animals, and the whole world will know that there is a God in Israel.

source: Chule hichea kikhom jousehin Pakaiyin chemjam le tengchan ahuhhing poi ti ahetdiu ahi; ajehchu galsat hi Pakaiya ahin, aman nangho kakhut uva eipehlut diu ahitai, ati.
target: All those gathered here will know that it is not by sword or spear that the Lord saves; for the battle is the Lord ’s, and he will give all of you into our hands.”

source: Chuin ahung hitin ahi, Philistine mipa ahung kipatdoh-a, David henglam ahin nai phatnin, kintah-in David chu Philistine galsat miho toh kisuto dingin alhaitan ahi.
target: As the Philistine moved closer to attack him, David ran quickly toward the battle line to meet him.

source: Chuin David'in akhutnin sakhao sung asoh-in, chua konchun songchang khat alan, ahsongse-a chu asea ahile, Philistine mipa chalpanga achun, songchang chu achalpanga alutnin; chuin ama amaijin tolla alhutai.
target: Reaching into his bag and taking out a stone, he slung it and struck the Philistine on the forehead. The stone sank into his forehead, and he fell facedown on the ground.

source: Chuti chun David'in Philistine mipa chu ahsongse le songchang khatnin ajouvin, Philistine mipa chu asepmin, athattai; ahinla David khutna chun chemjam aumpon ahi.
target: So David triumphed over the Philistine with a sling and a stone; without a sword in his hand he struck down the Philistine and killed him.

source: Hitichun David alhaijin, Philistine mipa chunga adingin, achemjam chu alan, apaija konchun asatdoh in, athatnin, hia chun alu atanbongtai. Chuin Philistine ten amihatpao athi chu amuphatnun ajamtaovin ahi.
target: David ran and stood over him. He took hold of the Philistine’s sword and drew it from the sheath. After he killed him, he cut off his head with the sword. When the Philistines saw that their hero was dead, they turned and ran.

source: Chuin Israelte le Judah miho akipatnun, hatah in a-aovun, phaicham le Ekron kotpi aphah kahseovin Philistine te chu anung delun ahi. Chule Philistine mipi ho chu Shaaraim lampi dunga, Gath le Ekron changeijin alhuchap jengun ahi.
target: Then the men of Israel and Judah surged forward with a shout and pursued the Philistines to the entrance of Gath and to the gates of Ekron. Their dead were strewn along the Shaaraim road to Gath and Ekron.

source: Chuin Israel chate chu Philistine te anungdel uva konin ahung kileuvin, aponbuh houchu asumang taove.
target: When the Israelites returned from chasing the Philistines, they plundered their camp.

source: Ahin David'in Philistine mipa luchang chu alan, Jerusalem'a ahinpotai; ahin agalvon vang apon in'a akoijin ahi.
target: David took the Philistine’s head and brought it to Jerusalem; he put the Philistine’s weapons in his own tent.

source: Chuin Saul'in David Philistine mipa satdinga achedoh amuchun, janel gallamkai Abner jah-a, Abner hiche gollhangpa hi koicha ham? ati. Chuin Abner'in, Vo lengpa, nahinna hingjeng hen, kasei theipoi, ati.
target: As Saul watched David going out to meet the Philistine, he said to Abner, commander of the army, “Abner, whose son is that young man?” Abner replied, “As surely as you live, Your Majesty, I don’t know.”

source: Chuin lengpan, Khangdongpa chu koicha ham? hinkhol toh-in, ati.
target: The king said, “Find out whose son this young man is.”

source: Chuin David chu Philistine mipa atha-a kona ahung kile phatnin, Abner'in apuijin, akhutna Philistine mipa luchang pumin Saul masanga ahin puilut tai.
target: As soon as David returned from killing the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul, with David still holding the Philistine’s head.

source: Chuin Saul'in ajah-a, Gollhang nangma koipen cha nahim? ati. Chuin David'in adonbutnin, Keima Bethlehem mi nasoh Jesse chapa kahi, ati.
target: “Whose son are you, young man?” Saul asked him. David said, “I am the son of your servant Jesse of Bethlehem.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Saul henga athusei achai phatnin, Jonathan hinna chu David hinna toh akijopmat tan, chule Jonathan'in David chu ama hinna bang bangin angailutan ahi.
target: After David had finished talking with Saul, Jonathan became one in spirit with David, and he loved him as himself.

source: Chuin hicheni chun Saul'in ama akipuijin, chule a-in lam apa in'a achesah nom tapoi.
target: From that day Saul kept David with him and did not let him return home to his family.

source: Chujouvin Jonathan le David'in kitepna aneilhone; ajehchu aman ama hinna bangin amachu angailun ahi.
target: And Jonathan made a covenant with David because he loved him as himself.

source: Chuin Jonathan'in achunga kai asangkhol len chu asutlhan, avonho, achemjam le athalpi, chule akongah sannin David apetan ahi.
target: Jonathan took off the robe he was wearing and gave it to David, along with his tunic, and even his sword, his bow and his belt.

source: Chuin Saul'in asolnalam lama David achedohjin, chule chingthei tah-in aumin ahi: chule Saul'in ama chu galbolho chunga lamkaijin atungin, ama chu mijouse mitmu le Saul sohte mitmun deisahna achangin ahi.
target: Whatever mission Saul sent him on, David was so successful that Saul gave him a high rank in the army. This pleased all the troops, and Saul’s officers as well.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, David'in Philistine mipa atha-a, atha naova kona ahungkileu chun, Israelte khopiho jouse-a konin numei ho lasa le lam pumin, khongcha le thil gingtheiho thon thanom tah-in Saul lamto dingin ahungpot doh-un ahi.
target: When the men were returning home after David had killed the Philistine, the women came out from all the towns of Israel to meet King Saul with singing and dancing, with joyful songs and with timbrels and lyres.

source: Chuin numei hon la asaovin, Saul'in asang asang athatnin, David'in sangsom sangja athatne, tin khatle khat akidonbutnun ahi.
target: As they danced, they sang: “Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands.”

source: Chuin Saul alung ahanglheh-in, akisei chun alung phatmosah lheh-in; aman, David'in sangsom athan aseijun, chule keiman sangkhat kathan bou aseijuve: lenggam tailou adang ipi alahbe ding umtam? ati.
target: Saul was very angry; this refrain displeased him greatly. “They have credited David with tens of thousands,” he thought, “but me with only thousands. What more can he get but the kingdom?”

source: Chuin Saul'in chuche ni-a pat akalse chu David chu amit thiptan ahi.
target: And from that time on Saul kept a close eye on David.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, ajingin Pathen'a kona lhagao gilou chu Saul chungah ahungchun, insunga chun gaothu aseijin: phatdanga bangin David'in akhutnin semjang asaijin; chule Saul khutna chun tengcha khat aumin ahi.
target: The next day an evil spirit from God came forcefully on Saul. He was prophesying in his house, while David was playing the lyre, as he usually did. Saul had a spear in his hand

source: Chuin Saul'in tengcha chun akhon ahi; ajehchu aman, David chu tengchan bangtoh khobeh inge, ati ahi, chuin David ama-a konin nivei ahoidoh-in ahi.
target: and he hurled it, saying to himself, “I’ll pin David to the wall.” But David eluded him twice.

source: Chuin Saul'in David chu akichatan ahi, ajehchu Pakaiyin ama aumpin, Saul chu adalha tai.
target: Saul was afraid of David, because the Lord was with David but had departed from Saul.

source: Hijeh chun Saul'in ama-a konin asoldoh-in, sangkhat chunga gal lamkaijin apansah-in; chule ama mipi masanga chun alutle apotlejin ahi.
target: So he sent David away from him and gave him command over a thousand men, and David led the troops in their campaigns.

source: Chuin David alampi jouse-a chingthei tah-in aumin; chule Pakaiyin aumpin ahi.
target: In everything he did he had great success, because the Lord was with him.

source: Hijeh chun Saul'in ama chingtheitah-a aum amuphatnin, amachu akichatan ahi.
target: When Saul saw how successful he was, he was afraid of him.

source: Ahinla Israelte jouse le Judah ten David chu a-angsung uva alutle apotle jeh-in angailuvin ahi.
target: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he led them in their campaigns.

source: Chuin Saul'in David jah-a, Ven, kachanu lenjonu Merab hi najidinga kapeh ding nahi: keidin hangtah-in pang poupouvin lang, Pakai galchu satnin, ati. Ajehchu Saul'in, Kakhut hi achunga chuhda hen, amavang Philistine te khut joh chu achunga chuhen, ati ahi.
target: Saul said to David, “Here is my older daughter Merab. I will give her to you in marriage; only serve me bravely and fight the battles of the Lord .” For Saul said to himself, “I will not raise a hand against him. Let the Philistines do that!”

source: Chuin David'in Saul jah-a, Keima hi koi kahiham? chule kahinkho ipi hija, Israel insunga kapa insung ipi hija, lengpa tupa kahiding ham? ati.
target: But David said to Saul, “Who am I, and what is my family or my clan in Israel, that I should become the king’s son-in-law?”

source: Ahinla Saul chanu Merab chu David akipeh ding phatchun ahitin ahi, Meholath mi Adriel jidin amanu akipetan ahi.
target: So when the time came for Merab, Saul’s daughter, to be given to David, she was given in marriage to Adriel of Meholah.

source: Chuin Saul chanu Michal'in David adeichan; chule Saul jah-ah aseipeh-un ahile ama akipah lheh-in ahi.
target: Now Saul’s daughter Michal was in love with David, and when they told Saul about it, he was pleased.

source: Chuin Saul'in, Amanu hi amapa dinga thang ahitheina dingle, Philistine te khut achunga achuhthei nadin, amanu chu David penge, ati. Hijeh chun Saul'in David jah-a, Tunia katupa nahi ding ahitai, ati.
target: “I will give her to him,” he thought, “so that she may be a snare to him and so that the hand of the Philistines may be against him.” So Saul said to David, “Now you have a second opportunity to become my son-in-law.”

source: Chuin Saul'in asohte thu apen, ajah uva, David toh guhthim chan kihou unlang, ahenga, Ven, lengpan nachunga kipana aneijin, asohte jousen nangailui: hijeh chun tun lengpa tupa hitan tiuvin, ati.
target: Then Saul ordered his attendants: “Speak to David privately and say, ‘Look, the king likes you, and his attendants all love you; now become his son-in-law.’ ”

source: Chuin Saul sohten thuho chu David jah-a aseijun ahi. Chuin David'in, Kei migenthei le mi nahsahmo kahi nahena saova, lengpa tupa hidingchu thil bailama nagelu ham? ati.
target: They repeated these words to David. But David said, “Do you think it is a small matter to become the king’s son-in-law? I’m only a poor man and little known.”

source: Chuin Saul sohten ajah-a, David'in hitin aseije tin aseipeh-un ahi.
target: When Saul’s servants told him what David had said,

source: Chuin Saul'in, Hitia hi David henga nasei dingu ahi, lengpan amelmate phu lahna dinga Philistine chep jakhat tailou numei man imacha angehpoi tin seijun, ati. Ahinla Saul'in David chu Philistine te khutna thisah agot ahibouve.
target: Saul replied, “Say to David, ‘The king wants no other price for the bride than a hundred Philistine foreskins, to take revenge on his enemies.’ ” Saul’s plan was to have David fall by the hands of the Philistines.

source: Chuin asohten hichethu chu David aseipeh phatnun, lengpa tupa hiding chu David akipah-in; nikhoho chu akichai hihlaije.
target: When the attendants told David these things, he was pleased to become the king’s son-in-law. So before the allotted time elapsed,

source: Chuin David akipatdoh-in, amale amite acheuvin, Philistine miho jani agathatnun: David'in achepmu ahinpon, lengpa tupa ahithei nadin, lhingkeijin lengpa apetaove. Chuin Saul'in ajidin achanu Michal apetai.
target: David took his men with him and went out and killed two hundred Philistines and brought back their foreskins. They counted out the full number to the king so that David might become the king’s son-in-law. Then Saul gave him his daughter Michal in marriage.

source: Chuin Saul'in Pakaiyin David aumpi chu ahetan, chule Saul chanu Michal'in amachu angailun ahi.
target: When Saul realized that the Lord was with David and that his daughter Michal loved David,

source: Chuin Saul'in David chu akicha cheh tan: Saul chu David melma ahijom jingtan ahi.
target: Saul became still more afraid of him, and he remained his enemy the rest of his days.

source: Chujouvin Philistine pipuiho apotdoh-un: chuin ahitin ahi, amaho potdoh nungun, David chu Saul sohte jouse sangin chingthei cheh-in aumtan; chutichun aminchu nasatah-in akithangin ahi.
target: The Philistine commanders continued to go out to battle, and as often as they did, David met with more success than the rest of Saul’s officers, and his name became well known.

source: Chuin Saul'in achapa Jonathan le asohte jouse David that dingin ahoulimpi tan ahi.
target: Saul told his son Jonathan and all the attendants to kill David. But Jonathan had taken a great liking to David

source: Ahinla Saul chapa Jonathan'in David chu angailu lheh-in: chule Jonathan'in David henga, Kapa Saul'in thadingin nahole: hijeh chun tun, katao ahi, jingkah ahikahsen kichihtheijin, munthipma uminlang kiselin.
target: and warned him, “My father Saul is looking for a chance to kill you. Be on your guard tomorrow morning; go into hiding and stay there.

source: Chule keima kachesuh-a naumna loujaova chun kapa koma kadina, nangma chungchang thu kaseiding; chule kamudoh chanchu nangma kaseipeh ding nahi, ati.
target: I will go out and stand with my father in the field where you are. I’ll speak to him about you and will tell you what I find out.”

source: Chuin Jonathan'in apa Saul henga David chu aseiphan, ahenga hitin aseije, Lengpan asohpa David dounan chonset boldahen; ajehchu nang dounan achonsepon, chule athilbol jouse chu nang dinga phatna ngen ahi:
target: Jonathan spoke well of David to Saul his father and said to him, “Let not the king do wrong to his servant David; he has not wronged you, and what he has done has benefited you greatly.

source: Ajehchu aman ahinkho akhutna akichoi tho-a, Philistine mipa anatha-a, Pakaiyin Israelte jouse dinga huhhingna loupitah anabol ahi: chuti ahile ajeh beija David chu natha-a, monabei thisan douna-a nachonset ding ham? ati.
target: He took his life in his hands when he killed the Philistine. The Lord won a great victory for all Israel, and you saw it and were glad. Why then would you do wrong to an innocent man like David by killing him for no reason?”

source: Chuin Saul'in Jonathan thusei angaijin: chule Saul akihahselin, Hingjing Pakai min pana kasei ahi, ama kithat louding ahi, ati.
target: Saul listened to Jonathan and took this oath: “As surely as the Lord lives, David will not be put to death.”

source: Chuin Jonathan'in David akouvin, chule Jonathan'in thu jouse chu ahiltan ahi. Chule Jonathan'in David chu Saul henga apuijin, masanglaija bangin a-angsunga aumkit tan ahi.
target: So Jonathan called David and told him the whole conversation. He brought him to Saul, and David was with Saul as before.

source: Chuin gal aumkit tan: David akondoh-in Philistine tetoh akisatnin, amaho nasatah-in athatnin; chuin amaho ama-a konin ajamtaove.
target: Once more war broke out, and David went out and fought the Philistines. He struck them with such force that they fled before him.

source: Chuin a-insunga auma, akhutna teng akichoi petnin, Pakaiya kon lhagao gilou chu Saul chunga achutan; chule David'in akhutnin semjang asaijin ahi.
target: But an evil spirit from the Lord came on Saul as he was sitting in his house with his spear in his hand. While David was playing the lyre,

source: Chuin Saul'in David chu bangtoh khobeh-a thading agon; ahinla ama Saul umna-a konin ajamdoh-in, ateng chun bang akhochang jengin ahi. Chuin David ajamin, hiche janchun ajamdoh tai.
target: Saul tried to pin him to the wall with his spear, but David eluded him as Saul drove the spear into the wall. That night David made good his escape.

source: Saul'in David inlama jingkah-a anachanga thatdingin sottol leho asolin ahi: chuin David inneipi Michal'in ahenga, Tujanna nahinna nakihuh doh louva ahile, jingle nakithat ding ahi, ati.
target: Saul sent men to David’s house to watch it and to kill him in the morning. But Michal, David’s wife, warned him, “If you don’t run for your life tonight, tomorrow you’ll be killed.”

source: Chutichun Michal'in David chu bangkotna akhailhan: ama achen, ajamin, ahoidohtai.
target: So Michal let David down through a window, and he fled and escaped.

source: Chuin Michal'in milim khat alan, jalkhuna chun alupsah-in, aluchang dingin kelcha mul akoijin, hichu ponnin akhun ahi.
target: Then Michal took an idol and laid it on the bed, covering it with a garment and putting some goats’ hair at the head.

source: Chuin Saul'in David kouding thangkou asolphatnin, amanun, Adampoi atin ahi.
target: When Saul sent the men to capture David, Michal said, “He is ill.”

source: Chuin Saul'in David vedin sottol hochu asolkitnin, ajah uva, Katha theinadin, ajalkhun pumin kahenga hindom touvun, ati.
target: Then Saul sent the men back to see David and told them, “Bring him up to me in his bed so that I may kill him.”

source: Chuin sottol ho ahunglut phatnun, veuvin, jalkhuna chun aluchang dinga kelcha mul kikoi milim khat analumin ahi.
target: But when the men entered, there was the idol in the bed, and at the head was some goats’ hair.

source: Chuin Saul'in Michal henga, Ibola hitia hi neijou lhepma, kamelma pa chu ahoidoh nadinga nasoldoh ham? ati. Chuin Michal'in Saul adonbutnin, Aman kahengah, Neiche sah-in; ibola kathading nahim? atin ahi, ati.
target: Saul said to Michal, “Why did you deceive me like this and send my enemy away so that he escaped?” Michal told him, “He said to me, ‘Let me get away. Why should I kill you?’ ”

source: Chuin David chu ajamin, ahoidohtan, Ramah'a Samuel koma ahungin, Saul thilbol jouse chu ahiltai. Chuin amale Samuel ache lhonin, Naioth'a acheng lhontai.
target: When David had fled and made his escape, he went to Samuel at Ramah and told him all that Saul had done to him. Then he and Samuel went to Naioth and stayed there.

source: Chuin hichu Saul ahilun, Ven, Ramah gamsung Naioth'a David aume, atiuve.
target: Word came to Saul: “David is in Naioth at Ramah”;

source: Chuin Saul'in David mandin sottol leho asolin: chuin amahon themgao honkhat gaothu aseijuva, chule achunguva Samuel lamkaija ana ding amuphatnun, Saul sottol leho chunga chun Pathen lhagao ahung chun, amahon jong gaothu asei taove.
target: so he sent men to capture him. But when they saw a group of prophets prophesying, with Samuel standing there as their leader, the Spirit of God came on Saul’s men, and they also prophesied.

source: Chuin hichu Saul aseipeh phatnun, sottol dangho asolkitnin ahile, amahon jong chutima chun gaothu aseikit taove. Chuin Saul'in athumveina-a sottol leho asolkitnin ahileh, amahon jong gaothu aseiden kit taove.
target: Saul was told about it, and he sent more men, and they prophesied too. Saul sent men a third time, and they also prophesied.

source: Hichun amajong Ramah'a ahungin, Sechu'a um twikul lentah phung ahung lhungin, Samuel le David hoija umlhonnam? tin adongin ahi. Chuin mikhatnin, Vetan, Ramah gam Naioth mun'a aum lhone, ati.
target: Finally, he himself left for Ramah and went to the great cistern at Seku. And he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” “Over in Naioth at Ramah,” they said.

source: Chuin ama Ramah gam Naioth'a achen ahile, Pathen lhagao chu ama chunga jong achutan, Ramah gam Naioth alhun kahsen ache pumin gaothu aseipeh tan ahi.
target: So Saul went to Naioth at Ramah. But the Spirit of God came even on him, and he walked along prophesying until he came to Naioth.

source: Chuin aponjong ahohlhan, Samuel angsunga chun hitichun gaothu aseijin, chuche nikho nilhum le jankhovah-in asagoh-in alumin ahi. Hijeh chun amahon, Saul jong themgaoho lah-a panga hitam? atiuve.
target: He stripped off his garments, and he too prophesied in Samuel’s presence. He lay naked all that day and all that night. This is why people say, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”

source: Chuin David chu Ramah gam Naioth'a konin ajamin, Jonathan henga ahungin, ajah-a, Ipi kabol am? kakhan gitlouna ipi umam? chule napa anga kachonsetna ipi uma thadinga kahinkho hi aholham? ati.
target: Then David fled from Naioth at Ramah and went to Jonathan and asked, “What have I done? What is my crime? How have I wronged your father, that he is trying to kill me?”

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, Nathi ding chu Pathen'in jahda hen: ven kapan keima hetsah louvin, thil len hihen, thilneo hijongle bolponte. Achutile ipi dinga kapan hicheho chu kakoma a-im dingham? Chutiponte, ati.
target: “Never!” Jonathan replied. “You are not going to die! Look, my father doesn’t do anything, great or small, without letting me know. Why would he hide this from me? It isn’t so!”

source: Chuin David akihahsel kitleuvin, Namitmu-a lungsetna kachanhi napan chentah-in ahen; Jonathan'in hichehi hetda maihen, atiloule lungna getninte ati hinte. Ahinla hingjing Pakai le nangma mina pana kasei ahi, keima le thina kikah-a hi kalkhat sehbou uma ahi, ati.
target: But David took an oath and said, “Your father knows very well that I have found favor in your eyes, and he has said to himself, ‘Jonathan must not know this or he will be grieved.’ Yet as surely as the Lord lives and as you live, there is only a step between me and death.”

source: Hichun Jonathan'in David jah-a, Ipi hijongle nahinnan angaichat chanchu, nanga dinga kabolpeh ding nahi, ati.
target: Jonathan said to David, “Whatever you want me to do, I’ll do for you.”

source: Chuin David'in Jonathan jah-a, Ven jingkhu lhathah ni ahin, lengpa toh ankonga thonlouva katoukhom tei ngai ahi; ahinla anithum ni nilhah geija gamlah-a kaga kisel theinadin neisolin.
target: So David said, “Look, tomorrow is the New Moon feast, and I am supposed to dine with the king; but let me go and hide in the field until the evening of the day after tomorrow.

source: Napan eiholmona aumhela ahile, David'in akhopi Bethlehem'a gache vahdin kakoma phalna khohtah-in athumin ahi: ajehchu insung pumpi-a dinga kumtin ganlhai chukoma aneiju ahi, tin seijin ati.
target: If your father misses me at all, tell him, ‘David earnestly asked my permission to hurry to Bethlehem, his hometown, because an annual sacrifice is being made there for his whole clan.’

source: Hitia chu aman, Aphai atia ahile, nasohhi lungmona kanei ding; amavang hatah-a alung hana ahileh, thilse angaitoi ti hejengin.
target: If he says, ‘Very well,’ then your servant is safe. But if he loses his temper, you can be sure that he is determined to harm me.

source: Hijeh-a chu nasoh chunga hi hepina neitah-a na natoh ding ahi; ajehchu nasohhi Pakaiya kitepna naneipi ahitai. Hijeng jongle keima-a khangitlouna aumle, nangmatah in neithat jengin; ipi khoh-a napa henga neipui dingham? ati.
target: As for you, show kindness to your servant, for you have brought him into a covenant with you before the Lord . If I am guilty, then kill me yourself! Why hand me over to your father?”

source: Chuin Jonathan'in, Hichu nanga konin gamlahen: ajehchu kapan nachunga thilse bol agot kahet monga ahile, kahil louding ham? ati.
target: “Never!” Jonathan said. “If I had the least inkling that my father was determined to harm you, wouldn’t I tell you?”

source: Chuphatnin David'in Jonathan jah-a, Napan setah-in nadonbut tale, kon eihunghil dingham? ati.
target: David asked, “Who will tell me if your father answers you harshly?”

source: Chuin Jonathan'in David jah-a, Hungin, loujaova chehite, ati. Chuin amani loujao lama achedoh lhontan ahi.
target: “Come,” Jonathan said, “let’s go out into the field.” So they went there together.

source: Chuin Jonathan'in David jah-a, Pakai Israel Pathen chu ahetoh ahi! jing nikho, ahiloule nithum nikho hama kapa kadoh teng, David dinga apha ahia, chuteng nahenga mi kasol louva kahetsah louva ahile,
target: Then Jonathan said to David, “I swear by the Lord , the God of Israel, that I will surely sound out my father by this time the day after tomorrow! If he is favorably disposed toward you, will I not send you word and let you know?

source: Pakaiyin chutobang chun, chule akhohjo cheh-in Jonathan chunga boljenghen: ahinla nangma bolset dingchu kapa lunglhaina ahia ahile, lhamonga nachethei nadin nahetsah ingting, nasolmang nange. Chule kapa ana umpi bangchun Pakaiyin nangma naumpi hen.
target: But if my father intends to harm you, may the Lord deal with Jonathan, be it ever so severely, if I do not let you know and send you away in peace. May the Lord be with you as he has been with my father.

source: Chule kathilouna dinga kahinlai jenga Pakai phatna neimusah ding hilouvin;
target: But show me unfailing kindness like the Lord ’s kindness as long as I live, so that I may not be killed,

source: A-itih-a dinga ka-insunga kona naphatna nasat tanhel louding ahi. Pakaiyin David melmate aboncha leiset chunga asuhmanghel nung jongle sattanhih helin, ati.
target: and do not ever cut off your kindness from my family—not even when the Lord has cut off every one of David’s enemies from the face of the earth.”

source: Hitichun Jonathan'in David insung toh kitepna asemin, Pakaiyin David melmate chunga phu lahen, ati.
target: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, “May the Lord call David’s enemies to account.”

source: Chuin Jonathan'in angailut jeh-in, David chu akihahsel sah kitnin ahi. Ajehchu aman ama hinna angailut bang banga angailut ahi.
target: And Jonathan had David reaffirm his oath out of love for him, because he loved him as he loved himself.

source: Hichun Jonathan'in David jah-a, Jing nikho khu lhathah ni ahin; natouna a-on ding jeh-a nakiholmo ding ahi.
target: Then Jonathan said to David, “Tomorrow is the New Moon feast. You will be missed, because your seat will be empty.

source: Chule nithum naum nungteng, nachesuh loija thukhoh aumtengle nakisel jina mun mama-a chu nahung ding, Ezel song panga chu na-umden ding ahi.
target: The day after tomorrow, toward evening, go to the place where you hid when this trouble began, and wait by the stone Ezel.

source: Chule keiman doikhat neibanga thalchang thum hiche panga chu kahinkap ding ahi.
target: I will shoot three arrows to the side of it, as though I were shooting at a target.

source: Chule ven, chapang khat kahinsol ding, Chenlang thalchang ho khu gaholdoh-in, katiding ahi. Chule chapang henga chu, Ven, thalchang ho chu nasih hilam panga aume, hinlan kati-a ahile, hung jengin. Ajehchu Pakai hingjing mina kasei ahi, nangma dingin lungmona aumin, setna aumpoi.
target: Then I will send a boy and say, ‘Go, find the arrows.’ If I say to him, ‘Look, the arrows are on this side of you; bring them here,’ then come, because, as surely as the Lord lives, you are safe; there is no danger.

source: Ahinla gollhangpa jah-a chu, Ven, thalchang ho chu nakhel lama aume, kati-a ahile; nalampi-a che jengin: ajehchu Pakaiyin nasolmang ahi.
target: But if I say to the boy, ‘Look, the arrows are beyond you,’ then you must go, because the Lord has sent you away.

source: Chule nang le kei kikah-a iseidohho jouse chunga chun, ven, Pakai chu nang le kei kikah-a a-itih-in umjing hen, ati.
target: And about the matter you and I discussed—remember, the Lord is witness between you and me forever.”

source: Chuti chun David amale ama gamlah-a akiselin: chuin lhathah nikho ahunglhun phatnin, lengpa chu an nedin atou lhatan ahi.
target: So David hid in the field, and when the New Moon feast came, the king sat down to eat.

source: Chuin lengpa phat dangho bangin atouna chunga atouvin, bangpanga touna-a chun atouve: chuin Jonathan akipatdoh-in, chule Abner chu Saul panga atouvin, David munchu a-ongtan ahi.
target: He sat in his customary place by the wall, opposite Jonathan, and Abner sat next to Saul, but David’s place was empty.

source: Ahivangin Saul'in hicheni chun imacha aseipoi: ajeh chu aman, Achunga thilkhat tou soh-a thenglou hinte; thonlouva ama thenglou hinte, tia angaito ahi.
target: Saul said nothing that day, for he thought, “Something must have happened to David to make him ceremonially unclean—surely he is unclean.”

source: Chuin ajingin ahitin ahi, hichu chuche lha nini channi ahin, David munchu a-ongkit tai. Chuin Saul'in achapa Jonathan jah-a, Jesse chapa chu janhi-a jong, tunia jong ibola hunglou ham? ati.
target: But the next day, the second day of the month, David’s place was empty again. Then Saul said to his son Jonathan, “Why hasn’t the son of Jesse come to the meal, either yesterday or today?”

source: Chuin Jonathan'in Saul adonbutnin, David'in Bethlehem'a chenadin hatah-in kakoma phalna athumin:
target: Jonathan answered, “David earnestly asked me for permission to go to Bethlehem.

source: Katao ahi, neiche sah-in: ajehchu ka insung miten khopi sunga ganlhaina kaneidiu ahin; chule kasopipan chua umdin eithupeh-in ahi: chule tun, namitmu-a lungsetna kachana ahile, katao ahi, neichesah inlang kasopite gamunge, atin ahi. Hijeh-a chu lengpa dokhanga hunglou ahi, ati.
target: He said, ‘Let me go, because our family is observing a sacrifice in the town and my brother has ordered me to be there. If I have found favor in your eyes, let me get away to see my brothers.’ That is why he has not come to the king’s table.”

source: Chuphatnin Jonathan chunga Saul lunghana chu akoujah tan, ajah-a, Nang numei vahvei le golkeh chapa, nangman nangmatah jachat nadingle nanu sagohkeu jachatsah nadinga Jesse chapa chu nalhen ahi kahetlouva nabolham?
target: Saul’s anger flared up at Jonathan and he said to him, “You son of a perverse and rebellious woman! Don’t I know that you have sided with the son of Jesse to your own shame and to the shame of the mother who bore you?

source: Ajehchu Jesse chapa leiset chunga ahinlaisea nangma le nalenggam kiphutdet louding ahi. Hijeh chun tun kahenga din mi gakousah-in, ajehchu ama thiteiding ahi, ati.
target: As long as the son of Jesse lives on this earth, neither you nor your kingdom will be established. Now send someone to bring him to me, for he must die!”

source: Chuin Jonathan'in apa Saul adonbutnin, ajah-a, Ipi dinga ama kithat dingham? aman ipi abolem? ati.
target: “Why should he be put to death? What has he done?” Jonathan asked his father.

source: Chuin Saul'in thadingin teng khatnin akhon ahi. Hichea konchun Jonathan'in apan David thading agotmong ahichu ahetai.
target: But Saul hurled his spear at him to kill him. Then Jonathan knew that his father intended to kill David.

source: Hitichun Jonathan chu dokhanga konchun lunghang tah-in akipatdoh-in, chuche lha anini nichun an anetapoi. Ajehchu apan ajachatsah behseh jehchun, David chu alungkhampin ahi.
target: Jonathan got up from the table in fierce anger; on that second day of the feast he did not eat, because he was grieved at his father’s shameful treatment of David.

source: Chuin Jingkah-in ahitin ahi, David toh akitep phat tah chun Jonathan chu chapang khat toh apotdoh-in, loujaova chun achetai.
target: In the morning Jonathan went out to the field for his meeting with David. He had a small boy with him,

source: Chuin aman achapangpa jah-a, Lhaijinlang kathalchang kap ho chu gaholdoh-in atin. Chuin chapangpa chu alhai tolhonin, thalchang khat akal lama chun agah kapmin ahi.
target: and he said to the boy, “Run and find the arrows I shoot.” As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

source: Chuin chapangpa chun Jonathan'in akapdoh thalchang phung aphah phatnin, Jonathan'in chapangpa jah-a, Thalchang chu nakal peh-a uma hilouham? tin asame.
target: When the boy came to the place where Jonathan’s arrow had fallen, Jonathan called out after him, “Isn’t the arrow beyond you?”

source: Chuin Jonathan'in chapang chu asamin, Kikinnon, gangin, umden hih-in, ati. Chuin Jonathan chapangpa chun thalchang ho chu achom khomin, apu henga ahungtai.
target: Then he shouted, “Hurry! Go quickly! Don’t stop!” The boy picked up the arrow and returned to his master.

source: Ahin chapang pa chun imacha ahepon: Jonathan le David'in bou thil kibolchu ahelhone.
target: (The boy knew nothing about all this; only Jonathan and David knew.)

source: Chuin Jonathan'in amanchahho chapangpa apen, ajah-a, Chenlang khopi-a anapo lutan, ati.
target: Then Jonathan gave his weapons to the boy and said, “Go, carry them back to town.”

source: Chuin chapangpa achedoh doh-in, David lhanglama munkhatna konin ahung kipatdoh-in, amai tolla asulutnin, thumvei akunin ahi. Chuin khatle khat akichopto lhonin, David'in alhakang kahse chun hatah-in akika lhontan ahi.
target: After the boy had gone, David got up from the south side of the stone and bowed down before Jonathan three times, with his face to the ground. Then they kissed each other and wept together—but David wept the most.

source: Chuin Jonathan'in David henga, Lung mongin chetan, ajehchu ini-a Pakai mina ikihahsela, Pakai chu kei le nang kah-a, chule kei chilhahle nang chilhah ho kah-a a-itih-in ahetoh hijing tahen tia inasei ahitai, ati. Chuin ama akipatdoh-in achetai. Chule Jonathan jong khopi sunga alut tan ahi.
target: Jonathan said to David, “Go in peace, for we have sworn friendship with each other in the name of the Lord , saying, ‘The Lord is witness between you and me, and between your descendants and my descendants forever.’ ” Then David left, and Jonathan went back to the town.

source: Chujouvin David Ahimelech thempu henga Nob'a ahungin ahi. Chule David to akimuto chu Ahimelech akichan, ajah-a, Ipidinga nachangseh nahi hija, koimatoh kilhonlou nahim? ati.
target: David went to Nob, to Ahimelek the priest. Ahimelek trembled when he met him, and asked, “Why are you alone? Why is no one with you?”

source: Chuin David'in Ahimelech thempu jah-a, Lengpan kinkhatna eisola, kajah-a, Keiman kasolna thudol le kathupeh hi koimacha hetsah hih-in, ati ahi. Chule keiman kasohte hilai khulai mun'a chu kasol ahi.
target: David answered Ahimelek the priest, “The king sent me on a mission and said to me, ‘No one is to know anything about the mission I am sending you on.’ As for my men, I have told them to meet me at a certain place.

source: Hijeh chun tun nakhutna ipi umam? kakhutna changlhah nga ahiloule nakoma um umchu neipen, ati.
target: Now then, what do you have on hand? Give me five loaves of bread, or whatever you can find.”

source: Chuin thempu pan David adonbutnin, Kakhutna changlhah lham aumpon, changlhah thengbou aume; gollhangho chu numeija kon beh-a akichintup uva ahile, ati.
target: But the priest answered David, “I don’t have any ordinary bread on hand; however, there is some consecrated bread here—provided the men have kept themselves from women.”

source: Chuin David'in thempu pa chu adonbutnin, ajah-a, Atahbeh-in kahunga pat nithum tobang keiho-a kona numei ho kichomkoi ahin, chule gollhangho belho hi athenga ahi, chule changlhah chu tunia belsunga kisutheng hijongle, gelkhatna alham ahi ati.
target: David replied, “Indeed women have been kept from us, as usual whenever I set out. The men’s bodies are holy even on missions that are not holy. How much more so today!”

source: Hitichun thempupan changlhah theng chu apetai; ajehchu khat akilahdoh tengle changlhah sapeh akhela koidinga Pakai angsunga kona kiladoh vetsahna changlhah tailou changlhah ding umlou ahi.
target: So the priest gave him the consecrated bread, since there was no bread there except the bread of the Presence that had been removed from before the Lord and replaced by hot bread on the day it was taken away.

source: Tun hicheni chun Saul sohte khat hia chun Pakai anga anakihenin; aminchu Doeg ahin, Edom mi Saul ganchingho lah-a apipuipen ahi.
target: Now one of Saul’s servants was there that day, detained before the Lord ; he was Doeg the Edomite, Saul’s chief shepherd.

source: Chuin David'in Ahimelech henga, Nakhutna tengcha ahiloule chemjam umlou ham? ajehchu lengpa thuchu thukin ahijeh-in kachemjam le kagal manchah kahin poman tapoi, ati.
target: David asked Ahimelek, “Don’t you have a spear or a sword here? I haven’t brought my sword or any other weapon, because the king’s mission was urgent.”

source: Chuin thempu pan, Ven, Elah phaichama natha Philistine mipa Goliath chemjam chu hia thempu sangkhol nunga ponin akijelin aume: nadeile hichu kilah-in; ajehchu hiche tailou chu adang aumpoi, ati. Chuin David'in, Chekal lhah chu umding ham; neipe jengin, ati.
target: The priest replied, “The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the Valley of Elah, is here; it is wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you want it, take it; there is no sword here but that one.” David said, “There is none like it; give it to me.”

source: Chuin David akipatdoh-in, hicheni chun Saul ginna in ajamin, Gath lengpa Achish henga chetai.
target: That day David fled from Saul and went to Achish king of Gath.

source: Chuin Achish sohten ajah-a, Hichehi chuche gam lengpa David hilouham? Mihon achung changa lampuma khat le khat kidonbut to-a la asah uva, Saul'in sangkhat athatnin, David'in sangsom athatne, atiuchu hilouham? atiuve.
target: But the servants of Achish said to him, “Isn’t this David, the king of the land? Isn’t he the one they sing about in their dances: “ ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands’?”

source: Chuin Davidn'in thuhochu alungsunga aching pai jengin, Gath lengpa Achish chu akicha lheh jengtan ahi.
target: David took these words to heart and was very much afraid of Achish king of Gath.

source: Hitichun amasanguva achondan khelin, amitnuva chun akingolsah-in, kotpi kotkhah ho ajihpol letlut in, akhamul achun achilche akaisah dehduh-in ahi.
target: So he pretended to be insane in their presence; and while he was in their hands he acted like a madman, making marks on the doors of the gate and letting saliva run down his beard.

source: Chujouvin Achish'in asohte jah-a, Veuvin, mingol ahi henasa ibola kahenga nahin pui uham?
target: Achish said to his servants, “Look at the man! He is insane! Why bring him to me?

source: Mingol kangaichat hija, ka-angsunga angolna-a kichem dinga hitobang mihi nahin pui uham? Hitobang miho ka-insunga hunglut diham? ati.
target: Am I so short of madmen that you have to bring this fellow here to carry on like this in front of me? Must this man come into my house?”

source: Hijeh chun chua konchun David apotdoh-in, Adullam songkoa akiselin; asopitele apa insung mijousen ajah phatnun ahenga achesuh-un ahi.
target: David left Gath and escaped to the cave of Adullam. When his brothers and his father’s household heard about it, they went down to him there.

source: Chuin alung genthei jouse, leiba neijouse, chule lunglhailouna neijouse ahenga ahung kikhomun; amaho chunga chun ama gal lamkaijin apangin: chule ama toh umkhoma chu mi jali tobang ahiuve.
target: All those who were in distress or in debt or discontented gathered around him, and he became their commander. About four hundred men were with him.

source: Chuin David chua konin Moab gam Mizpeh'a achetan: chule Moab lengpa jah-a, Pathen'in kachunga ipi abolding ahi kahet masangsen, nahenga katao ahi, kanule kapa aumna-a hung dohhen lang nangma toh umkhom hen, ati.
target: From there David went to Mizpah in Moab and said to the king of Moab, “Would you let my father and mother come and stay with you until I learn what God will do for me?”

source: Chuin aman amani Moab lengpa anga apuijin; chule David songkoa aumlaisen amato acheng khomun ahi.
target: So he left them with the king of Moab, and they stayed with him as long as David was in the stronghold.

source: Chuin Gad themgaovin David henga, songko sunga chun umden hih-in; potdoh-in, Judah gamsunga chen, ati. Chuin David apotdoh-in, Hareth gammanga alut tan ahi.
target: But the prophet Gad said to David, “Do not stay in the stronghold. Go into the land of Judah.” So David left and went to the forest of Hereth.

source: Saul'in David le aumpi miho chu akimu dohtai ti ajah phatnin, (tun Saul chu Gibeah gam Ramah kho-a thingphung khat noija aumin, akhutna tengcha akichoijin, akimvela asohte jouse adingun ahi;)
target: Now Saul heard that David and his men had been discovered. And Saul was seated, spear in hand, under the tamarisk tree on the hill at Gibeah, with all his officials standing at his side.

source: Chuin Saul'in avella ding asohte jah-a chun, Tun nangho Benjamin miten ngaijun; Jesse chapa chun nangho amitakip lou le lengpi honho napeh cheh uva, sangkhat chunga gallamkai le jakhat chunga gal lamkaija napansah cheh dingu hija;
target: He said to them, “Listen, men of Benjamin! Will the son of Jesse give all of you fields and vineyards? Will he make all of you commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds?

source: Nabon uva keima douna galguh nabol uva, chule kachapan Jesse chapa toh kitepna anei lam eihetsah-a khatcha naum daova, keima dinga lungkham khatcha naum daova, chule tunia banga hi kachapan kasohpa keima douna-a eichanglhi dinga atildoh jonghi eihila koima umlou nahiuvem? ati.
target: Is that why you have all conspired against me? No one tells me when my son makes a covenant with the son of Jesse. None of you is concerned about me or tells me that my son has incited my servant to lie in wait for me, as he does today.”

source: Chujouvin Saul sohte chunga lamkaija kitung Edom mi Doeg chun adonbutnin, Nob'a Ahitub chapa Ahimelech henga Jesse chapa ahung kamui.
target: But Doeg the Edomite, who was standing with Saul’s officials, said, “I saw the son of Jesse come to Ahimelek son of Ahitub at Nob.

source: Chule aman amadin Pakai adohpeh-in, nehding ho apen, chule Philistine mipa Goliath chemjam jong apei, ati.
target: Ahimelek inquired of the Lord for him; he also gave him provisions and the sword of Goliath the Philistine.”

source: Chuphatnin aman Ahitub chapa Ahimelech thempupa le apa insungmi Nob'a um thempuho jouse koudin mi asolin ahi. Chuin amaho abonun lengpa henga ahunguvin ahi.
target: Then the king sent for the priest Ahimelek son of Ahitub and all the men of his family, who were the priests at Nob, and they all came to the king.

source: Chuin Saul'in, Tun nangma Ahitub chapa, ngaijin, ati. Chuin aman, Ka pakai hikoma kaume, ati.
target: Saul said, “Listen now, son of Ahitub.” “Yes, my lord,” he answered.

source: Chuin Saul'in ajah-a, Tunia banga hi nangma le Jesse chapan ibola keima douna-a galguh nabol lhona, keima douna-a kipatna eichanglhi dinga nangman amachu changlhah le chemjam napeh-a, Pakai nadoh peh ham? ati.
target: Saul said to him, “Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, giving him bread and a sword and inquiring of God for him, so that he has rebelled against me and lies in wait for me, as he does today?”

source: Chuin Ahimelech'in lengpa chu adonbutnin, Lengpa tupa hija, nasolna chana chea, na-insunga ja-umtah David tobanghi nasohte jouse lah-a koi umam?
target: Ahimelek answered the king, “Who of all your servants is as loyal as David, the king’s son-in-law, captain of your bodyguard and highly respected in your household?

source: Achutile ama dinga Pathen dohpeh chu kakipatbep ham? hichu keija konin gamlahen: lengpan nasohpa hi le kapa insung mite jousehi imachan mo neichan hihbeh-un; ajehchu hicheho jouse thudol hi nasohpan alhom hihen atam hileh imacha kahepoi, ati.
target: Was that day the first time I inquired of God for him? Of course not! Let not the king accuse your servant or any of his father’s family, for your servant knows nothing at all about this whole affair.”

source: Chuin lengpan, Ahimelech nangma le napa insung mite jouse nathi teidingu ahi, ati.
target: But the king said, “You will surely die, Ahimelek, you and your whole family.”

source: Chuin lengpan akoma ding keng sepaiho henga, Kiheijun lang Pakai thempuho chu David toh akikhut jop jeh ule, amahon ajampet ahetnuva keima eihetsahlou jeh-un thatnun, ati. Ahinla Pakai thempuho chunga akhutnu lha dingchu lengpa sohte anompouve.
target: Then the king ordered the guards at his side: “Turn and kill the priests of the Lord , because they too have sided with David. They knew he was fleeing, yet they did not tell me.” But the king’s officials were unwilling to raise a hand to strike the priests of the Lord .

source: Chuin lengpan Doeg henga, Nangma kiheijin lang thempuho chungachun chun, ati. Chuin Edom mi Doeg chu akiheijin, thempuho chunga achun, hiche nikho chun tupat ponnem thempu sangkhol kivon mi somget le nga athatnin ahi.
target: The king then ordered Doeg, “You turn and strike down the priests.” So Doeg the Edomite turned and struck them down. That day he killed eighty-five men who wore the linen ephod.

source: Chuin thempuho khopi Nob chu chemjamin asatnin, pasal le numei, chapang le noichep laiho, bongchal, sangan, chule kelngoiho chemjamin athat gamin ahi.
target: He also put to the sword Nob, the town of the priests, with its men and women, its children and infants, and its cattle, donkeys and sheep.

source: Chuin Ahitub chapa Ahimelech chapate lah-a khat amin Abiathar chu asohchan, David henga ajamin ahi.
target: But one son of Ahimelek son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled to join David.

source: Chuin Saul'in Pakai thempuho atha chu Abiathar'in David ahetsah tan ahi.
target: He told David that Saul had killed the priests of the Lord .

source: Chuin David'in Abiathar jah-a, Chuche ni-a Edom mi Doeg chua anauma chu Saul ahetsah teiding chu kahet ahitai: napa insung mite jouse chu keijeh-a thia ahitaove.
target: Then David said to Abiathar, “That day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, I knew he would be sure to tell Saul. I am responsible for the death of your whole family.

source: Nangma kahenga ummin lang, kicha hih-in: ajehchu keima thadinga eiholpa chun nang jong thadinga nahol ahi. Keitoh na-umle vang nahoidoh ding ahi, ati.
target: Stay with me; don’t be afraid. The man who wants to kill you is trying to kill me too. You will be safe with me.”

source: Chujouvin amahon David jah-a, Ven Philistine ten Keilah asatnun, changphol ho achomun ahi, atiuve.
target: When David was told, “Look, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah and are looting the threshing floors,”

source: Hijeh chun David'in Pakai adongin, Kache-a Philistine te khu kagasat dingham? ati. Chuin Pakaiyin David jah-a, Chen, Philistine te gasatnin lang, Keilah gahuhdoh-in, ati.
target: he inquired of the Lord , saying, “Shall I go and attack these Philistines?” The Lord answered him, “Go, attack the Philistines and save Keilah.”

source: Chuin David loihon ajah-a, Ven, hikom Judah gama bon kikicha-a, Keilah'a ihunguva, Philistine galsat miho igadou diuchu iti kichat umjocheh ding hitam? atiuve.
target: But David’s men said to him, “Here in Judah we are afraid. How much more, then, if we go to Keilah against the Philistine forces!”

source: Hichun David'in Pakai adong kitnin ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin adonbutnin, Kipatdoh-in lang Keilah'a chesuh-in; ajehchu Philistine te chu nakhutna kapehdoh ding ahi, ati.
target: Once again David inquired of the Lord , and the Lord answered him, “Go down to Keilah, for I am going to give the Philistines into your hand.”

source: Hitichun David le aloite Keilah-a acheuvin, Philistine te chutoh akisatnun, agancha hou ahin pui mangun, amaho chu nasatah-in athatnun ahi. Hitichun David'in Keilah miho chu ahuhdoh tan ahi.
target: So David and his men went to Keilah, fought the Philistines and carried off their livestock. He inflicted heavy losses on the Philistines and saved the people of Keilah.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Ahimelech chapa Abiathar chu David henga Keilah lama ajam phatnin, aman akhutna thempu sangkhol khat ahinchoijin ahi.
target: (Now Abiathar son of Ahimelek had brought the ephod down with him when he fled to David at Keilah.)

source: Chuin David Keilah'a ahungchu Saul henga aseipeh taovin ahi. Chuin Saul'in, Pathen'in ama kakhutna eipehdoh ahitai; ajehchu khopi kulkotpi le kotjol nei alutna chu, ama kikam khum ahitai, ati.
target: Saul was told that David had gone to Keilah, and he said, “God has delivered him into my hands, for David has imprisoned himself by entering a town with gates and bars.”

source: Chuin Saul'in mijouse chu galsat ding, Keilah'a chesuh-a David le aloite umchah din akoukhom tan ahi.
target: And Saul called up all his forces for battle, to go down to Keilah to besiege David and his men.

source: Chule David'in guhthima Saul'in ama chunga doha abolchu ahen; Abiathar thempu henga chun, Thempu sangkhol chu hinchoi jin, ati.
target: When David learned that Saul was plotting against him, he said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring the ephod.”

source: Hichun David'in, Vo Pakai Israel Pathen, keijeh-a Keilah khopi suse dingin Saul ahung suh-e ti kichentah in kajatai.
target: David said, “ Lord , God of Israel, your servant has heard definitely that Saul plans to come to Keilah and destroy the town on account of me.

source: Keilah mihon akhutna eipehdoh diu ham? nasoh-in kajah banga hi Saul hungsuh ding ham? Vo Pakai Israel Pathen, katao ahi, nasoh hi neihet sah-in, ati. Chuin Pakaiyin, Hungsuh ding ahi, ati.
target: Will the citizens of Keilah surrender me to him? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? Lord , God of Israel, tell your servant.” And the Lord said, “He will.”

source: Hichun David'in, Keilah miten keima le kamitehi Saul khutna eipeh doh dingu ham? ati. Chuin Pakaiyin, Amahon napehdoh dingu ahi, ati.
target: Again David asked, “Will the citizens of Keilah surrender me and my men to Saul?” And the Lord said, “They will.”

source: Chuphatnin David le aloiho mi jagup tobang chu akipatnun, Keilah chu adalhaovin, achetheinao lamcheh-a achetauve. Chuin David chu Keilah'a konin ajamdoh tai tichu Saul aseipeh taovin; chule aman amaho kondoh dingchu ajahda tan ahi.
target: So David and his men, about six hundred in number, left Keilah and kept moving from place to place. When Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah, he did not go there.

source: Chuin David chu gamthipma mundet tah khatna aumin, Ziph gamthip lhang khatna aumden tan ahi. Chule Saul'in aniseh-in aholin, ahivangin Pathen'in akhutna apedoh pon ahi.
target: David stayed in the wilderness strongholds and in the hills of the Desert of Ziph. Day after day Saul searched for him, but God did not give David into his hands.

source: Chuin Saul chu ama that dingin ahung kondoh-e ti chu David'in amutan: chule David chu Ziph gamthip gammanga uma ahi.
target: While David was at Horesh in the Desert of Ziph, he learned that Saul had come out to take his life.

source: Chuin Saul chapa Jonathan akipatnin, David umna gammanga chun achen, Pathen'a akhut tha agahatsah-in ahi.
target: And Saul’s son Jonathan went to David at Horesh and helped him find strength in God.

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, Kicha hih-in: ajehchu kapa Saul khutnin namaidoh louhel ding ahi; nangma Israel chunga leng changding nahin, keima nabantah-a kahi ding ahi; chule hichu kapa Saul'in ahet ahi, ati.
target: “Don’t be afraid,” he said. “My father Saul will not lay a hand on you. You will be king over Israel, and I will be second to you. Even my father Saul knows this.”

source: Chuin amanin Pakai angsunga kitepna aneilhonin ahi: chuin David gammanga aumin, Jonathan chu a-in'a achetai.
target: The two of them made a covenant before the Lord . Then Jonathan went home, but David remained at Horesh.

source: Chujouvin Ziph miho chu Gibeah mun'a Saul henga ahungun, ajah-a, Jeshimon lhanglama um Hachelah lhang gammang lah mun dettah khatna David chu keiho toh kisela hilouham?
target: The Ziphites went up to Saul at Gibeah and said, “Is not David hiding among us in the strongholds at Horesh, on the hill of Hakilah, south of Jeshimon?

source: Hijeh chun, vo lengpa, nalungin hungsuh ding anangaichat dungjuijin hungsuhtan; chule keiho mopohna chu lengpa khutna pehdoh dingchu hiding ahi, atiuve.
target: Now, Your Majesty, come down whenever it pleases you to do so, and we will be responsible for giving him into your hands.”

source: Chuin Saul'in, Nangho Pakaiya phattheiboh chang hiuvin; ajehchu nanghon keima neilainat piuvin ahi.
target: Saul replied, “The Lord bless you for your concern for me.

source: Cheovin, naheng uva katao ahi, gakhol toh-un, hilai mun'a chu kon amu ham akiselna mun gaveovin lang gahetoh-un; ajehchu ama doha thuhtah ahi ti eikisei peh-e.
target: Go and get more information. Find out where David usually goes and who has seen him there. They tell me he is very crafty.

source: Hijeh chun akiselguhna mun jouse chu gahetoh-un, chule adihchet chu nahet tengule kahenga hung kitnun, chutengle keima nangho toh kalhon ding ahi. Chule hung hitiding ahi, ama gamsunga um ahi pouva ahile, Judah mi asang asang lah-a chu kaholdoh ding ahi, ati.
target: Find out about all the hiding places he uses and come back to me with definite information. Then I will go with you; if he is in the area, I will track him down among all the clans of Judah.”

source: Chuin amaho akipat doh-un, Saul angsunga konin Ziph gama ache taovin ahi: ahin David le aloiho chu Jeshimon lhanglam phaichama um Maon gamthipma aumuvin ahi.
target: So they set out and went to Ziph ahead of Saul. Now David and his men were in the Desert of Maon, in the Arabah south of Jeshimon.

source: Saul le amite jong ama holin acheuvin ahi. Chuin amahon David aseipeh-un: hijeh chun ama songpi khat sunga ahung lutnin, Maon gamthipma aumtan ahi. Saul'in hichu ajah phatnin, David chu Maon gamthipma ahin nungdel tan ahi.
target: Saul and his men began the search, and when David was told about it, he went down to the rock and stayed in the Desert of Maon. When Saul heard this, he went into the Desert of Maon in pursuit of David.

source: Chuin Saul molpang hilam sanga achen, David le aloiho molpang khulam sanga acheuvin; chule David'in Saul ginna jammang loiding agon ahi: ajehchu Saul le aloihon David le amite chu matdinga a-umkolu ahitai.
target: Saul was going along one side of the mountain, and David and his men were on the other side, hurrying to get away from Saul. As Saul and his forces were closing in on David and his men to capture them,

source: Ahinla Saul henga thupole khat ahungin, ajah-a, Kinonlang hungin; ajehchu Philistine ten gamsunga gal ahinbol taove, tin ahungseijin ahi.
target: a messenger came to Saul, saying, “Come quickly! The Philistines are raiding the land.”

source: Hijeh chun David nung adelna-a konin Saul akinunglen, Philistine te satdin achetai. Hijeh chun hiche mun chu Sela-hammah-lekoth asah taovin ahi.
target: Then Saul broke off his pursuit of David and went to meet the Philistines. That is why they call this place Sela Hammahlekoth.

source: Chuin David chua konchun achetouvin, Engedi mun dettah sunga achengtai.
target: And David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Philistine te nung adelna-a kon Saul ahungkile phatnin, ahenga, Ven, Engedi gamthipma David aume tin aseipeh-un ahi.
target: After Saul returned from pursuing the Philistines, he was told, “David is in the Desert of En Gedi.”

source: Hichun Saul'in Israelte jouse lah-a kona kilhengdoh mi sangthum akipuijin, David le amite chu gamkel ho umna songko dung holdin achetaovin ahi.
target: So Saul took three thousand able young men from all Israel and set out to look for David and his men near the Crags of the Wild Goats.

source: Chuin lamdunga kelngoi kotphung songko umna khatna ahungin; chule Saul chu kicholdo dingin alutnin ahi: David le aloiho chu songko sungnung lama chu uma ahiuve.
target: He came to the sheep pens along the way; a cave was there, and Saul went in to relieve himself. David and his men were far back in the cave.

source: Chuin David loihon ajah-a, Vetan, Pakaiyin nahenga, Ven, namelmate nakhutna kapehdoh ding ahi, nangman phante nati bang banga achunguva nabol ding ahi, tia asei nikho chu tuni ahi, atiuve. Chuin David akipatdoh-in, Saul sangkhol chol mong chu achelhah pehtan ahi.
target: The men said, “This is the day the Lord spoke of when he said to you, ‘I will give your enemy into your hands for you to deal with as you wish.’ ” Then David crept up unnoticed and cut off a corner of Saul’s robe.

source: Chuin chuche jouvin ahitin ahi, aman Saul sangkhol chol monglha achelhah jehchun David'in alungthimin phamo asalheh jengtan ahi.
target: Afterward, David was conscience-stricken for having cut off a corner of his robe.

source: Chuin aman aloiho jah-a, Pakai thaonu kapu chunga kakhut kalapma, thaonu ahi ti henasasa hitobang kabolding chu Pakaiyin aphalpoi, ati.
target: He said to his men, “The Lord forbid that I should do such a thing to my master, the Lord ’s anointed, or lay my hand on him; for he is the anointed of the Lord .”

source: Chuti chun David'in asohte chu hiche thua hin asutangin, Saul chunga akhut analha sahpon ahi. Ahinla Saul chu songkoa konin ahungdoh-in, alamjot ban ajomkit tai.
target: With these words David sharply rebuked his men and did not allow them to attack Saul. And Saul left the cave and went his way.

source: Chujouvin David jong akipatnin, songkoa konin apotdoh-in, Saul jah-a, Kapu lengpa tin agah samin ahi. Chuin Saul'in nunglam ahinven ahile, David akunin tolla aboh khupmin ahi.
target: Then David went out of the cave and called out to Saul, “My lord the king!” When Saul looked behind him, David bowed down and prostrated himself with his face to the ground.

source: Chuin David'in Saul jah-a, Ibola miho thusei, ven David'in suhsetdin nahole atiuchu nangaiham?
target: He said to Saul, “Why do you listen when men say, ‘David is bent on harming you’?

source: Ven, tunia hi Pakaiyin songko sunga chu itobanga kakhutna eipehdoh hitam ti namit tah-in namutai. Mi phabepmin nangma thatdin eisolun; ahin, Keiman kapu chunga kakhut lhaponge, ajehchu ama Pathen thaonu ahi, tin kamitmun kahing hoijin ahi.
target: This day you have seen with your own eyes how the Lord delivered you into my hands in the cave. Some urged me to kill you, but I spared you; I said, ‘I will not lay my hand on my lord, because he is the Lord ’s anointed.’

source: Chukal valin, kapa, ven, kakhutna um napon chol mong kachetanhi ven: ajehchu naponchol kache lhah-a nangma katha louva konhin kakhutna gitlouna le khelna aumpon, nangma dounan kachonsepoi ti namun, nahen ahi. Ahinla nangin kei hinkho lahdin neidel lelen ahi.
target: See, my father, look at this piece of your robe in my hand! I cut off the corner of your robe but did not kill you. See that there is nothing in my hand to indicate that I am guilty of wrongdoing or rebellion. I have not wronged you, but you are hunting me down to take my life.

source: Keima le nangma kah-a Pakaiyin thu tanhen lang, Pakaiyin naphu kachunga lamaihen; amavang kakhut hi nachunga chulou ding ahi.
target: May the Lord judge between you and me. And may the Lord avenge the wrongs you have done to me, but my hand will not touch you.

source: Gollui thuchih-a kisei bangin, Migilouva konin gitlouna asohdoh-e, akiti: keima vang kakhut nachunga lhaponge.
target: As the old saying goes, ‘From evildoers come evil deeds,’ so my hand will not touch you.

source: Israelte lengpa hi koi nung dela hung doh ham? nangman koinung nadel ham? uithisa khat nungle uili khat nungbou ahi.
target: “Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Who are you pursuing? A dead dog? A flea?

source: Hijeh chun Pakai chu thutan hihen lang kei le nang kah-a thu tanhen, chule hinve hen, hin kholtoh henlang, nakhutna kona eihuhdoh hen, ati.
target: May the Lord be our judge and decide between us. May he consider my cause and uphold it; may he vindicate me by delivering me from your hand.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, David'in Saul jah-a hiche thuho hi aseijou phatnin, Saul'in, Kachapa David, hichehi nangma aw hija ham? ati. Chuin Saul hakan akaptai.
target: When David finished saying this, Saul asked, “Is that your voice, David my son?” And he wept aloud.

source: Chuin aman David jah-a, nangma keisangin nachonphajoi: ajehchu nangman apha jenga bou neilethuh-in, keiman vang ase jenga bou kalethuh-e.
target: “You are more righteous than I,” he said. “You have treated me well, but I have treated you badly.

source: Chule tunin nangman neiboldan neimusah tai: ajehchu Pakaiyin nakhutna einapeh jengin jong, nangman neithat poi.
target: You have just now told me about the good you did to me; the Lord delivered me into your hands, but you did not kill me.

source: Ajehchu min amelma amule bitkeicha lampia achemangsah dingham? Hijeh chun tunia kahenga nathilbol jehhin Pakaiyin thilphan nalethuh hen.
target: When a man finds his enemy, does he let him get away unharmed? May the Lord reward you well for the way you treated me today.

source: Chule ven, tun thonlouva nangma leng nahung hia, Israel lenggam hi nakhutna kitungdoh ding ahi, ti kichen tah-in kahetai.
target: I know that you will surely be king and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hands.

source: Hijeh chun tun kahenga, kanung tengle kachilhah te nasuhbeilou nading le, kapate insunga kona kamin nasuhmang louna dingin Pakaiya kihahsel in, ati.
target: Now swear to me by the Lord that you will not kill off my descendants or wipe out my name from my father’s family.”

source: Chuin David Saul henga akihahsel tan ahi. Chuin Saul a-in'a achetan; David le amite vang aumnao mun'a achetou taovin ahi.
target: So David gave his oath to Saul. Then Saul returned home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.

source: Chuin Samuel athitan; Israelte jouse akikhom khomun, alunghem piuvin, a-in mun Ramah'a avui taovin ahi. Chuin David akipatnin Paran gamthipma achesuhtai.
target: Now Samuel died, and all Israel assembled and mourned for him; and they buried him at his home in Ramah. Then David moved down into the Desert of Paran.

source: Chuin Moan kho-a chun Carmel'a anei agouho uma mikhat aumin; chule mipa chu ahao lheh jengin, kelngoi sangthum le kelcha sangkhat aneijin ahi. Chuin aman Carmel'a akelngoi mul avouvin ahi.
target: A certain man in Maon, who had property there at Carmel, was very wealthy. He had a thousand goats and three thousand sheep, which he was shearing in Carmel.

source: Tun mipa minchu Nabal ahin, a-inneipi minchu Abigail ahi. Chule amanu chu numei lungching tah le melhoitah ahin: hinla mipa vang chu umje helou le gilou tah-a natong ahi: chule ama Caleb insungmi ahi.
target: His name was Nabal and his wife’s name was Abigail. She was an intelligent and beautiful woman, but her husband was surly and mean in his dealings—he was a Calebite.

source: Chuin David'in gamthipma chun Nabal'in akelngoi mul avouve ti thu ajan ahi.
target: While David was in the wilderness, he heard that Nabal was shearing sheep.
