source: Chuin David'in gollhang som asolin, David'in gollhangho jah-a chun, Carmel'a chetouvun lang, Nabal henga cheovin, chule kaminin chibai gabolun:
target: So he sent ten young men and said to them, “Go up to Nabal at Carmel and greet him in my name.

source: Chule haosatah-a hingpa jah-a chu hitia nagasei dingu ahi, Nachunga lungmon umhen, na-insung chunga lungmon umhen, chule nanei jouse chunga lungmon umhen.
target: Say to him: ‘Long life to you! Good health to you and your household! And good health to all that is yours!

source: Chule tun nangman kelngoimul vouho naneije ti kajaovin ahi: tun nakelngoi chingho chu Carmel'a aum sungseuvin keihotoh kaum khomun, kasugenthei pouvin, amahoa konin jong imacha amanga aumpoi.
target: “ ‘Now I hear that it is sheep-shearing time. When your shepherds were with us, we did not mistreat them, and the whole time they were at Carmel nothing of theirs was missing.

source: Nagollhangho dongle chun namusah naovinte. Hijeh chun gollhangho hi namitmun lungsetna changu hen: ajehchu keiho kut nikho-a hung kahiuve. Nakhutna naphal khamkham chu nasohte le nachapa David dingin hinpen tin, gaseijun, ati.
target: Ask your own servants and they will tell you. Therefore be favorable toward my men, since we come at a festive time. Please give your servants and your son David whatever you can find for them.’ ”

source: Chuin David gollhangho ahung phatnun, hiche thuho jouse dungjui chun Nabal henga David minin aseijun anga taove.
target: When David’s men arrived, they gave Nabal this message in David’s name. Then they waited.

source: Chuin Nabal'in David sohte chu adonbutnin, David chu koiham? chule Jesse chapa koiham? tulaijin apu thu palkeh-a jam manga soh tamtah aume.
target: Nabal answered David’s servants, “Who is this David? Who is this son of Jesse? Many servants are breaking away from their masters these days.

source: Keiman ka-anneh le katwidon, chule ka kelngoi mul vouho dia kathapeh kasa chu kalah-a hoija kon ahiu kahetlou mihochu kapeh dingham? ati.
target: Why should I take my bread and water, and the meat I have slaughtered for my shearers, and give it to men coming from who knows where?”

source: Chutichun David gollhangho chu akinung leuvin, ahungun thujouse chu David ahiltaove.
target: David’s men turned around and went back. When they arrived, they reported every word.

source: Chuin David'in aloiho jah-a, Amitakipmin nachemjam cheh kikouvin, ati. Chuin amitakip chun ama ama chemjam cheh akiko taovin; chule David'in jong achemjam akikon ahi. Chuin David nunga chun mi jali tobang le, moltum choi mi jani tobang acheuvin ahi.
target: David said to his men, “Each of you strap on your sword!” So they did, and David strapped his on as well. About four hundred men went up with David, while two hundred stayed with the supplies.

source: Ahin gollhang khatnin Nabal jinu Abigail aseipeh-in, ajah-a, Ven, David'in gamthipma konin kapu chibai boh dingin sottol leho ahinsolin ahile, aman amaho anajumson ahi.
target: One of the servants told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, “David sent messengers from the wilderness to give our master his greetings, but he hurled insults at them.

source: Ahinla miho chu keihodia phatah ahiuvin, eisugenthei pouvin, amahotoh kakihou theijuva, gamlah-a kaum sungseuvin imacha jong kamansah pouve:
target: Yet these men were very good to us. They did not mistreat us, and the whole time we were out in the fields near them nothing was missing.

source: Amaho toh kiloija kelngoi kachin sungseuvin, amaho keihodin sun le janin kulbangin akisungun ahi
target: Night and day they were a wall around us the whole time we were herding our sheep near them.

source: Hijeh chun tun nangman ipi nabolding ham henlang ngaiton; ajehchu kapu chung le a-insung pumpi douna-a thilse kingaito ahitai. Ajehchu ama chutobang tah-a Belial chapa ahin, min ahenga thu asei theipon ahi, ati.
target: Now think it over and see what you can do, because disaster is hanging over our master and his whole household. He is such a wicked man that no one can talk to him.”

source: Chuphatnin Abigail akinoloijin, changlhah lhon jani, ju haini, kelngoi semtohsa nga, changkanpoh tena nga, chule lengpithei ga gop boh jakhat, theichang changlhah jani alan, asangan ho chunga agongtai.
target: Abigail acted quickly. She took two hundred loaves of bread, two skins of wine, five dressed sheep, five seahs of roasted grain, a hundred cakes of raisins and two hundred cakes of pressed figs, and loaded them on donkeys.

source: Chuin amanun asohte jah-a, Kamasanga cheovin; veuvin, nanung uva kahunge, ati. Ahinla ajipa Nabal ahetsahpon ahi.
target: Then she told her servants, “Go on ahead; I’ll follow you.” But she did not tell her husband Nabal.

source: Chule anahitin ahi, amanu sangan chunga atouva, lhang dunga ahungsuh laijin, veuvin, David le aloiho amanu dontah-a ahungun; amaho chu akimaitopi tai.
target: As she came riding her donkey into a mountain ravine, there were David and his men descending toward her, and she met them.

source: Tun David'in, Aneijouse imacha amanlouna dinga gamthipma kanachin tuppeh chu mohseh ahitai; aman apha chu asen eilethuh tai.
target: David had just said, “It’s been useless—all my watching over this fellow’s property in the wilderness so that nothing of his was missing. He has paid me back evil for good.

source: Pasal tapou ama-a kaiho jouse jingkah khovah geija kahinghoi ja ahile, akalvalin jong Pathen'in David melmate chunga bolhen, ati.
target: May God deal with David, be it ever so severely, if by morning I leave alive one male of all who belong to him!”

source: Chuin Abigail'in David amuphatnin, sangan chunga konin kintah-in akumlhan, David masanga chun alhun, tolla aboh khupmin;
target: When Abigail saw David, she quickly got off her donkey and bowed down before David with her face to the ground.

source: Akhophang bula alhun, ajah-a, Kachunga, ka pakai, keima chunga hiche themona hi umhen; chule nahenga katao ahi, nasohnu hi nanakhanga thu neiseisah inlang, nasohnu thusei hi neingaipeh-in.
target: She fell at his feet and said: “Pardon your servant, my lord, and let me speak to you; hear what your servant has to say.

source: Nahenga katao ahi, ka pakai, hiche Belial mipa Nabal hi thupi tah-in lahih-in: ajehchu amin tobang banga ama jong hija ahin; amin Nabal ahin, ama-a ngolna um ahi. Ahinla kapun nahinsol gollhangho chu nasohnun kanamu lou ahi.
target: Please pay no attention, my lord, to that wicked man Nabal. He is just like his name—his name means Fool, and folly goes with him. And as for me, your servant, I did not see the men my lord sent.

source: Hijeh chun tun, kapu, Pakai hingjing le nangma hinna panna kasei ahi, Pakaiyin thisanso dinga nahung kon le nangma khut tah-a thisan phuladinga nahung kon hi atuhtang ahitan, tun namelmate le kapu dinga thilse ngaito chanchu Nabal tobang hiuhen.
target: And now, my lord, as surely as the Lord your God lives and as you live, since the Lord has kept you from bloodshed and from avenging yourself with your own hands, may your enemies and all who are intent on harming my lord be like Nabal.

source: Chule tun kapu henga nasohnun kahinpoh hiche phattheina hohi, kapu nung hinjui gollhangho hi kipehen.
target: And let this gift, which your servant has brought to my lord, be given to the men who follow you.

source: Nahenga katao ahi, nasohnu suhkhelna ngaidamin: ijeh inem itile Pakaiyin thonlouva kapu insung hi dettah-a atundoh ding ahi; ajehchu kapun Pakai gal nasat ahin, chule nahinkho sunga hin thilse himhim akimu pon ahi.
target: “Please forgive your servant’s presumption. The Lord your God will certainly make a lasting dynasty for my lord, because you fight the Lord ’s battles, and no wrongdoing will be found in you as long as you live.

source: Ahijeng vangin nahin nungdel dingle nahinkho lamang dingin mikhat akipatdoh-in: ahinla kapu hinna hi Pakai na Pathen hinna toh kikan khom ding ahin; namelmate hinnaho vang, aman ahsongse-a kona kisepdoh banga asedoh ding ahi.
target: Even though someone is pursuing you to take your life, the life of my lord will be bound securely in the bundle of the living by the Lord your God, but the lives of your enemies he will hurl away as from the pocket of a sling.

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi, Pakaiyin kapu-a dinga aman nangma chungchanga thilpha anaseiho jouse dungjuija ahintoh chaija, Israel chunga vaipo-a nahin pansah tengle;
target: When the Lord has fulfilled for my lord every good thing he promised concerning him and has appointed him ruler over Israel,

source: Ajeh beijin thisan naso hihen lang, kapu'n ama phu akilahna hijongle, hichu nangma dinga lungkhamna le, kapu dinga lungnatna hitalou ding ahi: ahinla Pakaiyin kapu-a dinga thilpha ahinbol tengle, nasohnu hi neihin geldoh-in, ati.
target: my lord will not have on his conscience the staggering burden of needless bloodshed or of having avenged himself. And when the Lord your God has brought my lord success, remember your servant.”

source: Chuin David'in, Abigail jah-a, Tunia eikimupi dinga nahinsola Israel Pakai Pathen chu nunnom hen.
target: David said to Abigail, “Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who has sent you today to meet me.

source: Tunia thisanso dinga kahungna-a kon le, kakhut tah-a kaphu kakilah nadinga kona eihoidoh-a nangmale nathumop chu nunnom hen.
target: May you be blessed for your good judgment and for keeping me from bloodshed this day and from avenging myself with my own hands.

source: Ajehchu nangma eikimupi dinga kino loija nahung lou hile; nangma suhsetna dinga kona eituhtanga hingjing Israel Pakai Pathen min pana kasei ahi, thonlouva jingkhovah teng Nabal'a dinga pasal khatcha jong asohcha umlou helding ahi, ati.
target: Otherwise, as surely as the Lord , the God of Israel, lives, who has kept me from harming you, if you had not come quickly to meet me, not one male belonging to Nabal would have been left alive by daybreak.”

source: Hitichun David'in amanun ahin pohpeh hochu akhutna konin akisanin, amanu jah-a, Na-in'a lung mongin chetan, ven na aw kangaija chule nangma kajabol nahitai, ati.
target: Then David accepted from her hand what she had brought him and said, “Go home in peace. I have heard your words and granted your request.”

source: Chuin Abigail chu Nabal henga ahungin; veuvin, aman a-in'a lengpa golvah tobangin golvah anabolin; chule Nabal chu ju akham jeh-in, alungsung akipah lheh-in ahi. Hijeh chun amanun jingkhovah kahsen imacha ahilpoi.
target: When Abigail went to Nabal, he was in the house holding a banquet like that of a king. He was in high spirits and very drunk. So she told him nothing at all until daybreak.

source: Ahin jingkho ahungvah-in ahitin ahi, Nabal juhu atheu phatnin, a-inneipin thuho jouse chu aseipehtan ahile, alungsung athi helin, songtumto abangtan ahi.
target: Then in the morning, when Nabal was sober, his wife told him all these things, and his heart failed him and he became like a stone.

source: Chuin nisom jouvin ahitin ahi, Pakaiyin Nabal chu adengin ahile athitan ahi.
target: About ten days later, the Lord struck Nabal and he died.

source: Chuin David'in Nabal thithu ajah phatnin, Nabal khutna kona i-sah louva eikibolna phu eilah peh-a le asohpa thilse-a kona hoidoh-a Pakai chu nunnom hen; ajehchu Pakaiyin Nabal gitlouna chu ama luchanga achuhsahtai, ati. Chuin David'in Abigail chu ajidinga gahel dingin ahenga mi asolin ahi.
target: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, “Praise be to the Lord , who has upheld my cause against Nabal for treating me with contempt. He has kept his servant from doing wrong and has brought Nabal’s wrongdoing down on his own head.” Then David sent word to Abigail, asking her to become his wife.

source: Chuin David sohte chu Carmel'a Abigail henga ahung phatnun, amanu henga, David'in ajidinga nangma puidinga nahenga eihinsolu ahi, atiuve.
target: His servants went to Carmel and said to Abigail, “David has sent us to you to take you to become his wife.”

source: Chuin amanu akipatnin, aboh khupmin amai tolla asulutnin, ven, nasohnu hi kapupa sohte keng sildingin soh-in hungpang inge, ati.
target: She bowed down with her face to the ground and said, “I am your servant and am ready to serve you and wash the feet of my lord’s servants.”

source: Chuin Abigail akipatdoh paijin, sangan chung khatna atouvin, anungjui nungah nga toh ahin; David thupole ho nunga achen, ajin agapang tai.
target: Abigail quickly got on a donkey and, attended by her five female servants, went with David’s messengers and became his wife.

source: Chuin David'in Jezreel mi Ahinoam jong akipuijin; amani jong anilhonin aji ahilhontai.
target: David had also married Ahinoam of Jezreel, and they both were his wives.

source: Ahinla Saul'in achanu David jinu Michal chu Gallim mi Laish chapa Phalti chu apetan ahi.
target: But Saul had given his daughter Michal, David’s wife, to Paltiel son of Laish, who was from Gallim.

source: Chuin Ziph mite chu Saul henga Gibeah'a ahungun, David chu Jeshimon masanga um Hachilah lhanga kisela hilouham? atiuve.
target: The Ziphites went to Saul at Gibeah and said, “Is not David hiding on the hill of Hakilah, which faces Jeshimon?”

source: Chujouvin Saul akipatnin, Ziph gamthipma David holdingin Israel pasal akilhengdoh sangthum apuijin, Ziph gamthipma achesuh tan ahi.
target: So Saul went down to the Desert of Ziph, with his three thousand select Israelite troops, to search there for David.

source: Chuin Saul'in Jeshimon masang lampi pang Hachilah lhanga gebuh asongin ahi. Ahinla David chu gamthipma aumin, Saul'in gamthipma anung ahindel chu amun ahi.
target: Saul made his camp beside the road on the hill of Hakilah facing Jeshimon, but David stayed in the wilderness. When he saw that Saul had followed him there,

source: Hijeh chun Davidn'in mive lhiho asolin, Saul chu ahung monge ti ahechentai.
target: he sent out scouts and learned that Saul had definitely arrived.

source: Chuin David akipatnin, Saul gebuh sonna-a chun ahungin ahi: chuin David'in Saul le janel gal lamkai Ner chapa Abner lupna chu aven: Saul chu leiko-a alumin, mipi chun akimvela gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: Then David set out and went to the place where Saul had camped. He saw where Saul and Abner son of Ner, the commander of the army, had lain down. Saul was lying inside the camp, with the army encamped around him.

source: Chujouvin David'in adonbutnin Hit mi Ahimelech jah le Joab sopipa Zeruiah chapa Abishai jah-a, Saul henga agebuh uva keitoh lhonsuh ding koi nahiuvem? ati. Chuin Abishai'in, Keima nangtoh kalhonsuh ding ahi, ati.
target: David then asked Ahimelek the Hittite and Abishai son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, “Who will go down into the camp with me to Saul?” “I’ll go with you,” said Abishai.

source: Chuti chun David le Abishai chu jan-in mipi ho henga chun ahunglhonin: chuin veuvin, Saul leiko sunga analumin, alulhun koma chun atengcha tolla akiphutnin ahi: Abner le mipi vangchu akimvela alumun ahi.
target: So David and Abishai went to the army by night, and there was Saul, lying asleep inside the camp with his spear stuck in the ground near his head. Abner and the soldiers were lying around him.

source: Hichun Abishai'in David jah-a, tunia hi Pathen'in namelmapa hi nakhutna napehdoh ahitai: hijeh chun nahenga katao ahi, tun that jeng inge, tengchan khatvei sutnin tolto kilbeh jenging kate, velni kasut louding ahi, ati.
target: Abishai said to David, “Today God has delivered your enemy into your hands. Now let me pin him to the ground with one thrust of the spear; I won’t strike him twice.”

source: Chuin David'in Abishai jah-a, Sumang hih-in: ajehchu koiham Pathen thaonusa khat douna-a achunga akhut lha-a themmo changlouva umthei ding? ati.
target: But David said to Abishai, “Don’t destroy him! Who can lay a hand on the Lord ’s anointed and be guiltless?

source: David'in aseiben, Hingjing Pakai min pana kasei ahi, Pakaiyin sumang nante; ahiloule athinading anikho hunglhung nante; ahilou jongle galsatna konsuh intin, mangthah nante.
target: As surely as the Lord lives,” he said, “the Lord himself will strike him, or his time will come and he will die, or he will go into battle and perish.

source: Pakai thaonu chunga kakhut kalha ding chu Pakaiyin aphalpoi; ahinla nahenga katao ahi, tun alulhun koma tengcha le atuipai chu lanlang cheta hite, ati.
target: But the Lord forbid that I should lay a hand on the Lord ’s anointed. Now get the spear and water jug that are near his head, and let’s go.”

source: Chutichun David'in Saul lulhun koma tengcha le twipai chu alan, achemang lhontai; amahon hejong ahepouvin, mujong amupouvin, koimacha akhanga jong aumpoi. Pakaiya kona imutlhuhna nasatah achunguva achuh jeh chun, amaho a-ihmu cheh-un ahi.
target: So David took the spear and water jug near Saul’s head, and they left. No one saw or knew about it, nor did anyone wake up. They were all sleeping, because the Lord had put them into a deep sleep.

source: Chujouvin David agal langkhatna agalkaijin, chule lhang chungvum khatna gamlatah-a adingin; akah uvah gam ong lentah aumin ahi.
target: Then David crossed over to the other side and stood on top of the hill some distance away; there was a wide space between them.

source: Chuin David'in mipi le Ner chapa Abner agah samin, ajah-a chun, Abner, nadonbut louding ham? ati. Chujouvin Abner'in adonbutnin, Lengpa hinsama nangma koi nahim? ati.
target: He called out to the army and to Abner son of Ner, “Aren’t you going to answer me, Abner?” Abner replied, “Who are you who calls to the king?”

source: Chuin David'in Abner jah-a, Nangma pasal hangsan nahi hilouham? chule Israel sunga nangma tobang koi umam? achutile napu lengpa chu ida nangatup louham? ajehchu miho lah-a khat napu lengpa thatdingin ahungin ahi.
target: David said, “You’re a man, aren’t you? And who is like you in Israel? Why didn’t you guard your lord the king? Someone came to destroy your lord the king.

source: Hiche nathilbol hi aphapoi. Hingjing Pakai min pana kasei ahi, Pakai thaonu napupa nangatup loujeh-a athidinga lom nahi. Chule tun, lengpa tengcha chu hoija um hitam? chule alulhun koma um atuipai chu hoija uma hitam? ati.
target: What you have done is not good. As surely as the Lord lives, you and your men must die, because you did not guard your master, the Lord ’s anointed. Look around you. Where are the king’s spear and water jug that were near his head?”

source: Chuin Saul'in David aw chu ahen, Hiche hi nang aw ham? kachapa David? ati. Chuin David'in, Vo ka pakai lengpa, kei aw ahi, ati.
target: Saul recognized David’s voice and said, “Is that your voice, David my son?” David replied, “Yes it is, my lord the king.”

source: Chuin aman ipidinga ka pakaiyin asohpa nung adel ham? ipi kabol em? ahiloule kakhutna ipi gitlouna umem?
target: And he added, “Why is my lord pursuing his servant? What have I done, and what wrong am I guilty of?

source: Hijeh chun tun nahenga katao ahi, kapu lengpan asohpa thusei hi ngaihen. Pakaiyin keima doudinga nachothou ahile, aman thilto kisanhen; ahinla amahochu mihem chate ahiule, Pakai masanga sapset changuhen; ajehchu amahon tuni hin Pakai gouloho umna-a konin einodoh-un, pathen dangho gajenin eitiuve.
target: Now let my lord the king listen to his servant’s words. If the Lord has incited you against me, then may he accept an offering. If, however, people have done it, may they be cursed before the Lord ! They have driven me today from my share in the Lord ’s inheritance and have said, ‘Go, serve other gods.’

source: Hijeh chun tun kathisanhi Pakai maikoh-a tolla longhihhen; ajehchu Israelte lengpa chu mikhatnin molsang ho-a vabuh adel bangin, uili khat holin ahung kondohtai, ati.
target: Now do not let my blood fall to the ground far from the presence of the Lord . The king of Israel has come out to look for a flea—as one hunts a partridge in the mountains.”

source: Hichun Saul'in, Keima kachonse tai: hungkile kittan, chapa David: ijeh inem itile keiman nangma kasuh gentheikit louding ahitai, ajehchu tunin kahinna hi namitmun amantan lheh-e: vetan, ngolhoi tah-in kachonin, nasatah-in, kasukheltai, ati.
target: Then Saul said, “I have sinned. Come back, David my son. Because you considered my life precious today, I will not try to harm you again. Surely I have acted like a fool and have been terribly wrong.”

source: Chuin David'in adonbutnin, Ven lengpa tengchahi gollhangho khat hung galkaihen lang hunglahen.
target: “Here is the king’s spear,” David answered. “Let one of your young men come over and get it.

source: Pakaiyin amitakip achonphatna le akitahna alethuhjin ahi: ajehchu tunin Pakaiyin nangma kakhutna eipeluttan, hijongle keiman Pakai thaonusa chunga kakhut kalha louding ahi.
target: The Lord rewards everyone for their righteousness and faithfulness. The Lord delivered you into my hands today, but I would not lay a hand on the Lord ’s anointed.

source: Chule ven, tunia nahinkho kamitmu-a manlutah ahibang hin, Pakai mitmun keima hinkho jong manlutah hihen, chule gentheina jouse-a konin eihuhdoh hen, ati.
target: As surely as I valued your life today, so may the Lord value my life and deliver me from all trouble.”

source: Chujouvin Saul'in David jah-a, Kachapa David, nunnomin, nangin thil loupitah nabol ding, chule jojong najopeh ding ahi. Chutichun David achenading lampia achetan, Saul jong aumna-a akiletai.
target: Then Saul said to David, “May you be blessed, David my son; you will do great things and surely triumph.” So David went on his way, and Saul returned home.

source: Chuin David'in alungthimin, Tun nikhatle Saul khutna kathi teiding ahin; Philistine te gamsunga gangtah-a ka-otdoh tailou keidinga phajo imachadang aumpoi. Chutile Saul'in Israel gamsunga eihol hi ngatantin; akhutna kona kahoidoh ding ahitai, ati.
target: But David thought to himself, “One of these days I will be destroyed by the hand of Saul. The best thing I can do is to escape to the land of the Philistines. Then Saul will give up searching for me anywhere in Israel, and I will slip out of his hand.”

source: Chuin David akipatnin Gath lengpa Maoch chapa Achish henga aumpi mi jagup chutoh agalkai taove.
target: So David and the six hundred men with him left and went over to Achish son of Maok king of Gath.

source: Chuin David chu amale aloiho, chule amitakip a-insung mite jouse toh, David le ajiteni Jezreel mi Ahinoam le Carmel mi Nabal inneipi Abigail ngei chutoh Gath'a chun Achish toh acheng taove.
target: David and his men settled in Gath with Achish. Each man had his family with him, and David had his two wives: Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail of Carmel, the widow of Nabal.

source: Chuin David Gath'a ajamtai ti Saul aseipeh-un ahile, aman aholkit tapoi.
target: When Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, he no longer searched for him.

source: Chuin David'in Achish jah-a, Tun namitmu-a lungsetna kachana ahile, gamsunga khopiho lah-a hin kachen nadin munkhat eipeuhen; nasohhi ibola lengkhopi sunga nangtoh kachen khom dingham? ati.
target: Then David said to Achish, “If I have found favor in your eyes, let a place be assigned to me in one of the country towns, that I may live there. Why should your servant live in the royal city with you?”

source: Chuphatnin Achish'in hiche nikho chun Ziklag chu apetai. Hijeh chun Ziklag chu tulai geihin Judah lengte gam ahijingtai.
target: So on that day Achish gave him Ziklag, and it has belonged to the kings of Judah ever since.

source: Chule Philistine te gamsunga David aumna phatchu kum khat le lhali lhingset ahi.
target: David lived in Philistine territory a year and four months.

source: Chuin David le aloiho chu akondoh-un, Geshur mite, Gezri mite, chule Amalek mite agasat taove; ajehchu hiche namhochu Shur jotna lampi-a pat Egypt gam geija masanglaija pat agama chu cheng anahi taove.
target: Now David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites and the Amalekites. (From ancient times these peoples had lived in the land extending to Shur and Egypt.)

source: Chule David'in chuche gamchu asumangin, numei pasal khatcha ahoipon, kelngoiho leh bongchalho, sanganho leh sangongsang ho, chule ponsil ho akilah-in Achish henga ahung kiletai.
target: Whenever David attacked an area, he did not leave a man or woman alive, but took sheep and cattle, donkeys and camels, and clothes. Then he returned to Achish.

source: Chuin Achish'in, Tuni hoilam nagachomu ham? ati. Chuin David'in, Judah lhanglam sang, Jerahmeel mite lhanglam sang, chule Ken mite lhanglam sang, ati.
target: When Achish asked, “Where did you go raiding today?” David would say, “Against the Negev of Judah” or “Against the Negev of Jerahmeel” or “Against the Negev of the Kenites.”

source: Chuti chun David'in Gath henga thu hinpo ding pasal ahin, numei ahin khatcha ahinghoi jipon ahi; ajehchu aman, achuti loule ichungthu-u ahenga gahilun tin, David'in chutin abolin, Philistine gamsunga achengin phatseh-in hiti khatin achonne tiget nunte ati ahi.
target: He did not leave a man or woman alive to be brought to Gath, for he thought, “They might inform on us and say, ‘This is what David did.’ ” And such was his practice as long as he lived in Philistine territory.

source: Chuin Achish'in David atahsanin, Aman ami Israelte chu akihotsah heltai; hijeh-a chu ama a-itih-a kasoh hijing ding ahitai, ati.
target: Achish trusted David and said to himself, “He has become so obnoxious to his people, the Israelites, that he will be my servant for life.”

source: Chuin hiche nikho laichun ahitin ahi, Philistine te chun Israelte toh kisatdin asepaiteu galsat dingin akhom khomun ahi. Chuin Achish'in David jah-a, Nangho le namite galsatdia keitoh ikon dohdiu ahi ti kichentah-in nahei, ati.
target: In those days the Philistines gathered their forces to fight against Israel. Achish said to David, “You must understand that you and your men will accompany me in the army.”

source: Chuin David'in Achish henga, Thonlouva nasohpa hin ipi kabolthei nahet ding ahi, ati. Chule Achish'in David jah-a, Hijeh-a chu a-itih-a eihongbit dinga kapansah ding nahi, ati.
target: David said, “Then you will see for yourself what your servant can do.” Achish replied, “Very well, I will make you my bodyguard for life.”

source: Tun Samuel chu athitan, Israelte jouse chun akauvin, ama khopitah Ramah-a chun avuitaove. Chule Saul'in lhakouhole doithemho gamsunga konin anodohtai.
target: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in his own town of Ramah. Saul had expelled the mediums and spiritists from the land.

source: Chuin Philistine te akichom khomun, ahungun Shunem'a gebuh ahungsong taovin ahi: chule Saul'in Israelte jouse achom khomin Gilboa'a gebuh asongun ahi.
target: The Philistines assembled and came and set up camp at Shunem, while Saul gathered all Israel and set up camp at Gilboa.

source: Chuin Saul'in Philistine janelho amuphatnin, akichan, alungthim akihot hot jengtan ahi.
target: When Saul saw the Philistine army, he was afraid; terror filled his heart.

source: Chuin Saul'in Pakai adoh phatnin, Pakaiyin amangin jong, Urim'in jong, themgaohon jong adonbutpon ahi.
target: He inquired of the Lord , but the Lord did not answer him by dreams or Urim or prophets.

source: Chuphatnin Saul'in asohte henga, Ahenga kache-a kadoh theinadin numei lhakouthei khat neigahol peh-un, ati. Chuin asohten ajah-a, Ven, Endor'a numei lhakouthei khat aume, ati.
target: Saul then said to his attendants, “Find me a woman who is a medium, so I may go and inquire of her.” “There is one in Endor,” they said.

source: Chuin Saul'in alim akhelin, vonchom akivonin, minitoh jan-in numeinu henga chun ahungtaove. Chuin aman, Nahenga katao ahi, nalha kouthei na-a chun phun neisan peh-inlang, nahenga min kasei penpen chu neihin koudoh peh-in, ati.
target: So Saul disguised himself, putting on other clothes, and at night he and two men went to the woman. “Consult a spirit for me,” he said, “and bring up for me the one I name.”

source: Chuin numei chun ajah-a, Ven, Saul'in lhakou ho le doithemho gamsunga kona iti adeldoh helham nangman nahei. Achutile ibola kathi nadinga, kahinkho hi thang neikam peh ham? ati.
target: But the woman said to him, “Surely you know what Saul has done. He has cut off the mediums and spiritists from the land. Why have you set a trap for my life to bring about my death?”

source: Chuin Saul amanu henga Pakaiya akihahselin, Hingjing Pakai min pana kasei ahi, hiche jeh-a hi nachunga engbolna chulou ding ahi, ati.
target: Saul swore to her by the Lord , “As surely as the Lord lives, you will not be punished for this.”

source: Chuphatnin numei nun, Nahenga koi kahin puitou diham? ati. Chuin aman, Samuel neipuitou peh-in, ati.
target: Then the woman asked, “Whom shall I bring up for you?” “Bring up Samuel,” he said.

source: Chuin amanun Samuel amuphatnin hatah-in apengin: chuin Saul jah-a, Ibola neilhep ham? ajehchu nangma Saul nahi, ati.
target: When the woman saw Samuel, she cried out at the top of her voice and said to Saul, “Why have you deceived me? You are Saul!”

source: Chuin lengpan amanu jah-a, Kicha hih-in: nangin ipi namu em? ati. Chuin numeinu chun Saul jah-a, pathenho leisetna kona ahung kaltouvu kamui, ati.
target: The king said to her, “Don’t be afraid. What do you see?” The woman said, “I see a ghostly figure coming up out of the earth.”

source: Chuin aman amanu jah-a, Aman itobang mel aputnem? ati. Chuin amanun, Tehsepu khat ahungtouvin; sangkhol cholin akivone, ati. Chuin Saul'in Samuel ahi ahetan, amai tolla asulutnin akuntai.
target: “What does he look like?” he asked. “An old man wearing a robe is coming up,” she said. Then Saul knew it was Samuel, and he bowed down and prostrated himself with his face to the ground.

source: Chuin Samuel'in Saul jah-a, Ibola puitoudinga neisuhboi ham? ati. Chuin Saul'in adonbutnin, Kalung genthei behset jenga ahi; ajehchu Philistine ten eisatnun, Pathen keija konin achemang tan, themgao ham, mang hamin jong eidonbut tapon ahi: hijeh-a chu ipi kabolding nangin neihetsah theina dinga kakou nahi, ati.
target: Samuel said to Saul, “Why have you disturbed me by bringing me up?” “I am in great distress,” Saul said. “The Philistines are fighting against me, and God has departed from me. He no longer answers me, either by prophets or by dreams. So I have called on you to tell me what to do.”

source: Hichun Samuel'in, Pakai nanga kona achemang henasa le namelma ahitai ti henasa-a ibola keima neidoh ham?
target: Samuel said, “Why do you consult me, now that the Lord has departed from you and become your enemy?

source: Pakaiyin kakoma aseibanga abol ahitai. Ajehchu Pakaiyin lenggam chu nakhutna kona alhekeh-a, naheng nakom David ngeichu apeh ahitai.
target: The Lord has done what he predicted through me. The Lord has torn the kingdom out of your hands and given it to one of your neighbors—to David.

source: Ajehchu Pakai thusei nangaipon, chule Amalek mite chunga alunghana tijat umtah chu natongdohpoi; hijeh-a chu tunia hi hichehi Pakaiyin nachunga abol ahitai.
target: Because you did not obey the Lord or carry out his fierce wrath against the Amalekites, the Lord has done this to you today.

source: Achungchona jong Pakaiyin Israel chu nangma toh Philistine te khutna apehdoh ding ahinalaije. Chule jing nikho le nangma le nachapate keitoh i-um khomdiu ahitan: chule Pakaiyin Israel janel jongchu Philistine te khutna apehdoh ding ahi, ati.
target: The Lord will deliver both Israel and you into the hands of the Philistines, and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me. The Lord will also give the army of Israel into the hands of the Philistines.”

source: Chuphatnin Samuel thusei jehchun Saul chu alhun tolla akijamhel jengin, akicha behseh jengtan ahi: chule ama-a chun tha himhim aum tapon ahi; ajehchu sun nilhum jankhovah-a an nelouva um ahi.
target: Immediately Saul fell full length on the ground, filled with fear because of Samuel’s words. His strength was gone, for he had eaten nothing all that day and all that night.

source: Chuin numeinu chu Saul henga ahungin, alunggim behseh chu amun, ajah-a, Ven, nasohnun nathu kanitnin, chule kahinkho kakhutna kakichoijin, kahenga nasei thuho chu kangaijin ahi.
target: When the woman came to Saul and saw that he was greatly shaken, she said, “Look, your servant has obeyed you. I took my life in my hands and did what you told me to do.

source: Hijeh chun tun nahenga katao ahi, nangin jong nasohnu thusei ngaijin lang, na-anga changlhah kam khatbeh luipeh ingting; nachena ding lampia nache tengle tha nanei theinadin nen, ati.
target: Now please listen to your servant and let me give you some food so you may eat and have the strength to go on your way.”

source: Ahin ama anomhih-in, Kaneh louding ahi, ati. Ahinla asohte le numeinu akithouvin angeh teitei jengun ahile, athu angaitai. Chutichun tolla konin akipatdoh-in, jalkhun chunga atoutai.
target: He refused and said, “I will not eat.” But his men joined the woman in urging him, and he listened to them. He got up from the ground and sat on the couch.

source: Chule numeinu hin a-in'a bongnou thaochet khat aneijin; chuin gangtah-in athatnin, changbong alan ameh halin, chule hichea chun cholso louvin changlhah akangin;
target: The woman had a fattened calf at the house, which she butchered at once. She took some flour, kneaded it and baked bread without yeast.

source: Chuin Saul le asohte anga ahindomin, amahon anetaove. Chuin amaho chuche janchun akipatnun, achetauve.
target: Then she set it before Saul and his men, and they ate. That same night they got up and left.

source: Tun Philistine ten asepaiteu jouse Aphek'a akhomun, Israel ten Jezreel'a twinah phung khatna gebuh asongun ahi.
target: The Philistines gathered all their forces at Aphek, and Israel camped by the spring in Jezreel.

source: Chuin Philistine te pakaiho chu aja ajan, chule asang asangin akitol akitol jengun; ahinla David le aloiho chu Achish toh anunung penin ahung kitolun ahi.
target: As the Philistine rulers marched with their units of hundreds and thousands, David and his men were marching at the rear with Achish.

source: Chuin Philistine pipuihon, Hiche Hebrew miho hin hikoma ipi aboluham? atiuve. Chuin Achish'in Philistine pipuiho jah-a, Amahi Israel lengpa Saul sohpa, ni hijatle kum hijat kakoma um, kei koma ahung lutna pat tuni geija amona kamulou David hilouham? ati.
target: The commanders of the Philistines asked, “What about these Hebrews?” Achish replied, “Is this not David, who was an officer of Saul king of Israel? He has already been with me for over a year, and from the day he left Saul until now, I have found no fault in him.”

source: Chuin Philistine pipuiho chu achunga alunghangun, chule Philistine te chun ahenga, Hiche mipahi nangman aumna dinga napeh mun'a chu achekit theinadin kinungle sahtan, eiho toh galmuna chesuh khom hihhen, achuti loule galkisat na-a chun eiho douvin hungpang getninte. Ajehchu apu toh ipi-a kicham kit dingham? hiche mite luchanga kon hilou dingham?
target: But the Philistine commanders were angry with Achish and said, “Send the man back, that he may return to the place you assigned him. He must not go with us into battle, or he will turn against us during the fighting. How better could he regain his master’s favor than by taking the heads of our own men?

source: Mihon khat le khat kilhang lhah-a lam puma la asah uva, Saul'in asang asang athatnin, David'in sangsom sangja athatne, atiuchu hiche David hi hilouham? atiuve.
target: Isn’t this the David they sang about in their dances: “ ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands’?”

source: Chuphatnin Achish'in David akouvin, ahenga, Hingjing Pakai min pana kasei ahi, nangma nachondih jingin, chule janel lah-a keima toh nalutle napotle hi kamitmun aphalheh-e: ajehchu kahenga nahunga pat tunigei hin nachunga thilse kamupoi: hitajongle pipuihon nadeipouve.
target: So Achish called David and said to him, “As surely as the Lord lives, you have been reliable, and I would be pleased to have you serve with me in the army. From the day you came to me until today, I have found no fault in you, but the rulers don’t approve of you.

source: Hijeh chun tun Philistine pipuiho nalunghansah lounadin kilenlang, lung mongin chetan, ati.
target: Now turn back and go in peace; do nothing to displease the Philistine rulers.”

source: Chuin David'in Achish henga, Hijongle ken ipi kabol em? tuni geija nangma toh kahung um sunga hi nasoh chunga ipi namu-a, kapu lengpa melmate satdinga kache monading ipi umam? ati.
target: “But what have I done?” asked David. “What have you found against your servant from the day I came to you until now? Why can’t I go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?”

source: Chuin Achish'in adonbutnin, David jah-a, Kamitmun Pathen vantil khat bangin naphai ti kahei: achuti vangin Philistine pipuihon, Ama eiho toh galmuna chetou louhel ding ahi, ati ahi.
target: Achish answered, “I know that you have been as pleasing in my eyes as an angel of God; nevertheless, the Philistine commanders have said, ‘He must not go up with us into battle.’

source: Hijeh chun tun jingkah matah kho avah vahle napu sohte nahin kilhonpi hotoh thoudoh unlang che jengun, ati.
target: Now get up early, along with your master’s servants who have come with you, and leave in the morning as soon as it is light.”

source: Chuti chun David le amite chu kipatdoh-a Philistine gama kiledin matah-in athoutaove. Chule Philistine te chu Jezreel'a achetou taove.
target: So David and his men got up early in the morning to go back to the land of the Philistines, and the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, nithum ni-a David le aloiho Ziklag ahung lhunun, Amalek miten lhanggam le Ziklag ana buluvin, Ziklag kho chu anasatnun, meijin ahalun;
target: David and his men reached Ziklag on the third day. Now the Amalekites had raided the Negev and Ziklag. They had attacked Ziklag and burned it,

source: Chule asunga um numei ho chu gal hingin akaijun, alen le aneo khatcha thatlouvin akaimangun, achetauve ahi.
target: and had taken captive the women and everyone else in it, both young and old. They killed none of them, but carried them off as they went on their way.

source: Hitichun David le aloiho chu khopi ahunglhung taovin, chuin veuvin, meijin ana kihal vamin; ajiteu le achapateu, chule achanuteu gal hingin anakai taove.
target: When David and his men reached Ziklag, they found it destroyed by fire and their wives and sons and daughters taken captive.

source: Chuin David le alhonpi mipi chu ka nadinga tha aneilou geijun, hakan akaptaovin ahi.
target: So David and his men wept aloud until they had no strength left to weep.

source: Chule David jiteni Jezreel mi Ahinoam le Carmel mi Nabal jinu Abigail chu gal hingin anakai taovin ahi.
target: David’s two wives had been captured—Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail, the widow of Nabal of Carmel.

source: Chule David chu ahesoh lheh jengtan ahi; ajehchu amitakip achapate le achanute dinga alungkham cheh jeh-un, mipin ama songa seding agotauve. Ahinla David amatah Pakai a-Pathen'a akitil khouvin ahi.
target: David was greatly distressed because the men were talking of stoning him; each one was bitter in spirit because of his sons and daughters. But David found strength in the Lord his God.

source: Chuin David'in Abiathar thempu Ahimelech chapa henga, Nahenga katao ahi, thempu sangkhol chu eihin choipeh-in, ati. Chuin Abiathar'in thempu sangkhol chu David henga ahinchoi tai.
target: Then David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelek, “Bring me the ephod.” Abiathar brought it to him,

source: Chuin David'in Pakai adongin, Hiche mihonpi chu kanungdel dingham? del leng kaphah jouding ham? atin ahi. Chuin aman adonbutnin, Delin: ajehchu nangman naphah teitei ding, thonlouva nahuhdoh sohding ahi, ati.
target: and David inquired of the Lord , “Shall I pursue this raiding party? Will I overtake them?” “Pursue them,” he answered. “You will certainly overtake them and succeed in the rescue.”

source: Chutichun David le aumpi jagupho chu acheuvin, Besor vachadung ahung lhungun, ami dalhahho chu chuachun aumtaove.
target: David and the six hundred men with him came to the Besor Valley, where some stayed behind.

source: Ahinla David le mipi jali chun anungdel uvin ahi; ajehchu mi jani chu alhahsam behseh jeh uva Besor vachadung galkai joulouva umdena ahitaove.
target: Two hundred of them were too exhausted to cross the valley, but David and the other four hundred continued the pursuit.

source: Chuin amahon gamlah-a chun Egypt mikhat amuvin, David henga ahinpuijun, changlhah apeuvin ahile aman anen; chule donding twi jong apeuvin ahi.
target: They found an Egyptian in a field and brought him to David. They gave him water to drink and food to eat—

source: Chuin theichang changlhah halkhat le lengpithei gop bohni apeuvin; chuin aman aneh phatnin, atha ahungkile kittan ahi. Ajehchu nithum le janthum an nelou twi donlouhel ahitai.
target: part of a cake of pressed figs and two cakes of raisins. He ate and was revived, for he had not eaten any food or drunk any water for three days and three nights.

source: Chuin David'in ajah-a, Koija nahiham? chule Hoilama kon nahim? ati. Chuin aman keima Amalek mikhat soh, Egypt gollhang kahi; kadamlou jeh-in kapun nithum masang chun eidalhatan ahi.
target: David asked him, “Who do you belong to? Where do you come from?” He said, “I am an Egyptian, the slave of an Amalekite. My master abandoned me when I became ill three days ago.

source: Chereth mite lhanglam, Judah te gamsung, chule Caleb gam lhanglam kabulu uvin, chule Ziklag chu meijin kahalun ahi, ati.
target: We raided the Negev of the Kerethites, some territory belonging to Judah and the Negev of Caleb. And we burned Ziklag.”

source: Chuin David'in, Hiche loiho henga chu neipuisuh theiding ham? ati. Chuin aman, Neitha louding le kapu khutna neipehdoh loudingin Pathen'a kihahsel in, chule hiche loiho henga chun puisuh nange, ati.
target: David asked him, “Can you lead me down to this raiding party?” He answered, “Swear to me before God that you will not kill me or hand me over to my master, and I will take you down to them.”

source: Chuin aman apuisuh phatnin, veuvin, amaho tollhanga anakithe jalun, Philistine gam le Judah gama kona thil tamtah achomdoh jeh-u chun, aneovin, adonnun, alamun ahi.
target: He led David down, and there they were, scattered over the countryside, eating, drinking and reveling because of the great amount of plunder they had taken from the land of the Philistines and from Judah.

source: Chuin David'in amaho chu khovah tila pat ajing nilhah lam geijin asatnin: sangongsang chunga touva hoidoh gollhang jali tilou mi khatcha asohchapon ahi.
target: David fought them from dusk until the evening of the next day, and none of them got away, except four hundred young men who rode off on camels and fled.

source: Chule David'in Amalek miten apoh mangho chu akilelah sohkeijin: David'in ajiteni jong ahuhdohtai.
target: David recovered everything the Amalekites had taken, including his two wives.

source: Chule amahon anachomu alen ahin, aneo ahin, achanuteu ahin, achapateu ahin khatcha lhasam umlou helin David'in alelah sohkeijin ahi.
target: Nothing was missing: young or old, boy or girl, plunder or anything else they had taken. David brought everything back.

source: Chuin David'in kelngoihon holeh bonghonho chu alasoh keijin, hiho chu gancha dangho masanga ahoijun, Hihohi David galthil chom ahi, atiuve.
target: He took all the flocks and herds, and his men drove them ahead of the other livestock, saying, “This is David’s plunder.”

source: Chuin David alhahsam behseh jeh-a David juijou louva mi jani ho heng, Besor vachadunga aumsah hou henga chun ahungin; chule amaho David le ahinlhonpi mipi ho chu lamtodin apotdoh-un ahi. Chuin David'in miho heng ahinnai phatchun, amaho chu chibai aboh-in ahi.
target: Then David came to the two hundred men who had been too exhausted to follow him and who were left behind at the Besor Valley. They came out to meet David and the men with him. As David and his men approached, he asked them how they were.

source: Hichun David kilhonpi ho lah-a migilouho le Balial miho jouse chun adonbutnun, Amaho ilah uva ahung pantha loujeh-u chun, akipuijuva ache theina ding uva ajiteu le achateu ipeh-u tailou akichom thilho jouse chu khatcha ipeh lou dingu ahi, atiuve.
target: But all the evil men and troublemakers among David’s followers said, “Because they did not go out with us, we will not share with them the plunder we recovered. However, each man may take his wife and children and go.”

source: Chuphatnin David'in, Kasopite ho, Pakaiyin eihoidoh uva, eiho doudinga hunga mihonpi chu ikhutnuva eipedoh uva kona eipeh-u thilho hi chutichun bolhih-un.
target: David replied, “No, my brothers, you must not do that with what the Lord has given us. He has protected us and delivered into our hands the raiding party that came against us.

source: Ajehchu hiche thua hi kon nathu-u angai dingham? galsat dinga konpa chan jatjat chu thilchinga pangpa jong changding ahi: amaho akibang banga kihom dingu ahi, ati.
target: Who will listen to what you say? The share of the man who stayed with the supplies is to be the same as that of him who went down to the battle. All will share alike.”

source: Chule chuche nikho-a pat tuni geihin, Israelte din chutichun houdan thupeh le chondanin achepehtai.
target: David made this a statute and ordinance for Israel from that day to this.

source: Chuin David Ziklag'a ahung phatnin, agalthil chomho phabep chu Judah upaho, agolho geijin athotnin, ajah uva, Veuvin, Pakai melma te-a kon galthil kichomdoh nangho dinga thilpeh ahi, atin;
target: When David reached Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, who were his friends, saying, “Here is a gift for you from the plunder of the Lord ’s enemies.”

source: Bethel'a umho, Ramoth lhanglama umho, chule Jattir'a umho,
target: David sent it to those who were in Bethel, Ramoth Negev and Jattir;

source: Aroer'a umho, Siphmoth'a umho, chule Eshtemoa'a umho,
target: to those in Aroer, Siphmoth, Eshtemoa

source: Rachal'a umhole Jerahmeel mite khopiho-a umho, chule Ken mite khopi ho-a umho,
target: and Rakal; to those in the towns of the Jerahmeelites and the Kenites;

source: Hormah'a umhole, Chorashan'a umho, chule Athach'a umho,
target: to those in Hormah, Bor Ashan, Athak

source: Chule Hebron'a umhole, David amatahle aloiho umna munjouse-a henga chun athot tan ahi.
target: and Hebron; and to those in all the other places where he and his men had roamed.

source: Tun Philistine ten Israelte dounan gal ahinbolun: chule Israel mitechu Philistine te masanga konin ajamun, Gilboa molsanga chun akithat chap jengun ahi.
target: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; the Israelites fled before them, and many fell dead on Mount Gilboa.

source: Chule Philistine ten Saul le achapate hatah-in ajuijun; chule Philistine te chun Saul chapate Jonathan, Abinadab, chule Melchishua chu athat taovin ahi.
target: The Philistines were in hot pursuit of Saul and his sons, and they killed his sons Jonathan, Abinadab and Malki-Shua.

source: Chuin Saul douna gal kisat chu anasa lheh jengin; thalthem ho-a konin nasatah-in amachangtan ahi.
target: The fighting grew fierce around Saul, and when the archers overtook him, they wounded him critically.

source: Chuphatnin Saul'in agalvon popa jah-a, Nachemjam satdoh inlang neisunpai jengin; achutiloule hiche cheptan louho khu hunguntin eisununtin, eijumso getnunte, ati. Ahinla agalvon popa anompoi; ajehchu kicha behseh jenga ahi. Hijeh chun Saul'in chemjam alan, achung chu abotan ahi.
target: Saul said to his armor-bearer, “Draw your sword and run me through, or these uncircumcised fellows will come and run me through and abuse me.” But his armor-bearer was terrified and would not do it; so Saul took his own sword and fell on it.

source: Chuin agalvon popan Saul athi amuphatnin, aman jong achemjam chu abokhumin amatoh athi thatai.
target: When the armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his sword and died with him.

source: Chuti chun Saul le achapate thum, agalvon popa le amiho jouse chu chuche nichun athigam taove.
target: So Saul and his three sons and his armor-bearer and all his men died together that same day.

source: Chuin Israel mipi phaicham pang langkhatna umhole, Jordan pang langkhat lama umhon Israel mite ajama Saul le achapate athiu chu amuphatnun, khopiho adalhaovin ajamtaovin ahi. Chuin Philistine te ahungun, asunga acheng taove.
target: When the Israelites along the valley and those across the Jordan saw that the Israelite army had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their towns and fled. And the Philistines came and occupied them.

source: Chuin ajingin ahitin ahi, Philistine te akithatho von sutdinga ahung phatnun, Saul le achapa thumho chu Gilboa molsanga alhuh chapmu amutaovin ahi.
target: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

source: Chuin amaho alu atanun, agalvon asutlhaovin, amilim hounao inho le mipi ho lah-a phonjal dingin Philistine te gamsunga athot kimvel taovin ahi.
target: They cut off his head and stripped off his armor, and they sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news in the temple of their idols and among their people.

source: Chuin agalvon chu Astaroth insunga akoijun: along chu Beth-shan banga akanbeh-un ahi.
target: They put his armor in the temple of the Ashtoreths and fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.

source: Chuin Philistine ten Saul abolnau chu Jabesh-gilead'a chenghon ajah phatnun;
target: When the people of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,

source: Mihangsan jouse akipatnun, jankhon acheuvin, Saul le achapate longchu Beth-shan kulbanga konin alauvin, Jabesh'a ahungun, hikoma chun ahaltaove.
target: all their valiant men marched through the night to Beth Shan. They took down the bodies of Saul and his sons from the wall of Beth Shan and went to Jabesh, where they burned them.

source: Chuin aguho chu alauvin, Jabesh kho-a thingphung noi khatna avuijun, nisagi an angolun ahi.
target: Then they took their bones and buried them under a tamarisk tree at Jabesh, and they fasted seven days.

source: Tun Saul thinungin ahitin ahi, David'in Amalek mite athagamma ahung kinunglekit chun; David chu Ziklag'a nini ana umin;
target: After the death of Saul, David returned from striking down the Amalekites and stayed in Ziklag two days.

source: Ahin anithumnin ahitin ahi, hichun veuvin mikhat apon teldehduh le alua leiset nat pumin Saul gebuh-a konin ahungdoh-in; chuin ahitin ahi, ama David kom ahunglhun phatnin tolla alhun chibai aboh tan ahi.
target: On the third day a man arrived from Saul’s camp with his clothes torn and dust on his head. When he came to David, he fell to the ground to pay him honor.

source: Chuin David'in ajah-a, Hoija kona hunga nahim? ati. Chuin aman, Israel gebuh a kona hung hoidoh kahi, ati.
target: “Where have you come from?” David asked him. He answered, “I have escaped from the Israelite camp.”

source: Chuin David'in ajah-a, Thu iti tam? neisei peh-in, katao ahi, ati. Chuin aman adonbutnin, Miho galmuna konin ahung jamtaovin, chule mi tamtah jong alhun chule athitan; chule Saul le achapa Jonathan jong athitai, ati.
target: “What happened?” David asked. “Tell me.” “The men fled from the battle,” he replied. “Many of them fell and died. And Saul and his son Jonathan are dead.”

source: Chuin David'in gollhangpa henga, Nangman Saul le achapa Jonathan athi iti nahet ham? ati.
target: Then David said to the young man who brought him the report, “How do you know that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?”

source: Chuin gollhangpa chun ajah-a, Keima Gilboa molsanga kaga umkhan ahile, ven Saul chu atengcha chunga ana opmin, chule ven sakol kangtalai hole sakol chung themho chun amachu nasatah-in ahindelun ahi.
target: “I happened to be on Mount Gilboa,” the young man said, “and there was Saul, leaning on his spear, with the chariots and their drivers in hot pursuit.

source: Chuin aman anunglam ahin vetna ahile keima eimun, chuin eihin kouvin ahi. Chuin keiman kadonbut nin, Hikoma kaume, kati.
target: When he turned around and saw me, he called out to me, and I said, ‘What can I do?’

source: Chuin aman kahenga, Nang koi nahim? ati. Chuin keiman kadonbut nin, Keima Amalek mi kahi, kati.
target: “He asked me, ‘Who are you?’ “ ‘An Amalekite,’ I answered.

source: Aman kahenga aseikitnin, Kachunga dingin lang neithatnin, ajehchu kachunga lunghemna ahunglhung tai; ajehchu kahinkhohi keima-a aum nalaijin ahi, ati.
target: “Then he said to me, ‘Stand here by me and kill me! I’m in the throes of death, but I’m still alive.’

source: Hijeh chun keima achunga kadingin, amachu kathat tai; ajehchu ama alhuh nunga ahinjou louding chu kahet ahitai; chule keiman alu-a um alal lukhuh le abanbul ho-a chaokolho chu kagalah-a, ka pakai nangma henga kahinpohlut ahitai, ati.
target: “So I stood beside him and killed him, because I knew that after he had fallen he could not survive. And I took the crown that was on his head and the band on his arm and have brought them here to my lord.”

source: Hitichun David'in avonho abotkeh-in, hitima chun amatoh um miho jouse jong chun aboluvin ahi.
target: Then David and all the men with him took hold of their clothes and tore them.

source: Chuin amaho chu alunghemun, akapmun, hitichun amahon Saul le achapa Jonathan ding, Pakai miho jouse ding le Israel insung miho jouse dingin nilhah geijin an angolun ahi. Ajehchu amaho chemjam'a louva ahiuve.
target: They mourned and wept and fasted till evening for Saul and his son Jonathan, and for the army of the Lord and for the nation of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.

source: Chuin David'in athuseipeh gollhangpa jah-a chun, Hoilang mi nahim? ati. Chuin aman adonbutnin, Keima gamchom mikhat chapa Amalek mi kahi, ati.
target: David said to the young man who brought him the report, “Where are you from?” “I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite,” he answered.

source: Chuin David'in ajah-a, Iti nangman Pakaiyin thao anusa khat chunga chu kichalouhela nakhut nalhah-a nasuhmang jengham? ati.
target: David asked him, “Why weren’t you afraid to lift your hand to destroy the Lord ’s anointed?”

source: Chuin David'in gollhangho lah-a khatchu akouvin ajah-a, Nailutnin lang achunga chun, ati. Chuin aman ama chu athat tai.
target: Then David called one of his men and said, “Go, strike him down!” So he struck him down, and he died.

source: Chuin David'in ajah-a, Pakai thaonusa kathatne tia nakamtah-a naphon jeh-in, nangma thisan phuchu nachunga chuhen, ati.
target: For David had said to him, “Your blood be on your own head. Your own mouth testified against you when you said, ‘I killed the Lord ’s anointed.’ ”

source: Chuin David'in Saul le achapa Jonathan ka-lan akachamin;
target: David took up this lament concerning Saul and his son Jonathan,

source: (Chuin aman Judah chate jongchu thalpi manje hilding ahi, tin thu apen, veuvin, hichehi Jasher lekhabua akisunin ahi).
target: and he ordered that the people of Judah be taught this lament of the bow (it is written in the Book of Jashar):

source: Israel loupina chu namunsangho-a akithat tai; i-atile ahat ho lhu-a hitam!
target: “A gazelle lies slain on your heights, Israel. How the mighty have fallen!

source: Gath mun'a seihih-un, Ashkelon lampi dunga phongle hih-un, achuti loule Philistine te chanuho kipah uvintin; chule cheptan louho chanute jong kichoisang getnunte.
target: “Tell it not in Gath, proclaim it not in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines be glad, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised rejoice.

source: Gilbao molsang nangho, nachung uva daitwi lhahda henlang, gojong juhdahen, louhon jong aga soda hen; ajehchu mihatpa lumdal chu theng loutah-in lemangin aumin, Saul lumdal chu thao nulou bangin anaumin ahi.
target: “Mountains of Gilboa, may you have neither dew nor rain, may no showers fall on your terraced fields. For there the shield of the mighty was despised, the shield of Saul—no longer rubbed with oil.

source: Akithatpa thisana konle ahatpa thaova konin, Jonathan thalpi chu akile kitpon, chule Saul chemjam jong agoh keuvin ahung kilepon ahi.
target: “From the blood of the slain, from the flesh of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan did not turn back, the sword of Saul did not return unsatisfied.

source: Ahinkho sung lhonin Saul le Jonathan hi ngailut umtah le dei um pentah ahilhonin; chule athilhonin jong akikhen lhonpoi; amani muvanlai sangin amangang jolhonin, keipi bahkaiho sangin jong ahat lhonin ahi.
target: Saul and Jonathan— in life they were loved and admired, and in death they were not parted. They were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.

source: Nangho Israel chanute, dei umtah ponsanthipma natompao, sana-a najempao Saul dingin kapmun.
target: “Daughters of Israel, weep for Saul, who clothed you in scarlet and finery, who adorned your garments with ornaments of gold.

source: Iti ahat ho galmuna lhujenga hitam! Vo Jonathan, namun sangho chunga chun nangma nakithat tai.
target: “How the mighty have fallen in battle! Jonathan lies slain on your heights.

source: Kasopipa Jonathan, nangma jeh-in kalung agenthei lheh-in ahi: Keima dingin kipa umtah chu nanahin, keima neingailutna akidangin, numei ho ngailutna sangin asangjon ahi.
target: I grieve for you, Jonathan my brother; you were very dear to me. Your love for me was wonderful, more wonderful than that of women.

source: Ahat ho iti lhuh-a, chule gal manchah ho iti manthah jenga hitam!
target: “How the mighty have fallen! The weapons of war have perished!”

source: Chuin hiche jouchun ahitin ahi, David'in Pakai adongin, Judah khopiho khatpena chu kachetou dingham? ati. Chuin Pakaiyin ajah-a, Chetouvin, ati. Chuin David'in hoilama kachetou ding ham? ati. Chuin aman, Hebron, ati.
target: In the course of time, David inquired of the Lord . “Shall I go up to one of the towns of Judah?” he asked. The Lord said, “Go up.” David asked, “Where shall I go?” “To Hebron,” the Lord answered.

source: Hijeh chun David chukom mun jonin ajiteni Jezreel mi Ahinoam le Karmel mi Nabal jinu Abigail toh achetou tai.
target: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail, the widow of Nabal of Carmel.

source: Chule David'in aumpi amite, amitakip a-insung mite toh ahin puitouvin, chuin amaho Hebron khopiho-a chun acheng taove.
target: David also took the men who were with him, each with his family, and they settled in Hebron and its towns.

source: Chuin Judah miho ahungun, David chu hikoma chun Judah insung pumpi chunga leng dingin thao ahungnu taovin ahi. Chuin amahon David henga, Saul vuija pangho chu Jabesh-gilead miho ahi ti aseipeh-un ahi.
target: Then the men of Judah came to Hebron, and there they anointed David king over the tribe of Judah. When David was told that it was the men from Jabesh Gilead who had buried Saul,

source: Chuin David'in Jabesh-gilead mite henga sottol ho asollin, ahenguva, Pakaiyin phatthei naboh uhen, ijeh inem itile nanghon hitobang lungset themna chu napakai pau Saul navetsah-un, navui jun ahi.
target: he sent messengers to them to say to them, “The Lord bless you for showing this kindness to Saul your master by burying him.

source: Chule tun Pakaiyin nangho-a lungset themnale thutah namusah taohen: Chule nanghon hiche thilhi nanabol jeh uva keiman jong nangho ding thilpha kabolding ahi.
target: May the Lord now show you kindness and faithfulness, and I too will show you the same favor because you have done this.

source: Hijeh chun tun nabanthau hatdoh sah-un lang, chule hangsanun; ajehchu napakai pau Saul chu athitan; chujongle Judah insung miten achunguva leng dingin keima thao einutaovin ahi, ati.
target: Now then, be strong and brave, for Saul your master is dead, and the people of Judah have anointed me king over them.”

source: Ahinla Ner chapa Abner, Saul janel gal lamkaipa chun Saul chapa Ishbosheth chu Mahanaim'a ahinpuitan ahi.
target: Meanwhile, Abner son of Ner, the commander of Saul’s army, had taken Ish-Bosheth son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.

source: Chuin amachu Gilead Ashurim Jezreel, Ephraim chule Benjamin le Israel pumpi chunga lengin apansahtan ahi.
target: He made him king over Gilead, Ashuri and Jezreel, and also over Ephraim, Benjamin and all Israel.

source: Saul chapa Ishbosheth'in Israelte chunga vai ahomchun kum somli ahitan, chule kumni aleng changin ahi. Ahivangin Judah insung mi ten vang David ajuijun ahi.
target: Ish-Bosheth son of Saul was forty years old when he became king over Israel, and he reigned two years. The tribe of Judah, however, remained loyal to David.

source: Chule David Hebron khopi-a Judah insung pumpi chunga lenga apansung chu kum sagile lhagup ahi.
target: The length of time David was king in Hebron over Judah was seven years and six months.

source: Chuin Ner chapa Abner chule Saul chapa Ishbosheth soh ho chu Mahanaim'a konin Gibeon'a apotdoh-un ahi.
target: Abner son of Ner, together with the men of Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, left Mahanaim and went to Gibeon.

source: Chule Zeruiah chapa Joab le David soh ho akondoh-un, Gibeon twikul panga akisutou vin ahi: chuin khat ho chu twikul pang langkhatna atouvun, chule khat langho chu twikul pang langkhatna atouvun ahi.
target: Joab son of Zeruiah and David’s men went out and met them at the pool of Gibeon. One group sat down on one side of the pool and one group on the other side.

source: Chuin Abner'in Joab jah-a, Tun gollhangho chu kipatdoh-u henlang, imasanguva kideluhen, ati. Chuin Joab'in, Amahochu kipatdoh-u hen, ati.
target: Then Abner said to Joab, “Let’s have some of the young men get up and fight hand to hand in front of us.” “All right, let them do it,” Joab said.

source: Chuin Saul chapa Ishbosheth langa konin Benjamin mi somleni akipat doh-un, chule David sohte-a konin somleni akipat doh-un ahi.
target: So they stood up and were counted off—twelve men for Benjamin and Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, and twelve for David.

source: Chuin mikhat chehchun agolpao luchang chu atuh-un, chule aloipa pangpeh chehchu chemjamin akisunto uvin; hitichun amaho thakhatnin alhutaovin ahi. Hijeh chun hiche munchu Helkath-hazzurim asahtaove. Hichu Gibeon'a um ahi.
target: Then each man grabbed his opponent by the head and thrust his dagger into his opponent’s side, and they fell down together. So that place in Gibeon was called Helkath Hazzurim.

source: Chule hiche nikho-a galkisat chu anasalheh jengin, Abner le Israel miho chu David sohte masanga agal lel taovin ahi.
target: The battle that day was very fierce, and Abner and the Israelites were defeated by David’s men.

source: Chule chumuna chun Zeruiah chapa thumho: Joab, Abishai chule Asahel ajaovun, chule Asahel kaljandan chu gamlah sakhipi tobang ahi.
target: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai and Asahel. Now Asahel was as fleet-footed as a wild gazelle.

source: Chuin Asahel chun Abner nungchu adelin, chule achepumin jetle veija kihei louvin Abner nungchu ajuipeh-in ahi.
target: He chased Abner, turning neither to the right nor to the left as he pursued him.

source: Chuin Abner akinung heijin, Nangma Asahel nahilouham? ati. Chuin aman adonbutnin, Kahinai, ati.
target: Abner looked behind him and asked, “Is that you, Asahel?” “It is,” he answered.

source: Chuin Abner'in ajah-a, Najetlam ahiloule naveilama kiheijin lang nagollhangho khatchu manin lang, agalvon chu lahpeh-in; ati. Ahinla Asahel chun ama ajuina-a konchun akiheidoh dehpon ahi.
target: Then Abner said to him, “Turn aside to the right or to the left; take on one of the young men and strip him of his weapons.” But Asahel would not stop chasing him.

source: Chuin Abner'in Asahel jah-a aseikitnin, Keima neijuina-a konin kiheidohtan: keiman nangma ibola hiche munahi kathading nahim? Achutile kamai chu nasopipa Joab angsunga iti kalah dingham? ati.
target: Again Abner warned Asahel, “Stop chasing me! Why should I strike you down? How could I look your brother Joab in the face?”

source: Ahivangin ama kiheimang ding anompon; hijeh chun Abner'in atengcha lhumkeijin amapa nahgu ngachanna noitah chu asunin ahile anunglanga apaidoh jengin ahi: chuin ama alhun, hiche munna chun athitan ahi, chuin ahitin ahi, Asahel alhuh-a athina mun hin phapa chanchu adingden jengun ahi.
target: But Asahel refused to give up the pursuit; so Abner thrust the butt of his spear into Asahel’s stomach, and the spear came out through his back. He fell there and died on the spot. And every man stopped when he came to the place where Asahel had fallen and died.

source: Ahin Joab le Abishai chun Abner nungchu adel lhonin: chule Giah masanga um Gibeon gamthip jotna lampia um Ammah lhang ahung lhunun nisa alhumtan ahi.
target: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner, and as the sun was setting, they came to the hill of Ammah, near Giah on the way to the wasteland of Gibeon.

source: Chuin Benjamin chate chu Abner nung chun akikhom khomun, chule amaho chu galsatmi honkhat akisouvin, lhang chunga adingun ahi.
target: Then the men of Benjamin rallied behind Abner. They formed themselves into a group and took their stand on top of a hill.

source: Chuin Abner'in Joab chu akouvin, ajah-a, chemjam hin a-itih-a avallhum jingding hitam? Khonung akichaina le lungjinna ahung hi ding chu nahetlou ham? Namiho chu asopihou nung adelnauva kona akinungle kitna diuva naseipehna ding phat chu itih hiding ham? ati.
target: Abner called out to Joab, “Must the sword devour forever? Don’t you realize that this will end in bitterness? How long before you order your men to stop pursuing their fellow Israelites?”

source: Chuin Joab'in, Hingjing Pathen mina kasei ahi, Nangman ima na naseilou, hile thonlouva jingkah lama chu amitakipmin asopi nung adellou dingu ahitai, ati.
target: Joab answered, “As surely as God lives, if you had not spoken, the men would have continued pursuing them until morning.”

source: Hijeh chun Joab'in sumkon amutnin ahile mijouse adingden taovin; chule Israel nung chu adeltapouvin, chule satjong akisatpi tapouvin ahi.
target: So Joab blew the trumpet, and all the troops came to a halt; they no longer pursued Israel, nor did they fight anymore.

source: Chuin Abner le aloiho chu hiche jan chun phaicham ajot peh-un, chule Jordan agalkaijun, Bithron pumpi achonsoh-un, Mahanaim'ah ahungtaovin ahi.
target: All that night Abner and his men marched through the Arabah. They crossed the Jordan, continued through the morning hours and came to Mahanaim.

source: Chuin Joab chu Abner ajuina-a konin ahung kinungle kittan, miho jouse chu akhop khoma ahile, David sohte mi somleko toh Asahel chu alhasamtan ahi.
target: Then Joab stopped pursuing Abner and assembled the whole army. Besides Asahel, nineteen of David’s men were found missing.

source: Ahinla David sohte chun Benjamin mi Abner miho chu jathum le somgup athatnun ahi.
target: But David’s men had killed three hundred and sixty Benjamites who were with Abner.

source: Chuin amahon Asahel longchu apuvin, Bethlehem'a um apa kivuina ding lhanna chun avuitaovin ahi. Chuin Joab le amite jankhon akitolun, jingkho vah-in Hebron ahunglhung taovin ahi.
target: They took Asahel and buried him in his father’s tomb at Bethlehem. Then Joab and his men marched all night and arrived at Hebron by daybreak.

source: Tun Saul insungle David insung miho kikah-a chun gal sottah aumtan ahi. Ahinla David chu ahatcheh ahatcheh-in, Saul insung chu ahatmo cheh ahatmo cheh jengtan ahi.
target: The war between the house of Saul and the house of David lasted a long time. David grew stronger and stronger, while the house of Saul grew weaker and weaker.

source: Chuin Hebron khopi-a David'in chapa phabep ahingin: achapa apeng masapen chu Amnon ahin, Jezreel mi Ahinoam toh ahin ahi.
target: Sons were born to David in Hebron: His firstborn was Amnon the son of Ahinoam of Jezreel;

source: Chule achapa ni chana chu Chileab ahin, Karmel mi Nabal inneipi Abigail hin ahi: chule athum channa chu Absalom ahin, Geshur lengpa Talmai chanu Maakah chapa ahi.
target: his second, Kileab the son of Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel; the third, Absalom the son of Maakah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

source: Chule ali channa chu Haggith chapa Adonijah ahin, chule anga channa chu Abital chapa Shephatiah ahi:
target: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

source: Chule agup channa chu Ithream ahin, David jinu Eglad hin ahi. Hichengsehi Hebron khopi-a David'in chapa ahin hochu ahiuve.
target: and the sixth, Ithream the son of David’s wife Eglah. These were born to David in Hebron.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Saul insung le David insung kikah-a gal aum sungchun, Abner chu amatah Saul insung miho-a dingin akisuhat nin ahi.
target: During the war between the house of Saul and the house of David, Abner had been strengthening his own position in the house of Saul.

source: Chule Saul'in thaikem khat aneijin, amin chu Rizpah ahin, Aiah chanu ahi. Chuin Ishbosheth'in Abner henga Ipidinga kapa thaikemnu chu naluppi ham? atin aseije.
target: Now Saul had had a concubine named Rizpah daughter of Aiah. And Ish-Bosheth said to Abner, “Why did you sleep with my father’s concubine?”

source: Hichun Abner Ishbosheth thusei jehchun alunghang lheh jengtan, ajah-a, Keima hi Judah te uicha lu beh kahim? Tunin keiman napa Saul insung, asopiho heng, aloi agolho henga kitahna kamusah-in, chule David khutna jong kapedoh pon nahi; ahinla nangman numei khat chungchanga nei themosah nalai ham?
target: Abner was very angry because of what Ish-Bosheth said. So he answered, “Am I a dog’s head—on Judah’s side? This very day I am loyal to the house of your father Saul and to his family and friends. I haven’t handed you over to David. Yet now you accuse me of an offense involving this woman!

source: Pathen ahenga akihahselna bang banga keiman David achunga kabol louva ahile, Pathen'in Abner chunga abolnom nom bol henlang, akalvalin jong bolhen;
target: May God deal with Abner, be it ever so severely, if I do not do for David what the Lord promised him on oath

source: Lenggam chu Saul insunga kona toldoh-a, chule Israel le Judah chunga David laltouna chu Dan'a pat Beersheba geija tundohna dinga.
target: and transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul and establish David’s throne over Israel and Judah from Dan to Beersheba.”

source: Chuin aman Abner chu thusei cheng khatcha adonbut theipon ahi, ajehchu aman amachu akichan ahi.
target: Ish-Bosheth did not dare to say another word to Abner, because he was afraid of him.

source: Chuin Abner'in ama thalhengin David henga sottol ho asollin, ajah-a, Gamsung hi koijapen ham? aman aseiben, Keimatoh kitepna neijin, chule ven, Israel jouse nahenga hinpuilut nadinga kakhut hi nangma to pangkhom ding ahi, ati.
target: Then Abner sent messengers on his behalf to say to David, “Whose land is it? Make an agreement with me, and I will help you bring all Israel over to you.”

source: Chuin aman, Aphai, keiman nangma toh kitepna kaneiding ahi: ahin keiman nahenga thilkhat kangaichat aume, hichu, Keimatoh kimuto dinga nahung tengle Saul chanu Michal nahin puimasat loule kamai namu louhel ding ahi, ati.
target: “Good,” said David. “I will make an agreement with you. But I demand one thing of you: Do not come into my presence unless you bring Michal daughter of Saul when you come to see me.”

source: Chuin David'in Saul chapa Ishbosheth henga sottol ho asolin, ajah-a, Philistine te chep jakhat mana kaji dinga kanahol kajinu Michal chu neipedoh-in, ati.
target: Then David sent messengers to Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, demanding, “Give me my wife Michal, whom I betrothed to myself for the price of a hundred Philistine foreskins.”

source: Chuin Ishbosheth'in mi asolin, a-inneipu Laish chapa Phaltiel'a konin agapuidoh-in ahi.
target: So Ish-Bosheth gave orders and had her taken away from her husband Paltiel son of Laish.

source: Chuin ajipa chun kappumin amanu nungchu Bahurim geijin ahinjuijin ahi. Hichun Abner'in ama henga, Kinungletan, ati. Chuin ama akilekit tan ahi.
target: Her husband, however, went with her, weeping behind her all the way to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, “Go back home!” So he went back.

source: Chuin Abner chu Israel upaho toh akihou khomin, ahenguva, Phat chomkhat masang jepchun nanghon David chu nachung uva leng dingin nanaholun;
target: Abner conferred with the elders of Israel and said, “For some time you have wanted to make David your king.

source: Tun hichu boltaovin; ajehchu Pakaiyin David chungchanga, Kasoh David khutna kona keiman kami Israelte hi Philistinte khutna kon le amelma jouseu khutna kona kahuhdoh ding ahi, tia asei ahi, ati.
target: Now do it! For the Lord promised David, ‘By my servant David I will rescue my people Israel from the hand of the Philistines and from the hand of all their enemies.’ ”

source: Chuin Abner'in Benjamin mite henga jong aseijin ahi. Chuin Abner chu Israel le Benjamin insung pumpi-a dinga apha dinga kilomho seidingin Hebron khopi'a David henga achen ahi.
target: Abner also spoke to the Benjamites in person. Then he went to Hebron to tell David everything that Israel and the whole tribe of Benjamin wanted to do.

source: Hijeh chun Abner chu Hebron khopi-a David henga mi somni toh ahungin ahi. Chuin David'in Abner le amatoh alhonpi miho-a ding chun golvah abolin ahi.
target: When Abner, who had twenty men with him, came to David at Hebron, David prepared a feast for him and his men.

source: Chuin Abner'in David henga, Keima kipat in chengting, chule amahon nangma toh kitepna asemtheina dingu le, nalunggot jouse banga vai nahom theina dingin, ka pakai le ka lengpa dingin Israelte jouse gakhom khominge, ati. Hitichun David'in Abner chu asoldoh-in, ama lungnom tah-in achetan ahi.
target: Then Abner said to David, “Let me go at once and assemble all Israel for my lord the king, so that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may rule over all that your heart desires.” So David sent Abner away, and he went in peace.

source: Chuin veuvin, David sohte hole Joab chu michoma achenaova konin ahung lhungun, chule thil kichomdoh tamtah ahinpouvin ahi: ahin Abner vangchu Hebron'a David toh anaum tapon ahi; ajehchu aman ama chu asoldoh ahitan, lungmong tah-a che-a ahitai.
target: Just then David’s men and Joab returned from a raid and brought with them a great deal of plunder. But Abner was no longer with David in Hebron, because David had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.

source: Chuin Joab le aumpi mipi janel chu ahung phatnun, amahon Joab henga, Ner chapa Abner chu lengpa henga ahungin, chuin aman amachu asolmangin, chule ama lungmong tah-in achetai, atiuve.
target: When Joab and all the soldiers with him arrived, he was told that Abner son of Ner had come to the king and that the king had sent him away and that he had gone in peace.

source: Chuin Joab chu lengpa henga ahungin, ajah-a, Nangma ipi bol nahi hitam? Ven, Abner nahenga ahungin; ipidinga amachu nalesol kitna, chule ama chemanga hitam?
target: So Joab went to the king and said, “What have you done? Look, Abner came to you. Why did you let him go? Now he is gone!

source: Ner chapa Abner chu nalhemlha dinga, nahunglut napotdoh heding le, nabol jouse hedinga hunga ahichu nangman nahenai, ati.
target: You know Abner son of Ner; he came to deceive you and observe your movements and find out everything you are doing.”

source: Chuin Joab chu David koma kona ahung potdoh nungin, Abner nunga chun sottol ho asolin, chuin amahon amachu Sirah twikul'a konin ahinlepui kitnun ahi; ahinla hichu David'in ahepon ahi.
target: Joab then left David and sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the cistern at Sirah. But David did not know it.

source: Chuin Abner chu Hebron'a ahung kilekit phatnin, kotpi phunga chun Joab'in atumbeh-a kihou pidin apuijin, chuin asopipa Asahel thisan phulahnan, anahgu nga channa noitah chu asutna ahile, athitan ahi.
target: Now when Abner returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into an inner chamber, as if to speak with him privately. And there, to avenge the blood of his brother Asahel, Joab stabbed him in the stomach, and he died.

source: Chuin chomkhat jouvin David'in hichu ajahdoh phatnin, hitin aseitai, Ner chapa Abner thisan chungchanga hin keima le kalenggam hi Pakai angsunga a-itih-in themona kaneipouve,
target: Later, when David heard about this, he said, “I and my kingdom are forever innocent before the Lord concerning the blood of Abner son of Ner.

source: Hichehi Joab chung le apate insung jouse luchunga lhungjohen; chule Joab insunga konin thisan longa damlou, aphah, tenggola kingai, chemjam'a louva, ahiloule changlhah lhahsam ma kichat hihhen, ati.
target: May his blood fall on the head of Joab and on his whole family! May Joab’s family never be without someone who has a running sore or leprosy or who leans on a crutch or who falls by the sword or who lacks food.”

source: Hitichun Joab le asopipa Abishai chun sopipalhon Asahel chu Gibeon galmuna anatha jehchun Abner chu athat lhontan ahi.
target: (Joab and his brother Abishai murdered Abner because he had killed their brother Asahel in the battle at Gibeon.)

source: Chuin David'in Joab le ama umpi miho jouse henga chun, Naponhou jouse botkeh-unlang, nataiju chu khaodip ponin kigah-un, chule Abner masanga chun lunghemun, ati. Chule David amatah-in mithi kong chu ajuitan ahi.
target: Then David said to Joab and all the people with him, “Tear your clothes and put on sackcloth and walk in mourning in front of Abner.” King David himself walked behind the bier.

source: Chuin amahon Abner chu Hebron'a avui taovin: chuin lengpa awsang tah-in Abner lhanna chun akaptan, chule mipi jouse jong akaptan ahi.
target: They buried Abner in Hebron, and the king wept aloud at Abner’s tomb. All the people wept also.

source: Chuin lengpan Abner chu akachamin, hitin ati, Abner hi mingol thia thiding hitam?
target: The king sang this lament for Abner: “Should Abner have died as the lawless die?

source: Nakhut teni la akikanpon, nakeng teni jongla akisom poi; miphalouho anga mihem khat alhuh jeng bangin, nangma nalhu jengtan ahi, ati. Chuin mipi chu ama chunga akapkit taovin ahi.
target: Your hands were not bound, your feet were not fettered. You fell as one falls before the wicked.” And all the people wept over him again.

source: Chule sun ahipetna an nehsah ding mipi chu David henga ahung phatnun, David akihahselin, Nisalhum kah-a keiman changlhah le thildang katepma ahile, Pathen'in kachunga hitihin bolhen lang akhoh cheh-in jong eibolhen, ati.
target: Then they all came and urged David to eat something while it was still day; but David took an oath, saying, “May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if I taste bread or anything else before the sun sets!”

source: Chuin mipi ho chun ahethemun, alunglhai taove; lengpan bol jouse-a chu mipi ho lunglhaija ahiuve.
target: All the people took note and were pleased; indeed, everything the king did pleased them.

source: Ajehchu hiche nikho-a chu mijousele Israelte chun Ner chapa Abner kitha chu lengpa lunglam ahilou chu ahetnu ahi.
target: So on that day all the people there and all Israel knew that the king had no part in the murder of Abner son of Ner.

source: Chuin lengpan asohte henga, Tunia hi Israel sunga pipui le milen khat lhuh-a ahi ti helou nahiuvem?
target: Then the king said to his men, “Do you not realize that a commander and a great man has fallen in Israel this day?
