target: he went and took the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from the citizens of Jabesh Gilead. (They had stolen their bodies from the public square at Beth Shan, where the Philistines had hung them after they struck Saul down on Gilboa.)

source: Chuin aman hia konchun, Saul le achapa Jonathan guho chu ahinpodoh-in; chule amahon akhailih hou guho chu alohkhomun ahi.
target: David brought the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from there, and the bones of those who had been killed and exposed were gathered up.

source: Chuin amahon Saul le achapa Jonathan guho chu Benjamin gam Zelah mun'a apa Kish lhanna chun avuijun: chule amahon lengpa thupeh ho jouse atongdoh sohkeijun ahi. Chuin hiche jouchun Pathen'in gamsung mite taona chu angaipeh tan ahi.
target: They buried the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan in the tomb of Saul’s father Kish, at Zela in Benjamin, and did everything the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer in behalf of the land.

source: Hiche chungchon chun Philistine ten Israelte dounan gal ahinbol kitnun; chuin David le asohte chu akonsuh-un, Philistine te toh akisat taovin: chule David chu achol lheh jengtan ahi.
target: Once again there was a battle between the Philistines and Israel. David went down with his men to fight against the Philistines, and he became exhausted.

source: Chuin mihat chapate lah-a khat, atengcha chu sum-eng Shekel jathum-a gih Ishbi-benob kitipa chun, chemjam thah khat akikoijin, David chu thading agotan ahi.
target: And Ishbi-Benob, one of the descendants of Rapha, whose bronze spearhead weighed three hundred shekels and who was armed with a new sword, said he would kill David.

source: Ahin Zeruiah chapa Abishai'in amachu ahunghuh doh-in, Philistine mipa chu asatnin, athat tan ahi. Chujouvin David miho chu ahenga akihahselun, Israel meivah kisuhmit louna dinga, nangma keihotoh galkona nachekit louding ahitai, atiuve.
target: But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to David’s rescue; he struck the Philistine down and killed him. Then David’s men swore to him, saying, “Never again will you go out with us to battle, so that the lamp of Israel will not be extinguished.”

source: Chuin hiche jouchun ahitin ahi, Gob mun chun Philistine te toh akisat kit taovin; chuin Hushath mi Sibbachai chun Saph athatnin, amachu mihat chapate lah-a khat ahi.
target: In the course of time, there was another battle with the Philistines, at Gob. At that time Sibbekai the Hushathite killed Saph, one of the descendants of Rapha.

source: Chuin Gob mun'a chun Philistine te toh akisatpha kitnun, hilaija chun Benjamin mi Jaare-oregim chapa El-hanan'in Git mi Goliath sopipa chu athatnin, atenglung chu ponkhong ho pumlong te ahi.
target: In another battle with the Philistines at Gob, Elhanan son of Jair the Bethlehemite killed the brother of Goliath the Gittite, who had a spear with a shaft like a weaver’s rod.

source: Chuin Gath mun'a chu gal akisat kitnun, hilaija chun mi atahsa lentah khat aumin, akhutjung gup chule akengjung gup, agoma somnileli ahin; chule mihat chihlhah ahi.
target: In still another battle, which took place at Gath, there was a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot—twenty-four in all. He also was descended from Rapha.

source: Chuin aman Israelte achou phatnin, David sopipa Shimea chapa Jonathan chun agathatnin ahi.
target: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan son of Shimeah, David’s brother, killed him.

source: Hicheng liho Gath'a mihatpa ding hungpeng ho, David khut le asohte khutna louho chu ahiuve.
target: These four were descendants of Rapha in Gath, and they fell at the hands of David and his men.

source: Chule Pakaiyin amelmate jouse khut le Saul khutna kona ahuhdoh nikhon, David'in Pakai koma hiche lachengho hi aseijin ahi.
target: David sang to the Lord the words of this song when the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.

source: Chuin aman, Pakai hi kasongpi le kakulpi, chule eihuhhingpu ahi;
target: He said: “The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer;

source: Kasongpi Pathen ahin; keiman ama katahsan ding ahi: Ama kalum le kasochatna ki, ka-insang le kahoidohna, kahuhhingpu ahin; nangman pumhatna konin neihuhdoh tai.
target: my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation. He is my stronghold, my refuge and my savior— from violent people you save me.

source: Keiman pachat dinga lomtah Pakai chu kakou ding: hiti achu kamelmaho-a kona huhdoh-a kaumding ahi.
target: “I called to the Lord , who is worthy of praise, and have been saved from my enemies.

source: Thina twi kinongin eium kimvel teng, Pathen heloute twisoh-in eikichatsah-e;
target: The waves of death swirled about me; the torrents of destruction overwhelmed me.

source: Thikholkhul lungkham nan eium kimvelin, thina thanghon eikimaitopi-e.
target: The cords of the grave coiled around me; the snares of death confronted me.

source: Kagenthei tengle Pakai kakouvin, ka Pathen henga kapengin, Chule aman a-houin'a konin ka aw ahinjan, kapena chun anakhang sunga alutnin ahi.
target: “In my distress I called to the Lord ; I called out to my God. From his temple he heard my voice; my cry came to his ears.

source: Hichun leiset akilingin akihotnin; van kibulphuna ho akihotnin, akilinge, ajehchu ama lunghanga ahi.
target: The earth trembled and quaked, the foundations of the heavens shook; they trembled because he was angry.

source: Chuin anah homa konin meikhu ahungdoh-in, chule akama kona meikong chun aval lhumin; hiche chun meihol ho chu ahal kong tan ahi.
target: Smoke rose from his nostrils; consuming fire came from his mouth, burning coals blazed out of it.

source: Aman van ho jong aloi nemin, chule ahung kumlhan; muthim chu akengto noija umin ahi.
target: He parted the heavens and came down; dark clouds were under his feet.

source: Chule ama Cherub chunga atouvin, alengin; chule amachu hui lhavingho chunga akimun ahi.
target: He mounted the cherubim and flew; he soared on the wings of the wind.

source: Aman akimvela muthim lhangkhal akihehsah-in, twi thimjeju le van'a meilom satah ho chu.
target: He made darkness his canopy around him— the dark rain clouds of the sky.

source: Ama masang vah-a kon chun mei-am ho ahung aldoh-in ahi.
target: Out of the brightness of his presence bolts of lightning blazed forth.

source: Pakaiyin vangin bangin a-aw ahin sodoh-in; chungnung pen chun thu ahin seijin ahi.
target: The Lord thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.

source: Chule aman thalpi ho akapdoh-in, chule athe jal-in; kol aphet sah-in, amaho chu ajoutan ahi.
target: He shot his arrows and scattered the enemy, with great bolts of lightning he routed them.

source: Pakai phosalna le anahhoma ahu alhadoh-a konin; Twikhanglen toho chu akilangdoh-in, vannoi kibulphu naho jong akimudoh-in ahi.
target: The valleys of the sea were exposed and the foundations of the earth laid bare at the rebuke of the Lord , at the blast of breath from his nostrils.

source: Aman chunga konin ahinsolin, keima eiladoh-in; twi tamtah lah-a konin aman eikaidoh-in ahi.
target: “He reached down from on high and took hold of me; he drew me out of deep waters.

source: Ka melma hattah ho-a konle eithetboltea konin eihuhdoh-in; ajehchu amaho keima dingin ahat behseh-un ahi.
target: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from my foes, who were too strong for me.

source: Kahamsetna nikhon amahon eikimaitopi-un; ahinla Pakai chu kapanmun ahijinge.
target: They confronted me in the day of my disaster, but the Lord was my support.

source: Aman munlen tah-a jong eipuilutnin, kachunga akipa jeh-in eihuhdoh tai.
target: He brought me out into a spacious place; he rescued me because he delighted in me.

source: Pakaiyin kachon phatna dungjuijin kipaman eipen, kakhut teni thenna dungjuijin aman eilethuh-in ahi.
target: “The Lord has dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he has rewarded me.

source: Ajehchu keiman Pakai lampiho kajuijin, chule ka-Pathen'a konin giloutah-in kapot pon ahi.
target: For I have kept the ways of the Lord ; I am not guilty of turning from my God.

source: Ajehchu ama thutan ho jouse kamasanga aumin: achonna dan kisunho thudola vang, keima hicheho-a konchun kapotdoh pon ahi.
target: All his laws are before me; I have not turned away from his decrees.

source: Keima amasanga chondih tah kanahin; kakhangit louna-a konin kakikangsen ahi.
target: I have been blameless before him and have kept myself from sin.

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin kachon phatna dungjui eilethuh-a; amitmu-a kathena dungjuijin eilethuh ahi.
target: The Lord has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness in his sight.

source: Hepina neite henga nangman hepinanei nahi namusah ding; michondih ho henga nangma chondih nahi nakimusah ding ahi.
target: “To the faithful you show yourself faithful, to the blameless you show yourself blameless,

source: Mitheng ho henga atheng nahi nakimusah ding; milungkon te henga chingtah nahi nakimusah ding ahi
target: to the pure you show yourself pure, but to the devious you show yourself shrewd.

source: Chule bolgentheija umte nangman nahuhdoh ding; mikiletsahte chu suhnema aumtheina dingun, namit chu achunguva aumin ahi.
target: You save the humble, but your eyes are on the haughty to bring them low.

source: Ajehchu vo Pakai nangma kathaomei nahin; Pakaiyin kamuthim eisalvah pehding ahi.
target: You, Lord , are my lamp; the Lord turns my darkness into light.

source: Ajehchu nangma jala galmi honkhat douna kalhai ding; ka-Pathen jala bang kachop khup ding ahi.
target: With your help I can advance against a troop; with my God I can scale a wall.

source: Pathen vang, alampi achamkimin; Pakai thu chu akipho chenin; ama tahsan te jouse dingin ama alumdalu ahi.
target: “As for God, his way is perfect: The Lord ’s word is flawless; he shields all who take refuge in him.

source: Ajehchu Pathen tailou, Pakai koiham? chule Pathen tailou, koiham songpi?
target: For who is God besides the Lord ? And who is the Rock except our God?

source: Pathen chu kathahatna le kathaneina ahin: aman kalampi achamkimsah-in ahi.
target: It is God who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure.

source: Aman kakeng sajuhnu keng bangin asemin; kamun sangho-a eitousah-in ahi.
target: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer; he causes me to stand on the heights.

source: Kakhutnin thih thalpi ho ajetboh nadingin; Aman kakhut galbolje ahilin ahi.
target: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

source: Nangman nahuhhinga lumdal neipetan; nanun nem nachun keima lentah-in eisemdohtai.
target: You make your saving help my shield; your help has made me great.

source: Nangman kalhuh louna dingin, kanoija kakalsona ding neikeh letpeh-in ahi.
target: You provide a broad path for my feet, so that my ankles do not give way.

source: Keiman kamelmate kadelin, amaho kasumangin; chule amaho kasuh manghel kahsen kahungkile pon ahi.
target: “I pursued my enemies and crushed them; I did not turn back till they were destroyed.

source: Athokit theilouna diuvin keiman amaho kamavon, kasumang helin; henge, amaho kakengto noija alhusoh taovin ahi.
target: I crushed them completely, and they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.

source: Ajehchu nangman galsatn-a dingin thahat na-in katai neigah peh-in; keima douna-a kipandoh hochu kanoija nakoitan ahi.
target: You armed me with strength for battle; you humbled my adversaries before me.

source: Nangman keima eihot bolte chu kasuhmang nadingin, kamelmate lolho chu neipedoh-in ahi.
target: You made my enemies turn their backs in flight, and I destroyed my foes.

source: Amahon aveovin, ahinla ahuhdohdiu koima aumpon; Pakai jengin jong amaho adonbutpon ahi.
target: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them— to the Lord , but he did not answer.

source: Hichun keima amaho chu vutvai bangin kavongoijin, chule lamlen dunga bonlhoh bangin kachotphan, akithejalji taovin ahi.
target: I beat them as fine as the dust of the earth; I pounded and trampled them like mud in the streets.

source: Nangman kamite kiphinna-a konin neihuh doh-in, Pathen hephalouho luchang dingin neikoitai: kahet khahlou mihon eijen nadingu ahi.
target: “You have delivered me from the attacks of the peoples; you have preserved me as the head of nations. People I did not know now serve me,

source: Gamdang miho kahenga hungkipelut dingu: amahon ajah jah ule kasei angai dingu ahi.
target: foreigners cower before me; as soon as they hear of me, they obey me.

source: Gamchom mihochu hung lhadah untin, chule akikul khupnao mun'a kona kicha ding ahiuve.
target: They all lose heart; they come trembling from their strongholds.

source: Pakai chu ahingjingin, chule kasongpi chu nunnom hen; huhhingna songpi Pathen chu choisangin umhen.
target: “The Lord lives! Praise be to my Rock! Exalted be my God, the Rock, my Savior!

source: Kaphu eilah peh-a, mihemte kanoija sunema Pathen ahin,
target: He is the God who avenges me, who puts the nations under me,

source: Chule kamelmate lah-a kona eipuidoh-a chu Pathen ahi: keima douna-a kipandoh ho chungvuma neidomsangin: mihuham ho-a konin neihuhdoh tan ahi.
target: who sets me free from my enemies. You exalted me above my foes; from a violent man you rescued me.

source: Hijeh-a chu vo Pakai, Pathen hephalouho lah-a nangma thangvah ingting, chule namin vahchoi La kasah ding sange.
target: Therefore I will praise you, Lord , among the nations; I will sing the praises of your name.

source: Amachu aleng dinga sochatna insang ahin; chule athaonu David le achilhahte henga a-itih chanin hepina amusah-in ahi.
target: “He gives his king great victories; he shows unfailing kindness to his anointed, to David and his descendants forever.”

source: Tun hiche hohi David thusei nunungpen ahitai. Chungnung pena dopsanga umpa le Jacob Pathen'in thao anu, chule Israelte lah-a lathempen Jesse chapa David'in aseitai;
target: These are the last words of David: “The inspired utterance of David son of Jesse, the utterance of the man exalted by the Most High, the man anointed by the God of Jacob, the hero of Israel’s songs:

source: Pakai lhagao chun keija konin thu aseidoh-in, chule athu kaleija achengin ahi.
target: “The Spirit of the Lord spoke through me; his word was on my tongue.

source: Israel Pathen'in hitin aseijin, Israel songpin kajah-a hitin aseije, Mihem chunga vaihompa chu thudih ding, Pathen ging puma vai ahomding ahi.
target: The God of Israel spoke, the Rock of Israel said to me: ‘When one rules over people in righteousness, when he rules in the fear of God,

source: Chule amachu meibol kailouni jingkah, nisa ahungso doh-a khovah tobang hiding; gojuh jouva leisetna kona thengsela hungdon doh h amhing tobang hiding ahi.
target: he is like the light of morning at sunrise on a cloudless morning, like the brightness after rain that brings grass from the earth.’

source: Ka-insung hi Pathen'a dingin chutobang chu hihih jongle; aman keimatoh tonsot kitepna asemin, thiljouse thonlou dingin kitoh tah-in akoijin ahi. Ajehchu aman hichehi kahuh hingna jousele kangaichat ho jouse chu ahi; aman akhantousah lou dingham?
target: “If my house were not right with God, surely he would not have made with me an everlasting covenant, arranged and secured in every part; surely he would not bring to fruition my salvation and grant me my every desire.

source: Ahinla Belial chapate chu ling kisatlha-a kipaidoh tobang hidingu ahi, ajehchu amaho khutna kiman theilou ahiuve.
target: But evil men are all to be cast aside like thorns, which are not gathered with the hand.

source: Ahinla amaho gatongkha-a michu thih le tenglung ki-um khumding; chule amaho hiche mun'a chu meija kihalvam ding ahiuve.
target: Whoever touches thorns uses a tool of iron or the shaft of a spear; they are burned up where they lie.”

source: Hichehohi David'in anei mihat ho minchu ahi. Tachmon mite touna-a tou, lamkaiho lah-a pipu chu Ezni mi Adino ahi: aman mi jaget dounan atengcha alamin, amaho chu khatvei tha-in athat gamin ahi.
target: These are the names of David’s mighty warriors: Josheb-Basshebeth, a Tahkemonite, was chief of the Three; he raised his spear against eight hundred men, whom he killed in one encounter.

source: Chule ama bantah-a chu ahile, David le amihat thumho lah-a khat, Ahoh mi Dodo chapa Eleazar ahin, amahon galsat dinga galmuna kikhom Philistine te agahchou laijun, Israel miho chu ajam mang taovin;
target: Next to him was Eleazar son of Dodai the Ahohite. As one of the three mighty warriors, he was with David when they taunted the Philistines gathered at Pas Dammim for battle. Then the Israelites retreated,

source: Chuin ama akipatdoh-in, chemjam le akhut kikhen louvin, akhut angoi tokahsen Philistine te chu athatnin ahi. Chule hicheni chun Pakaiyin nasatah-in gal ajosah-un; chule mipi chu ama nunga thil kichom dingin akileuvin ahi.
target: but Eleazar stood his ground and struck down the Philistines till his hand grew tired and froze to the sword. The Lord brought about a great victory that day. The troops returned to Eleazar, but only to strip the dead.

source: Chule ama bantah-a chu Harar mi Agee chapa Shammah ahi. Chuin Philistine te chu louthul dimsetna gambih khatna apunin akikhom khomun: chule mipi chu Philistinete-a konin ajamtaovin ahi.
target: Next to him was Shammah son of Agee the Hararite. When the Philistines banded together at a place where there was a field full of lentils, Israel’s troops fled from them.

source: Ahinla ama loujao lailunga chun adingin, ngahtupmin apangin, chule Philistine te chu athatnin ahi. Hichun Pakaiyin nasatah-in agaljo sah-in ahi.
target: But Shammah took his stand in the middle of the field. He defended it and struck the Philistines down, and the Lord brought about a great victory.

source: Chule lamkai pipui somthum lah-a thum chu achesuh-un, chuin chang at laijin Adullam songkoa David henga ahungun: chule Philistine te sepaiho chun Rephaim phaichama gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: During harvest time, three of the thirty chief warriors came down to David at the cave of Adullam, while a band of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.

source: Chule David chu kosung khatna aumin, chule Philistine te sepaihon chu Bethlehem'a umuva ahi.
target: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the Philistine garrison was at Bethlehem.

source: Chuin David'in ngaicha tah-in, Ohe Bethlehem kotpi phungkom twikul'a twi chu dondin mi khat touvin eihung pethei taveleh! ati.
target: David longed for water and said, “Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!”

source: Chuin mihat thumho chun Philistine janelho lahchu aphujalun, Bethlehem kotpi phung koma um twikul'a twi chu athalun, chule David henga ahindomun ahi. Ahijeng vangin aman hichu adonpon, ahinla aman Pakai henga asunglhatan ahi.
target: So the three mighty warriors broke through the Philistine lines, drew water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem and carried it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out before the Lord .

source: Chule aman, Vo Pakai hiche kabol dinghi keija konin gamlahen: hiche ahinkhou tijat umtah-a dinga phaldoh miho thisan hilou ham? ati. Hijeh-a chu aman adon tapon ahi. Hiche mihat thumho hin hicheho hi aboldoh-u ahi.
target: “Far be it from me, Lord , to do this!” he said. “Is it not the blood of men who went at the risk of their lives?” And David would not drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty warriors.

source: Chule Zeruiah chapa Joab sopipa Abishai chu thumho lah-a apipuipen ahi. Chuin aman mi jathum dounan atengcha chu alamin, amaho chu athatnin, chuin thumho lah-a chun aminthang tan ahi.
target: Abishai the brother of Joab son of Zeruiah was chief of the Three. He raised his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed, and so he became as famous as the Three.

source: Amachu thumho lah-a ja umpen hilouham? Hijeh chun ama amaho gallamkai ahitai. Hijongle amasa thumho lah-a chun apang phapon ahi.
target: Was he not held in greater honor than the Three? He became their commander, even though he was not included among them.

source: Chule Kabzeel'a mihangtah khat chapa Jehoiada chapa Benaiah, thil tamtah tongdohpa chun, keipi bahkai tobang Moab mini athatnin ahi. Chule aman buh lhahlaijin achesuh-in, kotong sung khatna keipi bahkai khat jong athatnin ahi.
target: Benaiah son of Jehoiada, a valiant fighter from Kabzeel, performed great exploits. He struck down Moab’s two mightiest warriors. He also went down into a pit on a snowy day and killed a lion.

source: Chuin aman Egypt mi miphatah khat athatne: Egypt mipa chun akhutna tengcha akichoi ahin, hinlah aman tenggol khat achoijin achesuh-in, Egypt mipa khutna konchun tengcha chu alahpeh-in, ama tengcha mama-a chun ama chu athatnin ahi.
target: And he struck down a huge Egyptian. Although the Egyptian had a spear in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club. He snatched the spear from the Egyptian’s hand and killed him with his own spear.

source: Jehoiada chapa Benaiah'in hiche thilhohi anabolin, chule mihat thumho lah-a chun ama aminthang tan ahi.
target: Such were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada; he too was as famous as the three mighty warriors.

source: Amachu somthum hosangin ja aum cheh-in, ahinla amasa thumho chu aphapon ahi. Chuin David'in ama ngahtupho chungvuma akoitan ahi.
target: He was held in greater honor than any of the Thirty, but he was not included among the Three. And David put him in charge of his bodyguard.

source: Joab sopipa Ashahel chu somthum holah-a khat ahin; Bethlehem'a um Dodo chapa Elhanan,
target: Among the Thirty were: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo from Bethlehem,

source: Harod mi Shammah, Harod mi Elika,
target: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

source: Palt mi Helez, Teko mi Ikkesh chapa Ira,
target: Helez the Paltite, Ira son of Ikkesh from Tekoa,

source: Anathoth mi Abiezer, Hushath mi Mebunnai,
target: Abiezer from Anathoth, Sibbekai the Hushathite,

source: Ahoh mi Zalmon, Netophah mi Maharai,
target: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

source: Netophah mi Baanah chapa Heleb, Benjamin gam Gibeah'a kona Ribai chapa Ittai,
target: Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah in Benjamin,

source: Pirathon mi Benaiah, Gaash vacha dungho-a kon Hiddai.
target: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai from the ravines of Gaash,

source: Arbath mi Abialbon, Bahur mi Azmaveth,
target: Abi-Albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

source: Shaalhon mi Eliahba, Jashen chapate lah-a Jonathan,
target: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan

source: Harar mi Shammah, Harar mi Sharar chapa Ahiam,
target: son of Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam son of Sharar the Hararite,

source: Maachath chapa, Ahasbai chapa Eliphelet, Gilon mi Ahithophel chapa Eliam,
target: Eliphelet son of Ahasbai the Maakathite, Eliam son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

source: Karmel mi Hezrai, Arbai mi Paarai,
target: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

source: Zobah'a Nathan chapa Igal, Gad mi Bani,
target: Igal son of Nathan from Zobah, the son of Hagri,

source: Ammon mi Zelek, Zeruiah chapa Joab galvonpopa Beeroth mi Naharai,
target: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah,

source: Ithrite mi Ira le Ithrite mi Gareb,
target: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite

source: Hit mi Uriah ahiuvin, abonun mi somthum le sagi ahiove.
target: and Uriah the Hittite. There were thirty-seven in all.

source: Chuin Pakai lunghanna chu Israelte dounan ahung koujah kittan, chuin amaho douna-a David atilin, Chenlang, Israel le Judah gasimin, atisah-in ahi.
target: Again the anger of the Lord burned against Israel, and he incited David against them, saying, “Go and take a census of Israel and Judah.”

source: Ajehchu lengpan aumkhompi janel gal lamkaipa Joab henga, Amijat kahet theina dingin, tun chenlang Israel phungho jouse Dan'a pat Beersheba geijin gasimin, ati.
target: So the king said to Joab and the army commanders with him, “Go throughout the tribes of Israel from Dan to Beersheba and enroll the fighting men, so that I may know how many there are.”

source: Chuin Joab'in lengpa henga, Ka pakai lengpa mitnin amutheina dingin, Pakai na-Pathen'in amaho ijat hijeng jongleu ajat jakhat-in punsah hen: ahinla ipi dinga ka pakai lengpan hiche hohi nangaichat ham? ati.
target: But Joab replied to the king, “May the Lord your God multiply the troops a hundred times over, and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king want to do such a thing?”

source: Ahijeng vangin lengpa thu chu Joable janel lamkaiho chu anehjou jotan ahi. Chuin Joab le janel lamkaiho chu lengpa mitmu tah-in Israel mipi ho sim dingin apotdoh taovin ahi.
target: The king’s word, however, overruled Joab and the army commanders; so they left the presence of the king to enroll the fighting men of Israel.

source: Chuin amaho Jordan agalkaijun, Gad vachadung koma uma khopi jetlam Jazer langsang Aroer mun'a chun ponbuh asong taovin ahi.
target: After crossing the Jordan, they camped near Aroer, south of the town in the gorge, and then went through Gad and on to Jazer.

source: Chujouvin amaho Gilead le Tahtim-hodshi gam ahung lhungun; chuin amaho Dan-jaan le Zidon veldung ahung lhungun,
target: They went to Gilead and the region of Tahtim Hodshi, and on to Dan Jaan and around toward Sidon.

source: Chule Tyre kulpi dettah le Hiv mite khopi jouse le Canaan miho khopi jouse-a ahungun: chuin amaho Judah lhang lamsang Beersheba changeijin acheuvin ahi.
target: Then they went toward the fortress of Tyre and all the towns of the Hivites and Canaanites. Finally, they went on to Beersheba in the Negev of Judah.

source: Hitichun amaho agamsung jouse-a acheleuvin, lhakole nisomni alhinin amaho Jerusalem ahung lhungun ahi
target: After they had gone through the entire land, they came back to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

source: Chuin Joab'in mipi akisimdoh jat chu lengpa apedohtan: chule Israelte lah-a chun mihangsan chemjam lamthei cheh sang jaget aumin, chule Judah miho lah-a chun mi sangjanga aume.
target: Joab reported the number of the fighting men to the king: In Israel there were eight hundred thousand able-bodied men who could handle a sword, and in Judah five hundred thousand.

source: Chuin aman mipi asimjou phatnin David chu alung nalheh jengin ahi. Chuin David'in Pakai henga, Kana thilbol chungahin kachonse lheh jengtai: chule Vo Pakai, tu-a hi nahenga katao ahi, nasoh khangit lounahi ladoh in; ajehchu keiman ngolhoi tah-in na kanatongin ahi, ati.
target: David was conscience-stricken after he had counted the fighting men, and he said to the Lord , “I have sinned greatly in what I have done. Now, Lord , I beg you, take away the guilt of your servant. I have done a very foolish thing.”

source: Tun David jingkah-a ahungtho phatnin, Pakai thu chu David mitvah neipa Gad themgao henga ahungin, aseije,
target: Before David got up the next morning, the word of the Lord had come to Gad the prophet, David’s seer:

source: Chenlang David henga, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, keiman nangma thil thum kapei, nachunga kalhunsah dingin, thumlah-a hin khat penpen kilhenin, tin gaseijin ati.
target: “Go and tell David, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am giving you three options. Choose one of them for me to carry out against you.’ ”

source: Hitichun Gad David henga ahungin, amachu aseipeh-in, ajah-a, Nagam sunga kum sagi kel hunglha ding ham? ahiloule nangma namelmate masanga lhathum najama amahon nanung adeldiu ham? ahiloule nagamsunga hiset nithum lang dingham? Tun eihinsolpa henga kakilea kadonbut theina dingin neihilin, ati.
target: So Gad went to David and said to him, “Shall there come on you three years of famine in your land? Or three months of fleeing from your enemies while they pursue you? Or three days of plague in your land? Now then, think it over and decide how I should answer the one who sent me.”

source: Chuin David'in Gad henga, Keima nasatah in kagenthei tai; tun eiho Pakai khutna kipelut jenguhite; ajehchu amihepina alenin ahi: chule mihem khutna vang lutpou hite, ati.
target: David said to Gad, “I am in deep distress. Let us fall into the hands of the Lord , for his mercy is great; but do not let me fall into human hands.”

source: Hitichun Pakaiyin jingkah-a pat, aphat kitep geichun Israelte lah-a chun natset alhahsah tan ahi. Chutichun mipi lah-a konin Dan'a pat Beersheba geijin mi sangsomsagi athitan ahi.
target: So the Lord sent a plague on Israel from that morning until the end of the time designated, and seventy thousand of the people from Dan to Beersheba died.

source: Chuin Jerusalem suhmangna dinga vantil'in achunga akhut alap phatnin, Pakaiyin thilphalou abolgotna konin alung aheijin, mipi sumang ding vantil henga chun, Aphaset tai: nakhut chu tuhtang tan, ati. Chuin Pakai vantil chu Jebus mi Araunah pholla chun aumin ahi.
target: When the angel stretched out his hand to destroy Jerusalem, the Lord relented concerning the disaster and said to the angel who was afflicting the people, “Enough! Withdraw your hand.” The angel of the Lord was then at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

source: Chuin David'in mipi ho sumang dinga vantil chu amuphatnin, Pakai henga, Ven keima giloutah-in kanachonin, kachonse tai: ahinla hiche kelngoiho hin ipiham abollu? nahenga katao ahi, nakhut chu keima le kapa insung dounan chujohen, ati.
target: When David saw the angel who was striking down the people, he said to the Lord , “I have sinned; I, the shepherd, have done wrong. These are but sheep. What have they done? Let your hand fall on me and my family.”

source: Chule hicheni chun David henga Gad ahungin, ajah-a, Kipatdoh-in, Jebus mi Araunah pholmuna khun Pakai dingin maicham khat gasemin, ati.
target: On that day Gad went to David and said to him, “Go up and build an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.”

source: Chuin Pakai thupeh le Gad seidung juijin David achetoutan ahi.
target: So David went up, as the Lord had commanded through Gad.

source: Chuin Araunah'in aven ahile lengpa le asohte chu ahenglama ahung amun ahi. Chuin Araunah chu achedoh-in, lengpa masanga chun tolla amai asulut tan ahi.
target: When Araunah looked and saw the king and his officials coming toward him, he went out and bowed down before the king with his face to the ground.

source: Chuin Araunah'in, Ipi dinga ka pakai lengpa hi asoh henga hunga ham? ati. Chuin David'in, Mipi ho-a kona natset suhtanga aumna dinga, Pakaiya dinga maicham khat semna dinga nachangphol chodinga hunga kahi, ati.
target: Araunah said, “Why has my lord the king come to his servant?” “To buy your threshing floor,” David answered, “so I can build an altar to the Lord , that the plague on the people may be stopped.”

source: Chuin Araunah'in David henga, Ka pakai lengpan aman phante atibang chun kilah henlang pejenghen: Ven, hikoma hin govam thilto-a toding bongchal, chule thinga manding changphola manchah ho le bongchal manchah dangho aumin ahi.
target: Araunah said to David, “Let my lord the king take whatever he wishes and offer it up. Here are oxen for the burnt offering, and here are threshing sledges and ox yokes for the wood.

source: Hicheho jousehi Araunah'in lengpa dinga abola apehdoh ahi, ati. Chuin Araunah'in lengpa henga, Pakai na-Pathen'in nasanpehhen, ati.
target: Your Majesty, Araunah gives all this to the king.” Araunah also said to him, “May the Lord your God accept you.”

source: Chuin lengpan Araunah henga, Ahipoi, keiman thonlouva nangma-a kona aman uma kachoh ding ahi: chule keiman imacha suhmang louhela Pakai ka-Pathen henga govam thilto katolou ding ahi, ati. Hitichun David'in changphol le bongchalho chu dangka shekel somnga in achotan ahi.
target: But the king replied to Araunah, “No, I insist on paying you for it. I will not sacrifice to the Lord my God burnt offerings that cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen and paid fifty shekels of silver for them.

source: Chuin David'in hia chun Pakaiya dingin maicham khat asemin, govam thilto hole chamna thiltoho atohtan ahi. Hitichun Pakaiyin gamsung taona chu angaipeh-in, chule Israelte lah-a konin natset chu akitolmang tan ahi.
target: David built an altar to the Lord there and sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. Then the Lord answered his prayer in behalf of the land, and the plague on Israel was stopped.

source: Tun leng David chu ateh-in kum tamtah ahitan, chuin pon tamtah asilpeh-un, ahinla lum asajoupoi.
target: When King David was very old, he could not keep warm even when they put covers over him.

source: Hijeh chun asohten ahenga, ka pakai lengpa dingin khangdong nungah theng khat kihol hen, amanu lengpa anga dinghen lang, vesuihen lang, chule ka pakai lengpa tilumthei nadin, na-anga lumjihen, atiuve.
target: So his attendants said to him, “Let us look for a young virgin to serve the king and take care of him. She can lie beside him so that our lord the king may keep warm.”

source: Chutichun amahon Israel gamsung pumpi-a nungah hoitah khat aholuvin ahile, Shunam mi Abishag amuvin, lengpa henga ahinpui taove.
target: Then they searched throughout Israel for a beautiful young woman and found Abishag, a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

source: Nungahnu chu ahoilheh jengin, lengpa chu avesuijin, ajenletan ahi. Ahinla lengpan amanu chu akitimatpi pon ahi.
target: The woman was very beautiful; she took care of the king and waited on him, but the king had no sexual relations with her.

source: Chuphatnin Haggith chapa Adonijah chu ama akichoisangin, keima kalengchan ding ahi, tin kangtalai ho le sakol touthemho, chule mi somnga amasanga lhaidin akigottan ahi.
target: Now Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith, put himself forward and said, “I will be king.” So he got chariots and horses ready, with fifty men to run ahead of him.

source: Chule apan, ibola hitobang nabol ham? tin adongin alungnatsah khapoi. Amapa hi mi melhoitah jong ahin, anun Absalom nunga ahin ahi.
target: (His father had never rebuked him by asking, “Why do you behave as you do?” He was also very handsome and was born next after Absalom.)

source: Chule aman Zeruiah chapa Joab le Abiathar thempu chu ana kihoutoh pin, chule amanin Adonijah ajoplhonin, akithopi lhonin ahi.
target: Adonijah conferred with Joab son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest, and they gave him their support.

source: Ahinla Zadok thempu, Jehoida chapa Benaiah, Nathan themgao, Shimai, Rei chule David mihangsan ho vangchu Adonijah toh apangkhom pouvin ahi.
target: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei and Rei and David’s special guard did not join Adonijah.

source: Chuin Adonijah'in kelngoiho, bongchalho, chule gancha thao ho Enrogel koma um Zohaleth songpi chunga chun athatnin; leng chapate asopiho jouse le Judah gama lengpa lhachaho jouse akouvin;
target: Adonijah then sacrificed sheep, cattle and fattened calves at the Stone of Zoheleth near En Rogel. He invited all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the royal officials of Judah,

source: Ahin Nathan themgao, Benaiah, mihangsan ho le asopipa Solomon vang akoupon ahi.
target: but he did not invite Nathan the prophet or Benaiah or the special guard or his brother Solomon.

source: Hijeh chun Nathan'in Solomon nu Bethsheba jah-a, Haggith chapa Adonijah alengchana, ipu David'in ahetlou khu najahdoh louham?
target: Then Nathan asked Bathsheba, Solomon’s mother, “Have you not heard that Adonijah, the son of Haggith, has become king, and our lord David knows nothing about it?

source: Hijeh chun tun hungin, katao ahi, nangmatah hinkhole nachapa Solomon hinkho huhdoh theina din thumopming kate.
target: Now then, let me advise you how you can save your own life and the life of your son Solomon.

source: Leng David henga lutnin lang, ajah-a, kapu vo lengpa nasohnu henga thonlouva nachapa Solomon kakhela lengchanga, kalaltouna-a touding ahi tia nana kihahsel hilouham? Ibola Adonijah lengchanga hitam? tin gaseijin ati.
target: Go in to King David and say to him, ‘My lord the king, did you not swear to me your servant: “Surely Solomon your son shall be king after me, and he will sit on my throne”? Why then has Adonijah become king?’

source: Vetan, lengpa toh nakihou laitahle, keima jong nanunga hunging ting, nathusei kahung suhdet ding ahi, ati.
target: While you are still there talking to the king, I will come in and add my word to what you have said.”

source: Chuin Bethsheba chu lengpa henga indan sunga chun aluttai. Lengpa chu atehlheh jengtan, chule Shunam mi Abishag chun lengpa chu ajenlen ahi.
target: So Bathsheba went to see the aged king in his room, where Abishag the Shunammite was attending him.

source: Chuin Bethsheba chu aboh khupmin, lengpa chu janan chibai abohtai. Chuin lengpan, ipi nangaichat ham? anati.
target: Bathsheba bowed down, prostrating herself before the king. “What is it you want?” the king asked.

source: Amanun ajah-a, ka pakai, nangman nasohnu henga Pakai na Pathen min panin, kanungle nachapa Solomon thonlouva lengchanga, kalaltouna chunga touding ahi, tin nana kihahsel in ahi.
target: She said to him, “My lord, you yourself swore to me your servant by the Lord your God: ‘Solomon your son shall be king after me, and he will sit on my throne.’

source: Chule tun, vetan, Adonijah alengchang tan; chule tun, ka pakai lengpan hichu nahepoi.
target: But now Adonijah has become king, and you, my lord the king, do not know about it.

source: Aman bongchalho, gancha thao ho, chule kelngoiho nengtah-in athatnin; lengpa chapate jousele Abiathar thempu chule sepai janel gallamkai Joab akouvin, ahin nasoh Solomon vang akoupon ahi.
target: He has sacrificed great numbers of cattle, fattened calves, and sheep, and has invited all the king’s sons, Abiathar the priest and Joab the commander of the army, but he has not invited Solomon your servant.

source: Chule nangma, ka pakai, vo lengpa, nangma nunga ka pakai laltouna-a chu koi hungtou dingham ti naseipeh dingu ngah-in, Israel chate jouse mit chu nangma chunga aume.
target: My lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, to learn from you who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

source: Achutiloule hung hitiding ahi, ka pakai lengpa hi apu apate toh ahung lupkhom tengle, keile kachapa Solomon hi mi kisuhmosah-a eiki simlhon ding ahi, ati.
target: Otherwise, as soon as my lord the king is laid to rest with his ancestors, I and my son Solomon will be treated as criminals.”

source: Chule veuvin, amanu lengpa toh akihou petnin, Nathan themgao jong chu ahunglut tan ahi.
target: While she was still speaking with the king, Nathan the prophet arrived.

source: Chuin amahon lengpa ahilun, Nathan themgao ahunge, atiuve. Ama lengpa ang ahunglut phatnin lengpa anga akunin amai tolah asulut tai.
target: And the king was told, “Nathan the prophet is here.” So he went before the king and bowed with his face to the ground.

source: Chuin Nathan'in aseijin, ka pakai, vo ka lengpa, nangman kanungle Adonijah hi kalaltouna-a touding, chuleh vai ahomding ahi tia naseikhah ham?
target: Nathan said, “Have you, my lord the king, declared that Adonijah shall be king after you, and that he will sit on your throne?

source: Ajehchu ama tuni hin achesuh-in, bongchalle gancha thao chule kelngoi nengtah-in athatnin, leng chapate jouse, janel gallamkai, chule Abiathar thempu akouvin; chule vetan, amasanga aneuvin adonun, Pathen'in Adonijah lengpa huhhing hen atiuve.
target: Today he has gone down and sacrificed great numbers of cattle, fattened calves, and sheep. He has invited all the king’s sons, the commanders of the army and Abiathar the priest. Right now they are eating and drinking with him and saying, ‘Long live King Adonijah!’

source: Ahinla keima, nasoh keimatah jengjong, chule Zadok thempu, Jehoida chapa Benaiah, chule nasoh Solomon vang akoupon ahi.
target: But me your servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon he did not invite.

source: Hiche thilhi kapu lengpan nabol hija, kapu lengpa nunga alaltouna chunga koi atouding nasohpa henga nahetsah lou khattou ham? atin ahi.
target: Is this something my lord the king has done without letting his servants know who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?”

source: Chuphatnin David lengpan adonbutnin, Bethsheba chu kahenga dingin hinkou lutnun, ati. Chutichun amanu lengpa angsunga ahunglutnin, lengpa angah adingtai.
target: Then King David said, “Call in Bathsheba.” So she came into the king’s presence and stood before him.

source: Chuin lengpa akihahselin, lung gentheina jouse-a kona kahinna eilhatdoh jingjeng Pakai chu ahinjing bangin,
target: The king then took an oath: “As surely as the Lord lives, who has delivered me out of every trouble,

source: Keiman nahenga Pakai Israel Pathen mina kana kihahsela, thonlouva nachapa Solomon keima nunga lengchanga, keima khela kalaltouna chunga touding ahi, tia kanasei banga, tunikho-a hi chutia chu kabol tahbeh ding ahi, ati.
target: I will surely carry out this very day what I swore to you by the Lord , the God of Israel: Solomon your son shall be king after me, and he will sit on my throne in my place.”

source: Chuphatnin Bethsheba'in amai tolah asulutnin, lengpa jana apen, kapu David lengpa a-imatih-in hingjing hen, ati.
target: Then Bathsheba bowed down with her face to the ground, prostrating herself before the king, and said, “May my lord King David live forever!”

source: Chuin David lengpan Zadok thempu, Nathan themgao, chule Jehoiadah chapa Benaiah chu kahenga dingin hinkoulut nun ati. Chuin amaho lengpa henga ahungtaovin ahi.
target: King David said, “Call in Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet and Benaiah son of Jehoiada.” When they came before the king,

source: Lengpan jong amaho henga, napu sohte hi puijun lang, kachapa Solomon chu kasakol chunga tousah unlang, Gihon'a puisuh-un;
target: he said to them: “Take your lord’s servants with you and have Solomon my son mount my own mule and take him down to Gihon.

source: Chule Zadok thempupa le Nathan themgaovin hikoma chun Israel chunga leng dingin thao nulhon hen; chule nanghon sumkon mut un lang, Solomon lengpa Pathen'in huhhing hen, tiuvin.
target: There have Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him king over Israel. Blow the trumpet and shout, ‘Long live King Solomon!’

source: Chujoule ama kalaltouna-a atoutheina dingin, nanghon anung hinjui touvun; ajehchu kei khella ama lenga pangding ahi. Chule keiman ama Israel le Judah chunga vaipo dinga katun ahitai, ati.
target: Then you are to go up with him, and he is to come and sit on my throne and reign in my place. I have appointed him ruler over Israel and Judah.”

source: Chuin Jahoiada chapa Benaiah chun lengpa adonbutnin, Amen, kapu lengpa Pakai Pathen'in jong chutichun seihen.
target: Benaiah son of Jehoiada answered the king, “Amen! May the Lord , the God of my lord the king, so declare it.

source: Pakaiyin kapu lengpa anaumpi bangin, Solomon jong umpi henlang, alaltouna chu kapu David laltouna sanga lenjon sempeh hen, ati.
target: As the Lord was with my lord the king, so may he be with Solomon to make his throne even greater than the throne of my lord King David!”

source: Hitichun Zadok thempu, Nathan themgao, Jahoiada chapa Benaiah, Chereth mite, chule Paleth mite achesuh-un, David lengpa sakol chunga chun Solomon atousah-un, Gihon'a ahinpui taovin ahi.
target: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, the Kerethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon mount King David’s mule, and they escorted him to Gihon.

source: Chuin Zadok thempu chun houbuh-a konin thao koina saki khat aladoh-in, Solomon chu anutai. Chuin amahon sumkon amutnun; mijouse chun, Pathen'in Solomon lengpa huhhing hen, atiuve.
target: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the sacred tent and anointed Solomon. Then they sounded the trumpet and all the people shouted, “Long live King Solomon!”

source: Chuin mipi jouse anunga akitol touvun, mipin kuli amutnun, hachangpan akipah-un, hitichun ahusaovin leiset akithing leovin ahi.
target: And all the people went up after him, playing pipes and rejoicing greatly, so that the ground shook with the sound.

source: Chuin Adonijah le ajinho jousen a-anneh jouvun hichu ajataovin ahi. Chuin Joab'in sumkon gin ajah phatnin, ipidinga khopi sunga awgin kithong lenglung ham? atin ahi.
target: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they were finishing their feast. On hearing the sound of the trumpet, Joab asked, “What’s the meaning of all the noise in the city?”

source: Aman hichu asei nalaijin, veuvin, Abiathar thempu chapa Jonathan ahunge; chuin Adonijah'in ajah-a, hunglutnin, nang mihangsan nahin, kipanathu nahinpoi, ati.
target: Even as he was speaking, Jonathan son of Abiathar the priest arrived. Adonijah said, “Come in. A worthy man like you must be bringing good news.”

source: Chuin Jonathan'in Adonijah adonbutnin, tahbeh-in ipu David'in Solomon lengin asemtai, ati.
target: “Not at all!” Jonathan answered. “Our lord King David has made Solomon king.

source: Chule lengpan Zadok thempu, Nathan themgao, Jehoiada chapa Benaiah, Chereth mite, chule Peleth mite chu amatoh asolin, amahon amachu lengpa sakol chunga atousah-un;
target: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, the Kerethites and the Pelethites, and they have put him on the king’s mule,

source: Zadok thempu le Nathan themgaovin amachu Gihon'a lengdin thao anulhonin, amaho chua kona thanom tah-a hungtou uva, hijeh-a chu ahusan uva khopi kithonga ahi. Nanghon najah-u hi hiche husa chu ahi.
target: and Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king at Gihon. From there they have gone up cheering, and the city resounds with it. That’s the noise you hear.

source: Chule Solomon jong lenggam laltouna achun atoutan ahi.
target: Moreover, Solomon has taken his seat on the royal throne.

source: Chukalvalin lengpa sohte chu ipu David lengpa phattheiboh dingin ahungun, Pathen'in nangma min sangin Solomon min chu kithansah johenlang, chule alaltouna chu nangma laltouna sanga lenjon semhen atiuve. Chule lengpa chu alupna chunga akunjin ahi.
target: Also, the royal officials have come to congratulate our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make Solomon’s name more famous than yours and his throne greater than yours!’ And the king bowed in worship on his bed

source: Chule lengpan jong, kamitnin amu petna, tunikho-a kalaltouna-a touding mikhat eipe-a Israel Pakai Pathen chu nunnom hen, tin aseije, ati.
target: and said, ‘Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who has allowed my eyes to see a successor on my throne today.’ ”

source: Chuin Adonijah toh umkhom ajinho jouse akicha taovin, akipat doh-un, mijouse amadoncheh-a achedoh taove.
target: At this, all Adonijah’s guests rose in alarm and dispersed.

source: Chule Adonijah chu Solomon jeh-in atijan, akipatnin, achen, maicham ki hochu atuh dentan ahi.
target: But Adonijah, in fear of Solomon, went and took hold of the horns of the altar.

source: Chuin hichu Solomon aseipeh-un, veuvin, Adonijah'in Solomon lengpa akichatai; ajehchu, vetan, aman maicham ki hochu atuh-in, Solomon lengpan asohpa chemjam'a atha louna dingin tuni hin kahenga kihahsel hen atie, atiuve.
target: Then Solomon was told, “Adonijah is afraid of King Solomon and is clinging to the horns of the altar. He says, ‘Let King Solomon swear to me today that he will not put his servant to death with the sword.’ ”

source: Chuin Solomon'in, aman mi tahsan um ahina avetsah-a ahile asamjang khat jong tolla lhalou ding ahi; amavang ama-a khangitlouna akimu dohle, thiteiding ahi, ati.
target: Solomon replied, “If he shows himself to be worthy, not a hair of his head will fall to the ground; but if evil is found in him, he will die.”

source: Chutichun leng Solomon chun mi asolin, amahon maichama konin ahin puisuh taove. Chuin ama ahungsuh-in Solomon henga chun abohkhuptan; chuin Solomon'in ajah-a, na inlama chetan, ati.
target: Then King Solomon sent men, and they brought him down from the altar. And Adonijah came and bowed down to King Solomon, and Solomon said, “Go to your home.”

source: Tun David thi nading nikho chu anaitan; aman achapa Solomon chu athupeh-in, ajah-a,
target: When the time drew near for David to die, he gave a charge to Solomon his son.

source: Keima leiset pumpi chena lampi-a chu cheding kahitai; hijeh chun hatninlang, pasal nahina chu tahlangin.
target: “I am about to go the way of all the earth,” he said. “So be strong, act like a man,

source: Chule Pakai na Pathen thupeh chu nit jingin; Mosi lekhabua kisun bangin alampiho juijin, adan kisunho, adan thupeh ho, athutan lhahho le, ahetthohsahna ho nitjingin; chutile nakihei nalam jouse le nabol jouse-a naphatthei ding;
target: and observe what the Lord your God requires: Walk in obedience to him, and keep his decrees and commands, his laws and regulations, as written in the Law of Moses. Do this so that you may prosper in all you do and wherever you go

source: Chutiachu Pakaiyin keima chungchanga, nachaten alung pumpiu le ahinna pumpiuva kamasanga thutah-a achonna dinguva, akalsona lampi houva achihthei uva ahile, Israel laltouna-a touding kiphasam louva nanei ding ahi, tia anaseichu aguilhunsah ding ahi.
target: and that the Lord may keep his promise to me: ‘If your descendants watch how they live, and if they walk faithfully before me with all their heart and soul, you will never fail to have a successor on the throne of Israel.’

source: Chukal vallin Zeruiah chapa Joab'in kachunga athilbol, chule Israel janel gallamkai teni, Ner chapa Abner le Jether chapa Amasa atha-a, achung hona athilbol; chamna aumlaija gal thisan aso-a, akonga agah konggah chungle akenga akibu kengkoh chunga gal thisan anu chu nangman nahen ahi.
target: “Now you yourself know what Joab son of Zeruiah did to me—what he did to the two commanders of Israel’s armies, Abner son of Ner and Amasa son of Jether. He killed them, shedding their blood in peacetime as if in battle, and with that blood he stained the belt around his waist and the sandals on his feet.

source: Hijeh chun nachihna bangtah-in bolinlang, alukan nung hijongle lungmong tah-in lhankhuh-a chesuhsah hih-in.
target: Deal with him according to your wisdom, but do not let his gray head go down to the grave in peace.

source: Ahinla Gilead mite Barzilai chapate henga chun lungsetna chu musah inlang, nadokhanga an neho lah-a chun amahochu ankong umsah-in; ajehchu nasopipa Absalom jeh-a kajamle laijin kakoma ahungun ahi.
target: “But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai of Gilead and let them be among those who eat at your table. They stood by me when I fled from your brother Absalom.

source: Chule ven, Mahanaim'a kache petna gaosapna khohtah eina gaosap, Bahurim'a cheng Benjamin son Gera chapa Shimei chu nahenga uma ahi. Ahinla Jordan'ah eikimupidin ahungsuh-in, keiman Pakai minin kahahselin, chemjamin that ponge kanatin ahi.
target: “And remember, you have with you Shimei son of Gera, the Benjamite from Bahurim, who called down bitter curses on me the day I went to Mahanaim. When he came down to meet me at the Jordan, I swore to him by the Lord : ‘I will not put you to death by the sword.’

source: Hijeh chun tun ama mona beijin koihih-in; ajehchu miching nahin, achunga ipi bolding ahi nahenai; Ahin alukan nung hijongle thisan puma lhankhuh najotsah ding ahi, ati.
target: But now, do not consider him innocent. You are a man of wisdom; you will know what to do to him. Bring his gray head down to the grave in blood.”

source: Chutichun David chu apu apate toh analum khomin, David khopi-a anavuitaove.
target: Then David rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David.

source: Chule David'in Israelte chunga lengvai anapoh sung chu kum somli ahin, Hebron'ah kum sagi analeng changin, Jerusalem'a kum somthum le kumthum ana lengchange.
target: He had reigned forty years over Israel—seven years in Hebron and thirty-three in Jerusalem.

source: Chujouvin Solomon chu apa David laltouna-a atouvin; chule alenggam lentah-in anaki phutdoh tai.
target: So Solomon sat on the throne of his father David, and his rule was firmly established.

source: Chuin Haggith chapa Adonijah chu Solomon nu Bethsheba henga ahungin ahi. Amanun ajah-a, chamdela nahung hinam? tin adongin ahile, amapan, chamdelin kahung nai, ati.
target: Now Adonijah, the son of Haggith, went to Bathsheba, Solomon’s mother. Bathsheba asked him, “Do you come peacefully?” He answered, “Yes, peacefully.”

source: Chukalvalin aman amanu jah-a, nahenga seinom themkhat kaneije, ati. Amanun ajah-a, seijin, ati.
target: Then he added, “I have something to say to you.” “You may say it,” she replied.

source: Hichun amapan, lenggam chu keija ahi-a, chule Israelte jousen jong keima lengvai poding ahi tia eivet cheh-u ahi ti nangman nahenai; hijongle lenggam chu akiheidoh-in, kasopipa-a ahunghitai. Ajehchu Pakaiya kona hichu ama-a hija ahi.
target: “As you know,” he said, “the kingdom was mine. All Israel looked to me as their king. But things changed, and the kingdom has gone to my brother; for it has come to him from the Lord .

source: Chule tun nahenga ngehnom khat kaneijin, nei itpeh hihbeh-in, ati. Chuin amanun, seijin, ati.
target: Now I have one request to make of you. Do not refuse me.” “You may make it,” she said.

source: Chuin aman katao ahi, Solomon lengpa henga Shunam mi Abishag khu kaji dingin neithum peh-in, (ajeh chu aman nathu nelponte,) ati.
target: So he continued, “Please ask King Solomon—he will not refuse you—to give me Abishag the Shunammite as my wife.”

source: Chuin Bethsheba'n, aphai, lengpa henga nangma-a dingin seipeh nange, ati.
target: “Very well,” Bathsheba replied, “I will speak to the king for you.”

source: Hijeh chun Bethsheba chu Adonijah'a dinga seipeh dingin Solomon lengpa henga achetai. Chuin lengpa amanu kimuto pidin akipatdoh-in, a-anga akunin, chuin alaltouna-a atouvin, chule lengpa nu-a ding chun laltouna ado sah-in; akhutjet lama chun atoutai.
target: When Bathsheba went to King Solomon to speak to him for Adonijah, the king stood up to meet her, bowed down to her and sat down on his throne. He had a throne brought for the king’s mother, and she sat down at his right hand.

source: Chuin amanun ajah-a, nangma henga ngehna neokhat kanei nome; katao ahi, kanompoi neitipeh hih-in, ati. Chuin lengpan amanu henga, thumin, kanu, ajehchu kanompoi tipeh ponge, ati.
target: “I have one small request to make of you,” she said. “Do not refuse me.” The king replied, “Make it, my mother; I will not refuse you.”

source: Chuin amanun, Shunam mi Abishag hi nasopipa Adonijah ji dingin kipehen, ati.
target: So she said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given in marriage to your brother Adonijah.”

source: Chuin leng Solomon'in anu adonbutnin, ibola Shunam mi Abishag chu Adonijah ji dinga nathum ham? ama dingin lenggam jonghi thumin; ajehchu ama ka upa ahi; amadingin, Abiathar thempu dingin, chule Zeruiah chapa Joab dinjong thumin, ati.
target: King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you request Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? You might as well request the kingdom for him—after all, he is my older brother—yes, for him and for Abiathar the priest and Joab son of Zeruiah!”

source: Chujouvin Solomon lengpa Pakaiya akihahselin, Adonijah'in ama hinkho douna-a hiche thuhi aseilou hileh, Pathen'in kachunga chutichun bolhen, chukalvallin jong bolhen.
target: Then King Solomon swore by the Lord : “May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if Adonijah does not pay with his life for this request!

source: Hijeh chun tun, Pakai ahin jing bangin, athutep bangtah-a eitungdoh-a, kapa David laltouna-a eitousah-a, insungkhat eisempehpa mina kahahsel ahi; tunikho-a hi Adonijah thi teitei ding ahi, ati.
target: And now, as surely as the Lord lives—he who has established me securely on the throne of my father David and has founded a dynasty for me as he promised—Adonijah shall be put to death today!”

source: Chuin Solomon lengpan Jehoiada chapa Benaiah chu asolin, ama achunga achun athat tai.
target: So King Solomon gave orders to Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and he struck down Adonijah and he died.

source: Chuin lengpan Abiathar thempu henga, nangma Anathoth kho na inle lou mun'a kichetan, athidinga lom nahi; kapa David masanga Pakai Pathen kitepna thingkhong naput jehle, kapa kibolgimna chana kibolgim nahi jeh-in, tuchunghin thatponge, ati.
target: To Abiathar the priest the king said, “Go back to your fields in Anathoth. You deserve to die, but I will not put you to death now, because you carried the ark of the Sovereign Lord before my father David and shared all my father’s hardships.”

source: Chutichun Pakaiyin Shiloh'a Eli insung thudol anaseichu aguilhunsah theina dingin; Solomon'in Abiathar chu Pakai thempu ahina chu ahaisahtai.
target: So Solomon removed Abiathar from the priesthood of the Lord , fulfilling the word the Lord had spoken at Shiloh about the house of Eli.

source: Chujouvin Joab henga thu ahung lhungtai: ajehchu ama Absalom lama kiheihih jongle Joab chu Adonijah lama akiheija ahi. Hijeh chun Joab chu Pakai houbuh lama ajamin, maicham sakiho chu atuhchah tai.
target: When the news reached Joab, who had conspired with Adonijah though not with Absalom, he fled to the tent of the Lord and took hold of the horns of the altar.

source: Chuin, Joab chu Pakai houbuh lama ajamin, chule ven, maicham koma aume, tin Solomon lengpa aseipeh taove. Hichun Solomon'in Jehoiada chapa Benaiah asolin, chenlang gathatnin, ati.
target: King Solomon was told that Joab had fled to the tent of the Lord and was beside the altar. Then Solomon ordered Benaiah son of Jehoiada, “Go, strike him down!”

source: Chuin Pakai houbuh phunga Benaiah ahungin, ahenga, lengpan hung doh-in ati, tin agaseijin ahi. Ahin aman, kanompoi, hikoma hin thijonge, ati. Chuin Benaiah'in lengpa thu ahetsah kitnin, Joab'in hitin aseijin, hitin eidonbutne, ati.
target: So Benaiah entered the tent of the Lord and said to Joab, “The king says, ‘Come out!’ ” But he answered, “No, I will die here.” Benaiah reported to the king, “This is how Joab answered me.”

source: Chuin lengpan ajah-a, aseibang bangin boljengin, that inlang vuitan; chutile keima le kapa insunga kona monabei thisan Joab'in asochu nalahmang theiding ahi.
target: Then the king commanded Benaiah, “Do as he says. Strike him down and bury him, and so clear me and my whole family of the guilt of the innocent blood that Joab shed.

source: Chule ama sanga dihjo le phajo mini, Ner chapa Abner Israel janel gallamkai le Jether chapa Judah janel gallamkai Amasa chu kapa David hetlouva achemjama athajeh-a, Pakaiyin athisan chu ama luchung tah-a achuhsah ding ahi.
target: The Lord will repay him for the blood he shed, because without my father David knowing it he attacked two men and killed them with the sword. Both of them—Abner son of Ner, commander of Israel’s army, and Amasa son of Jether, commander of Judah’s army—were better men and more upright than he.

source: Hijeh-a chu amani thisan chu Joab luchangle achilhahte luchunga a-itih-a dinga hungkile ding ahin; ahinla David chungle achilhahte chung, insung mite chungle alaltouna chunga vang Pakaiya kona a-itih a chamna leng ding ahi, ati.
target: May the guilt of their blood rest on the head of Joab and his descendants forever. But on David and his descendants, his house and his throne, may there be the Lord ’s peace forever.”

source: Hitichun Jehoiada chapa Benaiah achetouvin, achunga achun, athattai. Chule gamthipma amatah in'a akivui tan ahi.
target: So Benaiah son of Jehoiada went up and struck down Joab and killed him, and he was buried at his home out in the country.

source: Chuin lengpan Jehoida chapa Benaiah chu ama khelin janel chunga vaihomin akoijin; chule Zadok thempu chu Abiathar mun'a akoitan ahi.
target: The king put Benaiah son of Jehoiada over the army in Joab’s position and replaced Abiathar with Zadok the priest.

source: Chuin lengpan Shimei kouding asolin, ajah-a, Jerusalem'a inkhat kisah-in lang chuachun chengin, chua konin hoima danga chedoh hih-in.
target: Then the king sent for Shimei and said to him, “Build yourself a house in Jerusalem and live there, but do not go anywhere else.

source: Ajehchu hitiding ahi, nangma nachedoh-a Kidron vachadung nagalkai ninile, nangma thonlouva nathi teiding ahi ti kihetnin; nathisan chu nangmatah luchunga chuding ahi, ati.
target: The day you leave and cross the Kidron Valley, you can be sure you will die; your blood will be on your own head.”

source: Chuin Shimei'in lengpa henga, akiseichu aphai; kapu lengpan nasei bangin nasohpan bollinge, ati. Chuin Shimei Jerusalem'a nitamtah achengtai.
target: Shimei answered the king, “What you say is good. Your servant will do as my lord the king has said.” And Shimei stayed in Jerusalem for a long time.

source: Chuin kumthum jouvin ahitin ahi, Shimei sohte mini Gath lengpa Maachah chapa Achish henga ajammang lhontai. Chule Shimei koma, ven, nasoh teni Gath'a aumlhone, tin aseipeh taove.
target: But three years later, two of Shimei’s slaves ran off to Achish son of Maakah, king of Gath, and Shimei was told, “Your slaves are in Gath.”

source: Chuin Shimei akipatnin, asangan chunga atouvin, Gath'a Achish henga asohteni hollin achetai; chuin Shimei achen, asohteni chu Gath'a konin ahinpuitai.
target: At this, he saddled his donkey and went to Achish at Gath in search of his slaves. So Shimei went away and brought the slaves back from Gath.

source: Chule Shimei Jerusalem'a konin Gath'a achen, ahungkile kit tai tin Solomon aseipeh taovin ahi.
target: When Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and had returned,

source: Chuin lengpan Shimei kouding mi asolin, ajah-a, keiman Pakai mina kaki hahsel sah-a, nangma napotdoh-a, mundanga navadoh ninileh nathi teiteiding ahi, chentah-in kihetnin, tia kagihsa nahi hilouham? chule nangman kajah-a, kathujah hohi aphai natin ahi.
target: the king summoned Shimei and said to him, “Did I not make you swear by the Lord and warn you, ‘On the day you leave to go anywhere else, you can be sure you will die’? At that time you said to me, ‘What you say is good. I will obey.’

source: Achutile ibola Pakaiya kihahselna le, thupeh kapeh chu nitlouva nahim?
target: Why then did you not keep your oath to the Lord and obey the command I gave you?”

source: Chukal valin lengpan Shimei jah-a, kapa David nabolna gitlouna jouse nahen, nalung gilin nahetpeh-e; hijeh chun nagitlouna chu Pakaiyin nangmatah luchunga achuhsah ding ahi.
target: The king also said to Shimei, “You know in your heart all the wrong you did to my father David. Now the Lord will repay you for your wrongdoing.

source: Chule Leng Solomon vang nunnom mintin, chule leng David laltouna chu Pakai angsunga tonsotna phudetna umding ahi, ati.
target: But King Solomon will be blessed, and David’s throne will remain secure before the Lord forever.”

source: Chuti chun lengpan Jehoiada chapa Benaiah thu apen; ama apotdoh-in, achunga achun, athat tai. Chule lenggam chu Solomon khutna akiphutdet tai.
target: Then the king gave the order to Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and he went out and struck Shimei down and he died. The kingdom was now established in Solomon’s hands.

source: Chuin Solomon'in Egypt lengpa Pharoah toh kihet them tona abolin, Pharoah chanu akichenpin, ama inding, Pakai inding, chule Jerusalem kimvella bang asah chaisoh kahse-a dingin, David khopi sunga chun akipui luttai.
target: Solomon made an alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt and married his daughter. He brought her to the City of David until he finished building his palace and the temple of the Lord , and the wall around Jerusalem.

source: Pakai mina in akisah loulai jeh-in, hiche nikho geija chun mihon munsang ho-a kilhaina abol jiuvin ahi.
target: The people, however, were still sacrificing at the high places, because a temple had not yet been built for the Name of the Lord .

source: Chule Solomon'in Pakai angailun, apa David chonnadan anitjingin; amavang munsang ho-a kilhainale gimnamtui halna aboljin ahi.
target: Solomon showed his love for the Lord by walking according to the instructions given him by his father David, except that he offered sacrifices and burned incense on the high places.

source: Chuin lengpa Gibeon'a ganlhaina boldin achetai; ajehchu hikom munchu munsang thupipen ahi. Solomon'in hiche maicham chunga chun govam thilto sangkhat jen atoh-in ahi.
target: The king went to Gibeon to offer sacrifices, for that was the most important high place, and Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.

source: Gibeon mun'a Pakai chu jan-in Solomon manga ahung kilah-in; chule Pathen'in, thumin ipi kapeh ding nahim, ati.
target: At Gibeon the Lord appeared to Solomon during the night in a dream, and God said, “Ask for whatever you want me to give you.”

source: Chuin Solomon'in, Nangman nasoh kapa David namasanga thutah-a, chonphatna-a, chule lung dihtah pu-a nangma toh aum jeh-in, achunga hepina lentah nanamu sah-in; ama khohsahna jal-in hiche hepina chu nakoi jom jingin, tunikho-a banghin alaltouna-a touding chapa khat nanapetan ahi.
target: Solomon answered, “You have shown great kindness to your servant, my father David, because he was faithful to you and righteous and upright in heart. You have continued this great kindness to him and have given him a son to sit on his throne this very day.

source: Chule tun, vo Pakai ka Pathen, nangman nasohhi kapa David khelin lengin neisemtan, hinla keimala chapang neocha kahin; vaikonje vailhunje helou kahi.
target: “Now, Lord my God, you have made your servant king in place of my father David. But I am only a little child and do not know how to carry out my duties.

source: Chule nasohhi nalhendoh mite, mipi tamtah, atamjeh uva simjouhoi hiloule ajat hetjouhoi hilou lah-a hin kaumme.
target: Your servant is here among the people you have chosen, a great people, too numerous to count or number.

source: Hijeh chun nasohhin, asele apha kakhentoh theija, namite vai kahom thei nadin, hetkhen themna lung neipen; ajehchu hibanga tam namite hi kon vai ahom thei dingham? ati.
target: So give your servant a discerning heart to govern your people and to distinguish between right and wrong. For who is able to govern this great people of yours?”

source: Solomon'in hiche thil athumna-a athuseihin Pakai alunglhaisah lheh jengin ahi.
target: The Lord was pleased that Solomon had asked for this.

source: Chuin Pathen'in ajah-a, nangman hiche thil nathuma, na hinkhosot nading, nahao nading, ahiloule namelmate hinkho ding thumlouva, nangman vaihom themna dinga hetkhenthem theinajoh nathum jeh-in,
target: So God said to him, “Since you have asked for this and not for long life or wealth for yourself, nor have asked for the death of your enemies but for discernment in administering justice,

source: Vetan, nathusei bang bangin kabolpeh tai. Ven, chihna le hetkhenthem theina lungthim kapeh nahitai; chutia chu namasanga jong nangma tobang ana um khalou, chule nanunga jong nangma tobang himhim hung umkit talou ding ahi.
target: I will do what you have asked. I will give you a wise and discerning heart, so that there will never have been anyone like you, nor will there ever be.

source: Chule nahin laise-a lengho lah-a nangma tobang himhim aum louhel nadingin, nangman nathumlou haonale jabolna jong kapehthan ahi
target: Moreover, I will give you what you have not asked for—both wealth and honor—so that in your lifetime you will have no equal among kings.

source: Chule kadan kisunho le kadan thupeh ho nanitna, napa David'in ajui banga, kalampiho najuija ahile, nahinkho kasotsah ding ahi, ati.
target: And if you walk in obedience to me and keep my decrees and commands as David your father did, I will give you a long life.”

source: Chuin Solomon akhangtan ahileh, veuvin hichu amang anahi. Chuin ama Jerusalem'a ahungin, Pakai kitepna thingkhong masanga adingin, govam thilto le chamna thiltoho atoh-in, asohte jouse golvah khat abolpeh-in ahi.
target: Then Solomon awoke—and he realized it had been a dream. He returned to Jerusalem, stood before the ark of the Lord’s covenant and sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. Then he gave a feast for all his court.

source: Chujouvin lengpa hengah numei kijoh ni ahunglhonin, chule a-angsunga ading lhonnin ahi.
target: Now two prostitutes came to the king and stood before him.

source: Chuin numei khatnu chun, Vo ka pakai, keile hichenu hi inkhatna kacheng lhonin; insunga amatoh kaum petnin cha khat kahingin ahi.
target: One of them said, “Pardon me, my lord. This woman and I live in the same house, and I had a baby while she was there with me.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, kacha hinjou anithumnin, hiche numeinu jonghin cha ahingin ahi. Hitichun ka umkhom lhonin, hiche insunga chu keini tilou midang koimacha toh kaum khom louvu ahi.
target: The third day after my child was born, this woman also had a baby. We were alone; there was no one in the house but the two of us.

source: Chule hichenun anaocha chu adelpha khah jeh-in, jan-in ana thitan ahi.
target: “During the night this woman’s son died because she lay on him.

source: Chuin jankhangin amanu athouvin, nasohnu ka-imut petnin kachapa kakoma konin akilah-in, apotnin a-anga alupsah-in, ama cha athisa chu keima angngah analupsah tan ahi.
target: So she got up in the middle of the night and took my son from my side while I your servant was asleep. She put him by her breast and put her dead son by my breast.

source: Chuin kanao noi chepsah dinga jingkah-a katho phatnin, vetan, athisa anahitai. Ahinla jingkah-a hoitah-a kavetchetna ahile, vetan, keiman kahin kachapa chu anahitapon ahi, ati.
target: The next morning, I got up to nurse my son—and he was dead! But when I looked at him closely in the morning light, I saw that it wasn’t the son I had borne.”

source: Chuin numei khatjonu chun, ahipoi; ahingjoh chu keichapa ahin, athi chu nang chapa ahi, ati. Chuin amasanu chun, ahipoi; athijoh chu nang chapa ahin, ahing chu kei chapa ahi, ati. Hitichun anilhon chun lengpa angsunga asei lhontan ahi.
target: The other woman said, “No! The living one is my son; the dead one is yours.” But the first one insisted, “No! The dead one is yours; the living one is mine.” And so they argued before the king.

source: Chujouvin lengpan, khatnin ahinghi keicha ahin, athi hi nang chapa ahi natilhon in; chule khatnin, ahipoi, athijoh chu nang chapa ahin, athilou chu keichapa ahi natilhone, tin aseije.
target: The king said, “This one says, ‘My son is alive and your son is dead,’ while that one says, ‘No! Your son is dead and mine is alive.’ ”

source: Chuin lengpan, chemjam khat neihin peuvin, ati. Chuin lengpa anga chun chemjam khat ahinchoi taovin ahi.
target: Then the king said, “Bring me a sword.” So they brought a sword for the king.

source: Chuin lengpan, naosen ahingjoh chu bongni souvin, bongkhat lamchu khat peuvinlang, chule bong khat lamchu khat jonu peuvin, ati.
target: He then gave an order: “Cut the living child in two and give half to one and half to the other.”

source: Chuphatnin naosen hingnu johchun lengpa jah-a, achapa alaigilga akhotona jeh-in, vo ka pakai, naosen hing chu amanu chu petan, thathih beh-un, ati. Ahinla khatjonu chun, keija jong hida henlang nanga jong hida hen, bongni souvin, atitai.
target: The woman whose son was alive was deeply moved out of love for her son and said to the king, “Please, my lord, give her the living baby! Don’t kill him!” But the other said, “Neither I nor you shall have him. Cut him in two!”

source: Chuphatnin lengpan adonbutnin, naosen hingchu amasajonu, that hih beh-un tinu chu peuvin, amanu chu ahinga anu ahi, atitai.
target: Then the king gave his ruling: “Give the living baby to the first woman. Do not kill him; she is his mother.”

source: Chuin Israelte jousen lengpa thutanlhah danchu ajataovin; lengpa chu akichataove; ajehchu amahon thutan nadinga Pathen chihna ama-a aumchu amutaovin ahi.
target: When all Israel heard the verdict the king had given, they held the king in awe, because they saw that he had wisdom from God to administer justice.

source: Chutichun Solomon lengpa Israel pumpi chunga leng anahi.
target: So King Solomon ruled over all Israel.

source: Chule hichehohi amilen neiho chu ahiuve: Zadok chapa Azariah chu Thempu ahin,
target: And these were his chief officials: Azariah son of Zadok—the priest;

source: Elihoreph, le Shisha chapa Ahijah chu lekhasun ahin; Ahilud chapa Jehoshaphat chu thuching ahi.
target: Elihoreph and Ahijah, sons of Shisha—secretaries; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud—recorder;

source: Chule Jehoiada chapa Benaiah chu janel gallamkai ahin; chule Zadok le Abiathar chu thempu ahilhone.
target: Benaiah son of Jehoiada—commander in chief; Zadok and Abiathar—priests;

source: Nathan chapa Azariah chu lamkaiho chunga ahin; Nathan chapa Zabud chu thempu le lengpa golpa ahi.
target: Azariah son of Nathan—in charge of the district governors; Zabud son of Nathan—a priest and adviser to the king;

source: Ahishar chu insung vaipo ahin; Abda chapa Adoniram chu sele kai choiho chunga vaipo ahi.
target: Ahishar—palace administrator; Adoniram son of Abda—in charge of forced labor.

source: Chule Solomon'in Israel pumpi chunga chun lamkai somleni aneijin, amaho chun lengpa le a-inkote dinga nehle chah angaito jiuvin; mikhatnin kumkhatna lhakhat sung nehding angaito cheh jiu ahi.
target: Solomon had twelve district governors over all Israel, who supplied provisions for the king and the royal household. Each one had to provide supplies for one month in the year.

source: Hichehi aminu ahi: Hur chapa chun Ephraim molsang apon,
target: These are their names: Ben-Hur—in the hill country of Ephraim;

source: Derek chapa chu Makaz, Shaalbim, Bethshemesh chule Elonbethhanan mun apon;
target: Ben-Deker—in Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh and Elon Bethhanan;

source: Hesed chapa chu Aruboth, Sochoh le Hepher gamsung pumpi apon;
target: Ben-Hesed—in Arubboth (Sokoh and all the land of Hepher were his);

source: Abinadab chapa chun Solomon chanu Taphath jin aneijin, Dor gamkol apumpi apon;
target: Ben-Abinadab—in Naphoth Dor (he was married to Taphath daughter of Solomon);

source: Ahilud chapa Baana chun Taanach, Megiddo, Bethshean pumpi, Jezreel noija Zarthanah koma um Bethshean'a pat Abel-meholah gei, Jokmeam gallam mungeijin apon;
target: Baana son of Ahilud—in Taanach and Megiddo, and in all of Beth Shan next to Zarethan below Jezreel, from Beth Shan to Abel Meholah across to Jokmeam;

source: Geber chapa chun Ramoth-gilead, Gilead'a umho Manasseh chapa Jair khopiho chu ama-a ahin, Bashana um Argob gamkai jong ama-a ahin, banghole akotgol ho sum-enga kisem cheh khopilen somgup ahin ahi.
target: Ben-Geber—in Ramoth Gilead (the settlements of Jair son of Manasseh in Gilead were his, as well as the region of Argob in Bashan and its sixty large walled cities with bronze gate bars);

source: Iddo chapa Ahinadab'in Mahanaim apon;
target: Ahinadab son of Iddo—in Mahanaim;

source: Ahimaaz'in Naphtali apon; Solomon chanu Bashemath chu jidin akipuijin ahi.
target: Ahimaaz—in Naphtali (he had married Basemath daughter of Solomon);

source: Hushai chapa Baanah chun Asher le Aloth-a apo-in;
target: Baana son of Hushai—in Asher and in Aloth;

source: Paruah chapa Jehoshaphat'in Issachar gamsung apon;
target: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah—in Issachar;

source: Ela chapa Shimei chun Benjamin gamsung;
target: Shimei son of Ela—in Benjamin;

source: Uri chapa Geber chun Gilead gamsung, Bashan lengpa Og chule Amor mite lengpa Sihon gamsung chu apon ahi. Chule agamsunga chu ama sehseh bou gamvaipo hia ahi.
target: Geber son of Uri—in Gilead (the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and the country of Og king of Bashan). He was the only governor over the district.

source: Judah le Israel chu luipi kama neldi bangin atamlheh-un, aneuvin adonun, chule nop abollun ahi.
target: The people of Judah and Israel were as numerous as the sand on the seashore; they ate, they drank and they were happy.

source: Chule Solomon chu luipi apat Philistine gamgi, chule Egypt gamgi chin geija lenggam jouse chunga chun vai ahomin; amahon thilpeh ahinchoijun, Solomon chu ahin laisen ajenun ahi.
target: And Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt. These countries brought tribute and were Solomon’s subjects all his life.

source: Solomon nikhat anneh chu changbong neljet tena somthum, chule changbong an tena somgup ahi.
target: Solomon’s daily provisions were thirty cors of the finest flour and sixty cors of meal,

source: Sakhi chalho, sapeng chalho, sakhi gol, chule vacha kivahthao ho tilouvin; bongchal thao som, hamdonga kivah bongchal somni, chule kelngoi jakhat ahi.
target: ten head of stall-fed cattle, twenty of pasture-fed cattle and a hundred sheep and goats, as well as deer, gazelles, roebucks and choice fowl.

source: Ajehchu aman luipipang hilamsang gamkai pumpi, Tiphsah apat Azzah gei, luipang hilamsang lengho jouse chunga lengvai apoh ahin; akimvel jouse toh chamna aneijin ahi.
target: For he ruled over all the kingdoms west of the Euphrates River, from Tiphsah to Gaza, and had peace on all sides.

source: Chule Judah le Israel chu Dan'a pat Beersheba geijin Solomon hinlaisen amitakip alengpi phungle atheichang phung noija mongtah-in achengun ahi.
target: During Solomon’s lifetime Judah and Israel, from Dan to Beersheba, lived in safety, everyone under their own vine and under their own fig tree.

source: Chuin Solomon'in asakol kangtalai koinadin in sangsomli aneijin, chule sakol touthem mi sangsom le sangni aneije.
target: Solomon had four thousand stalls for chariot horses, and twelve thousand horses.

source: Chule vaipiho chu amitakipmin alha seh-in Solomon dingle, Solomon lengpa dokhanga hungjouse dingin nehding ahin peuvin; amaho ima alhasam pouve.
target: The district governors, each in his month, supplied provisions for King Solomon and all who came to the king’s table. They saw to it that nothing was lacking.

source: Amitakipmin akinganse dungjuijin sakolhole gancha kaljangho ding chun, sakolchang le changpol ahinpo jingun ahi.
target: They also brought to the proper place their quotas of barley and straw for the chariot horses and the other horses.

source: Chuin Pathen'in Solomon chu chihna le hetthem theina nasatah, chule lungletna twipi panga neldi banghela tamin apen ahi.
target: God gave Solomon wisdom and very great insight, and a breadth of understanding as measureless as the sand on the seashore.

source: Chule Solomon chihna chun solam gam chate chihnale, Egypt pumpi chihna jouse akhokheltan ahi.
target: Solomon’s wisdom was greater than the wisdom of all the people of the East, and greater than all the wisdom of Egypt.

source: Ajehchu ama mijouse sangin achingin; Ezrah mi Etham, Heman, Chalcol chule Derda, Mahol chapate sangin achingjon, chule akimvela namjouse lah-a akithangtan ahi.
target: He was wiser than anyone else, including Ethan the Ezrahite—wiser than Heman, Kalkol and Darda, the sons of Mahol. And his fame spread to all the surrounding nations.

source: Aman thuchih sangthum aseijin; chule la anabol chu sangkhat le nga ahi.
target: He spoke three thousand proverbs and his songs numbered a thousand and five.

source: Chule thingphung jouse, Lebanon'a um cedar thinga pat, kulbanga kona hung kehdoh hyssop changeijin anaseijin; aman gamsaho, vachaho, a-opma kitholho, chule ngaho thu jong anaseije.
