target: He spoke about plant life, from the cedar of Lebanon to the hyssop that grows out of walls. He also spoke about animals and birds, reptiles and fish.

source: Ama chihna anajakha-a leiset lengho jouse-a konin, Solomon chihna ngai dingin namtin ahung jiuvin ahi.
target: From all nations people came to listen to Solomon’s wisdom, sent by all the kings of the world, who had heard of his wisdom.

source: Chule apa indan sunga amahon amachu lengdin thao anuve ti ajah jeh-in, Tyre lengpa Hiram'in asohteho Solomon henga asoltan ahi. Ajehchu Hiram chu a-itih-a David ngailu jing anahi.
target: When Hiram king of Tyre heard that Solomon had been anointed king to succeed his father David, he sent his envoys to Solomon, because he had always been on friendly terms with David.

source: Chuin Solomon'in Hiram henga mi asolin, ajah-a hitin aseije,
target: Solomon sent back this message to Hiram:

source: Pakaiyin amaho akengto noija akoi masangse-a, galmiten ama aumkimvel jing jeh uva, kapa David'in Pakai a-Pathen mina in iti anasah joulou ham ti nangman nahen ahi.
target: “You know that because of the wars waged against my father David from all sides, he could not build a temple for the Name of the Lord his God until the Lord put his enemies under his feet.

source: Ahinla tun Pakai ka Pathen'in ningtina konin choldona eipetan, hijeh chun kidoupi jong hamsetna jong aumtapoi.
target: But now the Lord my God has given me rest on every side, and there is no adversary or disaster.

source: Chule, vetan, Pakaiyin kapa David henga anasei, na indan sung nalaltouna-a katousah ding nachapa chun, keima mina in eisahpeh ding ahi, anati bangin, Pakai ka Pathen mina in sah ding kagon ahi.
target: I intend, therefore, to build a temple for the Name of the Lord my God, as the Lord told my father David, when he said, ‘Your son whom I will put on the throne in your place will build the temple for my Name.’

source: Hijeh chun tun Lebanon'a kona cedar thingho aphuh nadiuvin thu penlang; kasohte hi nangma sohte toh pangkhom untin, chule nanganse dungjuijin nasohte thaman keiman penange. Ajehchu Sidon mite banga thing tuthem kalah uvah aumpoi ti nahei, ati.
target: “So give orders that cedars of Lebanon be cut for me. My men will work with yours, and I will pay you for your men whatever wages you set. You know that we have no one so skilled in felling timber as the Sidonians.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Hiram'in Solomon thu ajah phatnin akipah lheh jengin, hiche mipi tamtah chunga chapa ching David pepa Pakai chu tuni hin nun nomhen, ati.
target: When Hiram heard Solomon’s message, he was greatly pleased and said, “Praise be to the Lord today, for he has given David a wise son to rule over this great nation.”

source: Chuin Hiram'in Solomon henga mi asolin, neihin solnaho chu kangaiton, cedar thingle chahthing chungchanga nangaichat jouse chu bolnange.
target: So Hiram sent word to Solomon: “I have received the message you sent me and will do all you want in providing the cedar and juniper logs.

source: Kasohten Lebanon'a konin twipi geijin hintol lhaovintin; nangin neitepeh ding mungeijin twipia hintoling ting, chule chua chun sodohsah ing-katin, chua kona chu nangman nana kilah ding ahi. Chule ka insung nehding neipeh-a, kangaichat neisuh bulhit pehding ahi, ati.
target: My men will haul them down from Lebanon to the Mediterranean Sea, and I will float them as rafts by sea to the place you specify. There I will separate them and you can take them away. And you are to grant my wish by providing food for my royal household.”

source: Chutichun Hiram'in Solomon chu angaichat jouse dungjuijin cedar thingle chahthing apetan ahi.
target: In this way Hiram kept Solomon supplied with all the cedar and juniper logs he wanted,

source: Chuin Solomon'in Hiram chu a-insung anneh dingin suhlou chang tena sangsomni, chule thaotheng tena somni apen; hitichun Solomon'in akum akumin Hiram apejin ahi.
target: and Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat as food for his household, in addition to twenty thousand baths of pressed olive oil. Solomon continued to do this for Hiram year after year.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin akitepna bangin Solomon chu chihna apen; chutichun Hiram le Solomon kah-a chamna aumin; amanin kiguijopna aneigel lhonne.
target: The Lord gave Solomon wisdom, just as he had promised him. There were peaceful relations between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty.

source: Chuin Solomon lengpan Israel jouse lah-a konin natong honkhat aphutdoh-in; natonghon hochu pasal sangsomthum ahiuve.
target: King Solomon conscripted laborers from all Israel—thirty thousand men.

source: Chuin aman amaho chu Lebanon'a asolin, lhakhatna sangsom cheh-in akilhahsah-in; Lebanon'a lhakhat umjiuva, in'a lhani umji ahiuvin; chule Adoniram chu natongho vesuija pang ahi.
target: He sent them off to Lebanon in shifts of ten thousand a month, so that they spent one month in Lebanon and two months at home. Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor.

source: Solomon'in molsang ho-a chun thilgih poho mi sangsomsagi aneijin, chule songkheng them mi sangsomget aneijin,
target: Solomon had seventy thousand carriers and eighty thousand stonecutters in the hills,

source: Natohnaho chunga Solomon vaipo pipuiho tilouvin, natohna-a mipi ho chunga vaihom dingin mi sangthum leh jathum aneijin ahi.
target: as well as thirty-three hundred foremen who supervised the project and directed the workers.

source: Chuin lengpan thu apen, inbul setna dingin song len tahtah, chule manlutahtah song kikhengho ahinpouvin ahi.
target: At the king’s command they removed from the quarry large blocks of high-grade stone to provide a foundation of dressed stone for the temple.

source: Chuin Solomon insaho, Hiram insaho, chule Gebal mi song khengho chun hicheho chu akhengun, chutichun insah nadin thingle songho chu agong uvin ahi.
target: The craftsmen of Solomon and Hiram and workers from Byblos cut and prepared the timber and stone for the building of the temple.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Israel chate Egypt gama ahungpot doh-u kum jali le kum somget lhinkum, Israelte chunga Solomon alengchan kum li na, Zif lha, hichu alha ni chana ahin, Solomon'in Pakai houin ding chu asapan tan ahi.
target: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the Israelites came out of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month of Ziv, the second month, he began to build the temple of the Lord .

source: Pakai dinga Solomon lengpa houin sahchu adunglam tong somgup, availam tong somni, chule asanlam tong somthum ahi.
target: The temple that King Solomon built for the Lord was sixty cubits long, twenty wide and thirty high.

source: Chule houin mailama ahongcha chu a-invai adungjuija adunglam tongsomni ahin, invailam amaichu tongsom ahi.
target: The portico at the front of the main hall of the temple extended the width of the temple, that is twenty cubits, and projected ten cubits from the front of the temple.

source: Chule houin dinga chun bangkot jim vah lutna asemin ahi.
target: He made narrow windows high up in the temple walls.

source: Chule houin bang kimvela chun indan ahoi kimvelin, houin bangho jon kimvel, houin le houna mun'a chun indan ahoi kimvele.
target: Against the walls of the main hall and inner sanctuary he built a structure around the building, in which there were side rooms.

source: Dan noinungpen chu tong nga-in alenin, alai chu tong gupmin alenin, chule athumna chu tong sagin alenne. Inkamho chu inbangho-a akihendet lounadin inbang sunglama chun akingapna din akimvela chomcha adosah-e.
target: The lowest floor was five cubits wide, the middle floor six cubits and the third floor seven. He made offset ledges around the outside of the temple so that nothing would be inserted into the temple walls.

source: Chule houin kisah sunga chu seh le heicha, ahiloule thih manchah gin insunga chu akijah louna dinga, insah na-a kimangcha songho chu kikheng tohsa-a hin kipolut ahi.
target: In building the temple, only blocks dressed at the quarry were used, and no hammer, chisel or any other iron tool was heard at the temple site while it was being built.

source: Chuche danlai kotkhah chu houin jetlam sanga aumin; amaho chu kalbi-a danlailha-a chiu kaltoujiu, danlaija kona chu athumna-a kaltou jiu ahi.
target: The entrance to the lowest floor was on the south side of the temple; a stairway led up to the middle level and from there to the third.

source: Hitichun houin chu asan, ajouvin, houin chu cedar thingtum le thingpeh-in atomin ahi.
target: So he built the temple and completed it, roofing it with beams and cedar planks.

source: Aman houin jonna chun indanho asa-in, tong nga-a cheh-a sangin asan; hicheho chu houin chunga cedar thingtuma kingamin ahi.
target: And he built the side rooms all along the temple. The height of each was five cubits, and they were attached to the temple by beams of cedar.

source: Chuin Pakai thu Solomon henga ahung lhungin, hitin aseije;
target: The word of the Lord came to Solomon:

source: Nangman nasah houin chungchanga hin, kachonna dan kisunho najuija, kathutanho najopma, kathupeh ho jouse nanit na, hichu najuija ahile; napa David henga kanasei thu chu nachunga kalhunsah-a,
target: “As for this temple you are building, if you follow my decrees, observe my laws and keep all my commands and obey them, I will fulfill through you the promise I gave to David your father.

source: Israel chate lah-a kachena, chule kami Israelte kanungsun louding ahi, ati.
target: And I will live among the Israelites and will not abandon my people Israel.”

source: Chutichun Solomon'in in chu asan ajoutai.
target: So Solomon built the temple and completed it.

source: Chule houin sunglam bang ahin, lhong ahin, chuleh in chung ahin ceder thingpeh-in atomin; hiche chunga chun asunglam chu thingin atomin, inlhong chu chahthingpeh-in atomin ahi.
target: He lined its interior walls with cedar boards, paneling them from the floor of the temple to the ceiling, and covered the floor of the temple with planks of juniper.

source: Chule inbangho chu tongsomni cheh-in lhongle bangho chu cedar thingpeh-in asan; houna mun, muntheng chungnung jenga jongchun asunglam hititah chun abolin ahi.
target: He partitioned off twenty cubits at the rear of the temple with cedar boards from floor to ceiling to form within the temple an inner sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.

source: Chule chuche houin mai chu tong somlia saova ahi.
target: The main hall in front of this room was forty cubits long.

source: Chule insung lama chun apah mumle apahlha pahcha banga kijem cedar thing aumin; aboncha cedar thinga kisem ahi, song khatcha muding aumpon ahi.
target: The inside of the temple was cedar, carved with gourds and open flowers. Everything was cedar; no stone was to be seen.

source: Chule Pakai kitepna thingkhong koina dingin insung lama chun Pathen houna muntheng agongin ahi.
target: He prepared the inner sanctuary within the temple to set the ark of the covenant of the Lord there.

source: Chule houna mun sunglam chu tong somni, atoa tong somni, alet tong somni, asan tong somni ahin, hichu sanathengin alonkhum cheh-in, chule cedar thing maicham chu chutima chun alonkhumin ahi.
target: The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits long, twenty wide and twenty high. He overlaid the inside with pure gold, and he also overlaid the altar of cedar.

source: Chutichun Solomon'in insunglam chu sanathengin alonkhum sah-in; chule houna mun maicham chu sanaguijin indan khenna asemin, hichu sanatwi jin alonkhum sah-in ahi.
target: Solomon covered the inside of the temple with pure gold, and he extended gold chains across the front of the inner sanctuary, which was overlaid with gold.

source: Chuin houin pumpi chu injouse ajosoh kah-un sana alonkhumin, houna mun koma maicham pumpi jongchu sana-in alonkhumin ahi.
target: So he overlaid the whole interior with gold. He also overlaid with gold the altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary.

source: Chule houna mun sunga chun olive thingin Cherubim ni, tongsom cheh-a sangin asemin ahi.
target: For the inner sanctuary he made a pair of cherubim out of olive wood, each ten cubits high.

source: Chule Cherub khatpa lhavingchu tong nga ahin, Cherub chompa lhaving chu tong nga ma ahi; khatpa lhaving monga pat, achompa lhaving mong geichu tongsom ahi.
target: One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long, and the other wing five cubits—ten cubits from wing tip to wing tip.

source: Chule Cherub chompa chu tongsom ahin, Cherub teni chu alet aneu kibangchet ahi.
target: The second cherub also measured ten cubits, for the two cherubim were identical in size and shape.

source: Cherub khat sandan chu tongsom ahin, Cherub khatpa jongchu chutima chu ahi.
target: The height of each cherub was ten cubits.

source: Chule Cherub teni chu insung nunga chun atungin, Cherubim teni lhaving chu akijahdoh gelin; chutima chun Cherub khatpa lhavingin bang langkhat chu atongkhan, alhaving lhonchu inlailung tah-a akigotkhan ahi.
target: He placed the cherubim inside the innermost room of the temple, with their wings spread out. The wing of one cherub touched one wall, while the wing of the other touched the other wall, and their wings touched each other in the middle of the room.

source: Chule Cherub teni chu sanatwijin kilonkhumin ahi.
target: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

source: Chule inbang jouse kimvel chu Cherubim le lusuphung, pahcha, chule pahcha pahlhan asungle apo ajem hoijin ahi.
target: On the walls all around the temple, in both the inner and outer rooms, he carved cherubim, palm trees and open flowers.

source: Chule inlhong asungle apochu sanatwijin alonkhumin ahi.
target: He also covered the floors of both the inner and outer rooms of the temple with gold.

source: Chule houna mun lutnadin olive thingin kot asemin; kotchungle kotbang hochu bang hopnga-a hopkhatjen ahi.
target: For the entrance to the inner sanctuary he made doors out of olive wood that were one fifth of the width of the sanctuary.

source: Chule kot teni chu olive thing ahigelin; achung lhonchu Cherubim le lusuphung, chule pahchapah phungin ajempolin, hihochu sanatwijin alonkhumin, Cherubim le lusu phungho chung chu sanatwi athekhumin ahi.
target: And on the two olive-wood doors he carved cherubim, palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid the cherubim and palm trees with hammered gold.

source: Chutima chun houin kotbengho chu, bang hop li-a hopkhatjen olive thingin asemin ahi.
target: In the same way, for the entrance to the main hall he made doorframes out of olive wood that were one fourth of the width of the hall.

source: Chule kot teni chu chahthinga kisem ahin; kotkhahpeh tenichu akilhepthei ahin, kot pheng chompa peh teni jongchu akilhepthei ahi.
target: He also made two doors out of juniper wood, each having two leaves that turned in sockets.

source: Hiche chungchu Cherubim le lusuphung, chule pahcha pahlhan ajemin; akijempah chungchu sanan atom nalaijin ahi.
target: He carved cherubim, palm trees and open flowers on them and overlaid them with gold hammered evenly over the carvings.

source: Houin sungnung chu song kikhen jolsa golthum, chule cedar thingtum golkhatnin asan ahi.
target: And he built the inner courtyard of three courses of dressed stone and one course of trimmed cedar beams.

source: Kum li lhina, Zif lha-a Pakai houin bul chu kiphutna ahin;
target: The foundation of the temple of the Lord was laid in the fourth year, in the month of Ziv.

source: Chule kumsomle khatna, Bul lha, hichu lha getna ahin, houin pumpi chu akigon dungjui cheh-in akijou sohtan ahi. Chutichun hiche sahna-a chun kum sagi alutnin ahi.
target: In the eleventh year in the month of Bul, the eighth month, the temple was finished in all its details according to its specifications. He had spent seven years building it.

source: Ahin Solomon'in amatah in sahnan kumsomle kumthum alut sah-in, a-in chu abonchan ajoutai.
target: It took Solomon thirteen years, however, to complete the construction of his palace.

source: Aman Lebanon gammang in jongchu asan: hichu adung tong jakhat, avai tong somnga, asanlam tong somthum ahin, cedar khom gol li kiphutna, hiche khomho chunga chu cedar thingtuma kisa-a ahi.
target: He built the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon a hundred cubits long, fifty wide and thirty high, with four rows of cedar columns supporting trimmed cedar beams.

source: Chule thingtumho chunga chu ceder thinga kikhu-a, khom somlenga cheh-a kigol, khom somli le nga chunga kisa-a ahi.
target: It was roofed with cedar above the beams that rested on the columns—forty-five beams, fifteen to a row.

source: Chule golthum na-a bangkot aumcheh-in, vahle vah chu golthumin akidongto cheh uve.
target: Its windows were placed high in sets of three, facing each other.

source: Chule kotpi jousele khomho chu ningli cheh ahin, bangkot hotoh vahle vah chu golthumin akidongto cheh uve.
target: All the doorways had rectangular frames; they were in the front part in sets of three, facing each other.

source: Aman khomho neijin thutanna hongcha jongchu asemin, hichu asaodan tong somnga ahin, chule avai chu tong somthum ahi. Chule hongcha chu amai lama aumin, khom dangho leh inkam lentah chu amailam sanga aumin ahi.
target: He made a colonnade fifty cubits long and thirty wide. In front of it was a portico, and in front of that were pillars and an overhanging roof.

source: Chujouvin thu atan theinadin, laltouna hongcha asemin, thutanna hongcha jong asemin; hichu lhong langkhatna patna langkhat gei cedar thinga kikhu ahi.
target: He built the throne hall, the Hall of Justice, where he was to judge, and he covered it with cedar from floor to ceiling.

source: Chule achenna in hongcha sunga chun inhong chomkhat aneijin, hiche jongchu chutobang ma-a kisa ahi. Solomon'in hiche hongcha tobanghin, ajidinga akipui Pharoah chanu dingin jong inkhat asahpeh-in ahi.
target: And the palace in which he was to live, set farther back, was similar in design. Solomon also made a palace like this hall for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had married.

source: Hicheho jousehi akikheng songho, song atna-a ki-at, song mantam tah jenga kisa ahin, a-inbula patna aleh gei, asung apo, chule inpilen hongsung apolam geija chutia chu kisa ahi.
target: All these structures, from the outside to the great courtyard and from foundation to eaves, were made of blocks of high-grade stone cut to size and smoothed on their inner and outer faces.

source: Chule inbulchu song mantam tah ho, song len tahtah, tongsom chenga sao le tong get sao ho-a kise ahi.
target: The foundations were laid with large stones of good quality, some measuring ten cubits and some eight.

source: Chule achunglam chu song mantam tah ho, song kitetoh-a kikhengtoh ho, chule cedar thinga kisa ahi.
target: Above were high-grade stones, cut to size, and cedar beams.

source: Chule inlen chu akimvela song kikheng golthum le cedar thingtum golkhat kigola kisa ahin; Pakai indan sungnung le ahongcha jongchu chutobang ma-a chu kibola ahi.
target: The great courtyard was surrounded by a wall of three courses of dressed stone and one course of trimmed cedar beams, as was the inner courtyard of the temple of the Lord with its portico.

source: Chuin Solomon lengpan Tyre'a konin Hiram agapuisah-in ahi.
target: King Solomon sent to Tyre and brought Huram,

source: Ama chu Naphtali phunga meithai khat chapa ahin, apa chu sum-eng kheng Tyre mi ahi. Amachu chihna le hetkhen themna dimset ahin, sum-eng khenalama thepna nei ahi. Chuin ama Solomon lengpa henga ahungin ana jouse chu atoh pehtai.
target: whose mother was a widow from the tribe of Naphtali and whose father was from Tyre and a skilled craftsman in bronze. Huram was filled with wisdom, with understanding and with knowledge to do all kinds of bronze work. He came to King Solomon and did all the work assigned to him.

source: Chuin aman tong somle tong getna sang sum-eng khomni alhan; chule aletdan chu tongsomle tongni cheh ahi.
target: He cast two bronze pillars, each eighteen cubits high and twelve cubits in circumference.

source: Chule khom teni vuma tundin, sum-eng kilhajol khom alujum ni asemin, khomjum khatchu tongnga asangin, khomjum khatpa jong tong ngama ahi.
target: He also made two capitals of cast bronze to set on the tops of the pillars; each capital was five cubits high.

source: Chule khompiteni vuma khom lujum teni jeppahna dingin sum-eng guilen polchit chet asemin; khom lujum khatdin sagi ahin, chule khom lujum khatpa dingin jong sagima aseme.
target: A network of interwoven chains adorned the capitals on top of the pillars, seven for each capital.

source: Aman khompiho asemin, avuma khom lujum teni khunadin kolbuthei lim lenvang golni asemin, chutimachun khom lujum khatpa jong abole.
target: He made pomegranates in two rows encircling each network to decorate the capitals on top of the pillars. He did the same for each capital.

source: Chule hongcha khom vuma ajumchu molhoipah-in akijemin, tongli ahi.
target: The capitals on top of the pillars in the portico were in the shape of lilies, four cubits high.

source: Chule khom lujum teni chunga apoh dontah-a avang silsel koma chun kolbuthei lim asemin; khom lujum ni kimvella chun kolbuthei lim jani agolin aumin ahi.
target: On the capitals of both pillars, above the bowl-shaped part next to the network, were the two hundred pomegranates in rows all around.

source: Chuin khom hochu houin hongcha-a aphutnin; jetlam khom aphutdoh-in, hiche minchu Jachin asah-in; chule veilam khom chu aphutdoh-in, hiche minchu Boaz asah-in ahi.
target: He erected the pillars at the portico of the temple. The pillar to the south he named Jakin and the one to the north Boaz.

source: Chule khompi vuma chun molhoipah lim achongin, chutichun khom natoh akichaitai.
target: The capitals on top were in the shape of lilies. And so the work on the pillars was completed.

source: Chuin twibem khat asemin, ageikhatna pat langkhat gei tongsom ahin; apuma kikolsoh ahin, asanlam tong nga ahin; chule akimvela kikolchu tong somthum ahi.
target: He made the Sea of cast metal, circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim and five cubits high. It took a line of thirty cubits to measure around it.

source: Hiche ageinoi kimvel chu pahmun limin avelsoh-in, tongkhat sunga pahmun som cheh asemin, twibem chu pahmunin akolkhumin ahi; pahmunchu akisun chun golnin akisungin ahi.
target: Below the rim, gourds encircled it—ten to a cubit. The gourds were cast in two rows in one piece with the Sea.

source: Hichu bongchal somleni chunga kingam ahin, thumin sahlam angan, thumin lhumlam angan, thumin simlam angan, thumin solam angat ahi. Twibem chu amaho chunga kikhang ahin, ameiju chun sunglam angat cheh ahi.
target: The Sea stood on twelve bulls, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south and three facing east. The Sea rested on top of them, and their hindquarters were toward the center.

source: Hichu asalam khutphang te-a sa ahin, ageichu khon gei tobang ahin molhoipah-a kijemin; asung chun twitena bath sangni adolin ahi.
target: It was a handbreadth in thickness, and its rim was like the rim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It held two thousand baths.

source: Chuin aman sum-eng khomtodom som asemin, khomtodom khat chu adung tongli ahin, avai tongli, chule asan chu tong thum ahi.
target: He also made ten movable stands of bronze; each was four cubits long, four wide and three high.

source: Chule khomtodom boldan chu hiti ahi: hicheho chun agei anei cheh-un, hiche ageiho chu akoho kikah-a kikhumlut cheh ahiuve.
target: This is how the stands were made: They had side panels attached to uprights.

source: Chule ageiho kikah-a akoho-a chun keipi bahkaiho, bongchalho, Cherub ho lim aumin; ageiho chunga chun tunsonna aumin, keipi bahkai le bongchalho noilam chu khut thema jephoina akisemin akibelap cheh-in ahi.
target: On the panels between the uprights were lions, bulls and cherubim—and on the uprights as well. Above and below the lions and bulls were wreaths of hammered work.

source: Tunsonna tinin sum eng kangtalai li cheh, sum-eng kong licheh aneijun, aninglia kingapna aumcheh-in, kisilna bel noija kingapna kisung aumin, aning cheh-a belapna umcheh ahi.
target: Each stand had four bronze wheels with bronze axles, and each had a basin resting on four supports, cast with wreaths on each side.

source: Alujum kikol sung akam chu tongkhat lha ahin, hiche akam vangchu tunsonna abem banga kikolbem ahin, tongkhat le akeh ahi. Chule akam gei kimvel chu kigeihoi ahin, aningli ahin, abem ahipoi.
target: On the inside of the stand there was an opening that had a circular frame one cubit deep. This opening was round, and with its basework it measured a cubit and a half. Around its opening there was engraving. The panels of the stands were square, not round.

source: Ageiho noija kangtalai li aumin, kangtalai ajolpi chu tunsonna toh akimatnin; akeng khatchu tong khatle akeh-a sang ahi.
target: The four wheels were under the panels, and the axles of the wheels were attached to the stand. The diameter of each wheel was a cubit and a half.

source: Chule akang boldan chu sakol kangtalai kiboldan bang ahin, ajolpiho, alaibohho, akaldet naho, ajangho chu akisuntho cheh ahi.
target: The wheels were made like chariot wheels; the axles, rims, spokes and hubs were all of cast metal.

source: Chule tunsonna ningli cheh-a akingapna licheh uma ahin; hiche akingapna hochu tunsonna toh pumkhat ahi.
target: Each stand had four handles, one on each corner, projecting from the stand.

source: Tunsonna chungvuma chun tong keh-a sang velkol khat aumin, tunsonna chunga ageihole akoho chu thakhat ahi.
target: At the top of the stand there was a circular band half a cubit deep. The supports and panels were attached to the top of the stand.

source: Ajehchu chuche ageipehle akoho chunga chun ahithei bang bangin Cherub ho, keipiho, tumthingho lim achonsah-in, akimvela ajephoina aumsoh keijin,
target: He engraved cherubim, lions and palm trees on the surfaces of the supports and on the panels, in every available space, with wreaths all around.

source: Hiche tobang cheh hin tunsonna som abolin; abona pumkhatna kisung ahicheh-in, tena thakhat, alet thakhat cheh ahi.
target: This is the way he made the ten stands. They were all cast in the same molds and were identical in size and shape.

source: Chujouvin kisilna belson sum engin asemin, kisilna bel khatnin twitena dim somli adolin; bel jouse chu tongli cheh ahin, tunsonna som chunga kisilna bel khat akitung cheh-e.
target: He then made ten bronze basins, each holding forty baths and measuring four cubits across, one basin to go on each of the ten stands.

source: Chule tunsonna nga houin jetlama atungin, ngama houin veilama atunge. Chule twibem chu houin jet lama niso lamngan atungin ahi.
target: He placed five of the stands on the south side of the temple and five on the north. He placed the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner of the temple.

source: Chule Hiram'in kisilna belho, vutloho, maiphet kongho asemin ahi. Chutichun Hiram'in Pakai houin'a dinga Solomon'in asemsah ho jouse chu ajousoh heltan:
target: He also made the pots and shovels and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished all the work he had undertaken for King Solomon in the temple of the Lord :

source: Khomni, khom ni chungvum alujum chunga kisem twithol teni, chule khom teni chungvuma alujum teni-a twidol tobang kikoi khuna-a kisem lenvang ni;
target: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars; the two sets of network decorating the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars;

source: Chule chuche lenvang dinga kibol kolbuthei jali, khomteni chunga twidol khuna ding lenvang khatna kolbuthei vui ni;
target: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network decorating the bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars);

source: Chule tunsonna somle tunsonna chunga kisilna bel som,
target: the ten stands with their ten basins;

source: Chule twibem khatle twibem noija bongchal somleni,
target: the Sea and the twelve bulls under it;

source: Belho, vutloho le maiphetna kongho, chule kongle belho jouse, Pakai houin'a dinga Solomon lengpan Hiram asemsah hochu sum-eng duljet cheh ahi.
target: the pots, shovels and sprinkling bowls. All these objects that Huram made for King Solomon for the temple of the Lord were of burnished bronze.

source: Jordan phaicham, Succoth le Zarthan kikah leilai mun'a lengpan hicheho chu asun sah ahi.
target: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Sukkoth and Zarethan.

source: Chule kongle belhochu atam behseh jeh-in Solomon'in telouvin amoh koitan, sum-eng gih jong hetsoh jouhoi ahipoi.
target: Solomon left all these things unweighed, because there were so many; the weight of the bronze was not determined.

source: Chule Solomon'in Pakai in'a um kong leh bel jouse asemin: sana maicham le vetsahna changlhah koina sana dokhang,
target: Solomon also made all the furnishings that were in the Lord ’s temple: the golden altar; the golden table on which was the bread of the Presence;

source: Chule houna mun masanga kikoi thaomei khom; jetlama nga, chule veilama nga, pahchaho leh meivah ho chule sana cheichaho,
target: the lampstands of pure gold (five on the right and five on the left, in front of the inner sanctuary); the gold floral work and lamps and tongs;

source: Chule khonho, meivahpon, chena ho, maiphetna kongho, thihkheho, sanatheng sela kisem lhengho; insung gilla muntheng pentah kotkhah ho le houin kotkhah ho kibutona ho chu sana ngenin asemin ahi.
target: the pure gold basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes and censers; and the gold sockets for the doors of the innermost room, the Most Holy Place, and also for the doors of the main hall of the temple.

source: Chutichun Solomon lengpan Pakai in'a dinga asem jouse chu achaisoh tai. Chuin Solomon'in apa David pehdohsa dangka, sana, chule kong leh bel ho geijin ahin polutnin, Pakai in'a gouho lah-a chun akoitan ahi.
target: When all the work King Solomon had done for the temple of the Lord was finished, he brought in the things his father David had dedicated—the silver and gold and the furnishings—and he placed them in the treasuries of the Lord ’s temple.

source: Hitichun Solomon'in Israel upaho, phungho jouse upaho, Israel sonho lah-a upaho chu, David khopi Zion'a kona Pakai kitepna thingkhong potou dingin Jerusalem'a akhomin ahi.
target: Then King Solomon summoned into his presence at Jerusalem the elders of Israel, all the heads of the tribes and the chiefs of the Israelite families, to bring up the ark of the Lord ’s covenant from Zion, the City of David.

source: Hijeh chun Israel mijouse chu lha sagina, Ethanim lha-a kut kibola chun Solomon lengpa henga amaho le amaho ahung kikhomun ahi.
target: All the Israelites came together to King Solomon at the time of the festival in the month of Ethanim, the seventh month.

source: Hitichun Israel upaho jouse chu ahungun, chule thempuho chun kitepna thingkhong chu apuvin ahi.
target: When all the elders of Israel had arrived, the priests took up the ark,

source: Chuin amahon Pakai kitepna thingkhong, houkhomhole houbuh pon, chule houbuh-a um kong leh bel thengho chu ahin potouvun; hicheho jouse chu thempuho le Levi hon apotouvun ahi.
target: and they brought up the ark of the Lord and the tent of meeting and all the sacred furnishings in it. The priests and Levites carried them up,

source: Chule Solomon lengpa le Israel mipi kikhomho, ama henga hung kikhomho jouse chu amatoh kitepna thingkhong masanga aumuvin; kelngoile bongchal atamval jeh-a simjou hilou le ajat hetthei jouhoi hilouvin ganlhaina aneijuvin ahi.
target: and King Solomon and the entire assembly of Israel that had gathered about him were before the ark, sacrificing so many sheep and cattle that they could not be recorded or counted.

source: Chule thempuhon Pakai kitepna thingkhong chu aumnading mun, insunggil houna mun, muntheng pentah sung, Cherub teni lhaving noija chun akoi taove.
target: The priests then brought the ark of the Lord ’s covenant to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the Most Holy Place, and put it beneath the wings of the cherubim.

source: Ajehchu Cherub teni chun kitepna thingkhong umna chung chu alhateni ajahkhuma, Cherub teni chun kitepna thingkhong le achunga moljol teni chu ahop sohkei ahi.
target: The cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark and overshadowed the ark and its carrying poles.

source: Chule moljol teni chu agasao doh-in, houmun masang munthenga konchun akimu phan ahi, ahin polama konin vang akimupoi; chule hichu tunichan geijin chua chun aumjingin ahi.
target: These poles were so long that their ends could be seen from the Holy Place in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from outside the Holy Place; and they are still there today.

source: Kitepna thingkhong sunga chun Egypt'a kon ahung potdoh laijuva, Pakaiyin Israel chate toh kitepna anei laija, Mosi'n Horeb molsanga anakoi songpheng ni tailou imadang aumpon ahi.
target: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb, where the Lord made a covenant with the Israelites after they came out of Egypt.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, thempuho munthenga kona ahungdoh phatnun, Pakai in chu meipin ahinkhu dimtan ahi.
target: When the priests withdrew from the Holy Place, the cloud filled the temple of the Lord .

source: Hitichun thempuho chu meipi jeh-in kinbolin adingthei tapouve. Ajehchu Pakai loupina-in Pakai in chu alodim sohtan ahi.
target: And the priests could not perform their service because of the cloud, for the glory of the Lord filled his temple.

source: Chuin Solomon'in hitin aseije, Pakaiyin muthim satah-a chu kaumding ahi ati.
target: Then Solomon said, “The Lord has said that he would dwell in a dark cloud;

source: Keiman tahbeh-in nachen nading in kasah peh-in, Tonsotna naum nading mun kasahpeh-e.
target: I have indeed built a magnificent temple for you, a place for you to dwell forever.”

source: Chuin lengpa akile heijin, Israel houkhom ho jouse chu phatthei aboh-in, (Israel houkhom ho jouse chu ading sohkeijun ahi.)
target: While the whole assembly of Israel was standing there, the king turned around and blessed them.

source: Chuin aman, Israel Pakai Pathen chu nunnom hen, aman kapa David henga akam ngeijin anaseijin, akhut ngeijin asubulhitnin,
target: Then he said: “Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who with his own hand has fulfilled what he promised with his own mouth to my father David. For he said,

source: Keiman kami Israelte Egypt gama kona kapuidoh nikho-a pat, kamin umna ding in sah nadingin Israel namjouse lah-a khopi khatcha jong kanalheng khapon; ahinla kami Israelte chunga vaipodin David kana lhenge, ati.
target: ‘Since the day I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I have not chosen a city in any tribe of Israel to have a temple built so that my Name might be there, but I have chosen David to rule my people Israel.’

source: Chuti chun kapa David'in Israel Pakai Pathen min dinga in sah ding chu alungelin anatupmin ahi.
target: “My father David had it in his heart to build a temple for the Name of the Lord , the God of Israel.

source: Ahin Pakaiyin kapa David jah-a, nalung gillin kamin dinga in sah ding natup lheh-in, hitobang lung naput hi aphalheh-in ahi.
target: But the Lord said to my father David, ‘You did well to have it in your heart to build a temple for my Name.

source: Hijeng jongle nangman in chu nasah louding ahi; amavang nachapa, nataiguija hung pengdoh dingchun kamin dinga in chu asah ding ahi, ati.
target: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build the temple, but your son, your own flesh and blood—he is the one who will build the temple for my Name.’

source: Chuin Pakaiyin athusei chu asudetnin, Pakai thutan bangin kapa David munchu kahinlotan, Israel laltouna-a chun kahung toutan, Israel Pakai Pathen min dingin in chu kahin satan ahi.
target: “The Lord has kept the promise he made: I have succeeded David my father and now I sit on the throne of Israel, just as the Lord promised, and I have built the temple for the Name of the Lord , the God of Israel.

source: Chule hia chun, Egypt gama kona ana puidoh laija, Pakaiyin ipu ipateu to ana kitepna, hiche thingkhong umna ding mun chu kagongin ahi.
target: I have provided a place there for the ark, in which is the covenant of the Lord that he made with our ancestors when he brought them out of Egypt.”

source: Chuin Solomon chu Pakai maicham masang, Israel houkhom ho jouse masanga adingin, van lama akhut ajahdoh in:
target: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in front of the whole assembly of Israel, spread out his hands toward heaven

source: Vo Pakai, Israel Pathen, nasohte alung pumpiuva nangma masanga lamlhaho henga akitepna le khotona musah-a, nangma tobang Pathen himhim chunglam van'a le noilam leija aumpoi;
target: and said: “ Lord , the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven above or on earth below—you who keep your covenant of love with your servants who continue wholeheartedly in your way.

source: Nangman nasoh kapa David nathutep jouse nanit in; nangman nakamin thu naseijin, tunia banghin nakhutnin naguilhun sah-in ahi.
target: You have kept your promise to your servant David my father; with your mouth you have promised and with your hand you have fulfilled it—as it is today.

source: Hijeh chun tun, Israel Pakai Pathen, nasoh kapa David henga nanasei, nangma kamitmu-a nalam lhah banga, nachate achih theijuva alamlhah uleh, Israel laltouna-a keima angsunga touding losam ponte, tia naseichu nitnin.
target: “Now Lord , the God of Israel, keep for your servant David my father the promises you made to him when you said, ‘You shall never fail to have a successor to sit before me on the throne of Israel, if only your descendants are careful in all they do to walk before me faithfully as you have done.’

source: Chule tun, vo Israelte Pathen, katao ahi, nangman nasoh kapa David henga nanaseisa chu sudet teijin.
target: And now, God of Israel, let your word that you promised your servant David my father come true.

source: Hijeng jongle Pathen chu leija hin acheng mong nadem? vetan, vanle vanho van'in nadol joulou ahin; ka houin sah hi ichana lhasamjo hitam?
target: “But will God really dwell on earth? The heavens, even the highest heaven, cannot contain you. How much less this temple I have built!

source: Ahivangin, vo Pakai, ka Pathen, nasoh taona le thumna hi nei jabolpeh-in lang; nasoh tunia ataona, nahenga angehna le ataona hi ngaipeh-in.
target: Yet give attention to your servant’s prayer and his plea for mercy, Lord my God. Hear the cry and the prayer that your servant is praying in your presence this day.

source: Hitia chu hikoma hi kamin umding ahi tia nanaseina mun, hiche houin lam hi namitnin sunle jana avet jinga, chutia chu nasoh-in hiche houin munlam nga-a ataona nangaipeh theina ding kati ahi.
target: May your eyes be open toward this temple night and day, this place of which you said, ‘My Name shall be there,’ so that you will hear the prayer your servant prays toward this place.

source: Chule nasoh, chule nami Israelte ngehna ngaipeh inlang, hiche munlam nga-a atao tenguleh; nachenna mun van'a konin ngaipeh inlang, chule najah teng, ngaidamin.
target: Hear the supplication of your servant and of your people Israel when they pray toward this place. Hear from heaven, your dwelling place, and when you hear, forgive.

source: Khattouvin aheng akom chunga asuhkhella, acham louva kihahsel dinga auma, hiche houin'a maicham masanga kihahsel dinga ahungleh;
target: “When anyone wrongs their neighbor and is required to take an oath and they come and swear the oath before your altar in this temple,

source: Chuteng nangman van'a konin ngaipeh inlang, kipanin, nasohte thu tanpeh-in; migilou chu anatoh lampi chu aluchunga chuhsah inlang, chule michonpha chu achonphatna dungjuijin themchan sah-in.
target: then hear from heaven and act. Judge between your servants, condemning the guilty by bringing down on their heads what they have done, and vindicating the innocent by treating them in accordance with their innocence.

source: Nami Israelte hin nang douna-a achonset jeh uva, melmate anga vohlhuh a aumuva; chuteng nangma lam ahin ngat kitnuva, namin aphondoh uva, hiche houin'a hi taona le ngehna aneijuva ahileh,
target: “When your people Israel have been defeated by an enemy because they have sinned against you, and when they turn back to you and give praise to your name, praying and making supplication to you in this temple,

source: Chuteng nangman van'a konin ngaipeh inlang, nami Israelte setna chu ngaidamin, chule apu apateu napehna gamsunga lepui kitnin.
target: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel and bring them back to the land you gave to their ancestors.

source: Nangma douna-a achonset jeh uva van akikha-a, go ajuhlou teng, hilam nga ataovuva, namin aphondoh uva, chule nangman amaho nabolgenthei jeh-a achonset naova kona alungu aheijuva ahileh,
target: “When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because your people have sinned against you, and when they pray toward this place and give praise to your name and turn from their sin because you have afflicted them,

source: Chutengle nangman van'a konin ngaipeh inlang, achenadiu lampipha nahila, chule namite goulo dinga napehna gama hi go najuhsah nadingin, nasohte le nami Israelte setna chu ngaidamin.
target: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel. Teach them the right way to live, and send rain on the land you gave your people for an inheritance.

source: Gamsunga kel alhah-a, hise alanna, huise, thingtam, khaokho, ahiloule lungmul alana, amelma teovin akhopi houva aumkol uva, itobang suhgamna le itobang natna ahunglhuna ahijongle,
target: “When famine or plague comes to the land, or blight or mildew, locusts or grasshoppers, or when an enemy besieges them in any of their cities, whatever disaster or disease may come,

source: Khat touvin, ahiloule nami Israelte jousen, itobang taona hihen, itobang ngehna hijongle, alungsunga hahsat nei ahi akihetna, hilam nga-a akhut ahin jah-a ahile;
target: and when a prayer or plea is made by anyone among your people Israel—being aware of the afflictions of their own hearts, and spreading out their hands toward this temple—

source: Chutengle nachenna mun van'a konin ngaipeh inlang, ngaidamin, kipan inlang, mitin alamlhah dungjui cheh le alung gelu nahet bangin lethuh-in, (ajeh chu nangma jengbou mihem chapate lungsung he-a nahi.)
target: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Forgive and act; deal with everyone according to all they do, since you know their hearts (for you alone know every human heart),

source: Chutiachu nangman kapu kapateu napeh gamsunga hi achenlai seuva nangma nagin theidiu ahi.
target: so that they will fear you all the time they live in the land you gave our ancestors.

source: Chukalvalin, nami Israel hilouho gamdangmi, namin jala gamlatah-a kona hung kalsongho chungchanga;
target: “As for the foreigner who does not belong to your people Israel but has come from a distant land because of your name—

source: (Ajehchu namin kithangtah le nakhut thahat tah, chule naban najahdohna chu ajah dingu ahin;) hiche inlam nga-a ahunga atao tengle;
target: for they will hear of your great name and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm—when they come and pray toward this temple,

source: Nami Israelte banga leiset mijousen nangma nagin theina dinguva namin ahetnuva; hiche ka insah hin namin apui ti ahet theina dinguvin, nangman nachenna van'a konin ngaijin lang, gamchom mihon athum bangu chun bolpeh-in.
target: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Do whatever the foreigner asks of you, so that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your own people Israel, and may know that this house I have built bears your Name.

source: Namite nangman nasol nalam lama amelmateu satdinga acheuva, chule nalhentum khopi lam leh, namin dinga kasahpeh hiche in lam nga-a Pakai henga ataovuleh;
target: “When your people go to war against their enemies, wherever you send them, and when they pray to the Lord toward the city you have chosen and the temple I have built for your Name,

source: Chuteng nangman van'a konin ataonao le angehnao ngaipeh inlang, chule athu uchu gelpeh-in.
target: then hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and uphold their cause.

source: Nangma douna-a achonsetnuva, (ajehchu koima chonselou aumpoi,) achunguva nalunghanna, melmate khutna napeh doh-a, amahon gamlatah ham ahiloule naicha gal hinga akai manguva;
target: “When they sin against you—for there is no one who does not sin—and you become angry with them and give them over to their enemies, who take them captive to their own lands, far away or near;

source: Gal hinga akikai mangnao gama akingaito doh uva, akisih uva, chonset kabolun, lamvaijin, khangitlouna kaboltaove, tia gal hinga akaiteu gamachu nahenga thumna ahin neijule,
target: and if they have a change of heart in the land where they are held captive, and repent and plead with you in the land of their captors and say, ‘We have sinned, we have done wrong, we have acted wickedly’;

source: Chule chutia chu nahenga alung pumpiule alhagao pumpiuva gal hinga kaimanga aumnao, amelmateu gama kona, apu apateu napehna gam, nalhentum khopi, namin dinga kasahpeh houin lam nga-a ahung kileheijuva ataovule;
target: and if they turn back to you with all their heart and soul in the land of their enemies who took them captive, and pray to you toward the land you gave their ancestors, toward the city you have chosen and the temple I have built for your Name;

source: Chuteng nangin nachenna mun van'a chun ataonao le angehnao ngaipeh inlang, athu uchu gelpeh-in.
target: then from heaven, your dwelling place, hear their prayer and their plea, and uphold their cause.

source: Namiten nangma douna-a chonset abol jouseule, nangma douna-a khangitlouna aboljouseu chu ngaidamin; chule soh-a akaimang houvin khotona aneitheina diuvin, a-angsunga khotona musah-in.
target: And forgive your people, who have sinned against you; forgive all the offenses they have committed against you, and cause their captors to show them mercy;

source: Ajehchu amaho Egypt gama thih meikonga kona nahin puidoh, nangma mite le nagoulote ahiuve.
target: for they are your people and your inheritance, whom you brought out of Egypt, out of that iron-smelting furnace.

source: Chutia chu nasoh ngehna le nami Israelte ngehna lama hi namit nahasah-a, chule nahenga atao chanuleh nangaipeh ding ahi.
target: “May your eyes be open to your servant’s plea and to the plea of your people Israel, and may you listen to them whenever they cry out to you.

source: Ajehchu vo Pakai Pathen, nangman kapu kapateu Egypt gama kona napuidoh laija, nasoh Mosi-a kona nasei banga, nagou lodinga vannoi mijouse lah-a kona amaho chu nakhendoh anahi.
target: For you singled them out from all the nations of the world to be your own inheritance, just as you declared through your servant Moses when you, Sovereign Lord , brought our ancestors out of Egypt.”

source: Chule chutichun Solomon'in Pakai henga taonale ngehna jouse achai phatnin, Pakai maicham masanga adilsuh na-a konin, akhut teni-a vanlam sangpumin ahung dingdoh tan ahi.
target: When Solomon had finished all these prayers and supplications to the Lord , he rose from before the altar of the Lord , where he had been kneeling with his hands spread out toward heaven.

source: Chuin adingin, Israel houkhom ho jouse chu aw gingtah-in phatthei aboh-in, hitin aseije;
target: He stood and blessed the whole assembly of Israel in a loud voice, saying:

source: Athutep dungjuija ami Israelte olna pepa Pakai chu nunnom hen, asoh Mosi khutna athutep phajouse chu thucheng khatcha athon aumpoi.
target: “Praise be to the Lord , who has given rest to his people Israel just as he promised. Not one word has failed of all the good promises he gave through his servant Moses.

source: Pakai i-Pathen'un ipu ipateu anaumpi bangchun, eiho jong eiumpiu hen; Aman eidalha hih-u henlang, nungjong einungsun hih-u hen,
target: May the Lord our God be with us as he was with our ancestors; may he never leave us nor forsake us.

source: Chutile alampi jouse jotdingle, iputeu thu anapeh banga athupeh ho, adanthuho, athutanho nitna dinga ilungthimu ama lama eiheilut peh dingu ahi.
target: May he turn our hearts to him, to walk in obedience to him and keep the commands, decrees and laws he gave our ancestors.

source: Chule phattina asohte ngaichatna le ami Israelte angaichat dungjuija angaitopeh theina dingin, Pakai anga kangehna hiche thucheng hohin, asun ajanin Pakai i-Pathen koma umjing hen;
target: And may these words of mine, which I have prayed before the Lord , be near to the Lord our God day and night, that he may uphold the cause of his servant and the cause of his people Israel according to each day’s need,

source: Chutia chu leiset mijousen Pakai chu Pathen ahin, adang khatcha aumpoi ti ahet dingu ahi.
target: so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the Lord is God and that there is no other.

source: Hijeh chun tunikho-a banghin adanthuho mangdingle, athupehho nitdingin, Pakai i-Pathen'u henga nalungthimu phachamkim hen, ati.
target: And may your hearts be fully committed to the Lord our God, to live by his decrees and obey his commands, as at this time.”

source: Chuin lengpa le aumpi Israelte jousen Pakai masanga ganlhaina apeuvin ahi.
target: Then the king and all Israel with him offered sacrifices before the Lord .

source: Chuin Solomon'in chamna thiltoho, ganlhaina Pakai henga atochu, bongchal sangsomni le sangni, chule kelngoi sangjakhat le sangsomni ahi. Hitichun lengpa le Israel chate jousen Pakai in chu athenso taovin ahi.
target: Solomon offered a sacrifice of fellowship offerings to the Lord : twenty-two thousand cattle and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep and goats. So the king and all the Israelites dedicated the temple of the Lord .

source: Hiche nikho chun lengpan Pakai in masanga um hongcha lailung chu asuthengin ahi; ajehchu aman govam thiltoho, anneh thiltoho, chule chamna thiltoho thao chu atoh-in ahi: ajehchu Pakai masanga um sum-eng maicham chu govam thiltoho, anneh thiltoho chule chamna thiltoho thao sanna dinga chu neo behset ahi.
target: On that same day the king consecrated the middle part of the courtyard in front of the temple of the Lord , and there he offered burnt offerings, grain offerings and the fat of the fellowship offerings, because the bronze altar that stood before the Lord was too small to hold the burnt offerings, the grain offerings and the fat of the fellowship offerings.

source: Chuin hiche petchun Solomon le Israelte jouse, Hamath kho lutna-a pat Egypt vapi geija houkhom mipi tamtah ho chun, nisagi, chule nisagi ma, ni somle nili sungin kut abolun ahi.
target: So Solomon observed the festival at that time, and all Israel with him—a vast assembly, people from Lebo Hamath to the Wadi of Egypt. They celebrated it before the Lord our God for seven days and seven days more, fourteen days in all.

source: Anigetnin mipi ho chu asolmangin, chule amahon lengpa chu phatthei aboh-un; Pakaiyin asoh David dingle ami Israelte dinga aphatna jehchun aponbuh lamuvah kipahtah le lungkipah tah-in achetauve.
target: On the following day he sent the people away. They blessed the king and then went home, joyful and glad in heart for all the good things the Lord had done for his servant David and his people Israel.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Solomon'in Pakai in le leng in, Solomon'in ama lunglhaina bangtah-a boldinga atup jouse chu aboljou phatnin;
target: When Solomon had finished building the temple of the Lord and the royal palace, and had achieved all he had desired to do,

source: Chuti chun Gibeon'a ahenga akilah bangchun, aniveinan Pakai chu Solomon henga ahung kilah-in ahi.
target: the Lord appeared to him a second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin ahenga, ka-anga nataona le nathumna chu kangaipeh tan; a-imatih chana kamin umna dinga nasah hiche in hi kasu thengtan, kamit teni le kalungthim hia chu umjing ding ahi.
target: The Lord said to him: “I have heard the prayer and plea you have made before me; I have consecrated this temple, which you have built, by putting my Name there forever. My eyes and my heart will always be there.

source: Chule nangma jong kathupeh jouse bangle napa David umchan banga, lungthim dihtah le chondih tah-a kamit mua na-uma, kadan thuho le kathutanho najui jinga ahile,
target: “As for you, if you walk before me faithfully with integrity of heart and uprightness, as David your father did, and do all I command and observe my decrees and laws,

source: Chutengle Israelte laltouna-a touding mi kisudong ponte tia napa David henga kana kitepna bangin, Israel chunga nalenggam laltouna chu a-itih-a dinga kaphudet ding ahi.
target: I will establish your royal throne over Israel forever, as I promised David your father when I said, ‘You shall never fail to have a successor on the throne of Israel.’

source: Amavang nangma le nachaten keima neijui naova kona nakihei manguva, najuidaova na-ang uva kakoi kathupeh ho le kachonna dan kisunho najuidaova, pathen dangho kin nagabol uva, nagahou vuleh,
target: “But if you or your descendants turn away from me and do not observe the commands and decrees I have given you and go off to serve other gods and worship them,

source: Chutengle keiman amaho kapehsa gama kona chu Israelte chu kasuhmang ding; chule kamin dinga kasuhtheng hiche in hi kamitmu-a kona kapaidoh ding, chule Israel hi mijouse lah-a thuchih le paochamtuh-a pangding ahiuve.
target: then I will cut off Israel from the land I have given them and will reject this temple I have consecrated for my Name. Israel will then become a byword and an object of ridicule among all peoples.

source: Chule hiche in hi, kichoisang tah hijongle, ajotpa jousen adatmouva, akhoisat khumdiu; iti dana Pakaiyin hiche gamsung le hiche in hi hititah-a abol hitam? atidiu ahi.
target: This temple will become a heap of rubble. All who pass by will be appalled and will scoff and say, ‘Why has the Lord done such a thing to this land and to this temple?’

source: Chule amahon, Pakai a-Pathen'u, apu apateu Egypt'a kona puidohpa chu adalhah uva, pathen dangho akolchah uva, ahou uva, akinu aboltah jeh-uva Pakaiyin hiche thilse jousehi achunguva alhunsah ahi, ati dingu ahi.
target: People will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the Lord their God, who brought their ancestors out of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—that is why the Lord brought all this disaster on them.’ ”

source: Solomon'in in ni, Pakai in le leng in asah kum somni akichaijin, ahitin ahi.
target: At the end of twenty years, during which Solomon built these two buildings—the temple of the Lord and the royal palace—

source: (Tun Tyre lengpa Hiram'in Solomon chu cedar thingho, chahthingho, sanaho, angaichat dungjuijin apen,) chule Solomon lengpan Hiram chu Galilee gama khopi somni apen ahi.
target: King Solomon gave twenty towns in Galilee to Hiram king of Tyre, because Hiram had supplied him with all the cedar and juniper and gold he wanted.

source: Chuin Hiram Tyre'a konin Solomon'in apeh khopiho vedin ahungdoh-in, ahin hicheho chu alunglhaina ahipon ahi.
target: But when Hiram went from Tyre to see the towns that Solomon had given him, he was not pleased with them.

source: Chuin aman kasopipa, nangman neipeh hohi itobang khopi bepseu hitam? ati. Chule aman hicheho chu Cabul gam asah-in, tuni geihin akisahden tan ahi.
target: “What kind of towns are these you have given me, my brother?” he asked. And he called them the Land of Kabul, a name they have to this day.

source: Chule Hiram'in lengpa chu sana talent jale somni athotnin ahi.
target: Now Hiram had sent to the king 120 talents of gold.

source: Chule Solomon lengpan natong honkhat asemlona ajehchu hiche ahi: Pakai in le ama in chule Millo sah nading, chule Jerusalem, Hazor, Megiddo, chule Gezer kulbang sahna ding ahi.
target: Here is the account of the forced labor King Solomon conscripted to build the Lord ’s temple, his own palace, the terraces, the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, Megiddo and Gezer.

source: Ajehchu Egypt lengpa Pharoah chu achetouva, Gezer khopi agalah-a, hichu meijin ahala, chule khopi-a cheng Canaan miho chu atha gama, achanu, Solomon jinu chu kipaman thilpeh dinga apeh ahi.
target: (Pharaoh king of Egypt had attacked and captured Gezer. He had set it on fire. He killed its Canaanite inhabitants and then gave it as a wedding gift to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.

source: Chuin Solomon'in Gezer le Beth-horon lhangnung chu asan,
target: And Solomon rebuilt Gezer.) He built up Lower Beth Horon,

source: Baalath chule chuche gamthipma Tadmor,
target: Baalath, and Tadmor in the desert, within his land,

source: Chule Solomon'in anei thilkhopna khopiho jouse, akangtalai ho ding khopiho, asakol chung touho ding khopiho, chule Solomon'in Jerusalem le Lebanon, chule ama gamvai pohnaho sunga sahdinga agot chanchu asaovin ahi.
target: as well as all his store cities and the towns for his chariots and for his horses—whatever he desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon and throughout all the territory he ruled.

source: Chuin Israel chate hilou, Amor mite, Hit mite, Perizz mite, Hiv mite, Jebus miteho-a kona kidalha mijouse,
target: There were still people left from the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites (these peoples were not Israelites).

source: Chuche gama amaho nunga kidalha-a achateu, Israel chaten jong asuhmangsoh joulouho chu, hicheho chunga chun tuni chanin Solomon'in hunama soh natongin anasemin ahi.
target: Solomon conscripted the descendants of all these peoples remaining in the land—whom the Israelites could not exterminate—to serve as slave labor, as it is to this day.

source: Israel chate vang Solomon'in soh-in anasempon, ahinla amaho chu galbol mi, ama lhachate, ama pipuiho, agal lamkaiho, chule kangtalai ho le sakol chung touho vaipon apansah-in ahi.
target: But Solomon did not make slaves of any of the Israelites; they were his fighting men, his government officials, his officers, his captains, and the commanders of his chariots and charioteers.

source: Hichehohi Solomon natohna chunga pipui dehho ahiuvin, nakitoh na-a mipi ho chunga vaipoho chu janga le somnga ahiuve.
target: They were also the chief officials in charge of Solomon’s projects—550 officials supervising those who did the work.

source: Ahinla Pharaoh chanu chu David khopi-a konin Solomon'in amanu dinga in asahpeh-a chun ahungtoutan ahi. Chuin aman Millo chu asan ahi.
target: After Pharaoh’s daughter had come up from the City of David to the palace Solomon had built for her, he constructed the terraces.

source: Chuin Pakai dinga asem amaicham chunga chun Solomon'in kumkhat sungin govam thiltoho le chamna thiltoho thumvei atohjin, chule Pakai masanga um maicham chunga chun namtui ahalin ahi. Hitichun houin chu ajoutai.
target: Three times a year Solomon sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings on the altar he had built for the Lord , burning incense before the Lord along with them, and so fulfilled the temple obligations.

source: Chuin Solomon lengpan Edom gama, Twipisan pang, Eloth koma um, Ezion-geber mun'a chun kongho asemin ahi.
target: King Solomon also built ships at Ezion Geber, which is near Elath in Edom, on the shore of the Red Sea.

source: Chuin Hiram'in asohte, twipi lampanga thepna neiho chu Solomon sohte toh natongkhom dingin, kong khatna ahin solin ahi.
target: And Hiram sent his men—sailors who knew the sea—to serve in the fleet with Solomon’s men.

source: Chuin amaho chu Ophir'a ahungun, chua konchun sana talent jali leh somni ahin lapaovin, hichu Solomon lengpa henga ahinpouvin ahi.
target: They sailed to Ophir and brought back 420 talents of gold, which they delivered to King Solomon.

source: Chuin Pakai min chungchanga Solomon minthanje chu Sheba lengnun ajah phatnin, thudoh hahtahho to achihna phochendin ahungin ahi.
target: When the queen of Sheba heard about the fame of Solomon and his relationship to the Lord , she came to test Solomon with hard questions.

source: Chuin amanu anungjui tamtah toh, sangongsang ho-a gimnamtui ho, sana tamtah, song mantam tamtah po pumin Jerusalem'a ahungin; chuin amanu Solomon henga ahunglhun phatnin, alungsunga umjouse a chun ama akihoupitan ahi.
target: Arriving at Jerusalem with a very great caravan—with camels carrying spices, large quantities of gold, and precious stones—she came to Solomon and talked with him about all that she had on her mind.

source: Chuin Solomon'in amanu thudoh jouse chu adonbutsoh keijin, amanu aseipehlou lengpa-a kona kisela thil imacha aumpon ahi.
target: Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too hard for the king to explain to her.

source: Chuin Sheba lengnun Solomon chihnaho jouse, chule a-insahho;
target: When the queen of Sheba saw all the wisdom of Solomon and the palace he had built,

source: Adokhanga annehho, asohte toudanho, chule ajenho umjedan hole akivondan hou, chule akhon domho, chule Pakai in'a achetouna lampiho amuphatnin, lunggel dang himhim aneitapoi.
target: the food on his table, the seating of his officials, the attending servants in their robes, his cupbearers, and the burnt offerings he made at the temple of the Lord , she was overwhelmed.

source: Chuin amanun lengpa jah-a, nanatoh ho le nachihna kagam lama kanajah chu thuthang dihtah mong ahi.
target: She said to the king, “The report I heard in my own country about your achievements and your wisdom is true.

source: Ahivangin keima kahunga, kamit tah-a kahungmu kahsen, thuho chu kana tahsanpoi; chule vetan, akehkhat jong einahil pouve. Nachihna le naphattouna hin thuthanga kanajah chu akhokhelin ahi.
target: But I did not believe these things until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not even half was told me; in wisdom and wealth you have far exceeded the report I heard.

source: Na anga tanglouva dingjinga, chule nachihna thu ngaijinga namite le nasohte hi anunnoma ahiuve.
target: How happy your people must be! How happy your officials, who continually stand before you and hear your wisdom!

source: Nangma-a kipah-a, Israel laltouna-natousahpa, Pakai na Pathen chu nunnom hen; ajehchu Pakaiyin Israel hi tonsotna angailut ahin, hijeh-a chu dihtah-a thutan dinga lenga natun ahi, ati.
target: Praise be to the Lord your God, who has delighted in you and placed you on the throne of Israel. Because of the Lord ’s eternal love for Israel, he has made you king to maintain justice and righteousness.”

source: Chuin amanun lengpa chu sana talent jale somni toh, gimnamtui tamtah le, songmantam ho apen; Sheba lengnun Solomon lengpa gimnamtui apeh, sanga tamjo ahung lutbe khatapoi.
target: And she gave the king 120 talents of gold, large quantities of spices, and precious stones. Never again were so many spices brought in as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

source: Chule Ophir'a kona sana hinpo-a Hiram konglen jongchun, Ophir'a konin almug thingphung ho le songmantam ho ahinpon ahi.
target: (Hiram’s ships brought gold from Ophir; and from there they brought great cargoes of almugwood and precious stones.

source: Chuin lengpan almug thingho chu Pakai in le leng in'a khompiho ding, chule lasaho dinga selangdahle tumgingho semnan amangin; chutobang almug thing himhim chu ahunglut tapon, tugeijin mujong akimukit tapoi.
target: The king used the almugwood to make supports for the temple of the Lord and for the royal palace, and to make harps and lyres for the musicians. So much almugwood has never been imported or seen since that day.)

source: Chule Solomon lengpan Sheba lengnu chu angaichat chanle athumchan apen, chuche tailouvin Solomon'in athumlousan hongphal tah-in apei. Chutichun aumna gamlama amanule asohte akiletaove.
target: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired and asked for, besides what he had given her out of his royal bounty. Then she left and returned with her retinue to her own country.

source: Tun Solomon henga kumkhat sunga sana hunglut chu agih talent jaguple somgup le gup ahin,
target: The weight of the gold that Solomon received yearly was 666 talents,

source: Hiche tiloujong chun aman sumkolvei mihole thiljoh ho, chule Arabia gama lengho jousele gamsung vaipoho aneijin ahi.
target: not including the revenues from merchants and traders and from all the Arabian kings and the governors of the territories.

source: Solomon'in sana kikheng peh-in lumdal lentah jani asemin, lumdal khatna chu sana shekel jagup lutna kisem ahi.
target: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of gold went into each shield.

source: Chule sana kikhengpeh lumdal jathum asemin, lumdal khatna chu sana mina thumthum lutna kisem ahi. Lengpan hicheho chu Labanon gamthipma in'a chun akoijin ahi.
target: He also made three hundred small shields of hammered gold, with three minas of gold in each shield. The king put them in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon.

source: Chukalvallin lengpan saiha laltouna lentah khat asemin, hichu sana phapen twi alonkhumin ahi.
target: Then the king made a great throne covered with ivory and overlaid with fine gold.

source: Laltouna chun kalbi gup aneijin, laltouna chungvum nunglam chu akikolin, atouna sihteni-a chun ban ngapna aumgelin, ban ngapna panga chun keipi bahkai ni adinge.
target: The throne had six steps, and its back had a rounded top. On both sides of the seat were armrests, with a lion standing beside each of them.

source: Chule kalbi gup chunga asih langto-a chun keipi bahkai gupcheh, alangtoa somleni adingin; chutobang chu koimacha lenggama akisem khapoi.
target: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at either end of each step. Nothing like it had ever been made for any other kingdom.

source: Solomon lengpa twi donna khonho jouse jong sana ngen ahin, chule Lebanon gamthip in'a kongle beljouse jongchu sana theng ngen ahi. Dangka-a kisem khatcha aumpoi; Solomon nikholaijin dangka chu imachan akigelpoi.
target: All King Solomon’s goblets were gold, and all the household articles in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. Nothing was made of silver, because silver was considered of little value in Solomon’s days.

source: Ajehchu lengpan twipia chun Hiram kong inneiho le Tarshish kong inneiho aneijin; Tarshish kong inneiho chun kumthum halin sana dangka, saiha, jongho chule vahongho ahin pojiuvin ahi.
target: The king had a fleet of trading ships at sea along with the ships of Hiram. Once every three years it returned, carrying gold, silver and ivory, and apes and baboons.

source: Chutichun Solomon lengpan leisetna lengho jouse chu haonale chihnan nasatah-in akhelsoh keijin ahi.
target: King Solomon was greater in riches and wisdom than all the other kings of the earth.

source: Chule Pathen'in alungsunga akhumpeh chihna thu ngaidingin, leiset pumpin Solomon ahol holjin ahi.
target: The whole world sought audience with Solomon to hear the wisdom God had put in his heart.

source: Chule amaho amitakipmin thilpeh ahinchoijun; dangka kongle belho, sana kongle belho, vonho, galvonho, namtuiho, sakol ho chule sanganho, kumtin in abineija ahin peuvin ahi.
target: Year after year, everyone who came brought a gift—articles of silver and gold, robes, weapons and spices, and horses and mules.

source: Chule Solomon'in sakol kangtalai ho le sakol touthemho akhom khommin, chule sakol kangtalai sangkhat le jali, sakol touthem sangsom le sangni aneijin; hichehochu kangtalai koina khopiho le Jerusalem'a leng umna-a chun aumsah in ahi.
target: Solomon accumulated chariots and horses; he had fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.

source: Chule lengpan dangka chu Jerusalem'a song bolin abolin, chule cedar thingchu atamjeh-in phaichama theiba thing bolin abole.
target: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.

source: Chule Solomon'in Egypt gama kona hung kipodoh sakolhole tupat ponnel ho aneijin; lengpa sumkolvei ho chun tupat ponnel chu aman apeh uva achohjiu ahi.
target: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from Kue—the royal merchants purchased them from Kue at the current price.

source: Sakol kangtalai khat Egypt'a kona hungtouva potdoh chu dangka shekel jagup man ahin, chule sakol khat chu jakhatle somnga man ahi. Chuti chun Hit lengho le Syria lengho din ahin toldohpeh jiuvin ahi.
target: They imported a chariot from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty. They also exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and of the Arameans.

source: Ahinla Solomon lengpan gamdang numei tamtah adeichatan, Pharaoh chanutoh kigomin, Moab numei ho, Ammon numei ho, Edom numei ho, Zidon numei ho chule Hit numei ho;
target: King Solomon, however, loved many foreign women besides Pharaoh’s daughter—Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians and Hittites.

source: Pakaiyin Israel chate jah-a, ahenguva nachelou dingu, amahojong naheng uva hunglou diu ahi; ajehchu thonlouva amahon nalungthimu a-pathen lamuva aheikoi dingu ahi; anatina miho chu Solomon'in ngailutna-in akolchahtai.
target: They were from nations about which the Lord had told the Israelites, “You must not intermarry with them, because they will surely turn your hearts after their gods.” Nevertheless, Solomon held fast to them in love.

source: Hitichun aman leng chanute jasagi ji-in aneijin, chule thaikem jathum aneijin; ajiten alung ahei mangpeh taove.
target: He had seven hundred wives of royal birth and three hundred concubines, and his wives led him astray.

source: Ajehchu ahitin ahi, Solomon ahungteh phatnin, ajiten pathen dangho lama alung aheikonpeh-un, chule apa David lungput bangin Pakai a-Pathen lama alungput aphachamkim tapon ahi.
target: As Solomon grew old, his wives turned his heart after other gods, and his heart was not fully devoted to the Lord his God, as the heart of David his father had been.

source: Ajehchu Solomon'in Zidon mite pathen Astorath, chule thet umtah Ammon mite pathen Milchom lama chun akiheitan ahi.
target: He followed Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and Molek the detestable god of the Ammonites.

source: Chuin Solomon'in Pakai mitmun thilse ahinboltan, apa David bangin Pakai chu ajui bukim tapoi.
target: So Solomon did evil in the eyes of the Lord ; he did not follow the Lord completely, as David his father had done.

source: Hitichun Solomon'in Jerusalem masang lhanga chun thet umtah Moab mite Chemosh dingle, thet umtah Ammon chate Molech dingin munsang khat asemin ahi.
target: On a hill east of Jerusalem, Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the detestable god of Moab, and for Molek the detestable god of the Ammonites.

source: Chutobang machun gamdang numei ajite jouse pathenho dingin gimnamtui halna le ganlhaina aseme.
target: He did the same for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and offered sacrifices to their gods.

source: Chuin Pakai Israel Pathen, ahenga niveijen kilahpa-a kona akiheimang jehchun, Solomon chunga Pakai alunghang tan,
target: The Lord became angry with Solomon because his heart had turned away from the Lord , the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice.

source: Aman pathen dang ahoulou nadinga, hiche thudola hi thu anapehsa ahin; ahinla aman Pakaiyin ana thupeh chu anitpon ahi.
target: Although he had forbidden Solomon to follow other gods, Solomon did not keep the Lord ’s command.

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Solomon henga, hitobang tah-a hi na-uma, nangma kathupeh kathulhun le kachondanho nanit loujeh-in, lenggam chu thonlouva kabotela nasohpa kapeh ding ahitai, ati.
target: So the Lord said to Solomon, “Since this is your attitude and you have not kept my covenant and my decrees, which I commanded you, I will most certainly tear the kingdom away from you and give it to one of your subordinates.

source: Ahijeng vangin napa David jal-in nahin sungin bolponge; ahinla nachapa khutna kona kalhe khending ahitai.
target: Nevertheless, for the sake of David your father, I will not do it during your lifetime. I will tear it out of the hand of your son.

source: Hijeng jongle lenggam jouse chu lhehkhen pongting, kasoh David jal leh kalhentum Jerusalem jala phungkhat vang nachapa kapeh ding ahi, ati.
target: Yet I will not tear the whole kingdom from him, but will give him one tribe for the sake of David my servant and for the sake of Jerusalem, which I have chosen.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Solomon doudingin Edom mi Hadad chu ahintildoh-in, amachu Edom leng chilhah ahi.
target: Then the Lord raised up against Solomon an adversary, Hadad the Edomite, from the royal line of Edom.

source: Ajehchu ahitin ahi, David Edom gama auma, janel gal lamkai Joab chun Edom gama pasal takip atha nungin, amithaho vuidin ache touvin ahi;
target: Earlier when David was fighting with Edom, Joab the commander of the army, who had gone up to bury the dead, had struck down all the men in Edom.

source: (Ajehchu Edom pasal takip athagam soh kahseuvin, Joab chu chua chun Israelte jousetoh lhagupjen aga umun ahi,)
target: Joab and all the Israelites stayed there for six months, until they had destroyed all the men in Edom.

source: Hadad chu apa sohte lah-a Edom mi phabep toh Egypt gama dingin ajamun; Hadad chu chapang neocha bou ahinalaije.
target: But Hadad, still only a boy, fled to Egypt with some Edomite officials who had served his father.

source: Amaho Midian gama konin akipat doh-un, Paran'a ahungun; Paran'a konin mi akipuijun, Egypt gama, lengpa Pharoah henga ahungun; amachun in apen, nehlechah angaitopeh-in, gamjong anapen ahi.
target: They set out from Midian and went to Paran. Then taking people from Paran with them, they went to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave Hadad a house and land and provided him with food.

source: Chule Hadad chu Pharoah mitmun lungsetna lentah achangin, chutichun amatah jinu sopinu, Tahpenes lengnu sopinu chu ajidin apen ahi.
target: Pharaoh was so pleased with Hadad that he gave him a sister of his own wife, Queen Tahpenes, in marriage.

source: Tahpenes sopinu chun chapa Genubath ahinpeh-in, amachu Tahpenes'in Pharoah in'a noichep abansah-in; Genubath chu Pharoah insungmi, Pharoah chapatetoh alhakhomin ahi.
target: The sister of Tahpenes bore him a son named Genubath, whom Tahpenes brought up in the royal palace. There Genubath lived with Pharaoh’s own children.

source: Chuin Hadad'in Egypt gama konin, David chu apu apatetoh alumkhom tan, chule sepai vaipipo Joab athitai ti ajah phatnin, Hadad'in Pharoah henga, kagamlama kachethei nadin neipotdoh sahtan, ati.
target: While he was in Egypt, Hadad heard that David rested with his ancestors and that Joab the commander of the army was also dead. Then Hadad said to Pharaoh, “Let me go, that I may return to my own country.”

source: Chuphatnin Pharoah'in ajah-a, kakoma naumhi ipi lhahsamna naneija, hitia chu phulou helouva nagam lama cheding nagot ham? ati. Chuin aman adonbutnin, imacha kalhasampoi, ahin neichesah pou pouvin, ati.
target: “What have you lacked here that you want to go back to your own country?” Pharaoh asked. “Nothing,” Hadad replied, “but do let me go!”

source: Chuin Pathen'in akidoupi chomkhat, Eliadah chapa Rezon, a-pakaipa Zaboh lengpa Hadadezer'a kona jamdohpa atildohpeh kitnin;
target: And God raised up against Solomon another adversary, Rezon son of Eliada, who had fled from his master, Hadadezer king of Zobah.

source: David'in Zobah kho miho athagam laija chu, amapa hin ahenga mi anakhopma, chule honkhat chunga gal lamkaija hungpanga; chule amaho Damascus'a acheuva, chua chu gachenguva, Damascus'a vaipo-a panga ahi.
target: When David destroyed Zobah’s army, Rezon gathered a band of men around him and became their leader; they went to Damascus, where they settled and took control.

source: Chule Hadad'in thilphalou anabol tilouvin jong, Solomon hinkho lhumkeijin amapa chu Israel kidoupi ahijingin; Israelte aho lheh-in, Syria gamchunga vai ahomin ahi.
target: Rezon was Israel’s adversary as long as Solomon lived, adding to the trouble caused by Hadad. So Rezon ruled in Aram and was hostile toward Israel.

source: Chule Zerada kho-a Ephrath mi, meithai khat amin Zeruah kitinu chapa, Solomon sohpa, Nebat chapa Jeroboam jongchun, lengpa dounan akhut alamin ahi.
target: Also, Jeroboam son of Nebat rebelled against the king. He was one of Solomon’s officials, an Ephraimite from Zeredah, and his mother was a widow named Zeruah.

source: Lengpa chunga akhut alapna ajehchu hiche ahi: Solomon in Millo asa-in, apa David khopi aselaiho asemphan ahi.
target: Here is the account of how he rebelled against the king: Solomon had built the terraces and had filled in the gap in the wall of the city of David his father.

source: Chule Jeroboam kiti mipa hi hattahle hangsantah ahin; chule Solomon'in chuche gollhang chu miphachom tah ahi ahetjeh-in, Joseph insung natohjouse chunga vaihomin apansah-in ahi.
target: Now Jeroboam was a man of standing, and when Solomon saw how well the young man did his work, he put him in charge of the whole labor force of the tribes of Joseph.

source: Chuin chuphat laitah chun ahitin ahi, Jeroboam Jerusalem'a kona apotdoh-a ahile, Shilon mi Ahijah themgaovin amachu lamdunga akimupin; amachun pon thahbeh akivon ahin, chule gamlah-a chu amanibou umlhona ahi.
target: About that time Jeroboam was going out of Jerusalem, and Ahijah the prophet of Shiloh met him on the way, wearing a new cloak. The two of them were alone out in the country,

source: Chuin Ahijah chun achunga pon thahbet-a chun amanin, halsomle halni in abottelin,
target: and Ahijah took hold of the new cloak he was wearing and tore it into twelve pieces.

source: Chuin aman Jeroboam jah-a, nangman halsom kilah-in, ajehchu Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije; vetan, keiman Solomon khutna kona lenggam chu kalhekhena, phung som chu nangma kapeh ding nahi, ati.
target: Then he said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces for yourself, for this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘See, I am going to tear the kingdom out of Solomon’s hand and give you ten tribes.

source: (Ahinla kasoh David jalle Israel namjouse lah-a kalhendoh khopi Jerusalem jala, namkhat vang aman aneiding ahi.)
target: But for the sake of my servant David and the city of Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, he will have one tribe.

source: Ajehchu amahon eida lhaovin Zidon mite pathen nu Astoreth, Moab mite pathen Chemosh, chule Ammon chate pathen Milcom ahouvun, apa David bangin kalampiho ajuipon, kamitmu-a thildih abolpon, kachondan kisunho le kathutanho anitpon ahi.
target: I will do this because they have forsaken me and worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Molek the god of the Ammonites, and have not walked in obedience to me, nor done what is right in my eyes, nor kept my decrees and laws as David, Solomon’s father, did.

source: Ipi hitaleh gam pumpi vang akhutna konin lahpeh ponge; ahinla kathupeh ho le kachondan kisunho nitpa, kalhendohsa kasoh David jal-in, ahinlaisen leng khatnin pansah nange.
target: “ ‘But I will not take the whole kingdom out of Solomon’s hand; I have made him ruler all the days of his life for the sake of David my servant, whom I chose and who obeyed my commands and decrees.

source: Amavang lenggamhi achapa khutna kona kalah-a, phung somho chu nangma kapeh ding nahi.
