target: I will take the kingdom from his son’s hands and give you ten tribes.

source: Chule kamin koina dinga kalhentum khopi Jerusalem, kasoh David'in kamasanga a-imatih chana vah aneitheina dinga, namkhat chu achapa kapeh ding ahi.
target: I will give one tribe to his son so that David my servant may always have a lamp before me in Jerusalem, the city where I chose to put my Name.

source: Nangma tungdoh-ing kating, nalunggot bangtah-a vai nahom ding, Israel chunga lenga napanding ahi.
target: However, as for you, I will take you, and you will rule over all that your heart desires; you will be king over Israel.

source: Chule hitiding ahin, kathupeh jouse nanitna, kalampiho najotna, kasoh David banga kachondan kisunhole kathupeh ho nanitna, kamitmu-a adih chu nabola ahile; chutichun nakoma umjinging ting, David dinga kasahpeh banga nangma jong insung dettah kasahdohpeh ding, chule Israelte hi kapeh ding nahi.
target: If you do whatever I command you and walk in obedience to me and do what is right in my eyes by obeying my decrees and commands, as David my servant did, I will be with you. I will build you a dynasty as enduring as the one I built for David and will give Israel to you.

source: Chule hiche jeh-a hi David chilhahte kabol genthei ding ahin, ahinla tonsotna ding ahipoi.
target: I will humble David’s descendants because of this, but not forever.’ ”

source: Hijeh chun Solomon'in Jeroboam thadingin aholtan ahi. Chuin Jeroboam akipat doh-in, Egypt gama Egypt lengpa Shishak henga ajamlutnin, Solomon thi kahsen Egypt'a aumtai.
target: Solomon tried to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam fled to Egypt, to Shishak the king, and stayed there until Solomon’s death.

source: Tun Solomon thilbol dangho jouse, anatohho jouse, chule achih naho chu, Solomon thilbolho kijihna lekhabua kisun hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Solomon’s reign—all he did and the wisdom he displayed—are they not written in the book of the annals of Solomon?

source: Chule Jerusalem'a Israel pumpi chunga Solomon analengchan sungchu, kum somli anahi.
target: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

source: Chuin Solomon chu apu apate toh alumkhomin, chule apa David khopi-ah akivuitai. Chule Rehoboam achapa chu akhelin alengchang tan ahi.
target: Then he rested with his ancestors and was buried in the city of David his father. And Rehoboam his son succeeded him as king.

source: Chuin Rehoboam Shechem'a achen ahi: ajehchu Israelte jouse ama lengchansah dinga Shechem'a hunga ahiuve.
target: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had gone there to make him king.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Egypt gama umnalai Nebat chapa Jeroboam'in hichu ahinjatan, (ajehchu ama Solomon lengpa-a kona jam-a ahin, chule Jeroboam Egypt gama chenga ahi;)
target: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard this (he was still in Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon), he returned from Egypt.

source: Hitichun amahon ama agakousah taovin ahi. Chuin Jeroboam le Israel mipi ho jouse chu ahungun, Rehoboam henga thu aseijun, hitin aseijuve,
target: So they sent for Jeroboam, and he and the whole assembly of Israel went to Rehoboam and said to him:

source: Napan kanamkol jonu agihsah behseh-in, hijeh chun tun napa kinbol hahsatahle kachunguva angap anamkoljon gihchu jansah-in, chutile nangma kin bolnao vinge, atiuve.
target: “Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but now lighten the harsh labor and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you.”

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, nithum sunga din kikhin kang tadiuvin, chuteng kahenga hungkitnun, ati. Chuin mipi chu akikhin kangtaove.
target: Rehoboam answered, “Go away for three days and then come back to me.” So the people went away.

source: Chuin Rehoboam lengpan apa Solomon hinlaija ahenga dingjing upaho chu akihoulim pin, hiche miho kadonbut theina ding thu iti neipeh diuham? tin adongin ahi.
target: Then King Rehoboam consulted the elders who had served his father Solomon during his lifetime. “How would you advise me to answer these people?” he asked.

source: Chuin amahon ajah-a, tunia hiteho soh-a napana, najenna, amaho nadonbutna, chule thungei tah naseipeh-a ahile; amaho a-itih-a nasoh hijingdiu ahitai, atiuve.
target: They replied, “If today you will be a servant to these people and serve them and give them a favorable answer, they will always be your servants.”

source: Ahinla aman tehse hon apeh-u thumop ho chu anot thapmin, amatoh khandohtha-a, amasanga dingjing khangdongho chu adong jotan;
target: But Rehoboam rejected the advice the elders gave him and consulted the young men who had grown up with him and were serving him.

source: Chuin aman ajah uvah, kahenga, napan kachunguva angap namkoljon hi jansah-in, tia seija mipi ho idonbut theina dinguva itobang thumop neipeh dingu ham? ati.
target: He asked them, “What is your advice? How should we answer these people who say to me, ‘Lighten the yoke your father put on us’?”

source: Chuin amatoh khandohtha khangdongho chun ajah-a, nahenga, napan kanamkol jonu agihsah behseh-in, nangman vang jansah dommin, tia seiho koma chu hitia hi naseiding ahi; kamecha hi kapa taibuh sanga sajo ahi.
target: The young men who had grown up with him replied, “These people have said to you, ‘Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but make our yoke lighter.’ Now tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

source: Chule kapan namkol jon gihtah nasepeh-u ahin, keiman nanamkol jonu kasebe ding; kapan khaohola najepmu ahin, keiman vang aipi-a kasuhgim ding nahiuve, atiuve.
target: My father laid on you a heavy yoke; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions.’ ”

source: Chutichun lengpan nithum nile kahenga hungkitnun tia anateppeh bangchun, anithumnin Jeroboam le mipi jouse chu Rehoboam henga ahung kitnun ahi.
target: Three days later Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, as the king had said, “Come back to me in three days.”

source: Chuin lengpan mipi ho chu khautah-in adonbutnin, chule tehse hon athumop naochu anot thapmin;
target: The king answered the people harshly. Rejecting the advice given him by the elders,

source: Chule khangthah ho thumop dungjui chun, kapan na namkol jonu agihsah ahin, keiman na namkol jonu kabelap ding: kapan khaohola najepmu ahin, kenvang aipiho-a kasuh gimding nahiuve, tin ahenguva aseitan ahi.
target: he followed the advice of the young men and said, “My father made your yoke heavy; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions.”

source: Ajehchu thilsoh chu Pakaiya kon ahin, Nebat chapa Jeroboam henga Shilon mi Ahijah mangcha-a Pakaiyin anaseisa chu tohdoh theina dinga, lengpan mipi ho thusei chu angaipeh lou ahitai.
target: So the king did not listen to the people, for this turn of events was from the Lord , to fulfill the word the Lord had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah the Shilonite.

source: Hitichun Israelte jouse chun lengpan athu angaipeh lou amu phatnun, mipi chun lengpa adonbutnun, eihon David'a ipi chan ineijum? chule Jesse chapa-a jong gouloding inei pouve. Vo Israelte, napon in cheh kijotnun; vo David, tun nangmatah in kivetan, atiuve. Hitichun Israel ten apon in cheh akijot taove.
target: When all Israel saw that the king refused to listen to them, they answered the king: “What share do we have in David, what part in Jesse’s son? To your tents, Israel! Look after your own house, David!” So the Israelites went home.

source: Ahinala Judah khopiho-a cheng Israel chate chunga vang Rehoboam'in lengvai apotai.
target: But as for the Israelites who were living in the towns of Judah, Rehoboam still ruled over them.

source: Chujouvin Rehoboam lengpan kaidong vaipo Adoram chu asolin ahile; Israelte jousen songin anasepmun, athitai. Hijeh chun Rehoboam lengpa Jerusalem'a jamdin akangtalaija kinotah-in akaldoh-in ahi.
target: King Rehoboam sent out Adoniram, who was in charge of forced labor, but all Israel stoned him to death. King Rehoboam, however, managed to get into his chariot and escape to Jerusalem.

source: Hitichun Israel'in tunigei hin David insungmite adouvin ahi.
target: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Israelte jousen Jeroboam ahungkit ahet phatnun, mipi kikhomho hengadin akou asolun, Israelte jouse chunga dingin lengin atungtaove. Judah phung tailou David insung nungjuija khatcha aumpouve.
target: When all the Israelites heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the assembly and made him king over all Israel. Only the tribe of Judah remained loyal to the house of David.

source: Chuin Rehobaom Jerusalem'a ahungphatnin, Israel insung kisatpi dingle, lenggam chu Solomon chapa Rehoboam dinga lelahkit dingin, Judah insung jousele Benjamin phunga gal hat hangsan cheh mi sangsom le sangget hel akhomin ahi.
target: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mustered all Judah and the tribe of Benjamin—a hundred and eighty thousand able young men—to go to war against Israel and to regain the kingdom for Rehoboam son of Solomon.

source: Ahinla Pathen mi Shemaiah henga Pathen thu ahung lhungin, aseije,
target: But this word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God:

source: Judah lengpa Solomon chapa Rehobaom hengle, Judah le Benjamin insung mijouse, chule mipi amoho henga chun seijin,
target: “Say to Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah, to all Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people,

source: Pakaiyin hitihin aseije; nangho nachetou loudiu, nasopiu Israel chate chu nasat louheldiu ahi; amitakip a-incheh-a kileuhen, ajehchu hiche thil hi keijakon ahi. Amahon Pakai thuchu angaijun, Pakai thu dungjuijin akileuvin akikhen taove.
target: ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not go up to fight against your brothers, the Israelites. Go home, every one of you, for this is my doing.’ ” So they obeyed the word of the Lord and went home again, as the Lord had ordered.

source: Chuin Jeroboam'in Ephraim molsanga chun Shechem kho asemin, hia chun achengin; chua konin achedoh-in, Penuel kho asemin ahi.
target: Then Jeroboam fortified Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and lived there. From there he went out and built up Peniel.

source: Chuin Jeroboam'in alungsunga, tun lenggam chu David insung mite henga kilekit khaget nunte;
target: Jeroboam thought to himself, “The kingdom will now likely revert to the house of David.

source: Hiche mitehi Jerusalem'a Pakai in'a ganlhaina bola acheuva ahile, chuteng hiche mite lungthimhi a-pakai pao, Judah lengpa Rehoboam lama kiheijintin, chutengle keima eitha uva, Judah leng Rehoboam lama chekit diu ahi, ati.
target: If these people go up to offer sacrifices at the temple of the Lord in Jerusalem, they will again give their allegiance to their lord, Rehoboam king of Judah. They will kill me and return to King Rehoboam.”

source: Chuti chun lengpan mi aki thumop sah-in, sana bongnou lim ni asemin, ajah uva, nanghodin Jerusalem kaltou ahahsa behseh-e; vo Israel mite, veuvin, Egypt gama kona nahin puidoh uva na-pathen'u hi, ati.
target: After seeking advice, the king made two golden calves. He said to the people, “It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Here are your gods, Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt.”

source: Chuin khat Bethel'a akoijin, khatchu Dan'a akoijin ahi.
target: One he set up in Bethel, and the other in Dan.

source: Ahin hiche thilhi chonset ahunghitai; ajehchu mipichu khatjoh chu houdingin Bethel'a acheuvin, khatjopa houdingin Dan'a ache jiuvin ahi.
target: And this thing became a sin; the people came to worship the one at Bethel and went as far as Dan to worship the other.

source: Chule aman munsanga in asan, Levi chapate hilou, jalhang lah-a minoinungpen hochu thempun apansah-in ahi.
target: Jeroboam built shrines on high places and appointed priests from all sorts of people, even though they were not Levites.

source: Chuin Jeroboam'in Judah gama kut bangin, lhagetna-a chuche nisomle ninga ni chu kut nikho din asudetnin, maicham chunga chun atoh doh-in ahi. Chutichun Bethel'a jong abolin, asem bongnou henga chun ganlhaina abolin ahi. Chutichun aman munsang asem ho-a thempuho chu Bethel'a akoijin ahi.
target: He instituted a festival on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, like the festival held in Judah, and offered sacrifices on the altar. This he did in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves he had made. And at Bethel he also installed priests at the high places he had made.

source: Chutichun aman alungdei bangtah-a agot, lhagetna nisomle ninga ni chun, Bethel'a amaicham asemin ahi. Chule Israel chate dingin kut asudetnin, chule maicham chunga chun thilto atoh-in, gimnamtui ahalin ahi.
target: On the fifteenth day of the eighth month, a month of his own choosing, he offered sacrifices on the altar he had built at Bethel. So he instituted the festival for the Israelites and went up to the altar to make offerings.

source: Chule veuvin Pathen mikhat Juda gama konin Pakai thusah-in Bethel'a ahungin, Jeroboam chu maicham pangah gimnamtui haldin anadinge.
target: By the word of the Lord a man of God came from Judah to Bethel, as Jeroboam was standing by the altar to make an offering.

source: Chuin Pakai thun maicham douna asap khumin, vo maicham, maicham Pakaiyin hitin aseije; vetan David insunga chapa khat, amin Josiah kiti hungpeng ding; nachunga gimnamtui haljia munsanga thempuho nachunga atodoh ding, mihem guho chu nachunga kihalding ahi, ati.
target: By the word of the Lord he cried out against the altar: “Altar, altar! This is what the Lord says: ‘A son named Josiah will be born to the house of David. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who make offerings here, and human bones will be burned on you.’ ”

source: Chule hiche nikho mama chun melchihna apen, hichehi Pakaiyin asei melchihna chu ahi; vetan maicham hi khikeh intin, achunga um vutvamhohi kisung lhading ahi, ati.
target: That same day the man of God gave a sign: “This is the sign the Lord has declared: The altar will be split apart and the ashes on it will be poured out.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Pathen mipa thusei, Bethel'a maicham douna-a athusei chu leng Jeroboam'in ajah phatnin, man-uvin, tin akhut maichama konin ahinlhangin ahi. Ahin amapa heng lama ahinlhandoh akhutchu agoheltan, hitichun akhut chu aleloi theitapon ahi.
target: When King Jeroboam heard what the man of God cried out against the altar at Bethel, he stretched out his hand from the altar and said, “Seize him!” But the hand he stretched out toward the man shriveled up, so that he could not pull it back.

source: Pathen mipan Pakai thua melchihna asei bangchun, maicham jongchu akhikeh-in, meivamho chu maichama konin akisung lhatai.
target: Also, the altar was split apart and its ashes poured out according to the sign given by the man of God by the word of the Lord .

source: Chuin lengpa chun adonbutnin Pathen mipa jah-achun, kakhut hi ahungdamkit theina din Pakai na Pathen maikoh-a neitao peh-in, ati. Chuin Pathen mipa chu Pakai henga ataovin ahile, lengpa khutchu adamkit tan, atila toh ahungbang kit tai.
target: Then the king said to the man of God, “Intercede with the Lord your God and pray for me that my hand may be restored.” So the man of God interceded with the Lord , and the king’s hand was restored and became as it was before.

source: Chuin lengpan Pathen mipa jah-a chun, keimatoh in lama hungin lang, hungkichol don, chule keiman kipaman napenge, ati.
target: The king said to the man of God, “Come home with me for a meal, and I will give you a gift.”

source: Chuin Pathen mipa chun lengpa jah-a, na in kehkhat neipehding hijongle nangma toh lhonin hung pongting, hikoma jonghin anneh twidon himhim jong bolponge.
target: But the man of God answered the king, “Even if you were to give me half your possessions, I would not go with you, nor would I eat bread or drink water here.

source: Ajehchu changlhah nehih-in, twi himhim jong donhih-in, chule nahung nalam mama-a jong kilekit hih-in, tia Pakai thua thupehsa kahi, ati.
target: For I was commanded by the word of the Lord : ‘You must not eat bread or drink water or return by the way you came.’ ”

source: Chuti chun lamchoma achen, Bethel jona ahungna lampia chun akiletapoi.
target: So he took another road and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel.

source: Tun Bethel'a chun themgao tehsepu khat achengin, chuin achapate chu ahungun, chuchenia Bethel'a Pathen mipa thilbol jouse chu ahilun; lengpa henga athuseiho jong chu apau ahilun ahi.
target: Now there was a certain old prophet living in Bethel, whose sons came and told him all that the man of God had done there that day. They also told their father what he had said to the king.

source: Chuin apauvin ajah uvah, hoilama che am? ati. Ajehchu Juda gama kona hung Pathen mipa chena lampia chu achapaten anamu-u ahi.
target: Their father asked them, “Which way did he go?” And his sons showed him which road the man of God from Judah had taken.

source: Chuin aman achapate jah-a, sangan neigon peh-un, ati. Hitichun amahon sangan agonpeh-un, achunga chun atoutan,
target: So he said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” And when they had saddled the donkey for him, he mounted it

source: Pathen mipa nunga chu achele gangpi phung noija atou agamun ahi. Chuin aman ajah-a, nangma Juda gama kona hung Pathen mipa chu nahim? ati. Chuin aman kahi, ati.
target: and rode after the man of God. He found him sitting under an oak tree and asked, “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?” “I am,” he replied.

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, keitoh in'a chehitin an hungnen, ati.
target: So the prophet said to him, “Come home with me and eat.”

source: Chuin aman, keima nangtoh kilethei pongting, nangto jong na-in lutthei ponge; hiche mun'a hin nangtoh anneh twidon himhim bolponge;
target: The man of God said, “I cannot turn back and go with you, nor can I eat bread or drink water with you in this place.

source: Ajehchu kajah-a Pakai thuchun, hikoma chu an naneh-a, twi nadon louhel ding; nahungna lampia jong nakilekit louhel ding ahi, ati.
target: I have been told by the word of the Lord : ‘You must not eat bread or drink water there or return by the way you came.’ ”

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, keijong nang bang bang themgao khat kahin, chule Pakai thun vantil khatnin kajah-a, aman an aneh-a, twi adonthei nadin na in'a hinlepuitan eiti, ati. Ahin aman ajou asei ahibouve.
target: The old prophet answered, “I too am a prophet, as you are. And an angel said to me by the word of the Lord : ‘Bring him back with you to your house so that he may eat bread and drink water.’ ” (But he was lying to him.)

source: Hitichun ama amapa chutoh anungchen, a-in'a an anen, twi adontan ahi.
target: So the man of God returned with him and ate and drank in his house.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, amani dokhang phunga agatou lhona ahile, ama lepui themgaopa henga chun Pakai thu chu ahung lhungin;
target: While they were sitting at the table, the word of the Lord came to the old prophet who had brought him back.

source: Juda gama kon Pathen mipa jah-a chun ahin samdoh-in, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Pakai kamsung thu ngailouva, Pakai na Pathen'in nathupeh nanitda-a,
target: He cried out to the man of God who had come from Judah, “This is what the Lord says: ‘You have defied the word of the Lord and have not kept the command the Lord your God gave you.

source: Nahung nung hunga, Pakaiyin nahenga an nehih-in, chule twi jong donhih-in atinamuna, an naneh-a, twi nadon jeh-in; nalonghi napu napate lhan hunglhung louhel ding ahi, atin ahi.
target: You came back and ate bread and drank water in the place where he told you not to eat or drink. Therefore your body will not be buried in the tomb of your ancestors.’ ”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, aman an aneh jouva, twi adonjou phatnin, themgao ahin lepuipa chunn sangan agonpeh-in ahi.
target: When the man of God had finished eating and drinking, the prophet who had brought him back saddled his donkey for him.

source: Chuin ama achephatnin, keipi bahkai khatnin lampia ana kimaito pin, athat tai. Chule along chu lamdunga selhah-in aumin, sangan chu akoma adingin, keipi bahkai jongchu thilong koma chun adinge.
target: As he went on his way, a lion met him on the road and killed him, and his body was left lying on the road, with both the donkey and the lion standing beside it.

source: Chuin veuvin, mihon ahin jotpaovin, chule lamdunga along kiseplha-a, keipi bahkai thilong koma adinchu amuvin ahi. Chuin amaho ahungun themgao tehsepu chenna khopi-a agasei taovin ahi.
target: Some people who passed by saw the body lying there, with the lion standing beside the body, and they went and reported it in the city where the old prophet lived.

source: Chuin lampia kona galepui themgao chun ajah phatnin, Pathen mi, Pakai thusei ngailoupa chu ahije; hijeh-a chu Pakaiyin ahenga asei athu bangtah-a, Pakaiyin keipi bahkai apeh doh-a, keipi bahkaijin amaltela atha ahi, ati.
target: When the prophet who had brought him back from his journey heard of it, he said, “It is the man of God who defied the word of the Lord . The Lord has given him over to the lion, which has mauled him and killed him, as the word of the Lord had warned him.”

source: Chuin aman achapate jah-a, sangan neigotpeh un, ati. Chuin amahon agotpeh taove.
target: The prophet said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me,” and they did so.

source: Chuin ama achen ahile along lampia kiseplha chu agamun, chule sangan le keipi bahkai akoma adinlhon chu amun ahi. Keipi bahkai chun thilong chu anepon, sangan jongchu abot telpon ahi.
target: Then he went out and found the body lying on the road, with the donkey and the lion standing beside it. The lion had neither eaten the body nor mauled the donkey.

source: Chuin themgao chun Pathen mipa long chu adomin, sangan chunga akoijin, ahinlepoh tai. Chule themgao tehsepu chu lunghem dingle avuidin khopi-a chun ahunge.
target: So the prophet picked up the body of the man of God, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back to his own city to mourn for him and bury him.

source: Chuin aman thilong chu amatah lhanna alupsah-in; ohe, kasopipa! tin achunga alunghem uvin ahi.
target: Then he laid the body in his own tomb, and they mourned over him and said, “Alas, my brother!”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, ama avuijou phatnin achapate jah-a, keima kathiteng Pathen mipa kivuina lhan nahin neihin vuijun lang, ama gu koma kagu hinkoijun, ati.
target: After burying him, he said to his sons, “When I die, bury me in the grave where the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones.

source: Ajehchu Bethel maicham chungle Samaria khopi-a um munsanga in jouse douna-a Pakai thua anaseidohho chu hung guilhung teiding ahi, ati.
target: For the message he declared by the word of the Lord against the altar in Bethel and against all the shrines on the high places in the towns of Samaria will certainly come true.”

source: Hicheng thilsoh nung jonghin Jeroboam setna lampia konin akilehei dehpon, ahinla minoinung dehho chu munsang ho thempun asemin; anomchan aman asuthengin, amatah munsang ho thempu khatnin apangin ahi.
target: Even after this, Jeroboam did not change his evil ways, but once more appointed priests for the high places from all sorts of people. Anyone who wanted to become a priest he consecrated for the high places.

source: Hiche thilhohi Jeroboam insung dinga chonsetna, kisuhgamna, chule leisetna kona suhmang helna ahung hitai.
target: This was the sin of the house of Jeroboam that led to its downfall and to its destruction from the face of the earth.

source: Hiche laichun Jeroboam chapa Abijah adampon ahi.
target: At that time Abijah son of Jeroboam became ill,

source: Chuin Jerobaom'in ajinu jah-a, nahenga katao ahi, kipat in lang Jerobaom jinu ahi ti ahetlouna diuvin na-umdan khelin lang, Shiloh'a gache temin; ven, hia chun Ahijah themgao, hiche miho chunga lenga kahungpan ding kachung chang thuseipa chu aume, ati.
target: and Jeroboam said to his wife, “Go, disguise yourself, so you won’t be recognized as the wife of Jeroboam. Then go to Shiloh. Ahijah the prophet is there—the one who told me I would be king over this people.

source: Chule changlhah somle changlhah lum neocha cha, chule khoiju haikhat kenginlang ahenga gachen; aman chapang umdan ding nahinhil teiding ahi, ati.
target: Take ten loaves of bread with you, some cakes and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will happen to the boy.”

source: Chuin Jeroboam jinun chutichun abolin, akipatnin, Shiloh'a achen, Ahijah in'a ahungtai. Ahin Ahijah chun atehjeh-in kho amutheipoi.
target: So Jeroboam’s wife did what he said and went to Ahijah’s house in Shiloh. Now Ahijah could not see; his sight was gone because of his age.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Ahijah henga, ven, Jeroboam jinu nahenga achapa dinga thilkhat thumdingin ahunge, ajehchu ama adamlou ahi. Chule hitiding ahi, amanu ahunglut tengle, numei dangho bangtah-a hung umding ahi.
target: But the Lord had told Ahijah, “Jeroboam’s wife is coming to ask you about her son, for he is ill, and you are to give her such and such an answer. When she arrives, she will pretend to be someone else.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Ahijah'in amanu kotphung ahunggeija akhodap gin ajah phatnin, amanu jah-a, nangma Jerobaom jinu hunglutnin; ibolla midang kihisah-a nahim? ajehchu keima thuhil phaloutah hildinga nahenga eikisola ahi.
target: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her footsteps at the door, he said, “Come in, wife of Jeroboam. Why this pretense? I have been sent to you with bad news.

source: Chen, Jeroboam jah-a gaseipeh-in, Pakai Israelte Pathen'in hitin ati, ajehchu mipi ho lah-a kona kachoisanga, kami Israelte chunga vaipo-a kapansah-a,
target: Go, tell Jeroboam that this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘I raised you up from among the people and appointed you ruler over my people Israel.

source: Chule David insunga kona alenggam kalhe khena, nang kapeh nahin; ahivangin nangma kathupeh ho nitna, chule kamitmu-a adih jeng bolna dingin alungthim pumpi-a eijuija, kasoh David bangin na-umpon;
target: I tore the kingdom away from the house of David and gave it to you, but you have not been like my servant David, who kept my commands and followed me with all his heart, doing only what was right in my eyes.

source: Ahivangin nangman keima lunghansah nadingin, namasanga mijouse sangin thilse nabol dehsetne; ajehchu nachen Pathen danghole milim kilhajol nakisemin, nanung lama neipaitai.
target: You have done more evil than all who lived before you. You have made for yourself other gods, idols made of metal; you have aroused my anger and turned your back on me.

source: Hijeh chun vetan, keiman Jeroboam insung chunga thilse kalhunsah ding, chule Jeroboam'a kona pasal tapou akihen hihen, ongthol hijongle, Israel gamsunga kona kasuhmang ding; chule Jeroboam insungmi ahingdoh amoh chengse chu, min eh abeikahse atheh banga katheh ngim ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Because of this, I am going to bring disaster on the house of Jeroboam. I will cut off from Jeroboam every last male in Israel—slave or free. I will burn up the house of Jeroboam as one burns dung, until it is all gone.

source: Jerobaom insungmi khopi sunga thitapou chu ui jin aneh ding, gama thitapou chungleng vachaten anehdiu ahi; ajehchu hichu Pakai seisa ahitai.
target: Dogs will eat those belonging to Jeroboam who die in the city, and the birds will feed on those who die in the country. The Lord has spoken!’

source: Hijeh chun kipat in, na inlama chetan; khopi sunga nakho nalhah lutlutleh chapang chu thiding ahi.
target: “As for you, go back home. When you set foot in your city, the boy will die.

source: Chutia chu Israel jousen apul adouvuva, avuidiu ahi. Ajehchu Jeroboam insung mi amabou lhana kivui hiding ahi, ajehchu Jeroboam insunga amabouhin Israelte Pakai Pathen lama phatna themkhat aneijin ahi.
target: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him. He is the only one belonging to Jeroboam who will be buried, because he is the only one in the house of Jeroboam in whom the Lord , the God of Israel, has found anything good.

source: Chukal vala Pakaiyin Jeroboam insung sumang dinga Israel chunga lengkhat atundoh ding; tujenga jong, ahile itiding hitam?
target: “The Lord will raise up for himself a king over Israel who will cut off the family of Jeroboam. Even now this is beginning to happen.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin twilah-a peng kilingling banga Israel ajepding, chule Pakai lunghansah nadinga milim akisemthu jeh uva, aman Israel chu apu apateu anapeh hiche gam phatah-a kona hi abodoh-a, chule vadunglen gala athecheh ding ahi.
target: And the Lord will strike Israel, so that it will be like a reed swaying in the water. He will uproot Israel from this good land that he gave to their ancestors and scatter them beyond the Euphrates River, because they aroused the Lord ’s anger by making Asherah poles.

source: Jeroboam chonset naho jehle chonset anabola Israel achonsetsah jeh-a, aman Israel apaidoh ding ahi.
target: And he will give Israel up because of the sins Jeroboam has committed and has caused Israel to commit.”

source: Chuin Jeroboam jinu akipat doh-in, apotnin, Tirzah ahunglhung tai. Chuin kotbul kempum agaphah phah-in chapang chu athitai.
target: Then Jeroboam’s wife got up and left and went to Tirzah. As soon as she stepped over the threshold of the house, the boy died.

source: Chuin amahon avuitaovin; Pakaiyin asoh Ahijah themgao henga anasei, Pakai thu dungjui chun avuijun, Israelte jousen apul adoutaove.
target: They buried him, and all Israel mourned for him, as the Lord had said through his servant the prophet Ahijah.

source: Jeroboam thilbol adang jouse, gal iti asatna, lengvai iti apoh thuho chu, veuvin, Israel lengte thusimbua hihochu akisunin ahi.
target: The other events of Jeroboam’s reign, his wars and how he ruled, are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.

source: Jeroboam lengchan nikhoho chu kum somni le kumni ahi. Chuin ama apu apate toh alumkhomin, achapa Nadab chu ama khelin alengchang tai.
target: He reigned for twenty-two years and then rested with his ancestors. And Nadab his son succeeded him as king.

source: Chuin Solomon chapa Rehoboam Judah gama aleng changin ahi. Rehoboam ahung lengchan patchun kum somli le kumkhat ahitan, Pakaiyin amin umna dinga Israel phung jouse lah-a kona analhentum khopi Jerusalem'a chun kum somle kumsagi aleng changin ahi. Anu minchu Naamah ahin, Ammon mi ahi.
target: Rehoboam son of Solomon was king in Judah. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel in which to put his Name. His mother’s name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite.

source: Chule Judah te chun Pakai mitmun thilse abolun, apu apateu jouse sanga chungnung-jo-a chonset abolnaova chun, Pakai chu thangsetna dingin achoh thouvun ahi.
target: Judah did evil in the eyes of the Lord . By the sins they committed they stirred up his jealous anger more than those who were before them had done.

source: Ajehchu amahon munsang jouse, chule thinghing phungnoi tinna munsang ho, milimho, khomho, chule thinga kisem milim atungdoh-un ahi.
target: They also set up for themselves high places, sacred stones and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every spreading tree.

source: Chule gamsunga chun Sodom mijong aumun; Israel chate masanga Pakaiyin anapaidohsa thet umtah namho bolbangchu anabolun ahi.
target: There were even male shrine prostitutes in the land; the people engaged in all the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.

source: Chuin Rehoboam lengchan kum ngana-a chun ahitin ahi, Egypt lengpa Shishak chu Jerusalem doudin ahung touvin,
target: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem.

source: Chule Pakai in'a gouho le lengpa in'a gouho chu alan, abonchan apomangin; Solomon'in anasem sana lumdal ho chu abonchan apomangtai.
target: He carried off the treasures of the temple of the Lord and the treasures of the royal palace. He took everything, including all the gold shields Solomon had made.

source: Chuin Rehoboam lengpan hicheho khelchun sum-eng in lumdal asemin, hicheho chu lengpa kot ngah-a pang, ngahtup pipui khutna apedoh-in ahi.
target: So King Rehoboam made bronze shields to replace them and assigned these to the commanders of the guard on duty at the entrance to the royal palace.

source: Chule hitihi anahi, lengpa chu Pakai in'a achetengle, ngahtup pachun hicheho chu ahinkengjin, chujou tengle ngahtup indan sunga alekoi kitjin ahi.
target: Whenever the king went to the Lord ’s temple, the guards bore the shields, and afterward they returned them to the guardroom.

source: Tun Rehoboam thilbol danghole anatoh jouse chu, Judah lengho thusimbu ho-a kisun soh hel hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Rehoboam’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

source: Chule Rehoboam le Jeroboam kah-a chun ahinkho lhumkei lhonin kidouna aumjinge.
target: There was continual warfare between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.

source: Chuin Rehoboam chu apu apate toh alumkhomin, apu apateu toh David khopi-a avuitha taove. Chule anu minchu Naamah ahin, Ammon numei ahi. Chuin achapa Abijam akhelin alengchang tai.
target: And Rehoboam rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David. His mother’s name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite. And Abijah his son succeeded him as king.

source: Tun Nebat chapa Jeroboam lengchan kum somle kumget na-in, Judah gam chunga Abijam aleng changin ahi.
target: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam son of Nebat, Abijah became king of Judah,

source: Ama Jerusalem'a kumthum alengchange. Chule anumin chu Maachah ahin, Abishalom chanu ahi.
target: and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother’s name was Maakah daughter of Abishalom.

source: Chule apan masanga anabol chonsetna jouse-a chun achonin; alungthim chu apa David lungthim bangin Pakai a-Pathen'a apha chamkimpon ahi.
target: He committed all the sins his father had done before him; his heart was not fully devoted to the Lord his God, as the heart of David his forefather had been.

source: Hijeng jongle David khohsahna jal-in Pakai a-Pathen'in ama nunga achapa tundoh nadingle, Jerusalem phudoh nadingin, Jerusalem'a meivah khat anapen ahi.
target: Nevertheless, for David’s sake the Lord his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem by raising up a son to succeed him and by making Jerusalem strong.

source: Ajehchu Hit mi Uriah chungchang tilouvin, David'in Pakai mitmun thildih jeng anabolin, ahin laisen athupeh khatcha-a konin akihei mangpon ahi.
target: For David had done what was right in the eyes of the Lord and had not failed to keep any of the Lord ’s commands all the days of his life—except in the case of Uriah the Hittite.

source: Chule Rehoboam chu Jeroboam toh ahin laisen akidou jing lhonin ahi.
target: There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam throughout Abijah’s lifetime.

source: Tun Abijam thilbol danghole anatohho Judah lengho thusimbu ho-a kisun soh hel louham? Chule Abijam le Jereboam kah-a chun kidouna anaumin ahi.
target: As for the other events of Abijah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

source: Chuin Abijam chu apu apate toh alumkhomin, David khopi-a avuitaove. Chule achapa Asa chu ama khelin alengchang tai.
target: And Abijah rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. And Asa his son succeeded him as king.

source: Chuin Israel lengpa Jeroboam lengchan kum somni na in Juda gamsunga Asa aleng changin ahi.
target: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa became king of Judah,

source: Chule ama Jerusalem'a kum somli le kumkhat alengchange. Anu minchu Maachah ahin, Abishalom chanu ahi.
target: and he reigned in Jerusalem forty-one years. His grandmother’s name was Maakah daughter of Abishalom.

source: Chule Asa chun apa David'in anabol bangin, Pakai mitmun adih chu abolin ahi.
target: Asa did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , as his father David had done.

source: Chuin aman gamsunga jonthanhoi bolhochu anodoh-in, chule apatehon anasem milim jouse asumang soh-in ahi.
target: He expelled the male shrine prostitutes from the land and got rid of all the idols his ancestors had made.

source: Chule anu Maachah, apena anu jengjong Asherah lim anasemjeh-in lengnu ahina ahaisah-in; Asa'in amanu milim chu asumangin, Kidron vapanga ahalvamin ahi.
target: He even deposed his grandmother Maakah from her position as queen mother, because she had made a repulsive image for the worship of Asherah. Asa cut it down and burned it in the Kidron Valley.

source: Ahinla munsang ho vang asumangpon, ahijeng vangin Asa lungthim chu ahinlai chansen Pakai lama achamkimin ahi.
target: Although he did not remove the high places, Asa’s heart was fully committed to the Lord all his life.

source: Chule apan asuhthengsa thilhole, amatah-in apeh thengsaho dangka le sana kong leh bel hochu, Pakai in'a apolutnin ahi.
target: He brought into the temple of the Lord the silver and gold and the articles that he and his father had dedicated.

source: Chule Asa le Israelte leng Baasha kikah-a ahinkho lhungkei lhonin kidou kinahna aumjinge.
target: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel throughout their reigns.

source: Chuin Israel lengpa Baasha chu Judah doudin achetouvin, Judah te lengpa Asa henga dinga koima alut le apot aumlouna dingin, Ramah kho asadoh-in ahi.
target: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah.

source: Chuphatnin Asa'in Pakai in'a anakidalhaho le lengpa in'a gouho, dangka le sana jouse chu alan asohte khutna apetai. Chuin lengpa Asa chun Damascus kho-a cheng Syria lengpa, Hezion chapa, Tabrimon chapa Benhadad henga chun aseijin,
target: Asa then took all the silver and gold that was left in the treasuries of the Lord ’s temple and of his own palace. He entrusted it to his officials and sent them to Ben-Hadad son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, the king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus.

source: Keima le nangma kikah, kapale napa kikah-a kinoptona aumin, ven, keiman nangma dangka le sana kipaman thilpeh kahinthotne; hungin lang, keija kona apotdoh nadingin, Israel lengpa Baasha toh nakinoptona hungsu keh-in, ati.
target: “Let there be a treaty between me and you,” he said, “as there was between my father and your father. See, I am sending you a gift of silver and gold. Now break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel so he will withdraw from me.”

source: Chuin Benhadad'in Asa lengpa thu angaijin, Israel khopiho doudingin janel gal lamkaiho asolin, Israel khopiho Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maachah, Cinneroth gam pumpi, chule Naptali gamjouse pumin asumangin ahi.
target: Ben-Hadad agreed with King Asa and sent the commanders of his forces against the towns of Israel. He conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel Beth Maakah and all Kinnereth in addition to Naphtali.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Baasha'n hiche thuchu ajah phatnin, Ramah'a kho asah banchu adalhan, Tirzah'a achengtai.
target: When Baasha heard this, he stopped building Ramah and withdrew to Tirzah.

source: Chujouvin lengpa Asa chun Judah gam pumpi-a thu athejalin, koimacha ahoi doh-a aumpoi. Baasha'in anasah Ramah'a songhole thingho aphedoh-un, chule hicheho chu Asa lengpan Mizpah le Benjamin gama Geba kho sahnan aneijin ahi.
target: Then King Asa issued an order to all Judah—no one was exempt—and they carried away from Ramah the stones and timber Baasha had been using there. With them King Asa built up Geba in Benjamin, and also Mizpah.

source: Asa thilbol dang jouse, athibol theina jouse, chule anatoh jouse, akhopi sahho chu Judah lengho thusimbu ho-a kisun hilouham? Hijeng jongle ateh lamin akhut akenga natna aneitan ahi.
target: As for all the other events of Asa’s reign, all his achievements, all he did and the cities he built, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah? In his old age, however, his feet became diseased.

source: Chuin Asa chu apu apate toh alumkhomin, apa David khopi-a apu apate toh avuitaove. Chuin achapa Jehoshaphat'in ama khellin lengvai apotai.
target: Then Asa rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the city of his father David. And Jehoshaphat his son succeeded him as king.

source: Chule Jeroboam chapa Nadab chu Judah lengpa Asa lengchan kal kum nina-in Israelte chunga vaipon apangin,Israelte chunga kumni alengchange.
target: Nadab son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel two years.

source: Chule Pakai mitmun thilphalou abolin, apa lampia achen, achonsetna-a chun Israelte achonsetsah-e.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , following the ways of his father and committing the same sin his father had caused Israel to commit.

source: Chuin Issachar insung mi lah-a Ahijah chapa Baasha chun ama dounan thilphalou agongin, Philistine ho gam Gibbethon'ah Baasha'n amachu athat tai. Ajehchu Nadab le Israelte jousen Gibbethon aumkol petnu ahi.
target: Baasha son of Ahijah from the tribe of Issachar plotted against him, and he struck him down at Gibbethon, a Philistine town, while Nadab and all Israel were besieging it.

source: Judah leng Asa kumthum channa'in Baasha'n Nadab chu athatnin, amakhelin alengchang tai.
target: Baasha killed Nadab in the third year of Asa king of Judah and succeeded him as king.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, ama alengchan phatnin Jeroboam insung pumpi athatnin; Shilon mi asoh Ahijah henga Pakai thusei dungjuijin, asuh manghel kahsen Jeroboam'a dingin ahingthei khatcha akhenpeh poi.
target: As soon as he began to reign, he killed Jeroboam’s whole family. He did not leave Jeroboam anyone that breathed, but destroyed them all, according to the word of the Lord given through his servant Ahijah the Shilonite.

source: Jeroboam'in anabol chonset naho jehle, Israel achonsetsah jeh, chule Israel Pakai Pathen chu asuh lunghang jeh ahi.
target: This happened because of the sins Jeroboam had committed and had caused Israel to commit, and because he aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel.

source: Tun Nadab thilbol danghole atoh jouse chu Israel lengte thusimbua kisun hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Nadab’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

source: Asale Israel leng Baasha kah-a ahinkho pumpi lhonin kigalna anaum jingin ahi.
target: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel throughout their reigns.

source: Judah leng Asa lengchan kal kumthum lhina-in, Ahijah chapa Baasha chu Tirzah'a kum somni le kumli Israelte chunga aleng changin ahi.
target: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah became king of all Israel in Tirzah, and he reigned twenty-four years.

source: Chule aman Pakai mitmun thilse anabolin, Jeroboam lampia chun anachen, aman achonsetna-a chun Israelte achonsetsah-in ahi.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , following the ways of Jeroboam and committing the same sin Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.

source: Chujouvin Pakai thuchu Baasha dounan, Hanani chapa Jehu henga ahungin, hitin aseije.
target: Then the word of the Lord came to Jehu son of Hanani concerning Baasha:

source: Leivuija kona nangma kachoi sanga, kami Israelte chunga vaipo-a kapansah; chule Jeroboam lamlhah najuija, achonset naova eilung hansah nadinguva, kami Israelte nachonset sah dungjuijin;
target: “I lifted you up from the dust and appointed you ruler over my people Israel, but you followed the ways of Jeroboam and caused my people Israel to sin and to arouse my anger by their sins.

source: Vetan, keiman Baasha phattheina le a-insung phattheina kasuhmanga, chule Nebat chapa Jeroboam insung banga kasemding ahi.
target: So I am about to wipe out Baasha and his house, and I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat.

source: Baasha mi khopi sunga thia chu uichan aneh-a, loujaova thipa chu chungleng vachahon anehdiu ahi.
target: Dogs will eat those belonging to Baasha who die in the city, and birds will feed on those who die in the country.”

source: Tun Baasha thilbol danghole, ipi abol, chule athahatna chu Israel lengte thusimbu ho-a kisunlut hilou ham?
target: As for the other events of Baasha’s reign, what he did and his achievements, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

source: Hitichun Baasha apu apate toh alumkhomin, Tirzah'a avuitaove. Chuin achapa Elah akhelin alengchang tai.
target: Baasha rested with his ancestors and was buried in Tirzah. And Elah his son succeeded him as king.

source: Jeroboam insung tobanga Pakai mitmu-a thilsetah abola, akhutsoh-a Pakai achunga alunghansah jeh, chule amachu atha jeh-in; Hanani chapa Jehu themgaova konin Pakai thuchu, Baasha le a-insung dounan ahung lhungtan ahi.
target: Moreover, the word of the Lord came through the prophet Jehu son of Hanani to Baasha and his house, because of all the evil he had done in the eyes of the Lord , arousing his anger by the things he did, becoming like the house of Jeroboam—and also because he destroyed it.

source: Judah lengpa Asa lengchan kal kum somni le kumgup lhinna-in, Baasha chapa Elah chu Tirzah'a Israelte chunga alengchang panin, kumni alengchange.
target: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah son of Baasha became king of Israel, and he reigned in Tirzah two years.

source: Chuin akangtalai kehkhat chunga vaipopa, asohpa Zimri chun ama dounan thil agongin; ama Tirzah'a um ahito lhonin, Tirzah'a a-insung gouchingpa Arza in'a chun ju adonkhamin ahi.
target: Zimri, one of his officials, who had command of half his chariots, plotted against him. Elah was in Tirzah at the time, getting drunk in the home of Arza, the palace administrator at Tirzah.

source: Chuin Zimri chu agalutnin avon, athatnin, akhelin alengchang tan ahi. Hichu Judah leng Asa alengchan kal kum somni le kumsagi lhinkum ahi.
target: Zimri came in, struck him down and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah. Then he succeeded him as king.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Ama ahung lengchan patna, alaltouna chunga atou touchun, Baasha insungmi jouse athatnin; a-insungmi chule agol apaite chapaho pasal tapouchu khatcha khen neilouvin asumangin ahi.
target: As soon as he began to reign and was seated on the throne, he killed off Baasha’s whole family. He did not spare a single male, whether relative or friend.

source: Hitichun Jehu themgaova kona Baasha chungchanga Pakai thusei dungjuijin, Zimri'in Baasha insung mijouse chu athat gamheltai.
target: So Zimri destroyed the whole family of Baasha, in accordance with the word of the Lord spoken against Baasha through the prophet Jehu—

source: Ajehchu apannabei houva Israel Pakai Pathen alunghansah uva, Baasha chonset naho jousele achapa Elah chonset naho jouse, hiche achonsetna ho-a chu Israelte achonset sah-u anahi.
target: because of all the sins Baasha and his son Elah had committed and had caused Israel to commit, so that they aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, by their worthless idols.

source: Tun Elah thilbol danghole anatoh jouse Israel lengte thusimbua kisunna hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Elah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

source: Judah lengpa Asa lengchan kal kum somni le kum sagi lhinkum chun, Zimri chu Tirzah'a nisagi aleng changin ahi. Chuin mipi chun Philistine gama um Gibbethon dounan gebuh asongun ahi.
target: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned in Tirzah seven days. The army was encamped near Gibbethon, a Philistine town.

source: Chuin gebuh songho mipi chun, Zimri'in thilphalou agongin lengpa jong atha ahitai, tia kisei aja taovin; hijeh chun Israelte jouse chun janel gallamkai Omri chu Israelte chunga chun alengchansah taove.
target: When the Israelites in the camp heard that Zimri had plotted against the king and murdered him, they proclaimed Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel that very day there in the camp.

source: Chuin Omri le Israelte jouse chu Gibbethon'a konin achetouvun, Tirzah chu aumkimvel taove.
target: Then Omri and all the Israelites with him withdrew from Gibbethon and laid siege to Tirzah.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Zimri chun khopi chu akilatai ti ahet phatnin, leng inpi sunga alutnin, leng inpi akihal khumin, athitai.
target: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the citadel of the royal palace and set the palace on fire around him. So he died,

source: Ajehchu Pakai mitmu-a thilsetah abola achonsetnaho jehle, Jeroboam lamlhahho ajotna, achonsetna-a Israel chate achonsetsah jeh ahi.
target: because of the sins he had committed, doing evil in the eyes of the Lord and following the ways of Jeroboam and committing the same sin Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.

source: Tun Zimri thilbol danghole ami philguhna thuho chu Israel lengte thusimbu ho-a kisunlut hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Zimri’s reign, and the rebellion he carried out, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

source: Chujouvin Israel mipi chu hopni in akihom khenun; mipi akeh khatnin Ginath chapa Tibni ajuijun, akeh khatnin Omri ajuitaove.
target: Then the people of Israel were split into two factions; half supported Tibni son of Ginath for king, and the other half supported Omri.

source: Ahivangin Omri jui mipi ho chun Ginath chapa Tibni juiho chu ajoujovin; hitichun Tibni athin Omri alengchang tai.
target: But Omri’s followers proved stronger than those of Tibni son of Ginath. So Tibni died and Omri became king.

source: Judah lengpa Asa lengchan kal kum somthumle kumkhat alhinin, Israelte chunga Omri kum somle kumni alengchang pannin; Tirzah'a kumgup alengchange.
target: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri became king of Israel, and he reigned twelve years, six of them in Tirzah.

source: Chuin aman Samaria lhang chu Shemer'a konin dangka talent ni in achon, lhang chunga chun khopi asemin, akhopi sem minchu lhang neipa Shemer min dungjuijin Samaria asahtai.
target: He bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver and built a city on the hill, calling it Samaria, after Shemer, the name of the former owner of the hill.

source: Ahinla Omri chun Pakai mitmun chonset abolin, ama masanga ho jouse sanga sejocheh-in abolin ahi.
target: But Omri did evil in the eyes of the Lord and sinned more than all those before him.

source: Ajehchu aman Nebat chapa Jeroboam lamlhah ajuijin, chule achonsetna-a chun Israel achonsetsah-in, apannabei houva Israel Pakai Pathen alunghan sah-un ahi.
target: He followed completely the ways of Jeroboam son of Nebat, committing the same sin Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit, so that they aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, by their worthless idols.

source: Tun Omri natohdoh athilbol dangho le athilbol theina atahlangho chu Israel lengte thusimbua kisun hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Omri’s reign, what he did and the things he achieved, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

source: Hitichun Omri chu apu apate toh alumkhomin, Samaria'a akivuitai. Chuin achapa Ahab ama khelin alengchang tai.
target: Omri rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria. And Ahab his son succeeded him as king.

source: Judah lengpa Asa lengchan kal kum somthumle kumget alhinin, Israelte chunga Omri chapa Ahab alengchang panin; Omri chapa Ahab chun Israelte chunga Samaria'a kum somni le kumni alengchange.
target: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab son of Omri became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria over Israel twenty-two years.

source: Chule Omri chapa Ahab chun Pakai mitmun ama masanga ho jouse sangin thilse abolin ahi.
target: Ahab son of Omri did more evil in the eyes of the Lord than any of those before him.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Nebat chapa Jeroboam chonsetna juichu amadingin ima hilou bangtah-in, Zidon mite lengpa Ethbaal chanu Jezebel akichenpin; Baal agajenin, ahoutan ahi.
target: He not only considered it trivial to commit the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, but he also married Jezebel daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and began to serve Baal and worship him.

source: Chule Samaria gama Baal dinga in asahna-a chun, Baal ding maicham khat aseme.
target: He set up an altar for Baal in the temple of Baal that he built in Samaria.

source: Chuin Ahab chun thingin milim asemin; ama masanga Israel lengho jouse sangin Ahab chun Pakai Israelte Pathen lunghana abol betan ahi.
target: Ahab also made an Asherah pole and did more to arouse the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, than did all the kings of Israel before him.

source: Ama nikho laichun Bethel'a Hiel chun Jericho khopi chu anasan ahi. Nun chapa Joshua'a kona Pakaiyin anaseidoh bangin; a-inbul agon patnin achapa lenpen Abiram hinkho achanlon, akotpiho atungdoh-in achapa lhumpen Segub achanin ahi.
target: In Ahab’s time, Hiel of Bethel rebuilt Jericho. He laid its foundations at the cost of his firstborn son Abiram, and he set up its gates at the cost of his youngest son Segub, in accordance with the word of the Lord spoken by Joshua son of Nun.

source: Chuin Gilead gama cheng Tishbi mi Elijah'in Ahab henga, A-anga kadinjing Pakai Israel Pathen hingjing mina kasei ahi, kum ijat-ham kathulouva daitwi le gotwi long louhel ding ahi, ati.
target: Now Elijah the Tishbite, from Tishbe in Gilead, said to Ahab, “As the Lord , the God of Israel, lives, whom I serve, there will be neither dew nor rain in the next few years except at my word.”

source: Chuin Pakai thuchu ahenga ahung lhungin,
target: Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah:

source: Hia konin kipat inlang solam sanga kiheijin; Jordan masanga um Cherith vachadunga gakiselin.
target: “Leave here, turn eastward and hide in the Kerith Ravine, east of the Jordan.

source: Chule hitiding ahi, nangman vachadung chu nadon ding; chukoma chu nangma vah dinga va-ah ho thu kapehsa ahitai, ati.
target: You will drink from the brook, and I have directed the ravens to supply you with food there.”

source: Hitichun ama achen Pakai thudungjui chun aboltai; ajehchu ama achen Jordan masanga um Cherith vachadung panga agachengtai.
target: So he did what the Lord had told him. He went to the Kerith Ravine, east of the Jordan, and stayed there.

source: Chuin va-ah ten jingkahle changlhah leh sa, chule nilhahle changlhah leh sa ama ahin pohpeh jiuvin; vachadung twi chu adonin ahi.
target: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning and bread and meat in the evening, and he drank from the brook.

source: Chuin chomkhat jouvin ahitin ahi, gamsunga go ajuh louhel phatnin, vachadung chu akangtan ahi.
target: Some time later the brook dried up because there had been no rain in the land.

source: Chuin Pakai thuchu ahenga ahung lhungin,
target: Then the word of the Lord came to him:

source: Kipat in, Zidon gama Zarephat'a chenlang hiche munachun gachengin; vetan, keiman nangma nanavah dingin meithai khat thu kapetai, ati.
target: “Go at once to Zarephath in the region of Sidon and stay there. I have directed a widow there to supply you with food.”

source: Hitichun ama akipatnin Zarephat'a achetai. Chuin ama khopi lutna kotpi ahunglhun phatnin, veuvin, meithainu chu chua anaumin, thingkang anachome. Chule aman amanu chu akouvin, ajah-a, kadon ding bela twi themkhat neipen tia nahenga katao ahi, ati.
target: So he went to Zarephath. When he came to the town gate, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her and asked, “Would you bring me a little water in a jar so I may have a drink?”

source: Chuin amanu twidom dinga achen ahile, amanu chu akouvin, kangeh nahi, changlhah kamkhat nakhutna neihin choipeh than, ati.
target: As she was going to get it, he called, “And bring me, please, a piece of bread.”

source: Chuin amanun, Pakai na Pathen hingjing mina kasei ahi, changlhah kaneipon, ahin bel'a changbong khutdim khat le thao theija thao themcha vang aume; chule ven, kagalutna keima le kachapa dinga kasemtheina dinga thingkang ni kachom ahin, hitia chu kaneh lhona kathi lhonding ahitai, ati.
target: “As surely as the Lord your God lives,” she replied, “I don’t have any bread—only a handful of flour in a jar and a little olive oil in a jug. I am gathering a few sticks to take home and make a meal for myself and my son, that we may eat it—and die.”

source: Chuin Elijah'in amanu jah-a, kicha hih-in, nasei bangchun gaboltan; ahin hichea konchun keima-a ding changlhah neocha hinsem masan lang, kahenga hinchoijin; chujoule nangle nachapa ding semin.
target: Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go home and do as you have said. But first make a small loaf of bread for me from what you have and bring it to me, and then make something for yourself and your son.

source: Ajehchu Israel Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, Pakaiyin leichunga go ahinjuhsah nikho kahse-a, bel'a changbong chu kemlou ding, thao thei jong kanglouhel ding ahi, ati.
target: For this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘The jar of flour will not be used up and the jug of oil will not run dry until the day the Lord sends rain on the land.’ ”

source: Chuin amanun Elijah thusei bangchun agaboltan; amanule amapa chule a-insung miten nitamtah aneuvin ahi.
target: She went away and did as Elijah had told her. So there was food every day for Elijah and for the woman and her family.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Elijah'a kona asei dungjuijin, bubel chu akempon, thao umjong chu akangpon ahi.
target: For the jar of flour was not used up and the jug of oil did not run dry, in keeping with the word of the Lord spoken by Elijah.

source: Chuin hicheho jouchun ahung hitin ahi, numei inneinu chapa chu ahung natan; anat chu alel lheh jengin ahile ama a chun haina hu aumtapoi.
target: Some time later the son of the woman who owned the house became ill. He grew worse and worse, and finally stopped breathing.

source: Chuin amanun Elijah henga, vo nangma Pathen mipa, nangma i-kalo ding nahim? Ka chonsetna geldohsah dingle kachapa thatdinga hunga nahim? ati.
target: She said to Elijah, “What do you have against me, man of God? Did you come to remind me of my sin and kill my son?”

source: Chuin aman amanu jah-a, nachapa chu neipen, ati. Chuin anun a-angsunga apomna-a konin aladoh-in, ama umna chung dana chun apomtouvin, ajalkhuna alupsah-in ahi.
target: “Give me your son,” Elijah replied. He took him from her arms, carried him to the upper room where he was staying, and laid him on his bed.

source: Chuin aman Pakai chu asamin, vo Pakai ka Pathen, kakholjina meithainu chunga jonghi, achapa thapeh-a kona thilse nahin lhunsah hija hitam? ati.
target: Then he cried out to the Lord , “ Lord my God, have you brought tragedy even on this widow I am staying with, by causing her son to die?”

source: Chuin chapang chunga chun thumvei akijah-in, Pakai chu akouvin, vo Pakai ka Pathen, kangeh nahi, hiche chapangpa hinna hi ama-ah hinkilesah kitnin, ati.
target: Then he stretched himself out on the boy three times and cried out to the Lord , “ Lord my God, let this boy’s life return to him!”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Elijah aw chu angaipeh-in; chapangpa hinna chu ama-a ahungkile kitnin, ahaldoh tai.
target: The Lord heard Elijah’s cry, and the boy’s life returned to him, and he lived.

source: Chuin Elijah'in chapang chu alan, a-indana konin insunga apuisuh-in, anu henga apen ahi. Chule Elijah'in amanu jah-a, ven, nachapa ahingtai, ati.
target: Elijah picked up the child and carried him down from the room into the house. He gave him to his mother and said, “Look, your son is alive!”

source: Chuin numeinu chun Elijah henga, tun hichea konhin nangma Pathen mikhat nahin, nakamsunga Pakai thuchu adih ahi ti kahetai, ati.
target: Then the woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God and that the word of the Lord from your mouth is the truth.”

source: Chuin nikho tamtah jouvin ahitin ahi, Pakai thuchu akum thum na-in Elijah henga ahung lhungin, chen Ahab gakimusah-in, leichunga go kajuh sah ding ahitai, ati.
target: After a long time, in the third year, the word of the Lord came to Elijah: “Go and present yourself to Ahab, and I will send rain on the land.”

source: Chuin Elijah Ahab kimusah dingin achetan; chule Samaria gama chun kel akhoh lheh-in ahi.
target: So Elijah went to present himself to Ahab. Now the famine was severe in Samaria,

source: Chuin Ahab min a-insung vaipopa Obadiah chu akouvin ahi (tun Obadiah hi Pakai gingtah ahi.
target: and Ahab had summoned Obadiah, his palace administrator. (Obadiah was a devout believer in the Lord .

source: Ajehchu hitichun, Jezebel'in Pakai themgaoho athagam laichun, Obadiah'in themgaoho jakhat apuijin, songkoa somnga ngan aselin, chule amaho chu changlhah le twijin avah-in ahi.)
target: While Jezebel was killing off the Lord ’s prophets, Obadiah had taken a hundred prophets and hidden them in two caves, fifty in each, and had supplied them with food and water.)

source: Chuin Ahab'in Obadiah henga, gamsunga twinahho jousele vachadung jouse-a gachen; ganchaho jouse manghel louva ijemtia hampa imuva, sakol ho le sanganho ihuhhing theina dingun, atin ahi.
target: Ahab had said to Obadiah, “Go through the land to all the springs and valleys. Maybe we can find some grass to keep the horses and mules alive so we will not have to kill any of our animals.”

source: Hitichun gamsung chu chotsoh nadin amani akihomlhonin, Ahab amatah akipatnin langkhat lama achen, Obadiah amatah akipatnin lamchom lama chun achen ahi.
target: So they divided the land they were to cover, Ahab going in one direction and Obadiah in another.

source: Chuin Chutia Obadiah lampia achepet chun, veuvin, Elijah'in akimupin; chule amapa chun ahen, amai tolla asulutnin, nangma kapu Elijah nahim? ati.
target: As Obadiah was walking along, Elijah met him. Obadiah recognized him, bowed down to the ground, and said, “Is it really you, my lord Elijah?”

source: Aman adonbutnin, kahi; chen, napakai pa jah-a, ven, Elijah hikoma aume, tin gahilin, ati.
target: “Yes,” he replied. “Go tell your master, ‘Elijah is here.’ ”

source: Chuin aman, ipi chonsetna kabola nasohhi thadinga Ahab khutna neipeh hitam? ati.
target: “What have I done wrong,” asked Obadiah, “that you are handing your servant over to Ahab to be put to death?

source: Pakai na Pathen ahinjing banga kasei ahi, ka pakaiyin nangma holdinga asol louna mun le gam aum tapoi. Chule ama khu-a aumpoi ati tenguleh; nangma namu lounao thuah lenggam le namchu akihahsel sahjin ahi.
target: As surely as the Lord your God lives, there is not a nation or kingdom where my master has not sent someone to look for you. And whenever a nation or kingdom claimed you were not there, he made them swear they could not find you.

source: Chule tun nangman, chen, napakai pa jah-a, ven, Elijah hikoma aume, tin naseije.
target: But now you tell me to go to my master and say, ‘Elijah is here.’

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi, keima nakoma kona kachedoh dohleh, Pakai Lhagaovin kahetlouna gama napuimang tantin; chutia chu kache-a Ahab kaga hila, aman nangma namudeh louteng, eitha ding ahi. Ahin nasoh keiman kakhangdon laijapat Pakai kanagin jing ahi.
target: I don’t know where the Spirit of the Lord may carry you when I leave you. If I go and tell Ahab and he doesn’t find you, he will kill me. Yet I your servant have worshiped the Lord since my youth.

source: Jezebel'in Pakai themgaoho athalaija kathilbol, Pakai themgaoho somnga nga-a mi jakhat songkoa kaselguh-a, changlhah le twija kavah chu ka pakai hi naseipeh louvu hijaham?
target: Haven’t you heard, my lord, what I did while Jezebel was killing the prophets of the Lord ? I hid a hundred of the Lord ’s prophets in two caves, fifty in each, and supplied them with food and water.

source: Tun nangman, chen, napakai pa jah-a, ven, Elijah hikoma aume, tin gaseijin neiti; aman eithatei ding ahi, ati.
target: And now you tell me to go to my master and say, ‘Elijah is here.’ He will kill me!”

source: Chuin Elijah'in, a-anga kadinjing janel Pakai hingjing mina kasei ahi, tunikho-a hi thonlouva kakimusah teiding ahi, ati.
target: Elijah said, “As the Lord Almighty lives, whom I serve, I will surely present myself to Ahab today.”

source: Chuin Obadiah Ahab kimupi din achen, amachu ahiltai. Chuin Ahab Elijah kimupi dingin achetai.
target: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab and told him, and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Ahab'in Elijah amuphatnin ajah-a, nangma Israelte sulungjing pachu nahim? ati.
target: When he saw Elijah, he said to him, “Is that you, you troubler of Israel?”

source: Chuin aman, keiman Israelte kasulung jingpoi; nangma le napa insungmiten Pakai thupeh ho nadalhah uva, Baal nung najuijuva kona nasuh lungjingu ahi bouve.
target: “I have not made trouble for Israel,” Elijah replied. “But you and your father’s family have. You have abandoned the Lord ’s commands and have followed the Baals.

source: Hijeh chun tun Israelte jouse, Baal themgaoho jali, chule Jezebel dokhanga an nejing Asherah themgao jali chu kahenga Carmel lhanga gakoukhom sah-in, ati.
target: Now summon the people from all over Israel to meet me on Mount Carmel. And bring the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table.”

source: Hitichun Ahab'in Israel chate jouse akoukhomin, Carmel lhanga themgaoho chu akou khomin ahi.
target: So Ahab sent word throughout all Israel and assembled the prophets on Mount Carmel.

source: Chuin Elijah chu mipi jouse henga chun ahungin, ahenguva, itihchan lunggel ni saikah-a naum jing diuham? Pakai chu Pathen ahile, juijun; ahin Baal joh ahi nati ule, amachu juijun, ati. Ahin mipin chengkhat chanjong adonbut pouve.
target: Elijah went before the people and said, “How long will you waver between two opinions? If the Lord is God, follow him; but if Baal is God, follow him.” But the people said nothing.

source: Chujouvin Elijah'in mipi jah-a, kei, keima bouhi Pakai themgao umnalai kahitan; Baal themgaoho vang mi jali leh somnga aumuve.
target: Then Elijah said to them, “I am the only one of the Lord ’s prophets left, but Baal has four hundred and fifty prophets.

source: Hijeh chun amahon bongchal ni eipeuhen; chule amahon bongchal khat kilhen uhen, chen bongselu henlang, thing chunga koijuhen, anoija mei tih hih-u hen. Chule bongchal chomjoh chu ken sem ingting, thing chunga koi jingting anoija mei kati louding ahi.
target: Get two bulls for us. Let Baal’s prophets choose one for themselves, and let them cut it into pieces and put it on the wood but not set fire to it. I will prepare the other bull and put it on the wood but not set fire to it.

source: Chule nanghon na pathen hou minchu kou unlang, chule keiman Pakai min kakouding; chule meija hindonbut Pathen chu, Pathen hiding ahi, ati. Chuin mipijouse chun adonbutnun, nathusei chu apha lheh-e, atiuve.
target: Then you call on the name of your god, and I will call on the name of the Lord . The god who answers by fire—he is God.” Then all the people said, “What you say is good.”

source: Chuin Elijah'in Baal themgaoho jah-a, nangho dingin bongchal khat kilhenun, chule kisem masatnun; ajehchu nangho natam uve; chule na pathen hou min chu kouvun, anoijavang mei natilou diu ahi, ati.
target: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one of the bulls and prepare it first, since there are so many of you. Call on the name of your god, but do not light the fire.”

source: Chuin amaho kipe bongchal chu athatnun, asemun, chule jingkah-a pat sunkim geihel Baal minchu akouvun, vo Baal, neihouvun, atiuve. Ahinla awgin ahiloule ahin donbutna khatcha aumpoi. Chuin amaicham semu chunga akichomchom jenguve.
target: So they took the bull given them and prepared it. Then they called on the name of Baal from morning till noon. “Baal, answer us!” they shouted. But there was no response; no one answered. And they danced around the altar they had made.

source: Chuin sunkimin ahitin ahi, Elijah'in amaho a-eng houvin, hapenun, ajehchu ama pathen ahin; aman thu aseiham, minung ajuiham, kholche ham, ahiloule a-ihmu khat touham hintin, suhkhah ngaiding ahi, ati.
target: At noon Elijah began to taunt them. “Shout louder!” he said. “Surely he is a god! Perhaps he is deep in thought, or busy, or traveling. Maybe he is sleeping and must be awakened.”

source: Chuin hasapmin asamun, achonnau ngaibangin chemchan chule thih hemin aki-atnun, achunguva athiu alonlhah kahsen aki-atnun ahi.
target: So they shouted louder and slashed themselves with swords and spears, as was their custom, until their blood flowed.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, nilhangkai ahi phatnin, amahon nilhah lam ganlhaina anneh thilto phat geijin gaothu aseijun; hinlah aw khatcha aumpon, chule donbutna khatchala aumpon, koima chanjong ijin asepeh pouvin ahi.
target: Midday passed, and they continued their frantic prophesying until the time for the evening sacrifice. But there was no response, no one answered, no one paid attention.

source: Chuin Elijah'in mipi jouse jah-a, neihin naijun, ati. Chuin mijouse chu akoma ahung naijun ahi. Chuin Pakai maicham akivochimsa chu asemphan ahi.
target: Then Elijah said to all the people, “Come here to me.” They came to him, and he repaired the altar of the Lord , which had been torn down.

source: Chuin Elijah'in, namin Israel hiding ahi tia Pakai thu hunglhuna Jacob chapate phungjat dungjuijin, songtum somleni alan ahi.
target: Elijah took twelve stones, one for each of the tribes descended from Jacob, to whom the word of the Lord had come, saying, “Your name shall be Israel.”

source: Songho-a chun Pakai minin maichan khat asemin, maicham kimvela chun muchi tena dimni doljou dinga lenin leiko khat alai kimvelin ahi.
target: With the stones he built an altar in the name of the Lord , and he dug a trench around it large enough to hold two seahs of seed.

source: Aman thingho agol golin akoijin, bongchal chu achenbongin, thingho chunga ajamin; chuin ajah uva, bel li chu twi sungdim munlang, govam ganlhaina le thing chunga chun sungun, ati.
target: He arranged the wood, cut the bull into pieces and laid it on the wood. Then he said to them, “Fill four large jars with water and pour it on the offering and on the wood.”

source: Chuin aman, aniveinan bolkitnun, ati. Chuin aniveina-in abolkitnuve. Chuin aman athumvei na-in bolkitnun, ati. Chuin amahon athumvei na-in jong abolkit taove.
target: “Do it again,” he said, and they did it again. “Do it a third time,” he ordered, and they did it the third time.

source: Chuin twi chu maicham kimvela alongin, aman leiko jongchu twija adipmin ahi.
target: The water ran down around the altar and even filled the trench.

source: Chuin nilhah lam ganlhai phat ahiphatnin, Elijah themgao ahungnaijin, hitin aseije; Abraham, Isaac chule Israel Pakai Pathen, nangma Israel Pathen nahi-a, chule keima nasoh kahia, chule hiche thiljousehi nangma thua kabol ahi ti tuni hin kihedoh hen, ati.
target: At the time of sacrifice, the prophet Elijah stepped forward and prayed: “ Lord , the God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant and have done all these things at your command.

source: Neihin ngaipeh-in, vo Pakai, neihin ngaipeh-in, chutile hiche mipihohin nangma Pakai Pathen nahi-a, chule nangman alungu nalehei ahitai ti ahet dingu ahi, ati.
target: Answer me, Lord , answer me, so these people will know that you, Lord , are God, and that you are turning their hearts back again.”

source: Chujouvin Pakai meikong chu ahungleng lhan, govam ganlhai, thingho, songho, leivuiho chu akavamin; chule leiko a twi chu ahulsahtan ahi.
target: Then the fire of the Lord fell and burned up the sacrifice, the wood, the stones and the soil, and also licked up the water in the trench.

source: Chuin mipi jousen hichu amuphatnun, amaiju tolla asulutnun, Pakai, amachu Pathen ahi; Pakai, amachu Pathen ahi, atiuve.
target: When all the people saw this, they fell prostrate and cried, “The Lord —he is God! The Lord —he is God!”

source: Chuin Elijah'in ajah uvah, Baal themgaoho chu man-un; khatcha hoidoh sah hih-un, ati. Chuin amahochu amanun; Elijah'in Kishon vachadunga apuisuh-in, hiche munachun athatgamtai.
target: Then Elijah commanded them, “Seize the prophets of Baal. Don’t let anyone get away!” They seized them, and Elijah had them brought down to the Kishon Valley and slaughtered there.

source: Chuin Elijah'in Ahab jah-a, chetouvin, nenlang donin, ajehchu go hajuh-a juhding husa aume, ati.
target: And Elijah said to Ahab, “Go, eat and drink, for there is the sound of a heavy rain.”

source: Hitichun neding le dondingin Ahab achetoutai. Chuin Elijah chu Carmel lhangvuma akaltouvin, tolla akunchah-in, akhupteni kah-a amai asulutnin ahi.
target: So Ahab went off to eat and drink, but Elijah climbed to the top of Carmel, bent down to the ground and put his face between his knees.

source: Chuin asohpa jah-a, tun chetouvin, twikhanglen lam ven, ati. Chuin ama achetouvin, agahven, imacha aumpoi, ati. Chuin ajah-a, sagivei chekitnin, ati.
target: “Go and look toward the sea,” he told his servant. And he went up and looked. “There is nothing there,” he said. Seven times Elijah said, “Go back.”

source: Chuin asagivei lhinnan, aman Elijah henga, vetemin, mihem khut tobang twikhanglen'a konin meilhang neocha ahung kitungdoh-e, ati. Chuin aman chetouvin, Ahab jah-a, nakangtalai kigotnin lang, gon nahen lounadin chesuh-in, tin gaseipeh-in, ati.
target: The seventh time the servant reported, “A cloud as small as a man’s hand is rising from the sea.” So Elijah said, “Go and tell Ahab, ‘Hitch up your chariot and go down before the rain stops you.’ ”

source: Chuin chomkah louvin, van chu meilhang le huijin athimletlut jengin, go nasatah in ajutan ahi. Chuin Ahab kangtalai ja atouvin Jezreel lama achetai.
target: Meanwhile, the sky grew black with clouds, the wind rose, a heavy rain started falling and Ahab rode off to Jezreel.

source: Chule Pakai khut Elijah chunga aumin; aman atai akigah-in, Ahab masanga Jezreel lutna lama alhaitai.
target: The power of the Lord came on Elijah and, tucking his cloak into his belt, he ran ahead of Ahab all the way to Jezreel.

source: Chuin Ahab'in Elijah thilbol, Baal themgaoho jouse chemjam'a athajedan jouse chu Jezebel ahilin ahi.
target: Now Ahab told Jezebel everything Elijah had done and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.

source: Chuin Jezebel'in Elijah henga thupole asolin, jingle tuphat vela amaho khatpen hinkho banga nahinkho kabol louleh, pathen hon kachunga hitobang chun bolhen, chule akalvalin jong bolu hen ati.
target: So Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah to say, “May the gods deal with me, be it ever so severely, if by this time tomorrow I do not make your life like that of one of them.”

source: Chuin hichu amuphatnin, akipatdoh-ni, ahinnadin ajamdoh-in, Judah gama um Beersheba-a ahung lhungin, hikoma chu asohpa chu adalhatai.
target: Elijah was afraid and ran for his life. When he came to Beersheba in Judah, he left his servant there,

source: Ahin amatah vang gamthip sunga nikhat lama achen, chuin ahungin juniper thingphung noikhatna atoutai. Chuin athina dingin athumin, tun aphaset tai, vo Pakai, kahinna ladohtan, kapu kapate sangin kaphachom jopoi, ati.
target: while he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness. He came to a broom bush, sat down under it and prayed that he might die. “I have had enough, Lord ,” he said. “Take my life; I am no better than my ancestors.”

source: Chuin ama juniper thingphung noija alupma a-imut chun, vetan, vantil khatnin athamin, thouvin, an kineh-in, ati.
target: Then he lay down under the bush and fell asleep. All at once an angel touched him and said, “Get up and eat.”

source: Chuin avetle, vetan, mei-am chunga changlhah khatle twi umkhat alu lhuna anaumin ahi. Chuin aman anen adonin, alumkit tai.
target: He looked around, and there by his head was some bread baked over hot coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank and then lay down again.

source: Chuin Pakai vantil chu aniveinan ahungkitnin, ahinkhoijin, ajah-a, thouvin lang nen; ajehchu nakholjin nading chu nangma-a dingin asao behsetne, ati.
target: The angel of the Lord came back a second time and touched him and said, “Get up and eat, for the journey is too much for you.”

source: Chuin ama athouvin, anen adonin, chule hiche an thahat chun Pathen Molsang Horeb lama nisomli le jansomli achen ahi.
target: So he got up and ate and drank. Strengthened by that food, he traveled forty days and forty nights until he reached Horeb, the mountain of God.

source: Chuin chulama songko khatna alutnin, chua chun agehden tai. Chule vetan, Pakai thu ahenga ahung lhungin, ajah-a, Elijah hikoma ibol nahim? ati.
target: There he went into a cave and spent the night. And the word of the Lord came to him: “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

source: Chuin aman, keima janelho Pakai Pathen dinga tompan behseh jeng kanahi; ajehchu Israel chaten nakitepna adondauvin, namaicham ho asuchimun, nathemgao ho chemjamin athatnun; kei, keima sehseh bouhi asohcha kahi; chule amahon kahinnahi lahmang dingin aholun ahi, ati.
target: He replied, “I have been very zealous for the Lord God Almighty. The Israelites have rejected your covenant, torn down your altars, and put your prophets to death with the sword. I am the only one left, and now they are trying to kill me too.”

source: Chuin aman, potdoh-in, chule molsang chunga khun Pakai anga gadingin, ati. Chuin veuvin, Pakai ahungin, chule Pakai angsunga chun huipi hattah le nasatah-in molsang ho chu asemkeh-in, songpiho ahal halin asuchipmin; ahin huilah-a chun Pakai aumpoi; chule hui akichai phatnin ling akihotnin; ahin inlinga chun Pakai aumpoi.
target: The Lord said, “Go out and stand on the mountain in the presence of the Lord , for the Lord is about to pass by.” Then a great and powerful wind tore the mountains apart and shattered the rocks before the Lord , but the Lord was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake, but the Lord was not in the earthquake.

source: Ling kiho jouvin mei akan; ahin meija chun Pakai aumpoi; chuin meikah jouvin aw ngatselin ahung gingin ahi.
target: After the earthquake came a fire, but the Lord was not in the fire. And after the fire came a gentle whisper.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Elijah'in hichu ajah phatnin, aponin amai akitomin, apotdoh-in songko lutna-a chun adingtan ahi. Chuin vetan, ahenga awkhat ahung gingin, Elijah hikoma hi ipibol nahim? ati.
target: When Elijah heard it, he pulled his cloak over his face and went out and stood at the mouth of the cave. Then a voice said to him, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

source: Chuin aman, keima janelho Pakai Pathen dinga tompan behseh jeng kanahi; ajehchu Israel chaten nakitepna adondauvin, namaicham ho asuchimun, nathemgao ho chemjamin athatnun; kei, keima sehseh bouhi asohcha kahi; chule amahon kahinnahi lahmang dingin aholun ahi, ati.
target: He replied, “I have been very zealous for the Lord God Almighty. The Israelites have rejected your covenant, torn down your altars, and put your prophets to death with the sword. I am the only one left, and now they are trying to kill me too.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin ajah-a, chen Damascus gamthip lama kilen lang, nahung lhunteng Hazael chu Syria chunga leng dinga thao nu-in.
target: The Lord said to him, “Go back the way you came, and go to the Desert of Damascus. When you get there, anoint Hazael king over Aram.
