source: Chule Nimshi chapa Jehu chu Israel chunga lengdinga thao nanuding; chule na indan sunga Abel-meholah khomi Shaphat chapa Elisha chu themgao dinga thao nanuding ahi.
target: Also, anoint Jehu son of Nimshi king over Israel, and anoint Elisha son of Shaphat from Abel Meholah to succeed you as prophet.

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi, Hazael chemjam'a kona hoidohchan Jehu'n atha ding; Jehu chemjam'a kona hoidohchan Elisha'n athading ahi.
target: Jehu will put to death any who escape the sword of Hazael, and Elisha will put to death any who escape the sword of Jehu.

source: Hijongle Baal anga akhupma bohkhup khaloulai, chule amuh-a ama chopkha louhel Israel gamsunga mi sangsagi kakikhen nalaije, ati.
target: Yet I reserve seven thousand in Israel—all whose knees have not bowed down to Baal and whose mouths have not kissed him.”

source: Hitichun hichea konchun apotnin, chule Shaphat chapa Elisha amun, amachun lou anakai jin, ama masanga bongchal tosomleni achen, chule ama somleni chana tochun alhonkhomin ahi; chuin Elijah'in ama agah jotpan, achunga apon agah sekhumin ahi.
target: So Elijah went from there and found Elisha son of Shaphat. He was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen, and he himself was driving the twelfth pair. Elijah went up to him and threw his cloak around him.

source: Chuin aman bongchalho chu adalhan, Elijah nunga alhaijin, katao ahi, kanule kapa gachop tading ting, chutengle juinange, ati. Chuin aman ajah-a, kinungle kitnin; ajehchu keiman nangma ipi kabolpeh em? ati.
target: Elisha then left his oxen and ran after Elijah. “Let me kiss my father and mother goodbye,” he said, “and then I will come with you.” “Go back,” Elijah replied. “What have I done to you?”

source: Chuin ama ama-a konin akinunglen, bongchal tokhat akaijin, athatnin, asa ho chu bong manchah ho-a chun ahonin, miho chu apen, aneovin ahi. Chuin ama akipatdoh-in, Elijah nung ajuijin, ama ajenletai.
target: So Elisha left him and went back. He took his yoke of oxen and slaughtered them. He burned the plowing equipment to cook the meat and gave it to the people, and they ate. Then he set out to follow Elijah and became his servant.

source: Chuin Syria lengpa Benhadad'in asepai janel jouse akhom khomin; amato pangkhoma chu leng somthumle ni ahin, amaho chu asakol kangtalaiju toh ahitha cheh-u ahi. Chuin ama achetouvin Samaria aum kimvelin, achunga gal aboltai.
target: Now Ben-Hadad king of Aram mustered his entire army. Accompanied by thirty-two kings with their horses and chariots, he went up and besieged Samaria and attacked it.

source: Chuin aman khopi sunga Israelte lengpa Ahab henga thupo ho asolin, hitin agasei sah-e, Benhadad'in hitin aseije,
target: He sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel, saying, “This is what Ben-Hadad says:

source: Nasana le nadangka ho chu keija ahin; najite le nachate, aphapen ho geija keija ahi.
target: ‘Your silver and gold are mine, and the best of your wives and children are mine.’ ”

source: Chuin Israel lengpa chun adonbutnin, ka pakai, vo lengpa, nathusei bangin keima le kaneijouse abonchan nanga ahi, ati.
target: The king of Israel answered, “Just as you say, my lord the king. I and all I have are yours.”

source: Chuin thupo ho chu ahungkitnun, hitin aseijuve, Benhadad'in hitin aseije, nahenga nadangka ho le nasana ho, najite le nachate neipeh ding ahi, tia mi kahinsol vangin,
target: The messengers came again and said, “This is what Ben-Hadad says: ‘I sent to demand your silver and gold, your wives and your children.

source: Jingle tuphat donahi kasohte kahinsola, amahon nangma inle nasohte inho aholdiu; chule hitiding ahi, ipi hile namit lachanchu, akhutnuva kona alah uva achoimang diu ahitai, ati.
target: But about this time tomorrow I am going to send my officials to search your palace and the houses of your officials. They will seize everything you value and carry it away.’ ”

source: Chuin Israel lengpan gamsung upaho jouse akouvin, kangeh nahiuve, hichepan thilse aboldanhi melchih unlang vetemun; ajehchu kahenga kajite le kachate, kadangka le kasanaho ahin thumin; kana itpehlou ahi, ati.
target: The king of Israel summoned all the elders of the land and said to them, “See how this man is looking for trouble! When he sent for my wives and my children, my silver and my gold, I did not refuse him.”

source: Chuin upa jousele mipi jousen, athu ngaihih-in, nopjong noppeh hih-in, atiuve.
target: The elders and the people all answered, “Don’t listen to him or agree to his demands.”

source: Hijeh chun aman Benhadad thupo ho henga, ka pakai lengpa chu seipeh-un, nasoh henga mi nahinsola na-ngeh masat jouse chu kabolding ahi: ahin hiche vanghi bolthei ponge. Chuin thupo ho chu akipat doh-un, hiche thuchu agalhut taove.
target: So he replied to Ben-Hadad’s messengers, “Tell my lord the king, ‘Your servant will do all you demanded the first time, but this demand I cannot meet.’ ” They left and took the answer back to Ben-Hadad.

source: Chuin Benhadad'in ahenga mi asolin, kanungjui mipi ho jouse-a dinga khutdim khat cheh tohding Samaria leivui kakhen poupoule, hitobang chun pathen hon kachunga lhunsah hen, chule akalvalin jong lhunsah hen, agati sah-e.
target: Then Ben-Hadad sent another message to Ahab: “May the gods deal with me, be it ever so severely, if enough dust remains in Samaria to give each of my men a handful.”

source: Chuin Israel lengpan adonbutnin, galvon kivonpa chu akisutlha sapa bangin hoitho hihhen, tin gaseipeh un, ati.
target: The king of Israel answered, “Tell him: ‘One who puts on his armor should not boast like one who takes it off.’ ”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Benhadad'in hiche thu chu ajah phatnin, ama le aleng chankhompi hon pon insunga ju adon petnu ahin, asohte jah-a, kigouvin, ati. Chuin amaho akhopi satdingin akigo taove.
target: Ben-Hadad heard this message while he and the kings were drinking in their tents, and he ordered his men: “Prepare to attack.” So they prepared to attack the city.

source: Chuin veuvin, themgao khat Israel lengpa Ahab henga ahungin, ajah-a, Pakaiyin hitin aseije; mipi tamtah hohi namu em? ven, tunia hicheho hi nakhutna kapehdoh ding ahin; chutengle keima Pakai chu kahi neihetding ahi, ati.
target: Meanwhile a prophet came to Ahab king of Israel and announced, “This is what the Lord says: ‘Do you see this vast army? I will give it into your hand today, and then you will know that I am the Lord .’ ”

source: Chuin Ahab'in, keija konin em? ati. Chuin aman, Pakaiyin hitin ati, gamkaiho-a pipui gollhang ho-a konin, ati. Chuphatnin aman galsatdinga koijin thu apeh dingham? ati. Chuin aman, nangman, ati.
target: “But who will do this?” asked Ahab. The prophet replied, “This is what the Lord says: ‘The junior officers under the provincial commanders will do it.’ ” “And who will start the battle?” he asked. The prophet answered, “You will.”

source: Chujouvin aman gamkaiho-a pipui gollhangho asimin, amahochu jani leh somthumle ni ahiuvin; chuin amaho nunga mijouse, Israel chate jouse asimle, sangsagi ahiuve.
target: So Ahab summoned the 232 junior officers under the provincial commanders. Then he assembled the rest of the Israelites, 7,000 in all.

source: Chuin amaho sunkimin akipatdoh taove. Benhadad vang pon inho sunga, amale akithopi leng somthumle ni chun ju adonun, anakham tan ahi.
target: They set out at noon while Ben-Hadad and the 32 kings allied with him were in their tents getting drunk.

source: Chuin gamkaiho-a pipui gollhangho apotdoh masaovin; chuin Benadad'in mi asolin, chule amaho chun, Samaria konin miho ahung potdoh uve, tin aseipeh uve.
target: The junior officers under the provincial commanders went out first. Now Ben-Hadad had dispatched scouts, who reported, “Men are advancing from Samaria.”

source: Chuin aman, cham boldinga hung ahijongle ahingin man-un; ahiloule galbol dinga ahung ahiu jongle ahingin man-un, ati.
target: He said, “If they have come out for peace, take them alive; if they have come out for war, take them alive.”

source: Hitichun gamkai lenho-a pipui gollhangho chu khopi-a konin ahungdoh uvin, galsatmi hochun anungu ahinjuijun ahi.
target: The junior officers under the provincial commanders marched out of the city with the army behind them

source: Chuin amitakipmin atokhahcheh-u athatnun ahile, Syria te chu ajam taovin; Israelte chun anung delun ahi; chuin Syria lengpa Benhadad chu sakol chunga atouvin, sakol tou them hotoh ajamdoh tan ahi.
target: and each one struck down his opponent. At that, the Arameans fled, with the Israelites in pursuit. But Ben-Hadad king of Aram escaped on horseback with some of his horsemen.

source: Chuin Israel lengpa chu apotdoh-in, sakolhole kangtalai ho chu asusen, Syria te chu tamtah athatnin ahi.
target: The king of Israel advanced and overpowered the horses and chariots and inflicted heavy losses on the Arameans.

source: Chuin themgaopa chu Israel lengpa henga ahungin, ajah-a; chen, natha hatsah inlang melchih-in, chule ipi nabolding kingaiton; ajehchu kum kitle Syria lengpa nangma dou dinga hungding ahi, ati.
target: Afterward, the prophet came to the king of Israel and said, “Strengthen your position and see what must be done, because next spring the king of Aram will attack you again.”

source: Chuin Syria lengpa sohten ajah-a, a-pathen hou chu thinglhang pathen ho ahin; hijeh-a chu eihosanga amaho hatjoa ahiuve; ahin eihon amaho phaichama kisatpiu hite, chutile amaho sanga thonlouva ihatjoh dingu ahi, ati.
target: Meanwhile, the officials of the king of Aram advised him, “Their gods are gods of the hills. That is why they were too strong for us. But if we fight them on the plains, surely we will be stronger than they.

source: Chule hitiho hi bolin, lengho chu amitakip ama muncheh-a konin ladoh-in, amaho mun'a chun sepai gal lamkaiho pansah-in.
target: Do this: Remove all the kings from their commands and replace them with other officers.

source: Nangman namansah sepaiho tobang sepaiho, sakol khela sakol, kangtalai khela kangtalai kisimdoh-in; chule keihon phaichama amaho kisat piuvinge, chule amaho sanga thonlouva kahatjohdiu ahi, atiuve. Chuin aman athu-u chu angaijin, hitichun aboltai.
target: You must also raise an army like the one you lost—horse for horse and chariot for chariot—so we can fight Israel on the plains. Then surely we will be stronger than they.” He agreed with them and acted accordingly.

source: Chuin akum kitnin ahitin ahi, Benhadad'in Syria mite chu asim toh-in, Israelte satdingin Aphek'a achetou tan ahi.
target: The next spring Ben-Hadad mustered the Arameans and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.

source: Chuin Israel chate chu akisim taovin, abonun ahungcheh-un, amaho satding chun ache taove. Chule Israel chaten amaho masanga chun kelnou hon neocha ni bangin pon-in akisonuve; Syria te vang chun gamsung alodimsoh jengun ahi.
target: When the Israelites were also mustered and given provisions, they marched out to meet them. The Israelites camped opposite them like two small flocks of goats, while the Arameans covered the countryside.

source: Chuin Pathen mikhat ahungin, Israel lengpa henga thu aseijin; Pakaiyin hitin atie, Syria te Pakai chu thinglhangho pathen ahin, phaicham pathen ahipoi atiuvin, hijeh-a chu mipi atama tamho jousehi nakhutna kapeh ding, chutia chu keimahi Pakai chu kahi ti nahetdiu ahi, ati.
target: The man of God came up and told the king of Israel, “This is what the Lord says: ‘Because the Arameans think the Lord is a god of the hills and not a god of the valleys, I will deliver this vast army into your hands, and you will know that I am the Lord .’ ”

source: Chuin amaho chun khatle khat kigalsai ton ponbuh akisonun ahi. Chuin ahitin ahi, nisagi nin gal akipanin, Israel chaten Syria mite chu nikhat sungin mi sangjakhat athatnun ahi.
target: For seven days they camped opposite each other, and on the seventh day the battle was joined. The Israelites inflicted a hundred thousand casualties on the Aramean foot soldiers in one day.

source: Ahin adangho vang Aphek khopi sunga ajamlutnun; aumnalaiho mi sangsomni le sangsagi chu kulpin achim khumin ahi. Chuin Benhadad chu ajam mangin, khopi sunga, indan sungnunga ajamlut tai.
target: The rest of them escaped to the city of Aphek, where the wall collapsed on twenty-seven thousand of them. And Ben-Hadad fled to the city and hid in an inner room.

source: Chuin asohten ajah-a, tun vetemin Israel insunga lengho khu hepina-a dim lengho ahiuve ti kanajaove. Katao ahi, ikong uvah khaodip pon kichenu hitin, chule ilu uva khaokol kikhiu hitin, Israel lengpa henga gacheu hite; ijem itile aman nahinkho huhhing khatninte, atiuve.
target: His officials said to him, “Look, we have heard that the kings of Israel are merciful. Let us go to the king of Israel with sackcloth around our waists and ropes around our heads. Perhaps he will spare your life.”

source: Hitichun akonguvah khaodip pon akingah-un, aluva khaokol akikopmun, Israel lengpa henga ahungun, ahenga, nasoh Benhadad'in, katao ahi, neihing hoijin, atie, atiuve. Chuin aman hingnalaija ong? kasopipa hijachu, atin ahi.
target: Wearing sackcloth around their waists and ropes around their heads, they went to the king of Israel and said, “Your servant Ben-Hadad says: ‘Please let me live.’ ” The king answered, “Is he still alive? He is my brother.”

source: Tun mihochun ama-a kona thu hungpot chu lunglut tah-in anitnun, chule ajoploi chelun; nasopipa Benhadad, atiuve. Chuin aman, gapuijun, ati. Chujouvin Benhadad ahenga ahungtan; chuin aman kangtalai ja akaldoh sah-in ahi.
target: The men took this as a good sign and were quick to pick up his word. “Yes, your brother Ben-Hadad!” they said. “Go and get him,” the king said. When Ben-Hadad came out, Ahab had him come up into his chariot.

source: Chuin Benhadad'in ajah-a, kapan napa-a kona analah khopiho chu kalepeh ding nahi; chule kapan Samaria'a abolbang chun nangman jong Damascus khosung lamlen kisemin, ati. Chuin Ahab'in keiman hiche kitepna hotoh nasoldoh tha nange, ati. Hitichun aman amatoh kitepna asemin, asolmangtai.
target: “I will return the cities my father took from your father,” Ben-Hadad offered. “You may set up your own market areas in Damascus, as my father did in Samaria.” Ahab said, “On the basis of a treaty I will set you free.” So he made a treaty with him, and let him go.

source: Chuin themgaoho chapate lah-a mikhatnin Pakai thu-in aheng akompa jah-a, nahenga katao ahi neivotem in, ati. Ahin mipa chun avonompoi.
target: By the word of the Lord one of the company of the prophets said to his companion, “Strike me with your weapon,” but he refused.

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, Pakai thu nangailou jeh-in, vetan, keija kona napotdoh dohle, keipi bahkaijin nathading ahi, ati. Chuin ama-a kona apotdoh doh-in, keipi bahkai khatnin amun, athat tai.
target: So the prophet said, “Because you have not obeyed the Lord , as soon as you leave me a lion will kill you.” And after the man went away, a lion found him and killed him.

source: Chujouvin michom khat amun, katao ahi, neivotem in, ati. Chuin amapan avotan, chutichun avohna-a chun amavotan ahi.
target: The prophet found another man and said, “Strike me, please.” So the man struck him and wounded him.

source: Hitichun themgaopa chu apotdoh-in, lengpa chu lampia angah-in, amai vutvai anun alim achomsah-in ahi.
target: Then the prophet went and stood by the road waiting for the king. He disguised himself with his headband down over his eyes.

source: Chuin lengpa ahungphatnin, aman awsang tah-in lengpa jah-a chun; nasohhi galmun laitah-a kagachen; chule vetemin, mikhat akiheidoh-in kahenga mikhat ahinpuijin, hichepa hi chingphan; itihama amanle ahinkho khela nahinkho nachan ding, ahiloule dangka talent khat napehding ahi, ati.
target: As the king passed by, the prophet called out to him, “Your servant went into the thick of the battle, and someone came to me with a captive and said, ‘Guard this man. If he is missing, it will be your life for his life, or you must pay a talent of silver.’

source: Chule nasohhi hilamle khulama kakisahlel kah-in amapa ana achemang tai, ati. Chuin Israel lengpan ajah-a, hitobanga chu nathu kitanlha ding ahi; nangma le nangman nakitan lhah ahitai, ati.
target: While your servant was busy here and there, the man disappeared.” “That is your sentence,” the king of Israel said. “You have pronounced it yourself.”

source: Chuin aman amaija kona vutvai chu aladoh loijin ahileh, Israel lengpa chun ama themgaoho lah-a ahi chu ahedohtan ahi.
target: Then the prophet quickly removed the headband from his eyes, and the king of Israel recognized him as one of the prophets.

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, suhgamhel dinga kagotsa chu nakhutna kona kakitol dohsah tahjeh-a, nahinkho chu ama hinkho khela, namite chu amite khela cheding ahiuve, ati.
target: He said to the king, “This is what the Lord says: ‘You have set free a man I had determined should die. Therefore it is your life for his life, your people for his people.’ ”

source: Chuin Israel lengpa chun nguitah le lunghimo tah-in a-inlam jonin achen, Samaria ahung lhungtai.
target: Sullen and angry, the king of Israel went to his palace in Samaria.

source: Chuin hicheng jouchun ahitin, Jazreel mi Naboth'in lengpi hon khat aneijin, hichu Jazreel mun'a um ahin, Samaria'a lengpa Ahab inpi bantah-a uma ahi.
target: Some time later there was an incident involving a vineyard belonging to Naboth the Jezreelite. The vineyard was in Jezreel, close to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

source: Chuin Ahab'in Naboth jah-a, nalengpi leihi ka in komcha-a um ahijeh-in, ka anche leidin neipetan, hiche khelchun asanga phajo hondang khat nape nange, ati.
target: Ahab said to Naboth, “Let me have your vineyard to use for a vegetable garden, since it is close to my palace. In exchange I will give you a better vineyard or, if you prefer, I will pay you whatever it is worth.”

source: Chuin Naboth'in Ahab jah-a, kapu kapate gou nang kapeh ding chu Pakaiyin ajanompoi, atin ahi.
target: But Naboth replied, “The Lord forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my ancestors.”

source: Chuin Jezreel mi Naboth thusei jehchun Ahab chu nguichet le lunghimo tah-in a-in'a ahung tan ahi; ajehchu aman, kapu kapate gou nangma peponge ati ahi. Chuin ama ajalkhuna alumin, amai aheimangin, imacha anenom tapon ahi.
target: So Ahab went home, sullen and angry because Naboth the Jezreelite had said, “I will not give you the inheritance of my ancestors.” He lay on his bed sulking and refused to eat.

source: Ahinla a-inneipi Jezebel ahenga ahungin, ajah-a, ibola nachuti lunggima, annelouva uma nahim? ati.
target: His wife Jezebel came in and asked him, “Why are you so sullen? Why won’t you eat?”

source: Chuin aman amanu jah-a, ajehchu keiman Jezreel mi Naboth henga, nalengpilei chu sumin neikichoh sah-in; ahilouva nalung lhaina ahile, hiche khelchun lengpilei chomkhat nape nange kanatin ahi. Ahinla aman, keiman kalengpilei nangma peponge, tin einadon butnin ahi, ati.
target: He answered her, “Because I said to Naboth the Jezreelite, ‘Sell me your vineyard; or if you prefer, I will give you another vineyard in its place.’ But he said, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’ ”

source: Chuin a-inneipi Jezebel'in ajah-a, nangma Israel lenggam vaipo nahilouham? thouvin lang an nen, nalung kipasah-in; keiman Jezreel mi Naboth lengpilei chu nangma kapeh ding nahi, ati.
target: Jezebel his wife said, “Is this how you act as king over Israel? Get up and eat! Cheer up. I’ll get you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”

source: Hitichun amanun Ahab minin lekhathot khat asunin, lengpa mohor chu anamkhumin, lekhathot chu Naboth toh chenga khopisunga upa hole milal ho chu athotnin ahi.
target: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name, placed his seal on them, and sent them to the elders and nobles who lived in Naboth’s city with him.

source: Amanun lekhathot ho-a chun, an ngol ding phongjalun lang, mipi lah-a chun Naboth chu domsangun;
target: In those letters she wrote: “Proclaim a day of fasting and seat Naboth in a prominent place among the people.

source: Chule mini, Belial chapateni chu amapa douna hettohsah dingin dinsah-un, nangman Pathen le lengpa nataitome, tin seisah-un; chujouteng puidoh unlang athina dingin songin sepmun, tin asunne.
target: But seat two scoundrels opposite him and have them bring charges that he has cursed both God and the king. Then take him out and stone him to death.”

source: Chuin akhopi sunga miho, akhopi sunga cheng upaho, milen milal ho chun, Jezebel'in ahenguva ahinthot lekhathotna kisunbang chun abol taovin ahi.
target: So the elders and nobles who lived in Naboth’s city did as Jezebel directed in the letters she had written to them.

source: Amahon an ngolthu aphongjalun, mipi lah-a Naboth chu adomsangun ahi.
target: They proclaimed a fast and seated Naboth in a prominent place among the people.

source: Chuin mini, Belial chate pasal ni ahunglut lhonin, amasanga atoulhone. Chuin Belial mi teni chun ama douna, Naboth dounan mipi anga chun ahettohsah lhonin, Naboth'in Pathen le lengpa ataitome, atilhone.Chujouvin amahon khopi-a konin akaidoh-un, songin asepmun ahile athitai.
target: Then two scoundrels came and sat opposite him and brought charges against Naboth before the people, saying, “Naboth has cursed both God and the king.” So they took him outside the city and stoned him to death.

source: Chuin Jezebel henga, Naboth songin asepmun, athitai tin agah hetsah taove.
target: Then they sent word to Jezebel: “Naboth has been stoned to death.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Jezebel'in Naboth songin asepmun athitai ti ahet phatnin, Jezebel'in Ahab henga, kipat in, Jezreel mi Naboth lengpilei suma chohdinga aphalou chu galotan; ajehchu Naboth chu ahingtapoi, athitai atin ahi.
target: As soon as Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned to death, she said to Ahab, “Get up and take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite that he refused to sell you. He is no longer alive, but dead.”

source: Chuin Ahab'in Naboth athitai ti ajah phatnin, Ahab chu Jezreel mi Naboth lengpilei galo dingin akipat doh-in, achesuh tai.
target: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, he got up and went down to take possession of Naboth’s vineyard.

source: Chuin Tishbi mi Elijah henga Pakai thu ahung lhungin, aseije,
target: Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite:

source: Kipat doh-in, Samaria'a um Israel lengpa Ahab kimupi din chesuh-in; ven, galo dinga achesuh lona Naboth lengpi leija aume.
target: “Go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who rules in Samaria. He is now in Naboth’s vineyard, where he has gone to take possession of it.

source: Chule nangman ajah-a, Pakaiyin hitihin aseije, nangman natha-a, agam hi nalo hilouham? chule nangman ajah-a, Pakaiyin aseije, uichan Naboth thisan alena mun'a chu, uicha hon nangma thisan ngeitah jong ale dingu ahi, tin jong gaseijin, ati.
target: Say to him, ‘This is what the Lord says: Have you not murdered a man and seized his property?’ Then say to him, ‘This is what the Lord says: In the place where dogs licked up Naboth’s blood, dogs will lick up your blood—yes, yours!’ ”

source: Chuin Ahab'in Elijah jah-a, neimudoh hitam, vo kamelma pa? ati. Chuin aman adonbutnin, kamudoh nahitai; ajehchu Pakai mitmu-a thilse boldinga nangle nang kijoh nahitai.
target: Ahab said to Elijah, “So you have found me, my enemy!” “I have found you,” he answered, “because you have sold yourself to do evil in the eyes of the Lord .

source: Vetan, keiman nachunga thilse kahin lhunsah ding, nachilhah kalah mangding, Israel gamsunga Ahab chilhah pasal jouse, akihen hihen, ongthol hijongle kasuh manghel ding ahi.
target: He says, ‘I am going to bring disaster on you. I will wipe out your descendants and cut off from Ahab every last male in Israel—slave or free.

source: Chule nangman neilung hansah-a, Israelte nachonset sah jeh-a, na-insung chu Nebat chapa Jeroboam insung bangle Ahijah chapa Baasha insung banga kasuhmang ding ahi.
target: I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat and that of Baasha son of Ahijah, because you have aroused my anger and have caused Israel to sin.’

source: Jezebel chungchang thujong Pakaiyin aseijin, kulpanga uichaten Jezebel anehdiu ahi.
target: “And also concerning Jezebel the Lord says: ‘Dogs will devour Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.’

source: Ahab insung mite khopi sunga thichan chu uichaten anehdiu; chule gama thichan chu chungleng vachaten anehdiu ahi.
target: “Dogs will eat those belonging to Ahab who die in the city, and the birds will feed on those who die in the country.”

source: Ahinla a inneipi Jezebel tildoh-a Pakai mitmu-a thilse tongdinga amale ama akijohdoh-a Ahab tobang koimacha aumpoi.
target: (There was never anyone like Ahab, who sold himself to do evil in the eyes of the Lord , urged on by Jezebel his wife.

source: Pakaiyin Israel chate masanga ana nodoh Amor mite thilbol jouse bangin, thet umtah in milimho nung anajuijin ahi, ati.
target: He behaved in the vilest manner by going after idols, like the Amorites the Lord drove out before Israel.)

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, hiche thuhochu Ahab'in ajah phatnin, apon abottelin, khaodip pon akisilin, an angolin, khaodip pon silin alumin, kangchan achedohtan ahi.
target: When Ahab heard these words, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and fasted. He lay in sackcloth and went around meekly.

source: Chuin Tishbi mi Elijah henga Pakai thu ahung lhungin, aseije,
target: Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite:

source: Ven ichana Ahab kamasanga amale ama kineosah hitam? kamasanga akineusah jeh-in ama hinkho sungin thilse lhunsah taponge; ahin achapa hinkho sungin vang a-insunga thilse kalhunsah ding ahi, ati.
target: “Have you noticed how Ahab has humbled himself before me? Because he has humbled himself, I will not bring this disaster in his day, but I will bring it on his house in the days of his son.”

source: Chuin Israel le Syria kikah-a chun kumthum sungin gal ana umpon ahi.
target: For three years there was no war between Aram and Israel.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, akumthum na-in Juda lengpa Jehoshaphat chu Israel lengpa henga ahungsuh-in ahi.
target: But in the third year Jehoshaphat king of Judah went down to see the king of Israel.

source: Chuin Israel lengpan asohte jeh-a, Gilead gama Ramoth kho khu eihoa ahin, Syria lengpa khutna konin akiladoh hihlaije ti nahet lou uham? ati.
target: The king of Israel had said to his officials, “Don’t you know that Ramoth Gilead belongs to us and yet we are doing nothing to retake it from the king of Aram?”

source: Chuin aman Jehoshaphat jah-a, Ramoth-gilead gal neisat hu ding ham? ati. Chuin Jehoshaphat'in Israel lengpa jah-a, keima nangma tobang kahin, kamite jong namite tobang, chule kasakolte jong nasakol tobang ahi, ati.
target: So he asked Jehoshaphat, “Will you go with me to fight against Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat replied to the king of Israel, “I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”

source: Chuin Jehoshaphat'in Israel lengpa jah-a, kangeh nahi, tunin Pakaiyin ipi thu aseijem dong photnin, ati.
target: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, “First seek the counsel of the Lord .”

source: Chuphatnin Israel lengpan themgao mi jaliho akhom khomin, ajah uvah, Ramoth-gilead satdinga kakon dingha, kakon louding ham? ati. Chuin amahon, kontouvin, ajehchu Pakaiyin hichu lengpa khutna apehding ahi, atiuve.
target: So the king of Israel brought together the prophets—about four hundred men—and asked them, “Shall I go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I refrain?” “Go,” they answered, “for the Lord will give it into the king’s hand.”

source: Chuin Jehoshaphat'in, eihon idohthei dingu Pakai themgao dang khattou hia hi umlou ham? ati.
target: But Jehoshaphat asked, “Is there no longer a prophet of the Lord here whom we can inquire of?”

source: Chuin Israel lengpan Jehoshaphat jah-a, Pakai thu idoh theina diu mikhat, Imlah chapa Micaiah aum nalaijin, hinla amapan keima chungchang ase tailou apha aseikhah louhel jeh-a kahot ahi, ati. Chuin Jehoshaphat'in, lengpan chuti chun seihih hen, ati.
target: The king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, “There is still one prophet through whom we can inquire of the Lord , but I hate him because he never prophesies anything good about me, but always bad. He is Micaiah son of Imlah.” “The king should not say such a thing,” Jehoshaphat replied.

source: Chuin Israel lengpan vaipo khat akouvin, Imlah chapa Micaiah hin puiloi temin, ati.
target: So the king of Israel called one of his officials and said, “Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once.”

source: Chuin Israel lengpa le Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat chu aleng vona kivon pumin, laltouna-a Samaria lutna kotpi phung mun ong laija atoulhonin; amasang lhona themgao jousen gaothu aseijuve.
target: Dressed in their royal robes, the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting on their thrones at the threshing floor by the entrance of the gate of Samaria, with all the prophets prophesying before them.

source: Chuin Chenaanah chapa Zedekiah chun thih-in ki phabep asemin; chuin aman, Pakaiyin hitin ati: hiche-a hi nangman Syria mite chu nasuh manghel kahse-a nanoding ahi, ati.
target: Now Zedekiah son of Kenaanah had made iron horns and he declared, “This is what the Lord says: ‘With these you will gore the Arameans until they are destroyed.’ ”

source: Chule themgaoho jousen chutobang machun gaothu aseijun, Ramoth-gilead'a chetouvin lang galolhing teijin; ajehchu Pakaiyin lengpa khutna hichu apehdoh ding ahi, atiuve.
target: All the other prophets were prophesying the same thing. “Attack Ramoth Gilead and be victorious,” they said, “for the Lord will give it into the king’s hand.”

source: Chuin Micaiah kou-a che thupopan ajah-a aseijin, tun vetemin, themgaoho chun lengpa-a dingin kitohtah-in akamuva thupha aphong jalun ahi; katao ahi, nangma thu jong amaho khatpenpen thu tobang hihen lang, apha chu seijin, ati.
target: The messenger who had gone to summon Micaiah said to him, “Look, the other prophets without exception are predicting success for the king. Let your word agree with theirs, and speak favorably.”

source: Chuin Micaiah in, Pakai hing jing mina kasei ahi, Pakaiyin kahenga aseibou chu kaseiding ahi, ati.
target: But Micaiah said, “As surely as the Lord lives, I can tell him only what the Lord tells me.”

source: Hitichun lengpa henga ahungtai. Chuin lengpan ajah-a, Micaiah Ramoth-gilead satna kache diuha, kachelou diuham? ati. Chuin aman adonbutnin, chenlang galolhing taohiti: ajehchu Pakaiyin hichu lengpa khutna pedoh navehta, ati.
target: When he arrived, the king asked him, “Micaiah, shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or not?” “Attack and be victorious,” he answered, “for the Lord will give it into the king’s hand.”

source: Chuin lengpan ajah-a, thutah tailou kahenga Pakai mina naseilouna dinga ijatvei nangma kaki hahsel sah ding nahim? ati.
target: The king said to him, “How many times must I make you swear to tell me nothing but the truth in the name of the Lord ?”

source: Chuin aman, Israelte jouse chu achingbei kelngoiho banga, lhang dunghoa achehchau gamhelu kamun; chule Pakaiyin, hihohin aching ding aneitapouve; mitin a-in lama lungmong tah-in kile taohen, atie, ati.
target: Then Micaiah answered, “I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd, and the Lord said, ‘These people have no master. Let each one go home in peace.’ ”

source: Chuin Israel lengpan Jehoshaphat jah-a, kachung chang thu ase tailou apha himhim seiponte tia kahil nahilouham? ati.
target: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he never prophesies anything good about me, but only bad?”

source: Chuin Micaiah'in, hichejeh chun nangman Pakai thuhi ngaijin; Pakai chu alaltouna chunga atouva, vanmi janel ajetlam le aveilama adinu kamui.
target: Micaiah continued, “Therefore hear the word of the Lord : I saw the Lord sitting on his throne with all the multitudes of heaven standing around him on his right and on his left.

source: Chuin Pakai chun Ahab hi Ramoth-gilead'a achea agathi nadinga kon agalhep ding ham? atin ahi. Chutichun khatnin hitin aseijin, chule adang khatnin khutin aseijin ahi.
target: And the Lord said, ‘Who will entice Ahab into attacking Ramoth Gilead and going to his death there?’ “One suggested this, and another that.

source: Chuin lhagao khat ahungdoh-in, Pakai anga adingin, keiman lheminge, ati.
target: Finally, a spirit came forward, stood before the Lord and said, ‘I will entice him.’

source: Chuin Pakaiyin ajah-a, iti danin em? ati. Chuin aman gache ingting, athemgaoho jouse kama chun jousei lhagaovin gapanginge, ati. Chuin aman ajah-a, nangman nagalhep ding, chule jojong nagajoding ahi; hijeh chun gachenlang hitobang chun gaboltan, ati.
target: “ ‘By what means?’ the Lord asked. “ ‘I will go out and be a deceiving spirit in the mouths of all his prophets,’ he said. “ ‘You will succeed in enticing him,’ said the Lord . ‘Go and do it.’

source: Hijeh chun tun, vetan, Pakaiyin hiche nathemgao ho jouse kama jousei lhagao akoijin, chule Pakaiyin nachung changa thilse aseitan ahi, ati.
target: “So now the Lord has put a deceiving spirit in the mouths of all these prophets of yours. The Lord has decreed disaster for you.”

source: Ahinla Chenaanah chapa Zedekiah'in aganaijin, Micaiah ngeiphe chu abengin, Pakai lhagao chu nahenga thu seidinga keija kona hoiche lampi-a potdoh-a ham? ati.
target: Then Zedekiah son of Kenaanah went up and slapped Micaiah in the face. “Which way did the spirit from the Lord go when he went from me to speak to you?” he asked.

source: Chuin Micaiah'in, vetan, indan sungnunga kisel dinga nalut niteng hetan nate, ati.
target: Micaiah replied, “You will find out on the day you go to hide in an inner room.”

source: Chuin Israel lengpan, Micaiah hi puijun lang, khopi vaihompa Amon le leng chapa Joash henga lepuijun;
target: The king of Israel then ordered, “Take Micaiah and send him back to Amon the ruler of the city and to Joash the king’s son

source: Chule hitin gaseijun, lengpan hitihin aseije, hichepahi songkul'a khumun lang, lungmonga kahung kahsen, gentheina an le gentheina twijin vah-un, ati.
target: and say, ‘This is what the king says: Put this fellow in prison and give him nothing but bread and water until I return safely.’ ”

source: Chuin Micaiah'in, lungmonga nahung kile pou poule, Pakaiyin kajah-a thu aseilou hinte, ati. Chuin aman, mipi ho, nangho kichih theijun, ati.
target: Micaiah declared, “If you ever return safely, the Lord has not spoken through me.” Then he added, “Mark my words, all you people!”

source: Hitichun Israel lengpa le Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat Ramoth-gilead'a achetou lhontai.
target: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

source: Chuin Israel lengpan Jehoshaphat jah-a, keiman kalim kheling ting galmuna lutninge; nangman vang nalengvon kivonin, ati. Chuin Israel lengpan alim akhelin, galmuna alut tai.
target: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will enter the battle in disguise, but you wear your royal robes.” So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.

source: Ahinla Syria lengpan kangtalai chunga vaipo gal lamkai somthumleni chu thu apen, Israel lengpa tailou alenjong aneojong kisatpi hih-un, ati.
target: Now the king of Aram had ordered his thirty-two chariot commanders, “Do not fight with anyone, small or great, except the king of Israel.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, kangtalai sepai vaipoho chun Jehoshaphat amuphatnun, amahon, amachu Israel lengpa ahimonge atiuvin ahi. Chuin ama satdingin akiheijun ahile, Jehoshaphat chu ahung pengjah-in ahi.
target: When the chariot commanders saw Jehoshaphat, they thought, “Surely this is the king of Israel.” So they turned to attack him, but when Jehoshaphat cried out,

source: Chuin kangtalai sepai vaipipo ho chun Israel lengpa ahilou ahet phatnun, ama anungdel uva konin akinungle taovin ahi.
target: the chariot commanders saw that he was not the king of Israel and stopped pursuing him.

source: Ahin mikhatnin athal ajebongin amoh kapmin ahileh Israel lengpa galvon thokah akhan ahi. Hijeh chun akangtalai tolpa jah-a chun, kaiheijin lang mipi lah-a konin neipotdoh pin, keima machanga kahitai, ati.
target: But someone drew his bow at random and hit the king of Israel between the sections of his armor. The king told his chariot driver, “Wheel around and get me out of the fighting. I’ve been wounded.”

source: Hicheni chun gal kisat akhohcheh chehtan, Syria mite lamngan lengpa chu kangtalai chunga akingaijin, nilhah lamin athitai. Chule amaha-a kona thisan along doh-in kangtalai sunga chun along lutnin ahi.
target: All day long the battle raged, and the king was propped up in his chariot facing the Arameans. The blood from his wound ran onto the floor of the chariot, and that evening he died.

source: Chuin nilhum ding konin sepai janel lah-a konin, amitakip akhopile agamsung cheh-a chetouhen, tin ahung kisamin ahi.
target: As the sun was setting, a cry spread through the army: “Every man to his town. Every man to his land!”

source: Hitichun lengpa chu athin, Samaria'a ahinpouvin; chuin lengpa chu Samaria'a avui taove.
target: So the king died and was brought to Samaria, and they buried him there.

source: Chuin mikhatnin kangtalai chu Samaria twikul'a chun asopmin; Pakai thusei dungjuijin, uicha hon athichu aleh-un; agalvon chu asopmun ahi.
target: They washed the chariot at a pool in Samaria (where the prostitutes bathed), and the dogs licked up his blood, as the word of the Lord had declared.

source: Tun Ahab thilbol danghole anatohho jouse, saiha-a a-in sah, chule ama sahdoh khopiho jouse chu Israel lengte thusimbua kisuna hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Ahab’s reign, including all he did, the palace he built and adorned with ivory, and the cities he fortified, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

source: Hitichun Ahab chu apu apate toh alumkhomin, ama khelin achapa Ahaziah alengchang tai.
target: Ahab rested with his ancestors. And Ahaziah his son succeeded him as king.

source: Chuin Israel lengpa Ahab lengchan kal kum li na-in, Asa chapa Jehoshaphat chu Juda gama alengchang panin ahi.
target: Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king of Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

source: Jehoshaphat alengchan kipat chun kum somthumle kum nga ahitan; Jerusalem'a kum somni le kum nga alengchange. Chule anu minchu Azubah ahin, Shili chanu ahi.
target: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-five years. His mother’s name was Azubah daughter of Shilhi.

source: Chuin aman apa Asa lampi jouse chu ajotnin, chua kona kiheimang louvin Pakai mitmu-a adih jeng abolin ahi. Ahivangin munsang ho vangchu akiladoh dehpoi; ajehchu munsang ho-a chun mipin thilpehle gimnamtui halna aneijing nalaijun ahi.
target: In everything he followed the ways of his father Asa and did not stray from them; he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord . The high places, however, were not removed, and the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.

source: Chule Jehoshaphat'in Israel lengpa toh chamna asemin ahi.
target: Jehoshaphat was also at peace with the king of Israel.

source: Tun Jehoshaphat thilbol danghole ahatna avetsahho, chule agalbol danho chu Judah lengte thusim buho-a kisuna hilou ham?
target: As for the other events of Jehoshaphat’s reign, the things he achieved and his military exploits, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

source: Chule apa Asa nikhoho-a jonthanhoija kimangcha ahingdoh amoh umsun chu, gamsunga konin anodohsoh helin ahi.
target: He rid the land of the rest of the male shrine prostitutes who remained there even after the reign of his father Asa.

source: Chulaichun Edom'a leng ana umpon; gamvaihom chu leng anahijenge.
target: There was then no king in Edom; a provincial governor ruled.

source: Jehoshaphat'in Ophir'a sana gapoding Tarshish kongho asemin, ahinla Ezion-geber'a kongho chu akegam jeh-in achetapoi.
target: Now Jehoshaphat built a fleet of trading ships to go to Ophir for gold, but they never set sail—they were wrecked at Ezion Geber.

source: Chuphatnin Ahab chapa Ahaziah chun Jehoshaphat jah-a, kasohte hi nasohtetoh kongho-a konkhom sah-u hite, ati. Ahinla Jehoshaphat anompon ahi.
target: At that time Ahaziah son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “Let my men sail with yours,” but Jehoshaphat refused.

source: Chuin Jehoshaphat apu apate toh alumkhom tan, apu apate toh apa David khopi-a avuitaovin ahi. Chuin ama khelin achapa Jehoram alengchang tai.
target: Then Jehoshaphat rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the city of David his father. And Jehoram his son succeeded him as king.

source: Chuin Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat lengchan kal kum somle kumsagi alhinin, Samaria gama Israelte chunga Ahab chapa Ahaziah alengchang panin; Israelte chunga kum ni alengchange.
target: Ahaziah son of Ahab became king of Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel two years.

source: Aman Pakai mitmun thilse abol jingin, apa lamlhah le anu lamlhah, chule Israelte chonsetsah-a Nebat chapa Jeroboam lamlhah chu ajotpeh-in ahi;
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , because he followed the ways of his father and mother and of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.

source: Ajehchu apan anabol bangin Baal ajenin, ahouvin, Israel Pakai Pathen lung hansahna dingin aphinsen ahi.
target: He served and worshiped Baal and aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, just as his father had done.

source: Chuin Ahab thi nungin, Moab mite chu Israel dounan akiphin taovin ahi.
target: After Ahab’s death, Moab rebelled against Israel.

source: Chuin Ahaziah chu Samaria'a um a-indan chungnung akalbi vang kah-a alhamangin, adammo tan ahi. Chuin thupole ho asolin ajah uva, kanatna-a konahi kadamdoh kitding hinam ti Ekron pathen Baalzebub chu gadop temun, ati.
target: Now Ahaziah had fallen through the lattice of his upper room in Samaria and injured himself. So he sent messengers, saying to them, “Go and consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron, to see if I will recover from this injury.”

source: Ahinla Pakai vantil'in Tishbi mi Elijah jah-a, kipat inlang chen, Samaria lengpa thupole ho gakimupin, chule ajah uvah hitin gaseijin, Israel gamsunga Pathen umloujeh-a Ekron pathen Baalzebub donga che nahiuvem?
target: But the angel of the Lord said to Elijah the Tishbite, “Go up and meet the messengers of the king of Samaria and ask them, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are going off to consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron?’

source: Hijeh chun tun Pakaiyin aseije, nangma nakaltouna jalkhuna kona kumlha louva thiden teiding nahitai tin seipeh un, ati. Chuin Elijah akipatdoh tai.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord says: ‘You will not leave the bed you are lying on. You will certainly die!’ ” So Elijah went.

source: Chuin thupole ho ahenga ahung kilekit phatnun, aman ajah uvah ibola hung kinungle pai nahiuvem? ati.
target: When the messengers returned to the king, he asked them, “Why have you come back?”

source: Chuin amahon ajah-a, Mikhat eikimupi diuvin ahung touvin kajah uvah, nahinsolpao lengpa henga kinung leovin lang ajah-a, Pakaiyin Ekron pathen Baalzebub donga nacheu chu, Israel gama Pathen umloujeh hijaham? hijeh chun nangma nakaldohna jalkhuna kona kumlha louva nathiden teitei ding joh ahi ati, atiuve.
target: “A man came to meet us,” they replied. “And he said to us, ‘Go back to the king who sent you and tell him, “This is what the Lord says: Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are sending messengers to consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not leave the bed you are lying on. You will certainly die!” ’ ”

source: Chuin aman ajah uvah, nakimupi diuva hungtouva, hiche thuho nahilpao chu itobang melpu ham? ati.
target: The king asked them, “What kind of man was it who came to meet you and told you this?”

source: Chuin amahon, ama mimul ahin, akonga savun konggah akigah-e, tin adonbutnuve. Chuin aman Tishbi mi Elijah ahi, ati.
target: They replied, “He had a garment of hair and had a leather belt around his waist.” The king said, “That was Elijah the Tishbite.”

source: Chujouvin lengpan somnga chunga gal lamkaipa le anungjui somnga hochu ahenga asolin ahi. Chuin amapa ahenga achetouvin; chuin, vetan, ama lhangvum khatna anatouvin ahi. Chuin amapan ajah-a, Pathen mipa, lengpan hungkum suh-in tin aseije, ati.
target: Then he sent to Elijah a captain with his company of fifty men. The captain went up to Elijah, who was sitting on the top of a hill, and said to him, “Man of God, the king says, ‘Come down!’ ”

source: Chuin mi somnga chunga gal lamkaipa chu Elijah'in adon butnin, keima Pathen mi kahia ahile, van'a konin mei hung lenglha henlang, nangma le nanungjui somnga hochu kavam helhen, ati. Chuin van'a konin mei ahungleng lhan, amale anungjui somnga hochu akavam heltan ahi.
target: Elijah answered the captain, “If I am a man of God, may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men!” Then fire fell from heaven and consumed the captain and his men.

source: Aman avelin, somnga chunga gallamkai le anungjui somnga ma asol kitnin ahi. Chuin amapan adonbutnin, ajah-a, vo Pathen mipa, lengpan hungkumlha loijin ati, ati.
target: At this the king sent to Elijah another captain with his fifty men. The captain said to him, “Man of God, this is what the king says, ‘Come down at once!’ ”

source: Chuin Elijah'in adonbutnin, ajah uvah, keima Pathen mi kahia ahile, van'a konin mei hung lenglha henlang, nangma le nanungjui somngaho kavamhen, ati. Chuin van'a konin mei ahungleng lhan, ama le anungjui somnga hochu akavam heltan ahi.
target: “If I am a man of God,” Elijah replied, “may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men!” Then the fire of God fell from heaven and consumed him and his fifty men.

source: Chuin aman athumvei channa-in somnga gallamkai khat anungjui somnga toh asolkitnin ahi. Chuin somnga vaipo thum channapa chu achetouvin, Elijah masanga akhupmin adilsun, ahenga ngehna aneijin, ajah-a, vo Pathen mipa, nahenga kathum ahi, keima hinkho le nasohte hicheho somngaho hinkho hi namitmun manlutah hisah-in.
target: So the king sent a third captain with his fifty men. This third captain went up and fell on his knees before Elijah. “Man of God,” he begged, “please have respect for my life and the lives of these fifty men, your servants!

source: Vetan, van'a konin mei ahungleng lhan, somnga vaipo masa teni le anungjui somnga gelchu akavam heltan ahi. Hijeh chun kahinkho hi namitmun manlutah hisah-in, atitan ahi.
target: See, fire has fallen from heaven and consumed the first two captains and all their men. But now have respect for my life!”

source: Chuin Pakai vantil chun Elijah jah-a, ama toh chesuh-in; ama chu kicha hih-in, ati. Chuin ama akipat doh-in, amapa chutoh lengpa henga achesuh tai.
target: The angel of the Lord said to Elijah, “Go down with him; do not be afraid of him.” So Elijah got up and went down with him to the king.

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Israel gamsunga Ekron pathen Baalzebub donga mi nasol chu, Israel gamsunga athu dopthei Pathen umloujeh ham? hichejeh-a chu nangma nakaldohna jalkhuna kona chu nahung kumlhah tahlouhel ding, nathi teitei ding ahi, ati.
target: He told the king, “This is what the Lord says: Is it because there is no God in Israel for you to consult that you have sent messengers to consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron? Because you have done this, you will never leave the bed you are lying on. You will certainly die!”

source: Hitichun Elijah in asei Pakai thu bangchun ama athitai. Chule Judah te lengpa Jehoshaphat chapa Jehoram lengchan kal kum nina-in, amakhelin Jehoram alengchang tai; ajehchu aman chapa aneipoi.
target: So he died, according to the word of the Lord that Elijah had spoken. Because Ahaziah had no son, Joram succeeded him as king in the second year of Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah.

source: Tun Ahaziah natohle athilbol dangho chu Israel lengte thusimbu ho-a kisuna hilouham?
target: As for all the other events of Ahaziah’s reign, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Pakaiyin Elijah chu van lama chimpeija atoltou dingkon chun, Elijah chu Elisha toh Gilgal'a konin akipatdoh lhonin ahi.
target: When the Lord was about to take Elijah up to heaven in a whirlwind, Elijah and Elisha were on their way from Gilgal.

source: Chuin Elijah'in Elisha jah-a, kangeh nahi, nangma hikoma hin umdentan; ajehchu Pakaiyin Bethel'a che dingin eisole, ati. Ahin Elisha'n ajah-a, Pakai hinna le nangma hinna pana kasei ahi, keiman nadalha hihhel inge, ati. Hitichun Bethel'a achesuh lhontai.
target: Elijah said to Elisha, “Stay here; the Lord has sent me to Bethel.” But Elisha said, “As surely as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave you.” So they went down to Bethel.

source: Chuin Bethel'a anaum themgaoho chapate chu Elisha henga ahungdoh-un, ajah-a, Pakaiyin nangma-a kona napupa chu tunia alahdoh dinghi nahet nah-em? atiuve. Chuin aman, henge, kahenai; lung mongin umun, ati.
target: The company of the prophets at Bethel came out to Elisha and asked, “Do you know that the Lord is going to take your master from you today?” “Yes, I know,” Elisha replied, “so be quiet.”

source: Chuin Elijah'in Elisha jah-a, kangeh nahi, nangma hikoma hin umdentan; ajehchu Pakaiyin Jericho'a che dingin eisole, ati. Chuin aman Pakai hinna le nangma hinna pana kasei ahi, keiman nadalha hihhel inge, ati. Hitichun Jericho'a ahung lhontai.
target: Then Elijah said to him, “Stay here, Elisha; the Lord has sent me to Jericho.” And he replied, “As surely as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave you.” So they went to Jericho.

source: Chuin Jericho'a um themgaoho chapate chu Elisha henga ahungun, ajah-a, Pakaiyin nangma-a kona napupa chu tunia alahdoh ding ahitai ti nahet nah-em? atiuve. Chuin aman adonbutnin, henge, kahenai; lung mongin umun, ati.
target: The company of the prophets at Jericho went up to Elisha and asked him, “Do you know that the Lord is going to take your master from you today?” “Yes, I know,” he replied, “so be quiet.”

source: Chuin Elijah'in ajah-a, kangeh nahi, umdentan; ajehchu Pakaiyin Jordan'a chedin eisole, ati. Chuin aman Pakai hinna le nangma hinna pana kasei ahi, keiman nadalha hihhel inge, ati. Chuin amani achejom kit lhontai.
target: Then Elijah said to him, “Stay here; the Lord has sent me to the Jordan.” And he replied, “As surely as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave you.” So the two of them walked on.

source: Chuin themgaoho chapate pasal somnga acheuvin, gamlatah-a konin agaldot din adingun; amani Jordan panga adinglhone.
target: Fifty men from the company of the prophets went and stood at a distance, facing the place where Elijah and Elisha had stopped at the Jordan.

source: Chuin Elijah'in aponsil chu alan, ajel tumin, twi chu avon ahile hilam le khulama akikhenin, hitichun amani tolgoa chun ache galkai lhontai.
target: Elijah took his cloak, rolled it up and struck the water with it. The water divided to the right and to the left, and the two of them crossed over on dry ground.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, amani agalkailhon phatnin, Elijah'in Elisha jah-a, nangma-a kona lahmanga kaum masanghin, nangma ipi kabolpeh dingham, kithumin, ati. Chuin Elisha'n, katao ahi, nalhagao chan channi kachunga umhen, ati.
target: When they had crossed, Elijah said to Elisha, “Tell me, what can I do for you before I am taken from you?” “Let me inherit a double portion of your spirit,” Elisha replied.

source: Chuin aman, nangman thil hahsatah nathum ahi; hijeng jongle nangma-a kona lahdoh-a kaum pet namu-a ahile, nachunga chutichun umhen; namu loule vang, chutilou ding ahi, ati.
target: “You have asked a difficult thing,” Elijah said, “yet if you see me when I am taken from you, it will be yours—otherwise, it will not.”

source: Chuin amani lamjot puma akihoulimpeh lhona ahile, veuvin, mei kangtalai khatle mei sakol ho ahungkilah-in, amani achom khenin; Elijah chu chimpeijin van'a akaltoutai.
target: As they were walking along and talking together, suddenly a chariot of fire and horses of fire appeared and separated the two of them, and Elijah went up to heaven in a whirlwind.

source: Chule Elisha'n hichu amun, hepa, hepa, Israel kangtalai le asakol touthemho khu, tin asamin ahi. Chuin aman amachu amukit tapoi: chuin aponsil chu alan abotkeh-in, halni ason ahi.
target: Elisha saw this and cried out, “My father! My father! The chariots and horsemen of Israel!” And Elisha saw him no more. Then he took hold of his garment and tore it in two.

source: Aman Elijah ponsil ama-a kona hunglha jong chu alan, akile kitnin, Jordan pama adingtai.
target: Elisha then picked up Elijah’s cloak that had fallen from him and went back and stood on the bank of the Jordan.

source: Aman Elijah ponsil ama-a kona hunglha chu alan, twi chu avon, Elijah Pakai Pathen chu hoija uma ham? ati, chuin amanjong twi avoh phatnin, hilam le khulama akikhenin ahi: chuin Elisha agalkaitai.
target: He took the cloak that had fallen from Elijah and struck the water with it. “Where now is the Lord , the God of Elijah?” he asked. When he struck the water, it divided to the right and to the left, and he crossed over.

source: Chuin themgaoho chapate Jericho'a anagaldot jinga umhon ama amuphat uvin, amahon Elijah lhagao Elisha chunga achutai atiuve. Chuin ama kimupi dingin ahungun, amasanga tolla aboh khupmun ahi.
target: The company of the prophets from Jericho, who were watching, said, “The spirit of Elijah is resting on Elisha.” And they went to meet him and bowed to the ground before him.

source: Chuin amahon ajah-a, tuhin vetemin, nasohte pasal hatcheh mi somnga kaumui; kataovu ahi, amaho cheohen lang na pupa gaholuhen; ijemtia Pakai lhagaovin apohtouva, molchung dung, ahiloule phaicham dunga ama aselhah hithei ahi, atiuve. Ahin aman nasol loudiu ahi, ati.
target: “Look,” they said, “we your servants have fifty able men. Let them go and look for your master. Perhaps the Spirit of the Lord has picked him up and set him down on some mountain or in some valley.” “No,” Elisha replied, “do not send them.”

source: Chuin amahon jachat umkhop leuva angeh phatnu chun, ajah uva, soltaovin, ati. Hijeh chun amahon pasal somnga asolun, nithum sung aholun, ahinla amupouve.
target: But they persisted until he was too embarrassed to refuse. So he said, “Send them.” And they sent fifty men, who searched for three days but did not find him.

source: Chuin amaho ahenga ahungkit phatnun, (ajehchu Jericho'a uma ahi,) aman ajah uvah, chehih-un tia naheng uva kasei hilouham? ati.
target: When they returned to Elisha, who was staying in Jericho, he said to them, “Didn’t I tell you not to go?”

source: Chuin khopi sunga miho chun Elisha jah-a, vetemin, katao ahi, ka Pakaiyin namu banghin, hiche khopihi nomtah ahi; ahinla twi aphapon, aleiset jong gamtem ahi, atiuve.
target: The people of the city said to Elisha, “Look, our lord, this town is well situated, as you can see, but the water is bad and the land is unproductive.”

source: Chuin aman, kahenga leibel thahkhat hinchoi junlang, asunga chi hinkoijun, ati. Chuin hichu ahenga ahinchoijun ahi.
target: “Bring me a new bowl,” he said, “and put salt in it.” So they brought it to him.

source: Chuin ama twisam phunga chun aga chen, asunga chun chi asung lutnin, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Keiman hiche twihi kasuhtheng ahitai; tua patna thina, ahiloule gamtem umtalou ding ahi, ati.
target: Then he went out to the spring and threw the salt into it, saying, “This is what the Lord says: ‘I have healed this water. Never again will it cause death or make the land unproductive.’ ”

source: Hitichun Elisha'n asei dungjuijin, twi chu tuchan geijin aphajingtai.
target: And the water has remained pure to this day, according to the word Elisha had spoken.

source: Chuin ama hiche mun'a konchun Bethel lama achetou tan ahi, chuin lamdunga achetou petchun, khopi-a konin chapang neochaho ahungdoh-un, amachu eltolnan abolun ajah-a, lutolpa, chetouvin; lutolpa, chetouvin, atiuve.
target: From there Elisha went up to Bethel. As he was walking along the road, some boys came out of the town and jeered at him. “Get out of here, baldy!” they said. “Get out of here, baldy!”

source: Chuin ama akinung heijin, amaho chu aven, Pakai minin agaosap tan ahi. Chuin vompi ni gammanga konin ahungdoh-in, chapang somlileni chu abottel lhontan ahi.
target: He turned around, looked at them and called down a curse on them in the name of the Lord . Then two bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of the boys.

source: Chuin ama chua konin Carmel molsanga achen, chu-a konchun Samaria lama akiletai.
target: And he went on to Mount Carmel and from there returned to Samaria.

source: Tun Judah leng Jehoshaphat lengchan kal kum somle kumget lhinkumin, Ahab chapa Jehoram chu Samaria'a Israelte chunga alengchang panin; chule kum somle kumni aleng changin ahi.
target: Joram son of Ahab became king of Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned twelve years.

source: Aman Pakai mitmun thilse abolin, apale anu bang vang ahipoi. Ajehchu apan anasem Baal milim chu anapai mangin ahi.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , but not as his father and mother had done. He got rid of the sacred stone of Baal that his father had made.

source: Hijeng jongle ama Israel chonsetsah Nebat chapa Jeroboam chonsetna a chun abeh jingin; hia konchun akikangse pon ahi.
target: Nevertheless he clung to the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit; he did not turn away from them.

source: Chuin Moab lengpa Mesha chu kelngoi vahmi ahin, aman Israel lengpa henga kelngoinou sangjakhat le kelngoichal sangjakhat amul pumin anapen ahi.
target: Now Mesha king of Moab raised sheep, and he had to pay the king of Israel a tribute of a hundred thousand lambs and the wool of a hundred thousand rams.

source: Ahinla ahitin ahi, Ahab athi phatnin, Israel lengpa dounan Moab lengpa akiphin tan ahi.
target: But after Ahab died, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

source: Chuin Jehoram lengpa chuphat laitah chun Samaria'a konin apotdoh-in, Israelte jouse chu asimtan ahi.
target: So at that time King Joram set out from Samaria and mobilized all Israel.

source: Chuin ama achen Judah leng Jehoshaphat henga mi asolin, Moab lengpan keima dounan akiphin tai; Moab douna galsat dinga keima toh nalhon dingham? agati sah-e. Chuin aman, ka chetou ding ahi: keima nang tobang kahin, kamite namite tobang ahin, kasakolho nangma sakol ho tobang ahi, ati.
target: He also sent this message to Jehoshaphat king of Judah: “The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me to fight against Moab?” “I will go with you,” he replied. “I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”

source: Chuin aman lampi hoichepena ikitoltou diuham? ati. Aman adonbutnin, Edom gamthip jotpaina lamlena, ati.
target: “By what route shall we attack?” he asked. “Through the Desert of Edom,” he answered.

source: Hitichun Israel lengpa chu Judah lengpa le Edom lengpa toh akontaove. Chuin nisagi achekolun ahile, anung juihou janel hole ganchaho donding twi aumtapon ahi.
target: So the king of Israel set out with the king of Judah and the king of Edom. After a roundabout march of seven days, the army had no more water for themselves or for the animals with them.

source: Chuin Israel lengpan, ohe! Pakaiyin leng thumho hi Moab mite khutna pehdoh dinga eikou khomu hitante, ati.
target: “What!” exclaimed the king of Israel. “Has the Lord called us three kings together only to deliver us into the hands of Moab?”

source: Ahinla Jehoshaphat'in, hikoma hi ama-a kona Pakai idopthei nadiu Pakai themgao khatbeh umlou ham? ati. Chuin Israel lengpa soh khatnin adonbutnin, Elijah khut twi sung jipa Shaphat chapa Elisha aume, ati.
target: But Jehoshaphat asked, “Is there no prophet of the Lord here, through whom we may inquire of the Lord ?” An officer of the king of Israel answered, “Elisha son of Shaphat is here. He used to pour water on the hands of Elijah.”

source: Chuin Jehoshaphat'in, Pakai thu chu ama henga uma ahi, ati. Hitichun Israel lengpa le Jehoshaphat, chule Edom lengpa chu ahenga achesuh-un ahi.
target: Jehoshaphat said, “The word of the Lord is with him.” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

source: Chuin Elisha'n Israel lengpa henga, keiman nangma toh ipi kiguijopna kaneijem? napa themgaoho le nanu themgaoho henga chen, ati. Chuin Israel lengpan ajah-a, chepong-e: ajehchu Pakaiyin hiche leng thumho hi Moab mite khutna pehdoh dinga akoukhom ahitai, ati.
target: Elisha said to the king of Israel, “Why do you want to involve me? Go to the prophets of your father and the prophets of your mother.” “No,” the king of Israel answered, “because it was the Lord who called us three kings together to deliver us into the hands of Moab.”

source: Chuin Elisha'n, a-anga kadin jing hingjing janelho Pakai min panna kasei ahi, Judah leng Jehoshaphat hungjao hi kakhohsahlou hile, nangma lamhi vetjong kavet louding, mujong kakimusah louding nahi.
target: Elisha said, “As surely as the Lord Almighty lives, whom I serve, if I did not have respect for the presence of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, I would not pay any attention to you.

source: Hijongle tumging tumthem mikhat neihin puipeh-un ati. Chuin ahitin ahi, tumging tumthem chun ahintum phatnin, Pakai khut achunga achutan ahi.
target: But now bring me a harpist.” While the harpist was playing, the hand of the Lord came on Elisha

source: Chuin aman, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, hiche phaicham hi kotongin dimsah-un.
target: and he said, “This is what the Lord says: I will fill this valley with pools of water.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, nanghon hui himhim namu loudiu, go himhim jong namuloudiu ahi. Hijeng jongle hiche phaicham chu nadon diuva twi dimding, nanghole nagancha teo, chule nagamsa houvin adondingu ahi.
target: For this is what the Lord says: You will see neither wind nor rain, yet this valley will be filled with water, and you, your cattle and your other animals will drink.

source: Chule hichehi Pakai mitmu-a thil neocha bou ahi: aman Moab mite jong nakhut nuva apehdoh nahlai ding ahi.
target: This is an easy thing in the eyes of the Lord ; he will also deliver Moab into your hands.

source: Khopi kul nei jouse le khopi deilhen jouse najo uva, thingphung phaho jouse naphuh lhuh diu, twikul jouse nasuh kangdiu, chule gamphaho jouse songa nasuhset dingu ahi, ati, ati.
target: You will overthrow every fortified city and every major town. You will cut down every good tree, stop up all the springs, and ruin every good field with stones.”

source: Chuin jingkah anneh thilto tophat vellin ahitin ahi, hichun veuvin, Edom lampia konin twi ahung longin, gamsung chu twijin adimsoh tai.
target: The next morning, about the time for offering the sacrifice, there it was—water flowing from the direction of Edom! And the land was filled with water.

source: Chule Moab mite jousen, amaho satdingin lengho chu ahung kontou taove ti ajah phatnun, galvon kivon theija pat chunglam jouse akikhomun, gamgi china ading taove.
target: Now all the Moabites had heard that the kings had come to fight against them; so every man, young and old, who could bear arms was called up and stationed on the border.

source: Chuin amaho jingkah matah-in athoudoh-un, twi chung chu nisan ahinkhon ahile, Moab miten apang langkhatna twi chu thisan bangin asanin amuvin ahi.
target: When they got up early in the morning, the sun was shining on the water. To the Moabites across the way, the water looked red—like blood.

source: Chuin amahon, hichehi thisan ahi; lengho chu akithat mong mong ahiuve, amaho khatle khat kithat to ahitaove; hijeh chun tun, Moab mite, gachom taote atiuvin ahi.
target: “That’s blood!” they said. “Those kings must have fought and slaughtered each other. Now to the plunder, Moab!”

source: Chuin amaho Israelte gebuh ahunglhun phatnun, Israelte akipat doh-un, Moab miho chu athat taovin, hitichun amaho amasanguva ajamtaove. Ahinla amahon amano peh-un, Moab mite chu agamsungu geisanin athatpeh jengun ahi.
target: But when the Moabites came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and fought them until they fled. And the Israelites invaded the land and slaughtered the Moabites.

source: Chule khopiho chu avochimun, agampha lai jouse amitakipmin song asekhumun avuhdimun, twikul jouse asubingun, thingphung phajouse aphuh lhuvin; Kirharaseth kho-a songho bouchu adalhaovin ahi. Ahinla ahsongse choiho acheleuvin, aga sumangun ahi.
target: They destroyed the towns, and each man threw a stone on every good field until it was covered. They stopped up all the springs and cut down every good tree. Only Kir Hareseth was left with its stones in place, but men armed with slings surrounded it and attacked it.

source: Chuin Moab lengpan gal kisat chu ama dingin ahoise behsetne ti amuphatnin, chemjam themcheh mi jasagi akipuijin, Edom lengpa pan nalam suhkeh ding agongin; ahinla ajou joupouve.
target: When the king of Moab saw that the battle had gone against him, he took with him seven hundred swordsmen to break through to the king of Edom, but they failed.

source: Chujouvin akhela lengchang dingpa achapa lenpen chu amanin, kulvuma chun govam thilto dingin atohdoh-in; Israelte chunga hatah-in alunghangun ahi. Chuin ama chu adalhaovin, agamuva akile taove.
target: Then he took his firstborn son, who was to succeed him as king, and offered him as a sacrifice on the city wall. The fury against Israel was great; they withdrew and returned to their own land.

source: Tun themgaoho chapate jite khatnin Elisha jah-a, nasohpa kajipa chu athitan; chule nasohpan Pakai aginje chu nahenai. Chule kachapa teni soh-a kaidingin kaleibat pao ahunge, tin akaptan ahi.
target: The wife of a man from the company of the prophets cried out to Elisha, “Your servant my husband is dead, and you know that he revered the Lord . But now his creditor is coming to take my two boys as his slaves.”

source: Chuin Elisha'n amanu jah-a, ipi kabolpeh dingham? neisei peh-in, na in'a ipi naneijem? ati. Chuin amanun ajah-a, nasohnun ina thao belkhat tailou imacha kaneipoi, ati.
target: Elisha replied to her, “How can I help you? Tell me, what do you have in your house?” “Your servant has nothing there at all,” she said, “except a small jar of olive oil.”

source: Chuphatnin aman, naheng nakom jouse umle belho, akeoho ngeichu apadin galan, lhomcha gala hih beh-in.
target: Elisha said, “Go around and ask all your neighbors for empty jars. Don’t ask for just a few.

source: Chule nahunglut tengle, nangma le nachateni kot nakikha khumdiu; bel jouse nasun dimuva, chule adimho jouse achoma nakoi diu ahi, ati.
target: Then go inside and shut the door behind you and your sons. Pour oil into all the jars, and as each is filled, put it to one side.”

source: Hitichun amanu ahenga konchun achedoh-in, bel hinchoi peh-a achapa teni toh kot akikhakhumun; aman asung sung jengtan ahi.
target: She left him and shut the door behind her and her sons. They brought the jars to her and she kept pouring.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, belho adimsoh phatnin, amanun achapa jah-a, bel neihin choipeh nalaijin, ati. Chuin aman anu jah-a, beldang aumtapoi, ati. Chuin thao chu akangtai.
target: When all the jars were full, she said to her son, “Bring me another one.” But he replied, “There is not a jar left.” Then the oil stopped flowing.

source: Chuphatnin amanu ahungin Pathen mipa chu aseipehtai. Chuin aman, chen thao chu gakijoh inlang nabat gasan, chule amoh-a chun nangle nachapate kihinso taovin, ati.
target: She went and told the man of God, and he said, “Go, sell the oil and pay your debts. You and your sons can live on what is left.”

source: Chuin nikhat hi numei haotah khat chenna Shunem kho-a Elisha agachen, amanun an nedin asolin ahi. Chuin ahitin ahi, aman hiche mun ahin hopa chanin, hia chun an nedin alutjin ahi.
target: One day Elisha went to Shunem. And a well-to-do woman was there, who urged him to stay for a meal. So whenever he came by, he stopped there to eat.

source: Chuin amanun a-inneipu jah-a, tun vetemin, eihin hopa jinguva hi Pathen mitheng khat ahi kahetai.
target: She said to her husband, “I know that this man who often comes our way is a holy man of God.

source: Katao ahi, bang chunga khun indan neokhat sempeh hitin; ama dingin jalkhun khat, dokhang khat, touna khat, chule meivah khom koipeh hite; chutia chu ama eini koma ahungji teng, hia chu lutji ding ahi, ati.
target: Let’s make a small room on the roof and put in it a bed and a table, a chair and a lamp for him. Then he can stay there whenever he comes to us.”

source: Chuin nikhat chu ahitin ahi, ama hilama chun ahungin, indan sunga chun alutnin, hia chun alumtai.
target: One day when Elisha came, he went up to his room and lay down there.

source: Chuin aman asohpa Gehazi henga Shunem, numeinu gakouvin, ati. Chuin aman agakouvin, amanu amasanga adingtai.
target: He said to his servant Gehazi, “Call the Shunammite.” So he called her, and she stood before him.

source: Chuin aman amapa jah-a, tun amanu jah-a, vetan, nangman keiho-a dingin najo chanin neikhoh sah-un; nangma ipi kabolpeh ding nahim? lengpa, ahiloule janel gallamkai henga thu kaseipeh diuham? tin dongin ati. Chuin amanun adonbutnin, keima kamite lah-a cheng kahi, ati.
target: Elisha said to him, “Tell her, ‘You have gone to all this trouble for us. Now what can be done for you? Can we speak on your behalf to the king or the commander of the army?’ ” She replied, “I have a home among my own people.”

source: Chuin aman, achutile amanu dinga ipi kibolpeh tantem? ati. Chuin Gehazi'n adonbutnin, tahbeh-in amanu chabei ahin, chule ajipahi tehse ahitai, ati.
target: “What can be done for her?” Elisha asked. Gehazi said, “She has no son, and her husband is old.”

source: Chuin aman, amanu chu kouvin, ati. Chuin amanu akouphatnin, amanu kotna adingtai.
target: Then Elisha said, “Call her.” So he called her, and she stood in the doorway.

source: Chuin aman, khovei tulai phatteng chapa khat napom ding ahi, ati. Chuin amanun, ahipoi, ka pakai, Pathen mipa, nasohnu henga jousei hih-in, ati.
target: “About this time next year,” Elisha said, “you will hold a son in your arms.” “No, my lord!” she objected. “Please, man of God, don’t mislead your servant!”

source: Chuin phatche dungjuijin numei chu agaijin, Elisha'n ajah-a anasei phattah chun chapa khat ahingtan ahi.
target: But the woman became pregnant, and the next year about that same time she gave birth to a son, just as Elisha had told her.

source: Chuin chapang chu akhandoh phatnin, nikhat hi chang at-ho lah-a apa henga agachen ahi.
target: The child grew, and one day he went out to his father, who was with the reapers.

source: Chuin aman apa henga, kalu, kalu atin ahi. Chuin apan chapang khat henga, anu hengah puiloijin, ati.
target: He said to his father, “My head! My head!” His father told a servant, “Carry him to his mother.”

source: Chuin aman chapangpa chu apoma, anu henga apui phatnin, anu khupchunga sun geijin atouvin, chujouvin athitai.
target: After the servant had lifted him up and carried him to his mother, the boy sat on her lap until noon, and then he died.

source: Chuin amanu achetouvin, Pathen mipa jalkhun chunga alupsah-in, kot akha khumin, achedohtai.
target: She went up and laid him on the bed of the man of God, then shut the door and went out.

source: Chuin aman a-inneipu akouvin, nahenga katao ahi, Pathen mipa henga kalhaija kahungkit theinadin, gollhangho lah-a khatle sangan holah-a khat neihin solpeh in, ati.
target: She called her husband and said, “Please send me one of the servants and a donkey so I can go to the man of God quickly and return.”

source: Chuin aman, lhathahni ahiloule cholngahni jongla ahipon, ibola tunitah-a ahenga nache ding ham? ati. Ahin amanun, hung phapha nante, ati.
target: “Why go to him today?” he asked. “It’s not the New Moon or the Sabbath.” “That’s all right,” she said.

source: Chuin amanu sangan chunga atouvin, asohpa jah-a, masang lama tilloi loijin; thu kapeh tilouvin keima-a dingin olchesah hih-in, ati.
target: She saddled the donkey and said to her servant, “Lead on; don’t slow down for me unless I tell you.”

source: Hitichun achen Pathen mipa heng Carmel mollama ahungin ahi. Chuin ahitin ahi, Pathen mipan amanu gamlatah-a amuphatnin, asohpa Gehazi jah-a, vetemin, gallanga khu Shunem numeinu ahi;
target: So she set out and came to the man of God at Mount Carmel. When he saw her in the distance, the man of God said to his servant Gehazi, “Look! There’s the Shunammite!

source: Tun amanu kimupi din lhai jel-in, kangeh nahi, chule ajah-a, ima jouse phapha-a hinam? na inneipu phapha-a hinam? naocha chu phapha-a hinam? gatin, ati. Chuin amanun, apha phanai tin adonbutne.
target: Run to meet her and ask her, ‘Are you all right? Is your husband all right? Is your child all right?’ ” “Everything is all right,” she said.

source: Chuin amanu lhanga Pathen mipa heng ahung lhun phatnin, akeng atuh jengin ahile; amanu sondohdin Gehazi'n ahin naijin ahi. Chuin Pathen mipan, limsah hih in; ajehchu amanu lung gentheija ahi: Pakaiyin keija kona a-ima, eihetsahlou ahitai, ati.
target: When she reached the man of God at the mountain, she took hold of his feet. Gehazi came over to push her away, but the man of God said, “Leave her alone! She is in bitter distress, but the Lord has hidden it from me and has not told me why.”

source: Chuphatnin amanun, ka pakai pa-a kona chapa kangeh-em? neijoulhep hih-in tia kanasei hilou ham? ati.
target: “Did I ask you for a son, my lord?” she said. “Didn’t I tell you, ‘Don’t raise my hopes’?”

source: Hitichun Gehazi jah-a, nakong kigah in, chule nakhutna katengol choijin lang chen; mikhat tou namujongle chun chibai boh hih-in, chule khat touvin na chibai jongle chun donhih-in; ka tenggol hi chapang maija gajamin, ati.
target: Elisha said to Gehazi, “Tuck your cloak into your belt, take my staff in your hand and run. Don’t greet anyone you meet, and if anyone greets you, do not answer. Lay my staff on the boy’s face.”

source: Chuin chapangpa nuchun, Pakai hinna le nangma hinna pana kasei ahi, keiman nangma kadalhah louhel ding nahi, ati. Chuin akipatdoh-in, amanu chu ajuitai.
target: But the child’s mother said, “As surely as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave you.” So he got up and followed her.

source: Chule Gehazi chu amani masanga anachen, tenggol chu naocha maija anajamtai; ahinla husale imacha jahding aumtapoi. Hijeh chun ama kimupi din achekitnin, ajah-a, chapang chu athoudoh dehpoi, tin aseipeh-in ahi.
target: Gehazi went on ahead and laid the staff on the boy’s face, but there was no sound or response. So Gehazi went back to meet Elisha and told him, “The boy has not awakened.”

source: Chuin Elisha insung ahunglhun phatnin, veuvin, chapang chu athisan ajalkhuna analumin ahi.
target: When Elisha reached the house, there was the boy lying dead on his couch.

source: Hitichun alutnin, amani changseh insunga kot akikhakhum honin, Pakai henga ataotai.
target: He went in, shut the door on the two of them and prayed to the Lord .

source: Chuin lupna-a chun akaldoh-in, chapang chunga chun aboh-in, akamle akam, amitle amit, chule akhutle akhut asuton ahi. Chuin chapang chu a-op khumin ahile chapangpa tichu ahunglum jepjep tan ahi.
target: Then he got on the bed and lay on the boy, mouth to mouth, eyes to eyes, hands to hands. As he stretched himself out on him, the boy’s body grew warm.

source: Chuin akumlha kitnin, insunga chun avahlelen; chuin akaltou kitnin, ama chu a-opkhum kitnin ahi. Chuin chapang chu sagi veijen achin, chuin chapang chu amit ahahtai.
target: Elisha turned away and walked back and forth in the room and then got on the bed and stretched out on him once more. The boy sneezed seven times and opened his eyes.

source: Chuin aman Gehazi akouvin, Shunem numeinu hinkouvin, ati. Hitichun aman amanu ahinkoutan ahi. Chuin amanu ahenga ahung phatnin, nachapa hi kipomtan, ati.
target: Elisha summoned Gehazi and said, “Call the Shunammite.” And he did. When she came, he said, “Take your son.”

source: Chuin amanu alutnin, akengbula alhun, tolla aboh khupmin, achapa chu akipomin, apotdohtai.
target: She came in, fell at his feet and bowed to the ground. Then she took her son and went out.

source: Chuin Elisha Gilgal'a ahungkit tai: chule gamsunga chun kel alhan; themgaoho chapate chu amasanga atouvun ahi. Chuin aman asohpa jah-a, bel lenchu songin lang themgaoho chapate din annoi honpeh in, ati.
target: Elisha returned to Gilgal and there was a famine in that region. While the company of the prophets was meeting with him, he said to his servant, “Put on the large pot and cook some stew for these prophets.”

source: Chuin mikhat anche louva loujaova achen ahile gam lengpi guikhat amun, agachu a-ang dimset-in ahinpomin, annoi bela chun alhahtai: ajehchu amahon hihochu ipi ahi ahet louvu ahi.
target: One of them went out into the fields to gather herbs and found a wild vine and picked as many of its gourds as his garment could hold. When he returned, he cut them up into the pot of stew, though no one knew what they were.

source: Hitichun mipi ho nehdin athuhpeh taove. Chuin ahitin ahi, annoi chu aneh petnun, amahon ahin samdoh-un, vo Pathen mipa, belsunga thina aume atiuve. Hitichun amahon hichu anethei tapouve.
target: The stew was poured out for the men, but as they began to eat it, they cried out, “Man of God, there is death in the pot!” And they could not eat it.

source: Ahinla aman, achutile anchu hinlaovin, ati. Chuin bela alhei lutnin; ajah uva, mihon anehtheina diuvin thuh-un, ati. Chuin belsunga chun imacha aphamo aumtapon ahi.
target: Elisha said, “Get some flour.” He put it into the pot and said, “Serve it to the people to eat.” And there was nothing harmful in the pot.

source: Chuin Baal-shalisha'a konin mikhat ahungin, Pathen mipi chu ga masa-a kona kisem changlhah, sakol changlhah somni toh chang ga thah lihleh vuikhat ahinpohpeh in ahi. Chuin aman ajah-a, amahon aneh theina diuvin mipi ho chu pen ati.
target: A man came from Baal Shalishah, bringing the man of God twenty loaves of barley bread baked from the first ripe grain, along with some heads of new grain. “Give it to the people to eat,” Elisha said.

source: Chuin asohpan, mi jakhatjen anga hichehi kaluipeh dingham? ati. Aman mihon aneh theina diuvin pen, tin aseikitnin ahi: ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, amahon neuvintin, anehval nahlaidiu ahi, ati.
target: “How can I set this before a hundred men?” his servant asked. But Elisha answered, “Give it to the people to eat. For this is what the Lord says: ‘They will eat and have some left over.’ ”

source: Hitichun a-anguva aluipeh-in, amahon aneuvin, Pakai thu dungjui chun, aneh valu akhen nalaijun ahi.
target: Then he set it before them, and they ate and had some left over, according to the word of the Lord .

source: Tun Syria lengpa janel lamkai Naaman chu a-pakaipa mitmu-a dinga milentah le jabol changtah ahin, ajehchu ama jala Pakaiyin Syria te chu galjona anapeh ji ahi. Ama hi mihat hangsantah jong ahin; hinla miphah ahi.
target: Now Naaman was commander of the army of the king of Aram. He was a great man in the sight of his master and highly regarded, because through him the Lord had given victory to Aram. He was a valiant soldier, but he had leprosy.
