source: Syria mite chu ahon honin akitoldoh uvin, chule Israel gama konin numei chapang khat sohchangin ahin puidoh uvin; amanu chu Naaman inneipi jenin apangin ahi.
target: Now bands of raiders from Aram had gone out and had taken captive a young girl from Israel, and she served Naaman’s wife.

source: Chuin amanu chun a-pakainu jah-a, ka pakaipa hi Samaria'a um themgaopa gakivetsah hitavele! ajehchu aman aphahhi athensah ding ahi, ati.
target: She said to her mistress, “If only my master would see the prophet who is in Samaria! He would cure him of his leprosy.”

source: Chuin Naaman agalutnin a-pakaipa jah-a chun, Israel gama kon nungahnu khun hiti tihin thu aseije agatin ahi.
target: Naaman went to his master and told him what the girl from Israel had said.

source: Chuin Syria lengpan, gache jengin, keiman Israel lengpa henga chun lekha khat jih nange, ati. Chuin ama akipatdoh-in, dangka talent som toh, sana nong sang gup toh, kikhelna von som akipoh-in ahi.
target: “By all means, go,” the king of Aram replied. “I will send a letter to the king of Israel.” So Naaman left, taking with him ten talents of silver, six thousand shekels of gold and ten sets of clothing.

source: Chuin aman lekha chu Israel lengpa henga ahin choijin, athuchu hitin akisune: Tun hiche lekha hi nahenga ahunglhun teng, vetan, keiman kasohpa Naaman hi aphah-a kona nathensah theina dingin, nahenga kahinsolin ahi.
target: The letter that he took to the king of Israel read: “With this letter I am sending my servant Naaman to you so that you may cure him of his leprosy.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Israel lengpan lekha chu asimphatnin, apon asat telin, keihi Pathen kahia, mi kathisah-a, kahin sahthei hija, hichepa hin phah thensah dinga kahenga mi ahinsol ham? hijeh chun ngaitouvin, katao ahi, chule veuvin keimatoh kinahna nading iti ahol hitam, atin ahi.
target: As soon as the king of Israel read the letter, he tore his robes and said, “Am I God? Can I kill and bring back to life? Why does this fellow send someone to me to be cured of his leprosy? See how he is trying to pick a quarrel with me!”

source: Chule Pathen mipa Elisha'n Israel lengpan aponho abot tele ti ajah phatnin, lengpa henga mi asolin, ibola napon nabotel ham? Israel gama themgao khat aume ti ahetnadin, tun amachu kahenga hinsolin, ati.
target: When Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his robes, he sent him this message: “Why have you torn your robes? Have the man come to me and he will know that there is a prophet in Israel.”

source: Hitichun Naaman chu asakole akangtalai toh ahung kitolin, Elisha in kotphunga adingtai.
target: So Naaman went with his horses and chariots and stopped at the door of Elisha’s house.

source: Chuin Elisha'n thupole khat ahenga asolin, Jordan'a sagivei gaki soplhan, chutile natahsa hungkile kitnin tin, chutengle natheng ding ahitai, agatisah-e.
target: Elisha sent a messenger to say to him, “Go, wash yourself seven times in the Jordan, and your flesh will be restored and you will be cleansed.”

source: Ahinla Naaman alunghangin, ache mangin, hitin aseije, vetan, kei ngaiton ama kahenga hungdoh teijintin, dingintin, a-Pakai Pathen min kou intin, akhutna kanatna chung chu thamintin, chuteng phahna chu daminte kati ahi, ati.
target: But Naaman went away angry and said, “I thought that he would surely come out to me and stand and call on the name of the Lord his God, wave his hand over the spot and cure me of my leprosy.

source: Damascus vapiho, Abana le Pharpar khu Israel gama twi jouse sanga phajo hilou ham? hicheho-a khu kakisop lhah-a kathen moham? ati. Hitichun lunghang tah-in akiheijin achemang tai.
target: Are not Abana and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Couldn’t I wash in them and be cleansed?” So he turned and went off in a rage.

source: Chuin asohten ahin naijun, ahenga thu aseijun, hepa, themgaopan thil lentah boldia nasoleh, hichu nabolda theiding ham? Aman gakisoplhan lang thengtan, ati kalvalla ipiba asei nahlai dingham? atiuve.
target: Naaman’s servants went to him and said, “My father, if the prophet had told you to do some great thing, would you not have done it? How much more, then, when he tells you, ‘Wash and be cleansed’!”

source: Chuphatnin ama achesuh-in, Pathen mipa sei dungjuijin, Jordan'a chun sagivei akiphumin ahi. Chuin avouchu chapangsen vou bangin ahungkile kitnin, athengseltan ahi.
target: So he went down and dipped himself in the Jordan seven times, as the man of God had told him, and his flesh was restored and became clean like that of a young boy.

source: Chuin ama le aloiho jouse Pathen mipa henga ahungkile kitnun, amasanga ading taove. Chuin aman, vetan, leiset pumpi-a hin Pathen aumpon, Israel gama bou aumme ti tun kahetai; hijeh chun tun kangeh nahi, nasoh phatthei bohnahi neisan peh-in, ati.
target: Then Naaman and all his attendants went back to the man of God. He stood before him and said, “Now I know that there is no God in all the world except in Israel. So please accept a gift from your servant.”

source: Ahinla aman, a-anga kadinjing Pakai hingjing mina kasei ahi, keiman imacha laponge, ati. Ahin alahteina dingin aman angeh-in, ahinla ama anompoi.
target: The prophet answered, “As surely as the Lord lives, whom I serve, I will not accept a thing.” And even though Naaman urged him, he refused.

source: Chuin Naaman'in nahenga, chuti ahile, katao ahi, nasoh hi sangan nin apoh khopset leiset neipeh thei dingham? ajehchu nasoh hin tua pat Pakai henga tilouva, govam thilto le ganlhaina himhim pathen dangho henga kalha louhel ding ahitai.
target: “If you will not,” said Naaman, “please let me, your servant, be given as much earth as a pair of mules can carry, for your servant will never again make burnt offerings and sacrifices to any other god but the Lord .

source: Hiche thila hin Pakaiyin nasohhi ngaidam maihen; kapupa Rimmon houin'a chibaiboh dinga alut tengle, aman kakhut chunga akingaijin, chule keimatah hi Rimmon houin'a kunjia kahi. Keima Rimmon houin sunga kakunji teng nasohhi Pakai chun hiche thilahin eingai damhen, ati.
target: But may the Lord forgive your servant for this one thing: When my master enters the temple of Rimmon to bow down and he is leaning on my arm and I have to bow there also—when I bow down in the temple of Rimmon, may the Lord forgive your servant for this.”

source: Chuin aman ajah-a lung mongin chetan, ati. Hitichun ama-a konin apotdoh-in achesaohih laije.
target: “Go in peace,” Elisha said. After Naaman had traveled some distance,

source: Ahinla Pathen mi Elisha sohpa Gehazi chun, ven kapun Syria mi Naaman thil hinkenho lahpeh louvin alhadoh jengtan; ahinla Pakai hinna pana kasei ahi, nungdel ingting ipiham khatbeh galahpeh inge, atin ahi.
target: Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said to himself, “My master was too easy on Naaman, this Aramean, by not accepting from him what he brought. As surely as the Lord lives, I will run after him and get something from him.”

source: Hitichun Gehazi'n Naaman anungdeltai. Chuin Naaman'in anunga min ahindel amuphatnin, akimupidin kangtalai ja konin akumlhan, ijakai phapha-a hinam, anati.
target: So Gehazi hurried after Naaman. When Naaman saw him running toward him, he got down from the chariot to meet him. “Is everything all right?” he asked.

source: Chuin aman, ijakai aphanai; kapun vetan tutah chun Ephraim mola konin themgao chapate mini ahung lhonin ahi. Kangeh nahi, dangka talent khat le kikhelna pon ni amani chu pen tia eihinsol ahi, ati.
target: “Everything is all right,” Gehazi answered. “My master sent me to say, ‘Two young men from the company of the prophets have just come to me from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and two sets of clothing.’ ”

source: Chuin Naaman'in, lunglhai selin talent ni kilah jengin, ati. Chule akilah dingin hangeh-in angeh-in, sakhao ni sunga dangka talent nile kikhelna ponsil ni dipsunga athunin, asohte mini apohsah-in; chule Gahazi masanga chun ache lhonin ahi.
target: “By all means, take two talents,” said Naaman. He urged Gehazi to accept them, and then tied up the two talents of silver in two bags, with two sets of clothing. He gave them to two of his servants, and they carried them ahead of Gehazi.

source: Chuin insang alhun phatnun, amani khutna konin alan, insunga chun akoitai. Chuin amani chu alesolin, amani achedoh lhontai.
target: When Gehazi came to the hill, he took the things from the servants and put them away in the house. He sent the men away and they left.

source: Ahinla ama alutnin, apu anga adingtai. Chuin Elisha'n ajah-a, Gehazi hoilama kona hung nahim? ati. Chuin aman nasoh hoimacha kachepoi, ati.
target: When he went in and stood before his master, Elisha asked him, “Where have you been, Gehazi?” “Your servant didn’t go anywhere,” Gehazi answered.

source: Chuin aman ajah-a aseijin, nakimupi dingpa akangtalaija kona ahung kiheikitna chu, kalungthim hi nangma toh kilhona hilou ham? sum, ponsil, Olive hon, lengpi hon, bongchal ho, soh pasal ho, chule soh numei ho lah phat ham?
target: But Elisha said to him, “Was not my spirit with you when the man got down from his chariot to meet you? Is this the time to take money or to accept clothes—or olive groves and vineyards, or flocks and herds, or male and female slaves?

source: Hijeh chun Naaman phahna chu nangma chungle nachih lhahte chunga a-itih-a chujingding ahitai, ati. Chuin amasanga kona apotdoh doh-in buhbang bangin aphahtan ahi.
target: Naaman’s leprosy will cling to you and to your descendants forever.” Then Gehazi went from Elisha’s presence and his skin was leprous—it had become as white as snow.

source: Chuin themgaoho chapaten Elisha jah-a, vetemin, tuhin nangma toh ichen khomnao munhi eiho dingin aneo behsehtai.
target: The company of the prophets said to Elisha, “Look, the place where we meet with you is too small for us.

source: Kataovu ahi, Jordan lama cheohitin, mitinin thingtum khatcheh chua konchun laohitin, chumuna chun ichen nadiu mun kisemu hite, atiuve. Chuin aman, cheovin, ati.
target: Let us go to the Jordan, where each of us can get a pole; and let us build a place there for us to meet.” And he said, “Go.”

source: Chuin mikhatnin, katao ahi, nasohte neilhon piuvin, ati. Chuin aman, lhonpi naovinge, tin adonbutnin ahi.
target: Then one of them said, “Won’t you please come with your servants?” “I will,” Elisha replied.

source: Hitichun amahotoh alhontai. Chuin Jordan alhun phatnun, thing aphuhtaove.
target: And he went with them. They went to the Jordan and began to cut down trees.

source: Ahinla mikhatnin thingtum atana ahile heichang chu twija alhalut tai. Chuin ama apengjah-in, ohe, hepu! mi-a kapalah ahi, ati.
target: As one of them was cutting down a tree, the iron axhead fell into the water. “Oh no, my lord!” he cried out. “It was borrowed!”

source: Chuin Pathen mipan hoija lhamang ham? ati. Chuin amun chu ahilin ahi. Aman molkang khat asatnin, amuntah-a chu akholutnin ahile; heichang chu ahung kiletdoh tai.
target: The man of God asked, “Where did it fall?” When he showed him the place, Elisha cut a stick and threw it there, and made the iron float.

source: Hichun aman, kilah-in, ati, chuin aman akhut alhangin, akilahtai.
target: “Lift it out,” he said. Then the man reached out his hand and took it.

source: Chuin Syria lengpan Israelte chunga gal abolin, asohte toh thumop anei khomun, hiche mun chuche munchu kagebuh hiding ahi, ati.
target: Now the king of Aram was at war with Israel. After conferring with his officers, he said, “I will set up my camp in such and such a place.”

source: Chuin Pathen mipan Israel lengpa henga mi asolin, chuche mun jotlounadin chingtheijin; ajehchu hilama chun Syria te ahungsuh uve agatisah-e.
target: The man of God sent word to the king of Israel: “Beware of passing that place, because the Arameans are going down there.”

source: Chuin Israel lengpan Pathen mipa hilnale gihna mun'a chun mi asolin, hia konchun khatvei niveiseh hilouvin, akihuhhing jingin ahi.
target: So the king of Israel checked on the place indicated by the man of God. Time and again Elisha warned the king, so that he was on his guard in such places.

source: Hijeh chun Syria lengpa chu hiche thil jeh hin alungkham lheh-in, asohte akouvin, ajah uva, ilah uva Israel lengpa lama pang koipen ihiu nei musah loudiu ham? ati.
target: This enraged the king of Aram. He summoned his officers and demanded of them, “Tell me! Which of us is on the side of the king of Israel?”

source: Chuin asohte lah-a khatnin, vo lengpa ka pakai, khatcha aumpoi: Israel gamsunga Elisha themgaopan najalkhun danna nathuseiho chu Israel lengpa ahilji ahibouve, ati.
target: “None of us, my lord the king,” said one of his officers, “but Elisha, the prophet who is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the very words you speak in your bedroom.”

source: Chuin aman, keiman mi kasola kamat theinadin, chenlang hoija aum gavelhi temin, ati. Chuin ajah-a, vetan, Dothan'a aume, tin aseipeh-un ahi.
target: “Go, find out where he is,” the king ordered, “so I can send men and capture him.” The report came back: “He is in Dothan.”

source: Hijeh chun hilama chun sakol ho, kangtalai ho, chule mipi janle asolin; amaho jan-in ahungun, khopi chu a-um kimvel taove.
target: Then he sent horses and chariots and a strong force there. They went by night and surrounded the city.

source: Chuin Pathen mipa sohpa chu matah-a athodoh-a apotdohle, veuvin, mipi janelin khopi chu sakol ho le kangtalai toh anaum kimvelun ahi. Chuin sohpan ajah-a, ohe hepu! i-itiding hitam? ati.
target: When the servant of the man of God got up and went out early the next morning, an army with horses and chariots had surrounded the city. “Oh no, my lord! What shall we do?” the servant asked.

source: Chuin aman adonbutnin, kicha hih-in; ajehchu eini lama pangho chu amaho lama pangho sangin atamjouvin ahi, tin adonbutne.
target: “Don’t be afraid,” the prophet answered. “Those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”

source: Chuin Elisha ataovin, Pakai, katao ahi, amuthei nadin amit hasah-in, ati. Chuin Pakaiyin gollhangpa mit ahasah-in ahile, aman amutan: chuin veuvin, Elisha kimvela molsang chu sakolle mei kangtalai ho adimsetnin ahi.
target: And Elisha prayed, “Open his eyes, Lord , so that he may see.” Then the Lord opened the servant’s eyes, and he looked and saw the hills full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.

source: Chuin amaho ahenga ahungsuh phatnun, Elisha Pakai henga ataovin, katao ahi, hiche mitehi amitnu chotsah-in, ati. Chuin Elisha thu dungjuijin amitnu achotsahtai.
target: As the enemy came down toward him, Elisha prayed to the Lord , “Strike this army with blindness.” So he struck them with blindness, as Elisha had asked.

source: Chuin Elisha'n ajah uva, hichehi lampichu ahipon, chule khopi jongchu hichehi ahipoi; neijuijun, chutile naholpao henga chu kapuiding nahiuve, ati. Ahinla aman amaho Samaria lama apuitai.
target: Elisha told them, “This is not the road and this is not the city. Follow me, and I will lead you to the man you are looking for.” And he led them to Samaria.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, amaho Samaria ahunglhun phatnun, Elisha'n, Pakai amutheina diuvin, hiteho mit hi hasahtan, ati. Chuin Pakaiyin amitnu ahasahtan ahile, kho amutaovin; chule veuvin, amaho Samaria lailunga um anahi taove.
target: After they entered the city, Elisha said, “ Lord , open the eyes of these men so they can see.” Then the Lord opened their eyes and they looked, and there they were, inside Samaria.

source: Chuin Israel lengpan amaho amu phatnin, Elisha henga, hepa amahohi katha dingham? katha dingham? ati.
target: When the king of Israel saw them, he asked Elisha, “Shall I kill them, my father? Shall I kill them?”

source: Aman adonbutnin, nangman amahohi nasuhmang louding ahi; nangman soh changa namat ho chu nachemjam le nathalpi-a natha dingham? Amahon aneh uva adonuva, chule apupao henga ache theina diuvin, amasanguva an le twi luipeh-in, ati.
target: “Do not kill them,” he answered. “Would you kill those you have captured with your own sword or bow? Set food and water before them so that they may eat and drink and then go back to their master.”

source: Chuin amaho nehding nasatah-in agonpeh-in; chule amahon aneh uva, adon jouvun, amaho chu asolmang tan, amaho a-pakaipa henga achetauve. Hitichun Syria miho chu Israel gamsunga ahungkit tapouve.
target: So he prepared a great feast for them, and after they had finished eating and drinking, he sent them away, and they returned to their master. So the bands from Aram stopped raiding Israel’s territory.

source: Chuin hiche jouhin ahitin ahi, Syria lengpa Benhadad'in janel honpi chu akhomin, akontouvin, Samaria aumkol tan ahi.
target: Some time later, Ben-Hadad king of Aram mobilized his entire army and marched up and laid siege to Samaria.

source: Chuin Samaria gama chun kel nasatah alhatan; chule veuvin, sangan lu khat dangka somgetna akijoh-a, vakhu eh hop li-a hop khat dangka nongsi nga-a akijoh kahsen, khopi chu aumchah jengun ahi.
target: There was a great famine in the city; the siege lasted so long that a donkey’s head sold for eighty shekels of silver, and a quarter of a cab of seed pods for five shekels.

source: Chuin Israel lengpa kulvuma ahung valea ahile, numei khatnin ama chu ahinsamin, ajah-a, neikithopin, ka pakai, vo lengpa, atin ahi.
target: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, “Help me, my lord the king!”

source: Chuin aman, Pakaiyin nakithopi loule keiman hoija kona kakithopi dingham? Chang pholla konin em, ahiloule lengpi kichilna-a konin em? ati.
target: The king replied, “If the Lord does not help you, where can I get help for you? From the threshing floor? From the winepress?”

source: Chuin lengpan amanu jah-a, iti nahi ham? ati. Chuin amanun adonbutnin, hichenu hin kahenga, nachapa hintoh doh-in, tunin nehitin, chule jingle kei chapa nena hite, atin ahi.
target: Then he asked her, “What’s the matter?” She answered, “This woman said to me, ‘Give up your son so we may eat him today, and tomorrow we’ll eat my son.’

source: Hitichun kachapa kakihon lhonin, kane lhontai. Chuin ajing nikhon amanu henga, nachapa hintoh dohtan, neta hite, katin ahile; amanun achapa anaseltai.
target: So we cooked my son and ate him. The next day I said to her, ‘Give up your son so we may eat him,’ but she had hidden him.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, lengpan numeinu thusei ajah phatnin, apon asat telin; chuin palvuma vahlen, mipi chun aveovin, chule veuvin, atichunga khaodip pon akisiltan ahi.
target: When the king heard the woman’s words, he tore his robes. As he went along the wall, the people looked, and they saw that, under his robes, he had sackcloth on his body.

source: Chuin aman, tunikho-a hi Shaphat chapa Elisha luchang achunga aum den poupouva ahile, Pathen'in chutobang chun eibol hen, chule akalvalin jong eibol hen, atin ahi.
target: He said, “May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if the head of Elisha son of Shaphat remains on his shoulders today!”

source: Ahinla Elisha a-in'a atouvin, chule upahon atoupiuvin ahi. Chuin lengpan a-angsunga konin mikhat asolin; ahinla amapa chu ahunglhun masangin, aman upaho jah-a, hiche tolthatpa chapan kalu ladinga mi ahinsol hi nahet uvem? Veuvin, sottolpa ahungteng kot khah unlang, kotna lutsah hih helun: anunga khu apu kholhah gin hilouham? ati.
target: Now Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. The king sent a messenger ahead, but before he arrived, Elisha said to the elders, “Don’t you see how this murderer is sending someone to cut off my head? Look, when the messenger comes, shut the door and hold it shut against him. Is not the sound of his master’s footsteps behind him?”

source: Chuin ama amahotoh akihou nalaijin, veuvin, thupo chu amaheng ahung lhungtai. Chuin aman, veuvin, hiche thilsehi Pakaiya kon ahin; Pakai chu ipi dinga kanga nahlai dingham? ati.
target: While he was still talking to them, the messenger came down to him. The king said, “This disaster is from the Lord . Why should I wait for the Lord any longer?”

source: Chujouvin Elisha'n, Pakai thuhi ngaijun; Pakaiyin hitin aseije, jingle tuphat teng Samaria kotpi phunga changbong nelsel tena dan khat sekel khat, chule sakol chang tena dan ni sekel khatna kijoh ding ahi, ati.
target: Elisha replied, “Hear the word of the Lord . This is what the Lord says: About this time tomorrow, a seah of the finest flour will sell for a shekel and two seahs of barley for a shekel at the gate of Samaria.”

source: Chuin lengpa kingaina milen khatnin Pathen mipa chu adonbutnin, veuvin, Pakaiyin van'a bangkot ahonding hijongle, hichu hitheidi hinam? ati. Chuin aman, vetan hichehi namitna namu-a, neh vang naneh louding ahi, ati.
target: The officer on whose arm the king was leaning said to the man of God, “Look, even if the Lord should open the floodgates of the heavens, could this happen?” “You will see it with your own eyes,” answered Elisha, “but you will not eat any of it!”

source: Chuin kotpisung lutna-a chun miphah li aumin; amaho khatnin khat jah-a, hikomahi ibola ithi kahseuva itou diuham?
target: Now there were four men with leprosy at the entrance of the city gate. They said to each other, “Why stay here until we die?

source: Khosunga lutnu hite tileu henla, khosung kel alhan, chua chu ithi jeng dingu ahin; hilaija hin hiti tou jongleu hen, ithi thou thoudiu ahi. Hijeh chun tun hungtemun, Syria sepaiho lama kipelut jengu hite; eihing hoijule hingu hitin; eithaolela ithi maidingu hitante, akitiuve.
target: If we say, ‘We’ll go into the city’—the famine is there, and we will die. And if we stay here, we will die. So let’s go over to the camp of the Arameans and surrender. If they spare us, we live; if they kill us, then we die.”

source: Syria miteho gebuh-a chedingin khomut chipchep in akipatdoh taovin; chuin amaho Syria te gebuhpam nungpen ahung lhunule, veuvin, hichea chun koimacha anaum tapoi.
target: At dusk they got up and went to the camp of the Arameans. When they reached the edge of the camp, no one was there,

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin Syria mite janel chu kangtalai ho husagin, sakol ho hugin, janelho hugin chule janel tamtah ho hugin geijin ajahsah-in; chuin khatnin khat jah-a aseijun, veuvin, Israel lengpa hin Hit lengte, Egypt lengte hohi ichunguva galbol dinga apalah ahi, atiuve.
target: for the Lord had caused the Arameans to hear the sound of chariots and horses and a great army, so that they said to one another, “Look, the king of Israel has hired the Hittite and Egyptian kings to attack us!”

source: Hijeh chun amaho akipatnun khomut chipchep in ajamun, apon inhou, asakolhou, asanganhou, chule agebuh-u chu atobang bangin ahinna diuvin adalhaovin, ajamtaovin ahi.
target: So they got up and fled in the dusk and abandoned their tents and their horses and donkeys. They left the camp as it was and ran for their lives.

source: Chuin hiche mi phahho chu gebuh manglhapen alhun phatnun, pon-in khatna agalutnun, aneuvin adonnun, chua konchun sana le dangka chule ponsil ho akilah uvin, acheuvin agaselun; chuin ahungkitnun gebuh chomdang khatna alut kitnun, chu-a kon jongchun alah kitnun, aselkitnun ahi.
target: The men who had leprosy reached the edge of the camp, entered one of the tents and ate and drank. Then they took silver, gold and clothes, and went off and hid them. They returned and entered another tent and took some things from it and hid them also.

source: Chuin amaho khatnin khat jah-a aseijun, ithilbolu hi aphapoi; tuni hi kipana thupha lhunni ahin, eiho ithipbeh jengun ahi: jingkah khovah gei ingauva ahile, ichunguva thilse hunglhung thei ahi. Hijeh chun tun hungun, icheuva lengte insung igahil theina diuvin, akitiuve.
target: Then they said to each other, “What we’re doing is not right. This is a day of good news and we are keeping it to ourselves. If we wait until daylight, punishment will overtake us. Let’s go at once and report this to the royal palace.”

source: Hitichun ahungun, khopi kotngahpa chu akouvun, ahenga, Syria miho gebuh-a kagacheuvin, chule vetan, chua chun mi koimacha aumpon, mi awjong akijapon, ahinla sakol ho, sanganho akihennin, pon inho chu abang bangin aume, atiuve.
target: So they went and called out to the city gatekeepers and told them, “We went into the Aramean camp and no one was there—not a sound of anyone—only tethered horses and donkeys, and the tents left just as they were.”

source: Chuin aman kotngah ho chu akouvin, chuin amahon leng insunga miho chu ahilun ahi.
target: The gatekeepers shouted the news, and it was reported within the palace.

source: Chuin lengpa chu ajanin athouvin, asohte henga, tun keiman Syria miten ichunguva ipi abolem navetsah uvinge, eiho igilkel uve tihi ahetnuva; hijeh-a chu agebuh uva kona chu gamlah-a kiseldinga potdoh uva, amaho khopi-a kona ahungdoh tengule ahingin man-u hitin, khopi sunga lutnu hite atiu ahi, ati.
target: The king got up in the night and said to his officers, “I will tell you what the Arameans have done to us. They know we are starving; so they have left the camp to hide in the countryside, thinking, ‘They will surely come out, and then we will take them alive and get into the city.’ ”

source: Chuin asohte lah-a khatnin adonbutnin, nahenga katao ahi, khopi sunga sakol umsun lah-a ngahi mi phabep gakaisah-in, (vetan, amahohi akidalha Israel mipi ho jouse tobang ahiuvin; vetan, amaho Israel mipi athigam saho tobang ahiuve:) hijeh chun amaho solu hitin, vetem uhite kati-e, ati.
target: One of his officers answered, “Have some men take five of the horses that are left in the city. Their plight will be like that of all the Israelites left here—yes, they will only be like all these Israelites who are doomed. So let us send them to find out what happened.”

source: Hijeh chun amahon sakol kangtalai ni alauvin; chule lengpan Syria janelho nunga mi asolin, cheovinlang gaveovin, ati.
target: So they selected two chariots with their horses, and the king sent them after the Aramean army. He commanded the drivers, “Go and find out what has happened.”

source: Chuin amaho Jordan lama amaho nunglama acheule; veuvin, lampi jouse chun Syria miten akino nalam uva apaiju um le bel chule ponsil adimsetnin ahi. Chuin thupo ho akileuvin lengpa ahiltaove.
target: They followed them as far as the Jordan, and they found the whole road strewn with the clothing and equipment the Arameans had thrown away in their headlong flight. So the messengers returned and reported to the king.

source: Chuin mipi apotdoh-un, Syria mite ponbuh chu achom taove. Hitichun Pakai thu dungjuijin, changbong nel tena dim khat sekel khat manin akijoh-in, chule sakol chang tena ni chu sekel khat manin akijohtan ahi.
target: Then the people went out and plundered the camp of the Arameans. So a seah of the finest flour sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley sold for a shekel, as the Lord had said.

source: Chuin lengpan kingaina milenpa chu kul kotpi ngah-in apansah-in ahi. Ahenga lengpa ahung kumsuh laija, Pathen mipan anasei bangin, amapa chu mipin kotphunga ana chotphaovin, athitai.
target: Now the king had put the officer on whose arm he leaned in charge of the gate, and the people trampled him in the gateway, and he died, just as the man of God had foretold when the king came down to his house.

source: Chuin Pathen mipan lengpa henga anasei, jingle tuphat vela Samaria kotbula sakol chang tena dimni sekel khat manna kijoh-a, chule changbong nel tena dimkhat sekel khat manna kijoh ding ahi, atia;
target: It happened as the man of God had said to the king: “About this time tomorrow, a seah of the finest flour will sell for a shekel and two seahs of barley for a shekel at the gate of Samaria.”

source: Chule pipui pan, vetan, Pakaiyin van'a bangkot ahonding hijongle, hichu hitheidi hinam? tia ana donbutna; Elisha'n, ven, nangman hiche chu namitna namu ding, nehvang naneh louding ahi, tia anasei ahi.
target: The officer had said to the man of God, “Look, even if the Lord should open the floodgates of the heavens, could this happen?” The man of God had replied, “You will see it with your own eyes, but you will not eat any of it!”

source: Hitobang chun ama chunga achutai. Ajehchu mipin kotpiphunga achotphaovin, ama athitan ahi.
target: And that is exactly what happened to him, for the people trampled him in the gateway, and he died.

source: Chuin Elisha'n achapa adamsah numei henga chun, kipatdoh-in, nangma le na-insung mite naumthei theina dinguvin, napem nathei chanun gapemun; ajehchu gamsunga Pakaiyin kumsagi jen kel alhahsah ding ahi, ati.
target: Now Elisha had said to the woman whose son he had restored to life, “Go away with your family and stay for a while wherever you can, because the Lord has decreed a famine in the land that will last seven years.”

source: Chuin Pathen mipan asei dungjuijin, numei chu akipat doh-in; a-insung mite toh acheuvin Philistine gama chun kumsagi agapemun ahi.
target: The woman proceeded to do as the man of God said. She and her family went away and stayed in the land of the Philistines seven years.

source: Chuin kumsagi kichai chun ahitin ahi, numeinu chu Philistine'a konin ahungkile kitnin, lengpa henga a-inle alou ngeh dingin agachen ahi.
target: At the end of the seven years she came back from the land of the Philistines and went to appeal to the king for her house and land.

source: Chule lengpan Pathen mipa soh Gehazi ana kihoulim pin, katao ahi, Elisha thilbol loupiho jouse chu neihilin, atin ahi.
target: The king was talking to Gehazi, the servant of the man of God, and had said, “Tell me about all the great things Elisha has done.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, mithisa khat ahinsahkit asei laitah chun, veuvin, achapa kihinsahkit numeinu chu lengpa henga a-in le lou ngehnan ahung taovin ahi. Chuin Gehazi'n, ka pakai, vo lengpa, hichehi Elisha'n ahinsah numeinu le achapa chu ahi, ati.
target: Just as Gehazi was telling the king how Elisha had restored the dead to life, the woman whose son Elisha had brought back to life came to appeal to the king for her house and land. Gehazi said, “This is the woman, my lord the king, and this is her son whom Elisha restored to life.”

source: Chuin lengpan numeinu chu adongin ahile, amanun aseipehtan ahi. Hitichun lengpan vaipo khat angansen, hiche numeinu-a jouse chu lepeh kitnin, chule gamsung adalhah nikho-a pat tuchan geija loujaova agaho jouse lepeh kit tan, ati.
target: The king asked the woman about it, and she told him. Then he assigned an official to her case and said to him, “Give back everything that belonged to her, including all the income from her land from the day she left the country until now.”

source: Chuin Elisha Damascus'ah ahungin; chule Syria lengpa Benhadad chu anadampon; ahenga, Pathen mipa chu hilama ahunge, ti aseipeh-un ahi.
target: Elisha went to Damascus, and Ben-Hadad king of Aram was ill. When the king was told, “The man of God has come all the way up here,”

source: Chuin lengpan Hazael jah-a, thilpeh kenginlang Pathen mipa gakimupin, chule hiche kanatna-a kona hi kadamdoh kitding hinam? Pakai chu gadohsah temin, ati.
target: he said to Hazael, “Take a gift with you and go to meet the man of God. Consult the Lord through him; ask him, ‘Will I recover from this illness?’ ”

source: Hitichun ama kimupi din Hazael achen, thilpehdin Damascus'a konin thilpha tincheng sangongsao somli jen poh thil akengin, ahungin ama masanga adingin, nachapa Benhadad Syria lengpan nahenga eihinsolin, hiche natna-a kona hi kadamdoh kitding ham? atin ahi, ati.
target: Hazael went to meet Elisha, taking with him as a gift forty camel-loads of all the finest wares of Damascus. He went in and stood before him, and said, “Your son Ben-Hadad king of Aram has sent me to ask, ‘Will I recover from this illness?’ ”

source: Chuin Elisha'n ajah-a, thonlouva nadamdoh kitding ahi gatipeh-in: ahinla thitei teiding ahi ti Pakaiyin eimusahtai, ati.
target: Elisha answered, “Go and say to him, ‘You will certainly recover.’ Nevertheless, the Lord has revealed to me that he will in fact die.”

source: Chuin jachat umkhop leuvin amapa chu aven: chuin Pathen mipa chu akaptai.
target: He stared at him with a fixed gaze until Hazael was embarrassed. Then the man of God began to weep.

source: Chuin Hazael'in, kapu chu ibola kapjeng nahim? ati. Aman, Israel chate chunga thilse naboldingchu kahetjeh ahi; akuldetho halhan natin, agollhangho chemjamin thatnin natin, achateu chule anu oipi sunga umho jongchu nakhejalpeh ding ahi, tin adonbutne.
target: “Why is my lord weeping?” asked Hazael. “Because I know the harm you will do to the Israelites,” he answered. “You will set fire to their fortified places, kill their young men with the sword, dash their little children to the ground, and rip open their pregnant women.”

source: Chuin Hazael'in, nasoh keima hi uicha kahija, hitobang thil loupi chu katohthei ding hijaham? ati. Chuin Elisha'n, nangma Syria mite chunga leng nahiding Pakaiyin eimusah ahitai, ati.
target: Hazael said, “How could your servant, a mere dog, accomplish such a feat?” “The Lord has shown me that you will become king of Aram,” answered Elisha.

source: Hitichun ama Elisha'a konin apotnin, apu henga ahungtai. Aman ajah-a, Elisha'n nahenga ipi aseijem? ati. Chuin aman na damdoh teiding ahi, ti eiseipeh-e, tin adonbutnin ahi.
target: Then Hazael left Elisha and returned to his master. When Ben-Hadad asked, “What did Elisha say to you?” Hazael replied, “He told me that you would certainly recover.”

source: Chuin ajingin ahitin ahi, ponsatah khat alan twija adekotnin, amai akhunan ahile, hitichun athitan ahi. Chuin Hazael alengchang tai.
target: But the next day he took a thick cloth, soaked it in water and spread it over the king’s face, so that he died. Then Hazael succeeded him as king.

source: Chuin Israel leng Ahab chapa Jehoram lengchan kal kum ngana-in, Jehoshaphat chu Judah leng hija ahin, Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat chapa Jehoram chu ahung lengchang panin ahi.
target: In the fifth year of Joram son of Ahab king of Israel, when Jehoshaphat was king of Judah, Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat began his reign as king of Judah.

source: Ama alengchan patchun kum somthumle kum ni ahin, Jerusalem'a kumget aleng changin ahi.
target: He was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years.

source: Chule aman Ahab insung chonna bangin, Israel lengte lamlhah ajotnin ahi: ajehchu a-inneipi chu Ahab chanu hija ahin; Pakai mitmun thilse abolin ahi.
target: He followed the ways of the kings of Israel, as the house of Ahab had done, for he married a daughter of Ahab. He did evil in the eyes of the Lord .

source: Hijongle ama le achate henga meivah pehjing dinga ana thutep bangin, asoh David khohsahna jalchun Judah chu asumangpon ahi.
target: Nevertheless, for the sake of his servant David, the Lord was not willing to destroy Judah. He had promised to maintain a lamp for David and his descendants forever.

source: Ama nikho laijin Edom chu Judah khutnoija konin akiphinun, achunguva lengkhat akisem taove.
target: In the time of Jehoram, Edom rebelled against Judah and set up its own king.

source: Hijeh chun Joram kangtalai jousetoh Zair'a achetouvin ahi. Chuin ama jan-in athou doh-in, ama umkimvel Edom miho le gal lamkai kangtalai ho athatgamin; mipi ho chu aponbuh sunguva ajamlut gamtaove.
target: So Jehoram went to Zair with all his chariots. The Edomites surrounded him and his chariot commanders, but he rose up and broke through by night; his army, however, fled back home.

source: Ahinla Edom Judah khutnoija konin tuni geijin akiphinun ahi. Chuin hiche phat mama chun Libna jong akiphinin ahi.
target: To this day Edom has been in rebellion against Judah. Libnah revolted at the same time.

source: Chule Joram thilbol dangho jousele atoh jouse chu Judah lengte thusimbua kisun hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Jehoram’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

source: Chuin Joram apu apate toh alumkhomin, David khopi-a apu apate toh akivuitai. Chuin ama khelin achapa Ahaziah alengchang tai.
target: Jehoram rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David. And Ahaziah his son succeeded him as king.

source: Israel leng Ahab chapa Joram lengchan kal kum somle kumni na-in, Judah leng Jehoram chapa Ahaziah alengchang panne.
target: In the twelfth year of Joram son of Ahab king of Israel, Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.

source: Alengchan pat kumchun Ahaziah kum somni le kumni ahitai. Chuin ama Jerusalem'a kumkhat aleng changin ahi, chule anu minchu Athaliah ahin, Israel lengpa Omri chanu ahi.
target: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem one year. His mother’s name was Athaliah, a granddaughter of Omri king of Israel.

source: Chuin aman Ahab insung lamlhah ajotnin, Pakai mitmun Ahab insung bol bangin thilse abolin ahi. Ajehchu ama Ahab insung tupa hija ahi.
target: He followed the ways of the house of Ahab and did evil in the eyes of the Lord , as the house of Ahab had done, for he was related by marriage to Ahab’s family.

source: Chuin ama Ramoth-gilead'ah Syria lengpa Hazael kisatpi dingin Ahab chapa Joram toh achen; chuin Syria miten Joram amavo taove.
target: Ahaziah went with Joram son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth Gilead. The Arameans wounded Joram;

source: Chuin Joram lengpa chu Syria lengpa Hazael to akisat petnuva Ramah mun'a akimavona kijen dinga Jezreel lama akinungle tan ahi. Chuin Judah lengpa Jehoram chapa Ahaziah chu, Jezreel'a um Ahab chapa Joram anat jeh-a vedin achesuh-in ahi.
target: so King Joram returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds the Arameans had inflicted on him at Ramoth in his battle with Hazael king of Aram. Then Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to Jezreel to see Joram son of Ahab, because he had been wounded.

source: Chuin Elisha themgaovin themgao chate khat akouvin, ajah-a, natai kigah-in, chule nakhutnin hiche thaobom hi choijin lang Ramoth-gilead'a gache-in:
target: The prophet Elisha summoned a man from the company of the prophets and said to him, “Tuck your cloak into your belt, take this flask of olive oil with you and go to Ramoth Gilead.

source: Chukoma nagalhun teng, Nimshi chapa Jehoshaphat chapa Jehu chu holdoh inlang lutnin; chule asopite lah-a konin kipatdohsah inlang, indan sungnung khatna puilutnin:
target: When you get there, look for Jehu son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi. Go to him, get him away from his companions and take him into an inner room.

source: Chule thaobom chu lanlang aluchunga sungin, chule ajah-a, Pakaiyin Israelte chunga lengdinga thao kanu nahitai, atie, tin seijin. Chuteng kot honginlang jamin, chule khongai hih-in, ati.
target: Then take the flask and pour the oil on his head and declare, ‘This is what the Lord says: I anoint you king over Israel.’ Then open the door and run; don’t delay!”

source: Hitichun themgao gollhangpa chu Ramoth-gilead'a achetai.
target: So the young prophet went to Ramoth Gilead.

source: Chuin ahung lhunle, veuvin, janel gal lamkaiho chu ana toukhomun ahi; chuin aman, gal lamkaipa, nahenga thukhoh seiding kaneije, ati. Chuin Jehu'n koipen henga am? ati. Chuin aman, vo gallamkai, nangma henga, ati.
target: When he arrived, he found the army officers sitting together. “I have a message for you, commander,” he said. “For which of us?” asked Jehu. “For you, commander,” he replied.

source: Chuin ama akipatdoh-in, insunga alut tai; chuin aman aluchanga thaochu asungin, ajah-a, Israel Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, Pakai mipite Israelte chunga lengdinga thao kanu nahitai.
target: Jehu got up and went into the house. Then the prophet poured the oil on Jehu’s head and declared, “This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘I anoint you king over the Lord ’s people Israel.

source: Kasohte themgaoho thisanle Pakai sohte jouse thisan phuchu Jezebel khutna kalah theina dinga, Ahab insung mite chu natha gamhel ding ahi.
target: You are to destroy the house of Ahab your master, and I will avenge the blood of my servants the prophets and the blood of all the Lord ’s servants shed by Jezebel.

source: Ajehchu Ahab insung pumpi mangthah ding; Israel gamsunga Ahab'a kona cha pasal tapou chu, ongthol hihen akihen hijongle kasuhmang ding ahi.
target: The whole house of Ahab will perish. I will cut off from Ahab every last male in Israel—slave or free.

source: Chule Ahab insung chu Nebat chapa Jeroboam insung bangle, Ahijah chapa Baasha insung banga kasem ding ahi.
target: I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like the house of Baasha son of Ahijah.

source: Uicha hon Jezebel chu Jezreel kulpanga anehdiu, amanu vuiding koimacha umlou ding ahi, ati. Chuin kot ahongin ajamtai.
target: As for Jezebel, dogs will devour her on the plot of ground at Jezreel, and no one will bury her.’ ” Then he opened the door and ran.

source: Hitichun Jehu chu apu sohte henga ahungdohtan; chuin mikhatnin ajah-a, ijakai phasohnam? ibola mi ngolpahi nahenga hunga ham? ati. Chuin aman ajah uvah, nahetsao mi hija, athusei jong nahetnu chula-em, ati.
target: When Jehu went out to his fellow officers, one of them asked him, “Is everything all right? Why did this maniac come to you?” “You know the man and the sort of things he says,” Jehu replied.

source: Chuin amahon, kahe pouve; tun neihilun atiuve. Chuin aman ahenguva, hiti hitihin kahenga thu aseijin, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Israelte chunga lengdinga thao kanu nahi, atie, ati.
target: “That’s not true!” they said. “Tell us.” Jehu said, “Here is what he told me: ‘This is what the Lord says: I anoint you king over Israel.’ ”

source: Chuin amaho amitakipmin aponu asutlhaloi chelun, kalbiho chungnung pena ama noija chun aphaovin; sumkon amutnun, Jehu alengchang tai, atiuve.
target: They quickly took their cloaks and spread them under him on the bare steps. Then they blew the trumpet and shouted, “Jehu is king!”

source: Hitichun Nimshi chapa Jehoshaphat chapa Jehu chun Joram dounan aguh-a thil agong pantan ahi. (Tun Joram, amale Israelte jousen, Syria lengpa Hazael jeh-a Ramoth-gilead chu ana ngatupmu ahi.
target: So Jehu son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi, conspired against Joram. (Now Joram and all Israel had been defending Ramoth Gilead against Hazael king of Aram,

source: Joram lengpa vangchu Syria leng Hazael toh akisat laija Syria leng miten amavo chu Jezreel kho-a kisudam dinga kilekit ahitai.) Chuin Jehu'n, pha nasah ule koimacha Jezreel langa hiche thusei dingin potdohsah hih-un, ahiloule jam dohsah hihhelun, ati.
target: but King Joram had returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds the Arameans had inflicted on him in the battle with Hazael king of Aram.) Jehu said, “If you desire to make me king, don’t let anyone slip out of the city to go and tell the news in Jezreel.”

source: Hitichun Jehu chu kangtalai ja atouvin, Jezreel lama chun achetan ahi; ajehchu chukoma Joram uma ahin, chule Judah lengpa Ahaziah chu Joram vedinga hungsuh-a ahi.
target: Then he got into his chariot and rode to Jezreel, because Joram was resting there and Ahaziah king of Judah had gone down to see him.

source: Chuin Jezreel insung chunga chun khongah khat adingin, amachun Jehu loiho hungchu amulhin, mihon khat kamui, ati. Chuin Joram'in, amaho kimupi din sakol toumi solinlang, chamna thu hinam? gatisah-in, ati.
target: When the lookout standing on the tower in Jezreel saw Jehu’s troops approaching, he called out, “I see some troops coming.” “Get a horseman,” Joram ordered. “Send him to meet them and ask, ‘Do you come in peace?’ ”

source: Hitichun mikhat akimupidin sakol chunga atouvin achen, lengpan chamna thu hinam? atie agati. Chuin Jehu'n chamna iding natiham? kanunglama chen, ati. Chuin khongahpa chun aseijin, thupolepa chu ahenguva achen, ahinla ahungkile tapoi, ati.
target: The horseman rode off to meet Jehu and said, “This is what the king says: ‘Do you come in peace?’ ” “What do you have to do with peace?” Jehu replied. “Fall in behind me.” The lookout reported, “The messenger has reached them, but he isn’t coming back.”

source: Chuin aman aniveinan michom dang khat sakol chunga asolkitnin, ahenguva ahunglhunin, lengpan chamna thu hinam? atie ati. Chuin Jehu'n adonbutnin, chamna iding natiham, kanung lama chen, ati.
target: So the king sent out a second horseman. When he came to them he said, “This is what the king says: ‘Do you come in peace?’ ” Jehu replied, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me.”

source: Chuin khongah pan, ama jong ahengu agalhungin, ahinla ahung kinungle kit tapoi: chule asakol tildan jong Nimshi chapa Jehu sakol tildan abange; ajehchu hamvevun atil jenge, ati.
target: The lookout reported, “He has reached them, but he isn’t coming back either. The driving is like that of Jehu son of Nimshi—he drives like a maniac.”

source: Chuin Joram'in kigon, ati. Chuin akangtalai agotpeh taove. Chuin Israel leng Joram le Juda leng Ahaziah akangtalai gela atoulhonin, Jehu kimupi din akondoh lhonin, chule Jezreel mi Naboth honsunga akimuto pi lhontan ahi.
target: “Hitch up my chariot,” Joram ordered. And when it was hitched up, Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah rode out, each in his own chariot, to meet Jehu. They met him at the plot of ground that had belonged to Naboth the Jezreelite.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Joram'in Jehu amu phatnin chamna thu hinam, Jehu? ati. Chuin aman adonbutnin, nanu Jezebel jonthanhoina le doithu hijatpi hi aumlai se-a ipi chamna umthei dingham? atin ahi.
target: When Joram saw Jehu he asked, “Have you come in peace, Jehu?” “How can there be peace,” Jehu replied, “as long as all the idolatry and witchcraft of your mother Jezebel abound?”

source: Chuin Joram'in akhut aleheijin, ajam'in, chule Ahaziah jah-a, vo Ahaziah kiduha bolna aume, ati.
target: Joram turned about and fled, calling out to Ahaziah, “Treachery, Ahaziah!”

source: Chuin Jehu'n athanei chasunin thalpi chu aloijin, Joram dahteni kikahtah-a akapma ahile, athalmuh jumin aluchang adotpaijin, akangtalai chunga a-op dentai.
target: Then Jehu drew his bow and shot Joram between the shoulders. The arrow pierced his heart and he slumped down in his chariot.

source: Chujouvin Jehu'n agal lamkaipa Bidkar jah-a, along chu lanlang, Jezreel mi Naboth loulai mun'a seplhatan; ajehchu hiche hi geldoh-in, nangle kei apa Ahab nunga itoukhom laija, Pakaiyin hiche pohgih hi achunga anangap ahitai;
target: Jehu said to Bidkar, his chariot officer, “Pick him up and throw him on the field that belonged to Naboth the Jezreelite. Remember how you and I were riding together in chariots behind Ahab his father when the Lord spoke this prophecy against him:

source: Pakaiyin, tahbeh-in janhin Naboth thisanle achapate thisan kamu mong mongin; chule hiche mun mama-a hi kalethuh ding nahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Hijeh chun tun Pakai thu dungjuijin ama chu lanlang, hiche leiset munahin seplhan, ati.
target: ‘Yesterday I saw the blood of Naboth and the blood of his sons, declares the Lord , and I will surely make you pay for it on this plot of ground, declares the Lord .’ Now then, pick him up and throw him on that plot, in accordance with the word of the Lord .”

source: Ahin Judah lengpa Ahaziah chun hichu amuphatnin, hon inlampi lama ajamtan ahi. Chuin Jehu'n anung ajuijin, kangtalai ja chun amajong thatnun, ati. Chuin Ibleam khokenga Gur jot touna-a chun hitichun abol taovin ahi. Chuin ama Megiddo lama ajamin, hia chun athitai.
target: When Ahaziah king of Judah saw what had happened, he fled up the road to Beth Haggan. Jehu chased him, shouting, “Kill him too!” They wounded him in his chariot on the way up to Gur near Ibleam, but he escaped to Megiddo and died there.

source: Chuin asohten Jerusalem lama kangtalai khatna apouvin, David khopi-a apu apate toh lhana avuitaove.
target: His servants took him by chariot to Jerusalem and buried him with his ancestors in his tomb in the City of David.

source: Chuin Ahab chapa Joram lengchan kal kum kumsomle kumkhat na-a chu Ahaziah chu Judah te chunga ana lengchang pan ahi.
target: (In the eleventh year of Joram son of Ahab, Ahaziah had become king of Judah.)

source: Chuin Jezreel'a Jehu ahung phatnin, hichu Jezebel'in ajatan; amanun amai ajemin, asam akipo jolin, bangkotna konin ahinven ahi.
target: Then Jehu went to Jezreel. When Jezebel heard about it, she put on eye makeup, arranged her hair and looked out of a window.

source: Chuin Jehu kotpi-a alut tolhonin, amanun, apu thatpa Zimri'in chamna anei hinam? atin ahi.
target: As Jehu entered the gate, she asked, “Have you come in peace, you Zimri, you murderer of your master?”

source: Chuin Jehu bangkotlam ngan adahdoh-in, koiham keima lama pang? koiham? atin ahi. Chuin nukiso ni ham thum hamin ahin veuvin ahi.
target: He looked up at the window and called out, “Who is on my side? Who?” Two or three eunuchs looked down at him.

source: Chuin aman, amanu chu hinson lhaovin, ati. Chuin mahon ahin sonlhaovin ahile, athisan phabeppi bang le sakol ho chunga akithe thangin ahi. Chuin aman akengton anachilin ahi.
target: “Throw her down!” Jehu said. So they threw her down, and some of her blood spattered the wall and the horses as they trampled her underfoot.

source: Chuin ama alut phatnin, anen adon tan ahi. Chuin aman, cheovin, hiche sapset changnuhi gaveovin lang gavuijuvin; ajehchu amanuhi leng chanu khat ahi, ati.
target: Jehu went in and ate and drank. “Take care of that cursed woman,” he said, “and bury her, for she was a king’s daughter.”

source: Chuin amaho avui dingin ache taove; ahinla amahon alugu le akeng chule akhut phangho tailou adang amu tapouve.
target: But when they went out to bury her, they found nothing except her skull, her feet and her hands.

source: Hitichun amaho ahung kile kitnun, hichu ahung hetsah taove. Chuin aman, hichehi Pakaiyin asoh Tishbi mi Elijah'a kona anasei, Jezreel khomuna Jezebel phe uichaten anehdiu;
target: They went back and told Jehu, who said, “This is the word of the Lord that he spoke through his servant Elijah the Tishbite: On the plot of ground at Jezreel dogs will devour Jezebel’s flesh.

source: Chule koimachan, hilaija hin Jezebel akivuije atilouna dinguva, alongchu Jezreel gam loujaova eh tobang hiding ahi, tia anasei guilhuna ahi, ati.
target: Jezebel’s body will be like dung on the ground in the plot at Jezreel, so that no one will be able to say, ‘This is Jezebel.’ ”

source: Samaria'a chun Ahab'in chapa Somsagi aneijin ahi. Chuin Jehu'n Samaria'a Jezreel vaipoho, chule Ahab chate hinvah dohho henga chun lekha athotnin, hitin asune;
target: Now there were in Samaria seventy sons of the house of Ahab. So Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria: to the officials of Jezreel, to the elders and to the guardians of Ahab’s children. He said,

source: Tun hiche lekha hi nahengu ahunglhun lhunle, napupao chapate chu naheng uva uma, chule kangtalai ho, sakol ho, kulpi kium le galvon jong naneiju ahin,
target: “You have your master’s sons with you and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city and weapons. Now as soon as this letter reaches you,

source: Napu-u chapate lah-a aphapen veovin lang, apa laltouna chunga tousah-un, chule napu insung dingin gal sat uvin, ati.
target: choose the best and most worthy of your master’s sons and set him on his father’s throne. Then fight for your master’s house.”

source: Ahinla amaho akicha behset jengun, veuvin, amasanga leng nibon dingjou louva; eiho iti idinthei dinguham? atiuve.
target: But they were terrified and said, “If two kings could not resist him, how can we?”

source: Chuin leng insunga vaipopa, khopi chunga vaipopa, upaho jong, chule chapangho hinvah dohho nasan chun Jehu henga chun thu athotnun, keiho nasohte kahiuvin, nangin bolin neiti jouseu bolung ting; leng khatcha sem pouvinge: namitmu-a pha nasah chan boljengin, atiuvin ahi.
target: So the palace administrator, the city governor, the elders and the guardians sent this message to Jehu: “We are your servants and we will do anything you say. We will not appoint anyone as king; you do whatever you think best.”

source: Chujouvin aniveina-in lekha hitin asun kitnin, keima-a nahiuva, kathu nangai dinguva ahile, napupao chapate luchu hinlaovin lang jingle tuphat hin Jezreel'a kahenga hunguvin, tin asunin ahi. Tun leng chapate chu somsagi ahiuvin, ahin vahdoh-a khopi milen hotoh umngen ahiuve.
target: Then Jehu wrote them a second letter, saying, “If you are on my side and will obey me, take the heads of your master’s sons and come to me in Jezreel by this time tomorrow.” Now the royal princes, seventy of them, were with the leading men of the city, who were rearing them.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, lekha chu ahengu alhun phatnin, lengchapate chu amanun, asomsagi chun athatnun, alu chu boma akhumun, chule amahon hichu Jezreel'a athot taove.
target: When the letter arrived, these men took the princes and slaughtered all seventy of them. They put their heads in baskets and sent them to Jehu in Jezreel.

source: Chuin thangkou khat ahungin, amahon lengpa chapate lu ahinpo taove, tin amachu aseipeh-e. Chuin aman khopi lutna akhun lhuhnin lhu khomun lang, jingkah geijin umhen, ati.
target: When the messenger arrived, he told Jehu, “They have brought the heads of the princes.” Then Jehu ordered, “Put them in two piles at the entrance of the city gate until morning.”

source: Chuin jingkah-in ama apotdoh-in, adingin, mijouse jah-a chun, nangho michonpha nahiuve: veuvin, kapu chu ka changlhin kathat tai. Ahinla hicheho jousehi koitha ham?
target: The next morning Jehu went out. He stood before all the people and said, “You are innocent. It was I who conspired against my master and killed him, but who killed all these?

source: Pakaiyin Ahab mite chungthu asei Pakai thuchu halkhat chajong tolla lhamang louding ahi ti tuhin hechennun: ajehchu Pakaiyin asoh Elijah kama aseichu atohdoh ahitai, ati.
target: Know, then, that not a word the Lord has spoken against the house of Ahab will fail. The Lord has done what he announced through his servant Elijah.”

source: Hitichun Jehu'n Jezreel'a Ahab insung mi amoh jouse, amilenho jouse, chule asangkaiho, athempuho khatcha khenlou hela atha chai kahsen athatnin ahi.
target: So Jehu killed everyone in Jezreel who remained of the house of Ahab, as well as all his chief men, his close friends and his priests, leaving him no survivor.

source: Chuin ama akipatdoh-in achen, Samaria ahungtai. Chuin lamdunga kelngoimul vona in'a aumchun,
target: Jehu then set out and went toward Samaria. At Beth Eked of the Shepherds,

source: Jehu'n Judah lengpa Ahaziah sopiho amun, koi nahiuvem? ati. Chuin amahon keiho Ahaziah sopite kahiuvin; lengpa chate le lengnu chate chibai bohdinga chesuh kahiuve, tin adonbutnuve.
target: he met some relatives of Ahaziah king of Judah and asked, “Who are you?” They said, “We are relatives of Ahaziah, and we have come down to greet the families of the king and of the queen mother.”

source: Chuin aman ahingin man-un ati. Chuin amaho ahingin amanun, kelngoimul vona in kokhuh-a mi somlileni jen athatnun; amaho khatcha khen aneipoi.
target: “Take them alive!” he ordered. So they took them alive and slaughtered them by the well of Beth Eked—forty-two of them. He left no survivor.

source: Chuin chukom adalhah phatnin, Rechab chapa Jehonadab ama lamto-a hung amun: chuin chibai aboh-in, ajah-a, nachunga lungdih kaput banga hi lungdih naputnem, ati. Jehonadab'in kapu nai, ati. Achutile nakhut neihinpen, ati. Chuin akhut agahpen ahile, ama henga kangtalai chunga akai luttai.
target: After he left there, he came upon Jehonadab son of Rekab, who was on his way to meet him. Jehu greeted him and said, “Are you in accord with me, as I am with you?” “I am,” Jehonadab answered. “If so,” said Jehu, “give me your hand.” So he did, and Jehu helped him up into the chariot.

source: Chuin aman kahenga hungin lang Pakai dinga katompanje hungven, ati. Hitichun akangtalai chunga atousah taove.
target: Jehu said, “Come with me and see my zeal for the Lord .” Then he had him ride along in his chariot.

source: Chuin ama Samaria ahunglhun phatnin, Elijah henga Pakai thusei dungjuijin, Ahab insungmi Samaria umjouse chu asuhmanghel kahsen abonchan athat gamtan ahi.
target: When Jehu came to Samaria, he killed all who were left there of Ahab’s family; he destroyed them, according to the word of the Lord spoken to Elijah.

source: Chuin Jehu'n mijouse akoukhomin, ajah uvah, Ahab'in Baal chu anajen maimai ahin; Jehu'n vang aha jencheh ding ahi.
target: Then Jehu brought all the people together and said to them, “Ahab served Baal a little; Jehu will serve him much.

source: Hijeh chun tun Baal themgao jouse, asohte jouse, chule athempu jouseu kahenga hinkouvun; koima alhasam umlou helding ahi: ajehchu Baal henga ganlhaina loupitah kabolding ahin; aumlouchan chu kihinghoi louhel ding ahi, ati. Ahinla Jehu'in Baal houho thagam nadinga, doha thuhtah-a abol ahi.
target: Now summon all the prophets of Baal, all his servants and all his priests. See that no one is missing, because I am going to hold a great sacrifice for Baal. Anyone who fails to come will no longer live.” But Jehu was acting deceptively in order to destroy the servants of Baal.

source: Chuin Jehu'n Baal houna dingin khoppilen phongjalun, ati. Chuin amahon aphongjal letaovin ahi.
target: Jehu said, “Call an assembly in honor of Baal.” So they proclaimed it.

source: Chuin Jehu'n Israel pumpi thu athotnin; Baal houjouse ahungun, hitichun ahunglou mikhatcha jong aumpoi. Chuin amaho Baal insunga alutnun; Baal kotbula konin bangtom changei adimset jengun ahi.
target: Then he sent word throughout Israel, and all the servants of Baal came; not one stayed away. They crowded into the temple of Baal until it was full from one end to the other.

source: Hitichun kivonna pon hompa jah-a chun, Baal houho jousehi kivonna pon pecheh in, ati. Hitichun kivonna pon chu apecheh-in ahi.
target: And Jehu said to the keeper of the wardrobe, “Bring robes for all the servants of Baal.” So he brought out robes for them.

source: Chuin Jehu le Rechab chapa Jehonadab chu Baal insunga chun alutlhonin, chuin Baal houho jah-a chun, holun lang veleuvin, hiche-a hin Baal houho tailou Pakai mite jong umgetnunte, ati.
target: Then Jehu and Jehonadab son of Rekab went into the temple of Baal. Jehu said to the servants of Baal, “Look around and see that no one who serves the Lord is here with you—only servants of Baal.”

source: Chuin ganlhaina le govam thilto tohdinga alutphatnun, Jehu'n polama mi somget adinsah-in, ajah uva, nakhut uva kahinpuilut mikhattou ahoidoh auma, ajamdohsah aumle, ajamdohpa hinna khela aman ahinna achanding ahi, ati.
target: So they went in to make sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had posted eighty men outside with this warning: “If one of you lets any of the men I am placing in your hands escape, it will be your life for his life.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, aman govam thilto achai chaijin, Jehu'n avetuphole gal lamkaiho jah-a, lutnun lang thatnun; khatcha hung dohsah hih-un, ati. Chuin amaho chu chemjamin athatnun; chuin ngahtuple gal lamkaiho chun ahinleh doh-un, khopi-a Baal in'a chun acheuvin ahi.
target: As soon as Jehu had finished making the burnt offering, he ordered the guards and officers: “Go in and kill them; let no one escape.” So they cut them down with the sword. The guards and officers threw the bodies out and then entered the inner shrine of the temple of Baal.

source: Chuin Baal in'a konin milimho ahinpodoh-un, ahalvam taove.
target: They brought the sacred stone out of the temple of Baal and burned it.

source: Chuin Baal milim chu asuchimun, Baal in chu asulhuvin, tunigeijin ehbuh in aneijuve.
target: They demolished the sacred stone of Baal and tore down the temple of Baal, and people have used it for a latrine to this day.

source: Hitobang chun Jehu'n Israel lah-a konin Baal anasumang helin ahi.
target: So Jehu destroyed Baal worship in Israel.

source: Ahijeng vangin Bethel le Dan'a um sana bongnou lim asema, Israel chonset sahpa, Nebat chapa Jeroboam chonset naho-a konin Jehu chu akiheimang dehpon ahi.
target: However, he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit—the worship of the golden calves at Bethel and Dan.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Jehu jah-a, kamitmu-a thildih nabola, kalungsunga umho jouse dungjuija Ahab insung chunga nabolphat jeh-a, nachate khang li geija Israelte laltouna-a toudiu ahi, ati.
target: The Lord said to Jehu, “Because you have done well in accomplishing what is right in my eyes and have done to the house of Ahab all I had in mind to do, your descendants will sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation.”

source: Ahinla Jehu'n alungthim pumpi-a Israel Pakai Pathen dan thupeh-a chon ding chu akhohsahpon ahi; ajehchu Israelte chonsetsah Jeroboam chonset na-a konin akihei mangpon ahi.
target: Yet Jehu was not careful to keep the law of the Lord , the God of Israel, with all his heart. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam, which he had caused Israel to commit.

source: Hiche laichun Pakaiyin Israel gamsung chu asukeh pantan; Hazael'in Israel gamsung jouse ahinjou pehtan ahi.
target: In those days the Lord began to reduce the size of Israel. Hazael overpowered the Israelites throughout their territory

source: Jordan'a pat solamsang, Gilead gam jouse, Gad te, Reuben te, Manasseh te, Arnon vapidung panga Aroer kho-a pat Gilead le Basan geijin ahinlatan ahi.
target: east of the Jordan in all the land of Gilead (the region of Gad, Reuben and Manasseh), from Aroer by the Arnon Gorge through Gilead to Bashan.

source: Tun Jehu thilbol danghole anatoh jouse chu Israel lengte thusimbua kisunlut hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Jehu’s reign, all he did, and all his achievements, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

source: Chuin Jehu chu apu apate toh alumkhomin, amachu Samaria a avuitaove. Chuin achapa Jehoahaz ama khelin alengchang tan ahi.
target: Jehu rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son succeeded him as king.

source: Samaria'a Israelte chunga Jehu lengchan phatsung chu kum somni le kumget ahi.
target: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.

source: Chuin Ahaziah nu Athaliah'in achapa athi amuphatnin, akipatnin leng chilhah jouse asumangtai.
target: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she proceeded to destroy the whole royal family.

source: Ahinla Ahaziah sopinu, Joram lengpa chanu Jehosheba chun, Ahaziah chapa Joash chu leng chapate kithat ho lah-a konchun anagudoh-in; amale adon nutah chu Athaliah'a konin lupna indan sunga asel honin, hitichun amachu akithat tapoi.
target: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram and sister of Ahaziah, took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the royal princes, who were about to be murdered. She put him and his nurse in a bedroom to hide him from Athaliah; so he was not killed.

source: Chule amanu chutoh Pakai in'a kumget akisel lhone. Chule Athaliah chu hiche gama chun leng achangtan ahi.
target: He remained hidden with his nurse at the temple of the Lord for six years while Athaliah ruled the land.

source: Chuin kum sagina-a chun Jehoiada'in mi asolin, jakhat chunga vaihomho, gal lamkaiho le ngahtupho agakou sah-in, amaho chu Pakai insunga ama henga apuilutnin, amaho chu kitepna aneipin, Pakai insunga chun akihahsel sah-in, chule leng chapa chu amaho avetsah-in ahi.
target: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent for the commanders of units of a hundred, the Carites and the guards and had them brought to him at the temple of the Lord . He made a covenant with them and put them under oath at the temple of the Lord . Then he showed them the king’s son.

source: Chuin amaho chu thu apen, hichehi nabol dingu thil chu ahi; nalah uva choldoni-a hunglut ho chu hopthum-a hopkhatnin leng in chu ngah untin,
target: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you are to do: You who are in the three companies that are going on duty on the Sabbath—a third of you guarding the royal palace,

source: Chule hopthum-a hopkhat Sur kotpi-a umding, hopthum-a hopkhat ngatupna nunglam kotpi phunga umding: hiti achu in chu achimlhah louna dinga nangatup diu ahi.
target: a third at the Sur Gate, and a third at the gate behind the guard, who take turns guarding the temple—

source: Chule nangho choldoni-a potdoh ho jouse lah-a hopni chun, lengpa kimvela Pakai in chu angadiu ahi.
target: and you who are in the other two companies that normally go off Sabbath duty are all to guard the temple for the king.

source: Chule amitakipmin manchah akichoicheh-a, lengpa chu na-umkim veldiu ahi. Chule aki-um sunga hunglut lutchu nanatha diu, chule lengpa apotdoh le ahunglut nalhonpi jingdingu ahi, ati.
target: Station yourselves around the king, each of you with weapon in hand. Anyone who approaches your ranks is to be put to death. Stay close to the king wherever he goes.”

source: Chuin Jehoiada thempu thupeh dungjuijin, jakhat chunga gallamkai hochun abolun; chule amahon choldoni-a hunglut ding amite cheh-u, chule choldoni-a potdoh dingho chu ahinpuijun, Jehoiada thempu henga ahungcheh-un ahi.
target: The commanders of units of a hundred did just as Jehoiada the priest ordered. Each one took his men—those who were going on duty on the Sabbath and those who were going off duty—and came to Jehoiada the priest.

source: Chuin thempupan Pakai houin sunga um David lengpa tengcha ho le lumho chu sepai jakhat chunga gallamkai hochu apen ahi.
target: Then he gave the commanders the spears and shields that had belonged to King David and that were in the temple of the Lord .

source: Chuin ngahtupa le amitakipmin amanchah-u akhut cheh uva akichoijun lengpa akimvelun, houin ning jetlama pat houin ning veilam gei akigolun, houin le maicham lhon lhungin adingun ahi.
target: The guards, each with weapon in hand, stationed themselves around the king—near the altar and the temple, from the south side to the north side of the temple.

source: Chuin Jehoiada'in lengpa chapa chu ahinpui doh-in, Lallukhuh chu akhuhpeh-in, het tohsahna chu apen; chuin amahon amachu lengin atungun, thao anuvin; akhutnu abengun, Pathen'in lengpa huhhing hen atiuve.
target: Jehoiada brought out the king’s son and put the crown on him; he presented him with a copy of the covenant and proclaimed him king. They anointed him, and the people clapped their hands and shouted, “Long live the king!”

source: Chuin ngahtupho le mipi husa chu Athaliah'in ajah phatnin, Pakai in'a mipi ho lah-a chun ahunglut tan ahi.
target: When Athaliah heard the noise made by the guards and the people, she went to the people at the temple of the Lord .

source: Amanun agahven ahileh, veuvin, chonna ngaibangin sutpi phunga lengpa chu anadingin, pipuiho le sumkon mut ho lengpa koma chun adingun, gamsunga mipite jouse akipah-un, sumkon amutnuvin ahi. Chuin Athaliah'in apon abot eh-in, kidouna, kidouna tin apeng jah-in ahi.
target: She looked and there was the king, standing by the pillar, as the custom was. The officers and the trumpeters were beside the king, and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her robes and called out, “Treason! Treason!”

source: Ahinla jakhat chunga lamkaiho le sepai janel milenho chu Jehoiada thempupan thu apen, ajah uvah, ngahtupho kikah lah-a konin potdoh sah-un, chule amanu juitapou chu chemjamin thatnun, ati. Ajehchu thempupan, amanu chu Pakai houin sunga that hih-un ati ahi.
target: Jehoiada the priest ordered the commanders of units of a hundred, who were in charge of the troops: “Bring her out between the ranks and put to the sword anyone who follows her.” For the priest had said, “She must not be put to death in the temple of the Lord .”

source: Chuin amanu chunga khut alhaovin; amanu chu lengpa in'a sakol ho hunglutnaji lampia chun achen, chu-a chun amanu athat taove.
target: So they seized her as she reached the place where the horses enter the palace grounds, and there she was put to death.

source: Amaho chu Pakai mite ahitheina diuvin, Jehoiada'n Pakai le lengpa chule mipi kah-a kitepna asemin, leng le mipi kah-a jong chutichun aseme.
target: Jehoiada then made a covenant between the Lord and the king and people that they would be the Lord ’s people. He also made a covenant between the king and the people.

source: Chuin gamsung mijouse Baal insunga alutnun, asuchimun, maicham ho masanga chun Baal thempu Mattan chu athat taove. Chuin thempupan Pakai inpi chunga vaipo ding alhengin ahi.
target: All the people of the land went to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols to pieces and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars. Then Jehoiada the priest posted guards at the temple of the Lord .

source: Chuin jakhat chunga lamkaiho gal lamkaiho, ngahtuppa, chule gamsung mipite jouse apuijin; amahohin lengpa chu Pakai in'a konin ahinpuisuh-un, leng in ngahho kotpi lampi ahin houvin ahi. Chuin ama lengho laltouna-a atoutai.
target: He took with him the commanders of hundreds, the Carites, the guards and all the people of the land, and together they brought the king down from the temple of the Lord and went into the palace, entering by way of the gate of the guards. The king then took his place on the royal throne.

source: Chuin gamsung mipi jouse akipah-un, khopi chu athip chetnin; chule Athaliah chu lengpa inpanga chemjamin athatnun ahi.
target: All the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was calm, because Athaliah had been slain with the sword at the palace.

source: Jehoash alengchan patchun kum sagibou ahi.
target: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign.

source: Jehu lengchankal kumsagi na-in Jehoash alenchang panin; chule ama Jerusalem'a kum somli alengchange. Chule anu minchu Zibiah ahin, Beersheba mi ahi.
target: In the seventh year of Jehu, Joash became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother’s name was Zibiah; she was from Beersheba.

source: Chuin Jehoash chu Jehoiada thempun ahilchah bangin, ahinkho lhum keijin Pakai mitmu-a adihchu abol jingin ahi.
target: Joash did what was right in the eyes of the Lord all the years Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

source: Ahivangin munsang ho chu akiladohpon; munsang ho-a chun mipi ho chun ganlhaina le gimnamtui halna aneijing nalaijun ahi.
target: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.

source: Chuin Jehoash'in thempuho jah-a, Pakai insunga hinkipolutna akikat dohsa sum jouse, amitakipmin apeh dinga kitepeh dungjuija ato doh-u sum jouse, chule alungsunga Pakai insunga pohlutdinga akigelhah dungjuija atodoh sum jouse chu,
target: Joash said to the priests, “Collect all the money that is brought as sacred offerings to the temple of the Lord —the money collected in the census, the money received from personal vows and the money brought voluntarily to the temple.

source: Thempuhon hicheho chu lakhomu hen, mitinin amel hethouva konin lalutnu hen; chule houin selaiho, aselai kimuchanse chu semphat nan neiju hen, ati.
target: Let every priest receive the money from one of the treasurers, then use it to repair whatever damage is found in the temple.”

source: Ahinla ahitin ahi, Jehoash lengchan kum somni le kumthum lhinin thempuhon houin selaiho chu asempha pouvin ahi.
target: But by the twenty-third year of King Joash the priests still had not repaired the temple.

source: Chuin leng Jehoash'in Jehoiada thempu le thempu dangho akouvin, ajah uvah, ibola houin selaiho chu nasemphat lou uham? hijeh chun tun namel hethouva konin sum latahih-un, ahinla houin selaiho sempha dingho pedoh jengun, ati.
target: Therefore King Joash summoned Jehoiada the priest and the other priests and asked them, “Why aren’t you repairing the damage done to the temple? Take no more money from your treasurers, but hand it over for repairing the temple.”

source: Chuin thempuho chun miho-a kona sum lahtah loudingle amaho tah-in houin selaiho asemphat loudingu chu pha asaovin ahi.
target: The priests agreed that they would not collect any more money from the people and that they would not repair the temple themselves.

source: Ahivangin thempu Jehoiada'n thingkhong khat alan, asin agei vangin, Pakai in lutna jetlama maicham panga akoijin ahi. Hichea chun Pakai ina sum kichoilut jouse chu kotngah thempuho chun akoilutji jiuvin ahi.
target: Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid. He placed it beside the altar, on the right side as one enters the temple of the Lord . The priests who guarded the entrance put into the chest all the money that was brought to the temple of the Lord .

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, thingkhonga chun sum atamtai ti ahet tenguleh, lengpa lekha sunpa le thempu chungnung chu hungji-a, dipho-a akoijiuva, Pakai insunga kimu sum hochu asimjiu ahi.
target: Whenever they saw that there was a large amount of money in the chest, the royal secretary and the high priest came, counted the money that had been brought into the temple of the Lord and put it into bags.

source: Chutengle amaho asimsao sum chu natongho, Pakai insaho chunga vaipoho khutna apeh jiuva; amahon Pakai in bolna dinga natongho, thingthemho le insaho,
target: When the amount had been determined, they gave the money to the men appointed to supervise the work on the temple. With it they paid those who worked on the temple of the Lord —the carpenters and builders,

source: Chule songbol ho, song khengho, chule Pakai in selaiho semphatna dinga thing le song kikhengsa ho chohna dingle, chule angaicha ho jouse-a dinga apehjiu ahi.
target: the masons and stonecutters. They purchased timber and blocks of dressed stone for the repair of the temple of the Lord , and met all the other expenses of restoring the temple.

source: Ahijeng vangin Pakai insunga sum hungkichoilut chun Pakai in'a dingin dangka khonho, kong leh bel, twikongho, sumkon ho, sanabelho, dangka belho asemhih laijuve.
target: The money brought into the temple was not spent for making silver basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, trumpets or any other articles of gold or silver for the temple of the Lord ;

source: Ahinla natong miho henga apeuvin, hichu Pakai in semphatna-in amang chaovin ahi.
target: it was paid to the workers, who used it to repair the temple.

source: Chukal valin natongho hoppeh dinga akhutnuva sum apehlutna houchun tahsan umtah-a abol jeh-un, amaho chu avesuisam pouvin ahi.
target: They did not require an accounting from those to whom they gave the money to pay the workers, because they acted with complete honesty.

source: Pakai in'a chun suhkhelna sumho le chonsetna sumho chu achoilutji pouve. Hichu thempu ho-a ahi.
target: The money from the guilt offerings and sin offerings was not brought into the temple of the Lord ; it belonged to the priests.

source: Chujouvin Syria lengpa Hazael achetouvin, Gath agasatnin alatai. Chuin Hazael chu Jerusalem lam ngan achetoutai.
target: About this time Hazael king of Aram went up and attacked Gath and captured it. Then he turned to attack Jerusalem.

source: Chuin Juda lengpa Jehoash'in apu apate Judah lengho Jehoshaphat, Jehoram chule Ahaziah tehon anakatdoh-u thil thengho jouse, ama thilthengho jouse, chule Pakai in le lengpa in goukhol na-a kimu sana jouse chu alasoh keijin, Syria leng Hazael chu athotnin: chuin Jerusalem'a konin apotdohtai.
target: But Joash king of Judah took all the sacred objects dedicated by his predecessors—Jehoshaphat, Jehoram and Ahaziah, the kings of Judah—and the gifts he himself had dedicated and all the gold found in the treasuries of the temple of the Lord and of the royal palace, and he sent them to Hazael king of Aram, who then withdrew from Jerusalem.

source: Chuin Jehoash thilbol danghole anatoh jouse chu Judah lengte thusimbua kisun hilouham?
target: As for the other events of the reign of Joash, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

source: Chuin asohte akipat doh-un, achang lhiuvin, Jehoash chu Millo in'a Silla jotsuhna-a chun athat taove.
target: His officials conspired against him and assassinated him at Beth Millo, on the road down to Silla.

source: Ajehchu asoh teni, Shimeath chapa Jozachar le Shomer chapa Jehozabad chun avoh lhona, thia ahi. Chuin amahon David khopi-a apu apatetoh avuitha taove. Chuin achapa Amaziah ama khelin alengchang tai.
target: The officials who murdered him were Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer. He died and was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. And Amaziah his son succeeded him as king.

source: Judah leng Ahaziah chapa Joash lengchan kal kum somlethum lhin kum-in, Jehu chapa Jehoahaz chu Israelte chunga Samaria'a alengchang panin, kum somle kum sagi alengchange.
target: In the twenty-third year of Joash son of Ahaziah king of Judah, Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned seventeen years.

source: Chuin Pakai mitmun thil phaloutah abol jingin, Israelte chonset sahpa Nebat chapa Jeroboam chonsetna chu ajuijingin; chua konin akichoidohpoi.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord by following the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit, and he did not turn away from them.

source: Chuin Pakai lungsat chu Israelte chunga asoujah jengin, Syria lengpa Hazael khut le Hazael chapa Benhadad khutna ahinkho lhumkeijun apedoh tan ahi.
target: So the Lord ’s anger burned against Israel, and for a long time he kept them under the power of Hazael king of Aram and Ben-Hadad his son.

source: Chuin Jehoahaz'in Pakai henga ngehna aneijin, Pakaiyin angaipehtai. Ajehchu Syria lengpan amaho asuh genthei jeh-in, Israelte kisuh gentheina chu amupehtan ahi.
target: Then Jehoahaz sought the Lord ’s favor, and the Lord listened to him, for he saw how severely the king of Aram was oppressing Israel.

source: (Chuin Pakaiyin Israel chu huhhingpu khat ahinpen, hitichun amaho Syria mite khutnoija konin apotdoh taovin: Israel chate chu masanga bangin aponbuh uva acheng taove.
target: The Lord provided a deliverer for Israel, and they escaped from the power of Aram. So the Israelites lived in their own homes as they had before.

source: Ahijeng vangin Israel chonsetsah Jeroboam insung chonset na-a konin amaho ahaideh pouvin, hiche achun aumjinguvin; chule Samaria gama chun thingbom jong aumjing nalaijin ahi).
target: But they did not turn away from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, which he had caused Israel to commit; they continued in them. Also, the Asherah pole remained standing in Samaria.

source: Jehoahaz chun amite lah-a sakol chung toumi somnga toh, kangtalai somtoh, keng sepai sangsom tilou aneiding aphalpeh louvu ahi. Ajehchu Syria lengpan asuhmanghela, phola leivui banga asem ahitai.
target: Nothing had been left of the army of Jehoahaz except fifty horsemen, ten chariots and ten thousand foot soldiers, for the king of Aram had destroyed the rest and made them like the dust at threshing time.

source: Tun Jehoahaz thilbol dangho, anatohho jouse le athil bolthei naho chu Israel lengho thusimbua kisun hilouham?
target: As for the other events of the reign of Jehoahaz, all he did and his achievements, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

source: Chuin Jehoahaz chu apu apate toh alumkhomin, Samaria'a avuitaove. Chuin achapa Joash ama khelin alengchang tai.
target: Jehoahaz rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria. And Jehoash his son succeeded him as king.
