source: Chuin Judah lengpa Joash lengchan kal kum somthumle kum sagina-in, Jehoahaz chapa Jehoash chu Israelte chunga Samaria'a alengchang panin, kum somle kumgup alengchange.
target: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash son of Jehoahaz became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned sixteen years.

source: Chuin aman Pakai mitmu-a thilphalou anaboljin; Israelte anachonsetsah Nebat chapa Jeroboam chonset naho-a konin ana kikangsepon; hichea chun achon jingin ahi.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord and did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit; he continued in them.

source: Chule Joash thilbol danghole anatoh jouse, Judah leng Amaziah asatna athilbol theinaho chu Israel lengho thusimbua kisun hilouham?
target: As for the other events of the reign of Jehoash, all he did and his achievements, including his war against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

source: Chuin Joash chu apu apate toh alumkhomin, chuin Jeroboam chu alaltouna-a atoutai. Chuin Joash chu Samaria'a Israel lengho toh akivui khomtai.
target: Jehoash rested with his ancestors, and Jeroboam succeeded him on the throne. Jehoash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

source: Tun Elisha chu athipi khop hel ding natna-in ahung natan ahi. Chuin Israel lengpa Joash chu ahenga ahungsuh-in, amaichunga chun akapmin, vo hepa, hepa Israelte kangtalai le sakol touthemho, atin ahi.
target: Now Elisha had been suffering from the illness from which he died. Jehoash king of Israel went down to see him and wept over him. “My father! My father!” he cried. “The chariots and horsemen of Israel!”

source: Chuin Elisha'n ajah-a, thalpi le thalchang ho hinlan, ati. Chuin aman ahenga thalpi le thalchang ho ahinlatai.
target: Elisha said, “Get a bow and some arrows,” and he did so.

source: Chuin aman Israel lengpa jah-a, thalpi chunga chun nakhut koijin, ati. Chuin aman achunga akhut akoijin; chuin Elisha'n lengpa khut chunga chun akhut akoitai.
target: “Take the bow in your hands,” he said to the king of Israel. When he had taken it, Elisha put his hands on the king’s hands.

source: Chuin aman, solamsang bangkot hongtemin, ati. Chuin hichu ahongtai. Chuin Elisha'n, kapmin, ati. Chuin akaptai. Pakaiya kon huhdohna thalchang, Syria te-a kona huhdohna thalchang ahi. Ajehchu nangman Syria mite Aphek mun'a nasuh manghel kahse-a nasatding ahi, ati.
target: “Open the east window,” he said, and he opened it. “Shoot!” Elisha said, and he shot. “The Lord ’s arrow of victory, the arrow of victory over Aram!” Elisha declared. “You will completely destroy the Arameans at Aphek.”

source: Chuin aman, thalchang ho chu lan, ati. Chuin aman alatai. Chuin aman Israel lengpa jah-a, tolchu jepmin, ati. Chuin aman thumvei ajepmin, angatai.
target: Then he said, “Take the arrows,” and the king took them. Elisha told him, “Strike the ground.” He struck it three times and stopped.

source: Chuin Pathen mipa chu achunga alungsatan, ajah-a, ngavei, gupvei najep dingdol ahi; chutile Syria te chu nasuhmang hel kahse-a najep ding ahin; ahinla tun Syria te chu thumvei sehbou najoding ahitai, ati.
target: The man of God was angry with him and said, “You should have struck the ground five or six times; then you would have defeated Aram and completely destroyed it. But now you will defeat it only three times.”

source: Chuin Elisha athitan amahon avuitaove. Chuin kum hunglhung chun Moab miten ahon honin gamchu ahinsatnun ahi.
target: Elisha died and was buried. Now Moabite raiders used to enter the country every spring.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, mikhat vuiding agot laitah-un, vetan, amahon mihonpi khat amuvin; chuin mipa chu Elisha lhansunga alehlut taove. Chuin mipa chu akilelhah-a Elisha gu atohkhah phatnin, amachu ahingdoh-in, akengin adingdohtai.
target: Once while some Israelites were burying a man, suddenly they saw a band of raiders; so they threw the man’s body into Elisha’s tomb. When the body touched Elisha’s bones, the man came to life and stood up on his feet.

source: Ahin Syria lengpa Hazael chun Jehoahaz nikho pumpi chun Israelte asugentheijin ahi.
target: Hazael king of Aram oppressed Israel throughout the reign of Jehoahaz.

source: Ahivangin Pakaiyin Abraham, Isaac, Jacob henga athutep jeh-in amaho chu alungsetnin, achunguva lainatna aneijin, chule angaisah-in; asumang nompon, chujongle a-ansunga konin apaidoh nompon ahi.
target: But the Lord was gracious to them and had compassion and showed concern for them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. To this day he has been unwilling to destroy them or banish them from his presence.

source: Hitichun Syria lengpa Hazael chu athitai; chuin achapa Benhadad ama khelin alengchang tai.
target: Hazael king of Aram died, and Ben-Hadad his son succeeded him as king.

source: Apa Jehoahaz khutna kona gala aman analahdohsa khopiho chu, Jehoahaz chapa Jehoash'in Hazael chapa Benhadad khutna konin alakit tai. Amachu Joash'in thumvei ajouvin, Israelte khopiho chu alelah kit tai.
target: Then Jehoash son of Jehoahaz recaptured from Ben-Hadad son of Hazael the towns he had taken in battle from his father Jehoahaz. Three times Jehoash defeated him, and so he recovered the Israelite towns.

source: Israel leng Jehoahaz chapa Joash lengchan kal kumni na-in, Judah leng Joash chapa Amaziah ahung lengchange.
target: In the second year of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel, Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah began to reign.

source: Ama alengchan phatchun kum somni le nga ahitan, Jerusalem'a kum somni le kumko alengchange. Chule anu minchu Jehoaddan ahin, Jerusalem mi ahi.
target: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan; she was from Jerusalem.

source: Chule aman Pakai mitmun adihchu abolin, ahinla apa David bang ahi hihlaije: aman apa Joash boljouse chu anabolin ahi.
target: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , but not as his father David had done. In everything he followed the example of his father Joash.

source: Ahijeng vangin munsang ho chu akiladoh dehpon; munsang ho-a chun mipi ho chun ganlhaina le gimnamtui halna anei jiuvin ahi.
target: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.

source: Chuin ahung hitin ahi, lenggam chu ama khutna ahungdet detchun, apa lengpa anathat sohte chu ahin thatnin ahi.
target: After the kingdom was firmly in his grasp, he executed the officials who had murdered his father the king.

source: Ahinla Mosi Danbua, chate jeh-a pate thading ahipon, pate jeh-a jong chate thading ahipoi, ahinla amitakip ama ama chonsetna jeh-a kithat ding ahi, tia kisun Pakai danthupeh anakisunsa bangin; tolthat ho chate chu anathatpon ahi.
target: Yet he did not put the children of the assassins to death, in accordance with what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses where the Lord commanded: “Parents are not to be put to death for their children, nor children put to death for their parents; each will die for their own sin.”

source: Edom mite chu chi phaichama sangsom athatnin, Selah khochu galin alan, hiche minchu tunichan geijin Joktheel asah-un ahi.
target: He was the one who defeated ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt and captured Sela in battle, calling it Joktheel, the name it has to this day.

source: Chujouvin Amaziah chun Israel lengpa, Jehu chapa Jehoahaz chapa Jehoash henga mi thupole mi asolin, hungin kimaiton khatle khat kivehite, ati.
target: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, with the challenge: “Come, let us face each other in battle.”

source: Chuin Israel lengpa Jehoash'in Judah lengpa Amaziah henga, Lebanon'a um meithai seltho lingin Lebanon'a um Cedar jah-a, kachapa jiding nachanu neipen ati. Chuin hiche munachun Lebanon gamsa khat ahungin meithai seltholing chu achonlhu deltan ahi.
target: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah: “A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle underfoot.

source: Nangman Edom chu najo tahbeh ahin, chule nalungthim chu kichoisang ahitai. Hiche-a chun loupi inlang, in'a kiumthimin; ajehchu ipidinga nangin nalungthima nangmatah le Judah mite toh lhuhtha nading nangaito dingham? ti thu agah thottai.
target: You have indeed defeated Edom and now you are arrogant. Glory in your victory, but stay at home! Why ask for trouble and cause your own downfall and that of Judah also?”

source: Ahinla Amaziah chun ngaipeh-in aneipon ahi. Hijeh chun Israel lengpa Jehoash akontouvin, amale Judah lengpa Amaziah chu Judah gam Bethshemesh'a khatle khat akimaito lhontan ahi.
target: Amaziah, however, would not listen, so Jehoash king of Israel attacked. He and Amaziah king of Judah faced each other at Beth Shemesh in Judah.

source: Chuin Israelte masanga chun Judah chu amaimoh taovin; hichun mitin aponbuh lam cheh-a ajamtaove.
target: Judah was routed by Israel, and every man fled to his home.

source: Chuin Israel lengpa Jehoash'in, Ahaziah chapa Jehoash chapa Amaziah Judah lengpa chu Bethshemesh'a amanin, chule Jerusalem'a ahungin, Jerusalem kulpi chu Ephraim kotpi apat aninglama kotpigei tong jalijen asuchimin ahi.
target: Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh. Then Jehoash went to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate—a section about four hundred cubits long.

source: Chuin Pakai inle leng in'a gou kholkhom na-a kimu sana le dangka jouse, chule um le bel manchah jouse alan, Samaria'a akiletai.
target: He took all the gold and silver and all the articles found in the temple of the Lord and in the treasuries of the royal palace. He also took hostages and returned to Samaria.

source: Tun Jehoash'in atohdoh athilbol dangho jouse le athilbol theina, chule Judah leng Amaziah asatdanho chu Israel lengte thusimbua kisunlutna hilouham?
target: As for the other events of the reign of Jehoash, what he did and his achievements, including his war against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

source: Chuin Jehoash chu apu apate toh alumkhomin, Israel lengte toh Samaria'a avuitaove; chuin achapa Jeroboam akhelin alengchang tan ahi.
target: Jehoash rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. And Jeroboam his son succeeded him as king.

source: Chuin Judah lengpa Joash chapa Amaziah chu, Israel leng Jehoahaz chapa Jehoash thinungin kum somle kum nga ahing nalaije.
target: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.

source: Chule Amaziah thilbol dangho chu Judah lengho thusimbua kisun hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Amaziah’s reign, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

source: Chule tun amahon ama dounan Jerusalem'a thilguh agongun; chuin ama Lachish lama ajamin, ahinla Lachish lama anunga mi asolun, hiche munachun athat taove.
target: They conspired against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish, but they sent men after him to Lachish and killed him there.

source: Chuin amahon sakol in ahinpouvin, David khopi Jerusalem'a apu apate toh avuitha taove.
target: He was brought back by horse and was buried in Jerusalem with his ancestors, in the City of David.

source: Chuin Judah mipite jousen kum somle kum gup lhingbep Azariah chu apuijun, apa Amaziah khelin alengchansah taove.
target: Then all the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.

source: Aman Elath kho chu asadoh-in, Judah gama aumsah kitnin, hiche jouchun lengpa chu apu apate toh alumkhom tai.
target: He was the one who rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah after Amaziah rested with his ancestors.

source: Judah leng Joash chapa Amaziah lengchan kal kum somle kumnga alhinnin, Israel lengpa Joash chapa Jeroboam Samaria'a alengchang panin; kum somli le kum khat aleng changin ahi.
target: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam son of Jehoash king of Israel became king in Samaria, and he reigned forty-one years.

source: Chuin Pakai mitmun thilse abolin, Israelte chonsetsah Nebat chapa Jeroboam chonsetna jouse-a konin akikangse pon ahi.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord and did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.

source: Pakai Israel Pathen'in Gath-hepher'a um Amittai chapa asoh themgao Jonah khutna athusei bangin, Hamath lutna-a kona phaicham luipi geijin Israel gamchu alelah kit tai.
target: He was the one who restored the boundaries of Israel from Lebo Hamath to the Dead Sea, in accordance with the word of the Lord , the God of Israel, spoken through his servant Jonah son of Amittai, the prophet from Gath Hepher.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin Israelte nasatah-a athohgimnao chu amun; ajehchu akihen oh-a hihen, akilha onga hile Israelte kithopi ding koimacha aumlou amun ahi.
target: The Lord had seen how bitterly everyone in Israel, whether slave or free, was suffering; there was no one to help them.

source: Pakaiyin Israelte minhi vannoi'a kona asuhmang ding anaseipon; Joash chapa Jeroboam khutna konin amaho chu ahuhdohjon ahi.
target: And since the Lord had not said he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven, he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam son of Jehoash.

source: Tun Jeroboam thilbol danghole anatoh jouse, chule athilbol theina, agal boldan, chule aman tumasanga Judah te chan anahijing Damascus le Hamath kho Israelte dia ahin lelahlut thuho hi Israel lengte thusimbua kisunlut hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Jeroboam’s reign, all he did, and his military achievements, including how he recovered for Israel both Damascus and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

source: Chuin Jeroboam chu apu apate, Israel lengte ngeitoh analum khomin; chule achapa Zekeriah ama khelin alengchang tan ahi.
target: Jeroboam rested with his ancestors, the kings of Israel. And Zechariah his son succeeded him as king.

source: Israel leng Jeroboam lengchan kal kum somni le kum sagina-in, Judah leng Amaziah chapa Azariah alenchang panin ahi.
target: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign.

source: Alengchan patchun kum somle kumgup ahin, Jerusalem'a kum somnga le kumni alengchange; chule anu minchu Jecholiah ahin, Jerusalem mi ahi.
target: He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother’s name was Jekoliah; she was from Jerusalem.

source: Chuin aman apa Amaziah boljouse dungjuijin Pakai mitmu-a adih chu abolin,
target: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father Amaziah had done.

source: Munsang ho-a bouchu achonmang dehpon; mihon munsang ho-a chun ganlhaina le gimnamtui hal aboljing nalai uve.
target: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin lengpa chu adengin, hitichun athi nikho geijin aphah-in, intumbeh-a achengtai. Chule leng chapa Jotham chu gamsung mite vaihomin insunglam vaipon apangtai.
target: The Lord afflicted the king with leprosy until the day he died, and he lived in a separate house. Jotham the king’s son had charge of the palace and governed the people of the land.

source: Chule Azariah thilbol danghole anatohho jouse chu Judah lengte thusimbu kisutlutna-a kisunlutna hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Azariah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

source: Hitichun Azariah apu apate toh alumkhomin, chule amahon David khopi-a apu apate toh avuitaove. Chuin ama khelin achapa Jotham alengchang tai.
target: Azariah rested with his ancestors and was buried near them in the City of David. And Jotham his son succeeded him as king.

source: Judah lengpa Zakariah lengchankal kum somthumle kum get lhin na-in, Jeroboam chapa Zakariah chu Israelte chunga Samaria'a lhagup alengchange.
target: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned six months.

source: Chule apu apate bolbangin Pakai mitmun dihloutah abol jingin, Israelte chonsetsah-a Nebat chapa Jeroboam chonset naho-a konin akiheimang dehpoi.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , as his predecessors had done. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.

source: Chuin Jabesh chapa Shallum'in ama douna-in thilguh agongin, miho anga ajepmin, athatnin, akhelin alengchang tai.
target: Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against Zechariah. He attacked him in front of the people, assassinated him and succeeded him as king.

source: Chule Zakariah thilbol dangho chu vetan Israel lengte thusimbu sunga akisunin ahi.
target: The other events of Zechariah’s reign are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.

source: Hichehi Jehu henga Pakaiyin thu aseichu ahin, Nachapate chu Israelte laltouna-a khangli geija toudiu ahi tin aseije. Chuin hitichun aguilhung tan ahi.
target: So the word of the Lord spoken to Jehu was fulfilled: “Your descendants will sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation.”

source: Juda lengpa Uzziah lengchan kal kum somthumle kumko lhin kum-in, Jabesh chapa Shallum chu alengchang panin, Samaria'a lhakhat lhingset alengchange.
target: Shallum son of Jabesh became king in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned in Samaria one month.

source: Ajehchu Gadi chapa Menahem chu Tirzah'a konin achetouvin, Samaria'a ahungin, Samaria'a Jabesh chapa Shaallum chu avon, athatnin, ama khelin alengchang tai.
target: Then Menahem son of Gadi went from Tirzah up to Samaria. He attacked Shallum son of Jabesh in Samaria, assassinated him and succeeded him as king.

source: Chule Shallum thilbol danghole ama thilguh gonho chu, veuvin, Israel lengte thusimbu sunga akisunlut tan ahi.
target: The other events of Shallum’s reign, and the conspiracy he led, are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.

source: Chuin Menahem'in Tirzah le asunga umjouse, chule agamsung chu Tirzah'a patnin asatnin ahi. Ajehchu ama henga akipehlut loujeh uva asat ahin, chule chuche sunga um numei naovop jouse chu agai akhepeh-in ahi.
target: At that time Menahem, starting out from Tirzah, attacked Tiphsah and everyone in the city and its vicinity, because they refused to open their gates. He sacked Tiphsah and ripped open all the pregnant women.

source: Judah leng Azariah lengchan kal kum somthumle kum ko na-in, Gadi chapa Menahem Israelte chunga ahung lengchang panin, Samaria'a kum som alengchange.
target: In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem son of Gadi became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria ten years.

source: Chule aman Pakai mitmun thilse abol jingin, Israelte chonsetsah Nebat chapa Jeroboam chonset na-a konin ahinkho lhumkeijin akihei mangpon ahi.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord . During his entire reign he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.

source: Chuin Assyria leng Pul chu agamu dounan ahungkonin; chule Menahem'in lenggam chu akhutna suhdet ahina dinga akhut chun aumpina dingin, Pul chu dangka talent sangkhat apen ahi.
target: Then Pul king of Assyria invaded the land, and Menahem gave him a thousand talents of silver to gain his support and strengthen his own hold on the kingdom.

source: Chuin Menahem'in Israelte mihaoho sum jouse chu, mikhat khatna dangka shekel somnga cheh Assyria lengpa pehdingin adongin ahi. Hitichun Assyria lengpa akinunglen gamsunga aumdenpoi.
target: Menahem exacted this money from Israel. Every wealthy person had to contribute fifty shekels of silver to be given to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria withdrew and stayed in the land no longer.

source: Chuin Menahem thilbol danghole atoh jouse chu Israel lengho thusimbua kisun hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Menahem’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

source: Chuin Menahem chu apu apate toh alum khomin, ama khelin achapa Pekahiah alengchang tai.
target: Menahem rested with his ancestors. And Pekahiah his son succeeded him as king.

source: Judah lengpa Azariah lengchan kal kum somnga na-in, Menahem chapa Pekahiah chu Israelte chunga Samaria'a aleng changin, kumni lengvai apon ahi.
target: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah son of Menahem became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned two years.

source: Chule Pakai mitmun thilse abol jingin, Israelte chonsetsah Nebat chapa Jeroboam chonset naho-a konin akikangsepoi.
target: Pekahiah did evil in the eyes of the Lord . He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.

source: Chuin agal lamkai Remaliah chapa Pekah chun guhthimin thilgon aneijin, Samaria leng inpi sunga Argob le Arieh chule akiloipi Gilead mi somnga chutoh avouvin; chule athatnin, a-indan sunga alengchang tai.
target: One of his chief officers, Pekah son of Remaliah, conspired against him. Taking fifty men of Gilead with him, he assassinated Pekahiah, along with Argob and Arieh, in the citadel of the royal palace at Samaria. So Pekah killed Pekahiah and succeeded him as king.

source: Chule veuvin Pekahiah thilbol danghole atoh jouse chu Israel lengte thusimbua akisunlut cheh-e.
target: The other events of Pekahiah’s reign, and all he did, are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.

source: Judah leng Azariah lengchankal kum somnga le kum ni kum-in, Remaliah chapa Pekah chu Israelte chunga Samaria'a alengchang panin, kum somni alengchange.
target: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah son of Remaliah became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned twenty years.

source: Chule aman Pakai mitmu-a aphalou chu abol jingin, Israelte chonsetsah Nebat chapa Jeroboam chonset naho-a konin akikangsepoi.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord . He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.

source: Israel leng Pekah lallaijin, Assyria leng Tiglath-pileser ahungin Ijon, Abel-beth-maachah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, Galilee, chule Naphtali gam pumpi alan, Assyria gama amaho chu gal hingin akaitai.
target: In the time of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maakah, Janoah, Kedesh and Hazor. He took Gilead and Galilee, including all the land of Naphtali, and deported the people to Assyria.

source: Chuin Elah chapa Hoshea chu Remaliah chapa Pekah dounan guhthimin thilgon aneijin, asatnin, athatnin; Uzziah chapa Jotham lengchan kal kum somni na-a chun akhelin alengchang tai.
target: Then Hoshea son of Elah conspired against Pekah son of Remaliah. He attacked and assassinated him, and then succeeded him as king in the twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah.

source: Chule Pekah thilbol danghole atohjouse, veuvin, hicheho chu Israel lengte thusimbua kisunlutna ahi.
target: As for the other events of Pekah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

source: Israel lengpa Remaliah chapa Pekah lengchankal kumni na-in, Judah leng Uzziah chapa Jotham chu alengchang pantai.
target: In the second year of Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign.

source: Alengchan patchun kum somni le kum nga ahitan, Jerusalem'a kum somle kumgup aleng changin ahi. Chule anu minchu Jerusha ahin, Zadok chanu ahi.
target: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. His mother’s name was Jerusha daughter of Zadok.

source: Hitichun aman Pakai mitmu-a adih chu abolin; aman apa Uzziah boljouse bangchun abolin ahi.
target: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father Uzziah had done.

source: Hitajongle munsang ho chu akiladohpon, miho chun munsang ho-a chun ganlhaile gimnamtui hal aboljing nalai uve. Aman Pakai in kotpi chungnung chu asan ahi.
target: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there. Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the temple of the Lord .

source: Tun Jotham thilbol danghole anatohho chu Judah lengho thusim kisutlutna lekhabua kusuna hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Jotham’s reign, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

source: Hiche laichun Pakaiyin Syria leng Rezin le Remaliah chapa Pekah chu Judah te doudin asol pantan ahi.
target: (In those days the Lord began to send Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah against Judah.)

source: Chuin Jotham chu apu apate toh alumkhom tan, chule apa David khopi-a apu apate toh akivuitha tai. Chule achapa Ahaz chu ama khelin ahung lengchangtai.
target: Jotham rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David, the city of his father. And Ahaz his son succeeded him as king.

source: Remaliah chapa Pekah lengchankal kum somle kum sagina-in, Judah lengpa Jotham chapa Ahaz chu alengchang panin ahi.
target: In the seventeenth year of Pekah son of Remaliah, Ahaz son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

source: Ahaz ahung lengchan patchun kum somni ahin, chule Jerusalem'a kum somle kum get vai apon, aman apa David bangin Pakai Pathen mitmun thildih abolpon ahi.
target: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. Unlike David his father, he did not do what was right in the eyes of the Lord his God.

source: Ahin Israel lengte lamlhah jouse chu ajotnin; chule Israel chate masanga kona Pakaiyin apaidoh Pathen helouhon abolu thet umtah dungjuijin, achapa chu meija aselutsah-in ahi.
target: He followed the ways of the kings of Israel and even sacrificed his son in the fire, engaging in the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.

source: Chule munsang ho le lhangho, chule thinghing jouse noija ganlhaina le gimnamtui ahaljin ahi.
target: He offered sacrifices and burned incense at the high places, on the hilltops and under every spreading tree.

source: Chuin Syria leng Rezin le Israel lengpa Remaliah chapa Pekah chu Jerusalem'a gal bolin ahungtou lhonin; chule Ahaz chu aumun, ahinla amachu ajoujou lhonpoi.
target: Then Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel marched up to fight against Jerusalem and besieged Ahaz, but they could not overpower him.

source: Hiche laichun Syria lengpa Rezin'in Elath chu Syria gamdin alelah-in, Judah te chu Elath'a konin adelmangin, Syria te chu Elath na ahungun tugeijin achenguve.
target: At that time, Rezin king of Aram recovered Elath for Aram by driving out the people of Judah. Edomites then moved into Elath and have lived there to this day.

source: Hijeh chun Ahaz'in Assyria lengpa Tiglath-pileser henga thupole asolin; keima nasoh le nachapa kahi; hungtouvin lang eidou dinga hungkipat doh-a Syria lengpa le Israel lengpa khutna konin neihuh doh-in, ati.
target: Ahaz sent messengers to say to Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria, “I am your servant and vassal. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Aram and of the king of Israel, who are attacking me.”

source: Chuin Ahaz'in Pakai in'a dangka le sana umjouse, chule leng in'a gou kholkhom na-a umjouse alan, Assyria lengpa chu thilmoh peh din athottai.
target: And Ahaz took the silver and gold found in the temple of the Lord and in the treasuries of the royal palace and sent it as a gift to the king of Assyria.

source: Chuin Assyria lengpa chun athu angai pehtai; ajehchu Assyria lengpa chu Damascus dounan achetouvin, alan, amite chu Kir gama gal hingin akaijin, Rezin chu athat tai.
target: The king of Assyria complied by attacking Damascus and capturing it. He deported its inhabitants to Kir and put Rezin to death.

source: Chuin Ahaz lengpa chun Assyria lengpa Tiglath-pileser chu kimupi ding Damascus'a achen, chule Damascus'a um maicham khat agamun ahi. Chule maicham lim le akisem dan, chule akigon bangtah chun, lengpan Uriah thempu agah thotnin ahi.
target: Then King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria. He saw an altar in Damascus and sent to Uriah the priest a sketch of the altar, with detailed plans for its construction.

source: Chuin Uriah thempu chun Ahaz lengpan Damascus'a kona ahinthot dungjui chun maicham asemin; hitichun Uriah thempupan Damascus'a kona leng Ahaz ahung kilekah-in anasem joutan ahi.
target: So Uriah the priest built an altar in accordance with all the plans that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus and finished it before King Ahaz returned.

source: Chuin Damascus'a kona lengpa ahung chun, lengpan maicham chu amun; chule maicham chu anailutnin, hichea chun thilto atohtai.
target: When the king came back from Damascus and saw the altar, he approached it and presented offerings on it.

source: Chuin aman govam thilto le anneh thilto ahalin, chule donding thilto alheijin, maicham chung chu chamna thiltoho thisan chu athe khumin ahi.
target: He offered up his burnt offering and grain offering, poured out his drink offering, and splashed the blood of his fellowship offerings against the altar.

source: Chuin houin maija kon, maicham thah le Pakai in kikah-a konin, Pakai masanga um sum-eng maicham jongchu aladoh-in, maicham sahlam panga chun akoitai.
target: As for the bronze altar that stood before the Lord , he brought it from the front of the temple—from between the new altar and the temple of the Lord —and put it on the north side of the new altar.

source: Chuin Ahaz lengpan Uriah thempu jah-a, maicham len chungahin jingkah govam thilto, nilhah anneh thilto, lengpa govam ganlhai, a-anneh thilto, chule gamsunga mijouse govam thilto, anneh thilto, chule dontho thilto toh-in; chule hiche chunga chun govam thilto thisan le kilhaina thilto jouse thisan chu thekhumin; sum-eng maicham vangchu keima houna ding ahi, tin athupeh-in ahi.
target: King Ahaz then gave these orders to Uriah the priest: “On the large new altar, offer the morning burnt offering and the evening grain offering, the king’s burnt offering and his grain offering, and the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their grain offering and their drink offering. Splash against this altar the blood of all the burnt offerings and sacrifices. But I will use the bronze altar for seeking guidance.”

source: Hitichun Uriah thempu chun Ahaz lengpa thupeh jouse dungjuijin aboltai.
target: And Uriah the priest did just as King Ahaz had ordered.

source: Chuin Ahaz lengpan agamgi geisihho chu akhin neovin, hicheho-a konchun kisilna kong chu achondoh-in, twidol chu anoija um sum-eng bongchal ho-a konin alalhan, songlhongnal chunga atungtai.
target: King Ahaz cut off the side panels and removed the basins from the movable stands. He removed the Sea from the bronze bulls that supported it and set it on a stone base.

source: Chule houin sunga choldoni-a dinga pondal abolule, polama lengpa lutna chu Assyria lengpa jeh'in Pakai in'a konin atoldohtai.
target: He took away the Sabbath canopy that had been built at the temple and removed the royal entryway outside the temple of the Lord , in deference to the king of Assyria.

source: Tun Ahaz thilbol thusim dangho ama natohho chu Judah lengte thusimbu ho-a kisunlutna hilouham?
target: As for the other events of the reign of Ahaz, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

source: Chuin Ahaz apu apate toh alumkhomin, chule David khopi-a apu apate toh avui khomuve. Chuin achapa Hezekiah chu ama khelin alengchang tai.
target: Ahaz rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David. And Hezekiah his son succeeded him as king.

source: Judah lengpa Ahaz lengchan kal kumsomle kum ni na-in, Elah chapa Hoshea chu Israelte chung Samaria'a alengchang panin, kum ko alengchange.
target: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned nine years.

source: Chuin Pakai mitmu-a thilphalou chu anabolin, ama masanga Israel lengho tobang anahipon ahi.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , but not like the kings of Israel who preceded him.

source: Assyria lengpa Shalmaneser chu ama dounan ahung kontouvin; chule Hoshea chu asoh-in ahungpangin, thilpeh ho apen ahi.
target: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up to attack Hoshea, who had been Shalmaneser’s vassal and had paid him tribute.

source: Chuin Assyria lengpan Hoshea thilguh gonchu amudohtai: ajehchu aman Egypt lengpa So henga thu pole asolin, akumseh-a abolngai bangin Assyria lengpa henga thilpeh ahinpe tapon ahi. Hijeh chun Assyria lengpan songkul'a ahenin, akhachah khumtai.
target: But the king of Assyria discovered that Hoshea was a traitor, for he had sent envoys to So king of Egypt, and he no longer paid tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year. Therefore Shalmaneser seized him and put him in prison.

source: Chuin Assyria lengpan gamjouse ahin banchot touvin, Samaria'a achen, kumthum hel aum khumtai.
target: The king of Assyria invaded the entire land, marched against Samaria and laid siege to it for three years.

source: Hoshea lengchan kal kumko lhinkum chun Samaria alan, Israelte chu Assyria gama atol mangin, Gozan vadunglen pama Medes te khopiho Halah le Habor'ah aumsah taovin ahi.
target: In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria and deported the Israelites to Assyria. He settled them in Halah, in Gozan on the Habor River and in the towns of the Medes.

source: Ajehchu ana hitin ahi, Egypt gama konle Egypt lengpa Pharoah khutnoija kona ahinpuidoh uva, Pakai a-Pathen'u dounan achonse taovin, chule pathen dangho joh aging taovin,
target: All this took place because the Israelites had sinned against the Lord their God, who had brought them up out of Egypt from under the power of Pharaoh king of Egypt. They worshiped other gods

source: Amahon Israel chate masanga kona Pakaiyin ana nodohsa Pathen hephalouho, chule amahon akitun'u Israel leng teho chonnadan chu ajuijun, ahi.
target: and followed the practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before them, as well as the practices that the kings of Israel had introduced.

source: Chule Israel chaten Pakai a-Pathen'u dounan guhthimin adihlou thilho chu anabolun; chule akhopiho jouse-a, khongahpa insangho-a pat, kulnei khopi geijin munsang ho akisemun ahi.
target: The Israelites secretly did things against the Lord their God that were not right. From watchtower to fortified city they built themselves high places in all their towns.

source: Chule lhangsang jouse le thingphung hing jouse noija, milimho le thingbomho akitundoh-un,
target: They set up sacred stones and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every spreading tree.

source: Chule chua munsang ho jouse-a, Pakaiyin amasanguva kona apaidoh Pathen hephalouho bangin gimnamtui ahalun; Pakai lunghana sodohna dingin thilphalou agongun ahi.
target: At every high place they burned incense, as the nations whom the Lord had driven out before them had done. They did wicked things that aroused the Lord ’s anger.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin ahenguva, hitobanghi bolhih-un anati, milimho chu anajenun ahi.
target: They worshiped idols, though the Lord had said, “You shall not do this.”

source: Ahin Pakai chun themgao jousele mitvahneiho jouse-a konin, Israelte le Judah te douna chu ana phongdoh jin, ahenguva, nakhangitlou naova konin hung kiheijun lang, naheng uva kasohte themgaoho kahinsola, napateu henga kathupeh ho jouse dungjuijin, kachondanho le kathupeh ho nit uvin, anati jin ahi.
target: The Lord warned Israel and Judah through all his prophets and seers: “Turn from your evil ways. Observe my commands and decrees, in accordance with the entire Law that I commanded your ancestors to obey and that I delivered to you through my servants the prophets.”

source: Achuti vangin amahon angai hih-un, Pakai a-Pathen'u ana tahsan lou apu apateu ngong bangin, angongu ahamsah-un ahi.
target: But they would not listen and were as stiff-necked as their ancestors, who did not trust in the Lord their God.

source: Chule amahon apu apateu toh asemu achondanhou le akitepna, chule ahenguva athu hettohsah ho chu asandauvin; pannabei nungchu ajuijun, pannabei asoh-un, achung changuva Pakaiyin amaho bangin umhih-un anati, akimveluva Pathen hephalouho nung ajuijun ahi.
target: They rejected his decrees and the covenant he had made with their ancestors and the statutes he had warned them to keep. They followed worthless idols and themselves became worthless. They imitated the nations around them although the Lord had ordered them, “Do not do as they do.”

source: Chule Pakai a-Pathen'u thupeh jouse adalhaovin, akilhajol bongnou lim nitoh akisemun, thingbom akisemun, van janelpi ahouvun, Baal ajentaove.
target: They forsook all the commands of the Lord their God and made for themselves two idols cast in the shape of calves, and an Asherah pole. They bowed down to all the starry hosts, and they worshiped Baal.

source: Chule achapateule achanuteu mei apalsah-un, aisan le lhimna amangun, ama lungsat sah-a lung hansah nadin Pakai mitmun thilsetah boldingin akijoh doh-un ahi.
target: They sacrificed their sons and daughters in the fire. They practiced divination and sought omens and sold themselves to do evil in the eyes of the Lord , arousing his anger.

source: Hijeh chun Israelte chunga Pakai alunghang behsetnin, amuphahna louva achon mangin; Judah phung tailou khatcha akhen aumtapoi.
target: So the Lord was very angry with Israel and removed them from his presence. Only the tribe of Judah was left,

source: Judah jongchun a-Pakai Pathen'u thupeh chu anit tapon; ahinla Israel ten akisemu chondan kisema chun achontaove.
target: and even Judah did not keep the commands of the Lord their God. They followed the practices Israel had introduced.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Israel chilhah jouse chu adeitapon, asugentheijin, amitmua kona apaidoh kahsen michom mangho khutna chun apedohtan ahi.
target: Therefore the Lord rejected all the people of Israel; he afflicted them and gave them into the hands of plunderers, until he thrust them from his presence.

source: Ajehchu Israel chu David insunga konin abottelin, chule amahon Nebat chapa Jeroboam chu lengin asemun; chuin Jeroboam'in Israelte chu Pakai ajuijuva konin anomangin, amaho chu chonsetna lentah-in achonset sahtai.
target: When he tore Israel away from the house of David, they made Jeroboam son of Nebat their king. Jeroboam enticed Israel away from following the Lord and caused them to commit a great sin.

source: Ajehchu Israelte chu Jeroboam'in abol chonsetna jouse-a chun achonseuvin, hicheho-a konchun akiheimang theipouvin;
target: The Israelites persisted in all the sins of Jeroboam and did not turn away from them

source: Asohte themgaoho jouse kama anasei bangin, Pakaiyin amitmua kona achon manghel kahsen hicheho-a konchun akichoidoh pouve. Hitichun atolmangin tunigeijin achengden taove.
target: until the Lord removed them from his presence, as he had warned through all his servants the prophets. So the people of Israel were taken from their homeland into exile in Assyria, and they are still there.

source: Chuin Assyria lengpan Babylon'a kon, Cuthah'a kon, Ava'a kon, Hamath'a kon, chule Sepharvaim'a konin mi ahinpuijin; Israel chate khelin Samaria'a achensahtai. Amahon Samaria alovin, chua khopiho-a chun acheng taove.
target: The king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, Kuthah, Avva, Hamath and Sepharvaim and settled them in the towns of Samaria to replace the Israelites. They took over Samaria and lived in its towns.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, chua achentilu chun, Pakai chu aging pouvin; hijeh chun Pakaiyin alah uva keipi bahkai asollin, mi phabep athatnin ahi.
target: When they first lived there, they did not worship the Lord ; so he sent lions among them and they killed some of the people.

source: Hijeh chun amaho Assyria lengpa henga, nangman nachon doh-a, Samaria khopi-a nachensah nam mite hin, hichegam Pathen houdan ahepouve. Hijeh chun aman alah uva keipi bahkai ahinsolin, vetan, hiche gam Pathen houdan ahetlou jeh-un, amaho chu athat taove, atiuve.
target: It was reported to the king of Assyria: “The people you deported and resettled in the towns of Samaria do not know what the god of that country requires. He has sent lions among them, which are killing them off, because the people do not know what he requires.”

source: Chuin Assyria lengpan thu apen, khulama kona nahin puiho thempuho lah-a khat puijun lang; chule chua gacheng hen, chule chugam Pathen houdan chu amaho gahil hen, ati.
target: Then the king of Assyria gave this order: “Have one of the priests you took captive from Samaria go back to live there and teach the people what the god of the land requires.”

source: Chuin Samaria'a kona ahin puidoh hou lah-a thempu khat ahungin, Bethel'a achengin, amaho chu Pakai ginje ahiltan ahi.
target: So one of the priests who had been exiled from Samaria came to live in Bethel and taught them how to worship the Lord .

source: Hijongle namtinin ama amacheh pathen akisemun, Samaria ten akisemu munsang ho, inho, chule namtinin achennao khopiho-a hicheho chu akikoicheh uve.
target: Nevertheless, each national group made its own gods in the several towns where they settled, and set them up in the shrines the people of Samaria had made at the high places.

source: Chuin Babylon miten Succoth-benoth asemun, Kuth miten Nergal asemun, Hamath miten Ashima asemun,
target: The people from Babylon made Sukkoth Benoth, those from Kuthah made Nergal, and those from Hamath made Ashima;

source: Avi miten Nibhaz le Tartak semun, chule Sepharv miten achateu chu Sepharvaim pathenho Adram-melech le Anam-melech henga din meija agou jiuve.
target: the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire as sacrifices to Adrammelek and Anammelek, the gods of Sepharvaim.

source: Hitichun Pakai chu agingun, chule alah uva anempenho chu munsang ho-a thempun akisemun, munsang inho-a chun kilhaina aneijiuve.
target: They worshiped the Lord , but they also appointed all sorts of their own people to officiate for them as priests in the shrines at the high places.

source: Amahon Pakai chu agingun, chule chua kona apuimangu namho houdan dungjuijin, amaho pathenho chu ajen jiuvin ahi.
target: They worshiped the Lord , but they also served their own gods in accordance with the customs of the nations from which they had been brought.

source: Tumasanga aboldan bangun tulai geijin abolun; Pakai chu agingpouvin, aman Israel tia aminvo Jacob chateho chonna dan kisunle houdan thupeh ho, chule Pakaiyin apeh dan thupeh ho jongchu anitpouvin;
target: To this day they persist in their former practices. They neither worship the Lord nor adhere to the decrees and regulations, the laws and commands that the Lord gave the descendants of Jacob, whom he named Israel.

source: Amaho chutoh Pakaiyin kitepna asema, amaho chu athu lhah-a, nanghon pathen dangho naginloudiu, a-anguva jong nakunloudiu, jenjong najen loudiu, ahenguva jong naki lhai loudiu;
target: When the Lord made a covenant with the Israelites, he commanded them: “Do not worship any other gods or bow down to them, serve them or sacrifice to them.

source: Amavang thilboltheina nasatah le banjah puma Egypt gama kona napuidoh pao Pakai chu naginuva, nahou uva, ama hengabou kilhaina nabol dingu ahi.
target: But the Lord , who brought you up out of Egypt with mighty power and outstretched arm, is the one you must worship. To him you shall bow down and to him offer sacrifices.

source: Aman nangho dinga asut achondanho, houdanho, dan, chule danthupeh chu a-imatih chana chingthei tah-a nanit dingu; pathen dangho nagin loudingu ahi.
target: You must always be careful to keep the decrees and regulations, the laws and commands he wrote for you. Do not worship other gods.

source: Chule nangho toh kitepna kasemhi nasuhmil loudingu, pathen dangho jong nagin louhel dingu ahi.
target: Do not forget the covenant I have made with you, and do not worship other gods.

source: Ahinla Pakai na Pathen'u chu nagin dingu; aman namelma teu jouse khutna kona nahuhdoh dingu ahi, ati.
target: Rather, worship the Lord your God; it is he who will deliver you from the hand of all your enemies.”

source: Achutijeng vangin amahon angaideh pouvin, tumasanga aumdanu bou abol jingun ahi.
target: They would not listen, however, but persisted in their former practices.

source: Hitihin hiche nam mite hin Pakai chu agingun, amilim semthu chu apu apateu vin anajen bangun, achateu le achate chateuvin jong ajenun; hitichun tulai geihin abolun ahi.
target: Even while these people were worshiping the Lord , they were serving their idols. To this day their children and grandchildren continue to do as their ancestors did.

source: Tun ahitin ahi, Elah chapa Israel leng Hoshea lengchan kal kum thum na-in, Judah lengpa Ahaz chapa Hezekiah chu ahung lengchang panin ahi.
target: In the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Hezekiah son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

source: Ama alengchan patchun kum somni le kum nga ahin; chule ama Jerusalem'a kum somni le kum ko alengchange. Anu minchu Abi ahin, Zachariah chanu ahi.
target: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Abijah daughter of Zechariah.

source: Aman apa David'in anabol jouse dungjuijin, Pakai mitmun adih chu abolin ahi.
target: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father David had done.

source: Munsang ho chu achon mangin, milimho chu asubongin, thingbomho aphuh lhun, Mosi'n anasem sum-eng gul chu avobongsele; ajehchu hiche nikholai geija chu Israel chaten hiche henga chu gimnamtui ahaljiu ahin; chule aman hichu Nehushtan asah-e.
target: He removed the high places, smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles. He broke into pieces the bronze snake Moses had made, for up to that time the Israelites had been burning incense to it. (It was called Nehushtan.)

source: Aman Pakai Israel Pathen atahsanin; hitichun ama nungin Juda lengte jouse lah-a ama tobang aum tapon, ama masangin jong khatcha anaumpoi.
target: Hezekiah trusted in the Lord , the God of Israel. There was no one like him among all the kings of Judah, either before him or after him.

source: Ajehchu Pakai atuhchah-in, ama ajuija konin achemangpon, Pakaiyin Mosi anapeh thuho chu anit jingin ahi.
target: He held fast to the Lord and did not stop following him; he kept the commands the Lord had given Moses.

source: Chule Pakaiyin aumpin, achedohna lamjousea aphattheijin; Assyria lengpa dounan akiphinin, ama chu ajenpon ahi.
target: And the Lord was with him; he was successful in whatever he undertook. He rebelled against the king of Assyria and did not serve him.

source: Philistine te chu Gaza kho le agamgi chin gei, khongah ho insanga pat khopi kulnei geijin abantha gamin ahi.
target: From watchtower to fortified city, he defeated the Philistines, as far as Gaza and its territory.

source: Chuin Hezekiah lengchan kumli alhinin, Israel leng Elah chapa Hoshea kum sagi alengchan kum-in ahitin ahi. Assyria leng Shalmaneser chu Samaria satdin ahung kontouvin, Chule aum kultan ahi.
target: In King Hezekiah’s fourth year, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria marched against Samaria and laid siege to it.

source: Chuin kumthum kichaijin alataovin ahi: Hezekiah lengchan kal kum gup lhina, Israel lengpa Hoshea lengchankal kum ko na-in, Samaria chu lah-in aumtan ahi.
target: At the end of three years the Assyrians took it. So Samaria was captured in Hezekiah’s sixth year, which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel.

source: Chuin Assyria lengpan Israelte chu Assyria-a apuimangin, Halah'a Gozan vapi pama Habor chule Medes khopiho-a chun amahochu akoitan ahi.
target: The king of Assyria deported Israel to Assyria and settled them in Halah, in Gozan on the Habor River and in towns of the Medes.

source: Ajehchu amahon Pakai a-Pathen'u aw angaipouvin, akitepna le Pakai soh Mosi athupeh jouse asukhelun, ajui nomhih-un, boljong abolpouve.
target: This happened because they had not obeyed the Lord their God, but had violated his covenant—all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded. They neither listened to the commands nor carried them out.

source: Tun Hezekiah Lengpa lengchan kal kum somle kum li lhinin, Assyria lengpa Sennacherib chu Judah gam khopi kulpi neijouse satdin ahungkon touvin, hicheho chu alatan ahi.
target: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah’s reign, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.

source: Chuin Judah lengpa Hezekiah'in Lachish'a Assyria lengpa henga chun, thil kanabol kheltan ahi, tin thu agah thottai. Chuin Assyria lengpa chun Hezekiah chu dangka talent jathum le sana talent somthum atep pehtan ahi.
target: So Hezekiah king of Judah sent this message to the king of Assyria at Lachish: “I have done wrong. Withdraw from me, and I will pay whatever you demand of me.” The king of Assyria exacted from Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

source: Chuin Hezekiah'in Pakai in'a dangka umjouse le leng in'a goukhol na-a dangka umjouse chu apetan ahi.
target: So Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the temple of the Lord and in the treasuries of the royal palace.

source: Hiche phatlai chun Hezekiah'in Pakai in kotna sanale, Juda leng Hezekiah'in khompi ho-a sana alonkhumho chu akhohdoh sohkeijin, Assyria lengpa chu apetan ahi.
target: At this time Hezekiah king of Judah stripped off the gold with which he had covered the doors and doorposts of the temple of the Lord , and gave it to the king of Assyria.

source: Chuin Assyria lengpan Tartan le Rabsaris chule Rabshakeh chu Lachish'a konin sepai janeltoh Jerusalem'a Hezekiah lengpa henga asolin ahi. Chuin amaho achetouvun Jerusalem alhung taove. Chuin amaho alhunun, ponsoppa lamlhah-a twikul sahnung, twilam panga chun adinguve.
target: The king of Assyria sent his supreme commander, his chief officer and his field commander with a large army, from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. They came up to Jerusalem and stopped at the aqueduct of the Upper Pool, on the road to the Washerman’s Field.

source: Chuin amahon lengpa akouvun ahile, insung vaipopa Hilkiah chapa Eliakim, lekhasunpa Shebna, chule thuchingpa Asaph chapa Joah chu ahungdoh-un ahi.
target: They called for the king; and Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went out to them.

source: Chuin Rabshakeh chun ajah uva, tun nanghon Hezekiah henga gaseijun, leng loupitah, Assyria lengpan hitin aseije, ipi tahsana nakingaija kisong nahim?
target: The field commander said to them, “Tell Hezekiah: “ ‘This is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: On what are you basing this confidence of yours?

source: Nangman naseijin, (ahinla hicheho chu mohthu mai maibou ahi,) keiman galbol nadin thumopthem le thahatna kaneije nati. Tun koichunga natahsan nangapma, keima douna-a kiphin nahim?
target: You say you have the counsel and the might for war—but you speak only empty words. On whom are you depending, that you rebel against me?

source: Tun, vetan, hiche pumpeng kihehchip tenggol Egypt mite ngeichu natahsan ahin; ama chunga chun mikhattou kingaitaleh, akhutna lutna chule asutding ahi. Egypt lengpa Pharoah tahsan jouse chu chutiding ahi.
target: Look, I know you are depending on Egypt, that splintered reed of a staff, which pierces the hand of anyone who leans on it! Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who depend on him.

source: Ahinla nanghon kahenga, Pakai ka Pathen'u katahsanu ahi, tijong leuchun, hiche munsang ho le maicham ho chu hilouham, Hezekiah'in alah manga, Judah le Jerusalem mite henga, Jerusalem'a um hiche maicham masanga hi nahoudiu ahi, ati chu?
target: But if you say to me, “We are depending on the Lord our God”—isn’t he the one whose high places and altars Hezekiah removed, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, “You must worship before this altar in Jerusalem”?

source: Hijeh chun tun kangeh nahiuve, ka pakai Assyria lengpa henga chun kitepna peuvin, chule achunga touding mi nanga jouding pou ule, sakol sangni napeu vinge.
target: “ ‘Come now, make a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses—if you can put riders on them!

source: Achutile iti dana kapupa sohteho lah-a gal lamkai neopen khat mai nahei manguva, Egypt mite kangtalai ho le sakol ho chunga natahsanu na-ngap muham?
target: How can you repulse one officer of the least of my master’s officials, even though you are depending on Egypt for chariots and horsemen?

source: Tu-a hi keima Pakai thulouva hiche munhi satna sumang dinga hunga kahim? Pakaiyin kajah-a, heche gam dounan chetouvin, chule gasumangin eiti ahi, ati.
target: Furthermore, have I come to attack and destroy this place without word from the Lord ? The Lord himself told me to march against this country and destroy it.’ ”

source: Chujouvin Hilkiah chapa Eliakim, Shebna, chule Joah chun Rabshakeh jah-a, kangeh nahi, nasohte jah-a, Syria paovin thu seijin; ajehchu keihon kahecheh naove; chule kulpi vuma mipi jahdin Judah paovin neikihoupi hih-un, atiuve.
target: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, and Shebna and Joah said to the field commander, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it. Don’t speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall.”

source: Ahinla Rabshakeh chun ajah uva, kapu chun napu hengle nangma henga hiche thuho seidinga eihinsol ham? Kulpi vuma touho hin nang hotoh aeh-u aneh uva ajunu adon theina dinguva ahenguva eihinsol hilouham? ati.
target: But the commander replied, “Was it only to your master and you that my master sent me to say these things, and not to the people sitting on the wall—who, like you, will have to eat their own excrement and drink their own urine?”

source: Chujouvin Rabshakeh adingin, Judah paovin aw sangtah-in asamin, thu aseijin, lenglen Assyria lengpa thu ngaijun;
target: Then the commander stood and called out in Hebrew, “Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria!

source: Lengpan hitin aseije, Hezekiah chu kilheplhah sah hih-un; ajehchu aman ama khutna konin nahuhdoh jou pouvinte.
target: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you. He cannot deliver you from my hand.

source: Chule Hezekiah'in, Pakaiyin thonlouva eihuhdoh teidingu ahin, hiche khopihi Assyria lengpa khutna jong kipedoh louhel ding ahi, tin Pakai natahsan sah daohen.
target: Do not let Hezekiah persuade you to trust in the Lord when he says, ‘The Lord will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.’

source: Hezekiah thu ngai hih-un; ajehchu Assyria lengpan hitin aseije, thilpeh khatna konin keitoh kinoptona khat bolun lang kahenga hungun, hitichun mitinin alengpi gui cheh le atheichang phung cheh kineh hen, chule nangho mitinin atwibel cheh-u kidonuhen;
target: “Do not listen to Hezekiah. This is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then each of you will eat fruit from your own vine and fig tree and drink water from your own cistern,

source: Thilouva nahina diuva nangho gam tobang gam, chang le lengpithei gam, changlhah le lengpilei gam, olive thao le khoiju lonna gam khatna dinga kahunga kahung puidoh kahseuvin: chule, Pakaiyin eihuhdoh naovinte tia najol tengule, Hezekiah thu ngai hih-un.
target: until I come and take you to a land like your own—a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive trees and honey. Choose life and not death! “Do not listen to Hezekiah, for he is misleading you when he says, ‘The Lord will deliver us.’

source: Namtin pathenho lah-a khat tou Assyria lengpa khutna kona agam huhdoh-a umkha tam?
target: Has the god of any nation ever delivered his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?

source: Hamath le Arpad pathenho hoija umtaovam? Sepharvaim, Hena, chule Ivah pathenho hoilamba hitaovam? Amahon kakhutna kona Samaria ahuhdoh beh uvem?
target: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena and Ivvah? Have they rescued Samaria from my hand?

source: Gamsung pathenho jouse lah-a kakhutna kona agamu huhdohpeh-a koi uma, Pakai chun kakhutna kona Jerusalem ahuhdoh ding hijaham? ati.
target: Who of all the gods of these countries has been able to save his land from me? How then can the Lord deliver Jerusalem from my hand?”

source: Ahinla mipi chu athipbeh-un, thu chengkhat chanjong adonbut pouve. Ajehchu lengpa thulhah chu, donbut hih-un, ti ahi.
target: But the people remained silent and said nothing in reply, because the king had commanded, “Do not answer him.”

source: Chujouvin leng insunga vaihom Hilkiah chapa Eliakim le lekhasun Shebna chule thuchingpa Asaph chapa Joash chu Hezekiah henga aponu kibottel pumin ahungun, Rabshakeh thusei ho chu ama aseipeh-un ahi.
target: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went to Hezekiah, with their clothes torn, and told him what the field commander had said.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Hezekiah lengpan hichu ajah phatnin, apon abottelin, khaodippon akisilin, Pakai insunga alut tai.
target: When King Hezekiah heard this, he tore his clothes and put on sackcloth and went into the temple of the Lord .

source: Chuin insung vaipopa Eliakim, lekhasun Shebna, chule thempuho lah-a upaho chu khaodip pon kisil pumin, Amoz chapa Isaiah themgao henga asoltan ahi.
target: He sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary and the leading priests, all wearing sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.

source: Chuin amahon ajah-a, Hezekiah'in hitin aseije, tunihi lungjin nikho, kipho nikho, chule kitaitom nikho ahi: ajehchu naosen ho pengding aki gouvin, ahinla apenlhahsah nading thahatna aumpoi.
target: They told him, “This is what Hezekiah says: This day is a day of distress and rebuke and disgrace, as when children come to the moment of birth and there is no strength to deliver them.

source: Apu Assyria lengpan hingjing Pathen house dinga asolpa Rabshakeh thusei jouse chu Pakai na Pathen chun jatei tantin; Pakai na Pathen'in athu jahho chu phohsal nante. Hijeh chun amoh umnalai ho ding chun taona manpeh-in, atiuve.
target: It may be that the Lord your God will hear all the words of the field commander, whom his master, the king of Assyria, has sent to ridicule the living God, and that he will rebuke him for the words the Lord your God has heard. Therefore pray for the remnant that still survives.”

source: Hitichun Hezekiah lengpa soh ho chu Isaiah henga ahungtaove.
target: When King Hezekiah’s officials came to Isaiah,

source: Chuin Isaiah'in ajah uvah, napupao henga hiti nagasei dingu ahi; Pakaiyin hitin aseije, nathujah hou, Assyria lengpa sohten eitamsetnao thuho-a chun kicha hih-in.
target: Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master, ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not be afraid of what you have heard—those words with which the underlings of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

source: Veovin, achunga huihat kanunsah ding, chule aman thuthang ajah-a, agamlama kileding; agamsung tah-a chemhema kalousah ding ahi, ati.
target: Listen! When he hears a certain report, I will make him want to return to his own country, and there I will have him cut down with the sword.’ ”

source: Hitichun Rabshakeh akiletan, Assyria lengpan Libnah anasat agatohkhai; ajehchu aman ama chu Lachish'a konin apot tai ti ajah ahitai.
target: When the field commander heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish, he withdrew and found the king fighting against Libnah.

source: Chule, Ethiopia leng Tirhakah chungchanga kisei, veuvin, nangma satdingin ahungkon dohtai ti thu ajah phatnin; Hezekiah henga thupole ho asolkitnin, ajah-a,
target: Now Sennacherib received a report that Tirhakah, the king of Cush, was marching out to fight against him. So he again sent messengers to Hezekiah with this word:

source: Hitia hi Judah lengpa Hezekiah henga naseidingu ahi, Assyria lengpa khutna Jerusalem kipedoh ponte tia natahsan pa na Pathen chu kilhep lhahsah hih-in.
target: “Say to Hezekiah king of Judah: Do not let the god you depend on deceive you when he says, ‘Jerusalem will not be given into the hands of the king of Assyria.’

source: Veuvin, Assyria lengten gamjouse asuhmang hela, achunguva athilbol houchu najatan; achutile nangma huhhing-a na-umchom dehding ham?
target: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the countries, destroying them completely. And will you be delivered?

source: Kapu Kapa teovin anasuhmang Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, chule Thelasar kho-a um Eden chateho chu, namtin pathenho chun anahuhdoh beh-em?
target: Did the gods of the nations that were destroyed by my predecessors deliver them—the gods of Gozan, Harran, Rezeph and the people of Eden who were in Tel Assar?

source: Hamath lengpa, Arpad lengpa, chule Sepharvaim khopi lengpa, Hena le Ivah lengpa hoija umgama hitaovam? agati sah-e.
target: Where is the king of Hamath or the king of Arpad? Where are the kings of Lair, Sepharvaim, Hena and Ivvah?”

source: Chuin Hezekiah'in thupo ho khutna lekhathot chu amun, asimtai. Chuin Hezekiah chu Pakai in'a achetouvin, hichu Pakai anga aphajaltan ahi.
target: Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers and read it. Then he went up to the temple of the Lord and spread it out before the Lord .

source: Chuin Hezekiah Pakai anga ataovin, Cherub teni kah-a cheng, vo Pakai Israel Pathen, nangma, nangma sehseh bou lenggam jouse-a Pathen nahin; nangman vanle lei nana seme.
target: And Hezekiah prayed to the Lord : “ Lord , the God of Israel, enthroned between the cherubim, you alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

source: Pakai nanakhang hinsung inlang, ngaijin; Pakai namit hasah inlang hinven: chule Pathen hing taitom na-a Sennacherib i-sah louna thuseihi ngaijin.
target: Give ear, Lord , and hear; open your eyes, Lord , and see; listen to the words Sennacherib has sent to ridicule the living God.

source: Tahbeh-in, Pakai, Assyria lengten namtinle agamu asuhmang gamuva,
target: “It is true, Lord , that the Assyrian kings have laid waste these nations and their lands.

source: Chule a-pathen hou meija alelutpeh gamu ahitai. Ajehchu amaho pathen ahi pouvin, mihem khutsem thingle songbou ahiuve: hijeh-a chu asuhmangu ahi.
target: They have thrown their gods into the fire and destroyed them, for they were not gods but only wood and stone, fashioned by human hands.

source: Hijeh chun tun, vo Pakai ka Pathen'u, kangeh nahi, leiset lenggam jousen nangma sehseh bou Pakai Pathen nahihi ahet theina diuvin, ama khutna konin neihuh doh-un, ati.
target: Now, Lord our God, deliver us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you alone, Lord , are God.”

source: Chujouvin Amoz chapa Isaiah chun Hezekiah henga thu athotnin, hitin aseije, Pakai Israel Pathen chun hitin aseije, Assyria leng Sennacherib douna-a kahenga nataona chu kasangtai.
target: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent a message to Hezekiah: “This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I have heard your prayer concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria.

source: Hichehi achungchang thu-u Pakaiyin aseichu ahi; Nungah theng Zion chanu chun nahsah-in naneipon, i-sah louvin nanuisat in; Jerusalem chanun alu napei khume.
target: This is the word that the Lord has spoken against him: “ ‘Virgin Daughter Zion despises you and mocks you. Daughter Jerusalem tosses her head as you flee.

source: Koi nahousetna koi nataitom ham? Koichunga na aw nachoi sanga, namit nachung hasah ham? Israel mithengpa tah chunga ahi.
target: Who is it you have ridiculed and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes in pride? Against the Holy One of Israel!

source: Nathu poleho mangchan Pakai chu nahousen, hitin naseijin, ka kangtalai ho tamtah toh Lebanon panga um molsang ho kahung lhungtoutan, chule chua Cedar thing sangtah tahho leh, chahthing phatah tahho kaphuh lhuhding; chule keima agamgi chin geija kalutna, Karmel gammang geija kalut ding ahi.
target: By your messengers you have ridiculed the Lord. And you have said, “With my many chariots I have ascended the heights of the mountains, the utmost heights of Lebanon. I have cut down its tallest cedars, the choicest of its junipers. I have reached its remotest parts, the finest of its forests.

source: Keiman kalaijin, gamdang twi kadonjin, kakengto hin kulpi kium khum vadungho chu kakan sahjin ahi, nati.
target: I have dug wells in foreign lands and drunk the water there. With the soles of my feet I have dried up all the streams of Egypt.”

source: Keiman hichehohi sotlaija iti kanabola, khanglui laija kanasemsa ahidan najah khah louham? Hicheho chu tu-a hi kagui lhunsah ahin, Khopi kul neiho chu nasuhchima bohse banga nasetvum ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Have you not heard? Long ago I ordained it. In days of old I planned it; now I have brought it to pass, that you have turned fortified cities into piles of stone.

source: Hijeh chun asunguva chengho thalhoma ahiuvin, ameidoijuva, maimoh ahiuvin; amaho jaova hampaho, hamhing eng ho, in chunga hamhing keh bangle akikhanlhit kah-a golhaji chang tobang bep hiuva ahi.
target: Their people, drained of power, are dismayed and put to shame. They are like plants in the field, like tender green shoots, like grass sprouting on the roof, scorched before it grows up.

source: Ahinla keiman nachenna, nahunglut le napotdoh, chule kachunga nalungsat kahenai.
target: “ ‘But I know where you are and when you come and go and how you rage against me.

source: Ajehchu kachunga nalunghan nale nakitomna kanakhang sunga ahunglut tan; hijeh-a chu ka ngakoi nanah-a kavo-a, nanephu-a kakamdal kakoi ding, nahungna lampia kakinung lesah ding nahi.
target: Because you rage against me and because your insolence has reached my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth, and I will make you return by the way you came.’

source: Chule hichehi nangma dinga melchihna hiding ahi, tukum achama kehho naneh dingu, kum ni nateng hiche-a kona alikeh mama chu nanehdingu; kumthum nateng vangle nakitu uva na atdiu; chule lengpilei nabol uva, aga nanehdiu ahi.
target: “This will be the sign for you, Hezekiah: “This year you will eat what grows by itself, and the second year what springs from that. But in the third year sow and reap, plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

source: Chule Judah insung mi ahoidoh amoh cheng chun ajungu noilama khothuh unting, chunglama aga asepdoh dingu ahi.
target: Once more a remnant of the kingdom of Judah will take root below and bear fruit above.

source: Ajehchu Jerusalem'a kona amoh ho, Zion mola kona ahoidohho chu potdoh diu ahi. Janel Pakai tompan nachun hichehi abolding ahi, ati.
target: For out of Jerusalem will come a remnant, and out of Mount Zion a band of survivors. “The zeal of the Lord Almighty will accomplish this.

source: Hijeh chun Assyria lengpa chungchang thu Pakaiyin hitihin aseije; ama hiche khopi sunga hunglut louding, thalchang khatjong akaplut louding, alumdal jong ahinpohlut louding, aumna ding kuljong asesang louhel ding ahi.
target: “Therefore this is what the Lord says concerning the king of Assyria: “ ‘He will not enter this city or shoot an arrow here. He will not come before it with shield or build a siege ramp against it.

source: Ahungna lampi hiche mama-a chu kilekit ding, hiche khopi sunga hunglut louding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: By the way that he came he will return; he will not enter this city, declares the Lord .

source: Ajehchu keima le keima kikhoh sahna jal le, kasoh David khohsahna jala, hiche huhdohna dinga kahonbit ding ahi, ati.
target: I will defend this city and save it, for my sake and for the sake of David my servant.’ ”

source: Chuin hiche janchun ahitin ahi, Pakai vantil chu akondoh-in, Assyria te gebuh-a chun sepai sangjakhat le sangsomget le sangnga athatnin ahi. Chuin amaho jingpitah-a athophatnun, veuvin, amaho abonchauvin mithilong ngen ahitaove.
target: That night the angel of the Lord went out and put to death a hundred and eighty-five thousand in the Assyrian camp. When the people got up the next morning—there were all the dead bodies!

source: Hitichun Assyria lengpa Sennacherib chu apotdoh-in, akinunglen, Nineveh'a achengtai.
target: So Sennacherib king of Assyria broke camp and withdrew. He returned to Nineveh and stayed there.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, aman a-pathen Nisroch in'a ama ahoupetnin, achapa teni Adram-melech le Sharezer'in chemjamin athat lhontan ahi. Chuin amani Armenia gama ajammang lhontai. Hichun achapa Esarhaddon ama khelin alengchang tai.
target: One day, while he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisrok, his sons Adrammelek and Sharezer killed him with the sword, and they escaped to the land of Ararat. And Esarhaddon his son succeeded him as king.

source: Hiche laichun Hezekiah chu thidingin anatan ahi. Chuin Amoz chapa Isaiah themgao chu ahenga ahungin, ajah-a, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, na insung kisemtoh-in; ajehchu nathi ding ahitan, nahinsot tahlou ding ahi, ati.
target: In those days Hezekiah became ill and was at the point of death. The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz went to him and said, “This is what the Lord says: Put your house in order, because you are going to die; you will not recover.”

source: Chujouvin amai banglama aheijin, Pakai henga ataovin, hitin aseije,
target: Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the Lord ,

source: Vo Pakai, kangeh nahi, namasanga thutah le lungdih pu-a chule namitmu-a thilpha kanabolho chu tuhin neigeldoh pehtan, ati. Chuin Hezekiah hakan akaptai.
target: “Remember, Lord , how I have walked before you faithfully and with wholehearted devotion and have done what is good in your eyes.” And Hezekiah wept bitterly.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Isaiah chu hongsung lailunga apotdoh masangin, Pakai thu chu ahenga ahung lhungin,
target: Before Isaiah had left the middle court, the word of the Lord came to him:

source: Kilekitnin lang kamite vaipipo Hezekiah chu gaseipeh-in, Pakai, napa David Pathen chun hitin aseije, keiman nataona kasangin, namitlhi lon kamutai: ven, kadamsah ding nahitai. Nithum chan nile nangma Pakai in'a nachetou ding ahi, ati.
target: “Go back and tell Hezekiah, the ruler of my people, ‘This is what the Lord , the God of your father David, says: I have heard your prayer and seen your tears; I will heal you. On the third day from now you will go up to the temple of the Lord .

source: Nahinkho kum somle kum nga kajopbea, nangmale hiche khopihi Assyria lengpa khutna kona kahuhdoh ding; chule hiche khopihi keima le keima kikhoh sahna jaleh kasoh David kakhohsahna jala kahonbit ding ahi, ati.
target: I will add fifteen years to your life. And I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city for my sake and for the sake of my servant David.’ ”

source: Chuin Isaiah'in, theichang pheng khat hinlaovin ati. Chuin ahinlaovin uilut chunga chu akoijun ahile a-ol domtan ahi.
target: Then Isaiah said, “Prepare a poultice of figs.” They did so and applied it to the boil, and he recovered.

source: Chuin Hezekiah'in Isaiah jah-a, Pakaiyin eidamsah dingle nithum ni-a Pakai in'a kachetou nading melchihna chu ipi hintem? ati.
target: Hezekiah had asked Isaiah, “What will be the sign that the Lord will heal me and that I will go up to the temple of the Lord on the third day from now?”

source: Chuin Isaiah'in, Pakaiyin aseisa chu aboltei ding ahi tihi nangma-a dinga Pakaiya kona namelchihna chu ahi: nilim chu kalsom machon dingham, ahiloule kalsom nungchon dingham? ati.
target: Isaiah answered, “This is the Lord ’s sign to you that the Lord will do what he has promised: Shall the shadow go forward ten steps, or shall it go back ten steps?”

source: Chuin Hezekiah'in adonbutnin, nilim dinga kalsom chesuh dinghi thil bailam ahin; hichu hidahen, ahinla nilim chu kalsom kinungchon johen, ati.
target: “It is a simple matter for the shadow to go forward ten steps,” said Hezekiah. “Rather, have it go back ten steps.”

source: Chuin Isaiah themgao chu Pakai henga ataovin; Ahaz nidan melchih na-a kumlhasa nilim chu kalsom ahinlepui kitnin ahi.
target: Then the prophet Isaiah called on the Lord , and the Lord made the shadow go back the ten steps it had gone down on the stairway of Ahaz.

source: Hiche laichun Babylon lengpa Baladan chapa Berodach-baladan'in Hezekiah henga lekhathot le thilpeh ahinthotnin ahi: ajehchu aman Hezekiah chu anai ti ajan ahi.
target: At that time Marduk-Baladan son of Baladan king of Babylon sent Hezekiah letters and a gift, because he had heard of Hezekiah’s illness.

source: Chuin Hezekiah'in amahochu ana sasah-in, athillu koina in jouse, dangka, sanaho, gimnamtui ho, thao mantamho, agalvon koina in jouse, chule agou kholna-a umjouse avetsah sohkeijin; a-insungle alenggam jouse Hezekiah'in amaho amusahlou khatcha aumpon ahi.
target: Hezekiah received the envoys and showed them all that was in his storehouses—the silver, the gold, the spices and the fine olive oil—his armory and everything found among his treasures. There was nothing in his palace or in all his kingdom that Hezekiah did not show them.

source: Chujouvin Isaiah themgao chu Hezekiah lengpa henga ahungin, ajah-a, hiche teho hin ipi aseijum? hoija kona nahenga hunguva ham? ati. Chuin Hezekiah'in amaho gamlatah-a Babylon'a kona hunga ahiuve, ati.
target: Then Isaiah the prophet went to King Hezekiah and asked, “What did those men say, and where did they come from?” “From a distant land,” Hezekiah replied. “They came from Babylon.”

source: Chuin aman, na insunga hi ipipi amutah um? ati. Chuin Hezekiah'in adonbutnin, ka-insunga thil umjouse amutaove; kagouho lah-a kavetsahlou khatchabeh aumpoi, ati.
target: The prophet asked, “What did they see in your palace?” “They saw everything in my palace,” Hezekiah said. “There is nothing among my treasures that I did not show them.”

source: Chuin Isaiah'in Hezekiah jah-a, Pakai thuhi ngaijin,
target: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of the Lord :

source: Vetan, na-insunga umjouse le napan tunigeija anakhol khomho chu Babylon gamsunga apohlutna dingu nikho hunglhung ding; imacha khen umlou ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: The time will surely come when everything in your palace, and all that your predecessors have stored up until this day, will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will be left, says the Lord .

source: Chule nangma nahin, nangma-a kona hungpot ding nachapate chu apuimangdiu; chule amaho chu Babylon lengpa leng insunga Nukiso ho hiding ahiuve, ati.
target: And some of your descendants, your own flesh and blood who will be born to you, will be taken away, and they will become eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.”

source: Chuphatnin Hezekiah'in Isaiah henga, nangin naseidoh Pakai thuchu apha ahi. Chule aman, kahinkho sungbeh-a hi chamna le thutah aumle, hichu apha hijeng lou ham? ati.
target: “The word of the Lord you have spoken is good,” Hezekiah replied. For he thought, “Will there not be peace and security in my lifetime?”

source: Chule Hezekiah thilbol danghole athaneina jouse, chule twikul le twilam iti asema, chule khopi sunga twi iti ana lahlut ham tiho chu, Judah lengte thusimbua kisunlutna hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Hezekiah’s reign, all his achievements and how he made the pool and the tunnel by which he brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

source: Chuin Hezekiah chu apu apate toh alumkhomin, chule achapa Manasseh chu ama khelin alengchang tai.
target: Hezekiah rested with his ancestors. And Manasseh his son succeeded him as king.

source: Manasseh alengchan patchun kum somle kum ni ahin, ama Jerusalem'a kum somnga le kum nga analeng change. Chule anu minchu Hephzi-bah ahi.
target: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-five years. His mother’s name was Hephzibah.

source: Chule aman Israelte masanga Pakaiyin ananodoh, Pathen helouho thil thet um bolji ho bangchun, Pakai mitmun thilse anabolin ahi.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , following the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.

source: Ajehchu apa Hezekiah'in asuhmangsa munsang ho atungdoh kitnin; Israel leng Ahab bol bangin Baal maicham atungdoh in, thingbom asemin, van janelpi ahouvin, ajentaovin ahi.
target: He rebuilt the high places his father Hezekiah had destroyed; he also erected altars to Baal and made an Asherah pole, as Ahab king of Israel had done. He bowed down to all the starry hosts and worshiped them.

source: Pakaiyin Jerusalem'a kamin kaum sah ding ahi atina, Pakai in'a chun maicham ho asemin ahi.
target: He built altars in the temple of the Lord , of which the Lord had said, “In Jerusalem I will put my Name.”

source: Chuin aman Pakai in hongsung teni-a chun van janelho jousedin maicham ho aseme.
target: In the two courts of the temple of the Lord , he built altars to all the starry hosts.

source: Chuin aman achapa chu meija kilhaina-in amangin, phat ho anitnin, kilhimna ho amangchan, lhakou le doithemho amangin: lungsat sah-a lunghansah nadin, Pakai mitmun khangitlouna tamtah abolin ahi.
target: He sacrificed his own son in the fire, practiced divination, sought omens, and consulted mediums and spiritists. He did much evil in the eyes of the Lord , arousing his anger.

source: Aman thingbom milim asem chu Pakai in'a chun atungdoh-e, hiche houin chungchang hi Pakaiyin David le achapa Solomon henga, hiche in le Jerusalem hi a-imatih chana kamin umjing nadinga, Israel phung jouse-a kona kalhendoh ahin,
target: He took the carved Asherah pole he had made and put it in the temple, of which the Lord had said to David and to his son Solomon, “In this temple and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my Name forever.

source: Keiman amaho kathupeh jouse dungjuile, kasoh Mosi'n amaho athupeh jouse dungjuija boldinga anit pou ule, apu apateu kanapehna leisetna kona Israel ten akalu asondoh louhel dingu ahi, anati.
target: I will not again make the feet of the Israelites wander from the land I gave their ancestors, if only they will be careful to do everything I commanded them and will keep the whole Law that my servant Moses gave them.”

source: Ahinla amahon angaipouvin; Pakaiyin Israel chate masanga anasuhmang namho bolsanga phaloujo cheh-in Manasseh'in miho chu alhemlha tai.
target: But the people did not listen. Manasseh led them astray, so that they did more evil than the nations the Lord had destroyed before the Israelites.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin asoh themgaoho-a thu aseijin,
target: The Lord said through his servants the prophets:

source: Ajehchu Judah lengpa Manasseh in hichethil thet umtah abola, amaho masanga Amor mihon abol jouseu vuma giloutah-a abola, Judah jong milim houva achonsetsah jeh hin;
