target: “Manasseh king of Judah has committed these detestable sins. He has done more evil than the Amorites who preceded him and has led Judah into sin with his idols.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, veuvin, hiche thuhi ajapha chanin anakol teni kichih lahlah leuva ajah nadinga, keiman Jerusalem le Judah chunga thilse kalhunsah ding ahi.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I am going to bring such disaster on Jerusalem and Judah that the ears of everyone who hears of it will tingle.

source: Chule Samaria tena khao le Ahab insung tena thihkhai chu Jerusalem chunga kaman ding; min kong asoptheng banga Jerusalem kasuhtheng ding, chule kabung butun ding ahi.
target: I will stretch out over Jerusalem the measuring line used against Samaria and the plumb line used against the house of Ahab. I will wipe out Jerusalem as one wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.

source: Chule kagou chan amoh chengse chu kadalhah-a, amelmateu khutna kapehdoh ding; chule amaho amelmateuva dinga anchahle thil kichom hidiu ahi.
target: I will forsake the remnant of my inheritance and give them into the hands of enemies. They will be looted and plundered by all their enemies;

source: Ajehchu apateu Egypt'a kona ahungdoh uva pat tunigei hin kamitmun thilphalou jeng aboluvin, kalunghan nadin eilungsat sah-un ahi, ati.
target: they have done evil in my eyes and have aroused my anger from the day their ancestors came out of Egypt until this day.”

source: Chukal vallin Manasseh hin themona bei thisan aso tambeh seh'in, Jerusalem dunglevai adip jengin; ama chonset tilouvin Judah jong achonsetsah-in, hitichun Pakai mitmun thilse jeng abolin ahi.
target: Moreover, Manasseh also shed so much innocent blood that he filled Jerusalem from end to end—besides the sin that he had caused Judah to commit, so that they did evil in the eyes of the Lord .

source: Tun Manasseh thilbol danghole chonsetna abol hochu Judah lengte thusimbua kisuna hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Manasseh’s reign, and all he did, including the sin he committed, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

source: Chuin Manasseh apu apate toh alumkhomin; a-in'a ama honsungtah, Uzza honsunga avuitaovin: achapa Amon ama khelin alengchang tai.
target: Manasseh rested with his ancestors and was buried in his palace garden, the garden of Uzza. And Amon his son succeeded him as king.

source: Amon alengchan patchun kum somni le kumni ahin, Jerusalem'a kumni alengchange. Anu minchu Meshullemeth ahin, Jotbah kho-a Haruz chanu ahi.
target: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem two years. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth daughter of Haruz; she was from Jotbah.

source: Aman apa Manasseh bolbangin Pakai mitmun thilphalou jeng abolin ahi.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , as his father Manasseh had done.

source: Chule apa chena lampi chu ajotnin, apan milim kin abol hochu abolin, amaho chu ahouvin,
target: He followed completely the ways of his father, worshiping the idols his father had worshiped, and bowing down to them.

source: Hitichun apu apate Pakai Pathen chu adalhan, Pakai lamlhah chu ajotpon ahi.
target: He forsook the Lord , the God of his ancestors, and did not walk in obedience to him.

source: Chuin Amon sohte chun ama dounan guhthimin thilgon aneijun, lengpa chu ama in'a athat taove.
target: Amon’s officials conspired against him and assassinated the king in his palace.

source: Ahinla chuche gam miho chun Amon lengpa changlhiho chu athatgam helun; chuche gam miho chun achapa Josiah chu ama khelin alengchansah taove.
target: Then the people of the land killed all who had plotted against King Amon, and they made Josiah his son king in his place.

source: Tun Amon'in anabol anatoh dangho chu Judah lengte thusimbua kisuna hilou ham?
target: As for the other events of Amon’s reign, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

source: Chuin ama chu Uzza honsunga lhana chun avuijun, achapa Josiah ama khelin alengchang tai.
target: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza. And Josiah his son succeeded him as king.

source: Josiah chu alengchan kipat chun kum get ahin, ama Jerusalem'a kum somthumle kumkhat aleng changin ahi. Chule anu minchu Jedidah ahin, Boskath kho-a Adaiah chanu ahi.
target: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years. His mother’s name was Jedidah daughter of Adaiah; she was from Bozkath.

source: Chuin aman Pakai mitmu-a thil dihtah abolin, apa David lamlhah jouse ajotnin, jetle veija akiheidohpon ahi.
target: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord and followed completely the ways of his father David, not turning aside to the right or to the left.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Josiah lengchan kumsomle kum getna-in, lengpan Meshullam chapa Azaliah chapa Shaphan lekhasun chu Pakai in'a asolin, aseije,
target: In the eighteenth year of his reign, King Josiah sent the secretary, Shaphan son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, to the temple of the Lord . He said:

source: Thempu chungnung Hilkiah henga chetouvin lang, kotngah hon miho-a kona alahkhomu, Pakai in'a kipo dangka chu simhen,
target: “Go up to Hilkiah the high priest and have him get ready the money that has been brought into the temple of the Lord , which the doorkeepers have collected from the people.

source: Chule Pakai in'a natongho vesuiho khutna pedoh uhen; chule amahon houin selai semphat nadingin, Pakai in'a um natongho,
target: Have them entrust it to the men appointed to supervise the work on the temple. And have these men pay the workers who repair the temple of the Lord —

source: Thingthem bol hole insaho chule songthem bolho hengah, insemphat nading thingtumle song kikhengho choh nadingin peson uhen, ati.
target: the carpenters, the builders and the masons. Also have them purchase timber and dressed stone to repair the temple.

source: Ahivangin amahon tahsan umtah-a aboljeh-un, akhutnuva kipelut sumho chu vetsuina aumpoi.
target: But they need not account for the money entrusted to them, because they are honest in their dealings.”

source: Chuin thempu chungnung Hilkiah'in lekhasun Shaphan jah-a, danthupeh lekhabu chu Pakai in'a kamutai, ati. Chuin Hilkiah'in lekhabu chu Shaphan apen, aman hichu asimtan ahi.
target: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the secretary, “I have found the Book of the Law in the temple of the Lord .” He gave it to Shaphan, who read it.

source: Chuin lekha sunpa Shaphan chu lengpa henga ahungin hitihin thu ahinlhut tai; nasohten in'a um sumho chu natongho khutna Pakai insa-a natongho apesoh hel taove, ati.
target: Then Shaphan the secretary went to the king and reported to him: “Your officials have paid out the money that was in the temple of the Lord and have entrusted it to the workers and supervisors at the temple.”

source: Chuin lekha sunpa Shaphan'in lengpa henga, Hilkiah thempupan lekhabu khat eipei, tin lengpa avetsah tai. Chuin Shaphan'in lengpa masanga hichu asimtai.
target: Then Shaphan the secretary informed the king, “Hilkiah the priest has given me a book.” And Shaphan read from it in the presence of the king.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, lengpan danthupeh lekhabua thuchu ajah phatnin, apon abottelin ahi.
target: When the king heard the words of the Book of the Law, he tore his robes.

source: Chuin lengpan Hilkiah thempu, Shaphan chapa Ahikam, Michaiah chapa Achbor, lekhasun Shaphan, lengpa sohpa Asahiah chu thu apen,
target: He gave these orders to Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Akbor son of Micaiah, Shaphan the secretary and Asaiah the king’s attendant:

source: Cheovin, Pakai chu keima dingle mipi ho-a ding, chule Judah te jousedin hiche akimudoh lekhabua thu umho chungchang thuhi neigadop peh-un; ajehchu ijuidiuva hiche lekhabua kijih jousehi ipu ipateovin ajuilou jeh-un, ichunguva Pakai lungsatna deujeju ahi, ati.
target: “Go and inquire of the Lord for me and for the people and for all Judah about what is written in this book that has been found. Great is the Lord ’s anger that burns against us because those who have gone before us have not obeyed the words of this book; they have not acted in accordance with all that is written there concerning us.”

source: Hitichun Hilkiah thempu, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, Asahiah chu ponsil chingtupma pang Harhas chapa Tikvah chapa Shallum inneipi Huldah themgaonu henga acheuvin,(Amachu Jerusalem vengsahlama cheng ahin,) amanu aga kihoupiu vin ahi.
target: Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Akbor, Shaphan and Asaiah went to speak to the prophet Huldah, who was the wife of Shallum son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe. She lived in Jerusalem, in the New Quarter.

source: Chuin amanun ajah uvah, Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, kahenga nahinsolpao jah-a chun seipeh taovin,
target: She said to them, “This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Tell the man who sent you to me,

source: Pakaiyin hitin ati, vetan, Judah lengpan asim lekhabua thucheng jouse banga chu, hikom munle asunga chengho jouse chunga thil phaloutah kalhunsah ding ahi:
target: ‘This is what the Lord says: I am going to bring disaster on this place and its people, according to everything written in the book the king of Judah has read.

source: Ajehchu akhutsohho jouse-a eilung hansah theina dinguvin, amahon keima eidalhao vin, pathen dangho henga gimnamtui ahaluvin ahi; hijeh-a chu hiche mun douna-a hi kalungsatna deujah jengding, chule kisumit louding ahi.
target: Because they have forsaken me and burned incense to other gods and aroused my anger by all the idols their hands have made, my anger will burn against this place and will not be quenched.’

source: Ahinla Pakai dopdinga nahin soluvah Judah lengpa henga chun hitihin seijun, Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin ati, nathu jah ho chungchanga;
target: Tell the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the Lord , ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says concerning the words you heard:

source: Hiche mun le asunga chengho chungchanga kathusei, amaho akamhel le sapset chang hung hidiu ahi tia kasei najah phatna nalung anema, Pakai anga nakineosah-a, napon nabotel jenga, kamasanga naka jeh-in; keiman nataona kasangtai tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Because your heart was responsive and you humbled yourself before the Lord when you heard what I have spoken against this place and its people—that they would become a curse and be laid waste—and because you tore your robes and wept in my presence, I also have heard you, declares the Lord .

source: Hijeh chun vetan, keiman nangma napu napate henga kapuiding, nalhansunga lhamong tah-a kipuilut ding nahin; hiche mun'a thilse kalhunsah dingchu namitna namulouhel ding ahi, tin gaseipeh-un ati. Hitichun hiche thuchu lengpa henga agalhut taovin ahi.
target: Therefore I will gather you to your ancestors, and you will be buried in peace. Your eyes will not see all the disaster I am going to bring on this place.’ ” So they took her answer back to the king.

source: Chuin lengpan mi asolin, Judah gam le Jerusalem'a upaho jouse ahenga akhomin ahi.
target: Then the king called together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

source: Chuin lengpa chu Judah mi jousele Jerusalem'a cheng jouse, chule thempuho le themgaoho, chule mijouse, alenle aneo agomin amatoh Pakai in'a achetouvun; Pakai in'a kimu kitepna lekhabua thujouse chu nakhang jouse jah dingin asimin ahi.
target: He went up to the temple of the Lord with the people of Judah, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the priests and the prophets—all the people from the least to the greatest. He read in their hearing all the words of the Book of the Covenant, which had been found in the temple of the Lord .

source: Chuin lengpa chu khompi koma adingin, Pakai nung juidingle, adan thupeh ho, athu hettohsah ho, achondan kisunho chu alungthim pumpi le ahinna pumpi-a juiding le, hiche lekhabua kisun kitepna ho jouse tongdoh dingin, Pakai angsunga chun kitepna aneijin ahi. Chule mipi jouse chun kitepna chu adin piuvin ahi.
target: The king stood by the pillar and renewed the covenant in the presence of the Lord —to follow the Lord and keep his commands, statutes and decrees with all his heart and all his soul, thus confirming the words of the covenant written in this book. Then all the people pledged themselves to the covenant.

source: Chule lengpan thempu chungnung Hilkiah, anoidou thempuho, chule kotngah ho chu Baal ding, thingbom ding, chule van janelpi dinga kisem um le bel jouse Pakai in'a kona ladohdin thu apen ahi. Chuin aman hicheho chu Jerusalem pama Kidron loujaova agouvin, avamho chu Bethel'a apotai.
target: The king ordered Hilkiah the high priest, the priests next in rank and the doorkeepers to remove from the temple of the Lord all the articles made for Baal and Asherah and all the starry hosts. He burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron Valley and took the ashes to Bethel.

source: Chule aman milimhou thempuho, Judah khopiho le Jerusalem kimvel munsang ho-a gimnamtui haldia Judah lengten anapansah hou; Baal, nisa, lhathah, vantham jola umho, chule van janelho henga gimnamtui hal hochu, ahaisah gamtai.
target: He did away with the idolatrous priests appointed by the kings of Judah to burn incense on the high places of the towns of Judah and on those around Jerusalem—those who burned incense to Baal, to the sun and moon, to the constellations and to all the starry hosts.

source: Chule aman thingbom chu Pakai in'a konin Jerusalem pamlam, Kidron vachadunga apodoh-in; Kidron vachadunga ahalvamin, dijetnin achil ngemin, adi chu mipi ho chate buikhuh chunga apaijin ahi.
target: He took the Asherah pole from the temple of the Lord to the Kidron Valley outside Jerusalem and burned it there. He ground it to powder and scattered the dust over the graves of the common people.

source: Chule Pakai in koma pasal kijoh ho umna, thingbom dinga numei hon pon akhon jinao inho chu asuchim gamtan ahi.
target: He also tore down the quarters of the male shrine prostitutes that were in the temple of the Lord , the quarters where women did weaving for Asherah.

source: Chule Judah khopiho-a konin thempu jouse apuidoh-in, thempuho ginnamtui halna munsang ho Geba'a pat Bersheba geijin asuboh soh helin; khopi kotpi lutna veilam sanga khopi vaipo Joshua kotpi lutna-a munsang ho chu asuchimin ahi.
target: Josiah brought all the priests from the towns of Judah and desecrated the high places, from Geba to Beersheba, where the priests had burned incense. He broke down the gateway at the entrance of the Gate of Joshua, the city governor, which was on the left of the city gate.

source: Munsang thempuho chu Jerusalem'a Pakai maichama ahunglou vangun, asopiteu lah-a chol solou changlhah vang ane naove.
target: Although the priests of the high places did not serve at the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem, they ate unleavened bread with their fellow priests.

source: Chule koimachan achapa ahiloule achanu Molech koma meija alelut louna din, Hinnom chate phaichama um Tophet chu asuboh'in ahi.
target: He desecrated Topheth, which was in the Valley of Ben Hinnom, so no one could use it to sacrifice their son or daughter in the fire to Molek.

source: Chule Pakai in lutna, lengpa noidou Nathan-melech indan koma um, Judah lenghon nisa dinga apeh-u sakol ho chu aladoh-in; nisa kangtalai ho chu meijin ahalin ahi.
target: He removed from the entrance to the temple of the Lord the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun. They were in the court near the room of an official named Nathan-Melek. Josiah then burned the chariots dedicated to the sun.

source: Chule Ahaz indan chungnung vuma Judah lenghon maicham asemhou, chule Manasseh'in Pakai inhong teni sunga maicham asemho chu lengpan avochimin, asubongin, aleivuiju chu Kidron vachadunga apai lutnin ahi.
target: He pulled down the altars the kings of Judah had erected on the roof near the upper room of Ahaz, and the altars Manasseh had built in the two courts of the temple of the Lord . He removed them from there, smashed them to pieces and threw the rubble into the Kidron Valley.

source: Chule Jerusalem masang, kitahlouna molsang jetlama um munsang ho, Israel lengpa Solomon'in Zidon mite pathen thet umtah Ashtoreth ding, Moab miho Pathen thet umtah Chemosh ding, Ammon chate pathen thet umtah Milcom dinga anasah hochu, lengpan asubohtan ahi.
target: The king also desecrated the high places that were east of Jerusalem on the south of the Hill of Corruption—the ones Solomon king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the vile goddess of the Sidonians, for Chemosh the vile god of Moab, and for Molek the detestable god of the people of Ammon.

source: Chuin milimho chu ahal halin asuchipmin, chule thingbomho chu aphuh lhun, amunho chun mihem gubuh-in adipme.
target: Josiah smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles and covered the sites with human bones.

source: Chukal valin Israelte chonsetsah Nebat chapa Jeroboam'in Bethel'a maicham le munsang asem munho chu asuchim soh-in; munsang chu ahalvamin, achil ngemin, thingbom chu ahalvamtai.
target: Even the altar at Bethel, the high place made by Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused Israel to sin—even that altar and high place he demolished. He burned the high place and ground it to powder, and burned the Asherah pole also.

source: Chuin Josiah agakiheile mola lhanho chu ahinmun, mi asolin, lhana konin guho chu agalahsah-in, hiche thu anasei, Pathen mipan anaphondoh Pakai thu dungjuijin, maicham chunga chun ahalvamin, asubohtai.
target: Then Josiah looked around, and when he saw the tombs that were there on the hillside, he had the bones removed from them and burned on the altar to defile it, in accordance with the word of the Lord proclaimed by the man of God who foretold these things.

source: Chuphatnin aman, khuche kagah mukhu ipi songphu ham? ati. Chuin khopi miho chun, Pathen mi, Judah gama kona hunga Bethel maicham chunga nathilbol saho hung seichoi masapa lhan ahi, tin ahiluve.
target: The king asked, “What is that tombstone I see?” The people of the city said, “It marks the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and pronounced against the altar of Bethel the very things you have done to it.”

source: Chuin aman limsah hih-un, koiman aguchu suloh hih-un, ati. Hitichun Samaria'a kona hung kipotou themgaoho gutoh umkhom louvin, achomkoi taove.
target: “Leave it alone,” he said. “Don’t let anyone disturb his bones.” So they spared his bones and those of the prophet who had come from Samaria.

source: Chule Israel lengten Pakai lunghan sahna-a asah-u, Samaria khopiho-a munsang inho jouse jongchu, Joshiah'in alamangin, Bethel'a abol bangin abolsoh keijin ahi.
target: Just as he had done at Bethel, Josiah removed all the shrines at the high places that the kings of Israel had built in the towns of Samaria and that had aroused the Lord ’s anger.

source: Chule munsang thempuho jouse jongchu maicham chunga athatnin; mi guho chu achunguva ahalin; chuin Jerusalem'a akiletai.
target: Josiah slaughtered all the priests of those high places on the altars and burned human bones on them. Then he went back to Jerusalem.

source: Chuin lengpan mijouse henga, hiche kitepna lekhabua kisun banghin, Pakai na Pathen'u henga kalchuh kut mangun, tin thu apei.
target: The king gave this order to all the people: “Celebrate the Passover to the Lord your God, as it is written in this Book of the Covenant.”

source: Tabbeh-in Israelte chunga thutan hon thu atan laijuva pat, Israel leng tele Judah lengte nikholai jousen jong, chutobanga kalchuh kut chu ana umkhapon ahi.
target: Neither in the days of the judges who led Israel nor in the days of the kings of Israel and the kings of Judah had any such Passover been observed.

source: Josiah lengchan kal kum somle kumget na-in, chuche kalchuh kut chu Jerusalem'a Pakai dingin ananei bepmun ahi.
target: But in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, this Passover was celebrated to the Lord in Jerusalem.

source: Chukal valin Pakai in'a thempu Hilkiah'in amudoh lekhabua danthupeh kisunho suhbulhit ahina dingin, lhakou ho, doithemho, milimho, alim kisunthu bolho, chule le Judah gamle Jerusalem'a thil thet um amujiho jouse chu Josiah'in asumang soh hele.
target: Furthermore, Josiah got rid of the mediums and spiritists, the household gods, the idols and all the other detestable things seen in Judah and Jerusalem. This he did to fulfill the requirements of the law written in the book that Hilkiah the priest had discovered in the temple of the Lord .

source: Mosi danthupeh dungjuija Pakai lama alungthim pumpi, alhagao pumpi, chule athaneinao pumpi-a kipe-a amatobang leng khatcha anaumpon, anungin jong ama tobang khatcha jong aum tapoi.
target: Neither before nor after Josiah was there a king like him who turned to the Lord as he did—with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his strength, in accordance with all the Law of Moses.

source: Achuti jeng vangin Pakai chun alunghana tijat umtah, Manasseh'in alunghan sahna jouse jeh-a, Judah chunga alunghana deujejua konchun adai lhadeh pon ahi.
target: Nevertheless, the Lord did not turn away from the heat of his fierce anger, which burned against Judah because of all that Manasseh had done to arouse his anger.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin, Israel kachon mang banga, Judah jonghi kamitmu-a kona kachon mang ding ahin; keiman kalhentum hiche khopi Jerusalem le, chu-a chu kamin umding ahi tia kanaseina hiche houin hi kapaidoh ding ahi, ati.
target: So the Lord said, “I will remove Judah also from my presence as I removed Israel, and I will reject Jerusalem, the city I chose, and this temple, about which I said, ‘My Name shall be there.’”

source: Tun Josiah thilbol dangho le anatoh jouse chu Judah lengte thusimbua kisuna hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Josiah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

source: Ama nikho laijin Egypt lengpa Pharoah-nechoh chu Assyria lengpa satdin Euphrates luipi-a akon touvin: chuin Josiah lengpa chu amapa kidoupidin achen; chuin Pharoah-nechoh'in ama amu phatnin Megiddo'a athat tai.
target: While Josiah was king, Pharaoh Necho king of Egypt went up to the Euphrates River to help the king of Assyria. King Josiah marched out to meet him in battle, but Necho faced him and killed him at Megiddo.

source: Chuin asohten Megiddo'a konin kangtalai khatna athilong chu apouvin, Jerusalem alhutnun, amatah lhana avuitaove. Chuin gamsung mite chun Josiah chapa Jehoahaz apuijun, thao anuvin, apa khelin lengin apansah taove.
target: Josiah’s servants brought his body in a chariot from Megiddo to Jerusalem and buried him in his own tomb. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz son of Josiah and anointed him and made him king in place of his father.

source: Jehoahaz alengchan patnin kum somni le kum thum ahin; Jerusalem'a lhathum aleng changin ahi. Anu minchu Hamutal ahin, Libnah'a Jeremiah chanu ahi.
target: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.

source: Chule aman apu apate thilbol jouse bangin, Pakai mitmun thilphalou jeng abolin ahi.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as his predecessors had done.

source: Chuin Pharoah-nechoh chun Jerusalem'a alengchan theilouna dingin, Hamath gama um Riblah'a ahen nin; chule agamu chu dangka talent jakhat le sana talent khat kai apohsah tan ahi.
target: Pharaoh Necho put him in chains at Riblah in the land of Hamath so that he might not reign in Jerusalem, and he imposed on Judah a levy of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

source: Chuin Pharoah-nechoh chun Josiah chapa Eliakim chu apa Josiah indan sunga chun alengchan sah-in, aminchu Jehoiakim'in akhelin, Jehoahaz chu apuimangtai. Chuin Pharoah'in Jehoahaz chu Egypt'a apuisuh-in, chua chun Jehoahaz athitai.
target: Pharaoh Necho made Eliakim son of Josiah king in place of his father Josiah and changed Eliakim’s name to Jehoiakim. But he took Jehoahaz and carried him off to Egypt, and there he died.

source: Chuin Jehoiakim'in dangka le sana chu Pharoah apen; ahinla Pharaoh thupeh dungjuija sum pehdingin gamsung chu kai apohsah cheh-in ahi. Aman Pharoad-nechoh pehdinga mitin ateppeh cheh bangtah-in, chuche gam miho chu dangka le sana kaijin apehsah cheh-in ahi.
target: Jehoiakim paid Pharaoh Necho the silver and gold he demanded. In order to do so, he taxed the land and exacted the silver and gold from the people of the land according to their assessments.

source: Jahoiakim chu alengchan tilin kum somni le kum nga ahin, Jerusalem'a kum somle kum khat alengchange. Chule anu minchu Zebudah ahin, Rumah mi Pedaiah chanu ahi.
target: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Zebidah daughter of Pedaiah; she was from Rumah.

source: Chule aman apu apate bolho jouse bangin Pakai mitmun thilphalou ngen abolin ahi.
target: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as his predecessors had done.

source: Ama nikho laichun Babylon lenga Nabuchadnezzar ahungtouvin, Jehoiakim chu kumthum asoh-in ahung pangin; chujouvin akile heijin chule ama douvin ahung pangtai.
target: During Jehoiakim’s reign, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded the land, and Jehoiakim became his vassal for three years. But then he turned against Nebuchadnezzar and rebelled.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin ama doudin Chaldea loiho, Syria loiho, Moab loiho, chule Ammon chate asolin, Pakaiyin themgaoho kama anasei thu dungjuijin, Judah douva sumangdingin asoltan ahi.
target: The Lord sent Babylonian, Aramean, Moabite and Ammonite raiders against him to destroy Judah, in accordance with the word of the Lord proclaimed by his servants the prophets.

source: Tabbeh-in Manasseh chonsetna ho jouse le athilbolho jouse dungjuija, amitmua kona chondoh nadinga, Pakaiya kona hiche thupeh hi hunglhunga ahi.
target: Surely these things happened to Judah according to the Lord ’s command, in order to remove them from his presence because of the sins of Manasseh and all he had done,

source: Chule themonabei thisan asojeh jong ahi: ajehchu Jerusalem chu monabei thisan sonan adiptan, Pakaiyin angaidam louding ahi.
target: including the shedding of innocent blood. For he had filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the Lord was not willing to forgive.

source: Tun Jehoiakim thilbol danghole atoh jouse chu Judah lengte thusimbua kisuna hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Jehoiakim’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

source: Hitichun Jehoiakim apu apate toh alumkhomin, achapa Jehoiachin ama khelin alengchang tai.
target: Jehoiakim rested with his ancestors. And Jehoiachin his son succeeded him as king.

source: Chuin Egypt lengpa chu agama konin ahungkit tapoi: ajehchu Babylon lengpan Egypt vapidunga kona Euphrates vadunglen gei, Egypt lengpa gamhop jouse alah ahitai.
target: The king of Egypt did not march out from his own country again, because the king of Babylon had taken all his territory, from the Wadi of Egypt to the Euphrates River.

source: Jehoiachin chu alengchan patnin kum somle kumget ahin, chule Jerusalem'a lhathum alengchange. Chule anu minchu Nehusta ahin, Jerusalem'a um Elnathan chanu ahi.
target: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta daughter of Elnathan; she was from Jerusalem.

source: Chuin aman apa thilbol jouse dungjuijin Pakai mitmun thilse jeng abolin ahi.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father had done.

source: Hiche laichun Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar sohpa Jerusalem dounan ahung touvin, khopi chu aumkul taovin ahi.
target: At that time the officers of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon advanced on Jerusalem and laid siege to it,

source: Chuin Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar khopi doudinga chu ahungleh, asohten anaumchah taovin ahi.
target: and Nebuchadnezzar himself came up to the city while his officers were besieging it.

source: Chuin Judah lengpa Jehoiachin chu ama le anu, asohte, amilenho, avaipoho toh Babylon lengpa henga achedoh-un; chuin alengchan kumget lhinin Babylon lengpan sohchangin akaitai.
target: Jehoiachin king of Judah, his mother, his attendants, his nobles and his officials all surrendered to him. In the eighth year of the reign of the king of Babylon, he took Jehoiachin prisoner.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin anasei bangchun, Pakai in'a goujouse le leng in'a goujouse chu hiche mun'a konchun apodoh-in, Pakai houin'a Israelte lengpa Solomon'in sana kong leh bel anasem jouse chu avokeh sohkeijin ahi.
target: As the Lord had declared, Nebuchadnezzar removed the treasures from the temple of the Lord and from the royal palace, and cut up the gold articles that Solomon king of Israel had made for the temple of the Lord .

source: Chuin Jerusalem'a mijouse, milen jouse, mihatle mihang jouse chu gal hing sangsom jen akaijin, khutthem jousele thih khengho jouse chu apuimang soh helin: gamsunga chun mipi avaicha dehho tailou koimacha aumtapoi.
target: He carried all Jerusalem into exile: all the officers and fighting men, and all the skilled workers and artisans—a total of ten thousand. Only the poorest people of the land were left.

source: Chuin Jehoiachin chu Babylon'a apui mangin, chule lengpa nu, lengpa jiteho, avaipoho, chule chuche gama mihat ho chu Jerusalem'a konin gal hingin Babylon'a akaitai.
target: Nebuchadnezzar took Jehoiachin captive to Babylon. He also took from Jerusalem to Babylon the king’s mother, his wives, his officials and the prominent people of the land.

source: Chule pasal hatjouse chu sangsagi jen, khutthemhole thih khengho sangkhat ahiuvin, amaho chu mihat le gal bolthei cheh ahiuvin, Babylon lengpan gal hingin Babylon'a akaitai.
target: The king of Babylon also deported to Babylon the entire force of seven thousand fighting men, strong and fit for war, and a thousand skilled workers and artisans.

source: Chuin Babylon lengpan Jehoiachin pa sopipa Mattaniah chu ama khelin alengchan sah-in, amin akhelpeh-in Zedekiah asahtai.
target: He made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s uncle, king in his place and changed his name to Zedekiah.

source: Zedekiah alengchan patnin kum somni le kum khat ahin, Jerusalem'a kum somle kum khat alengchange, chule anu minchu Hamutal ahin, Libnah kho-a Jeremiah chanu ahi.
target: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.

source: Chule Jehoiakim'in anabol bangin Pakai mitmun thilphalou jeng anabolin ahi.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as Jehoiakim had done.

source: Ajehchu Pakai lunghan na-a kona Jerusalem le Judah gamsung chu a-angsunga kona apaidoh kahse-a chuti chu soh-a ahi. Chuin Zedekiah chu Babylon lengpa dounan akiphin tan ahi.
target: It was because of the Lord ’s anger that all this happened to Jerusalem and Judah, and in the end he thrust them from his presence. Now Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

source: Chuin Zedekiah lengchan kal kum ko na, lha somna, chuche lha nisom na-in ahitin ahi, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar chu, amale asepaite toh Jerusalem dounan ahung konun, pal akai khumun, akimvela kul akai khumun ahi.
target: So in the ninth year of Zedekiah’s reign, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his whole army. He encamped outside the city and built siege works all around it.

source: Zedekiah lengpa lengchan kal kum somle kum khat na-in, khopi chu aum kimvel taove.
target: The city was kept under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

source: Chuin lha lina ni ko nichun khopi-a chun kel alhan, gamsung miho dingin an himhim aumtapoi.
target: By the ninth day of the fourth month the famine in the city had become so severe that there was no food for the people to eat.

source: Chuin khopi chu asukeh-un, galsatmi jouse chu lengpa honna kulbang ni kikah lampia chun jan-in ajamun; (tun Chaldea te chun khopi chu aum khumu ahin,) chuin lengpa chu phaicham lampi lama chun achen ahi.
target: Then the city wall was broken through, and the whole army fled at night through the gate between the two walls near the king’s garden, though the Babylonians were surrounding the city. They fled toward the Arabah,

source: Chuin Chaldea sepaihon lengpa chu anung delun, Jericho phaichama aphapa taovin; asepaite jouse chu ama-a konin akithecheh taove.
target: but the Babylonian army pursued the king and overtook him in the plains of Jericho. All his soldiers were separated from him and scattered,

source: Hitichun lengpa chu amanun, Babylon lengpa henga Riblah'a apuitouvun; achungthu atan taove.
target: and he was captured. He was taken to the king of Babylon at Riblah, where sentence was pronounced on him.

source: Chuin amahon Zedekiah chapate chu ama mitmu tah-in athatnun, chule Zedekiah chu amit akaldoh-un, sum-eng khaovin akanun, Babylon lama apuitaove.
target: They killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. Then they put out his eyes, bound him with bronze shackles and took him to Babylon.

source: Chuin Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar lengchan kal kum somle kumko na, alha ngana, chuche lha nisagi nichun, Babylon lengpa sohpa vetup ho gal lamkai Nebuzaradan chu Jerusalem'a ahungin;
target: On the seventh day of the fifth month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard, an official of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

source: Pakai in le lengpa in, chule Jerusalem'a injouse le milentakip in chu meijin ahallha gamtan ahi.
target: He set fire to the temple of the Lord , the royal palace and all the houses of Jerusalem. Every important building he burned down.

source: Chuin vetup vaipopa henga um chaldea sepai jouse chun, Jerusalem kimvela kulbangho chu asuchim gam taove.
target: The whole Babylonian army under the commander of the imperial guard broke down the walls around Jerusalem.

source: Tun khopi sunga kidalha mipi dangho, chule Babylon lengpa henga kona jammangho, chule amoh tamtah ho chu vetuploi lamkai Nebuzaradan'in apuimang sohtai.
target: Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard carried into exile the people who remained in the city, along with the rest of the populace and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon.

source: Ahinla gamsunga mivaichaho chu vetup loi lamkaipa chun lengpilei lhouding le louboldin adalha tai.
target: But the commander left behind some of the poorest people of the land to work the vineyards and fields.

source: Chuin Pakai insunga sum-eng khomho, chule twikongho, Pakai insunga sum-eng twidol, chule atunna sum-eng ho chu Babylon'a apotaove.
target: The Babylonians broke up the bronze pillars, the movable stands and the bronze Sea that were at the temple of the Lord and they carried the bronze to Babylon.

source: Chule bel ho, vutlonaho, chaicheho, thihkheho, chule sum-enga kisem um le bel jouse chu amahon apomang taovin ahi.
target: They also took away the pots, shovels, wick trimmers, dishes and all the bronze articles used in the temple service.

source: Chule khangbelho, sumlheng ho, chule chutobang thilho chu, sana chu sana-in, dangka chu dangka-in ngahtup gallamkai pan apomangtai.
target: The commander of the imperial guard took away the censers and sprinkling bowls—all that were made of pure gold or silver.

source: Solomon in Pakai in dinga anasem khom ni, twidol khat, chule atunna, umle bel ho jouse sum-eng chu tejougol ahipoi.
target: The bronze from the two pillars, the Sea and the movable stands, which Solomon had made for the temple of the Lord , was more than could be weighed.

source: Khompi khat sanje chu tong somle tong get ahin, achunga aluboh chu sum-eng ahi; aluboh sanje chu tong thum ahin, chule aluboh chung kimvel chu kolbuthei lim kigeipol chitchetna, ajepna chu sum-eng jeng hija ahi. Hiche tobangma-a hi khompi nina-a jong chu akigeipol chitchet uma ahi.
target: Each pillar was eighteen cubits high. The bronze capital on top of one pillar was three cubits high and was decorated with a network and pomegranates of bronze all around. The other pillar, with its network, was similar.

source: Chuin ngahtup vaipopa chun thempu chungnung Seraiah, thempu nina Zephaniah, chule kotngah thumho chu amanin;
target: The commander of the guard took as prisoners Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the priest next in rank and the three doorkeepers.

source: Chule aman khopi sunga galbolho chunga vaipo toh, khopi sunga lengpa anga ana umjing mi nga toh, gamsunga mipi ho min sunlutji janelho lekhasun pipuipa toh, khopisunga um gamsung mipilah a mi somgup toh amanin ahi.
target: Of those still in the city, he took the officer in charge of the fighting men, and five royal advisers. He also took the secretary who was chief officer in charge of conscripting the people of the land and sixty of the conscripts who were found in the city.

source: Chuin ngahtup vaipo Nebuzaradan'in amaho chu akaijin, Riblah'a Babylon lengpa henga apuitai.
target: Nebuzaradan the commander took them all and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.

source: Chuin Babylon lengpan amaho chu Hamath gamsunga um Riblah'a mun'a chun amaho chu athat gamin ahi. Hitichun Judah chu agamuva konin apuimangtai.
target: There at Riblah, in the land of Hamath, the king had them executed. So Judah went into captivity, away from her land.

source: Chule Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in adalhah, Judah gama umden hoding chun, aman Shaphan chapa Ahikam chapa Gedaliah chu achunguva gamvaipo din asem peh-in ahi.
target: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, to be over the people he had left behind in Judah.

source: Chuin galsat lamkaiho jouse, amahole amiteuvin Babylon lengpan Gedaliah chu gamvaipodin asemtai ti ajah phatnun, Nethaniah chapa Ishmael, Careah chapa Johanan, Netophah mi Tanhumeth chapa Seraiah, Maachath mi chapa Jaazaniah amahole amiteu chu Mizpah'a Gadaliah henga ahunguvin ahi.
target: When all the army officers and their men heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah as governor, they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah—Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, Jaazaniah the son of the Maakathite, and their men.

source: Chuin Gedaliah amahole amiteu henga akihahselin, ajah uvah, Chaldea ho soh hiding kicha hih-un; gamsunga chun chengun lang Babylon lengpa jenmaijun; chutile nangho dinga thilpha hiding ahi, ati.
target: Gedaliah took an oath to reassure them and their men. “Do not be afraid of the Babylonian officials,” he said. “Settle down in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you.”

source: Ahinla lha sagina-in ahitin ahi, lengte chilhah-a kon Elisha chapa Nethania chapa Ishmael chu pasal somtoh ahungin, Gedaliah le Mizpah'a aumpi Judah tele Chaldea te chu anokhumun athat taovin ahi.
target: In the seventh month, however, Ishmael son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, who was of royal blood, came with ten men and assassinated Gedaliah and also the men of Judah and the Babylonians who were with him at Mizpah.

source: Chuin mijouse, alen aneo, chule galsat vaipoho, akipatnun Egypt'a ahungtaove; ajehchu Chaldea te chu akichatnu ahi.
target: At this, all the people from the least to the greatest, together with the army officers, fled to Egypt for fear of the Babylonians.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Judah lengpa Jehoiachin sohchan kal kum somthumna, lha somle lhanina, nisomni le sagini na-in, Babylon lengpa Evil-merodach ahung lengchan kum kipat chun, Judah lengpa Jehoiachin chu songkul'a konin alhadoh tan ahi.
target: In the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the year Awel-Marduk became king of Babylon, he released Jehoiachin king of Judah from prison. He did this on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month.

source: Chule ahenga lungsetna neitah-in thu aseijin, Babylon'a amatoh umkhom lengho jouselaltouna vuma chun ama laltouna adosangpeh-in;
target: He spoke kindly to him and gave him a seat of honor higher than those of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.

source: Asongkul von akhelpeh-in, ahinkho lhumkeijin a-anga an anejom jingtan ahi.
target: So Jehoiachin put aside his prison clothes and for the rest of his life ate regularly at the king’s table.

source: Chule alo chu ahile, lengpan niseh-in a-an nehding ape jingin, ahinkho lhumkeijin niseh-in achang neijin ape jingin ahi.
target: Day by day the king gave Jehoiachin a regular allowance as long as he lived.

source: Adam, Seth, Enosh;
target: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

source: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared;
target: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

source: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech;
target: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, Noah.

source: Noah, Shem, Ham, chule Japheth.
target: The sons of Noah: Shem, Ham and Japheth.

source: Japheth chapate chu: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech chule Tiras ahiuve.
target: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek and Tiras.

source: Chule Gomer chapate chu: Ashkenaz, Riphath chule Togarmah ahiuve.
target: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath and Togarmah.

source: Chule Javan chapate chu: Elishah, Tarshish, Chittim chule Dodanim.
target: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites and the Rodanites.

source: Ham chapate chu: Cush, Mizraim, Put, Canaan ahiuve.
target: The sons of Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put and Canaan.

source: Cush chapate chu: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah chule Sabtecha ahiuve. Chule Raamah chapate chu: Sheba le Dedan ahi.
target: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah and Sabteka. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

source: Chule Cush'in Nimrod ahingin; Amachu leisetna mihat masapen ahunghitai.
target: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who became a mighty warrior on earth.

source: Chule Mizraim'in Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
target: Egypt was the father of the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites,

source: Pathrusim, Casluhim (ama-a kona Philistine te hungdoh ahi), chule Caphthorim ahinge.
target: Pathrusites, Kasluhites (from whom the Philistines came) and Caphtorites.

source: Chule Canaan'in chapa masapen Sidon, abana Heth,
target: Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,

source: Jebush miho, Amor miho, Girgas miho,
target: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,

source: Hiv miho, Ark miho, Sin miho,
target: Hivites, Arkites, Sinites,

source: Arvad miho, Zemar miho, chule Hamath miho ahingin ahi.
target: Arvadites, Zemarites and Hamathites.

source: Shem chapate chu: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether chule Meshech ahiuve.
target: The sons of Shem: Elam, Ashur, Arphaxad, Lud and Aram. The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether and Meshek.

source: Chule Arphaxad'in Shelah ahingin, Shelah'in Eber ahinge.
target: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah the father of Eber.

source: Chule Eber'a konin cha pasal ni apengin, khatpa minchu Peleg ahi, ajehchu ama nikho laijin leiset ana kikhena ahi; chule asopipa minchu Joktan ahi.
target: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided; his brother was named Joktan.

source: Chule Joktan'in Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
target: Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

source: Hadoram jong, Uzal, Diklah,
target: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

source: Chule Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,
target: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

source: Chule Ophir, Havilah le Jobab ahingin ahi. Hichengse hi Joktan chapate ahiuve.
target: Ophir, Havilah and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.

source: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah;
target: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,

source: Eber, Peleg, Reu;
target: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

source: Serug, Nahor, Terah;
target: Serug, Nahor, Terah

source: Abram; hichu Abraham ahi.
target: and Abram (that is, Abraham).

source: Abraham chapateni chu: Isaac le Ishmael ahilhone.
target: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

source: Hichehohi akhangguiju ahi: Ishmael chapa lenpen chu Nebaioth ahin, chejouchun Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
target: These were their descendants: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

source: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
target: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

source: Jetur, Naphish, chule Kedemah ahiuve. Hichehohi Ishmael chapate ahiuve.
target: Jetur, Naphish and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.

source: Tun Abraham thaikem Keturah chapate chu: amanun Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, chule Shuah ahinge. Chule Jokshan chapateni chu: Sheba le Dedan ahilhone.
target: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

source: Chule Midian chapate chu: Ephah, Epher, Henoch, Abida chule Eldaah ahi. Hichehosehi Keturah chapate ahiuve.
target: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanok, Abida and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Keturah.

source: Chule Abraham'in Isaac ahinge. Isaac chapateni chu Esau le Israel ahilhone.
target: Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

source: Esau chapate chu: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam chule Korah ahiuve.
target: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam and Korah.

source: Eliphaz chapate chu: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna chule Amalek ahiuve.
target: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam and Kenaz; by Timna: Amalek.

source: Reuel chapate chu: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah chule Mizzah ahiuve.
target: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah.

source: Chule Seir chapate chu: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer chule Dishan ahiuve.
target: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer and Dishan.

source: Chule Lotan chapateni chu: Hori le Homam ahilhonin, Timna chu Lotan sopinu ahi.
target: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.

source: Shobal chapate chu: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, chule Onam ahiuve. Chule Zibeon chapateni chu Aiah le Anah ahilhone.
target: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

source: Anah chapa chu Dishon ahi. Chule Dishon chapate chu: Amran, Eshban, Ithran chule Keran ahiuve.
target: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran and Keran.

source: Ezer chapate chu: Bilhan, Zavan chule Jakan ahiuve. Dishan chapateni chu Uz le Aran ahilhone.
target: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan and Akan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

source: Israel chate chunga leng khatchan vai ahom masanga Edom gama analengchangte lengho chu tun hichehohi ahiuve. Beor chapa Bela ahin; chule akhopi minchu Dinhabah ahi.
target: These were the kings who reigned in Edom before any Israelite king reigned: Bela son of Beor, whose city was named Dinhabah.

source: Chule Bela athiphatnin Bozrah'a um Zerah chapa Jobab ama khelin analeng change.
target: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah succeeded him as king.

source: Chule Jobab athiphatnin Teman ho gama Husham ama khelin aleng changin ahi.
target: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites succeeded him as king.

source: Chule Husham athiphatnin Bedad chapa Hadad, Moab phaija Midia ho joupa chu ama khelin aleng changin, chule akhopi minchu Avith ahi.
target: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, succeeded him as king. His city was named Avith.

source: Chule Hadad athiphatnin Masrekah'a um Samlah ama khelin aleng changin ahi.
target: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah succeeded him as king.

source: Chule Samlah athiphatnin vadung panga Rehoboth'a um Shual ama khelin analeng change.
target: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the river succeeded him as king.

source: Chule Shual athiphatnin Achbor chapa Baalhanan ama khelin aleng changin ahi.
target: When Shaul died, Baal-Hanan son of Akbor succeeded him as king.

source: Chule Baalhanan athiphatnin ama khelin Hadad alengchange; chule akhopi min Pai ahi, chule ajinu minchu Mezahab chanu Matred chanu Mehatabel ahi.
target: When Baal-Hanan died, Hadad succeeded him as king. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-Zahab.

source: Hada jong athitan ahi. Chule Edom leng noidouho chu: leng noidou Timna, leng noidou Aliah, leng noidou Pinon,
target: Hadad also died. The chiefs of Edom were: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,

source: Leng noidou Aholibamah, leng noidou Elah, leng noidou Pinon,
target: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,

source: Leng noidou Kenaz, leng noidou Teman, leng noidou Mibzar,
target: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,

source: Leng noidou Magdiel, leng noidou Iram, hichehohi Edom leng noidouho ahiuve.
target: Magdiel and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.

source: Israel chapate chu hichehohi ahiuve: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
target: These were the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

source: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad chule Asher.
target: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

source: Judah chapate chu: Er, Onan chule Shelah ahiuvin, amaho thum chu Canaan mi Shua chanu-a kona peng ahiuve. Judah chapa lenpen Er chu Pakai mitmun agilou lheh jengin, hitichun Pakaiyin athattan ahi.
target: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan and Shelah. These three were born to him by a Canaanite woman, the daughter of Shua. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the Lord ’s sight; so the Lord put him to death.

source: Amounu Tamar'in Pharez le Zerah ahinpeh-in ahi. Judah chapate chu abonun mi nga ahiuve.
target: Judah’s daughter-in-law Tamar bore Perez and Zerah to Judah. He had five sons in all.

source: Pharez chapateni chu Hezron le Hamul ahilhone.
target: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

source: Zerah chapate chu: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calkol chule Dara ahiuvin, abonun mi nga ahiuve.
target: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Kalkol and Darda—five in all.

source: Carmi chapa chu Akar ahin, Israel sunohphah-a sapset thila suhkhel nei ahi.
target: The son of Karmi: Achar, who brought trouble on Israel by violating the ban on taking devoted things.

source: Chule Ethan chapa chu Azariah ahi.
target: The son of Ethan: Azariah.

source: Hezron'a kona hungpeng achapate chu: Jerahmeel, Ram chule Chelubai ahiuve.
target: The sons born to Hezron were: Jerahmeel, Ram and Caleb.

source: Chule Ram'in Amminadab ahingin; chule Amminadab'in Judah chate pipu pa Nahshon ahingin ahi.
target: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab the father of Nahshon, the leader of the people of Judah.

source: Chule Nahshon'in Salma ahingin, chule Salma'in Boaz ahinge.
target: Nahshon was the father of Salmon, Salmon the father of Boaz,

source: Chule Boaz'in Obed ahingin, chule Obed'in Jesse ahingin ahi.
target: Boaz the father of Obed and Obed the father of Jesse.

source: Chule Jesse'in achapa peng masapen chu Eliab ahin, anina Abinadab, athumna Shimma,
target: Jesse was the father of Eliab his firstborn; the second son was Abinadab, the third Shimea,

source: Ali channa Nethaneel, anga channa Raddai,
target: the fourth Nethanel, the fifth Raddai,

source: Agup channa Ozem, asagi channa chu David ahinge.
target: the sixth Ozem and the seventh David.

source: Asopiu numei teni minchu Zeruiah le Abigail ahilhone. Chule Zeruiah chapate chu: Abishai, Joab chule Asahel ahin, mi thum ahiuve.
target: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah’s three sons were Abishai, Joab and Asahel.

source: Chule Abigail'in Amasa ahingin; chule Amasa pachu Ishmael mi Jether ahi.
target: Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.

source: Chule Hezron chapa Caleb'in ajinu Azubah le Jerioth'a konin chate ahingin, achapate chu: Jesher, Shobab chule Ardon ahiuve.
target: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah (and by Jerioth). These were her sons: Jesher, Shobab and Ardon.

source: Azubah athi phatnin Caleb in Ephrath akichenpi kitnin Hur ahinge.
target: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.

source: Hur'in Uri ahingin, chule Uri'in Bezaleel ahinge.
target: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri the father of Bezalel.

source: Hiche nungchun Hezron Gilead pa Machir chanu henga ache-in, kum somgup ahinungin akichenpin; chule amanun Segup ahinpeh-in ahi.
target: Later, Hezron, when he was sixty years old, married the daughter of Makir the father of Gilead. He made love to her, and she bore him Segub.

source: Segup'in Jair ahingin, aman Gilead gama khopi somni le thum aneije.
target: Segub was the father of Jair, who controlled twenty-three towns in Gilead.

source: Aman amaho'a konin Geshur le Aram, Jair khopihotoh, chule Kenath toh akhopiho, khopi somgup jen alahpeh-in ahi. Hicheho jousehi Gilead pa Machir chapate-a ngen ahi.
target: (But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth Jair, as well as Kenath with its surrounding settlements—sixty towns.) All these were descendants of Makir the father of Gilead.

source: Chuche nunga Caleb-ephrathah mun Hezron'a athi phatnin, Hezron inneipi Abijah'in Tekoa pa Ashur chu ahinpeh-in ahi.
target: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah the wife of Hezron bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

source: Hezron chapa masapen Jerahmeel sonho chapate chu apeng masapen Ram ahin, chule Bunah, Oren, Ozem le Ahijah ahiuve.
target: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron: Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem and Ahijah.

source: Jerahmeel'in jidang jong aneijin amin Atarah ahi: Amanuhi Onam nu ahi.
target: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

source: Jerahmeel chapa masapen Ram chapate chu; Maaz, Jamin chule Eker ahiuve.
target: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin and Eker.

source: Onam chapateni chu Shammai le Jada ahilhonin; chule Shammai chapateni Nadab le Abishur ahi.
target: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

source: Abishur inneipi min chu Abihail ahin, amanun Ahban le Molid ahinpeh-e.
target: Abishur’s wife was named Abihail, who bore him Ahban and Molid.

source: Nadab chapateni chu Seled le Appaim ahin, Seled vang chahing louvin athitan ahi.
target: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.

source: Appaim chapa chu Ishi ahin; Ishi chapa chu Sheshan ahi. Chule Sheshan chapa chu Ahlai ahi.
target: The son of Appaim: Ishi, who was the father of Sheshan. Sheshan was the father of Ahlai.

source: Shammai sopipa Jada chapateni chu Jether le Jonathan ahilhone. Chule Jether chu chabeijin athitan ahi.
target: The sons of Jada, Shammai’s brother: Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.

source: Jonathan chapateni chu Peleth le Zaza ahilhone. Hichehohi Jerahmeel chapate ahiuve.
target: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.

source: Tun Sheshan'in chanuho tailou cha pasal aneipon ahi. Chule Sheshan'in Egypt mi Jarha kiti soh khat aneijin ahi.
target: Sheshan had no sons—only daughters. He had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.

source: Sheshan'in asohpa Jarha jidingin achanu apen, amanun Attai ahinpeh-e.
target: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore him Attai.

source: Attai'in Nathan ahingin, chule Nathan'in Jabad ahingin,
target: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan the father of Zabad,

source: Jabad'in Ephlal ahingin, chule Ephlal'in Obed ahingin,
target: Zabad the father of Ephlal, Ephlal the father of Obed,

source: Obed'in Jehu ahingin, chule Jehu'n Azariah ahingin,
target: Obed the father of Jehu, Jehu the father of Azariah,

source: Azariah'in Helez ahingin, chule Helez'in Eleasah ahingin,
target: Azariah the father of Helez, Helez the father of Eleasah,

source: Eleasah'in Sisamai ahingin, chule Sisamai'in Shallum ahingin,
target: Eleasah the father of Sismai, Sismai the father of Shallum,

source: Shallum'in Jekamiah ahingin, chule Jekamiah'in Elishama ahingin ahi.
target: Shallum the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah the father of Elishama.

source: Tun Jerahmeel sopipa Caleb chapate chu: achapa masapen chu Mesha ahin, amachu Ziphte pa ahin; chule Hebron pa Mereshah chapate ahiuve.
target: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and his son Mareshah, who was the father of Hebron.

source: Hebron chapate chu; Korah, Tappuah, Rekem chule Shema ahiuve.
target: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem and Shema.

source: Shema'in Jorkeam pa Raham ahingin, chule Rekem'in Shammai ahinge.
target: Shema was the father of Raham, and Raham the father of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai.

source: Shammai chapa chu Maon ahin; chule Maon chu Beth-zur pa ahi.
target: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.

source: Caleb thaikemnu Ephah'in Haran, Moza chule Gazez ahinge, chule Haran'in Gazez ahingin ahi.
target: Caleb’s concubine Ephah was the mother of Haran, Moza and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.

source: Jahdai chapate chu; Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah chule Shaaph ahiuve.
target: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah and Shaaph.

source: Caleb thaikemnu Maachah'in Shebor le Tirhanah ahinge.
target: Caleb’s concubine Maakah was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah.

source: Amanun Madmannah pa Shaaph toh Machbenah pa Sheva chule Gibeah pa ahingin: chule Caleb chanu chu Achsah ahi.
target: She also gave birth to Shaaph the father of Madmannah and to Sheva the father of Makbenah and Gibea. Caleb’s daughter was Aksah.

source: Caleb chilhah ho chu: Ephrathah chapa masapen Hur chapate, Kirjath-jearim pa Shobal,
target: These were the descendants of Caleb. The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,

source: Bethlehem pa Salma, chule Beth-gader pa Hareph ahiuve.
target: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.

source: Kirjath-jearim pa Shobal'in chapate aneijin: Haroeh le Manaheth miho akehkhat ahiuve.
target: The descendants of Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim were: Haroeh, half the Manahathites,

source: Kirjath-jearim insungmiho chu Ithra miho, Puth miho, Shumath miho, chule Mishrai miho ahiuve: amaho-a konchun Zareath miho le Eshtaul miho ahungdoh uve.
target: and the clans of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites and Mishraites. From these descended the Zorathites and Eshtaolites.

source: Salma chapate chu; Bethlehem chule Netophah miho, Netophah miho, Joab insungmi Atroth, chule Manaheth mite akehkhat le Zor miho ahiuve.
target: The descendants of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, half the Manahathites, the Zorites,

source: Jabez'a cheng danthusunho insung mite chu; Tirath miho, Shimeath miho, chule Suchath miho ahiuve. Hicheho hi Rechab insung pa Hamath'a kona hungdoh Ken mite ahiuve.
target: and the clans of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, Shimeathites and Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the Rekabites.

source: Tun hichehohi David chapate Hebron'a pengho ahiuve: Acha masapen chu Amnon ahin, Jezreel numeinu Ahinoam'a kon ahi; anina Daniel ahin, Karmel numeinu Abigail'a kon ahin,
target: These were the sons of David born to him in Hebron: The firstborn was Amnon the son of Ahinoam of Jezreel; the second, Daniel the son of Abigail of Carmel;

source: Athum channa chu Geshur lengpa Talmai chanu Maachah chapa Absalom ahin, ali channa chu Haggith chapa Adonijah ahi:
target: the third, Absalom the son of Maakah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;

source: Anga channa chu Abital chapa Shephatiah ahin; agup channa a-inneipi Eglah'in ahinpeh Ithream ahi.
target: the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital; and the sixth, Ithream, by his wife Eglah.

source: Hiche guphohi Hebron'a peng ahiuvin; chule ama hia chun kum sagi le lhagup alengchange. Chule ama Jerusalem'a kum somthum le kumthum aleng changin ahi.
target: These six were born to David in Hebron, where he reigned seven years and six months. David reigned in Jerusalem thirty-three years,

source: Chule Ammiel chanu Bath-shua'in Jerusalem'a ahin achapate li hochu: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan chule Solomon ahiuve:
target: and these were the children born to him there: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan and Solomon. These four were by Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel.

source: Chujongle Ibhar, Elishama chule Eliphelet,
target: There were also Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet,

source: Chule Nogah, Nepheg le Japhia,
target: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

source: Elishama, Eliada chule Eliphelet, mi ko ahiuve.
target: Elishama, Eliada and Eliphelet—nine in all.

source: Hichengsehi athaikemho chapate tilouvin David chapate ngen ahiuvin, chule asopinu-u Tamar toh ahi.
target: All these were the sons of David, besides his sons by his concubines. And Tamar was their sister.

source: Solomon chapa chu Rehoboam ahin, Rehoboam chapa chu Abia ahin, Abijah chapa chu Asa ahin, Asa chapa chu Jehoshaphat ahin,
target: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

source: Jehoshaphat chapa chu Joram ahin, Joram chapa Ahaziah ahin, Ahaziah chapa chu Joash ahin,
target: Jehoram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

source: Joash chapa chu Amajiah ahin, Amajiah chapa Azariah ahin, Azariah chapa chu Jotham ahin,
target: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

source: Jotham chapa chu Ahaz ahin, Ahaz chapa chu Hezekiah ahin, Hezekiah chapa chu Manasseh ahin,
target: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

source: Manasseh chapa chu Amon ahin, Amon chapa chu Josiah ahin,
target: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

source: Chule Josiah chapate apeng masapen chu Johanan, anina Jehoiakim, athum channa Zedekiah, ali channa chu Shallum ahi.
target: The sons of Josiah: Johanan the firstborn, Jehoiakim the second son, Zedekiah the third, Shallum the fourth.

source: Chule Jehoiakim chapateni chu: Jeconiah le Zedekiah ahilhone.
target: The successors of Jehoiakim: Jehoiachin his son, and Zedekiah.

source: Chule Jeconiah chapate chu; Assir, achapa Salathiel,
target: The descendants of Jehoiachin the captive: Shealtiel his son,

source: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazar, Jekamiah, Hoshama chule Nedabiah ahiuve.
target: Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama and Nedabiah.

source: Chule Pedaiah chapateni chu Zerubbabel le Shimei ahilhonin; chule Zerubbabel chapateni chu Meshullam le Hananiah ahilhonin, asopinulhon chu Shelomith ahi.
target: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah. Shelomith was their sister.

source: Chule Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah chule Jushabhesed mi nga ahiuve.
target: There were also five others: Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah and Jushab-Hesed.

source: Hananiah chapate chu Pelatiah le Jesaiah ahin, Rephaiah chapate, Arnan chapate, Obadiah chapate, Shechaniah chapate ahiuve.
target: The descendants of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, and the sons of Rephaiah, of Arnan, of Obadiah and of Shekaniah.

source: Chule Shechaniah chapa chu Shemaiah ahin, Shemaiah chapate chu Hattush, Igeal, Bariah, Neariah chule Shaphat, mi gup ahiuve.
target: The descendants of Shekaniah: Shemaiah and his sons: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah and Shaphat—six in all.

source: Neariah chapate chu Elioenai, Hezekiah chule Azrikam, mi thum ahiuve.
target: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah and Azrikam—three in all.

source: Chule Elioenai chapate chu Hodaiah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah chule Anani, mi sagi ahiuve.
target: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah and Anani—seven in all.

source: Judah chapate chu; Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur chule Shobal ahiuve.
target: The descendants of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur and Shobal.

source: Shobal chapa Reaiah'in Jahath ahingin, chule Jahath'in Ahumai le Lahad ahinge. Hichehohi Zorath miho insung mite ahiuve.
target: Reaiah son of Shobal was the father of Jahath, and Jahath the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.

source: Chule hichehohi Etam pa chapate ahi: Jezreel, Ishma chule Idbash ahiuvin, asopinu-u minchu Hazzelelponi ahi.
target: These were the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma and Idbash. Their sister was named Hazzelelponi.

source: Gedor pa Penuel le Hushah pa Ezer toh, hichehohi Bethlehem pa Ephrathah cha masapen Hur chate ahiuve.
target: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These were the descendants of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and father of Bethlehem.

source: Chule Tekoa pa Ashhur'in ji ni, Helah le Naarah aneijin ahi.
target: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

source: Naarah'in Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni chule Haahashtari ahinpeh-in ahi. Hichehohi Naarah chapate ahiuve.
target: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni and Haahashtari. These were the descendants of Naarah.

source: Chule Helah chapate chu Zereth, Zerer chule Ethnan ahiuve.
target: The sons of Helah: Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan,

source: Chuin Coz'in Anub, Zobebah le Harum chapa Aharhel insung mite ahinge.
target: and Koz, who was the father of Anub and Hazzobebah and of the clans of Aharhel son of Harum.

source: Jabez vangchu asopi dangho sangin ja aumpenin, anun lung hesoh puma kavop ahi atijeh-a amin Jabez asah ahi.
target: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, “I gave birth to him in pain.”

source: Chuin Jabez Pathen henga ataovin, O, nangman phatthei neiboh teiding hihen lang, kagamsung nasuh letna, nakhut chu kakoma umjinga, thilphalouvin eilungdon sahlou nadinga hiche-a kona chu neihuhdoh ding hitavele! ati. Hichun Pathen'in angeh chu aphal pehtai.
target: Jabez cried out to the God of Israel, “Oh, that you would bless me and enlarge my territory! Let your hand be with me, and keep me from harm so that I will be free from pain.” And God granted his request.

source: Chule Shuah sopipa Chelub'in Eshton pa Mehir ahingin ahi.
target: Kelub, Shuhah’s brother, was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

source: Eshton'in Beth-rapha, Paseah chule Irnahash pa Tehinnah ahinge, hichehohi Rekah mite ahiuve.
target: Eshton was the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These were the men of Rekah.

source: Kenaz chapateni chu: Othniel le Seraiah ahilhone; chule Othniel chapa chu Hathath ahi.
target: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath and Meonothai.

source: Meonothai'in Ophrah ahingin, Seraiah'in Charashim phaicham semdohpa Joab ahinge. Amahohi khutthem mi ahiuve.
target: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of Ge Harashim. It was called this because its people were skilled workers.

source: Jephunneh chapa Caleb chapate chu: Iru, Elah chule Naam ahiuvin; chule Elah chapa chu Kenaz ahi.
target: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.

source: Jehalelel chapate chu: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria chule Asareel ahiuve.
target: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria and Asarel.

source: Ezrah chapate chu: Jether, Mered, Epher chule Jalon ahiuvin; chule Mered inneipin Miriam, Shammai chule Eshtemoa pa Isbah ahinge.
target: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher and Jalon. One of Mered’s wives gave birth to Miriam, Shammai and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

source: A-inneipi Jehudijah chun Gedor pa Jered, Socho Pa Heber, chule Zanoah pa Jekuthiel ahingin ahi. Hichehohi Mered'in akichenpi Pharaoh chanu Bithiah chapate hochu ahiuve.
target: (His wife from the tribe of Judah gave birth to Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soko, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.) These were the children of Pharaoh’s daughter Bithiah, whom Mered had married.

source: Chule Naham sopinu Hodiah inneipi chapate chu; Garm mite pa Keilah ahin, chule Eshtemoa mite pa Maachath ahi.
target: The sons of Hodiah’s wife, the sister of Naham: the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maakathite.

source: Shimon chapate chu: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan chule Tilon ahiuvin; chule Ishi chapateni chu Zoheth le Benzoheth ahilhone.
target: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-Hanan and Tilon. The descendants of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-Zoheth.

source: Judah chapa Shelah chapate chu: Lecah pa Er, Mareshah pa Laadah, chule Ashbea inkon tupat ponnem khong insung miho,
target: The sons of Shelah son of Judah: Er the father of Lekah, Laadah the father of Mareshah and the clans of the linen workers at Beth Ashbea,

source: Jokim le Chozeba mite, Joash, Moab gam chunga thuneina ananei Saraph, chule Jashubi-lahem ahiuve. Tun hichehohi khanglui thu ahitai.
target: Jokim, the men of Kozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who ruled in Moab and Jashubi Lehem. (These records are from ancient times.)

source: Hichehohi beldengho ahiuvin, amaho chu thingbil lah-a achengun; hiche mun'a chu lengpa natong dinga cheng ahiuve.
target: They were the potters who lived at Netaim and Gederah; they stayed there and worked for the king.

source: Simeon chapate chu: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zarah chule Shaul:
target: The descendants of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah and Shaul;

source: Achapa Sahllum, achapa Mibsam, chule achapa Mishma ahiuve.
target: Shallum was Shaul’s son, Mibsam his son and Mishma his son.

source: Mishma chapate chu: achapa Hamuel, achapa Zaccur, achapa Shimei ahiuve.
target: The descendants of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zakkur his son and Shimei his son.

source: Shimei'in chapa somlegup le chanu aneije, ahivangin asopihon cha tampi aneipouve, Judah chate bangin a-insung miteu apungpon ahi.
target: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers did not have many children; so their entire clan did not become as numerous as the people of Judah.

source: Amaho Beersheba, Moladah, chule Hazarshual'ah achengun ahi.
target: They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar Shual,

source: Bilhah, Ezem chule Toladah,
target: Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,

source: Bethuel, Hormah, chule Ziklag'ah,
target: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,

source: Bethmarcaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbirei, chule Shaaraim'a jong achengun ahi. Hicheho chengsehi David lengchan geija akhopihou ahi.
target: Beth Markaboth, Hazar Susim, Beth Biri and Shaaraim. These were their towns until the reign of David.

source: Chule akhohou chu; Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen chule Ashan, khopi len nga ahin;
target: Their surrounding villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Token and Ashan—five towns—

source: Chuche Baal changeija khopilenho kimvela um khoho jouse ahi. Hichehohi achennao chule akhangguiju ahi.
target: and all the villages around these towns as far as Baalath. These were their settlements. And they kept a genealogical record.

source: Meshobab, Jamlech le Amaziah chapa Joshah,
target: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah,

source: Joel le Joshibiah chapa Jehu, Seraiah chapa, Asiel chapa,
target: Joel, Jehu son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

source: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel chule Benaiah,
target: also Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,

source: Shiphi chapa Ziza, Allon chapa, Jedaiah chapa, Shimri chapa, Shemaiah chapa:
target: and Ziza son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah.

source: Hiche amin kikut hohi a-insunguva pipui ngenchang ahiuve, chule apu apateu insung chu ahapun lheh jengin ahi.
target: The men listed above by name were leaders of their clans. Their families increased greatly,

source: Agan honu lhatnading holin solam phaicham langsang Gedor lutna mun geijin acheuvin ahi.
target: and they went to the outskirts of Gedor to the east of the valley in search of pasture for their flocks.

source: Hitichun gan hon lhatnading mun phatah, nehding hamhing tamna, gam lentah, munthip le gamhoina mun agamudoh-un ahi; ajehchu masanga chu hiche munna chu Ham mite anacheng uva ahi.
target: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was spacious, peaceful and quiet. Some Hamites had lived there formerly.

source: Hiche amin kisunlut hohi Judah lengpa Hezekiah nikho laijin ahungun, aponbuh hou asuseuvin, chuche munna anachengho chu tunichan geijin asugam helun, amaho munna chun acheng taove: ajehchu chuche munna chu agan honu lhatnading hamhing mun uma ahi.
target: The men whose names were listed came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. They attacked the Hamites in their dwellings and also the Meunites who were there and completely destroyed them, as is evident to this day. Then they settled in their place, because there was pasture for their flocks.

source: Alah uva Simeon chapate ngeija kon mi janga chu, Ishi chapate Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah le Uzziel lamkaina-in Seir molsanga acheuvin ahi.
target: And five hundred of these Simeonites, led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, invaded the hill country of Seir.

source: Chule amahon ahoidoh Amalek mite amohse chu asatgamun, hitichun tunichan geijin chuche munna chun achengden taove.
target: They killed the remaining Amalekites who had escaped, and they have lived there to this day.

source: Tun Israel cha masapen Reuben chapate chu, ama chu (cha masapen hijeng jongle, apa jalkhun asuhboh tahjeh-in upa hina chu Israel chapa Joseph chapate chu kipe ahitan; chule akhanggui thu chu upa hina dungjuija kisut talou ding ahi.
target: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (he was the firstborn, but when he defiled his father’s marriage bed, his rights as firstborn were given to the sons of Joseph son of Israel; so he could not be listed in the genealogical record in accordance with his birthright,

source: Ahin Judah chu asopite sangin achung nungin, hitichun ama-a konin vaipo pipu ahungkon doh-in: ahivangin upa hina chu Joseph'a hijaa hi.)
target: and though Judah was the strongest of his brothers and a ruler came from him, the rights of the firstborn belonged to Joseph)—

source: Israel cha masapen Reuben chapate chu: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron chule Karmi ahiuve.
target: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron and Karmi.

source: Joel chapate chu: achapa Shemaiah, achapa Gog, achapa Shimei,
target: The descendants of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

source: Achapa Micah, achapa Reaiah, achapa Baal,
target: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

source: Achapa Beerah, ama chu Assyria lengpa Tilgath-pilneser in gal hinga akaimangpa ahin; Reuben mite lamkaipa ahi.
target: and Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria took into exile. Beerah was a leader of the Reubenites.

source: Akhangu khanggui thu akisutlaija a-inko ko-a asopihou lah-a pipui chu Jeiel le Zekeriah,
target: Their relatives by clans, listed according to their genealogical records: Jeiel the chief, Zechariah,

source: Chule Aroer, Nebo le Baalmeon geija cheng Joel chapa, Shema chapa, chule Azaz chapa Bela ahi.
target: and Bela son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel. They settled in the area from Aroer to Nebo and Baal Meon.

source: Chule amaho chu solamsang Euphrates vadunglen'a pat gamthip ma lutnachan geijin anachengun ahi. Ajehchu Gilead gama chu agancha honu punglheh jenga ahi.
target: To the east they occupied the land up to the edge of the desert that extends to the Euphrates River, because their livestock had increased in Gilead.

source: Saul damlaijin Hagar mite toh akidouvun, amaho chu anajouvun, Gilead solam sese-a aponbuh uva anachengun ahi.
target: During Saul’s reign they waged war against the Hagrites, who were defeated at their hands; they occupied the dwellings of the Hagrites throughout the entire region east of Gilead.

source: Chule Gad chu Bashan gamsunga Salcah changeijin amahotoh akigalsaijin achenge.
target: The Gadites lived next to them in Bashan, as far as Salekah:

source: Apipuiju chu Joel ahin, aban Sapham chule Bashan, Jaanai le Shaphat ahiuve.
target: Joel was the chief, Shapham the second, then Janai and Shaphat, in Bashan.

source: Apu apateu insunga asopihou chu: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jachan, Zia chule Heber; mi sagi ahiuve.
target: Their relatives, by families, were: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jakan, Zia and Eber—seven in all.

source: Hichehohi Buz chapa, Jahda chapa, Jeshishai chapa, Michael chapa, Gilead chapa, Jaroah chapa, Hur chapa, Abihail chate ahiuve.
target: These were the sons of Abihail son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz.

source: Guni chapa, Abdiel chapa Ahi hi apu apateu insunga pipupen ahi.
target: Ahi son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, was head of their family.

source: Amahohi Bashan gama Gilead le akhopihou, chule Sharon kimvel changeijin achengun ahi.
target: The Gadites lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its outlying villages, and on all the pasturelands of Sharon as far as they extended.

source: Hicheho sesehi Judah lengpa Jotham nikholai le Israel lengpa Jeroboam nikholaija akhanggui thubu houva ana kisun ahi.
target: All these were entered in the genealogical records during the reigns of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel.

source: Reuben chapate le Gad mite chule Manasseh phung kehkhat, mihang cheh, chemjam le lum thothei, thal kapthem le galdou them, galla kontheiho chu sangsomli le sangli le jasagi le somgup ahiuve.
target: The Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh had 44,760 men ready for military service—able-bodied men who could handle shield and sword, who could use a bow, and who were trained for battle.

source: Chuin amahohin Hagar mite, Jetur, Naphish chule Nodab chunga gal abolun,
target: They waged war against the Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish and Nodab.

source: Chule amaho douna-in panpi achangun, Hagar mite le apankhompi jouse chu akhutnuva akipelut taove: ajehchu kidouna munna Pathen akou jeh uva aman ataonao asanpeh ahi. Ajehchu amahon Ama-a atahsanao angamun ahi.
target: They were helped in fighting them, and God delivered the Hagrites and all their allies into their hands, because they cried out to him during the battle. He answered their prayers, because they trusted in him.

source: Hitichun aganchahou, asangonsangu sangsomnga, kelngoi sangjani le sangsomnga, sangan sangni, chule mihem sangjakhat akai mangun ahi.
target: They seized the livestock of the Hagrites—fifty thousand camels, two hundred fifty thousand sheep and two thousand donkeys. They also took one hundred thousand people captive,

source: Kidouna chu Pathen'a ahijeh-in mitamtah athiuvin ahi. Chule amaho gal hinga akikaimang kahseuvin agamuvah chun acheng taovin ahi.
target: and many others fell slain, because the battle was God’s. And they occupied the land until the exile.

source: Chule Manasseh phung kehkhat chate chu chua chun anachengun; Bashan'a kipat Baal-hermon le Senir chule Hermon mol geijin anapunguve.
target: The people of the half-tribe of Manasseh were numerous; they settled in the land from Bashan to Baal Hermon, that is, to Senir (Mount Hermon).

source: Chule hichehohi apu apateu insunga apipupen cheh ahiuve: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah chule Jahdiel, amahohi mihatle hangsan, mi minthang le apu apateu insunga aluchang cheh ahiuve.
target: These were the heads of their families: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah and Jahdiel. They were brave warriors, famous men, and heads of their families.

source: Chuin amaho apu apateu Pathen douna-in achonkhelun, amaho masanga Pathen'in anasuh mangsa, chuche gama miho pathenho chu ajon thanghoipi taovin ahi.
