target: But they were unfaithful to the God of their ancestors and prostituted themselves to the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.

source: Hijeh chun Israel Pathen'in Assyria lengpa Pul, hichu Assyria lengpa Tilgath-pilneser ahin; amachu ahintildoh-in, aman Reuben mite, Gad mite chule Manasseh phung kehkhat chu gal hingin akaijin; Halah, Habor, Hara chule Gozan vadunglen geijin ahinpuijin, tunigeijin achengden taove.
target: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria (that is, Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria), who took the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile. He took them to Halah, Habor, Hara and the river of Gozan, where they are to this day.

source: Levi chapate chu: Gershom, Kohath chule Merari ahiuve.
target: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

source: Kohath chapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron chule Uzziel ahiuve.
target: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.

source: Chule Amram chate chu: Aaron, Mosi chule Miriam ahiuve. Aaron chapate jong chu: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar chule Ithamar.
target: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

source: Eleazar'in Phinehas ahingin, Phinehas'in Abishua ahingin,
target: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas, Phinehas the father of Abishua,

source: Abishua'in Bukki ahingin, Bukki in Uzzi ahingin,
target: Abishua the father of Bukki, Bukki the father of Uzzi,

source: Uzzi'in Zerahiah ahingin, Zerahiah'in Meraioth ahingin,
target: Uzzi the father of Zerahiah, Zerahiah the father of Meraioth,

source: Meraioth'in Amariah ahingin, Amariah'in Ahitub ahingin,
target: Meraioth the father of Amariah, Amariah the father of Ahitub,

source: Ahitub'in Zadok ahingin, Zadok'in Ahimaaz ahingin,
target: Ahitub the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Ahimaaz,

source: Ahimaaz'in Azariah ahingin, Azariah'in Johanan ahingin,
target: Ahimaaz the father of Azariah, Azariah the father of Johanan,

source: Johanan'in Azariah ahinge, (amahi Jerusalem'a Solomon'in asah houin'a thempu tohmun hintongpa chu ahi.)
target: Johanan the father of Azariah (it was he who served as priest in the temple Solomon built in Jerusalem),

source: Chule Azariah'in Amariah ahingin, Amariah in Ahitub ahingin,
target: Azariah the father of Amariah, Amariah the father of Ahitub,

source: Ahitub'in Zadok ahingin, Zadok'in Shallum ahingin,
target: Ahitub the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Shallum,

source: Shallum'in Hilkiah ahingin, Hilkiah'in Azariah ahingin,
target: Shallum the father of Hilkiah, Hilkiah the father of Azariah,

source: Azariah'in Seraiah ahingin, Seraiah'in Jehozadak ahingin ahi.
target: Azariah the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah the father of Jozadak.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Judah le Jerusalem Nebuchadnezzar khutna akaimang laichu Jehozadak hi gal hinga kikai ahi.
target: Jozadak was deported when the Lord sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

source: Levi chapate chu: Gershom, Kohath chule Merari ahiuve.
target: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

source: Chule Gershom chapateni minchu Libni le Shimei ahi.
target: These are the names of the sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei.

source: Kohath chapate chu: Amram, Izhar, Hebron chule Uzziel ahiuve.
target: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.

source: Merari chapateni chu: Mahli le Mushi ahilhone. Chule hichehohi apu apateu dungjuija Levi insung mite ahiuve.
target: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites listed according to their fathers:

source: Gershom'a konin achapa Libni, achapa Jahath, achapa Zimmah,
target: Of Gershon: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

source: Achapa Joah, achapa Iddo, achapa Zerah, achapa Jeaterai apengin ahi.
target: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son and Jeatherai his son.

source: Kohath chapate chu: achapa Amminadab, achapa Korah, achapa Assir,
target: The descendants of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

source: Achapa Elkanah, achapa Ebiasaph, achapa Assir,
target: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,

source: Achapa Tahath, achapa Uriel, achapa Uzziah, chule achapa Shaul ahiuve.
target: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son and Shaul his son.

source: Chule Elkanah chapate chu: Amasai le Ahimoth ahi.
target: The descendants of Elkanah: Amasai, Ahimoth,

source: Elkanah ahile; Elkanah chapate chu: achapa Zophai, achapa Nahath,
target: Elkanah his son, Zophai his son, Nahath his son,

source: Achapa Eliab, achapa Jeroham, achapa Elkanah ahiuve.
target: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son and Samuel his son.

source: Chule Samuel chapateni chu: Apeng masa Vashni le Abiah ahilhone.
target: The sons of Samuel: Joel the firstborn and Abijah the second son.

source: Merari chapate chu: Mahli, achapa Libni, achapa Shimei, achapa Uzzah,
target: The descendants of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

source: Achapa Shimea, achapa Haggiah, achapa Asaiah ahiuve.
target: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son and Asaiah his son.

source: Chule hichehohi David'in Kitepna thingkhong akikoihe nunga Pakai houin'a la lama natohna neidinga akoiho chu ahiuve.
target: These are the men David put in charge of the music in the house of the Lord after the ark came to rest there.

source: Chule Jerusalem'a Solomon'in Pakai houin asah masangsen houkhom ho houbuh umna masanga chun amahon la asajiuvin, atohding kinu chu aban banin atong jiuvin ahi.
target: They ministered with music before the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, until Solomon built the temple of the Lord in Jerusalem. They performed their duties according to the regulations laid down for them.

source: Hichehohi achateu toh kinbola pangho ahiuve. Kohath miho chapate-a kon: lathempa Heman, Heman hi Joel chapa, Shemuel chapa,
target: Here are the men who served, together with their sons: From the Kohathites: Heman, the musician, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

source: Elkanah chapa, Jeroham chapa, Eliel chapa, Toah chapa,
target: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

source: Zuph chapa, Elkanah chapa, Mahath chapa, Amasai chapa,
target: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

source: Elkanah chapa, Joel chapa, Azariah chapa, Zephaniah chapa,
target: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

source: Tahath chapa, Assir chapa, Ebiasaph chapa, Korah chapa,
target: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

source: Izhar chapa, Kohath chapa, Levi chapa, Israel chapa ahi.
target: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel;

source: Chule ajet lama ding chu asopipa Asaph ahin, Asaph hi Berechiah chapa, Shimea chapa,
target: and Heman’s associate Asaph, who served at his right hand: Asaph son of Berekiah, the son of Shimea,

source: Michael chapa, Baaseiah chapa, Malchiah chapa,
target: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malkijah,

source: Ethni chapa, Zerah chapa, Adaiah chapa,
target: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

source: Ethan chapa, Zimmah chapa, Shimei chapa,
target: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

source: Jahath chapa, Gershom chapa, Levi chapa ahi.
target: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershon, the son of Levi;

source: Chule veilama ding chu asopi Merari chapate lah-a kon Kishi chapa Ethan ahin, Kishi hi Abdi chapa, Malluch chapa,
target: and from their associates, the Merarites, at his left hand: Ethan son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluk,

source: Hashabiah chapa, Amaziah chapa, Hilkiah chapa,
target: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

source: Amzi chapa, Bani chapa, Shemer chapa,
target: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

source: Mahli chapa, Mushi chapa, Merari chapa, Levi chapa ahi.
target: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

source: Chule asopiteu Levi mite dangho chu Pathen in Houbuh-a tohding tincheng tong dinga kipansah ahiuve.
target: Their fellow Levites were assigned to all the other duties of the tabernacle, the house of God.

source: Ahivangin Pathen'in alhacha Mosi ana thupeh jouse dungjuijin Aaron le achapate chun maicham chunga govam thilto atoh-un, gimnamtui ahalun, muntheng chungnunga tohding jouse tongding le, Israel dinga longlhena bolpeh dinga pansah ahiuve.
target: But Aaron and his descendants were the ones who presented offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense in connection with all that was done in the Most Holy Place, making atonement for Israel, in accordance with all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

source: Chule hichehohi Aaron chapate ahiuve: achapa Eleazar, achapa Phinehas, achapa Abishua,
target: These were the descendants of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

source: Achapa Bukki, achapa Uzzi, achapa Zerahiah,
target: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

source: Achapa Meraioth, achapa Amariah, achapa Ahitub
target: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

source: Achapa Zadok, achapa Ahimaaz ahiuve.
target: Zadok his son and Ahimaaz his son.

source: Tun hichehohi Kohath mite insung miho, Aaron chapate agamsung hop sunga achennao ahi. Ajehchu hichehi achannu ahi.
target: These were the locations of their settlements allotted as their territory (they were assigned to the descendants of Aaron who were from the Kohathite clan, because the first lot was for them):

source: Chule amaho chu Judah gamsunga um Hebron le khopipam kimvel sese anapeuve.
target: They were given Hebron in Judah with its surrounding pasturelands.

source: Ahinla khopi naija gamho le khoneoho chu Jephunneh chapa Caleb anapeuvin ahi.
target: But the fields and villages around the city were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.

source: Chule Aaron chapate chu Judah khopiho, hoidohna khopi Hebron, Libna le khopi kimvel, chule Jattir le Eshtamoa le akhopi kimvel ho sese toh anapeuve.
target: So the descendants of Aaron were given Hebron (a city of refuge), and Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa,

source: Chule Hilen le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Debir le khopi kimvel ho,
target: Hilen, Debir,

source: Ashan le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Bethshemesh le akhopi kimvel sese anapeuve.
target: Ashan, Juttah and Beth Shemesh, together with their pasturelands.

source: Chule Benjamin phunga konin: Geba le akhopi kimvel ho, Alemeth le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Anathoth le akhopi kimvel ho sese anapeuve. A-insung pumpiuva akhopihou chu khopi somlethum ahi.
target: And from the tribe of Benjamin they were given Gibeon, Geba, Alemeth and Anathoth, together with their pasturelands. The total number of towns distributed among the Kohathite clans came to thirteen.

source: Chule Kohath phunga chapa dangho chu, Manasseh chapate phung akehkhatna konin vang sanin khopi som apeuvin ahi.
target: The rest of Kohath’s descendants were allotted ten towns from the clans of half the tribe of Manasseh.

source: Chule Gershom chapate chu a-insungu dungjuijin Issachar phunga kon, Asher phunga kon, Naphtali phunga kon chule Bashan'a Manasseh phunga konin khopi somlethum apeuve.
target: The descendants of Gershon, clan by clan, were allotted thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher and Naphtali, and from the part of the tribe of Manasseh that is in Bashan.

source: Merari chapate henga chun a-insungu dungjuile vangkivet dungjuijin Reuben phunga kon, Gad phunga kon, chule Zebulun phunga konin khopiho somleni akipen ahi.
target: The descendants of Merari, clan by clan, were allotted twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun.

source: Israel chaten hiche khopi somleni hohi akhopiu kimvel ho pumin Levi mite anapeuve.
target: So the Israelites gave the Levites these towns and their pasturelands.

source: Chule vangvet na-in Judah chate phunga kon, Simeon chate phunga kon, chule Benjamin chate phunga kon, hiche aminuva kivo khopihohi anapeuvin ahi.
target: From the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin they allotted the previously named towns.

source: Chule Kohath chapate insung mi amohho chun Ephraim phunga konin gam le khopilen aneijuvin ahi.
target: Some of the Kohathite clans were given as their territory towns from the tribe of Ephraim.

source: Chuin amahon amaho chu Ephraim molsanga hoidohna khopi Shechem chu akhopi kimvel ho to apeuvin, chule Gezer le akhopi kimvel ho,
target: In the hill country of Ephraim they were given Shechem (a city of refuge), and Gezer,

source: Jokmeam le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Beth-horon le akhopi kimvel ho,
target: Jokmeam, Beth Horon,

source: Aijalon le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Gathrimmon le akhopi kimvel sese apeuvin ahi.
target: Aijalon and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands.

source: Manasseh phung kehkhatna konin, Kohath chapate insung amoh ho-a dingin Aner le akhopi kimvel ho, Bileam le akhopi kimvel sese apeuve.
target: And from half the tribe of Manasseh the Israelites gave Aner and Bileam, together with their pasturelands, to the rest of the Kohathite clans.

source: Manasseh phung kehkhat insungho-a kona Gerahom chapate kipe chu Bashan'a um Golan le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Ashtaroth le akhopi kimvel sese ahi.
target: The Gershonites received the following: From the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh they received Golan in Bashan and also Ashtaroth, together with their pasturelands;

source: Issachar phunga konin Kedesh le akhopi kimvel ho, Daberath le akhopi kimvel ho,
target: from the tribe of Issachar they received Kedesh, Daberath,

source: Ramoth le akhopi kimvel ho, Anem le akhopi kimvel sese apeuvin:
target: Ramoth and Anem, together with their pasturelands;

source: Chule Asher phunga konin Mashal le akhopi kimvel ho, Abdon le akhopi kimvel ho,
target: from the tribe of Asher they received Mashal, Abdon,

source: Hukok le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Rehob le akhopi kimvel sese apeuvin ahi.
target: Hukok and Rehob, together with their pasturelands;

source: Chule Naphtali phunga konin Galilee gama um Kedesh le akhopi kimvel ho, Hammon le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Kirjathaim le akhopi kimvel sese apeuvin ahi.
target: and from the tribe of Naphtali they received Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon and Kiriathaim, together with their pasturelands.

source: Zebulun phunga kona Merari chate amohchengse henga kipe chu Rimmon le akhopi kimvel ho, Tabor le akhopi kimvel sese ahi.
target: The Merarites (the rest of the Levites) received the following: From the tribe of Zebulun they received Jokneam, Kartah, Rimmono and Tabor, together with their pasturelands;

source: Chule Reuben phunga kona amaho kipedoh chu Jordan gal langkhat Jericho kom Jordan solamsang gamthipma um Bezer le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Jahzah le akhopi kimvel ho,
target: from the tribe of Reuben across the Jordan east of Jericho they received Bezer in the wilderness, Jahzah,

source: Kedemoth le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Mephaath le akhopi kimvel sese ahi.
target: Kedemoth and Mephaath, together with their pasturelands;

source: Chule Gad phunga kon Gilead'a um Ramoth le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Mahanaim le akhopi kimvel ho,
target: and from the tribe of Gad they received Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim,

source: Chule Heshbon le akhopi kimvel ho, chule Jazer le akhopi kimvel sese apeuvin ahi.
target: Heshbon and Jazer, together with their pasturelands.

source: Tun Issachar chapate chu: Tolla, Pu-ah, Jashub chule Shimron, mi li ahiuve.
target: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub and Shimron—four in all.

source: Chule Tolla chapate chu: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Jibsam chule Shemuel, Tolla sonho apu apateu insunga luchang cheh ahiuvin; akhanguva mihat le mihangsan cheh ahiuve: David nikholaijin amijatnu chu sangsomni le sangni le jagup alhinguve.
target: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam and Samuel—heads of their families. During the reign of David, the descendants of Tola listed as fighting men in their genealogy numbered 22,600.

source: Chule Uzzi chapa chu Izrahiah ahin chule Izrahiah chapate chu: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, Isshiah, mi nga ahiuvin, abonchauvin pipui jeng ahiuve.
target: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel and Ishiah. All five of them were chiefs.

source: Amaho le akhanguva chu, apu apateu insung dungjuija galdouthei sepaihon ngen ahiuvin, mi sangsomthum le sang gup ahiuve: ajehchu amahon ji tamtah tah le chapa tamtah tah aneiju ahi.
target: According to their family genealogy, they had 36,000 men ready for battle, for they had many wives and children.

source: Chule Issachar insung mite jouse lah-a asopiteu chu mihat mihangsan cheh ahiuvin, akhangthu sutna dungjuija sutnin abonun sangsomget le sangsagi ahiuve.
target: The relatives who were fighting men belonging to all the clans of Issachar, as listed in their genealogy, were 87,000 in all.

source: Benjamin chapate chu: Bela, Becher chule Jediael, mi thum ahiuve.
target: Three sons of Benjamin: Bela, Beker and Jediael.

source: Chule Bela chapate chu: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth chule Iri, mi nga ahiuvin; apu apateu insunga luchang cheh, mihat mihangsan ngen ahiuve;, akhangguithu sutna dungjuijin sangsomni le sangni le somthum le li ahiuve.
target: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth and Iri, heads of families—five in all. Their genealogical record listed 22,034 fighting men.

source: Chule Becher chapate chu: Zemira, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth chule Alemeth ahiuvin, hicheho chenghi Becher chapate ahiuve.
target: The sons of Beker: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Beker.

source: Amijatnu, akhangu khanggui thu kisutna dungjuijin apu apateu insunga luchang cheh, mihat mihangsan cheh sangsomni le jani ahiuve.
target: Their genealogical record listed the heads of families and 20,200 fighting men.

source: Jediael chapa jong chu Bilhan ahin; chule Bilhan chapate: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish chule Ahishahar ahiuve.
target: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Kenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish and Ahishahar.

source: Hichehohi Jediael chapate, apu apateu insunga luchang chehho sima mihat mihangsan cheh sangsom le sangsagi le jani ahiuvin, galmuna galsatna konthei cheh ahiuve.
target: All these sons of Jediael were heads of families. There were 17,200 fighting men ready to go out to war.

source: Shuppim le Huppim chu Ir chapateni ahin, chule Hushim chu Aher chapa ahi.
target: The Shuppites and Huppites were the descendants of Ir, and the Hushites the descendants of Aher.

source: Naphtali chapate chu: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer chule Shallum ahin, Bilhah chapate ahiuve.
target: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer and Shillem—the descendants of Bilhah.

source: Manasseh chapa chu Asriel ahin, amahi athaikemnu Aram numei nun ahinpeh ahi; (amanuhin Gilead pa Machir jong ahinge.
target: The descendants of Manasseh: Asriel was his descendant through his Aramean concubine. She gave birth to Makir the father of Gilead.

source: Chule Machir'in Huppim le Shuppim sopinu Maakah chu ji in aneije;) chule anichanna pa chu Zelophehad ahin, chule Zelophehad'in chanu jengbou aneijin ahi.
target: Makir took a wife from among the Huppites and Shuppites. His sister’s name was Maakah. Another descendant was named Zelophehad, who had only daughters.

source: Machir inneipi Maakah'in chapa khat ahingin, amanun amin Peresh asah-in ahi; chule asopipa minchu Sheresh ahin, chule achapateni chu Ulam le Rakem ahilhone.
target: Makir’s wife Maakah gave birth to a son and named him Peresh. His brother was named Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

source: Ulam chapa chu Bedan ahi. Hichehohi Manasseh chapa Machir, Machir chapa Gilead chapate ahiuve.
target: The son of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead son of Makir, the son of Manasseh.

source: Chule asopinu Hammoleketh in Ishod, Abiezer chule Mahalah ahingin ahi.
target: His sister Hammoleketh gave birth to Ishhod, Abiezer and Mahlah.

source: Shemida chapate chu Ahian, Shechem, Likhi chule Aniam ahiuve.
target: The sons of Shemida were: Ahian, Shechem, Likhi and Aniam.

source: Ephraim chapate chu: Shuthelah chule achapa Bered, achapa Tahath, achapa Eladah, achapa Tahath,
target: The descendants of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,

source: Chule achapa Zabad, achapa Shuthelah, chule achapa Ezer le Elead, aganchahou gudinga ahungsuh jeh lhona agama peng Gath mihon anatha teniu chutoh ahiuve.
target: Zabad his son and Shuthelah his son. Ezer and Elead were killed by the native-born men of Gath, when they went down to seize their livestock.

source: Hitichun apau Ephraim chun nitamtah alunghempi-in, hijeh chun asopite ama lhamon dingin ahunguvin ahi.
target: Their father Ephraim mourned for them many days, and his relatives came to comfort him.

source: Chujouvin ama a-inneipi henga alutnin, amanun nao ahinvop min, chule chapa khat ahingin a-insunga thilse aumtahjeh-in amin Beriah asahtan ahi.
target: Then he made love to his wife again, and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. He named him Beriah, because there had been misfortune in his family.

source: (Chule achanu Sherah ahin, Beth-horon noinung le chungnung chule Uzzen-sherah sadohnu ahi).
target: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Lower and Upper Beth Horon as well as Uzzen Sheerah.

source: Achapa Rephah ahin, Resheph jong ahin, Resheph chapa Telah chule Tahah chapa Tahan ahi.
target: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,

source: Tahan chapa Laadan, Laadan chapa Ammihud, Ammihud chapa Elishama,
target: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

source: Elishama chapa Nun, Nun chapa Joshua ahi.
target: Nun his son and Joshua his son.

source: Chule aneiju le achennahou chu Bethel le akhopihose, solam sanga Naaran, lhumlama Gezer le akhopihose toh, Shechem le akhopiho, chule Gaza le akhopiho changei ahi.
target: Their lands and settlements included Bethel and its surrounding villages, Naaran to the east, Gezer and its villages to the west, and Shechem and its villages all the way to Ayyah and its villages.

source: Chule Manasseh chapate gamgi china um Bethshean le akhopise, Taanach le akhopise, Megiddo le akhopise Dor chule akhopise ahi. Hicheho ahin Israel chapa Joseph chate achengun ahi.
target: Along the borders of Manasseh were Beth Shan, Taanach, Megiddo and Dor, together with their villages. The descendants of Joseph son of Israel lived in these towns.

source: Asher chapate chu: Imnah, Ishuai, Ishuai, Beriah chule asopinu-u Serah ahiuve.
target: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi and Beriah. Their sister was Serah.

source: Beriah chapateni chu Heber le Birzavith pa Malchiel ahilhone.
target: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malkiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

source: Chuin Heber'in Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham chule asopinu-u Shua ahingin ahi.
target: Heber was the father of Japhlet, Shomer and Hotham and of their sister Shua.

source: Chule Japhlet chapate chu: Pasach, Bimhal chule Ashvath ahiuve. Amahohi Japhlet chate ahiuve.
target: The sons of Japhlet: Pasak, Bimhal and Ashvath. These were Japhlet’s sons.

source: Shemer chapate chu: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah chule Aram ahiuve.
target: The sons of Shomer: Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah and Aram.

source: Chule asopipa Helem chapate chu Zophah, Imna, Shelesh chule Amal ahiuve.
target: The sons of his brother Helem: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh and Amal.

source: Zophah chapate chu: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
target: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,

source: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran chule Beera ahiuve.
target: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran and Beera.

source: Chule Jether chapate chu: Jephunneh, Pispah, chule Ara ahiuve.
target: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispah and Ara.

source: Chule Ulla chapate chu: Arah, Hanniel chule Rezia ahiuve.
target: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel and Rizia.

source: Hicheho chengsehi Asher chate, apu apateu insung luchang cheh, lhendoh le mihat mihangsan ngen, lamkai pipui cheh ahiuve. Chule akhanggui thu apumpia kisutna dungjuija galdouna-a gala konthei chu mi sangsomni le sang gup ahiuve.
target: All these were descendants of Asher—heads of families, choice men, brave warriors and outstanding leaders. The number of men ready for battle, as listed in their genealogy, was 26,000.

source: Tun Benjamin'in acha masa Bela, anina Ashbel, athumna Aharah,
target: Benjamin was the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second son, Aharah the third,

source: Alichana Nohah, chule anga chana Rapha ahinge.
target: Nohah the fourth and Rapha the fifth.

source: Chule Bela chapate chu: Addar, Gera, Abihud,
target: The sons of Bela were: Addar, Gera, Abihud,

source: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
target: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

source: Gera, Shephuphan chule Huram ahiuve.
target: Gera, Shephuphan and Huram.

source: Chule hichehohi Ehud chapate ahiuvin: Geba'a chengho pate luchang cheh ahiuvin, chule amahon amaho chu Manahath'a atolmangun ahi.
target: These were the descendants of Ehud, who were heads of families of those living in Geba and were deported to Manahath:

source: Chule Naaman, Ahiah, chule Gera, amahohi atolmangin, chuin Uzza le Ahihud ahingin ahi.
target: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who deported them and who was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

source: Chule Shaharaim'in ajiteni Hushim le Beera asolmang nungin, Moab gama chate ahingin ahi.
target: Sons were born to Shaharaim in Moab after he had divorced his wives Hushim and Baara.

source: Chule aman a-inneipi Hodesh'a konin; Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcham,
target: By his wife Hodesh he had Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malkam,

source: Jeuz, Sachia chule Mirma ahingin ahi. Hiche achapateho hi apu apateu insunga luchang cheh ahiuve.
target: Jeuz, Sakia and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of families.

source: Chuin Hushim'a konin Abitub le Elpaal apengin ahi.
target: By Hushim he had Abitub and Elpaal.

source: Elpaal chapate chu: Eber, Misham, chule Ono le akimvela khopiho sadohpa Shema.
target: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, Shemed (who built Ono and Lod with its surrounding villages),

source: Gath'a chengho nodoh-a, Aijalon'a chengho pate luchang cheh Beriah le Shema;
target: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of families of those living in Aijalon and who drove out the inhabitants of Gath.

source: Ahio, Shashak le Jeremoth,
target: Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,

source: Zebadiah, Arad le Ader,
target: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,

source: Chule Michael, Ishpa le Joha, amahohi Beriah chapate ahiuve.
target: Michael, Ishpah and Joha were the sons of Beriah.

source: Chule Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki chule Heber,
target: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

source: Ishmerai, Izliah le Jobab, hichenghi Elpaal chapate ahiuve.
target: Ishmerai, Izliah and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal.

source: Chule Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,
target: Jakim, Zikri, Zabdi,

source: Chule Elienai, Zilthai le Eliel,
target: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

source: Adaiah, Beraiah chule Shimrath, hichenghi Shimhi chapate ahiuve.
target: Adaiah, Beraiah and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei.

source: Ishpan, Heber le Eliel,
target: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,

source: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,
target: Abdon, Zikri, Hanan,

source: Hananiah, Elam le Anthothijah,
target: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,

source: Iphdeiah chule Penuel, hichenghi Shashak chapate ahiuve.
target: Iphdeiah and Penuel were the sons of Shashak.

source: Shamsherai, Shehariah le Athaliah,
target: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,

source: Jaresiah, Eliah chule Zichri, hichengsehi Jeroham chapate ahiuve.
target: Jaareshiah, Elijah and Zikri were the sons of Jeroham.

source: Hichehohi apu apateu insunga aluchang cheh, akhanguva pipui ngen ahiuve. Amahosehi Jerusalem'a cheng ahiuve.
target: All these were heads of families, chiefs as listed in their genealogy, and they lived in Jerusalem.

source: Chule Gibeon'a Gibeon pa achengin, a-inneipi min chu Maachah ahi.
target: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maakah,

source: Chule achapa peng masapen chu Abdon ahin, chule Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,
target: and his firstborn son was Abdon, followed by Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

source: Gedor, Ahio chule Zecher ahiuve.
target: Gedor, Ahio, Zeker

source: Chule Mikloth'in Shimeah ahinge. Amaho jonghi asopihou toh kigalsaijin Jerusalem'a achengun ahi.
target: and Mikloth, who was the father of Shimeah. They too lived near their relatives in Jerusalem.

source: Chule Ner'in Kish ahingin, Kish in Saul ahingin, Saul'in Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab chule Eshbaal ahingin ahi.
target: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish the father of Saul, and Saul the father of Jonathan, Malki-Shua, Abinadab and Esh-Baal.

source: Jonathan chapa chu Merib-baal ahi, chule Merib-baal'in Micah ahingin ahi.
target: The son of Jonathan: Merib-Baal, who was the father of Micah.

source: Chule Micah chapate chu; Pithon, Melech, Tarea chule Ahaz ahiuve.
target: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melek, Tarea and Ahaz.

source: Chule Ahaz'in Jehoadah ahingin, chule Jehoadah'in Alemeth, Azmaveth, chule Zimri ahingin, Zimri'in Moza ahingin,
target: Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah, Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth and Zimri, and Zimri was the father of Moza.

source: Chule Moza'in Binea ahingin, Binea chapa chu Rapha ahin, Rapha chapa chu Eleasah, Eleasah chapa chu Azel ahi.
target: Moza was the father of Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son and Azel his son.

source: Chule Azel'in chapa gup aneijin, hicheho minchu: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, chule Hanan ahi. Hicheho jousehi Azel chapate ahiuve.
target: Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

source: Chule asopipa Eshek chapate chu Ulam acha masa, Jehush anichanna, chule Eliphelet athum channa, ahiuve.
target: The sons of his brother Eshek: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second son and Eliphelet the third.

source: Chule Ulam chapate chu mihat mihangsan, thal kapthem mi ahiuvin, chapate tamtah aneijun, achapateu chapate mi jale somnga ahiuve. Hicheho jousehi Benjamin chapate ahiuve.
target: The sons of Ulam were brave warriors who could handle the bow. They had many sons and grandsons—150 in all. All these were the descendants of Benjamin.

source: Hitichun Israelte jouse akhanguijuva konin akisimin; chule veuvin, amaho chu Israel lengte le asuhkhel jeh uva Babylon'a kikaimang Juda lengte lekhabua akisune.
target: All Israel was listed in the genealogies recorded in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah. They were taken captive to Babylon because of their unfaithfulness.

source: Tun achanu khopiho-a cheng masapen ho chu; Israelte, thempuho, Levi ho, chule Nethinim ho ahiuve.
target: Now the first to resettle on their own property in their own towns were some Israelites, priests, Levites and temple servants.

source: Chule Jerusalem'a Judah chate, Benjamin chate, chule Ephraim le Manasseh chate achengun; amaho chu:
target: Those from Judah, from Benjamin, and from Ephraim and Manasseh who lived in Jerusalem were:

source: Judah chapa Pharez chapate lah-a kon Bani chapa, achapa Imri, Imri chapa, Omri chapa, Ammihud chapa Uthai.
target: Uthai son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, a descendant of Perez son of Judah.

source: Shilon mite lah-a kon; acha masa Asaiah le achapate.
target: Of the Shelanites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

source: Chule Zerah chapate lah-a; Jeuel le asopite mi jaguple somko.
target: Of the Zerahites: Jeuel. The people from Judah numbered 690.

source: Chule Benjamin chapate lah-a kon: Hasenuah chapa Hodaviah, Hodaviah chapa Meshullam, chule Meshullam chapa Sallu,
target: Of the Benjamites: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

source: Jeroham chapa Ibneiah, Michri chapa Uzzi, Uzzi chapa Elah, Ebnijah chapa Reuel, Reuel chapa Shephatiah, Shephatiah chapa Meshullam,
target: Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi, the son of Mikri; and Meshullam son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah.

source: Chule akhangu dungjuija asopiteu jakole somnga le gup ahiuve. Hicheho sesehi apu apateu insunga aluchang cheh ahiuve.
target: The people from Benjamin, as listed in their genealogy, numbered 956. All these men were heads of their families.

source: Chule thempuho lah-a kon; Jedaiah, Jehoiarib le Jachin,
target: Of the priests: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jakin;

source: Chule Pathen in'a vaihompa Ahitub chapa Meraioth, Meraioth chapa Zadok, Zadok chapa Meshullam, Meshullam chapa Hilkiah, Hilkiah chapa Azariah,
target: Azariah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the official in charge of the house of God;

source: Chule Malchijah chapa Pashhur, Pashhur chapa Jeroham, Jeroham chapa Adaiah, chule Immer chapa Meshillemith, Meshillemith chapa Meshullam, Meshullam chapa Jahzerah, Jahzerah chapa Adiel, Adiel chapa Maasia,
target: Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malkijah; and Maasai son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer.

source: Chule asopiteu, apu apateu insunga luchangcheh sangkhat le somgup ahiuvin, Pathen insunga kinbolna-a natong hatcheh ahiuve.
target: The priests, who were heads of families, numbered 1,760. They were able men, responsible for ministering in the house of God.

source: Chule Levi ho lah-a kon: Merari chapate lah-a Hashabiah chapa Azrikam, Azrikam chapa Hasshub, Hasshub chapa Shemaiah,
target: Of the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, a Merarite;

source: Chule Asaph chapa Zichri, Zichri chapa Micah, Micah chapa Mattaniah, Galal, Haresh, chule Bakbakkar,
target: Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal and Mattaniah son of Mika, the son of Zikri, the son of Asaph;

source: Chule Jeduthun chapa Galal, Galal chapa Shemaiah, Shemaiah chapa Obadiah, chule Netophah mite khoho-a chengho Elkanah chapa Asa, Asa chapa Berechiah ahiuve.
target: Obadiah son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berekiah son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

source: Chule kotngah ho chu Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman chule asopiteu jong ahi. Shallum chu apipuipen ahi.
target: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman and their fellow Levites, Shallum their chief

source: Lengpa solam kotpi chu tumasang sen angah jiuvin, amahohi Levi chate kiloikhom lah-a kotngah ho chu ahiuve.
target: being stationed at the King’s Gate on the east, up to the present time. These were the gatekeepers belonging to the camp of the Levites.

source: Chule Korah chapa Ebiasaph, Ebiasaph chapa Kore, Kore chapa Shallum le asopite, apa insunga kon Korah mite chu Houbuh kotngah-a panga, kinbolna-a natonga pang ahiuve. Chule apu apateu chu Pakai janelho ngahmun lutna ngahtupma anapang ahiuve.
target: Shallum son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his fellow gatekeepers from his family (the Korahites) were responsible for guarding the thresholds of the tent just as their ancestors had been responsible for guarding the entrance to the dwelling of the Lord .

source: Chule Eleazar chapa Phinehas chu tumasanga amaho chunga vaihoma pang ahin, Pakaiyin aumpin ahi.
target: In earlier times Phinehas son of Eleazar was the official in charge of the gatekeepers, and the Lord was with him.

source: Chule Meshelemiah chapa Zakariah chu Houkhom ho Houbuh kotngahpa ahi.
target: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was the gatekeeper at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

source: Kotphungho ngahdinga lhendoh ho jousehi mi jani leh somleni ahiuve. Hichehohi akhohouva akhangguiju kisut dungjuija David le themgao Samuel'in atohmunu tongdinga anasuhdetsa ahiuve.
target: Altogether, those chosen to be gatekeepers at the thresholds numbered 212. They were registered by genealogy in their villages. The gatekeepers had been assigned to their positions of trust by David and Samuel the seer.

source: Hitichun amahole achateu chun Houbuh Pakai in kotphungho chu avetup mun, angahtup mum ahi.
target: They and their descendants were in charge of guarding the gates of the house of the Lord —the house called the tent of meeting.

source: Kotngah ho chu aningli: solam, lhumlam, sahlam chule lhanglama umuva ahi.
target: The gatekeepers were on the four sides: east, west, north and south.

source: Chule asopihou akhoneo houva umho ni sagi sehle aphat phatna amahotoh umdinga hungji dingu ahi.
target: Their fellow Levites in their villages had to come from time to time and share their duties for seven-day periods.

source: Hiche Levi mi ngahtup pipui li hochun akingansenao Pathen in indanho le goukholna indanho chu avetupmun ahi.
target: But the four principal gatekeepers, who were Levites, were entrusted with the responsibility for the rooms and treasuries in the house of God.

source: Chule jingkah seh-a kot hongdinga kinganse ahijeh-un Pathen in kimvela chun ageh jiuvin ahi.
target: They would spend the night stationed around the house of God, because they had to guard it; and they had charge of the key for opening it each morning.

source: Chule alah uva abang um le bel kinbol ahiuvin, akoilut alahdoh tengule asimcheh jiu ahi.
target: Some of them were in charge of the articles used in the temple service; they counted them when they were brought in and when they were taken out.

source: Amaho abang chu um le bel ho le munthenga manchah ho jouse: changbong, lengpitwi, sathao, bego chule gimnamtui ho vetup dinga kipansah ahiuve.
target: Others were assigned to take care of the furnishings and all the other articles of the sanctuary, as well as the special flour and wine, and the olive oil, incense and spices.

source: Chule thempuho chapate phabep chun nuding gimnamtui asemun ahi.
target: But some of the priests took care of mixing the spices.

source: Chule Korah mi Shallum chamasa Levi mikhat Mattithiah kitipa chu khangbel ho-a kikang thilto chunga natohna neidinga kinganse ahitai.
target: A Levite named Mattithiah, the firstborn son of Shallum the Korahite, was entrusted with the responsibility for baking the offering bread.

source: Chule asopihou loikhat Kohath mite chapate chu vetsahna changlhah chunga tohmun nei ahiuvin, cholngahni seh-a asemdingu ahi.
target: Some of the Kohathites, their fellow Levites, were in charge of preparing for every Sabbath the bread set out on the table.

source: Chule hichehohi lasaho ahiuvin, Levi ho pate lah-a pipui, indan sunga um a-ongthola umjingho ahiuve; ajehchu amahon chuche nachu sunle jana atoh-u ahi.
target: Those who were musicians, heads of Levite families, stayed in the rooms of the temple and were exempt from other duties because they were responsible for the work day and night.

source: Levi pate pipui hohi akhangu lhumkeija pipui ahiuvin; amaho Jerusalem'a achengun ahi.
target: All these were heads of Levite families, chiefs as listed in their genealogy, and they lived in Jerusalem.

source: Chule Gibeon'a chun Gibeon mite pa Jehiel achengin, a-inneipi minchu Maakah ahi.
target: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maakah,

source: Chule achapa masapen chu Abdon ahin, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
target: and his firstborn son was Abdon, followed by Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

source: Gedor, Ahio, Zekeriah chule Mikloth toh ahiuve.
target: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah and Mikloth.

source: Chule Mikloth'in Shimeam ahinge. Chule amaho jong asopihou toh kikotmai ngatnin Jerusalem'a achenguve.
target: Mikloth was the father of Shimeam. They too lived near their relatives in Jerusalem.

source: Chule Ner'in Kish ahingin, Kish'in Saul ahingin, Chule Saul in Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab chule Eshbaal ahingin ahi.
target: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish the father of Saul, and Saul the father of Jonathan, Malki-Shua, Abinadab and Esh-Baal.

source: Chule Jonathan chapa chu Merib-baal ahin, Merib-baal'in Micah ahingin ahi.
target: The son of Jonathan: Merib-Baal, who was the father of Micah.

source: Chule Micah chapate chu; Pithon, Melech, Tahrea chule Ahaz ahiuve.
target: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melek, Tahrea and Ahaz.

source: Chule Ahaz'in Jarah ahingin, Jarah'in Alemeth, Azmaveth chule Zimri ahingin, chule Zimri'in Moza ahinge.
target: Ahaz was the father of Jadah, Jadah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth and Zimri, and Zimri was the father of Moza.

source: Chule Moza'in Binea ahingin, Binea chapa chu Rephaiah ahin, Rephaiah chapa chu Eleasah ahin, Eleasah chapa chu Azel ahi.
target: Moza was the father of Binea; Rephaiah was his son, Eleasah his son and Azel his son.

source: Chule Azel'in chapa gup aneijin, aminu hiche ahi: Azrikam, Bokheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah chule Hanan. Hicheho jousehi Azel chapate ahiuve.
target: Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

source: Tun Philistine ten Israelte ahinsatnun; Israel mite chu Philistine te masanga ajam taovin, chule Gilboa molsanga chun mi tamtah athiuvin ahi.
target: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; the Israelites fled before them, and many fell dead on Mount Gilboa.

source: Chule Philistine ten Saul le achate chu hadelin adelun; hitichun Philistine te chun Saul chapate Jonathan, Abinadab, chule Malchishua chu athat taovin ahi.
target: The Philistines were in hot pursuit of Saul and his sons, and they killed his sons Jonathan, Abinadab and Malki-Shua.

source: Chuin gal chu Saul dingin ahahsalheh jengtan, chuin thal themhon ahinkap khauvin, thalthem hon amavotaovin ahi.
target: The fighting grew fierce around Saul, and when the archers overtook him, they wounded him.

source: Chuin Saul'in agalvon popa jah-a, Nachemjam satdoh inlang, hiche cheptan louho khu ahunguva eihung jumso louna dingun, neisun pailet jenggin, ati. Ahivangin agalvon popa chu anompoi; ajehchu ama akichalheh jengin ahi. Hijeh chun Saul'in achemjam alan, achung chu abotan ahi.
target: Saul said to his armor-bearer, “Draw your sword and run me through, or these uncircumcised fellows will come and abuse me.” But his armor-bearer was terrified and would not do it; so Saul took his own sword and fell on it.

source: Chule agalvon popan Saul athi amuphatnin, chutobang machun achemjam chungchu abon, athitan ahi.
target: When the armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his sword and died.

source: Hitichun Saul le achapate thum, chule a-insung jouse chu athikhom taovin ahi.
target: So Saul and his three sons died, and all his house died together.

source: Chuin phaichama um Israel miho jousen, amaho ajamuva, chule Saul le achapate athiu chu amu phatnun, akhopihou adalhauvin ajamtaovin ahi. Chuin Philistine te ahungun, hicheho-a chun acheng taovin ahi.
target: When all the Israelites in the valley saw that the army had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their towns and fled. And the Philistines came and occupied them.

source: Chuin ajingin ahitin ahi, Philistine te mithiho von sutlha dinga ahunguva ahile, Saul le achapate Gilboa molsanga anathiu chu amudoh taovin ahi.
target: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

source: Chuin avon asutlhah phatnun, aluchang le agalvon alauvin, amilim semthuhou le mipite henga thupha pole dingin Philistine te gamsunga athot kimvel taovin ahi.
target: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news among their idols and their people.

source: Chule agalvonho chu a-pathen houin'a akoijun, aluchu Dagon houin'a atah-un ahi.
target: They put his armor in the temple of their gods and hung up his head in the temple of Dagon.

source: Chuin Jabesh-Gilead mite jousen Saul chunga Philistine te thilbol jouse ajah phatnun,
target: When all the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,

source: Mihangsan sese akipatnun, Saul le achapate longchu agalamangun, Jabesh'a ahinpouvin, aguhou chu Jabesh'a gangpi thing noija chun avuijun, chule nisagi an angolun ahi.
target: all their valiant men went and took the bodies of Saul and his sons and brought them to Jabesh. Then they buried their bones under the great tree in Jabesh, and they fasted seven days.

source: Hitichun Saul chu Pakai thu angailou jeh le, lhakou ho henga thumop adoh-a, Pakai douna suhkhelna aneitah jeh-in athitan ahi;
target: Saul died because he was unfaithful to the Lord ; he did not keep the word of the Lord and even consulted a medium for guidance,

source: Chule aman Pakai adongpon: hijeh chun aman ama chu athatnin, chule alenggam chu Jesse chapa David henga apetan ahi.
target: and did not inquire of the Lord . So the Lord put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.

source: Chuin Israelte jouse David henga Hebron'a ahung kikhom khomun, ahenga, Ven keiho nagule naphe kahiuve.
target: All Israel came together to David at Hebron and said, “We are your own flesh and blood.

source: Chujongle tumasanga Saul lengchanlaijin jong Israel puidoh'a puilutjia chu nangma nahin: chule Pakai na Pathen'in naheng-ah, Nangman kami Israelte navah-a, kamipi Israelte chunga vai napoh ding ahi, ati'e atiuvin ahi.
target: In the past, even while Saul was king, you were the one who led Israel on their military campaigns. And the Lord your God said to you, ‘You will shepherd my people Israel, and you will become their ruler.’ ”

source: Hijeh chun Israel upaho jouse Hebron'a lengpa henga ahungun; David'in Hebron'a chun amahotoh Pakai masanga kitepna asemin; chuin Pakaiyin Samuel mangcha asei thucheng dung juijin, David chu Israel chunga leng hidingin thao anutaovin ahi.
target: When all the elders of Israel had come to King David at Hebron, he made a covenant with them at Hebron before the Lord , and they anointed David king over Israel, as the Lord had promised through Samuel.

source: Chuin David le Israelte jouse Jerusalem'a acheuvin, hichu Jebus ahin; chuche gama anachengho chu Jebus mite ahiuve.
target: David and all the Israelites marched to Jerusalem (that is, Jebus). The Jebusites who lived there

source: Chuin Jebus'a chengho chun David hengah, Nangma hilama nahunglou helding ahi, atiuve. Ahijeng vangin David'in Zion kulpi chu alan, hichu David khopi ahung hitai.
target: said to David, “You will not get in here.” Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion—which is the City of David.

source: Chuin David'in, Koihile Jebus mite gasat masapen pen chu lamkaiho pipui hiding ahi, ati. Hitichun Zeruiah chapa Joab chu akontou masapenin, apipuipen ahitan ahi.
target: David had said, “Whoever leads the attack on the Jebusites will become commander in chief.” Joab son of Zeruiah went up first, and so he received the command.

source: Chuin David chu kulpi-a chun achengin; hijeh chun amahon hichu David khopi asahtaovin ahi.
target: David then took up residence in the fortress, and so it was called the City of David.

source: Chuin aman khopi chu Millo'a pat akimvelse geijin asadoh-in; chule Joab'in khopi amohse chu asemphan ahi.
target: He built up the city around it, from the terraces to the surrounding wall, while Joab restored the rest of the city.

source: Hitichun janel Pakaiyin aumpi jeh chun; David akhangtou chehcheh jengtan ahi.
target: And David became more and more powerful, because the Lord Almighty was with him.

source: Hicheho hi Israelte chungchanga Pathen'in anaseidoh dungjuija David'in anei mihat pipuiho, alenggam sunga ama le Israel pumpi to kisuhat hochu ahiuve.
target: These were the chiefs of David’s mighty warriors—they, together with all Israel, gave his kingship strong support to extend it over the whole land, as the Lord had promised—

source: Chule hichehi David'in anei mihat jat ahi: gal lamkaiho pipuipen Hachmon mi Jashobeam ahin: aman atengcha alamin phat khatseh'in mi jathum jen athatgam helin ahi.
target: this is the list of David’s mighty warriors: Jashobeam, a Hakmonite, was chief of the officers; he raised his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed in one encounter.

source: Chule ama bana chu Ahoh mi Dodo chapa Eleazer ahin, amahi mihat thumho lah-a khat ahi.
target: Next to him was Eleazar son of Dodai the Ahohite, one of the three mighty warriors.

source: Ama David toh Pasdamim'a umkhom ahin, chule hiche mun'a chun Philistine te galsat dingin anakikhom khomun, chule hiche mun'a chu sakol chang dimsetna akena leiset beh khat aumin ahi. Chuin mipi ho chu Philistine te masanga konin ajamtaove.
target: He was with David at Pas Dammim when the Philistines gathered there for battle. At a place where there was a field full of barley, the troops fled from the Philistines.

source: Chuin amaho chu loulaija chun dettah-in apangun, ahuhdoh-un, chule Philistine te chu athatnun; chule Pakaiyin amaho chu huhdohna loupitah-in ahuhdohtai.
target: But they took their stand in the middle of the field. They defended it and struck the Philistines down, and the Lord brought about a great victory.

source: Tun gal lamkai somthum lah-a mi thum chu, songpi lama Adullam songko sunga David henga chun achesuh-un; chule Philistine sepai janel chun Rephaim phaichama chun pon in akison uvin ahi.
target: Three of the thirty chiefs came down to David to the rock at the cave of Adullam, while a band of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.

source: Chule hichepetna chu David kulpi-a uma ahin, chule Philistine te galsat miho chu Bethlehem'a pansaova ahi.
target: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the Philistine garrison was at Bethlehem.

source: Chuin David'in ngaicha tah-in, Oh Bethlehem kotpi phung twikul'a twi chu dondinga eipethei khattou umtave leh! ati.
target: David longed for water and said, “Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!”

source: Chuin mi thumho chun Philistine sepai janel chu aphu vangun, Bethlehem kotpi phung twikul'a konin twi agakhaijun, ahin domun, David henga ahinchoijun ahi: ahinla hiche donding chu David anompon, ahinla Pakai henga asunglha jon,
target: So the Three broke through the Philistine lines, drew water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem and carried it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out to the Lord .

source: Hitin ati, Hiche kabolding hi ka Pathen'in eijahda maihen: ahinkhou tosetna-a dinga pedoh hiche miho thisanhi kadon dingham? Ajehchu ahinkhou tosetna puma ahinchoiju ahi, ati. Hijeh-a chun aman adon tapon ahi. Hichehohi mihat chungnung thumho bol ahi.
target: “God forbid that I should do this!” he said. “Should I drink the blood of these men who went at the risk of their lives?” Because they risked their lives to bring it back, David would not drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty warriors.

source: Chule Joab sopipa Abishai hi thumho pipui ahi: ajehchu aman mi jathum chunga atengcha alamin, athat gamhelin, thumho lah-a minphatna achangtai.
target: Abishai the brother of Joab was chief of the Three. He raised his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed, and so he became as famous as the Three.

source: Mi thumho lah-a chun ni teni sangin amachu ja-aumjon ahi; ajehchu ama alamkaiju ahi. Hijongle amasa mi thumho chu aphajoupoi.
target: He was doubly honored above the Three and became their commander, even though he was not included among them.

source: Kabzeel kho-a mihangsan pa chapa Jehoiada chapa Benaiah chun tohdoh tampi aneijin; keipi bahkai tobang Moab mi ni athatnin; chule achesuh-in buhbang lhah laijin kokhuh sunga keipi bahkai khat jong athatnin ahi.
target: Benaiah son of Jehoiada, a valiant fighter from Kabzeel, performed great exploits. He struck down Moab’s two mightiest warriors. He also went down into a pit on a snowy day and killed a lion.

source: Chule aman milen pitah, tong nga-a sang Egypt mi khat athatnin; chule Egypt mipa chun ponkhong ho talhang tejen tengcha khat akichoi ahin; chule aman atenggol akichoijin ajonsuh-in, Egypt mipa khutna konchun atengcha asalhah peh-in, ama tengcha mama chun athattan ahi.
target: And he struck down an Egyptian who was five cubits tall. Although the Egyptian had a spear like a weaver’s rod in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club. He snatched the spear from the Egyptian’s hand and killed him with his own spear.

source: Hichehohi Jehoiada chapa Benaiah thilbol ahin; mihat chungnung thumho lah-a chun minphat achangtan ahi.
target: Such were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada; he too was as famous as the three mighty warriors.

source: Veuvin, ama somthum lah-a jana achangin, ahin amasa mi thumho vang chu aphadehpoi; amachu David'in ama ngahtupho chunga apansah-in ahi.
target: He was held in greater honor than any of the Thirty, but he was not included among the Three. And David put him in charge of his bodyguard.

source: Chujongle agalsat ho lah-a mihangsan ho chu, Joab sopipa Asahel, Bethlehem'a Dodo chapa Elhanan,
target: The mighty warriors were: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo from Bethlehem,

source: Haror mi Shammoth, Pelon mi Helez,
target: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

source: Teko mi Ikkesh chapa Ira, Anathoth mi Abiezer,
target: Ira son of Ikkesh from Tekoa, Abiezer from Anathoth,

source: Hushath mi Sibbecai, Ahoh mi Ilai,
target: Sibbekai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

source: Netophah mi Maharai, Netophah mi Baanah chapa Heled,
target: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite,

source: Benjamin chapate gama um Gibeah mi Ribai chapa Ithai, Pirathon mi Benaiah,
target: Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah in Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

source: Gaash vadung ho-a cheng Hurai, Arbath mi Abiel,
target: Hurai from the ravines of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

source: Baharum mi Azmaveth, Shaalbon mi Eliahba,
target: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

source: Gizon mi Hashem chapate, Harar mi Shage chapa Jonathan,
target: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan son of Shagee the Hararite,

source: Harar mi Sacar chapa Ahiam, Ur chapa Eliphal,
target: Ahiam son of Sakar the Hararite, Eliphal son of Ur,

source: Mecherathmi Hepher, Pelon mi Ahijah,
target: Hepher the Mekerathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

source: Carmel mi Hezro, Ezbai chapa Naarai,
target: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai son of Ezbai,

source: Nathan sopipa Joel, Haggeri chapa Mibhar,
target: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar son of Hagri,

source: Ammon mi Zelek, Zeruiah chapa Joab galvon popa Beroth mi Naharai,
target: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah,

source: Ithri mi Ira, Ithri mi Gareb,
target: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

source: Hit mi Uriah, Ahlai chapa Zabad,
target: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad son of Ahlai,

source: Reuben mi Shiza chapa Adina, Reuben mite gal lamkaipa le amatoh um somthum ho,
target: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, who was chief of the Reubenites, and the thirty with him,

source: Maakah chapa Hanan, Chule Mithni mi Joshaphat,
target: Hanan son of Maakah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,

source: Ashterath mi Uzzia, Aroer mi Hotham chapate Shama le Jehiel,
target: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

source: Tiz mi Shimri chapa Jediael le asopipa Jaha,
target: Jediael son of Shimri, his brother Joha the Tizite,

source: Mahav mi Eliel, chule Elnaam chapate Jeribai le Joshaviah chule Moab mi Ithmah,
target: Eliel the Mahavite, Jeribai and Joshaviah the sons of Elnaam, Ithmah the Moabite,

source: Mesoba mi Eliel, Obed chule Jasiel ahiuve.
target: Eliel, Obed and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

source: Tun hichehohi Kish chapa Saul jeh-a akikulkhup laija Ziklag'a David koma hungho chu ahiuve: chule amaho chu galsatna-a kithopi-a pang mihat ho ahiuve.
target: These were the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was banished from the presence of Saul son of Kish (they were among the warriors who helped him in battle;

source: Amahon thal akichoijun, song senale thal kapdohna dinga akhut jetlamle veilam thothei cheh ahiuvin, Benjamin phunga Saul sopite ahiuve.
target: they were armed with bows and were able to shoot arrows or to sling stones right-handed or left-handed; they were relatives of Saul from the tribe of Benjamin):

source: Apipuipenu chu Ahiezer ahin, aban Joash, Gibeath mi Shemaah chapateni ahilhonin; chule Azmaveth chapateni Jeziel le Pelet, chule Anathoth mi Berachah le Jehu,
target: Ahiezer their chief and Joash the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet the sons of Azmaveth; Berakah, Jehu the Anathothite,

source: Chule somthum chungle somthum lah-a mihat Gibeon mi Ismaiah, chule Gederath mi Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan chule Josabad,
target: and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty warrior among the Thirty, who was a leader of the Thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, Jozabad the Gederathite,

source: Haruph mi Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah chule Shephatiah,
target: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah and Shephatiah the Haruphite;

source: Korah mi Elkanah, Jesaiah, Azareel, Joezer chule Jashobeam,
target: Elkanah, Ishiah, Azarel, Joezer and Jashobeam the Korahites;

source: Chule Gedora Jeroham chapate, Joelah chule Zebadiah ahiuve.
target: and Joelah and Zebadiah the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.

source: Chule Gad miho gamthip kul sunga David henga behho chu mihat mihang ngen, chule galsatmi galsat dinga lhingset, lumle pho thothem cheh, amaiju keipi bahkai mai banghel, akaljan danu molsanga sakhi banga gang ahiuve.
target: Some Gadites defected to David at his stronghold in the wilderness. They were brave warriors, ready for battle and able to handle the shield and spear. Their faces were the faces of lions, and they were as swift as gazelles in the mountains.

source: Akhatna Ezer, anina Obadiah, athumna Eliab,
target: Ezer was the chief, Obadiah the second in command, Eliab the third,

source: Alina Mishmannah, angana Jeremiah,
target: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

source: Agupna Attai, asagina Eliel,
target: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

source: Agetna Johanan, akona Elzabad,
target: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

source: Asomna Jeremiah, asomlekhat na Machbannai.
target: Jeremiah the tenth and Makbannai the eleventh.

source: Hichehohi Gad chapate sepai janel gal lamkai cheh ahiuvin: alah uva aneopen chu jakhat chunga thunei, chule alenpen sangkhat chunga thunei ahiuve.
target: These Gadites were army commanders; the least was a match for a hundred, and the greatest for a thousand.

source: Amahohi lha masapen sung, luikam khela twi let leuva Jordan asolaitah-a palgalkai ho ahiuvin; amahon phaichama chengho chu lhumlamle solama agadel jamun ahi.
target: It was they who crossed the Jordan in the first month when it was overflowing all its banks, and they put to flight everyone living in the valleys, to the east and to the west.

source: Chuin David kulpi-a chun Benjamin le Judah miho ahunguvin ahi.
target: Other Benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.

source: Chuin amaho kimupi din David apotdoh-in ajah uva, Eipanpidia chamna-a hung nahiule, kalungthim hi nangho-a kijopmat ding; amavang kakhut teni-a thildihlou kabolkhahlou munasa-a, kamelmate henga eipedoh dinga hung nahiule, ipu ipateu Pathen'in hinvehen lang, nathu-u tanhen, ati.
target: David went out to meet them and said to them, “If you have come to me in peace to help me, I am ready for you to join me. But if you have come to betray me to my enemies when my hands are free from violence, may the God of our ancestors see it and judge you.”

source: Chuphatnin gal lamkaiho pipui Amasai chungah lhagao ahungchun, hitin ati, Keiho nanga kahiuve David, nangma lama panga kahiuve Jesse chapa: lungmon, nachunga lungmon umhen, chule napanpi ho chunga lungmon umhen: ajehchu na Pathen'in napanpi, ati. Chuin David'in amaho chu asangin, honho lamkaijin asemtai.
target: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, chief of the Thirty, and he said: “We are yours, David! We are with you, son of Jesse! Success, success to you, and success to those who help you, for your God will help you.” So David received them and made them leaders of his raiding bands.

source: Chule Saul doudinga Philistine te toh ahunglaijun, Manasseh mi phabepmin David anajopmun: ahinla amahon ana kithopi pouve: ajehchu Philistine te pakaiho kihoutoh uva, Ama apu Saul lama lutnintin, iluchang diuvin tosetna hibep ding ahi, atiuva asolmangu ahitai.
target: Some of the tribe of Manasseh defected to David when he went with the Philistines to fight against Saul. (He and his men did not help the Philistines because, after consultation, their rulers sent him away. They said, “It will cost us our heads if he deserts to his master Saul.”)

source: Ziklag'a achen ahile Manasseh mi Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu chule Zilthai Manasseh miho asang sang lamkaiho ama lama alutnun ahi.
target: When David went to Ziklag, these were the men of Manasseh who defected to him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu and Zillethai, leaders of units of a thousand in Manasseh.

source: Chuin amahon michomgamho loi douna-in David akithopiuvin ahi; ajehchu amaho mihat mihangsan, sepai janel lamkai cheh hiuva ahi.
target: They helped David against raiding bands, for all of them were brave warriors, and they were commanders in his army.

source: Ajehchu chuche laija chu ani ania Pathen janel tobang sepai janel nasatah ahikahsea, David kithopi dinga hunghung jenguva ahi.
target: Day after day men came to help David, until he had a great army, like the army of God.

source: Chule hichehohi Pakai thu dungjuija, Saul lenggam chu ama-a hisah dinga Hebron'a David henga hung, galsat dinga galvon puma kigosa dema umjing sepaihon honho jat ahi.
target: These are the numbers of the men armed for battle who came to David at Hebron to turn Saul’s kingdom over to him, as the Lord had said:

source: Juda chate lumle tengcha choi, galsat dinga galvon puma kigosadem chu sangguple jaget ahiuve.
target: from Judah, carrying shield and spear—6,800 armed for battle;

source: Simeon chate galsat dinga mihat mihangsan cheh sangsagi le jakhat ahiuve.
target: from Simeon, warriors ready for battle—7,100;

source: Levi chate-a kon sangli le jagup ahiuve.
target: from Levi—4,600,

source: Aaron mite lamkai chu Jehoiada ahin, amatoh sangthum le jasagi ahiuve.
target: including Jehoiada, leader of the family of Aaron, with 3,700 men,

source: Chule Zadok, gollhang mihat hangsanle apa insunga gal lamkaiho somnileni ahiuve.
target: and Zadok, a brave young warrior, with 22 officers from his family;

source: Chule Saul insungmi, Benjamin miho chu sangthum ahiuvin, amaho atamjo Saul insung lama panga ahiuve.
target: from Benjamin, Saul’s tribe—3,000, most of whom had remained loyal to Saul’s house until then;

source: Chule Ephraim chate apu apateu insung pumpi-a minthang cheh sangsomni le jaget ahiuve.
target: from Ephraim, brave warriors, famous in their own clans—20,800;

source: Chule Manasseh phung kehkhat-a kon David lenga semdinga hungdia kiminkut cheh chu sangsom le sangget ahiuve.
target: from half the tribe of Manasseh, designated by name to come and make David king—18,000;

source: Chule Issachar chate-a kon phat hetthemna nei, Israel'in ipi abolding hethem; aluchang cheh-u jani ahiuvin, asopihou jouse chu amaho thu thu ahi.
target: from Issachar, men who understood the times and knew what Israel should do—200 chiefs, with all their relatives under their command;

source: Zebulun chate gal kondohthei, gal manchah tincheng tho-a galsat them, panmun neithei cheh sangsomnga ahiuvin: amahohi lungtho neilou ahiuve.
target: from Zebulun, experienced soldiers prepared for battle with every type of weapon, to help David with undivided loyalty—50,000;

source: Chule Naphtali'a kon gal lamkai sangkhat, chule lumle teng toh tho-a amahotoh umkhom sangsomthum le sangsagi ahiuve.
target: from Naphtali—1,000 officers, together with 37,000 men carrying shields and spears;

source: Chule Dan'a kon galsatna konthei cheh sangsomni le sangget le jagup ahiuve.
target: from Dan, ready for battle—28,600;

source: Chule Asher'a kon galsatna konthei cheh, galbol them sangsomli ahiuve.
target: from Asher, experienced soldiers prepared for battle—40,000;

source: Chule Jordan gal langkhat lama um Reuben mite, Gad mite chule Manasseh phung kehkhatna kon, gal mun'a galmanchah tincheng mangthem cheh mi sangjakhat le sangsomni ahiuve.
target: and from east of the Jordan, from Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh, armed with every type of weapon—120,000.

source: Hicheho jousehi galsat mi, panmun tuhthei cheh, Israel jouse chunga David lenga semdinga lungthim chamkim tah-a Hebron'a hunga ahiuvin, chule Israel adang amoh chengse jong chu David lenga semdinga lungkitoh sel ahiuvin ahi.
target: All these were fighting men who volunteered to serve in the ranks. They came to Hebron fully determined to make David king over all Israel. All the rest of the Israelites were also of one mind to make David king.

source: Hitichun hiche mun'a chun amaho David toh nithum aumun, anekhom adonkhomun ahi: ajehchu asopihouvin amaho ding anagonpeh-u ahi.
target: The men spent three days there with David, eating and drinking, for their families had supplied provisions for them.

source: Chukalvalin amaho nai vela um Issachar, Zebulun, chule Naphtali ho jengin jong sangan ho, sangongsang ho, sakolpol ho, chule bongchal hochun sa, an, theichang changlhah, lengpithei gop bohho, lengpitwi, sathao chule bongchal ho le kelngoi ho atama tam ahinpo uvin ahi: ajehchu Israel sunga kipa thanop uma ahi.
target: Also, their neighbors from as far away as Issachar, Zebulun and Naphtali came bringing food on donkeys, camels, mules and oxen. There were plentiful supplies of flour, fig cakes, raisin cakes, wine, olive oil, cattle and sheep, for there was joy in Israel.

source: Chuin David'in asangsang le ajaja gal lamkaiho le vaipoho jouse akihou khompin ahi.
target: David conferred with each of his officers, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds.

source: Chule David'in Israel mipi ho jouse jah-a, Hichehi nanghon pha nasah uva, chule Pakai i-Pathen'uva kon ahile, Israel gamsung jouse-a kidalha, muntina um isopihou heng, chule amaho toh akhopihoule akimvela cheng thempuho le Levi mite jouse jong, hitichun eiho henga ahung kikhop khom theina dingun mi solkimvelu hitin:
target: He then said to the whole assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you and if it is the will of the Lord our God, let us send word far and wide to the rest of our people throughout the territories of Israel, and also to the priests and Levites who are with them in their towns and pasturelands, to come and join us.

source: Chule eihon i-Pathen'u thingkhong chu ihenguva polut kit taohite: ajehchu eihon Saul nikho laijin hichu inadon tapouvin ahi, ati.
target: Let us bring the ark of our God back to us, for we did not inquire of it during the reign of Saul.”

source: Chuin mipi kikhomho jouse chun chutia chu aboldiuvin aseitaove: ajehchu hichu mi jouse mitmu-a dih sohkeija ahi.
target: The whole assembly agreed to do this, because it seemed right to all the people.

source: Hitichun David'in Egypt gam Shihor'a pat Hamath lutna geija Israelte jouse chu, Kirjath-jearim'a kona Pathen kitepna thingkhong podingin akhom khomtan ahi.
target: So David assembled all Israel, from the Shihor River in Egypt to Lebo Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath Jearim.

source: Chuin David le Israelte jouse chu Judah gama um Baalah kiti Kirjath-jearim'a um Cherub teni kikah-a cheng, Amin kiphon dohna, Pakai Pathen thingkhong podingin achetouvun ahi.
target: David and all Israel went to Baalah of Judah (Kiriath Jearim) to bring up from there the ark of God the Lord , who is enthroned between the cherubim—the ark that is called by the Name.

source: Chuin amahon Pathen thingkhong chu bong kangtalai thah khatnin Abinadab in'a konin apodoh-un, Uzza le Ahio in bong kangtalai chun atol lhone.
target: They moved the ark of God from Abinadab’s house on a new cart, with Uzzah and Ahio guiding it.

source: Chule David le Israelte jousen ajochanun Pathen anga lasah pumin, selangdah le tumging toh, khongcha le khutbeh, chule sumkon ho mut pumin alamuvin ahi.
target: David and all the Israelites were celebrating with all their might before God, with songs and with harps, lyres, timbrels, cymbals and trumpets.

source: Chuin Chidon changchilna phol ahung geitah-un, Uzz'in akhut alhangdoh-in thingkhong agah tuh go-in ahi: ajehchu bongchal chu kipala ahi.
target: When they came to the threshing floor of Kidon, Uzzah reached out his hand to steady the ark, because the oxen stumbled.

source: Chuin Uzza chunga Pakai lunghanna ahung koujah tan, aman thingkhong akhutna atuhjeh chun adengin; chuachun Pathen masanga athitan ahi.
target: The Lord ’s anger burned against Uzzah, and he struck him down because he had put his hand on the ark. So he died there before God.

source: Chuin Uzza chunga Pakaiyin akhut alhajeh chun David alunglhaitapon: hijeh chun tuni geijin chuche munchu Perez Uzza akitin ahi.
target: Then David was angry because the Lord ’s wrath had broken out against Uzzah, and to this day that place is called Perez Uzzah.

source: Chule chuche nikho chun David'in Pathen akichatan, Pathen thingkhong hi iti in'a kahenga kapohlut ding ham? ati.
target: David was afraid of God that day and asked, “How can I ever bring the ark of God to me?”

source: Hijeh chun Davidn'in thingkhong chu David khopi ama in'a alhutapon, Git mi Obed-edom in'a chun apolut jotan ahi.
target: He did not take the ark to be with him in the City of David. Instead, he took it to the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.

source: Chule Pathen thingkhong chu Obed-edom insungmi tetoh ama in'a lhathum jen aumdentan ahi. Chule Pakaiyin Obed-edom insung chu aneiho jouse toh phatthei aboh tan ahi.
target: The ark of God remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house for three months, and the Lord blessed his household and everything he had.

source: Tun Tyre lengpa Hiram'in David koma thupole ho toh lhonin, cedar thingtumho, songkheng themho chule thingthemho a-in sahpeh dingin asolin ahi.
target: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, along with cedar logs, stonemasons and carpenters to build a palace for him.

source: Ami Israelte jala alenggam choisanga aumtahjeh chun, Pakaiyin Israelte lenga atundet ahichu David'in akihet tai.
target: And David knew that the Lord had established him as king over Israel and that his kingdom had been highly exalted for the sake of his people Israel.

source: Chuin David'in Jerusalem'a chun ji akipuibe nalaijin: David'in chapate le chanute ahinbe nalaije.
target: In Jerusalem David took more wives and became the father of more sons and daughters.

source: Tun hichehohi Jerusalem'a anei achate minho chu ahi: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan chule Solomon,
target: These are the names of the children born to him there: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

source: Chule Ibhar, Elishua chule Elpalet,
target: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,

source: Chule Nogah, Nepheg chule Japhia,
target: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

source: Chule Elishama, Beeliada, chule Eliphelet ahiuve.
target: Elishama, Beeliada and Eliphelet.

source: Chuin Philistine miten David chu Israel jouse chunga leng dingin thao akinutai ti ajah phatnun, Philistine mite jouse David holdingin achetou taovin ahi. Chuin David'in hichu ajan, amaho kisatpi din akondohtai.
target: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, they went up in full force to search for him, but David heard about it and went out to meet them.

source: Chule Philistine te ahungun Rephaim phaichama akithecheh taove.
target: Now the Philistines had come and raided the Valley of Rephaim;

source: Chuin David'in Pathen adongin, Philistine te satna kakontou dingham? Chule kakhutna amaho chu neipeh ding hinam? ati. Chuin Pakaiyin ajah-a, Kontouvin, amaho chu nakhutna kapehdoh ding ahi, ati.
target: so David inquired of God: “Shall I go and attack the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hands?” The Lord answered him, “Go, I will deliver them into your hands.”

source: Hitichun amaho Baal-perazim geijin ahung touvun, David'in chuachun amaho ajoutan ahi. Chuphatnin David'in, Twi kivocheh bangin kamelmate chu Pathen'in kakhutna avochehtai, ati. Hijeh chun amahon chuche mun chu Baal-perazim asahtaove.
target: So David and his men went up to Baal Perazim, and there he defeated them. He said, “As waters break out, God has broken out against my enemies by my hand.” So that place was called Baal Perazim.

source: Chuin amahon chukoma a-pathen hou adalhah phatnun, David'in thupeh apen, meijin ahalvam taove.
target: The Philistines had abandoned their gods there, and David gave orders to burn them in the fire.

source: Chuin Philistine te chu avelin phaichama chun ahung kithecheh kitnuvin ahi.
target: Once more the Philistines raided the valley;

source: Hijeh chun David'in Pathen adongkitnin ahile, Pathen'in ajah-a, Amaho nunga khun chetou hih-in; amaho-a konin kihei mang inlang, thingtheimi phung jonna khun achunguva hung chun.
target: so David inquired of God again, and God answered him, “Do not go directly after them, but circle around them and attack them in front of the poplar trees.

source: Chule hunghiti ding ahi; thingtheimi thing chunga akitol ginu najah teng, galsatdia nakondoh ding ahi: ajehchu Philistine galmi janel that dinga namasanga Pathen kondoh-a ahitai, ati.
target: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the poplar trees, move out to battle, because that will mean God has gone out in front of you to strike the Philistine army.”

source: Hijeh chun David'in Pathen'in thupeh bangchun abolin; amahon Philistine galmi janel chu Gibeon'a pat Gazer geijin athatpeh taovin ahi.
target: So David did as God commanded him, and they struck down the Philistine army, all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.

source: Chuin gam jouse-a David min athangtan; chule Pakaiyin nam jouse chunga ama ginna achuhsah tan ahi.
target: So David’s fame spread throughout every land, and the Lord made all the nations fear him.

source: Chule David'in David khopi-a chun a-inding ho asan, chule Pathen thingkhong dingin mun khat agongin, ponbuh asonpeh-in ahi.
target: After David had constructed buildings for himself in the City of David, he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.

source: Hichun David'in, Levi mite tailouvin Pathen thingkhong apohthei louhel dingu ahi; ajehchu Pakaiyin amaho chu Pathen thingkhong pole ding le atonsotna ama jendinga alhendoh ahiuve, ati.
target: Then David said, “No one but the Levites may carry the ark of God, because the Lord chose them to carry the ark of the Lord and to minister before him forever.”

source: Chuin David'in aumna dinga agonpehna mun'a chu Pakai thingkhong potou dingin, Israelte jouse chu Jerusalem'a akhom khomin ahi.
target: David assembled all Israel in Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the Lord to the place he had prepared for it.

source: Chule David'in Aaron chate le Levi mite akhomin:
target: He called together the descendants of Aaron and the Levites:

source: Kohath chapate lah-a kon; pipui Uriel, chule asopite jakhat le somni,
target: From the descendants of Kohath, Uriel the leader and 120 relatives;

source: Merari chate lah-a kon; pipui Asaiah, chule asopite jani le somni,
target: from the descendants of Merari, Asaiah the leader and 220 relatives;

source: Gershom chapate lah-a kon; pipui Joel, chule asopite jakhat le somthum,
target: from the descendants of Gershon, Joel the leader and 130 relatives;

source: Elizaphan chapate lah-a kon; pipui Shemaiah, chule asopite jani,
target: from the descendants of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the leader and 200 relatives;

source: Hebron chapate lah-a kon; pipui Eliel, chule asopite somget,
target: from the descendants of Hebron, Eliel the leader and 80 relatives;

source: Uziel chapate lah-a kon; pipui Amminadab, chule asopite jakhatle somleni ahiuve.
target: from the descendants of Uzziel, Amminadab the leader and 112 relatives.

source: Chuin David'in thempu teni Zadok le Abiathar, chule Levi mite Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel chule Amminadab akouvin,
target: Then David summoned Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel and Amminadab the Levites.

source: Ajah uva, Nangho Levi ho pate pipuiho nahiuve: aumna dinga kasemsa mun lama Israel Pakai Pathen thingkhong nahinpoh theina dingun, nangho le nasopite cheng kisuthengun.
target: He said to them, “You are the heads of the Levitical families; you and your fellow Levites are to consecrate yourselves and bring up the ark of the Lord , the God of Israel, to the place I have prepared for it.

source: Ajehchu amasa chunga chu hichu nabollou jeh-u le, abolding dan ama idohlou jeh uva, Pakai i-Pathen'un ichunguva akhut analhah ahi, ati.
target: It was because you, the Levites, did not bring it up the first time that the Lord our God broke out in anger against us. We did not inquire of him about how to do it in the prescribed way.”

source: Hitichun thempuho le Levi te chu Israel Pakai Pathen thingkhong podingin akisutheng taovin ahi.
target: So the priests and Levites consecrated themselves in order to bring up the ark of the Lord , the God of Israel.

source: Chuin Levi chate chun Pakai thu dungjuija Mosi thupeh bangin, achunga moljola chun Pathen kitepna thingkhong chu alengkouvun apuvin ahi.
target: And the Levites carried the ark of God with the poles on their shoulders, as Moses had commanded in accordance with the word of the Lord .

source: Chuin David'in Levi pipuiho chu ahoupin, asopihou chu lasahna manchah pum, tumgingho le selangdah ho pum, chule khutbeh to tho-a, aw sangtah-a lasa dinga alhendoh diuvin aseipeh-in ahi.
target: David told the leaders of the Levites to appoint their fellow Levites as musicians to make a joyful sound with musical instruments: lyres, harps and cymbals.

source: Hitichun Levi hon Joel chapa Heman, chule asopite lah-a Berechiah chapa Asaph, asopihou Merari chapate lah-a Kushaiah chapa Ethan chu apansah-un;
target: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel; from his relatives, Asaph son of Berekiah; and from their relatives the Merarites, Ethan son of Kushaiah;

source: Chule amaho kitho-a aloi ni-a pangding asopihou chu; Zekeriah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Elipheleh, Mikneiah chule kotngah-a pang teni Obed-edom le Jeiel toh ahiuve.
target: and with them their relatives next in rank: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom and Jeiel, the gatekeepers.

source: Hitichun lasathem, Heman, Asaph chule Ethan chu sum-eng khutbeh bengin apansah uvin,
target: The musicians Heman, Asaph and Ethan were to sound the bronze cymbals;

source: Chule Zekeriah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah chule Benaiah chu Alamoth dungjuija tumging toh thoding ahiuvin;
target: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah and Benaiah were to play the lyres according to alamoth,

source: Chule Mattithiah, Elipheleh, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel chule Azaziah chu Sheminith dungjuija selangdah toh thoding ahiuve.
target: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel and Azaziah were to play the harps, directing according to sheminith.
