source: Chule Levi te pipui Chenaniah chu labul-in apangin ahi; ajehchu ama athep jeh-in lahil in apangin ahi.
target: Kenaniah the head Levite was in charge of the singing; that was his responsibility because he was skillful at it.

source: Chule Berechiah le Elkanah chu thingkhong kotngah-in apang lhonin ahi.
target: Berekiah and Elkanah were to be doorkeepers for the ark.

source: Chule thempuho Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethaneel, Amasai, Zekeriah, Benaiah chule Eliezer chu Pathen thingkhong masanga sumkon mut ahiuvin; chule Obed-edom le Jehiah chu thingkhong umna kotngah ahilhone.
target: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah and Eliezer the priests were to blow trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-Edom and Jehiah were also to be doorkeepers for the ark.

source: Hitichun David le Israel upaho, chule asang asang chunga gal lamkaiho chu Obed-edom in'a kona Pakai kitepna thingkhong kipahtah-a gapotou din ache taovin ahi.
target: So David and the elders of Israel and the commanders of units of a thousand went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the house of Obed-Edom, with rejoicing.

source: Chule ahitin ahi, Pakai kitepna thingkhong pu-a pang Levi ho chu Pathen'in akithopi phatchun, amahon bongchal sagile kelngoichal sagin ganlhaina aboluvin ahi.
target: Because God had helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord , seven bulls and seven rams were sacrificed.

source: Chule David le kitepna thingkhong jonga pang Levi ho jouse, chule lasaho le lalamkaipa Chenaniah chu tupat ponnemin akivonun; David'in jong tupat ponnem boitong sangkhol aki-ah in ahi.
target: Now David was clothed in a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who were carrying the ark, and as were the musicians, and Kenaniah, who was in charge of the singing of the choirs. David also wore a linen ephod.

source: Hitichun Israelte jousen a-ao tothon, sumkon binei ginle sumkon gin, khutbeh gin, tumging le selangdah gin to thon Pakai kitepna thingkhong chu apotou taovin ahi.
target: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouts, with the sounding of rams’ horns and trumpets, and of cymbals, and the playing of lyres and harps.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Pakai thutep thingkhong chu David khopi sung ahunglhun tah-in, Saul chanu Michal'in David lengpa lamle chople chu bangkotna konin amutan: alungsunga amuneo lheh-in ahi.
target: As the ark of the covenant of the Lord was entering the City of David, Michal daughter of Saul watched from a window. And when she saw King David dancing and celebrating, she despised him in her heart.

source: Chutichun amahon Pathen thingkhong chu ahin pouvin, David'in chuche dinga anason ponbuh lailung tah-a chun angauvin; chule Pathen angsunga govam thilto le chamna thilto atoh-un ahi.
target: They brought the ark of God and set it inside the tent that David had pitched for it, and they presented burnt offerings and fellowship offerings before God.

source: Chuin David'in govam thilto le chamna thilto aboljou phatnin, Pakai minin mipi ho chu phatthei aboh-in ahi.
target: After David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord .

source: Chule Israelte amitakip apasal anumeijin, mitin changlhah tumkhat, saphehoi lhang khat, chule lengpitwi pai khat apecheh-in ahi.
target: Then he gave a loaf of bread, a cake of dates and a cake of raisins to each Israelite man and woman.

source: Chule aman Levi te mi phabep chu Pakai thingkhong masanga lhacha ding, thu ching ding, chule Israel Pakai Pathen thangvah le vahchoi dingin apansah-in;
target: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord , to extol, thank, and praise the Lord , the God of Israel:

source: Pipui Asaph, chule amabana Zekeriah, Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah chule Obed-edom ahiuvin: chule Jeiel chu tumgingle selangdah thoding ahin, hinlah Asaph chu thih khutbeh bengin apangin;
target: Asaph was the chief, and next to him in rank were Zechariah, then Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom and Jeiel. They were to play the lyres and harps, Asaph was to sound the cymbals,

source: Thempu Benaiah le Jahaziel'in Pathen kitepna thingkhong masanga chun sumkon amutjing lhonin ahi.
target: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests were to blow the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God.

source: Chule hiche nikho chun David'in amasapen dingin hiche Pakai thangvahna la Asaph le asopite khutna apedoh-in ahi.
target: That day David first appointed Asaph and his associates to give praise to the Lord in this manner:

source: Pakai henga vahchoina peuvin lang, aminin taovun, mihemte lah-a athilbol hetsah-un.
target: Give praise to the Lord , proclaim his name; make known among the nations what he has done.

source: Ahenga la saovin, Ahenga vahchoi La saovin, athil kidang bolho jouse seijun.
target: Sing to him, sing praise to him; tell of all his wonderful acts.

source: Amintheng chu loupisah-un; Pakai holho lungthim kipah hen.
target: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice.

source: Pakai le ahatna holunlang; tanglouvin amai holjingun.
target: Look to the Lord and his strength; seek his face always.

source: Aman ana tohdohsa anatoh kidangho, athil kidangho, akamsunga athutanho chu geldoh-un;
target: Remember the wonders he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he pronounced,

source: Vo nangho Israel chilhah asohte, vo alhentum nangho Jacob chate,
target: you his servants, the descendants of Israel, his chosen ones, the children of Jacob.

source: Amachu Pakai i-Pathen'u ahin; athutanho chu leiset chung jouse-a aume.
target: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

source: Akitepna chu a-itih-in geldoh jingun; khang sang sanga dinga athupeh thuho chu;
target: He remembers his covenant forever, the promise he made, for a thousand generations,

source: Abraham henga akitepna ngei le, Isaac henga akihahselna chu;
target: the covenant he made with Abraham, the oath he swore to Isaac.

source: Chule hiche mama chu Jacob henga danthu-a dingin asudetnin; chule Israelte henga tonsotna kitepna dingin asuhdetnin,
target: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:

source: Ahenga, Canaan gam chu nangma dinga, nachan ding gouva kapeh ding nahi, ati.
target: “To you I will give the land of Canaan as the portion you will inherit.”

source: Nangho hiche gamahi lhomcha bou, tahbeh-a lhomcha bou khopem nahilaiju chun.
target: When they were but few in number, few indeed, and strangers in it,

source: Chule amaho nam khatna kona nam khatna, lenggam khatna kona midang henga achele laijun,
target: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.

source: Koiman adihlouva aboldiu aphalpon; chule amaho jeh-in lengho aphohsal jin;
target: He allowed no one to oppress them; for their sake he rebuked kings:

source: Kathaonupa hi tongkha hih-un, chule kathemgao ho chunga khangse hih-un, atin ahi.
target: “Do not touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm.”

source: Leiset pumpin Pakai vahchoi La saovin: anitinin ahuhhingna phongjalun.
target: Sing to the Lord , all the earth; proclaim his salvation day after day.

source: Aloupi na chu Pathen helou ho lah-a; chule anatoh kidangho chu namtin lah-a phongjalun.
target: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous deeds among all peoples.

source: Ajehchu Pakai hi loupitah ahin; loupitah-a choiat ding ahi: Ama Pathen dang jouse chung vuma ginding ahi.
target: For great is the Lord and most worthy of praise; he is to be feared above all gods.

source: Ajehchu miho pathen jouse chu milim bou ahin; Pakaiyin vang vanho asemin ahi.
target: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but the Lord made the heavens.

source: Loupina leh jana ama-a aumin; thahatna le kipana ama munah aume.
target: Splendor and majesty are before him; strength and joy are in his dwelling place.

source: Pakai henga peuvin, nangho phungtina miho, Pakai henga loupi na le thahatna peuvin.
target: Ascribe to the Lord , all you families of nations, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.

source: Pakai henga aminto kithuh loupina peuvin: thilto hin choi jinlang a-angsung hungun; athenna hoina-in Pakai chu houvun.
target: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; bring an offering and come before him. Worship the Lord in the splendor of his holiness.

source: Lei pumpi a-anga kichauvin; vannoi jong akilon louna dinga detding ahi.
target: Tremble before him, all the earth! The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved.

source: Vanho kipahhen lang leiset thanom hen: chule Pakai alengchang tai, tin miten namtin lah-a seijuhen.
target: Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let them say among the nations, “The Lord reigns!”

source: Twipi le asunga umjouse ginglellul henlang: gamho le asunga umho jouse thanomuhen.
target: Let the sea resound, and all that is in it; let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them!

source: Chujou tengle gammang thing jousen Pakai anga la asahdoh dingu ahi, ajehchu ama leiset thutan dingin ahunge.
target: Let the trees of the forest sing, let them sing for joy before the Lord , for he comes to judge the earth.

source: Aw Pakai henga thangvahna peuvin; ajehchu ama aphan; ahepina atonsotnin aumjinge.
target: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.

source: Chule nanghon, Vo eihuh hinguva Pathen, neihuhhing un, namin theng kathangvah uva, napachat na-a loupina kapeh theina dingun, neikhom khomun lang, Pathen helouho-a konin neihuh doh-un, tiuvin.
target: Cry out, “Save us, God our Savior; gather us and deliver us from the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name, and glory in your praise.”

source: Israel Pakai Pathen chu atonsot atonsotnin nunnom hen, ati. Chuin mipi jouse chun AMEN, Pakai chu vahchoijun atiuve.
target: Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Then all the people said “Amen” and “Praise the Lord .”

source: Chutichun aman Asaph le asopite cheng chu Pakai kitepna thingkhong masanga chun, niseh-a tohding angai dungjuija kitepna thingkhong masanga tanglouva kinbol jing dingin;
target: David left Asaph and his associates before the ark of the covenant of the Lord to minister there regularly, according to each day’s requirements.

source: Chule Obed-edom toh asopite somgup le get, Jeduthun chapa Obed-edom chu Hosah toh kotngah-a pang dingin;
target: He also left Obed-Edom and his sixty-eight associates to minister with them. Obed-Edom son of Jeduthun, and also Hosah, were gatekeepers.

source: Chule thempu Zadok le asopite thempuho chu Gibeon'a um munsanga Pakai Houbuh masanga,
target: David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests before the tabernacle of the Lord at the high place in Gibeon

source: Aman Israelte ana thupeh, Pakai danthua kisun jouse dungjuija boldingle, tanglouva jingkah nilhah seh-a govam thilto maicham chunga govam thilto pejing dingin;
target: to present burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of burnt offering regularly, morning and evening, in accordance with everything written in the Law of the Lord , which he had given Israel.

source: Chule amaho chutoh Heman le Jeduthun, chule amin kiminkutna kilhengdoh adangho sese chu ahepina tonsotna aumjing jeh-a Pakai henga thangvahna pedingin;
target: With them were Heman and Jeduthun and the rest of those chosen and designated by name to give thanks to the Lord , “for his love endures forever.”

source: Chule amaho chutoh Heman le Jeduthun chu sumkon ho le thihkhutbehho chule Pathen tumgingtheiho tumging dingin adalhan ahi. Chule Jeduthun chapate chu kotngah ahiuve.
target: Heman and Jeduthun were responsible for the sounding of the trumpets and cymbals and for the playing of the other instruments for sacred song. The sons of Jeduthun were stationed at the gate.

source: Chuin ami jouse chu a-inlam cheh-a akile taovin: chule David jong a-insung vangboh dingin akiletan ahi.
target: Then all the people left, each for their own home, and David returned home to bless his family.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, David chu a-in'a atoupetnin Nathan themgao jah-a chun David'in, Ven keima cedar thinga kisa in'a kachengin, ahivangin Pakai kitepna thingkhong chu pon in noija aumnalaije, ati.
target: After David was settled in his palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, “Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of the covenant of the Lord is under a tent.”

source: Chuphat chun Nathan'in David jah-a, Nalunga um jouse chu boljengin; ajehchu Pathen'in na-umpinai, ati.
target: Nathan replied to David, “Whatever you have in mind, do it, for God is with you.”

source: Chuin chuche jan mama chun ahitin ahi, Nathan henga Pathen thu ahung lhungin, hitin ati,
target: But that night the word of God came to Nathan, saying:

source: Kasoh David henga chenlang hitin gaseijin, Pakaiyin hitihin aseije, Nangman kachenna ding in neisahpeh louding ahi;
target: “Go and tell my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord says: You are not the one to build me a house to dwell in.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Israel kapuidoh nikho-a pat tuni geihin in'a kacheng khapon; ponbuh-a kon ponbuh, chule Houbuh khatna kon achom khatna kakichon lele bouvin ahi.
target: I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought Israel up out of Egypt to this day. I have moved from one tent site to another, from one dwelling place to another.

source: Israelte jouse toh kachelena jouse-a, ka mipite vahdinga kathupeh Israel vaipoho khatpenpen jah-a chu, Ipidinga cedar thinga in neisahpeh lou uham, tia kasei khah em?
target: Wherever I have moved with all the Israelites, did I ever say to any of their leaders whom I commanded to shepherd my people, “Why have you not built me a house of cedar?” ’

source: Hijeh chun tun kasoh David jah-a hitia hi naseiding ahi, Janel Pakaiyin hitihin ati, kelngoihon lah-a kon, kelngoi nung najuina ngeija konin kami Israelte chunga leng dingin kapuidoh-in:
target: “Now then, tell my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty says: I took you from the pasture, from tending the flock, and appointed you ruler over my people Israel.

source: Chule nachelena lam jouse-a kalhonpi jingin, namasanga konin namelmaho jouse kasatlhah peh-in, chule leisetna um miloupi tahtah ho min bangin namin kathansah tan ahi.
target: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make your name like the names of the greatest men on earth.

source: Chujongle kami Israelte dinga munkhat kagonpeh ding, kaphulut uva, amaho amunuva cheng diu, chule kichonle talou dingu; chule abultil lai banga gitlouna chaten asuhgim kit tahlou dingu,
target: And I will provide a place for my people Israel and will plant them so that they can have a home of their own and no longer be disturbed. Wicked people will not oppress them anymore, as they did at the beginning

source: Kami Israelte chunga vaihom dinga thutan ho kathupeh lai banga chu. Chujongle namelmaho jouse kasuhnempeh ding nahi. Chukit jongle Pakaiyin insung khat natundoh pehding ahi ti kaseipeh nahi.
target: and have done ever since the time I appointed leaders over my people Israel. I will also subdue all your enemies. “ ‘I declare to you that the Lord will build a house for you:

source: Chule hunghiti ding ahi, nanikho ho ahung beija napu napate toh umkhom dinga nacheteng, nanunga nachilhah khat katundoh ding, amachu nachapate lah-a kon hiding; chule alenggam kaphudet ding ahi.
target: When your days are over and you go to be with your ancestors, I will raise up your offspring to succeed you, one of your own sons, and I will establish his kingdom.

source: Ama chun in eisahpeh ding, chule keiman tonsotna dinga alaltouna katundoh pehding ahi.
target: He is the one who will build a house for me, and I will establish his throne forever.

source: Keima apa kahiding, chule ama kachapa hiding: nangma masanga ana umpa-a kona kalahmang banga, ama-a kon kahepina kalahmang louding:
target: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will never take my love away from him, as I took it away from your predecessor.

source: Amavang atonsotna dinga ka insungle kalenggam sunga kachensah ding: chule alaltouna chu a-imatih chana dinga katundoh ding ahi, ati.
target: I will set him over my house and my kingdom forever; his throne will be established forever.’ ”

source: Hiche thuho jouse dungjui le, hiche gaothil muho dungjuijin, Nathan'in David hengah aseitan ahi.
target: Nathan reported to David all the words of this entire revelation.

source: Chuin David lengpa chu ahungin Pakai angah atouvin, hitin aseije, Vo Pakai Pathen, keima koi kahia, chule ka insunghi ipi hija, nangman hichangei jen neihinpui hitam?
target: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord , and he said: “Who am I, Lord God, and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?

source: Ahinla vo Pathen, hichehi nangma mitmun thil neocha bou ahi nalaije; ajehchu nasoh insunga khonung peh sottah jouva hunglhung ding jong naseijin, chule vo Pakai Pathen, nangman keimahi dinmun sangtah nei miho tobangin neikoije.
target: And as if this were not enough in your sight, my God, you have spoken about the future of the house of your servant. You, Lord God, have looked on me as though I were the most exalted of men.

source: Nasoh najabolna chunga hi David'in nahenga ipidang aseibe thei nahlai ding ham? Ajehchu nangman nasoh hi nahenai.
target: “What more can David say to you for honoring your servant? For you know your servant,

source: Vo Pakai, nasoh khohsahna jal le, nangmatah lunggel dungjuija, hiche thil loupiho jouse pihi hetsahna dinga, hiche thilloupitah jouse hi nabol ahi.
target: Lord . For the sake of your servant and according to your will, you have done this great thing and made known all these great promises.

source: Vo Pakai, kakol uva kajah-u jouse dungjuijin nangma tobang koima aumpon, chule nangma tailoujong Pathen dang khatcha aumpoi.
target: “There is no one like you, Lord , and there is no God but you, as we have heard with our own ears.

source: Chule nami Israelte tobanga Pathen'in amite hidinga aga lhatdoh, Egypt gama kona nahuhdoh namite-a dinga amasanguva kona namtin nanodoh-a, namin kithan nadinga thil kidangtah le loupitah nabolna nam khatbeh leiset chunga hi umkham?
target: And who is like your people Israel—the one nation on earth whose God went out to redeem a people for himself, and to make a name for yourself, and to perform great and awesome wonders by driving out nations from before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt?

source: Ajehchu nami Israelte hi tonsotna namite hidingin nasemtan; chule Pakai, nangma a-Pathen'u nahunghi tai.
target: You made your people Israel your very own forever, and you, Lord , have become their God.

source: Hijeh chun tun, Pakai, nasoh chung chang le a-insung chungchang thua nasei thil chu atonsotna dingin sudet inlang, chule naseisama bangin hinboltan.
target: “And now, Lord , let the promise you have made concerning your servant and his house be established forever. Do as you promised,

source: Pakai janel Pathen hi Israel Pathen ahin, Israel Pathen ngeichu ahi: tia tonsotna namin choisanga aumna dingin kiphut det hen; chule nasoh David insunghi nangma angsunga phudetnin umhen.
target: so that it will be established and that your name will be great forever. Then people will say, ‘The Lord Almighty, the God over Israel, is Israel’s God!’ And the house of your servant David will be established before you.

source: Ajehchu vo ka-Pathen, nangman nasoh henga insung khat natundoh pehding ahi tin naseipeh tan ahi: hijeh-a chu nasohhin na-anga taona ding lungthim amu ahi.
target: “You, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build a house for him. So your servant has found courage to pray to you.

source: Chule tun, Pakai, nangma Pathen nahin, chule hiche phatnahi nasoh henga nateppeh ahitai:
target: You, Lord , are God! You have promised these good things to your servant.

source: Hijeh chun tun, na-angsunga tonsotna a-umjing theina dingin, nasoh insung vangboh dinghi nalung lhaina hihen: ajehchu vo Pakai, nangman phatthei naboh ahitan, atonsot geija phatthei boh hiding ahitai, ati.
target: Now you have been pleased to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever in your sight; for you, Lord , have blessed it, and it will be blessed forever.”

source: Tun hiche jouhin ahitin ahi, David'in Philistine te ajouvin, chule asunemin, chuin Philistine mite khutna konin Gath le akhopiho alatan ahi.
target: In the course of time, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Gath and its surrounding villages from the control of the Philistines.

source: Chule Moab ajouvin, Moab mite chu David soh-in apangtauvin, chule thilpehho ahinpouvin ahi.
target: David also defeated the Moabites, and they became subject to him and brought him tribute.

source: Chuin David Euphrates vadung geija alenggam tungdet dinga achena-a, Hamath langa Zobah lengpa Hadarezer chu ajoutan ahi.
target: Moreover, David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, in the vicinity of Hamath, when he went to set up his monument at the Euphrates River.

source: Chule David'in ama-a konin sakol kangtalai sangkhat, sakol chunga tou sepai sangsagi, chule keng sepai sangsomni ahin lan: chuin David'in kangtalai kai sakol ho jouse chu akeng asat baijin, alah uva konchun sakol kangtalai jakhat kaiding bou akhenin ahi.
target: David captured a thousand of his chariots, seven thousand charioteers and twenty thousand foot soldiers. He hamstrung all but a hundred of the chariot horses.

source: Chuin Damascus'a kona Syria miho Zobah lengpa Hadarezer kithopi dinga ahung phatnun, David'in Syria miho chu mi sangsomni le sangni athatnin ahi.
target: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand of them.

source: Chuphatnin David'in Syria gamsung Damascus'a sepai atousah in; chule Syria miho chu David soh-in apanguvin, thilpeh ahin choijun ahi. Hitichun Pakaiyin David chu achenalam jouse ah avengbit jingin ahi.
target: He put garrisons in the Aramean kingdom of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to him and brought him tribute. The Lord gave David victory wherever he went.

source: Chuin David'in Hadarezer soh ho chunga um sana lumho chu alan, Jerusalem'a ahinpo tai.
target: David took the gold shields carried by the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.

source: Chutobang machun David nin Hadarezer khopiho Tibhath le Chun akonin sum-eng atama tam ahinlan; hicheho-a chun Solomon'in sum-eng twikong le khom, chule sum-eng belho asemin ahi.
target: From Tebah and Kun, towns that belonged to Hadadezer, David took a great quantity of bronze, which Solomon used to make the bronze Sea, the pillars and various bronze articles.

source: Tun Hamath lengpa Tou'in Zobah lengpa Hadarezer sepaihon jouse David nin ajousohtai ti ajah phatnin,
target: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,

source: Hadarezer chu akisatpi-a ajotah jeh chun, ama chibai bohdingle kipapi dingin, achapa Hadoram chu David lengpa henga asolin ahi: (ajehchu Hadarezer le Tou chu ana kidou jingsa ahilhone) chule aman sana, dangka chule sum-eng um le bel namkim ahin solthan ahi.
target: he sent his son Hadoram to King David to greet him and congratulate him on his victory in battle over Hadadezer, who had been at war with Tou. Hadoram brought all kinds of articles of gold, of silver and of bronze.

source: David lengpan jong hicheho chutoh nam dangdang ho: Edom'a kon, Moab'a kon, Ammon chate-a kon, Philistine miho-a kon chule Amalek mite-a kona ahinpohho dangka le sanaho chu Pakai henga apedohtai.
target: King David dedicated these articles to the Lord , as he had done with the silver and gold he had taken from all these nations: Edom and Moab, the Ammonites and the Philistines, and Amalek.

source: Chukalvalin Zeruiah chapa Abishai'in chi phaichama chun Edom mite Sangsom le sangget anathatnin ahi.
target: Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

source: Chule aman Edom'a sepai akoijin, Edom mite jouse chu David soh-in apangtauvin ahi. Hitichun Pakaiyin David chu achenalam chenga aveng bitnin ahi.
target: He put garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites became subject to David. The Lord gave David victory wherever he went.

source: Hitichun David Israel mite jouse chunga aleng changin, chule amipi jouse lah-a thudih le chondih na-in vai ahomin ahi.
target: David reigned over all Israel, doing what was just and right for all his people.

source: Chule sepai janel jouse chunga vaihoma chu Zeruiah chapa Joab ahin; chule Ahilud chapa Jehoshaphat chu thuching ahi.
target: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;

source: Chule Ahitub chapa Zadok le Abiathar chapa Abimelech chu thempu ahilhonin; chule Shavsha chu danthusun ahin;
target: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelek son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was secretary;

source: Chule Jehoiada chapa Benaiah chu Chereth mite le Peleth mite chunga vaibol ahin; chule David chapate vang lengpa kimvela pipuipen ahiuvin ahi.
target: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief officials at the king’s side.

source: Tun hiche jouhin ahitin ahi, Ammon mite lengpa Nahash athitan ahile, ama khelin achapa alengchang tan ahi.
target: In the course of time, Nahash king of the Ammonites died, and his son succeeded him as king.

source: Chuin David'in, Apan kachunga hepina anamusah jeh-in ken jong Nahash chapa Hanun chunga hepina vetsah inge, ati. Hitichun David'in apa chungchanga ama lhamon dingin thupole ho asole. Hitichun David sohte chu Ammon chate gama Hanun henga alhamon din ahungun ahi.
target: David thought, “I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent a delegation to express his sympathy to Hanun concerning his father. When David’s envoys came to Hanun in the land of the Ammonites to express sympathy to him,

source: Ahinla Ammon chate lah-a pipuihon Hanun jah-a, David'in napa ajajeh-a nahenga lhamon ding miho ahinsol hidinga nagelem? Asohhohi nahenga gamsung kholtoh-a lehkhup dinga, avelhi dingin hunga hilou uham? atiuvin ahi.
target: the Ammonite commanders said to Hanun, “Do you think David is honoring your father by sending envoys to you to express sympathy? Haven’t his envoys come to you only to explore and spy out the country and overthrow it?”

source: Hijeh chun Hanun'in David sohte chu amanin, akhamulu ahettol peh-in, chule avonhou chu akimlaitah atobuh-u phabep bepmin atanpeh-in, asolmang tan ahi.
target: So Hanun seized David’s envoys, shaved them, cut off their garments at the buttocks, and sent them away.

source: Chuphatnin mi phabep David henga acheuvin, miho kiboldanho chu aseipeh taovin ahi. Chule aman amaho kimu pidingin mi asolin ahi: ajehchu miho chu ajahcha behseh jenguve. Chuin lengpan, Nakhamulu ahung khandoh kit kahsen Jericho'a umunlang, chujou tengle hungkile taovin, ati.
target: When someone came and told David about the men, he sent messengers to meet them, for they were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho till your beards have grown, and then come back.”

source: Chuin Ammon chaten David dinga thet umtah-a akisemdoh-u amu phatnun, Hanun chule Ammon chaten Mesopotamia'a kon, Syria-Maachaha kon, chule Zobah'a kona kangtalai ho le sakol touthemho goina dingin dangka talent sangkhat athot taovin ahi.
target: When the Ammonites realized that they had become obnoxious to David, Hanun and the Ammonites sent a thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and charioteers from Aram Naharaim, Aram Maakah and Zobah.

source: Hijeh chun amahon kangtalai sangsomthum le sangni le Maachah lengpa le amipiho chu atha lah un: amaho ahungun Medeba masanga ponbuh akisonun, chule Ammon chateho akhopilen houva konin ahung kikhom khomun, galsat dingin ahung taovin ahi.
target: They hired thirty-two thousand chariots and charioteers, as well as the king of Maakah with his troops, who came and camped near Medeba, while the Ammonites were mustered from their towns and moved out for battle.

source: Chuin David'in hichu ajah phatnin, Joab le sepai hangsan janel jouse asoltan ahi.
target: On hearing this, David sent Joab out with the entire army of fighting men.

source: Chuin Ammon chate ahungdoh-un, khopi lutna kotpi-a galsat dingin akigolun; chule ahunga lengho jong loujaova chun apangun ahi.
target: The Ammonites came out and drew up in battle formation at the entrance to their city, while the kings who had come were by themselves in the open country.

source: Tun Joab'in anung ama-a adouding aume ti amu phatnin, Israel lah-a konin lhentum cheh phabep alhengdoh-in, Syria te doudingin agoltohtan ahi.
target: Joab saw that there were battle lines in front of him and behind him; so he selected some of the best troops in Israel and deployed them against the Arameans.

source: Chule mipi adang sese chu asopipa Abishai khutna apedoh-in, chule amaho chu Ammon chate doudingin akigol taovin ahi.
target: He put the rest of the men under the command of Abishai his brother, and they were deployed against the Ammonites.

source: Chuin aman, Syria mite keidinga ahatbeh seh-u le neihin huding ahi: ahinla Ammon chate chu nang dinga ahatbeh seh-ule keiman nangma kahin huding ahi.
target: Joab said, “If the Arameans are too strong for me, then you are to rescue me; but if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will rescue you.

source: Hangsan tah-in uminlang, imipiteu le I-Pathen'u khopiho dingin hangtah-in umhite; chule Pakaiyin amitmua pha asah bangtah-in hinbol tahen, ati.
target: Be strong, and let us fight bravely for our people and the cities of our God. The Lord will do what is good in his sight.”

source: Hitichun Joab le amatoh umkho mipite chu Syria miho doudingin anailut taovin; chuin amaho ama masanga ajamcheh taovin ahi.
target: Then Joab and the troops with him advanced to fight the Arameans, and they fled before him.

source: Chuin Ammon chaten Syria te ajamtaove ti amuphatnun, amaho jong chutobangma chun asopipa Abishai masanga konin ajamcheh-un, khopi sunga chun alut taovin ahi. Chujouvin Joab Jerusalem'a ahungtai.
target: When the Ammonites realized that the Arameans were fleeing, they too fled before his brother Abishai and went inside the city. So Joab went back to Jerusalem.

source: Chuin Syria ten Israelte aleluchu amuphatnun, sottole ho asolun, vadung gala um Syria mite chu agatoldoh taovin: chuin Hadarezer sepai janel gallamkai Shophach chu amasanguva alamkaijin ahi.
target: After the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they sent messengers and had Arameans brought from beyond the Euphrates River, with Shophak the commander of Hadadezer’s army leading them.

source: Chuin hiche chu David aseipeh taovin ahile, aman Israel jouse akhomin, Jordan agalkaijun, achunguva achun, kisatpi din akigol taovin ahi. Chutia Syria te doudinga David nin asepaiho agoltoh phatnin, amahon akisatpi taove.
target: When David was told of this, he gathered all Israel and crossed the Jordan; he advanced against them and formed his battle lines opposite them. David formed his lines to meet the Arameans in battle, and they fought against him.

source: Ahinla Israelte masanga Syria te ajamcheh taovin, David'in Syria te kangtalai ja galsat ho mi sangsagi, chule keng sepai sangsomli athatnin, chule janel gallamkai Shophach chu athattan ahi.
target: But they fled before Israel, and David killed seven thousand of their charioteers and forty thousand of their foot soldiers. He also killed Shophak the commander of their army.

source: Chule Hadarezer sohten Israel masanga amaimoh-u amuphatnun, David toh chamna asemun, hitichun asoh-in apang taovin; chule Syria ten Ammon chate chu apanpi kit tapouvin ahi.
target: When the vassals of Hadadezer saw that they had been routed by Israel, they made peace with David and became subject to him. So the Arameans were not willing to help the Ammonites anymore.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, kum ahung kichaija, lengho galsatna achedoh phat laitah-un, Joab'in sepaihon thahat tah chu apuidoh-in, Ammon chate gam chu asusen, chuin ahungin Rabah ahin umtan ahi. Ahin David vangchu Jerusalem'a aume. Chuin Joab'in Rabbah ajouvin, asusetan ahi.
target: In the spring, at the time when kings go off to war, Joab led out the armed forces. He laid waste the land of the Ammonites and went to Rabbah and besieged it, but David remained in Jerusalem. Joab attacked Rabbah and left it in ruins.

source: Chule David'in alengpao luchanga konin lallukhuh alalhan, hichu sana talent khatna gih ahi amudoh-in, chule hia chun song mantam jong ajaovin; chuin hichu David akhuhpeh taovin: chule khopi-a kon chun gala kichomdoh thil tamtah jong ahin pon ahi.
target: David took the crown from the head of their king—its weight was found to be a talent of gold, and it was set with precious stones—and it was placed on David’s head. He took a great quantity of plunder from the city

source: Chuin chua um mipihochu apuidoh-in, thing-at, khenchi, chule heicha mangin na atohsah-in ahi. Chutobang tahchun David'in Ammon chate khopiho jouse chu abolin ahi. Chuin David le mipite jouse Jerusalem'a akile taovin ahi.
target: and brought out the people who were there, consigning them to labor with saws and with iron picks and axes. David did this to all the Ammonite towns. Then David and his entire army returned to Jerusalem.

source: Chuin hiche jouhin ahitin ahi, Philistine te toh Gezer'a kidouna aumin; hichepet hin Hushath mi Sibbechai'in milen chate lah-a khat Sippai kitipa chu athatnin: chuin amaho chu suhnemin aumtaovin ahi.
target: In the course of time, war broke out with the Philistines, at Gezer. At that time Sibbekai the Hushathite killed Sippai, one of the descendants of the Rephaites, and the Philistines were subjugated.

source: Chule Philistine te toh kidouna aumkitnin, chuin Jair chapa Elhanan'in Git mi Goliath sopipa, atenglung jong ponkhong ho talhang tejen hijah, Lahmi chu athatnin ahi.
target: In another battle with the Philistines, Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, who had a spear with a shaft like a weaver’s rod.

source: Chuin Gath'a kidouna aumkitnin, hia chun mi sangtah khat, akhut langto-a khutjung gup le akeng langto-a kengjung gup cheh, agoma khutjungle kengjung somnileli nei aumin: ama jong chu milen chapa ahije.
target: In still another battle, which took place at Gath, there was a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot—twenty-four in all. He also was descended from Rapha.

source: Ahinla aman Israelte ataitom phatnin, David sopipa Shimeia chapa Jonathan'in ama chu athattan ahi.
target: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.

source: Hichehohi Goth mun'a milen ho-a kona pengho ahiuvin, ahin amaho David le asohte khutna alougam taove.
target: These were descendants of Rapha in Gath, and they fell at the hands of David and his men.

source: Chuin Israelte dounan Satan adingdoh-in, Israelte simsah din David chu atildohtan ahi.
target: Satan rose up against Israel and incited David to take a census of Israel.

source: Chuin David'in Joab le mipi vaipoho jah-a, Cheovin, Beersheba apat Dan geipeh-in Israel jat simunlang, kahet theina dingin kahengah ajatnu hin lhutnun, ati.
target: So David said to Joab and the commanders of the troops, “Go and count the Israelites from Beersheba to Dan. Then report back to me so that I may know how many there are.”

source: Chuin Joabmin adonbutnin, Pakaiyin amite chu ajat jakhatna tamjon punsah hen: ahinla ka pakai lengpa, amaho chu ka pakaipa sohte ngen hilouham? Ipidinga ka pakaiyin hiche thilhi angaichat hija ham? Ipidinga ama Israel themmo channa hunghi dingham? ati.
target: But Joab replied, “May the Lord multiply his troops a hundred times over. My lord the king, are they not all my lord’s subjects? Why does my lord want to do this? Why should he bring guilt on Israel?”

source: Ahijeng vangin lengpa thusei chun Joab chu ajoujotan ahi. Hijeh chun Joab akipatdoh-in Israel achonsoh keijin, Jerusalem'a ahungkile kit tai.
target: The king’s word, however, overruled Joab; so Joab left and went throughout Israel and then came back to Jerusalem.

source: Chuin Joab'in David hengah mipi asimdoh jat chu apei. Chule Israel lah-a chemjam lamthei cheh chu mi sang sangkhat le sangjakhat ahiuve: chule Judah lah-a chemjam lamthei cheh chu mi sangjali le sangsomsagi ahiuve.
target: Joab reported the number of the fighting men to David: In all Israel there were one million one hundred thousand men who could handle a sword, including four hundred and seventy thousand in Judah.

source: Ahivangin Levi le Benjaminte chu alah uva akisimtha poi; ajehchu lengpa thusei chu Joab dinga thet umtah ahije.
target: But Joab did not include Levi and Benjamin in the numbering, because the king’s command was repulsive to him.

source: Chule hiche thil la hin Pathen alunglhai tapon, hijeh chun Israel chunga jepna achuhsah tai.
target: This command was also evil in the sight of God; so he punished Israel.

source: Chuin David'in Pathen hengah, hiche thil kabol jeh hin keima nasatah-in kachonse tai: ahin tun, nahenga katao ahi, nasoh khangit louna hi lamangtan; ajehchu ngolhoi tah-in kana chontai, ati.
target: Then David said to God, “I have sinned greatly by doing this. Now, I beg you, take away the guilt of your servant. I have done a very foolish thing.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin David mitvah neipa, Gad henga thu ahin seijin, hitin ati,
target: The Lord said to Gad, David’s seer,

source: Chenlang David hengah hitin gaseijin, Pakaiyin hitihin aseije, keiman nangma thil thum kagonpeh-e: nachunga katoh theina dingin alah-a khat kilhenin gatin, ati.
target: “Go and tell David, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am giving you three options. Choose one of them for me to carry out against you.’ ”

source: Hitichun Gad chu David hengah ahungin, ajah-a, Pakaiyin hitihin ati, Nangman kilhenin,
target: So Gad went to David and said to him, “This is what the Lord says: ‘Take your choice:

source: Kumthum kel lhah ham; ahiloule namelmate masanga lhathum sunga suhmanga naum ding, hiche sunga chu namelmate chemjamin nadelding; ahiloule nithum sunga gamsunga Pakai chemjam, hise ngeichu gamsunga uma, chule Pakai vantil'in Israel gamkol jouse asuhmang ding nalhenam. Hijeh chun tun, eihin solpa henga ipi thu kalhut dingham kilhen temin, ati.
target: three years of famine, three months of being swept away before your enemies, with their swords overtaking you, or three days of the sword of the Lord —days of plague in the land, with the angel of the Lord ravaging every part of Israel.’ Now then, decide how I should answer the one who sent me.”

source: Chuphatnin David'in Gad jah-a, Keima kalung adonglheh jengtai: tun Pakai khutna lhalut jenging kate; ajehchu amihepina nasatah-in alenin ahi: mihem khutna vang neilhahlut sah hihbeh-in, ati.
target: David said to Gad, “I am in deep distress. Let me fall into the hands of the Lord , for his mercy is very great; but do not let me fall into human hands.”

source: Hitichun Pakaiyin Israel chunga hise alansahtan, Israel lah-a mi sangsomsagi athi taovin ahi.
target: So the Lord sent a plague on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell dead.

source: Chule Pathen'in Jerusalem sumang dingin vantil asoltan: chule aman asuhmang laitah-in, Pakaiyin aven, chule thilse atohgotna konchun alung aheijin, asumang vantil henga chun, Aphasettai, tun nakhut tuhtang tan, ati. Chuin Pakai vantil chu Jebus mi Ornan phola chun adingtan ahi.
target: And God sent an angel to destroy Jerusalem. But as the angel was doing so, the Lord saw it and relented concerning the disaster and said to the angel who was destroying the people, “Enough! Withdraw your hand.” The angel of the Lord was then standing at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

source: Chuin David akhodah-in ahile, Pakai vantil chemjam kidopma Jerusalem lam nga-a, leile van kikah-a adin amutan ahi. Chuphatnin David le Israel upaho khaodippon kisila umho chu tolla abohkhup taovin ahi.
target: David looked up and saw the angel of the Lord standing between heaven and earth, with a drawn sword in his hand extended over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell facedown.

source: Chuin Davidn'in Pathen hengah, Mipi ho simding thu pe-a chu keima kahi hilouham? Achonsea khanset bola chu keima ngeihi kahi; ahin hiche kelngoi ho vanghin ipi aboluvem? Vo Pakai ka Pathen, nahenga katao ahi, nakhut chu keimale kapa insungah chujohen; ahin hiche namite hin natset atona dingun chuhda hen, ati.
target: David said to God, “Was it not I who ordered the fighting men to be counted? I, the shepherd, have sinned and done wrong. These are but sheep. What have they done? Lord my God, let your hand fall on me and my family, but do not let this plague remain on your people.”

source: Chujouvin Pakai vantil'in Gad hengah David chu achetouva, Jebus mi Ornan phola Pakai dinga maicham agasem nadinga David aseipeh dingin athupeh-in ahi.
target: Then the angel of the Lord ordered Gad to tell David to go up and build an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

source: Chuin Gad'in Pakai mina aseibang chun David achetou tan ahi.
target: So David went up in obedience to the word that Gad had spoken in the name of the Lord .

source: Chuin Ornan chu akinung heija ahile vantil chu amutan; chule akoma um achapa liho akisel taovin, ahin Ornan chun suhlouchang chu achil jingin ahi.
target: While Araunah was threshing wheat, he turned and saw the angel; his four sons who were with him hid themselves.

source: Chuin David Ornan koma ahung laichun, Ornan'in ahinven ahile David chu amutan, chuin phola konchun achedoh-in, amai tolla asulutnin David anga chu abohkhuptan ahi.
target: Then David approached, and when Araunah looked and saw him, he left the threshing floor and bowed down before David with his face to the ground.

source: Hitichun Davidn'in Ornan jah-a, Mipi lah-a kona natset atan theina dingin, hiche phol munhi Pakai henga maicham kasem theina dingin neipen; aman lhingsetna dinga neipeh ding ahi, ati.
target: David said to him, “Let me have the site of your threshing floor so I can build an altar to the Lord , that the plague on the people may be stopped. Sell it to me at the full price.”

source: Chuin Ornan'in David jah-a, Kilah jengin, chule ka pakai lengpan pha asah bang bangin boljeng hen; ven, govam thilto dingin bongchal, thing dingin changchilna manchah ho, chule anneh thilto dingin suhlouchang kapei: abonahi kapeh sohkei nahi, ati.
target: Araunah said to David, “Take it! Let my lord the king do whatever pleases him. Look, I will give the oxen for the burnt offerings, the threshing sledges for the wood, and the wheat for the grain offering. I will give all this.”

source: Chuin David lengpan Ornan jah-a, Ahipoi, aman lhingsetna kachohtei ding ahi: ajehchu nangma-a chu Pakaiya dinga kalah louding, imacha suhmang louva govam thilto kato louding ahi, ati.
target: But King David replied to Araunah, “No, I insist on paying the full price. I will not take for the Lord what is yours, or sacrifice a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”

source: Hitichun David'in Ornan chu chuche mun man ding chun sana shekel jagup-a gih apen ahi.
target: So David paid Araunah six hundred shekels of gold for the site.

source: Chuin David'in chumunna chun Pakai dingin maicham asemin, govam thilto hole chamna thiltoho apen, Pakai henga ataovin ahi; chuin aman meijin van'a konin govam thilto maicham chunga chun ahindonbut nin ahi.
target: David built an altar to the Lord there and sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. He called on the Lord , and the Lord answered him with fire from heaven on the altar of burnt offering.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin vantil chu thu apen, chuin achemjam chu apaijah akhumkit tan ahi.
target: Then the Lord spoke to the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.

source: Chule David'in Jebus mi Ornan chang chilna phol mun'a Pakaiyin adonbut amu phatnin, hia chun ganlhaina aboltai.
target: At that time, when David saw that the Lord had answered him on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite, he offered sacrifices there.

source: Ajehchu gamthipma Mosi'n asem Pakai Houbuh le govam thilto maicham chu chuche petna chu Gibeon munsanga uma ahi.
target: The tabernacle of the Lord , which Moses had made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering were at that time on the high place at Gibeon.

source: Ahivangin hiche masanga chu Pakai dong dingin David ache ngampon ahi; ajehchu Pakai vantil chemjam jeh-a chu kicha-a ahi.
target: But David could not go before it to inquire of God, because he was afraid of the sword of the angel of the Lord .

source: Chujouvin David'in hichehi Pakai Pathen in ahin, hichehi Israel dinga govam thilto maicham ahi, ati.
target: Then David said, “The house of the Lord God is to be here, and also the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”

source: Chuin David'in Israel gamsunga gamdang mi umho chu khopkhom dingin thupeh apen; chule Pathen in sahna dingin songkheng hochu song akhensah-in ahi.
target: So David gave orders to assemble the foreigners residing in Israel, and from among them he appointed stonecutters to prepare dressed stone for building the house of God.

source: Chuin David'in kotpi ho kotkhah kilna dingle akisuhto naho kilna-a thihkila man dingin thih atamatam agongin; chule sum-eng chu tejoulou khopma tam,
target: He provided a large amount of iron to make nails for the doors of the gateways and for the fittings, and more bronze than could be weighed.

source: Cedar thing jong atama tam akhol khomin ahi: ajehchu Sidon miho le Tyre mihon David hengah cedar thing tamtah ahinpoh-u ahi.
target: He also provided more cedar logs than could be counted, for the Sidonians and Tyrians had brought large numbers of them to David.

source: Chule David'in, Kachapa Solomon hi chapang cha le ima heloulai ahin, chule Pakai dinga kisading in hi gamjousea minthana le loupina-a choisanga umding ahin: hijeh chun tun keima hiche-a dingchun kigotna neijing kate, ati. Hitichun David'in athi masangin thil tampitah agongtup min ahi.
target: David said, “My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the Lord should be of great magnificence and fame and splendor in the sight of all the nations. Therefore I will make preparations for it.” So David made extensive preparations before his death.

source: Hichun aman achapa Solomon akouvin, Israel Pakai Pathen in sahdingin ngansena apetan ahi.
target: Then he called for his son Solomon and charged him to build a house for the Lord , the God of Israel.

source: Chule David'in Solomon jah-a, Kachapa, keima kalungthimin Pakai ka Pathen min dinga in khat sah ding kanagelin ahi:
target: David said to Solomon: “My son, I had it in my heart to build a house for the Name of the Lord my God.

source: Ahinla Pakai thu kahengah ahung lhungin, Nangman thisan naso tamlheh jengin, gal nasatah tahho nasat ahin: nangman kamin dinga in nasah louding ahi, ajehchu kamitmu-in leiset chunga thisan tamtah nasotai.
target: But this word of the Lord came to me: ‘You have shed much blood and have fought many wars. You are not to build a house for my Name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.

source: Ven, chapa khat hingin natin, ama chu chamna mi hiding; chule akimvela amelmaho jouse-a kon choldona kapeh ding ahi: ajehchu amin Solomon hiding ahin, chule ama nikho laija chu Israelte henga chamnale lungmonna kapeh ding ahi.
target: But you will have a son who will be a man of peace and rest, and I will give him rest from all his enemies on every side. His name will be Solomon, and I will grant Israel peace and quiet during his reign.

source: Aman kamin dinga in asahding; chule ama kachapa hia, keima apa kahiding ahi; chule keiman atonsotna dinga Israel chunga alenggam laltouna katundoh ding ahi, ati.
target: He is the one who will build a house for my Name. He will be my son, and I will be his father. And I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’

source: Tun kachapa, Pakaiyin naumpi hen; nangma khangtouvin lang, aman nachung changa asei bangtah-in Pakai na Pathen in chu sa-in.
target: “Now, my son, the Lord be with you, and may you have success and build the house of the Lord your God, as he said you would.

source: Pakai na Pathen danthu chu nanit theina dingin, Pakai sehseh-in bou chihna le het themna, chule Israel chung changa ngansena nape hen ati.
target: May the Lord give you discretion and understanding when he puts you in command over Israel, so that you may keep the law of the Lord your God.

source: Chutengle Israel chung changa Pakaiyin Mosi ana thupeh tepna danho le thutan lhahnaho chu chingthei tah-a najuija ahile kakhantou ding ahi. Hatnin lang hangsanin; kicha hih-in, lungjong lungthoi hih-in.
target: Then you will have success if you are careful to observe the decrees and laws that the Lord gave Moses for Israel. Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or discouraged.

source: Tun, ven, boipum pumin keiman Pakai in sahna dingin sana talent sangjakhat, dangka talent sang sangkhat; chule sum-eng le thih jong tejoulou khopma tam; chule thingtum le song jong kagong tupmin; nangman nakibelap thei ahi.
target: “I have taken great pains to provide for the temple of the Lord a hundred thousand talents of gold, a million talents of silver, quantities of bronze and iron too great to be weighed, and wood and stone. And you may add to them.

source: Chukalvalin natong mi, songkheng them le thing thembol, chule natoh tinchenga khutthem tamtah nakoma aume.
target: You have many workers: stonecutters, masons and carpenters, as well as those skilled in every kind of work

source: Sana, dangka, sum-eng chule thih ajat simjoulou aumin ahi. Hijeh chun kipatdoh-in lang tong jengin; chule Pakaiyin naumpi hen, ati.
target: in gold and silver, bronze and iron—craftsmen beyond number. Now begin the work, and the Lord be with you.”

source: David'in jong Israel pipuiho chu achapa Solomon kithopi dingin thu apen:
target: Then David ordered all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon.

source: Pakai na Pathen'un na-umpiu hilou ham? Chule ningtina cholngahna napeh-u hilou ham? Ajehchu chuche gama chengho chu kakhutna eipeh ahitan ahi, chule agam chu Pakai le amipite masanga suhnema uma ahitai.
target: He said to them, “Is not the Lord your God with you? And has he not granted you rest on every side? For he has given the inhabitants of the land into my hands, and the land is subject to the Lord and to his people.

source: Tun nalungthimu le nahinao chu Pakai na Pathen'u holnan neijun; hijeh chun kipatdoh-un, chule Pakai kitepna thingkhong le, Pathen um le bel thengho chu Pakai mina kisa ding insunga chu napohlut theina dingun Pakai Pathen muntheng sadoh-un, ati.
target: Now devote your heart and soul to seeking the Lord your God. Begin to build the sanctuary of the Lord God, so that you may bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord and the sacred articles belonging to God into the temple that will be built for the Name of the Lord .”

source: Chuin David ahung teh-a akum ahung tamlheh phatnin, achapa Solomon chu Israel chunga leng dingin apansahtan ahi.
target: When David was old and full of years, he made his son Solomon king over Israel.

source: Chule aman Israel pipuiho jouse chu thempuho le Levi ho toh akhomkhom soh keijin ahi.
target: He also gathered together all the leaders of Israel, as well as the priests and Levites.

source: Tun Levi mite kum somthuma lhah achunglamse akisimin ahile: akisim dungjuijun mi pasal cheh sangsomthum le sangget alhinguve.
target: The Levites thirty years old or more were counted, and the total number of men was thirty-eight thousand.

source: Hicheho lah-a sangsomni le sangli hohi Pakai in kisah vetup ding ahiuvin; chule sanggupho chu milenho le thutan ho ahiuve.
target: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand are to be in charge of the work of the temple of the Lord and six thousand are to be officials and judges.

source: Chukalvalin sangli chu kotpi ngahho ahiuvin; chule sanglima chu Pakai vahchoi nadinga kasem manchah ho chu amanuva, Pakai chu avahchoi dingu ahi, tin David'in aseije.
target: Four thousand are to be gatekeepers and four thousand are to praise the Lord with the musical instruments I have provided for that purpose.”

source: Chule David'in Levi chapate lah-a Gershon, Kohath chule Merari loi tin amaho chu aloi loijin akhenin ahi.
target: David separated the Levites into divisions corresponding to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

source: Gershon mite-a kon Laadan le Shimei;
target: Belonging to the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

source: Laadan chapate chu; apipen Jehiel ahin, Zetham, chule Joel, mi thum ahiuve.
target: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the first, Zetham and Joel—three in all.

source: Shimei chapate chu; Shelomith, Haziel, chule Haran, mi thum ahiuve. Hiche hohi Laadan pate insung pipui ahiuve.
target: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel and Haran—three in all. These were the heads of the families of Ladan.

source: Chule Shimei chapate chu; Jahath, Zina, Jeush, chule Beriah ahiuve. Hiche mili hohi Shimei chapate ahiuve.
target: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Ziza, Jeush and Beriah. These were the sons of Shimei—four in all.

source: Chule Jahath chu apipen ahin, Zizah anina ahi: ahinla Jeush le Beriah'in chapa tampi anei lhonpoi; hijeh-a chu amahohi apu apateu insung dungjuija insung khatna kisim ahiuve.
target: Jahath was the first and Ziza the second, but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons; so they were counted as one family with one assignment.

source: Kohath chapate chu; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, chule Uzziel, mi li ahiuve.
target: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel—four in all.

source: Amram chapate chu; Aaron le Mosi ahi: Aaron vang chu amale achapate a-itih-a dinga thiltheng chung nungho chu sutheng dingle, Pakai anga gimnamtui halding, ama jending le, a-itih-a ama mina phatthei bohdinga khendoh ahiuve.
target: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron was set apart, he and his descendants forever, to consecrate the most holy things, to offer sacrifices before the Lord , to minister before him and to pronounce blessings in his name forever.

source: Tun Pathen mi Mosi thudol chu, achapate chu Levi phunga kiminvo ahitaove.
target: The sons of Moses the man of God were counted as part of the tribe of Levi.

source: Mosi chapateni chu Gershom le Eliezer ahilhone.
target: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

source: Gershom chapate lah-a pipui chu Shebuel ahi.
target: The descendants of Gershom: Shubael was the first.

source: Chule Eliezer chapate lah-a pipui chu Rehabiah ahin, chule Eliezer'in chapa dang himhim aneipon, Rehabiah'in vang chapa tamtah aneije.
target: The descendants of Eliezer: Rehabiah was the first. Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very numerous.

source: Izhar chapate lah-a pipui chu Shelomith ahi.
target: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith was the first.

source: Hebron chapate lah-a kon; amasapen Jeriah ahin, anina Amariah, athumna Jahaziel chule alina Jekameam ahi.
target: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third and Jekameam the fourth.

source: Uzziel chapate lah-a kon; amasapen Michah ahin, anina chu Jesiah ahi.
target: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the first and Ishiah the second.

source: Merari chapateni chu; Mahli le Mushi ahilhone. Chule Mahli chapateni chu; Eleazar le Kish ahilhone.
target: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

source: Chuin Eliezar chu chapa neilouvin athitan, chanuho bou aneijin: amaho chu asopiteu Kish chapaten akichenpiuvin ahi.
target: Eleazar died without having sons: he had only daughters. Their cousins, the sons of Kish, married them.

source: Mushi chapate chu; Mahli, Eder chule Jeremoth, mi thum ahiuve.
target: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder and Jerimoth—three in all.

source: Hichehohi apu apateu insung dungjuija Levi chapate ahiuvin, a-insungu kisimna dungjuija kisimdoh, apu apateu lah-a pipui cheh, Pakai in'a kintheng bolna-a pang, kum somni-a lhah achunglamse ahiuve.
target: These were the descendants of Levi by their families—the heads of families as they were registered under their names and counted individually, that is, the workers twenty years old or more who served in the temple of the Lord .

source: Ajehchu David'in, Israel Pakai Pathen'in amite chu Jerusalem'a atonsotna achentheina dingun choldona apei, atin;
target: For David had said, “Since the Lord , the God of Israel, has granted rest to his people and has come to dwell in Jerusalem forever,

source: Chule Levi mite jah-a jong, Houbuh ahiloule kin bolna-a manchah dinga umle bel ho apohleu ngaitalou ding ahi, ati.
target: the Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of the articles used in its service.”

source: Ajehchu David thusei nukhahpenho dungjuija Levi mite chu kum somni apat achunglamse kisima ahiuve.
target: According to the last instructions of David, the Levites were counted from those twenty years old or more.

source: Ajehchu atoh dingu chu, Pakai in lhacha natohna-a hongsungho le dansungho-a Aaron chapate kithopi ding, thil thengho jouse sutheng ding, chule Pathen in'a lhacha natoh toh ding;
target: The duty of the Levites was to help Aaron’s descendants in the service of the temple of the Lord : to be in charge of the courtyards, the side rooms, the purification of all sacred things and the performance of other duties at the house of God.

source: Vetsah changlhah le anneh thilpeh ding changbong nel chung, cholsolou changlhah phengho chung, khangbela agoa kikangmin chule thaova kikangmin chung, chule atam alhom alet aneo chunga mopoh ding,
target: They were in charge of the bread set out on the table, the special flour for the grain offerings, the thin loaves made without yeast, the baking and the mixing, and all measurements of quantity and size.

source: Chule jingkah nilhah seh-a, Pakai thangvah le vahchoina la sadinga dingding,
target: They were also to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord . They were to do the same in the evening

source: Chule cholngah nikhoho, lhathah nikho ho, chule kut kitep nikho ho-a chu amaho tohding thu kipeh dungjuija, mijat chun Pakai henga govam thilto jouse, Pakai masanga abol jingjeng ding;
target: and whenever burnt offerings were presented to the Lord on the Sabbaths, at the New Moon feasts and at the appointed festivals. They were to serve before the Lord regularly in the proper number and in the way prescribed for them.

source: Chule Pakai in'a kintheng bolna-a asopiteu Aaron chapate akithopi ding, chule munthengle mipi Houkhom ho Houbuh vetupma pangding chu ahi.
target: And so the Levites carried out their responsibilities for the tent of meeting, for the Holy Place and, under their relatives the descendants of Aaron, for the service of the temple of the Lord .

source: Tun hichehi Aaron chapate kihop khen dan chu hiche hi ahin. Aaron chapate chu; Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, chule Ithamar ahiuve.
target: These were the divisions of the descendants of Aaron: The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

source: Ahinla Nadab le Abihu chu apao sangin athimasa lhonin, cha anei lhonpoi: hijeh chun Eleazar le Ithamar'in thempu natoh atong lhontan ahi.
target: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father did, and they had no sons; so Eleazar and Ithamar served as the priests.

source: Chule David'in Eleazer chapate lah-a Zadok, chule Ithamar chapate lah-a Ahimelech chu alhacha natoh naova atoh dingu ahop peh-in ahi.
target: With the help of Zadok a descendant of Eleazar and Ahimelek a descendant of Ithamar, David separated them into divisions for their appointed order of ministering.

source: Ithamar chapate lah-a sangin Eleazer chapate lah-a pipui atamjon, hijeh chun amaho chu akihom khen ahi. Apu apateu insung dungjuijin Eleazer chapate lah-a pipui somlegup aumin, chule apu apateu insung dungjuijin Ithamar chapate lah-a pipui get aumuvin ahi.
target: A larger number of leaders were found among Eleazar’s descendants than among Ithamar’s, and they were divided accordingly: sixteen heads of families from Eleazar’s descendants and eight heads of families from Ithamar’s descendants.

source: Hitichun vang vetna konin amaho loikhat le loikhat chu ahomtoh uvin ahi; ajehchu muntheng vetup le Pathen in vetup hochu Eleazer chapate le Ithamar chapate ahigelun ahi.
target: They divided them impartially by casting lots, for there were officials of the sanctuary and officials of God among the descendants of both Eleazar and Ithamar.

source: Chule Levi miho lah-a khat, lekhasun Nathaneel chapa Shemaiah chun aminhou chu lengpa le milenho, thempu Zadok le Abiathar chapa Ahimelech angsung, chule thempuho le Levi ho apu apateu insunga apipen cheh angsunga chun asunlut tan: apu apateu insunga abulpen dingin Eleazer dingin mi khat, Ithamar dingin mi khat akilan ahi.
target: The scribe Shemaiah son of Nethanel, a Levite, recorded their names in the presence of the king and of the officials: Zadok the priest, Ahimelek son of Abiathar and the heads of families of the priests and of the Levites—one family being taken from Eleazar and then one from Ithamar.

source: Tun, vang masapen chu Jehoiarib chungah achun, anina Jedaiah chungah,
target: The first lot fell to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

source: Athumna Harim chungah, alina Saorim chungah,
target: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

source: Angana Malchijah chungah, agupna Mijamin chungah,
target: the fifth to Malkijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

source: Asagina Hakkoz chungah, agetna Abijah chungah,
target: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

source: Akona Jesuah chungah, asomna Shechaniah chungah,
target: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shekaniah,

source: Asomle khatna Eliashib chungah, asomle nina Jakim chungah,
target: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

source: Asomle thumna Huppah chungah, asomle lina Jeshebeab chungah,
target: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

source: Asomle ngana Bilgah chungah, asomle gupna Immer chungah,
target: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

source: Asomle sagina Hezir chungah, asomle getna Aphses chungah,
target: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,

source: Asomle kona Pethahiah chungah, asomnina Jehezekel chungah,
target: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,

source: Asomnile khatna Jachin chungah, asomnile nina Gamul chungah,
target: the twenty-first to Jakin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

source: Asomnile thumna Delaiah chungah, asomnile lina Maaziah chungah achun ahi.
target: the twenty-third to Delaiah and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

source: Hiche hi Pakai Israel Pathen'in apau Aaron ana thupeh dungjuija, anoija atoh ding danu, Pakai insunga ahunglut uva alhacha natoh dingu kihop khen dan chu ahi.
target: This was their appointed order of ministering when they entered the temple of the Lord , according to the regulations prescribed for them by their ancestor Aaron, as the Lord , the God of Israel, had commanded him.

source: Chule Levi chapate amohse chu hichehohi ahiuve: Amram chapate lah-a kon, Shubael; Shubael chapate lah-a kon, Jehdeiah.
target: As for the rest of the descendants of Levi: from the sons of Amram: Shubael; from the sons of Shubael: Jehdeiah.

source: Rehabiah chungchang chu: Rehabiah chapate lah-a kon, amasapen Isshiah ahi.
target: As for Rehabiah, from his sons: Ishiah was the first.

source: Izhar mite lah-a kon, Shelomoth: Shelomoth chapate lah-a kon, Jahath.
target: From the Izharites: Shelomoth; from the sons of Shelomoth: Jahath.

source: Chule Hebron chapate chu: akhatna Jeriah, anina Amariah, athumna Jahaziel, alina Jekameam ahi.
target: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third and Jekameam the fourth.

source: Uzziel chapate lah-a kon, Michah; Michah chapate lah-a kon, Shamir ahi.
target: The son of Uzziel: Micah; from the sons of Micah: Shamir.

source: Michah sopipa chu Isshiah ahin: Isshiah chapate lah-a kon, Zekeriah ahi.
target: The brother of Micah: Ishiah; from the sons of Ishiah: Zechariah.

source: Merari chapateni chu Mahli le Mushi ahilhone; Jaaziah chapa chu Beno ahi.
target: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.

source: Merari chapate Jaaziah' akon chu Beno, Shoham, Zaccur chule Ibri ahiuve.
target: The sons of Merari: from Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zakkur and Ibri.

source: Mahli'a konin Eleazar apengin, aman chapa aneipoi.
target: From Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

source: Kish chungchang chu: Kish chapa chu Jerahmeel ahi.
target: From Kish: the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.

source: Chujongle Mushi chapate chu; Mahli, Eder chule Jerimoth ahiuve. Hitehohi apu apateu insung dungjuija Levi ho chate ahiuve.
target: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder and Jerimoth. These were the Levites, according to their families.

source: Amahohin hitima chun asopiteu Aaron chapate bangin lengpa David, Zadok, Ahimelech chule thempuho le Levi ho insunga apu apateu lah-a pipui cheh angsunga chun vang aveovin ahi. Insung pate pipuiho chun asopiu neojoho bolbang bang chun aboltauve.
target: They also cast lots, just as their relatives the descendants of Aaron did, in the presence of King David and of Zadok, Ahimelek, and the heads of families of the priests and of the Levites. The families of the oldest brother were treated the same as those of the youngest.

source: Chukitle David le asepai janel lamkai hon, lhachana tong dingin Asaph chapate, Heman chapate, chule Jeduthun chapate lah-a konin phabep achomkhenun; amaho chun selangdah, tumging, chule thih khutbeh toh tho-a gaothu aseidingu ahi. Chule chutobanga tongding ho mijat chu:
target: David, together with the commanders of the army, set apart some of the sons of Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun for the ministry of prophesying, accompanied by harps, lyres and cymbals. Here is the list of the men who performed this service:

source: Asaph chapate lah-a konin: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, chule Asarelah ahiuve, achapate sehi Asaphmin alamkaijin lengpa thupeh dungjuijin gaothu aseijuve.
target: From the sons of Asaph: Zakkur, Joseph, Nethaniah and Asarelah. The sons of Asaph were under the supervision of Asaph, who prophesied under the king’s supervision.

source: Jeduthun'a kon: Jeduthun chapate chu, Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Hashabiah chule Mattithiah, mi gup ahiuvin; apau Jeduthun tumgingtoh tho gaothusei khutnoija Pakai loupisah dingle vahchoi ding ahiuve.
target: As for Jeduthun, from his sons: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah and Mattithiah, six in all, under the supervision of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied, using the harp in thanking and praising the Lord .

source: Heman'a kon: Heman chapate chu: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti chule Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir chule Mahazioth.
target: As for Heman, from his sons: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shubael and Jerimoth; Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti and Romamti-Ezer; Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir and Mahazioth.

source: Hiteho jousehi Pathen thu dungjuija saki mutding lengpa mitvahnei themgao Heman chapate ahiuve. Chule Pathen'in Heman chu chapa somleli le chanu thum apen ahi.
target: (All these were sons of Heman the king’s seer. They were given him through the promises of God to exalt him. God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.)

source: Hicheho jousehi lengpan Asaph, Jaduthun chule Heman athupeh dungjuija apau khut noija, Pakai in'a thih khutbeh le, chule selangdah tho-a Pathen in'a kintheng kibolna-a kimang cha-a lasa loi ahiuve.
target: All these men were under the supervision of their father for the music of the temple of the Lord , with cymbals, lyres and harps, for the ministry at the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun and Heman were under the supervision of the king.

source: Hitichun amaho amijatnu chu, asopihou Pakai la ho kihil themsa cheh pumin mi jani leh somget le get ahiuve.
target: Along with their relatives—all of them trained and skilled in music for the Lord —they numbered 288.

source: Chule atohding chanu chu akibah cheh nadingin, alen jong aneo jong, mihil jong jillai jong abonchauvin vang aveovin ahi.
target: Young and old alike, teacher as well as student, cast lots for their duties.

source: Tun vang masa chu Asaph chapa Joseph chungah achun: anina chu Gedaliah chungah achun, amale asopite chule achapate somleni ahiuve.
target: The first lot, which was for Asaph, fell to Joseph, his sons and relatives 12 the second to Gedaliah, him and his relatives and sons 12

source: Athumna chu Zaccur chungah achun, amale achapate, chule asopite somleni ahiuve.
target: the third to Zakkur, his sons and relatives 12

source: Alina chu Izri chungah achun, amale achapate chule asopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the fourth to Izri, his sons and relatives 12

source: Angana chu Nethaniah chunga achun, amale achapate chule asopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and relatives 12

source: Agupna chu Bukkiah chungah achun, amale achapate chule sopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and relatives 12

source: Asagina chu Jesharelah chungah achun, amale achapate chule sopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the seventh to Jesarelah, his sons and relatives 12

source: Agetna chu Jeshaiah chungah achun, amale achapate chule sopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and relatives 12

source: Akona chu Mattaniah chungah achun, amale achapate chule sopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and relatives 12

source: Asomna chu Shimei chungah achun, amale achapate chule asopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and relatives 12

source: Asomle khatna chu Azareel chungah achun, amale achapate chule sopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and relatives 12

source: Asomle nina chu Hashabiah chungah achun, amale achapate chule sopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and relatives 12

source: Asomle thumna chu Shubael chungah achun, amale achapate chule sopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the thirteenth to Shubael, his sons and relatives 12

source: Asomle lina chu Mattithiah chungah achun, amale achapate chule sopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the fourteenth to Mattithiah, his sons and relatives 12

source: Asomle ngana chu Jeremoth chungah achun, amale achapate chule sopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the fifteenth to Jerimoth, his sons and relatives 12

source: Asomle gupna chu Hananiah chungah achun, amale achapate chule sopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and relatives 12

source: Asomle sagina chu Joshbekashah chungah achun, amale achapate chule sopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and relatives 12

source: Asomle getna chu Hanani chungah achun, amale achapate chule sopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and relatives 12

source: Asomle kona chu Mallothi chungah achun, amale achapate chule sopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and relatives 12

source: Asomnina chu Eliathah chungah achun, amale achapate chule sopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and relatives 12

source: Asomnile khatna chu Hothir chungah achun, amale achapate chule sopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and relatives 12

source: Asomnile nina chu Eliathah chungah achun, amale achapate chule sopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and relatives 12

source: Asomnile thumna chu Mahazioth chungah achun, amale achapate chule sopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and relatives 12

source: Asomnile lina chu Romamti-ezer chungah achun, amale achapate chule sopite mi somleni ahiuve.
target: the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and relatives 12.

source: Kotngah ho kihopdan thudol: Kor mite-a kon Asaph chapate lah-a Kore chapa Meshelemiah ahi.
target: The divisions of the gatekeepers: From the Korahites: Meshelemiah son of Kore, one of the sons of Asaph.

source: Chule Meshelemiah chapate chu; apeng masapen Zechariah ahin, anina Jediael, athumna Zebadiah, alina Jathniel,
target: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

source: Angana Elam, agupna Jehohanan, asagina Elioenai ahi.
target: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth and Eliehoenai the seventh.

source: Chukitle Obed-edom chapate chu; apeng masapen Shemiah ahin, anina Jehozabad, athumna Joah, alina Sacar chule angana Nethaneel,
target: Obed-Edom also had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sakar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

source: Agupna Ammiel, asagina Issachar, agetna Peullethai ahi; ajehchu Pathen'in ama phatthei aboh-e.
target: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh and Peullethai the eighth. (For God had blessed Obed-Edom.)

source: Chujongle achapa Shemaiah'a konin chapate, apateu insunga vaipoho apenguve; ajehchu amaho chu mihat hangsan ngen anahiuve.
target: Obed-Edom’s son Shemaiah also had sons, who were leaders in their father’s family because they were very capable men.

source: Shemiah chapate chu; Othni, Rephael, Obed, chule Elzabad ahin, asopiteniu Elihu le Samachiah chu mihat ahilhone.
target: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed and Elzabad; his relatives Elihu and Semakiah were also able men.

source: Hicheho jousehi Obed-edom chapate ahiuvin; amahole achapateu chule asopiteu jouse kinbolna dinga mibulhing cheh chu, Obed-edom kon mi somgup le mini ahiuve.
target: All these were descendants of Obed-Edom; they and their sons and their relatives were capable men with the strength to do the work—descendants of Obed-Edom, 62 in all.

source: Chule Meshelemiah chun chapa le sopi mihat cheh somleget aneijin ahi.
target: Meshelemiah had sons and relatives, who were able men—18 in all.

source: Merari chate lah-a Hosah'in jong chapate ahingin, Simri chu apipen (apeng masapen ahilou vangin ama chu apan apipui penin anasemin) ahi.
target: Hosah the Merarite had sons: Shimri the first (although he was not the firstborn, his father had appointed him the first),

source: Anina Hilkiah, athumna Tebaliah, alina Zekeriah ahin, Hosah chapate le asopite jouse chu somlethum ahiuve.
target: Hilkiah the second, Tabaliah the third and Zechariah the fourth. The sons and relatives of Hosah were 13 in all.

source: Hicheho lah-a amaho loihi apipuiho lah jenga jong Pakai in'a natong dinga chan neija, houin kot ngah dinga kihom khen ahiuve.
target: These divisions of the gatekeepers, through their leaders, had duties for ministering in the temple of the Lord , just as their relatives had.

source: Amahon alen aneo abonin, apateu insung dungjui cheh-in, kotphung jouse-a dingin vang asang uve.
target: Lots were cast for each gate, according to their families, young and old alike.

source: Chuin nisolama dinga vang chu Shelemiah chunga achutai. Chujouvin thumopthem milungching chapa Zechariah dinga vang asanuva ahile sahlam sanga din alhatai.
target: The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah. Then lots were cast for his son Zechariah, a wise counselor, and the lot for the North Gate fell to him.

source: Obed-edom dingin lhanglam alhan, achapatea dingin thil koikhomna mun alhai.
target: The lot for the South Gate fell to Obed-Edom, and the lot for the storehouse fell to his sons.

source: Shuppim le Hosah dinga vang kisan chu lhumlam, khonga nale khongahna kikah lampi kaltouna-a um Shallecheth toh ahi.
target: The lots for the West Gate and the Shalleketh Gate on the upper road fell to Shuppim and Hosah. Guard was alongside of guard:

source: Niso lamah Levi mi migup aumun, sahlama nikhat in mi li aumin, lhang lamah nikhat in mi lima aumin, chule thil koikhomna mun'a mi nini aumin ahi.
target: There were six Levites a day on the east, four a day on the north, four a day on the south and two at a time at the storehouse.

source: Lhumlam inhongsung lutna song lampia mi li, chule inhongsungah mi ni.
target: As for the court to the west, there were four at the road and two at the court itself.

source: Hichehohi Kore chapate lah le Merari chapate lah-a kotngah ho kihop khen dan chu ahi.
target: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers who were descendants of Korah and Merari.

source: Chule Levi ho lah-a Ahijah chu Pathen in'a gouthilho le thilthengho chunga vaihom ahi.
target: Their fellow Levites were in charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries for the dedicated things.

source: Laadan chapate chungchang ahile, Laadan chu Gershon chapate lah-a khat, apu apate insunga aluchang ahin, Laadan chate lah-a chu Jehieli ahi.
target: The descendants of Ladan, who were Gershonites through Ladan and who were heads of families belonging to Ladan the Gershonite, were Jehieli,

source: Jehieli chapate; Zetham le asopipa Joel chu Pakai in'a gouho chunga ahiuve.
target: the sons of Jehieli, Zetham and his brother Joel. They were in charge of the treasuries of the temple of the Lord .

source: Amram mite, Izhar mite, Hebron mite chule Uzziel mite lah-a;
target: From the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites and the Uzzielites:

source: Mosi chapa Gershom chapa Shebuel chu gouho chunga vaipo ahiuve.
target: Shubael, a descendant of Gershom son of Moses, was the official in charge of the treasuries.

source: Chule Eliezer'a kona asopite chu: achapa Rehabiah ahin, Rehabiah chapa chu Jeshaiah ahin, Jeshaiah chapa chu Joram ahin, Joram chapa chu Zichri ahin, chule Zichri chapa chu Shelomith ahi.
target: His relatives through Eliezer: Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zikri his son and Shelomith his son.

source: Hiche Shelomith le asopite hi David lengpa le insung pateho luchang, sepai sang lamkaiho ja lamkaiho, chule sepai janel gal lamkai hon atodoh-u gouho chunga vaipo ahiuve.
target: Shelomith and his relatives were in charge of all the treasuries for the things dedicated by King David, by the heads of families who were the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and by the other army commanders.

source: Kidouna munho-a thil kichom phabep chu Pakai in'a manchah dingin atohdoh jiuvin ahi.
target: Some of the plunder taken in battle they dedicated for the repair of the temple of the Lord .

source: Chule mitvahneipa Samuel, Kish chapa Saul, Ner chapa Abner, chule Zeruiah chapa Joab tehon atodoh jouseu chule koihile ato channu chu Shelomith le asopite khutnoija um ahi.
target: And everything dedicated by Samuel the seer and by Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner and Joab son of Zeruiah, and all the other dedicated things were in the care of Shelomith and his relatives.

source: Izhar mite lah-a kon Chenaniah le achapate chu Israel chunga polam kin mopo ahiuvin, milenle thutan ahiuve.
target: From the Izharites: Kenaniah and his sons were assigned duties away from the temple, as officials and judges over Israel.

source: Chule Hebron mi Hashabiah le asopite mihangsan cheh mi sangkhat le jasagi ho chu Jordan vadung lhumlama vaipole vetupmin apangun, chule Pakai kin bol le lengpa natong ahiuvin ahi.
