target: From the Hebronites: Hashabiah and his relatives—seventeen hundred able men—were responsible in Israel west of the Jordan for all the work of the Lord and for the king’s service.

source: Hebron mite lah-a Jerijah chu apu apateu khanggui dungjuijn Hebron mite lah-a apipu pen ahi. David kum somli alengchan kum-in amaho chu akholuvin ahile, Gilead gam Jazer kho-a alah uva mihat hangsanho chu phabep amudoh-un ahi.
target: As for the Hebronites, Jeriah was their chief according to the genealogical records of their families. In the fortieth year of David’s reign a search was made in the records, and capable men among the Hebronites were found at Jazer in Gilead.

source: Chule asopite chu mihangsan le pipui cheh mi sangni le jasagi ahiuvin, amaho chu David lengpan Reuben mite, Gad mite, chule Manasseh phung kehkhat chunga, Pathen lam thil tintang le, lengpa kinbolna-a, vaipo-a apansah-u ahi.
target: Jeriah had twenty-seven hundred relatives, who were able men and heads of families, and King David put them in charge of the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.

source: Tun Israel chate amijatnu chu, apipui cheh, pate pipuiho le sepai sangkhat lamkaihole ja lamkaiho, chule akihop dungjuija lamjouse-a lengpa natong kum lhung keija alha alha-a ahung lhungle apotdoh jing jengho chu mi sangsomni le sangli ahiuve.
target: This is the list of the Israelites—heads of families, commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and their officers, who served the king in all that concerned the army divisions that were on duty month by month throughout the year. Each division consisted of 24,000 men.

source: Aphat kihop dungjuija alha masapena lamkai chu Zabdiel chapa Jashobeam ahin; ama loi lah-a chun mi sangsomni le sangli aumui.
target: In charge of the first division, for the first month, was Jashobeam son of Zabdiel. There were 24,000 men in his division.

source: Ama chu Perez chate lah-a apipui pentah, alha masapena sepai janel jouse lamkai pen ahi.
target: He was a descendant of Perez and chief of all the army officers for the first month.

source: Chule alhani channa loi lamkai chu Ahoh mi Dodai ahin, aloi lah-a chun Mikloth jong vaipo khat ahin, ama hon lah-a jong chun mi sangsomni le sangli ma aumui.
target: In charge of the division for the second month was Dodai the Ahohite; Mikloth was the leader of his division. There were 24,000 men in his division.

source: Alhathum channa sepai janel jalamkai thumchanna chu thempu pipui khat Jehoiada chapa Benaiah ahin; ama loi lah-a chun mi sangsomni le sangli aumui.
target: The third army commander, for the third month, was Benaiah son of Jehoiada the priest. He was chief and there were 24,000 men in his division.

source: Hiche Benaiah hi ahi mihat somthum lah-a panga, chule somthum lah-a achungnung pen chu: ama loija chun achapa Ammizabad apange.
target: This was the Benaiah who was a mighty warrior among the Thirty and was over the Thirty. His son Ammizabad was in charge of his division.

source: Alha lina-a gallamkai lina chu Joab sopipa Asahel ahin, chule ama bana achapa Zebadiah ahi; ama loi lah-a chun mi sangsomni le sangli aumui.
target: The fourth, for the fourth month, was Asahel the brother of Joab; his son Zebadiah was his successor. There were 24,000 men in his division.

source: Alha ngana-a gallamkai ngana chu Izrah mi Shamhuth ahin; ama loi lah-a chun mi sangsomni le sangli aumui.
target: The fifth, for the fifth month, was the commander Shamhuth the Izrahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

source: Alha gupna-a sepai jalamkai gupna chu Teko mi Ikkesh chapa Ira ahin; ama loi lah-a chun mi sangsomni le sangli aumui.
target: The sixth, for the sixth month, was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

source: Alha sagina-a gallamkai sagina chu Ephraim chate lah-a Pelon mi Helez ahin; ama loi lah-a chun mi sangsomni le sangli aumui.
target: The seventh, for the seventh month, was Helez the Pelonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

source: Alha getna-a gallamkai getna chu Zarh mite lah-a Husath mi Sibbecai ahin; ama loi lah-a chun mi sangsomni le sangli aumui.
target: The eighth, for the eighth month, was Sibbekai the Hushathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

source: Alha kona-a gallamkai ko nachu Benjamin mite lah-a Anetoth mi Abiezer ahin; ama loi lah-a chun mi sangsomni le sangli aumui.
target: The ninth, for the ninth month, was Abiezer the Anathothite, a Benjamite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

source: Alha somna-a gallamkai somna chu Zarh mite lah-a Netophah mi Maharai ahi; ama loi lah-a chun mi sangsomni le sangli aumui.
target: The tenth, for the tenth month, was Maharai the Netophathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

source: Alha somle khatna-a gallamkai somlekhatna chu Ephraim chate lah-a Pirathon mi Benaiah ahin; ama loi lah-a chun mi sangsomni le sangli aumui.
target: The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Benaiah the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

source: Alha somleni na-a gallamkai somlenina chu Othniel chate lah-a Netophah mi Heldai ahin; ama loi lah-a chun mi sangsomni le sangli aumui.
target: The twelfth, for the twelfth month, was Heldai the Netophathite, from the family of Othniel. There were 24,000 men in his division.

source: Chukalvalin Israel phungho chunga: Reuben mite chunga vaipo chu Zichri chapa Eliezer ahin; Simeon mite lah-a, Maachah chapa Shephatiah ahin,
target: The leaders of the tribes of Israel: over the Reubenites: Eliezer son of Zikri; over the Simeonites: Shephatiah son of Maakah;

source: Levi mite lah-a, Kemuel chapa Hashabiah ahin; Aaron mite lah-a Zadok ahin:
target: over Levi: Hashabiah son of Kemuel; over Aaron: Zadok;

source: Judah mite lah-a, David sopite khat Elihu ahin; Issachar mite lah-a, Michael chapa Omri ahin:
target: over Judah: Elihu, a brother of David; over Issachar: Omri son of Michael;

source: Zebulun mite lah-a, Obadiah chapa Ishmaiah ahin; Naphtali mite lah-a Azriel chapa Jerimoth ahin:
target: over Zebulun: Ishmaiah son of Obadiah; over Naphtali: Jerimoth son of Azriel;

source: Ephraim chate lah-a, Azaziah chapa Hoshea ahin; Manasseh phung kehkhat lah-a, Pedaiah chapa Joel ahin;
target: over the Ephraimites: Hoshea son of Azaziah; over half the tribe of Manasseh: Joel son of Pedaiah;

source: Manasseh phung kehkhat lah-a Gilead'a Zekeriah chapa Iddo ahin; Benjamin phung lah-a, Abner chapa Jaasiel ahin:
target: over the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead: Iddo son of Zechariah; over Benjamin: Jaasiel son of Abner;

source: Dan mite lah-a, Jeroham chapa Azareel ahin. Hichehohi Israel phung sunga pipuiho ahiuve.
target: over Dan: Azarel son of Jeroham. These were the leaders of the tribes of Israel.

source: Ahivangin David'in kum somni-a pat anoilamse chu ajat anasim thapoi: ajehchu Pakaiyin Israelte chu van'a ahsi ho banga apunsah ding ahi tia anaseisa ahi.
target: David did not take the number of the men twenty years old or less, because the Lord had promised to make Israel as numerous as the stars in the sky.

source: Zeruiah chapa Joab'in ana simpantan, ahinla ana simjou manpoi,;ajehchu Israelte chungah lunghanna achutan, David lengpa thusimbua jong ajat akisut tha tapoi.
target: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count the men but did not finish. God’s wrath came on Israel on account of this numbering, and the number was not entered in the book of the annals of King David.

source: Chule lengpa gouho chunga vaipo chu, Adiel chapa Azmaveth ahin; chule loujaoho-a le khopiho-a, kho neoho le kul sangho-a thilkeo koikhomnaho chunga vaipo chu Uzziah chapa Jonathan ahi.
target: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the royal storehouses. Jonathan son of Uzziah was in charge of the storehouses in the outlying districts, in the towns, the villages and the watchtowers.

source: Chule loujaova loukaija pangho jouse chunga vaipo chu Chelub chapa Ezri ahi:
target: Ezri son of Kelub was in charge of the workers who farmed the land.

source: Chule Lengpilei ho chunga vaipo chu Ramath mi Shimei ahin; lengpitwija dinga lengpigaho chunga vaipo chu Shiph mi Zabdi ahi:
target: Shimei the Ramathite was in charge of the vineyards. Zabdi the Shiphmite was in charge of the produce of the vineyards for the wine vats.

source: Chule phaicham munnem ho-a Olive thingho le theichang thingho chunga vaipo chu Geder mi Baal-hanan ahin; chule thao kholkhomnaho chunga vaipo chu Joash ahi.
target: Baal-Hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive and sycamore-fig trees in the western foothills. Joash was in charge of the supplies of olive oil.

source: Chule Sharon'a kivah ganchahon ho chunga vaipo chu Sharon mi Shitrai ahin; chule phaichama ganchahon ho chunga vaipo chu Adlai chapa Shaphat ahi.
target: Shitrai the Sharonite was in charge of the herds grazing in Sharon. Shaphat son of Adlai was in charge of the herds in the valleys.

source: Sangongsang ho vetup chu Ishmael mi Obil ahin; chule sanganho vetup chu Meronoth mi Jehdeiah ahi.
target: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels. Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of the donkeys.

source: Chule kelngoihon vetup chu Hager mi Jaziz ahi. Hicheho jousehi David lengpa neichunga vaihomho ahiuve.
target: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the flocks. All these were the officials in charge of King David’s property.

source: Chule David pangah Jonathan chu thumop ahin, michingtah chule lekhasun ahi: chule Hachmoni chapa Jehiel chu lengpa chapate toh umkhom ahi.
target: Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of insight and a scribe. Jehiel son of Hakmoni took care of the king’s sons.

source: Chule Ahithophel chu lengpa thumop ahin, Arch mi Hushai chu lengpa kiloipi ahi.
target: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Arkite was the king’s confidant.

source: Chule Ahithophel bana chu Benaiah chapa Jehoiada le Abiathar ahilhonin, chule lengpa Galsat ho gallamkai lenpen chu Joab ahi.
target: Ahithophel was succeeded by Jehoiada son of Benaiah and by Abiathar. Joab was the commander of the royal army.

source: Chuin David'in Israel pipuiho jouse, phung pipuiho, chule aphat kihop dungjuija lengpa nehle chah sutupma pang loi lamkaiho, asang sang chunga lamkaiho, aja aja chunga ja lamkaiho, chule lengpa neile gou jouse vetupma pang neiching ho, achapate le milen milal ho jouse, chule mihangsan ho jouse chu Jerusalem'a akoukhom sohkeijin ahi.
target: David summoned all the officials of Israel to assemble at Jerusalem: the officers over the tribes, the commanders of the divisions in the service of the king, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and the officials in charge of all the property and livestock belonging to the king and his sons, together with the palace officials, the warriors and all the brave fighting men.

source: Chuin David lengpa chu adingdoh-in, Kasopite le kamiteho, kathuseihi ngaijuvin, keiman Pakai kitepna thingkhong kicholdona ding le, i-Pathen'u kengto ngapna ding in sah ding kalungin kana ngaiton, in sahna ding jong kagongtoh soh hel tan ahi.
target: King David rose to his feet and said: “Listen to me, my fellow Israelites, my people. I had it in my heart to build a house as a place of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord , for the footstool of our God, and I made plans to build it.

source: Ahinla Pathen'in kajah-a, Nangman kamin dingin in nasah louding ahi, ajehchu nangma galsat mi nahin, thisanso mi nahije, ati.
target: But God said to me, ‘You are not to build a house for my Name, because you are a warrior and have shed blood.’

source: Hijeng jongle Israel Pakai Pathen'in kapa insung jouse lah-a atonsotna Israel leng hidingin eina lhengtan ahi; ajehchu aman Judah phunga kapa insung alhengin, chule kapa chapate lah-a konin Israel jouse chunga leng hidingin keima eina deilhentai.
target: “Yet the Lord , the God of Israel, chose me from my whole family to be king over Israel forever. He chose Judah as leader, and from the tribe of Judah he chose my family, and from my father’s sons he was pleased to make me king over all Israel.

source: Chule kachapate jouse lah-a jong, (ajehchu Pakaiyin chapa tamtah einapen,) Israelte chunga Pakai leng laltouna-a tou dingin kachapa Solomon hi alhengtan ahi.
target: Of all my sons—and the Lord has given me many—he has chosen my son Solomon to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.

source: Chule aman kajah-a, Nachapa Solomon, aman ka in le kahong sungho asah ding ahi; ajehchu amachu kachapa dinga kalhendoh ahitan, keima apa kahi ding ahi.
target: He said to me: ‘Solomon your son is the one who will build my house and my courts, for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

source: Chujongle aman kathupeh ho le kathutan lhahho chu tunia banga hi anit jinga ahile, ama lenggam chu atonsotna dinga kasemdoh ding ahi, ati.
target: I will establish his kingdom forever if he is unswerving in carrying out my commands and laws, as is being done at this time.’

source: Hijeh chun tun, Pakai mipi ho Israel jouse mitmule, Pathen jah tah-a kasei ahi, Pakai na Pathen'u thupeh ho jouse chu holunlang nitnun; chutile hiche gampha hi nalouva, nangho nunga nachateo goulo ding a-imatih chana dinga nadalhah peh thei dingu ahi.
target: “So now I charge you in the sight of all Israel and of the assembly of the Lord , and in the hearing of our God: Be careful to follow all the commands of the Lord your God, that you may possess this good land and pass it on as an inheritance to your descendants forever.

source: Chule nangma, kachapa Solomon, nangman napa Pathen hi hejingin lang, lungsung chamkimkei le lungthim thanom tah-in jenin; ajehchu Pakaiyin lungsung jouse akholin, lungsunga lunggel ho jouse jong ahesoh keije. Ama nahola ahile namu ding: amavang amachu nadalhah-a ahile, aman atonsotna dinga nanotthap ding ahi.
target: “And you, my son Solomon, acknowledge the God of your father, and serve him with wholehearted devotion and with a willing mind, for the Lord searches every heart and understands every desire and every thought. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will reject you forever.

source: Tun chingtheijin, ajehchu Pakaiyin muntheng sadinga nalhendoh ahitai: hatninlang hichu tongin, ati.
target: Consider now, for the Lord has chosen you to build a house as the sanctuary. Be strong and do the work.”

source: Chuin David'in achapa Solomon chu hongcha lim, in lim, asumkholna in lim, inchungdan lim, indan sungnung lim, chule hepi touna mun lim kigongho chu apen,
target: Then David gave his son Solomon the plans for the portico of the temple, its buildings, its storerooms, its upper parts, its inner rooms and the place of atonement.

source: Chule lhagaova kona agontoh lim jouse, Pakai in hongsung, chule akimvela indanho jouse, Pathen in'a goukhol khomna, chule akikatdoh thilho kholkhom lim chu apen;
target: He gave him the plans of all that the Spirit had put in his mind for the courts of the temple of the Lord and all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of the temple of God and for the treasuries for the dedicated things.

source: Chujongle thempuho le Levi mite aloi aloija aumna dingu mun limho, Pakai in'a kinbolna ding jouse limho, chule Pakai in'a kinbolna-a kimangcha ding um le bel limho jong,
target: He gave him instructions for the divisions of the priests and Levites, and for all the work of serving in the temple of the Lord , as well as for all the articles to be used in its service.

source: Kinbolna-a sana kimang ding jouse chu sana-a kisem din atedohpeh-in apen, kinbolna-a dangka kimang ding jouse jong chu akin jatna manchah dingin dangka atedohpeh-in;
target: He designated the weight of gold for all the gold articles to be used in various kinds of service, and the weight of silver for all the silver articles to be used in various kinds of service:

source: Sana meivah ho geijin, sana meivah khom ho ding, sana-a kisem meivah ho takip ding: chule dangka meivah ho ding jong atepeh cheh-in, meivah dingle ameivahkhom dingin jong, ameivah dungjuijin atedohpeh cheh-in ahi.
target: the weight of gold for the gold lampstands and their lamps, with the weight for each lampstand and its lamps; and the weight of silver for each silver lampstand and its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand;

source: Chule vetsahna changlhah dokhangho semna ding le dokhang jouse-a dingin sana ape-in; chule chutima chun dangka dokhangho semna ding dangka agih tesan apen ahi.
target: the weight of gold for each table for consecrated bread; the weight of silver for the silver tables;

source: Chujongle satul kaho ding, lhengkong ho ding, khonho dingin sana thengsel atepeh-in; chule sana kongdal ding ho-a dingin, sana kongdal khatcheh dingin sana tesan apen; chutobangma chun dangka kongdal khat khat ding jong dangka tesan apecheh-in ahi.
target: the weight of pure gold for the forks, sprinkling bowls and pitchers; the weight of gold for each gold dish; the weight of silver for each silver dish;

source: Chule gimnamtui maicham ding sana kilha thengsel, chule Pakai kitepna thingkhong khukhum na-a alha jah Cherub kangtalai dingin sana apen ahi.
target: and the weight of the refined gold for the altar of incense. He also gave him the plan for the chariot, that is, the cherubim of gold that spread their wings and overshadow the ark of the covenant of the Lord .

source: David'in, Hicheho jousehi Pakaiyin ama khutna kachunga suttho-a, nakitoh dingdan lim jouse hi eihetsah ahi, ati.
target: “All this,” David said, “I have in writing as a result of the Lord ’s hand on me, and he enabled me to understand all the details of the plan.”

source: Chule David'in achapa Solomon jah-a, Hatninlang hangsanin, chule hichu tongin; kicha hih-in, chule lung jong lungthoi hih-in; ajehchu Pakai Pathen, ka Pathen ngeichun naumpi ding; aman nalosam sah louding, Pakai in kinbolna natohho jouse nachaidoh kahse-a da jong nadalhah lou ding ahi.
target: David also said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do the work. Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the Lord God, my God, is with you. He will not fail you or forsake you until all the work for the service of the temple of the Lord is finished.

source: Chule ven, aloi aloija kihomtoh thempuho le Levi mite chun Pathen in'a kin kibolna jouse-a dinga naumpi jing dingu ahin; chule ipi kinbolna hijengjongle natohna jouse-a thanom tah natong themgil mihon naumpi dingu: chujongle pipuiho le mipi ho jouse chu nathupeh-a umdiu ahi, ati.
target: The divisions of the priests and Levites are ready for all the work on the temple of God, and every willing person skilled in any craft will help you in all the work. The officials and all the people will obey your every command.”

source: Chukit jongle leng David'in mipi ho jouse jah-a chun, Pathen bouvin alhendoh kachapa Solomon hi achapang nalaijin ima ahenaipon, anatoh ding hila alen lheh jengin ahi. Ajehchu hiche leng inpihi mihem'a ding ahipon, Pakai Pathen'a ding ahi.
target: Then King David said to the whole assembly: “My son Solomon, the one whom God has chosen, is young and inexperienced. The task is great, because this palatial structure is not for man but for the Lord God.

source: Tun kahatna jousen ka Pathen in dingin sana-a kisem thilho dingin sana, chule dangka-a kisem thilho dingin dangka, chule sum-enga kisem thilho ding sum-eng, chule thih-a kisem thilho dingin thih, chule thinga kisem thilho dingin thing: Song engdang songho, setding songho, avahthei songho, ajem chomchom le song mantam jat chomchom, chule songkang atama tam kagotan ahi.
target: With all my resources I have provided for the temple of my God—gold for the gold work, silver for the silver, bronze for the bronze, iron for the iron and wood for the wood, as well as onyx for the settings, turquoise, stones of various colors, and all kinds of fine stone and marble—all of these in large quantities.

source: Chukalvalin, ka Pathen in kangailut behseh jal-in, hiche in theng dinga kagot ho chungvumin jong, keima tuma dinga kanei sana le dangka jong ka Pathen in dingin kapen ahi.
target: Besides, in my devotion to the temple of my God I now give my personal treasures of gold and silver for the temple of my God, over and above everything I have provided for this holy temple:

source: Abangho jephoina dingin Ophir sana, sana talent sangthum, chule dangka thengsel talent sangsagi;
target: three thousand talents of gold (gold of Ophir) and seven thousand talents of refined silver, for the overlaying of the walls of the buildings,

source: Amanchahna ding jat chomchoma natong themhon amanchah dingun, sana thil manchahna dinga manchah dingin sana, chule dangka manchahna dinga dangka kapen ahi. Ahile tunia Pakaiya natohna-a dinga kiphal tah-a kipenom koi umem? ati.
target: for the gold work and the silver work, and for all the work to be done by the craftsmen. Now, who is willing to consecrate themselves to the Lord today?”

source: Hitichun apu apateu pipuiho, chule Israel phungho lah-a pipuiho, chule sangkhat chungle jakhat chunga lamkaiho chun lengpa natohna-a vaipo sese toh kiphal tah-in,
target: Then the leaders of families, the officers of the tribes of Israel, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and the officials in charge of the king’s work gave willingly.

source: Chuin Pathen in sahna dingin sana talent sangnga le dram sangsom, chule dangka talent sangsom, chule sum-eng talent sangsom le sangget, chule thih talent sangjakhat apeuvin ahi.
target: They gave toward the work on the temple of God five thousand talents and ten thousand darics of gold, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of bronze and a hundred thousand talents of iron.

source: Chule song mantam neiho chun Gershon mi Jehiel khutna Pakai in gouthil kholkhom na-a dingin apeuvin ahi.
target: Anyone who had precious stones gave them to the treasury of the temple of the Lord in the custody of Jehiel the Gershonite.

source: Hitichun mipi ho chu Pakai dinga alung pumpiuva kiphal tah-a thil apehjeh-u chun athanom lheh jengun, chule leng David jong kipa mainah-in akipahpon ahi.
target: The people rejoiced at the willing response of their leaders, for they had given freely and wholeheartedly to the Lord . David the king also rejoiced greatly.

source: Hijeh chun houkhom ho jouse masang-ah David'in Pakai chu avahchoijin: chule David'in hitin aseije, Kapu kapau Israel Pakai Pathen, nangma atonsot atonsotnin nunnom jingin.
target: David praised the Lord in the presence of the whole assembly, saying, “Praise be to you, Lord , the God of our father Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.

source: Vo Pakai, letna, thaneina, loupina, galjona, choi-atna jouse nanga ahi: ajehchu van'a le leija thil jousehi nangma-a ahin, Vo Pakai lenggam chu nangma-a ahin, ijakai chungvuma aluchang hidinga choisang nahi.
target: Yours, Lord , is the greatness and the power and the glory and the majesty and the splendor, for everything in heaven and earth is yours. Yours, Lord , is the kingdom; you are exalted as head over all.

source: Haonale jana agoma nanga hungkon ahin, chule nangma ijakai chungvuma vaihom nahi; chule nakhutna thilbol theinale thahat aumin; chule nakhutna mijouse dinga loupisah nading le thahat pehtheina aume.
target: Wealth and honor come from you; you are the ruler of all things. In your hands are strength and power to exalt and give strength to all.

source: Hijeh chun tun, ka-Pathen'u, nangma kathangvah-un, namin loupi kavahchoi juve.
target: Now, our God, we give you thanks, and praise your glorious name.

source: Hijongle keimahi koi kahia, ka mipite jonghi ipi hiuva, hitobang khopma kiphal tah-a kapeh theiju hija ham? Ajehchu thil jousehi nanga hungkon ahin, chule nangma-a mama chu kahin lepeh kitnu ahibouve.
target: “But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to give as generously as this? Everything comes from you, and we have given you only what comes from your hand.

source: Ajehchu keiho hi nangma angsunga kapu kapatehou jouse banga maljin le khopem bou kahiu ahi: chule leiset chunga kahinkhouhi le-lim tobang bou ahin, aumden ding imacha aumpoi.
target: We are foreigners and strangers in your sight, as were all our ancestors. Our days on earth are like a shadow, without hope.

source: Vo Pakai ka Pathen, namin theng dinga in kasahpehna diuva, kakigot nao hiche thil hijatpi hi nangma khutna kon bou ahin, abonchan nangma-a ahi.
target: Lord our God, all this abundance that we have provided for building you a temple for your Holy Name comes from your hand, and all of it belongs to you.

source: Ka Pathen, nangman lungsunghi napatep jin, chondihna chunga nalunglhaije tijong kahei. Keijong kalungsung chondih na-in thilho jousehi hongphal tah-in nangma kanapetan: tun kipah tah-in namite hilaija umho hin kiphal tah-a nahenga athilpehhou kamutan ahi.
target: I know, my God, that you test the heart and are pleased with integrity. All these things I have given willingly and with honest intent. And now I have seen with joy how willingly your people who are here have given to you.

source: Vo Pakai, kapu kapateu Abraham, Isaac chule Israel Pathen, hitobang lunggel hi namite lungthima a-itih-a aumjing theina dingin koijingin lang, nangman alungsungu gongtoh-in.
target: Lord , the God of our fathers Abraham, Isaac and Israel, keep these desires and thoughts in the hearts of your people forever, and keep their hearts loyal to you.

source: Chule kachapa Solomon hin nathupeh ho, nathu hettohsah ho, nachon danho anitna, hicheho jousehi abolna ding le, chule kana ngaito in loupi hi asahthei nadingin lungsung phachamkim hinpen, ati.
target: And give my son Solomon the wholehearted devotion to keep your commands, statutes and decrees and to do everything to build the palatial structure for which I have provided.”

source: Chuin David'in mipi ho jouse jah-a, Tun Pakai na Pathen'u chu vahchoijun, ati. Chuin mipi ho jouse chun apu apateu Pakai Pathen chu avahchoijun, chule akunun, Pakai le lengpa chu chibai aboh-un ahi.
target: Then David said to the whole assembly, “Praise the Lord your God.” So they all praised the Lord , the God of their fathers; they bowed down, prostrating themselves before the Lord and the king.

source: Chuin chuche nikho jou ajingin Pakai hengah ganlhaina asemun, chule Pakai henga govam thilto din bongchal sangkhat le kelngoichal sangkhat, chule kelngoinou sangkhat toh, donding thiltoho toh Israel pumpi dingin ganlhaina tampitah asemun ahi.
target: The next day they made sacrifices to the Lord and presented burnt offerings to him: a thousand bulls, a thousand rams and a thousand male lambs, together with their drink offerings, and other sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.

source: Chule hiche nikho chun kipah thanom tah-in Pakai angsunga chun aneuvin adontauvin ahi. Chule amahon David chapa Solomon chu anivei channa-in leng dingin asemkitnun, chule Pakai henga vaipo pipuipen hidingin thao anuvin, chule Zadok chu thempun asemun ahi.
target: They ate and drank with great joy in the presence of the Lord that day. Then they acknowledged Solomon son of David as king a second time, anointing him before the Lord to be ruler and Zadok to be priest.

source: Hitichun Solomon chu apa David khelin Pakai laltouna-a chun lengin atoutan, chule akhangtouvin; chule Israelte jousen athu angaijun ahi.
target: So Solomon sat on the throne of the Lord as king in place of his father David. He prospered and all Israel obeyed him.

source: Chule pipuiho jouse, mihangsan jouse, chule Leng David chapaho jouse jongchu leng Solomon henga chun akipelut taovin ahi.
target: All the officers and warriors, as well as all of King David’s sons, pledged their submission to King Solomon.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Israel jouse mitmun Solomon chu nasatah-in achoisangin, chule Israel gamsunga ama masanga leng khatchan jong aneikhah louvu leng hina loupina achansah tai.
target: The Lord highly exalted Solomon in the sight of all Israel and bestowed on him royal splendor such as no king over Israel ever had before.

source: Hitichun Jesse chapa David chu Israel jouse chunga chun lengvai apon ahi.
target: David son of Jesse was king over all Israel.

source: Ama Israel chunga alengchan sungchu kum somli ahin, Hebron'a kum sagi aleng changin, chule Jerusalem'a kum somthumle kumthum aleng changin ahi.
target: He ruled over Israel forty years—seven in Hebron and thirty-three in Jerusalem.

source: Chuin ama upatah le tehkem keijin, chule haotah le jabol changpumin athitan ahi; chule ama khelin achapa Solomon chu alengchang tan ahi.
target: He died at a good old age, having enjoyed long life, wealth and honor. His son Solomon succeeded him as king.

source: Tun, David lengpa natohho abula patna achaina gei chu, veuvin, mitvahnei Samuel lekhabu le Nathan themgao lekhabu, chule mitvahneipa Gad lekhabu ho-a akisunsoh keijin,
target: As for the events of King David’s reign, from beginning to end, they are written in the records of Samuel the seer, the records of Nathan the prophet and the records of Gad the seer,

source: Alengvai poh thu jouse le athahatje, chule ama chungle Israel chung, chule gamjousea lenggam jouse-a thilsoh jouse chu achongsoh keijin ahi.
target: together with the details of his reign and power, and the circumstances that surrounded him and Israel and the kingdoms of all the other lands.

source: Chuin David chapa Solomon chu alenggama chun hatah-in akisuhat tan, Pakai a-Pathen'in aumpin, nasatah-in achoisang tai.
target: Solomon son of David established himself firmly over his kingdom, for the Lord his God was with him and made him exceedingly great.

source: Chuin Solomon'in Israelte jouse, sepai sang lamkaiho, ja lamkaiho, thutan ho, Israel pumpi sunga gamvaipo jouse, phung upaho henga thu aseije.
target: Then Solomon spoke to all Israel—to the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, to the judges and to all the leaders in Israel, the heads of families—

source: Hitichun Solomon chule aumpi houkhom ho jouse chu Gibeon'a um munsanga chun acheuvin ahi; ajehchu hia chu Pakai soh Mosi'n gamthipma anasem Pathen houkhom ho Houbuh chu uma ahi.
target: and Solomon and the whole assembly went to the high place at Gibeon, for God’s tent of meeting was there, which Moses the Lord ’s servant had made in the wilderness.

source: Ahinla Pathen thingkhong chu David'in Kirjath-jearim'a konin akoina dinga asemna chun apotou tan ahi; ajehchu hiche dinga chu Jerusalem'a ponbuh khat anasonsa ahitai.
target: Now David had brought up the ark of God from Kiriath Jearim to the place he had prepared for it, because he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem.

source: Chukalvalin Hur chapa, Uri chapa, Bezaleel in'a anasem sum-eng maicham chu Pakai houbuh maija chu akoi ahin; Solomon le houkhom ho chun hichu aholun ahi.
target: But the bronze altar that Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was in Gibeon in front of the tabernacle of the Lord ; so Solomon and the assembly inquired of him there.

source: Chuin Pakai angsunga um sum-eng maicham phunga chun Solomon achetouvin, hichu houkhom ho Houbuh-a uma ahin, achunga chun govam thilto sangkhat jen atoh-in ahi.
target: Solomon went up to the bronze altar before the Lord in the tent of meeting and offered a thousand burnt offerings on it.

source: Hiche janchun Solomon henga Pathen akilah-in, ahenga, Thumin, ipi kapeh ding ham, ati.
target: That night God appeared to Solomon and said to him, “Ask for whatever you want me to give you.”

source: Chuin Solomon'in Pathen henga, Nangman kapa David henga hepina lentah namusah-in, ama khelin keima neilengchan sahtai.
target: Solomon answered God, “You have shown great kindness to David my father and have made me king in his place.

source: Tuhin, vo Pakai Pathen, kapa David henga nathutep chu guilhun sahtan: ajehchu leivuibanga tam miho chunga hi lenga neitun ahitai.
target: Now, Lord God, let your promise to my father David be confirmed, for you have made me king over a people who are as numerous as the dust of the earth.

source: Hiche miho anga kavaikon kavailhun theinadin, chihna le hetna neipen; ajehchu hibangse-a tam nam mite hi kon thu atanjou dingham? atin ahi.
target: Give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may lead this people, for who is able to govern this great people of yours?”

source: Chuin Pathen'in Solomon jah-a, Hiche lungthimhi navopma, haona, neile gou, jabolna, namelmate hinkho, ahiloule nangma hinkho sotna jong thumlouva; achunguva lenga kapansah kamite thu natan theina dinga, chihna le hetna naki thumjoh jeh-in:
target: God said to Solomon, “Since this is your heart’s desire and you have not asked for wealth, possessions or honor, nor for the death of your enemies, and since you have not asked for a long life but for wisdom and knowledge to govern my people over whom I have made you king,

source: Chihna le hetna chu kapeh nahitan; chule nangma masanga anaum lengho khatchan jong ananei khahlou, nanunga honjong aneikhah loudiu haona, neile gou, chule jabolna jong kapeh ding nahi, ati.
target: therefore wisdom and knowledge will be given you. And I will also give you wealth, possessions and honor, such as no king who was before you ever had and none after you will have.”

source: Chujouvin Solomon chu Gibeon'a um munsanga, houkhom ho houbuh masang akholjina-a konin Jerusalem'a ahungin, Israelte chunga vai ahomtan ahi.
target: Then Solomon went to Jerusalem from the high place at Gibeon, from before the tent of meeting. And he reigned over Israel.

source: Chuin Solomon'in kangtalai ho le sakol chung touho akhomin: aman kangtalai sangkhat le jani, chule sakol chunga tou mi sangsom le sangni aneijin, hicheho chu sakol kangtalai khopiho-a le lengpa umna Jerusalem'a akoijin ahi.
target: Solomon accumulated chariots and horses; he had fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.

source: Chule Jerusalem'a chun lengpan dangka le sana song bangkhopma nengin akoijin, chule cedar thing chu phaichama theiba thing tam bangkhopma neingin aum sah-in ahi.
target: The king made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.

source: Chule Solomon'in tupat kikheh ho chu Egypt'a konin sakol ho ahin toldoh sah-in; lengpa sumkol veihon tupat kikheh ho chu aman apeh uva akilahjiu ahi.
target: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from Kue—the royal merchants purchased them from Kue at the current price.

source: Amahon kangtalai khat chu dangka shekel jagup din Egypt'a konin ahintoluvin; hitichun Hit miho lengte jouse dingle Syria lengho dingin sakolhochu amaho minin ahin toldoh jiuvin ahi.
target: They imported a chariot from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty. They also exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and of the Arameans.

source: Chuin Solomon'in Pakai min dinga in khat le alenggama dinga in khat sah ding agel lhutai.
target: Solomon gave orders to build a temple for the Name of the Lord and a royal palace for himself.

source: Chuin Solomon'in pohgih poding mi sangsomsagi, molsanga song khengding mi sangget, chule avetupdiu mi sangthum le jagup alhengdoh tan ahi.
target: He conscripted 70,000 men as carriers and 80,000 as stonecutters in the hills and 3,600 as foremen over them.

source: Chuin Solomon'in Tyre lengpa Huram henga mi asolin, Kapa Davidn'in achenna ding in khat akisahna dinga cedar thing nathotna nabolna bangin keimatah jong neibolin.
target: Solomon sent this message to Hiram king of Tyre: “Send me cedar logs as you did for my father David when you sent him cedar to build a palace to live in.

source: Vetan, choldo nikho, lhathah nikho, chule Pakai ka Pathen'u kutpi nikhoho le ama henga katdoh ding, amasanga gimnamtui halna ding, tanglouva vetsahna changlhah tona ding, chule jingkah nilhah-a govam thilpeh bolna dinga Pakai ka Pathen mina inkhat kasah ahi. Hichehi Israelte dinga a-itih-a houdan thupeh ahi.
target: Now I am about to build a temple for the Name of the Lord my God and to dedicate it to him for burning fragrant incense before him, for setting out the consecrated bread regularly, and for making burnt offerings every morning and evening and on the Sabbaths, at the New Moons and at the appointed festivals of the Lord our God. This is a lasting ordinance for Israel.

source: Chule ka-in sahhi lentah ahin; ka Pathen'u hi pathenho jouse sanga lenjo ahi.
target: “The temple I am going to build will be great, because our God is greater than all other gods.

source: Ahinla vanle vanho van jengin jong ama adoljoulou ahin, kon ama dinga in asahpeh jou dingham? Ama anga ganlhaina kago tailou, kei koi kahia ama dinga in kasahpeh thei dingham?
target: But who is able to build a temple for him, since the heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain him? Who then am I to build a temple for him, except as a place to burn sacrifices before him?

source: Hijeh chun tun kapa David'in anamanchahsa Judah le Jerusalem'a kaumpi natongthem hotoh tongkhom dingin, sana, dangka, sum-eng, thih, pon asandup, asanthip, adum ho jouse-a thepna nei mikhat neihin solpeh-in.
target: “Send me, therefore, a man skilled to work in gold and silver, bronze and iron, and in purple, crimson and blue yarn, and experienced in the art of engraving, to work in Judah and Jerusalem with my skilled workers, whom my father David provided.

source: Labanon'a konin cedar thing, chah thing, algum thingho jong neihin tolpeh-in; ajehchu nasohte chu Lebanon thing tuhdan athemuve ti kahei; chule vetan, keima sohten nangma sohte kithopiu vintin,
target: “Send me also cedar, juniper and algum logs from Lebanon, for I know that your servants are skilled in cutting timber there. My servants will work with yours

source: Thing nengtah-a eigonpeh dingu ahi; ajehchu ka in sahgot hi kidangtah-a len hiding ahi.
target: to provide me with plenty of lumber, because the temple I build must be large and magnificent.

source: Chule, vetan, nasohte, thing phuh-a tanho chu suhlou chang kigoibong tena sangsomni, sakolchang tena sangsomni toh, lengpitwi tena sangsomni, chule thaotwi tena sangsomni kapeh ding ahi, tin mi agahsole.
target: I will give your servants, the woodsmen who cut the timber, twenty thousand cors of ground wheat, twenty thousand cors of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine and twenty thousand baths of olive oil.”

source: Chuphatnin Tyre lengpa Huram'in sut tho-in adonbutnin, Solomon athot tai; Pakaiyin amite angailut jeh-in, nangma achunguva lengin nasemtai.
target: Hiram king of Tyre replied by letter to Solomon: “Because the Lord loves his people, he has made you their king.”

source: Achung chonin Huram'in aseiben, Van le lei sempa, Pakai dinga in khatle alenggam dinga in khat sathei dinga David dinga chihna le hetkhen themna nei chapa chingtah khat pepa Pakai Israel Pathen chu nunnom hen.
target: And Hiram added: “Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth! He has given King David a wise son, endowed with intelligence and discernment, who will build a temple for the Lord and a palace for himself.

source: Chule tun keiman kapate Huram mi, mithemnal, hetkhen themma nei mi khat kahin solpeh-e.
target: “I am sending you Huram-Abi, a man of great skill,

source: Ama Dan chanute numei khat chapa, apachu Tyre mi ahin, sana-a, dangka-a, sum-enga, ponduma, tupat ponnema, ponsanthip lama themtah ahin; thiljem jouse khengthei, boldinga kigonpeh jouse boldohthei ahin, nangma khutthemho le kapu David napa khutthemho toh kithothei ahi.
target: whose mother was from Dan and whose father was from Tyre. He is trained to work in gold and silver, bronze and iron, stone and wood, and with purple and blue and crimson yarn and fine linen. He is experienced in all kinds of engraving and can execute any design given to him. He will work with your skilled workers and with those of my lord, David your father.

source: Hijeh chun tuhin ka pakaiyin anaseisa suhlou chang, sakolchang, thaotwi, lengpitwi chu asohte henga hinthot tahen;
target: “Now let my lord send his servants the wheat and barley and the olive oil and wine he promised,

source: Chule keihon Lebanon'a konin nangaichat dingjat jat chu phuh ungting; keihon nahenga Joppa geijin twipi chunga puma kahin toldiu, chule nanghon Jerusalem geija naki lhoh dingu ahi, ati.
target: and we will cut all the logs from Lebanon that you need and will float them as rafts by sea down to Joppa. You can then take them up to Jerusalem.”

source: Chuin Solomon'in apa David'in anasimsa bangin, gamsunga um gamdangmi jouse asimin; amaho chu sangjakhat le sangsomnga chule sangthum le jagup asimdoh-in ahi.
target: Solomon took a census of all the foreigners residing in Israel, after the census his father David had taken; and they were found to be 153,600.

source: Chuin amaholah-a sangsomsagi chu thilgih poding, mi sangsomget chung molchunga song khengding, chule mi sangthum le jagup chu anatoh-u vetup dingin apansah tan ahi.
target: He assigned 70,000 of them to be carriers and 80,000 to be stonecutters in the hills, with 3,600 foremen over them to keep the people working.

source: Chujouvin Solomon'in Jerusalem'a um Moriah molsang, apa David henga Pakai kilahna mun, Jebus mi Ornan pholmun David'in anagona mun'a chun Pakai in chu asapantan ahi.
target: Then Solomon began to build the temple of the Lord in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the Lord had appeared to his father David. It was on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite, the place provided by David.

source: Alengchan kum lina, alhani na, nini chan nin insah akipantan ahi.
target: He began building on the second day of the second month in the fourth year of his reign.

source: Tun hichehohi Pathen in kisah dingdan Solomon anakihil chu ahi. Adunglam chu tena masa dungjuijin tong somgup ahin, avaichu tong somni ahi.
target: The foundation Solomon laid for building the temple of God was sixty cubits long and twenty cubits wide (using the cubit of the old standard).

source: Chule inmai lama um hongcha dunglam chu invai dungjuijin tong somni ahin, asanlam tong jakhatle somni ahin: asunglam chu sana theng twijin aloijin ahi.
target: The portico at the front of the temple was twenty cubits long across the width of the building and twenty cubits high. He overlaid the inside with pure gold.

source: Chule aman in alenjo sung chu chahthingin athopmin, hichu sana thengin aloijin, achunga chun tumthingho le thihkhao kiphan lim aseme.
target: He paneled the main hall with juniper and covered it with fine gold and decorated it with palm tree and chain designs.

source: Chuin in chu ahoinadin song mantamin ajemin, sana chu Parvaim gam sana ahi.
target: He adorned the temple with precious stones. And the gold he used was gold of Parvaim.

source: Aman in chu a-inkamho, akhomho, abangho, akotho chu sana in aloijin; bangho chunga chun Cherub limho asemin ahi.
target: He overlaid the ceiling beams, doorframes, walls and doors of the temple with gold, and he carved cherubim on the walls.

source: Aman in theng chungnung asemin, adung chu invai dungjuija tong somni ahin, avai jong tong somnima ahi: chuin aman sana thengset talent jagup man jenin aloijin ahi.
target: He built the Most Holy Place, its length corresponding to the width of the temple—twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide. He overlaid the inside with six hundred talents of fine gold.

source: Chule akilnaho chu sana shekel somnga-a gih ahin, chule indan chungnung chu sana-a kiloi ahi.
target: The gold nails weighed fifty shekels. He also overlaid the upper parts with gold.

source: Chule intheng chungnung sunga chun Cherub ni lim asemin, sana in aloijin ahi.
target: For the Most Holy Place he made a pair of sculptured cherubim and overlaid them with gold.

source: Cherub teni lhachu tong somni asaovin: Cherub khat lha langkhat chu tong nga ahin, inbang chu aphan ahi: hiche bang chun alha langkhat jong tong nga ma ahin, Cherub khatpa lhaving chu aphai.
target: The total wingspan of the cherubim was twenty cubits. One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long and touched the temple wall, while its other wing, also five cubits long, touched the wing of the other cherub.

source: Chule Cherub khatpa lhaving langkhat chu tong nga ahin, inbang chu aphan; alhaving dang jongchu tong nga ahin, Cherub khatpa lhaving chutoh akimatnin ahi.
target: Similarly one wing of the second cherub was five cubits long and touched the other temple wall, and its other wing, also five cubits long, touched the wing of the first cherub.

source: Hiche Cherub teni lhavingho chu tongsomni akijalin, amani akengin adinglhonin, amailhonin sunglam angatgel lhone.
target: The wings of these cherubim extended twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, facing the main hall.

source: Chule aman ponjal adum, asanthip, asandup, chule tupat ponnem asemin; achunga chun Cherub ho lim achonsah-e.
target: He made the curtain of blue, purple and crimson yarn and fine linen, with cherubim worked into it.

source: Aman inmaija chun khom ni tong somthum le nga sanggel jong asemin, achungvuma alujum lhon chu tongnga gel ahi.
target: For the front of the temple he made two pillars, which together were thirty-five cubits long, each with a capital five cubits high.

source: Chuin aman muntheng insunga bangin thihkhao kiphan asemin, khomteni leh-a akhaijin, chule khombula chun kolbuthei lim jakhat asemin, thihkhao kiphana-a chun akoije.
target: He made interwoven chains and put them on top of the pillars. He also made a hundred pomegranates and attached them to the chains.

source: Chule aman Houin maija chun khompi ni, khat chu jetlama, khat veilama atungdoh-in; chule jetlama pa minchu Jachin asah-in, veilamapa minchu Boaz asah-in ahi.
target: He erected the pillars in the front of the temple, one to the south and one to the north. The one to the south he named Jakin and the one to the north Boaz.

source: Chukalvalin aman sum-eng maicham, adung tongsomni, avai tongsomni, chule asan tongsom khat asemin ahi.
target: He made a bronze altar twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide and ten cubits high.

source: Aman twikonglen ageilang khatna pat langkhat kah chu tongsom lha-a akimvel kikolkhum ahin, chule asanlam chu tong nga asangin asemin, chule khaojang tong somthum khatnin akimvel akolkhumin ahi.
target: He made the Sea of cast metal, circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim and five cubits high. It took a line of thirty cubits to measure around it.

source: Anoilam chu bongchalho lheh lheh abangin, hiche lim chun akimvelin akolkhumin, tong khatna som cheh-in twikong chu akimvelin ahi. Hiche kisun laija chu bongchal lim golnia kisung ahi.
target: Below the rim, figures of bulls encircled it—ten to a cubit. The bulls were cast in two rows in one piece with the Sea.

source: Hichu bongchal somleni chunga chun adingin; thumin sahlam angan, thumin lhumlam angan, thumin lhanglam angan, chule thumin solam angai: chule twikong chu hitiho chungvuma chu kiluija, atou chu akholut cheh-u ahi.
target: The Sea stood on twelve bulls, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south and three facing east. The Sea rested on top of them, and their hindquarters were toward the center.

source: Asadan khutphang chana sa ahin, agei chu khongeija molhoipah kisem tobang ahin; hichun bath sangthum adole.
target: It was a handbreadth in thickness, and its rim was like the rim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It held three thousand baths.

source: Aman twidol jong som asemin; kisilna dingin jetlama nga akoijin, veilama ngama akoijin ahi: hicheho sunga chu govam thiltoho asopjiu ahin, ahinla twikongho chu thempuho kisilna ding ahi.
target: He then made ten basins for washing and placed five on the south side and five on the north. In them the things to be used for the burnt offerings were rinsed, but the Sea was to be used by the priests for washing.

source: Chule agongu dungjuijin sana meivah khom som asemin; houin sunga jet lama nga, chule veilama nga atunge.
target: He made ten gold lampstands according to the specifications for them and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north.

source: Aman dokhang som jong asemin, houin sunga chun jetlama nga chule veilama ngama akoije; chule sana twikong jakhat jong asemin ahi.
target: He made ten tables and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north. He also made a hundred gold sprinkling bowls.

source: Chuche bana aman thempuho hongsung le kulpi, chule kulpi kotkhah asemin; chule kotho chu sum-eng in aloijin ahi.
target: He made the courtyard of the priests, and the large court and the doors for the court, and overlaid the doors with bronze.

source: Chule twikong chu solam mong jetlam lhanglam jona chun akoijin ahi.
target: He placed the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner.

source: Chuin Huram'in belho le vutloho, chule twikongho chu asemtan ahi. Chule Huram'in Pathen in'a dinga Solomon lengpa abolpeh natohho chu ajoutan ahi.
target: And Huram also made the pots and shovels and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished the work he had undertaken for King Solomon in the temple of God:

source: Hetding chu khomteni, khombemho, khom teni lehvuma abohteni, chule khompiteni lehvuma abohtenia khombem teni khuna ding pahvuiteni;
target: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars; the two sets of network decorating the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars;

source: Pahvui teni chunga kolbuthei jali, khomho chunga abohtenia khombem teni khuna ding pahvui khat khat chunga chu kolbuthei golnini ga ahi.
target: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network, decorating the bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars);

source: Aman akhomho asemin, chule akhomho chungadin twidol ho aseme.
target: the stands with their basins;

source: Twikong khatle anoija bongchal somleni asemin;
target: the Sea and the twelve bulls under it;

source: Belho jong, vutlona le satulka; hicheho jouse hi apa Huram'in Pakai in'a dinga sum-eng duljetna Solomon lengpa asempeh ahi.
target: the pots, shovels, meat forks and all related articles. All the objects that Huram-Abi made for King Solomon for the temple of the Lord were of polished bronze.

source: Jordan phaicham Succoth le Zeradathah kikah-a hahlei laija lengpan alhahtho ngen ahi.
target: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Sukkoth and Zarethan.

source: Hitichun Solomon'in hiche umle belho jousehi bulhing setnin asemtan ahi: ajehchu sum-eng ho gihchu hetsoh jouhoi ahitapoi.
target: All these things that Solomon made amounted to so much that the weight of the bronze could not be calculated.

source: Chule Solomon'in Pathen in dinga umle belho jouse asemjouvin, sana maicham jong, chule achunga vetsahna changlhah kitoh koina dokhang jong;
target: Solomon also made all the furnishings that were in God’s temple: the golden altar; the tables on which was the bread of the Presence;

source: Chukalvalin muntheng pen masanga adan dungjuija adetjiu meivah khomhole ameivahho jong sanathengin asemin;
target: the lampstands of pure gold with their lamps, to burn in front of the inner sanctuary as prescribed;

source: Chule pahchaho, thaomei ho, chaicheho jouse jongchu sana thengselin asemin;
target: the gold floral work and lamps and tongs (they were solid gold);

source: Chule thaomei ponchenaho, twikongho, thihkheho, gimnamtui lhengho chu sana thengselin asemin: insung lutna, muntheng chungnung kotkhah sungnung, chule houin kotkhah ho chu sana in asemin ahi.
target: the pure gold wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes and censers; and the gold doors of the temple: the inner doors to the Most Holy Place and the doors of the main hall.

source: Hitichun Pakai in dinga Solomon'in aboljouse chu jo ahitan: Solomon'in apa David'in anakatdohsa thil jouse; chule sana, dangka, chule manchah jouse chu Pathen in thilkholna lah-a chun ahin polut tan ahi.
target: When all the work Solomon had done for the temple of the Lord was finished, he brought in the things his father David had dedicated—the silver and gold and all the furnishings—and he placed them in the treasuries of God’s temple.

source: Chuin Solomon'in Israel upa hole phung upaho, Israel chate upaho lamkai jouse chu David khopi Zion'a kona Pakai kitepna thingkhong podoh din Jerusalem'a akhomin ahi.
target: Then Solomon summoned to Jerusalem the elders of Israel, all the heads of the tribes and the chiefs of the Israelite families, to bring up the ark of the Lord ’s covenant from Zion, the City of David.

source: Hijeh chun Israel mite jouse lha sagi lhinna kut-a chun lengpa henga akikhom taove.
target: And all the Israelites came together to the king at the time of the festival in the seventh month.

source: Chuin Israel upaho jouse ahungun; Levi ho chun thingkhong chu apodoh taove.
target: When all the elders of Israel had arrived, the Levites took up the ark,

source: Chule amahon thingkhong, houkhom ho houbuh, chule houbuh sunga um le bel thengho jouse ahinpo touvun; hichehohi thempuho le Levi ho hinpohtou ahi.
target: and they brought up the ark and the tent of meeting and all the sacred furnishings in it. The Levitical priests carried them up;

source: Solomon lengpa le ahenga thingkhong maija mipi kikhom Israel hou lamkaiho jouse chun kelngoiho le bongchal ho-a kilhaina abolun, hichu atambehseh jeh-in seijougol ahitapoi.
target: and King Solomon and the entire assembly of Israel that had gathered about him were before the ark, sacrificing so many sheep and cattle that they could not be recorded or counted.

source: Chuin thempuho chun Pakai thulhun thingkhong chu ama mun, houin'a muntheng lai, muntheng chungnung pena chun Cherubim lhaving noi ngeija ahinpolut taovin ahi:
target: The priests then brought the ark of the Lord ’s covenant to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the Most Holy Place, and put it beneath the wings of the cherubim.

source: Ajehchu Cherub teni lhaving chun thingkhong kikoina ding chung chu akhu ahin, chule Cherub teni chun thingkhong le achunga amoljol teni chu akhu ahi.
target: The cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark and covered the ark and its carrying poles.

source: Chuin thingkhoga moljol teni chu asao behseh jeh-in, munthenga konin akimuphan ahi; ahin polama vang akimupoi. Hitichun hikoma chun aumjing nalaije.
target: These poles were so long that their ends, extending from the ark, could be seen from in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from outside the Holy Place; and they are still there today.

source: Thingkhong sunga chu Egypt'a kona ahungdoh laiju, Pakaiyin Israel chatetoh Horeb mun'a kitepna asem laija, Mosi'n anakoilut songpheng teni tailou imacha umlou ahi.
target: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb, where the Lord made a covenant with the Israelites after they came out of Egypt.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Thempuho chu munthenga kona ahungdoh phatnun, (ajeh chu thempu aumho jouse kisutheng cheh jiuva ahin, ahona kingahlou ahiuve:
target: The priests then withdrew from the Holy Place. All the priests who were there had consecrated themselves, regardless of their divisions.

source: Chujongle Levi lasaho jouse, Asaph'a kon jouse, Heman'a kon, Jeduthun'a kon, achapateu le asopiteu jouse chu tupat ponbangleh-a akivonun, thih khutbehho, tumgingho, selangdah ho akichoijun, maicham mong solama chun adingun, chule amaho chutoh sumkon mut thempu jakhat le somni dinguva ahi:)
target: All the Levites who were musicians—Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun and their sons and relatives—stood on the east side of the altar, dressed in fine linen and playing cymbals, harps and lyres. They were accompanied by 120 priests sounding trumpets.

source: Ahung hitin ahi, Pakai vahchoina le thangvahna aw akijah nadinga sumkon mut hole lasaho chun awkhat banga ahin ginsah uva; sumkon le thih khutbeh chule tumgingthei manchah ho jouse to kitho-a apenuva, Ama aphai, ijeh inem itile ahepina atonsotnin aum jinge, tia Pakai avahchoi laijun: Pakai houin ngeichu meilhangin adiptan;
target: The trumpeters and musicians joined in unison to give praise and thanks to the Lord . Accompanied by trumpets, cymbals and other instruments, the singers raised their voices in praise to the Lord and sang: “He is good; his love endures forever.” Then the temple of the Lord was filled with the cloud,

source: Meilhang jehchun thempuho chu kinbol dingin ading thei tapouve: ajehchu Pathen in chu Pakai loupi na-in adip ahitai.
target: and the priests could not perform their service because of the cloud, for the glory of the Lord filled the temple of God.

source: Chuin Solomon'in, Pakaiyin muthim lhangkhal kiheh lah-a kachending ahi, tin anaseije.
target: Then Solomon said, “The Lord has said that he would dwell in a dark cloud;

source: Hijongle naum nading le, tonsotna nachenna ding mun hidingin in khat kasahpehtai, ati.
target: I have built a magnificent temple for you, a place for you to dwell forever.”

source: Chuin lengpan amai aheijin, Israel houkhom ho jouse chu phatthei aboh-in: chule Israel houkhom ho jouse chu adingdoh-un ahi.
target: While the whole assembly of Israel was standing there, the king turned around and blessed them.

source: Chuin aman, kapa David henga akamtah-a anaseisa akhut tah-a guilhun sah-a Israel Pakai Pathen chu nunnom hen.
target: Then he said: “Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who with his hands has fulfilled what he promised with his mouth to my father David. For he said,

source: Aman kamite Egypt gama kona kapuidoh nikho-a patnin kamin umna dinga in khat sahna dingin Israel phung jouse sunga khopi khatcha kanalheng khapon; kami Israelte chunga vaipo dingjong mi khatcha kana lheng khapoi.
target: ‘Since the day I brought my people out of Egypt, I have not chosen a city in any tribe of Israel to have a temple built so that my Name might be there, nor have I chosen anyone to be ruler over my people Israel.

source: Ahinla keiman Jerusalem chu kamin umtheina din kana lhengin; kami Israelte chunga vaihomdin David chu kana lhengin ahi.
target: But now I have chosen Jerusalem for my Name to be there, and I have chosen David to rule my people Israel.’

source: Tun Israel Pakai Pathen dinga in khat sahdoh ding chu kapa David lungsunga ana umin ahi.
target: “My father David had it in his heart to build a temple for the Name of the Lord , the God of Israel.

source: Ahinla Pakaiyin kapa David henga, Kamin dinga in sah ding nalunga nagela, hitobang lungtup chu nalunga aumjeh-in aphalheh jenge;
target: But the Lord said to my father David, ‘You did well to have it in your heart to build a temple for my Name.

source: Hijeng jongle in chu nangman nasah louding ahi; amavang nataijola hungpeng nachapa chun, kamina in chu asahding ahi.
target: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build the temple, but your son, your own flesh and blood—he is the one who will build the temple for my Name.’

source: Hijeh-a chu Pakaiyin anaseisa chu aguilhunsah ahi. Ajehchu keima kapa David indan sunga kahung seilenin, Pakai thutep bangin Israel laltouna-a katouvin, Israel chate Pakai Pathen min dingin in chu kasatan ahi.
target: “The Lord has kept the promise he made. I have succeeded David my father and now I sit on the throne of Israel, just as the Lord promised, and I have built the temple for the Name of the Lord , the God of Israel.

source: Chule hiche sunga chun Pakaiyin Israel chatetoh anasem kitepna thingkhong chu kakoitan ahi, ati.
target: There I have placed the ark, in which is the covenant of the Lord that he made with the people of Israel.”

source: Chuin ama Israel houkhom ho jouse mitmun Pakai maicham anga chun adingin, akhut ajah-in:
target: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in front of the whole assembly of Israel and spread out his hands.

source: Ajehchu Solomon'in sum-eng dokhang tong nga sao, tong nga len chule tong thum sangkhat asem ahin, hichu hongsung lailunga atun ahi. Chuin hiche chunga chun adingin, Israel houkhom ho jouse masanga chun adilsun, akhutnin vanlam sangin,
target: Now he had made a bronze platform, five cubits long, five cubits wide and three cubits high, and had placed it in the center of the outer court. He stood on the platform and then knelt down before the whole assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven.

source: Hitin ati, Vo Pakai, Israel Pathen, nangma banga akitepna subulhit, namasanga alung pumpiuva vahlea nasohte henga hepina musah-a van'a ahin leija ahin jong Pathen dang aumpoi.
target: He said: “ Lord , the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth—you who keep your covenant of love with your servants who continue wholeheartedly in your way.

source: Nangman nasoh kapa David henga nana thutep jouse nasubulhit nin; nakamtah-in nanaphong doh-in, tunikho banghin nakhut tah-in namolso tai.
target: You have kept your promise to your servant David my father; with your mouth you have promised and with your hand you have fulfilled it—as it is today.

source: Hijeh chun tun, Vo Pakai Israel Pathen, nasoh kapa David henga, Nachate chu kamasanga nangma chonna banga alamlhah uva, chule kadanthu dungjuija alamlhah na diuva achihthei pou uva ahile; kamitmu-a Israelte laltouna-a touding mi lhasam louding ahi, tia nana thutep chu molsotan.
target: “Now, Lord , the God of Israel, keep for your servant David my father the promises you made to him when you said, ‘You shall never fail to have a successor to sit before me on the throne of Israel, if only your descendants are careful in all they do to walk before me according to my law, as you have done.’

source: Achutile tun, vo Pakai Israel Pathen, nasoh David henga naseisa thu chu subulhit teijin.
target: And now, Lord , the God of Israel, let your word that you promised your servant David come true.

source: Ahinla Pathen chu leisetna hin mihemte toh achengkhom mong nadem? Vetan vanle vanho van'in jong nadolou ahin, keiman kasah hiche inhi iti neojocheh-a hitam!
target: “But will God really dwell on earth with humans? The heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain you. How much less this temple I have built!

source: Hijeh chun vo Pakai ka Pathen, nasoh taona le thumna hi jabolpeh inlang, na angsunga nasohpa taona le pen nahi ngaipeh-in:
target: Yet, Lord my God, give attention to your servant’s prayer and his plea for mercy. Hear the cry and the prayer that your servant is praying in your presence.

source: Chule nasoh-in hiche lam nga-a ataona nangaipeh na dingin; kamin kakoi ding ahi tia nanaseina mun, hiche in hi asun ajanin ve jingin.
target: May your eyes be open toward this temple day and night, this place of which you said you would put your Name there. May you hear the prayer your servant prays toward this place.

source: Hitichun nasohpa le nami Israel ten hichemun lam nga-a ataonao chu ngaipeh-in: nachenna mun van'a konin ngaijin lang, najahpeh tengle ngaidamtan.
target: Hear the supplications of your servant and of your people Israel when they pray toward this place. Hear from heaven, your dwelling place; and when you hear, forgive.

source: Mi khattou aheng akom douna-a achonsetna, kihahselsah dinga achunga thutep achuh-a, hiche akihahsel dingpa chu hiche insung namaicham masang ahi ahunga ahile,
target: “When anyone wrongs their neighbor and is required to take an oath and they come and swear the oath before your altar in this temple,

source: Van'a konin hinngaijin lang na hintongin, nasoh chu athu tanpeh-in; michonpha chu themchanna le, achonphatna dungjuija lethuh inlang; migilou chu ama luchang ngeija phulahna chuhsah-in.
target: then hear from heaven and act. Judge between your servants, condemning the guilty and bringing down on their heads what they have done, and vindicating the innocent by treating them in accordance with their innocence.

source: Chule nangma douna chonset aboljeh uva, nami Israelte chu amelmateu masanga aleluva; ahung kile heijuva, namin aphondoh uva, hiche insungahi na-angsunga taona le thumna aneijuva ahile;
target: “When your people Israel have been defeated by an enemy because they have sinned against you and when they turn back and give praise to your name, praying and making supplication before you in this temple,

source: Van'a konin hin ngaipeh inlang, nami Israelte chonsetna chu ngaidamin, chule nangman amaho le apu apateu nanapeh gama chun hinlepui kitnin.
target: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel and bring them back to the land you gave to them and their ancestors.

source: Nangma douna-a achonset jeh uva, van akikha-a, go julouva aumteng; amaho hiche munlam nga-a atao uva, namin aphondoh uva, namgman nasuh genthei jeh uva, achonset naova kona ahung kileuva ahile;
target: “When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because your people have sinned against you, and when they pray toward this place and give praise to your name and turn from their sin because you have afflicted them,

source: Van'a konin hinngaijin lang, ajot dingu lampi pha nahil theina dingin, nasohte le nami Israelte chonset ngaidamin; chule alodinguva namite nanapehna nagam chunga hin go hinjuh sah-in.
target: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel. Teach them the right way to live, and send rain on the land you gave your people for an inheritance.

source: Gamsunga kel alhah ham, hise alan ham, huise anun ham, thinglung ahiloule khaokho alan hama; melmaten agamsungu khopiho-a chu aumchah-uham; itobang hise ham ahiloule itobang natna hijongle alanteng;
target: “When famine or plague comes to the land, or blight or mildew, locusts or grasshoppers, or when enemies besiege them in any of their cities, whatever disaster or disease may come,

source: Amitakipmin apohgih ule alung khamna cheh akihetdoh uva, hiche in lam nga-a akhut ajah uva, changval ham ahiloule Israel mipi jousen, itobang taona hihen, itobang thumna hijong le ahin nei tengule;
target: and when a prayer or plea is made by anyone among your people Israel—being aware of their afflictions and pains, and spreading out their hands toward this temple—

source: Nachenna van'a konin ngaipeh inlang, ngaidamin, chule alunggelu nahet bangin, mitin alamlhah dungjui cheh-un lethuh-in; (ajehchu nangma bouvin mihem chate lungsung nahet ahi.)
target: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Forgive, and deal with everyone according to all they do, since you know their hearts (for you alone know the human heart),

source: Chutia chu kapu kapateu nanapehna gamsunga hi achenlai seuva nalampi ajot nadinguva nagin dingu ahi.
target: so that they will fear you and walk in obedience to you all the time they live in the land you gave our ancestors.

source: Chukalvalin namin loupitahle nakhut thahat tah, chule naban jahdoh jala gamlatah-a kona hung nami Israelte hilou gamdang mi thudola; amaho ahunguva hiche insunga hi ataovuva ahile;
target: “As for the foreigner who does not belong to your people Israel but has come from a distant land because of your great name and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm—when they come and pray toward this temple,

source: Chuteng nachenna mun vanho ngeija konchun ngaijin lang, gamdang mipan nakoulona pen dungjui chun bolpeh-in; chutile leiset mite jouse namin ahet dingu, nami Israel ten nagin banguva nagin diu, chule keiman kasah hiche inhi namina kivo ahi ti ahet dingu ahi.
target: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Do whatever the foreigner asks of you, so that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your own people Israel, and may know that this house I have built bears your Name.

source: Namite chu nangman nasolna lampia amelmateu satdinga akondoh uva, nangman nalhendohsa hiche khopi lam le nangma min dinga kasah hiche in lam nga-a hi ahung tao uva ahile,
target: “When your people go to war against their enemies, wherever you send them, and when they pray to you toward this city you have chosen and the temple I have built for your Name,

source: Nangman van'a konin ataonao le athumnao ngaipeh inlang, athu-u bolpeh in.
target: then hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and uphold their cause.

source: Amaho nangma douna-a achonsetnuva, (ajehchu achonse lou khatcha umlou ahi,) nangma achunguva nalunghana, amelmateu henga napeh doh-a, amahon gamlatah ham naicha hama sohchanga akaimang uva ahile,
target: “When they sin against you—for there is no one who does not sin—and you become angry with them and give them over to the enemy, who takes them captive to a land far away or near;

source: Hijongle sohchanga akikainao gama chu ahung kingaito uva, asohchannao gama chu ahung kiheijuva nahenga ahung tao uva, Keiho kana chonseuvin, kasukhelun, chule giloutah-in na katonguve atiuva;
target: and if they have a change of heart in the land where they are held captive, and repent and plead with you in the land of their captivity and say, ‘We have sinned, we have done wrong and acted wickedly’;

source: Soh-a akikainao asohchannao gama kona chu alung pumpiu le ahinna pumpiuva nangma lama ahung kiheijuva, apu apateu nanapeh gam le nangman nanalhen khopi, chule keiman namin dinga kasah hiche in lam nga-a hi ahungtao uva ahile;
target: and if they turn back to you with all their heart and soul in the land of their captivity where they were taken, and pray toward the land you gave their ancestors, toward the city you have chosen and toward the temple I have built for your Name;

source: Chuteng ataonao le athumnao chu nachenna mun van'a kon ngeichun ngaipeh inlang, athu chu bolpeh-in; chule nangma douna chonsea namite hi ngaidamin.
target: then from heaven, your dwelling place, hear their prayer and their pleas, and uphold their cause. And forgive your people, who have sinned against you.

source: Tun, ka-Pathen, kangeh nahi, hiche mun'a taona kimanna-a hin, namit hasah inlang, nana hinsungin.
target: “Now, my God, may your eyes be open and your ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.

source: Hijeh chun tun, vo Pakai Pathen, nacholdona mun'a dingin nangma chule nathahatna thingkhong toh kipatdoh-in; vo Pakai Pathen nathempu ho chu huhhingna-in kivonu henlang, namithengte chu phatna-a kipah uhen.
target: “Now arise, Lord God, and come to your resting place, you and the ark of your might. May your priests, Lord God, be clothed with salvation, may your faithful people rejoice in your goodness.

source: Vo Pakai Pathen, nathaonupa mai chu heimang hih-in, nasoh David hepinaho chu geldoh-in, ati.
target: Lord God, do not reject your anointed one. Remember the great love promised to David your servant.”

source: Tun Solomon taojou phatnin, van'a konin mei ahungleng lhan, govam thilto le ganlhaina hochu akavamin, houin chu Pakai loupina adimtan ahi.
target: When Solomon finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices, and the glory of the Lord filled the temple.

source: Chuin Pakai in chu Pakai loupina adimjeh-in, Pakai insunga chun thempuho alutthei tapouve.
target: The priests could not enter the temple of the Lord because the glory of the Lord filled it.

source: Chuin Israel chate jousen mei ahung lenlhah le in chunga Pakai loupina ahung kumlhah chu amuphatnun, tolla songlhongnal chunga amaiju asulutnun, Pakai chu ahouvun, avahchoijun, Ama aphat jeh-in, ahepina tonsotnin aumjinge, atiuvin ahi.
target: When all the Israelites saw the fire coming down and the glory of the Lord above the temple, they knelt on the pavement with their faces to the ground, and they worshiped and gave thanks to the Lord , saying, “He is good; his love endures forever.”

source: Chuin lengpa le mijouse chun Pakai angsunga chun ganlhaina atoh taovin ahi.
target: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the Lord .

source: Chuin Solomon'in bongchal sangsomni le sangni toh, kelngoi sang jankhatle sangsomni in kilhaina abolin; hitichun lengpa le mijouse chun Pathen in chu athenso taove.
target: And King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep and goats. So the king and all the people dedicated the temple of God.

source: Chuin thempuho chu atohmun cheh uva adingun; chule Levi ho jong chun David'in, Ajehchu ahepina atonsotnin aumjinge tia Pakai vahchoina dinga anasem, Pakai tumging thei manchah ho chu akichoijun; chuin thempuhon mipi angsunga chun sumkon amutnun ahile, Israelte jouse chu adingdoh sohkeijun ahi.
target: The priests took their positions, as did the Levites with the Lord ’s musical instruments, which King David had made for praising the Lord and which were used when he gave thanks, saying, “His love endures forever.” Opposite the Levites, the priests blew their trumpets, and all the Israelites were standing.

source: Chukalvalin Solomon'in Pakai in maija hongsung lailung chu athenson ahi: ajehchu Solomon'in asem sum-eng maicham chun govam thilto le anneh thilto, chule thao thilto chu adol joulou jeh-a, govam thilto le chamna thilto thao ho chu hikoma chu atou ahi.
target: Solomon consecrated the middle part of the courtyard in front of the temple of the Lord , and there he offered burnt offerings and the fat of the fellowship offerings, because the bronze altar he had made could not hold the burnt offerings, the grain offerings and the fat portions.

source: Hiche sung mama chun Solomon le akoma um Israelte jouse, Hamath lutna-a pat Egypt vapi geija hung kikhom mipi atama tam chun nisagi kut amangun ahi.
target: So Solomon observed the festival at that time for seven days, and all Israel with him—a vast assembly, people from Lebo Hamath to the Wadi of Egypt.

source: Chuin niget lhinin kikhoppi loupitah abolun ahi: ajehchu amahon maicham thensona chu nisagi amanuva, kut chu ni sagima amanu ahi.
target: On the eighth day they held an assembly, for they had celebrated the dedication of the altar for seven days and the festival for seven days more.

source: Chuin lha sagina, nisomni le nithum ni chun, Pakaiyin David le Solomon chule ami Israelte henga anamusah phatna jeh chun, mipi chu kipahtahle thanom tah-in aponbuh lamuva asoltan ahi.
target: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month he sent the people to their homes, joyful and glad in heart for the good things the Lord had done for David and Solomon and for his people Israel.

source: Hitichun Solomon'in Pakai inle lengpa in chu ajoutai: chule Pakai in le amatah in sahna dinga Solomon lunga kon jouse chu aman lamjang keijin amolsotan ahi.
target: When Solomon had finished the temple of the Lord and the royal palace, and had succeeded in carrying out all he had in mind to do in the temple of the Lord and in his own palace,

source: Chuin Pakai chu jan-in Solomon henga akilah-in, ahenga hitin aseije, Nataona kangaijin, hiche munhi keima dinga ganlhaina in hidingin kalheng tai.
target: the Lord appeared to him at night and said: “I have heard your prayer and have chosen this place for myself as a temple for sacrifices.

source: Keiman van kakha-a go ajuhda-a, ahiloule gamsung bahgam dinga khaokhopi kalansah-a, ahiloule kamite lah-a hise kalansah-a ahile;
target: “When I shut up the heavens so that there is no rain, or command locusts to devour the land or send a plague among my people,

source: Kamina kikou kamite hi ahung kineosah uva, atao uva, kamai aholuva, akhansetna houva kona akile heijuva ahile; chuteng keiman van'a kona ataonao kangaipeh ding, achonsetnao kangaidam-a, agamu kadamsah ding ahi.
target: if my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, and I will forgive their sin and will heal their land.

source: Hiche mun'a taona kimangho lama kamit kahasah-a kana kasun jing ding ahi.
target: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.

source: Ajehchu a-itih-a kamin umjing nadinga hiche in hi kalhena kasuhtheng ahitai: kamit le kalungthim hi chukoma umjing ding ahitai.
target: I have chosen and consecrated this temple so that my Name may be there forever. My eyes and my heart will always be there.

source: Chule nangma thudol vang, napa David lamlhah banga kamasanga nalam lhah-a, Keiman kathupeh jouse dungjuija nabola, kachonna dan le kathutan lhah nanitna ahile;
target: “As for you, if you walk before me faithfully as David your father did, and do all I command, and observe my decrees and laws,

source: Nanga kona Israelte lah-a vaipo ding lhasam louding ahi, tia napa David toh kakitepna dungjuija nalenggam laltouna kaphudet ding ahi.
target: I will establish your royal throne, as I covenanted with David your father when I said, ‘You shall never fail to have a successor to rule over Israel.’

source: Ahinla nakihei manga, namasanga kakoi kachonna dan le kathupeh nadalhah-a, nache-a pathen dangho najena naga houva ahile;
target: “But if you turn away and forsake the decrees and commands I have given you and go off to serve other gods and worship them,

source: Chutengle amaho kanapeh gamsunga kona ajung ajaova kabodoh uva, kamin dinga kathenso hiche in hi kamitmu-a kona kapaidoh ding, namtin lah-a thuchih le seichah khatna kaum sah ding ahi.
target: then I will uproot Israel from my land, which I have given them, and will reject this temple I have consecrated for my Name. I will make it a byword and an object of ridicule among all peoples.

source: Chule hiche in sangtah hi ajotpa channin adatmoa; chutia chu amahon, Pakaiyin ibola hiche gam le hiche in hi ahitibol ham? atidiu ahi.
target: This temple will become a heap of rubble. All who pass by will be appalled and say, ‘Why has the Lord done such a thing to this land and to this temple?’

source: Amahon apu apateu Pakai Pathen, Egypt gama kona ahin puidohpao adalhah uva, pathen dangho akolchah uva, ahou uva chule ajenjeh uva; hijeh-a chu hitobang thilsehi achunguva alhunkhum sah ahi, tia adonbut dingu ahi.
target: People will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the Lord , the God of their ancestors, who brought them out of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—that is why he brought all this disaster on them.’ ”

source: Chuin Solomon'in Pakai in le ama in ding asahsung kum somni kichaijin ahitin ahi.
target: At the end of twenty years, during which Solomon built the temple of the Lord and his own palace,

source: Huram'in Solomon analepeh khopi chu Solomon'in asaphan, hia chun Israel chate chu achensahtan ahi.
target: Solomon rebuilt the villages that Hiram had given him, and settled Israelites in them.

source: Chuin Solomon Hamath-zobah satdin achen, agajou tan ahi.
target: Solomon then went to Hamath Zobah and captured it.

source: Chuin aman gamthipma Tadmor asan, Hamath'a thilkholna khopiho jouse asan ahi.
target: He also built up Tadmor in the desert and all the store cities he had built in Hamath.

source: Aman Beth-horon sahnung le Beth-horon lhangnung khopi kium kul, abangho, akotpiho, akotgolho pumin jong asan,
target: He rebuilt Upper Beth Horon and Lower Beth Horon as fortified cities, with walls and with gates and bars,

source: Chule Baalath le Solomon'in anei thil kholna khopi jouse, sakol kangtalai khopiho, sakol touthemho khopiho asan, chule Jerusalem le Labanon chule alenggam pumpi-a Solomon'in asah nom jouse chu asadohtan ahi.
target: as well as Baalath and all his store cities, and all the cities for his chariots and for his horses—whatever he desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon and throughout all the territory he ruled.

source: Israel hilou Hit mite, Amor mite, Perizz mite, Hiv mite, chule Jebus mite amoh chengse thudola,
