target: There were still people left from the Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites (these people were not Israelites).

source: Achateu gamsunga amaho nunga kidalha, Israel chaten asuhmang louhou chu Solomon'in tuni geijin kai apeh sah-in ahi.
target: Solomon conscripted the descendants of all these people remaining in the land—whom the Israelites had not destroyed—to serve as slave labor, as it is to this day.

source: Israel chate lah-a konin Solomon'in anatong soh alapon ahi; ahin amaho chu galbolin, gal lamkaijin, sakol kangtalai ho le sakol ho chunga lamkaijin apansahjon ahi.
target: But Solomon did not make slaves of the Israelites for his work; they were his fighting men, commanders of his captains, and commanders of his chariots and charioteers.

source: Hichehohi Solomon pipui lenho ahiuvin, mipi chunga vaihom mi jani le somngajen ahiuve.
target: They were also King Solomon’s chief officials—two hundred and fifty officials supervising the men.

source: Chuin Solomon'in Pharaoh chanu chu David khopi-a konin ama dinga asahpeh in lama apuitoutai. Ajehchu aman, Israel lengpa David in chu Pakai thingkhong lhunna muntheng ahijeh-in, ka-inneipi chengthei louding ahi, ati.
target: Solomon brought Pharaoh’s daughter up from the City of David to the palace he had built for her, for he said, “My wife must not live in the palace of David king of Israel, because the places the ark of the Lord has entered are holy.”

source: Chuin Solomon'in hongcha maija asem Pakai maicham chunga chun Pakai henga govam thilto atoh-in,
target: On the altar of the Lord that he had built in front of the portico, Solomon sacrificed burnt offerings to the Lord ,

source: Mosi thupeh dungjuija, niseh-a dia kibituh ngei bangin choldo nikho ho, lhathah niho, kumkhatna abineija kibol kut thumho; cholsolou changlhah kut, haptaho kut, chule Houbuh kutna atohjin ahi.
target: according to the daily requirement for offerings commanded by Moses for the Sabbaths, the New Moons and the three annual festivals—the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the Festival of Weeks and the Festival of Tabernacles.

source: Chuin apa David thupeh bangin, thempuho chu natong dingin aloi aloijin, Levi ho chu niseh-a angaichat dungjuija vahchoi dingle thempuho masanga lhachana tongding, Kotpi ngahho jouse jongchu kotpi jouse-a akihopkhen dungjui uvin mopohna apesoh keijin ahi; ajeh chu Pathen mipa David'in hitia hi ana thupeh ahi.
target: In keeping with the ordinance of his father David, he appointed the divisions of the priests for their duties, and the Levites to lead the praise and to assist the priests according to each day’s requirement. He also appointed the gatekeepers by divisions for the various gates, because this was what David the man of God had ordered.

source: Chule thempuho le Levi ho chu lengpan athupeh-a konin ipilam thu hihen, sumle pai lampang hijongle akiheimang pouvin ahi.
target: They did not deviate from the king’s commands to the priests or to the Levites in any matter, including that of the treasuries.

source: Tun Pakai inbul kiphu nikho-a pat le akijo theng nikho geija Solomon natoh jouse chu gontupsa ahi. Hitichun Pakai in chu achamkimin ahi.
target: All Solomon’s work was carried out, from the day the foundation of the temple of the Lord was laid until its completion. So the temple of the Lord was finished.

source: Chuin Solomon Edom gamsunga luipipanga um Ezion-geber le Eloth'a chun achen ahi.
target: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and Elath on the coast of Edom.

source: Chuin Huram'in asohte khut, twikhanglen umdan hethem asohteho khutnin kong inneiho ahin thotnin ahi. Chuin amaho Solomon sohte toh Ophir'a acheuvin, chua kon chun sana talent jali le somnga ahin laovin, Solomon lengpa heng ahinlhut taove.
target: And Hiram sent him ships commanded by his own men, sailors who knew the sea. These, with Solomon’s men, sailed to Ophir and brought back four hundred and fifty talents of gold, which they delivered to King Solomon.

source: Chuin Sheba lengnun Solomon kithan chu ajatan, aloi tampitah toh, gimnamtui ho le sana chule songmantam tampitah po-a sangongsang ho ahin puijin, thudoh hahsatah ho-a Solomon phochen dingin Jerusalem'a ahungin ahi. Chuin amanu Solomon heng ahunglhun phatnin, alungsunga umjouse akhedoh-in akihoupitai.
target: When the queen of Sheba heard of Solomon’s fame, she came to Jerusalem to test him with hard questions. Arriving with a very great caravan—with camels carrying spices, large quantities of gold, and precious stones—she came to Solomon and talked with him about all she had on her mind.

source: Chuin Solomon'in athudoh jouse ahilin: Solomon'a kona kisela amanu ahil lou khatcha aumpoi.
target: Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too hard for him to explain to her.

source: Chuin Sheba lengnun Solomon chihna le a-insah amuphatnin,
target: When the queen of Sheba saw the wisdom of Solomon, as well as the palace he had built,

source: Chule adokhanga anneh, asohte toudanho, alhachate kinboldan, akivonnao; chule akhon domho le akivonnao; chule Pakai in'a achetouna lampiho amuphatnin; alungthim abeihel jengtan ahi.
target: the food on his table, the seating of his officials, the attending servants in their robes, the cupbearers in their robes and the burnt offerings he made at the temple of the Lord , she was overwhelmed.

source: Chuin amanun lengpa jah-a, Kagam sunga nathilbol le nachihna thulhut kanajah chu anadih lheh-e.
target: She said to the king, “The report I heard in my own country about your achievements and your wisdom is true.

source: Ahinla kahunga kamittah-a kamu kahsen athu-u chu katahsan pon ahi: ven, na chihna loupi danhi akehkhat jong einakisei peh lou ahibouve: ajehchu naminthan na kanajah chu nakho khelin ahi.
target: But I did not believe what they said until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not even half the greatness of your wisdom was told me; you have far exceeded the report I heard.

source: Namite le hiche nasohte na ang sunga dingjinga nachihna thu jajingho hi anunnom ahiuve.
target: How happy your people must be! How happy your officials, who continually stand before you and hear your wisdom!

source: Pakai na Pathen'a dinga leng hidinga alaltouna tousah ding thanoma Pakai na Pathen chu nunnom hen: ajehchu na-Pathen'in tonsotna dinga tundoh dingin Israelte angailun, hiche jeh-a chu thudih le chonphatna boldinga achunguva lenga napansah ahi.
target: Praise be to the Lord your God, who has delighted in you and placed you on his throne as king to rule for the Lord your God. Because of the love of your God for Israel and his desire to uphold them forever, he has made you king over them, to maintain justice and righteousness.”

source: Chuin amanun lengpa chu sana talent jakhat le somni, gimnamtui tamtah toh, songmantam ho apen: Sheba lengnun Solomon lengpa apeh gimnamtui tobang khatcha aum khapoi.
target: Then she gave the king 120 talents of gold, large quantities of spices, and precious stones. There had never been such spices as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

source: Chule Ophir'a kona sana hinpo-a Huram sohte le Solomon sohten jong algum thinghole songmantam ho ahinpouvin ahi.
target: (The servants of Hiram and the servants of Solomon brought gold from Ophir; they also brought algumwood and precious stones.

source: Chuin lengpan algum thinga chun Pakai in le lengpa inpi kalbiho, lasaho selangdah le tumgingho asemin;chule hitobang chu masangin Judah gama ana kimu khapon ahi.
target: The king used the algumwood to make steps for the temple of the Lord and for the royal palace, and to make harps and lyres for the musicians. Nothing like them had ever been seen in Judah.)

source: Chule Solomon lengpan Sheba lengnu chu ama hinpoh tailouvin angaichatna athumjouse chu apen ahi. Hitichun amale asohte chu agamlama akileuvin achemang taove.
target: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired and asked for; he gave her more than she had brought to him. Then she left and returned with her retinue to her own country.

source: Tun kumkhat sunga Solomon henga sana hunglut chu sana talent jaguple somgup le gup ahin;
target: The weight of the gold that Solomon received yearly was 666 talents,

source: Hichu thiljohle sumkol veiho hinpoh simlouva ahi. Chule Arabia lengho jouse le gamsunga gamvaipoho jousen Solomon henga sana le dangka ahin popo jengun ahi.
target: not including the revenues brought in by merchants and traders. Also all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the territories brought gold and silver to Solomon.

source: Chuin Solomon lengpan sana kikhenglum jani asemin, sanalum khatna chu sana kikheng shekel jagup lutna ahi.
target: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of hammered gold went into each shield.

source: Chule sana-a kikheng lumdal jagup asemin, lumdal khatna chu sana shekel jathum lutna ahi. Chuin lengpan hicheho chu Lebanon gammang in'a chun akoije.
target: He also made three hundred small shields of hammered gold, with three hundred shekels of gold in each shield. The king put them in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon.

source: Chukalvalin lengpan Saiha laltouna lentah khat asemin, sana thengin aloijin ahi.
target: Then the king made a great throne covered with ivory and overlaid with pure gold.

source: Laltouna-a kaldohna ding chun kalbi gup aumin, akeng chu sana-a kisem ahin, hichu laltouna toh kikilmat ahi; touna alangtoa chun khut ngapna aum gelin, khut ngapna geija chun keipi bahkai ni adinge.
target: The throne had six steps, and a footstool of gold was attached to it. On both sides of the seat were armrests, with a lion standing beside each of them.

source: Chule kalbi gup alangtoa chun keipi bahkai somleni adingin; hitobanga kisem hi lenggam khatcha-a jong aumpon ahi.
target: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at either end of each step. Nothing like it had ever been made for any other kingdom.

source: Chule Solomon lengpa khonho jouse chu sana ngen ahin, chule Lebanon gammang in'a khonho jouse chu sana theng ngen ahi: dangka-a kisem khatcha aumpoi, Solomon khanglaijin hichu imachan akisimpoi.
target: All King Solomon’s goblets were gold, and all the household articles in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. Nothing was made of silver, because silver was considered of little value in Solomon’s day.

source: Ajehchu lengpa kong inneiho chu Huram sohte toh Tarshish'a chejiu ahin; Tarshish kong inneiho chun kumthum sehle khatvei sana, dangka, saiha chule vahong chalho ahinpohjiu ahi.
target: The king had a fleet of trading ships manned by Hiram’s servants. Once every three years it returned, carrying gold, silver and ivory, and apes and baboons.

source: Chule Solomon lengpan leiset lengho jouse chu haona le chihna-a akhelsoh keijin ahi.
target: King Solomon was greater in riches and wisdom than all the other kings of the earth.

source: Chule Pathen'in alungsunga akhumpeh chihna chu ngaidingin leiset lengho jousen Solomon umna chu ahin holhol jenguvin ahi.
target: All the kings of the earth sought audience with Solomon to hear the wisdom God had put in his heart.

source: Chule amitakipmin athilpeh diu dangka kongle belho, sana kongle belho, ponsil, galvon, gimnamtui ho, sakol ho, sanganho kumtin in abi neijin ahinpe jiuvin ahi.
target: Year after year, everyone who came brought a gift—articles of silver and gold, and robes, weapons and spices, and horses and mules.

source: Chule Solomon'in sakol le sakol kangtalai kholna in sangli aneijin, sakol touthem mi sangsom le sangni aneijin; amaho chu sakol kangtalai khopiho le lengpa heng Jerusalem'a aumsah-in ahi.
target: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.

source: Chule ama vadunga pat Philistinete le Egypt gamgi geijin lengho jouse chunga vai ahomin ahi.
target: He ruled over all the kings from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt.

source: Chule lengpan Jerusalem'a dangka chu songho abahsah-in, cedar thingho chu phaicham nemho-a tamtah keh theiba thingho abahsah jengin ahi.
target: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.

source: Chule amahon Egypt'a konle gamjousea konin sakol ho Solomon henga ahintol tol jengun ahi.
target: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from all other countries.

source: Tun Solomon thilbol dangho jouse, thusim abula pat ajona gei chu Nathan themgao lekhabu, Shilon mi Ahijah gaothu seina, Nebat chapa Jeroboam douna-a mitvahnei Iddo thilmuho-a chu kisun sohkeija hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Solomon’s reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the records of Nathan the prophet, in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat?

source: Solomon chu Jerusalem'a Israel pumpi chunga kum somli analeng change.
target: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

source: Chuin Solomon chu apu apatetoh alumkhom tan, apa David khopi-a avuitaove. Chuin ama khelin achapa Rehoboam alengchang tan ahi.
target: Then he rested with his ancestors and was buried in the city of David his father. And Rehoboam his son succeeded him as king.

source: Chuin Rehoboam Schechem'a achen ahi: ajehchu Shechem'a chu ama leng chansah dinga Israelte jouse hunga ahiuve.
target: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had gone there to make him king.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Solomon lengpa-a kona jam-a Egypt'a ga um Nebat chapa Jeroboam'in hichu ajah phatnin, Egypt'a konin Jerusalem'a ahung kiletai.
target: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard this (he was in Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon), he returned from Egypt.

source: Chuin akou dingin mi asolun ahi. Hitichun Jereboam le Israelte jouse Rehoboam henga hungun,
target: So they sent for Jeroboam, and he and all Israel went to Rehoboam and said to him:

source: Napan kanamkol jonu agihsah behseh-in ahi: hijeh chun tun napan kachunguva angap sohthalah natoh hahsa le anamkol gihtah hi jansah domin lang, keihon nangma jennung kate, atiuve.
target: “Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but now lighten the harsh labor and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you.”

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Nithum joule kahenga hungkit taovin ati. Chuin mipi apotdoh taove.
target: Rehoboam answered, “Come back to me in three days.” So the people went away.

source: Chuin Rehoboam'in apa Solomon hinlaija amasanga dingjing tehse ho chu adopmin, Hiche mipihohi donbutna dinga ipi thumop neipeh diuham? ati.
target: Then King Rehoboam consulted the elders who had served his father Solomon during his lifetime. “How would you advise me to answer these people?” he asked.

source: Chuin amahon ahenga, Hiche mipite hi nakhoto-a, nakipa sah-a, ahenguva thupha naseipeh-a ahile, a-itih-a nalhacha ding ahiuve, atiuve.
target: They replied, “If you will be kind to these people and please them and give them a favorable answer, they will always be your servants.”

source: Ahinla tehse hon athumopmu chu adondan, amatoh seilettha, amasanga dingjing khangdongho thumop chu alajon ahi.
target: But Rehoboam rejected the advice the elders gave him and consulted the young men who had grown up with him and were serving him.

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Napan kachunguva anangap namkol jonhi themkhat jansah domin tia kajah-a seija hiche mitekhu idonbut theinadiu ipi thuhil neinei uvem? ati.
target: He asked them, “What is your advice? How should we answer these people who say to me, ‘Lighten the yoke your father put on us’?”

source: Chuin amatoh seilettha khangdongho chun ahenga, Napan kanamkol jonu agihsah ahin, nangin vang themkhat beh jansah-in tia nahenga sei mipi chu hitin donbutnin, Kamechahi kapa kong sanga sajo ding ahi.
target: The young men who had grown up with him replied, “The people have said to you, ‘Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but make our yoke lighter.’ Now tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

source: Ajeh chu kapan namkol jon gihtah nachung uva angap ahin, keiman na namkoljon'u kabelap ding: kapan khaohola nanasuhgimu ahin, kenvang aipi-a kasuhgim ding nahiuve, tin seijin atiuve.
target: My father laid on you a heavy yoke; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions.’ ”

source: Hitichun lengpan, Nithum nile hungun anati bangchun, nithum nin Jeroboam le mipi ho jouse chu Rehoboam henga ahungtaovin ahi.
target: Three days later Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, as the king had said, “Come back to me in three days.”

source: Chuin lengpan amaho chu gumtah-in anadonbutnin; chule Rehoboam lengpan tehse ho thumop chu adon tapon,
target: The king answered them harshly. Rejecting the advice of the elders,

source: Khangthah ho thumop dungjuijin, Kapan na namkol jonu agihsah ahin, kenvang kabelap ding; kapan khaohola nasuhgimu ahin, kenvang aipiho-a kasuhgim ding nahiuve tin adonbut tai.
target: he followed the advice of the young men and said, “My father made your yoke heavy; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions.”

source: Hitichun lengpan mipi ho thu angaitapoi. Ajehchu Pakaiyin Shilon mi Ahijah amanchah-a, Nebat chapa Jeroboam henga anaseisa chu amolso theina dinga, hichu Pathen'in asosah ahitai.
target: So the king did not listen to the people, for this turn of events was from God, to fulfill the word the Lord had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah the Shilonite.

source: Chuin lengpan athu-u angai pehlou chu Israelte jousen amuphatnun, mipin lengpa chu adonbutnun, David'a chu ipi chan kaneijum? Jesse chapa-a chun goulo imacha kaneipouve. Vo Israel, amitakipmin naponbuh cheh-u kijot taovin: chule tun, David, na-insung kivettan, atiuve. Hitichun Israelte jouse aponbuh cheh-a achetauve.
target: When all Israel saw that the king refused to listen to them, they answered the king: “What share do we have in David, what part in Jesse’s son? To your tents, Israel! Look after your own house, David!” So all the Israelites went home.

source: Ahinla Judah gam khopiho-a cheng Israel chunga vang Rehoboam aleng changin ahi.
target: But as for the Israelites who were living in the towns of Judah, Rehoboam still ruled over them.

source: Chuin Rehoboam lengpan kai vaipopa Hadoram chu asolin ahile Israel chaten amachu songin asepmun, athitai. Ahinla Rehoboam lengpa chu Jerusalem'a jamdingin asakol kangtalai ja atoudoh loitan ahi.
target: King Rehoboam sent out Adoniram, who was in charge of forced labor, but the Israelites stoned him to death. King Rehoboam, however, managed to get into his chariot and escape to Jerusalem.

source: Hitichun Israel'in tugeijin David insung adoujing taovin ahi.
target: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.

source: Chuin Rehoboam Jerusalem'a ahung phatnin, lenggam chu Rehoboam henga puilut kit theina dinga Israelte satdin Judah le Benjamin insunga akilhengtum gal hatcheh mi sangsom le sangetjen akhomin ahi.
target: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mustered Judah and Benjamin—a hundred and eighty thousand able young men—to go to war against Israel and to regain the kingdom for Rehoboam.

source: Ahinla Pathen mipa Shemaiah henga chun Pakai thu ahung lhungin,
target: But this word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the man of God:

source: Judah lengpa Solomon chapa Rehoboam le Juda gama cheng Israelte le Benjamin mite jouse henga,
target: “Say to Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin,

source: Pakaiyin hitin ati, Nangho nachetou loudiu, nasopiteu jong nagasat loudiu ahi: amitakip na-in cheh-a kileuvin: hichehi keimabol ahi, tin seijin, gatin ati. Chuin Pakai thu chu angaijun, Jereboam satdinga achegot uva konin akih taove.
target: ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not go up to fight against your fellow Israelites. Go home, every one of you, for this is my doing.’ ” So they obeyed the words of the Lord and turned back from marching against Jeroboam.

source: Chuin Rehoboam Jerusalem'a achengin, Judah gamsunga chun kihuhdoh nading khopi Kul asadoh-in ahi.
target: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem and built up towns for defense in Judah:

source: Aman Bethlehem, Etam, chule Tekoa jengjong asadoh-in,
target: Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,

source: Beth-zur, Shoco, chule Adullam,
target: Beth Zur, Soko, Adullam,

source: Gath, Mareshah, chule Ziph,
target: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,

source: Adoraim, Lachish, chule Azekah,
target: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,

source: Zorah, Aijalon, chule Hebron asadoh-in, hichehohi Judah le Benjamin gama um kulpinei khopiho ahiuve.
target: Zorah, Aijalon and Hebron. These were fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin.

source: Kulho chu asudetnin, hicheho-a chun vaipo akoicheh-in, nehding le thao chule lengpitwi akholkhome.
target: He strengthened their defenses and put commanders in them, with supplies of food, olive oil and wine.

source: Chule khopi tina lumle tengcha ho akoicheh-in, dettah-in asemin, Judah le Benjamin chu ama lama pang ahi.
target: He put shields and spears in all the cities, and made them very strong. So Judah and Benjamin were his.

source: Chule Israel gamsung jouse-a thempuho le Levi ho jouse agamkai cheh uva konin ahenga ahunguve.
target: The priests and Levites from all their districts throughout Israel sided with him.

source: Ajehchu Jeroboam le achapaten Pakai dinga thempu na atoh naova kona ahaisah jeh uva, Levi ho chun agamule aumnao khopi kimvelse adalhah uva, Judah le Jerusalem'a hunguva ahi:
target: The Levites even abandoned their pasturelands and property and came to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had rejected them as priests of the Lord

source: Chule aman munsang ho-a ding, thilhaho-a ding, chule abongnou semho-a dinga thempuho akisuhdet ahitai.
target: when he appointed his own priests for the high places and for the goat and calf idols he had made.

source: Chule amaho nungchun Pakai Pathen holding lungput neija Israelte chu apu apateu Pakai Pathen henga ganlhaina boldingin Israel phung jouse-a konin Jerusalem'a ahunguvin ahi.
target: Those from every tribe of Israel who set their hearts on seeking the Lord , the God of Israel, followed the Levites to Jerusalem to offer sacrifices to the Lord , the God of their ancestors.

source: Chuti chun Judah lenggam chu asuhatnun, kumthum sung Solomon chapa Rehoboam chu ahatsah uvin ahi: ajehchu amahon kumthum sung David le Solomon lampi ajotnun ahi.
target: They strengthened the kingdom of Judah and supported Rehoboam son of Solomon three years, following the ways of David and Solomon during this time.

source: Chuin Rehoboam'in David chapa Jerimoth le Jesse chapa Eliab chanu Abihail chanu Mahalath chu aji dingin akipuijin ahi.
target: Rehoboam married Mahalath, who was the daughter of David’s son Jerimoth and of Abihail, the daughter of Jesse’s son Eliab.

source: Amachun chate, Jeush, Shemariah, chule Zaham ahinpeh-in ahi.
target: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah and Zaham.

source: Amanu nungin Absalom chanu Maachah akichenpin, amanun Abijah, Attai, Zizah, chule Shelomith ahinpeh-in ahi.
target: Then he married Maakah daughter of Absalom, who bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza and Shelomith.

source: Chule Rehoboam'in Absalom chanu Maachah chu ajite jousele athaikemho lah-a angailu pene, (ajehchu aman ji somleget le thaikem somgup akipuijin; chapa somni le get le chanu somgup anei ahi).
target: Rehoboam loved Maakah daughter of Absalom more than any of his other wives and concubines. In all, he had eighteen wives and sixty concubines, twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.

source: Chuin Rehoboam'in Maachah chapa Abijah chu lenga semding agotjeh-in, asopite lah-a vaipo pipen dingin akoijin ahi.
target: Rehoboam appointed Abijah son of Maakah as crown prince among his brothers, in order to make him king.

source: Aman chingthei tah-in abolin, achate jouse chu Judah le Benjamin gamjouse khopi kulpi nei tina athecheh-in, nehding nengchetnin apen ahi. Chule amaho dingin ji tamtah agonpeh-e.
target: He acted wisely, dispersing some of his sons throughout the districts of Judah and Benjamin, and to all the fortified cities. He gave them abundant provisions and took many wives for them.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Rehoboam'in lenggam atundoh-a, ama hattah-a akisahdoh phatnin, amale aumpi Israelte jousen Pakai danthupeh chu anungsun taove.
target: After Rehoboam’s position as king was established and he had become strong, he and all Israel with him abandoned the law of the Lord .

source: Chule ahitin ahi, amahon Pakai douna asuhkhel jeh uvin, Rehoboam lengchan kal kum nga lhina-in, Jerusalem satdingin Egypt lengpa Shishak chu ahung kontou tan,
target: Because they had been unfaithful to the Lord , Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem in the fifth year of King Rehoboam.

source: Sakol kangtalai sangkhat le jani le, sakol touthem sangsomgup toh ahung kontaovin: Egypt'a kona ahin kondohpi Lubim miho, Sukkiim miho, Ethiopia miho chu simjoulou ahiuve.
target: With twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen and the innumerable troops of Libyans, Sukkites and Cushites that came with him from Egypt,

source: Aman Judah gamsung kulpinei khopiho chu aban lah-in, Jerusalem'a ahungtai.
target: he captured the fortified cities of Judah and came as far as Jerusalem.

source: Chuin Shishak jeh-a Jerusalem'a kikhom Rehoboam le Judah pipuiho henga chun Shemaiah themgao chu ahungin, ajah uva, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Nanghon neinungsun taovin, hijeh-a chu kenjong Shishak khutna kadalhah-u nahitaove, tin Pakaiyin aseije, ati.
target: Then the prophet Shemaiah came to Rehoboam and to the leaders of Judah who had assembled in Jerusalem for fear of Shishak, and he said to them, “This is what the Lord says, ‘You have abandoned me; therefore, I now abandon you to Shishak.’ ”

source: Hichun Israel pipuiho le lengpa chu akineosah uvin, Pakai chu chonpha ahi atiuve.
target: The leaders of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said, “The Lord is just.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin akineosah-u chu amuphatnin, Shemai henga Pakai thuchu ahung lhungin, hitin aseije, Amaho akineosah taovin; hijeh chun sumang tapong ting, amavang akihoidoh nadiu themkhat kapeh ding ahi. Chule Shishak khutna kona Jerusalem chunga kalunghana kabuh lhah louding ahi.
target: When the Lord saw that they humbled themselves, this word of the Lord came to Shemaiah: “Since they have humbled themselves, I will not destroy them but will soon give them deliverance. My wrath will not be poured out on Jerusalem through Shishak.

source: Hijeng jongle keima kinbol le lenggam dangho kinbol ahetkhen theina diuva, amaho ama soh-a pangdiu ahi, ati.
target: They will, however, become subject to him, so that they may learn the difference between serving me and serving the kings of other lands.”

source: Hitichun Egypt lengpa Shishak'in Jerusalem ahungsatnin, Pakai in sunga gouho le leng in sunga gouho chu apomangin; aman Solomon'in anasem sana lumdal ho jong chu apomangtai.
target: When Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem, he carried off the treasures of the temple of the Lord and the treasures of the royal palace. He took everything, including the gold shields Solomon had made.

source: Hicheho khelchun Rehoboam lengpan sum-eng lumho akisemin, hiche chu leng in lutna kotngah vaipoho khutna akoitan ahi.
target: So King Rehoboam made bronze shields to replace them and assigned these to the commanders of the guard on duty at the entrance to the royal palace.

source: Chule lengpa Pakai in sunga alutji tengle kotngahpa chu hunga, agalahdoh jia, chule kotngah ho indan sunga akoilut kitji ahi.
target: Whenever the king went to the Lord ’s temple, the guards went with him, bearing the shields, and afterward they returned them to the guardroom.

source: Chuin ama akineosah phatnin, asuh manghel lounadin Pakai lunghanna chu ama-a konin akilehei tan; chule Judah gamsunga jong thil ache hoi tan ahi.
target: Because Rehoboam humbled himself, the Lord ’s anger turned from him, and he was not totally destroyed. Indeed, there was some good in Judah.

source: Hitichun Rehoboam lengpa chu Jerusalem'a akisuhat nin, lengvai apon ahi. Ajehchu Rehoboam alengchan patchu akum kum somli le kum khat ahitan, Pakaiyin amin umna dinga Israel phung jouse-a kona alhendoh khopi Jerusalem'a chun kum somlesagi lengvai apon ahi. Chule anu min chu Naamah ahin, Ammon mi ahi.
target: King Rehoboam established himself firmly in Jerusalem and continued as king. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel in which to put his Name. His mother’s name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite.

source: Chule Pakai holna dinga alungthim agontuplou jeh-in, thilse jeng abolin ahi.
target: He did evil because he had not set his heart on seeking the Lord .

source: Tun Rehoboam thilbol abula pat ajogei chu Shemaith themgao lekhabu le, mitvanei Iddo khanggui bu-a kisun hilouham? chule Rehoboam le Jereboam kah-a chun kidouna aumjom jingin ahi.
target: As for the events of Rehoboam’s reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the records of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer that deal with genealogies? There was continual warfare between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.

source: Chule Rehoboam chu apu apate toh alumkhomin, David khopi-a akivuitai: chule achapa Abijah chu ama khelin alengchang tai.
target: Rehoboam rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. And Abijah his son succeeded him as king.

source: Tun Jeroboam lengchan kum somle kumget lhin kum-in Judah gama Abijah alengchang panin ahi.
target: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam, Abijah became king of Judah,

source: Aman Jerusalem'a kumthum lengvai apon ahi. Anu min chu Michaiah ahin, Gibeah mi Uriel chanu ahi. Chule Jeroboam le Abijah kah-a gal ana umin ahi.
target: and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother’s name was Maakah, a daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

source: Chuin Abijah chu galsat dingin lhentum cheh sepai galsat mihangsan sangjali to akigol toh-in: Jeroboam'in jong lhentum cheh sepai galsat mihangsan sang jaget toh ama satdingin akigol toh-in ahi.
target: Abijah went into battle with an army of four hundred thousand able fighting men, and Jeroboam drew up a battle line against him with eight hundred thousand able troops.

source: Chuin Ehpraim molsanga um Zemaraim mol chunga Abijah adingin, Nangma Jeroboam le Israelte jousen kasei ngaijuvin;
target: Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim, in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, “Jeroboam and all Israel, listen to me!

source: Pakai Israel Pathen'in Israelte chunga lenggam hi David le achapate henga chi-a kitepna-a tonsotna dinga anapehsa ahi chu nahet diudol hilouham?
target: Don’t you know that the Lord , the God of Israel, has given the kingship of Israel to David and his descendants forever by a covenant of salt?

source: Hijongle David chapa Solomon sohpa Nebat chapa Jeroboam chu akipatdoh-in, a-pakaipa dounan akiphintan ahi.
target: Yet Jeroboam son of Nebat, an official of Solomon son of David, rebelled against his master.

source: Chule ama henga chun pannabei ho, Belial chate akikhomun, Rehoboam chu khangdong cha le lungthim nemhiuheo ahi-a amaho doudal thei ahilou petchun, Solomon chapa Rehoboam dounan akisuhat nun ahi.
target: Some worthless scoundrels gathered around him and opposed Rehoboam son of Solomon when he was young and indecisive and not strong enough to resist them.

source: Chule tun nanghon David chapate khutna um Pakai lenggam chu doudal dingin nangaitou vin; chule nangho mihonpi tamtah nahiuvin, Jeroboam'in pathenho dinga anasempeh-u sana bongnouho chu nangho toh aumkhomin ahi.
target: “And now you plan to resist the kingdom of the Lord , which is in the hands of David’s descendants. You are indeed a vast army and have with you the golden calves that Jeroboam made to be your gods.

source: Nanghon bongchal khat le kelngoichal sagi-a kisutheng dinga hungchan chu pathen hilouho thempu ahithei nadinga; Pakai thempuho, Aaron chapate le Levi ho nanodoh uva, gamdang namho chona banga thempu nakisem thu-u hilouham?
target: But didn’t you drive out the priests of the Lord , the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and make priests of your own as the peoples of other lands do? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may become a priest of what are not gods.

source: Keiho din vang Pakai chu ka Pathen'u ahin, ama chu kanungsun pouve; chule Pakai kinbol thempuho chu Aaron chapate ahiuvin, chule Levi hon amaho kin abol jingun ahi.
target: “As for us, the Lord is our God, and we have not forsaken him. The priests who serve the Lord are sons of Aaron, and the Levites assist them.

source: Chule amahon jingkah nilhah sehle Pakai henga govam ganlhaina le gimnamtui ahaljiuvin; vetsahna changlhah jong chu dokhang theng chunga atoh jiuvin; chule nilhah seh-a halding sana meivah khomle chua meivah pumin akoitoh jiuvin ahi. Ajehchu keihon Pakai i-Pathen'u thupeh kanit jingu ahin; nanghon vang ama nanungsun taove.
target: Every morning and evening they present burnt offerings and fragrant incense to the Lord . They set out the bread on the ceremonially clean table and light the lamps on the gold lampstand every evening. We are observing the requirements of the Lord our God. But you have forsaken him.

source: Chule veuvin, Pathen amatah chun eilamkai hidingin eiumpiuvin, chule athempuho jong nangho douna gal sumkon mutdingin aumjinguve. Vo Israel chate, napu napateu Pakai Pathen'u chu kisatpi hih-un; ajehchu najolou dingu ahi, ati.
target: God is with us; he is our leader. His priests with their trumpets will sound the battle cry against you. People of Israel, do not fight against the Lord , the God of your ancestors, for you will not succeed.”

source: Ahinla Jeroboam'in anunglam uva kona hinbulu ding asolin ahi: hitichun amaho Judah te masanga aumun, chule ahin bulu dingho chu anunglam uva aumun ahi.
target: Now Jeroboam had sent troops around to the rear, so that while he was in front of Judah the ambush was behind them.

source: Chuin Judah ten akinung heijuva ahile, veuvin, gal chu anung ama uva aumtan ahi: Chuin Pakai henga ataovun, chule thempuhon sumkon amutnun ahi.
target: Judah turned and saw that they were being attacked at both front and rear. Then they cried out to the Lord . The priests blew their trumpets

source: Chuin Judah mite a-aovun: chule Judah mite hatah a a-ao phatnun ahitin ahi, Pathen'in Jeroboam le Israelte jouse chu Abijah le Judah te masanga agal lelsah tan ahi.
target: and the men of Judah raised the battle cry. At the sound of their battle cry, God routed Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

source: Chuin Israelte chu Judah masanga ajamtaovin; Pathen'in amaho chu akhutnuvah apedoh tai.
target: The Israelites fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hands.

source: Chuin Abijah le amiten amaho chu atamatam athat taovin: hitichun hikoma chun Israel mite chu lhentum cheh sangjanga athiuvin ahi.
target: Abijah and his troops inflicted heavy losses on them, so that there were five hundred thousand casualties among Israel’s able men.

source: Hitichun chuche chunga chun Israel chate chu suhnemin aumun, Judah chate chun apu apateu Pakai Pathen chunga akingai jeh-un ajoutaovin ahi.
target: The Israelites were subdued on that occasion, and the people of Judah were victorious because they relied on the Lord , the God of their ancestors.

source: Chuin Abijah'in Jeroboam anungdelin, ama-a konin khopi phabep alan, Bethel chu akholenho pumin, Jeshanah chu akholenho pumin, chule Ehpraim chu akholenho pumin alatan ahi.
target: Abijah pursued Jeroboam and took from him the towns of Bethel, Jeshanah and Ephron, with their surrounding villages.

source: Abijah nikho laijin Jeroboam chu ahatdohjou tapon ahi: chuin Pakaiyin adengin, athitai.
target: Jeroboam did not regain power during the time of Abijah. And the Lord struck him down and he died.

source: Abijah vang ahat cheh cheh-in, ji somleli aneijin, chapa somnileni toh chanu somgup ahingin ahi.
target: But Abijah grew in strength. He married fourteen wives and had twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

source: Abijah thilbol adangse le alamlhah ho, chule athuseiho chu Iddo themgao thusima kisun cheh ahi.
target: The other events of Abijah’s reign, what he did and what he said, are written in the annotations of the prophet Iddo.

source: Hitichun Abijah apu apatetoh alumkhomin, David khopi-a avuijun: chule achapa Asa ama khelin alengchang tan ahi. Ama nikholaijin gamsung chu kum som galmongin aumuvin ahi.
target: And Abijah rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. Asa his son succeeded him as king, and in his days the country was at peace for ten years.

source: Chule Asa'in Pakai a-Pathen mitmun apha le adih jeng abolin ahi.
target: Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the Lord his God.

source: Ajeh chu aman gamdang pathenho maicham ho le munsang ho aladoh-in, milimho avobongin, Asherah limho aphuh lhun:
target: He removed the foreign altars and the high places, smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles.

source: Judah te chun apu apao Pakai Pathen aholuva, adanthu le athupeh anit dingun athupeh-in ahi.
target: He commanded Judah to seek the Lord , the God of their ancestors, and to obey his laws and commands.

source: Aman Judah te khopiho jouse-a konin munsanghole milimho alamangin; lenggam chu ama noija galmongin aumin ahi.
target: He removed the high places and incense altars in every town in Judah, and the kingdom was at peace under him.

source: Aman Judah gamsunga chun khopi kulneiho asan ahi: ijeh inem itile gamsungin choldona amun, chule chuche kumho-a chun aman gal aneipon ahi: ajehchu Pakaiyin choldona apeh ahi.
target: He built up the fortified cities of Judah, since the land was at peace. No one was at war with him during those years, for the Lord gave him rest.

source: Hijeh chun aman Judah te henga, Gamhi imasanguva aumpetnin, hiche khopiho hi saohitin, akimveluvah kulbangho, insangho, kotpiho, chule kotgolho semuhite; ajehchu eihon Pakai i-Pathen'u iholun, eihon ama iholun chule aman ningjouse-a choldona eipeuvin ahi, ati. Hitichun amahon asaovin, akhangtou lheh-un ahi.
target: “Let us build up these towns,” he said to Judah, “and put walls around them, with towers, gates and bars. The land is still ours, because we have sought the Lord our God; we sought him and he has given us rest on every side.” So they built and prospered.

source: Chule Asa'n Judah'a konin thih khutbu le tengcha choi cheh galsat mi sangsomthum aneijin, Benjamin'a kona lum le thal thocheh mi sangjani le somget aneijin: amaho mihat mihangsan cheh ahiuve.
target: Asa had an army of three hundred thousand men from Judah, equipped with large shields and with spears, and two hundred and eighty thousand from Benjamin, armed with small shields and with bows. All these were brave fighting men.

source: Chuin Ethiopia mi Zerah chu amaho satdin galmi janel asang asangto, sakol kangtalai jathum toh ahung kondoh-in; Mareshah'a ahungun ahi.
target: Zerah the Cushite marched out against them with an army of thousands upon thousands and three hundred chariots, and came as far as Mareshah.

source: Chuin Asa ama satdin ahung kondoh-in, Maresha'a um Zephathah phaichama chun galsat dingin akigoltoh taove.
target: Asa went out to meet him, and they took up battle positions in the Valley of Zephathah near Mareshah.

source: Chuin Asa'n Pakai a-Pathen akouvin, Pakai, nangman napanpi ding chu mi tamtah manchah ding hihen, ahiloule thanei louho manchah ding hijongle imacha ahichom poi: vo Pakai ka Pathen'u, neipanpi uvin; ajehchu nanga kingai kahiuvin, namina mihonpi hi satdinga che kahiuve. Vo Pakai, nangma ka Pathen'u nahi: mihemin najouhih helhen, ati.
target: Then Asa called to the Lord his God and said, “ Lord , there is no one like you to help the powerless against the mighty. Help us, Lord our God, for we rely on you, and in your name we have come against this vast army. Lord , you are our God; do not let mere mortals prevail against you.”

source: Hitichun Pakaiyin Asa le Judah te masanga Ethiopia mite chu ajouvin; Ethiopia mite ajamtaove.
target: The Lord struck down the Cushites before Asa and Judah. The Cushites fled,

source: Chuin Asa le aumpi mipi chun amaho chu Gerar geijin adelun: Ethiopia mite chu ajoutaovin, hitichun amaho akidodoh jou tapouve; ajehchu Pakai le ajanel angsunga gallel ahitaove; chuin amahon galthil kichom tamtah ahinkipoh mangun ahi.
target: and Asa and his army pursued them as far as Gerar. Such a great number of Cushites fell that they could not recover; they were crushed before the Lord and his forces. The men of Judah carried off a large amount of plunder.

source: Chuin amahon Gerar kimvela khopi jouse asumangun ahi; ajehchu achunguva Pakai ginna hung chu-a ahitai: chule amahon khopi jouse achomun ahi: ajehchu hiche ho sunga chu galthilchom tamtah uma ahi.
target: They destroyed all the villages around Gerar, for the terror of the Lord had fallen on them. They looted all these villages, since there was much plunder there.

source: Amahon ganchaho ponbuh ho jong asumangun, kelngoiho le sangongsang ho tampitah akikaimangun, Jerusalem'a ahung kile taove.
target: They also attacked the camps of the herders and carried off droves of sheep and goats and camels. Then they returned to Jerusalem.

source: Chuin Oded chapa Azariah chunga Pathen lhagao ahungchun:
target: The Spirit of God came on Azariah son of Oded.

source: Asa kimupi din achen, ahenga, Asa, Judah te chule Benjamin miten kathusei ngaijun; amatoh naum khom lai seuvin, Pakaiyin na-umpive; nanghon ama nahol uva ahileh ama namu dingu; amavang nanungsun uva ahile, aman jong nangho nanungsun dingu ahi.
target: He went out to meet Asa and said to him, “Listen to me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin. The Lord is with you when you are with him. If you seek him, he will be found by you, but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.

source: Tun Israel hi phat sottah Pathen dih bei le, mihil ding thempu bei, chule dan bei anahiuvin ahi.
target: For a long time Israel was without the true God, without a priest to teach and without the law.

source: Ahinla amaho alungdon uva Israel Pakai Pathen henga akileuva, ama aholuva ahile, ama amu jiuvin ahi.
target: But in their distress they turned to the Lord , the God of Israel, and sought him, and he was found by them.

source: Chule hichelai chun vaikonpa ahiloule vailhungpa din chamna anaumpon, gamsunga cheng jouse chunga gentheina nasatah anaumjon ahi.
target: In those days it was not safe to travel about, for all the inhabitants of the lands were in great turmoil.

source: Pathen'in vangsetna jouse-a asuhgenthei jeh-un, namkhat le namkhat, khopi khat le khopi khat akisumang touvin ahi.
target: One nation was being crushed by another and one city by another, because God was troubling them with every kind of distress.

source: Hijeh chun hatnunlang nakhut thau lhomsah hih-un; ajehchu nanatoh-u tohman kipe ding nahiuve, ati.
target: But as for you, be strong and do not give up, for your work will be rewarded.”

source: Chuin Asan hiche thuho le Oded themgao thusei ajah phatnin, ahangsan chehtan, Judah le Benjamin gamsung jouse-a kon le Ephraim molsanga kona akhopi lah ho-a konin kidah umtah milim jouse akoimangin, Pakai hongcha maija um Pakai maicham chu asemphan ahi.
target: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Azariah son of Oded the prophet, he took courage. He removed the detestable idols from the whole land of Judah and Benjamin and from the towns he had captured in the hills of Ephraim. He repaired the altar of the Lord that was in front of the portico of the Lord ’s temple.

source: Chuin aman Judah mite le Benjamin mite jouse, chule Ephraim, Manasseh le, Simeon'a kon amaho umpi gamdang miho jouse akhom khomin ahi. Ajehchu Pakai a-Pathen'in aumpi amuphatnuva, Israel'a konin mi tamtah-in ama ahinbelu ahitai.
target: Then he assembled all Judah and Benjamin and the people from Ephraim, Manasseh and Simeon who had settled among them, for large numbers had come over to him from Israel when they saw that the Lord his God was with him.

source: Hitichun Asa lengchan kal kum somle kumnga na, alhathum lhina-in amahole amaho Jerusalem'a akikhom khom taovin ahi.
target: They assembled at Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.

source: Chule hiche chunga chun amahon Pakai henga galthila ahin chomhou lah-a konin bongchal jasagi le kelngoi sangsagi atoh-un ahi.
target: At that time they sacrificed to the Lord seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep and goats from the plunder they had brought back.

source: Chuin amahon alungthim pumpiu le ahinna pumpiuva apu apateu Pakai Pathen hol dingin kitepna aneijuvin;
target: They entered into a covenant to seek the Lord , the God of their ancestors, with all their heart and soul.

source: Hitichun alen hihen aneo hileh, numei hihen pasal hijongle, Pakai Israel Pathen hollou chanchu kithat ding ahi atiuve.
target: All who would not seek the Lord , the God of Israel, were to be put to death, whether small or great, man or woman.

source: Chuin Pakai henga awsang tah-in, sumkon le sumkon binei mutpum in akihahselun ahi.
target: They took an oath to the Lord with loud acclamation, with shouting and with trumpets and horns.

source: Chule Judah te jouse chu kihahsel na-a chun akipah uvin ahi; ajehchu alung pumpiuva kihahsel uva, angaichat nao pumpi-a aholu ahin; amachu amuvin ahi: chuin Pakaiyin akimveluvah choldona apeuvin ahi.
target: All Judah rejoiced about the oath because they had sworn it wholeheartedly. They sought God eagerly, and he was found by them. So the Lord gave them rest on every side.

source: Chujongle Asa lengpa nu Maachah thudola, amanun Asherah lim anakisem jeh-in, lengnu ahina-a konin akoidohtai: chule Asa'n amilim chu aphuh lhun, achon goijin, Kidron vadunga ahal lhatai.
target: King Asa also deposed his grandmother Maakah from her position as queen mother, because she had made a repulsive image for the worship of Asherah. Asa cut it down, broke it up and burned it in the Kidron Valley.

source: Ahinla Israel'a konin munsang ho chu akilamangpon: hijeng jongle Asa lungthim vangchu ahinkho lhumkeijin achamkimin ahi.
target: Although he did not remove the high places from Israel, Asa’s heart was fully committed to the Lord all his life.

source: Chule aman Pathen insunga chun apa thensosa thilho le amatah in athensosa thilho, dangka, sana chule umle belho chu ahin polutnin ahi.
target: He brought into the temple of God the silver and gold and the articles that he and his father had dedicated.

source: Chule Asa lengchan kum somthum le kumnga sungchun gal aumkit tapon ahi.
target: There was no more war until the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.

source: Asa lengchan kal kum somthum le kumgup kum-in, Judah lengpa Asa henga koimacha alut le apot aum louhel nading gelnan Israel lengpa Baasha chu Judah satdin ahungtouvin, Ramah chu asadohtan ahi.
target: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa’s reign Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah.

source: Hichun Asa'n Pakai in'a konle leng in goukholna in'a konin dangka le sana aladoh-in, Damascus'a cheng Syria lengpa Banhadad agah thotnin, ahenga,
target: Asa then took the silver and gold out of the treasuries of the Lord ’s temple and of his own palace and sent it to Ben-Hadad king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus.

source: Kapa le napa kah-a anaum bangin keima le nang kah-a kitepna aumin ahi: ven, dangka le sana kahin thotne; chen, ama keija kona apotdohna dingin, Baasha toh nakitepna lhon gasukehtan, ati.
target: “Let there be a treaty between me and you,” he said, “as there was between my father and your father. See, I am sending you silver and gold. Now break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel so he will withdraw from me.”

source: Chuin Benhadad'in Asa lengpa thu angaijin, agalsat lamkaiho chu Israel khopiho satdin asolin; amahon Ijon, Dan, Abel-maim le Naphtali thilkholna khopiho jouse agajou taove.
target: Ben-Hadad agreed with King Asa and sent the commanders of his forces against the towns of Israel. They conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim and all the store cities of Naphtali.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Baasha'n hichu ajah phatnin, Ramah asah chu adalhan, anatoh atansahtai.
target: When Baasha heard this, he stopped building Ramah and abandoned his work.

source: Chuin Asa lengpan Judah te jouse apuijin, amahon Baasha'in amanchah Ramah songho jouse le thingho chu apomangun, hicheho-a chun Geba le Mizpeh asadohtan ahi.
target: Then King Asa brought all the men of Judah, and they carried away from Ramah the stones and timber Baasha had been using. With them he built up Geba and Mizpah.

source: Hichelai chun mitvahnei Hanani chu Judah lengpa Asa henga ahungin, ahenga, Nangma Pakai na Pathen'a kingai louva Syria lengpa-a nakingai jeh-in, Syria lengpa sepai janel chu nakhutna konin ahoidoh taovin ahi.
target: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah and said to him: “Because you relied on the king of Aram and not on the Lord your God, the army of the king of Aram has escaped from your hand.

source: Ethiopia mite le Lubim mite chu sakol kangtalai tamtah le sakol touthem tamtah janel mihonpi hilouvu ham? ahivangin Pakaiya nakingai jeh-in aman amaho nakhutna apedoh-in ahi.
target: Were not the Cushites and Libyans a mighty army with great numbers of chariots and horsemen? Yet when you relied on the Lord , he delivered them into your hand.

source: Ajehchu ama lama alungthim chamkimho henga amaho khela ahatna musah dinga Pakai mit chu leiset pumpi-a suhletunga lhailele-a ahi. Hichea hin nangman ngolhoi tah-in thil naboltai: hijeh-a chu tua patna gal nanei jingding ahitai, ati.
target: For the eyes of the Lord range throughout the earth to strengthen those whose hearts are fully committed to him. You have done a foolish thing, and from now on you will be at war.”

source: Chuphatnin mitvah neipa chunga Asa alunghangin, songkul'a akhumtai; ajehchu hiche thilho jeh-a chu achunga alungsalheh jenga ahi. Chule hiche laichun Asa'n mi phabep asugentheijin ahi.
target: Asa was angry with the seer because of this; he was so enraged that he put him in prison. At the same time Asa brutally oppressed some of the people.

source: Chule vetan, Asa thilbol amasale anunung chu, vetan, Judah le Israel lengho lekhabua akisunlut cheh-in ahi.
target: The events of Asa’s reign, from beginning to end, are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

source: Chule Asa lengchan kal kum somthum le kumko lhin kum-in akenga natna aneitan; ahanat kikhon geijin anatan: ahinla anatna-a chun Pakai hollouvin louthem ho joh anaholin ahi.
target: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign Asa was afflicted with a disease in his feet. Though his disease was severe, even in his illness he did not seek help from the Lord , but only from the physicians.

source: Chuin Asa apu apate toh alumkhomin, alengchan kal kum somli le kumkhat lhina-in athitan ahi.
target: Then in the forty-first year of his reign Asa died and rested with his ancestors.

source: Chuin amahon aman David khopisunga anakisem lhansunga avuijun, gimnamtui semhon gimnamtui jat chomchom agonu dimset jalkhuna chun alupsah taove. Chule amahon ama dingin meikong deojejun atih-un ahi.
target: They buried him in the tomb that he had cut out for himself in the City of David. They laid him on a bier covered with spices and various blended perfumes, and they made a huge fire in his honor.

source: Chuin achapa Jehoshaphat ama khelin aleng changin, Israelte dounan akisuhat nin ahi.
target: Jehoshaphat his son succeeded him as king and strengthened himself against Israel.

source: Aman Judah gamsunga kulbang nei khopiho jouse-a galsatmi akoijin, Judah gamsung le apa Asan analahsa Ephraim khopiho-a sepaihon akoicheh-in ahi.
target: He stationed troops in all the fortified cities of Judah and put garrisons in Judah and in the towns of Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.

source: Pakaiyin Jehosaphat aumpin ahi; ajehchu aman apa David lampi masa chu ajotnin, Baalim ahol pon;
target: The Lord was with Jehoshaphat because he followed the ways of his father David before him. He did not consult the Baals

source: Pakai apa Pathen joh aholin, ama thupeh ho-a chun achonnin, Israelte chonna bangin achonpon ahi.
target: but sought the God of his father and followed his commands rather than the practices of Israel.

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin lenggam chu akhutna asudetnin; Judah te jousen Jehosaphat henga thilpeh ahinchoijun, chule aman haona le jabolna bulhing setnin aneije.
target: The Lord established the kingdom under his control; and all Judah brought gifts to Jehoshaphat, so that he had great wealth and honor.

source: Alungthim Pakai lampiho-a achoisangin; achungchonin jong Judah gamsunga konin mun sanghole Asherah limho alamangin ahi.
target: His heart was devoted to the ways of the Lord ; furthermore, he removed the high places and the Asherah poles from Judah.

source: Alengchan kumthum na-a jongchun Judah gamsung khopiho-a cheng miho hildingin amilenho Benhail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethaneel chule Michaiah asolle.
target: In the third year of his reign he sent his officials Ben-Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel and Micaiah to teach in the towns of Judah.

source: Chule aman amaho chutoh Levi miho, Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, Tob-adonijah, chule amahotoh Elishama le Jehoram thempu teni asoltan ahi.
target: With them were certain Levites—Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah and Tob-Adonijah—and the priests Elishama and Jehoram.

source: Amahon Judah gamsunga ahilun, Pakai danthu lekhabu chu akikenun, Judah gamsung khopiho jouse achonchan sohkeijun, mipichu ahil leuvin ahi.
target: They taught throughout Judah, taking with them the Book of the Law of the Lord ; they went around to all the towns of Judah and taught the people.

source: Chuin Judah gamkimvela um lenggam ho jouse chunga chun Pakai kichatna achutan, hitichun amahon Jehosaphat dounan gal abol pouvin ahi.
target: The fear of the Lord fell on all the kingdoms of the lands surrounding Judah, so that they did not go to war against Jehoshaphat.

source: Chule Philistine mite phabepmin jong Jehosaphat chu thilpeh le dangka kai apeuvin; chule Arab mihon kelngoi hon sangsagi le jasagi toh kelchal jasagi ahin peuvin ahi.
target: Some Philistines brought Jehoshaphat gifts and silver as tribute, and the Arabs brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred goats.

source: Chuin Jehosaphat chu nasatah-in aloupitan; Judah gamsunga kulpiho le thilkholna khopiho asadoh-in ahi.
target: Jehoshaphat became more and more powerful; he built forts and store cities in Judah

source: Chule aman Judah gamsung khopiho-a chun natoh tamtah aneijin: galbolmiho le mihat mihangsan ho chu Jerusalem'a aumun ahi.
target: and had large supplies in the towns of Judah. He also kept experienced fighting men in Jerusalem.

source: Chule hichehohi apu apateu insung kailhah dungjuija ajatnu chu ahi: Judah insunga sang gal lamkaiho pipui chu Adnah ahin; chule amatoh umkhom mihat mihangsan hochu sangjathum ahiuve.
target: Their enrollment by families was as follows: From Judah, commanders of units of 1,000: Adnah the commander, with 300,000 fighting men;

source: Chule ama bana chu gallamkai Jehohanan ahin, ama tohin mi sangjani leh sangsomget aumkhomin ahi.
target: next, Jehohanan the commander, with 280,000;

source: Ama bana chu ama le ama kiphal tah-a Pakai henga kipe Zichri chapa Amasiah ahin; ama tohin mihat mihangsan sangjani aumkhomin ahi.
target: next, Amasiah son of Zikri, who volunteered himself for the service of the Lord , with 200,000.

source: Chule Benjamin'a konin mihat mihangsan Eliada ahin, ama tohin thal le lum thothei mi sangjani aumkhomin ahi.
target: From Benjamin: Eliada, a valiant soldier, with 200,000 men armed with bows and shields;

source: Chule abana chu Jehozabad ahin, ama tohin galkap dinga kigosadem mi sangjakhat le sangsomget aumkhomin ahi.
target: next, Jehozabad, with 180,000 men armed for battle.

source: Hicheho hi Judah gamsung pumpi-a kulbang nei khopiho sunga lengpan akoiho simlouva lengpa ngahho chu ahiuve.
target: These were the men who served the king, besides those he stationed in the fortified cities throughout Judah.

source: Tun Jehoshaphat chu haona le jabolna nasatah achangtan, chule Ahab toh kiguijopna aneitan ahi.
target: Now Jehoshaphat had great wealth and honor, and he allied himself with Ahab by marriage.

source: Chuin kum ijat-ham jouvin Ahab henga Samaria'a achesuh-in ahi. Chuin Ahab'in amale alhonpiho chu kelngoi le bongchal nengchetnin athapeh-in, Ramoth-gilead'a kilhon toupi din ajolin ahi.
target: Some years later he went down to see Ahab in Samaria. Ahab slaughtered many sheep and cattle for him and the people with him and urged him to attack Ramoth Gilead.

source: Chuin Israel lengpa Ahab'in Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat henga, Ramoth-gilead'a neilhonpi dingham? ati. Chuin aman adonbutnin, Keima nangma tobang kahin, kamite jong namite tobang ahi; galchu sat hu nao vinge, ati.
target: Ahab king of Israel asked Jehoshaphat king of Judah, “Will you go with me against Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat replied, “I am as you are, and my people as your people; we will join you in the war.”

source: Chuin Jehoshaphat'in Israel lengpa jah-a, Katao ahi, tuni hin Pakai thu doptadin, ati.
target: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, “First seek the counsel of the Lord .”

source: Hijeh chun Israel lengpan themgaoho mi jali jen akhomin, ajah uva, Ramoth-gilead'a galsatna kakon diuham, ahiloule kahaidiu ham? ati. Chuin amahon, Kontaovin; ajehchu Pathen'in lengpa khutna apehdoh dingu ahi, atiuve.
target: So the king of Israel brought together the prophets—four hundred men—and asked them, “Shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I not?” “Go,” they answered, “for God will give it into the king’s hand.”

source: Ahinla Jehoshaphat'in, Hicheho tilouva hi eihon idop theidiu Pakai themgao umlouva hitam? ati.
target: But Jehoshaphat asked, “Is there no longer a prophet of the Lord here whom we can inquire of?”

source: Chuin Israel lengpan Jehoshaphat jah-a, Eihon Pakai thu idopna theidiu mi khat aum nalainai: ahinla keiman ama kahon ahi; ajehchu aman thilphalou tilou apha eigaopeh ngaipoi: amachu Imla chapa Micaiah ahi, ati. Chuin Jehoshaphat'in, Lengpan hiti chun thu seihih-in, ati.
target: The king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, “There is still one prophet through whom we can inquire of the Lord , but I hate him because he never prophesies anything good about me, but always bad. He is Micaiah son of Imlah.” “The king should not say such a thing,” Jehoshaphat replied.

source: Chuin Israel lengpan lamkaiho khat akouvin, Imla chapa Micaiah chu kintah-in gakouvin, ati.
target: So the king of Israel called one of his officials and said, “Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once.”

source: Chuin Israel lengpa le Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat chu Samaria lutna kotpi bul mun onglaija lengvon pumin alaltouna gella atou lhonin; a-angsung lhona chun themgaoho chun gaothu aseijun ahi.
target: Dressed in their royal robes, the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting on their thrones at the threshing floor by the entrance of the gate of Samaria, with all the prophets prophesying before them.

source: Chuin Chenaanah chapa Zedekiah chun thih sakiho akisemin, Hicheho-a hi Syria mite chu amanhel tokah seova nano ding ahi tin Pakaiyin aseije, ati.
target: Now Zedekiah son of Kenaanah had made iron horns, and he declared, “This is what the Lord says: ‘With these you will gore the Arameans until they are destroyed.’ ”

source: Chuti chun themgao jouse chun chutima chun gaothu aseijun, Ramoth-gilead'a chetouvin lang galo lhingin: ajehchu Pakaiyin hichu lengpa khutna apehdoh ding ahi, atiuve.
target: All the other prophets were prophesying the same thing. “Attack Ramoth Gilead and be victorious,” they said, “for the Lord will give it into the king’s hand.”

source: Chuin Micaiah kou-a che sottol chun ajah-a, Ven, lengpa henga themgaoho chun kitohtah-in aphalam aseijuve; katao ahi, nathu chu amaho-a tobangin hihen, chule apha seijin, ati.
target: The messenger who had gone to summon Micaiah said to him, “Look, the other prophets without exception are predicting success for the king. Let your word agree with theirs, and speak favorably.”

source: Chuin Micaiah'in, Pakai hingjing min pana kasei ahi, Ka-Pathen'in asei sei bouchu keiman kaseiding ahi, ati.
target: But Micaiah said, “As surely as the Lord lives, I can tell him only what my God says.”

source: Chuin ama lengpa henga ahung phatnin, lengpan ajah-a, Micaiah, Ramoth-gilead'a galbola kakon diuham, ahiloule kahaisah diham? ati. Chuin aman, Kontou vunlang galo lhingun, amaho chu nakhutna kipedoh ding ahi, ati.
target: When he arrived, the king asked him, “Micaiah, shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I not?” “Attack and be victorious,” he answered, “for they will be given into your hand.”

source: Chuin lengpan ajah-a, Pakai mina thutah tailou imacha dang seilou dinga ijatvei kaki hahsel sah ding nahim? ati.
target: The king said to him, “How many times must I make you swear to tell me nothing but the truth in the name of the Lord ?”

source: Chuin aman, Israelte molsang chungho-a achingbei kelngoi banga akithecheh-u kamui: chule Pakaiyin, Hiche hohin lamkai anei tapouve; hijeh chun amitakip a-incheh-a lung mongin kiletaohen atie, ati.
target: Then Micaiah answered, “I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd, and the Lord said, ‘These people have no master. Let each one go home in peace.’ ”

source: Chuin Israel lengpan Jehoshaphat henga, Aman thilse tailou apha eigaopeh ponte tia kasei hilouham?
target: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he never prophesies anything good about me, but only bad?”

source: Chule Micaiah'in aseiben, Pakai thu ngaijun; Pakai alaltouna-a atouva, ajetle veija vanmi janel jouse adinnu kamui.
target: Micaiah continued, “Therefore hear the word of the Lord : I saw the Lord sitting on his throne with all the multitudes of heaven standing on his right and on his left.

source: Chule Pakaiyin, Koipen tah-in Israel lengpa Ahab chu Ramoth-gilead-a agathi den nadinga agalhep dingham, ati. Chuin khatnin hitobanghin atin, achom khatnin khutobang khun atin ahi.
target: And the Lord said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel into attacking Ramoth Gilead and going to his death there?’ “One suggested this, and another that.

source: Chujouvin lhagao khat ahung potdoh-in, Pakai anga agadingin, Ken lheminge, ati. Chuin Pakaiyin ajah-a, ipi lampi-in em? ati.
target: Finally, a spirit came forward, stood before the Lord and said, ‘I will entice him.’ “ ‘By what means?’ the Lord asked.

source: Chuin aman chedoh ingting, athemgaoho koma jouthu sei lhagaova kagapan ding ahi, ati. Chuin Pakaiyin, Nangman nagalhep ding, jojong najoding ahi: chen lang chuti chun gaboltan, ati.
target: “ ‘I will go and be a deceiving spirit in the mouths of all his prophets,’ he said. “ ‘You will succeed in enticing him,’ said the Lord . ‘Go and do it.’

source: Hijeh chun tun, vetan, Pakaiyin hiche nathemgao ho kama jousei lhagao akoija, Pakaiyin nangma douna-a thilse asei ahitai, ati.
target: “So now the Lord has put a deceiving spirit in the mouths of these prophets of yours. The Lord has decreed disaster for you.”

source: Chujouvin Chenaanah chapa Zedekiah chun ahin naijin, Micaiah ngeiphe abengin, ajah-a, Hoiche lampi-a Pakai lhagao chu keima-a kona nangma henga thusei dinga che-a ham? ati.
target: Then Zedekiah son of Kenaanah went up and slapped Micaiah in the face. “Which way did the spirit from the Lord go when he went from me to speak to you?” he asked.

source: Chuin Micaiah'in, Ven, kiseldinga indan sungnunga nalut nikhole hetan nate, ati.
target: Micaiah replied, “You will find out on the day you go to hide in an inner room.”

source: Chuin Israel lengpan, Micaiah chu man unlang, khopi vaipo Amon le, lengpa chapa Joash henga lekaijun;
target: The king of Israel then ordered, “Take Micaiah and send him back to Amon the ruler of the city and to Joash the king’s son,

source: Chule, Lengpan hitin aseije, Hichepa hi keima lhamonga kahung kilekit kahsen songkul'a khumin lang, gimbolna changlhah le gimbolna twijin vah uvin atie, tin gaseijun ati.
target: and say, ‘This is what the king says: Put this fellow in prison and give him nothing but bread and water until I return safely.’ ”

source: Chuin Micaiah'in, Lungmonga nahung kile ngeingeija ahile Pakaiyin keima mangcha-a thu aseilou hinte, ati. Chule aman, Mipi jousen ngaijun, ati.
target: Micaiah declared, “If you ever return safely, the Lord has not spoken through me.” Then he added, “Mark my words, all you people!”

source: Hitichun Israel lengpa le Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat chu Ramoth-gilead lama akontou lhontai.
target: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

source: Chuin Israel lengpan Jehoshaphat jah-a, Keiman kalim kachom sah-a galmuna kache ding ahi; nangma vang naleng von kivonin, ati. Hitichun Israel lengpan alim achomsah-in, galmuna ache taove.
target: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will enter the battle in disguise, but you wear your royal robes.” So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.

source: Tun Syria lengpa chun alhonpi sakol kangtalai lamkaiho athupeh-in, Nanghon Israel lengpa tailou alen jong aneo jong nasat loudiu ahi, ati.
target: Now the king of Aram had ordered his chariot commanders, “Do not fight with anyone, small or great, except the king of Israel.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, sakol kangtalai lamkaihon Jehoshaphat amu phatnun, Hichekhu Israel lengpa ahi, atiuve. Hijeh chun kisatpidin ahin um taovin; ahinla Jehoshaphat chu apeng jah-in ahile, Pakaiyin akithopin; Pathen'in amaho chu amapa adalhah sahtan ahi.
target: When the chariot commanders saw Jehoshaphat, they thought, “This is the king of Israel.” So they turned to attack him, but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the Lord helped him. God drew them away from him,

source: Ajehchu ahung hitin ahi, sakol kangtalai lamkaihon Israel lengpa ahilou ahetphat uvin, ama nung adel naova konin ahung kinungle taovin ahi.
target: for when the chariot commanders saw that he was not the king of Israel, they stopped pursuing him.

source: Chuin mikhatnin doitum neilouvin athal akapmin ahile, Israel lengpa ompho kikah tah chu akhan ahi. Hijeh chun asakol kangtalai tolpa henga, Janel lah-a kona neitoldoh theinadin nakhut leheijin; ajehchu keima kamachang tan ahi, ati.
target: But someone drew his bow at random and hit the king of Israel between the breastplate and the scale armor. The king told the chariot driver, “Wheel around and get me out of the fighting. I’ve been wounded.”

source: Chule hiche nikho chun galkisat anasalheh jengin: ahijeng vangin Israel lengpa chu sakol kangtalai chunga Syria mite lamngan nilhah geijin aumin: chuin nisa lhumphat donin athitan ahi.
target: All day long the battle raged, and the king of Israel propped himself up in his chariot facing the Arameans until evening. Then at sunset he died.

source: Chuin Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat chu lungmong tah-in a-in lam Jerusalem'a ahung kile kit tai.
target: When Jehoshaphat king of Judah returned safely to his palace in Jerusalem,

source: Chuin ama kimupi din mitvahnei Hanani chapa Jehu apotdoh-in, Jehoshaphat lengpa henga, Nangman Pathen helouho napanpi-a, Pakai hotbolteho nangailut ding hijaham? hijeh chun Pakai masanga konin nachung uva lunghana achutan ahi.
target: Jehu the seer, the son of Hanani, went out to meet him and said to the king, “Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the Lord ? Because of this, the wrath of the Lord is on you.

source: Ahivangin hiche gama kona doikhomho nalahmanga, Pathen holding nalungthim nagot jeh-in, nangma-a thilpha akimun ahi, ati.
target: There is, however, some good in you, for you have rid the land of the Asherah poles and have set your heart on seeking God.”

source: Chuin Jehoshaphat Jerusalem'a achengin; Beersheba'a pat Ephraim molsang geijin amite lah-a achelen, Pakai apu apateu Pathen lama amaho chu ahin lepui kitnin ahi.
target: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, and he went out again among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim and turned them back to the Lord , the God of their ancestors.

source: Chuin aman Judah gama kulbang nei khopiho jouse-a, khopi tina thutan ho akoijin,
target: He appointed judges in the land, in each of the fortified cities of Judah.

source: Thutan ho henga, Nathilbol uva chingtheijun: ajehchu mihem dinga thutan nahipouvin; nathutan naova na-umpiu Pakai ding joh-a thutan nahiuve.
target: He told them, “Consider carefully what you do, because you are not judging for mere mortals but for the Lord , who is with you whenever you give a verdict.

source: Hijeh chun tun nachung uva Pakai ginna umhen; chingthei tah-in bolun: ajehchu Pakai i-Pathen uva chun khangitlouna, maipha vetna, chule nehguh nehna aumpon ahi, ati.
target: Now let the fear of the Lord be on you. Judge carefully, for with the Lord our God there is no injustice or partiality or bribery.”

source: Chukalvalin amaho Jerusalem'a ahung kile phatnun, Jehoshaphat'in Jerusalem'a chun Pakai thutan ding le thunoh baotamna-a thutan dingin Levi ho le thempuho, chule Israel phung upaho akoijin ahi.
target: In Jerusalem also, Jehoshaphat appointed some of the Levites, priests and heads of Israelite families to administer the law of the Lord and to settle disputes. And they lived in Jerusalem.

source: Chule aman amaho chu athupeh-in, Nanghon Pakai ging pum le kitah tah-a, chule lungthim chamkim tah-a hichu naboldiu ahi.
target: He gave them these orders: “You must serve faithfully and wholeheartedly in the fear of the Lord .

source: Chule achennao akhopi houva nasopiteu lah-a kon ipi thu hijongle: thisan le thisan kikah thu, danthu le thupeh kikah thu, chondanho le thutanlhahho thua naheng uva hungchan chu, nangho le nasopiteu chunga lunghanna achuh louna dinga Pakai douna-a asuhkhel louna diuva nahil chahdiu ahi. Hichehi bolun, chutile nasuhkhel lou dingu ahi.
target: In every case that comes before you from your people who live in the cities—whether bloodshed or other concerns of the law, commands, decrees or regulations—you are to warn them not to sin against the Lord ; otherwise his wrath will come on you and your people. Do this, and you will not sin.

source: Chule veuvin, thempu chungnung Amariah chu Pakai thulam jouse-a nachung uva aumin; chule lengpa thulam jouse-a Judah te insung vaihompa Ishmael chapa Zebadiah aume; chule Levi mite jong chu namasanguva lamkai hidiu ahi. Hangtah-in tongun, chule Pakaiyin miphaho aumpi ding ahi, ati.
target: “Amariah the chief priest will be over you in any matter concerning the Lord , and Zebadiah son of Ishmael, the leader of the tribe of Judah, will be over you in any matter concerning the king, and the Levites will serve as officials before you. Act with courage, and may the Lord be with those who do well.”

source: Hiche jou jonghin ahitin ahi, Moab chatele Ammon chate chu Ammon mite hilou adangtoh Jehoshaphat satdin ahunguvin ahi.
target: After this, the Moabites and Ammonites with some of the Meunites came to wage war against Jehoshaphat.

source: Chuin mi phabep Jehoshaphat henga ahungun, Mihonpi tamtah nangma doudin twipigal hilam Syria'a konin ahung konun; chule vetan, Engedi kite Hazazon-tamar'a aumun ahi, tin ahilun ahi.
target: Some people came and told Jehoshaphat, “A vast army is coming against you from Edom, from the other side of the Dead Sea. It is already in Hazezon Tamar” (that is, En Gedi).

source: Chuin Jehoshaphat akicha tan, Pakai holdin akipen, Judah gamsung pumpi-a an ngol din aphongdoh tan ahi.
target: Alarmed, Jehoshaphat resolved to inquire of the Lord , and he proclaimed a fast for all Judah.

source: Chuin Judah chu Pakai kithopina thumdin akikhom khomun: Judah khopiho jouse-a konin Pakai holdin ahungdoh-un ahi.
target: The people of Judah came together to seek help from the Lord ; indeed, they came from every town in Judah to seek him.

source: Chuin Jehoshaphat chu Judah le Jerusalem houkhom ho lah, Pakai insunga inhong thah maija chun adingin,
target: Then Jehoshaphat stood up in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem at the temple of the Lord in the front of the new courtyard

source: Hitin ati, Vo kapu kapateu Pakai Pathen, nangma van'a um Pathen nahi hilouham? chule Pathen helou mite lenggam ho chunga vaihom nahi hilouham? chule koimachan nanan joulou na dinga, nakhutna thahatna le thaneina uma hilouham?
target: and said: “ Lord , the God of our ancestors, are you not the God who is in heaven? You rule over all the kingdoms of the nations. Power and might are in your hand, and no one can withstand you.

source: Nami Israelte masanga kona hiche gama chengho nodoh-a, nagolpa Abraham chilhahte tonsotna dia pe-a ka-Pathen'u nahi hilouham?
target: Our God, did you not drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel and give it forever to the descendants of Abraham your friend?

source: Chuin amaho hia chun achengun, hia chun namin dingin muntheng khat nasahpeh-un,
target: They have lived in it and have built in it a sanctuary for your Name, saying,

source: Ijemtia kachunguva thilphalou, chemjam, thutana, hise, kellhah ho kachunguva ahung chuh-a ahile, hiche in mai le na angsung tah-a hi kadindiu, (ajehchu hiche insunga hi namin uma ahi,) kathohgim naova kona nangma henga kapendiu, chuteng nangman neingaipeh uva neikithopi dingu ahi, tin anaseijuve.
target: ‘If calamity comes upon us, whether the sword of judgment, or plague or famine, we will stand in your presence before this temple that bears your Name and will cry out to you in our distress, and you will hear us and save us.’

source: Chule tun, vetan, Egypt gama kona ahungdoh laijuva Israel ten gala asat dingu nanaphal louho, amavang amaho-a kona kinungle uva, asuhmang louvu Ammon chate le Moab chate, chule Seir molsang miho hi;
target: “But now here are men from Ammon, Moab and Mount Seir, whose territory you would not allow Israel to invade when they came from Egypt; so they turned away from them and did not destroy them.

source: Vetan, itobanga eilethuh-u hitam, nangman kalodiuva neinapeh-u nagouchana kona nodoh dingin ahunguve.
target: See how they are repaying us by coming to drive us out of the possession you gave us as an inheritance.

source: Vo ka Pathen'u, nangman athu-u natanlou dingham? Ajehchu eidoudiuva hungkon hiche hon tamtah ho douna dingin hatna kanei pouvin; alonaje jong kahepouve: ahin kamitnu hi nangma chunga aume, ati.
target: Our God, will you not judge them? For we have no power to face this vast army that is attacking us. We do not know what to do, but our eyes are on you.”

source: Chuin Judah te jouse chu Pakai angsunga achasen houle ajiteu, chule achateu toh adingsoh keijun ahi
target: All the men of Judah, with their wives and children and little ones, stood there before the Lord .

source: Hichun Levi mi Asaph chate lah-a Mattania chapa, Jeiel chapa, Benaiah chapa, Zekeriah chapa, Jahaziel chunga chun houkhom ho lailung tah-a Pakai lhagao ahungchutan;
target: Then the Spirit of the Lord came on Jahaziel son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite and descendant of Asaph, as he stood in the assembly.

source: Chuin aman, Ngaijun, nangho Judah te jouse le Jerusalem'a cheng jouse, chule nangma Jehoshaphat lengpa, Pakaiyin najah uva hitin aseije, Hiche mihonpi jeh hin nangho kicha hih-un, lung jong lungthoi hih-un; ajehchu galsat hi nangho-a ahipon, Pathen'a joh ahi
target: He said: “Listen, King Jehoshaphat and all who live in Judah and Jerusalem! This is what the Lord says to you: ‘Do not be afraid or discouraged because of this vast army. For the battle is not yours, but God’s.

source: Jing nikhole amaho doudingin konsuh-un; veuvin, amaho Ziz songkol'a ahung kaltou uve; nanghon Jeruel gamthip masang, vadung kichaina lama namudiu ahi.
target: Tomorrow march down against them. They will be climbing up by the Pass of Ziz, and you will find them at the end of the gorge in the Desert of Jeruel.

source: Hiche galhi nangho sat ngailou ding ahi: nangho le nangho kigol toh-un, dingthim beh uvinlang, napanpiuva Pakai huhhingna chu veuvin, vo Judah le Jerusalem: kicha hih-un, lungjong lungthoi hih-un; jingtengle amaho doudingin kondoh-un; ijeh inem itile Pakaiyin na umpi dingu ahi, ati.
target: You will not have to fight this battle. Take up your positions; stand firm and see the deliverance the Lord will give you, Judah and Jerusalem. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Go out to face them tomorrow, and the Lord will be with you.’ ”

source: Chuin Jehoshaphat akunin amai tolla asuluttai: chuin Judah le Jerusalem'a cheng jouse Pakai anga alhuvin, Pakai chu ahou taove.
target: Jehoshaphat bowed down with his face to the ground, and all the people of Judah and Jerusalem fell down in worship before the Lord .

source: Chuin Kohath chate lah-a kon le Korhi chate lah-a kon Levi miho chu awgin sangtah le nasatah-a Israel Pakai Pathen vahchoi dingin adingdoh uvin ahi.
target: Then some Levites from the Kohathites and Korahites stood up and praised the Lord , the God of Israel, with a very loud voice.

source: Chuin jingpi tah-in athouvun, Tekoa gamthipma alutnun: amaho achedoh laijun Jehoshaphat adingin, ajah uva, Vo Judah le Jerusalem'a chengte, kathusei ngaijun; Pakai na Pathen'u tahsanun, chutile naki phutdet dingu ahi; athemgaoho tahsanun, chutile nalolhin dingu ahi, ati.
target: Early in the morning they left for the Desert of Tekoa. As they set out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, “Listen to me, Judah and people of Jerusalem! Have faith in the Lord your God and you will be upheld; have faith in his prophets and you will be successful.”

source: Chuin mipi toh akihoutoh phatnin, Pakai vahchoijun, ajehchu ahepina tonsotnin aumjinge, tia sepaiho masanga achepumuva athen hoina vahchoi ding le Pakai henga lasa ding mi alhengdoh-in ahi.
target: After consulting the people, Jehoshaphat appointed men to sing to the Lord and to praise him for the splendor of his holiness as they went out at the head of the army, saying: “Give thanks to the Lord , for his love endures forever.”

source: Chuin amahon lasah le vahchoina apat phatnun, Pakaiyin Judah doudinga hunga Ammon chate, Moab chate, chule Seir molsang miho dounan changpang akoijin; chuin amaho chu ajou taovin ahi.
target: As they began to sing and praise, the Lord set ambushes against the men of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir who were invading Judah, and they were defeated.

source: Ajehchu Ammon chate le Moab chate chu Seir molsang miho thatgam hela sumanghel dingin amaho dounan akipat doh-un: Seir'a chengho athagam phatnun, amitakip khatle khat akisumangto taovin ahi.
target: The Ammonites and Moabites rose up against the men from Mount Seir to destroy and annihilate them. After they finished slaughtering the men from Seir, they helped to destroy one another.

source: Chuin Judah te gamthipma um khongahpa insang ahung lhun phatnun, mihonpi lam chu aveovin ahile, veuvin, tolla mithilong alhuchap jengin, khatcha ahoidoh aumpouve.
