target: When the men of Judah came to the place that overlooks the desert and looked toward the vast army, they saw only dead bodies lying on the ground; no one had escaped.

source: Chuin Jehoshaphat le amite chu galthil kichomdinga ahung phatnun, amahon mithi longho-a chun thil mantam tahtah haosatna le kijepna thil lutahtah ho amuvin, apohlel khophel dingun amaho-a din akisut lhah-un ahi: chule atam behseh jehchun, galthil chu nithumjen achom khomun ahi.
target: So Jehoshaphat and his men went to carry off their plunder, and they found among them a great amount of equipment and clothing and also articles of value—more than they could take away. There was so much plunder that it took three days to collect it.

source: Chuin nilinin amaho Berachah phaichama akikhomun ahi; ajehchu hia chun Pakai achoi-anun ahi. Hijeh chun hiche mun minchu tugeijin Berachah phaicham akitin ahi.
target: On the fourth day they assembled in the Valley of Berakah, where they praised the Lord . This is why it is called the Valley of Berakah to this day.

source: Chujouvin Judah le Jerusalem mite jouse akinung leuvin, Jerusalem'a kipahtah-a chedingin Jehoshaphat chu alamkaijin ahi; ajehchu Pakaiyin amelmateu chunga akipasah-u ahi.
target: Then, led by Jehoshaphat, all the men of Judah and Jerusalem returned joyfully to Jerusalem, for the Lord had given them cause to rejoice over their enemies.

source: Chuin tumging le selangdah, chule sumkon tho-in Jerusalem'a Pakai in chu ahunglhung taove.
target: They entered Jerusalem and went to the temple of the Lord with harps and lyres and trumpets.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Israel te-a dingin amelmateu dounan gal asatne ti ajah phatnun, chuche lenggam ho jouse chunga Pathen ginna achutai.
target: The fear of God came on all the surrounding kingdoms when they heard how the Lord had fought against the enemies of Israel.

source: Chuin Jehoshaphat gamsunga lungmona aumtan ahi; ajehchu a-Pathen'in akimvela choldona apeh ahi.
target: And the kingdom of Jehoshaphat was at peace, for his God had given him rest on every side.

source: Hitichun Jehoshaphat chu Judah te chunga aleng changin ahi. Ama alengchan pat chun kum somthum le kumnga ahin, ama Jerusalem'a kum somni le kumnga aleng changin ahi. Chule anu minchu Azubah ahin, Shilhi chanu ahi.
target: So Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah. He was thirty-five years old when he became king of Judah, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-five years. His mother’s name was Azubah daughter of Shilhi.

source: Chule aman apa Asa lamlhah ajotnin, chua kona petdoh louvin Pakai mitmu-a adih chu abolin ahi.
target: He followed the ways of his father Asa and did not stray from them; he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord .

source: Ahijeng vangin munsang ho chu lahmangin aumpon ahi; ajehchu mipi chun apu apateu Pathen lama dingin alungthimu agongtup hihlaijun ahi.
target: The high places, however, were not removed, and the people still had not set their hearts on the God of their ancestors.

source: Tun Jehoshaphat thilbol dangho jouse chu abula pat achaina gei chu, veuvin, Israel lengte lekhabu sunga kiphapoh, Hanani chapa Jehu lekhabua akisuncheh-in ahi.
target: The other events of Jehoshaphat’s reign, from beginning to end, are written in the annals of Jehu son of Hanani, which are recorded in the book of the kings of Israel.

source: Hiche jou nung hin Judah lengpa Jehoshaphat chun thil giloutah bola Israel lengpa Ahaziah toh kiguijopna aneijin;
target: Later, Jehoshaphat king of Judah made an alliance with Ahaziah king of Israel, whose ways were wicked.

source: Aman Tarshish'a chena ding kong-innei semna'a amato chun akigui jopmin; chule amanin Ezion-gaber'a kong innei chu asem lhonin ahi.
target: He agreed with him to construct a fleet of trading ships. After these were built at Ezion Geber,

source: Chujouvin Mareshah mi Dodavah chapa Eliezer'in Jehoshaphat dounan gaothu aseijin, ahenga, Nangman Ahaziah toh kiguijopna nabol jeh-in, Pakaiyin nanatoh ho asusetai, ati. Hitichun kongho chu suhsetnin aum gamin, Tarshish'a achethei lhon tapoi.
target: Eliezer son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, “Because you have made an alliance with Ahaziah, the Lord will destroy what you have made.” The ships were wrecked and were not able to set sail to trade.

source: Tun Jehoshaphat apu apate toh alumkhomin, David khopi-a apu apate toh avuikhom taove. Chule ama khelin achapa Jehoram alengchang tan ahi.
target: Then Jehoshaphat rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David. And Jehoram his son succeeded him as king.

source: Aman Jehoshaphat chapate sopi Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, chule Shephatiah aneijin: amahohi abonuva Israel lengpa Jehoshaphat chapate ahiuve.
target: Jehoram’s brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat, were Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariahu, Michael and Shephatiah. All these were sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

source: Chule apaovin amaho thilpeh nasatah dangka, sana, thilmantam ho, chule Judah gama kulbang nei khopiho apeuvin ahi: ahinla lenggam chu Jehoram apen ahi; ajehchu ama apeng masapen ahi.
target: Their father had given them many gifts of silver and gold and articles of value, as well as fortified cities in Judah, but he had given the kingdom to Jehoram because he was his firstborn son.

source: Tun Jehoram'in apa lenggam ahin lopat phatnin, amale ama akisuhat nin, asopi pasal jouse chemjamin athatnin, Israel pipuiho dangdang jong athatnin ahi.
target: When Jehoram established himself firmly over his father’s kingdom, he put all his brothers to the sword along with some of the officials of Israel.

source: Alengchan patchun Jehoram chu kum somthum le kumni ahitan, Jerusalem'a kumget aleng changin ahi.
target: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years.

source: Aman Ahab insung bangin Israel lengte lamlhah ajotnin ahi; ajehchu aman Ahab chanu jin aneijin: chule Pakai mitmun thilse abolin ahi.
target: He followed the ways of the kings of Israel, as the house of Ahab had done, for he married a daughter of Ahab. He did evil in the eyes of the Lord .

source: Ahinla Pakaiyin David to kitepna anasemjeh le, amale achate henga a-itih-a meivah peh dinga anakitep jehchun, David insung chu asumang pon ahi.
target: Nevertheless, because of the covenant the Lord had made with David, the Lord was not willing to destroy the house of David. He had promised to maintain a lamp for him and his descendants forever.

source: Ama nikholai chun Edom mite chu Judah vaihomna noija aumnaova konin akiphinun, leng khat akitun taovin ahi.
target: In the time of Jehoram, Edom rebelled against Judah and set up its own king.

source: Chuin Jehoram apipuiho le amato umkhom sakol kangtalai jousetoh akondoh-un: chuin jan-in athoudoh-in, ama le asakol kangtalai lamkaiho umkimvela Edom mite chu asatnin ahi.
target: So Jehoram went there with his officers and all his chariots. The Edomites surrounded him and his chariot commanders, but he rose up and broke through by night.

source: Hitichun tuni geijin Edom mite chu Judah te khutnoija konin akiphinjing taovin ahi. Hiche phatlai mama jong chun aman apu apate Pakai Pathen anungsun jeh-in; Libnah chu akhut noija konin akiphinin ahi.
target: To this day Edom has been in rebellion against Judah. Libnah revolted at the same time, because Jehoram had forsaken the Lord , the God of his ancestors.

source: Chukalvalin jong aman Judah molsang chungho-a munsang ho asemin, Jerusalem'a chengho ajonthanhoi sah-in, Judah te apuimangin ahi.
target: He had also built high places on the hills of Judah and had caused the people of Jerusalem to prostitute themselves and had led Judah astray.

source: Chuin Elijah themgaova konin ahenga lekha ahungin, hitin ati, Napa David Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, nangman napa lamlhah najuilou jehle, Judah leng Asa lamlhah najuilou jeh,
target: Jehoram received a letter from Elijah the prophet, which said: “This is what the Lord , the God of your father David, says: ‘You have not followed the ways of your father Jehoshaphat or of Asa king of Judah.

source: Amavang Israel lengte lamlhah najuija, Ahab insung jonthanhoi banga Judah le Jerusalem'a chengho na jonthanhoi sah-a, nang sanga phajo cheh napa insunga nasopite nathagam jeh-in,
target: But you have followed the ways of the kings of Israel, and you have led Judah and the people of Jerusalem to prostitute themselves, just as the house of Ahab did. You have also murdered your own brothers, members of your own family, men who were better than you.

source: Vetan, Pakaiyin namite, nachate, najite, chule nanei nagouho jouse chu hise nasatah-a ajepding:
target: So now the Lord is about to strike your people, your sons, your wives and everything that is yours, with a heavy blow.

source: Chule nangman gilnatna kona natna nasatah naneiding, ani ni-a hiche natna jeh-a chu nagil hung lotdoh kahse-a natna nanei ding ahi, ati.
target: You yourself will be very ill with a lingering disease of the bowels, until the disease causes your bowels to come out.’ ”

source: Chukal valin Pakaiyin Ethopia naija um Philistine miho le Arab miho lungthim chu Jehoram doudingin atildoh-in;
target: The Lord aroused against Jehoram the hostility of the Philistines and of the Arabs who lived near the Cushites.

source: Amaho Judah gama ahung kontouvun, abuluvin, lengpa insunga kimu thiljouse le achapate le ajite jong apomangun; hitichun achate lah-a alhumpen Jehoahaz tailou chapa khatcha adalhahpeh pouvin ahi.
target: They attacked Judah, invaded it and carried off all the goods found in the king’s palace, together with his sons and wives. Not a son was left to him except Ahaziah, the youngest.

source: Chuin hicheho jouse jouhin Pakaiyin amachu gilnat damthei louvin ajeptan ahi.
target: After all this, the Lord afflicted Jehoram with an incurable disease of the bowels.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, phat phabep sung kumni kichai jouvin, anatnajeh in agiljang ahung lotdoh-in; hitichun natna hoisetah-in athitan ahi. Chule amiten apate meikong anatipeh ji bangun, ama chu meikong atipeh pouvin ahi.
target: In the course of time, at the end of the second year, his bowels came out because of the disease, and he died in great pain. His people made no funeral fire in his honor, as they had for his predecessors.

source: Alengchan kipat in ama kum somthumle kumni ahin, Jerusalem'a kumget lengvai apon, koimacha alha ngaija beihelin athitan ahi. Ahijeng vangin amahon David khopi-a avuijun, lengte lhan vang ahipoi.
target: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years. He passed away, to no one’s regret, and was buried in the City of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.

source: Chuin Jerusalem'a chenghon achapa lhumpen Ahaziah chu ama khelin alengchansah taove. Ajehchu Arab miho toh kiloija gebuh-a hunga mihon ho chun a-ute sese atha gamu ahitai. Hitichun Judah lengpa Jehoram chapa Ahaziah chu alengchang tan ahi.
target: The people of Jerusalem made Ahaziah, Jehoram’s youngest son, king in his place, since the raiders, who came with the Arabs into the camp, had killed all the older sons. So Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.

source: Alengchan patchun Ahaziah chu kum somli le kumni ahin, Jerusalem'a kumkhat aleng changin ahi. Anu min chu Athaliah ahin, Omri chanu ahi.
target: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem one year. His mother’s name was Athaliah, a granddaughter of Omri.

source: Amajong Ahab insung lamlhah ajuijin ahi. Ajehchu anu chu athilse bolna dinga athumopma pang ahi.
target: He too followed the ways of the house of Ahab, for his mother encouraged him to act wickedly.

source: Hijeh chun aman Pakai mitmun Ahab insung bangin thilse abolin ahi: ajehchu apa thinungin amaho chu amanthahna dinga thumopmin apanguvin ahi.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , as the house of Ahab had done, for after his father’s death they became his advisers, to his undoing.

source: Amajong amaho thumop bangchun achonin, Israel lengpa Ahab chapa Jehoram toh kilhonin Syria lengpa Bazael toh kisatdin Ramoth-Gilead'a achen: chule Syria mihon Joram chu amavouvin ahi.
target: He also followed their counsel when he went with Joram son of Ahab king of Israel to wage war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth Gilead. The Arameans wounded Joram;

source: Chuin Syria lengpa Hazael toh Ramoth'a akisatna-a amachanjeh-in, kijendam dingin Jezreel'a ahung kiletai. Chuin ama adamlou jehchun, Judah lengpa Jehoram chapa Azariah chu Ahab chapa Jehoram ve dingin Jezreel'a ache suh-in ahi.
target: so he returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds they had inflicted on him at Ramoth in his battle with Hazael king of Aram. Then Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to Jezreel to see Joram son of Ahab because he had been wounded.

source: Chule Joram henga Amaziah ahungchu amanthahna dinga Pathen thilgon ahi: ajehchu ama ahung chun, Pakaiyin Ahab insung sumang ding thao anu Nimshi chapa Jehu doudin Jehoram toh akondoh lhonin ahi.
target: Through Ahaziah’s visit to Joram, God brought about Ahaziah’s downfall. When Ahaziah arrived, he went out with Joram to meet Jehu son of Nimshi, whom the Lord had anointed to destroy the house of Ahab.

source: Chuin ahung hitin ahi, Jehu'n Ahab insung chunga thutana anei laijin, Judah pipuiho le Ahaziah sopiho chapaten Ahaziah ajenu chu amun, amaho chu athat tan ahi.
target: While Jehu was executing judgment on the house of Ahab, he found the officials of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah’s relatives, who had been attending Ahaziah, and he killed them.

source: Chuin aman Ahaziah aholin; chule amahon ama amanun, (ajehchu ama Samaria'a anakisel ahin,) Jehu henga ahin puijun ahi. Chuin amahon ama atha jouvun avui taovin ahi. Ajehchu amahon, Amahi alung pumpi-a Pakai hola Jehoshaphat chapa ahi, atiuve. Hitichun Ahaziah insung miten lenggam chunga lengvaipo ding anei tapouvin ahi.
target: He then went in search of Ahaziah, and his men captured him while he was hiding in Samaria. He was brought to Jehu and put to death. They buried him, for they said, “He was a son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the Lord with all his heart.” So there was no one in the house of Ahaziah powerful enough to retain the kingdom.

source: Ahinla Ahaziah nu Athaliah'in achapa thi amu phatnin, akipatdoh-in Judah insunga lengte chilhah jouse athat gamtan ahi.
target: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she proceeded to destroy the whole royal family of the house of Judah.

source: Ahinla lengpa chanu Jeho-shabeath'in Ahaziah chapa Joash chu akithatna leng chapate lah-a konin agudoh-in, adonnu toh indan sung khatna akoitai. Hitichun Jehoram lengpa chanu Jehoiada thempupa jinu Jeho-shabeath chun (ajehchu amanu Ahaziah sopinu hija ahi,) amanun amapa atha louna dingin, Athaliah'a konin aselin ahi.
target: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram, took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the royal princes who were about to be murdered and put him and his nurse in a bedroom. Because Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram and wife of the priest Jehoiada, was Ahaziah’s sister, she hid the child from Athaliah so she could not kill him.

source: Chuin ama chu amahotoh kumgup sung Pathen in'a akiselin: chule gamsunga chun Athaliah'in lengvai apon ahi.
target: He remained hidden with them at the temple of God for six years while Athaliah ruled the land.

source: Chuin kum sagi lhinna-in Jehoida akisuhat nin, Ja lamkaiho, Jeroham chapa Azariah, Jehohanan chapa Ishmael, Obed chapa Azariah, Adaiah chapa Maaseiah, chule Zichri chapa Alishaphat apuijin, amato kitepna aneijin ahi.
target: In the seventh year Jehoiada showed his strength. He made a covenant with the commanders of units of a hundred: Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zikri.

source: Chuin Judah gam achonleuvin, Judah khopiho-a konin Levi mite le Israel phung upaho jouse akhomun, Jerusalem'a ahungun ahi.
target: They went throughout Judah and gathered the Levites and the heads of Israelite families from all the towns. When they came to Jerusalem,

source: Chuin houkhom ho jouse Pathen insung lengpa toh thulhun asemuvin ahi. Chuin aman ajah uva, Veuvin Pakaiyin David chapate thudol asei banga, lengpa chapan lengvai apohding ahi.
target: the whole assembly made a covenant with the king at the temple of God. Jehoiada said to them, “The king’s son shall reign, as the Lord promised concerning the descendants of David.

source: Nanghon nabol dingu chu hiche ahi; choldoni-a lutji thempuho le Levi ho lah-a hopthum-a hopkhat chu kotngah-a napandiu,
target: Now this is what you are to do: A third of you priests and Levites who are going on duty on the Sabbath are to keep watch at the doors,

source: Hopthum-a hopkhat lengpa in'a; chule hopthum-a hopkhat chu kotpi bula napandiu: chule mipi ho jouse chu Pakai in hongcha ho-a umdiu ahi.
target: a third of you at the royal palace and a third at the Foundation Gate, and all the others are to be in the courtyards of the temple of the Lord .

source: Ahinla thempuho le kinbola pang Levi ho tailou koimacha Pakai insung hunglut louding ahi; amaho athenjeh uva lutdiu ahin: mipi ho jouse vang Pakai anga dingu ahi.
target: No one is to enter the temple of the Lord except the priests and Levites on duty; they may enter because they are consecrated, but all the others are to observe the Lord ’s command not to enter.

source: Chule Levi miten akhutna manchah kichoijuva lengpa chu aum kimvel diu; koi hijongle insung hunglut chan chu kithat ding ahi. Ahinla nanghon lengpa chu ahunglut le apotdoh teng naumpi jingdiu ahi, ati.
target: The Levites are to station themselves around the king, each with weapon in hand. Anyone who enters the temple is to be put to death. Stay close to the king wherever he goes.”

source: Hitichun Levi ho le Judah te jousen Jehoida thempu thupeh bangtah-in abolun, chule amitakipmin choldoni-a hunglut ding amiho chu choldoni-a potdoh dingho chutoh apuijun ahi; ajehchu Jehoida thempupan anatoh-u angahsah louvu ahi.
target: The Levites and all the men of Judah did just as Jehoiada the priest ordered. Each one took his men—those who were going on duty on the Sabbath and those who were going off duty—for Jehoiada the priest had not released any of the divisions.

source: Chukalvalin Jehoida thempupan ja lamkaiho chu Pakai in'a um David lengpa tengcha ho le lumho chu apen ahi.
target: Then he gave the commanders of units of a hundred the spears and the large and small shields that had belonged to King David and that were in the temple of God.

source: Chuin aman miho jouse chu amitakip akhutna galvon kengcheh-in houin jetlama pat veilam geijin, maicham le houin lhung lhonin lengpa kimvela adin sah-in ahi
target: He stationed all the men, each with his weapon in his hand, around the king—near the altar and the temple, from the south side to the north side of the temple.

source: Chujouvin amahon leng chapa ahin puidoh-un, achunga lallukhuh akhuh peh-un, thulhun chu apeuvin, lengin asemtaove. Chuin Jehoiada le achapaten thao anuvin, Pathen'in lengpa huhhing hen atiuve.
target: Jehoiada and his sons brought out the king’s son and put the crown on him; they presented him with a copy of the covenant and proclaimed him king. They anointed him and shouted, “Long live the king!”

source: Tun Athaliah'in mipi alhai gin le lengpa vahchoina husa ajah phatnin, Pakai insunga mipi henga chun ahungin,
target: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and cheering the king, she went to them at the temple of the Lord .

source: Amanun agahven ahile, veuvin, insung lutna-a khompi phunga chun lengpa adingin, chule lengpa koma chun pipuiho le sumkon mutho adingun: gamsung mipi jouse akipah-un, sumkon amutnun, lasahon jong akihil bangun manchahto thon avahchoijun ahi. Chuphatnin Athaliah'in apon abot eh-in, Kidouna, kidouna, atin ahi.
target: She looked, and there was the king, standing by his pillar at the entrance. The officers and the trumpeters were beside the king, and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets, and musicians with their instruments were leading the praises. Then Athaliah tore her robes and shouted, “Treason! Treason!”

source: Hichun Jehoida thempupan janel chunga lamkaija akoi ja lamkaiho chu apuidoh-in, ajah uva, Amanu chu milah-a konin puidoh unlang, amanu juichan chu chemjamin thatnun, ati. Ajehchu thempupan, Amanu chu Pakai insunga that hih-un ati, ahi.
target: Jehoiada the priest sent out the commanders of units of a hundred, who were in charge of the troops, and said to them: “Bring her out between the ranks and put to the sword anyone who follows her.” For the priest had said, “Do not put her to death at the temple of the Lord .”

source: Hitichun amahon achunga akhut alhaovin; lengpa in khoma sakol lutna kotpi phung ahunggei phatnin, chua chun amanu athat taovin ahi.
target: So they seized her as she reached the entrance of the Horse Gate on the palace grounds, and there they put her to death.

source: Chuin Jehoiada'n ama le mipi ho jouse le lengpa kah-a chun Pathen mite ahina diuvin kitepna asemin ahi.
target: Jehoiada then made a covenant that he, the people and the king would be the Lord ’s people.

source: Hichun mipi jouse Baal in'a acheuvin, amaichamho le amilimho asuchimun, maicham meija chun Baal thempu Mattan chu athat taove.
target: All the people went to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.

source: Chujongle Jehoiada'n Pakai in'a natoh ding jouse chu, Mosi danthu bu-a kimu dungjuija David'in ana gontup bangchun, Pakai insunga kipah le lasa puma Pakai henga govam thilto tohdoh dinga David'in anahoptoh Levi mite thempuho khutna apedoh-in ahi.
target: Then Jehoiada placed the oversight of the temple of the Lord in the hands of the Levitical priests, to whom David had made assignments in the temple, to present the burnt offerings of the Lord as written in the Law of Moses, with rejoicing and singing, as David had ordered.

source: Chule aman imalam jouse-a thenglou tapou khatcha alut louna dingin, Pakai in kotpi-a kotngah ho akoijin ahi.
target: He also stationed gatekeepers at the gates of the Lord ’s temple so that no one who was in any way unclean might enter.

source: Chuin aman ja lamkaiho, milunho, mipi chunga vaipoho le chuche gama mipi ho jouse chu apuijin, Pakai in'a konin lengpa chu apuilhasuh-un: kotpi sang palgalkai jin leng in lama acheuvin, lengpa chu alenggam laltouna-a atousah taove.
target: He took with him the commanders of hundreds, the nobles, the rulers of the people and all the people of the land and brought the king down from the temple of the Lord . They went into the palace through the Upper Gate and seated the king on the royal throne.

source: Chule gamsung mipi jouse akipah-un: Athaliah chemjam'a atha phatnun, khopi chu lung mongin aumtan ahi.
target: All the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was calm, because Athaliah had been slain with the sword.

source: Joash chu alengchan patchun kum sagi ahibepmin, Jerusalem'a kum somli aleng changin ahi. Anu min chu Zibiah ahin, Beersheba mi ahi.
target: Joash was seven years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother’s name was Zibiah; she was from Beersheba.

source: Jehoiada thempu nikho laisen Joash'in Pakai mitmun adih abolin ahi.
target: Joash did what was right in the eyes of the Lord all the years of Jehoiada the priest.

source: Chule Jehoiada ama dingin ji ni apuipeh-in, aman chanu chapa ahingin ahi.
target: Jehoiada chose two wives for him, and he had sons and daughters.

source: Chuin hiche jouhin ahitin ahi, Joash'in Pakai in semphat ding alungviltai.
target: Some time later Joash decided to restore the temple of the Lord .

source: Chuin aman thempuho le Levi ho akhomin, ajah uva, Judah khopiho-a cheovinlang, akum kum-a Pakai in semphatnadin Israel mijouse henga dangka gadong khomun, chule hiche natoh hi nakino sah dingu ahi, ati. Ahinla Levi ho chu akino pouvin ahi.
target: He called together the priests and Levites and said to them, “Go to the towns of Judah and collect the money due annually from all Israel, to repair the temple of your God. Do it now.” But the Levites did not act at once.

source: Chuin lengpan thempu chungnung Jehoiada chu akouvin, ajah-a, I-atile Pakai soh Mosi le Israel houkhom ho thupeh dungjuija hettohsahna houbuh-a dinga tokhom chu Judah le Jerusalem'a kona gadongkhom dinga Levi mite nasol louham?
target: Therefore the king summoned Jehoiada the chief priest and said to him, “Why haven’t you required the Levites to bring in from Judah and Jerusalem the tax imposed by Moses the servant of the Lord and by the assembly of Israel for the tent of the covenant law?”

source: Ajehchu numei phalounu Athaliah chapaten Pathen in chu asuseuvin; Pakai in'a thil kikatdoh jouse jong Baal'a dingin apedoh gam taovin ahi, ati.
target: Now the sons of that wicked woman Athaliah had broken into the temple of God and had used even its sacred objects for the Baals.

source: Chuin amahon lengpa thupeh-in sumbom asemun, hichu Pakai in kotpi polama akoijun ahi.
target: At the king’s command, a chest was made and placed outside, at the gate of the temple of the Lord .

source: Chuin gamthipma Pathen soh Mosi'n Israelte chunga anapohsah tokhom chu Pakai henga ahinchoi diuvin, Judah gamjouse le Jerusalem'a asam phong taovin ahi.
target: A proclamation was then issued in Judah and Jerusalem that they should bring to the Lord the tax that Moses the servant of God had required of Israel in the wilderness.

source: Chuin pipuiho jouse le mipi ho jouse athanomun, ahinchoijun, apehchai kahseovin sumbom sunga alehlut nun ahi.
target: All the officials and all the people brought their contributions gladly, dropping them into the chest until it was full.

source: Tun ahung hitin ahi, hichelai chun sum thingkhong chu lengpa natohna mun'a Levi ho khutnin ahin domlutnin, sum tampi aumtai ti ahet phatnun, lengpa thuchingpa le thempu chungnung vaipoho ahungun, sumbom chu ahongun, aladoh-un, chule amun mama-a agakoi kitnun ahi. Hitichun niseh in abolun, sum tampi akholdoh taovin ahi.
target: Whenever the chest was brought in by the Levites to the king’s officials and they saw that there was a large amount of money, the royal secretary and the officer of the chief priest would come and empty the chest and carry it back to its place. They did this regularly and collected a great amount of money.

source: Chuin lengpa le Jehoiada'n hicheho chu Pakai in'a natong kinbolho apedoh lhonin; chule amahon Pakai in semphat nadin songkheng hole thingthem ho agoijun, chujongle Pakai in chu bolpha dingin thih le sum-enga semphaho jong agoijun ahi.
target: The king and Jehoiada gave it to those who carried out the work required for the temple of the Lord . They hired masons and carpenters to restore the Lord ’s temple, and also workers in iron and bronze to repair the temple.

source: Hitichun natong hon atongun amaho-a konin natoh chu amolsouvin, Pathen in chu amasalai bangin atungdoh-un, asudet taovin ahi.
target: The men in charge of the work were diligent, and the repairs progressed under them. They rebuilt the temple of God according to its original design and reinforced it.

source: Chuin ajophatnun sumval chu lengpa le Jehoiada henga ahinchoijun, hichea chun Pakai in'a ding um le bel ho, kinbol nading le thiltona ding manchah ho, thihkhe ho, sanale dangka umle bel ho asemuvin ahi. Chuin Jehoiada nikho laisen Pakai in'a chun govam thilto tanglouvin atoh jinguvin ahi.
target: When they had finished, they brought the rest of the money to the king and Jehoiada, and with it were made articles for the Lord ’s temple: articles for the service and for the burnt offerings, and also dishes and other objects of gold and silver. As long as Jehoiada lived, burnt offerings were presented continually in the temple of the Lord .

source: Ahinla Jehoiada chu atehlheh tan, nikho alhingsetnin athin; athi chun kum jakhatle somthum ahitai.
target: Now Jehoiada was old and full of years, and he died at the age of a hundred and thirty.

source: Chule Israelte lah-a Pathen'a ding le a-in dinga thilpha aboljeh-in, amahon David khopi-a lengho lah-a avuitaove.
target: He was buried with the kings in the City of David, because of the good he had done in Israel for God and his temple.

source: Tun Jehoiada thinungin Judah pipuiho ahungun, lengpa chu jana ahung peuvin ahi. Chuin lengpan amaho angaipeh tan ahi.
target: After the death of Jehoiada, the officials of Judah came and paid homage to the king, and he listened to them.

source: Chuin amahon apu apateu Pakai Pathen in adalhauvin, thingbul le milim semthuho ahou taove: chule hiche suhkhelna jeh hin, Judah le Jerusalem chunga lunghanna achutai.
target: They abandoned the temple of the Lord , the God of their ancestors, and worshiped Asherah poles and idols. Because of their guilt, God’s anger came on Judah and Jerusalem.

source: Ahinla aman amaho chu Pakai henga hinlepui kit dingin themgaoho asolin; chule amahon amaho dounan thu aseijun: ahinla angaipeh pouve.
target: Although the Lord sent prophets to the people to bring them back to him, and though they testified against them, they would not listen.

source: Chuin Jehoiada thempupa chapa Zechariah chunga Pathen lhagao ahung chun, amachu miho chunglama adingin, ajah uva, Pathen'in hitin aseije, Nakhantou louna diuva ibola Pakai thupeh chu nasuhkhelu ham? Nanghon Pakai nanungsun tah jeh-un, amanjong nangho nanungsun taove, ati.
target: Then the Spirit of God came on Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest. He stood before the people and said, “This is what God says: ‘Why do you disobey the Lord ’s commands? You will not prosper. Because you have forsaken the Lord , he has forsaken you.’ ”

source: Chuin ama dounan guhthimin akihou khomun, Pakai inhong sunga chun lengpa thupeh-in songin aseplih taove.
target: But they plotted against him, and by order of the king they stoned him to death in the courtyard of the Lord ’s temple.

source: Hitichun Joash lengpan apa Jehoiada'n ama anahepina ageldoh tapon, achapa chu athat tan ahi. Chuin athi konin, Pakaiyin hinvehen lang, hinlethuh hen, ati.
target: King Joash did not remember the kindness Zechariah’s father Jehoiada had shown him but killed his son, who said as he lay dying, “May the Lord see this and call you to account.”

source: Chuin kumlhun phatnin ahitin ahi, Syria sepaite chu ama doudingin ahung kontouvun; amaho Judah le Jerusalem'a ahungun, mipi lah-a kona pipuiho jouse athat gamun, amaho-a kona achomdoh jouse chu Damascus lengpa athot soh hel taove.
target: At the turn of the year, the army of Aram marched against Joash; it invaded Judah and Jerusalem and killed all the leaders of the people. They sent all the plunder to their king in Damascus.

source: Ajehchu Syria sepaiho hon lhomcha hunguva ahin, Pakaiyin janel mihon tamtah chu amaho khutna apedoh tan ahi; ajehchu amahon apu apateu Pakai Pathen anungsun taovin ahi. Hitichun amahon Joash chunga thutanna anei taove.
target: Although the Aramean army had come with only a few men, the Lord delivered into their hands a much larger army. Because Judah had forsaken the Lord , the God of their ancestors, judgment was executed on Joash.

source: Chuin amahon ama adalhah phatnun, (ajehchu natna nasatah thoh puma adalhah-u ahi,) Jehoiada chapate thisan jehchun asohte guhthimin akihou somun, ajalkhuna athatnun, ama athitai. Chuin David khopi-a avuijun, lengte lhanna vang avuipouve.
target: When the Arameans withdrew, they left Joash severely wounded. His officials conspired against him for murdering the son of Jehoiada the priest, and they killed him in his bed. So he died and was buried in the City of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.

source: Chule ama douna-a guhthima kihou somho chu hichehohi ahiuve; Ammon mi Shimeath chapa Zabad, Moab mi Shimrith chapa Zehozabad ahilhone.
target: Those who conspired against him were Zabad, son of Shimeath an Ammonite woman, and Jehozabad, son of Shimrith a Moabite woman.

source: Tun achapate thudol le, achungah pohgih natsatje thu, chule Pathen in kisemphat thudol chu, veuvin, lengho thusimbua akisun chen cheh-in ahi. Chuin achapa Amaziah chu ama akhelin alengchang tan ahi.
target: The account of his sons, the many prophecies about him, and the record of the restoration of the temple of God are written in the annotations on the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son succeeded him as king.

source: Amaziah chu alengchan patchun kum somni le kumnga ahin, Jerusalem'a kum somni le kumko aleng changin ahi. Chule anu minchu Jehoaddan ahin, Jerusalem mi ahi.
target: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan; she was from Jerusalem.

source: Chule aman Pakai mitmu-a adih abolin, ahinla lungthim chamkimtah-in abolpon ahi.
target: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , but not wholeheartedly.

source: Tun ahitin ahi, lenggam chu ama-a akiphudet phatnin, apa lengpa anathat asohho chu athat tan ahi.
target: After the kingdom was firmly in his control, he executed the officials who had murdered his father the king.

source: Ahinla achate chu athatpoi; Mosi danthupeh lekhabua kisun, Pate chu chate jeh-a thilou ding, chate dinga jong pate jeh-a thilou ding, amavang mitin ama chonset jeh-a thiding ahi, tia Pakaiyin athupeh bangchun abolin ahi.
target: Yet he did not put their children to death, but acted in accordance with what is written in the Law, in the Book of Moses, where the Lord commanded: “Parents shall not be put to death for their children, nor children be put to death for their parents; each will die for their own sin.”

source: Chukalvalin Amaziah'in Judah te akhom khomin, Judah le Benjamin gamsunga apu apateu insung kailhah dungjuijin sang chunga lamkai le ja chunga lamkaijin apansah-in: chule kum somni-a pat chunglamse asima ahile, tengle lum choija gal konthei lhentum cheh mi sangjathum aumuvin ahi.
target: Amaziah called the people of Judah together and assigned them according to their families to commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds for all Judah and Benjamin. He then mustered those twenty years old or more and found that there were three hundred thousand men fit for military service, able to handle the spear and shield.

source: Aman Israel gama kon mihat mihangsan cheh sangjakhat jong dangka talent jakhat-in athalah-e.
target: He also hired a hundred thousand fighting men from Israel for a hundred talents of silver.

source: Ahinla ahenga Pathen mi khat ahungin, Vo lengpa, Israel galsat ho chu lhonpi hih-in; ajehchu Pakaiyin Israel le Ephraim chate aumpipon ahi.
target: But a man of God came to him and said, “Your Majesty, these troops from Israel must not march with you, for the Lord is not with Israel—not with any of the people of Ephraim.

source: Ahin nache ding ahi jongle, boljengin, galsat dingin kisuhatnin: Pathen'in melmate masanga nalhuhsah ding ahi; ajehchu Pathen'in panpi theina le pailhah theina thahat anei ahi, ati.
target: Even if you go and fight courageously in battle, God will overthrow you before the enemy, for God has the power to help or to overthrow.”

source: Chuin Amaziah'in Pathen mipa jah-a, Achutile Israel sepaiho kapeh dangka talent jakhat chu i-ilo dingu hitam? ati. Chuin Pathen mipan adonbutnin, Pakaiyin chuche sanga gamchenga tamjo napehthei ahi, ati.
target: Amaziah asked the man of God, “But what about the hundred talents I paid for these Israelite troops?” The man of God replied, “The Lord can give you much more than that.”

source: Chuphatnin Amaziah'in Ephraim'a kona ahenga hung sepaiho chu in'a kile kitdin achom khentai. Hijeh chun Judah te chunga alunghang lheh jengun, lunghang tah-in inlama akilekit taove.
target: So Amaziah dismissed the troops who had come to him from Ephraim and sent them home. They were furious with Judah and left for home in a great rage.

source: Chuin Amaziah akisuhat nin, amite chu apuidoh-in, chi phaichama acheuvin, Seir miho chu sangsom jen athatnun ahi.
target: Amaziah then marshaled his strength and led his army to the Valley of Salt, where he killed ten thousand men of Seir.

source: Chuin ahing hoiju sangsom dang chu Judah ten gal hingin akaijun, songpi chungvuma akaitouvun, songpi vuma konin asonlhaovin, abonchauvin agoisoh jengun ahi.
target: The army of Judah also captured ten thousand men alive, took them to the top of a cliff and threw them down so that all were dashed to pieces.

source: Ahinla Amaziah'in amatoh galsatna chelou dinga anungsolho chu Samaria apat Beth-horon geijin Judah gam khopiho chunga achuvin, mi sangthum athatnun, thilchom tamtah akipoh uvin ahi.
target: Meanwhile the troops that Amaziah had sent back and had not allowed to take part in the war raided towns belonging to Judah from Samaria to Beth Horon. They killed three thousand people and carried off great quantities of plunder.

source: Tun ahitin ahi, Edom mite athana-a Amaziah ahung kilekit phatnin, Seir chate pathenho chu ahinpon, a-pathen dingin atungdoh-in, a-anguva chun akunin, ahenguva gimnamtui ahalin ahi.
target: When Amaziah returned from slaughtering the Edomites, he brought back the gods of the people of Seir. He set them up as his own gods, bowed down to them and burned sacrifices to them.

source: Hijeh chun Amaziah chunga Pakai lunghan akongjahtan, ahenga themgao khat ahin solin, ama chun ajah-a, Ipi dinga nakhutna kona amite huhdohjoulou chuche mite pathenho najuiham? ati.
target: The anger of the Lord burned against Amaziah, and he sent a prophet to him, who said, “Why do you consult this people’s gods, which could not save their own people from your hand?”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, ajah-a thu aseilai chun, lengpan ajah-a, Nangma lengpa thumopma kisem nahim? kithipmin, ibola kithat ding nahim? ati. Chuin themgaopa chu akhongaijin, Nangman hichehi nabola, kathumop nasan loujeh-in, Pathen'in nangma suhmangdin nagotai ti kahei, ati.
target: While he was still speaking, the king said to him, “Have we appointed you an adviser to the king? Stop! Why be struck down?” So the prophet stopped but said, “I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel.”

source: Chujouvin Judah lengpa Amaziah'in mi thuhilna alan, Israel lengpa Jehoahaz chapa, Jehu chapa, Joash henga mi asolin, Hungin khatle khat kimaito-in kisat hite, agatisah-e.
target: After Amaziah king of Judah consulted his advisers, he sent this challenge to Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel: “Come, let us face each other in battle.”

source: Chuin Israel lengpa Joash'in Judah leng Amaziah henga, Lebanon'a lingphungin Lebanon'a cedar phung jah-a, kachapa jiding nachanu neipen ati; chuin Lebanon'a konin gamsa khat ahungin, lingphung chu achon lhutan ahi.
target: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah: “A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle underfoot.

source: Nangman, Ven, keiman Edom mite kajouve natin, nalung thimin nangma kihoitho sah dingin nadom kangin ahi: tun na-in'a kium thimin; ibola nangma le naumpi Judah mite lhuhna dinga kisalung gima nahim? ati.
target: You say to yourself that you have defeated Edom, and now you are arrogant and proud. But stay at home! Why ask for trouble and cause your own downfall and that of Judah also?”

source: Ahinla Amaziah'in ngaisah ding agopon ahi; ajehchu Edom mite pathenho ahoujeh uva, amelmateu khutna apehdoh theina dinga Pathen thilgon hija ahi.
target: Amaziah, however, would not listen, for God so worked that he might deliver them into the hands of Jehoash, because they sought the gods of Edom.

source: Hitichun Israel lengpa Joash ahung kontouvin, amale Judah lengpa Amaziah chu kimaito-in Judah gamsunga um Beth-shemeash'a kimaiton akisat lhontai.
target: So Jehoash king of Israel attacked. He and Amaziah king of Judah faced each other at Beth Shemesh in Judah.

source: Chuin Judah ten Israelte masanga gal alel taovin, amitakip aponbuh cheh uva ajam taove.
target: Judah was routed by Israel, and every man fled to his home.

source: Chuin Israel lengpan Jehoahaz chapa, Joash chapa, Juda lengpa Amaziah chu Beth-shemesh'a amanin, Jerusalem'a ahinkaijin, Jerusalem kulbang chu Ephraim kotpi-a pat kulning kotpigei tong jalijen asuchimin ahi.
target: Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh. Then Jehoash brought him to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate—a section about four hundred cubits long.

source: Chuin aman Pathen insunga sana le dangka, chule um le bel ho jouse chu, lengpa in'a gouchinga pang Obed-edom le lhachaho pumin akaijin, Samaria'a akiletai.
target: He took all the gold and silver and all the articles found in the temple of God that had been in the care of Obed-Edom, together with the palace treasures and the hostages, and returned to Samaria.

source: Chuin Judah lengpa Joash chapa Amaziah chu, Israel lengpa Jehoahaz chapa Joash thinungin kum somle kumnga ahing nalaije.
target: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.

source: Tun Amaziah thilbol dangho jouse abula pat ajogei chu, vetan, Judah le Israel lengte lekhabua kisunlut hilouham?
target: As for the other events of Amaziah’s reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

source: Tun Amaziah'in Pakai anungsun jouvin, Jerusalem'a chun ama dounan galguh abol taovin, chule ama Lachish'a ajamtai; ahinla Lachish'a mi anungdel sah-un, hia chun athat taove.
target: From the time that Amaziah turned away from following the Lord , they conspired against him in Jerusalem and he fled to Lachish, but they sent men after him to Lachish and killed him there.

source: Chuin sakol ho chunga ahinpouvin, Judah khopi-a chun apu apate toh avuikhom taove.
target: He was brought back by horse and was buried with his ancestors in the City of Judah.

source: Chuin Judah mite jousen kum somlegup hibep Uzziah chu apuijun, apa Amaziah khelin alengchan sah taove.
target: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.

source: Amachun lengpa apu apatetoh alupkhom nungin, Eloth kho chu asaphan, Judah gama alelutsah kit tai.
target: He was the one who rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah after Amaziah rested with his ancestors.

source: Alengchan kipat in Uzziah kum somlegup ahin, Jerusalem'a kum somnga le kumni aleng changin ahi. Anumin chu Jecholiah ahin, Jerusalem mi ahi.
target: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother’s name was Jekoliah; she was from Jerusalem.

source: Chule apa Amaziah thilbol jouse bangin, aman Pakai mitmu-a adih abolin ahi.
target: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father Amaziah had done.

source: Chuin Pathen kilahna hethemna nei Zachariah nikho laisen Pathen aholin; chule Pakai ahol laise chun Pathen'in alolhin sah-in ahi.
target: He sought God during the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God. As long as he sought the Lord , God gave him success.

source: Chuin ama akondoh-in Philistine te akisatpin, Gath kulbang le Jabnah kulbang, chule Ashdod kulbang asuchimin, Ashdod kimvel le Philistine mite lah-a khopiho asan ahi.
target: He went to war against the Philistines and broke down the walls of Gath, Jabneh and Ashdod. He then rebuilt towns near Ashdod and elsewhere among the Philistines.

source: Chuin Pathen'in Philistinte le Gurbaal'a chenga Arab mite, chule Mehunim mite douna-in apanpin ahi.
target: God helped him against the Philistines and against the Arabs who lived in Gur Baal and against the Meunites.

source: Chuin Ammon miten Uzziah chu thilpeh apeuvin: Egypt lutna geijin amin athangin ahi; ajehchu ama nasatah-in akisuhatna ahi.
target: The Ammonites brought tribute to Uzziah, and his fame spread as far as the border of Egypt, because he had become very powerful.

source: Chukalvalin Uzziah'in Jerusalem kotpi ning le, phaicham kotpi, chule kulbang kisuhto na-a chun insang asan, hicheho chu asudetnin ahi.
target: Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate, at the Valley Gate and at the angle of the wall, and he fortified them.

source: Nelphaija jong insang asan, twikul tamtah alaijin ahi: ajehchu aman gamnem laile phaicham ho-a gancha tamtah anei ahi; chule molsang hole Carmel mun'a honlei bolding akoijin ahi; ajehchu loubol ngailu mi ahi.
target: He also built towers in the wilderness and dug many cisterns, because he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain. He had people working his fields and vineyards in the hills and in the fertile lands, for he loved the soil.

source: Chukalvalin Uzziah lengpan agal lamkai khat Hananiah khutnoija lekha sunpa Jeiel le vaipopa Maaseiah khutna ajatnu kisimtoh dungjuijin, ahon honna kondoh-a galbol mi janel aneijin ahi.
target: Uzziah had a well-trained army, ready to go out by divisions according to their numbers as mustered by Jeiel the secretary and Maaseiah the officer under the direction of Hananiah, one of the royal officials.

source: Mihat mihangsan pipuiho jouse chu sangni le jagup alhinguvin ahi.
target: The total number of family leaders over the fighting men was 2,600.

source: Amaho khutnoija thanei tah-a galsat, melma-a kona lengpa panpi thei sepai sangjathum le sangsagi le janga aumuvin ahi.
target: Under their command was an army of 307,500 men trained for war, a powerful force to support the king against his enemies.

source: Chule Uzziah'in sepai jousedin lum, tengcha, thih lukhuh, thih sangkhol, thalpi, chule song sena ahsongse agonpeh cheh-in ahi.
target: Uzziah provided shields, spears, helmets, coats of armor, bows and slingstones for the entire army.

source: Chuin aman Jerusalem'a thilsemdoh themho pohdoh-a konin insang chungle kulpi bangho chunga thal kapdohna dingle songlen lenho kapdohna ding manchah aseme. Chuin gamtina aminthang tan ahi; ajehchu ahat kikhon kahsen kidang tah-in kithopin aumin ahi.
target: In Jerusalem he made devices invented for use on the towers and on the corner defenses so that soldiers could shoot arrows and hurl large stones from the walls. His fame spread far and wide, for he was greatly helped until he became powerful.

source: Ahinla ahung hatdoh phatnin, amanthah nadingin alungthim ahung kichoisang tai. Ajehchu Pakai a-Pathen dounan asuhkhel tan, gimnamtui halna maicham chunga gimnamtui haldingin Pakai houin sung alutnin ahi.
target: But after Uzziah became powerful, his pride led to his downfall. He was unfaithful to the Lord his God, and entered the temple of the Lord to burn incense on the altar of incense.

source: Chuin Azeriah thempupa le mihangsan cheh Pakai thempu mi somgetnin anung ajuilutnun;
target: Azariah the priest with eighty other courageous priests of the Lord followed him in.

source: Chule Uzziah lengpa chu ajahdaovin, ahenga, Uzziah, Pakai henga gimnamtui halhi nang bolding ahipoi, gimnamtui haldinga kithenso Aaron chate thempuho bolding ahibouve: munthenga konin potdoh-in; ijeh inem itile nangman nasukhel tan; Pakaiya kona jabolna nachanna lou ding ahi, atiuve.
target: They confronted King Uzziah and said, “It is not right for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the Lord . That is for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, who have been consecrated to burn incense. Leave the sanctuary, for you have been unfaithful; and you will not be honored by the Lord God.”

source: Hichun Uzziah alunghangin, akhutna gimnamtui halna ding lheng akichoi ahin; chuin thempuho chunga alunghan phatchun, Pakai insunga thempuho masang gimnamtui halna maicham koma chun achalpanga phah ahung chutan ahi.
target: Uzziah, who had a censer in his hand ready to burn incense, became angry. While he was raging at the priests in their presence before the incense altar in the Lord ’s temple, leprosy broke out on his forehead.

source: Chuin thempu chungnung Azariah le thempuho jousen avetnuva ahile, veuvin, achalpang chu anaphahtan, amahon chua konchun asondoh taovin ahi; hichun amatah jong potdoh din akinotan ahi; ajehchu Pakaiyin ama chu aden ahitai.
target: When Azariah the chief priest and all the other priests looked at him, they saw that he had leprosy on his forehead, so they hurried him out. Indeed, he himself was eager to leave, because the Lord had afflicted him.

source: Hitichun Uzziah lengpa chu athikahsen miphah ahitan, miphah ahi jehchun inchoma achengtai; ajehchu Pakai in'a kona kinodoh ahitai. Chuin achapa Jotham chu leng in chunga vaipon apangin, gamsung mite thu atanin ahi.
target: King Uzziah had leprosy until the day he died. He lived in a separate house—leprous, and banned from the temple of the Lord . Jotham his son had charge of the palace and governed the people of the land.

source: Tun Uzziah natoh adang jouse amasa-a pat ajona gei chu, Amoz chapa Isaiah themgaovin asunin ahi.
target: The other events of Uzziah’s reign, from beginning to end, are recorded by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.

source: Hitichun Uzziah chu apu apate toh alumkhomin, lengte kivuina mun'a chun apu apate toh avuitaove; ajehchu amahon, Ama miphah ahi, atiuve. Chuin ama khelin achapa Jotham alengchang tan ahi.
target: Uzziah rested with his ancestors and was buried near them in a cemetery that belonged to the kings, for people said, “He had leprosy.” And Jotham his son succeeded him as king.

source: Jotham alengchan pat chun kum somni le kumnga ahin, Jerusalem'a kum somle kumgup aleng changin ahi. Anu min chu Jerushah ahin, Zadok chanu ahi.
target: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. His mother’s name was Jerusha daughter of Zadok.

source: Chuin aman apa Uzziah'in anabol jouse dungjujin Pakai mitmu-a adih chu abolin ahi: ahijeng vangin ama Pakai houin sunga analutpoi. Ahin mipichun thilphalou abol nalaijun ahi.
target: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father Uzziah had done, but unlike him he did not enter the temple of the Lord . The people, however, continued their corrupt practices.

source: Aman Pakai houin kotpi sang chu asan, chule Ophel kulbang chu nasatah-in asan ahi.
target: Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the temple of the Lord and did extensive work on the wall at the hill of Ophel.

source: Chukalvalin Judah molsang ho-a khopiho asan, gam mangho-a chun in thupi tahtah le insangho asan ahi.
target: He built towns in the hill country of Judah and forts and towers in the wooded areas.

source: Ammon lengpa tojong akisatnin, amaho chu ajouvin ahi. Chule Ammon chaten hiche kum mama chun dangka talent jakhat toh suhlouchang atena dim sangsom le sakolchang atena dim sangsom apeuvin ahi. Hitichun Ammon chaten amachu akum ninale thum na-in jong tamtah tah apeuve.
target: Jotham waged war against the king of the Ammonites and conquered them. That year the Ammonites paid him a hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat and ten thousand cors of barley. The Ammonites brought him the same amount also in the second and third years.

source: Hitichun jotham'in Pakai Pathen anga alampi akigontup jeh-in, ahung hat lhehtan ahi.
target: Jotham grew powerful because he walked steadfastly before the Lord his God.

source: Tun Jotham thilbolho dangho jouse, agalbolho jouse, alamlhah jouse chu, veuvin, Israel le Judah lengte lakhabu-a akijihlut cheh-e.
target: The other events in Jotham’s reign, including all his wars and the other things he did, are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

source: Ama alengchan pat chun kum somni le nga ahin, Jerusalem'a kum somle kumgup lengvai apon ahi.
target: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years.

source: Chuin Jotham apu apate toh alumkhomin, David khopi-a avuitaove: chuin achapa Ahaz chu ama khelin alengchang tan ahi.
target: Jotham rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. And Ahaz his son succeeded him as king.

source: Ahaz alengchan pat chun kum somni ahin, Jerusalem'a kum somle kumgup aleng changin ahi. Ahin aman apu David bangin Pakai mitmun adih abolpon ahi.
target: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. Unlike David his father, he did not do what was right in the eyes of the Lord .

source: Ajehchu Israel lengho lamlhah ajuijin, Baalim kilhajol jong asemin ahi.
target: He followed the ways of the kings of Israel and also made idols for worshiping the Baals.

source: Chukalvalin Hinnom chapa phaichama chun gimnamtui ahalin, Pakaiyin Israelte masanga anodohsa namho thilbol thet umtah bangin, aman achate chu meija agouvin ahi.
target: He burned sacrifices in the Valley of Ben Hinnom and sacrificed his children in the fire, engaging in the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.

source: Aman munsang ho, lhangho, chule thinghing noi tina kilhaina abolin, gimnamtui ahalin ahi.
target: He offered sacrifices and burned incense at the high places, on the hilltops and under every spreading tree.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai a-Pathen'in Syria lengpa khutna apedoh-in, amahon akisat piuvin, amaho tamtah gal hingin akaijun, Damascus'a apui taove. Chule Israel lengpa khutna jong pehdoh-in aumin, aman ajouvin, mi tamtah athatnin ahi.
target: Therefore the Lord his God delivered him into the hands of the king of Aram. The Arameans defeated him and took many of his people as prisoners and brought them to Damascus. He was also given into the hands of the king of Israel, who inflicted heavy casualties on him.

source: Ajehchu Remaliah chapa Pekah chun nikhat sungin Judah te sangjakhat le sangsomni athatnin, abonuva mihangsan cheh ahiuve; ajehchu amahon apu apateu Pakai Pathen anungsun taovin ahi.
target: In one day Pekah son of Remaliah killed a hundred and twenty thousand soldiers in Judah—because Judah had forsaken the Lord , the God of their ancestors.

source: Chuin Ephraim mihatpa Zichri chun lengpa chapa Maaseiah le insung vaipo Azrikam, chule lengpa noidou Elkanah chu athatnin ahi.
target: Zikri, an Ephraimite warrior, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the officer in charge of the palace, and Elkanah, second to the king.

source: Chuin Israel ten asopiteu lah-a konin mi sangjani, numei ho, achapateu, chule achanuteu chu gal hingin akaimangun, amaho-a konin galthil tamtah jong apomangun, galthil kichomho chu Samaria'a ahinpouvin ahi.
target: The men of Israel took captive from their fellow Israelites who were from Judah two hundred thousand wives, sons and daughters. They also took a great deal of plunder, which they carried back to Samaria.

source: Ahinla Pakai themgao khat hia chun anaumin, amin Oded ahi: chuin ama Samaria'a hung janelho masanga chun achen, ajah uva, Judah te chunga napu napateu Pakai Pathen alunghan jeh-in amaho chu nakhut uva apedoh-in, ahin nanghon lunghan manin nathatnun, hichu van ahung geitai.
target: But a prophet of the Lord named Oded was there, and he went out to meet the army when it returned to Samaria. He said to them, “Because the Lord , the God of your ancestors, was angry with Judah, he gave them into your hand. But you have slaughtered them in a rage that reaches to heaven.

source: Chule nanghon Judah le Jerusalem mite chu nanoi uva soh numei le soh pasal'a vulding nagouvin ahi: ahinla nangho-a jong, nangho tah ngeija jong Pakai na Pathen'u douna-a chonset uma hilouham?
target: And now you intend to make the men and women of Judah and Jerusalem your slaves. But aren’t you also guilty of sins against the Lord your God?

source: Hijeh chun tun kasei ngaijun lang, nasopiteu lah-a kon gal-hinga nahinkaiju, gal-hingho chu lhadoh kit taovin; ajehchu tijat umtah Pakai lunghanna chu nachung uva aumtai, ati.
target: Now listen to me! Send back your fellow Israelites you have taken as prisoners, for the Lord ’s fierce anger rests on you.”

source: Chuin Ephraim chate lamkaiho phabep, Johanan chapa Azariah, Mishillemoth chapa Berechiah, Shallum chapa Jehizkiah, chule Hadlai chapa Amasa chu galmuna kona hungho dounan adingdoh-un;
target: Then some of the leaders in Ephraim—Azariah son of Jehohanan, Berekiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai—confronted those who were arriving from the war.

source: Ajah uva chun, Gal hinga namathou chu hilama nahinkai loudiu ahi: ajehchu Pakai douna-a ikhel nao chungchona, ichonset nao le isuhkhel nau belap ding go-a nahiuve: ijeh inem itile isuhkhelu alenin, Israelte douna-a tijat umtah lunghan chua ahitai, atiuve.
target: “You must not bring those prisoners here,” they said, “or we will be guilty before the Lord . Do you intend to add to our sin and guilt? For our guilt is already great, and his fierce anger rests on Israel.”

source: Hitichun sepaihon gal hingho le galthil kichomho chu pipuiho le houkhom ho masanga adalha taove.
target: So the soldiers gave up the prisoners and plunder in the presence of the officials and all the assembly.

source: Chuin akimin phahho chu akipatnun, gal-hinga kimanho chu apuijun, galthil ho-a kon chun alah uva sagoh keova umho chu von avonpeh-un, kengchot asepeh-un, nehding le donding apeuvin, thao anuvin; achatmo jouse sangan chunga atousah-un, lusu kena khopi-a asopiteu umna Jericho'a apuijun; chuin amaho Samaria'a akile taove.
target: The men designated by name took the prisoners, and from the plunder they clothed all who were naked. They provided them with clothes and sandals, food and drink, and healing balm. All those who were weak they put on donkeys. So they took them back to their fellow Israelites at Jericho, the City of Palms, and returned to Samaria.

source: Hichelai chun Ahaz lengpan Assyria lengpa ahin panpi nadingin ahenga mi asolin ahi.
target: At that time King Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria for help.

source: Ajehchu Edom miten Judah te ahung satkit uvin, gal hingin akai kit taove.
target: The Edomites had again come and attacked Judah and carried away prisoners,

source: Chuin Philistine ten jong gamnem khopiho le Judah lhanglam ahin buluvin, Beth-shemesh, Aijalon le Gederoth, chule Shocho chu akhoneo hou pumin, Timnah chu akhoneo hou pumin, Gimzo jong akhoneo hou pumin alauvin, hia chun acheng taove.
target: while the Philistines had raided towns in the foothills and in the Negev of Judah. They captured and occupied Beth Shemesh, Aijalon and Gederoth, as well as Soko, Timnah and Gimzo, with their surrounding villages.

source: Ajehchu Israel lengpa Ahaz jeh-a Pakaiyin Judah asuhnem ahi; ajehchu Judah chu sagoh-a aumsah-a, Pakai douna nasatah-a chonkhel ahi.
target: The Lord had humbled Judah because of Ahaz king of Israel, for he had promoted wickedness in Judah and had been most unfaithful to the Lord .

source: Chule Assyria lengpa Tilgath-pilneser chu ahenga ahungin, hatsah jolouvin, ahung sugenthei jin ahi.
target: Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria came to him, but he gave him trouble instead of help.

source: Ajehchu Ahaz'in Pakai in'a konle lengpa in'a kon, chule pipuiho-a kona thil mantamho alah doh-a Assyria lengpa chu apeh ahin; ahinla aman apanpipon ahi.
target: Ahaz took some of the things from the temple of the Lord and from the royal palace and from the officials and presented them to the king of Assyria, but that did not help him.

source: Chule alung genthei laitah-in jong Pakai douna suhkhel aneibebe jengin ahi: hichehi Ahaz lengpa chu ahi.
target: In his time of trouble King Ahaz became even more unfaithful to the Lord .

source: Ajehchu aman alel Damascus te pathenho henga ganlhai abolin; chule aman, Syria lengte chu a-pathen houvin apanpi jeh-un, keima jong eipanpi theina diuvin, amaho henga ganlhaina bolinge, ati ahi. Ahinla amaho chu amale Israelte jouse manthah na ahi.
target: He offered sacrifices to the gods of Damascus, who had defeated him; for he thought, “Since the gods of the kings of Aram have helped them, I will sacrifice to them so they will help me.” But they were his downfall and the downfall of all Israel.

source: Chuin Ahaz'in Pathen in'a umle bel ho achom khomin, Pathen in'a umle bel ho chu asatse gamin, Pakai in kot akhahchah-in, Jerusalem ningkoi tina ama dingin maicham akisemin ahi.
target: Ahaz gathered together the furnishings from the temple of God and cut them in pieces. He shut the doors of the Lord ’s temple and set up altars at every street corner in Jerusalem.

source: Chule Judah te khopi tamtah-a pathen dangho henga gimnamtui halna ding munsang ho asemin, apu apate Pakai Pathen alunghan sah-in ahi.
target: In every town in Judah he built high places to burn sacrifices to other gods and aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of his ancestors.

source: Tun athilbol dangho le achondan dangho jouse abula pat achaigei chu, veuvin, Judah le Israel leng teho lekhabua akisun cheh-in ahi.
target: The other events of his reign and all his ways, from beginning to end, are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

source: Chuin Ahaz chu apu apatetoh alumkhomin, khopisung Jerusalem ngeija chun avuitaove: ahinla Israel lengte lhana chun akoipouve. Chuin achapa Hezekiah chu ama khelin alengchang tan ahi.
target: Ahaz rested with his ancestors and was buried in the city of Jerusalem, but he was not placed in the tombs of the kings of Israel. And Hezekiah his son succeeded him as king.

source: Hezekiah alengchan pat chun kum somni le kumnga ahin, Jerusalem'a kum somni le kumko aleng changin ahi. Anu minchu Abijah ahin, Zekeriah chanu ahi.
target: Hezekiah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Abijah daughter of Zechariah.

source: Ama apa David'in anabolho jouse bangin Pakai mitmu-a adih abolin ahi.
target: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , just as his father David had done.

source: Alengchan kipat kum, lha masapen-in Pakai in kotho chu ahongin, asemphan ahi.
target: In the first month of the first year of his reign, he opened the doors of the temple of the Lord and repaired them.

source: Aman thempuho le Levi ho apuilutnin, solam khopi lamlena akhom khomin,
target: He brought in the priests and the Levites, assembled them in the square on the east side

source: Chuin ajah uva, Nangho Levi ho, kathu ngaijun, tun nanghole nangho kisuthengun lang, napu napateu Pakai Pathen in jong suthengun, chule munthenga konin abohho chu podoh uvin.
target: and said: “Listen to me, Levites! Consecrate yourselves now and consecrate the temple of the Lord , the God of your ancestors. Remove all defilement from the sanctuary.

source: Ajehchu ipateovin asukhelun, Pakai i-Pathen'u mitmu-a thilphalou anabolun, chule ama adalhaovin, Pakai chenna mun'a konin amai aheimangun, anung ngat taove.
target: Our parents were unfaithful; they did evil in the eyes of the Lord our God and forsook him. They turned their faces away from the Lord ’s dwelling place and turned their backs on him.

source: Chujongle hongcha kotho akhah-un, meivah ho asumitnun, muntheng sunga chun Israel Pakai Pathen henga gimnamtui ahal pouvin chule govam thilto jong atohpouve.
target: They also shut the doors of the portico and put out the lamps. They did not burn incense or present any burnt offerings at the sanctuary to the God of Israel.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai lunghanna chu Judah le Jerusalem mite chunga achutan, namit tah uva namu-u bangin boina, lungkidanna, chule khoisatna henga apedoh taovin ahi.
target: Therefore, the anger of the Lord has fallen on Judah and Jerusalem; he has made them an object of dread and horror and scorn, as you can see with your own eyes.

source: Ijeh inem itile veuvin, ipu ipateu chu chemhemin alouvun, hichejeh hin ichapateu le ichanuteu chule ijiteu asohchang taove.
target: This is why our fathers have fallen by the sword and why our sons and daughters and our wives are in captivity.

source: Tun alunghana tijat umtah chu eihoa kona aheimang theina dingin, Pakai Israel Pathen toh kitepna semding kalunga aumin ahi.
target: Now I intend to make a covenant with the Lord , the God of Israel, so that his fierce anger will turn away from us.

source: Ka chapateho, tun nahsahmon bolhih-un: ajehchu Pakaiyin nangho hi a-angsunga dingding, ama jending, alhacha na tongding, chule gimnamtui hal nadinga nalhenu ahi, ati.
target: My sons, do not be negligent now, for the Lord has chosen you to stand before him and serve him, to minister before him and to burn incense.”

source: Hichun Levi miho chu, Kohath chapate lah-a kon Amasai chapa Mahat le Azeriah chapa Joel: chule Merari chapate lah-a kon Abdi chapa Kish, Jehalelel chapa Azariah: Gershon mite lah-a kon Zimmah chapa Joash le Joash chapa Eden,
target: Then these Levites set to work: from the Kohathites, Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah; from the Merarites, Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel; from the Gershonites, Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah;

source: Chule Elizaphan chapate lah-a kon Shimri le Jeiel: Asaph chapate lah-a kon Zechariah le Mattaniah,
target: from the descendants of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeiel; from the descendants of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;

source: Chule Heman chapate lah-a kon Jehiuel le Shimei: Jeduthun chapate lah-a kon Shemaiah le Uzziel akipat doh-un ahi.
target: from the descendants of Heman, Jehiel and Shimei; from the descendants of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.

source: Chuin asopiteu akou khomun, akisuthengun, Pakai thua kona lengpa thupeh dungjuijin Pakai in sutheng ding chun ahungtaove.
target: When they had assembled their fellow Levites and consecrated themselves, they went in to purify the temple of the Lord , as the king had ordered, following the word of the Lord .

source: Chuin thempuho chu asutheng dingin Pakai in sungnunga alutnun, Pakai houin sung athenglou amujouseu chu Pakai inhong sunga ahinpodoh uvin ahi. Chuin Levi mihon Kidron vadung lama pohdoh dingin alauvin ahi.
target: The priests went into the sanctuary of the Lord to purify it. They brought out to the courtyard of the Lord ’s temple everything unclean that they found in the temple of the Lord . The Levites took it and carried it out to the Kidron Valley.

source: Tun lha masapen nimasanin asutheng pannun, chuchelha nigetnin Pakai hongcha-a ahungun, niget sungin Pakai in chu asuthengun, lha masa nisomle nigupnin ajona asemtaove.
target: They began the consecration on the first day of the first month, and by the eighth day of the month they reached the portico of the Lord . For eight more days they consecrated the temple of the Lord itself, finishing on the sixteenth day of the first month.

source: Chuin Hezekiah lengpa henga ahungun, ajah-a, Pakai in jouse le govam thiltona maicham chu a-umle belho jousetoh, chule vetsahna changlhah dokhang chu a-umle bel jouse toh kasutheng soh hel taove.
target: Then they went in to King Hezekiah and reported: “We have purified the entire temple of the Lord , the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the table for setting out the consecrated bread, with all its articles.

source: Chukalvalin Ahaz lengpan alengvaipoh laija asuhkhelna apaimang um le bel jouse chu kagong toh-un, kasutheng uvin, chule ven, hicheho chu Pakai maicham masanga aumuve, atiuve.
target: We have prepared and consecrated all the articles that King Ahaz removed in his unfaithfulness while he was king. They are now in front of the Lord ’s altar.”

source: Hichun Hezekiah lengpa matah-in athouvin, khopi sunga vaihomho akhomin, Pakai houin lama achetou taove.
target: Early the next morning King Hezekiah gathered the city officials together and went up to the temple of the Lord .

source: Chuin lenggam le muntheng chule Judah dinga chonset thilto dingin bongchal sagi, kelngoichal sagi, kelngoinou sagi, chule kelchal sagi ahin kaijun ahi. Chuin hicheho chu Pakai maicham chunga tohdoh dingin Aaron chapate thempuho chu athupeh-in ahi.
target: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven male lambs and seven male goats as a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary and for Judah. The king commanded the priests, the descendants of Aaron, to offer these on the altar of the Lord .

source: Hitichun bongchal ho chu athatnun, thempuhon athi chu alauvin, maicham chunga atheuvin; hitobang machun kelngoichal ho chu atha phatnun, athi chu maicham chunga atheuvin; kelngoinou ho jong athatnun, athichu maicham chunga atheuvin ahi.
target: So they slaughtered the bulls, and the priests took the blood and splashed it against the altar; next they slaughtered the rams and splashed their blood against the altar; then they slaughtered the lambs and splashed their blood against the altar.

source: Chuin kelchalho chu chonset thilto dingin lengpa le houkhom ho masanga ahinkaijun; hicheho chunga chun akhutnu angamun:
target: The goats for the sin offering were brought before the king and the assembly, and they laid their hands on them.

source: Chuin thempu hon hicheho chu athatnun, Israelte jouse-a dinga lhatdohna bolna dingin maicham chunga athisana kichamna asemun ahi: ajehchu lengpan govam thilto le chonset thilto chu Israelte jouse-a dinga boldingin athupeh-in ahi.
target: The priests then slaughtered the goats and presented their blood on the altar for a sin offering to atone for all Israel, because the king had ordered the burnt offering and the sin offering for all Israel.

source: Chuin David le lengpa themgao Gad chule Nathan themgao thupeh bangin, Pakai in'a chun Levi ho chu thih khutbeh, tumging le selangdah ho tumdin akoijun ahi: ijeh inem itile hitia chu boldinga Pakaiyin athemgaoho-a kona thu apeh ahi.
target: He stationed the Levites in the temple of the Lord with cymbals, harps and lyres in the way prescribed by David and Gad the king’s seer and Nathan the prophet; this was commanded by the Lord through his prophets.

source: Chule Levi ho chu David manchah ho toh, chule thempuho chu sumkon toh adingun ahi.
target: So the Levites stood ready with David’s instruments, and the priests with their trumpets.

source: Chuin Hezekiah'in maicham chunga chu govam thilto ato dinguvin thupeh aneijin ahi. Chuin govam thilto atopat phatnun, sumkon le Israel lengpa David manchah ho toh kithon Pakai la chu asapan taovin ahi.
target: Hezekiah gave the order to sacrifice the burnt offering on the altar. As the offering began, singing to the Lord began also, accompanied by trumpets and the instruments of David king of Israel.

source: Chuin houkhom ho jousen Pathen ahouvun, lasahon la asauvin, sumkon mut hon sumkon amutnun: hicheho jousehi govam thilto kichai kahsen aboljom jingun ahi.
target: The whole assembly bowed in worship, while the musicians played and the trumpets sounded. All this continued until the sacrifice of the burnt offering was completed.

source: Chuin thilto ajophatnun, lengpa le aumpiho jouse akunun, Pathen ahou taovin ahi.
target: When the offerings were finished, the king and everyone present with him knelt down and worshiped.

source: Achung chonin lengpa Hezekiah le pipuihon David le mitvanei Asaph sem Pakai la sadingin Levi ho thu apeuvin ahi. Chuin amahon kipahtah-in vahchoi la asaovin, akunun Pathen ahou uvin ahi.
target: King Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to praise the Lord with the words of David and of Asaph the seer. So they sang praises with gladness and bowed down and worshiped.

source: Hichun Hezekiah'in adonbutnin, Tun nangho Pakaiya dinga kisuhtheng nahitah-u toh kilhonin, hung naijun lang ganlhaina le thangvahna thilto hochu Pakai in sunga hin choijun, ati. Chuin houkhom ho chun ganlhaina le thangvahna thilto hochu ahinchoi lutnun; chule alungthima kiphalna neichan chun govam thilto atoh-un ahi.
target: Then Hezekiah said, “You have now dedicated yourselves to the Lord . Come and bring sacrifices and thank offerings to the temple of the Lord .” So the assembly brought sacrifices and thank offerings, and all whose hearts were willing brought burnt offerings.

source: Chule houkhom ho hinto govam thilto jat chu bongchal somsagi, kelngoi chal jakhat, kelngoi nou jani ahi. Hicheho jousehi Pakai henga govam thilto-a ding ahi.
target: The number of burnt offerings the assembly brought was seventy bulls, a hundred rams and two hundred male lambs—all of them for burnt offerings to the Lord .

source: Chule thil kithensoho chu bongchal jagup le kelngoi sangthum ahi.
target: The animals consecrated as sacrifices amounted to six hundred bulls and three thousand sheep and goats.

source: Ahinla thempuho alhom behseh jeh-u chun govam thilto jouse chu avun alipjou pouvin; hijeh chun natoh kichai kahsehle thempu dangho akisuhtheng kahseuvin asopihou Levi ho chun akitho piuvin ahi: ajehchu amaho le amaho kisuhtheng nalama Levi ho chu thempuho sangin alungdih jouvin ahi.
target: The priests, however, were too few to skin all the burnt offerings; so their relatives the Levites helped them until the task was finished and until other priests had been consecrated, for the Levites had been more conscientious in consecrating themselves than the priests had been.

source: Chujongle govam thiltoho, chamna thilto-a dinga athao ho, chule govam thilto jouse-a dinga don thiltoho chu atamlheh jengin ahi. Hitichun Pakai houin lhacha natoh dan chu akigoltoh chetnin ahi.
target: There were burnt offerings in abundance, together with the fat of the fellowship offerings and the drink offerings that accompanied the burnt offerings. So the service of the temple of the Lord was reestablished.

source: Chuin Pathen'in mipi agontup jeh chun Hezekiah le mipi chu akipah lheh jenguvin ahi: ajehchu thilchu photlotna kibol ahi.
target: Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced at what God had brought about for his people, because it was done so quickly.

source: Chuin Hezekiah'in Israelte le Judah te jouse henga mi asolin, chule Ephraim le Manasseh henga jong, Pakai houin Jerusalem mun'a ahunguva, Israel Pakai Pathen henga kalchuh kut ahung manna diuvin lekha athotnin ahi.
target: Hezekiah sent word to all Israel and Judah and also wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasseh, inviting them to come to the temple of the Lord in Jerusalem and celebrate the Passover to the Lord , the God of Israel.

source: Ajehchu lengpa le apipuiho chule Jerusalem'a houkhom ho jouse chu lhanina-a kalchuh kut mang dinga kihoutoh-u ahi.
target: The king and his officials and the whole assembly in Jerusalem decided to celebrate the Passover in the second month.

source: Ajehchu thempuho bulhing setna akisuh theng lou jeh-u le, mipi ho jong Jerusalem'a ahung kikhopkhom loujeh uva, hichepetna chu amanthei louvu ahi.
target: They had not been able to celebrate it at the regular time because not enough priests had consecrated themselves and the people had not assembled in Jerusalem.

source: Chule hiche thilhin lengpa le houkhom ho jouse alung lhaisah lheh-in ahi.
target: The plan seemed right both to the king and to the whole assembly.

source: Hitichun Beersheba'a pat Dan geija Israelte jouse henga, Jerusalem'a ahunguva Israel Pakai Pathen henga kalchuh kut ahungman diuva phonjal dingin akilol lha taovin ahi: ajehchu akisutdan bangtah a phat sottah anabol louvu ahitai.
target: They decided to send a proclamation throughout Israel, from Beersheba to Dan, calling the people to come to Jerusalem and celebrate the Passover to the Lord , the God of Israel. It had not been celebrated in large numbers according to what was written.

source: Hitichun lekha thah ho chu lengpa le pipuiho-a kona lekhathot pumin Israel le Judah gamjousea acheuvin, lengpa thupeh bangin hitin agaseijuve, Israel chate, nangho Abraham, Isaac, chule Israel Pakai Pathen henga hungkileuvin, chutile ama nangho Assyria lengte khutna kona hoidoh amohho henglama hungkile kitding ahi.
target: At the king’s command, couriers went throughout Israel and Judah with letters from the king and from his officials, which read: “People of Israel, return to the Lord , the God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, that he may return to you who are left, who have escaped from the hand of the kings of Assyria.

source: Chule nangho apu apateu Pakai Pathen douna-a sukhela napu napateu le nasopiteu bangin umhih-un, hijeh-a chu namu-u bangahi aman amaho chu akamhel dinga apehdoh-u ahitai.
target: Do not be like your parents and your fellow Israelites, who were unfaithful to the Lord , the God of their ancestors, so that he made them an object of horror, as you see.

source: Tun nangho napu napateu bangin lungtah hih-un, Pakai henga nangho le nangho kipelut unlang, a-itih-a dinga asuhthengsa amunthenga chun lutjouvin: chule alunghana tijat umtah chu nangho-a kona aheimang theinadin, Pakai na Pathen'u kin boluvin.
target: Do not be stiff-necked, as your ancestors were; submit to the Lord . Come to his sanctuary, which he has consecrated forever. Serve the Lord your God, so that his fierce anger will turn away from you.

source: Ajehchu Pakai heng lama nahung kilehei kitnuva ahile, nasopiteu le nachateo chu hiche gama ahung kilekit nadinguva gal hinga akaimanghou angsunga lungsetna chang dingu ahi: ajehchu Pakai na Pathen'u chu lungset le hepina-a dim ahin, nangho ama heng lama nakile heijuva ahile, aman nangho-a kona amai aheimang louding ahi, atiuve.
target: If you return to the Lord , then your fellow Israelites and your children will be shown compassion by their captors and will return to this land, for the Lord your God is gracious and compassionate. He will not turn his face from you if you return to him.”

source: Hitichun lekha thah ho chu Ephraim le Manasseh chule Zebulun geipeh-in khopitina acheuvin: ahinla amahon anuisatnun anahsah pouvin ahi.
target: The couriers went from town to town in Ephraim and Manasseh, as far as Zebulun, but people scorned and ridiculed them.

source: Ahijeng vangin Asher le Manasseh chule Zebulun mi phabep akineosah-un, Jerusalem'a ahungun ahi.
target: Nevertheless, some from Asher, Manasseh and Zebulun humbled themselves and went to Jerusalem.

source: Pakai thua kona lengpa le pipuiho thupeh jopnadin, Judah gamsung jong Pathen'in lungkhat aputsah uve.
target: Also in Judah the hand of God was on the people to give them unity of mind to carry out what the king and his officials had ordered, following the word of the Lord .

source: Chuin alhanina-in cholsolou changlhah kut mangdin Jerusalem'a mi tamtah, mipi atama tam akikhomun ahi.
target: A very large crowd of people assembled in Jerusalem to celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread in the second month.

source: Chuin amaho akipatnun Jerusalem'a maicham ho chule gimnamtui halna maicham ho aladoh-un, Kidron vadunga aseplut taove.
target: They removed the altars in Jerusalem and cleared away the incense altars and threw them into the Kidron Valley.

source: Hichun amahon lhanina nisomle nilinin kalchuh kut ding gan athatnun ahi: chuin thempuho le Levi ho chu ajahcha taovin, chuphatnin amahole amaho akisuthengun, govam thiltoho chu Pakai insunga alalut taovin ahi.
target: They slaughtered the Passover lamb on the fourteenth day of the second month. The priests and the Levites were ashamed and consecrated themselves and brought burnt offerings to the temple of the Lord .

source: Chuin Pathen mi Mosi danthu dungjuijin, amaho chongai danin ama muncheh-a adingun: thempuhon Levi ho khutna alah-u thisan chu atheuvin ahi.
