target: Then they took up their regular positions as prescribed in the Law of Moses the man of God. The priests splashed against the altar the blood handed to them by the Levites.

source: Ajehchu houkhom ho lah-a mi tamtah kisutheng lou aum nalaijun: Pakaiya dinga suhtheng ahina diuva, athenglou takipma dinga kalchuh kut sa thapeh ding mopohna chu Levi ho changuva ahi.
target: Since many in the crowd had not consecrated themselves, the Levites had to kill the Passover lambs for all those who were not ceremonially clean and could not consecrate their lambs to the Lord .

source: Ajehchu mipi choplop, Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar le Zebulun'a kon mi tamtah chu kisutheng lou ahiuvin, ahinla akisun banglouvin amahon kalchuh kut an chu ane jenguvin ahi. Ahinla Hezekiah'in amaho ataopeh-in, Pakai Phatah chun amitakip,
target: Although most of the many people who came from Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar and Zebulun had not purified themselves, yet they ate the Passover, contrary to what was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, “May the Lord , who is good, pardon everyone

source: Munthenga kisuhthengna dungjuija thenga hihih jongle, Pathen, apu apateu Pakai Pathen holdinga alungsunga kigotna neichan chu ngaidamhen, ati.
target: who sets their heart on seeking God—the Lord , the God of their ancestors—even if they are not clean according to the rules of the sanctuary.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Hezekiah taona asanpeh-in, mipi chu asudamtai.
target: And the Lord heard Hezekiah and healed the people.

source: Chuin Jerusalem'a um Israel chate chun cholsolou changlhah kut chu kipana nasatah-in nisagi amangun: Levi ho le thempuho chun ani anin Pakai avahchoijun, manchah gingtah pumin Pakaiya la asaove.
target: The Israelites who were present in Jerusalem celebrated the Festival of Unleavened Bread for seven days with great rejoicing, while the Levites and priests praised the Lord every day with resounding instruments dedicated to the Lord .

source: Chuin Hezekiah'in Pakai hetna phatah thuhila pang Levi ho jouse henga lhamona thu aseijin: amahon apu apateu Pakai Pathen henga chamna thilto atoh-un, chonset phondohna aneijun, chule kut ni sagi lhumkeijin aneuvin ahi.
target: Hezekiah spoke encouragingly to all the Levites, who showed good understanding of the service of the Lord . For the seven days they ate their assigned portion and offered fellowship offerings and praised the Lord , the God of their ancestors.

source: Chuin khoppi pumpi chu nisagi bang manbe dingin akihouvun, kipahtah-in nisagi amanbe kitnun ahi.
target: The whole assembly then agreed to celebrate the festival seven more days; so for another seven days they celebrated joyfully.

source: Ajehchu Judah lengpa Hezekiah'in houkhom ho chu bongchal sangkhat le kelngoi sangsagi apen; chule pipuiho chun houkhom ho chu bongchal sangkhat le kelngoi sangsom apeuvin: thempu tamtah akisuthengun ahi.
target: Hezekiah king of Judah provided a thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep and goats for the assembly, and the officials provided them with a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep and goats. A great number of priests consecrated themselves.

source: Chuin Judah gam houkhom ho jouse, thempuho le Levi ho toh, chule Israel gama kona hungdoh houkhom ho jouse, Israel gama kona hungdoh-a Juda gama cheng gamdang mijouse jouse chu akipah-un ahi.
target: The entire assembly of Judah rejoiced, along with the priests and Levites and all who had assembled from Israel, including the foreigners who had come from Israel and also those who resided in Judah.

source: Hitichun Jerusalem'a kipana nasatah aume: ajehchu Israel lengpa David chapa Solomon nikho-a patnin chutobangtah kipana chu ana umkhapon ahi.
target: There was great joy in Jerusalem, for since the days of Solomon son of David king of Israel there had been nothing like this in Jerusalem.

source: Chuphatnin thempuho le Levi ho chu akipat doh-un, mipi chu phatthei abohtauve: chuin athuseiju chu ngaipeh-in aumin, ataonao chu achenna muntheng van geijin alhungin ahi.
target: The priests and the Levites stood to bless the people, and God heard them, for their prayer reached heaven, his holy dwelling place.

source: Tun hicheho jouse akichai nunghin, chua um Israelte jouse chu Judah khopiho-a acheuvin, song milimho avochipmun, thingbomho aphulhuvin, Judah le Benjamin gam, Ephraim le Manasseh gamho-a konin munsang ho le maicham ho jouse chu abeihel kahsen aphuhlhu uvin ahi. Chuin Israel chate jouse akinung leuvin, amitakip agoulona akhopi cheh uva akile taovin ahi.
target: When all this had ended, the Israelites who were there went out to the towns of Judah, smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles. They destroyed the high places and the altars throughout Judah and Benjamin and in Ephraim and Manasseh. After they had destroyed all of them, the Israelites returned to their own towns and to their own property.

source: Chuin Hezekiah'in thempuho le Levi kihom khenho chu akihopkhen dungjuijun atoh dingu akomu peh-in, amitakip akinbol dingu dungjui cheh-in, thempuho le Levi ho chu govam thilto le chamna thilto toh ding, lhacha natong ding, thangvahna peding, Pakai ponbuh kotpi phunga vahchoi jingdingin angansen ahi.
target: Hezekiah assigned the priests and Levites to divisions—each of them according to their duties as priests or Levites—to offer burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, to minister, to give thanks and to sing praises at the gates of the Lord ’s dwelling.

source: Aman Pakai dan thupeh-a kisun banga, jingkah le nilhah-a dinga govam thilto ding; choldo nikho, lhathah nikho, chule kut bineiho-a dinga govam thilto dingho chu lengpa neile gouva konin aman apohdoh dingin agongin ahi.
target: The king contributed from his own possessions for the morning and evening burnt offerings and for the burnt offerings on the Sabbaths, at the New Moons and at the appointed festivals as written in the Law of the Lord .

source: Chukalvalin Pakai danthu-a akitilkhou theina diuvin Jerusalem'a cheng mipi ho chu thempuho le Levi ho chan pedingin athupeh-in ahi.
target: He ordered the people living in Jerusalem to give the portion due the priests and Levites so they could devote themselves to the Law of the Lord .

source: Chuin thupeh ahung kithejal jal-in, Israel chaten chang, lengpitwi, thao, khoiju, chule lousoh jouse-a kon gamasaho chu ninglhing tah-in ahinpolut nun ahi.
target: As soon as the order went out, the Israelites generously gave the firstfruits of their grain, new wine, olive oil and honey and all that the fields produced. They brought a great amount, a tithe of everything.

source: Chule Judah khopiho-a cheng Israel le Judah chate thudol chu, amahon jong bongchal le kelngoiho hopsom, chule Pakai a-Pathen uva dinga kikatdoh thilthengho hopsom ahinpeuvin, asevum jengun ahi.
target: The people of Israel and Judah who lived in the towns of Judah also brought a tithe of their herds and flocks and a tithe of the holy things dedicated to the Lord their God, and they piled them in heaps.

source: Lha thum na-a asetvum patnu ahin, lha sagina-in ajou uvin ahi.
target: They began doing this in the third month and finished in the seventh month.

source: Chule Hezekiah le pipuiho chu ahunguva, akisevum chu amuphatnun, Pakai le amite Israelte chu phatthei aboh taovin ahi.
target: When Hezekiah and his officials came and saw the heaps, they praised the Lord and blessed his people Israel.

source: Chuphatnin Hezekiah'in akisevum thudol chu thempuho le Levi ho chu adongin ahi.
target: Hezekiah asked the priests and Levites about the heaps;

source: Chuin Zadok insung mi Azariah thempu chungnung'in adonbutnun, Mipihon Pakai insunga thilto ahinpohlut patnuva patnin nehding bulhing setnin kaneijun, tamtah avaldoh nalaijin ahi: ajehchu Pakaiyin amite phatthei aboh-in, chule thil hijatpi hi amoh chengse chu ahi, ati.
target: and Azariah the chief priest, from the family of Zadok, answered, “Since the people began to bring their contributions to the temple of the Lord , we have had enough to eat and plenty to spare, because the Lord has blessed his people, and this great amount is left over.”

source: Chuin Hezekiah'in Pakai insunga chu indan sem dingin thu apen, chule amahon asem taovin,
target: Hezekiah gave orders to prepare storerooms in the temple of the Lord , and this was done.

source: Chuin thiltoho le hopsom ho, chule thilpeh thengho chu tahsan umtah-in alhoh lutnun: hiche chunga chu Levi mi Conaniah chu vaipo ahin, asopipa Shimei chu ama noidou ahi.
target: Then they faithfully brought in the contributions, tithes and dedicated gifts. Konaniah, a Levite, was the overseer in charge of these things, and his brother Shimei was next in rank.

source: Chuin Jehiel, Azariah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, chule Benaiah, mi hicheng hi Hezekiah lengpa le Pathen houin lamkai Azariah thupeh-a, Conaniah le asopipa Shimei khutnoija vetupma pang ahiuve.
target: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismakiah, Mahath and Benaiah were assistants of Konaniah and Shimei his brother. All these served by appointment of King Hezekiah and Azariah the official in charge of the temple of God.

source: Chule solam kotpi ngah-a pang Levi mi Imnah chapa Kore chu, Pakaiya lungcham thilpehho vetuple, Pakaiya dinga thilpeh le thiltheng chung nungho homtoh ding ahi.
target: Kore son of Imnah the Levite, keeper of the East Gate, was in charge of the freewill offerings given to God, distributing the contributions made to the Lord and also the consecrated gifts.

source: Ama bana chu Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, Shecaniah ahiuvin, amaho thempuho khopiho-a umuva, asopihou chu akihopkhenu dungjuija alen aneo kibanga chan ahoppeh dingu;
target: Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah and Shekaniah assisted him faithfully in the towns of the priests, distributing to their fellow priests according to their divisions, old and young alike.

source: Khanggui kisutna-a kisun pasal kum thuma pat chunglamse tilou, Pakai in'a hunglut amitakip chu akihopkhenu dungjuija nitina akin bolna-a amuding achan chu ahop dingu,
target: In addition, they distributed to the males three years old or more whose names were in the genealogical records—all who would enter the temple of the Lord to perform the daily duties of their various tasks, according to their responsibilities and their divisions.

source: Chule apu apateu ingsung kailhah-a dungjuija khanggui kisutna-a jao thempu-a pang le Levi miho kum somni-a pat chunglamse kihomkhena anatoh-u dungjui,
target: And they distributed to the priests enrolled by their families in the genealogical records and likewise to the Levites twenty years old or more, according to their responsibilities and their divisions.

source: Chule mipi jouse lah-a kona khanggui kisutna-a jao jouse, achasen hou, ajiteu, achapateu, chule achanuteu geija ahoppeh dingu ahi: ajehchu amaho akin boldiu kipe mun'a chu thenna-a kisutheng cheh ahiuve.
target: They included all the little ones, the wives, and the sons and daughters of the whole community listed in these genealogical records. For they were faithful in consecrating themselves.

source: Akhopihou kimvel loujao dunga cheng le khopi tina Aaron chapate thempuho thudola, thempuho lah-a pasal jouse le Levi mite lah-a kon khanggui kisutna-a kisimho jouse chan hoppeh dingin mi phabep akimin kutnin ahi.
target: As for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, who lived on the farm lands around their towns or in any other towns, men were designated by name to distribute portions to every male among them and to all who were recorded in the genealogies of the Levites.

source: Chule Hezekiah'in Judah gamsung jouse-a hitichun abolin, chule Pakai a-Pathen angsunga chun apha, adih, chule atah jeng abolin ahi.
target: This is what Hezekiah did throughout Judah, doing what was good and right and faithful before the Lord his God.

source: Chule Pathen houin kinbolna-a anatoh jouse ahin, danthu lam ahin, thupeh lam ahin, abula patnin a-Pathen aholin, alung pumpin atongin; hitichun akhangtou cheh cheh-in ahi.
target: In everything that he undertook in the service of God’s temple and in obedience to the law and the commands, he sought his God and worked wholeheartedly. And so he prospered.

source: Hicheng thilho kiphudet nunghin, Assyria lengpa Sennacherib ahungin, Judah gama alutnin, kulbang nei khopiho dounan gebuh asongin, ama-a dinga joding angaiton ahi.
target: After all that Hezekiah had so faithfully done, Sennacherib king of Assyria came and invaded Judah. He laid siege to the fortified cities, thinking to conquer them for himself.

source: Chuin Hezekiah'in Sennacherib ahunga Jerusalem satding agot chu amu phatnin,
target: When Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come and that he intended to wage war against Jerusalem,

source: Apipuiho le amihat hotoh khopi pama twinahho suhbing dingin akihouvun, amahon akitho piuvin ahi.
target: he consulted with his officials and military staff about blocking off the water from the springs outside the city, and they helped him.

source: Hitichun mipi tamtah akikhomun, gamsung lailunga long twinahho le vachaho atingun, Ipibola Assyria lengho, twi nengtah-a amu diuham? atiuve.
target: They gathered a large group of people who blocked all the springs and the stream that flowed through the land. “Why should the kings of Assyria come and find plenty of water?” they said.

source: Chuin ama akisuhat nin, kulbang kehlai jouse asaphan, insangho atungdoh-in, polama kulbang chom jong agensonin, chule David khopi-a um Millo jong asaphan, tengcha le lumdal jong ninglhing tah-in asemin ahi.
target: Then he worked hard repairing all the broken sections of the wall and building towers on it. He built another wall outside that one and reinforced the terraces of the City of David. He also made large numbers of weapons and shields.

source: Chuin mipi chunga gal lamkaiho atungin, amaho chu khopi kotpi lamlena chun ahenga akhomin, ahenguva lhamona thu aseijin, hitin ati,
target: He appointed military officers over the people and assembled them before him in the square at the city gate and encouraged them with these words:

source: Hatnunlang hangun, Assyria lengpa ahiloule aumpi mipi ho jeh-in kicha hih-un, lungjong lungthoi hih-un: ajehchu ama umpi sangin eiho umpi atamjon ahi.
target: “Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or discouraged because of the king of Assyria and the vast army with him, for there is a greater power with us than with him.

source: Ama koma um chu tahsa bantha ahin; eiho koma vang Pakai i-Pathen'u chu eihuhdiu le igalteu satdinga uma ahi, ati. Chuin Judah te lengpa Hezekiah thuseija chun mipi chu alung ngam taovin ahi.
target: With him is only the arm of flesh, but with us is the Lord our God to help us and to fight our battles.” And the people gained confidence from what Hezekiah the king of Judah said.

source: Hiche jouhin Assyria lengpa Sennacherib'in asohte chu (ahinla amale aumpi agalhat ho jouse chun Lachish dounan kulpi akaijun ahi,) Jerusalem'a um Judah lengpa heng le Jerusalem'a um Judah mite jouse henga asolin, hitin agasei sah-e,
target: Later, when Sennacherib king of Assyria and all his forces were laying siege to Lachish, he sent his officers to Jerusalem with this message for Hezekiah king of Judah and for all the people of Judah who were there:

source: Assyria lengpa Sennacherib'in hitin aseije, Jerusalem'a umkulsa naum nunguva, ipi-a kisong nahiuvem?
target: “This is what Sennacherib king of Assyria says: On what are you basing your confidence, that you remain in Jerusalem under siege?

source: Hezekiah'in, Assyria lengpa khutna konin Pakai i-Pathen'un eihuh naovinte tia gilkel le dangchah-a nathi nadiuva bou najolu hilouham?
target: When Hezekiah says, ‘The Lord our God will save us from the hand of the king of Assyria,’ he is misleading you, to let you die of hunger and thirst.

source: Amunsangho le amaichamho sumanga, Judah le Jerusalem henga, Maicham khat angabou nahou uva, achunga gimnamtui nahaldiu ahi tia seija chu hiche Hezekiah mamahi hilouham?
target: Did not Hezekiah himself remove this god’s high places and altars, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, ‘You must worship before one altar and burn sacrifices on it’?

source: Kei le kapaten gamdangho chunga ipi kanabolu nahet lou uham? chuche gamsunga cheng namho pathenho chun amaho kakhutna kona anahuhdoh jou beh-um?
target: “Do you not know what I and my predecessors have done to all the peoples of the other lands? Were the gods of those nations ever able to deliver their land from my hand?

source: Kapaten anasuh manghel-u namho pathenho lah-a kakhutna kona amite huhdoh-a koi ana uma, kakhutna kona na-Pathen'u chun nahuhdoh jou diuham?
target: Who of all the gods of these nations that my predecessors destroyed has been able to save his people from me? How then can your god deliver you from my hand?

source: Hijeh chun tun Hezekiah chun nalhemlha hih-u hen, ahiloule najol lhahih-u hen, tahjong tahsan hih-un: ajehchu koimacha namle lenggam pathen khatchan amite chu kakhutna konle, kapate khutna konin anahuhdoh joupoi: na Pathen'un kakhutna kona nahuh dohding chu ichanna lhinglel jocheh hitam? ati, atiuve.
target: Now do not let Hezekiah deceive you and mislead you like this. Do not believe him, for no god of any nation or kingdom has been able to deliver his people from my hand or the hand of my predecessors. How much less will your god deliver you from my hand!”

source: Chuin asohten Pakai Pathen le asohpa Hezekiah dounan thu aseibe nalaijun ahi.
target: Sennacherib’s officers spoke further against the Lord God and against his servant Hezekiah.

source: Aman Israel Pakai Pathen tailtomna le ama dounan lekhathot jong asunin, Gamdangho namdang pathen hon amiteu kakhutna kona ahuhdoh louvu bangin, Hezekiah Pathen'in jong amite kakhutna konin huhdoh ponte, ati.
target: The king also wrote letters ridiculing the Lord , the God of Israel, and saying this against him: “Just as the gods of the peoples of the other lands did not rescue their people from my hand, so the god of Hezekiah will not rescue his people from my hand.”

source: Chujouvin khopi chu alah theina diuvin Jerusalem mite kulbanga um miho henga chun, kichatsah-a, suhboina dingin Judah te paovin awsang tah-in asapkhumun ahi.
target: Then they called out in Hebrew to the people of Jerusalem who were on the wall, to terrify them and make them afraid in order to capture the city.

source: Amahon Jerusalem Pathen dounan, mihem khutna kisem leiset pathenho douna bangbepmin thu aseijun ahi.
target: They spoke about the God of Jerusalem as they did about the gods of the other peoples of the world—the work of human hands.

source: Chuin hiche jeh hin, Hezekiah lengpa le Amoz chapa Isaiah themgao chu atao lhonin, vanlam sangin akaplhonin ahi.
target: King Hezekiah and the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz cried out in prayer to heaven about this.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin vantil khat asolin, Assyria lengpa gebuh-a um mihat hangsan jouse, chule lamkaiho le vaipoho chu athatgam tan ahi. Hitichun maijum tah-in agamlama akiletai. Chuin a-pathen in'a ahung phatnin asunga kona hungpengho tahchun hiche munachun chemjamin athat taovin ahi.
target: And the Lord sent an angel, who annihilated all the fighting men and the commanders and officers in the camp of the Assyrian king. So he withdrew to his own land in disgrace. And when he went into the temple of his god, some of his sons, his own flesh and blood, cut him down with the sword.

source: Hitichun Pakaiyin Hezekiah le Jerusalem'a chengho chu Assyria lengpa Sennacherib khutna kon le adang jouse khutna konin ahuhdoh-in, lamtina apuihoijin ahi.
target: So the Lord saved Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib king of Assyria and from the hand of all others. He took care of them on every side.

source: Chuin mi tamtah-in Jerusalem'a Pakaiya dingin thilpeh ahinpouvin, Judah leng Hezekiah chu apeove: hitichun hiche-a pat chun namjouse mitmun amachu choi-atnin aumtan ahi.
target: Many brought offerings to Jerusalem for the Lord and valuable gifts for Hezekiah king of Judah. From then on he was highly regarded by all the nations.

source: Hiche nikholai chun Hezekiah chu thina khopmin anatan, Pakai henga ataovin ahile, Aman ahenga thu aseijin, melchihna khat apen ahi.
target: In those days Hezekiah became ill and was at the point of death. He prayed to the Lord , who answered him and gave him a miraculous sign.

source: Ahinla Hezekiah'in achunga phatna kibol dungjuijin alethuh pon ahi. Ajehchu alungthim akichoisang tan; hijeh chun amale Judah chule Jerusalem chunga Pathen lunghana achutan ahi.
target: But Hezekiah’s heart was proud and he did not respond to the kindness shown him; therefore the Lord ’s wrath was on him and on Judah and Jerusalem.

source: Ahinla Hezekiah le Jerussalem'a chengho jouse chu alungsung hoithona-a konchun akineosah taovin, hitichun Hezekiah nikho sungsen achunguva Pakai lunghanna achutapoi.
target: Then Hezekiah repented of the pride of his heart, as did the people of Jerusalem; therefore the Lord ’s wrath did not come on them during the days of Hezekiah.

source: Chuin Hezekiah'in nasatah-in haona le jabolna aneitan: aman ama dingin dangka, sana, songmantam, gimnamtui, lumle pho, chule thillu jat jouse khol khomna ding in akisah-in;
target: Hezekiah had very great wealth and honor, and he made treasuries for his silver and gold and for his precious stones, spices, shields and all kinds of valuables.

source: Chujongle chang le lengpitwi, chule thao khol khomna dingin in asan; chule ganhing namkim khumna dingin gan in asan, chule kelngoi ho-a dingin kelngoi hongho asemin ahi.
target: He also made buildings to store the harvest of grain, new wine and olive oil; and he made stalls for various kinds of cattle, and pens for the flocks.

source: Chukal valin khopiho akisahdoh-in, kelngoihon le bonghonho ahaolheh jengin ahi: ajehchu Pathen'in neile gou atama tam apen ahi.
target: He built villages and acquired great numbers of flocks and herds, for God had given him very great riches.

source: Hiche Hezekiah mamahin Gihon luipi sahnung jong atingkangin, David khopi lhumlam sanga jangpetnin alonsah-in ahi. Chuin Hezekiah chu anatohna jouse akhangtouvin ahi.
target: It was Hezekiah who blocked the upper outlet of the Gihon spring and channeled the water down to the west side of the City of David. He succeeded in everything he undertook.

source: Ahijeng vangin palaija hunga Babylon pipuho thudol, gamsunga thil kidang kibolho kholdinga ahinsol hou thudola vang; alungsunga umjouse ahetdohna dingle apatep nadingin, Pathen ama-a konin apotdoh-in ahi.
target: But when envoys were sent by the rulers of Babylon to ask him about the miraculous sign that had occurred in the land, God left him to test him and to know everything that was in his heart.

source: Tun Hezekiah thilbol danghole aphatnaho chu, veuvin, Amoz chapa Isaiah gaothil mun'a le Judah le Israel lengte lekhabua chun akisunlut cheh-in ahi.
target: The other events of Hezekiah’s reign and his acts of devotion are written in the vision of the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

source: Chuin Hezekiah chu apu apate toh alumkhomin, David chapate lhan thupipena chun avuitaove: chule athi chun Judah le Jerusalem'a chengho jousen jabolna apeuve. Chuin achapa Manasseh chu ama khelin alengchang tan ahi.
target: Hezekiah rested with his ancestors and was buried on the hill where the tombs of David’s descendants are. All Judah and the people of Jerusalem honored him when he died. And Manasseh his son succeeded him as king.

source: Manasseh lengchanpat chun kumsom le kumni ahin, Jerusalem'a kum somnga le kumnga aleng changin ahi.
target: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-five years.

source: Ahinla Pakaiyin Israelte masanga kona anodoh pathen helou namhon thilbol thet umtah bangchun, Pakai mitmun thilphalou abolin ahi.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , following the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.

source: Ajehchu aman apa Hezekiah suhchimsa munsang ho chu asapha kitnin, Baal maicham ho atungdoh-in, thingbomho aphutnin, van janel jouse ahouvin, amaho chu ajenin ahi.
target: He rebuilt the high places his father Hezekiah had demolished; he also erected altars to the Baals and made Asherah poles. He bowed down to all the starry hosts and worshiped them.

source: Pakaiyin, Jerusalem'a hi a-itih-a kamin umding ahi tia aseina mun, Pakai insunga jong chun maicham ho asemin ahi.
target: He built altars in the temple of the Lord , of which the Lord had said, “My Name will remain in Jerusalem forever.”

source: Aman Pakai houin hongcha teni-a chun van janelho jouse-a dingin maicham atungdoh-in ahi.
target: In both courts of the temple of the Lord , he built altars to all the starry hosts.

source: Aman Hinnom chapa phaicham meisung chu achate apalsah-in, phat ho jong anitnin, phun asangin, doi le ai amangchan, lhakou ho le mitpheldoi themho jong adongin: phinsetna lunghansah nadinga Pakai mitmun thilphalou tamtah abolin ahi.
target: He sacrificed his children in the fire in the Valley of Ben Hinnom, practiced divination and witchcraft, sought omens, and consulted mediums and spiritists. He did much evil in the eyes of the Lord , arousing his anger.

source: Chule Pathen in sunga chun aman milim semthuho akoijin, Pathen'in David le achapa Solomon henga, Israel namjouse anga kana lhendoh hiche Jerusalem houin sungahi a-itih-a kamin kakoi jingding:
target: He took the image he had made and put it in God’s temple, of which God had said to David and to his son Solomon, “In this temple and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my Name forever.

source: Mosi khutna kona kapeh kadanthu jouse le kachona dan ho jouse, chule kachondan jouse atohdoh uva ahile, napu napateu dinga kanapeh leisetna kona jong Israelte keng kachondoh kit louhel ding ahitai tia aseina mun'a chun milim semthuho chu akoijin ahi.
target: I will not again make the feet of the Israelites leave the land I assigned to your ancestors, if only they will be careful to do everything I commanded them concerning all the laws, decrees and regulations given through Moses.”

source: Hitichun Manasseh'in Judah le Jerusalem'a chengho chu Pakaiyin Israelte anga anasuhmang houbeiho sanga khohjo cheh-in thilphalou abolsahtan ahi.
target: But Manasseh led Judah and the people of Jerusalem astray, so that they did more evil than the nations the Lord had destroyed before the Israelites.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Manasseh le amite henga thu anaseijin, ahinla amahon ngaipeh-in anei pouve.
target: The Lord spoke to Manasseh and his people, but they paid no attention.

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Assyria sepai janel lamkaiho chu achunguva achuhsah-in, amahon Manasseh chu linglah-a akaijun, henkol abuvin, Babylon'a akaitaove.
target: So the Lord brought against them the army commanders of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh prisoner, put a hook in his nose, bound him with bronze shackles and took him to Babylon.

source: Chuin ama suhgentheija aumphatnin, Pakai a-Pathen aholtan, apu apate Pathen angsunga nasatah-in akineosah tan,
target: In his distress he sought the favor of the Lord his God and humbled himself greatly before the God of his ancestors.

source: Ahenga ataotai: chuin alungsetna achangin, ataona asanpeh-in, alenggam Jerusalem'a ahinpui kit tai. Chuphatnin Manasseh'in Pakai amachu Pathen ahi ti ahetai.
target: And when he prayed to him, the Lord was moved by his entreaty and listened to his plea; so he brought him back to Jerusalem and to his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the Lord is God.

source: Chuin hiche jouchun David khopi polama Gihon lhumlam vacha phaicham ngalim kotpi lutna geijin, chule Ophel gei umkimvelin kulpi asan, asana sangin atungdoh-in, Judah gama kulbang nei khopi jouse-a chun gal lamkaiho akoitai.
target: Afterward he rebuilt the outer wall of the City of David, west of the Gihon spring in the valley, as far as the entrance of the Fish Gate and encircling the hill of Ophel; he also made it much higher. He stationed military commanders in all the fortified cities in Judah.

source: Chuin gamdang pathenho le milimho chu Pakai in'a konin aladoh-in, Pakai in molsang Jerusalem'a anatundoh maicham ho jouse chu khopi polama apaidoh sohtai.
target: He got rid of the foreign gods and removed the image from the temple of the Lord , as well as all the altars he had built on the temple hill and in Jerusalem; and he threw them out of the city.

source: Chuin Pakai maicham asemphan, achunga chun chamna thilto le thangvahna thilto ganlhai abolin, Judah te chun Israel Pakai ajen dinguvin thu apen ahi.
target: Then he restored the altar of the Lord and sacrificed fellowship offerings and thank offerings on it, and told Judah to serve the Lord , the God of Israel.

source: Hijeng jongle mipihon munsang ho-a chun ganlhaina abol nalaijun, amavang Pakai a-Pathen'u hengabou abolu ahi.
target: The people, however, continued to sacrifice at the high places, but only to the Lord their God.

source: Tun Manasseh thilbol dangho le a-Pathen henga ataona, chule Pakai Israelte Pathen mina ahenga themgaoho thusei ho chu, veuvin, Israel lengte lekhabua akisun cheh-e.
target: The other events of Manasseh’s reign, including his prayer to his God and the words the seers spoke to him in the name of the Lord , the God of Israel, are written in the annals of the kings of Israel.

source: Ataonaho jong, chule Pathen'in iti alungsetnam; chule akineosah masanga achonsetna jouse le asuhkhelna jouse, munsang asahna munho jouse le thingbul le milim aphuho jouse chu, veuvin, themgaoho thusei ho lah-a akisun cheh-in ahi.
target: His prayer and how God was moved by his entreaty, as well as all his sins and unfaithfulness, and the sites where he built high places and set up Asherah poles and idols before he humbled himself—all these are written in the records of the seers.

source: Hitichun Manasseh apu apate toh alumkhomin, amatah insunga avuitaove. Chuin achapa Ammon ama khelin alengchang tan ahi.
target: Manasseh rested with his ancestors and was buried in his palace. And Amon his son succeeded him as king.

source: Ammon alengchan phatchun akum kum somni le kumni ahin, Jerusalem'a kumni aleng changin ahi.
target: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem two years.

source: Ahinla apa Manasseh'in anabol bangin Pakai mitmun thilse abolin ahi. Ammon'in apa Manasseh'in anasema anahou khentho milimho jouse henga ganlhaina abolin;
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , as his father Manasseh had done. Amon worshiped and offered sacrifices to all the idols Manasseh had made.

source: Apa Manasseh anakineosah bangin Pakai anga akineosah pon; ahinla Ammon'in asuhkhel bebe jengin ahi.
target: But unlike his father Manasseh, he did not humble himself before the Lord ; Amon increased his guilt.

source: Chuin asohte ama dounan galguh abolun, a-insung tah-a athat taove.
target: Amon’s officials conspired against him and assassinated him in his palace.

source: Ahinla Ammon lengpa douna-a galguh bolho jouse chu gamsung miten athatgamun; gamsung mite chun achapa Josiah chu akhelin alengchan sah taovin ahi.
target: Then the people of the land killed all who had plotted against King Amon, and they made Josiah his son king in his place.

source: Josiah alengchan patchun kum get ahin, Jerusalem'a kum somthumle kumkhat aleng changin ahi.
target: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years.

source: Chule Pakai mitmu-a adih abolin, apa David lamlhahho ajotnin, jetlam le veilama akihei dohpoi.
target: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord and followed the ways of his father David, not turning aside to the right or to the left.

source: Ajehchu alengchan kal kumget lhina-in chapangcha ahinalaijin, apa David Pathen chu ahol pantan ahi. Chuin kum somle nina-in Judah le Jerusalem chu munsang ho, doikhomho, khenthu milimho, chule lhahtho milim ho-a konin asuthengtan ahi.
target: In the eighth year of his reign, while he was still young, he began to seek the God of his father David. In his twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem of high places, Asherah poles and idols.

source: Chuin Baal maicham ho chu amitmun asuchimun, chule hicheho chunga um milimho chu aphuh lhun: thingbul hole khettho milimho, chule lhahtho milimho chu avochipmin, leivui ason, ahenguva kilhaiho lhan chunga chun athe jalsoh helin ahi.
target: Under his direction the altars of the Baals were torn down; he cut to pieces the incense altars that were above them, and smashed the Asherah poles and the idols. These he broke to pieces and scattered over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.

source: Thempuho guho chu amaicham chunguva ahalin, Judah le Jerusalem chu asuthenge.
target: He burned the bones of the priests on their altars, and so he purged Judah and Jerusalem.

source: Hitichun aman Manasseh, Ephraim, Simeon, chule Naphtali khopiho le akimvelu jouse jongchu hitichun abolcheh-in ahi.
target: In the towns of Manasseh, Ephraim and Simeon, as far as Naphtali, and in the ruins around them,

source: Aman maicham ho le doikhomho asuhchima, milim kikhengho bongsela avoh chipma, Israel gamsung pumpi-a milimho aphuh lhuh soh phatnin, Jerusalem'a akiletai.
target: he tore down the altars and the Asherah poles and crushed the idols to powder and cut to pieces all the incense altars throughout Israel. Then he went back to Jerusalem.

source: Tun alengchan kal kum somle kumget alhinna, gamsungle in chu asuhtheng phatnin, Azaliah chapa Shephan le khopisung vaipo thuchingpa Joahaz chapa Joah chu Pakai a-Pathen in saphadin asole.
target: In the eighteenth year of Josiah’s reign, to purify the land and the temple, he sent Shaphan son of Azaliah and Maaseiah the ruler of the city, with Joah son of Joahaz, the recorder, to repair the temple of the Lord his God.

source: Chuin thempu chungnung Hilkiah henga ahung phatnun, amahon kotngah Levi mihon Manasseh le Ephraim mite, chule Israelte amoh umjouse le Judah le Benjamin mite jouse khutna kona adonkhom uva Pathen insunga akoiju sum chu apeuvin; chuin Jerusalem'a akiletaove.
target: They went to Hilkiah the high priest and gave him the money that had been brought into the temple of God, which the Levites who were the gatekeepers had collected from the people of Manasseh, Ephraim and the entire remnant of Israel and from all the people of Judah and Benjamin and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

source: Chuin Pakai in vetupma natongho khutna chun akoijun, amahon Pakai in sapha ho le semhoiho khutna apeuvin,
target: Then they entrusted it to the men appointed to supervise the work on the Lord ’s temple. These men paid the workers who repaired and restored the temple.

source: Judah lenghon anasuhsetnu lhongho semphatna dingin song kikheng le athopna ding thing chohnadin khuthemho le insaho chu apeuvin ahi.
target: They also gave money to the carpenters and builders to purchase dressed stone, and timber for joists and beams for the buildings that the kings of Judah had allowed to fall into ruin.

source: Chuin mihon na chu tahsan umtah-in atongun; amachal nadinguva avetupmuva chu Levi ho Merari chapate-a kon Jahath le Obadiah; Kohath chapate-a kon Zechariah le Meshullam ahin; chule Levi dangho lasahna-a manchah tumthemho jousetoh na chu atonguvin ahi.
target: The workers labored faithfully. Over them to direct them were Jahath and Obadiah, Levites descended from Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam, descended from Kohath. The Levites—all who were skilled in playing musical instruments—

source: Amaho chu pohgih poho vetupma chule lhachaho tintang kinbolna jouse vesuija jong ahiuve; chule lekhasunho, vaipoho, chule kotngah ho chu Levi mite lah-a jeng ahiuve.
target: had charge of the laborers and supervised all the workers from job to job. Some of the Levites were secretaries, scribes and gatekeepers.

source: Chuin Pakai in'a achoilutnu sum chu ahinladoh phatnun, Hilkiah thempupan Mosi'n apeh Pakai danthu lekhabu chu amudoh-in ahi.
target: While they were bringing out the money that had been taken into the temple of the Lord , Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law of the Lord that had been given through Moses.

source: Chuin Hilkiah'in adonbutnin Lekhasunpa Shaphan henga, Danthu lekhabu chu Pakai in'a akimu dohtai, ati. Chuin Hilkiah'in lekhabu chu Shaphan apetai.
target: Hilkiah said to Shaphan the secretary, “I have found the Book of the Law in the temple of the Lord .” He gave it to Shaphan.

source: Chuin Shaphan'in lekhabu chu lengpa henga achoijin, lengpa henga thu alhut kitnin, Nasohte boldia kigotpeh jouse chu abolnaove.
target: Then Shaphan took the book to the king and reported to him: “Your officials are doing everything that has been committed to them.

source: Chule Pakai in'a aum kimu sum chu alakhomun, vetup hole natongho khutna apedoh taove, ati.
target: They have paid out the money that was in the temple of the Lord and have entrusted it to the supervisors and workers.”

source: Chuin lekhasun Shaphan'in lengpa henga, Hilkiah thempupan lekhabu khat eipei, ati. Chuin Shaphan'in lengpa anga hichu asimdoh pehtan ahi.
target: Then Shaphan the secretary informed the king, “Hilkiah the priest has given me a book.” And Shaphan read from it in the presence of the king.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, lengpan danthuho chu ajah phatnin apon abottel tai.
target: When the king heard the words of the Law, he tore his robes.

source: Chuin lengpan Hilkiah le Shaphan chapa Ahikam, Micah chapa Abdon, lekhasun Shaphan, chule lengpa soh Asaiah chu thu apen,
target: He gave these orders to Hilkiah, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Abdon son of Micah, Shaphan the secretary and Asaiah the king’s attendant:

source: Cheovin, hiche lekhabu kimu chungchanga hin keima le Israel le Judah'a kidalha ho din Pakai chu neigadoh peh-un: ajehchu hiche lekhabua kisun banga ipu ipateovin Pakai thu anajoplou jeh-un, Pakai lunghanna chu ichunguva akibung lhatai, ati.
target: “Go and inquire of the Lord for me and for the remnant in Israel and Judah about what is written in this book that has been found. Great is the Lord ’s anger that is poured out on us because those who have gone before us have not kept the word of the Lord ; they have not acted in accordance with all that is written in this book.”

source: Chuin lengpan anganseho le Hilkiah chu ponho chingtupma pang Hasrah chapa, Tikvath chapa, Shallum jinu, Huldah themgaonu henga acheuvin; (tun amanu Jerusalem indan nina-a cheng ahi,) chule hiche thuchu agasei taove.
target: Hilkiah and those the king had sent with him went to speak to the prophet Huldah, who was the wife of Shallum son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe. She lived in Jerusalem, in the New Quarter.

source: Chuin amanun amaho chu adonbutnin, Israel Pakai Pathen'in hitin ati, Kahenga nahinsolpa chu seipeh uvin,
target: She said to them, “This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Tell the man who sent you to me,

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Veuvin hiche munle asunga chengho chunga Judah lengpa masanga asimdoh-u lekhabua kisun sapsetna jouse chu kalhunsah ding ahi:
target: ‘This is what the Lord says: I am going to bring disaster on this place and its people—all the curses written in the book that has been read in the presence of the king of Judah.

source: Ajehchu amahon eida lhaovin, akhutnuva athilbol uva kona eilunghan sahna diuvin pathen dangho henga gimnamtui ahalun ahi; hiche jeh-a chu hiche mun chunga kalunghana kibunglha ding, chule kisumit jou louding ahi.
target: Because they have forsaken me and burned incense to other gods and aroused my anger by all that their hands have made, my anger will be poured out on this place and will not be quenched.’

source: Ahin Pakai dong dinga nahin soluva Judah lengpa thudol chu hitin seipeh-un, Nangman najah thuho thudola hin Israel Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije,
target: Tell the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the Lord , ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says concerning the words you heard:

source: Hiche mun douna le asunga chengho douna athusei najah phatna, nalung anema, Pathen anga nakisuhnem jeh-in, chule kamasanga nakineosah-a, napon nabotel-a, kamasanga naka jeh-in; keiman jong nathu kangaipeh-e, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Because your heart was responsive and you humbled yourself before God when you heard what he spoke against this place and its people, and because you humbled yourself before me and tore your robes and wept in my presence, I have heard you, declares the Lord .

source: Ven, keiman napu napate toh kagop khom ding, lungmonga lhana nakivui ding, hiche munle asunga chengho chunga kalhunsah ding thilphalou jouse chu namitnin amulouding ahi, ati. Hitichun lengpa henga thu ahinpo taovin ahi.
target: Now I will gather you to your ancestors, and you will be buried in peace. Your eyes will not see all the disaster I am going to bring on this place and on those who live here.’ ” So they took her answer back to the king.

source: Chuin lengpan mi asolin, Judah le Jerusalem'a upa jouse akhomin ahi.
target: Then the king called together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

source: Chuin lengpan Judah mijouse le Jerusalem'a chengho jouse toh, thempuho, Levi ho, chule mijouse alen aneo Pakai in'a achetouvun; chuin aman Pakai in'a amudoh-u kitepna lekhabua thu jouse chu anabenguva asimdoh peh-in ahi.
target: He went up to the temple of the Lord with the people of Judah, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the priests and the Levites—all the people from the least to the greatest. He read in their hearing all the words of the Book of the Covenant, which had been found in the temple of the Lord .

source: Chuin lengpa chu aumna mun'a adingin, alungthim pumpi le ahinna pumpi-a Pakai nung juiding le, athupehho, ahettoh sahnaho, achondanho nitding, chule hiche lekhabua kisun kitepna thuho jouse tongdoh dingin Pakai angsunga kitepna aneijin ahi
target: The king stood by his pillar and renewed the covenant in the presence of the Lord —to follow the Lord and keep his commands, statutes and decrees with all his heart and all his soul, and to obey the words of the covenant written in this book.

source: Chuin Jerusalem le Benjamin'a umjouse hiche-a chu dingdet dingin aseijin ahi. Chuin Jerusalem'a chengho chun a-Pathen'u, apu apateu Pathen thulhun dungjuijin abol taovin ahi.
target: Then he had everyone in Jerusalem and Benjamin pledge themselves to it; the people of Jerusalem did this in accordance with the covenant of God, the God of their ancestors.

source: Chuin Josaiah'in Israel chate gam jouse-a konin thil thet umjouse alamangin, Israel'a umjouse chu Pakai a-Pathen'u bouchu ajensah-in ahi. Chuin ahinkho lhumkeijin Pakai, apateu Pathen ajuija konin akichoi dohpon ahi.
target: Josiah removed all the detestable idols from all the territory belonging to the Israelites, and he had all who were present in Israel serve the Lord their God. As long as he lived, they did not fail to follow the Lord , the God of their ancestors.

source: Chukalvalin Josiah'in Jerusalem'a chun Pakai dingin kalchuh kut amangin: lha masapen nisomle nili nin kalchuh kut sa athatnun ahi.
target: Josiah celebrated the Passover to the Lord in Jerusalem, and the Passover lamb was slaughtered on the fourteenth day of the first month.

source: Chuin thempuho chu akinganse naova apansah-in, amaho chu Pakai in'a kinboldin atilkhouvin,
target: He appointed the priests to their duties and encouraged them in the service of the Lord ’s temple.

source: Chuin Pakaiya dinga atheng Israelte hila pang Levi ho jah-a chun, Israel lengpa David chapa Solomon'in asah in'a chun thingkhong thengchu koijun; hichu nalengkou uva dinga pohgih hitalou ding ahi: tun Pakai na Pathen'u le ami Israelte jenun,
target: He said to the Levites, who instructed all Israel and who had been consecrated to the Lord : “Put the sacred ark in the temple that Solomon son of David king of Israel built. It is not to be carried about on your shoulders. Now serve the Lord your God and his people Israel.

source: Chule Israel lengpa David sutle achapa Solomon sut dungjuijin, napu napateu insungho kailhah dungjui le nakihopkhen dungjuijun kigotup uvin.
target: Prepare yourselves by families in your divisions, according to the instructions written by David king of Israel and by his son Solomon.

source: Chule mipi ho nasopiteu insung kailhah kikhen dungjuile, Levi insung kailhah kikhen dungjuijin muntheng chun dinguvin.
target: “Stand in the holy place with a group of Levites for each subdivision of the families of your fellow Israelites, the lay people.

source: Hitichun kalchuh kut sa that unlang kisuthengun, chule Mosi khutna kon Pakai thu dungjuija atoh theina diuvin, nasopiteu chu gongtoh-uvin, ati.
target: Slaughter the Passover lambs, consecrate yourselves and prepare the lambs for your fellow Israelites, doing what the Lord commanded through Moses.”

source: Chuin Josiah'in chuche mun'a um mijouse chu kalchuh kutna atodiu ganhon lah-a konin kelngoinou le kelnou sangsomthum le bongchal sangthum apen, hicheho chu lengpa neija kon ahi.
target: Josiah provided for all the lay people who were there a total of thirty thousand lambs and goats for the Passover offerings, and also three thousand cattle—all from the king’s own possessions.

source: Chuin apipuiho chun mipi ho, thempuho, chule Levi ho chu hongphal tah-in apeuvin; Pathen in vaipo Hilkiah, Zechariah, chule Jehiel chun thempuho chu kalchuh kut thiltodin ganchaneo sangni le jagup le bongchal jathum apeuve.
target: His officials also contributed voluntarily to the people and the priests and Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah and Jehiel, the officials in charge of God’s temple, gave the priests twenty-six hundred Passover offerings and three hundred cattle.

source: Conaniah le asopi Shemaiah le Nathaneel, chule Levi ho pipu Hashabish le Jeiel, chule Jozabad jongchun Levi ho henga kalchuh kutna todin ganchaneo sanga le bongchal janga apeuve.
target: Also Konaniah along with Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brothers, and Hashabiah, Jeiel and Jozabad, the leaders of the Levites, provided five thousand Passover offerings and five hundred head of cattle for the Levites.

source: Hitichun lhacha natohna chu agongun, lengpa thupeh bangin thempuho chu amun cheh uvah adingun, Levi ho jong aloi loijin apang taove.
target: The service was arranged and the priests stood in their places with the Levites in their divisions as the king had ordered.

source: Amahon kalchuh kut sa athatnun, thempuhon akhutna konin thisan atheuvin, Levi hon avun alipmuve.
target: The Passover lambs were slaughtered, and the priests splashed against the altar the blood handed to them, while the Levites skinned the animals.

source: Chuin Mosi lekhabua kisun banga, mipi chun a-insungu kikhen dungjuija Pakai henga atotheina dingun, govam thiltoho chu aladoh-un ahi. Hitichun bongchalho jong aboluve.
target: They set aside the burnt offerings to give them to the subdivisions of the families of the people to offer to the Lord , as it is written in the Book of Moses. They did the same with the cattle.

source: Chuin kalchuh kut sa chu chondan dungjui jin meija agou minun, thilto theng dangho vang bel le bel lengnei, chule khangbelin ahonun, mipi lah-a chun ahomdoh loi jiuvin ahi.
target: They roasted the Passover animals over the fire as prescribed, and boiled the holy offerings in pots, caldrons and pans and served them quickly to all the people.

source: Hiche jouchun amahole thempuhodin asemtoh uvin ahi: ajehchu Aaron chapate thempuho chu thilto thua govam thilto le thao thilto-a khojin geija kisalel uva ahi; hijeh chun Levi ho chun amaho dingle Aaron chapate thempuhodin agongtoh uvin ahi.
target: After this, they made preparations for themselves and for the priests, because the priests, the descendants of Aaron, were sacrificing the burnt offerings and the fat portions until nightfall. So the Levites made preparations for themselves and for the Aaronic priests.

source: Chuin David le Asaph, Heman, chule lengpa mitvanei Jeduthun thupeh dungjuijin, Asaph chapate lasaho chu amun cheh-a aumun; akinuva kona atoldoh theilouna diuvin kotngah hon kotpi tina angah-un ahi; ajehchu asopiteu Levi hon agontohpeh-u ahi.
target: The musicians, the descendants of Asaph, were in the places prescribed by David, Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun the king’s seer. The gatekeepers at each gate did not need to leave their posts, because their fellow Levites made the preparations for them.

source: Hitichun Josiah lengpa thupeh bangin kalchuh kut nitna dingle Pakai maicham chunga govam thiltoho tona dingin, hiche nikho mama chun Pakai kinbolna jouse chu agongtoh uvin ahi.
target: So at that time the entire service of the Lord was carried out for the celebration of the Passover and the offering of burnt offerings on the altar of the Lord , as King Josiah had ordered.

source: Chule Israel chapate chua umho chun kalchuh kut amangun, cholsolou changlhah kut jong nisagi amanguve.
target: The Israelites who were present celebrated the Passover at that time and observed the Festival of Unleavened Bread for seven days.

source: Samuel themgao nikho-a patnin Israel gamsunga chutobang kalchuh kut ana umkhapon; Josiah le thempuho, Levi ho, chule chua um Judah le Israel jouse, chule Jerusalem'a chenghon anaman bangun, Israel lengte jousen jong hitobang kalchuh kut hi anamang khapouve.
target: The Passover had not been observed like this in Israel since the days of the prophet Samuel; and none of the kings of Israel had ever celebrated such a Passover as did Josiah, with the priests, the Levites and all Judah and Israel who were there with the people of Jerusalem.

source: Josiah lengchan kala kum somle kumget na-a hiche kalchuh kut hi anamanu ahi.
target: This Passover was celebrated in the eighteenth year of Josiah’s reign.

source: Hicheho jouse nung, Josiah'in houin agontoh phatnin, Egypt lengpa Nicho chu Euphrates luija Carchemish satdin ahungtouvin; chule Joshiah chu ama doudin akondoh-in ahi.
target: After all this, when Josiah had set the temple in order, Necho king of Egypt went up to fight at Carchemish on the Euphrates, and Josiah marched out to meet him in battle.

source: Ahinla aman ahenga palai ahinsolin, ajah-a, Judah lengpa, nangle kei kikah-a ipi iboina uma ham? tunia nangma doudinga hung kahipoi, kakisatpipa insung doudinga hungjoh kahibouve: ajehchu Pathen'in kikinno dinga eithupeh ahi: eiumpia Pathen nadoudal na-a konin kikhindalin, nasumang khante, agati sah-e.
target: But Necho sent messengers to him, saying, “What quarrel is there, king of Judah, between you and me? It is not you I am attacking at this time, but the house with which I am at war. God has told me to hurry; so stop opposing God, who is with me, or he will destroy you.”

source: Ahijeng vangin Josiah'in ama-a konin amai aheidoh nompon, akisatpi theinadin amel achomsah-in, Pathen kama kon Necho thusei chu angai hih-in, Megiddo phaichama kisatpidin ahunge.
target: Josiah, however, would not turn away from him, but disguised himself to engage him in battle. He would not listen to what Necho had said at God’s command but went to fight him on the plain of Megiddo.

source: Chuin thal kaphon Josiah lengpa ahin kapkha taovin; hichun lengpa chun asohte henga, Neipodoh-un; ajehchu nasatah-in kamachang tai ati.
target: Archers shot King Josiah, and he told his officers, “Take me away; I am badly wounded.”

source: Hijeh chun asohten amachu kangtalai ja konchun aladoh-un, akangtalai nina-a akoijun; Jerusalem'a ahinpolut nun, athin, apu apateu lhankhuh khatna avuitaove. Chuin Judah le Jerusalem mite jousen Josiah chu alunghempi taove.
target: So they took him out of his chariot, put him in his other chariot and brought him to Jerusalem, where he died. He was buried in the tombs of his ancestors, and all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for him.

source: Chule Jeremiah'in jong Josiah alunghempin: chule lasa pasal hole lasa numei ho jousen Josiah chu tunigeijin akalaova akacham cham jengun, Israel gamsunga chondan khatnin asem taovin ahi: chule veuvin, hicheho chu kala lekhabua akisunin ahi.
target: Jeremiah composed laments for Josiah, and to this day all the male and female singers commemorate Josiah in the laments. These became a tradition in Israel and are written in the Laments.

source: Tun Josiah thilbol dangho le Pakai danthu-a kisun dungjuija aphatnaho,
target: The other events of Josiah’s reign and his acts of devotion in accordance with what is written in the Law of the Lord —

source: Anatohho apatna le ajona chu, veuvin, Israel le Judah lengte lekhabua akisun cheh-in ahi.
target: all the events, from beginning to end, are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

source: Chuin chuche gam mihochun Josiah chapa Jehoahaz chu apuijin, Jerusalem'a apa khelin alengchansah taove.
target: And the people of the land took Jehoahaz son of Josiah and made him king in Jerusalem in place of his father.

source: Jehoahaz chu alengchan patnin kum somni le kumthum ahitan, Jerusalem'a lha thum alengchange.
target: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months.

source: Chuin Jerusalem'a Egypt lengpan amachu asulhun, agamchu dangka talent jakhat le sana talent khat kai apohsah-in ahi.
target: The king of Egypt dethroned him in Jerusalem and imposed on Judah a levy of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

source: Egypt lengpa chun asopipa Eliakim chu Judah le Jerusalem'a lengin atungin; amin chu Jehoiakim'in akhel peh-in ahi. Chuin Necho chun asopipa Jehoahaz chu apuijin, Egypt'a akaitai.
target: The king of Egypt made Eliakim, a brother of Jehoahaz, king over Judah and Jerusalem and changed Eliakim’s name to Jehoiakim. But Necho took Eliakim’s brother Jehoahaz and carried him off to Egypt.

source: Jehoiakim chu alengchan patnin kum somni le kumnga ahin, Jerusalem'a kum somle kumkhat aleng changin ahi. Ahin aman Pakai a-Pathen mitmun thilse jeng abolin ahi.
target: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. He did evil in the eyes of the Lord his God.

source: Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar ama satdin ahung kontouvin, Babylon'a puidin bul atuh-in ahi.
target: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon attacked him and bound him with bronze shackles to take him to Babylon.

source: Nebuchadnezzar'in Pakai in'a khon le kongho jongchu Babylon apon, hicheho chu Babylon'a a-houin'a akoijin ahi.
target: Nebuchadnezzar also took to Babylon articles from the temple of the Lord and put them in his temple there.

source: Tun Jehoiakim thilbol dangho ama-a kimudoh thet umtah thil anabolho chu, veuvin, Israel le Judah lengte lekhabua akisuncheh-e, chuin achapa Jehoiachin chu ama khelin alengchang tan ahi.
target: The other events of Jehoiakim’s reign, the detestable things he did and all that was found against him, are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah. And Jehoiachin his son succeeded him as king.

source: Jehoiachin chu alengchan patnin kum get ahin, Jerusalem'a lhathum le nisom aleng changin ahi. Chule aman Pakai mitmun thilphalou abolin ahi.
target: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months and ten days. He did evil in the eyes of the Lord .

source: Chuin kum kichai phatnin, Nebuchadnezzar lengpan mi ahinsolin, Pakai in'a um le bel phaho toh Babylon'a apuijin; asopipa Zedekiah chu Judah le Jerusalem chunga lengin atungtai.
target: In the spring, King Nebuchadnezzar sent for him and brought him to Babylon, together with articles of value from the temple of the Lord , and he made Jehoiachin’s uncle, Zedekiah, king over Judah and Jerusalem.

source: Zedekiah alengchan patchun kum somni le kumkhat ahin, Jerusalem'a kum somle kumkhat aleng changin ahi.
target: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years.

source: Chuin aman Pakai a-Pathen mitmun thilse abol jingin, Pakai kama kona thuseipa Jeremiah themgao anga chun akisunem nompon ahi.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord his God and did not humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet, who spoke the word of the Lord .

source: Ama Pathen'a ana kitep sah-a Nebuchadnezzar dounan jong agolkeh-in, Pakai Israel Pathen lama akiheina dinga konin angong avaiputnin, alung atahsah-in ahi.
target: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him take an oath in God’s name. He became stiff-necked and hardened his heart and would not turn to the Lord , the God of Israel.

source: Chukalvalin thempu pipuiho jouse le mipi chun Pathen helouho thilbol thet umtahho bangin asukhel taovin; Jerusalem'a Aman asuhthengsa Pakai houin jongchu asuboh-un ahi.
target: Furthermore, all the leaders of the priests and the people became more and more unfaithful, following all the detestable practices of the nations and defiling the temple of the Lord , which he had consecrated in Jerusalem.

source: Chule apu apateu Pakai Pathen'in amite chung le achenna mun alainatpi jeh-in, ahenguva sottol tamtahvei asolin ahi.
target: The Lord , the God of their ancestors, sent word to them through his messengers again and again, because he had pity on his people and on his dwelling place.

source: Ahinla Pakai lunghan amite chunga akondoh chu, asudai lhading abeihel kahsen amahon Pathen thupo ho chu totnopnan aneijun, chule athuho anuisatnun, athemgaoho chu dihlou tah-in amang chaovin ahi.
target: But they mocked God’s messengers, despised his words and scoffed at his prophets until the wrath of the Lord was aroused against his people and there was no remedy.

source: Hijeh chun achunguva Chaldea mite lengpa ahin puilutnin, amunthengu insunga agollhanghou chemjamin athatnin, gollhang le nungah, tehse le tehse kongkon chunga lainatna beijin, abonun ama khutna apedohtai.
target: He brought up against them the king of the Babylonians, who killed their young men with the sword in the sanctuary, and did not spare young men or young women, the elderly or the infirm. God gave them all into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar.

source: Chuin Pathen in'a um le bel jouse alen aneo, Pakai in'a gouho le leng in'a gouho, chule apipuiho: hitiho jouse Babylon'a apotai.
target: He carried to Babylon all the articles from the temple of God, both large and small, and the treasures of the Lord ’s temple and the treasures of the king and his officials.

source: Chule Pathen in chu ahalun, Jerusalem bang asuchimun, leng inpi jouse meijin ahalun, chua um le bel phaho jouse chu asumang helun ahi.
target: They set fire to God’s temple and broke down the wall of Jerusalem; they burned all the palaces and destroyed everything of value there.

source: Chemjam'a kona sohcha jouse chu aman Babylon'a apuijin; chua chun Persia lenggam vaipoh kahsen amaho chu amale achapate soh-in apanguvin:
target: He carried into exile to Babylon the remnant, who escaped from the sword, and they became servants to him and his successors until the kingdom of Persia came to power.

source: Gamsungin acholngahni aman kahse-a Jeremiah kama Pakai thu guilhuna dingin: ajehchu kumsom sagi asuhbulhit nadingin, agohkeova aumlaisen acholngahni chu anitnin ahi.
target: The land enjoyed its sabbath rests; all the time of its desolation it rested, until the seventy years were completed in fulfillment of the word of the Lord spoken by Jeremiah.

source: Tun Jeremiah kama Pakai thusei guilhun theinadin, Persia lengpa Cyrus lengvaipoh kumkhat na-in, Pakaiyin Persia lengpa Cyrus lungthim atildoh-in, hitichun aman alenggam sung jouse-a thuphon aneijin, chule sut thon jong akoijin ahin,
target: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, in order to fulfill the word of the Lord spoken by Jeremiah, the Lord moved the heart of Cyrus king of Persia to make a proclamation throughout his realm and also to put it in writing:

source: Persia lengpa Cyrus in hitin aseije, Leiset lenggam jouse hi van Pakai Pathen'in keima eipeh ahitan; chule Judah gam Jerusalem'a ama-a ding in sadingin eingansen ahi. Amite jouse lah-a kon koi naum uvem? Pakai a-Pathen'in ama chu umpi hen, chule ama chetouhen, ati.
target: “This is what Cyrus king of Persia says: “ ‘The Lord , the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth and he has appointed me to build a temple for him at Jerusalem in Judah. Any of his people among you may go up, and may the Lord their God be with them.’ ”

source: Persia lengpa Cyrus lengchan kum khat alhinin, Jeremiah kama Pakaiyin athumopsa chu aguilhun theina dingin, Persia leng Cyrus lung chu Pakaiyin achoh thouvin ahi. Chule jihtho-a koidingin aseijin alenggam pumpi-a thu aphongdoh tai.
target: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, in order to fulfill the word of the Lord spoken by Jeremiah, the Lord moved the heart of Cyrus king of Persia to make a proclamation throughout his realm and also to put it in writing:

source: Persia leng Cyrus chun hitin aseije, leiset lenggam jouse chu keima khutna van Pakai Pathen'in phatthei eiboh-in eipen; chule aman Judah gam Jerusalem'a a-in sadingin thu eipetai.
target: “This is what Cyrus king of Persia says: “ ‘The Lord , the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth and he has appointed me to build a temple for him at Jerusalem in Judah.

source: Nangho amite jouse lah-a koi umam? ama chu a-Pathen'in umpihen, chule Judah gam Jerusalem'a chetou henlang, Pakai Israel Pathen (ama chu Pathen ahi) in chu gasahen, hichu Jerusalem'a um ahi.
target: Any of his people among you may go up to Jerusalem in Judah and build the temple of the Lord , the God of Israel, the God who is in Jerusalem, and may their God be with them.

source: Chule apemna mun'a chengdena koi hijongle aumna muncheh-a chun lungcham thilpeh tilouvin; dangka-in, sana-in, thil lelo-in, gancha-in Jerusalem'a Pathen in sahna dingin kithopiu hen.
target: And in any locality where survivors may now be living, the people are to provide them with silver and gold, with goods and livestock, and with freewill offerings for the temple of God in Jerusalem.’ ”

source: Chujouvin Judah le Benjamin phunga apateo lah-a alamkaiho, thempuho, chule Levi ho, Jerusalem'a um Pakai in sadinga chetou dinga Pathen lhagaovin alung asuhthouho chutoh akipatdoh taove.
target: Then the family heads of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests and Levites—everyone whose heart God had moved—prepared to go up and build the house of the Lord in Jerusalem.

source: Amaho chu akimveluva umho chun lungcham thilpeh-a apeh-u tilouvin, dangka umle belho, sana, thil le loho, ganchaho chule thillu tahtah ho apeuvin, atha hatsah-un ahi.
target: All their neighbors assisted them with articles of silver and gold, with goods and livestock, and with valuable gifts, in addition to all the freewill offerings.

source: Chule Cyrus lengpan jong Nebuchadnezzar'in Jerusalem'a kona anapoh-a, a-pathen in'a anakoi, Pakai in'a umle belho chu ahinpodoh-in ahi.
target: Moreover, King Cyrus brought out the articles belonging to the temple of the Lord , which Nebuchadnezzar had carried away from Jerusalem and had placed in the temple of his god.

source: Hitihohi Persia leng Cyrus chun neichingpa Mithredath alahdohsah-in, chule ajat asimun, Judah gama vaipipo Sheshbazzar khutna apetai.
target: Cyrus king of Persia had them brought by Mithredath the treasurer, who counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.

source: Hitiho asimdoh-u chu: sana kong somthum, dangka thih-a kisem kong sangkhat, chemcha somni le ko ahi.
target: This was the inventory: gold dishes 30 silver dishes 1,000 silver pans 29

source: Sana khondal somthum, dangka khondal jatchom jali le som, chule um le bel adang sangkhat toh,
target: gold bowls 30 matching silver bowls 410 other articles 1,000

source: Um le bel sana le dangka-a kisem chu aboncha sanga le jali ahi. Sohchangho Babylon'a kona Jerusalem'a ahintoltou laichun, hitiho jouse jonghi Sheshbazaar in ahintolthan ahi.
target: In all, there were 5,400 articles of gold and of silver. Sheshbazzar brought all these along with the exiles when they came up from Babylon to Jerusalem.

source: Tun Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in gal-hinga Babylon'a anakai mangho, asoh channao gama kona Jerusalem le Judah, ama ama khopi cheh-a hung kilekit ho chu ahiuvin;
target: Now these are the people of the province who came up from the captivity of the exiles, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had taken captive to Babylon (they returned to Jerusalem and Judah, each to their own town,

source: Chule hitehohi Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addan chule Immer akon chetou ahiuvin ahin amahon apu apau insung Israel mimong mong ahinao avetsahthei pouve.
target: The following came up from the towns of Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Kerub, Addon and Immer, but they could not show that their families were descended from Israel:

source: Delaiah chilhah, Tobiah chilhah, Nekoda chilhah, chu jaguple somnga le ni ahiuve.
target: The descendants of Delaiah, Tobiah and Nekoda 652

source: Chule thempuho chilhah: Habaiah chilhah, Koz chilhah, Barzillai chilhah (Barzillai in Gileadite mitejin aneijin achilhah chu amin dungjuijin asah-in ahi).
target: And from among the priests: The descendants of Hobaiah, Hakkoz and Barzillai (a man who had married a daughter of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by that name).

source: Mi hichenghi phunggui thu kisut na-a chun aminu aholun, ahin amujou pouve. Hijeh chun amaho chu akisuboh tobang ahiuvin, athemputnao ahaisah taove.
target: These searched for their family records, but they could not find them and so were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.

source: Chuin Tirshatha chun ahunguva Urim le Thummim kivon thempu khat chua adindoh kahsen amahon thilthengtah chu anehthei loudingu ahi tin aseije.
target: The governor ordered them not to eat any of the most sacred food until there was a priest ministering with the Urim and Thummim.

source: Mipi kikhomho jouse chu sangsomli sangni toh jathum le somgup ahiuve.
target: The whole company numbered 42,360,

source: Asohteo pasal hole numei ho mi sangsagi le jathum le somthumle sagi simlouvin, lasaho pasal le numei jani aumun ahi.
target: besides their 7,337 male and female slaves; and they also had 200 male and female singers.

source: Asakolho chu jasagi le somthumle gup, sangan jani leh somli le nga ahin,
target: They had 736 horses, 245 mules,

source: Asagonsangu jali leh somthumle nga, asanganu sangguple jasagi le somni ahi.
target: 435 camels and 6,720 donkeys.

source: Jerusalem'a Pakai in ahung lhunun, amun mama-a akisahdoh kitna dingin, phung lamkaiho phabep min kipehna thilto aneijun ahi.
target: When they arrived at the house of the Lord in Jerusalem, some of the heads of the families gave freewill offerings toward the rebuilding of the house of God on its site.

source: Ajokham cheh apeuvin, thilkholna-a akholdoh-u chu sana dram sangsomgup le sangkhat chule dangka sangnga le thempu von jakhat ahi.
target: According to their ability they gave to the treasury for this work 61,000 darics of gold, 5,000 minas of silver and 100 priestly garments.

source: Hitichun thempuho le Levi ho chule mi phabep khat lasahile kotngah ho, chule Nethinim ho chule Israelte jouse akhopi cheh-a acheng taove.
target: The priests, the Levites, the musicians, the gatekeepers and the temple servants settled in their own towns, along with some of the other people, and the rest of the Israelites settled in their towns.

source: Chuin lhasagi ahunglhina, Israel chate khopiho-a aumlaijun, mipi ho chu mikhat bangin Jerusalem'a akikhom khommun ahi.
target: When the seventh month came and the Israelites had settled in their towns, the people assembled together as one in Jerusalem.

source: Chuin Jozadak chapa Jeshua le asopi thempuho, chule Shealtiel chapa Jerubbabel le asopiho chu ading doh-un, Pathen mi Mosi dan thupeh-a kisun banga achunga govam thiltona ding Israel Pathen maicham chu asataove.
target: Then Joshua son of Jozadak and his fellow priests and Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and his associates began to build the altar of the God of Israel to sacrifice burnt offerings on it, in accordance with what is written in the Law of Moses the man of God.

source: Chuin amun mama-a chun maicham chu asemuve; ajeh chu chuche gamkaija miho jeh-a chun achunguva kichatna chu-a ahitai. Chua chun amahon Pakaiya dingin govam thilto atoh uvin, jingkah nilhah seh-in jong govam thilto atoh jiuvin ahi.
target: Despite their fear of the peoples around them, they built the altar on its foundation and sacrificed burnt offerings on it to the Lord , both the morning and evening sacrifices.

source: Anakisunsa bangin amahon Houbuh kut jong abollun, chule niseh-a bolding jat danthua kisun dungjuijin nisehle govam thilto chu atohjiovin;
target: Then in accordance with what is written, they celebrated the Festival of Tabernacles with the required number of burnt offerings prescribed for each day.

source: Chule hiche nunghin govam thilto aboljompeh-un, lhathah ho chule akithenso Pakai kut ho jouse-a, Pakai dingin mitinin kiphal tah-in lungcham thilpehho chu atoh-un ahi.
target: After that, they presented the regular burnt offerings, the New Moon sacrifices and the sacrifices for all the appointed sacred festivals of the Lord , as well as those brought as freewill offerings to the Lord .

source: Lha sagina nimasa ni-a patnin Pakai dinga govam thilto atoh panun ahi. Ahinla Pakai houin chu abul akiphutdoh hihlaijin ahi.
target: On the first day of the seventh month they began to offer burnt offerings to the Lord , though the foundation of the Lord ’s temple had not yet been laid.

source: Persia lengpa Cyrus'in apeh dung juijun, amahon songkheng hole thingthem bol hochu sum apeuvin, Lebanon'a pat Joppa twipi geijin Cedar thingho hinpo-a Sidon le Tyre miho chu anneh, twidon chule thao apeovin ahi.
target: Then they gave money to the masons and carpenters, and gave food and drink and olive oil to the people of Sidon and Tyre, so that they would bring cedar logs by sea from Lebanon to Joppa, as authorized by Cyrus king of Persia.

source: Tun Jerusalem'a Pathen In ahunglhunu kum nina, lhani na-in, Shealtiel chapa Zerubbabel le Jozak chapa Jeshua, chule asopite thempu dangho jouse le Levi ho, chule asoh channauva kona Jerusalem'a hungkileho chun natoh apanuvin, Levi ho kum somni-a lhah achunglamse chu Pakai in sahna-a mopo dingin apansah-un ahi.
target: In the second month of the second year after their arrival at the house of God in Jerusalem, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jozadak and the rest of the people (the priests and the Levites and all who had returned from the captivity to Jerusalem) began the work. They appointed Levites twenty years old and older to supervise the building of the house of the Lord .

source: Chujouvin Jeshua chu achapate le asopite, Kadmiel le achapate, Judah chapate Pathen in'a natong dinga kisepdoh ho toh thakhatnin adingun, Henadad chapateleh asopite Levi chapate toh ahiuve.
target: Joshua and his sons and brothers and Kadmiel and his sons (descendants of Hodaviah) and the sons of Henadad and their sons and brothers—all Levites—joined together in supervising those working on the house of God.

source: Chuin insahon Pakai houin chu abul aphudoh phatnun, amahon thempuho chu sumkon leh von akivonsah-un, chule Asaph chapate Levi ho chun khutbeh akichoijun, Israel lengpa David houdan thupeh dungjuijin Pakai chu avahchoijun ahi.
target: When the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the Lord , the priests in their vestments and with trumpets, and the Levites (the sons of Asaph) with cymbals, took their places to praise the Lord , as prescribed by David king of Israel.

source: Chuin amahon kilhang lhah-in vahchoina le thangvah nachu Pakaiya apeuvin: Ajehchu Pakai aphai, ijeh inem itileh ahepina a-imatih chanin Israel chunga aum jinge, tin asaovin ahi. Chule Pakai in abul akiphudoh tahjeh chun, mipi chun Pakai avahchoijun, awsang tah-in asamun ahi.
target: With praise and thanksgiving they sang to the Lord : “He is good; his love toward Israel endures forever.” And all the people gave a great shout of praise to the Lord , because the foundation of the house of the Lord was laid.

source: Ahinla thempu tamtah le Levi ho chule phunglah-a lubohho, milui tehse houin masa anamukha ho chun, amit mutah uva hiche Pakai in khom akiphu amutah-un, aw thong jejun akapmun, chule mitamtah kipah tah-in a-aosot sot jengun ahi.
target: But many of the older priests and Levites and family heads, who had seen the former temple, wept aloud when they saw the foundation of this temple being laid, while many others shouted for joy.

source: Hitichun mipi chun kipana jeh-a awgin leh mipi ka awgin chu ahekhenthem tapouve. Ajeh chu mipi chu thong jejun a-aovun, aw gin kithong chu gamlatah-a akijan ahi.
target: No one could distinguish the sound of the shouts of joy from the sound of weeping, because the people made so much noise. And the sound was heard far away.

source: Tun Judah le Benjamin mite kidoupihon, gal hinga kikaihon Israel Pakai Pathen houin ding asauve ti ajahphat uvin;
target: When the enemies of Judah and Benjamin heard that the exiles were building a temple for the Lord , the God of Israel,

source: Amaho Zerubbabel leh pate lamkaiho henga ahungun, ajah uva, keihon nasah khompiu vinge; ajehchu nangho bol bangin, keihon jong na Pathen'u kahol ui; chule hichan geija eihinpui toupao Assyria leng Esarhaddon nikho-a pat ama henga chu ganlhaina kana pehjiu ahi, atiuve.
target: they came to Zerubbabel and to the heads of the families and said, “Let us help you build because, like you, we seek your God and have been sacrificing to him since the time of Esarhaddon king of Assyria, who brought us here.”

source: Ahivangin Zerubbabel le Jeshua chule Israel lah-a pate lamkai dangho chun ajah uvah hitin aseijun, Ka Pathen'u in kisahna-a hin nangho ima nakikum nadiu aumpoi; ahinla Persia leng Cyrus'in thu eipeh banguva keihotah in Israel Pathen in kasahpeh dingu ahi, atiuve.
target: But Zerubbabel, Joshua and the rest of the heads of the families of Israel answered, “You have no part with us in building a temple to our God. We alone will build it for the Lord , the God of Israel, as King Cyrus, the king of Persia, commanded us.”

source: Chuphatnin chuche gama miho chun Judah mipi khut tha chu ahatmosah-un, a-insah-u chu asunohphah taove.
target: Then the peoples around them set out to discourage the people of Judah and make them afraid to go on building.

source: Chule Persia leng Cyrus nikholai sungsele, Persia leng Darius vaihom chan geijin, athilgonnu sunoh dingin amaho dounan thumopthem ho athalah-un ahi.
target: They bribed officials to work against them and frustrate their plans during the entire reign of Cyrus king of Persia and down to the reign of Darius king of Persia.

source: Chule Ahasuerus leng vaipoh kipattil lamin, amahon Judah gamsungle Jerusalem'a chengho hehna lekha asunuve.
target: At the beginning of the reign of Xerxes, they lodged an accusation against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.

source: Chule Artaxerxes nikho laijin Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel chule akiloipi dangho Persia leng Artaxerxes henga lekha ajih-un; chule lekhathot chu Syria paova kisun ahin, Syria paova kiledoh ahi.
target: And in the days of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel and the rest of his associates wrote a letter to Artaxerxes. The letter was written in Aramaic script and in the Aramaic language.

source: Vaipo pipui Rehum le danthu sunpa Shimshai'in Jerusalem douna-in Artaxerxes lengpa henga hitobanghin lekhathot asun lhonin:
target: Rehum the commanding officer and Shimshai the secretary wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king as follows:

source: Chuin vaipo pipu Rehum, danthu sunpa Shimshai, chule akiloipi dangho: Dina mite, Apharsath mite, Tarpel mite, Apharsith mite, Archevite mite, Babylon mite, Susan mite, Dehavi mite, chule Elam mite,
target: Rehum the commanding officer and Shimshai the secretary, together with the rest of their associates—the judges, officials and administrators over the people from Persia, Uruk and Babylon, the Elamites of Susa,

source: Chule ginle ja umtah Asnapper'in ahinpuidoh-a, chuche phat laija Samaria gamsung achensahho leh luigallam gamdanga cheng adang chengsen, hitihin asunun ahi.
target: and the other people whom the great and honorable Ashurbanipal deported and settled in the city of Samaria and elsewhere in Trans-Euphrates.

source: Alekha thotnu chu hiche hi ahi: Artaxerxes lengpa henga, luigal langkhatna chengho leh adang dangho-a kon nalhacha tehon:
target: (This is a copy of the letter they sent him.) To King Artaxerxes, From your servants in Trans-Euphrates:

source: Nangma-a kona Judah mi hungkitol dohho chu kahenguva Jerusalem'a ahungun, amahon baotamna le phaloutah khopi asauvin, abangho atungdoh-un, chule abulhochu asuto taove tihi lengpan anahe tan.
target: The king should know that the people who came up to us from you have gone to Jerusalem and are rebuilding that rebellious and wicked city. They are restoring the walls and repairing the foundations.

source: Hiche khopihi akisah phatna, chule abangho akitundoh kitna ahile, amahon gam man, thilpoh man, lamlen man ho apehlou dingu ahitan, chule hitia chu lengho sum mun'a asuhset dingu ahi, tihi tun lengpan anahe tan.
target: Furthermore, the king should know that if this city is built and its walls are restored, no more taxes, tribute or duty will be paid, and eventually the royal revenues will suffer.

source: Ajehchu keiho leng inpia kona kivah kahi jalun, lengpa kijabol louna mu hi keiho dinga vet thada umtah ahin, hijeh-a chu keihon hiche thuhi lengpa kahin hetsah-u ahi.
target: Now since we are under obligation to the palace and it is not proper for us to see the king dishonored, we are sending this message to inform the king,

source: Napu napate thuchin lekhabua chun kiholhen; chutile thuchin lekhabua kona chu, hiche khopihi kiphinna khopi, lengho le agamkaiho dinga kisuhkhah nathei, chule phat masa-a patna ana kiphin jing ahi jeh-a hiche khopi chu kisumanga anahi, ti namudoh-a nahetdoh ding ahi.
target: so that a search may be made in the archives of your predecessors. In these records you will find that this city is a rebellious city, troublesome to kings and provinces, a place with a long history of sedition. That is why this city was destroyed.

source: Hiche khopihi akisahphat kitna, chule abang akitundoh kitleh, hichejeh-a hi hilam pang vadung gal sese-a hi nangman chanvou nanei louhel ding ahi, ti lengpa kahin hetsah-u ahi.
target: We inform the king that if this city is built and its walls are restored, you will be left with nothing in Trans-Euphrates.

source: Chuphatnin lengpan adonbutna alethot nin: Vaipo pipu Rehum le danthu sunpa Shimshai, chule Samaria'a cheng akiloikhompi dangho le vadung lama chengho henga chun, chamna umhen.
target: The king sent this reply: To Rehum the commanding officer, Shimshai the secretary and the rest of their associates living in Samaria and elsewhere in Trans-Euphrates: Greetings.

source: Kahenguva nahin thotnu lekha chu, kamasanga kichentah-in akisim doh-e.
target: The letter you sent us has been read and translated in my presence.

source: Chule thu lhahna kapen, aki khol toh-in; hiche khopihi masanga patna lengho douna-a thunoh baotam boljing, asungah kiphinna le kiphin dinga mijollhahna ana umjing ahi, ti mudoh ahi.
target: I issued an order and a search was made, and it was found that this city has a long history of revolt against kings and has been a place of rebellion and sedition.
