source: Jerusalem'a hin leng thahat tahtah ana umin, amaho chu vadung gal gamjousea jong vai anahom uvin, chule amaho henga chun gam man, thilpoh man, lamlen man anapeuvin ahi.
target: Jerusalem has had powerful kings ruling over the whole of Trans-Euphrates, and taxes, tribute and duty were paid to them.

source: Tun hiche miho chun anatoh-u angahna diu le keiman thupeh dang kanei kit masangse-a khopi chu akisah kit louna dingin nanghon thu peuvin.
target: Now issue an order to these men to stop work, so that this city will not be rebuilt until I so order.

source: Hichehi boldoh louva aumlouna dingin tun nangho chingtheijun; ipidinga lengho setnading kiboldoh becheh ding ham?
target: Be careful not to neglect this matter. Why let this threat grow, to the detriment of the royal interests?

source: Tun Artaxerxes lengpa lekhathot chu Rehum le danthu sunpa shimahai le akiloipiho masanga asimjouvun, kinotah in Jerusalem'a Judah te henga acheuvin, thuneitah le thahatsanin anatoh-u chu angahsah taove.
target: As soon as the copy of the letter of King Artaxerxes was read to Rehum and Shimshai the secretary and their associates, they went immediately to the Jews in Jerusalem and compelled them by force to stop.

source: Chuphatnin Jerusalem'a Pathen Houin kisa chu atang tan ahi. Hitichun Persia leng Darius vaihom kum ni lhinna geijin atangdel tan ahi.
target: Thus the work on the house of God in Jerusalem came to a standstill until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

source: Chuchephat laichun Themgaoho, Haggai Themgao le Iddo chapa Zakariah'in, Judah le Jerusalem'a chengho Judah te henga Israel Pathen minin gaothu asei lhonin ahi.
target: Now Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the prophet, a descendant of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, who was over them.

source: Chujouvin Shealtiel chapa Zerubbabel leh Jozadok chapa Jeshua chu Jerusalem'a Pathen in chu sadingin akipan lhontai. Amani chu Pathen Themgaoho toh ahiuvin, amaho chun akithopiuvin ahi.
target: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jozadak set to work to rebuild the house of God in Jerusalem. And the prophets of God were with them, supporting them.

source: Hichephat laitah chun vadung hilamsang vaipopa Tatnai le Shetharbozenai, chule aloihotoh ahenguva ahungun, ajah uvah, hiche in sadingle abangho sajoudinga thu napeuvah koiham? tin ahung seijun ahi.
target: At that time Tattenai, governor of Trans-Euphrates, and Shethar-Bozenai and their associates went to them and asked, “Who authorized you to rebuild this temple and to finish it?”

source: Chuphatnin keihon ajah uvah hitin kasei taove, hiche in saho min chu ipiham? katiuve.
target: They also asked, “What are the names of those who are constructing this building?”

source: Ahivangin Pathen mit chu Judah upaho chunga chun aumin, hiche thudol hi Darius leng heng alhun masangsen anatoh-u chu asutang theipouve. Chuphatnin hiche thudol hi lekhathot nin ahindonbut taove.
target: But the eye of their God was watching over the elders of the Jews, and they were not stopped until a report could go to Darius and his written reply be received.

source: Hiche hi Tattenai'in athot lekhathot chu ahi: Vadung hilamsang vaipopa Tatnai le Shetharbozenai le akiloipi Aphreachi mite, vadung hilam sanga umhon, leng Darius henga:
target: This is a copy of the letter that Tattenai, governor of Trans-Euphrates, and Shethar-Bozenai and their associates, the officials of Trans-Euphrates, sent to King Darius.

source: Amahon ahenga lekha athotnun, asunga hitin akisune: Darius lengpa henga, lungmona jouse umhen.
target: The report they sent him read as follows: To King Darius: Cordial greetings.

source: Keiho Judah gamsunga kacheuvin, Pathen in loupitah, song lenpipi-a akisah le abang thing lenpipi-a kigen, chule hiche natoh hi amachal lheh-a, akhut tah uva akhantouvu hi lengpan anahen ahi.
target: The king should know that we went to the district of Judah, to the temple of the great God. The people are building it with large stones and placing the timbers in the walls. The work is being carried on with diligence and is making rapid progress under their direction.

source: Chuin keihon upaho henga chun, hiche in sading le abangho tungdoh dinga koijin thu napeh uham? tin kadongun ahi.
target: We questioned the elders and asked them, “Who authorized you to rebuild this temple and to finish it?”

source: Nangma henga alamkai hou min kichehtah-a kahin jih theina dingun, aminu jong kadongun ahi.
target: We also asked them their names, so that we could write down the names of their leaders for your information.

source: Amahon hitin eidon butnun, keihohi van le lei Pathen lhacha kahiuvin, kum tamtah masanga anakisa, Israelte leng loupi khatnin anasahdohsa in chu kasah-u ahi, atiuve.
target: This is the answer they gave us: “We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago, one that a great king of Israel built and finished.

source: Ahinla kapu kapa teovin van Pathen chu ana sulunghangun, Aman Chaldea mi Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar khutna amaho anapen, aman hiche in hi anasusen, miho chu Babylon gama anapuimang tan ahi.
target: But because our ancestors angered the God of heaven, he gave them into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar the Chaldean, king of Babylon, who destroyed this temple and deported the people to Babylon.

source: Ahivangin Babylon leng Cyrus lengchan akum khat na-in, leng Cyrus hin hiche Pathen in sah ding thupeh anapen ahi.
target: “However, in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, King Cyrus issued a decree to rebuild this house of God.

source: Chule Jerusalem'a um Pathen houin'a kon, sanale dangka-a kisem khonle bel jouse, Nebuchadnezzar'in analahdoh-a Babylon houin'a apohlut chengse chu, leng Cyrus chun Babylon houin'a konin aladoh kitnin, mikhat amin Sheshbazzar gam vaipo-a apansahpa henga chun apedohtan;
target: He even removed from the temple of Babylon the gold and silver articles of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the temple in Jerusalem and brought to the temple in Babylon. Then King Cyrus gave them to a man named Sheshbazzar, whom he had appointed governor,

source: Chule ahenga, hiche kong leh bel hohi lanlang, chen, Jerusalem'a um houin'a polutnin, Pathen houin chu akisahna ngaima-a kisa hen, ati.
target: and he told him, ‘Take these articles and go and deposit them in the temple in Jerusalem. And rebuild the house of God on its site.’

source: Chuphatnin Sheshbazzar chu ahungin, Jerusalem'a um Pathen houin sahnading khombul chu atungdoh-in, chule hichea patna chu tuni geija kisa jing ahin, chule tuchan hin akisajou hihlaije.
target: “So this Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of the house of God in Jerusalem. From that day to the present it has been under construction but is not yet finished.”

source: Hichejeh chun tun lengpan pha asahlam ahile, Jerusalem'a hiche Pathen in kisahna dinga leng Cyrus'in thutanlhah apehmong hinam ti hetdoh nadin, Babylon'a um lengpa goukholna in chu kikholtoh hen, chule hiche chungchang thudolla hin lengpan alungdeilam eihin hetsah taohen.
target: Now if it pleases the king, let a search be made in the royal archives of Babylon to see if King Cyrus did in fact issue a decree to rebuild this house of God in Jerusalem. Then let the king send us his decision in this matter.

source: Chuphatnin lengpa Darius chun thupeh apen, Babylon'a goukholna, thusimlui jouse kikoina in chu akhol toh uvin ahi.
target: King Darius then issued an order, and they searched in the archives stored in the treasury at Babylon.

source: Hichea hin Media gamkai, Achmetha khopi leng inpia lekhabujol amuvin, chule hiche sunga chun hitihin akisunin ahi.
target: A scroll was found in the citadel of Ecbatana in the province of Media, and this was written on it: Memorandum:

source: Leng Cyrus lengchan kumkhat alhin kum-in, hiche Cyrus lengpa hin Jerusalem'a Pathen houin thudola chun hitihin thupeh apei; ganlhai thilto aboljinao in chu kisapha hen, chule akhombul chu dettah-in kiphut hen, asanlam chu tong somgup, chule availam jong tong somgup hihen;
target: In the first year of King Cyrus, the king issued a decree concerning the temple of God in Jerusalem: Let the temple be rebuilt as a place to present sacrifices, and let its foundations be laid. It is to be sixty cubits high and sixty cubits wide,

source: Songtum len tahtah golthum min kigol hen, chule thingpeh thah gol khatnin kigol hen, chule akimang jouse chu leng ina kona kipeding ahi.
target: with three courses of large stones and one of timbers. The costs are to be paid by the royal treasury.

source: Chule Pathen in'a kon sana le dangka-a kisem khonle lheng jouse, leng Nabuchadnezzar in Jerusalem houin'a kona alahdoh-a Babylon lama anapohho chu, kilepehkit henlang Jerusalem houin'a chun kipolutkit hen, chule Pathen in'a akikoina muncheh-a kikoi kit hen.
target: Also, the gold and silver articles of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple in Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, are to be returned to their places in the temple in Jerusalem; they are to be deposited in the house of God.

source: Hijeh chun tun vadung gal lama gam vaipo Tatnai, Shetharbozenai le vadung gal lama um naloiho Apharsach mite chu, chukoma konchun ana kikhindalun.
target: Now then, Tattenai, governor of Trans-Euphrates, and Shethar-Bozenai and you other officials of that province, stay away from there.

source: Hiche Pathen in kisahi limsah hih-un, Judah te gam vaipopa leh Judah upaho chengsen hiche Pathen houin hi amun mama-a saohen.
target: Do not interfere with the work on this temple of God. Let the governor of the Jews and the Jewish elders rebuild this house of God on its site.

source: Chukalvallin hiche Pathen in kasahna dinga, Judah upaho chunga ipi naboldingu thupeh kapeh nahiuve; amaho natoh atanlouna diuva lengpa thilholeh vadung lama kaiho chu, hiche miho hin amanchah diuva pehding ahi.
target: Moreover, I hereby decree what you are to do for these elders of the Jews in the construction of this house of God: Their expenses are to be fully paid out of the royal treasury, from the revenues of Trans-Euphrates, so that the work will not stop.

source: Chule van Pathen dinga govam thilto ding angaichat jouseu, bongchal golho, kelngoichalho, kelngoinou ho, suhlou chang, chi, lengpitwi le thao ho chu Jerusalem'a thempu hon angaichat khoh dungjuijuva aniseh-a amaho thonlouva napeh teitei dingu ahi.
target: Whatever is needed—young bulls, rams, male lambs for burnt offerings to the God of heaven, and wheat, salt, wine and olive oil, as requested by the priests in Jerusalem—must be given them daily without fail,

source: Chutileh van Pathen henga namtui tahtah-a ganlhaina aneitheijuva, chule lengpa le achate hinkho dinga ataopeh theidingu ahi.
target: so that they may offer sacrifices pleasing to the God of heaven and pray for the well-being of the king and his sons.

source: Hiche thupeh jonghi kapeh ahi: koihile hiche thuhi akhela aumle, a-in lhungpi kiloilha hen, chule hichu kiphut hen, achunga chun kikhailih hen; chule a-in chu eh notnan kineihen.
target: Furthermore, I decree that if anyone defies this edict, a beam is to be pulled from their house and they are to be impaled on it. And for this crime their house is to be made a pile of rubble.

source: Chule chemuna amin umsah Pathen chun, Jerusalem'a Pathen in suhsetgo-a, chule hiche thu kheldoh ding go-a khut lama chu lengho hihen, mipi ho hijongleh suhmang hihen, keima Darius in thu kapeh ahi; gangtah in kitongdoh hen.
target: May God, who has caused his Name to dwell there, overthrow any king or people who lifts a hand to change this decree or to destroy this temple in Jerusalem. I Darius have decreed it. Let it be carried out with diligence.

source: Chujouvin Darius lengpan thu ahinthot dungjuijin, vadung hilamsanga vaipo Tatnai le Shetharbozenai chule aloihon gangtah in aboltauve.
target: Then, because of the decree King Darius had sent, Tattenai, governor of Trans-Euphrates, and Shethar-Bozenai and their associates carried it out with diligence.

source: Chule Judah upaho chun asaovin, Haggai themgao le Iddo chapa Zekeriah gaothusei vangin amachallheh jenguvin ahi. Hitichun Israel Pathen thupeh dungjuile, Persia leng Cyrus, Darius, chule Artaxerxes thupeh dungjuijin asauvin, ajoutaovin ahi.
target: So the elders of the Jews continued to build and prosper under the preaching of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah, a descendant of Iddo. They finished building the temple according to the command of the God of Israel and the decrees of Cyrus, Darius and Artaxerxes, kings of Persia.

source: Chuin hiche in chu Darius alengchan kumgup lhinna, Adar lha nithum channin ajou taove.
target: The temple was completed on the third day of the month Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.

source: Chuin Israel chate, thempuho, Levi ho, chule sohchang chate danghon, hiche Pathen in thensona chu kipahtah-in amangun,
target: Then the people of Israel—the priests, the Levites and the rest of the exiles—celebrated the dedication of the house of God with joy.

source: Hiche Pathen houin thenso na-a hin, bongchal jakhat, kelngoichal jani, kelngoinou jali, chule Israel pumpidin chonset thilpeh-a dingin Israel phungjat dungjuijin kelchal somleni apeuvin ahi.
target: For the dedication of this house of God they offered a hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred male lambs and, as a sin offering for all Israel, twelve male goats, one for each of the tribes of Israel.

source: Mosi lekhabua kisun dungjuijin, Jerusalem'a Pathen kin bolna dingin thempuho chu aloiloijin chule Levi ho chu agolgolin ahomkhenun ahi.
target: And they installed the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their groups for the service of God at Jerusalem, according to what is written in the Book of Moses.

source: Chule lha masapen nisomle nili lhinin, gal hinga kikai chaten kalchuh kut amangun ahi.
target: On the fourteenth day of the first month, the exiles celebrated the Passover.

source: Ajehchu thempuho le Levi ho chu akisutheng khomun, abonchauvun atheng taovin, chuin sohchang chate jouse dingle asopiteu thempuho chule amaho ding ngeijin kalchuh kut satha aboltauve.
target: The priests and Levites had purified themselves and were all ceremonially clean. The Levites slaughtered the Passover lamb for all the exiles, for their relatives the priests and for themselves.

source: Chule Israel chate gal hinga kikai hungkilekit hole, Pakai Israel Pathen holdinga chuche gama Pathen helou thenlouna-a kona kikangse jouse chun aneuvin ahi.
target: So the Israelites who had returned from the exile ate it, together with all who had separated themselves from the unclean practices of their Gentile neighbors in order to seek the Lord , the God of Israel.

source: Chutichun cholsolou changlhah kut chu thanom tah-in nisagi amanguve. Ajehchu Pakaiyin amaho chu akipasah in, Pathen, Israel Pathen insahna-a akhuthou hatsah dingin, Assyria lengpa lungthim chu amaho lam angatsah-in ahi.
target: For seven days they celebrated with joy the Festival of Unleavened Bread, because the Lord had filled them with joy by changing the attitude of the king of Assyria so that he assisted them in the work on the house of God, the God of Israel.

source: Tun hicheng nunghin Persia leng Artaxerxes alengchan laijin, Ezra: amachu Seraish chapa, Azariah chapa, Hilkiah chapa,
target: After these things, during the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

source: Shallum chapa, Zadok chapa, Ahitub chapa,
target: the son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

source: Amariah chapa, Azariah chapa, Meraioth chapa,
target: the son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

source: Zerahiah chapa, Uzzi chapa, Bukki chapa,
target: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

source: Abishua chapa, Phinehas chapa, Eleazar chapa, thempu chungnung Aaron chapa ahi.
target: the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest—

source: Hiche Ezra hi Babylon'a kon achetouvin, chule Pakai Israel Pathen'in apeh Mosi danthu sunthem tah ahin, Pakai a-Pathen khutchu achunga aumjeh-in angeh chanchu lengpan apejingin ahi.
target: this Ezra came up from Babylon. He was a teacher well versed in the Law of Moses, which the Lord , the God of Israel, had given. The king had granted him everything he asked, for the hand of the Lord his God was on him.

source: Chule leng Artaxerxes alengchan kum sagi alhinnin, Israel chate phabep, thempuho, Levi ho, Lasaho, kotngah ho, chule Nethinim ho Jerusalem'a agache touvun ahi.
target: Some of the Israelites, including priests, Levites, musicians, gatekeepers and temple servants, also came up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes.

source: Chule lengpa lengchan kal kum sagina, alha ngana-a chun Ezra Jerusalem ahung lhungin ahi.
target: Ezra arrived in Jerusalem in the fifth month of the seventh year of the king.

source: Ajehchu lha masapen nikho masapen ni-a Babylon'a kona hung kipatdoh ahin, a-Pathen khutchu achunga aum dungjuijin alha chaina nikho masapen nin Jerusalem ahung lhungin ahi.
target: He had begun his journey from Babylon on the first day of the first month, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month, for the gracious hand of his God was on him.

source: Ijeh inem itileh Ezra chu Pakai dan thupeh ho chu hol ding le tongdoh dinga, chule tepna dan kisun hole thutanlhahna chu Israel lah-a hildingin, alunggila akigo chaisa ahitai.
target: For Ezra had devoted himself to the study and observance of the Law of the Lord , and to teaching its decrees and laws in Israel.

source: Tun, leng Artaxerxes in Ezra thempu, danthu sun, Pakaiyin Israelte apeh dan thupeh ho le danthu kisunho hethempa, henga apeh lekhathot chu hichehi ahi.
target: This is a copy of the letter King Artaxerxes had given to Ezra the priest, a teacher of the Law, a man learned in matters concerning the commands and decrees of the Lord for Israel:

source: Lengho leng Artaxerxes Ezra thempu, van Pathen danthusunpa henga: lungmona chamkim tu le khonungin umjinghen.
target: Artaxerxes, king of kings, To Ezra the priest, teacher of the Law of the God of heaven: Greetings.

source: Kaleng gamsunga Israel mipi jouse, thempuho le, Levi ho, Jerusalem'a chetou nom jouse chu nangma toh kilhondin thu kalhuhsahtai.
target: Now I decree that any of the Israelites in my kingdom, including priests and Levites, who volunteer to go to Jerusalem with you, may go.

source: Nakhutna um Pathen dan dungjuija, Judah gam le Jerusalem chungchang thudol kholtoh dinga lengpa le athumop mi sagihon nangmatah nasolu ahin;
target: You are sent by the king and his seven advisers to inquire about Judah and Jerusalem with regard to the Law of your God, which is in your hand.

source: Chule Jerusalem'a cheng Israel Pathen henga, lengpa le athumop hon achamtah uva atou, sanale dangka thah dinga;
target: Moreover, you are to take with you the silver and gold that the king and his advisers have freely given to the God of Israel, whose dwelling is in Jerusalem,

source: Chule Babylon gamkai jouse sana le dangka namu jousetoh, Jerusalem'a Pathen in dinga kiphal tah-a mipi hole thempuhon atodoh-u, lungcham thilpeh hojong thah dinga kisol nahi:
target: together with all the silver and gold you may obtain from the province of Babylon, as well as the freewill offerings of the people and priests for the temple of their God in Jerusalem.

source: Chutia chu nangman hiche suma chu bongchalho, kelngoichalho, kelngoinou ho, anneh thilto hole donthei theilto ho chu gangtah-a nachoh-a, Jerusalem'a um na Pathen houin maichama chu natoding ahi.
target: With this money be sure to buy bulls, rams and male lambs, together with their grain offerings and drink offerings, and sacrifice them on the altar of the temple of your God in Jerusalem.

source: Chule sanale dangka amoh chengse chu nangma le nasopi hon naphatsahna lam lamun, na Pathen lungdeilamin mangtaovin.
target: You and your fellow Israelites may then do whatever seems best with the rest of the silver and gold, in accordance with the will of your God.

source: Na Pathen in'a akinbolna dinga nakipe kong leh bel hojong, Jerusalem'a Pathen angsunga napehlut ding ahi.
target: Deliver to the God of Jerusalem all the articles entrusted to you for worship in the temple of your God.

source: Chule na Pathen in'a dinga akhohna chana pehding aum nahlaileh, lengpa nei khol khomna in'a kona napehding ahi.
target: And anything else needed for the temple of your God that you are responsible to supply, you may provide from the royal treasury.

source: Chule keima Artaxerxes leng keimatah-in, vadung gal lama um neiching ho jouse henga; ipi hijongle Ezra thempu, van Pathen danthu sunpan naheng uva athumchan chu gangtah-a nabolpeh dingu ahi, tin thulhah kaneijin ahi.
target: Now I, King Artaxerxes, decree that all the treasurers of Trans-Euphrates are to provide with diligence whatever Ezra the priest, the teacher of the Law of the God of heaven, may ask of you—

source: Dangka talent jakhat, suhlou chang tena jakhat, lengpitwi atena jakhat, thao atena jakhat, chule chi ijatmong ti umlouva napeh dingu ahi.
target: up to a hundred talents of silver, a hundred cors of wheat, a hundred baths of wine, a hundred baths of olive oil, and salt without limit.

source: Van Pathen thupeh chanchu, van Pathen in dinga thanom tah-a pehding ahi. Ajeh chu ipidinga lunghanna chu lengpa le achapate lenggam douna-a umding ham?
target: Whatever the God of heaven has prescribed, let it be done with diligence for the temple of the God of heaven. Why should his wrath fall on the realm of the king and of his sons?

source: Chujongle thempuho, Levi ho, tumginga lasaho, kotngah ho, Nethinim ho, ahiloule Pathen in'a lhachaho chunga thilpohman kai, ahiloule thilho kai lah hi danto kitohlou ahi, ti kahin hetsah nahiuve.
target: You are also to know that you have no authority to impose taxes, tribute or duty on any of the priests, Levites, musicians, gatekeepers, temple servants or other workers at this house of God.

source: Chule Ezra nangman, nakhutna Pathen chihna nanei dungjuija, vadung gala mipi jouse thutan dinga, na Pathen dan heho lah-a kona thutan dingle vaihom ding nalhen ding, chule ahelouho chu nahil ding ahi.
target: And you, Ezra, in accordance with the wisdom of your God, which you possess, appoint magistrates and judges to administer justice to all the people of Trans-Euphrates—all who know the laws of your God. And you are to teach any who do not know them.

source: Koihile na Pathen danle lengpa dan joplou chu: thading ham, nodoh dingham, ahiloule athilkeo lahpeh dingham, songkul'a khumding ham, gangtah-a dan dungjuija athu-u tanding ahi.
target: Whoever does not obey the law of your God and the law of the king must surely be punished by death, banishment, confiscation of property, or imprisonment.

source: Jerusalem khopi'a Pakai in jephoina dinga lengpa lungsunga hitobang lunggel khumpeh-a ipu ipateu Pakai Pathen chu nunnom hen.
target: Praise be to the Lord , the God of our ancestors, who has put it into the king’s heart to bring honor to the house of the Lord in Jerusalem in this way

source: Chule aman lengpa le athumopho, chule lengpa pipui loupitahho masanga hepina eina pejingin ahi. Chule Pakai ka Pathen khut kachunga aumjeh-in keima katha ahatdoh-in, Israel lah-a konin mithupiho keima kilhontoupi din kakhomkhomin ahi.
target: and who has extended his good favor to me before the king and his advisers and all the king’s powerful officials. Because the hand of the Lord my God was on me, I took courage and gathered leaders from Israel to go up with me.

source: Hichehohi leng Artaxerxes vaihom laija Babylon'a kona keitoh hung kilhontou aphung sunga upa chengse phunggui chu ahi.
target: These are the family heads and those registered with them who came up with me from Babylon during the reign of King Artaxerxes:

source: Phinehas chapate lah-a Gershom, Ithamar chapate lah-a Daniel, David chapate lah-a Hattush.
target: of the descendants of Phinehas, Gershom; of the descendants of Ithamar, Daniel; of the descendants of David, Hattush

source: Shecaniah chapate, Parosh chapate, Zekeriah chapate chule amatoh phunggui kisimna-a pasal jakhatle somnga alhinguve.
target: of the descendants of Shekaniah; of the descendants of Parosh, Zechariah, and with him were registered 150 men;

source: Pahath-moab chapate, Zerahiah chapa Elihoenai ahin, chule amatoh jani ahiuve.
target: of the descendants of Pahath-Moab, Eliehoenai son of Zerahiah, and with him 200 men;

source: Shecaniah chapate, Jahaziel chapa chule amatoh pasal jathum ahiuve.
target: of the descendants of Zattu, Shekaniah son of Jahaziel, and with him 300 men;

source: Adin chapate, Jonatham chapa Ebed chule amatoh pasal somnga ahiuve.
target: of the descendants of Adin, Ebed son of Jonathan, and with him 50 men;

source: Chule Elam chapate, Athaliah chapa Jeshaiah chule amatoh pasal somsagi ahiuve.
target: of the descendants of Elam, Jeshaiah son of Athaliah, and with him 70 men;

source: Shephatiah chapate, Michael chapa Zebadiah chule amatoh pasal somget ahiuve.
target: of the descendants of Shephatiah, Zebadiah son of Michael, and with him 80 men;

source: Joab chapate, Jehiel chapa Obadiah chule amatoh pasal jani leh somleget ahiuve.
target: of the descendants of Joab, Obadiah son of Jehiel, and with him 218 men;

source: Chule Shelomith chapate, Josiphiah chapa chule amatoh pasal jakhatle somgup ahiuve.
target: of the descendants of Bani, Shelomith son of Josiphiah, and with him 160 men;

source: Chule Bebai chapate, Bebai chapa Zekeriah ahin chule amatoh pasal somni le get ahiuve.
target: of the descendants of Bebai, Zechariah son of Bebai, and with him 28 men;

source: Chule Azgad chapate, Hakkatan chapa Johanan chule amatoh pasal jakhatle som ahiuve.
target: of the descendants of Azgad, Johanan son of Hakkatan, and with him 110 men;

source: Chule Adonikam chapate anunung lamho lah-a, aminho chu Eliphelet, Jeiel, Shemaiah, chule amatoh pasal somgup ahiuve.
target: of the descendants of Adonikam, the last ones, whose names were Eliphelet, Jeuel and Shemaiah, and with them 60 men;

source: Bigvai chapate jong Uthai le Zabbud chule amatoh pasal somsagi ahiuve.
target: of the descendants of Bigvai, Uthai and Zakkur, and with them 70 men.

source: Chule amaho chu keiman Ahava luidunglen lama long vadunga chun kakhom khomin, chule hiche mun'a chun pon in'a nithum kaumun, chule mihole thempuho chu kagahven ahile Levi chapate khatcha jong kamupoi.
target: I assembled them at the canal that flows toward Ahava, and we camped there three days. When I checked among the people and the priests, I found no Levites there.

source: Chuphatnin mithupiho, Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zekeriah, Meshullam koudin mi kasolin; chule hetkhenna nei Joirib le Elnathan jong kakouvin ahi.
target: So I summoned Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah and Meshullam, who were leaders, and Joiarib and Elnathan, who were men of learning,

source: Chule keiman amaho chu Kasiphia mun'a lamkai Iddo henga thupeh pumin kasollin, chule ka Pathen in'a lhachading kahenguva ahinpuina dingun Kasiphia mun'a um Iddo le asopipa Nithinim jah-a ipi aseidingu kaseipeh-in ahi.
target: and I ordered them to go to Iddo, the leader in Kasiphia. I told them what to say to Iddo and his fellow Levites, the temple servants in Kasiphia, so that they might bring attendants to us for the house of our God.

source: Chule ka Pathen khut phatah kachunguva aumjeh-in, milung chingtah khat: Mahli chapate lah-a, Levi chapate lah-a, Israel chapate lah-a kon Sherabiah kitipa chu achapate le asopite somleget toh kahenguva ahinpuijun ahi;
target: Because the gracious hand of our God was on us, they brought us Sherebiah, a capable man, from the descendants of Mahli son of Levi, the son of Israel, and Sherebiah’s sons and brothers, 18 in all;

source: Chule Hashabiah, amatoh Merari chapate Jeshaiah, asopite leh achapate toh somni ahiuvin,
target: and Hashabiah, together with Jeshaiah from the descendants of Merari, and his brothers and nephews, 20 in all.

source: Chujongle David le pipuhon Levi ho kin boldinga anapansah-u, Nethinim lah-a Nethinim mi jani leh somni ahiuvin, amahohi amincheh-a kiphongdoh ahiuve.
target: They also brought 220 of the temple servants—a body that David and the officials had established to assist the Levites. All were registered by name.

source: Chuphatnin Ahava vadunglen'a chun, ka Pathen'u anga keihole keiho kaki gimbol uve, ama-a kona lamdih kamutheina dingun, keiho dingle kacha tediu chule kathilnei jouseu diuvin, an ngolding thu kaphongin ahi.
target: There, by the Ahava Canal, I proclaimed a fast, so that we might humble ourselves before our God and ask him for a safe journey for us and our children, with all our possessions.

source: Ijeh inem itile sepai honkhat, chule sakol sepaiho lamkah-a melma ho-a kona eikithopi diu lengpa henga thumding chu kajah achai. Ajehchu keihon lengpa henga, ka Pathen'u khutchu ama holho jouse chunga aphatna diuvin aumjin, ahinla ama nungsun ho jouse chunga athahatna le alunghana chujia ahi, tia kanaseiju ahi.
target: I was ashamed to ask the king for soldiers and horsemen to protect us from enemies on the road, because we had told the king, “The gracious hand of our God is on everyone who looks to him, but his great anger is against all who forsake him.”

source: Hitichun hiche dingin an kangol taovin, ka Pathen'u henga kathum un, eijahpeh-un ahi.
target: So we fasted and petitioned our God about this, and he answered our prayer.

source: Chuin thempuho lah-a lamkai somleni, Sherabiah, Hashebiah, chule asopiho somtoh kasep khentan ahi.
target: Then I set apart twelve of the leading priests, namely, Sherebiah, Hashabiah and ten of their brothers,

source: Chule lengpa le athumopho, a-pakai ho, chule chua Israel aum jousen anato doh-u sanale dangka, umle bel, ka Pathen'u in'a thilpehho jengjong chu amaho katedoh pehtan:
target: and I weighed out to them the offering of silver and gold and the articles that the king, his advisers, his officials and all Israel present there had donated for the house of our God.

source: Keiman dangka talent jaguple somnga, dangka umle bel talent jakhat, chule sana talent jakhat,
target: I weighed out to them 650 talents of silver, silver articles weighing 100 talents, 100 talents of gold,

source: Chujongle sana twikong somni, dram sangkhat, chule sana tobanga lu sumsantheng bel ni, akhutnuva katedoh in ahi.
target: 20 bowls of gold valued at 1,000 darics, and two fine articles of polished bronze, as precious as gold.

source: Chule ajah uvah nangho Pakai dinga atheng nahiuvin, umle bel hojong atheng ahin, chule sanale dangka hohi napu napateu Pakai Pathen henga lungcham thilto ahi.
target: I said to them, “You as well as these articles are consecrated to the Lord . The silver and gold are a freewill offering to the Lord , the God of your ancestors.

source: Jerusalem'a Pakai indan ho-a, thempuho le Levi ho lamkai, chule Israel pateho lamkaiho angsunga hicheho hi natedoh masang seuvin, vetupmun lang chingphaovin.
target: Guard them carefully until you weigh them out in the chambers of the house of the Lord in Jerusalem before the leading priests and the Levites and the family heads of Israel.”

source: Hitichun thempuho leh Levi hon todohsa dangkale sana chule um le bel ho chu, Jerusalem'a ka Pathen'u in'a pohdingin alataovin ahi.
target: Then the priests and Levites received the silver and gold and sacred articles that had been weighed out to be taken to the house of our God in Jerusalem.

source: Chujouvin lhasomle lhani na nimasanin, Ahava vadunglen'a konin Jerusalem'a chedin kakipan taove. Chule ka Pathen'u khutchu kachunguva aumin, lampi dunga eichanglhi ho leh melmaho khutna konin eihuhdoh uve.
target: On the twelfth day of the first month we set out from the Ahava Canal to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God was on us, and he protected us from enemies and bandits along the way.

source: Chule Jerusalem'a kahungun, chule hia chun nithum kanichong taove.
target: So we arrived in Jerusalem, where we rested three days.

source: Tun anili channin, dangka le sana chule umle bel ho chu ka Pathen'u in'a thempu Uriah chapa Meremoth khutna katedoh taovin; chule amato chun Phinehas chapa Eleazer aumin, chule amanitoh Levi mi Jeshua chapa Jozabad le Binnui chapa Naodiah aumin ahi.
target: On the fourth day, in the house of our God, we weighed out the silver and gold and the sacred articles into the hands of Meremoth son of Uriah, the priest. Eleazar son of Phinehas was with him, and so were the Levites Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.

source: Thil jouse chu simsoh keile tesohkei ahin; chule akite jouse chu hiche petchun akisunlut sohkeije.
target: Everything was accounted for by number and weight, and the entire weight was recorded at that time.

source: Chujongle anakikai manga sohchana-a kona hungkilekit chatehon, Israel Pathen henga bongchal somleni, kelngoichal somko le gup, kelngoinou somsagi le sagi, govam thilto din, chule kelchal somleni chonset thiltodin atoh uve. Hicheho jousehi Pakai henga govam thilto ahi.
target: Then the exiles who had returned from captivity sacrificed burnt offerings to the God of Israel: twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven male lambs and, as a sin offering, twelve male goats. All this was a burnt offering to the Lord .

source: Chuin amahon lengpa thalheng ho, chule vadunglen hilam sanga gam vaipoho henga, lengpa thutanlhah hochu apedoh taove. Chule amahon mipileh Pathen houna in chu akithopi jomjing taovin ahi.
target: They also delivered the king’s orders to the royal satraps and to the governors of Trans-Euphrates, who then gave assistance to the people and to the house of God.

source: Tun hiti thil jouse akitoh chai phatnin, milenho chu eikimuto pidingin ahunguvin, kajah-a; Israel mite, thempuho, chule Levi ho chense chu, hiche gama cheng Canaan mite, Hit mite, Perizz mite, Jebus mite, Ammon mite, Moab mite, Egypt mite chule Amor mite thilbol thet umtah tahho-a konin amaho le amaho akikangse pouve, tin aseijun ahi.
target: After these things had been done, the leaders came to me and said, “The people of Israel, including the priests and the Levites, have not kept themselves separate from the neighboring peoples with their detestable practices, like those of the Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians and Amorites.

source: Ajehchu amahon achanu teu chu achapateu jidingle, amaho jidin akipuijun; hitichun muchi theng chu amaho le amaho agam miho toh akihalsoh taovin, hiche suhkhelna chu lengho le vaihomho khut ahahi dehsetne.
target: They have taken some of their daughters as wives for themselves and their sons, and have mingled the holy race with the peoples around them. And the leaders and officials have led the way in this unfaithfulness.”

source: Hiche thilsoh kajah apat hin, kavon holeh kaponsil kabot telin, kasam le kakhamul kabot doh-in, kidang satah-in katou lhatai.
target: When I heard this, I tore my tunic and cloak, pulled hair from my head and beard and sat down appalled.

source: Sohchanga kikaiho thil suhkhel jeh-a Israel Pathen thua ati kithingleu hochu kahenglama ahung khomun; chuin nilhah lam ganlhaiphat channin kidang satah-in katoutai.
target: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel gathered around me because of this unfaithfulness of the exiles. And I sat there appalled until the evening sacrifice.

source: Chule nilhah lam ganlhai phatnin lungkham tah-a katouna-a konin kathoudoh-in, kavonle kapon kabokeh tolhonin kaboh khupmin, chule Pakai ka Pathen lama kakhut kajah-in,
target: Then, at the evening sacrifice, I rose from my self-abasement, with my tunic and cloak torn, and fell on my knees with my hands spread out to the Lord my God

source: Chule hitin kati, Vo Ka Pathen, nahenglam hinngat dinghi kajah achan kamaimoh lheh jenge, vo Pathen; ajehchu kachonset naohin kaluvumu achup jengin, chule kasuhkhel naohi van chan phahelin akitungdoh-e.
target: and prayed: “I am too ashamed and disgraced, my God, to lift up my face to you, because our sins are higher than our heads and our guilt has reached to the heavens.

source: Kapu kapateu nikho laija pat tuni chanin suhkhelna lentah kanei jingun; kakhan gitlou jeh-un keiho, kalengteo, chule kathempu hou gamsunga lengho khutna, chemjam'a, sohchang dinga, chomgam dinga, jumle ja thoh dinga, tunia banga hi eikipedoh-u ahi.
target: From the days of our ancestors until now, our guilt has been great. Because of our sins, we and our kings and our priests have been subjected to the sword and captivity, to pillage and humiliation at the hand of foreign kings, as it is today.

source: Chule tunvang ka Pathen'un kamit hou ahadohsah theina dingle, soh-a kaum naova kona halna neokhat eipeh theina diule, asohcha amoh themkhat beh kaum theina dingun, chule amunthenga eiumsah theina dingun, Pakai ka Pathen'un chom khatbeh lungsetna eimusah nalaiju hen.
target: “But now, for a brief moment, the Lord our God has been gracious in leaving us a remnant and giving us a firm place in his sanctuary, and so our God gives light to our eyes and a little relief in our bondage.

source: Ajehchu keihohi soh kihen kahibouvun, ahijeng vangin ka Pathen'un kakihen naova eidalha pouvin, ahivangin keiho halna peh kit dingle, Pathen in tungdoh ding, chule aselaiho sempha dingle, Judah gamle Jerusalem'a kulbang sempha dingin, Persia lengte mitmu-a hepina eimusah-un ahi.
target: Though we are slaves, our God has not forsaken us in our bondage. He has shown us kindness in the sight of the kings of Persia: He has granted us new life to rebuild the house of our God and repair its ruins, and he has given us a wall of protection in Judah and Jerusalem.

source: Chule Vo ka Pathen, tu-a keihon hicheho jouse nunga ipi kasei dingu hitam? keihon nathupeh ho kanung ngatsan taovin,
target: “But now, our God, what can we say after this? For we have forsaken the commands

source: Nalhacha themgaoho mangcha-a, hitia nanasei, nagalo dingu gam chu, agama chengho thenlounale, thil kidah umtah abolhouva kona bohtin bohtanga among langkhat napat among langkhat geija asuhboh-u, gam thenglou ahi.
target: you gave through your servants the prophets when you said: ‘The land you are entering to possess is a land polluted by the corruption of its peoples. By their detestable practices they have filled it with their impurity from one end to the other.

source: Hijeh chun tun nathahat na dingule, gamsunga anpha naneh nadingu, chule nachateo gou ding nadalhah peh theina dingun: nanghon nachanuteu chu achapateu pedoh hih-un, chule achanuteu chu nachapateo dingin puipeh hih-un, chuleh a-imatih chanin amaho-a konin chamna le neile gou hol hih-un.
target: Therefore, do not give your daughters in marriage to their sons or take their daughters for your sons. Do not seek a treaty of friendship with them at any time, that you may be strong and eat the good things of the land and leave it to your children as an everlasting inheritance.’

source: Chule ka-eng khan jeh-uleh, kasuhkhel nau jeh-a, kachung uva hitobang thil ahunglhun nungin jong, nang ka Pathen'un kakhan gitlounau jeh-a kathoh dingu sanga lhomjo-a gotna neipeh uva, hitobang tah hin neihoidoh nahlai jeh-un:
target: “What has happened to us is a result of our evil deeds and our great guilt, and yet, our God, you have punished us less than our sins deserved and have given us a remnant like this.

source: Neithupeh hou chu kasuhkehkit uva, chule hiche thet umtah miho hi kaki guijoppi kit dingu ham? Ahoidoh-a le ajamdoh-a beihela neisuh mang kahseuva, kachunguva nalunghang lou ding ham?
target: Shall we then break your commands again and intermarry with the peoples who commit such detestable practices? Would you not be angry enough with us to destroy us, leaving us no remnant or survivor?

source: Vo Israelte Pakai Pathen, nangma chonphatah nahi; ajehchu keiho tunikho-a banghin kahoidoh nalaijun ahi. Ven kasuh khelnao pumin namasanga kaum uve; ajehchu hiteho jeh-a hi nama sanga dingthei lou kahiuve.
target: Lord , the God of Israel, you are righteous! We are left this day as a remnant. Here we are before you in our guilt, though because of it not one of us can stand in your presence.”

source: Tun Ezra chu ataova, chonset naho chu aphongdoh-a, kapuma Pathen in masanga chun atoulhah jeng phatchun, Israel mite lah-a kon pasal le numei chule chapang mipi kikhom nasatah ahenga ahung kikhomun, mipi chu lhasetah-in akap taove.
target: While Ezra was praying and confessing, weeping and throwing himself down before the house of God, a large crowd of Israelites—men, women and children—gathered around him. They too wept bitterly.

source: Chule Elam chate lah-a kona Jehiel chapa Shechaniah chun adonbutnin chule Ezra keihon i-Pathen angsungah thil kasukhel taovin, chule hiche gama gamchom numei ho chu jin kaneijun ahi; ahinla hiche thua hin Israel mite din kinepna aum nalaijin ahi.
target: Then Shekaniah son of Jehiel, one of the descendants of Elam, said to Ezra, “We have been unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women from the peoples around us. But in spite of this, there is still hope for Israel.

source: Hijeh chun tun ka pakai thumop dungjuile, danthu dungjuijin, Pathen danthupeh ginga kihot hotna umjousen, gamdang numei ji-a kinei jouse le amaho-a kon peng jouse koidoh nadingin, i-Pathen'u toh kitepna khat semu hite.
target: Now let us make a covenant before our God to send away all these women and their children, in accordance with the counsel of my lord and of those who fear the commands of our God. Let it be done according to the Law.

source: Thoudoh-in, ajehchu hichehi nangma khutna um ahi, keiho jong nangma to kaum khom dingu ahi; hangsanin, tong jengin, ati.
target: Rise up; this matter is in your hands. We will support you, so take courage and do it.”

source: Chutah-in Ezra athoudoh-in, thempulen leh Levi ho chuleh Israel mijouse chu akisei thu banga boldingin akihahsel sah-in ahileh, amaho jong akihahsel taove.
target: So Ezra rose up and put the leading priests and Levites and all Israel under oath to do what had been suggested. And they took the oath.

source: Chuin Ezra Pathen in masanga konchun athoudoh-in, Johanan kiti Eliashib chapa indan sunga alutnin: chule hiche mun ahunglhun chun, aman changlhah anepon twi jong adonpoi; ajehchu soh-a kikai mangho thilsuhkhel jeh-a lunghema uma ahi.
target: Then Ezra withdrew from before the house of God and went to the room of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. While he was there, he ate no food and drank no water, because he continued to mourn over the unfaithfulness of the exiles.

source: Chule Judah gam le Jerusalem'a um sohchangho jouse henga chun, Jerusalem'a kikhop sohkei dingin kouna thu alha taovin;
target: A proclamation was then issued throughout Judah and Jerusalem for all the exiles to assemble in Jerusalem.

source: Koihile milen holeh vaihom upaho thumop dungjuija, nithum sunga hung kikhom louva aumleh, athilkeu jouse kilahpeh-a, amatah jongchu soh-a kikaimang mipi ho lah-a kona chomkhen hiding ahi, ti thu akiphongtai.
target: Anyone who failed to appear within three days would forfeit all his property, in accordance with the decision of the officials and elders, and would himself be expelled from the assembly of the exiles.

source: Chujouvin Judah le Benjamin mite sese chu nithum sungin Jerusalem'a akikhom kimsoh-un ahi. Hichu lhako channa hichelha nisomni alhin nikho ahi. Chuin Pathen in lamlenna chun mipi jouse chu atouvun, athu akhoh jehle go ajuh nasat jeh-in mipi ho chu akithing thing jengun ahi.
target: Within the three days, all the men of Judah and Benjamin had gathered in Jerusalem. And on the twentieth day of the ninth month, all the people were sitting in the square before the house of God, greatly distressed by the occasion and because of the rain.

source: Hichun thempu Ezra chu adingin, mipi henga chun: nanghon nasukhel taove, nanghon Israel mipi suhkhel belap nadingin jatdang numei jin naki puijun ahi ati.
target: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have been unfaithful; you have married foreign women, adding to Israel’s guilt.

source: Hijeh chun tun Pakai napu napateu Pathen henga chun nachonset phongun lang, alunglhaina boluvin; chule hiche gama jatdangho-a konle, anumei houva konhin kikangse uvin ati.
target: Now honor the Lord , the God of your ancestors, and do his will. Separate yourselves from the peoples around you and from your foreign wives.”

source: Chutah-in houkhom ho mijouse chun adonbutnun, awging tah-in, nasei bangin bolnao vinge.
target: The whole assembly responded with a loud voice: “You are right! We must do as you say.

source: Ahinla mipi hi atamlheh jengin, go hajuh laima ahin, chule polanga kading jing thei pouvin, chumale nikhat nini natoh jong ahipoi: ajehchu hiche thu ahin achonkhela jong katam taovin ahi.
target: But there are many people here and it is the rainy season; so we cannot stand outside. Besides, this matter cannot be taken care of in a day or two, because we have sinned greatly in this thing.

source: Tun mipi kikhomho jouse chunga eivaipohou chu dingdoh uhen, chule hiche chungchanga Pathen lunghanna nasatah hi eiho-a kon akiheimang kahsen, ka khopi hou jouse-a jatdang ji-a nei jouse chu, khopi jouse-a upaho leh vaihomho toh akitep nikhon hunguhen, atiuve.
target: Let our officials act for the whole assembly. Then let everyone in our towns who has married a foreign woman come at a set time, along with the elders and judges of each town, until the fierce anger of our God in this matter is turned away from us.”

source: Asahel chapa Jonanthan le Tikvah chapa Jahaziah'in bouvin anelkal lhonin, chule Levi mi Meshullam le Shabbethai'in akithopi lhonin ahi.
target: Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah, supported by Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite, opposed this.

source: Chuin gal hing kikai chilhah hon hitichun aboltauve. Chuin Ezra thempu le, apu apateu lhah-a, insunga phung upa akilhengdoh hotoh ahin, amaho amin cheh-a kilheng doh ahiuvin, akihom khenun, chule hiche thu ngaito dinghin lhasom channa nikho masapen nin atou khomtaove.
target: So the exiles did as was proposed. Ezra the priest selected men who were family heads, one from each family division, and all of them designated by name. On the first day of the tenth month they sat down to investigate the cases,

source: Chule lhakhatna nikhatnin jatdang ji-a neiho jousechu akholdoh chai taove.
target: and by the first day of the first month they finished dealing with all the men who had married foreign women.

source: Chule thempu chate lah-a jatdang ji-a ananei ahetdoh houchu: Jozadak chapa Jeshua chapateho le asopiho; Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib chule Gedaliah hichenghi ahiuve.
target: Among the descendants of the priests, the following had married foreign women: From the descendants of Joshua son of Jozadak, and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib and Gedaliah.

source: Chuin amahon ajiteu akoidohna dingun akhutnu apedoh-un; chule themo ahi jeh-un, suhkhel thilto dingin kelngoi honlah-a kelngoi chal khat atoh-un ahi.
target: (They all gave their hands in pledge to put away their wives, and for their guilt they each presented a ram from the flock as a guilt offering.)

source: Chule Immar chapateho-a kon; Hanani le Zebediah.
target: From the descendants of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

source: Harim chapateho-a kon; Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel chule Uzziah.
target: From the descendants of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel and Uzziah.

source: Pashhur chapateho-a kon; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad chule Elasah.
target: From the descendants of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad and Elasah.

source: Chumaleh Levi lah-a kon; Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (Kelita akiti), Pethahiah, Judah le Eliezer.
target: Among the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (that is, Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah and Eliezer.

source: Chule lasa loi lah-a kon jong; Eliashib, chule kotngah ho lah-a Shallum, Telem le Uri.
target: From the musicians: Eliashib. From the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem and Uri.

source: Israel dangdang ho lah-a kon: Parosh chapateho; Ramiah, Jeziah, Malchiah, Miamin, Eleazar, Mechijah chule Benaiah.
target: And among the other Israelites: From the descendants of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malkijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malkijah and Benaiah.

source: Elam chapateho-a kon; Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth chule Eliah.
target: From the descendants of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth and Elijah.

source: Zattu chapateho-a kon; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad le Aziza.
target: From the descendants of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad and Aziza.

source: Bebai chapateho-a kon jong; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai le Athlai.
target: From the descendants of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai and Athlai.

source: Chule Bani chapateho-a kon; Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal chule Ramoth.
target: From the descendants of Bani: Meshullam, Malluk, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal and Jeremoth.

source: Pahath-moab chapateho-a kon; Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui chule Manasseh.
target: From the descendants of Pahath-Moab: Adna, Kelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui and Manasseh.

source: Chule Harim chapateho-a kon; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah chule Shimeon,
target: From the descendants of Harim: Eliezer, Ishijah, Malkijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

source: Benjamin, Malluch, chule Shemariah.
target: Benjamin, Malluk and Shemariah.

source: Hashum chapateho-a kon; Mattenai, Mattatthah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh chule Shimei.
target: From the descendants of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh and Shimei.

source: Bani chapateho-a kon; Maadai, Amram chule Uel,
target: From the descendants of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,

source: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,
target: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Keluhi,

source: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
target: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

source: Mattaniah, Mattenai chule Jaasau,
target: Mattaniah, Mattenai and Jaasu.

source: Chule Bani, Binnui chule Shimei,
target: From the descendants of Binnui: Shimei,

source: Chule Shelemiah, Nathan chule Adaiah,
target: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,

source: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
target: Maknadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

source: Azareel le Shelemiah, Shemariah,
target: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,

source: Shallum, Amariah le Joseph.
target: Shallum, Amariah and Joseph.

source: Nebo chapateho-a kon; Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddau, Joel, chule Benaiah.
target: From the descendants of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel and Benaiah.

source: Hiteho jousehin jatdang numei ji'n aneijun; chule abangin ajiteuva konin cha aneijuve.
target: All these had married foreign women, and some of them had children by these wives.

source: Hachaliah chapa Nehemiah thuho chu ahi. Chuin ahitin ahi. Kum somni lhinkum Chislev lhasunga keima Shushan leng ina kaum laijin,
target: The words of Nehemiah son of Hakaliah: In the month of Kislev in the twentieth year, while I was in the citadel of Susa,

source: Kasopite lah-a mikhat Hanani chule Judah'a konin mi phabep ahungun, chule keiman Judah te sohchan na-a kona hoidohho chule Jerusalem khopi thu kadonglen ahi.
target: Hanani, one of my brothers, came from Judah with some other men, and I questioned them about the Jewish remnant that had survived the exile, and also about Jerusalem.

source: Chuin amahon kajah-a, sohchan na-a kidalha amohho chun gamsunga gentheinale seisetna athoh thoh jengun, Jerusalem kul bang jong achimlha gamtan, chule akotpiho jouse jong meijin akalhatan ahi atiuve.
target: They said to me, “Those who survived the exile and are back in the province are in great trouble and disgrace. The wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates have been burned with fire.”

source: Chule ahitin ahi, hiche thuho kajah phatnin katouvin kakapmin, chule ni ijat-ham lunghemin kaumin, chule an kangol-in van Pathen henga kataovin,
target: When I heard these things, I sat down and wept. For some days I mourned and fasted and prayed before the God of heaven.

source: Vo Pakai van Pathen, Pathen loupitahle tijat um, ama ngailu-a athupeh nit ho chunga thulhun chingtupma lungsetji nahenga katao ahi,
target: Then I said: “ Lord , the God of heaven, the great and awesome God, who keeps his covenant of love with those who love him and keep his commandments,

source: Tun nasohte Israel chate dinga asun ajana namasanga nasohpa kataonahi ngaipeh dingin namit hin hasah inlang, nanakhang hinsungin; nangma douna-a kachonse taovin, Israel chate chonset naho kahin phonge, keimale kapa insung mite kachonse taove.
target: let your ear be attentive and your eyes open to hear the prayer your servant is praying before you day and night for your servants, the people of Israel. I confess the sins we Israelites, including myself and my father’s family, have committed against you.

source: Nangma dounan thilphalouhel kanabol taovin, nalhachapa Mosi henga nanapeh thupeh ho, tepna danho, vaihomnaho jouse chu kana nit tapouve.
target: We have acted very wickedly toward you. We have not obeyed the commands, decrees and laws you gave your servant Moses.

source: Kangeh nahi, geldoh temin, nalhacha Mosi henga kathupeh chu nasuhkhel uva ahile, keiman nangho namtin lah-a kathejal ding nahiuve nati.
target: “Remember the instruction you gave your servant Moses, saying, ‘If you are unfaithful, I will scatter you among the nations,

source: Ahinla keima lama nahung kiheijuva, kathupeh nachintup uva nabol uva ahile, van mong geija nomanga um hijongleu chun chua kona chu kapuidoh khomding, chule kamin umna dinga kalhena mun'a chu amaho kapuikhom ding ahi.
target: but if you return to me and obey my commands, then even if your exiled people are at the farthest horizon, I will gather them from there and bring them to the place I have chosen as a dwelling for my Name.’

source: Tun hiteho hi nasohte le namite, nathilbol theina loupitahleh nakhut thahat tah-a nalhatdohsate chu ahiuve.
target: “They are your servants and your people, whom you redeemed by your great strength and your mighty hand.

source: Vo Pakai kangeh nahi, tun nasoh taona lama hin nanakhang hindon, chule nasohho taona namin janachu lolhinsah-in katao nahi, tunin nasoh keima hiche mipa mitmuhin lungset tah-in hepina neipen, ajehchu keima lengpa khondoma panga kahi, ati.
target: Lord, let your ear be attentive to the prayer of this your servant and to the prayer of your servants who delight in revering your name. Give your servant success today by granting him favor in the presence of this man.” I was cupbearer to the king.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Artaxerxes lengchan kal kum somni lhin kum, Nisan lha sungin a-anga lengpitwi aumin, keiman lengpitwi chu kalan lengpa chu kapetai. Tuma sangin amasanga lungkham mel kamusah khapon ahi.
target: In the month of Nisan in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, when wine was brought for him, I took the wine and gave it to the king. I had not been sad in his presence before,

source: Hijeh chun lengpan kajah-a, anala nahipon, namaiso anguinave itidan ham? imachadang hiponte, lungdonna nanei ahi, ati, chuphatnin kakicha behset jengtai.
target: so the king asked me, “Why does your face look so sad when you are not ill? This can be nothing but sadness of heart.” I was very much afraid,

source: Chuin keiman lengpa jah-a, lengpa hingsotnin, ipidia kamaiso nguida dingham? kapu kapate khopi, lhankhuh ho umna chu mang thah-in aum gamtai, kotpiho jouse meijin akagam tan, ahomkeo ahitai, kati.
target: but I said to the king, “May the king live forever! Why should my face not look sad when the city where my ancestors are buried lies in ruins, and its gates have been destroyed by fire?”

source: Chuin lengpan kajah-a ipi nathum nomham? eitin, hiti chun keima van Pathen henga kataotai.
target: The king said to me, “What is it you want?” Then I prayed to the God of heaven,

source: Chuin lengpa henga Lengpa lunglhai nading ahia, nasohpa nangma mitmu-a hi lungset theidol kahile, Judah gama kapu kapate lhankhuh ho umna khopi-a chun neisolin lang gasaphange, kati.
target: and I answered the king, “If it pleases the king and if your servant has found favor in his sight, let him send me to the city in Judah where my ancestors are buried so that I can rebuild it.”

source: Chuin lengpan kajah-a (lengnu jong akoma atoupet ahi) itih changei nagatham ding ham? itih phatleh nahung kilekit ding ham? atin, hiti chun lengpan soldingin pha eisan, chuin keiman aphat kateptai.
target: Then the king, with the queen sitting beside him, asked me, “How long will your journey take, and when will you get back?” It pleased the king to send me; so I set a time.

source: Achung chonin lengpa henga chun, Lengpa lunglhaina ahileh Judah gam kalhun kahse-a eichesah uva, eihen-oh louna diuvin vadunglen lama gamvaipoho mudin lekhathot neisutpeh inlang,
target: I also said to him, “If it pleases the king, may I have letters to the governors of Trans-Euphrates, so that they will provide me safe-conduct until I arrive in Judah?

source: Chule Lengpa gam ngahpa Asaph dingin jong, inpitoh kimat kotpi-a pangding, khopi kul-a ding, chule kagachenna inding thing, eipehtheina dingin lekha neisut peh-in katin ahi. Chule ka Pathen khut thahat kachunga aumdung juijin, imajouse chu lengpan eiphatsah pehtai.
target: And may I have a letter to Asaph, keeper of the royal park, so he will give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel by the temple and for the city wall and for the residence I will occupy?” And because the gracious hand of my God was on me, the king granted my requests.

source: Chuin keijong vadung len gal lama gamvaipo ho henga kahungin, lengpa lekhathot ho chu kapen ahi. Chuin lengpan sepai lamkaiholeh, sakol chungtou galsatho chu eikilhonpi din ahin solin ahi.
target: So I went to the governors of Trans-Euphrates and gave them the king’s letters. The king had also sent army officers and cavalry with me.

source: Chuin Horon mi Sanballat le sottola pang Ammon mi Tobiah sohpan anajahtah uchun, Israel chate khantouna ding ngaito din mi ahunguve tin, analung himolheh-un ahi.
target: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about this, they were very much disturbed that someone had come to promote the welfare of the Israelites.

source: Hitichun Jerusalem'a kahungin nithum kanichong tai.
target: I went to Jerusalem, and after staying there three days

source: Chuin jan-in kathouvin, keimatoh kaumpi mi phabep kahiuvin, Jerusalem dinga katohgot ka Pathen'in kalungthima eikoipeh chu, koima kahilpon, katouna gancha tilou chu kahenga gamchadang aumpoi.
target: I set out during the night with a few others. I had not told anyone what my God had put in my heart to do for Jerusalem. There were no mounts with me except the one I was riding on.

source: Chule jan laijin kapotdoh-in, phaicham lama kotpi lampi chu kajuijin, dragon twikul mai lampileh ehbohna kotpi phung geijin kachepeh-in, Jerusalem kulbang chimsa leh akotpi meijin akahvamsaho chu kavetohsoh keije.
target: By night I went out through the Valley Gate toward the Jackal Well and the Dung Gate, examining the walls of Jerusalem, which had been broken down, and its gates, which had been destroyed by fire.

source: Chujouvin twinah kotpi phung gei, lengpa twikul geijin kachen, ahin che-apat hin katouna gancha chu achepai theina ding mun aumtapoi.
target: Then I moved on toward the Fountain Gate and the King’s Pool, but there was not enough room for my mount to get through;

source: Chuin jan-in vachadung kajottouvin, kulbang chu kavelen, chuin kakinungle kitnin, phaicham kotpi-a chun kalutnin hitichun kakinungle kit tai.
target: so I went up the valley by night, examining the wall. Finally, I turned back and reentered through the Valley Gate.

source: Vaihomte chun hoija kache, ipikabol jong eihedoh pouvin, chule Judah te thempuho, milen milalhole vaihomho chule hiche natonga pangdingho henga jong kasei pon ahi.
target: The officials did not know where I had gone or what I was doing, because as yet I had said nothing to the Jews or the priests or nobles or officials or any others who would be doing the work.

source: Chuin keiman amaho jah-a, igen theinao nasatje hi namuvin, Jerusalem agohkeova aumle, akotpi phungho jouse meijin akasetai tijong namuve: hungtemun, mi i-sah louva i-um louna dingun, Jerusalem kulpi chu saphakitnu hite, kati.
target: Then I said to them, “You see the trouble we are in: Jerusalem lies in ruins, and its gates have been burned with fire. Come, let us rebuild the wall of Jerusalem, and we will no longer be in disgrace.”

source: Chuin keiman amaho chu kadinga phatah ka Pathen khutleh lengpan kajah-a anasei thu jouse chu kaseipehtai. Chuin amahon kipatdoh-u hitin, saote, atiuve. Hitichun napha tongding chun abanthau ahatsah taove.
target: I also told them about the gracious hand of my God on me and what the king had said to me. They replied, “Let us start rebuilding.” So they began this good work.

source: Ahinla Horon mi Sanballat le Ammon mi sottollea pang Tobiah leh Aram mi Geshem, amahohin ajahdoh phatnu chun, eidai chavaijun, nahsahmotah-in eibolun, nathil boluhi ipi hitam? lengpa douna-a kiphin ding nahiuvem? atiuve.
target: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite official and Geshem the Arab heard about it, they mocked and ridiculed us. “What is this you are doing?” they asked. “Are you rebelling against the king?”

source: Chuin amaho chu keiman kadonbut nin, van Pathen'in eilolhinsah untin, hijeh chun keiho ama lhacha hohi kipat ungting kasahdoh dingu ahi. Nangho vangin Jerusalem'a chanle thuneina chule hetjingna naneipouve, katin ahi.
target: I answered them by saying, “The God of heaven will give us success. We his servants will start rebuilding, but as for you, you have no share in Jerusalem or any claim or historic right to it.”

source: Chuin thempu chungnung Eliashib chu asopi thempu dang hotoh akipat doh-un, kelngoi hongkot chu asemphaovin, asuthengun, chule akotkhah ho asutouvin Meah insangle Hananeel insang geijin asuthengun ahi.
target: Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests went to work and rebuilt the Sheep Gate. They dedicated it and set its doors in place, building as far as the Tower of the Hundred, which they dedicated, and as far as the Tower of Hananel.

source: Chule hiche bana hin Jericho miten asauvin ahi. Chule amaho bankitna chun Imri chapa Zaccur chun asan ahi.
target: The men of Jericho built the adjoining section, and Zakkur son of Imri built next to them.

source: Ahin Hasseneaah chapaten ngakul kotpi laichu asemun, ajol chengsetoh ajamun, chule akot jousetoh atouvin, akamnading holeh athihlhon jong atouve.
target: The Fish Gate was rebuilt by the sons of Hassenaah. They laid its beams and put its doors and bolts and bars in place.

source: Chule amaho banin Koz chapa Uriah chapa Meremoth in asemphan ahi. Chule amaho bana hin Meshezabeel chapa Berechiah chapa Meshullam'in asemphan ahi. Chule amaho bana hin Baana chapa Zadok'in asemphan ahi.
target: Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, repaired the next section. Next to him Meshullam son of Berekiah, the son of Meshezabel, made repairs, and next to him Zadok son of Baana also made repairs.

source: Chule amaho bana hin Tekoa miten asemphaovin, amilen amilalteu chu hiche a-pakaiyu natohna-a hin athunoija akunpouve.
target: The next section was repaired by the men of Tekoa, but their nobles would not put their shoulders to the work under their supervisors.

source: Hiche chungchon hin akotpi luichu Paseah chapa Jehoiada le Besodeiah chapa Meshullam'in asemphaovin, ajolpi ajamun akot jouse atouvin, akamnading hole athihjol jong atouve.
target: The Jeshanah Gate was repaired by Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah. They laid its beams and put its doors with their bolts and bars in place.

source: Amaho bana hin Gibeon mi Melatiah le Meronoth mi Jadon le vadunglen gallama gamvaipo Gibeon mite Mizpeh mihon asemphaovin ahi.
target: Next to them, repairs were made by men from Gibeon and Mizpah—Melatiah of Gibeon and Jadon of Meronoth—places under the authority of the governor of Trans-Euphrates.

source: Abana hin sana khengho lah-a pang Harhaiah chapa Uzziel'in asemphan ahi. Abankitna chun thao namtui semho chapa khat Hananiah in asemphan, chule Jerusalem kulbang satah geijin kul akhokhum taovin ahi.
target: Uzziel son of Harhaiah, one of the goldsmiths, repaired the next section; and Hananiah, one of the perfume-makers, made repairs next to that. They restored Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.

source: Amaho bana hin Jerusalem khopi kehkhat vaipo-a pang Hur chapa Rephaiah in asemphan ahi.
target: Rephaiah son of Hur, ruler of a half-district of Jerusalem, repaired the next section.

source: Chule amaho bana hin Harumaph chapa Jedaiah'in ama inmai dontah chu asemphan chule ama bana hin Hashabnah chapa Hattush'in asemphan ahi.
target: Adjoining this, Jedaiah son of Harumaph made repairs opposite his house, and Hattush son of Hashabneiah made repairs next to him.

source: Harim chapa Malchijah le Pahath-moab chapa Hashub'in amaho semnaban alangkhat chu asemphan, meilum insang chan geijin asemphan ahi.
target: Malkijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath-Moab repaired another section and the Tower of the Ovens.

source: Chule abana chun Jerusalem kehkhat chunga vaihom Hallohesh chapa Shallum'in achanu tetoh asemphaovin ahi.
target: Shallum son of Hallohesh, ruler of a half-district of Jerusalem, repaired the next section with the help of his daughters.

source: Phaicham kotpichu Hanun le Zanoah chenghon asemphaovin, amahon asaovin kotkhah ho atovin akamnading holeh athihlhon hojong atovin, chule Ehbohna kotpi changeijin akulbang tong sangkhat asemun ahi.
target: The Valley Gate was repaired by Hanun and the residents of Zanoah. They rebuilt it and put its doors with their bolts and bars in place. They also repaired a thousand cubits of the wall as far as the Dung Gate.

source: Ahinla ehbohna kotpi lamchu Beth-haccerem gamkaikhat vaipopa Rechab chapa Malchiah in asemphan, asan, akotkhahho atungdoh-in akamnading hole athih lhonho jong aton ahi.
target: The Dung Gate was repaired by Malkijah son of Rekab, ruler of the district of Beth Hakkerem. He rebuilt it and put its doors with their bolts and bars in place.

source: Ahin Mizpah gamkaikhat vaipopa Col-hozeh chapa Shallun'in twinah kotpi chu asemin, asan, chule aloijolsoh-in, chule akotkhah ho atung doh-in akamnading holeh athihgol hojong asemin, chule lengpa hon pama Siloah twikul chu David khopi lam jotsuhna kalbi chanin asemphai.
target: The Fountain Gate was repaired by Shallun son of Kol-Hozeh, ruler of the district of Mizpah. He rebuilt it, roofing it over and putting its doors and bolts and bars in place. He also repaired the wall of the Pool of Siloam, by the King’s Garden, as far as the steps going down from the City of David.

source: Chule abanin Azbuk Beth-zur gam kehkhat vaipopa chapa Nehemiah chun David lhankhuh toh kigalsaile twikul kisem nalam le mihangsan ho in changeijin, asemphan ahi.
target: Beyond him, Nehemiah son of Azbuk, ruler of a half-district of Beth Zur, made repairs up to a point opposite the tombs of David, as far as the artificial pool and the House of the Heroes.

source: Ama jouvin Levi holeh Bani chapa Rehum'in asaphan ahi. Abanin Keilah gam kehkhat vaihoma pang Hashabiah chun ama gamchan chu thalhengin asemphai.
target: Next to him, the repairs were made by the Levites under Rehum son of Bani. Beside him, Hashabiah, ruler of half the district of Keilah, carried out repairs for his district.

source: Ama banin Keilah gam kehkhat vaipopa Henadad chapa Bavaile asopihon asemphaovin ahi.
target: Next to him, the repairs were made by their fellow Levites under Binnui son of Henadad, ruler of the other half-district of Keilah.

source: Chule ama banin Mizpeh gam vaipo Jeshua chapa Ezer chun gal manchah kholna kul ningkoi jottouna jonchu asemphan ahi.
target: Next to him, Ezer son of Jeshua, ruler of Mizpah, repaired another section, from a point facing the ascent to the armory as far as the angle of the wall.

source: Ama jouvin Zabbai chapa Baruch chun phatchom ngaitah-in mun behkhat, kul ningkoi apat thempu chungnung Eliashib in kotpi phung geijin asemphai.
target: Next to him, Baruch son of Zabbai zealously repaired another section, from the angle to the entrance of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

source: Abanin Koz cha Uriah chapa Meremoth'in, mun behkat Eliashib in kotkhah apat Eliashib in monglam chanin asemphan ahi.
target: Next to him, Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, repaired another section, from the entrance of Eliashib’s house to the end of it.

source: Chule ama banin phaicham miho le thempuhon asemphaove.
target: The repairs next to him were made by the priests from the surrounding region.

source: Amaho bana hin Benjamin mitele Hashub miten amani in donchu asempha lhonin ahi. Chujouvin Ananiah cha Maaseiah chapa Zariah'in ama in kom chu asemphan ahi.
target: Beyond them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs in front of their house; and next to them, Azariah son of Maaseiah, the son of Ananiah, made repairs beside his house.

source: Abanin Hanadad chapa Binnui'in mun behkhat Azeriah in-apat kulbang ningkoi chan asemphan ahi.
target: Next to him, Binnui son of Henadad repaired another section, from Azariah’s house to the angle and the corner,

source: Uzai chapa Palal'in kulbang in ningkoito kigalsai le lengpa insanga kona hung sangdoh, songkul tangho, thukitana vela insang chungnung chu asemphan ahi. Aban chu Parosh chapa Pedaiah'in asemphan ahi.
target: and Palal son of Uzai worked opposite the angle and the tower projecting from the upper palace near the court of the guard. Next to him, Pedaiah son of Parosh

source: Chukal valin Ophel'a cheng Nethinim ho chun niso lampanga twikul kotpi kigalsai, in kisa sangdoh geijin asaphaovin ahi.
target: and the temple servants living on the hill of Ophel made repairs up to a point opposite the Water Gate toward the east and the projecting tower.

source: Aban chu Tekoa hon mun behkhat insang lenpi kisajumdoh jonleh Ophel kulbang chanin asaphauve.
target: Next to them, the men of Tekoa repaired another section, from the great projecting tower to the wall of Ophel.

source: Amaho banin thempuhon sakol kotpi chunglama pat, ama ama injoncheh asemphaovin ahi.
target: Above the Horse Gate, the priests made repairs, each in front of his own house.

source: Immer chapa Zadok'in amaho bana hin, ama injon asemphan ahi. Abanchu niso lam kotpi ngah-a pang Shechaniah chapa Shemaiah'in asemphan ahi.
target: Next to them, Zadok son of Immer made repairs opposite his house. Next to him, Shemaiah son of Shekaniah, the guard at the East Gate, made repairs.

source: Abana hin Shelemiah chapa Hananiah le Zalaph chapa agupna Hanun'in mun behkhat asemphaove. Abana hin Berechiah chapa Meshullam'in ama indanjon chu asemphan ahi.
target: Next to him, Hananiah son of Shelemiah, and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another section. Next to them, Meshullam son of Berekiah made repairs opposite his living quarters.

source: Ama bana hin sana kheng chapa Malchiah'in, Nethinim ho umna mun Miphkad kotpi chanleh kivei miho inchan asemphan ahi.
target: Next to him, Malkijah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs as far as the house of the temple servants and the merchants, opposite the Inspection Gate, and as far as the room above the corner;

source: Aning jottouna lampile kelngoihong kotpitoh kikah chu, kivei miho leh sana khenghon asemphaove.
target: and between the room above the corner and the Sheep Gate the goldsmiths and merchants made repairs.

source: Ahinla ahung hitin ahi, Sanballat'in kulbang kasemphatnu ajahtah-in, alung ahanglheh jengin Judah te chu ataitomin, i-sah loutah-in aboltan ahi.
target: When Sanballat heard that we were rebuilding the wall, he became angry and was greatly incensed. He ridiculed the Jews,

source: Chule asopiholeh Samaria sepaiho masanga chun hitin thu aseijin, hiche milhachom Judah hohin ipiham abolu? amahole amaho kisadoh joudingu hinam? ganlhaina abolmong dingu hinam, nikhat na asahdoh mong dingu hinam? meijin akahsetsa, bohnen lah-a kilhukhom songho chu akaldoh uva asemphat joumong dingu hinam? ati.
target: and in the presence of his associates and the army of Samaria, he said, “What are those feeble Jews doing? Will they restore their wall? Will they offer sacrifices? Will they finish in a day? Can they bring the stones back to life from those heaps of rubble—burned as they are?”

source: Hichun akoma um Ammon mi Tobiah chun, ahinai cheho insah hi iti sahjongleu achunga sial khattou gakaldohleh, asongbang hohi chimlha talou ding ham? ati.
target: Tobiah the Ammonite, who was at his side, said, “What they are building—even a fox climbing up on it would break down their wall of stones!”

source: Vo, ka Pathen'u ngaijin, i-sah louvin kaumun, eihou setnao jousehi amaho chunga lhunsah inlang, amaho jong hoilai gam hama sohchang dingin michomgamte khutna pedoh-in.
target: Hear us, our God, for we are despised. Turn their insults back on their own heads. Give them over as plunder in a land of captivity.

source: Chule akhangit lounao immangpeh hih in, chule achonsetnao chu nangma-a konin thaimangin umdahen, ajehchu kulbang semho masanga nangma naphinseuvin ahi.
target: Do not cover up their guilt or blot out their sins from your sight, for they have thrown insults in the face of the builders.

source: Hitichun kulbang chu kasauvin, chule kulbangho chu akimlai gei kajopmatsoh taove. Ajehchu mipi honjong natoh thanopna lung apucheh un ahi.
target: So we rebuilt the wall till all of it reached half its height, for the people worked with all their heart.

source: Ahinla ahung hiti, Sanballat, Tobiah le Arabia mite, Ammon mite, chule Ashdod miten, Jerusalem kulbang sahphat ahia, chule akehlai jouse akisemphatai ti ajahtah-un, alunghang lheh taovin,
target: But when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites and the people of Ashdod heard that the repairs to Jerusalem’s walls had gone ahead and that the gaps were being closed, they were very angry.

source: Chuin abonchauvin akihougu sohkeijun, chule Jerusalem chu kisatpi-a suhtang agotauve.
target: They all plotted together to come and fight against Jerusalem and stir up trouble against it.

source: Hijeng jongle ka Pathen'u henga kataovun, asun ajanin amaho ngah-a velhiding kakoijingun ahi.
target: But we prayed to our God and posted a guard day and night to meet this threat.

source: Chuin Judah chun, thilpoho athachol gamtaovin, ahin bohnenla tampi aumnalaijin, hijeh-a chu kulbanghi i-sah joulou dingu hitante ati.
target: Meanwhile, the people in Judah said, “The strength of the laborers is giving out, and there is so much rubble that we cannot rebuild the wall.”

source: Imelma teovinla, amaho lah-a igalut uva, igathaova, anatoh-u igasuh tangpeh tokah seuva ahet loudingu ahi, mujong eimu pouvinte tin aseijui.
target: Also our enemies said, “Before they know it or see us, we will be right there among them and will kill them and put an end to the work.”

source: Chule ahitin ahi, akenguva cheng Judah te chu ahungun, kajah uvah amaho muntina kona hunguva eihung delkhum dingu ahi, tin somveijen ahungseijui.
target: Then the Jews who lived near them came and told us ten times over, “Wherever you turn, they will attack us.”

source: Hijeh chun kenjong kulbang polam pang anem nalai le asanglai munho chun mipi ho chu, a-in kokon achemjamu, atengchao chule thalpi hotoh thon panmun kasemsah-e.
target: Therefore I stationed some of the people behind the lowest points of the wall at the exposed places, posting them by families, with their swords, spears and bows.

source: Chule kathoudoh-in kagavelen, milen milal, vaihomhole mipi ho jah-a, amaho khu kichahih beh-un, Pakai loupi kidang le thahat tah neipa chu sumil louvin, nasopi hou, nachapateo, najiteule na-inko huhnadin satnun kati.
target: After I looked things over, I stood up and said to the nobles, the officials and the rest of the people, “Don’t be afraid of them. Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your families, your sons and your daughters, your wives and your homes.”

source: Chule ahitin ahi, kamelma teovin athil gonnu kahetdoh uva, chule Pathen'in athilgonu asuh chatvai pehtah-in, keiho jong ama ama natoh cheh tong dingin kakinungle kit taove.
target: When our enemies heard that we were aware of their plot and that God had frustrated it, we all returned to the wall, each to our own work.

source: Chule ahitin ahi, hiche nikho-a pat hin, keima lhachate mi akeh khatnin na atongun, chule akehkhat hochu tengcha, lumle thalpi chule ompho aki-ah un, chule vaihomte chu Judah te insung mite nunglama apanguve.
target: From that day on, half of my men did the work, while the other half were equipped with spears, shields, bows and armor. The officers posted themselves behind all the people of Judah

source: Kulbang seho, chule pohgih pohon apohgih-u pumin akhut langkhat nun na atongun langkhatna manchah akichoicheh un ahi.
target: who were building the wall. Those who carried materials did their work with one hand and held a weapon in the other,

source: Hitichun insaho chun achemjamu apanguva akikocheh-un, insah chuto akopmun, chule sumkon mutna pangpa chu keima koma aume.
target: and each of the builders wore his sword at his side as he worked. But the man who sounded the trumpet stayed with me.

source: Chule keiman milen milal holeh vaihomho chule mipi henga chun, inatoh-u hi anasan alenlheh-in, kulbang isahnaova hin ikigamlat thei lheh-un,
target: Then I said to the nobles, the officials and the rest of the people, “The work is extensive and spread out, and we are widely separated from each other along the wall.

source: Hijeh chun sumkon gin najah nalamcheh uvah keiholam hindelluvin, i-Pathen'un eiho dia gal eisatpeh diu ahi, kati.
target: Wherever you hear the sound of the trumpet, join us there. Our God will fight for us!”

source: Hitobang tah hin na ka tongun, mi akeh khatnin jingkah khovah lhah-a pat nilhah jan ahsi sophat geijin tengcha akidopmun ahi.
target: So we continued the work with half the men holding spears, from the first light of dawn till the stars came out.

source: Hiche bangma hin chepettah hin mipi jah-a chun, jana eingah dingule suna natonga pang ding koihileh alhacha hotoh Jerusalem'a gehsoh keijuhen tin kaseije.
target: At that time I also said to the people, “Have every man and his helper stay inside Jerusalem at night, so they can serve us as guards by night and as workers by day.”

source: Hitichun keima jong, kasopite hojong, kasottol houjong, kanungjuija eingah uva pangho kisilpet tailouvin koimachan kavonnu sop dingin jong kasutlha pouvin ahi.
target: Neither I nor my brothers nor my men nor the guards with me took off our clothes; each had his weapon, even when he went for water.

source: Chule mipi holeh ajiteu chu asopihou Judah te douna-in nasatah-in akapmun ahi.
target: Now the men and their wives raised a great outcry against their fellow Jews.

source: Ajeh chu amaho abang khatnin, keiho kachapa teoleh kachanu teotoh tampi kahiuvin hijeh chun kaneh uva kahintheina dingun anneh kilah unge atiuvin ahi.
