target: Some were saying, “We and our sons and daughters are numerous; in order for us to eat and stay alive, we must get grain.”

source: Abang khatnin kel jeh-in keihon kalou mun jouseu, kalengpilei jouseu le ka-inu neh chohna din katungjou taove, atiuve.
target: Others were saying, “We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards and our homes to get grain during the famine.”

source: Abangkhat kitnin, keihon kalou munnu kalengpileiju lengpa kai pehdin sum pa lahnan katungdoh soh taove atiuvin, ahi.
target: Still others were saying, “We have had to borrow money to pay the king’s tax on our fields and vineyards.

source: Tuchanin katahsao hi kasopihou tahsavou bang ahin, kachateu jong amaho chate tobang ahiuve. Chule ven, kachapateu hi sohchanga um gamdingu ahitai. Kachanuteu phabep jong sohchanga um ahitaovin, huhdohna je kaheta pouve, ajehchu kagam houleh lengpilei ho midang achang taove, atiuvin ahi.
target: Although we are of the same flesh and blood as our fellow Jews and though our children are as good as theirs, yet we have to subject our sons and daughters to slavery. Some of our daughters have already been enslaved, but we are powerless, because our fields and our vineyards belong to others.”

source: Chuin hicheng thuho kajah-a, akao-aw kajahtah-in, keima kalung ahangbehseh jengtan,
target: When I heard their outcry and these charges, I was very angry.

source: Hichun keiman kalung kanageltoh masan, milen milal tele vaihoma pangho chu kahousen, nangho amitakipmin nasopi hou batman apung nakilahcheh uve, kati, chule amaho thu gelkhom dingin mi tamtah kakoukhomin ahi.
target: I pondered them in my mind and then accused the nobles and officials. I told them, “You are charging your own people interest!” So I called together a large meeting to deal with them

source: Chuin keiman ajah uva Pathen hephalou lah-a kijohdohsa isopihou chu ijochanun ilhatdoh-un, nanghon nasopi hou Judah te chu joh nagotjingu ham? eihole eiho lah-a jong ikijoh dingu ham? katin, chutah-in adailhahel taovin, donbut nading ahetapouve.
target: and said: “As far as possible, we have bought back our fellow Jews who were sold to the Gentiles. Now you are selling your own people, only for them to be sold back to us!” They kept quiet, because they could find nothing to say.

source: Kasei kitnin, nathilbolu hi aphahih beh-e, imelmateu Pathen helouhon eihouset jeh uva Pathen kicha jinga naum dingu hilouham? kati.
target: So I continued, “What you are doing is not right. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God to avoid the reproach of our Gentile enemies?

source: Hitobang chun keimale kasopite chule kalhachaho jong sum chule changle mim kana palahsah jiuve, Kangeh nahiuve, apung uma palah sahhi haitaohite.
target: I and my brothers and my men are also lending the people money and grain. But let us stop charging interest!

source: Kangeh nahiuve, tuni tah hin, alouhou alengpilei hou, a olive honhou, a-inhou, chujongle hop jakhat chunga hopkhat nalahjiu sum hihen, chang hihen, lengpitwi hihen chule thao hijongle lepehsoh kitnun, katin ahi.
target: Give back to them immediately their fields, vineyards, olive groves and houses, and also the interest you are charging them—one percent of the money, grain, new wine and olive oil.”

source: Chuin amahon, keihon lepehkit nunge, chule amaho-a konin imacha ngehpou vinge, hitichun nasei bangtah-in boluvinge, atiuve. Chujouvin, keiman thempuho kakouvin, thutep bangtah-a abolsohkei nadiuvin kaki hahsel sahtai.
target: “We will give it back,” they said. “And we will not demand anything more from them. We will do as you say.” Then I summoned the priests and made the nobles and officials take an oath to do what they had promised.

source: Chujongle kaponchol chen chu kathingin, hitin kati, hiche thutep banga molsolou jouse chu Pathen'in ama insung le anatoh na-a konin hitobang hin thinglha hen, chule agoh keuseh-in umuhen, chuin mipi kikhomho jouse chun, atisoh keijun, Pakai avahchoi taove. Chule mipi ho chun hiche kitepna banghin aboltauve.
target: I also shook out the folds of my robe and said, “In this way may God shake out of their house and possessions anyone who does not keep this promise. So may such a person be shaken out and emptied!” At this the whole assembly said, “Amen,” and praised the Lord . And the people did as they had promised.

source: Hiche kalval hin amaho chungle Judah ho chunga gam vaipodia eikipansah-a pat leng Artaxerxes kum somni alengchan kum-a pat kum somthumle kumni alengchan gei; hichu kum somle kumni sunga hin, keile kasopi hon gamvaipo anneh chu kanepouve.
target: Moreover, from the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, when I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, until his thirty-second year—twelve years—neither I nor my brothers ate the food allotted to the governor.

source: Ahin, keima masanga gamvaipoa anapangho chun mipi hodinga pohgih tampi anapeuvin, dangka shekel somli simtha louvin changlhah le lengpitwi analahpeh jiuvin, ahi. Alhachaho jengin jong mipi chunga vai ahomun, ahinla kenvang, ka Pathen kakichat jeh-in hitobanghin kabolpoi.
target: But the earlier governors—those preceding me—placed a heavy burden on the people and took forty shekels of silver from them in addition to food and wine. Their assistants also lorded it over the people. But out of reverence for God I did not act like that.

source: Ahi, hiche kulbang bolna-a hi kapan jing ahin, gam himhim kachopouve, kalhachate jouse jong natongin aumkhom jingun ahi.
target: Instead, I devoted myself to the work on this wall. All my men were assembled there for the work; we did not acquire any land.

source: Hiche chungchonin, ikimvel uva namtina konle Pathen helouhole ahung kikhom khomho simlouvin, Judah teleh vaihomlete lah-a keima dokhanga an ananejing mi jakhat le somnga aumjinguve.
target: Furthermore, a hundred and fifty Jews and officials ate at my table, as well as those who came to us from the surrounding nations.

source: Nikhat sunga kei nehdinga kigong chu bongchal khatleh deilhencheh kelngoi gup, chule ahcha hojong keidingin asemun, nisom alhinsehle lengpitwi akimin akhol khomun, hichan geihin eikigonpeh jongle mipi ho asohchannao anasatjeh-in, keiman gam vaipo kahina-a, kipe changlhah chu kanejipoi.
target: Each day one ox, six choice sheep and some poultry were prepared for me, and every ten days an abundant supply of wine of all kinds. In spite of all this, I never demanded the food allotted to the governor, because the demands were heavy on these people.

source: Ka Pathen hiche mite dinga kathilbol jouse dungjui hin, nangin keima phatnading neigelpeh jingin.
target: Remember me with favor, my God, for all I have done for these people.

source: Tun ahung hitin ahi, Sanballat le Tobiah le Arab mi Geshem chule kamelmaho adangsen bang kisahdoh le aphalou akidalha abeitai ti ajah phatnun, (kotpi kotho kabuto loulai vangin,)
target: When word came to Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arab and the rest of our enemies that I had rebuilt the wall and not a gap was left in it—though up to that time I had not set the doors in the gates—

source: Sanballat le Geshem'in, hungin lang Ono phaicham khoho khatna kimutou hite, tin thu ahinthot lhonin ahi. Ahinla amahon kachunga engkhanna thilphalou abol gotnu ahi.
target: Sanballat and Geshem sent me this message: “Come, let us meet together in one of the villages on the plain of Ono.” But they were scheming to harm me;

source: Chuin keiman ahenguva thupole ho kasolin, na loupitah katoh jeh-in kahungsuh theipoi. Kahungsuh-a kadalhah kah-a, natoh ibola tangding ham? katin ahi.
target: so I sent messengers to them with this reply: “I am carrying on a great project and cannot go down. Why should the work stop while I leave it and go down to you?”

source: Ahinla hitobang hin mi liveijen ahinsolun, keiman kadonbut ngaiman kadonbut jin ahi.
target: Four times they sent me the same message, and each time I gave them the same answer.

source: Chuphatnin chutobangma chun angavei channa-in, Sanballat'in kahenga lekhathot kihongsa khat asohpa ahinchoi sah-in,
target: Then, the fifth time, Sanballat sent his aide to me with the same message, and in his hand was an unsealed letter

source: Asunga chun hiti hin akisune: Pathen heloulaiho henga akiseijin, Geshem injong aseijin ahi, hichu nangle Judah ten kiphin nagotnu ahi. Hiche dinga chu kulpi bang hi nasem phatnu ahi, akisei dungjuija nangma amaho leng nahi theina dinga ahi.
target: in which was written: “It is reported among the nations—and Geshem says it is true—that you and the Jews are plotting to revolt, and therefore you are building the wall. Moreover, according to these reports you are about to become their king

source: Chule Judah gama lengkhat aume tia nathu phong jalle ding themgao tamtah Jerusalem'a napansah tai. Chule tun hiche thuho dungjui jahi lengpa henga thu alhut dingu ahitai. Hijeh chun, tun hungin lang kihou khomu hite, ati.
target: and have even appointed prophets to make this proclamation about you in Jerusalem: ‘There is a king in Judah!’ Now this report will get back to the king; so come, let us meet together.”

source: Chuphatnin keiman thu kathotnin, nasei banga thil kibol khatcha aumpoi, nangma lungchama nasemthu ahibouve, kati.
target: I sent him this reply: “Nothing like what you are saying is happening; you are just making it up out of your head.”

source: Ajehchu amaho jousen eikichatjeh uva, kanatoh-u pilhin louna dinga kakhutnu hatmosah ding eitiu ahi. Hijeh chun tun vo, Pathen kakhutnu hatsah in.
target: They were all trying to frighten us, thinking, “Their hands will get too weak for the work, and it will not be completed.” But I prayed, “Now strengthen my hands.”

source: Hiche jouhin Mehetabeel cha Delaiah chapa Shemaiah henga kachen, ama a-in'a kot kikha khum ahin, chule aman aseije, Pathen'in a-houin sungeija kimuto hitin, houin kotkhah ho ikhadiu ahi, ajehchu nangma thatdinga hungding ahiuve; henge, janteng nangma thatdinga hungdiu ahi.
target: One day I went to the house of Shemaiah son of Delaiah, the son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at his home. He said, “Let us meet in the house of God, inside the temple, and let us close the temple doors, because men are coming to kill you—by night they are coming to kill you.”

source: Chuin keiman hitin kati, kei tobang mikhat chu jam intem? keitobanga ahinna huhdoh go-a houin sunga lutding koi umam? lut louhel ding kahi.
target: But I said, “Should a man like me run away? Or should someone like me go into the temple to save his life? I will not go!”

source: Chule ven, ama Pathen sol ahipoi ti kahethemtai. Hiche gaothuhi keima douna-a asei ahi, ajehchu Tobiah le Sanballat'in athalah lhon ahi.
target: I realized that God had not sent him, but that he had prophesied against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

source: Hijeh-a chu keima katijatna, ati bangu kabola, chule thil engkhanna nei ahi tia eisuhminset nuva, eihouset theina dinguva, athalah-u ahibouve.
target: He had been hired to intimidate me so that I would commit a sin by doing this, and then they would give me a bad name to discredit me.

source: Ka Pathen, Tobiah le Sanballat hi, anatoh dungjui cheh leh Naodiah themgaonu, chule themgao dang dangho kichatsah eigohohi hetpeh jingin.
target: Remember Tobiah and Sanballat, my God, because of what they have done; remember also the prophet Noadiah and how she and the rest of the prophets have been trying to intimidate me.

source: Nisomnga le nini lutnin Elul lha nisomni le ninga lhinin kulbang chu jo ahitai.
target: So the wall was completed on the twenty-fifth of Elul, in fifty-two days.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Pathen helouho leh kamelma teovin, nakitong jouse amutah un, amaho alungthoi lheh-un, hiche nakitonghi Pathen natoh ngei ahi ti ahetauve.
target: When all our enemies heard about this, all the surrounding nations were afraid and lost their self-confidence, because they realized that this work had been done with the help of our God.

source: Chukalvalin hiche laichun Judah milen milal hon Tobiah chu lekha tamtah athotnuvin, chujongle Tobiah lekhathot jong amujiuve.
target: Also, in those days the nobles of Judah were sending many letters to Tobiah, and replies from Tobiah kept coming to them.

source: Ajehchu Judah mitamtah ama koma kihahselji ahiuvin, ajehchu amachu Arah chapa Sehchaniah tupa ahin, achapa Johanan chun Berechiah chapa Meshullam chanu ji-a anei ahi.
target: For many in Judah were under oath to him, since he was son-in-law to Shekaniah son of Arah, and his son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berekiah.

source: Keima jahdin anatohphat aseijiuvin chule kathuseiho jong ama koma alhutjiuve. Chule Tobiah hin kei kichatsah nadinga lekha ahinthotji ahi.
target: Moreover, they kept reporting to me his good deeds and then telling him what I said. And Tobiah sent letters to intimidate me.

source: Tun ahitin ahi, kulbangho kasemuva kotkhah ho katundoh uva, kotngah ho, lasa loile Levi ho kapansah jouvun,
target: After the wall had been rebuilt and I had set the doors in place, the gatekeepers, the musicians and the Levites were appointed.

source: Kasopi Hanani leh leng ina vaihom Hananiah, amani hi Jerusalem vaipo din kathupeh-in, amahi mi kitah tahsan umtah ahin, chule midang sanga Pathen ging ahi.
target: I put in charge of Jerusalem my brother Hanani, along with Hananiah the commander of the citadel, because he was a man of integrity and feared God more than most people do.

source: Chule ajah uvah, Jerusalem kotpihi nisa asatdoh kahsen kihonda henlang, kotngah ho dinpetin, kotjouse khah-u henlang, kamsoh keijuhen, chule kotngah-a pangdin Jerusalem'a chengho lhengdoh unlang, ama ama ngana munchehle, ama ama injoncheh akingadiu ahi, kati.
target: I said to them, “The gates of Jerusalem are not to be opened until the sun is hot. While the gatekeepers are still on duty, have them shut the doors and bar them. Also appoint residents of Jerusalem as guards, some at their posts and some near their own houses.”

source: Tun khopi chu alenin, chule ajaolheh-in, ahin amihem alhom nalaijin chule inho jong sahjou loulai ahi.
target: Now the city was large and spacious, but there were few people in it, and the houses had not yet been rebuilt.

source: Chuin ka Pathen'in kalung gila milen milal ho, vaihomho chule mipi ho kou khomsoh keija, aphungkhai khaija aminu simdin kalunggil ahetsah-in ahi. Chule anachetou masaho phung kaija minbu sutna chu kamudoh-in, hia chun hitia kisunhi kamun, ahi.
target: So my God put it into my heart to assemble the nobles, the officials and the common people for registration by families. I found the genealogical record of those who had been the first to return. This is what I found written there:

source: Hitehohi agamsung chate chu ahiuve amaho gal hinga kikaina mun'a kona hungkitol tou ahiuvin, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar chun anatolmanga, Jerusalemle Judah a hungkile kitnuva, ama khopi cheh ahinkijot kitnu, ahi.
target: These are the people of the province who came up from the captivity of the exiles whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had taken captive (they returned to Jerusalem and Judah, each to his own town,

source: Amaho chu Zerubbabel toh hungkhom; Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah ahiuve. Israel mipi lah-a amijatmong chu hichehi ahi, kati.
target: in company with Zerubbabel, Joshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum and Baanah): The list of the men of Israel:

source: Chule Temalah, Talharesha, Cherub, Addon le Immera kona hungtou hochu hichehohi ahiuve, ahinla apu apa sonholah-a achilhah ho chu Israel mi ahiule ahilouvu chu asutthei tapouve.
target: The following came up from the towns of Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Kerub, Addon and Immer, but they could not show that their families were descended from Israel:

source: Delaiah chate, Tobiah chate, Nekoda chate sechu jaguple somlileni ahiuve.
target: the descendants of Delaiah, Tobiah and Nekoda 642

source: Chule thempuho lah-a, Habaiah chate Barxillai chate Gilead mi Barzillai chanute lah-a khat akichenpia, aminu dungjuija kisah ahi.
target: And from among the priests: the descendants of Hobaiah, Hakkoz and Barzillai (a man who had married a daughter of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by that name).

source: Mi hichenghin phungmin kisutna lah-a, aminu aholun, ahinla amujou tapouve. Akisuhboh jeh-un, a thempu hinaova konin akihaisahtaove.
target: These searched for their family records, but they could not find them and so were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.

source: Chule Tirshatha'in amaho jah-a, thempu chun Urim le Thummim akibeha adin kahse-a, thiltheng chungnung chu anehthei loudiu ahi, ati.
target: The governor, therefore, ordered them not to eat any of the most sacred food until there should be a priest ministering with the Urim and Thummim.

source: Mipi kikhomho jouse chu abonchauvin, sangsomli le sangni le jathum le somgup ahiuve.
target: The whole company numbered 42,360,

source: Asohho numei le Pasal sangsagi le jathum le somthum le sagi simtha louvin la saloi numei le Pasal jani le somli le nga ahiuvin,
target: besides their 7,337 male and female slaves; and they also had 245 male and female singers.

source: A sakol houchu ja sagi le somthum le gup, sanganho chu jani le somli le nga ahiuve.
target: There were 736 horses, 245 mules,

source: A sangongsao vuchu jali le somthum le nga ahi.
target: 435 camels and 6,720 donkeys.

source: Chule Pa te lah-a lamkai phabepmin natohna dingin atoh doh un ahi. Tirshatha gam vaipopan sana tena sangkhat, twikong somnga, thempu von janga le somthum, sumkhol na-a atohdohe.
target: Some of the heads of the families contributed to the work. The governor gave to the treasury 1,000 darics of gold, 50 bowls and 530 garments for priests.

source: Chule insung luboh mi phabep honjong sumkhol na-a din sana tena sangsomni chule dangka tena sangni le jani atohdoh-un, ahi.
target: Some of the heads of the families gave to the treasury for the work 20,000 darics of gold and 2,200 minas of silver.

source: Chule midang jousen apeh uchu sana tena sangsomni le dangka tena sangni, chule thempu von somgup le sagi ahi.
target: The total given by the rest of the people was 20,000 darics of gold, 2,000 minas of silver and 67 garments for priests.

source: Hitihin thempuho, Levi ho, kotngah ho, lasaho mi phabep le Nethinim ho, chule Israel jouse chu ama ama khopi cheh-a achengcheh un, ahi. Lhasagi ahunglhin phatnin Israel chate chu akhopicheh uvah aumtaove.
target: The priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the musicians and the temple servants, along with certain of the people and the rest of the Israelites, settled in their own towns. When the seventh month came and the Israelites had settled in their towns,

source: Chuin mipi jouse chu mihem khat bang jengin twikul kotpi masang lamlena chun akikhom khommun, chule amahon Pakaiyin Israelte dan thupeh Mosi dan lekhabu chu hinpodoh dingin, lekhasunpa Ezra henga aseitaove.
target: all the people came together as one in the square before the Water Gate. They told Ezra the teacher of the Law to bring out the Book of the Law of Moses, which the Lord had commanded for Israel.

source: Chuin thempu Ezra chun, anumei apasal houkhom ho henga leh ahekhen themthei ho jah ding chun, amasanguva lhasagi na, ani masa nin danthupeh chu ahinpodoh tai.
target: So on the first day of the seventh month Ezra the priest brought the Law before the assembly, which was made up of men and women and all who were able to understand.

source: Chuin aman twi kotpi phunga um khopi lamlen masanga chun numei pasal leh ahethei dingdol jouse masanga chun jingkah-a pat nin sunkim geijin asimdoh peh in: chule dan thupeh chu mijousen anakhang uva lunglut tah-in angaisoh keijun, ahi.
target: He read it aloud from daybreak till noon as he faced the square before the Water Gate in the presence of the men, women and others who could understand. And all the people listened attentively to the Book of the Law.

source: Chuin danthusun Ezra chu thuseina dinga lhongpeh kidosang chunga chun adingin, akoma chun Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah le Maaseiah adinguvin; chule ajet le veija chun Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zekeriah, le Meshullam adinguvin ahi.
target: Ezra the teacher of the Law stood on a high wooden platform built for the occasion. Beside him on his right stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah and Maaseiah; and on his left were Pedaiah, Mishael, Malkijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah and Meshullam.

source: Chuin Ezra'in mipi jouse mitmun lekhabu chu aphongin; (ajeh chu mipi jouse chungvuma dinga ahin) chuin aphohdoh phatnin mipi jouse chu adingun:
target: Ezra opened the book. All the people could see him because he was standing above them; and as he opened it, the people all stood up.

source: Chuin Ezra'in Pakai Pathen len chu athangvah-in ahi. Chuin mipi jousen adonbut un; “Amen, Amen” tin akhut hou adomsangun: chule alu akunsah-un, amaiju tolla asulut nun Pakai chu ahou taovin, ahi.
target: Ezra praised the Lord , the great God; and all the people lifted their hands and responded, “Amen! Amen!” Then they bowed down and worshiped the Lord with their faces to the ground.

source: Chule Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, le Levi hojong chun mipi hochu danthu peh ahetchet sah-un: chule mipi hochu adinnau munna chun ading jingun ahi.
target: The Levites—Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan and Pelaiah—instructed the people in the Law while the people were standing there.

source: Hitichun amahon Pathen dan thupeh lekhabu chu kichentah-in asimun, chule athuchu ahilchet peh in, asimdoh hochu ahetkhenthem sah-un ahi.
target: They read from the Book of the Law of God, making it clear and giving the meaning so that the people understood what was being read.

source: Chuin Tirshatha Nehemiah le dan thusun thempu Ezra, chule mipi hille-a pang Levi hochun, mipi jouse henga chun; tuni nikho hi Pakai na Pathen dinguva nikho theng ahin, lunghem hih-un, kapjong kap hih-un, atiuvin ahi, Ajeh chu amahon danthupeh thu cheng hochu ajah phatnuva mipi jouse chu kapma ahiuve.
target: Then Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and teacher of the Law, and the Levites who were instructing the people said to them all, “This day is holy to the Lord your God. Do not mourn or weep.” For all the people had been weeping as they listened to the words of the Law.

source: Chuin aman ahenguva, cheovin lang, athao thao neuvin lang, alhum lhum donun: imacha kigon louho dingin chan thotpeh-un: ajeh chu tunihi i-Pakai dinguva nikho theng ahin, lung jong lungdong hih-un; ajeh chu Pakai kipana chu na thahat nau ahi.
target: Nehemiah said, “Go and enjoy choice food and sweet drinks, and send some to those who have nothing prepared. This day is holy to our Lord. Do not grieve, for the joy of the Lord is your strength.”

source: Hitichun Levi hochun mipi hochu athipsah-un, tunihi nikho theng ahin, chule lungjong lungkham hih un, atiuve.
target: The Levites calmed all the people, saying, “Be still, for this is a holy day. Do not grieve.”

source: Chuin ahenguva kiphongdoh thuho chu ahetcheh tah jeh-un, aneh dingle adonding chule chanho thotdoh dingle kipah tah-a umdingin akikhen dohtaove.
target: Then all the people went away to eat and drink, to send portions of food and to celebrate with great joy, because they now understood the words that had been made known to them.

source: Chuin ani ni lhinnin, Mipi jouse lah-a apateu insung luchang holeh Levi holeh thempu hochu, dan thusun Ezra henga; dan thupeh ho hetchet theina dingin akikhomun, ahi.
target: On the second day of the month, the heads of all the families, along with the priests and the Levites, gathered around Ezra the teacher to give attention to the words of the Law.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Mosi anapeh, Israel chate chu lhasagi channa kut sunga lhambuh sunga chengdio ahi: tia dan thupeh lekhabua kisun chu amahon amuvin ahi.
target: They found written in the Law, which the Lord had commanded through Moses, that the Israelites were to live in temporary shelters during the festival of the seventh month

source: Chule hitia chu amahon akhopi jouseule Jerusalem khopi sunga alhangsap leuva, lhangvum lama potdoh unlang Olive thingbah ho, chah thing bah ho, lenmui bah ho, tumkao ho, chule lhambuh ho-a sem dinga akijih banga, aphonjal lediu ahi.
target: and that they should proclaim this word and spread it throughout their towns and in Jerusalem: “Go out into the hill country and bring back branches from olive and wild olive trees, and from myrtles, palms and shade trees, to make temporary shelters”—as it is written.

source: Hitichun mipi hochu acheuvin, hitiho chu ahinpouvin; ama ama in chung dingle ahonsung dinghou, chule Pathen in hongsung ho-a, twi kotpi khopi lamlen; chule Ephraim kotpi khopi lamlen sunga lhambuh in akisemun, ahi.
target: So the people went out and brought back branches and built themselves temporary shelters on their own roofs, in their courtyards, in the courts of the house of God and in the square by the Water Gate and the one by the Gate of Ephraim.

source: Chule gal hinga kikai hungkile kit mipi ho jouse chun, lhambuh ho akisonun, lhambuh ho noija chun atouvun Nun chapa Joshua nikholaija pat hiche nikho geija hi Israel chaten hitia hi anabolkhah loulaiju ahi. Hitichun kipa na lentah anaumin, ahi.
target: The whole company that had returned from exile built temporary shelters and lived in them. From the days of Joshua son of Nun until that day, the Israelites had not celebrated it like this. And their joy was very great.

source: Chujongle ani anin ni masa ni-a pat achaini geijin, Pathen danthupeh lekhabu chu asimin ahi. Chule amahon nisagi kut abollun, chule aumdan dungjui jin, aniget nichu thupeh dungjuija kikhoppi theng nikho ahi.
target: Day after day, from the first day to the last, Ezra read from the Book of the Law of God. They celebrated the festival for seven days, and on the eighth day, in accordance with the regulation, there was an assembly.

source: Tun hiche lha nisomni le nili nin, Israel chaten khaopon akisilun, achunguva leivui akinuvin an ngollin kikhopna aneijun ahi.
target: On the twenty-fourth day of the same month, the Israelites gathered together, fasting and wearing sackcloth and putting dust on their heads.

source: Chuin Israel chilhah phung chu gamdangmi ho lah-a konin, akisepdoh un adingun, chule achonset nau leh apu apateu khangitlouna jouseu aphongun, ahi.
target: Those of Israelite descent had separated themselves from all foreigners. They stood in their places and confessed their sins and the sins of their ancestors.

source: Chule amaho aumnacheh uva ading doh-un, chuche nikho hopli-a hopkhat sung chun Pakai a-Pathen'u danthupeh lekhabu chu asimun; chule hopli-a hopkhat danga chun a-Pathen'u ahouvun ahi.
target: They stood where they were and read from the Book of the Law of the Lord their God for a quarter of the day, and spent another quarter in confession and in worshiping the Lord their God.

source: Chuin Levi ho thuseina dinga kisepsang chunga chun Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebia, Bani le Chenani hohi adingun, awsangtah in Pakai a-Pathen'u asamun ahi.
target: Standing on the stairs of the Levites were Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani and Kenani. They cried out with loud voices to the Lord their God.

source: Chuin Levi ho, Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabnah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah le Pethahiah chun dingun lang na Pathen chu atonsotnin choi-anun, chule pachatna leh vahchoina tincheng chunga namin loupichamkim chu nunnom hen, atiuve.
target: And the Levites—Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah and Pethahiah—said: “Stand up and praise the Lord your God, who is from everlasting to everlasting.” “Blessed be your glorious name, and may it be exalted above all blessing and praise.

source: Nangma bou Pakai nahi, nangman van nasemin, vanle vanho ngeisunga umjouse, leisetle asunga aumjouse twipiho chule asunga umjouse, chu Nangin nachingtup'in, chule van janelin nahouvun, ahi.
target: You alone are the Lord . You made the heavens, even the highest heavens, and all their starry host, the earth and all that is on it, the seas and all that is in them. You give life to everything, and the multitudes of heaven worship you.

source: Nangin Abram chu Chaldea gam Ur kho-a kona nahinpuidoh-a, amindinga Abraham hinsah-a Pakai Pathen chu nangma nahin,
target: “You are the Lord God, who chose Abram and brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans and named him Abraham.

source: Chule namasanga ama milungkitah ahina namudoh a, chule Kanaan mite, Hit mite, Ammor mite, Perizz mite, Jebus mite chule Girgas mite gam pehdinga amatoh thulhuna nanasem achilhahte kapeh ding ahi, natin chule nangin nathuho chu nasubu lhit jie, ajehchu nangma chondihtah nahi.
target: You found his heart faithful to you, and you made a covenant with him to give to his descendants the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Jebusites and Girgashites. You have kept your promise because you are righteous.

source: Egypt gama kapateu thohgimna namujingin, chule twipi sana akanao najahpeh-e.
target: “You saw the suffering of our ancestors in Egypt; you heard their cry at the Red Sea.

source: Chule Pharaoh le asohte jouse le agamsung mihem jouse chunga melchihna le thil kidangho namusah-in ahi. Ajehchu amahon amaho dounan kiletsahtah -in thil anaboluve, ti nahedoh-in ahi. Hitichun tuni banghin min khat nana neije.
target: You sent signs and wonders against Pharaoh, against all his officials and all the people of his land, for you knew how arrogantly the Egyptians treated them. You made a name for yourself, which remains to this day.

source: Amaho twikhanglen lailunga tolgoa achetheina dingun, nangin amasanguva twikhanglen chu nasukhenin, song twihat lah-a kiseplut bangin, abolgenthei hochu twithuh lah-a naseplutnin ahi.
target: You divided the sea before them, so that they passed through it on dry ground, but you hurled their pursuers into the depths, like a stone into mighty waters.

source: Chukal valin amaho achenau lampia vah pehdin, sunle meilhang khompin chule janleh meikong khompin amaho chu nanapuijin ahi.
target: By day you led them with a pillar of cloud, and by night with a pillar of fire to give them light on the way they were to take.

source: Chule Sinai lhang chunga konin jong nahung kumlhan, van'a konin amaho nakihoupin, amaho thutanlhah dihna dan dihtahho, tepnadan phaho le thupeh ho napen,
target: “You came down on Mount Sinai; you spoke to them from heaven. You gave them regulations and laws that are just and right, and decrees and commands that are good.

source: Chule nacholdo nitheng chu amaho nahetsah-in, chule nasoh Mosi khutna konin danho, tepna danho, danho, amaho thu napen ahi.
target: You made known to them your holy Sabbath and gave them commands, decrees and laws through your servant Moses.

source: Chule agilkel tengule van'a konin changlhah napen, chule adangchah tengule songpi-a konin twi naputdoh sah-in, amaho pehdinga nana thutepna gama acheuva, agalo nadingun amaho nathutep-in ahi.
target: In their hunger you gave them bread from heaven and in their thirst you brought them water from the rock; you told them to go in and take possession of the land you had sworn with uplifted hand to give them.

source: Ahinla amaho leh kapateu chun kiletsah tah-in anabollun, alouchalun, nathupeh hochu angainom pouve.
target: “But they, our ancestors, became arrogant and stiff-necked, and they did not obey your commands.

source: Chule thu amangnom pouvin, alah uva nathil kidang bolhojong anahsah pouvin, ahinla alouchalun akiphinun, asoh hinao mun'a kilekitdin gal lamkai ding akilhenun, ahivangin nangin ngaidam dinga kigosa jingpa Pathen milungset themle hepina-a dim, lunghang vahlou khotona-a dim nahin, amaho namoh dalhah ngaipon ahi.
target: They refused to listen and failed to remember the miracles you performed among them. They became stiff-necked and in their rebellion appointed a leader in order to return to their slavery. But you are a forgiving God, gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in love. Therefore you did not desert them,

source: Ahi, amahon akilhajol bongnou lim anasemuvin, hichehi ahi, na Pathen'u, Egypt gama kona nahinpuidoh uva chu, atiuvin, chule lunghana nasatah-in naphin seuve;
target: even when they cast for themselves an image of a calf and said, ‘This is your god, who brought you up out of Egypt,’ or when they committed awful blasphemies.

source: Hijongle hepina dimset chun gamthipmah amaho nadalha pon, lampia sunle amaho puidingin meilhang khompin chule amaho salvah dingle achenao lampi hildingin janleh meikong khompin, nadalha jipon ahi.
target: “Because of your great compassion you did not abandon them in the wilderness. By day the pillar of cloud did not fail to guide them on their path, nor the pillar of fire by night to shine on the way they were to take.

source: Amaho hil dingin nalhagao pha chu napen, na manna chu akam sunguva lutding na-itpon, chule adang chah naova amaho twi napen ahi.
target: You gave your good Spirit to instruct them. You did not withhold your manna from their mouths, and you gave them water for their thirst.

source: Ahi, gamthipma chun kum somli sung nanavah-in, hitichun imacha alhasam pouvin, asil le achenu achulpon, akeng houjong apompon, ahi.
target: For forty years you sustained them in the wilderness; they lacked nothing, their clothes did not wear out nor did their feet become swollen.

source: Chukal valin lenggam holeh nampi hochu napen, gam ningkoi tina amaho nahom khennin, hitichun amahon Sihon gam Heshbon lenggam leh, Bashan lengpa Og gamchu alotauve.
target: “You gave them kingdoms and nations, allotting to them even the remotest frontiers. They took over the country of Sihon king of Heshbon and the country of Og king of Bashan.

source: Achateu jongchu van'a ahsi jatnin napunsah-in, chule amahon alodinguva apateu henga nana tepsa gamsunga chun napuilut tan ahi.
target: You made their children as numerous as the stars in the sky, and you brought them into the land that you told their parents to enter and possess.

source: Hitichun achateu chu alutnun gamchu alotaovin, chule nangman gamsunga chun Kanaan miho chu amaho masanga nasunemin, anop aninguva aboldiuvin alenghouleh chugama miho chu akhutnuvah napedoh tai.
target: Their children went in and took possession of the land. You subdued before them the Canaanites, who lived in the land; you gave the Canaanites into their hands, along with their kings and the peoples of the land, to deal with them as they pleased.

source: Chule amahon khopi det holeh leiset phaho chu alauvin, chule thilkeu dimset inhole, twikul kilaiho, lengpilei ho, Olive honho, theiphung tamtah jong alotaovin, ahi. Hitichun aneuvin, avasetnun, ahung thaovun, chule naphatna lentah achun akipah un, ahi.
target: They captured fortified cities and fertile land; they took possession of houses filled with all kinds of good things, wells already dug, vineyards, olive groves and fruit trees in abundance. They ate to the full and were well-nourished; they reveled in your great goodness.

source: Hijengjongle sei angaipouvin, nangma dounan akiphinun, chule nadan thupeh thuchu anung angatnun, nangma lama ahung kiheikit nadinguva, amaho douna-a nathu hettohsahna themgao hou chu athatnun, chule amahon nasatah-in aphinseuvin, ahi.
target: “But they were disobedient and rebelled against you; they turned their backs on your law. They killed your prophets, who had warned them in order to turn them back to you; they committed awful blasphemies.

source: Hijehhin amaho sugenthei amelmateu khutna chun napedoh in, alungdon laijuva nangma nakou phatnu chun, van'a konin nanangai peh-in, chule namihepi nadimset chun amelmateuva konin ahuhdoh dingu nanapei.
target: So you delivered them into the hands of their enemies, who oppressed them. But when they were oppressed they cried out to you. From heaven you heard them, and in your great compassion you gave them deliverers, who rescued them from the hand of their enemies.

source: Ahin amaho akicholdo jouvun, amahon namasanga engkhan abolkit taovin, hijeh chun amelmateu khutna dingin nadalha jitan; hitichun amelma teovin, achunguva vai ahomin, ahinla ahung kihei juva nangma nasap tenguleh, van'a konin nahin ngaijin, chule nami hepina dungjuijin amahochu vel tamtah na huhdohjin ahi.
target: “But as soon as they were at rest, they again did what was evil in your sight. Then you abandoned them to the hand of their enemies so that they ruled over them. And when they cried out to you again, you heard from heaven, and in your compassion you delivered them time after time.

source: Chule nadan thupeh thua amaho nahinpui kit theina dingin, amaho dounan nahet tohsahjin ahi. Hijongle amaho kiletsah tah-in aumun, nathu peh ho angaipouvin, nathu tanlhah ho dounan achonseuvin, (min abola ahile, ama hina-a chu hingding ahi) chule alengkouvu ahih leuvin, angong avaiputnun chule angainom pouve.
target: “You warned them in order to turn them back to your law, but they became arrogant and disobeyed your commands. They sinned against your ordinances, of which you said, ‘The person who obeys them will live by them.’ Stubbornly they turned their backs on you, became stiff-necked and refused to listen.

source: Ahinla kum tamtah amaho nanathoh ham hamin, chule na themgaoho mangchan nalhagaovin amaho dounan nana hettohsah jin ahi. Hijongle anakhangu asung pouvin, hijeh chun nangman gamsunga cheng miho khutna napedoh-in ahi.
target: For many years you were patient with them. By your Spirit you warned them through your prophets. Yet they paid no attention, so you gave them into the hands of the neighboring peoples.

source: Hijeng jongle nahepina lentah jalchun, amaho nasumang hel jipoi, notjong nanot thap pon, ajehchu nangma khotonale hepina-a dim Pathen nahi.
target: But in your great mercy you did not put an end to them or abandon them, for you are a gracious and merciful God.

source: Hijeh chun tun, ka Pathen, akitepna le akhotona chingjing, loupitahle thilbol thei chule tijat umtah Pathen, Assyria lengho phat laija pat tuni nikho geija, keihole kaleng teho, kapipui hou, kathempu hou, kathemgao hou, kapatehou chule nampite jouse chunga hahsatna hung lhung jousehi thilneo maimai jin anasandan.
target: “Now therefore, our God, the great God, mighty and awesome, who keeps his covenant of love, do not let all this hardship seem trifling in your eyes—the hardship that has come on us, on our kings and leaders, on our priests and prophets, on our ancestors and all your people, from the days of the kings of Assyria until today.

source: Ipi hitajongle kachunguva thil nalhunsah jousehin nadih-e, ajehchu nangman adih nabolin, keihovang giloutah-in kachon jiuve.
target: In all that has happened to us, you have remained righteous; you have acted faithfully, while we acted wickedly.

source: Nangma amaho douna-a nana photchen sahna dan thupeh, nathupeh ho leh nathu photchen sahna ho chu, kalenghou, kapipui hou, kathem puhou, kapu kapa tehouvin anitpouvin, ngaijong angainom pouve.
target: Our kings, our leaders, our priests and our ancestors did not follow your law; they did not pay attention to your commands or the statutes you warned them to keep.

source: Ajehchu naphatna lentah chule amasanguva gam lentahle phatah amaho napehjing vangin, amahon aleng gamuva nangma naja nompouvin, a-engkhan bolnaova konin jong ahung kilehei pouvin ahi.
target: Even while they were in their kingdom, enjoying your great goodness to them in the spacious and fertile land you gave them, they did not serve you or turn from their evil ways.

source: Vetan, tun misoh kahitao vin, gamle asunga theiga le thilpha, kapu kapateu nehdinga nanapeh chu ven, chemunna chun keiho soh in kapangun ahi.
target: “But see, we are slaves today, slaves in the land you gave our ancestors so they could eat its fruit and the other good things it produces.

source: Kachonset jeh uva kachung uva leng dinga neisem peh houvinla gamga soh ho anetam valun, kati chungule kagancha teo chunga jong nopsahnan vai ahomun, chule keiho kahesoh behset taove.
target: Because of our sins, its abundant harvest goes to the kings you have placed over us. They rule over our bodies and our cattle as they please. We are in great distress.

source: Chule hitiho jouse jeh hin thulhun dettah kasemun, chule kasunun, kapipui hou, Levi ho, chule kathempu hou vin hichu namdet anam khumun ahi.
target: “In view of all this, we are making a binding agreement, putting it in writing, and our leaders, our Levites and our priests are affixing their seals to it.”

source: Tun, Namdet kinamkhum hochu Nehemiah, Tirshatha, Hachaliah chapa chule Zidkiah,
target: Those who sealed it were: Nehemiah the governor, the son of Hacaliah. Zedekiah,

source: Seraihah, Azeriah, Jeremiah,
target: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,

source: Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah,
target: Pashhur, Amariah, Malkijah,

source: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,
target: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluk,

source: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,
target: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,

source: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,
target: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,

source: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,
target: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,

source: Maaziah, Beilgai, Shemaiah; hichenghi thempu ahiuve.
target: Maaziah, Bilgai and Shemaiah. These were the priests.

source: Chule Levi techu: Azariah chapa Jeshua, Henadad, Kadmiel chapa Binnui ahiuve.
target: The Levites: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel,

source: Chule asopiho Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
target: and their associates: Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

source: Micha, Rehob, Hashabiah,
target: Mika, Rehob, Hashabiah,

source: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
target: Zakkur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,

source: Hodijah, Bani, Beninu.
target: Hodiah, Bani and Beninu.

source: Mipi ho luchang Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,
target: The leaders of the people: Parosh, Pahath-Moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,

source: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
target: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,

source: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
target: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,

source: Ater, Hizkijah, Azzur,
target: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,

source: Hodijah, Hashum, Bezai,
target: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,

source: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,
target: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,

source: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
target: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,

source: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,
target: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,

source: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
target: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,

source: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hashub,
target: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,

source: Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek,
target: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,

source: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
target: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,

source: Chule Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,
target: Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,

source: Malluch, Harim, Baanah, ahiuve.
target: Malluk, Harim and Baanah.

source: Chule mipi dangho chu thempuho, Levi ho, kotngah ho, la saho, Nethinim mitele Pathen dan thupehna gamsung miho a konle amahole amaho kisepkhena, ajiteu achateu le achanuteu, hetna neiho jouse chule hetkhenthem theina neiho jouse.
target: “The rest of the people—priests, Levites, gatekeepers, musicians, temple servants and all who separated themselves from the neighboring peoples for the sake of the Law of God, together with their wives and all their sons and daughters who are able to understand—

source: Pathen soh Mosi in apeh, I-Pakaiyu Pakai athutanlhah hole adan kisemho, bolla nitding chule Pathen danthu peh jouse-a chon dingin amaho asopite, amilen amilal teova abeh un, gaosapnale kihahsel na-a alutnun,
target: all these now join their fellow Israelites the nobles, and bind themselves with a curse and an oath to follow the Law of God given through Moses the servant of God and to obey carefully all the commands, regulations and decrees of the Lord our Lord.

source: Chule keihon chugama miho ding chun, kachanu tehou pepou vingting, kachapa teo jiding achanuteu jong lapouvinge.
target: “We promise not to give our daughters in marriage to the peoples around us or take their daughters for our sons.

source: Chule agamsung miten choldoni-a johding thil, ahiloule nehlechah johding hinpojongleu, keihon choldonin ahilouleh nithengnin amaho-a konin imacha chopouvinge, chule hia chun kum sagi lhinkumle achamlou louva bat kilaho chu kangaidam diu ahi.
target: “When the neighboring peoples bring merchandise or grain to sell on the Sabbath, we will not buy from them on the Sabbath or on any holy day. Every seventh year we will forgo working the land and will cancel all debts.

source: Ka Pathen ina natoh nadingin, sekel hopthum-a hopkhat kumseh-a peh dingin houdan khatjong kasemun,
target: “We assume the responsibility for carrying out the commands to give a third of a shekel each year for the service of the house of our God:

source: Vetsahna changlhah, tantih neilou anneh thilto, tantih neilou govam thilto, choldoniho, lhathah ni, kutho bolnading, chule thiltheng ho-a dingin, Israelte dia longlhen kisempeh nadinga chonset thiltoho, chule ka Pathen in'a natoh naho-a dingin houdan thupeh hojong kakisemun, ahi.
target: for the bread set out on the table; for the regular grain offerings and burnt offerings; for the offerings on the Sabbaths, at the New Moon feasts and at the appointed festivals; for the holy offerings; for sin offerings to make atonement for Israel; and for all the duties of the house of our God.

source: Dan thupeh-a kisun dungjuijin, kumtina kitepsa phatho-a Pakai ka Pathen maicham chunga haldingin, kapateu insungho dungjuijin thing thilto ka Pathen insunga polut ding, thempuho le Levi ho chule mipi ho lah-a chun vang kasangun ahi.
target: “We—the priests, the Levites and the people—have cast lots to determine when each of our families is to bring to the house of our God at set times each year a contribution of wood to burn on the altar of the Lord our God, as it is written in the Law.

source: Chule kumseh-a kaleiset lhosoh-u ga masapenle thing jouse ga masapen Pakai in'a pohlutdin,
target: “We also assume responsibility for bringing to the house of the Lord each year the firstfruits of our crops and of every fruit tree.

source: Chujongle dan thupeh-a kisun dungjuijin kachateu apengdoh masapen le gancha apeng masapen, chule gan honle kelngoihon apeng masapen hochu, ka Pathen houin'a lhacha natong thempu koma puicheh din,
target: “As it is also written in the Law, we will bring the firstborn of our sons and of our cattle, of our herds and of our flocks to the house of our God, to the priests ministering there.

source: Chule keihon gam ga masapen changbong, kathilpeh hou chule theiga jat namkim lengpitwi le, thao jat namkim thempuho komle ka Pathen indan sungnunga kapoh lutnuva, chule kagam gao hopsom-a hopkhat hochu Levi ho anga kapohlut uva, hiche Levi ho chun khopi jouse-a kalousoh uchu aneitheina dingu ahi.
target: “Moreover, we will bring to the storerooms of the house of our God, to the priests, the first of our ground meal, of our grain offerings, of the fruit of all our trees and of our new wine and olive oil. And we will bring a tithe of our crops to the Levites, for it is the Levites who collect the tithes in all the towns where we work.

source: Levi ten somakhat alahding tengule, Aron chapa thempu chu Levi hotoh umkhom ding, chule Levi hon somakhat alah uva kona somakhat chu ka Pathen indan sunga thil kholkhom na-a ahinpohlut dingu ahi.
target: A priest descended from Aaron is to accompany the Levites when they receive the tithes, and the Levites are to bring a tenth of the tithes up to the house of our God, to the storerooms of the treasury.

source: Ajehchu Israel chate le Lei chaten, changle lengpitwi le thao, thilpeh-a kipechu houin dansung munthenga manchah kikoina, alhachale thempuho, kotngah ho, lasaloi umna indan-a chu ahinpohlut dingu ahin, keiho ka Pathen in chu donlouva koilou ding kahiuve.
target: The people of Israel, including the Levites, are to bring their contributions of grain, new wine and olive oil to the storerooms, where the articles for the sanctuary and for the ministering priests, the gatekeepers and the musicians are also kept. “We will not neglect the house of our God.”

source: Mipi vaihomho chu Jerusalem'a achengun, mipi adangho jongchun somakhat lah-a khat khopitheng Jerusalem'a chengding somkhat lah-a ko chu khopi danga chengdingin vang aveovin, ahi.
target: Now the leaders of the people settled in Jerusalem. The rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of every ten of them to live in Jerusalem, the holy city, while the remaining nine were to stay in their own towns.

source: Chule mipin jong ama ama lung chama Jerusalem'a cheng dinga hungkipeho chu phatthei abohsoh keijun ahi.
target: The people commended all who volunteered to live in Jerusalem.

source: Tun hitehohi agamkai dola gamsung lamkai Jerusalem'a chengho chu ahiuve. Ahinla Judah gamsung khopiho-a chun, ama ama chanding dolcheh khopiho-a chun achengun, Israelte ahin, thempuho ahin, chule Levi te leh Nethinim ho le Solomon soh ho chate ahiuve.
target: These are the provincial leaders who settled in Jerusalem (now some Israelites, priests, Levites, temple servants and descendants of Solomon’s servants lived in the towns of Judah, each on their own property in the various towns,

source: Chuin Jerusalem'a chun Judah mileh Benjamin mi phabep achengun ahi. Judah chate lah-a chun Uzziah chapa Athaiah ahin, Zakariah chapa Amariah chapa Shephatiah chapa Perez chate lah-a Mahalalel ahiuvin;
target: while other people from both Judah and Benjamin lived in Jerusalem): From the descendants of Judah: Athaiah son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, a descendant of Perez;

source: Chule Baruch chapa Maaseiah Col-hozeh chapa, Hazaiah chapa Asaiah chapa Joiarib chapa Zekeriah chapa Shiloni chapa ahiuve.
target: and Maaseiah son of Baruch, the son of Kol-Hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, a descendant of Shelah.

source: Perez chate Jerusalem khopi-a chengho jouse chu abonchauvin gal hangcheh jali le somgup le get ahiuve.
target: The descendants of Perez who lived in Jerusalem totaled 468 men of standing.

source: Chule amahohi Benjamin chapate ahiuvin, Meshullam chapa Sallu Joab chapa Pedaiah chapa, Kolaiah chapa, Maaseiah chapa, Ithiel chapa, Jesaiah chapa ahiuve.
target: From the descendants of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah,

source: Chule ama nunga hin Gabbai, Sallai mi jakole somni leh get ahiuve.
target: and his followers, Gabbai and Sallai—928 men.

source: Chule Zichri chapa Joel chu amaho vetup ahin; chule Senuah chapa Judah chu Jerusalem khopi chunga lamkai anina-a panga ahi.
target: Joel son of Zikri was their chief officer, and Judah son of Hassenuah was over the New Quarter of the city.

source: Thempu hochu: Joiarib chapa Jedaiah, Jachin.
target: From the priests: Jedaiah; the son of Joiarib; Jakin;

source: Hilkiah chapa Seraiah, Meshullam chapa, Zadok chapa Meraioth chapa, Ahitub chapa chu Pathen insunga vaihoma panga ahi.
target: Seraiah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the official in charge of the house of God,

source: Chule asopite in'a natonga pangho chu mihem jagetle somnileni ahiuve; chule Jeroham chapa Adaiah, Pelaliah chapa, Amzi chapa, Zekeriah chapa, Pashhur chapa, Malchiah chapa,
target: and their associates, who carried on work for the temple—822 men; Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malkijah,

source: Chule asopitele apateo lamkaiho chu mi jani leh somlileni ahiuvin: chule Azareel chapa Amashai, Ahasai chapa, Meshillemoth chapa, Immer chapa,
target: and his associates, who were heads of families—242 men; Amashsai son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

source: Chule asopiteu mihat mihangho chu jakhatle somni le get ahiuvin: chule milen khat chapa Zabdiel chu vaipole-a pang ahi.
target: and his associates, who were men of standing—128. Their chief officer was Zabdiel son of Haggedolim.

source: Levi ho jong: Hashub chapa Shemaiah, Azrikam chapa, Hashabiah chapa, Bunni chapa ahiuvin;
target: From the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

source: Levi ho pipui Shabbethai le Jozabad chun Pathen in polama nakitong jouse chu avettuplhonin ahi.
target: Shabbethai and Jozabad, two of the heads of the Levites, who had charge of the outside work of the house of God;

source: Chule Micha chapa Maataniah, Zabdi chapa, Asaph chapa chu vahchoi taona kin akibolteng alamkai pipenin apangin, asopite lah-a ni chana Bakkukiah, Shammua chapa Abda, Galal chapa, Jeduthun chapa ahiuve.
target: Mattaniah son of Mika, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, the director who led in thanksgiving and prayer; Bakbukiah, second among his associates; and Abda son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

source: Khopi thenga Levi ho jouse chu jani leh somget le li ahiuve.
target: The Levites in the holy city totaled 284.

source: Chukal vallin kotpi ngahho, Akkub, Talmon le asopite kotho ngah-a chu mihem jakhatle somsagi le ni ahiuve.
target: The gatekeepers: Akkub, Talmon and their associates, who kept watch at the gates—172 men.

source: Chule Israel amoh chengse le thempuho Levi ho chu Judah khopiho-a ama ama loding muncheh-a aumtaove.
target: The rest of the Israelites, with the priests and Levites, were in all the towns of Judah, each on their ancestral property.

source: Ahinla Nethinim ho chu Ophel'a achengun, chule Ziha le Gispa chu Nethinim mite chunga lamkai ahiuve.
target: The temple servants lived on the hill of Ophel, and Ziha and Gishpa were in charge of them.

source: Jerusalem khopi-a Levi ho vaipo-a pangpa jong chu Vani chapa Uzzi, Hashabiah chapa, Mattaniah chapa, Micha chapa, ahiuve. Asaph chapate lasaho chu Pathen insunga natong lamkai ahiuve.
target: The chief officer of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mika. Uzzi was one of Asaph’s descendants, who were the musicians responsible for the service of the house of God.

source: Ajehchu amaho chungchanga lengpa thulhahna chu hichehi ahin, niseh-a lasaho dinga chan phabep umding ahi.
target: The musicians were under the king’s orders, which regulated their daily activity.

source: Judah chapa Zerah chate son lah-a Meshezabeel chapa Pethahiah chu mipi ho chungthu dola ijakaija lengpa thalhenga panga ahi.
target: Pethahiah son of Meshezabel, one of the descendants of Zerah son of Judah, was the king’s agent in all affairs relating to the people.

source: Chule khoholeh alouhou diuvin, Judah chate phabep chu Kirjath-arba le hiche khoho-a achengun, chule Dibon le asunga khohole, Jekabzeel le asunga khoho-a chun.
target: As for the villages with their fields, some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its surrounding settlements, in Dibon and its settlements, in Jekabzeel and its villages,

source: Chule Jeshua le Moladah chule Beth-phelet,
target: in Jeshua, in Moladah, in Beth Pelet,

source: Chule Hazar-shual, Beer-sheba le kho ho-achun,
target: in Hazar Shual, in Beersheba and its settlements,

source: Chule Ziklag, Mekonah'a chule kho ho-a,
target: in Ziklag, in Mekonah and its settlements,

source: Chule En-rimmon le Zovah ah chule Jarmuth'a,
target: in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,

source: Nanoah, Adullam chule akho houva Lachish le aloumun houva, Azekah le khoho-a chun achengun ahi. Chuin amaho Beersheba apatnin Hinnom gamgeijin achengun ahi.
target: Zanoah, Adullam and their villages, in Lachish and its fields, and in Azekah and its settlements. So they were living all the way from Beersheba to the Valley of Hinnom.

source: Chule Benjamin chate jongchu Geba apat, Michmash a achengun chule Aija, Bethel chule akhohouva,
target: The descendants of the Benjamites from Geba lived in Mikmash, Aija, Bethel and its settlements,

source: Chule Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
target: in Anathoth, Nob and Ananiah,

source: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
target: in Hazor, Ramah and Gittaim,

source: Hadid, Zeboiim, Neballat,
target: in Hadid, Zeboim and Neballat,

source: Lod le Ona khut themho phaichama achenguve.
target: in Lod and Ono, and in Ge Harashim.

source: Chule Levi ho chu Judah le Benjamin gama ahomkhen taovin, ahi.
target: Some of the divisions of the Levites of Judah settled in Benjamin.

source: Tun hichehohi Shealtiel chapa Zerubbabel le Jeshua toh kilhona chetouva thempuho le Levi hochu ahiuvin, Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra.
target: These were the priests and Levites who returned with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and with Joshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

source: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
target: Amariah, Malluk, Hattush,

source: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
target: Shekaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

source: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,
target: Iddo, Ginnethon, Abijah,

source: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
target: Mijamin, Moadiah, Bilgah,

source: Shemaiahle Jolarib, Jedaiah,
target: Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,

source: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. Hichehohi Jeshua nikho laija thempuho leh asopiho lah-a lamkai pipen ahiuve.
target: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah and Jedaiah. These were the leaders of the priests and their associates in the days of Joshua.

source: Hiche chungchon chun Levi ho, Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah le Mattaniah hi amale asopiho thangvah na-a lamkaijin apangun, ahi.
target: The Levites were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and also Mattaniah, who, together with his associates, was in charge of the songs of thanksgiving.

source: Bakbukiah le Unni chule asopite jong chu amaho vetupmin apanguve.
target: Bakbukiah and Unni, their associates, stood opposite them in the services.

source: Chule Jeshua'n Joiakim ahingin, Joiakim'in Eliashib ahinge, Chule Eliashib'in Joiada ahingin,
target: Joshua was the father of Joiakim, Joiakim the father of Eliashib, Eliashib the father of Joiada,

source: Chule Joiada'n Jonathan ahingin, Jonathan'in Jaddua ahingin ahi.
target: Joiada the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan the father of Jaddua.

source: Chule Joiakim nikho laija thempuho apateo luchangho chu: Seraiah, Meraiah; Jeremiah, Hananiah;
target: In the days of Joiakim, these were the heads of the priestly families: of Seraiah’s family, Meraiah; of Jeremiah’s, Hananiah;

source: Ezra, Meshullam, Amarian, Jehohanan:
target: of Ezra’s, Meshullam; of Amariah’s, Jehohanan;

source: Melicut, Jonathan, Shebaniah te, Joseph,
target: of Malluk’s, Jonathan; of Shekaniah’s, Joseph;

source: Harim te, Adna; Meraioth, Helkai,
target: of Harim’s, Adna; of Meremoth’s, Helkai;

source: Iddo te, Zekeriah, Ginnethon, Meshullam,
target: of Iddo’s, Zechariah; of Ginnethon’s, Meshullam;

source: Abiah, Zilchri, Miniamin, Moadiah, Piltai,
target: of Abijah’s, Zikri; of Miniamin’s and of Moadiah’s, Piltai;

source: Bilgah te, Shammua, Shemaiah, Jehonathan,
target: of Bilgah’s, Shammua; of Shemaiah’s, Jehonathan;

source: chule Joiarib, Mattenai, Jedaiah, Uzzi,
target: of Joiarib’s, Mattenai; of Jedaiah’s, Uzzi;

source: Sallai, Kallai, Amok te, Eber,
target: of Sallu’s, Kallai; of Amok’s, Eber;

source: Hilkiah, Hashabiah, Jedaiah, Nethaneel.
target: of Hilkiah’s, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah’s, Nethanel.

source: Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan chule Jaddua nikho laija Levi ho chu apateu pipuija ana kisunlut ahiuvin, Persia mi Darius in vaihom lah-a thempuho jong ahiuve.
target: The family heads of the Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan and Jaddua, as well as those of the priests, were recorded in the reign of Darius the Persian.

source: Levi chapate le apateu pipuiho chu Eliashib chapa Johanan nikho geijin thusimbua akijihlutsoh keijin ahi.
target: The family heads among the descendants of Levi up to the time of Johanan son of Eliashib were recorded in the book of the annals.

source: Chule Levi ho lamkai pipuiho chu, Hashabiah, Sherebiah, chule Kadmiel chapa Jashua le asopihotoh, Pathen mipa David thulhahna dungjuija vahchoina le thangvahna pedingin aloiloijin akilhauve.
target: And the leaders of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua son of Kadmiel, and their associates, who stood opposite them to give praise and thanksgiving, one section responding to the other, as prescribed by David the man of God.

source: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub hohi kotbula thilkeu koikhom nahole kotpi ngaho ahiuve.
target: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon and Akkub were gatekeepers who guarded the storerooms at the gates.

source: Hitehohi Jozadak chapa Jeshua chapa Joiakim nikho lai leh gam vaipo Nahemiah le Ezra thempu leh lekhasunpa nikholaija um anahiuve.
target: They served in the days of Joiakim son of Joshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and of Ezra the priest, the teacher of the Law.

source: Jerusalem kulbang thensona-a Jerusalem'a hung dingin Levi te chu kulbang chu kipahtah-a thenso ahina dingin selangdah, tumging, khutbeh, lasah le thuseidin aumnao munjouse-a konin aholdoh-un ahi.
target: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, the Levites were sought out from where they lived and were brought to Jerusalem to celebrate joyfully the dedication with songs of thanksgiving and with the music of cymbals, harps and lyres.

source: Chule lasa themho chapate chu Jerusalem le akimvel phaicham Netophah mi khoho-a konin ahung khomun.
target: The musicians also were brought together from the region around Jerusalem—from the villages of the Netophathites,

source: Chujongle Gilgal ina konle, Geba le Azmavath gama konin ahung kikhomun ahi. Ajehchu lasa hochun Jerusalem kimvella chun khoho anatungdoh-un ahi.
target: from Beth Gilgal, and from the area of Geba and Azmaveth, for the musicians had built villages for themselves around Jerusalem.

source: Chule Thempuho le Levi ho chu akisuthengun, chule mipihole kotpiho chule akul bangho chu asuthengun ahi.
target: When the priests and Levites had purified themselves ceremonially, they purified the people, the gates and the wall.

source: Chujouvin keiman Judah milenho chu kulbang chunga kapuidoh in, chule thangvahna pedingin loilentahtah nin kahom khenin, loikhat chu kulbang chunga ehkotpi jetlama chun acheuvin,
target: I had the leaders of Judah go up on top of the wall. I also assigned two large choirs to give thanks. One was to proceed on top of the wall to the right, toward the Dung Gate.

source: Amaho nunga hin Hoshaiah le Judah pipuiho akehkhat jen akitolun ahi.
target: Hoshaiah and half the leaders of Judah followed them,

source: Chule Azariah, Ezra le Meshullam,
target: along with Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,

source: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah chule Jeremiah,
target: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,

source: Chule sumkon choi thempu chate loikhat aminu chu Jonathan chapa Zekeriah, Mattaniah chapa, Michaiah chapa, Zaccur chapa, Asaph chapa,
target: as well as some priests with trumpets, and also Zechariah son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zakkur, the son of Asaph,

source: Chule Pathen mipa David tumging manchah chu asopiho Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, Hanani in akengun, chule lekhajihpa Ezra chu alamkaijin ahi.
target: and his associates—Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah and Hanani—with musical instruments prescribed by David the man of God. Ezra the teacher of the Law led the procession.

source: Amaho jonna um twinah kotpi phungle, kulbang jottouna David insahlam solamsang twi kotpi geile David khopi kalbia chun akaltouvun ahi.
target: At the Fountain Gate they continued directly up the steps of the City of David on the ascent to the wall and passed above the site of David’s palace to the Water Gate on the east.

source: Chule loichom dang thangvahna peho chu, amaho jong chu acheuvin, keima anunguva kachen, chule mipi akehkhat chu meilhum insang khella pat kulbang satah gei, bang chunga chun acheuvin,
target: The second choir proceeded in the opposite direction. I followed them on top of the wall, together with half the people—past the Tower of the Ovens to the Broad Wall,

source: Chule Ephraim kotpi chunga kotpilen chungah, chule Hananeel insanglen Maah insanga pat kelngoi kotkhah geijin acheuvin, chuin amaho songkul kotpi-a chun adingdenun ahi.
target: over the Gate of Ephraim, the Jeshanah Gate, the Fish Gate, the Tower of Hananel and the Tower of the Hundred, as far as the Sheep Gate. At the Gate of the Guard they stopped.

source: Hitichun keimale Pathen ina thangvahna peho loini hole, kaum khompi vaihomho akehkhat chu kadingun,
target: The two choirs that gave thanks then took their places in the house of God; so did I, together with half the officials,

source: Chule sumkon choija thempuho chu Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zekeriah, chule Hananiah,
target: as well as the priests—Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah and Hananiah with their trumpets—

source: Chule Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam chule Ezer ahiuve. Chule la saho chun avaipopao Jezrahiah toh hatah-in asaove.
target: and also Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malkijah, Elam and Ezer. The choirs sang under the direction of Jezrahiah.

source: Chujongle hicheni chun ganlhaina loupitah ho atoh un, akipah thanomun ahi. Ajehchu Pathen'in amaho chu kipana lentah in akipa sah-in ajite houle achateu hojong akipah thanom mun, hitichun Jerusalem kipana chu gamlatah in jong akijan ahi.
target: And on that day they offered great sacrifices, rejoicing because God had given them great joy. The women and children also rejoiced. The sound of rejoicing in Jerusalem could be heard far away.

source: Chule hichepet laichun, loujaoho lah-a le khopiho-a danthupeh dungjuija thempuho le Levi ho chan ga masaho, thiltoho, hopsom ho thil kholna indan ho-a, kholkhom din mi phabep akipansah-e. Ajehchu thempuho leh Levi ho kinboljeh chun Judah akipah thanomin ahi.
target: At that time men were appointed to be in charge of the storerooms for the contributions, firstfruits and tithes. From the fields around the towns they were to bring into the storerooms the portions required by the Law for the priests and the Levites, for Judah was pleased with the ministering priests and Levites.

source: Chule David le achapa Solomon thulhahna dungjuijin, a-Pathen dinguva natoh peh dandingle kisuh thengna dan chu lasaloile kotngah hon jong ajopmun ahi.
target: They performed the service of their God and the service of purification, as did also the musicians and gatekeepers, according to the commands of David and his son Solomon.

source: Ajehchu malai David le Asaph nikho laijin, lasaloi lamkaile Pathen vahchoina le pachatna lasa ana umin ahi.
target: For long ago, in the days of David and Asaph, there had been directors for the musicians and for the songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.

source: Chule Zerubbabel le Nehemiah nikho laijin Israel jouse lasa holeh kotngah hochu niseh-in achan dolu ana pejiuvin ahi. Chule thiltheng hochu Levi hodin asuthengun, chule Levi hon hicheho chu Aaron chate dingin asuthengun ahi.
target: So in the days of Zerubbabel and of Nehemiah, all Israel contributed the daily portions for the musicians and the gatekeepers. They also set aside the portion for the other Levites, and the Levites set aside the portion for the descendants of Aaron.

source: Hiche nikho chun mipi hetdin Mosi lekhabu asimun, chule chuachun Ammon miteleh Moab mite chu Pathen houkhom ho lah-a a-itih-a pangthei loudiu ahi tia kisun asimdoh uve.
target: On that day the Book of Moses was read aloud in the hearing of the people and there it was found written that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever be admitted into the assembly of God,

source: Ajehchu amahon Israel chate chu changlhah leh twisih-in analamto pouvin, ahinla amaho douna-a gaosapdin Balaam athalah-un ahijeng vangin ka Pathen'un gaosapna chu phattheina in aheidoh tai.
target: because they had not met the Israelites with food and water but had hired Balaam to call a curse down on them. (Our God, however, turned the curse into a blessing.)

source: Tun ahitin ahi, amahon danthupeh chu ajah phatnun, Israel te-a konin mipi choplopho jouse chu asepkhen taovin ahi.
target: When the people heard this law, they excluded from Israel all who were of foreign descent.

source: Chule hiche masanghin, ka Pathen'u indan sungnung vetupjing, Eliaship thempupa chu Tobiah toh akithujop lhonin,
target: Before this, Eliashib the priest had been put in charge of the storerooms of the house of our God. He was closely associated with Tobiah,

source: Chule Levi ho, lasaho chule kotngah ho peh dinga kithu lhahna thao, lengpitwi thah, mimle chang hopsom ho, um le bel, begole nehding thilpehho, chule thempuho dinga thiltoho, tumasanga anakoinau indan lentah chu amadin agonpeh-in ahi.
target: and he had provided him with a large room formerly used to store the grain offerings and incense and temple articles, and also the tithes of grain, new wine and olive oil prescribed for the Levites, musicians and gatekeepers, as well as the contributions for the priests.

source: Ahinla hiche phatlai hin keima Jerusalem'a kana umpoi. Babylon leng Artaxerxes kum somthumle kum ni alengchan kum-in lengpa henga kachen, chule ni ijat-ham jouvin lengpa-a konin phalna kamun ahi.
target: But while all this was going on, I was not in Jerusalem, for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I had returned to the king. Some time later I asked his permission

source: Chuin Jerusalem'a kahungin, chule Pathen in hongsung ho-a amadinga indan khat agonpeh-a, Eliashib min Tobiah'a dinga thildih lou abolchu kahechen tan ahi.
target: and came back to Jerusalem. Here I learned about the evil thing Eliashib had done in providing Tobiah a room in the courts of the house of God.

source: Chule hichun eisulungna behsetnin, hijeh chun keiman indan sunga konin Tobiah insang thilkeu jouse chu kapaidoh tan ahi.
target: I was greatly displeased and threw all Tobiah’s household goods out of the room.

source: Chuin gihna thu kapen, amahon indan chu asutheng taove. Chule keiman hia chun Pathen in'a um le bel holeh anneh thiltoho chule bego chu kahinpolut kit tai.
target: I gave orders to purify the rooms, and then I put back into them the equipment of the house of God, with the grain offerings and the incense.

source: Chuin keiman Levi ho chandingdol hochu akipe pouve ti kahedohtan ahi. Hijeh chun Levi ho le lasaloi chu ama ama honlam cheh-a anajamtaovin ahi.
target: I also learned that the portions assigned to the Levites had not been given to them, and that all the Levites and musicians responsible for the service had gone back to their own fields.

source: Chujouvin keiman vaihomho chu kanelkalin, ipidinga Pathen in hi kimoh dalhahthip jingaham? chuin amaho chu kakou khomin, ama ama panmun cheh-a kapansah kit tai.
target: So I rebuked the officials and asked them, “Why is the house of God neglected?” Then I called them together and stationed them at their posts.

source: Chujouvin Judah jousen changle mim chule lengpitwi thah le thao hopsom chu thilkholna-a ahinpolut nun ahi.
target: All Judah brought the tithes of grain, new wine and olive oil into the storerooms.

source: Chuin keiman thilkholna ho chunga thilkhol ding kasemin, Shelemiah thempu, danthusun Zadok, Levi ho le Pedaiah, chule amaho bana chu Mattaniah chapa, Zaccur chapa Hanan ahi. Ajehchu amaho chu tahsan detna kisima, chule amaho natohna munchu asopiteu kihoppeh ding ahi.
target: I put Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the scribe, and a Levite named Pedaiah in charge of the storerooms and made Hanan son of Zakkur, the son of Mattaniah, their assistant, because they were considered trustworthy. They were made responsible for distributing the supplies to their fellow Levites.

source: Vo, ka Pathen hiche chungchanga hin neihe jingin, chule ka Pathen in'a dingle hiche tohmun ho-a dinga thilpha kanabol hochu noimang hih-in.
target: Remember me for this, my God, and do not blot out what I have so faithfully done for the house of my God and its services.

source: Hichelai hin Judah gamsunga choldo nikho-a lengpiga achiluva, changphal ahinpoh uva, sangan apohsah-u, lengpitwi le lengpiga hihen, theichang ga hihen, pohgih tincheng apohsah uva, choldoni-a Jerusalem sunga ahinpoh lutjiu kamun ahi. Chuin hiche nikho-a nehle chah ajohjeh-un amaho dounan kaphoh sal-in, ahi.
target: In those days I saw people in Judah treading winepresses on the Sabbath and bringing in grain and loading it on donkeys, together with wine, grapes, figs and all other kinds of loads. And they were bringing all this into Jerusalem on the Sabbath. Therefore I warned them against selling food on that day.

source: Hiche mun'a cheng Tyre mihojong chun, nga leh johthei thil namkim ahinpouvin, Judah le Jerusalem chate henga choldonin ahungjoh jiuvin ahi.
target: People from Tyre who lived in Jerusalem were bringing in fish and all kinds of merchandise and selling them in Jerusalem on the Sabbath to the people of Judah.

source: Chujouvin keiman Judah milen milal hochu kanelkalin, ajah uvah, ipidinga hitobang thilphalou nabol uva, choldoni hi asuhboh-u ham? kati.
target: I rebuked the nobles of Judah and said to them, “What is this wicked thing you are doing—desecrating the Sabbath day?

source: Napateu vin hitobanghi anaboluva, i Pathen'un hiche thilphalou jousehi eihole hiche khopi chunga analhunsah hilou? hijongle choldoni nasuhboh naova konin Israel chunga lunghanna nahin pohlutbe nalaijun ahi.
target: Didn’t your ancestors do the same things, so that our God brought all this calamity on us and on this city? Now you are stirring up more wrath against Israel by desecrating the Sabbath.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, choldoni masanga Jerusalem kotpiho-a muthim ahungkipat jouseh le khachah-a, chule choldoni kichai kahse-a honlouna dingin gihna thu kapen ahi. Chule choldoni-a thilpoh kiti apohlut louna dingun kasohho phabep khat kotpiho-a kakoijin ahi.
target: When evening shadows fell on the gates of Jerusalem before the Sabbath, I ordered the doors to be shut and not opened until the Sabbath was over. I stationed some of my own men at the gates so that no load could be brought in on the Sabbath day.

source: Hitichun akivei holeh thil jatchom chom joh hochu khatveiham? nivei ham? Jerusalem polama chun ageh khovah dentauve.
target: Once or twice the merchants and sellers of all kinds of goods spent the night outside Jerusalem.

source: Chujouvin, keiman amaho dounan kahettohsah-in, ajah uvah, ipidinga nanghohi kulbang vela geh nahiuvem? Hitobanga nabolkit ule, nachung uva khut kalhahding ahi, katipeh-e. Hichea patchun amahon choldonin ahungkit tapouve.
target: But I warned them and said, “Why do you spend the night by the wall? If you do this again, I will arrest you.” From that time on they no longer came on the Sabbath.

source: Chuin keiman Levi ho chu amaho akisuh thenguva, chule hunguva kotpiho chu anga uva, choldoni sutheng dingin thupeh kapen, ahi. O ka Pathen, hiche chungchanga jonghin neihejingin lang, nahepina lentah dungjuijin neihing hoijin.
target: Then I commanded the Levites to purify themselves and go and guard the gates in order to keep the Sabbath day holy. Remember me for this also, my God, and show mercy to me according to your great love.

source: Hiche nikholai jong chun Judah mite chun, Ashdod mite, Ammon mite Moab miho ji-a aneiju kamun ahi.
target: Moreover, in those days I saw men of Judah who had married women from Ashdod, Ammon and Moab.

source: Chule Judah te pao ahekhenthem pouvin, ahinla mipi ho pao dungjui cheh-in, achateu apaodoh tengule akeh khatnin Ashdod pao amangun, ahi.
target: Half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod or the language of one of the other peoples, and did not know how to speak the language of Judah.

source: Chule ken amaho chu kakinelpi, kasamsen, abang bangjong kadengin, asamu kabopeh-in, nachanu teochu achapa teodinga napehloudiu, ahiloule nachapateo dinga achanuteu napuipeh loudiu, nangho tah-in jong nabol loudiu ahi, tin Pathen'a kaki hahsel sah-in ahi.
target: I rebuked them and called curses down on them. I beat some of the men and pulled out their hair. I made them take an oath in God’s name and said: “You are not to give your daughters in marriage to their sons, nor are you to take their daughters in marriage for your sons or for yourselves.

source: Israel leng Solomon jongchu hiche thil ho-a hi anachonsea hilouham? Pathen'in Israelte chunga Leng din anapansah-in, ama tobanga Pathen'in angailut lengdang namtin vaipi lah-a anaum khapoi: Hitajeng jongleh namdang numei hon amajeng jong chonsetnan alhahsah-un ahi.
target: Was it not because of marriages like these that Solomon king of Israel sinned? Among the many nations there was no king like him. He was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel, but even he was led into sin by foreign women.

source: Gamchom numei ho kichenpia ka Pathen douna-a suhkhel dinga, hiche thil phalouho boldinga nathu-u kangai dingu ham?
target: Must we hear now that you too are doing all this terrible wickedness and are being unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women?”

source: Thempu chungnung Eliashib chapa Joiada chapate khat chu Horon mi Sanballat tupa ahin, hijeh chun keiman amahi keija konin kanomangtai.
target: One of the sons of Joiada son of Eliashib the high priest was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite. And I drove him away from me.

source: Vo, ka Pathen amahohi hejing temin, ajehchu amahon themputna kin chule thempu hina-a kitepna le Levi kitepna asubohtauve.
target: Remember them, my God, because they defiled the priestly office and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites.

source: Hitichun keiman gamdang mite akonin amaho kasuthengin, thempuho leh Levi dinga anatoh ding dolcheh-u leh anatoh ding danu kagot peh-in ahi.
target: So I purified the priests and the Levites of everything foreign, and assigned them duties, each to his own task.

source: Akitepsa phatho-a thing toh dingle, aga masapen peding kagot toh peh-in ahi. Vo ka Pathen aphalam thila dingin nelheng jingin.
target: I also made provision for contributions of wood at designated times, and for the firstfruits. Remember me with favor, my God.

source: Tun Ahasuerus nikho laijin ahung hitin ahi, (hiche Ahasuerus hi India'a kona Ethiopia changei gamkai jakhatle somni le sagi chunga analeng changin ahi)
target: This is what happened during the time of Xerxes, the Xerxes who ruled over 127 provinces stretching from India to Cush:

source: Chuche laichun, Shushan'a um leng inpia Ahasuerus lengpa alenggam laltouna-a atoujin,
target: At that time King Xerxes reigned from his royal throne in the citadel of Susa,

source: Alengchan kal kumthum channa-in, aman pipuiho le asohho jouse dingin golvah abolin; Persia le Media thaneina, gamkai pipuiho, chule milenho chu amasanga aumuvin;
target: and in the third year of his reign he gave a banquet for all his nobles and officials. The military leaders of Persia and Media, the princes, and the nobles of the provinces were present.

source: Chule aman alenggam loupitah haona, chule alal loupina nasatah jabola aumna chu nikho tamtah, nijakhat le nisomget sungin avetsah-in ahi.
