target: For a full 180 days he displayed the vast wealth of his kingdom and the splendor and glory of his majesty.

source: Chuin hiche nikhoho chu akichai phatnin, lengpan leng inpi honsunga chun alen aneo khenlouvin, Shushan leng inpia mi jouse chu nisagi golnop abolpin;
target: When these days were over, the king gave a banquet, lasting seven days, in the enclosed garden of the king’s palace, for all the people from the least to the greatest who were in the citadel of Susa.

source: Hia chun akang, a-engle aduma kisem pondal ho chu, tupat patngat le dangka sumkola akikhaijin, chule songval khompi ho-a chun akihenin; chule sanale dangka-a kisem tounaho chu songlhongnal sanpeh, adum, akang, avoma kisemho chunga chun akidon ahi.
target: The garden had hangings of white and blue linen, fastened with cords of white linen and purple material to silver rings on marble pillars. There were couches of gold and silver on a mosaic pavement of porphyry, marble, mother-of-pearl and other costly stones.

source: Chuin amahon amaho chu sana khonin leng ju chu adon diuvin ahomun, (akhonho chu achomcheh ahi,) chule lenggam kipohna dungjuijin, ju aneng jengjung jengin ahi.
target: Wine was served in goblets of gold, each one different from the other, and the royal wine was abundant, in keeping with the king’s liberality.

source: Chule hichea adonu chu dan dungjuija kibol ahin; koima acham louva kibol aumpoi: ajehchu lengpan amijouse chu amacheh dei dungjuija abolpeh dinguva a-in'a vaipoho chu athupeh cheh ahi.
target: By the king’s command each guest was allowed to drink with no restrictions, for the king instructed all the wine stewards to serve each man what he wished.

source: Chule lengnu Vashti jong chun lengpa Ahasuerus leng inpia chun, numei umjouse chu golnop abolpin ahi.
target: Queen Vashti also gave a banquet for the women in the royal palace of King Xerxes.

source: Nisagi lhin ni-a, lengpan ju adona alung akipa petnin, aman Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, chule Abagtha Zethar, chule Carcas, Ahasuerus anga kinbol nukiso sagiho chu asolin,
target: On the seventh day, when King Xerxes was in high spirits from wine, he commanded the seven eunuchs who served him—Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar and Karkas—

source: Lengnu Vashti chu melhoitah ahijeh-in, mipile milenho vetsah dinga, aleng lukhuh puma lengpa anga ahinpui dingun thu apen ahi.
target: to bring before him Queen Vashti, wearing her royal crown, in order to display her beauty to the people and nobles, for she was lovely to look at.

source: Ahivangin Vashti lengnu chu anukisoho-a kona leng thupeh-a hungding chu anompon; hijeh chun lengpa alung ahangtan, alungsa tuntun jengin ahi.
target: But when the attendants delivered the king’s command, Queen Vashti refused to come. Then the king became furious and burned with anger.

source: Chuphatnin lengpan michingho, phat umchan hethemho henga chun aseijin, (ajehchu dan le thutanje heho chungchanga lengpa umdan ngai mong ahi.
target: Since it was customary for the king to consult experts in matters of law and justice, he spoke with the wise men who understood the times

source: Chule ama bantah-a hochu Persia le Media'a milen sagiho Carshena, Shethar, Admathah, Tarshish, Meres, Mersena, chule Memucan ahiuvin, amaho chu lengpa angsunga lutmasapen le lenggam sunga alenpenho ahiuvin ahi;)
target: and were closest to the king—Karshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena and Memukan, the seven nobles of Persia and Media who had special access to the king and were highest in the kingdom.

source: Ahasuerus lengpan nukiso ho-a kona apeh thupeh amanun anittah loujeh-a, dan dungjuija Vashti lengnu chunga ipi ibol diu hitam? tin adonge.
target: “According to law, what must be done to Queen Vashti?” he asked. “She has not obeyed the command of King Xerxes that the eunuchs have taken to her.”

source: Chuin Memucan'in lengpa le pipuiho anga chun adonbutnin, lengnu Vashti in lengpa heng seh-a dihloutah abol hilouvin, Ahasuerus lengpa gamkai jouse-a, milen jousele mipi jouse chunga jong abolkhel ahi.
target: Then Memukan replied in the presence of the king and the nobles, “Queen Vashti has done wrong, not only against the king but also against all the nobles and the peoples of all the provinces of King Xerxes.

source: Ajehchu Ahasuerus lengpan, Vashti lengnu amasanga hinpuidia thupeh apehle, amanu ahungpon ahi ti thuhi ahung kiseison tengle, lengnu natoh hi numei ho jousen hin hedoh-untin, amahon amitmuva ajiteu chu ajalou dingu ahitai.
target: For the queen’s conduct will become known to all the women, and so they will despise their husbands and say, ‘King Xerxes commanded Queen Vashti to be brought before him, but she would not come.’

source: Hiche banga chu Persia le Media'a numei ho lengnu thilbol jajouse chun lengpa pipuiho jouse henga chu lengnu natoh ajah-u chu aseidingu ahi. Hitia chu kitaitom nale lunghana tamtah sohdoh ding ahi.
target: This very day the Persian and Median women of the nobility who have heard about the queen’s conduct will respond to all the king’s nobles in the same way. There will be no end of disrespect and discord.

source: Lengpa lunglam ahile, Vashti chu Ahasuerus lengpa masanga hunglut talou ding ahi tin ama-a konin leng thupeh khat sohdoh hen, chule hichu khelkit tahlou dingin Media le Persia dan lah-a kisunlut hen; chule lengpan lengnu mun chu ama sanga phajo dangkhat pehen.
target: “Therefore, if it pleases the king, let him issue a royal decree and let it be written in the laws of Persia and Media, which cannot be repealed, that Vashti is never again to enter the presence of King Xerxes. Also let the king give her royal position to someone else who is better than she.

source: Chule aman apeh ding leng thupeh chu alenggam pumpi-a akiphon dohteng (ajeh chu lenggam chu lentah hija ahi), numei jousen ajiteu chu alen hihen aneo hijongle jana apehcheh dingu ahi, ati.
target: Then when the king’s edict is proclaimed throughout all his vast realm, all the women will respect their husbands, from the least to the greatest.”

source: Chuin kithumopna hin lengpa le pipuiho chu alung lhaisah lheh-in; chule Memucan thusei dungjui chun lengpan aboltai.
target: The king and his nobles were pleased with this advice, so the king did as Memukan proposed.

source: Hitichun lengpan gamkaiho jouse-a, agamkai jouse alekhajem cheh uva, amitakip apao cheh-un, Pasal tinin a-insung cheh-a vai ahom cheh dingu ahi tin, amitakip pao dungjuija phonjal dingin lekha athottan ahi.
target: He sent dispatches to all parts of the kingdom, to each province in its own script and to each people in their own language, proclaiming that every man should be ruler over his own household, using his native tongue.

source: Hiche hojouse nung, lengpa Ahasuerus alunghan na-a kon alungdam phatnin, Vashti le athilbol, chule achunga thupeh ho chu ahin geldoh-in ahi.
target: Later when King Xerxes’ fury had subsided, he remembered Vashti and what she had done and what he had decreed about her.

source: Chuin ajenlea pang asohho chun lengpa henga, Lengpa-a dingin nungah theng donglai melhoi kiholpeh hen:
target: Then the king’s personal attendants proposed, “Let a search be made for beautiful young virgins for the king.

source: Chule nungah theng donglai melhoiho jouse chu leng inpi Shushan'a, numei ho chingpa lengpa nukiso Hegai vettupna-a, numei ho umna in'a kholkhom dingin, lengpan alenggama gamkai jouse sunga vaipoho pansah hen. Chule amaho chu akisuhtheng nadinguva khoh thilho chu kipehen.
target: Let the king appoint commissioners in every province of his realm to bring all these beautiful young women into the harem at the citadel of Susa. Let them be placed under the care of Hegai, the king’s eunuch, who is in charge of the women; and let beauty treatments be given to them.

source: Chule lengpa lunglhaina penpen nungah chu lengnu Vashti khel hihen, atiuve. Chule lengpan hichu pha asan, hitichun aboltai.
target: Then let the young woman who pleases the king be queen instead of Vashti.” This advice appealed to the king, and he followed it.

source: Tun Shushan leng inpi sunga chun Juda mi khat aumin, amin Mordecai akitin, Jair chapa, Shimei chapa, Kish chapa Benjamin mi ahin;
target: Now there was in the citadel of Susa a Jew of the tribe of Benjamin, named Mordecai son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish,

source: Amahi Jerusalem'a kona Jeconiah toh kilhona sohchang dinga Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in anapoh mangho lah-a chu jao ahi.
target: who had been carried into exile from Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, among those taken captive with Jehoiachin king of Judah.

source: Chule aman apangah chanu Hadassah, hichu Esther ahin, ahin khoukhah-in ahi: ajehchu amanu nulepa neilou ahin, chule nungahnu chu vetnom umle melhoitah ahi; Mordecai'in anu le apa thi nunga ama chanu dinga akilah ahi.
target: Mordecai had a cousin named Hadassah, whom he had brought up because she had neither father nor mother. This young woman, who was also known as Esther, had a lovely figure and was beautiful. Mordecai had taken her as his own daughter when her father and mother died.

source: Chuin ahung hitin ahi, lengpa thupeh le thuphondoh chu jah ahi-a, Shushan leng inpi-a nungah tampi Hagai vetsuina noija khopkhom ahi phatnin, Esther jong chu lengpa in'a numei ho vesuipa Hagai vetsui ding chun ahinpui taovin ahi.
target: When the king’s order and edict had been proclaimed, many young women were brought to the citadel of Susa and put under the care of Hegai. Esther also was taken to the king’s palace and entrusted to Hegai, who had charge of the harem.

source: Hiche nungahnu chun amapa chu alunglhaisah lheh-in, amapa hepina achangtan ahi; hijeh chun amapan akisuh thengna dinga thil ngaikhoh ho, achan dinga thil kigotpeh ho, chule leng inpia kona amanu jenleding nungah sagi kipeho chu amanu apeloi jengin: chule aman amanu le ajenleding numei ho chu numei ho in'a mun phalai pena chun akoitan ahi.
target: She pleased him and won his favor. Immediately he provided her with her beauty treatments and special food. He assigned to her seven female attendants selected from the king’s palace and moved her and her attendants into the best place in the harem.

source: Esther'in vang amitele a-inkoho aseidohpon ahi: ajehchu Mordecai'in amanu henga seidoh hih-in tia aseipeh masah ahi.
target: Esther had not revealed her nationality and family background, because Mordecai had forbidden her to do so.

source: Chule nisehle Mordecai chu numei ho umna in hong maija chun Esther iti uma, achungchanga ipi hungsoh doh dingham ti hetnadin avahle jingin ahi.
target: Every day he walked back and forth near the courtyard of the harem to find out how Esther was and what was happening to her.

source: Tun numei ho umdan dungjuija lhasomle lhani alhin jou chun, nungah ho chu leng Ahasuerus anga akilutlhah lhahdiu nikho ahung lhungtan ahi, (ajeh chu akisuhtheng nao nikho lhinga ahitan, lhagup myrrh thao kinu uva, lhagupma gimnamtui le numei ho kisuhthengna thildangho kinu uva ahi).
target: Before a young woman’s turn came to go in to King Xerxes, she had to complete twelve months of beauty treatments prescribed for the women, six months with oil of myrrh and six with perfumes and cosmetics.

source: Hitichun nungah ho jouse chu lengpa anga ahunguvin; chule numei khatcheh chu numei ho umna in'a kona lengpa in'a ache tengle adeichan chu akipe jin ahi.
target: And this is how she would go to the king: Anything she wanted was given her to take with her from the harem to the king’s palace.

source: Nilhahle lutji-a, ajingle numei umna in nina, thaikem ho vetuppa lengpa nukisopa Shaashgaz vetsuina-a umdingin akile kitjin ahi. Amanu chu achunga lengpan lunglhaina aneija, amina akou tilouva lengpa henga avela lutkit talou ahi.
target: In the evening she would go there and in the morning return to another part of the harem to the care of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch who was in charge of the concubines. She would not return to the king unless he was pleased with her and summoned her by name.

source: Tun achanu dinga hinkivahdoh, Mordecai pangah Abigail chanu Esther, lengpa henga alutna ding phat ahunglhun phatnin, numei ho vetuppa lengpa nukisopa Hagai'in agot teho tailou amanun imacha dang angaichapoi. Chule Esther chu ama hinvaho jouse mitmun lungsetna achangin ahi.
target: When the turn came for Esther (the young woman Mordecai had adopted, the daughter of his uncle Abihail) to go to the king, she asked for nothing other than what Hegai, the king’s eunuch who was in charge of the harem, suggested. And Esther won the favor of everyone who saw her.

source: Hitichun alengchan kum sagi chana, lhasom channa, Tebeth lha-a chun lengpa Ahasuerus leng inpi sunga Esther chu ahin puilut taovin ahi.
target: She was taken to King Xerxes in the royal residence in the tenth month, the month of Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

source: Chuin lengpan numei dangho jouse sangin Esther angailu penin, nungah theng dangho jouse sangin amitmun lungsetna le khotona achangtan ahi; hijeh chun aman amanu chu lallukhuh akhuh peh-in, Vashti khelin lengnun apansah tai.
target: Now the king was attracted to Esther more than to any of the other women, and she won his favor and approval more than any of the other virgins. So he set a royal crown on her head and made her queen instead of Vashti.

source: Chujouvin lengpan pipuiho jousele asohte din golvah loupitah, Esther golvah ngei chu abolin; gamkaiho-a choldona aphongdoh-in, lengpa gamkai dungjuijin thilpehho apen ahi.
target: And the king gave a great banquet, Esther’s banquet, for all his nobles and officials. He proclaimed a holiday throughout the provinces and distributed gifts with royal liberality.

source: Chule aniveina-a nungahthengho chu akikhopkhom phatnun, Mordecai chu lengpa kotpi bulla atouvin ahi.
target: When the virgins were assembled a second time, Mordecai was sitting at the king’s gate.

source: Hiche geichun Esther'in Mordecai'in ahilna bangin, aphungle amite chu aseidohpon ahi. Ajehchu aman ahin vahlai bangbanga Esther'in Mordecai thupeh angai ahi.
target: But Esther had kept secret her family background and nationality just as Mordecai had told her to do, for she continued to follow Mordecai’s instructions as she had done when he was bringing her up.

source: Hiche nikholai, Mordecai chu lengpa kotpi bula atouji laichun, lengpa kotngah ho lah-a nukiso mini Bigthan le Teresh chu alunghang lhontan, leng Ahasuerus chunga khut lhah ding ago lhontan ahi.
target: During the time Mordecai was sitting at the king’s gate, Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king’s officers who guarded the doorway, became angry and conspired to assassinate King Xerxes.

source: Chuin thil umdan chu Mordecai'in ahetan, aman lengnu Esther ahilin; chule Esther'in Mordecai minin lengpa henga ahetchen sahtan ahi.
target: But Mordecai found out about the plot and told Queen Esther, who in turn reported it to the king, giving credit to Mordecai.

source: Chuin hiche thu chu akikholtoh phatnin, atahbeh ahi akihechentan, hijeh chun anilhonin thinga akhailih taovin ahi. Chuin hichu thusimbua lengpa masanga akisunlut tan ahi.
target: And when the report was investigated and found to be true, the two officials were impaled on poles. All this was recorded in the book of the annals in the presence of the king.

source: Hicheng jouhin Ahasuerus lengpan Agag mi Hammedatha chapa Haman chu apanmun akalsah in, amasotsah in, chule apipui chankhompi jouse chungvuma touna adopehtan ahi.
target: After these events, King Xerxes honored Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, elevating him and giving him a seat of honor higher than that of all the other nobles.

source: Chule Lengpa kotpi phunga um asohte jouse akunun, Haman chu jana apeovin ahi: ajehchu lengpan ama thudola hitia chu thu apeh ahi. Ahin Mordecai vang kun jong akunpon, jana jong apepoi.
target: All the royal officials at the king’s gate knelt down and paid honor to Haman, for the king had commanded this concerning him. But Mordecai would not kneel down or pay him honor.

source: Chuin lengpa kotpi phunga um soh ho chun Mordecai henga, ibola leng thupeh nasuhkhel ham? atiuvin ahi.
target: Then the royal officials at the king’s gate asked Mordecai, “Why do you disobey the king’s command?”

source: Tun ahitin ahi, amahon ajah-a niseh-a asei seijuva, aman angaipeh lou phatnun, amahon Mordecai thu ache achelou hetnadin, Haman ahiltaove: ajehchu aman amaho henga Judah mi kahi tin aseijin ahi.
target: Day after day they spoke to him but he refused to comply. Therefore they told Haman about it to see whether Mordecai’s behavior would be tolerated, for he had told them he was a Jew.

source: Chuin Haman'in Mordecai chu kunjong akunlouva, chule jana jong apehlou chu amudoh phatnin, Haman chu lunghan na-in adimtan ahi.
target: When Haman saw that Mordecai would not kneel down or pay him honor, he was enraged.

source: Chuin aman Mordecai chungseh seh-a khut lhading chu imalouvin ageltan ahi; ajehchu amahon Mordecai jat mite chu ama ahetsah-u ahitai. Hiche jehchun Haman'in Ahasuerus gamsung pumpi-a Mordecai mite, Judah ho jouse chu suhmanghel ding agotan ahi.
target: Yet having learned who Mordecai’s people were, he scorned the idea of killing only Mordecai. Instead Haman looked for a way to destroy all Mordecai’s people, the Jews, throughout the whole kingdom of Xerxes.

source: Ahasuerus lengchan kal kum somle kumni lhinna-a, lha masapen, hichu Nisan lha ahin, amahon Haman angsunga pur kiti vangvetna khat, ani anin, chule alha alhan, lhasomle lhani channa, Adar lha geichun, asang asang jengun ahi.
target: In the twelfth year of King Xerxes, in the first month, the month of Nisan, the pur (that is, the lot) was cast in the presence of Haman to select a day and month. And the lot fell on the twelfth month, the month of Adar.

source: Chuin Haman'in lengpa Ahasuerus henga, Nalenggam sung gamkai jouse mipi ho lah-a hin namkhat kithecheh-a le vahcheh-a aumun; chule adan uchu mijouse-a toh akitohpon; chule lengpa dan jong anit pouvin ahi. Hijeh chun amaho nomlhat sah ding chu lengpa dinga phatchomna bei ahi.
target: Then Haman said to King Xerxes, “There is a certain people dispersed among the peoples in all the provinces of your kingdom who keep themselves separate. Their customs are different from those of all other people, and they do not obey the king’s laws; it is not in the king’s best interest to tolerate them.

source: Lengpa lunglam ahile, amaho chu suhmang ding ahi tin kisunhen: chule keiman chuche tong dinga nganseho khutna chun, lengpa goukhol na-a din dangka talent sangsom penge, ati.
target: If it pleases the king, let a decree be issued to destroy them, and I will give ten thousand talents of silver to the king’s administrators for the royal treasury.”

source: Chuin lengpan akhutna konin akhutjem aladoh-in, Judah te melmapa, Agag mi Hammedatha chapa Haman chu apetan ahi.
target: So the king took his signet ring from his finger and gave it to Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of the Jews.

source: Chuin lengpan Haman henga, dangka le miho chu naphatsah sah-a nabol dinga kipehdoh nahitai ati.
target: “Keep the money,” the king said to Haman, “and do with the people as you please.”

source: Chuin lha masapen nisomle nithum lhin nin, lengpa lekhasunho chu akikou khomin, Haman thupeh dungjuijin, lengpa gal lamkaiho heng, gamkai jouse-a vaipoho heng, chule gamkai tina mipi chunga vaihomho henga alekha jem-u dungjui cheh le apaovu dungjui cheh-in Ahasuerus lengpa minin thupeh khat asunun, lengpa khutjem chu anam khumun ahi.
target: Then on the thirteenth day of the first month the royal secretaries were summoned. They wrote out in the script of each province and in the language of each people all Haman’s orders to the king’s satraps, the governors of the various provinces and the nobles of the various peoples. These were written in the name of King Xerxes himself and sealed with his own ring.

source: Chule lha somle lhani na, hichu Adar lha ahin, ni somle nithum ni lhin nikho leh, nikhat sunga, Juda te jouse khangdong le tehse, chapang le numei ho abonuva suhmang ding, thading, suhgamhel ding, chule anei agou jouseu chomgamhel dingin, lekhathot ho chu lengpa gamkai jouse-a lekhapole ho-a konin akithot tan ahi.
target: Dispatches were sent by couriers to all the king’s provinces with the order to destroy, kill and annihilate all the Jews—young and old, women and children—on a single day, the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar, and to plunder their goods.

source: Chuche nikho-a dinga akigot chehna dinguva, hiche lekha chu mijouse-a dinga kisun ahito lhonin, hichu sutsona gamkai jouse-a dan banga mijouse henga phondoh dinga thupeh ahi.
target: A copy of the text of the edict was to be issued as law in every province and made known to the people of every nationality so they would be ready for that day.

source: Lengpa dinga athupeh dungjuijin lekhaho chu gangtah-in akihomdoh tan; chule thuphondoh chu leng inpi Shushan'a phondoh-in aumtai. Chuin lengpa le Haman chu judon dingin atoulhonin, ahinla Shushan khopi sung chu alungdong gamtaove.
target: The couriers went out, spurred on by the king’s command, and the edict was issued in the citadel of Susa. The king and Haman sat down to drink, but the city of Susa was bewildered.

source: Mordecai'in thil kibol jouse amudoh phatnin, Mordecai'in apon jouse abotkeh-in, khaodip pon akiselin vut akinun, khopi sung laitah-a ahungdoh-in, hatah le lungna tah-in akapmin;
target: When Mordecai learned of all that had been done, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and ashes, and went out into the city, wailing loudly and bitterly.

source: Chule lengpa kotpi chan geijin ahunge: ajehchu khaodip pon kisila chu koimacha lengpa kotpi-a luttheilou ahi.
target: But he went only as far as the king’s gate, because no one clothed in sackcloth was allowed to enter it.

source: Chule gamkai jouse-a, lengpa thupeh le thuphondoh lhunna chana chun, Judah teho lah-a lunghemna nasatah toh, anngolna, kana le penna aumin: chule mitam tah-in khaodip pon akisilun vut lah-a alumun ahi.
target: In every province to which the edict and order of the king came, there was great mourning among the Jews, with fasting, weeping and wailing. Many lay in sackcloth and ashes.

source: Hitichun Esther soh numei ho le anukiso ho chu ahungun hichu ahunghil taovin ahi. Chuphatnin lengnu alungkham behseh jengtan, akhaodip pon chu aholhah-a akivon dingin Mordecai chu pon agah thotnin; ahinla aman hichu akisanpon ahi.
target: When Esther’s eunuchs and female attendants came and told her about Mordecai, she was in great distress. She sent clothes for him to put on instead of his sackcloth, but he would not accept them.

source: Chujouvin Esther'in, ama vetup dinga kipansah, lengpa nukiso ho lah-a Hatach chu akouvin, Mordecai chungchanga ipi iti hija, chule ipidinga chuti umham? ti gahetoh din thupeh apen ahi.
target: Then Esther summoned Hathak, one of the king’s eunuchs assigned to attend her, and ordered him to find out what was troubling Mordecai and why.

source: Hitichun Hatach chu lengpa kotpi maija khopi lamlena Mordecai henga chun achedoh-in ahi.
target: So Hathak went out to Mordecai in the open square of the city in front of the king’s gate.

source: Chuin Mordecai'in achunga thusoh jouse, chule Judah te suhmangna dinga Haman'in lengpa goukhol na-a sum pedinga akitepnaho chu ahilin ahi.
target: Mordecai told him everything that had happened to him, including the exact amount of money Haman had promised to pay into the royal treasury for the destruction of the Jews.

source: Chule aman Esther avetsah-a, ahenga ahilchetna, chule amanu lengpa angsunga galut dinga thu apeh-a, amanu ahenga agataova, chule amite dinga ngehna aganei theina dingin, amaho suhmang nadinga Shushan'a kona thutanlhah kithotdoh lekhat khat jong apen ahi.
target: He also gave him a copy of the text of the edict for their annihilation, which had been published in Susa, to show to Esther and explain it to her, and he told him to instruct her to go into the king’s presence to beg for mercy and plead with him for her people.

source: Chuin Hatach chu ahungin, Mordecai thusei jouse chu Esther ahiltan ahi.
target: Hathak went back and reported to Esther what Mordecai had said.

source: Esther'in Hatach henga aseikitnin, chule Mordecai henga hitia agasei dingin thupeh apen ahi.
target: Then she instructed him to say to Mordecai,

source: Lengpa sohte jousele lengpa gamkai sunga um jousen, koi hijongle, numei hihen pasal hijongle, aman akou louva lengpa hongsung sungnunga hunglut ho chu, aman dan khatseh aneijin, amachu kithat ding, amavang lengpan sana tenggol ama lama adop khumho bou chu hingding ahi, ti ahesoh keijun ahi. Ahinla nisomthum sunghin lengpa henga lut dingin keima eikikou tapoi, ati.
target: “All the king’s officials and the people of the royal provinces know that for any man or woman who approaches the king in the inner court without being summoned the king has but one law: that they be put to death unless the king extends the gold scepter to them and spares their lives. But thirty days have passed since I was called to go to the king.”

source: Chuin amahon Esther thu chu Mordecai aseipeh-un ahi.
target: When Esther’s words were reported to Mordecai,

source: Chuin Mordecai'in Esther hitia adonbut diuvin athupeh-in ahi, Judah te jouse sangin leng inpi sunga hoidoh nange tin kigel hih-in.
target: he sent back this answer: “Do not think that because you are in the king’s house you alone of all the Jews will escape.

source: Ajehchu nangma tuphatna hi nathipbeh-a ahile, mun danga kona Judah te letdohna le hoidohna um teiding ahin, nangmale napa insung vang namanthah diu ahi. Hitobang phatna dinga hi lenggam sunga nahungpan ahi kon ahetnem? ati.
target: For if you remain silent at this time, relief and deliverance for the Jews will arise from another place, but you and your father’s family will perish. And who knows but that you have come to your royal position for such a time as this?”

source: Chuin Esther'in hiche donbutna hi Mordecai hetsahdin amaho chu asolin:
target: Then Esther sent this reply to Mordecai:

source: Cheovin, Shushan'a um Judah te jouse kichomkhomu vinlang, keidingin an ngolun, chule nithum sung sunle jan-in nelou donlouvin umun: keimale kasoh numei hon jong hitobanga chu an kangol diu; chule dan hihih jongle lengpa koma kagalut ding ahi: kamanthahle mangthah tange, ati.
target: “Go, gather together all the Jews who are in Susa, and fast for me. Do not eat or drink for three days, night or day. I and my attendants will fast as you do. When this is done, I will go to the king, even though it is against the law. And if I perish, I perish.”

source: Hitichun Mordecai chu achedoh-in, Esther'in athupeh jouse chu aboltan ahi.
target: So Mordecai went away and carried out all of Esther’s instructions.

source: Tun anithum channin ahitin ahi, Esther'in alengpon akivonin, lengpa in jon tah-a lengpa hongsung sungnunga chun adingtan: chule lengpa chu in kotpi jontah, leng in sunga alaltouna-a chun atouvin ahi.
target: On the third day Esther put on her royal robes and stood in the inner court of the palace, in front of the king’s hall. The king was sitting on his royal throne in the hall, facing the entrance.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, lengpan Esther lengnu chu thutana hongsunga adin amu phatnin, lengpa mitmun amanu chu lungsetna achangtan; chuin lengpan akhutna um sana tenggol chun Esther chu ahin japmin ahi. Hitichun Esther ahung naijin, chule tenggol muh chu athamin ahi.
target: When he saw Queen Esther standing in the court, he was pleased with her and held out to her the gold scepter that was in his hand. So Esther approached and touched the tip of the scepter.

source: Chuin lengpan amanu jah-a, lengnu Esther, ipiham nadei? chule ipiham nathum? Lenggam akehkhat geija jong kipeding nahi, atitai.
target: Then the king asked, “What is it, Queen Esther? What is your request? Even up to half the kingdom, it will be given you.”

source: Chuin Esther'in adonbutnin, lengpan pha asah-a ahile, tunia keiman ama dinga kagonpeh anneh khomna-a hin lengpa le Haman hunglhon le kati, ati.
target: “If it pleases the king,” replied Esther, “let the king, together with Haman, come today to a banquet I have prepared for him.”

source: Chuin lengpan, Esther seibang aboltheidin, Haman chu hinpui loijun, ati. Hitichun Esther'in agon nehkhom na-a chun lengpa le Haman chu ahungtai.
target: “Bring Haman at once,” the king said, “so that we may do what Esther asks.” So the king and Haman went to the banquet Esther had prepared.

source: Chuin lengpan judon khomna-a chun Esther henga, ipiham nathum? nakibolpeh ding nahi, chule na-ngeh chu ipi ham? lenggam kehkhat hijengjongle kibulhitpeh ding nahi, ati.
target: As they were drinking wine, the king again asked Esther, “Now what is your petition? It will be given you. And what is your request? Even up to half the kingdom, it will be granted.”

source: Chuin Esther hin adonbutnin, kathum le kangeh chu:
target: Esther replied, “My petition and my request is this:

source: Lengpa mitmu-a lungsetna kachana, kathilthum hi lengpan phalpeh dinga pha nasah-a, Kathil ngeh bulhitpeh dinga pha nasahle, lengpa le Haman kagonpeh ding nehkhom na-a hunglhonin lang, lengpa seibangin jingle bolnange, ati.
target: If the king regards me with favor and if it pleases the king to grant my petition and fulfill my request, let the king and Haman come tomorrow to the banquet I will prepare for them. Then I will answer the king’s question.”

source: Hitichun Haman chu hicheni chun lunglhaisel le thanom tah-in apotdohtai. Ahinla Haman'in lengpa kotpi phunga Mordecai ama jana-a adindohlou le achalohlou chu amuphatnin, Mordecai chunga alunghang lheh jengin ahi.
target: Haman went out that day happy and in high spirits. But when he saw Mordecai at the king’s gate and observed that he neither rose nor showed fear in his presence, he was filled with rage against Mordecai.

source: Ahijengvangin, Haman akitimham hamin: in ahunglhun phatnin agolho le ajinu Zeresh koudin asolin ahi.
target: Nevertheless, Haman restrained himself and went home. Calling together his friends and Zeresh, his wife,

source: Chuin Haman'in amaho henga ahaona loupije, achate tamdan, lengpan adopsangna thilho jouse, chule lengpa pipuiho le asohte chungvuma amasotsah dan chu aseijin ahi.
target: Haman boasted to them about his vast wealth, his many sons, and all the ways the king had honored him and how he had elevated him above the other nobles and officials.

source: Chukalvalin Haman'in aseibe kitnin, Henge, Esther lengnun nehkhom na agonna-a chun lengpa le kei tailou koimacha alutsahpoi; chule jingle avelin lengpa toh eikou kit lhonin ahi.
target: “And that’s not all,” Haman added. “I’m the only person Queen Esther invited to accompany the king to the banquet she gave. And she has invited me along with the king tomorrow.

source: Ahinla lengpa kotpi phunga tou Judah mi Mordecai kamu laisen, hicheho jousehin ima eiphatchom sahpoi, ati.
target: But all this gives me no satisfaction as long as I see that Jew Mordecai sitting at the king’s gate.”

source: Chuin ajinu Zeresh le agolho jousen ajah-a, tong somnga sang thingpel kisem hen, chule achunga chu Mordecai akikhai theinadin nangman lengpa henga jingle hinseijin: chuteng lengpa to thanom tah-in nehkhom na-a chun chen, atiuve. Chuin Haman'in hichu pha asan, thingpel chu asemsahtai.
target: His wife Zeresh and all his friends said to him, “Have a pole set up, reaching to a height of fifty cubits, and ask the king in the morning to have Mordecai impaled on it. Then go with the king to the banquet and enjoy yourself.” This suggestion delighted Haman, and he had the pole set up.

source: Hiche jan chun lengpa a-imuthei hihbeh-in, chule thusoh ho kisutlutna thusimbu chu ahinchoi diuvin thupeh apen, chule hicheho chu lengpa angah asimun ahi.
target: That night the king could not sleep; so he ordered the book of the chronicles, the record of his reign, to be brought in and read to him.

source: Chuin Bigthana le Teresh lengpa kotngah-a pang nukiso tenin, Ahasuerus lengpa chunga khut lhahdia agotlhon, Mordecai'in ana seidohpeh thu kisun chu amudoh-un ahi.
target: It was found recorded there that Mordecai had exposed Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king’s officers who guarded the doorway, who had conspired to assassinate King Xerxes.

source: Chuin lengpan aseijin, hiche jeh-a hi ipi janale choi-atna Mordecai kibolpeh am? ati. Chuin ajenlea pang lengpa sohten, ima akibol pehpoi, atiuvin ahi.
target: “What honor and recognition has Mordecai received for this?” the king asked. “Nothing has been done for him,” his attendants answered.

source: Chuin lengpan, hong sunga koi umam? ati. Tun Haman chu lengpa aman asem thingpel chunga Mordecai khaiding thusei dingin, indan ponunga chun ahunglutnin ahi.
target: The king said, “Who is in the court?” Now Haman had just entered the outer court of the palace to speak to the king about impaling Mordecai on the pole he had set up for him.

source: Chuin lengpa sohten ajah-a, vetan, hong sunga Haman adinge, atiuve. Chuin lengpan, hinlutsah un, ati.
target: His attendants answered, “Haman is standing in the court.” “Bring him in,” the king ordered.

source: Hitichun Haman ahunglut tai. Chuin lengpan ajah-a, lengpan ajabol nompa henga ipi kibolpeh le phantem? ati. Tun Haman'in alungsunga, lengpan keisanga ajabolnom koi umding ham? tin agelin ahi.
target: When Haman entered, the king asked him, “What should be done for the man the king delights to honor?” Now Haman thought to himself, “Who is there that the king would rather honor than me?”

source: Chuin Haman in lengpa chu adonbutnin, lengpan ajabol nom mipa ding chun,
target: So he answered the king, “For the man the king delights to honor,

source: Lengpan akivon lengvon, lengpa tounaji sakol, chule lengpa kikhuhji lallukhuh chu hin kilahsah hen:
target: have them bring a royal robe the king has worn and a horse the king has ridden, one with a royal crest placed on its head.

source: Chule lengpan ajabol dingpa chu ajep theina dingin, hiche von le sakol chu lengpa pipu lulpen ho lah-a khat khutna kipehen: chule amachun khopi lamlena sakol chunga chun ama chu puile henlang, amasanga chun: lengpan ajabol nom mi chu hiti ahi kibol ding ahi, tin samphongle hen, ati.
target: Then let the robe and horse be entrusted to one of the king’s most noble princes. Let them robe the man the king delights to honor, and lead him on the horse through the city streets, proclaiming before him, ‘This is what is done for the man the king delights to honor!’ ”

source: Chuin lengpan Haman jah-a, kino-in, nasei bang chun von le sakol chu galan, chule lengpa kotpi phunga tou Juda mipa Mordecai henga khun gabolin: naseiho chu khatcha akipel umlou ding ahi, atitai.
target: “Go at once,” the king commanded Haman. “Get the robe and the horse and do just as you have suggested for Mordecai the Jew, who sits at the king’s gate. Do not neglect anything you have recommended.”

source: Hitichun Haman'in von le sakol chu alan, Mordecai chu avonpeh-in, sakol chunga khopi sung lamlena ahinpuijin, amasanga chun, lengpan ajabol nom mi chu hitia hi kibol ding ahi, tin asampeh-in ahi.
target: So Haman got the robe and the horse. He robed Mordecai, and led him on horseback through the city streets, proclaiming before him, “This is what is done for the man the king delights to honor!”

source: Chuin Mordecai chu lengpa kotpi phunga ahungkit tan ahi. Haman vang chun ponlu akikhun, lunghem tah-in a-in lama acheloitai.
target: Afterward Mordecai returned to the king’s gate. But Haman rushed home, with his head covered in grief,

source: Chuin Haman'in ajinu Zeresh le agolho jouse henga achunga thilsoh jouse chu aseitai. Hichun amiching hole ajinu Zeresh'in ahengah, ama masanga nalhuhpatna Mordecai chu Judah te son ahile, nangman ama najo louhel ding, amavang thonlouva a-anga nalhuhtei ding ahi, atiuve.
target: and told Zeresh his wife and all his friends everything that had happened to him. His advisers and his wife Zeresh said to him, “Since Mordecai, before whom your downfall has started, is of Jewish origin, you cannot stand against him—you will surely come to ruin!”

source: Chuin amaho amatoh akihoulim nalai uvin, lengpa nukiso ho khat ahungin, Esther lengnun asem nehkhom na-a dingin Haman chu mangang tah-in ahung puitan ahi.
target: While they were still talking with him, the king’s eunuchs arrived and hurried Haman away to the banquet Esther had prepared.

source: Hitichun lengpa le Haman chu Esther lengnun agon nehkhom na-a chun ahung lhontan ahi.
target: So the king and Haman went to Queen Esther’s banquet,

source: Chule anini channi jong chun lengpan don khomna-a chun Esther chu adongin, Esther lengnu, nathum chu ipiham? nangma kinop peh ding nahi, chule na-ngeh chu ipiham? lenggam kehkhat pehding hijengjongle, kibolpeh ding nahi, ati.
target: and as they were drinking wine on the second day, the king again asked, “Queen Esther, what is your petition? It will be given you. What is your request? Even up to half the kingdom, it will be granted.”

source: Chuin lengnu Esther'in adonbutnin, Vo lengpa namit mu-a lungsetna kachana, lengpa lung ahile, kathumna-a hin kahinkho hi eikipe henglang, kangehna-a hin kamite hinkho kipehen.
target: Then Queen Esther answered, “If I have found favor with you, Your Majesty, and if it pleases you, grant me my life—this is my petition. And spare my people—this is my request.

source: Ajehchu keiho, keimale kamitehi, suhmang ding, tha dingle, suhgamhel dinga eikijoh doh-u ahitai. Ahinla keihohi sohpa le sohnu dinga eikijohdoh maimaiju hilevang, melmapan lengpa thil suhmang ditdoh jouding hihih jongle, ima seilouva kaum jengding ahi, ati.
target: For I and my people have been sold to be destroyed, killed and annihilated. If we had merely been sold as male and female slaves, I would have kept quiet, because no such distress would justify disturbing the king.”

source: Chuin Ahasuerus lengpan Esther lengnu adonbutnin, ajah-a, alungsunga jong chutobang gahgel ngama chu koihija, hoija uma ham? ati.
target: King Xerxes asked Queen Esther, “Who is he? Where is he—the man who has dared to do such a thing?”

source: Chuin Esther'in, doubol le melma chu hiche mi-engsepa Haman hi ahi ati. Chuin Haman chu lengpa le lengnu anga chun akichatan ahi.
target: Esther said, “An adversary and enemy! This vile Haman!” Then Haman was terrified before the king and queen.

source: Chuin lengpa ju donkhom na-a kon chun lunghang tah-in adingdoh in, leng inpi honsung lama achetai. Chuin Haman chu adingdoh-in ahinkho kihuhna dingin Esther lengnu henga ataotai; ajehchu lengpan achunga setna angaito chu ahet ahitai.
target: The king got up in a rage, left his wine and went out into the palace garden. But Haman, realizing that the king had already decided his fate, stayed behind to beg Queen Esther for his life.

source: Chuin lengpa chu hona konin donkhomna mun'a akile kitnin, chule Haman chu Esther umna jalkhun chunga chun analhun ahi. Hichun lengpan, kamasang tah-a jong aman hiche insunga hi lengnu suhset ding agot ham? ati. Chutia lengpa thusei petchun, Haman chu amai atompeh taove.
target: Just as the king returned from the palace garden to the banquet hall, Haman was falling on the couch where Esther was reclining. The king exclaimed, “Will he even molest the queen while she is with me in the house?” As soon as the word left the king’s mouth, they covered Haman’s face.

source: Chuin nukiso ho lah-a khat Harbonah chun, lengpa anga, Vetan, lengpa dinga thupha seipa Mordecai khailihna dinga Haman'in tong somnga sanga asem thingpel chu Haman in'a akitunge, ati. Chuin lengpan, hiche chunga chun ama khailih-un, ati.
target: Then Harbona, one of the eunuchs attending the king, said, “A pole reaching to a height of fifty cubits stands by Haman’s house. He had it set up for Mordecai, who spoke up to help the king.” The king said, “Impale him on it!”

source: Hijeh chun amahon Haman chu Mordecai kikhaina dinga asem thingpel chunga chun akhai taove. Chujouvin lengpa chu alungdamtai.
target: So they impaled Haman on the pole he had set up for Mordecai. Then the king’s fury subsided.

source: Hiche ni chun Ahasuerus lengpan Judah te melmapa Haman in chu Esther lengnu apetan ahi. Chuin Mordecai lengpa masanga ahungin ahi; ajehchu Esther'in ama chu ama dinga a ipi ahi aseipeh ahitai.
target: That same day King Xerxes gave Queen Esther the estate of Haman, the enemy of the Jews. And Mordecai came into the presence of the king, for Esther had told how he was related to her.

source: Chuin lengpa chun Haman'a kona alah akhutjem chu aladoh-in, Mordecai chu apetan ahi. Chule Esther'in Mordecai chu Haman insung vaipon apansahtai.
target: The king took off his signet ring, which he had reclaimed from Haman, and presented it to Mordecai. And Esther appointed him over Haman’s estate.

source: Chuin Esther'in lengpa anga thu aseikitnin, akengbula alhun, mitlhi pumin Agag mi Haman'in Judah te douna-a thilphalou agon chu alahdoh din angeh-e.
target: Esther again pleaded with the king, falling at his feet and weeping. She begged him to put an end to the evil plan of Haman the Agagite, which he had devised against the Jews.

source: Chuin lengpan sana tenggol chu Esther lama adomdoh-in ahi. Hitichun Esther athoudoh-in, lengpa anga adingin,
target: Then the king extended the gold scepter to Esther and she arose and stood before him.

source: Hitin aseije, Lengpan pha asah-a, amitmua lungsetna kachana, chule hiche thil hi lengpa anga adih-a akilah-a, amitmua alunglhaina kahile, lengpa gamkai jouse sunga um Judah te suhmangna dinga Agag mi Hammedatha chapa Haman'in anabol lekhaho chu akheldohna ding kisun hen:
target: “If it pleases the king,” she said, “and if he regards me with favor and thinks it the right thing to do, and if he is pleased with me, let an order be written overruling the dispatches that Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, devised and wrote to destroy the Jews in all the king’s provinces.

source: Kanam mite chunga hunglhung ding setna chu ken iti kamu-a kadoujou dingham? Ahiloule kasopiho kisuh mangna ding chu iti kamua kadoujou dingham? ati.
target: For how can I bear to see disaster fall on my people? How can I bear to see the destruction of my family?”

source: Chuin Ahasuerus lengpan Esther lengnu le Judah mi Mordecai hengah, veuvin, Judah te chunga akhut alhah jeh-a thingpel'a akhailih-u Haman in chu, keiman Esther kapeh ahitai.
target: King Xerxes replied to Queen Esther and to Mordecai the Jew, “Because Haman attacked the Jews, I have given his estate to Esther, and they have impaled him on the pole he set up.

source: Nanghon nadeilam tah-un lengpa minin Judah te dingin jong lekha sunun, chule lengpa khutjema chun sinkhana nam khumun: ajehchu lengpa mina kisuna, chule lengpa khutjema sinkhana kinamkhum chu koimachan akhelthei louhel ahitai, ati.
target: Now write another decree in the king’s name in behalf of the Jews as seems best to you, and seal it with the king’s signet ring—for no document written in the king’s name and sealed with his ring can be revoked.”

source: Chuin chuche phatlai lha thumna, hichu sivan lha ahin, nisomni le nithum nin lengpa lekhasunho chu koukhom in aumun; abonchan Mordecai'in athupeh dungjuijin, India'a pat Ethiopia gei, agoma gamkai jale somni le sagi-a um Judah te heng, gal lamkaiho heng, gamvaipoho le pipuiho henga thotdin lekha asunun; gamkai jouse chu amaho lekhajem'in, mijouse chu apao cheh-in, chule Judah te dingin jong alekhajem dungjuile apao dungjuijun athot uvin ahi.
target: At once the royal secretaries were summoned—on the twenty-third day of the third month, the month of Sivan. They wrote out all Mordecai’s orders to the Jews, and to the satraps, governors and nobles of the 127 provinces stretching from India to Cush. These orders were written in the script of each province and the language of each people and also to the Jews in their own script and language.

source: Chuin aman Ahasuerus lengpa minin asunin, lengpa khutjemin sinkhana anamkhumin, lekha chu lekha pole-a pang sakol chung, sangan chunga touho, sangongsang, chule sangongsang khangdongho apohsah-un ahi.
target: Mordecai wrote in the name of King Xerxes, sealed the dispatches with the king’s signet ring, and sent them by mounted couriers, who rode fast horses especially bred for the king.

source: Hia chun lengpan khopi tina cheng Judah te jouse chu ahinkhou kihuhna dinga akikhop khomuva, amaho hindel khum ding thahatna jouse mihem le gamkai chu naosen le numei geija asumanguva, atha uva, asuhgamhel uva, chule anei agouhou chu galthil choma akichom diuvin aphalpeh-in,
target: The king’s edict granted the Jews in every city the right to assemble and protect themselves; to destroy, kill and annihilate the armed men of any nationality or province who might attack them and their women and children, and to plunder the property of their enemies.

source: Hichu nikhat sung, lha somle lhani na, hichu Adar lha ahin, nisomle nithum nileh, Ahasuerus lengpa gamkai jouse-a tohdoh-a umding ahi.
target: The day appointed for the Jews to do this in all the provinces of King Xerxes was the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar.

source: Gamkai tina mijouse pehdinga thuphondoh kisunson chu, Juda te chu hiche nikho-a amelmateu chunga phula dinga kigosa dema aumna dinguvin, mijouse henga akihom jaltan ahi.
target: A copy of the text of the edict was to be issued as law in every province and made known to the people of every nationality so that the Jews would be ready on that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.

source: Hitichun kino dingle kikinsah dinga lengpa thupeh ahi jehchun, sangan le sangongsang chunga tou lekhahomho chu akipatdoh taove. Chule thuphondoh chu leng inpi Shushan'a kihomdoh ahi.
target: The couriers, riding the royal horses, went out, spurred on by the king’s command, and the edict was issued in the citadel of Susa.

source: Chuin Mordecai chu lengpa angsunga konin lengvon adum le akang, sana lallukhuh loupitah, tupat ponnem le ponsandup kivon pumin apotdoh-in: chuin Shushan khopi chu akipah-un chule athanomlheh jengun ahi.
target: When Mordecai left the king’s presence, he was wearing royal garments of blue and white, a large crown of gold and a purple robe of fine linen. And the city of Susa held a joyous celebration.

source: Judah te chun vah, kipana, thanopna, chule jana aneitauvin ahi.
target: For the Jews it was a time of happiness and joy, gladness and honor.

source: Chuin gamkaitin le khopitin, lengpa thupeh le thuphondoh lhunna channa chun Judah ten kipana le thanopna aneijun, golvah abolun chule akichol douvin ahi. Chuin gamsunga mitamtah chunga chu Judah te ginna achuh jeh-in, Juda mi asohgam taove.
target: In every province and in every city to which the edict of the king came, there was joy and gladness among the Jews, with feasting and celebrating. And many people of other nationalities became Jews because fear of the Jews had seized them.

source: Tun lhasom le lhani lhina, hichu Adar lha ahin, chuche lha nisomle nithum ni, lengpa thupeh le thuphondoh chu tohlhah-a aumding nikho, Juda mite chunga amelma teovin thaneina anei diuva akinepnao nikho chu ahung nai phatnin, (amaho ana hotbol ho chunga Judah te joh-in vai ahomna diuva thu chu akaleh-a heija aum vang chun)
target: On the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar, the edict commanded by the king was to be carried out. On this day the enemies of the Jews had hoped to overpower them, but now the tables were turned and the Jews got the upper hand over those who hated them.

source: Judah te chu Ahasuerus lengpa gamkai sung jouse-a chun khopi jouse-a, achunguva thilse boldingho chunga khut lhadin akikhomun ahi: Chule koiman amaho atingjou pouve; ajehchu amaho kichatna chu mijouse chunga chua ahitai.
target: The Jews assembled in their cities in all the provinces of King Xerxes to attack those determined to destroy them. No one could stand against them, because the people of all the other nationalities were afraid of them.

source: Chule gamkaija vaipoho jouse, gal lamkaiho, chule lengpa vaipoho chun Judah te akithopiuve; ajehchu achunguva Mordecai ginna achutan ahi.
target: And all the nobles of the provinces, the satraps, the governors and the king’s administrators helped the Jews, because fear of Mordecai had seized them.

source: Ajehchu Mordecai chu leng insunga alen lhehtan, chule aminthanna chu gamkai jouse-a akithang sohtan ahi; ajehchu hichepa Mordecai hi akhangtou tultul jengin ahi.
target: Mordecai was prominent in the palace; his reputation spread throughout the provinces, and he became more and more powerful.

source: Hitichun Judah ten amelmateu jouse chu chemjamin abansat gamun, athatnun, asumangun, chule ahotbolteu chunga boldinga lomtah chu abol taovin ahi.
target: The Jews struck down all their enemies with the sword, killing and destroying them, and they did what they pleased to those who hated them.

source: Chule Shushan inpia Judah ten mi janga athatnun asumangun ahi.
target: In the citadel of Susa, the Jews killed and destroyed five hundred men.

source: Chuin Parshandatha, Dalphon, chule Aspatha,
target: They also killed Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha,

source: Chule Poratham, Adalia, chule Aridatha,
target: Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha,

source: Chule Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai chule Vaizatha.
target: Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai and Vaizatha,

source: Hammedatha chapa Haman chapa som, Judah te melmaho chu amahon athatnun; ahinla galthil chu ima alapouvin ahi.
target: the ten sons of Haman son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews. But they did not lay their hands on the plunder.

source: Hichenia Shushan leng inpia kithatho chu amijat lengpa angsunga ahinpolut nun ahi.
target: The number of those killed in the citadel of Susa was reported to the king that same day.

source: Chuin lengpan lengnu Esther jah-a, Judah ten Shushan inpia mi janga athatnun, asumanguvin, chule Haman chapate misom jong chu athat taove: lengpa gamkai dang jouse-a ipi aboluvem? Tun ipiham nathum? Hichu kibolpeh ding nahi. Ahiloule ipiham nangehbe? Hichu kibolding ahi, ati.
target: The king said to Queen Esther, “The Jews have killed and destroyed five hundred men and the ten sons of Haman in the citadel of Susa. What have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces? Now what is your petition? It will be given you. What is your request? It will also be granted.”

source: Chuin Esther'in, lengpa lunglam ahile, Shushan'a um Juda te chu tunikho-a dinga thuphondoh kibol banga, jing nikho jongle abol diuvin phalna kipehen, chule Haman chapate somho hi thingpel'a kikhai hen, ati.
target: “If it pleases the king,” Esther answered, “give the Jews in Susa permission to carry out this day’s edict tomorrow also, and let Haman’s ten sons be impaled on poles.”

source: Chuin lengpan chutia bolding chun thupeh apetan ahi. Chule thupeh apeh chu Shushan'a akipen; chule amahon Haman chapate som chu thingpel'a akhailih taove.
target: So the king commanded that this be done. An edict was issued in Susa, and they impaled the ten sons of Haman.

source: Ajehchu Shushan'a um Judah te chu Adar lha, ni somleli nin akikhom khomun, Shushan'a mi jathum athat uvin; hinlah athilhou vang imacha alapouvin ahi.
target: The Jews in Susa came together on the fourteenth day of the month of Adar, and they put to death in Susa three hundred men, but they did not lay their hands on the plunder.

source: Ahinla Juda mi adang dangho lengpa gamkai sunga umho chu akikhomun, ahinnao huhna-in apanguvin, amelmateuva konin akicholdo uvin, agalteu chu sangsomsagi le sangnga athatnun ahi; hinla anei agouhou chunga akhut alha pouve;
target: Meanwhile, the remainder of the Jews who were in the king’s provinces also assembled to protect themselves and get relief from their enemies. They killed seventy-five thousand of them but did not lay their hands on the plunder.

source: Hiche hi Adar lha ni som le nithum ni ahi. Chuin hiche lha mama nisomle nili channin amaho akicholdo uvin, hiche nikho chu golvah le kipa nikhon amanguvin ahi.
target: This happened on the thirteenth day of the month of Adar, and on the fourteenth they rested and made it a day of feasting and joy.

source: Ahinla Shushan'a um Judah te chu chuche lha ni somle nithum ni, chuleh nisomle nili nin akikhomun; chule hiche lha mama nisomle ninga channin akicholdo uvin, hiche nikho chu golvah le kipa nikhon amanguvin ahi.
target: The Jews in Susa, however, had assembled on the thirteenth and fourteenth, and then on the fifteenth they rested and made it a day of feasting and joy.

source: Hijeh-a chu kulpi kikai khum lou khoneo ho-a Judah te chun, Adar lha nisomle nili ni chu kipa le golvah nikhon amangun, chule choldoni akilhaovin, khat lekhat thilpeh kipehto nikhon amanguvin ahi.
target: That is why rural Jews—those living in villages—observe the fourteenth of the month of Adar as a day of joy and feasting, a day for giving presents to each other.

source: Chuin Mordecai jin hichehohi asunin, Ahasuerus lengpa gamkaiho jouse-a um Judah te, naija le gamlha-a umho jouse henga lekha athotnin,
target: Mordecai recorded these events, and he sent letters to all the Jews throughout the provinces of King Xerxes, near and far,

source: Adar lha nisomle nili le nisomle ninga ni hi kum seh-a anitdiuva alah uva phudoh-a,
target: to have them celebrate annually the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month of Adar

source: Hiche nikho-a chu Juda te amelmateova kona acholdonao nikhou, chule chuche lha chu amaho dinga lunggim na-a kon kipana aso-a, chule lunghemna-a kona choldo nikho sodohna lha ahin: hitia chu amahon hiche nikho teni chu golvah le kipa nikho, khatle khat thilpeh kipehto nikho, chule gentheiho thilpeh peh nikho-a amandiuvin athotnin ahi.
target: as the time when the Jews got relief from their enemies, and as the month when their sorrow was turned into joy and their mourning into a day of celebration. He wrote them to observe the days as days of feasting and joy and giving presents of food to one another and gifts to the poor.

source: Chuin Judah te chun amahon ana bolpatsao bangle, ahenguva Mordecai hinsut banga chu bol dingin asang taove.
target: So the Jews agreed to continue the celebration they had begun, doing what Mordecai had written to them.

source: Ajehchu Agag mi Hammedatha chapa Haman, Judah te melmapa chun Judah te douna-a amaho suhmang ding anagotna, chule Pur anasana, hichu vangvetna ahin, amaho chu thagama, suhgam ding anagot ahi.
target: For Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had plotted against the Jews to destroy them and had cast the pur (that is, the lot) for their ruin and destruction.

source: Ahinla, Esther chu lengpa anga ahung phatnin, lengpan lekha-a thupeh apen, amapa lung ngaito phalou, Judah te douna-a abol hochu ahungkinung le-a, abona ama luchunga achuh-a, chule amale achapate chu thingpel'a khailih ahina dingin nathupeh tan ahi.
target: But when the plot came to the king’s attention, he issued written orders that the evil scheme Haman had devised against the Jews should come back onto his own head, and that he and his sons should be impaled on poles.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu hiche nikhohi Pur mina konin Purim asah-u ahi. Hijeh chun hiche lekhathotna thucheng jousele, chuche chungchanga athilmu hou jouse, chule amaho chunga hunglhungho jeh chun,
target: (Therefore these days were called Purim, from the word pur .) Because of everything written in this letter and because of what they had seen and what had happened to them,

source: Judah ten amaho chung le, asohteu chung, chule amaho jop chan chunga din, akisun dungjuija thonlou hela akitep dungjuija kumseh le hiche nikho ni hi anit dingun asudetnun ahi.
target: the Jews took it on themselves to establish the custom that they and their descendants and all who join them should without fail observe these two days every year, in the way prescribed and at the time appointed.

source: Chule hiche nikho teni hi geldoh jinga uma, insung tina, gamkai tina, chule khopi tina akhang akhanga kinit jingding ahi. Chule hiche Purim nikho teni hi Judah te lah-a kona kilamang louding, chule hicheho hetjingna jonghi achilhah teova kona mangthah louding ahi.
target: These days should be remembered and observed in every generation by every family, and in every province and in every city. And these days of Purim should never fail to be celebrated by the Jews—nor should the memory of these days die out among their descendants.

source: Chujouvin Abihail chanu lengnu Esther le Juda mi Mordecai'in thaneina jouseto thon, Purim suhdetna dingin lekhathot aniveina asun lhonin ahi.
target: So Queen Esther, daughter of Abihail, along with Mordecai the Jew, wrote with full authority to confirm this second letter concerning Purim.

source: Chuin aman lekhathot ho chu, Ahasuerus lenggama gamkai jakhatle somni le sagi-a cheng Judah te jouse henga, lungmona thu le thutah thu toh athot than,
target: And Mordecai sent letters to all the Jews in the 127 provinces of Xerxes’ kingdom—words of goodwill and assurance—

source: Judah mi Mordecai le Esther lengnun ajui diuva aphatsah lhon dungjuile, a-an ngolu le akanao thudola amaho tah dingle achateu dinga thuphondoh anabol banguva, phat kitep dungjuija hiche Purim nikho hi suhdetna aumna dinga athot ahi.
target: to establish these days of Purim at their designated times, as Mordecai the Jew and Queen Esther had decreed for them, and as they had established for themselves and their descendants in regard to their times of fasting and lamentation.

source: Chuin Esther thuphondoh chun Purim thudol chu asudet tan; chuleh hichu lekhabua akisunlut tai.
target: Esther’s decree confirmed these regulations about Purim, and it was written down in the records.

source: Chuin lengpa Ahasuerus'in leiset chungle twikol gamho chunga kai alatan ahi.
target: King Xerxes imposed tribute throughout the empire, to its distant shores.

source: Chuin athaneina le athilbol theina-a anatoh jouse, chule Mordecai loupina kiphondoh, lengpan amasot dan, Media le Persia lengte thusimbua kisunlut hilouham?
target: And all his acts of power and might, together with a full account of the greatness of Mordecai, whom the king had promoted, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Media and Persia?

source: Ajehchu Juda mi Mordecai chu leng Ahasuerus ban tah-a ahin, chule Judah te lah-a loupitah, asopi tamtah lunglhaina, amite phatna ding hol, chule achilhahte jouse henga lungmona thu aseijing ahi.
target: Mordecai the Jew was second in rank to King Xerxes, preeminent among the Jews, and held in high esteem by his many fellow Jews, because he worked for the good of his people and spoke up for the welfare of all the Jews.

source: Uz gamsunga chun amin Job atiu mikhat anachenge. Amapa chu chamkimle mikitah anahin, chuleh Pathen ginga setna nungsun jing mi anahi.
target: In the land of Uz there lived a man whose name was Job. This man was blameless and upright; he feared God and shunned evil.

source: Chule aman chapa sagile chanu thum ahinge.
target: He had seven sons and three daughters,

source: Aman aneiho chu kelngoi sangsagi, sangongsao sangthum chule bongchal to janga chule sanganpi sanga ahin, chuleh insung lentah ahi; hijeh chun hichepa chu solam miho jouse lah-a milenpen anahi.
target: and he owned seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen and five hundred donkeys, and had a large number of servants. He was the greatest man among all the people of the East.

source: Chuin achapate chun a-inhouva ama ama nikhosehle golvah bollin ache jiuve. Hichea chun nehkhom donkhompi ding chun asopi numei thum jongchu akoujiuve.
target: His sons used to hold feasts in their homes on their birthdays, and they would invite their three sisters to eat and drink with them.

source: Golvah nikho kitol chu akichai phatnin, Job'in mi asollin achate chu asuthengjin chuleh Jingpi tahle athoujin achate khatcheh ding chun govam thilto abolpehjin ahi; ajehchu Job'in, kachate Pathen douna-in chonse khaovintin, chule alungun Pathen chu gaosap khaovinte, ati ahi. Hitichun Job'in tanglouvin abol jingin ahi.
target: When a period of feasting had run its course, Job would make arrangements for them to be purified. Early in the morning he would sacrifice a burnt offering for each of them, thinking, “Perhaps my children have sinned and cursed God in their hearts.” This was Job’s regular custom.

source: Tun nikhat Pathen chapate chu Pakai angsunga acham chama ahung kikhop nikhou ahung lhungin, alah uva chun Satan jong ahungpange.
target: One day the angels came to present themselves before the Lord , and Satan also came with them.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Satan jah-a hoija kona hung nahim? ati. Satan'in Pakai chu adonbutnin, leiset chunga suhle tunga kavalea chule chungle noi kakoptoa kahung ahi, ati.
target: The Lord said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Satan answered the Lord , “From roaming throughout the earth, going back and forth on it.”

source: Chuin Pakai chun Satan jah-a nangman kalhacha Job khu iti nagellem? Leiset chunga michamkim, mikitah Pathen ginga chule asetnalam nungsun jing amatobang aumdem? ati.
target: Then the Lord said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? There is no one on earth like him; he is blameless and upright, a man who fears God and shuns evil.”

source: Chuphatnin Satan'in Pakai chu adonbutnin, Job'in Pathen chu mohseh a agin hija ong? ati.
target: “Does Job fear God for nothing?” Satan replied.

source: Nangman amale a-insungmite chule aneijousele aveljouse pal nakaikhum hilouham? Nangman akhut tenin atoh jouse phatthei naboh in, chule hiche gamsunga hin anei agou apung chehcheh-in ahi.
target: “Have you not put a hedge around him and his household and everything he has? You have blessed the work of his hands, so that his flocks and herds are spread throughout the land.

source: Ahinla tun nakhut lhang inlang aneijousehi tongkha lechun, aman namaichang tah a nagaosap tante ati.
target: But now stretch out your hand and strike everything he has, and he will surely curse you to your face.”

source: Chule Pakai chun Satan jah-a, ven, aneijouse khu nangma thaneina ahitai; amatahsa chunga vang nakhut lha hih in. Hitichun Satan chu Pakai angsunga konchun achedohtai.
target: The Lord said to Satan, “Very well, then, everything he has is in your power, but on the man himself do not lay a finger.” Then Satan went out from the presence of the Lord .

source: Chule nikhathi a-upa pennu inna chun achapate achanute chun nehkhom donkhom abolpetnu chun:
target: One day when Job’s sons and daughters were feasting and drinking wine at the oldest brother’s house,

source: thangkou mikhatnin Job henga thu ahung lhutnin, hitin aseije. Bongchal hon lou akaipetnu, chule sanganhon akomuva ham aneh petnun,
target: a messenger came to Job and said, “The oxen were plowing and the donkeys were grazing nearby,

source: Seba miho chun ahindel khumuvin abonun akaimangun chule sohdangho jouse jong chu chemjamin athatnun, kei changseh bouhi nangma hildinga hung hoidoh kahi, ati.
target: and the Sabeans attacked and made off with them. They put the servants to the sword, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!”

source: Aman hiche thuchu asei nalaijin, midang khatma ahung lhungin hitin aseije, Pathen meichu van'a konin ahungleng lhan, kelngoihole soh ho chu akataovin amaho meijin ahalvamtai. Kei changseh bouhi nangma hildinga hung hoidoh kahi, ati.
target: While he was still speaking, another messenger came and said, “The fire of God fell from the heavens and burned up the sheep and the servants, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!”

source: Aman hiche thuchu asei nalaijin, midang khatma ahung lhungin, Chaldea miho loithumin akisemmun sangongsao ho ahindeluvin, amahochu akaimang taove. Kei changseh bouhi nangma hildinga hung hoidoh kahi, ati.
target: While he was still speaking, another messenger came and said, “The Chaldeans formed three raiding parties and swept down on your camels and made off with them. They put the servants to the sword, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!”

source: Aman hiche thuchu aseinalaijin, midang khatjong ahunglhung paijin nachapate le nachanutehon a-upa penu in'a an aneh uva lengpitwi adonpet tah-un,
target: While he was still speaking, yet another messenger came and said, “Your sons and daughters were feasting and drinking wine at the oldest brother’s house,

source: Chule ven, gamthipma konin khopihuijin in ningli chu ahinmutnin ahile, in chun khangdongho chu alhuh khumin, amaho athigam taove. Chule kei changseh bouhi nangma hildinga hung hoidoh kahi, ati.
target: when suddenly a mighty wind swept in from the desert and struck the four corners of the house. It collapsed on them and they are dead, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!”

source: Chutah in Job chu akipatdoh-in, asangkhol lenchu abottelin, asam akivotolin, chuin tolla aboh khupmin, Pathen chu ahoutai,
target: At this, Job got up and tore his robe and shaved his head. Then he fell to the ground in worship

source: Chule hitin aseije, kanu naobu sunga kona kasagoh keova hungdoh-a kahin, sagoh keova kakilekit ding ahi. Pakai chun eipeh ahin, Pakai chun akile lahkit ahi; Pakai min chu nunnom hen.
target: and said: “Naked I came from my mother’s womb, and naked I will depart. The Lord gave and the Lord has taken away; may the name of the Lord be praised.”

source: Hicheng jouse-a hin Job'in chonset abolpon, Pathen jong ngol hoitah in oimo achanpoi.
target: In all this, Job did not sin by charging God with wrongdoing.

source: Nikhathi Pathen chapate chu Pakai anga ahung kikhomkit taovin, chule amaho lah-a chun Satan jong Pakai angah ahunglhan ahi.
target: On another day the angels came to present themselves before the Lord , and Satan also came with them to present himself before him.

source: Chule Pakai chun Satan jah-a, hoija hungkon nahim? ati. Satan'in Pakai chu adonbutnin leiset chunga suhle tunga kavalea chule chungle noi kakoptoa kahung ahi, ati.
target: And the Lord said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Satan answered the Lord , “From roaming throughout the earth, going back and forth on it.”

source: Chule Pakai chun Satan jah-a, kalhachapa Job khu iti nagellem? Leiset chunga michamkim michondih Pathen ginga chule setnalam nungsun jing amatobang aumpoi. Nangman ajeh beija ama suhmang dinga ama douna-a neitildoh vangin, aman achondihna lhadeh louvin atuhchah jing nalaije, ati.
target: Then the Lord said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? There is no one on earth like him; he is blameless and upright, a man who fears God and shuns evil. And he still maintains his integrity, though you incited me against him to ruin him without any reason.”

source: Chuin Satan'in Pakai chu adonbutnin, vun khella vun, henge, min aneijouse ahinna lhengin pente.
target: “Skin for skin!” Satan replied. “A man will give all he has for his own life.

source: Ahin tun nangman nakhut lhangin lang agule aphe tongkha lechun aman namaichang tah-a nangma gaosap tannate, ati.
target: But now stretch out your hand and strike his flesh and bones, and he will surely curse you to your face.”

source: Pakai chun Satan jah-a, ven, ama nakhutna aume ahinla ahinna vang hoijin, ati.
target: The Lord said to Satan, “Very well, then, he is in your hands; but you must spare his life.”

source: Hitichun Satan chu Pakai angsunga konin achedoh-in, chule Job chu akengtoa pat alujang geijin uilut khohtah-in atomsah tai.
target: So Satan went out from the presence of the Lord and afflicted Job with painful sores from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head.

source: Chule aman akikhot nadingin bel halkhat alan, vut lah-a chun atoutai.
target: Then Job took a piece of broken pottery and scraped himself with it as he sat among the ashes.

source: Chuin ajinu chun ajah-a, nachondihna chu nakolchah nahlaijem? Pathen chu gaosap minlang thijengtan, ati.
target: His wife said to him, “Are you still maintaining your integrity? Curse God and die!”

source: Ahin aman amanu jah-a nangman numei ngolkhat thusei bangin thu naseije. Ipiham? einin Pathen'a kona apha jeng ikisana, aphalou kisan louva i-um dingham? Hicheng chunga hin Job'in akamin thuse aseipoi.
target: He replied, “You are talking like a foolish woman. Shall we accept good from God, and not trouble?” In all this, Job did not sin in what he said.

source: Tun Job golte thumho chun hiche thilse jouse hi ama chunga achutai ti ajah phatnun, aumna cheh uva konin ahungun; amaho chu Teman mi Eliphaz, Shuh mi Bildad, chule Naamath mi Zophar ahiuve. Amaho chu ama lunghempi dingle lhamon ding chun akitem toh-un ahi.
target: When Job’s three friends, Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite, heard about all the troubles that had come upon him, they set out from their homes and met together by agreement to go and sympathize with him and comfort him.

source: Chule amahon gamlatah-a avetnuva amachu ahettheilou phatnun amaho awging tah-in akaptaovin; chule amahon asangkhol cheh-u chu abottelun, chule van lama aluchung uva leivui atheuvin ahi.
target: When they saw him from a distance, they could hardly recognize him; they began to weep aloud, and they tore their robes and sprinkled dust on their heads.

source: Hitichun amahon amachu ni sagi le jan sagi tollhanga atoupiuvin, koimachan kamcheng khatchan jong ahouloh pouve; ajehchu amahon athohgim nasatah chu amuvin ahi.
target: Then they sat on the ground with him for seven days and seven nights. No one said a word to him, because they saw how great his suffering was.

source: Hicheng jouhin Job akam kan apenni chu agaosaptai.
target: After this, Job opened his mouth and cursed the day of his birth.

source: Chule Job apaodoh-in hitin aseije,
target: He said:

source: Kapenna nikho chu mangthah hen, chule naosen pasal khat akivoptai tia kiseina janchu mangthah hen.
target: “May the day of my birth perish, and the night that said, ‘A boy is conceived!’

source: Hiche nikho chu muthim hihen, chunglama konin Pathen'in ngaisah dahen, hiche nikho chu vah injong salvah dahen.
target: That day—may it turn to darkness; may God above not care about it; may no light shine on it.

source: Hiche nikho chu muthimle thina limmin kaikhumhen, meipin achung khukhumhen; muthim lhangkhal in hiche ni chu kichatsah hen.
target: May gloom and utter darkness claim it once more; may a cloud settle over it; may blackness overwhelm it.

source: Chule hiche janchu muthimin mangjeng hen; hichu kumsunga nikho lah-a jong pandahen, lha kisim nalah ajong panghih hen.
target: That night—may thick darkness seize it; may it not be included among the days of the year nor be entered in any of the months.

source: Veovin hiche janchu janlengvai hihen; hia chun kipa awgin hung lutdahen.
target: May that night be barren; may no shout of joy be heard in it.

source: Alunghem nao sodohgo-a nikho gaosaphon hichu gaosap muhen.
target: May those who curse days curse that day, those who are ready to rouse Leviathan.

source: Thingjangvah ahsi hochu thim taohen, hiche chun khovah velehen, ahin khatcha jong mudahen, khovahlhah jong mudahen.
target: May its morning stars become dark; may it wait for daylight in vain and not see the first rays of dawn,

source: Ajehchu hiche jan chun kanu naobu anasingpon, chujongle gentheina kamitna konin ana selmangpoi.
target: for it did not shut the doors of the womb on me to hide trouble from my eyes.

source: Ipijeh-a naobu-a kona kanathi louham? Oisunga kona kahungdoh a chu ipijeh-a kahinna kanalha louham?
target: “Why did I not perish at birth, and die as I came from the womb?

source: Ipijeh-a pheiphung in einasana? ahiloule, ipi dinga kachepding noi ana uma ham?
target: Why were there knees to receive me and breasts that I might be nursed?

source: Chutile keima tu-a hi analuma thipbeh-a anaum tadinga, keima ana ihmu tadinga, hichepetna chu keima anacholdo hitaleng,
target: For now I would be lying down in peace; I would be asleep and at rest

source: Amaho-a dinga khogemsa kisema leiset thumopthem ho le leiset lenghoto,
target: with kings and rulers of the earth, who built for themselves places now lying in ruins,

source: Ahiloule a-inhou dangka a sudima, sana neija leng chapatetoh,
target: with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver.

source: ahiloule aphatlouva peng chapang kisel mahthah khat tobangla kana hitapon, vah mukhalouhel naosen ho tojongla kanabang tapon,
target: Or why was I not hidden away in the ground like a stillborn child, like an infant who never saw the light of day?

source: Hikoma chun migilouho alungkham naova konin atangun, chule athacholla chu akitha oltai.
target: There the wicked cease from turmoil, and there the weary are at rest.

source: Hikoma chun songkul lut ho acholngaovin; mibol gentheina aw jong ajatapouve.
target: Captives also enjoy their ease; they no longer hear the slave driver’s shout.

source: Hikoma chun alen aneo aumun, chule sohjong apakaipa-a konin achamlhat tai.
target: The small and the great are there, and the slaves are freed from their owners.

source: Ipijeh-a genthei thohpahi vah chu anakipea, chule alha hesoh lengvaipahi hinna anakipeham;
target: “Why is light given to those in misery, and life to the bitter of soul,

source: Thina ngaicha lheh-a ahivanga hunglhung dehlou, chule gouthil kiselgu sanga nasajo-a holpa;
target: to those who long for death that does not come, who search for it more than for hidden treasure,

source: Amahon lhankhuh amutengule, hatah-a kipah thanomji hilou vuham?
target: who are filled with gladness and rejoice when they reach the grave?

source: Ipijeh-a alampi kisel mangpeh mipa hengle, Pathen'in kul akaikhum pehpa henga vah kipe aham?
target: Why is life given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?

source: Ajehchu ka anneh masangin kahai sammin eiphan, chule kapen ginhi twi bangin akibunglhai.
target: For sighing has become my daily food; my groans pour out like water.

source: Ajehchu kakichat pentah thilchu kachunga alhungtan, chule kana ginjing thilchun eihin phatai.
target: What I feared has come upon me; what I dreaded has happened to me.

source: Keima kana hoidohpon, choljong kana choldopoi, chule thipbeh injong kana umpoi, ajehchu gimna chun eilhun khumtai.
target: I have no peace, no quietness; I have no rest, but only turmoil.”

source: Chuphatnin Teman mi Eliphaz chun adonbutnin, hitin ati,
target: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:

source: keihon nangma kihoulimpi talengu nalung phamo dem? ahinla koiham paolouva umthei dinga?
target: “If someone ventures a word with you, will you be impatient? But who can keep from speaking?

source: Vetan, nangman mi tamtah nahildoh-in, khut thalhom te chu nahatsah-in ahi.
target: Think how you have instructed many, how you have strengthened feeble hands.

source: Nathun alhusapa chu atungdingin, khup ngoite chu nathahat sahtai.
target: Your words have supported those who stumbled; you have strengthened faltering knees.

source: Ahin tun nachunga alhungtan ahile, nangma nalhasam tan; hichun nangma natongkhan ahile nangma nagenthei tai.
target: But now trouble comes to you, and you are discouraged; it strikes you, and you are dismayed.

source: Hichehi nakichat, natahsan, nakinepna chule nalampi ho-a nadihna chu hilouham?
target: Should not your piety be your confidence and your blameless ways your hope?

source: Geldoh-in, katao ahi; suhkhel neilou mangthah-a koi umam? ahiloule mikitah ho koi kipaidoh kha-am?
target: “Consider now: Who, being innocent, has ever perished? Where were the upright ever destroyed?

source: Keimatah jengin jong kamudanin, khan gitlouna lou kaija kaiho chule khansetna muchi tu-a tuhon jong kibang bangin a-atnun ahi.
target: As I have observed, those who plow evil and those who sow trouble reap it.

source: Pathen hu-a amaho amangthah jiuvin; chule alunghana hu-a chun amaho ajunmang jitaove.
target: At the breath of God they perish; at the blast of his anger they are no more.

source: Keipi bahkai kitum, chule keipi bahkai hang awgin, chule keipi donglai haho jong chu akisubong tan ahi.
target: The lions may roar and growl, yet the teeth of the great lions are broken.

source: Keipi bahkai teh chu nehding lhasamin amangthah jin, chuteng keipi bahkai nouho chu akithecheh jin ahi.
target: The lion perishes for lack of prey, and the cubs of the lioness are scattered.

source: Tun thilkhat guhthim chan kakom ahung lhungin; chule kanakhangin thuguh kisei ajan ahi.
target: “A word was secretly brought to me, my ears caught a whisper of it.

source: Mihemte chunga imutlhuhna achuh-a, jana gao thilmu ho-a kona kagel laijin,
target: Amid disquieting dreams in the night, when deep sleep falls on people,

source: Kichatna kachunga ahungchun, kakithingtai; hichun kagu jouse ahot longin ahi.
target: fear and trembling seized me and made all my bones shake.

source: Chujouvin lhagao khat kamaikoh-a ahungin; katimul athoujenge.
target: A spirit glided past my face, and the hair on my body stood on end.

source: Kading jingin, ahin keiman alimso kahe thempon; alim chu kamasanga aumin, athipchetnin, chuin keiman awkhat kajan hitin aseije,
target: It stopped, but I could not tell what it was. A form stood before my eyes, and I heard a hushed voice:

source: Thithei mihem Pathen sanga dihjo thei ham? mihem chu asempa sanga thengjo theiham?
target: ‘Can a mortal be more righteous than God? Can even a strong man be more pure than his Maker?

source: Ven, aman asohte chunga ginchatna aneipon; chule avantil te jengjong themmo achane.
target: If God places no trust in his servants, if he charges his angels with error,

source: Ngetnin asuhmangji, bon in'a chenga, leivui lah-a kona kisemdoh leingan hohi, ichanna lhasamdiu ham?
target: how much more those who live in houses of clay, whose foundations are in the dust, who are crushed more readily than a moth!

source: Amaho chu jingkah-a patnin nilhah geijin suhmangin aumun, amaho chu i-sah loutah in atonsotnin amangthah jiuve.
target: Between dawn and dusk they are broken to pieces; unnoticed, they perish forever.

source: Amaho-a thilphapen chu chemangjilou ham? chuteng amaho chu chihna beijin athiji taove.
target: Are not the cords of their tent pulled up, so that they die without wisdom?’

source: Nangma nadonbut theiding khattou aumle tun kouvin; chule mithengho koi kom pena nakihei ding ham?
target: “Call if you will, but who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?

source: Ajehchu lunghanin mingol chu athatjin, thangsetnan milungthim beipa chu athatjin ahi.
target: Resentment kills a fool, and envy slays the simple.

source: Keiman mingol aki jungkho kamun; ahin phulou helouvin achenna kagaosap tai.
target: I myself have seen a fool taking root, but suddenly his house was cursed.

source: Achate jong bitna-a konin agamlaovin, amaho kotpi phunga suhchipmin aumjiuvin, amaho huhdoh ding koimacha akimuji tapoi.
target: His children are far from safety, crushed in court without a defender.

source: Achang atsajong agilkelten anejou taovin, chule linglah jenga jong alakhomjin, gucha michom hon aneijouseu chu avallhum jitai.
target: The hungry consume his harvest, taking it even from among thorns, and the thirsty pant after his wealth.

source: Thohgimnahi leivuilah-a kona hung ahilou vangin, chule gentheina jonghi leisetna hungkon ahilou vangin;
target: For hardship does not spring from the soil, nor does trouble sprout from the ground.

source: Hitajongle meisi chunglama alentou banga, mihemhi thohgim ding monga penga ahi.
target: Yet man is born to trouble as surely as sparks fly upward.
