source: Keiman vang Pathen holingting, chule Pathen henga kathuhi lhutning kate:
target: “But if I were you, I would appeal to God; I would lay my cause before him.

source: Amachun thil len tahtah le holdoh jouhoi hilou thilkidang tamtah simjoulou abole.
target: He performs wonders that cannot be fathomed, miracles that cannot be counted.

source: Aman leichunga go ajuhsahjin, loulaija twi ahinsolji:
target: He provides rain for the earth; he sends water on the countryside.

source: Hichun mi noinungte tundoh ahinadiule, alunghemte chu hoina-a choisang ahina dingu ahi.
target: The lowly he sets on high, and those who mourn are lifted to safety.

source: Aman miduha thuh ho thilgon asumojin, hitichun atohgonu chu akhutnun atongtheiji tapouve.
target: He thwarts the plans of the crafty, so that their hands achieve no success.

source: Aman michingho chu adohaovin amanjin, milung gilouho thilgon chu abungbun achuhsahjin ahi.
target: He catches the wise in their craftiness, and the schemes of the wily are swept away.

source: Amaho nisa vah noija muthim toh akitoh-un, sunchangnoija muthim lah bangin akimailele jiuve.
target: Darkness comes upon them in the daytime; at noon they grope as in the night.

source: Ahin aman michaga chu ahatho khutna konle, akamuva kon chule chemjam'a konin ahuhdohjin ahi.
target: He saves the needy from the sword in their mouth; he saves them from the clutches of the powerful.

source: Hitichun mivaichan kinepna aneijin, khan gitlouna chun akam ahuptai.
target: So the poor have hope, and injustice shuts its mouth.

source: Ven, Pathen'in asuhdih mi chu minunom ahi; hijeh chun hat chungnung gimbol nahi i-sah louvin koihih-in.
target: “Blessed is the one whom God corrects; so do not despise the discipline of the Almighty.

source: Ajehchu aman amavon, chule atompeh-in, asukhan, akhutnin adamsah kitji.
target: For he wounds, but he also binds up; he injures, but his hands also heal.

source: Gentheina gup ma kona aman nahuhdoh ding; sagi na-a jong setnan natohkhah louding ahi.
target: From six calamities he will rescue you; in seven no harm will touch you.

source: Kellhah tengle aman thina-a kona nalhatdoh ding, chule galmuna chemjam thanei na-a kon nahuhdoh ding ahi.
target: In famine he will deliver you from death, and in battle from the stroke of the sword.

source: Miseiseho-a kona selthipma aum ding; gamna ahungteng jongle nakichat louding ahi.
target: You will be protected from the lash of the tongue, and need not fear when destruction comes.

source: Suhgamna le kel lhahna chu na nuisat ding; leiset gamsaho jong nakichat louding ahi.
target: You will laugh at destruction and famine, and need not fear the wild animals.

source: Ajehchu loulai songhotoh nangman kiloikhomna nanei ding, chule gamlah saho chun nangma toh kichamna anei diu ahi.
target: For you will have a covenant with the stones of the field, and the wild animals will be at peace with you.

source: Chule nahoubuh-a chamna aumding chu nahet ding, chule nachenna chu navil ding, chonset nabol louding ahi.
target: You will know that your tent is secure; you will take stock of your property and find nothing missing.

source: Chule nangman nachilhah ho letding jong nahetding, chule nachilhah hou chu leija hampa tobang ding ahi, ti nahet ding ahi.
target: You will know that your children will be many, and your descendants like the grass of the earth.

source: Aphatcha kiloh changvui banga, nakum kilhin tenglebou nalhankhuh najotding ahi.
target: You will come to the grave in full vigor, like sheaves gathered in season.

source: Ven, hichehi keihon kaholdoh-u ahi, hitichu ahi; ngaijin, nangma dinga pha ahi ti kihetnin.
target: “We have examined this, and it is true. So hear it and apply it to yourself.”

source: Ahin Job'in adonbutnin hitin aseije.
target: Then Job replied:

source: O kagimna ho hi kito tohsel henlang, chule kahamsetnaho hi khaikotnin kilepto tavele!
target: “If only my anguish could be weighed and all my misery be placed on the scales!

source: Ajehchu, tunvang hicheng pihi twikhanglen panga neldi sangin gihjonte; hijeh-a chu kathuseiho vallhuma um ahitai.
target: It would surely outweigh the sand of the seas— no wonder my words have been impetuous.

source: Ajehchu hat chungnungpa thalchang chu kasunga aumin; agu chun kalhagao adonjou heltan, Pathen'a tijatnaho keidou dingin akigoltoh taove.
target: The arrows of the Almighty are in me, my spirit drinks in their poison; God’s terrors are marshaled against me.

source: Gamlah sangan chu hamhing neisasa pengji-am? ahiloule bongchal anehding chunga bu ngainam?
target: Does a wild donkey bray when it has grass, or an ox bellow when it has fodder?

source: Atamset thilchu chi beijin akinethei nadem? ahiloule ahtui podala atuina umam?
target: Is tasteless food eaten without salt, or is there flavor in the sap of the mallow?

source: Kalhan jong atohkhah nomlou thilho chu, keija din lungkham na-a dim anneh tobang ahi.
target: I refuse to touch it; such food makes me ill.

source: O keiman ngehkhat kaneithei ding hihen, chule Pathen'in kadei thilchu eiphalpeh theiding hitavele!
target: “Oh, that I might have my request, that God would grant what I hope for,

source: Pathen chun eisuhmang jenga lunglhai ding hijongle, chule aman akhut alha-a eitanboh ding hijongle!
target: that God would be willing to crush me, to let loose his hand and cut off my life!

source: Chuteng keiman lhamona kanei nahlai ding, chule kagenthei na-a jong kakipa ding ahi; aman eihoidoh dahen, ajehchu keiman mithengpa thuho chu kana selgupoi.
target: Then I would still have this consolation— my joy in unrelenting pain— that I had not denied the words of the Holy One.

source: Kathahat nahi ipi hija kakineppi ding ham? chule kaki chaina chu ipihija, keiman kahinkho kakisuhsao dingham?
target: “What strength do I have, that I should still hope? What prospects, that I should be patient?

source: Kathahi songho banga tah hija, kasaphe hi sum-eng tobang ham?
target: Do I have the strength of stone? Is my flesh bronze?

source: Keija hi panpina umlou ham? chihnahi keija kona kidelmanga hitam?
target: Do I have any power to help myself, now that success has been driven from me?

source: Bolhesoh-a umpahi agolpa-a kona lungsetna chu vetsah ding ahi; ahinla aman Hat chungnung ginna chu adalhatai.
target: “Anyone who withholds kindness from a friend forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

source: Kasopi hon vachadung bangin kitahloutah-in eijoubolun, chule luidungho bangin alongmang taovin;
target: But my brothers are as undependable as intermittent streams, as the streams that overflow

source: Hicheho chu buhbang jeh-in avomin, chule asunga chun buhbangho kiselin;
target: when darkened by thawing ice and swollen with melting snow,

source: Amaho akisahjun phatle amangjitan, hichu asat tengle aumnaova konin amangthah jitaove.
target: but that stop flowing in the dry season, and in the heat vanish from their channels.

source: Achenau lampi chu akiheimangin, amaho hoima lhungjilouvin amangthahji taove.
target: Caravans turn aside from their routes; they go off into the wasteland and perish.

source: Tema galsat mihon aveovin, Sheba kiloihon amaho chu angah-uve.
target: The caravans of Tema look for water, the traveling merchants of Sheba look in hope.

source: Amahon akineppina anei jeh-un akisumo taovin, amaho khulama ahungun akisujum taove.
target: They are distressed, because they had been confident; they arrive there, only to be disappointed.

source: Ajehchu tun nangho ima nahi tapouvin, nanghon eikiselhah namuvin, chuleh nakichataove.
target: Now you too have proved to be of no help; you see something dreadful and are afraid.

source: Kahenga hinchoijun tia kasei khah em? ahiloule nanei uva konin lhatdoh man neipeuvin tia kaseikhah em?
target: Have I ever said, ‘Give something on my behalf, pay a ransom for me from your wealth,

source: Ahiloule melma khutna konin neihoidoh-un; ahiloule hat chungnung khutna konin neilhat doh-un katikhah em?
target: deliver me from the hand of the enemy, rescue me from the clutches of the ruthless’?

source: Neihilun, chule keiman kalei tuhtang ingkate; chule hoikoma chu kasuhkhel ham neihetchet sah-in.
target: “Teach me, and I will be quiet; show me where I have been wrong.

source: Thudih hohi itobanga thaneija hitam! ahinla naminel nahou hin ipi aphatsah em?
target: How painful are honest words! But what do your arguments prove?

source: Thu kisei hohi suhdih dinga nagel hih uva, chule kinepna neiloupa thusei chu hui tobangbou hitam?
target: Do you mean to correct what I say, and treat my desperate words as wind?

source: Henge, pa neilou chu nasugimun, chule nagol diuvin kokhuh nalaijun ahi.
target: You would even cast lots for the fatherless and barter away your friend.

source: Hijeh chun tun lunglhaijun, keima neiveuvin; kajou ahile kicheh-in heuvin nate.
target: “But now be so kind as to look at me. Would I lie to your face?

source: Hungkileuvin naheng uva katao ahi, khan gitlouna chu hidahen; henge, hung kile kitnun, kachon phatna chu hia chun aume.
target: Relent, do not be unjust; reconsider, for my integrity is at stake.

source: Kaleijahi khan gitlouna umam? kathil patepna hin hetkhena tha aneilou hitam?
target: Is there any wickedness on my lips? Can my mouth not discern malice?

source: Leiset chungahi mihem dinga phattep khat uma hilouham? anikhohi thalahpa nikho tobang hilouham?
target: “Do not mortals have hard service on earth? Are not their days like those of hired laborers?

source: Soh-in nilim angaichat ten bangle, thalahpan atohman sanding avetlhih jing bangin,
target: Like a slave longing for the evening shadows, or a hired laborer waiting to be paid,

source: Hitichun panna beijin lha hijatpihi eiki chansah-in, thohgimna jan hijatpihi kadingin eikitep pehtai.
target: so I have been allotted months of futility, and nights of misery have been assigned to me.

source: Kalupteng itihle kathou kitdem katin, chule janhi itihle abeitadem? katin, chule khovah kahsen nungle ma-a kakileh humhal jengjin ahi.
target: When I lie down I think, ‘How long before I get up?’ The night drags on, and I toss and turn until dawn.

source: Katahsa hi lungle leivuijin atomin, kavunhi akeh-in chule kidah umtah asohtai.
target: My body is clothed with worms and scabs, my skin is broken and festering.

source: Kanikho hi ponkhong khothei sangin aleng gangjon, chule kinepna beijin akimang chaitai.
target: “My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and they come to an end without hope.

source: Oh, kahinkho hi hui ahi ti geldoh jingun; kamitnin apha mukit taponte.
target: Remember, O God, that my life is but a breath; my eyes will never see happiness again.

source: Eimupa mitchun eimukit tapontin; chule namitnun eiventin, keivang ana um taponge.
target: The eye that now sees me will see me no longer; you will look for me, but I will be no more.

source: Meilhang amanthah a abeihel bangin, thikholkhula chelutsa chu ahungdoh kitjitapoi.
target: As a cloud vanishes and is gone, so one who goes down to the grave does not return.

source: A-in'a ahung kilekitji tapon; chule ama munin jong ama anaheta ponte.
target: He will never come to his house again; his place will know him no more.

source: Hijeh chun keiman kakam hupta pong ting; kalhagao hesoh puma thu kasei ding, kahinna natna jeh-a chu kaphun ding ahi.
target: “Therefore I will not keep silent; I will speak out in the anguish of my spirit, I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

source: Keimahi twikhanglen kahia, ahiloule ngapi kahija, eingah ding kachunga nakoi ham?
target: Am I the sea, or the monster of the deep, that you put me under guard?

source: Kajalkhun in eilhamon nintin, chule kalupnahin kalunglhai louna olsah dominte kati tengle;
target: When I think my bed will comfort me and my couch will ease my complaint,

source: Nangman mangin neikichat sah-in, munei na-in neitijat sah-e.
target: even then you frighten me with dreams and terrify me with visions,

source: Hitia chu kahinna hin, hin sanga kimeh lihle thi alhenjoh theina dinga nabol ahi.
target: so that I prefer strangling and death, rather than this body of mine.

source: Hichehi kakidah-e, kahinbe nompoi; neichang lhaovin, ajehchu kanikhoho hi pannabei ahi.
target: I despise my life; I would not live forever. Let me alone; my days have no meaning.

source: Mihemhi ipi hija nangman nahiti choisanga, achunga nalungthim nakoijing ham?
target: “What is mankind that you make so much of them, that you give them so much attention,

source: Jingkah sehle nangman amahi navil jinga, chule phattina napatep jingding ham?
target: that you examine them every morning and test them every moment?

source: Itihchan keija kona chemanglouva na-uma, chule kachil kaval lhah kahse dinga jong neichanglha louding ham?
target: Will you never look away from me, or let me alone even for an instant?

source: Kana chonsetai; nahenga ikatiding hitam, Vo nang mihem hinkho chingtup pa? ipijeh-a nangma douna melchihna khatna neikoija, hitachu keimahi keima dinga pohgih kahi hitam?
target: If I have sinned, what have I done to you, you who see everything we do? Why have you made me your target? Have I become a burden to you?

source: Chule nangman ibolla suhkhel ngaidamlouva, keima khan gitlouna nalahmang louham? ajehchu tun keima leivui lah-a ihmutang kating, chule nangman jingkah le neihol ding, ahia keima ana umlou ding kahitai.
target: Why do you not pardon my offenses and forgive my sins? For I will soon lie down in the dust; you will search for me, but I will be no more.”

source: Chuphatnin Shuhit mi Bildad chun adonbutnin, hitin aseije.
target: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:

source: Nangman itih chanpi hiche hohi nasei dingham? chule itih chanpihi nakamsunga kona hungpotdoh thuchenghi, hui hattah hungbang dingham?
target: “How long will you say such things? Your words are a blustering wind.

source: Pathen'in thutan lhahhi alehei khah-em? ahiloule hat chungnung chun thudih hi alehei khah em?
target: Does God pervert justice? Does the Almighty pervert what is right?

source: Nachate ama douna-a achonsetnuva, chule asuhkhel jeh uva aman apaidohle,
target: When your children sinned against him, he gave them over to the penalty of their sin.

source: Nangman aphatcha Pathen chu naholkitna, chule hat chungnung henga chu taona nasemkitna ahile;
target: But if you will seek God earnestly and plead with the Almighty,

source: Nangma nathem channa chule nathenna ahile, thonlouvin tun ama nangma dingin hung thoudoh intin, chule nachon phatna munchu khantousah tante.
target: if you are pure and upright, even now he will rouse himself on your behalf and restore you to your prosperous state.

source: Nakipatna chu neocha anahijongle, nakichai na chu nasatah-a pungding ahi.
target: Your beginnings will seem humble, so prosperous will your future be.

source: Ajehchu nahenga katao ahi, khanglui lama miho chu kholin, chule apatehou chung changhi holdingin kigon,
target: “Ask the former generation and find out what their ancestors learned,

source: (Ajehchu eiho janhi mibou ihiuvin, chule ima ihepouve; ajehchu leisetna ihinkhou hi le-lim bou ahi.)
target: for we were born only yesterday and know nothing, and our days on earth are but a shadow.

source: Amahon nangma nahil louvu, naseipeh louvu, chule alunguva kona thu naseipeh lou dingu ham?
target: Will they not instruct you and tell you? Will they not bring forth words from their understanding?

source: Doplah louva phaipheng kehtheijam? twi beija peng kehthei ding hinam?
target: Can papyrus grow tall where there is no marsh? Can reeds thrive without water?

source: Satlhah louvin ado hingpet jong, hamhing dangho sangin agoplha masaji taove.
target: While still growing and uncut, they wither more quickly than grass.

source: Pathen sumilho jouse lamlhah chu hitichu ahin; chule miphalhem pa kinepna jong mangthah ding ahi.
target: Such is the destiny of all who forget God; so perishes the hope of the godless.

source: Amapa kinepna chu suhbeijin umintin, chule aginchatna chu maimom pan tobang ding ahi.
target: What they trust in is fragile; what they rely on is a spider’s web.

source: Ama a-in'a kingai jintin, ahivangin hichu dingjou louding; aman hatah-in tuhchah intin, ahivangin pangjou louding ahi.
target: They lean on the web, but it gives way; they cling to it, but it does not hold.

source: Ama nisat masanga ahingsetnin, chule honsunga konin abah ajamdoh-in ahi.
target: They are like a well-watered plant in the sunshine, spreading its shoots over the garden;

source: Ajungho chu song lah-a ajam lutnin, chule songho lah-a chun mun aveove.
target: it entwines its roots around a pile of rocks and looks for a place among the stones.

source: Aman amuna konchun sumang taleh, hichun ama seilep mintin nangmahi kamukha hihbeh-e, tinte.
target: But when it is torn from its spot, that place disowns it and says, ‘I never saw you.’

source: Ven hichehi ama kipana lampi chu ahin, chule leisetna konin adangho hung kehdoh tante.
target: Surely its life withers away, and from the soil other plants grow.

source: Ven Pathen'in miphachamkim chu apaidoh louding; chujongle khanset bolpa chu akithopi louding ahi.
target: “Surely God does not reject one who is blameless or strengthen the hands of evildoers.

source: Aman nakam nuina-a adip dima, namuh kipana-a adipdim kahse-a,
target: He will yet fill your mouth with laughter and your lips with shouts of joy.

source: Nangma nahotbol teho chu jachatna-a kivona, chule mikhang gilou chenna munchu imalou hungsoh ding ahi.
target: Your enemies will be clothed in shame, and the tents of the wicked will be no more.”

source: Chujouvin Job'in adonbutnin, hitin aseije.
target: Then Job replied:

source: Hichehi thutah ahi ti kahei: ahivanga Pathen angsunga koiham them changjou dinga?
target: “Indeed, I know that this is true. But how can mere mortals prove their innocence before God?

source: Aman ama kinahpi goleh, sangkhat lah-a khat jong donbut theiponte.
target: Though they wished to dispute with him, they could not answer him one time out of a thousand.

source: Ama lungthima chingtah, tha-a hattah ahin, ama douna-a kilungtahsah-a khangtouva koi umam?
target: His wisdom is profound, his power is vast. Who has resisted him and come out unscathed?

source: Molsang ho achon mangin, amahon ahepouve; aman alunghan na-in amaho aleh khupmin ahi.
target: He moves mountains without their knowing it and overturns them in his anger.

source: Aman leiset hi aumna mun'a konin ahot lingjin, chule chua akhomho chu akilingjin ahi.
target: He shakes the earth from its place and makes its pillars tremble.

source: Aman nisa thu apen nisa asohji tapoi; chule ahsi ho namdet anam khumjin ahi.
target: He speaks to the sun and it does not shine; he seals off the light of the stars.

source: Amabou chu vanho phajala, chule twikhanglen kinongho chotpha a chu ahi.
target: He alone stretches out the heavens and treads on the waves of the sea.

source: Aman sahlam valpa, Juheisuhtun, Bombel, chule lhanglam ahsi umna jousehi asem ahi.
target: He is the Maker of the Bear and Orion, the Pleiades and the constellations of the south.

source: Aman mudohjoulou thillen abolin; simjoulou thil kidangho jong abolin ahi.
target: He performs wonders that cannot be fathomed, miracles that cannot be counted.

source: Ven, ama kakom tah-a achen, ahinla kamupoi; chule ama achepeh jengin, ahinla kahekhen theipoi.
target: When he passes me, I cannot see him; when he goes by, I cannot perceive him.

source: Veuvin, aman akilah mangleh koiham akhamtheija? koiham ajah-a ipi nabol ham tithei dinga?
target: If he snatches away, who can stop him? Who can say to him, ‘What are you doing?’

source: Pathen chun alunghana alahdohji loutengle, mi kiletsahte kithopi ho chu anoija akunjiuve.
target: God does not restrain his anger; even the cohorts of Rahab cowered at his feet.

source: Keiman ijatna lhoma ama kadonbut dingham? chule amatoh kihouna dinga thucheng ijat kaki lhendoh dingham?
target: “How then can I dispute with him? How can I find words to argue with him?

source: Keima dihlheh jongleng ama donbut pongkating; ahinla keima kathutan dingpa henga taona neijo tange.
target: Though I were innocent, I could not answer him; I could only plead with my Judge for mercy.

source: Keiman ama kou ingting, aman eidonbut jongle, aman ka awchu einangai peh-e ti gingcha ponge.
target: Even if I summoned him and he responded, I do not believe he would give me a hearing.

source: Ajehchu aman huipi le go kithon keima eisuchipmin, chule ajehbeijin kamaha put apunsahbe-e.
target: He would crush me with a storm and multiply my wounds for no reason.

source: Aman kahaina kalah ding eiphalpon, ahinla genthei na-in eidipme.
target: He would not let me catch my breath but would overwhelm me with misery.

source: Keiman hatna thu seijong leng, ven, ama ahatne; chule thutanna tijongleng, koiham thu kasei theina dinga phat eipeding.
target: If it is a matter of strength, he is mighty! And if it is a matter of justice, who can challenge him?

source: Keima them kichan jongleng, kakam sungin mo-eichan intin; keima kacham kimme tijong leng, hiche jongchun kalhin lelna eiphot chetpeh bepding ahi.
target: Even if I were innocent, my mouth would condemn me; if I were blameless, it would pronounce me guilty.

source: Keima ana chamkim nama jongleng, kahinna hi hedehpong kating, kahinkhohi nahsahmo bep ingkate.
target: “Although I am blameless, I have no concern for myself; I despise my own life.

source: Hichehi thilkhat ahi; hijeh-a chu hichehi kasei ahi, aman michamkim pa le mikhang giloupa asumang gele.
target: It is all the same; that is why I say, ‘He destroys both the blameless and the wicked.’

source: Hitichun phulou helouvin kijepna-in kijeplih jongle, aman themona neiloupa thukitan chu anuisat bepding ahi.
target: When a scourge brings sudden death, he mocks the despair of the innocent.

source: Leiset hi agiloupa khutna kipedoh ahin, aman thutan ho maichu atoma, hichu ahiloule, hoija, koiba hijaham?
target: When a land falls into the hands of the wicked, he blindfolds its judges. If it is not he, then who is it?

source: Tun kahin nikhohohi thangkouva lhaipa sangin aman gangjon, amaho aphajong muman louvin alengmang jitai.
target: “My days are swifter than a runner; they fly away without a glimpse of joy.

source: Kongho mangang tah-a akitolmang jeljel bangle, mulaopin anehding amat dinga amangan bangin agangin ahi.
target: They skim past like boats of papyrus, like eagles swooping down on their prey.

source: Keiman kakiphin nahi sumiltange, kagihsatna hohi dalhang ting, chuleh keima kilhamon tange titaleng;
target: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will change my expression, and smile,’

source: Keiman kagenthei naho jousehi kakichan, nangman themona beija neikoi deh louding ahi ti kahei.
target: I still dread all my sufferings, for I know you will not hold me innocent.

source: Keima mikhang gilou khat kahile, ipijeh-a pannabei ja kakisuhboi ham?
target: Since I am already found guilty, why should I struggle in vain?

source: Buhbang twijin kisilha jongleng, kakhut hohi hibang tah-in thengkha hih jongle;
target: Even if I washed myself with soap and my hands with cleansing powder,

source: Hijongleh, nangman kokhuh sunga neiphumlut teijin natin, chule kapon jengtah jonghin eithetbol ding ahi.
target: you would plunge me into a slime pit so that even my clothes would detest me.

source: Ajehchu ama kadonbut theiding le, thutan na-a kache khompi theiding, keitobang mihem ahipoi.
target: “He is not a mere mortal like me that I might answer him, that we might confront each other in court.

source: Kachung cheh lhonna akhut lhathei ding, kakahlhona palai dingjong aumpon ahi.
target: If only there were someone to mediate between us, someone to bring us together,

source: Aman amol lhon keija konin ladohhen; chule ama kichatna hin eitijatsah dahen;
target: someone to remove God’s rod from me, so that his terror would frighten me no more.

source: Chuteng keiman thu seijing ting ama kichataponge; ahin keima kachuti theipoi.
target: Then I would speak up without fear of him, but as it now stands with me, I cannot.

source: Kahinna in kahinkhohi acholpitai; kakiphin naho hi keima chungtah-a ngamingting; kahinna-in lungna tah-in thu seitange.
target: “I loathe my very life; therefore I will give free rein to my complaint and speak out in the bitterness of my soul.

source: Keiman Pathen henga themmo neichan hih-in tinge; Ipijeh-a neilungsat khumham neimusah-in tinge.
target: I say to God: Do not declare me guilty, but tell me what charges you have against me.

source: Nakhutna nasemsa hi bolgentheija, nahsahlouva koija, migilou ho kihouna chungjoh salvah dinghi nangma dinga phajo hitam?
target: Does it please you to oppress me, to spurn the work of your hands, while you smile on the plans of the wicked?

source: Tahsa mit tobang naneija? ahiloule mihem thilmu banga nangman jong namuham?
target: Do you have eyes of flesh? Do you see as a mortal sees?

source: Nangma hin nikhohi mihem hin nikho tobang ham? nangma hinkho kumho jonghi mihem hin nikho ho tobang hija ham?
target: Are your days like those of a mortal or your years like those of a strong man,

source: Hiti achu nangman kakhan gitlouna ho nakhol jinga, chule kachonset naho naholjing ham?
target: that you must search out my faults and probe after my sin—

source: keima khanggilou kahilou hi nangman nahen; chule nakhutna kona eihuhdoh theija koimacha aumpoi tihi nahei.
target: though you know that I am not guilty and that no one can rescue me from your hand?

source: Nakhut tenin einasema, chule kalimhi nasuhto-a neimehtoh ahin; ahijeng vangin nangman neisumang tan ahi.
target: “Your hands shaped me and made me. Will you now turn and destroy me?

source: Geldoh in, nahenga kangeh ahi, nangman bonngan banga neisem ahin, chule leivui neisokit ding hitam?
target: Remember that you molded me like clay. Will you now turn me to dust again?

source: Nangman bongnoi banga neisunlhah hilou ham? chule bongnoiha banga neihatsah hilou ham?
target: Did you not pour me out like milk and curdle me like cheese,

source: Nangman vunle phen neitomin, chule gule thaguijin neikan chah-in ahi.
target: clothe me with skin and flesh and knit me together with bones and sinews?

source: Nangman hinkhole panpina chu neipen; chule neivil jingna chun kalhagao aching tupmin ahi.
target: You gave me life and showed me kindness, and in your providence watched over my spirit.

source: Chule hiche thilhohi nalungsunga naselin; hichehi nangma-ah aume ti kahei.
target: “But this is what you concealed in your heart, and I know that this was in your mind:

source: Keima kachonsetle nangman neimelchih-in, chule nangman kakhan setna jong don louvin neikoipoi.
target: If I sinned, you would be watching me and would not let my offense go unpunished.

source: Keima mikhangilou kanahile, ohe ada chu kahi! chule midih ana hijongleng khodah pong kate. Keima kiboina-in kadimtan; hijeh chun kahesohnahi hungvetan.
target: If I am guilty—woe to me! Even if I am innocent, I cannot lift my head, for I am full of shame and drowned in my affliction.

source: Ajehchu hichehi apungcheh tai. Nangman keipi bahkai hangtah bangin neidelin, chule nangman kachunga kidang tah-in nakitahlang kitnin ahi.
target: If I hold my head high, you stalk me like a lion and again display your awesome power against me.

source: Nangman keima douna-in hettohsahna athah-in napodoh-in; chule kachunga nalunghanna napunbe sahsah-in; kikhelna le galkisat hi keimato aumkhom jinge.
target: You bring new witnesses against me and increase your anger toward me; your forces come against me wave upon wave.

source: Ipijeh-a chu naobu-a kona chu neihinpuidoh hitam? Ohe, kalhagao chu kanalha hihen, mit khatchan jong einamu da hitale!
target: “Why then did you bring me out of the womb? I wish I had died before any eye saw me.

source: Keima ana umkhalou tobang hitadinga, naobu-a kona lhankhuh-a eikipo tading ahi.
target: If only I had never come into being, or had been carried straight from the womb to the grave!

source: Kanikho hi lhomcha hitalou ham? themkhat beh jong lungmonga kaum theina dingin, khongai jinlang, neichang lhatan.
target: Are not my few days almost over? Turn away from me so I can have a moment’s joy

source: Kilekit lounading mun, muthim gamle, thina le-lim gama kache masangin;
target: before I go to the place of no return, to the land of gloom and utter darkness,

source: Muthim gam, athima thim, chule thina le-lim, thupeh umtalou; chule vah jong muthim banga athim namun ahi.
target: to the land of deepest night, of utter darkness and disorder, where even the light is like darkness.”

source: Chujouvin Naamath mi Zophar chun adonbutnin, hitin aseije,
target: Then Zophar the Naamathite replied:

source: Thu hijatpihi donbut louva umthei dingham? chule mihem khatchu thusei tamjeh-a them kichanthei dingham?
target: “Are all these words to go unanswered? Is this talker to be vindicated?

source: Najou hohin miho asuhthip thei dingham? mi i-sah louva nabol tengle koiman eijumso ponte natiham?
target: Will your idle talk reduce others to silence? Will no one rebuke you when you mock?

source: Ajehchu nangman kathuhil hi athenge, chule namitmuva kangime natin ahi.
target: You say to God, ‘My beliefs are flawless and I am pure in your sight.’

source: Ahinla, oh! Pathen'in thu seihen lang, chule nangma douna-in akam kataleh;
target: Oh, how I wish that God would speak, that he would open his lips against you

source: Chutengle aman akisei chihna thuguh ho chu nangma namusah intin, hicheho chu hiche aumsa sanga hi achan ni-a tama ahin, Pathen'in nakhanset jala nathoh dingdol sanga lhomjo nachunga angeh ahi hi kihetnin.
target: and disclose to you the secrets of wisdom, for true wisdom has two sides. Know this: God has even forgotten some of your sin.

source: Nangman Pathen chu nahol vanga namudoh theiham? hat chungnung chu chamkim keija naholdoh thei dingham?
target: “Can you fathom the mysteries of God? Can you probe the limits of the Almighty?

source: Hichehi van banga sanga ahin, ipi nalo theiding ham? thikholkhul sanga thuhjo ahin, ipi nahetjou dingham?
target: They are higher than the heavens above—what can you do? They are deeper than the depths below—what can you know?

source: Atena chu leiset sanga saojo ahin, chule twikhanglen sanga jaojo ahi.
target: Their measure is longer than the earth and wider than the sea.

source: Aman tanbong hen, chule khahchah hen, ahiloule khomtup henlang hile koiham ama sutang jouding?
target: “If he comes along and confines you in prison and convenes a court, who can oppose him?

source: Ajehchu aman pannabei miho chu ahen; aman khan gitlounaho jongchu amunai; chuti ahileh aman hichu angaito louding ham?
target: Surely he recognizes deceivers; and when he sees evil, does he not take note?

source: Ajehchu gamlah sangan nou bangin mihem chu peng tajongle, pannabei mihem chu hungching ding ahi.
target: But the witless can no more become wise than a wild donkey’s colt can be born human.

source: Nangman nalungsung chu nagot tupma, nakhut teni-a ahenglam nasan dinga ahileh;
target: “Yet if you devote your heart to him and stretch out your hands to him,

source: khansetna chu nakhutna auma ahile, gamlatah-a koimangin, chule khan gitlouna chu naponbuh sunga chensah hih-in.
target: if you put away the sin that is in your hand and allow no evil to dwell in your tent,

source: Chutengle nolna umlouvin namai dadohsah-in natin; chule kichalouva nadindet ding ahitai.
target: then, free of fault, you will lift up your face; you will stand firm and without fear.

source: Ajehchu nangman nathohgimna chu suhmilin natin, chule akitol mangsa twiho banga nagelding ahitai.
target: You will surely forget your trouble, recalling it only as waters gone by.

source: Chule nahinkho hi sunlai sanga thengjoding, nangman navah nasodoh-a, jingkah toh nabahding ahi.
target: Life will be brighter than noonday, and darkness will become like morning.

source: Chule nangma huhtupma naum ding ahi, ajehchu hichea chun kinepna aumtan; henge, nangman nachung chang nakikhol ding; chule kihuhtupna mun'a nangma nacholngah ding ahi.
target: You will be secure, because there is hope; you will look about you and take your rest in safety.

source: Chule nangma lummin natin, koimachan nakichat sah tah louding, hiteng chule mitam tah-in nahenga ngehna anei diu ahitai.
target: You will lie down, with no one to make you afraid, and many will court your favor.

source: Ahinla mikhangilou ho mitvang chu losam ding, chule amaho hoidoh loudiu; chule akinepna chu alhagaovu lhadoh ding bou ahi.
target: But the eyes of the wicked will fail, and escape will elude them; their hope will become a dying gasp.”

source: Chuin Job'in adonbutnin, aseije.
target: Then Job replied:

source: Tahsanlel beihela nanghohi mipi chu nahiu ahitan, chule chihna toh nathitha diu ahi.
target: “Doubtless you are the only people who matter, and wisdom will die with you!

source: Ahinla keiman jong nangho bangin hetna kaneije, keima nangho sanga noinungjo deh kahipon; hiche hohi ahelou koi umem?
target: But I have a mind as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Who does not know all these things?

source: Keimahi Pathen kou-a amanjong ana donbutji, aheng akomaho i-sahlou mikhat tobang kahitan; midihtah nolnabei chu mi nuisatle ki-dah in aumtai.
target: “I have become a laughingstock to my friends, though I called on God and he answered— a mere laughingstock, though righteous and blameless!

source: Alhudinga kigosa umpa chu nomsa tah-a umpan alunga adeilou thaomei tobang ahi.
target: Those who are at ease have contempt for misfortune as the fate of those whose feet are slipping.

source: Gucha michomho ponbuh sungchu akhangtouvin, chule Pathen sulunghang ho jong huhtup in aumun; akhutnu Pathen'in apeneng chetnin ahi.
target: The tents of marauders are undisturbed, and those who provoke God are secure— those God has in his hand.

source: Ahinla tun gamsaho khu dongun, chuteng amahon nahil untin; chule chunga leng vachaho jongkhu dongun, amahon naseipeh dingu ahi.
target: “But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you;

source: Ahiloule leiset koma seijin, aman nahil intin, chule twikhanglen'a nga hon nahenga aphondoh diu ahi.
target: or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.

source: Hichehi Pakai khutnin atoh ahin, hicheng jouse-a kona hetheilou koiham?
target: Which of all these does not know that the hand of the Lord has done this?

source: Ama khutna ahingthei jouse hinna aumin; chule mihem jouse haina hu aumme.
target: In his hand is the life of every creature and the breath of all mankind.

source: Nakhangin thu jahding agotna, chule kammin a-anneh atepkhahji louham?
target: Does not the ear test words as the tongue tastes food?

source: Khanglui mite henga chihna aumin; chule hinkho sotna-a hetkhenna aume.
target: Is not wisdom found among the aged? Does not long life bring understanding?

source: Chihna le thahatna amatoh umkhom ahin, aman thumop le hetkhenthem theina aneije.
target: “To God belong wisdom and power; counsel and understanding are his.

source: Ven, aman aphelhan, akisadohkit theitapoi; aman mi akhakhumjin, chule akihongdoh kit theiji tapoi.
target: What he tears down cannot be rebuilt; those he imprisons cannot be released.

source: Ven, aman twiho atingin ahile ago gamtaovin; chule aman hicheho chu ahinsol doh-in ahile, amahon leiset achup jengun ahi.
target: If he holds back the waters, there is drought; if he lets them loose, they devastate the land.

source: Chihna thahatna chu amatoh auma ahin, akilhem lhapa le alhem lhapa chu ama-a ahi.
target: To him belong strength and insight; both deceived and deceiver are his.

source: Aman thumopthem ho chu achomgamjin, chule thutan ho chu mingol jeng asojitai.
target: He leads rulers away stripped and makes fools of judges.

source: Aman lengho kikanna alhaplhah pehjin, chule konggah-in akongu agahpehjin ahi.
target: He takes off the shackles put on by kings and ties a loincloth around their waist.

source: Aman pipuiho chu galthil kichom bangin apuimangjin, chule amihatteu chu asumangjin ahi.
target: He leads priests away stripped and overthrows officials long established.

source: Aman ginchat theitahpa thusei chu atolmangin, chule tehse ho hetkhen themna jongchu alahmang pehjin ahi.
target: He silences the lips of trusted advisers and takes away the discernment of elders.

source: Aman vaipoho chunga i-sah louna abunglhajin, chule mihatpa thahat chu alhahsam sahjin ahi.
target: He pours contempt on nobles and disarms the mighty.

source: Aman muthim lah-a thil kiselguh ho chu ahedohjin, chule thina le-lim chu vah-a ahin puidohjin ahi.
target: He reveals the deep things of darkness and brings utter darkness into the light.

source: Aman namho apunsah-in chule asumangjin; namho chu asulenin chule apuijang kitjin ahi.
target: He makes nations great, and destroys them; he enlarges nations, and disperses them.

source: Aman leiset mihemte alamkaipao lungthim chu alahmang pehjin, amahochu lampi umlouna gamthip laija chun avamahthah sahjin ahi.
target: He deprives the leaders of the earth of their reason; he makes them wander in a trackless waste.

source: Amaho chu vah beijin muthim lah-a chun akimailele jiuvin; chule aman amaho chu pasal jukham bangin avalon lelesah jin ahi.
target: They grope in darkness with no light; he makes them stagger like drunkards.

source: Veuvin kamit tah-in hicheng jousehi amukhanai, kanakhangin ajan, chule hichu kahekhen tan ahi.
target: “My eyes have seen all this, my ears have heard and understood it.

source: Ipi nahetnum, hiche jengjong chu keiman kahei, keima nangho sanga noinungjo deh kahipon ahi.
target: What you know, I also know; I am not inferior to you.

source: Tahbeh-in keiman hat chungnung hengah seijing ting, chule Pathen toh ngaito khomding kadeijin ahi.
target: But I desire to speak to the Almighty and to argue my case with God.

source: Ahin nangho jouthu bolho nahiuvin, nabonchao vin manlutna neilou louthem nahiuve.
target: You, however, smear me with lies; you are worthless physicians, all of you!

source: Oh, nanghohi thipbeh-in umthei tave leuchun! hichu nachihnao hiding ahi.
target: If only you would be altogether silent! For you, that would be wisdom.

source: Tun kalung ngaitohi ngaijun, chule kakam sunga kataonahi neingaipeh-un.
target: Hear now my argument; listen to the pleas of my lips.

source: Nanghon Pathen dinga gitlou na-a thu nasei dingu ham? chule amadinga lheplhahna thua nakihou dingu ham?
target: Will you speak wickedly on God’s behalf? Will you speak deceitfully for him?

source: Nanghon amachu nasan dingu ham? nanghon Pathen dinga nelkalna nanei dingu ham?
target: Will you show him partiality? Will you argue the case for God?

source: Aman nangho naholdoh diuhi pha hinam? ahiloule mikhatnin michom dangkhat anelpeh banga, nanghon ama hitia chu nanelpeh dingu ham?
target: Would it turn out well if he examined you? Could you deceive him as you might deceive a mortal?

source: Nanghon guhthima miho nasan ule, aman nangho napho teidingu ahi.
target: He would surely call you to account if you secretly showed partiality.

source: Chungnunna hin nangho natijat sah loudingu ham? chule ama ginna hi nachung uva chulouding ham?
target: Would not his splendor terrify you? Would not the dread of him fall on you?

source: Na kigeldohna jouseu chu vutvai tobangbou ahi, natahsao jong leingan tobang ahi.
target: Your maxims are proverbs of ashes; your defenses are defenses of clay.

source: Nangho thipbeh un, thu kasei theina dingin neichang lhaovin, kachunga ipi hunglhung ding hijongle hunglhung hen,
target: “Keep silent and let me speak; then let come to me what may.

source: Ipijeh-a kaha-a kasa hi kaketlhah-a, kahinkhohi kakhutna kakoi dingham?
target: Why do I put myself in jeopardy and take my life in my hands?

source: Aman eithat jongle katahsan jingding, ahin ama angsunga kalampihi katuhdet jingding ahi.
target: Though he slay me, yet will I hope in him; I will surely defend my ways to his face.

source: Ama kahuh hingna jong hiding ahi; ajehchu miphalhem koimacha a-anga lutlou ding ahi.
target: Indeed, this will turn out for my deliverance, for no godless person would dare come before him!

source: Kathuseihi phatechan ngai phaovin, chule kaphondoh hi nanakhangun ngaijun.
target: Listen carefully to what I say; let my words ring in your ears.

source: Tun veuvin, kathuhi kagong tuptai; keima them eiki chanding ahi ti kakihetne.
target: Now that I have prepared my case, I know I will be vindicated.

source: Keima eiseihu ding koiham? ajehchu tun keima thiptaleng kalhagao kalhadoh ding ahitai.
target: Can anyone bring charges against me? If so, I will be silent and die.

source: Kadingin thilni sehseh hi boldan, chutengle nangma-a konin keima kiselmang taponge.
target: “Only grant me these two things, God, and then I will not hide from you:

source: Keija konin gamlatah-in nakhut lamangin, chule natijat na-in neikichat sah hih-in.
target: Withdraw your hand far from me, and stop frightening me with your terrors.

source: Chutengle nangman neikouvin, keiman donbut nange, ahiloule keiman seijing ting chule neidonbut in.
target: Then summon me and I will answer, or let me speak, and you reply to me.

source: Kachonsetna le kakhan gitlounaho hi ijatloma tama hitam? Kasuh khelnale kachonsetna hohi neihetsah-in.
target: How many wrongs and sins have I committed? Show me my offense and my sin.

source: Ipijeh-a namai nasela, namelma-a neingaito ham?
target: Why do you hide your face and consider me your enemy?

source: Nangin suhle touva huijin alhohle thingna chu nahe ngem ding ham? Chule chang kung gosa nadel lele ding ham?
target: Will you torment a windblown leaf? Will you chase after dry chaff?

source: Ajehchu nangman keima douna-in thilse tah najih-in, chule kakhang donlaija khangitlouna jouse chu neichansah tai.
target: For you write down bitter things against me and make me reap the sins of my youth.

source: Nangman kakeng jong thinghom sung ho-a nakoijin; chule kalamlhah ho jouse hoitah-in navejingin, nangin kakengto teni-a din teptena nakoijin ahi.
target: You fasten my feet in shackles; you keep close watch on all my paths by putting marks on the soles of my feet.

source: Chule keima thil monsa tobang kahin, ngetnin aneh chaisa ponse tobang kahi.
target: “So man wastes away like something rotten, like a garment eaten by moths.

source: Numeija hung penga mihem hinkho hi nichomcha bou ahin, chule lungkham nan adimsetne.
target: “Mortals, born of woman, are of few days and full of trouble.

source: Pahcha bangin ahung pahdoh jin, chule akisat tan jitai; ama nilim kihei bangin alhaijin, atangden jitai.
target: They spring up like flowers and wither away; like fleeting shadows, they do not endure.

source: Hitobang bep mi khat hi nangin namit lhuh jinga, chule nahenga thu kitan dinga neipui lutjiham?
target: Do you fix your eye on them? Will you bring them before you for judgment?

source: Kon thilthenglou lah-a kona thiltheng alahdoh theijem? koima cha aumpoi.
target: Who can bring what is pure from the impure? No one!

source: Ama hin nikho hi tepsa ahin, ahinkho lha ho jong nangkoma umah ahin? aman akhokhel louna din nangin agamgi nasempeh-in;
target: A person’s days are determined; you have decreed the number of his months and have set limits he cannot exceed.

source: Thalah tobang ahin nikho hi, aman lhumkah-a acholdo theina din, ama-a konin kiheimangin.
target: So look away from him and let him alone, till he has put in his time like a hired laborer.

source: Ajehchu thingphung khat chu kiphuh lhu jongle, ajih ahung dondoh kitding le, chule hiche abah kisepthah chu atanden louding kinepna aneijin ahi.
target: “At least there is hope for a tree: If it is cut down, it will sprout again, and its new shoots will not fail.

source: Ajung chu leinoi'a motgam henlang, aphungbul chu leinoi'a thi jongle;
target: Its roots may grow old in the ground and its stump die in the soil,

source: Twija konin hichu hung mumdoh kitnintin, chule thingphung banga abah ahinsepdoh nahlai ding ahi.
target: yet at the scent of water it will bud and put forth shoots like a plant.

source: Ahin mihem athin, manthei louvin paimang ahijitai: henge, mihemin alhagao alhajin, hoija umji-a hitam?
target: But a man dies and is laid low; he breathes his last and is no more.

source: Twipia kona twiho alhahsam bangle, twisoh lai akana agot jeng bangin;
target: As the water of a lake dries up or a riverbed becomes parched and dry,

source: Hitichun mihem chu a-imu miljin, athoudohji tapoi; vanho jouse abeito kahse-a amaho khang taloudiu, alupnaova kona thou jong thou taloudiu ahitai.
target: so he lies down and does not rise; till the heavens are no more, people will not awake or be roused from their sleep.

source: O nangin nalungsatna abeikah-a guh thima neikoija, lhan khuh sunga hi neisel ding hija; nangin keija dinga phat khat neitep peh-a, chule neigeldoh kit ding hitavele!
target: “If only you would hide me in the grave and conceal me till your anger has passed! If only you would set me a time and then remember me!

source: Mihem khat athile ahingkit dem? kakikhelna ding nikho ahung lhun kah-a, keiman eikiteppeh phat nikho ho chu kanga ding ahi.
target: If someone dies, will they live again? All the days of my hard service I will wait for my renewal to come.

source: Nangman neikouvin natin, keima kahou ding; nangman nakhutsem chunga hi ngaichat nahin neiding ahi.
target: You will call and I will answer you; you will long for the creature your hands have made.

source: Ajehchu tun nangin kakalse jat nasima; chule kachonsetna hi navet lhih jing hilouham?
target: Surely then you will count my steps but not keep track of my sin.

source: Kasuhkhelna hi sakhao sunga khumtupmin aumin, chule kakhan gitlouna nangin nakhui chahjin ahi.
target: My offenses will be sealed up in a bag; you will cover over my sin.

source: Chule thonlou hella molsang hung chimma ahal halla mang ding, chule songpi chu aumna-a kona kitoldoh ding ahi.
target: “But as a mountain erodes and crumbles and as a rock is moved from its place,

source: Twijin song ho alhoh mangin; nangin leivui lah-a kona hung kehdoh thil jouse chu twijin nasumangin, chule mihem kinepna chu nasumang tan ahi.
target: as water wears away stones and torrents wash away the soil, so you destroy a person’s hope.

source: Nangin ama a-imatih-a din najouvin, ama achetai; nangin amaiso nakhel peh-in chule nasolmangtan ahi.
target: You overpower them once for all, and they are gone; you change their countenance and send them away.

source: Achapate chu jabolna pedin ahungun, ahin aman hichu ahetapoi; amaho suhnemin aumtaovin, ahin aman amaho ageldoh tapon ahi.
target: If their children are honored, they do not know it; if their offspring are brought low, they do not see it.

source: Ahinla atahsa chun natna athoh ding, chule ama-a um hinna chun pul adou ding ahi.
target: They feel but the pain of their own bodies and mourn only for themselves.”

source: Chujouvin Teman mi Eliphaz'in adonbutnin, aseije,
target: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:

source: Michingin pannabei thu aseidohjia, chule solam huija asung asuhdim ji-em?
target: “Would a wise person answer with empty notions or fill their belly with the hot east wind?

source: Aman phatchomna umlou thu kisei chu anel ding ham? ahiloule thilpha bolna theilou thu aseiding ham?
target: Would they argue with useless words, with speeches that have no value?

source: Ahi, nangin kichatna napaimangin, chule Pathen anga taona nasutange.
target: But you even undermine piety and hinder devotion to God.

source: Ajehchu nakamin nakhangit louna aphondoh-a, chule doha lheplhahna lei chu nakilhen ahitai.
target: Your sin prompts your mouth; you adopt the tongue of the crafty.

source: Nakamin nangma themmo nachan ahin, keima kahipoi; henge, namuh-in nangma dounan thu ahettohsah-in ahi.
target: Your own mouth condemns you, not mine; your own lips testify against you.

source: Ana peng masapenah mihem chu nangma nahim? ahiloule mol le lhangho masanga ana kisema chu nangma nahim?
target: “Are you the first man ever born? Were you brought forth before the hills?

source: Nangin Pathen thuguh chu najahkhah am? chule chihna hi nangma sehseh-in naneija nangaito ham?
target: Do you listen in on God’s council? Do you have a monopoly on wisdom?

source: Keihon kahet louvu nangin ipi nahet em? keiho-a umlou nangin ipi hetthemna naneijem?
target: What do you know that we do not know? What insights do you have that we do not have?

source: Kalah uvah napa sanga gamchenga upajo, lukangle, tehsejo a-umui.
target: The gray-haired and the aged are on our side, men even older than your father.

source: Pathen'a kona lhamona hohi nadinga thilneo ham? nadinga aguh-a um thil ipi umem?
target: Are God’s consolations not enough for you, words spoken gently to you?

source: Ipi dinga nalungin nangma napuimang hitam? chule namit nin ipi aphet lhap lhap piham?
target: Why has your heart carried you away, and why do your eyes flash,

source: Hitia chu nalhagao Pathen douna-a naleheija, chule nakama kona hitobang thuho hi naso dohsah hitam?
target: so that you vent your rage against God and pour out such words from your mouth?

source: Mihem chu ipi hija theng tei ding hija ham? numeija kona penga chu chonpha teiding hija ham?
target: “What are mortals, that they could be pure, or those born of woman, that they could be righteous?

source: Veovin, aman amithengte lah-a tahsana akoipoi; henge, ama mitmun van ho jong atheng pouvin ahi.
target: If God places no trust in his holy ones, if even the heavens are not pure in his eyes,

source: Khan gitlouna twi banga donna mihem hi, ichanna lenjo-a thet umle theng lou jocheh-a hitam?
target: how much less mortals, who are vile and corrupt, who drink up evil like water!

source: Ngaijin, keiman navetsah-inge; chule kamu tah chu kaphon doh ding ahin;
target: “Listen to me and I will explain to you; let me tell you what I have seen,

source: Miching hon apateova kona anaseiju, chule aselmang louvu;
target: what the wise have declared, hiding nothing received from their ancestors

source: Hitobang miho henga bou chun leiset hi anakipen, gamchom mi alah uva vahlea aumpoi.
target: (to whom alone the land was given when no foreigners moved among them):

source: Mi khang gilou chun ahinkho lhum keijin natna athoh-in, chule ahinkho kum jat chu misugenthei pa-a akiselin ahi.
target: All his days the wicked man suffers torment, the ruthless man through all the years stored up for him.

source: Tijat umtah awgin chu anakhanga agingin; aphatthei laitahle mi sumangpa achunga hung lhung ding ahi.
target: Terrifying sounds fill his ears; when all seems well, marauders attack him.

source: Muthima kona kiledoh ding kahi ti aman atahsan joupon, aman alouna ding chemjam chu angah-in ahi.
target: He despairs of escaping the realm of darkness; he is marked for the sword.

source: Ama an holnan avah kimvelin, hoija uma hitam? atin, thimjin nikho gotsa chu ahungnai tai, ti ahen ahi.
target: He wanders about for food like a vulture; he knows the day of darkness is at hand.

source: Lungkhamna le lung genthei na-in ama akichatsah ding; leng khat galsat dinga akigot banga, amahon ama ajokhupdio ahi.
target: Distress and anguish fill him with terror; troubles overwhelm him, like a king poised to attack,

source: Ajehchu aman akhut Pathen dounan alhangdoh-in, hat chungnung pen douna-in amale ama aki suhatnin,
target: because he shakes his fist at God and vaunts himself against the Almighty,

source: Ama, ama chungle angong chang chung gei, chule alum satah ho chunga chun alhailen ahi.
target: defiantly charging against him with a thick, strong shield.

source: Ajehchu aman amai chu athaovin atomin, ataija chun athao akikhol khome.
target: “Though his face is covered with fat and his waist bulges with flesh,

source: Suhmanga umdinga gotsa, koimacha chen khah louna, khopi kamhelsa-a um inho-a chun ama achengin ahi.
target: he will inhabit ruined towns and houses where no one lives, houses crumbling to rubble.

source: Ama haodoh lou ding, anei agou jong umjing lou ding, aman leisetna hiche ho-a chu ninglhinna aneisot lou ding ahi.
target: He will no longer be rich and his wealth will not endure, nor will his possessions spread over the land.

source: Ama muthima kona potdoh talou ding; meikongin abahho chu aleo got ding, chule akama ahaina hu-a chu ama jammang ding ahi.
target: He will not escape the darkness; a flame will wither his shoots, and the breath of God’s mouth will carry him away.

source: Ama chu ahomkeo tahsan dinga kilhemlha-a hihih hen; ajehchu ama kilethuhna ding chu ahomkeo ahibouve.
target: Let him not deceive himself by trusting what is worthless, for he will get nothing in return.

source: Hiche hi ama phat masanga kisu bulhit ding, chuleh ama bah chu ana hing lou ding ahi.
target: Before his time he will wither, and his branches will not flourish.

source: Aman lengpithei banga amin lou agaho chu aholhah ding, chule apah chu olive banga apaidoh ding ahi.
target: He will be like a vine stripped of its unripe grapes, like an olive tree shedding its blossoms.

source: Ajehchu miphalhem kikhomho chu kamhel ding, nehguhna houbuh chu meija kisumang ding ahi.
target: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of those who love bribes.

source: Amahon thilphalou naovop in avopmun, ahomkeo ahungsoh-in, lheplhahna chu a-oijuva akigongjin ahi.
target: They conceive trouble and give birth to evil; their womb fashions deceit.”

source: chuin Job'in adonbutnin, aseije,
target: Then Job replied:

source: Keiman hitobang thil ho tamtah kajai, mi sugenthei dinga lhamon sah-a panga chu nangho nahiuve.
target: “I have heard many things like these; you are miserable comforters, all of you!

source: Pannabei thuho hin akichaina aneijem? ahiloule ipin nasuh thouva hitia chu nadonbut ham?
target: Will your long-winded speeches never end? What ails you that you keep on arguing?

source: Nahinnao hi keima hinna khela hinga hileh, kenjong nangho bangin kaseithei ding ahin; nangho douna-a thuho kasei doh ding, chule kalu hi kathin khum ding nahiuve.
target: I also could speak like you, if you were in my place; I could make fine speeches against you and shake my head at you.

source: Ahin kakamin nangho suhatning ting, kakama kona pot thu chun nahahsat nao angaijang ding ahi.
target: But my mouth would encourage you; comfort from my lips would bring you relief.

source: Keiman seijong leng kahesohna hi oldom dehponte, chule keiman thoh thoh jong leng ipiham kanopna ding?
target: “Yet if I speak, my pain is not relieved; and if I refrain, it does not go away.

source: Ahin, tun aman eithacholsah ahitan, nangin kagol kapai ho jouse nasuh kamhel ahitai.
target: Surely, God, you have worn me out; you have devastated my entire household.

source: Chule keima douna-a hettohsah din nangman kapuma tivoijin neikoijin; chule kamaija hettohsahna hidin, katahsa agong lhan ahi.
target: You have shriveled me up—and it has become a witness; my gauntness rises up and testifies against me.

source: Aman alung hanna-a eibottelin, keima eihotai; aman kachunga aha eigel khumin; kamelman mitsal tengin eive-e.
target: God assails me and tears me in his anger and gnashes his teeth at me; my opponent fastens on me his piercing eyes.

source: Amahon kachunga akamu lentah-in akah-un; isahlou tah-in kabengphe abengun; keima dounan amaho akikhom khomun ahi.
target: People open their mouths to jeer at me; they strike my cheek in scorn and unite together against me.

source: Pathen'in ama ngaisah lou mite henga eipedoh-in, khang giloute khutna eipaidoh tan ahi.
target: God has turned me over to the ungodly and thrown me into the clutches of the wicked.

source: Keima nom-in kana umin, ahin aman ahal halin eisuchiptan; aman kalollin jong eimanin, eithingin, ama bidoija din eitungdoh-e.
target: All was well with me, but he shattered me; he seized me by the neck and crushed me. He has made me his target;

source: Athal kap hon eium kimvelun, aman kakalteni khenlouhellin asukhenin; kathinkha tolla asung lhan ahi.
target: his archers surround me. Without pity, he pierces my kidneys and spills my gall on the ground.

source: Aman setna chunga setna-in eisusetan, kachunga milen mihat tah bangin alhailen ahi.
target: Again and again he bursts upon me; he rushes at me like a warrior.

source: Katahsa vou chunga hin khaodip pon kakikhun, chule leivui lah-a hin kaki asuboh tai.
target: “I have sewed sackcloth over my skin and buried my brow in the dust.

source: Kamai hi kaka kanan asan dohtan, kamitgeiho hi thina le-lim alange.
target: My face is red with weeping, dark shadows ring my eyes;

source: Kakhut tenihi thildihlou imacha-a din kamangpon; kataona jong hi atheng ahi.
target: yet my hands have been free of violence and my prayer is pure.

source: Vo leiset, nangin kathisan hi vuhmang hih-in, chuleh kaka nahin mun neihih hen.
target: “Earth, do not cover my blood; may my cry never be laid to rest!

source: Chujongle tun, veuvin, keima hettohsahna chu van'a aume, chuleh kathu kichinna bu chu chungsanga aume.
target: Even now my witness is in heaven; my advocate is on high.

source: Kagol tehon nasahmon eibolun; ahinla kamit lhihi Pathen heng lama along jinge.
target: My intercessor is my friend as my eyes pour out tears to God;

source: Mihem khat a-inheng dinga atao bangin, mihem khat dinga mikhat Pathen'a taopeh ding uma hile o!
target: on behalf of a man he pleads with God as one pleads for a friend.

source: Kum phabep ahung lhunteng, hung kile kit lounading mun'a chu keima kache ding ahitai.
target: “Only a few years will pass before I take the path of no return.

source: Kahaina hi akemtan; kahin nikho hojong alhasuhtan, keima dinga lhan khuh ho chu gotsa ahitai.
target: My spirit is broken, my days are cut short, the grave awaits me.

source: Mi nelpeh ho chu kakoma um hilou ham? ami phin lunghang nao hi kamitnin avet lhih jing hilou ham?
target: Surely mockers surround me; my eyes must dwell on their hostility.

source: Tun, keima nanga dinga kitepna khat nin nei umsah-in; keima to kikhutsan ding chu koiham?
target: “Give me, O God, the pledge you demand. Who else will put up security for me?

source: Ajeh chu nangman alung thimu chu hetthem theina-a konin nasel mangpeh-in; hijeh-a chu amaho nachoisang louding ahi.
target: You have closed their minds to understanding; therefore you will not let them triumph.

source: Agol apaiho henga pachat lhem thuseipa chu, achate mit ngeijong khomulouva umding ahi.
target: If anyone denounces their friends for reward, the eyes of their children will fail.

source: Mite seichah thei din jong aman eisem dohtan; chule phat masalaija chu min achil aset khum mi tobang kana hi.
target: “God has made me a byword to everyone, a man in whose face people spit.

source: Kahesoh na jeh in kamit jong hi athimin, katibah hojong nilim kihei abangtan ahi.
target: My eyes have grown dim with grief; my whole frame is but a shadow.

source: Milungdih hochun hiche hi kidang saovintin, themona neilou michu miphalhem dounan amale ama kitildoh inte.
target: The upright are appalled at this; the innocent are aroused against the ungodly.

source: Michonphan alampi jong kituh chah intin, chule akhutho thengsella umsah jingpa chu hatcheh cheh ding ahi.
target: Nevertheless, the righteous will hold to their ways, and those with clean hands will grow stronger.

source: Ahin nangho jouse vang, tun hungkile kitnun lang, hungun,; ajeh chu keiman nalah uva hin miching khat jong kamu doh joupoi.
target: “But come on, all of you, try again! I will not find a wise man among you.

source: Kahin nikhoho achetan, kathil gon hole kalunga kagelho jeng jong abonin achavaitai.
target: My days have passed, my plans are shattered. Yet the desires of my heart

source: Hicheho chun jan chu sun aso-un; muthim jeh-in khovah achome.
target: turn night into day; in the face of the darkness light is near.

source: Keiman ngah taleng, lhankhuh chu ka-in ahitan; ka jalkhun chu muthim lah-a kakisemtan ahi.
target: If the only home I hope for is the grave, if I spread out my bed in the realm of darkness,

source: Keiman monmang thei jah-a chun, nangma kapa nahi; lung jah-a chun, nangma kanule kasopinu chu nahi, kati.
target: if I say to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother’ or ‘My sister,’

source: Achutile tu-a kakinepna chu hoija umtam? kakinepna vangchu kon amuding hitam?
target: where then is my hope— who can see any hope for me?

source: Leivui toh kichoh halla kicholdo kahung hitenguleh, amaho aki khahtup kotong lam jona chu chesuh ding ahiuve.
target: Will it go down to the gates of death? Will we descend together into the dust?”

source: Chujouvin Shuh mi Bildad nin adonbutnin, aseije,
target: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:

source: Thuho nachaina ding chu itih chan hiding ham? melchih-in, chujouteng keihon seijuvinge.
target: “When will you end these speeches? Be sensible, and then we can talk.

source: Ipijeh-a keiho gamsa-a eiki simuva, chule namitmu-a man mo-a eikigelu ham?
target: Why are we regarded as cattle and considered stupid in your sight?

source: Alung hanna-a amale ama kimal teljia; nang dinga leiset hi kidalha ding ham? chule songpi chu aumna-a kona kichondoh ding ham?
target: You who tear yourself to pieces in your anger, is the earth to be abandoned for your sake? Or must the rocks be moved from their place?

source: Henge, mi khang gilou meivah chu kisumit ding, chule ameikonga meisi chu vahdoh louding ahi.
target: “The lamp of a wicked man is snuffed out; the flame of his fire stops burning.

source: Ahoubuh sunga meivah chu thimding, chule athaomei chu ama puma kisuhmit thading ahi.
target: The light in his tent becomes dark; the lamp beside him goes out.

source: Athahat lai kalsena ho chu kisu chom ding, amatah thumopna chun ama asotlhah ding ahi.
target: The vigor of his step is weakened; his own schemes throw him down.

source: Ajeh chu amatah kengchun ama lenthang sunga akhumlutna, chule ama thang kikam chunga vahlea ahi.
target: His feet thrust him into a net; he wanders into its mesh.

source: Thangin akhotal jum-a akhi khah ding, chule gucha michompa chun ama ajo ding ahi.
target: A trap seizes him by the heel; a snare holds him fast.

source: Ama dinga thang kikam chu leinoi'a akivuijin, athangchu lampia akidoi.
target: A noose is hidden for him on the ground; a trap lies in his path.

source: Tijatna hon ning jouse-a ama akichatsah ding, akeng geija ahin no ding ahi.
target: Terrors startle him on every side and dog his every step.

source: Athahatna chu gilkel thohna hung hintin, chule manthah na chu ama-a gotsa hiding ahi.
target: Calamity is hungry for him; disaster is ready for him when he falls.

source: Hichun atichung vun thaneina chu aval lhum ding; thina peng masapen ngeichun athahatna avallhum ding ahi.
target: It eats away parts of his skin; death’s firstborn devours his limbs.

source: Ama thil tahsana chu a houbuh sunga kona kila dohding, hichun ama tijat umtah lengpa henga ahin lhut ding ahi.
target: He is torn from the security of his tent and marched off to the king of terrors.

source: Hichu ama houbuh sunga hung cheng inte, ajeh chu ama-a khatcha ahitapoi; ama chena chunga chu meile kaat kithejal ding ahi.
target: Fire resides in his tent; burning sulfur is scattered over his dwelling.

source: Ajung ho chu noilanga gopgamin tin, chule chung langa abah chu kisat lha ding ahi.
target: His roots dry up below and his branches wither above.

source: Ama kigeldoh jingna chu leisetna kona mangding, chule aman khopi lamlena min kiphah pohna aneilou ding ahitai.
target: The memory of him perishes from the earth; he has no name in the land.

source: Ama khovah-a konin muthim lah-a nodoh-in umintin, chule vannoi'a kona kideldoh hiding ahi.
target: He is driven from light into the realm of darkness and is banished from the world.

source: Aman amite lah-a achapa le asopiten ahin chapate aneilou ding, chujongle achena sung ho-a ahinga um umlou ding ahi.
target: He has no offspring or descendants among his people, no survivor where once he lived.

source: Ana che masa hon tijatna ana nei banguva, ama nunga hung ho chu ama nikho nileh kidang asah diu ahi.
target: People of the west are appalled at his fate; those of the east are seized with horror.

source: Tahbeh-a hitobang hi mi khang gilouho chena chu ahin, chule hiche hi Pathen hepha louho mun chu ahi.
target: Surely such is the dwelling of an evil man; such is the place of one who does not know God.”

source: Chuin Job'in adonbutnin, aseije:
target: Then Job replied:

source: Nanghon itihchan kahina hi nasuhgenthei uva, chule thua ahal hala suhchip ding neigotnu hitam?
target: “How long will you torment me and crush me with words?

source: Hiche somvei jenhi i-sah louvin neibolun; kahenga hetkhah lou mibanga nachonu hi jachatnan naneipouvin ahi.
target: Ten times now you have reproached me; shamelessly you attack me.

source: Chule bolkhel kanei hijeng jongle, kadihlouna chu keima-a umding ahi.
target: If it is true that I have gone astray, my error remains my concern alone.

source: Tahbeh-a keidouna-a nangho kichoisang nahiule, i-sah louva eikibol nahi keima douna-a nelkalna mang nahiule;
target: If indeed you would exalt yourselves above me and use my humiliation against me,

source: Tun heovin, Pathen'in keima eisot lhah ahitan, chule alen thang chun eiumkivel ahitai.
target: then know that God has wronged me and drawn his net around me.

source: Veovin, keiman dihlou na-a konin kasamin, ahin eikijah peh tapoi; hatah-in kasamin, ahinla thutana ima aumpoi.
target: “Though I cry, ‘Violence!’ I get no response; though I call for help, there is no justice.

source: Keima kache thei louna din, aman kalamlhah na-ah pal agenin, chule kalam lhahna-a thim ajin sah-in ahi.
target: He has blocked my way so I cannot pass; he has shrouded my paths in darkness.

source: Aman kaloupina eiho lhah peh-in, chule kalua konin lallukhuh aladoh-in ahi.
target: He has stripped me of my honor and removed the crown from my head.

source: Aman keima lam jouse-a eisumang tan, keima akichai kahitai, chule aman kakinepna hi thingphung banga abodoh ahitai.
target: He tears me down on every side till I am gone; he uproots my hope like a tree.

source: Aman keima dounan alungsatna jong akoudoh sah-in, chule amelma holah-a khat bangin eisimtai.
target: His anger burns against me; he counts me among his enemies.

source: Agalsat mite ahung khomun, keima douna din lampi akisemun, chule kahoubuh kimvela gebuh akisonun ahi.
target: His troops advance in force; they build a siege ramp against me and encamp around my tent.

source: Aman kasopite keija konin gamlatah-in akoijin, chule keima kimel hetpi hojong tahbeh-a keija kona achoma umdoh ahitaove.
target: “He has alienated my family from me; my acquaintances are completely estranged from me.

source: Ka-in kote alosamtan, chule kaki ngailutpi gol le paihon eisumil taovin ahi.
target: My relatives have gone away; my closest friends have forgotten me.

source: Keima in'a cheng mite le kasoh numei hon gamchom min eisim taovin; amitmu uvin gamchom mi kahitai.
target: My guests and my female servants count me a foreigner; they look on me as on a stranger.

source: Keiman kasohpa kakouvin, ahin aman eidonbutpon; kakam tah-in ahenga kataovin ahi.
target: I summon my servant, but he does not answer, though I beg him with my own mouth.

source: Kahaina hu hi ka-inneipi-a dingin ajatchom tan, ka-insungmite dinga jong deimo-um kahitai.
target: My breath is offensive to my wife; I am loathsome to my own family.

source: Ahi, khangdong chapanghon i-sah louvin eibolun; kakipatdoh in ahile, keidouna thu aseijun ahi.
target: Even the little boys scorn me; when I appear, they ridicule me.

source: Kaki ngailutpi tah golle paihon eihot bolun; kangailut ho chu keima douvin apang taovin ahi.
target: All my intimate friends detest me; those I love have turned against me.

source: Kagu hi kavunle kaphe toh akikamat tan, keima kahani vun sehseh toh hoidoh kahi.
target: I am nothing but skin and bones; I have escaped only by the skin of my teeth.

source: O nangho kagol kapaiten neilungset nun, neilungsetnun; ajeh chu Pathen khut chun eitong khatan ahi.
target: “Have pity on me, my friends, have pity, for the hand of God has struck me.

source: Ipi dinga Pathen'in eibol genthei banga nanghon neibol genthei uva, katahsa thoh nahohi phaset nasah loulai uham?
target: Why do you pursue me as God does? Will you never get enough of my flesh?

source: Ohe, tun kathu hohi sutlutnin umtavele! Ohe, hiho chu lekhabua kitat doh-a hita vele!
target: “Oh, that my words were recorded, that they were written on a scroll,

source: Hiho chu thih lekhabu sutna mol chule ngenin songpi chunga, a-itih-a dinga kigeitong hitavele!
target: that they were inscribed with an iron tool on lead, or engraved in rock forever!

source: Ajeh chu eilhatdohpa chu ahingin, chule ninunung lamle leiset chunga hung ding ding ahi, ti kahei.
target: I know that my redeemer lives, and that in the end he will stand on the earth.

source: Chule kavun bannin hiche katahsa hi lunghon ne manghel jeng jongleu, katahsa tah-a Pathen chu kamu ding ahi.
target: And after my skin has been destroyed, yet in my flesh I will see God;

source: Kasunga kalung thimgil jun manghel tajongle, keima-a dinga ama chu kamu ding, chule kamit teni-a kavet ding, adang ima kamulou ding ahi.
target: I myself will see him with my own eyes—I, and not another. How my heart yearns within me!

source: Ajehchu keija thiljouse bul akimudoh chu namudiu ipidinga eihon ama isuh genthei diuham? nati diu ahi.
target: “If you say, ‘How we will hound him, since the root of the trouble lies in him,’

source: Chemjam chu nanghon kichaovin; ajeh chu thutana aume ti nahet theina dinguva, lung hana chun gimbolna chemjam ahin lhut ding ahi.
target: you should fear the sword yourselves; for wrath will bring punishment by the sword, and then you will know that there is judgment.”

source: Chuin Naamath mi Zophar'in adonbutnin, aseije;
target: Then Zophar the Naamathite replied:

source: Hijeh chun kalunggel hohin eidonbut sah-in, hiche thua ka kinon ahi.
target: “My troubled thoughts prompt me to answer because I am greatly disturbed.

source: Keima ima eikisahlouna thu kajan, kahetthem theina lhagao chun donbutnin eitin ahi.
target: I hear a rebuke that dishonors me, and my understanding inspires me to reply.

source: Leiset chunga mihem aki koija pat, nangman hiche thului hi nahetlou ham?
target: “Surely you know how it has been from of old, ever since mankind was placed on the earth,

source: Hitia chu migilou kichoisang na hi chomcha bou ahin, chule miphalhem kipana jong mitphetkah bou hilou ham?
target: that the mirth of the wicked is brief, the joy of the godless lasts but a moment.

source: Alul nachun vanho chan pha henlang, aluchun meibol ho lah phajongle;
target: Though the pride of the godless person reaches to the heavens and his head touches the clouds,

source: Ama a-imatih chana a-eh banga mangthah ding; ama anamu kha-a miho chun, ama hoija um hitam? atidiu ahi.
target: he will perish forever, like his own dung; those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’

source: Ama mang banga leng manga, kimudoh lou ding ahitan; jana gaothilmu banga ama delmanga umding ahi.
target: Like a dream he flies away, no more to be found, banished like a vision of the night.

source: Ama anamua mit jong chun ama amukit tah louding; chujongle ama ana-umna mun jong chun ama amukit lou ding ahitai.
target: The eye that saw him will not see him again; his place will look on him no more.

source: Achaten mivaicha lunglhaina ding hin holuntin, chule akhutnin athilhou alepeh kitding ahi.
target: His children must make amends to the poor; his own hands must give back his wealth.

source: Aguho chu akhang dong laija chonsetna adimin, hiche chu amato leivui lah-a luptha ding ahi.
target: The youthful vigor that fills his bones will lie with him in the dust.

source: Gitlouna chu a akam sunga lhumlheh henlang, aman hichu alei noija seljongle;
target: “Though evil is sweet in his mouth and he hides it under his tongue,

source: Aman hichu khendoh hen, chule notthap dahen, akamsunga chuti koiden tajongle;
target: though he cannot bear to let it go and lets it linger in his mouth,

source: A-oija um anchu akikhelin, asungah gulse thinkha asohtan ahi.
target: yet his food will turn sour in his stomach; it will become the venom of serpents within him.

source: Aman haonaho aval lutnin, chule ahin lohdoh kit ding; Pathen'in a-oija kona ahin paidoh ding ahi.
target: He will spit out the riches he swallowed; God will make his stomach vomit them up.

source: Aman gulseho gu achepding; gulse leijin ama atha ding ahi.
target: He will suck the poison of serpents; the fangs of an adder will kill him.

source: Aman vadungho le twisohho, khoiju le bongnoi lona vachadung ho amulou ding ahitai.
target: He will not enjoy the streams, the rivers flowing with honey and cream.

source: Aman acholna man alepehdoh kitna, chule hichu aman aval lhum louding; athil nei dungjuija alepeh kitna jong hiding, aman hichea chu lung lhaina anei louding ahi.
target: What he toiled for he must give back uneaten; he will not enjoy the profit from his trading.

source: Ajeh chu aman mivaicha agotchepmin, anungsunin; chule aman asahdoh hilou in chu pumhatnin alapeh-in ahi.
target: For he has oppressed the poor and left them destitute; he has seized houses he did not build.

source: Thonlou hella aman asunga damna aneilou ding, chule angaichat ho imacha ahuhdoh jou louding ahi.
target: “Surely he will have no respite from his craving; he cannot save himself by his treasure.

source: A-anneh na-a amoh kidalha khatcha umlou ding; hijeh-a chu koiman aphatna amulouding ahitai.
target: Nothing is left for him to devour; his prosperity will not endure.

source: Aninglhina pentah chun ama agentheisah ding, khang gilou ho khut jouse chu achunga hung chuding ahi.
target: In the midst of his plenty, distress will overtake him; the full force of misery will come upon him.

source: A-oipoh suhdim ding agot petle, Pathen'in alungsatna chu achunga ahin selhah-a, a-anneh laitah leh hichu achunga go banga julha ding ahi.
target: When he has filled his belly, God will vent his burning anger against him and rain down his blows on him.

source: Ama thih-a kisem manchah-a kona jam ding, chule thihtah-a kisem thal chun ama asut pailet ding ahi.
target: Though he flees from an iron weapon, a bronze-tipped arrow pierces him.

source: Akiloidoh-in, atahsa-a kon chun ahung dohtan ahi; ahi, chemjam val lahlah chu athinkha-a konin ahung doh-in; tijat umtah ho chu achunga achutai.
target: He pulls it out of his back, the gleaming point out of his liver. Terrors will come over him;

source: Muthim jouse chu guthim muna selmanga umding; huijin asemmit joulou meikongin akah vamding; aponbuh sunga kidalha chu ama dinga natna hiding ahi.
target: total darkness lies in wait for his treasures. A fire unfanned will consume him and devour what is left in his tent.

source: Van'in ama khangitlouna chu hin phongdoh-in tin; chule leiset chu ama dou dinga hung thoudoh ding ahi.
target: The heavens will expose his guilt; the earth will rise up against him.

source: A-insung khantouna chun adalhah ding, chule athilkeo ho chu Ama lungsatna nikhole long mang ding ahitai.
target: A flood will carry off his house, rushing waters on the day of God’s wrath.

source: Hiche hi migilou pa chanding Pathen'a kon chu ahin, chule Pathen'in ateppeh goulo chu ahitan ahi.
target: Such is the fate God allots the wicked, the heritage appointed for them by God.”

source: Ahinla Job'in adonbutnin, aseije:
target: Then Job replied:

source: Kathusei hi lunglut tah-in ngaijun, chule hiche hi nangho kilhamona hihen.
target: “Listen carefully to my words; let this be the consolation you give me.

source: Keiman kasei theina din thoh hamham tadiuvin; chule kasei chai tengle nei nelpeh naovin nate.
target: Bear with me while I speak, and after I have spoken, mock on.

source: Keima vang, kakiphina hi mihem lama ham? chuti chu hia ahile, ipi dinga kalhagao suhboija umlou ding ham?
target: “Is my complaint directed to a human being? Why should I not be impatient?

source: Neimel chih unlang kidang saovin, chule nakhut nun nakam simun.
target: Look at me and be appalled; clap your hand over your mouth.

source: Keiman kageldoh teng jongle kati ajan, chule katahsa hi akithing jin ahi.
target: When I think about this, I am terrified; trembling seizes my body.

source: Ipi dinga migilouhi hing jinga, hung tehji-a; chule thahat thaneitah hijiuva ham?
target: Why do the wicked live on, growing old and increasing in power?

source: Achateu chu amaho mitmu tah-in amaho toh phudoh than aumin, chule achilhahteu chu amaho maikoh-a phudoh-in aume.
target: They see their children established around them, their offspring before their eyes.

source: A-in hou chu kichatna-a konin ahoidoh-in, achunguva Pathen lungsatna moljong achujipon ahi.
target: Their homes are safe and free from fear; the rod of God is not on them.

source: Abongchal houvin anou ahinsah-un, athona aumpon; abongpiu houvin anou ahingun, anou adalha khapon ahi.
target: Their bulls never fail to breed; their cows calve and do not miscarry.

source: Amahon achateu chu ganchahon bangin asoldoh jiuvin, acha teo alam alam jiuvin ahi.
target: They send forth their children as a flock; their little ones dance about.

source: Amahon khongcha le selangdah akichoijun, tumging kitumgin na-a chun akipah-un ahi.
target: They sing to the music of timbrel and lyre; they make merry to the sound of the pipe.

source: Amahon ahin nikhou chu haosatnan amang jiuvin, chom louvin lhan khuh-a achesuh ji taove.
target: They spend their years in prosperity and go down to the grave in peace.

source: Hijeh chun amahon Pathen henga, keiho-a konin potdoh tan; ajeh chu nalampi ho hetkhen theina chu keihon kangaicha pouve, atiuve.
target: Yet they say to God, ‘Leave us alone! We have no desire to know your ways.

source: Keihon kajendiu Hat chungnung amachu ipiham? Keiho ahenga kataovule ipi phatchomna kanei diuham?
target: Who is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What would we gain by praying to him?’

source: Veovin, athilu chu akhutnuva aumpon; migilou thumopna chu keija konin gamla tah-in aumin ahi.
target: But their prosperity is not in their own hands, so I stand aloof from the plans of the wicked.

source: Mikhang gilou thaomei chu ichana kimutmit matchet jinga hitam! chule amanthahna chu achunguva ichana lhung matchet hitam! Pathen'in alungsatna-a lung gentheina hi ahom dohjie.
target: “Yet how often is the lamp of the wicked snuffed out? How often does calamity come upon them, the fate God allots in his anger?

source: Amaho huipi masanga chang kong gosa tobang ahiuvin, chule hui leh gon apohmang changsi tobang ahiuve.
target: How often are they like straw before the wind, like chaff swept away by a gale?

source: Pathen'in amapa khansetna chu achateuva din akholpehjin, amapan ahetthei nadin lethuhna apejin ahi.
target: It is said, ‘God stores up the punishment of the wicked for their children.’ Let him repay the wicked, so that they themselves will experience it!

source: Amit tenin ama kisuh mangna chu amuding, chule Hat chungnung lungsatna chu adon ding ahi.
target: Let their own eyes see their destruction; let them drink the cup of the wrath of the Almighty.
