source: Ajeh chu ahin nikho lhajat ho akimlaitah-in sattanin umtaleh, anunga ipi nopna insunga anei ding ham?
target: For what do they care about the families they leave behind when their allotted months come to an end?

source: Aman mi chunglama umho thu atanji-e ti munasa-a, Pathen chu hetna kon ahil dingham?
target: “Can anyone teach knowledge to God, since he judges even the highest?

source: Mikhat chu lung nomsa chamkimin, athalhin laitah-in athi jin ahi.
target: One person dies in full vigor, completely secure and at ease,

source: Anoi teni chu noitwi adimin, chule aguho chu lhintwi adimin ahi.
target: well nourished in body, bones rich with marrow.

source: Chule mi abangchu hinkho hahsa tah-in athijin, kipah-in ima anekha pon ahi.
target: Another dies in bitterness of soul, never having enjoyed anything good.

source: Amaho chu leivui lah-a thakhatna lumdiu, chule lungin amaho atomchah ding ahi.
target: Side by side they lie in the dust, and worms cover them both.

source: Veovin, keiman nalunggel hou, keima douna-a thilgon dihlou nangaito hou jouse chu kahen ahi.
target: “I know full well what you are thinking, the schemes by which you would wrong me.

source: Ajeh chu nanghon, leng chapa in chu hoiche hija? chule migiloute chenna mun chu hoilai ham? nati uve.
target: You say, ‘Where now is the house of the great, the tents where the wicked lived?’

source: Lampia chelea miho chu nanghon nadoh khah lou uham? chule amaho melchihna chu nahet lou uham?
target: Have you never questioned those who travel? Have you paid no regard to their accounts—

source: Mikhang gilou chu manthah nikho-a dinga kikoija hilouham? amaho chu lunghan nikho-a hung kipuidoh ding ahiuve.
target: that the wicked are spared from the day of calamity, that they are delivered from the day of wrath?

source: Koiham alampi ding amaikoh-a phondoh peh thei dinga? chule kon athilbol na chunga lethuhna apeh ding ham?
target: Who denounces their conduct to their face? Who repays them for what they have done?

source: Hijeng jongle ama chu lhan khuh-a kipui ding, chule buikhuh sunga umding ahi.
target: They are carried to the grave, and watch is kept over their tombs.

source: Phaichama leilhang ho chu ama dinga lhumtah hiding, amasanga simjoulou miho ache banga, mitinin ama nungchu ajui ding ahi.
target: The soil in the valley is sweet to them; everyone follows after them, and a countless throng goes before them.

source: Achutile nathil donbut naovahin jouthu aume ti namunasaova, ipi dinga pannabei ja neilhamonu ham?
target: “So how can you console me with your nonsense? Nothing is left of your answers but falsehood!”

source: Chujouvin Teman mi Eliphaz'in adonbutnin, aseije;
target: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:

source: Achinga jong chu ama dinga bou phachomthei ahijeh-in, Pathen'a dinga mihem hi phachom dingham?
target: “Can a man be of benefit to God? Can even a wise person benefit him?

source: Nangma chonphatna hi Hat chungnung dinga lunglhaina hinam? ahiloule nalampi ho nachamkim sahna hin ama aphatchom sah hinam?
target: What pleasure would it give the Almighty if you were righteous? What would he gain if your ways were blameless?

source: Nangma nagin jeh-a aman napho ding ham? ama nangto thupi tanna-a lutkhom ding ham?
target: “Is it for your piety that he rebukes you and brings charges against you?

source: Nakhan gitlouna hi lentah hilou hija, nakhansetna hohi akhon nabei hilou ham?
target: Is not your wickedness great? Are not your sins endless?

source: Ajeh chu nangin nasopipa-a konin pannabei jin kitepna thil nala-in, chule aponsil ho nahoh lhan sagoh keovin naum sah-in ahi.
target: You demanded security from your relatives for no reason; you stripped people of their clothing, leaving them naked.

source: Nangin thachol techu donding twi napepon, chule changlhah chu agilkel ho-a dingin naphalpon ahi.
target: You gave no water to the weary and you withheld food from the hungry,

source: Ahin mihatpan vang leiset aneijin, hia chun gin umtah mihem chu achengin ahi.
target: though you were a powerful man, owning land— an honored man, living on it.

source: Nangin meithai ho chu khutgoh keovin nasol mangin, chule paneiloute thahat chu aki subong tai.
target: And you sent widows away empty-handed and broke the strength of the fatherless.

source: Hijeh chun nakim vela thangho akikamin, hetmanlou kichatnan nasuboi tai;
target: That is why snares are all around you, why sudden peril terrifies you,

source: Ahiloule kho namu thei louna din thim ajingin; chule twisoh chun nachup tan ahi.
target: why it is so dark you cannot see, and why a flood of water covers you.

source: Pathen hi vanchung sanga um hilou ham? chule ahsi ho sandan khu vetemin, amaho iti sanna sang hitaovem!
target: “Is not God in the heights of heaven? And see how lofty are the highest stars!

source: Chule nangin, Pathen'in iti ahet hija? aman meipi thim lah-a thu iti atan theiham? tin naseijin ahi.
target: Yet you say, ‘What does God know? Does he judge through such darkness?

source: Meilhang satah ho khu aman amuthei louna dinga akhukhuma pang ahin; chule ama van'a avahkimvel lejin ahi.
target: Thick clouds veil him, so he does not see us as he goes about in the vaulted heavens.’

source: Mi khang gilouvin ajotji lamlui chu namel chihji em?
target: Will you keep to the old path that the wicked have trod?

source: Hiho chu aphatnu lhin masangin satlhah-in aumjin, akingapna bul chu twisoh-in achuptai.
target: They were carried off before their time, their foundations washed away by a flood.

source: Hiho chun Pathen henga, keiho-a konin potdoh-in, Hatchung nungin amaho-a dinga ipi abol thei dingham? atiuve.
target: They said to God, ‘Leave us alone! What can the Almighty do to us?’

source: Hijongle aman a-in ho chu thilphan adippeh-in; mikhang gilou thumopna vang chu keija kona gamlatah ahi.
target: Yet it was he who filled their houses with good things, so I stand aloof from the plans of the wicked.

source: Michonphan hichu amun akipahjin; chule themona neilou michun, i-sah loutah-in anuisat khumjin ahi.
target: The righteous see their ruin and rejoice; the innocent mock them, saying,

source: Hichan chun eiho neilegou suhmangin aumpon, ahinla amaho-a amoh chengse meijin akavamtai.
target: ‘Surely our foes are destroyed, and fire devours their wealth.’

source: Tun nangma amatoh kiheton lang, chule lung mongin umin; hichun nangdinga thilpha ahin lhut ding ahi.
target: “Submit to God and be at peace with him; in this way prosperity will come to you.

source: Nahenga katao ahi, akama kondoh danthu chu kisanin, chule athu chu nalungthim sunga khol khomin.
target: Accept instruction from his mouth and lay up his words in your heart.

source: Hat chungnung pen henga nakile kitna ahile, nangma kisadoh-in natin, nangin khansetna chu nahoubuh ho-a kona gamla tah-a nakoi mang ding ahi.
target: If you return to the Almighty, you will be restored: If you remove wickedness far from your tent

source: Chuteng sana chu leivui banga nakhola, chule Ophir sana chu vachadunga songho banga nakhol khom ding ahi.
target: and assign your nuggets to the dust, your gold of Ophir to the rocks in the ravines,

source: Hiteng chule Hat chungnung chu nahongbitna hintin, chule dangka ninglhing setna naneiding ahi.
target: then the Almighty will be your gold, the choicest silver for you.

source: Chutengle nangman Hatchung nungpen nachun kipana neijin natin, chule Pathen lama namai nangat ding ahi.
target: Surely then you will find delight in the Almighty and will lift up your face to God.

source: Nangman ahenga taona neijin natin, aman nataona angaiding, chule nakitepna chu napeh ding ahi.
target: You will pray to him, and he will hear you, and you will fulfill your vows.

source: Nangman thupeh khat jong naphondoh ding, hichu nachunga tohdoh-a hung umding; chule vahchun nalampi ho asalvah ding ahi.
target: What you decide on will be done, and light will shine on your ways.

source: Mihem hi akisuh lhah tengle, kitundoh-na aum jie, tia naseiding; aman mi kineosah chu ahuhhing ding ahi.
target: When people are brought low and you say, ‘Lift them up!’ then he will save the downcast.

source: Aman themona neilou mi chu ahuhdoh ding ahin, nakhut teni thenna-a chu kihuhdoh ahi.
target: He will deliver even one who is not innocent, who will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”

source: Chujouvin Job'in adonbutnin, aseije.
target: Then Job replied:

source: Kakiphina hi tuni chanin akha-in; kakhoisatna sangin kahesohna hi agihjon ahi.
target: “Even today my complaint is bitter; his hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

source: Oh ama touna mun ngeija kahung lut theina dingin; keiman ama chu hoijah kamu doh thei tadem?
target: If only I knew where to find him; if only I could go to his dwelling!

source: Keiman amasanga kachung thu lhut ingting, chule kakam sung nelkal na-a kadip ding ahi.
target: I would state my case before him and fill my mouth with arguments.

source: Aman eidonbutna ding thuho chu kihetning ting, chule kahenga asei ding chu ipi ahi, kahetchet ding ahi.
target: I would find out what he would answer me, and consider what he would say to me.

source: Aman athahat thunei na-in kachung thu eiseipeh dem? Chutiponte, aman keija hi thahatna ahinkoijoh ding ahi.
target: Would he vigorously oppose me? No, he would not press charges against me.

source: Michonphan chua chu amato thu aseikhom ding; hitia chu thutana-a kona keima a-imatih-a dinga huhdoh kahiding ahitai.
target: There the upright can establish their innocence before him, and there I would be delivered forever from my judge.

source: Veovin, keima malama kachen, ahin ama hia chun aumpoi; nunglama kachen, ahin ama kahe dohpon ahi.
target: “But if I go to the east, he is not there; if I go to the west, I do not find him.

source: Aman akhut veilama na atongin, ahin ama kamupon; ama kamu theilouna dingin akhut jetlama akiselin ahi.
target: When he is at work in the north, I do not see him; when he turns to the south, I catch no glimpse of him.

source: Ahin aman kakalsena lampi ahen; aman eipatep teng keima sana toh kahungbah ding ahi.
target: But he knows the way that I take; when he has tested me, I will come forth as gold.

source: Kakeng phangin ama kholhahna ho achonin; ama lampi chu kaching jingin, kavah doh khapoi.
target: My feet have closely followed his steps; I have kept to his way without turning aside.

source: Ama thupeh-a konin keima nungjong kanungchon kitpon; ama kamsung thuchengho chu ka anneh thilkhoh pen sanga twijon kangai sangin ahi.
target: I have not departed from the commands of his lips; I have treasured the words of his mouth more than my daily bread.

source: Ahin ama lungthim khatseh pu ahin, aman angaitoa bolding ati chu kon aheikon jouding ham?
target: “But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? He does whatever he pleases.

source: Ajehchu keima dinga kitepsa thil chu aman atongdohjin, chule hitobang thilho chu akoma tamtah aume.
target: He carries out his decree against me, and many such plans he still has in store.

source: Hijeh chun lungkhamin amasangah kaumin; kangaiton ahile keiman ama kakichan ahi.
target: That is why I am terrified before him; when I think of all this, I fear him.

source: Ajeh chu Pathen'in kalung asu nemin; chule Hatchung nungin eilung khamsah-e,
target: God has made my heart faint; the Almighty has terrified me.

source: Ajehchu keima muthima kona suhmang kanahipon, kamai jong muthim ana khu khum sahpoi.
target: Yet I am not silenced by the darkness, by the thick darkness that covers my face.

source: Ipi dinga phat hi hat chungnung pa-a kona selmanga aumlou munasa-a, ama he-a miten ama nikho ho chu amulouvu ham?
target: “Why does the Almighty not set times for judgment? Why must those who know him look in vain for such days?

source: Mi konkhat in gamgi achonji-un; amahon pumhatnin gancha hon alamang jiuvin, hia chun akivah jiuve.
target: There are those who move boundary stones; they pasture flocks they have stolen.

source: Amahon paneiloute sangan chu ahoi mangun, meithai bongchal chu kitepna thil dingin amang jiuve.
target: They drive away the orphan’s donkey and take the widow’s ox in pledge.

source: Amahon angaichate chu lampia konin anodoh-un; leisetna vaichate chu akisel mangji taove.
target: They thrust the needy from the path and force all the poor of the land into hiding.

source: Veovin, nelgama gam sangan bangin, amaho anatoh naovadin apot doh-un; neh ding holin akipat doh-un; gamthip gam chun amaho dingle achateu dingin neh asodoh-e.
target: Like wild donkeys in the desert, the poor go about their labor of foraging food; the wasteland provides food for their children.

source: Amaho amitakipmin louva chang aki-at cheh-un; chule amahon khansetna lengpiga chu aloh khomun ahi.
target: They gather fodder in the fields and glean in the vineyards of the wicked.

source: Amahon sagohkeo chu pon beijin ajan gesah-un, hitia chu amaho daplaija silding neilou ahiuve.
target: Lacking clothes, they spend the night naked; they have nothing to cover themselves in the cold.

source: Amaho molsang ho-a gotwijin akotnun, kiselna ding deinan songpi akolun ahi.
target: They are drenched by mountain rains and hug the rocks for lack of shelter.

source: Amahon pa neilou chu anu-anga konin asat lhaovin, vaichate-a konin kitepna thil ala jiuve.
target: The fatherless child is snatched from the breast; the infant of the poor is seized for a debt.

source: Amahon pon beijin sagoh keovin ache sah-un; chule gilkelpa-a konin changphal alah mang peh-un;
target: Lacking clothes, they go about naked; they carry the sheaves, but still go hungry.

source: Abang hou sunglama thao aheh-un, alengpiga hou achilun; dangchah athoh-un ahi.
target: They crush olives among the terraces; they tread the winepresses, yet suffer thirst.

source: Mihem hi khopi sunga konin khoisan aumun, akimavo miho hinna ataovin; hijongle Pathen'in amaho chu ngaipeh-in aneipoi.
target: The groans of the dying rise from the city, and the souls of the wounded cry out for help. But God charges no one with wrongdoing.

source: Amaho khovah douna-a kiphin mite ahiuvin; alampihou ahethei pouvin, hiche lampia chun umjong aumthei pouve.
target: “There are those who rebel against the light, who do not know its ways or stay in its paths.

source: Tolthat ho khovah le athouvun, vaichale ngaicha jingte athat jiuvin, janle gucha abangun ahi.
target: When daylight is gone, the murderer rises up, kills the poor and needy, and in the night steals forth like a thief.

source: Jonthanhoi bolnom mit jongchun khothim angah jingin, koiman eimu ponte tin, amaiso akikhelsah jin ahi.
target: The eye of the adulterer watches for dusk; he thinks, ‘No eye will see me,’ and he keeps his face concealed.

source: Sunteng melchihna akisemu in hochu janteng avut jiuvin; amahon khovah kiti ahepouve.
target: In the dark, thieves break into houses, but by day they shut themselves in; they want nothing to do with the light.

source: Ajehchu amaho din jingkah chu thina le-lim toh abangin; khat touvin amaho ahetnule, thina le-lim kichan aumjiuvin ahi
target: For all of them, midnight is their morning; they make friends with the terrors of darkness.

source: Ama twi banga ganga ahin; achanu chu leisetna gaosap ahin; aman lengpilei ho lampi chu amuphapon ahi.
target: “Yet they are foam on the surface of the water; their portion of the land is cursed, so that no one goes to the vineyards.

source: Gamgot le nichang satnin buhbang twiho ajunsah tan, hitobanga chu lhankhuh-in jong michonse te chu abol ahi.
target: As heat and drought snatch away the melted snow, so the grave snatches away those who have sinned.

source: Naobun amachu asuhmil ding; lungin amachu nomsa tah-a kivahnan neijintin; ama geldoh-a umtalou ding, chule khan gitlouna chu thingbanga phuhlhuh-a umding ahi.
target: The womb forgets them, the worm feasts on them; the wicked are no longer remembered but are broken like a tree.

source: Aman cha neilou achinga chu kivahnan mangchan tin; meithai chunga thilpha abolpeh louding ahi.
target: They prey on the barren and childless woman, and to the widow they show no kindness.

source: Aman mihatpa jong chu athaneinan akaijin; ama akipat dohjin, chule hinkho kicheh tah mihem koiman aneipoi.
target: But God drags away the mighty by his power; though they become established, they have no assurance of life.

source: Akicholdo nadin, bitkeicha aumna ding kipe jongle, amit chun alampi hou avetjing ding ahi.
target: He may let them rest in a feeling of security, but his eyes are on their ways.

source: Amaho phat chomcha dinga kichoisang ahiuvin, ahinla suh nemin aumin akichaijitaove; amaho alampiuva kona midangho banga kimandoh ahiuvin, changvuileh kisih tan banga kisattanji ahi taove.
target: For a little while they are exalted, and then they are gone; they are brought low and gathered up like all others; they are cut off like heads of grain.

source: Chule tun hichu ahilouva ahile, koiham keima eijousah-a, chule kathusei pannabei ahi tiding chu?
target: “If this is not so, who can prove me false and reduce my words to nothing?”

source: Chujouvin Shuh mi, Bildad'in adonbutnin, aseitai.
target: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:

source: Vaihom nale kichatna chu ama-a aumin, aman amunsang ho-a chamna aumsah-in ahi.
target: “Dominion and awe belong to God; he establishes order in the heights of heaven.

source: Agalsatmite ho ajat umthei ngaijem? chule achunguva avahsodoh louna mite umem?
target: Can his forces be numbered? On whom does his light not rise?

source: Achutile mihem hi Pathen angsunga iti themchang thei dingham? ahilouleh numeija kona peng mihem chu iti thenjou ding ham?
target: How then can a mortal be righteous before God? How can one born of woman be pure?

source: Lha jeng jong khu veuvin, avahjipon ahi; henge, ama mitmu-a ahsi ho jong athengpon ahi.
target: If even the moon is not bright and the stars are not pure in his eyes,

source: Lungtol bangbep mihem hi ichan geija lhasamjo ham? mihem chapa hi, lungtol bangbep hia hitam?
target: how much less a mortal, who is but a maggot— a human being, who is only a worm!”

source: Ahinla Job'in adonbutnin, aseije:
target: Then Job replied:

source: Nangin tha neilou mi chu iti nakithopi-a, tha neilou ban chu iti nahuhdoh-am?
target: “How you have helped the powerless! How you have saved the arm that is feeble!

source: Chihna neilou mi chu nangin iti nathumop ma? chule ahina banga thilchu iti lhingsetna naphondoh am?
target: What advice you have offered to one without wisdom! And what great insight you have displayed!

source: Koi koma nangin thuho naseijam? Chule nanga kona koi lhagao hungdoh am?
target: Who has helped you utter these words? And whose spirit spoke from your mouth?

source: Thil thiho jousele chuche-a chengho jouse chu, twinoija kona kisem ahi.
target: “The dead are in deep anguish, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

source: Damun chu ama masanga agohkeo ahin, chule suhmangna chun akhu ding ima aneipoi.
target: The realm of the dead is naked before God; Destruction lies uncovered.

source: Aman sahlam chu ahomkeo mun chunga ajah doh-in, chule leiset chu imacha umlouva akhaijin ahi.
target: He spreads out the northern skies over empty space; he suspends the earth over nothing.

source: Aman twiho chu meilom satah-in atomchah-in; chule amaho noija chun meilhang chu akehpon ahi.
target: He wraps up the waters in his clouds, yet the clouds do not burst under their weight.

source: Aman alaltouna maichu akhukhumin, chule ameilhang chu achunga chun akijal sah-e.
target: He covers the face of the full moon, spreading his clouds over it.

source: Sunle jan ahung kichai kahsen, aman twiho chu gikhatnin aumkim velin ahi.
target: He marks out the horizon on the face of the waters for a boundary between light and darkness.

source: Aman apho tengle van khompiho akithing jin, chule kidang asaovin ahi.
target: The pillars of the heavens quake, aghast at his rebuke.

source: Aman athaneina-in twipi ahom khenin, chule ahetthem na-in kiletsah ajepjin ahi.
target: By his power he churned up the sea; by his wisdom he cut Rahab to pieces.

source: Aman alhagaovin vanho ajem hoijin, ama khut chun dihna neilou gul chu aseme.
target: By his breath the skies became fair; his hand pierced the gliding serpent.

source: Veovin, hiche hohi ama lampiho ahin, ahinla ama thudol hi ichana kija lhoma hitam? athaneina van kithing tobanghi kon ahetthem thei ding ham?
target: And these are but the outer fringe of his works; how faint the whisper we hear of him! Who then can understand the thunder of his power?”

source: Hiche chung chon chun Job'in athulem sei ajomin, aseije;
target: And Job continued his discourse:

source: Kathu kitana ding eilahmang peh-a hingjing Pathen, chule kahinna suboija Hat chungnung;
target: “As surely as God lives, who has denied me justice, the Almighty, who has made my life bitter,

source: Kasunga haina thei aum laise le, Pathen lhagao kanahkohom teni sunga aum laisen;
target: as long as I have life within me, the breath of God in my nostrils,

source: Kakamin khangitlouna thu sei pongting, kaleijin jong lheplhahna thu phongdoh ponge.
target: my lips will not say anything wicked, and my tongue will not utter lies.

source: Nangma them kachansah ding Pathen anompoi; kathi kahse-a keiman kadinna kachondoh louding ahi.
target: I will never admit you are in the right; till I die, I will not deny my integrity.

source: Kachon phatna hi tuhdet jinging ting, kalhaso louhel ding; kahin lai chansen kalung thim hin eithemmo sah louding ahi.
target: I will maintain my innocence and never let go of it; my conscience will not reproach me as long as I live.

source: Kamelma chu mikhang gilou tobang hihen, keima dou dinga hung kipatdohpa chu chonpha louteto banguhen.
target: “May my enemy be like the wicked, my adversary like the unjust!

source: Ajehchu Pathen'in ahinna alahdohteng, phatchomna neijongle mipha lhemin ipi kinepna aneiding ham?
target: For what hope have the godless when they are cut off, when God takes away their life?

source: Lungkhamna achunga ahung lhunteng ataona chu Pathen'in angaipeh na dem?
target: Does God listen to their cry when distress comes upon them?

source: Hat chungnungpa-a chun amatah alung lhaina dem? phattinin aman Pathen akou nadem?
target: Will they find delight in the Almighty? Will they call on God at all times?

source: Pathen khut thahat dan nangho seipeh-unge; Hat chungnungpa koma um chu keiman ka-imchah lou ding ahi.
target: “I will teach you about the power of God; the ways of the Almighty I will not conceal.

source: Veovin, nangho tah-in hichu namu taovin; achutile ipi dinga nangho nabon chaova hitia hi pannabei, nahiu hitam?
target: You have all seen this yourselves. Why then this meaningless talk?

source: Hiche hi mikhang gilouvin Pathen'a achan chu ahin, misugenthei ho goulo ding, Hat chungnung pa-a kon amudio chu ahi.
target: “Here is the fate God allots to the wicked, the heritage a ruthless man receives from the Almighty:

source: Achateu apunna ahile hichu chemjam'a lou ding bep ahiuvin; chule achilhahteu chu changlhah-a oiva loudiu ahi.
target: However many his children, their fate is the sword; his offspring will never have enough to eat.

source: Ama nunga ana umnalai ho chu thi uva kivui diu; chule ameithai hou chun aka loudiu ahi.
target: The plague will bury those who survive him, and their widows will not weep for them.

source: Aman dangka leivui bangin kholkhom henlang, kivona pon leiset bangin gong jongle;
target: Though he heaps up silver like dust and clothes like piles of clay,

source: Hichu aman gong theijinte, ahinla hichu midih-in akivon ding, chule dangka chu themona neilou ho kihom diu ahi.
target: what he lays up the righteous will wear, and the innocent will divide his silver.

source: Aman a-in chu maimom bangin asan, thil ngah-a pangpan akisah lhambuh bangbep ahi.
target: The house he builds is like a moth’s cocoon, like a hut made by a watchman.

source: Mihaopa chu lumintin, ahin ama gopkhoma umlou ding; aman amit ahahsahle, ama anaum tapoi.
target: He lies down wealthy, but will do so no more; when he opens his eyes, all is gone.

source: Tijatna hon ama twibangin achuptan, huipin jan-in ama alhoh mangtai.
target: Terrors overtake him like a flood; a tempest snatches him away in the night.

source: Ama solam huijin apomangin, ama achemang tan; chule aumna mun'a konin khopi huijin alhoh mangtan ahi
target: The east wind carries him off, and he is gone; it sweeps him out of his place.

source: Ajehchu Pathen'in achunga ahin selhah-a, ama akhendoh louhel ding; ama khutna kona ama lhasama jamdoh ding ahi.
target: It hurls itself against him without mercy as he flees headlong from its power.

source: Mihon ama khut abeh khumuva, chule aumna mun'a kona aphisanuva anodoh dingu ahi.
target: It claps its hands in derision and hisses him out of his place.”

source: Tahbeh-in dangka-a dingin akhuh aumin, chuleh sana-a dingin akilhit thengna mun aumin ahi.
target: There is a mine for silver and a place where gold is refined.

source: Thih hi leisetna kona kiladoh ahin; chuleh sum-eng hi song lah-a kona kiladoh-a kilhajol ahi.
target: Iron is taken from the earth, and copper is smelted from ore.

source: Ama muthim akhona geijin achen, muthim le thina le-lim changei songho chu agaholin ahi.
target: Mortals put an end to the darkness; they search out the farthest recesses for ore in the blackest darkness.

source: Aman mihem umlouna-a le chotkhah louna mun'a leiko avutnin, mihem'a konin gamlha tah-in akikhaijun, suh le tunga akivat leuvin ahi.
target: Far from human dwellings they cut a shaft, in places untouched by human feet; far from other people they dangle and sway.

source: Leiset hi ahileh, hichea konhin neh ahungdoh-in, anoilang vang meikong tobanga hungsoh doh ahi.
target: The earth, from which food comes, is transformed below as by fire;

source: Hiche mun'a songho chu khisongdum ahin, chule hia chun sana di aumin ahi.
target: lapis lazuli comes from its rocks, and its dust contains nuggets of gold.

source: Chungleng vachan ahetkhahlou, muthong mitnin amukhahlou, lampi khat aumin;
target: No bird of prey knows that hidden path, no falcon’s eye has seen it.

source: Keipi bahkai nouvin achotkhahlou, keipi hangtah-in jong ahokhahlou lampi khat aume.
target: Proud beasts do not set foot on it, and no lion prowls there.

source: Aman akhutchu songpi chunga akoidoh-in, aman molsangho chu abula konin alehkhup jenge.
target: People assault the flinty rock with their hands and lay bare the roots of the mountains.

source: Aman songpiho lah-a vadung alaidoh-in, thil manlutah hojouse chu amitnin amun ahi.
target: They tunnel through the rock; their eyes see all its treasures.

source: Aman alonlet louna dingin twisoh ho chu atingin, chule anakisel thilho chu aman khovah-a ahinpodoh-in ahi.
target: They search the sources of the rivers and bring hidden things to light.

source: Ahinla chihna chu hoija kimu ding ham? Chule hetkhen themtheina munchu hoilai ham?
target: But where can wisdom be found? Where does understanding dwell?

source: Mihemin hicheho manlut dan chu ahedoh joupoi, ahiloujongle mihing gamachun hichu akimudoh jou dehpoi.
target: No mortal comprehends its worth; it cannot be found in the land of the living.

source: Hiche chu keija aumpoi, tin twi thuhtah chun aseijin, hiche chu keija aumpoi, tin twipin aseije.
target: The deep says, “It is not in me”; the sea says, “It is not with me.”

source: Hiche chu sana-a jong chohjou ahipon, ahilou jongle hiche manding chu dangka-a jong lepjou ahipoi.
target: It cannot be bought with the finest gold, nor can its price be weighed out in silver.

source: Ophir sana mantam tah ahilouleh khisongdum manlutna toh tethei ahipoi.
target: It cannot be bought with the gold of Ophir, with precious onyx or lapis lazuli.

source: Sana le songval toh kibanga ahipon, chule sana-a kilhatheng thil mantam tah tojong lhehthei ahipoi.
target: Neither gold nor crystal can compare with it, nor can it be had for jewels of gold.

source: Songmantam san ahiloule twikohchang hojong gahmin phahthei ahipoi; ajehchu chihna manlutdan chu song mantam phapen sanga lujo ahi.
target: Coral and jasper are not worthy of mention; the price of wisdom is beyond rubies.

source: Ethiopia khi song engtoh kibanga jong ahipon, ahilou jongle sanatheng manlutna tojong kibanga ahipoi.
target: The topaz of Cush cannot compare with it; it cannot be bought with pure gold.

source: Achutile chihna hoija hungkon hija, hetthem theina munchu hoilaiham?
target: Where then does wisdom come from? Where does understanding dwell?

source: Ahingthei jousele mitmu jouse-a kon kisel ahin, chungleng vacha jouse-a kona akiselmang ahi.
target: It is hidden from the eyes of every living thing, concealed even from the birds in the sky.

source: Manthahnale thina-in, hiche chungchang thulhut hi kanakhang hona kajalhonin ahi, ati lhone.
target: Destruction and Death say, “Only a rumor of it has reached our ears.”

source: Pathen'in hiche lampi chu ahekhenin, chule aman hiche laimun chu ahen ahi.
target: God understands the way to it and he alone knows where it dwells,

source: Ajeh chu aman leiset kichaina ding gei aven, vannoi pumpihi amun ahi.
target: for he views the ends of the earth and sees everything under the heavens.

source: Huidingin agih tena ding asemin, chule aman twiho chu agih tena-a aten ahi.
target: When he established the force of the wind and measured out the waters,

source: Aman go henga thupeh anapeh-a, van ginle kolphe dinga lampi anasemachun:
target: when he made a decree for the rain and a path for the thunderstorm,

source: Chua chun aman chihna chu amun, aphong doh-in; aman agongin, henge, chule hichu aholdoh-in ahi.
target: then he looked at wisdom and appraised it; he confirmed it and tested it.

source: Chule mihem jah-a chun aman aseijin, veuvin Pakai ginhi chihna chu ahin, chule setna a kona jamdoh chu hetkhen themna chu ahi.
target: And he said to the human race, “The fear of the Lord—that is wisdom, and to shun evil is understanding.”

source: Chukal valin Job'in athulem ajompeh-in aseije.
target: Job continued his discourse:

source: O Pathen'in eichintup nikhoho, achesa lhaho-a chu keima ana uma hileng;
target: “How I long for the months gone by, for the days when God watched over me,

source: Kalu chunga athaomei anavah-a, chule amavah-a muthim lah kanajotle lai;
target: when his lamp shone on my head and by his light I walked through darkness!

source: Kakhang donlai nikhoho, Pathen thuguh chu kahoubuh chunga aumlai;
target: Oh, for the days when I was in my prime, when God’s intimate friendship blessed my house,

source: Hatchung nungpen pan kakoma eiumpia, kachate kakimvela ahung umlaiju;
target: when the Almighty was still with me and my children were around me,

source: Kakholhah naho bongnoi thaova kana soplai, chule songpin kadinga thaotwi vadung long banga asodohsah lai;
target: when my path was drenched with cream and the rock poured out for me streams of olive oil.

source: Khopi sung kotpi phunga kapotdoh le-a, khopi lamlen laija katouna kadole laichun!
target: “When I went to the gate of the city and took my seat in the public square,

source: Khangdong hon eimuvin, akiseluvin, chule tehse ho chu akipat doh-un, ading jiuvin ahi.
target: the young men saw me and stepped aside and the old men rose to their feet;

source: Pipuiho chu ahoulim laiju atang jiuvin, chule akhutnun akam akisip jiuve.
target: the chief men refrained from speaking and covered their mouths with their hands;

source: Milen milal ho athipchet jiuvin, chule aleiju chu adanguva abehjin ahi.
target: the voices of the nobles were hushed, and their tongues stuck to the roof of their mouths.

source: Nakhangin eijahteng, phatthei eiboh-in, mitnin eimuteng, hichun keima hettohsahna eipen ahi.
target: Whoever heard me spoke well of me, and those who saw me commended me,

source: Ajehchu keiman mivaicha pengpenga umle, paneiloute, chule kithopi ding neiloupa chu kahuh doh-in ahi.
target: because I rescued the poor who cried for help, and the fatherless who had none to assist them.

source: Mangthah dinga umpa phattheina chu keima chunga ahungchun, keiman meithainu lungsung chu kipanan la kasah sahjin ahi.
target: The one who was dying blessed me; I made the widow’s heart sing.

source: Chonphatna chu kakivonin hichun eitomin, kathutan lhah chu sangkhol len le lukhuh tobang ahi.
target: I put on righteousness as my clothing; justice was my robe and my turban.

source: Mitchodin mit kanahin, kengbaiho din keng kanahi.
target: I was eyes to the blind and feet to the lame.

source: Mivaichate din apau kahin, chule kahet khahlou thu chu kaholdoh jin ahi.
target: I was a father to the needy; I took up the case of the stranger.

source: Khang giloute khagu chu kasuhboh peh-in, chule akamuva konin anehdoh houchu kasadoh peh-in ahi.
target: I broke the fangs of the wicked and snatched the victims from their teeth.

source: Chuin keiman, neldi banga kahin nikhohohi kapunsah-a, kabuh sunga kathi ding ahi, kati.
target: “I thought, ‘I will die in my own house, my days as numerous as the grains of sand.

source: Twipanga kajung ajamin, kabahho chunga jankhon daitwi alhan ahi.
target: My roots will reach to the water, and the dew will lie all night on my branches.

source: Kaloupina chu keija athah jingin, chule kakhutna kathalchang chu akisuthah jinge.
target: My glory will not fade; the bow will be ever new in my hand.’

source: Mihon kahenga anakhangu ado-uvin, chule angah jiuvin, kathumop teng athipchet jiuve.
target: “People listened to me expectantly, waiting in silence for my counsel.

source: Kathusei joutengle amahon aseikitji tapouvin, chule kathusei chu achunguva achun ahi.
target: After I had spoken, they spoke no more; my words fell gently on their ears.

source: Gotwi angaichat bangun keima eingaicha jiuvin; gotwi nunung ngah bangin, amahon akamu akalen jiuve.
target: They waited for me as for showers and drank in my words as the spring rain.

source: Keiman amaho nuisat jongleng, amahon atahsan loudiu; chule kamaiso vah chu amahon asulha pouvin ahi.
target: When I smiled at them, they scarcely believed it; the light of my face was precious to them.

source: Alampihou kalhen peh-in, apipu uvin kapange, chule sepai lah-a lengpa bangin kaumin, lhasete lhamonsah khat bangin kaumin ahi.
target: I chose the way for them and sat as their chief; I dwelt as a king among his troops; I was like one who comforts mourners.

source: Ahinla tun, apateu kaganhon ngah-a uichate toh pangkhom dinga jong kadeilou, keisanga khangdongjoho chun i-sah louvin eibolun ahi.
target: “But now they mock me, men younger than I, whose fathers I would have disdained to put with my sheep dogs.

source: Henge, akhut thahatnaova kona ken ipi kaphatchompi ding ham? athahatnao chu beija ahitai.
target: Of what use was the strength of their hands to me, since their vigor had gone from them?

source: Lhahsap jehle keljeh-in amaho achang lhatnun, masanga ana kamhel le agohkeo gamthipma chun ajamlutnun ahi.
target: Haggard from want and hunger, they roamed the parched land in desolate wastelands at night.

source: Amahon nangboh lah-a vandol, chule theimi jungchu anehdiuvin abotdoh un ahi.
target: In the brush they gathered salt herbs, and their food was the root of the broom bush.

source: Amaho chu miho lah-a konin aki deldoh-un, (amahon gucha kihoh bangin hatah-in a-aovun;)
target: They were banished from human society, shouted at as if they were thieves.

source: Phaicham khikah dungle, leiset kotong sung, chule songpiho lah-a umdin adeldoh-un ahi.
target: They were forced to live in the dry stream beds, among the rocks and in holes in the ground.

source: Hamboh lah-a amaho chu apengun, lingphung noi dunga amaho akisukhomun ahi.
target: They brayed among the bushes and huddled in the undergrowth.

source: Amaho mingol chate le, milung lhomho chate ahiuvin, amaho leiset sangin aphamo jouve.
target: A base and nameless brood, they were driven out of the land.

source: Tun keima amaho la chu kahin, henge, keima aseichah-u kahitai.
target: “And now those young men mock me in song; I have become a byword among them.

source: Amahon eihotaovin, keija konin gamlatah-a ajamun, chule kamai chil setkhum dingjong akiphalam pouve.
target: They detest me and keep their distance; they do not hesitate to spit in my face.

source: Ajehchu aman kakhao alhanenga chule eisuhgenthei jeh-in, amahon jong ka-angsunga kamdal alha nengun ahi.
target: Now that God has unstrung my bow and afflicted me, they throw off restraint in my presence.

source: Kakhut jetlama khangdongho akichoisangun, kakeng asonmangun, chule amanthahna lampihou chu keima dounan aboldoh uve.
target: On my right the tribe attacks; they lay snares for my feet, they build their siege ramps against me.

source: Amahon kakeng lampi asuseuvin, kahamset nading kamasanga akoijun, amaho akithopi ding aumpoi;
target: They break up my road; they succeed in destroying me. ‘No one can help him,’ they say.

source: Amaho twipi pohjah bangin kachunga ahungun, setna lah-a kachunga ahung kitoluve.
target: They advance as through a gaping breach; amid the ruins they come rolling in.

source: Tijatnaho kachunga ahung kihei lutnin, amahon kahinna chu huibangin ahin delun, kaphat theina chu meibol bangin achemang tai.
target: Terrors overwhelm me; my dignity is driven away as by the wind, my safety vanishes like a cloud.

source: Chule tun kahinna kachunga akisunglhan, suhgenthei nikho hon eikolchah tai.
target: “And now my life ebbs away; days of suffering grip me.

source: Jantengle kaguhon eichipjin, katha junghon choldona aneipoi.
target: Night pierces my bones; my gnawing pains never rest.

source: Kanatna hoisetna jehchun kavon akikhelsah-in, kasangkhol chol ngong bangin eikanbeh tai.
target: In his great power God becomes like clothing to me; he binds me like the neck of my garment.

source: Aman bonlhoh lah-a eileh lutnin, keima vutle leivui kabang jengtai.
target: He throws me into the mud, and I am reduced to dust and ashes.

source: Keiman nangma kakouvin, ahinla nangman neingai pehpoi: keima kading doh-in, chuleh nangman iman neigelpoi.
target: “I cry out to you, God, but you do not answer; I stand up, but you merely look at me.

source: Nangma keima dingin nahung giloutan: na bantha hattah chun nangman neidouve.
target: You turn on me ruthlessly; with the might of your hand you attack me.

source: Nangin huijin neidom touvin; achunga chun neitou sah-in, kahinnaho nasujun lhatan ahi.
target: You snatch me up and drive me before the wind; you toss me about in the storm.

source: Ajehchu nangman thina-a neipuilut ding, chule ahing jouse dinga kitepsa ina chu neipuiding ahi, ti kahei.
target: I know you will bring me down to death, to the place appointed for all the living.

source: Itin iti jongle amaho kisuhgepna-a kapjongleu, aman lhan geija akhut ajahdoh louding ahi.
target: “Surely no one lays a hand on a broken man when he cries for help in his distress.

source: Boina neiho dinga kanaka hilouham? kahinna hi amaho dinga analungna-a hilouham?
target: Have I not wept for those in trouble? Has not my soul grieved for the poor?

source: Apha kagaldot teng, kahenga setna ahungjin, khovah kanga tengle muthim ahung lhungjie.
target: Yet when I hoped for good, evil came; when I looked for light, then came darkness.

source: Kalung agimlheh jin, akicholdopoi, genthei hesohna nikhon eikimai topi jinge.
target: The churning inside me never stops; days of suffering confront me.

source: Nisa beijin lunghemin kavahlen, mipi kikhomho lah-a chun kading doh-in kakapme.
target: I go about blackened, but not by the sun; I stand up in the assembly and cry for help.

source: Keima dragon ho sopile, sumbupi ho kiloipi kahi.
target: I have become a brother of jackals, a companion of owls.

source: Katichunga kavun adupmin, kaguhohin eileusa henhune.
target: My skin grows black and peels; my body burns with fever.

source: Ka selangdah jong lunghemna, chule kamut gingjong akapho ogin asohtai.
target: My lyre is tuned to mourning, and my pipe to the sound of wailing.

source: Keiman kamit tenitoh kitepna kasemin, achutile ibola nungah kageltah dingham?
target: “I made a covenant with my eyes not to look lustfully at a young woman.

source: Ajehchu chunga Pathen'a kona chanding ipi umam? chungsang Hatchung nunga kona gou chan ding ipiham?
target: For what is our lot from God above, our heritage from the Almighty on high?

source: Mi khanggilou dinga manthah na um hilou ham? engbolna kidangtah chu khansetna bolteho-a ding hilou ham?
target: Is it not ruin for the wicked, disaster for those who do wrong?

source: Aman kalampiho amulou hija, chule kakho lhahnaho asim hilouham?
target: Does he not see my ways and count my every step?

source: Keima pannabei ja kanavalea, ahiloule lheplhahnaho-a kakal kanason gangtah-a ahile,
target: “If I have walked with falsehood or my foot has hurried after deceit—

source: Pathen'in kadihna ahettheina dingin, khaikotnin eilep hen.
target: let God weigh me in honest scales and he will know that I am blameless—

source: Kakalson nahi lampia kona akiheimanga, kamitnin amuchu kalungin ajuile, anen khattou kakhutna abetahle;
target: if my steps have turned from the path, if my heart has been led by my eyes, or if my hands have been defiled,

source: Chutengle muchi tungting adangin nehen; henge, kason kapahho chu ajungah kibotdoh hen.
target: then may others eat what I have sown, and may my crops be uprooted.

source: Numei khatnin kalung alheplhah-a, ahiloule ka-in heng kotphunga ka chanlhih-a ahile;
target: “If my heart has been enticed by a woman, or if I have lurked at my neighbor’s door,

source: Chuteng ka-inneipin midang ding chang suhen, chule midangho amanu chunga bohkhup uhen.
target: then may my wife grind another man’s grain, and may other men sleep with her.

source: Ajehchu hichehi thet umtah khansetna ahin; henge, hichehi thutan hon engbolna apehding khansetna chu ahi.
target: For that would have been wicked, a sin to be judged.

source: Ajehchu hichehi manthah na geija kavamtheija meichu ahin, chule kaphat touna jouse ajunga kibodoh ding ahi.
target: It is a fire that burns to Destruction; it would have uprooted my harvest.

source: Kasohpa ahiloule kasohnu thu chu i-sah louva kabola, amahon keima eikinahpi tengule;
target: “If I have denied justice to any of my servants, whether male or female, when they had a grievance against me,

source: Pathen ahung kipatdoh tengle ikatiding hitam? Aman aviltengle ipi-a kadonbut dingham?
target: what will I do when God confronts me? What will I answer when called to account?

source: Naobu sunga keima einasempa chun ama asem hilouham? chule khatseh-in naobu sunga einasemu hilouham?
target: Did not he who made me in the womb make them? Did not the same one form us both within our mothers?

source: Keiman mivaichate ngaichat ka-itpeh-a, ahiloule meithainu mit chu kalosamsah khah-a ahile;
target: “If I have denied the desires of the poor or let the eyes of the widow grow weary,

source: Ahiloule ka-an chu kachanga kakineh-a, chule paneilou ten hichu anehkhah loule;
target: if I have kept my bread to myself, not sharing it with the fatherless—

source: (Ajehchu kakhangdon laijapat amachu keimatoh hung khanglen khom ahin, pa banga, kanu naobu sunga patna amanu kahin lamhil ahi);
target: but from my youth I reared them as a father would, and from my birth I guided the widow—

source: Koihamkhat ponsil lhahsam jeh-a mangthah-a, ahiloule silding neilou mivaicha khattou kamua;
target: if I have seen anyone perishing for lack of clothing, or the needy without garments,

source: Alungin keima phatthei eibohlouva, chule kakelngoi mulla aman lum asah loule,
target: and their hearts did not bless me for warming them with the fleece from my sheep,

source: Kotpi phunga eikithopi kamua, paneiloute douna-a kakhut kalapma ahile,
target: if I have raised my hand against the fatherless, knowing that I had influence in court,

source: Chuteng kabanhi kalengkouva konin lhonglha henlang, chule kaban guhi bonglha jeng hen.
target: then let my arm fall from the shoulder, let it be broken off at the joint.

source: Ajehchu Pathen'a kona manthah na chu keidinga tijat umtah ahin, chule alalna jeh-in, kathoh joupon ahi.
target: For I dreaded destruction from God, and for fear of his splendor I could not do such things.

source: Keiman kakinepna chu sana kahi sah-a, ahiloule sana theng jah-a, nangma katahsana nahi, kanati-a ahile;
target: “If I have put my trust in gold or said to pure gold, ‘You are my security,’

source: Kagou tamjeh le, kakhut hin tamtah amujeh-a kakipa-a ahile;
target: if I have rejoiced over my great wealth, the fortune my hands had gained,

source: Keiman nisa ahungvah kavetna, ahiloule lhathah vahtah-a ache kavetna;
target: if I have regarded the sun in its radiance or the moon moving in splendor,

source: Chule kalungthimhi aguh-a jol lhah-a auma, ahilouleh kakamin kakhut achopleh;
target: so that my heart was secretly enticed and my hand offered them a kiss of homage,

source: Hiche jonghi thutanpan engbolna apehding khansetna chu ahi; ajehchu chunga um Pathen chu keiman kasanlou ahitai.
target: then these also would be sins to be judged, for I would have been unfaithful to God on high.

source: Keima eithetbolpa kisuhmang nikho-a kakipa-a, thilsen alhunkhum teng kakichoi sanga ahile;
target: “If I have rejoiced at my enemy’s misfortune or gloated over the trouble that came to him—

source: Kakamhi chonsetna, ama hinna sapset sahna dingin jong kaphalpon ahi.
target: I have not allowed my mouth to sin by invoking a curse against their life—

source: Kahoubuh mihon, Oh atahsa chu kaneilouva ahile! kalungnao chimlou ding ahi, atiuve.
target: if those of my household have never said, ‘Who has not been filled with Job’s meat?’—

source: Gampam mi khopi lamlena agehpon, ahin kholjinleho dingin kakotho kahonpeh-in ahi.
target: but no stranger had to spend the night in the street, for my door was always open to the traveler—

source: Keiman Adam banga kasuhkhelna leh, kakhan gitlouna chu ka-angsunga kakhu khuma ahile;
target: if I have concealed my sin as people do, by hiding my guilt in my heart

source: Keiman mihonpi kakichatna, ahiloule insung mite i-sah louna chun eikichatsah-a, thipbeh-a kauma, kotpama potlouva kaum-em?
target: because I so feared the crowd and so dreaded the contempt of the clans that I kept silent and would not go outside—

source: O khattouvin eingaipeh hitaveleh! vetan, kangaichat chu, Hatchung nungin eidonbutna, chule kaki doupin lekha ajihding chu ahi.
target: (“Oh, that I had someone to hear me! I sign now my defense—let the Almighty answer me; let my accuser put his indictment in writing.

source: Thonlouva hichu kalengkouva kaputna, chuleh lallukhuh banga kakhuh ding ahi.
target: Surely I would wear it on my shoulder, I would put it on like a crown.

source: Kakholhah jatchu ahenga kaphon doh-a, vaipo khat banga ahenga kahin nailut ding ahi.
target: I would give him an account of my every step; I would present it to him as to a ruler.)—

source: Kagam chu keima douna-a apenna, ahiloule langkonho jong chu hitobanga chu akiphina ahileh;
target: “if my land cries out against me and all its furrows are wet with tears,

source: Keiman hiche lougaho chu sum pelouva kaneh-a, ahiloule aneiho hinkho chu kachansah-a ahileh;
target: if I have devoured its yield without payment or broken the spirit of its tenants,

source: suhlouchang khelin meithai seltholing, sakol chang khellin hampa kehhen. Job thusei akichaitai.
target: then let briers come up instead of wheat and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.

source: Hitichun hiche mithumho chun Job chu ama le ama mitmu-a achonphat jehchun, adonbutnu chu anga taovin ahi.
target: So these three men stopped answering Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

source: Chujouvin Ram inkon Buz mi Barachel chapa Elihu lunghanna chu akoujah-in, Job douna-a ama deojah-a ahi, ajehchu ama Pathen sangin akithem chanin ahi.
target: But Elihu son of Barakel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, became very angry with Job for justifying himself rather than God.

source: Amagolte thum ho douna-in jong alunghan adeujah-e, ajehchu amahon adonbutna ding amujou pouvin, hinlah Job chu themmo achanun ahi.
target: He was also angry with the three friends, because they had found no way to refute Job, and yet had condemned him.

source: Tun amaho chu ama sanga upajo cheh ahijeh-un, Elihu'n Job thusei kichai chu angahjing nalaijin ahi.
target: Now Elihu had waited before speaking to Job because they were older than he.

source: Elihu'n hiche mi thumho kamsunga donbutna aumlou amu phatnin, alunghana adeujah tai.
target: But when he saw that the three men had nothing more to say, his anger was aroused.

source: Chuin Buz mi Barachel chapa Elihu chun adonbutnin: keima khangdong kahin, nangho upatah cheh nahiuve; hijeh-a chu keima kakichatna, kalunggel nangho kavetsah ngamlou ahi.
target: So Elihu son of Barakel the Buzite said: “I am young in years, and you are old; that is why I was fearful, not daring to tell you what I know.

source: Upaho chun seijuntin, chule kum tamtah ho chun chihna hilinte, katin ahi.
target: I thought, ‘Age should speak; advanced years should teach wisdom.’

source: Ahinla mihem'a hi lhagao uma ahin, chule Hatchung nungpen hu haikhumna chun amaho chu hetkhenthem theina apeh ahi.
target: But it is the spirit in a person, the breath of the Almighty, that gives them understanding.

source: Milenho chu ching jing jengu ahipon, mi kumtam hon jong thutanlhah themna ahetdeh-u ahipoi.
target: It is not only the old who are wise, not only the aged who understand what is right.

source: Hijeh chun kathusei ngaijun, keiman jong kalunggel vetsah uvinge, kati.
target: “Therefore I say: Listen to me; I too will tell you what I know.

source: Vetan, nathuho chu kangah-in, ipiseiding ham tia nanghon nahol laiju chun nakihoulim naova kanakhang kanasungin ahi.
target: I waited while you spoke, I listened to your reasoning; while you were searching for words,

source: Henge, lunglut tah-in nathuseiju kangaijin, chuleh veuvin, nalah uva Job noplhah sahthei, ahiloule athuho donbut theiding khatcha na-umpouve.
target: I gave you my full attention. But not one of you has proved Job wrong; none of you has answered his arguments.

source: Keihon chihna kamudoh taove, tin seikhaovin nate, mihem ahipon Pathen'in ama asuhlhuh ahibouve.
target: Do not say, ‘We have found wisdom; let God, not a man, refute him.’

source: Tun aman athuho chu keima douna ahipon, hijeh-a chu nangho thusei ho-a chu ama kadonbut louding ahi.
target: But Job has not marshaled his words against me, and I will not answer him with your arguments.

source: Amahon kidang asauvin adonbutbe tapouve, thu asei tapouve.
target: “They are dismayed and have no more to say; words have failed them.

source: Keiman kanga-a chun, (ajehchu amahon thu aseitapouvin, ading dennun, adonbut be tapouve;)
target: Must I wait, now that they are silent, now that they stand there with no reply?

source: Kadonbut dingdol chu donbut ningting, kalunggel jong vetsah ingkate, kanatie.
target: I too will have my say; I too will tell what I know.

source: Ajehchu keima thu-in kadimsetnin, kasunga kalhagao hin eisol teitei tan ahi.
target: For I am full of words, and the spirit within me compels me;

source: Veuvin, ka oipoh hi akising chah ju toh abangtai, hichehi juhai thah pohkeh ding kigo tobang ahitai.
target: inside I am like bottled-up wine, like new wineskins ready to burst.

source: Kahaldoh kit theina dingin keiman thu seijinge; kakam kangting donbut ning kate.
target: I must speak and find relief; I must open my lips and reply.

source: Nahenga katao ahi, mi koimacha langneina musah dang ting, Pachat lhem thucheng mihem'ah pejong peponge.
target: I will show no partiality, nor will I flatter anyone;

source: Ajehchu keiman pachat lhem thucheng pehje kahepon, hitichun bol taleng eisempan eilahdoh loiding ahi.
target: for if I were skilled in flattery, my Maker would soon take me away.

source: Hijeh chun Job, nahenga katao ahi, kathuseiho ngaijin, chule kathu jousehi neingaipeh-in.
target: “But now, Job, listen to my words; pay attention to everything I say.

source: Vetan, tun keima kakamkan, kalei hin kakama thu aseije.
target: I am about to open my mouth; my words are on the tip of my tongue.

source: Kathuhohi kalungsung chondih na-a kon hiding ahin, chule kakamin hetna chu thengtah-a aphondoh ding ahi.
target: My words come from an upright heart; my lips sincerely speak what I know.

source: Pathen lhagaovin einasemin, chule Hatchung nungpen haina hu chun hinna eipeh ahi.
target: The Spirit of God has made me; the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

source: Nangman neidonbut thei dinga ahile, nathuho chu kamasanga koitoh inlang, dingdoh-in.
target: Answer me then, if you can; stand up and argue your case before me.

source: Vetan, keimahi nadeisah dungjuija Pathen khela um kahin, keijong leinganna kisemdoh kahi.
target: I am the same as you in God’s sight; I too am a piece of clay.

source: Vetan, tijat kaumna-in nakichat sah pontin, kakhut jengjong nachunga gihponte.
target: No fear of me should alarm you, nor should my hand be heavy on you.

source: Tahbeh-in, kajah theijin thu naseijin, chule keiman nathusei awgin chu kajatai;
target: “But you have said in my hearing— I heard the very words—

source: Keima suhkhelna beija thenga kahin, themona neilou kahin, khansetna jengjong keija aumpoi.
target: ‘I am pure, I have done no wrong; I am clean and free from sin.

source: Vetan, aman keima douna ajehho chu amun, aman keima amelma khatnin eisimtai,
target: Yet God has found fault with me; he considers me his enemy.

source: aman kakengteni ahennin, kalampi jouse amelchih-e.
target: He fastens my feet in shackles; he keeps close watch on all my paths.’

source: Vetan, hichea hin nangma nadihpon ahi; keiman nangma donbut-inge, Pathen chu mihem sanga lenjo ahi.
target: “But I tell you, in this you are not right, for God is greater than any mortal.

source: Ipidinga ama douna-a nakiphin ham? ajehchu aman ama chungchang thuho khatcha apepon ahi.
target: Why do you complain to him that he responds to no one’s words?

source: Ajehchu Pathen'in khatvei thu aseijin, henge nivei, ahijeng vangin mihemin ahetheipon ahi.
target: For God does speak—now one way, now another— though no one perceives it.

source: Jan manga, janna muneina-a, mihemte chunga imut lhuhna ahung chuh-a, lupna chunga imutsona alhun tengle;
target: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on people as they slumber in their beds,

source: Chuteng aman mihem nakhang ahonpeh-in, chule amaho kithupehna chu asinkhumpeh-in,
target: he may speak in their ears and terrify them with warnings,

source: Athil gona kona mihem alahdoh theina dingle, mihem'a konin kiletsahna aselmangpeh jin ahi.
target: to turn them from wrongdoing and keep them from pride,

source: Kokhuh-a konin ahinna, chule ahinkho chu chemjam'a amanthah nadinga konin ahuhdoh peh-in ahi.
target: to preserve them from the pit, their lives from perishing by the sword.

source: Aman ajalkhun chunga natna, chule agu achangho jouse hachang natna natna-in asugimin,
target: “Or someone may be chastened on a bed of pain with constant distress in their bones,

source: Hitia chu ahinkho chun changlhah, chule ahinna chun anneh ahot nadinga abol ahi.
target: so that their body finds food repulsive and their soul loathes the choicest meal.

source: Akimutheilou nadingin, atipum chu ajunmang tan, chule agu anakimulouho chu adoh setsot tai.
target: Their flesh wastes away to nothing, and their bones, once hidden, now stick out.

source: Ahi, ahinna chun lhankhuh lam, chule ahinkho chun suhmangna chu anaijin ahi.
target: They draw near to the pit, and their life to the messengers of death.

source: Achondihna chu mihem musahna dinga, thupole khat, paoledoh khat, sangkhat lah-a khat amatoh auma hileh,
target: Yet if there is an angel at their side, a messenger, one out of a thousand, sent to tell them how to be upright,

source: Chuteng amachu ama lungset them ahin, hitin aseije, kokhuh-a lhahlutna dinga konin aman ahuhdoh-in, keiman lhatdohna kamutai.
target: and he is gracious to that person and says to God, ‘Spare them from going down to the pit; I have found a ransom for them—

source: Ama tipum chu chapanga sanga noujo ding, ama akhangdonlai nikho-a kilekit ding ahi.
target: let their flesh be renewed like a child’s; let them be restored as in the days of their youth’—

source: Ama Pathen henga taoding, chule ama chu amadinga lunglhaina hiding, chule aman kipah-a amai amuding ahi: ajeh chu aman chonphatna chu mihem apehding ahi.
target: then that person can pray to God and find favor with him, they will see God’s face and shout for joy; he will restore them to full well-being.

source: Aman mihemho aven, khattouvin, keima kachonsetan, adih-a konin kakiheimang tan, chule hiche hin eiphatchom sahpoi, atia ahileh;
target: And they will go to others and say, ‘I have sinned, I have perverted what is right, but I did not get what I deserved.

source: Aman ahinna chu kokhuh-a alhahlutna dinga kona alhatdoh ding, chule hinkho chun vah amuding ahi.
target: God has delivered me from going down to the pit, and I shall live to enjoy the light of life.’

source: Ven, hiche thil ho jousehi mihem dingin Pathen'in abol jingin,
target: “God does all these things to a person— twice, even three times—

source: Kokhuh-a kona ahinna puidoh nading, hinna vah-a vahsah nading ahi.
target: to turn them back from the pit, that the light of life may shine on them.

source: Vo Job, phatah in melchih in, kathu ngaijin, thipmin, thu kaseiding ahi.
target: “Pay attention, Job, and listen to me; be silent, and I will speak.

source: Nangin seiding khattou naneija ahile neidonbut in, seijin ajehchu keiman nangma kathem chansah nome.
target: If you have anything to say, answer me; speak up, for I want to vindicate you.

source: Ahiloule kasei ngaijin, thipmin, chule keiman chihna kahil ding nahi.
target: But if not, then listen to me; be silent, and I will teach you wisdom.”

source: Elihun adonbut kitleuvin aseije:
target: Then Elihu said:

source: Vo miching nanghon; kathuhi ngaijunlang, hetnanei nanghon nanakhangu hinsung uvin,
target: “Hear my words, you wise men; listen to me, you men of learning.

source: Ajehchu kamin an atepbangin, nakhangin thu apatepmin ahi.
target: For the ear tests words as the tongue tastes food.

source: Eihon thutanlhah dih kilhenu hitin, ilah uva apha chu ipiham kihetnu hite.
target: Let us discern for ourselves what is right; let us learn together what is good.

source: Ajehchu Job'in keima michonpha kahin, Pathen'in kadihna alahmang ahitai, ati.
target: “Job says, ‘I am innocent, but God denies me justice.

source: Keima kadihna chunga kajou ding ham? suhkhel bei kahivangin kamaput hi damtheihoi ahipoi.
target: Although I am right, I am considered a liar; although I am guiltless, his arrow inflicts an incurable wound.’

source: Job banga mi-isahlouna twibanga dontheijah koi umam?
target: Is there anyone like Job, who drinks scorn like water?

source: Ama khangitlouna bolhotoh akiloijin, chule miphalou hotoh akilhonlen ahi.
target: He keeps company with evildoers; he associates with the wicked.

source: Ajehchu aman, mihem Pathen'a kipah-a aumhin imachan aphatchom pipoi, ati.
target: For he says, ‘There is no profit in trying to please God.’

source: Hijeh chun hethem na nei mi nanghon kathuhi ngaijun; Pathen'in khansetna abol louding, chule Hatchung nungin khangitlouna abol louhel ding ahi.
target: “So listen to me, you men of understanding. Far be it from God to do evil, from the Almighty to do wrong.

source: Ajehchu mihem chu atoh dungjuija achunga alhunsah ding, chule mijouse achonna dungjui cheh a lethuhna amusah ding ahi.
target: He repays everyone for what they have done; he brings on them what their conduct deserves.

source: Henge, Pathen'in khan gitlouna abol louhel ding, Hatchung nungin jong thu akaleh-a atan louding ahi.
target: It is unthinkable that God would do wrong, that the Almighty would pervert justice.

source: Leiset chunga thunei dinga kon mopohna apeh ham? ahiloule vannoi pumpi kon achunga akoiham?
target: Who appointed him over the earth? Who put him in charge of the whole world?

source: Aman mihem chunga alung koihen lang, alhagao le ahaina hu chu kilah taleh;
target: If it were his intention and he withdrew his spirit and breath,

source: Tipumpi mangthah khomuva, chule mihem leivuija kilekit ding ahi.
target: all humanity would perish together and mankind would return to the dust.

source: Tun nangma hetkhen themna nei nahile, hichehi ngaijin: kathusei hohi ngaiphan.
target: “If you have understanding, hear this; listen to what I say.

source: Thudih hotbolpa chun vai ahomding hija? chule kitah chungnung pen chu nangin themmo nachan dingham?
target: Can someone who hates justice govern? Will you condemn the just and mighty One?

source: Lengpa jah-a, nangma khangse nahin, chule pipuiho jah-a, Pathen helou nahiuve, tiding kilomnam?
target: Is he not the One who says to kings, ‘You are worthless,’ and to nobles, ‘You are wicked,’

source: Ahin ama pipuiho langa alangnei chompon, chule mivaichaho sangin mihaoho ajachom dehpoi; ajehchu abonchauva akhutsem ahiuve.
target: who shows no partiality to princes and does not favor the rich over the poor, for they are all the work of his hands?

source: Amaho mitphetkah louvin thiuvintin, chule mipi ho chu jan khangkim le suhboija umdiu, chemang diu, chule mihat hochu mihem khutjao louva kaimanga umdiu ahi.
target: They die in an instant, in the middle of the night; the people are shaken and they pass away; the mighty are removed without human hand.

source: Ajehchu aman mihem lamlhah avejingin, achenachan amusoh keijin ahi.
target: “His eyes are on the ways of mortals; he sees their every step.

source: Khangitlou bolho kiselna dingin, muthimle thina le-lim aumpon ahi.
target: There is no deep shadow, no utter darkness, where evildoers can hide.

source: Ajehchu Pathen angsunga thutana-a lutna dinga, aman adih kalval mihem chunga akoilou ding ahi.
target: God has no need to examine people further, that they should come before him for judgment.

source: Aman simthei louva mihat ho chu asuhbonga, akheluva midangho atunding ahi.
target: Without inquiry he shatters the mighty and sets up others in their place.

source: Hijeh chun aman atohhou chu ahen, amaho chu suhmanga aumtheina dinguvin, jankhat sungin alehkhup heltan ahi.
target: Because he takes note of their deeds, he overthrows them in the night and they are crushed.

source: Aman amaho chu migilouho bangin midangho mitmu tah-in ajepmin;
target: He punishes them for their wickedness where everyone can see them,

source: Ajehchu amaho ama-a konin akinung heijun, chule alampi khat jengjong agelphata pouve;
target: because they turned from following him and had no regard for any of his ways.

source: Chutichun ahenga amahon mivaichaho kana chu alhunsah-un, aman bolgentheiho kana chu angaipeh tan ahi.
target: They caused the cry of the poor to come before him, so that he heard the cry of the needy.

source: Aman asuhcham tengleh koiham boina boldinga? nampi douna hihen lang mikhat douna-a kibol hijongle, aman asel tengle koiham amai muthei dingah?
target: But if he remains silent, who can condemn him? If he hides his face, who can see him? Yet he is over individual and nation alike,

source: Chutiachu mipha lhemin vai ahomlou ding, achutiloule mipi ho thanga ohding ahi.
target: to keep the godless from ruling, from laying snares for the people.

source: Tahbeh-a mihemin Pathen koma, suhgimna chu kathohtan, doumah bolkit taponge,
target: “Suppose someone says to God, ‘I am guilty but will offend no more.

source: Kamu khahlou chu nangman neihilin, keiman khan gitlouna kaboljongle, bolkit taponge, tia aseiding chu kilom ahi.
target: Teach me what I cannot see; if I have done wrong, I will not do so again.’

source: Keima hilouvin nangma gel bang ahidem? nangma danlang nomjongle chun, aman nalethuh ding ahi; hijeh chun nahetchu seijin.
target: Should God then reward you on your terms, when you refuse to repent? You must decide, not I; so tell me what you know.

source: Hetthemna neihon eihilen, chule michingin kathusei ngaihen.
target: “Men of understanding declare, wise men who hear me say to me,

source: Job'in hetna jaolouvin thu aseijin, athuseiho jong chihna jaolou ahi.
target: ‘Job speaks without knowledge; his words lack insight.’

source: Khang gilouho dinga adonbut jeh-in, Job chu akhona geija achungthu tanding hi kalung ahi.
target: Oh, that Job might be tested to the utmost for answering like a wicked man!

source: Ajehchu aman achonsetna chunga akiphin ben, aman ilah uvah akhut abengin, chule Pathen douna athu apun sah-in ahi.
target: To his sin he adds rebellion; scornfully he claps his hands among us and multiplies his words against God.”

source: Hiche kalvalin Elihun aseiben, chule hitin aseije:
target: Then Elihu said:

source: Kachon phatna hi Pathen'a sangin asangjoi, tia nasei chu dih dinga nagellem?
target: “Do you think this is just? You say, ‘I am in the right, not God.’

source: Ajehchu nangman, kachonsetna kona theng kahile, nang dinga phachom ipi hiding hija, keiman aphachom ipi kamuding ham? tin naseije.
target: Yet you ask him, ‘What profit is it to me, and what do I gain by not sinning?’

source: Keiman nangmale naumpi naloiho chu donbut-inge.
target: “I would like to reply to you and to your friends with you.

source: Van lama dah inlang vetemin; chule nangsanga sangjo meibol ho khu vetemin.
target: Look up at the heavens and see; gaze at the clouds so high above you.

source: Nachonsetle, ama douna-a ipi nabol em? ahiloule nasuhkhelna apunbeleh, nangman ama henga ipi nabol ham?
target: If you sin, how does that affect him? If your sins are many, what does that do to him?

source: Nachon phatna ahile ama ipi napeh-em? ahiloule nakhutna kona ipi amu-em?
target: If you are righteous, what do you give to him, or what does he receive from your hand?

source: Naphatlouna chun nangtobang mihem khat asuna theijin, nachon phatna chun mihem chapa chu aphatchom sah thei ahi.
target: Your wickedness only affects humans like yourself, and your righteousness only other people.

source: Suhgentheinaho atamjeh-in, akisugen theiho aka sah-un, mihat ho ban thahat jeh-in, apeng doh-un ahi.
target: “People cry out under a load of oppression; they plead for relief from the arm of the powerful.

source: Ahinla koimachan jong eisempa Pathen, janteng la eipepa chu hoija umam? atipouve.
target: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,

source: Leija gamsaho sanga eiha hiluva, chungleng vachate sanga chingjoa eisempao chu, hoija umem? atipouve.
target: who teaches us more than he teaches the beasts of the earth and makes us wiser than the birds in the sky?’

source: Chua chun apengun, ahinla miphalouho kiletsah jeh-in, koimachan adonbut pouve.
target: He does not answer when people cry out because of the arrogance of the wicked.

source: Tahbeh-in Pathen'in pannabei chu ngai pontin, Hatchung nungin jong nahsah-a aneilouding ahi.
target: Indeed, God does not listen to their empty plea; the Almighty pays no attention to it.

source: Nangin amachu muponge tijongle chun, amasanga chu thutana umnalai ahin; hijeh chun ama chu tahsan nin.
target: How much less, then, will he listen when you say that you do not see him, that your case is before him and you must wait for him,

source: Ahinla tun hitichu ahilou jeh-in, lunghan na-in agavilin, hijongle nasabehsetnin ahehhih laijin,
target: and further, that his anger never punishes and he does not take the least notice of wickedness.

source: Hijeh-a chu Job hi pannabei ja kamka-a, hetna jaolouva athusei apunsah ahi.
target: So Job opens his mouth with empty talk; without knowledge he multiplies words.”

source: Elihun aseijompeh-in, hitin aseije.
target: Elihu continued:

source: Neikhongai nalaijun, chule Pathen khella seiding kanei nahlai chu, vetsah-unge.
target: “Bear with me a little longer and I will show you that there is more to be said in God’s behalf.

source: Gamla tah-a konin kahetna galangting, eisempa chonphatna phongdoh inge.
target: I get my knowledge from afar; I will ascribe justice to my Maker.

source: Ajehchu kathuhi nolnabei jou hilouhel ding ahin, hetna chamkimpa chu nangma toh uma ahi.
target: Be assured that my words are not false; one who has perfect knowledge is with you.

source: Vetan, Pathen chu thaneitah ahin, koimacha nahsahmon akoipoi; Ama thahatna le chihna-a thaneitah ahi.
target: “God is mighty, but despises no one; he is mighty, and firm in his purpose.

source: Aman migilou hinkho ahoidoh pehpon, mi genthei chu dihna apen ahi.
target: He does not keep the wicked alive but gives the afflicted their rights.

source: Michonpha ho-a konin amit aheimangpon, ahinla amaho lengho toh laltouna chunga atouvun; aman amaho chu a-itih-in atungdohjin, chule choisangin aumjiuvin ahi.
target: He does not take his eyes off the righteous; he enthrones them with kings and exalts them forever.

source: Chule amaho bulkituh ahiuva, bolgentheina khaova kihen ahiule;
target: But if people are bound in chains, held fast by cords of affliction,

source: Chuteng aman athilbolule, asuhkhel nao chonvalna chu amusahjin ahi.
target: he tells them what they have done— that they have sinned arrogantly.

source: Aman abilkolu chu sehgimna angaina diuvin ahonpeh-in, khansetna kona ahungkile theina diuvin thu apejin ahi.
target: He makes them listen to correction and commands them to repent of their evil.

source: Amahon thu angaijuva, ama ajenule, anikhohou phattheina, chule akumhou nopsahna-a amandiu ahi.
target: If they obey and serve him, they will spend the rest of their days in prosperity and their years in contentment.

source: Ahinlah thu angailou vangule, chemjam'a mangthah uva, chule hetna beija thidiu ahi.
target: But if they do not listen, they will perish by the sword and die without knowledge.

source: Ahinla miphalhem hon lunghanna lungthima akikhol khomun, aman amaho ahen tengle atao jipouve.
target: “The godless in heart harbor resentment; even when he fetters them, they do not cry for help.

source: Amaho akhandon laijun athiuvin, ahinkhou chu mithenglouho lah-a aumjin ahi.
target: They die in their youth, among male prostitutes of the shrines.

source: Migenthei chu bolgentheija aumna-a konin ahuhdoh-in, suhgentheina-a anakhangu ahonpeh-e.
target: But those who suffer he delivers in their suffering; he speaks to them in their affliction.

source: Hitima chun aman hahsatna-a konin napuidoh intin, suhboina umlouna mun lentah-a nachon lutding, chule nadokhanga kiluiding chu nehtuitah dimset ding ahi.
target: “He is wooing you from the jaws of distress to a spacious place free from restriction, to the comfort of your table laden with choice food.

source: Ahinla nangin migiloute thutanna chu nagui lhunsahtan, thutannale thudih chun namandet tai.
target: But now you are laden with the judgment due the wicked; judgment and justice have taken hold of you.

source: Lunghanna aumjeh-in chingtheijin, achutiloule ajepna-a chun nalhoh mang intin; chuteng lhatna loupitah chun nahuhdoh joulou ding ahi.
target: Be careful that no one entices you by riches; do not let a large bribe turn you aside.

source: Aman nahaona jabol intem? ajabol louding, sana ahiloule thaneina jouse jong angaisang louding ahi.
target: Would your wealth or even all your mighty efforts sustain you so you would not be in distress?

source: Miho aumnao mun'a akisuhmangu janchu ngaicha hih-in.
target: Do not long for the night, to drag people away from their homes.

source: Chingtheijin, khangitlouna ngaito hih-in, ajehchu gimbolna sangin hichehi nalheng jotai.
target: Beware of turning to evil, which you seem to prefer to affliction.

source: Vetan, Pathen'in athaneina-in achoisangtan, amabanga kon ahil theijem?
target: “God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

source: Alampi chu koijin aseipeh-am? ahiloule, nangin khangitlouna nabole, tia kon asei theijem?
target: Who has prescribed his ways for him, or said to him, ‘You have done wrong’?

source: Mihon avetjingu, anatoh choisang dingchu geldoh jingin.
target: Remember to extol his work, which people have praised in song.

source: Mitinin hichu muthei jintin; mihemin gamlatah-a konin muthei jinte.
target: All humanity has seen it; mortals gaze on it from afar.

source: Veuvin, Pathen chu aloupin, eihon ama ihepouve, akum jatho jong holdoh jouhoi ahipoi.
target: How great is God—beyond our understanding! The number of his years is past finding out.

source: Ajehchu aman twi vatneocha cha anasemin, twimeija konin go ajulhajin ahi.
target: “He draws up the drops of water, which distill as rain to the streams;

source: Hichu meibolin gomal asema, chule mihem chunga nengtah-a julhaji ahi.
target: the clouds pour down their moisture and abundant showers fall on mankind.

source: Meibol kithejal leho, ahiloule ahoubuh gingho khu mihemin ahetkhen thei jem?
target: Who can understand how he spreads out the clouds, how he thunders from his pavilion?

source: Veovin, aman achunga chun avah ajalin, twipi todop chu akhu-in ahi.
target: See how he scatters his lightning about him, bathing the depths of the sea.

source: Ajehchu aman hitiho-a konhin mipi thu atanin, an neh nengtah-in apen ahi.
target: This is the way he governs the nations and provides food in abundance.

source: Aman vah chu meibolin atomin, akikah-a hungdoh meibola kona avahlou nadin thu apen ahi.
target: He fills his hands with lightning and commands it to strike its mark.

source: Chua hu gin chun aumdan chu avetsah-in, twimei umchan jong ganchaho ahetsah-e.
target: His thunder announces the coming storm; even the cattle make known its approach.

source: Hichea jonghin kalung chang akihotnin, chule achomdoh dehdeh jenge.
target: “At this my heart pounds and leaps from its place.

source: A-awgin le akama kona hungpot chu lunglut tah-in ngaijin.
target: Listen! Listen to the roar of his voice, to the rumbling that comes from his mouth.

source: Aman hichu van pumpi noi-a asolin, akolphe chu leiset kolmong geija dingin aphet sah-in ahi.
target: He unleashes his lightning beneath the whole heaven and sends it to the ends of the earth.

source: Hiche jouhin aw khat ahung kitumin, aloupina aw-a chun ahung ging dumdumin, chule a-aw akijahteng jongle amaho chu atuhtang louding ahi.
target: After that comes the sound of his roar; he thunders with his majestic voice. When his voice resounds, he holds nothing back.

source: Pathen chu kidang tah-in a-aw'in ahung kithongin; eiho hetjouhoi hilou thil loupitah abole.
target: God’s voice thunders in marvelous ways; he does great things beyond our understanding.

source: Ajehchu aman buhbang henga, leija umin atin; chubangma chun athahatna gophinle gohong henga jong aseijin ahi.
target: He says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ and to the rain shower, ‘Be a mighty downpour.’

source: Mijousen athilbol ahettheina diuvin, aman mitin khutchu amelchih-in ahi.
target: So that everyone he has made may know his work, he stops all people from their labor.

source: Chuphatnin gamsaho akul sunguva alutnun, amuncheh-a aumtaove.
target: The animals take cover; they remain in their dens.

source: Lhanglama konin huise ahungnungin, sahlama konin dap ahunge.
target: The tempest comes out from its chamber, the cold from the driving winds.

source: Pathen hu-a konin buhbang aumin, chule twilentah jong akang jin ahi.
target: The breath of God produces ice, and the broad waters become frozen.

source: Meibol satah jengjong chu twihu achun asunouvin, ameibol bangleh chu athejalin ahi.
target: He loads the clouds with moisture; he scatters his lightning through them.

source: Aman athupeh jouseu vannoi leiset chung jouse-a abolna dingun, athumopma chun akipeikol lele-un ahi
target: At his direction they swirl around over the face of the whole earth to do whatever he commands them.

source: Aman suhdih nading ham, agam ding ham, ahiloule hepina ding hama hichu asosah ahi.
target: He brings the clouds to punish people, or to water his earth and show his love.

source: Vo Job, hichehi ngaijin; dingdet jinginlang, Pathen natoh kidangho chu ngaiton.
target: “Listen to this, Job; stop and consider God’s wonders.

source: Pathen'in itih-a amaho agoltoh-a, ameilom vah chu avahsah, nangin nahet em?
target: Do you know how God controls the clouds and makes his lightning flash?

source: Meilhang ho gihdan, hetna chamkimpa thilbol kidangtah chu nahet em?
target: Do you know how the clouds hang poised, those wonders of him who has perfect knowledge?

source: Lhanglam huija leiset athipsah teng, navon iti lummaham, nahet em?
target: You who swelter in your clothes when the land lies hushed under the south wind,

source: Phatvet kilhajol bangtah-a nasa-a vanlaijol hi, nangin amatoh naphajal ham?
target: can you join him in spreading out the skies, hard as a mirror of cast bronze?

source: Muthim jeh-a kaseidiu kaseidoh theilou jeh-un, Ama henga kaseidiu neihilun.
target: “Tell us what we should say to him; we cannot draw up our case because of our darkness.

source: Kathusei dingchu hilding kangaijem? mikhatnin thu seile, thonlouva ama vallhuma umding ahi.
target: Should he be told that I want to speak? Would anyone ask to be swallowed up?

source: Tun mihem hon meilhang ho lah-a vah vahtah chu amupouvin, ahinla huijin amuttheng jitan ahi.
target: Now no one can look at the sun, bright as it is in the skies after the wind has swept them clean.

source: Sahlama konin van ahung thengselin, Pathen chu janale tijatnan adime.
target: Out of the north he comes in golden splendor; God comes in awesome majesty.

source: Hat chungnung thudol chu imudoh joupouve, ama thilboltheina, thutanlhahna, dihna-a chungnung pen ahin, aman sugenthei ponte.
target: The Almighty is beyond our reach and exalted in power; in his justice and great righteousness, he does not oppress.

source: Hijeh-a chu mihon aginu ahin, milungching khatcha aman ajabol aumpoi.
target: Therefore, people revere him, for does he not have regard for all the wise in heart?”

source: Chuin chimpei lah-a kon chun Pakaiyin Job ahindonbut nin, aseije.
target: Then the Lord spoke to Job out of the storm. He said:

source: Hetna bei thuho-a thumop thimsahpa chu koiham?
target: “Who is this that obscures my plans with words without knowledge?

source: Pasal tah bangin nakong kigah-in; nangma thu kadoh ding nahin, neidonbut ding ahi.
target: Brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer me.

source: Leiset bul kaphupetna chu hoilai ja nana umem? hetkhen themna naneile phongdoh-in.
target: “Where were you when I laid the earth’s foundation? Tell me, if you understand.

source: Alet aneo koijin atotoh ham, nahet nam? ahiloule achunga khau chu kon ajandoh ham?
target: Who marked off its dimensions? Surely you know! Who stretched a measuring line across it?

source: Abul chu ipi chunga kihendet naham? ahiloule aning song chu kon agaphu ham?
target: On what were its footings set, or who laid its cornerstone—

source: Itih tengle jing valpa hon La asah khomuva, Pathen chapate jouse kipah tah-a ao dingu ham?
target: while the morning stars sang together and all the angels shouted for joy?

source: Ahiloule naobu-a kon potdoh ding banga, alonjal dingteng twipi kotpiho kon akha ham?
target: “Who shut up the sea behind doors when it burst forth from the womb,

source: Aponsil dingin meilhang kasema, chule akitomna dingin muthim satah kasema,
