target: when I made the clouds its garment and wrapped it in thick darkness,

source: Hiche dinga chu akhonna kasema, kotgol hole kotpiho kasema,
target: when I fixed limits for it and set its doors and bars in place,

source: chule hichangei nahunga, nakhokhel louding; chule hilaija hi nahoithona twikinong chu kingading ahi kati louham?
target: when I said, ‘This far you may come and no farther; here is where your proud waves halt’?

source: Nakhohetna patna jingkah hi thupeh napeh khah-a, chule jingphalvah hi amun kihetnin kitikha em?
target: “Have you ever given orders to the morning, or shown the dawn its place,

source: Hitia chu leiset kolmong gei atuh theija, chua kona mikhangseho thinlhah ahi nadiu nabol khah-am?
target: that it might take the earth by the edges and shake the wicked out of it?

source: Namdet namna henga bonngan bangin heidoh in aumun; chule ponsil bangin adinguvin ahi.
target: The earth takes shape like clay under a seal; its features stand out like those of a garment.

source: Migilou ho-a konin avah uchu lahpeh-in aumin, chule banjang nasatah chu kihehbong ding ahi.
target: The wicked are denied their light, and their upraised arm is broken.

source: Twikhanglen nahho-a nalutkhah tah-em? ahiloule athuhdan kholla nachekhah tah-em?
target: “Have you journeyed to the springs of the sea or walked in the recesses of the deep?

source: Nang dinga thina kotpiho kihongtam? ahiloule thina lim kotkhah ho namukhah tah-em?
target: Have the gates of death been shown to you? Have you seen the gates of the deepest darkness?

source: Leiset letdan hi nahet em? nahetsoh keile phongdoh temin.
target: Have you comprehended the vast expanses of the earth? Tell me, if you know all this.

source: Vah umna lampi chu hoilai ham? chule muthim aumna mun hoilai hija,
target: “What is the way to the abode of light? And where does darkness reside?

source: Agamgi geija chu cheding hitale chun, hiche a-in lampi chu naga hekhen nadem?
target: Can you take them to their places? Do you know the paths to their dwellings?

source: Chuche phat laija nanapen tahjeh-a chu nahet nam? ahiloule nanikho ho jong atamtah jeh-a nahet nam?
target: Surely you know, for you were already born! You have lived so many years!

source: Buhbangho kikhol na-a nalut khah tah-em? ahiloule gel kikholna namu khah-a;
target: “Have you entered the storehouses of the snow or seen the storehouses of the hail,

source: Genthei nikho, kidoule kisat nikho-a dinga kakheh hokhu namu khah-am?
target: which I reserve for times of trouble, for days of war and battle?

source: Ipi lampia vah chu kikhenna, nisolam huihi leichunga kithecheh ham?
target: What is the way to the place where the lightning is dispersed, or the place where the east winds are scattered over the earth?

source: Twi lonlet nading twilam kon ahop khenna, ahiloule van ginle kehlhah nading lampi;
target: Who cuts a channel for the torrents of rain, and a path for the thunderstorm,

source: Mi umlouna leichung, mihem umlouna gamthipma gojuh nadinga;
target: to water a land where no one lives, an uninhabited desert,

source: Akham helsa gam donlouva umchu kidodoh sah kitdingle, hamdong hindoh sah kitdinga alampi chu kon asem ham?
target: to satisfy a desolate wasteland and make it sprout with grass?

source: Gotuijin pa aneijem? daitwi hohi koi hin ham?
target: Does the rain have a father? Who fathers the drops of dew?

source: Buhbanghi koi naobu-a hung pengdoh ham? chule van dai bang jonghi koi hin ham?
target: From whose womb comes the ice? Who gives birth to the frost from the heavens

source: Twiho chu song bangin atah-in, chule twithuh chungchu akanin ahi.
target: when the waters become hard as stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen?

source: Nangman bombel khu nakan khom theija, ahiloule Juheisuhtun khu nalhap lhah theijem?
target: “Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades? Can you loosen Orion’s belt?

source: Ahsi somleng khu aphatna napuidoh theija, ahilou le sahlam Ahsilen le achate nalam kaithei jem?
target: Can you bring forth the constellations in their seasons or lead out the Bear with its cubs?

source: Nangman van chondanho nahet em? hicheho kivaipohna chu leisetna nachesah theijem?
target: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you set up God’s dominion over the earth?

source: Twi tamtah in nachup theina dinga, meilomho chu na awsoa nakou theiding ham?
target: “Can you raise your voice to the clouds and cover yourself with a flood of water?

source: Kolpheho chu achena dinguva nasol theija, chule nahenga, hilaija kaumuve ahinte thei dingu ham?
target: Do you send the lightning bolts on their way? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?

source: Sung gil lama chihna chu koijin akoi ham? ahiloule lungsung hetkhen themna chu koijin apeh ham?
target: Who gives the ibis wisdom or gives the rooster understanding?

source: Chihna-a meibol hokhu asimtheija koiham? ahiloule van twibom khu kon alheilhah thei dingham?
target: Who has the wisdom to count the clouds? Who can tip over the water jars of the heavens

source: Itih-a leivui chu hungtah-a, chule alomho chu hung kimatchetna ham?
target: when the dust becomes hard and the clods of earth stick together?

source: Keipi bahkai chu asaneh ding naholpeh theija, keipi bahkai nou gilkel chu navahva thei dingham?
target: “Do you hunt the prey for the lioness and satisfy the hunger of the lions

source: Itihteng akosunguva koljiuva, achangpan naova itihleh changpang jiuham?
target: when they crouch in their dens or lie in wait in a thicket?

source: Va-ah noute khu Pathen henga apen penna, nehding lhasama alenlele tenguleh, kon neh apehji-ham?.
target: Who provides food for the raven when its young cry out to God and wander about for lack of food?

source: Nangin songpi lah-a gam kelchaho itih-a asoding phat nahetnam? ahiloule sajuh-in nou itih-a aneiding namelchih theijem?
target: “Do you know when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears her fawn?

source: Nangin, avoplai lhaho nasim theijem? ahiloule itih phatna asodiu nahet em?
target: Do you count the months till they bear? Do you know the time they give birth?

source: Amaho aboh-un, anouvu asoh-in, agentheinau akoidoh jiuvin ahi.
target: They crouch down and bring forth their young; their labor pains are ended.

source: Anousenhou chu ahung maldoh-un, hamlah-a ahung khang doh-un, achedoh-un, ahungkile kitji tapouve.
target: Their young thrive and grow strong in the wilds; they leave and do not return.

source: Gam sanganho chu kon alhadoh ham? ahiloule akihennao khao chu kon asutlhah ham?
target: “Who let the wild donkey go free? Who untied its ropes?

source: Gamthip chu a-inding, chule gamtem gamchu achenna munin kasemin ahi.
target: I gave it the wasteland as its home, the salt flats as its habitat.

source: Aman khopi-a mihonpi chu ima asahpon, ahoijipa husa jongchu ajajitapoi.
target: It laughs at the commotion in the town; it does not hear a driver’s shout.

source: Moljol ho chu ama lhatlena ahin, chule aman hamhingho jouse chu ahollen ahi.
target: It ranges the hills for its pasture and searches for any green thing.

source: Sakol kinei chun nangma najennom ding hinam? ahiloule nagankula umnom ding hinam?
target: “Will the wild ox consent to serve you? Will it stay by your manger at night?

source: Sakol kinei chu angonga khao nakhithei dingham? ahiloule loukaina nabuto-a, phaicham chu akaibot thei dingham?
target: Can you hold it to the furrow with a harness? Will it till the valleys behind you?

source: Athahat nasat jeh-a chu nangman ama chu natahsan dingham? ahiloule natohding chu ama nanot khum ding ham?
target: Will you rely on it for its great strength? Will you leave your heavy work to it?

source: Namuchi hochu na-in'a ahinpoh lutna, nachangsala kholkhom dinga natahsan ding ham?
target: Can you trust it to haul in your grain and bring it to your threshing floor?

source: Vahong hochu lhaving hoitah napeh hilou ham? ahiloule vachalen chu lhaving le amulho napeh hilou ham?
target: “The wings of the ostrich flap joyfully, though they cannot compare with the wings and feathers of the stork.

source: Aman leija atuiho adalhan, leivuijin alumsah-in,
target: She lays her eggs on the ground and lets them warm in the sand,

source: chule mikhat touvin akenga alhokhah theiding, ahiloule gamsa khat touvin asukeh theiding ahi jong ageldoh jipoi.
target: unmindful that a foot may crush them, that some wild animal may trample them.

source: Ama nou hilou bangtah-in anousenho chunga a-engsen, atohgimna chu kichatna beija mohseh ahi;
target: She treats her young harshly, as if they were not hers; she cares not that her labor was in vain,

source: Ajehchu Pathen'in amanu akonin chihna chu aladoh-in, ahetkhen themna jengjong amanu apepon ahi.
target: for God did not endow her with wisdom or give her a share of good sense.

source: Amanu ama le ama sangtah-a akidopsang phatle, sakol le achunga toupa chu ataitomjin ahi.
target: Yet when she spreads her feathers to run, she laughs at horse and rider.

source: Nangman sakol khu thahatna napeh em? angonga along gingjeng jung navopeh ham?
target: “Do you give the horse its strength or clothe its neck with a flowing mane?

source: Nangman khaokhopi ho banga nakichat sah theijem? anahko loupitah chu tijat umtah ahi.
target: Do you make it leap like a locust, striking terror with its proud snorting?

source: Aman tolgo atinin akhotjin, athahatna-a athanomin; gal manchah choiho to kimuto dingin apotdohjin ahi.
target: It paws fiercely, rejoicing in its strength, and charges into the fray.

source: Kichat chu anuisatnin, akicha pon, chemjam'a konin jong anungchon ngaipon ahi.
target: It laughs at fear, afraid of nothing; it does not shy away from the sword.

source: Livathei ama dounan aginglah lah-in, tengcha le lumho aval lahlah-in ahi.
target: The quiver rattles against its side, along with the flashing spear and lance.

source: Aman leiset chu tijat-umtah le lunghang tah-in aval lhumin; hiche hi sumkon gin ahi tijong aman atahsanpoi.
target: In frenzied excitement it eats up the ground; it cannot stand still when the trumpet sounds.

source: Aman sumkon ginho lah-a chun, haha, atin; chule gamlatah-a konin gal husa ajan, gal lamkaiho husan leh akithong gin ajan ahi.
target: At the blast of the trumpet it snorts, ‘Aha!’ It catches the scent of battle from afar, the shout of commanders and the battle cry.

source: Nangma chihna jeh-a muthi chu lengji-a, alhaving teni chu lhanglam nga-a ajahji ham?
target: “Does the hawk take flight by your wisdom and spread its wings toward the south?

source: Muvanlai chu nangma thupeh-a lengtouva, chule chungsanga abuh aset ham?
target: Does the eagle soar at your command and build its nest on high?

source: Ama kol lah-a achengin, songkol chunga mundet tah-a chun acheng jin ahi.
target: It dwells on a cliff and stays there at night; a rocky crag is its stronghold.

source: Hia konchun thading sa aholin, chule amitnin gamlatah amun ahi.
target: From there it looks for food; its eyes detect it from afar.

source: Anousen houvin thisan achopmun, chule sa kithat umna mun'a chun, amanu aumjin ahi.
target: Its young ones feast on blood, and where the slain are, there it is.”

source: Chukalvalin Pakaiyin Job adonbutnin, aseije:
target: The Lord said to Job:

source: Hatchung nungpen kinahpi pachun ama ahilding ham? Pathen themmo chansah pachun hichu donbut hen.
target: “Will the one who contends with the Almighty correct him? Let him who accuses God answer him!”

source: Chule Job'in Pakai chu adonbutnin, aseije:
target: Then Job answered the Lord :

source: vetan, keima miphalou kahin, ipi kadonbut dingham? keiman kakhutnin kakam kisip tange.
target: “I am unworthy—how can I reply to you? I put my hand over my mouth.

source: Khatvei kana seitan, ahinla donbut ponge, henge, nivei; hijongle seibe taponge.
target: I spoke once, but I have no answer— twice, but I will say no more.”

source: Chujouvin Pakaiyin chimpeija konin Job ahindonbut nin, aseije.
target: Then the Lord spoke to Job out of the storm:

source: Pasal tah bangin nakong kigah-in; nangma thu kadoh ding nahin, neidonbut ding ahi.
target: “Brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer me.

source: Kathutan jonghi ima hilou neisopeh got ham? chonphat nachan theina dinga keima themmo neichan got ham?
target: “Would you discredit my justice? Would you condemn me to justify yourself?

source: Nangin Pathen banga ban naneijem? ahiloule ama awgin banga nangma aw naginsah theijem?
target: Do you have an arm like God’s, and can your voice thunder like his?

source: Tun nangma lalnale chungnun na-in kijem inlang, hoina le loipina-in nangma kijemin.
target: Then adorn yourself with glory and splendor, and clothe yourself in honor and majesty.

source: Nalung hanna chungnung chu bunglhan lang, mikiletsah tapou chu venlang, sunemin.
target: Unleash the fury of your wrath, look at all who are proud and bring them low,

source: Mi kiletsah tapou chu venlang, loilha-in, chule migilou hochu aumnaova lholhan.
target: look at all who are proud and humble them, crush the wicked where they stand.

source: Leivui lah-a amaho selkhomin; chule guhthimin amaiju kanpeh-in.
target: Bury them all in the dust together; shroud their faces in the grave.

source: Chutengle keiman jong nahenga nakhut jetlamin nahuhdoh jouding ahi tia kaphondoh ding ahi.
target: Then I myself will admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

source: Tun vetan, Behemoth khu nangma toh kasemkhom ahin, aman bongchal bangin hamhing anen ahi.
target: “Look at Behemoth, which I made along with you and which feeds on grass like an ox.

source: Tun ven, athahat nachu akonga um ahin, chule ahatna chu a-oipoh laimu-a um ahi.
target: What strength it has in its loins, what power in the muscles of its belly!

source: Amei chu Cedar thing bangin achaloh sah-in; akhelbuh-a aphelom hochu akitomchah kheh-in ahi.
target: Its tail sways like a cedar; the sinews of its thighs are close-knit.

source: Agu chu sum-eng hal tahbet tobang ahin, aguho chu thihlhon tobang ahi.
target: Its bones are tubes of bronze, its limbs like rods of iron.

source: Ama Pathen lampiho lah-a alupen ahin, asempa chun ama nailut nading chemjam asem thei ahi.
target: It ranks first among the works of God, yet its Maker can approach it with his sword.

source: Tahbeh-in gamsaho jouse kichepna molhochun, a-an nehding ahin sodohpeh-in ahi.
target: The hills bring it their produce, and all the wild animals play nearby.

source: Ama thingphung limnoi, pumpengle hamling neiho noija akoljin ahi.
target: Under the lotus plants it lies, hidden among the reeds in the marsh.

source: Thinglimho chun ale-limuva ama akhu-vin, vachadunga huisum hochun ama aum kimvelun ahi.
target: The lotuses conceal it in their shadow; the poplars by the stream surround it.

source: Veovin, aman vadung chu achipkangin, akinopoi; aman Jordan chu akama achipkang joudingin atahsanin ahi.
target: A raging river does not alarm it; it is secure, though the Jordan should surge against its mouth.

source: Amit tenin alaji-in, anahkuijin thangho chu aphujalpai jin ahi.
target: Can anyone capture it by the eyes, or trap it and pierce its nose?

source: Ngakoija Leviathan nakoidoh theiji em? ahiloule nakhao khaisuh-a chu alei nakhithei dingham?
target: “Can you pull in Leviathan with a fishhook or tie down its tongue with a rope?

source: Nangin anah kohom sunga ngakoi nakoithei dem? ahiloule linga akha nasunpai thei dem?
target: Can you put a cord through its nose or pierce its jaw with a hook?

source: Nahenga ngehna tampi anei ding ham? nahenga aw nemma thu aseiding ham?
target: Will it keep begging you for mercy? Will it speak to you with gentle words?

source: Aman nangma toh kitepna asem dingham? a-imatih chana soh dinga nakipui thei dingham?
target: Will it make an agreement with you for you to take it as your slave for life?

source: Nangman ama chu vacha banga nakicheppi dingham? ahiloule nasoh numei ho dinga nahending ham?
target: Can you make a pet of it like a bird or put it on a leash for the young women in your house?

source: Agolhon golnop abolpeh dem? sumkolvei ho lah-a chu chan aneisahdiu hinam?
target: Will traders barter for it? Will they divide it up among the merchants?

source: Nangin avunchu thih hema nadimsah theija, ahiloule aluchu nga tenga nadimsah thei ding ham?
target: Can you fill its hide with harpoons or its head with fishing spears?

source: Achunga nakhut ngaminlang, galchu geldoh inlang, bolkit tahih in.
target: If you lay a hand on it, you will remember the struggle and never do it again!

source: Veovin, ama thajo dinga kinepna chu moh ahin; ama akimu sehseh jongleh mihem chu pailhah-a umji-a hilouham?
target: Any hope of subduing it is false; the mere sight of it is overpowering.

source: Ama tildoh dinga kingapcha mihang koima aumpoi, achutile koiham Ka-anga dingjou dinga?
target: No one is fierce enough to rouse it. Who then is able to stand against me?

source: Ama kalepeh kitna dinga koiham eikhamah? Vannoi pumpia thil umjouse hi keija ahi.
target: Who has a claim against me that I must pay? Everything under heaven belongs to me.

source: Keiman atibahho hihen, athahatna hihen, amellom naho hijongle selgu ponge.
target: “I will not fail to speak of Leviathan’s limbs, its strength and its graceful form.

source: Koiham aponsil chungnung hohlhah thei dinga? ahiloule kamdal ni puma akoma hung ngamding koiham?
target: Who can strip off its outer coat? Who can penetrate its double coat of armor?

source: Ahaho chu tijat umtah-a kigol ahin, amaichang kotkhah hong ngamdinga koiham?
target: Who dares open the doors of its mouth, ringed about with fearsome teeth?

source: Alipho chu akiletsahna ahin, sinkhana kinamkhum banga kikha khuma ahibouve.
target: Its back has rows of shields tightly sealed together;

source: Akah uva hu alutthei louna dingin, khat le khat hanaijin akinaijin ahi.
target: each is so close to the next that no air can pass between.

source: Amaho suhkhen ahilouna diuvin, khatle khat kijom matnin, akilompelun ahi.
target: They are joined fast to one another; they cling together and cannot be parted.

source: Achit tengle vah ahung kikapdoh jin, amit ho chu jingkah ninel toh abange.
target: Its snorting throws out flashes of light; its eyes are like the rays of dawn.

source: Akama konin thaomei kong, chule meisi pahlahlah ahungdoh jin ahi.
target: Flames stream from its mouth; sparks of fire shoot out.

source: Belle khangbela kona twi asou bangin, anah homa konin meikhu ahungdoh jin ahi
target: Smoke pours from its nostrils as from a boiling pot over burning reeds.

source: Ahaina huchun meihol hochu ajap-am min, chule akama konin meikong apotdoh jin ahi.
target: Its breath sets coals ablaze, and flames dart from its mouth.

source: Angonga hatna aumin, amasanga lungkham nachu kipanan akilejin ahi.
target: Strength resides in its neck; dismay goes before it.

source: Aphe hal hochu akijop matcheh-in, amaho chu adet chetnun, suhlonghoi ahipoi.
target: The folds of its flesh are tightly joined; they are firm and immovable.

source: Alung chu song banga tah ahin, song sumhei noinung banga tah ahi.
target: Its chest is hard as rock, hard as a lower millstone.

source: Ama ahung kipatdoh tengle mihat hojong akichauvin, kichatna anatsat jehchun, ama hotah jong akisutheng jiuvin ahi.
target: When it rises up, the mighty are terrified; they retreat before its thrashing.

source: Min chemjamin sat jongle ajolou ding, tengcha, tuljum, tenghem injong anang joupoi.
target: The sword that reaches it has no effect, nor does the spear or the dart or the javelin.

source: Aman thih chu changpol bangin agelin, chule sum-eng jong thingmot bangin agel bepmin ahi.
target: Iron it treats like straw and bronze like rotten wood.

source: Thalpin ama ajamsah ngaipon, ahsongse jong ama dingin changkung tobang bep ahi.
target: Arrows do not make it flee; slingstones are like chaff to it.

source: Tenghem hochu poljang abahsah bepmin, tengcha akilo khumteng aman anuisat jin ahi.
target: A club seems to it but a piece of straw; it laughs at the rattling of the lance.

source: Songhem hochu anoija aumin, aman bonlhoh chunga chun tenghem hochu athecheh jin ahi.
target: Its undersides are jagged potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

source: Aman twi thuhtah chu bela twibangin asou sah-in, aman twikhanglen jong chu lou theikhat tobang asosah-e.
target: It makes the depths churn like a boiling caldron and stirs up the sea like a pot of ointment.

source: Aman anunga lampi chu avahsah-in, min twithuh chu samkang bangin ageljiuvin ahi.
target: It leaves a glistening wake behind it; one would think the deep had white hair.

source: Leichunga akibahpi ama tobang aumpoi, amahi kichat na beija kisema ahi.
target: Nothing on earth is its equal— a creature without fear.

source: Aman thil sang kiti jouse amun, ama akiletsah chateho chunga leng ahi.
target: It looks down on all that are haughty; it is king over all that are proud.”

source: Chuin Job'in Pakai adonbutnin, aseije:
target: Then Job replied to the Lord :

source: Nangin ijakai nabol theijin, chule nalung ngaito jouse chu imachan adaltan theilou ahi, ti kahei,
target: “I know that you can do all things; no purpose of yours can be thwarted.

source: Hetna neilouva thumop sella chu koiham? hijeh chun kahetkhen theilou, keija dinga thil kidang behsehho chu kanaseidoh-in ahi.
target: You asked, ‘Who is this that obscures my plans without knowledge?’ Surely I spoke of things I did not understand, things too wonderful for me to know.

source: Ngaijin, nahenga katao ahi, keiman seijinge; keiman nahenga kangeh ding, chule nangin neiphondoh peh-in,
target: “You said, ‘Listen now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you shall answer me.’

source: Kakhojah theina nakhanga konin nangma chung changthu kanajan, tunvang kamitnin nangma amutai.
target: My ears had heard of you but now my eyes have seen you.

source: Hijeh chun keima le keima kaki ki-dah in, leivuile vutlah-a kakisih-in ahi.
target: Therefore I despise myself and repent in dust and ashes.”

source: Pakaiyin hiche thuho Job henga aseijou phatnin ahitin ahi, Pakaiyin Teman mi Eliphaz henga aseijin, nangmale nagolteni dounan kalungsatna akoujahtai. Ajehchu nanghon kasoh Job bangin keima chungthua thudih naseipouve.
target: After the Lord had said these things to Job, he said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “I am angry with you and your two friends, because you have not spoken the truth about me, as my servant Job has.

source: Hijeh chun tun nanghon bongchal sagile kelngoichal sagi kaijunlang, kasoh Job henga cheovin; nangho dinga govam thilto gatoh uvin; chule kasoh Job nangho dingin taovintin, ataona chu ama jeh-a kasanpeh ding ahi. Achutiloule kasoh Job banga kachung changthu adih-a naseilou jeh uva, nangolnao dungjuija kabolding ahi.
target: So now take seven bulls and seven rams and go to my servant Job and sacrifice a burnt offering for yourselves. My servant Job will pray for you, and I will accept his prayer and not deal with you according to your folly. You have not spoken the truth about me, as my servant Job has.”

source: Hitichun Teman mi Eliphaz le Shuh mi Bildad chule Naamath mi Zophar chu acheuvin, Pakaiyin athupeh dungjuijin abolun, Pakaiyin Job chu asampehtai.
target: So Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite did what the Lord told them; and the Lord accepted Job’s prayer.

source: Chuin agolho dinga atao phatnin Pakaiyin Job asohchanna-a konin akiledoh sahtan; Pakaiyin jong Job chu anei masah sanga ajatnia tamin abetan ahi.
target: After Job had prayed for his friends, the Lord restored his fortunes and gave him twice as much as he had before.

source: Chujouvin asopi pasal ho jousele asopi numei ho jouse, chule masanga ama kihetpiho jouse ahenga ahungun, a-in'a chun changlhah anekhom mun; chuin amahon alunghem piuvin, chule Pakaiyin achunga thilse abol hojouse jehchun alhamonun, amitakipmin jong sumle sana bilba khatcheh apeovin ahi.
target: All his brothers and sisters and everyone who had known him before came and ate with him in his house. They comforted and consoled him over all the trouble the Lord had brought on him, and each one gave him a piece of silver and a gold ring.

source: Hitichun Pakaiyin Job chu ahinkho masalama sangin, ahinkho nununglama phatthei abohjon ahi. Ajehchu aman kelngoi sangsom le sangli, sangongsang gup, chule loukaithei cheh bongchal sangkhat, sanganpi sangkhat aneijin ahi.
target: The Lord blessed the latter part of Job’s life more than the former part. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, a thousand yoke of oxen and a thousand donkeys.

source: Aman chapa sagi le chanu thumjong aneijin,
target: And he also had seven sons and three daughters.

source: Chule aman apeng masapennu chu amin Jemima asah-in, chule aninanu minchu Kezia, cule athum nanu minchu Keren-happuch asah-in ahi.
target: The first daughter he named Jemimah, the second Keziah and the third Keren-Happuch.

source: Chule gamsung pumpi-a chun Job chanute bangtah-a hoi aumpoi; chule amaho chu apauvin asopihou lah-a agouchan diu apecheh-in ahi.
target: Nowhere in all the land were there found women as beautiful as Job’s daughters, and their father granted them an inheritance along with their brothers.

source: Hiche jouchun Job kum jakhatle kum somli ahingin, achapate le, achapate chate khangli geijin amun ahi.
target: After this, Job lived a hundred and forty years; he saw his children and their children to the fourth generation.

source: Hitichun Job tehkem keile, nikho lhingsetnin athitan ahi.
target: And so Job died, an old man and full of years.

source: Pathen ngaisahlouho thumopma chonlou, michonse te lamlhah-a jong dingle lou, i-sah louho touna-a jong toulou michu anun nome.
target: Blessed is the one who does not walk in step with the wicked or stand in the way that sinners take or sit in the company of mockers,

source: Amavang alung lhaina chu Pakai danthu-ah aumin; adanthu chu sunle janin angaito jin ahi.
target: but whose delight is in the law of the Lord , and who meditates on his law day and night.

source: Amachu vadung panga thingphung kiphut tobang, aphatcha aga sodoh jia, anajong gop louding; chule abol jousea lolhing ding ahi.
target: That person is like a tree planted by streams of water, which yields its fruit in season and whose leaf does not wither— whatever they do prospers.

source: Pathen ngaisah louho vang chutobang ahipoi. Ahin huijin amut mangji changvai tobang bou ahi.
target: Not so the wicked! They are like chaff that the wind blows away.

source: Hijeh chun Pathen ngaisahlouho chu thutan na-a ding jouloudiu, chujongle chonseho chu michonpha ho houkhom na-a pangloudiu ahi.
target: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin michonpha ho lampi chu ahen, hinla Pathen ngaisahlouho lampi vang mangthah ding ahi.
target: For the Lord watches over the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked leads to destruction.

source: Ibola Pathen hephalouho lunghanga, chule mihon mohthu homkeo angaitou ham?
target: Why do the nations conspire and the peoples plot in vain?

source: Leiset lengho atoukhomun, vaipoho akihoutoh-un, Pakai leh athaonu dounan hitin aseijuve,
target: The kings of the earth rise up and the rulers band together against the Lord and against his anointed, saying,

source: Eihon akikana akhao holhou suhtanpeh-u hitin, akhaohou eihoa konin paimangu hite.
target: “Let us break their chains and throw off their shackles.”

source: Van ho-a toupa chu nui jintin, Pakaiyin amaho chu nuisat inte.
target: The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord scoffs at them.

source: Chutengle ahenguva lunghangin thu seijintin, lung nommo-a achunguva lunghang ding ahi.
target: He rebukes them in his anger and terrifies them in his wrath, saying,

source: Hitajongle kalhang theng Zion chunga kalengpa katousah-e.
target: “I have installed my king on Zion, my holy mountain.”

source: Thupeh chu keiman phongdoh inge, Pakai chun kahenga, nangma kachapa nahin; tunia hi kahin nahi, ati.
target: I will proclaim the Lord ’s decree: He said to me, “You are my son; today I have become your father.

source: Kahenga thumin, keiman namtin chu nagoulo dinga kapeh ding, chule leiset kolmong geichu nagouchan dinga kapeh ding nahi.
target: Ask me, and I will make the nations your inheritance, the ends of the earth your possession.

source: Nangin amaho chu thih tenggola navohcheh-a; beldengpa bel banga ahal ahala nasuhchip ding ahi.
target: You will break them with a rod of iron; you will dash them to pieces like pottery.”

source: Hijeh chun, vo nangho lengho, tuhin kichih theijun; nangho vannoi thutan ho kihilphaovin.
target: Therefore, you kings, be wise; be warned, you rulers of the earth.

source: Pakai chu kichapumin jenunlang, kithing pumpumin kipah-un.
target: Serve the Lord with fear and celebrate his rule with trembling.

source: Chapa chu chopmun; achutiloule lunghang intin lamdunga konin mahthah getnun nate, alunghan chu neocha a deujahji ahi. Ama-a atahsan koiho chu anunnom ahi.
target: Kiss his son, or he will be angry and your way will lead to your destruction, for his wrath can flare up in a moment. Blessed are all who take refuge in him.

source: O Pakai, eidouhohi iti pun hitam! Eidouva kipanho chu atamlheh uve.
target: Lord , how many are my foes! How many rise up against me!

source: Pathen ama kithopi ding aumpoi, tia kahina thudol seija chu tamtah ahi. Selah
target: Many are saying of me, “God will not deliver him.”

source: Ahinla, vo Pakai, nangma chu keidinga lumdal nahin, kaloupi nale kalu eidop sangpeh-a chu nahi.
target: But you, Lord , are a shield around me, my glory, the One who lifts my head high.

source: Keima ka Pakai henga aw gingin kataovin, aman alhang thenga konin eihin houve. Selah
target: I call out to the Lord , and he answers me from his holy mountain.

source: Keima kalumin, ka-imujin; Pakaiyin eihoi damjeh-in, kahung thoudoh kitne.
target: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, because the Lord sustains me.

source: Eidouva eium kimvel mipi sangsom hi kicha taponge.
target: I will not fear though tens of thousands assail me on every side.

source: Hung thouvin, O Pakai; vo ka Pathen, neihuh doh-in! Ajehchu kamelmate jouse chu abeng gu-u najep pehjin; Pathen ngaisah louho ha chu navoh pulpeh jie.
target: Arise, Lord ! Deliver me, my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.

source: Huhhingna chu Pakaiya ahi. Na phatthei bohna chu namite chunga um ahi. Selah
target: From the Lord comes deliverance. May your blessing be on your people.

source: Vo kachon phatna Pathen, kakou tengle neihouvin, gentheija kaum tengle nangin neipanpijie, ka chunga hepina neijinlang, kataona ngaijin.
target: Answer me when I call to you, my righteous God. Give me relief from my distress; have mercy on me and hear my prayer.

source: Vo nangho mihem chapate, kaloupi nahi itihchan jachatna a nahei diuham? Itih changei mohthu homkeo nangailut uva chule jouthu naholdiu ham? Selah
target: How long will you people turn my glory into shame? How long will you love delusions and seek false gods?

source: Ahinla Pakai chun ama dinga Pathen ngaisahho chu amadin akhendohtai ti hethemuvin; keiman ama kakou tengle Pakaiyin ajahding ahi.
target: Know that the Lord has set apart his faithful servant for himself; the Lord hears when I call to him.

source: Kichageuvin dingun lang, chonse hih un; najalkhun chunga lungthimin kihou unlang, thipbeh chan umun. Selah
target: Tremble and do not sin; when you are on your beds, search your hearts and be silent.

source: Chonphatna le ganlhainaho chu peuvinlang, chule Pakaiya natahsanu ngamdetnun.
target: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the Lord .

source: Mi tamtah-in thilpha kon eimusah untem? atiuve; Pakai namaiso vah chu kachunguva hindomsangin.
target: Many, Lord , are asking, “Who will bring us prosperity?” Let the light of your face shine on us.

source: Nangin, midanghon changle lengpitwi tamtah aneilaijuva sanga chungnungjo kipana kalungsunga nakoije.
target: Fill my heart with joy when their grain and new wine abound.

source: Keima lungmong tah-a kalupma chuleh ka-imut ding ahi: Ajehchu Pakai, nangma bou bitkeija eichensah nahi.
target: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, Lord , make me dwell in safety.

source: O Pakai, kathusei neihin ngaipeh inlang, kalunggel neingaito peh-in.
target: Listen to my words, Lord , consider my lament.

source: Ka lengpa leh ka Pathen, kakouna aw hi neingaipeh-in; ajehchu nahenga katao ding ahi.
target: Hear my cry for help, my King and my God, for to you I pray.

source: Ka-aw hi jingkah le najah ding ahi; O Pakai jingkahle chunglam vea nahenga taona kahin lhutding ahi.
target: In the morning, Lord , you hear my voice; in the morning I lay my requests before you and wait expectantly.

source: Ajehchu nangma gitlouna-a kipahji-a Pathen nahipon; thilse tojong chengkhom thei nahipoi.
target: For you are not a God who is pleased with wickedness; with you, evil people are not welcome.

source: Namitmu-a mingol dingthei louding; nangin khansetna boljouse nahot ahi.
target: The arrogant cannot stand in your presence. You hate all who do wrong;

source: Nangman jou seiho chu nasuhmang ding; Pakaiyin thisanso hat le milhemlha chu athet ding ahi.
target: you destroy those who tell lies. The bloodthirsty and deceitful you, Lord , detest.

source: Ahinla keivang, namilungset haotah jeh-in na insunga chun hunglut ingting; chule nangma kichapumin na houin theng lam ngan nahin houvinge.
target: But I, by your great love, can come into your house; in reverence I bow down toward your holy temple.

source: O Pakai, kamelmate jeh-in nadihna-a chun neipuijin; kamasanga nalampi hinlhung jangin.
target: Lead me, Lord , in your righteousness because of my enemies— make your way straight before me.

source: Ajehchu akam sunguva kitahna aumpon, asunglamu gitlouna adimin, alol homu lhan kihongsa ahin, aleijuvin amaho akiphatsei juve.
target: Not a word from their mouth can be trusted; their heart is filled with malice. Their throat is an open grave; with their tongues they tell lies.

source: O Pathen, amahohi, sumangin, athu hiluva amaho lhuhsah-in, Nangma nadoujeh ule asuhkhel nao tamtah jehchun, mipi lah-a konin amaho paidoh jengin.
target: Declare them guilty, O God! Let their intrigues be their downfall. Banish them for their many sins, for they have rebelled against you.

source: Ahinla atahsanu nangma-a ngamdet jouse kipah uhen; Nangman amaho nahonbit jal-in kipanan ao vuhen, namin ngailuho jouse jong nanga kipah uhen.
target: But let all who take refuge in you be glad; let them ever sing for joy. Spread your protection over them, that those who love your name may rejoice in you.

source: Ajehchu Pakai, nangman, michonpha phatthei boh-in natin, khotona-a lum banga nadal kimvel ding ahi.
target: Surely, Lord , you bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.

source: Pakai lunghangin neipho danlang, lungphamon jong neijep hih-in.
target: Lord , do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.

source: Vo Pakai kalhahsam jeh-in nei hepin, vo Pakai, kaguhon eichi natsoh jeh in neidamsah in.
target: Have mercy on me, Lord , for I am faint; heal me, Lord , for my bones are in agony.

source: Kahinna jong agenthei behsehtai: ahinla, O Pakai, itihchan hiding ham?
target: My soul is in deep anguish. How long, Lord , how long?

source: O Pakai, hung kinunglen lang kahinna huhhingin; oh nahepinaho jal-in neihuhhing in.
target: Turn, Lord , and deliver me; save me because of your unfailing love.

source: Ajehchu thina-a chun nangma geldohna aumtapon, lhankhuh sunga nangma kon nathangvah ding ham?
target: Among the dead no one proclaims your name. Who praises you from the grave?

source: Kakhoisat satna-in kalel lhehtan; Janseh-in kajalkhun kijapnan kaneijin, kalupna kamitlhin kachap lhop-in ahi.
target: I am worn out from my groaning. All night long I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.

source: Kamit jong lungkhamna jeh-in angui lhatan, Kamelmaho jouse jeh-in atehsetan ahi.
target: My eyes grow weak with sorrow; they fail because of all my foes.

source: Pakaiyin kataona eingaipeh tah jeh-in; khansetna bolteho jouse kakoma konin chemang uvin.
target: Away from me, all you who do evil, for the Lord has heard my weeping.

source: Pakaiyin kathumna eijah pehtan: Pakaiyin kataona eisanpeh ding ahi.
target: The Lord has heard my cry for mercy; the Lord accepts my prayer.

source: Kamelmate jouse jahchao henlang thohgim lheh uhen. Hungkileu henlang photlot louvin jahchao hen.
target: All my enemies will be overwhelmed with shame and anguish; they will turn back and suddenly be put to shame.

source: Pakai ka Pathen, nangma-ah katahsan kangame, eibol gentheiho jouse-a konin neihuh doh-in lang, neihoidoh in.
target: Lord my God, I take refuge in you; save and deliver me from all who pursue me,

source: Achutiloule, eihuhdoh ding umloupetnahi, keipi bahkai banga kahina abotela, ahal hala akoiding ahi.
target: or they will tear me apart like a lion and rip me to pieces with no one to rescue me.

source: O Pakai ka Pathen, hichehi kabol ahia, kakhutna khansetna uma ahile;
target: Lord my God, if I have done this and there is guilt on my hands—

source: kaki champi khat chu thilse-a kalethuh-a ahileh, (henge, ajehbeija kaki champi khat chu kamelma dinga kapehdoh ahitan):
target: if I have repaid my ally with evil or without cause have robbed my foe—

source: Melma chun kahinna hi bolgenthei henlang kilahjeng hen; henge, kahinkhohi, tolto lhobeh henlang, kaloupina hi leivui toh chil halhen. Selah
target: then let my enemy pursue and overtake me; let him trample my life to the ground and make me sleep in the dust.

source: O Pakai, nalung hanna-a, hung kipat doh-in, kamelma teho lunghana jeh-in nangma hung kidomsangin; chule nangman nathupeh banga thutandin keima dingin hung thoudoh-in.
target: Arise, Lord , in your anger; rise up against the rage of my enemies. Awake, my God; decree justice.

source: Hijeh-a chu mipi kikhomho chun nangma naum kimvel diu ahin; amaho khohsahna jal chun chungsang lama kiletan.
target: Let the assembled peoples gather around you, while you sit enthroned over them on high.

source: Pakaiyin mihemte thu atanding ahi: O Pakai, kachon phatna dungjuile keija um dihna dungjuijin kathu tanin.
target: Let the Lord judge the peoples. Vindicate me, Lord , according to my righteousness, according to my integrity, O Most High.

source: Oh migiloute gitlouna chu kichai hen; ahinla midihte chu tung doh-in; ajehchu Pathen chonphatna chun lungsungle lunggel apatepjin ahi.
target: Bring to an end the violence of the wicked and make the righteous secure— you, the righteous God who probes minds and hearts.

source: Eingah tupma chu, lungsung dihtah huhdohji-a Pathen'a kon ahi.
target: My shield is God Most High, who saves the upright in heart.

source: Pathen chu michonpha ho thutan ahin, Pathen chu niseh-in migilouho chunga alunghangin ahi.
target: God is a righteous judge, a God who displays his wrath every day.

source: Amachu akilehei louva ahileh, Aman achemjam anol hema, athalpi ajet kona, kigosa dema umding ahi.
target: If he does not relent, he will sharpen his sword; he will bend and string his bow.

source: Thina manchah ho jong chu amandin agongtoh demin; misugenthei ho dounan athalchang ho asemtohtai.
target: He has prepared his deadly weapons; he makes ready his flaming arrows.

source: Veovin, khansetna chu naosonat in anan, thilphalou chu avopmin, thujou chu ahung penglhatai.
target: Whoever is pregnant with evil conceives trouble and gives birth to disillusionment.

source: Aman kotong asemin, alaithuh in, akotong sema chun ama alhalutne.
target: Whoever digs a hole and scoops it out falls into the pit they have made.

source: Agitlouna chu ama luchang ngeija hungkilentin, a hunam thilbol chu alujanga hung chuding ahi.
target: The trouble they cause recoils on them; their violence comes down on their own heads.

source: Achonphatna dungjuijin keiman Pakai chu vahchoi jing ting, chungnung pen Pakai minin vahchoinan la sange.
target: I will give thanks to the Lord because of his righteousness; I will sing the praises of the name of the Lord Most High.

source: Vo Pakai ka Pakaiyu, leiset pumpi sunga naminhi iti lula lul hitam! vanho chunga naloupina nakoijin ahi.
target: Lord , our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory in the heavens.

source: Nangman melmate phulapa suhthipna dingle nangma melmaho jeh-in, naosen hole naonoichep laiho kama konin thahatna chu nasudet tan ahi.
target: Through the praise of children and infants you have established a stronghold against your enemies, to silence the foe and the avenger.

source: Keiman nakhut junga nasemsa, navan munho kavetle-a, nangman nasuhdetsaho lha leh ahsi ho kavetji teng;
target: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have set in place,

source: Mihem hi ipi hija nangin hibanga nagelkhoh-a? chule mihem chapa hi ipiham hibanga nakhohsah?
target: what is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?

source: Ajehchu nangin vantil ho sangin themkhat bou nanoinun sah-in, chule jana leh loupina lallukhuh nakhuh peh-in ahi.
target: You have made them a little lower than the angels and crowned them with glory and honor.

source: Nangman ama chu nakhutsohho jouse chunga vaihomin nasemin; thiljouse ama kengto noija nakoije:
target: You made them rulers over the works of your hands; you put everything under their feet:

source: Kelngoile bongchal jouse, henge, gamlah a gamsaho;
target: all flocks and herds, and the animals of the wild,

source: Chunga leng vachate, twikhanglen'a ngaho, chule ipi hijongleh twikhanglen'a lamlha ho jouse chunga vaipodin nasemin ahi.
target: the birds in the sky, and the fish in the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.

source: Vo Pakai ka Pakaiyu, leiset pumpi sunga naminhi iti lulla lul hitam!
target: Lord , our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!

source: Vo Pakai, kalung pumpin nangma vahchoi jingting; nathilbol kidang jouse katah lang ding ahi.
target: I will give thanks to you, Lord , with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds.

source: Nangma-a kipah-in thanominge: Vo chungnung pen Pakai, namin vahchoilan sange.
target: I will be glad and rejoice in you; I will sing the praises of your name, O Most High.

source: Kamelmate anungjam tengule, na-angsunga lhu uva mangthah diu ahi.
target: My enemies turn back; they stumble and perish before you.

source: Ajehchu nangman kathemnale kachungthu navetup in; dihtah-a thutanin laltouna-a chun natouve.
target: For you have upheld my right and my cause, sitting enthroned as the righteous judge.

source: Nangin Pathen hephalouho naphohjin, migilou chu nasumangin; aminu chu tonsotnadin nanoimang jin ahi.
target: You have rebuked the nations and destroyed the wicked; you have blotted out their name for ever and ever.

source: Vo nangho melmate, manthah na ho chu kumkho-a din suhmangin aumin; chule nangin khopi ho nasumangin; amaho hetjingna chu amahoto amantha tan ahi.
target: Endless ruin has overtaken my enemies, you have uprooted their cities; even the memory of them has perished.

source: Ahinla Pakai chu tonsotna umding ahin; Aman alaltouna chu thutanna dingin adotoh tan ahi.
target: The Lord reigns forever; he has established his throne for judgment.

source: Aman chonphatna-a vannoi hi athu atanding, aman lungthengsela mipi ho thutanna aneiding ahi.
target: He rules the world in righteousness and judges the peoples with equity.

source: Suhgentheija umte dingin Pakai chu kiselna ahin, lungkham laija kiselna mun ahi.
target: The Lord is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.

source: Chule nangma min heho chun atahsanu nanga angapdiu ahi. Ajehchu nangma holte chu, Pakai, nangman nadalha ngaipon ahi.
target: Those who know your name trust in you, for you, Lord , have never forsaken those who seek you.

source: Zion'a chenghon Pakai vahchoi La saovin; Athilbolho chu mipi lah-a phongdoh-un.
target: Sing the praises of the Lord , enthroned in Zion; proclaim among the nations what he has done.

source: Aman thisan kholchilna aneiteng amaho chu ahe jingin; aman mi kineosah ho ka awgin asumil ngaipoi.
target: For he who avenges blood remembers; he does not ignore the cries of the afflicted.

source: O Pakai, kachunga hepina neijinlang; thina kotpi-a kona eikaidohpa, eihot te-a kona kathohnahi neigel peh-in.
target: Lord , see how my enemies persecute me! Have mercy and lift me up from the gates of death,

source: Zion chanu kotpi phungho-a nangma thangvahna jouse kamusah theina dingin, nami huhhingna-a chun kipah inge.
target: that I may declare your praises in the gates of Daughter Zion, and there rejoice in your salvation.

source: Pathen hephalouho chu amaho sem kotong sunga alhalutnun; alenthang kamuva amaho keng mama a-oh jiuve.
target: The nations have fallen into the pit they have dug; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.

source: Pakai chu athutan lhah natohna-a hetdoh-in aumjin, migilou chu ama khutsohho ngeija a-oh jiuve. Haggaion. Selah
target: The Lord is known by his acts of justice; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands.

source: Migilou chu damuna kilehlutding, chule Pathen sumil namjouse jong kilehlut ding ahi.
target: The wicked go down to the realm of the dead, all the nations that forget God.

source: Ajehchu alhasama chu suhmilin umjing pontin, migenthei te kiholna tonsotnin mangpai ponte.
target: But God will never forget the needy; the hope of the afflicted will never perish.

source: Thouvin, vo Pakai, mihem kijosah hihhelin, namitmu tah-in Pathen hephalouho thu kitanhen.
target: Arise, Lord , do not let mortals triumph; let the nations be judged in your presence.

source: Vo Pakai, namtinin mihem bou akihi ti ahettheina diuvin amaho chu kichatsah-in. Selah
target: Strike them with terror, Lord ; let the nations know they are only mortal.

source: Vo Pakai, ibolla gamlatah-a ding nahim? Lungkham laija ibola kisela nahim?
target: Why, Lord , do you stand far off? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

source: Migilou chun ahoithona lamin mivaicha asugentheijin; athilgonu chun amaho kipalsah jinghen.
target: In his arrogance the wicked man hunts down the weak, who are caught in the schemes he devises.

source: Ajehchu migilou chun alung ngaichat asongin, Pakaiyin ahotlam kilosetna-a chun amaho anun nomui.
target: He boasts about the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the Lord .

source: Migilou chun ahoithona maiso-a konin Pathen holponte: Pathen chu ama ngaitona jouse-a aumpoi.
target: In his pride the wicked man does not seek him; in all his thoughts there is no room for God.

source: Alamlhah jouse phattinin lungkhamna jeng ahin; nathutan lhahho chu sangtah-a um ahin, amuphapon; amelmate jouse chu anuisatnin ahi.
target: His ways are always prosperous; your laws are rejected by him; he sneers at all his enemies.

source: Aman alungsunga, keima kiling ponge; ajehchu kidoupi kanei louding ahi, ati.
target: He says to himself, “Nothing will ever shake me.” He swears, “No one will ever do me harm.”

source: Akamsung chu gaosapna, joulhepna, dohabolna adimsetnin; alei noija setnale mohthuhomkeu bou aume.
target: His mouth is full of lies and threats; trouble and evil are under his tongue.

source: Ama khotina kichanlhih na munho-a atoujin; munthip ho-a themona neilouho athatjin: amit tenin panpibei ho guhthimin avelhin ahi.
target: He lies in wait near the villages; from ambush he murders the innocent. His eyes watch in secret for his victims;

source: Akosunga keipi bahkai bangin guhthimin akiselin achanglhi jin; migenthei chu matdin achangin, alensunga aloilutnin amanjitan ahi.
target: like a lion in cover he lies in wait. He lies in wait to catch the helpless; he catches the helpless and drags them off in his net.

source: Migenthei chu amihatpa koma alhuh nadin, ama akineosah-in tolla abohkhup jin ahi.
target: His victims are crushed, they collapse; they fall under his strength.

source: Aman alungthimin, Pathen'in asumilin, amai aseltai atin, aman itih-in mutaponte, ati.
target: He says to himself, “God will never notice; he covers his face and never sees.”

source: Vo Pakai, vo Pathen, thouvin lang nakhut domsangin, mikineosah ho chu sumil hih-in.
target: Arise, Lord ! Lift up your hand, O God. Do not forget the helpless.

source: Ipidinga mikhang gilouvin Pathen anoise ham? Aman alungsunga, nangin hichehi ngaichapon nate atin ahi.
target: Why does the wicked man revile God? Why does he say to himself, “He won’t call me to account”?

source: Ajehchu ven thilphaloule thangthipna nakhutna phulahding chu nangin namutai. Migenthei chu nahenga ahung kipelutnin; nangma pabeiho panpi chu nahi.
target: But you, God, see the trouble of the afflicted; you consider their grief and take it in hand. The victims commit themselves to you; you are the helper of the fatherless.

source: Mi engsele miphalou banjang suhboh peh-in, agitlouna naholmohel kahsen holin.
target: Break the arm of the wicked man; call the evildoer to account for his wickedness that would not otherwise be found out.

source: Pakai chu atonsot atonsotna leng ahin; Agamsunga kona Pathen hephalouho amangthah uve.
target: The Lord is King for ever and ever; the nations will perish from his land.

source: Pakai nangin mi kineosah ho ngaichat najah peh-in, nangman alungthimu nagot pehding, chule najahna dinga nakol nasun ding ahi.
target: You, Lord , hear the desire of the afflicted; you encourage them, and you listen to their cry,

source: Leiset mihemin abolgenthei kitlouna dinga, paneilou leh bolgentheija umho thu chu natanpeh ding ahi.
target: defending the fatherless and the oppressed, so that mere earthly mortals will never again strike terror.

source: Pakaiya katahsan ngaminge; iti dana nanghon kahinna jah-a, vacha bangin namolsang lama jamin neitiu ham?
target: In the Lord I take refuge. How then can you say to me: “Flee like a bird to your mountain.

source: Ajehchu, veuvin, mikitah ho lungchang guhthima kapna dingin, migilou hon athalpiu ajebongun, athal changu akhaoto asuto taove.
target: For look, the wicked bend their bows; they set their arrows against the strings to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.

source: Abulpiho akisuh mangle, michonphan ipi abolthei tahding ham?
target: When the foundations are being destroyed, what can the righteous do?”

source: Pakai chu a-houin thenga achengin, Pakai laltouna chu van'a um ahin, amit tenin ahinven, mihem chatehi apatepmin ahi.
target: The Lord is in his holy temple; the Lord is on his heavenly throne. He observes everyone on earth; his eyes examine them.

source: Pakaiyin michonpha chu apatepjin, migiloule pumhat mangho chu ahinna in ahon ahi.
target: The Lord examines the righteous, but the wicked, those who love violence, he hates with a passion.

source: Pakaiyin migiloute chunga chu meihol, mei le kaat ajuhsah-a, chule kichat umtah khopihui anunsah ding; Hichehi achandiu khon chu hiding ahi.
target: On the wicked he will rain fiery coals and burning sulfur; a scorching wind will be their lot.

source: Ajehchu chonphatna Pathen chun chonphatna chu angailun; milungthengin ama mel amujin ahi.
target: For the Lord is righteous, he loves justice; the upright will see his face.

source: Pakai, neipanpin, ajehchu Pathen he-a mi aumtapoi; ajehchu mihem chate lah-a konin tahsan um mi alosamjin ahi.
target: Help, Lord , for no one is faithful anymore; those who are loyal have vanished from the human race.

source: Amitakipmin aheng akomah thumanlou jeng aseijun, pachat lhemna muh leh lungtho neipumin thu aseijui.
target: Everyone lies to their neighbor; they flatter with their lips but harbor deception in their hearts.

source: Pakaiyin pachat lhemna muhle hoitho thu seina lei chu atanmui ding ahi.
target: May the Lord silence all flattering lips and every boastful tongue—

source: Amahon, ileijun eihon jona neiju hite, imuhhoula eihoa ahin, ichunguva Pakai koiham? atiuvin ahi.
target: those who say, “By our tongues we will prevail; our own lips will defend us—who is lord over us?”

source: Pakaiyin, vaichaho kisuh gentheina jehle, lhasamho khoisatjeh-in, tun kipat ingting, noise-a nuisatpa-a konin amachu huhdoh-in koijinge atin ahi.
target: “Because the poor are plundered and the needy groan, I will now arise,” says the Lord . “I will protect them from those who malign them.”

source: Pakai thusei ho chu thu thengtah ahin; dangka leiset lhumpi sunga vel sagivei kisutheng tobang ahi.
target: And the words of the Lord are flawless, like silver purified in a crucible, like gold refined seven times.

source: O Pakai, nangman amaho chingjingin natin, amaho chu tukhanga pat tonsot geijin vetupnan nate.
target: You, Lord , will keep the needy safe and will protect us forever from the wicked,

source: Miphalouho chu akichoisang teng, khangitlouna chu muntina avahlen ahi.
target: who freely strut about when what is vile is honored by the human race.

source: Vo Pakai, itihchan neisuhmil ding ham? Tonsot geijinem? Keima-a kona namai itihchan nasel dingham?
target: How long, Lord ? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

source: Niseh-a lungsunga lunggimna neija kahinna-a itihchan kagelgel dingham? Kamelmate kachunga itihchan choisanga umdiu ham?
target: How long must I wrestle with my thoughts and day after day have sorrow in my heart? How long will my enemy triumph over me?

source: Vo Pakai ka Pathen, ngaitonlang neingaipeh in, kamitteni vahsah in, ajole mithi ihmutnin ihmu khaget inge.
target: Look on me and answer, Lord my God. Give light to my eyes, or I will sleep in death,

source: Ajole kamelma chun ama kajoutai, tintin; chule kalonle tengle eidouva chu kipah getninte.
target: and my enemy will say, “I have overcome him,” and my foes will rejoice when I fall.

source: Ahinla nahepina ka tahsantan; nami huhhingna-a kalung kipahding ahi.
target: But I trust in your unfailing love; my heart rejoices in your salvation.

source: Aman thil ninglhing set eibolpeh jeh-in, Pakai vahchoinan keiman la sange.
target: I will sing the Lord ’s praise, for he has been good to me.

source: Mingolin alung thimin Pathen aumpoi, tin aseije. Amaho akisuboh-un, thil thet um abolun, thilpha bola khatcha aumpoi.
target: The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, their deeds are vile; there is no one who does good.

source: Ahetoh them milungching leh Pathen hola aumkhatle, tin Pakai chun van'a konin mihem chate ahinvesuh-in ahi.
target: The Lord looks down from heaven on all mankind to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.

source: Amaho ahilou lama achegam taovin, abonun aboh soh gamtaove: thilpha bola aumpouve, khat jengcha jong aumpoi.
target: All have turned away, all have become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.

source: Khangitlouna bolho jousen hetna himhim anei lou uham? Amahon achanglhah neh bangun kamite abahgamun, Pakaila akoupouvin ahi.
target: Do all these evildoers know nothing? They devour my people as though eating bread; they never call on the Lord .

source: Chua chun amaho kichatah-in aummui; ajehchu Pathen hi michonpha khang sunga aumin ahi.
target: But there they are, overwhelmed with dread, for God is present in the company of the righteous.

source: Nanghon migenthei thuhil chu najachat piuvin, hinla Pakai chu ama kiselna ahi.
target: You evildoers frustrate the plans of the poor, but the Lord is their refuge.

source: Israelte kihuh hingna chu Zion'a kona hitavele o! Pakaiyin amite asohchan naova kona ahin lepuikit tengle, Jacob chu thanom intin, Israel chu kipah ding ahi.
target: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When the Lord restores his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!

source: Pakai nahoubuh-a koi aumin? nalhang thenga koi acheng tadem?
target: Lord , who may dwell in your sacred tent? Who may live on your holy mountain?

source: Lungdih-a chonale, chonphatna bola, chule alungsunga thudihsei.
target: The one whose walk is blameless, who does what is righteous, who speaks the truth from their heart;

source: Akama mi seise lou, aheng akom chunga jong thilse bollou, chule aheng akom i-sah louva douva bol hilou.
target: whose tongue utters no slander, who does no wrong to a neighbor, and casts no slur on others;

source: Amitmua miphalou vetda, ahia Pakai gingho vang jabol; ama le ama kisuhkhah nadia kihahsel leh lungkhel kitlou.
target: who despises a vile person but honors those who fear the Lord ; who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and does not change their mind;

source: Apung dinga sumpa hom ngailou, monabei chunga nehguh la ngailou mi. Hicheng thilho bolla chu imatih-a longlou ding ahi.
target: who lends money to the poor without interest; who does not accept a bribe against the innocent. Whoever does these things will never be shaken.

source: Vo Pathen neiching phan, ajehchu nangah katahsan kangamin ahi.
target: Keep me safe, my God, for in you I take refuge.

source: Vo kahinna, nangin Pakai henga, nangma ka Pakai nahin, nangma kom tailouva thilpha kaneipoi, nati.
target: I say to the Lord , “You are my Lord; apart from you I have no good thing.”

source: Ahinla leisetna mithenghole milul ho henga, amaho-a chun kakipana jouse aumji-e nati.
target: I say of the holy people who are in the land, “They are the noble ones in whom is all my delight.”

source: Pathen dang nung del loiho chu alung hesohnao pungding; don thilpeh dinga apeh-u thisan jong katodoh louding, ahilouleh aminu jong kaphahpoh louding ahi.
target: Those who run after other gods will suffer more and more. I will not pour out libations of blood to such gods or take up their names on my lips.

source: Pakai chu kagouchanle kakhon ahi, nangman kachanvou chu neivettup peh-e.
target: Lord , you alone are my portion and my cup; you make my lot secure.

source: Tena khaoho chun munpha lai ho eikitedoh pehjin, henge, keiman gouphatah kaneitai.
target: The boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; surely I have a delightful inheritance.

source: Keima thumop eipepa Pakai chu phatthei boh inge, jan tengle kalungthimin eihiljin ahi.
target: I will praise the Lord , who counsels me; even at night my heart instructs me.

source: Keiman Pakai chu kamasanga kaumsah jingin, ama kajetlama aumjeh-in keima kiling ponge.
target: I keep my eyes always on the Lord . With him at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

source: Hijeh chun kalung akipah-in, kaloupina akipah-in; Katahsa jonghi kinepna-a choldo ding ahi.
target: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will rest secure,

source: Ajehchu nangman kahinna hi damuna nadalhah lou ding; namitheng chu mon mangna jong namusah louding ahi.
target: because you will not abandon me to the realm of the dead, nor will you let your faithful one see decay.

source: Nangin hinna lampi neimusah-in; naumna chu kipanan adimin, nakhut jetna chu tonsot kipana uma ahi.
target: You make known to me the path of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence, with eternal pleasures at your right hand.

source: Vo Pakai, adihchu ngaijin lang ka kana hi ngailhin, alhem hilou ka kama kataona ngaina din nana hinsungin.
target: Hear me, Lord , my plea is just; listen to my cry. Hear my prayer— it does not rise from deceitful lips.

source: Kachunga thulhuhna chu nanga kon hihen lang, namit tenin thil kibangho chu vehen.
target: Let my vindication come from you; may your eyes see what is right.

source: Nangin kalungthim nakhol chilin, janteng nei vilin, nangman neipatep in, ima namu louding ahi; kakamin suhkhel aneilou dinghi kakigel lhahna ahi.
target: Though you probe my heart, though you examine me at night and test me, you will find that I have planned no evil; my mouth has not transgressed.

source: Mihem natohho thudol, nakama thusoh jal-in, mi sumang jingho lampiho-a konin kakiveng tupmin ahi.
target: Though people tried to bribe me, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent through what your lips have commanded.

source: Kakalsona kalhuh lounadin, nalampi ho kajotna-a neituh-in.
target: My steps have held to your paths; my feet have not stumbled.

source: Vo Pathen, keiman nangma kakouvin, nangman neingaipeh innate; keima lama nakol hinsungin lang kathusei neingaipeh-in.
target: I call on you, my God, for you will answer me; turn your ear to me and hear my prayer.

source: O nanga atahsanu ngam jouse, amaho douho khutna kona khut jetna huhhingji-a chun, nangailut kidang chu neimusah-in.
target: Show me the wonders of your great love, you who save by your right hand those who take refuge in you from their foes.

source: Nalungset khat bangin neihongin lang, nalhalim noija neiselin,
target: Keep me as the apple of your eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings

source: Eisumang thei migilouva konle, thitheina melma eium chahho-a konin neihongin.
target: from the wicked who are out to destroy me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.

source: Amahon alungthimu thaotah chu akhahtupmun; akamun kiletsah tah-in thu aseijuve.
target: They close up their callous hearts, and their mouths speak with arrogance.

source: Amahon tun kakalsonao chana ei-umun; tollhanga suhngem dingin, amitnun eiveuvin,
target: They have tracked me down, they now surround me, with eyes alert, to throw me to the ground.

source: Keipi bahkaijin asatha apetel got bangle, keipi donglaijin munthip ho-a achanlhih abanguvin ahi.
target: They are like a lion hungry for prey, like a fierce lion crouching in cover.

source: Vo Pakai, thouvin, ama chu lunglhah sah-in, nachemjamin migilouva konin kahinkho huhdoh-in,
target: Rise up, Lord , confront them, bring them down; with your sword rescue me from the wicked.

source: Vo Pakai, nakhutna um mihemte-a konle vannoi mihem hiche hinkho-a chan neiho, atumpiu nagou sela nadip dimpeh ho-a konin kahinkho huhdoh-in; amaho chapang tamtah ahiuvin, athilu amoh chu achasen hou adalhahpeh taovin ahi.
target: By your hand save me from such people, Lord , from those of this world whose reward is in this life. May what you have stored up for the wicked fill their bellies; may their children gorge themselves on it, and may there be leftovers for their little ones.

source: Keiman vang namai chu chonphatna-a kahinvet ding; Nangma bangtah-a kahungtho teng keima kalungna chimtante.
target: As for me, I will be vindicated and will see your face; when I awake, I will be satisfied with seeing your likeness.

source: Vo Pakai, kathahat nan, keiman nangma ngailunge.
target: I love you, Lord , my strength.

source: Pakai chu kasongpile kakulpi chule eihuh hingpa ahi; ka Pathen, kathahatna, achunga katahsana kangap ding ahi; ka lumle, kahuh hingna ki, chuleh ka kulpidet ahi.
target: The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.

source: Vahchoi dia lomtah Pakai chu kou ingting, chutichun kamelma te-a konin huhdoh in umtange.
target: I called to the Lord , who is worthy of praise, and I have been saved from my enemies.

source: Thina lung genthei nahon eiumkimvelin, Pathen nahsahlouho twisoh-in eikichatsah-e.
target: The cords of death entangled me; the torrents of destruction overwhelmed me.

source: Thikholkhul lung genthei nahon eiumkimvelin, thina thangho chun ei kimaito pi-e.
target: The cords of the grave coiled around me; the snares of death confronted me.

source: Kagen theina a Pakai chu kakouvin, ka Pathen kasamin; Aman a-houin'a konin ka aw ajan, kakana chu a-angsung geijin aluttan ahi.
target: In my distress I called to the Lord ; I cried to my God for help. From his temple he heard my voice; my cry came before him, into his ears.

source: Chujouvin leiset akilingin, akihottai; Ama lunghan jeh-in lhangbul ho chu achatnin akihottai.
target: The earth trembled and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains shook; they trembled because he was angry.

source: Anah homa konin meikhu akitung doh-in, akama kona mei chun akavam heltan, hichun meihol a-al lenglung sah-in ahi.
target: Smoke rose from his nostrils; consuming fire came from his mouth, burning coals blazed out of it.

source: Aman vanho jong asonkunin, ahung kumlhan; muthim lhangkhal chu akengto noija aumin ahi.
target: He parted the heavens and came down; dark clouds were under his feet.

source: Ama Cherub chunga atouvin, alenge, henge, hui lhavingho chungah alengin ahi.
target: He mounted the cherubim and flew; he soared on the wings of the wind.

source: Aman muthim lhangkhal chu ama munthip min asemin; akimvela apon in chu twipi thimjejule van'a meilhang satah chu ahi.
target: He made darkness his covering, his canopy around him— the dark rain clouds of the sky.

source: Amasanga vahpem puma chun meilhang satah achen, gelchangle meikong alhan ahi.
target: Out of the brightness of his presence clouds advanced, with hailstones and bolts of lightning.

source: Pakaiyin vanho jong thongjejun aginsah in, chungnung pen chun a-aw asodoh in ahile gelchangle mei alhan ahi.
target: The Lord thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.

source: Henge, aman athal changho chu asoldoh-in ahile akithe chehtai, aman kolpheho akapdoh in, chule amaho chu ajoutan ahi.
target: He shot his arrows and scattered the enemy, with great bolts of lightning he routed them.

source: O Pakai nangman napho-a nanah nakhon khum tengle twilona jouse akimujin, chule vannoi leiset bulpi jouse jong akilangdoh jin ahi.
target: The valleys of the sea were exposed and the foundations of the earth laid bare at your rebuke, Lord , at the blast of breath from your nostrils.

source: Aman chunglama konin asolin, eituh in, twi tamtah lah-a konin eikaidoh-e.
target: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; he drew me out of deep waters.

source: Aman kamelma hattah-a kon leh eihot bolho-a konin eihuhdoh-e; ajehchu amaho keidingin ahat lheh jengun ahi.
target: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from my foes, who were too strong for me.

source: Hamsetna kato-nin amahon eikitopiuvin, ahinla Pakai chu kaki ngaina ahi.
target: They confronted me in the day of my disaster, but the Lord was my support.

source: Aman mun lentah khatna jong eipuidoh-in, kachunga akipajeh-in eihuh dohtan ahi.
target: He brought me out into a spacious place; he rescued me because he delighted in me.

source: Kachon phatna dungjuijin Pakaiyin kipaman eipen, kakhut then dungjuijin eilethuhnai.
target: The Lord has dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he has rewarded me.

source: Ajehchu keiman Pakai lampiho chu kajui jingin, ka Pathen'a konin giloutah-in kapotdoh khapoi.
target: For I have kept the ways of the Lord ; I am not guilty of turning from my God.

source: Athutan lhahna jouse kamasanga aumin, adan kisemho chu keija konin kapaidoh khapoi.
target: All his laws are before me; I have not turned away from his decrees.

source: Ama anga chondih jong kahin, kakhan gitlouna-a konin kakihongbit jinge.
target: I have been blameless before him and have kept myself from sin.

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin chonpha kahinale, amitmua kakhut athen dungjuijin eilethuh jin ahi.
target: The Lord has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight.

source: Mihepi themho chu hepina musah-in natin; mi chondihho chu nachondihna vetsah-in nate;
target: To the faithful you show yourself faithful, to the blameless you show yourself blameless,

source: Athenga chu nathenna musah-in natin, lung gilouho chu nalung gitlouna musah-in nate.
target: to the pure you show yourself pure, but to the devious you show yourself shrewd.

source: Ajehchu nangin aki bolgenthei hochu huhdoh-in natin; akichoisangho chu nasotlhah ding ahi.
target: You save the humble but bring low those whose eyes are haughty.

source: Ajehchu nangin kathaomei neivah peh-in natin, Pakai ka Pathen'in keija um muthim hi salvah-inte.
target: You, Lord , keep my lamp burning; my God turns my darkness into light.

source: Ajehchu nang jal-in sepaihon lah-a kalhaijin, ka Pathen jal-in kulbang kachopkhupme.
target: With your help I can advance against a troop; with my God I can scale a wall.

source: Pathen dingin alampi apha chamkimin; Pakai thu chu patepmin aumin; Ama tahsan jousedin ama chu lumdal ahi.
target: As for God, his way is perfect: The Lord ’s word is flawless; he shields all who take refuge in him.

source: Ajehchu Pakai tailou koiham Pathen? ahiloule i-Pathen'u tailou songpi koiham?
target: For who is God besides the Lord ? And who is the Rock except our God?

source: Hatna-a kakong eigehpeh-a leh kalampi sempha chamkima Pathen ahi.
target: It is God who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure.

source: Aman kakeng chu sajuhpi keng bangin asemin, kamunsangho chunga eiumsahjie.
target: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer; he causes me to stand on the heights.

source: Kaban teni-a thih thalpi kaheboh theinadin, aman kakhut teni gal bolje ahile.
target: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

source: Nangin nahuhhingna lumdal jong chu neipen; nakhut jetlamin neikai doh-in nanun nemna chun lentah eisoi.
target: You make your saving help my shield, and your right hand sustains me; your help has made me great.

source: Kalhuh louna dingin, kakho lhahna ding neisem letpeh-in ahi.
target: You provide a broad path for my feet, so that my ankles do not give way.

source: Kamelmate nung kadelin, kaphan, amaho kasuh manghel kahsen kahungkile jipon ahi.
target: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back till they were destroyed.

source: Amaho athodoh joulouhelna diuvin kamavon, kakengto noija alhusoh helun ahi.
target: I crushed them so that they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.

source: Ajehchu nangin galsatna-a ding thahatna kong neigah peh-in; keima douna-a hungkipatdohho chu kanoija nasunem hele.
target: You armed me with strength for battle; you humbled my adversaries before me.

source: Eithetbol ho chu kasuhmang theinadin, nangman kamelmate ngong hochu neipetan ahi.
target: You made my enemies turn their backs in flight, and I destroyed my foes.

source: Amaho apengun, ahinla ahuhdoh dingula khatcha aumpon; Pakai jengjong akouvun, ahinla aman adonbut dehpouve.
target: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them— to the Lord , but he did not answer.

source: Chu jouvin huinung masanga vutvai bangin amaho kavogoijin; lamlena thilboh bangin kapai doh-in ahi.
target: I beat them as fine as windblown dust; I trampled them like mud in the streets.

source: Nangin miho kisat tona lah-a konin neihuh doh-in; chule nangin keima Pathen hepha louho luchangin neisemin, kahetkhah lou mihon eijendiu ahi.
target: You have delivered me from the attacks of the people; you have made me the head of nations. People I did not know now serve me,

source: Kathulhut ajah jah-uleh eijoppai juntin; gamdang miho chu kahenga hungkipelut diu ahi.
target: foreigners cower before me; as soon as they hear of me, they obey me.

source: Gamdang miho chu hung lhasam untin, akulpi houva kona kithing pumpuma hung dohdiu ahi.
target: They all lose heart; they come trembling from their strongholds.

source: Pakai ahing jinge; kasongpi chu nunnom hen; eihuh hinga Pathen chu choisangin umhen.
target: The Lord lives! Praise be to my Rock! Exalted be God my Savior!

source: Kaphu eilahpeh-a, miho kanoija sunema chu Pathen ahi.
target: He is the God who avenges me, who subdues nations under me,

source: Aman kamelma te-a konin eihuhdoh-e; henge, keima douna-a hung kipatdoh ho chung vuma neidom sangin; hunam mipa-a konin neihuh doh tai.
target: who saves me from my enemies. You exalted me above my foes; from a violent man you rescued me.

source: Hijeh chun O Pakai, Pathen hephalou ho lah-a chun nangma na thangvah ingting, chutengle nangma min vahchoi la sange.
target: Therefore I will praise you, Lord , among the nations; I will sing the praises of your name.

source: Aman huhhingna lentah chu alengpa apen, chule athaonu David leh achilhahte chunga chun ahepina tonsotna din amusah-e.
target: He gives his king great victories; he shows unfailing love to his anointed, to David and to his descendants forever.

source: Vanhon Pathen loupina aphong doh-un; chule vanthamjolin akhutsem amusah-e.
target: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.

source: Sunin sun jah-a thu aseijin, chule jan-in jan jah-a hetna amusah-in ahi.
target: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.

source: Hichea chun thu kisei aumpon, paole oginjong akijapoi.
target: They have no speech, they use no words; no sound is heard from them.

source: Atena khao chu leiset pumpi-a chule athu uchu vannoi leiset kolmang geijin akikhon; Hicheho-a chun aman nisa dingin ponbuh khat asongin,
target: Yet their voice goes out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. In the heavens God has pitched a tent for the sun.

source: Hichu moulang a-indana kona hungdoh tobang ahin, kilhaitetna-a lhaiding pasal hat bangin athanome.
target: It is like a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course.

source: Apotdohna chu van mong langkhatna kipan ahin, alhuna chu among langkhat chan ahi; chuche asatna-a kona kisela imacha aumpoi.
target: It rises at one end of the heavens and makes its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.

source: Pakai dan chu achamkimin, hinna sempha-a ahi; Pakai thu hettohsah chu athengin, mimol ho achih sah-e.
target: The law of the Lord is perfect, refreshing the soul. The statutes of the Lord are trustworthy, making wise the simple.

source: Pakai dan kisemchu adih-in, lungsung akipasah-in; Pakai dan thupeh chu athengin, mit teni avahsah-in ahi.
target: The precepts of the Lord are right, giving joy to the heart. The commands of the Lord are radiant, giving light to the eyes.

source: Pakai ginchu athengin, a-imatih channa aumjingin; Pakai thutanlhahho chu thutah le chonphatna ahisoh keije.
target: The fear of the Lord is pure, enduring forever. The decrees of the Lord are firm, and all of them are righteous.

source: Hicheho chu sana sangin jong dei aumjon, henge, sana thengsel sangin jong athengjoi, khoijule khoiphang sanga jong lhumjo ahi.
target: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the honeycomb.

source: Chukalvalin nasohhi nagihsalin; chule hicheho chintupna-a chun kipaman lentah aumin ahi.
target: By them your servant is warned; in keeping them there is great reward.

source: Ama suhkhel ho kihetkhen jouva koiham? Guhthima kasuh khella konin neisuthengin.
target: But who can discern their own errors? Forgive my hidden faults.

source: Nasohhi kihoitho sahna chonset ho-a konin jong neituh-in; hitiho chu kachunga vaihomsah hih-in; chutengle keima kalung thenga, chule keima suhkhelna lentah-a kona monabei kahiding ahi.
target: Keep your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless, innocent of great transgression.

source: O Pakai, kahatnale eilhandampu, kakama thupot hole kalungthim sunga kagelhi, namitmun santhei doltah hihen.
target: May these words of my mouth and this meditation of my heart be pleasing in your sight, Lord , my Rock and my Redeemer.

source: Nalungkham nile Pakaiyin nadonbut henlang; Jacob Pathen min chun nahongbit hen!
target: May the Lord answer you when you are in distress; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.

source: Munthenga konin nakithopi hinsolhen lang, Zion'a konin natha hatsahhen;
target: May he send you help from the sanctuary and grant you support from Zion.

source: Nathilpeh jouse hejing henlang, chule na govam thilto jong sanghen. Selah
target: May he remember all your sacrifices and accept your burnt offerings.

source: Aman nalungdei dungjuijin nape henlang, chule nathilgon jouse nabulhit peh hen.
target: May he give you the desire of your heart and make all your plans succeed.

source: Keiho nami huhhingna-a chun kipah-uving ting, ka Pathen'u minin kaponlap hou tungdoh-uvinge! Nathum jouse Pakaiyin nasuh bulhitpeh hen.
target: May we shout for joy over your victory and lift up our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord grant all your requests.

source: Pakaiyin athaonu ho ahuhdoh-e ti tun kahetai; akhut jetlam huhhingna thahat chun, avanthenga konchun hin ngaipeh inte.
target: Now this I know: The Lord gives victory to his anointed. He answers him from his heavenly sanctuary with the victorious power of his right hand.

source: Abangin sakol kangtalai ho, chule abangin sakol ho atahsanun; keihon vang Pakai ka Pathen'u min chu kageldoh jingjeng diu ahi.
target: Some trust in chariots and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the Lord our God.

source: Amaho suhnem ahiuvin alhuve, keihovang kithoudoh uving ting, lungtheng sela kadindiu ahi.
target: They are brought to their knees and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.

source: Pakai, huhhingin! keihon kakou tengule lengpan neihin ngaipeh-un.
target: Lord , give victory to the king! Answer us when we call!

source: Vo Pakai, nahatna-a lengpa kipah intin, nahuhhing na-a ama iti akipa tadem!
target: The king rejoices in your strength, Lord . How great is his joy in the victories you give!

source: Nangin alung ngaichat napen, akama athumho chu na-it pehpoi.
target: You have granted him his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips.

source: Ajehchu Nangin ama chu phatnale phattheina ho in navengbit in, sana thengtah lallukhuh alua nakhuh peh-e.
target: You came to greet him with rich blessings and placed a crown of pure gold on his head.

source: Aman nahenga hinkho athumin, nangin tonsot hinkho saona jengjong napetan ahi.
target: He asked you for life, and you gave it to him— length of days, for ever and ever.

source: Nami huhhingna jana loupi chu anasata ngeijin, janale lalna chu achunga nangam tai.
target: Through the victories you gave, his glory is great; you have bestowed on him splendor and majesty.

source: Ajehchu nangman tonsotna phattheina chungnung changdin ama nasemin; na-umpina chun kipana chungnung apen ahi.
target: Surely you have granted him unending blessings and made him glad with the joy of your presence.

source: Ajehchu lengpan Pakai atahsanin, chule chungnung pen hepina jeh-in ama chu kiling ponte.
target: For the king trusts in the Lord ; through the unfailing love of the Most High he will not be shaken.

source: Nakhutnin namelmate jouse holdoh intin, nahote chu nakhut jetnin holdoh inte.
target: Your hand will lay hold on all your enemies; your right hand will seize your foes.

source: Nalunghan tengle amaho chu lhumsung meikong banga nasemding; Pakaiyin alunghana-a aval lhumuva, chule meichun ahalvam gamdiu ahi.
target: When you appear for battle, you will burn them up as in a blazing furnace. The Lord will swallow them up in his wrath, and his fire will consume them.

source: Amaho ga chu leija konin, chule achilhah-u chu leisetna mihem chate lah-a konin sumangin nate.
target: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from mankind.

source: Ajehchu amahon nangma douna-in thilse bol agouvin; amahon aboldoh joulou dingu thilphalou angaitouvin ahi.
target: Though they plot evil against you and devise wicked schemes, they cannot succeed.
