source: Hijeh chun nangin nathal changho akhaoto nasuhto-a amai dungu nadoitengle, nangin amaho nakinungle sah ding ahi.
target: You will make them turn their backs when you aim at them with drawn bow.

source: Pakai, nathahatna achun, nangma kichoisangin, chutia chu keihon nathahatna chu vahchoina la-a kasahdiu ahi.
target: Be exalted in your strength, Lord ; we will sing and praise your might.

source: Ka Pathen, ka Pathen ibola neidalhah hitam? Ipidinga eipanpi dingle gimthoh-a kapena awchenga kona nahiti gamlat hitam?
target: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from saving me, so far from my cries of anguish?

source: Vo ka Pathen, suntengle nangma kasamjin, ahinla neijah pehpoi; chule jankhon jong thiptih kanei jipoi.
target: My God, I cry out by day, but you do not answer, by night, but I find no rest.

source: Ahinla nangma atheng nahin, Israelte pachatna-a chengjinga chu nahi.
target: Yet you are enthroned as the Holy One; you are the one Israel praises.

source: Kapu kapa teovin nangma natahsan uvin, amahon natahsanun, chule nangin amaho nahuhdohjin ahi.
target: In you our ancestors put their trust; they trusted and you delivered them.

source: Amaho nangma henga ataovun, nahuhdohji-e; amahon nangma natahsan jeh-uchun, akisudong jipouve.
target: To you they cried out and were saved; in you they trusted and were not put to shame.

source: Ahinla keima lungtol bep kahin, mihem kahipoi; chule mihemte i-sah loule mite nahsahlou kahi.
target: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by everyone, despised by the people.

source: Eimu chanin nahsahlouvin einuisatnun; amuh aholpumun, alu athingun, aseijiuvin,
target: All who see me mock me; they hurl insults, shaking their heads.

source: Aman eihuhdoh-inte tin Pakai chu atahsanin; Achunga akipa amujeh-in aman ama huhdoh tahen.
target: “He trusts in the Lord ,” they say, “let the Lord rescue him. Let him deliver him, since he delights in him.”

source: Ahinla nangma naobu sunga kona einaloi doh-a chu nahin, kanu anga kaumlaija neina kinepsahsa ahitai.
target: Yet you brought me out of the womb; you made me trust in you, even at my mother’s breast.

source: Keima naobu-a kona nachunga eina sekhumu ahin, kanu oisunga kona ka Pathen nahitai.
target: From birth I was cast on you; from my mother’s womb you have been my God.

source: Keija konin gamlahih-in, ajehchu lungkhamna anaije; ajehchu eipanpi ding khatcha aumpoi.
target: Do not be far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.

source: Bongchal tamtah-in eiumkimvelun; Bashan bongchal hattahhon eiumkimvel sohtai.
target: Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.

source: Keipi bahkai hangtah kitum bangin, akam eikat hom khumun ahi.
target: Roaring lions that tear their prey open their mouths wide against me.

source: Keima twibangin eikisunglhan, kagu kachang jouse akikhensoh in; kalunghi khoilu bangin kagilpi sunga ajollha tai.
target: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint. My heart has turned to wax; it has melted within me.

source: Kathahat nahi leibel chipsa bangin agolhatan; chule kalei jong kadanga abehchah in, nangin thina leivuija neipuilut tai.
target: My mouth is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth; you lay me in the dust of death.

source: Ajehchu uicha hon eiumkimvelun; khangilou mipi kikhom hon eium naijun, kakhutle kakenghohi asunun ahi.
target: Dogs surround me, a pack of villains encircles me; they pierce my hands and my feet.

source: Kagujouse kasimtheijin, amahon eiveovin eigaldot uve.
target: All my bones are on display; people stare and gloat over me.

source: Amaho kavon jouse akihomun, chule kaponsil changding jong vang akisan taove.
target: They divide my clothes among them and cast lots for my garment.

source: Vo Pakai nangma keija konin umgamla hih-in, vo kathahatna, eipanpi dingin kinon.
target: But you, Lord , do not be far from me. You are my strength; come quickly to help me.

source: Kahinna hi chemjam'a konin huhdoh-in, kahinkho manlutah hi uicha thanei na-a konin huhdoh-in.
target: Deliver me from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dogs.

source: Keipi bahkai kamsunga konin neihuh doh-in, ajehchu sakol kinei kiho-a konin jong neina ngaipeh-in ahi.
target: Rescue me from the mouth of the lions; save me from the horns of the wild oxen.

source: Kasopite henga namin phongleng ting; mipi kikhomho lah-a nangma kavahchoi ding nahi.
target: I will declare your name to my people; in the assembly I will praise you.

source: Pakai ginga nanghon ama vahchoijun, Jacob sonho jousen ama choi-anun, Israel sonho jousen ama chu gingun.
target: You who fear the Lord , praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, honor him! Revere him, all you descendants of Israel!

source: Ajehchu aman bolgenthei thohho chu nahsahmole hotnin abol gentheipon, ama-a konin jong amai aselpoi; ahinla ahenga athumteng angaipehjie.
target: For he has not despised or scorned the suffering of the afflicted one; he has not hidden his face from him but has listened to his cry for help.

source: Mipi kikhomho tamtah lah-a kapachatna chu nanga hintin, ama gingte angsunga kakitepna ho lhutninge.
target: From you comes the theme of my praise in the great assembly; before those who fear you I will fulfill my vows.

source: Minunnem hon neovintin, lunglhaijunte; ama holho chun Pakai chu vahchoi unte; nalungthim chu tonsotna hingding ahi.
target: The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the Lord will praise him— may your hearts live forever!

source: Leiset kolkimvelin Pakai ageldoh-a Pakai henga kilediu; chule chitin namtin jousen ama ahou dingu ahi.
target: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the Lord , and all the families of the nations will bow down before him,

source: Ajehchu lenggam chu Pakaiya ahin; chule ama namtin lah-a vaihompa ahi.
target: for dominion belongs to the Lord and he rules over the nations.

source: Leichunga khangtouho jousen neovintin chule ama ahoudiu; leivuija kileding jouse a-anga kuncheh ding; koimachan ama hinna akihuhjou louding ahi.
target: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before him— those who cannot keep themselves alive.

source: Chilhah khatnin ama jenintin, hichu Pakai henga khangkhatna kisimding ahi.
target: Posterity will serve him; future generations will be told about the Lord.

source: Amaho hunguva, ahung pengding miho henga hiche athilbol aumchan chonphatna hi aphondoh dingu ahi.
target: They will proclaim his righteousness, declaring to a people yet unborn: He has done it!

source: Pakai chu kelngoi chinna eichingpa ahin, keima lhasamponge.
target: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.

source: Aman hamhing lah-a eikolsah jin, twi damdidei pang dunga eipuilei.
target: He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters,

source: Aman kalhagao akiledohsah jin; amin jallin chonphatna lampiho-a eipuilei.
target: he refreshes my soul. He guides me along the right paths for his name’s sake.

source: Henge, keiman thina phaicham lim jotjongleng, thilse gingtaponge; ajehchu nangman nei umpin, namol lhon le natenggolin eilhamonjin ahi.
target: Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

source: Nangman kamelmate angsunga dokhang neigon peh-in; kalu thao nanun, kakhon alonglet tai.
target: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.

source: Thonlou hella phatnale hepina-in kahinkho lhungkeija eijuiding; chule atonsotna keima Pakai in'a kachenjing ding ahi.
target: Surely your goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever.

source: Vannoi leisetle asunga cheng jouse, aboncha Pakaiya ahi.
target: The earth is the Lord ’s, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it;

source: Ajehchu aman twipiho chunga atundoh-a, twisohho chunga aphudet ahi.
target: for he founded it on the seas and established it on the waters.

source: Pakai lhanga kaldinga koi hija, amunthenga gading dinga koiham?
target: Who may ascend the mountain of the Lord ? Who may stand in his holy place?

source: Khut thengle lungtheng neija, ahinna pannabei dinga pedohlou, jouva kihahsel louhel mi chu ahi.
target: The one who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not trust in an idol or swear by a false god.

source: Aman Pakaiya kona vangbohna le, ahuhhingpa Pathen'a kona chonphatna amuding ahi.
target: They will receive blessing from the Lord and vindication from God their Savior.

source: Vo Jacob hichehi ama holtele namai holte khanggui chu ahi. Selah
target: Such is the generation of those who seek him, who seek your face, God of Jacob.

source: Vo kotpi ho, nanghon nalu-u domsangun, chule tonsot kotpi nangho kikhang sangun, chutile loupina leng chu hunglut ding ahi.
target: Lift up your heads, you gates; be lifted up, you ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.

source: Hiche loupina leng chu koiham? Pakai thahat tah le thaneitah, gal hattah Pakai chu ahi.
target: Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle.

source: Vo kotpiho, nanghon nalu-u domsangun, chule tonsot kotpi nangho kikhang sangun, chutile loupina leng chu hunglut ding ahi.
target: Lift up your heads, you gates; lift them up, you ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.

source: Hiche loupina leng chu koiham? Janel Pakai, ama loupina leng ahi. Selah
target: Who is he, this King of glory? The Lord Almighty— he is the King of glory.

source: Vo Pakai, na-anga, kalhagao kadom sange.
target: In you, Lord my God, I put my trust.

source: Vo ka Pathen, nangma katahsane, nei jachatsah danlang, kamelmate neijosah hihhelin.
target: I trust in you; do not let me be put to shame, nor let my enemies triumph over me.

source: Henge, nangma ngahjinga um chanchu jumso hih-in, ajeh beija suhkhelna neiho vangchu jachatsah-in.
target: No one who hopes in you will ever be put to shame, but shame will come on those who are treacherous without cause.

source: Vo Pakai, nalampi ho neimusah-in, na lamlhahho neihilin.
target: Show me your ways, Lord , teach me your paths.

source: Nathutah-a neipuijin lang, neihilin, eihuh hinga Pathen nahi jeh-in nilhumkeijin nangma kangeh-e.
target: Guide me in your truth and teach me, for you are God my Savior, and my hope is in you all day long.

source: Vo Pakai, masang laija anaumjingsa nahi jeh-in, nahepi khotonale nangailut lungsetna chu geldoh in.
target: Remember, Lord , your great mercy and love, for they are from of old.

source: Kakhang donlai chonset hole suhkhelnaho geldoh hih-in, Vo Pakai naphatna jehle nahepina dungjuijin neigeldoh in.
target: Do not remember the sins of my youth and my rebellious ways; according to your love remember me, for you, Lord , are good.

source: Apha le akitah chu Pakai ahin; hijeh-a chu aman michonse te chu alampi ahilding ahi.
target: Good and upright is the Lord ; therefore he instructs sinners in his ways.

source: Aman milungnengho thutan na-a kaihoi jintin, milungneng chu alampi ahilding ahi.
target: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them his way.

source: Athulhunale athu hettohsahna tuhdet ho dingin, Pakai lamlhah jouse chu hepinale thutah ahi.
target: All the ways of the Lord are loving and faithful toward those who keep the demands of his covenant.

source: O Pakai, namin jal-in kakhan setna nasatah hi ngaidamin.
target: For the sake of your name, Lord , forgive my iniquity, though it is great.

source: Pakai ginga mi chu koiham? Aman akilhending lampi chu aman ahilding ahi.
target: Who, then, are those who fear the Lord ? He will instruct them in the ways they should choose.

source: Ahinkho-a nomtah-a chenga, achilhah ten leiset alodiu ahi.
target: They will spend their days in prosperity, and their descendants will inherit the land.

source: Pakai thuguh chu ama gingho-a uma ahin, akitepna chu amaho amusah ding ahi.
target: The Lord confides in those who fear him; he makes his covenant known to them.

source: Aman kakengteni lenna kona asutlhah ding jeh-in, kamitnin Pakai lamjeng akat jingin ahi.
target: My eyes are ever on the Lord , for only he will release my feet from the snare.

source: Kaheng lama hung kiheijinlang kachunga khotona neineijin, ajehchu lung thomhaole thohgima um kahitai.
target: Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am lonely and afflicted.

source: Kalunga lungkhamna ho anasa behsehtai; O kahesohna ho-a konin neipuidoh tan.
target: Relieve the troubles of my heart and free me from my anguish.

source: Kahesoh nale kathoh nat nahi hin venlang, chule kachonsetna jouse neingaidamin.
target: Look on my affliction and my distress and take away all my sins.

source: Kamelma tehi ngaito temin, ajehchu tamtah ahiuvin, nasatah in eihouvun ahi.
target: See how numerous are my enemies and how fiercely they hate me!

source: Kahinna hongbit ninlang, neihuhdoh tan, nangma-a katahsan kangapjeh-in, neijachat sah hih-in.
target: Guard my life and rescue me; do not let me be put to shame, for I take refuge in you.

source: Nangma ngah-a kahijeh-in, lungthen le dihcham kimna chun eivengtup hen.
target: May integrity and uprightness protect me, because my hope, Lord , is in you.

source: Vo Pathen, alungkhamnao jouse-a konin Israel hi lhatdoh tan.
target: Deliver Israel, O God, from all their troubles!

source: Lungdet tah-a kachon jeh-in, Vo Pakai kathu tanin, katahsan jong Pakaiya kangaijin, hijeh-a chu keima kalhuh louding ahi.
target: Vindicate me, Lord , for I have led a blameless life; I have trusted in the Lord and have not faltered.

source: Vo Pakai, neikhol chilin lang neiphochenin, kalunggel leh kalungsung patepmin.
target: Test me, Lord , and try me, examine my heart and my mind;

source: Ajehchu nangailut lungsetna kamasanga aumin, chule nathutah-a kachonlen ahi.
target: for I have always been mindful of your unfailing love and have lived in reliance on your faithfulness.

source: Moh mimaimaitoh katoukhom ngaipon, miphalhem ho henga jong lut hihhel inge.
target: I do not sit with the deceitful, nor do I associate with hypocrites.

source: Thilse bolho kikhopna chu kahot ahin, michonse tojong toukhom ponge.
target: I abhor the assembly of evildoers and refuse to sit with the wicked.

source: Kakhut teni hi nolna beijin sopming ting, hitichun o Pakai, namaicham kimvela vahlenge.
target: I wash my hands in innocence, and go about your altar, Lord ,

source: Thangvahna awgina kaphondoh theina dingin, nathilbol kidang jouse hil lenge.
target: proclaiming aloud your praise and telling of all your wonderful deeds.

source: Pakai, naumna in leh loupitah nachenna mun chu kangailun ahi.
target: Lord , I love the house where you live, the place where your glory dwells.

source: Kalhagao hi michonseho, ahiloule kahinkhohi thisanso ho toh umkhomsah hih-in.
target: Do not take away my soul along with sinners, my life with those who are bloodthirsty,

source: Akhut houva chonphat louna aumin, akhut jetlam uva nehguh adimsetnin ahi.
target: in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.

source: Ahinla keima vang lungdih tah-in vahleng ting, neilhatdoh inlang, neihin hepitan.
target: I lead a blameless life; deliver me and be merciful to me.

source: Kakenghi muncham tah-a adingin, kikhopnaho-a Pakai choi-an inge.
target: My feet stand on level ground; in the great congregation I will praise the Lord .

source: Pakai chu kameivah le eihuh hingpa ahin; koi kagin dingham? Pakai chu kahinkho-a kathahatna ahin; Koi kakichat dingham?
target: The Lord is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The Lord is the stronghold of my life— of whom shall I be afraid?

source: Mikhangse, kamelmahole kagalte jengin jong, kasa hi nehgop dinga kachunga ahungchuh tengule akipalun alhuji taovin ahi.
target: When the wicked advance against me to devour me, it is my enemies and my foes who will stumble and fall.

source: Janel hon keima dounan gebuh songjong leu, kalung kicha pontin; eidoudin gal hungkon jongle hichea jongchu tahsan um kahiding ahi.
target: Though an army besiege me, my heart will not fear; though war break out against me, even then I will be confident.

source: Keiman Pakai henga kadeichat thilkhat thuming ting; hichu kaholjing ding, chutileh Pakai insunga kahinkho lhungkeija kachen theija, Pakai melhoina kavetjing ding, chule a-houin sunga thu kakhol jingthei ding ahi.
target: One thing I ask from the Lord , this only do I seek: that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the Lord and to seek him in his temple.

source: Ajehchu kalungkham tengle apon insunga eiselintin, ahoubuh munthip sunga aman eisela, asongpi chunga eitousah ding ahi.
target: For in the day of trouble he will keep me safe in his dwelling; he will hide me in the shelter of his sacred tent and set me high upon a rock.

source: Tunvang kakimvela kamelmate chungvuma kaluhi dopsanga umding ahitan; hijeh-a chu ahoubuh-a kipa ganlhaina ho kapeh-a, la kasah ding, henge, Pakai vahchoi La tumgingto tho-a kasah ding ahi.
target: Then my head will be exalted above the enemies who surround me; at his sacred tent I will sacrifice with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the Lord .

source: Vo Pakai, ka aw gina kasap tengle neingaipeh-in, kachungah hepina neijinlang, neidonbut in.
target: Hear my voice when I call, Lord ; be merciful to me and answer me.

source: Kamai holun nati laichun kalungin nahenga, Pakai namai holinge kanatin ahi.
target: My heart says of you, “Seek his face!” Your face, Lord , I will seek.

source: Keija konin namai selgamla hih-in, lunghanin nasoh hi notdoh hih-in, nangma eipanpi nahin, vo eihuh hinga Pathen, neidalhah danlang, neipaidoh hih-in.
target: Do not hide your face from me, do not turn your servant away in anger; you have been my helper. Do not reject me or forsake me, God my Savior.

source: Kanule kapan eidalhah tengle Pakaiyin eikipomding ahi.
target: Though my father and mother forsake me, the Lord will receive me.

source: Vo Pakai, nalampi neihilin, chule kamelmaho jeh-in lamjolsela neipuijin.
target: Teach me your way, Lord ; lead me in a straight path because of my oppressors.

source: Kamelmate deilamin neipedoh loujenin; ajehchu keima dounan, nunset thujeng aseijun, chule hettohsah lhemho asohdoh tan ahi.
target: Do not turn me over to the desire of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, spouting malicious accusations.

source: Mihing gama chu Pakai phatna muding tahsanlou anahileng vang alhasama kahitai.
target: I remain confident of this: I will see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

source: Pakai chu ngahjingin, hangtah in umin, chutile nalungthim ahatsah ding ahi; Pakai chu ngahjingin, kati ahi.
target: Wait for the Lord ; be strong and take heart and wait for the Lord .

source: Vo Pakai le kasongpi, nahenga hungtaovinge, keima neithipsan le, kotong sung kijotlut ho tobang kahiding ahitai.
target: To you, Lord , I call; you are my Rock, do not turn a deaf ear to me. For if you remain silent, I will be like those who go down to the pit.

source: Nahenga kaka-a, namun theng lam nga-a kakhut kahindop teng, kathumna aw neingaipeh-in.
target: Hear my cry for mercy as I call to you for help, as I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

source: Migiloule khanset bolho chutoh neikaimangtha hih-in, amahon aheng akom henga chamna thu aseijiuvin, ahinla alunguva thilphalou aumjinge.
target: Do not drag me away with the wicked, with those who do evil, who speak cordially with their neighbors but harbor malice in their hearts.

source: Athilbollu dungjuile athil gilou bollu dungjuijin pen, akhutnuva atoh bangun lethuh inlang, aset mannu musah-in.
target: Repay them for their deeds and for their evil work; repay them for what their hands have done and bring back on them what they deserve.

source: Amahon Pakai natohle akhutna athilbol angaisahlou jeh un, aman amaho sumang intin, semphakit ponte.
target: Because they have no regard for the deeds of the Lord and what his hands have done, he will tear them down and never build them up again.

source: Kathumna eingaipeh jeh-in Pakai chu vahchoijin umhen.
target: Praise be to the Lord , for he has heard my cry for mercy.

source: Pakai chu kathahatle kalumdal ahin; kalungin ama atahsanin, chule panpin kaumme; hijeh chun kalung akipah lheh-in, chule ama chu lan vahchoi tange.
target: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me. My heart leaps for joy, and with my song I praise him.

source: Pakai chu athahatnao ahin, ama chu athaonu dinga huhhingna thahat ahi.
target: The Lord is the strength of his people, a fortress of salvation for his anointed one.

source: Namite huhhingin lang chule nagoulote phatthei boh-in; amaho chu vah inlang chule tonsotna din domsang tan.
target: Save your people and bless your inheritance; be their shepherd and carry them forever.

source: Pakai chu vahchoina peovin, vo, van mite Athahat aloupina chu vahchoijun, Pakai chu loupina leh thahatna peovin.
target: Ascribe to the Lord , you heavenly beings, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.

source: Pakaiya amin loupina chu peuvin; athen hoina-in Pakai chu houvun.
target: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; worship the Lord in the splendor of his holiness.

source: Pakai aw chu twiho chunga aumin; Pathen loupinachu ahung kitumjah-in; Pakai chu twiho chunga chun aumin ahi.
target: The voice of the Lord is over the waters; the God of glory thunders, the Lord thunders over the mighty waters.

source: Pakai aw chu thaneitah ahin; Pakai awchu lal loupina-a dimset ahi.
target: The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is majestic.

source: Pakai aw chun Cedar thingho amanthah sah-in; henge, Pakaiyin Lebanon'a Cedar ho asumang gamtai.
target: The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars; the Lord breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

source: Aman amaho bongnou bangin akichopsah-in; Lebanon le Sirion chu sakol kinei nou abahsah-e.
target: He makes Lebanon leap like a calf, Sirion like a young wild ox.

source: Pakai aw chun meika al-lenglung aphelkhen-in ahi.
target: The voice of the Lord strikes with flashes of lightning.

source: Pakai aw chun gamthip gam ahotlingjin, Pakai chun Kadesh ahotlingtai.
target: The voice of the Lord shakes the desert; the Lord shakes the Desert of Kadesh.

source: Pakai aw chun sajuhpi bongnou asosahjin, gammangho jong achaisah in, a-houin sunga umho jousen aloupina aseijuve.
target: The voice of the Lord twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in his temple all cry, “Glory!”

source: Pakai chu twisohho chunga chun atouvin; henge, Pakai chu tonsot lengdin atouvin ahi.
target: The Lord sits enthroned over the flood; the Lord is enthroned as King forever.

source: Pakaiyin amite henga thaneina pentin, Pakaiyin amite chu chamna-a phatthei abohding ahi.
target: The Lord gives strength to his people; the Lord blesses his people with peace.

source: Vo Pakai nangin neidopsanga, kachunga kamelmate nakipasah loujeh-in, keiman nangma choi-an inge.
target: I will exalt you, Lord , for you lifted me out of the depths and did not let my enemies gloat over me.

source: Vo Pakai ka Pathen, nahenga kataovin, nangin neidamsah tai.
target: Lord my God, I called to you for help, and you healed me.

source: Vo Pakai, nangin kahinna lhankhuh-a konin napuitouvin, kokhuh-a kakumsuh lounadin, nangin neihinghoi tan ahi.
target: You, Lord , brought me up from the realm of the dead; you spared me from going down to the pit.

source: Vo nangho amithengte, Pakaiya tumgingto thon vahchoi La saovin lang, athenna hetdohnadin ama thangvahna peovin.
target: Sing the praises of the Lord , you his faithful people; praise his holy name.

source: Ajehchu alunghana chu chom chakhat bou ahin, alungsetna-a chun hinna aume; kana hi jankhatbou ahin, jingkah teng kipana ahunghiji tai.
target: For his anger lasts only a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime; weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.

source: Chule kaphatthei laijin, itih hijongle kiling ponge, kanatin ahi.
target: When I felt secure, I said, “I will never be shaken.”

source: Pakai, nei khohsahna jal-in, kamolsang nadindet sah-in, namai nanaselin, kana lungkhame.
target: Lord , when you favored me, you made my royal mountain stand firm; but when you hid your face, I was dismayed.

source: Vo Pakai nangma kanasamin, chule Pakai henga kana thumin ahi.
target: To you, Lord , I called; to the Lord I cried for mercy:

source: Kokhuh-a kakumlhah tengle, kathisan nahi ipi phatchomna umding ham? Leivuijin navahchoija nakitahna aphondoh ding ham?
target: “What is gained if I am silenced, if I go down to the pit? Will the dust praise you? Will it proclaim your faithfulness?

source: Vo Pakai ngaijin lang, kachunga hepina neijin, Pakai nangma eipanpia chu hin.
target: Hear, Lord , and be merciful to me; Lord , be my help.”

source: Nangin kalung hemna lamnan naheidoh-in, kakhaodip pon nahohlhan, kipanan kong neigahpeh tan,
target: You turned my wailing into dancing; you removed my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,

source: Kaloupina beikahsea nangma vahchoi La tanglouva kasah ding, kathip louding ahi. O Pakai, ka Pathen, keiman atonsot atonsotnin nangma vahchoi jinge.
target: that my heart may sing your praises and not be silent. Lord my God, I will praise you forever.

source: Vo Pakai, nanga katahsan kangamin, imatih-in nei jachatsah hih-in, na chonphatna-a chun neihuh doh-in.
target: In you, Lord , I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; deliver me in your righteousness.

source: Kahenglama nana hin sungin, gangtah-in neihuh doh-in, keidinga songpi dettahle eihuhhing dinga hoidohna in hunghin.
target: Turn your ear to me, come quickly to my rescue; be my rock of refuge, a strong fortress to save me.

source: Ajehchu nangma kasongpile kakulpi nahin, hijeh chun naminjalin neikaijinlang neilamkai jin.
target: Since you are my rock and my fortress, for the sake of your name lead and guide me.

source: Guhthima lenthang eikampeh uva konin neiloidoh-in, ajehchu nangma kahatna nahi.
target: Keep me free from the trap that is set for me, for you are my refuge.

source: Nakhutna kalhagao kapei; Vo Pakai Pathen dihtah nangin neilhatdoh tai.
target: Into your hands I commit my spirit; deliver me, Lord , my faithful God.

source: Mohseh thil ngaisahho chu kahon; Pakai vang chu katahsane.
target: I hate those who cling to worthless idols; as for me, I trust in the Lord .

source: Nahepina-a kipah-ing ting thanominge, ajehchu nangin kalung hesohna neigelpeh in, kahinna hi vangsetna-a aume ti nahei.
target: I will be glad and rejoice in your love, for you saw my affliction and knew the anguish of my soul.

source: Chule eidouho khutna neikha khumpon, kakenghohi mun lentah-a nakoije.
target: You have not given me into the hands of the enemy but have set my feet in a spacious place.

source: Vo Pakai, lungkhama kaum jeh-in neihepin, kamit hi lunggim na-in akhamtan, ahi, kahinna leh katumpi jong ahi.
target: Be merciful to me, Lord , for I am in distress; my eyes grow weak with sorrow, my soul and body with grief.

source: Ajehchu hinkhohi lunggim na-in kamangin, kakum hohi khoisatna-in kamange; Kakhangitlou jallin katha abeijin, kaguho alhong lhatai.
target: My life is consumed by anguish and my years by groaning; my strength fails because of my affliction, and my bones grow weak.

source: Kamelmate lah, adeh deh-in kaheng kakomho lah-a i-sah louvin kaumin, chule kamel hetho din kichat kaumin; Eimuho chun eijamsan taovin ahi.
target: Because of all my enemies, I am the utter contempt of my neighbors and an object of dread to my closest friends— those who see me on the street flee from me.

source: Mithi bangin suhmilin kaumin, belkehsato kabangtai.
target: I am forgotten as though I were dead; I have become like broken pottery.

source: Ajehchu mitam tah-in eihehsetna kanajan; Kakimvelah kichatna aumtai; keima douna-a akihoukhom laijun, kahinkho lah nadin doha abolui.
target: For I hear many whispering, “Terror on every side!” They conspire against me and plot to take my life.

source: Ahinla vo Pakai nangma kanatahsane, nangma ka Pathen nahi, kanatin ahi.
target: But I trust in you, Lord ; I say, “You are my God.”

source: Kaphat ho nakhutna um ahin, kamelmatele eibolgiloute khutna konin neihuh doh-in.
target: My times are in your hands; deliver me from the hands of my enemies, from those who pursue me.

source: Nasoh chunga namai hinvahsah-in, nahepina jal-in neihuhhing in.
target: Let your face shine on your servant; save me in your unfailing love.

source: Nangma kakou jeh-in, vo Pakai neijachat sah hih-in, migilouho jachatsah-in lang, thikholkhul sunga thipbeh-in umuhen.
target: Let me not be put to shame, Lord , for I have cried out to you; but let the wicked be put to shame and be silent in the realm of the dead.

source: Jouseinale midih ho chunga, musitnale hoithona thu tamtah seina kam chu paomon umhen.
target: Let their lying lips be silenced, for with pride and contempt they speak arrogantly against the righteous.

source: O, naphatna, nangma gingte dinga nakhol khom, mihem chate masanga nanga atahsan ngamho dinga nanabol chu iti letna hitam?
target: How abundant are the good things that you have stored up for those who fear you, that you bestow in the sight of all, on those who take refuge in you.

source: Nangin amaho chu mihoitho ho-a konin naumna munthipma naselding; nangin kinelkalna-a konin pon-in sunga koithipbeh in nate.
target: In the shelter of your presence you hide them from all human intrigues; you keep them safe in your dwelling from accusing tongues.

source: Pakai chu nunnom hen, ajehchu akhotona kidangtah chun khopi dettah sunga eimusahtai.
target: Praise be to the Lord , for he showed me the wonders of his love when I was in a city under siege.

source: Ajehchu namitmu-a konin paidoh-in kaumtai, kana tiloijin; hijengjongle lungset kangehna aw-a nangma kakou chun neina ngaipehtan ahi.
target: In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from your sight!” Yet you heard my cry for mercy when I called to you for help.

source: Vo nangho amithengte jousen, Pakai chu ngailuvin, ajehchu tahsan umho chu Pakaiyin avetupmin, chule hoitho bol hochu lhingkeijin alethuhjin ahi.
target: Love the Lord , all his faithful people! The Lord preserves those who are true to him, but the proud he pays back in full.

source: Hangtah-in umun, chutile nangho Pakaiya kinem jouse chu aman nalungu ahatsah ding ahi.
target: Be strong and take heart, all you who hope in the Lord .

source: Koihile asuhkhelna kingaidama, achonset kikhukhuma chu anunnom ahi.
target: Blessed is the one whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

source: Pakaiyin achonset asimlou, chule alhagaova themona umlou mi chu anunnom ahi.
target: Blessed is the one whose sin the Lord does not count against them and in whose spirit is no deceit.

source: Thipbeh a kauma, nilhumkeija kasunga ka-ao na lammin kaguho manlou asohgam tai.
target: When I kept silent, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

source: Sunle jannin nakhut gih-in eidelphan, kati lhop jong nipi laija gamgo asohjitai. Selah
target: For day and night your hand was heavy on me; my strength was sapped as in the heat of summer.

source: Nahenga kachonsetna kahetsah in, kakhan gitlouna kaselpoi. Pakai hengah suhkhelna phongtange katin, nangin kachonset khan gitlouna chu neingaidam tai. Selah.
target: Then I acknowledged my sin to you and did not cover up my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the Lord .” And you forgave the guilt of my sin.

source: Ajehchu, Pathen ngaisah jouse chu mutheija na-umpet hin nahenga taovuhen, tahbeh-in twilentah soh hon ahengu ahinnai louding ahi.
target: Therefore let all the faithful pray to you while you may be found; surely the rising of the mighty waters will not reach them.

source: Nangma ka kiselna mun nahin, lungkham na-a kona neiventup ding; huhdohna la ho-a nei-um kimvel ding ahi. Selah
target: You are my hiding place; you will protect me from trouble and surround me with songs of deliverance.

source: Keiman nangma kahilchah ding chule nachena ding kahilding; keiman kamitna nangma kapuile ding nahi.
target: I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; I will counsel you with my loving eye on you.

source: Hetna neilou, kamdal le thihkola kituhtangji sakol ahiloule sangan toh banghih-un, achuti loule naheng hinnai junte.
target: Do not be like the horse or the mule, which have no understanding but must be controlled by bit and bridle or they will not come to you.

source: Migilou din lung gentheina adimin, ahinla Pakai tahsan vang chu hepina-in aumkimvelin ahi.
target: Many are the woes of the wicked, but the Lord ’s unfailing love surrounds the one who trusts in him.

source: Nangho michonpha ho, Pakaiya kipah unlang thanomun, milungtheng nangho jouse kipah-in ao-vun.
target: Rejoice in the Lord and be glad, you righteous; sing, all you who are upright in heart!

source: Vo nangho michonpha ho Pakaiyah kipah jingun, ajehchu milungtheng dinga pachat lasah hi lomtah ahi.
target: Sing joyfully to the Lord , you righteous; it is fitting for the upright to praise him.

source: Selangdah in Pakai chu vahchoijun, manchah tumging khao somnei toh thon vahchoi La saovin.
target: Praise the Lord with the harp; make music to him on the ten-stringed lyre.

source: Ama vahchoina lathah khat saovinlang, aw thongin themtah-in tumging uvin.
target: Sing to him a new song; play skillfully, and shout for joy.

source: Pakai thu chu adih-in, athilbol jouse chu dihtah-a kibol ahi.
target: For the word of the Lord is right and true; he is faithful in all he does.

source: Aman chonphatna-a thutanlhah angailun; leiset hi Pakai phatna adimin ahi.
target: The Lord loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of his unfailing love.

source: Pakai thua vanhohi kisema ahin, chule amaho janelpihi akamsoh ahua kon ngen ahiuve.
target: By the word of the Lord the heavens were made, their starry host by the breath of his mouth.

source: Aman twipia twiho chu lomkhat bangin akoikhomin, twi thuhtah chu khol khomna in'a akholkhome.
target: He gathers the waters of the sea into jars; he puts the deep into storehouses.

source: Leiset pumpin Pakai chu gingu hen, vannoi'a cheng jouse Pakai janan dimuhen.
target: Let all the earth fear the Lord ; let all the people of the world revere him.

source: Ajehchu aman thu aseile akibol jengin, aman thu apehle aumden jenge.
target: For he spoke, and it came to be; he commanded, and it stood firm.

source: Pakaiyin Pathen hephalouho thuhil chu imahilou asosah in, mipi ho thilngaito chu phatchomna bei ahisah-e.
target: The Lord foils the plans of the nations; he thwarts the purposes of the peoples.

source: Pakai thumop chu tonsotnin ading jingin, alungngaito chu akhang akhanga ding ahi.
target: But the plans of the Lord stand firm forever, the purposes of his heart through all generations.

source: Pathen chu Pakaiya neija nam mite, chule ama agoulo dinga kilhen mihochu anun nom ahiuve.
target: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord , the people he chose for his inheritance.

source: Pakai chun van'a konin ahinven mihem chate jouse chu amui.
target: From heaven the Lord looks down and sees all mankind;

source: Aman aumna mun'a konin leisetna chengho jouse chu ahinven ahi.
target: from his dwelling place he watches all who live on earth—

source: Aman alungthim melputna akibahsah-in, athilbolhou jouseu agelpeh-e.
target: he who forms the hearts of all, who considers everything they do.

source: Mipi janelin ahuhhing thei leng aumpoi, mihat tah jong ahatjeh-a kihuhdoh aumpoi.
target: No king is saved by the size of his army; no warrior escapes by his great strength.

source: Sakolhi hoidohna dingin pannabei ahin; athahatna jeh-a jong koima ahuhdoh louding ahi.
target: A horse is a vain hope for deliverance; despite all its great strength it cannot save.

source: Veovin, Pakai mit chu ama gingte chunga, chule ahepina-a kinemho chunga aumjingin;
target: But the eyes of the Lord are on those who fear him, on those whose hope is in his unfailing love,

source: Thina-a kona ahinnao huhdoh dingle, kellhah teng ahinna diu akoipeh-e.
target: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.

source: Ihin naohin Pakai chu angah-in; ama eipanpiule ilumdalu ahi.
target: We wait in hope for the Lord ; he is our help and our shield.

source: Ajehchu ama mintheng itahsan jeh uva, ama-a ilungu kipahding ahi.
target: In him our hearts rejoice, for we trust in his holy name.

source: Vo Pakai nanga kakinepnao dungjuijin hepina kachung uvah umhen.
target: May your unfailing love be with us, Lord , even as we put our hope in you.

source: Phat jousen Pakai chu vahchoi jingting: Ama vahchoina chu kakam toh kichat louding ahi.
target: I will extol the Lord at all times; his praise will always be on my lips.

source: Kahinna hi Pakaiya kisong ding, mi kineosah ho chun ajah uva kipahdiu ahi.
target: I will glory in the Lord ; let the afflicted hear and rejoice.

source: O, Pakai chu neichoi-atpiu vinlang, amin choi-an khom uhite.
target: Glorify the Lord with me; let us exalt his name together.

source: Pakai chu kaholin aman eingaipeh-in, kakichatna jouse-a konin eihuhdoh tai.
target: I sought the Lord , and he answered me; he delivered me from all my fears.

source: Amahon ama lam aveovin ahile avah uvin; chule amaijuva jachatna-a aumpoi.
target: Those who look to him are radiant; their faces are never covered with shame.

source: Hiche migenthei hin akouteng, Pakaiyin angaipeh-in, alungdonna jouse-a konin ahuhhingtai.
target: This poor man called, and the Lord heard him; he saved him out of all his troubles.

source: Ama gingho chu Pakai vantil'in aumkim velin, chule amaho ahuhdoh-in ahi.
target: The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him, and he delivers them.

source: Pakai phatje chu patepmun lang veuvin, ama tahsan michu anunnom ahi.
target: Taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the one who takes refuge in him.

source: O mitheng teho Pakai chu gingun, ajehchu ama gingtedin lhahsamna himhim aumpoi.
target: Fear the Lord , you his holy people, for those who fear him lack nothing.

source: Keipi bahkai donglaiho jong alhasamin, agilkel jiuve; ahin Pakai holte vang chu thilpha himhim lhasamloudiu ahi.
target: The lions may grow weak and hungry, but those who seek the Lord lack no good thing.

source: Hunguvin, chateho, kathu ngaijuvin; keiman Pakai ginje hiluvinge.
target: Come, my children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord .

source: Phatna amutheina dinga nikho tamtah ngailu-a, hinkho ngailu-a michu koiham?
target: Whoever of you loves life and desires to see many good days,

source: Thilse-a konin nalei, chule lheplhah thusei na-a konin namuh tuhtangin.
target: keep your tongue from evil and your lips from telling lies.

source: Ase dalhanlang apha bolin, chamna holinlang hichu nungdelin.
target: Turn from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

source: Pakai mit chu michonpha ho chunga achun, ataonao ngainan ana asunge.
target: The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears are attentive to their cry;

source: Pakai maichun thilse bolho dounale, leisetna kona amaho kigeldohna suhtanga aum nadin angat jinge.
target: but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil, to blot out their name from the earth.

source: Michonpha ho taona Pakaiyin ajahpeh in, ahesohna jouseuva konin ahuhdoh ji-e.
target: The righteous cry out, and the Lord hears them; he delivers them from all their troubles.

source: Lungthim kisihte henga Pakai anaijin, lhagaova kisihho chu ahuhhingin ahi.
target: The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.

source: Michonpha thohgimna atamin, ahinla Pakaiyin chucheho jouse-a konchun ahuhdohji.
target: The righteous person may have many troubles, but the Lord delivers him from them all;

source: Aman aguho jouse aching phan, khatcha jong abongpoi.
target: he protects all his bones, not one of them will be broken.

source: Thilphalouvin migilou athading; chule midih hotbola chu mangthah heldiu ahi.
target: Evil will slay the wicked; the foes of the righteous will be condemned.

source: Pakaiyin asohte lhagao chu lhatdoh intin, ama tahsan ho chu mangthah loudiu ahi.
target: The Lord will rescue his servants; no one who takes refuge in him will be condemned.

source: Vo Pakai, kakidoupi ho chu neiseitohpeh-in, eikisatpiho chu kisatpin.
target: Contend, Lord , with those who contend with me; fight against those who fight against me.

source: Lumdal leh pho paninlang, ikithopidin dingin.
target: Take up shield and armor; arise and come to my aid.

source: Tengcha jong satdoh inlang eidouva eisugentheiho lampi khah in, kalhagao jah-a, nahuhhingpa kahi tin seijin.
target: Brandish spear and javelin against those who pursue me. Say to me, “I am your salvation.”

source: Kahinna suhmang dinga holho chu kisuh dongsah inlang jachat sah-in, suhset eigoho chu sunohphah inlang kinungle sah-in.
target: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plot my ruin be turned back in dismay.

source: Amaho hui nung masanga changsi bahsah-in, chule Pakai vantil nungdel sah-in.
target: May they be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of the Lord driving them away;

source: Alampiu thimhen lang nal hen, chule Pakai vantil'in amaho bolgimhen.
target: may their path be dark and slippery, with the angel of the Lord pursuing them.

source: Ajehchu amahon ajeh beijin keidingin alen'u kotong sunga aselun, ajehbeija hichu hinna lahna dinga alaiju ahi.
target: Since they hid their net for me without cause and without cause dug a pit for me,

source: Kigingman louvin manthah na achunga lhunghen lang, alenthang sela chun amatah ohhen, chuche manthah na-a chun lhalut hen.
target: may ruin overtake them by surprise— may the net they hid entangle them, may they fall into the pit, to their ruin.

source: Chutile kahinna Pakaiya kipah intin, ami huhhing na-a thanominte.
target: Then my soul will rejoice in the Lord and delight in his salvation.

source: Ama dinga hatbeh sehpa-a kona migenthei pa huhdoh-a; henge, achomgam dingpa-a kona migenthei milhasam huhdohpa, Pakai nang tobang koi umem? tia kagu kachang houvin asei dingu ahi.
target: My whole being will exclaim, “Who is like you, Lord ? You rescue the poor from those too strong for them, the poor and needy from those who rob them.”

source: Hettohsah lhemho akipat doh-un, kahet phahlouhel thil ho-a mo eichan uve.
target: Ruthless witnesses come forward; they question me on things I know nothing about.

source: Kahinna suhmang nadin apha khelin ase kipamandin eisan sah uve.
target: They repay me evil for good and leave me like one bereaved.

source: Keimavang amaho anat tenguleh kaponsil khaodip pon ahijin, an ngolin kahinna kasunemin, kataona ka angsung ngeija ahung kilahjin ahi.
target: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth and humbled myself with fasting. When my prayers returned to me unanswered,

source: Kagol ham ahiloule sopi ham bangin kanaboljin, mi anu puldouho bangin kakhai khulele jin ahi.
target: I went about mourning as though for my friend or brother. I bowed my head in grief as though weeping for my mother.

source: Ahinla kahesoh tengle akipah-un akikhom jiuvin, ahin panna beijin eidou dingin akikhomun hichu kenla kahepon, tang louvin eisam seuvin ahi.
target: But when I stumbled, they gathered in glee; assailants gathered against me without my knowledge. They slandered me without ceasing.

source: Golvahna-a phatlhem tothon, ahao eigel khumun ahi.
target: Like the ungodly they maliciously mocked; they gnashed their teeth at me.

source: Pakai itihchan navet thim ding ham? Kangailut tah kahinkhohi asumang ding keipi bahkaihoa konin huhdoh-in.
target: How long, Lord, will you look on? Rescue me from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.

source: Mipi kikhopna munna chun nangma thangvahna peng kating; mi tamtah lah-a nangma vahchoi jinge.
target: I will give you thanks in the great assembly; among the throngs I will praise you.

source: Kamelmate chu adihlou lamin kachunga kipa daohen, ajehbeija eihotbol teho chu amitnun kihou daohen.
target: Do not let those gloat over me who are my enemies without cause; do not let those who hate me without reason maliciously wink the eye.

source: Ajehchu amahon chamna thu him him aseipouvin; ahinla amahon gamsunga lungmonga um mongho dounan doha lungthim agongun ahi.
target: They do not speak peaceably, but devise false accusations against those who live quietly in the land.

source: Henge, keima dounan amaho hatah-in akam kaovin, chule amahon aha, aha, kamitnun kamutaove, atiuve.
target: They sneer at me and say, “Aha! Aha! With our own eyes we have seen it.”

source: Vo Pakai hichehi nangin namutan, thipbeh in umhih-in, vo Pakai keija konin gamla hih-in.
target: Lord , you have seen this; do not be silent. Do not be far from me, Lord.

source: Ka Pakai leh ka Pathen, kathu tan dingin nang le nang hung kitildoh-in lang, hung thoudoh-in.
target: Awake, and rise to my defense! Contend for me, my God and Lord.

source: Vo Pakai ka Pathen, chonphatna dungjuijin kathu tanin lang, amaho kachunga kipah hih uhen.
target: Vindicate me in your righteousness, Lord my God; do not let them gloat over me.

source: Alunguvin amahon, kate! eiho ichandiu ahi tidaohen, eihon ama ival lhumtaove tidaohen.
target: Do not let them think, “Aha, just what we wanted!” or say, “We have swallowed him up.”

source: Kakisuhkhah na-a kipahho chu jahchale lungdongin umkhom sah inlang, keima douna-a kiloupisah ho chu jachatnale jalounan kivonuhen.
target: May all who gloat over my distress be put to shame and confusion; may all who exalt themselves over me be clothed with shame and disgrace.

source: Ka chonphatna natoh-a lunglhaiho chu, kipahle thanomin ao-vin la saohen: asoh phattheina chunga kipahji Pakai chu, loupitah-in umhen tin seijom jing taohen.
target: May those who delight in my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “The Lord be exalted, who delights in the well-being of his servant.”

source: Chutile kaleijin chonphatna nilhumkeijin seitante.
target: My tongue will proclaim your righteousness, your praises all day long.

source: Migilou suhkhelna chungchanga kalungsunga kathusei; amitmua Pathen ginna himhim aumpoi.
target: I have a message from God in my heart concerning the sinfulness of the wicked: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

source: Ajehchu akhan gitlouna kidah umtah chu akimudoh kahsen, ama mitmun amale ama akiseiphajin ahi.
target: In their own eyes they flatter themselves too much to detect or hate their sin.

source: Akama thusoh ho chu khangitlouna leh lheplhahna ngen ahin; chihnale thilpha bolding chu adalhatan ahi.
target: The words of their mouths are wicked and deceitful; they fail to act wisely or do good.

source: Aman jalkhun chunga thilse agongtoh-in, lampi phalou laitah a akitungin, thilse ahopon ahi.
target: Even on their beds they plot evil; they commit themselves to a sinful course and do not reject what is wrong.

source: Vo Pakai, na mihepina chu van ho-a aumin, chule nakitahna chun meilom lah aphan ahi.
target: Your love, Lord , reaches to the heavens, your faithfulness to the skies.

source: Nachon phatna chu molsang lenho abangin, nathutan lhahho chu athuhlheh-e, vo Pakai, nangman mihem le gamsa navengbit nin ahi.
target: Your righteousness is like the highest mountains, your justice like the great deep. You, Lord , preserve both people and animals.

source: Vo Pakai nangailut nahi itilutna hitam, hijeh-a chu mihem chaten na lhavingho limnoi atahsanu ahi.
target: How priceless is your unfailing love, O God! People take refuge in the shadow of your wings.

source: Na insung aninlhin jehchun amaho lunglhai lheh-untin, nalunglhaina vachadung twi chu amaho nadonsah ding ahi.
target: They feast on the abundance of your house; you give them drink from your river of delights.

source: Ajehchu hinna twinah nanga aumin; navah-a chu khovah kamudiu ahi.
target: For with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light.

source: Nangma heho henga nangailutna chu umsah jinginlang, chule milung thengho henga chonphatna chu umsah-in.
target: Continue your love to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

source: Mi kiletsah kengin ei chotkhahda henlang, migilou khutnin einodoh dahen.
target: May the foot of the proud not come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.

source: Khukoma engse bolho alhulhop mun, lelhah ahiuvin, kithoujou tapouvinte.
target: See how the evildoers lie fallen— thrown down, not able to rise!

source: Thilse bolho jeh-in lungkham hih-in, khangitlouna bolho chunga jong thangset bolhih-in.
target: Do not fret because of those who are evil or be envious of those who do wrong;

source: Ajehchu amaho hampa banga kivatlhu loidiu ahin, hamhing banga goploi diu ahi.
target: for like the grass they will soon wither, like green plants they will soon die away.

source: Pakai tahsanin lang, thilpha bolin, chutile nangma gamsunga nachen ding, chule tahbeh-a suhlung lhaija naum ding ahi.
target: Trust in the Lord and do good; dwell in the land and enjoy safe pasture.

source: Pakaiya jong kipah thanomin, aman nalung ngaichat jouse napeh ding ahi.
target: Take delight in the Lord , and he will give you the desires of your heart.

source: Nalampi Pakai henga pedoh jengin; ama jong tahsanin chutile aman nabolpeh nante.
target: Commit your way to the Lord ; trust in him and he will do this:

source: Chutile aman nachon phatna chu vah bangin vahdoh sah intin, chule nathem chana chu sunlai bang ding ahi.
target: He will make your righteous reward shine like the dawn, your vindication like the noonday sun.

source: Pakaiya cholngan, chule amachu lungneng tah-in ngah-in mi alamlhahna jouse-a akhantou jehle, thil gilou hinpodoh pa jeh-in lungkham hih in.
target: Be still before the Lord and wait patiently for him; do not fret when people succeed in their ways, when they carry out their wicked schemes.

source: Lunghan na-a konin tanginlang, chule lungsatna chu dalhan; ase bolna ding poupouvah kisugim hih-in.
target: Refrain from anger and turn from wrath; do not fret—it leads only to evil.

source: Ajehchu thilse bolte chu kipaidoh hel ding ahiuvin; hinla Pakai ngah jingte vang chun leiset chung alodiu ahi.
target: For those who are evil will be destroyed, but those who hope in the Lord will inherit the land.

source: Ajehchu chomkhat joule migilou umtalou ding, henge, lungthim themtah-in aum namun chu vele chun, ana umta ponte.
target: A little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.

source: Ahinla milung nengin vang leiset chung aloding, chule amaho chamna lhingset chunga kipah ding ahiuve.
target: But the meek will inherit the land and enjoy peace and prosperity.

source: Migilouvin midih dounan thil agongjin, chule achungah aha agoiji.
target: The wicked plot against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them;

source: Pakaiyin ama anuisat ding ahi; ajehchu aman anikho hunglhung ding chu amun ahi.
target: but the Lord laughs at the wicked, for he knows their day is coming.

source: Migilouvin chemjam asatdoh-in, vaichale lhasam suhlhahna dingle thudih-a houlimho tha nadin athalpiu ajekonin ahi.
target: The wicked draw the sword and bend the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.

source: Achemjamu amahotah lungchanga lutnintin, athalpihou kihebohpeh ding ahi.
target: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.

source: Mi chonphan lhomcha aneichu migilouho haona tamtah sangin aphajoi.
target: Better the little that the righteous have than the wealth of many wicked;

source: Ajehchu migilou banjang kihebohpeh ding; midihtah ho vang Pakaiyin ageldoh jingding ahi.
target: for the power of the wicked will be broken, but the Lord upholds the righteous.

source: Midih nikhoho chu Pakaiyin ahen, agoulo ding chu tonsotna ding ahi.
target: The blameless spend their days under the Lord ’s care, and their inheritance will endure forever.

source: Amaho phat phatloulai jongle jahcha loudiu; Kel lhahlai jongle ninglhing diu ahi.
target: In times of disaster they will not wither; in days of famine they will enjoy plenty.

source: Ahinla migilou vang chu mangthah ding chule Pakai melmaho chu kelngoinou thao tahho bangdiu; amaho meikhu lah-a manghel diu ahi.
target: But the wicked will perish: Though the Lord ’s enemies are like the flowers of the field, they will be consumed, they will go up in smoke.

source: Migilouvin batnin alan, asakitjipoi, michonphan vang hepina amusah-in, ahomji-e.
target: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous give generously;

source: Ajehchu ama phattheiboh changhon leiset chung louvintin; chule ama gaosap changte chu suhmanga umdiu ahi.
target: those the Lord blesses will inherit the land, but those he curses will be destroyed.

source: Mipha kalsonnaho chu Pakai thusah ahin; alampia chun ama akipah lhehjin ahi.
target: The Lord makes firm the steps of the one who delights in him;

source: Ama lhutajongle kilehlhapai louhel ding ahi; ajehchu Pakaiyin akhutnin atuhjinge.
target: though he may stumble, he will not fall, for the Lord upholds him with his hand.

source: Khangdong kanahin, tunvang katehtai: ahivangin michonpha akinungsun kamukhapon, achilhahte khutdo-a apanlam kamukhapoi.
target: I was young and now I am old, yet I have never seen the righteous forsaken or their children begging bread.

source: Ama a-itih-a hepina dimle hongphalji ahin, achilhahte phatthei achangun ahi.
target: They are always generous and lend freely; their children will be a blessing.

source: Setna dalhanlang chule thilpha bolin, a-imatih channin cheng jingtan.
target: Turn from evil and do good; then you will dwell in the land forever.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin thutandih angailun amithengte adalha jipoi, amaho tonsotna dinga kikheh ahiuve. Ahinla migilou chilhahte vang kisumang ding ahiuve.
target: For the Lord loves the just and will not forsake his faithful ones. Wrongdoers will be completely destroyed; the offspring of the wicked will perish.

source: Michonpha hon gamsung louvintin, asunga tonsotna chengdio ahi.
target: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.

source: Michonpha ho kamsungin chihna thu aseijin, chule aleijin thutanlhah thu aseijin ahi.
target: The mouths of the righteous utter wisdom, and their tongues speak what is just.

source: A Pathen dan chu alungsunga aumin, akalsona channa alhonal khapoi.
target: The law of their God is in their hearts; their feet do not slip.

source: Migilouvin michonpha avelhijin, chule thadin aholjin ahi.
target: The wicked lie in wait for the righteous, intent on putting them to death;

source: Pakaiyin amachu akhutna dalhapontin, athu kitanteng themosah ponte.
target: but the Lord will not leave them in the power of the wicked or let them be condemned when brought to trial.

source: Pakai chu ngah-in lang, alampi chu juijin, chutile gamsung lodinga nachoisang ding ahi: migilouho akisuhmang teng, hichu namu ding ahi.
target: Hope in the Lord and keep his way. He will exalt you to inherit the land; when the wicked are destroyed, you will see it.

source: Migilou chu thanei tah-a, bong thinghing bahjamkai banga aum kamui.
target: I have seen a wicked and ruthless man flourishing like a luxuriant native tree,

source: Ahinla ama akitol mangtai, veuvin, aumtapoi; henge, kahol holin, ahinla akimujou tapoi.
target: but he soon passed away and was no more; though I looked for him, he could not be found.

source: Michamkim chu melchih inlang, milungdih chu ven, ajehchu chuche mipa kichaina chu chamna ahi.
target: Consider the blameless, observe the upright; a future awaits those who seek peace.

source: Ahinla suhkhelna neiho chu thakhatna kisumang diu, mikhang gilou kichaina chu, suhmanga umding ahi.
target: But all sinners will be destroyed; there will be no future for the wicked.

source: Ahivangin michonpha huhhingna chu Pakaiya ahin; lungkham laija atha hatnao ama ahi.
target: The salvation of the righteous comes from the Lord ; he is their stronghold in time of trouble.

source: Chule Pakaiyin amaho apanpi-a ahuhhing ding, aman khangitlouho-a kona ahuhdoh-a, chule ama atahsan jeh uva, amaho ahuhdoh ding ahi.
target: The Lord helps them and delivers them; he delivers them from the wicked and saves them, because they take refuge in him.

source: Vo Pakai nalunghanna-a neiphoh hih-in; nalungsat natah-a jong neisehgim hih-in.
target: Lord , do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.

source: Ajehchu nathal changho kasungah alutnin, chule nakhutnin eimeh nasabehseh jengin ahi.
target: Your arrows have pierced me, and your hand has come down on me.

source: Nalunghanna jeh-in katichung-ah damna himhim aumtapoi, kachonsetna jeh-in jong kaguho-a choldona himhim aumtapoi.
target: Because of your wrath there is no health in my body; there is no soundness in my bones because of my sin.

source: Ajehchu kakhan gitlounahon eichuptan; poh gihsatah khat bangin keidin agihsa behseh taovin ahi.
target: My guilt has overwhelmed me like a burden too heavy to bear.

source: Kangolna jeh-in katina mahaho auijin amon lhasoh tai.
target: My wounds fester and are loathsome because of my sinful folly.

source: Kalung akhamin, hatah-in kakunsuh in, nilhum keijin kalunghemin ahi.
target: I am bowed down and brought very low; all day long I go about mourning.

source: Ajehchu kakong dungho jouse adul soh gamin, chule kati chunga damna aumpoi.
target: My back is filled with searing pain; there is no health in my body.

source: Keima lhasamle akisugepma chu kahitan; Kalung montheilou jeh-a peng penga chu kahitai.
target: I am feeble and utterly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.

source: Pakai kangaichat jouse namasanga uma ahi, kakhoisat jong nanga kona kisellou ahi.
target: All my longings lie open before you, Lord; my sighing is not hidden from you.

source: Kalung aphulin, katha abeitan; kamit vah jengjong, keija kon achemang tan ahi.
target: My heart pounds, my strength fails me; even the light has gone from my eyes.

source: Eingailuho leh kagolte katina-a kon ading gamlha taovin; ka-inkote jong gamlatah-a adingun ahi.
target: My friends and companions avoid me because of my wounds; my neighbors stay far away.

source: Kahinkho suhmang dinga hol hon jong thang eikampeh uvin, chule kasetna ding hol hon jong lamvaina thujeng aseijun, nilhum keijin thilphalou jeng ageljiuve.
target: Those who want to kill me set their traps, those who would harm me talk of my ruin; all day long they scheme and lie.

source: Ahin keimanla na-ngong bangin kajapon, akamka ngailou mipaomo kana bangtan ahi.
target: I am like the deaf, who cannot hear, like the mute, who cannot speak;

source: Hiti chun kho jaloule, akama phona sohngailou bangin kana umin ahi.
target: I have become like one who does not hear, whose mouth can offer no reply.

source: Ajeh chu o Pakai, nangah kakinemin, o Pakai ka Pathen, nangin jan nate.
target: Lord , I wait for you; you will answer, Lord my God.

source: Ajehchu keiman, nei ngaipeh-in, achuti loule kachunga kipah getnunte kati ahi, kakenga kalhonalteng keima dounan amaho kiloupisah getnunte.
target: For I said, “Do not let them gloat or exalt themselves over me when my feet slip.”

source: Ajehchu, kalung gentheinahi tanglouvin kamasanga aumin, chule alhu paiding kahitai.
target: For I am about to fall, and my pain is ever with me.

source: Ajehchu kakhan gitlouna hi phonging ting, kachonsetna jeh-a kalung khamding ahi.
target: I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.

source: Ahinla kamelmate khu ahingtheijun, ahatnuvin, dihlou tah-a eihot bolte chu apunguve.
target: Many have become my enemies without cause; those who hate me without reason are numerous.

source: Thilse thilphato kilheh ho jong kakidoupi ahiuve; ajehchu keiman thildih chu kajuijin ahi.
target: Those who repay my good with evil lodge accusations against me, though I seek only to do what is good.

source: Vo Pakai, neidalha hih-in, vo Pathen, keija konin gamla hih-in.
target: Lord , do not forsake me; do not be far from me, my God.

source: Eipanpi dingin hung kinon; Vo Pakai eihuh hingpa.
target: Come quickly to help me, my Lord and my Savior.

source: Kaleija kachonset lounadin kalampiho-a kihong phange, kati; migilouho kamasanga aumlaijun kakamhi kamdalin tuhchah inge.
target: I said, “I will watch my ways and keep my tongue from sin; I will put a muzzle on my mouth while in the presence of the wicked.”

source: Apha-a konin jong thipbeh-in paolouvin kana umin; chule kalung gimna apong bepmin ahi.
target: So I remained utterly silent, not even saying anything good. But my anguish increased;

source: Kasunga kalungchang asadoh-in, lung kangaito laijin, meijin akongdohtan; chuin kaleija thu kaseijin ahi.
target: my heart grew hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned; then I spoke with my tongue:

source: Pakai, kanikhoho teptena le kaki chaina hedin neisemin, chutile itobanga thalhom kahi hetange.
target: “Show me, Lord , my life’s end and the number of my days; let me know how fleeting my life is.

source: Vetan, kanikho hohi khutpeh chanbep bangin nasemin, chule kahinkhohi namasanga imacha hilou ahi; Tahbeh-in mitinhi aphat pettah laijong abona ahomkeo bou ahi. Selah
target: You have made my days a mere handbreadth; the span of my years is as nothing before you. Everyone is but a breath, even those who seem secure.

source: Tahbeh-in mitinhi ahomkeova vahlea ahiuvin; tahbeh-in amaho ahomkeova lunglinglao ahiuve; aman haonaho ase khomin, chule kon ahin lokhom ding ahepon ahi.
target: “Surely everyone goes around like a mere phantom; in vain they rush about, heaping up wealth without knowing whose it will finally be.

source: Chule Pakai tu-a hi ipi kanga em? Kakinepna nanga uma ahi.
target: “But now, Lord, what do I look for? My hope is in you.

source: Ka suhkhelna jouse-a konin neihuh doh-in; mingol ho noisedin neisem hih-in.
target: Save me from all my transgressions; do not make me the scorn of fools.

source: Nangma bol anahijeh-in kana paomon, kakam kanakehpoi.
target: I was silent; I would not open my mouth, for you are the one who has done this.

source: Namivohna keija konin ladohtan, nakhut gua athipai ja kahitai.
target: Remove your scourge from me; I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

source: Mi akhangitlou jeh-a napho-a nasuhdih teng, ahoina chu nget banga nejoudin nasemji, tahbeh-in mitinhi pannabei ahi. Selah
target: When you rebuke and discipline anyone for their sin, you consume their wealth like a moth— surely everyone is but a breath.

source: Vo Pakai, kataona ngaijin, chule kakounahi neijah peh-in; kamitlhi lonhi neithipsan hih-in, ajehchu keima kapu kapateu banga nangma toh kholjinle khopembou kahi.
target: “Hear my prayer, Lord , listen to my cry for help; do not be deaf to my weeping. I dwell with you as a foreigner, a stranger, as all my ancestors were.

source: Kachemanga, kaumtah lou ding masanga, katha akiledoh theinadin, O neikhongai tadin.
target: Look away from me, that I may enjoy life again before I depart and am no more.”

source: Thohhat tah-in Pakai chu kangah-in; chule aman ana eisunpeh-in, kakouna ajatai.
target: I waited patiently for the Lord ; he turned to me and heard my cry.

source: Aman kokhuh gimneitah-a konle bonlhoh lah-a konin jong eiloidoh-in, chule songpi chunga kakengin eidinsah-in, kachena dingho eisuhdet peh-in ahi.
target: He lifted me out of the slimy pit, out of the mud and mire; he set my feet on a rock and gave me a firm place to stand.

source: Aman i-Pathen'u pachatna dingin jong lathah khat kakamsunga eikoipeh-in; mi tampin hichu amuva akichatdiu, chule Pakai chu atahsandiu ahi.
target: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear the Lord and put their trust in him.

source: Mihoitho hole joulama kiheite ngaisahlouva, Pakaiya atahsanna kisem mi chu anunnom ahi.
target: Blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord , who does not look to the proud, to those who turn aside to false gods.

source: Vo Pakai ka Pathen, thil kidang nanabol ho leh keiho lam nangaitona hohi atamlheh-in, hicheho chu nahenga kisimdoh joupontin; hicheho chu phondoh-a seiding tileng simjouhoi hilouding ahi.
target: Many, Lord my God, are the wonders you have done, the things you planned for us. None can compare with you; were I to speak and tell of your deeds, they would be too many to declare.

source: Ganlhaina leh thilpeh nangailu pon, kakolho neihonpeh tan; govam thilto leh chonset thilto jong nangailu poi.
target: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire— but my ears you have opened— burnt offerings and sin offerings you did not require.

source: Chujouvin keiman ven kahunge kati; lekhajol bu-a chun kachung chang thu akisune,
target: Then I said, “Here I am, I have come— it is written about me in the scroll.

source: vo ka Pathen, nalunglhaina bolding katha anomin; henge, nadan thu chu kalung sungah aume.
target: I desire to do your will, my God; your law is within my heart.”

source: Houkhom na loupitah-a chun chonphatna thu kalhangsapmin; vetemin vo Pakai, kakamhi thip ponte ti nahei.
target: I proclaim your saving acts in the great assembly; I do not seal my lips, Lord , as you know.

source: Nachon phatna kalungsunga kaselpon; nakitahnale nami huhhingna keiman kaphonglen; nalungset ngailutna le nathudihna chu mipi kikhom tamtah lah-a chun ka-im jipoi.
target: I do not hide your righteousness in my heart; I speak of your faithfulness and your saving help. I do not conceal your love and your faithfulness from the great assembly.

source: Vo Pakai nami hepina lutah chu keija dingin it hih-in; nangailutna leh nathutah-in neivetup jingin.
target: Do not withhold your mercy from me, Lord ; may your love and faithfulness always protect me.

source: Ajehchu simjoulou setna-in eiumkimvelin; kakhan gitlouna chun eituh-in, chutichun kadahdoh theitapoi; hicheho chu kalua sam jangho sangin atamjon, hijeh chun kalungthimin eilosam sahtai.
target: For troubles without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, and I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart fails within me.

source: Vo Pakai, lungset tah-in neihuhdoh in, vo Pakai, eipanpidin kikinno loijin.
target: Be pleased to save me, Lord ; come quickly, Lord , to help me.

source: Kahinna manthah sah ding go-a holho chu jahchale maimoh-in umhen, kasetna ding ngaitoho chu kinungno kitnu henlang jahchao hen.
target: May all who want to take my life be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

source: Ajachat manuva aha, aha, eitihou kipaman chu manthah na hihen.
target: May those who say to me, “Aha! Aha!” be appalled at their own shame.

source: Nangma naholte jouse chu nanga kipah-uhen lang thanomuhen; nami huhhingna ngailuho chun tanglouvin Pakai chu choi-atnin umhen, tiuhen.
target: But may all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; may those who long for your saving help always say, “The Lord is great!”

source: Ahinla keivang vaichale lhasam kahi, ahinla Pakaiyin keimading agelnai, nangma eipanpile eihuhdoh-a nahin, vo ka Pathen, geisang loujenin.
target: But as for me, I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my help and my deliverer; you are my God, do not delay.

source: Migenthei khotopa chu anunnom ahi; Pakaiyin boina ato phatle ahuhdoh ding ahi.
target: Blessed are those who have regard for the weak; the Lord delivers them in times of trouble.

source: Pakaiyin ama chu ahonbitna ahinsah ding; chule leiset chunga phattheina chang ding; chule nangman ama chu melmate deilama napehdoh louding ahi.
target: The Lord protects and preserves them— they are counted among the blessed in the land— he does not give them over to the desire of their foes.

source: Lungkhamna jalkhun chunga chu Pakaiyin ama ahatsah ding; nangman ajalkhun chunga nasemthah ding ahi.
target: The Lord sustains them on their sickbed and restores them from their bed of illness.

source: Keiman Pakai neihepin, nei damsah-in, ajehchu nangma dounan kachonse tai kati.
target: I said, “Have mercy on me, Lord ; heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

source: Kamelma ten keima eisamse jingun, itihle ama athin, amin amangdem? atiuvin ahi.
target: My enemies say of me in malice, “When will he die and his name perish?”

source: Chule eivedinga ahung jongle, manlou thu jeng aseijin alungsunga khan gitlouna adimin, apotdohle teng aseithang sohjin ahi.
target: When one of them comes to see me, he speaks falsely, while his heart gathers slander; then he goes out and spreads it around.

source: Eihotbol jouse chu keidounan akihou lhiuvin; keima dingin asecheh angaitouvin,
target: All my enemies whisper together against me; they imagine the worst for me, saying,

source: Nat phalou tah-in ama aphah ahitai, alupna-a kon thoudoh talou ding ahi, atiuve.
target: “A vile disease has afflicted him; he will never get up from the place where he lies.”

source: Henge, kagol ngaitah, katahsan pen, ka changlhah nepa tah-in jong kachunga akengto alamtai.
target: Even my close friend, someone I trusted, one who shared my bread, has turned against me.

source: Ahivangin vo Pakai, amaho kalethuh theina dingin neihepin lang neiphong dingin.
target: But may you have mercy on me, Lord ; raise me up, that I may repay them.

source: Kamelma ten eijolou jeh-un, nangma kachunga nalung lhaije ti hichea konhin kahei.
target: I know that you are pleased with me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.

source: Chule keima vang, kadih chamkimna-a nangin neituh jingin, namai koh-a tonsotnadin neitousah tan ahi.
target: Because of my integrity you uphold me and set me in your presence forever.

source: Pakai Israel Pathen chu tonsotna pat tonsot geijin nunnom jinghen, Amen chule Amen.
target: Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.

source: Sitwi ngaija sakhichal haisama bangin, vo Pathen nangma ngaijin kahinna hi ahaisam-e.
target: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul pants for you, my God.

source: Kahinna hi Pathen, Pathen hing ngaijin adangchah-e; itih tahle kahunga Pathen anga kakilah dingham?
target: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When can I go and meet with God?

source: Kamitlhi hi sunle janna ka-an ahin; amahon kahengah tanglouvin na Pathen hoibaham? eitiuvin ahi.
target: My tears have been my food day and night, while people say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”

source: Hiche thilhohi kageldoh tengle kahinna kasungah kabunglha ji-e; ajehchu mipi lah-a kachen, amahotoh kipana le vahchoina aw tothon Pathen in'a kacheuvin, nitheng nitna mihonpi chuto kahiuvin ahi.
target: These things I remember as I pour out my soul: how I used to go to the house of God under the protection of the Mighty One with shouts of joy and praise among the festive throng.

source: Vo kahinna, ipi dinga nangma kisonlha-a nahim? chule ipi dinga nangma lung olmoa nahin? Nangma Pathen'a kinemmin, ajeh chu amaiso-a kithopina jeh-a ama kavahchoi ding ahi.
target: Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.

source: Vo ka Pathen, kasunga kahinna hi alengvaijin; hijeh chun Jordan gama kon, Harmon munsang ho-a kon, chuleh Mizar lhanga konin nangma geldoh inge.
target: My soul is downcast within me; therefore I will remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon—from Mount Mizar.

source: Natwi lon gin'a chun twithuh le twithuh akidongton, natwi kinong le husa gin chun eichuptan ahi.
target: Deep calls to deep in the roar of your waterfalls; all your waves and breakers have swept over me.

source: Hijongle Pakaiyin alungset ngailutna chun sunle thu pentin, janle ala chun eiumpi ding, chule kahinna Pathen henga chu katao ding ahi.
target: By day the Lord directs his love, at night his song is with me— a prayer to the God of my life.

source: Keiman Pathen kasongpi henga chu ibolla neisuhmil ham? kamelmate suhgentheina jeh-a ibola lunghemma vahlea kahim? katiding ahi.
target: I say to God my Rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?”

source: Kagusunga chemjam um banghelin, kamelma ten i-sah louvin eibolun; niseh in kahenga na Pathen hoiba ham? atiuvin ahi.
target: My bones suffer mortal agony as my foes taunt me, saying to me all day long, “Where is your God?”

source: Vo kahinna, ibolla lengvaija nahim? Chule ipidinga kasunga lung olmoa nahim? Pathen'a kinemmin, ajehchu kamel eidamsahpa le ka Pathen, ama chu vahchoi nalaiding kahi.
target: Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.

source: Vo Pathen kathu neitan peh-inlang Pathen ngaisahlou nam mite chunga kathuhi neiseitoh peh-in, O milhem lhaho le midihlou ho-a konin neihuh doh-in.
target: Vindicate me, my God, and plead my cause against an unfaithful nation. Rescue me from those who are deceitful and wicked.

source: Ajehchu nangma kathahatna Pathen nahin, ibolla neipaidoh hitam? Kamelmateho suhgentheina jeh-a, ibola lunghemma kavale dingham?
target: You are God my stronghold. Why have you rejected me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?

source: O navah le nathutah chu hinsol doh-in, hicheho chun eipuile henlang, chule hichun nalhang theng le na houbuh chu eilhut hen.
target: Send me your light and your faithful care, let them lead me; let them bring me to your holy mountain, to the place where you dwell.

source: Chujou tengle Pathen maicham lamma kakipana chungnung Pathen henga chun chenge, henge, selangdah-in nangma vahchoi jinge, O Pathen, ka Pathen,
target: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my joy and my delight. I will praise you with the lyre, O God, my God.

source: Vo kahinna, ibolla lengvaija nahim? Chule ipidinga kasunga lung olmoa nahim? Pathen'a kinemmin, ajehchu kamel eidamsahpa le ka Pathen, ama chu vahchoi nalaiding kahi.
target: Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.

source: Vo Pathen kapu kapa teovin khangluilaija nanatoh nathilbol einahilu chu, kanakhang houvun kajauvin ahi.
target: We have heard it with our ears, O God; our ancestors have told us what you did in their days, in days long ago.

source: Nangin nakhutna Pathen hephalouho chu nanano manga, chule kapu kapateu chu naphudetna, chuche gam miho chu iti nasuh gentheija, napaidoh jeng hitam.
target: With your hand you drove out the nations and planted our ancestors; you crushed the peoples and made our ancestors flourish.

source: Ajehchu amahon achemjamuva gam chu alah uva alou ahipon, ahiloule aban thahatnuva kihuh hinga jong ahipouvin; hinla achunguva nakipa jeh-a nabanjet le namai vah-a konjoh ahi.
target: It was not by their sword that they won the land, nor did their arm bring them victory; it was your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, for you loved them.

source: Vo Pathen nangma kalengpa nahi, Jacob huhdohna dingin thu pe-in.
target: You are my King and my God, who decrees victories for Jacob.

source: Nangma jala kamelma teo kasot kundiu ahin; namin jala keiho douna-a kipatdoh ho chu kachotpha diu ahi.
target: Through you we push back our enemies; through your name we trample our foes.

source: Ajehchu kathalpi hi katahsan pon, ahilouleh kachemjamin jong eihuhdoh ponte.
target: I put no trust in my bow, my sword does not bring me victory;

source: Ahinla kamelma teova konin nangin neihuhhing jouvin, chule eihot bolteu chu najumso jotan ahi.
target: but you give us victory over our enemies, you put our adversaries to shame.

source: Nilhum keijin Pathen jenga kisongung kating, chule namin chu tonsotnin vahchoi uvinge. Selah
target: In God we make our boast all day long, and we will praise your name forever.

source: Ahinla nangin neipaidoh-un, neijumso taovin; chule kagalsat mite toh nakondoh khom tapoi.
target: But now you have rejected and humbled us; you no longer go out with our armies.

source: Melma-a konin nangin neikinung lesah-un, chule eihotbol teo chun amahodin thil akichomuvin ahi.
target: You made us retreat before the enemy, and our adversaries have plundered us.

source: Nangin Pathen hephalouho lah-a neithe cheh-un, nehdinga kigong kelngoi bangin neipedoh taovin ahi.
target: You gave us up to be devoured like sheep and have scattered us among the nations.

source: Namitehi imalouvin najohdoh-in, aman nu jong haonan nanei chom dehpoi.
target: You sold your people for a pittance, gaining nothing from their sale.

source: Nangin kaheng kakomhou noise din neisemun, kakim vel uva miho musit le nuisat nin neiumsah taove.
target: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, the scorn and derision of those around us.

source: Nangin Pathen hephalouho lah-a seichah dingle, miho lah-a lu thinkhum din neisem taovin ahi.
target: You have made us a byword among the nations; the peoples shake their heads at us.

source: Lunggimna tanglouvin kamasanga aumjingin, chule kamai jong jachatnan akhu tan ahin,
target: I live in disgrace all day long, and my face is covered with shame

source: Ajehchu melmale phulapa i-sah louna le taitomna aw-so jeh chu ahi.
target: at the taunts of those who reproach and revile me, because of the enemy, who is bent on revenge.

source: Hichengse chu kachunguva alhungin, ahinla nangma kasumilkha pouvin, chule nathu lhuna jong kapalkeh khapouvin ahi.
target: All this came upon us, though we had not forgotten you; we had not been false to your covenant.

source: Kalungthimu akile hei pon, kakalseu jonghi nalampi-a konin apetmang khapoi.
target: Our hearts had not turned back; our feet had not strayed from your path.

source: Ahivangin nangin dragonho mun'a neisuchip deh-un, thina le-lim chun neikhu uvin ahi
target: But you crushed us and made us a haunt for jackals; you covered us over with deep darkness.

source: Ka Pathen'u min chu kasuhmil uva, gamchom pathen henga kakhut kajahdoh uva ahile;
target: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,

source: Pathen'in hiche chu aholdoh louding ham? ajehchu aman lungsung thuguhho chu ahen ahi.
target: would not God have discovered it, since he knows the secrets of the heart?

source: Henge, keiho nangma jeh-in nilhum keijin eikithat jingui, thadinga kigo kelngoi bangin eikisim taove.
target: Yet for your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.

source: Vo Pakai khangin, ibola imua nahim? kithouvin tonsotnadin neipaidoh loujenun.
target: Awake, Lord! Why do you sleep? Rouse yourself! Do not reject us forever.

source: Ipijeh-a namai naselmanga, chule eikibol gimnaole eiki suhgenthei naohi nasuhmil hitam?
target: Why do you hide your face and forget our misery and oppression?

source: Ajehchu kahinnao hi leivui lah-a akunin, ka-oiju hi leisetna abehtan ahi.
target: We are brought down to the dust; our bodies cling to the ground.

source: Eipanpi diuvin kipatdoh-in, chule nahepina jal-in neilhat doh-un.
target: Rise up and help us; rescue us because of your unfailing love.

source: Kalungthim sunghi thuphan akisun dimtan, lengpa chung changa thil kanabol chu kaseijin, kaleihi gotsa thusunpa lekhamol ahi.
target: My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses for the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.
