source: Mihem chate sangin nahoijon, lungsetnahi nakama akisunglutne; hijeh-a chu Pathen'in tonsotna phatthei naboh ahi.
target: You are the most excellent of men and your lips have been anointed with grace, since God has blessed you forever.

source: Vo hat chungnung, nachemjam chu nataija kigah inlang, nalalna le ja naum na-a chun kivonin.
target: Gird your sword on your side, you mighty one; clothe yourself with splendor and majesty.

source: Chule thutah le nunnem na chule chonphatna jal-in, nalalna-a chun khangtou tah-in touvin; chule nakhut jetnin thil gimneitahho nahilding ahi.
target: In your majesty ride forth victoriously in the cause of truth, humility and justice; let your right hand achieve awesome deeds.

source: Lengpa melmate lung sunga nathalmuh chu ahemin, hichea chun mite nanoija alhu jiuvin ahi.
target: Let your sharp arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s enemies; let the nations fall beneath your feet.

source: Vo Pathen nalaltouna chu atonsot atonsotna ahin; nalenggam tenggol chu leng tenggol dihtah ahi.
target: Your throne, O God, will last for ever and ever; a scepter of justice will be the scepter of your kingdom.

source: Nangman chonphatna nangailun, chule gitlouna nahot bolin; hijeh chun Pathen, na Pathen chun, nagol ho chung vuma kipana thao nanutan ahi.
target: You love righteousness and hate wickedness; therefore God, your God, has set you above your companions by anointing you with the oil of joy.

source: Navonho jouse chu saiha-a kisa leng inpiho sunga konin myrrh le aloe chule cassia anam hiuheu vin hicheho chun nakipa sah-in ahi.
target: All your robes are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces adorned with ivory the music of the strings makes you glad.

source: Lengho chanute chu numei ja-umtah ho lah-a aumun, najet lama lengnu chu Ophir sana-a kijemin adingin ahi.
target: Daughters of kings are among your honored women; at your right hand is the royal bride in gold of Ophir.

source: Vo chanu, ngaiphan lang geltoh-in, chule nana sungin, namite le napa insung jong chu sumilin;
target: Listen, daughter, and pay careful attention: Forget your people and your father’s house.

source: Chutile lengpan nahoina nasatah chu adeichat ding ahi; ajehchu ama na Pakai pa ahin, chule nangman ama chu houvin.
target: Let the king be enthralled by your beauty; honor him, for he is your lord.

source: Chule Tyre chanu chu thilpeh khat choija hungding, miho lah-a mihaoho jengin jong nalungsetna angeh diu ahi.
target: The city of Tyre will come with a gift, people of wealth will seek your favor.

source: Lengpa chanu chu loupina adimin; aponsil chu sana-a kijempah ahi.
target: All glorious is the princess within her chamber; her gown is interwoven with gold.

source: Amanu chu lengpa henga pon kikhui pahsel kivona apuidiu; aloi anungjui nungah thengho chu nahenga ahinpuidiu ahi.
target: In embroidered garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions follow her— those brought to be with her.

source: Kipahtahle thanom tah-in amaho hin kipuijintin, amaho leng inpi sunga lutdiu ahi.
target: Led in with joy and gladness, they enter the palace of the king.

source: Leiset pumpi-a leng chapa-a nasem diuchu, napateu khela nachateo hiding ahi.
target: Your sons will take the place of your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.

source: Akhang akhanga geldoh jing dingin namin seming ting, hijeh-a chu mihem ten atonsot, atonsotna navahchoi diu ahi.
target: I will perpetuate your memory through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you for ever and ever.

source: Pathen chu ikiselnao le itha hatnao ahin, lungkham pettah a eipanpiu ahi.
target: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

source: Leiset hi kichon mang henlang, chule twikhanglen lailung-ah molsang hohi kipolut hen;
target: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth give way and the mountains fall into the heart of the sea,

source: chu-a twiho chu ginglul lulin kinong henlang, chule molsangho kihotlingsoh jongle keiho kicha pouvinge. Selah
target: though its waters roar and foam and the mountains quake with their surging.

source: Vadung khat aumin, chu-a luidungho chun Pathen khopi akipasah ding, Hatchung nungpen houbuh umna muntheng chu akipasah ding ahi.
target: There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.

source: Alailunga chun Pathen aumin, ama longlou helding; jingpi tah-a Pathen'in akithopi ding ahi.
target: God is within her, she will not fall; God will help her at break of day.

source: Pathen hephalouho alunghangun, lenggam ho akilongsoh-in; Aman a-aw aginsah le leiset ajunlha tai.
target: Nations are in uproar, kingdoms fall; he lifts his voice, the earth melts.

source: Janel ho Pakai chun eiumpiuvin, Jacob Pathen chu ikiselnao ahi. Selah
target: The Lord Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress.

source: Leiset hi itobanga agohkeo asosah hitam, hungun lang Pakai thilbolhohi vetemun.
target: Come and see what the Lord has done, the desolations he has brought on the earth.

source: Aman kolmong geija gal kisat asutangin, thalpi ahehbongin, tengcha asubongin, sakol kangtalai meijin ahalvamtan ahi.
target: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth. He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; he burns the shields with fire.

source: Thipkhen chan umunlang Pathen kahi heuvin, Pathen helou namtin vaipi lah-a choi-at na kauma, leisetna choisanga kaum ding ahi.
target: He says, “Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.”

source: Janelho Pakai chun eiumpiuvin, Jacob Pathen chu ikiselnao ahi. Selah
target: The Lord Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress.

source: Vo nangho mipite jousen nakhut bengun, Pathen henga galjona aw thongin samun.
target: Clap your hands, all you nations; shout to God with cries of joy.

source: Ajehchu hat chungnung Pakai chu gimneitah ahin, leiset pumpi chunga leng loupitah ahi.
target: For the Lord Most High is awesome, the great King over all the earth.

source: Aman mitin chu inoijuva asuh nemding, namtin chu ikengto noijuva akoiding ahi.
target: He subdued nations under us, peoples under our feet.

source: Aman angailut Jacob loupina chu igoulo diuva alhending ahi. Selah
target: He chose our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom he loved.

source: Pathen chu aw ging pumin, Pakai chu sumkon gin pumin akitol toutai.
target: God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the Lord amid the sounding of trumpets.

source: Pathen vahchoi La tumgingto thon saovin, vahchoi La saovin ilengpao vahchoi La saovin, vahchoi La saovin.
target: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises.

source: Ajehchu Pathen chu leiset pumpi leng ahin, hetnatoh thon tumgingin vahchoi La saovin.
target: For God is the King of all the earth; sing to him a psalm of praise.

source: Pathen chu namtin chunga aleng changin, Pathen chu alaltouna theng chunga atouvin ahi.
target: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on his holy throne.

source: Mipi lah-a pipuho akikhom khomun, Abraham Pathen mite lah-a pipuho geijin akikhom khomun ahi. Ajehchu leisetna lumdal jouse Pathen'a ahin, ama chu nasatah-a choisanga uma ahi.
target: The nobles of the nations assemble as the people of the God of Abraham, for the kings of the earth belong to God; he is greatly exalted.

source: Alen na chu Pakai bou ahin, chule athenna molsang, i-Pathen'u khopi-a chu loupi tah-a vahchoi ding ahi.
target: Great is the Lord , and most worthy of praise, in the city of our God, his holy mountain.

source: Amun dinga hoitah, leiset pumpi kipana chu sahlam sanga Zion molsang, leng loupitah khopi chu ahi.
target: Beautiful in its loftiness, the joy of the whole earth, like the heights of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the Great King.

source: Aleng inpiho sunga chun, Pathen chu kiselna-in akihei.
target: God is in her citadels; he has shown himself to be her fortress.

source: Ajehchu veuvin, lengho chu akikhomun achemang gamtaove.
target: When the kings joined forces, when they advanced together,

source: Amahon hichu amuvin, chutichun adatmouvin; amaho alung khamun ache mangloi taove.
target: they saw her and were astounded; they fled in terror.

source: Chuachun kichatle natna-in, numei anaoso natnin amat bangin amanchah taove.
target: Trembling seized them there, pain like that of a woman in labor.

source: Nangman solama huijin, Tarshish kong inneiho chu nasumang gamtan ahi.
target: You destroyed them like ships of Tarshish shattered by an east wind.

source: Keihon kanajah bangun, janelho Pakai khopi sung, Pathen khopi sunga chun kamu taovin; Pathen'in atonsotna dinga atundoh ding ahi. Selah
target: As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the Lord Almighty, in the city of our God: God makes her secure forever.

source: Vo Pathen nahouin sung lailunga chun, nalungset ngailutna thu kana ngaitouvin ahi.
target: Within your temple, O God, we meditate on your unfailing love.

source: Vo Pathen, namin dungjuija napachat na chu kolmong geija umding ahin, nakhut jetlam chu chonphatna-a dimset ahi.
target: Like your name, O God, your praise reaches to the ends of the earth; your right hand is filled with righteousness.

source: Nathu tanlhah naho jal-in Zion lhang chu kipah henlang, Juda chanute chu thanomu hen.
target: Mount Zion rejoices, the villages of Judah are glad because of your judgments.

source: Zion chu velkolun lang, akimvela kijotnun, chua insangho chu hilun.
target: Walk about Zion, go around her, count her towers,

source: Ahung umkitding khangho henga nahil theina diuvin, nanghon akulpiho chu melchih-un lang, aleng inpiho chu ngaito temun.
target: consider well her ramparts, view her citadels, that you may tell of them to the next generation.

source: Ajehchu hiche Pathen hi tonsot atonsotna i-Pathen'u ahin; thi geija jong eipuihoi pau hiding ahi.
target: For this God is our God for ever and ever; he will be our guide even to the end.

source: Nanghon mipite jousen hichehi ngaijunlang, vannoi'a cheng nangho jousen nanau hin sungun.
target: Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all who live in this world,

source: Misangle minem, ahaole avai, kigomin hichehi ngaijuvin.
target: both low and high, rich and poor alike:

source: Kakamin chihna thu seijintin, chule kalung ngaito chu hetkhen themna thu hiding ahi.
target: My mouth will speak words of wisdom; the meditation of my heart will give you understanding.

source: Thulem thuah kana sungin ting, kathugil sei chu selangdah-in hilchen inge.
target: I will turn my ear to a proverb; with the harp I will expound my riddle:

source: Nikho phatlou lai, kakhotal ho-a khanset na-in eiumchah teng ibola kakichat ding ham?
target: Why should I fear when evil days come, when wicked deceivers surround me—

source: Anei agouvu tahsan ho, chule ahaona houva kisongho chu;
target: those who trust in their wealth and boast of their great riches?

source: koimachan iti nama jongle asopi alhat thei louheldiu, Pathen henga ama lhatdohna dingjong apehthei louheldiu ahi.
target: No one can redeem the life of another or give to God a ransom for them—

source: (Ajehchu alhagaovu lhatdohna ding chu manlutah ahin, hichu a-imatih chana dinga kikhah ahitai).
target: the ransom for a life is costly, no payment is ever enough—

source: Ama chu a-imatih chana hingjinga, chule thina jong atepkhah louding ahi.
target: so that they should live on forever and not see decay.

source: Ajehchu aman michingho jong athiu amun, hitobangma chun angola milungselho jong amangthah-in, anei agouho midangho adalhahpeh jiuve, ti amutan ahi.
target: For all can see that the wise die, that the foolish and the senseless also perish, leaving their wealth to others.

source: A-in hou chu a-imatih chana umjing ding bangle achennao munho chu akhang houva umjing ding bangin, asunglamuva agelun, chule agamu chu amaho mincheh asah jiuvin ahi.
target: Their tombs will remain their houses forever, their dwellings for endless generations, though they had named lands after themselves.

source: Hijeng jongle mihem hi jatah-in aumjing jipon, ama chu amangthah ji gamsa tobang ahi.
target: People, despite their wealth, do not endure; they are like the beasts that perish.

source: Hiche alampiuhi angolnao ahin; hinla, asonhouvin amaho thusei chu aphochenun ahi. Selah
target: This is the fate of those who trust in themselves, and of their followers, who approve their sayings.

source: Kelngoi bangin lhankhuh-a alumin, thinan amaho chu avahding, chule jingkah lamle michondih hon achunguva vai ahomdiu; chule achen naova kona ahoinau chu lhankhuh-a mangthah ding ahi.
target: They are like sheep and are destined to die; death will be their shepherd (but the upright will prevail over them in the morning). Their forms will decay in the grave, far from their princely mansions.

source: Ahinla Pathen'in kahinna hi lhankhuh thanei na-a kona alhatdoh ding ahi: ajehchu aman einasan ding ahi. Selah
target: But God will redeem me from the realm of the dead; he will surely take me to himself.

source: Mi khattou ahung haova, a-insung loupina chu ahungkhan cheh cheh tengle nangman kicha hih-in;
target: Do not be overawed when others grow rich, when the splendor of their houses increases;

source: Ajehchu chu ama athi tengle imacha apohtheilou ding ahin, aloupina chun ajui louding ahi.
target: for they will take nothing with them when they die, their splendor will not descend with them.

source: Adamlaijin ahinna ho chu amale ama phatthei kiboh jongle, nangman nangmatah dinga thilpha nakibol tengle min navahchoi diu ahi.
target: Though while they live they count themselves blessed— and people praise you when you prosper—

source: Ama apateu chilhah ho henga chentin, a-itih-a khovah amulouding ahitai.
target: they will join those who have gone before them, who will never again see the light of life.

source: Mihem choi-at changa, ahia hetkhen themna neilou chu amangthahji gamsaho bangbep ahi.
target: People who have wealth but lack understanding are like the beasts that perish.

source: Hat chungnung Pakai Pathen chun thu aseitan, leiset hi niso-a pat nilhum geijin akouvin ahi.
target: The Mighty One, God, the Lord , speaks and summons the earth from the rising of the sun to where it sets.

source: Zion'a konin Pathen hoi chamkimna chu avahdohtai.
target: From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.

source: I Pathen'u chu hungintin thipbeh-in umponte; Amasanglam chu meijin halvam intin, chule akimvel chu huile go kitho hiding ahi.
target: Our God comes and will not be silent; a fire devours before him, and around him a tempest rages.

source: Aman amite thu atan theina dinga, vanho chule leiset pumpihi chungsanga kona akoukhom ding ahi.
target: He summons the heavens above, and the earth, that he may judge his people:

source: Ganlhaina-a keima toh kitepna nei kami thengte chu kahenga hinkhomin.
target: “Gather to me this consecrated people, who made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”

source: Chule vanho hin achonphatna chu aphon doh ding ahi; ajehchu Pathen amatah chu thutan ahi. Selah
target: And the heavens proclaim his righteousness, for he is a God of justice.

source: Vo kamiteho ngaijun, keiman thu seijinge: vo Israel, chule nangma nahin hilchen inge, Keima Pathen, na Pathen'u chu kahi.
target: “Listen, my people, and I will speak; I will testify against you, Israel: I am God, your God.

source: Kamasanga tanglouva umjing nagan lhainaho le nagovam thilpehho jeh-in nangma naphohsal ponge.
target: I bring no charges against you concerning your sacrifices or concerning your burnt offerings, which are ever before me.

source: Na-in'a konin bongchal chule nahonga konin kelchal himhim ladoh ponge.
target: I have no need of a bull from your stall or of goats from your pens,

source: Ajehchu gamlah-a gamsa jouse chule lhangho jouse chunga gancha jouse keija ahi.
target: for every animal of the forest is mine, and the cattle on a thousand hills.

source: Molsang ho-a chungleng vacha jouse kahesoh keijin, loulaija gamsaho jousehi keija ahi.
target: I know every bird in the mountains, and the insects in the fields are mine.

source: Kagil akela ahijongle nahenga seiponge; ajehchu vannoi leiset leh asunga thil um jouse keija ahi.
target: If I were hungry I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

source: Bongchal ho sa kaneh-a ahiloule kelchaho thisan kadon ding ham?
target: Do I eat the flesh of bulls or drink the blood of goats?

source: Pathen hengah thangvahna peuvin, chungnung pen hengah nakitepnao lhutjouvin.
target: “Sacrifice thank offerings to God, fulfill your vows to the Most High,

source: Chule lungkham nile neikouvun, keiman huhdoh ingting chule nangin neichoi-at ding ahi.
target: and call on me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

source: Ahinla Pathen'in migilou hengah, kadan kisunho naphon doh-a ipi-a napan sah-a, ahiloule ija pang dinga kathulhun nakama nakoiding ham? ati.
target: But to the wicked person, God says: “What right have you to recite my laws or take my covenant on your lips?

source: Kihilna nahotna kathuho nanung lama napaiji kamun ahi.
target: You hate my instruction and cast my words behind you.

source: Gucha namule ama chu najopmin, chule mijonghotoh chan nanei khomjin ahi.
target: When you see a thief, you join with him; you throw in your lot with adulterers.

source: Nakam chu setna-a napedoh-in, nalei chu lhep lhahnan nasemtoh-e.
target: You use your mouth for evil and harness your tongue to deceit.

source: Natoumun in nasopi douna thu naseijin, nanu chapatah chu naseisejin ahi.
target: You sit and testify against your brother and slander your own mother’s son.

source: Hichehohi nabolin, keima kathipbeh-in, nangin nang tobangin neingaiton ahi. Ahinla keiman kaphosala hihochu namitmu tah-a katahlang ding ahi.
target: When you did these things and I kept silent, you thought I was exactly like you. But I now arraign you and set my accusations before you.

source: Tun nangho Pathen sumiltehon, hichehi ngaito phaovin, achutiloule ahal halla kabotel uva, nahuhdoh diu umlou ding ahi.
target: “Consider this, you who forget God, or I will tear you to pieces, with no one to rescue you:

source: Vahchoina thilto banga toh chanchun keima eichoi-at ahin; chule ahoulimna kisemtohpa henga chu Pathen mi huhhingna kavetsah ding ahi.
target: Those who sacrifice thank offerings honor me, and to the blameless I will show my salvation.”

source: Vo Pakai na ngailut phatna dungjuijin neihepin lang, nami hepi haotah dungjuijin kasuh khelnaho noimangin.
target: Have mercy on me, O God, according to your unfailing love; according to your great compassion blot out my transgressions.

source: Kakhan gitlouna-a konin neisil ngim selinlang, kachonsetna-a konin neisuthengin.
target: Wash away all my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.

source: Ajehchu kasuh khelnaho kakihet nin; chule kachonsetna chu kamasanga aumjingin ahi.
target: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.

source: Nangman thu naseiteng them nachan theina dingle, thu natan teng akichet theina dingin, nangmatah dounan kachonsen, hiche thilse hi namitmun kana boltan ahi.
target: Against you, you only, have I sinned and done what is evil in your sight; so you are right in your verdict and justified when you judge.

source: Vetan, gitlouna-a anakijila kahin, chule kanun chonset na-a einavop ahi.
target: Surely I was sinful at birth, sinful from the time my mother conceived me.

source: Vetan, nangin asung gil lama thutah chu nangailun; chule lunggil lama chu nangin chihna thu neihetsah ding ahi.
target: Yet you desired faithfulness even in the womb; you taught me wisdom in that secret place.

source: Hyssop'in neisuthengin chutile ngimtange; neisilin chutile buhbang sanga kaban joh ding ahi.
target: Cleanse me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

source: Nasuh bohsa guho akipana diuvin, kipana le thanopna chu neijah sah-in.
target: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones you have crushed rejoice.

source: Kachonsetna ho-a konin namai selin, chule ka gitlouna jousehi noimangin.
target: Hide your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquity.

source: Vo Pathen, keima-a lungtheng khumin lang, kasunghi lhagao dihtah-in semthah-in.
target: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.

source: Naum na-a konin neipaidoh danlang, keija konin nalhagao theng ladoh hih-in.
target: Do not cast me from your presence or take your Holy Spirit from me.

source: Nami huhhingna kipana chu neipekit ninlang, chule nalhagao hongphal tah-a chun nei tuhdet jingin.
target: Restore to me the joy of your salvation and grant me a willing spirit, to sustain me.

source: Chutengle suhkhel neiho chu nalampi hil ingting, chule michonse hon alungu nangma heng lamma ahin aheidiu ahi.
target: Then I will teach transgressors your ways, so that sinners will turn back to you.

source: Vo Pathen, nang eihuh hingpa Pathen, thisanso mona-a konin neihuh doh-in chutile kalei hin nachon phatna aw thongin lan sante.
target: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, you who are God my Savior, and my tongue will sing of your righteousness.

source: Vo Pakai nangin kakamhi kat sah in, chutile kakamin navahchoina aphonjal ding ahi.
target: Open my lips, Lord, and my mouth will declare your praise.

source: Ajehchu nangin ganlhaina nangaichapoi; chutilou hile kapeh ding nahin, nangma govam thilpeh-a jong nalunglhai pon ahi.
target: You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; you do not take pleasure in burnt offerings.

source: Pathen'in adei ganlhaina chu lhagaova kisuhchip hi ahin; Vo Pathen, lungsung pohkeh le kisih ho chu nangin nahsah louva nakoi louding ahi.
target: My sacrifice, O God, is a broken spirit; a broken and contrite heart you, God, will not despise.

source: Zion dinga apha nadeilamtah chu bolin, Jerusalem kulbang chu saphan.
target: May it please you to prosper Zion, to build up the walls of Jerusalem.

source: Chutengle chonphatna ganlhaina, govam thilpeh chule govam thilto pumpi-a chun lunglhai tan natin; chutengle namaicham chunga chun abongchal hou chu hintoh taovinte.
target: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of the righteous, in burnt offerings offered whole; then bulls will be offered on your altar.

source: Vo mithahatpa, nangmale nangma ibola thilphalou va naki thang-at ham? Pathen phatna chu tanglouva umjing ahi.
target: Why do you boast of evil, you mighty hero? Why do you boast all day long, you who are a disgrace in the eyes of God?

source: Nalei hin samchem hemtah bangin jonchihna na atongin, chule lamvaina chu agongin ahi.
target: You who practice deceit, your tongue plots destruction; it is like a sharpened razor.

source: Nangin thilpha sangin thilse nangailun, chule chonphatna seisangin jouthu nangailu jon ahi. Selah
target: You love evil rather than good, falsehood rather than speaking the truth.

source: Vo lheplhahna lei, nangman bahgam thu jouse nangailun ahi.
target: You love every harmful word, you deceitful tongue!

source: Chutobanga chu Pathen'in a-itih-a dinga nagamsah-a nalahmang ding, chule na chenna mun'a kona nabodoh-a, mihing gama kona nakaldoh ding ahi. Selah
target: Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin: He will snatch you up and pluck you from your tent; he will uproot you from the land of the living.

source: Michonphan jong amua, chule akichatna, anuisat ding ahi.
target: The righteous will see and fear; they will laugh at you, saying,

source: Veovin, Pathen chu ahatna-a semloupa, ahi-a ninglhing setna ahaonaho tahsan na, gitlouna-a kisuhat mipa chu amahi ahi.
target: “Here now is the man who did not make God his stronghold but trusted in his great wealth and grew strong by destroying others!”

source: Ahinla keimavang Pathen insunga olive thinghing tobang chu kahin, keiman Pathen hepina chu a-imatih channa din katahsanin ahi.
target: But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in God’s unfailing love for ever and ever.

source: Hichu nabol jeh-in a-imatih chanin nangma vahchoi jing ting, chule namin chu ngahjing tange; ajeh chu namithengte mitmu-a hichu phatah ahi.
target: For what you have done I will always praise you in the presence of your faithful people. And I will hope in your name, for your name is good.

source: Mingolin alung sungah Pathen aumpoi atijin ahi. Amaho akisuboh-un, chule thet umtah khan gitlouna aboluvin, koimacha thilpha bola aumpouvin ahi.
target: The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and their ways are vile; there is no one who does good.

source: Ahethem le Pathen hola umkhat touvem tin, Pathen'in van'a konin mihem chate ahinvesuh-in ahi.
target: God looks down from heaven on all mankind to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.

source: Amaho abonun akinung heijin, abon chaovin abohgam taove; thilpha bola khatcha aumpoi, khatcha jong aumpoi.
target: Everyone has turned away, all have become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.

source: Khan gitlouna natongho chun hetna himhim anei lou uham? amahon changlhah aneh bangun kamite abahgam taovin; Pathen la akou him him pouve.
target: Do all these evildoers know nothing? They devour my people as though eating bread; they never call on God.

source: Kichat umlouna-a chun amaho akicha lheh-un ahi; ajehchu Pathen'in nangma douna-a gebuh sunga umpa guho chu athechehtan; Pathen'in amaho i-asahlou jeh-in, nangman amaho najachat sahtai.
target: But there they are, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to dread. God scattered the bones of those who attacked you; you put them to shame, for God despised them.

source: Pathen'in amite asohchan naova kon ahin lepui teng, Israelte huhhingna chu Zion'a kon hitavele, Jacob thanomin tin, Israel kipah ding ahi.
target: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When God restores his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!

source: Vo Pathen, naminin neihuh hingin, chule natha hatnin kathu neitan peh-in.
target: Save me, O God, by your name; vindicate me by your might.

source: Vo Pathen, kataona ngaijin lang, kakama thupot ho-a hin nana neisun peh-in.
target: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.

source: Ajehchu gamchom miho keima doudingin akigotaovin, chule misugenthei hon kahin nahi aholun; Pathen chu amasanguvah akoipouve.
target: Arrogant foes are attacking me; ruthless people are trying to kill me— people without regard for God.

source: Vetan, Pathen chu eipanpia ahin; Pakai chun kahinna eituh peh ho aumpin ahi.
target: Surely God is my help; the Lord is the one who sustains me.

source: Aman kamelmate chu setna-a alelutding ahin; nangman amaho chu nathutah-a chun sumangin.
target: Let evil recoil on those who slander me; in your faithfulness destroy them.

source: Nahenga manbeijin ganlhaina neijinge, O Pakai, hichehi thilpha ahijeh-in, namin vahchoi jinge.
target: I will sacrifice a freewill offering to you; I will praise your name, Lord , for it is good.

source: Ajehchu aman lungkhamna jouse-a konin eihuh dohtan; chule kamelmate chunga kamitnin angaichat chu amutai.
target: You have delivered me from all my troubles, and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.

source: Vo Pathen, kataona-a nana hinsungin; chule kathumna-a konin nangma kiselmang hih-in.
target: Listen to my prayer, O God, do not ignore my plea;

source: Kakoma uminlang, chule kataona nei ngaipeh-in, kagenthei na-a kalunghemin, hichun eisunoh phah-in,
target: hear me and answer me. My thoughts trouble me and I am distraught

source: Melma aw jehle migiloupa suhgentheina jeh-in na satah-in kamaovin ahi. Ajehchu khan gitlouna kachunga eisekhumun, chule lunghang tah-in eihot boluvin ahi.
target: because of what my enemy is saying, because of the threats of the wicked; for they bring down suffering on me and assail me in their anger.

source: Kalungthim sunggil lamhi analheh jengin; chule thina kichat umtah chu kachunga achutai.
target: My heart is in anguish within me; the terrors of death have fallen on me.

source: Kichatna le kithinna kachunga ahung lhungin, chule kichatna melse tah-in eichuptai.
target: Fear and trembling have beset me; horror has overwhelmed me.

source: Chule keiman kaseije, O keima vakhu banga lhaving nei hitaveleng! lengmang ingting gakicholdo tange.
target: I said, “Oh, that I had the wings of a dove! I would fly away and be at rest.

source: Veovin, gamla tah-a vah lengting, gamthipma kaumding ahi. Selah
target: I would flee far away and stay in the desert;

source: Huipi hattah le khopihuija kona hoidohna dingin kikin nonge.
target: I would hurry to my place of shelter, far from the tempest and storm.”

source: Vo Pakai aleiju sukhen inlang, sumangin, ajehchu khopi sunga khun hunam le kinahna kamun ahi.
target: Lord, confuse the wicked, confound their words, for I see violence and strife in the city.

source: Sunle jan-in chua kulbang chunga chun amaho avahle leuvin, asunga chun lungkhamna le thilphalou jeng aumin ahi.
target: Day and night they prowl about on its walls; malice and abuse are within it.

source: Alah uva chun khan gitlouna aumin; lheplhahna le doha bolnan akhosung lamlen adalha khapoi.
target: Destructive forces are at work in the city; threats and lies never leave its streets.

source: Ajehchu eiseisea chu melma ahipoi; hijo ngaple kathoh joujoh ding ahi. Keima douna-a ama kiloupi sahpa jong chu eihotbol ahipoi; hijo ngaple ama-a kona kiselding kahi.
target: If an enemy were insulting me, I could endure it; if a foe were rising against me, I could hide.

source: Ahinla kakibahpi mi, eipuija, chule kamelhet mi, nangma nahi,
target: But it is you, a man like myself, my companion, my close friend,

source: kithu hilna ngeitah ingaikhom jin, chule Pathen houin'a ichekhomji-e.
target: with whom I once enjoyed sweet fellowship at the house of God, as we walked about among the worshipers.

source: Thinan achungu lhunkhum hen, chule thikhol khulah kumsuh loijuhen, ajehchu gitlouna chu achennao le alah uvah aume.
target: Let death take my enemies by surprise; let them go down alive to the realm of the dead, for evil finds lodging among them.

source: Keivangin Pathen kou vingting, Pakaiyin eihuhhing ding ahi.
target: As for me, I call to God, and the Lord saves me.

source: Jingkah le nilhah, chule sunnin taovingting, hatah in saminge; Chule aman ka aw ajahding ahi.
target: Evening, morning and noon I cry out in distress, and he hears my voice.

source: Eidounao galmuna konin aman kahinna mongtah-in eihuhdoh-in ahi; ajehchu eidouho chu tamtah ahiuvin ahi.
target: He rescues me unharmed from the battle waged against me, even though many oppose me.

source: Pathen, khanglui laija umjingpa tahchun, ngaijintin, abol hesohdiu ahi. Selah Ajehchu amahon kikhelna aneilou jeh-un Pathen agingpouve.
target: God, who is enthroned from of old, who does not change— he will hear them and humble them, because they have no fear of God.

source: Amatoh kichamna neiho dounan akhut alhangin, akitepna chu asukehtan ahi.
target: My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.

source: Akama thuho chu bongnoiha sangin analjon, alungsungla kidouna bou ahin; athuho chu thao sangin ajoljon, ahinla chemjam kisatdoh ahiuve.
target: His talk is smooth as butter, yet war is in his heart; his words are more soothing than oil, yet they are drawn swords.

source: Napohgih Pakai chunga seplhan, aman napanpi ding ahi; Aman michonpha chu suhling dingin itih hijongle phal ponte.
target: Cast your cares on the Lord and he will sustain you; he will never let the righteous be shaken.

source: Ahinla vo Pathen, nangin amaho chu manthah na kokhuh sunga napuisuh ding; thisanso mile milhem lhaho chu anikhou kehkhat jong hing joulou dingu ahi; Hijongle keiman nangma katahsan ding ahi.
target: But you, God, will bring down the wicked into the pit of decay; the bloodthirsty and deceitful will not live out half their days. But as for me, I trust in you.

source: Vo Pathen, neihepin, ajehchu min vallhum din eigon, aman niseh-in eikisatpin eisugenthei jinge.
target: Be merciful to me, my God, for my enemies are in hot pursuit; all day long they press their attack.

source: Kamelma ten niseh in vallhum dingin eigouve; ajehchu eidouho chu tamtah ahiuve, vo chungnung pen.
target: My adversaries pursue me all day long; in their pride many are attacking me.

source: Kakichat tengle nangma tahsan inge.
target: When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.

source: Pathen chu athu-in vahchoi jinge, mihemin i-eilo theiding ham? Pathen'a katahsan kangamtan kicha ponge
target: In God, whose word I praise— in God I trust and am not afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?

source: Niseh in kathuho alakoijun, alunggel jouseu keima douna le setna ahi.
target: All day long they twist my words; all their schemes are for my ruin.

source: Amaho akikhom khommun, kahinna ladinga eichan tengule, akiselun, kakholhah amelchih jiuvin ahi.
target: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps, hoping to take my life.

source: Khan gitlouna-a kona ongthol diu hinam? Vo Pathen, nalunghanna miho chu seplhatan.
target: Because of their wickedness do not let them escape; in your anger, God, bring the nations down.

source: Nangin kavalenaho namelchih-in, kamitlhiho nahai sungah nakhumin, hiho chu nalekhabu-a umcheh louham?
target: Record my misery; list my tears on your scroll— are they not in your record?

source: Nahenga kaka phatle, kamelmate chu anungchon jiuve; hiche hi kahei, Pathen chu keija ahi.
target: Then my enemies will turn back when I call for help. By this I will know that God is for me.

source: Pathen chu athu-in vahchoi jinge; Pakai chu athu -in vahchoi jinge.
target: In God, whose word I praise, in the Lord , whose word I praise—

source: Keima kicha taponge mihemin i-eilo thei dingham? Pathen'a katahsan kangam tai.
target: in God I trust and am not afraid. What can man do to me?

source: Vo Pathen, nakihahselnaho kachungah aumin; keiman, nangma vahchoinaho peng kate.
target: I am under vows to you, my God; I will present my thank offerings to you.

source: Ajehchu kahinna hi thina-a konin nahuhdoh tan; Pathen masanga hinna vah-a kavale theina dinga, kakenga kalhuh louna dinga nangin neihuhdoh lou ding ham?
target: For you have delivered me from death and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.

source: Neihepin, vo Pathen, neihepin, ajehchu kahinna-in natahsanin ahi. Hiche vangsetna ho kichai kahse-a, nalhalima kahoidoh na kasemding ahi.
target: Have mercy on me, my God, have mercy on me, for in you I take refuge. I will take refuge in the shadow of your wings until the disaster has passed.

source: Pathen thil jouse eibol pehpa, chungnung pen Pathen henga chun taovinge.
target: I cry out to God Most High, to God, who vindicates me.

source: Vallhum dinga eigopa i-sah louva konchun, aman van'a konin hinsol intin eihuhhing ding ahi. Selah Pathen'in amihepinale athutah chu ahinsoldoh ding ahi.
target: He sends from heaven and saves me, rebuking those who hotly pursue me— God sends forth his love and his faithfulness.

source: Kahinnahi keipi bahkaiho lah-a aumin, chule mei kihal khumho lahle, ahahou tengcha le thallung bang, aleiju chemjam hemtah tobang mihem chapate lah jenga jong chun kalumjin ahi.
target: I am in the midst of lions; I am forced to dwell among ravenous beasts— men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.

source: Vo Pathen, nangma vanho chungvuma kichoisangin, naloupina chu leiset pumpi chungvuma umhen.
target: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.

source: Amahon kakholhah na din lenthang aphaovin, kahinna hi alhadah-in; kamasanga kokhuh alaijun, chuche-a chun amaho alhalutnuve. Selah
target: They spread a net for my feet— I was bowed down in distress. They dug a pit in my path— but they have fallen into it themselves.

source: Kalungthim dettah ahi, vo Pathen, kalungthim dettah ahi, la sang ting chule vahchoina penge.
target: My heart, O God, is steadfast, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and make music.

source: Thoudoh-in, kaloupina, tumging le selangdah kithou vin, keima tah jong matah-in thouvinge.
target: Awake, my soul! Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

source: Vo Pakai, mipi ho lah-a nangma vahchoi jing ting; namtin lah-a nangma henga la sange.
target: I will praise you, Lord, among the nations; I will sing of you among the peoples.

source: Ajehchu nahepina chun vanho apha-in; chule nathudih chu meilhang ho aphan ahi.
target: For great is your love, reaching to the heavens; your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

source: Vo Pathen, nangma vanho chungvum geijin kichoisangin, naloupi chu leiset pumpi chungvum ma umhen.
target: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.

source: Vo mipi ho, nanghon tahbeh-a chonphat thu naseiju hinam? Vo nangho mihem chapaten, lungtheng sela thu natanu hinam?
target: Do you rulers indeed speak justly? Do you judge people with equity?

source: Henge, nalunguvin gitlou nabolun, leisetna hin nakhut-un hunam napan jiuvin ahi.
target: No, in your heart you devise injustice, and your hands mete out violence on the earth.

source: Migilou chu naobu-a kona khensa ahin, apen penule jouthu seijin avahmangpai jitaovin ahi.
target: Even from birth the wicked go astray; from the womb they are wayward, spreading lies.

source: Agu-u chu gulgu tobang ahin, amaho gulsum na-ngong kolseh tobang ahiuvin;
target: Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like that of a cobra that has stopped its ears,

source: cheho chun guldoi themhon itobang themin lhim jongleu jou pouvinte.
target: that will not heed the tune of the charmer, however skillful the enchanter may be.

source: Vo Pathen, akamuva aha-u chu subongin lang, vo Pakai, keipi bahkai donglaiho hapiho chu subongsoh-in.
target: Break the teeth in their mouths, O God; Lord , tear out the fangs of those lions!

source: Tanglouva longjing twi bangin amaho junmang sah-in, athalchang kapdoh dinga athalpi ajetkon teng, ahal ahala kisat bahsah jengin.
target: Let them vanish like water that flows away; when they draw the bow, let their arrows fall short.

source: Twilung ajunmang bangin amaho abonchauvin mangthah uhen, aphatlouva nupi naonei, nimel mutheilou bang hiuhen.
target: May they be like a slug that melts away as it moves along, like a stillborn child that never sees the sun.

source: Nabel houvin lingsut ahet masang uva, aman alunghana-a ahing le ago abona chimpeija alhohmang ding ahi.
target: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns— whether they be green or dry—the wicked will be swept away.

source: Michonpha chun phulahna amutenguleh kipah intin, migilou thisana chu akeng akisil ding ahi.
target: The righteous will be glad when they are avenged, when they dip their feet in the blood of the wicked.

source: Chutia chu mihemin michonpha din tohphat man aum mong monge atidiu ahin; tahbeh-a leiset chunga thutan Pathen chu ama ahi.
target: Then people will say, “Surely the righteous still are rewarded; surely there is a God who judges the earth.”

source: Vo ka Pathen, kagalte-a konin neihuh doh-in, eidouva dinga kipatdoh ho-a konin neihuh doh-in.
target: Deliver me from my enemies, O God; be my fortress against those who are attacking me.

source: Khan gitlou bolho-a konin neihuhdoh in, chule thisanso mi-a konin neihuh hingin.
target: Deliver me from evildoers and save me from those who are after my blood.

source: Ajehchu vetan, amaho kahinna ngah-in aumjingun; Vo Pakai kasuhkhel jehle kachonset jeh jong hilouvin, mihat ho chu keima dounan akikhomun ahi.
target: See how they lie in wait for me! Fierce men conspire against me for no offense or sin of mine, Lord .

source: Kasetna beijin akigouvin alhaijun ahi. Ven kithoudoh inlang eipanpin.
target: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Arise to help me; look on my plight!

source: Hijeh chun vo janel Pakai, Israel Pathen, Pathen hephalouho vildin thouvin, mikitahlou suhkhel neihohi khatcha jong hepihih helin. Selah
target: You, Lord God Almighty, you who are the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to wicked traitors.

source: Nilhahle ahung kileuvin uicha bangin apeng setsot jiuvin, chule khopi chu avelvel jiuve.
target: They return at evening, snarling like dogs, and prowl about the city.

source: Veovin amahon akamuvin aphong doh-un; amuh uva chemjamho aumin; hitichun, koiham ajah-a? atiuve.
target: See what they spew from their mouths— the words from their lips are sharp as swords, and they think, “Who can hear us?”

source: Ahinla vo Pakai nangin amaho chu nuisatjon natin, Pathen hephalouho chu nuijat nan neijinate.
target: But you laugh at them, Lord ; you scoff at all those nations.

source: Atha hatna jeh-in nangma ngah inge; ajehchu Pathen kakihonbitna ahi.
target: You are my strength, I watch for you; you, God, are my fortress,

source: Eihepi Pathen chun eihoidoh intin, Pathen'in kamelmate chunga kangaichat eimusah inte.
target: my God on whom I can rely. God will go before me and will let me gloat over those who slander me.

source: Amaho chu that hih in, ajole kamiten sumil getnunte, vo Pakai kalum dalu, nathaneina in thecheh inlang loi nemin.
target: But do not kill them, Lord our shield, or my people will forget. In your might uproot them and bring them down.

source: Ajehchu akamuva asetnao le amuh uva thuho jeh, chule athuseiju gaosapna le jouthu jeh-in, akiletsah naova matnin umuhen;
target: For the sins of their mouths, for the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride. For the curses and lies they utter,

source: Amaho chu lung hana-a sumangin, aumlouna diuvin amaho chu sumangin, chule leiset kichaini geija Pathen'in Jacob'a vai ahomchu amahon heuhen. Selah
target: consume them in your wrath, consume them till they are no more. Then it will be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob.

source: Chule nilhahle hungkile sah inlang; uichaho bangin peng setsot nuhen lang, chule khopi chu velleu hen.
target: They return at evening, snarling like dogs, and prowl about the city.

source: Amaho chu nehding holin sahle lhanga vaveisah-in, chule achim louvule phunphun taohen.
target: They wander about for food and howl if not satisfied.

source: Ahinla keiman nathahatna chu lan sangting, henge, jingkahle nahepina la gingtah in sange; ajehchu nangma lungkham ni-a kahoina le kakiselna nahi.
target: But I will sing of your strength, in the morning I will sing of your love; for you are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.

source: Vo kathahatna, naheng-ah la sange; ajeh chu Pathen hi kahoina le eihepia Pathen chu ahi.
target: You are my strength, I sing praise to you; you, God, are my fortress, my God on whom I can rely.

source: Vo Pathen nangin neipaidoh-un nei thecheh taovin, nalung phamotai; O nangma keiho lammah hung kile kitan.
target: You have rejected us, God, and burst upon us; you have been angry—now restore us!

source: Nangin leiset nahot lingin, nasukehjin; akhikeh jouse thoi bitnin, ajehchu akilingin ahi.
target: You have shaken the land and torn it open; mend its fractures, for it is quaking.

source: Namite hi thil hahsatah namusahtan; lungdonna lengpitwi neidonsah taovin ahi.
target: You have shown your people desperate times; you have given us wine that makes us stagger.

source: Thutah jeh-a tah langa aumtheina diuvin, nangma gingho chu ponlap khat napetan ahi. Selah
target: But for those who fear you, you have raised a banner to be unfurled against the bow.

source: Nalungset ho nahuhdoh theinadin nakhut jetnin huhhingin lang, chule neingaipeh in.
target: Save us and help us with your right hand, that those you love may be delivered.

source: Pathen'in athenna-in thu aseijin, keima kipah ingting, Shechem chu kahop khenna chule Succoth phaicham chu kahopdoh ding ahi, ati.
target: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph I will parcel out Shechem and measure off the Valley of Sukkoth.

source: Gilead le Manasseh hi keija ahin, Ephraim jonghi kalu thahatna ahin, Judah chu ka danthu pepa ahi.
target: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah is my scepter.

source: Moab hi kakisilna bel ahin, Edom chunga chu ka kengkoh kaledoh ding; Philistia, keima jal-in jona changin.
target: Moab is my washbasin, on Edom I toss my sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”

source: Edom'a chu kon eilamkaija, khopi dettah-a chu kon eipuilut ding ham?
target: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

source: Vo Pathen, eina paidoh uva chu nang nahilou ham? chule kagalsat houtoh kondohji Pathen chu nang nahilou ham?
target: Is it not you, God, you who have now rejected us and no longer go out with our armies?

source: Lungkham na-a konin neipanpin, ajehchu mihem panpinahi ahomkeo ahi.
target: Give us aid against the enemy, for human help is worthless.

source: Pathen jala hangsan tah-a iboldiu ahi; ajehchu kamelma teo chotpha dinga chu ama ahi.
target: With God we will gain the victory, and he will trample down our enemies.

source: Vo Pathen, ka kana ngaijin lang, kataona neingaipeh-in.
target: Hear my cry, O God; listen to my prayer.

source: Kalungthim alhahdah tengle, leiset kolmonga patnin hinkou vingting, kei sanga sangjo songpi-a chun neipuijin.
target: From the ends of the earth I call to you, I call as my heart grows faint; lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

source: Ajehchu nangma bou kahoidoh na nahin, melma te-a kona insang det tah chu nahi.
target: For you have been my refuge, a strong tower against the foe.

source: A-imatih chana keima nahoubuh sunga kaum jing ding; nalhaving noi kiselna chu tahsan inge.
target: I long to dwell in your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of your wings.

source: Ajehchu vo Pathen, nangin kakitepna neijah pehtan; namin gingho gamlo ding chu neipetai.
target: For you, God, have heard my vows; you have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

source: Nangin lengpa hinkho nasaosah ding; chule akumho chu khang tamtah tobang hiding ahi.
target: Increase the days of the king’s life, his years for many generations.

source: Ama Pathen anga tonsotna umjing ding; ama vettup ahithei nadin hepina le thutah chu gongtoh-in.
target: May he be enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint your love and faithfulness to protect him.

source: Chutichun kitepnaho niseh-a kabol theina din, a-imatih chanin namin vahchoi La sajing tange.
target: Then I will ever sing in praise of your name and fulfill my vows day after day.

source: Tahbeh-in kahinna hin Pathen angah-in, huhhing-a kaum nahi ama-a kona hung ahi.
target: Truly my soul finds rest in God; my salvation comes from him.

source: Amabou kasongpile eihuh hingpa ahin, ama kahoidohna ahin, keima kiling louhel ding kahi.
target: Truly he is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress, I will never be shaken.

source: Itihchan mi khat douna-a thilphalou nangaito diuham? Nabon chaova kithatgam ding nahiuvin; bang on tobang le pal chim kon tobangbou nahidiu ahi.
target: How long will you assault me? Would all of you throw me down— this leaning wall, this tottering fence?

source: Ama athupina-a kona sotlhah dingbou akihouvun, jouseihi athanopnao lamtah ahin; akamun phatthei aboh-un asung gilun vang agaosapmun ahi.
target: Surely they intend to topple me from my lofty place; they take delight in lies. With their mouths they bless, but in their hearts they curse.

source: Kalhagao, na Pathen bou ngah-in, ajehchu kagin chatna chu ama-a konbou ahi.
target: Yes, my soul, find rest in God; my hope comes from him.

source: Amabou kasongpi le eihuh hingpa ahi; ama kahoidohna ahin, keima longlou ding kahi.
target: Truly he is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress, I will not be shaken.

source: Pathen'a kahuh hingna le kaloupina aumin, kahatna songpi, chule kahoina chu Pathen'a uma ahi.
target: My salvation and my honor depend on God; he is my mighty rock, my refuge.

source: Phat tinin ama tahsanun lang nanghon nalung thimmu a-angah sunglhaovin, Pathen chu eiho dinga hoidoh na ahi. Selah
target: Trust in him at all times, you people; pour out your hearts to him, for God is our refuge.

source: Tahbeh-in minoi nungte hi pannabei ahin, milenho jonghi jou thubuh ahibouve; khaikotna khaidin abonchauvin ahomkeo sangin ajang jouve.
target: Surely the lowborn are but a breath, the highborn are but a lie. If weighed on a balance, they are nothing; together they are only a breath.

source: Suhgentheina tahsan hih-un, chule mohseh-a mi chom jong bolhih-un, haona apunleh, hiche chunga chun nalung koihih-un.
target: Do not trust in extortion or put vain hope in stolen goods; though your riches increase, do not set your heart on them.

source: Pathen'in khatvei aseitan, hiche hi nivei kana jatai; thahatna hi Pathen'a ahi.
target: One thing God has spoken, two things I have heard: “Power belongs to you, God,

source: O Pakai hepina jonghi nangma-a ahije; ajehchu nangman mitin anatoh dungjui cheh-in lethuhna napejin ahi.
target: and with you, Lord, is unfailing love”; and, “You reward everyone according to what they have done.”

source: Vo Pathen, nangma ka Pathen nahin, jingpi matah-in nangma holinge; Twi beina gamgo dangchah na gama hin, kalhagao nang ngaijin adang chah-in, katahsan jong nangma nangaichan ahi.
target: You, God, are my God, earnestly I seek you; I thirst for you, my whole being longs for you, in a dry and parched land where there is no water.

source: Nathuneinale naloupi munadin, munthenga chun nangma kana velen ahi.
target: I have seen you in the sanctuary and beheld your power and your glory.

source: Ajehchu nalungset ngailutna hi hinkho sanga aphat joh jeh-in, kakamin nangma navahchoi ding ahi.
target: Because your love is better than life, my lips will glorify you.

source: Hitichun kahinlai chansen nangma vahchoi jingting; namina kakhut kadop sang ding ahi.
target: I will praise you as long as I live, and in your name I will lift up my hands.

source: Kahinna hi lhin le thaova lunglhai ding, chule kakam hin kipah-in nangma navahchoi tante.
target: I will be fully satisfied as with the richest of foods; with singing lips my mouth will praise you.

source: Kajalkhun chunga nangma kageldoh teng, jankho lhonin nangma kangaito jin ahi.
target: On my bed I remember you; I think of you through the watches of the night.

source: Ajehchu nangma eipanpi jia nahin, hijeh-a chu nalha limnoija keima kipah kahi.
target: Because you are my help, I sing in the shadow of your wings.

source: Kahinna hin nanung naichan ajuijin; nakhut jetlamin neituh jinge.
target: I cling to you; your right hand upholds me.

source: Kahinna sumang dinga holho vang chu, leiset noinung geija kumlha diu ahi.
target: Those who want to kill me will be destroyed; they will go down to the depths of the earth.

source: Amaho chemjam'a loudingu ahiuvin; amaho sial ho chanvou dingbou hidiu ahi.
target: They will be given over to the sword and become food for jackals.

source: Ahinla lengpa chu Pathen'a kipah ding, ama-a kihahsel takip chu loupi ding ahiuvin; ahinla jou thusei ho kam vang kisimbing ding ahi.
target: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by God will glory in him, while the mouths of liars will be silenced.

source: Vo Pathen, kataona-a ka aw ngaijin, melmate ginna-a konin kahinkho hi neiventup peh-in.
target: Hear me, my God, as I voice my complaint; protect my life from the threat of the enemy.

source: Mikhangse kithuhilna-a konle, khan gitlou natongho thilgona konin jong neiselin.
target: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the plots of evildoers.

source: Amahon aleiju chemjam bangin anol hemun, chule thu khatah ho kap nadin athalpihou ajekon uvin,
target: They sharpen their tongues like swords and aim cruel words like deadly arrows.

source: Nolnabei mi chu guhthima akaptheina diuvin; amahon photlot louvin, kichalou helin ama chu akapmun ahi.
target: They shoot from ambush at the innocent; they shoot suddenly, without fear.

source: Thilse lama amahole amaho akitil khouvun; guhthima thang kam nadin akihou jiuvin, kon amuding ham? atiuve.
target: They encourage each other in evil plans, they talk about hiding their snares; they say, “Who will see it?”

source: Amahon khan gitlounaho chu aholun, gunchu tah-a athil holu chu amolsouve. Amaho sunggil lam ngaitona le lungthimho chu thuhtah ahi.
target: They plot injustice and say, “We have devised a perfect plan!” Surely the human mind and heart are cunning.

source: Ahinla Pathen'in amaho thalla akapding, photlot louva machangdiu ahi.
target: But God will shoot them with his arrows; they will suddenly be struck down.

source: Hitichun aleigui jeh uvin amaho mangthah-un tin, amaho mutapou chu jammang jengdiu ahi.
target: He will turn their own tongues against them and bring them to ruin; all who see them will shake their heads in scorn.

source: Chule mijouse kichaovintin,Pathen natoh chu aphondoh diu ahi; ajehchu ama thilbol chu lungching tah-a angaitodiu ahi.
target: All people will fear; they will proclaim the works of God and ponder what he has done.

source: Michonpha hochu Pakaiyah kipah untin, chule ama atahsan diu; milung dih ho jouse chu loupidiu ahi.
target: The righteous will rejoice in the Lord and take refuge in him; all the upright in heart will glory in him!

source: O Pathen, Sion'ah pachatnan na-ngah jingin, chule kitepna chu nahenga kimolso ding ahi.
target: Praise awaits you, our God, in Zion; to you our vows will be fulfilled.

source: O nangma taona sang nahin, tahsa phe jouse nahenga hungdiu ahi.
target: You who answer prayer, to you all people will come.

source: Khan gitlouvin eijou jing jengin; ka suhkhelnaho vang nangman nasop ngim ding ahi.
target: When we were overwhelmed by sins, you forgave our transgressions.

source: Na-in hong sunga achentheina dinga, naheng nailut dinga nalhentum mi chu anunnome. Na insung phatna na houin theng ngeija chu kalungnao chimding ahi.
target: Blessed are those you choose and bring near to live in your courts! We are filled with the good things of your house, of your holy temple.

source: Vo eihuh hingpao Pathen, chonphat na-a gimneitah thil kibol ho-a nei donbut nin natin; nangma kolkimvela jouse le, twipi chunga gamlatah-a miho tahsan chu nahin;
target: You answer us with awesome and righteous deeds, God our Savior, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas,

source: Thanei na-a kong akigah-a, athahat na-a molsang ho tungdoh pa;
target: who formed the mountains by your power, having armed yourself with strength,

source: Twipiho husan le twikinong husan, chule mipi tamtah husa gin suthip pa nahi.
target: who stilled the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

source: Kolmonga chenghon jong namelchihna ho chu akichauvin; nangman jingkahle nilhah jong thanom tah-a potdoh din nasemin ahi.
target: The whole earth is filled with awe at your wonders; where morning dawns, where evening fades, you call forth songs of joy.

source: Nangin leiset hi navilin, chule twi nachap kot jin; naning lhinset sah-in, Pathen vadung chu twi dimset ahin, nangin chutabang chu napeh phat chun, chang ahung umdoh-in ahi.
target: You care for the land and water it; you enrich it abundantly. The streams of God are filled with water to provide the people with grain, for so you have ordained it.

source: Nangin damkom ho chu twi nanen sah-in, langkon mahaho naum sah-in, hichu gohongin nachapnemin, chua kehdohho chu phatthei naboh-in ahi.
target: You drench its furrows and level its ridges; you soften it with showers and bless its crops.

source: Nangin kum chu naphatna-in nakhu-in, chule na lampiho chun sathao navat khumin ahi.
target: You crown the year with your bounty, and your carts overflow with abundance.

source: Amaho chu gamthipma hampaho chunga avalhan, lhang neoho chu amun cheh-a akipah un ahi.
target: The grasslands of the wilderness overflow; the hills are clothed with gladness.

source: Hamhina mun jouse-a chun gancha hon adimin; phaicham ho jong changin akhusoh-in, thanomin a-aovun, lajong asauve.
target: The meadows are covered with flocks and the valleys are mantled with grain; they shout for joy and sing.

source: Nangho gamjousen, Pathen na kipa aw thon sah-un.
target: Shout for joy to God, all the earth!

source: Amin jana la saovin, ama vahchoi chu loupi sah-un.
target: Sing the glory of his name; make his praise glorious.

source: Pathen henga, nathilbol chu iti gimnei hitam! nathilbol theina loupi jala, namelmate nahenga kipelut ding ahiuve, tin seijuvin.
target: Say to God, “How awesome are your deeds! So great is your power that your enemies cringe before you.

source: Leiset pumpin nangma nahouvun tin, chule nahenga la asah uva, namin vahchoi La asahdiu ahi. Selah
target: All the earth bows down to you; they sing praise to you, they sing the praises of your name.”

source: Pathen thilbol hohi hungvetemun, mihem chate chunga athilbol hohi tijat umtah ahi.
target: Come and see what God has done, his awesome deeds for mankind!

source: Aman twipi tolgo asosah in, twisoh chu kengin apal galkaijun, hia chun ama-ah kakipah uvin ahi.
target: He turned the sea into dry land, they passed through the waters on foot— come, let us rejoice in him.

source: Aman athaneina-in tonsotnin vai ahomin, amitnin namtin chu amui; dou bolho chu kichoisang daohen. Selah
target: He rules forever by his power, his eyes watch the nations— let not the rebellious rise up against him.

source: Vo nangho mipin, i-Pathen'u chu vahchoijun, chule apachatna awgin chu kijahdoh sah-un.
target: Praise our God, all peoples, let the sound of his praise be heard;

source: Aman mihing lah-a ihinnao hi eituhdet peh-un, chule ikengu achaloh ding jong aphalpoi.
target: he has preserved our lives and kept our feet from slipping.

source: Ajehchu Pathen, nangin neipatep un, dangka bangin nei suthengun ahi.
target: For you, God, tested us; you refined us like silver.

source: Nangin len sunga chun neipui lutnun, kakong uvah suhgentheina nangame.
target: You brought us into prison and laid burdens on our backs.

source: Nangin kalu chunguva mi natousah-in, keihon meilah le twilah kapal galkaijun; ahinla nangin munphatah khatna neipuilut taove.
target: You let people ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but you brought us to a place of abundance.

source: Keima govam thilpeh choija na in'a kalut ding ahin; kakitepna ho chu nangma kapeh ding,
target: I will come to your temple with burnt offerings and fulfill my vows to you—

source: hichu kahesoh laitah-a kamuh-in aseidoh-a, ka kamin anaphondoh ahitai.
target: vows my lips promised and my mouth spoke when I was in trouble.

source: Sathao tah-a govam ganlhaina le kelngoichalho gimnamtui chu nahenga toh ingting, bongchalho le kelcha hotoh tothange. Selah
target: I will sacrifice fat animals to you and an offering of rams; I will offer bulls and goats.

source: Nangho Pathen gingho jouse, hung unlang ngaijuvin, chule kahinna dinga ipi eibol peh-em phongdoh inge.
target: Come and hear, all you who fear God; let me tell you what he has done for me.

source: Kakamin ama kakouvin, kaleijin ama achoi anjin ahi.
target: I cried out to him with my mouth; his praise was on my tongue.

source: Keiman kalungthima gitlouna kangaitole, Pakaiyin eingaipeh ponte.
target: If I had cherished sin in my heart, the Lord would not have listened;

source: Ahinla tahbeh-in Pathen'in eingaipeh in, aman kataona aw eingaipeh tan ahi.
target: but God has surely listened and has heard my prayer.

source: Kataona le amihepina keija kona heimanglouva Pathen chu nunnom hen.
target: Praise be to God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld his love from me!

source: Pathen'in eihepiu hen, phatthei eiboh uhen, chule amaivah chu ichunguva salvah hen. Selah
target: May God be gracious to us and bless us and make his face shine on us—

source: Hichu leiset chunga nalampi akihetna ding, chule nahuhhingna damna chu namtin lah-a akihet nading ahi.
target: so that your ways may be known on earth, your salvation among all nations.

source: Vo Pathen, mitinin navahchoi hen, mijousen nangma navahchoiju hen.
target: May the peoples praise you, God; may all the peoples praise you.

source: O namtin kipah henlang kipanan la saohen, ajehchu nangin chonphatna-a miho thu natana, chule leisetna cheng namtin chunga vai napoh ding ahi. Selah
target: May the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you rule the peoples with equity and guide the nations of the earth.

source: Vo Pathen mitinin navahchoi hen, mijousen nangma navahchoiju hen.
target: May the peoples praise you, God; may all the peoples praise you.

source: Chutengle leisetnin aga tampi sodoh intin, Pathen, ka Pathen'u chun, phatthei eiboh taovinte.
target: The land yields its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.

source: Pathen'in phatthei eiboh-untin, chule kolkim vella mijousen ama ging taovinte.
target: May God bless us still, so that all the ends of the earth will fear him.

source: Pathen chu kipat henlang amelmate kithecheh uhen, ama hote jong chu amasanga jamuhen.
target: May God arise, may his enemies be scattered; may his foes flee before him.

source: Meikhu alencheh bangin, amaho lenmang sah-in, mei koma khoilu jollha bangin, Pathen anga migilouho chu mangthah uhen.
target: May you blow them away like smoke— as wax melts before the fire, may the wicked perish before God.

source: Ahinla michonpha ho kipah-u henlang, Pathen anga thanomuhen; henge, nasatah-in thanom uhen.
target: But may the righteous be glad and rejoice before God; may they be happy and joyful.

source: Pathen henga la saovinlang, tumgingto thon amin vahchoi La saovin; vanho chunga touva amina JAH kitipa chu choisangun lang a-anga kipah un.
target: Sing to God, sing in praise of his name, extol him who rides on the clouds; rejoice before him—his name is the Lord .

source: Achenna munthenga um Pathen chu, pabeite pale meithaiho thutan ahi.
target: A father to the fatherless, a defender of widows, is God in his holy dwelling.

source: Pathen'in michangkhat chu inko lah-a akoijin, akihenho alhadoh-in; golkehho vang chu gamgoa achensah-in ahi.
target: God sets the lonely in families, he leads out the prisoners with singing; but the rebellious live in a sun-scorched land.

source: Vo Pathen, namite nahin lamkaija, gamthip nahinjot laichun, Selah
target: When you, God, went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness,

source: Leiset akihotnin, vanho jong Pathen angah achimlhan, Israel Pathen anga chun Sinai jengjong chu akihot tan ahi.
target: the earth shook, the heavens poured down rain, before God, the One of Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.

source: Vo Pathen, nangin go nengtah-in najuhsah-in, hichea chun nagoulote ahatmo laitah-un nasudet tan ahi.
target: You gave abundant showers, O God; you refreshed your weary inheritance.

source: Nangma mipi ho chu chua chun anachengun, vo Pathen nangin naphatna chu mivaichate dingin nagon peh-in ahi.
target: Your people settled in it, and from your bounty, God, you provided for the poor.

source: Pakaiyin thu apen; chuche thu phongjal ho chu hon lentah ahiuve.
target: The Lord announces the word, and the women who proclaim it are a mighty throng:

source: Lengte galmiho chu gangtah-in ajamtaovin; chule in'a um numei ho chu galla kichom dohho akihom taovin ahi.
target: “Kings and armies flee in haste; the women at home divide the plunder.

source: Belho lah-a lumji jongle chun, vakhu lha dangka-a kitom tobang le amul ho sana enga kitom tobang nahi nahlai dingu ahi.
target: Even while you sleep among the sheep pens, the wings of my dove are sheathed with silver, its feathers with shining gold.”

source: Hatchung nungin chua lengho athehcheh laichun, Salmon'a buhbang bangin abangin ahi.
target: When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like snow fallen on Mount Zalmon.

source: Pathen lhang chu Bashan lhang tobang ahin, lhang sangtah chu Bashan lhang tobang ahi.
target: Mount Bashan, majestic mountain, Mount Bashan, rugged mountain,

source: Nangho lhang sangho, ibolla kichom nahiuvem? Hichehi Pathen'in achenna dinga adei lhang chu ahi; henge, Pakai chu chukoma atonsotna chengding ahi.
target: why gaze in envy, you rugged mountain, at the mountain where God chooses to reign, where the Lord himself will dwell forever?

source: Pathen kangtalai chu sangsomni, vantil asang asangho ahin, Pakai chu muntheng Sinai'a tobang chun alah uva aume.
target: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands; the Lord has come from Sinai into his sanctuary.

source: Nangma chungsanga nakaltouvin, gal hing chu gal hingin nakaijin, nangin miho din thilpeh nasangin, henge, doubolho-a dingin jong nasangin; hitia chu Pakai Pathen chu alah uva achentheina ding ahi.
target: When you ascended on high, you took many captives; you received gifts from people, even from the rebellious— that you, Lord God, might dwell there.

source: Niseh-a iphat chomna diu eipeuva Pakai, eihuh hingpao Pathen chu nunnom hen. Selah
target: Praise be to the Lord, to God our Savior, who daily bears our burdens.

source: I-Pathen'u chu huhhing-a Pathen ahin, thina-a kona hoidohna chu Pakai Pathen chun anei ahi.
target: Our God is a God who saves; from the Sovereign Lord comes escape from death.

source: Ahinla Pathen'in amelmate luchang le, suhkhel na-a chejing pa samphatna lulei chu amavoding ahi.
target: Surely God will crush the heads of his enemies, the hairy crowns of those who go on in their sins.

source: Pakaiyin, Bashan gama konin hinpuikit ningting, kamite chu twikhanglen thuhtah-a konin pui kitninge, ati.
target: The Lord says, “I will bring them from Bashan; I will bring them from the depths of the sea,

source: Hitia chu nakengu namelmate thisanna nadelut uva, chule na uichateu lei jongchu chutima hiding ahi.
target: that your feet may wade in the blood of your foes, while the tongues of your dogs have their share.”

source: Vo Pathen, amahon nache chu amuvin, ka Pathen le kalengpa, munthenga nachelaitah chu amuvin ahi.
target: Your procession, God, has come into view, the procession of my God and King into the sanctuary.

source: Lasaho amasauvin, tumging tumhon anungu ajuijun, alah uva chun nungah khongcha bengho aumuvin ahi.
target: In front are the singers, after them the musicians; with them are the young women playing the timbrels.

source: Mipi kikhom lah-a Pathen vahchoijun, tonsot Pakai chu Israel twinah-a konchun vahchoijun.
target: Praise God in the great congregation; praise the Lord in the assembly of Israel.

source: Chua chun Benjamin phungneo leh, avaipoteu; Judah pipuiho le avaipoteu, Zebulun pipuiho chule Naptali pipuiho chu aumuvin ahi.
target: There is the little tribe of Benjamin, leading them, there the great throng of Judah’s princes, and there the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.

source: Na Pathen'in nathahat chu thu apen; Vo Pathen, kadiuva neithil bolpeh-u chu hatsah-in.
target: Summon your power, God; show us your strength, our God, as you have done before.

source: Jerusalem'a na houin jala lenghon nahenga kipaman ahinchoi diu ahi.
target: Because of your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring you gifts.

source: Mijouse dangka nongho to ahung kipehlut masang seuvin; tengcha choi mihon ho, mipi ho bongnou jaonan bongchal tamtah ho, chu phohsalin lang, galbol ding dei miho chu thecheh-in.
target: Rebuke the beast among the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations. Humbled, may the beast bring bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

source: Egypt'a konin pipuho hungdoh untin, Ethiopia'in Pathen lamah akhut jahdoh vah tante.
target: Envoys will come from Egypt; Cush will submit herself to God.

source: Leiset lenggam hon Pathen vahchoi La saovin, Pakai vahchoina la saovin. Selah
target: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth, sing praise to the Lord,

source: Golluilai vanho le, vanho chunga toupa henga chun; veuvin, aman a-aw, thaneitah aw ahin lhadoh-in ahi.
target: to him who rides across the highest heavens, the ancient heavens, who thunders with mighty voice.

source: Pathen henga nahatnao chu peuvin, athupina chu Israelte chungah aumin, chule ahatna chu meilom ho lah-a aumme.
target: Proclaim the power of God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose power is in the heavens.

source: Vo Pathen, namun thengho-a kona nangma tijat umtah nahi. Ama Israelte Pathen ngeitah chu amite thahatna le thilboltheina peji-a ahi. Pathen chu nunnom hen.
target: You, God, are awesome in your sanctuary; the God of Israel gives power and strength to his people. Praise be to God!

source: Vo Pathen, neihuhhing in, ajehchu twi hohin kahinna gei ahin phatan ahi.
target: Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to my neck.

source: Dinna ding umlou bonlhoh thuhtah-a chun kalhalut tan; twisoh in eichupmin, twi thuh lama chun kahunglut tan ahi.
target: I sink in the miry depths, where there is no foothold. I have come into the deep waters; the floods engulf me.

source: Kaka kanan katha acholin, kadang agotan; Ka Pathen kanga jing lai hin kamit alosam tan ahi.
target: I am worn out calling for help; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.

source: Ajeh beija eihotbol te chu kalua kasamho sangin atamjouvin; dihlou tah-a suhmang dinga eigo kamelmate chu hattah ahiuvin; hiti chun kalah khah louhel chu kalepeh jin ahi.
target: Those who hate me without reason outnumber the hairs of my head; many are my enemies without cause, those who seek to destroy me. I am forced to restore what I did not steal.

source: Vo Pathen, nangin kangolna nahen, chule kachonsetna ho nanga konin akiselpon ahi.
target: You, God, know my folly; my guilt is not hidden from you.

source: Vo tonsot Pakai, janel Pathen, nangma ngahte chu keima jeh in jachat sah hih-in, vo Israel Pathen, nangma holte chu keima jal-in maimoh daohen.
target: Lord, the Lord Almighty, may those who hope in you not be disgraced because of me; God of Israel, may those who seek you not be put to shame because of me.

source: Ajehchu nangma jal-in keima i-sah louvin ka umin, jachatnan kamai akhutan ahi.
target: For I endure scorn for your sake, and shame covers my face.

source: Kasopite lah-a maljin kasohtan, chule kanu chate lah-a gamchom mi kahitan ahi.
target: I am a foreigner to my own family, a stranger to my own mother’s children;

source: Ajehchu na in dinga katom pana-in einechai jin, chule nahouse hon na housetnao chu keima chungah achutan ahi.
target: for zeal for your house consumes me, and the insults of those who insult you fall on me.

source: Keima kaka ka-a chule an ngola kahinna kasuhgim tengle, hichu eiki houset nabep ahijin ahi.
target: When I weep and fast, I must endure scorn;

source: Khaodip pon jong kavonin kasemtan, amahodin thuchihbep kahijitai.
target: when I put on sackcloth, people make sport of me.

source: Kotpi phunga touho chun keima douna thu aseijun, chule jukhamho la bou kanahi jin ahi.
target: Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of the drunkards.

source: Ahinla vo Pakai, keima vang lah phatchan nahenga kataojin, vo Pathen nahepina tamtah, nahuh hingna thutah jal chun nei ngaipeh-in.
target: But I pray to you, Lord , in the time of your favor; in your great love, O God, answer me with your sure salvation.

source: Bonlhoh-a konin neiloidoh inlang, neilhah lhumsah hih-in, eihot bolte leh twi thuhtah-a konin neihuh doh-in.
target: Rescue me from the mire, do not let me sink; deliver me from those who hate me, from the deep waters.

source: Twisoh chu neichupsah danlang, twithuh chu neival lhumsah hih-in, chule kotongin jong akam eichikhum hih hen.
target: Do not let the floodwaters engulf me or the depths swallow me up or the pit close its mouth over me.

source: Vo Pakai nalungset ngailutna hi aphatjeh-in, neingaipeh in, nahepi khotona chamkim dungjuijin kaheng lama hung kiheijin.
target: Answer me, Lord , out of the goodness of your love; in your great mercy turn to me.

source: Nasoh-a konin namai sel hih-in, ajeh chu lungkhamin kaume; gangtah-in neingai peh-in.
target: Do not hide your face from your servant; answer me quickly, for I am in trouble.

source: Kahinna hin naijin chule lhatdoh-in, kamelmate jeh-in neilhat doh-in.
target: Come near and rescue me; deliver me because of my foes.

source: Nangin eikisei setnale kajachatna chule eikija louna hohi nahen; kakidoupi jouse abonun namasanga aumuve.
target: You know how I am scorned, disgraced and shamed; all my enemies are before you.

source: Houset nahin kalungthim asukeh-in, chule lungkham na-a kadimset nin; ei khoto ding kaholin, khatchala kamupon, chule lhamon naho kaholin khatcha jong kamujoupon ahi.
target: Scorn has broken my heart and has left me helpless; I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found none.

source: Ka-an dingin gilkha eipeuvin, chule kadang chah-a kadondin lengpitwi thuh eipeuve.
target: They put gall in my food and gave me vinegar for my thirst.

source: Adokhangu chu amasanguva thang hihen, chule aphat theinadiu tahho jong chu, thang kisoh hen.
target: May the table set before them become a snare; may it become retribution and a trap.

source: Amulouna diuvin amitnu thimhen lang, chule akongu chu tanglouvin kithin sah-in.
target: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.

source: Nalungsat na chu achunguva bunglhan, chule nalunghan lungsatna chun amaho manchah hen,
target: Pour out your wrath on them; let your fierce anger overtake them.

source: achennao chu kamhel henlang, aponbuh uva koimacha cheng hihhen.
target: May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.

source: Ajehchu nangin navoh chu abol gentheijun, chule namavona-a lungkhamho chu houlim nan anei jiuvin ahi.
target: For they persecute those you wound and talk about the pain of those you hurt.

source: Akhan gitlounao chu khan gitlouna-in belapmin, chule amaho chu nachon phatna sunga hunglut hih-u hen.
target: Charge them with crime upon crime; do not let them share in your salvation.

source: Amaho chu hinna lekhabua konin noimangin, chule chonpha hotoh sunhal hih-in.
target: May they be blotted out of the book of life and not be listed with the righteous.

source: Ahinla keima genthei tahle lunggimtah kahin, o Pathen nami huhhingna chun mun sang-ah eikoihen.
target: But as for me, afflicted and in pain— may your salvation, God, protect me.

source: Pathen min chu la khatnin vahchoi jingting, chule thangvah tothon choi-an inge.
target: I will praise God’s name in song and glorify him with thanksgiving.

source: Hiche hin ki le tin nei bong ahiloule bongchal sanga Pakai chu alung lhaisah joh ding ahi.
target: This will please the Lord more than an ox, more than a bull with its horns and hooves.

source: Mi nunnemin hichu muntin chule kipahding; chule nangho Pathen hol ho, nalungthimu hingding ahi.
target: The poor will see and be glad— you who seek God, may your hearts live!

source: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin migenthei te angaipeh-in, chule asoh changho nahsah louvin abolpoi.
target: The Lord hears the needy and does not despise his captive people.

source: Van le leiset, twipiho chule asunga achatle thei jousen, ama chu vahchoi cheh hen.
target: Let heaven and earth praise him, the seas and all that move in them,

source: Ajeh chu Pathen'in Zion ahuhhing ding, chule amaho chua achenuva, gouloa anei na dinguva, Judah khopiho asahdoh ding ahi.
target: for God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah. Then people will settle there and possess it;

source: Asohte sonho jong chun hichu ahinlodiu; Amin ngailuho chu asunga chu chengdio ahi.
target: the children of his servants will inherit it, and those who love his name will dwell there.

source: Vo Pathen eihuhdoh dingin kino-inlang, vo Pakai eipanpi dingin kikinno loijengin.
target: Hasten, O God, to save me; come quickly, Lord , to help me.

source: Kahinna suhgep dinga holho chu, jahchao henlang maimoh uhen; kakisuhkhah ding deiho chu, kinungle sah inlang kisudongu hen.
target: May those who want to take my life be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

source: Aha, aha, tiho chu ajachatnau lethuh na-in nunglama kilesahtan.
target: May those who say to me, “Aha! Aha!” turn back because of their shame.

source: Nangma holjouse chu nangma-a kipahle thanom muhen, na huhhingna ngailuho jouse chun tanglouvin, Pathen chu choi-at nin umhen tiuhen.
target: But may all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; may those who long for your saving help always say, “The Lord is great!”

source: Ahinla keivang vaichale lhasama kahi, vo Pathen, kahenga hungloijin, nangma eipanpi-ale eihuh hingpa nahi; vo Pakai, geisang loujenin.
target: But as for me, I am poor and needy; come quickly to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; Lord , do not delay.

source: Vo Pakai nangma ah katahsan kangame, a-imatih chanin nei lungdonsah hih helin.
target: In you, Lord , I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.

source: Na chonphat na-in neihuhdoh inlang, neihoidoh sah-in, kaheng lama nana hin sung inlang, neihuh doh-in.
target: In your righteousness, rescue me and deliver me; turn your ear to me and save me.

source: Nangma kachenna dettah, kapansat jom jingna nahin, keima huhhing dingin nangman thupeh napei; ajehchu nangma kasongpile kakulpi chu nahi.
target: Be my rock of refuge, to which I can always go; give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

source: Vo ka Pathen, migilouho, chonpha louho, chule mi-engse ho khutna konin neihuh doh-in.
target: Deliver me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of those who are evil and cruel.

source: Ajehchu vo Pakai Pathen, nangma kakinepna nahin; kakhangdon laijapat nangma katahsanpa chu nahi.
target: For you have been my hope, Sovereign Lord , my confidence since my youth.

source: Nang jala naobu-a kona eina kituh-a ahin, kanu oisunga kona eiladoh-a jong nangma nahin; kavah choina tanglouva nanga hijing ding ahi.
target: From birth I have relied on you; you brought me forth from my mother’s womb. I will ever praise you.

source: Mi tamtah-in kidang eisah-u ahin, ahinla nangma kakiselna dettah nahi.
target: I have become a sign to many; you are my strong refuge.

source: Nilhum keijin kakamhi nangma vahchoina le jabolna-in dimset jing hen.
target: My mouth is filled with your praise, declaring your splendor all day long.

source: Kateh nungle neipaidoh hih-in, kathabei phatle neidalha lou jenin.
target: Do not cast me away when I am old; do not forsake me when my strength is gone.

source: Ajehchu kamelma ten keidouna thu aseijun, chule kahinna changlhiho akihou somun,
target: For my enemies speak against me; those who wait to kill me conspire together.

source: Pathen'in ama adalhatan, manin lang bolgen theijun, ajehchu ahuhdoh ding koima aumtapoi, atiuve.
target: They say, “God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for no one will rescue him.”

source: Vo Pathen, keija konin gamla hih-in, vo ka Pathen, eipanpi din hung loijin.
target: Do not be far from me, my God; come quickly, God, to help me.

source: Kahinna douho chu kisuh dongsah-in lang sumangin, kakisuh khah nading hol ho chu seisetle maimohna-in khukhum uhen.
target: May my accusers perish in shame; may those who want to harm me be covered with scorn and disgrace.

source: Ahinla keima vang kakinep jing ding, chule nangma kaha vahchoi cheh cheh ding ahi.
target: As for me, I will always have hope; I will praise you more and more.

source: Kakamin nilhum keijin nachon phatna le nami huhhingna phongdoh inge; ajehchu keiman ijat tah mong ahi kahepoi.
