target: My mouth will tell of your righteous deeds, of your saving acts all day long— though I know not how to relate them all.

source: Keima Pakai Pathen thahatna songin cheng ting, nangma chonphatna, nangma-a sehbou phapoh inge.
target: I will come and proclaim your mighty acts, Sovereign Lord ; I will proclaim your righteous deeds, yours alone.

source: O Pathen, kakhangdon laija patnin nangin neina hilin, tugeijin nathilbol kidangho chu kaphong doh-in ahi,
target: Since my youth, God, you have taught me, and to this day I declare your marvelous deeds.

source: kahatna hi hiche khang mite hengle, nathaneina hi ahung lhung dingho jouse henga kahetsah masangsen; vo Pakai tu kateh-a kalu akan phat jonghin, nangin neidalha hih-in.
target: Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, my God, till I declare your power to the next generation, your mighty acts to all who are to come.

source: Vo Pathen, nang thil loupitah bolpa chu, nachon phatna jong asanglheh jenge, vo Pathen nang tobang koi umintem!
target: Your righteousness, God, reaches to the heavens, you who have done great things. Who is like you, God?

source: Nangma Lungkhamna lentahle nasatah eina musah pan, neisuh hal kit ding ahin, leiset thuhtah-a kona neipuitou kitding ahi.
target: Though you have made me see troubles, many and bitter, you will restore my life again; from the depths of the earth you will again bring me up.

source: Nangin kaletna punsah-in natin, lamjousea eilhamon nin nate.
target: You will increase my honor and comfort me once more.

source: Tumging tothon navahchoi jinge, Vo ka Pathen, na thutah ngeichu vahchoi jinge; vo nang Israelte mithengpen, selangdah in nangma vahchoi jinge.
target: I will praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God; I will sing praise to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

source: Nangma henga la kasah tengle, kamuhhi hapan kipah intin, chule nalhatdohsa kahinna hi hapan kipah inte.
target: My lips will shout for joy when I sing praise to you— I whom you have delivered.

source: Kalei jonghin nachon phatna nilhum keijin seijinte; ajehchu kasetna ding holho chu jachatna ah achutaovin ahi.
target: My tongue will tell of your righteous acts all day long, for those who wanted to harm me have been put to shame and confusion.

source: Vo Pathen, nathutanna chu lengpa penlang, nachon phatna chu lengpa chapa petan.
target: Endow the king with your justice, O God, the royal son with your righteousness.

source: Aman namite chu chonphatna-a thu atanna, chule nami vaichaho chunga thudih-a thu atanding ahi.
target: May he judge your people in righteousness, your afflicted ones with justice.

source: Molsang hon namite henga chamna hinpou vintin, chule lhang neohon chonphatna ahinpoh dingu ahi.
target: May the mountains bring prosperity to the people, the hills the fruit of righteousness.

source: Aman milah-a vaichaho chu athu-u atanna, milhasam ho chate chu ahuhdoh ding, chule misugenthei te chu ngemsela asuhchip ding ahi.
target: May he defend the afflicted among the people and save the children of the needy; may he crush the oppressor.

source: Amahon nile lha aumlaise-a akhang akhanga nagindiu ahi.
target: May he endure as long as the sun, as long as the moon, through all generations.

source: Ama gohongin lei achapnou banga, hampa chunga goju banga hung ding ahi.
target: May he be like rain falling on a mown field, like showers watering the earth.

source: Ama nikholaile chonphatna chu pungin tin, chule lha aumlaisea chamna bulhing setna umding ahi.
target: In his days may the righteous flourish and prosperity abound till the moon is no more.

source: Aman twikhanglen'a pat twikhanglen gei, chule vadunga pat leiset kolmong geija lengvai apohding ahi.
target: May he rule from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth.

source: Gamthipma chengho chu a-anga bohkhup muntin, chule amelma teovin leivui ale diu ahi.
target: May the desert tribes bow before him and his enemies lick the dust.

source: Tarshish lenghole twikol gamhon thilpeh ahinchoidiu, chule Seba lengho le Seba'n thilpeh apehdiu ahi.
target: May the kings of Tarshish and of distant shores bring tribute to him. May the kings of Sheba and Seba present him gifts.

source: Henge, lengjouse a-anga bohkhupdiu, nam jousen ama ajendiu ahi.
target: May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.

source: Ajehchu aman angaichaho, mivaicha le panpiding neilou mi chu atao tengleh ahuhdoh ding ahi.
target: For he will deliver the needy who cry out, the afflicted who have no one to help.

source: Aman mivaichale lhasamho ahoidoh ding, alhasamho hinna chu ahuhhing ding ahi.
target: He will take pity on the weak and the needy and save the needy from death.

source: Aman amaho hinkho chu lheplhahna le hunam na-a kona alhatdoh ding, chule athisannu chu amitmua manlutah hiding ahi.
target: He will rescue them from oppression and violence, for precious is their blood in his sight.

source: Chule ama hingintin, ahenga Sheba sana chu kipe ding; amadinga taona tanglouva uma, niseh-a ama kivahchoi ding ahi.
target: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him and bless him all day long.

source: Leiset molsang ho chungvuma chun chang ga tamtah umintin, Lebanon banga aga chu kiling ding, khopi sunga miho chu leisetna hampa banga pungdiu ahi.
target: May grain abound throughout the land; on the tops of the hills may it sway. May the crops flourish like Lebanon and thrive like the grass of the field.

source: Amin chu tonsotna umding ahin; amin chu nisa umlaisea umjing ding ahi: chule ama-a mitin phattheina changding; Namtinin nunnom ati dingu ahi.
target: May his name endure forever; may it continue as long as the sun. Then all nations will be blessed through him, and they will call him blessed.

source: Pakai Pathen, Israelte Pathen chu nunnom hen, ama bou thilkidang bolpa chu ahi.
target: Praise be to the Lord God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

source: Chule amin loupi chu tonsotnin nunnom hen; leiset pumpihi aloupina in lodimhen, Amen chule Amen.
target: Praise be to his glorious name forever; may the whole earth be filled with his glory. Amen and Amen.

source: Jesse chapa David taonaho akichai tai.
target: This concludes the prayers of David son of Jesse.

source: Dihtah-in Pathen hi Israelte dingin aphan, milung thengtah hodingin jong aphan ahi.
target: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

source: Ahinla keimadingin vang, kakengho amui lhagam kon ahitan, kakalsonho kalhonal ding koncha ahitai.
target: But as for me, my feet had almost slipped; I had nearly lost my foothold.

source: Ajehchu migilouho phattheina kamuteng, mingol ho kathangse jin ahi.
target: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

source: Ajehchu athi tengu jongle thohnatna himhim aneipouvin, ahin athahatnao adetjon ahi.
target: They have no struggles; their bodies are healthy and strong.

source: Midang bangin hahsatna imacha anei pouvin, midang bangin thohgimna jong aneipouvin ahi.
target: They are free from common human burdens; they are not plagued by human ills.

source: Hijeh chun kiletsahnan thihkhao bangin a-um kimvelu vin, hunam chun ponsil bangin atomuvin ahi.
target: Therefore pride is their necklace; they clothe themselves with violence.

source: Athao jeh un amitnu alotdoh-in, lungin angaitophah kalval aneijun ahi.
target: From their callous hearts comes iniquity; their evil imaginations have no limits.

source: Amahon nehguh abolun, giloutah-in suhgentheina thu aseijun, hoithotah in apaovui.
target: They scoff, and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.

source: Van douna in akamkaovin, aleijun leiset pumpi achonsoh uvin ahi.
target: Their mouths lay claim to heaven, and their tongues take possession of the earth.

source: Hijeh chun amite hilanga ahung akileuvin, chule twi khon dimset adon kangun ahi.
target: Therefore their people turn to them and drink up waters in abundance.

source: Chule amahon, Pathen'in iti ahetna, chule chungnung pena chu hetna umam? atiuve.
target: They say, “How would God know? Does the Most High know anything?”

source: Veovin, hiche hohi Pathen ngaisah louho ahiuve, amaho vannoi'a alolhingun, ahao cheh cheh uvin ahi,
target: This is what the wicked are like— always free of care, they go on amassing wealth.

source: Tahbeh-in keiman kalunghi mohseh-in kasuthengin, kakhut hohi mona beijin kasile.
target: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure and have washed my hands in innocence.

source: Ajehchu nilhum keijin kathohgimin, chule jingsehle eikisehgimjin ahi.
target: All day long I have been afflicted, and every morning brings new punishments.

source: Keiman, chutobang chun seijinge, tijongleng, vetan, nachate khanggui kipalsah kahiding ahi.
target: If I had spoken out like that, I would have betrayed your children.

source: Keiman hichu hetdinga kangaito tengle, keidin anabehseh-in;
target: When I tried to understand all this, it troubled me deeply

source: Pathen munthenga kagalutna, akichainao kaga hetthem masangsen, kachutin ahi.
target: till I entered the sanctuary of God; then I understood their final destiny.

source: Atahbeh-in nangin amaho mun nal ho-a nakoijin, manthah na-a napailhan ahi.
target: Surely you place them on slippery ground; you cast them down to ruin.

source: Chomkah louva iti amaho mahthah hel jenga hitaovem! amaho tijat umtah-in akisumang heltaovin ahi.
target: How suddenly are they destroyed, completely swept away by terrors!

source: Mangnei khat ahung khah doh banga; vo Pakai nakhahdoh tengle, chutobang chun alimu chu geldao tannate.
target: They are like a dream when one awakes; when you arise, Lord, you will despise them as fantasies.

source: Hitichun kalungthim ahesoh-in, chule kalunggil asunalheh-in ahi.
target: When my heart was grieved and my spirit embittered,

source: Keima mingol tah le kho hephalou kahin; namasanga gamsa tobangbou kahi.
target: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before you.

source: Hijeng jongle nang toh kaum khom jingin, kakhut jet lamin neituh jingnai.
target: Yet I am always with you; you hold me by my right hand.

source: Nathumop machun neipuijin natin, chujoule loupi na-ah neisangin nate.
target: You guide me with your counsel, and afterward you will take me into glory.

source: Van'a nang tailou koi dang kaneijem? Chule leisetna jong nang tailou kangaichat dang aumpoi.
target: Whom have I in heaven but you? And earth has nothing I desire besides you.

source: Katahsa le kalungthim alosamtan; ahinla Pathen chu kalungthim thahatna le, tonsotna kachan ding chu ahi.
target: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

source: Ajehchu vetan, nanga kona gamla ho mangthah diu ahin; nangma najon san jouse chu nasumang tan ahi.
target: Those who are far from you will perish; you destroy all who are unfaithful to you.

source: Keidin vang Pathen naihi apha ahin; nathilbol jouse kaphondoh theinadin, Pakai Pathen'a katahsana kangam tan ahi.
target: But as for me, it is good to be near God. I have made the Sovereign Lord my refuge; I will tell of all your deeds.

source: Vo Pathen ibola tonsotna dia neipaidoh hitam? Ibola nahamhinga kivah kelngoite douna-a nalung hanna khudoh-a hitam?
target: O God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

source: Masanglaija nachoh dohsa namipi kikhomho, nalhatdohsa nagou nam mite le asunga nachenna hiche Zion molsang hi hingel doh-in
target: Remember the nation you purchased long ago, the people of your inheritance, whom you redeemed— Mount Zion, where you dwelt.

source: Kumkho-a manthah helna lama chun nakal hinsongin; melmaten engse tah-in munthenga na atongun ahi.
target: Turn your steps toward these everlasting ruins, all this destruction the enemy has brought on the sanctuary.

source: Namelmate chu namite kikhom ho lah-a chun akitumun, aponlap hou chu melchihnadin atungdoh taove.
target: Your foes roared in the place where you met with us; they set up their standards as signs.

source: Thing lentah ho chunga aheichaho lamma mikhat tobang ahiuve.
target: They behaved like men wielding axes to cut through a thicket of trees.

source: Ahinla tun athil suiho chu thakhat tah-in, heichale sehtumin asuchim taovin ahi.
target: They smashed all the carved paneling with their axes and hatchets.

source: Namun theng jong meijin ahaluvin, namin chena ho tollah aseplhaovin, asuboh soh hel taove.
target: They burned your sanctuary to the ground; they defiled the dwelling place of your Name.

source: Amahon alungthimun aseijun, eihon amaho abonchan sumangu hite; gamsunga Pathen hou khomna in jouse meijin ahalvam taove.
target: They said in their hearts, “We will crush them completely!” They burned every place where God was worshiped in the land.

source: Keihon kamelchihna hou kamu tapouvin, themgao himhim aumtapon; itihchan hiding ham he-a kalah uva khatcha jong aumtapon ahi.
target: We are given no signs from God; no prophets are left, and none of us knows how long this will be.

source: Vo Pathen, itihchan melman eihouset dingu ham? Namin chu tonsotna melmaten ataitom ding hitam?
target: How long will the enemy mock you, God? Will the foe revile your name forever?

source: Ipidinga nakhut natuhtanga, nakhut jetlam ngeichu ibola natuh tang ham? na-opma konin lhangdoh inlang amaho khu sumangin.
target: Why do you hold back your hand, your right hand? Take it from the folds of your garment and destroy them!

source: Ajehchu Pathen chu tonna patna kalengpa ahin, leiset lailunga huhhingna na tongji chu ahi.
target: But God is my King from long ago; he brings salvation on the earth.

source: Nangin nahatna-in twikhanglen chu nalheh khennin, nangin twilah-a Dragonho lu nasukeh-in ahi.
target: It was you who split open the sea by your power; you broke the heads of the monster in the waters.

source: Nangin Leviathan luchang ahal halin navochip in, amachu gamthipma cheng miho anchah din napen ahi.
target: It was you who crushed the heads of Leviathan and gave it as food to the creatures of the desert.

source: Nangin twinah le twisoh nahom khenin, vadunglen ho jongchu nasukangin ahi.
target: It was you who opened up springs and streams; you dried up the ever-flowing rivers.

source: Sunhi nanga ahin, jan jong nanga ahi; Nangin vah le nisa nanasemin ahi.
target: The day is yours, and yours also the night; you established the sun and moon.

source: Nangin leiset gamgiho jouse nakoijin, nipi le phalbi nasemme.
target: It was you who set all the boundaries of the earth; you made both summer and winter.

source: Vo Pakai, melmate i-sah louna le, mingolin namin ataitom naohi geldoh jingin.
target: Remember how the enemy has mocked you, Lord , how foolish people have reviled your name.

source: Oh, navapal hinna chu migilou mipi henga pedoh hih-in, a-imatih-in namigenthei kikhom hohi sumil hih-in.
target: Do not hand over the life of your dove to wild beasts; do not forget the lives of your afflicted people forever.

source: Kitepna neija peh-in, ajehchu leiset munthim laihohi engsetna adimin ahi.
target: Have regard for your covenant, because haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.

source: O, akibolgimho chu jachatnan kilesah hih-in, vaicha le lhasamhon namin vahchoi hen.
target: Do not let the oppressed retreat in disgrace; may the poor and needy praise your name.

source: Vo Pathen, thouvin lang nathuhi seitoh-in, mingolin niseh-a iti nahouset nem geldoh jingin.
target: Rise up, O God, and defend your cause; remember how fools mock you all day long.

source: Namelmate awgin chu sumil hih-in, nangma douna mipite husa chu tanglou helin akhang jingin ahi.
target: Do not ignore the clamor of your adversaries, the uproar of your enemies, which rises continually.

source: Nangma kathangvah uve, Vo Pathen, nangma kathangvah uve, nathil kidang bolhon namin anaihi aphong doh-e.
target: We praise you, God, we praise you, for your Name is near; people tell of your wonderful deeds.

source: Phat kijenpet kalhendoh teng, dihtah-a thu katan ding ahi.
target: You say, “I choose the appointed time; it is I who judge with equity.

source: Leisetle asunga cheng jouse ajunmang tan, keiman akhom chu dettah-in katungdoh tai. Selah
target: When the earth and all its people quake, it is I who hold its pillars firm.

source: Mingol ho henga chun ngolhoi tah-in umhih-un katin, migilou hengah naki domsang hih-in kati.
target: To the arrogant I say, ‘Boast no more,’ and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up your horns.

source: Naki chu domsang hih-in, ngei pukonin thu seihih-in.
target: Do not lift your horns against heaven; do not speak so defiantly.’ ”

source: Ajehchu choisangna chu solama kon, lhumlama kon, ahiloule lhanglama kona jong hung hilou ahi.
target: No one from the east or the west or from the desert can exalt themselves.

source: Ahinla Pathen chu thutan ahin; aman khat asotlhah-a chomkhat adopsangji ahi.
target: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.

source: Ajehchu Pakai khutna chun khon khat aumin, chule ju chu asan ahin; hichu akihalchop dimset ahin, hiche mama chu ahinsunglhan; ahinla leisetna migilouho jousen aning geija adon kanghel diu ahi.
target: In the hand of the Lord is a cup full of foaming wine mixed with spices; he pours it out, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to its very dregs.

source: Ahinla kenvang a-imatih chanin phongdoh ingting, Jacob Pathen vahchoi La chu sange.
target: As for me, I will declare this forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob,

source: Migilouho jouse ki kasuhlhuh ding, michonpha ho ki vang kichoisang ding ahi.
target: who says, “I will cut off the horns of all the wicked, but the horns of the righteous will be lifted up.”

source: Judah te lah a-Pathen chu hetnin aumin, Israelte lah-a amin chu aloupin ahi.
target: God is renowned in Judah; in Israel his name is great.

source: Salem'a jong ahou buh aumin, chule Zion'a achenna mun aumin ahi.
target: His tent is in Salem, his dwelling place in Zion.

source: Hiche mun'a chun aman thalpi thalchang ho, lumdal le chemjam, chule gal asubong gamin ahi. Selah
target: There he broke the flashing arrows, the shields and the swords, the weapons of war.

source: Nangma sadelna molsang ho sangin naloupin nachung nungjon ahi.
target: You are radiant with light, more majestic than mountains rich with game.

source: Milunglenho chu akisuse gamun, a-imut naova a-imulhu paijun; chule mihat ho koimachan akhut hou amujou tapouvin ahi.
target: The valiant lie plundered, they sleep their last sleep; not one of the warriors can lift his hands.

source: Vo Jacob Pathen, naphosalna jeh-in sakol kangtalai le sakol jong a-imu millhon tan ahi.
target: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both horse and chariot lie still.

source: Nang, nangmatah chu gindingtah nahin, chule nangma lunghan teng namitmu-a koiham ading theidinga?
target: It is you alone who are to be feared. Who can stand before you when you are angry?

source: Nangin nathutanna thu van'a konin najahsah-in, leiset akichan athip behtan,
target: From heaven you pronounced judgment, and the land feared and was quiet—

source: Pathen thutanlha dinga ahung kipat doh-a, leisetna gimbola um jouse ahuhdoh ding teng. Selah
target: when you, God, rose up to judge, to save all the afflicted of the land.

source: Tahbeh-a mihem lunghanna chun nangma navahchoi ding, lunghanna amohchengse-a chu naki gah ding ahi.
target: Surely your wrath against mankind brings you praise, and the survivors of your wrath are restrained.

source: Pakai na Pathen nu henga kihahselun, chule peuvin; akimvella umjousen ginding dolpa henga chun kipaman hinchoijun.
target: Make vows to the Lord your God and fulfill them; let all the neighboring lands bring gifts to the One to be feared.

source: Aman pipuiho lhagao asuhmang ding; ama chu leiset lengho dinga kichat umtah ahi.
target: He breaks the spirit of rulers; he is feared by the kings of the earth.

source: Ka awn Pathen kakouve, ka aw-in Pathen ngei chu kakouvin, chule aman keilama ana asungin ahi.
target: I cried out to God for help; I cried out to God to hear me.

source: Kalung khamnin Pakai chu kaholin, kanatna kajanthoh lel-in, oltih kanei theipoi, kahinna jong lhepbi ding anompoi.
target: When I was in distress, I sought the Lord; at night I stretched out untiring hands, and I would not be comforted.

source: Pathen kanageldoh-in, chuin kalungkhamin; kana kiphin in, chuin kalhagao lungdongin aumin ahi. Selah
target: I remembered you, God, and I groaned; I meditated, and my spirit grew faint.

source: Kamit nahasah jingin, thusei theilou khopmin kalungkhame.
target: You kept my eyes from closing; I was too troubled to speak.

source: Khangluilai thu, masanglai kumho chu kagah gelin ahi.
target: I thought about the former days, the years of long ago;

source: Jana kalasah chu kageldoh kitnin, kalungsunga keile kei kakihouvin, kalhagaovin gunchu tah-in aholin ahi.
target: I remembered my songs in the night. My heart meditated and my spirit asked:

source: Pakaiyin a-itih-a dinga aledoh dingham? chule akhohsahna chu umkit louhel ding hitam?
target: “Will the Lord reject forever? Will he never show his favor again?

source: Ahepina theng chu a-itih-a dinga kichai hitam? Athutep chu atonsotna dinga thonna hitam?
target: Has his unfailing love vanished forever? Has his promise failed for all time?

source: Pathen'in lungsetna aneiding chu asuhmil hitam? ahepina lainatna chu alunghanin akhachah hitam? Selah
target: Has God forgotten to be merciful? Has he in anger withheld his compassion?”

source: Chule hichehi keima lhahsam ahi kanatin, ahinla chungnung pen khut jetlam kumho chu geljinging kate.
target: Then I thought, “To this I will appeal: the years when the Most High stretched out his right hand.

source: Pakai thilbolho chu kageldoh ding ahi; khanglui laija nathilbol kidangho chu geldoh tahbeh ingkate.
target: I will remember the deeds of the Lord ; yes, I will remember your miracles of long ago.

source: Nanatoh ho jouse jong ngaito ingting, nathilbol ho houlimnan neijinge.
target: I will consider all your works and meditate on all your mighty deeds.”

source: Vo Pathen, nalampi chu munthenga aumin; i-Pathen banguva lentah Pathen koiham?
target: Your ways, God, are holy. What god is as great as our God?

source: Nangma thil kidangho bolji Pathen chu nahin nangman nathahat mitin lah-a naphong doh-e.
target: You are the God who performs miracles; you display your power among the peoples.

source: Nabanin namite, Jacob le Joseph chate chu nalhatdohtan ahi. Selah
target: With your mighty arm you redeemed your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.

source: Twiho chun namutaove, vo Pathen, twiho chun namutaove; amaho akichauvin, twi thuhho jong aki tihotsoh taove.
target: The waters saw you, God, the waters saw you and writhed; the very depths were convulsed.

source: Meilhang hon twi ahinlha lha uvin, vanthamjol hon aw ahinsodoh-un, nathalchangho aleng lahlah jenge.
target: The clouds poured down water, the heavens resounded with thunder; your arrows flashed back and forth.

source: Navan ginchu van'a akithong lhungin, kolphen vannoi asalvah soh-in, leiset akithingin, akihotnin ahi.
target: Your thunder was heard in the whirlwind, your lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.

source: Nalampi twikhanglen'a aumin, nalam lhah twilenho sunga um ahi, chule nakhonung ho het ahipoi.
target: Your path led through the sea, your way through the mighty waters, though your footprints were not seen.

source: Nangin namite kelngoi hon bangin, Mosi le Aaron khutna nanapuijin ahi.
target: You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

source: Vo kamite kadanthu-a hin nana hinsungun, kakamsung thuho-a hin na-nakhangu hinsung uvin.
target: My people, hear my teaching; listen to the words of my mouth.

source: Thulem seinan kam kangting, malai thu ki-im ho seidoh-ing kate.
target: I will open my mouth with a parable; I will utter hidden things, things from of old—

source: Inajah uva inahetsao, ipateovin eina hil hou chu ahi.
target: things we have heard and known, things our ancestors have told us.

source: Hicheho chu achateuva henga i-im loudiu, khangthah hung umdingho henga Pakai vahchoinaho le athahatna chule thilkidang ana boldohho chu ihetsah diu ahi.
target: We will not hide them from their descendants; we will tell the next generation the praiseworthy deeds of the Lord , his power, and the wonders he has done.

source: Ajehchu Jacob hengah photchetna aphutdoh-in, chule Israelte lah-a danthu atungdoh-in, hichu achateu ahetsah diuvin ipu ipateu thu apen ahi.
target: He decreed statutes for Jacob and established the law in Israel, which he commanded our ancestors to teach their children,

source: Chutia chu khang hunglhung dingho, chate hungpeng dingho chun ahet diu; chutia chu amaho chu thoudoh uva achateu ahilson jing dingu ahi.
target: so the next generation would know them, even the children yet to be born, and they in turn would tell their children.

source: Akinepnao chu Pathen'a angapmuva, chule Pathen natohho chu sumil louva, amavang athupeh ajui nadiu ahi.
target: Then they would put their trust in God and would not forget his deeds but would keep his commands.

source: Apateu louchal le golkeh khangmite, alungputnu janglou khangmite, alhagaovu Pathen'a detlouho bang ahilouna diu ahi.
target: They would not be like their ancestors— a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose hearts were not loyal to God, whose spirits were not faithful to him.

source: Ephraim chaten galvon akivonun, chule thalpi akikenun, galsat nikhon akiheijun akinungle taove.
target: The men of Ephraim, though armed with bows, turned back on the day of battle;

source: Amahon Pathen thutep chu achingtup pouvin, adanthua chonding anompouve.
target: they did not keep God’s covenant and refused to live by his law.

source: Chule aman avetsah anatohho le athilkidang bolho asumilgam taovin ahi.
target: They forgot what he had done, the wonders he had shown them.

source: Egypt gam Zoan munah apateu mitmun, Pathen'in datmo umtahtah thil anabolin ahi.
target: He did miracles in the sight of their ancestors in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.

source: Aman twikhanglen ahom khenin, chuin amaho chu agalkaisah-in, chule twiho chu alhuh-in adinsah-in ahi.
target: He divided the sea and led them through; he made the water stand up like a wall.

source: Amaho chu sunle meilhangin apuijin, janle meikongin apuilejin ahi.
target: He guided them with the cloud by day and with light from the fire all night.

source: Gamthipma songpiho chu akhitkeh sah-in, chule thuhtah-a kon hungdoh bangin amaho donding twi apen ahi.
target: He split the rocks in the wilderness and gave them water as abundant as the seas;

source: Aman songpi-a konchun luiho alondohsah-in, vadungho bangin twiho alonlhah sah-e.
target: he brought streams out of a rocky crag and made water flow down like rivers.

source: Chule gamthipma chun chungnung pen phinsetnan achonset bebe nalaijun ahi.
target: But they continued to sin against him, rebelling in the wilderness against the Most High.

source: Chule amahon atahsao ngaichat an thumnan alungthimun Pathen apatepmun ahi.
target: They willfully put God to the test by demanding the food they craved.

source: Henge, amahon Pathen douna thu aseijun, gamthip mahi Pathen'in dokhang adothei dingham? atiuve.
target: They spoke against God; they said, “Can God really spread a table in the wilderness?

source: Veuvin, aman songpi avon, twiho ahung kikhodoh-in, vachadung chu along letset tan; changlhah jong apetheidem? amitedin sa ape theidem?
target: True, he struck the rock, and water gushed out, streams flowed abundantly, but can he also give us bread? Can he supply meat for his people?”

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hichu ajan, chuin alunghangin; Jacob dounan mei akongdoh-in, Israel dounan jong lunghanna ahung kongdoh-e.
target: When the Lord heard them, he was furious; his fire broke out against Jacob, and his wrath rose against Israel,

source: Pathen atahsan lou jeh-u le, ahuhhingna atahsan loujeh-u ahi.
target: for they did not believe in God or trust in his deliverance.

source: Aman chunga kona meilhang ho thu apeh-a, van kot ho ahonjeng vangin,
target: Yet he gave a command to the skies above and opened the doors of the heavens;

source: Chule aneh diuvin mana achunguva alhahsah-in, van an chu amaho anapen ahi.
target: he rained down manna for the people to eat, he gave them the grain of heaven.

source: Mihemin vantil ho an aneuvin, amaho avaset nadiuvin an anapen ahi.
target: Human beings ate the bread of angels; he sent them all the food they could eat.

source: Aman solam hui chu van'a anunsah-in, chule athaneina-in lhanglam hui ahin puilutne.
target: He let loose the east wind from the heavens and by his power made the south wind blow.

source: Sa chu leivui jat bangin achunguva ajuhsah-in, vacha lhaving nei chu twikhanglen'a neldi jat tobang ahi.
target: He rained meat down on them like dust, birds like sand on the seashore.

source: Chule achennao kimvel, agebuhhou lailunga alhahsah-in ahi.
target: He made them come down inside their camp, all around their tents.

source: Hitichun aneuvin, avasetnui; ajehchu mahon angaichat uchu ape ahi.
target: They ate till they were gorged— he had given them what they craved.

source: Amaho ngaichatna toh akikhendeh pouvin, akamuva asaneh-u aumpetlai chun,
target: But before they turned from what they craved, even while the food was still in their mouths,

source: Pathen lunghanna achunguva achun, amaho lah-a athaopenho chu athatnin, Israel pasal lhendoh ho chu asumangtan ahi.
target: God’s anger rose against them; he put to death the sturdiest among them, cutting down the young men of Israel.

source: Ajehchu chuche geijong chun achonse jing nalaijun, chule athil kidang bol ho jong atahsan pouve.
target: In spite of all this, they kept on sinning; in spite of his wonders, they did not believe.

source: Hijeh chun akumhou mohseh-in, chule anikhohou lungkham na-in asuhbei pehtan ahi.
target: So he ended their days in futility and their years in terror.

source: Aman amaho atha phatnin amahon ahinholun, chule ahung kileuvin Pathen chu ahol loi uvin ahi.
target: Whenever God slew them, they would seek him; they eagerly turned to him again.

source: Chule amahon Pathen chu asongpiule, Pathen chungnung chu alhatdohpau ahi ahingeldoh uvin ahi.
target: They remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.

source: Ahivangin akamuvin ama apahcha lhemun, chule aleijun amachu ajoulhep jiuvin ahi.
target: But then they would flatter him with their mouths, lying to him with their tongues;

source: Ajehchu alungu ama lama aum pon, chujongle akitepna-a chun jong alungdet pouvin ahi.
target: their hearts were not loyal to him, they were not faithful to his covenant.

source: Hijongle ama lungsetna dimset ahijeh-in, akhan gitlounao angaidamin, chule asumang pouve; henge, vel tamtah alunghana aheimangjin, alunghana jouse asodoh pon ahi.
target: Yet he was merciful; he forgave their iniquities and did not destroy them. Time after time he restrained his anger and did not stir up his full wrath.

source: Ajehchu tahsaphe bou ahiu ageldoh-in, khohui anunmanga hungkile kitlou ahiuchu ageldoh-in ahi.
target: He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.

source: Gamthipma iti alunghansah jinguva, chule nelgama iti alung phatmosah jingu hitam!
target: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness and grieved him in the wasteland!

source: Henge, akinung heijun Pathen alhemjiuvin, chule Israel mitheng pa chu asulung na-un ahi.
target: Again and again they put God to the test; they vexed the Holy One of Israel.

source: Amahon akhut ageldoh pouvin, melma-a kona alhatdohna nikho jong chu ageldohdeh pouvin ahi.
target: They did not remember his power— the day he redeemed them from the oppressor,

source: Egyp gama melchihna ho abola, chule Zoan phaija thil kidang iti abol hitam,
target: the day he displayed his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the region of Zoan.

source: chule aman avadunghou thisan asosah-in, chule atuisoh hou chu adonthei tapouvin ahi.
target: He turned their river into blood; they could not drink from their streams.

source: Aman alah uva thousi jatchom chom asolin, hichun amaho anejouvun, chule uphoh chun amaho asumanguvin ahi.
target: He sent swarms of flies that devoured them, and frogs that devastated them.

source: Aman amuchi hou chu lungtol apen, chule atohgau chu khaokhopi ho apen ahi.
target: He gave their crops to the grasshopper, their produce to the locust.

source: Alengpi guihou gellin asusen, chule atheiba phunghou buhbangin asumangtan ahi.
target: He destroyed their vines with hail and their sycamore-figs with sleet.

source: Aganchahou jong gelchang henga apen, chule akelngoihou keh nasatah henga chun apen ahi.
target: He gave over their cattle to the hail, their livestock to bolts of lightning.

source: Aman vantil engseho asolin, alungsatna kichat umtah, alunghana le lungthahna, chule thangtom nale gentheina chu achunguva achutan ahi.
target: He unleashed against them his hot anger, his wrath, indignation and hostility— a band of destroying angels.

source: Alunghana lampi asem peh-in, ahinnao chu thina a konin akhendoh pon, ahinkhou chu hise apedoh jotai;
target: He prepared a path for his anger; he did not spare them from death but gave them over to the plague.

source: chule Ham Houbuh ho-a ahatnau chungnung pen, Egypt cha pengmasa jouse chu athatnin ahi.
target: He struck down all the firstborn of Egypt, the firstfruits of manhood in the tents of Ham.

source: Ahinla amite chu kelngoi banga chedoh dingin asemin, ganchahon bangin gamthipma chun alamkaijin ahi.
target: But he brought his people out like a flock; he led them like sheep through the wilderness.

source: Chule akichat louna diuvin bitkeijin apuijin, ahinla amelmateu chu twikhanglen'in achupgam taovin ahi.
target: He guided them safely, so they were unafraid; but the sea engulfed their enemies.

source: Chule aman muntheng gamgi gei, akhut jetlama anachoh molsang geijin, apuilhung tan ahi.
target: And so he brought them to the border of his holy land, to the hill country his right hand had taken.

source: Amasanguva Pathen hephalouho jong anodohpeh-in, chule agoulodin ahoppeh-in, Israel phungho aponbuh cheh uva achensahtai.
target: He drove out nations before them and allotted their lands to them as an inheritance; he settled the tribes of Israel in their homes.

source: Achuti vangin chungnung pen Pathen chu apatepmun, alunghansah uvin, aphotchetnaho achingtup pouvin ahi.
target: But they put God to the test and rebelled against the Most High; they did not keep his statutes.

source: Ahinla akinung heijun, apateu bangin tahsan umloutah-in akhangun, kitahlouna thalpi bangin akiheimang taovin ahi.
target: Like their ancestors they were disloyal and faithless, as unreliable as a faulty bow.

source: Hitichun amunsang houva alunghan nachu achoh thouvun, amilim semhouvin athangsetsah taove.
target: They angered him with their high places; they aroused his jealousy with their idols.

source: Pathen'in hichehi ajah phatnin alunghangin, Israelte chu akidah behsehtai:
target: When God heard them, he was furious; he rejected Israel completely.

source: chutichun aman Shiloh Houbuh, mihem ho lah-a akoi ponbuh chu adalha tan;
target: He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent he had set up among humans.

source: chuin aman athahatna chu sohchang din apedoh-in, chule aloupina chu melmate khutna apedoh tai.
target: He sent the ark of his might into captivity, his splendor into the hands of the enemy.

source: Amite chu chemjam'a loudin jong apedoh-in, chule agou lote chunga chun alunghangtai.
target: He gave his people over to the sword; he was furious with his inheritance.

source: Meikongin agollhanghou akavam gamin, chule anungah hou kichena himhima akipe tapouve.
target: Fire consumed their young men, and their young women had no wedding songs;

source: Athempuhou chemjamin alouvun, ameithai houvin jong akapouve.
target: their priests were put to the sword, and their widows could not weep.

source: Chujouvin Pakai chu mi a-ihmut na-a kona hungkhang bangin ahung khangdoh-in, chule lengpitwi jeh-a mihat tah khat hung kisen abangin ahi.
target: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, as a warrior wakes from the stupor of wine.

source: Amelmate ale sat kitnin, kumkho-a i-sah louva umdingin akoitan ahi.
target: He beat back his enemies; he put them to everlasting shame.

source: Chulou jong chun Joseph houbuh chu adeitapon, Ephraim phung jong alheng tapoi.
target: Then he rejected the tents of Joseph, he did not choose the tribe of Ephraim;

source: Ahivangin angailut Zion molsang, Juda phung chu alheng jotai.
target: but he chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which he loved.

source: Aman leiset a-imatih channa dinga atundoh bangin, amuntheng chu leng inpi sangtah ho bangin asadoh tan ahi.
target: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth that he established forever.

source: Aman asoh David chu, kelngoi honga konchun alheng dohtan ahi.
target: He chose David his servant and took him from the sheep pens;

source: Anou tamtah kai kelngoipi ho juija konin, amite Jacob phungle agoulo Israelte vahdin apuitai.
target: from tending the sheep he brought him to be the shepherd of his people Jacob, of Israel his inheritance.

source: Chutichun alungthim dihtah-in amaho chu avah-in, chule akhut themna-in amaho chu analamkaijin ahi.
target: And David shepherded them with integrity of heart; with skillful hands he led them.

source: Vo Pathen, nangma helouho nagoulona sunga ahung lutnun, na houin theng asuboh uvin, Jerusalem chu alhuh-in asetaove.
target: O God, the nations have invaded your inheritance; they have defiled your holy temple, they have reduced Jerusalem to rubble.

source: Amahon nasohte thilong chu chungleng vachate an dingin apeuvin, namithengte sa chu leija gamsaho apeuve.
target: They have left the dead bodies of your servants as food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your own people for the animals of the wild.

source: Athisanu chu Jerusalem kimvela twi bangin alongin, chule avui dingu koimacha aumpoi.
target: They have poured out blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury the dead.

source: Kaheng kakomhou housetnin kaumun, kakimvel uvaho nuisatle totnop nabep kahiuve.
target: We are objects of contempt to our neighbors, of scorn and derision to those around us.

source: Itih channem, Pakai? Atonsotna nalunghang ding hitam? Nathangthipna chu mei banga kongding ham?
target: How long, Lord ? Will you be angry forever? How long will your jealousy burn like fire?

source: Nangma hephalou namho chung le, chule namin phapohlou lenggam ho chunga nalung hanna chu bunglha tan.
target: Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge you, on the kingdoms that do not call on your name;

source: Ajehchu amahon Jacob chu abah gammun, achenna mun kamhelin alha taove.
target: for they have devoured Jacob and devastated his homeland.

source: Oh, masanglai kakhan gitlouna houchu geldoh hih-un, nahepinaho thahat chun neihoidoh loijun, ajehchu keiho hatah-a eikisu nemu ahitai.
target: Do not hold against us the sins of past generations; may your mercy come quickly to meet us, for we are in desperate need.

source: Vo eihuh hinguva Pathen, namin loupina dingin neipanpi uvin, namin jal-in kachonsetnahou sungimin lang, neihuhdoh uvin.
target: Help us, God our Savior, for the glory of your name; deliver us and forgive our sins for your name’s sake.

source: Ipidinga Pathen hephalouhon a-Pathenu hoibaham atidiuham? Sohte thisan kiso phulah na-in, kamitmuvin Pathen hephalouho lah-a hin amachu hetnin umhen.
target: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Before our eyes, make known among the nations that you avenge the outpoured blood of your servants.

source: Akihenho khoisatna chu na-angsung hung lhung hen, nathil bolthei natsat bangtah-in, thidinga gotsaho chu huhdoh-in;
target: May the groans of the prisoners come before you; with your strong arm preserve those condemned to die.

source: Chule vo Pakai amahon nahouset nao chu, ajat sagin kaheng kakomte angsunga lethuh-in.
target: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors seven times the contempt they have hurled at you, Lord.

source: Chuti chun namite keihole nahamhing lah-a kelngoiten, a-imatih chanin nangma thangvahna peuving ting, akhang akhangin napachat na musahjing taovinge.
target: Then we your people, the sheep of your pasture, will praise you forever; from generation to generation we will proclaim your praise.

source: Vo Israel kelngoi chinna chingpa, Joseph ganhon banga ana lamkaipa nangman, nana sungin, Cherubim ho kah-a chengpa nangma vah bangin vah doh-in.
target: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock. You who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth

source: Ephraim le Benjamin miho, chule Manasseh masanga nahatna chu hintildoh-in, chule hungin lang neihuh doh-un.
target: before Ephraim, Benjamin and Manasseh. Awaken your might; come and save us.

source: Vo Pathen, neisemthah kitnunlang, namai vahsah-in, chutile huhhing-a kaum dingu ahi.
target: Restore us, O God; make your face shine on us, that we may be saved.

source: Vo janelho Pakai Pathen, itihchan namite taona douva nalunghang dingham?
target: How long, Lord God Almighty, will your anger smolder against the prayers of your people?

source: Nangin amaho chu mitlhi-a kisem changlhah-in navah-in, adon dingun tena lentah-in mitlhi napejin ahi.
target: You have fed them with the bread of tears; you have made them drink tears by the bowlful.

source: Nangin kaheng kakomhou dingin kiphinna-in neisemun, chule kamelma teo lah-a nuisat kahitaove.
target: You have made us an object of derision to our neighbors, and our enemies mock us.

source: Vo janelho Pathen, neisemthah kitnunlang, namai vahsah-in, chutile huhhing-a kaum dingu ahi.
target: Restore us, God Almighty; make your face shine on us, that we may be saved.

source: Nangin Egypt'a konin lengpigui khat nahinpon; Pathen hephalouho nanodoh-in, hichu naphut tan ahi.
target: You transplanted a vine from Egypt; you drove out the nations and planted it.

source: Nangin ama dingin mun nasem peh-in, ajung thuhtah-in nakikhosah-in, gam leiset alosohtai.
target: You cleared the ground for it, and it took root and filled the land.

source: Lhangho chu alimin akhusoh-in, chule hiche abahho chu cedar thing phatah abange.
target: The mountains were covered with its shade, the mighty cedars with its branches.

source: Abahkai hochu twipi geijin asolin, chule hiche abahho chu vadung lama asole.
target: Its branches reached as far as the Sea, its shoots as far as the River.

source: Ibola apal ho chu naphet lhah-a, chuche lampi jot chanin akilou hitam?
target: Why have you broken down its walls so that all who pass by pick its grapes?

source: Gamlah-a kon hungpotdoh ngalchangin asuse-in, chuleh gamlah-a gamsan anejou tan ahi.
target: Boars from the forest ravage it, and insects from the fields feed on it.

source: Vo janelho Pathen, katao ahi, hungkile kitnin, van'a konin hinvenlang, hiche lengpi guihi hinvilin;
target: Return to us, God Almighty! Look down from heaven and see! Watch over this vine,

source: Nangman nakhut jetna naphu lengpi leihi, chule nangma dinga dettah-a nasem abahchu ahi.
target: the root your right hand has planted, the son you have raised up for yourself.

source: Hichehi meijin akihallhan akiphuh lhutan; namaiso-a phosal na-a amangthah taovin ahi.
target: Your vine is cut down, it is burned with fire; at your rebuke your people perish.

source: Nakhut chu najetlama mi, nangma dinga nahatsah mihem chapa chunga chun umhen.
target: Let your hand rest on the man at your right hand, the son of man you have raised up for yourself.

source: Chutichun nanga konin kinunghei tapouving ting; neisuhalun, chuteng keihon namin kakoudingu ahi.
target: Then we will not turn away from you; revive us, and we will call on your name.

source: Vo janelho Pakai Pathen neisemthah kitnunlang, namai vahsah in, chutile huhhing-a kaum dingu ahi.
target: Restore us, Lord God Almighty; make your face shine on us, that we may be saved.

source: Itha hatnao Pathen hengah gingtah-in la saovin, Jacob Pathen henga kipa aw thonsah-un,
target: Sing for joy to God our strength; shout aloud to the God of Jacob!

source: vahchoi La saovinlang, khongcha tum gingun, selangdah ngeitoh, tumging toh tho uvin.
target: Begin the music, strike the timbrel, play the melodious harp and lyre.

source: Lhathah, kitepna phat, i-kutpi nikho houva sumkon mut uvin.
target: Sound the ram’s horn at the New Moon, and when the moon is full, on the day of our festival;

source: Ajehchu Israelte dinga hichehi chondan kisem chu ahin, Jacob Pathen dinga dan chu ahi.
target: this is a decree for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

source: Hichehi Joseph chunga photchetsah na-a, Egypt gam sunga achedoh laija anasuhdet chu ahin, chu-a chun kahetlou paokhat kanajan ahi.
target: When God went out against Egypt, he established it as a statute for Joseph. I heard an unknown voice say:

source: Alengkou chu pohgih-a konin kalahdohpeh in, akhut chu belho-a konin akihuhdoh tai.
target: “I removed the burden from their shoulders; their hands were set free from the basket.

source: Lungkham nin neikouvin chule kahuh doh-e, keiman munthipma kithong lenglung ginin kahin donbutne, Maribah twija chun nangma kana patepme. Selah
target: In your distress you called and I rescued you, I answered you out of a thundercloud; I tested you at the waters of Meribah.

source: Ngaijuvin, vo kamite kapatep dingu nahiuve, vo Israel, kathu nangai uva ahile,
target: Hear me, my people, and I will warn you— if you would only listen to me, Israel!

source: Nalah uva gamdangmi Pathen himhim umlou ding ahin, gamchom pathen himhim nahoulou dingu ahi.
target: You shall have no foreign god among you; you shall not worship any god other than me.

source: Keimahi Egypt gama kona napuidoh uva, tonsot Pakai na Pathen'u chu kahi; Nakam kalen uvin chule keiman kadipdim ding ahi.
target: I am the Lord your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth and I will fill it.

source: Ahinla kamiten ka aw angaipouvin, chule Israelte khatchan eideipouve.
target: “But my people would not listen to me; Israel would not submit to me.

source: Chutichun alung ngaichat nao lama kapedoh-in, chule amahotah kithumop dungjuijin achontauve.
target: So I gave them over to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.

source: Ohe, kamiten kathu ngaijuhen, chule Israel hi kalampi ho-a che hitavele!
target: “If my people would only listen to me, if Israel would only follow my ways,

source: Agalteu kasot kun loija, chule akidoupiteu chunga kakhut kanalap ding ahitai.
target: how quickly I would subdue their enemies and turn my hand against their foes!

source: Pakai hotbolte chu ahenga kipelut chehdiu; ahivanga aphatnu chu a-imatih channa umjing ding ahi.
target: Those who hate the Lord would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

source: Aman suhlou chang tuipena amaho avahding; chule keiman songpi-a kon khoijua chu nangma ka lunglhaisah ding nahi.
target: But you would be fed with the finest of wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy you.”

source: Pathen chu thaneitah houkhom ho lah-a chun adingin, pathen ho lah-a thu atantai.
target: God presides in the great assembly; he renders judgment among the “gods”:

source: Itihchan dihlou tah-a thu natan uva, chule migilouho chunga langneina nanei dingu ham? Selah
target: “How long will you defend the unjust and show partiality to the wicked?

source: Vaichate le pabeite chu hongbitnun, bolgenthei thohho le lhasamte henga adih chu bolun.
target: Defend the weak and the fatherless; uphold the cause of the poor and the oppressed.

source: Vaichate le ngaichate chu huhdoh-un, migiloupa khutna konin amaho chu lhadoh-un.
target: Rescue the weak and the needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked.

source: Amahon ahepouvin chujongle hetkhen themna jong aneipouve; muthima vahle jing ahiuvin, leiset bulho jouse akilongtai.
target: “The ‘gods’ know nothing, they understand nothing. They walk about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.

source: Nangho pathenho nahiuvin, chule nabon uva chungnung pen chate nahiuve, kanatin ahi.
target: “I said, ‘You are “gods”; you are all sons of the Most High.’

source: Ahinla mihem banga nathiuva, chule pipuiho khat banga nalhuh dingu ahi.
target: But you will die like mere mortals; you will fall like every other ruler.”

source: Vo Pathen thouvin lang leiset thuhi tanin, ajehchu namjouse hi nalo ding ahi.
target: Rise up, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are your inheritance.

source: Vo Pathen, paolouvin umdan lang, thip beh-in umhih beh hih-in, chule vo Pathen umthim hihbeh-in.
target: O God, do not remain silent; do not turn a deaf ear, do not stand aloof, O God.

source: Ajehchu vetan, namelma ten thunoh aboluvin, chule nangma hotbolte akiletsah-un ahi.
target: See how your enemies growl, how your foes rear their heads.

source: Namite dounan amahon lungthim phalou agelun, chule naselguhte dounan akihousom taove.
target: With cunning they conspire against your people; they plot against those you cherish.

source: Hungun namkhat ahinaova konin sumangu hitin, Israel minhi geldohkit louhel nadingin bolu hite, atiuve.
target: “Come,” they say, “let us destroy them as a nation, so that Israel’s name is remembered no more.”

source: Ajehchu amaho lungkhat kisan akihoutoh-un, nangma dounan kiloikhomna akisem taove.
target: With one mind they plot together; they form an alliance against you—

source: Edom le Ishmael mite houbuhho, Moab le Hagar mite,
target: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,

source: Gebal la Ammon chule Amalek, Philistine te le Tyre'a chengho toh,
target: Byblos, Ammon and Amalek, Philistia, with the people of Tyre.

source: Assur jong amahotoh apangkhom taovin, amahon Lot chate akithopiuvin ahi. Selah
target: Even Assyria has joined them to reinforce Lot’s descendants.

source: Midian ho nabolna bang, Sisera nabolna bangin amaho chu bolin.
target: Do to them as you did to Midian, as you did to Sisera and Jabin at the river Kishon,

source: Amaho Endor'a amangthah taovin; leisetna din eh tobang ahitaove.
target: who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.

source: Amilen hou chu Oreb le Zeeb bangin bolin; henge, apiputeu jong Zebah le Zalmunna bangin bolin,
target: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

source: Pathen inho chu eiho chan dingin kilah uhite, atiuve.
target: who said, “Let us take possession of the pasturelands of God.”

source: Vo ka Pathen amaho chu chimpei bangle, khohui masanga changpol bangin semin.
target: Make them like tumbleweed, my God, like chaff before the wind.

source: Meijin gammang akah bangle, molsangho mei kihal deujeju bangin;
target: As fire consumes the forest or a flame sets the mountains ablaze,

source: Hitichun nahuipi chun sugen theijin lang, nahuipi le gopi achun kichatsah-in.
target: so pursue them with your tempest and terrify them with your storm.

source: Vo Pakai namin aholna diuvin, amaiju jachatnan dipmin.
target: Cover their faces with shame, Lord , so that they will seek your name.

source: A-itih-in jahchale lungdongin umsah-in, henge, jahchao henlang mangthah jengu uhen.
target: May they ever be ashamed and dismayed; may they perish in disgrace.

source: Chutia chu mihem ten, nangma bouseh Jehovah minpu, leiset pumpi-a chunga chungnung pen nahi ti ahethei diu ahi.
target: Let them know that you, whose name is the Lord — that you alone are the Most High over all the earth.

source: Vo janel Pakai, na houbuh hochu iti ngaichat umtam!
target: How lovely is your dwelling place, Lord Almighty!

source: Kahinna hin alhangai jin, henge, Pakai inpi indan ngaijin kalhasam heltan, kalungthim le katahsa hi hingjing Pathen henga akapme.
target: My soul yearns, even faints, for the courts of the Lord ; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

source: Henge, vasoh injong in akimun, chule pelpan jong anou akoina dingin amading bu aneije; Vo janel ho Pakai, kalengpale ka Pathen hichu namaicham ho ngei chu ahi.
target: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young— a place near your altar, Lord Almighty, my King and my God.

source: Nangma in'a chengho chu anunnom ahiuve, amahon navahchoi jing taovinte. Selah
target: Blessed are those who dwell in your house; they are ever praising you.

source: Nanga hatna neipa chu anunnomin, alungthimu gamtheng jotna dinga pedoh hochu anunnome.
target: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.

source: Amahon Baca phaicham ajot lhungun, twikul asemun, gotwi jong chun twikhuh hochu adip dime.
target: As they pass through the Valley of Baka, they make it a place of springs; the autumn rains also cover it with pools.

source: Amaho hat cheh, hatcheh-in acheuvin, Zion'a Pathen anga chun amichang cheh-in akilah-un ahi.
target: They go from strength to strength, till each appears before God in Zion.

source: Vo Pakai Janel Pathen, kataona ngaijin lang, Jacob Pathen, nana hinsungin. Selah
target: Hear my prayer, Lord God Almighty; listen to me, God of Jacob.

source: Vo kalumdal'u Pathen, vetemin, nathaonu mai hi hinven.
target: Look on our shield, O God; look with favor on your anointed one.

source: Ajehchu nahong sunga chun nikhat chu kum sangkhat sangin aphajon; gitlouna pon buho-a chensangin, ka Pathen in kotngah-a pan kanomjoi.
target: Better is one day in your courts than a thousand elsewhere; I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.

source: Ajehchu Pakai Pathen chu nisale lumdal ahin, Pakai chun lungsetna le loupina apeh ding, thildih'a chonteho-a dingin thilpha himhim it ponte.
target: For the Lord God is a sun and shield; the Lord bestows favor and honor; no good thing does he withhold from those whose walk is blameless.

source: Vo janelho Pakai, nangma tahsana michu anunnom ahi.
target: Lord Almighty, blessed is the one who trusts in you.

source: Pakai nagam chunga lungsetna naneijin; sohchanga Jacob chu nahin lepui kittan ahi.
target: You, Lord , showed favor to your land; you restored the fortunes of Jacob.

source: Nangin namite khan gitlouna nangaidamin, achonsetnao jouse namelkhutan ahi. Selah
target: You forgave the iniquity of your people and covered all their sins.

source: Nalunghanna jouse naladoh-in, nalungsat gimneitah chu nakihei mang khumtai.
target: You set aside all your wrath and turned from your fierce anger.

source: Vo eihuh hingpao Pathen, neilehei jinlang, kachunguva nalunghan bangtan.
target: Restore us again, God our Savior, and put away your displeasure toward us.

source: A-imatih channa kachunguva nalung hanjing ding ham? Nalunghan chu khangjousea naso dohsah jing ding hitam?
target: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you prolong your anger through all generations?

source: Nangman namite kakipana diuva, neisuhhal kit loudiu ham?
target: Will you not revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

source: Vo Pakai nahepina chu neimusah unlang, nahuhhingna chu neipeuvin.
target: Show us your unfailing love, Lord , and grant us your salvation.

source: Pakai Pathen'in ahin thusei ding chu ngaijing kate, ajehchu amite le amithengte henga chamna thu aseiding ahin; ahinla amaho ngolna lama kiheikit daohen.
target: I will listen to what God the Lord says; he promises peace to his people, his faithful servants— but let them not turn to folly.

source: Adihtah-in igam uva loupina aumtheina dingin, ami huhhing na chu ama gingte henga ahungnaijin ahi.
target: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that his glory may dwell in our land.

source: Hepina le thutah akimuto lhonin, chonphatna le chamna akichopto lhone.
target: Love and faithfulness meet together; righteousness and peace kiss each other.

source: Leisetna konin thutah kehdoh intin, chule chonphat na-in van'a kona ahinvet suh ding ahi.
target: Faithfulness springs forth from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.

source: Henge, Pakai chun thilpha chu hinpentin, chule igamuhin aga ahin punsah ding ahi.
target: The Lord will indeed give what is good, and our land will yield its harvest.

source: Chonphatna chu amasanga chentin, chule akholhahna lampia eichesah diu ahi.
target: Righteousness goes before him and prepares the way for his steps.

source: Vo Pakai nana hin sung inlang neingaipeh-in, ajehchu keima vaicha le lhasam kahi.
target: Hear me, Lord , and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

source: Kahinna hi neikheh peh-in, ajeh chu keima atheng kahi; vo ka Pathen, nangma tahsana nasohhi huhhingin.
target: Guard my life, for I am faithful to you; save your servant who trusts in you. You are my God;

source: Vo Pakai neihepin, ajehchu niseh-in nangma kakoujinge.
target: have mercy on me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

source: Nasoh hinkhohi kipasah-in; ajehchu vo Pakai, nangma-a kahinna kapedoh-e.
target: Bring joy to your servant, Lord, for I put my trust in you.

source: Ajehchu Pakai nangma naphan, ngaidam dinga kigojing nahin, nangma nakoute jouse chunga hepina dimset nahi.
target: You, Lord, are forgiving and good, abounding in love to all who call to you.

source: Vo Pakai kataona-a hin nana hinsungin, chule kathumna awcheng hi ngaiphan.
target: Hear my prayer, Lord ; listen to my cry for mercy.

source: Kalungjina nikho leh nangma kakou ding nahi; ajehchu nangman neidonbut ding ahi.
target: When I am in distress, I call to you, because you answer me.

source: Vo Pakai pathen ho lah-a nangtobang khatcha aumpon; chujongle nathilbol tobang bola jong khatcha aumpoi.
target: Among the gods there is none like you, Lord; no deeds can compare with yours.

source: Vo Pakai nasemsa nam jouse chu hungintin, na-anga chibai aboh uva, namin achoi-at diu ahi.
target: All the nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord; they will bring glory to your name.

source: Ajehchu nangma naloupin, thil kidangtah naboljin; Nangseh bou Pathen nahi.
target: For you are great and do marvelous deeds; you alone are God.

source: Vo Pakai, nalampi neihilin, na thutah-a chon inge, namin kagin theina ding lungthim pumkhat neipen.
target: Teach me your way, Lord , that I may rely on your faithfulness; give me an undivided heart, that I may fear your name.

source: Vo Pakai ka Pathen, kalung pumpin nangma vahchoi jing ting; chule a-imatih chana namin kachoi-at jing ding ahi.
target: I will praise you, Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify your name forever.

source: Ajehchu nahepina keidingin alenin; chule kahinna hi thikholkhul noinung penna konin nahuhdoh tai.
target: For great is your love toward me; you have delivered me from the depths, from the realm of the dead.

source: Vo Pathen, keima dounan mi kiletsahho akipanun, pumhat manga mipi kikhom mihon kahina aholun, chule amasanguva nangma nakoipouve.
target: Arrogant foes are attacking me, O God; ruthless people are trying to kill me— they have no regard for you.

source: Ahinla vo Pakai, nangma lainatpina le lungsetna, thoh hat, thutah, chule hepina dimset Pathen chu nahi.
target: But you, Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness.

source: O, kahenga hungkiheijin lang neihin hepin, nasohhi nahatna penlang, nasohnu chapahi huhhingin.
target: Turn to me and have mercy on me; show your strength in behalf of your servant; save me, because I serve you just as my mother did.

source: Aphatna dingin melchihna neimusah-in, chutile eihot bolten hichu muvintin, chule jahcha taovinte; ajehchu Pakai nangman neina kithopin chule neina lhamonin ahi.
target: Give me a sign of your goodness, that my enemies may see it and be put to shame, for you, Lord , have helped me and comforted me.

source: Akibulphuna chu moltheng ho-a aumin ahi.
target: He has founded his city on the holy mountain.

source: Pakai chun Jacob chennaho jouse sangin, Zion kotpiho chu angailujoi.
target: The Lord loves the gates of Zion more than all the other dwellings of Jacob.

source: Vo Pathen khopi, nachung chang thu loupitah-in akiseitai. Selah
target: Glorious things are said of you, city of God:

source: Keima eiheho henga Rehab le Babylon phapoh inge, Philistine le Tyre toh Ethiopia khu veuvin, hichepahi chua chu penga ahi.
target: “I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me— Philistia too, and Tyre, along with Cush— and will say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’ ”

source: Chule Zion chungchang thu hitia kiseiding ahi; hiche mipa le khuche mipa chu amanu-a peng ahin, chule chungnung penin amanu chu atun dohding ahi.
target: Indeed, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High himself will establish her.”

source: Pakai chun mipi ho min chu asutdoh tengle, hiche mipahi chua chu peng ahi, tia asut ding ahi. Selah
target: The Lord will write in the register of the peoples: “This one was born in Zion.”

source: Lasathemho le tumging themho chua umdiu, katwisam jouse chu nanga um ahi, ati dingu ahi.
target: As they make music they will sing, “All my fountains are in you.”

source: Vo eihuh hinga Pakai Pathen, sunle jannin na-anga kanataovin ahi.
target: Lord , you are the God who saves me; day and night I cry out to you.

source: Kataona na-angsunga hunglhung hen; kapenna-a hin nana hinsungin.
target: May my prayer come before you; turn your ear to my cry.

source: Ajehchu kahinnahi lungkham nan adimin; chule kahinkho hin lhan khuh lam anaitan ahi.
target: I am overwhelmed with troubles and my life draws near to death.

source: Kokhuh sunga kumlha ho toh eikisimtha tan, thabei hel mitoh kabangtai.
target: I am counted among those who go down to the pit; I am like one without strength.

source: Nangin nageldoh kit tahlou, Mithilah-a ongthol, akithatsa lhana lum tobang kahin chule amaho nakhutna kona kisatlha ahitaove.
target: I am set apart with the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more, who are cut off from your care.

source: Kotong noinungpen, muthim lah, mun thutah-a chun neikoijin ahi.
target: You have put me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

source: Nalung hanna kachunga agihsan, chule natwi kinonghon eibol gentheitan ahi. Selah
target: Your wrath lies heavily on me; you have overwhelmed me with all your waves.

source: Kamel het ho chu keija konin gamla tah-a nakoimangin, amaho henga thet umtah in neisemin, khakhumin kaumin, kapotdoh theipoi.
target: You have taken from me my closest friends and have made me repulsive to them. I am confined and cannot escape;

source: Thohgimna jeh-in kamit athimtai, Pakai, nitinin nangma kakouvin, naheng lama kakhut kajah jingin ahi.
target: my eyes are dim with grief. I call to you, Lord , every day; I spread out my hands to you.

source: Mithi henga thil kidangho namusah-a, mithiho hung thouva navahchoi diu ham? Selah
target: Do you show your wonders to the dead? Do their spirits rise up and praise you?

source: Vuikhuh-a chu nalungset ngailutna kiphonga, ahiloule tahsan naumna hi manthah na mun'a kiphong ding ham?
target: Is your love declared in the grave, your faithfulness in Destruction?

source: Muthima chu na thilkidang ho kihe theija, chule na nachon phatna chu suhmilna-a dim gama kihe ding ham?
target: Are your wonders known in the place of darkness, or your righteous deeds in the land of oblivion?

source: Ahinla vo Pakai, nahenga kap pumin kangeh-e, chule jingkah teng kataona chu naheng ahung lhunge.
target: But I cry to you for help, Lord ; in the morning my prayer comes before you.

source: Pakai idia kahinna hi naledoh-a, idia keija kona namai nasel hitam?
target: Why, Lord , do you reject me and hide your face from me?

source: Kakhangdon apat kathohgimin athikoncha kahitai, kichat naum naho kathoh laijin, kapangjou him himpoi.
target: From my youth I have suffered and been close to death; I have borne your terrors and am in despair.

source: Nalunghan gin umtah kachunga achun, kichat naum naho chun eisumang heltai.
target: Your wrath has swept over me; your terrors have destroyed me.

source: Hicheho chu twibangin niseh-in kavela ahungun, amahon eiumchah soh taove.
target: All day long they surround me like a flood; they have completely engulfed me.

source: Ngailut gol le paihola keija konin agamlatan, chule kamel hetho chu muthim lah-a aumtaovin ahi.
target: You have taken from me friend and neighbor— darkness is my closest friend.

source: Pakai hepinaho chu a-imatih chanin lan sangting; kakamin tahsan aumje khangjouse-a hetsah inge.
target: I will sing of the Lord ’s great love forever; with my mouth I will make your faithfulness known through all generations.

source: Ajehchu hepinahi a-imatih chana dinga kisadoh ding, nakitahna chu vanmun jouse-a naphudet ding ahi, kanatin ahi.
target: I will declare that your love stands firm forever, that you have established your faithfulness in heaven itself.

source: Keiman kamilhen chutoh kitepna kasemin, kasoh David henga kaki hahsel in,
target: You said, “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David my servant,

source: Nachilhah a-imatih chana dingin phutdoh ingting, chule nalaltouna chu khangjousea dinga katundoh ding ahi. Selah
target: ‘I will establish your line forever and make your throne firm through all generations.’ ”

source: Chule vo Pakai vanhon nathil kidang bolho avahchoi ding; nakitahna jong mitheng kikhomho lah-a umtante.
target: The heavens praise your wonders, Lord , your faithfulness too, in the assembly of the holy ones.

source: Ajehchu Pakai toh tepithei van'a koi uma? Mihat chapate lah-a Pakai kibahpi thei koi umjou ding ham?
target: For who in the skies above can compare with the Lord ? Who is like the Lord among the heavenly beings?

source: Mithengte kikhopna sunga Pakai chu sangtah-a ginding, chule akimvelaho jouse lah-a jana sangpen peh ding ahi.
target: In the council of the holy ones God is greatly feared; he is more awesome than all who surround him.

source: Vo janelho Pakai Pathen, nang tobang Pakai hat koiham? ahiloule nakimvelaho lah-a nakitahna phading koi umam?
target: Who is like you, Lord God Almighty? You, Lord , are mighty, and your faithfulness surrounds you.

source: Twikhanglen chunga vai nahomin, hichu ahung kinon teng nasuthip jin ahi.
target: You rule over the surging sea; when its waves mount up, you still them.

source: Mi khat kithat bangin, nangman Rahab chu ahal halin nasuchipmin, namelmate chu naban thahatnin nathe cheh-in ahi.
target: You crushed Rahab like one of the slain; with your strong arm you scattered your enemies.

source: Vanho nanga ahin, leiset jong nanga ahi; vannoi le asunga um jouse hi nangma phudoh ahi.
target: The heavens are yours, and yours also the earth; you founded the world and all that is in it.

source: Nangin sahlam le lhanglam nasemin, Tabor le Hermon namina kipah ding ahi.
target: You created the north and the south; Tabor and Hermon sing for joy at your name.

source: Nangin ban thahat tah naneijin, nakhut chu thahatna ahin, chule nakhut jetlam chu choi-atna achangin ahi.
target: Your arm is endowed with power; your hand is strong, your right hand exalted.

source: Chonphatna le thudih chu nalaltouna kibulphuna ahin; hepinale thutah chu namasangah aumin ahi.
target: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne; love and faithfulness go before you.

source: Kipana hethema mite chu anunnom ahiuve! O Pakai, amaho namaivah-a vahle diu ahi.
target: Blessed are those who have learned to acclaim you, who walk in the light of your presence, Lord .

source: Amaho namina nilhum keija kipah diu; chule nachon phatna-a amaho choisanga umdiu ahi.
target: They rejoice in your name all day long; they celebrate your righteousness.

source: Ajehchu nangma athahatnao loupina nahin; chule naphatna jeh-a ka ki'u choisanga umding ahi.
target: For you are their glory and strength, and by your favor you exalt our horn.

source: Ajehchu Pakai chu ihoidoh nao ahin, chule Israel mithengpa chu ilengpao ahi.
target: Indeed, our shield belongs to the Lord , our king to the Holy One of Israel.

source: Chuin gaovin namitheng khat henga thu naseijin: mihat tah khat chunga panpina kangamin, milah-a kona kilhengdoh khat kachoi-an tai, nati.
target: Once you spoke in a vision, to your faithful people you said: “I have bestowed strength on a warrior; I have raised up a young man from among the people.

source: Keiman kasoh David kamutan, kathaotheng chu ama kanutai.
target: I have found David my servant; with my sacred oil I have anointed him.

source: Ama-a chun kakhut hi thahatnin umintin, kabanin jong ama ahatsah ding ahi.
target: My hand will sustain him; surely my arm will strengthen him.

source: Melman achunga hunam bolpontin, chujongle gitlouna chapan jong ama sugim ponte.
target: The enemy will not get the better of him; the wicked will not oppress him.

source: Chule amaikohtah-a amelmate kavoh lhuh-a, chule ama hote chu kasuhgim ding ahi.
target: I will crush his foes before him and strike down his adversaries.

source: Amavang kakitahna le kahepinan ama aumpi ding; chule kamina aki chu choisanga umding ahi.
target: My faithful love will be with him, and through my name his horn will be exalted.

source: Akhut twikhanglen chunga kangapsah ding, chule akhut jetlam chu vadunglen hochunga kangapsah ding ahi.
target: I will set his hand over the sea, his right hand over the rivers.

source: Aman kahenga, nangma kapa, ka Pathen, chule eihuhhing songpi nahi tia kikou ding ahi.
target: He will call out to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock my Savior.’

source: Kenjong ama kachapa masapenle, leiset lengho sanga chungnung jo-a kasem ding ahi.
target: And I will appoint him to be my firstborn, the most exalted of the kings of the earth.

source: Kahepinan atonsotnin kivoppintin, kakitepna-in ama dettah-a adinpi jingding ahi.
target: I will maintain my love to him forever, and my covenant with him will never fail.

source: Achilhah jong atonsotna umdinga kasemding; alaltouna vangam nikhoho banga kasem ding ahi.
target: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.

source: Achate chun kadanthu apallhah uva, chule kathutan lhah banga achon lou uleh,
target: “If his sons forsake my law and do not follow my statutes,

source: Amahon kadan kisemho asuhkeh uva, chule kathupeh ho anitlou-uleh,
target: if they violate my decrees and fail to keep my commands,

source: Chutengle asuhkhelnau jeh-a mola kajep ding, chule akhan gitlounao jeh-a jepna-a kajep ding ahi.
target: I will punish their sin with the rod, their iniquity with flogging;

source: Hijeng jongle ama-a konin kalungset ngailutna hi ladoh soh hel pongting, tahsan kaumna hi thonsah ponge.
target: but I will not take my love from him, nor will I ever betray my faithfulness.

source: Kakitepna chu sukehpongting, chujongle kakamsunga sohsa jong khelkit ponge.
target: I will not violate my covenant or alter what my lips have uttered.

source: Kathenna-a khatvei kaki hahselsa ahin, David henga jouponge.
target: Once for all, I have sworn by my holiness— and I will not lie to David—

source: Achilhah a-imatih chana umjing ding, chule alaltouna ka-anga nisa banga umding ahi.
target: that his line will continue forever and his throne endure before me like the sun;

source: Hichu a-itih-a lha banga kiphutdoh ding, chule van'a hettohsah tahsan umtah banga kiphutdoh ding ahi. Selah
target: it will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.”

source: Ahinla nangman napaidoh-in nakidah tan, nathaonu chunga chun nalunghangtan ahi.
target: But you have rejected, you have spurned, you have been very angry with your anointed one.

source: Nangman nasohpa kitepna chu imalouvin nabolin, alal lukhuh tolla naseplhan, nasuhminset pehtan ahi.
target: You have renounced the covenant with your servant and have defiled his crown in the dust.

source: Nangin apaljouse navoh lhuhpeh-in, akulpidet chu manghel-in nalhatai.
target: You have broken through all his walls and reduced his strongholds to ruins.

source: Chuche lam hopa jousen amachu achom mun, a-inhengho-a dingin i-sah louvin aumtan ahi.
target: All who pass by have plundered him; he has become the scorn of his neighbors.

source: Nangman akidoupiho banjetlam chu nahatsah-in, amelmate jouse chu nakipa sahtan ahi.
target: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; you have made all his enemies rejoice.

source: Nangman achemjam ha jong nalehei peh-in, chule galmuna chun nadindet sah tapoi.
target: Indeed, you have turned back the edge of his sword and have not supported him in battle.

source: Nangin aloupina nasutangin, chule alaltouna tolla naseplhatai.
target: You have put an end to his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.

source: Nangin akhangdonlai nikhoho nasuchomin, jachatna-in nakhutai. Selah
target: You have cut short the days of his youth; you have covered him with a mantle of shame.

source: Pakai itih chanem? tonsotna nakisel mang ding hitam? nalung hanna chu meibanga kongding ham?
target: How long, Lord ? Will you hide yourself forever? How long will your wrath burn like fire?

source: Kaphat hi ichana choma ham geltemin, ipidinga mijousehi panabeija nasemham?
target: Remember how fleeting is my life. For what futility you have created all humanity!

source: Thina mulouva hingjing dinga mi koi umam? aman lhankhuh-a konin ahinna kihuhdoh thei jintem? Selah
target: Who can live and not see death, or who can escape the power of the grave?

source: Pakai malaija nalungset ngailutna, David henga nakitah na-a naki hahselna chu hoiba hitam?
target: Lord, where is your former great love, which in your faithfulness you swore to David?

source: Pakai nasohte kihouset nahi hingeldoh temin, mijouse housetna chu ka-anga kapoh hi geltemin;
target: Remember, Lord, how your servant has been mocked, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the nations,

source: Vo Pakai namelma ten anoisenao, nathaonupa kholhahna chana ataitom naohi geltemin.
target: the taunts with which your enemies, Lord , have mocked, with which they have mocked every step of your anointed one.

source: Pakai chu atonsot atonsotnin nunnom tahen. Amen, chule Amen.
target: Praise be to the Lord forever! Amen and Amen.

source: Pakai nangma khangjousea kachennao mun nahi.
target: Lord, you have been our dwelling place throughout all generations.

source: Molsangho jouse kitundoh masang, leiset le vannoi jeng jong nasuhto masanga, tonsotna kipat tonsotgeija nangma Pathen nahi.
target: Before the mountains were born or you brought forth the whole world, from everlasting to everlasting you are God.

source: Nangin mihem chu manthah na-a nakilesah-in, nangho mihem chate kileuvin natin ahi.
target: You turn people back to dust, saying, “Return to dust, you mortals.”

source: Ajehchu nangma mitmun kum sangkhat jonghi akichai tengleh janhi bangbep ahijin, chule janna khongah ho phat dankhat bepbou ahijie.
target: A thousand years in your sight are like a day that has just gone by, or like a watch in the night.

source: Nangin twisoh bangin amaho nalhoh mangjin, a-ihmu bangbep ahiuvin; jingkah-a hampa khangdoh bangbep ahiuve.
target: Yet you sweep people away in the sleep of death— they are like the new grass of the morning:

source: Jingkahteng adon doh-in akhangtoujin, nilhah lamle akisatlhan agopjitai.
target: In the morning it springs up new, but by evening it is dry and withered.

source: Ajehchu nalungsat na-a suhmang kahiuvin, chule nalunghanna-a kalung khamun ahi.
target: We are consumed by your anger and terrified by your indignation.

source: Kakhan gitlounao namasanga nakoijin, guhthima kachonsetnao namai vah-a natah langin ahi.
target: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

source: Ajehchu kanikho hou jouse nalunghannan achemang gamtan; kakumhou jong thusim kiseibangin kamangtaovin ahi.
target: All our days pass away under your wrath; we finish our years with a moan.

source: Kahin kumho nikho hou chu kum somsagi, chule atha hat ho chu kum somget jong ahitheije; hijongle ahatnau chu tohgimna le lungkhamna bou ahin, akisatlha loijin kalengmangji taove.
target: Our days may come to seventy years, or eighty, if our strength endures; yet the best of them are but trouble and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.

source: Nalungsat thaneina he-a koiham? nangma gin naum bangtah ngeijin nalunghan jong chuti chu ahi.
target: If only we knew the power of your anger! Your wrath is as great as the fear that is your due.

source: Hitichun kalungthimu hi chihna-a kaman theina diuvin, kanikho hou simje neihilun.
target: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

source: Hung kiheijin, vo Pakai itih chan em? chule nasohte chungchanga nalung hin heitan.
target: Relent, Lord ! How long will it be? Have compassion on your servants.

source: Kahin laiseuva kakipauva kathanopna diuvin, O nahepinan neilunglhai sah loijun.
target: Satisfy us in the morning with your unfailing love, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

source: Neisuh gentheinao nikhoho sungle, thilse kamu-u kumho sung dungjuijin neikipa sah-un.
target: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen trouble.

source: Nanatoh chu nasohte henga, chule naloupina chu achateu henga kilanghen.
target: May your deeds be shown to your servants, your splendor to their children.

source: Chule Pakai ka Pathen'u hoina chu kachunguva umhen, chule kakhutsoh-u natoh chu kachunguva tung doh-in, henge, kakhutsoh-u natoh chu tung doh-in.
target: May the favor of the Lord our God rest on us; establish the work of our hands for us— yes, establish the work of our hands.

source: Chungnung pen munthip mun'a chenga chu, hatchung nungpen dailim noija umding ahi.
target: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

source: Keiman Pakai chu, kakiselna le kakulpi ahin, ka Pathen chule ama katahsan ding pa ahi, ting kate.
target: I will say of the Lord , “He is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”

source: Tahbeh-in aman thangkampa thanga kon, chule hise phalou tah-a konin nahuhdoh-inte.
target: Surely he will save you from the fowler’s snare and from the deadly pestilence.

source: Aman amulho in nahui jintin, chule alhavingho noi natahsan ding, akitahna chu nalumdal le napho hiding ahi.
target: He will cover you with his feathers, and under his wings you will find refuge; his faithfulness will be your shield and rampart.

source: Janteng tijatna kicha tapon natin, chule suna thalchang hung lengji jong,
target: You will not fear the terror of night, nor the arrow that flies by day,

source: Ahilou jongle muthima hise lang, chule sunlaija manthah na hungleng jong kicha tapon nate.
target: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the plague that destroys at midday.

source: Nasihlama sangkhat lhu-a, chule najetlama sangsom lhuding, ahinla hichun nahin nai ponte.
target: A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near you.

source: Migilou kilethuhna chu namit sehseh-a navetna namu ding ahi.
target: You will only observe with your eyes and see the punishment of the wicked.

source: Ajehchu nangman kakiselna Pakai, chungnung pen chu, nangma chennan naseme.
