target: If you say, “The Lord is my refuge,” and you make the Most High your dwelling,

source: Thilphalou himhimin nalhun khum pontin, hise himhimin jong nachenna hinnai ponte.
target: no harm will overtake you, no disaster will come near your tent.

source: Ajehchu nalampi jouse-a nachingtup dinga, aman avantilte nangma chunga mopo dinga thu apeh ding ahi.
target: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways;

source: Songa nakeng nakisuh louna dinga, amahon akhutnuva nadop dingu ahi.
target: they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.

source: Keipi bahkai le gulsum chung nachot ding, keipi gollai le dragon chu nakengto noija nachilding ahi.
target: You will tread on the lion and the cobra; you will trample the great lion and the serpent.

source: Ajehchu angailutna kachunga akoijeh-in amachu huhdoh ingting; kamin ahetjeh-a mun sanga kakoiding ahi.
target: “Because he loves me,” says the Lord , “I will rescue him; I will protect him, for he acknowledges my name.

source: Aman eikou ding, keiman kadonbut ding; lungkham na-a kaumpia, kahuh doh-a, jabolna kachansah ding ahi.
target: He will call on me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble, I will deliver him and honor him.

source: Hinkho saona-in lunglhaisah ingting, kahuh hingna chu kamusah ding ahi.
target: With long life I will satisfy him and show him my salvation.”

source: Vo chungnung pen, namin vahchoi La sah-a, Pakai henga thangvahna peh hi thilpha ahi.
target: It is good to praise the Lord and make music to your name, O Most High,

source: Jingkah-a nalungset ngailutna, chule janseh-a nakitahna musah dingin,
target: proclaiming your love in the morning and your faithfulness at night,

source: Manchah jang som nei toh, tumging leh, selangdah gin ngeija nangma vahchoihi thilpha ahi.
target: to the music of the ten-stringed lyre and the melody of the harp.

source: Ajehchu Pakai nangin nathilbolla neikipasah ahin; nakhutsoh thilbolho-a jona la sange.
target: For you make me glad by your deeds, Lord ; I sing for joy at what your hands have done.

source: O Pakai nanatoh ho iti loupia hitam! chule nalunggel ho athuh-in ahi.
target: How great are your works, Lord , how profound your thoughts!

source: Milungsel hon hichu ahethei pouvin, mingolin jong hichu ahethem theipoi.
target: Senseless people do not know, fools do not understand,

source: Migilouho hampa banga ahung kedoh-a, khan gitlou bolho jouse aphat thei tengule, tonsot geija suhmanga umding ahitaove.
target: that though the wicked spring up like grass and all evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

source: Ahinla Pakai, nangma vang tonsotna chungnung pen nahi.
target: But you, Lord , are forever exalted.

source: Ajehchu, vo Pakai, namel mate khu vetan, ajehchu ven, namelmate khu mangthah untin, khan gitlou bolho jouse kithecheh diu ahi.
target: For surely your enemies, Lord , surely your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.

source: Ahinla ka-ki hi sakol kinei banga nachoisang ding; keima thaotwi thah eikinuding ahi.
target: You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; fine oils have been poured on me.

source: Kamit hin kamel mate chunga angaichat chu muntin, chule kanakhang hin keima douna-a kipan khangitlou bolho ngaichat chu ajahding ahi.
target: My eyes have seen the defeat of my adversaries; my ears have heard the rout of my wicked foes.

source: Michonpha chu tum phung banga khangtou ding; Lebanon lhanga Cedar thing banga khangtou ding ahiuve.
target: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, they will grow like a cedar of Lebanon;

source: Pakai in'a kiphut hochu i-Pathen'u hong sunga khangtou diu ahi.
target: planted in the house of the Lord , they will flourish in the courts of our God.

source: Amaho atehgeijuva jong ga jinguva, amaho chu thao uva khang toudiu;
target: They will still bear fruit in old age, they will stay fresh and green,

source: Pakai chu chondih ahi avetsah diu, ama chu kasongpi ahin, chule ama-a chun chonphat louna himhim umpoi.
target: proclaiming, “The Lord is upright; he is my Rock, and there is no wickedness in him.”

source: Pakai chun lengvai apon, ama loupina-in akivonin, Pakai chu thahat na-in akivonin, hiche-a chun aman atai akigah-e; leiset jonghi akilin louhelna dingin akitung detnin ahi.
target: The Lord reigns, he is robed in majesty; the Lord is robed in majesty and armed with strength; indeed, the world is established, firm and secure.

source: Nalal touna chu malaija kiphut doh-a ahitan; nangma tonsotna umsa nahitai.
target: Your throne was established long ago; you are from all eternity.

source: Vo Pakai twisoh akinong sangin, twisoh akinong gingin, twisoh akinong lenin ahi.
target: The seas have lifted up, Lord , the seas have lifted up their voice; the seas have lifted up their pounding waves.

source: Twi tamtah gin sangin Pakai chungnung chu ahatjon; henge, twikhanglen kinong hattah sangin ahatjon ahi.
target: Mightier than the thunder of the great waters, mightier than the breakers of the sea— the Lord on high is mighty.

source: Nathu hetoh sahna chu adihlheh-in; Vo Pakai a-imatih chanin thenna chu nangma in ahunghitai.
target: Your statutes, Lord , stand firm; holiness adorns your house for endless days.

source: Phulahna neija, vo Pakai Pathen, phulahna neija vo Pathen, hung kiphong doh-in.
target: The Lord is a God who avenges. O God who avenges, shine forth.

source: Leiset chung thutanpa, nangmatah kichoisangin lang, mikilet sahho lethuhna pen.
target: Rise up, Judge of the earth; pay back to the proud what they deserve.

source: Pakai itihchan migilou hon, itihchan migilou hon ajodingu ham?
target: How long, Lord , will the wicked, how long will the wicked be jubilant?

source: Itihchan thil hahsaho aseidingu ham? chule khangitlou bolte chu amaho le amaho kiletsah dingu ham?
target: They pour out arrogant words; all the evildoers are full of boasting.

source: Vo Pakai namite ahal hallin aheh goijun, nagouloho asugentheijuvin ahi.
target: They crush your people, Lord ; they oppress your inheritance.

source: Amahon meithaile kholjin asat lih-un, chule pa neilouho athatnun ahi.
target: They slay the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.

source: Ahijeng vangin amahon Pakai chun mupontin, Jacob Pathen'in jong ngaisah hih inte atiuve.
target: They say, “The Lord does not see; the God of Jacob takes no notice.”

source: Mipi lah-a milungselho, nanghon hekhenuvin, chule mingol ho, nangho itihle nachih dingu ham?
target: Take notice, you senseless ones among the people; you fools, when will you become wise?

source: Kol sempa kho jalouva uma? Mit sempa kho mulouva umding ham?
target: Does he who fashioned the ear not hear? Does he who formed the eye not see?

source: Pathen hephalouho gimbolpan, asuhdih louding ham? Mihem chihna hilpa chun, iti ahet da ding ham?
target: Does he who disciplines nations not punish? Does he who teaches mankind lack knowledge?

source: Pakai chun mihem lunggel ho chu pannabei ahi ti ahenai.
target: The Lord knows all human plans; he knows that they are futile.

source: Vo Pakai nasehgimpa, nadanthu-a kona nahilpa chu anun nome;
target: Blessed is the one you discipline, Lord , the one you teach from your law;

source: migilou dinga kokhuh kilai kahse-a, akidoupi ho nikho-a kona nacholnga sah ding ahi.
target: you grant them relief from days of trouble, till a pit is dug for the wicked.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin amite paimang hel pontin, chule agoulo mite chu adalhah lou ding ahi.
target: For the Lord will not reject his people; he will never forsake his inheritance.

source: Ahinla thutanlhahna chu chonphatna-a hung kilentin, chule lungdihpu jousen hichu ajuidiu ahi.
target: Judgment will again be founded on righteousness, and all the upright in heart will follow it.

source: Thilse bolho eidoupeh dinga koi kipatdoh-a, ahiloule khanset bolho eidoupeh dinga koi dingdoh dingham?
target: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will take a stand for me against evildoers?

source: Pakai chu eipanpi anahilou hileh, kahinna hi thipbeh-a ana umding ahitai.
target: Unless the Lord had given me help, I would soon have dwelt in the silence of death.

source: Kakeng kalho nale katichun, vo Pakai nahepina-in nei natuh-e.
target: When I said, “My foot is slipping,” your unfailing love, Lord , supported me.

source: Kasunga lungkhamna tamtah kaneilai chun, nalhamona-in kahinna akipasah-in ahi.
target: When anxiety was great within me, your consolation brought me joy.

source: Danthu-a phatlouna semdohji khan gitlouna laltouna chun, nangma toh kiloikhomna neijin tem?
target: Can a corrupt throne be allied with you— a throne that brings on misery by its decrees?

source: Michonpha hinna douna-in akikhom khomun, monabei thisan chu themo achanuvin ahi.
target: The wicked band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.

source: Amavang Pakai chu eihong bitna ahin, chuleh ka Pathen chu kakiselna songpi ahi.
target: But the Lord has become my fortress, and my God the rock in whom I take refuge.

source: Chule aman akhan gitlounao chu amahotah chunga alhutna, chule agitlou naova chu asuh manghel diu ahi: henge, Pakai i-Pathen'un asuh manghel diu ahi.
target: He will repay them for their sins and destroy them for their wickedness; the Lord our God will destroy them.

source: Hungun, Pakai henga la saote, eihuh hingpao songpi henga kipana awthong tah-in samu hite.
target: Come, let us sing for joy to the Lord ; let us shout aloud to the Rock of our salvation.

source: Thangvah tothon a-angsunga hungu hitin, kipana aw thongin la saohite.
target: Let us come before him with thanksgiving and extol him with music and song.

source: Ajehchu Pakai chu Pathen lentah ahin, pathen jouse chunga leng lenpen ahi.
target: For the Lord is the great God, the great King above all gods.

source: Leiset mun thuhtah ho chu akhutna um ahin, lhangho thaneina jong ama-a ahi.
target: In his hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to him.

source: Twipihi ama-a ahin chule asemsa ahin; chule tolgo chu akhutna asuhtoh ahi.
target: The sea is his, for he made it, and his hands formed the dry land.

source: O hunguvin, ama houvin kun-u hitin; eisempao Pakai anga dilsu-u hite.
target: Come, let us bow down in worship, let us kneel before the Lord our Maker;

source: Ama i-Pathen'u ahin, eiho aganlhatna mun'a amitele akhutna kelngoite ihiuve. Tunia a-awgin najah uva ahile;
target: for he is our God and we are the people of his pasture, the flock under his care. Today, if only you would hear his voice,

source: Lunghansahna-a bangle, gamthipma kipatep ni-a bang chun nalungu tahsah hih-un.
target: “Do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, as you did that day at Massah in the wilderness,

source: Hichelai chun napu napateu vin eipatepmun, eiphochenun, kathilbolho amutaove.
target: where your ancestors tested me; they tried me, though they had seen what I did.

source: Kum somli jen hiche nam mite chunga kana lungkhamin, alungthim uva lungdihlou gela mite ahiuvin, kalampi ahepouve, kanatin ahi.
target: For forty years I was angry with that generation; I said, ‘They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known my ways.’

source: Hijeh chun amaho kacholngah na-a lutloudiu ahi, tia kalunghan na-a kana hahsel ahitaove.
target: So I declared on oath in my anger, ‘They shall never enter my rest.’ ”

source: Pakaiya lathah khat saovin, leiset pumpin Pakai henga la saovin.
target: Sing to the Lord a new song; sing to the Lord , all the earth.

source: Pakai henga la saovin, amin choi annun, ani anin ahuhhingna phongdoh-un.
target: Sing to the Lord , praise his name; proclaim his salvation day after day.

source: Pathen hephalouho lah-a aloupi, mijouse lah-a thilkidang ho phongdoh-un.
target: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous deeds among all peoples.

source: Ajehchu Pakai chu aloupi-in, loupitah-a vahchoi ding ahi; pathen jouse chungvuma ja ding ahi.
target: For great is the Lord and most worthy of praise; he is to be feared above all gods.

source: Ajehchu namtinho pathen jouse chu milim semthu ahin; ahinla Pakaiyin vanho asemin ahi.
target: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but the Lord made the heavens.

source: Amasanga janale lalna aumin, amuntheng sunga hatnale hoina aume.
target: Splendor and majesty are before him; strength and glory are in his sanctuary.

source: Vo nangho phungtina miten Pakaiya peuvinlang, Pakai henga loupina le hatna peuvin.
target: Ascribe to the Lord , all you families of nations, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.

source: Pakai chu achandia lom amin loupi chu peuvinlang, thilto hinchoijun lang, ahong sunga hunglut uvin.
target: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; bring an offering and come into his courts.

source: O, Pakai chu thenna le hoina-in houvun, leiset pumpi amasanga kichauvin.
target: Worship the Lord in the splendor of his holiness; tremble before him, all the earth.

source: Pathen hephalouho lah-a chun Pakaiyin lengvai apoi tiuvin, vannoi leiset jong akilin louna dinga kiphutdet ding ahin, aman chonphatna-a mitin thu atanding ahi, tiuvin.
target: Say among the nations, “The Lord reigns.” The world is firmly established, it cannot be moved; he will judge the peoples with equity.

source: Vanho kipah uhen, leiset jong thanom hen, twipi le asunga umjouse aodoh uhen.
target: Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let the sea resound, and all that is in it.

source: Loujao le asunga um jouse kipah uhen, chuteng gammanga thingphung jouse jong Pakai masanga thanom diu ahi.
target: Let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them; let all the trees of the forest sing for joy.

source: Ajehchu ama ahunge, amachu leiset thutan dinga hung ahi; aman vannoi chonphatna-a thu atanding chule mitin athudih na-a atanding ahi.
target: Let all creation rejoice before the Lord , for he comes, he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in his faithfulness.

source: Pakaiyin lengvai apotai, leiset thanom hen, twikol gamho jouse kipah uhen.
target: The Lord reigns, let the earth be glad; let the distant shores rejoice.

source: Meilhangle muthimin aumkimvelin; chonphatna le thutandih chu alaltouna kibulphuna ahi.
target: Clouds and thick darkness surround him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

source: Amasanga meikong ache-in, chule akimvela amelmate akavamtai.
target: Fire goes before him and consumes his foes on every side.

source: Akolphehon vannoi asalvah-in, leiset hin amun, akithing thinguve.
target: His lightning lights up the world; the earth sees and trembles.

source: Leiset pumpi Pakai anga, Pakai anga chun, lhangho chu khoilu bangin ajol lhan ahi.
target: The mountains melt like wax before the Lord , before the Lord of all the earth.

source: Vanhon achonphatna aphong doh-un, chule mijousen aloupina amuvin ahi.
target: The heavens proclaim his righteousness, and all peoples see his glory.

source: Alim semthu jenjouse le milima kison na nejouse lungdonguhen, nangho pathen jousen, Ama houvun.
target: All who worship images are put to shame, those who boast in idols— worship him, all you gods!

source: Zion'in ajan akipah-in, chule vo Pakai nathutanlhah jeh-in Judah chanute athanomuve.
target: Zion hears and rejoices and the villages of Judah are glad because of your judgments, Lord .

source: Ajehchu Pakai, nangma leiset pumpi chunga chungnung pen nahin; pathen jouse chunga choisanga um nahi.
target: For you, Lord , are the Most High over all the earth; you are exalted far above all gods.

source: Pakai ngailu-a nanghon thilse hotbolun, aman amithengte hinna akheh doh-in, amaho chu migilouho khutna konin ahuhdoh-in ahi.
target: Let those who love the Lord hate evil, for he guards the lives of his faithful ones and delivers them from the hand of the wicked.

source: Michonphate din kho ahungvah tan, milungdihho din kipana ahunglhung tai.
target: Light shines on the righteous and joy on the upright in heart.

source: Michonpha ho Pakaiya kipah-un, chule athenna hetjingna-in ama-a thangvahna peuvin.
target: Rejoice in the Lord , you who are righteous, and praise his holy name.

source: Oh, Pakai vahchoinan lathah saovin, ajehchu aman thilkidang tah aboltai; akhut jetlam le abantheng chun jona achansah tai.
target: Sing to the Lord a new song, for he has done marvelous things; his right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.

source: Pakaiyin ami huhhing na chu ahetsahtan; Pathen hephalouho mitmun achonphatna chu phongtah-in amusahtai.
target: The Lord has made his salvation known and revealed his righteousness to the nations.

source: Israel insung chunga amihepina le athutah chu ageldohtan; i-Pathen'u mihuhhing na chu leiset kolmong geija mijousen amusoh taovin ahi.
target: He has remembered his love and his faithfulness to Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

source: Leiset pumpin Pakaiya kipana aw thonsah-un, aw gingtah-in sam unlang, kipah-un, chule vahchoi La saovin.
target: Shout for joy to the Lord , all the earth, burst into jubilant song with music;

source: Selangdah tothon Pakaiya la saovin, selangdahle vahchoi awgin thouvin.
target: make music to the Lord with the harp, with the harp and the sound of singing,

source: Sumkon binei le pengkulto thon lengpa, Pakai anga chun kipana aw thonsah un.
target: with trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn— shout for joy before the Lord , the King.

source: Twipi le asunga umjouse, vannoi leisetle asunga cheng jouse aodoh uhen.
target: Let the sea resound, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.

source: Twisoh hon akhutnu benguhen, lhangho jouse thakhatnin Pakai masanga kipah uhen.
target: Let the rivers clap their hands, let the mountains sing together for joy;

source: Ajehchu ama leiset thutanna hungding ahin; chonphatna a vannoi chule khanggilou mite thu atanding ahi.
target: let them sing before the Lord , for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples with equity.

source: Pakaiyin lengvai apotai: Mitin kihot lhu hen, ama Cherub ho kah-a atouve; leiset kilinghen.
target: The Lord reigns, let the nations tremble; he sits enthroned between the cherubim, let the earth shake.

source: Pakai chu Zion'a aloupin, chule mijouse chunga chungnung pen ahi.
target: Great is the Lord in Zion; he is exalted over all the nations.

source: Namin loupile gimneitah chu vahchoi uhen, ijeh inem itile hichu atheng ahi.
target: Let them praise your great and awesome name— he is holy.

source: Lengpa thahatna jongchun thutanlhahna angailun, nangin adih chu naphut doh-in, Jacob henga chonphat na-in thutanna naboldoh-e.
target: The King is mighty, he loves justice— you have established equity; in Jacob you have done what is just and right.

source: Nanghon Pakai i-Pathen'u chu choi-an nun, chule akhophang bulla houvun; ijeh inem itile ama athengin ahi.
target: Exalt the Lord our God and worship at his footstool; he is holy.

source: Athempuho lah-a Mosi le Aaron apangin, chule aman amina akouho lah-a Samuel apangin ahi; amahon Pakai akouvun, chule aman amaho chu adonbutnin ahi.
target: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who called on his name; they called on the Lord and he answered them.

source: Meibang khompi-a konin ahenguva thu anaseijin, ahettoh sahho le ahoudan thuho amaho anapeh chu achingtupmun ahi.
target: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept his statutes and the decrees he gave them.

source: Vo Pakai ka Pathen nu, nangin amaho nana donbutnin; atohkhelnao chunga phu anala jongle chun, nangma amaho ngaidampa Pathen chu nahi.
target: Lord our God, you answered them; you were to Israel a forgiving God, though you punished their misdeeds.

source: Pakai i-Pathen'u chu choi-an nun, chule alhang thenga chun ama houvun, ajehchu Pakai i-Pathen'u chu athengin ahi.
target: Exalt the Lord our God and worship at his holy mountain, for the Lord our God is holy.

source: Nangho gamjousen, Pakaiya kipa awgin thonsah-un,
target: Shout for joy to the Lord , all the earth.

source: Kipahtah-in Pakai chu jennun, lasahto thon amasanga hunguvin.
target: Worship the Lord with gladness; come before him with joyful songs.

source: Nanghon Pakai chu Pathen ahi ti heuvin, einasem uva chu ama ahin, eiho eiho-a tum ihipouve; eiho ama mitele ahamhing mun'a akelngoite chu ihiuve.
target: Know that the Lord is God. It is he who made us, and we are his; we are his people, the sheep of his pasture.

source: Thangvah pumin akotpi sunga lutnun, chule vahchoi pumin ahongsunga lutnuvin, ama thangvah unlang, amin vahchoijun.
target: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name.

source: Ajehchu Pakai chu aphan, ahepina chu a-imatih chana umjing ahin; chule akitahna chu khangjouse geija umding ahi.
target: For the Lord is good and his love endures forever; his faithfulness continues through all generations.

source: Hepinale thutanlhahna chu lan sange, Vo Pakai naheng-ah la sange.
target: I will sing of your love and justice; to you, Lord , I will sing praise.

source: Chamkimna lampia chingthei tah-in chon ingting; O itihle kahenga nahung ding ham? ka-insunga lungthim phachamkim in choninge.
target: I will be careful to lead a blameless life— when will you come to me? I will conduct the affairs of my house with a blameless heart.

source: Thil gilou poupou kamitmun koiponge; vahkoiho thilbol chu kahon, hichu keija umlou ding ahi.
target: I will not look with approval on anything that is vile. I hate what faithless people do; I will have no part in it.

source: Lung gitlouna keija kona kiheimang ding; keiman khang gilou kahet louding ahi.
target: The perverse of heart shall be far from me; I will have nothing to do with what is evil.

source: Aheng akom guhthima seise-a chu kasuhmang ding; mi kiletsah le hoitho lungpu chu kathohthei louding ahi.
target: Whoever slanders their neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; whoever has haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not tolerate.

source: Keimatoh kachen khom theina dinguva, tahsan gamchu ngailutna mitna kavet ding; chamkimna lampia chepa chun, keima eijending ahi.
target: My eyes will be on the faithful in the land, that they may dwell with me; the one whose walk is blameless will minister to me.

source: Lheplhahna thilbolla chu ka insunga chenglouding; jousei jong kamitmu-a umlou ding ahi.
target: No one who practices deceit will dwell in my house; no one who speaks falsely will stand in my presence.

source: Thilgilou bolho jouse Pakai khopi-a kona kasuhmang theina dinga, gamsung migilouho jouse kasuhmang loiding ahi.
target: Every morning I will put to silence all the wicked in the land; I will cut off every evildoer from the city of the Lord .

source: Vo Pakai kataona ngaijin lang, kakouna naheng hunglhung hen.
target: Hear my prayer, Lord ; let my cry for help come to you.

source: Kalungkham nileh keija konin namai selmang danlang, keilam ngan nana hinsungin, nangma kakou nileh neidonbut loijin.
target: Do not hide your face from me when I am in distress. Turn your ear to me; when I call, answer me quickly.

source: Ajehchu kahin nikhoho hi meikhu bangin akitol mangin, chule kaguhohi thuhsunga mei bangin akan ahi.
target: For my days vanish like smoke; my bones burn like glowing embers.

source: Kalunghi agentheijin hampa bangin agolhatan, ka changlhah nehding kasuhmil lotan ahi.
target: My heart is blighted and withered like grass; I forget to eat my food.

source: Kahimsat husa gin jeh-in, kaguho jong kavunna abehchah gamtai.
target: In my distress I groan aloud and am reduced to skin and bones.

source: Keima gamthipma vamuhsao bang kahitan nelgama sumbupi bang kahitai.
target: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.

source: Kahah jingin, intingvuma pelpa changlhat bangbep kahitai.
target: I lie awake; I have become like a bird alone on a roof.

source: Kamelma ten eihouse nilhum jiuvin, chule kachunga kingolsah ho keima dounan akihahsel jiuvin ahi.
target: All day long my enemies taunt me; those who rail against me use my name as a curse.

source: Ajehchu vut hi changlhah bangin kanejin, chule kadon ding chu ka-na toh kachoh haljin,
target: For I eat ashes as my food and mingle my drink with tears

source: hichu nalung nopmo le nalunghan jeh ahi; ajehchu nangin neidom sangin chule neiseplhan ahi.
target: because of your great wrath, for you have taken me up and thrown me aside.

source: Kanikhoho jong le-lim kiheimang bep ahin, chule hampa bangin kagopjitai.
target: My days are like the evening shadow; I wither away like grass.

source: Ahinla Vo Pakai nangvang a-imatih chana umding nahin, chule nangma khang jouse-a kigeldoh jingding nahi.
target: But you, Lord , sit enthroned forever; your renown endures through all generations.

source: Nangma thouvinnatin, Zion chunga hepina nanei ding; ajehchu ama lungsetna phat, henge, phat kitepsa chu ahunglhung tai.
target: You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show favor to her; the appointed time has come.

source: Ajehchu nasohte amanu songho-a chun alunglhaijun, chule chua leivui chu akhohsah-un ahi.
target: For her stones are dear to your servants; her very dust moves them to pity.

source: Chutia chu Pathen hephalouhon Pakai min chu agin diu, chule leiset lengho jousen naloupina chu agindiu ahi.
target: The nations will fear the name of the Lord , all the kings of the earth will revere your glory.

source: Pakaiyin Zion asahdoh tengle, aloupi na-a hungkilah ding ahi.
target: For the Lord will rebuild Zion and appear in his glory.

source: Aman milengvai ho taona angai ding, chule ataonao ngaisah louva akoi louding ahi.
target: He will respond to the prayer of the destitute; he will not despise their plea.

source: Hichehi khangkitna dinga kisun ding; chule ahung kisem ding miho chun Pakai chu avahchoidiu ahi.
target: Let this be written for a future generation, that a people not yet created may praise the Lord :

source: Ajehchu aman amuntheng sanga konin ahin vesuh-in, Pakaiyin van'a konin leihi ahinmui;
target: “The Lord looked down from his sanctuary on high, from heaven he viewed the earth,

source: Sohchangho himsatna ngaidingle, thidinga thu kitepsaho lhadohnadin;
target: to hear the groans of the prisoners and release those condemned to death.”

source: Zion'a Pakai min le Jerusalem'a ama pachatna chu phondohna dingin;
target: So the name of the Lord will be declared in Zion and his praise in Jerusalem

source: Lenggam ho le mitin Pakai jenna dinga akikhopkhom tenguleh, hichu hiding ahi.
target: when the peoples and the kingdoms assemble to worship the Lord .

source: Aman lamdunga kahatna asudoijin, kanikhoho asuchomin ahi.
target: In the course of my life he broke my strength; he cut short my days.

source: Keiman, Vo ka Pathen, kahinna akimtuh in neilamang hih-in, nangma kumho chu khang jouse lhumkeija uma ahi, kati.
target: So I said: “Do not take me away, my God, in the midst of my days; your years go on through all generations.

source: Leiset bul kingapna chu malaija nakoisa ahitan, chule vanho jong nakhutsoh ahi.
target: In the beginning you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.

source: Amaho mangthah diu ahin, ahinla nangvang umjing ding nahi, henge, amaho ponlui banga sesohdiu, von banga nangin amaho nakhela, chutia chu amaho kikheldiu ahitai.
target: They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing you will change them and they will be discarded.

source: Ahinla nangvang angai nahi jingin, nakumin jong kichaitih aneilouding ahi.
target: But you remain the same, and your years will never end.

source: Nasohte chateho chu umjing uva, chule achilhahteu chu namasanga kitungdoh diu ahi.
target: The children of your servants will live in your presence; their descendants will be established before you.”

source: Vo kalhagao, Pakai chu choi-an nin, chule kasunga umjousen amintheng choi-an nun.
target: Praise the Lord , my soul; all my inmost being, praise his holy name.

source: Vo kalhagao Pakai chu choi-an nin, chule aphatchom naho jouse sumil hih-in.
target: Praise the Lord , my soul, and forget not all his benefits—

source: Nakhan gitlouna jouse ngaidama, nanatna jouse damsah-a,
target: who forgives all your sins and heals all your diseases,

source: Nahinkho manthah na-a kona lhatdoh-a, ngailut phatna le hepina lal lukhuh banga nakhuh peh-a,
target: who redeems your life from the pit and crowns you with love and compassion,

source: Nakhang donlai muvanlai banga semthah ahina dinga, thilphaho-a nakamsung lunglhaisahpa chu ahi.
target: who satisfies your desires with good things so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

source: Pakaiyin chonphatna atah langin, suhgentheija umho jouse dingin thu adih-in atan peh-e.
target: The Lord works righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.

source: Aman alampiho Mosi henga ahetsah-in, anatohho Israel chate ahetsah-in ahi.
target: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the people of Israel:

source: Pakai chu hepina le lungsetna-a dim, lunghangvah lou chule ngailutna-a dimset ahi.
target: The Lord is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in love.

source: Aman phatjousen eiho eiphohjing pouvintin; chujongle a-itih in alunghana chingjing ponte.
target: He will not always accuse, nor will he harbor his anger forever;

source: Aman ichonsetnao bangin eibol pouvin, chujongle ikhan gitlounao dungjuijin jong eilethuh pouve.
target: he does not treat us as our sins deserve or repay us according to our iniquities.

source: Ajehchu leisanga van asan banga, ama gingte chunga ahepina chubanga chu lena ahi.
target: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is his love for those who fear him;

source: Solam le lhumlam akigamlat banga, hichan gamla-a chu ikhan gitlounao eihoa kona achonmang ahitai.
target: as far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

source: Mipan achate akhoto banga, Pakaiyin ama gingte akhoto ahi.
target: As a father has compassion on his children, so the Lord has compassion on those who fear him;

source: Ajehchu aman ikisuhto dannu ahen, eiho leivuibou ihiu aman ageldoh jingin ahi.
target: for he knows how we are formed, he remembers that we are dust.

source: Mihem vang, anikhoho chu hampa bangbou; jaova pahcha bangbep bou ahin, hitichun ahung khangin ahi.
target: The life of mortals is like grass, they flourish like a flower of the field;

source: Ajehchu huijin achung ahin mutle amang gamin, chule aumna mun chun ahepha ji tapoi.
target: the wind blows over it and it is gone, and its place remembers it no more.

source: Ahinla Pakai hepina chu ama gingte chunga atonsot atonsot geija umding, chule achonphatna jong achateu chateho geija;
target: But from everlasting to everlasting the Lord ’s love is with those who fear him, and his righteousness with their children’s children—

source: Akitepna chingtupma, chule athupehho juidinga geldoh jingho chunga umding ahi.
target: with those who keep his covenant and remember to obey his precepts.

source: Pakaiyin van ho-a alaltouna atungdoh-in, aleng gamin imajouse chunga vai apoi.
target: The Lord has established his throne in heaven, and his kingdom rules over all.

source: Nangho thahat chungnung nei, athupehho bola, a-thu ngaija avantil hon, Pakai chu vahchoijun.
target: Praise the Lord , you his angels, you mighty ones who do his bidding, who obey his word.

source: Nangho ama janel ho, ama lhachaho, ama lunglhaina bolho jousen, Pakai chu vahchoijun.
target: Praise the Lord , all his heavenly hosts, you his servants who do his will.

source: A vaihomna muntina athilbolho jousen, Pakai vahchoijun. Vo kalhagao Pakai chu vahchoijin.
target: Praise the Lord , all his works everywhere in his dominion. Praise the Lord , my soul.

source: Vo kahinna, Pakai chu vahchoijin. Vo Pakai ka Pathen, naloupi lheh jengin, janale loupina-in nakijeme.
target: Praise the Lord , my soul. Lord my God, you are very great; you are clothed with splendor and majesty.

source: Vanho pondal banga kaijal pan, khovah chu ponsil bangin naki sile.
target: The Lord wraps himself in light as with a garment; he stretches out the heavens like a tent

source: A-in danho-a inkamho chu twilah-a ajama, meilhang ho kangtalai jin akiseme, hui lhavingho chunga vahle pa.
target: and lays the beams of his upper chambers on their waters. He makes the clouds his chariot and rides on the wings of the wind.

source: Avantilho lhagaoho sempa, alhachate jong meikong sosah jipa.
target: He makes winds his messengers, flames of fire his servants.

source: Nangma tonsotna akichon lounadinga, leiset bulho anaphut detpa.
target: He set the earth on its foundations; it can never be moved.

source: Nangman hichu thutah-in ponsil bangin nakhu khumin, twiho chu molsangho vuma akiting uve.
target: You covered it with the watery depths as with a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.

source: Nangman naphoh-in ahile amaho ajamun, na van ginho-a amaho ajammang loiji taove.
target: But at your rebuke the waters fled, at the sound of your thunder they took to flight;

source: Amaho molsang ho-a akaltouvun, amaho dinga nagonpeh namun, phaicham ho-a chun achesuh jiuvin ahi.
target: they flowed over the mountains, they went down into the valleys, to the place you assigned for them.

source: Leiset chupdinga ahungkile louna diuvin, ahin khelthei loudiu gamgi nasempeh-in ahi.
target: You set a boundary they cannot cross; never again will they cover the earth.

source: Aman lhang ho-a twisam longho chu, phaicham lama asolin ahi.
target: He makes springs pour water into the ravines; it flows between the mountains.

source: Hicheho chun gama saho jouse donding apeuvin; gam sangan dangchah hon dangnou nan aneijuve.
target: They give water to all the beasts of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.

source: Apang chu chungleng vachaten chenna-in aneijun, thingbah holah-a chun la saove.
target: The birds of the sky nest by the waters; they sing among the branches.

source: Aman a-in danho-a konin lhangho achapnouvin, leiset hi nanatoh ga ho-a alunglhai uve.
target: He waters the mountains from his upper chambers; the land is satisfied by the fruit of his work.

source: Aman leisetna kona nehding akondoh nadingin; ganchaho dingin hampa akedoh sah-in, chule mihem neh dingin anche akesah-in;
target: He makes grass grow for the cattle, and plants for people to cultivate— bringing forth food from the earth:

source: chule mihem lung kipasah lengpitwi, chule amaivahna ding thao, chule mihem lungthim hatsah-a changlhah jong ahinsodoh sah-in ahi.
target: wine that gladdens human hearts, oil to make their faces shine, and bread that sustains their hearts.

source: Aman Lebanon'a Cedar thing aphuho; Pakai thingphung ho chu twi akichap nou jinge;
target: The trees of the Lord are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon that he planted.

source: Hia chun vachaten bu asaovin, twiva dingin vang chahthinglah chu a-in ahi.
target: There the birds make their nests; the stork has its home in the junipers.

source: Lhangsang ho chu gamkelcha ho ding ahin, jupi ho dingin songpiho chu kiselna ahi.
target: The high mountains belong to the wild goats; the crags are a refuge for the hyrax.

source: Phatbih hetnading lhathah aumsah-in, nisan alhum phat akihetne.
target: He made the moon to mark the seasons, and the sun knows when to go down.

source: Muthim nasemin hichu jan ahin, hia chun gammanga sajouse ahung kitholdoh jiuve.
target: You bring darkness, it becomes night, and all the beasts of the forest prowl.

source: Keipi donglaihon asamat dingu akitum khumun, Pathen'a konin anehdiu akiholuve.
target: The lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.

source: Nisa asoteng akikhom khomun, akulsung cheh uva akolji taove.
target: The sun rises, and they steal away; they return and lie down in their dens.

source: Miho chu natong dingin akon doh-un, nilhah kahsen na atong jiuvin ahi.
target: Then people go out to their work, to their labor until evening.

source: Vo Pakai nathilsem hohi iti tamma tam hitam! abonchauva chihna-a nasem ahin, leiset hi nahaona-a dimset ahi.
target: How many are your works, Lord ! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.

source: Chutia chu hiche twikhanglen lentahle jaotah hi uma, asunga akithol thoho simjoulou uma, ganhing alen le aneo agoma uma ahi.
target: There is the sea, vast and spacious, teeming with creatures beyond number— living things both large and small.

source: Hia chun kong innei akitolin, chuche sunga kichem dinga nangin nasem Leviathan chu aume.
target: There the ships go to and fro, and Leviathan, which you formed to frolic there.

source: Hicheho jousen aphatcha a-an'u napeh theinadin, nangahcheh uvin ahi.
target: All creatures look to you to give them their food at the proper time.

source: Napeh ho chu amahon akhom tupmun, nakhut najalin neh tuitah-in avaset uve.
target: When you give it to them, they gather it up; when you open your hand, they are satisfied with good things.

source: Namai naselin alungkham jiuvin, ahaitheinau na lahmang peh-in, athi jiuvin chule leivuijin akileji taove.
target: When you hide your face, they are terrified; when you take away their breath, they die and return to the dust.

source: Nalhagao nasoldoh-in amaho akisem doh jiuvin, chule leiset chunghi nasemthah kitjin ahi.
target: When you send your Spirit, they are created, and you renew the face of the ground.

source: Pakai loupina chu tonsotnin umintin, Pakai chu athil bolho-a kipahding ahi.
target: May the glory of the Lord endure forever; may the Lord rejoice in his works—

source: Aman leiset chung aven ahile akihot jengin; lhangho atongkhan ahile mei akhun ahi.
target: he who looks at the earth, and it trembles, who touches the mountains, and they smoke.

source: Kahinlaisen Pakai henga la sangting, kahinpet nin ka Pathen vahchoi la sange.
target: I will sing to the Lord all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.

source: Ama chung chang kangaito nahi ahenga lhumin tin, Pakaiya kipahding kahi.
target: May my meditation be pleasing to him, as I rejoice in the Lord .

source: Michonse ho chu leija konin suh mangin umhen, chule migilou ho umkit tahih uhen. Vo kahinna, Pakai chu choi-anin. Vahchoijun Pakai chu.
target: But may sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Praise the Lord , my soul. Praise the Lord .

source: Pakai henga thangvahna peuvin! aminin taovun; mihemte lah-a athilbol hetsah-un.
target: Give praise to the Lord , proclaim his name; make known among the nations what he has done.

source: Ahenga la saovin, Ahenga vahchoi La saovin, athilkidang bol ho jouse thu kihoulimun.
target: Sing to him, sing praise to him; tell of all his wonderful acts.

source: Amintheng chu loupihen, Pakai holho lungsung kipahhen.
target: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice.

source: Pakai le ahatna holunlang, tanglouvin amai chu holjingun.
target: Look to the Lord and his strength; seek his face always.

source: Akamsung thutan lhahho, athil kidangho, atohsa anatoh kidangho geldoh-un,
target: Remember the wonders he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he pronounced,

source: Vo nangho Abraham chilhah asohte, alhentum nangho Jacob chaten sumil hih-un.
target: you his servants, the descendants of Abraham, his chosen ones, the children of Jacob.

source: Amachu Pakai i-Pathen'u ahin, athutan lhahho chu leichung jouse-a aumme.
target: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

source: Atonsotnin akitepna ageldoh jingin, kum asang asang dinga aman anatep ahitan ahi.
target: He remembers his covenant forever, the promise he made, for a thousand generations,

source: Abraham toh asem kitepna, chule Isaac henga akitepna;
target: the covenant he made with Abraham, the oath he swore to Isaac.

source: Chule hiche mama chu Jacob dinga danthua din, Israel henga tonsot kitepna din asuhdetpehtan,
target: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:

source: Kanaan gamchu nachan ding gouva nahenga kapeh ding ahi ati;
target: “To you I will give the land of Canaan as the portion you will inherit.”

source: Amaho lhomcha bou anahiuvin; henge, lhomcha khat le khopem mi anahiuve.
target: When they were but few in number, few indeed, and strangers in it,

source: Amaho nam khatna kona nam khatna, lenggam khatna kona midang henga achele laijun,
target: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.

source: Koiman jouva aboldiu aphalpon, amaho jeh-in lengho aphohsaljin;
target: He allowed no one to oppress them; for their sake he rebuked kings:

source: Kathaonupa chu tongkha hih-un, chule kathemgao ho susehih-un, ati.
target: “Do not touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm.”

source: Achung chonin chuche gama chun kel alhahsah-in; changkung jouse amanthahsah soh heltan ahi.
target: He called down famine on the land and destroyed all their supplies of food;

source: Amasanguva mi khat asolmasan, sohdia kijoh-a Joseph chu ahin,
target: and he sent a man before them— Joseph, sold as a slave.

source: Akengho chu bullin asunaovin, thihkul sunga ahenun ahi.
target: They bruised his feet with shackles, his neck was put in irons,

source: Ama thu aguilhun kahsen, Pakai thu chun ama apatepmin ahi.
target: till what he foretold came to pass, till the word of the Lord proved him true.

source: Lengpan mi asolin alhadoh-in, miho vaihompatah chun agalha dohtai.
target: The king sent and released him, the ruler of peoples set him free.

source: Aman a-insung pakai jin apansah-in, chule aneijouse chunga vaihom din;
target: He made him master of his household, ruler over all he possessed,

source: Pipuiho chu anop nopma kan dingle, vaihomho chihna hil din apansah tai.
target: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.

source: Israel jong chu Egypt'a ahungtan, Jacob chu Ham gama ahung jintan ahi.
target: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob resided as a foreigner in the land of Ham.

source: Aman amite nasatah-in apunsah-in, amelmate sangin ahatsah jotai.
target: The Lord made his people very fruitful; he made them too numerous for their foes,

source: Asohte doha thuhtah-a abolna dingun, aman alungu chu amite hotbol din aheimangpeh tai.
target: whose hearts he turned to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

source: Aman asoh Mosi, chule amilhen Aaron chu anasolin ahi.
target: He sent Moses his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

source: Amanin amelchihnaho alah uva abol lhonin, chule thilkidang ho Ham gamsunga avetsah lhone.
target: They performed his signs among them, his wonders in the land of Ham.

source: Aman muthim asolin mu athimsahtan, chuin athu chu adou tapouvin ahi.
target: He sent darkness and made the land dark— for had they not rebelled against his words?

source: Aman atwi hou thisan asosah-in, anga hou athat gamtai.
target: He turned their waters into blood, causing their fish to die.

source: Agamu chun uphoh tamtah ahin pendoh sah-in, leng teho indan sung geijin adimtan ahi.
target: Their land teemed with frogs, which went up into the bedrooms of their rulers.

source: Thu aseile thousi jatchom chom tamtah ahungun, chule kha jong agamkol sungu ahung dimtan ahi.
target: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, and gnats throughout their country.

source: Aman amaho chu go khelin gel apen, chule agamuva meikou jengjung apen ahi.
target: He turned their rain into hail, with lightning throughout their land;

source: Aman alengpi guihoule atheichang phunghou jepna apen, agamkol sunguva thingphung ho amanthahsah gamheltai.
target: he struck down their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.

source: Aman thu aseile khaokhoho ahunguvin, khaokho noute simjoulou ahungdoh uvin,
target: He spoke, and the locusts came, grasshoppers without number;

source: Chuin agamsung uva hampa louhing jouse anejouvun, aleisetnu theiga jouse anechai taovin ahi.
target: they ate up every green thing in their land, ate up the produce of their soil.

source: Aman agamsung uva athahatna jouse bulpi, apengmasa jouse jongchu asumang heltan ahi.
target: Then he struck down all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their manhood.

source: Aman amaho sana le dangka pumin ahinpui doh-in, aphung sunguva chun achatmo khatcha aumpoi.
target: He brought out Israel, laden with silver and gold, and from among their tribes no one faltered.

source: Amaho apotdoh uva chun Egypt akipah-e; ajehchu amaho kichatna chu achunguva chu-ah ahitai.
target: Egypt was glad when they left, because dread of Israel had fallen on them.

source: Akhu diuvin meilhang apha jal-in, janteng asalvah diuvin meikong apen ahi.
target: He spread out a cloud as a covering, and a fire to give light at night.

source: Mipi hochun athumun, vengke ahinpen, van changlhah-in alungu alhaisah tai.
target: They asked, and he brought them quail; he fed them well with the bread of heaven.

source: Songpi ahonle, twi ahung kikhodoh-in, gamgo munho-a vadung lonin alongin ahi.
target: He opened the rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.

source: Ajehchu aman athutep thengtah le, asoh Abraham chu ageldoh jing ahi.
target: For he remembered his holy promise given to his servant Abraham.

source: Amite thanom tah-in ahin puidoh-in, chule amilhenho kipahtah-in apuidoh-e.
target: He brought out his people with rejoicing, his chosen ones with shouts of joy;

source: Aman Pathen hephalou te gam chu amaho apen; amahon chua miho tohdohsa chu alotauve;
target: he gave them the lands of the nations, and they fell heir to what others had toiled for—

source: Chutia chu amahon achondan kisemho ajuijuva, adan thupeh ho anit nadiuva apeh ahi. Pakai chu vahchoijun.
target: that they might keep his precepts and observe his laws. Praise the Lord .

source: Pakai chu vahchoijun. Oh, aphatna jeh-in Pakai chu thangvahna peuvin; ajehchu amihepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: Praise the Lord . Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.

source: Pakai natoh thahatna chu kon seithei jintem? Avahchoina jouse kon aphondoh jouding ham?
target: Who can proclaim the mighty acts of the Lord or fully declare his praise?

source: Thutandih tuhchah-a chule phat tinna chonphatna bolho chu anunnom ahiuve.
target: Blessed are those who act justly, who always do what is right.

source: O Pakai, namite chunga nanei lungsetna-a chun neigeldoh jingin, O nahuhhing nan neivilin,
target: Remember me, Lord , when you show favor to your people, come to my aid when you save them,

source: Chutile nami lhentumte hamphatna kamuthei ding, namite kipana-a kathanop thei ding, nagou chan toh kaloupi ding ahi.
target: that I may enjoy the prosperity of your chosen ones, that I may share in the joy of your nation and join your inheritance in giving praise.

source: Kapu kapateu toh kana chonseuvin, kana khang gilouvun, kana khanse taove.
target: We have sinned, even as our ancestors did; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.

source: Kapu kapa teuvin Egypt'a nathil kidangho ana hethei pouvin; nahepina tamtah chu ageldoh pouvin, amavang twipi le twipi san ngeija chun ama ana lungsat sah taovin ahi.
target: When our ancestors were in Egypt, they gave no thought to your miracles; they did not remember your many kindnesses, and they rebelled by the sea, the Red Sea.

source: Hijeng jongle athil boltheina loupitah chu hetdoh ahina din; amin jal-in amaho chu ana huhdoh-e.
target: Yet he saved them for his name’s sake, to make his mighty power known.

source: Twipisan jongchu apho-in ahile akang tan; chutichun amaho chu gamthip laija apui bangin, twi thuhtah-a chun apui galkai tai.
target: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; he led them through the depths as through a desert.

source: Ahotbolteu khutna konin ahuhdoh-in, melma khutna konin alhatdoh-in ahi.
target: He saved them from the hand of the foe; from the hand of the enemy he redeemed them.

source: Chuche twi chun amelmateu achupmin; khatcha asohcha aum pouve.
target: The waters covered their adversaries; not one of them survived.

source: Chujouvin athu chu atahsanun, ama vahchoi la asaove.
target: Then they believed his promises and sang his praise.

source: Anatohho asumil loijun; athumop chu angah tapouvin ahi.
target: But they soon forgot what he had done and did not wait for his plan to unfold.

source: Gamthipma chun tahsa ngaichatnin adimun, nelphaija chun Pathen apatep taovin ahi.
target: In the desert they gave in to their craving; in the wilderness they put God to the test.

source: Chuin athil thumu apen, ahivangin asunguvah gamna hise alansah in ahi.
target: So he gave them what they asked for, but sent a wasting disease among them.

source: Amahon gebuh sunga Mosi, chule Pakai mitheng Aaron jong chu athangset taovin ahileh;
target: In the camp they grew envious of Moses and of Aaron, who was consecrated to the Lord .

source: Leiset akhikeh-in Dathan aval lhumin, Abiram loiho akhukhum tai.
target: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it buried the company of Abiram.

source: Aloi lah uva mei ahung kadoh-in, meikong chun migilouho chu akalihtai.
target: Fire blazed among their followers; a flame consumed the wicked.

source: Amahon Horeb'a akilhajol bongnou lim asemun, alim semthu uchu ahou taove.
target: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped an idol cast from metal.

source: Chutobang chun aloupinao chu bongchal hampane bangbepmin akhel taovin ahi.
target: They exchanged their glorious God for an image of a bull, which eats grass.

source: Egypt'a thil loupitah tah bola Pathen, ahuhhingpao chu asumil taovin;
target: They forgot the God who saved them, who had done great things in Egypt,

source: Ham gama thilkidang tahtah le, twipisana kichat umtah bolpa chu asumil taovin ahi.
target: miracles in the land of Ham and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.

source: Hijeh chun mipi chu sumang khante tia alunghana heimang dinga alhentum Mosi chu amasanga chu akah uva ding louva hile, amaho chu sumang tange anati ahitai.
target: So he said he would destroy them— had not Moses, his chosen one, stood in the breach before him to keep his wrath from destroying them.

source: Henge, amahon gam nomtah chu i-sah louvin abulun, athu chu atahsan pouve.
target: Then they despised the pleasant land; they did not believe his promise.

source: Ahivangin apon in sunguva aphunchel uvin, Pakai aw chu angai pouvin ahi.
target: They grumbled in their tents and did not obey the Lord .

source: Hijeh chun gamthip laija amaho suhlhuhna dingin, amaho dounan akhut alam tan,
target: So he swore to them with uplifted hand that he would make them fall in the wilderness,

source: Achilhahteu jong namtin lah-a asuhlhuh nadingle, namtin lah-a athecheh nadinga akhut alap ahi.
target: make their descendants fall among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.

source: Amaho Peor mun'a baal lama abeh-un, athiho dinga ganlhaina kibol chu anetaove.
target: They yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods;

source: Chutichun anatohho uva chun ama aphinseuvin, chule achunguva hise alengtai.
target: they aroused the Lord ’s anger by their wicked deeds, and a plague broke out among them.

source: Chujouvin Phinehas adingdoh-in thu atantan; chuin hise chu atangtan ahi.
target: But Phinehas stood up and intervened, and the plague was checked.

source: Hichu ama dingin a-imatih chana khang jouse-a dingin chonphatna-a sim ahitai.
target: This was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.

source: Kinahna twiphunga jong chun alunghan sah-un, chutichun amaho jeh-in Mosi chunga thilse alhunlo helin;
target: By the waters of Meribah they angered the Lord , and trouble came to Moses because of them;

source: Alhagao aphinset jeh-un, akamin thilsetah anaseitan ahi.
target: for they rebelled against the Spirit of God, and rash words came from Moses’ lips.

source: Pakaiyin amaho thu apeh bangun, amahon namho chu anasumang pouve.
target: They did not destroy the peoples as the Lord had commanded them,

source: Ahivangin Pathen hephalouho toh akihalun, athil bolhou chu ajil jotaovin ahi.
target: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.

source: Chule amilimhou chu ajenun, hichu amaho dingin thang ahung hitai.
target: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.

source: Henge, amaho thilha henga achapateu le achanuteu chu ganlhai thilto dingin apedoh-un,
target: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to false gods.

source: monabei thisan, achapateule achanuteu thisantah chu asouvin, hicheho-a chun Canaan milimho henga akilhaijun; chuche gam chu thisana suhboh-in aumtan ahi.
target: They shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was desecrated by their blood.

source: Chutichun anatohtah uchun akisuboh-un, athil boldoh uva chun noti'n apang taovin ahi.
target: They defiled themselves by what they did; by their deeds they prostituted themselves.

source: Hichejeh-a chu Pakai lung hanna chu amite chunga meikou banga anakou doh-a, chubang tah-a agoulote tah chu athet ahitai.
target: Therefore the Lord was angry with his people and abhorred his inheritance.

source: Chuin amaho chu Pathen hephalouho khutna apedoh-in, ahotbolteu chun achunguva vai ahomtai.
target: He gave them into the hands of the nations, and their foes ruled over them.

source: Amelmateu jongchun asugentheijun, akhut noijuva suhnemin aum taovin ahi.
target: Their enemies oppressed them and subjected them to their power.

source: Amaho chu avel velin anahuhdoh-in, ahinla alung ngaitouvin alunghan sah-un, khangitlouna jeh-in suhnemin aumjiuve.
target: Many times he delivered them, but they were bent on rebellion and they wasted away in their sin.

source: Hijeng jongle aka-u ajah jiteng, ahesohnau akhohsah jin;
target: Yet he took note of their distress when he heard their cry;

source: Akitepna chu amahodin ageldohjin, ahepina hao dungjuijin alung aheijitai.
target: for their sake he remembered his covenant and out of his great love he relented.

source: Sohchanga akaihou jouse jong chun amaho akhotosah-un ahi.
target: He caused all who held them captive to show them mercy.

source: O Pakai ka Pathen'u, neihuhhing un, chule namin theng thangvah dingle navahchoi na-a galjou dingin, Pathen hephalouho lah-a konin neipui khom un.
target: Save us, Lord our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in your praise.

source: Pakai Israel Pathen chu tonsotnapat tonsot geijin vahchoijin umhen: chule mijousen, Amen, tiuhen. Pakai chu vahchoijun.
target: Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, “Amen!” Praise the Lord .

source: O aphatna jeh-in Pakai henga thangvahna peuvin, ajehchu ahepina a-imatih chanin aum jingin ahi.
target: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.

source: Melmaho khutna kona alhatdoh, Pakai lhatdamsaten hitichun seijuhen;
target: Let the redeemed of the Lord tell their story— those he redeemed from the hand of the foe,

source: chule gamtin solam le lhumlam, sahlam le lhanglama konin amaho kikhomuhen.
target: those he gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.

source: Amaho gamthip mi chekhah louna lampia avahleuvin, chenna ding khopi khatcha amu pouve.
target: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no way to a city where they could settle.

source: Gilkel le dang chah-in, asunguva ahinnao alhasamtai.
target: They were hungry and thirsty, and their lives ebbed away.

source: Chuphatnin Pakai henga lungkhamin ataovun, aman ahesoh naova konin anahuhdoh tai.
target: Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them from their distress.

source: Mi chenna khopi-a achetheina diuvin, lampi dih-a apuijin ahi.
target: He led them by a straight way to a city where they could settle.

source: Mihemte hin mihem chate henga, aphatna jehle athil kidang bolho jeh hin Pakai chu vahchoi taveleu, o!
target: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind,

source: Ajehchu aman lhagao ngaichat alunglhai sahjin, lhagao gilkel an pha phan avahvajin ahi.
target: for he satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.

source: Muthim le thina le-lima touva, suhgentheina le thihkhaova kihenho chu,
target: Some sat in darkness, in utter darkness, prisoners suffering in iron chains,

source: ajehchu amahon Pathen thu douna-a gol akeh-un, chungnung pen thuhil anahsah pouve.
target: because they rebelled against God’s commands and despised the plans of the Most High.

source: Hijeh chun alungu tohgimna-in ason kun-in, apanpidiu khatcha aumpon, alhasuh taovin ahi.
target: So he subjected them to bitter labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.

source: Chutengle lungkhamin Pakai henga apengun, aman ahesoh naova konin ahuhdoh jin ahi.
target: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.

source: Aman muthima konle thina lima konin apuidoh in, chule akihen nahou chu asuchip jin ahi.
target: He brought them out of darkness, the utter darkness, and broke away their chains.

source: Mihemte hin mihem chate henga, aphatna jehle athil kidang bolho jeh hin Pakai chu vahchoi taveleu, o!
target: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind,

source: Ajehchu aman sum-eng kotpiho aphusen, thih banggolho asatkhen tan ahi.
target: for he breaks down gates of bronze and cuts through bars of iron.

source: Mingol ho chu asuhkhel nao jehle, akhanset jeh uvin suhgentheijin aumuvin ahi.
target: Some became fools through their rebellious ways and suffered affliction because of their iniquities.

source: Ahin naovin an jatjouse atheuvin, chule thina kotpiho lam chu anai jiuvin ahi.
target: They loathed all food and drew near the gates of death.

source: Chutengle lungkhamin Pakai henga apengun, aman ahesoh naova konin ahuhdoh jin ahi.
target: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.

source: Ama thu asolin, amaho asudamjin, amanthah naova konin ahuhdoh jin ahi.
target: He sent out his word and healed them; he rescued them from the grave.

source: Mihemte hin mihem chate henga, aphatna jehle athil kidang bolho jeh hin Pakai chu vahchoi taveleu, o!
target: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind.

source: Amahon thangvahna ganlhaina-in ganlhaina neiju henlang, athilbolho chu thanom tah-in phongjal uhen.
target: Let them sacrifice thank offerings and tell of his works with songs of joy.

source: Twikhanglen lama kong inneija chesuh-a, twipi nasatah chunga sumkolvei ho,
target: Some went out on the sea in ships; they were merchants on the mighty waters.

source: Amahon Pakai thilbolho le, twi thuhtah sunga athilkidang bolho chu amuvin ahi.
target: They saw the works of the Lord , his wonderful deeds in the deep.

source: Ajehchu aman thu apeh leh huile go nasatah ahung kithojin, hichun twipi kinong chu adomsang jin ahi.
target: For he spoke and stirred up a tempest that lifted high the waves.

source: Hicheho chu van lama akinongtou jin, twi thuhtah-a akumsuh kitjin; ahinnao lungkham jeh-in ajunlha jitai.
target: They mounted up to the heavens and went down to the depths; in their peril their courage melted away.

source: Suhle tungin akipeijun, jukham bangin alon lele uvin, achihnao kichaina-a um ahitaove.
target: They reeled and staggered like drunkards; they were at their wits’ end.

source: Chutengle lungkhamin Pakai henga apengun, aman ahesoh naova konin ahuhdoh jin ahi.
target: Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble, and he brought them out of their distress.

source: Aman huile go athipsah-in, chutichun twipi kinongchu atangtan ahi.
target: He stilled the storm to a whisper; the waves of the sea were hushed.

source: Chuin athiptah jehchun akipah-un, chutichun adeinau kaimun geichun apui lhungtan ahi.
target: They were glad when it grew calm, and he guided them to their desired haven.

source: Mihemte hin mihem chate henga, aphatna jehle athil kidang bolho jeh hin Pakai chu vahchoi taveleu, o!
target: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind.

source: Amahon amachu mipi kikhom lah-a jong choisangu henlang, upaho kikhopna-a ama chu vahchoi uhen.
target: Let them exalt him in the assembly of the people and praise him in the council of the elders.

source: Aman vadungho gamthip asosah-in, twisamho tolgo asosah-in;
target: He turned rivers into a desert, flowing springs into thirsty ground,

source: Asunga chengho khangitlou jeh-in, gam phalai chu gamtem asosoh tan ahi.
target: and fruitful land into a salt waste, because of the wickedness of those who lived there.

source: Aman gamthip chu twikul asosah-in, tolgolai chu twinah putna asosah jin ahi.
target: He turned the desert into pools of water and the parched ground into flowing springs;

source: Chenna ding khopi akigon theina diuvin, chua chun gilkelho achensah-in;
target: there he brought the hungry to live, and they founded a city where they could settle.

source: Chule ga tamtah punsah dingin, lou aboluvin, chule lengpithei aphut uvin ahi.
target: They sowed fields and planted vineyards that yielded a fruitful harvest;

source: Amaho nasatah-a apuntheina dingun phatthei jong aboh-in, aganchahou akemsuhsah nompoi.
target: he blessed them, and their numbers greatly increased, and he did not let their herds diminish.

source: Avelin, amaho suhgentheina, hesohna, chule lungdona jeh-in, amuisuh tultulun suhnemin aumuve.
target: Then their numbers decreased, and they were humbled by oppression, calamity and sorrow;

source: Aman lengchapate chunga noisena abunglhan, lampi kamhel gamthipma avale sahtai.
target: he who pours contempt on nobles made them wander in a trackless waste.

source: Ahinla gentheiho chu hesohna-a konin munsanga akoijin, kelngoihon tobangin insung asempeh-in ahi.
target: But he lifted the needy out of their affliction and increased their families like flocks.

source: Michonpha hon hichu amu uva kipah diu, chule khan gitlouna jousen akam akihup diu ahi.
target: The upright see and rejoice, but all the wicked shut their mouths.

source: Michingho jousen hiche hohi anit dingu, chule Pakai mingailut khotona chu ahet dingu ahi.
target: Let the one who is wise heed these things and ponder the loving deeds of the Lord .

source: Vo Pathen, kalunghi adetne; keiman la sangting navahchoi jinge, kaloupina jengin jong.
target: My heart, O God, is steadfast; I will sing and make music with all my soul.

source: Tumging le selangdah ho khangun, keiman thingjangvah chu sukhang inge.
target: Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

source: O Pakai mipi lah-a nangma vahchoi jingting, namtin lah jenga jong nangma vahchoi la sange.
target: I will praise you, Lord , among the nations; I will sing of you among the peoples.

source: Ajehchu nahepina vanho sangin asangjon, nakitahna chun meibol holah aphan ahi.
target: For great is your love, higher than the heavens; your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

source: Pakai nangma vanho chungvuma choisangin umin; chule naloupina chu leiset pumpi chungvuma umhen.
target: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.

source: Nami ngailut ho chu huhdoh-a aumtheina dingin, nakhut jet lamin neihuhhing in lang, nei donbutnin.
target: Save us and help us with your right hand, that those you love may be delivered.

source: Keima kipah ingting, Shechem chu kahop khending, chule Succoth phaicham katedoh ding ahi, tin Pathen'in athenna-in anaseije.
target: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph I will parcel out Shechem and measure off the Valley of Sukkoth.

source: Gilead keija ahin, Manasseh jong keija ahi; Ephraim jonghi kalu thahatna ahin, Judah hi kadanthu pepa ahi;
target: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah is my scepter.

source: Moab kakisilna bel ahin, Edom chunga ka kengkoh kaselhah ding, Philistine chunga jona kanei ding ahi.
target: Moab is my washbasin, on Edom I toss my sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”

source: Khopi dettah-a koiham eipuilut dinga? Koijin Edom sunga eipuilut ding ham?
target: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

source: Vo Pathen, eipaidoh uva nang nahi hilou ham? Vo Pathen, kajanel houtoh nakondoh khom hilou ham?
target: Is it not you, God, you who have rejected us and no longer go out with our armies?

source: Lungkham na-a konin neipanpi uvin, ajehchu mihem panpina chu pannabei ahi.
target: Give us aid against the enemy, for human help is worthless.

source: Pathen jal-in hangtah-in pangu vinge, ajehchu kagalteo chotphading ama ahi.
target: With God we will gain the victory, and he will trample down our enemies.

source: Kavahchoi jing, vo Pathen, neithipsan hih-in;
target: My God, whom I praise, do not remain silent,

source: Ajehchu kei douna-in mi khang gilouhole mi lhemlha ho akamkaovin; aleijun keima dounan jou aseijun ahi.
target: for people who are wicked and deceitful have opened their mouths against me; they have spoken against me with lying tongues.

source: Amahon hotna thun eium kimvelun, ajeh beijin eikisat piuve.
target: With words of hatred they surround me; they attack me without cause.

source: Ajehchu kangailut amaho kamelman apangun, ahinla keima taona lama kakipen ahi.
target: In return for my friendship they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.

source: Amahon phatna chu setna-in, ngailutna chu hotnan eilethuh taovin ahi.
target: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my friendship.

source: Ama chunga mikhang gilou koijin lang, akhut jet lama Satan dinghen.
target: Appoint someone evil to oppose my enemy; let an accuser stand at his right hand.

source: Athu kitan tengle themmo chansah inlang, ataona chu chonset soh hen.
target: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayers condemn him.

source: Ahin nikho lhom henlang, anatohna mun midang changhen.
target: May his days be few; may another take his place of leadership.

source: Achate pabei hiuhenlang, ajinu meithai hihen.
target: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.

source: Achate chu tanglouva vahveile khutdo hiuhenlang, mun gohkeoho-a chun changlhah kihol uhen.
target: May his children be wandering beggars; may they be driven from their ruined homes.

source: Hunam thilchom hon aneijouse lahpeh hen, gamchom min atohgimga kichomhen.
target: May a creditor seize all he has; may strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.

source: Ahenga hepina musah koimacha umhih hen, pabei chate lainatpi ding jong umda hen.
target: May no one extend kindness to him or take pity on his fatherless children.

source: Aphattheina suhtanin umhen lang, khang hunglhung dinga aminu noimangin umhen.
target: May his descendants be cut off, their names blotted out from the next generation.

source: Apateu khan gitlouna Pakai anga geldoh-in umhen, chule anu chonset noimangin umhih hen.
target: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the Lord ; may the sin of his mother never be blotted out.

source: Leisetna kona amaho hetjingna asuhtan theina dingin, amaho Pakai anga umjomjing taohen.
target: May their sins always remain before the Lord , that he may blot out their name from the earth.

source: Ajehchu hepina musah ding geltah sangin, vaicha lhasam abol gentheijin, aman alunghesohho jong chu athatnin ahi.
target: For he never thought of doing a kindness, but hounded to death the poor and the needy and the brokenhearted.

source: Mi gaosap ding adeibang chun, hichu amachunga chuhen, phattheiboh adeilou bangin, hichu ama-a konin gamlahen.
target: He loved to pronounce a curse— may it come back on him. He found no pleasure in blessing— may it be far from him.

source: Ponsil banga gaosapna akivon ahin, chutichun hichu a-oi sunga twi bangin luthen, chule agu sunga thao bangin luthen.
target: He wore cursing as his garment; it entered into his body like water, into his bones like oil.

source: Hichu amadin akikhu khum ponsil bangin umhen lang, akigah jing konggah dingin umjing tahen.
target: May it be like a cloak wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.

source: Hichu Pakaiya kona kamelmate leh, kahinna douna-a thuse seiho lethuhna hihen.
target: May this be the Lord ’s payment to my accusers, to those who speak evil of me.

source: Ahinla vo Pakai Pathen, namin jal-in neibol peh-in, ajehchu nahepina aphat jeh-in neihuh doh-in.
target: But you, Sovereign Lord , help me for your name’s sake; out of the goodness of your love, deliver me.

source: Ajehchu keima vaichale lhasam kahin, kalung thim hi mavo-a uma ahitai.
target: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

source: Keima le-lim kiheimang banga chemanga kahitan; khaokhopi banga chungle noija kipeile kahitai.
target: I fade away like an evening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.

source: An ngol jal-in kakhup angoijin, kasa hin thaona apu tapoi.
target: My knees give way from fasting; my body is thin and gaunt.

source: Keima jengjong amaho i-sah louvin kaumtan; eiveovin alu eithinkhum jiuvin ahi.
target: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.

source: Vo Pakai ka Pathen, neipanpin, nami hepina dungjuijin neihuhhing in.
target: Help me, Lord my God; save me according to your unfailing love.

source: Hichehi nakhut ahi ti amahon ahet theijuva, Pakai, nangman nabol ahi, ti ahetna diu ahi.
target: Let them know that it is your hand, that you, Lord , have done it.

source: Amahon gaosap muhen, ahinla nangin phatthei boh-in, amaho ahungtho tengule, jahchao hen, ahinla nalhachapa kipahhen.
target: While they curse, may you bless; may those who attack me be put to shame, but may your servant rejoice.

source: Eidouho chu jachatna-in kivon henlang, sangkhol len ah bangin akisuhdong naova kikhu khumu hen.
target: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace and wrapped in shame as in a cloak.

source: Keiman kakamin Pakai chu nasatah-in vahchoi jinge, henge, mipi lah-a amachu ka vahchoi ding ahi.
target: With my mouth I will greatly extol the Lord ; in the great throng of worshipers I will praise him.

source: Ajehchu ahinna themmo chansahho-a kona huhdoh dinga, ama migenthei ho jetlama ding ding ahi.
target: For he stands at the right hand of the needy, to save their lives from those who would condemn them.

source: Pakaiyin ka Pakai hengah, namelmate nakeng chotpha-a kaneisah masangsen, kajetlama toujingin, ati.
target: The Lord says to my lord: “Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”

source: Pakai chun Zion'a kona nathahatna mol lhon chu ahinsolding ahi. Na melmate lah-a vaihomin.
target: The Lord will extend your mighty scepter from Zion, saying, “Rule in the midst of your enemies!”

source: Jingkah naobu-a kona thenna hoinaho-a, namite chu natha neina nikho-a kiphal tah-a kipedoh diu ahi, nangman nakhang donlai daitwi chu naneije.
target: Your troops will be willing on your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, your young men will come to you like dew from the morning’s womb.

source: Pakai chu akihahseltan, alung akhel kit louding ahi; Nangma Melchizedec banga tonsot thempu nahi.
target: The Lord has sworn and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek.”

source: Pakai nakhut jetna umchun, alunghan nikho leh lengho chu avoh lhuhding ahi.
target: The Lord is at your right hand; he will crush kings on the day of his wrath.

source: Aman Pathen hephalouho lah-a thu tan intin, munjouse chu thilonga adipsetna, gam tamtah luchangho chu amavoding ahi.
target: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead and crushing the rulers of the whole earth.

source: Aman lampi dunga vachadung twi adonding, hijeh-a chu aman luchang chu adopsang ding ahi.
target: He will drink from a brook along the way, and so he will lift his head high.

source: Pakai chu vahchoijun; Mi kitah ho kikhopnale mipi kikhomho lah-a, kalung pumpin Pakai chu vahchoi jinge.
target: Praise the Lord . I will extol the Lord with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

source: Pakai thilbolho chu alenin, chule akipah hon hihochu akholdoh sohkeijuve.
target: Great are the works of the Lord ; they are pondered by all who delight in them.

source: Athilbol chu ja umtahle loupitah ahin, achonphatna chu tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: Glorious and majestic are his deeds, and his righteousness endures forever.

source: Aman athil kidang bolho chu geldoh jing dingin asemin; Pakai chu lungset them le lainatna-a dimset ahi.
target: He has caused his wonders to be remembered; the Lord is gracious and compassionate.

source: Ama gingho anneh apejin, akitepna chu tonsotna ahet jingding ahi.
target: He provides food for those who fear him; he remembers his covenant forever.

source: Pathen hephalouho gouchu amaho apeh theinadin, anatoh thaneije amite amusahtai.
target: He has shown his people the power of his works, giving them the lands of other nations.

source: Akhutna anatohho thutah le thutandih ahin, athupeh jouse chu atahbeh ahi.
target: The works of his hands are faithful and just; all his precepts are trustworthy.

source: Hicheho chu tonsot atonsotna din dettah-in ading jingin, chuleh hicheho chu thutah le chondih na-a tohdoh-a um ahi.
target: They are established for ever and ever, enacted in faithfulness and uprightness.

source: Aman amite henga lhatdamna ahinsolin, akitepna chu tonsotnadin thupeh apen, amin chu atheng le ja um ahi.
target: He provided redemption for his people; he ordained his covenant forever— holy and awesome is his name.

source: Pakai ginhi chihna kipatna ahi; athupeh bolho jousen hetthemna phatah aneijun, ama thangvahna chu tonsotnin aumjinge.
target: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow his precepts have good understanding. To him belongs eternal praise.

source: Pakai chu vahchoijin umhen. Pakai ginga chule athupehho jouse-a kipah-a michu anunnom ahi.
target: Praise the Lord . Blessed are those who fear the Lord , who find great delight in his commands.

source: Leichunga achilhahte hung hatdiu, mikitah ho khang chu phattheiboh changding ahi.
target: Their children will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.

source: A-insunga neile gou le haona umding, achonphatna chu imatih chana umding ahi.
target: Wealth and riches are in their houses, and their righteousness endures forever.

source: Mikitah ho dingin muthim lah jenga jong kho avahjin; ama lungset them, milainatpina dimset le chonphatah ahi.
target: Even in darkness light dawns for the upright, for those who are gracious and compassionate and righteous.

source: Mipha chun mi asulunglhaijin, thilpha ahomin; chingtheitah-a akhosahdan akivetphat ding ahi.
target: Good will come to those who are generous and lend freely, who conduct their affairs with justice.

source: Tahbeh-a ama a-imatih chana longlou ding; michonpha chu atonsotna hetna umjing ding ahi.
target: Surely the righteous will never be shaken; they will be remembered forever.

source: Aman thuse akichat louhel ding; alung adetnin, Pakai atahsanin ahi.
target: They will have no fear of bad news; their hearts are steadfast, trusting in the Lord .

source: Alungthim kiphut detna ahin, amelmate chunga angaichat amukahse-a, ama kichalou ding ahi.
target: Their hearts are secure, they will have no fear; in the end they will look in triumph on their foes.

source: Aman athe jal-in, mivaichate apen, achonphatna chu a-imatih chana umjing ding; aki chu jabolna-a choisanga umding ahi.
target: They have freely scattered their gifts to the poor, their righteousness endures forever; their horn will be lifted high in honor.

source: Migilouvin hichu muntin lungkham ding, aha agela, junmang ding ahi; migilou ngaichat chu mangthah ding ahi.
target: The wicked will see and be vexed, they will gnash their teeth and waste away; the longings of the wicked will come to nothing.

source: Pakai chu vahchoijin umhen; Vo Pakai sohten vahchoijun, nanghon Pakai minchu vahchoijun.
target: Praise the Lord . Praise the Lord , you his servants; praise the name of the Lord .

source: Tua patnin tonsot geijin Pakai min chu nunnom hen.
target: Let the name of the Lord be praised, both now and forevermore.

source: Niso apat nilhum geijin Pakai min chu vahchoijin umhen.
target: From the rising of the sun to the place where it sets, the name of the Lord is to be praised.

source: Pakai chu namjouse chunga asangpen ahin, aloupina chu van ho jouse chungvuma uma ahi.
target: The Lord is exalted over all the nations, his glory above the heavens.

source: Chungsanga cheng Pakai i-Pathen'u tobang koi umma,
target: Who is like the Lord our God, the One who sits enthroned on high,

source: van'a leh leija thil umho vedinga, ama tobanga kineosah jeng koi umintem!
target: who stoops down to look on the heavens and the earth?

source: Leivuija konin mivaicha akaithouvin, alhasamho vutbol lah-a konin aphong dingin;
target: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap;

source: Chutia chu pipuiho toh, amite lah-a pipuiho ngeitoh atou khomsah thei nading ahi.
target: he seats them with princes, with the princes of his people.

source: Chate neija minu kipahtah bangin, aman numei ching chu in apen ahi. Pakai chu vahchoijin umhen.
target: He settles the childless woman in her home as a happy mother of children. Praise the Lord .

source: Egypt'a kona Israel ahungpot doh-u, chule paomah ho-a kona Jacob insung mite apotlai chun,
target: When Israel came out of Egypt, Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,

source: Judah chu amuntheng anahin, Israel chu alenggam anahi.
target: Judah became God’s sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

source: Twikhanglen'in hichu amun, ajam mangin, Jordan alelon kit tai.
target: The sea looked and fled, the Jordan turned back;

source: Molsangho chu kelngoichal bangin akichomun, lhangneohochu kelngoinou bangin akichomuvin ahi.
target: the mountains leaped like rams, the hills like lambs.

source: Vo nang twikhanglen, ipi nathohlela najam mang ham? Nang Jordan, ijeh-a nalelon kit ham?
target: Why was it, sea, that you fled? Why, Jordan, did you turn back?

source: Nangho molsangho kelngoichal banga, chule nangho lhang neoho kelngoinou banga idia nakichopmu ham?
target: Why, mountains, did you leap like rams, you hills, like lambs?

source: Nang leiset, Pakai Jacob Pathen anga chun kithingin,
target: Tremble, earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

source: Songpi twikul'a heidoh thei, meituh song twinah sosah thei Pathen ahi.
target: who turned the rock into a pool, the hard rock into springs of water.

source: Keiho heng hilouvin, vo Pakai keiho heng hilouvin, amavang nami hepina le nathutah jal-in nangma minin loupina pen.
target: Not to us, Lord , not to us but to your name be the glory, because of your love and faithfulness.

source: Ibola Pathen hephalouten, a-Pathen'u tu-a hoiba hitam? atiu ham?
target: Why do the nations say, “Where is their God?”

source: Ahinla i-Pathen'u van ho-a uma ahin, aman adeichan abol ahi.
target: Our God is in heaven; he does whatever pleases him.

source: Amilimu chu dangka le sana ahin, mihemho khutsoh ahi.
target: But their idols are silver and gold, made by human hands.
