source: Amahon kam aneijun, apaothei pouvin; mit aneijun, ahinla kho amupouve.
target: They have mouths, but cannot speak, eyes, but cannot see.

source: Amahon bil aneijun, ahinla ajapouvin; nah aneijun, ahinla imacha nam ajapouve.
target: They have ears, but cannot hear, noses, but cannot smell.

source: Amahon khut aneijun, imala akhoithei pouvin; keng aneijun, achethei pouvin, alolhomuva konin jong apaothei pouve.
target: They have hands, but cannot feel, feet, but cannot walk, nor can they utter a sound with their throats.

source: Amaho semho chu amaho bangbep ahin; amaho tahsan chan jong chutichu ahi.
target: Those who make them will be like them, and so will all who trust in them.

source: Vo Israel, Pakai chu tahsanun, ama chu apanpiule alumdalu ahi.
target: All you Israelites, trust in the Lord — he is their help and shield.

source: Vo Aaron insung mite, Pakai chu tahsanun, ama chu apanpiule alumdalu ahi.
target: House of Aaron, trust in the Lord — he is their help and shield.

source: Pakai ging nanghon, Pakai chu tahsanun, amachu apanpiule alumdallu ahi.
target: You who fear him, trust in the Lord — he is their help and shield.

source: Pakaiyin eikhohsah jingun phatthei eibohdiu ahi; Aman Israel insung phatthei abohding, aman Aaron insung phatthei abohding ahi.
target: The Lord remembers us and will bless us: He will bless his people Israel, he will bless the house of Aaron,

source: Aman Pakai gingho chu alen aneo agoma phatthei abohding ahi.
target: he will bless those who fear the Lord — small and great alike.

source: Pakaiyin nangho hapuna napunsahdiu, chule nachateo apunsah chehdiu ahi.
target: May the Lord cause you to flourish, both you and your children.

source: Nangho chu vanle leiset sem, Pakai phattheiboh nahiuve.
target: May you be blessed by the Lord , the Maker of heaven and earth.

source: Vanle vanho tah chu Pakaiya ahin, leiset vanghi mihem chate anapeh ahi.
target: The highest heavens belong to the Lord , but the earth he has given to mankind.

source: Mithin Pakai avahchoipon, thipchetna chesuh-in jong avahchoipoi.
target: It is not the dead who praise the Lord , those who go down to the place of silence;

source: Ahivangin eihonvang tua pat tonsot geijin Pakai chu vahchoi ute. Pakai chu vahchoijun.
target: it is we who extol the Lord , both now and forevermore. Praise the Lord .

source: Keiman Pakai kangailui; ajehchu aman ka aw leh kataona eijahpeh tan ahi.
target: I love the Lord , for he heard my voice; he heard my cry for mercy.

source: Ajehchu aman kahenglama ana asungin, hijeh-a chu kahin laise-a ama kakoujing ding ahi.
target: Because he turned his ear to me, I will call on him as long as I live.

source: Thina lung gentheina-in eium kimvelin, thilkholkhul thohlel nahon eimanin, lungkhamna le lungdonna katoh-in ahi.
target: The cords of death entangled me, the anguish of the grave came over me; I was overcome by distress and sorrow.

source: Chujouvin keiman Pakai min kakouvin, vo Pakai, kangeh nahi, kahinna huhhingin, kati.
target: Then I called on the name of the Lord : “ Lord , save me!”

source: Pakai chu lungset themle chonphatah ahi; henge, i Pathen'u hi hepina-a dim ahi.
target: The Lord is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.

source: Pakaiyin milhamho ahoitupmin, keima eiki sunem in, ahin aman eipanpie.
target: The Lord protects the unwary; when I was brought low, he saved me.

source: Vo kahinna nacholngahna-a kiletan, ajehchu Pakaiyin naning lhinsah tan ahi.
target: Return to your rest, my soul, for the Lord has been good to you.

source: Ajehchu nangin kahinkho thina-a kon, kamit mitlhi-a kon, chule kakeng jong lhahmangna-a konin, nahuhdoh tan ahi.
target: For you, Lord , have delivered me from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling,

source: Mihing gamsunga chu, Pakai masanga kavale ding ahi.
target: that I may walk before the Lord in the land of the living.

source: Keiman katahsanin, hijeh-a chu kasei ahi, nasatah-a bolgenthei kanahi.
target: I trusted in the Lord when I said, “I am greatly afflicted”;

source: Mijouse hi ajouve, tin kana seiloi chelle.
target: in my alarm I said, “Everyone is a liar.”

source: Keidinga aphatchom naho jeh-a, Pakai chu ipi kapeh ding hitam?
target: What shall I return to the Lord for all his goodness to me?

source: Huhhingna khon chu domsang ingting, Pakai minchu kou ing kate.
target: I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the Lord .

source: Tun amite jouse masanga, Pakaiya kakitepna ho jouse peng kate.
target: I will fulfill my vows to the Lord in the presence of all his people.

source: Pakai mitmu-a amithengte thichu manlutah ahi.
target: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his faithful servants.

source: Vo Pakai keima nasoh tahbeh kahi, nasohnu chapa nasohpa kahin, kakihen naho neisutlhah peh tai.
target: Truly I am your servant, Lord ; I serve you just as my mother did; you have freed me from my chains.

source: Thangvahna chu kilhaina bangin nahenga toh ingting, Pakai minchu kouvinge.
target: I will sacrifice a thank offering to you and call on the name of the Lord .

source: Tun amite jouse angsunga, Pakai inpi hongsunga,
target: I will fulfill my vows to the Lord in the presence of all his people,

source: Vo Jerusalem, nalailung laitah-a, Pakai henga kakitepna chu kapeh ding ahi, Pakai chu vahchoijun.
target: in the courts of the house of the Lord — in your midst, Jerusalem. Praise the Lord .

source: Oh, namtin jousen, Pakai chu vahchoijun, mijousen ama vahchoijun.
target: Praise the Lord , all you nations; extol him, all you peoples.

source: Ahepi lungsetna ichunguva aletjeh-in, chule Pakai thutah chu tonsotna umjing ahi. Pakai chu vahchoijun.
target: For great is his love toward us, and the faithfulness of the Lord endures forever. Praise the Lord .

source: Pakai chu aphat jeh-in, thangvahna peovin, ajehchu ahepina a-imatih chana umjing ahi.
target: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.

source: Ahepina a-imatih chana umjing ahi, tin Israel'in tun seijuhen.
target: Let Israel say: “His love endures forever.”

source: Ahepina imatih chana umjing ahi tin, tun Aaron insung miten seijuhen.
target: Let the house of Aaron say: “His love endures forever.”

source: Ahepina a-imatih chana umjing ahi tin, tun Pakai gingten seijuhen.
target: Let those who fear the Lord say: “His love endures forever.”

source: Pakai chu lung gentheijin kakouvin, Pakaiyin eidon butnin mun lentah-a eikoije.
target: When hard pressed, I cried to the Lord ; he brought me into a spacious place.

source: Pakai chu keilama pang ahin, keima kicha ponge, mihemin i-eilo thei ding ham?
target: The Lord is with me; I will not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?

source: Pakai chu keimale eipanpi hoto pangkhom ahin; hijeh-a chu eihot bolte chunga kalungtup kamuding ahi.
target: The Lord is with me; he is my helper. I look in triumph on my enemies.

source: Mihem'a kingai sangin, Pakaiya tahsan ngap aphajoi.
target: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in humans.

source: Pipuho-a kingai sangin, Pakaiya tahsan ngap aphajoi.
target: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in princes.

source: Nam jousen keima eiumkim velun; ahivanga keiman Pakai mina amaho kasuhmang ding ahi.
target: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the Lord I cut them down.

source: Amahon eiumchah taove, henge, amahon eiumchah taove; ahivanga keiman Pakai mina amaho kasuhmang ding ahi.
target: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the Lord I cut them down.

source: Khoi bangin eitomchah un, meisi lingnei banga suhmit ahiuve; ajehchu keiman Pakai mina amaho kasuhmang ding ahi.
target: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were consumed as quickly as burning thorns; in the name of the Lord I cut them down.

source: Nangin kalhuhna dingin hatah-in neihin sonin; ahinla Pakaiyin eikithopin ahi.
target: I was pushed back and about to fall, but the Lord helped me.

source: Pakai chu kathahatna le kala ahin, ama kahuhhingpa ahung hitai.
target: The Lord is my strength and my defense; he has become my salvation.

source: Kipanale huhhingna aw ginchu, michonpha houbuho-a chun aumin; Pakai khutjet nin hangsan tah-in aboljin ahi.
target: Shouts of joy and victory resound in the tents of the righteous: “The Lord ’s right hand has done mighty things!

source: Pakai khutjet chu choisangin aumtan, Pakai khutjet nin hangsan tah-in aboljin ahi.
target: The Lord ’s right hand is lifted high; the Lord ’s right hand has done mighty things!”

source: Keima thilouva kahin ding, chule Pakai thilbolho chu kaphondoh ding ahi.
target: I will not die but live, and will proclaim what the Lord has done.

source: Pakaiyin eisehgim behsehtan; hinla thinagei lomin eina pedohpon ahi.
target: The Lord has chastened me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

source: Chonphatna kotpiho chu neihon peh-in, asunguva lutning ting, Pakai chu vahchoi jinge.
target: Open for me the gates of the righteous; I will enter and give thanks to the Lord .

source: Hichehi michonpha lut nading, Pakai kotpi ahin.
target: This is the gate of the Lord through which the righteous may enter.

source: Nangma vahchoi jinge, ajehchu nangman neingaipeh-in, kahuhhingpu nahunghitai.
target: I will give you thanks, for you answered me; you have become my salvation.

source: In sahon anot thapmu song chu, inning songpi penin ahung pangtai.
target: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone;

source: Hichehi Pakai thilbol ahin, imitnuva kidangtah ahi.
target: the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes.

source: Hichehi Pakai sem nikho chu ahin, hichea hi ikipa thanop diu ahi.
target: The Lord has done it this very day; let us rejoice today and be glad.

source: Tun huhhingin, vo Pakai, nahenga katao ahi, vo Pakai, nahenga katao ahi, tun phattheina hinsolin.
target: Lord , save us! Lord , grant us success!

source: Pakai mina hungpa chu anun nome, Pakai in'a konin phatthei kahinboh uve.
target: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord . From the house of the Lord we bless you.

source: Pathen hi vah eimusah-u Pakai chu ahi; ganlhaina chu maicham kiho-a khao ho-a chun henuvin.
target: The Lord is God, and he has made his light shine on us. With boughs in hand, join in the festal procession up to the horns of the altar.

source: Nangma ka Pathen nahin kavahchoi ding nahi; nangma ka Pathen nahin kachoi sang ding nahi.
target: You are my God, and I will praise you; you are my God, and I will exalt you.

source: Oh, aphatjeh-in Pakai chu thangvah un, ajehchu ahepina a-imatih chana umjing ahi.
target: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.

source: Lamlhah-a kisubohlou, Pakai danthua chonpa chu anunnom ahi.
target: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the law of the Lord .

source: Ahettohsah naho tuhdetna, chule lungthim pumpi-a ama holla chu anunnom ahi.
target: Blessed are those who keep his statutes and seek him with all their heart—

source: Amahon khangitlou jong abol pouvin, ama lamlhah-a chun acheuvin ahi.
target: they do no wrong but follow his ways.

source: Chingthei tah-a nachon danho nitdingin, nangin thupeh neipeuvin ahi.
target: You have laid down precepts that are to be fully obeyed.

source: Nachon danho kajuina dinga kachon dingdan eikihila hitavele o!
target: Oh, that my ways were steadfast in obeying your decrees!

source: Nathupeh jouse kajabol tengle keima jahcha taponge.
target: Then I would not be put to shame when I consider all your commands.

source: Nachon phatna thutan naho kakihil tengle, lungtheng tah-a kavahchoi ding nahi.
target: I will praise you with an upright heart as I learn your righteous laws.

source: Nachon danho kanitjing ding ahin; nangman neidalha manghel hih-in. BETH
target: I will obey your decrees; do not utterly forsake me.

source: Khangdongin alampi iti asuhtheng thei ding ham? Nathu dungjuija chingthei tah-a hinkho amana kon hiding ahi.
target: How can a young person stay on the path of purity? By living according to your word.

source: Kalung pumpin nangma kanaholle, O nathupeh ho-a konin neilam vaisah loujenin.
target: I seek you with all my heart; do not let me stray from your commands.

source: Nangma douna-a kachonset kit lou nadin, nathu kalung sunga kaselle.
target: I have hidden your word in my heart that I might not sin against you.

source: Vo Pakai anunnom nahi, nadanthu kisunho neihilin.
target: Praise be to you, Lord ; teach me your decrees.

source: Nakama nathutan lhahho jouse, kamuh-in kaphongdoh tan ahi.
target: With my lips I recount all the laws that come from your mouth.

source: Haona jousetoh kikotnin, nathu hettohsah naho lampi achun kana thanomin ahi.
target: I rejoice in following your statutes as one rejoices in great riches.

source: Nachon danho keiman ngaito ingting, nalampi ho jabolinge.
target: I meditate on your precepts and consider your ways.

source: Nachondan kisunho-a kipah jinging ting; nathu chu kasuhmil louding ahi. GIMEL
target: I delight in your decrees; I will not neglect your word.

source: Kahin theina dingle, nathu kanit nadin, nasoh chunga hin kiphal tah-in na tongin.
target: Be good to your servant while I live, that I may obey your word.

source: Nachondan thua kona thilkidang ho kamu theinadin, kamit hasah inlang hin.
target: Open my eyes that I may see wonderful things in your law.

source: Leisetna kholjin kahin, nathupeh ho chu keija konin selhih-in.
target: I am a stranger on earth; do not hide your commands from me.

source: Nathutanlhah phattina lhangai na-in kahinna hi suhlam vaijin aumtan ahi.
target: My soul is consumed with longing for your laws at all times.

source: Nathupeh ho-a kon vahmanga, mikiletsah sapset changho chu naphohsalin ahi.
target: You rebuke the arrogant, who are accursed, those who stray from your commands.

source: Keija konin i-sah lounale housetna ho lamangin; ajehchu keiman nahettohsahna ho kanit jinge.
target: Remove from me their scorn and contempt, for I keep your statutes.

source: Pipuiho jong atouvun chule eiseiseuvin, ahinla nasoh hin nadan kisunho kangaiton ahi.
target: Though rulers sit together and slander me, your servant will meditate on your decrees.

source: Na hettohsahna jong chu kakipanale eithumopma ahi. DALETH
target: Your statutes are my delight; they are my counselors.

source: Kahinnahi leivuija abehchah tan; nathu dungjuijin neisuhalin.
target: I am laid low in the dust; preserve my life according to your word.

source: Kalamlhah ho kaphong doh-in, nangin neijahpeh tai; Na danthu kisunho neihilin.
target: I gave an account of my ways and you answered me; teach me your decrees.

source: Nachondan lampiho neihet them sah-in; chutichun nathilbol kidangho seichoi lenge.
target: Cause me to understand the way of your precepts, that I may meditate on your wonderful deeds.

source: Kahinna lungkhamin ajunlha tai; nathu dungjuijin neihatdoh sah-in.
target: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.

source: Jouseina lampi keija konin chondoh-in; lungsettah in nadanthu neipejotan.
target: Keep me from deceitful ways; be gracious to me and teach me your law.

source: Thudih lampi chu kana lhengin; Nathu tanlhah ho kamasanga kakoije.
target: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; I have set my heart on your laws.

source: Nathu hettoh sahho katuh jinge, O Pakai, neijumso hih-in.
target: I hold fast to your statutes, Lord ; do not let me be put to shame.

source: Kalung nakhantou sah tengle, nathupeh lampia chun lhaijinge. HE
target: I run in the path of your commands, for you have broadened my understanding.

source: Vo Pakai na danthu kisunho lampi neihilin, chutile akhonna geija kachintup ding ahi.
target: Teach me, Lord , the way of your decrees, that I may follow it to the end.

source: Nadanthu kanit theina dingin hetkhen themna neipen, henge, kalung pumpin nit ing kate.
target: Give me understanding, so that I may keep your law and obey it with all my heart.

source: Na thupeho lampia neiche sah-in, Ajehchu hichea chu kipah kahi.
target: Direct me in the path of your commands, for there I find delight.

source: Kiloset lam hilouvin, nathu hetohsahna lama chun neilunglut sah-in.
target: Turn my heart toward your statutes and not toward selfish gain.

source: Manmo vetna-a konin kamit heimangin, chule nalampi-a neisuhalin.
target: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; preserve my life according to your word.

source: Nangma ginna-a lunglut, nasohpa henga nathu sudetnin.
target: Fulfill your promise to your servant, so that you may be feared.

source: I-eikisah louna kakichat hi heimangin, ajehchu nathu tanlhahna chu aphan ahi.
target: Take away the disgrace I dread, for your laws are good.

source: Vetan, nachondan thuchu kalhangai jinge, nachon phatna-a neisuhalin. VAU
target: How I long for your precepts! In your righteousness preserve my life.

source: Vo Pakai nami hepina kahenga hunghen, nathudih dungjuijin nahuhhingna jong hunglhung hen.
target: May your unfailing love come to me, Lord , your salvation, according to your promise;

source: Nathu katahsan jala, i-sah louva eibolho chu adonbutna kaneiding ahi.
target: then I can answer anyone who taunts me, for I trust in your word.

source: Kakama kona thutah thu chu lamanghel hih-in, ajehchu nathu tanna-a kinema kahi.
target: Never take your word of truth from my mouth, for I have put my hope in your laws.

source: Chutia chu nadanthu tanglouva, atonsot atonsot geija kanit ding ahi.
target: I will always obey your law, for ever and ever.

source: Nachondan thuho kahole jeh-in, keima chamlhat tah-in choninge.
target: I will walk about in freedom, for I have sought out your precepts.

source: Lengho angsunga jong nathu hettohsah ho seijing ting, chule keima jahchaponge.
target: I will speak of your statutes before kings and will not be put to shame,

source: Chule kanangailut jing, nathupeh ho-a chun kipah inge.
target: for I delight in your commands because I love them.

source: Kanangailut jing, nathupeh ho lama chun kakhut jong domsang inting, nadan kisunho ngaitonge. ZAYIN
target: I reach out for your commands, which I love, that I may meditate on your decrees.

source: Achunga neikinep sahna, nasoh thusei chu geldoh-in.
target: Remember your word to your servant, for you have given me hope.

source: Nathun hinna eipeh jala, hichehi kahesohna-a kalhamona hiding ahi
target: My comfort in my suffering is this: Your promise preserves my life.

source: Mikiletsah-in nasatah-in einuisatnin, ahinla nadanthu-a konin kalhadah dehpoi.
target: The arrogant mock me unmercifully, but I do not turn from your law.

source: Vo Pakai malaija nathu tanlhah ho chu kahejingin, lhamon nan kaneijin ahi.
target: I remember, Lord , your ancient laws, and I find comfort in them.

source: Nadanthu nungsun mikhang gilouho jeh-in, kichatnin kadimtan ahi.
target: Indignation grips me because of the wicked, who have forsaken your law.

source: Ka kholjina insunga dinga la chu, Nadanthu kisunho chu ahi.
target: Your decrees are the theme of my song wherever I lodge.

source: Vo Pakai namin chu janteng kageldohjin, nadanthu chu kanit jingin ahi.
target: In the night, Lord , I remember your name, that I may keep your law.

source: Nachon danthu kavetup jeh-in, hichehi kanei ahi. HETH
target: This has been my practice: I obey your precepts.

source: Vo Pakai nangma keija nahi; nathu kanit ding ahi tin kanaseije.
target: You are my portion, Lord ; I have promised to obey your words.

source: Kalung pumpin nalungsetna kangeh-e; nathu dungjuijin hepina neineijin.
target: I have sought your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to your promise.

source: Kalampi ho kangaiton, nathu hettohsahna lama kakeng kahei tai.
target: I have considered my ways and have turned my steps to your statutes.

source: Nathupeh ho nitdingin kakinon, kageisangpoi.
target: I will hasten and not delay to obey your commands.

source: Mikhang gilou kiloihon eichomun; ahivangin nadanthu chu kasumil pon ahi.
target: Though the wicked bind me with ropes, I will not forget your law.

source: Nachon phatna thutan ho jeh-in, khangkim laijin thouving ting nangma thangvah inge.
target: At midnight I rise to give you thanks for your righteous laws.

source: Nangma ginghole nachondan thu nit ho jouse dinga loile gol kahi.
target: I am a friend to all who fear you, to all who follow your precepts.

source: Vo Pakai, leiset hi nahepina dimset ahi; nadanthu kisunho neihilin. TETH
target: The earth is filled with your love, Lord ; teach me your decrees.

source: Vo Pakai nathu dungjuijin, nasohhi neibol phalheh jengin ahi.
target: Do good to your servant according to your word, Lord .

source: Thutan dihtah leh hetna neihilin, ajehchu nathupeh katahsanin ahi.
target: Teach me knowledge and good judgment, for I trust your commands.

source: Eiki bolgim masang chun kana vahmangin, hinla tunvang nathu kanit tai.
target: Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now I obey your word.

source: Nangma naphan, thilpha nabole; Nadan kisun ho neihilin.
target: You are good, and what you do is good; teach me your decrees.

source: Mi kiletsah-in kei dounan jou asemthun, kenvang kalung pumpin nadanthuho vetup inge.
target: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep your precepts with all my heart.

source: Alungu sathao bangin athaovin, keivang nadanthu-a kipah inge.
target: Their hearts are callous and unfeeling, but I delight in your law.

source: Nadanthu kisun ho kahet theina dinga, eiki bolgim chu keidingin aphan ahi.
target: It was good for me to be afflicted so that I might learn your decrees.

source: Sanale dangka sang tamtah sangin, nakama danthu sohdoh chu keidin aphajon ahi. YOD
target: The law from your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of silver and gold.

source: Nangman nakhutna neisema neigontoh ahin; nathupeh kahet theina din hetkhen themna neipen.
target: Your hands made me and formed me; give me understanding to learn your commands.

source: Nathu-a kinema kaumjing jeh-in, nangma ginghon eimu tengule kipah unte.
target: May those who fear you rejoice when they see me, for I have put my hope in your word.

source: Vo Pakai nathu tanlhah ho adih-in, tahsan umtah-a neibolgim ahi ti kahei.
target: I know, Lord , that your laws are righteous, and that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

source: Katao ahi, nasoh henga nathusei dungjuijin, nahepi lungsetna chu kalha mona hihen.
target: May your unfailing love be my comfort, according to your promise to your servant.

source: Kahin theinadin, nahepina thah chu kahenga hunghen; ajehchu nadanthu chu kakipana ahi.
target: Let your compassion come to me that I may live, for your law is my delight.

source: Ajehbeija eibolval jeh uvin, mi kiletsahho chu jahchao hen, keiman vang, nachondan thuho chu kangaito jinge.
target: May the arrogant be put to shame for wronging me without cause; but I will meditate on your precepts.

source: Nangma gingho, nathu hetohsah heho chu keima lama hungkihei juhen.
target: May those who fear you turn to me, those who understand your statutes.

source: Kajachat louna din, kalunghi nadanthu kisun ho-a det hen. KAPH
target: May I wholeheartedly follow your decrees, that I may not be put to shame.

source: Nahuhhingna ngaichan, kahinna alhasamtai; ahinla nathun kakineme.
target: My soul faints with longing for your salvation, but I have put my hope in your word.

source: Nathu-a dingin kamit alosamtai, itihle neilhamon ding ham? kati.
target: My eyes fail, looking for your promise; I say, “When will you comfort me?”

source: Meikhu lah-a hai um tobang kahitai; hijongle nadanthu kisun chu kasumilpoi.
target: Though I am like a wineskin in the smoke, I do not forget your decrees.

source: Nasoh nikho hohi ijat-ham, eisugentheiho chunga itihle thu natan ding ham?
target: How long must your servant wait? When will you punish my persecutors?

source: Mi kiletsah nadanthu banga umlouhon, kokhuh eilaipeh uvin ahi.
target: The arrogant dig pits to trap me, contrary to your law.

source: Nathupeh ho jouse tahsan um ahin, amahon dihlou tah-in eibolgimuve, neipanpin.
target: All your commands are trustworthy; help me, for I am being persecuted without cause.

source: Amahon leiset chungahi eisuhmang konu ahitan; kenvang nachondan thuho kadalhapon ahi.
target: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken your precepts.

source: Nalungset hepina bangin neisem thah-in, chutichun nakamsung thu hettohsah chu juijinge. LAMED
target: In your unfailing love preserve my life, that I may obey the statutes of your mouth.

source: Vo Pakai, nathuhi a-imatih chanin van'a aumjinge.
target: Your word, Lord , is eternal; it stands firm in the heavens.

source: Nakitahna chu khang jouse-a aumin; nangman leiset naphut doh-in, hichu aumjingin ahi.
target: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; you established the earth, and it endures.

source: Nahou danthupeh dungjuijin amaho tulai geijin aumjinge; ajehchu abonchauva nasohte ahiuvin ahi.
target: Your laws endure to this day, for all things serve you.

source: Nadanthu hi kakipana hilou hile, kalung hesoh-a chu anamangthah ding kahitai.
target: If your law had not been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

source: Nachondan thuho chu a-itih in sumil pong kate, ajehchu hicheho-a chu hinna neina peh ahi.
target: I will never forget your precepts, for by them you have preserved my life.

source: Nanga kahi, neihuhhing in, ajehchu nachondan thuho kanaholin ahi.
target: Save me, for I am yours; I have sought out your precepts.

source: Mi khangilou chun suhmang dingin eingah-e, ahivangin nathu hetohsahna ho kagel jing ding ahi.
target: The wicked are waiting to destroy me, but I will ponder your statutes.

source: Chamkimna jouse akhonna kamutai; ahin nathupeh vang ajao lheh jengin ahi. MEM
target: To all perfection I see a limit, but your commands are boundless.

source: Oh, nadanthu hi iti kangailut hitam! nilhumkeijin kangaitojin ahi.
target: Oh, how I love your law! I meditate on it all day long.

source: Nathupeh ho-a kona kamelmate sanga chingjoa neisem ahi; ajehchu hichu keitoh aum jingin ahi.
target: Your commands are always with me and make me wiser than my enemies.

source: Eihilho jouse sangin hetthemna kaneijoi; ajehchu nathu hettohsah naho chu kangaiton ahi.
target: I have more insight than all my teachers, for I meditate on your statutes.

source: Nachondan thuho kavet tup jal-in, malai miho sangin hetkhen themna kaneijoi.
target: I have more understanding than the elders, for I obey your precepts.

source: Nathu kanit theina din, setna lampi ho-a konin kakeng kakangsen ahi.
target: I have kept my feet from every evil path so that I might obey your word.

source: Nathu tanlhah na-a konin kana kihei mangpoi; ajehchu nangma tah-in nei nahilsa ahi.
target: I have not departed from your laws, for you yourself have taught me.

source: Nathuhohi keija dinga iti lhuma hitam! Henge, kakama khoiju sangin alhumjon ahi.
target: How sweet are your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

source: Nachondan thuho-a konin hetkhen themna kaneijin; hijeh chun lampi dih lou jouse kathen ahi. NUN
target: I gain understanding from your precepts; therefore I hate every wrong path.

source: Nathuhi kakeng dinga thaomei ahin, ka lampi dingin vah ahi.
target: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.

source: Keima nachonphat nathutan ho nit dingin, kaki hahsel in kaphut det tai.
target: I have taken an oath and confirmed it, that I will follow your righteous laws.

source: Vo Pakai eiki bolgim behsehtan; nathu dungjuijin neisuhalin.
target: I have suffered much; preserve my life, Lord , according to your word.

source: Vo Pakai kangeh ahi, kakama lungcham thilpeh hi sangin lang, nathu tanlhah naho chu neihilin.
target: Accept, Lord , the willing praise of my mouth, and teach me your laws.

source: Kahinna kakhutna aumjingin; hijongle nadanthu kasumil dehpoi.
target: Though I constantly take my life in my hands, I will not forget your law.

source: Mi khang gilou chun thang eikampeh-in; hijongle na danthuho-a konin kavahmang dehpon ahi.
target: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from your precepts.

source: Nathu hettohsah naho chu katonsot goudin kakilah-e; ajehchu hicheho chu kalung kipana ahi.
target: Your statutes are my heritage forever; they are the joy of my heart.

source: Akhonna geija nadanthu kisunho tohdoh nadin, kalungthim kapetan ahi. SAMEK
target: My heart is set on keeping your decrees to the very end.

source: Mohthil ngaitohi kahon, ahin, nadanthu vang kangailun ahi.
target: I hate double-minded people, but I love your law.

source: Nangma kakiselna munle kalumdal nahin, nathu-a kakineme.
target: You are my refuge and my shield; I have put my hope in your word.

source: Nangho khanset bolho, keijakonin potdoh-un, ajehchu ka Pathen thupeh ho chu kanga tup ding ahi.
target: Away from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commands of my God!

source: Kahin theinadin nathu dungjuijin neituh-in, kakinepna-a neijachat sah hih-in.
target: Sustain me, my God, according to your promise, and I will live; do not let my hopes be dashed.

source: Neituh detnin chutileh kahoidoh ding ahi; chule nadanthu kisun ho tanglouva kajabol ding ahi.
target: Uphold me, and I will be delivered; I will always have regard for your decrees.

source: Nadanthu kisunho-a kona vahmangho jouse chu nachotpha tai; ajehchu amilhep lhahnao chu jou ahi.
target: You reject all who stray from your decrees, for their delusions come to nothing.

source: Nangin migilouho jouse chu thih-eh bangin nasumangin, hijeh chun nathu hettohsah naho kangailun ahi.
target: All the wicked of the earth you discard like dross; therefore I love your statutes.

source: Katahsa nangma ginan akihotnin, chule nathutannaho chu kakichan ahi. AYIN
target: My flesh trembles in fear of you; I stand in awe of your laws.

source: Thutandih le chonphatna kabole, eibol gentheiho hengah eidalha hih-in.
target: I have done what is righteous and just; do not leave me to my oppressors.

source: Nasoh phatnadin kitungin lang, mihoitho chu eisuh genthei sah hih-in.
target: Ensure your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.

source: Nahuhhing nale nachon phatna thu holna-a konin, kamit hi alhasam tai.
target: My eyes fail, looking for your salvation, looking for your righteous promise.

source: Nami hepina dungjui jin nasoh hi bolin lang, nadanthu kisemho neihilin.
target: Deal with your servant according to your love and teach me your decrees.

source: Keima nasoh kahin; nathu hettohsah naho kahet khen thei nadin, het themna neipen.
target: I am your servant; give me discernment that I may understand your statutes.

source: Pakai nang dinga natoh phat ahitai; ajehchu nadanthu anotthap taovin ahi.
target: It is time for you to act, Lord ; your law is being broken.

source: Hijeh chun sana sangin nathupeh kangailun; henge, sana thengsel sangin kangailu jon ahi.
target: Because I love your commands more than gold, more than pure gold,

source: Hijeh chun nachondan thuho jouse, adih ding thil jouse kajabolin; lampi dihlou jouse kathen ahi. PE
target: and because I consider all your precepts right, I hate every wrong path.

source: Nathu hettohsahnaho chu kidangtah ahin; hijeh-a chu kahinna-in hiho chu anitding ahi.
target: Your statutes are wonderful; therefore I obey them.

source: Nathu lutna chun vah apejin, hichun milhamho hetkhen themna apejin ahi.
target: The unfolding of your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.

source: Kakam kan, kahaihai jenge; ajehchu nathupeh ho kangaichan ahi.
target: I open my mouth and pant, longing for your commands.

source: Namin ngailuho nabolnaji bangchun, keima neivenlang, neihepi tan.
target: Turn to me and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

source: Nathu-a kakholhah ho thu penlang, kachunga khansetna himhim vaipohsah hihbeh-in.
target: Direct my footsteps according to your word; let no sin rule over me.

source: Mihem suhgentheina-a konin neihuh doh-in, chutichun nachondan thuho nit inge.
target: Redeem me from human oppression, that I may obey your precepts.

source: Nasoh chunga hin namai vahsah inlang, nadanthu kisun ho neihilin.
target: Make your face shine on your servant and teach me your decrees.

source: Amahon nadanthu anit loujeh-un, kamit lhi vadung twi bangin alonglhan ahi. TSADDE
target: Streams of tears flow from my eyes, for your law is not obeyed.

source: Vo Pakai nangma chonpha nahin, nathutan ho chu dihtah ahi.
target: You are righteous, Lord , and your laws are right.

source: Nangin napeh nathu hettohsah naho chu, chonpha le kitah ahi.
target: The statutes you have laid down are righteous; they are fully trustworthy.

source: Kamelma ten nathu asuhmil jeh-un, katompan na-in eisumang tan ahi.
target: My zeal wears me out, for my enemies ignore your words.

source: Nathuhi athenglheh jengin, hijeh-a chu nasoh-in kangailun ahi.
target: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

source: Keima neochale isahlou kahin, hijongle nachondan thuho chu kasumil pon ahi.
target: Though I am lowly and despised, I do not forget your precepts.

source: Nachon phatna chu tonsot chonphatna ahin, nadanthu chu thutah ahi.
target: Your righteousness is everlasting and your law is true.

source: Lungkhamnale natthoh lel-in eituhchah-in, hijongle nathupeh ho chu kakipana ahi.
target: Trouble and distress have come upon me, but your commands give me delight.

source: Nathu hettohsah naho chonphatna chu tonsotna ding ahin; hetkhen themna neipen, chule hingjing tange. KOPH
target: Your statutes are always righteous; give me understanding that I may live.

source: Kalung pumpin kakouve, neingaipeh-in, O Pakai, nadanthu kisun hi kanit ding ahi.
target: I call with all my heart; answer me, Lord , and I will obey your decrees.

source: Nangma kakouve, neihuhhing in, chutia chu nathu hettohsah naho kanit ding ahi.
target: I call out to you; save me and I will keep your statutes.

source: Khovah masangin kathouvin, chuin nang kakouvin, nathu-a kaki nem-e.
target: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I have put my hope in your word.

source: Nathu kagelthei nadin, jankhon mitsing louvin kaumin ahi.
target: My eyes stay open through the watches of the night, that I may meditate on your promises.

source: Nalungset hepina dungjuijin ka aw ngaijin, vo Pakai nathutandih dungjuijin neisem thah-in.
target: Hear my voice in accordance with your love; preserve my life, Lord , according to your laws.

source: Thilphalou nung juiho chun eihin naijui; amaho nadanthu-a kona gamla ahiuve.
target: Those who devise wicked schemes are near, but they are far from your law.

source: Vo Pakai nangma nailamcha nahin, nathupeh jouse thudih ahi.
target: Yet you are near, Lord , and all your commands are true.

source: Nathu hettohsah chungchanga, nangman tonsotna dinga naphudetsa ahitai, ti malaija pat kahet ahitai. RESH
target: Long ago I learned from your statutes that you established them to last forever.

source: Kathoh gimje hi ngaitonlang, neihuh doh-in, ajehchu nadanthu kasumilpon ahi.
target: Look on my suffering and deliver me, for I have not forgotten your law.

source: Kachungthu neisei lhahpeh inlang neihuh doh-in, nathu dungjuijin neisem thah-in.
target: Defend my cause and redeem me; preserve my life according to your promise.

source: Huhhingna chu migilou ho-a kona gamlatah ahi; ajehchu amahon nadanthu kisun aholpouve.
target: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek out your decrees.

source: Vo Pakai nahepinaho chu nasatah ahi; Nathutanlhah dungjuijin neisem thah-in.
target: Your compassion, Lord , is great; preserve my life according to your laws.

source: Eisugentheile kamelma atam lheh-un; hijongle nathu hetohsah na ho-a konin kalhasam dehpoi.
target: Many are the foes who persecute me, but I have not turned from your statutes.

source: Suhkhel neiho kaven, nathu achintuplou jeh-un kalung akhamin ahi.
target: I look on the faithless with loathing, for they do not obey your word.

source: Ngaito temin, nadanthuho iti kangailut hitam; vo Pakai nalungset hepina dungjuijin neisem thah-in.
target: See how I love your precepts; preserve my life, Lord , in accordance with your love.

source: Atil abula pat nathu hi adih-in; chule nachon phatna thutan ho chu tonsotnin aumjingin ahi. SCHIN
target: All your words are true; all your righteous laws are eternal.

source: Ajehbeijin pipuihon eisugentheijun; ahinla kalunghi nathu-a tijatah-in ading jingin ahi.
target: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart trembles at your word.

source: Thil tamtah chomdohho bangin, nathu-a hin katha anomlheh jie.
target: I rejoice in your promise like one who finds great spoil.

source: Jouhi kathen kakidah-in, Na danthu vang kangailun ahi.
target: I hate and detest falsehood but I love your law.

source: Nachon phatna nathutan naho jeh-in, nikhatnin sagivei nangma kathangvah-e.
target: Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous laws.

source: Nadanthu ngailuhon chamna loupitah aneijun; imachan amaho asuhmo louding ahi.
target: Great peace have those who love your law, and nothing can make them stumble.

source: Pakai nami huhhingna-a kakinemin kangah-in, nathupeh ho kabolin ahi.
target: I wait for your salvation, Lord , and I follow your commands.

source: Kahinna-in nathu hetohsahna ho anitjingin, nasatah-in kangailun ahi.
target: I obey your statutes, for I love them greatly.

source: Na danthu kisunhole nathu hetohsahna kanitjinge; ajehchu kalampiho jouse na masanga aumin ahi. TAU
target: I obey your precepts and your statutes, for all my ways are known to you.

source: Vo Pakai kakana nakom hunglhung hen, nathu dungjuijin hetkhen themna neipen.
target: May my cry come before you, Lord ; give me understanding according to your word.

source: Kataona na-ang hunglhung hen, nathu dungjuijin neihuhdoh in.
target: May my supplication come before you; deliver me according to your promise.

source: Kakamin navahchoina aphondoh ding ahi, ajehchu nangman nadanthu kisunho neihile.
target: May my lips overflow with praise, for you teach me your decrees.

source: Kaleijin nathuho aseiding ahi; ajehchu nathupeh jouse chonphatna ahi.
target: May my tongue sing of your word, for all your commands are righteous.

source: Nachondanthuho kalhen jeh-in, nakhut chun eiki thopihen.
target: May your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

source: Vo Pakai nami huhhingna kalhangaijin, nadanthu hi kakipana ahi.
target: I long for your salvation, Lord , and your law gives me delight.

source: Kahinna hinsah in, chuteng kavahchoi ding nahi, chule nathutan lhahna-a chun neipanpin.
target: Let me live that I may praise you, and may your laws sustain me.

source: Kelngoi mang bangin kana vahmang tai; nasohhi neihin hollin, ajehchu nathupeh kasumilpon ahi.
target: I have strayed like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I have not forgotten your commands.

source: Kagenthei teng Pakai kakoujin, aman eingaipeh jin ahi.
target: I call on the Lord in my distress, and he answers me.

source: Vo Pakai jouseina kamle, lheplhahna leija konin, kahinna huhdoh-in.
target: Save me, Lord , from lying lips and from deceitful tongues.

source: Jou seija leigui, nangma ipi kapeh-a, ahilouleh ipi kabolpeh dingham?
target: What will he do to you, and what more besides, you deceitful tongue?

source: Mihat thalchang ho hemtah leh makeithing meihol ahi.
target: He will punish you with a warrior’s sharp arrows, with burning coals of the broom bush.

source: Ohe ada kahi! Meshech gama kana kholjin le-a, Kedar ponbuh-a kanachen.
target: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshek, that I live among the tents of Kedar!

source: Kahinnahi chamna hotbolho toh sottah anacheng khomin ahi.
target: Too long have I lived among those who hate peace.

source: Keiman chamna kadeijin, hinla thu kaseidoh teng, amahon galbol ding agojiuve.
target: I am for peace; but when I speak, they are for war.

source: Hoija kona eipanpi hung ham tin, lhangho lam ve-in khodah inge.
target: I lift up my eyes to the mountains— where does my help come from?

source: Vanle leiset sempa Pakaiya kona eipanpi hungah ahi.
target: My help comes from the Lord , the Maker of heaven and earth.

source: Aman nakeng achaloh sah louding, nachingpa chu lulhu louding ahi.
target: He will not let your foot slip— he who watches over you will not slumber;

source: Vetan, Israel chingpa chu lulhu louding; imu jong imulouding ahi.
target: indeed, he who watches over Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

source: Pakai chu nachingpa ahin; Pakai chu nakhut jetlam nalima pang ahi.
target: The Lord watches over you— the Lord is your shade at your right hand;

source: Sunle nisan nasangkha pontin, janteng jongle lha-in nasalkha ponte.
target: the sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

source: Pakaiyin thilse jouse-a kona nahongbit ding; nahinna jong ahonbit ding ahi.
target: The Lord will keep you from all harm— he will watch over your life;

source: Pakaiyin tua pat atonsot geija navaikon navailhun ahonbit ding ahi.
target: the Lord will watch over your coming and going both now and forevermore.

source: Mihon kahenga, Pakai in'a cheu hite, atiu chun, katha anom lheh-in ahi.
target: I rejoiced with those who said to me, “Let us go to the house of the Lord .”

source: Vo Jerusalem, nakotpi sunga kakeng uva kadin dingu ahi.
target: Our feet are standing in your gates, Jerusalem.

source: Jerusalem hi abilla chengkhom khopi banga kisem ahin,
target: Jerusalem is built like a city that is closely compacted together.

source: Chukoma chu Israel hettohsah na-a phungho, Pakai phungho chu Pakai minna thangvahna pedinga, chetou jiuva ahi.
target: That is where the tribes go up— the tribes of the Lord — to praise the name of the Lord according to the statute given to Israel.

source: Ajehchu chumuna chu thutanna laltounaho, David insung laltounaho chu kido-a ahi.
target: There stand the thrones for judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

source: Jerusalem'a chamna aum nadin taovun, nangailu hou chu khangtou dingu ahi.
target: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you be secure.

source: Nakulsunga cham lenghen lang, na leng-inpi sunga khantouna umhen.
target: May there be peace within your walls and security within your citadels.”

source: Ajehchu tu-a hi kasopite le kaloiho jala, nalah uva cham lenghen katiding ahi.
target: For the sake of my family and friends, I will say, “Peace be within you.”

source: Ajehchu Pakai ka Pathen insung jeh-a, naphatnadiu kahol ding ahi.
target: For the sake of the house of the Lord our God, I will seek your prosperity.

source: O nang van ho-a cheng, nangma henglam ven kakhodah-in ahi.
target: I lift up my eyes to you, to you who sit enthroned in heaven.

source: Vetan, sohte mitnin apakai teo khut avetjing bangle, sohnu mitnin a-pakainu khut avetjingji bangin, kachunguva hepina einei masang seuvin, kamitnuvin Pakai ka Pathen'u ave jingin ahi.
target: As the eyes of slaves look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a female slave look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the Lord our God, till he shows us his mercy.

source: Hepina neineijun, O Pakai, hepina neineijun, ajehchu noisena-in kadim behseh taove.
target: Have mercy on us, Lord , have mercy on us, for we have endured no end of contempt.

source: Mi kinomsahho mitaitomna, chule mikiletsahho midem na-in, ka hinnao hi nasatah-in adip tan ahi.
target: We have endured no end of ridicule from the arrogant, of contempt from the proud.

source: Tun Israel ten seijuhen, Pakai chu eiho lama anapanglou hileh:
target: If the Lord had not been on our side— let Israel say—

source: Mihon eina dou uva chu, Pakai chu eiho lama anapanglou hileh:
target: if the Lord had not been on our side when people attacked us,

source: Ichunguva hatah-a alunghan laitah uva chu, eina vallhum diu ahitai.
target: they would have swallowed us alive when their anger flared against us;

source: Chuche laija chu twijin einachup manguva, ihinnao chungaho luidung analong ding ahitai.
target: the flood would have engulfed us, the torrent would have swept over us,

source: Chuche laija chu hoithona twi chu ihinnao chunga hi analong ding ahitai.
target: the raging waters would have swept us away.

source: Aha uva dinga anneh-a eina pedoh louvu Pakai chu nunnom hen.
target: Praise be to the Lord , who has not let us be torn by their teeth.

source: Thang kamho thanga kona vacha kitoldoh banga ihinnao hi kitoldoh ahitan, thangkhao atanin, ikitoldoh taove.
target: We have escaped like a bird from the fowler’s snare; the snare has been broken, and we have escaped.

source: Eipanpiuva chu, Vanle lei sempa Pakai minna uma ahi.
target: Our help is in the name of the Lord , the Maker of heaven and earth.

source: Pakai tahsanna mite chu Zion molsang tobanga, suhlonghoi hilouva a-imatih channa umjing diu ahi.
target: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken but endures forever.

source: Molsang hon Jerusalem a-umkimvel bangin, tua pat tonsot geijin Pakaiyin amite a-umkimvel jinge.
target: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the Lord surrounds his people both now and forevermore.

source: Ajehchu miphalouho moltum chu michonpha ho chunga chulouding, achutiloule chonphaten khangitlou na-a khut lhang getnunte.
target: The scepter of the wicked will not remain over the land allotted to the righteous, for then the righteous might use their hands to do evil.

source: Vo Pakai miphaho dingin thilpha bolin, alungthim dih ho-a din thilpha bolpeh-in.
target: Lord , do good to those who are good, to those who are upright in heart.

source: Alampia vahkoija kihei mangho vang, Pakaiyin thilse bolho toh puidoh thantin, Israelte chunga vang chamna umding ahi.
target: But those who turn to crooked ways the Lord will banish with the evildoers. Peace be on Israel.

source: Pakaiyin sohchangho Zion'a alepuikit laichun, eiho mang neiho toh ibangun ahi.
target: When the Lord restored the fortunes of Zion, we were like those who dreamed.

source: Chuche laichun ikamu chu nuinale ileijuva lasahna anadimin ahi. Chujouchun amahon Pathen hephalouho lah-a Pakaiyin amaho thil loupitah abolpeh uve, anatiuvin ahi.
target: Our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with songs of joy. Then it was said among the nations, “The Lord has done great things for them.”

source: Pakaiyin thil loupitah einabolpeh-un, chua chun eiho ikipah uve.
target: The Lord has done great things for us, and we are filled with joy.

source: Vo Pakai, lhanglam luidungho bangin, kasohchang hou hinlepui kitnin.
target: Restore our fortunes, Lord , like streams in the Negev.

source: Mitlhi puma tu hochun kipahtah-a a-atdiu ahi.
target: Those who sow with tears will reap with songs of joy.

source: Muchi lutah choija, kapumma kondohpa chun, achangphal ahin kipoh-a, thanom tah-a hungkile kitding ahi.
target: Those who go out weeping, carrying seed to sow, will return with songs of joy, carrying sheaves with them.

source: In sa-a Pakai apanlouleh, asaho tohgimna chu moh ahin; Khopi ngah-a Pakai apanlou leh, angahpa janha chu moh ahibouve.
target: Unless the Lord builds the house, the builders labor in vain. Unless the Lord watches over the city, the guards stand watch in vain.

source: Matah-a natho-a, jan sottah natouva, lungkhamna changlhah neh chu, nangdinga pannabei ahi: ajehchu aman angailut chu a-imutsah jin ahi.
target: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for food to eat— for he grants sleep to those he loves.

source: Veovin chatehi Pakaiya kon gouchan ahin, chule laigilga jonghi akipaman thilpeh ahi.
target: Children are a heritage from the Lord , offspring a reward from him.

source: Khangdon laija chate hi, Galhatpa khutna thalchang ho tobang ahi.
target: Like arrows in the hands of a warrior are children born in one’s youth.

source: Alivathei dimsetna hicheho neija mi chu anunnom ahi; amaho jahcha loudiu, ahivanga amelmateu toh kotpi phunga kihoujo diu ahi.
target: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. They will not be put to shame when they contend with their opponents in court.

source: Pakai ging jouse leh alampiho-a chonchan chu anunnom ahi.
target: Blessed are all who fear the Lord , who walk in obedience to him.

source: Ajehchu nakhutna natohgim ga naneh ding; nangman nomsan natin, chule hichu nang dinga phading ahi.
target: You will eat the fruit of your labor; blessings and prosperity will be yours.

source: Na inneipi chu na-in vella lengpigui ga phatah bangintin; nachate chu nadokhang kimvela Olive phung tobang hidiu ahi.
target: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house; your children will be like olive shoots around your table.

source: Vetan, chutia Pakai ginga mi chu phatthei chang ding ahi.
target: Yes, this will be the blessing for the man who fears the Lord .

source: Pakaiyin Zion'a konin phatthei naboh intin; chule nahin laise-a Jerusalem phatna chu namu ding ahi.
target: May the Lord bless you from Zion; may you see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

source: Henge, nachateo chatele Israelte chunga chamna chu namu ding ahi.
target: May you live to see your children’s children— peace be on Israel.

source: Tuhin Israel ten seijuhen; kakhangdon laijapat tamtahvei einabol gimuve.
target: “They have greatly oppressed me from my youth,” let Israel say;

source: Kakhangdon laijapat tamtahvei einabolgim uvin; hijongle amahon eijoudeh pouve.
target: “they have greatly oppressed me from my youth, but they have not gained the victory over me.

source: Loukaihon katungtun chunga akaijun; akainau nung saotah-in akigolin ahi.
target: Plowmen have plowed my back and made their furrows long.

source: Pakai chu chonphatna ahin; migilouho khaojang chu aman asatan tan ahi.
target: But the Lord is righteous; he has cut me free from the cords of the wicked.”

source: Zion hotbolho jouse chu jahchao henlang hung kinung leuhen.
target: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.

source: Amaho chu akhandoh kah-a goppai jia in chunga hampa tobang bep hiuhen.
target: May they be like grass on the roof, which withers before it can grow;

source: Hiche achun chang at pan akhut adip pon; chujongle changphal kanpan jong a-ang adip poi.
target: a reaper cannot fill his hands with it, nor one who gathers fill his arms.

source: Avahleho koiman, nangho Pakai phatthei boh changun, Pakai Minna phatthei kaboh nahiuve, tia seija aumpoi.
target: May those who pass by not say to them, “The blessing of the Lord be on you; we bless you in the name of the Lord .”

source: Vo Pakai, kokhuh thuhtah-a konin nangma kahinsamme.
target: Out of the depths I cry to you, Lord ;

source: Pakai ka aw ngaijin, kangehna aw hi ngai nadin nana hinsungin.
target: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to my cry for mercy.

source: Pakai nangin khangit lounaho namelchih-a ahile, O Pakai koiham adingjou dinga.
target: If you, Lord , kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

source: Ahinla ginna naum theinadin nahenga ngaidamna chu aumme.
target: But with you there is forgiveness, so that we can, with reverence, serve you.

source: Pakai chu kangah-in, kahinna hin angah jingin, athu-a chun kinemin kaume.
target: I wait for the Lord , my whole being waits, and in his word I put my hope.

source: Jingkhovah ngahho sangin nasajon, kahinna hin Pakai chu angah-e. Henge, jing khovah ngah ho sangin kamasajoi.
target: I wait for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning, more than watchmen wait for the morning.

source: Israel chu Pakaiya kinemhen; ajehchu Pakaiya hepina leh lhatdamna chamkim aumin ahi.
target: Israel, put your hope in the Lord , for with the Lord is unfailing love and with him is full redemption.

source: Chule aman akhangit lounao jouse-a kona Israel chu alhatdoh ding ahi.
target: He himself will redeem Israel from all their sins.

source: Pakai kalungthim hi akiletsahpon, kamit jong akichoisangpoi. Keidinga thil len hole thil sang behsehho-a jong kakijil ngaipoi.
target: My heart is not proud, Lord , my eyes are not haughty; I do not concern myself with great matters or things too wonderful for me.

source: Tahbeh-in anu noichep bangsa naosen bangin, thip khinkhen chan kaumin, ka hinna hi naosen noichep bangsa tobanghel ahi.
target: But I have calmed and quieted myself, I am like a weaned child with its mother; like a weaned child I am content.

source: Tu-a kipat a-imatih chana din, Pakaiya chun Israelte kinem uhen.
target: Israel, put your hope in the Lord both now and forevermore.

source: Pakai David leh athoh hahsatna jouse chu geldoh-in.
target: Lord , remember David and all his self-denial.

source: Pakai henga iti ama kitepma, chule Jacob Pathen hat chungnung henga iti ana kihahsela hitam.
target: He swore an oath to the Lord , he made a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:

source: Atahbeh-in ka insunga lutpong ting, kajalkhuna jong kicholdo din lutponge;
target: “I will not enter my house or go to my bed,

source: Kamit ho imutsah pongting, ahiloule lulhuh jong lulhuh sah ponge.
target: I will allow no sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,

source: Pakaiya dinga munkhat kamudoh kahsen, hat chungnung Jacob Pakai dinga chendetna in kamudoh kahsen.
target: till I find a place for the Lord , a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”

source: Veovin, hiche thuchu Ephratah'a kajauvin; gammang lah-a chun kamutaove.
target: We heard it in Ephrathah, we came upon it in the fields of Jaar:

source: Ama houbuh sunga eiho cheohitin; eihon akhophang bullah houvu hite.
target: “Let us go to his dwelling place, let us worship at his footstool, saying,

source: O Pakai, thoudoh-in, nacholdona sunga lutnin; nangmale nathahatna thingkhong toh kipatdohtan.
target: ‘Arise, Lord , and come to your resting place, you and the ark of your might.

source: Nathemputeu chonphat na-in kivonuhen; chule namithengte kipah-in ao vuhen.
target: May your priests be clothed with your righteousness; may your faithful people sing for joy.’ ”

source: Ajehchu nasoh David jal-in, nathaonupa mai chu heimangpeh hih-in.
target: For the sake of your servant David, do not reject your anointed one.

source: Pakai chu David henga thutah in akihahselin; chua kona kiheimang lou ding; nanga kona hung doh khat, nalaltouna chunga katousah ding ahi.
target: The Lord swore an oath to David, a sure oath he will not revoke: “One of your own descendants I will place on your throne.

source: Keiman amaho kahilding kathu lhunle kathu hetohsah nahi, nachaten anit uva ahile amaho jongchu a-imatih chana nalal touna chunga touding ahiuve.
target: If your sons keep my covenant and the statutes I teach them, then their sons will sit on your throne for ever and ever.”

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin achenna ding anadeitan; Zion chu analhengtan ahi.
target: For the Lord has chosen Zion, he has desired it for his dwelling, saying,

source: Hichehi a-imatih channa kacholngah na ahin; kadeitah anahijeh-in, hia hin chengjing tange.
target: “This is my resting place for ever and ever; here I will sit enthroned, for I have desired it.

source: Aneh dingu nengtah-in phungvuh ingting; ami gentheite changlhah-in vah vange.
target: I will bless her with abundant provisions; her poor I will satisfy with food.

source: Athemputeu huhhingna-in von ingting, chule amithengte kipa aw-thonga ao dingu ahi.
target: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her faithful people will ever sing for joy.

source: Chukoma chu keiman David ki kadotdoh sah ding; kathaonu dinga chun thaomei khat kaphudet pehtai.
target: “Here I will make a horn grow for David and set up a lamp for my anointed one.

source: Amelmateu jachatna-in voning ting; ahinla ama tah chunga vang alallukhuh chu khangtou jing ding ahi.
target: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but his head will be adorned with a radiant crown.”

source: Veovin, sopi kitohtah-a chenkhomhi iti phatna iti nopma hitam!
target: How good and pleasant it is when God’s people live together in unity!

source: Hichu luchunga thao mantam tah tobang ahin, khamula longlha-a, Aaron khamul geija longlhasuh tobang; aponchen mong geija jollha suhpeh tobang ahi.
target: It is like precious oil poured on the head, running down on the beard, running down on Aaron’s beard, down on the collar of his robe.

source: Hermon daitwi bangle, Zion molsangho chunga hunglhajia dai twiho tobang ahi. Ajehchu chua chun Pakaiyin tonsotna hinna ding phattheina thupeh chu apen ahi.
target: It is as if the dew of Hermon were falling on Mount Zion. For there the Lord bestows his blessing, even life forevermore.

source: Veovin, nangho Pakai sohte jouse, janna Pakai in'a dinghon Pakai chu vahchoijun.
target: Praise the Lord , all you servants of the Lord who minister by night in the house of the Lord .

source: Munthenga chun nakhut domsangun lang, chule Pakai chu vahchoijun.
target: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary and praise the Lord .

source: Van leh leiset sempa Pakai chun Zion'a konin phatthei naboh-uhen.
target: May the Lord bless you from Zion, he who is the Maker of heaven and earth.

source: Pakai chu vahchoijun, nanghon Pakai minchu vahchoijun, vo nangho Pakai sohte, amachu vahchoijun.
target: Praise the Lord . Praise the name of the Lord ; praise him, you servants of the Lord ,

source: Nangho Pakai insunga dingteho, Pathen in hongsunga dingteho,
target: you who minister in the house of the Lord , in the courts of the house of our God.

source: Pakai chu aphat jeh-in, Pakai chu vahchoijun, nomtah ahijeh-in, aminin vahchoina la saovin.
target: Praise the Lord , for the Lord is good; sing praise to his name, for that is pleasant.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin ama ding tumin Jacob akilhenin, chule agou tum mong dingin Israel akilhentai.
target: For the Lord has chosen Jacob to be his own, Israel to be his treasured possession.

source: Ajehchu Pakai chu loupitah ahi kahen, chule I-Pakaiyu hi Pathen jouse chunga ahi.
target: I know that the Lord is great, that our Lord is greater than all gods.

source: Pakaiyin alunglhaina chan chu van'a, leija, twikhanglen sunga chule mun thuhtah ho jouse-a aboljin ahi.
target: The Lord does whatever pleases him, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all their depths.

source: Aman leiset kolmang ho-a konin twimeiho ajamdoh sah-in, go juhna dingin kolphe asemin, akholna in'a konin khohui ahin lhadohjin ahi.
target: He makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth; he sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.

source: Aman Egypt gama mihem apeng masa mihem le gancha, agomin athat gamin ahi.
target: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, the firstborn of people and animals.

source: Vo Egypt gam, Pharaoh chung leh asohte jouse chunga, aman melchihna le thil kidang nalah uva ahinsolin ahi.
target: He sent his signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.

source: Namlenho asumangin, chule leng hattaho athat gamin ahi.
target: He struck down many nations and killed mighty kings—

source: Amor mite lengpa Sihon leh Bashan lengpa Og, chule Canaan lenggam ho jouse;
target: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan—

source: Chule agammu chu goulo din, ami Israelte gouchan din apetan ahi.
target: and he gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to his people Israel.

source: Vo Pakai, namin chu tonsotnin aumjingin, chule vo Pakai, nahetjingna chu khangjouse lhumkeijin aumjinge.
target: Your name, Lord , endures forever, your renown, Lord , through all generations.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin amite thu atanding ahin, chule asohte chungchanga alung aheiding ahi.
target: For the Lord will vindicate his people and have compassion on his servants.

source: Pathen hephalouho milimhou chu dangka le sana, mihem khutna kisem ahi.
target: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by human hands.

source: Amahon kam aneijun ahinla apaothei pouvin, mit aneijun ahinla kho amupouvin;
target: They have mouths, but cannot speak, eyes, but cannot see.

source: Amahon nakhang aneijun ahinla kho ajapouvin, akam sunguva jong haina himhim aumpon ahi.
target: They have ears, but cannot hear, nor is there breath in their mouths.

source: Hicheho semho chu amaho tobangbou ahin; Chucheho tahsan chan jong chu chutima chu ahiuve.
target: Those who make them will be like them, and so will all who trust in them.

source: Vo Israel insung mite, Pakai chu vahchoijun; vo Aaron insung mite, Pakai chu vahchoijun.
target: All you Israelites, praise the Lord ; house of Aaron, praise the Lord ;

source: Vo Levi insung mite, Pakai chu vahchoijun; Pakai gingte nanghon, Pakai chu vahchoijun.
target: house of Levi, praise the Lord ; you who fear him, praise the Lord .

source: Jerusalem'a cheng Pakai chu, Zion'a konin nunnom hen, Pakai chu vahchoijun,
target: Praise be to the Lord from Zion, to him who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the Lord .

source: O aphat jeh-in Pakai henga thangvahna peuvin: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahin,
target: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good. His love endures forever.

source: O pathenho Pathen henga thangvahna peuvin: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: Give thanks to the God of gods. His love endures forever.

source: O pakaiho Pakai henga thangvahna peuvin: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: Give thanks to the Lord of lords: His love endures forever.

source: Amabou thilkidang loupitah bola ahi: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: to him who alone does great wonders, His love endures forever.

source: Chihna-a vanho sempa henga chun: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: who by his understanding made the heavens, His love endures forever.

source: Twipi chunga leiset phajalpa henga chun: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: who spread out the earth upon the waters, His love endures forever.

source: Vah loupitah sempa henga chun: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: who made the great lights— His love endures forever.

source: Sunna vaihom dinga nisa: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: the sun to govern the day, His love endures forever.

source: Janna vaihom dinga lhale ahsi ho: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: the moon and stars to govern the night; His love endures forever.

source: Egypt'a apeng masa jouse thatgam pa henga: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: to him who struck down the firstborn of Egypt His love endures forever.

source: Chule amaho lah-a kona Israelte puidoh: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: and brought Israel out from among them His love endures forever.

source: Khut thahat tah le aban lhangdoh pa: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: with a mighty hand and outstretched arm; His love endures forever.

source: Twipisan hopni-a homkhenpa henga chun: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: to him who divided the Red Sea asunder His love endures forever.

source: Chule chuche lailung Israelte palgal kaisahpa: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: and brought Israel through the midst of it, His love endures forever.

source: Ahinla Pharaoh le ami janelho twipi san sunga lehlutpa: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea; His love endures forever.

source: Gamthip lhonlhunga amite puilhung helpa henga: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: to him who led his people through the wilderness; His love endures forever.

source: Leng loupitah ho sumang helpa henga chun: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: to him who struck down great kings, His love endures forever.

source: Chule leng minthangho that gampa: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: and killed mighty kings— His love endures forever.

source: Amor mite lengpa Sihon: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: Sihon king of the Amorites His love endures forever.

source: Chule Bashan lengpa Og: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: and Og king of Bashan— His love endures forever.

source: Chule agamu goulo dinga pe-a: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: and gave their land as an inheritance, His love endures forever.

source: Asoh Israel henga goulo dinga pepa: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: an inheritance to his servant Israel. His love endures forever.

source: Ilhahsam laitah uva eina geldoh pao: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: He remembered us in our low estate His love endures forever.

source: Chule imelmateuva kona eilhat dohpao: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: and freed us from our enemies. His love endures forever.

source: Tahsa-a hung jouse nehding pepa: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: He gives food to every creature. His love endures forever.

source: O van Pathen henga thangvahna peuvin: ajehchu ami hepina tonsotna umjing ahi.
target: Give thanks to the God of heaven. His love endures forever.

source: Babylon vadungho pama chun katouvun, Zion kageldoh phatnun kakap taovin ahi.
target: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.

source: Huisum chungho-a chun ka selangdah hou kakhaijun ahi.
target: There on the poplars we hung our harps,

source: Ajehchu chukoma gal hinga eipuimang houchun la khat angeh-un; chule eibolgenthei houchun kipahtah-in eijolun, Zion la khat neisah peh-un atiuve.
target: for there our captors asked us for songs, our tormentors demanded songs of joy; they said, “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”

source: Mi gama keihon Pakai la chu iti kasah dingu ham?
target: How can we sing the songs of the Lord while in a foreign land?

source: Vo Jerusalem, nangma kasuhmila ahile, kakhut jetlam hin akhut themna sumil jenghen,
target: If I forget you, Jerusalem, may my right hand forget its skill.

source: nangma kageljing louva, kakipana pipen sanga Jerusalem kalhenjoh loule, kaleihi kadang chunga behden jenghen.
target: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not consider Jerusalem my highest joy.

source: Vo Pakai Jerusalem chim nikho-a, Edom miten anatoh-u chu geldoh-in; suchimun, a-inbul songho chu suchimun, tin asamui.
target: Remember, Lord , what the Edomites did on the day Jerusalem fell. “Tear it down,” they cried, “tear it down to its foundations!”

source: Suhmang dinga uma vo, Babylon chanu, keiho neibolnao banga nale thuhpa chu kipah hen.
target: Daughter Babylon, doomed to destruction, happy is the one who repays you according to what you have done to us.

source: Nachasenho man khoma songho jepna-a neipa chu kipah hen.
target: Happy is the one who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.

source: Kalungthim pumpin nangma vahchoi jinge, pathenho masang-ah keiman nangma vahchoi La sange.
target: I will praise you, Lord , with all my heart; before the “gods” I will sing your praise.

source: Na houin thenglam ngan na houvingting, chule nalungset ngailutna le nathupeh jallin namin vahchoi jinge; ajehchu namin jouse chungvuma, nathu nachoisangtai.
target: I will bow down toward your holy temple and will praise your name for your unfailing love and your faithfulness, for you have so exalted your solemn decree that it surpasses your fame.

source: Katao nikhon nangman neidonbut in, chule kahinna thahat napen, nahatsah tai.
target: When I called, you answered me; you greatly emboldened me.

source: Vo Pakai, amahon na kama thusoh ajah tengule, leiset leng jousen navahchoi diu ahi.
target: May all the kings of the earth praise you, Lord , when they hear what you have decreed.

source: Henge, amahon Pakai lampiho lan saovinte; ajehchu Pakai loupi nachu nasatah ahi.
target: May they sing of the ways of the Lord , for the glory of the Lord is great.

source: Pakai chu sanglheh jongle, mi noinungho ajaboljin, mi kiletsah vang gamlatah-in ahei.
target: Though the Lord is exalted, he looks kindly on the lowly; though lofty, he sees them from afar.

source: Lungkhamna lah-a vahle jongleng, nangin neisuhalin, kamelmate lunghanna chunga nakhut nalhan ding, chule najetlama nei huhhing ding ahi.
target: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you preserve my life. You stretch out your hand against the anger of my foes; with your right hand you save me.

source: Pakaiyin kachung chang thu chamkimsah inte, vo Pakai, nahepina tonsotna umjing ahi: Na khuttah-a nanatoh ho chu nungsun lou jenin.
target: The Lord will vindicate me; your love, Lord , endures forever— do not abandon the works of your hands.

source: Vo Pakai nangin neikhochillin neihetai.
target: You have searched me, Lord , and you know me.

source: Nangin katoulhah le kadindoh jong nahen, gamlatah-a konin ka lunggel ho jong nahen ahi.
target: You know when I sit and when I rise; you perceive my thoughts from afar.

source: Nangin kalampi le kaluplhah nakhol toh-in, chule kalampiho jouse nahechen sohkeije.
target: You discern my going out and my lying down; you are familiar with all my ways.

source: Ajehchu, vo Pakai, kaleija thu khatcha aumpon, ahinla vetan abonin na hesoh-in ahi.
target: Before a word is on my tongue you, Lord , know it completely.

source: Nangin kanungle kama-a nei-um ton, kachunga nakhut nangamjin ahi.
target: You hem me in behind and before, and you lay your hand upon me.

source: Chutobang hetna hi keidin akidang behseh-in, asangin, kasoh phajou poi.
target: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.

source: Nalhagaova kona hoilama kache-a, ahilouleh na-angsunga kona hoilama kajamding ham?
target: Where can I go from your Spirit? Where can I flee from your presence?

source: Van'a kaltou jongleng chu-a chun naumin, thikhol khul'a jalkhun kido jongleng, vetan, chumuna jong chun na-umme.
target: If I go up to the heavens, you are there; if I make my bed in the depths, you are there.

source: Jingkah lhavingho kilah ingting, twikhanglen mongpeh-a gacheng jongleng,
target: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle on the far side of the sea,

source: Chukom jenga jong chun nakhutnin neikaijin natin, nakhut jetna neituh ding ahi.
target: even there your hand will guide me, your right hand will hold me fast.

source: Thonlouva muthimin eikhuding ahi tijongleng, jan jengjong chu kavela vah hiding ahi.
target: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me and the light become night around me,”

source: Henge, muthim chu nanga konin akiselpon, jan chu sun bangin avahjoi, nangdia muthimle khovah ania kibang ahi.
target: even the darkness will not be dark to you; the night will shine like the day, for darkness is as light to you.

source: Ajehchu kasungil jouse jong nangma gontoh ahin, nangin kanu naobu sunga neinakhu ahi.
target: For you created my inmost being; you knit me together in my mother’s womb.

source: Kichat um le kidangtah-a kisem kahi jeh-in, nangma Kavah choije; nanatoh hohi datmo aumin, chule hichu kahina hin ahechen lheh-e.
target: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.

source: Aguh-a eikisema chun ka gong hi namasanga akiselpoi, kidang tah-a leiset noinung pena eikisem ahi.
target: My frame was not hidden from you when I was made in the secret place, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.

source: Katibah jouse hi khatcha aum masang, chamkim loulai ka gong hi namitnin namun; nalekhabu-a chu hicheho jouse hi akisemjou masanga kisun sohkei ahitai.
target: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all the days ordained for me were written in your book before one of them came to be.

source: Vo Pathen nalunggel ho hi keidia iti mantam hitam! akisuhto khom chu iti natsatna hitam!
target: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is the sum of them!

source: Kasimding hitale neldi sanga tamjo ahiuvin; kakhahdoh jengin jong nangto kaum khom nalaije.
target: Were I to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand— when I awake, I am still with you.

source: Vo Pathen, migilou chu thonlouva nathatei ding ahin, hijeh chun nangho thisan sohatte, keija konin potdoh-un.
target: If only you, God, would slay the wicked! Away from me, you who are bloodthirsty!

source: Ajehchu nangma dounan giloutah-in thu aseijun, chule namelma ten mohseh-in namin apanuve.
target: They speak of you with evil intent; your adversaries misuse your name.

source: Vo Pakai nahote chu kahotbol louham? Chule nangma douna-a kipatdoh ho chunga kalungphatmo louham?
target: Do I not hate those who hate you, Lord , and abhor those who are in rebellion against you?

source: Amaho chu hot atin kaho-in; kamelma-a kasimu ahitai.
target: I have nothing but hatred for them; I count them my enemies.

source: O Pathen, Neikhol chilin chule Kalungthim hi he-in; nei patepmin, chule kalunggel hohi hechenin.
target: Search me, God, and know my heart; test me and know my anxious thoughts.

source: Chule ven keija hin khangitlouna lampi khattou aumdem, chule tonsot lampia chun neipuijin.
target: See if there is any offensive way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

source: Vo Pakai, miphalouva konchun neihuh doh-in, hunam miho-a konchun neiveng tupmin.
target: Rescue me, Lord , from evildoers; protect me from the violent,

source: Alunguvin lheplhahna angaitouvin, tanglouvin galboldin akikhom khom jiuve.
target: who devise evil plans in their hearts and stir up war every day.

source: Aleiju gul bangin anol hemun, alei noijuva gulsum gu aumme. Selah
target: They make their tongues as sharp as a serpent’s; the poison of vipers is on their lips.

source: Vo Pakai migilou khutna konin neingahphan, kachena suhboi ding eigo-a, hunam miho-a konin neihongphan.
target: Keep me safe, Lord , from the hands of the wicked; protect me from the violent, who devise ways to trip my feet.

source: Mi kiletsah hon thang le khaohol eikampeh-un, lamsih-a lenthang aphaovin, amahon thang eikam khumuve. Selah
target: The arrogant have hidden a snare for me; they have spread out the cords of their net and have set traps for me along my path.

source: Keiman Pakai henga chun, nangma ka Pathen nahi kati, vo Pakai kataona aw hi ngaijin.
target: I say to the Lord , “You are my God.” Hear, Lord , my cry for mercy.

source: Vo Pakai Pathen, kahuh hingna thahat; nangman gal kisat nikhon kalu neikhu peh-e.
target: Sovereign Lord , my strong deliverer, you shield my head in the day of battle.

source: Vo Pakai, migilou ngaichat chu phalpeh hih-in, aduha lungthim gilou chu pilhinsah hih-in, achutiloule kichoisang getnunte. Selah
target: Do not grant the wicked their desires, Lord ; do not let their plans succeed.

source: Eium chahho luchang chu, amaho kamtah-a lheplhahna chun khukhumhen.
target: Those who surround me proudly rear their heads; may the mischief of their lips engulf them.

source: Mei am lenglung chu achunguva hungchu hen, ama ahung kithodoh kitna loudiuvin, kotong thuh tahle meikong lah-a chun kisep lutnu hen.
target: May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, never to rise.

source: Thuse seija leisetna kitungdoh hihhen, hunam mang chu setna-in suhlhuh dia anungjui ding ahi.
target: May slanderers not be established in the land; may disaster hunt down the violent.

source: Akibol gentheite thu leh vaichate dihna chu, Pakaiyin suhdih peh inte ti kahei.
target: I know that the Lord secures justice for the poor and upholds the cause of the needy.

source: Michonphan thonlouva namin athangvah ding; Midih chu na angsunga cheng ding ahi.
target: Surely the righteous will praise your name, and the upright will live in your presence.

source: Pakai nangma kakouve, nangma kakou tengle ka aw-a hin nana hinsung loijin.
target: I call to you, Lord , come quickly to me; hear me when I call to you.

source: Kataona ginnamtui bangin na-anga kitungdoh hen, chule kakhut dopsanghi nilhah lam ganlhaina bang hihen.
target: May my prayer be set before you like incense; may the lifting up of my hands be like the evening sacrifice.

source: Vo Pakai, kakam kamdal neikoi peh in, kakam nei ngatup peh-in.
target: Set a guard over my mouth, Lord ; keep watch over the door of my lips.

source: Kalungthim hi thilse lama lutsah hih-in, khanset bol mihem natoh phalou kijildin nopsah hih-in, chule a-anneh tuihou neinehsah hih-in.
target: Do not let my heart be drawn to what is evil so that I take part in wicked deeds along with those who are evildoers; do not let me eat their delicacies.

source: Michonphan eivohen, hichu lungsetna hinte, chule eiphohsal hen, hichu thao nasatah hiding ahi, hichun kalu suheh ponte, ajehchu avangsetnao sanna kataopeh ding ahi.
target: Let a righteous man strike me—that is a kindness; let him rebuke me—that is oil on my head. My head will not refuse it, for my prayer will still be against the deeds of evildoers.

source: Athutanhou songhol lah-a akipailhah tengle, hiche hochu alhum jeh-in, kathu ngaitao vinte,
target: Their rulers will be thrown down from the cliffs, and the wicked will learn that my words were well spoken.

source: Khattouvin tolla thing atanna a-ea bangin, kaguhou lhankhuh kama akithecheh gamtai.
target: They will say, “As one plows and breaks up the earth, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of the grave.”

source: Ahinla vo Pakai Pathen, kamitnin nangma lam akatjingin, nangma-a katahsan kangame, ka hinna hi gentheijin dalha hih-in.
target: But my eyes are fixed on you, Sovereign Lord ; in you I take refuge—do not give me over to death.

source: Keidinga athang kamhouva konle, khangitlou bolho-a konin neihongbit in.
target: Keep me safe from the traps set by evildoers, from the snares they have laid for me.

source: Keima kakitoldoh laitah-in, migilouho chu amahotah lensunga lhalut uhen.
target: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.

source: Ka aw-in Pakai kakouvin, ka aw in Pakai henga ngehna kaneije.
target: I cry aloud to the Lord ; I lift up my voice to the Lord for mercy.

source: Amasanga kalunglhai louna kasam phongin, a-angsunga kalung khamna kamusah-e.
target: I pour out before him my complaint; before him I tell my trouble.

source: Kasunga um lhagao agenthei tengle, nangin kalampi nahejinai. Kakeng lamlhahna-a guhthimin amahon keidin thang eikampeh-un ahi.
target: When my spirit grows faint within me, it is you who watch over my way. In the path where I walk people have hidden a snare for me.

source: Kakhut jetlam kavetle, veuvin eihuhding mi khatchala aumpon; belding kaneipoi; Koimachan kahinna akhohsahpoi.
target: Look and see, there is no one at my right hand; no one is concerned for me. I have no refuge; no one cares for my life.

source: Vo Pakai nahenga kataove; Nangma mihing gama kakiselna ding le kachan nahi katin ahi.
target: I cry to you, Lord ; I say, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

source: Eikisuhneo behseh jeh-in, ka kana ngaijin, amaho kei sanga ahatjoh jeh-un, eibol gentheiho-a konin neihuh doh-in.
target: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need; rescue me from those who pursue me, for they are too strong for me.

source: Namin kavahchoi theinadin sohchan na-a konin kahinna puidoh in, nangman ninglhing keija neibolphat ding jeh-a, michonpha ten eiumkim veldiu ahi.
target: Set me free from my prison, that I may praise your name. Then the righteous will gather about me because of your goodness to me.

source: Vo Pakai kataona ngaijin lang, kangehna-a nana sungin, nakitahna leh nachon phatna-a chun neidonbut in.
target: Lord , hear my prayer, listen to my cry for mercy; in your faithfulness and righteousness come to my relief.

source: Chule nasohhi thutan na-a nei lutpi hih-in, ajehchu namitmu-a mihing khatcha chonpha aumpoi.
