target: Do not bring your servant into judgment, for no one living is righteous before you.

source: Ajehchu melman kahinna abolgimin, kahinkho hi tolla avolhun: sotna anathisaho bangin muthima eichen sah-e.
target: The enemy pursues me, he crushes me to the ground; he makes me dwell in the darkness like those long dead.

source: Hijeh chun kalhagao kasunga athoh gimmin, kalungthim hi kasunga agoh ahitai.
target: So my spirit grows faint within me; my heart within me is dismayed.

source: Khanglui nikhoho kageldoh in, nathilbol ho jouse kangaitojin, nakhut thilbolho kasutjin ahi.
target: I remember the days of long ago; I meditate on all your works and consider what your hands have done.

source: Nahenglam kakhutnin kahin sange, kahinna hi dangchah na gam bangin, nangma ngaicha-in adangchah-e. Selah
target: I spread out my hands to you; I thirst for you like a parched land.

source: Vo Pakai neidonbut loijin, kalhagao alhasamtai, leiko sunga kumsuh ho kabah lounadin, keija konin namai selmang hih-in.
target: Answer me quickly, Lord ; my spirit fails. Do not hide your face from me or I will be like those who go down to the pit.

source: Nangma katahsan jeh-in, jingkah teng nalungsetna neijah sah-in, kahinna naheng lama kadop sang jing jeh-in, chena ding lampi neihetsah-in.
target: Let the morning bring me word of your unfailing love, for I have put my trust in you. Show me the way I should go, for to you I entrust my life.

source: Vo Pakai kamelma te-a konin neihuh doh-in, nahenga kisel dinga hungjam kahi.
target: Rescue me from my enemies, Lord , for I hide myself in you.

source: Nangma ka Pathen nahi jeh-in nadeilam bolje neihilin, Na Lhagaohi aphai, chondihna gama neipuijin.
target: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God; may your good Spirit lead me on level ground.

source: Vo Pakai namin jal-in neihin sah-in, ajehchu nachon phatna jal-in, lungkham na-a konin kahinna hi puidoh-in.
target: For your name’s sake, Lord , preserve my life; in your righteousness, bring me out of trouble.

source: Chule nahepina-a kamelmate subei jinlang, kahinna bol gentheiteho jouse sumangin, ajehchu nalhacha kahi.
target: In your unfailing love, silence my enemies; destroy all my foes, for I am your servant.

source: Kakhutho galboldan, kakhut jungho galsatdan hillah; kahatna Pakai chu nunnom hen.
target: Praise be to the Lord my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle.

source: Kahatnale kakulpi, ka insang le kakihuhdohna, kalumdal le katahsan kingapna, kamite kanoija kunsahpa.
target: He is my loving God and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer, my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.

source: Pakai, mihemhi ipi hija, nahiti lungvil tenna! ahiloule mihem chapahi ipi hija, nahiti khohsah ham!
target: Lord , what are human beings that you care for them, mere mortals that you think of them?

source: Mihemhi pannabei tobang ahin, anikhoho jong nisalim kiheimang bangbep bou ahi.
target: They are like a breath; their days are like a fleeting shadow.

source: Vo Pakai navanho sonkunin hungkum lhan lang, molsangho chu tongkha lechun, meikhun lengunte.
target: Part your heavens, Lord , and come down; touch the mountains, so that they smoke.

source: Kolphetsah inlang amaho sucheh-in, nathalchangho kapdoh inlang amaho sumangin.
target: Send forth lightning and scatter the enemy; shoot your arrows and rout them.

source: Chunga konin nakhut hin lhangin lang, neilha doh-in, twipi nasatahho lah-a konle, gamdangmi chate-a konin neihuh doh-in;
target: Reach down your hand from on high; deliver me and rescue me from the mighty waters, from the hands of foreigners

source: Akamun thu manlou aseijun, akhut jetlamu chu joujou khut jetlam ahibouve.
target: whose mouths are full of lies, whose right hands are deceitful.

source: Vo Pathen, nahenga lathah khat sange; tumging le manchah jangsom neijin nangma vahchoi La sange.
target: I will sing a new song to you, my God; on the ten-stringed lyre I will make music to you,

source: Lengho henga huhhingna pe-a ama ahin, aman asoh David kisuhkhahna chemjam'a konin ahuhdoh-e.
target: to the One who gives victory to kings, who delivers his servant David. From the deadly sword

source: Gamchom chate-a konin neilha doh-in, neihuh doh-in, akamun mohthu aseijun, akhut jetnu chu khutjet dihlou ahi.
target: deliver me; rescue me from the hands of foreigners whose mouths are full of lies, whose right hands are deceitful.

source: Ka chapateu khangdong ho chu thingphung khangtou bang uhen, ka chanuteu chu leng in ninga song kipotjola bang uhen.
target: Then our sons in their youth will be like well-nurtured plants, and our daughters will be like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

source: Kachang inhou adima, akikholna jouse anenchet nadin, ka kelngoi teovin kakholai lamlen houva sang sangle sangsom cheng hinguhen.
target: Our barns will be filled with every kind of provision. Our sheep will increase by thousands, by tens of thousands in our fields;

source: Kabongchal hou natoh-a ahatnuva, kakholai houva thunoh asolouna din, golkeh louleh potdoh louvin umuhen.
target: our oxen will draw heavy loads. There will be no breaching of walls, no going into captivity, no cry of distress in our streets.

source: Chutobanga um miho chu avangpha ahiuve, henge, a-Pathen'u Pakai hia mite chu avangpha ahiuve.
target: Blessed is the people of whom this is true; blessed is the people whose God is the Lord .

source: Ka Pathen, vo lengpa nangma vahchoi jingting, chule atonsot atonsotnin namin choi-an inge.
target: I will exalt you, my God the King; I will praise your name for ever and ever.

source: Aniseh-in choi-an ningting, chule atonsot atonsotnin namin vahchoi jinge.
target: Every day I will praise you and extol your name for ever and ever.

source: Pakai chu aloupi-in, sangtah-a vahchoi ding ahi; chule aloupinahi holdoh jouhoi ahipoi.
target: Great is the Lord and most worthy of praise; his greatness no one can fathom.

source: Nanatoh hohi khang khatnin, akhangkit geija avahchoija, chule thanei tah-a natohho aphon dohdiu ahi.
target: One generation commends your works to another; they tell of your mighty acts.

source: Nalal loupina le jana chu keiman seijing ting, nathilbol kidangho seijing kate.
target: They speak of the glorious splendor of your majesty— and I will meditate on your wonderful works.

source: Miten nathilbol gimneitahho thaneije seijuntin, chule keiman naloupina kaphonjal ding ahi.
target: They tell of the power of your awesome works— and I will proclaim your great deeds.

source: Amahon lhingsetnin naphatna loupitah geldoh untin, chule nachon phatna chu la'n saovinte.
target: They celebrate your abundant goodness and joyfully sing of your righteousness.

source: Pakai chu lungsetna le khotona-a dimset ahin, lunghang vahlou, chule hepina dimset ahi.
target: The Lord is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and rich in love.

source: Pakai chu mitin din aphan; chule ahepina chu anatoh jouse chunga aume.
target: The Lord is good to all; he has compassion on all he has made.

source: Vo Pakai nathilbol jousen navahchoi juntin, chule namitheng ten nachoi-at dingu ahi.
target: All your works praise you, Lord ; your faithful people extol you.

source: Amahon nalenggam loupije seijuntin, chule nathaneije asei dingu ahi.
target: They tell of the glory of your kingdom and speak of your might,

source: Athilbol thahatje mihem chapate ahetsah ding; chule alenggam lal loupi ahetsah ding ahi.
target: so that all people may know of your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of your kingdom.

source: Nalenggam chu tonsot lenggam ahin, chule navai homna akhang khanga um jingding ahi.
target: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your dominion endures through all generations. The Lord is trustworthy in all he promises and faithful in all he does.

source: Pakaiyin alhu jouse akaidingin, chule aki sonkunho jouse akaithouvin ahi.
target: The Lord upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.

source: Nangma velhijinga um mitjouse chu; aphatchan anehdiu napejin ahi.
target: The eyes of all look to you, and you give them their food at the proper time.

source: Nangin nakhut najah-in, ahingthei jouse angaichat cheh-un nalung lhaisahjin ahi.
target: You open your hand and satisfy the desires of every living thing.

source: Pakai chu alampi jouse-a chonpha ahin, anatoh jouse-a athenge.
target: The Lord is righteous in all his ways and faithful in all he does.

source: Pakaiyin akoute jouse heng anaijin, dihtah-a ama koute jouse heng anaije.
target: The Lord is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

source: Aman ama gingte ngaichat suhbulhit peh intin, ataonao asan peh-a, ahuhhing diu ahi.
target: He fulfills the desires of those who fear him; he hears their cry and saves them.

source: Pakaiyin ama ngailuho jouse hongbit nintin, migilou jouse vang asuhmang ding ahi.
target: The Lord watches over all who love him, but all the wicked he will destroy.

source: Kakamin pakai vahchoina thu asei ding ahi; tahsa mihing jousen amintheng atonsot atonsotnin vahchoi uhen.
target: My mouth will speak in praise of the Lord . Let every creature praise his holy name for ever and ever.

source: Pakai chu vahchoijun, Vo kahinna Pakai chu vahchoijin.
target: Praise the Lord . Praise the Lord , my soul.

source: Kahinlaisen Pakai chu vahchoi jingting, limle mel kanei laisen Pakai vahchoi la sange.
target: I will praise the Lord all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.

source: Pipuiho chunga natahsana ngam hih-in; ama-a panpina umlou mihem chapate jong tahsan hih-in.
target: Do not put your trust in princes, in human beings, who cannot save.

source: Ahaina achedohjin ama aleisetnah akilejin; hiche ni chuleh alunggel jouse abeiji tai.
target: When their spirit departs, they return to the ground; on that very day their plans come to nothing.

source: Akithopi dinga Jacob Pathen neikha-a; akinepna Pakai a-Pathen hikha-a michu anunnom ahi.
target: Blessed are those whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the Lord their God.

source: Vanle leiset chule twikhanglen le asunga umjouse sempa; a-imatih channa thutah tuhjingpa chu ahi.
target: He is the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them— he remains faithful forever.

source: Aman akijoulhepho thu atanlhah peh-in; aman agilkelho an apen ahi. Pakai chun sohchangho alhatdoh tan ahi.
target: He upholds the cause of the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free,

source: Pakaiyin mitcho ho ahasah-in; Pakaiyin akineosah hochu akaithouve: Pakaiyin michonpha ho angailui.
target: the Lord gives sight to the blind, the Lord lifts up those who are bowed down, the Lord loves the righteous.

source: Pakaiyin kholjin miho ahongbitnin, aman pabeiho le meithaiho a-olsahtai; migilouho lampi vang akhup athallin alehjin ahi.
target: The Lord watches over the foreigner and sustains the fatherless and the widow, but he frustrates the ways of the wicked.

source: Vo Zion na Pakai na-Pathen tah chun khangjouse chunga lengvai apoh ding ahi. Pakai chu vahchoijun.
target: The Lord reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Praise the Lord .

source: Pakai chu vahchoijun, ajehchu i-Pathen'u henga vahchoi la sah hi anomin; kipa aumin, chule vahchoi dinga lomtah ahi.
target: Praise the Lord . How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and fitting to praise him!

source: Pakaiyin Jerusalem asadoh-in; aman akinodohsa Israelte chu akhom khome.
target: The Lord builds up Jerusalem; he gathers the exiles of Israel.

source: Aman lungthima natna neiho asudamin; chule amaha puthou atompehjin ahi.
target: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

source: Aman ahsi ho jat aseijin; abonchauvin aminu avo soh keijin ahi.
target: He determines the number of the stars and calls them each by name.

source: I-Pakaiyu alenin, thahat tah ahi; ahetkhen themna chu akhonna bei ahi.
target: Great is our Lord and mighty in power; his understanding has no limit.

source: Pakaiyin mi kineosah ho adomsangin; migiloute chu tolla aseplhan ahi.
target: The Lord sustains the humble but casts the wicked to the ground.

source: Thangvah pumin Pakai henga la saovin; i-Pathen'u henga selangdah tothon vahchoi la saovin.
target: Sing to the Lord with grateful praise; make music to our God on the harp.

source: Aman van chu meilom'in atomin, leiset dingin go agongtoh-in, molsangho chunga kehdin hampa aseme.
target: He covers the sky with clouds; he supplies the earth with rain and makes grass grow on the hills.

source: Aman gamsaho a-an nehdiu apen; va-ah nou gilkelho aneh dingu apen ahi.
target: He provides food for the cattle and for the young ravens when they call.

source: Ama sakol ho hatna-a akipahpon; mihem kenga jong kipana aneipoi.
target: His pleasure is not in the strength of the horse, nor his delight in the legs of the warrior;

source: Pakai chu ama gingte chunga akipah-in; ahepina-a kinemho chunga akipah-in ahi.
target: the Lord delights in those who fear him, who put their hope in his unfailing love.

source: Vo Jerusalem, Pakai chu vahchoijin; vo Zion na Pathen chu vahchoijin.
target: Extol the Lord , Jerusalem; praise your God, Zion.

source: Aman nakul kotpi kotgol ho ahamsah-in; nasunga nachate phatthei aboh-in ahi.
target: He strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses your people within you.

source: Nagam gi ho-ah cham alensah-in; suhlouchang phapenin nadipdim tan ahi.
target: He grants peace to your borders and satisfies you with the finest of wheat.

source: Aman leiset chunga athupeh ahinsol doh-in; Athu chu gangtah-in alhaijin ahi.
target: He sends his command to the earth; his word runs swiftly.

source: Aman buhbang kelngoi mul bangin apen; buhlhah chu vutvam bangin athejaovin ahi.
target: He spreads the snow like wool and scatters the frost like ashes.

source: Aman abuhlhang ankong bangin athejalin; hiche adap masanga chu koi dingjou dingham?
target: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can withstand his icy blast?

source: Aman thu apehleh hichu ajunlha tan; Ahui anunsah-in ahile twi ahung longtai.
target: He sends his word and melts them; he stirs up his breezes, and the waters flow.

source: Aman athu chu Jacob henga amusah-in; adan thuho le athutan chu Israel amusah tan ahi.
target: He has revealed his word to Jacob, his laws and decrees to Israel.

source: Aman koima nam achutibol khapon; ama thutan lhahho jong amahon ahepha pouve. Pakai chu vahchoijun.
target: He has done this for no other nation; they do not know his laws. Praise the Lord .

source: Pakai chu vahchoijun, van ho-a konin Pakai vahchoijun; chungsang ho-a chun vahchoijun.
target: Praise the Lord . Praise the Lord from the heavens; praise him in the heights above.

source: Avantil jousen, Pakai vahchoijun; ami janelten ama vahchoijun.
target: Praise him, all his angels; praise him, all his heavenly hosts.

source: Nisa le lhathah-in ama vahchoijun; nangho ahsi vahho jousen ama vahchoijun.
target: Praise him, sun and moon; praise him, all you shining stars.

source: Nangho vanlaijola vanhon ama vahchoijun; vanho chungvuma twipihon ama vahchoijun.
target: Praise him, you highest heavens and you waters above the skies.

source: Amahon Pakai min vahchoi uhen; ajehchu aman thu apeh-a, amaho kisem ahiuve.
target: Let them praise the name of the Lord , for at his command they were created,

source: Aman amaho tonsot atonsotna din aphutdetnin; apalkehlou diuvin thupeh apen ahi.
target: and he established them for ever and ever— he issued a decree that will never pass away.

source: Nangho dragon ho le twithuh ho jousen; Leisetna konin Pakai chu Vahchoijun;
target: Praise the Lord from the earth, you great sea creatures and all ocean depths,

source: Mei le gel, buhbang le meijun; khopi huijin athu aguilhunsah-in ahi.
target: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy winds that do his bidding,

source: Molsangho le lhangho; thingphung ga phaho le cedar thingho:
target: you mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

source: Gamsaho le gancha jouse; tolla kitholho le chungleng vachaho:
target: wild animals and all cattle, small creatures and flying birds,

source: Leija lengho le mihem jouse; pipuiho le leiset thutan ho jouse:
target: kings of the earth and all nations, you princes and all rulers on earth,

source: Gollhangho le nungah ho; tehse ho le chapangho:
target: young men and women, old men and children.

source: Amahon Pakai minchu vahchoi uhen: Ama minbou chu chungnunpen ahin; aloupina leile van chungvuma uma ahi.
target: Let them praise the name of the Lord , for his name alone is exalted; his splendor is above the earth and the heavens.

source: Mithengte jouse choi-at nan; Israel chate, ama kinaipi mite choi-at nan; Aman amite ki adomsangtai. Pakai chu vahchoijun.
target: And he has raised up for his people a horn, the praise of all his faithful servants, of Israel, the people close to his heart. Praise the Lord .

source: Pakai vahchoijun. Pakai vahchoina lathah khat saovin lang; mithengte houkhom na-a ama vahchoina la saovin.
target: Praise the Lord . Sing to the Lord a new song, his praise in the assembly of his faithful people.

source: Israel chu ama hinsem Pa-ah kipah hen; Zion chate chu alengpao chunga thanomu hen.
target: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the people of Zion be glad in their King.

source: Lam to thon amin vahchoi uhen; khongchale selangdah-in avahchoila saohen.
target: Let them praise his name with dancing and make music to him with timbrel and harp.

source: Ajehchu Pakai amite chunga alunglhaijin; Aman mi nunnem chu huhhingna-a ajephoi ding ahi.
target: For the Lord takes delight in his people; he crowns the humble with victory.

source: Mithengte chu loupi na-in kipah uhen; ajalkhun hou chunguva gingtah-in la saohen.
target: Let his faithful people rejoice in this honor and sing for joy on their beds.

source: Akamuva Pathen sangtah-in vahchoi uhen; akhutnuva hemto chemjam kidop uhen;
target: May the praise of God be in their mouths and a double-edged sword in their hands,

source: Pathen hephalouho chunga phulahna chuhsah dingle mitin chunga engbolna chuhsah ding;
target: to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,

source: Alengteu thihkhaova hen dingle, amilalteu thihbul tuh ding;
target: to bind their kings with fetters, their nobles with shackles of iron,

source: Thutanlhah kijihdohsa achunguva tongdoh dingin, hiche jana hi amithengte jousen aneijun ahi. Pakai chu vahchoijun.
target: to carry out the sentence written against them— this is the glory of all his faithful people. Praise the Lord .

source: Pakai chu vahchoijun. Amuntheng sunga Pathen vahchoijun, athil boltheina vanthamjol lah-a ama vahchoijun.
target: Praise the Lord . Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in his mighty heavens.

source: Anatoh kidangtahho jal-in ama vahchoijun, alet loupina dungjuijin ama vahchoijun.
target: Praise him for his acts of power; praise him for his surpassing greatness.

source: Sumkon ginnin ama vahchoijun, tumgingto selangdah-in vahchoijun.
target: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet, praise him with the harp and lyre,

source: Khongchale lamin ama vahchoijun, tumging tho-a manchah le semjang binei tho-in vahchoijun.
target: praise him with timbrel and dancing, praise him with the strings and pipe,

source: Khutbeh ginnin ama vahchoijun, khutbeh gin thong jejun ama vahchoijun.
target: praise him with the clash of cymbals, praise him with resounding cymbals.

source: Haitheina neijousen Pakai chu vahchoi uhen, Pakai chu vahchoijun.
target: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord . Praise the Lord .

source: Israel leng David chapa Solomon thuchih ho;
target: The proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel:

source: Chihna leh kihilna hetna ding, hettheina thuho kimudohna ding;
target: for gaining wisdom and instruction; for understanding words of insight;

source: Chihna, thutah, thutan lhahna chule thudih kihilnaho kisana ding:
target: for receiving instruction in prudent behavior, doing what is right and just and fair;

source: Milhamho gelchet theina, khangdongpa hetnale thil hetkhen them theina pehnading ahi.
target: for giving prudence to those who are simple, knowledge and discretion to the young—

source: Michingin ngaijin tin ahetna kibeding, chule hetthem theina nei michun themna akimuding ahi.
target: let the wise listen and add to their learning, and let the discerning get guidance—

source: Thuchih le aledohna hetnading; miching thusei ho le giltah-a thu kiseiho hetkhenthem theina ding ahi.
target: for understanding proverbs and parables, the sayings and riddles of the wise.

source: Pakai gin kitihi hetna bulpi kipatna ahin, ahinla mingol hon vang chihna le kihilna asang pouvin ahi.
target: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

source: Kachapa napan nahilna ngaijin, chule nanu thupeh chu nahsahmon koihih-in,
target: Listen, my son, to your father’s instruction and do not forsake your mother’s teaching.

source: Ajehchu hicheho chu naluchanga dinga kijep hoina hiding, chule nangonga dinga khivui tobang hiding ahi.
target: They are a garland to grace your head and a chain to adorn your neck.

source: Kachapa, michonse hon jollhah ding nagot tenguleh nomhih helin.
target: My son, if sinful men entice you, do not give in to them.

source: Amahon naheng-ah, hungin keihotoh thisanso ding ngah-u hitin, mona neilouho chu ajeh beijin guhthimin changu hite atiuva ahileh,
target: If they say, “Come along with us; let’s lie in wait for innocent blood, let’s ambush some harmless soul;

source: Kokhuh sunga lhalut ho bangin, eihon amaho khu ahing sanun, apumchangin lhankhuh sunga vallutnu hite.
target: let’s swallow them alive, like the grave, and whole, like those who go down to the pit;

source: Eihon chutia chu thillu jouse ikimudoh dingu, thil kichom doh-a chu i-in'u idipdim dingu ahi.
target: we will get all sorts of valuable things and fill our houses with plunder;

source: Keiholah-a navang hung kisanin; ibonun sumdip khat neikhomu hite.
target: cast lots with us; we will all share the loot”—

source: Kachapa amahotoh alamlhah uva chekhom hih-in; amaho lampia konin nakeng tuhtangin.
target: my son, do not go along with them, do not set foot on their paths;

source: Ajehchu akenghou chu aselama alhaijin; chule thisan sona lamah ajangkai uvin ahi.
target: for their feet rush into evil, they are swift to shed blood.

source: Tahbeh mongin vacha jouse mitmun panna beijin len chu akijal tan ahi.
target: How useless to spread a net where every bird can see it!

source: Chule amahon amahole amaho thisan kiso dingjoh angah-un; amahole amaho hinkhojoh chu guhthimin achangun ahi.
target: These men lie in wait for their own blood; they ambush only themselves!

source: Mipapseho lampi chu chutobang ding ahibouve; hichun aneiho tah hinkho jongchu alamangjin ahi.
target: Such are the paths of all who go after ill-gotten gain; it takes away the life of those who get it.

source: Chihnan lamlhong dunga asamlen, amanun lamkon tinchenga awthongin asamlelen ahi.
target: Out in the open wisdom calls aloud, she raises her voice in the public square;

source: Amanun lamthompi dungle kotpi lutna ho-a alhang samlen, khopi sunga amanun thu hitihin aseije,
target: on top of the wall she cries out, at the city gate she makes her speech:

source: Nangho milhamhon, itihchan milhama umding nangai nahlai dingu ham? chule mitaitom ho amitaitom naova thanom jinguva, chule mingolten hetna ahotnahlai dingu ham?
target: “How long will you who are simple love your simple ways? How long will mockers delight in mockery and fools hate knowledge?

source: Kaphosalna hi nanghon ngaijun: veuvin, keiman nachung uva kalhagao kahin buhlhah ding, chule kathu kahin hetsah ding nahiuve.
target: Repent at my rebuke! Then I will pour out my thoughts to you, I will make known to you my teachings.

source: Ajehchu keiman kakouvin, nangho nanom pouve; Keiman kakhutnin kahinsangun, koiman nei ngaisah pouve.
target: But since you refuse to listen when I call and no one pays attention when I stretch out my hand,

source: Ahinla kahilna jouse nanghon lahlou nahisah taovin, chule kaphosalna jong iman nasep pouve.
target: since you disregard all my advice and do not accept my rebuke,

source: Keiman jong nangho hamsetna chu kanuisat ding, natijat nao ahunglhun teng nahsah-a kaneilou ding;
target: I in turn will laugh when disaster strikes you; I will mock when calamity overtakes you—

source: Natijat naochu manthah na banga ahunglhuna, chule nakisuhmang naochu chimpei banga ahung lhunteng, gentheina le lungdonna nachung uva ahungchuh tengleh khohsahna kanei louding nahiuve.
target: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when disaster sweeps over you like a whirlwind, when distress and trouble overwhelm you.

source: Chutengle amahon thonlouva keima eihinkou dingu, hijongle keiman kadonbut louding; amahon keima eihinhol loi dingu, hijongle eimudoh loudingu ahi.
target: “Then they will call to me but I will not answer; they will look for me but will not find me,

source: Achuti theina dinga amahon hetna chu anahotnu ahin, chule Pakai gin kitichu anakilhen louvu ahi.
target: since they hated knowledge and did not choose to fear the Lord .

source: Amahon kathumop angainom pouvin, amahon kiphosalna jong anahsah pouvin ahi.
target: Since they would not accept my advice and spurned my rebuke,

source: Hijeh-a chu amahon achonnau ga akineh dingu, chule athil gonhouva chu dimding ahiuve.
target: they will eat the fruit of their ways and be filled with the fruit of their schemes.

source: Ajehchu milhamho chu akihei mangnao chun atha dingu, chule mingol ho chu aphat theinao chun asuhmang dingu ahi.
target: For the waywardness of the simple will kill them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them;

source: Ahin koi hijongleh keima sei ngaija chu bitkeija cheng ding, chule thilphalou kichatna-a kona hoidoh teiding ahi.
target: but whoever listens to me will live in safety and be at ease, without fear of harm.”

source: Kachapa, nangman kathuseiho nakisana, chule kathupeh ho nakichin tupma ahile;
target: My son, if you accept my words and store up my commands within you,

source: Chutia chu chihna lama nanakhang nasun geh-a, hetkhenthem theina lama nalung naman chah-a;
target: turning your ear to wisdom and applying your heart to understanding—

source: Chule nangman hetna ding gunchu tah-a nahola, hetkhenthem theina dinga aw thong jena nasapma;
target: indeed, if you call out for insight and cry aloud for understanding,

source: Nangman amanu chu dangka banga nahola, chule gou kiselu banga nakhol chila ahileh;
target: and if you look for it as for silver and search for it as for hidden treasure,

source: Chuteng nangman Pakai gin kitihi nahet khending; chule Pathen hetna hi nakimudoh teiding ahi.
target: then you will understand the fear of the Lord and find the knowledge of God.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin chihna apen, akam sunga konin hetna leh hetkhenthem theina asodoh-in ahi.
target: For the Lord gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and understanding.

source: Aman michonpha ho dingin chihna phatah akoipeh-in; dihtah-a chonteho dingin ama chu lumdal'in apangin ahi.
target: He holds success in store for the upright, he is a shield to those whose walk is blameless,

source: Aman thu adih-a kitana lampiho chu aching tupmin, chule amithengte lampi chu aveng tupmin ahi.
target: for he guards the course of the just and protects the way of his faithful ones.

source: Chuteng nangman chonphatna, thutandih, thildih, chule lampipha ho jouse hethem tan nate.
target: Then you will understand what is right and just and fair—every good path.

source: Chihna nalung sunga alutna, chule hetna chu nahinna-a dinga kipana ahunghi tengle;
target: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

source: Chihtheina chun nangma nahoitup ding, hetkhenthem theinan nangma naventup ding ahi.
target: Discretion will protect you, and understanding will guard you.

source: Hichun migiloupa lampia konle, jouthu thilho seipa akon;
target: Wisdom will save you from the ways of wicked men, from men whose words are perverse,

source: Milungdih lampiho peldoh-a, muthim lampiho joh-a chepa-a kon;
target: who have left the straight paths to walk in dark ways,

source: Thilse bolna-a kipah-a, chule khangitlouna le engsetna-a thanom ho-a kon;
target: who delight in doing wrong and rejoice in the perverseness of evil,

source: Alampihou koile-a, chuleh alampi houva vahlon leho-a kona, huhdoh-a naum ding ahi.
target: whose paths are crooked and who are devious in their ways.

source: Nangma numei phalounu-a konle, numei phalou akama pachat lhem seinu-a kon;
target: Wisdom will save you also from the adulterous woman, from the wayward woman with her seductive words,

source: Akhan donlaija apuihoipa dalha-a, chule Pathen toh akitepna sumildelnu a kona huhdoh-a naum ding ahi.
target: who has left the partner of her youth and ignored the covenant she made before God.

source: Ajehchu amanu in chun thina lama apuijin, chule lampi chun thina alhutnin ahi.
target: Surely her house leads down to death and her paths to the spirits of the dead.

source: Amanu koma lutapou chu koima ahung kinungle pon, amahon hinna lampiho jong chu atuhdet pouve.
target: None who go to her return or attain the paths of life.

source: Chutia chu nangman miphaho lampi najot theiding, chule michonpha te lampiho nakichin tup thei ding ahi.
target: Thus you will walk in the ways of the good and keep to the paths of the righteous.

source: Ajehchu milungdih chu gamsunga chengintin, chule michamkim chu chua chengden ding ahi.
target: For the upright will live in the land, and the blameless will remain in it;

source: Ahin migilouho vangchu leisetna kona suhgama umding, chule suhkhel neiho chu chua kona kaldoh-a umding ahiuve.
target: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be torn from it.

source: Kachapa keima danthu sumil hih-in, ahinla kathupeh ho nalung thimin kichintup jingin;
target: My son, do not forget my teaching, but keep my commands in your heart,

source: Hichun nahin nikho, nahin kumkho, chule lungmona napehbe ding ahi.
target: for they will prolong your life many years and bring you peace and prosperity.

source: Hepinale thutah chun nangma nadalha hihhel hen; hiteni chu nangonga khivui on ki-onlang, nalungthim sunga lekhajem kijihlut bangin jihlutnin.
target: Let love and faithfulness never leave you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.

source: Chutiachu nangman Pathen leh mihem mitmu-a, khohsahna le hetkhen themna chu nakimudoh teiding ahi.
target: Then you will win favor and a good name in the sight of God and man.

source: Nalungthim pumpin Pakai chu tahsanin; chule nangma chang hetkhen themtheina-a kingai hihbeh-in.
target: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding;

source: Nalampi jouse ama hetsah-in, chutile aman nalampi ho nahil ding ahi.
target: in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.

source: Nangma chang mitmu-a kichihsah hih-in; Pakai chu gingin, chule agilouva konin jammangin.
target: Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the Lord and shun evil.

source: Hichu nalaimu dinga damna, chule nagu nachang jouse dinga lhintwi hitei ding ahi.
target: This will bring health to your body and nourishment to your bones.

source: Nathil lupen le nalhosoh ga masapen chu, Pakai janan tohdoh jengin.
target: Honor the Lord with your wealth, with the firstfruits of all your crops;

source: Chutile nachangsal ho kidip letsetna; chule nalengpiga hehna-a chu lengpitwi thah hung longlet ding ahi.
target: then your barns will be filled to overflowing, and your vats will brim over with new wine.

source: Kachapa Pakai gimbolna chu nahsahmo loujenin, aman mi asuhdihna jong chu chimchah hih-in.
target: My son, do not despise the Lord ’s discipline, and do not resent his rebuke,

source: Ajehchu mipan alunglhaina chapa abolna bangin, Pakaiyin angailut mi chu asudihjin ahi.
target: because the Lord disciplines those he loves, as a father the son he delights in.

source: Chihna kimudoh-a, chule hetkhenthem theina kisanpa chu anun nom ahi.
target: Blessed are those who find wisdom, those who gain understanding,

source: Ajehchu hichea kivei chu dangka-a kiveina sangin aphan; chule ahung gadoh chu sana thengsel sangin jong aphajon ahi.
target: for she is more profitable than silver and yields better returns than gold.

source: Amanu chu songmantam ho sangin alujon; chule nangai chat thilho jouse jongchu amanu chutoh tekah hoi ahipon ahi.
target: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire can compare with her.

source: Amanu khut jetlama hinkho saona aumin; chule akhut veilama haona le jana aume.
target: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.

source: Amanu lampiho chu nopna lampijong ahin, chule alampiho jouse chu chamna ahi.
target: Her ways are pleasant ways, and all her paths are peace.

source: Amanu kituhchah khahte dingin amachu hinna thingphung ahin; chule amanu kichinjing tapou chu anunnome.
target: She is a tree of life to those who take hold of her; those who hold her fast will be blessed.

source: Pakaiyin achihna-in leiset anaphutdoh-in; ahetkhen themna-in van ho anatung doh-in ahi.
target: By wisdom the Lord laid the earth’s foundations, by understanding he set the heavens in place;

source: Aman ahetna-in munthuh ho ahong jal-in; chule meilomho daitwijin ahin lhahsah-in ahi.
target: by his knowledge the watery depths were divided, and the clouds let drop the dew.

source: Kachapa hiche hohi namit mu-a konin jam mangsah hih-in; gellhuh them theina le chihna chu ngah tupmin.
target: My son, do not let wisdom and understanding out of your sight, preserve sound judgment and discretion;

source: Hichu nalhagao dinga hinna, chule na-ngong chang dinga kijepna hiding ahi.
target: they will be life for you, an ornament to grace your neck.

source: Chuteng nangma nalampi-a bitkeija nava le-a, chule nakeng jong kipal louding ahi.
target: Then you will go on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble.

source: Nangma nalup tengle nakichat tahlouhel ding, chule nangma lumin natin, nomsa tah-a na-imut ding ahi.
target: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.

source: Photlot louva tijatna, ahiloule khang gilouho chunga manthah na ahunglhun teng jongle kicha hih-in.
target: Have no fear of sudden disaster or of the ruin that overtakes the wicked,

source: Ajehchu Pakai chu nakisonna hintin; chule nakeng chu akisuh khahna dinga kona nachintup pehding ahi.
target: for the Lord will be at your side and will keep your foot from being snared.

source: Nakhutna boltheina thahat aum petnin, amahon thilpha amudingu chu suhtangpeh hih-in,
target: Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in your power to act.

source: Nahenga gahpehpai jengthei thil aumle, na-inhengpa jah-a, chetan, jingle hungkitjon, petei nange tin seihih beh-in.
target: Do not say to your neighbor, “Come back tomorrow and I’ll give it to you”— when you already have it with you.

source: Ama nakoma mongtah-a achen namu manin, na-inhengpa chunga thil gilou gonghih beh-in.
target: Do not plot harm against your neighbor, who lives trustfully near you.

source: Aman nangma chunga setna abol louva ahile, ajeh beijin mikhat kidoupi hih-in.
target: Do not accuse anyone for no reason— when they have done you no harm.

source: Nangman misugenthei pa chu thangse hih-in; chule alampiho chu kilhen ding gohih-in.
target: Do not envy the violent or choose any of their ways.

source: Ajehchu milung dihlou chu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin, hinla ama thuguh chu michonpha te henga aumme.
target: For the Lord detests the perverse but takes the upright into his confidence.

source: Pakai sapsetna chu khan gitlouna insunga achun: ahinla aman midihtah chenna chu phatthei aboh-in ahi.
target: The Lord ’s curse is on the house of the wicked, but he blesses the home of the righteous.

source: Tahbeh-in aman mi i-sah louva bolho chu i-sah louvin abolin; ahinla mi kineosah ho chu khotona apen ahi.
target: He mocks proud mockers but shows favor to the humble and oppressed.

source: Miching chu loupina changding, hinlah mingol hon vang jum na ato dingu ahi.
target: The wise inherit honor, but fools get only shame.

source: Ngaijun, chateho, hetkhen themtheina nakimudoh theina dingun, napan nahilnao hi ngai phaovin.
target: Listen, my sons, to a father’s instruction; pay attention and gain understanding.

source: Ajehchu keiman nangho thuhilpha kapeh nahiuve, ka danthu dalha hih beh-un.
target: I give you sound learning, so do not forsake my teaching.

source: Ajehchu keima kapa chapa kahin, khangnou chitchet le kanu mitmu-a ngailut khatseh chu kahi.
target: For I too was a son to my father, still tender, and cherished by my mother.

source: Aman keima hiljong einahilin, chule kahenga hitin anaseije; nalungin kathuho chu kichintup min, kathupeh ho kituh detnin lang hinnan neijin.
target: Then he taught me, and he said to me, “Take hold of my words with all your heart; keep my commands, and you will live.

source: Chihna kimun, hetkhen themtheina kimun, sumil hih beh-in; kakama thusohdoh ho-a konin jong kiheidoh hihbeh-in.
target: Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or turn away from them.

source: Amanu dalha hih-in, chule amanun nangma nahoitup ding ahin; amanu ngailun chutile amanun nangma navettup ding ahi.
target: Do not forsake wisdom, and she will protect you; love her, and she will watch over you.

source: Chihna hi thil lupen ahi, hijeh chun chihna chu kimun; chule nathil mu jouse chu hetkhen themtheina toh mudohtha teijin.
target: The beginning of wisdom is this: Get wisdom. Though it cost all you have, get understanding.

source: Amanu choisangin, chutile amanun nangma nadopsang ding ahi. Nangman amanu nakikolchah teng, amanun nangma jabolna mun'a nalhut ding ahi.
target: Cherish her, and she will exalt you; embrace her, and she will honor you.

source: Amanun naluchang chu ngailutna-a ajepding; amanun loupina lallukhuh nahenga ahinlhut ding ahi.
target: She will give you a garland to grace your head and present you with a glorious crown.”

source: Ngaijin, vo kachapa, chule kaseihohi kisanin; chutile nahin kumkho sot ding ahi.
target: Listen, my son, accept what I say, and the years of your life will be many.

source: Keiman nangma chihna lampi kahiltan, keiman nangma lamdih ho-a chun kalamkai tai.
target: I instruct you in the way of wisdom and lead you along straight paths.

source: Nangma nachele teng nakalson kisudong pontin; chule nalhaiteng jongle nangma kipal lhu ponnate.
target: When you walk, your steps will not be hampered; when you run, you will not stumble.

source: Hilchahna chu tuhdetkheh-in, amanu chu lhaso hih in; kivet tupmin, ijeh inem itile amanu chu na hinna ahi.
target: Hold on to instruction, do not let it go; guard it well, for it is your life.

source: Khang giloute lampia nangma lut hih-in; chule miphaloute lampia cheloujenin.
target: Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evildoers.

source: Peldoh-in, anaija chehih in, chua konin kihei mangin, chule chemang jengin.
target: Avoid it, do not travel on it; turn from it and go on your way.

source: Ajehchu thilse abol louvule amaho a-imu pouvin; chule amahon khattou lhuhna ding abol masang seuvin a-imuthei pouvin ahi.
target: For they cannot rest until they do evil; they are robbed of sleep till they make someone stumble.

source: Ajehchu amahon khan gitlouna changlhah chu aneuvin, chule thisan sona lengpitwi adonun ahi.
target: They eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

source: Amavang midihtah te lampi chu vah bangin a-emselin; nikho hoitah asodoh changeija vahcheh cheh tobang ahi.
target: The path of the righteous is like the morning sun, shining ever brighter till the full light of day.

source: Mikhang giloute lampichu muthim tobang ahin; amaho ipi-a kipal lhu hiuvem aheji pouvin ahi.
target: But the way of the wicked is like deep darkness; they do not know what makes them stumble.

source: Kachapa kathuseiho phaten ngaijin; kathusei ho-a nanakhang hin sungin.
target: My son, pay attention to what I say; turn your ear to my words.

source: Hicheho chu namitmu-a konin jam mangsah hih-in; hiche chu nalunggil sunga kichintup min.
target: Do not let them out of your sight, keep them within your heart;

source: Ajehchu hiche chu akimudohte dinga hinna, chule atahsa pumpi diuva damna ahi.
target: for they are life to those who find them and health to one’s whole body.

source: Chingthei tah-in nalungsung kivet tupmin; ajehchu chua kona chu hinkho-a thilsoh ho hungsoh doh ji ahi.
target: Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.

source: Nanga konin jouthu sei chu koimangin; chule alam louva muhthem nachu gamla tah-in koijin.
target: Keep your mouth free of perversity; keep corrupt talk far from your lips.

source: Namit chun vejangpet henlang, chule namitnel honjong namasang vejang keihen.
target: Let your eyes look straight ahead; fix your gaze directly before you.

source: Nakeng phangin achot nading lampi kivet phatnin; chule nalampi jouse chu semtupmin umhen.
target: Give careful thought to the paths for your feet and be steadfast in all your ways.

source: Jetlam ahiloule veilama kiheidoh hihbeh in; setna a konin nakeng sepdoh jengin.
target: Do not turn to the right or the left; keep your foot from evil.

source: Kachapa kachihna hi lunglut tah-in ngaiphan; chule kahetkhen themtheina lama hin nanakhang hin sungin.
target: My son, pay attention to my wisdom, turn your ear to my words of insight,

source: Chutile thil datkhen je nahetding, nakamin jong hetna achintup thei ding ahi.
target: that you may maintain discretion and your lips may preserve knowledge.

source: Ajehchu miphalou nu muh chu khoiju abangin; chule amanu kamsung chu thaosangin analjon ahi.
target: For the lips of the adulterous woman drip honey, and her speech is smoother than oil;

source: Ahinla amanu kichaina chu gamsai bangin akhan, hemto chemjam bangin ahemin ahi.
target: but in the end she is bitter as gall, sharp as a double-edged sword.

source: Amanu kengin thinalam ajonsuh in; akalseho chun thikholmun achonlut tan ahi.
target: Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to the grave.

source: Nangman hinna lampi chu lunggil tah-a nangaito louva ahile, amanu lampiho chu kikhel thipthap ahin, chutia chu nangin lampiho chu nahet theilou ding ahi.
target: She gives no thought to the way of life; her paths wander aimlessly, but she does not know it.

source: Hijeh chun chateho tun kathu ngaijun, chule kakamsung thuho-a konin nangho kiheimang hih-un.
target: Now then, my sons, listen to me; do not turn aside from what I say.

source: Amanu-a konin nalampi khin gamlan, chule amanu kotphung jong hin nailut hih-in.
target: Keep to a path far from her, do not go near the door of her house,

source: Achuti louleh jabola naumna chu midangho kipedoh intin; chule nahinkumkho chu engseho henga kipedoh ding ahi.
target: lest you lose your honor to others and your dignity to one who is cruel,

source: Nahaona jouse jong gamdang mihon haonan neijuntin chule natohgim ga jouse jong gamdang mi inna lut ding ahi.
target: lest strangers feast on your wealth and your toil enrich the house of another.

source: Natahsa leh naphe suhmanga aumteng, achaina keija lunghema naum ding;
target: At the end of your life you will groan, when your flesh and body are spent.

source: Chule nangman seijin natin, itobanga hilchahna kana hotna, chule kalungin phona donse louva anakoi hitam?
target: You will say, “How I hated discipline! How my heart spurned correction!

source: Chule jilkung hon eihilnao kana ngaida-a, eithumop ho thupeh-a kanakhang kanasunlou hitam!
target: I would not obey my teachers or turn my ear to my instructors.

source: Keima houkhom nale khoppi lah-a jong, agilouva mangthah paidin kana ume nati ding ahi.
target: And I was soon in serious trouble in the assembly of God’s people.”

source: Nangma twibel'a konle nangma twikhuh-a kon hung longdoh twiho bouchu donin.
target: Drink water from your own cistern, running water from your own well.

source: Natwinah ho chu thejalin umhen lang, chule vadung twiho chu lamlhongpi dunga longhen.
target: Should your springs overflow in the streets, your streams of water in the public squares?

source: Amaho chu nangma changseh-a bou hihen lang, naum khompi gamdang miho-a hida hen.
target: Let them be yours alone, never to be shared with strangers.

source: Natwinah chu phatthei boh-in umhen; chule nakhang donlai na-inneipitoh kipahkhom lhonin.
target: May your fountain be blessed, and may you rejoice in the wife of your youth.

source: Amanu chu dei umtah sajuh leh lunglhai umtah sajuh chal tobang hihen, amanu anglum chun phatjousen nalung lhaisah hen; chule amanu ngailutna chun nangma a-imatih chanin lung mongin nakoi jinghen.
target: A loving doe, a graceful deer— may her breasts satisfy you always, may you ever be intoxicated with her love.

source: Chule kachapa ipi dinga hetkhahlou numei khat toh nakikolchah-a, chule hetkhahlou khatchu nangman nakikoipi ding ham?
target: Why, my son, be intoxicated with another man’s wife? Why embrace the bosom of a wayward woman?

source: Ajehchu mihem lampi jouse Pakaiyin amu sohkei ahin; chule aman amapa chena jouse chu avelhi jingin ahi.
target: For your ways are in full view of the Lord , and he examines all your paths.

source: Khan gitlouna bolpa chu athepmonan amatchah ding, chule amatah chonsetna chun khao banga akanchah ding ahi.
target: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare them; the cords of their sins hold them fast.

source: Amachu hilchahna beija thiding, chule angol behseh jeh-a vahmang ding ahi.
target: For lack of discipline they will die, led astray by their own great folly.

source: Kachapa nangma nagol dinga kitepna thila kitung nahi tah-a, gamdang mitoh kikhutsan nahitahle,
target: My son, if you have put up security for your neighbor, if you have shaken hands in pledge for a stranger,

source: Nakam sunga kon naseidoh thuchengho chun nangma namat den ahitai.
target: you have been trapped by what you said, ensnared by the words of your mouth.

source: Kachapa, tun hichehi bolin, nangma le nangma kihudoh-in; nagolpa khutna chu naum tengle, chen, gakisunem min, nagolpa chu galung lhaijin.
target: So do this, my son, to free yourself, since you have fallen into your neighbor’s hands: Go—to the point of exhaustion— and give your neighbor no rest!

source: Namit chu nguisah hih-in, chule namitteni jong kisin sah hih-in.
target: Allow no sleep to your eyes, no slumber to your eyelids.

source: Gamlengpa khutna kon sajuhchal akitol doh bangle, thangkampa khutna kona vacha khat akitol doh bangin, nangma kihuhdoh in.
target: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

source: Vo mithase, sihmi henga gachen, alamlhah ho ngaiton lang, chihnan neijin.
target: Go to the ant, you sluggard; consider its ways and be wise!

source: Aman apuihoi, avesui, ahiloule vaihom aneipon;
target: It has no commander, no overseer or ruler,

source: Aman nipilai leh nehding akisuh tupmin, chule chang at laile neh le chah akikhol khomjin ahi.
target: yet it stores its provisions in summer and gathers its food at harvest.

source: Vo mithase, itihchan na-imut nahlai ding ham? Itihle na-imutna-a kona nahung kithodoh ding ham?
target: How long will you lie there, you sluggard? When will you get up from your sleep?

source: Chom chakhat na-imun nalulhu kitjin, imudingin nakhut nalhepton;
target: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest—

source: Chutia chu vaichatna-in kholjin vahle banga, chule lhahsamna-in hem le thal kikenpa banga nahin lhunkhum ding ahi.
target: and poverty will come on you like a thief and scarcity like an armed man.

source: Seingailou mi, mikhang gilou chu jouthu seijin avah lejin ahi.
target: A troublemaker and a villain, who goes about with a corrupt mouth,

source: Aman amit teni asat lhaplhap jin, akengin thu aseijin, akhutjunghon mi ahilji;
target: who winks maliciously with his eye, signals with his feet and motions with his fingers,

source: Aman alungsunga jouthu jeng agelin, thilphalou chu agongjom jingin, kitolouna atun ahi.
target: who plots evil with deceit in his heart— he always stirs up conflict.

source: Hijeh achu achunga vangsetna phulou helouva hunglhung ding; phulou helouva ama jendam thei louva kisuse ding ahi.
target: Therefore disaster will overtake him in an instant; he will suddenly be destroyed—without remedy.

source: Hiche thil gup hohi Pakaiyin ahot ahi; Henge, sagi chu amadinga thet umtah ahi.
target: There are six things the Lord hates, seven that are detestable to him:

source: Kiletsah maiso, jouseina leigui, chule mona neilou thisan sona khut,
target: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

source: Thil gilou gongji-a lungthim, agiloulam delna-a kaljanga keng,
target: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are quick to rush into evil,

source: Hettohsah lhem jouthu seija, chule sopite lah-a kitolouna muchi banga tulut jia mihem.
target: a false witness who pours out lies and a person who stirs up conflict in the community.

source: Kachapa napa thupeh nitnin, chule nanu danthu lhaso hih-in,
target: My son, keep your father’s command and do not forsake your mother’s teaching.

source: Hicheho chu nalungsunga kichin jingin; chule nangonga khivui on ki-o jingin.
target: Bind them always on your heart; fasten them around your neck.

source: Nachele teng hichun nalamkai ding, na-imut teng hichun nachintup ding; chule nakhahdoh tengle hichun nakihou limpi teiding ahi.
target: When you walk, they will guide you; when you sleep, they will watch over you; when you awake, they will speak to you.

source: Ajehchu thupeh chu meivah ahin, danthu chu vah ahi, chule kihila kiphosalna chu hinna lampi ahi.
target: For this command is a lamp, this teaching is a light, and correction and instruction are the way to life,

source: Hicheho chun numei gilounu-a konle, gamdang numeinu pachat lhemna thuho-a kona nahoitup ding ahi.
target: keeping you from your neighbor’s wife, from the smooth talk of a wayward woman.

source: Amanu hoina chu nalungin ngaicha hihbeh in; chule amit hadan jong kilhep lhahsah hih-in.
target: Do not lust in your heart after her beauty or let her captivate you with her eyes.

source: Ajehchu jonthanhoi bol numeinu chu pasal khatnin changlhah halkhatna akichoh thei ahin; chule mijongnu chun hinkho manlu tahchu asuhmang ding ahi.
target: For a prostitute can be had for a loaf of bread, but another man’s wife preys on your very life.

source: Mikhatnin a-opma mei achoija, apon kalouva um theijem?
target: Can a man scoop fire into his lap without his clothes being burned?

source: Mikhat song meihol kitih-am chunga chea, akeng kalouva um theijem?
target: Can a man walk on hot coals without his feet being scorched?

source: Hitia chu a-inhengpa inneipi henga galutna michu, koihile amanu tongkha chan chu themo changding ahi.
target: So is he who sleeps with another man’s wife; no one who touches her will go unpunished.

source: Mikhat touvin agilkel pet tah-a ahinna suhlunglhai nadinga guhchat abola ahileh, min guchapa chu amusit ngaipoi.
target: People do not despise a thief if he steals to satisfy his hunger when he is starving.

source: Akimatdoh vangle amachun ajat sagi-a aditding; a-insunga thiljouse apeh ding ahi.
target: Yet if he is caught, he must pay sevenfold, though it costs him all the wealth of his house.

source: Ahinla koihile numei khat toh jonga vangchu het themna lhasama ahin, chutobang bolla chun ama hinkho akisuhset ahitai.
target: But a man who commits adultery has no sense; whoever does so destroys himself.

source: Amachun mavo nale kijumsona akimuding; chule ama i-sah louva aumna chu kitheh mang joulou ding ahi.
target: Blows and disgrace are his lot, and his shame will never be wiped away.

source: Ajehchu kithangset hi mihem lunghanna ahin; hijeh-a chu phulahna nikho ahung lhunteng aman khen aneilouhel ding ahi.
target: For jealousy arouses a husband’s fury, and he will show no mercy when he takes revenge.

source: Aman kilhatdohna thil khatcha adonpeh louding; thilpeh tamtah pejongle chun, ama lunglhai louding ahi.
target: He will not accept any compensation; he will refuse a bribe, however great it is.

source: Kachapa kathuho kichin tupmin, chule kathupeh ho kikhol khom minlang hin,
target: My son, keep my words and store up my commands within you.

source: kathupeh ho kichintup minlang hingin, chule ka dan chu namit mu-a alupen hihen.
target: Keep my commands and you will live; guard my teachings as the apple of your eye.

source: Hicheho chu nakhut jungho-a kibunlang; nalungsunga kijih lutnin,
target: Bind them on your fingers; write them on the tablet of your heart.

source: nangman chihna henga chun kasopinu nahi tin, chule hetkhen themtheina chu na inkonu hisah-in,
target: Say to wisdom, “You are my sister,” and to insight, “You are my relative.”

source: Chutile hicheho chun gamchom numei nu-a konle, gamdang mi pachat lhem seinu-a kona nahuhdoh ding ahi.
target: They will keep you from the adulterous woman, from the wayward woman with her seductive words.

source: Ajehchu ka-in bangkotna bangvang kah-a kagah ven,
target: At the window of my house I looked down through the lattice.

source: milhamho lah chu kaven, khangdongho lah-a chun, hetkhenthem theina neilou golhang khat kagah lhengdoh theijin,
target: I saw among the simple, I noticed among the young men, a youth who had no sense.

source: Amanu umna ningkoi lamlhah-a achepai jengin, chule amapan amanu inlam ajonjelin,
target: He was going down the street near her corner, walking along in the direction of her house

source: nilhah lam, khothim chipchep in, jan muthim jing noija,
target: at twilight, as the day was fading, as the dark of night set in.

source: veuvin, numei kijoh vona kivonle, dohathuh numei khatnin amapa chu ana kimupi tan ahi.
target: Then out came a woman to meet him, dressed like a prostitute and with crafty intent.

source: (Amanu chu husetah le louchaltah ahin, akengchu a-in'a angaman hihbeh-in;
target: (She is unruly and defiant, her feet never stay at home;

source: abang komle amanu apama aumin, abang komle lamlhah-a aumin, chule ningkoi tinchenga achanglhi jingin ahi.)
target: now in the street, now in the squares, at every corner she lurks.)

source: Hitichun amanu chun amapa chu amanin, achopmin, chule jah motah in amapa henga aseije,
target: She took hold of him and kissed him and with a brazen face she said:

source: keiman chamna kilhaina thilto kaneije, tuni hin keiman kakitepna ho kapetan ahi.
target: “Today I fulfilled my vows, and I have food from my fellowship offering at home.

source: Hichejeh-a chu nangma kimupi dinga, gunchu tah-a namaiso holdinga kahung vadoh ahin, chule nangma kamudohtan ahi.
target: So I came out to meet you; I looked for you and have found you!

source: Kajalkhun jemhoitah khaodip ponin, akigeitho thilho-in, chule Egypt tupat ponnemjetnin kajem joutan ahi.
target: I have covered my bed with colored linens from Egypt.

source: Kajalkhun chu myrrh, aloes chule thingthal gimnamtuiho-a keiman kasu namtuisoh keijin ahi.
target: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes and cinnamon.

source: Hungin jingkhovah kahsen eini chimsetnin kinou hitin, mongtah-in kinou chimset hite.
target: Come, let’s drink deeply of love till morning; let’s enjoy ourselves with love!

source: Ka inneipao la ina aumpoi, gamlatah-a jindoh ahi.
target: My husband is not at home; he has gone on a long journey.

source: Aman sum dip khat akisemin, nikho atepni lebou in hunglhung ding ahi.
target: He took his purse filled with money and will not be home till full moon.”

source: Amanun thu ngeitah seijin, amapa chu ajol lhatan, amuh nal-heu pachatna lhemin amapa chu athujo tan ahi.
target: With persuasive words she led him astray; she seduced him with her smooth talk.

source: Bongchal khatnin akithana ding mun, ahiloule mingol khatnin bul akituh nading bangin; amapan amanu nungchu ajuijel tan;
target: All at once he followed her like an ox going to the slaughter, like a deer stepping into a noose

source: Thalchangin athinlung asutpai bangle; vacha khat kikin sah tah-a thanga a-o tobangin, amapan ahinkho manthah ding akihet pon ahi.
target: till an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird darting into a snare, little knowing it will cost him his life.

source: Hijeh chun vo nangho chapangho kaseihi kingaijun; chule kakama hungsoh doh thuho hi kigel phatnun.
target: Now then, my sons, listen to me; pay attention to what I say.

source: Amanu chena lama chun nalung onsah hih-in; amanu lampiho a chun kiheimangin lut hihbeh-in.
target: Do not let your heart turn to her ways or stray into her paths.

source: Ajehchu amanun mi tamtah ama put sahtan; chule mihat tamtah jong alousahjou ahitai.
target: Many are the victims she has brought down; her slain are a mighty throng.

source: Amanu in chu thikholmun jotna lampi ahin; thina indanho jotsuhna ahi.
target: Her house is a highway to the grave, leading down to the chambers of death.

source: Chihna chun kholhang asapji hilouham? chule hetkhen themtheina-in a-aw ahin sodohji hilouham?
target: Does not wisdom call out? Does not understanding raise her voice?

source: Amanu munsang vumlai tah-ah, lamthom tina adingin ahi.
target: At the highest point along the way, where the paths meet, she takes her stand;

source: Amanun kotpi phungho, khopi lutnaho chule kotna hung lutna ho-a asamlen ahi.
target: beside the gate leading into the city, at the entrance, she cries aloud:

source: Vo miho kahinkou nahiuve, chule ka awgin hin mihem chapate chu akou ahi.
target: “To you, O people, I call out; I raise my voice to all mankind.

source: Vo nangho milhamte, chihna kihet themun; chule nangho mingolte, hetkhen themtheina lungthim neijun.
target: You who are simple, gain prudence; you who are foolish, set your hearts on it.

source: Ngaijun, ajehchu thilpha chung nungho kahinsei ding ahin; chule kakamsoh chun thilpha ngen aseiding ahi.
target: Listen, for I have trustworthy things to say; I open my lips to speak what is right.

source: Ajehchu kakamin thutah aseiding, chule phatlouna chu kakam dinga thet umtah ahi.
target: My mouth speaks what is true, for my lips detest wickedness.

source: Kakama kon sohdoh thucheng jouse chu chonphatna ahin, hicheho-a chun khan gitlouna leh vakoina aumpon ahi.
target: All the words of my mouth are just; none of them is crooked or perverse.

source: Ahekhen themtheipa dingin hicheho chu akicheh-in; chule hetna kimudoh tedin adih chu ahi.
target: To the discerning all of them are right; they are upright to those who have found knowledge.

source: Dangka sangin hilchahna chu kisanin lang, chule sana deitah sangin jong hetna chu kisanin,
target: Choose my instruction instead of silver, knowledge rather than choice gold,

source: ajehchu chihna hi songmantam sangin aphajon; chule deithei thilho jouse chutoh tekah theihoi ahipoi.
target: for wisdom is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire can compare with her.

source: Chihna kiti keima hi datkhenthem natoh kacheng khomin, chule keiman hetna leh chihnaho kamudoh in ahi.
target: “I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence; I possess knowledge and discretion.

source: Pakai gin kitihi thilse hot bolding hi ahin; Kiletsahna, hoithona, setna lampi, chule jou seina kam hi keiman kahot ahi.
target: To fear the Lord is to hate evil; I hate pride and arrogance, evil behavior and perverse speech.

source: Chihna giltah leh thumop chu keija ahin, keima hetkhenthem theina chu kahin, chule thahatna kaneije.
target: Counsel and sound judgment are mine; I have insight, I have power.

source: Keima jal-in lenghon vai apouvin, chule pipuihon dihtah-in thutana abolun ahi.
target: By me kings reign and rulers issue decrees that are just;

source: Keima jal-in pipuiho, milal ho, leiset pumpi-a thutan ho jengin jong vai ahomun ahi.
target: by me princes govern, and nobles—all who rule on earth.

source: Keima eingailute chu kangailun; chule matah-a eiholte chun eimudiu ahi.
target: I love those who love me, and those who seek me find me.

source: Haonahole jana keija aumin, henge, haosatna le chonphatna jong keijah aume.
target: With me are riches and honor, enduring wealth and prosperity.

source: Kaga hi sana sangin aphajon, ahi, sana phapen sangin aphajoi, katoh dohsa jong hi dangka lhentum sangin aphajoi.
target: My fruit is better than fine gold; what I yield surpasses choice silver.

source: Chonphatna lampi-a kalamkaijin, Thutanna lampiho lah-a kalamkaije.
target: I walk in the way of righteousness, along the paths of justice,

source: Chutia chu eingailute chu keiman gou kalosah ding; chule agouho chu kadimsetsah ding ahi.
target: bestowing a rich inheritance on those who love me and making their treasuries full.

source: Khanglui laija Pakaiyin na anatoh masang, chule alampiho kipat tilla, aman keima einanei ahitai.
target: “The Lord brought me forth as the first of his works, before his deeds of old;

source: Keima tonsotna pat, abula pat, ahilouleh leiset ana kisemdoh masanga pat eina kitungdoh ahitai.
target: I was formed long ages ago, at the very beginning, when the world came to be.

source: Munthuh tah anaum masang, twinengtah-a akikholna twinaho ana um masanga pat, keima anakipodoh kahitai.
target: When there were no watery depths, I was given birth, when there were no springs overflowing with water;

source: Mol le lhangho anaum masanga, keima einakipo doh-a kahitai.
target: before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was given birth,

source: Aman leisetle gamho, vannoi leiset sangpen asemdoh masang peh-a jong anaum kahitai.
target: before he made the world or its fields or any of the dust of the earth.

source: Aman vanho anagona, munthuh akolkhum laichun, keima kana ummin ahi.
target: I was there when he set the heavens in place, when he marked out the horizon on the face of the deep,

source: Aman chunga meilomho anaphudoh-a, twinah thuhho anahatsah laichun,
target: when he established the clouds above and fixed securely the fountains of the deep,

source: Aman twiho akiveina kalval akhokhel louna dinga, leiset bul aphudoh a chu twikhanglen thupeh ananei ahitai.
target: when he gave the sea its boundary so the waters would not overstep his command, and when he marked out the foundations of the earth.

source: Chuti chun amatoh thilkhat hung kikhoukhah bangin ama koma kana ummin; chule ama anga kipah jingle, nitinna ama dei kanahin,
target: Then I was constantly at his side. I was filled with delight day after day, rejoicing always in his presence,

source: Pathen semsa leiset chen nathei munkhatna chun kanakipah-in; chule kalunglhaina chu mihem chapate chunga anaumin ahi.
target: rejoicing in his whole world and delighting in mankind.

source: Hijeh chun tun vo chateho, kathu sei hi kichintup mun; ajehchu kalampiho nit chan chu anunnom ahi.
target: “Now then, my children, listen to me; blessed are those who keep my ways.

source: Hilchahna kingaijunlang, chihnan neijun, hichu pampai hih-un.
target: Listen to my instruction and be wise; do not disregard it.

source: Kathusei phatecha ngaija, nitina kakotpiphung velhijing, kakot bulho-a ngahjingpa chu anunnom ahi.
target: Blessed are those who listen to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at my doorway.

source: Ajehchu koihile keima eikimudoh-a chun hinna akimudoh ahitan; chule Pakai lunglhaina chu changding ahi.
target: For those who find me find life and receive favor from the Lord .

source: Ahinla keima douna-a chonsepa vang chun, amatah hinkho chu dihlouva akibol ahi. Keima eihotbol chanchun thina joh angailut ahi.
target: But those who fail to find me harm themselves; all who hate me love death.”

source: Chihna in a-in akisah doh-in, chule khompi jong sagi atungdohtai.
target: Wisdom has built her house; she has set up its seven pillars.

source: Amanun aganchaho akitha-in; ajuho jong ahaltoh-in, adokhangho jong ajem joutai.
target: She has prepared her meat and mixed her wine; she has also set her table.

source: Amanun asoh numei ho asoldoh joutai; amanun khopi sunga munsangpena kon asamin,
target: She has sent out her servants, and she calls from the highest point of the city,

source: Milham koi hile hilama hungkile heihen, hetthem theina ngaichaho henga chun amanun aseijin,
target: “Let all who are simple come to my house!” To those who have no sense she says,

source: hungin, ka changlhah nenlang, kahalsa juhi hungdonin ati.
target: “Come, eat my food and drink the wine I have mixed.

source: Ngolna chu dalhanlang hingin; chule hetkhen themtheina lampia chen.
target: Leave your simple ways and you will live; walk in the way of insight.”

source: Mitaitom hat ho phoh-a, adih bolsah ding gopa chu ama le ama akijumso jin, chule agilou phohsala chun gimna akimun ahi.
target: Whoever corrects a mocker invites insults; whoever rebukes the wicked incurs abuse.

source: Mitaitom hatchu suhdih ding gohih-in; aman nahot loding ahi. Miching chu phoh le chun aman nangailut ding ahi.
target: Do not rebuke mockers or they will hate you; rebuke the wise and they will love you.

source: Miching chu hilchah lechun ama ching cheh ding: Midihtah pa chu hil lechun, chutile ama hetna lama khangtou ding ahi.
target: Instruct the wise and they will be wiser still; teach the righteous and they will add to their learning.

source: Pakai gin hi chih kipatna chu ahin; Mithengpa het kiti jonghi hetkhen themna chu ahi.
target: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

source: Ajehchu keima-a nahin nikhoho kipunsah-a; chule nahinkumho kisutam ding ahi.
target: For through wisdom your days will be many, and years will be added to your life.

source: Nangma aching nahile, nangma dingabou ching nahin; ahinla nangman nataitomle, hichu nangman nachanga nakipoh ding ahi.
target: If you are wise, your wisdom will reward you; if you are a mocker, you alone will suffer.

source: Numei ngolchu akam atamin, mimol ahin, chule hetna imacha aneipoi.
target: Folly is an unruly woman; she is simple and knows nothing.

source: Amanu akotphunga atouvin, khopisunga munsang ho-a touna-a jong atouji-e.
target: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat at the highest point of the city,

source: Achena ding lampia jangpetna chehon ahin jotpa tengule akoujin ahi.
target: calling out to those who pass by, who go straight on their way,

source: Milham koi hile hilama hungkile heihen, hetthem theina ngaichaho henga chun amanun aseijin,
target: “Let all who are simple come to my house!” To those who have no sense she says,

source: Twi kigu chu alhumin, chule changlhah aguh a kine chu atuije.
target: “Stolen water is sweet; food eaten in secret is delicious!”

source: Ahinla amapan hia chun thina aume, chule amanu jinho chu thikholmun thuhlaija um ahiuve ti ahepon ahi.
target: But little do they know that the dead are there, that her guests are deep in the realm of the dead.

source: Chapa chingin apa akipasah in; amavang chapa ngol chu anu dinga hesohna bep ahi.
target: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

source: Khan gitlouna gouho chun koima aphatchom sahpon; ahinla chonphat na-in thina-a konin ahuhdoh theije.
target: Ill-gotten treasures have no lasting value, but righteousness delivers from death.

source: Pakaiyin michonpha hinkho chu kel thoh dinga asuhgenthei louding; amavang khan giloute thil le lo vang asuhmang peh ding ahi.
target: The Lord does not let the righteous go hungry, but he thwarts the craving of the wicked.

source: Khut thase tah-a natongpa chu ahung vaichan, hinla migunchu khutnin haona amujie.
target: Lazy hands make for poverty, but diligent hands bring wealth.

source: Nipi laija kikholkhoma chu chapa ching ahin, ahinla chang at laija ihmupa vangchu jachat konsah chapa ahi.
target: He who gathers crops in summer is a prudent son, but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son.

source: Phattheina chu michondih tah luchunga aumin, migiloute kamsunga vang hunama thuseijin atomchah-in ahi.
target: Blessings crown the head of the righteous, but violence overwhelms the mouth of the wicked.

source: Midihtah hetjingna chu phattheina ahin, amavang mikhangilou chu amin mangthah ding ahi.
target: The name of the righteous is used in blessings, but the name of the wicked will rot.

source: Milungching chun thupeh ho akisan ding, mingol moh paopao vangchu lhutei ding ahi.
target: The wise in heart accept commands, but a chattering fool comes to ruin.

source: Dihtah-a kalsongpa chu mongtah-in achejin; alampiho-a vahveija chu hetdoh-a umding ahi.
target: Whoever walks in integrity walks securely, but whoever takes crooked paths will be found out.

source: Amit satlaplap pachun gimna asosah-in; ahinla mingol moh paopao vangchu lhuding ahi.
target: Whoever winks maliciously causes grief, and a chattering fool comes to ruin.

source: Michonpha kamchu hinna twikhuh ahin; migiloute kamsunga vang hunama thuseijin atomchah-in ahi.
target: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

source: Kihotna-in kinahna akondoh sah-in; ahivangin ngailutnan chonset jouse akhujin ahi.
target: Hatred stirs up conflict, but love covers over all wrongs.

source: Hetkhenthem theina neipa kamsunga chun chihna akimudoh in; ahinla mol chu het khenthem theina neiloupa tungtuna ding ahibouve.
target: Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning, but a rod is for the back of one who has no sense.

source: Miching hon hetna akikholun, ahinla mingol kam vangchu manthah na toh naicha ahi.
target: The wise store up knowledge, but the mouth of a fool invites ruin.

source: Ahaopa haona chu akhopidet ahin; migenthei ho suhgemna chu avaichatnau ahi.
target: The wealth of the rich is their fortified city, but poverty is the ruin of the poor.

source: Michonpha te tohgimna chun hinna asodoh in, agiloute toh ga vang chonsetna ahi.
target: The wages of the righteous is life, but the earnings of the wicked are sin and death.

source: Hilchahna kichintup pa chu hinna lampia aumin, ahinla phona sangloupa chu avahthai jin ahi.
target: Whoever heeds discipline shows the way to life, but whoever ignores correction leads others astray.

source: Ami hotna selgu chanchu mijou ahin, chule thujouva mi seise-a chu angol ahi.
target: Whoever conceals hatred with lying lips and spreads slander is a fool.

source: Thucheng tamna-a chun chonsetna alhasampon, ahin akam kihupthem thei michu miching ahi.
target: Sin is not ended by multiplying words, but the prudent hold their tongues.

source: Midihtah lei chu dangka thengsel tobang ahin; migilou lungthim vang pannabei ahi.
target: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked is of little value.

source: Michonpha kam chun mi tampi avah-in; ahinla mingol hovang chihna lhahsam jeh-in athijin ahi.
target: The lips of the righteous nourish many, but fools die for lack of sense.

source: Pakai phattheiboh na-in haosatna asodoh sah-in; chule hiche-a chun gimna abelap pon ahi.
target: The blessing of the Lord brings wealth, without painful toil for it.

source: Gitlouna hi mingol dingin kichep golseh tobang ahin; ahinla hetkhenthem theina neipan chihna aneijin ahi.
target: A fool finds pleasure in wicked schemes, but a person of understanding delights in wisdom.

source: Migilouvin akichat jing kichatna chu amachunga hunglhung ding; ahinla michonpha ngaichat chu kipeding ahi.
target: What the wicked dread will overtake them; what the righteous desire will be granted.

source: Chimpei kitolmang bangin agiloupa chu aumtapon; ahinla michonpha chu tonsotna kiphutdet ahi.
target: When the storm has swept by, the wicked are gone, but the righteous stand firm forever.

source: Ha dinga lengpitwi thuh, mit dinga meikhu ahibangin, mithase chu asolleho dingin chutobang chu ahi.
target: As vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so are sluggards to those who send them.

source: Pakai ginna chun nikhoho asaosah-in ahi, ahinla agiloute kumho vangchu kisuchom ding ahi.
target: The fear of the Lord adds length to life, but the years of the wicked are cut short.

source: Michonpha te kinepna chu kipana hintin, migiloute kinepna vang manthah na hiding ahi.
target: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hopes of the wicked come to nothing.

source: Pakai lampi chu midih dingin thahatna ahi, ahinla khansetna tongho dinga suhgemna hiteiding ahi.
target: The way of the Lord is a refuge for the blameless, but it is the ruin of those who do evil.

source: Michonpha te chu imatihchana suhlonga umlou helding, ahinla migilou ten leiset alo loudingu ahi.
target: The righteous will never be uprooted, but the wicked will not remain in the land.

source: Midih kamsungin chihna asodohsah-in; ahinla jouthusei lei vangchu ki-atdoh ding ahi.
target: From the mouth of the righteous comes the fruit of wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be silenced.

source: Michonpha kamsung chun santhei ahen; ahinla mikhang gilou kamin vang jouthu bou aseijin ahi.
target: The lips of the righteous know what finds favor, but the mouth of the wicked only what is perverse.

source: Khaikot dihlouva kite hi Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin, ahinla dihtah-a kite chu ama lunglhaina ahi.
target: The Lord detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.

source: Kiletsahna ahunglhun teng, jum na ahung lhungin, ahinla mi kineosah koma chihna aum jinge.
target: When pride comes, then comes disgrace, but with humility comes wisdom.

source: Mikitahte phatna chun amaho apuihoi ding, ahinla suhkhelna neiho louchalna chun amaho asuhmang ding ahi.
target: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the unfaithful are destroyed by their duplicity.

source: Lungsat nikhoteng haonaho pannabei ahin, chonphat na-in vang thina-a konin ahuhdoh-e.
target: Wealth is worthless in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

source: Chamkimsel mihem chu achonphatnan lamdih-a apuiding; amavang khanggilou chu akhangit louna-a lhuding ahi.
target: The righteousness of the blameless makes their paths straight, but the wicked are brought down by their own wickedness.

source: Milungdih ho achonphatnao chun amaho ahuhhing ding, amavang mi kitahlouho chu amahotah suhkhelna chun amatden diu ahi.
target: The righteousness of the upright delivers them, but the unfaithful are trapped by evil desires.

source: Migilou athiteng akinepna chu mang ding ahin; chule midihlou ho kinepna chu amangjitai.
target: Hopes placed in mortals die with them; all the promise of their power comes to nothing.

source: Michonpha chu lungkham na-a konin huhdoh-in aumin; chule migiloupa chu michonpha pa thakhelin lungkham na-a ahunglutjin ahi.
target: The righteous person is rescued from trouble, and it falls on the wicked instead.

source: Mipha lhemin aheng akom chu akamin asumangin, ahinla hetnavanga midihtah chu huhdoh-a umding ahi.
target: With their mouths the godless destroy their neighbors, but through knowledge the righteous escape.

source: Michonpha ho akhantou tengle khopi akipahjin, amavang mikhangilou amanthah teng min a-eu jie.
target: When the righteous prosper, the city rejoices; when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.

source: Midih phatthei achan jal-in khopi choisangin aumjin; ahinla migilouho kamso jeh-in suhchimin aum jitai.
target: Through the blessing of the upright a city is exalted, but by the mouth of the wicked it is destroyed.

source: Chihna notthapma koi mihem chun a-inheng iman agelpon; ahinla hetkhenthem theina neipa vang chun chamna akituh chah-in ahi.
target: Whoever derides their neighbor has no sense, but the one who has understanding holds their tongue.

source: Guhthima thuseijin thuguhho aphong dohjin, hinla tahsan umtah mihem vang chun thuguh chu a-imjouvin ahi.
target: A gossip betrays a confidence, but a trustworthy person keeps a secret.

source: Kithumop umlouna-a chun mipi alhujin, ahinla mithumop tamna a chun hoidohna aume.
target: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.

source: Gamdang mikhat dinga bat thila ama le ama kitunga chun lunggimna akimu teiding, hinla midinga bat thila kitunding nomlouva chu hoidoh teiding ahi.
target: Whoever puts up security for a stranger will surely suffer, but whoever refuses to shake hands in pledge is safe.

source: Lungsetna dim numei jin jana akilamdoh-in chule pasal thahat hon haonaho akilamdoh ji-e.
target: A kindhearted woman gains honor, but ruthless men gain only wealth.

source: Hepi nadim pasal'in alhagaodin napha atongin; mi engsepa vangin atahsatah ngeijong asugime.
target: Those who are kind benefit themselves, but the cruel bring ruin on themselves.

source: Agiloupan lheplhahna dimset na atongin, ahinla chonphatna muchi tupa ding chun thonlou kipana aumme.
target: A wicked person earns deceptive wages, but the one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

source: Chonphatna in hinna apuilut bangin, thilse delpa chun amatah thina dinga adel ahi.
target: Truly the righteous attain life, but whoever pursues evil finds death.

source: Khangitlouna lung puho chu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin; chutobanga chu nolnabei miho lamdih-a acheu chu ama lunglhaina ahi.
target: The Lord detests those whose hearts are perverse, but he delights in those whose ways are blameless.

source: Migiloute khat le khat akhutnun kituhto jongleu talen manlouva umloudiu; ahinla michonpha chilhah vang kihuhdoh ding ahi.
target: Be sure of this: The wicked will not go unpunished, but those who are righteous will go free.

source: Numei melhoitah hetthem theina neilou chu, vohpi nahkuija sana thengsel kibapeh tobang bep ahi.
target: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout is a beautiful woman who shows no discretion.

source: Michonpha lungdei chu aphalam jengbou ahin; amavang migilou kinepna chu lungsatna ahibouve.
target: The desire of the righteous ends only in good, but the hope of the wicked only in wrath.

source: Mihem khatnin manbeijin ahomdohjin, hinlah akhangtouvin ahaocheh cheh jin; mihem khat apehdingdol jong pelouva it aumin, hinlah hiche chun vaichatna lam alhutjon ahi.
target: One person gives freely, yet gains even more; another withholds unduly, but comes to poverty.

source: Mihongphal hinna chu suhthaova umding; chule midinga twi chappeh chan chu ama jong kichap pehding ahi.
target: A generous person will prosper; whoever refreshes others will be refreshed.

source: Ahop ding chang itna michu mipin agaosap ding, ahinla chuche johdohpa lujanga chu vangbohna chuding ahi.
target: People curse the one who hoards grain, but they pray God’s blessing on the one who is willing to sell.

source: Gunchu tah-a apha holpa chun khohsahna akimudoh-a, thilphalou holpa henga vang ase hunglhung ding ahi.
target: Whoever seeks good finds favor, but evil comes to one who searches for it.

source: Ahaona-a kisongpa chu lhutei ding ahin, ahinla michonpha vang thingbah banga khangtou ding ahi.
target: Those who trust in their riches will fall, but the righteous will thrive like a green leaf.

source: Ama insungtah suboipa goulo chu hui hiding; chule mingol chu milungchingpa soh-a pangding ahi.
target: Whoever brings ruin on their family will inherit only wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise.
