source: Chonphat ga chu hinna thingphung ahin; chule lhagaoho huhhingpa chu miching ahi.
target: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and the one who is wise saves lives.

source: Veuvin, chonphate chu leisetna lethuh-a umding ahiuvin, migiloute leh chonsete jongchu chuche sanga tamcheh-a kilethuh ding ahiuve.
target: If the righteous receive their due on earth, how much more the ungodly and the sinner!

source: Koi hile hilchahna ngailu-a chun hetna angailut ahin, kiphona hotbolpa vangchu mingol ahi.
target: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but whoever hates correction is stupid.

source: Mipha chu Pakai khohsahna achangin, ahinla khangitlou thil gongpa vangchu themmo achanding ahi.
target: Good people obtain favor from the Lord , but he condemns those who devise wicked schemes.

source: Phatlouna-in mikhatcha atundoh louding, ahinla michonpha te kijung khona vangchu suhlonghoi hilouding ahi.
target: No one can be established through wickedness, but the righteous cannot be uprooted.

source: Numei chonchan pha chu a-inneipu dinga lallukhuh ahin, hinla jachatna hinlhut numei vangchu amapa ding aguho monlha tobang ahi.
target: A wife of noble character is her husband’s crown, but a disgraceful wife is like decay in his bones.

source: Michonpha lunggel ho chu adih-in, amavang mikhangilou thumop chu kijou lhepna ahibouve.
target: The plans of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

source: Mikhang giloute kamcheng vang thisanso ding chanlhih ding thu ahin; ahinla midihte kamsungsoh vang chun amaho ahuhdoh ding ahi.
target: The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

source: Agiloute chu lekhupmin aumin, abeiji taovin, ahinla michonpha in vangchu dingjing ding ahi.
target: The wicked are overthrown and are no more, but the house of the righteous stands firm.

source: Mikhat chu ama lungsung chihna dungjuija pachat hintin, ahinla lungdihlou kengpa vangchu isahlou hiding ahi.
target: A person is praised according to their prudence, and one with a warped mind is despised.

source: Ama le ama kijabola nehding lhasampa sangin mi i-sah louva um, ahia soh neija michu aphajon ahi.
target: Better to be a nobody and yet have a servant than pretend to be somebody and have no food.

source: Michonphan agancha hinkho akhoh sah-in; ahinla migiloupa nemheuva mikhotona chu engsetna ahibouve.
target: The righteous care for the needs of their animals, but the kindest acts of the wicked are cruel.

source: Agam kilhopa chun nehle chah lhingsetna amuding, ahinla pannabei miho juilepa vangchu hetthem theina lama ahomkeo ahibouve.
target: Those who work their land will have abundant food, but those who chase fantasies have no sense.

source: Mikhangilou vin miphalouho lenthang adeichan, ahinla chonphatna jungchun ga asodoh-e.
target: The wicked desire the stronghold of evildoers, but the root of the righteous endures.

source: Mikhang gilou chu ama thusei dihlouva chun a-oh jin, ahinla midihtah pachu boina-a kona ongdoh ding ahi.
target: Evildoers are trapped by their sinful talk, and so the innocent escape trouble.

source: Akamsunga thupot vanga mikhat chu aphalama lunglhai ding, chule akhut tah-a natongpa chu atohga ama kipetei ding ahi.
target: From the fruit of their lips people are filled with good things, and the work of their hands brings them reward.

source: Mingolin achena lampi chu ama mitnin adih-in amun; ahinla hilchahna ngaipa chu miching ahi.
target: The way of fools seems right to them, but the wise listen to advice.

source: Mingol khat lungsatna chu apettah-a kihedoh ahin, milungchingin vang jum na akhukhumin ahi.
target: Fools show their annoyance at once, but the prudent overlook an insult.

source: Thutah seidohpa chun chonphatna atah langin, ahinla hettohsah lhem vang chun lheplhahna avetsah-e.
target: An honest witness tells the truth, but a false witness tells lies.

source: Chemjam'a kisun banga thusei aumin, ahinla miching thusei chu damna ahi.
target: The words of the reckless pierce like swords, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.

source: Thutah sei kamsung chu a-imatih chana kiphutdoh ding ahin, ahinla thujou seina leigui vangchu chomkhat kah dingbou ahi.
target: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.

source: Lheplhahna hi ase gelho lunga aumjin, ahinla chamna thuhil ho-a vang kipana aume.
target: Deceit is in the hearts of those who plot evil, but those who promote peace have joy.

source: Midihtah chunga thilse sohlou ding ahin; ahinla agilou chu setna-a dimding ahi.
target: No harm overtakes the righteous, but the wicked have their fill of trouble.

source: Thujou seina kamchu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin, ahinla thutah a kimangchaho vang chu ama lunglhaina ahi.
target: The Lord detests lying lips, but he delights in people who are trustworthy.

source: Michingin hetna akikoi tupmin, ahinla mingol ho lungin vang ngolna asamlen ahi.
target: The prudent keep their knowledge to themselves, but a fool’s heart blurts out folly.

source: Gunchupa khutnin vaihomna achoiding ahin, hinla thasepa vangchu hunama na kitohsah ding ahi.
target: Diligent hands will rule, but laziness ends in forced labor.

source: Lungsung pohgih na-in mi alungkham sah-in, ahinla thupha cheng khatnin akipasah-e.
target: Anxiety weighs down the heart, but a kind word cheers it up.

source: Michonpha chu aheng akom sangin gamchengin apha chung nungjon, hinla migilou lampi chun amaho apuimangji-e.
target: The righteous choose their friends carefully, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

source: Mithase chun agam lenna-a atha sa chu agou jipoi, hinla agunchupa thil vang chu manlutah ahi.
target: The lazy do not roast any game, but the diligent feed on the riches of the hunt.

source: Chonphatna lampia chun hinna aumin, chule chuche lampia chun thina himhim aumpoi.
target: In the way of righteousness there is life; along that path is immortality.

source: Chapa chingin apa thuhilna angaijin, mi i-sah loupan vang phona angaipon ahi.
target: A wise son heeds his father’s instruction, but a mocker does not respond to rebukes.

source: Min akamsoh ga tuitah akineh ding ahin, hinla suhkhelna neiho hinna-in vang hunama kibol anehdiu ahi.
target: From the fruit of their lips people enjoy good things, but the unfaithful have an appetite for violence.

source: Akam kituh tuppan ahinkho akivettup ahin, hinla akamtampa vang chun suhgemna ato teiding ahi.
target: Those who guard their lips preserve their lives, but those who speak rashly will come to ruin.

source: Mithasen alungin angaichan hinla aneijipoi; ahivangin migunchu pa hinna chu haosatah-a umding ahi.
target: A sluggard’s appetite is never filled, but the desires of the diligent are fully satisfied.

source: Michonphan joule nala thu kisei aho-in; hinla migilou vang kidah umtah ahin, jachatnan achuji-e.
target: The righteous hate what is false, but the wicked make themselves a stench and bring shame on themselves.

source: Lamdih-a chepa chu chonphat na-in avetupmin, hinla gitlou na-in michonse alehkhup jin ahi.
target: Righteousness guards the person of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

source: Ama kihaosah-a, imacha neilou aumin, ama kivaichatsa-a neile gou tamtah neijong aumin ahi.
target: One person pretends to be rich, yet has nothing; another pretends to be poor, yet has great wealth.

source: Mihem khat hinkho chu haona-a kilhatdoh ahin, hinla vaichahon vang kiphosalna chu angai pouvin ahi.
target: A person’s riches may ransom their life, but the poor cannot respond to threatening rebukes.

source: Mi chonphate vah chu akipah-in; migiloute thaomei vang kisumit ding ahi.
target: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

source: Kiletsah nahin kidouna alhunsahjin, hinla kihilna pha umna-a chun chihna aume.
target: Where there is strife, there is pride, but wisdom is found in those who take advice.

source: Lamdih louva kimu neile gou chu kemsuh teiding ahin, tohgimna-a kona kikholdoh neile gou vang chu pung ding ahi.
target: Dishonest money dwindles away, but whoever gathers money little by little makes it grow.

source: Kinepna thonin lungsung adammo sah-in, hinla ngaichat akimolso teng vangleh, hichu hin thingphung ahi.
target: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but a longing fulfilled is a tree of life.

source: Koi hile thu i-sah louhela koija chu suhmanga umding, hinla thupeh gingpa vangchu kipaman kipeding ahi.
target: Whoever scorns instruction will pay for it, but whoever respects a command is rewarded.

source: Miching dan thupeh chu hinna twinah ahin, hichu thina thangho-a kona hoidohna ahi.
target: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, turning a person from the snares of death.

source: Thilpha hetthem theina chun khohsahna akimun; hinla suhkhelna neiho lampi chu ahahsan ahi.
target: Good judgment wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful leads to their destruction.

source: Milung chingin hetna akisah lelpi-in; hinla mingolin vang angolna chu atahlangin ahi.
target: All who are prudent act with knowledge, but fools expose their folly.

source: Thupole-a pang migilou chu boina-ah alhalut jin; hinla tahsan umtah palai chun damtheina ahinpolut jin ahi.
target: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy brings healing.

source: Vaichatna le jum na chu hilchahna kisan nomloupa chanding ahin; hinla phona kichin thempa vang chu ja-a umding ahi.
target: Whoever disregards discipline comes to poverty and shame, but whoever heeds correction is honored.

source: Ngaichat khat suhbulhit hi hinkho nopna ahin; hinla thilse-a kon kiheimang dinghi mingolte dinga thet umtah ahi.
target: A longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

source: Miching toh chekhom chu chingding ahin; hinla mingol hotoh kiloija chu suhmanga umding ahi.
target: Walk with the wise and become wise, for a companion of fools suffers harm.

source: Setna-in michonseho anungdeljin; hinla michonpha chu phatna-a kilethuh ding ahi.
target: Trouble pursues the sinner, but the righteous are rewarded with good things.

source: Mipha chun achate chate ding neile gou adalhah pehjin; chule michonse te neile gou vangchu midih ho dinga kikhol khom ahi.
target: A good person leaves an inheritance for their children’s children, but a sinner’s wealth is stored up for the righteous.

source: Vaichate loulhona-a neh tamtah aumin, hinla thutanna lhahsam jeh-a suhmanga umjong aumin ahi.
target: An unplowed field produces food for the poor, but injustice sweeps it away.

source: Mol panlou chun achapa ahot ahin; hinla achapa ngailupa vang chun asehgimjin ahi.
target: Whoever spares the rod hates their children, but the one who loves their children is careful to discipline them.

source: Michonphan alungnachim setnin anen; hinla agiloupa vangchu gilkel ding ahi.
target: The righteous eat to their hearts’ content, but the stomach of the wicked goes hungry.

source: Numei chingin a-in akisahdoh-in; hinla numei ngolin vang akhutnin aloilhuji-e.
target: The wise woman builds her house, but with her own hands the foolish one tears hers down.

source: Chondih tah-a kalsongpa chun Pakai agin ahin; hinla alampiho hokhelpa chun Pakai chu i-sah louva abol ahi.
target: Whoever fears the Lord walks uprightly, but those who despise him are devious in their ways.

source: Mingol kamsunga konin kiletsahna jeng apotnin; hinla miching kamin vang amaho ahoidoh sah ding ahi.
target: A fool’s mouth lashes out with pride, but the lips of the wise protect them.

source: Bongchal umlouna-a gan ankong chu athengin; hinla bongchal thahat vanga ga tamtah kiso ji ahi.
target: Where there are no oxen, the manger is empty, but from the strength of an ox come abundant harvests.

source: Tahsan umtah hettohsah chun jou seipontin; hinla hettohsah lhemchun joule nal jeng seijinte.
target: An honest witness does not deceive, but a false witness pours out lies.

source: Mi i-sah loupan chihna aholin, ahivangin amupon; hinla hetna kitihi ahekhenthem theidingin bailamtah ahi.
target: The mocker seeks wisdom and finds none, but knowledge comes easily to the discerning.

source: Mingol kamsunga chihna aumlou nahetdoh tengle, ama-a konin chedoh jengin.
target: Stay away from a fool, for you will not find knowledge on their lips.

source: Milungching chihna chu alampi akihetkhen themtheina chu ahin, hinla mingol ho ngolna chu lheplhahna ahi.
target: The wisdom of the prudent is to give thought to their ways, but the folly of fools is deception.

source: Mingol hon chonset hi totnan amangun; hinla chonphaho lah-a vang khohsahna aume.
target: Fools mock at making amends for sin, but goodwill is found among the upright.

source: Lungsungin amatah hesoh genthei chu akihetnin, chule midangin akipana-a jong chan aneipi poi.
target: Each heart knows its own bitterness, and no one else can share its joy.

source: Migilou in chu lekhupma umding ahin, hinla mikitahpa ponbuh vangchu khangtou jing ding ahi.
target: The house of the wicked will be destroyed, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

source: Mihem dingin adihtobang lampi khat aumin, hinla achaina le hiche lampi chu thina lampi ahiji-e.
target: There is a way that appears to be right, but in the end it leads to death.

source: Nuina jenga jong lungsung gimna aumin, chule hiche thanopna kichaina chu lunghemna ahijin ahi.
target: Even in laughter the heart may ache, and rejoicing may end in grief.

source: Lamdih-a kon kinunghei pa chu ama lunggot lampi jenga achen, chule mipha chu chunga kon kilunglhaisah ding ahi.
target: The faithless will be fully repaid for their ways, and the good rewarded for theirs.

source: Mimolin thujouse atahsanin, hinla mi chingtheipan vang achena ding akivettup jingin ahi.
target: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.

source: Miching akichajin, setna adalhan, hinla mingol vangchu alungsajin chule amale ama akisong ji-e.
target: The wise fear the Lord and shun evil, but a fool is hotheaded and yet feels secure.

source: Lunghangbai mi chu ngolhoi tah-in akimang chajin, chule thil gilou tamtah gongpa chu hotnin aumjitai.
target: A quick-tempered person does foolish things, and the one who devises evil schemes is hated.

source: Mimolin ngolna goulo bangin alon, hinla miching vang hetna chu kikhuhpeh ding ahi.
target: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

source: Migilou chu mipha anga bohkhup ding, chule migiloute chu michonpha te kotphunga bohkhup ding ahi.
target: Evildoers will bow down in the presence of the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

source: Mivaicha chu aheng akom jengin jong ahon, hinla mihao chun gol le pai tamtah aneijin ahi.
target: The poor are shunned even by their neighbors, but the rich have many friends.

source: Aheng akom noise-a chun chonset abol ahin, mivaicha hepina neipa vangchu anunnom ahi.
target: It is a sin to despise one’s neighbor, but blessed is the one who is kind to the needy.

source: Thilse gongho chun asuhkhelu hilou ham? hinla hepina leh thutah chu thilpha gongho-a ahi.
target: Do not those who plot evil go astray? But those who plan what is good find love and faithfulness.

source: Tohgimna jouse-a aphat chomna aumin, hinla kama seitho maimai vang chun vaichatna alhutjin ahi.
target: All hard work brings a profit, but mere talk leads only to poverty.

source: Michingho lallukhuh chu ahaonau ahin; hinla mingol ho ngolna chu angol naohi ahi.
target: The wealth of the wise is their crown, but the folly of fools yields folly.

source: Hettohsah tahsan umtah chun hinkho ahuhdoh-in; hinla hettohsahna lhem chun jou le nal jeng aseije.
target: A truthful witness saves lives, but a false witness is deceitful.

source: Pakai ginna-a chun kisona dettah aumin, chule achate chun kiselna ding mun aneiteidiu ahi.
target: Whoever fears the Lord has a secure fortress, and for their children it will be a refuge.

source: Pakai ginhi hinna twinah ahin, thina thanga kona hoidohna ahi.
target: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, turning a person from the snares of death.

source: Mipi tamtah umhi lengpa-a dinga loupina ahin; hinla mihem lhahsamna-a vangchu lengchapa-a dia manthah na ahi.
target: A large population is a king’s glory, but without subjects a prince is ruined.

source: Milung nengchun hetkhenthem theina lentah anei ahin; hinla mikino thethun angolna achoisang ahi.
target: Whoever is patient has great understanding, but one who is quick-tempered displays folly.

source: Lungdamsela umhi tahsa dinga hinna ahin, hinla kithang thipna hi gule chang monsahna ahi.
target: A heart at peace gives life to the body, but envy rots the bones.

source: Mivaicha bolgentheija chun ama sempa anoise ahin, hinla ama jabol chanchun vaichate chunga khotona anei ahi.
target: Whoever oppresses the poor shows contempt for their Maker, but whoever is kind to the needy honors God.

source: Migilou chu ama gitlouna a delmangin aumin, hinla michonphan vang thina chunga jong kinepna aneijin ahi.
target: When calamity comes, the wicked are brought down, but even in death the righteous seek refuge in God.

source: Hetkhen themtheina neipa lungsunga chun chihna achengin, hinla mingol ho lungthim sunga umchu akihedoh teijin ahi.
target: Wisdom reposes in the heart of the discerning and even among fools she lets herself be known.

source: Chonphat na-in namkhat achoisangin, hinla chonsetna hi nampi dinga themmo chana ahi.
target: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.

source: Lengpa khohsahna chu sottol milung chingpa chunga aumjin, hinla alunghana chu jachatna sodohsahpa chunga aumin ahi.
target: A king delights in a wise servant, but a shameful servant arouses his fury.

source: Aw nemheuva kidonbutna hin lungsatna aheimangin; hinla thucheng ngeimotah chun lunghanna asuthouve.
target: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

source: Miching leijin hetna chu dihtah-in amangcha jin; hinla mingolte kamin ngolna ngen aphongdoh-in ahi.
target: The tongue of the wise adorns knowledge, but the mouth of the fool gushes folly.

source: Pakaiyin munjouse amusoh keijin; ase leh apha ave jingin ahi.
target: The eyes of the Lord are everywhere, keeping watch on the wicked and the good.

source: Kamdam awnema thu kisei chu hinna thingphung tobang ahin; hinla thugilou sei leigui vang lhagao suse-a ahi.
target: The soothing tongue is a tree of life, but a perverse tongue crushes the spirit.

source: Mingolin apan ahilchahna i-sah louvin akoijin; hinla phona kisanthem michu miching ahi.
target: A fool spurns a parent’s discipline, but whoever heeds correction shows prudence.

source: Michonpha te insunga chun neile gou tamtah aumin; hinla migilouho phatchomna vangchu boinabou ahi.
target: The house of the righteous contains great treasure, but the income of the wicked brings ruin.

source: Miching kamin hetna athejalin; hinla mingol lungin vang chutin abolpoi.
target: The lips of the wise spread knowledge, but the hearts of fools are not upright.

source: Migilouvin kilhaina abol chu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin; hinla milungdih taonachu ama lunglhaina tah ahi.
target: The Lord detests the sacrifice of the wicked, but the prayer of the upright pleases him.

source: Migilou lampi chu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin; hinla chonphatna nung juipachu aman angailun ahi.
target: The Lord detests the way of the wicked, but he loves those who pursue righteousness.

source: Suhdihna hi achena lampi dalhapa dingin athohhah-in; chule phona nahsah loupa chu thiteiding ahi.
target: Stern discipline awaits anyone who leaves the path; the one who hates correction will die.

source: Thikholkhul leh manthah na chu Pakai anga aumin; achutile mihem chate lungthim jong chusanga khohcheh louding ham?
target: Death and Destruction lie open before the Lord — how much more do human hearts!

source: Mi i-sah loupa chun aphohpa chu angailupon; ama michingte koma jong cheponte.
target: Mockers resent correction, so they avoid the wise.

source: Lungsung kipana chun kipana maiso asosah-in; hinla lungjin nahin lhagao asusen ahi.
target: A happy heart makes the face cheerful, but heartache crushes the spirit.

source: Hetkhenthem theina neipa lunggil chun hetna aholin; hinla mingol ho kam vangchu ngolna-in akivah-in ahi.
target: The discerning heart seeks knowledge, but the mouth of a fool feeds on folly.

source: Suhgentheija umte dingin nikhojouse chu aphalou jeng ahin; hinla lungkipah-a umten tanglouvin golnop anei jinguve.
target: All the days of the oppressed are wretched, but the cheerful heart has a continual feast.

source: Pakai gingpuma themcha neichu, neile gou tampi boina toh neitha sanga phajo ahi.
target: Better a little with the fear of the Lord than great wealth with turmoil.

source: Kidou puma bongchal thaotah neh sangin; ngailutna puma anche me neh aphajoi.
target: Better a small serving of vegetables with love than a fattened calf with hatred.

source: Lungsat kengpan kinahna achoh thouvin; hinla milung nengin kinahna asuchamin ahi.
target: A hot-tempered person stirs up conflict, but the one who is patient calms a quarrel.

source: Mithase chenalampi chu lingtho kikaitobang ahin; hinla michonpha lampi chu lamphei ahi.
target: The way of the sluggard is blocked with thorns, but the path of the upright is a highway.

source: Chapa chingin apa akipasah-in; hinla chapa ngolin anu anoise-in ahi.
target: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish man despises his mother.

source: Ngolchon kitihi chihna-a lhasampa dingin thanopna ahin; hetkhen themna neipa vang dihtah-in achon jinge.
target: Folly brings joy to one who has no sense, but whoever has understanding keeps a straight course.

source: Thumopna umlouna-a thil kigongho chu alhasamjin; hinla thumopthem tamna-a chun hicheho chu akimolso jin ahi.
target: Plans fail for lack of counsel, but with many advisers they succeed.

source: Mihem chu dihtah-a donbutna akipeh jallin thanopna aneijin; chule thucheng khat aphatcha kiseidoh chu iti phatna pha hitam!
target: A person finds joy in giving an apt reply— and how good is a timely word!

source: Noilam thikhol khul'a kona akiheimang theina dingin; hinna lampi chu milungching dingin chunglama aume.
target: The path of life leads upward for the prudent to keep them from going down to the realm of the dead.

source: Mi kiletsah insung chu Pakaiyin alhuhsah ding ahin; hinla aman meithainu gamgichu aphudoh ding ahi.
target: The Lord tears down the house of the proud, but he sets the widow’s boundary stones in place.

source: Migilou lunggel ho chu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin; mitheng thusei ho vangchu thucheng ngeitah ahi.
target: The Lord detests the thoughts of the wicked, but gracious words are pure in his sight.

source: Mikilose chun a-insung asuhboi bep ahin; hinla nehguh thilho thetbolpa chu kihinso teiding ahi.
target: The greedy bring ruin to their households, but the one who hates bribes will live.

source: Michonpha lungin adonbutna ding akigeltoh in; migilou kam invang thilseho asodoh jingin ahi.
target: The heart of the righteous weighs its answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes evil.

source: Pakai chu migiloute-a konin agamlan; hinla michonpha taona vangchu aman angaipeh-in ahi.
target: The Lord is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

source: Mit ha hoi selin lungsung akipasah-in; chule thulhut phatah chu gule chang ho dinga damna ahi.
target: Light in a messenger’s eyes brings joy to the heart, and good news gives health to the bones.

source: Hinna dinga kiphona ngailha nakhang chu michingte lah-a achengin ahi.
target: Whoever heeds life-giving correction will be at home among the wise.

source: Hilchahna donloupa chun amatah-in hinna chu i-sahlouva akoi ahin; phona kingaipa vang chun hetthem theina akimudoh-in ahi.
target: Those who disregard discipline despise themselves, but the one who heeds correction gains understanding.

source: Chihna hilchahna chu Pakai ginding hi ahin; chule jana masanga chun kineosahna aume.
target: Wisdom’s instruction is to fear the Lord , and humility comes before honor.

source: Mihem in alungthimin tohgon aneijin,; hinlah kamsunga kon donbutna chu Pakaiya konbou ahi.
target: To humans belong the plans of the heart, but from the Lord comes the proper answer of the tongue.

source: Mihem khat-in ama mitvetnin alampi jouse chu athengselin amun; ahinla Pakaiyin lungsung chu akholchilin ahi.
target: All a person’s ways seem pure to them, but motives are weighed by the Lord .

source: Nanatoh jouse chu Pakaiya pedohjengin, chutile nalunggel ho chu lolhingtei ding ahi.
target: Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.

source: Pakaiyin thiljouse ama dinga asem ahi, henge, migiloute jengjong nikho phalou ni-a dinga asem ahi.
target: The Lord works out everything to its proper end— even the wicked for a day of disaster.

source: Lungsunga kiletsah tapouchu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin, khutle khut kituhmat to jengjongle, ama chu talen manlouva umlou helding ahi.
target: The Lord detests all the proud of heart. Be sure of this: They will not go unpunished.

source: Hepina leh thutah-in khangitlouna asuthengin; chule Pakai ginna jal-in mihem ten setna adalhaove.
target: Through love and faithfulness sin is atoned for; through the fear of the Lord evil is avoided.

source: Mi achondanin Pakai akipasah tengle, amelmate jengjong amatoh akichamsah-in ahi.
target: When the Lord takes pleasure in anyone’s way, he causes their enemies to make peace with them.

source: Chonphatna puma thil themcha khat neichu, alamlouva kimu thil tamtah sangin aphajoi.
target: Better a little with righteousness than much gain with injustice.

source: Mihem khat lungsungin ama lampi agongin, ahinla Pakaiyin vang amapa kalsonna dingho akopeh-in ahi.
target: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.

source: Pathen thutanlhahna chu lengpa kamsunga konin apotnin; akamin jong thu atankhel louding ahi.
target: The lips of a king speak as an oracle, and his mouth does not betray justice.

source: Agih dihtah leh khaikot dihtah chu Pakaiya ahin; dip sunga um thilgih kitedoh jouse jong ama boljeng ahi.
target: Honest scales and balances belong to the Lord ; all the weights in the bag are of his making.

source: Phatlouna tohdohhi lengte dinga thet umtah ahi, ajehchu laltounahi chonphatna-a kitungdoh ahi.
target: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.

source: Dihtah-a thu kisei chu lengho lunglhaina ahin, chule amahon thudih seija chu angailuvin ahi.
target: Kings take pleasure in honest lips; they value the one who speaks what is right.

source: Lengpa lunghana chu thina thupole tobang ahin, ahinla michingin vang hichu asulungdam jin ahi.
target: A king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but the wise will appease it.

source: Lengpa maiso vah-a chun hinna aumin, chule aman akhohsah mi chu gotuilha nunung twimei tobang ahi.
target: When a king’s face brightens, it means life; his favor is like a rain cloud in spring.

source: Sana sanga chihna kimudoh hi iti phatna pha hitam! chule dangka sanga hetkhen themtheina kilhenjohhi iti phatjoh hitam!
target: How much better to get wisdom than gold, to get insight rather than silver!

source: Midih lamlhongpi chu agilouva kona kiheimang hi ahin, alampi kituhdetpa chun ahinkho akivettup ahi.
target: The highway of the upright avoids evil; those who guard their ways preserve their lives.

source: Manthah na masanga kilet sahna achen, chule lhuh nading masanga hoithona achen ahi.
target: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.

source: Mikiletsahho toh thil kichomdoh kihop sangin, kineosah puma minoinung hotoh umkhom aphajoi.
target: Better to be lowly in spirit along with the oppressed than to share plunder with the proud.

source: Koihile hilchahna ngaipha-a chun thilpha akimudoh-in; chule koihile Pakai tahsan chanchu anunnom ahi.
target: Whoever gives heed to instruction prospers, and blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord .

source: Alungsunga chihna nei mi chu thil hekhen them kitiding ahin, chule nemheuva thu kiseijin hetna apunsah-e.
target: The wise in heart are called discerning, and gracious words promote instruction.

source: Hetthem theina hi aneijoupa dingin hinna twinah ahin, ahinla mingol ho hilchahna chu ngolna ahibouve.
target: Prudence is a fountain of life to the prudent, but folly brings punishment to fools.

source: Michingin alungsunga chihna mangchan thu aseijin; chule amuh dingin kihilna abepeh-in ahi.
target: The hearts of the wise make their mouths prudent, and their lips promote instruction.

source: Ngainom um thuchengho chu khoiju tobang ahin, hinna-a dinga lhumkei le gule changho dinga damna ahi.
target: Gracious words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and healing to the bones.

source: Mihem dingin adih tobang lampi aumin, ahinla chuche lampi chu akhonna thina ahijin ahi.
target: There is a way that appears to be right, but in the end it leads to death.

source: Natong gimma chun amadinga atohgim ahi, ajehchu agilkel chun atohsah ahi.
target: The appetite of laborers works for them; their hunger drives them on.

source: Pathen ngaisahlou michun setna alaidohjin; chule athusei jong meikong tobang ahi.
target: A scoundrel plots evil, and on their lips it is like a scorching fire.

source: Jon lunggelin kinahna atun, guhthim thu seile pan golcha phatah ho asukhenjin ahi.
target: A perverse person stirs up conflict, and a gossip separates close friends.

source: Hunam panpa chun aheng akom atilsejin; chule lampi phalouva apuilutjin ahi.
target: A violent person entices their neighbor and leads them down a path that is not good.

source: Aman hoitho thil mitsing leuvin agongjin, akam achaloh sah-in thilse ahinlhutjin ahi.
target: Whoever winks with their eye is plotting perversity; whoever purses their lips is bent on evil.

source: Tehse samkang hi loupina lallukhuh ahin; Hichu chonphatna lampia kon bou kimu ahi
target: Gray hair is a crown of splendor; it is attained in the way of righteousness.

source: Lunghan nalama ngaikhampa chu thahattahpa sangin aphajon, chule alungsung kivaihom joupa chu khopi khat lapa sangin aphajon ahi.
target: Better a patient person than a warrior, one with self-control than one who takes a city.

source: Pheichunga chun vang akisang jin; hinla thulhahna jouse chu Pakaiya ahi.
target: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the Lord .

source: Lunglhai sela an-gum kamkhat neh hi, kinah puma insung dimset golvah an neh sanga phajo ahi.
target: Better a dry crust with peace and quiet than a house full of feasting, with strife.

source: Soh chingtah-in jachatna semdoh chapa chunga vai ahop ding; chule sopiho goulona lah-a chu chan aneiding ahi.
target: A prudent servant will rule over a disgraceful son and will share the inheritance as one of the family.

source: Dangka dingin lhit thengna bel, chule sana dingin lhummei akimangin; ahinla Pakaiyin vang lungsungho apatepjin ahi.
target: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but the Lord tests the heart.

source: Khanset bolpa chun jouthu jeng angaijin, chule mijouvin thil gilou ngaina dingin ana asunge.
target: A wicked person listens to deceitful lips; a liar pays attention to a destructive tongue.

source: Koihile mivaicha daichavaija chun ama asempa i-asahlou ahin, chule midang vangsetna chunga kipahpa chu talen manlouva umlou helding ahi.
target: Whoever mocks the poor shows contempt for their Maker; whoever gloats over disaster will not go unpunished.

source: Achate chate chu tehse hodinga lallukhuh ahin, chule achateu loupina chu apateu ahi.
target: Children’s children are a crown to the aged, and parents are the pride of their children.

source: Mingolin thugiltah aseidohle akilompon; chusanga chu leng chapan jou aseiding chu kilommo cheh ahi.
target: Eloquent lips are unsuited to a godless fool— how much worse lying lips to a ruler!

source: Kipamana kipe thil hi aneipa mitna songmantam tobang ahin, amachu akiheinalam tina akhangtouve.
target: A bribe is seen as a charm by the one who gives it; they think success will come at every turn.

source: Suhkhel khukhumpa chun ngailutna ahol ahin; ahinla thilkhat velphoh jingpa chun golphatah jong asukhenjin ahi.
target: Whoever would foster love covers over an offense, but whoever repeats the matter separates close friends.

source: Mingol khatnin jakhatvei jepna atosangin, miching khatnin khatvei kiphona chu na asajon ahi.
target: A rebuke impresses a discerning person more than a hundred lashes a fool.

source: Mi gilouvin kiphinna ding jengbou aholin, hijeh-a chu mi engse thupole khat ama doudinga kisol ding ahi.
target: Evildoers foster rebellion against God; the messenger of death will be sent against them.

source: Mingol khat angolpet tosangin, vompi anouho kilohpeh khat toh kimaito abaijon ahi.
target: Better to meet a bear robbed of her cubs than a fool bent on folly.

source: Koi hile apha chu ase-a lethuh chanchu, insunga kona ase kichoidoh louhel ding ahi.
target: Evil will never leave the house of one who pays back evil for good.

source: Kinah kipatnahi mikhatnin twi agah londohsah tobang ahin, hijeh chun kinahna asodoh masangin kinelna chu dalhan.
target: Starting a quarrel is like breaching a dam; so drop the matter before a dispute breaks out.

source: Miphalouho themchan sah-a, chule midihtah ho themmo chansah-a chu anilhona Pakai dinga thet umtah ahi.
target: Acquitting the guilty and condemning the innocent— the Lord detests them both.

source: Chihna-a alunglut lou mingol chun, ipikhoh-a chihna chohna dinga akhutna sum achoi dingham?
target: Why should fools have money in hand to buy wisdom, when they are not able to understand it?

source: Loile gol chun phat jousen angailun, sopi vang genthei nikho-a dinga peng ahi.
target: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for a time of adversity.

source: Hetthem theina neiloupa chun akhut abengton, chule loile gol anga kitepna neija dingpa-in ahungpang jitai.
target: One who has no sense shakes hands in pledge and puts up security for a neighbor.

source: Suhkhelna ngailupa chun kinahna adei ahin, chule akotpi choisanga chun manthah na ahol ahi.
target: Whoever loves a quarrel loves sin; whoever builds a high gate invites destruction.

source: Khangitlouna lung neipa chun thilpha amupon; chule joule nal seijingpa vang thilphalou va alhalut jitai.
target: One whose heart is corrupt does not prosper; one whose tongue is perverse falls into trouble.

source: Mingol chu ahingpa din gimna ahin; chule mingolpa pa chun kipana aneipoi.
target: To have a fool for a child brings grief; there is no joy for the parent of a godless fool.

source: Lungsung kipana hi loule ai phatah abangin; ahinla lung gentheina vang hin gu le changho agotsah-in ahi.
target: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

source: Migilouvin thutanna lampiho heikoina dingin, guhthima thilpeh akilahjin ahi.
target: The wicked accept bribes in secret to pervert the course of justice.

source: Hetkhenthem theina neipa masanga chihna aumin, ahinla mingolpa mit vang chun leiset mong gei ave lelen ahi.
target: A discerning person keeps wisdom in view, but a fool’s eyes wander to the ends of the earth.

source: Chapa ngolchu apa dinga gimna ahin, chule anu dinga hesohna bep ahi.
target: A foolish son brings grief to his father and bitterness to the mother who bore him.

source: Chujongle midih gotna peh-a, ahiloule thu adih-a tanjeh-a pipuiho jepna kipe jongchu dihlou ahi.
target: If imposing a fine on the innocent is not good, surely to flog honest officials is not right.

source: Hetna neipa chun ngaikham tah-in thu aseijin; chule hetkhenthem theina neija michu milungchingtah ahi.
target: The one who has knowledge uses words with restraint, and whoever has understanding is even-tempered.

source: Mingol jengjong thipbeh-a aum tengleh michinga sim ahin; chule akam kihup pa chu hetkhenthem theina neimi ahi tin akive sange.
target: Even fools are thought wise if they keep silent, and discerning if they hold their tongues.

source: Mipi lah-a kon kikangse mihem chun, ama phatchomna ding maimai bou aholin, thudih jouse douvin apangin ahi.
target: An unfriendly person pursues selfish ends and against all sound judgment starts quarrels.

source: Mingol chun chihna le hetna-a kipana aneipon, hinlah ama lunggel jengbou phondoh ding adeije.
target: Fools find no pleasure in understanding but delight in airing their own opinions.

source: Migilou ahungtengle i-sah louna jong ahung jin, chuleh minsetna ahungteng jum na ahungjin ahi.
target: When wickedness comes, so does contempt, and with shame comes reproach.

source: Mihem khat kamsunga kon thupot chu twithuh tahho tobang ahin, chihna twinah jonghi vadung longjing tobang ahi.
target: The words of the mouth are deep waters, but the fountain of wisdom is a rushing stream.

source: Thutanna munna migiloupa panpi-a, chuleh michondih pa themmo chansah jongchu phaloutah ahi.
target: It is not good to be partial to the wicked and so deprive the innocent of justice.

source: Mingol thusei chun kinelna asosahjin, chule akamsungin ama kijepnading akiseidoh ji-e.
target: The lips of fools bring them strife, and their mouths invite a beating.

source: Mingol kamsungsoh chu amadinga manthah na ahin, chule athusei chu ahinkho kisuh mangna dinga thang ahi.
target: The mouths of fools are their undoing, and their lips are a snare to their very lives.

source: Guhthima kisei thucheng chu nehle chah tuitah tobang ahin, chule oisunggil lampeh a alutjin ahi.
target: The words of a gossip are like choice morsels; they go down to the inmost parts.

source: Anatoh na-a thasepa chu, ijakai susepa toh sopi khat ahi.
target: One who is slack in his work is brother to one who destroys.

source: Pakai minchu insang dettah ahin, hia chun michonpha te alhailut alhailutnun ahoijuve.
target: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.

source: Mihaopa dinga anei agouchu akhopi dettah tobang ahin, chule akiletsahpi tah kulpi sangtah tobang ahi.
target: The wealth of the rich is their fortified city; they imagine it a wall too high to scale.

source: Suhmangna masanga chun mihem lungthima hoithona aumin, chule jana masanga kineosahna aumin ahi.
target: Before a downfall the heart is haughty, but humility comes before honor.

source: Thu angailhah masanga donbut jengpa chu, amadinga ngolna leh jachatna ahi.
target: To answer before listening— that is folly and shame.

source: Mihem lhagao chun mihem adammo na-a kon adamsah jou ahin, ahinlah koiham lhagao damlouna thohjou dinga?
target: The human spirit can endure in sickness, but a crushed spirit who can bear?

source: Milung chingin hetkhena akimudoh-in, chule miching nakhangin hetna aholin ahi.
target: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.

source: Mihem khat chu athilpeh-in ama dingin mun asem peh-in; chule amachu milen, milal ho masanga ahin puilut jin ahi.
target: A gift opens the way and ushers the giver into the presence of the great.

source: Ama chungthu kisei masatpa chu adihtah danin akilangin; ahinla aheng akom chu ahungin ama ahung kholchiljin ahi.
target: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.

source: Vang san nahin kinelnaho asuthipmin, chule mithahat te jong asukhenin ahi.
target: Casting the lot settles disputes and keeps strong opponents apart.

source: Sopi kisunohsa jollut kitna chu khopi dettah lahsangin ahahsajon; chule amaho kibaona chu kulpi pal kigenho bangjeng ahi.
target: A brother wronged is more unyielding than a fortified city; disputes are like the barred gates of a citadel.

source: Mihem chu akamsung soh jala oiva setna umding, athusei phatchomna jala ama vaset ding ahi.
target: From the fruit of their mouth a person’s stomach is filled; with the harvest of their lips they are satisfied.

source: Leigui hin thina le hinna thahatna aneijin, chule chuche ngailuho chun aga akineh dingu ahi.
target: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.

source: Koihile jinu kimu-a chun thilpha akimu ahin; chule Pakai khohsahna chu changa ahitai.
target: He who finds a wife finds what is good and receives favor from the Lord .

source: Mivaichan taona jeng amangchan, ahinla mihaovin vang hoithotah-in adonbutnin ahi.
target: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.

source: Golle pai tamtah nei mikhat chu amajong agolho dinga golphatah hiding, hinla sopi tah sanga ikinaipi goljong aumin ahi.
target: One who has unreliable friends soon comes to ruin, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

source: Genthei jongle kitah tah-a hinkho mangpa chu, thugilou seija mingolpa sangin aphajon ahi.
target: Better the poor whose walk is blameless than a fool whose lips are perverse.

source: Hetna beija umhi aphapon, chule chonset na-a kaljangpa jongchu aphadeh pon ahi.
target: Desire without knowledge is not good— how much more will hasty feet miss the way!

source: Mihem angolna chun alampi aheimangpeh-in, chule alungthim sunga Pakai adouvin ahi.
target: A person’s own folly leads to their ruin, yet their heart rages against the Lord .

source: Neile gouvin loile gol tampi asemdoh-in, ahinla vaichapa chu aheng akom jengin jong adalha jitai.
target: Wealth attracts many friends, but even the closest friend of the poor person deserts them.

source: Hettohsah lhem chu talen manlouva umlou ding ahin, chule jou le nala thusei jongchu hoidoh louhel ding ahi.
target: A false witness will not go unpunished, and whoever pours out lies will not go free.

source: Pipuiho khohsahna chu mitam tah-in angeh dingu ahin, chule thilpepa din mitin chu agol apai ahijitai.
target: Many curry favor with a ruler, and everyone is the friend of one who gives gifts.

source: Mivaicha chu asopite jousen jong ahot boluvin, agolho chu ama-a konin iti agamlat tadiuvem? Aman amaho chu ngehna le taona pumin anung delpeh-in, hinlah amahon adon tapouve.
target: The poor are shunned by all their relatives— how much more do their friends avoid them! Though the poor pursue them with pleading, they are nowhere to be found.

source: Chihna kimudohpa chun ahinna angailut ahin, hetkhen themtheina kichin pachun thilpha amuteiding ahi.
target: The one who gets wisdom loves life; the one who cherishes understanding will soon prosper.

source: Hettohsah lhem chu talen manlouva umlou helding, chule jouthu seipa chu mangthah teiding ahi.
target: A false witness will not go unpunished, and whoever pours out lies will perish.

source: Nomsa tah-a hinkho mandinghi mingol dingin akilompon, soh khatnin pipuiho chunga vai ahomding jong akilompoi.
target: It is not fitting for a fool to live in luxury— how much worse for a slave to rule over princes!

source: Mihem lunggel themnan alunghana asudamin, chuleh ama douna-a thil kibol angaidam jouchu aloupina ahi.
target: A person’s wisdom yields patience; it is to one’s glory to overlook an offense.

source: Lengpa lungsatna chu keipi kitum tobang ahin; ama mikhohsahna vang chu hampa chunga daitwi lha tobang ahi.
target: A king’s rage is like the roar of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

source: Chapa ngol chu apadinga hamsetna ahin; chule kinel kalna dimset inneipi chu tanglouva vajing gotwi tobang ahi.
target: A foolish child is a father’s ruin, and a quarrelsome wife is like the constant dripping of a leaky roof.

source: Inle lou, chule neile gou jouse hi pate-a kon kilason gou chu ahin, chule numei ji phatah vanghi Pakaiya kon ahi
target: Houses and wealth are inherited from parents, but a prudent wife is from the Lord .

source: Thasetna hin mihem a-imut lhuhsah-in; chule mi thase chun kel athoh ding mong ahi.
target: Laziness brings on deep sleep, and the shiftless go hungry.

source: Thupeh nitpa chun ahinkho akichintup ahin, ahinla alamjot na-a chingtheilou chu thitei ding ahi.
target: Whoever keeps commandments keeps their life, but whoever shows contempt for their ways will die.

source: Mivaicha chunga khotona neipa chun Pakai apeh ahin; chule aman anapehdohsah chu alepeh kitding ahi.
target: Whoever is kind to the poor lends to the Lord , and he will reward them for what they have done.

source: Kinepna aumpetnin nachapa bolgimin, chule suhmanga aumding jong gel hih-in.
target: Discipline your children, for in that there is hope; do not be a willing party to their death.

source: Milungchomin talen amat teiding ahi; ajehchu nangman ama huhdoh jengle chun avela abolkit teiding ahi.
target: A hot-tempered person must pay the penalty; rescue them, and you will have to do it again.

source: Khonunga nachih theina dingin, hilthemnale hilchahna hi ngaijin lang kisanin.
target: Listen to advice and accept discipline, and at the end you will be counted among the wise.

source: Mihem lungsunga thilgon tampi aumin, ahijeng vangin Pakai thilgon leh phatsah bouchu kiphutdet ding ahi.
target: Many are the plans in a person’s heart, but it is the Lord ’s purpose that prevails.

source: Mihem khatnin angaichat chu lungsetna chan hi ahin, chule joule nal sei mihem hisangin mivaicha hiding aphajoi.
target: What a person desires is unfailing love; better to be poor than a liar.

source: Pakai ginna-in hinna-a apuilutnin, chuche Pakai ging mi chu lunglhai ding ahin, thilsen alhunkhum louhel ding ahi.
target: The fear of the Lord leads to life; then one rests content, untouched by trouble.

source: Mithasen akhutnin abukong asohlut jin, akam sung geija hin dop ding jong angapcha poi.
target: A sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not even bring it back to his mouth!

source: Mitaitompa akijepleh, mimolpan chih theinan aneijin, chule hetkhenthem theina neipa chu phohsal lechun hetna-a khangtou ding ahi.
target: Flog a mocker, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke the discerning, and they will gain knowledge.

source: Apa lamlouva engbola chule anu delmanga chu jum nale jachatna hinpolut chapa chu ahi.
target: Whoever robs their father and drives out their mother is a child who brings shame and disgrace.

source: Kachapa, hetkhen themna-a kon nachekhelsah thumop ho chu ngaita hih hellin.
target: Stop listening to instruction, my son, and you will stray from the words of knowledge.

source: Pathen jalou hettohsahpan thutanlhahna dihtah chu ataitomin, chule migilou kamsungin khangitlouna chu avalhume.
target: A corrupt witness mocks at justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down evil.

source: Gotna hohi mitaitom ho dinga kisem ahin; chule kijepnahohi mingol ho tungtuna ding ahi.
target: Penalties are prepared for mockers, and beatings for the backs of fools.

source: Ju hi midai chavai ahin, chule akidontho khamnathei jong kinahna ahibouve. Hicheho kipui mangsah chu miching ahipoi.
target: Wine is a mocker and beer a brawler; whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

source: Lengpa lungsatna hi keipi kitum tobang ahin; koihile ama lunghan sah-a chu amatah hinkho achanlo teiding ahi.
target: A king’s wrath strikes terror like the roar of a lion; those who anger him forfeit their lives.

source: Mihem khat dinga kinahna-a kon akikangse thei chu, ja achan na ahin; ahinla angol tapouvin kinahna asosah theije.
target: It is to one’s honor to avoid strife, but every fool is quick to quarrel.

source: Thasepan daplai ahijeh-in lou alhoupon, hijeh-a chu chang at tengle aman khut adolea imacha neilouva umding ahije.
target: Sluggards do not plow in season; so at harvest time they look but find nothing.

source: Mihem lungsunga um hilthem theina hi twi thuhtah tobang ahin; ahinla hetkhentheina neipan akithaldoh ding ahi.
target: The purposes of a person’s heart are deep waters, but one who has insight draws them out.

source: Mitam tah-in ama changseh phatna aphongjal len, ahinla mi kitah tah chu kon amu jouding ham?
target: Many claim to have unfailing love, but a faithful person who can find?

source: Midih chu ama kitahna-a achon lejin, ama nunga achate jong phat theina achanguve.
target: The righteous lead blameless lives; blessed are their children after them.

source: Thutanna laltouna a tou lengpan amit tenin thil gilou jouse chu athecheh-in ahi.
target: When a king sits on his throne to judge, he winnows out all evil with his eyes.

source: Koiham kalungsung kakisop thengtan, kachonsetna-a konin kathengtai, tia aseithei ding?
target: Who can say, “I have kept my heart pure; I am clean and without sin”?

source: Thilgih kibanglou leh thilgih tena dihlou chu, kibangtah-a Pakai dinga thet umtah ahi.
target: Differing weights and differing measures— the Lord detests them both.

source: Chapang khat jengjong anatohchu atheng ham, adih ham, athilbola konin akihekhen jenge.
target: Even small children are known by their actions, so is their conduct really pure and upright?

source: Khojah theina kol leh, khomutheina mit jengjong, ania Pakaiyin asem cheh ahi.
target: Ears that hear and eyes that see— the Lord has made them both.

source: Imut dingjeng ngailu hih-in, vaichatlo getnin nate, namitteni hasah jingin,chutile changlhah-a naneija, nalunglhai ding ahi.
target: Do not love sleep or you will grow poor; stay awake and you will have food to spare.

source: Thilchopan hichehi apanna aumpoi, hichehi apanna ding aumpoi, tin aseijin, ahin achedoh tengle vang akithang-at jie.
target: “It’s no good, it’s no good!” says the buyer— then goes off and boasts about the purchase.

source: Sana aumin chule songmantam tampi aumnai, ahinla hetna hungsodohna kam vangchu songmantam lutah khat ahi.
target: Gold there is, and rubies in abundance, but lips that speak knowledge are a rare jewel.

source: Gamdang mikhat dinga kitepna thilla kitungpa ponsil chu lahpeh un; chule gamdang numeinu khat dingin kitepna thilin mangun.
target: Take the garment of one who puts up security for a stranger; hold it in pledge if it is done for an outsider.

source: Mihem khat dingin lamdih louva kimu changlhah hi atuijin; ahinla chomkhat joutengle akamsunga chu songbong dimding ahi.
target: Food gained by fraud tastes sweet, but one ends up with a mouth full of gravel.

source: Thilgon tapouhi thumopna in aphudoh ahin; chule kihilna phatah in gal asat ahibouve.
target: Plans are established by seeking advice; so if you wage war, obtain guidance.

source: Guhthimthu seija vahlelepa chun thu ki imho aphongdoh jin; hijeh chun akama thuphalou seile hotoh kitimat hihbeh in.
target: A gossip betrays a confidence; so avoid anyone who talks too much.

source: Koihile apa ahiloule anu samse-a chu; ameivah muthim lah-a kisuhmit pehding ahi.
target: If someone curses their father or mother, their lamp will be snuffed out in pitch darkness.

source: Neile gou chu abul lang gangtah-a gahlothei ahinai; ahinla akichaina chu phattheibohna hilouhel ding ahi.
target: An inheritance claimed too soon will not be blessed at the end.

source: Keiman setna chu kalethuh teiding ahi, tin seihih beh in; amavang Pakai chu ngah-in, aman nangma nahuhdoh teiding ahi.
target: Do not say, “I’ll pay you back for this wrong!” Wait for the Lord , and he will avenge you.

source: Thilgih dihlou chu Pakai dinga thet umtah ahin; chule thilgih tena dihlou jongchu thilpha ahipoi.
target: The Lord detests differing weights, and dishonest scales do not please him.

source: Mihem chenahohi Pakaiya kon ahin, achutile mihemin ama lampi iti akihet khenthei ding ham?
target: A person’s steps are directed by the Lord . How then can anyone understand their own way?

source: Kinotah-a thilkhat chu atheng ahi tia, chule kitepna ineijouva nungkhol kitding kiti hi mihem dinga kipal lhuhna thangkol ahibouve.
target: It is a trap to dedicate something rashly and only later to consider one’s vows.

source: Leng chingtah chun migilouho athe cheh-in, chule achunguva changvohna kanglum chu atangjin ahi.
target: A wise king winnows out the wicked; he drives the threshing wheel over them.

source: Mihem lhagao chu Pakai meivah ahin, hichun mihem lungsung jouse akhol chilsoh ji-e.
target: The human spirit is the lamp of the Lord that sheds light on one’s inmost being.

source: Hepinale thutah-in lengpa chu achingtup jingin, chule ngailutna-in alaltouna chu achoisang jinge.
target: Love and faithfulness keep a king safe; through love his throne is made secure.

source: Khangdongte loupina chu athahatnao hi ahin; chule tehse ho melhoina chu asam kannu hi ahi.
target: The glory of young men is their strength, gray hair the splendor of the old.

source: Thoh hahsatah kijepnan agilou chu asopthengjin; hibang chun kijepna-in sunggil laiho jouse asuthengin ahi.
target: Blows and wounds scrub away evil, and beatings purge the inmost being.

source: Lengpa lungsung chu Pakai khutna um ahin, twi lonna vadungho bangin aman agot nalam lama aheijin ahi.
target: In the Lord ’s hand the king’s heart is a stream of water that he channels toward all who please him.

source: Mihem khat mitmun ama lampi tapouchu adih-in amun, ahinla Pakaiyin lungsungho joh akholchil jin ahi.
target: A person may think their own ways are right, but the Lord weighs the heart.

source: Dihtah-a thil kibole, dihtah-a thutan nahi, kilhaina sanga Pakaiya dinga santhei joh ahi.
target: To do what is right and just is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.

source: Eima chang kivetsangna leh kiletsahna lungsung, chule migilou chalohna jousen chonset aboldoh jin ahi.
target: Haughty eyes and a proud heart— the unplowed field of the wicked—produce sin.

source: Gunchupa lunggel ho chun ninglhin namun alhunsah-in, ahinla kikinsah tapou chu lhasam dingbou ahi.
target: The plans of the diligent lead to profit as surely as haste leads to poverty.

source: Joule nala kimu neile gou chu thina holho dinga pannabei suhle tunga lengle ahibouve.
target: A fortune made by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor and a deadly snare.

source: Migilou ten aguhdoh-u thil hochun amaho asuhmang teiding ahi; ajeh chu amahon thudih ajuinom pouve
target: The violence of the wicked will drag them away, for they refuse to do what is right.

source: Chonsepa lampi chu alam jangpon, hinlah chonphapa natoh vang adihjeng ahi.
target: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.

source: Inn lentah sunga numei nelhat khatto chenkhom sangin, in chung ningkoi khatna chen joh aphajoi.
target: Better to live on a corner of the roof than share a house with a quarrelsome wife.

source: Migilou lunggel chun thilse adeijin, aheng akomin ama mitna khohsahna amujoupoi.
target: The wicked crave evil; their neighbors get no mercy from them.

source: Mitaitompa gimbolna akipeh tengle milhamin chihtheina aneilo jin; chule miching chu akihil teng aman hetna akimujin ahi.
target: When a mocker is punished, the simple gain wisdom; by paying attention to the wise they get knowledge.

source: Michonpha pan agiloute insung chu alungthima chingthei tah-in angaitojin; hinla Pathen'in agiloutechu agitlounau jal-in alehkhup jitai.
target: The Righteous One takes note of the house of the wicked and brings the wicked to ruin.

source: Koi hijongle vaichate kapetna akol kisipma chu, amajong hungkap mintin hinla kijahpeh talou ding ahi.
target: Whoever shuts their ears to the cry of the poor will also cry out and not be answered.

source: Aguh-a thil kipe hin lunghanna adailhah sah-in; chule pon noija nehguh kipe hin lungsatna nasatah asudaijin ahi.
target: A gift given in secret soothes anger, and a bribe concealed in the cloak pacifies great wrath.

source: Thu dihtah-a tanding hi midihte kipana ahin, Hinlah thilgilou bolte chunga manthah na hung lhungding ahi.
target: When justice is done, it brings joy to the righteous but terror to evildoers.

source: Hetthem theina lampia kona vahmangpa chu, athiho kikhop khom nalah-a umding ahi.
target: Whoever strays from the path of prudence comes to rest in the company of the dead.

source: Nopsahna ngailu-a chu vaicha teiding ahin, koihile jule thaova lop chu haosa louhel ding ahi.
target: Whoever loves pleasure will become poor; whoever loves wine and olive oil will never be rich.

source: Migiloute chu michonpha te dinga kilhatdohna-a pangdiu, chule mikitahloute jong mikitahte lhatdoh na-a pangdiu ahi.
target: The wicked become a ransom for the righteous, and the unfaithful for the upright.

source: Numei nelhat jingle lunghang jingtoh chenkhom sangin, gamthipma chending aphajoi.
target: Better to live in a desert than with a quarrelsome and nagging wife.

source: Michingtah chenna in'a chun deichatthei neile gou, chule thao aumin, ahin mingolin vang akisuhmang joujitai.
target: The wise store up choice food and olive oil, but fools gulp theirs down.

source: Koi hile chonphatna le hepina juija chun hinna, chonchan phatna chule jana akimudoh-in ahi.
target: Whoever pursues righteousness and love finds life, prosperity and honor.

source: Miching chun mithahat ho khopi jong atedoh jouvin, chule amahon akisonpiu athahatnao jousejong asuchim jouvin ahi.
target: One who is wise can go up against the city of the mighty and pull down the stronghold in which they trust.

source: Koi hile akamle alei kitimthem chun, alhagao lungjinna-a kona akivenbit ahi.
target: Those who guard their mouths and their tongues keep themselves from calamity.

source: Kiletsah tah-a lunghangpa minchu kiletsah leh taitomhat ahi.
target: The proud and arrogant person—“Mocker” is his name— behaves with insolent fury.

source: Mithase chu angaichat nan athatjitan ahi, ajehchu akhutnin na atonggim nompoi.
target: The craving of a sluggard will be the death of him, because his hands refuse to work.

source: Nilhum keijin aman neipap leh kiloset abolin, ahinla chonpha pan vang apedoh in khen ima aneipoi.
target: All day long he craves for more, but the righteous give without sparing.

source: Khangitloute kilhaina chu thet umtah ahin, aman lungthim phalou puma ahinchoi teng iti thet umcheh ding hitam?
target: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable— how much more so when brought with evil intent!

source: Hettohsah lhem-a pang michu mangthai teiding ahin, hinla thukisei ngaithempan vang tanlouhela thu aseiding ahi.
target: A false witness will perish, but a careful listener will testify successfully.

source: Migiloupa chu akimoh hansan sah-in, hinla mi kitahpa vangin alampi akigeltoh jingin ahi.
target: The wicked put up a bold front, but the upright give thought to their ways.

source: Chihna hihen, hetkhen themna hihen, thumopthemna hijongle Pakai douthei dinga aumpoi.
target: There is no wisdom, no insight, no plan that can succeed against the Lord .

source: Sakol chu gal kisat nikho-a dinga gotsa ahitan, hinla galjona chu Pakaiya kon bou ahi.
target: The horse is made ready for the day of battle, but victory rests with the Lord .

source: Minphatna hi haona tamtah ho sanga kilhending aphajon, chule ngailutna a kikhohsah nahi dangkale sana sanga kilhenjoh ding ahi.
target: A good name is more desirable than great riches; to be esteemed is better than silver or gold.

source: Ahaole avai aumkhomin, abonuva sempa chu Pakai ahi.
target: Rich and poor have this in common: The Lord is the Maker of them all.

source: Milung chingin thilse hunglhung ding chu amu masan, hijeh chun akiselin, ahinla mimolhochu achepaijun talen amanjitaove.
target: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.

source: Kineosahnale Pakai ginna-a chun haona, jana chule hinna aumin ahi.
target: Humility is the fear of the Lord ; its wages are riches and honor and life.

source: Khanggilouho lampia chun lingle thang aumin, ahinkho kichintuppa vang hicheho-a kona chu gamlading ahi.
target: In the paths of the wicked are snares and pitfalls, but those who would preserve their life stay far from them.

source: Chapang chu achena dingdol lampia khoukhah-in; chutile ama ateh teng jongle hia kona chun kiheimang taponte.
target: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.

source: Mihaovin mivaicha chunga vai ahomin, chule abatpa chu abatsahpa soh-in apangin ahi.
target: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.

source: Khangitlouna tupa chun ahomkeo aki at ding ahin, chule alunghana mol chu thon ding ahije.
target: Whoever sows injustice reaps calamity, and the rod they wield in fury will be broken.

source: Mihongphal chu phatthei kiboh teiding ahi; ajehchu aman achanglhah jengjong vaichate din apedoh jin ahi.
target: The generous will themselves be blessed, for they share their food with the poor.

source: Mitaitompa chu deldoh un chutile kinelna beitante; henge, kinahnale kihousetna jong tang tante.
target: Drive out the mocker, and out goes strife; quarrels and insults are ended.

source: Lungthenna ngailupa chu akamdam jeh-a lengpa gol hiding ahi.
target: One who loves a pure heart and who speaks with grace will have the king for a friend.

source: Pakai mit tenin hetna avetupmin, chule aman suhkhelna neipa thusei ho chu alehkhup helin ahi.
target: The eyes of the Lord keep watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.

source: Mithasepa chun, polama keipibahkai aumin, lampi kahlah ho-a keima eithat ninte, tin aseije.
target: The sluggard says, “There’s a lion outside! I’ll be killed in the public square!”

source: Hetkhahlou numei ho kamsung chu kotong thuhtah ahin, Pakai hotna umpa chu chua chu lhalutding ahi.
target: The mouth of an adulterous woman is a deep pit; a man who is under the Lord ’s wrath falls into it.

source: Chapang khat lungsunga chun ngolna aumin, ahinla sudihna molchun ama-a kona gamlatah-a anomang ding ahi.
target: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child, but the rod of discipline will drive it far away.

source: Ahaonaho puntheina dinga vaichaho joulhepma, mihaoho pehbepa vangchu thonlouva lhasam teiding ahi.
target: One who oppresses the poor to increase his wealth and one who gives gifts to the rich—both come to poverty.

source: Nanakhang hinsungin lang miching thuseihohi ngaijin, chule keima hetna lama nalungthim hinmang chan.
target: Pay attention and turn your ear to the sayings of the wise; apply your heart to what I teach,

source: Ajehchu nangman nasunga hicheho chu nakichin tupma ahile, lunglhaina ahin, hicheho chu nakama jong naseiding ahi.
target: for it is pleasing when you keep them in your heart and have all of them ready on your lips.

source: Pakaiya natahsana aumtheina dinga, tuni nikho-a keiman nangmatah henga hetsahna kabol ahitai.
target: So that your trust may be in the Lord , I teach you today, even you.

source: Hetna thu hihen thumop phatah hijongle, thilpha chungnung chu keiman nahenga kahinsut hitalou ham?
target: Have I not written thirty sayings for you, sayings of counsel and knowledge,

source: Thudihho chu thutahbeh mong ahi nangma kahetchetsah nadingle nahenga hungkisol ho henga thutah hochu nadonbut theina dinga keiman nahenga kahinsut hitalou ham?
target: teaching you to be honest and to speak the truth, so that you bring back truthful reports to those you serve?

source: Mivaichaho chu chomhih-un, ajehchu ama mivaicha ahi; kotpi phunga jong gentheiho chu bolgim hih-in.
target: Do not exploit the poor because they are poor and do not crush the needy in court,

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin amahothu chu aseitohpeh-a, chule vaichaho chomho hinna chu aman achom ding ahi.
target: for the Lord will take up their case and will exact life for life.

source: Milung hang jingtoh kigolcha hih-in; chule milungkhoh toh nangma chekhom hih in.
target: Do not make friends with a hot-tempered person, do not associate with one easily angered,

source: Achuti loule nangman ama lampiho hekhan natin, chule nahinkho-a din thang hikhante.
target: or you may learn their ways and get yourself ensnared.

source: Kitepna chunga khut lhaho lah-a nangma khat nin jong pang hih-in, ahiloule sum kibat jeh-a midinpeh ho lah-a jong pang hih-in.
target: Do not be one who shakes hands in pledge or puts up security for debts;

source: Nangman pehding imacha naneilou ahitahle ipi dinga aman nalupna jalkhun chu alahmang dingham?
target: if you lack the means to pay, your very bed will be snatched from under you.

source: Gollui laija napu napateu vin anatun dohsao, gamgi chu chon mang hih-un.
target: Do not move an ancient boundary stone set up by your ancestors.

source: Atohna lama gunchu mi namu em? amachu lengho anga dingtei ding, mi maimai anga dinglou helding ahi.
target: Do you see someone skilled in their work? They will serve before kings; they will not serve before officials of low rank.

source: Nangma thunei vaihomho khat toh an nedinga natoutengle, na anga ipi ummam ti phatechan gellin.
target: When you sit to dine with a ruler, note well what is before you,

source: Chule an dutah mi nahile nalol la chemcha kidojingin.
target: and put a knife to your throat if you are given to gluttony.

source: A-anneh tuitahho chu ducha hih-in, ajehchu hicheho chu kilheplhahna an ahibouve.
target: Do not crave his delicacies, for that food is deceptive.

source: Haoding tupnan kisulung gimval hih-in, nangma chang kichihsah hih-in.
target: Do not wear yourself out to get rich; do not trust your own cleverness.

source: Nangman aumlou thil chu namit teni-a navet dingham? Ajehchu thonlouvin haona hohin lhaving akisemun, van lama muvanlai bangin alengmangji taove.
target: Cast but a glance at riches, and they are gone, for they will surely sprout wings and fly off to the sky like an eagle.

source: Michip pa changlhah chu nangman nehih beh-in; ama antuiho jong ducha hih-in.
target: Do not eat the food of a begrudging host, do not crave his delicacies;

source: Ajehchu amachu alunga agel bangbang hija ahin; nenlang donin tin nahenga aseijin, ahinla alungthim chu nangma toh aumkhom pon ahi.
target: for he is the kind of person who is always thinking about the cost. “Eat and drink,” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.

source: Nangman nanehsa anchu nalohdoh ding; chule thu ngeitah naseiho jong pannabei hiding ahi.
target: You will vomit up the little you have eaten and will have wasted your compliments.

source: Mingol nakhanga imacha seihih beh-in, ajehchu chihna thu naseiho jong i-sah louva akoiding ahi.
target: Do not speak to fools, for they will scorn your prudent words.

source: Gollui laija gamgi lui melchihna ho chu ladoh hih-in, chule pabei ho gamsunga jong lutdan.
target: Do not move an ancient boundary stone or encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

source: Ajehchu amaho lhatdohpa chu thaneitah ahin, aman athuchu nahenga aseitoh ding ahi.
target: for their Defender is strong; he will take up their case against you.

source: Hilchahna lama nalungsung mangchan lang; chule nanakhang teni chu hetna thu lama mangchan.
target: Apply your heart to instruction and your ears to words of knowledge.

source: Chapang kisuhdih nahi tuhtang hih-in, ajehchu nangman ama molin jep jongle chun thiponte.
target: Do not withhold discipline from a child; if you punish them with the rod, they will not die.

source: Nangman ama mola najepding, chutile ama lhagao thikhol khul'a kona nahuhdoh johding ahi.
target: Punish them with the rod and save them from death.

source: Kachapa nalung achih-a ahile, kalung kipahlheh ding ahi.
target: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad indeed;

source: Henge, nangman nakama thil dihho naseidoh tengle, kalung gilla kakipa ding ahi.
target: my inmost being will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.

source: Nalungin michonseho thangse hih-in, ahinla nangman nilhumkeijin Pakai chu gingin.
target: Do not let your heart envy sinners, but always be zealous for the fear of the Lord .

source: Ajehchu tahbeh a akichaina khat uma ahin, chule nakinepna chu kisei tanlou ding ahi.
target: There is surely a future hope for you, and your hope will not be cut off.

source: Kachapa nangman ngaijin lang chihnan neijin, chule hiche lampia chun nalung puihoijin.
target: Listen, my son, and be wise, and set your heart on the right path:

source: Judon hole saneh hat ho lah-a nangma lhahih in.
target: Do not join those who drink too much wine or gorge themselves on meat,

source: Ajehchu jukhamho leh milopho chu vaicha teiding; chule imutsona chun mipa chu ponse avonpeh ding ahije.
target: for drunkards and gluttons become poor, and drowsiness clothes them in rags.

source: Nahinga napa thu kingai jinlang, nanu ateh phatteng jongle nahsahmon bolhih-in.
target: Listen to your father, who gave you life, and do not despise your mother when she is old.

source: Thutah chu kichoh-in, chule chihna, hilchahna hetkhen themtheina, jong kichoh inlang johdoh tahih-in.
target: Buy the truth and do not sell it— wisdom, instruction and insight as well.

source: Michonpha chu apa hapah-in kipah intin; chule chapang ching hingpa chun amajalla kipana aneiding ahi.
target: The father of a righteous child has great joy; a man who fathers a wise son rejoices in him.

source: Nanu leh napa kipah inte, chule nahinga nanu chu kipah thanom ding ahi.
target: May your father and mother rejoice; may she who gave you birth be joyful!

source: Kachapa nalungthim neipen, chule namitnin kalampiho vetupmin.
target: My son, give me your heart and let your eyes delight in my ways,

source: Ajehchu notinu chu kokhuh thuhtah tobang ahin; chule hetlou numeinu chu kokhuhjim ahi.
target: for an adulterous woman is a deep pit, and a wayward wife is a narrow well.

source: Amanun jong gucha michom bangin mi achanglhin; chule mihem ho lah-a chun suhkhel neiho apunsah-in ahi.
target: Like a bandit she lies in wait and multiplies the unfaithful among men.

source: Koiham dana nei? Koiham gimna nei? Koiham kinahna nei? Koiham kiphina-a nei? Koiham ajehbeija tina maha pu-a? Koiham mit san dehduh neija?
target: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

source: Amaho chu juphola khongaisotna ju kihalna hola vahle ho chu ahiuve.
target: Those who linger over wine, who go to sample bowls of mixed wine.

source: Ju chu asanphat laitah vetdan, khonjong asansah-a achama naljella alonlhah jongle nangman vehih-in.
target: Do not gaze at wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly!

source: Akhonnale hichun gul bangle gulsum gu hattah bangin achujin ahi.
target: In the end it bites like a snake and poisons like a viper.

source: Namit tenin hetkhahlou numei ho avetna, chule nalunggilla jong thildihlou jeng nagelding ahi.
target: Your eyes will see strange sights, and your mind will imagine confusing things.

source: Nangma twipi lailunga lumpa nabahding, ahiloule kongsunga kitungdoh khom sangtah leh-a lumpa nabah ding ahi.
target: You will be like one sleeping on the high seas, lying on top of the rigging.

source: Amahon eivouvin ahinla keima kanapoi; amahon eidengun ahinla kahephapoi; itihle kei kakhangdoh tadem? Kaholbekit nahlaiding ahi, tia naseiding ahi.
target: “They hit me,” you will say, “but I’m not hurt! They beat me, but I don’t feel it! When will I wake up so I can find another drink?”

source: Migilouho chu thangset hih-in, amahotoh umkhom ding jong ngaicha hihbeh-in.
target: Do not envy the wicked, do not desire their company;

source: Ajehchu amaho lungsungin manthah na lamjeng agelin; chule akam sungun aphalou aseijuve.
target: for their hearts plot violence, and their lips talk about making trouble.

source: Chihna vangin in akisahdoh-in, chule hetkhenthem theina jal-in akiphutdetne.
target: By wisdom a house is built, and through understanding it is established;

source: Chule hetna jala indanho chu manlutah thil le lo, chule lungdei umtah neile gou dimsetna ahi.
target: through knowledge its rooms are filled with rare and beautiful treasures.

source: Miching chu atha ahatnin; henge, hetna neipa thahatna chu khangtou ding ahi.
target: The wise prevail through great power, and those who have knowledge muster their strength.

source: Ajehchu chihna puma thumopthemna vanga nangman gal nasatding ahin, thumopthem ho tamna lah-a hoidohna aume.
target: Surely you need guidance to wage war, and victory is won through many advisers.

source: Mingol dingin chih gilnahi asang behsetnin, aman kotpi phunga akam akehpoi.
target: Wisdom is too high for fools; in the assembly at the gate they must not open their mouths.

source: Thilse bolding gongdohpa chu, miphaloupa kitiding ahi.
target: Whoever plots evil will be known as a schemer.

source: Lunga ngolhoi thu geljing hi chonset ahin, chule mitaitompa chu miho dingin thet umtah ahi.
target: The schemes of folly are sin, and people detest a mocker.

source: Kidouna nikho-a nalung alhah-a ahile, natha chu lhoma ahi.
target: If you falter in a time of trouble, how small is your strength!

source: Nangman thina lam jonna kijot hole, akithat dinga gotsa umteho huhdohna dinga pohnatna nanei louva;
target: Rescue those being led away to death; hold back those staggering toward slaughter.

source: Nangman, keihon kanahepha pouve nati vangle, ven, ama milungsung vetuppa chun hichu agelkhoh louding ham? chule nahinkho hoituppa chun ahetlou dingham? chule aman mijouse chu anatoh dungjuija lethuhna apehlou ding ham?
target: If you say, “But we knew nothing about this,” does not he who weighs the heart perceive it? Does not he who guards your life know it? Will he not repay everyone according to what they have done?

source: Kachapa khoiju chu ne-in, ajeh chu tuitah ahi, chule khoiju phang jongchu ne-in, nakam sung dinga lhumtah ahi.
target: Eat honey, my son, for it is good; honey from the comb is sweet to your taste.

source: Chihna le hetna jong chu nalhagao dinga khoiju tuitah tobang ahin, nangman hichu nakimudoh teng kipaman nasanding, chule nakinepna jong thon louding ahi.
target: Know also that wisdom is like honey for you: If you find it, there is a future hope for you, and your hope will not be cut off.

source: Vo migiloupa, michonpha chenna mun dounan changlhi hih-in, akicholngahna munchu suse hih in.
target: Do not lurk like a thief near the house of the righteous, do not plunder their dwelling place;

source: Midihtah pa chu sagivei lhu jongle athoudohkit jin, ahinla migilou vangchu setna-a lhalut teiding ahi.
target: for though the righteous fall seven times, they rise again, but the wicked stumble when calamity strikes.

source: Namelmapa alhuhteng nangma kipah hih-in, chule ama akipal lhuh tahjongle nalung kipasah hih-in.
target: Do not gloat when your enemy falls; when they stumble, do not let your heart rejoice,

source: Achuti loule Pakaiyin hichu muntin, hichun ama alung hansah-a, chule ama-a kona alunghana aheimang louding ahi.
target: or the Lord will see and disapprove and turn his wrath away from them.

source: Thil gilou bolte jeh-in nangma lungkham hih-in, migiloute umchan jong thangse hih-in.
target: Do not fret because of evildoers or be envious of the wicked,

source: Ajehchu thil gilou bolpa dinga kipaman umlou helding, chule migiloupa meivah chu kisumit ding ahi.
target: for the evildoer has no future hope, and the lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.

source: Kachapa Pakai le lengpa chu gingin, chule vaihom gilouho lah-a jong kikumlut hih-in.
target: Fear the Lord and the king, my son, and do not join with rebellious officials,

source: Ajehchu amaho chunga hamsetna photlot louva hungsoh ding ahin, amani manthah na hinlhut ding chu kon ija ahet em?
target: for those two will send sudden destruction on them, and who knows what calamities they can bring?

source: Hiche thilho jonghi miching ho-a ahi. Thutan na-a sihnei langnei bolding apha poi.
target: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judging is not good:

source: Migiloupa jah-a, nangma michonpha nahi tia seipa chu, amachu mipin asapset ding, namtinin ahotbol dingu ahi.
target: Whoever says to the guilty, “You are innocent,” will be cursed by peoples and denounced by nations.

source: Ahinla migilou phohsalho chunga chu kipana umtei ding, chule phattheina chu achunguva chuding ahi.
target: But it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and rich blessing will come on them.

source: Dihtah-a donbutna pepa chu mijousen abengchop ding ahi.
target: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.

source: Polama nanatoh ding gotsan koijin, chule naloulaija nanatohna ding jong kigottup masatnin, chujou tengle na in kisah-in.
target: Put your outdoor work in order and get your fields ready; after that, build your house.

source: Ajeh beijin naheng nakom dounan hettoh sah-in panghih-in, chule nakamin koima lhemlha hih-in.
target: Do not testify against your neighbor without cause— would you use your lips to mislead?

source: Aman eibolna bangin keiman ama bolinge tin seihih-in, anatoh dungjuijin keiman lethuh inge tin seihih-in.
target: Do not say, “I’ll do to them as they have done to me; I’ll pay them back for what they did.”

source: Keiman mithasepa loumun leh, hetthem theina neiloupa lengpilei chu kagah jotpan:
target: I went past the field of a sluggard, past the vineyard of someone who has no sense;

source: Chule ven, apumpin lingle khaovin adipsohtai, chule sachih-in apheng alhangin akhujeng tan, chule songtho kisejong achimlha joutai.
target: thorns had come up everywhere, the ground was covered with weeds, and the stone wall was in ruins.

source: Chuin keiman hichu kamu phatnin, phatechan kagelin, hiche kavetna-a konchun hilchahna kachangin ahi.
target: I applied my heart to what I observed and learned a lesson from what I saw:

source: Chom chakhat imutna, chom chakhat lulhuh-a, chom chakhat khut gahlhepto-a imut;
target: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest—

source: Hitobanga chu kholjinpa banga vaichat nan nangma nahin lhunkhum ding, galmanchah choipa banga gentheinan nahin phah ding ahi.
target: and poverty will come on you like a thief and scarcity like an armed man.

source: Hicheho jonghi Solomon thuchihho; Judah lengpa Hezekiah mitehon anasutdoh-u chu ahi.
target: These are more proverbs of Solomon, compiled by the men of Hezekiah king of Judah:

source: Pathen'in thilkhat aselguh hi ama loupina ahin; ahinla thilkhat holdohhi lengho ja achan nao ahije.
target: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.

source: Van asan bangle leiset athuh banga hi, lengho lungsung jong holdoh hoi ahipoi.
target: As the heavens are high and the earth is deep, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.

source: Dangka-a konin a-eh ladohle chun, thih khengpa dinga bel hung sohdoh ding ahi.
target: Remove the dross from the silver, and a silversmith can produce a vessel;

source: Lengpa angsunga konin mikhang gilou chu puidoh lechun, alaltouna chu chonphatna-a kiphutdet ding ahi.
target: remove wicked officials from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established through righteousness.

source: Lengpa angsunga nang le nang gavahlut hih-in, chule milen milal ho umna mun'a gading hihbeh-in.
target: Do not exalt yourself in the king’s presence, and do not claim a place among his great men;

source: Ajehchu namitna namu lengchate masanga suhnema naum sanga, hilama hungtouvin tia nahin kou diuchu nang dinga phajo ahi.
target: it is better for him to say to you, “Come up here,” than for him to humiliate you before his nobles. What you have seen with your eyes

source: Kinah nadinga kino tah-in che hih-in, ijemtin naheng nakomin najumso khale, achainale nangma jong bolding helouvin umkhaget in nate.
target: do not bring hastily to court, for what will you do in the end if your neighbor puts you to shame?

source: Nachung chang thuchu na inhengpa toh seikhom lhonin, chule midang henga thuguh himhim seidoh hih-in.
target: If you take your neighbor to court, do not betray another’s confidence,
