source: Achutiloule hiche thuguh hedoh chanchun nahin jumson tin, chule naminsetna chu mang talouhel ding ahi.
target: or the one who hears it may shame you and the charge against you will stand.

source: Thu dihtah-a kisei hi dangka kigol lah-a sanatum tobang ahi.
target: Like apples of gold in settings of silver is a ruling rightly given.

source: Thu kisei ngaipa dinga kiphona dihtah hi, sana bilba le sanathenga kisem kijepna tobang ahi.
target: Like an earring of gold or an ornament of fine gold is the rebuke of a wise judge to a listening ear.

source: Tahsan umtah thupole-a mihem chu, asolpa dinga chang at laija buhbang dapjen tobang ahi; ajehchu aman alamkaite hinna asunou vin ahi.
target: Like a snow-cooled drink at harvest time is a trustworthy messenger to the one who sends him; he refreshes the spirit of his master.

source: Koi hile thilpeh dihlou kithang atpi-a michu, meibol jingleiloi le hui nunga go julou tobang ahi.
target: Like clouds and wind without rain is one who boasts of gifts never given.

source: Thohhat na-in vaihom khat ajol lhajouvin, chule awnema thu kiseihin gule chang jong asubong theijin ahi.
target: Through patience a ruler can be persuaded, and a gentle tongue can break a bone.

source: Nangman khoiju namu em? naneh jou khambep ne-in; achutiloule vavalin natin lodoh khagetnin nate.
target: If you find honey, eat just enough— too much of it, and you will vomit.

source: Naheng nakom insung hachot lut behseh hih-in, injole natheichim valintin, nahotlo khante.
target: Seldom set foot in your neighbor’s house— too much of you, and they will hate you.

source: Aheng akom douna-a hettohsah lhem-a pangpa chu, moltum lentan, chemjam chule thalchang hemtah tobang ahi.
target: Like a club or a sword or a sharp arrow is one who gives false testimony against a neighbor.

source: Lungjinpetna kitahna neilou mikhat chunga kinep hi, habongle kenggu kipel tobang ahi.
target: Like a broken tooth or a lame foot is reliance on the unfaithful in a time of trouble.

source: Lunggim gentheija umkhat henga la sapa chu; daplaitah-a mi ponsil lahmang pehpa tobangle, lengpitwi thuhtah kisuhkhahna maha chunga kisunglha tobang ahi.
target: Like one who takes away a garment on a cold day, or like vinegar poured on a wound, is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.

source: Namelma chu agil akela ahile nehding penlang, adang achahle donding twi pe-in;
target: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat; if he is thirsty, give him water to drink.

source: Chutia chu nabola ahile nangman ama lujanga mei-am nasunlhah peh hiding ahin, Pakaiyin nangma tohphat man napeh teiding ahi.
target: In doing this, you will heap burning coals on his head, and the Lord will reward you.

source: Sahlam huijin go asem mangin, hitobang chun kiseisetna hin lunghanna maiso asodohsah-e.
target: Like a north wind that brings unexpected rain is a sly tongue—which provokes a horrified look.

source: Numei hansetah toh inlen khatna chenkhom sangin, in chung ningkoija chending aphajoi.
target: Better to live on a corner of the roof than share a house with a quarrelsome wife.

source: Gamlatah-a kona thupha hunglhung hi, adangchahpa dinga donding twidap tobang ahi.
target: Like cold water to a weary soul is good news from a distant land.

source: Migilou angsunga michonpha abohkhup dinghi, twinah phalou le twinen putna twisam tobang ahi.
target: Like a muddied spring or a polluted well are the righteous who give way to the wicked.

source: Khoiju tampi neh aphatlou bangin, mihem hon amachang loupina akiholu jonghi aphapon ahi.
target: It is not good to eat too much honey, nor is it honorable to search out matters that are too deep.

source: Amatah lhagao thunun jouloupa chu, khopi chimlhasa le kulpi umlou tobang ahibouve.
target: Like a city whose walls are broken through is a person who lacks self-control.

source: Nipilaija buhbang alhah bangle, chang-at laitah-a go ajuh bangin, jana hi mingol dingin akilompoi.
target: Like snow in summer or rain in harvest, honor is not fitting for a fool.

source: Vacha lengle le pelpa lengle bangin, ajehbeija kisapsetna jong atang deh poi.
target: Like a fluttering sparrow or a darting swallow, an undeserved curse does not come to rest.

source: Sakol dinga jepna, sangan dinga kamdal, chule mingol tungtun dinga mol uma ahi.
target: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the backs of fools!

source: Mingolpa chu angol dungjuijin donbut hih-in, amatoh bang khagetnin nate.
target: Do not answer a fool according to his folly, or you yourself will be just like him.

source: Mingol chu ama mitmu-a akichihsah louna dingin, angol dungjuijin donbutnin.
target: Answer a fool according to his folly, or he will be wise in his own eyes.

source: Mingol khat khutna thuthotpa chun, amatah keng akitanboh-a chule setna twi adon tobang ahi.
target: Sending a message by the hands of a fool is like cutting off one’s feet or drinking poison.

source: Kengbaipa keng tenichu akibang ngaipon, mingol ho kamsunga kon kisei thulem jong chutobang chu ahi.
target: Like the useless legs of one who is lame is a proverb in the mouth of a fool.

source: Mingol jana pepa chu, ahsongse-a songchang khitpa tobang ahi.
target: Like tying a stone in a sling is the giving of honor to a fool.

source: Mingol ho kamsunga kon hungpot thulem chu, ling hemjet khatnin jukham khat akhut adotlut tobang ahibouve.
target: Like a thornbush in a drunkard’s hand is a proverb in the mouth of a fool.

source: Thiljouse sema Pathen loupitah chun, mingol hole chonkhelte tohman apecheh-e.
target: Like an archer who wounds at random is one who hires a fool or any passer-by.

source: Uichan aloh lhahsa anehkit ji bangin, mingol jong angolna-a akile kitjin ahi.
target: As a dog returns to its vomit, so fools repeat their folly.

source: Mihem ama mitmu-a kichang chihsah namu khah em? hichepa sangchun mingolpa din kinepna aumjoi.
target: Do you see a person wise in their own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for them.

source: Mithasepan, lampia keipi bahkai aumin, khopi lamlen ho-a keipi bahkai aume, ati.
target: A sluggard says, “There’s a lion in the road, a fierce lion roaming the streets!”

source: Kotkhah chu akikam na-a akiheilele bangin, mithase chu ajalkhuna akiheilelejin ahi.
target: As a door turns on its hinges, so a sluggard turns on his bed.

source: Mithasen akhutnin abukong asohlut jin, akam sung geija hin dop ding jong angapcha poi.
target: A sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.

source: Thil hethem le lunggel them mi sagi sanga, mithase chu ama mitmu-a chingjo-a kigel ahi.
target: A sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven people who answer discreetly.

source: Akikumna ding jong hilouva kikumma kinahna-a jaopa chu; uicha abila manpa tobang bep ahi.
target: Like one who grabs a stray dog by the ears is someone who rushes into a quarrel not their own.

source: Milung chavai thingkho-am, thalchang, chule thina, seplele pa chu,
target: Like a maniac shooting flaming arrows of death

source: aheng akom lhemlha-a, chule katot ahibouve, tia mitobang ahi.
target: is one who deceives their neighbor and says, “I was only joking!”

source: Thing umlouna-a mei amitji bangin, misuto umlouna-a kidouna atangji tai.
target: Without wood a fire goes out; without a gossip a quarrel dies down.

source: Songmeihol-am min songmeihol akahvam bangle, meijin thing akahvan ji banga; minelkal hatpa chu kinahna sosah-a pang ahi.
target: As charcoal to embers and as wood to fire, so is a quarrelsome person for kindling strife.

source: Misuto hat thusei ho chu tina maha tobang ahin; oisunggil lampeh-a jong hiche hochu alutjin ahi.
target: The words of a gossip are like choice morsels; they go down to the inmost parts.

source: Muhnaljetle lungsung gilouchu, leibel dangka-a kitomjol tobang ahi.
target: Like a coating of silver dross on earthenware are fervent lips with an evil heart.

source: Koi hile mihotbola chun akamin aseithem jin, hinlah alungsunga lheplhahna ngen akikhol khom ahin;
target: Enemies disguise themselves with their lips, but in their hearts they harbor deceit.

source: Aman damheocha thu aseidohteng, tahsan hih-in, ajehchu alungsunga thet umtah thil sagi aumin ahi.
target: Though their speech is charming, do not believe them, for seven abominations fill their hearts.

source: Mi ahotbolna chu joulhepna-a atomkhum hijongle, mipi kikhom khom masanga kitahlang ding ahi.
target: Their malice may be concealed by deception, but their wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.

source: Koi hile kokhuh laija chu, chua chu ama lhalut teiding; chule song tangpa chunga chu, asong tah chu hungkilekit ding ahi.
target: Whoever digs a pit will fall into it; if someone rolls a stone, it will roll back on them.

source: Jousei leiguijin asuhgim ho chu ahokit jin, chule pachat lhem seidoh kamsung hin manthah na atongdoh-e.
target: A lying tongue hates those it hurts, and a flattering mouth works ruin.

source: Jing nikho-a din kithang at hih-in, ajehchu hiche nikho chun ipi ahinlhun sah ding nangman nahepoi.
target: Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring.

source: Nang le nang nakamsunga nakivahchoi sangin, gamdang mikhatnin nangma navahchoi johen.
target: Let someone else praise you, and not your own mouth; an outsider, and not your own lips.

source: Song agih in chule neldi agihcheh-e, ahinla mingol lungsatna chu hicheteni sanga chu gihjonalai ahi.
target: Stone is heavy and sand a burden, but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.

source: Lungsatna hi thil phaloutah ahin, chule lunghana hi thil nasatah ahi; ahinla thangthipna masanga dingjou ding koiham?
target: Anger is cruel and fury overwhelming, but who can stand before jealousy?

source: Guhthima kingailut sangin phongtah-a kiphosal aphajoi.
target: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.

source: Gol le paijin amavona chu tahsan umtah ahi, amavang melman eichop chu lheplhahna ahibouve.
target: Wounds from a friend can be trusted, but an enemy multiplies kisses.

source: An vasa hodin khoiju jengjong kidah aumin, ahinla agilkel dingin vang thilkha jouse jong alhumjie.
target: One who is full loathes honey from the comb, but to the hungry even what is bitter tastes sweet.

source: A-in'a kon vahmangpa chu, vacha abuh-a kon lengmang tobang ahi.
target: Like a bird that flees its nest is anyone who flees from home.

source: Thaole gimnamtuijin lungsung akipasah-in, chutobang chun lungsunga kona kihilna phatah chun loile gol akipasah theije.
target: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart, and the pleasantness of a friend springs from their heartfelt advice.

source: Nangma loile gol ahin, napa loile gol ahin jong dalha hih-in; hamset nikhoteng jongle nasopipa in'a chelut hih-in; ajehchu gamlatah a um napenpipa sangin na-in hengpa aphachomjoi.
target: Do not forsake your friend or a friend of your family, and do not go to your relative’s house when disaster strikes you— better a neighbor nearby than a relative far away.

source: Kachapa limgeh inlang, eitamsepa kadonbut theinadin kalung kipasah-in.
target: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart; then I can answer anyone who treats me with contempt.

source: Milung chingin thilse hunglhung ding amumasan, hijeh chun akiselin, ahinla mimolhochu achepaijun, talen amanjitaove.
target: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.

source: Gamdang mikhat dinga kitepna thilla kitungpa ponsil chu lahpeh-un; chule gamdang numeinu khat dingin kitepna thilin mangun.
target: Take the garment of one who puts up security for a stranger; hold it in pledge if it is done for an outsider.

source: Jingkah matah-a thouva awsangtah-a agolpa phatthei bohpa chu, amadinga gaosapna-a kilading ahi.
target: If anyone loudly blesses their neighbor early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse.

source: Gohajuh nikho-a gomal lha jengjung toh, numei nelhat tahchu kibang bep ahi.
target: A quarrelsome wife is like the dripping of a leaky roof in a rainstorm;

source: Koihile amanu tuhtang jouva chun huipi jong atuhtang jou ahin, chule akhut jetlama thao jong asip thei ahi.
target: restraining her is like restraining the wind or grasping oil with the hand.

source: Thih in thih mama anol hemthei bangchun, mihem khatnin agolpa maiso chu avahsah theijin ahi.
target: As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another.

source: Koihile theichang phung kivettupma chun theichang ga chu aneh teiding ahin; chutobangma chun a-pakaipa ngahjingpa chu jana changtei ding ahi.
target: The one who guards a fig tree will eat its fruit, and whoever protects their master will be honored.

source: Twilah ivet le ilim akimudoh ji bangin, mihem lungthimin jong mihem hina aphongdoh jin ahi.
target: As water reflects the face, so one’s life reflects the heart.

source: Thikholmun le manthah na chu imatih-in adim ngaipon, chutobang chun mihem mitnin jong chimtih anei ngaipoi.
target: Death and Destruction are never satisfied, and neither are human eyes.

source: Dangka dinga sontwina bel, chule sana dinga lhummei ahin; hinlah mihem chu mi apachat nadung juija kipatep ji ahi.
target: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.

source: Mingol khatchu nangman sum sunga changbong toh suhtha jongle chun, angolna chu ama-a konin beichomdeh ponte.
target: Though you grind a fool in a mortar, grinding them like grain with a pestle, you will not remove their folly from them.

source: Nakelngoi hon umdan nahet nadingle, nagancha hon phatecha navettup nadingin pontho tah-in pangin.
target: Be sure you know the condition of your flocks, give careful attention to your herds;

source: Ajehchu haonahohi tonsotna ding ahipon, lallukhuh jeng jonghi akhang akhanga umding ahipoi.
target: for riches do not endure forever, and a crown is not secure for all generations.

source: Changpol akilahdoh teng hamjing ahung nouthah-in, chule molsang ho-a hamhingho akichomkhom jin ahi.
target: When the hay is removed and new growth appears and the grass from the hills is gathered in,

source: Kelngoiho chu navonding ahiuvin, chule kelchaho chu louman ding ahiuve.
target: the lambs will provide you with clothing, and the goats with the price of a field.

source: Chule nangman nadon khopset le na-insungmi nehkhop set, chule nanungah umpi chengse khoukhah nadinga lhingset kelcha noi nanei ding ahi.
target: You will have plenty of goats’ milk to feed your family and to nourish your female servants.

source: Migilou chu koimacha dellouvin ajamin, midihtah pa vangchu keipibahkai bangin ahang san-e.
target: The wicked flee though no one pursues, but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

source: Gamkhat suhkhel jeh-in pipui tamtah ahung umji, ahinla hetkhen themtheina le hetna nei mikhat jala gamsung chu chesotding ahi.
target: When a country is rebellious, it has many rulers, but a ruler with discernment and knowledge maintains order.

source: Mivaicha khatnin mivaicha khatma asuhgenthei chu, nehding khenlou hela lhohmang jeng goju tobang ahi.
target: A ruler who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain that leaves no crops.

source: Dan pailhaho chun migilouho chu apahchaovin, ahin dan juiho chun amahochu akinelpi jiuvin ahi.
target: Those who forsake instruction praise the wicked, but those who heed it resist them.

source: Miphalou hon thutanlhah nahi ahekhen themthei jipouvin, Pakai holte vang chun thiljouse ahekhen them jiuve.
target: Evildoers do not understand what is right, but those who seek the Lord understand it fully.

source: Mivaicha chondih na-a lamjotpa chu, alampi ho-a vahkoi le mihaopa sangin aphajoi.
target: Better the poor whose walk is blameless than the rich whose ways are perverse.

source: Koihile dan tuhdetna chu chapa ching ahin; ahinla boina semho toh kivoppa vang chun apa ajumsahjin ahi.
target: A discerning son heeds instruction, but a companion of gluttons disgraces his father.

source: Lamdih louva sumpung lajia chule adihlouva nejipa chun anei apunsahbejin; hinla amapa chun vaichate khotothempa ding-a akhol khompeh ahibouve.
target: Whoever increases wealth by taking interest or profit from the poor amasses it for another, who will be kind to the poor.

source: Dan thupeh ho-a kon anakhang heimangpa taona jengjong chu thet umtah ahibouve.
target: If anyone turns a deaf ear to my instruction, even their prayers are detestable.

source: Koihile midih aselama kiheimangsahpa chu, amatah-in asem kokhuh sunga chu lhalutteiding; ahinla midihpa vang chun thilphaho aneiding ahi.
target: Whoever leads the upright along an evil path will fall into their own trap, but the blameless will receive a good inheritance.

source: Mihao chu amachang mitmun akichih sah-in, ahinla hetkhenthem theina nei vaichapan ama akholdoh sohjin ahi.
target: The rich are wise in their own eyes; one who is poor and discerning sees how deluded they are.

source: Michonpha te akipa tengule loupina nasatah aumjin; ahin migiloute ahung letdoh tengle mi akisel gamjitai.
target: When the righteous triumph, there is great elation; but when the wicked rise to power, people go into hiding.

source: Koi hile achonsetna selguh-a chu lolhing louding; amavang koihile hicheho phongdoh jenga chule dalha jenga chun hepina akimuding ahi.
target: Whoever conceals their sins does not prosper, but the one who confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

source: Pathen ging jinga umpa chu anunnom ahin; ahinla alung tahsahpa vangchu vangsetna-a chuding ahi.
target: Blessed is the one who always trembles before God, but whoever hardens their heart falls into trouble.

source: Mivaichate chunga vaihom gilou chu, keipi bahkai kitumle vompi midel hat tobang ahi.
target: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.

source: Hetkhen themtheina neilou pipuichu misugenthei tah jong ahin, hinla papsetna hotbolpa chun ahinkho akisuhsao ding ahi.
target: A tyrannical ruler practices extortion, but one who hates ill-gotten gain will enjoy a long reign.

source: Pumhatna thisan so-a chu kokhuh-a jamlut ding; chule koiman apanpi louhel ding ahi.
target: Anyone tormented by the guilt of murder will seek refuge in the grave; let no one hold them back.

source: Koihile nolna beija chonlea chu huhhing-a umding ahin; alampiho-a vahkoilepa vangchu lhupai ding ahi.
target: The one whose walk is blameless is kept safe, but the one whose ways are perverse will fall into the pit.

source: Alou kilhopa chun nehle chah ninglhingsetna aneiding ahin, ahinla pannabei miho nungjuipa vang chun vaichatna akimutei ding ahi.
target: Those who work their land will have abundant food, but those who chase fantasies will have their fill of poverty.

source: Mikitah chu phattheiboh changintin, ahinla hetman louva haoding gopa chu themmo changtei ding ahi.
target: A faithful person will be richly blessed, but one eager to get rich will not go unpunished.

source: Sihnei langnei bolhi aphapoi, ajehchu changlhah halkhat jeh-a jong mi chonkhelji-a ahi.
target: To show partiality is not good— yet a person will do wrong for a piece of bread.

source: Mikilosen hetman louva haoding jeng agelin; achunga vaichatna ahunglhun ding agelpha jipon ahi.
target: The stingy are eager to get rich and are unaware that poverty awaits them.

source: Akama pachatna lhem seipa sanga, miphohsal pa chun nungtengle khohsahna akimutam johding ahi.
target: Whoever rebukes a person will in the end gain favor rather than one who has a flattering tongue.

source: Koihile anule apa choma hichehi chonset ahipoi tipa chu, misugampa toh golcha ahi.
target: Whoever robs their father or mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is partner to one who destroys.

source: Kiletsahna lungthim neipan kidouna achoh thouvin, Pakaiya atahsanna koipa vangchu phatthei changding ahi.
target: The greedy stir up conflict, but those who trust in the Lord will prosper.

source: Ama chang lunggela kisongpa chu mingol ahin; ahinla chingtah-a kalsongpa chu huhdoh-a umding ahi.
target: Those who trust in themselves are fools, but those who walk in wisdom are kept safe.

source: Koihile mivaicha kithopi-a chu lhasam louding; mivaicha kimumosah vang chun sapsetna tampi akimuding ahije.
target: Those who give to the poor will lack nothing, but those who close their eyes to them receive many curses.

source: Migilou adindoh teng miho akiseljin, amaho amanthah tengule vang midih apungjin ahi.
target: When the wicked rise to power, people go into hiding; but when the wicked perish, the righteous thrive.

source: Tamtahvei akihilchah nunga jong louchal nalaipa chu, hetmanlouva manthah na-a chuding, chule boldamo hella umding ahi.
target: Whoever remains stiff-necked after many rebukes will suddenly be destroyed—without remedy.

source: Michonpha te vaihoma apanteng mipi akipah-in; ahinla khang gilouten vai ahomteng mipi alunghem jiuve.
target: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.

source: Koihile chihna ngailu-a chun apa akipasah-in, notiho toh kivopma vang chun anei agou jouse asuhmang ahi.
target: A man who loves wisdom brings joy to his father, but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.

source: Lengpan thutandih na-in agam aphutdetnin, ahin nehguh kilahpan vang agamchu alehkhup jin ahi.
target: By justice a king gives a country stability, but those who are greedy for bribes tear it down.

source: A-inheng pahcha lhempa chun akeng dinga thang akampeh ahi.
target: Those who flatter their neighbors are spreading nets for their feet.

source: Migilou chu asuhkhelna-a a-oh jin, ahinla michonpha hon la asaovin akipah uve.
target: Evildoers are snared by their own sin, but the righteous shout for joy and are glad.

source: Michonphan mivaicha khankho ding angaitopeh-in, ahinla migilouvin hetpeh dingjong agopoi.
target: The righteous care about justice for the poor, but the wicked have no such concern.

source: Midaichavai hon khopi chu meijin ahal vamun, ahinla miching hon lungsatna aheidoh-un ahi.
target: Mockers stir up a city, but the wise turn away anger.

source: Miching khatnin mingol khat chu kinahpi henglang, mingolpa chu kitomhen lang nuijongle chamna umdeh louding ahi.
target: If a wise person goes to court with a fool, the fool rages and scoffs, and there is no peace.

source: Thisan sohatpan milungdihpa ahotbolin, ahinla midihtah pan vang alhagao huhdoh ding agon ahi.
target: The bloodthirsty hate a person of integrity and seek to kill the upright.

source: Mingolin alungthima agel jouse aseidoh sohkeijin, miching pan vang akichintup-in ahi.
target: Fools give full vent to their rage, but the wise bring calm in the end.

source: Vaihom khatnin jouthu jeng akhohsah-a ahileh, asohho jouse jong migilou asohji taove.
target: If a ruler listens to lies, all his officials become wicked.

source: Mivaichale milhem hatpa akimuto lhonnin, amitlhon jong Pakai hasah ahicheh-e.
target: The poor and the oppressor have this in common: The Lord gives sight to the eyes of both.

source: Dihtah-a mivaichate thu tanpeh lengpa laltouna chu, atonsot geija kiphudet ding ahi.
target: If a king judges the poor with fairness, his throne will be established forever.

source: Mol le phosal na-in chihna ape-in, ahinla achama kilha chapang chun anu ajumson ahi.
target: A rod and a reprimand impart wisdom, but a child left undisciplined disgraces its mother.

source: Migilou apunteng dan suhkhelna apungjin, ahinla michonpha ten amaho lhuhchu amudiu ahi.
target: When the wicked thrive, so does sin, but the righteous will see their downfall.

source: Nachapa nathun nunsah-in, chutile aman nangma olna napehding; chule aman nalung akipasah ding ahi.
target: Discipline your children, and they will give you peace; they will bring you the delights you desire.

source: Khonungthu i-atiding ngaitophah louna achun mipite amangthah jitan; ahinla dan kituhchahpa chu akipah-in ahi.
target: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom’s instruction.

source: Soh chu kamcheng keovin akisudih theipoi, ajehchu aman hethem jongle adonbut louding ahi.
target: Servants cannot be corrected by mere words; though they understand, they will not respond.

source: Ngaikham le geltoh umlouva thusei namu em? amasangin mingol din kinepna atamjon ahi.
target: Do you see someone who speaks in haste? There is more hope for a fool than for them.

source: Asoh aneovapat demchatah-a hinkhou khah-a chun, khonung teng hiche sohpa chu chapa-a ahin neiding ahi.
target: A servant pampered from youth will turn out to be insolent.

source: Milung chompan kinahna achoh thouvin, chule milungkhoh pan suhkhelna ahaolo jitai.
target: An angry person stirs up conflict, and a hot-tempered person commits many sins.

source: Mihem khat kiletsahna chun ama anoinunsah teiding, ahinla jana chun lungsunga kineosahpa chu atundoh ding ahi.
target: Pride brings a person low, but the lowly in spirit gain honor.

source: Koihile migucha toh kithokhompa chun ama hinna jong ahot ahin, sapsetna ajanan ahin imacha aseipon ahi.
target: The accomplices of thieves are their own enemies; they are put under oath and dare not testify.

source: Mihem ginna hi thangkol kido ahibouvin, ahinla koihile Pakai tahsanna chu hoidoh ding ahi.
target: Fear of man will prove to be a snare, but whoever trusts in the Lord is kept safe.

source: Mitamtah in vaihompa khohsahna chu aholun, ahinla amitakip chunga thutanna chu Pakaiya kon ahibouve.
target: Many seek an audience with a ruler, but it is from the Lord that one gets justice.

source: Mikitah loupa chu midihpa dingin thet umtah ahin, chule achena lampia nolnabei michu agiloupa dinga thet umtah ahi.
target: The righteous detest the dishonest; the wicked detest the upright.

source: Jakeh chapa Agur thusei ho, themgao thusei ngeichu: hiche mipan Ithiel henga, Ithiel le Ucal heng ngeija thu aseijin;
target: The sayings of Agur son of Jakeh—an inspired utterance. This man’s utterance to Ithiel: “I am weary, God, but I can prevail.

source: Tahbeh-in hi midang sangsanga ngoljo kahin, mihem khatnin hetna aneibangin keiman kaneipoi.
target: Surely I am only a brute, not a man; I do not have human understanding.

source: Chihna kitijong kajil khapon, mithengpa hetnajong kananeipon ahi.
target: I have not learned wisdom, nor have I attained to the knowledge of the Holy One.

source: Koiham van'a kaltouva ahiloule hungkum lha-a? Koiham hui akhutna huikhom theija? Koiham twi ponna chuntheija? Koiham leiset kolkimvel anaphut detna? Ama minchu ipi hija, chule achapa minchu ipiham, nangman nasei theijem?
target: Who has gone up to heaven and come down? Whose hands have gathered up the wind? Who has wrapped up the waters in a cloak? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is the name of his son? Surely you know!

source: Pathen thu jousehi atheng ahin, chule ama tahsan ho jouse dingin ama chu lumdal ahi.
target: “Every word of God is flawless; he is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

source: Nangman athuho chu belap hihbeh-in, achuti loule aman nangma phohsalin natin, thujou seipa nahilo ding ahi.
target: Do not add to his words, or he will rebuke you and prove you a liar.

source: Keiman nanga konin thilni kangeh-in, kathi masangin hiche teni chu nei-itpeh hihbeh-in;
target: “Two things I ask of you, Lord ; do not refuse me before I die:

source: Keija konin thumanlou le jouthu gamlatah-a neikoi mangpeh jengin; vaichatna ahin haona hijongle neipehdan, keima dinga kakitopibep an achun neivah-in.
target: Keep falsehood and lies far from me; give me neither poverty nor riches, but give me only my daily bread.

source: Neng behsehleng nangma seilep inting, Pakai chu koiham? katiding; ahiloule vaicha behseh leng kaguhchat ding, ka Pathen min chu mohseh-a kaphah pohding ahi.
target: Otherwise, I may have too much and disown you and say, ‘Who is the Lord ?’ Or I may become poor and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.

source: Apupa henga asottolpa chu hehse hih-in, aman nasapset lontin themo changkhan nate.
target: “Do not slander a servant to their master, or they will curse you, and you will pay for it.

source: Mihem tamtah apa gaosapma, chule anu jong phatthei bohlou aumin ahi.
target: “There are those who curse their fathers and do not bless their mothers;

source: Mihem tamtah ama mitmu-a athenga kigel aumin, ahinla athenlou naova chu kisoptheng lou ahiuve.
target: those who are pure in their own eyes and yet are not cleansed of their filth;

source: Mihem tamtah aumin, Oh, amit houchu ichana sanga hitam! amit gei ujong dopsangin aumin ahi.
target: those whose eyes are ever so haughty, whose glances are so disdainful;

source: Mihem tamtah aumin, amaho hachu chemjam tobang, chule aha noinung houchu chemcha hemthet tobang ahin; leiset chunga kona vaichate vallhum dingle, mihem lah-a kona lhasamte sugam dinga kigo ahiuve.
target: those whose teeth are swords and whose jaws are set with knives to devour the poor from the earth and the needy from among mankind.

source: Votnin chanu ni aneijin, neipen, neipen tin apengin ahi. A-itih-a chimjoulou thilthum aumin, henge, aphatai, tilouhel thil li aume.
target: “The leech has two daughters. ‘Give! Give!’ they cry. “There are three things that are never satisfied, four that never say, ‘Enough!’:

source: Lhankhuh le nao neilou naobu; twi dim theilou hel leiset, chule aphatai tilouhel meikou ahi.
target: the grave, the barren womb, land, which is never satisfied with water, and fire, which never says, ‘Enough!’

source: Apa noisena mitna vea, chule anuthua nunding i-sah loupa mit chu,, phaichama va-ah hon achuhdoh ding, chule mulaopi nouhon anehdingu ahi.
target: “The eye that mocks a father, that scorns an aged mother, will be pecked out by the ravens of the valley, will be eaten by the vultures.

source: Keima dingin datmo umtah thil thum aumin, kahetlou thil li aume;
target: “There are three things that are too amazing for me, four that I do not understand:

source: van'a mulaopi lenna lampi, songpi chunga gul kithollena lampi, twikhanglen lailunga kong kitolna lampi, chule pasal khatle nungah khat chena lampi ahi.
target: the way of an eagle in the sky, the way of a snake on a rock, the way of a ship on the high seas, and the way of a man with a young woman.

source: Notinu lampi jong chutobang chu ahi; amanun anen chule amuh akitheh-in, agilou kabol hihbeh-e, atin ahi.
target: “This is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth and says, ‘I’ve done nothing wrong.’

source: Thilthum jeh in leiset athip theipon, chule thil li athoh theipoi:
target: “Under three things the earth trembles, under four it cannot bear up:

source: Soh khatnin vai ahinpoh-a, mingol khat-in sa vasetna ahin neh-a;
target: a servant who becomes king, a godless fool who gets plenty to eat,

source: Mi hotbol jing numei khatnin ji ahin neija, chule soh numei khat apinu goulo dinga ahung umhi ahi
target: a contemptible woman who gets married, and a servant who displaces her mistress.

source: Leiset chunga neocha cha thil li aumin, ahinla hicheho chu aching cheh ahiuve;
target: “Four things on earth are small, yet they are extremely wise:

source: Sihmi hohin mihem sanga thalhomjo ahivangun, nipilaile amahon anehdiu akigonun;
target: Ants are creatures of little strength, yet they store up their food in the summer;

source: Jupihohi lhasam tah ahivangun, songpiho-a buh akisah uvin;
target: hyraxes are creatures of little power, yet they make their home in the crags;

source: Khaokhohon leng aneipouvin, ahijeng vangin abonchauvin ahonin achelejiu ve;
target: locusts have no king, yet they advance together in ranks;

source: Maimom in akhutnin atuh-in, chule leng inpiho-a aumin ahi.
target: a lizard can be caught with the hand, yet it is found in kings’ palaces.

source: Phatah a chekhom thilthum aumin, chule thil li kitoh della chekhom jong aume;
target: “There are three things that are stately in their stride, four that move with stately bearing:

source: Keipi bahkaihi gamsa jouse lah-a ahatpen ahin, koima otdohlou ahi;
target: a lion, mighty among beasts, who retreats before nothing;

source: Uichal ahin, kelchal ahin, chuleh ama dou dinga koima dingdoh khalou lengpa ahi.
target: a strutting rooster, a he-goat, and a king secure against revolt.

source: Nangle nang kichoisang na-a ngolhoi tah-a nachon khah-a, ahiloule nangman thilphalou nagelleh, nakhutnin nakam kisimin.
target: “If you play the fool and exalt yourself, or if you plan evil, clap your hand over your mouth!

source: Bongnoi khu icho thipthap le bongnoiha asohjin, inahlhong iheh jongle thisan apotjin, chutobanga chu ilung ihansah jingle kinahna asohjin ahi.
target: For as churning cream produces butter, and as twisting the nose produces blood, so stirring up anger produces strife.”

source: Lemuel lengpa thusei ho, anun ahung guilhung dingthu anahilho.
target: The sayings of King Lemuel—an inspired utterance his mother taught him.

source: Ipiham kachapa? Iham kanaobua kon peng kachapa? Chule ipiham kakitepna ho-a kahin kachapa?
target: Listen, my son! Listen, son of my womb! Listen, my son, the answer to my prayers!

source: Nathahatna chu numei ho pedoh hih-in, nalampi ho jongchu lengte sumangho pedoh hih-in.
target: Do not spend your strength on women, your vigor on those who ruin kings.

source: Hichehi lengho ding ahipoi, Vo Lemuel, lenghon ju adonding ahipon, leng chateho dingin jong juchih donding ahipoi.
target: It is not for kings, Lemuel— it is not for kings to drink wine, not for rulers to crave beer,

source: Amahon donnu henlang danthu sumil taleu, suhgentheija umte chungchang thua lamdih louva thutan na aneikhah diu ahi.
target: lest they drink and forget what has been decreed, and deprive all the oppressed of their rights.

source: Amangthai ding hochu juchih donsah-un, chule lunggimho chu ju donsah-un.
target: Let beer be for those who are perishing, wine for those who are in anguish!

source: Aman don henlang avaichatna sumil hen, chule agimnaho geldohda tahih hen.
target: Let them drink and forget their poverty and remember their misery no more.

source: Mangthah dinga lhuhsahsa umho chungchanga, paomoho dingin nakam keh-in.
target: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute.

source: Mihem apaomo amadia thu kisei theilou jeh-a suhmanga umtadingho panpinan, nakam keh-inlang seipeh-in.
target: Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.

source: Numei chondihtah koijin akimujou tadem? ajehchu amanu manlutdan chu songmantam ho sangin asangjon ahi.
target: A wife of noble character who can find? She is worth far more than rubies.

source: A-inneipu chun lungmong selin atahsanin, hitichun amapa dingin lhahsamna kitimong mong umponte.
target: Her husband has full confidence in her and lacks nothing of value.

source: Amanun ahinkho lhumkeijin amapa dingin thilpha bolin tin, chule thilse bolpeh ponte.
target: She brings him good, not harm, all the days of her life.

source: Amanun samul le tupat aholin, alungcham tah-in akhut tah-in na atongin ahi.
target: She selects wool and flax and works with eager hands.

source: Amanu chu sumkolvei ho kong innei tobang ahin, gamla tahtah-a konin aman nehle chah ahin polutjin ahi.
target: She is like the merchant ships, bringing her food from afar.

source: Amanu janlai jengin jong athoudoh jin, chule a-insungmite chu nehding sa apen, aumpi soh numei ho jong achanding apejin ahi.
target: She gets up while it is still night; she provides food for her family and portions for her female servants.

source: Amanun loumun khat avechilin, hichu achon, akhutsoh mangchan lengpilei abolin ahi.
target: She considers a field and buys it; out of her earnings she plants a vineyard.

source: Amanun thahat na-in atai akigeh-in, chule abantha ahatsah-in ahi.
target: She sets about her work vigorously; her arms are strong for her tasks.

source: Amanun aveipungho chu aphai ti ahen, amanu meivah jong janle amit ngaipoi.
target: She sees that her trading is profitable, and her lamp does not go out at night.

source: Amanun akhutnin muikung atuh-in, chule akhutnin patkong kung atuh-in ahi.
target: In her hand she holds the distaff and grasps the spindle with her fingers.

source: Amanun vaichate le, lhasamte dingin akhut alhangdoh jin ahi.
target: She opens her arms to the poor and extends her hands to the needy.

source: Amanun a-insungmite dingin buhbang hunglha dingjong akichapoi; ajehchu a-insungmite jouse chu ponsanthip cheh-a kivon ahiuve.
target: When it snows, she has no fear for her household; for all of them are clothed in scarlet.

source: Amanun amadingin ponsil jemnei akikhonin, amanu von chu lungpon le ponsandup ahi.
target: She makes coverings for her bed; she is clothed in fine linen and purple.

source: A-inneipu chu gamsung upaho toh khopi kotpiphunga atouteng mijouse het ahijin ahi.
target: Her husband is respected at the city gate, where he takes his seat among the elders of the land.

source: Amanun tupat ponnemjet akhongin, ajohjin; chule konggah jong sumkolveipa henga akijoh jin ahi.
target: She makes linen garments and sells them, and supplies the merchants with sashes.

source: Amanu chu thahatna le jana-in akivonin, ahunglhung ding phatna jong ama kipah thanom ding ahi
target: She is clothed with strength and dignity; she can laugh at the days to come.

source: Amanun chingthei tah-in thu aseijin, athusei jong khotona dimset ahi.
target: She speaks with wisdom, and faithful instruction is on her tongue.

source: Amanun a-insung chena lampiho phatechan aven, chule thasetna changlhah jong anepon ahi.
target: She watches over the affairs of her household and does not eat the bread of idleness.

source: Achate ahung thoudoh-un anunnom nahi atiuve; a-inneipun jong amanu apahcha lheh jengin ahi.
target: Her children arise and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praises her:

source: Chanu tamtah-in chonphat abolin, ahinla nangman amaho chu nakhokhel sohkeije.
target: “Many women do noble things, but you surpass them all.”

source: Deisahna hi kilhep lhahna ahin, chule hoinahi pannabei ahi; ahinla Pakai gingjing numei vangchu, choi-atna umding ahi.
target: Charm is deceptive, and beauty is fleeting; but a woman who fears the Lord is to be praised.

source: Akhutsoh chu amanu peuvin, chule kotpi phunga anatoh jousechun amanu vahchoi cheh hen.
target: Honor her for all that her hands have done, and let her works bring her praise at the city gate.

source: Jerusalem lengpa David chapa thuhilpa thusei ho.
target: The words of the Teacher, son of David, king in Jerusalem:

source: Pannabei ho pannabei ahi tin thuhilpan aseije, pannabei ho pannabei; ijakai pannabei ahi.
target: “Meaningless! Meaningless!” says the Teacher. “Utterly meaningless! Everything is meaningless.”

source: Mihem khatnin nisa noija atohgimna jouse-a kona ipi phatchomna aneinah em?
target: What do people gain from all their labors at which they toil under the sun?

source: Khang khat achemangjin, chule khangchom khat ahunglhung kitji-e; ahinla leiset a-imatih-in aum jingin ahi.
target: Generations come and generations go, but the earth remains forever.

source: Nisa jong ahung sohdoh-in, nisa alhumkit jin, chule ahung sodohna lam mama-a akileloi jitai.
target: The sun rises and the sun sets, and hurries back to where it rises.

source: Hui chu lhanglam ngan anungin, chule sahlam ngan ahung lennun jin; tanglouvin akipei pei jengin, chule anundan kisem dungjuijin ahunglenun kitjin ahi.
target: The wind blows to the south and turns to the north; round and round it goes, ever returning on its course.

source: Vadung jouse twipia alonglut nun, ahijeng vangin twipi chu adimdehpoi; vadungho chu ahung londohna lama chun akile kitnun ahi.
target: All streams flow into the sea, yet the sea is never full. To the place the streams come from, there they return again.

source: Thil jousehi tohgimnan adimsetnin, mihemin aseidoh theipoi; mitla thilmu achinpon, nakol jong athujah-a adim theipoi.
target: All things are wearisome, more than one can say. The eye never has enough of seeing, nor the ear its fill of hearing.

source: Thil anaumsa chu, ahung um kitding mama chu ahin; chule anakibolsa chu, ahung kibol kitding chu ahije; chule nisa noijahin thilthah ima aumpoi.
target: What has been will be again, what has been done will be done again; there is nothing new under the sun.

source: Ven thilkhat chungchanga, hichehi athah ahi-e, tia gahsei thei umem? Eiho masangpeh, gollui laija ana umsa jeng ahi.
target: Is there anything of which one can say, “Look! This is something new”? It was here already, long ago; it was here before our time.

source: Masanglai thilho geldohna aumpon; khonunga hung umding honjong ahunglhung ding thil ho geldohna neideh pouvinte.
target: No one remembers the former generations, and even those yet to come will not be remembered by those who follow them.

source: Thuhilpa keima hi Jerusalem'a Israel chunga leng kanahi.
target: I, the Teacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

source: Chule keiman vannoi'a thil kitongdoh ho jouse chung changhi chihna-a hola kholdoh nadin kalung kanapen ahi; hichehi Pathen'in akisinsah nadiuva mihem chapate chu thohgimna nasatah hi anapeh ahi.
target: I applied my mind to study and to explore by wisdom all that is done under the heavens. What a heavy burden God has laid on mankind!

source: Keiman nisa noija nakitongsa jouse chu kamutai; chule veuvin aboncha keijin pannabei le lhagao sunohphah ahibouve.
target: I have seen all the things that are done under the sun; all of them are meaningless, a chasing after the wind.

source: Akonsa chu kisujang thei louding; chule akisama chu kisimtha theilou ding ahi.
target: What is crooked cannot be straightened; what is lacking cannot be counted.

source: Kalungthimin keima le keima kakihoulim jin, hitin kati; veuvin, keiman mun jaotah chu kahin phatai, chule Jerusalem'a keima masanga anaumho jouse sangin chihna kakimube tai: Tahbeh mongin kalungin chihna le hetnalam hetdohna lentah aneitai.
target: I said to myself, “Look, I have increased in wisdom more than anyone who has ruled over Jerusalem before me; I have experienced much of wisdom and knowledge.”

source: Keiman chihna, ngolna, chule ngolchona hetdoh nadin kalung kanapen; hiche jonghi lhagao sunohphah ahi ti kamudoh-in ahi.
target: Then I applied myself to the understanding of wisdom, and also of madness and folly, but I learned that this, too, is a chasing after the wind.

source: Ajehchu chihna tamna-a gimna atamin; chule hetna haopa chun lungkhamna ahaove.
target: For with much wisdom comes much sorrow; the more knowledge, the more grief.

source: Keiman kalung sunga, tun chen, keiman nangma thanop na-in napatep inge, hijeh chun nopsahna hinkho mangin, tin kaseije: ahin, veuvin, hiche jonghi pannabei ahi.
target: I said to myself, “Come now, I will test you with pleasure to find out what is good.” But that also proved to be meaningless.

source: Keiman nuina hi, ngolna ahi kati; chule thanopna hi, ipin ahin sodoh ham?
target: “Laughter,” I said, “is madness. And what does pleasure accomplish?”

source: Chihna toh kalungsung kiheto-a kakoi jeng vangin, keiman kalung sunga ju lama kakipeh nading; chule mihem chapatehon ahin nikho lhumkei uva, vannoi'a amaho ding atohdoh uva pha kamudoh kahsen, ngolchon nalama kipenge tin, kangaiton ahi.
target: I tried cheering myself with wine, and embracing folly—my mind still guiding me with wisdom. I wanted to see what was good for people to do under the heavens during the few days of their lives.

source: Keiman natohlen len katongin; keima din in tampi kakisah-in; chule lengpigui hon tampi kakibolin ahi.
target: I undertook great projects: I built houses for myself and planted vineyards.

source: Keiman hon le theilei tampi kakibolin, hiche sunga chun thei namkim kaphutnin ahi.
target: I made gardens and parks and planted all kinds of fruit trees in them.

source: Keiman gammang hinsodoh-a thingphung ho twichap dingin, twikul tampi jong kakilaijin ahi.
target: I made reservoirs to water groves of flourishing trees.

source: Keiman soh pasal le soh numei tampi kaki choh-in, ka-insunga pengden soh tampi kaneijin; keima masanga Jerusalem'a anaum ho jouse sangin gancha alenle aneo kanei tamjon ahi.
target: I bought male and female slaves and had other slaves who were born in my house. I also owned more herds and flocks than anyone in Jerusalem before me.

source: Keiman dangka le sana, chule lengho le gamkai ho neile gou kidang dangho jong kakichom khomin; Keiman numei lasathem le pasal lasathem, chule mihem chapate kipana thei, tumgingthei manchah ho jatkim keijin kakichom khomin ahi.
target: I amassed silver and gold for myself, and the treasure of kings and provinces. I acquired male and female singers, and a harem as well—the delights of a man’s heart.

source: Hitichun keima kanaloupi-in, chule kamasanga Jerusalem'a ana umho jouse sangin kanakhang touvin; chule ka chihna jong aum aumpeh-in ahi.
target: I became greater by far than anyone in Jerusalem before me. In all this my wisdom stayed with me.

source: Chule kamit tenin amunom tapou chu musah louvin kakoipon, kipana-a konin kalungthim kakham chah poi; ajehchu katohgim najousea kalung akipah-in, chule hiche chu katoh gimna jouse-a kona kachan chu ahi.
target: I denied myself nothing my eyes desired; I refused my heart no pleasure. My heart took delight in all my labor, and this was the reward for all my toil.

source: Chujouvin keiman kakhut teni-a kanatohdoh ho jousele, tohgimna-a katohdoh ho kaven; chule, veuvin, aboncha chu pannabei le lungthim kisuhboina anahi bouvin, chule nisa noija hin imacha aphachom aumpoi.
target: Yet when I surveyed all that my hands had done and what I had toiled to achieve, everything was meaningless, a chasing after the wind; nothing was gained under the sun.

source: Chuin keima chihna le ngolna chule ngolchona ngaitodin kakiheitan ahi: ajehchu lengpa nunga hungpa chun ipi aboldoh dingham? ana kiboldoh sajeng bou hiding ahi.
target: Then I turned my thoughts to consider wisdom, and also madness and folly. What more can the king’s successor do than what has already been done?

source: Chujouvin keiman vah-in muthim akhokhel banga, chihna-in ngolchon na akhokhel chu kanamudoh tan ahi.
target: I saw that wisdom is better than folly, just as light is better than darkness.

source: Michingpa mit teni chu aluchunga aumin; ahinla mingol vang chun muthim lah-a lam ajotnin ahi. Chule thilsoh khatchu abonchau chunga asoh-e ti keima tah-in kamudoh tai.
target: The wise have eyes in their heads, while the fool walks in the darkness; but I came to realize that the same fate overtakes them both.

source: Chujouvin keiman kalung sunga kaseijin, mingol chunga thilsoh tobang, keima chung jenga jong asoh-in; achutile ipidinga ching jep kahim? kati; chuin kalung sunga, hiche jonghi pannabei ahi kati.
target: Then I said to myself, “The fate of the fool will overtake me also. What then do I gain by being wise?” I said to myself, “This too is meaningless.”

source: Ajehchu a-imatih chanin miching chu mingol sangin geldoh-in aumdehpoi; tu-a umho jousehi ahunglhung ding nikho hole suhmila umsoh keiding ahi. Chule mi michingpa chu iti thi ham? mingol tobanga thi ahi.
target: For the wise, like the fool, will not be long remembered; the days have already come when both have been forgotten. Like the fool, the wise too must die!

source: Hijeh chun keiman hinkho kahon ahi; ajehchu nisa noija nakitong doh hi keima dingin lungkhamna jeng ahi. Ajehchu imajouse pannabei le lungthim kisuhboina ahi.
target: So I hated life, because the work that is done under the sun was grievous to me. All of it is meaningless, a chasing after the wind.

source: Dihtah-in keiman nisa noija katoh gimna jouse kahon ahi; ajehchu keiman kanunga hungpa dinga kadalhah pehding ahi.
target: I hated all the things I had toiled for under the sun, because I must leave them to the one who comes after me.

source: Chule amapa chu miching ahi mingol ahiding koijin ija ahetnem? hijeng jongle keiman nisa noija kachihna vetsahna-a, gimtah-a katohdoh ho jouse chung, aman vai ahop ding ahi. Hiche jonghi pannabei ahi.
target: And who knows whether that person will be wise or foolish? Yet they will have control over all the fruit of my toil into which I have poured my effort and skill under the sun. This too is meaningless.

source: Hijeh chun nisa noija katohgimna ho jouse-a chun kalung kathoi sah-in ahi.
target: So my heart began to despair over all my toilsome labor under the sun.

source: Ajehchu chihna, hetna chule thudih-a tong gima mi aumin; ahijeng vangin amapan tonggim louhelpa chan dinga adalhah pehding ahi. Hiche jonghi pannabei le thil phaloutah ahi.
target: For a person may labor with wisdom, knowledge and skill, and then they must leave all they own to another who has not toiled for it. This too is meaningless and a great misfortune.

source: Ajehchu mihem khatnin atohgimna jousele, alunggimna chule nisa noija atohgim naho-a ipi amu-em?
target: What do people get for all the toil and anxious striving with which they labor under the sun?

source: Ajehchu anikhoho jouse chu gentheina ahin, chule athohgimna jong lunghemna ahi; tahbeh-in, janteng jongle alungsung aolpoi. Hiche jonghi pannabei ahi.
target: All their days their work is grief and pain; even at night their minds do not rest. This too is meaningless.

source: Mihem khatnin an aneh-a, twi adona, chule ahinna-in atohgimna chunga nop asah sanga phajo aumpoi. Hiche jonghi Pathen khutna kon anahi ti, keiman kana mudoh-e.
target: A person can do nothing better than to eat and drink and find satisfaction in their own toil. This too, I see, is from the hand of God,

source: Ajehchu keima sanga koijin an neh akimu joh-a, ahiloule koijin nom asah joh-am?
target: for without him, who can eat or find enjoyment?

source: Ajehchu Pathen'in ama mitmun mipha chu chihna le hetna chule kipana apen; ahinla michonse vang chu, Pathen ang sunga miphapa peh ding chomkhom ding le sevum dingin, thoh hahsa apen ahi. Hiche jonghi pannabei le lungthim kisuhbohna ahi.
target: To the person who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge and happiness, but to the sinner he gives the task of gathering and storing up wealth to hand it over to the one who pleases God. This too is meaningless, a chasing after the wind.

source: Thil jouse din phat aumcheh-in, chule vannoi'a chule thil kigong jousen phat anei cheh-e.
target: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens:

source: Penphat aumin, chule thi phat aume; aphu phat aumin, chule akiphutsa bodoh phat aume.
target: a time to be born and a time to die, a time to plant and a time to uproot,

source: Thaphat aumin, chule boldam phat aume; phetlhah phat aumin, chule sahdohna phat aume.
target: a time to kill and a time to heal, a time to tear down and a time to build,

source: Ka phat aumin, chule nui phat aume; lunghem phat aumin, chule lam phat aume.
target: a time to weep and a time to laugh, a time to mourn and a time to dance,

source: Songho paidoh phat aumin, chule songho lokhom phat aume; kikolchah phat aumin, chule kilhakang phat aume.
target: a time to scatter stones and a time to gather them, a time to embrace and a time to refrain from embracing,

source: Amu phat aumin, chule mansahna phat aume; chintup phat aumin, chule paidoh phat aume.
target: a time to search and a time to give up, a time to keep and a time to throw away,

source: Bo-eh phat aumin, chule khuibit phat aume; thipchetna umphat aumin, chule paodoh phat aume,
target: a time to tear and a time to mend, a time to be silent and a time to speak,

source: Kingailut phat aumin, chule kimuda phat aume; kigal phat aumin, chule kicham phat aumin ahi.
target: a time to love and a time to hate, a time for war and a time for peace.

source: Atongpa chun atohgimna-a kona ipi phatchomna aneijem?
target: What do workers gain from their toil?

source: Keiman mihem chapate kisinsahna dinga Pathen'in apeh thoh hahsat nachu keiman kamutai.
target: I have seen the burden God has laid on the human race.

source: Aman thil ijakai jouse aphatchan hoitah-in asemin ahi: chujongle koimachan Pathen'in abula patna ajona geija ipi atoh doh-em ahetdoh joulouna dingun, alungthim sunguva vannoi thu akhumpeh tan ahi.
target: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in the human heart; yet no one can fathom what God has done from beginning to end.

source: Ahinla mihem chu akipa thanopma, ahinkho-a thilpha abol tilouvin, amaho-a thilpha aumpoi ti keiman kahen ahi.
target: I know that there is nothing better for people than to be happy and to do good while they live.

source: Chujongle mihem jousen aneh-a, adona chule atohgimna jouse-a kona thilpha nomtah-a amanchah ding ahi, hichu Pathen thilpeh ahi.
target: That each of them may eat and drink, and find satisfaction in all their toil—this is the gift of God.

source: Pathen'in abol tapou chu a-imatih chana ding ahi, ti keiman kahei; chuche chunga chu belapthei, chule lahdohthei jong aumpoi. Chule hichehi Pathen'in mihemte ama angsunga kicha tah-a aumna diuva abol ahi.
target: I know that everything God does will endure forever; nothing can be added to it and nothing taken from it. God does it so that people will fear him.

source: Ana umsa chu tu-a umhi ahi; chule ahung umding jong chu anaumsa chu ahin; chule Pathen'in achesa chu anung holin ahi.
target: Whatever is has already been, and what will be has been before; and God will call the past to account.

source: Chule chuche chungchon chun keiman nisa noija thutan na mun chu kamun, chua phatlouna aum; chule chonphatna mun'a khangit louna aum kamun ahi.
target: And I saw something else under the sun: In the place of judgment—wickedness was there, in the place of justice—wickedness was there.

source: Pathen'in michonpha hole migiloute chung thu atanding ahi; ajehchu thil kigong le thil kiboldoh chengse dingin phat khat aumcheh-e, tin keiman kalungsunga kaseijin ahi.
target: I said to myself, “God will bring into judgment both the righteous and the wicked, for there will be a time for every activity, a time to judge every deed.”

source: Mihem chapate umdan chungchanga hin, Pathen'in amaho hinphong doh henlang, chule amahotah in jong sahem ahiuhi kimudoh theileu, tin kalung sunga kaseijin ahi.
target: I also said to myself, “As for humans, God tests them so that they may see that they are like the animals.

source: Ajehchu mihem chapate chunga thil lhungchu sahemho chunga alhungin; thilkhat jeng jong amaho chunga alhung gellin ahi: khat athi bangin, khatjong athin; tahbeh-in, abonchauva haitheina kibang neicheh ahiuve; chutichun mihemin sahem chunga chungnunna aneipoi. Ajehchu aboncha pannabei ahi.
target: Surely the fate of human beings is like that of the animals; the same fate awaits them both: As one dies, so dies the other. All have the same breath; humans have no advantage over animals. Everything is meaningless.

source: Abon chaovin munkhat ajon cheh-un, abon chaova vutvaija kon ahiuvin, chule abon chaovin vutvai asoh kit jiuve.
target: All go to the same place; all come from dust, and to dust all return.

source: Mihem lhagao chunglama kaltouva, chule sahem lhagao leisetna akumsuh koijin ahet khah-em?
target: Who knows if the human spirit rises upward and if the spirit of the animal goes down into the earth?”

source: Hijeh chun mihem chu anatoh ho-a kipah thanoma aumding sanga phajo adang aumpoi ti keiman kahedoh tai; ajehchu hichu ama chan ahin; chule ama nunga ipi asoding ve dinga koijin ama apui ding ham?
target: So I saw that there is nothing better for a person than to enjoy their work, because that is their lot. For who can bring them to see what will happen after them?

source: Chuti chun kahung kilen, nisa noija suhgentheina jouse chu kangaitoi: chule veuvin, joulhepma umte mitlhi chu, amahon lhamonsah aneipouvin; chule amaho sugentheite henga chun thaneina aume, ahinla amahon lhamonsah aneipouve.
target: Again I looked and saw all the oppression that was taking place under the sun: I saw the tears of the oppressed— and they have no comforter; power was on the side of their oppressors— and they have no comforter.

source: Hijeh chun keiman ahingho tu-a hing nalaiho sangin, athiho tu-a athisaho kapah chajon ahi.
target: And I declared that the dead, who had already died, are happier than the living, who are still alive.

source: Tahbeh-in, amani sangin, tuchan geija umkha loulai, chule nisa noija thilse kibol mukhalou laipa chu aphajoi.
target: But better than both is the one who has never been born, who has not seen the evil that is done under the sun.

source: Avelin, keiman mihem khat aheng akomin amit thip lona thohgimnaho jouse le natohphaho jouse chu kangaiton; hiche jonghi pannabei le lungthim kisuhboina ahi.
target: And I saw that all toil and all achievement spring from one person’s envy of another. This too is meaningless, a chasing after the wind.

source: Mingolin akhut asim tumin, chule ama le ama tahsa akineh jin ahi.
target: Fools fold their hands and ruin themselves.

source: Thohgim tahle lungthim kisuhboi puma khut ni dimsei neisangin, lungdam sella tah-a khut khat dim nei aphajoi.
target: Better one handful with tranquillity than two handfuls with toil and chasing after the wind.

source: Chujouvin keima kahung kile kitnin, chule nisa noija pannabei chu kamu doh-e.
target: Again I saw something meaningless under the sun:

source: Khatsehbou aumin, anina aumpoi: henge, aman cha aneipon sopi pasal jong aneipoi; ahinla atohgimna aki ngahtih aumpon; amit jong chu haonaho-a alunglhai joupon; koidinga katoh-a, chule kahinna thilpha kachansah louham? tin aseidehpoi. Hichejonghi pannabei ahin, nasatah-a thohgimna ahi.
target: There was a man all alone; he had neither son nor brother. There was no end to his toil, yet his eyes were not content with his wealth. “For whom am I toiling,” he asked, “and why am I depriving myself of enjoyment?” This too is meaningless— a miserable business!

source: Khat sangin ni aphajoi; ajehchu atoh gimna lhona kipaman phatah amulhonin ahi.
target: Two are better than one, because they have a good return for their labor:

source: Ajehchu alhuh hon jongle, khat chun aloipa aphohding ding ahi; ahinla achanga umpa chu alhuh teng ada ahi; ajehchu aman akithopi ding aneipon ahi.
target: If either of them falls down, one can help the other up. But pity anyone who falls and has no one to help them up.

source: Chukitle mi ni alupkhom lhonle, akinehlum to lhonin; ahinla khat changseh chu iti kisuh lum thei ding ham?
target: Also, if two lie down together, they will keep warm. But how can one keep warm alone?

source: Chule khat touvin ama hindou taleh, mi nin amapa chu anan jouding ahi; chule khaohol thum kiheh kop chu atanbai pon ahi.
target: Though one may be overpowered, two can defend themselves. A cord of three strands is not quickly broken.

source: Leng tehse ngoltah, thumop sangthei lou hisangin; chapang vaichatah le chingtah hi aphajoi.
target: Better a poor but wise youth than an old but foolish king who no longer knows how to heed a warning.

source: Ajehchu amachu songkul'a konin leng chang dingin ahungpot doh-in; hijongle ama lenggam sung mama-a peng khatchu ahung vaicha theije.
target: The youth may have come from prison to the kingship, or he may have been born in poverty within his kingdom.

source: Keiman nisa noija kalsong hinna neiho jouse chu, ama khela lenga hung pangding cha ni lhinna chutoh kagah ngaito khomin ahi.
target: I saw that all who lived and walked under the sun followed the youth, the king’s successor.

source: Mipi jouse leh amaho masanga anaumho jouse kichaitih aumpoi; nunga hung dingho jong ama chunga kipah deh loudingu ahi. Tahbeh-in hiche jonghi pannabei le lungthim kisuhboina ahi.
target: There was no end to all the people who were before them. But those who came later were not pleased with the successor. This too is meaningless, a chasing after the wind.

source: Pathen in'a nache tengle nakeng kivet phatnin, chule mingol ho longlhenna thilpeh sangin thu ngai dingin kigo jingin umjon; ajehchu amahon thilse aboluve ti angaito phapouve.
target: Guard your steps when you go to the house of God. Go near to listen rather than to offer the sacrifice of fools, who do not know that they do wrong.

source: Nakam tamsah hih-in, chule Pathen angsunga thilkhat phongdoh dingin nalung kino dahen; ajehchu van'a Pathen aumin, nangma leiset chunga uma nahi; hijeh chun nathu seidoh chu lhom sah-in.
target: Do not be quick with your mouth, do not be hasty in your heart to utter anything before God. God is in heaven and you are on earth, so let your words be few.

source: Ijeh inem itile kisah lelna tamtah jala mang umji ahin, chule mingol aw chu athu tamseija konin akihen ahi.
target: A dream comes when there are many cares, and many words mark the speech of a fool.

source: Pathen henga kitepna khatna nakitep teng, peh ding ngongkai hih-in; ajehchu aman mingol ho-a kipana aneipoi; nathutep chu pe jengin.
target: When you make a vow to God, do not delay to fulfill it. He has no pleasure in fools; fulfill your vow.

source: Nakitepna pelouva naum sangin, nakitep louma apha jon ahi.
target: It is better not to make a vow than to make one and not fulfill it.

source: Nakam chu natahsa chonsetsah nadingin phal hih-in; vantil masanga jong hichehi suhkhel ahi tin seihih in. Ipidinga Pathen chu na aw-soa lunghanga, nakhutsoh thilho asuh manghel dingham?
target: Do not let your mouth lead you into sin. And do not protest to the temple messenger, “My vow was a mistake.” Why should God be angry at what you say and destroy the work of your hands?

source: Ajehchu mang tamnale thu tamna-a chun pannabei tampi jong aumjie; ahinla nangman Pathen chu gingin.
target: Much dreaming and many words are meaningless. Therefore fear God.

source: Nangman gamsunga mivaichate kisuh gentheina, chule thutanlhahna le thudih pumhatna akibol namu-a ahile hichu datmo hih-in; ajehchu asang penpa sanga sang jopan akhohsah nan; chule amaho sanga sangjo aumnai.
target: If you see the poor oppressed in a district, and justice and rights denied, do not be surprised at such things; for one official is eyed by a higher one, and over them both are others higher still.

source: Hiche chungchon chun leiset phatchomna hi mijouse dinga ahi, lengpa tah jengjong louma-a hinga ahi.
target: The increase from the land is taken by all; the king himself profits from the fields.

source: Dangka ngailupa chu dangka-a lunglhai joulou ding, ninglhin na ngailupa chu punbe na-a lunglhai louding ahi; hiche jonghi pannabei ahi.
target: Whoever loves money never has enough; whoever loves wealth is never satisfied with their income. This too is meaningless.

source: Thil le lo apunbe teng, aneding jong apunben; chule chuche neiho dinga chu, amitnuva amu-u tilouva aphat chomna ipi umam?
target: As goods increase, so do those who consume them. And what benefit are they to the owners except to feast their eyes on them?

source: Tamtah nehen lhomcha nejongle natong gimpa imut chu anomin; ahinla mihaopa haosatna chun ama a-imut sahpon ahi.
target: The sleep of a laborer is sweet, whether they eat little or much, but as for the rich, their abundance permits them no sleep.

source: Keiman nisa noija thil phaloutah khat kamu aume; hichu haonahi aneipa kisuhkhah nadinga kikoija ahi.
target: I have seen a grievous evil under the sun: wealth hoarded to the harm of its owners,

source: Ahinla chuche haonaho chu thoh hahsatna phaloutah jeh-in amangthah jin, chule aman chapa khat ahingin, chule imacha akhutna aumpoi.
target: or wealth lost through some misfortune, so that when they have children there is nothing left for them to inherit.

source: Amapa anu naobu-a kona ahungpot banga chu, ahung bang banga sagoh keova kile kitding, chule akhutna akichoi mang thei, atohgimna-a kona ima aki kenthei louding ahi.
target: Everyone comes naked from their mother’s womb, and as everyone comes, so they depart. They take nothing from their toil that they can carry in their hands.

source: Chule hiche jonghi thilsetah ahin, lamjouse-a ahung bang banga, kinungle cheh ding ahi. Chule ahomkeo dinga tonggimpan ipi phatchomna aneijem?
target: This too is a grievous evil: As everyone comes, so they depart, and what do they gain, since they toil for the wind?

source: Aman ahin nikho jousen muthim lah-a an anen, chule hesoh tampi, lungsatna tampi chu anatna to athoh than ahi.
target: All their days they eat in darkness, with great frustration, affliction and anger.

source: Veovin, keiman kamudoh hi; Pathen'in mihem khat apeh ahinkho lhumkeija; nisa noija atohgimna jouse-a, an aneh-a, twi adona, akipa thanop dinghi thil phatah le kilomtah ahi; ajehchu hichu ama chan ahi.
target: This is what I have observed to be good: that it is appropriate for a person to eat, to drink and to find satisfaction in their toilsome labor under the sun during the few days of life God has given them—for this is their lot.

source: Amitakip henga Pathen'in haona le neile gou apen; chule chuche-a kona chu neding le, achan kilah nading, chule atohgimna-a akipa theina dingin thaneina apen ahi; Hichehi Pathen thilpeh ahi.
target: Moreover, when God gives someone wealth and possessions, and the ability to enjoy them, to accept their lot and be happy in their toil—this is a gift of God.

source: Ijeh inem itile aman ahinlai nikhoho chu hageldoh theiponte; ajehchu Pathen'in alungsung kipana-in adonbut tan ahi.
target: They seldom reflect on the days of their life, because God keeps them occupied with gladness of heart.

source: Nisa noija thilse khat keiman kamui; chule hichu mihemte lah-a umjing thil ahi.
target: I have seen another evil under the sun, and it weighs heavily on mankind:

source: Pathen'in mihem khat ahinan angaichat jouse imacha alhahsam louna dinga haosatna, neile gou, chule jana apen, ahijeng vangin Pathen'in chuche ho-a kona chu aneh theina ding tha apepon, ahinla gamdang min bou anen ahi. Hichehi pannabei, nat phaloutah ahi.
target: God gives some people wealth, possessions and honor, so that they lack nothing their hearts desire, but God does not grant them the ability to enjoy them, and strangers enjoy them instead. This is meaningless, a grievous evil.

source: Mihem khatnin cha jakhat hinghen lang, chule kum tampi hing hen, hitichun ahin nikhoho tamtah hihen lang, ahin ahinna chun thilpha-in lungkimna neihih hen, chule vui louvin jong umtaleh; keiman amapa sangchun aphat louva pen aphajoi kati.
target: A man may have a hundred children and live many years; yet no matter how long he lives, if he cannot enjoy his prosperity and does not receive proper burial, I say that a stillborn child is better off than he.

source: Ajehchu ama pannabei to ahung lutnin, chule muthim lah-a achemang tan, chule aminchu muthimin akhukhum ding ahi.
target: It comes without meaning, it departs in darkness, and in darkness its name is shrouded.

source: Chukal valin aman nisa anamu pon, imacha jong anahe poi; aman khatjopa sangin olna akimu joh-in ahi.
target: Though it never saw the sun or knew anything, it has more rest than does that man—

source: Henge, kum sangkhat nivei hing henlang, thilpha mu hihleh, mijouse abonchauva munkhatna checheh hilouham?
target: even if he lives a thousand years twice over but fails to enjoy his prosperity. Do not all go to the same place?

source: Mihem tohgimna jousehi akamsung ding ahin, ahijeng vangin aduchat achim dehpoi.
target: Everyone’s toil is for their mouth, yet their appetite is never satisfied.

source: Ajehchu michingin mingol ho sanga ipi atamnei deh em? ahing nalaiho masanga kalsonje he-a vaichaten, ipi aneideh em?
target: What advantage have the wise over fools? What do the poor gain by knowing how to conduct themselves before others?

source: Gamtin ngaichat sangin, mitna mu joh chu aphajoi; hiche jonghi pannabei le lungthim kisuhgimna ahi.
target: Better what the eye sees than the roving of the appetite. This too is meaningless, a chasing after the wind.

source: Aumsa chu minvosa ahitan, chule hichu mihem ahije ti akihen; ama sanga thahatjo toh ama kitet theihoi ahideh poi.
target: Whatever exists has already been named, and what humanity is has been known; no one can contend with someone who is stronger.

source: Pannabei punsah-a thil tampi akimudoh tolhonin, mihem dinga hichu ipiham aphat chomna?
target: The more the words, the less the meaning, and how does that profit anyone?

source: Ijeh inem itile mihem hinkhon nisa lim banga kitol mang loithei sung ajot laija, ama dia aphachom koijin ahetdoh ding ham? Ajeh chu ama athi nungle hiche nisa noija ipi ahungso ding koijin aseitheijem?
target: For who knows what is good for a person in life, during the few and meaningless days they pass through like a shadow? Who can tell them what will happen under the sun after they are gone?

source: Minphat hi thao mantam tah sangin aphajon; chule thi nikhohi pen nikho sangin aphajon ahi.
target: A good name is better than fine perfume, and the day of death better than the day of birth.

source: Lunghemna in'a gachehi, golvahna in'a gache sangin aphajoi; ajehchu hiche chu mijouse hinkho kichaini ahin, chule ahing nalai chun alung sunga achin jing ding ahi.
target: It is better to go to a house of mourning than to go to a house of feasting, for death is the destiny of everyone; the living should take this to heart.

source: Hesohna hi nuina sangin aphajoi; ajehchu lunghemna melput vangin lungsung semphat cheh in aum jie.
target: Frustration is better than laughter, because a sad face is good for the heart.

source: Miching lungsung chu lunghemna insunga aumin, ahinla mingol ho lungsung vang chu kipana inabou aum jie.
target: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning, but the heart of fools is in the house of pleasure.

source: Mihem dinga michingin mi aphona jah chu, mingol lasah kijah sangin aphachom jon ahi.
target: It is better to heed the rebuke of a wise person than to listen to the song of fools.

source: Ajehchu mingol nuigin chu linga belto kikhot gin poh lenglung tobang ahin; hiche jonghi pannabei ahi.
target: Like the crackling of thorns under the pot, so is the laughter of fools. This too is meaningless.

source: Tahbeh-in suhgentheina hin miching asungolin, chule nehguh thilpeh hin lungsung asusen ahi.
target: Extortion turns a wise person into a fool, and a bribe corrupts the heart.

source: Thilkhat kichaina chu akipatna sangin aphajoi; chule lhagaova thohhat chu lhagaova kiletsah sangin aphajoi.
target: The end of a matter is better than its beginning, and patience is better than pride.

source: Lunghang dingin nalungthima kino loihih-in, ajehchu lunghan hi mingol ho angsunga bou auma ahi.
target: Do not be quickly provoked in your spirit, for anger resides in the lap of fools.

source: Tulai sanga malai nikho ho aphatjoh chu ipi jeh hintem, tin nangman seihih-in; ijeh inem itile nangman hiche chung changhi chingthei tah-in nakhol pon ahi.
target: Do not say, “Why were the old days better than these?” For it is not wise to ask such questions.

source: Chihna hi gou kilo bangin dingin aphan; chule hiche jal hin nisa mute dingin phatchomna aume.
target: Wisdom, like an inheritance, is a good thing and benefits those who see the sun.

source: Ajehchu sum hi kihon bitna ahibangin, chihna jonghi kihon bitna ahin; ahinla hetna achungchon na chu, chihna hin ama neiho chu hinna ape-in ahe.
target: Wisdom is a shelter as money is a shelter, but the advantage of knowledge is this: Wisdom preserves those who have it.

source: Pathen natoh hohi gah ngaiton, ajehchu aman akhonsa-a asem chu, kon ajansah thei dingham?
target: Consider what God has done: Who can straighten what he has made crooked?

source: Hamphat nikhon kipah thanomin, ahinla hahsat nikhole ngaiton; mihemin khonung leh amanunga imacha amudoh louna dingin, Pathen'in mihem khatjoh banga achom joh jong chu asem cheh ahi.
target: When times are good, be happy; but when times are bad, consider this: God has made the one as well as the other. Therefore, no one can discover anything about their future.

source: Keiman pannabei nikhoho sunga hin imajouse kamusohtai. Midih khat achonphatna-a mangthah aumin, chule migilou khat agitlou vanga sottah hinga aumin ahi.
target: In this meaningless life of mine I have seen both of these: the righteous perishing in their righteousness, and the wicked living long in their wickedness.

source: Tamtah chunga kichon phatsah hih-in; chih jong kichihsah hih-in; ipidinga nangma nangle nang nakisuhset dingham?
target: Do not be overrighteous, neither be overwise— why destroy yourself?

source: Phatlou bolval hih-in, ngoljong ngolval hih-in; ipidinga naphat masanga nathi jeng ding ham?
target: Do not be overwicked, and do not be a fool— why die before your time?

source: Hichehi nangman nakimat khah a pha ahi; henge, nakhut jong hichea konchun loidoh hih-in: ajehchu amaho jouse lah-a kona Pathen ginga chu hungdoh teiding ahi.
target: It is good to grasp the one and not let go of the other. Whoever fears God will avoid all extremes.

source: Khopi sunga um mithahat som sangin, chihna hin miching athahatsah jon ahi.
target: Wisdom makes one wise person more powerful than ten rulers in a city.

source: Ajehchu leiset chunga thilpha bolla, chonselou, midihtah khatcha aumpon ahi.
target: Indeed, there is no one on earth who is righteous, no one who does what is right and never sins.

source: Chujongle thu kiseiho jousehi abonchan ngaikhoh hih-in, ajole nasohpan nasapsetna kijah getnin nate.
target: Do not pay attention to every word people say, or you may hear your servant cursing you—

source: Ajehchu chutobanga chu nangman jong midangho masapsetji chu nalung sungin ahe matchet jin ahi.
target: for you know in your heart that many times you yourself have cursed others.

source: Hitiho jousehi keiman chihna-a kaphot chet ahitai. Keiman ching taveleng kanatin, ahinla chihna chu keija konin anagamla lheh-e.
target: All this I tested by wisdom and I said, “I am determined to be wise”— but this was beyond me.

source: Gamlatah-a um, chule hathuh-a thuh chu, kon amudoh jou dingham?
target: Whatever exists is far off and most profound— who can discover it?

source: Hetna dingle kholchil nading, chule chihna holdohna ding le thilho umjedan holdoh nading, ngolna phatlou dan hetdohna dingle ngolna le lung chatvaina hetdoh nadingin, keiman kalungthim kana mangchan ahi.
target: So I turned my mind to understand, to investigate and to search out wisdom and the scheme of things and to understand the stupidity of wickedness and the madness of folly.

source: Chule keiman alungsung Thangkol le Len ho ngen hia, chule akhut teni khaohol ho bangjeng, thina sanga khajo numei kamudoh-in ahi. Koi hileh Pathen lung lhaisahpa chu amanu-a kona hoidoh jouding, ahinla chonse vangchu amunun amat khahding ahi.
target: I find more bitter than death the woman who is a snare, whose heart is a trap and whose hands are chains. The man who pleases God will escape her, but the sinner she will ensnare.

source: Veuvin, hiche hi kamudoh ahi, tin thuhilpan aseije: thil ahung kipat dan mudoh ahina dingin, khat khatnin kasimin;
target: “Look,” says the Teacher, “this is what I have discovered: “Adding one thing to another to discover the scheme of things—

source: Kahinnan ahol nahlai pentah chu keiman kamudoh poi. Sangkhat lah-a pasal khat kamudoh-in; ahinla amaho jouse lah-a chun keiman numei khat jengjong kamudoh poi.
target: while I was still searching but not finding— I found one upright man among a thousand, but not one upright woman among them all.

source: Veovin, hibouhi kamu doh-e, Pathen'in mihem dihtah-a asem ahin, ahinla amahon semdoh thu tamtah aholdoh-un ahi.
target: This only have I found: God created mankind upright, but they have gone in search of many schemes.”

source: Miching tobang ding koiham? chule thilkhat aledohna he-a koiham? mihem khatchu achihna-in amai avahsah-in; chule amai ngalna jongchu kikhel jengding ahi.
target: Who is like the wise? Who knows the explanation of things? A person’s wisdom brightens their face and changes its hard appearance.

source: Keiman, nangma kathumop nahi, Pathen'a nakitepna jalchun, lengpa thupeh chu chingtupmin.
target: Obey the king’s command, I say, because you took an oath before God.

source: Amitmua kona chedoh dingin kikinsah hih-in; thilse-a pang teitei hih-in; ajehchu aman adeichan chu aboljeng ahi.
target: Do not be in a hurry to leave the king’s presence. Do not stand up for a bad cause, for he will do whatever he pleases.

source: Lengpa thu umna-a chun thahatna aumin; chule amahenga nangman ipi nabol ham tia seithei dinga koiham?
target: Since a king’s word is supreme, who can say to him, “What are you doing?”

source: Koi hileh ama thupeh nitchan chun thilse atolouding ahi; Chule michingpa lungthim chun phat le thu tanlhahna adatkhen theije.
target: Whoever obeys his command will come to no harm, and the wise heart will know the proper time and procedure.

source: Thil kigong jouse-a dingin phat le thutanlhahna aumcheh-in, hijeh chun mihem hamsetna hi amachunga lentah in aumjingin ahi.
target: For there is a proper time and procedure for every matter, though a person may be weighed down by misery.

source: Ijeh inem itile aman ipi ahung soding ahepoi; ajehchu itih phatna ahungso ding koijin ama aseipeh theidem?
target: Since no one knows the future, who can tell someone else what is to come?

source: Lhagao henden na dinga lhagao chunga tha neija mihem koimacha aumpon; thi nikhon jong aman thaneina aneideh poi. Chule hiche gal kisat sunga jong chun ontholna aumpon; khangit louna-in jong chuche-a kipelut hochu ahuhdoh louding ahi.
target: As no one has power over the wind to contain it, so no one has power over the time of their death. As no one is discharged in time of war, so wickedness will not release those who practice it.

source: Hicheho jousehi keiman kamutan, chule nisa noija thil kibol jouse gelnan kalungsung kamangchan; mikhatnin ama le ama kisuh khahna dinga midang khat chunga thunei phat khat aumjin ahi.
target: All this I saw, as I applied my mind to everything done under the sun. There is a time when a man lords it over others to his own hurt.

source: Hitichun keiman migilou akivui kamun, amaho chu munthenga kona hunglut uva potdoh-u ahin, chule amaho chu chutobang abolnao khopi sunga chun suhmilin aumun ahi. Hiche jonghi pannabei ahi.
target: Then too, I saw the wicked buried—those who used to come and go from the holy place and receive praise in the city where they did this. This too is meaningless.

source: Natoh phalou chunga thu kitanlha chu gangtah-a tohdoh-a aumloujeh-in, mihem chapate lungsung chu thilse boldingin kigojou depmin aumjin ahi.
target: When the sentence for a crime is not quickly carried out, people’s hearts are filled with schemes to do wrong.

source: Michonse khatnin thilphalou jakhat veijen bolhen lang, chule ahin nikho kisaosah jongleh, Pathen ginga, ama anga gingkhen cha umho vang chun phatna amutei dingu ahi ti keiman kahei.
target: Although a wicked person who commits a hundred crimes may live a long time, I know that it will go better with those who fear God, who are reverent before him.

source: Ahinla migilou dinga vang phalou helding ahi; ajehchu aman Pathen anga kichatna aneilou jeh-a, nilim tobang ahin nikhoho chu sao louding ahi.
target: Yet because the wicked do not fear God, it will not go well with them, and their days will not lengthen like a shadow.
