source: Leiset chunga pannabei ja kitongdoh thil aume; hichu mihem khat chu midih tah ahivanga, migiloute chunga thilsoh tobang achunga soh umin; chukitle, migilou tah ahivanga, michonpha te chunga thilsoh tobanga achunga soh aumin ahi. Hiche jonghi keiman pannabei ahije kati.
target: There is something else meaningless that occurs on earth: the righteous who get what the wicked deserve, and the wicked who get what the righteous deserve. This too, I say, is meaningless.

source: Chujouvin mihemin aneh-a, adona, chule nomtah-a aum sanga phajo nisa noija aneilou jeh-in, keiman nopsahna kalheng jotai. Ijeh inem itile Pathen'in nisa noija apeh ahinkho lhumkeija, hiche hi atoh gimna-a umjing ding ahi.
target: So I commend the enjoyment of life, because there is nothing better for a person under the sun than to eat and drink and be glad. Then joy will accompany them in their toil all the days of the life God has given them under the sun.

source: Keiman chihna hetna dingle, leiset chunga kin kitongdohho mun'a dinga kalungthim kimanchah phatnin; (ajehchu sun hile jan hijongle amitsing lou aume);
target: When I applied my mind to know wisdom and to observe the labor that is done on earth—people getting no sleep day or night—

source: Keiman mihem khatnin nisa noija na kitonga kona amudoh joulou, Pathen natoh jouse chu kamun ahi. Ajehchu mihemin tonggim tah-in holdoh ding go jongle, amudoh louding ahin, chukal valin; miching khatnin het dingin ngaito jongle, aman amudoh joulouhel ding ahi.
target: then I saw all that God has done. No one can comprehend what goes on under the sun. Despite all their efforts to search it out, no one can discover its meaning. Even if the wise claim they know, they cannot really comprehend it.

source: Ajehchu hitiho jouse hi gah phondoh jeng dingin keiman kalungin kagelin, michonpha te le michingho chule anatoh houchu Pathen khutna um ahin; mihem koimachan amaho angsunga thil umho jouse jal-in kingailutna hile kihotna hile ahedoh thei pouvin ahi.
target: So I reflected on all this and concluded that the righteous and the wise and what they do are in God’s hands, but no one knows whether love or hate awaits them.

source: Thil jouse kibangin mijouse henga alhung cheh-e: michonpha le migilou chunga; apha chung le atheng chung chule athenglou chunga; ganlhai bolpa le ganlhai bol loupa chunga thilkhat alhung khom cheh-in ahi: michonse pa jong miphapa tobang ahin; chule akihahselpa jong kihahsel kichapa tobang ahi.
target: All share a common destiny—the righteous and the wicked, the good and the bad, the clean and the unclean, those who offer sacrifices and those who do not. As it is with the good, so with the sinful; as it is with those who take oaths, so with those who are afraid to take them.

source: Nisa noija kitongdoh jouse lah-a hin ase khat aumin, mijouse henga thilsoh khat aumin ahi: Tahbeh-in mihem chapate lungsunghi setna-in adimsetnin, chule ahinlai jengun jong alungsung uva lung chatvaina aumin, chujouteng amaho athiho henga acheji taove.
target: This is the evil in everything that happens under the sun: The same destiny overtakes all. The hearts of people, moreover, are full of evil and there is madness in their hearts while they live, and afterward they join the dead.

source: Ahinla mihingho jousetoh kijopmat pa dingin kinepna aume; ajehchu uicha hingchu keipi bahkai athisa sangin aphachom jon ahi.
target: Anyone who is among the living has hope—even a live dog is better off than a dead lion!

source: Ijeh inem itile ahingho chun athidingu akihetnuve; ahinla athihon vang imacha akihet pouvin, amahon tohman jong anei tapouve. Ajehchu amaho suhmila um ahi taove.
target: For the living know that they will die, but the dead know nothing; they have no further reward, and even their name is forgotten.

source: Chujongle tu-a hi amaho mingailutna, mihotna, chule mi mitthipna chu manga ahitan; Nisa noija kitongdoh thil ipi hileh, amahon a-imatih chana dinga chan anei louvu ahitai.
target: Their love, their hate and their jealousy have long since vanished; never again will they have a part in anything that happens under the sun.

source: Chen, kipah thanomin na an kineh inlang, chule lungnom selin nalengpi twi kidonin; ajehchu tun Pathen'in nanatoh ho asangtai.
target: Go, eat your food with gladness, and drink your wine with a joyful heart, for God has already approved what you do.

source: Naponsil ho chu bangleh jing jenghen; chule nalujanga jong thao lhasam hihhel hen.
target: Always be clothed in white, and always anoint your head with oil.

source: Pathen'in nisa noija napeh, pannabei nahinkho lhungkeijin, nangailu tah na-inneipi toh kipah thanomin chengkhom lhonin; ajehchu hichehi nahinkho sunga nisa noija nanatoh gimna-a nachan chu ahi.
target: Enjoy life with your wife, whom you love, all the days of this meaningless life that God has given you under the sun—all your meaningless days. For this is your lot in life and in your toilsome labor under the sun.

source: Ipi hijeng jongle nakhutnin tohdinga amaiphah chan chu, natha jesal teh-in tongin; ajehchu nangman najot jing lhankhuh asunga chun, tohding jong, tohgon jong, hetna jong, chihna jong aumtapoi.
target: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with all your might, for in the realm of the dead, where you are going, there is neither working nor planning nor knowledge nor wisdom.

source: Keima kahung kile kitnin, nisa noija kamudoh tai: kilhaitet jong alhai ajangkhaipa-a ahipon, gal kisat jong ahatpa-a ahipon, changlhah jong michang pa-a ahipon, haona jong hetthemna neipa-a ahipon, khohsahna jong khut thempa-a ahipoi; Ahinla abonchauva dinga phat le phatpha kitoh khaji ahibouve.
target: I have seen something else under the sun: The race is not to the swift or the battle to the strong, nor does food come to the wise or wealth to the brilliant or favor to the learned; but time and chance happen to them all.

source: Ajehchu mihemin ama phat akihet theipoi: thina thei lenthang giloutah sunga ngaho akimat bangle, vachaho thangkol sunga oh bangin; hicheho chu photlot louva achunguva achuhteng, mihem chapate chu phat phalouva a-ohji taove.
target: Moreover, no one knows when their hour will come: As fish are caught in a cruel net, or birds are taken in a snare, so people are trapped by evil times that fall unexpectedly upon them.

source: Hiche chihna jonghi keiman nisa noija kamu ahitan, hichehi keidin sangtah abange.
target: I also saw under the sun this example of wisdom that greatly impressed me:

source: Khopi neocha khat ana umin, chule asunga jong mi lhomcha anachenge; chuin leng lentah khat hiche khopi dou dingchun ahungin, aumkim veltan, chule pal nasatah tampi atungdoh tai.
target: There was once a small city with only a few people in it. And a powerful king came against it, surrounded it and built huge siege works against it.

source: Tun hiche khopi sunga chun mivaicha miching khat anaumin, amapan achihna jal-in hiche khopi chu ahuhdohtan ahi. Achuti jeng vangin koimachan chuche mivaichapa chu geldoh-in aneipoi.
target: Now there lived in that city a man poor but wise, and he saved the city by his wisdom. But nobody remembered that poor man.

source: Hichun keiman kanaseije, chihna hi thahat sangin aphajoi; ahijeng vanginla mivaichapa chihna chu i-sah louvin anaumin, chule athuseiho jong ngaipeh louvin aume.
target: So I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” But the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are no longer heeded.

source: Mingol ho lah-a vaihompa khosap awgin sangin, michingho thusei chu thipbeh chan akingaipeh jon ahi.
target: The quiet words of the wise are more to be heeded than the shouts of a ruler of fools.

source: Chihna hi galmanchah tampi sangin aphachomjoi; ahinla michonse khatnin thilpha tampi asusen ahi.
target: Wisdom is better than weapons of war, but one sinner destroys much good.

source: Thousi thisahon thao namtui sempa thaonam a-uisah-in, chutobang chun ngolna themkhat-in achihna le aja umna jeh-a kijabolpa chu asuminsen ahi.
target: As dead flies give perfume a bad smell, so a little folly outweighs wisdom and honor.

source: Miching lungthim chu akhut jetna aumin, ahinla mingol lungthim chu aveilama aume.
target: The heart of the wise inclines to the right, but the heart of the fool to the left.

source: Mingol chu alampia akalsonteng jongle, achihna chun alosam sah-in; chule mijouse henga mingol kahi tin aseilen ahi.
target: Even as fools walk along the road, they lack sense and show everyone how stupid they are.

source: Vaihompa lungthim chu nangma douna-a ahung kipatdohle, nangman naum namun dalha hih-in, ajehchu kipehlutna hin suhkhelna lentah asemphan ahi.
target: If a ruler’s anger rises against you, do not leave your post; calmness can lay great offenses to rest.

source: Vaihompa-a kona suhkhel hungdoh banga, keiman nisa noija thilse kamudoh aume:
target: There is an evil I have seen under the sun, the sort of error that arises from a ruler:

source: Ngolchon nahi jatah-in akikoi sangin; chule mihao chu mun nema atouvin ahi.
target: Fools are put in many high positions, while the rich occupy the low ones.

source: Sakol ho chunga soh ho atouva, chule pipuiho tolla soh ho banga avaleu kamun ahi.
target: I have seen slaves on horseback, while princes go on foot like slaves.

source: Koi hile khuh laija chu, akokhuh laija ama lhalut ding; chule koi hile tho kikai tumsepa chu, gul'in achuhding ahi.
target: Whoever digs a pit may fall into it; whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.

source: Koihile songho ladoh-a chu, chua chu kisukha ding; chule koihile thing chenna chu, chua chu kisukha ding ahi.
target: Whoever quarries stones may be injured by them; whoever splits logs may be endangered by them.

source: Heicha chu amola, amangcha pa chun aha chu akinol hem loule, atha ahaje ding ahi; ahinla chihna hi lamhil dinga phatah ahi.
target: If the ax is dull and its edge unsharpened, more strength is needed, but skill will bring success.

source: Tahbeh-a gul'in lhimlouva achuh pai bangin, kamtam jonghi aphat chomna aumpoi.
target: If a snake bites before it is charmed, the charmer receives no fee.

source: Miching kamsoh thuchengho chu lungsetna ahin, hinla mingol kamsoh vang chun amatah aval lhum ding ahi;
target: Words from the mouth of the wise are gracious, but fools are consumed by their own lips.

source: Akamsoh thubul hochu ngolna ngen ahin, ahoulim kichaina chu lung bulhinglou setna ngol thubuh ahi.
target: At the beginning their words are folly; at the end they are wicked madness—

source: Mingol jong chu thua dim ahi; mihemin ipi ahunglhun ding asei theipon, chule ama nunga ipi ahunglhung ding kon aseipeh theijem?
target: and fools multiply words. No one knows what is coming— who can tell someone else what will happen after them?

source: Mingol tohgimna chun amaho jouse asulung jing game; ajehchu aman khopisung jona iti che dingham ti ahepoi.
target: The toil of fools wearies them; they do not know the way to town.

source: Vo gamsung, nalengpa chapang neocha ahia, chule napipui hon jingkah-a nehkhom na aneijule, ohe ada nahi!
target: Woe to the land whose king was a servant and whose princes feast in the morning.

source: Vo gamsung, nalengpa chu milunlaiho chapa ahi-a, chule napipui hon khamna ding hilouva, thaneina dingjoh-a, aphatcha nehkhom na aneijule, anunnoma nahi!
target: Blessed is the land whose king is of noble birth and whose princes eat at a proper time— for strength and not for drunkenness.

source: Thaset behset jeh-in in angot lhajin, chule khut thaset vangin in alhujin ahi.
target: Through laziness, the rafters sag; because of idle hands, the house leaks.

source: Golvah hi nuina dinga kibol ahin, chule ju hin mi akipa sah-in ahi; ahinla sumin thiljouse ahisah theijin ahi.
target: A feast is made for laughter, wine makes life merry, and money is the answer for everything.

source: Nalungthim jengin jong lengpa chu samse hih in; chule nalupna dansunga jong mihao samse hih-in: ajehchu chungleng vachan na aw po khan tin, chule lhaving neikhatnin athu galhut khante.
target: Do not revile the king even in your thoughts, or curse the rich in your bedroom, because a bird in the sky may carry your words, and a bird on the wing may report what you say.

source: Nachanglhah twi chunga seplhan; ijeh inem itile nikho tamtah jouteng namu kitding ahi.
target: Ship your grain across the sea; after many days you may receive a return.

source: Mi sagi henga, chule get henga jong chanvou pe-in; ajehchu nangman leiset chunga itobang thilse ahunglhun ding nahe poi.
target: Invest in seven ventures, yes, in eight; you do not know what disaster may come upon the land.

source: Meilomho go adimset tengle, amaho le amaho leiset chunga ahung kilhei-ong jiuve; chule thingphung chu lhanglam ngan, ahiloule sahlam ngan lhutaleh, alhuhna mun laitah-a chu, kijamden jengding ahi.
target: If clouds are full of water, they pour rain on the earth. Whether a tree falls to the south or to the north, in the place where it falls, there it will lie.

source: Huinun vejing pa chun muchi atulouding, chule meilomho khohsah jing pa chun chang a-at louding ahi.
target: Whoever watches the wind will not plant; whoever looks at the clouds will not reap.

source: Nangman hui chena lampi nahetlou bangle, numei naovop sunga aguho iti khanlet ham nahetlou bangin; ijakai sema Pathen natoh ho jong nahepon ahi.
target: As you do not know the path of the wind, or how the body is formed in a mother’s womb, so you cannot understand the work of God, the Maker of all things.

source: Jingkah lamle namuchi kitun, chule nilhah lam jongle nakhut umthimsah hih-in; ajehchu hichepa ham, khuchipa ham, hoichepen chu hung phatou dingham, ahiloule ania kibanga phading ham ti nangman nahepoi.
target: Sow your seed in the morning, and at evening let your hands not be idle, for you do not know which will succeed, whether this or that, or whether both will do equally well.

source: Tahbeh-in vahhi anomin, chule mit dingin nisa vet hi anomta ngeije.
target: Light is sweet, and it pleases the eyes to see the sun.

source: Hijongle mihem chu kum tampi ahina, hicheho jouse-a chu akipa le; muthim nikhoho chu kigeldoh hen, ajehchu hicheho chu tamtah hiding ahi. Ahunglhung jouse chu pannabei ahi.
target: However many years anyone may live, let them enjoy them all. But let them remember the days of darkness, for there will be many. Everything to come is meaningless.

source: Vo gollhang, nakhangdon na-a kipah-in; chule nakhangdon lai nikhon nalung thimin nakipasah jinghen, nalungin adeilam le namitnin amu nomna lam chu juijin; amavang thil hichengse jeh-a hi Pathen'in thupi tanna-a napuilut ding ahi, tihi nangman kihet nin.
target: You who are young, be happy while you are young, and let your heart give you joy in the days of your youth. Follow the ways of your heart and whatever your eyes see, but know that for all these things God will bring you into judgment.

source: Hijeh chun nalungthima konin hesohna koidoh in, chule natahsa-a konin aphalou koimangin; ajehchu chapanlai le khangdonlai hi pannabei ahi.
target: So then, banish anxiety from your heart and cast off the troubles of your body, for youth and vigor are meaningless.

source: Nikho phalouho hunglhun masang, hicheho-a hin thanopna himhim kaneipoi, tia nasei nading kum phalouho ahung nai masangin; tu nakhangdon lai nikho sunghin nasempa geldoh-in.
target: Remember your Creator in the days of your youth, before the days of trouble come and the years approach when you will say, “I find no pleasure in them”—

source: Nisa ahin, vah ahin, lha ahin, ahsi ho ahin, athimsoh masang, meilom ho jong gojuh jouva akilekit masang;
target: before the sun and the light and the moon and the stars grow dark, and the clouds return after the rain;

source: In ngahho kithing thinga ahung um nitengule, mihat ho amaho chama ahung kunlhah diu, sumhei hehhon alhom behseh jeh uva atoh-u angahdiu, chule bangkotna kona khodahho thimdela umdingu,
target: when the keepers of the house tremble, and the strong men stoop, when the grinders cease because they are few, and those looking through the windows grow dim;

source: Chule khopi lamlena kot ho kha-a hung umding, sumhei kiheh gin anemsuh teng, chule mihem khat chu vacha husa-a hung thoudoh ding, chule lathem chanuho jouse suhnema hung umdingu ahi;
target: when the doors to the street are closed and the sound of grinding fades; when people rise up at the sound of birds, but all their songs grow faint;

source: Chujongle amahon munsang akichat tengule, kichatna lamtina hung umding, almond thing hung pahdoh ding, khao khopi chu pohgih hung hiding, chule ngaichat hungbei ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile mihemin atonsot in chu ajot ahin, chule lunghemho chu lamlhah ho-a acheleuvin ahi.
target: when people are afraid of heights and of dangers in the streets; when the almond tree blossoms and the grasshopper drags itself along and desire no longer is stirred. Then people go to their eternal home and mourners go about the streets.

source: Ahiloule dangka khao ahung kilhap, ahiloule sana lheng ahung kisuhkeh masang, twinah phunga bel ahung kisukeh, ahiloule twikhuh phunga twikhai dohna kang ahungbal masangin, nasempa geldoh-in.
target: Remember him—before the silver cord is severed, and the golden bowl is broken; before the pitcher is shattered at the spring, and the wheel broken at the well,

source: Chuteng leivui chu ahina ngai leisetna kile kitding; chule lhagao chu apepa Pathen henga kilekit ding ahi.
target: and the dust returns to the ground it came from, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.

source: Pannabei ho pannabei, ijakai pannabei ahije, tin thuhilpan aseije.
target: “Meaningless! Meaningless!” says the Teacher. “Everything is meaningless!”

source: Chule achungchonin, thuhilpa chu miching ahi jeh-in, miho chu hetna anahil nalaijin; henge, aman phatah-in alungin angaiton, aholdoh-in, chule thuchih tamtah asutoh-in ahi.
target: Not only was the Teacher wise, but he also imparted knowledge to the people. He pondered and searched out and set in order many proverbs.

source: Thuhilpan, santhei thuho, chondihna thu kisunho, thutah ho jengjong anaholdoh-in ahi.
target: The Teacher searched to find just the right words, and what he wrote was upright and true.

source: Miching thusei ho chu thihtul monghem tobang ahin; kelngoi chingpa khatnin apehdoh-a, khoppi lamkaihon akhet detnu thingkil tobang ahi.
target: The words of the wise are like goads, their collected sayings like firmly embedded nails—given by one shepherd.

source: Chujongle, kachapa, hicheho-a hin kitil khouvin; lekha tamtah semsem jong achaina aumpon, chule lekha hasim behset jonghi tahsa cholna ahi.
target: Be warned, my son, of anything in addition to them. Of making many books there is no end, and much study wearies the body.

source: Eihon athu pumpi khumkhana chu ngaiju hite: Pathen gingin, chule athupeh chengse nitsoh keijin; ajehchu hichehi mihem tohding pumpi chu ahi.
target: Now all has been heard; here is the conclusion of the matter: Fear God and keep his commandments, for this is the duty of all mankind.

source: Ajehchu Pathen'in nakitong jouse chu, thil kiselguh jouse toh, apha hihen ase hijongle, thupi tana-a ahin pohlut ding ahi.
target: For God will bring every deed into judgment, including every hidden thing, whether it is good or evil.

source: Laho lah-a la, hichehi Solomon la ahi.
target: Solomon’s Song of Songs.

source: Aman ami chopna akama chun eihinchop hen, ajehchu nangailutna chu lengpitwi sangin atuijon ahi.
target: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth— for your love is more delightful than wine.

source: Nangma thaotwi phatah ho namtui jeh-in, na min chu thaotwi hung longdoh abangin; hiche jehchun nungah thenghon nangma nangailu uve.
target: Pleasing is the fragrance of your perfumes; your name is like perfume poured out. No wonder the young women love you!

source: Neikai jin, keihon nanunga hung lhaijunge; lengpan keima a-indan sung eilhuttai. Keiho nangma-a kakipaova kathanop diu ahin, chule neingailut nao chu lengpitwi sanga kageldoh jingdiu ahi, lungdih tah-in nangma nangailu uvin ahi.
target: Take me away with you—let us hurry! Let the king bring me into his chambers. We rejoice and delight in you; we will praise your love more than wine. How right they are to adore you!

source: Keima kavome, ahinla vo nangho Jerusalem chanute, keima Cedar ponbuh ho le Solomon pondal hobangin kamellome.
target: Dark am I, yet lovely, daughters of Jerusalem, dark like the tents of Kedar, like the tent curtains of Solomon.

source: Kavom jehle, nisan eisah jeh-in, neive hih-un; kanu chapateho alung hangun; lengpilei ho eingah sah-un; ahinla keima tah-in lengpilei kangahpoi.
target: Do not stare at me because I am dark, because I am darkened by the sun. My mother’s sons were angry with me and made me take care of the vineyards; my own vineyard I had to neglect.

source: Vo kalhangai, nangman nakelngoi hon hoilaija navah-a, sun teng hoija nagakol sah jiham, neisei peh-in; ipijeh-a nagol ho kelngoihon lah-a mikhat vahlele banga kaum dingham?
target: Tell me, you whom I love, where you graze your flock and where you rest your sheep at midday. Why should I be like a veiled woman beside the flocks of your friends?

source: Vo numei ho lahlah a melhoipennu, nangman nahetlouva ahile, nakelngoihonho cheche nalama chenlang, chule kelngoi chingpa ponbuho komdunga chun nakelngoi nouho chu vah-in.
target: If you do not know, most beautiful of women, follow the tracks of the sheep and graze your young goats by the tents of the shepherds.

source: Vo kangainu, keiman Pharaoh kangtalai kai sakol honkhat toh nangma kahin tekah-e.
target: I liken you, my darling, to a mare among Pharaoh’s chariot horses.

source: Nabeng teni-a kijepna kigolho chu nakilompin, nangonga sana khivuiho chun namel lomsah-e.
target: Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings, your neck with strings of jewels.

source: Keihon sana-a kijepna kasem pehdiu, chule akilmatnaho dangka-a kasem dingu ahi.
target: We will make you earrings of gold, studded with silver.

source: Lengpa adokhanga atou chun, kathao namtui namchu ahung potdoh-in ahi.
target: While the king was at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.

source: Kangaitah chu keija din myrrh lomkhat ahin, jankhovah-a kanoi teni kah-a lumding ahi.
target: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh resting between my breasts.

source: Kangai chu keijadin Engadi lengpilei honsunga ponlou thingphung abilla kehto bang ahi.
target: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi.

source: Kangainu, ven, namel ahoije, ven, namel ahoije, namit teni vakhu mit abange.
target: How beautiful you are, my darling! Oh, how beautiful! Your eyes are doves.

source: Kangaipa, ven, namel ahoije; henge, dei-umtah nahi! ijalkhun jong a-eng selin ahi.
target: How handsome you are, my beloved! Oh, how charming! And our bed is verdant.

source: I-inkam jouse cedar thingjeng ahin, chule i-insung jouse jong chahthing jeng ahi.
target: The beams of our house are cedars; our rafters are firs.

source: Keima Sharon pah le, phaicham ho-a lily pah chu kahi.
target: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.

source: ling le khaoho lah-a Lily pah bangin, chutobang chun kangainu chu nungah ho lah-a aume.
target: Like a lily among thorns is my darling among the young women.

source: Theithup thing gammang thinglah-a aumbangin, chutobang chun kangaipa chu golhangho lah-a aume. Keima alimnoija chun kipah tah-in katouvin, chule aga chu kateple alhum keijin ahi.
target: Like an apple tree among the trees of the forest is my beloved among the young men. I delight to sit in his shade, and his fruit is sweet to my taste.

source: Amapan keima nehkhom na ina eipuilutnin, chule kachunga apondal chu ngailutna ahi.
target: Let him lead me to the banquet hall, and let his banner over me be love.

source: Lengpitwi jin neilhon lang, theithup changhon neilung monin, ajehchu ngailut natna-a na-a kahitai.
target: Strengthen me with raisins, refresh me with apples, for I am faint with love.

source: Akhut veilam kalu noija aumin, chule akhut jetlama chun eikoije.
target: His left arm is under my head, and his right arm embraces me.

source: Vo nangho Jerusalem chanute, loulaija sakhigol anuho le achalho panna kathupeh nahiuve, ngailutna hi ama chamtah-a ahung um tilouvin, nanghon suhthou tho dingle suhkhah thoding gohih-un.
target: Daughters of Jerusalem, I charge you by the gazelles and by the does of the field: Do not arouse or awaken love until it so desires.

source: Kangaipa aw kajai! Veovin, ama molsang ho chunga kichom pumle, lhangho chopkhup pumin kaheng lama ahunge.
target: Listen! My beloved! Look! Here he comes, leaping across the mountains, bounding over the hills.

source: Kangaipa chu sakhigol ahiloule sakhinou tobang ahi; ven, ama kabang tomuva adinge, bangkot ho-a konin aven, bang vangkah-a konin ahung khodah-e.
target: My beloved is like a gazelle or a young stag. Look! There he stands behind our wall, gazing through the windows, peering through the lattice.

source: Kangaipa chun thu ahin seijin, chule keima henga: hungthouvin, kangainu, keija dia melhoinu, hungpot dohtan.
target: My beloved spoke and said to me, “Arise, my darling, my beautiful one, come with me.

source: Ajehchu vetemin, phalbi akichaitan, gojuh phat akichaijin chule kho aphatan ahi.
target: See! The winter is past; the rains are over and gone.

source: Leiset chunga pahchaho ahung kilang doh-in, lasah phat ahung lhung tan, chule igam sunguva vahui ham gin akijatai.
target: Flowers appear on the earth; the season of singing has come, the cooing of doves is heard in our land.

source: Theichang phung jong ahung gadohtan, chule lengpiguiho jong aga dongset toh agim namtuitah ahin pedoh tai. Thouvin kangainu, keidia melhoinu, hungpotdoh jengtan.
target: The fig tree forms its early fruit; the blossoming vines spread their fragrance. Arise, come, my darling; my beautiful one, come with me.”

source: Vo ka vakhu, songpi khikehkah le, songkol kalbi kidona mungil laiho-a chengnu, namaiso neimu sah inlang, na aw neijah sah temin, ajehchu na aw angeijin, chule namaiso jong amel lomin ahi, ati.
target: My dove in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding places on the mountainside, show me your face, let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet, and your face is lovely.

source: Lengpilei suse-a sial ho, chule sial nouho neimatpeh un, ajehchu kalengpigui gahou adongset nalaijin ahi.
target: Catch for us the foxes, the little foxes that ruin the vineyards, our vineyards that are in bloom.

source: Kangaipa chu keija ahin, chule kei ama-a kahi. Aman Lily pahho lah-a akelngoi hon avah-in ahi.
target: My beloved is mine and I am his; he browses among the lilies.

source: Kho ahung vah-a, chule le-limho akitolmang kahsen, hung kiheijin, kangaipa, Bether mol chunga lhale sakhi chalgol, ahiloule sakhinou bangin hung umin.
target: Until the day breaks and the shadows flee, turn, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or like a young stag on the rugged hills.

source: Janle kajalkhun chunga keiman kalhangaipa chu kaholjin; ama kahol lelen, ahinla kamu joupon ahi.
target: All night long on my bed I looked for the one my heart loves; I looked for him but did not find him.

source: Keima, tun thouving ting, khopi sunga vahleng ting, kholai dung le lamlen ho-a kalhangaipa gaholinge, katin; ama kahol lelen, ahinla kamu joupon ahi.
target: I will get up now and go about the city, through its streets and squares; I will search for the one my heart loves. So I looked for him but did not find him.

source: Khopi vil le-a khongah ho chun eimuvin, keiman ahenguva, keiman kalhangaipa nanamu uvem? tin kadongin ahi.
target: The watchmen found me as they made their rounds in the city. “Have you seen the one my heart loves?”

source: Amaho themcha khatbou kagahkhel panbep nalaijin, keiman kalhangaipa chu kakimudoh paitai: keiman amapa chu eihinga kanu in, eina vopna indan sung kalhut kahsen katuh detnin kalhakang pon ahi.
target: Scarcely had I passed them when I found the one my heart loves. I held him and would not let him go till I had brought him to my mother’s house, to the room of the one who conceived me.

source: Vo nangho Jerusalem chanute, loulaija sakhigol anuho le achalho panna kathupeh nahiuve, ngailutna hi ama chamtah-a ahung um tilouvin, nanghon suhthou tho dingle suhkhah thoding gohih-un.
target: Daughters of Jerusalem, I charge you by the gazelles and by the does of the field: Do not arouse or awaken love until it so desires.

source: Meikhu khompi banga, myrrh le thao namtui gim namsela, sumkolvei pa thao namtui jouse pumma gamthipma kon hungdoh-a khu koiham?
target: Who is this coming up from the wilderness like a column of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and incense made from all the spices of the merchant?

source: Veuvin, Solomon talai ahi; chuche kimvella chun pasal hangsan cheh somgup aumuvin, Israel lah-a ahangsan cheh ahiuve.
target: Look! It is Solomon’s carriage, escorted by sixty warriors, the noblest of Israel,

source: Galsat themsa cheh ahijeh-un, abonchauvin chemjam akichoijun; Jan kichat tijatna jeh-in, amijousen achemjamu ataijuva akiko cheh-un ahi.
target: all of them wearing the sword, all experienced in battle, each with his sword at his side, prepared for the terrors of the night.

source: Solomon lengpan Lebanon thingin, talai khat akisemin ahi.
target: King Solomon made for himself the carriage; he made it of wood from Lebanon.

source: Aman akhom jouse dangka-in, alhong sana-in, chule achung khuse chu ponsandup min asemin, alailung chu Jerusalem chanuten dei umtah-in asemun ahi.
target: Its posts he made of silver, its base of gold. Its seat was upholstered with purple, its interior inlaid with love. Daughters of Jerusalem,

source: Vo nangho Zion chanute, potdoh unlang, ajinei nikho, alungsung kipa nikho-a anun lallukhuh akhuhpeh kikhuh-ah Solomon lengpa khu gaveovin.
target: come out, and look, you daughters of Zion. Look on King Solomon wearing a crown, the crown with which his mother crowned him on the day of his wedding, the day his heart rejoiced.

source: Ven, kangainu, namel ahoije! ven, nahoilheh jenge, namai khuna pon kah-a namit teni vakhu mit abangin, nasam jong Gilead molsanga kona hungkumlha kel hon abange.
target: How beautiful you are, my darling! Oh, how beautiful! Your eyes behind your veil are doves. Your hair is like a flock of goats descending from the hills of Gilead.

source: Nahaho chu kelngoipi hon amul akivojoutil akisil joutil uva ahungpot doh-u toh abangun; amaho asohkop cheh ahiuvin, alah uva nouneilou khatcha aumpoi.
target: Your teeth are like a flock of sheep just shorn, coming up from the washing. Each has its twin; not one of them is alone.

source: Nane teni jong patsan abangin, nakam jong ahoilheh jengin; nadeh pang jong nasamlom lah-a kolbuthei uma abangin ahi.
target: Your lips are like a scarlet ribbon; your mouth is lovely. Your temples behind your veil are like the halves of a pomegranate.

source: Na-ngong jong mihat ho lumdal sangkhat kikhaina, David'in galvon koinadinga asah insang abangin ahi.
target: Your neck is like the tower of David, built with courses of stone; on it hang a thousand shields, all of them shields of warriors.

source: Na noi teni jong sakhinou ni pengkop, lily pah lah-a lhale abange.
target: Your breasts are like two fawns, like twin fawns of a gazelle that browse among the lilies.

source: Kho ahungvah-a nilimho akitolmang kahsen, keima myrrh molsang lama chule bego molsanga gaum ingkate.
target: Until the day breaks and the shadows flee, I will go to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of incense.

source: Namel akilome, kangainu, natichung-ah nolnading ima aumpoi.
target: You are altogether beautiful, my darling; there is no flaw in you.

source: Labanon'a konin chekhom hite, kajiholnu, Lebanon'a konin kilhon hite; Amana lhangvuma konin, Shenir le Hermon lhangvuma konin, keipi bahkaiho kul-a konin, chule lutnu molsang ho-a konin vetemin.
target: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, come with me from Lebanon. Descend from the crest of Amana, from the top of Senir, the summit of Hermon, from the lions’ dens and the mountain haunts of leopards.

source: Kasopinu, kajiholnu, nangman kalungsung nalajoutai; nangman namitna khatvei neihinvet le, na ngonga khivui khatna konin kalungsung nalajoutan ahi.
target: You have stolen my heart, my sister, my bride; you have stolen my heart with one glance of your eyes, with one jewel of your necklace.

source: Kasopinu, kajiholnu, nei ngailutna hi iti noptam! na ngailutna hi lengpitwi sanga iti phatjoh hitam! Nathao kinujol jong gimnamtui jouse sanga iti namtui joh-a hitam!
target: How delightful is your love, my sister, my bride! How much more pleasing is your love than wine, and the fragrance of your perfume more than any spice!

source: Vo kajiholnu, nane teni, khoiphanga kon khoiju tobangin ahung valhan; khoijule bongnoi naleigui noija aume; chule naponsil ho namtui dan Lebanon gimnamtui abang jengin ahi.
target: Your lips drop sweetness as the honeycomb, my bride; milk and honey are under your tongue. The fragrance of your garments is like the fragrance of Lebanon.

source: Kasopinu, kajiholnu chu hon kiget khum ahin; twisam kiting, twinah kihuh ahi.
target: You are a garden locked up, my sister, my bride; you are a spring enclosed, a sealed fountain.

source: Na thingphung ho jong kolbuthei hon, aga hoitah-a ga, ponlou namtui thing le thao namtui thing,
target: Your plants are an orchard of pomegranates with choice fruits, with henna and nard,

source: Thao namtui le thing namtui, Aigeju le thingthal, begothing jouse toh; myrrh le aloe, chule anamtui penhotoh,
target: nard and saffron, calamus and cinnamon, with every kind of incense tree, with myrrh and aloes and all the finest spices.

source: Twiputna honleiho, hintwi twikhuh, chule Lebanon'a hungkona luidungho abang jengin ahi.
target: You are a garden fountain, a well of flowing water streaming down from Lebanon.

source: Vo sahlam hui, khangin, chule lhanglam hui, hungin; kahon sunghi gimnam tuihon alosohna dingin hung nungin. Kangaipa chu ahon sunga hunglut henlang, atheiga hoitahtah hohi hung nehen.
target: Awake, north wind, and come, south wind! Blow on my garden, that its fragrance may spread everywhere. Let my beloved come into his garden and taste its choice fruits.

source: Kasopinu, kajiholnu, keima kahonsunga kahunglut tan; ka myrrh le ka gimnamtui kakikhol khomtan; kakhoibal le kakhoiju kanetan; kalengpitwi le kabongnoi kadontai. Neovin, vo loile golte; donun, nengtah-in donun, vo kangailut teho.
target: I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride; I have gathered my myrrh with my spice. I have eaten my honeycomb and my honey; I have drunk my wine and my milk. Eat, friends, and drink; drink your fill of love.

source: Keima kalumin, ahin kalungthim akhangjinge; kangailutpa aw kajai, aman kot akiuvin, kot neihonin, kasopinu, kangailutnu, ka vakhu, keija dia chamkimnu; ajehchu kaluchang daitwijin atomin, kajang sam kisom jong jandaitwi lha-in adimtai.
target: I slept but my heart was awake. Listen! My beloved is knocking: “Open to me, my sister, my darling, my dove, my flawless one. My head is drenched with dew, my hair with the dampness of the night.”

source: Kasangkhol chol kasutlha tai; iti kaki-ah ding hitam? Kakeng kakisop joutai; iti kasuhbohkit ding ham?
target: I have taken off my robe— must I put it on again? I have washed my feet— must I soil them again?

source: Kangaipan kot-hom kah-a akhut ahin lhunglut nin, ama gelnan kalungsung akihot jengin ahi.
target: My beloved thrust his hand through the latch-opening; my heart began to pound for him.

source: Kangaipa kot honpeh dinga kathodoh leh, kakhutna myrrh avalha-in, chule kakhutjung ho-a gimnamtui avalhan, kotkilna chunga chun achu-in ahi.
target: I arose to open for my beloved, and my hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with flowing myrrh, on the handles of the bolt.

source: Kangaipa chu kot kahonpehtan, ahinla kangaipa chu akihei mangin, anachetai. Aman thu aseichun kahinna alhasam jengin ahi. Keiman ama kahol holin, ahinla kamujou dehpoi; keiman ama kakouvin, ahinla eidonbut tapoi.
target: I opened for my beloved, but my beloved had left; he was gone. My heart sank at his departure. I looked for him but did not find him. I called him but he did not answer.

source: Khopi sunga vahle khongah hon eimudoh-un, eivouvin, eimavo taove; kulpi ngahhon kaponlukhu eilah mangpeh uvin ahi.
target: The watchmen found me as they made their rounds in the city. They beat me, they bruised me; they took away my cloak, those watchmen of the walls!

source: Vo Jerusalem chanute, keiman thu kapeh-u nahi, nanghon kangaipa namu-ule, ama ngaina-a na-a kahitai, tin neinasei peh-un.
target: Daughters of Jerusalem, I charge you— if you find my beloved, what will you tell him? Tell him I am faint with love.

source: Midangin adeipa sanga nangin nadeipa chungnungjo dehham, Vo nangma numei lah-a hoichungnung nu? Midangin adeipa sanga nangin nadeipa chungnungjo dehham, nangman chuto bangtah-a nei gahchah-u chu?
target: How is your beloved better than others, most beautiful of women? How is your beloved better than others, that you so charge us?

source: Kangaipa chu angou seh-in avouso asan heovin, sangsom lah-a achungnung penin ahi.
target: My beloved is radiant and ruddy, outstanding among ten thousand.

source: Aluchang jong sana thengset abangin; asamho jong aboh litlet nin, chule va-ah bangin avomsetnin ahi.
target: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy and black as a raven.

source: Amit teni jong vadung panga uma vakhu mit, bongnoija kisop thenga kitoh chetna kibut abangin ahi.
target: His eyes are like doves by the water streams, washed in milk, mounted like jewels.

source: Abeng teni jong gimnamtui kikholna, pahcha namtuitahho abangin; aneho jong myrrh gimnamtui tah valha le, lily pahcha abange.
target: His cheeks are like beds of spice yielding perfume. His lips are like lilies dripping with myrrh.

source: Akhutteni jong sana khutjem achunga khisong engdum abangin; atahsa jong saiha kisuitoh bangleh khisong duma kilut abange.
target: His arms are rods of gold set with topaz. His body is like polished ivory decorated with lapis lazuli.

source: Akengteni chu songval khompi bangleh sana thengset khom tunna chunga kitung abangin; Amelput chu Lebanon thing bangle cedar thing hoipentah toh abange.
target: His legs are pillars of marble set on bases of pure gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, choice as its cedars.

source: Akam jong aphata ngeijin, amachu lamjousea dei aumin ahi. Vo Jerisulem chanute, hichehi kangaipa chu ahi, hichehi kagolpa ahi.
target: His mouth is sweetness itself; he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, this is my friend, daughters of Jerusalem.

source: Nangaipa chu hoilamma chemanga hitam? Vo nang numei lah lah-a hoichungnung nu, keihon ama kaholhu theina diuvin, nangaipa hoilanga kihei manga ham?
target: Where has your beloved gone, most beautiful of women? Which way did your beloved turn, that we may look for him with you?

source: Kangaipa chu Gimnamtui umna honsunga, aganhonho vah dingle, lily pahho loukhom dingin, ahon sunga achelutnin ahi.
target: My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices, to browse in the gardens and to gather lilies.

source: Keima kangaipa-a kahi, chule kangaipa chu keija ahi; ama lily pah lah-a aganhon avah-in ahi.
target: I am my beloved’s and my beloved is mine; he browses among the lilies.

source: Vo kangai Tirzah bangin nangma nahoije, Jerusalem bangin namellomin, ponlap dom galmi honpi bangin tijat na-ume.
target: You are as beautiful as Tirzah, my darling, as lovely as Jerusalem, as majestic as troops with banners.

source: Keijakonin namit teni heidoh-in, ajehchu hiho chun eisuboije. Nasam chu Gilead'a kona hungkumlha kel hon abangin ahi.
target: Turn your eyes from me; they overwhelm me. Your hair is like a flock of goats descending from Gilead.

source: Nahaho chu kelngoipi hon amul akivojoutil akisil joutil uva ahungpot doh-u toh abangun; amaho asohkop cheh ahiuvin, alah uva nouneilou khatcha aumpoi.
target: Your teeth are like a flock of sheep coming up from the washing. Each has its twin, not one of them is missing.

source: Nadeh pang jong nasamlom lah-a kolbuthei uma abangin ahi.
target: Your temples behind your veil are like the halves of a pomegranate.

source: Lengnu somgup, thaikem somget, chule nungah theng simjoulou aume.
target: Sixty queens there may be, and eighty concubines, and virgins beyond number;

source: Kavakhu, keija dia chamkim, keija dia khatseh bou ahi; anu-a dia cha changkhat ahin, chule ahingnu deilhenpen ahi. Nungah ho, lengnu ho chule thaikem hon amanu amuvin, nunnomnu atiuvin, chule apahchao vin ahi.
target: but my dove, my perfect one, is unique, the only daughter of her mother, the favorite of the one who bore her. The young women saw her and called her blessed; the queens and concubines praised her.

source: Jingkah banga hung vahdoh-a, lhabanga hoi, nisa banga thengset, chule galmi ponlap domhon khat banga tijat umhi, koi numei ahitabep dem?
target: Who is this that appears like the dawn, fair as the moon, bright as the sun, majestic as the stars in procession?

source: Phaicham theiga ho ve dingin, lengpiguiho mumtam ve dingle, kolbuthei ho pahtam ti ve dingin, keima beleilut honsunga kachesuh-in ahi.
target: I went down to the grove of nut trees to look at the new growth in the valley, to see if the vines had budded or the pomegranates were in bloom.

source: Kahetmanlou hellin kahinna-in, Amminadib sakol kangtalai bangin eina semtan ahi.
target: Before I realized it, my desire set me among the royal chariots of my people.

source: Hungkilen, hungkilen, vo Shulam nungahnu; keihon nangma kavet theina dingun; hungkilen, hungkilen. Shulam nungah nu-a hi ipi navet dingu ham? Galsatmi hon ni umkhom banga?
target: Come back, come back, O Shulammite; come back, come back, that we may gaze on you! Why would you gaze on the Shulammite as on the dance of Mahanaim?

source: Vo leng chapa chanu, nakeng teni chu kengkoh naseteng iti hoija hoi hitam! namalbul teni kisuhtona jong sana-a kisem abangin mikhut themtah ho khutsem abange.
target: How beautiful your sandaled feet, O prince’s daughter! Your graceful legs are like jewels, the work of an artist’s hands.

source: Nalai jong jutuitah lhasam khalouhela dimjing khon bempel abangin; na-oi jong suhlouchang kihuivum lily pah-a kijem abange.
target: Your navel is a rounded goblet that never lacks blended wine. Your waist is a mound of wheat encircled by lilies.

source: Na noi teni jong sakhinou ni pengkop, lily pah lah-a lhale abange.
target: Your breasts are like two fawns, like twin fawns of a gazelle.

source: Na-ngong jong saiha insang abangin; namit teni jong Heshbon'a Bath Rabbim kotpiphunga twikul abangin; nanah jong Lebanon insang Damascus lam nga-a abange.
target: Your neck is like an ivory tower. Your eyes are the pools of Heshbon by the gate of Bath Rabbim. Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon looking toward Damascus.

source: Nachunga naluchang chu Karmel abangin, naluchanga nasamjong ponsandup abangin; Nasam lom phatah chun lengpa soh henin ahenin ahi.
target: Your head crowns you like Mount Carmel. Your hair is like royal tapestry; the king is held captive by its tresses.

source: Iti hoija nahoija chule iti dei naum hitam, Vo kangainu, kipana dinga!
target: How beautiful you are and how pleasing, my love, with your delights!

source: Natun jong tumphung bangin asangin, chule nanoi teni jong lengpiga bohthet abang jenge.
target: Your stature is like that of the palm, and your breasts like clusters of fruit.

source: Keima tumphung chunga kalingting, abahho gatuh inge, katin: Tun nanoi teni chu lengpiga lomho bangen lang, nanah-a hu hungpot gimnam chu theithup namtui banghen,
target: I said, “I will climb the palm tree; I will take hold of its fruit.” May your breasts be like clusters of grapes on the vine, the fragrance of your breath like apples,

source: Chule nakam chung chu lengpitwi phapen tobang hihen. Lengpitwi chu kangaipa-a dingin tuitah-in alongsuh'in, a-imu pa muh chu nemheu chan achaloh sah-in ahi.
target: and your mouth like the best wine. May the wine go straight to my beloved, flowing gently over lips and teeth.

source: Keima kangaipa-a kahin, chule angaichat chu keima-a uma ahi.
target: I belong to my beloved, and his desire is for me.

source: Hungo, kangaipa, loulama chedoh hitin; khoneo ho-a gageh hite.
target: Come, my beloved, let us go to the countryside, let us spend the night in the villages.

source: Jingpi matah-in lengpi hona chehitin; lengpigui mumtam gave hitin, lengpiga mumho pahlha tam gave hitin, chule kolbuthei ho pahtam gavetem hite; chua chu kangailut na kapeh ding nahi.
target: Let us go early to the vineyards to see if the vines have budded, if their blossoms have opened, and if the pomegranates are in bloom— there I will give you my love.

source: Kangaipa, Joldei-ai hon jong anam tuitah alhadoh-un, chule ka kelkot phunguva theiga tuitahtah namkim athah le alui nanga dia kakoisa aume.
target: The mandrakes send out their fragrance, and at our door is every delicacy, both new and old, that I have stored up for you, my beloved.

source: Oh, nangma kanu noi hinchepma kapenpipa ana hitavele chun katitave! Pamlama kahinmu teng jongle kahinchop ding nahi; henge, i-sah louva kaumlou ding ahi.
target: If only you were to me like a brother, who was nursed at my mother’s breasts! Then, if I found you outside, I would kiss you, and no one would despise me.

source: Keiman nangma kalamkaija kapui puiding eina hil jinga kanu insunga kapui lutding, ka kolbuthei twija kon kisem ju gimnamtui kadonsah ding nahi.
target: I would lead you and bring you to my mother’s house— she who has taught me. I would give you spiced wine to drink, the nectar of my pomegranates.

source: Akhut veilam kalu noija aumin, chule akhut jetlama chun eikoije.
target: His left arm is under my head and his right arm embraces me.

source: Vo nangho Jerusalem chanute, keiman nangho kathupeh nahiuve, ngailutna hi ama chamtah-a ahung um tilouvin, nanghon suhthou tho dingle suhkhah thoding gohih-un.
target: Daughters of Jerusalem, I charge you: Do not arouse or awaken love until it so desires.

source: Angainu chunga kingaija gamthipma kona hungdoh khu koi ahitadem? Theithup phung noija kathodoh nahi; chua chu nanun nanahin ahin, chua chu nahingnun nahin hindoh ahi.
target: Who is this coming up from the wilderness leaning on her beloved? Under the apple tree I roused you; there your mother conceived you, there she who was in labor gave you birth.

source: Suhdetna kinamkhum bangin nalungsunga neinam detnin lang, nabanna jong neinam detnin; ajehchu ngailutna hi thina bangin athaneijin, thangthipna jong lhankhuh bangin a-engse-e; amei chu meikong ahin, meikong nasa pentah ahi.
target: Place me like a seal over your heart, like a seal on your arm; for love is as strong as death, its jealousy unyielding as the grave. It burns like blazing fire, like a mighty flame.

source: Twi tamtah in ngailutna asudai joupoi, twisang lenho jengin jong alhoh joupoi; min ngailutna dingin a-insunga anei jouse pedohsoh jongle, ima-a simkham hilou lai ding ahi.
target: Many waters cannot quench love; rivers cannot sweep it away. If one were to give all the wealth of one’s house for love, it would be utterly scorned.

source: Keihon sopi numeinu khat kaneijuve, amanun noi aneihih laije; amanu min ahungdoh nikho teng kasopinu diuvin keihon ipi kabolpeh tadiuvem?
target: We have a little sister, and her breasts are not yet grown. What shall we do for our sister on the day she is spoken for?

source: Amanu hi bang hitale, achunga leng inpi dangka-a kasah diu ahi. Chule amanu hi kotkhah hitale, cedar thingpeh-a katom dingu ahi.
target: If she is a wall, we will build towers of silver on her. If she is a door, we will enclose her with panels of cedar.

source: Keima bang kahi, chule kanoi teni jong insang tobang ahi; chuin keima ama mitteni-a lungmonna mu-a tobang kahung hitai
target: I am a wall, and my breasts are like towers. Thus I have become in his eyes like one bringing contentment.

source: Solomon'in Baal-hamon'a lengpihon khat ananeijin; aman lengpihon chu angahho angansen; mitinin ahonsoh ga man dangka sangkhat cheh ahin pehlutdiu ahi.
target: Solomon had a vineyard in Baal Hamon; he let out his vineyard to tenants. Each was to bring for its fruit a thousand shekels of silver.

source: Kalengpihon keima angsunga aumme. Vo Solomon, nangma sangkhat nachan ding, chule aga ngahho chu jani changding ahiuve.
target: But my own vineyard is mine to give; the thousand shekels are for you, Solomon, and two hundred are for those who tend its fruit.

source: Nangho hon leilaija chengho, golle paiten na aw angai juve hichu keijong nei jahsah-in.
target: You who dwell in the gardens with friends in attendance, let me hear your voice!

source: Hung kikinsah in kangaipa, gimnamtui molsang ho chunga chun nangma sakhi chalgol ahiloule sakhinou tobangin hung umin.
target: Come away, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or like a young stag on the spice-laden mountains.

source: Judah lengho Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz chule Hezekiah nikholaija Judah leh Jerusalem chungchang thudolla, Amoz chapa Isaiah munei;
target: The vision concerning Judah and Jerusalem that Isaiah son of Amoz saw during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

source: Vo, vanho ngaijun, chule vo leiset, nana hinsungin. Ajehchu Pakaiyin thu aseitai: keiman chapangte chu kahinkhoukhah-a kahinseilet dohsah ahitan, hinlah amahon keima dounan na atong taove.
target: Hear me, you heavens! Listen, earth! For the Lord has spoken: “I reared children and brought them up, but they have rebelled against me.

source: Bongchal'in apu akihetnin, chule sanganin apun an apehna kong akihet-in; ahinla Israel'in vang ahepon, kamiten angaitopha himhim pouve.
target: The ox knows its master, the donkey its owner’s manger, but Israel does not know, my people do not understand.”

source: Ohe chonse nam mite, khansetna pohgihpo mite, thilsebol chilhahte, manthah sah chate; amahon Pakai chu adalhaovin, Israel dinga Mithengpa chu lunghan sahdin achoh thouvun, nunglama akitolmang taove.
target: Woe to the sinful nation, a people whose guilt is great, a brood of evildoers, children given to corruption! They have forsaken the Lord ; they have spurned the Holy One of Israel and turned their backs on him.

source: Ipidinga nangho kivoto jingjeng nalai nahiuvem? Nakisatto nahlai ding'uham? luchang apumin anatan, chule lungthim apumin acholtai.
target: Why should you be beaten anymore? Why do you persist in rebellion? Your whole head is injured, your whole heart afflicted.

source: Kengto apat luchang geijin adamkom aumtapon; ahinla mapule kivodup, chule tina monsa ahin; amahon jenla ajen pouvin, tomla atom pouvin, thaojong anu pouve.
target: From the sole of your foot to the top of your head there is no soundness— only wounds and welts and open sores, not cleansed or bandaged or soothed with olive oil.

source: Nagam sungu akamdeltan, nakhopihou jong meijin akihalha gamtai. Gamdang mihon nagamu na-angsung tah uva abahgamun, chule akamhelin, gamdang mihon alehkhuphel taove.
target: Your country is desolate, your cities burned with fire; your fields are being stripped by foreigners right before you, laid waste as when overthrown by strangers.

source: Zion chanu chu lengpi leija buhcha bangle changmai leija buh kisong bang, khopi kiumkim vel tobang ahitai.
target: Daughter Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a cucumber field, like a city under siege.

source: Janel Pakai chun amoh themcha khat eikhen louvu hileh, Sodom toh ibah uva, Gommorah dung isun jengdingu ahi.
target: Unless the Lord Almighty had left us some survivors, we would have become like Sodom, we would have been like Gomorrah.

source: Sodom kho-a vaihomten, Pakai thuhi ngaijun! Gommorah mite nanghon i-Pathen'u danthupeh-a nanau hinsung uvin!
target: Hear the word of the Lord , you rulers of Sodom; listen to the instruction of our God, you people of Gomorrah!

source: Pakai chun, naganlhai nao hijatpihi keidia iphatsah naham? ati. Keiman kelngoichal govam thilto lhingset le gancha kivah thao tahtah kaneije. Keima bongchalho thisan hihen, kelngoinou ho thisan ahilouleh kelchate thisan'ah kalunglhaipon ahi.
target: “The multitude of your sacrifices— what are they to me?” says the Lord . “I have more than enough of burnt offerings, of rams and the fat of fattened animals; I have no pleasure in the blood of bulls and lambs and goats.

source: Nangho ka-angsunga nahung kilah tenguleh, ka inpi chonthanghoi dinga koiham nangai chaovah?
target: When you come to appear before me, who has asked this of you, this trampling of my courts?

source: Thilto pannabei ho chu hinchoikit tahih hel'un; gimnamtuijong keidia thet umtah ahibouvin; lhathah nikhoho le cholngah nikhoho chule khoppi kikouho jong kadou theipon, chujongleh khoppitheng kikouho jong gitlouna ngen ahibouve.
target: Stop bringing meaningless offerings! Your incense is detestable to me. New Moons, Sabbaths and convocations— I cannot bear your worthless assemblies.

source: Nalhathah nikhohoule naphat kitepmu kutho chu kahin nan ahot ahi. Eilunggim sahbep ahiuvin abonchan kapochim set tai.
target: Your New Moon feasts and your appointed festivals I hate with all my being. They have become a burden to me; I am weary of bearing them.

source: Chule nakhut nahin lhandoh tengu jongle, nangho-a kona kamit kaselding, tamtahvei taona hinnei jeng jongleu chun kangaipeh louding nahiuve; ajehchu nakhut hou thisan dimset ahi.
target: When you spread out your hands in prayer, I hide my eyes from you; even when you offer many prayers, I am not listening. Your hands are full of blood!

source: Kisilthengun lang, kisuthengu vin; kamitmu-a konin nathilbol phalouhou chu koimang unlang; thilse bolda taovin,
target: Wash and make yourselves clean. Take your evil deeds out of my sight; stop doing wrong.

source: thilphabol kithemchuh-un, thu adih-a tanding gouvin, akibol gentheiho panpiuvin, panei loute thu tandih unlang, meithaiho seihuvin.
target: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije: tun hungun lang gelkhomu hite, Nachonset nao santhip bangjongle, buhbang banga bangding; sandup jeju tajongleh kelngoimul bangding ahi.
target: “Come now, let us settle the matter,” says the Lord . “Though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they are red as crimson, they shall be like wool.

source: Nangho nanop uva thu nangai ule, gamsung phatna chu nanehdiu ahi.
target: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good things of the land;

source: Ahinla nadaova nadeh uvangle, chemjam'a nalou gamdiu ahi. Ajehchu Pakai kamin aphondoh ahitai.
target: but if you resist and rebel, you will be devoured by the sword.” For the mouth of the Lord has spoken.

source: Khopi tahsan umtah chu i-atile noti hungsoh-a hitantem! Thudih tanna anadimin, chonphatna analengin; hinla tun tolthat jeng ahitaove.
target: See how the faithful city has become a prostitute! She once was full of justice; righteousness used to dwell in her— but now murderers!

source: Nadangka thih eh asoh in, nalengpi twila twitoh kihal ahitai.
target: Your silver has become dross, your choice wine is diluted with water.

source: Napipui houla dou lungpu jeng ahiuvin, chule guchaho kiloipi ahiuve. Amitin-in pehguh angailuvin, chule kipaman del le ahiuve. Amahon panei loute thu atanpeh pouvin, meithaiho thujong atan diuvin ahengu ahunglhung khatapoi.
target: Your rulers are rebels, partners with thieves; they all love bribes and chase after gifts. They do not defend the cause of the fatherless; the widow’s case does not come before them.

source: Hijeh chun janel ho Pakai, Israel dia mihatpa chun hitin aseije; Ahi! Keiman kakidoupi teho lhadoh ingting kamelmate phu kalah teiding ahi.
target: Therefore the Lord, the Lord Almighty, the Mighty One of Israel, declares: “Ah! I will vent my wrath on my foes and avenge myself on my enemies.

source: Keiman nachungah kakhut lam ingting, chule nathih eh chu thengtah a kalhah thenga, nasum lhahjol jouse kalah mangding ahi.
target: I will turn my hand against you; I will thoroughly purge away your dross and remove all your impurities.

source: Chule keiman nathutan ho kaki ledoh sah-a, chule nathuhil ho jong akipat tilla banga kaumsah kitding ahi. Chuche joutengle chonphatna khopi, tahsan um khopi tia naki minvo ding ahi.
target: I will restore your leaders as in days of old, your rulers as at the beginning. Afterward you will be called the City of Righteousness, the Faithful City.”

source: Zion chu athu kitanlha-a kilhatdoh ding, chule amanu kisihna chu chonphatna hiding ahi.
target: Zion will be delivered with justice, her penitent ones with righteousness.

source: Ahin doumah bolteho le achonseho chu mangthah khomintin, chule Pakai dalhahho chu suhmang hela umdiu ahi.
target: But rebels and sinners will both be broken, and those who forsake the Lord will perish.

source: Ajehchu nangaichatnu gangpi phungho chu ajachat piuvin, naki lhensao honlei chu nalungjinpi diu ahi.
target: “You will be ashamed because of the sacred oaks in which you have delighted; you will be disgraced because of the gardens that you have chosen.

source: Ajehchu nangho gangpido pulsa bangle, twi umlouhel honlei tobang nahi dingu ahi.
target: You will be like an oak with fading leaves, like a garden without water.

source: Chule mihat chu saikhao nem bangintin, hiche sempa chu meisipah bangding, chutia chu kavam lhonding, koimachan aphelmit louding ahitai.
target: The mighty man will become tinder and his work a spark; both will burn together, with no one to quench the fire.”

source: Amoz chapa Isaiah'in Judah le Jerusalem chungchang thudol chu anamu.
target: This is what Isaiah son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem:

source: Ninunung lamle hitiding ahi, Pakai inmun molsang chu molsang chung vum ho-a hung kiphutdoh ding ahin, lhang vum ho-a kichoisanga; chutengle namtin vaipi chu kijotlutdiu ahi.
target: In the last days the mountain of the Lord ’s temple will be established as the highest of the mountains; it will be exalted above the hills, and all nations will stream to it.

source: Hiteng chule chitin, namtin hunguva hitia aseidingu ahi; hungun Pakai Molsang chunga kaltouvu hitin, Jacob Pathen inna chun cheu hite; chutia chu aman alampi thudol eihil uva, ama lampia chu ichediu ahi, tiuvinte. Ajehchu Zion'a kona dan thupeh le Jerusalem'a kona Pakai thuchu hungpotdoh ding ahi.
target: Many peoples will come and say, “Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord , to the temple of the God of Jacob. He will teach us his ways, so that we may walk in his paths.” The law will go out from Zion, the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

source: Chutia chu aman namtin vaipi kah-a thu atana, mitamtah aphosalding; amahon achemjamhou loukaina, chule atengchahou kangkuija akikhendiu; namkhat douna-a namkhat nin chemjam lamtalou ding, galbolje jong kijilna umlou ding ahitai.
target: He will judge between the nations and will settle disputes for many peoples. They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not take up sword against nation, nor will they train for war anymore.

source: Vo Jacob insung miteho, hunguvin, Pakai vah-a chun cheleu hite.
target: Come, descendants of Jacob, let us walk in the light of the Lord .

source: Ajehchu nangman nami Jacob insung chu napaitai, ajehchu amaho solam mite chona dimset ahiuvin, Philistine ho bangin gaothu aseijun chule gamdang mite chate toh kipa thanop abolkhom jiuve.
target: You, Lord , have abandoned your people, the descendants of Jacob. They are full of superstitions from the East; they practice divination like the Philistines and embrace pagan customs.

source: Agamujong sanale dangka adimsetnin, chule agou khol hou jong angahna bei ahin; agamsungu jong sakol adimset'in, chule asakol kangtalai hou jeng jong akichaitih aumpoi.
target: Their land is full of silver and gold; there is no end to their treasures. Their land is full of horses; there is no end to their chariots.

source: Agamsung jong milim semthu adimsetnin; akhut tah uva aboldoh-u akhutjung ngeijuva asemsao chu ahouvun ahi.
target: Their land is full of idols; they bow down to the work of their hands, to what their fingers have made.

source: Milham hon chibai aboh-un, milen ama le ama akisuneovin, hijeh chun ngaidam changlou diu ahi.
target: So people will be brought low and everyone humbled— do not forgive them.

source: Thahat tah Pakai ginna le alal loupi masanga chun songko sunga lutning lang leivui lah-a gakiselin.
target: Go into the rocks, hide in the ground from the fearful presence of the Lord and the splendor of his majesty!

source: Mihem kivetsangna chu kisunem intin, mihem kiletsahna chu kisulha ding, chule Pakai changsehbou chuche niteng chule choisanga umding ahi.
target: The eyes of the arrogant will be humbled and human pride brought low; the Lord alone will be exalted in that day.

source: Ajehchu ahoithole akiletsah chan chule akichoisang chan chunga chu janel Pakai nikho hunglhung ding, chule amaho chu kisunem ding ahi.
target: The Lord Almighty has a day in store for all the proud and lofty, for all that is exalted (and they will be humbled),

source: Lebanon Cedar thingsang hole adoh sangho jouse chung le Bashan gangpiho jouse chunga,
target: for all the cedars of Lebanon, tall and lofty, and all the oaks of Bashan,

source: molsang ho jousele lhang kichoisangho chunga,
target: for all the towering mountains and all the high hills,

source: in-song sangtin hole galpal kikaiho chunga,
target: for every lofty tower and every fortified wall,

source: Tarshish kong inneiho jouse chungle, khutthem kisem thilho jouse chunga hunglhung ahi.
target: for every trading ship and every stately vessel.

source: Chule mihem kichoisang nachu kisulhantin, mihem kiletsahna chu kisunem ding ahi. Chule chuche ni chule Pakai changsehbou choisanga umding ahi.
target: The arrogance of man will be brought low and human pride humbled; the Lord alone will be exalted in that day,

source: Chutengle semthu milimho jouse asuhmanghel ding ahi.
target: and the idols will totally disappear.

source: Tijat umtah a leiset hotling dinga akipatdoh tengle, Pakai ginjehle alal loupina jeh-a, amahochu songpiho kohomsung le leikoho sunga lutding ahiuve.
target: People will flee to caves in the rocks and to holes in the ground from the fearful presence of the Lord and the splendor of his majesty, when he rises to shake the earth.

source: Hicheni chule mihon adangka milimhou le asana milimhou, ama ama houding cheh-a akisem houchu, bui hole bah ho henga ahinse manguva,
target: In that day people will throw away to the moles and bats their idols of silver and idols of gold, which they made to worship.

source: tijat umtah-a leiset hotling dinga ahung kipatdoh tengle Pakai ginjehle alalna loupijeh-a songpiho khikeh sungle songpiho pohkeh sunga chu lutdiu ahi.
target: They will flee to caverns in the rocks and to the overhanging crags from the fearful presence of the Lord and the splendor of his majesty, when he rises to shake the earth.

source: Mihem anah-a hai maimaipa-a konin kikangseuvin, ajehchu ama ijapang dingham?
target: Stop trusting in mere humans, who have but a breath in their nostrils. Why hold them in esteem?

source: Ijeh-inem itile, veuvin, Pakai janel Pakai chun, Jerusalem'a konle Judah a konin, anehnao lampile adonnao lampi jouse aladohsoh heltai.
target: See now, the Lord, the Lord Almighty, is about to take from Jerusalem and Judah both supply and support: all supplies of food and all supplies of water,

source: Mihatpa le gal hatpa thutanpa le themgao, milungching le upapa ahin,
target: the hero and the warrior, the judge and the prophet, the diviner and the elder,

source: mi somnga kaihoipa le mija umpa, thumopthempa le khutthempa, chule kamthem mitpheldoi thempa ahiuve.
target: the captain of fifty and the man of rank, the counselor, skilled craftsman and clever enchanter.

source: Chule keiman chapangho chu apipuiho diuva kapeh ding, naosen hon achunguva vai ahomdiu ahi.
target: “I will make mere youths their officials; children will rule over them.”

source: Chule mipichu suhgentheija umding, amitakip chu midangin chule amitakip aheng akomin asuhgenthei ding; Chapang chu upa chunga chule pannabei michu ja-umtah chunga kiletsah tah-a umding ahi.
target: People will oppress each other— man against man, neighbor against neighbor. The young will rise up against the old, the nobody against the honored.

source: Min apa insungmi asopi khat atuh-a, nangin ponsil naneijin, kavaihom-un panginlang hiche amangsahi nakhut noija umhen atitengle,
target: A man will seize one of his brothers in his father’s house, and say, “You have a cloak, you be our leader; take charge of this heap of ruins!”

source: hiche nikhoteng chule aman asap phonga, keima midamsah hiponge; ajehchu ka in'a nehdingle ponsil ding aumpoi. Mipi vaihomin neipansah hih-in, hin tinte.
target: But in that day he will cry out, “I have no remedy. I have no food or clothing in my house; do not make me the leader of the people.”

source: Ajehchu athuseijule anatoh-u chu Pakai dounale aloupi mithipsah bou ahitah jeh-in, Jerusalem kipal lhu-a chule Judah chu lhu-a ahitai.
target: Jerusalem staggers, Judah is falling; their words and deeds are against the Lord , defying his glorious presence.

source: Amel lhona kilang chun amaho adou ahettohsah-in; hicheho chun Sodom'a tobang achonsetnao aphongjalin, aselpeh pouve. Amanitah-in thilse akilamthu lhon jeh-in ahinna lhonchu ohe ada na-e!
target: The look on their faces testifies against them; they parade their sin like Sodom; they do not hide it. Woe to them! They have brought disaster upon themselves.

source: Michonpha chu seipeh-un, hichu ama dinga apha ahi, Ajehchu amahon atohgao chu anehtei dingu ahi.
target: Tell the righteous it will be well with them, for they will enjoy the fruit of their deeds.

source: Migilou chu ada ahi! amadin hamsetna ahi. Ajehchu akhut teni-a atohdoh chu kipeding ahi.
target: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them! They will be paid back for what their hands have done.

source: Kamitehi amaho bolgentheija pang chate jeng ahitaovin, numei hon achunguva vai ahom uve. Vo kamite, napuihouvin napuiseuvin, nachennao lampiho asumanguve.
target: Youths oppress my people, women rule over them. My people, your guides lead you astray; they turn you from the path.

source: Pakai chu thutan din ahung kipanin, miho thutan ding chun adingtai.
target: The Lord takes his place in court; he rises to judge the people.

source: Pakai chu amite upaho le milen milal ho toh thutanlha dinga lutding ahi. Ajehchu nanghon lengpilei chu nanejouvun; migenthei ho thil kichomdoh chu na-in uva aumme.
target: The Lord enters into judgment against the elders and leaders of his people: “It is you who have ruined my vineyard; the plunder from the poor is in your houses.

source: Kamite navoh ngem uva migenthei te maichangtah sumheija natahgoijiu chu ipi natinao ham? tin janelho Pakai chun aseije.
target: What do you mean by crushing my people and grinding the faces of the poor?” declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty.

source: Chuche kalvallin Pakaiyin aseije; Zion chanute chu hoithotah-a aumuva, ngong vaiputna le jonmit puma avaleuva, akengu jangjet jetna chule gingdet detna achejeh-u ahi.
target: The Lord says, “The women of Zion are haughty, walking along with outstretched necks, flirting with their eyes, strutting along with swaying hips, with ornaments jingling on their ankles.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu Pakaiyin Zion chanute lujang khichet chutna ajepma, Pakaiyin atahsao aselguh laihou chu ahodoh pehdiu ahi.
target: Therefore the Lord will bring sores on the heads of the women of Zion; the Lord will make their scalps bald.”

source: Hiche nikho chule Pakaiyin akenguva jephoina gingselsel, haona a alukophou, lhathah tobang angong ou chu asutlhah ding ahin,
target: In that day the Lord will snatch away their finery: the bangles and headbands and crescent necklaces,

source: Sumgui ho, chaojangho chule ngongvei ho,
target: the earrings and bracelets and veils,

source: Lutomna ho, keng jephoina ho chule lukanna ho, gimnamtui ho bomho, chule bilba ho,
target: the headdresses and anklets and sashes, the perfume bottles and charms,

source: khutjem ho le nahkuiba sana ho,
target: the signet rings and nose rings,

source: von khelthei ho, sangkhol chol ho, ponsil ho chule dipho,
target: the fine robes and the capes and cloaks, the purses

source: phatvet ho, tupat ponnem ho, delkop ho chule ponlukhuh ho, asutlhah peh diu ahi.
target: and mirrors, and the linen garments and tiaras and shawls.

source: Chule hunghiti ding ahi: gimnamtui khella a-ui; konggah khella khaojang; sam pojolsel khella lutol leolou; ponchol hoitah sanga khaodip pon; melhoina sanga meikah umjoding ahi.
target: Instead of fragrance there will be a stench; instead of a sash, a rope; instead of well-dressed hair, baldness; instead of fine clothing, sackcloth; instead of beauty, branding.

source: Napasal hou chemjam'a, namihat hou galla thigamdiu ahi.
target: Your men will fall by the sword, your warriors in battle.

source: Chule amanu kul kotpiho chu lunghema kapdiu; amanu ahomkeo ahitahjeh-a tolla touding ahi.
target: The gates of Zion will lament and mourn; destitute, she will sit on the ground.

source: Chule hiche nikho chule numei sagin pasal khat atuh uva, keihon ka-annu kineh uving ting, kaponnu kisil naovinge; eiki housetnao lahmangna dingin namin sehseh neiput sah-un, atidiu ahi.
target: In that day seven women will take hold of one man and say, “We will eat our own food and provide our own clothes; only let us be called by your name. Take away our disgrace!”

source: Hiche nikho chule Pakaiya kona abah jamdoh chu hoitahle loupitah hiding ahin, chule Israel, ahoidoh hodinga leiset gachu nasatahle hoitah hiding ahi.
target: In that day the Branch of the Lord will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the pride and glory of the survivors in Israel.

source: Chule hunghiti ding ahi, Zion'a kadalha-a, Jerusalem'a umdenpa chule Jerusalem'a ahingho lah-a kisunlut chasun geija chu atheng kitiding ahin,
target: Those who are left in Zion, who remain in Jerusalem, will be called holy, all who are recorded among the living in Jerusalem.

source: Pakaiyin Zion chanute nen asoplhah-a, chule Jerusalem lailunga patna lhagao thutanlhah nale, lhagao meikonga Jerusalem'a thisan behho chu asopthengsoh ding ahi.
target: The Lord will wash away the filth of the women of Zion; he will cleanse the bloodstains from Jerusalem by a spirit of judgment and a spirit of fire.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Zion lhanga chenna jouse chungle, akikhopnahou chunga chun, sunle meilhangle, meikhu janle meikong vahtah asempeh ding ajehchu loupi jouse chunga chu ahongah umding ahi.
target: Then the Lord will create over all of Mount Zion and over those who assemble there a cloud of smoke by day and a glow of flaming fire by night; over everything the glory will be a canopy.

source: Chutengle sun nisatna kona limding le belding khopihuile gellhah a kona hoinading houbuh khat umding ahi.
target: It will be a shelter and shade from the heat of the day, and a refuge and hiding place from the storm and rain.

source: Tun keima kangailutpa henga alengpilei thudollin kangailut nan la sange. Kangailuttah pan thinglhang leiphalaija lengpilei khat aneije.
target: I will sing for the one I love a song about his vineyard: My loved one had a vineyard on a fertile hillside.

source: Aman alhou ngimin, chua songho alohdoh in lengpigui phapentah aphutnin, alaitah-a insang khat asan, asunga chun lengpiga chilna khatjong asemin; chule aman hichun lengpi ga hinsepdoh teijinte tin angah jingin; ahin hichun gam lengpi ga ahin sepdoh tai.
target: He dug it up and cleared it of stones and planted it with the choicest vines. He built a watchtower in it and cut out a winepress as well. Then he looked for a crop of good grapes, but it yielded only bad fruit.

source: Chule tun, vo Jerusalem'a chenghole, Judah pasal ho keile kalengpilei kah-a thuhi neihin tanpeh temun tia kangeh nahiuve,
target: “Now you dwellers in Jerusalem and people of Judah, judge between me and my vineyard.

source: kalengpilei dinga bolthei kanabol loulai ipi uma ham? Lengpithei ahung gadohding kingah-a ibolla gam lengpithei ga ahinsepdoh ham?
target: What more could have been done for my vineyard than I have done for it? When I looked for good grapes, why did it yield only bad?

source: Chule tun, kalengpi leija kabolding chu hil unge; alingtho kaphetlhah'a, min anehjou ding; asongpal chu kasuhchima, michot pha-a umding ahitai.
target: Now I will tell you what I am going to do to my vineyard: I will take away its hedge, and it will be destroyed; I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled.

source: Chule keiman agoh a kakoija, lho-ngimlou le lailouva uma; lingle khao hung kehdoh ding ahin; meibol ho jong thu kapeh-a achunguva go ahinjuhsah louhel ding ahi.
target: I will make it a wasteland, neither pruned nor cultivated, and briers and thorns will grow there. I will command the clouds not to rain on it.”

source: Ajehchu janel Pakai lengpilei chu Israel insungle adeitah a aphu Judah mitehi ahiuvin; aman thudih joh aven, ahinla veuvin bolset najoh ahin; chonphatna chu veuvin ka najoh ahitai.
target: The vineyard of the Lord Almighty is the nation of Israel, and the people of Judah are the vines he delighted in. And he looked for justice, but saw bloodshed; for righteousness, but heard cries of distress.

source: Ohe! ada ahiuve, in le in jopmatho, lou keh bebe ho, mun beihela koiho, leiset lailunga achangseh uva chengding ahiuve.
target: Woe to you who add house to house and join field to field till no space is left and you live alone in the land.

source: Janel Pakai chun kanabenga aseitai, atahbeh-in; in tamtah, lentah tahle hoitahtah chu achengding beija kamhel gamding, ahi tin aseije,
target: The Lord Almighty has declared in my hearing: “Surely the great houses will become desolate, the fine mansions left without occupants.

source: chule lengpilei ching soma bath khatbou sohding, muchi homer khat kituna ephah khatbou soh ding ahi.
target: A ten-acre vineyard will produce only a bath of wine; a homer of seed will yield only an ephah of grain.”

source: Ohe! ada ahiuve, Khamnathei dondinga jingkah matah-a thouva, lengpitwi jin achupkah seuva jankhang geija touho.
target: Woe to those who rise early in the morning to run after their drinks, who stay up late at night till they are inflamed with wine.

source: Amahon selangdah chule semjang, khongcha, kuli, chule lengpitwi jin golnop abollun; ahinla Pakai thilbol lah akhohsah pouvin, akhutna atohdohho jong angaito himhimpouve.
target: They have harps and lyres at their banquets, pipes and timbrels and wine, but they have no regard for the deeds of the Lord , no respect for the work of his hands.

source: Hijeh chun kamiten hetna aneilou jeh-un sohchangin acheuvin, amija-umteu agilkelun, amipiteu dangchah in adango gamtaove.
target: Therefore my people will go into exile for lack of understanding; those of high rank will die of hunger and the common people will be parched with thirst.

source: Hijeh chun, te joulou khopma lenin thikholkhul chu akam akahommin; aloupinahou, amipiteu, akichoisangho, chule athanompa jengjong chuche sunga chu kumsuh diu ahi.
target: Therefore Death expands its jaws, opening wide its mouth; into it will descend their nobles and masses with all their brawlers and revelers.

source: Minoinung chu kisonkun ding, mithaneipa jong kisunem ding, mikiletsah te mit jong nguilha ding ahi
target: So people will be brought low and everyone humbled, the eyes of the arrogant humbled.

source: Ahinla janel Pakai chu thutanlhahna-a choisanga umding ahin, chule Pathen, athenga chu chonphatna-a suhthenga umding ahitai.
target: But the Lord Almighty will be exalted by his justice, and the holy God will be proved holy by his righteous acts.

source: Chuteng kelngoinou ho chu hamhing lah-a lhaleuvintin, chule mun gohho-a leiphalaiho chu gamdangmin anehdiu ahi.
target: Then sheep will graze as in their own pasture; lambs will feed among the ruins of the rich.

source: Ohe! ada ahiuve, imacha hilou khaoholla khangitlouna chule kangtalai khaova kiheh chonsetna kaikhomho.
target: Woe to those who draw sin along with cords of deceit, and wickedness as with cart ropes,

source: Keihon kamutheina diuvin kigansah henlang, anatoh kino hen; chule kahet theina diuvin Israel mithengpa thumopna chu hungnai hen, tia seiho chu!
target: to those who say, “Let God hurry; let him hasten his work so we may see it. The plan of the Holy One of Israel— let it approach, let it come into view, so we may know it.”

source: Ohe! ada ahiuve, aphalou apha tia, apha aphalou tia; khovah dinga muthim koija, muthim dinga khovah koiji, alhum dinga akha koija, akha dinga alhum koiho.
target: Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, who put darkness for light and light for darkness, who put bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter.

source: Ohe! ada ahiuve, ama mitna ching kisa-a, ama mitmu-a lungching kisaho.
target: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes and clever in their own sight.

source: Ohe! ada ahiuve, lengpitwi donna mihat tah hija, khamnathei donding halna-a thahat tah ho.
target: Woe to those who are heroes at drinking wine and champions at mixing drinks,

source: Chuho chun migilouho kipaman peh them achanun, midihtah dohna chu ama-a konin aladohjiuve.
target: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice to the innocent.

source: Hijeh chun meijin chang ki-atna kung akahvam bangle, meikongin changsi aleumang banga, chutia chu ajungu monlha a, apah-u leivui banga kitungdoh diu ahi. Ajehchu amahon janel Pakai danthupeh apaimangun, Israelte mithengpa thu chu anahsahpouve.
target: Therefore, as tongues of fire lick up straw and as dry grass sinks down in the flames, so their roots will decay and their flowers blow away like dust; for they have rejected the law of the Lord Almighty and spurned the word of the Holy One of Israel.

source: Hijeh-a chu Pakai lunghan amite douna-a deujah jeng ahi. Amaho douna-a chun akhut alamin adengtan, chule athi longu khopi lamlen laidunga akisat telin ahi. Ajehchu hiche jousehin alunghan naho chu abeidehpon, akhut chu akilamjing nalaije.
target: Therefore the Lord ’s anger burns against his people; his hand is raised and he strikes them down. The mountains shake, and the dead bodies are like refuse in the streets. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.

source: Aman gamlatah-a kona namtin dinga ponlap atahsang ding, kolmonga kona amaho asapkhom tengle amaho gangtah-a hung lhungloi jengdiu ahi.
target: He lifts up a banner for the distant nations, he whistles for those at the ends of the earth. Here they come, swiftly and speedily!

source: Alah uva athacholle akipalhu khatcha umpou vinte; khatcha alulhu, a-ihmu umpontin, akonguva konggah kikang ahiloule akengkoh khao tanna umlou helding ahi.
target: Not one of them grows tired or stumbles, not one slumbers or sleeps; not a belt is loosened at the waist, not a sandal strap is broken.

source: Athalmuh-u ahemthet-in, athalpi jouseu kaosan akichoijun, asakol tin houchu meituh song bangjeng, chule asakol kangtalai kanghou chu chimpei kiheh bangding ahi.
