target: Their arrows are sharp, all their bows are strung; their horses’ hooves seem like flint, their chariot wheels like a whirlwind.

source: Akitum ginu keipibahkai bang hiding, keipi noute banga kitumdiu; hitia chun kitum muntin, sahing kimat untin, phatecha alhoh manga, koimachan ahuhdoh louding ahi.
target: Their roar is like that of the lion, they roar like young lions; they growl as they seize their prey and carry it off with no one to rescue.

source: Hiche nikho chule amaho twikhanglen kitumgin banga amaho douna-a kitumdiu ahi. Khatouvin hiche gamchu gahvele, veuvin muthimle lung hesohna, khovah chu van'a muthimin ahin lekhuding ahi.
target: In that day they will roar over it like the roaring of the sea. And if one looks at the land, there is only darkness and distress; even the sun will be darkened by clouds.

source: Uzziah lengpa athikum chun Pakai chu laltouna sangtah chunga atouva alalpon chun houin alodimset chu kana mun ahi.
target: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord, high and exalted, seated on a throne; and the train of his robe filled the temple.

source: Achunga chun alha gupcheh nei Seraphim'ho anadingun; alhaving ni in amai akhun, ni in akengteni akhun, ni in alengin ahi.
target: Above him were seraphim, each with six wings: With two wings they covered their faces, with two they covered their feet, and with two they were flying.

source: Chule khatchun khat henga, ATHENG, ATHENG, ATHENG, chu janelho Pakai chu ahi. Leiset pumpihi aloupina adimsetne tin asamin ahi.
target: And they were calling to one another: “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord Almighty; the whole earth is full of his glory.”

source: Chuin ahinsampa Ogin chun kotpi khomho akihotnin, chule in chu meikhun adimtai.
target: At the sound of their voices the doorposts and thresholds shook and the temple was filled with smoke.

source: Chujouvin kaseitai: ohe ada kahi! ajehchu keima kamtheng lou kahin, mi kamtheng loute lah-a cheng kahi. Ajehchu kamitnin leng janel Pakai chu amutai, kati.
target: “Woe to me!” I cried. “I am ruined! For I am a man of unclean lips, and I live among a people of unclean lips, and my eyes have seen the King, the Lord Almighty.”

source: Chuin maicham-a kona akhutna mei-am chaichea hinchoija, Seraphim holah-a khat kahenga ahung lengin,
target: Then one of the seraphim flew to me with a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with tongs from the altar.

source: chuin kakam-ah ahinkoijin aseitai; ven, hiche hin nane teni atongkhatan; nakhansetnaho akilamangin nachonset naho jong suhthengin aumtai.
target: With it he touched my mouth and said, “See, this has touched your lips; your guilt is taken away and your sin atoned for.”

source: Hichun Pakai awginin hitia asei kajai: keiho dinga koi chedingham? Hichun keiman kaseijin; keima hia kaume, neisolin kati.
target: Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying, “Whom shall I send? And who will go for us?” And I said, “Here am I. Send me!”

source: Chuin aman chenlang, hiche mitehi gahilin, nanghon jaovin natin, ahinla nahetkhen theilou dingu; chule mu uvin natin, ahinla nahetdoh loudiu ahi, ati.
target: He said, “Go and tell this people: “ ‘Be ever hearing, but never understanding; be ever seeing, but never perceiving.’

source: Hiche mite lunghi thao tomsah inlang, anao ngonsah in, chule amitnujong kisinghen; achutiloule amitnun muvintin, anaovin jauvintin, alungun hekhen-uvintin, lung heijuntin, chule damget nunte.
target: Make the heart of this people calloused; make their ears dull and close their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn and be healed.”

source: Chuphatnin keiman Pakai itih chan hiding ham? Katile aman eidonbutnin; khopiho acheng beija agohkeo ahikahsele, inho-a mi acheng abeihela, agamchu akamhel kahse-a,
target: Then I said, “For how long, Lord?” And he answered: “Until the cities lie ruined and without inhabitant, until the houses are left deserted and the fields ruined and ravaged,

source: chule Pakaiyin mite chu gamlatah a achon manga, agamlailunga mun kidalha lentah umding ahi.
target: until the Lord has sent everyone far away and the land is utterly forsaken.

source: Ahinla hiche sunga chun somlah-a khat umintin, hichu kile-a kinejouding, chahthing phungle gangpi thing ana apultengle akungbul umnalai banga muchi theng chu akungbul umjing ding ahi.
target: And though a tenth remains in the land, it will again be laid waste. But as the terebinth and oak leave stumps when they are cut down, so the holy seed will be the stump in the land.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Jotham chapa, Uzziah chapa, Judah lengpa Ahaz lallaijin, Syria lengpa Rezinle lengpa Pekah Remaliah Israel lengpa chapa chu Jerusalem satdingin akontou lhonin, ahivangin anajou joulhon tapoi.
target: When Ahaz son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, was king of Judah, King Rezin of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel marched up to fight against Jerusalem, but they could not overpower it.

source: Syria chu Ephraim toh apangkhome ti David insungmite akihiltai. Chuin amale amite lungchu gammang thingho huijin amutling bangin alinglao gamtai.
target: Now the house of David was told, “Aram has allied itself with Ephraim”; so the hearts of Ahaz and his people were shaken, as the trees of the forest are shaken by the wind.

source: Hichun Pakaiyin Isaiah henga, nangle nachapa Shear-jashub chu twikul sahnung twilam monga ponsoppa lamlhonga khun Ahaz to kimutodin potdoh lhoninlang;
target: Then the Lord said to Isaiah, “Go out, you and your son Shear-Jashub, to meet Ahaz at the end of the aqueduct of the Upper Pool, on the road to the Launderer’s Field.

source: Ahenga, chingtheijin lang thipbeh-in Syria toh Rezin le Remaliah chapa engset lunghanna maiso mei khuthethu ni tobang chu kicha hih-in, lunglhah nanjong neihih beh-in ati.
target: Say to him, ‘Be careful, keep calm and don’t be afraid. Do not lose heart because of these two smoldering stubs of firewood—because of the fierce anger of Rezin and Aram and of the son of Remaliah.

source: Ajehchu, Syria, Ephraim, chule Ramaliah chapan nangma dounan thil gilou angaitouvin aseijuve,
target: Aram, Ephraim and Remaliah’s son have plotted your ruin, saying,

source: Judah doudingle nokhum dingin chetou uhitin, khopi chu suchimu hitin, chutengle alaija chun Tabel chapa chu lengin tung uhite.
target: “Let us invade Judah; let us tear it apart and divide it among ourselves, and make the son of Tabeel king over it.”

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, hichu ding joulou ding, guijong guilhung louding ahi.
target: Yet this is what the Sovereign Lord says: “ ‘It will not take place, it will not happen,

source: Ajeh chu Syria luchang chu Damascus ahin, Damascus luchang chu Rezin ahin; kum somgup le kumnga sunga Ephraim chu namkhat hiloudinga kisucheh ding ahitai.
target: for the head of Aram is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is only Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim will be too shattered to be a people.

source: Chule Ephraim luchang chu Samaria ahin, Samaria luchang chu Remaliah chapa ahi. Natahsan lou uleh atahbeh-a naki phudet louhel ding ahi.
target: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is only Remaliah’s son. If you do not stand firm in your faith, you will not stand at all.’ ”

source: Chukalvalin Pakaiyin Ahaz henga aseijin,
target: Again the Lord spoke to Ahaz,

source: Nangman Pakai na Pathen henga melchihna kithumin; hathuh-a thuh ahiloule hasana sangkhat kithumin, ati.
target: “Ask the Lord your God for a sign, whether in the deepest depths or in the highest heights.”

source: Ahinla Ahaz in, keiman thumponge, Pakai jong patep hihhel ing kate, ati.
target: But Ahaz said, “I will not ask; I will not put the Lord to the test.”

source: Chuin aman aseitai, David insung mite, tun nanghon ngaitemun! mihem cholsah hi thilneova nagel uva, ka Pathen sana nacholsah jeng dinguham?
target: Then Isaiah said, “Hear now, you house of David! Is it not enough to try the patience of humans? Will you try the patience of my God also?

source: Hijeh chun Pakai amatah-in melchihna khat hinpeu vinate; veuvin, nungah theng khat gai jintin chapa khat ahinding, aminchu Immanuel kitiding ahi, ati.
target: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign: The virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and will call him Immanuel.

source: Aman bongnoi thaole khoiju aneh ding ahi, chutia chu aman aselam hotbola aphalam lhenje ahetding ahi.
target: He will be eating curds and honey when he knows enough to reject the wrong and choose the right,

source: Ajehchu chapang chun aselam thetbol dingle aphalam kilhen dingje ahetthei masanga nanaginu gamhochu aleng teniu chun adalhah diu ahitai.
target: for before the boy knows enough to reject the wrong and choose the right, the land of the two kings you dread will be laid waste.

source: Judah'a kona Ephraim achemanga patna ana lhungkhalou nikhoho chu Pakaiyin nangle namite chung, chutengle napa insung mite chunga Assyria lengpa nahin lhutpeh ding ahi.
target: The Lord will bring on you and on your people and on the house of your father a time unlike any since Ephraim broke away from Judah—he will bring the king of Assyria.”

source: Chule hiche nikho teng chule hung hiti ding, ahi. Pakaiyin Egypt vadunga thousi ho mutkhom minintin, chule Assyria gamsunga khoiho akoukhom ding ahi.
target: In that day the Lord will whistle for flies from the Nile delta in Egypt and for bees from the land of Assyria.

source: Chule amaho hunguntin, abon chaova phaicham gohkeu laija songpi kohomho-a, lingho chung jouse-a, chule hamhing ho chung jouse-a umdiu ahi.
target: They will all come and settle in the steep ravines and in the crevices in the rocks, on all the thornbushes and at all the water holes.

source: Hicheni mama-a chu Pakaiyin samchem alap'a vadung gal lamho toh Assyria lengpa chu aluchangle akengmul ho ahet namding ahi; chule akhamul sanna jong ahet chaiding ahi.
target: In that day the Lord will use a razor hired from beyond the Euphrates River—the king of Assyria—to shave your heads and private parts, and to cut off your beards also.

source: Chuche nikhole hung hitiding ahi, pasal khatnin bongla khatle kelngoi ni avulding ahin;
target: In that day, a person will keep alive a young cow and two goats.

source: chule hung hiti ding ahin, chuche teng chule bongnoi nengtah-a apehdiu jeh-a amapan bongnoi thao anehji ding ahi. Ajehchu chuche gama kidalha chanchun bongnoi thaole khoiju jeng anehdiu ahi.
target: And because of the abundance of the milk they give, there will be curds to eat. All who remain in the land will eat curds and honey.

source: Chule chuche nikholai chule hung hitiding ahi, dangka sangkhat man cheng, lengpilei sangkhat umna munchana chu lingle khao jengbou kehding ahitai.
target: In that day, in every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, there will be only briers and thorns.

source: Agam pumpi lingkhaole lingphung ahung dimtah ding jeh in chulama chu thalpi le thalchang puma miho hungdiu ahi.
target: Hunters will go there with bow and arrow, for the land will be covered with briers and thorns.

source: Chule tuphenga kilai lhang jouse chunga linglekhaoho ginna-a chulama hunglou ding, ahin, bongchalho le ganchaho lhatna hung hiding ahitai.
target: As for all the hills once cultivated by the hoe, you will no longer go there for fear of the briers and thorns; they will become places where cattle are turned loose and where sheep run.

source: Chukalvallin Pakaiyin kahenga Maher-shalal-hash-baz chung thudol, lekha jol lentah khat lanlang asunga chun mihem twi-mollin sunin eiti.
target: The Lord said to me, “Take a large scroll and write on it with an ordinary pen: Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.”

source: Chuin thuching ding hettohsah tahsan umtah Uriah thempulen le Jaberekiah chapa Zekeriah chu kapansah in ahi.
target: So I called in Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah as reliable witnesses for me.

source: Chuin themgaonu henga kagachen; ahile amanu ahung gaijin chapa khat ahinge. Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga amin Maher-shalal-hash-baz sah-in ati.
target: Then I made love to the prophetess, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. And the Lord said to me, “Name him Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.

source: Ajehchu naosen chun hepa heno tije hetna anei masanga, Damascus haonale Samaria thilchomdohho chu Assyria lengpa anga kipomang ding ahi, ati.
target: For before the boy knows how to say ‘My father’ or ‘My mother,’ the wealth of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried off by the king of Assyria.”

source: Pakai chun kahenga thu ahinsei kitnin,
target: The Lord spoke to me again:

source: hiche mite hin Shiloah twi longdel delho adeimouva, Rezin le Remaliah chapa akipapi jeh uvin;
target: “Because this people has rejected the gently flowing waters of Shiloah and rejoices over Rezin and the son of Remaliah,

source: hijeh tahchun tun vetan, Pakai chun vadung twiho hattahle tamtah, Assyria lengpa le aloupina jouse jengjong achunguva alonvuhsah ding, twilam jouse ahinchupma avakam jouse-a letlha ding,
target: therefore the Lord is about to bring against them the mighty floodwaters of the Euphrates— the king of Assyria with all his pomp. It will overflow all its channels, run over all its banks

source: chule Judah gama longlutna achupsoh-a letlha ding, ngong geihel aphahding chule alhaving jahchun nagamu avai akhokhong ding ahi, vo Immanuel, ati.
target: and sweep on into Judah, swirling over it, passing through it and reaching up to the neck. Its outspread wings will cover the breadth of your land, Immanuel!”

source: Vo miteho nangho ahal hala chiplhading nahiuve! gamlhatah miho nabonchaovin nanau hinsungun, natai kigah-uvin, achutiloule ahal halla nachipdingu ahi,
target: Raise the war cry, you nations, and be shattered! Listen, all you distant lands. Prepare for battle, and be shattered! Prepare for battle, and be shattered!

source: Ngaito khomun phachomponte, thuchu seijun dingjou pouvinate. Ajehchu Pathen'in eiumpiuve.
target: Devise your strategy, but it will be thwarted; propose your plan, but it will not stand, for God is with us.

source: Ajehchu khut thahat tah-in, Pakaiyin kahenga aseijin, hiche mite lamlhah a kavale lounadin eithumop in, hitin aseije;
target: This is what the Lord says to me with his strong hand upon me, warning me not to follow the way of this people:

source: hiche miten guhthima thilphalou agonu ahi tia asei-ujong guhthim tohgon ahi tin seidao henlang, agihnao jong kichat nale gentheinan neidaohen.
target: “Do not call conspiracy everything this people calls a conspiracy; do not fear what they fear, and do not dread it.

source: Janel Pakai amatah chu thensah-un lang, naginnu ama hisah unlang, natijat naochu ama hihen.
target: The Lord Almighty is the one you are to regard as holy, he is the one you are to fear, he is the one you are to dread.

source: Chule amachu muntheng hiding, Israel insungteni dinga vang kipalna songle kisuhmona songpi hiding, Jerusalem'a chengho dinga thangle pel hidingbou ahi.
target: He will be a holy place; for both Israel and Judah he will be a stone that causes people to stumble and a rock that makes them fall. And for the people of Jerusalem he will be a trap and a snare.

source: Alah uva mi tamtah kipala lhuhna le kisuhgepna hiding; thanga oh-uva kimandohdiu ahi.
target: Many of them will stumble; they will fall and be broken, they will be snared and captured.”

source: Hettohsahna chu kantup minlang danthupeh chu kaseijuite lah-a namdet jengin,
target: Bind up this testimony of warning and seal up God’s instruction among my disciples.

source: chule keiman Jacob insunga kona amai selmangpa Pakai chu ngah ingting, amabou vengkate.
target: I will wait for the Lord , who is hiding his face from the descendants of Jacob. I will put my trust in him.

source: Veuvin keile Pakaiyin eipeh chapangtehi, Israel insunga melchihna leh thilkidang hidinga Zion molla cheng janel Pakaiya hungkon kahiuve.
target: Here am I, and the children the Lord has given me. We are signs and symbols in Israel from the Lord Almighty, who dwells on Mount Zion.

source: Chule amahon naheng uva mithisa lha kouho le doithemho guhthima vea, phuisam ho chu hollun atitengule miten athi khella ahina dinga a-Pathen'u chu ahollou dingu ham?
target: When someone tells you to consult mediums and spiritists, who whisper and mutter, should not a people inquire of their God? Why consult the dead on behalf of the living?

source: Amahon dan thupeh le hettohsahna thu dungjuija asei lou uleh, asunguva khovah umlou ahi.
target: Consult God’s instruction and the testimony of warning. If anyone does not speak according to this word, they have no light of dawn.

source: Chule amahon hesohtahle gilkeltah in gamchu jotpaovintin, chule hitiding ahi. Gilkella aumtenguleh, lungsa tuntun untin, alengpaole a-pathen'u gaosap untin chunglam avetdiu ahi.
target: Distressed and hungry, they will roam through the land; when they are famished, they will become enraged and, looking upward, will curse their king and their God.

source: Hiteng chule amahon tollam hinveuvintin, lungkhamnale muthim, lungnat khojin amudiu chule amahochu muthim lah-a kinolutding ahiuve.
target: Then they will look toward the earth and see only distress and darkness and fearful gloom, and they will be thrust into utter darkness.

source: Ahijeng vangin lunglha-a ana um amanu dingin nguina umta ponte. Phatmasa laija chu aman Zebulun gam le Naphtali gam chu olla ana gimbol ahin, chule khonungle Jordan gal, twikhanglen lampi-a namdangte Galilee chu nasatah-a abolgim be cheh ding ahi.
target: Nevertheless, there will be no more gloom for those who were in distress. In the past he humbled the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, but in the future he will honor Galilee of the nations, by the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan—

source: Muthima vahle mihochun vah loupitah amutaove, thina lim gama chengho chunga chun kho avahtai.
target: The people walking in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of deep darkness a light has dawned.

source: Nangman namtin vaipi chu napunsah-in, kipana napunsahtai; nangma masanga chang-at laija kipana bangin akipah-un, chule thilkichom akihoptenguva akipau bangin akipah uve.
target: You have enlarged the nation and increased their joy; they rejoice before you as people rejoice at the harvest, as warriors rejoice when dividing the plunder.

source: Ajehchu nangman amapa pohgih namkoljon le alengkouva mol lhon, chule sugentheipa moltum chu Midian ho nikho laija bangin nasuhbohpehtai.
target: For as in the day of Midian’s defeat, you have shattered the yoke that burdens them, the bar across their shoulders, the rod of their oppressor.

source: Ajehchu gal hatpa galbol jouse ginchu kisuhnohna awginin ajuijin, chule galvonho chu thisan abehjin, ahinla hichehi kavama meikhu sohding ahi.
target: Every warrior’s boot used in battle and every garment rolled in blood will be destined for burning, will be fuel for the fire.

source: Ijeh inem itile eihodingin naosen khat apengin, chapa khat eikipeuve, chule vaipohna chu alengkouva aputding, chule aminchu kidangtah, thumopthem, hat chungnung Pathen, tonsot Pa, chamna leng chapa kitiding ahi.
target: For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

source: David laltouna chung leh alenggam chunga avaipohna le chamna khangtou ding, akichaitih umlou ding ahi. Tua pat atonsot geija thutanna le thudih atundoh ding ahi. Janel Pakai tompanna chun hichehi abolding ahi.
target: Of the greatness of his government and peace there will be no end. He will reign on David’s throne and over his kingdom, establishing and upholding it with justice and righteousness from that time on and forever. The zeal of the Lord Almighty will accomplish this.

source: Pakaiyin Jacob thukhat athotnin, hichu Israel chunga alhungtai.
target: The Lord has sent a message against Jacob; it will fall on Israel.

source: Chule mijousen hichu aboncha ahetdiu ahin, Ephraimle Samaria'a cheng hoithotah le kiletsah tah-a seija:
target: All the people will know it— Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria— who say with pride and arrogance of heart,

source: cheh ho achimlhatan ahinla song kikheng in kisah taovinge; Theiba akiphuhlhun ahinla cedar thingin kheltao vinge, tihochun hetao vinte.
target: “The bricks have fallen down, but we will rebuild with dressed stone; the fig trees have been felled, but we will replace them with cedars.”

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Rezin kidoupiho chu ama doudin tungdoh intin, amelmate chu apankhompi ding ahin;
target: But the Lord has strengthened Rezin’s foes against them and has spurred their enemies on.

source: amasanga Syria ho, anunglama Philistine hon kamka-a Israelte avallhumdiu ahi. Hicheng jouse jehhin alunghan abeidehpon akhut alamjing nalaijin ahi.
target: Arameans from the east and Philistines from the west have devoured Israel with open mouth. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.

source: Chuteng jongleh mipi ho chu abolgimpao heng lama akihei dehpouvin, janel Pakai jongchu aholdeh pouve.
target: But the people have not returned to him who struck them, nor have they sought the Lord Almighty.

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Israel'a kona alu le amei, abah le apumpeng chu nikhatleh asatlhah ding ahi.
target: So the Lord will cut off from Israel both head and tail, both palm branch and reed in a single day;

source: Miluile mija-um, amachu alu ahin. Jouthuhil themgao amachu amei ahi.
target: the elders and dignitaries are the head, the prophets who teach lies are the tail.

source: Ajehchu hiche mite lamkaihon asuhkhelsah uvin, chule alamkai houchu suhmangin aumuve.
target: Those who guide this people mislead them, and those who are guided are led astray.

source: Hijeh chun agollhangho chunga chun Pakai chu akipahpon, apabeiho le ameithaiteu hepinajong anei louhel ding ahi. Ajehchu amitakip aphalhemle khansetbol ahiuvin, akamuvin ngolthu aseicheh uve. Hicheng jouse jehhin alunghan abeidehpon, akhut alamjing nalaijin ahi.
target: Therefore the Lord will take no pleasure in the young men, nor will he pity the fatherless and widows, for everyone is ungodly and wicked, every mouth speaks folly. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.

source: Ajehchu dihlou nahi mei bangin akadohjin; hichun lingle khaoho akahvam ding, chule gammang thim letlut lah-a kongdoh a; chule meikhu kitungdoh banga kaltou diu ahi.
target: Surely wickedness burns like a fire; it consumes briers and thorns, it sets the forest thickets ablaze, so that it rolls upward in a column of smoke.

source: Janel Pakai lunghan na-a kona gamsunga thim jinga, mihochu meija tiding thing tobang hidiu ahin, koimachan asopipa jong akhen louding ahi.
target: By the wrath of the Lord Almighty the land will be scorched and the people will be fuel for the fire; they will not spare one another.

source: Aman akhut jetnin manloi chelintin, hijongle agilkel phachom louding; Chule akhut veilamin nentin, oivadeh louding ahi, amitakipmin ama banphe cheh akineh dingu ahi.
target: On the right they will devour, but still be hungry; on the left they will eat, but not be satisfied. Each will feed on the flesh of their own offspring:

source: Manasseh, Ephraim; chule Ephraim, Manasseh: pangkhoma Judah te adoudiu ahi. Hicheng jouse jeh hin alunghana abeidehpon akhut alamjing nalaijin ahi.
target: Manasseh will feed on Ephraim, and Ephraim on Manasseh; together they will turn against Judah. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.

source: Ohe! ada ahiuve, adihlouva thu lhuhsahhole athu gonsao dihloutah a sun miho;
target: Woe to those who make unjust laws, to those who issue oppressive decrees,

source: Alhasamho thutanlhah dih-a kona hoidoh a, kami gentheite-a kona achanu suhchatvaipeh, meithaiho abahgam theina diule paneiloute chomding goho chu!
target: to deprive the poor of their rights and withhold justice from the oppressed of my people, making widows their prey and robbing the fatherless.

source: Chule vilna nikhoteng chule gamlatah-a kona suhmangna hung nikhotengle ipipen naboldiuvem? Napanpi diu, koipen henga najam uva naloupi nao hoija nadalhah diuham?
target: What will you do on the day of reckoning, when disaster comes from afar? To whom will you run for help? Where will you leave your riches?

source: Keima beija amaho sohchangho noija kun uva, chule akithat ho noija lhumat diu ahi, Hicheng jouse jehhin alunghan abeidehpon, akhut alamjing nalaijin ahi.
target: Nothing will remain but to cringe among the captives or fall among the slain. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.

source: Vo, Assyria, kalunghana moltum? akhut uva um tenggol khu kathangtomna ahi.
target: “Woe to the Assyrian, the rod of my anger, in whose hand is the club of my wrath!

source: Keiman kiphat lhemsah nam mite le kalunghana mite doudinga, chule thil suhchat vaisaho ladingle bahgam dinga, chule hicheho chu kholai bonlhoh banga chotpha dinga amachu kasolding ahi.
target: I send him against a godless nation, I dispatch him against a people who anger me, to seize loot and snatch plunder, and to trample them down like mud in the streets.

source: I-hijongle aman chutobang chu atup ahipon, alungin jong chutin agelpon; ahinla namtin chu themkhat hilouva suhmang hel dinghi hiche-a alunggel chu ahi.
target: But this is not what he intends, this is not what he has in mind; his purpose is to destroy, to put an end to many nations.

source: Ajehchu aman aseije, kalengchapate chu abonchauva lengho hilou uham?
target: ‘Are not my commanders all kings?’ he says.

source: Kalno chu Karchemish tobang hilou hija? Hamath chu Arpad tobang hilou hija? Samaria chu Damascus tobang hilouham?
target: ‘Has not Kalno fared like Carchemish? Is not Hamath like Arpad, and Samaria like Damascus?

source: Kakhut hin amilim houho lenggam, Jerusalem le Samaria ho-a sanga nasajo ahin holdohtan;
target: As my hand seized the kingdoms of the idols, kingdoms whose images excelled those of Jerusalem and Samaria—

source: Keiman Samaria le ahou milimhou kabolna banga chu, Jerusalem le amilim houho kabollou ding ham?
target: shall I not deal with Jerusalem and her images as I dealt with Samaria and her idols?’ ”

source: Hijeh-a chu hunghiti ding ahi, Pakaiyin Zion molchungle Jerusalem chunga anatoh pumpi achai tengle, Assyria lengpa lung hoithona ga, chule akichungvet loupina-a chu talen kapeh ding ahi.
target: When the Lord has finished all his work against Mount Zion and Jerusalem, he will say, “I will punish the king of Assyria for the willful pride of his heart and the haughty look in his eyes.

source: Ajehchu aman, hetkhenna kathemjeh-a kakhut thahatna le kachihna a hichehi kanabol ahin, miho gamgi kachonpeh in, agou khollu kanachom in, mihangtah bangin achengho chu kanasonlhan ahi.
target: For he says: “ ‘By the strength of my hand I have done this, and by my wisdom, because I have understanding. I removed the boundaries of nations, I plundered their treasures; like a mighty one I subdued their kings.

source: Chule kakhutnin mite haona chu vacha buh bangin amudoh-in; chule min vacha tui kidalha alokhom bangin leiset pumpi kachom khom sohkei tai; Ahin alhaving hinjapma le akam ka-a avelhia jong khatcha aumpon ahi, ati.
target: As one reaches into a nest, so my hand reached for the wealth of the nations; as people gather abandoned eggs, so I gathered all the countries; not one flapped a wing, or opened its mouth to chirp.’ ”

source: Heicha chu amangpa chunga kithang-at ngaijem? Ahiloule thing-at chu a-atpa chunga kichoisang ngaijem? Moltum chu adomsangpa khutna kon akithinlhah got banga, ahiloule tenggol chu thing hilou, adomsang beija akikhantou banga chu!
target: Does the ax raise itself above the person who swings it, or the saw boast against the one who uses it? As if a rod were to wield the person who lifts it up, or a club brandish the one who is not wood!

source: Hijeh chun Pakai, janel Pakai chun, amithaote lah-a chun gonna solintin, chule aloupi na noija chun meikong bangin ama meijin konginte.
target: Therefore, the Lord, the Lord Almighty, will send a wasting disease upon his sturdy warriors; under his pomp a fire will be kindled like a blazing flame.

source: Chule Israelte salvah chu mei hung hintin, mitheng chu meikonga hung pangding ahin chule hichun nikhatle lingle khaohi akahvama aval lhumding ahin;
target: The Light of Israel will become a fire, their Holy One a flame; in a single day it will burn and consume his thorns and his briers.

source: Chule gammang loupi nale agamphalai hinna le tahsa agoma asuhmanga, amaho chu ponlap dompa tha angoilhahpet bang hidiu ahi.
target: The splendor of his forests and fertile fields it will completely destroy, as when a sick person wastes away.

source: Chule agam manga thing aumsun chu chapang lekha jih-in ajih kham bepma lhom hiding ahi.
target: And the remaining trees of his forests will be so few that a child could write them down.

source: Chule hiche nikholai chule hung hitiding ahi, Israel amoh chengsele Jacob insungmi asohchaho chu amaho sumangpa chunga kingaikit louheldiu Israel mithengpa Pakai chung joh-a dihtah-a kingaidiu ahitai.
target: In that day the remnant of Israel, the survivors of Jacob, will no longer rely on him who struck them down but will truly rely on the Lord , the Holy One of Israel.

source: Amoh chengse Jacob mite amoh chengse chu Hat chungnung Pathen henga hungkilediu ahi.
target: A remnant will return, a remnant of Jacob will return to the Mighty God.

source: Ajehchu nami Israelte chu twikhanglen neldi bangjongleu alah uva amoh chengbou hungkilediu ahi. Amangdinga umsaho chu chonphatna-a longletdiu ahi.
target: Though your people be like the sand by the sea, Israel, only a remnant will return. Destruction has been decreed, overwhelming and righteous.

source: Ajehchu janel Pakai Pathen chun suhmangna ahinlhun sah ding hichu gamjouse lailung tah-a bol dinga agelhuh ahitai.
target: The Lord, the Lord Almighty, will carry out the destruction decreed upon the whole land.

source: Hijeh chun janelho Pakai Pathen'in hiti hin aseije, Zion'a cheng kamite, Assyria ho chu kicha loujenun, aman Egypt mite abol banga chu moltum khatna navoh uva nachung uva atenggol alapsang ding ahi.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord, the Lord Almighty, says: “My people who live in Zion, do not be afraid of the Assyrians, who beat you with a rod and lift up a club against you, as Egypt did.

source: Ajehchu chomkhat kahlouva lung hilouna hi kichaija, kalungsatnahi amaho manthah na hiding ahi.
target: Very soon my anger against you will end and my wrath will be directed to their destruction.”

source: Ajehchu janel Pakaiyin Oreb songpi-a Midian ho athachaplai banga chu mivohna achothouva; chule amoltum twikhanglen chunga adopma, chutia chu Egypt'a banga chu adopsang ding ahi.
target: The Lord Almighty will lash them with a whip, as when he struck down Midian at the rock of Oreb; and he will raise his staff over the waters, as he did in Egypt.

source: Chule hiche nikholai chuleh hunghiti ding ahi. Ama pohgih chu nalengkouva kona chule anamkoljon chu nangonga kona kilamang ding ahi. Chule thao kinujeh-a chu anamkoljon chu kisumang ding ahi.
target: In that day their burden will be lifted from your shoulders, their yoke from your neck; the yoke will be broken because you have grown so fat.

source: Ama Aiath'a ahungin, ama Migron'a agalkaijin; Michmash'a apoh asekhomin;
target: They enter Aiath; they pass through Migron; they store supplies at Mikmash.

source: Amahon lampi ajot galkaijun, amaho Geba'a ajangeh taove, Ramah ho akichan; Saul khopi Gibeah mite ajamtaovin ahi.
target: They go over the pass, and say, “We will camp overnight at Geba.” Ramah trembles; Gibeah of Saul flees.

source: Vo Gallim chanu, awging tah-in samin, Laish lama kijahsah-in, vo khoto um Anathoth.
target: Cry out, Daughter Gallim! Listen, Laishah! Poor Anathoth!

source: Madmenah ho akichontan; Gebim'a chengho jamdingin akichomkhom taove.
target: Madmenah is in flight; the people of Gebim take cover.

source: Chuche ni chuleh ama Nob'a anaumden nalaijintin; Jerusalem lhang Zion chanu molsang douna-a akhut athin khum ding ahi.
target: This day they will halt at Nob; they will shake their fist at the mount of Daughter Zion, at the hill of Jerusalem.

source: Veovin, Pakai, janelho Pakaiyin tijat umtah a abah chu asatlhah ding ahin; adunglang sangtah kiphuh lhu-a, chule akiletsah kisunem ding ahitai.
target: See, the Lord, the Lord Almighty, will lop off the boughs with great power. The lofty trees will be felled, the tall ones will be brought low.

source: Chule aman thih-a gammang thimletlut chu atuhlhuh-a, Lebanon chu mihat tah-a kona lhuding ahi.
target: He will cut down the forest thickets with an ax; Lebanon will fall before the Mighty One.

source: Jesse phungbula konin adon khat hungdoh intin, ajunga kona abahkhat hung khangdoh ding ahi;
target: A shoot will come up from the stump of Jesse; from his roots a Branch will bear fruit.

source: Chule Pakai lhagao chihna le hetkhenna lhagao, thumopthem le hatna lhagao, hetnale Pakai ginna lhagao achunga hung chuding ahin;
target: The Spirit of the Lord will rest on him— the Spirit of wisdom and of understanding, the Spirit of counsel and of might, the Spirit of the knowledge and fear of the Lord —

source: chule amachu Pakai ginna-a hetna gangtah asem ding, chule amitna amubanga thu atan louding, anakhanga ajahbang maimaija jong aphosal louding ahi.
target: and he will delight in the fear of the Lord . He will not judge by what he sees with his eyes, or decide by what he hears with his ears;

source: Amavang chonphatna-a vaichate thu atanding, leisetna mi nunnem te chu dihtah-a aphoding ahi. Chule aman leiset hi akamsung molla ajepma migiloute chu akam hu-a athading ahi.
target: but with righteousness he will judge the needy, with justice he will give decisions for the poor of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; with the breath of his lips he will slay the wicked.

source: Chonphatna chu akonggah hintin, kitahna chu alunggil gahna hiding ahi.
target: Righteousness will be his belt and faithfulness the sash around his waist.

source: Ngeile kelngoinou chengkhom intin, lutnu chu kelnoutoh kolkhom ding ahin; chule bongnoule keipibahkai gol chule gan kivahthaoho lhakhoma; chapang neuchan apuilediu ahi.
target: The wolf will live with the lamb, the leopard will lie down with the goat, the calf and the lion and the yearling together; and a little child will lead them.

source: Chule bongpile vompi kivahkhomintin; anouteo kolkhom ding ahin; chule keipi bahkai jengin jong bongchal banga changpol ahin nehding ahi.
target: The cow will feed with the bear, their young will lie down together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox.

source: Nao noicheplai gulse ko kotna kichema, noichep bang naosen in gulsum kosung asoding ahi.
target: The infant will play near the cobra’s den, and the young child will put its hand into the viper’s nest.

source: Amaho kalhangthenga chu kisukha louhel le kisumang louhel ding ahiuve. Ajehchu twijin twikhanglen akhusoh banga leiset hi Pakai hetna-a dimset ding ahitai.
target: They will neither harm nor destroy on all my holy mountain, for the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the Lord as the waters cover the sea.

source: Chule hicheni chule Jesse jung hung umdoh intin; hichu mitin melchihna dinga hung dingdoh-a, chidang namdang hon ahinholdiu ahi. Chule acholdona chu loupitah hiding ahi.
target: In that day the Root of Jesse will stand as a banner for the peoples; the nations will rally to him, and his resting place will be glorious.

source: Chule hicheni chule hitiding ahi, Pakaiyin amite amoh chengse, akidalha dingho, Assyria'a kon Egypt, Pathros, Kush, Elam, Shinar, Hamath'a kon, twikol gamho-a kona lakit dingin aniveina-a akhut alhankit ding ahi.
target: In that day the Lord will reach out his hand a second time to reclaim the surviving remnant of his people from Assyria, from Lower Egypt, from Upper Egypt, from Cush, from Elam, from Babylonia, from Hamath and from the islands of the Mediterranean.

source: Chule namtin vaipi dingin aman melchihna tungdoh intin, Israel nodohsa ho achomkhoma, chule leiset ningli-a kona Judah mi kithecheh ho chu akhopkhom ding ahi.
target: He will raise a banner for the nations and gather the exiles of Israel; he will assemble the scattered people of Judah from the four quarters of the earth.

source: Ephraim mite thangsetna jongchu kitol manga, Judah te douho chu kisatlha ding, Ephraim min Judah thangset dantin, Judah'in jong Ephraim sutan taponte.
target: Ephraim’s jealousy will vanish, and Judah’s enemies will be destroyed; Ephraim will not be jealous of Judah, nor Judah hostile toward Ephraim.

source: Ahinla amaho lhumlang sanga Philistinte lengkouho chunga leng uva, kigomuva solam miho achom dingu ahi, amahon Edom le Moab chunga akhutnu alhah uva, chule Ammon chaten amaho thu angai dingu ahitai.
target: They will swoop down on the slopes of Philistia to the west; together they will plunder the people to the east. They will subdue Edom and Moab, and the Ammonites will be subject to them.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Egypt vadunglen Lei chu asuh manghela chule huipi hattah-a luipi chunga akhut athinkhuma, luidung sagiho chu ajepma, chutengle achunga chu mihon kengto kot louva lam ajot dingu hi.
target: The Lord will dry up the gulf of the Egyptian sea; with a scorching wind he will sweep his hand over the Euphrates River. He will break it up into seven streams so that anyone can cross over in sandals.

source: Chule Egypt gama kona ahungdoh niuva Israel ten lampi ahin jui banguva; amite amoh kidalha ho dinga chu, lamlhongpi khat Assyria'a kona hungki lhung ding ahi.
target: There will be a highway for the remnant of his people that is left from Assyria, as there was for Israel when they came up from Egypt.

source: Hicheni chule nanghon vo Pakai keiman nangma vahchoi jinge, kachunga analunghang tajongle chun nalunghanna akichonmangin neilhamon tai;
target: In that day you will say: “I will praise you, Lord . Although you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you have comforted me.

source: Vetan Pakai chu eihuh hinga ahin; keiman tahsaning ting kichataponge, Ajehchu Pakai Jehovah chu kahatnale kala ahin; amachu eihuh hingpa jong ahunghitai.
target: Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. The Lord , the Lord himself, is my strength and my defense; he has become my salvation.”

source: Hijeh-a chu huhhingna twikul'a kona kipahtah-a twi nathaldiu ahitai.
target: With joy you will draw water from the wells of salvation.

source: Hiche nikhoteng chule nanghon Pakai chu vahchoijun lang aminin taovun, athilbolho mitinlah a phongjalun lang aminchu choi-atnin aumtai, tin seijuvin, natidiu ahi.
target: In that day you will say: “Give praise to the Lord , proclaim his name; make known among the nations what he has done, and proclaim that his name is exalted.

source: Aman thil loupitah aboltahjeh-in Pakaiya la saovin; hichehi leiset pumpi het ahi.
target: Sing to the Lord , for he has done glorious things; let this be known to all the world.

source: Nangho Zion'a chengten kho sam unlang aovun ajehchu nalah uva um Israelte mithengpa chu loupitah ahi.
target: Shout aloud and sing for joy, people of Zion, for great is the Holy One of Israel among you.”

source: Babylon pohgih, Amoz chapa Isaiah'in amuchu ahi.
target: A prophecy against Babylon that Isaiah son of Amoz saw:

source: Milalte kotpi phunga aluttheina diuvin, molsang chunga chun ponlap domsangun lang, awsang tah-in sam unlang, khutnin japmun.
target: Raise a banner on a bare hilltop, shout to them; beckon to them to enter the gates of the nobles.

source: Kathensosa mihochu thu kapen, Kalunghana-a dingin kamihat ho jong kakouvin, kaloupina eikipapiho jengjong kakouve.
target: I have commanded those I prepared for battle; I have summoned my warriors to carry out my wrath— those who rejoice in my triumph.

source: Molchunga mitamtah husan chu mipi nasatah husan tobang ahin; namtin lengam kikhomkhomho kinah kisao husan toh abangin ahi. Janel Pakai chun galmi janel ho chu galmuna din akhomtup tai.
target: Listen, a noise on the mountains, like that of a great multitude! Listen, an uproar among the kingdoms, like nations massing together! The Lord Almighty is mustering an army for war.

source: Amaho gamlatah gama kon, van monga konin, Pakai amatahle lung hilouna manchah hotoh chuche gampumpi sumang dingin ahunguve atiuve.
target: They come from faraway lands, from the ends of the heavens— the Lord and the weapons of his wrath— to destroy the whole country.

source: Penguvin, ajehchu Pakai nikho chu ahungnai tai; Hatchung nunga kona manthah na tobang chu hunglhung ding ahi.
target: Wail, for the day of the Lord is near; it will come like destruction from the Almighty.

source: Hijeh-a chu khut jouse ngoilha-a mitin lungsung junlhading ahi.
target: Because of this, all hands will go limp, every heart will melt with fear.

source: Chule amaho kichaovintin; natna le lungkham na-in manchom untin; numei naosonat thoh banga thohgima umdiu amaho khatnin adang chu adatmouva, amaiju meikong bangjeng ding ahiuve.
target: Terror will seize them, pain and anguish will grip them; they will writhe like a woman in labor. They will look aghast at each other, their faces aflame.

source: Vetan, Pakai nikho lunghanale lungsatna khohtah toh kithokhom engsetna, chuche gam sugamhel dingchu ahunglhung tai. Aman chuche-a kona michonseho chu asuhmang helding ahi.
target: See, the day of the Lord is coming —a cruel day, with wrath and fierce anger— to make the land desolate and destroy the sinners within it.

source: Ajehchu van'a ahsi ho le chua bombel ho chun avah-u apehtahloudiu, nisa chu asodohna-a thimdeldul jengding ahitan, chule lhavah injong avahchu asalvah louding ahitai.
target: The stars of heaven and their constellations will not show their light. The rising sun will be darkened and the moon will not give its light.

source: Chule keiman vannoihi asetnao jeh-a chule migiloute chu akhansetnao jeh-a talen kapeh ding; mikiletsahho ahoithanau kasuhbei ding, chule kiletsahna tijat umtah chu nemcha kakoipeh ding ahi.
target: I will punish the world for its evil, the wicked for their sins. I will put an end to the arrogance of the haughty and will humble the pride of the ruthless.

source: Keiman sanatheng sanga lujo mihem khat, Ophir sanahal sanga lujohel mihem khat kasemding ahi.
target: I will make people scarcer than pure gold, more rare than the gold of Ophir.

source: Hijeh-a chu janel Pakai lunghan ni-a alungsat khohtah nikho chule vanho kaho lingsoh-a, leiset jong amuna kona kichondohding ahi.
target: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble; and the earth will shake from its place at the wrath of the Lord Almighty, in the day of his burning anger.

source: Chule hichu sakhi nung kidel bangle, ahoitupbei kelngoi tobang hiding ahin; mitin chu amaho mite cheh lama, kiheija, ama gamcheh-a jamlutdiu ahi.
target: Like a hunted gazelle, like sheep without a shepherd, they will all return to their own people, they will flee to their native land.

source: Koihile akimudoh chanchu kidot kamhel helding, chule amaho jopchan chu chemjam'a loudiu ahi.
target: Whoever is captured will be thrust through; all who are caught will fall by the sword.

source: Achateu jong amitmu tah uva kichil ngema a-inho kichom theng ding, chule ajiteu jong achamlou uva kisusedingu ahi.
target: Their infants will be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses will be looted and their wives violated.

source: Vetan, amaho doudin Mede mite tildoh ingting, amahon dangka angaisah loudiu; chule sana-a jong kipahlouding ahiuve.
target: See, I will stir up against them the Medes, who do not care for silver and have no delight in gold.

source: Athalpihou chun gollhangho hinkaplih untin; laigil gaho chunga khotona himhim aneilou diu; amitmuva naosen ho jong akheh louheldiu ahi.
target: Their bows will strike down the young men; they will have no mercy on infants, nor will they look with compassion on children.

source: Chule Babylon lenggam ho loupina Chaldea mite melhoina chungnung chu Pathen'in Sodom le Gomorrah asuhmang tobang chu hiding ahi.
target: Babylon, the jewel of kingdoms, the pride and glory of the Babylonians, will be overthrown by God like Sodom and Gomorrah.

source: A-itih a jong koima cheng talouhel ding, akhang akhanga jong chengkit talouhel ding. Arab miten jong chuche munna chu apon innu asonloudiu; kelngoi chinghonjong chua akelngoi hongu asemlouheldiu ahitai.
target: She will never be inhabited or lived in through all generations; there no nomads will pitch their tents, there no shepherds will rest their flocks.

source: Amavang nelgama gamsaho chua chu koldiu; a-inhou chu kichat um ganhingho dimsetna; sumbupi ho chua chu chenga, lhomiho hunglam diu ahi.
target: But desert creatures will lie there, jackals will fill her houses; there the owls will dwell, and there the wild goats will leap about.

source: A-in homhou sunga chu twikol gamsaho chule aleng in nomhou sunga chu Dragonho hung hamdiu ahin; chule amanu phat hunglhun nading chu anaitan, anikhoho jong kijopsao talouhel ding ahi.
target: Hyenas will inhabit her strongholds, jackals her luxurious palaces. Her time is at hand, and her days will not be prolonged.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin Jacob hepintin, chule Israelte chu lheng nalaijintin, agamsung tah uva achensahdiu chule gamdang mihon amaho ahinjopmuva, Jacob insunga behdiu ahitai.
target: The Lord will have compassion on Jacob; once again he will choose Israel and will settle them in their own land. Foreigners will join them and unite with the descendants of Jacob.

source: Chule mihochun amaho ahinpuijuva, apate mun ahinlhut ding, chule Israel insung chun Pakai gama amahochu sohpale sohnu-a avuluva; chule gal hinga akaihouchu gal hinga akaijuva; asugentheiteu chunga chu vai ahomdingu ahi.
target: Nations will take them and bring them to their own place. And Israel will take possession of the nations and make them male and female servants in the Lord ’s land. They will make captives of their captors and rule over their oppressors.

source: Chule nalungkham na-a konle nakichat na-a kona chule soh suhgenthei natoh hahsa naki tohsah na nasohchanna-a kona Pakaiyin nacholdosah nile hung hitiding ahi.
target: On the day the Lord gives you relief from your suffering and turmoil and from the harsh labor forced on you,

source: Chutia chu nangman Babylon lengpa douna-a hiche thuchih hi naman chah-a naseiding ahi. I-atileh misugenthei pa chu iti beija hitam! sana khopi chu kichai hitam!
target: you will take up this taunt against the king of Babylon: How the oppressor has come to an end! How his fury has ended!

source: Pakaiyin mikhang giloupa tenggol le vaihomho laltengdop chu aheboh pehtai.
target: The Lord has broken the rod of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,

source: Miho lunghanna tanlouva veijingpa, lungsa tah-a namtin chunga vaihompa chu bolgimin aumin, koimachan asutangpoi.
target: which in anger struck down peoples with unceasing blows, and in fury subdued nations with relentless aggression.

source: Leiset pumpi akicholdon, athipdeltan; amahon la asadoh-uvin ahi.
target: All the lands are at rest and at peace; they break into singing.

source: Ahi, nachunga chah thinghole Lebanon'a cedar thingho akipah-un, suhlhah-a na-uma patnin eiphuh lhudiu khatcha kahenguva ahungtapoi, atiuve.
target: Even the junipers and the cedars of Lebanon gloat over you and say, “Now that you have been laid low, no one comes to cut us down.”

source: Noilama konin thikholkhul chu nahunglhun lamdot dingin ahung kichonnin; hichun nangma dingin mithihole leiset pipui jouse jong achoh thouvin; namtin lengho jouse alaltounaova konin akaithou tan ahi.
target: The realm of the dead below is all astir to meet you at your coming; it rouses the spirits of the departed to greet you— all those who were leaders in the world; it makes them rise from their thrones— all those who were kings over the nations.

source: Amahon nahenga, nangjong keiho banga nahung lhahsam hitam? keihotoh nahungbah hitam? atidingu ahi.
target: They will all respond, they will say to you, “You also have become weak, as we are; you have become like us.”

source: Naloupina le naselangdah husa chu lhankhuh-a poh lhah-in aumin; lungtol chu nanoija akiphan, hiche lung chun natomchah tan ahi.
target: All your pomp has been brought down to the grave, along with the noise of your harps; maggots are spread out beneath you and worms cover you.

source: Vo Lucifer, jingkah chapa! van'a kona iti hunglhahmanga nahim! namtinho hatmosahpa chu leisetna iti nahung kisatlhah jeng hitam?
target: How you have fallen from heaven, morning star, son of the dawn! You have been cast down to the earth, you who once laid low the nations!

source: Ajehchu nangin nalungsunga keima van'a kaltouving ting; Pathen ahsi ho chungvuma kalaltouna kidopsanging katin; mipi kikhomho lhangchung sahlam sanga touving kate, natin ahi.
target: You said in your heart, “I will ascend to the heavens; I will raise my throne above the stars of God; I will sit enthroned on the mount of assembly, on the utmost heights of Mount Zaphon.

source: Meilhang ho chungvuma kaltouving katin; chungnung penpa toh banging kate, nanatin ahi.
target: I will ascend above the tops of the clouds; I will make myself like the Most High.”

source: Ahinla nangma kotongthuh lama thikholkhula kipui lhading nahijobouve.
target: But you are brought down to the realm of the dead, to the depths of the pit.

source: Namu jousen neochan namuvintin, leiset kithinsah-a lenggam ho hotlinga ngaito-a chu hiche mipahi hijaham? tin ngaitouvinte;
target: Those who see you stare at you, they ponder your fate: “Is this the man who shook the earth and made kingdoms tremble,

source: Amachun vannoihi gamthip banga asema, chule akhopihou sumanga sohchangho in honpehlou chu hiche mipahi hilouham? atiuve.
target: the man who made the world a wilderness, who overthrew its cities and would not let his captives go home?”

source: Namtin vaipi lengho jouse abonchauvin, ama ama insungcheh-a loupitah-in alum ihmuvin ahi.
target: All the kings of the nations lie in state, each in his own tomb.

source: Ahinla nangma thet umtah abah khatna hungkon chemjam'a kisatlih, akithatsaho ponsil, kokhuh-a songho lah-a kipailha, kenga kichonpha thilong bangin, nalhana konin paidoh-in na-umtan ahi.
target: But you are cast out of your tomb like a rejected branch; you are covered with the slain, with those pierced by the sword, those who descend to the stones of the pit. Like a corpse trampled underfoot,

source: Nangin nagam nasuhmanga, namite nathagam jeh-in, amahotoh nakivuitha louhel ding ahi. Khanset bolho chilhahte chu kiminphah kitlouhel ding ahiuve.
target: you will not join them in burial, for you have destroyed your land and killed your people. Let the offspring of the wicked never be mentioned again.

source: Amaho akipatdoh lounadiule, gam alo lounadiu, leiset chung khopiho achendim louna diuvin apateu khansetna jal-in achateu chu thagamdin gotan.
target: Prepare a place to slaughter his children for the sins of their ancestors; they are not to rise to inherit the land and cover the earth with their cities.

source: Ajehchu janel Pakaiyin amaho dounan kipat ingting, Babylon'a konin kachapa le katupa amohchengse minchu kasuhtan ding ahi, ati, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “I will rise up against them,” declares the Lord Almighty. “I will wipe out Babylon’s name and survivors, her offspring and descendants,” declares the Lord .

source: Keiman vakang chenna mun le twikulho-a kasema, manthah na muntheh-a katheh doh ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “I will turn her into a place for owls and into swampland; I will sweep her with the broom of destruction,” declares the Lord Almighty.

source: Kangaito bang banga guilhunga, kagon bang banga ding teiding ahi; tin janel Pakai chu aki hahselin aseitai.
target: The Lord Almighty has sworn, “Surely, as I have planned, so it will be, and as I have purposed, so it will happen.

source: Chutia chu keiman kagamsunga Assyria mite kasuhmanga, kamolsangho chunga kachotpha ding; chujou tengle anamkoljon chu amaho-a kona kiheimanga, apohgih-u alenguva kona aselhah dingu ahitai.
target: I will crush the Assyrian in my land; on my mountains I will trample him down. His yoke will be taken from my people, and his burden removed from their shoulders.”

source: Hiche thilgonhi leiset pumpi chunga thilgon ahin; chule hichehi namtin vaipi jouse chunga kijahdoh khutchu ahi.
target: This is the plan determined for the whole world; this is the hand stretched out over all nations.

source: Janel Pakai gonsa ahin, koiham ajahda dingah? Chule akhut kijahdohsa chu kon atimsahkit dingham?
target: For the Lord Almighty has purposed, and who can thwart him? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?

source: Ahaz lengpa thi kum-a chu hiche pohgih hi uma ahitai.
target: This prophecy came in the year King Ahaz died:

source: Nangma kivohna mol abohtah jeh-in, nang Palestine pumpi kipah hih-in, ajehchu gul sonna kona chu gulsum hungsoh-a, chule ama guchu meija lengthei gul hunghi ding ahi.
target: Do not rejoice, all you Philistines, that the rod that struck you is broken; from the root of that snake will spring up a viper, its fruit will be a darting, venomous serpent.

source: Chutengle migenthei cha pengmasa kivah intin, milhasam mongtah-in lumintin; najung chu kella katha-a, nami amoh chengchu aman athading ahi.
target: The poorest of the poor will find pasture, and the needy will lie down in safety. But your root I will destroy by famine; it will slay your survivors.

source: Vo kotpi samin; vo khopi pengin; nangma Palestine pumpi najun lhatai. Ajehchu sahlama kona meikhu hungdoh-a; aphattep sunga chu koimacha achanga umlou ding ahi.
target: Wail, you gate! Howl, you city! Melt away, all you Philistines! A cloud of smoke comes from the north, and there is not a straggler in its ranks.

source: Nampi thupole ho chu khatnin iti adonbut dingham? Pakaiyin Zion aphutdoh tan, hijeh-a chu mivaichaten hichu atahsan dingu ahi.
target: What answer shall be given to the envoys of that nation? “The Lord has established Zion, and in her his afflicted people will find refuge.”

source: Moab gam pohgih chungchanga, chuche jana chun Moab khopi Ar chu suhmangle kamdelin akilhan; chuleh Moab gama Kir khopi jong kamhel leh thipdelin akikoitai.
target: A prophecy against Moab: Ar in Moab is ruined, destroyed in a night! Kir in Moab is ruined, destroyed in a night!

source: Bajith le Dibon munsang ho-a chun ama kapdingin achetoutan: Nebo chungle Medeba chunga Moab peng pengding, aluchung jouseu chaijin tin akhamulhou jouse kivou ngim ding ahi.
target: Dibon goes up to its temple, to its high places to weep; Moab wails over Nebo and Medeba. Every head is shaved and every beard cut off.

source: Akhopi lamlen dunguva amahon khaodip pon akigah uva, a-inchunghou le alamlen houva amitin penguva haka-a kapdingu ahiuve.
target: In the streets they wear sackcloth; on the roofs and in the public squares they all wail, prostrate with weeping.

source: Chule Heshbon le Elealeh te kapmuva, Jahaz geisana a-aw kijading ahi. Hijeh-a chu galvon kivon Moab sepaiho chu awsangtah-a pengdoh uva; ahinna chu amadinga lungkham umtah hiding ahi.
target: Heshbon and Elealeh cry out, their voices are heard all the way to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry out, and their hearts are faint.

source: Kalungsung Moab dingin kapdoh intin; ajamleleho chu kumthum kijoma Zoar'a jamlutdiu ahi. Ajehchu Luhith kaltouna-a chu kap puma chetoudiu chule Heronaim lampia chu suhmangna-a pengjahdiu ahi.
target: My heart cries out over Moab; her fugitives flee as far as Zoar, as far as Eglath Shelishiyah. They go up the hill to Luhith, weeping as they go; on the road to Horonaim they lament their destruction.

source: Nimrim twiho akangin, hamdongho agopmin; hampa akehpon; hamhing himhim aumtapoi.
target: The waters of Nimrim are dried up and the grass is withered; the vegetation is gone and nothing green is left.

source: Hijeh chun amahon amujouseu le akholkhom jouseu chu huisum vachadung lama akipoh mangdiu ahitai.
target: So the wealth they have acquired and stored up they carry away over the Ravine of the Poplars.

source: Ajehchu Moab gamgi muntina kana aumin. Eglaim le Beerelin'a jong apen ginu chu akithangsoh tai.
target: Their outcry echoes along the border of Moab; their wailing reaches as far as Eglaim, their lamentation as far as Beer Elim.

source: Ajehchu Dimon twiho thisan dimding ahin, ajehchu Dimon chunga chu akhoh jocheh kalhunsahbe ding, Moab gama hoidohnale chuche gama amoh chengse chunga keipi bahkai kalhalut ding ahi.
target: The waters of Dimon are full of blood, but I will bring still more upon Dimon— a lion upon the fugitives of Moab and upon those who remain in the land.

source: Gamsung vaihomho dingin, Sela a konin, gamthip lam Zion chanu lhanga chun kelngoinou ho chu hinsolun.
target: Send lambs as tribute to the ruler of the land, from Sela, across the desert, to the mount of Daughter Zion.

source: Chutia chu Moab chanute chu vacha abuh-a kona kinodoh leng lele banga, Arnon kaimuna chutidiu ahi.
target: Like fluttering birds pushed from the nest, so are the women of Moab at the fords of the Arnon.

source: Thumop unlang, thutan boldoh-un; sunkim laija nalelim chu jan bangin seminlang; akinodohsa selinlang; vahvei chu matsah hih-in.
target: “Make up your mind,” Moab says. “Render a decision. Make your shadow like night— at high noon. Hide the fugitives, do not betray the refugees.

source: Akinodohho chu chenkhompin, Moab misumang pa maija akiselnao hitan, hunama lapa chu akichaija, migamsah pa akingah jehchun gamsunga konin misugenthei ho akisumang tai.
target: Let the Moabite fugitives stay with you; be their shelter from the destroyer.” The oppressor will come to an end, and destruction will cease; the aggressor will vanish from the land.

source: Chule hepina-in laltouna chu kitungdet nintin, hiche chunga chu thudih-a David ponbuh sunga vai ahomding, thu atanding, thutana dih aholding chule chonphatna-a kinoding ahi.
target: In love a throne will be established; in faithfulness a man will sit on it— one from the house of David— one who in judging seeks justice and speeds the cause of righteousness.

source: Moab hoithonahi thu kanajaovin; ama ahoitho lheh jengin; akiletsah nale ahoithona chule alunghan naho jengjong kanajaovin; ahinla ajounaho chu chutilou dingdol ahi.
target: We have heard of Moab’s pride— how great is her arrogance!— of her conceit, her pride and her insolence; but her boasts are empty.

source: Hijeh chun Moab pengjah hen, mitinin Moab ka cheh hen. Ajehchu Kirhareseth kiphudoh jala nalunghempiu; amaho chu akivolhu tahmonga ahiuve.
target: Therefore the Moabites wail, they wail together for Moab. Lament and grieve for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth.

source: Ajehchu Heshbon loujao le Sibmah lengpigui alhasamtai, aphung lhungpiho chu Pathen hephalou pakai hon anasubongun, Jazer alhung taove. Chuin gamthip lailunga ajamle leuvin ahi. Abahho ajamdoh un, twikhanglen galla ajamgalkai taove.
target: The fields of Heshbon wither, the vines of Sibmah also. The rulers of the nations have trampled down the choicest vines, which once reached Jazer and spread toward the desert. Their shoots spread out and went as far as the sea.

source: Hijeh chun Sibmah lengpigui chu Jazer chunga kana bangin kacham-inge; vo Heshbon le Elealeh kamitlhi-in twichap nange; nanipi lai theiho dingleh nachang at nadinga khosap chu athip tai.
target: So I weep, as Jazer weeps, for the vines of Sibmah. Heshbon and Elealeh, I drench you with tears! The shouts of joy over your ripened fruit and over your harvests have been stilled.

source: Chule lou phatah-a kona kipanale thanopna akilamang tan; lengpilei laija penga lasah le khosap jong umlou ding ahitai. Achilhon jong lengpitwi achildoh loudiu ahitai. Alengpiga lonao khosap jong atansahtai.
target: Joy and gladness are taken away from the orchards; no one sings or shouts in the vineyards; no one treads out wine at the presses, for I have put an end to the shouting.

source: Hijeh chun kagiljang hohi Moab te dingin, chule kasung hohi Kirhares dingin selangdah bangin ging'inte.
target: My heart laments for Moab like a harp, my inmost being for Kir Hareseth.

source: Chule hitiding ahi. Moab chu munsanga alungkham akimutengle munthenga tao dingin hungintin, hijongle lolhing louding ahi.
target: When Moab appears at her high place, she only wears herself out; when she goes to her shrine to pray, it is to no avail.

source: Hichehi Pakaiyin chuche laija patna Moab chungchang thu aseichu ahi.
target: This is the word the Lord has already spoken concerning Moab.

source: Ahinla tun Pakaiyin ana seijin, natongho kumsim dungjuija, kumthum sung Moab loupina chu amipite tamtah puma kinoise ding; amoh umsun chu lhomchale doitah hidiu ahi, ati.
target: But now the Lord says: “Within three years, as a servant bound by contract would count them, Moab’s splendor and all her many people will be despised, and her survivors will be very few and feeble.”

source: Damascus pohgih veuvin, Damascus hi khopi khat ahina-a konin akilamang tan, in-gem kiselom hunghidingbou ahi.
target: A prophecy against Damascus: “See, Damascus will no longer be a city but will become a heap of ruins.

source: Aroer khopichu dalhah-in aumtan, kelngoihonte kolna ding maimaibou hung hintin, koimachan akichatsah loudiu ahi.
target: The cities of Aroer will be deserted and left to flocks, which will lie down, with no one to make them afraid.

source: Ephraim'a konin kulpidet beijintin, Damascus'a lenggam le Syria amoh chengjong beiding ahitai. Amaho chu Israel chate loupina tobang hidiu ahi, atin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: The fortified city will disappear from Ephraim, and royal power from Damascus; the remnant of Aram will be like the glory of the Israelites,” declares the Lord Almighty.

source: Hicheni chule hitiding ahi. Jacob loupina chu kemsuh-in tin, chule atahsa thaotah chu jol lha-a gongding ahi.
target: “In that day the glory of Jacob will fade; the fat of his body will waste away.

source: Hiche chu chang atpan changho ahuikhom, akhutna changvuiho a-at banga Rephaim phaichama changvuiho alokhom tobang hiding ahi.
target: It will be as when reapers harvest the standing grain, gathering the grain in their arms— as when someone gleans heads of grain in the Valley of Rephaim.

source: Ahinla olive thingphung kihotlinga, abah sangpen tah vuma aga nile thum umdenna, abah ga phapena lile nga umden bep banga lengpigui kidalha ding ahi, tin Israel Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: Yet some gleanings will remain, as when an olive tree is beaten, leaving two or three olives on the topmost branches, four or five on the fruitful boughs,” declares the Lord , the God of Israel.

source: Hicheni chule min asempa ahinvet ding, chule amitnin Israel mithengpa chu ajabol ding ahi.
target: In that day people will look to their Maker and turn their eyes to the Holy One of Israel.

source: Chule aman amakhutsem maicham ho chu avet tahlou ding, akhutna asemsa thingbomho hihen, milimho hijengjongle, ajaboltah louhel ding ahi.
target: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands, and they will have no regard for the Asherah poles and the incense altars their fingers have made.

source: Hicheni chule akhopi dettahho chu thingbah kidalha Israelte jeh-a abah chungnung pen adalhah-u tobang hiding ahin, hikom chu kamdel ding ahitai.
target: In that day their strong cities, which they left because of the Israelites, will be like places abandoned to thickets and undergrowth. And all will be desolation.

source: Ajehchu nahuhhingpa Pathen nasumilin, nahatna songpi nageldohtapoi. Hijeh chun thingkeh hoihoi kiphun natin, hetkhah lou kiselhuhna koijinate.
target: You have forgotten God your Savior; you have not remembered the Rock, your fortress. Therefore, though you set out the finest plants and plant imported vines,

source: Naphuni maman khandohsah in natin, natu jingkah mama chun khantul tulsah-in nate, ahinla aga lokhomchu lungkhamna kisekhomle lungdon ngahnabei hiding ahi.
target: though on the day you set them out, you make them grow, and on the morning when you plant them, you bring them to bud, yet the harvest will be as nothing in the day of disease and incurable pain.

source: Mipi tamtah twikhanglen kitumging banga ahusao kitol guiguile, twipi kinong lullul banga kinonga, namtin kinongho chu ohe adau ahi!
target: Woe to the many nations that rage— they rage like the raging sea! Woe to the peoples who roar— they roar like the roaring of great waters!

source: Namtin vaipi chu twipi kinong tamtah bangin kingong untin, hijongle Pathen'in amaho phoh intin, amaho gamlatah-a jamdiu; chule lhanga huipin changsi amutlonle bangle chimpei masanga thil kipeimang bangdiu ahi.
target: Although the peoples roar like the roar of surging waters, when he rebukes them they flee far away, driven before the wind like chaff on the hills, like tumbleweed before a gale.

source: Chule vetan nilhah lamle lungkhamna ahijin, jingkah masangin ama anaumjitapon ahi. Hichehi eisuchavai hou chanchu ahin chule eigumang hou vangchan chu ahi.
target: In the evening, sudden terror! Before the morning, they are gone! This is the portion of those who loot us, the lot of those who plunder us.

source: Pathen'in Sudan Jepna Apehding:
target: Woe to the land of whirring wings along the rivers of Cush,

source: Nam thechehsa le ahomsa henga, akipatnuva lhah tugeija tijat umtah mite henga, twikhanglen le vadunglen chunga lekha thing kongsaova palai kisolho tedohsa le kengto chotbehsa, twijin agamu asuhsette nam henga chun thupole kaljangho cheovin ati-e.
target: which sends envoys by sea in papyrus boats over the water. Go, swift messengers, to a people tall and smooth-skinned, to a people feared far and wide, an aggressive nation of strange speech, whose land is divided by rivers.

source: Nangho vannoi'a umho jouse le leichunga chenghon, lhang chunga galponlap ahung kidopsang tengle, veovin lang aman sumkon ahinmut tengle ngaijuvin.
target: All you people of the world, you who live on the earth, when a banner is raised on the mountains, you will see it, and when a trumpet sounds, you will hear it.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin kahenga, keima kicholdong ting, kachenna mun hampa louhing chunga hin chang-at kholum laija daitwi meikai bangin hingel nange ati.
target: This is what the Lord says to me: “I will remain quiet and will look on from my dwelling place, like shimmering heat in the sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”

source: Ajehchu aga lophat masang, amum ahung pilhina, apahjong lengpiga minsa ahunghi tengle, aman abah sipah jam hole abah lenho chu agoma hampa vatna chema abahho asat lhah-a, apaidoh ding ahi.
target: For, before the harvest, when the blossom is gone and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the shoots with pruning knives, and cut down and take away the spreading branches.

source: Hicheho chu molsang ho-a vachaho dingle leisetna ganchaho kidalhah peh ding ahiuvin, vachate chun hichehochu nipilai man na-a, chule gamsaho chun phalbilai man na-a, aneidingu ahitai.
target: They will all be left to the mountain birds of prey and to the wild animals; the birds will feed on them all summer, the wild animals all winter.

source: Hichephat teng chule janel Pakai heng, Janel Pakai min umna Zion lhanga a chu: mipi thechehsa le ahomsaho-a kon, akipat uva lhah tugeija tijat umtah mite-a kona, tedohsa le kengtoa chotbehsa nam mite-a kon, twijin agamu asuhsetho-a kona, thilpeh chu hung kipelut ding ahitai.
target: At that time gifts will be brought to the Lord Almighty from a people tall and smooth-skinned, from a people feared far and wide, an aggressive nation of strange speech, whose land is divided by rivers— the gifts will be brought to Mount Zion, the place of the Name of the Lord Almighty.

source: Egypt pohgih chu veuvin, Pakai chu mei kitol gangtah chunga touva, Egypt gama hungding: chule ama angsunga Egypt gama milim ho chu kichon diu, Egypt mite lungchang chu asunga jun lhading ahi.
target: A prophecy against Egypt: See, the Lord rides on a swift cloud and is coming to Egypt. The idols of Egypt tremble before him, and the hearts of the Egyptians melt with fear.

source: Keiman Egypt mite doudin Egypt mite ma tilingting, amitakipmin asopi adoudiu, amitakipmin aheng akom adouva, khopile khopi, lenggamle lenggam hungkidouto diu ahi.
target: “I will stir up Egyptian against Egyptian— brother will fight against brother, neighbor against neighbor, city against city, kingdom against kingdom.

source: Hichesung chule Egypt mite lhagao chu hungthon nintin, chule hilchahna chu kasuhbei ding ahi. Chutengle amahon milimho le ailhimho, lhakou ho le doithemho henga aholdiu ahi.
target: The Egyptians will lose heart, and I will bring their plans to nothing; they will consult the idols and the spirits of the dead, the mediums and the spiritists.

source: Chule keiman Egypt mite chu vaipo engsetah khat khutna kapehdoh-a; kichat umtah pakai khatnin achunguva vai ahomding ahi; tin Pakai janel Pakai chun aseitai.
target: I will hand the Egyptians over to the power of a cruel master, and a fierce king will rule over them,” declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty.

source: Chule vadunglen ho-a kona twiho hungkanga; vadungho longmanga gothetding ahi.
target: The waters of the river will dry up, and the riverbed will be parched and dry.

source: Chule amahon vadunglen ho chu gamlatah-ah heimang untin, kinga tupna luidunga chu kanga gothet ding: Pumpeng hole aigeho jong golha ding ahi.
target: The canals will stink; the streams of Egypt will dwindle and dry up. The reeds and rushes will wither,

source: Luidung pang le vapangho akeova kijamding; chule luidung panga kithe chanchu golha-a huija lengmang ding; umkit louhel ding ahitai.
target: also the plants along the Nile, at the mouth of the river. Every sown field along the Nile will become parched, will blow away and be no more.

source: Ngamanho jong lunghemuva, luidung ho-a ngakoiho jouse lunghem untin; chuhtwi chunga lensep ho lhasamdiu ahitai.
target: The fishermen will groan and lament, all who cast hooks into the Nile; those who throw nets on the water will pine away.

source: Hiche chungchon chun tupat pon khongho le ponvang khongho chu lungjing diu ahi.
target: Those who work with combed flax will despair, the weavers of fine linen will lose hope.

source: Akibulphuna songho kisubong ding; natong dinga kigongho jouse jong lungjinga umdiu ahitai.
target: The workers in cloth will be dejected, and all the wage earners will be sick at heart.

source: Thonlouva Zoan lengchapate chu ngoldiu; Pharaoh thumopthem michingho thuhil chu lungsetna neilou ahung hitai. Keima miching cha leng luiho chapa kahi tia, Pharaoh henga iti naseiju ham?
target: The officials of Zoan are nothing but fools; the wise counselors of Pharaoh give senseless advice. How can you say to Pharaoh, “I am one of the wise men, a disciple of the ancient kings”?

source: Amaho hoilamba hitaovam? namichingho hoiba hitaovam? Amahochu tun kihilsah inlang, Egypt chunga janel Pakaiyin ipi agon chu amaho hetsah in.
target: Where are your wise men now? Let them show you and make known what the Lord Almighty has planned against Egypt.

source: Zoan lengchapate chu angoltaovin, Noph lengchapate akilhemlha gamtai; amahon jong Egypt mite, chuche phung mite chendetnaho geijin apuimanguve.
target: The officials of Zoan have become fools, the leaders of Memphis are deceived; the cornerstones of her peoples have led Egypt astray.

source: Alah uva chun Pakaiyin lamvaina lhagao achoh halin; chutichun jukhama alohna-a lonlele bangin Egypt mite chu atohnao channa asuhkhelsah uve.
target: The Lord has poured into them a spirit of dizziness; they make Egypt stagger in all that she does, as a drunkard staggers around in his vomit.

source: Egypt dingin alu hihen amei hijongle, lusu bah hihen phaipheng phung hijongle, abolpeh theiding aumpoi.
target: There is nothing Egypt can do— head or tail, palm branch or reed.

source: Hicheni chule Egypt chu numei tobang hidiu ahin; janel Pakai khut thin chu achunguva athin ahijeh-a kichaova tijading ahiuve.
target: In that day the Egyptians will become weaklings. They will shudder with fear at the uplifted hand that the Lord Almighty raises against them.

source: Chule Judah gamchu Egypt tedin tijat umtah hintin, chuche douna dinga janel Pakaiyin agontoh athuhiljeh-a aminphah chu kichacheh diu ahi.
target: And the land of Judah will bring terror to the Egyptians; everyone to whom Judah is mentioned will be terrified, because of what the Lord Almighty is planning against them.

source: Hiche nikho chule Egypt gama khopi nga in Kanaan pao athouva, janel Pakai henga chu kihahsel ding ahiuvin; khatchu manthah na khopi kitiding ahi.
target: In that day five cities in Egypt will speak the language of Canaan and swear allegiance to the Lord Almighty. One of them will be called the City of the Sun.

source: Hicheni chule Egypt gamlailunga chu Pakai maicham khat, chule agamsunga chu Pakaiya songphu khat umding ahi.
target: In that day there will be an altar to the Lord in the heart of Egypt, and a monument to the Lord at its border.

source: Chule Egypt gamsunga janel Pakai dinga hichu melchihna le hettohsahna hiding ahi; ajehchu misugenthei ho jeh-a Pakai henga taoding ahiuvin, chule aman huhhingna le hat chungnung khat ahinsolpeh-a, amahochu ahuhdoh ding ahi.
target: It will be a sign and witness to the Lord Almighty in the land of Egypt. When they cry out to the Lord because of their oppressors, he will send them a savior and defender, and he will rescue them.

source: Chutengle Pakai chu Egypt ho het hitantin, hiche nikho chule Egypt ten Pakai chu ahetdohdiu, chule ganlhaina le thilpeh aneidiu ahi; ahi, Pakai henga kitepna khatna kitep uva asuhbulhitdiu ahi.
target: So the Lord will make himself known to the Egyptians, and in that day they will acknowledge the Lord . They will worship with sacrifices and grain offerings; they will make vows to the Lord and keep them.

source: Chule Pakaiyin Egypt ajepding, ajepna-a asuhdam ding ahi. Amaho Pakai hengtah-a chu hungkileuva, chule aman ataonao angaipeh-a, chule aboldamdiu ahi.
target: The Lord will strike Egypt with a plague; he will strike them and heal them. They will turn to the Lord , and he will respond to their pleas and heal them.

source: Hiche nikho chule Egypt'a kona Assyria geija lamlhongpi khat umding Assyria te Egypt'a, Egypt Assyria a, hunguva Egypt mite chun Assyria mite toh ajenkhomdiu ahitai.
target: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria. The Assyrians will go to Egypt and the Egyptians to Assyria. The Egyptians and Assyrians will worship together.

source: Hiche nikho chule Israel hi Egypt le Assyria bana athumna hiding, chule gamlailunga phattheiboh changtah hunghi ding ahi.
target: In that day Israel will be the third, along with Egypt and Assyria, a blessing on the earth.

source: Janel Pakai chun kami Egypt te leh kakhutsoh Assyria te chule kagoulo Israelte chu phattheiboh changu hen tia aseiding ahi.
target: The Lord Almighty will bless them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria my handiwork, and Israel my inheritance.”

source: Tartan Ashdod na ahunga (Assyria lengpa Sargon in asol lai) Ashdod asatna alah kumchun;
target: In the year that the supreme commander, sent by Sargon king of Assyria, came to Ashdod and attacked and captured it—

source: Hichephat mama chun Pakaiyin Amoz chapa Isaiah hengah aseijin, chenlang nataija khaopon chu sutlhan lang, nakeng phanga konin nakengkoh sutlhan, ati. Chuin aman chutichun abolin, asagoh-in akeng keuvin lam ajottai.
target: at that time the Lord spoke through Isaiah son of Amoz. He said to him, “Take off the sackcloth from your body and the sandals from your feet.” And he did so, going around stripped and barefoot.

source: Chutin Pakaiyin, kasoh Isaiah Egypt le Ethiopia te chunga melchihna le thilkidang dinga kumthum sunga sagohle akeng keuva aumbangchun;
target: Then the Lord said, “Just as my servant Isaiah has gone stripped and barefoot for three years, as a sign and portent against Egypt and Cush,

source: chutia chu Assyria lengpan Egypt te sohchang dinga, Ethiopia gal hing ding, khangdong laile tehse cheng, sagohkeu le kengkeuva Egypt mite jachatsah dinga akhelbuhgei san uva kihohdoh-a, apuimang ding ahi, tin aseije.
target: so the king of Assyria will lead away stripped and barefoot the Egyptian captives and Cushite exiles, young and old, with buttocks bared—to Egypt’s shame.

source: Chule amaho akinepnao Ethiopia le aloupinao Egypt jala kichaova jahchadiu ahi.
target: Those who trusted in Cush and boasted in Egypt will be dismayed and put to shame.

source: Chule hiche twikol gama umho hin hicheni chule, vetaovin ikinepnao chutichu ahi, Assyria lengpa-a kona ikihuhdoh nadiuva kithopina hola hoilama ijamdiu hija, iti ihoidoh diuham? atidiu ahi.
target: In that day the people who live on this coast will say, ‘See what has happened to those we relied on, those we fled to for help and deliverance from the king of Assyria! How then can we escape?’ ”

source: Twipi nelgam pohgih, lhanglam chimpei hungkipei bangin chutichun nelgamle tijat umtah gama konin ahunge.
target: A prophecy against the Desert by the Sea: Like whirlwinds sweeping through the southland, an invader comes from the desert, from a land of terror.

source: Lungkham umtah thilmu khat kahenga akiphongin, kitahlou bolpan kitahlouvin abolin, misumang pan mi asumange. Vo Elam kaltouvin, vo Media gaum kimvelun, khoisatna jouse kasuhtang ahitai.
target: A dire vision has been shown to me: The traitor betrays, the looter takes loot. Elam, attack! Media, lay siege! I will bring to an end all the groaning she caused.

source: Hijeh chun kataihohi natna-in adimin; numei naosonat in aheh bangin, natna chun eiman chomtai. Hichu kajan kakunin kho mutheilou jennin kalungkhamtan ahi.
target: At this my body is racked with pain, pangs seize me, like those of a woman in labor; I am staggered by what I hear, I am bewildered by what I see.

source: Kalungsung ahaisamtan, thil gimneitah khatnin eikichat sahtai. Kanopna janchu aman kadingin kichatnan aleheitai.
target: My heart falters, fear makes me tremble; the twilight I longed for has become a horror to me.

source: Dokhang chu dovin, daiveina insanga chun ve jingin, neuvin, donun; kipat un, nangho pipuiho, lumdal chu thao uvin.
target: They set the tables, they spread the rugs, they eat, they drink! Get up, you officers, oil the shields!

source: Ajehchu hitihin kajah-a aseijin, Pakaiyin kahenga, chen, khongah khat koijin amu muchu phondoh sah-in ati.
target: This is what the Lord says to me: “Go, post a lookout and have him report what he sees.

source: Chuin aman kangtalai khat sakola tou mi kopkhat toh, sangan kangtalai khat, sangongsao ho kangtalai khat amun, chuin gunchu tahle lunglut tah in angaijin ahi.
target: When he sees chariots with teams of horses, riders on donkeys or riders on camels, let him be alert, fully alert.”

source: Chuin ama keipi bahkai bangin apengin, Pakai keima insang chunga kading jingin, chule jankhovah in kapansatna-a kaume.
target: And the lookout shouted, “Day after day, my lord, I stand on the watchtower; every night I stay at my post.
