source: Chule vetan, hiche munahin miho kangtalai khat, sakol chungtou kopkhat toh ahungin ahi. Chuin aman ahindonbut nin, Babylon achimtai, achimtai, amanu pathen semthu milim jouse aman tolah avobong gamtai, ati.
target: Look, here comes a man in a chariot with a team of horses. And he gives back the answer: ‘Babylon has fallen, has fallen! All the images of its gods lie shattered on the ground!’ ”

source: Vo kachang mola kavohsa kaphola kachang ho, Israel Pathen, janel ho Pakaiya kona kanajah chu naheng uva kaphondoh ahitai.
target: My people who are crushed on the threshing floor, I tell you what I have heard from the Lord Almighty, from the God of Israel.

source: Dumah pohgih chu, Aman Seir'a konin eihin kouvin, khongahpa, jana ipi soh am? Khongahpa jana ipi soh am? ati.
target: A prophecy against Dumah: Someone calls to me from Seir, “Watchman, what is left of the night? Watchman, what is left of the night?”

source: Khongahpa chun jingkah, chule janjong ahung naitai. Nakholtoh nomule kholtoh-un, hungkileuvin, hungun, ati.
target: The watchman replies, “Morning is coming, but also the night. If you would ask, then ask; and come back yet again.”

source: Arabia te pohgih chu, Vo Dedanim kholjinho, nangho Arabia gammang sunga nagedingu ahi.
target: A prophecy against Arabia: You caravans of Dedanites, who camp in the thickets of Arabia,

source: Tema gama chengho chun adangchahpa twi ahindop peh-un, galjampa chu amahon changlhah-in avah uve.
target: bring water for the thirsty; you who live in Tema, bring food for the fugitives.

source: Ajehchu amaho chemjam'a kon, chemjam kisatdohsa-a kon, chule thalpi kijebongsa-a kon, chule gal nasatah-a kona hungjam ahiuve.
target: They flee from the sword, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow and from the heat of battle.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin kahenga hitihin aseije; kithalah kumho dungjuija kumkhat sunga Kedarte loupina jouse beisohding ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says to me: “Within one year, as a servant bound by contract would count it, all the splendor of Kedar will come to an end.

source: Ajehchu Kedar chate thal kapthem le galhat hochu kilhomsah ding ahi. Ajehchu Pakai Israel Pathen'in hichehi aseisa ahitai.
target: The survivors of the archers, the warriors of Kedar, will be few.” The Lord , the God of Israel, has spoken.

source: Thilmuna phaicham pohgih. Tu-a ipi hahsatna uma, in chunga nabon chaova nakalu hitam?
target: A prophecy against the Valley of Vision: What troubles you now, that you have all gone up on the roofs,

source: Nangma husagin na dimset, khopi pohcheichoi, kipahtah khopi; napasal kithat ho chu chemjam'a kithat le galsatna a thi ahipouve.
target: you town so full of commotion, you city of tumult and revelry? Your slain were not killed by the sword, nor did they die in battle.

source: Navaihom hou abonun ajamkhomun, thalthem hon amaho akan khomun; nanga kona gamlha tah-a jamdoh jouse chu abonin akangomun ahi.
target: All your leaders have fled together; they have been captured without using the bow. All you who were caught were taken prisoner together, having fled while the enemy was still far away.

source: Hijeh-a chu kati ahi, keija konin achomlam veuvin; kamite chanu kisuhmang jeh-a haka-a kakading ahi, lhepbi dingin neigo hih-un.
target: Therefore I said, “Turn away from me; let me weep bitterly. Do not try to console me over the destruction of my people.”

source: Ajehchu tuni hi lungkhamna le kengto-a kichil thangna chule gao thilmuna phaichama janelho Pakai Pathen dinga lungnohphahna le, kul bangho kisuhchimna le mol chungho-a kana nikho chu ahi.
target: The Lord, the Lord Almighty, has a day of tumult and trampling and terror in the Valley of Vision, a day of battering down walls and of crying out to the mountains.

source: Elam mihon livathei akengun, mihem touna sakol kangtalai le sakolchung touhotoh alhonuvin, Kir mihon lumdal chu ahohdoh-uvin ahi.
target: Elam takes up the quiver, with her charioteers and horses; Kir uncovers the shield.

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi, Na phaicham deichungnung chu kangtalai dimset ding ahi, sakolchung touho chu kotpiphunga galvonpuma kigoldiu ahi.
target: Your choicest valleys are full of chariots, and horsemen are posted at the city gates.

source: Chuin aman Judah pondal kikhuna chu ahohdoh-in, chule hiche nikho chun gammanga galmanchah in chu navetai.
target: The Lord stripped away the defenses of Judah, and you looked in that day to the weapons in the Palace of the Forest.

source: Nanghon David khopi selaiho jongchu namutaove, hichu tamtah ahi. Chuin twikul noinunga twiho chu nagom khom taove.
target: You saw that the walls of the City of David were broken through in many places; you stored up water in the Lower Pool.

source: Chuin Jerusalem in hochu nasim uvin, chule in hochu kulbang semna dingin naphe lhaove.
target: You counted the buildings in Jerusalem and tore down houses to strengthen the wall.

source: Twikul luija hunglong dingin kulbangho kah-a chun twilam khatjong nalaijun; ahinla chuche sempa lamchu nave hih-un, sotna patna hingong tohpa jong chu nanahsah pouve.
target: You built a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the Old Pool, but you did not look to the One who made it, or have regard for the One who planned it long ago.

source: Hiche laichun janel Pakai Pathen'in akapdin, alunghemdin, alu voutoldin chule khaodip ponna atai kigahdin mi akouve.
target: The Lord, the Lord Almighty, called you on that day to weep and to wail, to tear out your hair and put on sackcloth.

source: Chule ven thanopnale kipanaho, bongchal ho kithana le kelngoi ho kithana, sanehna le lengpitwi dona hohi hungun neuhitin, donuhite, ajehchu jingle ithidiu ahitai.
target: But see, there is joy and revelry, slaughtering of cattle and killing of sheep, eating of meat and drinking of wine! “Let us eat and drink,” you say, “for tomorrow we die!”

source: Chule hichehi janel Pakaiyin kanabenga anaphondohsa ahin, thonlouhella hiche khansetnahi nathi kahseuva nangho-a kona kisutheng louhel ding ahi, tin janel Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: The Lord Almighty has revealed this in my hearing: “Till your dying day this sin will not be atoned for,” says the Lord, the Lord Almighty.

source: Janel Pakai Pathen chun hitin aseije, chenlang hiche neichingpa hengle insung chunga vaipo, Shebna heng ngeija chun gaseijin,
target: This is what the Lord, the Lord Almighty, says: “Go, say to this steward, to Shebna the palace administrator:

source: Ama dinga sangtah-a lhan kilaija, amadinga songpi sunga chendetna in kisem banga, hichemunahi ipi naneija, koi naneija lhan nakilai ham?
target: What are you doing here and who gave you permission to cut out a grave for yourself here, hewing your grave on the height and chiseling your resting place in the rock?

source: Vetan, Pakaiyin thahat tah-a gal hinga nakaimanga, nakhu khum teiding ahi.
target: “Beware, the Lord is about to take firm hold of you and hurl you away, you mighty man.

source: Aman nangma thonlouva pumhatna gamlen lama lumbeng banga kipeibong bonga napeiding ahin, chua nathiden ding, chua chu naloupina kangtalai chu napupa insung jachatna sohding ahi.
target: He will roll you up tightly like a ball and throw you into a large country. There you will die and there the chariots you were so proud of will become a disgrace to your master’s house.

source: Keiman naum na-a konin nangma deldoh ingting, napipui na-a kona aman naloilhah ding ahi.
target: I will depose you from your office, and you will be ousted from your position.

source: Chule hiche nikho chule hitiding ahi: Keiman kalhacha Hilkiah chapa Eliakim chu kakouding ahi.
target: “In that day I will summon my servant, Eliakim son of Hilkiah.

source: Keiman nasangkhol chol ama ahpeh ingting, nakonggah-in ama hatsah ingting navaipoh na akhutna kapeh ding ahi. Chule ama Jerusalem'a chenghole Judah insung mite pa-a pangding ahitai.
target: I will clothe him with your robe and fasten your sash around him and hand your authority over to him. He will be a father to those who live in Jerusalem and to the people of Judah.

source: Chule David insung kot heh alengkouva kakhaija, chutia chu aman ahonle koimachan akha theilou ding, aman akhale koimachan ahontheilou ding ahi.
target: I will place on his shoulder the key to the house of David; what he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.

source: Chule keiman amachu mundet tah-a kikilbeh banga kasuhdet ding; amachu apa insung dinga laltouna loupi chu hiding ahi.
target: I will drive him like a peg into a firm place; he will become a seat of honor for the house of his father.

source: Chule amahon amachunga chu apa insung loupina jouse, atu achate le asonho, bel neocha jouse belcha khonho-a pat twipai geija achunga akhaidiu ahi.
target: All the glory of his family will hang on him: its offspring and offshoots—all its lesser vessels, from the bowls to all the jars.

source: Janel Pakaiyin aseije, hiche nikho chule, mundet tah-a kikildet thihkil chu kibotdoh intin, kisatlha-a lhamang ding ahi. Chule achunga um pohgih chu kisatlhading ahi. Ajehchu hichehi Pakaiyin aseisa ahitai.
target: “In that day,” declares the Lord Almighty, “the peg driven into the firm place will give way; it will be sheared off and will fall, and the load hanging on it will be cut down.” The Lord has spoken.

source: Tyre pohgih. Nangho Tarshish kongho, pengun! Ajehchu in umlou hel, alutna ding umlouhel ahinadinga hiche chu kisukamhela ahitai. Chittim gama kona hichehi ahenguva hung kiphonga ahi.
target: A prophecy against Tyre: Wail, you ships of Tarshish! For Tyre is destroyed and left without house or harbor. From the land of Cyprus word has come to them.

source: Twikol gama cheng nangho thipchetnin umun, Zidon mi sumkolvei, twikhanglen palgalkai lehon alodimsoh taove.
target: Be silent, you people of the island and you merchants of Sidon, whom the seafarers have enriched.

source: Chule twilenho panga Sihor muchi, luipang dunga chang ki-at chu amanu chanding ahin, amanu chu namtin kailhang ahi.
target: On the great waters came the grain of the Shihor; the harvest of the Nile was the revenue of Tyre, and she became the marketplace of the nations.

source: Vo Zidon, jahchan umin; ajehchu twipin thu aseijin, twipi hatna ngeichun naoso natna kathoh khapon, chate jong kahingkhapoi, gollhangho jong kavahdoh khapoi, nungahthengho jong kaseiletsah khapoi, atin ahi.
target: Be ashamed, Sidon, and you fortress of the sea, for the sea has spoken: “I have neither been in labor nor given birth; I have neither reared sons nor brought up daughters.”

source: Egypt thudol thulhut kijabanga chu, Tyre thulhut na chu amaho lungna lhehdiu ahi.
target: When word comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report from Tyre.

source: Nangho twikol'a chengte, Tarshish a galkai junlang samun.
target: Cross over to Tarshish; wail, you people of the island.

source: Hichehi gollui khanglui nikho-a mi chuham? Akengphangin gamlatah-a chedinga alhohmang ding ahi.
target: Is this your city of revelry, the old, old city, whose feet have taken her to settle in far-off lands?

source: Lallukhuh khuh khopi, chua sumkolvei ho pipuiho jeng hija chua kiveihojong leisetna ja umtejeng hija, hiche Tyre khopi douna gong'a chu koiham?
target: Who planned this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traders are renowned in the earth?

source: Janel Pakai chun leisetna kiletsah le ja-umtah ho suhnemna dinga hichehi anagon ahi.
target: The Lord Almighty planned it, to bring down her pride in all her splendor and to humble all who are renowned on the earth.

source: Vo Tarshish chanu, vadung khat bangin nagamsung chu jotpaitan, nahatbe nading dang aumtapoi.
target: Till your land as they do along the Nile, Daughter Tarshish, for you no longer have a harbor.

source: Aman twikhanglen chunga akhut ajah-in, lenggam ho ahotlinge. Pakaiyin chuche sumkolveipa khopi douna kulpidet suhmangna dingin thu apetai.
target: The Lord has stretched out his hand over the sea and made its kingdoms tremble. He has given an order concerning Phoenicia that her fortresses be destroyed.

source: Chuin aman vo genthei thoh nungah theng, Zidon chanu, nangma nakipajom louhel ding ahi. Kipat inlang, Chittim'a galkaijin, chua jongchu choldona namulouhel ding ahi, ati.
target: He said, “No more of your reveling, Virgin Daughter Sidon, now crushed! “Up, cross over to Cyprus; even there you will find no rest.”

source: Chaldea gamhi vetan! Assyria miten amaho dinga gamthipma chengho amu kahseuvin hiche mitehi aumtapouve. Amahon insangho leng inpiho asauvin, ahin hichun manthah na-a ahin lhuttai.
target: Look at the land of the Babylonians, this people that is now of no account! The Assyrians have made it a place for desert creatures; they raised up their siege towers, they stripped its fortresses bare and turned it into a ruin.

source: Nangho Tarshish kong inneiho; pengun, ajehchu nathahatna beihela suhmang ahitai.
target: Wail, you ships of Tarshish; your fortress is destroyed!

source: Chule hiche nikho chule hitiding ahi, lengkhat nikhoho dungjuija Tyre chu kum somsagi suhmila hung umding, kum somsagi kichaitengle noti banga Tyre'in la asahding ahi.
target: At that time Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years, the span of a king’s life. But at the end of these seventy years, it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the prostitute:

source: Suhmila anaum notinu, nangman selangdah choi jinlang, khopichu velin, nangma geldoh-a naum theina dingin aw nguiheu vin, la tamtah san.
target: “Take up a harp, walk through the city, you forgotten prostitute; play the harp well, sing many a song, so that you will be remembered.”

source: Chule kum somsagi akichai joutengle hung hitiding ahi. Pakaiyin Tyre chu vilintin, amanu athalahnu henga hungkile ding, chule leiset chunga vannoi lenggam ho jouseto jong hungchonthanghoi ding ahi.
target: At the end of seventy years, the Lord will deal with Tyre. She will return to her lucrative prostitution and will ply her trade with all the kingdoms on the face of the earth.

source: Chule amanu kiveina thilho le athalah chu Pakaiya dinga atheng hiding: hichu kikhol louding, koijong kikoikhom louding ahi; ajehchu kiveina thilho chu Pakai masanga chenghon nengtah-a anehdiu chule sottah aneidiu ponsiljoh hiding ahi.
target: Yet her profit and her earnings will be set apart for the Lord ; they will not be stored up or hoarded. Her profits will go to those who live before the Lord , for abundant food and fine clothes.

source: Veuvin, Pakaiyin leiset hi keuhel le agoh-in anasemin, chule akhup athalin aleh-in, chua chengho chu athecheh tai.
target: See, the Lord is going to lay waste the earth and devastate it; he will ruin its face and scatter its inhabitants—

source: Chutia chu, mipi aum banga thempu uma; sohpa aum banga pakaipa uma; sohnu aum banga pakainu uma; achopa aum banga ajohpa uma; ahompa aum banga abatpa uma; sumthoi lapa aum banga sumthoi pepa uma; batna lapa aum banga batna pepa umah ahi.
target: it will be the same for priest as for people, for the master as for his servant, for the mistress as for her servant, for seller as for buyer, for borrower as for lender, for debtor as for creditor.

source: Leiset chu keuhela suhchatvai gam hela umding ahi; ajehchu Pakaiyin hiche thuhi anasei ahitai.
target: The earth will be completely laid waste and totally plundered. The Lord has spoken this word.

source: Vannoihi alunghemin agolhatai. Vannoihi akemsuh-in agolhatai. Leisetna mikiletsahho akemsuh taove.
target: The earth dries up and withers, the world languishes and withers, the heavens languish with the earth.

source: Leiset hi achengho noija suhboh-in aumtai; ajehchu amahon danho chu asukhelun, chondanthu akhelun, tonsot thulhun asukehtaove.
target: The earth is defiled by its people; they have disobeyed the laws, violated the statutes and broken the everlasting covenant.

source: Hijeh chun leiset hi gaosapmin avalhumtai, asunga chengho chu akamdeltai; hijeh chun leija chengho akavamun, mi lhomcha bou aumtai.
target: Therefore a curse consumes the earth; its people must bear their guilt. Therefore earth’s inhabitants are burned up, and very few are left.

source: Lengpitwi thah alunghemin, lengpitwi alhasamin, lungsunga kipahho jouse akhoisataove.
target: The new wine dries up and the vine withers; all the merrymakers groan.

source: Khongchaho thanopna akichaijin, kipahtah-a umho husa chu abeijin, selangdah thanopna atangtai.
target: The joyful timbrels are stilled, the noise of the revelers has stopped, the joyful harp is silent.

source: Amahon judon le lasah akop loudiu ahi; khamnathei donhi adonho dinga khatah ahi.
target: No longer do they drink wine with a song; the beer is bitter to its drinkers.

source: Lung nohphahna khopi chu akisumang tai; Koimacha alunglut thei louna dingin in jouse akikhahchahtai.
target: The ruined city lies desolate; the entrance to every house is barred.

source: Ju jeh-in lamlhongpi ho-ah kho akisame; kipana jouse athimin, gamsung thanopna jouse abeitai.
target: In the streets they cry out for wine; all joy turns to gloom, all joyful sounds are banished from the earth.

source: Khopisung ahomkeovin akidalhan, chule kotpi chu manthah na-in akivosen ahi.
target: The city is left in ruins, its gate is battered to pieces.

source: Gam lailung miholah-a hitia ahung um tengtah le, Olive thingphung kihotling tobangle lengpiga loujaova apul kilohkhom tobanga chu hung umding ahi.
target: So will it be on the earth and among the nations, as when an olive tree is beaten, or as when gleanings are left after the grape harvest.

source: Amahon a-aw hinsam doh-un tin, Pakai loupina lan saovintin; twikhanglen'a kona gingtah-a asapdohdiu ahi.
target: They raise their voices, they shout for joy; from the west they acclaim the Lord ’s majesty.

source: Hijeh chun nanghon Pakai, Israel Pakai Pathen min ngeichu mei le twipi chule twikol gamho-a chun choi-an uvin.
target: Therefore in the east give glory to the Lord ; exalt the name of the Lord , the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea.

source: Leiset kolmonga konin la kisaho ijaovin, michonpha te henga loupina umhen. Ahinla keima kalhasam tultul, kalhasam tultul tai; ohe! ada-a kahi, jouva mibol hon jouvin eiboluvin; adihlouva mibol hon jouvin eihabol lheh-un ahi, katin ahi.
target: From the ends of the earth we hear singing: “Glory to the Righteous One.” But I said, “I waste away, I waste away! Woe to me! The treacherous betray! With treachery the treacherous betray!”

source: Vo leisetna chengho, kichatna le kokhuh, chule thang nachung uva aume.
target: Terror and pit and snare await you, people of the earth.

source: Chule hitiding ahi: Tijatna husa-a kona jam-a chu kokhuh-a lhalutding, chule kokhuh-a kona hungdoh-a chu thanga ohding ahi; ajehchu chungsanga bangkot ho akihongin, chule leiset bulho akihotlinge.
target: Whoever flees at the sound of terror will fall into a pit; whoever climbs out of the pit will be caught in a snare. The floodgates of the heavens are opened, the foundations of the earth shake.

source: Leiset nasatah-in akehlhan, leiset hi ajunlha thengin, leiset hi nasatah-in akilong tai.
target: The earth is broken up, the earth is split asunder, the earth is violently shaken.

source: Leiset hi jukham banga kipei lonle-a, buh neocha banga kichon mangding ahi. Chule chua suhkhelna chu gihsatah-a achunga umding, chule hichu lhu-a kiphongkit louhel ding ahitai.
target: The earth reels like a drunkard, it sways like a hut in the wind; so heavy upon it is the guilt of its rebellion that it falls—never to rise again.

source: Chule hicheni chule hitiding ahi, Pakaiyin chunga um janel le leiset lengho chu talen apehding ahi.
target: In that day the Lord will punish the powers in the heavens above and the kings on the earth below.

source: Chule sohchangho kokhuh sunga akikoikhom banga, amaho kikhom khomdiu, songkul sunga kikhachah khumdiu, nitamtah joule amaho kivil ding ahiuve.
target: They will be herded together like prisoners bound in a dungeon; they will be shut up in prison and be punished after many days.

source: Chutengle janel Pakai chu Zion lhang le Jerusalem'a chule upaho anga loupitah-a alengchan tengle lha thimintin, nisa maimoh ding ahi.
target: The moon will be dismayed, the sun ashamed; for the Lord Almighty will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and before its elders—with great glory.

source: Vo Pakai, nangma ka Pathen nahin, nangma choi-an ningting, namin vahchoi jinge; ajehchu nangin datmo um thilho nabolin; malaija nathumop ho chu tahsan umle thudih ahi.
target: Lord , you are my God; I will exalt you and praise your name, for in perfect faithfulness you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago.

source: Ajehchu khopijong leivui nasosah-in, hoidohna khopi chu nasumangin, khopi umlouna dinga gamdang mite leng in-piho chu nasusen, hichu kisadohkit louhel ding ahitai.
target: You have made the city a heap of rubble, the fortified town a ruin, the foreigners’ stronghold a city no more; it will never be rebuilt.

source: Hijeh chun mihatten nangma loupisah-un natin, tijat um namtin vaipiho khopi'n nagindiu ahi.
target: Therefore strong peoples will honor you; cities of ruthless nations will revere you.

source: Ajehchu nangma vaichate din thahatna nahin, alhasamte hesoh laija thahatna nahin, khopihui hatlaija belding nahin, nisa noija lim nahin, khopihuijin kulbang anuh tobangkhu nahije.
target: You have been a refuge for the poor, a refuge for the needy in their distress, a shelter from the storm and a shade from the heat. For the breath of the ruthless is like a storm driving against a wall

source: Gamdang miteho husa chu mun go laija nisa sat banga nasuhnem ding; meilhang lima asa jengjong chu nasuhnem ding ahi. Kichat umtah abahho chu kisunem ding ahi.
target: and like the heat of the desert. You silence the uproar of foreigners; as heat is reduced by the shadow of a cloud, so the song of the ruthless is stilled.

source: Hiche molsanga hi janel Pakaiyin, lengpituichih-a mijouse golvah, thil thaova golvah, thil thao lhintwi dimsetna, lengpitwi chih kilhithengsella golvah abolding ahi.
target: On this mountain the Lord Almighty will prepare a feast of rich food for all peoples, a banquet of aged wine— the best of meats and the finest of wines.

source: Aman hiche molsang hi namtin jouse chunga kikhukhum maikhule, namtin jouse chunga kidah ponlukhuh chu asuhmang ding ahitai.
target: On this mountain he will destroy the shroud that enfolds all peoples, the sheet that covers all nations;

source: Aman thina chu jona-a aval lhuma; chule Pakai Pathen'in mai jouse-a kona mitlhiho atheh hulding, chule leiset pumpi jouse-a kona amite kiphona alahmang ding ahi: ajehchu Pakaiyin hichehi asei ahi.
target: he will swallow up death forever. The Sovereign Lord will wipe away the tears from all faces; he will remove his people’s disgrace from all the earth. The Lord has spoken.

source: Chule hiche nikho chule hitia kisei ding ahi. Veuvin, hichehi i-Pathen'u eihon ingao, eihuhhing dinguva amahi ahi. Hichehi eihon ina ngajingu Pakai chu ahi. Ami huhhing na-a eiho ikipaova itha nopdiu ahitai.
target: In that day they will say, “Surely this is our God; we trusted in him, and he saved us. This is the Lord , we trusted in him; let us rejoice and be glad in his salvation.”

source: Ajehchu Pakai khutchu hiche lhanga hi kingama, changpol eh-molla kon akilholhah banga, ama noija Moab chu chotbeh-a umding ahitai.
target: The hand of the Lord will rest on this mountain; but Moab will be trampled in their land as straw is trampled down in the manure.

source: Twijap pan twijapna dinga akhut ajah banga, aman alah uva akhut ajahding ahi. Chule aman akiletsah naochu akhutnuva achomdoh houtoh asotlhahtha ding ahi.
target: They will stretch out their hands in it, as swimmers stretch out their hands to swim. God will bring down their pride despite the cleverness of their hands.

source: Chule akulpidet kulbang sangho chu asuhnempeh-a akoinema, tolgeija, leivui changeija asotlhah ding ahi.
target: He will bring down your high fortified walls and lay them low; he will bring them down to the ground, to the very dust.

source: Chuche nikho tengchule hiche la hi Judah gamma kisading ahi; keihon khopi dettah khat kaneijun; Pathen'in huhhingna chu kulbanghole kulpiho dinga agetding ahi.
target: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; God makes salvation its walls and ramparts.

source: Nam chonphate, thutah nit mite alut theina dingun, nanghon kotpi chu hong lennun.
target: Open the gates that the righteous nation may enter, the nation that keeps faith.

source: Nachunga alungthim chensah chu chamna kimkeija navet tupding ahi. Ajehchu aman nangma natahsanin ahi.
target: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in you.

source: Nanghon Pakai chu a-imatih chanin tahsanun. Ajehchu Pakai Jehovah'a chu tonsot thahatna chu uma ahi.
target: Trust in the Lord forever, for the Lord , the Lord himself, is the Rock eternal.

source: Ajehchu sangtah-a chengho chu aman ahinpolhan; khopi sangtah chu akoinemin, tol geija akoinemtai; aman leivui geijin ahinpolhai.
target: He humbles those who dwell on high, he lays the lofty city low; he levels it to the ground and casts it down to the dust.

source: Mivaichate kenghole, lhasamte kalsonho, ngeichu akenga achotbeh ding ahi.
target: Feet trample it down— the feet of the oppressed, the footsteps of the poor.

source: Michonpha te lampi chu kitahna ahin, nang, lungdihpen chun mikitah lampi chu naleptohjin ahi.
target: The path of the righteous is level; you, the Upright One, make the way of the righteous smooth.

source: Ahi, nathutanlhahna lampia chun, vo Pakai, nangma kangah jingui; kahinnaovin alha ngaipen chu namin le nangma geldohjing ding ahi.
target: Yes, Lord , walking in the way of your laws, we wait for you; your name and renown are the desire of our hearts.

source: Janteng kahinna-in nalhangaijin ahi. Ahi, kasunga um lhagao chun jingkah matah-in nangma nahol inge. Ajehchu nathutanlhahnaho leija aumteng, vannoi'a chengten chonphatna chu kijil unte.
target: My soul yearns for you in the night; in the morning my spirit longs for you. When your judgments come upon the earth, the people of the world learn righteousness.

source: Migilou khohsahna musah jengle chun chonphatna kimudoh dehponte; lungdihna gama chun aman dihlou tah-in thilbol'intin Pakai lalna chu mudohponte.
target: But when grace is shown to the wicked, they do not learn righteousness; even in a land of uprightness they go on doing evil and do not regard the majesty of the Lord .

source: Pakai, nakhut nadopsang tengle amahon mupouvinnate. Ahinla mihochunga athangset jeh-un mudoh untin; jahchadiu ahi. Ahi, namelmate meichun amaho akahlih gamdiu ahi.
target: Lord , your hand is lifted high, but they do not see it. Let them see your zeal for your people and be put to shame; let the fire reserved for your enemies consume them.

source: Pakai, nangman keiho dinga chamna neisuhdet peh dingu ahi. Ajehchu nangman kanatoh jouseu jong neitohpeh taove.
target: Lord , you establish peace for us; all that we have accomplished you have done for us.

source: Vo Pakai, ka Pathen'u nang hilou pakai danghon kachunguva vai ahomtai.
target: Lord our God, other lords besides you have ruled over us, but your name alone do we honor.

source: Amaho athi ahiuvin, hing loudiu ahiuve: Amaho athi ahiuvin, thou talou ding ahiuve. Hijeh chun nangin amaho navilin, nasumangin, ahettheinao jouse jong naman sah-in ahi.
target: They are now dead, they live no more; their spirits do not rise. You punished them and brought them to ruin; you wiped out all memory of them.

source: Hiche nam mite chu napunsah-in; O Pakai, nangman hiche nam mite chu napunsah tan; Nangma choi-atnin na-umtai; Nangin hichu gamlatah leiset kolmang geijin nakithan sahtai.
target: You have enlarged the nation, Lord ; you have enlarged the nation. You have gained glory for yourself; you have extended all the borders of the land.

source: Pakai, lungkhamin amahon nangma naholun, nagimbolna achunguva aumteng hatah-in ataovun ahi.
target: Lord , they came to you in their distress; when you disciplined them, they could barely whisper a prayer.

source: Nupi naovop asophat ahung naija, anatna nachoi choija ahung pendoh bangin; Vo Pakai, nangma mitmun chutobang chu kanahiuve.
target: As a pregnant woman about to give birth writhes and cries out in her pain, so were we in your presence, Lord .

source: Keihon nao kavopmun, kana-uvin, hui lhohdohle kabangui, leijahin huhhingnadol ima kabolpouvin; vannoi'a cheng hojong lhujong alhupouve.
target: We were with child, we writhed in labor, but we gave birth to wind. We have not brought salvation to the earth, and the people of the world have not come to life.

source: Namithiho chu kamithilong toh thoudoh uva, hing khomdiu ahi. Leivuija cheng nangho thou vunlang la saovin. Ajehchu nadaitwi chu hampa louhingho daitwi bang ahin, leijin mithiho chu ahinledoh ding ahi.
target: But your dead will live, Lord ; their bodies will rise— let those who dwell in the dust wake up and shout for joy— your dew is like the dew of the morning; the earth will give birth to her dead.

source: Hungun kamite, na-indan sunguva lutnun lang, nakotnu kikha khum uvin; lungnat natah akichai kah-in, chomkhat tobang kiselmang uvin.
target: Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut the doors behind you; hide yourselves for a little while until his wrath has passed by.

source: Ajehchu veuvin, leisetna chengte akhansetnao jeh-a talen pedingin Pakai chu aumna mun'a konin ahung potdoh tai. Leisetnin jong athisan chu asellou ding ahin; chule amithiho jong akhutah louding ahi.
target: See, the Lord is coming out of his dwelling to punish the people of the earth for their sins. The earth will disclose the blood shed on it; the earth will conceal its slain no longer.

source: Hiche nikho chule Pakaiyin achemjam hemtah lentahle lhoutah-a chu leviathan gul ngongle leviathan gul kiveikol ngeng nung chu talen apeh-a; chule twikhanglen'a um dragon chu athading ahi.
target: In that day, the Lord will punish with his sword— his fierce, great and powerful sword— Leviathan the gliding serpent, Leviathan the coiling serpent; he will slay the monster of the sea.

source: Hiche nikho chule; lengpitwi san lengpilei, amanu henga la saovin.
target: In that day— “Sing about a fruitful vineyard:

source: Pakai kiti keimahi, tuhdetpa kahin; phat tinin twichapminge, achutiloule min sukhante, tia sunle jana kavettupding ahi.
target: I, the Lord , watch over it; I water it continually. I guard it day and night so that no one may harm it.

source: Keija lungsatna aumpoi, galla eidou dinga koijin lingle khao chu akoiding ham? Keima alah uva kache-a, kahalchap ding ahi.
target: I am not angry. If only there were briers and thorns confronting me! I would march against them in battle; I would set them all on fire.

source: Ahiloule eikichampi theina dingin, kahatnahin kivonhen, chutile eikichampi ding ahi.
target: Or else let them come to me for refuge; let them make peace with me, yes, let them make peace with me.”

source: Aman Jacob mite ahungho chu ajung khosah ding ahin; Israelte mum doh-a pahlhading, chule leiset chunghi aga dimset ding;
target: In days to come Jacob will take root, Israel will bud and blossom and fill all the world with fruit.

source: Ama jepho ajep bangtah a chu avoh hitam? Ahiloule ama thatte kitha banga chu amachu kithatna hitam?
target: Has the Lord struck her as he struck down those who struck her? Has she been killed as those were killed who killed her?

source: Solam hui anun banga, nangman amanu chu nalungsat na-a nanodoh-a, chule gal le sohchan na-a naumsah ding ahi
target: By warfare and exile you contend with her— with his fierce blast he drives her out, as on a day the east wind blows.

source: Hijeh chun hiche hin Jacob khansetna chu asop ngima, hichehi achonset lahmangna ding chu ahin, ngunsong kivochip jengjung banga maicham songho abol tengle thingbong hole, milimho dingdoh talou ding ahi.
target: By this, then, will Jacob’s guilt be atoned for, and this will be the full fruit of the removal of his sin: When he makes all the altar stones to be like limestone crushed to pieces, no Asherah poles or incense altars will be left standing.

source: Kulpi kikhokhum khopi jongchu kamhel intin, chenna munchu kidalha-a gamthip banga umding; chua bongnou kivah-a, chua chu kolding, hichea thingbaho chu anehjou ding ahi.
target: The fortified city stands desolate, an abandoned settlement, forsaken like the wilderness; there the calves graze, there they lie down; they strip its branches bare.

source: Abahho chu agot tengle mangthah intin, numei ho hunga meija atidiu ahi. Ajehchu hetkhen themna neilou mite ahijeh-un, asempao chun achunguva hepina aneilouding, agongdoh paovin khohsahna amusah louhel ding ahi.
target: When its twigs are dry, they are broken off and women come and make fires with them. For this is a people without understanding; so their Maker has no compassion on them, and their Creator shows them no favor.

source: Chule hiche nikho chule hitiding ahi: Pakaiyin vadunglen kama pat Egypt vachadung geijin long'intin, chule vo Israel chate nangho khat khatna naki khopdiu ahi.
target: In that day the Lord will thresh from the flowing Euphrates to the Wadi of Egypt, and you, Israel, will be gathered up one by one.

source: Chule hiche nikho chule hitiding ahi: Sumkon lentah chu hung kimut intin, Assyria gama mangthah dehdeh hole, Egypt gama akinodohho chu hunguva, Jerusalem lhangthenga Pakai chu ahoudiu ahi.
target: And in that day a great trumpet will sound. Those who were perishing in Assyria and those who were exiled in Egypt will come and worship the Lord on the holy mountain in Jerusalem.

source: Ohe Ephraim, jukhamho hoithona lallukhuh chu ada ahi! Ahoina loupi chu pahcha pultheibou ahin, hichu phaicham gampha ho-a anemsesa ho luchung chu ahi.
target: Woe to that wreath, the pride of Ephraim’s drunkards, to the fading flower, his glorious beauty, set on the head of a fertile valley— to that city, the pride of those laid low by wine!

source: Vetan, Pakaiyin thahat le hat chungnung khat aneijin, hichu huile gelin, thil sumangthei khopihui tobang, twilen nasatah let thethu banga akhutna tolla aselhah ding ahi.
target: See, the Lord has one who is powerful and strong. Like a hailstorm and a destructive wind, like a driving rain and a flooding downpour, he will throw it forcefully to the ground.

source: Ephraim jukhamho hoithona lallukhuh chu kengtonoija kilhobeh ding ahiuve.
target: That wreath, the pride of Ephraim’s drunkards, will be trampled underfoot.

source: Chule damphai, amel hoina loupitah chu pahcha pullha hung hintin, nipi masanga theiga masa pulbang hiding; hichu avepan amua akhutna um nalaija anehjoupai tobang ahi.
target: That fading flower, his glorious beauty, set on the head of a fertile valley, will be like figs ripe before harvest— as soon as people see them and take them in hand, they swallow them.

source: Hiche nikho chule janel Pakai chu loupina lallukhuh le, amite amoh umcha sun dinga hoina lallukhuh-a hungpang ding ahi.
target: In that day the Lord Almighty will be a glorious crown, a beautiful wreath for the remnant of his people.

source: Chule thutanlhahna-a toupa dinga thutanna lhagao le, kotpi phunga gal lenokit ho dinga thahatna hungpang ahi.
target: He will be a spirit of justice to the one who sits in judgment, a source of strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.

source: Ahinla amahon jong ju-a konin jong setna aneijun; jukhama konin lampama apetnun, thempuho le themgao hon ju-a konin setna aneijun; jukhama konin lampan apetnun amaho athilmuhouva aseuvin, amaho thutan na-a akipaluve.
target: And these also stagger from wine and reel from beer: Priests and prophets stagger from beer and are befuddled with wine; they reel from beer, they stagger when seeing visions, they stumble when rendering decisions.

source: Ajehchu dokhang jouse chu loh le thilboh adimin; hitichun muntheng aumtapoi.
target: All the tables are covered with vomit and there is not a spot without filth.

source: Koichun hetna ahila, koichun tahsan lhongpi ahetkhensah dingham? Noichep banghole noija kona kiloidohho chu ahiuve.
target: “Who is it he is trying to teach? To whom is he explaining his message? To children weaned from their milk, to those just taken from the breast?

source: Ajehchu chondan chunga chu chondan, umtei ding, chondan chunga chodan, thugol chunga thugol, thugol chunga thugol; hia themkhat khu-a themkhat.
target: For it is: Do this, do that, a rule for this, a rule for that; a little here, a little there.”

source: Ajehchu hiche mite hengahi aman kam-oh le paochoma thu aseiding ahi.
target: Very well then, with foreign lips and strange tongues God will speak to this people,

source: Aman ahenguva, hichehi thachol te nakicholdo sah theinao choldona chu ahin, hichehi kilha jangna ahi. Amahonla angaisahdeh pouve, ati.
target: to whom he said, “This is the resting place, let the weary rest”; and, “This is the place of repose”— but they would not listen.

source: Ahinla amaho henga Pakai thu vangchu; chondan chunga chondan, chondan chunga chondan; thugol chunga thugol, thugol chunga thugol; chule hia themkhat, khu-a themkhat, amaho cheova nunglhuh uva, chule mangthah diu, thanga oh-uva akimatdoh theinadiu ahi.
target: So then, the word of the Lord to them will become: Do this, do that, a rule for this, a rule for that; a little here, a little there— so that as they go they will fall backward; they will be injured and snared and captured.

source: Hichejeh chun nangho nahsalou mite, Jerusalem'a chengho chunga vaihomten Pakai thuchu ngaijun.
target: Therefore hear the word of the Lord , you scoffers who rule this people in Jerusalem.

source: Ajehchu nanghon thina toh kitepna kasemun, thikholkhul toh kitepna kaneitaovin; kivohna twipi alonlet teng jongle kahengu ahinphah tahlou dingu ahi. Ajehchu keihon jouthu beldingin kamangun, jouthun kakisel uve nati uve.
target: You boast, “We have entered into a covenant with death, with the realm of the dead we have made an agreement. When an overwhelming scourge sweeps by, it cannot touch us, for we have made a lie our refuge and falsehood our hiding place.”

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin ati, veuvin keiman Zion'a inbul songkhat patepna song, manlutah in-ning song, inbulphu tahbeh khat kakoije, atahsanchan chu kicha louding ahi, ati.
target: So this is what the Sovereign Lord says: “See, I lay a stone in Zion, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone for a sure foundation; the one who relies on it will never be stricken with panic.

source: Thutandih chu gol kaina-a kaman ding, chonphatna chu thil vettohna-a kaman ding ahi. Gellin jouthu umna mun chu alhohmang ding, kiselna ding munchu twijin achup mangding ahi.
target: I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the plumb line; hail will sweep away your refuge, the lie, and water will overflow your hiding place.

source: Chule thina toh nakitepnao chu kisubeija, thikholkhul toh nakinopto nao chu dinglou ding ahi; vohna twipi alonlet tengle hiche chun nachotpeh dingu ahi.
target: Your covenant with death will be annulled; your agreement with the realm of the dead will not stand. When the overwhelming scourge sweeps by, you will be beaten down by it.

source: Hichu ahung kitola patna, hiche chun nalah khah jing dingu ahi. Ajehchu jingkahsim jingkah seh-a; asun ajanna hung kitolding; thulhut hetkhen dingchu kisuh boina bou hiding ahitai.
target: As often as it comes it will carry you away; morning after morning, by day and by night, it will sweep through.” The understanding of this message will bring sheer terror.

source: Ajehchu jalkhun chu mikhat kilhon nathei sangin achomjon; akichuna jongchu ama kijelnathei sanga neojo ahi.
target: The bed is too short to stretch out on, the blanket too narrow to wrap around you.

source: Ajehchu aman anatoh kidangchu atohthei nadingle, athilbol kidangchu amolso theina dinga; Pakai chu Perazim molsang banga hungthouva, Gibeon phaija banga chu lunghang ding ahi.
target: The Lord will rise up as he did at Mount Perazim, he will rouse himself as in the Valley of Gibeon— to do his work, his strange work, and perform his task, his alien task.

source: Hijeh chun tun nelpeh hat ho chu hidaovin, nakihen nao lhoucheh sah getninte, ajehchu janel Pakai Pathen'a konin, leiset pumpi geija suhmang nading kigong chu kajatan ahi.
target: Now stop your mocking, or your chains will become heavier; the Lord, the Lord Almighty, has told me of the destruction decreed against the whole land.

source: Nana sung unlang, ka aw ngaijun; ngaijunlang, kathusei jaovin.
target: Listen and hear my voice; pay attention and hear what I say.

source: Muchi thena dinga loukaipan nilhum keija akai hinam? Aman aleilhangho akaldoh-a avohngem hinam?
target: When a farmer plows for planting, does he plow continually? Does he keep on breaking up and working the soil?

source: Aman atol alaicham tengle lengmusel le Pathikhom athehih-a, sakol changpi le suhlouchangpi, chule butun jong amuncheh-a athe hilou ham?
target: When he has leveled the surface, does he not sow caraway and scatter cumin? Does he not plant wheat in its place, barley in its plot, and spelt in its field?

source: Ajehchu a-Pathen'in ama ahila, gellhuh theinadia amachu ahilchah ahi.
target: His God instructs him and teaches him the right way.

source: Ajehchu lengmusel ho chu changmola kivo ngailou; pathikhom chunga chu kangtalai kang kitang jilou ahi. Ahinla lengmusel chu tenggola chule pathikhom chu moltuma bou kivoji ahi.
target: Caraway is not threshed with a sledge, nor is the wheel of a cart rolled over cumin; caraway is beaten out with a rod, and cumin with a stick.

source: Changlhah ding changchu akisubongjin; ajehchu a-itih-a vohtho louding, akangtalai kanga jong kitangkeh louding, asakol chungtouho jong asuh bongsah deh louding ahi.
target: Grain must be ground to make bread; so one does not go on threshing it forever. The wheels of a threshing cart may be rolled over it, but one does not use horses to grind grain.

source: Hiche jonghi thumopthem kidangtah; thilbol lama nasapenpa janel Pakaiya hung kondoh ahi.
target: All this also comes from the Lord Almighty, whose plan is wonderful, whose wisdom is magnificent.

source: Ohe Ariel, Ariel, David chenna khopi nada ahi! Akum kum-in belap unlang, ganlhaina sa thasah uvin.
target: Woe to you, Ariel, Ariel, the city where David settled! Add year to year and let your cycle of festivals go on.

source: Ariel chu kabolgentheija, chua gihsalnale lungdonna umding ahin, chule hichu keija dinga Ariel tobanga hiding ahi.
target: Yet I will besiege Ariel; she will mourn and lament, she will be to me like an altar hearth.

source: Chule nangma dounan nakimvela ngahmun sangting, galkul sangtah kakaikhuma, kulpiho kakhokhum ding nahi.
target: I will encamp against you on all sides; I will encircle you with towers and set up my siege works against you.

source: Chutia chu kisulha ding nahin, tolla kona nahung paodoh-a nathusei chu leivuija konin olcha gingding, na aw chu tolla kona thilhavop khat aw bang hintin, nathusei chu leivuija kona aw thopma gingdoh dingbou ahi.
target: Brought low, you will speak from the ground; your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will come ghostlike from the earth; out of the dust your speech will whisper.

source: Chukalvalin nagamchom mipi ho chu leivui sipahbep hintin, tijat umtah mipite chu changsi lengmang bangbep hintin: henge, gangta-a chutiphung ding ahi.
target: But your many enemies will become like fine dust, the ruthless hordes like blown chaff. Suddenly, in an instant,

source: Janel Pakaiyin van ginna, chule inlingle husa kithong, hui le go chule khopihuija, chule kavam helthei meikonga nahungvil ding ahi.
target: the Lord Almighty will come with thunder and earthquake and great noise, with windstorm and tempest and flames of a devouring fire.

source: Chule Ariel douna-a galsat namjouse-a kon mipi ho, amale agal manchah sat ho jouse, chule abolgenthei jouse geija janmang bangbep hiding ahiuve.
target: Then the hordes of all the nations that fight against Ariel, that attack her and her fortress and besiege her, will be as it is with a dream, with a vision in the night—

source: Chule mi gilkelin mang aneija, chule veuvin, amanga chu an aneh-a, ahivanga akhahdoh phatna la vachom dehlou: ahiloule midangchah in mang aneiteng vetan twi ana donna, ahivanga akhahdoh phatna la ngoideh jeng, asunga adangchah abangbep ahijing jeng banga: Zion lhang douna-a galsat namjouse mipi chu chutobangbep hiding ahiuve.
target: as when a hungry person dreams of eating, but awakens hungry still; as when a thirsty person dreams of drinking, but awakens faint and thirsty still. So will it be with the hordes of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion.

source: Nanghotah khongai unlang, datmouvin; kapmun lang, pengdoh uvin; amaho akhamun, ju-a konvang ahipouve; alon lele uvin khamnatheija konvang ahipoi.
target: Be stunned and amazed, blind yourselves and be sightless; be drunk, but not from wine, stagger, but not from beer.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin nachung uva imutsetna lhagao abuhlhah-a, namitnu asinsah ahitai. Themgaoho le navaipo hou, mitvah neiho akhuchahtan ahi.
target: The Lord has brought over you a deep sleep: He has sealed your eyes (the prophets); he has covered your heads (the seers).

source: Chule nanghodin mu neijousehi lekhabua thuchengho kisinkha khum tobang ahung hitan, hichu lekhathem khat henga kichoija; hichehi simin, tia nahenga katao ahi: Chule aman akisinkha jeh-in kasimtheipoi, ati tobang ahitai.
target: For you this whole vision is nothing but words sealed in a scroll. And if you give the scroll to someone who can read, and say, “Read this, please,” they will answer, “I can’t; it is sealed.”

source: Chuin lekhabu chu athemlou khat akipen, katao ahi, hichehi simtemin atile, aman keima kathempoi, atin ahi.
target: Or if you give the scroll to someone who cannot read, and say, “Read this, please,” they will answer, “I don’t know how to read.”

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin aseije: hiche mite hin akamuvin einaijun, amuh uvah eijabollun, ahinla alungu vang keija kona gamlatah ahin, keima eiginu jong mihem chondan thuhila konbou ahi, ati.
target: The Lord says: “These people come near to me with their mouth and honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me. Their worship of me is based on merely human rules they have been taught.

source: Hijeh chun ven, hiche mite lah-a hi thilbol kidangtah, thilbol kidangle datmo umtah jong kasodoh ding ahi. Ajehchu amichingteu chihna chu mangthah ding, chule ahegilho hetnachu kiselding ahitai.
target: Therefore once more I will astound these people with wonder upon wonder; the wisdom of the wise will perish, the intelligence of the intelligent will vanish.”

source: Pakaiya kona selding giltah-a holtechu ohe adau ahi. Anatoh-u chu muthim lah ahin, kon eimuvem? kon eihetnum? atiuvin ahi.
target: Woe to those who go to great depths to hide their plans from the Lord , who do their work in darkness and think, “Who sees us? Who will know?”

source: Tahbeh-in thil akhup athala naleu chu beldengpa khutna hahlei banga naki ngaitou ahi. Ajehchu athilsem chun asempa chu aman eisem hibeh am? atia ahiloule thil gontohsa chun agongtohpa chu aman hetkhenna aneipoi atiji em?
target: You turn things upside down, as if the potter were thought to be like the clay! Shall what is formed say to the one who formed it, “You did not make me”? Can the pot say to the potter, “You know nothing”?

source: Lebanon chu leiphatah sosah-a aumdingle, leiphatah chu gammang banga akigelding chu chom chakhat kahbou hung hitalou dingham?
target: In a very short time, will not Lebanon be turned into a fertile field and the fertile field seem like a forest?

source: Hiche nikho chule na-ngongin lekhabua thuchu ajah-a, mitcho ho mitnin khojinle muthim lah-a kona jong amudiu ahi.
target: In that day the deaf will hear the words of the scroll, and out of gloom and darkness the eyes of the blind will see.

source: Minunnemho jong Pakaiya halna-a akipanao pungding, milah a mivaichate jong Israel mithengpa-a kipahdiu ahitai.
target: Once more the humble will rejoice in the Lord ; the needy will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

source: Ajehchu gin umtah khatchu imalou akisotan, mi i-sah loupa chu akisutanin, khan-gitlouna velhi jingho chu akisubeitan ahi.
target: The ruthless will vanish, the mockers will disappear, and all who have an eye for evil will be cut down—

source: Hicheho chun thu cheng khatnin mi akipalsahjin, kotpi phunga phosal achan nadin thang akampehjin, midihtah chu ima hilouhela koijin aumtan ahi.
target: those who with a word make someone out to be guilty, who ensnare the defender in court and with false testimony deprive the innocent of justice.

source: Hijeh chun hitihin Jacob insung thudolla Abraham lhatdoh-a Pakai chun aseitai, tu-a Jacob jahcha talou ding, amaijong dang talou ding ahi, ati.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord , who redeemed Abraham, says to the descendants of Jacob: “No longer will Jacob be ashamed; no longer will their faces grow pale.

source: Ahinla achate kakhutsohho chu alah-a amutengle, kamin thensah-un tin, Jacob'a mithengpa chu athen sah uva, Israel Pathen chu agindiu ahitai.
target: When they see among them their children, the work of my hands, they will keep my name holy; they will acknowledge the holiness of the Holy One of Jacob, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.

source: Lhagaova suhkhel neihon jong ahin hetkhen themuva, aphunchel ho jong tahsan lhongpi kihildiu ahi.
target: Those who are wayward in spirit will gain understanding; those who complain will accept instruction.”

source: Pakaiyin doubolnom chate, midang kithumop kisan-a, keija nahsahlouva koiho, chonset chunga chonset bolbe theina dinga keima lhagaova hilouva khukhumna dang khatna khukhum ho; ohe, adau ahi!
target: “Woe to the obstinate children,” declares the Lord , “to those who carry out plans that are not mine, forming an alliance, but not by my Spirit, heaping sin upon sin;

source: Kathusei ngaicha louva Egypt'a chengdinga chesuh ho, Pharoah hatna-a kihatsah dingle, Egypt le-lim tahsan dinga cheho, ohe, adau ahi!
target: who go down to Egypt without consulting me; who look for help to Pharaoh’s protection, to Egypt’s shade for refuge.

source: Hijeh-a chu Pharoah hatna chu najachat nao hungsoh-a, Egypt le-lim tahsan nachu nakisuhmo nao hung hiding ahitai.
target: But Pharaoh’s protection will be to your shame, Egypt’s shade will bring you disgrace.

source: Ajehchu amilenteu Zoan'a aumun, apalaihou Hanes-a ahunguve.
target: Though they have officials in Zoan and their envoys have arrived in Hanes,

source: Amaho jousen amaho phatchomsah joulou miho chu ajachat piuvin, panpina le phatchomna hilouvin jachatnale housetna joh ahi.
target: everyone will be put to shame because of a people useless to them, who bring neither help nor advantage, but only shame and disgrace.”

source: Lhanglam gamsaho pohgih; lungkhamnale lungnatna gam, chua konchun keipi noule keipitah, gulse le gulsum ahungin, amahon aphatchom sah loudiu miho henga, sangan golho lengkou chunga ahao naole, sangongsao tinghem chunga agouho chu pouvinte.
target: A prophecy concerning the animals of the Negev: Through a land of hardship and distress, of lions and lionesses, of adders and darting snakes, the envoys carry their riches on donkeys’ backs, their treasures on the humps of camels, to that unprofitable nation,

source: Ajehchu Egypt miten pannabei jin panpiuvintin, chule apanajong umponte. Hijeh-a chu keiman hiche thua kasei ahi, athahatnao chu thabei pannabei ahi.
target: to Egypt, whose help is utterly useless. Therefore I call her Rahab the Do-Nothing.

source: Tun chenlang, atonsot atonsot phat hunglhung dingin, amasanguva dokhanga chun suninlang, lekhabua chingin.
target: Go now, write it on a tablet for them, inscribe it on a scroll, that for the days to come it may be an everlasting witness.

source: Hichehohi kiphin mite, joubol chate, Pakai danthupeh ngailouding chate ahiuve.
target: For these are rebellious people, deceitful children, children unwilling to listen to the Lord ’s instruction.

source: Amahon mitvah neiho jah-a, muhih un; themgaoho henga thildih neigaopeh hih-un lang, kahenguva thungei ngei neisei peh-un alhembou neigaopeh-un.
target: They say to the seers, “See no more visions!” and to the prophets, “Give us no more visions of what is right! Tell us pleasant things, prophesy illusions.

source: Lampi dalhan, lamsih-a kiheidoh unlang, Israel mithengpa chu keiho masanga konin phapoh tahih-un atiuve.
target: Leave this way, get off this path, and stop confronting us with the Holy One of Israel!”

source: Hijehhin Israel mithengpan aseitai, nangho hiche thu nanah sahmo uva suhgenthei nale golkehna natahsan uva chua na-umden jeh un;
target: Therefore this is what the Holy One of Israel says: “Because you have rejected this message, relied on oppression and depended on deceit,

source: hiche jehchun hiche khangitlouna chu nachung uva bang sangtah aselai pohjah dingkon, photlot mitphet kahlouva hung chimlha ding tobang nahidiu ahi, ati.
target: this sin will become for you like a high wall, cracked and bulging, that collapses suddenly, in an instant.

source: Chule aman hiche beldengpa bel suhkeh ahal halla achip banga asuhchipma; akhen louding, apokehna halchu meithuh-a kona mei-am lonading, ahiloule kokhuh-a kona twi thaldohna ding jeng jong kimulouding ahi.
target: It will break in pieces like pottery, shattered so mercilessly that among its pieces not a fragment will be found for taking coals from a hearth or scooping water out of a cistern.”

source: Ajehchu Pakai Pathen Israel mithengpan, hungkilea choldona chu huhhing nachan na hiding; thipbehnale tahsanna chu nahatnao hiding ahin, nangho nanompouve, ati.
target: This is what the Sovereign Lord , the Holy One of Israel, says: “In repentance and rest is your salvation, in quietness and trust is your strength, but you would have none of it.

source: Ahinla nanghon ahipoi sakol chunga katou uva kajamdiu ahi, nati uvin, hijeh-a chu nangho najamdiu, chule gangtah-a kajamdiu ahi nati uvin, hijeh-a chu nanungdel hou jong gangtah hidiu ahi.
target: You said, ‘No, we will flee on horses.’ Therefore you will flee! You said, ‘We will ride off on swift horses.’ Therefore your pursuers will be swift!

source: Mikhat phosala; sangkhat jamding, minga phosala; molvum'a melchihna kitah bangle, lhang chunga galponlap banga nakidalhah kahseuva najamdiu ahi.
target: A thousand will flee at the threat of one; at the threat of five you will all flee away, till you are left like a flagstaff on a mountaintop, like a banner on a hill.”

source: Hijeh-a chu nangho nakhoto theinadiuva Pakaiyin nangao ahi, ajehchu nachung uva hepina aneitheina dinga ama kichoisang ding ahi. Ajehchu Pakai chu thutan Pathen ahin; ama ngahte jouse anunnom ahiuve.
target: Yet the Lord longs to be gracious to you; therefore he will rise up to show you compassion. For the Lord is a God of justice. Blessed are all who wait for him!

source: Ajehchu mitechu Jerusalem'a Zion'a chenguntin: nakakit louheldingu ahitan; napennao awginna chu aman nakhoto lheh dingu ahin; aman hichu ajahtengle nadonbut jengdiu ahi.
target: People of Zion, who live in Jerusalem, you will weep no more. How gracious he will be when you cry for help! As soon as he hears, he will answer you.

source: Chule Pakaiyin hesohna changlhah, suhgimna twi napejeng jongleu, nahil hou chu ningchonga kichonlut louheldiu, namitnun nahil hou chu amujoh dingu ahi.
target: Although the Lord gives you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, your teachers will be hidden no more; with your own eyes you will see them.

source: Chule nangho nakijet heijuva chule nakiveihei tengule, nanunglam uva thakhatna hichehi lampi ahi, jotnun, tia nanunglam uva thukhat kiseichu nanauva najahdiu ahi.
target: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way; walk in it.”

source: Nanghon dangka milim kikhegho tomnale, sana milim kilhaho kijepna nasuhboh diu ahin, pon thenglou napai uva, ahenguva hia konin chemangin tia naseidingu ahi.
target: Then you will desecrate your idols overlaid with silver and your images covered with gold; you will throw them away like a menstrual cloth and say to them, “Away with you!”

source: Chutengle aman namuchi diuvin gotwi hinpeuvin natin, chutia chu nangin leisetna nathe-a, leija anneh pungding, hichu phatahle nengtah hiding ahin; chuche nitengle na ganchate chu ganlhaina munlen tah-a kivahdiu ahitai.
target: He will also send you rain for the seed you sow in the ground, and the food that comes from the land will be rich and plentiful. In that day your cattle will graze in broad meadows.

source: Chutobangma chu bongchal hole sangan nou lou kaihon, chang japnale changlona-a kijapchilsa ngen gancha antheng anehdiu ahitai.
target: The oxen and donkeys that work the soil will eat fodder and mash, spread out with fork and shovel.

source: Chule kithana nasatah nikho-a insangho chimtengle, molsang chungle lhangsang chung tina, vapile vadungho chule luidungho hung longdiu ahi.
target: In the day of great slaughter, when the towers fall, streams of water will flow on every high mountain and every lofty hill.

source: Chukalvala jong Pakaiyin amite maput atoma, akijepnau mahaho adamsah nitengle, lhavah chu nisa vah bangjenga, nisa vah chu ajat sagi jenna nisagi vah kigom bangkhopma vahding ahitai.
target: The moon will shine like the sun, and the sunlight will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven full days, when the Lord binds up the bruises of his people and heals the wounds he inflicted.

source: Veuvin Tonsot Pakai minchu gamlatah-a konin lunghang tah-in ahunge, chule hiche pohgih chu gihtah ahi. Akamsung chu thangtomna adimsetnin; alei chu kavamjengthei meikong tobang ahi.
target: See, the Name of the Lord comes from afar, with burning anger and dense clouds of smoke; his lips are full of wrath, and his tongue is a consuming fire.

source: Ahu hai chu ngong geija longlet vadungsoh abangin, namtin vaipi manthah na tengsa-a lochildin agon, chule suhkhelsah nadinga mitin kama kamdal umcheh ding ahi.
target: His breath is like a rushing torrent, rising up to the neck. He shakes the nations in the sieve of destruction; he places in the jaws of the peoples a bit that leads them astray.

source: Nanghon kutpitheng kimanjan banga la khat najah dingu ahin, chule mikhat kuli mutpum ma; Israelte thahatpa Pakai molchunga chebanga lungkipa najong nanei dingu ahi.
target: And you will sing as on the night you celebrate a holy festival; your hearts will rejoice as when people playing pipes go up to the mountain of the Lord , to the Rock of Israel.

source: Pakaiyin a-aw loupitah kijahna ding bolintin, lunghan nasatah toh, halvam thei meikong toh, huipi le gopi toh, chule gel'a alunghana khut chu alhahding ahi.
target: The Lord will cause people to hear his majestic voice and will make them see his arm coming down with raging anger and consuming fire, with cloudburst, thunderstorm and hail.

source: Ajehchu Pakai awgin'a kona Assyria te chu molla kinolhu ding kisumang ding ahiuve.
target: The voice of the Lord will shatter Assyria; with his rod he will strike them down.

source: Chule Pakaiyin achunga angapding kivohna tenggolin aphahding, munjouse-a chu khongchale selangdah kithoding ahi. Aman gal mun kihotling mun'a chu akisatpi ding ahi.
target: Every stroke the Lord lays on them with his punishing club will be to the music of timbrels and harps, as he fights them in battle with the blows of his arm.

source: Ajehchu Tophet hi malaija anakisudetsa ahitan; ahi, hichu lengpa dinga kigongsadem ahin; thuh tahle lentah-a asem ahi. Chua kikhol chu meile thing tamtah ahin, Pakai hu-hai chu meile kaat luija long deujeju bang ahi.
target: Topheth has long been prepared; it has been made ready for the king. Its fire pit has been made deep and wide, with an abundance of fire and wood; the breath of the Lord , like a stream of burning sulfur, sets it ablaze.

source: Panpi hola Egypt'a chesuh-a, sakol ho chunga kingaija, sakol kangtalai ho tamjeh-a tahsan; sakol touthemho hatbehseh jeh-a tahsana, Israel mithengpa lam velou, Pakai hollou helho chu, ohe! ada ahiuve.
target: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, who rely on horses, who trust in the multitude of their chariots and in the great strength of their horsemen, but do not look to the Holy One of Israel, or seek help from the Lord .

source: Achuti vangin amajong michingtah ahin, thilse hinlhun sah intin, athu ho chu alekou louding: thilsebol insungho douva hung kipana, khanset bolte panpiho chu adoujoh ding ahibouve.
target: Yet he too is wise and can bring disaster; he does not take back his words. He will rise up against that wicked nation, against those who help evildoers.

source: Tun Egypt mite chu mihem bou ahiuvin, Pathen ahipouve; Asakol-hou jong tahsaphe bou ahin, lhagao ahipouve. Pakaiyin akhut ahinlhandoh tengle mipanpipa chu lhu-a, chule akipanpipa jong lhuding ahin, ania lhukop lhonding ahi.
target: But the Egyptians are mere mortals and not God; their horses are flesh and not spirit. When the Lord stretches out his hand, those who help will stumble, those who are helped will fall; all will perish together.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin aseitai, keipi bahkai chule anou asaneh hon chunga akitumhon banga, kelngoi chingho tamtah adou dinga akikoudoh tengle, a-aw uchu kichadeh pontin, ahusaova jong nemlha deh louding ahi. Chutia chu janel Pakai chu Zion mol le alhang dinga galsatna hung kumlha ding ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says to me: “As a lion growls, a great lion over its prey— and though a whole band of shepherds is called together against it, it is not frightened by their shouts or disturbed by their clamor— so the Lord Almighty will come down to do battle on Mount Zion and on its heights.

source: Vachate alenlele banga, chutia chu janel Pakaiyin Jerusalem ahonbit ding ahin; ahonbitna ahuhdoh ding; chule akalchuh-a akhehdoh ding ahi.
target: Like birds hovering overhead, the Lord Almighty will shield Jerusalem; he will shield it and deliver it, he will ‘pass over’ it and will rescue it.”

source: Israel chaten nasatah-a adoupao heng lama hung kilekit teijuvin.
target: Return, you Israelites, to the One you have so greatly revolted against.

source: Ijeh inem itile, hiche nikho chule mitinin nadangka milimhou le nasana milimu chonsetna dinga nakhut tah uva nakisem muchu ahin paimang cheh dingu ahi.
target: For in that day every one of you will reject the idols of silver and gold your sinful hands have made.

source: Chutengle Assyria chu chemjam'a louding, mihatpa chemjam jong hilou, minoinung pa chemjam jong hilou chun ama avallhum ding; ahinla ama chemjam'a kona jamdoh-a, akhangdongteu chu suhnohphah-a umding ahiuve.
target: “Assyria will fall by no human sword; a sword, not of mortals, will devour them. They will flee before the sword and their young men will be put to forced labor.

source: Chule aman tijatna-a akulpidet akalchuh-a, chule pipuihon ponlap chu akichatdiu ahi, tin Zion'a ameikong uma, Jerusalem'a alhumpi umpa Pakai chun aseije.
target: Their stronghold will fall because of terror; at the sight of the battle standard their commanders will panic,” declares the Lord , whose fire is in Zion, whose furnace is in Jerusalem.

source: Veuvin, leng khatnin chonphatna-a vai ahomding, chule pipuihon thutan dihtah-a vai ahomdiu ahi.
target: See, a king will reign in righteousness and rulers will rule with justice.

source: Chule mikhat chu khohuija kona kiselna munle huipi le gopi-a kona kivenbitna hiding; gamgolaija twi umna vadung le cholna gama songpi lenkhat lim tobang hunghi ding ahi.
target: Each one will be like a shelter from the wind and a refuge from the storm, like streams of water in the desert and the shadow of a great rock in a thirsty land.

source: Chule khomuho mit chu thimlouva, khojaho chun angaidiu ahi.
target: Then the eyes of those who see will no longer be closed, and the ears of those who hear will listen.

source: Lungkinon jong hetkhen themtheina hetna aneija, pao oh hon jong kichentah-a thu aseidingu ahitai.
target: The fearful heart will know and understand, and the stammering tongue will be fluent and clear.

source: Mikhangse chu mihongphal kiti talou ding, migenthei chu ninglhing dehlouhel ding ahi.
target: No longer will the fool be called noble nor the scoundrel be highly respected.

source: Migilou chun gitlou thujeng aseijin, ajehchu phatlhemna kijil dingle, Pakai douna-a adihlou seidingin, gilkelte oisung akeova umsahdingle dangchah te donding thonsah dingin mi nunse chun thusese seijintin, alungsunga khan gitlou abolding ahi.
target: For fools speak folly, their hearts are bent on evil: They practice ungodliness and spread error concerning the Lord ; the hungry they leave empty and from the thirsty they withhold water.

source: Migenthei chu amanchahho jong phaloutah ahin, milhasam hon thudihtah aseiteng jongle, mivaichaho suhmang hela aum nadingin, thujouva jona thet umtah lungthim giloutah apodohjin ahi.
target: Scoundrels use wicked methods, they make up evil schemes to destroy the poor with lies, even when the plea of the needy is just.

source: Ahinla mihongphal tah-in hongphalin, hongphalna thilho agongdohjin; ama hongphalna thilho-a chu ding jingding ahi.
target: But the noble make noble plans, and by noble deeds they stand.

source: Nangho numei ho thoudoh uvin; khohsahna bei chanuten ka-aw ngaijunlang; kathusei jahin nana sungun.
target: You women who are so complacent, rise up and listen to me; you daughters who feel secure, hear what I have to say!

source: Khohsahbei numei nangho nikhoho le kumho tamtah-a nalungkham diu ahi. Ajehchu lengpithei hungga louding, aga lona hung umlou ding ahitai.
target: In little more than a year you who feel secure will tremble; the grape harvest will fail, and the harvest of fruit will not come.

source: Numei nangho kithinguvin, khohsah bei nangho lungkham mun, kihoh lhaovin, nakeuvin umun lang, nakong uvah khaodip pon kigah-un.
target: Tremble, you complacent women; shudder, you daughters who feel secure! Strip off your fine clothes and wrap yourselves in rags.

source: Loumun pha le, lengpigui gapha dinga, lunghem ding ahiuve.
target: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vines

source: Kamite gama lingle khao hungpou doh ding ahin; henge, khopi kipana pena insung kipah jouse-a jong chutiding ahi.
target: and for the land of my people, a land overgrown with thorns and briers— yes, mourn for all houses of merriment and for this city of revelry.

source: Ajehchu leng inpiho kidalha-a; mitamna khopi chu dalhah-a umding; galkul hole daivei insangho jong a-itih-a dinga gam sanganho, kinomtol nale ganchahon ho hamnehna mun hung hiding ahi.
target: The fortress will be abandoned, the noisy city deserted; citadel and watchtower will become a wasteland forever, the delight of donkeys, a pasture for flocks,

source: Chunga kona lhagao ichunguva ahung kibuh lhah-a, gamthip lou mun pha ahungsoa, lou mun pha gammanga akigel kahse-a;
target: till the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the desert becomes a fertile field, and the fertile field seems like a forest.

source: Chutengle gamthipma chu thutan lhahna uma, loumun pha-a chu chonphatna umden ding ahi.
target: The Lord ’s justice will dwell in the desert, his righteousness live in the fertile field.

source: Chonphatna natohchu chamna hintin; chule hiche chonphatna chun a-itih-a ol-heuna le aphotchena asodohsah ding ahi.
target: The fruit of that righteousness will be peace; its effect will be quietness and confidence forever.

source: Kamite chu chamdela umnale dettah-a chendetna inmun, chule ol-heuva choldona mun'a cheng taovintin;
target: My people will live in peaceful dwelling places, in secure homes, in undisturbed places of rest.

source: gellhah tengle gammang chunga hunglhantin; chule khopi chu mun nema kikoiding ahi.
target: Though hail flattens the forest and the city is leveled completely,

source: Twipang dunga muchi tu-a nangho anunnom nahiuvin; chukoma bongchal le sangan lhatlutsah-a nangho anunnom nahiuve.
target: how blessed you will be, sowing your seed by every stream, and letting your cattle and donkeys range free.

source: Nangla kichom khalouva michompa; amahonla nangma tahsanlel louva, mikitahlou pa; nada ahi. Michom nangah phatle, nangma nakichom ding; nangman kitahlouna nangah phatle, amahon nangma natahsan leldiu ahi.
target: Woe to you, destroyer, you who have not been destroyed! Woe to you, betrayer, you who have not been betrayed! When you stop destroying, you will be destroyed; when you stop betraying, you will be betrayed.

source: Vo Pakai, neilungset in, keihon nangma kangah jinguve, jingkahsehle aban nu hinlang, thohgenthei laile eihuh hingpao vin hung pangin.
target: Lord , be gracious to us; we long for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation in time of distress.

source: Thunoh husagin chun miho ajam mangun; nangma nakichoi sangna-a chun namtin thecheh-in aumtai.
target: At the uproar of your army, the peoples flee; when you rise up, the nations scatter.

source: Nathil chomdoh chu lungmul kikhol khom banga kikhol khom ding ahi. Khaokhopi suhle tunga achoplele banga achunguva lhai lele ding ahi.
target: Your plunder, O nations, is harvested as by young locusts; like a swarm of locusts people pounce on it.

source: Chungsanga um ahijeh-in Pakai chu akichoisangtai. Aman Zion chu thutandih nale chonphat na-in adipsohtan ahi.
target: The Lord is exalted, for he dwells on high; he will fill Zion with his justice and righteousness.

source: Chihnale hetna chu nahinkhodetna le nahuhhingna thahat hunghi ding ahin, Pakai gin chu ama-a dinga goukhol ahi.
target: He will be the sure foundation for your times, a rich store of salvation and wisdom and knowledge; the fear of the Lord is the key to this treasure.

source: Veuvin, amihangsan hou pama penguntin; chamna palaiho chu lhasetah-in kapmunte.
target: Look, their brave men cry aloud in the streets; the envoys of peace weep bitterly.

source: Lamlhongpiho chu akeoheltan, chule vahlea athipdeltai. Aman thulhuna asukeh-in, khopiho i-asahpon, koimacha anahsahtapoi.
target: The highways are deserted, no travelers are on the roads. The treaty is broken, its witnesses are despised, no one is respected.

source: Leiset hi alunghemin ahesoh-e, Lebanon ajahchan lhamlhah ahitai, Sharon chu gamthip abangin; Bashan le Karmel'in aga hou ahotpul taovin ahi.
target: The land dries up and wastes away, Lebanon is ashamed and withers; Sharon is like the Arabah, and Bashan and Carmel drop their leaves.

source: Tonsot Pakaiyin; tun keima thouving ting; tun kichoisang inting; tun kidomsang tange; ati.
target: “Now will I arise,” says the Lord . “Now will I be exalted; now will I be lifted up.

source: Nanghon changsi navop uva, chang kung nahindingu, nahaiju husa chun mei tobanga nakahvam dingu ahi.
target: You conceive chaff, you give birth to straw; your breath is a fire that consumes you.

source: Mitin chu ngunsong kihal kong banguntin, ling kisatlha-a meija kihal tobang hidiu ahi.
target: The peoples will be burned to ashes; like cut thornbushes they will be set ablaze.”

source: Gamlatah-a um nanghon ipi kabol em ngaijun; chule naicha umhon jong kathahatdan heuvin.
target: You who are far away, hear what I have done; you who are near, acknowledge my power!

source: Zion'a michonseho akichauvin, miphalhem ho tijatnin alungdongun ahi. Ilah uva halvamna meikongto chengdinga koiham, ilah uva tonsotna kongjing meito chengdinga koiham?
target: The sinners in Zion are terrified; trembling grips the godless: “Who of us can dwell with the consuming fire? Who of us can dwell with everlasting burning?”

source: Chonphatna-a vahlea dihtah-a thuseipa, bolgentheija kona phatchomna i-sah loupa, nehguh lahna-a kona akhut thinglhapa, thisona ding thu jah-a kona akol kisipma, thilse mu-a kona amit singpa chu;
target: Those who walk righteously and speak what is right, who reject gain from extortion and keep their hands from accepting bribes, who stop their ears against plots of murder and shut their eyes against contemplating evil—

source: amachu chungsanga chengintin; akihuhna munchu songa kisem kulpi hiding, nehding changlhah ama kipe-a adonding twi jong amuteiding ahi.
target: they are the ones who will dwell on the heights, whose refuge will be the mountain fortress. Their bread will be supplied, and water will not fail them.

source: Namitnin lengpa hoina amu-a, gamlatah-a um gamchu amudoh dingu ahi.
target: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty and view a land that stretches afar.

source: Nalungsungin kichatna nasatah nangaito ding ahi. Danthusunpa hoiba hitam? Alalutpa hoiba hitam? Daivei insangho simtohpa hoiba hitam?
target: In your thoughts you will ponder the former terror: “Where is that chief officer? Where is the one who took the revenue? Where is the officer in charge of the towers?”

source: Nangin kichat umtah mi namutahlou ding, giltah-a paodoh mi nahetchen theilou lei-oh mi namutah louhel ding ahi.
target: You will see those arrogant people no more, people whose speech is obscure, whose language is strange and incomprehensible.

source: Kut loupiho kiman nading Zion khopi chunglam chu vetemin, namit tenin mongtah-a chenna Jerusalem; phetlhah louding houbuh kisonna akhom khatcha kibotdoh louhel ding; akhaojang jong khatcha kibottan louding chu munnate.
target: Look on Zion, the city of our festivals; your eyes will see Jerusalem, a peaceful abode, a tent that will not be moved; its stakes will never be pulled up, nor any of its ropes broken.

source: Ahinla loupi Pakai chu eiho dinga luidung lenho le luidung neoho hiding ahin, Chua chu kong innei kongtol ho chelouding ahin, kong innei hattah jong chelouding ahi.
target: There the Lord will be our Mighty One. It will be like a place of broad rivers and streams. No galley with oars will ride them, no mighty ship will sail them.

source: Pakai chu ithu tanpao ahin, Pakai chu danthu eipepao ahin, Pakai chu ilengpao ahin; aman eihuh hingdiu ahi.
target: For the Lord is our judge, the Lord is our lawgiver, the Lord is our king; it is he who will save us.

source: Nakong tolna ponkhao ho akikangin; apondalu khombul chu ahendet theipouvin, pondal chu ajahthei pouve. Chuin gala thil kichom tamtah akihomun, elbaijin jong akilah-e.
target: Your rigging hangs loose: The mast is not held secure, the sail is not spread. Then an abundance of spoils will be divided and even the lame will carry off plunder.

source: Chule chua chenga chun kadampoi atilouding, chua cheng mitechu akhansetnao kingaidam ding ahi.
target: No one living in Zion will say, “I am ill”; and the sins of those who dwell there will be forgiven.

source: Namtin vaipi thungaidin hungnai junlang, nangho mipite ngai phaovin, leisetle asunga cheng jousen, vannoi le ama-a kon hungkondoh thiljousen ngaijuhen.
target: Come near, you nations, and listen; pay attention, you peoples! Let the earth hear, and all that is in it, the world, and all that comes out of it!

source: Ajehchu Pakai thangtomna chu namjouse chunga, chule alunghana chu agalsat jousete chunga aumtan, amaho chu asumangsoh helin, thagamheldin mithat ho hengah apedohsohtan ahi.
target: The Lord is angry with all nations; his wrath is on all their armies. He will totally destroy them, he will give them over to slaughter.

source: Amiteu kithat ho jong kipaidoh ding, chule athilonguva kona a-uiju kikhong doh-a, lhangho chu athisan utoh junlhah thading ahi.
target: Their slain will be thrown out, their dead bodies will stink; the mountains will be soaked with their blood.

source: Chule vanlaijola thil um jouse junlha-a, vanho chu lekha kijelbanga hung kijelding; chule avan janel jouse chu lengpiguija kona ana pulbanga, chule theichang phunga aga apulhah banga pullha diu ahitai.
target: All the stars in the sky will be dissolved and the heavens rolled up like a scroll; all the starry host will fall like withered leaves from the vine, like shriveled figs from the fig tree.

source: Ajehchu kachemjam chu van'a notvala umding, veuvin, hichu Edom chungle kagaosap te chunga thutanlha dinga hung khumlha ding ahi.
target: My sword has drunk its fill in the heavens; see, it descends in judgment on Edom, the people I have totally destroyed.

source: Pakai chemjam chu thisanin adimtan, chule chemjam chu thaovin atomtan; hichu kelngoi le kelchal thisanto, kelngoichal kal thao ahi. Ajehchu Pakai chun Bozrah'a ganlhaina aneijin, Edom gama kithana nasatah aume.
target: The sword of the Lord is bathed in blood, it is covered with fat— the blood of lambs and goats, fat from the kidneys of rams. For the Lord has a sacrifice in Bozrah and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

source: Chule gambongchal kineiho chu amahotoh hungsuh thantin, bongchal til kilalouho chu bongchal atil kilaho toh, chule agamu chu thisanin chup mintin, aleivui chu thaova jollha ding ahi.
target: And the wild oxen will fall with them, the bull calves and the great bulls. Their land will be drenched with blood, and the dust will be soaked with fat.

source: Ajehchu hichehi Pakai phulahna nikho ahin, chule Zion kinepna le khohsahna kum chu ahi.
target: For the Lord has a day of vengeance, a year of retribution, to uphold Zion’s cause.

source: Chule chua vachadung ho chu thingnaivom hungsoh-a, chule aleivuiho chu kaatsong hungsoh ding, chuche gamchu thingnaivom kadeujeju hungsoh ding ahi.
target: Edom’s streams will be turned into pitch, her dust into burning sulfur; her land will become blazing pitch!

source: Hichu sunle jana mitlouhel ding, ameikhu chu tonsotna kitungdoh ding, akhang akhanga agoh-a uma, atonsot atonsotna koimachan ahopa louhel ding ahi.
target: It will not be quenched night or day; its smoke will rise forever. From generation to generation it will lie desolate; no one will ever pass through it again.

source: Ahinla twivamuhsao le vakeng'in lo intin; sumbupi le vavom asunga chengdio ahin; hiche chunga chu lungnohna khaole khaidihna songho kikhaiding ahi.
target: The desert owl and screech owl will possess it; the great owl and the raven will nest there. God will stretch out over Edom the measuring line of chaos and the plumb line of desolation.

source: Chua milal ho chu lenggama dingin kou untin; koimacha vang umtalou ding, chule aleng chapate jouseu imacha hilouding ahitaove.
target: Her nobles will have nothing there to be called a kingdom, all her princes will vanish away.

source: Amanu leng inpiho-a lingphung, chule akulpidet hou sunga sachah le theimi hung kehdoh ding, Dragonho chennale sumbupi ho honsung hung hiding ahi.
target: Thorns will overrun her citadels, nettles and brambles her strongholds. She will become a haunt for jackals, a home for owls.

source: Neldi gam, gamsaho jong twikol gama gamsahoto kitoh untin, chule lhomi chun agol kou intin, sumbupi chu chua chun kicholdontin, amadinga choldona mun amuding ahi.
target: Desert creatures will meet with hyenas, and wild goats will bleat to each other; there the night creatures will also lie down and find for themselves places of rest.

source: Chua chu sumbupi lentah-in buh ase-a, atwi athah ding, alhaving noija ahuikhom ding ahi. Chua chu muthong ho jong akopcheh-a hung kikhom ding ahiuve.
target: The owl will nest there and lay eggs, she will hatch them, and care for her young under the shadow of her wings; there also the falcons will gather, each with its mate.
