source: Pakai lekhabu holdoh-un lang simun; hichehohi khatcha thonlou ding ahi; akopto lhasam umlou ding ahi. Ajehchu kam'in thu apeh-a ama lhagao ngeichun akhopkhom ahitai.
target: Look in the scroll of the Lord and read: None of these will be missing, not one will lack her mate. For it is his mouth that has given the order, and his Spirit will gather them together.

source: Chule aman amahodin vang asanin, akhut tah-in khaovin aten, ahopkhen pehtai. Amahon hichu atonsotna alouva, akhang akhanga hichea chu chengding ahiuve.
target: He allots their portions; his hand distributes them by measure. They will possess it forever and dwell there from generation to generation.

source: Gammang lah le gamthip lah chu amaho dingin hungkipah intin, chule neldigam chu thanoma pahchapah banga pahding ahi.
target: The desert and the parched land will be glad; the wilderness will rejoice and blossom. Like the crocus,

source: Nengchetnin pah-intin, kipah le lasah-in thanominte. Lebanon loupina ama kipeding, Karmel le Sharon ahoinapen, Pakai loupina le i-Pathen'u gunchena chungnung penchu amudingu ahi.
target: it will burst into bloom; it will rejoice greatly and shout for joy. The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, the splendor of Carmel and Sharon; they will see the glory of the Lord , the splendor of our God.

source: Khut hatlouho hatsah-un lang, khup ngoiho chu dindet sah-un.
target: Strengthen the feeble hands, steady the knees that give way;

source: Mi meidoite chu hitin seipeh-un, kicha hih-un! veuvin, phula dingle lethuh dinga na Pathen'u hungding; ama hunga nangho nahuhdoh diu ahi.
target: say to those with fearful hearts, “Be strong, do not fear; your God will come, he will come with vengeance; with divine retribution he will come to save you.”

source: Chutengle mitchote mit kihasah intin, chule na-ngongte kho kijahsah ding ahitai.
target: Then will the eyes of the blind be opened and the ears of the deaf unstopped.

source: Chutengle elbai chu sakhi banga kichoma, paomo leichun la asahding, ajehchu gamthipma twiho chule neldi gama vachadung ho hungput doh ding ahi.
target: Then will the lame leap like a deer, and the mute tongue shout for joy. Water will gush forth in the wilderness and streams in the desert.

source: Chule tolgo chu twikul hungsoh doh-a, chule dangchah na gama chu twisam hungsoh ding, Dragon ho chenna le akolnaova chu hampa toh pumpeng le phaipheng hungkeh ding ahi.
target: The burning sand will become a pool, the thirsty ground bubbling springs. In the haunts where jackals once lay, grass and reeds and papyrus will grow.

source: Chua chun lamlhongpi khatle lampi khat umintin, chuche lampi chu thenna lampi kitiding ahi. Atheng louvin achung aho louding; amavang hichu amaho ding ahi. Chule vahle ho ngoljong leu hichea chu adihlou abolloudiu ahi.
target: And a highway will be there; it will be called the Way of Holiness; it will be for those who walk on that Way. The unclean will not journey on it; wicked fools will not go about on it.

source: Chua chu keipi khatcha umtalou ding; sahingne gamsa khatcha jong hichea chu kaltou louding; hichea chu kimulouhel ding ahitai. Ahinla hichemun chu lhatdamsaten bou aho dingu ahi.
target: No lion will be there, nor any ravenous beast; they will not be found there. But only the redeemed will walk there,

source: Chule Pakai lhatdohsate hungkileu vintin, Zion'a hunguva tonsot kipana aluchung uva umding ahi. Amahon kipanale thanopna aneijuva, lungdon nale khoisatna jam mangding ahitai.
target: and those the Lord has rescued will return. They will enter Zion with singing; everlasting joy will crown their heads. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.

source: Tun, Hezekiah lengpa lengchankal kumsom le kumli alhinin, ahitin ahi, Assyria lengpa Sennacherib chu Judah gam khopi satdin ahungtouvin, alasohtan ahi.
target: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah’s reign, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.

source: Chuin Assyria lengpan Lachish'a konin Rabshakeh chu sepai tamtah toh Jerusalem'a Hezekiah lengpa henga asoltan ahi. Chuin ama ponsoppa lou lamlhongpia twikul sahnung twilam panga chun anadinge.
target: Then the king of Assyria sent his field commander with a large army from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. When the commander stopped at the aqueduct of the Upper Pool, on the road to the Launderer’s Field,

source: Chuphatnin insung vaipo Hilkiah chapa Eliakim le Danthusunpa Shebna chule thuchingpa Asaph chapa Joah toh ahunguve.
target: Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went out to him.

source: Chuin Rabshakeh-in ahenguva aseijin, tun nanghon Hezekiah jah-a, leng loupitah Assyria lengpa chun hitin aseije, natahsan kingapna chu ipi ham? ati, tin gaseijun ati.
target: The field commander said to them, “Tell Hezekiah: “ ‘This is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: On what are you basing this confidence of yours?

source: Keiman kati ahi, nangin (ahinla hicheho chu mohthu maimaibou ahi) galsatnadin lunggelna le thahatna kaneije natin ahi. Tun koichunga natahsana, keima douna-a gal naboljeng hitam?
target: You say you have counsel and might for war—but you speak only empty words. On whom are you depending, that you rebel against me?

source: Ven, nangin hiche peng tenggol chipsa Egypt mitehi natahsan ahin, achunga chu mi akingaile akhutna lutna asutding ahi. Egypt lengpa Pharoah chu ama tahsan jouse chunga chutiji ahi.
target: Look, I know you are depending on Egypt, that splintered reed of a staff, which pierces the hand of anyone who leans on it! Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who depend on him.

source: Ahinla nangin kahenga keihon Pakai ka Pathen'u katahsanu ahi, tijongleu chun; ama chu Hezekiah'in amunsangho le amaichamho alahmangpeh-a, Judah le Jerusalem mite jah-a nanghon hiche maicham masanga bou nahoudiu ahi ati hilouham?
target: But if you say to me, “We are depending on the Lord our God”—isn’t he the one whose high places and altars Hezekiah removed, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, “You must worship before this altar”?

source: Hijeh chun tun kangeh nahi, ka Pakai pa Assyria lengpa henga kitepna neijin, nangin achunguva touding mi naneiding poule sakol sangni pengkate.
target: “ ‘Come now, make a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses—if you can put riders on them!

source: Kapu sohte sepai lamkai neopen khat maichu iti naheimanga, sakol kangtalai le sakol galmiho jeh-a Egypt chunga natahsan na-ngap jeng ham?
target: How then can you repulse one officer of the least of my master’s officials, even though you are depending on Egypt for chariots and horsemen?

source: Tu-a keima Pakai panglouva hiche gam douva sumang dinga hungtouva kahiham? Pakaiyin kajah-a hiche gam doudin chetou vinlang, gasumangin eiti.
target: Furthermore, have I come to attack and destroy this land without the Lord ? The Lord himself told me to march against this country and destroy it.’ ”

source: Chujouvin Eliakim le Shebna, chule Joah chun Rabshakeh jah-a nahenga katao ahi, nasohte hengahin Syria te paovin thu seijin; ajehchu hichu keihon kaheuve, palvuma um miho hetthei Judah paovin seihih-in, atiuve.
target: Then Eliakim, Shebna and Joah said to the field commander, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it. Don’t speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall.”

source: Ahinla Rabshakeh chun kapu chun napule nang hengabou hiche thuho seidinga eihinsol ham? Aman palvuma touho khun aeh-u akineh theina diule, ajunu akidon theina diuva ahenguva eihinsol hilouham?
target: But the commander replied, “Was it only to your master and you that my master sent me to say these things, and not to the people sitting on the wall—who, like you, will have to eat their own excrement and drink their own urine?”

source: Chuin Rabshakeh adingin gingtah-in, Juda te paovin asamin; lengloupi Assyria lengpa thuseihohi ngaijun:
target: Then the commander stood and called out in Hebrew, “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!

source: Assyria lengpan hitihin aseije; Hezekiah'in nahuhdoh jouloudiu jeh in ama kilheplhahsah hih-un.
target: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you. He cannot deliver you!

source: Hezekiah chun nangho Pakaiyin thonlouvin eihuhdoh untin hiche khopihi Assyria lengpa khutna kipedoh louhel ding ahi, tin natahsan sah daohen.
target: Do not let Hezekiah persuade you to trust in the Lord when he says, ‘The Lord will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.’

source: Hezekiah thu ngaihih un; Assyria lengpan thilpeh khatnin kinoptona neipeuvinlang, kahenga hungdoh-un; nalengpilei cheh kineh unlang, natheichangphung cheh kineh-un, chule mitinin natwikula twicheh kidonun;
target: “Do not listen to Hezekiah. This is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then each of you will eat fruit from your own vine and fig tree and drink water from your own cistern,

source: keiman nagam tobangu gam khatna changle lengpitwi umna gam changlhah le lengpitwi umna gam khatna kahungpui kahseuvin ati.
target: until I come and take you to a land like your own—a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

source: Chingtheijun, achutiloule Hezekiah'in Pakaiyin eihuhdoh naovinte tintin najollha getnunte. Assyria lengpa khutna kona namtin vaipi pathenho khattou agam huhdohpeh-a umkha tam?
target: “Do not let Hezekiah mislead you when he says, ‘The Lord will deliver us.’ Have the gods of any nations ever delivered their lands from the hand of the king of Assyria?

source: Hamath le Arphad mite pathenho hoiba ham? Sepharvaim pathenho chu hoija umam? Amahon kakhutna kona Samaria ahuhdoh beh-um?
target: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they rescued Samaria from my hand?

source: Hiche gamho pathen lah-a kakhutna kona agamu huhdoh-a koiham? Hitia chu Pakaiyin kakhutna kona Jerusalem ahuhdoh dingham? ati.
target: Who of all the gods of these countries have been able to save their lands from me? How then can the Lord deliver Jerusalem from my hand?”

source: Ahinla amaho athipchetnun, thucheng khatchan adonbut pouve, ajehchu amachu donbut hih-un tin lengpa thulhahna aumtai.
target: But the people remained silent and said nothing in reply, because the king had commanded, “Do not answer him.”

source: Hitichun insung vaipo Hilkiah chapa Eliakim le lekhasunpa Shebna chule thuchingpa Asaph chapa Joah chun aponu kibottel pumin, Hezekiah henga ahungun Rabshakeh thusei ho chu ahung seipeh un ahi.
target: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went to Hezekiah, with their clothes torn, and told him what the field commander had said.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Hezekiah lengpan hiche thuho chu ajah phatnin, apon abottelin, khaodip pon akikhuh-in, Pakai insunga aluttai.
target: When King Hezekiah heard this, he tore his clothes and put on sackcloth and went into the temple of the Lord .

source: Chuin insung vaipo Eliakim le danthusunpa Shebna, chule upa thempuho chu khaodip pon silpumin, Amoz chapa Isaiah themgao henga asoltai.
target: He sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and the leading priests, all wearing sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.

source: Chuin amahon ajah-a, Hezekiah'in hitin aseije, tunihi hesoh nikho, kipho nikho chule taitom nikho ahi. Ajehchu chate pengding ahitan, ahinla apenlhah nadiu thahat aumpoi.
target: They told him, “This is what Hezekiah says: This day is a day of distress and rebuke and disgrace, as when children come to the moment of birth and there is no strength to deliver them.

source: Pakai na Pathen'in Rabshakeh thusei ho ajah theina dinga, amachu apu Assyria lengpan Pathen hing jumso dinga ahinsol ahin, Chule Pakai na Pathen'in athujahho chu abehlhah ding ahi. Hijeh chun akidalha amoh chengse dingin hatah-in taovin.
target: It may be that the Lord your God will hear the words of the field commander, whom his master, the king of Assyria, has sent to ridicule the living God, and that he will rebuke him for the words the Lord your God has heard. Therefore pray for the remnant that still survives.”

source: Chutichun Hezekiah lengpa sohte chu Isaiah henga ahungtaove.
target: When King Hezekiah’s officials came to Isaiah,

source: Chuin Isaiah'in, ahenguva, napupao henga hiti ahi nasei dingu ahi, Pakai chun hitin aseije, Assyria lengpa sohten eitaitom nathu najah hou jehchun kichahih beh-un.
target: Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master, ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not be afraid of what you have heard—those words with which the underlings of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

source: Veuvin, keiman achunga hui hattah solingting, chule aman thuthang khat jantin, agamlama kilekit ding, ama agamsung tah-a chemjam'a kalousah ding ahi, ati.
target: Listen! When he hears a certain report, I will make him want to return to his own country, and there I will have him cut down with the sword.’ ”

source: Chutichun Rabshakeh chu akilekitnin ahile Assyria lengpa Libna douna-a agalsatpet agatohtai. Ajehchu aman Lachish adalhatai ti thu anajatan ahi.
target: When the field commander heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish, he withdrew and found the king fighting against Libnah.

source: Chuin Ethiopia lengpa Tirhakah nangtoh kisatdin ahung kondoh-e ti chungchang thukisei ajatai. Hichu ajah phatnin Hezekiah henga thupo khat asollin, ajah-a;
target: Now Sennacherib received a report that Tirhakah, the king of Cush, was marching out to fight against him. When he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah with this word:

source: Hitia hi Judah lengpa Hezekiah henga naseiding ahi. Assyria lengpa khutna Jerusalem kipedoh louding ahi tin nangin natahsan pa Pathen chu kilheplhahsah hihbeh-in.
target: “Say to Hezekiah king of Judah: Do not let the god you depend on deceive you when he says, ‘Jerusalem will not be given into the hands of the king of Assyria.’

source: Veuvin, Assyria lengten gamjouse iti asuhmang hellem, tithu najatai. Hichu ahile nangma huhdohna hideh ding hinam?
target: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the countries, destroying them completely. And will you be delivered?

source: kapateuvin anasuh mangho Gozam, Haran, Rezeph chule Telassar'a anaum Eden chate banga chu namtin vaipite pathenho chun amaho chu anahuhdoh nah um?
target: Did the gods of the nations that were destroyed by my predecessors deliver them—the gods of Gozan, Harran, Rezeph and the people of Eden who were in Tel Assar?

source: Hamath lengpa, Arpad lengpa, Sepharvaim khopi lengpa Hena chule Ivah khopi lengpa hoija umtam?
target: Where is the king of Hamath or the king of Arpad? Where are the kings of Lair, Sepharvaim, Hena and Ivvah?”

source: Chuin Hezekiah'in lekhathot chu thupole ho khutna konchun alan hichu asimtai. Chuin Hezekiah Pakai inlama achetouvin Pakai angsunga chun aphajaltai.
target: Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers and read it. Then he went up to the temple of the Lord and spread it out before the Lord .

source: Chuin Hezekiah Pakai henga ataovin aseije,
target: And Hezekiah prayed to the Lord :

source: Vo janel Pakai, Israel Pathen, Cherubim ho kah-a chengjing pa, leiset lenggam jouse-a nangma Pathen nahin; nangma ngeibou nahi. Nangin vanle lei nanasemme.
target: “ Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, enthroned between the cherubim, you alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

source: Vo Pakai, nana sungin lang ngaijin, vo Pakai, namit hasah inlang hinvetan, chule Senacherib'in hingjing Pathen housetna-a ahinthot thu jousehi ngaijin.
target: Give ear, Lord , and hear; open your eyes, Lord , and see; listen to all the words Sennacherib has sent to ridicule the living God.

source: Atahbeh in Pakai, Assyria lenghon namjousele agamsunghou ahomkeovin akoi gamtaove.
target: “It is true, Lord , that the Assyrian kings have laid waste all these peoples and their lands.

source: Chule apathenhou meilhum sunga alehlutnuve, ajehchu amaho pathen hilouva mihem khutsem thingle songbou ahiuvin, hijeh-a chubou asuhmangu ahi.
target: They have thrown their gods into the fire and destroyed them, for they were not gods but only wood and stone, fashioned by human hands.

source: Hijeh chun tuhin, vo Pakai, ka Pathen nu, akhutna konin nei huhdoh-un, chutile leiset lenggam jousen nangma Pakai, nangma sehbou Pakai nahichu hethei taovinte, ati.
target: Now, Lord our God, deliver us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, Lord , are the only God.”

source: Chujouvin Amoz chapa Isaiah chun Hezekiah henga mi asolin, Assyria lengpa Sennacherib douna-a kahenga nataona chu, Israel Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije,
target: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent a message to Hezekiah: “This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Because you have prayed to me concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria,

source: ama chungchang Pakaiyin aseithu chu hichehi ahi. Nungah theng Zion chanun nangma nanoisen, nahsahmonan nanuisat in, Jerusalem chanun alu nathin khume.
target: this is the word the Lord has spoken against him: “Virgin Daughter Zion despises and mocks you. Daughter Jerusalem tosses her head as you flee.

source: Nangin koi nahousetna nataitom ham? Koi douna-a na aw nasansah-a chungsang lam nangatna navettou ham? Israel mitheng patah douna ahi.
target: Who is it you have ridiculed and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes in pride? Against the Holy One of Israel!

source: Nasohte-a konin Pakai chu nahousen hitin naseije, ka kangtalai tamtah toh molsang ho geijin Lebanon lhang pangho-a hungtou vingting, cedar thingphung sanghole chahthing hoiho phuhlhung ting, agamgi munsang ho le Karmel gammanga kalhut ding ahi.
target: By your messengers you have ridiculed the Lord. And you have said, ‘With my many chariots I have ascended the heights of the mountains, the utmost heights of Lebanon. I have cut down its tallest cedars, the choicest of its junipers. I have reached its remotest heights, the finest of its forests.

source: Keiman kotong kalaijin twi kadontai. Chule kakengton aki-umkul munho-a vadung jouse kalho kangtai.
target: I have dug wells in foreign lands and drunk the water there. With the soles of my feet I have dried up all the streams of Egypt.’

source: Hichehi iti kanabol hija, malaija patna iti kagontohsah-am, tichu sotna nanajah hitalou ham? Tu-a hi kagui lhunsah ahitai, Kulpi kikaikhum khopi ho akeova umsah-a, manthah na-a sevum dinga chu nangma nahiding ahi.
target: “Have you not heard? Long ago I ordained it. In days of old I planned it; now I have brought it to pass, that you have turned fortified cities into piles of stone.

source: Hijeh chun achengho chu thalhom tah ahiuvin, amaho alungthoijun alungdonguve. Amaho chu loujaova hampa tobangle chang aphung lhin masanga huise semgot tobang ahiuve.
target: Their people, drained of power, are dismayed and put to shame. They are like plants in the field, like tender green shoots, like grass sprouting on the roof, scorched before it grows up.

source: Hinla keiman naumna, napotdoh, nahunglut chule kachunga nalunghan kahenai.
target: “But I know where you are and when you come and go and how you rage against me.

source: Ajehchu kachunga nalunghannale, nahusa ginchu kanasunga ahunglut tai. Hijeh chun ka ngakoi nanah homa sutongting, nakama kakamdal kabuding, nahungna lampia chu kalehei kitding nahi.
target: Because you rage against me and because your insolence has reached my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth, and I will make you return by the way you came.

source: Hichehi nangdinga amelchihna hiding ahi. Tukum achama kehho naneh ding, kum nina jongle chuche-a dondoh chu nen natin, chule kumthum nateng nanghon kitun lang, ki-atnun, chule lengpilei kibolin lang aga nen.
target: “This will be the sign for you, Hezekiah: “This year you will eat what grows by itself, and the second year what springs from that. But in the third year sow and reap, plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

source: Chule Judah insungmi asohcha ahoidoh chengsen, jung akhosuh-a chule achunglamin ga aneiding ahi.
target: Once more a remnant of the kingdom of Judah will take root below and bear fruit above.

source: Ajehchu Jerusalem'a kona ahoidoh chengsele Zion'a kona asohchaho hung sohdoh ding ahiuve. Janel Pakai tompana-in hiche aboldoh ahi.
target: For out of Jerusalem will come a remnant, and out of Mount Zion a band of survivors. The zeal of the Lord Almighty will accomplish this.

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Assyria lengpa thudol hitihin aseijin, ama hiche khopi sunga hunglut louding, thalchang khatjong akap louding, amasanga lumdal puma jong hunglou ding, hiche satna dinga leikul jong asetlouding ahi.
target: “Therefore this is what the Lord says concerning the king of Assyria: “He will not enter this city or shoot an arrow here. He will not come before it with shield or build a siege ramp against it.

source: Ahungna lampi mama-a chu kinungle-a, hiche khopiahi hung louhel ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: By the way that he came he will return; he will not enter this city,” declares the Lord .

source: Ajehchu hiche khopihi keimajeh le kasoh David jeh-a kahuhdoh ding ahi, ati.
target: “I will defend this city and save it, for my sake and for the sake of David my servant!”

source: Chuin Pakai vantil chu apotdoh-in, Assyria ho ngahmuna sang jakhatle sangsomget le sanga athattai. Chuin jingpi-a ahungtho phatnun vetan; mithilong jeng anahitaove.
target: Then the angel of the Lord went out and put to death a hundred and eighty-five thousand in the Assyrian camp. When the people got up the next morning—there were all the dead bodies!

source: Chutichun Assyria lengpa Sennacherib chu apotdoh-in achen akilekitnin Nineveh'a achengtai.
target: So Sennacherib king of Assyria broke camp and withdrew. He returned to Nineveh and stayed there.

source: Chutichun ahitin ahi. Aman a-pathen Nisroch insunga pathen ahoupetnin achapateni Adram-melech le Sharezer'in chemjamin athatlhonin, Armania gama ajamlut lhontai. Chuin achapa Esar-haddon chu akhelin alengchang tai.
target: One day, while he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisrok, his sons Adrammelek and Sharezer killed him with the sword, and they escaped to the land of Ararat. And Esarhaddon his son succeeded him as king.

source: Hichelai chun Hezekiah chu thidingin anatan ahi. Chuin Amoz chapa Isaiah themgao chu ahenga ahungin, ajah-a, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, na-insung kisemtuptan, ajehchu nangma damdoh joulouva nathiding ahitai, ati.
target: In those days Hezekiah became ill and was at the point of death. The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz went to him and said, “This is what the Lord says: Put your house in order, because you are going to die; you will not recover.”

source: Chujouvin Hezekiah'in banglama amai aheijin, Pakai henga ataovin.
target: Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the Lord ,

source: Vo Pakai kengeh nahi, namasanga thutah le lungdih po-a, chule namitmu-a thilpha kanabolho chu tun neigeldoh peh tan, ati. Chuin Hezekiah hakan akaptai.
target: “Remember, Lord , how I have walked before you faithfully and with wholehearted devotion and have done what is good in your eyes.” And Hezekiah wept bitterly.

source: Chuin Pakai thuchu Isaiah henga ahung lhungin.
target: Then the word of the Lord came to Isaiah:

source: Hezekiah henga chun chenlang gaseijin, Pakai napa David Pathen'in hitin aseije, nataona kajan, namitlhi lon kamutai; vetan, keiman nahinkho kum somle kumnga kajopbe ding ahi, ati.
target: “Go and tell Hezekiah, ‘This is what the Lord , the God of your father David, says: I have heard your prayer and seen your tears; I will add fifteen years to your life.

source: Chule keiman nangmale hiche khopihi Assyria lengpa khutna kona kahuh doh-a hiche khopihi kahonbit ding ahi.
target: And I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city.

source: Pakaiyin aseisa chu aboltei ding ahi, tihi Pakaiya kona namelchihna ding chu ahi;
target: “ ‘This is the Lord ’s sign to you that the Lord will do what he has promised:

source: Vetan, keiman nisa lim chu hinlepui kitningting, Ahaz maikoh-a lhumsuhsa chu kalsoma kanungchon ding ahi. Chutichun alhumsuhsa-a konchun nisa chu kalsom anungchontan ahi.
target: I will make the shadow cast by the sun go back the ten steps it has gone down on the stairway of Ahaz.’ ” So the sunlight went back the ten steps it had gone down.

source: Judah lengpa Hezekiah damlouva auma ahung damdoh phatna athilsut chu hichehi ahi.
target: A writing of Hezekiah king of Judah after his illness and recovery:

source: Kahin nikho kisumanga thikholkhul kam jonding kahitan, kahin kumkho umnalai ho chu lahpeh kahitai, kanatin ahi.
target: I said, “In the prime of my life must I go through the gates of death and be robbed of the rest of my years?”

source: Pakai muponge, chule mihing gamachun Pakai le vannoi'a cheng mihemchu mukit taponge kanatin ahi.
target: I said, “I will not again see the Lord himself in the land of the living; no longer will I look on my fellow man, or be with those who now dwell in this world.

source: Kakhanghi achemangin, kelngoi chingpa pon in bangin akichonmangtai. Kahinkhohi pon kikhong bangin akijel doh tai. Natah-a kisuh natna-a eisuhmang ding ahi. Sun-apat jankhang geija neikichai sah ding ahitai.
target: Like a shepherd’s tent my house has been pulled down and taken from me. Like a weaver I have rolled up my life, and he has cut me off from the loom; day and night you made an end of me.

source: Jingkah geijin kakou kouvin, keipi bangin chutichun kagu jouse subongintin, sun-apat jangeija neikichai sah ding ahitai.
target: I waited patiently till dawn, but like a lion he broke all my bones; day and night you made an end of me.

source: Chule pelpa le vakengsang bangin kaham hamin, vahui bangin kamao maove. Chunglam vetnan kamit teni akhamtai. Vo Pakai eiki sugenthei tai, neivesui jin.
target: I cried like a swift or thrush, I moaned like a mourning dove. My eyes grew weak as I looked to the heavens. I am being threatened; Lord, come to my aid!”

source: Ipi seitang em? Aman kahenga aseijin, ama maman abolchai tai. Kahinna hi gimtah-in kahinkho lhumkeijin oltah-in chejingjeng tange.
target: But what can I say? He has spoken to me, and he himself has done this. I will walk humbly all my years because of this anguish of my soul.

source: Vo Pakai hitiho jal hin mite ahingjingin, hicheng thil jouse-a hi kalhagao hinna hi uma ahi. Chutichun nangin neidamsah kitnin natin, neihinsah kitnin nate.
target: Lord, by such things people live; and my spirit finds life in them too. You restored me to health and let me live.

source: Vetan chamnahi kana hotbol lheh-e; Ahinla kalhagao hi ngailutna-in setna kokhuh-a konin nahuhdoh tai. Ajehchu kachonsetna jouse nanung lama nasep mangtai.
target: Surely it was for my benefit that I suffered such anguish. In your love you kept me from the pit of destruction; you have put all my sins behind your back.

source: Ajehchu thikhol khulin navahchoi theipon, thina in nakipapi theipoi. Kokhuh-a kumlha hon jong nathudih akineppi theipouve.
target: For the grave cannot praise you, death cannot sing your praise; those who go down to the pit cannot hope for your faithfulness.

source: Mihing, mihingin vang tunia kabol banghin vahchoi jinnate, pan chate chu nathudih hetsah unte.
target: The living, the living—they praise you, as I am doing today; parents tell their children about your faithfulness.

source: Pakai chu eihuhhing dinga phasadem ahi. Hijeh chun tumging tothon kahinkho lhumkeijun Pakai insunga la saovinge.
target: The Lord will save me, and we will sing with stringed instruments all the days of our lives in the temple of the Lord .

source: Ajehchu Isaiah'in theichang bohkhat laohen lang uilut chunga chun louvin nu-uhen chutile damkit tante, ati.
target: Isaiah had said, “Prepare a poultice of figs and apply it to the boil, and he will recover.”

source: Hezekiah'in Pakai inna kachetou nading melchihna ipiham? tinjong anaseije.
target: Hezekiah had asked, “What will be the sign that I will go up to the temple of the Lord ?”

source: Hichelai chun Babylon lengpa Baladan chapa Merodach-baladan'in Hezekiah anan adamkit tai, ti thu ajah jeh-in lekhathot tampile thilpeh agahthotnin ahi.
target: At that time Marduk-Baladan son of Baladan king of Babylon sent Hezekiah letters and a gift, because he had heard of his illness and recovery.

source: Chuin Hezekiah'in hicheho chu akipapin, amaho chu athil lu ho in chu avetsah sohkeijin; sana, dangka, gimnamtui mantamho chule agal manchah ho in, chule agou kholna-a umjouse avetsahsoh heltan ahi. A-insung le avaihomna sunga Hezekiah'in avet sahlou khatcha jong aumtapoi.
target: Hezekiah received the envoys gladly and showed them what was in his storehouses—the silver, the gold, the spices, the fine olive oil—his entire armory and everything found among his treasures. There was nothing in his palace or in all his kingdom that Hezekiah did not show them.

source: Chuin Isaiah themgao chu Hezekiah lengpa henga ahungin, ajah-a, miho hin ipi aseijuva? hoija kona nahenga hunga hiuvam? atin ahi. Chuin Hezekiah'in, amaho gamlatah Babylon gamlampeh-a kona kahenga hunga ahiuve, ati.
target: Then Isaiah the prophet went to King Hezekiah and asked, “What did those men say, and where did they come from?” “From a distant land,” Hezekiah replied. “They came to me from Babylon.”

source: Chuin aman, amahon na-insunga ipipi amuvem? ati. Chuin Hezekiah'in adonbutnin, amahon ka-insunga umjouse amuvin, kagou thil lah-a amaho kamusahlou khatchabeh aumpoi, ati.
target: The prophet asked, “What did they see in your palace?” “They saw everything in my palace,” Hezekiah said. “There is nothing among my treasures that I did not show them.”

source: Chuin Isaiah'in Hezekiah henga, janel Pakaiyin asei thuhi ngaijin.
target: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of the Lord Almighty:

source: Vetan, na-insunga umjouse le napu napaten tunigeija akhol khomho jouse Babylon'a akipoh mangna nikho hung lhungding ahi; imacha akikhena umlou helding ahi, Pakaiyin aseije.
target: The time will surely come when everything in your palace, and all that your predecessors have stored up until this day, will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will be left, says the Lord .

source: Chule nachate, nanga kona pengdoh dingle nangin nahindingho jong apuimangdiu ahin; chule amahochu Babylon lengpa inpisunga nukiso hiding ahiuve.
target: And some of your descendants, your own flesh and blood who will be born to you, will be taken away, and they will become eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.”

source: Chuin Hezekiah'in Isaiah henga, nangin naseidoh Pakai thuchu aphai, ati. Aman chukalvalin keima hinkho sungin chamnale thudih lenghen, ati.
target: “The word of the Lord you have spoken is good,” Hezekiah replied. For he thought, “There will be peace and security in my lifetime.”

source: Nangho lungmongun, nangho lungmongun, kamite, tin na Pathen'un aseijin ahi.
target: Comfort, comfort my people, says your God.

source: Jerusalem henga damheochan seijun, agalbol lah molso ahitan, akhan git louna akingaidamtai tin ajah-a samun, ajehchu amanun achonsetna jouse jal-in Pakaiya konin ajat ni akimutai.
target: Speak tenderly to Jerusalem, and proclaim to her that her hard service has been completed, that her sin has been paid for, that she has received from the Lord ’s hand double for all her sins.

source: Gamthipma khosam aw chun nanghon Pakai lampi semtoh-un, nelgama chun i-Pathen'uva din lamlhongpi semjangun, ati.
target: A voice of one calling: “In the wilderness prepare the way for the Lord; make straight in the desert a highway for our God.

source: Damphai jouse kidomsanga, molsangtin le lhang jouse kisunem ding ahi. Akonlai kisujanga, aphonlai chu kisunamding ahi
target: Every valley shall be raised up, every mountain and hill made low; the rough ground shall become level, the rugged places a plain.

source: Chuteng Pakai loupinachu hungkilang intin, tahsaphe jousen amukhom sohkei diu ahi. Ajehchu Pakai kamin hichu asei ahitai.
target: And the glory of the Lord will be revealed, and all people will see it together. For the mouth of the Lord has spoken.”

source: Ogin chun samin, atin ahi. Chuin aman ipi kasap dingham? ati. Tahsaphe jousehi hampa tobang ahin, aphatna jouse jong loujaova pahcha pah tobang bou ahi.
target: A voice says, “Cry out.” And I said, “What shall I cry?” “All people are like grass, and all their faithfulness is like the flowers of the field.

source: Hampa agopjin, pahcha apuljie, ajehchu Pakai lhagaovin ahinsemji ahi. Tahbeh mongin mihem hi hampa tobang ahi.
target: The grass withers and the flowers fall, because the breath of the Lord blows on them. Surely the people are grass.

source: Hampa agopjin, pahcha apuljie, ahinla Pathen thu vang atonsotna ding jingjeng ding ahi.
target: The grass withers and the flowers fall, but the word of our God endures forever.”

source: Kipana thupha hinpo-a, vo Zion, molsanga khun kaltouvin; kipana thupha hinpo-a, vo Jerusalem, nathanei chasunin na aw sansah-in, sansah-in; kicha hih-in, Judah khopiho henga, veuvin, na Pathen'u khu? tiuvin.
target: You who bring good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who bring good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with a shout, lift it up, do not be afraid; say to the towns of Judah, “Here is your God!”

source: Veuvin, Pakai Pathen chu khut thahat tah-a hungding ahi, chule abantha-a avai ahomding, atohphat man chu akoma uma chule anatoh chu amasanga umding ahi.
target: See, the Sovereign Lord comes with power, and he rules with a mighty arm. See, his reward is with him, and his recompense accompanies him.

source: Aman kelngoi chingpa banga aganchahon avah ding ahi. Aman abana akelngoiho chu ahoikhoma, a-opma akipomding, anousen puma hicheho chu olchacha apuile ding ahi.
target: He tends his flock like a shepherd: He gathers the lambs in his arms and carries them close to his heart; he gently leads those that have young.

source: Akhut phang tonga twivei ho tetheija, akhapma van tethei, leija leivuiho tena khatna hedohtheija, tena-a molsangho tedoh-a, chule lhangho khaikotna khaija koiham?
target: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, or with the breadth of his hand marked off the heavens? Who has held the dust of the earth in a basket, or weighed the mountains on the scales and the hills in a balance?

source: Pakai Lhagao chu hila, thumopma panga, hilchah-a koiham?
target: Who can fathom the Spirit of the Lord , or instruct the Lord as his counselor?

source: Koito kithumoptoa, ama kon ahila, thutandan lampi kon ahila, chule chihna thu ahila, chule hetkhen themna lamlhah kon ama amusah khah-em?
target: Whom did the Lord consult to enlighten him, and who taught him the right way? Who was it that taught him knowledge, or showed him the path of understanding?

source: Vetan, namtin vaipihi baltina twi vatkhat bangbep ahin, chule khaikotna leivui sipah bangbepma asim ahin, vetan, twikol gamho chu thil neochakhat bangin alan ahi.
target: Surely the nations are like a drop in a bucket; they are regarded as dust on the scales; he weighs the islands as though they were fine dust.

source: Chule Lebanon chu meija tikham ahipon, asunga ganhingho jeng jong govam thil to-a tokham ahipouve.
target: Lebanon is not sufficient for altar fires, nor its animals enough for burnt offerings.

source: Namtin vaipi a-angsunga ima ahipouvin; amaho chu amadinga imacha hilou, agohkeo ahiuve.
target: Before him all the nations are as nothing; they are regarded by him as worthless and less than nothing.

source: Achutile Pathen chu koito nakibahsah uva? Ipi akibahpito natekah dingu ham?
target: With whom, then, will you compare God? To what image will you liken him?

source: Mikhut themin milim asemjin, sana khengin achunga sanan atomjin, chule dangka sumgui akhengjin ahi.
target: As for an idol, a metalworker casts it, and a goldsmith overlays it with gold and fashions silver chains for it.

source: Todoh ding neiloi mivaicha tah chun amotlouding thing akilhenin; achatloh theilou ding semthu milim semsah dingin, mikhut themtah akiholjin ahi.
target: A person too poor to present such an offering selects wood that will not rot; they look for a skilled worker to set up an idol that will not topple.

source: Nahet khah, najahkhah loulai uham? Semtila patna kihilkha loulai nahiuvem? Leiset bulkiphu-a pat nahetkhen thei loulai uham?
target: Do you not know? Have you not heard? Has it not been told you from the beginning? Have you not understood since the earth was founded?

source: Leiset kikol lum chunga touva ama ahin, asunga cheng ho jong khaokhopi tobang ahiuvin; vanho ponjal banga jeldoh-a, chenna inding pon-in banga jahdoh-a ama ahi.
target: He sits enthroned above the circle of the earth, and its people are like grasshoppers. He stretches out the heavens like a canopy, and spreads them out like a tent to live in.

source: Aman leng chapate imalouvin akoijin; aman leiset thutan ho agohkeovin asemtai.
target: He brings princes to naught and reduces the rulers of this world to nothing.

source: Henge, amaho kiphut lou ding ahiuvin; tu jong kitulou dingu; aphungu leija jungkho manlou ding; chule Aman amaho amut teng jongle amaho gop lhading, chule changpol banga chimpeijin apeimang dingu ahi.
target: No sooner are they planted, no sooner are they sown, no sooner do they take root in the ground, than he blows on them and they wither, and a whirlwind sweeps them away like chaff.

source: Achutile koito neikibah sah uva, ahiloule koito kakibah dingham? tin mithengpan aseijin ahi.
target: “To whom will you compare me? Or who is my equal?” says the Holy One.

source: Namtinin chungsang lam nganlang, hichengse sempale ajanelu ahon hona puidohpa khu vetemun; aman aletnale athahatnan amincheh-in akouvin, Ama thanei na-a hattah ahijeh in khatcha akhenpoi.
target: Lift up your eyes and look to the heavens: Who created all these? He who brings out the starry host one by one and calls forth each of them by name. Because of his great power and mighty strength, not one of them is missing.

source: Vo Jacob, vo Israel, kalampihi Pakaiya kona kisel ahin, kathutanhi ka Pathen'a kon ahipoi tia ipidinga naseiham?
target: Why do you complain, Jacob? Why do you say, Israel, “My way is hidden from the Lord ; my cause is disregarded by my God”?

source: Pathen, Pakai, leiset kolmong geija sempa, nahetkhah-a najahkhah louham? Lhasam khalou, choljong cholkhalou, ama hetkhen themna holdoh jouhoi hilou ahi.
target: Do you not know? Have you not heard? The Lord is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He will not grow tired or weary, and his understanding no one can fathom.

source: Aman milhasam chu hatna apen; chule thaneilou chu athahat nao akalsahjin ahi.
target: He gives strength to the weary and increases the power of the weak.

source: Khangdongho jengjong lhasama choldingu, gollhangho jong kipala lhuding ahiuve.
target: Even youths grow tired and weary, and young men stumble and fall;

source: Ahinla Pakai ngahjingho chun athao kisem thah-un tin; muvanlai bangin alhaovin lengtou untin; amaho lhaijuva chollou dingu; chule vahleuva lhasam louding ahiuve.
target: but those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint.

source: Vo twikol gamho, ka-anga thipchetnun; miten athao semthah-uhen; amaho hungnaiju henlang, chuteng thu seijuhen, thutanna mun chu naicheh-u hite.
target: “Be silent before me, you islands! Let the nations renew their strength! Let them come forward and speak; let us meet together at the place of judgment.

source: Solama kona michonpha pa chu hintungdoh-a, akhophang bulla kou-a, namtin vaipi a-angsunga pe-a, lengho chunga ama vaihomsah chu koiham? Amahochu leivui kisoh dingin chemjam ma apedoh-in; changpol kithethang bang thethang din athalpi henga apedoh tan ahi.
target: “Who has stirred up one from the east, calling him in righteousness to his service? He hands nations over to him and subdues kings before him. He turns them to dust with his sword, to windblown chaff with his bow.

source: Amaho chu anungdelin bitkeijin agalkaijin; lampia chun akengin jong achepoi.
target: He pursues them and moves on unscathed, by a path his feet have not traveled before.

source: Hichehi koijin atoh-a chule abol hintem; semtila patna akhang akhanga miho kou-a natong jouva chu koiham? Keima Pakai amasale anukhah, ama chu keihi kahi.
target: Who has done this and carried it through, calling forth the generations from the beginning? I, the Lord —with the first of them and with the last—I am he.”

source: Twikol gamhon hichu amuvin, akichauve; leiset kolmangho jong akitihot hot-un, ahung kikhin naijun ahing taove.
target: The islands have seen it and fear; the ends of the earth tremble. They approach and come forward;

source: Amaho amitakipmin aheng akomcheh akithopiuvin; chule amitakipmin asopipa jah-a, hangtah-in pangin, atiuve.
target: they help each other and say to their companions, “Be strong!”

source: Chutichun khut thempan sana khengpa atilkhouvin, chule sehcha-a khenpan thihnoidou khenpa atilkhouvin, ajah-a, solmat dinga phasadem ahitai atin, akilon lounadin thihkilin akildetne.
target: The metalworker encourages the goldsmith, and the one who smooths with the hammer spurs on the one who strikes the anvil. One says of the welding, “It is good.” The other nails down the idol so it will not topple.

source: Ahinla, Israel nangma kagolpa Abraham chilhah-a kalhacha Jacob chu nahi.
target: “But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen, you descendants of Abraham my friend,

source: Leiset kolmonga kona kalah-a, chukoma milenho-a kona kakouva, najah-a kasei ahi.
target: I took you from the ends of the earth, from its farthest corners I called you. I said, ‘You are my servant’; I have chosen you and have not rejected you.

source: Nangma kaumpi jeh-in kicha hih-in, keima na Pathen kahijeh-in lunglha hih-in; henge, keiman kahatsah ding nahin; Keiman nakithopi nange, chule keiman nangma kachon phatna khutjetna katuh ding nahi.
target: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.

source: Vetan, nangma douva lunghansah jouse chu jahchaova, kisudongdiu ahi. Amaho imalouhel banguntin, nakinahpiho chu mangthah ding ahiuve.
target: “All who rage against you will surely be ashamed and disgraced; those who oppose you will be as nothing and perish.

source: Nangman amahole nakinahpiho ngeichu nahola namu louding; nangma douva galbolho chu imalouhel leh pannabei sohding ahiuve.
target: Though you search for your enemies, you will not find them. Those who wage war against you will be as nothing at all.

source: Ajehchu keima Pakai na Pathen'in nakhutjetna katuh-a, kicha hih-in, keiman nangma panpi nange kati ding ahi.
target: For I am the Lord your God who takes hold of your right hand and says to you, Do not fear; I will help you.

source: Nangma lungtol Jacob, chule nangho Israel mite kicha hih-un; keiman panpinange, tin Pakai nalhandam pu Israel Mithengpan aseije.
target: Do not be afraid, you worm Jacob, little Israel, do not fear, for I myself will help you,” declares the Lord , your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.

source: Vetan, keiman nangma chang chilna manchah hanei hemtah-a kasemthah ding nahi. Nangin mol ho nachila, navoh ngemding, chule lhangho chu changvai nabahsah ding ahi.
target: “See, I will make you into a threshing sledge, new and sharp, with many teeth. You will thresh the mountains and crush them, and reduce the hills to chaff.

source: Nangin amaho najapma, huichun alhoh mangdiu, chule chimpei chun athecheh diu ahi. Chule nangma Pakaiya halna-in kipah-in natin, Israel Mithengpa-a chun loupitan nate.
target: You will winnow them, the wind will pick them up, and a gale will blow them away. But you will rejoice in the Lord and glory in the Holy One of Israel.

source: Avaichale alhasamin twi athuma, koimachan pelouva aleiju dangchah-a agotteng, Pakai keiman nousah ingting, Israel Pathen keiman amaho kapaidoh louding ahi.
target: “The poor and needy search for water, but there is none; their tongues are parched with thirst. But I the Lord will answer them; I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.

source: Keiman munsang ho-a vadunglen holeh phaicham lailunga twinahho kahonding ahi. Keiman gamthiplai twikul'a chule gam golai twisam putna-a kasemding ahi.
target: I will make rivers flow on barren heights, and springs within the valleys. I will turn the desert into pools of water, and the parched ground into springs.

source: Keiman gamthipma cedar thing, thinggi thing, le pahcha thing chule thao thing kaphua; neldi gama chahthing, phan thing chule thingkhang thing kaphu ding ahi.
target: I will put in the desert the cedar and the acacia, the myrtle and the olive. I will set junipers in the wasteland, the fir and the cypress together,

source: Chutia chu amahon amuva, ahetnuva, angaitouva, chule ahetthem cheh theina diuva Pakai khutnin hichu abola, chule Israel mithengpan hichu anasem ahi.
target: so that people may see and know, may consider and understand, that the hand of the Lord has done this, that the Holy One of Israel has created it.

source: Pakaiyin nakibaonao hinpolutnun ati; nathu hahsao hinpolutnun tin Jacob dinga lengpan aseije.
target: “Present your case,” says the Lord . “Set forth your arguments,” says Jacob’s King.

source: Amahon hicheho chu hinpolutnu henlang thil hunglhung ding eimusah uhen; amahon thil masaho chu ipiham? kangaitouva, akichaina kahet theina dingun eimusah-uhen; ahiloule ahunglhung dingho eiphon dohpeh uhen.
target: “Tell us, you idols, what is going to happen. Tell us what the former things were, so that we may consider them and know their final outcome. Or declare to us the things to come,

source: Nangho pathen ho nahiuve ti kahet theina dingun, tununga thil hunglhung dingho tahlangun; ahi, kalung thoijuva kamucheh nadiuvin apha ham aseham boluvin.
target: tell us what the future holds, so we may know that you are gods. Do something, whether good or bad, so that we will be dismayed and filled with fear.

source: Veuvin, imacha hilou nahiuvin, natoh-u jong pannabei ahi. Naki lhanpao chu thet umtah ahi.
target: But you are less than nothing and your works are utterly worthless; whoever chooses you is detestable.

source: Keiman sahlam gama konin mikhat katungin, ama chu hungding ahi: aman niso-a pat kamin akouding; Songchung kichonpha tobangle beldengpan leingan achil banga ama pipuiho chunga hungchu ding ahi.
target: “I have stirred up one from the north, and he comes— one from the rising sun who calls on my name. He treads on rulers as if they were mortar, as if he were a potter treading the clay.

source: Ihettheina diuleh ama chonpha ahi iti theina diuva abula patna kon aphonkhah-em? ahi, khatchan atahlangpon; ahi, khatchan aphongdoh poi; ahi, nathu ja-a khatcha ana umpoi.
target: Who told of this from the beginning, so we could know, or beforehand, so we could say, ‘He was right’? No one told of this, no one foretold it, no one heard any words from you.

source: Amasan Zion henga, ven, ven, amahokhu tinnate; Jerusalem chu kipana thupha pole-a khat kapeh ding ahi.
target: I was the first to tell Zion, ‘Look, here they are!’ I gave to Jerusalem a messenger of good news.

source: Ajehchu kagah vetleh koimacha kamupon; amaho kadohjongle thukhat donbut theijong alah uvah kamupoi, khatcha aumpouve.
target: I look but there is no one— no one among the gods to give counsel, no one to give answer when I ask them.

source: Vetemun, abonun pannabei jeng ahiuvin; atoh-u jong mohseh ahin; amilim kilhajol ujong hui lhi le ahomkeo ngen ahiuve.
target: See, they are all false! Their deeds amount to nothing; their images are but wind and confusion.

source: Veovin, kasottol, katuhjing, kalhentum; achunga kalung kipanakhu; achunga kalhagao kakoijin; aman chidang namdang ho henga thutanna anei ding ahi.
target: “Here is my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen one in whom I delight; I will put my Spirit on him, and he will bring justice to the nations.

source: Aman kho asaplouding, a-aw asodoh louhel ding, khopi lamlena jong a-aw kija louhel ding ahi.
target: He will not shout or cry out, or raise his voice in the streets.

source: Pumpeng kihehchip ahebohpai louding, thaomei patkhu athamit pailou ding ahi. Aman thudih-a thutanna apohdoh ding ahi.
target: A bruised reed he will not break, and a smoldering wick he will not snuff out. In faithfulness he will bring forth justice;

source: Leiset chunga thutanna aumsah masangse-a losam louding chule lungjong lunglhalouding; twikol gamhon ama danthupeh angaidiu ahi.
target: he will not falter or be discouraged till he establishes justice on earth. In his teaching the islands will put their hope.”

source: Vanho sema jahdohpa, leiset le asunga kona hungsoh ho phajaopa; chule achunga mite henga haina hule asunga vahle miho henga lhagao pe-a Pakai Pathen chun hitin aseije.
target: This is what God the Lord says— the Creator of the heavens, who stretches them out, who spreads out the earth with all that springs from it, who gives breath to its people, and life to those who walk on it:

source: Keima Pakai hin chonphatna-a kakou nahin, nakhut katuh-a kavet tupma, mitin dinga kitepna chule chidang namdangte vah hidinga kasem ding nahin;
target: “I, the Lord , have called you in righteousness; I will take hold of your hand. I will keep you and will make you to be a covenant for the people and a light for the Gentiles,

source: mitcho ho mit hasah ding, sohchangho songkulla kon puidoh ding, chule songkulsung muthim lah-a touho puidoh dinga kapansah nahi.
target: to open eyes that are blind, to free captives from prison and to release from the dungeon those who sit in darkness.

source: Keima Pakai chu kahin; hichu kamin ahi. Kaloupina chu midang kapehlouding, eiki vahchoina jong milim semthuho henga pelouding kahi.
target: “I am the Lord ; that is my name! I will not yield my glory to another or my praise to idols.

source: Veuvin, phatmasa thilho chu ahung lhungtan, thilthah ho kaphong doh-in; ahung dotdoh masanga athu dollu kahil masatdem nahiuve.
target: See, the former things have taken place, and new things I declare; before they spring into being I announce them to you.”

source: Nangho twikhanglen'a kumsuh hole asunga umho jousen; twikol gamle asunga cheng, leiset kolmonga patnin Pakai henga lathah khat saovin.
target: Sing to the Lord a new song, his praise from the ends of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, you islands, and all who live in them.

source: Gamthip le akhopiho Kedar chan geija kho ho pengu hen a-aw sansah uhen, songpi-a chenghon kipa la saohen lang, molsang hon chungvuma konin samu hen.
target: Let the wilderness and its towns raise their voices; let the settlements where Kedar lives rejoice. Let the people of Sela sing for joy; let them shout from the mountaintops.

source: Amahon Pakaiya loupina peuhenlang, twikol gamho-a chun a thangvahna phongjal uhen.
target: Let them give glory to the Lord and proclaim his praise in the islands.

source: Pakai chu mihat tah bangin kondoh intin, galsat mi banga thangthipna acho thouva, kholhang asapding; ama hat tah-a kituma, amelmate ajoding ahi.
target: The Lord will march out like a champion, like a warrior he will stir up his zeal; with a shout he will raise the battle cry and will triumph over his enemies.

source: Sottah thipbeh-in kaumtan; kathipbeh-in, kakitimkit hamhame, tunvang naosonat thohlel bangin peng ingting; kasuhmanga kavalhum ding ahi.
target: “For a long time I have kept silent, I have been quiet and held myself back. But now, like a woman in childbirth, I cry out, I gasp and pant.

source: Mol le lhangho agoh-in koi jingting, ahampaho gotsah gaming ting, vadungho twikol gammin semingting, chule twikulho kansah soh inge.
target: I will lay waste the mountains and hills and dry up all their vegetation; I will turn rivers into islands and dry up the pools.

source: Mitcho ho chu ahetkhah lounao kenglampia puijing ting; ahetkhah louvu lampia kaijinge; amasanguva muthim chu vahsah ingting, akonlaiho ka jansah ding ahi. Hicheng hi ahenguva kabolding, kadalhah louding ahiuve.
target: I will lead the blind by ways they have not known, along unfamiliar paths I will guide them; I will turn the darkness into light before them and make the rough places smooth. These are the things I will do; I will not forsake them.

source: Milim semthu tahsan ho, milimho jah-a, nangho kapathen'u nahiuve tiho chu hung kinungle uva, jahcha lheh ding ahiuve.
target: But those who trust in idols, who say to images, ‘You are our gods,’ will be turned back in utter shame.

source: Na-ngong ho, nanghon ngaijunlang, nangho mitcho hon namutheina dinguvin veuvin.
target: “Hear, you deaf; look, you blind, and see!

source: Mitcho koiham, kalhachapabou hilouham? atiloule kasottol kasolpa banga nangonga koiham? michamkim pa banga mitcho koi hijam? Pakai sohpa banga mitcho koiham?
target: Who is blind but my servant, and deaf like the messenger I send? Who is blind like the one in covenant with me, blind like the servant of the Lord ?

source: Thiltampi namun ahinla najuipoi; nakhangho chu avangnan ahinla ajapon ahi.
target: You have seen many things, but you pay no attention; your ears are open, but you do not listen.”

source: Achonphatna jal-in Pakai alunglhai tangeije; aman danthupeh chu aloupisah-a ja uma asemding ahi.
target: It pleased the Lord for the sake of his righteousness to make his law great and glorious.

source: Ahinla amahohi agumanga leh asuthanghoi ahiuvin; amaho jouse kohoma thangkol ho ahiuvin, songkul inho-a kisela ahiuve. Amaho akithatgam ding ahiuvin, ahuhdoh dingu khatcha aumpon; suhchatvai ding ahiuvin, lepeh kitnun tia khatcha aumpoi.
target: But this is a people plundered and looted, all of them trapped in pits or hidden away in prisons. They have become plunder, with no one to rescue them; they have been made loot, with no one to say, “Send them back.”

source: Hichea nakhang sungdinga nalah uva koi nahiuvem? Ahunglhung ding phat ho dinga kon nangai uva, najahdiu ham?
target: Which of you will listen to this or pay close attention in time to come?

source: Galthil kichom banga chomdinga Jacob pe-a, guchaho henga Israelte pedoh-a koiham? chonset iboluva idoupao Pakai chun apehdoh hilouham? ajehchu amaho alampiho-a achenom pouvin, adanthu jong ajuipouve.
target: Who handed Jacob over to become loot, and Israel to the plunderers? Was it not the Lord , against whom we have sinned? For they would not follow his ways; they did not obey his law.

source: Hijeh-a chu achunguva alunghana meikongle galkisat hattah chu abuhlhah khum ahi. Hichun akimvel meija ahalin, ahin amanla ahethei dehpon; hichun aka-in, ahivanga alungsungah aching dehpon ahi.
target: So he poured out on them his burning anger, the violence of war. It enveloped them in flames, yet they did not understand; it consumed them, but they did not take it to heart.

source: Ahinla tun, Vo Jacob, nasempao Pakaiyin, vo Israel natungdoh paovin kicha hih-un atin ahi. Ajehchu keiman kalhatdoh nahin, naminin kakouvin, keija nahitai.
target: But now, this is what the Lord says— he who created you, Jacob, he who formed you, Israel: “Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have summoned you by name; you are mine.

source: Twipi napalteng jongle umping ting; vadunghon jong nachup louding; meilah najot teng jongle, nakah louding ahi. Meikou deujejun jong naleogop louding ahi.
target: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and when you pass through the rivers, they will not sweep over you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned; the flames will not set you ablaze.

source: Ajehchu keima Pakai na Pathen, Israel mithengpa nahuhhingpa chu kahi nangma lhatnadin Egypt kapen, nangma khelin Ethiopia le Seba kapei.
target: For I am the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I give Egypt for your ransom, Cush and Seba in your stead.

source: Kamitmu-a lutah nahin, ja-umtah nahina jeh-in kangailun ahi. Hijeh chun nakhelin miho pengting nahinna dinga mitin kapeh ding ahi.
target: Since you are precious and honored in my sight, and because I love you, I will give people in exchange for you, nations in exchange for your life.

source: Kicha hih-in, ajehchu keiman kaumpi nai, nachilhah solama konin hinpui jingting, lhumlama konin dongkhom inge.
target: Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bring your children from the east and gather you from the west.

source: Keiman sahlam jah-a, hin pedoh-in, lhanglam jah-a, henden hih-in; gamlatah a konin kachapate, leiset kolmonga konin kachanute hinpuijin tinge.
target: I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’ and to the south, ‘Do not hold them back.’ Bring my sons from afar and my daughters from the ends of the earth—

source: Kamina kikouchan chu kaloupina dinga kasema kagon ahin; henge, keiman ama kasem ahi.
target: everyone who is called by my name, whom I created for my glory, whom I formed and made.”

source: Mit neija khomulou leh, nakhang neija khojalou ho chu hinpui doh-un.
target: Lead out those who have eyes but are blind, who have ears but are deaf.

source: Namtin vaipi jouse kikhom khomuhen, chule mipite kikhom khomuhen, alah uva koiham hiche phongdoh dingle thil um masa cheng eivetsah thei uva koiham? Athem chana dingun ahettohsah ho hinpuijuhen; ahiloule ngaijuhen chule adih ahi, tiuhen.
target: All the nations gather together and the peoples assemble. Which of their gods foretold this and proclaimed to us the former things? Let them bring in their witnesses to prove they were right, so that others may hear and say, “It is true.”

source: Nangho keima hettohsah nahiuve tin Pakaiyin aseije: chule kalhendohsa kalhacha nahi; hitia chu keima neihet uva neitahsan uva, keimahi Ama kahi neihet nadinguva: keima masanga Pathen dang akisempon, keima nunga jong khatcha kisem louding ahi.
target: “You are my witnesses,” declares the Lord , “and my servant whom I have chosen, so that you may know and believe me and understand that I am he. Before me no god was formed, nor will there be one after me.

source: Kei, keima bou Pakai chu kahi, keima tailou huhhingpu dang aumpoi.
target: I, even I, am the Lord , and apart from me there is no savior.

source: Nalah uva gamdang pathen aum masangin keiman kaphong doh-in, kahuhhingun, chule kamusah-un ahi. Hijeh chun nangho keima hettohsah nahiuve, tin keima Pakaiyin aseije, keima Pathen kahi.
target: I have revealed and saved and proclaimed— I, and not some foreign god among you. You are my witnesses,” declares the Lord , “that I am God.

source: Ahi, nikhoho umasanga keima Ama chu kahi; kakhutna kona ladohjou khatcha ana umpoi; keiman katohding chu koiham ajada dinga?
target: Yes, and from ancient days I am he. No one can deliver out of my hand. When I act, who can reverse it?”

source: Pakai na lhatdampu Israel mithengpan hitin aseije; nangho khohsahna jal-in Babylon'a sepai kasolin, amilaltehou jousele Chaldea ho kong-innei sunga peng jenjunin kahin puisuh-e.
target: This is what the Lord says— your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “For your sake I will send to Babylon and bring down as fugitives all the Babylonians, in the ships in which they took pride.

source: Keima Pakai na Mithengpao, Israelte sempa nalengpao chu kahi.
target: I am the Lord , your Holy One, Israel’s Creator, your King.”

source: Pakai twikhanglen'a kenglampi semaleh twihat sunga lampi sempan hitin aseije;
target: This is what the Lord says— he who made a way through the sea, a path through the mighty waters,

source: Sakol kangtalai le sakol, sepaiho le athahat ho puidohpa Pakai chun hitin aseije. Amaho lumkhom uva thoutaloudiu ahin; amaho amit adelun, thaomei pat bangin akimutmit taove.
target: who drew out the chariots and horses, the army and reinforcements together, and they lay there, never to rise again, extinguished, snuffed out like a wick:

source: Thil masaho geldaovin lang, tonlai thil jong ngaito daovin.
target: “Forget the former things; do not dwell on the past.

source: Veuvin, keiman thilthah khat kabolding ahin, tu-a hungpotdoh ding ahitan; nahetlou diuham? Gamthiplai geija lampi khat kasema, nelgama jong vadungho kalonsah ding ahi.
target: See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it? I am making a way in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland.

source: Kamite, kalhentumho dondinga gamthipma twiho chule nelgama vadung ho kapeh jeh-a, gamlah-a gamsaho, dragon ho chule sumbupi hon eijabol dingu ahi.
target: The wild animals honor me, the jackals and the owls, because I provide water in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland, to give drink to my people, my chosen,

source: Hiche mitehi keiding tumtah-a kasem ahin; amahon keima vahchoina atahlang lediu ahi.
target: the people I formed for myself that they may proclaim my praise.

source: Ahinla Vo Jacob, nangmanla neikou pon, Vo Israel, nanghon neitheichim un ahi.
target: “Yet you have not called on me, Jacob, you have not wearied yourselves for me, Israel.

source: Nagovam thilpeh-a din ganchaneo neihin choipehjipon, ganlhaina injong neijabol jitapon ahi. Thilpeh-in nangma kana kijenkhahsah pon, gimnamtui jinjong kasugim khapoi.
target: You have not brought me sheep for burnt offerings, nor honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with grain offerings nor wearied you with demands for incense.

source: Nangin sumin kolchulhum nachokhapon, naganlhai na sathaovin jong neivahva khapon ahi. Ahinla nachonset nao neipohsah-un, nakhangitlou naova neisugimun ahi.
target: You have not bought any fragrant calamus for me, or lavished on me the fat of your sacrifices. But you have burdened me with your sins and wearied me with your offenses.

source: Kei, keimong monghin, keile kei kikhohsah najala nasuhkhelnao thehmanga chu kahin, nachonset nahou kageldoh kit tahlou ding ahi.
target: “I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions, for my own sake, and remembers your sins no more.

source: Neigeldoh jingun; hungun ngaito khomu hite; them nachan theina dingun kisei phongun.
target: Review the past for me, let us argue the matter together; state the case for your innocence.

source: Napa masapen anachonsen, chuin nahil hou keima douna-in anasukhelun ahi.
target: Your first father sinned; those I sent to teach you rebelled against me.

source: Hijeh chun munthenga pipuiho chu kanasuboh-in, Jacob chu sapsetna-a, Israel chu i-sah louvin kana umsah tai.
target: So I disgraced the dignitaries of your temple; I consigned Jacob to destruction and Israel to scorn.

source: Tuvangin Vo kalhacha Jacob, Vo kalhenchom Israel, ngaijun;
target: “But now listen, Jacob, my servant, Israel, whom I have chosen.

source: Nasema leh naobu-a kona nahin gonga napanpi ding Pakai chun hitin aseije; Vo kalhacha Jacob chule vo kalhenchom Jerusalem, kicha hih-in.
target: This is what the Lord says— he who made you, who formed you in the womb, and who will help you: Do not be afraid, Jacob, my servant, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

source: Ajehchu adangchah chunga twi kasuna, tolgolaija twi kasosah ding ahi. Nachilhah ho chunga kalhagao chule nasonho chunga kaphat theina kabuh lhah ding ahi.
target: For I will pour water on the thirsty land, and streams on the dry ground; I will pour out my Spirit on your offspring, and my blessing on your descendants.

source: Amaho hampalah banga hungdon doh diu, twipanga huisum thingho bangdiu ahi.
target: They will spring up like grass in a meadow, like poplar trees by flowing streams.

source: Khatnin, keima Pakaiya kahin; achomkhatma Jacob mina kikou ding; chule adang khatnin akhut tah-a Pakaiya ding tia ajih ding, chule Israel mina kiminvo ding ahi.
target: Some will say, ‘I belong to the Lord ’; others will call themselves by the name of Jacob; still others will write on their hand, ‘The Lord ’s,’ and will take the name Israel.

source: Pakai Israelte leng, alhatdampu janel Pakai chun hitin ati; Keima amasale anukhah kahin, kei tailou Pathen dang aumpoi, ati.
target: “This is what the Lord says— Israel’s King and Redeemer, the Lord Almighty: I am the first and I am the last; apart from me there is no God.

source: Malai miho katundoh laija chu keima bolbanga koiham aboldingle aphongdoh dinga? chule abancha umsah ding? chule thil ahunglhung dingle ahunglhung saho chu amaho musah-u hen.
target: Who then is like me? Let him proclaim it. Let him declare and lay out before me what has happened since I established my ancient people, and what is yet to come— yes, let them foretell what will come.

source: Tija hih-un, kijong kicha hih-un; chuche laija patna kahilkhahlou, kaseipeh khahlou nahiuvem? Nangho kathu hettoh sahmong nahiuvin ahi. Keitailou Pathen dang umem? ahi, Pathen dang aumpoi, khatcha jong kahepoi.
target: Do not tremble, do not be afraid. Did I not proclaim this and foretell it long ago? You are my witnesses. Is there any God besides me? No, there is no other Rock; I know not one.”

source: Alim semthuho abonun ahomkeo ahiuvin; anopsahnao thilho jong pannabei ahin; amaho chu amaho hettohsah ahiuve, ajachat theina diuvin amahon amupouvin, hejong ahepouve.
target: All who make idols are nothing, and the things they treasure are worthless. Those who would speak up for them are blind; they are ignorant, to their own shame.

source: Aphat chomna bei pathen le alim semthu milim sema koiham?
target: Who shapes a god and casts an idol, which can profit nothing?

source: Vetan, aloiho jouse jahchao vintin, chule anatong amaho jong mihem bou ahiuve.
target: People who do that will be put to shame; such craftsmen are only human beings. Let them all come together and take their stand; they will be brought down to terror and shame.

source: Thih khengpan achoiche toh meihola agouvin, sehcha'n avotoh-in, aban thahatnin atongjin ahi; henge, ama agilkelin, ahatna angoilhajin, twila adonpon, alhadahjitai.
target: The blacksmith takes a tool and works with it in the coals; he shapes an idol with hammers, he forges it with the might of his arm. He gets hungry and loses his strength; he drinks no water and grows faint.

source: Thingthem bolpan agolkaina ahinladoh-in; gol akaijin, amelchih-in; tolnam na-in atoltoh-in, vettohna-in amelchih-in, mihem gong bangin mihem hoina dungjuijin a-insunga aumden nadingin amelchih-in ahi.
target: The carpenter measures with a line and makes an outline with a marker; he roughs it out with chisels and marks it with compasses. He shapes it in human form, human form in all its glory, that it may dwell in a shrine.

source: Aman cedar thingho aphuh lhun, khengthing le gangpi thing amadingin gammang lah-a akhansah-in ahi. Aman meila thing aphutnin gotuijin achapnoujin ahi.
target: He cut down cedars, or perhaps took a cypress or oak. He let it grow among the trees of the forest, or planted a pine, and the rain made it grow.

source: Chujoule hichu mihem dinga tiding hintin; ajehchu aman thing lah-a akehkhat chu akitikouvin a-oilumjin; changlhah akangjin; a pathen lim sem angsunga chun abohkhupmin ahoujin ahi.
target: It is used as fuel for burning; some of it he takes and warms himself, he kindles a fire and bakes bread. But he also fashions a god and worships it; he makes an idol and bows down to it.

source: Aman phabep chu meija atih-in; sa go nan aneijin oiva nan anen; meisa chu a-oilumin, katejo, keiman lum kasatai, meimu-a kahitai atijin ahi.
target: Half of the wood he burns in the fire; over it he prepares his meal, he roasts his meat and eats his fill. He also warms himself and says, “Ah! I am warm; I see the fire.”

source: Chule thing moh chu pathen khatnin semthu milim ngeijin asemjin, a-anga aboh khupmin, ahouvin, ahenga ataovin, ka-pathen nahi jeh-in neihuh doh-in atijin ahi.
target: From the rest he makes a god, his idol; he bows down to it and worships. He prays to it and says, “Save me! You are my god!”

source: Amahon anahepouvin, hetjong ahethem pouve; ajehchu amulouna diuva amitnu achotsah-a, ahetkhen themlouna diuva alungthimu akhachah ahi.
target: They know nothing, they understand nothing; their eyes are plastered over so they cannot see, and their minds closed so they cannot understand.

source: Abang meija katih-in, henge, chua mei mama chun changlhah kakangin, sa kakigon kanei; achutile amohchu thet umtah khatna kasema, thingbul khat anga kabokhupma kahou diham? tin koiman alungin chihnale hetkhenna injong angaitopoi.
target: No one stops to think, no one has the knowledge or understanding to say, “Half of it I used for fuel; I even baked bread over its coals, I roasted meat and I ate. Shall I make a detestable thing from what is left? Shall I bow down to a block of wood?”

source: Ama vutna kivah ahin; lheplhahna lungthimin aheikon ahin, ahinna aman ahuhdoh theilouna dia kakhutjetna jou uma hilouham, atin ahi.
target: Such a person feeds on ashes; a deluded heart misleads him; he cannot save himself, or say, “Is not this thing in my right hand a lie?”

source: Nangma kalhacha nahi jeh-in vo Jacob, le Israel hichehohi geldoh-in; kasemsa nahin, kalhacha nahi, Vo Israel, nangma kasuhmil theihoi nahipoi.
target: “Remember these things, Jacob, for you, Israel, are my servant. I have made you, you are my servant; Israel, I will not forget you.

source: Keiman meilhang satah tobang nasuhkhelnaho le nachonset naho meibol tobang chu katheh mang tai; kahenga hung kile kitnin, keiman kalhatdoh nahitai.
target: I have swept away your offenses like a cloud, your sins like the morning mist. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.”

source: Vo vanho hichu Pakai ahijeh-in la saovin; lei noilama umhon aovun; nangho mol ho, Vo gammang chule chua thingphung tinnin la san aodoh uvin, ajehchu Pakaiyin Jacob alhatdoh-in, Israel lentahle loupitah-in akichoi antai.
target: Sing for joy, you heavens, for the Lord has done this; shout aloud, you earth beneath. Burst into song, you mountains, you forests and all your trees, for the Lord has redeemed Jacob, he displays his glory in Israel.

source: Pakai nalhatdohpao naobu-a kona nagongtoh paovin hitin aseije, keihi thiljouse sema, Pakai achangseh-a vanho jahdoh-a, leiset phajaopa chu kahi, ati.
target: “This is what the Lord says— your Redeemer, who formed you in the womb: I am the Lord , the Maker of all things, who stretches out the heavens, who spreads out the earth by myself,

source: Mi jouho melchihna imalou so-a, doi-aithemho ngolsah-a; michingho nungnokit na, ahetnao ngolna-a sosah-a;
target: who foils the signs of false prophets and makes fools of diviners, who overthrows the learning of the wise and turns it into nonsense,

source: Asohpa thusei sudetpa, asottol ho thumop molsopeh-a; Jerusalem jah-a nangho chenna ding ahin; chule Judah khopiho jah-a, nangho kasahdoh kitna, alhusa munho kaphoh ding kitding ahi atipeh-e.
target: who carries out the words of his servants and fulfills the predictions of his messengers, who says of Jerusalem, ‘It shall be inhabited,’ of the towns of Judah, ‘They shall be rebuilt,’ and of their ruins, ‘I will restore them,’

source: Twithuh jah-a kangin, navadung ho jong kakansah kitding ahi tipa,
target: who says to the watery deep, ‘Be dry, and I will dry up your streams,’

source: Cyrus jah-a, ama kakelngoi chingpa ahin, kadeijouse asuhbulhit ding ahi, Jerusalem heng jenga jong nangma, kisapha ding nahi tin, chule houin jah-a, na-inbul kisem phading ahi tipa chu kahi, ati.
target: who says of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd and will accomplish all that I please; he will say of Jerusalem, “Let it be rebuilt,” and of the temple, “Let its foundations be laid.” ’

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, athao nu Cyrus jah-a namtin vaipi a-anga sunem dingle, lengho konggah lhamkang ding, amasanga pehni kisuto kotpiho hongdingle, khahkit loudingin, akhut jetna katuh chahpa henga chun hitin aseijin;
target: “This is what the Lord says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I take hold of to subdue nations before him and to strip kings of their armor, to open doors before him so that gates will not be shut:

source: keima namasanga chengting, akonlaiho kajansah ding; sum-eng kotpiho kavohchima, thih kotgol ho kasatkhen ding ahi.
target: I will go before you and will level the mountains; I will break down gates of bronze and cut through bars of iron.

source: Chule keima Pakai, namina nakoupa, Israel Pathen chu kahin, keima neihet theina dinga goukhol le munthipma kiselgu sumjong kapeh ding nahi.
target: I will give you hidden treasures, riches stored in secret places, so that you may know that I am the Lord , the God of Israel, who summons you by name.

source: Kalhacha Jacob le kalhen chom Israel jala namin monga kakou nahi, nangin neihetlou vanga keiman kaminvo nahi.
target: For the sake of Jacob my servant, of Israel my chosen, I summon you by name and bestow on you a title of honor, though you do not acknowledge me.

source: Keihi Pakai chu kahin, adang aumpoi, kei tailou Pathen dang himhim aumpoi; neihetlou vanga nakong kagahpeh nahin;
target: I am the Lord , and there is no other; apart from me there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not acknowledged me,

source: Kei tailou adang aumpoi. Keima Pakai chu kahi, adang him him aumpoi, ti nisolama pat nilhum lam geija miten ahet theina diu ahi.
target: so that from the rising of the sun to the place of its setting people may know there is none besides me. I am the Lord , and there is no other.

source: Keiman khovah kagong doh-in, muthim jong kaseme, chamna kasemin, setna jong kaseme, kei Pakaiyin hitiho jousehi kabol ahi.
target: I form the light and create darkness, I bring prosperity and create disaster; I, the Lord , do all these things.

source: Nangho vanho, chunga konin hung julhaovin, chule vandum hon chonphatna hinsunglhaovin, leiset kihonghenlang huhhingna sodoh-u hen, chonphat nato hung kedoh thaohen; keima Pakaiyin hichu kasem ahi.
target: “You heavens above, rain down my righteousness; let the clouds shower it down. Let the earth open wide, let salvation spring up, let righteousness flourish with it; I, the Lord , have created it.

source: Asempa kinelpi chu ohe! ada ahi: beldengpa bel hal chu leiset bel hal to kinel hen. Bon nganin asempa henga, ipi sema nahim? ahiloule nathilbol chun aman khut kaneipoi tintem?
target: “Woe to those who quarrel with their Maker, those who are nothing but potsherds among the potsherds on the ground. Does the clay say to the potter, ‘What are you making?’ Does your work say, ‘The potter has no hands’?

source: Apa jah-a ipi hinga nahim? ahiloule anujah-a ipi nana hindoh hitam? tiachu ada ahi.
target: Woe to the one who says to a father, ‘What have you begotten?’ or to a mother, ‘What have you brought to birth?’

source: Pakai Israel mithengpa le asempaovin hitin ati, kachate chungchanga thil hunglhung dingchu neidongun, chule, kakhut natoh chungchang thu neipeuvin.
target: “This is what the Lord says— the Holy One of Israel, and its Maker: Concerning things to come, do you question me about my children, or give me orders about the work of my hands?

source: Leiset hi kasem ahin, achunga mihem jonghi kasem ahi, Kakhut ho-a vanho kajahdoh-a, janelho jong kathupeh ahi.
target: It is I who made the earth and created mankind on it. My own hands stretched out the heavens; I marshaled their starry hosts.

source: Ama chu chonphat na-in kakhou khah-in, alampi jouse hilinge. Aman kakhopi asahdoh-a, kasohchang ho alhadoh ding, kipamanle tohphat man thil peh-a ding ahipoi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will raise up Cyrus in my righteousness: I will make all his ways straight. He will rebuild my city and set my exiles free, but not for a price or reward, says the Lord Almighty.”

source: Pakaiyin hitin, ati, Egypt tohgimna le Ethiopia le Sabea mite sumkolvei ho, misang tahtah ho chu naheng lama hunguva nanga hidiu ahitai. Nanung ahin juijuva, thihkhaova kihenpuma hung galkaijuva, na-anga bohkhup uva, chibai nabohdiu, nahenga lungsetna angeh uva tahbeh-in Pathen nangma-a aum monge, adang aumpoi, Pathen dang himhim aumpoi atidiu ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says: “The products of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush, and those tall Sabeans— they will come over to you and will be yours; they will trudge behind you, coming over to you in chains. They will bow down before you and plead with you, saying, ‘Surely God is with you, and there is no other; there is no other god.’ ”

source: Vo Israel Pathen, huhhingpa kisel thipbeh Pathen tahbeh mongchu nahi.
target: Truly you are a God who has been hiding himself, the God and Savior of Israel.

source: Amaho jahchaova abonchauva kisudongdiu; milimsem amaho chu lungnoh phah puma lutkhom diu ahi.
target: All the makers of idols will be put to shame and disgraced; they will go off into disgrace together.

source: Israel vangchu Pakaiya tonsot huhhingna-a huhhing-a umdiu ahin; nangho tonsot geija jahchalouva akhonna beija kisudong louding nahiuve.
target: But Israel will be saved by the Lord with an everlasting salvation; you will never be put to shame or disgraced, to ages everlasting.

source: Ajehchu vanho sempa, Pakai, leiset sutoh-a, sema tungdohpa, aman agohkeo asem hilouva chenna dinga anagong dohpa Pathen amatah chun hitin ati; Keima Pakai chu kahin koima cha dang aumpoi,
target: For this is what the Lord says— he who created the heavens, he is God; he who fashioned and made the earth, he founded it; he did not create it to be empty, but formed it to be inhabited— he says: “I am the Lord , and there is no other.

source: keiman leiset munthim mun'a guhthimin thu kaseipoi, keiman Jacob chilhahte henga agohkeovin neiholun katipoi, Pakai keiman chonphatna kaseijin, thudih bou chu kaphondoh ahi.
target: I have not spoken in secret, from somewhere in a land of darkness; I have not said to Jacob’s descendants, ‘Seek me in vain.’ I, the Lord , speak the truth; I declare what is right.

source: Nangho namtin lah-a asohcha chengse kikhom munlang, hungun, hinnai cheh-un. Thing semthu milim tungdoh-a, ahuhhing theilou diu Pathen henga taoho, amahonla hetna aneipouvin ahi.
target: “Gather together and come; assemble, you fugitives from the nations. Ignorant are those who carry about idols of wood, who pray to gods that cannot save.

source: Seipeh unlang hinpui naijun; thu kimopna chu sang uhen, masang laija patna kon aphondoh khah em? chulai apat kon nanahil um? Pakai keimahi kahilou ham? Pathen dihle huhhing-a Pathen dang aumpoi, kei tailou adang aumpoi.
target: Declare what is to be, present it— let them take counsel together. Who foretold this long ago, who declared it from the distant past? Was it not I, the Lord ? And there is no God apart from me, a righteous God and a Savior; there is none but me.

source: Leiset kolkimvela mi jousen keilam hinveuhen lang huhhingin umuhen; keima Pathen kahin, koimacha dang aumpoi.
target: “Turn to me and be saved, all you ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.

source: Keile kei kaki hahsel in, kakama kona chonphatna thu potnachu hungkilekit louding ahi. Chutia chu khup jouse ka-anga dilsua, lei jouse kihahsel ding ahi,
target: By myself I have sworn, my mouth has uttered in all integrity a word that will not be revoked: Before me every knee will bow; by me every tongue will swear.
