source: dihtah-in min Pakaiya chun chonphat nale thahatna kaneije tin seijinte; ama henga mi hunga; ama douva lunghansah jouse chu jahcha ding ahiuve.
target: They will say of me, ‘In the Lord alone are deliverance and strength.’ ” All who have raged against him will come to him and be put to shame.

source: Israel chilhah jouse chu Pakaiya them changa loupidiu ahi.
target: But all the descendants of Israel will find deliverance in the Lord and will make their boast in him.

source: Bel chu akunin, Nebo chu abungin, amilim hou chu sahole aganchahou chunga aumuve; nathilpoh-u pohgih tah ahin, gancha thachol dinga pohgihsa ahi.
target: Bel bows down, Nebo stoops low; their idols are borne by beasts of burden. The images that are carried about are burdensome, a burden for the weary.

source: Amaho abungun, akuncheh uve; amaho pohgih-a chun ahoidoh pouvin, gal hinga kaimangin aumjo taove.
target: They stoop and bow down together; unable to rescue the burden, they themselves go off into captivity.

source: Vo Jacob insungle Israel insung amohchengse, ka-oisunga patna kavopma, naobu-a kona kapensah hon kathu ngaijun.
target: “Listen to me, you descendants of Jacob, all the remnant of the people of Israel, you whom I have upheld since your birth, and have carried since you were born.

source: Nateh geija jong kei Ama chu kahin; nasamkan geija jong kapoh ding nahi; kasemsa nahin, chule keiman vop ingting kapoh-a; kahuh hingding nahi.
target: Even to your old age and gray hairs I am he, I am he who will sustain you. I have made you and I will carry you; I will sustain you and I will rescue you.

source: Koito kilo neisah uva, neikibah sah uva, neitekah uva, chule kakibah thei dinguham?
target: “With whom will you compare me or count me equal? To whom will you liken me that we may be compared?

source: Amaho dipma kona sana anopnopma manga, dangka akitena-a kitedoh-a, sana khengkhat thalah-a; pathen akisemsah-a, a-anga bohkhup jia chibai bohjia ahiuve.
target: Some pour out gold from their bags and weigh out silver on the scales; they hire a goldsmith to make it into a god, and they bow down and worship it.

source: Amahon hichu aleng kou uva adomdoh uvin, apojiuvin, ama munna atungjiove, ama akitung denin; aumna-a konin akichon jitapon ahi. Ahi, min ama kou intin, amanla donbut theilou ding, agimna-a kona jong ahuhdoh theilou ding ahi.
target: They lift it to their shoulders and carry it; they set it up in its place, and there it stands. From that spot it cannot move. Even though someone cries out to it, it cannot answer; it cannot save them from their troubles.

source: Vo suhkhel neiho, hichehi geldoh-un; miho kimusah unlang lungin geldoh kitnun.
target: “Remember this, keep it in mind, take it to heart, you rebels.

source: Khanglui laija thilmasaho geldoh-un, keima Pakai kahijeh in adang khatcha aumpoi, keima Pathen kahin, keitobang himhim aumpouve.
target: Remember the former things, those of long ago; I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is none like me.

source: Abula pat akichainagei, chule masang laijapat akibol loulaiho jong kaseiphong ahitai, kathumop ding jingintin, kanopchan kabolding ahitai, ati.
target: I make known the end from the beginning, from ancient times, what is still to come. I say, ‘My purpose will stand, and I will do all that I please.’

source: Solama kona vacha lol hattah khat gamlatah-a kona kathumopsa tongdoh dingpa chu kouvin; henge, kaseisa ahin, kagui lhunsah ding ahin, kangaitosa ahin boljong kaboldoh ding ahi, ati.
target: From the east I summon a bird of prey; from a far-off land, a man to fulfill my purpose. What I have said, that I will bring about; what I have planned, that I will do.

source: Chonphatna-a kona gamla-a lungtah-a nanghon kathu ngaijun;
target: Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, you who are now far from my righteousness.

source: kachon phatna hi kahinpo naitan, hichu gamla talou ding, ka huhhingna jong umjing louding ahi. Kaloupina Israelte dinga huhhingna chu Zion'a kakoiding ahi.
target: I am bringing my righteousness near, it is not far away; and my salvation will not be delayed. I will grant salvation to Zion, my splendor to Israel.

source: Vo nungah theng chanu, hungkum lhanlang leivuilah-a touvin, laltouna aumpon, Vo Chaldea mite chanu; ajehchu nangma nouchetle nomsa kitikit talou ding nahi.
target: “Go down, sit in the dust, Virgin Daughter Babylon; sit on the ground without a throne, queen city of the Babylonians. No more will you be called tender or delicate.

source: Sumhei songho lanlang chang goijin napon lukhuh hoh-inlang, kengkeuvin umin, na pheipi hohdoh inlang, vadungho palgalkai jin.
target: Take millstones and grind flour; take off your veil. Lift up your skirts, bare your legs, and wade through the streams.

source: Nasagohkeo chu khulouvin umintin; najamo kisel chu kimuding ahi. Phu langting, mihembanga nangma kakimupi louding ahi.
target: Your nakedness will be exposed and your shame uncovered. I will take vengeance; I will spare no one.”

source: Eilhatdohpao chu Israel mithengpa, janelho Pakai chu amin ahi.
target: Our Redeemer—the Lord Almighty is his name— is the Holy One of Israel.

source: Chaldea te chanu thipbeh in touvin lang, muthima lutnin, ajehchu lenggam ho pakainu kitijom louding nahitai.
target: “Sit in silence, go into darkness, queen city of the Babylonians; no more will you be called queen of kingdoms.

source: Kamite chunga kalungsan, kagouloho kasuboh-in, amaho chu nakhutna kanapeluttai; nanginla hepina nanamusahpon; golluiho chunga napohgih tah namkoljon chu na-ngapkhum tai.
target: I was angry with my people and desecrated my inheritance; I gave them into your hand, and you showed them no mercy. Even on the aged you laid a very heavy yoke.

source: Nangin imatihchanna pakainu kahijing ding ahi nanatin; chutichun nangin hiche hohi nalunga nanakoi pon khonunga akichaina diujong nanageldoh him himpoi.
target: You said, ‘I am forever— the eternal queen!’ But you did not consider these things or reflect on what might happen.

source: Hijeh chun tun anop nopma uma, chavaitah-a chengnu, alungsunga keitailou adang aumpon, keibou kahin; meithai banga toulou ding kahi, chate thi thu jong hehih helinge, tia seinun ngaijin;
target: “Now then, listen, you lover of pleasure, lounging in your security and saying to yourself, ‘I am, and there is none besides me. I will never be a widow or suffer the loss of children.’

source: ahinla hiche thilni, chate thinale meithai hinahi nikhatsunga hetmanlouva nachunga hungchu ding ahi. Hicheho chu namitpheldoi ho tamjeh le, kilhim ngolna bulhin lheh jeh-a nachunga lhingsetna hungchu ding ahi.
target: Both of these will overtake you in a moment, on a single day: loss of children and widowhood. They will come upon you in full measure, in spite of your many sorceries and all your potent spells.

source: Ajehchu nakhansetna natahsanin, koiman eimupoi natin ahi. Nachihnale nahetna in naheimangtan; nalungsunga keima kahi keitailou adang himhim aumpoi natin ahi.
target: You have trusted in your wickedness and have said, ‘No one sees me.’ Your wisdom and knowledge mislead you when you say to yourself, ‘I am, and there is none besides me.’

source: Hijeh-achu thilse nachunga hungchua hi hoija hung kipan ahi nahetlouding; setna nachunga hungchu ding; hichu nasuhmang joulou ding; chule nahet loubeh ding manthah na nachunga hung chuphung ding ahi.
target: Disaster will come upon you, and you will not know how to conjure it away. A calamity will fall upon you that you cannot ward off with a ransom; a catastrophe you cannot foresee will suddenly come upon you.

source: Tun naki lhim ngolnale namitpheldoi themna tamtah, naneolaija patna nahinjilna chun naphat theipi jouva, najo thei khattou dingle dinpi tan,
target: “Keep on, then, with your magic spells and with your many sorceries, which you have labored at since childhood. Perhaps you will succeed, perhaps you will cause terror.

source: nathumop tamjeh-in nacholtan ahi. Tun ahsi lekhathem ho, ahsi velhi jingho, lhatina khonunga hunglhung ding melchih themho dingdoh uhenlang, nachunga hung chudingho-a konin kihuhdoh sah-in.
target: All the counsel you have received has only worn you out! Let your astrologers come forward, those stargazers who make predictions month by month, let them save you from what is coming upon you.

source: Veuvin, amaho changpol bangbep hiuvintin; meijin akahvamdiu; meikong thahat na-a kona amahole amaho kihuhdoh loudiu; kisahlum nading mei-am tobang hilouva, amasanga tounangam mei tobang jong hilouding ahi.
target: Surely they are like stubble; the fire will burn them up. They cannot even save themselves from the power of the flame. These are not coals for warmth; this is not a fire to sit by.

source: Nangdinga naneolaija patna nasumkol veipiho, chule nanatoh gimpi amaho jengtah jong chutichu hintin, amaho khatcheh-a a-inlam cheh-a vahmanga, koimachan nahuhhing louding ahi.
target: That is all they are to you— these you have dealt with and labored with since childhood. All of them go on in their error; there is not one that can save you.

source: Vo Jacob insung Israel mina kivo-a Judah twiho-a kona sohdoh-a, Pakai mina kihahsel, thutah le chonphatna-a hilouva Israel Pathen min panho: hichehi ngaijun.
target: “Listen to this, you descendants of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel and come from the line of Judah, you who take oaths in the name of the Lord and invoke the God of Israel— but not in truth or righteousness—

source: Ajehchu amahole amaho khopitheng mi akihisah-un, Israel Pathen chunga akingaijui; ama minchu janel ho Pakai ahi.
target: you who call yourselves citizens of the holy city and claim to rely on the God of Israel— the Lord Almighty is his name:

source: Masanglai thilto chu abula patnin kaseiphongin; kakama kona sohdoh ho chu amaho kamusahtai; hiche ho chu kabol phunga guilhung jeng ahi.
target: I foretold the former things long ago, my mouth announced them and I made them known; then suddenly I acted, and they came to pass.

source: Ajehchu nangma milouchal nahi ti kahen, na-ngong chu thih khao ahin, nachalpang chu sum-eng ahin;
target: For I knew how stubborn you were; your neck muscles were iron, your forehead was bronze.

source: Hichu atila patna nahenga kaseija, ahung guilhun masanga kamusah nahitai. Achutiloule nangin kahou milim, alim semthu, kamilim kilhajolin abol ahi tikhan nate,
target: Therefore I told you these things long ago; before they happened I announced them to you so that you could not say, ‘My images brought them about; my wooden image and metal god ordained them.’

source: nanghon najataovin, hicheho jousehi namutaovin; chule naseiphong loudiu ham? tua patnin thilthah ho, thil kisel ho, nanghon nanahetlouho chu kamusah ahitai.
target: You have heard these things; look at them all. Will you not admit them? “From now on I will tell you of new things, of hidden things unknown to you.

source: Amaho tun akisemtai, abula patna ahipoi; najah masang nikho jongchu ahipoi; achutiloule nangin, veuvin, ken amaho kahei, tikhan nate.
target: They are created now, and not long ago; you have not heard of them before today. So you cannot say, ‘Yes, I knew of them.’

source: Ahi, nanaja khapon, nanahe khapoi; hichelaija patchun nanakhang ana kihongpon ahi; tahsanlel nahin, naobu-a patna suhkhelnei nakiti dingchu kanahen ahi.
target: You have neither heard nor understood; from of old your ears have not been open. Well do I know how treacherous you are; you were called a rebel from birth.

source: Ajehchu kamin jala kalungsatna-a kakitima, eikipachat nading jeh-a nangma kasuhtana dinga kona kitima kahi.
target: For my own name’s sake I delay my wrath; for the sake of my praise I hold it back from you, so as not to destroy you completely.

source: Vetan, keiman nangma kalhah theng nahitai, sum-eng bang hilouvin, suhgentheina meilhum sunga kalhah nahi.
target: See, I have refined you, though not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.

source: Keimajal leh keimatah jala kabolding ahi; Ajehchu kaminhi ibola suhboh a umding ham?
target: For my own sake, for my own sake, I do this. How can I let myself be defamed? I will not yield my glory to another.

source: Vo Jacob le kakou Israel, kathu ngai phaovin; keihi amachu kahin; amasale anukhah jong kahi.
target: “Listen to me, Jacob, Israel, whom I have called: I am he; I am the first and I am the last.

source: Kakhutnin leiset bul jong hi aphudoh ahin, kakhut jet hin vanho chu akaijala, amahochu kakoutengle dingdoh khom jengjiuva ahi.
target: My own hand laid the foundations of the earth, and my right hand spread out the heavens; when I summon them, they all stand up together.

source: Nangho nabon chaovin kikhomun lang ngaijun; hiche thil ho hi alah uva koipenin aphondoh khah em? Pakaiyin ama alungsetnin; aman Babylon chunga anopnop abolin, akhut chu Chaldea miteho chunga chuding ahi.
target: “Come together, all of you, and listen: Which of the idols has foretold these things? The Lord ’s chosen ally will carry out his purpose against Babylon; his arm will be against the Babylonians.

source: Kei, keimatah mongin kasei ahitai; amachu kakouvin; kahinpuijin, aman alampi akhantousah ding ahi.
target: I, even I, have spoken; yes, I have called him. I will bring him, and he will succeed in his mission.

source: Nanghon neihin naijun lang hichehi ngaijun; atila patnin keiman guhthimin thu kaseipon; phat aumtila patnin hia chun keima kaumin; chule tuhin Pakai Pathen le alhagaovin eisoltai.
target: “Come near me and listen to this: “From the first announcement I have not spoken in secret; at the time it happens, I am there.” And now the Sovereign Lord has sent me, endowed with his Spirit.

source: Pakai nalhatdohpao Israel mithengpan hitin aseije, keihi Pakai na Pathen, naphatnadiuva hila, nachenadiu lampia puihoipa chu kahi.
target: This is what the Lord says— your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “I am the Lord your God, who teaches you what is best for you, who directs you in the way you should go.

source: Vo nanghon kathu peh ho chu nangaiju hitavele! nachung uva chamna vadung banga longa, nachon phatnao twikhanglen kinong bang hitading!
target: If only you had paid attention to my commands, your peace would have been like a river, your well-being like the waves of the sea.

source: Nachilhah-u jong neldi jat phantin, nalaigilgao sonho jong nel bongsilsel bang ding, kamasanga kona aminu kithai mang louding, suhtanga jong umlouheldiu ahi.
target: Your descendants would have been like the sand, your children like its numberless grains; their name would never be blotted out nor destroyed from before me.”

source: Babylon'a konin potdoh-un, Chaldea mite-a konin jam mangun, hichehi lasah ginnin phongjal unlang, leiset kolkimvel geijin seiphongun, Pakaiyin asoh Jacob chu alhatdohtai tiuvin.
target: Leave Babylon, flee from the Babylonians! Announce this with shouts of joy and proclaim it. Send it out to the ends of the earth; say, “The Lord has redeemed his servant Jacob.”

source: Aman nelgam jotpaija apuilaijin adangchah pouvin; songpi-a konin amahodin twi alondohsah-in, songpijong akesah-in, twi chu ahung kikhodoh jengin ahi.
target: They did not thirst when he led them through the deserts; he made water flow for them from the rock; he split the rock and water gushed out.

source: Pakaiyin migiloute dingin chamna himhim aumpoi, ati.
target: “There is no peace,” says the Lord , “for the wicked.”

source: Vo twikol gamho, kathusei ngaijun; gamlatah-a konin miten ngaijuvin; Pakaiyin naobu-a kona einakouva; kanu oisunga kona kamin anasah sa ahitai.
target: Listen to me, you islands; hear this, you distant nations: Before I was born the Lord called me; from my mother’s womb he has spoken my name.

source: Aman chemjam hemtah bangin kakam anasemin; chule aman akhut lima einaselin, thalchang kinot dulin einasemin, alivathei sunga einaselin ahi.
target: He made my mouth like a sharpened sword, in the shadow of his hand he hid me; he made me into a polished arrow and concealed me in his quiver.

source: Kahenga, Vo Israel, nangma kalhacha kaki choi-atna dingpa chu nahi anatin ahi.
target: He said to me, “You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will display my splendor.”

source: Chuin keiman, mohseh-a tonggima kahitan, kathahatna imacha hiloule mohseh-a kaman ahitai. Hitajongle kathutana chu Pakai toh um ahin, kathilbol chu Pathen to uma ahi, kati.
target: But I said, “I have labored in vain; I have spent my strength for nothing at all. Yet what is due me is in the Lord ’s hand, and my reward is with my God.”

source: Chule tun Israel chu anakikhom khomlou hitajongleu, naobu-a patna alhacha-a pangdinga einagonga, Jacob chu ahenga hinlepuikit dinga, Pakai mitmu-a keima loupinalai dingle ka Pathen chu kathahat hidinga einagongpa Pakai chun aseije.
target: And now the Lord says— he who formed me in the womb to be his servant to bring Jacob back to him and gather Israel to himself, for I am honored in the eyes of the Lord and my God has been my strength—

source: Chuin aman Jacob phungho tungdoh dingle, Israel vetupma lepehkit dinga kalhacha-a napanding chu thil jangkhaicha ahi, ati. Leiset kolmong geija nangma kahuhhing nahiding, chidang namdangte salvahna dingjong kapeh ding nahi.
target: he says: “It is too small a thing for you to be my servant to restore the tribes of Jacob and bring back those of Israel I have kept. I will also make you a light for the Gentiles, that my salvation may reach to the ends of the earth.”

source: Tahsan umtah Israel lhatdohpale, amithengpa, mite i-sah loupa, namtin hotbolpa, vaipoho sohpa henga chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Tahsan umtah Pakai Israel mithengpa aman nang nalhendingjehin: lenghon amuteng thoudohdiu, leng chapatenjong chibai abohdiu ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says— the Redeemer and Holy One of Israel— to him who was despised and abhorred by the nation, to the servant of rulers: “Kings will see you and stand up, princes will see and bow down, because of the Lord , who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you.”

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, lahphat chan natao nao kangaijin, huhhing nikhon nangma kapanpin, chule nangma nahongbit ningting, Leiset tungdoh dingle goulo kamhelsa gam lodinga miho thulhun hidinga kapeh ding nahin;
target: This is what the Lord says: “In the time of my favor I will answer you, and in the day of salvation I will help you; I will keep you and will make you to be a covenant for the people, to restore the land and to reassign its desolate inheritances,

source: chutia chu sohchangho jah-a potdoh taovin, chule muthima umho jah-a hungkilahdoh un natiding ahi. Lamdunga kivah-untin, munsang jouse-a alhatlenao mun umding ahi.
target: to say to the captives, ‘Come out,’ and to those in darkness, ‘Be free!’ “They will feed beside the roads and find pasture on every barren hill.

source: Amaho gilkel dangchah talou ding; alumle nisanjong akahnat loudiu ahi. Ajehchu ahepi paovin puihoi jintin, twisam putna pang dunga apuilediu ahi.
target: They will neither hunger nor thirst, nor will the desert heat or the sun beat down on them. He who has compassion on them will guide them and lead them beside springs of water.

source: Chule kamolsang jouse lampin semingting, kalamlhongho kadop sang ding ahi.
target: I will turn all my mountains into roads, and my highways will be raised up.

source: Veovin, hiche hohi gamlatah-a kona hungdiu ahin; chule vetan, hiche hohi sahlamle lhumlama kon; chule hiche hohi Sinim gama kona hungdiu ahi.
target: See, they will come from afar— some from the north, some from the west, some from the region of Aswan.”

source: Vo vanho; kipala saovin; Vo leiset, thanomin umin; Vo molsang ho awthong jeju-a lasahnan pohjah-un. Ajehchu Pakaiyin amite alhamonin, akibol gentheinao chunga ahepiding ahi.
target: Shout for joy, you heavens; rejoice, you earth; burst into song, you mountains! For the Lord comforts his people and will have compassion on his afflicted ones.

source: Ahinla Zion'in, Pakaiyin eidalhan, ka Pakaiyin eisumil tai, ati.
target: But Zion said, “The Lord has forsaken me, the Lord has forgotten me.”

source: Numei jin anao noicheplai asuhmiljouva, ataijola peng achapa lainat louva umthei dingham? henge, amahon sumil theijunte, hijengjongle kenvang nangma kasuhmil louhel ding nahi.
target: “Can a mother forget the baby at her breast and have no compassion on the child she has borne? Though she may forget, I will not forget you!

source: Ven, kakhut phang chunga kasemdoh nahin, nakulbang ho kamasanga aumjinge.
target: See, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands; your walls are ever before me.

source: Nachate chu ki kino uvintin; nasumanghole panabeija nakoi houchu nanga kona potdoh ding ahiuve.
target: Your children hasten back, and those who laid you waste depart from you.

source: Khoda-in lang nakimvel vetemin, hiteho jousehi akikhom khomun, nahenga ahunguve. Pakaiyin keima kahingjingnai, nangin amaho jousehi thonlouhela kijepna-a naneiding, mounu kijep banga nachunga kijepna-a nanei ding ahi, ati.
target: Lift up your eyes and look around; all your children gather and come to you. As surely as I live,” declares the Lord , “you will wear them all as ornaments; you will put them on, like a bride.

source: Ajehchu mun ongle namun kamhelsa ho, chule namanthah nao gamhochu tu-a chengho dinga chu neo behseh ding ahin, chule naval lhum hou chu gamlatah-a kitolmangdiu ahitai.
target: “Though you were ruined and made desolate and your land laid waste, now you will be too small for your people, and those who devoured you will be far away.

source: Adangho namansah nunga nacha nahin dingho chun, munhi kadingin aneubehseh-in, kachenna ding mun neipen tia nanakhanga aseikitdiu ahi.
target: The children born during your bereavement will yet say in your hearing, ‘This place is too small for us; give us more space to live in.’

source: Chuteng nangin nalungsunga, kon eihinpeh hitantem? Kachatela kachan joutan, akamhela kahin, sohchanga suhle tunga kichonlea kahilouham? vetan, kachang seh-a eikidalha-a, amahohi hoija anaum hiuvintem? natiding ahi.
target: Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who bore me these? I was bereaved and barren; I was exiled and rejected. Who brought these up? I was left all alone, but these—where have they come from?’ ”

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, veuvin chidang namdangho chunga kakhut kadopsanga, miho dinga kaponlap katundoh ding; chule amahon nachapateo akhutnuva ahinpuijuva, alenguva nachanuteu ahinkitot dingu ahi.
target: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: “See, I will beckon to the nations, I will lift up my banner to the peoples; they will bring your sons in their arms and carry your daughters on their hips.

source: Lengho chu nadontup uva pate hung hiuvintin, chule lengnu ho jong chu nadontup nu-u hiding ahiuve. Amaho na-ang uva amaiju tolam ngatna bohkhup uva, nakenga leivui ahinle ngimdiu ahin; chutia chu keihi Pakai chu kahi ti nahet jengding ahi. Ajehchu keima eingah ho chu jahcha louhel ding ahiuve.
target: Kings will be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down before you with their faces to the ground; they will lick the dust at your feet. Then you will know that I am the Lord ; those who hope in me will not be disappointed.”

source: Mihatpa-a kona anehban kilahpeh theija, ahiloule dandih-a gal hinga kikai chu, sohchathei ding ham?
target: Can plunder be taken from warriors, or captives be rescued from the fierce?

source: Ahivangin Pakaiyin hitin aseije, sohchang mihat tahho jeng jong kilamanga, gin umtah nehban jong kisalhah peh ding ahi. Ajehchu nangma kinelpipa chu kinelping ting, nachate chu kahuhhing ding ahi.
target: But this is what the Lord says: “Yes, captives will be taken from warriors, and plunder retrieved from the fierce; I will contend with those who contend with you, and your children I will save.

source: Chule nangma sugenthei hochu amaho tahsa tah-a kavah-a, ju lhumtah banga amaho thisantah chu adonkhamdiu ahi. Chutengle tahsa hing jousen keima Pakai chu nahuhhingpa, nalhatdohpa le Jacob mihatpa kahi ahetdiu ahi.
target: I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh; they will be drunk on their own blood, as with wine. Then all mankind will know that I, the Lord , am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.”

source: Pakaiyin hitin, ati, nanu kadana lekha chu hoija umtam? ahiloule kalei-bapa koipen koma kajohdoh nahiuvem, veuvin nakhangitlou jeh uva nanghole naho nakijoh uva, chule nasuhkhelnao jeh-a nanu kida ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says: “Where is your mother’s certificate of divorce with which I sent her away? Or to which of my creditors did I sell you? Because of your sins you were sold; because of your transgressions your mother was sent away.

source: Ipijeh-a kahunga chu pasal khatcha naum lou uham? Kakouva chu eihouding khatcha umlou ham? Kakhut hin mi ahuhdoh lelhel nadinga kisuchoma ham? veuvin, twipi kaphoh-in agohelin, vadungho chu gamthip kasosah-in, anga'u hochu twi beijeh-in a-uijin, dang chah-in athiuvin ahi.
target: When I came, why was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Was my arm too short to deliver you? Do I lack the strength to rescue you? By a mere rebuke I dry up the sea, I turn rivers into a desert; their fish rot for lack of water and die of thirst.

source: Keiman vanho avomin kajemin, akhunaovin khaodip pon kaseme.
target: I clothe the heavens with darkness and make sackcloth its covering.”

source: Athachol ho chu aphatcha thukhat seipehje kahetnadin Pakai Pathen'in seithemna lei eipen; jingseh-in eisukhangin mithem banga ngainadin kakol avansah-e.
target: The Sovereign Lord has given me a well-instructed tongue, to know the word that sustains the weary. He wakens me morning by morning, wakens my ear to listen like one being instructed.

source: Pakai Pathen'in kakol eihonpeh in, kahuhelpon, kakinung heikit tahih helle.
target: The Sovereign Lord has opened my ears; I have not been rebellious, I have not turned away.

source: Katungtun mivoho kadopeh-in, sambot ho kabengteni kadopeh-in, jachatnale chil setkhuma konin kamai kaselpoi.
target: I offered my back to those who beat me, my cheeks to those who pulled out my beard; I did not hide my face from mocking and spitting.

source: Ajehchu Pakai Pathen'in eipanpin tin, hijeh chun kisudong ponge. Hijeh chun kamaihi meituh song bangin kadon, jachatna kato louding chu kahei.
target: Because the Sovereign Lord helps me, I will not be disgraced. Therefore have I set my face like flint, and I know I will not be put to shame.

source: Them eichan sahpan einaije, koiham eikinelpi dinga? Eiho dingkhomu hite; koiham eikidoupia chu? kahenga hungnai hen.
target: He who vindicates me is near. Who then will bring charges against me? Let us face each other! Who is my accuser? Let him confront me!

source: Vetan, Pakai Pathen'in eipanpi ding ahin; themmo eichan dinga amachu koiham? Veovin, amaho abonuva pon banga chuldiu ahin, ngetnin aneh chaidiu ahi.
target: It is the Sovereign Lord who helps me. Who will condemn me? They will all wear out like a garment; the moths will eat them up.

source: Nalah uva Pakai ginga alhachapa thusei jopma, muthima vahlea, vah himhim neilouva chu koiham? Pakai minchu tahsan henlang, a-Pathen chunga kingaihen.
target: Who among you fears the Lord and obeys the word of his servant? Let the one who walks in the dark, who has no light, trust in the name of the Lord and rely on their God.

source: Meisel de-a meisia kiumkim vel nangho jouse; nameivah-ule nameisel detnu mei sipahlah-a chun vahleuvin. Hichehi kakhutna namudingu chu ahin, lungkham tah a nalup dingu ahi.
target: But now, all you who light fires and provide yourselves with flaming torches, go, walk in the light of your fires and of the torches you have set ablaze. This is what you shall receive from my hand: You will lie down in torment.

source: Chonphatna nung juija Pakai holte nanghon kathu ngaijun; nakikhendoh nao songpile nakilaidoh nao kokhuh lamchu veuvin.
target: “Listen to me, you who pursue righteousness and who seek the Lord : Look to the rock from which you were cut and to the quarry from which you were hewn;

source: Napao Abraham le nahingu Sarah lam veuvin; ajehchu achang seh-in kakouvin, phatthei kanaboh-in kapunsah-e.
target: look to Abraham, your father, and to Sarah, who gave you birth. When I called him he was only one man, and I blessed him and made him many.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin Zion lhamon nintin, amunthip jouse lhamon inte, agamthip chu Eden bangin semintin, chule aneldigam chu Pakai hon bangin semintin, asunga chu kipanale thanopna, thangvahnale la ngei gin kijading ahi.
target: The Lord will surely comfort Zion and will look with compassion on all her ruins; he will make her deserts like Eden, her wastelands like the garden of the Lord . Joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and the sound of singing.

source: Kamiten kathu ngaijunlang, Vo kanam mite nanakhang hinsung uvin; ajehchu keija kona danthu hung kondoh-a, mitin salvah dinga kathutan na chu kakicholdo sah ding ahi.
target: “Listen to me, my people; hear me, my nation: Instruction will go out from me; my justice will become a light to the nations.

source: Kachon phatna nikho ahungnaijin; kahuh hingna apotdohtan, kabantenin mitin thu atanding; twikol gamhon eingah untin, kabanna hi atahsan nao angap dingu ahi.
target: My righteousness draws near speedily, my salvation is on the way, and my arm will bring justice to the nations. The islands will look to me and wait in hope for my arm.

source: Van lama khodah-un lang, chule noilam leiset chung hinveuvin; ajehchu vanho chu meikhu banga jam manga, leiset hi ponsil banga chulding ahin, chutobanga chu asunga chengho thidiu ahin, kahuh hingna vang atonsotna umjinga, kachon phatna kisumang louding ahi.
target: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, look at the earth beneath; the heavens will vanish like smoke, the earth will wear out like a garment and its inhabitants die like flies. But my salvation will last forever, my righteousness will never fail.

source: Chonphatna he-a alunga kadanthu he-ah nanghon kathusei ngaijun; mihem seiset ginghih-un, ahousetnau jong kicha hih helun.
target: “Hear me, you who know what is right, you people who have taken my instruction to heart: Do not fear the reproach of mere mortals or be terrified by their insults.

source: Ajehchu ponsil banga amaho ngetnin aneh uva, samul banga lungin anehdiu ahin, kachon phatna vang a-imatih chana uma, kahuh hingna akhang akhanga umding ahi.
target: For the moth will eat them up like a garment; the worm will devour them like wool. But my righteousness will last forever, my salvation through all generations.”

source: O Pakai banjang; Khangin, khangin, thahat na-in kivonin; masanglai nikhole khanglui laija bangin khangin, Rahab sat na, Dragon mavo-a chu nang nahilouham?
target: Awake, awake, arm of the Lord , clothe yourself with strength! Awake, as in days gone by, as in generations of old. Was it not you who cut Rahab to pieces, who pierced that monster through?

source: Nanghi twipi thuh nasatah twikhanglen kansah-a, lhatdohsate galkai nadinga twikhanglen thuhtah laija lampi sema chu nahilouham?
target: Was it not you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep, who made a road in the depths of the sea so that the redeemed might cross over?

source: Hijeh-a chu Pakai lhatdohsate hungkileuva, lasahpuma Zion lama hungdiu, aluchung uva tonsot kipana chu umding ahi; amaho kipanale thanopna chang-un tin; lungkhamnale lunghemna jam mangding ahitai.
target: Those the Lord has rescued will return. They will enter Zion with singing; everlasting joy will crown their heads. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.

source: Keima, keimong monghi nangho lhamon na chu kahin; athiding mihem, hampa bangbepma kisem mihem chapa kichading koi nahiuvam;
target: “I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you that you fear mere mortals, human beings who are but grass,

source: Vanho kijaldoh sah-a, leiset bul phutdetpa, nasempa Pakai na Pathen sumila, suhmang dinga nanago jing misugenthei pa lungsatna jeh-a niseh-a tanglouva kichajing nang koi nahim? Misugenthei pa lungsatna chu hoiba hitam?
target: that you forget the Lord your Maker, who stretches out the heavens and who lays the foundations of the earth, that you live in constant terror every day because of the wrath of the oppressor, who is bent on destruction? For where is the wrath of the oppressor?

source: Kokhuh sunga athilouna dingle anehjong alhahsap lounadingin, gal hinga kikaimang chu lhadoh-a aumna din ama akinon ahi.
target: The cowering prisoners will soon be set free; they will not die in their dungeon, nor will they lack bread.

source: Ahinla akinong ginglellul twipi homkhenpa Pakai na Pathen chu kahin, kamin janelho Pakai ahi.
target: For I am the Lord your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the Lord Almighty is his name.

source: Vanho kaphudetna, leiset bul kavui detna, Zion henga nangma kamite nahi kati theina din, kathuho nakam sunga kakhumin, kakhut limmin nangma kakhu khumin ahi.
target: I have put my words in your mouth and covered you with the shadow of my hand— I who set the heavens in place, who laid the foundations of the earth, and who say to Zion, ‘You are my people.’ ”

source: Pakai khutna alungsatna khona dona, vo Jerusalem, khangin, khangin, dingdoh-in, kichat jeh-a kitihona khona kon aningkai geijin nadonin, nadon kang hele.
target: Awake, awake! Rise up, Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the hand of the Lord the cup of his wrath, you who have drained to its dregs the goblet that makes people stagger.

source: Amanun ahindoh chapa jouse lah-a, amanu puihoi ding khatcha aumpoi; ahin vahdoh chapaho jouse lah-a jong akhutna akaile khatcha aumpoi.
target: Among all the children she bore there was none to guide her; among all the children she reared there was none to take her by the hand.

source: Hiche thilni hin nahin lhunkhum ding ahin, kon nalungkham peh tantem? Gamnale suhmangna, kel lhahna le chemjam; koijin nang nalhamon tan tem?
target: These double calamities have come upon you— who can comfort you?— ruin and destruction, famine and sword— who can console you?

source: Nachapate alhadah taovin, gam bongchal len thanga oh bangin khosung lamlen laija alumchap mun; amaho Pakai lungsatnale na Pathen'u phosalna dimset changa ahitaove.
target: Your children have fainted; they lie at every street corner, like antelope caught in a net. They are filled with the wrath of the Lord , with the rebuke of your God.

source: Hijeh chun tun lengpitheija hilouva, suhgentheina-a khampan hichehi ngaijin.
target: Therefore hear this, you afflicted one, made drunk, but not with wine.

source: Pakai na Pakai, amite thu seitohpeh-a na Pathen chun hitin ati, vetan, lamvaina khonle, kalungsatna ningkai khontah chu nakhutna konin kaladohtai; nadonkit tahlouhel ding ahitai, ati.
target: This is what your Sovereign Lord says, your God, who defends his people: “See, I have taken out of your hand the cup that made you stagger; from that cup, the goblet of my wrath, you will never drink again.

source: Ahinla nahinna jah-a, nachunga kache theinadiuvin bohkhupmin, tia nasugenthei ho khutna chun tollhang bangle kholai lamlen bangin nachunga lamjot ho dingin natahsa nadotan ahi.
target: I will put it into the hands of your tormentors, who said to you, ‘Fall prostrate that we may walk on you.’ And you made your back like the ground, like a street to be walked on.”

source: Khangin, khangin, vo Zion nathahatnin kivonin; Vo Jerusalem, khopitheng navon hoijin kivonin; ajehchu tua pat cheptanloule aboh nasunga lutlou hel ding ahitai.
target: Awake, awake, Zion, clothe yourself with strength! Put on your garments of splendor, Jerusalem, the holy city. The uncircumcised and defiled will not enter you again.

source: Vo Jerusalem, leivuija konin kithing ngimin, thoudoh-in lang, toulhan. Vo sohchang Zion chanu, nangonga nakihenna khaoho-a konin kisut lhamin.
target: Shake off your dust; rise up, sit enthroned, Jerusalem. Free yourself from the chains on your neck, Daughter Zion, now a captive.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin ati, ima hilouhel dinga kijoh nahiuvin, sumbeija kilhatdoh ding nahiuve, ati.
target: For this is what the Lord says: “You were sold for nothing, and without money you will be redeemed.”

source: Ajehchu Pakai Pathen'in hitin ati, masangin kamite Egypt'a khopemdin anachesuh uvin; ajeh beijin Assyria ten abol gentheijun ahi.
target: For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: “At first my people went down to Egypt to live; lately, Assyria has oppressed them.

source: Hijeh chun tun Pakaiyin aseitai, hikoma hi keiman ipi kanei tah-em? Kamitela ima hilouhelin apuimang taovin, achunguva vaipoten la apensahsah uvin, chule ka min jong niseh-in tanglouhelin ataitom jinguve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “And now what do I have here?” declares the Lord . “For my people have been taken away for nothing, and those who rule them mock,” declares the Lord . “And all day long my name is constantly blasphemed.

source: Hijeh chun kamiten keima min heovintin; hicheni chule amahon thuseipa chu keima kahi hetaovinte; veuvin keima kahi, ati.
target: Therefore my people will know my name; therefore in that day they will know that it is I who foretold it. Yes, it is I.”

source: Molsang chungho-a kipana thupha pole pa kengphang chu iti hoi hitam? chamna thu phongle; thupha-a kipana thupha pole-a, huhhingna thu phonglea, Zion henga, na Pathen alengchang tai, tia seilepa chu!
target: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of those who bring good news, who proclaim peace, who bring good tidings, who proclaim salvation, who say to Zion, “Your God reigns!”

source: Khopi ngahhon aw sangtah-a asapdohdiu ahi: thakhat tah-a penga la asahdiu ahi; ajehchu Pakaiyin Zion ahinpuikit tengle amitcheh uva akimudiu ahi.
target: Listen! Your watchmen lift up their voices; together they shout for joy. When the Lord returns to Zion, they will see it with their own eyes.

source: Jerusalem mun kamhelsa ho thanomun lang, kipa la sakhom un, ajehchu Pakaiyin amite alhamonin Jerusalem alhatdohtai.
target: Burst into songs of joy together, you ruins of Jerusalem, for the Lord has comforted his people, he has redeemed Jerusalem.

source: Pakaiyin abantheng chu namtin jouse mitmun agohkeo ahisah-in; chule leiset kolmong jousen i-Pathen nu mihuhhing na amudiu ahi.
target: The Lord will lay bare his holy arm in the sight of all the nations, and all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.

source: Potdoh-un, potdoh-un, hiche-a konin chedoh-un lang, thilboh tongkha hih-un; alah-a konin potdoh-un, Pakai manchah ho choija nangho kisuthengun.
target: Depart, depart, go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Come out from it and be pure, you who carry the articles of the Lord ’s house.

source: Ajehchu kintah-a, napotdoh loudiu, jamtho-a jong nache louheldiu, ajehchu Pakai nama sang uva chentin; Israel Pathen'in nanungu adelding ahi.
target: But you will not leave in haste or go in flight; for the Lord will go before you, the God of Israel will be your rear guard.

source: Vetan, kasohpan chingthei tah-in bolintin, ama choi-at le choisanga uma, sangtah-a umding ahi.
target: See, my servant will act wisely; he will be raised and lifted up and highly exalted.

source: Mitam tah-in adatmou bangin, amaiso mihem dang jouse-a sangin ase-in, chule apendan amelput mihem chapate ngaija sangin suhmelsetnin aumin ahi.
target: Just as there were many who were appalled at him— his appearance was so disfigured beyond that of any human being and his form marred beyond human likeness—

source: Chutia chu aman namtin vaipi tamtah athe khuma; ama chungchanga leng hon akamu akisip dingu ahi. Ajehchu akihil khahlouhelu amuva, ajahkhah louhelu jong agelthem dingu ahi.
target: so he will sprinkle many nations, and kings will shut their mouths because of him. For what they were not told, they will see, and what they have not heard, they will understand.

source: Kathulhut nu kon atahsana? Pakai bantha koihenga kilah-am?
target: Who has believed our message and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?

source: Ajehchu ama amasanga chun hamdong kehthah bangle leigo-a ajung kikhodoh bangin hungkhangdoh-in tin, aman limle melhoina himhim aneipon, ideina diu hoina himhim aumpon ahi.
target: He grew up before him like a tender shoot, and like a root out of dry ground. He had no beauty or majesty to attract us to him, nothing in his appearance that we should desire him.

source: Ama chu mihemte nahsahmole paidoh-in aumin; lungdon le lung genthei he mi ahin; eihon ama-a konin imaiju ina selmangun, amachu nahsahmon ana umin, eihonjong ina gelsangdeh pouve.
target: He was despised and rejected by mankind, a man of suffering, and familiar with pain. Like one from whom people hide their faces he was despised, and we held him in low esteem.

source: Atahbeh-in aman ilungkhamnahou apon, chule ilung gentheinahou apotai, ahinla eihon aki engbol, Pathen vohle sugentheijin ingaitouve.
target: Surely he took up our pain and bore our suffering, yet we considered him punished by God, stricken by him, and afflicted.

source: Ahinla ama eiho suhkhel jeh-in akimavon, eiho khangitlou jeh-in akisugepmin, eiho lungmona dingin gimbolna chu amachunga achutai. Ama kijepna chun eidamsah taove.
target: But he was pierced for our transgressions, he was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was on him, and by his wounds we are healed.

source: Eiho ibon chaovin kelngoi bangin ivah mangun, eiho amitakip inop nalam cheh-a ikiheijun, ahin Pakaiyin eiho khangitlouna jouse achunga angamtai.
target: We all, like sheep, have gone astray, each of us has turned to our own way; and the Lord has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

source: Ama akisugen theijin, ama akibolgimtai, ahijeng vangin ama akamkapoi. Ama thadinga kikai kelngoi bangin akaijun, kelngoi amulvouho anga athipbeh bangin chutichun akamkapoi.
target: He was oppressed and afflicted, yet he did not open his mouth; he was led like a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before its shearers is silent, so he did not open his mouth.

source: Ama sohchan nale thutan na-a konin akilamang tai. Kon ama khanggui thu asut thei dingham? Ajehchu ama mihing gama kona kisumanga ahitai. Ajehchu kamite suhkhel jeh-a ki-engbola ahitai.
target: By oppression and judgment he was taken away. Yet who of his generation protested? For he was cut off from the land of the living; for the transgression of my people he was punished.

source: Aman hunamin ima abolpon, akamin jong lheplhahna thu khatcha aseikhapoi; aman alhankhuh chu migiloute-a toh asemgomin, athi-a chun mihaopa toh aumkhom me.
target: He was assigned a grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death, though he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.

source: Hitajongle suhgep dingchu Pakai lunglam chu ahitan; aman natna athohsahtai. Nangin ahinna chonset thilto-a nasemtengle, aman achilhah kimuntin, anikhoho asaosah ding, Pakai lunglhaina chu akhutna khangtou ding ahitai.
target: Yet it was the Lord ’s will to crush him and cause him to suffer, and though the Lord makes his life an offering for sin, he will see his offspring and prolong his days, and the will of the Lord will prosper in his hand.

source: Aman ahinna thohgimna chu amua, lunglhai ding ahitai. Aman agitlounau apohpeh dingjeh-a kasohdih tah chun ahetna-a mitamtah them achanding ahi.
target: After he has suffered, he will see the light of life and be satisfied; by his knowledge my righteous servant will justify many, and he will bear their iniquities.

source: Hijeh-a chu keiman amachu milenhotoh chan kahop peh-a, aman mihat ho chu thil kichom akihoppi ding ahi. Ajehchu aman thina geijin ahinna abunglhan ahi. Chutichun ama suhkhel hotoh akisimthatan; mitamtah chonsetna apon, achonkhelho dingin ataopeh-in ahi.
target: Therefore I will give him a portion among the great, and he will divide the spoils with the strong, because he poured out his life unto death, and was numbered with the transgressors. For he bore the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.

source: Vo achinga chaneilou nun kipah-in la san lang, hatah-in samin; naosonat thohkhalou nu nangma, ajehchu jineiho chate sangin achingnu chate atamjoi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Sing, barren woman, you who never bore a child; burst into song, shout for joy, you who were never in labor; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband,” says the Lord .

source: Napon in mun kehlenin lang, chule nachen detna pon in chungchu kijalsah-in, khen neilouvin nakhao chu saosah-in lang, chule ahenna mol ho chu khendetnin;
target: “Enlarge the place of your tent, stretch your tent curtains wide, do not hold back; lengthen your cords, strengthen your stakes.

source: Ajehchu jetle veija kithejah intin, nachilhah hon chidang namdangte chu louvintin, khopi gamho chu chenna-a aneidiu ahitai.
target: For you will spread out to the right and to the left; your descendants will dispossess nations and settle in their desolate cities.

source: Kicha hih-in; ajehchu najachat louding, nakisuhdong louhel ding ahi. Ajehchu naneo laija najachatna nasuhmila, na meithai nahsah louva aumna chu nageldoh kit louhel ding ahitai.
target: “Do not be afraid; you will not be put to shame. Do not fear disgrace; you will not be humiliated. You will forget the shame of your youth and remember no more the reproach of your widowhood.

source: Ajehchu nasempa chu najipa ahin, janelho Pakai chu amin ahi. Nalhatdohpa chu Israel mithengpa ahin, ama chu leiset pumpi Pathen kitiding ahi.
target: For your Maker is your husband— the Lord Almighty is his name— the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; he is called the God of all the earth.

source: Ajehchu akidalha lhagaova lungnatah neogol ji kideitalou numei khat tobanga Pakaiyin nakoukit ahitai, tin na Pathen'in aseije.
target: The Lord will call you back as if you were a wife deserted and distressed in spirit— a wife who married young, only to be rejected,” says your God.

source: Phat chomcha dinga kadalhahsa nahitan, ahinla hepina lentah-a kakhopkit ding nahi.
target: “For a brief moment I abandoned you, but with deep compassion I will bring you back.

source: Lungkhamna neochakhat jeh-in mitphehkah louvin nanga kamai kanaselin, ahinla tonsot khotona-a kahepi nahi, tin nalhat doh-a Pakai chun aseije.
target: In a surge of anger I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you,” says the Lord your Redeemer.

source: Ajehchu keidin hichu Noah nikho tobang ahi, Ajehchu Noah twi chun leiset achupkit louding ahitai, tia kahahsel bangchun nachunga lunghangkit, phohsal kit taponge tia kaki hahsel ahitai.
target: “To me this is like the days of Noah, when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth. So now I have sworn not to be angry with you, never to rebuke you again.

source: Ajehchu lhangho kitoldoh-a, mol ho kitolmang ding ahin, ahinla kakhotona chu nanga kona kitoldoh louding; kachamna jong nanga kona kichondoh louhel ding ahi, tin, nahepi-a Pakai chun aseije.
target: Though the mountains be shaken and the hills be removed, yet my unfailing love for you will not be shaken nor my covenant of peace be removed,” says the Lord , who has compassion on you.

source: Vo nang bolgenthei khopi hui mutlon lele, lhamong lou, vetan, nasongho chu ajemhoija kaphua, na inbul chu saphir songa kaphu detding ahi.
target: “Afflicted city, lashed by storms and not comforted, I will rebuild you with stones of turquoise, your foundations with lapis lazuli.

source: Chule nabangkot ho song sandang, chule nakotpiho song santhip, chule nagamgi jouse song hoitah-a kasemding ahi.
target: I will make your battlements of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.

source: Chule nachate jouse chu Pakai hildoh hidiu, nachate chamna chu nasatah hiding ahitai.
target: All your children will be taught by the Lord , and great will be their peace.

source: Chonphatna-a naki phudetna, suhgentheija kona gamlatah nahiding ahi. Ajehchu tijatna-a kona nakichat louding ahi. Ajehchu hichun nahin nailouding ahitai.
target: In righteousness you will be established: Tyranny will be far from you; you will have nothing to fear. Terror will be far removed; it will not come near you.

source: Vetan, amaho kikhom khom teidiu ahin, keija konvang hiloudiu ahi. Nangma douna-a kikhom chanchu nangma vanga lhudiu ahi.
target: If anyone does attack you, it will not be my doing; whoever attacks you will surrender to you.

source: Vetan, keiman pummeija meihol japma, thihkhengpa anatoh nading manchah kikhendohpa chu kanasem ahin, asumang ding thilsumanghelpa jongchu kanasem ahi.
target: “See, it is I who created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame and forges a weapon fit for its work. And it is I who have created the destroyer to wreak havoc;

source: Nangma douna-a galmanchah kigon ho chu lolhing louding; chule thutan na-a nangma douva leigui takipchu themmo nachang ding ahi. Hichu Pakai sohte goulo ahin, achonphatnao chu keija ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: no weapon forged against you will prevail, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord , and this is their vindication from me,” declares the Lord .

source: Khaije, adangchah channin twiphung hinjon hen, chule sum neilou chan hungun lang kichoh-un, chule neovin; henge, hungun, lengpitwi le bongnoi sum beija manbeijin hung kichoh-un.
target: “Come, all you who are thirsty, come to the waters; and you who have no money, come, buy and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without cost.

source: Ipijeh-a changlhah hilouva sum nasuh manguva? chule van'a louhella natohgim uham? Kaseihi lunglut tah-in ngaijun, nanghon apha chu neuvin, chule nahinnao chu thaona-a chun kipah hen.
target: Why spend money on what is not bread, and your labor on what does not satisfy? Listen, listen to me, and eat what is good, and you will delight in the richest of fare.

source: Nanakol-u hinsungun lang kahenga hungun; ngaijun, chutile nahinnao chu hing ding ahi. Chutile David kihepina tahbeh chu naheng uva tonsot kitepna-a kasem ding ahi.
target: Give ear and come to me; listen, that you may live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, my faithful love promised to David.

source: Vetan, miho dinga hettohsah hidingin amachu kapen, miho dinga lamkainale thuneina amachu kapei.
target: See, I have made him a witness to the peoples, a ruler and commander of the peoples.

source: Ven, nahetkhahlou namkhat kouvin natin, Pakai Pathen vangle Israel mithengpa jala nangma hekhalou namhochu nahenga hungjam diu ahi. Ajehchu aman nachoi-at ahitai.
target: Surely you will summon nations you know not, and nations you do not know will come running to you, because of the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, for he has endowed you with splendor.”

source: Mutheija aumpetnin Pakai chu hollun, nailama aumpet nin amachu kouvun.
target: Seek the Lord while he may be found; call on him while he is near.

source: Migilouvin alampi dalha hen chule chonpha loupan alungngaito dalhahen; Pakai hengle i-Pathen'u henga hung kilehen, chutile hepina changa chamkimtah-a ngaidam hiding ahi.
target: Let the wicked forsake their ways and the unrighteous their thoughts. Let them turn to the Lord , and he will have mercy on them, and to our God, for he will freely pardon.

source: Ijeh inem itileh kangaito hohi nangho ngaito ahipon, nalampi hou jong kalampi ahipoi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways,” declares the Lord .

source: Ajehchu leiset sanga vanho asanjoh bangin, keima lampiho jong nangho lampi ho sangin asangjon, chule keima ngaito hojong nangho ngaito ho sangin asangjoi.
target: “As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways and my thoughts than your thoughts.

source: Ajehchu gotwi le buhbang van'a kona ahunglhah-a, chunglama kilekitlouva, leiset achapnou joh-a thil akedohsah-a chule amumdohsah ahin, muchi thepa muchi-a apeh nadingle, anneh-a hingpa changlhah apehnadinga ahi.
target: As the rain and the snow come down from heaven, and do not return to it without watering the earth and making it bud and flourish, so that it yields seed for the sower and bread for the eater,

source: Kakam sunga kona potdoh thuchu chutiding ahin, hichu agoh-a hungkile louhel ding, kadeichu asuhbulhitna, kasolna thilla chu lolhingjo ding ahi.
target: so is my word that goes out from my mouth: It will not return to me empty, but will accomplish what I desire and achieve the purpose for which I sent it.

source: Ajehchu kipah-a kondoh a chamdela nakipuidoh diu, molle lhanghon namasanguva penga la asahdoh jenguva, chule loujaova thingphung jousen khut abehcheh diu ahi.
target: You will go out in joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and hills will burst into song before you, and all the trees of the field will clap their hands.

source: Lingthing khella chahthihg kehdoh-a, khao lingnei khella lenmuipah phung kehdoh ding, chule Pakai dinga minphatnale suhtan hi louhel ding tonsotna melchihna ding chu hiding ahi.
target: Instead of the thornbush will grow the juniper, and instead of briers the myrtle will grow. This will be for the Lord ’s renown, for an everlasting sign, that will endure forever.”

source: Tonsot Pakaiyin hitin ati, thukitan chu nit uvin lang, adih chu bollun; ajehchu keima mihuhhing na hunglhung loiding ahitai, chule kachon phatna hungkiphong doh ding ahitai.
target: This is what the Lord says: “Maintain justice and do what is right, for my salvation is close at hand and my righteousness will soon be revealed.

source: Hiche bolpa hi anunmon ahi; mihem chapa hiche tuhchah jingpa; suboh louva cholngah nikho nitjingpa, chule akhut thilse bolna-a kona tuhtang jingpa chu ahi.
target: Blessed is the one who does this— the person who holds it fast, who keeps the Sabbath without desecrating it, and keeps their hands from doing any evil.”

source: Gamdangmi chapa, Pakai to kijop matsa chun Pakaiyin amite-a konin eichom khomheltai tin seida hen, nukiso jongchun, vetan, keima thinggo kahitai tin seidahen.
target: Let no foreigner who is bound to the Lord say, “The Lord will surely exclude me from his people.” And let no eunuch complain, “I am only a dry tree.”

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, nukiso keima choldo nikho jouse nitjinga, kalungdeilam kilhenna, chule kakitepna tuhjingpa chu;
target: For this is what the Lord says: “To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, who choose what pleases me and hold fast to my covenant—

source: keiman amahotah chu ka-insungle kakulbang sunga munkhat, chapate le chanute sanga phajohel munkhat le minkhat kapeh ding ahi. Keiman amaho amangkit louheldinga tonsotna umjing ding min kapeh ding ahi.
target: to them I will give within my temple and its walls a memorial and a name better than sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name that will endure forever.

source: Gamdang mi chapate Pakai toh kijopmat ho, ama jenna dingle Pakai min ngailutna dinga, ama soh hidinga, choldoni suhbohlouva nitjinga, chule kakitepna tuhchah chanjong chu;
target: And foreigners who bind themselves to the Lord to minister to him, to love the name of the Lord , and to be his servants, all who keep the Sabbath without desecrating it and who hold fast to my covenant—

source: amaho ngei chu kalhangthenga kapuija, kataona insunga kipana kadimsah ding; agovam thiltohoule akithoina houchu ka maicham chunga sanpeh hiding ahi. Ajehchu ka-in chu mijouse dinga taona in kitiding ahi.
target: these I will bring to my holy mountain and give them joy in my house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all nations.”

source: Israel kinodohho chomkhom Pakai Pathen chun aseije, ahenga kichomsaho tailouva, adangho jong ahenga kachom khombe nahlai ding ahi.
target: The Sovereign Lord declares— he who gathers the exiles of Israel: “I will gather still others to them besides those already gathered.”

source: Loujaova gamsaho jousen hungne jouvun; ahije, nangho gam manga gamsaho jousen jong hungneovin.
target: Come, all you beasts of the field, come and devour, all you beasts of the forest!

source: Akhongah hou chu mitcho ahiuve, ima heloucheh, abonchauva uicha hamma hamtheilou, mijong haptheilou cheh ahiuvin; lumma ihmunom ahiuve.
target: Israel’s watchmen are blind, they all lack knowledge; they are all mute dogs, they cannot bark; they lie around and dream, they love to sleep.

source: Ahi, amaho chimtih neilou uichalop le hetkhenna neitheilou kelngoiching ahiuvin; abonun achennaova koncheh-in, ama deilam chehle aphat chomna dingcheh akivet taove.
target: They are dogs with mighty appetites; they never have enough. They are shepherds who lack understanding; they all turn to their own way, they seek their own gain.

source: Amahon, hungun keiman lengpitwi galangting, khamnatheija idimsoh diu ahin, jing jongkhu tuni tobang hintin, nengjocheh ding ahi, atiuve.
target: “Come,” each one cries, “let me get wine! Let us drink our fill of beer! And tomorrow will be like today, or even far better.”

source: Michonpha amangthah jin, koiman lunga akoipoi. Mihepiho akipui mangin, thilphalou hunglhung dinga kona michonpha kipuimanga ahi, tin koiman agelpoi.
target: The righteous perish, and no one takes it to heart; the devout are taken away, and no one understands that the righteous are taken away to be spared from evil.

source: Ama chamna-a lutnintin: amaho ajalkhun uva choldodiu, ama dihsahna-a lamjotcheh ahiuve.
target: Those who walk uprightly enter into peace; they find rest as they lie in death.

source: Nangho gaothusei them chapate, mijigem le mijong sonho hilama hungnai jun,
target: “But you—come here, you children of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!

source: koi douna-a golsehbol nahiuvem? Koi douna-a kamka-a leilha doh-a nahiuvem? Nangho suhkhel neiho chate, mijouho son nahi lou uham?
target: Who are you mocking? At whom do you sneer and stick out your tongue? Are you not a brood of rebels, the offspring of liars?

source: Thing hing phung noi tina milim hotoh Nachon thanghoi juva, phaicham dunga songpi khikeh ho noija naosen ho thatgama nahilou uham?
target: You burn with lust among the oaks and under every spreading tree; you sacrifice your children in the ravines and under the overhanging crags.

source: Vachadung song jolpet ho lah-a nachan aumin; amaho, amahotah chu navang chan ahin, amaho hengtah-a chun donding thilto nalhei lhan anneh thilto natohji-e. Hicheho-a hi lhamon na kamu ding ham?
target: The idols among the smooth stones of the ravines are your portion; indeed, they are your lot. Yes, to them you have poured out drink offerings and offered grain offerings. In view of all this, should I relent?

source: Nangin munsangle molsang chunga najalkhun nadon; chulamtah-a chun ganlhaina tohdingin nakaltouve.
target: You have made your bed on a high and lofty hill; there you went up to offer your sacrifices.

source: Kot hole khomho nunglama chun naki melchihna natung doh-e; ajehchu keisanga achom nahi chu nangle nangin neikhe doh-in, nakaldoh-e. Nangin najalkhun nakeh lenin amahotoh kitepna nasemin ahi, nangin nagahmu ajalkhun hou chu nangaichan ahi.
target: Behind your doors and your doorposts you have put your pagan symbols. Forsaking me, you uncovered your bed, you climbed into it and opened it wide; you made a pact with those whose beds you love, and you looked with lust on their naked bodies.

source: Chule nangma lengpa henga nuding thao nachoijin nachen, nanamtui behseh-in, chule nasottol gamlatah-a nasolin, thikholkhul geijenin naki suneme.
target: You went to Molek with olive oil and increased your perfumes. You sent your ambassadors far away; you descended to the very realm of the dead!

source: Nalampi saojeh-in nachol lhehtai, ahinla nangin kinepna aumpoi natidehpoi. Nangin nakhutna hinna nakimutai; hijeh chun nalungkham poi.
target: You wearied yourself by such going about, but you would not say, ‘It is hopeless.’ You found renewal of your strength, and so you did not faint.

source: Chule koi nakichat na ahiloule naginna jou nasei hija, keima neigeldoh louva, nalunga jong koilouva nahim? sottah kathipbeh hilou hija neigin louhel ham?
target: “Whom have you so dreaded and feared that you have not been true to me, and have neither remembered me nor taken this to heart? Is it not because I have long been silent that you do not fear me?

source: Nachon phatna le nanatoh phongdoh inge, ajehchu hicheho chun phatchomsah ponnate.
target: I will expose your righteousness and your works, and they will not benefit you.

source: Nakatengle naloihon nahuhdoh-u hen; ahinla amaho abonuva huijin alhohmang gamuva, mohseh-a alenmang pidiu, ahinla atahsan keija ngampan bou gamsung chu aneija, kalhangtheng chu aloding ahi.
target: When you cry out for help, let your collection of idols save you! The wind will carry all of them off, a mere breath will blow them away. But whoever takes refuge in me will inherit the land and possess my holy mountain.”

source: Chule sepsangun, sepsangun, lampichu semtoh-un, kamite-a konin kipalna bul ladoh-un tinte.
target: And it will be said: “Build up, build up, prepare the road! Remove the obstacles out of the way of my people.”

source: Ajehchu tonsot munlo-a asangle chungnung pen amin atheng chun, hitin aseije; keima munsangle mun thenga cheng kahi, lhagaova lungnempa suhal dingle, chonset lungkham pipa lung suhhalna dingin, chonset lungkhampipa le lhagaova lungnempa kachen khompi-e.
target: For this is what the high and exalted One says— he who lives forever, whose name is holy: “I live in a high and holy place, but also with the one who is contrite and lowly in spirit, to revive the spirit of the lowly and to revive the heart of the contrite.

source: Ajehchu tonsotnin doujing pongting, lungjong lunghang jingponge, ajehchu kasemsa lhagaole hinna chu kamasanga hungthon getnunte.
target: I will not accuse them forever, nor will I always be angry, for then they would faint away because of me— the very people I have created.

source: Ajehchu akhangit louna kilosetna-a chun kana lunghangin, kanavon ahi; kamai kasela kalunghan ahin, amachu alung gotna lampia seingailou hella chepeh-a, ahi.
target: I was enraged by their sinful greed; I punished them, and hid my face in anger, yet they kept on in their willful ways.

source: Keiman alampiho kamutan, kadamsah ding ahi, ken amajong chu kapuija, amale alhaset piho chu lhamona kapeh ding ahi.
target: I have seen their ways, but I will heal them; I will guide them and restore comfort to Israel’s mourners,

source: Keiman kamsung ga chu kasem ahin, gamlatah-a umpale naija umpa henga chamna, chamna umhen, keiman ama kadamsah ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: creating praise on their lips. Peace, peace, to those far and near,” says the Lord . “And I will heal them.”

source: Ahinla migilouho chu twikhanglen kinong tobang ahiuvin, aumthimbeh louteng bonlhohle bohse jong anuhdohjin ahi.
target: But the wicked are like the tossing sea, which cannot rest, whose waves cast up mire and mud.

source: Ka Pathen chun migilouho dinga chamna himhim aumpoi ati.
target: “There is no peace,” says my God, “for the wicked.”

source: Khenlou helin ging tah-in kho samin, sumkon bangin na aw sansah-in, kamite suhkhelnale Jacob insung mite chonsetna chu musah-in.
target: “Shout it aloud, do not hold back. Raise your voice like a trumpet. Declare to my people their rebellion and to the descendants of Jacob their sins.

source: Chonphatna bolla, a-Pathen chondanho dalhakhalou namkhat tobangin, amahon nitinin eihol holun, kalampiho hetding anomuve. Amahon thutah chondan ho angeh jiuvin, Pathen hinnai dingjong athanomun ahi.
target: For day after day they seek me out; they seem eager to know my ways, as if they were a nation that does what is right and has not forsaken the commands of its God. They ask me for just decisions and seem eager for God to come near them.

source: Ibolla an ka ngolule neimupeh daova, ibola kahinnao kasuh gentheijule neihetpeh daoham? atiuve. Veuvin, na-anngol niuchun nopsahna naholun, namigoihou jouse nabolseuve.
target: ‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you have not seen it? Why have we humbled ourselves, and you have not noticed?’ “Yet on the day of your fasting, you do as you please and exploit all your workers.

source: Veuvin, nanghon kinahnale kinelnan, chule gitlouna khut tuma kisuhto nan an na ngoluve. Chunglama na aw kijahna dinga, tunia banga hi an na ngol loudingu ahi.
target: Your fasting ends in quarreling and strife, and in striking each other with wicked fists. You cannot fast as you do today and expect your voice to be heard on high.

source: Keiman kalhen chu hitobang an ngol hi hija ham? mikhatnin ahinkho asuhgentheiding nikho chu hibanghi hia ham? Lekha phaipheng banga alu kun-a, anoija khaodip pon le vut pha chu an ngol kiti theija ham? Chule hichu Pakai dinga santhei nikho hiding hinam?
target: Is this the kind of fast I have chosen, only a day for people to humble themselves? Is it only for bowing one’s head like a reed and for lying in sackcloth and ashes? Is that what you call a fast, a day acceptable to the Lord ?

source: Keiman kanalhen an-ngolchu hitihi hilouham? Khansetna-a kikanho lhaplhah ding, pohgih poho doplhah ding, suhgentheija umho jalensah ding, namkoljon tincheng suhboh dinghi hilouham?
target: “Is not this the kind of fasting I have chosen: to loose the chains of injustice and untie the cords of the yoke, to set the oppressed free and break every yoke?

source: Agil kelho nachanglhah nahoppeh-a, genthei inna kon kikaidoh ho na-inna napuilut ding hilouham? asagoh-a um namuteng pon nasilpeh-a, nangma tahsa tobang neiho-a kona nakiselmanglou chu hilouham?
target: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter— when you see the naked, to clothe them, and not to turn away from your own flesh and blood?

source: Chutengle jingkah bangin navah kikhodoh-in tin, nadamtheina gangtah-in hung kilang doh-intin, nachon phatna namasanga chentin, Pakai loupina chu nanungdal hiding ahi.
target: Then your light will break forth like the dawn, and your healing will quickly appear; then your righteousness will go before you, and the glory of the Lord will be your rear guard.

source: Chuteng nangin kouvin natin, Pakaiyin nahouding, nangin samin natin, aman hikoma kaume atiding ahi. Nangin nalah uva kona namkoljon le khutjunga kikotona, chule pannabei thu kisei nalah manga;
target: Then you will call, and the Lord will answer; you will cry for help, and he will say: Here am I. “If you do away with the yoke of oppression, with the pointing finger and malicious talk,

source: Nahinna chu agilkelte henga nabuh lhah-a, akibol gentheiho nalung lhaisah leh, navah chu athimlah-a vahdoh intin, navela muthim jong sunlai bangding ahi.
target: and if you spend yourselves in behalf of the hungry and satisfy the needs of the oppressed, then your light will rise in the darkness, and your night will become like the noonday.

source: Chule Pakaiyin tanglouvin puijin natin, nahinna chu gamgo laija jong lunglhaijintin, naguho athaosah ding: nangma twi kichapnou jing honsung bangin natin, twinah banga atuichu kanglou ding ahi,
target: The Lord will guide you always; he will satisfy your needs in a sun-scorched land and will strengthen your frame. You will be like a well-watered garden, like a spring whose waters never fail.

source: chule nangma-a hidingho chun munsesa luiho chu sephaovintin, khang tamtah-a inbul kiphut chu natundoh ding ahin; nangchu aselai semphapa, chena ding lampiho semphapa nakitiding nahi.
target: Your people will rebuild the ancient ruins and will raise up the age-old foundations; you will be called Repairer of Broken Walls, Restorer of Streets with Dwellings.

source: Nangin nakeng chu cholngah nikho kanitheng ni-a nadeilam bolna dinga kona naheimanga; cholngah nichu kipani nati-a, Pakaiya atheng chu ja-uma nagela, ama najabola, nangma nopna lam bolouva, nangma nopsahna dinglam holouva, nangma thu seilouva na-umle:
target: “If you keep your feet from breaking the Sabbath and from doing as you please on my holy day, if you call the Sabbath a delight and the Lord ’s holy day honorable, and if you honor it by not going your own way and not doing as you please or speaking idle words,

source: Pakaiyah kipah-in natin, leichung munsang ho-a chun tousah ingting; napa Jacob gou lo-a chu kavahding nahi. Ajehchu Pakai kamin hichu aseidoh ahitai.
target: then you will find your joy in the Lord , and I will cause you to ride in triumph on the heights of the land and to feast on the inheritance of your father Jacob.” The mouth of the Lord has spoken.

source: Veuvin, Pakai khutchun mi ahuhhing joulou dingin akisuchompon; anakhang jong kho ajah theilouna dingin angong hih hele.
target: Surely the arm of the Lord is not too short to save, nor his ear too dull to hear.

source: Ahinla nakhansetnao chun nanghole na Pathen'u kikah-a nachomkhenu ahin, nachonset nao chun ajahlouna dinga nangho-a kona amai asel ahibouve.
target: But your iniquities have separated you from your God; your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.

source: Ajehchu nakhut hou thisanna, chule nakhut junghou khansetna-a kisuboh-ah ahitai; namuh-un thujou aseijin, naleigui uvin jong thukaleh jeng asodoh jin ahi.
target: For your hands are stained with blood, your fingers with guilt. Your lips have spoken falsely, and your tongue mutters wicked things.

source: Koiman adihtah aseipon, koima thutah dinpi aumpoi. Amahon ahomkeo atahsanun, thujou aseijuve. Amahon umchan phalou avopmun, khansetna ahin jiuve.
target: No one calls for justice; no one pleads a case with integrity. They rely on empty arguments, they utter lies; they conceive trouble and give birth to evil.

source: Amahon gulse tui a-opkeuvun, maimom pan akhongjiuve; hiche tui nechanchu athijin, akikhedoh penpen chu gulse-in akeujiuve.
target: They hatch the eggs of vipers and spin a spider’s web. Whoever eats their eggs will die, and when one is broken, an adder is hatched.

source: Amompan ho chu ponsil sohdoh louding, athilbollu chu kihuina anei louheldiu ahi. Athilbol hou khansetna thilbol ahin, hunam thilbol chu akhutnuva um ahi.
target: Their cobwebs are useless for clothing; they cannot cover themselves with what they make. Their deeds are evil deeds, and acts of violence are in their hands.

source: Akengu thuphalou lama alhaijin, amaho thisan sonan akinojiuve. Angaitou chu suhmangna ngaito ahin, alampiuva gamnale manthah na aumme.
target: Their feet rush into sin; they are swift to shed innocent blood. They pursue evil schemes; acts of violence mark their ways.

source: Amahon chamna lampi ahepouvin, achele naova thudihtah aummong mongpoi. Amahon lampikon akisemun, chua che chanchun chamna ahet loudingu ahi.
target: The way of peace they do not know; there is no justice in their paths. They have turned them into crooked roads; no one who walks along them will know peace.

source: Hijeh chun thutah chu eihoa konin agamlan, thudih-in jong eipha joupouve. Eihon khovah ingah-un, ahinla muthim akimui, khovah khelin muthim lah joh-a ivahle taove.
target: So justice is far from us, and righteousness does not reach us. We look for light, but all is darkness; for brightness, but we walk in deep shadows.

source: Keihon mitcho bangin bang kachulun, mit neilou bangin kakimai lele uvin ahi. Janlai bangin sunlai tah-in kakipalun; mithiho bangin mungemsa laitah-a kaum jiuve.
target: Like the blind we grope along the wall, feeling our way like people without eyes. At midday we stumble as if it were twilight; among the strong, we are like the dead.

source: Vompi bangin kakitum letlut cheh-un, vakhuho bangin lhasetah-in kamao mao-uve, thutanna kangah-un, khatcha aumpoi. Huhhingna kangah-un, keiho-a kona gamlatah ahijoi.
target: We all growl like bears; we moan mournfully like doves. We look for justice, but find none; for deliverance, but it is far away.

source: Ajehchu kakhangit lounao namasanga apungcheh cheh-in, kachonsetnu hin eiphochen jiuvin ahi. Ajehchu suhkhelna hoto kaum khomun, kakhan setnao dolchu kakihetnun ahi;
target: For our offenses are many in your sight, and our sins testify against us. Our offenses are ever with us, and we acknowledge our iniquities:

source: Pakai douna-a chonkhelnale thujouva, ka Pathen uva kona chemangin, suhgenthei nale kidouna thuseijin, jouthu kalunguva kavopmun, kasodoh jiuve.
target: rebellion and treachery against the Lord , turning our backs on our God, inciting revolt and oppression, uttering lies our hearts have conceived.

source: Chule thutanna chu akinung chonin, thudih chu gamlatah-a adingtai. Thutah chu lamdunga alhupan, adih chu alut joutapoi.
target: So justice is driven back, and righteousness stands at a distance; truth has stumbled in the streets, honesty cannot enter.

source: Ahi, thutah chu athonjin, aphalouva kona kikangse chu anchah-in apangjitai. Hichu Pakaiyin amun, thudih tanna himhim umlou chun alung phamotan ahi.
target: Truth is nowhere to be found, and whoever shuns evil becomes a prey. The Lord looked and was displeased that there was no justice.

source: Chuin mi aumlouhel chu amun, midinga taopeh abeihel chu adatmo lheh-e, hijeh chun abantenin huhhingna apohpeh-in; ama chonphatna chun adinsahtai.
target: He saw that there was no one, he was appalled that there was no one to intervene; so his own arm achieved salvation for him, and his own righteousness sustained him.

source: Hichechun aman chonphatna ompho bangin akivonin, alua huhhingna lukhuh akhuh-in, phulahna ponin akivonin, tompanna chu sangkhol chollin aki ah-e.
target: He put on righteousness as his breastplate, and the helmet of salvation on his head; he put on the garments of vengeance and wrapped himself in zeal as in a cloak.

source: Anatoh-u dungjuijin kibang tah-in lethuh unte, akidoupiho chu lungsat na-in, amelmate lethuh inte, twikol gamhojong lethuhna-in lethuh inte.
target: According to what they have done, so will he repay wrath to his enemies and retribution to his foes; he will repay the islands their due.

source: Kichaovintin, chutia chun amahon lhumlama konin Pakai minchu, chule nisolama kona aloupisah diu ahi. Melma chu twisoh banga ahung kondoh tengle chuche douna-a Pakai lhagao chun ponlap khat atundoh ding ahi.
target: From the west, people will fear the name of the Lord , and from the rising of the sun, they will revere his glory. For he will come like a pent-up flood that the breath of the Lord drives along.

source: Chule lhatdampu chu Zion huhdoh dingle Jacob sunga suhkhelna-a kona kilete henga hungding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who repent of their sins,” declares the Lord .

source: Keidin vang hiche hi amahotoh kakitepna ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Nachunga um kalhagao chule nakamsunga kathuho chu, nachilhahte kama konle nachilhahte chilhahte kama kona jong tua pat atonsot ageija potdoh louding ahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says the Lord . “My Spirit, who is on you, will not depart from you, and my words that I have put in your mouth will always be on your lips, on the lips of your children and on the lips of their descendants—from this time on and forever,” says the Lord .

source: Thoudoh inlang Salvah tan; ajehchu navah chu ahunge, Pakai loupi chu nachunga ahungsohtai.
target: “Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the Lord rises upon you.

source: Ajehchu ven, muthimin leiset ahinkhu-a, muthim lhangkhal in amite ahinkhu ding; hijongle nachunga Pakai chu hungsohdoh-intin, aloupina chu nachunga hungkilang ding ahi.
target: See, darkness covers the earth and thick darkness is over the peoples, but the Lord rises upon you and his glory appears over you.

source: Chule chidang namdangte chu navah-a hungun tin, chule lengho navah dohna vah-em lama hungdiu ahi.
target: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn.

source: Khodah inlang vekimvel temin, chule vechenin; akichom khomun, nahenga ahunguve. Nachapate gamlatah-a konin hunguntin, nachanute chu nakoma kijending ahiuve.
target: “Lift up your eyes and look about you: All assemble and come to you; your sons come from afar, and your daughters are carried on the hip.

source: Chuteng nangin munatin, hicheho chu thakhatnin hungsoh doh inte. Chule nalungsung kicha-a, suhjaova umding ahi. Ajehchu twikhanglen ninglhina chu nahenga hungding, chidang namdangte hatna chun nahinphah ding ahi.
target: Then you will look and be radiant, your heart will throb and swell with joy; the wealth on the seas will be brought to you, to you the riches of the nations will come.

source: Sangongsao tamtah le, Midian le Ephah gam sangongsao golbepho chun nahinlonvuh ding ahin; abonuva Sheba-a kona hungdiu ahin, amahon sanale gimnamtui ahinchoidiu; abonuva Pakai loupina chu atahlangdiu ahi.
target: Herds of camels will cover your land, young camels of Midian and Ephah. And all from Sheba will come, bearing gold and incense and proclaiming the praise of the Lord .

source: Kedar te gancha honho jouse nahenga hung kichom khomuntin; Nebaioth kelngoichal hon najendiu ahi. Amahochu ka-maicham chunga santhei doltah-a hungtou uva, chule ka loupina in chu kachoi-at ding ahi.
target: All Kedar’s flocks will be gathered to you, the rams of Nebaioth will serve you; they will be accepted as offerings on my altar, and I will adorn my glorious temple.

source: Meilhang banga lengle-a, vakhuho banga abangkot dunguva lengle-a hichehohi koi hiuvaham?
target: “Who are these that fly along like clouds, like doves to their nests?

source: Aman loupina-a nachoi-at tahjeh-in, Pakai na Pathen mindingle, Israel mithengpa ding jala nachapate chu adangka hou le asana houtoh gamlatah-a kona puidinga, thonlouhela twikol gamhon einga dingu ahin, Tarshish konglen ho chu masapen dingu ahi.
target: Surely the islands look to me; in the lead are the ships of Tarshish, bringing your children from afar, with their silver and gold, to the honor of the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, for he has endowed you with splendor.

source: Chule gamdangmi chapaten nakul banghou hinsa doh-uvintin, chule alenghouvin jong nangma najendiu ahitai. Ajehchu kalunghana-a kajep nahin, hijeng jongle khohsah na-a nachunga kanahepi nahi.
target: “Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you. Though in anger I struck you, in favor I will show you compassion.

source: Hijeh chun miten chidang namdangte thaneina chu nahenga ahinpoh lutnuva, alenghou ahinpui theina diuvin nakotpiho tanglouvin kihong intin, sunle jana kikhah louhel ding ahiuve.
target: Your gates will always stand open, they will never be shut, day or night, so that people may bring you the wealth of the nations— their kings led in triumphal procession.

source: Ajehchu nangma jenlou ding nam le lenggam chu mangthah diu ahin; henge, hiche namho chu mahthah helding ahiuve.
target: For the nation or kingdom that will not serve you will perish; it will be utterly ruined.

source: Kamun theng jephoina dinga Lebanon loupina chu nahenga hunglhunga, chahthing, phanthing, meila thingho kehkhoma, kakeng ngapna munchu loupina-a kaki choi-atna ding ahi.
target: “The glory of Lebanon will come to you, the juniper, the fir and the cypress together, to adorn my sanctuary; and I will glorify the place for my feet.
