source: Nabolgenthei ho chapate nahenga kun uva, i-nasahlouho jousechu nakengto noija hungkun uva chibai nabohdiu ahi. Amahon Pakai khopi Israel mithengpa Zion chu nangma nahi, atidiu ahi.
target: The children of your oppressors will come bowing before you; all who despise you will bow down at your feet and will call you the City of the Lord , Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

source: Koiman nahin jotpa lou khopma dalhahle hotna nana um ahin, tonsot chungnunna khangtamtah kipana-a kasemding nahi.
target: “Although you have been forsaken and hated, with no one traveling through, I will make you the everlasting pride and the joy of all generations.

source: Nangin chidang namdangte noitwi jong nachepma, lengho noijong nachep ding ahi. Nangin keima Pakai chu nahuhhingpa le nalhatdohpa Jacob mihatpa kahichu nahetding ahi,
target: You will drink the milk of nations and be nursed at royal breasts. Then you will know that I, the Lord , am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

source: keiman sum-eng khela sana, thih khela dangka, thing khela sum-eng chule songho khela thih kahinpohlutpeh-a, navaipo te jong chamna kapeh-a, navaihom te chonphatna kapeh ding ahi.
target: Instead of bronze I will bring you gold, and silver in place of iron. Instead of wood I will bring you bronze, and iron in place of stones. I will make peace your governor and well-being your ruler.

source: Nagamsunga thuse kija louding, chule nagamgi sunga gamna le suhmangna kijalouhel ding ahitai. Nangin nakulbang ho chu huhhingna ahin, nakotpiho chu pachatna ahi, nahin tiding ahi.
target: No longer will violence be heard in your land, nor ruin or destruction within your borders, but you will call your walls Salvation and your gates Praise.

source: Sun teng nisa chu navah-a pangchom talouva, vahdinga lhathah-in jong vah napehchom louding ahitai. Ahinla Pakai chu natonsot vah leh na Pathen loupina-a pangding ahitai.
target: The sun will no more be your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon shine on you, for the Lord will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.

source: Na nisa lhumtalouhel ding, na lhathah mangtalouhel ding ahi. Ajehchu Pakai chu natonsot vah hija, nalunghemna nikhoho kichaisoh ding ahitai.
target: Your sun will never set again, and your moon will wane no more; the Lord will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will end.

source: Namite jouse michonpha hiuvintin, atonsotna gamsung alodingu ahin, choi-atna kaum theina dinga amahochu kathingphu bah kakhutsoh chu hiuva ahi.
target: Then all your people will be righteous and they will possess the land forever. They are the shoot I have planted, the work of my hands, for the display of my splendor.

source: Lhom chakhat chu sangkhat hungsoh intin, aneucha khat chu nam hattah khat hunghi ding ahi. Keima Pakaiyin aphatcha kalhunsah loiding ahi.
target: The least of you will become a thousand, the smallest a mighty nation. I am the Lord ; in its time I will do this swiftly.”

source: Pakai Pathen lhagao chu kachunga aume; ajehchu Pakaiyin milung nengte henga kipana thupha seiphong dinga thao einu ahin; lungna teho suhdampeh dinga eisol ahi, sohchangte henga chamlen nathu lhangsam ding, chule sohchang ho henga songkul kihondoh thu hillhang dinga eisol ahin,
target: The Spirit of the Sovereign Lord is on me, because the Lord has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim freedom for the captives and release from darkness for the prisoners,

source: Pakai santhei kumle, i Pathen'u phulah nikho hillhanga, alunghemte jouse lhamonsah dinga;
target: to proclaim the year of the Lord ’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,

source: Zion'a lunghemte henga lhamonsahna, vut khella hoina, lunghemna khella kipana thaotwi, lhagao pohgih khella pachatna ponsil pe dinga, hitia chu amaho Pathen thingphu, chonphatna thingphung tia akikouna diu, hitia chu ama choi-atna amutheina dinga eihinsol ahi.
target: and provide for those who grieve in Zion— to bestow on them a crown of beauty instead of ashes, the oil of joy instead of mourning, and a garment of praise instead of a spirit of despair. They will be called oaks of righteousness, a planting of the Lord for the display of his splendor.

source: Chule amahon agamlui sesao asah phatnuva, masanga akamhelsa atundoh kitdiu, chule khopi gamsaho khangtamtah-a kamhelsa asemphat dingu ahi.
target: They will rebuild the ancient ruins and restore the places long devastated; they will renew the ruined cities that have been devastated for generations.

source: Chule gamdangmi hung kipatdoh uva nakelngoi honnu avah uva, gamdangmi chapate chu nalou kaijule nalengpilei lhouvuva hungpang ding ahiuve.
target: Strangers will shepherd your flocks; foreigners will work your fields and vineyards.

source: Ahinla nangho Pakai thempuho nakisah uva, mihon Pathen kinbolho natidiu ahin; nanghon chidang namdangte haona naneh uva, aloupinao chu nakisonpi diu ahi.
target: And you will be called priests of the Lord , you will be named ministers of our God. You will feed on the wealth of nations, and in their riches you will boast.

source: Najachat nao khella ajatni namudiu, chule lungnoh phah khella achanuva kipahdiu ahin, hijeh-a chu agamsung uva chu chan nijen alodiu, achunguva tonsot kipana umding ahi.
target: Instead of your shame you will receive a double portion, and instead of disgrace you will rejoice in your inheritance. And so you will inherit a double portion in your land, and everlasting joy will be yours.

source: Ajehchu Pakai keima hin thutah kangailun, govam thilto dinga thil kichom kimangcha kathen; chule dihtah-a anatoh-u lamkai jingting, amahotoh tonsot kitepna kasemding ahi.
target: “For I, the Lord , love justice; I hate robbery and wrongdoing. In my faithfulness I will reward my people and make an everlasting covenant with them.

source: Chule achilhahteu chu chidang namdangte lah-a hetna uma, chule achateu chu mipite lah-a hetdoh-a umdingu ahi. Amaho mujousen amaho ahetkhendiu, hitia chu Pakai phatthei boh chilhahte hidiu ahi.
target: Their descendants will be known among the nations and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge that they are a people the Lord has blessed.”

source: Keima Pakaiya hapan kipah ingting, kahinna ka Pathen'a kipah inte. Ajehchu aman huhhingna pon eisilpehtan, moulang akijep bangle, mounu sana vona akivon bangin aman chonphatna ponlenin eihuije.
target: I delight greatly in the Lord ; my soul rejoices in my God. For he has clothed me with garments of salvation and arrayed me in a robe of his righteousness, as a bridegroom adorns his head like a priest, and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

source: Ajehchu leisetnin apahmum ahinsodoh bangle, honin asunga thil kituho adondohsah banga, hitia chu Pakai Pathen'in chonphatna le vahchoina namjouse masanga ahinsepdoh ding ahi.
target: For as the soil makes the sprout come up and a garden causes seeds to grow, so the Sovereign Lord will make righteousness and praise spring up before all nations.

source: Ajehchu chonphatna chu vah banga asodoh-a, huhhingna chu meivah banga akondoh masangsen, Zion jal-in umthimbeh pongting, chule Jerusalem jallin cholnga ponge.
target: For Zion’s sake I will not keep silent, for Jerusalem’s sake I will not remain quiet, till her vindication shines out like the dawn, her salvation like a blazing torch.

source: Chule chidang namdang ten nachon phatna, leng jousen naloupina amuteidiu, chule nangma Pakai kama kisah minthah khatna nakikou ding ahi.
target: The nations will see your vindication, and all kings your glory; you will be called by a new name that the mouth of the Lord will bestow.

source: Nangma Pakai khutna loupina lal lukhuh leh, na Pathen khutna leng lukhuh jong nahi ding ahi.
target: You will be a crown of splendor in the Lord ’s hand, a royal diadem in the hand of your God.

source: Nangma akidalha naki tikit talou ding, nagam jong agohkeo kitikit talouhel ding ahi. Ahinla nangma Hephzi-bah nakisah-a, chule nagam Beulah kisah ding ahi. Ajehchu Pakai nangma chunga akipah-in, chule nagam chu hung jineiding ahi.
target: No longer will they call you Deserted, or name your land Desolate. But you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for the Lord will take delight in you, and your land will be married.

source: Ajehchu gollhangin nungah theng khat akichenpi banga, hitia chu nachapaten nahin kichenpi diu ahin; chule moulang mounu chunga akipa banga hita chu na Pathen nachunga kipahding ahi.
target: As a young man marries a young woman, so will your Builder marry you; as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so will your God rejoice over you.

source: Vo Jerusalem, nakulbang ho chunga khongah ho kakoije, amahon sunle jana thiptih aneiloudingu, Pakai geldoh jinga nangho thip hih helun.
target: I have posted watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem; they will never be silent day or night. You who call on the Lord , give yourselves no rest,

source: Aman Jerusalem atundoh-a, leisetna phatthei chang khatna asemdoh kahsen, kicholdosah hihhelun.
target: and give him no rest till he establishes Jerusalem and makes her the praise of the earth.

source: Pakai chu akhutjetlam leh aban thahatnin akihahseltai. Tahbeh-a nachang chu namelmate an dinga kapehkit tahlou ding ahi, chule gamdang mi chapaten natohgim ga lengpitwi chu adonloudiu ahi.
target: The Lord has sworn by his right hand and by his mighty arm: “Never again will I give your grain as food for your enemies, and never again will foreigners drink the new wine for which you have toiled;

source: Ahinla alhoh khom hon hichu aneh uva, Pakai chu avahchoidiu ahin, chule ahin pokhom hon kathenna in hongsunga adondiu ahi.
target: but those who harvest it will eat it and praise the Lord , and those who gather the grapes will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary.”

source: Jotpaijun, kotpiho chu jotpaijun; mipi ho lampi gontohpeh uvin; dipsangun, dipsangun lamlhongpi chu; song hochu loh doh-un, mipidin ponlap khat domsangun.
target: Pass through, pass through the gates! Prepare the way for the people. Build up, build up the highway! Remove the stones. Raise a banner for the nations.

source: Veuvin, vannoi leiset kolmong geijin Pakaiyin ahillhangtai. Nanghon Zion chanu jah-a seijun ven, nahuhhingna ahung lhungtai; vetan, atohphat man le anatoh ahin kengin a-anga aume.
target: The Lord has made proclamation to the ends of the earth: “Say to Daughter Zion, ‘See, your Savior comes! See, his reward is with him, and his recompense accompanies him.’ ”

source: Chule amahon amaho chu mithengho Pakai lhatdamsate atidiu, chule nangma holdohsa, dalhahlou khopi khat kitiding nahi.
target: They will be called the Holy People, the Redeemed of the Lord ; and you will be called Sought After, the City No Longer Deserted.

source: Edom'a kona hungpa Bozrah-a kona ponsandup kisila hungahi koiham? Akivon na loupi tah, thahatna nasatah banga hunga chu, Keima chonphatna-a thuseija, huhhingna dinga hattah chu kahi.
target: Who is this coming from Edom, from Bozrah, with his garments stained crimson? Who is this, robed in splendor, striding forward in the greatness of his strength? “It is I, proclaiming victory, mighty to save.”

source: Ipidinga naponsil hitisan hija; chule naponsil chu lengpithei chilpa-a tobanga ham?
target: Why are your garments red, like those of one treading the winepress?

source: Keiman kachangin lengpithei kachillin, miholah-a khatchan eihupoi. Ajehchu amaho chu kalunghana-a kachotpha-a, chule kalungsatna-a kachil ngem ding; athisannu kaponsil ho-a kithekhuma, kavon jouse-a kasuhmat ding ahi.
target: “I have trodden the winepress alone; from the nations no one was with me. I trampled them in my anger and trod them down in my wrath; their blood spattered my garments, and I stained all my clothing.

source: Ajeh chu phulahna nikho chu kalunga uma ahin, kalhatdam kum chu ahung lhunge.
target: It was for me the day of vengeance; the year for me to redeem had come.

source: Chuin keiman kaven, eipanpi ding koimacha aumpon, eikai ding ding koimacha aumlou chu kalungdonge: hijeh chun kakhut tah-in keima dingin huhhingna eihin pohpeh-in, kalunghan na chun eikaiding tai.
target: I looked, but there was no one to help, I was appalled that no one gave support; so my own arm achieved salvation for me, and my own wrath sustained me.

source: Chule kalung hana-in miho chotphang ting, kalunghan na-in amaho khamsah ingting, ahatnau tolsena kanei ding ahi.
target: I trampled the nations in my anger; in my wrath I made them drunk and poured their blood on the ground.”

source: Ichunguva Pakai thilpeh jouse dungjuile, Israel insung mite dinga aphatna nasatah dungjuija, amihepina dungjuija athilpeh ho jalleh, ami lungset phatna ho jallin; keiman Pakai lungset phatna chu seijing ting, Pakai vahchoina thu kaseiding ahi.
target: I will tell of the kindnesses of the Lord , the deeds for which he is to be praised, according to all the Lord has done for us— yes, the many good things he has done for Israel, according to his compassion and many kindnesses.

source: Ajehchu aman aseije, amahohi keima mite mongmong, chule jouloubeh ding chate ahiuve, ati. Chutichun ama amaho huhhingpu anahi.
target: He said, “Surely they are my people, children who will be true to me”; and so he became their Savior.

source: Amaho kibol gimna channa ama jong kibolgimji ahin, a-anga um vantil chun amaho ahuhhing tai. Aman angailutna leh akhotona-in amaho chu alhatdoh-in; aman khangluilai jousen amaho avopmin, apolen ahi.
target: In all their distress he too was distressed, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and mercy he redeemed them; he lifted them up and carried them all the days of old.

source: Ahinla amahon adouvun, alhagao theng chu ana lungphatmosah-ui. Hijeh chun ama amaho melmadin ahung kihei doh-in, amatah-in amaho akisatpitai.
target: Yet they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. So he turned and became their enemy and he himself fought against them.

source: Chuphatnin aman khanglui lai, Mosi le amite ageldoh-in, twikhanglen'a kona akelngoihon chingpatoh puidohpa chu hoija umham? asunga A-Lhagao Theng khumpeh pachu hoija umtam?
target: Then his people recalled the days of old, the days of Moses and his people— where is he who brought them through the sea, with the shepherd of his flock? Where is he who set his Holy Spirit among them,

source: Loupitah-a Mosi khut jetlama amaho puilea, tonsot amin aumjing nadinga amasanguva twipi sukhenpa hoilam ham?
target: who sent his glorious arm of power to be at Moses’ right hand, who divided the waters before them, to gain for himself everlasting renown,

source: Amaho akipal louna dinguva gamthip laija sakol banga twi thuhtah laija puigalkai pa hoiba hitam?
target: who led them through the depths? Like a horse in open country, they did not stumble;

source: Phaichama gancha kumsuh bangin, Pakai lhagaovin ama acholdosah-in; chutichun namin loupina dingin namite nakaihoijin ahi.
target: like cattle that go down to the plain, they were given rest by the Spirit of the Lord . This is how you guided your people to make for yourself a glorious name.

source: Van'a konin hinvesuh inlang, chule nathen nale naloupina umna mun'a konin hinven; natompan nale nagunchuna keidinga nalainatnale nahepina hoi hitam? kituhtanga hitaovam?
target: Look down from heaven and see, from your lofty throne, holy and glorious. Where are your zeal and your might? Your tenderness and compassion are withheld from us.

source: Abraham'in eihe hih-u henlang, Israel'in eihehih jongleu, nangma kapau nahi-e. Vo Pakai nang kapau eilhandampu nahi; naminhi a-itih-a patna umjing ahi.
target: But you are our Father, though Abraham does not know us or Israel acknowledge us; you, Lord , are our Father, our Redeemer from of old is your name.

source: Vo Pakai ibolla nalampi ho-a kona nei chekhel sah uva, nangma kakichatna diuva kona neilungtah sah-u ham? nagoulo phungho, nasohte jal-in hungkiletan.
target: Why, Lord , do you make us wander from your ways and harden our hearts so we do not revere you? Return for the sake of your servants, the tribes that are your inheritance.

source: Nathenna miten hichu chomcha khatbou aneijun; kakidoupi teovin namun thengchu achotpha taove.
target: For a little while your people possessed your holy place, but now our enemies have trampled down your sanctuary.

source: Keiho nanga kahiuvin, amaho chunga vai nahom khapoi; amaho namina kikou ahipouve.
target: We are yours from of old; but you have not ruled over them, they have not been called by your name.

source: Molsang jouse chu na-angsunga twi lonna alonlhah suh theina dinga, O nangin van ho chu nasatella, nahung kumlhah nom hileh,
target: Oh, that you would rend the heavens and come down, that the mountains would tremble before you!

source: nakidoupi ho namin hetsahna dingle, na angsunga namtin kithingthinga aumna diuva, meijin akahjola akonbanga, meijin twi asousah bangin!
target: As when fire sets twigs ablaze and causes water to boil, come down to make your name known to your enemies and cause the nations to quake before you!

source: Kakinep pilouvu tijat umtah thil naboltengle, nahung kumlhajin na-angsunga molsang ho alonglha jeng jiuve.
target: For when you did awesome things that we did not expect, you came down, and the mountains trembled before you.

source: Ajehchu vannoi kipatna pat nangma tailou Pathen dang, ama ngah ho dinga natonga; mihemin aja khapon, nakhangin jong ajahkhapon, mitnin jong amukhapoi.
target: Since ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides you, who acts on behalf of those who wait for him.

source: Kipahtah-a uma chonphatna bolpa, nangma hejing puma nalampi jotpa nakimupin, vetan, kachonset jeh-un, nalung ahangin, chuho-a chun kaum jom jingun, huhhing kahidiu ahi.
target: You come to the help of those who gladly do right, who remember your ways. But when we continued to sin against them, you were angry. How then can we be saved?

source: Ahinla kabonun thilboh kabang sohkeijun, kachon phatna jouse jong ponsenen bangbou ahin, kabon chaovin nathel bangin kamol lhaovin, kakhanset naovin huibangin eilhohmang gamtaove.
target: All of us have become like one who is unclean, and all our righteous acts are like filthy rags; we all shrivel up like a leaf, and like the wind our sins sweep us away.

source: Chule namin panna nangma kolchah dinga kitilkhouva khatcha aumtapoi, ajehchu keiho-a konin namai naselin; kakhan setnao jeh-in neisumangtaovin ahi.
target: No one calls on your name or strives to lay hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us and have given us over to our sins.

source: Ahinla tun, vo Pakai, nangma kapao nahin; keiho bel kiden na leiset kahiuvin, nangma beldengpa nahi; chule keiho kabonun nang khutsoh jeng kahiuve.
target: Yet you, Lord , are our Father. We are the clay, you are the potter; we are all the work of your hand.

source: Vo Pakai, lunghang behseh hih-in, khanset najong tonsotnin geldoh jinghih-in; ngaijin, vetemin, kangeh-u nahi, keiho namite jeng kahiuve.
target: Do not be angry beyond measure, Lord ; do not remember our sins forever. Oh, look on us, we pray, for we are all your people.

source: Nakhopi thengho gamthip asohgamin, Zion jong gamthip ahin, Jerusalem jong akamheltai.
target: Your sacred cities have become a wasteland; even Zion is a wasteland, Jerusalem a desolation.

source: Kapu kapa teovin nangma navahchoi nao ka-inthenghou leh ka inhoi houjong meijin akavam gamtan; kathildeihou jouse jong manlou asoh gamtai.
target: Our holy and glorious temple, where our ancestors praised you, has been burned with fire, and all that we treasured lies in ruins.

source: Vo Pakai, hicheho-a dingahi nangma nakitim ding hinam, nangma nathip beh-a, neisuhgenthei teitei diuham?
target: After all this, Lord , will you hold yourself back? Will you keep silent and punish us beyond measure?

source: Kahenga thumlou hon eiholun, eihol louhon eimuve; kamina kikoulouhel nam mite henga chun, neiveuvin, neiveuvin, kati.
target: “I revealed myself to those who did not ask for me; I was found by those who did not seek me. To a nation that did not call on my name, I said, ‘Here am I, here am I.’

source: Amaho lunggella achona lampi phalou houva vahlea, doupanho chunga chun kakhut kajah nilhum lhumjin ahi;
target: All day long I have held out my hands to an obstinate people, who walk in ways not good, pursuing their own imaginations—

source: Tanglouva lung hansah dinga kamaija eilung phatmo sah-a; honsunga kithoija, chehsong maicham chunga gimnamtui hal mite;
target: a people who continually provoke me to my very face, offering sacrifices in gardens and burning incense on altars of brick;

source: Lhanho lah-a umdena, songko sung ho-a geh-a, vohsa ne-a, Abel sunguva thet umtah satwi kitunna;
target: who sit among the graves and spend their nights keeping secret vigil; who eat the flesh of pigs, and whose pots hold broth of impure meat;

source: Nachang seh-in dingin, neihin nai hih-in; ajehchu keima nang sangin kathengjoi, tiho chu ahiuve. Hicheho chu kanahko homsunga meikhu jing ahiuvin, nilhumkeija kongjing meikou ahiuve.
target: who say, ‘Keep away; don’t come near me, for I am too sacred for you!’ Such people are smoke in my nostrils, a fire that keeps burning all day.

source: Veuvin, hichehi kamasanga akisune: Thipbeh in umponge. Ahinla lethuh ingting, a-opkong sungtah uva kalethuh ding ahi.
target: “See, it stands written before me: I will not keep silent but will pay back in full; I will pay it back into their laps—

source: Nakhanset naole napu napateu khansetna agoma, molsang ho chunga gimnamtui ahal uva, lhangho chunga eitaitomu ahin, hijeh-a chu anatoh masah hou chu a-opkong sunguva katepeh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: both your sins and the sins of your ancestors,” says the Lord . “Because they burned sacrifices on the mountains and defied me on the hills, I will measure into their laps the full payment for their former deeds.”

source: Pakaiyin hitin ati, lengpiga lomlah-a kon lengpitwi akimu bangin, mikhat touvin asungahi phattheina aumjeh-in sumang hih-un ati banga: chutobanga chu kasohte jala abonchauva kasuhmang louding ahiuve.
target: This is what the Lord says: “As when juice is still found in a cluster of grapes and people say, ‘Don’t destroy it, there is still a blessing in it,’ so will I do in behalf of my servants; I will not destroy them all.

source: Chule keiman Jacob'a kona sonkhat, chule Judah'a kona kalhangtheng loding khat ka hinpuidoh ding; chule kamilhen hon hichu lovintin, chua kasohte chengden diu ahi.
target: I will bring forth descendants from Jacob, and from Judah those who will possess my mountains; my chosen people will inherit them, and there will my servants live.

source: Chule Sharon chu ganchahon dinga hongsung hintin, chule Achor phaicham chu ganchaho dinga kolna mun hiding; ajehchu keima eihola kamite jong chutobang ding ahi.
target: Sharon will become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds, for my people who seek me.

source: Ahinla nangho Pakai dalha-a, Ka molsang theng sumila, chuche sepaihon ho dinga dokhang gonpeh-a, chule chuche mijat ho donding thilpeh bulhitpeh nahiuve.
target: “But as for you who forsake the Lord and forget my holy mountain, who spread a table for Fortune and fill bowls of mixed wine for Destiny,

source: Hijeh chun chemjam'a kasimding nahiuvin, athatpa anga nakundiu ahi. Ajehchu kakoupetnin neihou pouvin, kahoupet un neingaipeh pouvin; ahinla kamitmun thilse nabol jouvin, keima deilou joh nakilhen taove.
target: I will destine you for the sword, and all of you will fall in the slaughter; for I called but you did not answer, I spoke but you did not listen. You did evil in my sight and chose what displeases me.”

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin ati, veuvin, kasohten anehdiu, nangho vang gilkela naum diu; veuvin, kasohten adonuva, nangho vang nadangchah diu ahi. Veuvin, kasohte kipah untin nangho vang najachatdiu ahi.
target: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: “My servants will eat, but you will go hungry; my servants will drink, but you will go thirsty; my servants will rejoice, but you will be put to shame.

source: Veuvin, kasohten lungsung kipa la saovintin, nangho vang gentheijeh-a nakadiu ahi. Chule lhagao bolsetjeh-a napenjah diu ahi.
target: My servants will sing out of the joy of their hearts, but you will cry out from anguish of heart and wail in brokenness of spirit.

source: Chule naminu chu kamilhendohpa henga sapsetna-a nadalhah diu ahi. Ajehchu Pakai pathen'in nangma natha-a, asohte minchoma akouding ahi.
target: You will leave your name for my chosen ones to use in their curses; the Sovereign Lord will put you to death, but to his servants he will give another name.

source: Leisetna amale ama phatthei kiboh-a chu, Pathen dihna-a amale ama phatthei kiboh ding ahin, chule leisetna kihahsela chu Pathen dihna-a kihahsel ding ahi. Ajehchu lungkhamna masaho akisumilin, chule kamitmu-a konin akisel mang taove.
target: Whoever invokes a blessing in the land will do so by the one true God; whoever takes an oath in the land will swear by the one true God. For the past troubles will be forgotten and hidden from my eyes.

source: Ajehchu veuvin, vanho leh leithah kasemin ahi. Chule thilmasa chu kiheta louhel ding, lunga jong langtalouhel ding ahi.
target: “See, I will create new heavens and a new earth. The former things will not be remembered, nor will they come to mind.

source: Ahinla kathilsema chun nangho a-itih-in halna in kipah unlang thanomun; ajehchu veuvin keiman Jerusalem chu kipa na-in, amite chu thanop na-in kasemtai.
target: But be glad and rejoice forever in what I will create, for I will create Jerusalem to be a delight and its people a joy.

source: Chule Jerusalem'a chun kipah ingting, chule kamite lah-a jong thanominge, Chule hia chu kana aw gin, penna aw gin jong kijalouding ahitai.
target: I will rejoice over Jerusalem and take delight in my people; the sound of weeping and of crying will be heard in it no more.

source: Chuteng chua chun naosen nikho lhomcha bou hinga leh tehse adamsung hin nikho lhinglouho umta ponte. Ajehchu chapang chu kum jakhatna thiding; ahinla michonse kum jatamtah hingho chu sapset chang hiding ahiuve.
target: “Never again will there be in it an infant who lives but a few days, or an old man who does not live out his years; the one who dies at a hundred will be thought a mere child; the one who fails to reach a hundred will be considered accursed.

source: Amahon inho saovintin, hiho-a chu chengdio, chule amahon lengpihon bolluntin, aga anehdingu ahi.
target: They will build houses and dwell in them; they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

source: In asah uva midang cheng talou ding; thingphung aphu uva midangin aneh tah louding: Ajehchu thingphung khat hinkho banga chu kamite hinkho jong hiding, kalhendohten akhut tah uva atohgao phatsotpi anopsahpidiu ahi.
target: No longer will they build houses and others live in them, or plant and others eat. For as the days of a tree, so will be the days of my people; my chosen ones will long enjoy the work of their hands.

source: Amahon moh-a atohgim loudiu, lungjina dingbepma jong cha ahinloudiu ahi, ajehchu amaho Pakai phattheiboh son ahiuvin, ason apah houtoh umkhoma ahiuve.
target: They will not labor in vain, nor will they bear children doomed to misfortune; for they will be a people blessed by the Lord , they and their descendants with them.

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi, amahon keima eikou masang uva kahouding, chule thu aseijing nahlai uva jong kajahpai ding ahitai.
target: Before they call I will answer; while they are still speaking I will hear.

source: Kamkeile kelngoinou lhakhoma, bongchal banga keipin changpol anehding, leivui chu gulho dinga sa hiding ahi. Kalhangtheng chung jouse-a chu amahon asukhah-u, asuhmangu umlou ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: The wolf and the lamb will feed together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox, and dust will be the serpent’s food. They will neither harm nor destroy on all my holy mountain,” says the Lord .

source: Pakaiyin hitihin aseije, vanhi kalaltouna ahin, leihi kakengto ngapna ahi. In nei sahpeh-u chu hoi ham? Kacholdona ding mun hoiba ham?
target: This is what the Lord says: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. Where is the house you will build for me? Where will my resting place be?

source: Ajehchu thiljouse chu kakhutna kasema, thiljouse chu uma ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ahivangin hiche migenthei pa, lungsung kisih-a kathua kihot hotpa bouhi kavet ding ahi.
target: Has not my hand made all these things, and so they came into being?” declares the Lord . “These are the ones I look on with favor: those who are humble and contrite in spirit, and who tremble at my word.

source: Bongchal thatpa chu mithat tobang ahin, kelngoinouva kithoipa chu ui ngong sattan tobang ahi; Pathen'a thilpeh toh-a chu vohcha thisan tobang ahin, gimnamtui halpa jong chu milim semthu pathen phattheiboh tobang ahi. Ahi, amahon alampidiu akilhenun, thet umtah ahinaova chun alungu akipah-in ahi.
target: But whoever sacrifices a bull is like one who kills a person, and whoever offers a lamb is like one who breaks a dog’s neck; whoever makes a grain offering is like one who presents pig’s blood, and whoever burns memorial incense is like one who worships an idol. They have chosen their own ways, and they delight in their abominations;

source: Keiman amaho bolgentheina lhenpeh ingting, chule achunguva akichatnao chuhsah inge, ajehchu kakoupetnin khatchan eidonbut pouvin, thu kaseipetnin angaipouve. Ahinla kamitmun thilse bou abollun, kakipana louhelbou akilhenuvin ahi.
target: so I also will choose harsh treatment for them and will bring on them what they dread. For when I called, no one answered, when I spoke, no one listened. They did evil in my sight and chose what displeases me.”

source: Pakai thuhi ngaijuvin, athua kithing thinga nangho, nasopiu nangho nahotbol houle keima min jeh-a nangho napaidoh hou chun, Pakai chu choisangin umhen tiuhen; ahinla ama nakipa naova hung kilah-in tin, chule amaho jahchajo ding ahiuve.
target: Hear the word of the Lord , you who tremble at his word: “Your own people who hate you, and exclude you because of my name, have said, ‘Let the Lord be glorified, that we may see your joy!’ Yet they will be put to shame.

source: Khopi-a kona husagin, houin'a kona husagin chu Pakai husagin ahin, amelmate lethuhna dinga Pakaiyin hiche chu asodoh ahi.
target: Hear that uproar from the city, hear that noise from the temple! It is the sound of the Lord repaying his enemies all they deserve.

source: Naosonat athoh masangin cha ahingin, anat thohgim masangin, naosen pasal khat ahingtai.
target: “Before she goes into labor, she gives birth; before the pains come upon her, she delivers a son.

source: Hitobang chu kon ajahkhah-a, hitobang chu kon amukhah-em? Leiset nikhat sunga kisemdoh-a, namkhat hi khatvei so-a sohjeng theijem? Ajehchu Zion hin naosonat athoh thoh-in achate ahingdoh jenge.
target: Who has ever heard of such things? Who has ever seen things like this? Can a country be born in a day or a nation be brought forth in a moment? Yet no sooner is Zion in labor than she gives birth to her children.

source: Pakaiyin cha kahindoh sah-a, kapen lhahsah louding ham? ati. Keiman kasolhah sahji ahin, naobu kakha-ji dingham? tin na Pathen'in aseije.
target: Do I bring to the moment of birth and not give delivery?” says the Lord . “Do I close up the womb when I bring to delivery?” says your God.

source: Nangho ama ngailu jousen Jerusalem kipa thanop piuvin lang, ama lunghempi nanghon halna-in kipa thanop piuvin.
target: “Rejoice with Jerusalem and be glad for her, all you who love her; rejoice greatly with her, all you who mourn over her.

source: Hitia chu nangho ama lunghempi ho jousen alhepbina noitwi chu nachep uva, nachim theina diuva, aloupi chamkimna lhingset chu nakipapi theina dingun, ati.
target: For you will nurse and be satisfied at her comforting breasts; you will drink deeply and delight in her overflowing abundance.”

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin ati, veuvin, amanu henga chamna vadung long banga, chule chidang namdangte loupina chu twilong banga kalonsah-a, chuteng nachep uva nangho amanu pangteni-a nakipoh uva, akhup chunga nakichop diu ahi.
target: For this is what the Lord says: “I will extend peace to her like a river, and the wealth of nations like a flooding stream; you will nurse and be carried on her arm and dandled on her knees.

source: Anun alhepbi mikhat banga hitia chu kalhepbiuva, Jerusalem'a lhamonga naum dingu ahitai.
target: As a mother comforts her child, so will I comfort you; and you will be comforted over Jerusalem.”

source: Hichehi namu tengule nalungu kipah-a, nagu nachang jouse jong hamhing banga nouding, Pakai khutchu asohte lama kilanga, alung himona amelmate chunga kilangding ahi.
target: When you see this, your heart will rejoice and you will flourish like grass; the hand of the Lord will be made known to his servants, but his fury will be shown to his foes.

source: Ajehchu vetan, Pakai chu meikong banga, huipi nung tobanga akangtalai ho puma, alunghana lungsatna sodoh dingle, aphosalna meikong banga hungding ahi.
target: See, the Lord is coming with fire, and his chariots are like a whirlwind; he will bring down his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin meile achemjama tahsahing jouse thu atanding, chule Pakai mitha chu tamtah hiding ahi.
target: For with fire and with his sword the Lord will execute judgment on all people, and many will be those slain by the Lord .

source: Amaho acham chama kisuthenga, chule honsung lailunga thingphung khat nunglama amale ama kisuthenga, vohsa phe thet umtah chule juchasa neho chu mangthah khomdingu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Those who consecrate and purify themselves to go into the gardens, following one who is among those who eat the flesh of pigs, rats and other unclean things—they will meet their end together with the one they follow,” declares the Lord .

source: Ajehchu athilbol houle alung ngaitohou kahenai, keiman namjousele paojouse kakhopkhoma, kaloupina amunadiuva hunglhung ding ahi.
target: “And I, because of what they have planned and done, am about to come and gather the people of all nations and languages, and they will come and see my glory.

source: Chutengle keiman alah uva melchihna khat koijing ting, chuleh alah uva asohcha hochu namtin vaipi keima minthan jakha louhel ho, kaloupina mukha loulaiho: Tarshish lam, Put lam, chule thalthem Lud lam ahin, Tubal leh Javan lam chule gamlatah twikol gamho geija kasolding ahiuve. Chuteng chule amahon chidang namdang lah-a kaloupina aphonjal dingu ahi.
target: “I will set a sign among them, and I will send some of those who survive to the nations—to Tarshish, to the Libyans and Lydians (famous as archers), to Tubal and Greece, and to the distant islands that have not heard of my fame or seen my glory. They will proclaim my glory among the nations.

source: Chule amahon, Israel chaten Pakai insunga lheng thengsel sunga thilto ahinchoi banguva, nasopiteu jouse Pakai henga thilto toh dinga namtina kona, sakol kangtalai chunga, talaija, sakol pol ho chunga, ganhing gangho chunga ka mol theng Jerusalem'a ahintollut dingu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: And they will bring all your people, from all the nations, to my holy mountain in Jerusalem as an offering to the Lord —on horses, in chariots and wagons, and on mules and camels,” says the Lord . “They will bring them, as the Israelites bring their grain offerings, to the temple of the Lord in ceremonially clean vessels.

source: Chule kenjong alah uva chu thempuho dingle, Levi ho ding kalhen ding ahi, tin, Pakaiyin aseije.
target: And I will select some of them also to be priests and Levites,” says the Lord .

source: Van thah hole leithah kasem dingchu kamasanga aumjing bangin, nasonhoule naminu chu umjing ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “As the new heavens and the new earth that I make will endure before me,” declares the Lord , “so will your name and descendants endure.

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi, lha ahungthah-a patna ahungthah kitchan, choldoni-a patna choldoni kit chan mijouse kamasanga keima hou dinga hung dingu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: From one New Moon to another and from one Sabbath to another, all mankind will come and bow down before me,” says the Lord .

source: Chutengle amaho chedoh uva, kachunga chonkhelna neiho thilong chu avetjing dingu ahi. Ajeh chu alungu thilouhel ding, ameikong jong mitlouhel ding, chule amaho tahsa hing jouse dinga kidah umtah hiding ahiuve.
target: “And they will go out and look on the dead bodies of those who rebelled against me; the worms that eat them will not die, the fire that burns them will not be quenched, and they will be loathsome to all mankind.”

source: Benjamin gamsunga Anathoth'a um thempuho lah-a Hilkiah chapa Jeremiah thuho,
target: The words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests at Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin.

source: Judah te leng Amon chapa Josiah nikholaija alengchan kal kum somle thumna in akoma Pakai thu ahung lhunge.
target: The word of the Lord came to him in the thirteenth year of the reign of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah,

source: Judah te leng Josiah chapa Jehoiakim nikholai jin jong, Judah te leng Josiah chapa Zedekiah kum somlekhat kichailam gei, Jerusalem gal hinga kikaimang lha nga lhinna geijin hiche thuhi ahung lhungin ahi.
target: and through the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, down to the fifth month of the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah, when the people of Jerusalem went into exile.

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu kakoma ahung lhungtan,
target: The word of the Lord came to me, saying,

source: Keiman nangma naobu sunga kasem masanga kanahetsa nahin, naobu-a kona nahung potdoh masanga kanasuh thengsa, chule namtin themgao dinga kapansah nahitai.
target: “Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, before you were born I set you apart; I appointed you as a prophet to the nations.”

source: Chuin keiman, kate, Pakai Pathen! ven, chapang kahi jeh-in, ima kasei theipoi katin ahi.
target: “Alas, Sovereign Lord ,” I said, “I do not know how to speak; I am too young.”

source: Ahinla Pakai chun, chapang kahi tihih-in, ajehchu keiman nangma kasolna jouse-a nache ding, keiman kathupeh chan naseidoh ding ahi, tin kajah-a aseitai.
target: But the Lord said to me, “Do not say, ‘I am too young.’ You must go to everyone I send you to and say whatever I command you.

source: Chuin aman, amaho mai khu kicha hih-in, ajehchu keiman nang huhdoh dingin kaumpi e, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you and will rescue you,” declares the Lord .

source: Chuin Pakai chun akhut alhangin, kamuh akhoije. Chuin Pakaiyin kajah-a, Ven, keiman kathuhohi nakam sungah kakhum luttai, tin aseije.
target: Then the Lord reached out his hand and touched my mouth and said to me, “I have put my words in your mouth.

source: Ven, tunia hi ajungho kaldoh dingle, aloilhu ding, asumang ding, asuchim ding, chule aphutdoh dinga namtin vaipihole lenggam ho chunga kapansah nahitai.
target: See, today I appoint you over nations and kingdoms to uproot and tear down, to destroy and overthrow, to build and to plant.”

source: Chukalvalin, Pakai thuchu kakoma ahung lhungin, Jeremiah, ipi namu em? eiti e, chuin keiman, Almond thing tenggol khat kamu e, katin ahi.
target: The word of the Lord came to me: “What do you see, Jeremiah?” “I see the branch of an almond tree,” I replied.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin kajah-a, namuchen lheh-e, ajehchu kathu tohdoh-a aumna dinga kavetlhih jing ahi, ati.
target: The Lord said to me, “You have seen correctly, for I am watching to see that my word is fulfilled.”

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu aniveinan kakoma ahung lhungin, ipi namu em? eiti e, keiman bel soulahlah amai sahlam ngat khat kamui, tin kaseije.
target: The word of the Lord came to me again: “What do you see?” “I see a pot that is boiling,” I answered. “It is tilting toward us from the north.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin kajah-a, sahlama pat thilphalou khat hungpotnintin, gamsunga chengho jouse chunga hung chuding ahi, tin aseije.
target: The Lord said to me, “From the north disaster will be poured out on all who live in the land.

source: Ajehchu ven, keiman sahlam lenggam ho jouse kakou ding, amaho hung dingu, Jerusalem lutna kotpiho phungle akimvele kulbangho, chule Judah khopiho jouse douna-a alaltounao atundoh cheh dingu ahi, tin Pakai jin aseije.
target: I am about to summon all the peoples of the northern kingdoms,” declares the Lord . “Their kings will come and set up their thrones in the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem; they will come against all her surrounding walls and against all the towns of Judah.

source: Chule keiman, keima eidalhah uva pathen dangho houna-a gimnamtui ahalu, chule akhut uva kisemho joh ahou uva, agitlounau chunga thutanlhahna kanei ding ahi.
target: I will pronounce my judgments on my people because of their wickedness in forsaking me, in burning incense to other gods and in worshiping what their hands have made.

source: Hijeh chun, nangman nakong kigah-in, chule kipatdoh-in lang, keiman kathupeh jouse chu amaho lah-a seijin, a-angsung uva meidoi hih-in, achutiloule keiman amasanguva nangma kisuh dongsah get inge.
target: “Get yourself ready! Stand up and say to them whatever I command you. Do not be terrified by them, or I will terrify you before them.

source: Ijeh inam itile, ven, tunin keiman nangmahi kihuh dohna khopi kasema, chule thihkhompi, gamsung pumpi, Judah lengho, pipuiho, thempuho chule agam miteu douna sum-eng kulpi detna kasem nahitai.
target: Today I have made you a fortified city, an iron pillar and a bronze wall to stand against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests and the people of the land.

source: Amahon nangma nadou diu, hijongle najolou dingu ahi. Ajehchu nangma huhdoh dinga keiman kaumpi nahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: They will fight against you but will not overcome you, for I am with you and will rescue you,” declares the Lord .

source: Chukalvalin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, hitin aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Chenlang Jerusalem nakhanga gasamin, Pakaiyin hitin aseije; tin seijin; nakhangdon laija namikhotonale, najite nangailutna, lholou gama, gamthipma kanung najuilai chu kahe jinge.
target: “Go and proclaim in the hearing of Jerusalem: “This is what the Lord says: “ ‘I remember the devotion of your youth, how as a bride you loved me and followed me through the wilderness, through a land not sown.

source: Israel chu Pakaiya atheng ahin; Ama puntheina ga masaho anahi. Ama vallhum jouse themo changa; achunguva thilse chuding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Israel was holy to the Lord , the firstfruits of his harvest; all who devoured her were held guilty, and disaster overtook them,’ ” declares the Lord .

source: Vo Jacob insungle Israel insungho jouse, Pakai thuhi ngaitemun,
target: Hear the word of the Lord , you descendants of Jacob, all you clans of Israel.

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, napateu vin kagitlouna ipi amu uva, keija kona chegam lhaova, pannabei nung ajuijuva, pannabei soh-u hitam?
target: This is what the Lord says: “What fault did your ancestors find in me, that they strayed so far from me? They followed worthless idols and became worthless themselves.

source: Egypt gama kon eipuidoh uva, gamthip nelgam lhunga, nelgamle kokhuhho lah-a, gamgo gama, thina limnoi, koima chekhah lounale mihem chenlouna gam lhungkeija einapuihoi leuva Pakai chu hoijaba um hitam? tin jong aseipouve.
target: They did not ask, ‘Where is the Lord , who brought us up out of Egypt and led us through the barren wilderness, through a land of deserts and ravines, a land of drought and utter darkness, a land where no one travels and no one lives?’

source: Chule keiman nangho ninglhinna gam, chu-a gamga le aphatnaho nedingin kanapuilutnin; ahinla nangho chu-a nalut phatnun kagam nasuboh-un, kagouho chu kidah um nasosah taove.
target: I brought you into a fertile land to eat its fruit and rich produce. But you came and defiled my land and made my inheritance detestable.

source: Thempuhon, Pakai chu hoija umtam? atipouve, dan tuhhon keima eiheta pouve. Hou lamkaiho jong kachunga achonkhel taove, chule themgao hon Baal thu aseijun phatchomna bei thilho nung ajuijun ahi.
target: The priests did not ask, ‘Where is the Lord ?’ Those who deal with the law did not know me; the leaders rebelled against me. The prophets prophesied by Baal, following worthless idols.

source: Hijeh achu, Pakai keiman nathu kasei jingding, chule nachateo chateho thu jong kasei ding ahi.
target: “Therefore I bring charges against you again,” declares the Lord . “And I will bring charges against your children’s children.

source: Ajehchu Chittim twikol gam chonsoh in lang ven, Kedar geijin mi solin, hitobang thilhi umnam, gunchu tah-in ngaiton.
target: Cross over to the coasts of Cyprus and look, send to Kedar and observe closely; see if there has ever been anything like this:

source: Nam khatnin pathen hilou a-pathen ho akhelkhah uvem? Kamiten vang aphachom lou dingin aloupi nao chu akikhel taove.
target: Has a nation ever changed its gods? (Yet they are not gods at all.) But my people have exchanged their glorious God for worthless idols.

source: Vo nangho vanhon, hiche hi datmouvin, tijat umtah in kichauvin, nangho kamhelun, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Be appalled at this, you heavens, and shudder with great horror,” declares the Lord .

source: Ajehchu kamiten manthah na thil ni aboluve; amahon hinna twinah keima eidalhaovin, twi veithei louna twikul akilaijuve.
target: “My people have committed two sins: They have forsaken me, the spring of living water, and have dug their own cisterns, broken cisterns that cannot hold water.

source: Israel chu soh khat ham? In le lou neilou soh hija ham? Ijeh-a ama suhsetna uma hitam?
target: Is Israel a servant, a slave by birth? Why then has he become plunder?

source: Keipibahkai chalgolin angih-in, ahamin chule agam chu asumangin; akhopiho acheng beihelin ahalvamin ahi.
target: Lions have roared; they have growled at him. They have laid waste his land; his towns are burned and deserted.

source: Noph le Tahapanes chaten jong nalu-a lallukhuh asukeh taove.
target: Also, the men of Memphis and Tahpanhes have cracked your skull.

source: Hichehi Pakai na-Pathen'in lamdunga napuihoile laija ama nadalhah jeh-a nangle nangin nakilamdoh hilouham?
target: Have you not brought this on yourselves by forsaking the Lord your God when he led you in the way?

source: Chule nangin Egypt lampia hi Sihor twi dona dinga ipi nabol dingham? Ahiloule vadung twiho donna dinga Assyria lampia hi ipi nabol ding ham?
target: Now why go to Egypt to drink water from the Nile? And why go to Assyria to drink water from the Euphrates?

source: Nangmatah gitlouna chun nangma nasuhdih ding, nanungchona chun nangma naphosal ding ahi, hijeh achu Pakai na-Pathen nadalhah-a, keima ginna nasunga aumlouhi thilphaloule thilkha ahi, ti nahetna namu ding ahi, tin janel Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: Your wickedness will punish you; your backsliding will rebuke you. Consider then and realize how evil and bitter it is for you when you forsake the Lord your God and have no awe of me,” declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty.

source: Ajehchu sotlaipeh-a na namkoljon kasuhboh-a, naloiho kasuhmangthah ahitai. Chule nangin, keima chonval taponge natin, molsang chung takiple thingphung hing noi takipma numei kijoh bangin navahlen, nakijoh-in ahi.
target: “Long ago you broke off your yoke and tore off your bonds; you said, ‘I will not serve you!’ Indeed, on every high hill and under every spreading tree you lay down as a prostitute.

source: Ahinla keiman lengpigui pha, muchi dihtah-a kanaphu nahi. Achutile ibola keidinga mansuhna, gamlah lengpigui keh naso jeng hitam?
target: I had planted you like a choice vine of sound and reliable stock. How then did you turn against me into a corrupt, wild vine?

source: Ajehchu nangma chang-alin kisopmin lang, sabon tamtah mangjong lechun, nakhangitlouna chu kamasanga kimelchih ahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: Although you wash yourself with soap and use an abundance of cleansing powder, the stain of your guilt is still before me,” declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Nangman kakisuboh poi, Baal kajuipoi iti nati ngam ding ham? phaichama nalampi ven, ipi nabol kihetnin, nangmahi mangang tah sangongsang nu acham chama che;
target: “How can you say, ‘I am not defiled; I have not run after the Baals’? See how you behaved in the valley; consider what you have done. You are a swift she-camel running here and there,

source: Gamthipma um gamlah sangan anopnopma hui donlele, ahuhlai chu kon asuhkih thei ding ham? Aholte jouse lungkham daohen, alha lhinteng amutei dingu ahi.
target: a wild donkey accustomed to the desert, sniffing the wind in her craving— in her heat who can restrain her? Any males that pursue her need not tire themselves; at mating time they will find her.

source: Kengchot beija naum louna din chule nadang gotlouna din umin, ahinla nangman, Kinepna aumtapoi, Aumtapoi, ajehchu keiman gamdang mi kangailun, anungu kajui ding ahi, tin naseije.
target: Do not run until your feet are bare and your throat is dry. But you said, ‘It’s no use! I love foreign gods, and I must go after them.’

source: Gucha akimatdoh phatle ajachat bangin, Israel insung mite ajahcha taove. Amaho, alenghou, aleng chapatehou, athempuhou chule athemgao houvin,
target: “As a thief is disgraced when he is caught, so the people of Israel are disgraced— they, their kings and their officials, their priests and their prophets.

source: Thingbul jah-a, nangma kapa nahin, song jah-a nangin neihin vahdoh ahi, atiuve. Ajehchu amahon eimaingat louvin einungsun taove. Ahivangin amahon agenthei phattah ule, kipat in, neihuh doh-un, tiuvinte.
target: They say to wood, ‘You are my father,’ and to stone, ‘You gave me birth.’ They have turned their backs to me and not their faces; yet when they are in trouble, they say, ‘Come and save us!’

source: Ahinla nangman nakisemthu na-pathen ho chu hoija umtaovem? Amaho chu kipatdoh uhen, nagenthei pet uva nahuhdoh jou uvem? ajehchu vo Judah, nakhopi jouse jatna na-pathen ho umsa ahije.
target: Where then are the gods you made for yourselves? Let them come if they can save you when you are in trouble! For you, Judah, have as many gods as you have towns.

source: Ijeh-a nangho keimatoh kinelkal ihiuvem? Nangho nabonchaovin keima dounan nachonkhel taove, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Why do you bring charges against me? You have all rebelled against me,” declares the Lord .

source: Nachateo chu mohseh-a kajep bep ahitai, kisuhdihnan anei tapouve. Nangho chemjam maman nathemgao hou chu, misugam keipibahkai bangin asugamtan ahi.
target: “In vain I punished your people; they did not respond to correction. Your sword has devoured your prophets like a ravenous lion.

source: Vo, khang mite, nangman Pakai thuhi veuvin, Keima Israel dinga gamthiple muthim gam kahi hitam? Ijeh-a kamiten, keihohi pakaiho kahiuve, nahenga kahunglou dingu ahitai, atiu hitam?
target: “You of this generation, consider the word of the Lord : “Have I been a desert to Israel or a land of great darkness? Why do my people say, ‘We are free to roam; we will come to you no more’?

source: Nungah in akivona ho asuhmil theija, ahiloule, mouvin avonho asuhmil theijem? Hinla kamiten nikho simjoulou khopmin eisumil taove.
target: Does a young woman forget her jewelry, a bride her wedding ornaments? Yet my people have forgotten me, days without number.

source: Ijeh-a dongma holna-a nalampi nakisuhjol ham? Hijeh chun migilou chu nalampi ho nahiltan ahi.
target: How skilled you are at pursuing love! Even the worst of women can learn from your ways.

source: Chule napon mongho-a jong chaga monabei hinnaho thisan beh akimun ahi. Keiman hichehi holguh-a kamu ahipon, phongtah-a kamudoh ahi.
target: On your clothes is found the lifeblood of the innocent poor, though you did not catch them breaking in. Yet in spite of all this

source: Ahinla nangman, themona bei kahi jeh-in alunghana keija konin kiheimang teijinte nati-e. Ven, keima kachonsepoi nati jeh-a nathu katan ding ahi.
target: you say, ‘I am innocent; he is not angry with me.’ But I will pass judgment on you because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’

source: Nalampi khelna dinga ibola vahle humhal nahim? Assyria-a najachat lheh banga Egypt jeh-a jong najachat ding ahi.
target: Why do you go about so much, changing your ways? You will be disappointed by Egypt as you were by Assyria.

source: Ahi, nakhut naluchunga nangapma, ama-a kona nachedoh ding ahi. Ajehchu Pakaiyin natahsan ho jouse chu alahlousa ahin, amaho-a chu lolhinna nanei lou ding ahi.
target: You will also leave that place with your hands on your head, for the Lord has rejected those you trust; you will not be helped by them.

source: Amahon, pasal'in ajinu dahenlang, amanu ama-a konin pot hen, pasal chom khatna hitale, amapa chu amanu koma akilekit dem? Chuche gam chu hatah-a suhboh-a umlou ding ham? atiuve. Ahinla nangma dongma tamtah toh noti'n nakichemin, kahenga nahung kilekit nalaije, tin Pakai jin aseije.
target: “If a man divorces his wife and she leaves him and marries another man, should he return to her again? Would not the land be completely defiled? But you have lived as a prostitute with many lovers— would you now return to me?” declares the Lord .

source: Munsang ho lam ngan dah-in, pasal tincheng to nalup louna mun umam? Gamthipma Arab ho bangin, amaho din lam tinna natoulen, najon thanhoi nale nagitlou nan gamsung chu nasuboh tan ahi.
target: “Look up to the barren heights and see. Is there any place where you have not been ravished? By the roadside you sat waiting for lovers, sat like a nomad in the desert. You have defiled the land with your prostitution and wickedness.

source: Hijeh chun gohong tuhtangin aumtan, go nunung jong ajutapoi; noti dehpang naneijin, jachat ding nanompon ahi.
target: Therefore the showers have been withheld, and no spring rains have fallen. Yet you have the brazen look of a prostitute; you refuse to blush with shame.

source: Nangman tu-a patnahi, Hepa, nangma hi kakhangdon laija patna eipuihoija chu nahi, tia neikou louding ham?
target: Have you not just called to me: ‘My Father, my friend from my youth,

source: Ama a-itih-a lunghang jing ding ham? Akhonna geija akoiding ham? vetan, hihochu naseijin thilse najo chanin naboltan ahi.
target: will you always be angry? Will your wrath continue forever?’ This is how you talk, but you do all the evil you can.”

source: Leng Josiah nikholaijin Pakai chun keikoma jong anaseijin, Israel kinungchonin abolkhu namu tah-em? Amanu molsang chung jousele thingphung hing noi tina achelen chule akijoh-in ahi.
target: During the reign of King Josiah, the Lord said to me, “Have you seen what faithless Israel has done? She has gone up on every high hill and under every spreading tree and has committed adultery there.

source: Chuin keiman, amanun hicheho jousehi aboljou phatnin, keilama hungkilen, kanatin ahi. Ahinla ahung kihei dehpoi, mikitahlou asopinu Judah'in hichu amutan ahi.
target: I thought that after she had done all this she would return to me but she did not, and her unfaithful sister Judah saw it.

source: Chule keiman, kinungchon Israel chu jonthanhoi jouse jeh-a kapaidoh-a, kadana thu kapeh jing vangin, mikitahlou asopinu Judah chu kichadeh louva, noti'a akichepjing jong kamun ahi.
target: I gave faithless Israel her certificate of divorce and sent her away because of all her adulteries. Yet I saw that her unfaithful sister Judah had no fear; she also went out and committed adultery.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, numei kijoh ahina jalchun gamsung chu asubohtan; chule thingle songhotoh ajongin ahi.
target: Because Israel’s immorality mattered so little to her, she defiled the land and committed adultery with stone and wood.

source: Chule hicheng jouse jeh-in tahsanbei asopinu Judah chu alung pumpin kahenga ahung kilehei dehpoi; akilepjo bouvin ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: In spite of all this, her unfaithful sister Judah did not return to me with all her heart, but only in pretense,” declares the Lord .

source: Pakaiyin kajah-a, nungchon Israel chu mikitahlou Judah sangin them akichanjoi, tin aseije.
target: The Lord said to me, “Faithless Israel is more righteous than unfaithful Judah.

source: Chenlang hiche thuho hi sahlam sanga seiphonglen, tin Pakaiyin aseije, Kitahna neilou Israel, hungkinungle kitnin, chule kalunghana nachunga chuhsah taponge. Ajehchu keima mikhoto them kahin, a-itih-in lunghang jing ponge, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Go, proclaim this message toward the north: “ ‘Return, faithless Israel,’ declares the Lord , ‘I will frown on you no longer, for I am faithful,’ declares the Lord , ‘I will not be angry forever.

source: Nakhangitlouna bou kihetnin, nangma Pakai na Pathen dounan nasukheltai. Chule nalampi ho chu gamchom miho ding thingphung hing noi tina nathe jah-in, keima aw nangai pouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Only acknowledge your guilt— you have rebelled against the Lord your God, you have scattered your favors to foreign gods under every spreading tree, and have not obeyed me,’ ” declares the Lord .

source: Vo, nungchon chate hung kileuvin, ajehchu nangma kakichenpi nahin, keiman nangho khopi khatna kon khat, insung khatna kon ni ladoh ingting, Zion'a kapui ding nahiuve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Return, faithless people,” declares the Lord , “for I am your husband. I will choose you—one from a town and two from a clan—and bring you to Zion.

source: Keiman kalungtoh kelngoiching ho peuvinge, amahon chihnale hetthemna-a nangho navah dingu ahi.
target: Then I will give you shepherds after my own heart, who will lead you with knowledge and understanding.

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, chuche nikho laiteng, chuche gama nahung punuva, nahungtam phatnile, amahon Pakai thulhun thingkhong tia aseitah lou dingu, geljong ageldohtah lou dingu, viljong avillou diu chule semphatna jong umtalou ding ahi, tin Pakai chun aseije.
target: In those days, when your numbers have increased greatly in the land,” declares the Lord , “people will no longer say, ‘The ark of the covenant of the Lord .’ It will never enter their minds or be remembered; it will not be missed, nor will another one be made.

source: Chuphatle Jerusalem chu Pakai laltouna atidiu, namtin jouse chu, Jerusalem'a Pakai mina kikhom dingu, alungu gitlouna ngaitona banga chontalou ding ahiuve.
target: At that time they will call Jerusalem The Throne of the Lord , and all nations will gather in Jerusalem to honor the name of the Lord . No longer will they follow the stubbornness of their evil hearts.

source: Chu nikho chule Judah insung chu Israel insungtoh lhakhom uva, sahlam gama kona hungpot khomdiu, napateu vin alodiuva kapeh gam lamchu ahin jot dingu ahi.
target: In those days the people of Judah will join the people of Israel, and together they will come from a northern land to the land I gave your ancestors as an inheritance.

source: Ahinla keiman chate lah-a nangma iti kaumsah-a, namtin janelho gouhoile gam nom chu kapeh ding ham? kanatin ahi. Chule nangin, Hepa tia neikouva, keija kona nakihei mang lou ding ahitai, kanatin ahi.
target: “I myself said, “ ‘How gladly would I treat you like my children and give you a pleasant land, the most beautiful inheritance of any nation.’ I thought you would call me ‘Father’ and not turn away from following me.

source: Tahbeh-in mikitahlou in-neipi khat, ajipa-a kon apotdoh bangin, Israel insungin jong keima angsunga gilouna aboltai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: But like a woman unfaithful to her husband, so you, Israel, have been unfaithful to me,” declares the Lord .

source: Israel chate kanale taona munsang ho chunga akijadoh tan ahi, ajehchu amahon alampio akaleh-in akisemun, Pakai a-Pathen'u chu asumil taove.
target: A cry is heard on the barren heights, the weeping and pleading of the people of Israel, because they have perverted their ways and have forgotten the Lord their God.

source: Hung kileuvin, nungchon Israel chate, chutile nanung chon nao suhdampeh tange. Ven, keiho nahenga kahunguve, ajehchu nangma Pakai ka Pathen'u nahi.
target: “Return, faithless people; I will cure you of backsliding.” “Yes, we will come to you, for you are the Lord our God.

source: Adihtah-in, lhang ho-a konle mol tamtah ho-a kona huhhingna mudin kakinem kheluve. Dihtah-in, Pakai ka Pathen uva Israel huhhingna chu aume.
target: Surely the idolatrous commotion on the hills and mountains is a deception; surely in the Lord our God is the salvation of Israel.

source: Ajehchu kakhang donlai juva pat kapateule achapateu, achanuteu le aganchahon hou chu jachatnan avallhumtan ahi.
target: From our youth shameful gods have consumed the fruits of our ancestors’ labor— their flocks and herds, their sons and daughters.

source: Eiho jahchan i-umun, lungnoh phahnan eikhu taove. Ajehchu eihole ipateu, ikhangdon uva pat tuni geihin Pakai i-Pathen'u dounan ichonseu vin, Pakai i-Pathen'u awchu inangai tapouve.
target: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our disgrace cover us. We have sinned against the Lord our God, both we and our ancestors; from our youth till this day we have not obeyed the Lord our God.”

source: Pakaiyin, Vo Israel nangma nahung kile-a, kahenga nahunga nalampi kidah umho chu kamitmu-a kona naheidoh leh, nangma kichonle tapon nate, tin aseije.
target: “If you, Israel, will return, then return to me,” declares the Lord . “If you put your detestable idols out of my sight and no longer go astray,

source: Chule nangman, Pakai chu thutah-a, thutan na-a chule chonphatna-a hinga ahi tia nakihahsel ding ahi. Chutengle namtinho chu ama-a phatthei changa, ama-a loupi ding ahiuve.
target: and if in a truthful, just and righteous way you swear, ‘As surely as the Lord lives,’ then the nations will invoke blessings by him and in him they will boast.”

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin Judahte le Jerusalem jah-a, hitin ati, naleiset lholouhou chu kal let uvin, chule ling lah-a tu hih-un, tin aseije.
target: This is what the Lord says to the people of Judah and to Jerusalem: “Break up your unplowed ground and do not sow among thorns.

source: Nangho Judah mitele Jerusalem'a chengten Pakaiya nachep tanunlang, nalungsung chep kitanun, ajole nathilbolu phatlou jeh-in, keima kalungsatna phelmit joulouvin mei bangin kongdoh getninte, ati.
target: Circumcise yourselves to the Lord , circumcise your hearts, you people of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem, or my wrath will flare up and burn like fire because of the evil you have done— burn with no one to quench it.

source: Judah'a seichoijin lang, Jerusalem'a phongjalin, gamsunga sumkon mut un pengun lang kikhom khomun, khopi kulneiho-a lutnuhite, tiuvin.
target: “Announce in Judah and proclaim in Jerusalem and say: ‘Sound the trumpet throughout the land!’ Cry aloud and say: ‘Gather together! Let us flee to the fortified cities!’

source: Zion lama ponlap tahdoh-un, kikhin unlang umden hih-un, ajehchu keiman sahlama kona thilphalou, manthaina kahin pohlut ding ahi.
target: Raise the signal to go to Zion! Flee for safety without delay! For I am bringing disaster from the north, even terrible destruction.”

source: Keipibahkai chu aumna hamthing lah-a konin ahungdoh-in, chule chidang namdangte sumang dingpa ahung pheitai, nagam sungu kamhelsah dingin aumna-a konin akipatdoh tai. Chule nakhopihou chu chenna louva agoh-a umding ahi.
target: A lion has come out of his lair; a destroyer of nations has set out. He has left his place to lay waste your land. Your towns will lie in ruins without inhabitant.

source: Hijeh hin khaodip pon kisilun, kapmun lang pengun, ajehchu Pakai lungsat tijat umtah chu eihoa kona kiheimang lou ahi.
target: So put on sackcloth, lament and wail, for the fierce anger of the Lord has not turned away from us.

source: Chuni chule hung hiti ding ahi, lengpa le pipuiho lungthim mang intin; thempuhon adatmouva, themgao hon kidang asahdiu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “In that day,” declares the Lord , “the king and the officials will lose heart, the priests will be horrified, and the prophets will be appalled.”

source: Chuin keiman, hekate, Pakai Pathen! nangman hiche mitele Jerusalem hi nalhep tahbeh ahitai. Chamna naneidiu ahi natin, hinlah chemjamin ahinnao chu asunkhatai, katin ahi.
target: Then I said, “Alas, Sovereign Lord ! How completely you have deceived this people and Jerusalem by saying, ‘You will have peace,’ when the sword is at our throats!”

source: Chuchephatle hiche mitele Jerusalem jah-a, gamthip munsang ho-a huigo chu kamite chanu umna lama, ajap ngim dingle athehngim ding hilouhel,
target: At that time this people and Jerusalem will be told, “A scorching wind from the barren heights in the desert blows toward my people, but not to winnow or cleanse;

source: chuche munho-a kona huipi hattah kahenga hungnung ding; tu-a jong keiman achunguva thu katanlhah ding ahi, hung kiti ding ahi.
target: a wind too strong for that comes from me. Now I pronounce my judgments against them.”

source: Ven, amachu meibol ho banga hung touva, akangtalai chu chimpei bang ding, asakolho chu mulaopi ho sanga gangjo ding ahiuve. Suhmanga um ihi jeh-un, ohe idau ahi!
target: Look! He advances like the clouds, his chariots come like a whirlwind, his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! We are ruined!

source: Vo Jerusalem, huhhing-a naum theina din, gitlouna-a konin nalung sopthengin. Nalung ngaito pannabei ho chu itihchan nasunga umding ham?
target: Jerusalem, wash the evil from your heart and be saved. How long will you harbor wicked thoughts?

source: Ajehchu Dan-a konin awkhatnin aphongdoh-in, Ephraim mola kon suhgentheina hung lhading aphongjale.
target: A voice is announcing from Dan, proclaiming disaster from the hills of Ephraim.

source: Namtinho jah-a seilen; veuvin Jerusalem dounan phongdoh-un, gamlatah-a konin galbolho ahungun, Judah khopiho dounan ahinsam uve.
target: “Tell this to the nations, proclaim concerning Jerusalem: ‘A besieging army is coming from a distant land, raising a war cry against the cities of Judah.

source: Keima eidou jeh uvin, loujao hongho bangin, amahon dounan a-umkimvel taove, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: They surround her like men guarding a field, because she has rebelled against me,’ ” declares the Lord .

source: Nachonnale nathilbolin hichehohi nachunga ahinsodoh ahin; hichehi nagitlouna ahin, anasalheh jenge, ajehchu hiche hin nalungsung ahinphah ahitai.
target: “Your own conduct and actions have brought this on you. This is your punishment. How bitter it is! How it pierces to the heart!”

source: Vo kalungsung, kalungsung! kalungchang tah anai; kalungphut husa aginge; kigalgin husa sumkon ginchu, vo kahinna, nangin najah jeh-in kaumthim thei tapoi,
target: Oh, my anguish, my anguish! I writhe in pain. Oh, the agony of my heart! My heart pounds within me, I cannot keep silent. For I have heard the sound of the trumpet; I have heard the battle cry.

source: suhmangna chunga suhmangna in kho asamin, gamsung pumpi chu suhsetnin aumin, photlotnin kaponbuh, mitphet kahin kapondal akisusetai.
target: Disaster follows disaster; the whole land lies in ruins. In an instant my tents are destroyed, my shelter in a moment.

source: Itih chanpi hiche ponlap hi kavetna, sumkon gin chu kangai jing ding ham?
target: How long must I see the battle standard and hear the sound of the trumpet?

source: Kamitehi angol jeh-un eiheta pouvin, ju-ngolvei chate ahiuvin, hetchet aneipouve. Thilse bolna din achingun, thilpha bolnadin hetna aneipouve.
target: “My people are fools; they do not know me. They are senseless children; they have no understanding. They are skilled in doing evil; they know not how to do good.”

source: Leiset chu kagahven, vetemin, alimle agong bei ahin; chule vanho chu, amahon vah anei pouve.
target: I looked at the earth, and it was formless and empty; and at the heavens, and their light was gone.

source: Molsangho kagahven, vetemun, akihot hotnun, lhang jouse kangchan akitol tolun ahi.
target: I looked at the mountains, and they were quaking; all the hills were swaying.

source: Kagahvetle, vetemun, mihem aumtapoi, chungleng vachate jouse alengmang gamtaove.
target: I looked, and there were no people; every bird in the sky had flown away.

source: Kagahvetle, vetemun, gamphalai chu gamthip asohtan, khopiho jouse chu Pakai le alungsatna tijat umtah anga chun achimlha gamtan ahi.
target: I looked, and the fruitful land was a desert; all its towns lay in ruins before the Lord , before his fierce anger.

source: Ajehchu gamsung pumpi chu kamhel ding; achainahel vang kahisah loulai ding ahi, tin Pakai chun aseije.
target: This is what the Lord says: “The whole land will be ruined, though I will not destroy it completely.

source: Hiche jeh ahi leiset lunghema, chunga vanho hung thim ding ahiuve; hichehi kaseisa ahijeh-in kalunggot ahin, kisih ponge, nungjong kinung heideh ponge.
target: Therefore the earth will mourn and the heavens above grow dark, because I have spoken and will not relent, I have decided and will not turn back.”

source: Sakol chung touhole thal choiho husa-a khopi jamgam diu ahin; hamhing lah-a lutnuva, songpiho chunga kaldiu ahi, khopi tin kidalha-a, chua koimacha cheng lou ding ahiuve.
target: At the sound of horsemen and archers every town takes to flight. Some go into the thickets; some climb up among the rocks. All the towns are deserted; no one lives in them.

source: Nangma nakisuhmang phatle ipi nabol ding ham? Ponsandup min kivonin lang, sana jemin kijemin lang, namai jempol jongle chun, mohseh-a kihoisah nahiding ahi, nadongma hon nanah sahmo uva, tha dinga nahol diu ahi.
target: What are you doing, you devastated one? Why dress yourself in scarlet and put on jewels of gold? Why highlight your eyes with makeup? You adorn yourself in vain. Your lovers despise you; they want to kill you.

source: Ajehchu numei naosonat thoh tobangle, chanei masapen natthoh pet banga Zion chanu aw kajai, amanu natthoh in apengin, akhut ajahdoh-in, ohe tuhin ada kahitai! ati. Ajehchu tolthat ho jeh-in kahinna alhasamtai, ati.
target: I hear a cry as of a woman in labor, a groan as of one bearing her first child— the cry of Daughter Zion gasping for breath, stretching out her hands and saying, “Alas! I am fainting; my life is given over to murderers.”

source: Nangho Jerusalem kholaiho-a suhle tungin lhaijun, tun veuvin lang heuvin, chule munlen ho-a holun, dihtah'a thutan mi khattou namule, keiman amanu ngaidaminge.
target: “Go up and down the streets of Jerusalem, look around and consider, search through her squares. If you can find but one person who deals honestly and seeks the truth, I will forgive this city.

source: Chule amahon, Pakai chu ahinge tinama jongleu, jouva kihahsel tahbeh ahiuve.
target: Although they say, ‘As surely as the Lord lives,’ still they are swearing falsely.”

source: Vo Pakai, thutah chu navet lhihjing hilou ham? Nangin amaho chu najepjin; amahola alunghem pouve; nangin nachaihel tan, ahinla kisuhdihsah ding anomdeh pouve, amaiju songpi sangin atahsah cheh-un, kile ding anompouve.
target: Lord , do not your eyes look for truth? You struck them, but they felt no pain; you crushed them, but they refused correction. They made their faces harder than stone and refused to repent.

source: Hijeh achu keiman, hitehohi vaicha tahbeh; mingol tahbeh ahiuve kati ahi. Ajehchu amahon Pakai lampi le a-Pathenu thutanna ahepouve.
target: I thought, “These are only the poor; they are foolish, for they do not know the way of the Lord , the requirements of their God.

source: Keima miloupiho henga chengting, ajah uva thu seijinge; ajehchu amahon Pakai lampi, a-Pathenu thutanlhahna ahethemun, ahinla hiteho hin anamkoljon'u ahehbongun, akikan gomnahou atumtan taove.
target: So I will go to the leaders and speak to them; surely they know the way of the Lord , the requirements of their God.” But with one accord they too had broken off the yoke and torn off the bonds.

source: Hijeh achu gamlah-a keipibahkai'in athaova, nilhah lang sial'in asuhmang diu, lutnu in akhopihou anga-a, chua kona vahdoh tapou chu asitel jeng ding ahije. Ajehchu asuhkhel nao atamin, anungchon nao apungin ahi.
target: Therefore a lion from the forest will attack them, a wolf from the desert will ravage them, a leopard will lie in wait near their towns to tear to pieces any who venture out, for their rebellion is great and their backslidings many.

source: Hijeh-achu nangho iti kangaidam diu ham? Nachateovin eidalhaovin, pathen hilouho-ah akihahseluvin; amaho kavahva petnin jonthanhoi abolun, ahon honin notiho ina akikhomun ahi.
target: “Why should I forgive you? Your children have forsaken me and sworn by gods that are not gods. I supplied all their needs, yet they committed adultery and thronged to the houses of prostitutes.

source: Amaho jingkah kivahva sakol ho abangun; mitin aheng akom inneipi henga angih lhehlhut-uve.
target: They are well-fed, lusty stallions, each neighing for another man’s wife.

source: Hitiho jeh-a hi kavil lou dingu ham? Hitobang nam mitehi kahinnan aphulah lou ding ham? tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Should I not punish them for this?” declares the Lord . “Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?

source: Akulbang hou chunga kaltouvin lang suchimun; achaina helvang hisah hih-un; apal hou lamangun; ajehchu hiho chu Pakaiya ahipouve.
target: “Go through her vineyards and ravage them, but do not destroy them completely. Strip off her branches, for these people do not belong to the Lord .

source: Ajehchu Israel le Judah insung chu keima dounan akhangse lheh taove, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: The people of Israel and the people of Judah have been utterly unfaithful to me,” declares the Lord .

source: Amahon Pakai chu ajoulhep mun, amahi ahipoi, ichunguva thilse jong chupontin; chule chemjam ahiloule kellhah jong tohpouhite atiuvin ahi.
target: They have lied about the Lord ; they said, “He will do nothing! No harm will come to us; we will never see sword or famine.

source: Chule themgaoho chu hui hungsoh uva, asunguva thu umlou ding ahi; hitia chu amaho kibol ding ahiuve.
target: The prophets are but wind and the word is not in them; so let what they say be done to them.”

source: Hijeh chun janel ho Pakai Pathen chun hitin aseije, nanghon hitia nasei jeh-un, veuvin, kathuhohi nakam uva mei kahisah-a, hiche mitehi thing hiuva, meichun akahvam dingu ahi.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord God Almighty says: “Because the people have spoken these words, I will make my words in your mouth a fire and these people the wood it consumes.

source: Ven, vo Israel insung, gamlatah-a kona vaipi khat kahinpoh khumding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ama chu nam hattah ahin, khangluilai nam, a-pauvu jong nahetlou, chule ipi aseiju jong nahethei lou nam hiding ahiuve.
target: People of Israel,” declares the Lord , “I am bringing a distant nation against you— an ancient and enduring nation, a people whose language you do not know, whose speech you do not understand.

source: Alivatheiju lhankot kihong tobang ahin, amaho mi hattah jeng ahiuve.
target: Their quivers are like an open grave; all of them are mighty warriors.

source: Chule nachanuteu le nachapateo nehding, nalousohle changlhah chu aneh chaidiu, nakelngoi hon, nagancha hon aneh chaijuva, natheichang phung hou anehjou dingu, natahsan tah-u kul kithodet nakhopihou chu chemjam'a asuhchatvai dingu ahi.
target: They will devour your harvests and food, devour your sons and daughters; they will devour your flocks and herds, devour your vines and fig trees. With the sword they will destroy the fortified cities in which you trust.

source: Hijengta jongle, chuche nikhoho-a chu kichaihel loulai dingu nahiuve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Yet even in those days,” declares the Lord , “I will not destroy you completely.

source: Chule Pakai i-Pathen'un ibola hicheho jousehi ichunguva alhunsah ham? tia nasei tengule hung hiti ding ahi, Chuteng amaho chu nadonbutna, nanghon neidalhah uva, nagamsunguva gamchom pathenho nahou banguva chutobanga chu nangho-a hilou gamchom khatna midangho najen diu ahi.
target: And when the people ask, ‘Why has the Lord our God done all this to us?’ you will tell them, ‘As you have forsaken me and served foreign gods in your own land, so now you will serve foreigners in a land not your own.’

source: Hichehi Jacob insunga phongdoh unlang, Judah gama phongjalun lang, hitin seijun,
target: “Announce this to the descendants of Jacob and proclaim it in Judah:

source: Tun hichehi ngaijun, lungthimbei, mit neija mulou; nakhang neija jalou; vo mingol ho,
target: Hear this, you foolish and senseless people, who have eyes but do not see, who have ears but do not hear:

source: neigin louvu ham? tin Pakaiyin aseije. Agalkai joulouna dinga, twipi gamgi dinga, a-itih-a thupeh-a neldi umsahpa keima anga nakithin loudiu ham? Twinong chu kinuh nuh jongle ajolou ding, kitum lullul jongle achunga galkaijou loulai diu ahi.
target: Should you not fear me?” declares the Lord . “Should you not tremble in my presence? I made the sand a boundary for the sea, an everlasting barrier it cannot cross. The waves may roll, but they cannot prevail; they may roar, but they cannot cross it.

source: Ahinla hiche mite hin dounale lungchang huhel aneijuvin; dou apanun, achemangji taove.
target: But these people have stubborn and rebellious hearts; they have turned aside and gone away.

source: Amahon alungthim uva, go masale go nunung aphatcha eipeuva, eiho dinga chang-at phat ho eikheh tuppeh uva Pakai i-Pathen'u ama chu tun gingtao hite, tinjong aseidoh pouve.
target: They do not say to themselves, ‘Let us fear the Lord our God, who gives autumn and spring rains in season, who assures us of the regular weeks of harvest.’

source: Nakhan gitlouna houvin hiche hohi aheimanga, chule nachonsetna houvin nangho-a kona thilpha ho atuhtang ahitai.
target: Your wrongdoings have kept these away; your sins have deprived you of good.

source: Ajehchu kamite lah-a, migilouho aumin, thang kam bangin mi achang lhiuvin, thang akamun, mi apojiuve.
target: “Among my people are the wicked who lie in wait like men who snare birds and like those who set traps to catch people.

source: Bom sung vachaho adimset abangin, a-in jouseu lheplhahna adimsetne, hijeh chun amaho alendoh-un, chule ahaodoh gamtaove.
target: Like cages full of birds, their houses are full of deceit; they have become rich and powerful

source: Amaho athaovun, akiti theijun; chule amahon khang gilouho natoh chu akhokhelun, pabeiho ding agelpouve, ahinla aphatheijun, alhasamho chanding agelpeh pouve.
target: and have grown fat and sleek. Their evil deeds have no limit; they do not seek justice. They do not promote the case of the fatherless; they do not defend the just cause of the poor.

source: Hitiho jeh-a hi kabolgim louding ham? Hitobang nam chungahi kahinna-in phu alah louding ham? tin Pakai chun aseije.
target: Should I not punish them for this?” declares the Lord . “Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?

source: Datmo umtahle tijat umtah thilkhat gamsunga hin akiboltai.
target: “A horrible and shocking thing has happened in the land:
