source: Themgaoho jouvin agaovun, themputen anopnop mun vai apouvin, kamiten chutia bol ding adeijuve, ajonale ipi nabol diu hitam?
target: The prophets prophesy lies, the priests rule by their own authority, and my people love it this way. But what will you do in the end?

source: Vo Benjamin chate, Jerusalem lailunga kona jamdoh dingin kikhomun lang, Tekoah'ah sumkon mut un chule Beth-haccerem 'ah melchih mei domsangun. Ajehchu sahlama konin thilphaloule suhmangna lentah khat ahung kilang doh-e.
target: “Flee for safety, people of Benjamin! Flee from Jerusalem! Sound the trumpet in Tekoa! Raise the signal over Beth Hakkerem! For disaster looms out of the north, even terrible destruction.

source: Keiman Zion chanu chu numei hoitah le nouchet toh kakilo sah-e.
target: I will destroy Daughter Zion, so beautiful and delicate.

source: Kelngoi chingho chu akelngoihon utoh amanu henga hungun tin, amanu doudinga akimvela ponbuh asondiu, amahon ama ama muncheh a avahdiu ahi.
target: Shepherds with their flocks will come against her; they will pitch their tents around her, each tending his own portion.”

source: Amanutoh kisatdin kigouvin, kipat un, chule sunin kontouvuhite. Ohe! idau ahitai; ajehchu sun achemangin nilhah lam alep heihoi tai.
target: “Prepare for battle against her! Arise, let us attack at noon! But, alas, the daylight is fading, and the shadows of evening grow long.

source: Kipat un, janle cheohitin, aleng inpihou gasuseu hite.
target: So arise, let us attack at night and destroy her fortresses!”

source: Ajehchu janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, thingho phuhlhu uvin lang, Jerusalem dou nadin kul khouvin, hichehi hunama gotna kipeding khopi chu ahi. Amanu apumpia kisugenthei ahi.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “Cut down the trees and build siege ramps against Jerusalem. This city must be punished; it is filled with oppression.

source: Twinah in twi asodoh bangin, agitlounaho ahinsodoh jin ahi. Hunamle suhmangna amanu-ah akijadohin, kamasanga hin thohgimnale maha aum jingin ahi.
target: As a well pours out its water, so she pours out her wickedness. Violence and destruction resound in her; her sickness and wounds are ever before me.

source: Vo Jerusalem, kichih theijin, ajole nanga konin kahinna kichondoh khantin, chennalou gam akamhel kaso lounadin, gamgoh-in umsah khange.
target: Take warning, Jerusalem, or I will turn away from you and make your land desolate so no one can live in it.”

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin ati, amahon Israelte amoh-aumsun chu lengpigui khai banga alokhumuva, lengpiga loupan pochaho sunga alelut banga nakhutnu ale kaleh ding ahi.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “Let them glean the remnant of Israel as thoroughly as a vine; pass your hand over the branches again, like one gathering grapes.”

source: Ajahtheina diuva koi henga kaseija kagihsal dingham? Veuvin, akol aseh-un, ajathei pouve, veuvin, Pakai thu chu isahlou vin aneijun, kipanan anei pouvin ahi.
target: To whom can I speak and give warning? Who will listen to me? Their ears are closed so they cannot hear. The word of the Lord is offensive to them; they find no pleasure in it.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai lunghanna chun kadimsetnin, kakitim timnan kacholtai. Keiman hichehi pama um chate chungle khangdong kikhomho chunga kabuh lhah ding ahi, ajehchu ajipa ajinu geija, tehse le atehkem geija kikaidoh ding ahiuve.
target: But I am full of the wrath of the Lord , and I cannot hold it in. “Pour it out on the children in the street and on the young men gathered together; both husband and wife will be caught in it, and the old, those weighed down with years.

source: A-inhou chu alouhou puma midangho kipe ding ahiuve. Ajehchu gamsunga chengho chunga kakhut kalhandoh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Their houses will be turned over to others, together with their fields and their wives, when I stretch out my hand against those who live in the land,” declares the Lord .

source: Ajehchu amaho aneopena pat alenpen geija, amitakip kilosetna lama akipeuvin, chule themgaova pat thempu geijin dihloutah in akimangun ahi.
target: “From the least to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; prophets and priests alike, all practice deceit.

source: Amahon chamna umlou petnin chamna, chamna atiuvin, amite chanu kisuhkhahna chu adamsah bolluve.
target: They dress the wound of my people as though it were not serious. ‘Peace, peace,’ they say, when there is no peace.

source: Amahon thil thet um abol tengule jahcha jiuvem? achutipoi, ajahcha naisai pouve, amaiju jong asanji poi. Hijeh chun amaho alhu ho lah-a lhu-u vintin; keiman amaho kagasuh gim phat tengle amaho sotlhah-a umdiu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Are they ashamed of their detestable conduct? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; they will be brought down when I punish them,” says the Lord .

source: Pakai chun hitin aseije, keng lampiho-a dingun lang, veuvin, chule lamluiho chu dongun, hia chun lampha aume, nahinnaova choldona namu dingu ahi. Ahinla amahon, hichea chun chepouving-e, atiuve.
target: This is what the Lord says: “Stand at the crossroads and look; ask for the ancient paths, ask where the good way is, and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But you said, ‘We will not walk in it.’

source: Nachung uva khongah ho jong katundohpeh un, sumkon gin chu ngaijun, atiuve. Ahivangin amahon ngaipou vinge, atiuvin ahi.
target: I appointed watchmen over you and said, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But you said, ‘We will not listen.’

source: Hijeh chun nangho namtin hon ngaijun, chule vo Houkhom ho, alah uva ipi um ahi, heuvin.
target: Therefore hear, you nations; you who are witnesses, observe what will happen to them.

source: Ngaijin, vo leiset, ven, hiche mite chungahi thilphalou, alungputnu ga thilse kalhutkhum ding ahi. Ajehchu amahon kathule kadanthupeh nitlouvin, anotthap jotaove.
target: Hear, you earth: I am bringing disaster on this people, the fruit of their schemes, because they have not listened to my words and have rejected my law.

source: Ipi ngaitona-a Sheba'a kon bego le gamlatah-a kona kolchu lhum kahenga hung kipolut ham? Nagovam thiltoule naganlhai nao tuitah jong chu kei dinga santhei ahitapoi.
target: What do I care about incense from Sheba or sweet calamus from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable; your sacrifices do not please me.”

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije, vetan, hiche mite anga kipal lhuh naho kakoipeh ding, achunga chu pate le chapate lhukhom diu, aheng akomle agolhou mangthah diu ahi.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord says: “I will put obstacles before this people. Parents and children alike will stumble over them; neighbors and friends will perish.”

source: Pakai chun hitin aseije, Veuvin, sahlam gama kon mipi ahung kitolin, leiset ningtin ho-a kona namlentah khat tundoh-a umding ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says: “Look, an army is coming from the land of the north; a great nation is being stirred up from the ends of the earth.

source: Vo Zion chanu, amahon thal le teng apat diu, mi engse le hepinabei ahiuvin, ahusao twipinong abangin, nangma dounan galsat miho bangin sakol chunga atou vun akigoltoh taove.
target: They are armed with bow and spear; they are cruel and show no mercy. They sound like the roaring sea as they ride on their horses; they come like men in battle formation to attack you, Daughter Zion.”

source: Aminthanjeu kajataovin, kakhut hou angoilha gamin, hesohnan kadimtauve, chule numei naosonat bangin kanasoh taovin ahi.
target: We have heard reports about them, and our hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped us, pain like that of a woman in labor.

source: Loujaova potdoh hih-un, lampia jong vahle hih-un, ajehchu melmate chemjamle tijatna-in ningtin alotai.
target: Do not go out to the fields or walk on the roads, for the enemy has a sword, and there is terror on every side.

source: Vo kamite chanu, khaodip pon kigah-in, vut kinun, chapa changkhat jeh-a lunghem lheh jeng bangin lunghemin, ajehchu michomgampa chu phulou helouva ichunguva hunglhung ding ahi.
target: Put on sackcloth, my people, and roll in ashes; mourn with bitter wailing as for an only son, for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.

source: Nangin alampiu nahetna, napatep theina dinga kamite lah-a inchungsang khatle kulpidet khatna katun nahitai.
target: “I have made you a tester of metals and my people the ore, that you may observe and test their ways.

source: Amaho abonchauva lunggim umtah chohchi bol, miseisea vahlea, sum engle thih ahiuvin, abonuva misuboh ahiuve.
target: They are all hardened rebels, going about to slander. They are bronze and iron; they all act corruptly.

source: Pumlong teni akatan, ngen chu meijin ahaljol lhan, asuhthengna bul chu amoh junlhah jengin ahi, ajehchu migilouho akipaidohpoi.
target: The bellows blow fiercely to burn away the lead with fire, but the refining goes on in vain; the wicked are not purged out.

source: Amaho chu mihon dangka lahtheilou asahdiu ahi. Ajehchu Pakaiyin amaho chu adeilou ahitai.
target: They are called rejected silver, because the Lord has rejected them.”

source: Pakaiya kona Jeremiah henga thu hung lhung chun, hitin aseije.
target: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord :

source: Pakaiyin kotpi phunga dingin lang, hiche thuhi phongjalin chule seijin, nangho Judah mijouse, Pakai hou dinga hiche kotpi phungho sunga lut hon Pakai thu chu ngaijun.
target: “Stand at the gate of the Lord ’s house and there proclaim this message: “ ‘Hear the word of the Lord , all you people of Judah who come through these gates to worship the Lord .

source: Janelho Pakai, Israelte Pathen chun hitin aseije, nalampiule nanatoh hou kisem phatnun, chule keiman hiche munahin chensah unge.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Reform your ways and your actions, and I will let you live in this place.

source: Pakai houin, Pakai houin, Tonsot Pakai houin tia jouthu seiho chu tahsan hih-un;
target: Do not trust in deceptive words and say, “This is the temple of the Lord , the temple of the Lord , the temple of the Lord !”

source: ajehchu nanghon nalampiu chule nathil bolhou chu apuma nakisem phatnuva, mikhatle aheng akom kah-a thudih nasodoh uva,
target: If you really change your ways and your actions and deal with each other justly,

source: kholjin mi, pabeiho leh meithaiho sugenthei louva, hiche munahi monabeiho thisan nasodauva, chule nasuse dingu pathen dangho jong najoulhepmuva ahile,
target: if you do not oppress the foreigner, the fatherless or the widow and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and if you do not follow other gods to your own harm,

source: chutengle keiman napateu kanapeh nagam hiche munahi atonsot atonsotna kachensah ding nahiuve.
target: then I will let you live in this place, in the land I gave your ancestors for ever and ever.

source: Veuvin, phatchomna bei thujouho chu natahsanun ahi.
target: But look, you are trusting in deceptive words that are worthless.

source: Nanghon guchat, toltha, jouva kihahsel, Baal houna-a gimnamtui hala, nahetlouvu pathen dangho najuijuva,
target: “ ‘Will you steal and murder, commit adultery and perjury, burn incense to Baal and follow other gods you have not known,

source: chule naheng uva kamina kivo hiche in'a kamasanga nadin uva, chule thet umhohi bol dinga eikipedoh uva ahitai, nati dingu ham?
target: and then come and stand before me in this house, which bears my Name, and say, “We are safe”—safe to do all these detestable things?

source: kamina kivo hiche inhi nangho mitmu-a michomho kokhuh hitam? Veuvin, hiti chun kamubepme, tin Pakai chun aseije.
target: Has this house, which bears my Name, become a den of robbers to you? But I have been watching! declares the Lord .

source: Ahinla tun nangho kamina kaphudoh masahna Shiloh-a kaumna mun'a chun cheovin, chule kami Israelte gitlou jeh-a chua ipi kanabolem gaveovin.
target: “ ‘Go now to the place in Shiloh where I first made a dwelling for my Name, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of my people Israel.

source: Chule Pakaiyin aseije, nanghon hitobang jousehi naboltah jeh-un, chule matah-a katho-a kanaseipeh vanguva nangaitahlou jeh-un, chule kakou vang uva neina donbut tahlou jeh-un,
target: While you were doing all these things, declares the Lord , I spoke to you again and again, but you did not listen; I called you, but you did not answer.

source: hijeh achu nanghole napu napateu kanapehna mun, nanghon nana tahsanu, kamina kivo hiche in'a hi Shiloh a kabol tobang chu kabol ding ahi.
target: Therefore, what I did to Shiloh I will now do to the house that bears my Name, the temple you trust in, the place I gave to you and your ancestors.

source: Keiman nasopiteu Ephraim chilhah apumpia kana paidoh banga nangho jong kamitmu-a kona kapaidoh ding nahiuve.
target: I will thrust you from my presence, just as I did all your fellow Israelites, the people of Ephraim.’

source: Hijeh chun, hiche mite dingin taohih-in, amaho dingin kho samhih-in, taojong taohih-in, kahenga jong thumpeh hih-in, ajehchu kajahpeh louding nahi.
target: “So do not pray for this people nor offer any plea or petition for them; do not plead with me, for I will not listen to you.

source: Amahon Judah khopiho sungle Jerusalem lamlen ho-a ipi abolu chu mulou nahiuvem?
target: Do you not see what they are doing in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

source: Chaten thing achomun, paten mei atih-un, numei hon changbong ameh-un van lengnu din changlhah asem gouve, chule keima phin lunghan theinadin pathen dangho din donthei thilto alheilha jiuve.
target: The children gather wood, the fathers light the fire, and the women knead the dough and make cakes to offer to the Queen of Heaven. They pour out drink offerings to other gods to arouse my anger.

source: Amahon keima eiphin lunghanu ham? Amaho maiso kisuhmona ding bepma amahole amaho kiphin lunghangu hilouham? tin Pakai chun aseije.
target: But am I the one they are provoking? declares the Lord . Are they not rather harming themselves, to their own shame?

source: Hijeh chun tonsot Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, veuvin, kalunghana hiche mun chunga, mi chunga, sa chunga, thingphung ho leiset gaho chunga kabuh lhah ding, hichun akah-a kasuhmit tahlou ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: My anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place—on man and beast, on the trees of the field and on the crops of your land—and it will burn and not be quenched.

source: Israelte Pathen janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, naganlhai naova govam thiltoho chu kikoijun lang apheho chu neuvin.
target: “ ‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Go ahead, add your burnt offerings to your other sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves!

source: Ajehchu napateu Egypt'a kona kipuidoh nichun govam thilto le ganlhai thudol amaho jah-a kanaseipon, thupeh jong kananeipon ahi.
target: For when I brought your ancestors out of Egypt and spoke to them, I did not just give them commands about burnt offerings and sacrifices,

source: Ahinla hichehi amaho thu kanapen, ka aw ngaijun chutile keima na Pathen'u hing ting, nangho kamite nahi dingu ahi. Nangho thu kapeh jouse-a chun chonun, chutile nangho dinga phathei ding ahi, katin ahi.
target: but I gave them this command: Obey me, and I will be your God and you will be my people. Walk in obedience to all I command you, that it may go well with you.

source: Ahinla angai hih-un, anau asungpouve, alung gilou ngaitonaole alunggelun achon jouvin, machon louvin anungchon jotaove.
target: But they did not listen or pay attention; instead, they followed the stubborn inclinations of their evil hearts. They went backward and not forward.

source: Napateu Egypt gama kona ahung potdoh uva pat tuni geihin kasoh themgao jouse naheng uva, kahinsolin, jingkah matah-in athouvun kasolen,
target: From the time your ancestors left Egypt until now, day after day, again and again I sent you my servants the prophets.

source: Hinla amahon kathu angai hih-un, anau jong asungpouve, angei apukonun, alouchal uvin, apateu sangin asejouvin ahi.
target: But they did not listen to me or pay attention. They were stiff-necked and did more evil than their ancestors.’

source: Hijeh chun, nangin ajah uva thu jousehi seijin natin, na ngaipeh loudiu, Nangin amaho kouvin natin, amahon nadonbut louding ahi.
target: “When you tell them all this, they will not listen to you; when you call to them, they will not answer.

source: Ahinla nangin ajah uva hiti ahi nasei ding ahi, hiche nam mitehi Pakai a-Pathen aw ngailou, hilna jong sangdeh lou nam ahiuve, thutah chu amanghelin, akamuva konin pailhah helin aumtai.
target: Therefore say to them, ‘This is the nation that has not obeyed the Lord its God or responded to correction. Truth has perished; it has vanished from their lips.

source: Vo Jerusalem, nasam kitanin lang, munsang ho-a kapmin, ajehchu Pakaiyin alunghana khang mitehi adeitapon, adalhatai.
target: “ ‘Cut off your hair and throw it away; take up a lament on the barren heights, for the Lord has rejected and abandoned this generation that is under his wrath.

source: Ajehchu Judah chaten kamitmun thilphalou aboluve, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Kamin kivona insung suhbohna dingin, athet umtah hou chu apolut taove.
target: “ ‘The people of Judah have done evil in my eyes, declares the Lord . They have set up their detestable idols in the house that bears my Name and have defiled it.

source: Chule keiman kanathupeh louhel, kalung sunga jong umlouhel, achapateule achanuteu meija gona dingin Hinnom chapa phaicham, Topheth munsang ho asadoh taove.
target: They have built the high places of Topheth in the Valley of Ben Hinnom to burn their sons and daughters in the fire—something I did not command, nor did it enter my mind.

source: Hijeh chun Tonsot Pakaiyin, veuvin hiche munchu Tophet kiti talou ding, Hinnom chapa phaicham jong kitikitlouva, tolthana phaicham kiti johna ding nikho ahung lhunge, Ajehchu mun abeihel kahse-a Topheth'a kivuigam ding ahiuve, ati.
target: So beware, the days are coming, declares the Lord , when people will no longer call it Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter, for they will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.

source: Hiche mite thilongho chu chungleng vachaho, tolla gamsaho an hiding ahi. Chule koimachan amaho anomang lou ding ahi.
target: Then the carcasses of this people will become food for the birds and the wild animals, and there will be no one to frighten them away.

source: Chutahle Judah khopiho-a chule Jerusalem lamlen ho-a thanopna aw chule kipana aw, moulang le Mounu aw beisoh ding ahi. Ajehchu gamsung chu kamhel ding ahitai.
target: I will bring an end to the sounds of joy and gladness and to the voices of bride and bridegroom in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem, for the land will become desolate.

source: Hiche phatchule amahon Judah te lengho, leng chapateho, thempuho, themgaoho chule Jerusalem'a chengho guho chu abuikhuh uva kona ahinpoh doh dingu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “ ‘At that time, declares the Lord , the bones of the kings and officials of Judah, the bones of the priests and prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem will be removed from their graves.

source: Chule amaho chu nisa le lhathah chule vanmi janel jouse, amahon anangailutnu, anajenu, anajuijuva, anaholu chule anahouvu ho angsunga ahinthejah dingu ahi. Amaho kigomlou ding, kivuilou ding ahiuve, chule leiset chunga eh-a umding ahiuve.
target: They will be exposed to the sun and the moon and all the stars of the heavens, which they have loved and served and which they have followed and consulted and worshiped. They will not be gathered up or buried, but will be like dung lying on the ground.

source: Chule keiman kanodohna mun jouse-a hiche insung phalou sunga umden amohho jouse chun hin sanga thina akilhenjoh dingu ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Wherever I banish them, all the survivors of this evil nation will prefer death to life, declares the Lord Almighty.’

source: Hiche kalvalchun, nangman amaho jah-a nasei ding ahi, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, amaho lhuva thoudoh talou diu ham? Aman aheimanguva, hung kinungle lou dingu hitam?
target: “Say to them, ‘This is what the Lord says: “ ‘When people fall down, do they not get up? When someone turns away, do they not return?

source: Chuti ahile, hiche Jerusalem mitehi ijeh-a tanglouhel nungchon na-a nungchon uva ham? Thujou atuhchah-un, hung kinungle ding anompouve.
target: Why then have these people turned away? Why does Jerusalem always turn away? They cling to deceit; they refuse to return.

source: Keiman kangaijin kajai, ahinla thudih aseipouve. Ipi kabol beh em? atiuvin agitlou naova kona kisih-a koima aumpoi. Sakol galmuna alhailut jeng bangin, mitin ama ama lampia akiheitai.
target: I have listened attentively, but they do not say what is right. None of them repent of their wickedness, saying, “What have I done?” Each pursues their own course like a horse charging into battle.

source: Ahi, van'a leng twiva injong ama phat kitepsa akihetnin, vakhu, vakengsang chule vasilih hon amaho hungna phat akihet uve. Ahivangin, kamiten Pakai thupi tanlhahna dinghi ahepha pouve.
target: Even the stork in the sky knows her appointed seasons, and the dove, the swift and the thrush observe the time of their migration. But my people do not know the requirements of the Lord .

source: Nanghon kachinge, Pakai dan chutoh kaum khomnai, iti natiu ham? Veuvin tahbeh-in, aman hichehi mohseh-a abol ahin, danthupeh sunho lekhamol chu moh ahi.
target: “ ‘How can you say, “We are wise, for we have the law of the Lord ,” when actually the lying pen of the scribes has handled it falsely?

source: Michingho chu ajahchauvin, alungthoijun, akiman taove, veuvin, amahon Pakai thu chu athetbolun chule amaho-a ipi chihna umem?
target: The wise will be put to shame; they will be dismayed and trapped. Since they have rejected the word of the Lord , what kind of wisdom do they have?

source: Hijeh chun a-inneipi teo midangho kapeh-a chule alouhou chu ahinlo dinghou kapeh ding ahi. Ajehchu amitakip aneopena pat alenpen geijin kilosetna-a akipeuvin, themgaova pat thempu gei sanin jou aboluve.
target: Therefore I will give their wives to other men and their fields to new owners. From the least to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; prophets and priests alike, all practice deceit.

source: Ajehchu amahon kamite chanu kisuhkhahna chu adamsah boluvin, chamna umlou helin, chamna, chamna, atiuve.
target: They dress the wound of my people as though it were not serious. “Peace, peace,” they say, when there is no peace.

source: Thet umtah thil aboluva chu jahchabeh uvem? Achutipoi, ajahchahih beh uve, amaiju jong asan sinpoi. Hijeh chun alhuho lah-a lhuhtha diu, gotna akipeh phatnule kipailha ding ahiuve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Are they ashamed of their detestable conduct? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; they will be brought down when they are punished, says the Lord .

source: Keiman amaho kasuhmang tei ding, lengpiguiho-a aga umlou ding, theichang phungin jong ga neilouva, ado pulding, amaho kapeh thilho chu amaho-a kona kitol mang ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “ ‘I will take away their harvest, declares the Lord . There will be no grapes on the vine. There will be no figs on the tree, and their leaves will wither. What I have given them will be taken from them.’ ”

source: Ibola itou thim beh-u ham? Hung kikhomun, kul kikhodet khopiho-a lutnu hite. Ajehchu Pakai douna-a ichonset jeh uva Pakai i-Pathen'un thipchetna eikoijuva, donding thinkha twi eipeh-u ahitai.
target: Why are we sitting here? Gather together! Let us flee to the fortified cities and perish there! For the Lord our God has doomed us to perish and given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against him.

source: Lungmona kaholun, ahin thilpha ahungpoi, chule damtheina phat kaholun, veuvin gentheina bou ahi!
target: We hoped for peace but no good has come, for a time of healing but there is only terror.

source: Asakolho nahkhon gin Dan'a pat akijan, asepai hat ho kholhah ginin gam pumpi akihottai. Ajehchu amaho ahungun, gamsungle asunga umho jouse, chule khopihole asunga chengho jouse abahgamuve.
target: The snorting of the enemy’s horses is heard from Dan; at the neighing of their stallions the whole land trembles. They have come to devour the land and everything in it, the city and all who live there.

source: Ajehchu veuvin, keiman nalah uva, gulho chule suhngoi theilou gulsumho kahin sollutna amahon nachuh dingu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “See, I will send venomous snakes among you, vipers that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you,” declares the Lord .

source: Lungdona-a kona kilhamon kagot teng kalungsung alhoplha jitai.
target: You who are my Comforter in sorrow, my heart is faint within me.

source: Veuvin, gamlatah-a chengho jeh-a kamite chanu ka awgin khu, Pakai chu Zion'a umlouva hitam? Alengpa asunga umlou hitam? Amahon ipijeh-a semthu milimhole mohthil kidangho-a eiphin lunghangu ham?
target: Listen to the cry of my people from a land far away: “Is the Lord not in Zion? Is her King no longer there?” “Why have they aroused my anger with their images, with their worthless foreign idols?”

source: Chang-at phat akichaijin, nipi phatla akichaitan, eihola huhhingin i-um tapouve.
target: “The harvest is past, the summer has ended, and we are not saved.”

source: Kamite chanu kimavo jeh-in mavon kaumin kadup lhatai, lungdona-in eikolchah-in ahi.
target: Since my people are crushed, I am crushed; I mourn, and horror grips me.

source: Gilead gamsunga damna dinga, nuding thingnai lou umlou hitam? Achutile ipijeh-a kamite chanu chu suhdam louva uma hitam?
target: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then is there no healing for the wound of my people?

source: Ohe, kamite chanu kithajeh hin sunle jana kaka theina din kalu twijeng hihen lang chule kamit tenihi mitlhi luipi sohjeng tavele kati!
target: Oh, that my head were a spring of water and my eyes a fountain of tears! I would weep day and night for the slain of my people.

source: Ohe, kamite dalha-a, amaho-a kon kapotdoh theina dinga gamthipma chele vahle ho gebuh khat kanei hitavele! ajehchu abonchauva mijong ngen, misumang kisukhom bou ahiuve.
target: Oh, that I had in the desert a lodging place for travelers, so that I might leave my people and go away from them; for they are all adulterers, a crowd of unfaithful people.

source: Chule amahon jou seinan athalpiu bangin aleiju amangun, ahinla leiset chunga thutah dingin ahangsan pouve. Ajehchu amahon aphalouva konin aphalou asodohun, keima eiheta pouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “They make ready their tongue like a bow, to shoot lies; it is not by truth that they triumph in the land. They go from one sin to another; they do not acknowledge me,” declares the Lord .

source: Mitin aheng akoma chingtheihen, asopi tahsan hih hen, ajehchu sopi takipmin ahinson manghel ding, henglekom chu misumin se-a vahle ding ahiuve.
target: “Beware of your friends; do not trust anyone in your clan. For every one of them is a deceiver, and every friend a slanderer.

source: Amaho mitinin ahenglekom cheh alheplhah diu, thutah aseilou dingu ahi; Aleiju jou seije ahilun, dihloutah bolna-in akisuchol uve.
target: Friend deceives friend, and no one speaks the truth. They have taught their tongues to lie; they weary themselves with sinning.

source: Nachenna chu lheplhahna lah ahin; lheplhahna jeh-in keima eihetnom pouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: You live in the midst of deception; in their deceit they refuse to acknowledge me,” declares the Lord .

source: Hijeh chun janelho Pakaiyin hitin aseije, veuvin, keiman amaho junlhahsah ingting, kapatep ding ahi, ajehchu kamite chanu chu iba kalo ding ham?
target: Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty says: “See, I will refine and test them, for what else can I do because of the sin of my people?

source: Aleiju thalchang kikapdoh abangin, hichun lheplhahna thu aseije. Khatnin aheng akom jah-a akamin chamna thu aseijin, hinla alungsungin achanglhi keovin ahi.
target: Their tongue is a deadly arrow; it speaks deceitfully. With their mouths they all speak cordially to their neighbors, but in their hearts they set traps for them.

source: Hitiho jeh ahi keiman amaho gotna pelouva kakoi dingham? Hitobang namho chungahi hitia hi kahinna-in phu alahlou ding ham? tin Pakai jin aseije.
target: Should I not punish them for this?” declares the Lord . “Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?”

source: Molsangho dinga kaka-a kamao ding, gamthipma umho dinga kalunghem ding ahi. Ajehchu amaho akavamtan, koimachan ajotpai thei tapon, ganchaho hamgin jong akijatapoi. Chungleng vachate le gamsaho ajamun, achemang taove.
target: I will weep and wail for the mountains and take up a lament concerning the wilderness grasslands. They are desolate and untraveled, and the lowing of cattle is not heard. The birds have all fled and the animals are gone.

source: Keiman Jerusalem chu ingem jeng kasoa, dragon kokhuh-a kasem ding, chule Judah khopiho chu acheng beihela kakam helsah ding ahi.
target: “I will make Jerusalem a heap of ruins, a haunt of jackals; and I will lay waste the towns of Judah so no one can live there.”

source: Hiche hekhenthem thei dinga miching koiham? Hiche gam chu amanthaija, gamthip banga akahvama, koimachan ajotpai thei louding ahi, tia phongdoh dinga Pakai kamin aseinapa chu koiham?
target: Who is wise enough to understand this? Who has been instructed by the Lord and can explain it? Why has the land been ruined and laid waste like a desert that no one can cross?

source: Chule Pakaiyin aseije, ajehchu amahon amasanguva kakoipeh kadan thupeh chu adon tapouve, chule ka aw angaipouve, hia chun chonjong achonpouve.
target: The Lord said, “It is because they have forsaken my law, which I set before them; they have not obeyed me or followed my law.

source: Amaho lungsuhto-a bou achonjo taove, apateuvin anahilu, Baal houna nung ajuijo taovin ahi.
target: Instead, they have followed the stubbornness of their hearts; they have followed the Baals, as their ancestors taught them.”

source: Hijeh chun janel Pakai, Israel Pathen'in hitin aseitai! Veovin keiman amaho, hiche miho tahhi thinglungin vah ingting, thinkha twi kadonsah ding ahi.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: “See, I will make this people eat bitter food and drink poisoned water.

source: Keiman amaho chu, apateule amahon anahetkhah louvu, Pathen helouho lah-a kathecheh ding, chule amaho kasuh manghel kahse-a anungu chemjam kajuisah ding ahi.
target: I will scatter them among nations that neither they nor their ancestors have known, and I will pursue them with the sword until I have made an end of them.”

source: Hitihin janel Pakai chun aseije, nanghon ngaitouvin, ahung theina dingun numei lunghemho chu kouvun lang, ahung theina dingun numei dohathuh ho gakou sah-un.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “Consider now! Call for the wailing women to come; send for the most skillful of them.

source: Amaho chu kinouhen lang, chule eiho dingin himsao hen, chutiachu imitnuva kon mitlhi alonlhah-a, imit nel uva kona twiho akikhodoh jeng nadingin,
target: Let them come quickly and wail over us till our eyes overflow with tears and water streams from our eyelids.

source: ajehchu Zion'a konin maon'a aw chu akijan, suhmanga iti i-umu hitam? Igamu idalhah uva ichendetna houvin einotthap jeh-un, ikisumo lheh taove.
target: The sound of wailing is heard from Zion: ‘How ruined we are! How great is our shame! We must leave our land because our houses are in ruins.’ ”

source: Ahinla, vo numei ho, Pakai aw chu ngaijun, nanakhang uva akam thucheng chu lutsah-un, chule nachanuteu chu maoje, chule amitakipmin aheng akomho lunghemje hilun.
target: Now, you women, hear the word of the Lord ; open your ears to the words of his mouth. Teach your daughters how to wail; teach one another a lament.

source: Ijeh-inem itile chate polama umhole khangdong lamlen ho-a umho sumang dingin, thina chu bangkot ho-ah ahungkal touvin chule ileng inpihouva ahung luttan ahi.
target: Death has climbed in through our windows and has entered our fortresses; it has removed the children from the streets and the young men from the public squares.

source: Seijin, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Mihem thilongho chu gam onga eh tobanga pul lhadiu, chule chang atpa nunga khutdim khat chang kidalha banga koiman amaho aga chomkhom lou ding ahitai.
target: Say, “This is what the Lord declares: “ ‘Dead bodies will lie like dung on the open field, like cut grain behind the reaper, with no one to gather them.’ ”

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, michingho chu achihnauva, mihat ho chu ahatnauva, chule mihaoho chu ahaonauva kithang-at daohen.
target: This is what the Lord says: “Let not the wise boast of their wisdom or the strong boast of their strength or the rich boast of their riches,

source: Ahinla akithang-at michu hichea hin kithang at-uhen, keimahi leiset chunga ngailut lungsetna, thutanlhahna, chule chonphatna a vaihom Pakai chu kahi ti hehen chule hethemhen, ajehchu hitiho ahin keima kakipahjie, tin Pakaiyin seije.
target: but let the one who boasts boast about this: that they have the understanding to know me, that I am the Lord , who exercises kindness, justice and righteousness on earth, for in these I delight,” declares the Lord .

source: Veovin Pakaiyin hitin aseije, keiman cheptanho jouse chu cheptan louho toh kagimbol thading nikho ahung lhunge!
target: “The days are coming,” declares the Lord , “when I will punish all who are circumcised only in the flesh—

source: Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon chate, Moab chule gam ningchong penaho, gamthipma chengho jouse chunga, ajehchu hiche nam miho jousehi cheptanlou loi chu ahiuvin chule Israel insung jouse jong lungsunga cheptanlou ahiuve.
target: Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon, Moab and all who live in the wilderness in distant places. For all these nations are really uncircumcised, and even the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart.”

source: Israel insung naheng uva Pakai thusei chu ngaijun.
target: Hear what the Lord says to you, people of Israel.

source: Hitihin Pakaiyin aseije, Pathen hephalouho lamlhah chu kihil hih-un, van melchihna ho jeh-in jong lungthoi hih-un, ajehchu Pathen helouho hitiho ahin alungthoi jiuve.
target: This is what the Lord says: “Do not learn the ways of the nations or be terrified by signs in the heavens, though the nations are terrified by them.

source: Ajehchu miho puchon pachon chu moh ahi. Ijeh-inem itile khatnin gammanga konin thing aphuh-in, hichu heicha-a natongpa khutsoh ahi.
target: For the practices of the peoples are worthless; they cut a tree out of the forest, and a craftsman shapes it with his chisel.

source: Amahon hichu dangkale sanan ajemuvin, akilonlou nadin thihkille seh-in amandetnuve.
target: They adorn it with silver and gold; they fasten it with hammer and nails so it will not totter.

source: Amaho lusu thingphung bangin akitung jangpetnun, ahinla apaothei pouve. Achetheilou jeh uva poh ngaitei ahiuve. Amaho ginghih uvin, amahon thilse abolthei pouve, thilpha bolna dingjong amaho-a aumpoi.
target: Like a scarecrow in a cucumber field, their idols cannot speak; they must be carried because they cannot walk. Do not fear them; they can do no harm nor can they do any good.”

source: Vo Pakai, nangma tobangtah koimacha aumpoi, nangma loupitah nahin, naminhi thanei na-a loupi ahi.
target: No one is like you, Lord ; you are great, and your name is mighty in power.

source: Vo namtin vaipi lengpa, nangma kichalou ding koi ham? Ajehchu nangma-a hichu uma ahin, ajehchu nampiho michingte jouse lahle alenggamhou jouse-a, nangma tobang khatcha aumpoi.
target: Who should not fear you, King of the nations? This is your due. Among all the wise leaders of the nations and in all their kingdoms, there is no one like you.

source: Amaho lungselle angol ahiuvin, lim semthu ahouvu jong chu manthah na lhongpi ahibouve.
target: They are all senseless and foolish; they are taught by worthless wooden idols.

source: Tarshish'a konin dangka kikhen pheng chule Uphaz'a konin sana ahinpouvin, khutthemho khutsohle thihkheng themho khutsohho, adumle asandup akivonun, aboncha chu doha thuh khutthemho khutsoh ngen ahi.
target: Hammered silver is brought from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz. What the craftsman and goldsmith have made is then dressed in blue and purple— all made by skilled workers.

source: Pakai vang chu Pathen dihtah ahin, ama hingjing Pathen le tonsot leng ahi. Alunghana-a leiset kihot ding! athangtomna chu namtin vaipin anan joulou diu ahi.
target: But the Lord is the true God; he is the living God, the eternal King. When he is angry, the earth trembles; the nations cannot endure his wrath.

source: Hiti ahi nanghon ajah uva, vanle lei sem hilou pathenho, amahotah chu leisetna konle hiche vanho noija konahi mangthah ding ahiuve, natidiu ahi.
target: “Tell them this: ‘These gods, who did not make the heavens and the earth, will perish from the earth and from under the heavens.’ ”

source: Aman athaneina-in leiset asemin, achihna-in vannoi atungdoh-in, ahetthem na-in vanho ajandoh-e.
target: But God made the earth by his power; he founded the world by his wisdom and stretched out the heavens by his understanding.

source: Aw aso tengle, van'a twi tamtah aging lullul jin, kolmonga pat twimei ajamtousah jin, kolphele gotwi asemin, agou boma konin hui ahin nundoh sah jin ahi.
target: When he thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; he makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth. He sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.

source: Mitinhi ahetna-a lungsel ngen ahin, asemdoh takip milim kilhah tho-a akisudongun ahi. Ajehchu amilim kilhahtho hochu jouthubuh ahin, asunguva haitheina aumpoi.
target: Everyone is senseless and without knowledge; every goldsmith is shamed by his idols. The images he makes are a fraud; they have no breath in them.

source: Amaho pannabei le natoh dihlou ahiuvin, gotna akipeh tengule mangthah ding ahiuve.
target: They are worthless, the objects of mockery; when their judgment comes, they will perish.

source: Jacob chan chu hicheho bangchu ahipoi; ajehchu Ama thil jouse sempa hin; Israel hi agoulo nam tenggol ahin, amin chu janel Pakai ahi.
target: He who is the Portion of Jacob is not like these, for he is the Maker of all things, including Israel, the people of his inheritance— the Lord Almighty is his name.

source: Vo kulpi sunga chengho, gamsunga konin nakiveina thilho chom khomin.
target: Gather up your belongings to leave the land, you who live under siege.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, vetan, agamsunga chengho chu khatveihi hinpaidoh inting, amahon chutia amutheina diuva amaho kasuhgenthei ding ahi.
target: For this is what the Lord says: “At this time I will hurl out those who live in this land; I will bring distress on them so that they may be captured.”

source: Kakisuh natna jeh-in ada kahitai, kamaha put hi analheh jenge, ahinla keiman, hichehi thohgimna tahbeh ahin, chule kathoh teiding ahi kati.
target: Woe to me because of my injury! My wound is incurable! Yet I said to myself, “This is my sickness, and I must endure it.”

source: Kahoubuh asetan chule kakhao jouse atantai. Keija konin kachate achedoh-un, aumtapouve chule kahoubuh songdoh dingle kapondal ho tungdoh ding koima aumtapoi.
target: My tent is destroyed; all its ropes are snapped. My children are gone from me and are no more; no one is left now to pitch my tent or to set up my shelter.

source: Ajehchu kelgnoi chingho la alungsel ngen ahiuvin, Pakai hola aumpouve. Hijeh-a chu lolhing loudiu, akelngoiteu jouse chehchao ding ahiuve.
target: The shepherds are senseless and do not inquire of the Lord ; so they do not prosper and all their flock is scattered.

source: Veuvin, Judah khopiho kamhelsah dingle, Dragon ho kokhuh sosah dingin, sahlam gama konin thuthang le husa nasatah ahunge.
target: Listen! The report is coming— a great commotion from the land of the north! It will make the towns of Judah desolate, a haunt of jackals.

source: Vo Pakai mihem chondanhi ama-a um ahipoi ti kahetai, akalson hil dinga chu mihem sunga um ahipoi.
target: Lord , I know that people’s lives are not their own; it is not for them to direct their steps.

source: Aw Pakai imacha hilou munna neilhut louna dingin, nalunghanna-a hilouvin nathu tan najoh-in neisu dih-in.
target: Discipline me, Lord , but only in due measure— not in your anger, or you will reduce me to nothing.

source: Nangma hephalouho chungle, namina taolou insungho chunga nalungsatna bunglha tan, ajehchu amahon Jacob anejouvun, abahgamun, asumangun, chule achenna mun kamhelin alhauve.
target: Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge you, on the peoples who do not call on your name. For they have devoured Jacob; they have devoured him completely and destroyed his homeland.

source: Jeremiah henga Pakai thu hunglhung chun aseije,
target: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord :

source: hiche thulhun thuhi ngaijun lang, Judah mitele Jerusalem'a chengho henga seipeh-un.
target: “Listen to the terms of this covenant and tell them to the people of Judah and to those who live in Jerusalem.

source: Chule nangman amaho jah-a seijin, Israel Pathen Pakai chun hitin aseije, hiche thulhun thuho ngailoupa chu sapset changhen.
target: Tell them that this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘Cursed is the one who does not obey the terms of this covenant—

source: Hichu napateu Egypt gamma thih meilhuma kona kahin puidoh ni-a kana thupeh a kanasei, Ka aw ngaijun lang chule kathupeh ho dungjuijin bollun. Hitia chu nangho kamite nahiuva, chule keima na Pathen'u kahi ding ahi.
target: the terms I commanded your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, out of the iron-smelting furnace.’ I said, ‘Obey me and do everything I command you, and you will be my people, and I will be your God.

source: Chutia chu napateu henga, khoijule bongnoi lonna gamkhat pehdinga tunia bangahi kakitepma kahahselna chu katohdoh thei ding ahi, ati. Chuin keiman, hihen, Pakai tin kadonbutne.
target: Then I will fulfill the oath I swore to your ancestors, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey’—the land you possess today.” I answered, “Amen, Lord .”

source: Chujouvin Pakaiyin kahengah aseije, Judah khopihole Jerusalem khopi lamlen ho-a hiche thuho hi phongjalun lang, hiche thulhun thuho hi ngaijunlang, boluvin, ati.
target: The Lord said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem: ‘Listen to the terms of this covenant and follow them.

source: Egypt gama kona amaho kanapuidoh nikhon napateu henga hatah-in kana kiphin in, tuni chan geijin jong, matah-a kipatdoh pumin kagihsal lin, ka-aw ngaijun katijingin ahi.
target: From the time I brought your ancestors up from Egypt until today, I warned them again and again, saying, “Obey me.”

source: Ahinla angaipouvin, anau jong sunglouvin, amitakip alungaito gitlouna-a achonun, hijeh chun abol dinguva kana thupeh-a, ahivanga ana bolou-u, hiche thulhuna thucheng ho jouse hi achunguva kahin lhunsah ding ahi.
target: But they did not listen or pay attention; instead, they followed the stubbornness of their evil hearts. So I brought on them all the curses of the covenant I had commanded them to follow but that they did not keep.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin kajah-a, Judah mitele Jerusalem'a cheng mite lah-a thilguh kigong akimudoh-in ahi.
target: Then the Lord said to me, “There is a conspiracy among the people of Judah and those who live in Jerusalem.

source: Apu apateu, kathu ngainomlouho khangitlouna lama akilehei gamun, pathen dangho jen dingin anungu ajuijun, Israel insungle Judah insungin, apateutoh kanasem thulhun chu asukeh taove, ati.
target: They have returned to the sins of their ancestors, who refused to listen to my words. They have followed other gods to serve them. Both Israel and Judah have broken the covenant I made with their ancestors.

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije, veuvin, ahoidoh theilou hel nadiu thilse achunguva kalhunsah-a, kahenga hungpeng jongleu kangaipeh louding ahi.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord says: ‘I will bring on them a disaster they cannot escape. Although they cry out to me, I will not listen to them.

source: Chuteng Judah khopihole Jerusalem'a chengho chu, gimnamtui ahalnau pathenho henga chun cheovintin, ahenguva pengdiu, hijongle alungdon petnuva hiho chun ahuhdoh louhel diu ahi.
target: The towns of Judah and the people of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to whom they burn incense, but they will not help them at all when disaster strikes.

source: Ajehchu vo Judah, nakhopihou jat dung juijin pathen naneijun, Jerusalem khosung lamlen jat dung juijin jachat umtah Baal henga gimnamtui halna maicham natung doh-un ahi.
target: You, Judah, have as many gods as you have towns; and the altars you have set up to burn incense to that shameful god Baal are as many as the streets of Jerusalem.’

source: Hijeh chun hiche mite dinghin taohih-in, kanale thumna jong bolhih-in, ajehchu alungkham jeh uva kahenga atao tengu jongle kangaipeh louding ahi.
target: “Do not pray for this people or offer any plea or petition for them, because I will not listen when they call to me in the time of their distress.

source: Kangainun thil thet um tahtah bolpumle, nanga kona tahsa theng achemang munasasa a ka-insunga ipi abol nahlai dingham? Nangin aphalou nabol tengle nakipah jilheh-e.
target: “What is my beloved doing in my temple as she, with many others, works out her evil schemes? Can consecrated meat avert your punishment? When you engage in your wickedness, then you rejoice.”

source: Pakaiyin namin chu Olive thingphung hing, ga hoitahle phatah tin nanaminvon, mipi hugin thong chu achunga meijin akongin, ahin abahho chu abong gamtai.
target: The Lord called you a thriving olive tree with fruit beautiful in form. But with the roar of a mighty storm he will set it on fire, and its branches will be broken.

source: Ajehchu Kei phinset na-a lunghansahna dia Baal henga gimnamtui hal Israel insung le Judah insung setna jeh'in, Janel Pakai nangma phutpa chun, nachunga thilgilou ahinbol ding aphongdoh tai.
target: The Lord Almighty, who planted you, has decreed disaster for you, because the people of both Israel and Judah have done evil and aroused my anger by burning incense to Baal.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin eihetsah-in, kahetan, chuphatnin nangin athilbolu neimusah tai.
target: Because the Lord revealed their plot to me, I knew it, for at that time he showed me what they were doing.

source: Ahinla keima kelngoinou, ahiloule bongchal tha dinga kikai bangbou kahin, amin kihetkit louhel nadin mihing gama konin ama chu sumangu hitin, thingphung chu aga pumin subeiju hite, tia kachunga adoha bolu chu kanahe hihhelin ahi.
target: I had been like a gentle lamb led to the slaughter; I did not realize that they had plotted against me, saying, “Let us destroy the tree and its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name be remembered no more.”

source: Ahinla Vo janel Pakai dihtah-a thutanpa, lungsung gille lungthim sung patep jipa, achunguva naphulahna chu neimusah tan, ajehchu kachung chang thu nangma-a kaphondoh ji ahi.
target: But you, Lord Almighty, who judge righteously and test the heart and mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for to you I have committed my cause.

source: Kakhut uva nalou louna dingin Pakai minin gao thu seitahih-in tia kahin na suhmang dinga chang lhijing Anathoth mite chungchanga Pakaiyin hitin aseije.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord says about the people of Anathoth who are threatening to kill you, saying, “Do not prophesy in the name of the Lord or you will die by our hands”—

source: Hijeh chun janel Pakai chun hitin aseije, vetan, amaho chu talen pengting, gollhangho chu chemjam'a louvuntin achapateule achanuteu chu kela thidiu ahi.
target: therefore this is what the Lord Almighty says: “I will punish them. Their young men will die by the sword, their sons and daughters by famine.

source: Chule amaho amoh himhim umpou vinte. Ajehchu Anathoth mite chunga thilse kalhunsah ding, gotna achan kum-u jong hiding ahi.
target: Not even a remnant will be left to them, because I will bring disaster on the people of Anathoth in the year of their punishment.”

source: Nahenga kaphun teng jongle vo Pakai, nangma chonphatah nahin, hijongle nathutan dol neiseisah tadin, ipi dinga migiloute lamlhah lolhinga? hatah'a kitahlouhon nom asahsoh keiju ham?
target: You are always righteous, Lord , when I bring a case before you. Yet I would speak with you about your justice: Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all the faithless live at ease?

source: Nangma phu ahiuvin, henge, ajungkho gam taove, akeh-un, henge, ga asodoh taove. Amahoto naichan naumin, alung giluva konin nagamlan ahi.
target: You have planted them, and they have taken root; they grow and bear fruit. You are always on their lips but far from their hearts.

source: Ahinla Vo Pakai keima neihetan, neimutan, chule nangma lama kalung napatep ahitai. Amaho chu tha dinga kigo kelngoi bangin kaidoh'in lang, athana ding nikho gotpeh tan.
target: Yet you know me, Lord ; you see me and test my thoughts about you. Drag them off like sheep to be butchered! Set them apart for the day of slaughter!

source: Chua chengho gitlouna jeh-a gamsung chu itihchan lunghema loujao tina hampaho golha dingham? Aman kaki chainao amulou ding ahi ati jeh-un, gamsahole vachate amangthah gamtaove.
target: How long will the land lie parched and the grass in every field be withered? Because those who live in it are wicked, the animals and birds have perished. Moreover, the people are saying, “He will not see what happens to us.”

source: Nangma kenga lhai miho toh nalhaikhoma amahon nachol sah-u leh, sakolto iti naki lhaitet thei ding ham? Nangman natahsan, Chamna gama bon amahon nachol sah-u leh, achutile Jordan kinonga chun iti tan natem?
target: “If you have raced with men on foot and they have worn you out, how can you compete with horses? If you stumble in safe country, how will you manage in the thickets by the Jordan?

source: Ajehchu nasopihole napa insung mite tah-in jong, kitahloutah-in nabol uve; henge, amahon nanungsanga mipi akouvuve. Amahon nahenga thungei tah seijongleu tahsan hih-in.
target: Your relatives, members of your own family— even they have betrayed you; they have raised a loud cry against you. Do not trust them, though they speak well of you.

source: Ka-inle kagoulo kadalhatai, kahinna ka-itchah kangaitah chu amanu melmate khutna kapedohtai.
target: “I will forsake my house, abandon my inheritance; I will give the one I love into the hands of her enemies.

source: Kei dinga kagoulo chu gammang sunga keipi tobang ahin, keima dounan apengdoh-in, hijeh-a chu kahot ahi.
target: My inheritance has become to me like a lion in the forest. She roars at me; therefore I hate her.

source: Kagoulohi vacha pol litlet tobang ahin, akimvela um vachaten ama adouvun ahi, hunguvin, gama gamsa jouse hung kikhomun lang anegamdin hungtauvin.
target: Has not my inheritance become to me like a speckled bird of prey that other birds of prey surround and attack? Go and gather all the wild beasts; bring them to devour.

source: Kelngoiching tamtah-in kalengpilei asumangun, kachan achotphauvin, kachan deitah chu gamthip gohkeo asosah taove.
target: Many shepherds will ruin my vineyard and trample down my field; they will turn my pleasant field into a desolate wasteland.

source: Amahon hiche akamhel sah-un, hichu kahenga alunghemin, agam pumpi agohkeo asotaove, ahinla koimachan anahsah poi.
target: It will be made a wasteland, parched and desolate before me; the whole land will be laid waste because there is no one who cares.

source: Gamthip lhonlhung munsang jouse-a thilsuseho ahunglhung taove. Gammong langkhatna pat gammong langkhat gei Pakai chemjamin bahgam intin, mi koimachan chamna aneilou ding ahi.
target: Over all the barren heights in the desert destroyers will swarm, for the sword of the Lord will devour from one end of the land to the other; no one will be safe.

source: Amahon suhlouchang atheuvin, hijongle lingho bou a-atdiu, amahole amaho akisucholun, ahinla phachom ponte, Pakai lungsat nasatah jeh-a chu, nalhosoh-u ajachatpi diu ahi.
target: They will sow wheat but reap thorns; they will wear themselves out but gain nothing. They will bear the shame of their harvest because of the Lord ’s fierce anger.”

source: Kami Israelte losah dinga kagotsa gou tongkha-a, ka-inheng gilouho jouse douna-in Pakai chun hitin aseije, vetan, keiman agamuva konle Judah insung mite lah-a kona kalolhah ding ahiuve.
target: This is what the Lord says: “As for all my wicked neighbors who seize the inheritance I gave my people Israel, I will uproot them from their lands and I will uproot the people of Judah from among them.

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, amaho kalolhah joutengle kahung kile-a, amaho kalungsetna, amitakip agoulo nale agamcheh-a kalepui ding ahi.
target: But after I uproot them, I will again have compassion and will bring each of them back to their own inheritance and their own country.

source: Chule hiti ding ahi, Baal henga kamite kihahselje ahil banguva, ahingjinga Pakai kamina, kihahselna dinga kamite chondan gunchu tah-a akijiluva ahile, chuteng amaho kamite lah-a kisadoh ding ahiuve.
target: And if they learn well the ways of my people and swear by my name, saying, ‘As surely as the Lord lives’—even as they once taught my people to swear by Baal—then they will be established among my people.

source: Ahinla amahon kathu angailou vangule, hiche nam mite chu kabodoh-a, kasuh manghel ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: But if any nation does not listen, I will completely uproot and destroy it,” declares the Lord .

source: Pakaiyin kahenga, tupatpon konggah gakilah-in lang, twija sukot louvin, nakonga kigah-in, ati.
target: This is what the Lord said to me: “Go and buy a linen belt and put it around your waist, but do not let it touch water.”

source: Hitichun Pakai thu dungjuijin konggah khat kaga kilah-in, kakonga kaki gah-in ahi.
target: So I bought a belt, as the Lord directed, and put it around my waist.

source: Chuin anivei channan Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin aseije,
target: Then the word of the Lord came to me a second time:

source: Nagalah nakonga um konggah chu choijin lang, kipat in, Euphrates lama chenlang, chukoma songpi kosung khatna gaselin, ati.
target: “Take the belt you bought and are wearing around your waist, and go now to Perath and hide it there in a crevice in the rocks.”

source: Hitichun Pakaiyin thu eipeh bangin kachen, Euphrates koma kagaseltai.
target: So I went and hid it at Perath, as the Lord told me.

source: Chuin ni tamtah jouvin Pakaiyin kajah-a, kipat in Euphrates lama chenlang chua konin, chukoma sel dinga thu kanapeh konggah chu hinchoijin, ati.
target: Many days later the Lord said to me, “Go now to Perath and get the belt I told you to hide there.”

source: Chuin Euphrates lama kachen kalaidoh-in, kaselna mun'a kon chun konggah chu kaladoh-in, chule vetan, konggah chu anangot tan, imachan aphachom tapoi.
target: So I went to Perath and dug up the belt and took it from the place where I had hidden it, but now it was ruined and completely useless.

source: Chuin Pakai thu kahenga ahung lhungin aseije,
target: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Pakai chun, Judah hoithonale Jerusalem hoithona chu hiti ahi kasuhset ding ahi, ati.
target: “This is what the Lord says: ‘In the same way I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.

source: Kathu ngailouva alung ngaito to-a chonna, pathen dangho jenna, chule houva, hiche nam phaloutehi imacha phachom lou konggah tobang bepbou chu ahiuve.
target: These wicked people, who refuse to listen to my words, who follow the stubbornness of their hearts and go after other gods to serve and worship them, will be like this belt—completely useless!

source: Ajehchu konggah mikonga abechah banga Israel insung pumpile Judah insung pumpi chu keima-a kabechahsah ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, hitia chu amaho kei dinga kamitele kaminthana, kahoinale kaloupina dinga kasem ahin, ahinla amahon angainom pouve.
target: For as a belt is bound around the waist, so I bound all the people of Israel and all the people of Judah to me,’ declares the Lord , ‘to be my people for my renown and praise and honor. But they have not listened.’

source: Hijeh-a chu ajah uva hiche thuhi naseija, Israelte Pakai Pathen'in hai jouse chu lengpitwi sung dimun, ati, nati ding ahi. Chuteng amahon najah-a, hai jouse lengpitwi dim dinghi kahetchen lou uham? atidiu ahi.
target: “Say to them: ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Every wineskin should be filled with wine.’ And if they say to you, ‘Don’t we know that every wineskin should be filled with wine?’

source: Chuteng nangin ajah uva, Pakai jin hitin aseije, vetan, hiche gama chengho jouse David laltouna-a tou lengho, thempuho, themgaoho, chule Jerusalem'a chengho jouse chu khamna-a kadip ding ahiuve.
target: then tell them, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am going to fill with drunkenness all who live in this land, including the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets and all those living in Jerusalem.

source: Chule keiman amaho khatle khat, pate leh chapate tahjong kahin tato ding, kalainat louding, kakhen louding, ahiloule kahepi louhel ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will smash them one against the other, parents and children alike, declares the Lord . I will allow no pity or mercy or compassion to keep me from destroying them.’ ”

source: Ngaijun, nanau sungun, kithahatsah hih-un, ajehchu Pakaiyin thu aseitai.
target: Hear and pay attention, do not be arrogant, for the Lord has spoken.

source: Aman kho ajinsah-a, chule molchung muthim lah-a nakipal lhuh masangin, Pakai na Pathen chu loupina peuvin, chule vah nangaichat laitah-un, thina le-lim asosah-in, muthim lhangkhal in aseme.
target: Give glory to the Lord your God before he brings the darkness, before your feet stumble on the darkening hills. You hope for light, but he will turn it to utter darkness and change it to deep gloom.

source: Ahinla hichu nangailou diule, nahoitho jeh uva kahinna sunthipma kap kapmin tin, Pakai kelngoite gal hinga kikaimang jeh-a kamit teni jong mitlhin achupding ahi.
target: If you do not listen, I will weep in secret because of your pride; my eyes will weep bitterly, overflowing with tears, because the Lord ’s flock will be taken captive.

source: Lengpa le Lengnu jah-a, kineosah lhonin, toulha lhonin, ajehchu nathupina lhonle naloupina lallukhuh lhon jengjong lhamang ding ahitai, tin aseije.
target: Say to the king and to the queen mother, “Come down from your thrones, for your glorious crowns will fall from your heads.”

source: Lhanggam khopi lenho kikhah chah gamintin, koimachan ahontheilou ding, Judah aboncha gal hinga kikaimanga, apumpiuva gal hinga kikaimang diu ahitai.
target: The cities in the Negev will be shut up, and there will be no one to open them. All Judah will be carried into exile, carried completely away.

source: Dahdoh-un lang sahlama kona hungho khu veuvin, nangma kipe kelngoihon, nakelngoi hon hoitah ho chu hoi hitam?
target: Look up and see those who are coming from the north. Where is the flock that was entrusted to you, the sheep of which you boasted?

source: Aman nangma na-engbol teng ipi nasei ding ham? Ajehchu nangin gal lamkai dia nanahil chu, nachunga vaipon apangtai. Numei naosonat banga na nasah louding ham?
target: What will you say when the Lord sets over you those you cultivated as your special allies? Will not pain grip you like that of a woman in labor?

source: Nangin nalunga hiche thilho ibola kachunga hung lhung ham? tia naseile, hichehi nangma nakhansetna alet behset jeh ahin, hijeh-a chu nanih kihoh-a, nakhotal doh-a ahi.
target: And if you ask yourself, “Why has this happened to me?”— it is because of your many sins that your skirts have been torn off and your body mistreated.

source: Ethiopia min avun akheltheija ahiloule lutnun ajem akhel theijem? Achutile angaina-a thilse boljing nanghon jong thilpha nabol thei diu ahi.
target: Can an Ethiopian change his skin or a leopard its spots? Neither can you do good who are accustomed to doing evil.

source: Hijeh chun gamthipma huijin pol amutcheh banga chu kathecheh diu nahi.
target: “I will scatter you like chaff driven by the desert wind.

source: Hichehi keija kona nakite-a navang chanchu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, ajehchu nangin neisumilin, joubulom joh natahsan tai.
target: This is your lot, the portion I have decreed for you,” declares the Lord , “because you have forgotten me and trusted in false gods.

source: Hijeh-a chu najachat kilahna dinga, namai changa nanih kahodohpeh ding nahi.
target: I will pull up your skirts over your face that your shame may be seen—

source: Loujao lhangchung dunga najon thanhoina, nanahkhon, nahuhna awgin, na noti chon naho, nathet um thilbolho chu kamutai. Ohe Jerusalem, nada ahi, naki suhtheng louding ham? Itih tahle ahitadem?
target: your adulteries and lustful neighings, your shameless prostitution! I have seen your detestable acts on the hills and in the fields. Woe to you, Jerusalem! How long will you be unclean?”

source: Twihah thudola Pakai thu chu Jeremiah henga ahung lhungin ahi.
target: This is the word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:

source: Judah alunghemin, akotpihou chu anguije, amaho tolla aduplha taovin, Jerusalem khopi ka ogin akitol toutai.
target: “Judah mourns, her cities languish; they wail for the land, and a cry goes up from Jerusalem.

source: Amilal houvin asohteu twikhaijin asolun, luikhuh-a ahungun, twi amupouve. Atuibelu keo pumin akileuvin, amaho jahchan akisujumuvin ponlu akikhuvin ahi.
target: The nobles send their servants for water; they go to the cisterns but find no water. They return with their jars unfilled; dismayed and despairing, they cover their heads.

source: Leija go juhlou jeh-a, leiset akhit jeh-in, loukaiho ajahchauvin ponlu akikhuh taove.
target: The ground is cracked because there is no rain in the land; the farmers are dismayed and cover their heads.

source: Henge, sajuh pin jong hamlah-a nou aneijin, hamhing umlou jeh-in adalhatai.
target: Even the doe in the field deserts her newborn fawn because there is no grass.

source: Gam sanganho munsang ho-a adingun, dragonho bangin hui ahoplut helhol-un, hamhing umlou jeh-in amitnu athabei gamtai.
target: Wild donkeys stand on the barren heights and pant like jackals; their eyes fail for lack of food.”

source: Vo Pakai kakhangitlou naovin eilansan jongleu, namin jal-in hichu boljengin, ajehchu kakinungtol nao atamin, nangma dounan kachonse taove.
target: Although our sins testify against us, do something, Lord , for the sake of your name. For we have often rebelled; we have sinned against you.

source: Vo Israel kinepna pa, lungkham laija huhhingpu, ibola gamsungahi kholjin banga jankhat gehdia kiheimang lamjot nabah ding hitam?
target: You who are the hope of Israel, its Savior in times of distress, why are you like a stranger in the land, like a traveler who stays only a night?

source: Ibola milungthoile pasal hat kihuh hing theilou bang bepma naum ding ham? Vo Pakai kalah uva naum nalaijin, naminin katao jiuve, neidalha hih-un.
target: Why are you like a man taken by surprise, like a warrior powerless to save? You are among us, Lord , and we bear your name; do not forsake us!

source: Pakaiyin hiche mite thudol hitin aseije, amahon vavei ding adeijun, akengu atuhtang pouvin, hijeh chun Pakai jin amaho asang tapouve. Tu-a aman akhang gitlounao ageldoh-a, asetnao jeh-a gotna apehding ahitai.
target: This is what the Lord says about this people: “They greatly love to wander; they do not restrain their feet. So the Lord does not accept them; he will now remember their wickedness and punish them for their sins.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga, hiche mite phattheina dingin taopeh hih-in,
target: Then the Lord said to me, “Do not pray for the well-being of this people.

source: an ngola apennau kangaipeh louding, govam thilto atotengu jongle kasanpeh louding, chemjamle kela chule hise-a kasuhmang johdiu ahi, ati.
target: Although they fast, I will not listen to their cry; though they offer burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. Instead, I will destroy them with the sword, famine and plague.”

source: Chuin keiman kaseije, Pakai Pathen vetan, themgaoho chun ahenguva, chemjam nato loudiu, keljong nahet loudiu, chamna mong mong kapehjoh ding nahiuve, atiuve.
target: But I said, “Alas, Sovereign Lord ! The prophets keep telling them, ‘You will not see the sword or suffer famine. Indeed, I will give you lasting peace in this place.’ ”

source: Chuphatnin Pakaiyin kahenga, themgaoho chu kamina jouva ahiuve, keiman kasolpon, thujong kapepoi, houjong kakihoupi poi. Naheng uva thilmu dihloule, gaothu chule mohthu pannabei aseijuva, alungu alheplhah-u ahi.
target: Then the Lord said to me, “The prophets are prophesying lies in my name. I have not sent them or appointed them or spoken to them. They are prophesying to you false visions, divinations, idolatries and the delusions of their own minds.

source: Hijeh chun hiche gama hin chemjamle kellhah chuponte tia, keiman kasol louva gaothusei themgaoho chungchang chu chemjamle kellhah in hiche themgaoho chu asuhmang ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord says about the prophets who are prophesying in my name: I did not send them, yet they are saying, ‘No sword or famine will touch this land.’ Those same prophets will perish by sword and famine.

source: Chule agao thuseinao miho chu kel lhahle chemjam jeh-a, Jerusalem khosung lamlena kipaidoh diu, amaho ajiteu ahiloule achapateule achanuteu vuiding koimacha aneilou diu ahi. Ajehchu agitlounau achunguva kabuh lhah ding ahi.
target: And the people they are prophesying to will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and sword. There will be no one to bury them, their wives, their sons and their daughters. I will pour out on them the calamity they deserve.

source: Hijeh-a chu nangin hiche thuhi ajah uva nasei ding ahi: sunle jan-in kamitlhi longhen lang, kanghih behhen. Ajehchu kamite chanu nungah theng chun mavona hoisetah, manthah na nasatah athohtai.
target: “Speak this word to them: “ ‘Let my eyes overflow with tears night and day without ceasing; for the Virgin Daughter, my people, has suffered a grievous wound, a crushing blow.

source: Keima loujaova kagapot dohle, chemjam'a kithat ho pikhu vetan! chuin khopi sunga kagalut le kel lhah naho pikhu vetan! henge, themgaoho le thempuho chu ahetlou nau gama avah leuve, nati ding ahi.
target: If I go into the country, I see those slain by the sword; if I go into the city, I see the ravages of famine. Both prophet and priest have gone to a land they know not.’ ”

source: Judah chu napaidoh hel hitam? Zion chu nahinnan akidah hitam? Kadamna diu umlou hela ibola neivoh-u hitam? Chamna kaholun apha imacha aumpoi, damna ding phat chu, vetan lungkhamna bep ahitai.
target: Have you rejected Judah completely? Do you despise Zion? Why have you afflicted us so that we cannot be healed? We hoped for peace but no good has come, for a time of healing but there is only terror.

source: Vo Pakai kagitlou naole kapateu khangitlou naho kakihet taove. Ajehchu nangma douna-in kachonse taove.
target: We acknowledge our wickedness, Lord , and the guilt of our ancestors; we have indeed sinned against you.

source: Namin jal-in neithet bol hih-un, naloupina laltouna chu jaboldan umhih hen, keihotoh nasem nathulhun chu hejingin lang, sukeh hih-in.
target: For the sake of your name do not despise us; do not dishonor your glorious throne. Remember your covenant with us and do not break it.

source: Chidang namdang pannabei ho lah-a, go juhsah theija umam? ahiloule van'in gohong ajuhsah theijem? Vo Pakai ka Pathen ama chu nangma nahilou ham? Hijeh-a chu nangma kanga diu ahi. Ajehchu hicheho jouse nangma sem ahi.
target: Do any of the worthless idols of the nations bring rain? Do the skies themselves send down showers? No, it is you, Lord our God. Therefore our hope is in you, for you are the one who does all this.

source: Chuphatnin Pakaiyin kahenga, Mosi le Samuel ka-anga dinglhon jongle kalunghi hiche mite lama umthei ponte. Kamitmu-a konin paidoh-un lang chemang taohen, ati.
target: Then the Lord said to me: “Even if Moses and Samuel were to stand before me, my heart would not go out to this people. Send them away from my presence! Let them go!

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, amahon nahenga hoilama ipotdoh diuham? atiuva ahile, nangman amaho chu naseipeh ding ahi, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, athidingho chu thina-a, chemjam'a loudingho chu chemjam'a, kelhah-a thiding hochu kelhah-a, sohchang dingho chu sohchan na-a,
target: And if they ask you, ‘Where shall we go?’ tell them, ‘This is what the Lord says: “ ‘Those destined for death, to death; those for the sword, to the sword; those for starvation, to starvation; those for captivity, to captivity.’

source: Chule achunguva thil jatli, athana diu chemjam, abottel diu uichate, abahgam diule asumang dingu chungleng vachate le gamsaho chu kasol ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “I will send four kinds of destroyers against them,” declares the Lord , “the sword to kill and the dogs to drag away and the birds and the wild animals to devour and destroy.

source: Chule keiman Judah leng Hezekiah chapa Manasseh in Jerusalem'a athilbol jeh-a, leiset lenggam jouse-a amaho kachao lesah ding ahi.
target: I will make them abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth because of what Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah did in Jerusalem.

source: Ajehchu Vo Jerusalem, koijin nangma nakhotoa, koijin nalhasetpi-a, ahiloule iti nahi hitam tia dongle dinga koi chedohle dingham?
target: “Who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? Who will mourn for you? Who will stop to ask how you are?

source: Pakai chun, nangin neidalhan, nanung chontai, hijeh-a chu nachunga kakhut kajah-a, kasuhmang ding nahi, kakitimtim jong kakhoptai.
target: You have rejected me,” declares the Lord . “You keep on backsliding. So I will reach out and destroy you; I am tired of holding back.

source: Amahohi gamsung kotpiho-a changjapmin japming ting, achonnau akhel loujeh uva, chate-a kona kakhena, kamite kasuhmang ding ahi.
target: I will winnow them with a winnowing fork at the city gates of the land. I will bring bereavement and destruction on my people, for they have not changed their ways.

source: Twipi lah-a neldi sanga tamin ameithaihou apungin, sunchang laijin gollhangho nute chunga misumang kapuilut khumin, chucheho leh khopi chunga chun photlotnin tijatna kachuhsah jin ahi.
target: I will make their widows more numerous than the sand of the sea. At midday I will bring a destroyer against the mothers of their young men; suddenly I will bring down on them anguish and terror.

source: Cha sagi hingnun, alhagao alhan, sun ahipetnin nisa alhumin, ajah achan akisudongtai. Amoh umnalai ho chu amelmateu chemjam'a kapehdoh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: The mother of seven will grow faint and breathe her last. Her sun will set while it is still day; she will be disgraced and humiliated. I will put the survivors to the sword before their enemies,” declares the Lord .

source: Leiset pumpi-a kinahnale kikalsetna-a neina hinhi, Ohe heno, kadatave! sumthoila kalha khapon, minjongla sumthoi eilahsah khapon, ahinla amitakipmin eigaosap uve.
target: Alas, my mother, that you gave me birth, a man with whom the whole land strives and contends! I have neither lent nor borrowed, yet everyone curses me.

source: Pakaiyin, tahbeh-a nunga naphatna ding hintin, tahbeh-a melmaten phat hahsat laile genthei laija nabolphatna diu ahi, ati.
target: The Lord said, “Surely I will deliver you for a good purpose; surely I will make your enemies plead with you in times of disaster and times of distress.

source: Thih-in sahlam thihle thihtah chu asuhboh dingham?
target: “Can a man break iron— iron from the north—or bronze?

source: Nachonsetna jouse jeh-a, naneile nagouho, nagam pumpi sung jouse geija, gallaija thil kichom khom banga manbeija kapehdoh ding ahi.
target: “Your wealth and your treasures I will give as plunder, without charge, because of all your sins throughout your country.

source: Nahetlou gama namelmate toh kachesah ding nahi, ajehchu kalunghana mei akongin, hichun nakahvam ding ahi.
target: I will enslave you to your enemies in a land you do not know, for my anger will kindle a fire that will burn against you.”

source: Vo Pakai nangin nahenai, neigel doh-in lang neivilin, eibolgimho phu neilahpeh-in, nathahatna-a neipuimang hih-in, nangma jala houset kato neihet peh-in.
target: Lord , you understand; remember me and care for me. Avenge me on my persecutors. You are long-suffering—do not take me away; think of how I suffer reproach for your sake.

source: Nathu kamun, keiman kanetai, nathu chu keidin kipanale lungsung thanopna ahi. Ajehchu vo janel Pakai Pathen, keima namina kikou kahi.
target: When your words came, I ate them; they were my joy and my heart’s delight, for I bear your name, Lord God Almighty.

source: Minelpehho kikhopna-a katoupon, pahjong kakipah poi; nakhut jeh-in kachangin katouve, ajehchu nalung hilouna-in neina dipsettan ahi.
target: I never sat in the company of revelers, never made merry with them; I sat alone because your hand was on me and you had filled me with indignation.

source: Ibola kanat kumkho sotna, katina damthei louva damding nomlou ham? Nangma kei dinga mijoule akangthei twi tobang nahi ding hitam?
target: Why is my pain unending and my wound grievous and incurable? You are to me like a deceptive brook, like a spring that fails.

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije, nahung kile-a ahileh keiman puikit ningting, kamasanga nadin ding ahi. Thilse-a kona thil lutah nasodoh-a ahile, kakam sung bang ding nahi. Amaho nahenga hungkileu hen, nangvang amaho henga kile hih-in.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord says: “If you repent, I will restore you that you may serve me; if you utter worthy, not worthless, words, you will be my spokesman. Let this people turn to you, but you must not turn to them.

source: Chule keiman nangma hiche mite dinga sum-eng kulbang kigena kasema, amahon nakisatpi diu ahi. Ajehchu keima nahuhhing dingle nahuhdoh dinga um kahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will make you a wall to this people, a fortified wall of bronze; they will fight against you but will not overcome you, for I am with you to rescue and save you,” declares the Lord .

source: Chule keiman migiloute khutna kona kahuh doh-a, tijat umtahho khutna kona kalhatdoh ding nahi.
target: “I will save you from the hands of the wicked and deliver you from the grasp of the cruel.”

source: Pakai thu chu kahenga ahunglhung kitnin aseije.
target: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Nangin hiche munnahi ji naneilou ding, chapate chanute jong naneilou ding ahi.
target: “You must not marry and have sons or daughters in this place.”

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin, hiche munna pengho chapatele chanute thudol, chule ahinguva anuteo thudol le hiche gama ahinguva apateu thudol hitihin aseije.
target: For this is what the Lord says about the sons and daughters born in this land and about the women who are their mothers and the men who are their fathers:

source: Amaho hesohtah-a thiuva, kikalou diu, vuijong kivui louva tollhanga ehbang bep hidiu, amaho chemjamle gilkela mangthah uva alongu chu chunga leng vachate le leija gamsaho anneh hiding ahiuve.
target: “They will die of deadly diseases. They will not be mourned or buried but will be like dung lying on the ground. They will perish by sword and famine, and their dead bodies will become food for the birds and the wild animals.”

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, lunghemna insunga lut hih-in, akapi dingle alunghempi dingin jong che hih-in, ajehchu keiman hiche mite-a konin kacham nale kahebolna chule kahepina kaladohtai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: For this is what the Lord says: “Do not enter a house where there is a funeral meal; do not go to mourn or show sympathy, because I have withdrawn my blessing, my love and my pity from this people,” declares the Lord .

source: Alen aneu hiche gamahi thicheh diu, amaho kivuilou diu, minjong aka loudiu, atahsao jong ki-at pop louding, luchaija jong umlou diu ahi.
target: “Both high and low will die in this land. They will not be buried or mourned, and no one will cut themselves or shave their head for the dead.

source: Thi jeh-a lhamonsahna dinga mite kapma lhisoh lou ding, koimachan anu ahiloule apa lungmonsahna dinga donding khon apeh louhel ding ahi.
target: No one will offer food to comfort those who mourn for the dead—not even for a father or a mother—nor will anyone give them a drink to console them.

source: Nang jong amaho toh nedingle dondinga golvahna insunga nalut louhel ding ahi.
target: “And do not enter a house where there is feasting and sit down to eat and drink.

source: Ajehchu Israel Pathen janel Pakai chun hitin aseije, vetan, namitmule nahinkho uva hiche nuina oginle kipana ogin, moulang nopna oginle mounu ogin katansah hel ding ahi.
target: For this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Before your eyes and in your days I will bring an end to the sounds of joy and gladness and to the voices of bride and bridegroom in this place.

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, thu jousehi hiche mite nahetsah tengle, amahon najah-a, ipijeh-a Pakaiyin thilse nasatahhi keiho douna-a aphondoh hitam? Pakai ka-Pathen'u douna-a kakhangit lounao leh kachonsetnau ipiham? ati dingu ahi.
target: “When you tell these people all this and they ask you, ‘Why has the Lord decreed such a great disaster against us? What wrong have we done? What sin have we committed against the Lord our God?’

source: Chuteng nangin ajah uva nasei ding ahi, ajehchu napateu vin eidalhaovin, pathen dangho nung ajuijun, amaho ajenun, ahouvun keima eidalhaovin, kadan thupeh anitpouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije, natiding ahi.
target: then say to them, ‘It is because your ancestors forsook me,’ declares the Lord , ‘and followed other gods and served and worshiped them. They forsook me and did not keep my law.

source: Nanghon napateu sanga sejocheh nabol taove, ajehchu veuvin, amahon kathu angaida theina diuvin amitakip ama ama lunggel gilou dungjuijin achonuvin,
target: But you have behaved more wickedly than your ancestors. See how all of you are following the stubbornness of your evil hearts instead of obeying me.

source: hijeh-a chu keiman hiche gama kona nahetkhah louvu, nanghole napateu vin ahetkhah louvu gama kapaidoh-a, chua chu sunle jana pathen dangho najen diu, hia chu lungsetna kamusah loudiu nahiuve.
target: So I will throw you out of this land into a land neither you nor your ancestors have known, and there you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.’

source: Hijeh chun vetan, Egypt gama kona Israel chate puidoh-a Pakai chu ahing jinge, tia akiseikit tahlouhel na nikho hochu ahung lhunge, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
