target: “However, the days are coming,” declares the Lord , “when it will no longer be said, ‘As surely as the Lord lives, who brought the Israelites up out of Egypt,’

source: Ahinla, Israel chate sahlam gama konle, aman anochehna gamho-a kona hinpuidoh-a Pakai chu ahing jinge. Chule apateu kanapehsa amaho gama chu kahin lepuikit dingu ahi.
target: but it will be said, ‘As surely as the Lord lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of the north and out of all the countries where he had banished them.’ For I will restore them to the land I gave their ancestors.

source: Ven, ngamanho tamtah kasol ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, amahon ahinmat dingu, chujoule sadelho tamtah solingting, amahon moltinle lhangtin chule songkoho-a kona adel lele dingu ahi.
target: “But now I will send for many fishermen,” declares the Lord , “and they will catch them. After that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them down on every mountain and hill and from the crevices of the rocks.

source: Ajehchu alampiu jouse kamitnin amun, amaho kamaija konin akisel pouvin, akhangit lounao kamitmu-a konin akiselpoi.
target: My eyes are on all their ways; they are not hidden from me, nor is their sin concealed from my eyes.

source: Chule amasatah-a keiman akhangitlou naole achonsetnao ajatnia kalethuh ding ahi. Ajehchu amahon kagam asuboh un, kagoulo chu ki-dah le thet umtah athilongu chun adipset taove.
target: I will repay them double for their wickedness and their sin, because they have defiled my land with the lifeless forms of their vile images and have filled my inheritance with their detestable idols.”

source: Vo Pakai kahatnale kakuldet, chule bolgenthei ni-a jamlutna, leiset kolmonga konin chidang namdangte nahenga hunguntin, ipateovin jouthule ahomkeo phatchomna beihel ana kisan-u ahi atidiu ahi.
target: Lord , my strength and my fortress, my refuge in time of distress, to you the nations will come from the ends of the earth and say, “Our ancestors possessed nothing but false gods, worthless idols that did them no good.

source: Pathen la hilou, pathenho mihemin akisem dingham?
target: Do people make their own gods? Yes, but they are not gods!”

source: Hijeh chun vetan, keiman amaho hichehi khatvei hetsah ingting, kakhutle kathahat hetsah inge, chutile amahon kamin hi Pakai ahi ti hetao vinte.
target: “Therefore I will teach them— this time I will teach them my power and might. Then they will know that my name is the Lord .

source: Judah chonset nahi thih lekhamol le song mantam muhhema kisunlut ahin, alungsungu dokhang chungle namaicham sakiho chunga kikhenga ahi.
target: “Judah’s sin is engraved with an iron tool, inscribed with a flint point, on the tablets of their hearts and on the horns of their altars.

source: Achateuvin thinghing phungho leh molsang chungho-a amaicham hou leh adoikhom hou ageldoh jiuve.
target: Even their children remember their altars and Asherah poles beside the spreading trees and on the high hills.

source: Vo gama kamolsang, naneile nagou jouse gal laija thil kichom banga kapehdoh ding chule nagam pumpi lhung keija namun sangho, chonset mana kapeh ding ahi.
target: My mountain in the land and your wealth and all your treasures I will give away as plunder, together with your high places, because of sin throughout your country.

source: Chule nangma, nangma ngeijin, nagoulo kapehsa chu nalo jomlou ding, nahetphah lou gama namelmate jena kapansah ding nahi. Ajehchu kalunghana meikong nakou sah-un, a-itih-a kongjing ding ahitai, ati.
target: Through your own fault you will lose the inheritance I gave you. I will enslave you to your enemies in a land you do not know, for you have kindled my anger, and it will burn forever.”

source: Pakaiyin hitin ati, mihem'a atahsan na ngama, atichunga abantha kisema, chule Pakaiya kona alungthim petmang mipa chu sapset chenghen.
target: This is what the Lord says: “Cursed is the one who trusts in man, who draws strength from mere flesh and whose heart turns away from the Lord .

source: Ajehchu ama nelphaija phaipheng keh banga thilpha ahungteng amulou ding, ahinla gamthipma gambeh neoho chi umna gamle mihem chenlouna gama cheng ding bou ahi.
target: That person will be like a bush in the wastelands; they will not see prosperity when it comes. They will dwell in the parched places of the desert, in a salt land where no one lives.

source: Pakai tahsana, akinepna Pakai hia mipa chu anun nom ahi.
target: “But blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord , whose confidence is in him.

source: Ajehchu ama twipanga thing kiphut, vapanga ajung jamdoh-a, nisa satnin sangkha louva ana jong hingjing tobang chu hiding ahi, gamgot kum-a olmo louva, aga jong geongai louding ahi.
target: They will be like a tree planted by the water that sends out its roots by the stream. It does not fear when heat comes; its leaves are always green. It has no worries in a year of drought and never fails to bear fruit.”

source: Lungthimhi thil jouse chunga joulhepna dimset, gitlouna-a sesoh hel ahin, hichehi kon hethei jintem?
target: The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?

source: Mitin ama ama lamlhah dungjuile atohga dungjui cheh-a kapeh theina dingin, keima Pakaiyin lungsung kakholin, lunggil ho kapatepjin ahi,
target: “I the Lord search the heart and examine the mind, to reward each person according to their conduct, according to what their deeds deserve.”

source: vabuh-in atwi athah-a khelouva adalhah banga, adihlouva haojong chu chutobang ahin; chule ahinkho kimtuh-a adalha-a, akichaina chu mingol hiding ahi.
target: Like a partridge that hatches eggs it did not lay are those who gain riches by unjust means. When their lives are half gone, their riches will desert them, and in the end they will prove to be fools.

source: Atila pat laltouna sang loupi khat umchu kamun theng laiju chu ahi.
target: A glorious throne, exalted from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.

source: Vo Israelte kinepna Pakai, nangma dalha jouse jahchaova keija kona kidalseho chu tolla kijihlut ding ahiuve, ajehchu amahon Pakai hinna twi longjing chu adalha taove.
target: Lord , you are the hope of Israel; all who forsake you will be put to shame. Those who turn away from you will be written in the dust because they have forsaken the Lord , the spring of living water.

source: Neidam sah-in, Vo Pakai, chutile dam tange, neihuh-in chutile huhhing hitange, ajehchu nangma kavahchoi jing pa nahi.
target: Heal me, Lord , and I will be healed; save me and I will be saved, for you are the one I praise.

source: Vetan, amahon kajah-a, Pakai thusei chu hoiba ham? Tuhin hung guilhung hen, atiuve.
target: They keep saying to me, “Where is the word of the Lord ? Let it now be fulfilled!”

source: Keima vang, kelngoichingpu kahina-a nakoma kon kavah mangpon, dana nikho jong kangaichapoi, namasanga kakama thupot chu, adih ahi nangin nahenai.
target: I have not run away from being your shepherd; you know I have not desired the day of despair. What passes my lips is open before you.

source: Kei dingin manthah na hihih-in, nikho phalou ni-a kakinepna nahi.
target: Do not be a terror to me; you are my refuge in the day of disaster.

source: Eibolgimho jahchaohen lang, keivang nei jachatsah hih-in, amaho lungthoijuhen lang, keivang neilungthoi sah hih-in, achunguva nikho phalou lhunsah inlang, manthah na jatni-in sumangin.
target: Let my persecutors be put to shame, but keep me from shame; let them be terrified, but keep me from terror. Bring on them the day of disaster; destroy them with double destruction.

source: Pakaiyin kajah-a hitihin aseije, Jerusalem kotpi jouse, Judah lengte lutle potlena, mihem chate kotpi phunga khun gadingin,
target: This is what the Lord said to me: “Go and stand at the Gate of the People, through which the kings of Judah go in and out; stand also at all the other gates of Jerusalem.

source: Chule ahenguva, hiche kotpi-a lutji nangho Judah leng tele, Judah mite, chule Jerusalem'a chenghon Pakai thusei hi ngaijun.
target: Say to them, ‘Hear the word of the Lord , you kings of Judah and all people of Judah and everyone living in Jerusalem who come through these gates.

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, kichihtheijun lang cholngah nin pohgih pohdaovin, chule hichu Jerusalem kotpi-a jong hinpolut hih-un.
target: This is what the Lord says: Be careful not to carry a load on the Sabbath day or bring it through the gates of Jerusalem.

source: Na inhouva konin jong cholngah nile pohgih podoh hih-un, najong imacha tong hih-un, napateu thu kapeh bangin cholngahni chu jabol uvin.
target: Do not bring a load out of your houses or do any work on the Sabbath, but keep the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded your ancestors.

source: Ahinla amahon ajuipouve, anaujong asungpouvin ahi, ajahlouna diule hilchahna asanlouna diuvin alouchal uve.
target: Yet they did not listen or pay attention; they were stiff-necked and would not listen or respond to discipline.

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, Pakai jin cholngah ni-a hiche khopi kotpi-a pohgih pohlut louna dingle, na imacha tohlouna dinga choldoni najabol joh uva, lunglut tah-a neijop ule,
target: But if you are careful to obey me, declares the Lord , and bring no load through the gates of this city on the Sabbath, but keep the Sabbath day holy by not doing any work on it,

source: David laltouna-a tou lenghole lengchate, kangtalai le sakolchung chongho, amahole amilenteu Judah mitele Jerusalem'a chengho chu, hiche khopi kotpi sunga lutnuntin, hiche kotpihi a-imatih-a umjing ding ahi.
target: then kings who sit on David’s throne will come through the gates of this city with their officials. They and their officials will come riding in chariots and on horses, accompanied by the men of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, and this city will be inhabited forever.

source: Chule amaho Judah khopiho-a konle, Jerusalem kimvela konin, Benjamin gama konle phaichama konin molsang ho-a konle, lhanglama konin govam thil tole ganlhaiho Pakai ina hinpouvinte.
target: People will come from the towns of Judah and the villages around Jerusalem, from the territory of Benjamin and the western foothills, from the hill country and the Negev, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices, grain offerings and incense, and bringing thank offerings to the house of the Lord .

source: Ahinla nanghon choldoni jabolna dingle, choldoni-a Jerusalem kotpi-a lutna-a, pohgih pohlouna dinga kathu nangai lou uleh, chuche kotpiho phunga chu mei kakonsah-a, hichun Jerusalem'a leng inpiho akahvama, mitlouhel ding ahitai, ati.
target: But if you do not obey me to keep the Sabbath day holy by not carrying any load as you come through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle an unquenchable fire in the gates of Jerusalem that will consume her fortresses.’ ”

source: Pakaiya kona Jeremiah henga thu hung lhung chun hitin aseije,
target: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord :

source: kipat in, beldengpa ina chesuh-in, hikoma chu kathu kajahsah ding nahi, ati.
target: “Go down to the potter’s house, and there I will give you my message.”

source: Chuin beldengpa ina kachesuhle, vetan, aman bel dena akang kikola chun na anatonge.
target: So I went down to the potter’s house, and I saw him working at the wheel.

source: Chuin bonngana abelden chu beldengpa khutna chun asedentan, hitichun beldengpan den dinga aphatsah bangin, belchom khatnin adengtai.
target: But the pot he was shaping from the clay was marred in his hands; so the potter formed it into another pot, shaping it as seemed best to him.

source: Chujouvin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin aseije,
target: Then the word of the Lord came to me.

source: Vo Israel insung, beldengpa banga kabolmo nahiu vem? tin Pakaiyin aseije. Veuvin, beldengpa khutna bonngan banga khu kakhutna um nahilouvu ham? Vo Israel insung.
target: He said, “Can I not do with you, Israel, as this potter does?” declares the Lord . “Like clay in the hand of the potter, so are you in my hand, Israel.

source: Itih phat hama namkhat ham ahiloule lenggam khat ham chungchanga, bodoh ding, suhlhuh ding, suhmang ding tia kaseija,
target: If at any time I announce that a nation or kingdom is to be uprooted, torn down and destroyed,

source: adouna-a kana seisa, chuche nam chu asetnaova kona akisih uva ahile, achunguva thilse bolding kagotsa-a kona kalung kakhelkit ding ahi.
target: and if that nation I warned repents of its evil, then I will relent and not inflict on it the disaster I had planned.

source: Itih phat hama namkhat ham ahiloule lenggam khat ham chungchanga semdoh dingle phudet dinga kaseina ding techun,
target: And if at another time I announce that a nation or kingdom is to be built up and planted,

source: kamitmu-a thilse aboluva, kathu angailou-ule, phatchom sah-u vinge kana tisa, thilpha-a kona chu kalung kisihkit jengding ahi.
target: and if it does evil in my sight and does not obey me, then I will reconsider the good I had intended to do for it.

source: Hijeh chun tun, Judah mitele Jerusalem'a chengteho henga Pakai jin hitin aseije, veuvin, nangho dounan thilse kagongin, nangho dounan thil gilou kagonge. Tuhin mitin nakhangitlou naova konin hung kileuvin lang, nachonnaole nathil bolu aphacheh hisah-un, ati.
target: “Now therefore say to the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, ‘This is what the Lord says: Look! I am preparing a disaster for you and devising a plan against you. So turn from your evil ways, each one of you, and reform your ways and your actions.’

source: Chuin amahon, kinepna aumpoi, kalung gotnu bang chehle mitin ama lung gilou ngaito bang cheh-a kachonjoh dingu bou ahi atiuve.
target: But they will reply, ‘It’s no use. We will continue with our own plans; we will all follow the stubbornness of our evil hearts.’ ”

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije, tun nanghon Pathen helouho lah-a dong temun, hitobang chu kon ajah khah em? Israel nungah theng chun thil tijat umtah khat aboltai.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord says: “Inquire among the nations: Who has ever heard anything like this? A most horrible thing has been done by Virgin Israel.

source: Loujao songpi-a kona Lebanon buhbang hunglong chu, min dalhantin, twidap jenjen munchoma kona hunglong chu kidalhan tem?
target: Does the snow of Lebanon ever vanish from its rocky slopes? Do its cool waters from distant sources ever stop flowing?

source: Ajehchu kamiten eisumilun, pannabei jin gimnamtui ahalun, chule keng lampiho-a chena din, lamluiho-a konin apetnun alampi houva akipalun ahi.
target: Yet my people have forgotten me; they burn incense to worthless idols, which made them stumble in their ways, in the ancient paths. They made them walk in byways, on roads not built up.

source: Agamu kamhelna dingle, a-itih-a leihit khongleu dingin asemun, ajotpa chanchu king vutna alu apei ding ahi.
target: Their land will be an object of horror and of lasting scorn; all who pass by will be appalled and will shake their heads.

source: Melma masanga solam hui thecheh banga amaho kathecheh uva, ahamset niule ang-ngat louva kanungsun ding ahi.
target: Like a wind from the east, I will scatter them before their enemies; I will show them my back and not my face in the day of their disaster.”

source: Chuin amahon, hungun, Jeremiah dounan thilgon khat gong-u hite, ajehchu thempu-a kona danthupeh chu manglou ding ahin, miching ho-a kona thumop, themgaova kona jong thu beilou ding ahi. Hungun kamsungin ama vouhitin, athu khatcha ngaipou hite, atiuve.
target: They said, “Come, let’s make plans against Jeremiah; for the teaching of the law by the priest will not cease, nor will counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophets. So come, let’s attack him with our tongues and pay no attention to anything he says.”

source: Neikhoh sah-in, Vo Pakai, eikinahpiho ogin khu ngaitemin.
target: Listen to me, Lord ; hear what my accusers are saying!

source: Ase chu aphan kilethuh intem? Ajehchu amahon kei thana dingin ko alaitauve. Amaho-a kona nalunghana nalahdohna dinga, amaho dinga thupha kisei chu geldoh-in.
target: Should good be repaid with evil? Yet they have dug a pit for me. Remember that I stood before you and spoke in their behalf to turn your wrath away from them.

source: Hijeh chun achate chu kellhah na-a pedoh-in lang, athisanu chemjam hatna-a bunglha tan, chule ajiteu chu meithai soh uhen, apasalteu thisah inlang, agollhanghou gala chemjamin lousah-in.
target: So give their children over to famine; hand them over to the power of the sword. Let their wives be made childless and widows; let their men be put to death, their young men slain by the sword in battle.

source: Photlot louva achunguva galmihon napuilut tengle, a-inhouva jong kana kijahen, ajehchu kei thana din ko alaijun, kakeng o-nadin thang akamuve.
target: Let a cry be heard from their houses when you suddenly bring invaders against them, for they have dug a pit to capture me and have hidden snares for my feet.

source: Ahijengvangin Pakai kei thana dinga kachunga akihousomu nangin nahenai, akhangit lounao ngaidam hih-in lang, achonsetnao jong namitmu-a konin noimang hih-in. Namasang-ah gal lelsahjon lang, nalunghan tengle hitichun bolin.
target: But you, Lord , know all their plots to kill me. Do not forgive their crimes or blot out their sins from your sight. Let them be overthrown before you; deal with them in the time of your anger.

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, chenlang beldengpa lei halkhat galanlang, miho lah-a tehse ho le thempu luiho gapuijin.
target: This is what the Lord says: “Go and buy a clay jar from a potter. Take along some of the elders of the people and of the priests

source: Solam kotpi lutna-a Hinnom chapa phaicham lama potdoh-in lang, kaseipeh ding thuho chu gaphong jal-in.
target: and go out to the Valley of Ben Hinnom, near the entrance of the Potsherd Gate. There proclaim the words I tell you,

source: Chule Vo Judah lengte le Jerusalem'a cheng nanghon, Pakai thu chu ngaijuvin, janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, vetan, hiche mun chungahi thilse kalhunsah-a, ajachan akolu thah tuntun ding ahi, tin seijin;
target: and say, ‘Hear the word of the Lord , you kings of Judah and people of Jerusalem. This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Listen! I am going to bring a disaster on this place that will make the ears of everyone who hears of it tingle.

source: Ajehchu amahon eidalhaovin, hiche munhi ahotbolun, asunga chun amahole apateu chule Judah lengten anahetkhah louvu pathen dangho din gimnamtui ahalun, hiche munhi setna neilouho thisan adiptauve.
target: For they have forsaken me and made this a place of foreign gods; they have burned incense in it to gods that neither they nor their ancestors nor the kings of Judah ever knew, and they have filled this place with the blood of the innocent.

source: Amahon kei thupeh loule kei seilou, kalunga jong lutkhalou Baal henga govam thilpeh nadingle, achateu meija gona dingin Baal munsang ho jong asemun,
target: They have built the high places of Baal to burn their children in the fire as offerings to Baal—something I did not command or mention, nor did it enter my mind.

source: hijeh chun vetan, hiche munhi Tophet, ahiloule Hinnom chate phaicham kiti talouva kithana phaicham joh kitina ding nikhoho hunglhung ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: So beware, the days are coming, declares the Lord , when people will no longer call this place Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.

source: Chule keiman hikoma Judah le Jerusalem kithumopna moh kahisah-a, amelmateu masangle ahinnao holte khutna chemjam'a kalousah-a, alongu chu chunga vachate le leija ganhingho anneh hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘In this place I will ruin the plans of Judah and Jerusalem. I will make them fall by the sword before their enemies, at the hands of those who want to kill them, and I will give their carcasses as food to the birds and the wild animals.

source: Keiman hiche khopiho akamhel le leihit khongleuva kasema, hiche suhgamnaho jouse jeh-a chu ajotpa chan king vutna chesa diu ahi.
target: I will devastate this city and make it an object of horror and scorn; all who pass by will be appalled and will scoff because of all its wounds.

source: Chule achapateu sa leh achanuteu sa kanehsah-a, khopi kiumkim vel sunga mitinin agolpa sa aneh uva, hikoma chu amelmateule ahinnao holten ano chinto diu ahi.
target: I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and daughters, and they will eat one another’s flesh because their enemies will press the siege so hard against them to destroy them.’

source: Chutengle nangman nalhonpi ho mitmu-a hai chu nasuhkeh ding ahi.
target: “Then break the jar while those who go with you are watching,

source: Chule ajah uva, janel Pakaiyin hitihin aseije, min beldengpa bel bitkit theilou dinga asuhkeh tobang ngeija hiche mitele khopihi kivuina ding abeihel kahse-a kasuhsetna Topheth'a kivui ding ahiuve, nati ding ahi.
target: and say to them, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty says: I will smash this nation and this city just as this potter’s jar is smashed and cannot be repaired. They will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.

source: Hiti achu hiche khopile asunga chengho chunga kabola, Tophet khopi kabahsah ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: This is what I will do to this place and to those who live here, declares the Lord . I will make this city like Topheth.

source: Amahon inho jouse chunga van janelpi houna-a gimnamtui ahal uva, pathen dangho henga don thilpeh asunlhah jeh uvin Jerusalem inhole Judah lengte inho chu Tophet mun banga kisuboh ding ahitai, ati.
target: The houses in Jerusalem and those of the kings of Judah will be defiled like this place, Topheth—all the houses where they burned incense on the roofs to all the starry hosts and poured out drink offerings to other gods.’ ”

source: Chuphatnin Topheth'a konin Jeremiah chu Pakaiyin gaochanga asolna lama chun ahungin, Pakai inhong sunga chun adingin, mijouse henga aseitai.
target: Jeremiah then returned from Topheth, where the Lord had sent him to prophesy, and stood in the court of the Lord ’s temple and said to all the people,

source: Israelte Pathen'in hitin aseije, amahon kathusei ngailouna dinga angongu avaiput jeh-un, veuvin, hiche khopile akhopi jouse adouna-a kaseisa thilse jouse chu kalhunsah ding ahi, ati.
target: “This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘Listen! I am going to bring on this city and all the villages around it every disaster I pronounced against them, because they were stiff-necked and would not listen to my words.’ ”

source: Tun Pakai insunga vaipo pipuija pang Immer chapa Pashhur Thempu'n, Jeremiah hiche thuho-a agao chu ajatan,
target: When the priest Pashhur son of Immer, the official in charge of the temple of the Lord , heard Jeremiah prophesying these things,

source: chuin Pashhur in Jeremiah Themgao chu avon, Benjamin kotpi sunga soulah-a ahenin, hichu Pakai inkom ahi.
target: he had Jeremiah the prophet beaten and put in the stocks at the Upper Gate of Benjamin at the Lord ’s temple.

source: Chuin ajingin ahitin ahi, Pashhur in soulah-a kon chun Jeremiah chu ahin puidohtai. Chuin Jeremiah in ajah-a, Pakaiyin namin Pashhur hilouvin “Magor-missabib” asahtai, ati.
target: The next day, when Pashhur released him from the stocks, Jeremiah said to him, “The Lord ’s name for you is not Pashhur, but Terror on Every Side.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, ven, nangma tahle nagol ho jouse dinga tijat umtah-a kasem ding nahin, amaho chu amelmateu chemjamin louvuntin, nangin namitna navet ding, chule Judah te jouse Babylon lengpa khutna kapeh-a, aman gal hinga Babylon'a akaija, amaho chu chemjam'a atha ding ahi.
target: For this is what the Lord says: ‘I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends; with your own eyes you will see them fall by the sword of their enemies. I will give all Judah into the hands of the king of Babylon, who will carry them away to Babylon or put them to the sword.

source: Chukalvala chu hiche khopi haona jouse, atohdoh jouseu, thil manlu jouse, Judah lengte gou jouse chu amelmateu khutna kapehdoh-a, hichu asuh chatvaijuva akilah uva, Babylon'a apoh diu ahi.
target: I will deliver all the wealth of this city into the hands of their enemies—all its products, all its valuables and all the treasures of the kings of Judah. They will take it away as plunder and carry it off to Babylon.

source: Chule nang, Pashhur na-insunga cheng jousetoh gal hinga Babylon gama nacheuva, chuachu nathi ding, nangle jouthu nanaseipeh nagol ho jousetoh chu-a nakivuiden diu ahitai, ati.
target: And you, Pashhur, and all who live in your house will go into exile to Babylon. There you will die and be buried, you and all your friends to whom you have prophesied lies.’ ”

source: Vo Pakai, nangin neijou lhepmin, joulhep kahitai, nangma kei sangin nahatjon, neinajou tai. Keima nisehle i-sah louvin kaumin, mitinin eitotnop naove.
target: You deceived me, Lord , and I was deceived; you overpowered me and prevailed. I am ridiculed all day long; everyone mocks me.

source: Kathusei chanin kapeng doh-in, hunamle suhmang jeng katijin ahi. Ajehchu Pakai thu chu kei dingin niseh-a mihouset nale i-sah louna ahitai.
target: Whenever I speak, I cry out proclaiming violence and destruction. So the word of the Lord has brought me insult and reproach all day long.

source: Chuin keiman ama chu phahpoh dangting, aminin jong thu seitaponge kati. Ahinla ama thu chu kalungsunga hin, kaguho sunga meikong kilhakhum abangin, kathohlel behsetnin kaumthei tapoi.
target: But if I say, “I will not mention his word or speak anymore in his name,” his word is in my heart like a fire, a fire shut up in my bones. I am weary of holding it in; indeed, I cannot.

source: Ahinla mi tamtah-in eiminset sahnao kajan, ningtina tijatna adime, amahon hehseuvin, hehseuhite akitiuve. Kakihet gilpiho jousen eichanglhi uvin, ijemtin lheplhah-in umintin, eihon ama jouvuhitin, achunga iphu kilah uhite akitiuve.
target: I hear many whispering, “Terror on every side! Denounce him! Let’s denounce him!” All my friends are waiting for me to slip, saying, “Perhaps he will be deceived; then we will prevail over him and take our revenge on him.”

source: Ahinla Pakai chun mihangsan tijat umtah bangin eiumpin, hijeh achu eibolgimho kipal lhuva eijo lou diu, alolhin loujeh uva chu jahcha lheh diu ahin, tonsotna akisuh dongnao chu suhmila umlou ding ahitai.
target: But the Lord is with me like a mighty warrior; so my persecutors will stumble and not prevail. They will fail and be thoroughly disgraced; their dishonor will never be forgotten.

source: Ahinla Vo janel Pakai, midih patepna lungsungle lunggil muletsohji, achunguva naphulahna neimusah-in. Ajehchu kachung chang thu nahenga kakhe lhahsoh ahi.
target: Lord Almighty, you who examine the righteous and probe the heart and mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for to you I have committed my cause.

source: Pakai henga la saovin, Pakai chu vahchoijun, ajehchu aman thilse bolho khutna konin migenthei ho hinna-a ahuhdoh-e.
target: Sing to the Lord ! Give praise to the Lord ! He rescues the life of the needy from the hands of the wicked.

source: Kapenni chu sapset hihen lang, kanun eihin ni chu vangboh hidahen.
target: Cursed be the day I was born! May the day my mother bore me not be blessed!

source: Kapa henga nang dingin chapa khat apengtai tia thu hung lhutna, kapa kipasah pa chu sapset changhen.
target: Cursed be the man who brought my father the news, who made him very glad, saying, “A child is born to you—a son!”

source: Hiche mipa chu Pakaiyin asuhchim, lungheilou khopiho toh banghen lang, jingkahle kana, sunphatle kho kisap jahen.
target: May that man be like the towns the Lord overthrew without pity. May he hear wailing in the morning, a battle cry at noon.

source: Ajehchu kanu chu kalhankhuh anahi theina dingle, chule phattina anaobu keima dinga alet jingna dingin, aman naobu-a konin einathat tapon ahi.
target: For he did not kill me in the womb, with my mother as my grave, her womb enlarged forever.

source: Kahinkho jachatna-a lhum mang ding, tohgimna le lunggimna mubep dinga, ibola naobu-a kona kahung pendoh hitam?
target: Why did I ever come out of the womb to see trouble and sorrow and to end my days in shame?

source: Zedekiah lengpan Jeremiah henga Melchiah chapa Pashhur le Maaseiah thempu chapa Zephaniah asol laija Pakaiya kona Jeremiah henga thu hunglhung chun aseije,
target: The word came to Jeremiah from the Lord when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Malkijah and the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. They said:

source: Kangeh nahi, keiho dingin Pakai chu neidoh peh-un, ajehchu Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in kachunguva gal abolin, chuti ahile athilbol kidangho jouse dungjuijin Pakaiyin eihuvintin, ama keiho-a konin chetouthei nante, ati.
target: “Inquire now of the Lord for us because Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is attacking us. Perhaps the Lord will perform wonders for us as in times past so that he will withdraw from us.”

source: Chuin Jeremiah'in ajah lhona, nangnin Zedekiah henga hitin seilhonin:
target: But Jeremiah answered them, “Tell Zedekiah,

source: Israelte Pakai Pathen'in vetan, kul polama nangho na-umkol khumuva, Babylon lengpa le Chaldea mite nadouna diu, nakhut uva gal manchah ho chu kanung heiding, chule amaho chu hiche khopi sungahi kahin khopkhom ding ahi.
target: ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I am about to turn against you the weapons of war that are in your hands, which you are using to fight the king of Babylon and the Babylonians who are outside the wall besieging you. And I will gather them inside this city.

source: Chule keimatah-in khut lhangdoh le banthahat toh, lunghangle lungsa tah-a, chule lungnatah puma nangho kasatdiu nahiuve.
target: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and a mighty arm in furious anger and in great wrath.

source: Chule hiche khopi sunga chengho mihem le ganhing agoma katha ding, hise nasatah-a kona thiding ahiuve.
target: I will strike down those who live in this city—both man and beast—and they will die of a terrible plague.

source: Hichejou chun Pakaiyin aseije, keiman Judah lengpa Zedekiah le asohte, chule mipi ho, chule hiche khopi-a hise-a, chemjam'a, kela kona hoidohho chu Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar khutna, amelmateu khutna, ahinnao holte khutna kapehdoh ding, aman amaho chemjam'a atha-a, akhenlou diu, achunga hepina anei louhel ding ahi.
target: After that, declares the Lord , I will give Zedekiah king of Judah, his officials and the people in this city who survive the plague, sword and famine, into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and to their enemies who want to kill them. He will put them to the sword; he will show them no mercy or pity or compassion.’

source: Chule hiche mite henga hiti ahi nasei ding ahi, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, veuvin, keiman namasanguva hinna lampile thina lampi kakoije.
target: “Furthermore, tell the people, ‘This is what the Lord says: See, I am setting before you the way of life and the way of death.

source: Hiche khopi sunga uma chu chemjam'a, kela, hise-a thiding: ahinla chedoh-a nangho hin um khuma Chaldea miho henga kipelutpa chu hingintin, chule ahinna chu ama dinga gala kichomdoh bangbep hiding ahi.
target: Whoever stays in this city will die by the sword, famine or plague. But whoever goes out and surrenders to the Babylonians who are besieging you will live; they will escape with their lives.

source: Ajehchu keiman hiche khopi hin thilse atona dinga kamaingat ahitai, thilpha dinga ahipoi, tin Pakai jin aseije. Hichehi Babylon lengpa khutna kipedoh-a, aman meija ahalvam ding ahi.
target: I have determined to do this city harm and not good, declares the Lord . It will be given into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will destroy it with fire.’

source: Judah lengpa insung thudola, Pakai thu ngaijun, tin seijin.
target: “Moreover, say to the royal house of Judah, ‘Hear the word of the Lord .

source: Vo David insung mite, jingkahle thu tannun lang, misugenthei pa khutna konin hunama kichompa chu huhdoh-un, ajole thilse nabol jeh uvin, koima phelmit theilou kalunghana meikong tobang potdoh getninte, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: This is what the Lord says to you, house of David: “ ‘Administer justice every morning; rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed, or my wrath will break out and burn like fire because of the evil you have done— burn with no one to quench it.

source: Vetemin, eidou diuva koi hungsuh-a, ichen naova koi hunglut dingham? tia seija, vo damphaija chengpa, chule phaicham songpi, Pakai keiman nangma kadouve, ati.
target: I am against you, Jerusalem, you who live above this valley on the rocky plateau, declares the Lord — you who say, “Who can come against us? Who can enter our refuge?”

source: Ahinla Pakaiyin natohga dungjuija kabolgima, gammang sunga mei kakousah-a, hichun akimvela thil jouse akahvam ding ahi, ati.
target: I will punish you as your deeds deserve, declares the Lord . I will kindle a fire in your forests that will consume everything around you.’ ”

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Judah lengpa ina chesuh-in lang, hiche thuhi gaseijin,
target: This is what the Lord says: “Go down to the palace of the king of Judah and proclaim this message there:

source: Vo David laltouna-a tou Judah lengpa, nangle hiche kotpiho sunga lut nasohte le namite, Pakai thu chu ngaijuvin:
target: ‘Hear the word of the Lord to you, king of Judah, you who sit on David’s throne—you, your officials and your people who come through these gates.

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, nanghon thutan nale chonphatna bolunlang, nanghon mibolgima konin hunama kichompa chu huhdoh un: gamdang mi paneilou ahiloule meithai henga adihloule pumhat boldaovin, hiche mun'a hin setnabei thisan jong sohih-un.
target: This is what the Lord says: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed. Do no wrong or violence to the foreigner, the fatherless or the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place.

source: Ajehchu nanghon hitichu nabol uva ahile, kangtalai le sakola amale asohte, chule amite hiche kotpi ahi hunglut uva, David laltouna-a toudiu ahi.
target: For if you are careful to carry out these commands, then kings who sit on David’s throne will come through the gates of this palace, riding in chariots and on horses, accompanied by their officials and their people.

source: Ahinla hiche thuho hi nangai louvule, keimatah kaki hahsel ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, hiche inhi akeohela hung umding ahi.
target: But if you do not obey these commands, declares the Lord , I swear by myself that this palace will become a ruin.’ ”

source: Ahinla Pakaiyin, Judah leng insung jah-a hitin aseije, nangma kei dinga Gilead nahin Lebanon luchang nahi: hijengjongle gamthiple mi chenlouna khopi-a kasem teiding nahi.
target: For this is what the Lord says about the palace of the king of Judah: “Though you are like Gilead to me, like the summit of Lebanon, I will surely make you like a wasteland, like towns not inhabited.

source: Chule nadou ding misumang ho, gal manchahto kithocheh kagona, na cedar thing deichomho aphuh uva, mei sunga aselut dingu ahi.
target: I will send destroyers against you, each man with his weapons, and they will cut up your fine cedar beams and throw them into the fire.

source: Nam tamtah-in hiche khopihi ahin hopaova, amitakip min aheng akom henga, ibola Pakaiyin hiche khopi lentah hi ahitibol hitam? atidiu ahi.
target: “People from many nations will pass by this city and will ask one another, ‘Why has the Lord done such a thing to this great city?’

source: Chuteng amahon, ajehchu amahon Pakai Pathen thulhun adonpouvin, pathen dangho ahouvuva ajen jeh-u ahi, tia adonbut dingu ahi.
target: And the answer will be: ‘Because they have forsaken the covenant of the Lord their God and have worshiped and served other gods.’ ”

source: Nangho mithi dingin kaphih-un, lunghempi jong bolhih-un: apotdohpa ding joh-in lhasetah-in kapmun, ajehchu ama hung kilekit talou ding, apenna gam jong mukit lou ding ahitai.
target: Do not weep for the dead king or mourn his loss; rather, weep bitterly for him who is exiled, because he will never return nor see his native land again.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin ati, hiche mun'a kona potdoh apa Josiah khela lengchang Judah leng Josiah chapa Shallum thudola, ama chulama hung kilekit louhel ding ahitai, ati.
target: For this is what the Lord says about Shallum son of Josiah, who succeeded his father as king of Judah but has gone from this place: “He will never return.

source: Ahinla gal hinga akaina lamu mun'a chu thia, hiche gamhi amukit louding ahitai.
target: He will die in the place where they have led him captive; he will not see this land again.”

source: Chonphat louna-a a-in kisah-a, adihlouva a-indan kisempa, aheng akom manbeija goija, atohman peloupa chu, Ohe! ada ahi.
target: “Woe to him who builds his palace by unrighteousness, his upper rooms by injustice, making his own people work for nothing, not paying them for their labor.

source: In lentahle indan lentah chule bangkot ho umin kisah inge, tia cedar thinga sa-a, sandul jetna naloi ahi.
target: He says, ‘I will build myself a great palace with spacious upper rooms.’ So he makes large windows in it, panels it with cedar and decorates it in red.

source: Nangin cedar jenga najo jeh-a chu nalengchan ding ham? Napa chun aneh-a, adonna, thutannale thudih anabolla, hichu ama dinga anaphalheh hilou ham?
target: “Does it make you a king to have more and more cedar? Did not your father have food and drink? He did what was right and just, so all went well with him.

source: Aman vaicha lhasamho thu anatandih jin, hichu amadin anaphalheh ji-e: hichehi keima hetna hilou ham? tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: He defended the cause of the poor and needy, and so all went well. Is that not what it means to know me?” declares the Lord .

source: Ahinla namitle nalungthim chu nakiloset na dingle, setnabei thisan sona, suhgenthei nale pumhat manna ding bep ahi.
target: “But your eyes and your heart are set only on dishonest gain, on shedding innocent blood and on oppression and extortion.”

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin, Judah leng Josiah chapa Jehoiakim thudol hitihin aseije, amahon Vo kasopipa, vo kasopinu tia alunghempi loudiu, amahon ama dinga, vo pakai, ahiloule vo jana-a aloupina, tia alunghempi loudiu ahi.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord says about Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah: “They will not mourn for him: ‘Alas, my brother! Alas, my sister!’ They will not mourn for him: ‘Alas, my master! Alas, his splendor!’

source: Ama sangan kivui banga kivui ding, Jerusalem kotpi kallama kikaija kipaidoh ding ahi.
target: He will have the burial of a donkey— dragged away and thrown outside the gates of Jerusalem.”

source: Lebanon'a chetouvin lang, gakap temin, chule Bashana gakisenin lang, Abarim'a konin gakapmin. Ajehchu nangai jouse kimanthahsah ahitai.
target: “Go up to Lebanon and cry out, let your voice be heard in Bashan, cry out from Abarim, for all your allies are crushed.

source: Keiman naphatna ding kasei ahin, ahinla nangman ngaiponge nati. Hichehi naneolaija na-umchan ahin, hitia chu kathu nangailou ahi.
target: I warned you when you felt secure, but you said, ‘I will not listen!’ This has been your way from your youth; you have not obeyed me.

source: Huijin nakelngoi chin jouse semlih intin, nalungsette gal hinga chediu, nagitlouna jouse jeh-a najachat ding, chule nakisuhdong ding ahi.
target: The wind will drive all your shepherds away, and your allies will go into exile. Then you will be ashamed and disgraced because of all your wickedness.

source: Vo cedar phunga bu kiset, Lebanon'a chengte, numei naosonat banga natna nachunga ahungchuh phungteng, iti lungset naum tadem?
target: You who live in ‘Lebanon,’ who are nestled in cedar buildings, how you will groan when pangs come upon you, pain like that of a woman in labor!

source: Keima kahing jinge tin Pakaiyin aseije, Judah leng Jehoiakim chapa Koniah chu kakhut jetlama melchihna hijongle chun, kasutlhah ding nahin:
target: “As surely as I live,” declares the Lord , “even if you, Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, were a signet ring on my right hand, I would still pull you off.

source: Nahinna holtehole amaiju nagin jingho, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar khut ngeija, chule Chaldea miho khutna kapehdoh ding nahi.
target: I will deliver you into the hands of those who want to kill you, those you fear—Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and the Babylonians.

source: Chule keiman nangmale nahinga nanu chu napenna hilou gamchombeh-a kapuilutna, hia chu nathi ding ahi.
target: I will hurl you and the mother who gave you birth into another country, where neither of you was born, and there you both will die.

source: Ahinla amaho akilekit nomnao gama chu kilekit louhel ding ahiuve.
target: You will never come back to the land you long to return to.”

source: Hiche mipa Koniah hi mi isahlou milim chipsa chu hijam? Amahi deilouhel hitam? Ibola amale achilhahte kipaidoh-a, amahon ahetlouvu gama kipaidoh-a hiuvaham?
target: Is this man Jehoiachin a despised, broken pot, an object no one wants? Why will he and his children be hurled out, cast into a land they do not know?

source: Vo leiset, leiset, leiset, Pakai thu chu ngaitemin.
target: O land, land, land, hear the word of the Lord !

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, hiche mipahi chaneilou, ahinkho sunga lolhing lou ding ahi, tin suntaovin: ajehchu achilhah khatcha lolhing lou ding, David laltouna-a touva Judah gama vaihom umlou ding ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says: “Record this man as if childless, a man who will not prosper in his lifetime, for none of his offspring will prosper, none will sit on the throne of David or rule anymore in Judah.”

source: Kakelngoite hamset na-a sugamle thecheh-a kelngoiching ho adau ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Woe to the shepherds who are destroying and scattering the sheep of my pasture!” declares the Lord .

source: Hijeh chun kamite vah-a kelngoiching ho douna-in Israelte Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, nanghon ka kelngoi hon nathe cheh-un, nano mangun, navil pouve: veuvin, nathil gilou bolu chunga gotna kapeh ding nahiuve, tin Pakai jin aseije.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says to the shepherds who tend my people: “Because you have scattered my flock and driven them away and have not bestowed care on them, I will bestow punishment on you for the evil you have done,” declares the Lord .

source: Chule ka kelngoi hon amohho chu kadeldohna gamho jouse-a kona kachom khoma, ahong sunguva kalepui kitna, amaho gatheijuva pungthei diu ahi.
target: “I myself will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them and will bring them back to their pasture, where they will be fruitful and increase in number.

source: Keiman amaho vahdinga achunguva kelngoiching ho katundoh ding, amaho kichatalou ding, lungjong lungthoitalou diu: imacha jong lhasam talou diu ahi, tin Pakai jin aseije.
target: I will place shepherds over them who will tend them, and they will no longer be afraid or terrified, nor will any be missing,” declares the Lord .

source: Vetan, keiman David dinga chonphatna bah khat katundoh-a, leng khatnin vai ahoma lolhing ding, leisetna thudih-a thu atan ding nikhoho ahung lhunge, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “The days are coming,” declares the Lord , “when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch, a King who will reign wisely and do what is just and right in the land.

source: Ama nikho sunga Judah kihuh hinga, Israel bitkeija cheng ding ahin: chule ama kikouna ding min chu Ichon phatnao Pakai kitiding ahi.
target: In his days Judah will be saved and Israel will live in safety. This is the name by which he will be called: The Lord Our Righteous Savior.

source: Hijeh chun ven, Egypt gama kona Israel chate hinpui dohpa Pakai chu ahing jinge, atikit louna diu nikhoho chu ahung lhunge, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “So then, the days are coming,” declares the Lord , “when people will no longer say, ‘As surely as the Lord lives, who brought the Israelites up out of Egypt,’

source: Ahin sahlam gamkaija kona kanadelmangna gamkaiho jouse-a kona, Israel insung chilhah hinpui touva, kaihoipa chu ahing jinge, chule amaho agamtah uva cheng dingu ahiuve.
target: but they will say, ‘As surely as the Lord lives, who brought the descendants of Israel up out of the land of the north and out of all the countries where he had banished them.’ Then they will live in their own land.”

source: Themgaoho jeh-in kalunghi kasunga apohkeh tan, kagu jouse akilong gamin, Pakai jehle athenna thuho jeh-in, jukhampa jun ajo mipatoh kabangtan ahi.
target: Concerning the prophets: My heart is broken within me; all my bones tremble. I am like a drunken man, like a strong man overcome by wine, because of the Lord and his holy words.

source: Ajehchu gamsunghi jonthanhoi adimsetnin, kihehsetna jeh-in gamsung alunghemin, gamthip nomlaiho agolhan, alamlhah-u asetan, ahetnao adihtapoi.
target: The land is full of adulterers; because of the curse the land lies parched and the pastures in the wilderness are withered. The prophets follow an evil course and use their power unjustly.

source: Themgaole Thempu agomin aboh geltan ahi; henge, ka-insunga jong agitlounau kamudohtai, tin Pakai chun aseije.
target: “Both prophet and priest are godless; even in my temple I find their wickedness,” declares the Lord .

source: Hijeh-a chu alampiu chu amaho dinga muthima lamnal tobang hintin, amaho kino lele uva, chua lhugam diu: achunguva thilse kapohlut ding, gotna achan kum-u hiding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Therefore their path will become slippery; they will be banished to darkness and there they will fall. I will bring disaster on them in the year they are punished,” declares the Lord .

source: Samaria Themgaoho lah-a ngolna kamudoh-in, amaho Baal jenga agao vun, kami Israelte achonsetsah taove.
target: “Among the prophets of Samaria I saw this repulsive thing: They prophesied by Baal and led my people Israel astray.

source: Jerusalem themgaoho lah-a jong tijat umtah thil kamu doh-e: amahon jonthanhoi abolun, jou amangun agitlounauva kona khatcha ahung kile louna din, thilse bolho khuttha ahatsah-un, amaho abonun kei dingin Sodom abangun, chule asunga chengho chu Gomorrah tobang ahiuve.
target: And among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen something horrible: They commit adultery and live a lie. They strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that not one of them turns from their wickedness. They are all like Sodom to me; the people of Jerusalem are like Gomorrah.”

source: Hijeh chun janel Pakaiyin themgaoho thudol chu hitin aseije, ven, keiman amaho thinglunga kavah-a, thinkha twi kadonsah diu ahi. Ajehchu Jerusalem themgaoho-a konin gamsung pumpi-a kisuhbohna ajaltai.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty says concerning the prophets: “I will make them eat bitter food and drink poisoned water, because from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has spread throughout the land.”

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, naheng uva gao thusei themgaoho thu chu ngaihih-un, amahon manmo nasouva agaothu seiju jong amaho lunggela kon ahin, Pakai kamsunga kon ahipoi.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “Do not listen to what the prophets are prophesying to you; they fill you with false hopes. They speak visions from their own minds, not from the mouth of the Lord .

source: Amahon einahsah louho henga, Pakaiyin asei ahi, nanghon chamna nanei diu ahi, atiuve. Chule amahon amaho lungngaito banga chonho mitin henga chun, nachunga thilse imacha chuponte, atiuve.
target: They keep saying to those who despise me, ‘The Lord says: You will have peace.’ And to all who follow the stubbornness of their hearts they say, ‘No harm will come to you.’

source: Ajehchu Pakai thumop na-a koi gadinga, athu ja-a koiham?
target: But which of them has stood in the council of the Lord to see or to hear his word? Who has listened and heard his word?

source: Vetan, Pakai lungsatna chimpei khohtah ngeichu ahung nunge, hichu migilou luchunga khohtah-a chuding ahi.
target: See, the storm of the Lord will burst out in wrath, a whirlwind swirling down on the heads of the wicked.

source: Pakai lunghanna chu atohdoh kahsehle, alung ngaito amolso kahse-a kilekit louding ahin, ninunung tengle chamkimtah-a nahet them diu ahi.
target: The anger of the Lord will not turn back until he fully accomplishes the purposes of his heart. In days to come you will understand it clearly.

source: Hiche themgaohohi kasol ahipon, hijongle alhaijun, kenla amaho thu kamoppon, ahinla agaochanguve.
target: I did not send these prophets, yet they have run with their message; I did not speak to them, yet they have prophesied.

source: Ahinla amaho kathumopna-a dinga hiuhenlang, kamite kathu ajahsah-u hile, amahon alampiu phalouva kon chule athilbolu phalouva kona alehei diu ahi.
target: But if they had stood in my council, they would have proclaimed my words to my people and would have turned them from their evil ways and from their evil deeds.

source: Keima naitah-a um Pathen, gamlatah-a umlou Pathen chu kahilou ham? tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Am I only a God nearby,” declares the Lord , “and not a God far away?

source: Kamuthei louna dinga munthipma kiseljouva mi umintem? Pakai jin ati. Keima vanle leisetna dimsoh kahilouham? tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Who can hide in secret places so that I cannot see them?” declares the Lord . “Do not I fill heaven and earth?” declares the Lord .

source: Kamina jouva gaova themgaoho thusei kajan, mang kaneije, mang kaneije, atiuve.
target: “I have heard what the prophets say who prophesy lies in my name. They say, ‘I had a dream! I had a dream!’

source: Jouva gaothusei themgaoho lungsunga itih chanpi hichehi umding ham? Henge, amaho alungsung uva mijoulhep themgaoho ahiuve.
target: How long will this continue in the hearts of these lying prophets, who prophesy the delusions of their own minds?

source: Apateuvin Baal jeh-a kamin asuhmil banguva, aheng akomuva mitinin amang aseijuva, kamite chu kamin suhmilsahna ding angaitou ahi.
target: They think the dreams they tell one another will make my people forget my name, just as their ancestors forgot my name through Baal worship.

source: Mangnei themgaovin mangthu seihen lang, kathu neija chun kathu tahsan umtah-in seihen: suhlouchang dinga asi chu ipi ham? tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Let the prophet who has a dream recount the dream, but let the one who has my word speak it faithfully. For what has straw to do with grain?” declares the Lord .

source: Kathuhi meikong tobang hilou ham? tin Pakaiyin aseije. Songpi disela vokeh sehtum tobang hilou ham?
target: “Is not my word like fire,” declares the Lord , “and like a hammer that breaks a rock in pieces?

source: Hijeh chun vetan, keiman aheng akoma kona kathu gumang themgao takip chu kadou ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Therefore,” declares the Lord , “I am against the prophets who steal from one another words supposedly from me.

source: Veovin, aman aseije, tia aleiju mangcha-a themgaoho chu keiman kadouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Yes,” declares the Lord , “I am against the prophets who wag their own tongues and yet declare, ‘The Lord declares.’

source: Veovin, mang dihlou gaothua seija miho hille-a, ajounaole anahsahmo naova kamite puise-a, keisola hilou, thu kapeh jong hilouho chu kadou ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Hijeh achu hiche mitehi aphatchom sah louhel diu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Indeed, I am against those who prophesy false dreams,” declares the Lord . “They tell them and lead my people astray with their reckless lies, yet I did not send or appoint them. They do not benefit these people in the least,” declares the Lord .

source: Hiche mitele themgao, ahiloule thempu khattouvin, Pakai pohgih chu ipiham? tia nadoh ule, chuteng nangin ajah uva, ipi pohgih ham? Nangho tahhi kapaidoh ding nahiuve, tin Pakaiyin aseije, tin seijin.
target: “When these people, or a prophet or a priest, ask you, ‘What is the message from the Lord ?’ say to them, ‘What message? I will forsake you, declares the Lord .’

source: Chule Pakai pohgih, tia seiding themgaole thempu mipa thudol chu, chuche mipa tahle a-insung chu talen kapeh ding ahi.
target: If a prophet or a priest or anyone else claims, ‘This is a message from the Lord ,’ I will punish them and their household.

source: Mitinin aheng akomchehle asopipa cheh henga, Pakaiyin ipi adonbut nem? Chule Pakaiyin ipi aseijem? tia nasei diu ahi.
target: This is what each of you keeps saying to your friends and other Israelites: ‘What is the Lord ’s answer?’ or ‘What has the Lord spoken?’

source: Chule Pakai pohgih tia naphahpoh kit loudiu ahitai. Ajehchu amitakip thu chu ama pohgih hiding, ajehchu i-Pathen'u janel Pakai Pathen hingjing thu chu akaleh-in nahei gamtaove.
target: But you must not mention ‘a message from the Lord ’ again, because each one’s word becomes their own message. So you distort the words of the living God, the Lord Almighty, our God.

source: Themgaopa henga chu hiti ahi nasei ding ahi, Pakaiyin ipi nadonbut nem? Chule Pakaiyin ipi aseijem?
target: This is what you keep saying to a prophet: ‘What is the Lord ’s answer to you?’ or ‘What has the Lord spoken?’

source: Ahinla Pakai pohgih chu, nati uva pat hiche thu nasei jeh-un, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Pakai pohgih chu tia nasei jeh-un, Pakai pohgih chu natikit loudiu ahi, tia naheng uva thu kahinthot ahi.
target: Although you claim, ‘This is a message from the Lord ,’ this is what the Lord says: You used the words, ‘This is a message from the Lord ,’ even though I told you that you must not claim, ‘This is a message from the Lord .’

source: Hijeh chun, ven kei keimatah-in nangho kasuhmil uva, nanghole napateu kapehsa khopi chu kapaidoh-a, ka-angsunga kona kaledoh diu nahiuve.
target: Therefore, I will surely forget you and cast you out of my presence along with the city I gave to you and your ancestors.

source: Chule a-itih-a nachung uva housetnale tonsot jachatna kahin pohlut khumuva, hichu suhmiltih umtalou ding ahi, ati.
target: I will bring on you everlasting disgrace—everlasting shame that will not be forgotten.”

source: Babylon lengpa Nabuchadnezzer in, Judah leng Jehoiakim chapa Jeconiah le Judah milenho, thingthem hole thihthem ho Jerusalem'a kona Babylon'a apuimang nungin Pakaiyin Pakai houin maija chun theichang pocha ni einamu sah-in ahi.
target: After Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah and the officials, the skilled workers and the artisans of Judah were carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Lord showed me two baskets of figs placed in front of the temple of the Lord .

source: Pocha khat chu theichang phatah, theichang gamasapen tobang hel ahin, pocha khatjoh chu theichang phaloubeh, nehthei louhel, phamo behseh jeng ahi.
target: One basket had very good figs, like those that ripen early; the other basket had very bad figs, so bad they could not be eaten.

source: Chujouvin Pakai chun kajah-a, Jeremiah ipi namu em? eiti, chuin keiman theichang ho kati; theichang phaho chu aphalheh-in, chule phaloutah nehthei louhel, chuti phatmo jeng ahi, kati.
target: Then the Lord asked me, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” “Figs,” I answered. “The good ones are very good, but the bad ones are so bad they cannot be eaten.”

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin aseije,
target: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Pakai Israelte Pathen'in hitin aseije, hiche theichang phamoho bangahi Judah mite, hiche mun'a kona Chaldea gama kasoldohho, gal hinga kikaiho chu aphatna diuva kahet ding ahi.
target: “This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘Like these good figs, I regard as good the exiles from Judah, whom I sent away from this place to the land of the Babylonians.

source: Ajehchu achunguva aphatna diuva kavet lhih jinga, hiche gamahi kahinlepui ding: kasahdoh-a kasotlhuh lou ding, kaphudetna kabodoh lou ding ahitai.
target: My eyes will watch over them for their good, and I will bring them back to this land. I will build them up and not tear them down; I will plant them and not uproot them.

source: Keima Pakai kahi ahetdohna diu lungthim khat kapeh-a, amaho kamite hiuva, keima a-Pathen'u kahi ding ahi. Ajehchu amaho alung pumpiuva kahenga hungkile diu ahitai.
target: I will give them a heart to know me, that I am the Lord . They will be my people, and I will be their God, for they will return to me with all their heart.

source: Theichang phalou, nehthei hilou, chuti phatmo bang chun tahbeh-in Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Judah lengpa Zedekiah le amilenho Jerusalem'a umden, hiche gama amohho, chule Egypt gamsunga chengho chu, chutia chu kapehdoh ding:
target: “ ‘But like the bad figs, which are so bad they cannot be eaten,’ says the Lord , ‘so will I deal with Zedekiah king of Judah, his officials and the survivors from Jerusalem, whether they remain in this land or live in Egypt.

source: chule kanomangna ding mun jouse-a, seisetle thuchih dinga seichahle gaosap dinga, leiset lenggam jouse-a akisuh khahna diuva chaulele dinga kapehdoh ding ahiuve.
target: I will make them abhorrent and an offense to all the kingdoms of the earth, a reproach and a byword, a curse and an object of ridicule, wherever I banish them.

source: Chule keiman amahole apateu kanapehsa gama kona amanthah hel kahseuva alah uva chemjam, kellhah, hiset kasolpeh ding ahiuve.
target: I will send the sword, famine and plague against them until they are destroyed from the land I gave to them and their ancestors.’ ”

source: Judah lengpa Josiah chapa Jehoiakim lengchan kal kumli channa-a, Judah mite jouse chungchang thudol Jeremiah henga hung lhung chu Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar lengchan kumkhatna ahin,
target: The word came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, which was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.

source: hichu Jeremiah themgaovin Judah mite jousele Jerusalem'a chengte jouse henga aseije.
target: So Jeremiah the prophet said to all the people of Judah and to all those living in Jerusalem:

source: Judah leng Amon chapa Josiah kum somle kumthum na-a pat tuni geijin hichu kum somni le kumthum ahin, Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, keiman naheng uva kaseijin, matah-in kathouvin, kaseijin, ahinla nangaipouve.
target: For twenty-three years—from the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah until this very day—the word of the Lord has come to me and I have spoken to you again and again, but you have not listened.

source: Chule Pakaiyin naheng uva asohte themgaoho jouse ahinsolin, jingpi-a thouvin ahinsolin, ahinla nanghon nangaipeh pouvin, jahdin jong nanau nasung pouve.
target: And though the Lord has sent all his servants the prophets to you again and again, you have not listened or paid any attention.

source: Amahon aseijun, amitakip tuhin alampi phalouva konle thilphalou nabol uva konin hungkileu hen lang, Pakaiyin nanghole napateu atonsot tonsotna dinga anapeh gama chun chengtauvin.
target: They said, “Turn now, each of you, from your evil ways and your evil practices, and you can stay in the land the Lord gave to you and your ancestors for ever and ever.

source: Chule pathen dangho chu jendingle hou dingin juidaovin lang, nakhutsoh uva lunghansah din neiphinse hih uvin, chutile bolsetda taovinge.
target: Do not follow other gods to serve and worship them; do not arouse my anger with what your hands have made. Then I will not harm you.”

source: Ahijengvangin kathu nangaipouvin, hitichun nakisuh khahna diuva nakhutsoh uva lunghansah din neiphinse uvin, ahi tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “But you did not listen to me,” declares the Lord , “and you have aroused my anger with what your hands have made, and you have brought harm to yourselves.”

source: Hijeh chun janel Pakaiyin hitihin aseije, nanghon kathu nangailou jeh un:
target: Therefore the Lord Almighty says this: “Because you have not listened to my words,

source: Veuvin, mi solingting sahlam gama insung jousele kasoh Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar hiche gam dou dingle asunga chengho, chule akimvela namho jouse sumanghel dinga kahinpuija, amaho chun kidang asah-va cheh sasa diu, chule a-itih-a kamhela kalha ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will summon all the peoples of the north and my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon,” declares the Lord , “and I will bring them against this land and its inhabitants and against all the surrounding nations. I will completely destroy them and make them an object of horror and scorn, and an everlasting ruin.

source: Chukalvala amaho-a kona kipana ogin, thanopna ogin, moulang ogin, mounu ogin, sumhei song kiheh gin, chule thaomeivah kasuhbei ding ahi.
target: I will banish from them the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of bride and bridegroom, the sound of millstones and the light of the lamp.

source: Hiche gam pumpihi kamhelle datmotah-a umding, hiche namho chun Babylon lengpa chu kum somsagi ajendiu ahi.
target: This whole country will become a desolate wasteland, and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

source: Chule kum somsagi lhinteng hiti ding ahi, akhangit lounao jeh-a Babylon lengpa chule hiche Chaldea mite gam chu talen kapeh-a a-itih-a dinga kamhela kalha ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “But when the seventy years are fulfilled, I will punish the king of Babylon and his nation, the land of the Babylonians, for their guilt,” declares the Lord , “and will make it desolate forever.

source: Chule hiche gam douna-a kaseisa thuho jouse nam jouse douna-a Jeremiah themgaovin anasei, hiche lekhabu kisun jouse ngei chu kahin lhunsah ding ahi.
target: I will bring on that land all the things I have spoken against it, all that are written in this book and prophesied by Jeremiah against all the nations.

source: Ajehchu amahon nam tamtah le leng lenho ajendiu, atoh-u dungjuile akhuttah uva athilbolu dungjuija kalethuh ding ahi.
target: They themselves will be enslaved by many nations and great kings; I will repay them according to their deeds and the work of their hands.”

source: Ajehchu Israelte Pathen Pakai chun kahenga hitin aseije, kakhutna lunghanna khonhi lanlang, kasolna ding namho jouse chu donsah in.
target: This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, said to me: “Take from my hand this cup filled with the wine of my wrath and make all the nations to whom I send you drink it.

source: Chule amahon adonuva alah uva kasol ding chemjamho jeh-a chu lonle leuva ngoldiu ahi.
target: When they drink it, they will stagger and go mad because of the sword I will send among them.”

source: Chuin Pakai khutna khon chu kalan, Pakaiyin eisolna namho jouse chu kadonsah in ahi.
target: So I took the cup from the Lord ’s hand and made all the nations to whom he sent me drink it:

source: Jerusalem le Judah khopiho, chua lenghole milenho chu tulai bangahi kamhela, datmo uma, leihit khongleuva gaosapma umsah dingin,
target: Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, its kings and officials, to make them a ruin and an object of horror and scorn, a curse—as they are today;

source: Egypt lengpa Pharaoh le asohte, chule amilentele amipite:
target: Pharaoh king of Egypt, his attendants, his officials and all his people,

source: Mi kichoh hal ho jousele Uz gamsunga lengho jouse, Philistine gamsunga lengho jouse, chule Ashkelon, Azzah, Ekron chule Ashdod na amoh um jouse,
target: and all the foreign people there; all the kings of Uz; all the kings of the Philistines (those of Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the people left at Ashdod);

source: Edom le Moab, chule Ammon chate,
target: Edom, Moab and Ammon;

source: Trye lengte jousele Zidon lengte jouse, chule twipi gala twikol gamho lengte,
target: all the kings of Tyre and Sidon; the kings of the coastlands across the sea;

source: Dedan, Tema, Buz chule gamningkoi kikhonnaho jouse,
target: Dedan, Tema, Buz and all who are in distant places;

source: Arabia lengho jousele nelphaija cheng michoplop ho jouse,
target: all the kings of Arabia and all the kings of the foreign people who live in the wilderness;

source: Zimri lengte jousele Elam lengte jouse, chule Media lengte jouse,
target: all the kings of Zimri, Elam and Media;

source: Chule naija gamla sahlam gamkai lengho jouse khat khatna, lei chunga vannoi lenggam jouse, chule amaho nunga chu Sheshach lengpan adon ding ahi.
target: and all the kings of the north, near and far, one after the other—all the kingdoms on the face of the earth. And after all of them, the king of Sheshak will drink it too.

source: Hijeh achu ajah uva Israel Pathen janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, donun lang kham uvin, chule phidohun lang lhu uvin, thoukit tahih un. Nalah uva kahinsol ding chemjam jehchun, tia nasei ding ahi.
target: “Then tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Drink, get drunk and vomit, and fall to rise no more because of the sword I will send among you.’

source: Chule hiti ding ahi, amahon nakhutna khon chu lah-a donding adaova ahile, nangman ajah uva, janel Pakaiyin nadon teidiu ahi ati, nati ding ahi.
target: But if they refuse to take the cup from your hand and drink, tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty says: You must drink it!

source: Ajehchu ven, kamina kivo hiche khopi chunga thilse kahin pohlut patding ahitan, nangho talen manlouvin umun natem? Nangho talen manlouvin umpouvin nate: ajehchu leiset chung cheng jouse chunga chemjam kakou ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: See, I am beginning to bring disaster on the city that bears my Name, and will you indeed go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, for I am calling down a sword on all who live on the earth, declares the Lord Almighty.’

source: Hijeh chun amaho jouse dounan hiche thuho hi gaovin, ajah uva seijin, chunga konin Pakai hung kitumin tin, achenna munthenga konin a-aw hinsodohin tin, thanei tah-a muntheng chunga kituma, lengpiga chilho banga, leiset chunga cheng jouse douna-a aoding ahi.
target: “Now prophesy all these words against them and say to them: “ ‘The Lord will roar from on high; he will thunder from his holy dwelling and roar mightily against his land. He will shout like those who tread the grapes, shout against all who live on the earth.

source: Leiset kolmong geija aw khat kitollele ding ahi, ajehchu Pakaiyin nam jouse toh kinelna aneijin, aman tahsa hing jouse thu atanna, migiloute jouse chemhema apehdoh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: The tumult will resound to the ends of the earth, for the Lord will bring charges against the nations; he will bring judgment on all mankind and put the wicked to the sword,’ ” declares the Lord .

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, vetan, setna chu nam khatna kona nam khatna kitollele ding, chule leiset kolmonga kona chimpei nasatah hungnung ding ahi.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “Look! Disaster is spreading from nation to nation; a mighty storm is rising from the ends of the earth.”

source: Chule chuche ni-a Pakai mitha chu leiset kolmong langkhatna pat langkhat gei hiding ahin, amaho chu kilunghempi louding, kichom khom lou dingu, vui jong kivui louding, amaho leichunga eh-a pangdiu ahi.
target: At that time those slain by the Lord will be everywhere—from one end of the earth to the other. They will not be mourned or gathered up or buried, but will be like dung lying on the ground.

source: Nangho kelngoiching ho pengun lang kapmun, nangho kelngoihon lah-a pipuiho vut lah-a kilih leuvin, ajehchu nakithana diule naki thecheh na diu nikho abulhing tai. Chule dei umtah um le bel banga nalhahmang diu ahi.
target: Weep and wail, you shepherds; roll in the dust, you leaders of the flock. For your time to be slaughtered has come; you will fall like the best of the rams.

source: Kelngoichingpan jamna ding ahetlou ding, kelngoihon lah-a pipuipan jong hoidohna ding aneilou ding ahi.
target: The shepherds will have nowhere to flee, the leaders of the flock no place to escape.

source: Kelngoiching ho ka awgin le, kelngoihon pipuipa pen awgin kija ding ahi. Ajehchu Pakaiyin ahamhing jouse asuhmang pehtai.
target: Hear the cry of the shepherds, the wailing of the leaders of the flock, for the Lord is destroying their pasture.

source: Chule tijat umtah Pakai lungsat jeh-in mongtah-a chennaho akisumang tai.
target: The peaceful meadows will be laid waste because of the fierce anger of the Lord .

source: Aman keipibahkai chal bangin akiselna adalhatai. Ajehchu suhgentheina tijat umjehle, alungsatna tijat umtah jeh-in gamsung chu akamheltai.
target: Like a lion he will leave his lair, and their land will become desolate because of the sword of the oppressor and because of the Lord ’s fierce anger.

source: Judah lengpa Josiah chapa Jehoiakim lengchan kipat in, Pakaiya konin hiche thuhi ahung lhungin,
target: Early in the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came from the Lord :

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Pakai houin leitola dingin lang, Pakai insunga chibai boh-a hung, Judah khopiho jouse jah-a, ajah uva sei dinga kathupeh thujouse chu cheng khatcha lhajah louvin seijin.
target: “This is what the Lord says: Stand in the courtyard of the Lord ’s house and speak to all the people of the towns of Judah who come to worship in the house of the Lord . Tell them everything I command you; do not omit a word.

source: Hiti achu amahon angaijuva, alampi phalouva kona amitakip akileheijule, amaho thilse bol jeh-a achunguva bol dinga kagotsa thilse akona kalung kisih thei ahi.
target: Perhaps they will listen and each will turn from their evil ways. Then I will relent and not inflict on them the disaster I was planning because of the evil they have done.

source: Chule nangin ajah uva, Pakaiyin hitin ati, nanghon namasanguva kakoi kadanthupeh najuidinguva;
target: Say to them, ‘This is what the Lord says: If you do not listen to me and follow my law, which I have set before you,

source: naheng uva kahinsol kasohte themgaoho, matah-a thouva hungkisol ho thuho ngai ding golouva nadon daole,
target: and if you do not listen to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I have sent to you again and again (though you have not listened),

source: chuteng hiche inhi Shiloh kabahsah-a, leiset nam jouse gaosap kahisah ding ahi.
target: then I will make this house like Shiloh and this city a curse among all the nations of the earth.’ ”

source: Hitichun thempuho le themgaoho chule mijousen Pakai insunga Jeremiah thusei chu ajataove.
target: The priests, the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speak these words in the house of the Lord .

source: Tun ahitin ahi, mipi ho jouse henga sei dinga Pakaiyin athupeh Jeremiah in aseichai phatnin, thempuho le themgaoho, chule mijouse chun ama chu amanun, nathitei ding ahi, atiuve.
target: But as soon as Jeremiah finished telling all the people everything the Lord had commanded him to say, the priests, the prophets and all the people seized him and said, “You must die!

source: Ibola nangma Pakai mina nagao chana, hiche inhi Shiloh bang ding, chule hiche khopiho chenna louva kamhel ding ahi natiham? atiuve. Chuin mipi ho chu Pakai insunga chun Jeremiah dounan akikhom taove.
target: Why do you prophesy in the Lord ’s name that this house will be like Shiloh and this city will be desolate and deserted?” And all the people crowded around Jeremiah in the house of the Lord .

source: Judah milenhon hiche thu chu ajah phatnun, leng ina konin Pakai ina ahung touvun, Pakai in lutna kotpi thah-a chun atoutaove.
target: When the officials of Judah heard about these things, they went up from the royal palace to the house of the Lord and took their places at the entrance of the New Gate of the Lord ’s house.

source: Chuin thempuho le themgaoho, milenhole mipi jouse jah-a chun, hichepahi thi dinga lom ahi. Ajehchu nanghon nanauva najah bangu chun hiche khopi dounan gaothu aseije, atiuve.
target: Then the priests and the prophets said to the officials and all the people, “This man should be sentenced to death because he has prophesied against this city. You have heard it with your own ears!”

source: Chuin Jeremiah in milenho jousele mipi jouse jah-a, Pakaiyin hiche inle hiche khopi douna-a nanghon najah-u thu jousehi gao dinga eihinsol ahi.
target: Then Jeremiah said to all the officials and all the people: “The Lord sent me to prophesy against this house and this city all the things you have heard.

source: Hijeh chun tun nalampiule nathil bolu kisem phatnun lang, Pakai na-Pathen'u thu ngaijun, chutile Pakaiyin nangho douna-a thilse aphondohsa chu alung kisih kit ding ahi.
target: Now reform your ways and your actions and obey the Lord your God. Then the Lord will relent and not bring the disaster he has pronounced against you.

source: Keidin vang, veuvin, nakhut uva um kahi. Pha nasah bangule nadei bangun neibol taovin.
target: As for me, I am in your hands; do with me whatever you think is good and right.

source: Ahinla kichentah-in heuvin, keima neithauva ahile nanghotah leh hiche khopi chule asunga chengho chungahi setnabei thisan nakipohlut teidiu ahi. Ajehchu hiche thu jouse naheng uva sei dinga Pakaiyin eihinsol tahmong ahi, ati.
target: Be assured, however, that if you put me to death, you will bring the guilt of innocent blood on yourselves and on this city and on those who live in it, for in truth the Lord has sent me to you to speak all these words in your hearing.”

source: Chujouvin milenhole mipi jousen thempuho le themgaoho henga chun, hichepahi thi dinga lom ahipoi. Ajehchu aman ihenguva Pakai i-Pathen'u mina thu asei ahi, atiuve.
target: Then the officials and all the people said to the priests and the prophets, “This man should not be sentenced to death! He has spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God.”

source: Chujouvin gamsunga upa phabep akipatdoh- un, mipi akikhomho jouse henga chun aseijun,
target: Some of the elders of the land stepped forward and said to the entire assembly of people,

source: Judah lengpa Hezekiah nikho laijin Morasthih mi Micah anagao changin, Judah mite jouse jah-a janel Pakaiyin hitin anati, Zion chu lou banga kikaija, Jerusalem chu alhuh-a umding, chule insahna mol chu gammang munsang bang ding ahi, anatin ahi.
target: “Micah of Moresheth prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. He told all the people of Judah, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty says: “ ‘Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, the temple hill a mound overgrown with thickets.’

source: Judah lengpa Hezekiah le Judah mijouse chun anatha beh monguvem? Aman Pakai agingin, Pakai chu angeh in, Pakaiyin amaho douna-a thilse anaphondohsa chu alung kisih kit hilouham? Hiti achu ihinnao douna-a thil setah ikilhut khumdiu ahi, atiuve.
target: “Did Hezekiah king of Judah or anyone else in Judah put him to death? Did not Hezekiah fear the Lord and seek his favor? And did not the Lord relent, so that he did not bring the disaster he pronounced against them? We are about to bring a terrible disaster on ourselves!”

source: Chule Kirjath-jearim mi, Shemaiah chapa Urijah kiti mi khat jong Pakai minin anagaovin, aman hiche khopi dounale hiche gam douna in, Jeremiah thusei dungjuijin anagaovin:
target: (Now Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath Jearim was another man who prophesied in the name of the Lord ; he prophesied the same things against this city and this land as Jeremiah did.

source: Chuin Jehoiakim lengpan, agal hat ho jousele milenho jousen ajah phatnun, lengpan ama chu thadin aholtai. Ahinla Urijah in hichu ajah phatnin, akichatan, ajamin Egypt gama achetai.
target: When King Jehoiakim and all his officers and officials heard his words, the king was determined to put him to death. But Uriah heard of it and fled in fear to Egypt.

source: Chuin Jehoiakim lengpan Achbor chapa amin Elnathan chu mi phabep khatto Egypt gama chun asolin ahi.
target: King Jehoiakim, however, sent Elnathan son of Akbor to Egypt, along with some other men.

source: Chuin Urijah chu Egypt gama konin agamandoh-un, Jehoiakim lengpa henga ahinpuijun, aman chemjamin athatnin milhamho lhan sunga athilong chu asepluttai.
target: They brought Uriah out of Egypt and took him to King Jehoiakim, who had him struck down with a sword and his body thrown into the burial place of the common people.)

source: Ahijengvangin amahon ama chu mipi khutna tha dinga apehdoh louna dingun Shaphan chapa Ahikam khut chun Jeremiah chu aumpin ahi.
target: Furthermore, Ahikam son of Shaphan supported Jeremiah, and so he was not handed over to the people to be put to death.

source: Judah leng Josiah chapa Jehoiakim lengchan kipat in Pakaiya konin Jeremiah henga hiche thuhi ahung lhungin aseije.
target: Early in the reign of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord :

source: Pakaiyin kahenga hitin aseije, namkoljon kisemin lang nangonga kivonlang,
target: This is what the Lord said to me: “Make a yoke out of straps and crossbars and put it on your neck.

source: hiho chu Edom lengpa, Moab lengpa, Ammon lengpa, Tyre lengpa, Zidon lengpa henga, Jerusalem'a Judah lengpa Zedekiah henga palai hungjiho khutna gahthot temin,
target: Then send word to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre and Sidon through the envoys who have come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.

source: chule apakaiteu henga asei diuvin thu pen, janel Pakai Israelte Pathen'in hitin aseije, tia apakaiteu henga nasei diu ahi.
target: Give them a message for their masters and say, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: “Tell this to your masters:

source: Keiman kathilboltheina nasatahle kaban lhang doh-a, leiset chule achunga um mihemle ganhinghohi kasema, hichu pha kasahsah kapehji ahi.
target: With my great power and outstretched arm I made the earth and its people and the animals that are on it, and I give it to anyone I please.

source: Chule tuahi keiman hiche gamhohi kasohpa Babylon leng Nebuchadnezzar khutna kapehdoh ahitai. Chule gamlah-a, ganhingho jong ama jen dinga kapehtha ahitai.
target: Now I will give all your countries into the hands of my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; I will make even the wild animals subject to him.

source: Chule ama gam mongmong chu ahunglhun kahsen nam jousen ama, achapa, achapa chapa ajen diu ahi.
target: All nations will serve him and his son and his grandson until the time for his land comes; then many nations and great kings will subjugate him.

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar jen nomlou chuche namle lenggam, chule Babylon lengpa namkoljon noija angong donomlou, chuche nam chu chemjam'a, kela, hise-a, ama khutna chu kasuh manghel kahse-a talen kapeh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseijin ahi.
target: “ ‘ “If, however, any nation or kingdom will not serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon or bow its neck under his yoke, I will punish that nation with the sword, famine and plague, declares the Lord , until I destroy it by his hand.

source: Hijeh chun nathemgao hou, na-aisan hou, namang neihou, ailhim themho, doithemho, naheng uva Babylon lengpa najen lou diu ahi, tiho thu ngaihih-un.
target: So do not listen to your prophets, your diviners, your interpreters of dreams, your mediums or your sorcerers who tell you, ‘You will not serve the king of Babylon.’

source: Ajehchu amahon, nagam uva kona gamlatah-a nakichona diu, kanomangna diu, namanthaina diuva thujouva gaova ahiuve.
target: They prophesy lies to you that will only serve to remove you far from your lands; I will banish you and you will perish.
