source: Ahinla Babylon lengpa namkoljon noija angong do-a, jenho chu, agamuva kaumden sah-a, aleisetnu akilhouva, chengden diu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: But if any nation will bow its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him, I will let that nation remain in its own land to till it and to live there, declares the Lord .” ’ ”

source: Hiche thuho jouse banghin Judah lengpa Zedekiah henga jong kaseijin, Babylon lengpa namkoljon noija na-ngong donlang amale amite jenin lang, hingin tin kaseije.
target: I gave the same message to Zedekiah king of Judah. I said, “Bow your neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon; serve him and his people, and you will live.

source: Babylon lengpa jen nomlou nam douna-a Pakaiyin anasei chemjam, kel, chule hise-a kona nanghole namite ibola nathi jeng diuham?
target: Why will you and your people die by the sword, famine and plague with which the Lord has threatened any nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

source: Hijeh chun, Babylon lengpa najen lou diu ahi, tia themgaoho thusei chu ngaihih-un, ajehchu amahon naheng uva jouva gao ahiuve.
target: Do not listen to the words of the prophets who say to you, ‘You will not serve the king of Babylon,’ for they are prophesying lies to you.

source: Ajehchu keiman amaho kasolpoi, tin Pakaiyin aseije; ahijengvangin amahon kaminin, nangho kanomang theina dingule namanthah theina dinguva, nanghole naheng uva gaochangho, namanthah theina dinguva jouthu-a gaochang ahiuve, ati.
target: ‘I have not sent them,’ declares the Lord . ‘They are prophesying lies in my name. Therefore, I will banish you and you will perish, both you and the prophets who prophesy to you.’ ”

source: Keiman thempuho le hiche miteho jouse henga jong kaseijin Pakaiyin hitin ati, veuvin, Pakai ina umle belho chu Babylon'a kona hung kiletol vahding ahitai, tia gaova themgaoho thu ngaihih-un, amaho thujouva gao ahitaove, kati.
target: Then I said to the priests and all these people, “This is what the Lord says: Do not listen to the prophets who say, ‘Very soon now the articles from the Lord ’s house will be brought back from Babylon.’ They are prophesying lies to you.

source: Amaho thu ngaihih-un, Babylon lengpa jenun lang, hinguvin, ibola hiche khopi kamhela umding ham?
target: Do not listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon, and you will live. Why should this city become a ruin?

source: Ahinla amaho themgao ahiuve, Pakai thu amaho-a auma ahile, janel Pakai henga tuhin Pakai ina kidalha umle bel ho, chule Judah lengpa insungale Jerusalem'a ho Babylon'a akitol louna dingin, tuhin taovuhen.
target: If they are prophets and have the word of the Lord , let them plead with the Lord Almighty that the articles remaining in the house of the Lord and in the palace of the king of Judah and in Jerusalem not be taken to Babylon.

source: Ajehchu khomho, twikongho, akitun naho, chule hiche khopi sunga um le bel amoh kidalha ho chungchang thu chu janel Pakaiyin aseijin;
target: For this is what the Lord Almighty says about the pillars, the bronze Sea, the movable stands and the other articles that are left in this city,

source: Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in, Jerusalem'a kona Babylon gamgeija Judah lengpa Jehoiakim chapa Jeconiah le Jerusalem'a umle bel ho, milenho jouse gal hinga akai laija anapoh lou ahi.
target: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take away when he carried Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon, along with all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem—

source: Pakai ina kidalha, Judah lengpa inle Jerusalem'a umle bel ho chungchang thu chu janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije.
target: yes, this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says about the things that are left in the house of the Lord and in the palace of the king of Judah and in Jerusalem:

source: Hitiho chu Babylon'a kipoding, keiman amaho kavil kahse-a, chuachu umdiu ahi, tin Pakai chun aseije; chujoule keiman kale poh-a hiche munahi avela kakoi kitding ahi.
target: ‘They will be taken to Babylon and there they will remain until the day I come for them,’ declares the Lord . ‘Then I will bring them back and restore them to this place.’ ”

source: Chuin Judah lengpa Zedekiah lengchan kipat, kum mama chun ahitin ahi, akumlina lha nga lhina-a chun, Gibeon'a mi Azur chapa Hananiah themgao chun, Pakai insunga thempuho le mipi ho angsung tah-a kahenga thu aseijin,
target: In the fifth month of that same year, the fourth year, early in the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur, who was from Gibeon, said to me in the house of the Lord in the presence of the priests and all the people:

source: Janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitihin aseije, keiman Babylon lengpa namkoljon kasubong tai, atie ati.
target: “This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

source: Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in hiche mun'a kona alahdoh-a, Babylon'a apoh Pakai ina umle belho jouse chu, kumni lhin sunga hiche munahi kahin pohlut kit ding ahitai.
target: Within two years I will bring back to this place all the articles of the Lord ’s house that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon removed from here and took to Babylon.

source: Keima Judah leng Jehoiakim chapa Jeconiah le Judah mi sohchang jouse Babylon'a cheho chu, hiche munahi kahin puikit ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, ajehchu Babylon lengpa namkoljon kaheboh ding ahitai, ati.
target: I will also bring back to this place Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah and all the other exiles from Judah who went to Babylon,’ declares the Lord , ‘for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’ ”

source: Chuin Jeremiah themgaovin Hananiah themgao henga chun themgaoho le Pakai insunga ding mipi jouse mitmu tah in aseijin:
target: Then the prophet Jeremiah replied to the prophet Hananiah before the priests and all the people who were standing in the house of the Lord .

source: Jeremiah themgao tahchun, hihen, Pakaiyin chutin bolhen, Pakai ina umle belhole gal hinga kikai jouse chu, Babylon'a kona hiche mun'a hinlelhut kit dinga nagaona thu chu Pakaiyin molsohen.
target: He said, “Amen! May the Lord do so! May the Lord fulfill the words you have prophesied by bringing the articles of the Lord ’s house and all the exiles back to this place from Babylon.

source: Hijongle tu-a hiche nangle mijouse nakhanga jah dinga kaseihi ngaitemin.
target: Nevertheless, listen to what I have to say in your hearing and in the hearing of all the people:

source: Nangle kei masanga themgao luiho chun, gam tamtah le lenggam tamtah douna thule thilse chule hise thu anagao jiuve.
target: From early times the prophets who preceded you and me have prophesied war, disaster and plague against many countries and great kingdoms.

source: Themgao chamna thu gaopa chu, chuche themgaovin asei chu aguilhun tengle, themgaopa chu Pakai hinsol tahbeh ahi akihejie, ati.
target: But the prophet who prophesies peace will be recognized as one truly sent by the Lord only if his prediction comes true.”

source: Chuin Hananiah themgaovin Jeremiah themgao ngonga kona namkoljon chu alan, ahehbongtai.
target: Then the prophet Hananiah took the yoke off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah and broke it,

source: Chuin Hananiah-in mijouse anga chun, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar namkoljon chu nam jouse ngonga kona kumni lhingset sunga hiche bang ngeijahi kasuhboh ding ahi ati. Chuin Jeremiah themgao chu alampia akichetai.
target: and he said before all the people, “This is what the Lord says: ‘In the same way I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon off the neck of all the nations within two years.’ ” At this, the prophet Jeremiah went on his way.

source: Chuin Jeremiah themgao ngonga namkoljon chu Hananiah themgaovin aheboh jouvin Jeremiah themgao henga Pakai thu chu ahung lhungin aseije.
target: After the prophet Hananiah had broken the yoke off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:

source: Chenlang Hananiah gahilin, Pakaiyin hitin aseije. Nangman thing namkol ho chubou naheboh ahin, hicheho khela chu keiman thih namkol kahin semdoh ding ahi.
target: “Go and tell Hananiah, ‘This is what the Lord says: You have broken a wooden yoke, but in its place you will get a yoke of iron.

source: Ajehchu janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije. Amahon Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar kin aboltheina diuva hiche namho jouse ngonga thih namkoljon hi kabucheh ahitai. Amahon ajencheh diu ahi, gamsa jouse jong kapeh ahitai, ati ahungtin ahi.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I will put an iron yoke on the necks of all these nations to make them serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and they will serve him. I will even give him control over the wild animals.’ ”

source: Chuin Jeremiah themgaovin Hananiah themgao henga, ngaijin tun Hananiah, Pakaiyin nang nasolpoi, nangin hiche mitehohi jou khat natahsan sah ahibouve.
target: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, “Listen, Hananiah! The Lord has not sent you, yet you have persuaded this nation to trust in lies.

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin ati, vetan, leiset chunga kona kapaidoh ding nahi: Pakai douna-a douna thu nahil jeh-in, tukuma nathitei ding ahi, ati.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord says: ‘I am about to remove you from the face of the earth. This very year you are going to die, because you have preached rebellion against the Lord .’ ”

source: Hitichun Hananiah themgao chu chuche kum mama lha sagina in athitan ahi.
target: In the seventh month of that same year, Hananiah the prophet died.

source: Tun Nebuchadnezzar'in Babylon gama gal hing akaimangho, sohchang upaho, thempuho, themgaoho chule mipi ho jouse henga Jeremiah themgaovin Jerusalem'a kon lekha athot thuchengho chu hichehohi ahi.
target: This is the text of the letter that the prophet Jeremiah sent from Jerusalem to the surviving elders among the exiles and to the priests, the prophets and all the other people Nebuchadnezzar had carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.

source: (Jeconiah lengpa le lengnu, nukiso ho, Judah le Jerusalem'a milenho, thingthemho, thih suho, Jerusalem adalhah nungu chun):
target: (This was after King Jehoiachin and the queen mother, the court officials and the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, the skilled workers and the artisans had gone into exile from Jerusalem.)

source: Shaphan chapa Elasah, Hilkiah chapa Gemariah khutna lekha chu apohsah-in ahi (amani chu Judah lengpa Zedekiah'in Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar henga asol ahin):
target: He entrusted the letter to Elasah son of Shaphan and to Gemariah son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to King Nebuchadnezzar in Babylon. It said:

source: Janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in Jerusalem'a kona Babylon gama puimanga aumsah, akipuimang sohchangho henga hitin aseije.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says to all those I carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon:

source: Nanghon in kisah-un lang, hia chun chengun, chule hon kibolun lang aga chu neuvin.
target: “Build houses and settle down; plant gardens and eat what they produce.

source: Ji neijun lang chanu chapa hingun, nachapateo jiding puipeh unlang, nachanu teo inneipu ho peovin, chutile chanu chapa hinguntin, hia chun pungun natin kemsuh pouvin nate.
target: Marry and have sons and daughters; find wives for your sons and give your daughters in marriage, so that they too may have sons and daughters. Increase in number there; do not decrease.

source: Sohchanga kapuimang sahna lama khopi ho-a chun chamna chu holun, chule hiche ding chun Pakai henga taovun, ajehchu chukom cham na-a chu nanghon jong chamna nanei diu ahi.
target: Also, seek the peace and prosperity of the city to which I have carried you into exile. Pray to the Lord for it, because if it prospers, you too will prosper.”

source: Ajehchu janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, nalah uva um nathemgao hou le na-aisan hou chu kilheplhah sah hih helun; nahin mangmat diu namang hou jong nahsah hihhelun.
target: Yes, this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: “Do not let the prophets and diviners among you deceive you. Do not listen to the dreams you encourage them to have.

source: Ajehchu amaho thujouva kamina aisan ahiuvin, amaho kasol ahipouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: They are prophesying lies to you in my name. I have not sent them,” declares the Lord .

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Babylon'a kum somsagi alhin jouteng, kahin viluva hiche munahi nahung kilekitna dinguva, nangho dinga kathupha kasuh bulhit ding ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says: “When seventy years are completed for Babylon, I will come to you and fulfill my good promise to bring you back to this place.

source: Ajehchu nangho dinga kagon chu thilse hilou chamna, khonunga peh dinga kagon chu kahenai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: For I know the plans I have for you,” declares the Lord , “plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.

source: Chuteng neikouvun natin, kahenga hung taovun natin, keiman sanpeh taovinge.
target: Then you will call on me and come and pray to me, and I will listen to you.

source: Nanghon neiholun natin, nalung pumpi-a neihol tengule neimu diu ahi.
target: You will seek me and find me when you seek me with all your heart.

source: Namudoh-u hitange, tin Pakaiyin aseije, chule kadel mangnao mun jouse-a konle nam jouse-a konin chomkhom ungting, nasoh chanao kaheimang ding, kasoh chansah naova kona kahin lepui kit ding nahiuve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will be found by you,” declares the Lord , “and will bring you back from captivity. I will gather you from all the nations and places where I have banished you,” declares the Lord , “and will bring you back to the place from which I carried you into exile.”

source: Ajehchu nanghon Babylon gama jong Pakaiyin themgao eitundoh peh uve, nati uve.
target: You may say, “The Lord has raised up prophets for us in Babylon,”

source: David laltouna-a tou lengpa le hiche khopi sunga cheng mijouse, chule nang hotoh sohchanga chekhom lou nasopiteu Pakai chun hitin aseije, tiuvin.
target: but this is what the Lord says about the king who sits on David’s throne and all the people who remain in this city, your fellow citizens who did not go with you into exile—

source: Janel Pakai chun hitin aseije, vetan, amaho chunga chemjam'a, kel lhah-a, chule hise kasola, nehthei hilouhel aphatna phamo theichang banga kasem diu ahi.
target: yes, this is what the Lord Almighty says: “I will send the sword, famine and plague against them and I will make them like figs that are so bad they cannot be eaten.

source: Chule amaho chu chemjam, kel lhah-a, hise-a kasuhgentheija, leiset lenggam jouse-a chaulele dinga keiman kanochehna nam jouse lah-a chu gaosap dinga, datmo umleh chehsatna, seisetna tohding bepma kapehdoh diu:
target: I will pursue them with the sword, famine and plague and will make them abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth, a curse and an object of horror, of scorn and reproach, among all the nations where I drive them.

source: Ajehchu jingpi-a thouva kisoldoh kasohte themgaoho-a kona ahenguva kathu kathotho chu angaipouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ahinla nangainom pouve, tin Pakai jin aseije.
target: For they have not listened to my words,” declares the Lord , “words that I sent to them again and again by my servants the prophets. And you exiles have not listened either,” declares the Lord .

source: Hijeh chun Pakai thu chu, nangho Jerusalem'a kona Babylon'a sohchang hon ngaijun,
target: Therefore, hear the word of the Lord , all you exiles whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.

source: Israel Pathen janel Pakai chun Kolaiah chapa Ahab le Maaseiah chapa Zedekiah kamina jouthu-a gaoho chungchang thua chun hitin aseije, veuvin, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar khutna amaho chu kapehdoh ding, aman namitmu tah uva atha diu:
target: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says about Ahab son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying lies to you in my name: “I will deliver them into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will put them to death before your very eyes.

source: Amanu thu chu Babylon'a Judah sohchang jousen, Babylon lengpan meija asahgop Zedekiah le Ahab bang helin Pakaiyin nachunga bolhen.
target: Because of them, all the exiles from Judah who are in Babylon will use this curse: ‘May the Lord treat you like Zedekiah and Ahab, whom the king of Babylon burned in the fire.’

source: Ajehchu Israel gama setkhona hel amahon abolun, aheng akom jiteutoh ajongun, kathupeh louva kamina jou asei jeh-un, keima ngei ahe ale hettohsah kahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: For they have done outrageous things in Israel; they have committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and in my name they have uttered lies—which I did not authorize. I know it and am a witness to it,” declares the Lord .

source: Nehelam mite le Shemaiah henga jong hiti ahi nasei ding ahi, atin:
target: Tell Shemaiah the Nehelamite,

source: Janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, ajehchu nangin Jerusalem'a um mijouse hengale Maaseiah chapa Zephaniah thempu chule thempu jouse henga naminin lekha nathotnin hitin naseije.
target: “This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You sent letters in your own name to all the people in Jerusalem, to the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, and to all the other priests. You said to Zephaniah,

source: Pakaiyin Jehoiada thempu khelin thempun napansahtan, Pakai insunga vaipole-a pang ding nahin, ngolla kithemput sah tapou chu songkul'a nakhuma nahen ding ahi, ati.
target: ‘The Lord has appointed you priest in place of Jehoiada to be in charge of the house of the Lord ; you should put any maniac who acts like a prophet into the stocks and neck-irons.

source: Hijeh chun tun ibola amale ama neheng uva kithemput sah Anathoth mi Jeremiah chu napholou ham?
target: So why have you not reprimanded Jeremiah from Anathoth, who poses as a prophet among you?

source: Ajehchu Babylon gama kahenguva sohchana hi asotnin, in kisah unlang asunga chengun, hon kibolun lang aga neuvin, tin thu eihin thotnuve.
target: He has sent this message to us in Babylon: It will be a long time. Therefore build houses and settle down; plant gardens and eat what they produce.’ ”

source: Chuin Jephaniah thempun Jeremiah themgao jahdia lekhathot chu asime.
target: Zephaniah the priest, however, read the letter to Jeremiah the prophet.

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu Jeremiah henga ahung lhungin, aseije.
target: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:

source: Sohchangho jouse henga chun Nehelam mi Shemaiah thudol chu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Shemaiah'in kasol louva naheng uva jouthu natahsan sah jeh uvin:
target: “Send this message to all the exiles: ‘This is what the Lord says about Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, even though I did not send him, and has persuaded you to trust in lies,

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije, veuvin, keiman Nehelam mi Shemaiah le achilhah ho talen kapeh-a, hiche mite lah-a cheng ding khatcha aneilou ding, kamite dinga thilpha kabol ding jong chu amulou ding ahi, tin Pakai chun aseije. Ajehchu aman Pakai dounan thu anahilin ahi.
target: this is what the Lord says: I will surely punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his descendants. He will have no one left among this people, nor will he see the good things I will do for my people, declares the Lord , because he has preached rebellion against me.’ ”

source: Jeremiah henga Pakaiya kona thu hunglhung chu,
target: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord :

source: Pakai Israel Pathen chun hitin aseije, nahenga kathusei jouse chu lekhabu khatna sunin.
target: “This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘Write in a book all the words I have spoken to you.

source: Vetan, nikhoho chu ahung lhunge, tin Pakaiyin aseije, kamite Israel le Judah sohchangho chu kalepui kit ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin ati. Apateu kapehna gama kakilesah kitna hichu alo dingu ahi.
target: The days are coming,’ declares the Lord , ‘when I will bring my people Israel and Judah back from captivity and restore them to the land I gave their ancestors to possess,’ says the Lord .”

source: Hichehohi Israel le Judah chungchanga Pakai thusei chu ahi.
target: These are the words the Lord spoke concerning Israel and Judah:

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, keihon chamna thu hilou tijatna, awgin kithing selsul khat kajauve.
target: “This is what the Lord says: “ ‘Cries of fear are heard— terror, not peace.

source: Dong leuvin lang veleuvin, pasal'in nao avop ngaijem? I-atile pasal tapouvin numei naosonat thoh banga atai akisot cheh uva, amaiju dangdih deh-a sohdoh gama hitam?
target: Ask and see: Can a man bear children? Then why do I see every strong man with his hands on his stomach like a woman in labor, every face turned deathly pale?

source: Ohe, hiche nichu aloupi lheh-in, hitichun akibahpi aumpon, hichu Jacob hesoh phattah chu ahin, ahinla hichea kona chu ama huhdoh-a umding ahi.
target: How awful that day will be! No other will be like it. It will be a time of trouble for Jacob, but he will be saved out of it.

source: Ajehchu hiche ni chule hiti ding ahi, nangonga kona namkoljon chu kaheboh-a, ahennaho kasuhtan ding, chule gamdang min amaho soh-a aneitah lou diu ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “ ‘In that day,’ declares the Lord Almighty, ‘I will break the yoke off their necks and will tear off their bonds; no longer will foreigners enslave them.

source: Ahinla Pakai a-Pathen'ule, katundohpeh ding alengpao David ajenjoh diu ahi.
target: Instead, they will serve the Lord their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.

source: Hijeh chun Vo kasoh Jacob, kicha hih-in, chule vo Israel, lungthoi hih-in, ajehchu ven gamlatah-a kona nangmale nachilhahte kahuhdoh ding, Jacob chu hungkile kitna koimachan akichatsah lou ding ahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “ ‘So do not be afraid, Jacob my servant; do not be dismayed, Israel,’ declares the Lord . ‘I will surely save you out of a distant place, your descendants from the land of their exile. Jacob will again have peace and security, and no one will make him afraid.

source: Ajehchu nahuhhing dingin kaumpi jinge, tin Pakaiyin aseije: nangho kathecheh nao nam jouse akichainao boljong leng nangho kichaina vang bolhih laijing ting atin, ahinla thutah-a kasuhdih ding nahin, hijongle talen pelouva kalhadoh louhel ding nahi.
target: I am with you and will save you,’ declares the Lord . ‘Though I completely destroy all the nations among which I scatter you, I will not completely destroy you. I will discipline you but only in due measure; I will not let you go entirely unpunished.’

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, nakimavona chu damdoh theilou namaput chu nase behset ahi.
target: “This is what the Lord says: “ ‘Your wound is incurable, your injury beyond healing.

source: Nakikanchah theina din nathu seilhap pehdinga khatcha aumpoi, damna ding lou nanei hihhele.
target: There is no one to plead your cause, no remedy for your sore, no healing for you.

source: Nangailu jousen nasumil tan, nadon tapouve; nakhangitlouna atam behset jeh le nachonsetna punbe jing jeh-in, melma kimavona in kamavon, mi engse gimbolna in kagimboltai.
target: All your allies have forgotten you; they care nothing for you. I have struck you as an enemy would and punished you as would the cruel, because your guilt is so great and your sins so many.

source: Ibola nagim jeh-a kap nahim? nakhangit louna tambehset jeh-a, nalungkham nachu suhdam theihoi hilou ahitai. Nachonsetna apun jeh-a hichehi kabol ahitai.
target: Why do you cry out over your wound, your pain that has no cure? Because of your great guilt and many sins I have done these things to you.

source: Hijeh achu nabahgamho jouse chu kibahgama, nakidoupi jouse khat khatna sohchanga chediu, chule nachomgam ho kichomgama, anchah-a nanei jouse chu anchah-a kapehdoh ding ahi.
target: “ ‘But all who devour you will be devoured; all your enemies will go into exile. Those who plunder you will be plundered; all who make spoil of you I will despoil.

source: Ajehchu nachunga damna kalhunsah kitna, namaha ho kadamsah ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ajehchu amahon nangma akinodoh ahi nati uvin, hichehi koimachan adonlou Zion chu ahi, atiuve.
target: But I will restore you to health and heal your wounds,’ declares the Lord , ‘because you are called an outcast, Zion for whom no one cares.’

source: Pakaiyin hitin ati, Ven keiman Jacob ponbuh sohchangsa chu kahin puikitna, achenna mun'a kahepi ding, akisetvumna chunga chu khopi chu kasahdoh-a, leng inpi chu aumdan bang banga umkit ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “This is what the Lord says: “ ‘I will restore the fortunes of Jacob’s tents and have compassion on his dwellings; the city will be rebuilt on her ruins, and the palace will stand in its proper place.

source: Amaho-a kon chun thangvahnale kipana husa gingdoh-in tin, amaho chu punsah ingting, lhomcha hilou diu, loujong loupisah ingting, neocha hilou diu ahitai.
target: From them will come songs of thanksgiving and the sound of rejoicing. I will add to their numbers, and they will not be decreased; I will bring them honor, and they will not be disdained.

source: Achateu jong masanga bangin umuntin, akikhopnao kiphutdet ding, chule amaho sugenthei hojouse talen kapeh ding ahiuve.
target: Their children will be as in days of old, and their community will be established before me; I will punish all who oppress them.

source: Amilunhou chu amaho-a kontah hiuvintin, avaipopau chu amaho lah-a hung hiding, ama chu kinaisah ingting, aman eihin naija hung lutngam jengthei ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Their leader will be one of their own; their ruler will arise from among them. I will bring him near and he will come close to me— for who is he who will devote himself to be close to me?’ declares the Lord .

source: Chuteng nangho kamite nahiuva, keima na-Pathen'u kahi ding ahi.
target: “ ‘So you will be my people, and I will be your God.’ ”

source: Ngaijun Pakai lungsatna huipi, tanglouva nungjing huipi chu ahung nunge, hichun migiloute luchang asuhnat ding ahi.
target: See, the storm of the Lord will burst out in wrath, a driving wind swirling down on the heads of the wicked.

source: Hichu abolchai kahsehle alunggot phalou chu amolso kahse-a, Pakai lungsat tijat umtah chu dailha louhel ding ahi. Ninunung lamteng hin ngaito taovinate.
target: The fierce anger of the Lord will not turn back until he fully accomplishes the purposes of his heart. In days to come you will understand this.

source: Hiche phat tah chule, keihi Israel pumpi Pathen hingting, amaho jong kamite hitaovinte, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “At that time,” declares the Lord , “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people.”

source: Israel choldosah dia kachelaitah chun, chemjam'a thimoh hochun, gamthipma lungsetna akimutaove, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: This is what the Lord says: “The people who survive the sword will find favor in the wilderness; I will come to give rest to Israel.”

source: Masangin Pakai kahenga akilah-in, hitin aseije, keiman nangma tonsot lungsetna-in kalungsetnin: hijeh chun lainatna-in kakaile jinge.
target: The Lord appeared to us in the past, saying: “I have loved you with an everlasting love; I have drawn you with unfailing kindness.

source: Vo nungah theng Israel, keiman nasaphang ting sahphat nahi ding ahitai: na cha'ngeng ho-a nakijephoi kitna, kipah thanop bolho lamna-a nachedoh ding ahi.
target: I will build you up again, and you, Virgin Israel, will be rebuilt. Again you will take up your timbrels and go out to dance with the joyful.

source: Samaria molsangho chunga lengpigui nakiphuna laija aphuthon aphuva, agachu aneh diu ahi.
target: Again you will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria; the farmers will plant them and enjoy their fruit.

source: Ajehchu Ephraim mol chunga khongah hon, nangho kipat un Pakai i-Pathen'u heng, Zion'a chetou vuhite, tia asapna diu nikho khat hungum ding ahi.
target: There will be a day when watchmen cry out on the hills of Ephraim, ‘Come, let us go up to Zion, to the Lord our God.’ ”

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Jacob din kipah-in la saovin lang, namtin haosaho lah-a aodoh-un: phongjalun, vahchoijun lang, Vo Pakai, Israel amoh umsun namitehi huhdoh-in, tiuvin.
target: This is what the Lord says: “Sing with joy for Jacob; shout for the foremost of the nations. Make your praises heard, and say, ‘ Lord , save your people, the remnant of Israel.’

source: Veuvin, sahlam gama konin hinpuijing ting, leiset kolmonga konin khoming ting, alah uva chun mitcho elbai, numei naovop, numei naoso natna na, mihon atama tam hung kilekhom diu ahi.
target: See, I will bring them from the land of the north and gather them from the ends of the earth. Among them will be the blind and the lame, expectant mothers and women in labor; a great throng will return.

source: Kappum pumin hunguntin, kalhep lhepma kapui ding, vadunglen twilah lamdih tah-a chesah ungting, hia chu kipalhu loudiu ahi. Ajehchu keima Israel pa kahin Ephraim chu kachapa lenpen ahi.
target: They will come with weeping; they will pray as I bring them back. I will lead them beside streams of water on a level path where they will not stumble, because I am Israel’s father, and Ephraim is my firstborn son.

source: Vo nangho namtinho, Pakai thusei ngaijun lang, twikol gam gamlatah-a phongjalun, Israel thechehpa chun achopkhom kitna, kelngoi chingpa banga amaho chu achin ding ahitai, tin aseije.
target: “Hear the word of the Lord , you nations; proclaim it in distant coastlands: ‘He who scattered Israel will gather them and will watch over his flock like a shepherd.’

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin Jacob alhatdoh-in, asanga hatjopa khutna konin alhatdohtai.
target: For the Lord will deliver Jacob and redeem them from the hand of those stronger than they.

source: Hijeh achu hunguva Zion chungvuma la ahinsah diu, Pakai phatna, suhlouchang, lengpitwi, thaotwi, kelngoihon noutele ganchahon noute chunga kipah uva, ahinkhou chu hon twi kichapnou jing bang hiuva, lunghem kit talou hel ding ahitaove.
target: They will come and shout for joy on the heights of Zion; they will rejoice in the bounty of the Lord — the grain, the new wine and the olive oil, the young of the flocks and herds. They will be like a well-watered garden, and they will sorrow no more.

source: Chuteng nungah theng chu gollhanghole tehse ho toh lamna-a kipah khomdiu ahi. Ajehchu alunghem nao kipana-a kaheidoh-a, kalhamona, alunghem naova kona kakipasah ding ahi.
target: Then young women will dance and be glad, young men and old as well. I will turn their mourning into gladness; I will give them comfort and joy instead of sorrow.

source: Thempuho hinna chu tahsa damtheina-a kalunglhai sah-a, kamite chu kaphatna-a lunglhai diu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will satisfy the priests with abundance, and my people will be filled with my bounty,” declares the Lord .

source: Pakaiyin hitin ati, Ramah-a lunghemnale nasatah-a kana awgin akijai, Rachel'in achate aka akan, aumlou jeh uvin lhepbi ding anomtapon ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says: “A voice is heard in Ramah, mourning and great weeping, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.”

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, naka awginle namitlhi lonna-a konin haijin, ajehchu nathilbol kipaman umding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, chule amaho amelmate gama kona hung kilekit diu ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says: “Restrain your voice from weeping and your eyes from tears, for your work will be rewarded,” declares the Lord . “They will return from the land of the enemy.

source: Nakhonung ding thua kinepna aume, tin Pakaiyin aseije, chutia chu nachate agamsung lamuva hungkit teidiu ahi.
target: So there is hope for your descendants,” declares the Lord . “Your children will return to their own land.

source: Keiman Ephraim kagin kaja monge, nangin neiseh gimin, bongchal namkoljon pokhalou bangin neiseh gimtai. Nei lehei lechun kihei kit tange, ajehchu Pakai ka Pathen nahi.
target: “I have surely heard Ephraim’s moaning: ‘You disciplined me like an unruly calf, and I have been disciplined. Restore me, and I will return, because you are the Lord my God.

source: Tahbeh-in kakilehei nungin kakisih tai. Eikihil nungin kapheipi kabengin, kajah achan, kaneo laija minsetna chu kapohjing jeh-in, kakisudong heltai.
target: After I strayed, I repented; after I came to understand, I beat my breast. I was ashamed and humiliated because I bore the disgrace of my youth.’

source: Ephraim kachapa deitah ham? Ama kalungtoh kacha ham? Ajehchu ama douna-a thu kasei chanin lungset tah-in kageldoh jing nalaije, hijeh chun ama dingin kasung akithingin, ama kahepi mongding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Is not Ephraim my dear son, the child in whom I delight? Though I often speak against him, I still remember him. Therefore my heart yearns for him; I have great compassion for him,” declares the Lord .

source: Lampi melchihna kisemin lang, sangtah-in kiset vumin, nagachena lampi, lamlhongpi lam geljingin, Vo nungah theng Israel, hung kihei kitnin, hiche nakhopi lama hung kiheijin.
target: “Set up road signs; put up guideposts. Take note of the highway, the road that you take. Return, Virgin Israel, return to your towns.

source: Vo nang chanu nungchonnu, itihchan navale ding ham? Pakaiyin leisetna thilthah khat asemin, numei jin pasal adei ding ahi.
target: How long will you wander, unfaithful Daughter Israel? The Lord will create a new thing on earth— the woman will return to the man.”

source: Janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, asohchan naova kona kalepui kit tengle, Judah gamle akhopiho-a chu hitobang kamso, Vo thudihtah chenna, Vo thenna mol, Pakaiyin phatthei boh-in, tihi amankit diu ahi.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: “When I bring them back from captivity, the people in the land of Judah and in its towns will once again use these words: ‘The Lord bless you, you prosperous city, you sacred mountain.’

source: Chuachu Judah tele akhopi jouse-a mite, loubol mihole kelngoihon vahho chengkhom diu ahi.
target: People will live together in Judah and all its towns—farmers and those who move about with their flocks.

source: Ajehchu cholte kavahva-in, lungkhamte kahaldohsah tai.
target: I will refresh the weary and satisfy the faint.”

source: Hiche thua hin kahung khangin, kavelen, chule ka-imut chu anomlheh-e.
target: At this I awoke and looked around. My sleep had been pleasant to me.

source: Vetan, Israel insungle Judah insunga mihem muchile sahem muchi katuna ding nikho chu ahung lhunge, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “The days are coming,” declares the Lord , “when I will plant the kingdoms of Israel and Judah with the offspring of people and of animals.

source: Chule hiti ding ahi, amaho botdoh-a, subonga, pailha-a, sumanga chule suhgenthei dinga kachan jing bangahi, sadoh dingle phutpha dinga kachan jing ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Just as I watched over them to uproot and tear down, and to overthrow, destroy and bring disaster, so I will watch over them to build and to plant,” declares the Lord .

source: Hiche nichule paten lengpiga thuh aneuvin, chate ha ajatai atikit louhel dingu ahi.
target: “In those days people will no longer say, ‘The parents have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.’

source: Ahinla amitakip ama amacheh khangitlouna-a thia, lengpi ga thuh nechan chu, ama hacheh jading ahitai.
target: Instead, everyone will die for their own sin; whoever eats sour grapes—their own teeth will be set on edge.

source: Vetan, Israel insungle Judah insungtoh thulhun thah khat kasemna ding nikho ahung lhunge, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “The days are coming,” declares the Lord , “when I will make a new covenant with the people of Israel and with the people of Judah.

source: Keima amaho dinga ajipau hijongleng, apateu Egypt gama kona puidoh dinga akhutnuva kakai ni-a thulhun kanasem asuhkeh-u tobang chu hilou ding ahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: It will not be like the covenant I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand to lead them out of Egypt, because they broke my covenant, though I was a husband to them,” declares the Lord .

source: Ahinla chuche nikhoho jouva Israel insungtoh thulhun kasem ding chu hichehi ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Asunguva kadanthupeh koijing ting, alungsung uva kasutlut ding, chule a-Pathen'u kahia, amaho kamite hidiu ahitai.
target: “This is the covenant I will make with the people of Israel after that time,” declares the Lord . “I will put my law in their minds and write it on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

source: Chule koimachan aheng akomle asopi takip jah-a Pakai chu hen, atilou diu ahitai. Ajehchu aneopena pat alenpen geija eihet soh hel diu ahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ajehchu akhangit lounao kangaidam-a, achonsetnao kageldoh kit louhel ding ahitai.
target: No longer will they teach their neighbor, or say to one another, ‘Know the Lord ,’ because they will all know me, from the least of them to the greatest,” declares the Lord . “For I will forgive their wickedness and will remember their sins no more.”

source: Suna vahdinga nisa pe-a, jana vahdinga lhathahle ahsi ho vahding dan sempeh-a pepa, twipi kinong ginglul lula homkhenpa, Pakai chun hitin aseije, janel Pakai chu amin ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says, he who appoints the sun to shine by day, who decrees the moon and stars to shine by night, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the Lord Almighty is his name:

source: Hiche danho chu kamasanga keija kona achemangle, Israel chilhah jong namkhat ahina-a kona, a-itih-a dinga kamasanga beihel ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Only if these decrees vanish from my sight,” declares the Lord , “will Israel ever cease being a nation before me.”

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, chunga van khu akite theija, noija leiset kingapna hohi holdoh thei ahilebou, kenjong Israel chilhah jousehi, athilbolhou jouse jeh-a kapaidoh diu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: This is what the Lord says: “Only if the heavens above can be measured and the foundations of the earth below be searched out will I reject all the descendants of Israel because of all they have done,” declares the Lord .

source: Vetan, Hananeel insanga patna kul ning kotpi geija Pakai khopi kisahdohna ding nikho chu ahung lhunge, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “The days are coming,” declares the Lord , “when this city will be rebuilt for me from the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.

source: Chule thil tena khao chu Gareb lhangchung jona kilhung jangpetna chule Goath akolkhum ding ahi.
target: The measuring line will stretch from there straight to the hill of Gareb and then turn to Goah.

source: Thilonghole vut kinotna damphai pumpile Kidron luipi gei loujao jouse, solam sanga sakol kotpi, ning geija chu Pakai dinga atheng hiding ahin, a-imatih-a kibotdoh-a kiseplha kit louhel ding ahitai.
target: The whole valley where dead bodies and ashes are thrown, and all the terraces out to the Kidron Valley on the east as far as the corner of the Horse Gate, will be holy to the Lord . The city will never again be uprooted or demolished.”

source: Judah lengpa Zedekiah lengchan kum som lhin kum, hichu Nebuchadnezzar lengchan kal kum somle kum get lhin kum chun, Jeremiah henga Pakaiya konin thu ahung lhungin ahi.
target: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.

source: Ajehchu hichelai chun Babylon lengpa sepaihon Jerusalem aumkulun, Jeremiah chu Judah lengpa inhong sunga, mihenna ina akulkhupmun ahi.
target: The army of the king of Babylon was then besieging Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was confined in the courtyard of the guard in the royal palace of Judah.

source: Ajehchu Judah lengpa Zedekiah chun ama chu ahentupma hitia asei ahi, ibola nangman gaothu naseija, Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Veuvin, keiman hiche khopihi Babylon lengpa khutna kapeh-a, aman ahinlah ding ahi;
target: Now Zedekiah king of Judah had imprisoned him there, saying, “Why do you prophesy as you do? You say, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am about to give this city into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it.

source: Chule Judah leng Zedekiah chu Chaldea miho khutna kona hoidoh lou ding, Babylon lengpa khutna kapehdoh joh-a, akamtah-a akihoupia, amitnin ama mit avet ding ahi.
target: Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape the Babylonians but will certainly be given into the hands of the king of Babylon, and will speak with him face to face and see him with his own eyes.

source: Chule Zedekiah chu Babylon'a apuija, keiman kavil kahse-a chu umding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Chaldea miho chu kisatpi jongleu chun lolhing pouvinte, tin Pakaiyin aseije, tia naseiham? ati.
target: He will take Zedekiah to Babylon, where he will remain until I deal with him, declares the Lord . If you fight against the Babylonians, you will not succeed.’ ”

source: Chuin Jeremiah chun Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin hitihin aseije, ati.
target: Jeremiah said, “The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Vetan, napangah Shallum chapa Hanameel nahenga hungintin, Anathoth'a um kalou kichoh-in, ajehchu chohna ding lhatdohna thahat naneije ati ding ahi.
target: Hanamel son of Shallum your uncle is going to come to you and say, ‘Buy my field at Anathoth, because as nearest relative it is your right and duty to buy it.’

source: Hitichun kapangahpa chapa Hanameel chu, Pakai thu dungjuijin kihenna hongsunga kahenga ahungin, kajah-a aseije, Benjamin gama Anathoth a kalou chu goulo thei nahijeh-a nalhatdoh ding ahi, nang dingin kichoh-in, ati. Hichun hichehi Pakai thu ahi kahetai.
target: “Then, just as the Lord had said, my cousin Hanamel came to me in the courtyard of the guard and said, ‘Buy my field at Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin. Since it is your right to redeem it and possess it, buy it for yourself.’ “I knew that this was the word of the Lord ;

source: Chuin kapangahpa chapa Hanameel lou, Anathoth a um chu kachon, sumchu katepeh-in dangka shekel somlesagi jen ahi.
target: so I bought the field at Anathoth from my cousin Hanamel and weighed out for him seventeen shekels of silver.

source: Chuin lekha kajih-in kamin kasunin, namdet kanamun ahetoh kakouvin, sumchu agihdan katepehtai.
target: I signed and sealed the deed, had it witnessed, and weighed out the silver on the scales.

source: Chuin kichohna lekha chu chondanle angai dungjuijin, akichohdan kisutna namdet kinamsa lekha chu kaladoh-in hichu akiphong dohsa ahi.
target: I took the deed of purchase—the sealed copy containing the terms and conditions, as well as the unsealed copy—

source: Chuin kichohna lekhabu chu Maaseiah chapa Neriah chapa Baruch chu, kapangahpa chapa Hanameel mitmule akichohna-a minchong ahettohho mitmun chule kihenna hongsunga tou Judah te jouse anga chun kapetan ahi.
target: and I gave this deed to Baruch son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the presence of my cousin Hanamel and of the witnesses who had signed the deed and of all the Jews sitting in the courtyard of the guard.

source: Chuin amasanguva Baruch chu thu kapen,
target: “In their presence I gave Baruch these instructions:

source: Israel Pathen janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, hiche kichohna lekha, sinkhana kinamle kichohna lekha kihonghi akopmin lanlang, sottah aumtheina dingin leibel sung khatna koijin.
target: ‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Take these documents, both the sealed and unsealed copies of the deed of purchase, and put them in a clay jar so they will last a long time.

source: Ajehchu janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin ati, hiche gama inho, louho, lengpilei ho hi hinkilo kit ding ahi, ati.
target: For this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Houses, fields and vineyards will again be bought in this land.’

source: Tun kichohna lekha chu Neriah chapa Baruch kapeh phatnin Pakai henga kataovin,
target: “After I had given the deed of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah, I prayed to the Lord :

source: Vo Pakai Pathen, vetan, nathilboltheina nasatahle naban jahdoh-in, leile van nasemin, nangma dingin ahahsa ima aumpoi.
target: “Ah, Sovereign Lord , you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and outstretched arm. Nothing is too hard for you.

source: Asang asang henga lungset le khotona namusah-in, chule pate khangitlouna chu anunguva achateu chunga nalethuh jin: Loupitah, Pathen Hattah, janel Pakai chu amin ahi.
target: You show love to thousands but bring the punishment for the parents’ sins into the laps of their children after them. Great and mighty God, whose name is the Lord Almighty,

source: Thumop themtah, thilbol hattah, mihem chapate jouse atoh dunjui cheh-a lethuhna pedinga alamlhah jouseu vejing nahi,
target: great are your purposes and mighty are your deeds. Your eyes are open to the ways of all mankind; you reward each person according to their conduct and as their deeds deserve.

source: Egypt gama melchihna le datmo bola, tuni geija Israel le midangho lah-a boljom jinga, tunia bang banga min khat hin kiboldoh-a,
target: You performed signs and wonders in Egypt and have continued them to this day, in Israel and among all mankind, and have gained the renown that is still yours.

source: Egypt gama kona nami Israelte melchihna hole datmoho-a, khut thahattahle banjahdoh-a, chule tijatna nasatah puma hinpuidoh-a,
target: You brought your people Israel out of Egypt with signs and wonders, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with great terror.

source: hiche khoijule bongnoi lonna gam, apateu pehdinga anakihahsela, amaho anapepa,
target: You gave them this land you had sworn to give their ancestors, a land flowing with milk and honey.

source: chuin ahung lutnun alotauve, ahinla nathu angai hih-un, nadanthupeh-a jong achonpouve. Aboldiuva napeh jouse khatcha abolpouve. Hijeh achu hiche thilse jousehi achunguva nalhunsah ahitai.
target: They came in and took possession of it, but they did not obey you or follow your law; they did not do what you commanded them to do. So you brought all this disaster on them.

source: Mol ho khu vetemin, khopi lodingin amaho ahungtaove, chemjamle kellhah, chule hise jeh-in, galla hinsatna Chaldea mite khutna khopihi pehdoh-in anaumtan, naseisa chu aguilhung tai, vetan, nangin namun ahi.
target: “See how the siege ramps are built up to take the city. Because of the sword, famine and plague, the city will be given into the hands of the Babylonians who are attacking it. What you said has happened, as you now see.

source: Chule Vo Pakai Pathen, nangin kahenga, lou chu sumin kichoh inlang, khopihi Chaldea mite akipehdohtah jeh-in, ahetoh ding mi kikoijin, natin ahi.
target: And though the city will be given into the hands of the Babylonians, you, Sovereign Lord , say to me, ‘Buy the field with silver and have the transaction witnessed.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu Jeremiah henga ahung lhungin, aseije,
target: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:

source: Ven, keima Pakai tahsahing jouse Pathen kahi, keima dinga thil hahsa behseh ipi umam? ati.
target: “I am the Lord , the God of all mankind. Is anything too hard for me?

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije, vetan, hiche khopihi Chaldea mite khutna, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar khutna pengting, aman alah ding ahitai.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord says: I am about to give this city into the hands of the Babylonians and to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who will capture it.

source: Chule hiche khopi hinsat Chaldea mite chu hunguntin, hiche khopihi ahal uva, lunghansahna dinga eiphinset nao, Baal dinga gimnamtui ahalnau, inchunghole Pathen dang dinga don thilpeh asunlhah nao chu akahvam gamding ahitai.
target: The Babylonians who are attacking this city will come in and set it on fire; they will burn it down, along with the houses where the people aroused my anger by burning incense on the roofs to Baal and by pouring out drink offerings to other gods.

source: Ajehchu Israel chatele Judah chaten aneulaijuva pat kamasanga thilse jengbou aboluve. Ajehchu Israel chaten akhutnuva athilbol jaluvin eiphin lunghang jinguve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “The people of Israel and Judah have done nothing but evil in my sight from their youth; indeed, the people of Israel have done nothing but arouse my anger with what their hands have made, declares the Lord .

source: Ajehchu hiche khopihi asahdoh uva pat tuni geija kalunghana le kalungsatna dinga phinsetna khopi anahin, kamasanga kona kachon mang ding ahi.
target: From the day it was built until now, this city has so aroused my anger and wrath that I must remove it from my sight.

source: Israel chatele Judah chate amaho, alengteu, amilenhou, athempuhou, athemgaohou, chule Judah mihole Jerusalem'a chengten, keima lunghan sah-a phinsetna dinga thilse abol jeh-u ahi.
target: The people of Israel and Judah have provoked me by all the evil they have done—they, their kings and officials, their priests and prophets, the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem.

source: Matah-a thouva kahil vangin, akihilnao kisanding agelkhoh pouve, anung eingatnun, eimaingat pouve.
target: They turned their backs to me and not their faces; though I taught them again and again, they would not listen or respond to discipline.

source: Kamina kivo in chu suhbohna dingin, thet umhou chu atunglut jiuvin ahi.
target: They set up their vile images in the house that bears my Name and defiled it.

source: Amahon Hinnom chapa phaicham, kathupeh louhel kalunga jong chengkhalou, Judah chonsetsah nadingin thil thet umtah abolun, achapateule achanuteu Molech henga meija pehdohna dingin Baal munsang ho asadoh-un ahi.
target: They built high places for Baal in the Valley of Ben Hinnom to sacrifice their sons and daughters to Molek, though I never commanded—nor did it enter my mind—that they should do such a detestable thing and so make Judah sin.

source: Hijeh chun tuhin Pakai Israelte Pathen'in, hiche khopihi chemjam, kel, hiset jeh-a Babylon lengpa khutna kipedoh ahitai, natiu thudola chun hitin aseije,
target: “You are saying about this city, ‘By the sword, famine and plague it will be given into the hands of the king of Babylon’; but this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says:

source: Vetan, keiman amahohi kalungnatna, kalungsatna, kalunghana nasatah jeh-a, kana nomangna gamtina kona kakhop khom kitna, hiche munahi kahinpui kitna, mongtah-a kachensah ding ahi.
target: I will surely gather them from all the lands where I banish them in my furious anger and great wrath; I will bring them back to this place and let them live in safety.

source: Chule amaho kamite hiuva, Keima a-Pathen'u kahi ding ahi.
target: They will be my people, and I will be their God.

source: Keiman amahole amaho nunga achateu phatna dinga, a-itih-a eigin theina diuva lungthim khatle lampi khatseh kapeh diu ahi.
target: I will give them singleness of heart and action, so that they will always fear me and that all will then go well for them and for their children after them.

source: Chule amaho phatna ding kabolpeh-a kona kakiheimang louna dinga, amahotoh tonsot thulhuhna kasemdoh-a, amaho keija kona akiheimang louna diuva, alung sunguva eikichatnao kakhum peh dingu ahi.
target: I will make an everlasting covenant with them: I will never stop doing good to them, and I will inspire them to fear me, so that they will never turn away from me.

source: Ahi, aphatnao bolpeh chu kakipana lam hintin, kalung pumpile kahinna pumpi-a hiche gamhi kaphudet mongding ahi.
target: I will rejoice in doing them good and will assuredly plant them in this land with all my heart and soul.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, hiche mite chunga thilse nasatah jouse kahin pohlut khum bangahi, amaho kanateppeh thilpha jouse chu kahin pohlut peh ding ahiuve.
target: “This is what the Lord says: As I have brought all this great calamity on this people, so I will give them all the prosperity I have promised them.

source: Nanghon mihemle ganhing beina gamgo hi, Chaldea mite khutna kipedoh ahitai, tia nasei laiju gamho chu kichodoh soh ding ahitai.
target: Once more fields will be bought in this land of which you say, ‘It is a desolate waste, without people or animals, for it has been given into the hands of the Babylonians.’

source: Benjamin gamle Jerusalem khopi vel munho-a, chule Judah khopiho-a, lhang gama khopiho-a, chule phaicham khopiho-a louho chu mihon suma achoh uva, kichohna lekha asutnuva, namdet anamuva, hettohsah ho akoicheh diu ahi. Ajehchu keiman asohchannau chu kakilesah kit ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Fields will be bought for silver, and deeds will be signed, sealed and witnessed in the territory of Benjamin, in the villages around Jerusalem, in the towns of Judah and in the towns of the hill country, of the western foothills and of the Negev, because I will restore their fortunes, declares the Lord .”

source: Chukalvalin kihenna hongsunga akulkhup laijun Jeremiah henga, Pakai thu chu aniveina in ahung lhungin, aseije,
target: While Jeremiah was still confined in the courtyard of the guard, the word of the Lord came to him a second time:

source: Leiset hinsempa, ijakai hingong tohpa Pakai chun hitin aseije, Pakai kiti chu ama min ahi.
target: “This is what the Lord says, he who made the earth, the Lord who formed it and established it—the Lord is his name:

source: Neihin kouvin, keiman donbut-ing ting, nahetkhah louvu thil lentahle loupitah vetsah inge,
target: ‘Call to me and I will answer you and tell you great and unsearchable things you do not know.’

source: Ajehchu molhole chemjam'a kisuchim hiche khopi inhole Judah lengte inho chungchang thudol chu Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije,
target: For this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says about the houses in this city and the royal palaces of Judah that have been torn down to be used against the siege ramps and the sword

source: Amaho Chaldea mite toh kisat dingin ahungun, ahinla kalungnatnale kalungsatna-a kathagam thilongho chun adipjoh dingu, chule agitlounahou jouse jeh-a hiche khopi-a kona kamai kasel ahitai.
target: in the fight with the Babylonians: ‘They will be filled with the dead bodies of the people I will slay in my anger and wrath. I will hide my face from this city because of all its wickedness.

source: Vetemin, damtheina le damdohna hinpong ting, amaho damsah ingting, chamnale thudih lhingset kamusah ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Nevertheless, I will bring health and healing to it; I will heal my people and will let them enjoy abundant peace and security.

source: Keiman Jadah le Israel sohchana chu kinunglesah ingting, amasa-a banga kasahphat kitding ahi.
target: I will bring Judah and Israel back from captivity and will rebuild them as they were before.

source: Keima douna-a achonsetnao, athemo nao jouse-a konin thensah ingting, akhangit lounao jouse kachunga achonsetnao leh kachunga asuhkhelnau jouse ngaidam tange.
target: I will cleanse them from all the sin they have committed against me and will forgive all their sins of rebellion against me.

source: Chule hiche khopihi leiset nam jouse, adiuva kabolphat jouse muho masanga chu, kei dinga kipanale vahchoina, chule loupina hintin, phatnale khantouna kalhunsah jouse jala kicha-a kithing thing diu ahi.
target: Then this city will bring me renown, joy, praise and honor before all nations on earth that hear of all the good things I do for it; and they will be in awe and will tremble at the abundant prosperity and peace I provide for it.’

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, hiche mun, nanghon mile sa umlouna ahomkeo ahi natinao mun Judah khopihole Jerusalem khosung lamlen mile sa, acheng beina natiu mun ahi,
target: “This is what the Lord says: ‘You say about this place, “It is a desolate waste, without people or animals.” Yet in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem that are deserted, inhabited by neither people nor animals, there will be heard once more

source: thanopnale kipana aw, moulangle mounu aw, janel Pakai chu vahchoijun tia aseidiu aw, ajehchu Pakai chu aphan, ahepina itih-in aumjinge, chule Pakai in'a vahchoina ganlhaina hinchoiho hugin kija kit ding ahi. Ajehchu masanga banga, gamsunga sohchangho chu kakinungle sah ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of bride and bridegroom, and the voices of those who bring thank offerings to the house of the Lord , saying, “Give thanks to the Lord Almighty, for the Lord is good; his love endures forever.” For I will restore the fortunes of the land as they were before,’ says the Lord .

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, mile sa umlouna gamgoh, hiche munahi, chule chuche khopiho jouse sung chu, kelngoihon ho kolsah nale kelngoiching ho chenna mun hung hiding ahi.
target: “This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘In this place, desolate and without people or animals—in all its towns there will again be pastures for shepherds to rest their flocks.

source: Mola khopiho-a, phaicham khopiho-a, lhanglam khopiho-a, Benjamin gamsunga, Jerusalem kimvel munho-a, Judah khopiho-a chu ahilteu khutnoija kelngoihonho kijotjot jengdiu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: In the towns of the hill country, of the western foothills and of the Negev, in the territory of Benjamin, in the villages around Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah, flocks will again pass under the hand of the one who counts them,’ says the Lord .

source: Vetan, Israel insungle Judah insung chungchanga thilpha kathutep chu kamolso ding ahi, ati nikhoho chu hunglhung ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “ ‘The days are coming,’ declares the Lord , ‘when I will fulfill the good promise I made to the people of Israel and Judah.

source: Chuche nikhoho-a, chuche phatteng David dinga chonphatna bah kajamdohsah-a, aman gamsunga chu thutannale chonphatna apohdoh ding ahi.
target: “ ‘In those days and at that time I will make a righteous Branch sprout from David’s line; he will do what is just and right in the land.

source: Hiche laichule Judah huhhingin umintin, Jerusalem bitkeija umding ahi; chule akihouna ding min chu Ichon phatnao Pakai kitiding ahi.
target: In those days Judah will be saved and Jerusalem will live in safety. This is the name by which it will be called: The Lord Our Righteous Savior.’

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Israel insung laltouna-a touding chu David lhasamkha louhel ding ahi,
target: For this is what the Lord says: ‘David will never fail to have a man to sit on the throne of Israel,

source: Ahiloule thempuho, Levi ho jong kamasanga govam thilto chule anneh thilto le tanglouva ganlhaina bolding lhasamkha louhel ding ahi.
target: nor will the Levitical priests ever fail to have a man to stand before me continually to offer burnt offerings, to burn grain offerings and to present sacrifices.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu Jeremiah heng ahung lhungin, aseije.
target: The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, nanghon sun le jantoh kakitepna nasukeh jou uva chule hiti achu sunle jan aphatcha aumthei louva ahile,
target: “This is what the Lord says: ‘If you can break my covenant with the day and my covenant with the night, so that day and night no longer come at their appointed time,

source: Chuteng kalhacha David toh kakitepna jong kehthei bouvinte, alaltouna-a touding chapa aneilou ding bou ahin, Levi ho thempuho, kalhachaho toh kakitepna jong chuti ding ahi.
target: then my covenant with David my servant—and my covenant with the Levites who are priests ministering before me—can be broken and David will no longer have a descendant to reign on his throne.

source: Van janelpi kisim joulou bangle, twipi neldi kitejoulou banga, kasoh David chilhahle kahenga kinbol jing Levi te chu, hitobanga chu kapunsah ding ahi, ati.
target: I will make the descendants of David my servant and the Levites who minister before me as countless as the stars in the sky and as measureless as the sand on the seashore.’ ”

source: Chukalvalin Pakai thu chu Jeremiah henga ahung lhungin, aseije.
target: The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:

source: Insung ni Pakaiyin alhen chu apaidoh geltai, tia hiche miten aseiju chu nangaito khahlouvu ham? Amahon kamite i-sah louvin abolun, chutia chu amaho masanga namkhat hikit louhel diu ahitai.
target: “Have you not noticed that these people are saying, ‘The Lord has rejected the two kingdoms he chose’? So they despise my people and no longer regard them as a nation.

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, sun le jantoh kakitepna chu aumdet louva, leile van umding dan kana gontoh lou hile,
target: This is what the Lord says: ‘If I have not made my covenant with day and night and established the laws of heaven and earth,

source: Jacob chilhahhole kasoh David chu kapaidoh hella, Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob chilhah chunga vaihom ding achilhah khatcha kalhen louding ahi. Ajehchu keiman asohchannau kakinungle sah-a, achunguva hepina kanei ding ahi, ati.
target: then I will reject the descendants of Jacob and David my servant and will not choose one of his sons to rule over the descendants of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. For I will restore their fortunes and have compassion on them.’ ”

source: Pakaiya kona Jeremiah henga thu hunglhung chu, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar le asepaite jouse alengvai pohna leiset lenggam jousele amijousen, Jerusalem le khopiho jouse chu asatnun, aseijui.
target: While Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army and all the kingdoms and peoples in the empire he ruled were fighting against Jerusalem and all its surrounding towns, this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord :

source: Pakai, Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, Judah lengpa Zedekiah henga chenlang hitin gaseijin, vetan, hiche khopihi Babylon lengpa khutna kapeh ding, aman meija ahallhah ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije gatin ati.
target: “This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Go to Zedekiah king of Judah and tell him, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am about to give this city into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it down.

source: Chule nangma akhutna kona nahoidoh louhel ding, nakiman na, ama khutna kipedoh ding nahi, namitnin Babylon lengpa mit chu avetna, aman akamtah-a nakihoupi ding, chule Babylon'a nache ding ahi.
target: You will not escape from his grasp but will surely be captured and given into his hands. You will see the king of Babylon with your own eyes, and he will speak with you face to face. And you will go to Babylon.

source: Ahinla Vo, Zedekiah, Judah lengpa, Pakai thusei ngaijin, Pakaiyin nachung thu hitin aseije, chemjam'a nathi lou ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Yet hear the Lord ’s promise to you, Zedekiah king of Judah. This is what the Lord says concerning you: You will not die by the sword;

source: Lungmong tah-a nathi ding ahi, namasanga leng masaho, napate gimnamtui ahalpeh banguva, nangma dinga jong gimnamtui ahaluva, ohe hepu atiuva, nakacham diu ahi. Ajehchu keiman thu kaphongdohtai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: you will die peacefully. As people made a funeral fire in honor of your predecessors, the kings who ruled before you, so they will make a fire in your honor and lament, “Alas, master!” I myself make this promise, declares the Lord .’ ”

source: Chujouvin Jeremiah themgaovin, thujousehi Jerusalem'a um Judah te lengpa Zedekiah henga aseitan ahi.
target: Then Jeremiah the prophet told all this to Zedekiah king of Judah, in Jerusalem,

source: Babylon lengpa sepaihon Jerusalem le Judah khopi aumuva, Lachish le Azekah asat laijuva chu kulpi kikai khum hichengse chu Judah khopiho lah-a umnalai ahi.
target: while the army of the king of Babylon was fighting against Jerusalem and the other cities of Judah that were still holding out—Lachish and Azekah. These were the only fortified cities left in Judah.

source: Zedekiah lengpan Jerusalem'a um mipi jouse toh, jalenna thu phongdoh dinga thulhun asem jouva Pakaiya kona Jeremiah henga thu hunglhung chu hichehi ahi.
target: The word came to Jeremiah from the Lord after King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people in Jerusalem to proclaim freedom for the slaves.

source: Hitihin mijousen asohnu ham, asohpa ham chu Hebrai numei ham, Hebrai pasal ham ahile lha-ong hen, asopipa Hebrai mi kijensah-a koimacha umlou ding ahi, ati.
target: Everyone was to free their Hebrew slaves, both male and female; no one was to hold a fellow Hebrew in bondage.

source: Tun mitinin asohpale asohnu alha-ong ding, koimachan amaho akijensah kit louding ahi, ti ja-a thulhuna-a lut milen ho jousele mipite jouse chun ajuijun, alhadoh taove.
target: So all the officials and people who entered into this covenant agreed that they would free their male and female slaves and no longer hold them in bondage. They agreed, and set them free.

source: Ahinla khonungin akileheijun, alhadohsao soh pasal hole soh numei ho chu avelin soh na atohsah kitnun, sohpa le sohnu hidingin thununna noija akoitaove.
target: But afterward they changed their minds and took back the slaves they had freed and enslaved them again.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai thu chu Pakaiya konin Jeremiah henga ahung lhungin aseije,
target: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:

source: Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, keiman Egypt gama sohchana in'a kona amaho kapuidoh ni chun, napateu toh thulhun kanasemin, hitin kanaseije.
target: “This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I made a covenant with your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery. I said,

source: Hitihin asopipa, Hebrai mi, ahenga kijohsa, kum gup ama anajensa chu kum sagi kichaile alha-ong ding ahin, chule aman kum gup najen tengle nanga kona nalha ong ding ahi, kanatin: ahinla napateu vin kathu angaihih un, anau jong asungpouve.
target: ‘Every seventh year each of you must free any fellow Hebrews who have sold themselves to you. After they have served you six years, you must let them go free.’ Your ancestors, however, did not listen to me or pay attention to me.

source: Chuin nangho nahung kiheijun, adih chu nabolun, mitinin asopi henga jalenna naphongun: kamina kivo in'a kamasanga chun kitepna nasem uvin ahi.
target: Recently you repented and did what is right in my sight: Each of you proclaimed freedom to your own people. You even made a covenant before me in the house that bears my Name.

source: Ahinla nakilehei kitnuvin, kamin nasuboh-un, anoptah uva nalha-ong nungun, nasohnule nasohpao chu napuipha kitnun, nasohpaole nasohnu hidingin thununna noija napuilut kitnuve.
target: But now you have turned around and profaned my name; each of you has taken back the male and female slaves you had set free to go where they wished. You have forced them to become your slaves again.

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije, mitinin asopipale aheng akom henga chamlhatna thu phong dingin kathu nangai hih un, veuvin, keiman chemjam'a din, hise-a din, chule kel lhah-a din, chamlhatna kaphong doh-e. Leiset lenggam jouse-a kichonlele dingin semtao vinge, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Therefore this is what the Lord says: You have not obeyed me; you have not proclaimed freedom to your own people. So I now proclaim ‘freedom’ for you, declares the Lord —‘freedom’ to fall by the sword, plague and famine. I will make you abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth.

source: Chule keiman thulhun suhkeh-a, kamasanga kitepna asemsao nitlouho chu, bongnou kihapsatna, akah-a mi kijotpai jengtheija uma,
target: Those who have violated my covenant and have not fulfilled the terms of the covenant they made before me, I will treat like the calf they cut in two and then walked between its pieces.

source: bongnou kihapsat kah-a kijotpai Judah milenhole Jerusalem'a milenho, nukiso ho, thempuho, chule gamsung mipite jouse;
target: The leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, the court officials, the priests and all the people of the land who walked between the pieces of the calf,

source: Keiman amelmateu khutna, chule ahinnao holte khutna amaho chu kapehdoh-a, athilongu chu chunga leng vachate le, leija ganhingho anneh dingbep hiding ahitai.
target: I will deliver into the hands of their enemies who want to kill them. Their dead bodies will become food for the birds and the wild animals.

source: Chule Judah lengpa Zedekiah le amilenho chu, amelmateu khutna, ahinnao holte khutna, chule nangho-a kona kinungtol louva Babylon lengpa sepaiho khutna kapehdoh ding ahi.
target: “I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah and his officials into the hands of their enemies who want to kill them, to the army of the king of Babylon, which has withdrawn from you.

source: Vetan, keiman thu kapeh-a, amaho chu hiche khopi-a kahin kilesah kit ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Amahon hiche khopihi ahinsat naova, alahdiu chule meija ahaldiu, chule keiman Judah khopihohi chenna louva kamhela kalha ding ahi, ati.
target: I am going to give the order, declares the Lord , and I will bring them back to this city. They will fight against it, take it and burn it down. And I will lay waste the towns of Judah so no one can live there.”

source: Judah lengpa Josiah chapa Jehoiakim nikho laija, Pakaiya kona Jeremiah henga thu hung lhung chun hitin aseije,
target: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord during the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:

source: Rechab mite insunga chenlang, kihoupinlang, Pakai insunga indan khatna amaho chu puilut inlang, lengpitwi donding pen, ati.
target: “Go to the Rekabite family and invite them to come to one of the side rooms of the house of the Lord and give them wine to drink.”

source: Chuin Habazziniah chapa, Jeremiah chapa Jaazaniah le asopite, achapate jouse, chule Rechab mite insung pumpi kapuijin,
target: So I went to get Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, and his brothers and all his sons—the whole family of the Rekabites.

source: Pakai insung kotngah-a pang Shallum chapa Masseiah indan chunga, milenho indan koma um, Pathen mi Igdaliah chapa, Hanan chapate indan-a kapuilutnin,
target: I brought them into the house of the Lord , into the room of the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah the man of God. It was next to the room of the officials, which was over that of Maaseiah son of Shallum the doorkeeper.

source: Rechab mite insung chapate anga chun lengpitwi dimset cheh belhole, khonho katungin, ajah uva, lengpitwi donuvin, kati.
target: Then I set bowls full of wine and some cups before the Rekabites and said to them, “Drink some wine.”

source: Ahinla amahon lengpitwi donpou vinge. Ajehchu kapau Rechab chapa Jonadab'in, nanghole nachapa teovin a-itih-a lengpitwi nadon louhel diu,
target: But they replied, “We do not drink wine, because our forefather Jehonadab son of Rekab gave us this command: ‘Neither you nor your descendants must ever drink wine.

source: in nasah loudiu, muchi natu loudiu, lengpilei jong nabol louhel diu, imacha nanei loudiu, napennao leisetna nitamtah nachen theina dinguva, nahinkhou lhumkeija pon in'a bou nachen diu ahi, tin thu eipeuve atiuve.
target: Also you must never build houses, sow seed or plant vineyards; you must never have any of these things, but must always live in tents. Then you will live a long time in the land where you are nomads.’

source: Keihon kapau Rechab chapa Jonadab'in, kahinkhou lhumkeija, keiho, kajiteu, kachapa teole kachanu teovin lengpitwi don louhel dinga eithupeh-u kanitnun,
target: We have obeyed everything our forefather Jehonadab son of Rekab commanded us. Neither we nor our wives nor our sons and daughters have ever drunk wine

source: Kachenna diuvin in jong kakisah pouvin, lengpilei hihen, loumun hihen, muchi hijongle kaneipouvin ahi.
target: or built houses to live in or had vineyards, fields or crops.

source: Kapau Jonadab eithupeh-u jouse banga kaboluva, kanit uva, pon in'a bou kachenu ahi.
target: We have lived in tents and have fully obeyed everything our forefather Jehonadab commanded us.

source: Ahinla ahitin ahi, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar gamsunga ahunglut phatnin, Chaldea mihole Syria miho kichat jeh-in, hungun Jerusalem'a cheohite katiuvin, hitia chu Jerusalem'a kachenu ahi, atiuve.
target: But when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded this land, we said, ‘Come, we must go to Jerusalem to escape the Babylonian and Aramean armies.’ So we have remained in Jerusalem.”

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu Jeremiah henga ahung lhungin, hitin aseije;
target: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying:

source: Janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, kathu ngaina dinga kahilna nasan loudiu ham? tin Pakaiyin aseije, tin Judah mitele Jerusalem'a chengho gahilin, ati.
target: “This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Go and tell the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, ‘Will you not learn a lesson and obey my words?’ declares the Lord .

source: Rechab chapa Jonadab thu achate henga apeh, lengpitwi donlou ding chu anitnun, tuni geijin imacha adon hih-un, apau thupeh bou chu anit tup chetnun, ahijengvangin naheng uva thu kaseijin, matah-a kathouvin kahilun, ahinla neingaipeh pouve.
target: ‘Jehonadab son of Rekab ordered his descendants not to drink wine and this command has been kept. To this day they do not drink wine, because they obey their forefather’s command. But I have spoken to you again and again, yet you have not obeyed me.

source: Kalhachate themgaoho chu matah-a thouvin naheng uva kasolin, pasal tapou alamlhah phalouva konin tuhin hung kileuvin lang, nachonnao kisem phatnun, pathen dangho jen dingin anung lejui hih-un, nanghole napu napateu kapeh gamachu nachen diu ahi. Ahinla nanau nasung hih-un, ngai jong neingaipeh pouve.
target: Again and again I sent all my servants the prophets to you. They said, “Each of you must turn from your wicked ways and reform your actions; do not follow other gods to serve them. Then you will live in the land I have given to you and your ancestors.” But you have not paid attention or listened to me.

source: Ajehchu Rechab chapa Jonadab chapaten, apau thupeh amaho thu apeh chu anit-uvin, hiche miten vang hin kathusei angai pouve.
target: The descendants of Jehonadab son of Rekab have carried out the command their forefather gave them, but these people have not obeyed me.’

source: Hijeh chun, Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, ahenguva thu kaseija angai louvu, amaho kakouva eidonbut lou jeh-un, vetan, Judah le Jerusalem'a chengho jouse chunga, kaphondohsa thilphalou jouse chu achunguva kahin lhunsah ding ahi, ati.
target: “Therefore this is what the Lord God Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘Listen! I am going to bring on Judah and on everyone living in Jerusalem every disaster I pronounced against them. I spoke to them, but they did not listen; I called to them, but they did not answer.’ ”

source: Chuin Jeremiah chun Rechab insung mite jah-a chun, janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije ati, napau Jonadab thupeh nanit uva, adanho naman uva, aman thu napeh-u jouse dungjuija nabol lun ahi.
target: Then Jeremiah said to the family of the Rekabites, “This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘You have obeyed the command of your forefather Jehonadab and have followed all his instructions and have done everything he ordered.’

source: Hijeh chun janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, Rechab chapa Jonadab chu a-itih-a kamasanga ding ding mi lhasam louhel ding ahi, ati.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘Jehonadab son of Rekab will never fail to have a descendant to serve me.’ ”

source: 1 Judah lengpa Josiah chapa Jehoikim lengchankal kumli lhina in ahitin ahi, Pakaiya konin Jeremiah henga hiche thuhi ahung lhungin, hitin aseije.
target: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord :

source: Lekhajol bukhat lanlang, nahenga Israel thudol, Judah thudol, chule nam jouse thudol Josiah nikho laija patna tuni geija nahenga kanasei jouse chua chun sunlutnin.
target: “Take a scroll and write on it all the words I have spoken to you concerning Israel, Judah and all the other nations from the time I began speaking to you in the reign of Josiah till now.

source: Achunguva thilse bol dinga kagot jouse Judah insung miten ajah theina diuva, hiti achu mitin achonphatlou naova kona akiletheijuva, akhangitlou naole achonsetnao kangaidam theina diu ahi, ati.
target: Perhaps when the people of Judah hear about every disaster I plan to inflict on them, they will each turn from their wicked ways; then I will forgive their wickedness and their sin.”

source: Chuin Jeremiah chun Neriah chapa Baruch chu akouvin, Baruch chun Pakai thu jouse ahenga anaseisa chu Jeremiah kama konin lekhajol bukhatna ajihlut tai.
target: So Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah, and while Jeremiah dictated all the words the Lord had spoken to him, Baruch wrote them on the scroll.

source: Chuin Jeremiah chun Baruch chu akouvin, keima kikulkhup kahin, Pakai insunga kache theipon ahi.
target: Then Jeremiah told Baruch, “I am restricted; I am not allowed to go to the Lord ’s temple.

source: Hijeh chun chenlang, kakama kona najah Pakai thu lekhajol nasut chu anngol nile, Pakai ina mipi ho jahdin gasim doh-in, akhopiuva kona hungdoh Judah te jouse jahdia nagasim doh ding ahi, ati.
target: So you go to the house of the Lord on a day of fasting and read to the people from the scroll the words of the Lord that you wrote as I dictated. Read them to all the people of Judah who come in from their towns.

source: Chutile ataonao Pakai angsung hung lhungintin, amitakip achonphatlou naova kona hung kilehei thei diu ahi.
target: Perhaps they will bring their petition before the Lord and will each turn from their wicked ways, for the anger and wrath pronounced against this people by the Lord are great.”

source: Chuin Neriah chapa Baruch chun Jeremiah themgao thupeh jouse bangtah chun, Pakai in'a Pakai lekhabua thu chu asimdohtai.
target: Baruch son of Neriah did everything Jeremiah the prophet told him to do; at the Lord ’s temple he read the words of the Lord from the scroll.

source: Chuin Judah leng Josiah chapa Jehoiakim lengchankal kum nga lhina lhako na-in ahitin ahi. Jerusalem'a mijousele Judah khopiho-a kona Jerusalem'a hungho jouse jahdin Pakai masanga, anngol thu aphong taove.
target: In the ninth month of the fifth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, a time of fasting before the Lord was proclaimed for all the people in Jerusalem and those who had come from the towns of Judah.

source: Chuin Baruch in Pakai in'a chun Jeremiah thu chu lekhabua, lekhasun Shaphan chapa Gemariah indan-a, inhong chungnung jo-a, Pakai in kotpithah lutna-a chun, mijouse jahdin asimdohtai.
target: From the room of Gemariah son of Shaphan the secretary, which was in the upper courtyard at the entrance of the New Gate of the temple, Baruch read to all the people at the Lord ’s temple the words of Jeremiah from the scroll.

source: Shaphan chapa Gemariah chapa Michaiah chun, Pakai thu jouse lekhabua kona ajahdoh phatnin,
target: When Micaiah son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, heard all the words of the Lord from the scroll,

source: Lengpa insunga lekhasunpa indan sunga chun achesuh-in ahile, vetan hia chun milen jouse lekhasun Elishama tahjong, Shemaiah chapa Delaiah, Achbor chapa Elnathan, Shaphan chapa Gemariah, Hananiah chapa Zedekiah chule milen jouse anatouvun ahi.
