target: he went down to the secretary’s room in the royal palace, where all the officials were sitting: Elishama the secretary, Delaiah son of Shemaiah, Elnathan son of Akbor, Gemariah son of Shaphan, Zedekiah son of Hananiah, and all the other officials.

source: Chuphatnin Michaiah chun mipi ho jahdinga lekhabu asim, athu jouse chu ajah uva aphongdoh tai.
target: After Micaiah told them everything he had heard Baruch read to the people from the scroll,

source: Hijeh chun Kushi chapa, Shelamiah chapa, Nethaniah chapa Jehudi chu milenho jousen Baruch henga asolun, mipi jahdinga nasim lekhajol bu chu hinchoi jinlang, hungin, atiuve. Hitichun Neriah chapa Baruch chun lekhajol chu ahenguva ahinchoijin ahi.
target: all the officials sent Jehudi son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to say to Baruch, “Bring the scroll from which you have read to the people and come.” So Baruch son of Neriah went to them with the scroll in his hand.

source: Chuin amahon, tun touvin lang, keiho jahdin hinsimin, atiuve. Hitichun Baruch chun amaho jahdin asimtai.
target: They said to him, “Sit down, please, and read it to us.” So Baruch read it to them.

source: Tun ahitin ahi, amahon thu jouse chu ajah phatnun, amaho khatle khat akicha taovin, Baruch jah-a chun keihon hiche thu jousehi lengpa kaseipeh tei dingu ahi, atiuve.
target: When they heard all these words, they looked at each other in fear and said to Baruch, “We must report all these words to the king.”

source: Chuin amahon Baruch chu adongun hitin aseijuve, hiche thu jousehi akama kona itijong najih ham? neihilun atiuve.
target: Then they asked Baruch, “Tell us, how did you come to write all this? Did Jeremiah dictate it?”

source: Chuin Baruch chun, hiche thu jousehi akamin eihilin, lekhatuija lekhabua kasutjeng ahi, tin adonbutne.
target: “Yes,” Baruch replied, “he dictated all these words to me, and I wrote them in ink on the scroll.”

source: Chuin milenho chun Baruch henga, chenlang nangle Jeremiah kisel lhonin, koiman na-umnao hetdahen, atiuve.
target: Then the officials said to Baruch, “You and Jeremiah, go and hide. Don’t let anyone know where you are.”

source: Chuin inhong sunga lengpa henga alut lhonin, lekhajol vang chu lekhasunpa Elishama indan sunga adalha lhonin, thu jouse chu lengpa jahdin ahil lhone.
target: After they put the scroll in the room of Elishama the secretary, they went to the king in the courtyard and reported everything to him.

source: Hitichun lekhajol ladin lengpan Jehudi chu asolin, lekhasunpa Elishama indan-a konin agaladoh tai. Chuin lengpa le lengpa vela ding milenho jah dingin Jehudi chun asimin ahi.
target: The king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and Jehudi brought it from the room of Elishama the secretary and read it to the king and all the officials standing beside him.

source: Tun lhako na-in lengpa Phalbi laile aumjina insunga atouvin, amasanga meikhuh-a chun mei akongin ahi.
target: It was the ninth month and the king was sitting in the winter apartment, with a fire burning in the firepot in front of him.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Jehudi'n phengthum phengli asimjouvin, chemcha khatnin a-at tanin, thuh-a mei chun akahvamhel kahsen, thuh meija chun asepluttan ahi.
target: Whenever Jehudi had read three or four columns of the scroll, the king cut them off with a scribe’s knife and threw them into the firepot, until the entire scroll was burned in the fire.

source: Ahinla lengpa le akinbolho, hiche thu jouse ngaiho koimacha akicha pouvin, apon bottela jong aumpouve.
target: The king and all his attendants who heard all these words showed no fear, nor did they tear their clothes.

source: Ahijengvangin lekhajol chu ahal louna din Elnathan, Delaiah chule Gemariah chun lengpa chu angeh un, ahinla amaho thu angaipehpoi.
target: Even though Elnathan, Delaiah and Gemariah urged the king not to burn the scroll, he would not listen to them.

source: Ahin lengpan lekhasun Baruchle Jeremiah themgao mandin, Hammelech chapa Jerahmeel, Azriel chapa Seraiah, Abdeel chapa Shelemiah thu apen, ahinla Pakaiyin amani chu aseltai.
target: Instead, the king commanded Jerahmeel, a son of the king, Seraiah son of Azriel and Shelemiah son of Abdeel to arrest Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet. But the Lord had hidden them.

source: Chuin lekhajol le Jeremiah kama kona Baruch in ajih thuho jouse lengpan ahalvam jouvin, Pakai thu chu Jeremiah henga ahung lhungin ahi.
target: After the king burned the scroll containing the words that Baruch had written at Jeremiah’s dictation, the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:

source: Lekhajol bu adang lanlang, lekhajol bu masa-a thu jouse, Judah lengpa Jehoiakim ahalvam saho chu jihdoh kitnin ati.
target: “Take another scroll and write on it all the words that were on the first scroll, which Jehoiakim king of Judah burned up.

source: Chule Judah lengpa Jehoiakim henga chu hiti ahi nasei ding ahi. Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Babylon lengpa chu hungtei ding hiche gamhi asuhmanga, hichea patna chu mile sa kisubei ding ahi, tia kijihna chu, ibola chutobang thu najih ham? natin lekhabujol kisun chu nana halvamtan.
target: Also tell Jehoiakim king of Judah, ‘This is what the Lord says: You burned that scroll and said, “Why did you write on it that the king of Babylon would certainly come and destroy this land and wipe from it both man and beast?”

source: Hijeh chun Judah lengpa Jehoiakim thudol chu Pakaiyin hitihin aseije, aman David laltouna-a touding, koimacha aneilou ding, along jong sun nisatah noile jan buhdap lah-a kipaidoh ding ahi.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord says about Jehoiakim king of Judah: He will have no one to sit on the throne of David; his body will be thrown out and exposed to the heat by day and the frost by night.

source: Akhangit lounao jeh-a, amale achilhah chule asohte talen kapeh-a, amahole Jerusalem'a chengho, chule Judah mite chunga chu, achunguva kaphondohsa anahsah louvu, thilphalou jouse chu kalhunsah ding ahi, ati.
target: I will punish him and his children and his attendants for their wickedness; I will bring on them and those living in Jerusalem and the people of Judah every disaster I pronounced against them, because they have not listened.’ ”

source: Chuin Jeremiah chun lekhabujol dang alan Neriah chapa Baruch chu apen, hia chun aman Jeremiah kama kona lekhabu jihsa jouse, Jehoiakim'in meija ahalsa thuho chu ajih-in, chuche tilou jong akibahpi tamtah abelapme.
target: So Jeremiah took another scroll and gave it to the scribe Baruch son of Neriah, and as Jeremiah dictated, Baruch wrote on it all the words of the scroll that Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire. And many similar words were added to them.

source: Chuin Josiah chapa Zedekiah chu Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in Judah gam lenga anasem Jehoiakim chapa Koniah khelin alengchang tai.
target: Zedekiah son of Josiah was made king of Judah by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; he reigned in place of Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim.

source: Ahinla ama ahin, asohte ahin, gamsunga mite ahin, Jeremiah themgao kama asei Pakai thuho chu angai pouvin ahi.
target: Neither he nor his attendants nor the people of the land paid any attention to the words the Lord had spoken through Jeremiah the prophet.

source: Chuin Zedekiah lengpan Shelemiah chapa Jehucal le Maaseiah chapa Zephaniah thempu chu Jeremiah themgao henga Pakai ka Pathen'u henga tuhin neitao peh-un, ti dingin asole.
target: King Zedekiah, however, sent Jehukal son of Shelemiah with the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah to Jeremiah the prophet with this message: “Please pray to the Lord our God for us.”

source: Tun Jeremiah chu mipi ho lah-a chun alutle apotle in ahi. Ajehchu ama songkul'a akhum loulaiju ahi.
target: Now Jeremiah was free to come and go among the people, for he had not yet been put in prison.

source: Chuin Pharaoh sepaiho Egypt'a konin ahung kondoh taove; chuin Jerusalem kul-a Chaldea miten amaho thulhut ajah phatnun, Jerusalem adalha taove.
target: Pharaoh’s army had marched out of Egypt, and when the Babylonians who were besieging Jerusalem heard the report about them, they withdrew from Jerusalem.

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu Jeremiah themgao henga ahung lhungin aseije;
target: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah the prophet:

source: Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, eidop dinga nahinsolpao Judah lengpa henga hitihin seijun, vetan, nahu dinga hungkondoh Pharaoh sepaiho chu, agam lamu Egypt'a kilekit diu ahitai.
target: “This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Tell the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of me, ‘Pharaoh’s army, which has marched out to support you, will go back to its own land, to Egypt.

source: Chule Chaldea mite hungkit uva, hiche khopihi ahin satnuva, meija ahallhah diu ahi.
target: Then the Babylonians will return and attack this city; they will capture it and burn it down.’

source: Pakaiyin hitin ati, Chaldea mite chun eidalhah teidiu ahi, tin nanghole nangho kilhemlha hih-un, nadalhah louhel diu ahi.
target: “This is what the Lord says: Do not deceive yourselves, thinking, ‘The Babylonians will surely leave us.’ They will not!

source: Ajehchu nahin dou uva Chaldea sepai pumpihi satchai jongleu chun, alah uva machang umnalai ho jengjong, apon ina kona kipatdoh uva, hiche khopihi meija ahaldiu ahi, tin seijin.
target: Even if you were to defeat the entire Babylonian army that is attacking you and only wounded men were left in their tents, they would come out and burn this city down.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Pharaoh sepaiho ginna Chaldea sepaiho Jerusalem'a kona akitoldoh phatnun,
target: After the Babylonian army had withdrawn from Jerusalem because of Pharaoh’s army,

source: Jeremiah chu, mipi ho lah-a kona chom umdingin, Jerusalem'a konin apotdoh-in, Benjamin gam lama achetai.
target: Jeremiah started to leave the city to go to the territory of Benjamin to get his share of the property among the people there.

source: Chuin Benjamin kotpi agei phatnin, chuche veng lamkai khat, Hananiah chapa, Shelemiah chapa, amin Irijah chu anaumin, ama chun Jeremiah chu amanin, Chaldea miho henga jam nahi, ati.
target: But when he reached the Benjamin Gate, the captain of the guard, whose name was Irijah son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah, arrested him and said, “You are deserting to the Babylonians!”

source: Chuin Jeremiah chun, jou ahi, Chaldea mite henga jammang kahipoi ati. Ahinla aman angaipeh hih-in: hitichun Irijah chun Jeremiah chu amanin, lamkaiho henga apuitai.
target: “That’s not true!” Jeremiah said. “I am not deserting to the Babylonians.” But Irijah would not listen to him; instead, he arrested Jeremiah and brought him to the officials.

source: Hijeh chun pipuiho chu Jeremiah chunga analunghang lheh-un, avouvin, lekhasun Jonathan insunga songkul'a chun akhumtaove. Ajehchu hichu songkul'a akisemu ahi.
target: They were angry with Jeremiah and had him beaten and imprisoned in the house of Jonathan the secretary, which they had made into a prison.

source: Jeremiah chu leinoi'a, lhambuh sunga alutphatnin, chua chun nisottah aumtan ahi.
target: Jeremiah was put into a vaulted cell in a dungeon, where he remained a long time.

source: Chujouvin Zedekiah lengpan mi asolin, Jeremiah chu agapuidoh tai. Chuin lengpan a-insunga guhthim chan adongin, Pakaiya kona ipi thu umam? ati. Chuin Jeremiah chun, aume, atin ahi; ajehchu Babylon lengpa khutna kipedoh ding nahi, tin aseije.
target: Then King Zedekiah sent for him and had him brought to the palace, where he asked him privately, “Is there any word from the Lord ?” “Yes,” Jeremiah replied, “you will be delivered into the hands of the king of Babylon.”

source: Chukalvalin Jeremiah chun Zedekiah lengpa henga, nangma chungle nasohte chunga, ahiloule namite chunga ipi kasuhkhel uma songkul'a neikhum ham?
target: Then Jeremiah said to King Zedekiah, “What crime have I committed against you or your attendants or this people, that you have put me in prison?

source: Babylon lengpa nangma satdin ahiloule hiche gam satdin hungponte tia gaochangho nathemgao ho chu tu-a hoijaba um hitaovam?
target: Where are your prophets who prophesied to you, ‘The king of Babylon will not attack you or this land’?

source: Hijeh chun tun, ngaijin, katao ahi. Vo kapu lengpa, katao ahi, kangeh nahi na-angsunga neisanpeh in, hitichun lekhasun Jonathan ina neikilesah hih-in, ajole chukoma thidenget inge, ati.
target: But now, my lord the king, please listen. Let me bring my petition before you: Do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the secretary, or I will die there.”

source: Chuin Zedekiah lengpan Jeremiah chu songkul hongsunga akoina dingun, chule changlhah semho lamlena kona changlhah halkhat, khopi sunga changlhah abeihel kahse-a niseh-a apehjing diuvin thu apen ahi. Hitichun Jeremiah chu songkul hongsunga chun aumdentan ahi.
target: King Zedekiah then gave orders for Jeremiah to be placed in the courtyard of the guard and given a loaf of bread from the street of the bakers each day until all the bread in the city was gone. So Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard.

source: Chujouvin Mattan chapa Shephatiah, Pashhur chapa Gedaliah, Shelemiah chapa Jucal, chule Malchiah chapa Pashhur in mijouse henga Jeremiah thusei ho chu ajaovin,
target: Shephatiah son of Mattan, Gedaliah son of Pashhur, Jehukal son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur son of Malkijah heard what Jeremiah was telling all the people when he said,

source: hiche khopi sunga umdenpa chu chemjam'a, kella, chule, hise-a thiding ahi. Ahin Chaldea miho henga chedohpa chu hingding ahi. Ajehchu ahinkho chu gal anchah-a anei ding ahin, hijeh-a chu hingding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “This is what the Lord says: ‘Whoever stays in this city will die by the sword, famine or plague, but whoever goes over to the Babylonians will live. They will escape with their lives; they will live.’

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, hiche khopihi Babylon lengpa sepaiho khutna kipe-a, amahon alahdiu ahi.
target: And this is what the Lord says: ‘This city will certainly be given into the hands of the army of the king of Babylon, who will capture it.’ ”

source: Hijeh chun pipuiho chun, lengpa henga, kangeh-u nahi, hiche mipahi thatjengin, ajehchu aman hiche khopi sunga umnalai ho henga chutobang thu sei jeh-in sepaiho khutle mipi ho jouse khut hi angoisah-e, hiche pan hiche mite phatna ding aseipon, akisuhmona diu bou aseije, atiuve.
target: Then the officials said to the king, “This man should be put to death. He is discouraging the soldiers who are left in this city, as well as all the people, by the things he is saying to them. This man is not seeking the good of these people but their ruin.”

source: Chuin Zedekiah lengpan veuvin, ama nakhut uva um ahi. Lengpa hi nabolgot-u sutang thei ahipoi.
target: “He is in your hands,” King Zedekiah answered. “The king can do nothing to oppose you.”

source: Chujouvin amahon Jeremiah chu amanun, songkul hongsunga Hammelech chapa Malchiah leiko-a chun alehlutnun ahi. Ahin leiko-a chun twi aumpon, bonngan bou aumin, hitichun Jeremiah chu bonngan lah-a alhalut tai.
target: So they took Jeremiah and put him into the cistern of Malkijah, the king’s son, which was in the courtyard of the guard. They lowered Jeremiah by ropes into the cistern; it had no water in it, only mud, and Jeremiah sank down into the mud.

source: Tu-a lengpa in'a um Ethiopia mi, nukiso ho lah-a mi khat Ebed-melech chun, amahon Jeremiah chu leiko sunga akhum taove ti ajatan, hiche petna chu lengpa chu Benjamin kotpi phunga touva ahin,
target: But Ebed-Melek, a Cushite, an official in the royal palace, heard that they had put Jeremiah into the cistern. While the king was sitting in the Benjamin Gate,

source: Ebed-melech chu leng in'a konin apotdoh-in lengpa akihoupin aseije;
target: Ebed-Melek went out of the palace and said to him,

source: Kapu lengpa, hitehon Jeremiah themgao chunga abol jouseu khu thilsetah abolu ahitai. Amahon leiko sunga alehlutnun, aumna mun'a chu thiding kon ahitai. Ajehchu khopi sunga changlhah umlou ahitai, ati.
target: “My lord the king, these men have acted wickedly in all they have done to Jeremiah the prophet. They have thrown him into a cistern, where he will starve to death when there is no longer any bread in the city.”

source: Chujouvin lengpan Ethiopia mi Ebed-melech chu thu apen, hia konin mi thum kipuijin lang Jeremiah themgao chu, athi kah-in leiko-a konin gapuidoh un, ati.
target: Then the king commanded Ebed-Melek the Cushite, “Take thirty men from here with you and lift Jeremiah the prophet out of the cistern before he dies.”

source: Hitichun Ebed-melech chun miho chu akipuijin, lengpa ina thil kholna noija chun achen, ponlui ehsaho chu ahinlan, hicheho chu Jeremiah henga leiko-a chun khaovin agah khailhan ahi.
target: So Ebed-Melek took the men with him and went to a room under the treasury in the palace. He took some old rags and worn-out clothes from there and let them down with ropes to Jeremiah in the cistern.

source: Chuin Ebed-melech Ethiopia mipa chun Jeremiah henga hiche ponluihole asesahohi najahnoija khaohi ngapsah-in, ati. Chuin Jeremiah chun chutichun aboltai.
target: Ebed-Melek the Cushite said to Jeremiah, “Put these old rags and worn-out clothes under your arms to pad the ropes.” Jeremiah did so,

source: Hitichun Jeremiah chu khaovin aloidoh-un, leiko-a kon chun aladoh-un, Jeremiah chu songkul honsunga chun aumdentai.
target: and they pulled him up with the ropes and lifted him out of the cistern. And Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard.

source: Chuin Zedekiah lengpan Jeremiah chu akouvin, Pakai in-lutna thum na-a chun ahenga apuilut tai. Chuin lengpan Jeremiah jah-a, thilkhat donging ting, keija konin imacha imhih-in, ati.
target: Then King Zedekiah sent for Jeremiah the prophet and had him brought to the third entrance to the temple of the Lord . “I am going to ask you something,” the king said to Jeremiah. “Do not hide anything from me.”

source: Chuin Jeremiah'in Zedekiah jah-a, nahenga kaphondohle neithada mongding hinam? Chule thu kamopma nahile neingaipeh mongding ham? atin ahi.
target: Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “If I give you an answer, will you not kill me? Even if I did give you counsel, you would not listen to me.”

source: Hitichun Zedekiah lengpan Jeremiah henga guhthim tah-in hiche hinna eisempeh pau, Pakai chu ahinlaisen, nangma that ponge, nahinna hola hiche mite khutna jong pedoh ponge, tin akihahselin ahi.
target: But King Zedekiah swore this oath secretly to Jeremiah: “As surely as the Lord lives, who has given us breath, I will neither kill you nor hand you over to those who want to kill you.”

source: Chuphatnin Jeremiah chun Zedekiah henga Pakai, janel Pathen Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, nangma Babylon lengpa pipuho henga nakipehlut poupouva ahile hingin natin, hiche khopi jong meija kihal lou ding, nangle na-insung mite nahindiu ahi.
target: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “This is what the Lord God Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you surrender to the officers of the king of Babylon, your life will be spared and this city will not be burned down; you and your family will live.

source: Ahinla Babylon pipuiho lengpa henga nakipehlut loule vang, hiche khopihi Chaldea mite khutna kipedoh intin, meija ahaldiu, amaho khutna kona nahoidoh louhel ding ahi.
target: But if you will not surrender to the officers of the king of Babylon, this city will be given into the hands of the Babylonians and they will burn it down; you yourself will not escape from them.’ ”

source: Chuin Zedekiah lengpan Jeremiah henga, Chaldea miho khutna lutsa Judah ho khu kakichai, ajole amaho khutna eipedoh khauvintin eijapi getnunte, ati.
target: King Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, “I am afraid of the Jews who have gone over to the Babylonians, for the Babylonians may hand me over to them and they will mistreat me.”

source: Ahinla, Jeremiah chun pedoh pouvin nate, najah-a kasei Pakai aw hi juijengin, kangeh nahi, chutile nang din phantin, nahin ding ahi.
target: “They will not hand you over,” Jeremiah replied. “Obey the Lord by doing what I tell you. Then it will go well with you, and your life will be spared.

source: Nakipehlut nomloule vang, hichehi Pakaiyin thu eimusah chu ahi.
target: But if you refuse to surrender, this is what the Lord has revealed to me:

source: Chule vetan, Judah lengpa ina numei um jouse chu Babylon lengpa pipuho henga kipuija, hiche numei ho chun, aseidio ahi, nagolten natung doh-un, amahon najou taove. Nakengho bon lah-a alhalut tan, amaho akinungle taove.
target: All the women left in the palace of the king of Judah will be brought out to the officials of the king of Babylon. Those women will say to you: “ ‘They misled you and overcame you— those trusted friends of yours. Your feet are sunk in the mud; your friends have deserted you.’

source: Hiti achu najite jousele nachate jouse Chaldea miho henga apuidoh diu, akhutnuva kona nasochat louhel diu, Babylon lengpa khutna kikaijo ding nahin, nang jeh-a hiche khopihi meija kihal lhading ahitai, ati.
target: “All your wives and children will be brought out to the Babylonians. You yourself will not escape from their hands but will be captured by the king of Babylon; and this city will be burned down.”

source: Chuin Zedekiah chun Jeremiah henga, hiche thuho hi koimacha hetsah hih-in, nangma nathi lou ding ahi, ati.
target: Then Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, “Do not let anyone know about this conversation, or you may die.

source: Ahinla pipuhon nangma kakihoupihi heleu, nahenga hunguva, najah-a, lengpa henga naseijouse leh lengpan nakoma aseijouse tun keiho henga phongdoh-in, keiho-a konin imhih-in, nangma that pouvinge,
target: If the officials hear that I talked with you, and they come to you and say, ‘Tell us what you said to the king and what the king said to you; do not hide it from us or we will kill you,’

source: chuteng nangin ajah uva, Jonathan in'a eikilesah da-a, chua kagathiden louna dinga lengpa henga ngehna kanei jeng ahi, nati ding ahi, ati.
target: then tell them, ‘I was pleading with the king not to send me back to Jonathan’s house to die there.’ ”

source: Chujouvin pipuho jouse Jeremiah henga ahungun, ama adong taove. Aman amaho chu lengpan thu apeh jouse bang chun ahiltai. Hitichun akihouvu chu anga taove. Ajehchu amani kihouna chu ajahlou-u ahitai.
target: All the officials did come to Jeremiah and question him, and he told them everything the king had ordered him to say. So they said no more to him, for no one had heard his conversation with the king.

source: Hitichun Jeremiah chu Jerusalem kilahni geijin songkul hongsunga chun aume. Chule Jerusalem kilahni geijin aumin ahi.
target: And Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard until the day Jerusalem was captured. This is how Jerusalem was taken:

source: Judah lengpa Zedekiah lengchan kal kumko lhinna, lha som alhinna chun, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar le asepaite Jerusalem satdin ahungun, aumkul taove.
target: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his whole army and laid siege to it.

source: Chule Zedekiah lengchankal kum somlekhat lhina, lha li na-a ni ko lhinnin, khopi chu akeh tan ahi.
target: And on the ninth day of the fourth month of Zedekiah’s eleventh year, the city wall was broken through.

source: Chuin Babylon pipuiho jouse ahung lutnun, Nergal-sharezer, Samgar-nebo, Sarsechim, Rab-saris, Nergal-sharezer, Rabmag, Babylon lengpa pipuiho dang jouse toh kulpi lailha penachun atoutaove.
target: Then all the officials of the king of Babylon came and took seats in the Middle Gate: Nergal-Sharezer of Samgar, Nebo-Sarsekim a chief officer, Nergal-Sharezer a high official and all the other officials of the king of Babylon.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Judah lengpa Zedekiah le asepaiho jousen, amaho amu phatnun, jan-in khopi-a kon chun apotdoh-un, lengpa honlei lampia acheuvin, kulbang teni kikah-a kotpi-a chun ajamdoh taove; chule ama phaicham lampia achetai.
target: When Zedekiah king of Judah and all the soldiers saw them, they fled; they left the city at night by way of the king’s garden, through the gate between the two walls, and headed toward the Arabah.

source: Ahinla Chaldea sepaihon anung delun, Zedekiah chu Jericho phaichama aphapao vin, ama amat phatnun Hamath gama Riblah ah Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar henga apuijun, hia chun aman athu atanlhatai.
target: But the Babylonian army pursued them and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. They captured him and took him to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he pronounced sentence on him.

source: Chuin Babylon lengpan Riblah'a Zedekiah mitmu tah-in achapate chu athatnin, Babylon lengpan Judah milun jouse jong athatgam heltai.
target: There at Riblah the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes and also killed all the nobles of Judah.

source: Chukalvalin Zedekiah mitchang teni jong akaldoh-in, Babylon gama kaidin thihkhaova ahentai.
target: Then he put out Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him with bronze shackles to take him to Babylon.

source: Chuin Chaldea mihon lengpa inle mipi ho inho chu ahalun, Jerusalem kulbangho asuchimgam taove.
target: The Babylonians set fire to the royal palace and the houses of the people and broke down the walls of Jerusalem.

source: Chuin sepaiho lamkai Nebuzaradan chun khopi-a mipi umnalai ho, ahenga hungkipelut hole mipi amoh chengse chu Babylon'a sohchang din akaitai.
target: Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard carried into exile to Babylon the people who remained in the city, along with those who had gone over to him, and the rest of the people.

source: Ahin sepai lamkai Nebuzaradan chun, Judah gamsunga imacha neilou mivaichaho chu adalhan, amaho chu apetpetnin lengpilei le loumun apen ahi.
target: But Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard left behind in the land of Judah some of the poor people, who owned nothing; and at that time he gave them vineyards and fields.

source: Tun Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in Jeremiah chungchanga sepai lamakai Nebuzaradan henga,
target: Now Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had given these orders about Jeremiah through Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard:

source: amahi puijin lang, vetupmin, bolse hihhelin, nahenga asei ding bang bangin bolpeh-in, tin thu apei.
target: “Take him and look after him; don’t harm him but do for him whatever he asks.”

source: Hitichun sepai lamkai Nebuzaradan chun Nebushazban, Rab-saris, Nergal-sharezer, Rabmag chule Babylon lengpa pipuiho jouse asolin,
target: So Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard, Nebushazban a chief officer, Nergal-Sharezer a high official and all the other officers of the king of Babylon

source: amaho ngeijin Jeremiah chu songkul hongsunga konin mikhat agapuidoh sah-un, Shaphan chapa, Ahikam chapa, Gedaliah chu a-in'a puidin anganse uvin, hitichun miho lah-a achengtai.
target: sent and had Jeremiah taken out of the courtyard of the guard. They turned him over to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, to take him back to his home. So he remained among his own people.

source: Tun songkul hongsunga akulkhup laijun Jeremiah henga Pakai thu ahung lhungin, aseije,
target: While Jeremiah had been confined in the courtyard of the guard, the word of the Lord came to him:

source: Ethiopia mi Ebed-melech henga janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitihin aseije, vetan aphatna ding hilouva, hiche khopi setna ding joh-a kathu kahinlhut ding ahi. Hicheho chu namasanga hicheni chule guilhung ding ahi.
target: “Go and tell Ebed-Melek the Cushite, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I am about to fulfill my words against this city—words concerning disaster, not prosperity. At that time they will be fulfilled before your eyes.

source: Hicheni chule nangvang huhdoh nange, chule nakichat miho khutna kipedoh pon nate, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: But I will rescue you on that day, declares the Lord ; you will not be given into the hands of those you fear.

source: Ajehchu tahbeh-a kahoidohsah-a, chemjam'a naloulou ding, nahinkho chu gal anchah banga naneijoh ding ahi. Ajehchu kachunga natahsan na-ngap ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will save you; you will not fall by the sword but will escape with your life, because you trust in me, declares the Lord .’ ”

source: Judah le Jerusalem'a kon sohchang jouse, sepai lamkai Nebuzaradan chun Babylon gama sohchang dia kikaiho lah-a Jeremiah chu thihkhaova kihenpuma apuija Ramah a kona alhadoh nungin Pakaiya konin Jeremiah henga thu ahung lhungin ahi.
target: The word came to Jeremiah from the Lord after Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard had released him at Ramah. He had found Jeremiah bound in chains among all the captives from Jerusalem and Judah who were being carried into exile to Babylon.

source: Chuin sepai lamkaipan Jeremiah apuijin ajah-a, Pakai na Pathen'in hiche mun'a thilphalouhi aphondoh ahitai.
target: When the commander of the guard found Jeremiah, he said to him, “The Lord your God decreed this disaster for this place.

source: Tun Pakaiyin ahinlhun sahtan, asei bangin aboltai. Pakai douna-a nachonset uva, athu nangailou jeh uva hiche thil hi nachung uva hunglhung ahitai.
target: And now the Lord has brought it about; he has done just as he said he would. All this happened because you people sinned against the Lord and did not obey him.

source: Chule tun, vetan, tuni hin nakhutna thihkhaova konin kalha-ong tai. Babylon'a kei toh hung nanople hungin, ken nangma vetup nange, ahinla Babylon'a kei toh hung nanop loule hung datan, ven, gam jouse namasanga aume, nang dinga phale kitup nasahna lama chun chejengtan, ati.
target: But today I am freeing you from the chains on your wrists. Come with me to Babylon, if you like, and I will look after you; but if you do not want to, then don’t come. Look, the whole country lies before you; go wherever you please.”

source: Tun ama akilekit masangin, Babylon'a lengpan Judah khopiho-a vaipo dinga atun Saphan chapa Ahikam chapa Gadaliah toh gacheng khomtan; ahiloule pha nasah-a nache nomna lam lama chetan, ati. Hitichun sepai lamkai chun nehtheihole tohphat man apen asoltai.
target: However, before Jeremiah turned to go, Nebuzaradan added, “Go back to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has appointed over the towns of Judah, and live with him among the people, or go anywhere else you please.” Then the commander gave him provisions and a present and let him go.

source: Chuin Jeremiah chu Ahikam chapa Gedaliah heng Mizpeh-ah achen, akidalha miho lah-a ama toh achengtai.
target: So Jeremiah went to Gedaliah son of Ahikam at Mizpah and stayed with him among the people who were left behind in the land.

source: Tun gamlah-a um sepai gallamkai jouse le amiteuvin, Babylon lengpan Ahikam chapa Gedaliah chu gamsung vaipon apansah-in, pasal ho, numei ho, chapangho chule Babylon'a sohchanga kipuilou gamsung vaichaho vetupdin angansetai ti thu ajah phatnun,
target: When all the army officers and their men who were still in the open country heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam as governor over the land and had put him in charge of the men, women and children who were the poorest in the land and who had not been carried into exile to Babylon,

source: Amaho Nethaniah chapa Ishmael, Kareah chapa teni Johanan le Jonathan, Tanhumeth chapa Seriah, Netophah mi Ephai chapaho, Maachath mi chapa Jezaniah, amahole amiteu chu Mizpah'a um Gedaliah henga ahung taove.
target: they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah—Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth, the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maakathite, and their men.

source: Chuin Shaphan chapa, Ahikam chapa Gedaliah chu amahole amiteu henga akihahselin, Chaldea mite jending kicha hih-un, gamsunga chengun lang, Babylon lengpa kin bolun, hichu nangho dinga phading ahi.
target: Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, took an oath to reassure them and their men. “Do not be afraid to serve the Babylonians,” he said. “Settle down in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you.

source: Keidin vang veuvin, ihenguva hung ding Chaldea miho jendin Mizpah a cheng ingting, nangho vang lengpitwi, nipilai theiga ho le thao holkhom unlang nabel sunguva kikoijun, chule nalahsao khopiho-ah chengtauvin, ati.
target: I myself will stay at Mizpah to represent you before the Babylonians who come to us, but you are to harvest the wine, summer fruit and olive oil, and put them in your storage jars, and live in the towns you have taken over.”

source: Hibang chun Moab'a Judah te jouse Ammon mite lah-a umho, Edom mite lah-a umho chule gamsung jouse-a umhon, Babylon lengpan Judah mi phabep adalhan, achunguva vaipodin Shaphan chapa, Ahikam chapa Gedaliah apansah-e, ti ajah phatnun,
target: When all the Jews in Moab, Ammon, Edom and all the other countries heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant in Judah and had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, as governor over them,

source: Judah te jouse akino mangnao gamho-a konin, Judah gama, Gedaliah heng Mizpah-ah ahungun lengpitwi le nipilai theiho tamtah akiholkhomun ahi.
target: they all came back to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah at Mizpah, from all the countries where they had been scattered. And they harvested an abundance of wine and summer fruit.

source: Chukalvalin Kareah chapa Johanan le gama um sepaiho gallamkai jouse, Gedaliah heng Mizpah a ahungun,
target: Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers still in the open country came to Gedaliah at Mizpah

source: Ahenga, Ammon lengpa Baalis chun Nethaniah chapa Ishmael chu nangma that dinga asol chu nahet chennem? atiuve. Ahinla Ahikam chapa Gedaliah chun amaho atahsanpon ahi.
target: and said to him, “Don’t you know that Baalis king of the Ammonites has sent Ishmael son of Nethaniah to take your life?” But Gedaliah son of Ahikam did not believe them.

source: Chujouvin Kareah chapa Johanan chun Mizpah a Gedaliah henga, katao ahi, neisol jengin, Nethaniah chapa Ishmael chu gathat jeng'inge, koiman heponte, Judah mi nahenga umkhomho jouse acheh chauna dingle Judah'a amohho manthah na ding bepma ibola aman nangma natha ding ham? tin guhthim chan ahung seije.
target: Then Johanan son of Kareah said privately to Gedaliah in Mizpah, “Let me go and kill Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and no one will know it. Why should he take your life and cause all the Jews who are gathered around you to be scattered and the remnant of Judah to perish?”

source: Ahinla Ahikam chapa Gedaliah chun Kareah chapa Johanan henga, nangin hichehi nabol lou ding ahi; ajehchu Ishmael thu naseihi adihlou ahi, ati.
target: But Gedaliah son of Ahikam said to Johanan son of Kareah, “Don’t do such a thing! What you are saying about Ishmael is not true.”

source: Tun lha sagi lhinin ahitin ahi, lengte chilhah lah-a Elishama chapa, Nethaniah chapa Ishmael le lengpa pipuiho, amatoh mi somjen, Mizpah ah Ahikam chapa Gedaliah henga ahungun, chukom Mizpah a chun changlhah anekhomuve.
target: In the seventh month Ishmael son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, who was of royal blood and had been one of the king’s officers, came with ten men to Gedaliah son of Ahikam at Mizpah. While they were eating together there,

source: Chuin Nethaniah chapa Ishmael le alhonpi mi som akipatnun, chemjamin Shaphan chapa, Ahikam chapa Gedaliah Babylon lengpan vaipo-a apansah chu athat taove.
target: Ishmael son of Nethaniah and the ten men who were with him got up and struck down Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, with the sword, killing the one whom the king of Babylon had appointed as governor over the land.

source: Ishmael'in Mizpah a Gedaliah toh um Judah miho jousele chua anaumkha Chaldea te sepai jong athatgam helin ahi.
target: Ishmael also killed all the men of Judah who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, as well as the Babylonian soldiers who were there.

source: Chuin aman Gedaliah athajou nini na-a chun ahitin ahi, chule hichu koiman ahetlou ahin,
target: The day after Gedaliah’s assassination, before anyone knew about it,

source: Shechem'a kon, Shiloh'a kon, Samaria'a konin mi somget jen, akhamul hetsa cheh aponsilu kibot tela, amale ama ki-atchen chenna, akhutnuva thilpehle gimnamtui choija, Pakai in'a tohdoh din ahunguve.
target: eighty men who had shaved off their beards, torn their clothes and cut themselves came from Shechem, Shiloh and Samaria, bringing grain offerings and incense with them to the house of the Lord .

source: Chuin Nethaniah chapa Ishmael chu Mizpah a konin amaho kimupi din, kappum pumin ajah uva, Ahikam chapa Gedaliah henga hungun, ati.
target: Ishmael son of Nethaniah went out from Mizpah to meet them, weeping as he went. When he met them, he said, “Come to Gedaliah son of Ahikam.”

source: Hitichu anahin, khopi lailung ahunggei phatnun, Nethaniah chapa Ishmael'in, amipuiho toh amaho chu athatnun kotong lailunga alehlut taove.
target: When they went into the city, Ishmael son of Nethaniah and the men who were with him slaughtered them and threw them into a cistern.

source: Ahinla alah uva, mi somho chun Ishmael jah-a, neithat hih-un, ajehchu keihon suhlouchang, sakol chang, thao, chule khoiju selguh kaneijuve, atiuve. Hitichun ama atangin, amaho chu asopihou lah-a chun athat tapon ahi.
target: But ten of them said to Ishmael, “Don’t kill us! We have wheat and barley, olive oil and honey, hidden in a field.” So he let them alone and did not kill them with the others.

source: Tun Ishmael'in Gedaliah jeh-a amithaho long apaina kotong chu Asa lengpan Israel lengpa Baasha agin jeh-a alai ahin, Nethaniah chapa Ishmael'in amithaho longin adippeh in ahi.
target: Now the cistern where he threw all the bodies of the men he had killed along with Gedaliah was the one King Asa had made as part of his defense against Baasha king of Israel. Ishmael son of Nethaniah filled it with the dead.

source: Chuin Ishmael'in Mizpah a amoh umsun leng chanute, Mizpah a sepai lamkai Nebuzaradan'in Ahikam chapa Gedaliah apehdohho, Mizpah a um jouse apuimangin, Nethaniah chapa Ishmael'in amaho chu sohchangin akaimangin, Ammon mite gam kalpeh-a din akipatdoh tai.
target: Ishmael made captives of all the rest of the people who were in Mizpah—the king’s daughters along with all the others who were left there, over whom Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam. Ishmael son of Nethaniah took them captive and set out to cross over to the Ammonites.

source: Ahinla Kareah chapa Johanan le aumpi sepai gallamkai jousen, Nethaniah chapa Ishmael thilbol phalou jouse ajah phatnun,
target: When Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him heard about all the crimes Ishmael son of Nethaniah had committed,

source: mijouse apuijun Nethaniah chapa Ishmael satdin akonun, Gibeon'a twi tamtah umna-a chun aphapa taove.
target: they took all their men and went to fight Ishmael son of Nethaniah. They caught up with him near the great pool in Gibeon.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Ishmael umpi mi jousen Kareah chapa Johanan le ahinpui sepai gallamkai jouse amu phatnun akipah behseh jenguve.
target: When all the people Ishmael had with him saw Johanan son of Kareah and the army officers who were with him, they were glad.

source: Hitichun sohchanga Mizpah a kona Ishmael'in apuimang mi jouse ahung kinunghei cheh uvin, Kareah chapa Johanan heng lama achetauve.
target: All the people Ishmael had taken captive at Mizpah turned and went over to Johanan son of Kareah.

source: Nethaniah chapa Ishmael vang chu mi get toh Johanan'a konin ahoidoh-un Ammon mite henga achetauve.
target: But Ishmael son of Nethaniah and eight of his men escaped from Johanan and fled to the Ammonites.

source: Chuin Kareah chapa Johanan le aumpi sepai gallamkai jouse chun, Nethaniah chapa Ishmael'in Ahikam chapa Gedaliah atha jouva Mizpah a kona Nethaniah chapa Ishmael''a kona Johanan'in ahuhdoh mijouse, gal hat ho, numei ho, chapangho, nukiso ho, chu Gibeon'a konin ahin lepuisoh kit tai.
target: Then Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him led away all the people of Mizpah who had survived, whom Johanan had recovered from Ishmael son of Nethaniah after Ishmael had assassinated Gedaliah son of Ahikam—the soldiers, women, children and court officials he had recovered from Gibeon.

source: Akipat doh-un, Egypt jotlutna Bethlehem koma Chimham achun acheng taove.
target: And they went on, stopping at Geruth Kimham near Bethlehem on their way to Egypt

source: Ajehchu, gamsunga vaipo dinga Babylon lengpan anapansah Ahikam chapa Gedaliah chu, Nethaniah chapa Ishmael'in anatha jeh-a chu Chaldea miho akichatnu ahi.
target: to escape the Babylonians. They were afraid of them because Ishmael son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon had appointed as governor over the land.

source: Chujouvin sepaiho gal lamkaiho le Kareah chapa Johanan, Hoshaiah chapa Jezeniah, chule mipi ho jouse, chule mijouse aneopena pat alenpen gei ahung naijun,
target: Then all the army officers, including Johanan son of Kareah and Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least to the greatest approached

source: Jeremiah themgao jah-a nahenga kangeh-u ahi, kataonaohi neisan peh-un lang Pakai na Pathen henga neitao peh-un, ajehchu neimu-u banga hi keihohi tamtah lah-a themcha bou kidalha kahitao vin;
target: Jeremiah the prophet and said to him, “Please hear our petition and pray to the Lord your God for this entire remnant. For as you now see, though we were once many, now only a few are left.

source: chutia chu Pakai na Pathen'in kachena diu lampile kabol diu thil eihil theina diuvin, atiuve.
target: Pray that the Lord your God will tell us where we should go and what we should do.”

source: Chuin Jeremiah themgaovin ajah uva, nathu-u chu kahei, veuvin, nathu-u bangin Pakai na-Pathen'u henga thuminge, chule hiti ding ahi, Pakaiyin nadonbutna diu thil chu ipi hijongle naheng uva phongdoh nange, nangho-a konin imacha imponge, ati.
target: “I have heard you,” replied Jeremiah the prophet. “I will certainly pray to the Lord your God as you have requested; I will tell you everything the Lord says and will keep nothing back from you.”

source: Chuin amahon Jeremiah henga Pakai na-Pathen'in kahenguva nasolna thu jouse banga kabol louvule kalah uva Pakai chu hettohsah dihtahle tahsan umtah hihen.
target: Then they said to Jeremiah, “May the Lord be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not act in accordance with everything the Lord your God sends you to tell us.

source: Ahenga kasolnapao Pakai ka-Pathen'u aw chu apha hihen ase hile juinao vinge, hitia chu Pakai ka-Pathen'u aw kajui tengule keiho dinga phattheina hiding ahi, atiuve.
target: Whether it is favorable or unfavorable, we will obey the Lord our God, to whom we are sending you, so that it will go well with us, for we will obey the Lord our God.”

source: Chuin nisom jouvin ahitin ahi, Pakai thu chu Jeremiah henga ahungtai.
target: Ten days later the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah.

source: Chuin Kereah chapa Johanan le aumpi sepaiho gallamkai jousele sepai jouse, aneopena pat,
target: So he called together Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him and all the people from the least to the greatest.

source: alenpen geijin akouvin, ajah uva, Pakai na Pathen'u a-anga nathumnao lhut dinga neisolna pao chun hitin aseije.
target: He said to them, “This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your petition, says:

source: Hiche gamahi tuni geija naum jing nahlai diule, tungdoh ungting sonlhu ponge, chule naphutnu vingting, botdoh pouvinge, ajehchu nachung uva thilphalou kalhunsah chu kakisih tai.
target: ‘If you stay in this land, I will build you up and not tear you down; I will plant you and not uproot you, for I have relented concerning the disaster I have inflicted on you.

source: Babylon lengpa naginnu chu ging tahih-un, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije, ajehchu ama khutna kona huhhing dingle huhdoh dinga kaumpi nahiuve.
target: Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, whom you now fear. Do not be afraid of him, declares the Lord , for I am with you and will save you and deliver you from his hands.

source: Chule nachung uva hepina anei theina dinga, naheng uva hepina kavetsah-a, nangho naleiset uva kakilesah ding ahi.
target: I will show you compassion so that he will have compassion on you and restore you to your land.’

source: Ahinla nanghon, hiche gama cheng pouvinge, Pakai na Pathen thu jong ngai pouvinge, nati uve,
target: “However, if you say, ‘We will not stay in this land,’ and so disobey the Lord your God,

source: kanom pouve, Egypt gama chejovinge, chua galthu jata pouvinge, sumkon gin jong, changlhah-a gilkelna jong umta ponte, chua kache diu ahi, nati uve.
target: and if you say, ‘No, we will go and live in Egypt, where we will not see war or hear the trumpet or be hungry for bread,’

source: Hijeh chun tun, nangho Judah te amoh chengin Pakai thu chu ngaijun, janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin ati, Egypt'a lutdingle chua pem dinga namaiju napum ngat helu ahitahle,
target: then hear the word of the Lord , you remnant of Judah. This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you are determined to go to Egypt and you do go to settle there,

source: hung hiti ding ahi, naginnu chemjam chun Egypt gama nahinphah diu, chule nakichatnu kel chun naitah-a Egypt gama nahin juijuva, chua chu nathi diu ahi.
target: then the sword you fear will overtake you there, and the famine you dread will follow you into Egypt, and there you will die.

source: Egypt gama pem dinga amaiju pumngat hel ho chunga chutobanga chu umding ahi. Amaho chemjam'a, kela, hise-a thiuva, achunguva thilse kalhunsah dinga kona chu khatcha amohle asohcha umlou helding ahi.
target: Indeed, all who are determined to go to Egypt to settle there will die by the sword, famine and plague; not one of them will survive or escape the disaster I will bring on them.’

source: Ajehchu janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, kalunghana le kalungsatna Jerusalem'a chengte chunga kasunlhah jeng banga chu, nachung uva kalungsatna chu Egypt gam nalhun tengule kasunlhah-a ki-dah le datmo, sapsetle mi houset nahiuva, hiche gamhi namukit loudiu ahi.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘As my anger and wrath have been poured out on those who lived in Jerusalem, so will my wrath be poured out on you when you go to Egypt. You will be a curse and an object of horror, a curse and an object of reproach; you will never see this place again.’

source: Vo nangho Judah amoh chengse, Pakaiyin nachung chang thu-u hitin aseije, Egypt'a che hih-un: tunia kahin hilchah naohi kihet chenun.
target: “Remnant of Judah, the Lord has told you, ‘Do not go to Egypt.’ Be sure of this: I warn you today

source: Pakai ka-Pathen'u henga neitao peh-un tia Pakai na Pathen'u henga neisol petnu chun nalung gelu na-im uvin, Pakai ka-Pathen'un asei ding jouse dungjuijin, neiphondoh peh-un, juijuvinge, nati uve.
target: that you made a fatal mistake when you sent me to the Lord your God and said, ‘Pray to the Lord our God for us; tell us everything he says and we will do it.’

source: Keiman tuni hin naheng uva kaphongdohtan, Pakai na Pathen'u aw ahiloule naheng uva eihinsol lona khatcha najui pouvin ahi.
target: I have told you today, but you still have not obeyed the Lord your God in all he sent me to tell you.

source: Hijeh chun tun pemna dinga nache nomnao mun'a chu chemjam'a, kela, hise-a nathi teidiu ahi ti kihetchen jotaovin, ati.
target: So now, be sure of this: You will die by the sword, famine and plague in the place where you want to go to settle.”

source: Chuin Jeremiah chun miho jouse henga Pakai a-Pathen'u thu jouse Pakai Pathen'in sei dinga asolna thu, hicheng thu jouse chu aseichai phatnin ahung hitin ahi.
target: When Jeremiah had finished telling the people all the words of the Lord their God—everything the Lord had sent him to tell them—

source: Chuin Hoshaiah chapa Azeriah le Kereah chapa Johanan chule mihoitho ho jouse chun Jeremiah henga, Pakaiyin Egypt gama pem dinga nache loudiu ahi tia sei dingin nasolpoi.
target: Azariah son of Hoshaiah and Johanan son of Kareah and all the arrogant men said to Jeremiah, “You are lying! The Lord our God has not sent you to say, ‘You must not go to Egypt to settle there.’

source: Tha dinga Babylon'a eipui theina diuva, Chaldea miho khutna pedoh dinga, Neriah chapa Baruch in natun ahibouve, atiuve.
target: But Baruch son of Neriah is inciting you against us to hand us over to the Babylonians, so they may kill us or carry us into exile to Babylon.”

source: Hitichun Kareah chapa Johanan le sepaiho gallamkai jouse chule mipite jouse chun, Judah gama chenna dingin, Pakai thu chu angai tapouve.
target: So Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers and all the people disobeyed the Lord ’s command to stay in the land of Judah.

source: Hitichun Kareah chapa Johanan le sepaiho gallamkai jouse chun; amoh umsun Juda ho jouse, Judah gama cheng dinga akinomang nao namtin lah-a kona hungkileho,
target: Instead, Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers led away all the remnant of Judah who had come back to live in the land of Judah from all the nations where they had been scattered.

source: pasal ho, numei ho, chapangho, leng chanute chule Shaphan chapa, Ahikam chapa, Gedaliah toh sepai lamkai Nebuzaradan'in adalhah amitakip, chule Jeremiah themgao le Neriah chapa Baruch jaonan abonchauvin apuidoh taove.
target: They also led away all those whom Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard had left with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan—the men, the women, the children and the king’s daughters. And they took Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah along with them.

source: Hitichun Egypt gamsung ahung lhung taove. Ajehchu amahon Pakai thu angai pouvin, hitichun Tahpanhes mun ngei chu ahung lhung taove.
target: So they entered Egypt in disobedience to the Lord and went as far as Tahpanhes.

source: Chuin Tahpanhes achun Jeremiah henga Pakai thu ahung lhungin, aseije,
target: In Tahpanhes the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:

source: nakhutnin songchang len hochu lanlang Juda mite mitmu tah-in Tahpanhes a Pharaoh inlutna lampi-a kipha songpeh noija khun gavuijin,
target: “While the Jews are watching, take some large stones with you and bury them in clay in the brick pavement at the entrance to Pharaoh’s palace in Tahpanhes.

source: chule ajah uva hitin seijin, janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, ngaijun kalhacha Babylon leng Nebuchadnezzar chu kakouva, hiche songchang kivuisaho chungahi alaltouna atundoh-a, chule aleng pondal loupi chu ajahdoh ding ahi.
target: Then say to them, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I will send for my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and I will set his throne over these stones I have buried here; he will spread his royal canopy above them.

source: Chule ama ahung teng Egypt gam ahin bolset ding athi dinga chu thina-a, sohchang dinga chu sohchan na-a, chemjam'a loudingho chu chemjam'a apehdoh ding ahi.
target: He will come and attack Egypt, bringing death to those destined for death, captivity to those destined for captivity, and the sword to those destined for the sword.

source: Chule keiman Egypt gama pathenho insunga mei kachokaija, hichun ahallhah ding, amaho chu sohchanga akaimang ding, kelngoichingpan avon chunga hit le kha aphetngim banga amanjong Egypt gam chu asuhtheng hella, chua kona mongtah-a potdoh ding ahi.
target: He will set fire to the temples of the gods of Egypt; he will burn their temples and take their gods captive. As a shepherd picks his garment clean of lice, so he will pick Egypt clean and depart.

source: Aman Egypt gama Beth-shemesh'a um song milimho jong chu asuhchima, Egypt mite pathen inho chu meija ahallhah ding ahi.
target: There in the temple of the sun in Egypt he will demolish the sacred pillars and will burn down the temples of the gods of Egypt.’ ”

source: Egypt gama Judah umjouse Migdol gama chengho, Tahpanhes chule Noph khoho, Pathros gama chengho chungchanga Jeremiah henga thu ahung lhungin hitin aseije,
target: This word came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews living in Lower Egypt—in Migdol, Tahpanhes and Memphis—and in Upper Egypt:

source: Janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin ati, Jerusalem le Judah khopi jouse-a thilphalou kalhunsah jouse chu namutaovin, chule veuvin, amaho tuhin akamhelun, chuachun koimacha acheng tapouve.
target: “This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You saw the great disaster I brought on Jerusalem and on all the towns of Judah. Today they lie deserted and in ruins

source: Lunghansahna dinga eiphinset uva, agitlou jehu'n, amahon ahetphah louvu amahole nangho, chule napateu vin jong ahetkhah louvu pathen dangho jen dingin gimnamtui hal dingin acheuve.
target: because of the evil they have done. They aroused my anger by burning incense to and worshiping other gods that neither they nor you nor your ancestors ever knew.

source: Hijengjongle naheng uva kalhacha themgaoho jouse chu, Ohe, hiche thil thet um kakidah tahhi bolhih helun, tidingin matah-a thouvin kahinsolin ahi.
target: Again and again I sent my servants the prophets, who said, ‘Do not do this detestable thing that I hate!’

source: Ahinla amahon angaideh pouve, Pathen dangho henga gimnamtui ahallouna dingule, agitlounauva kona akileheina dingun anao jong asungdeh pouve.
target: But they did not listen or pay attention; they did not turn from their wickedness or stop burning incense to other gods.

source: Hijeh chun kalunghana le kalungsatna chu Judah khopihole Jerusalem khopi lamlena kabunglhan, akadohtai. Chule hichu tunia banghin akisumangin, akamheltan ahi.
target: Therefore, my fierce anger was poured out; it raged against the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem and made them the desolate ruins they are today.

source: Hijeh chun tun Pakai janel Pathen, Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, ibola nalah uva kona pasal le numei, naosen le nao noicheplai Judah gamsunga kona paidoh-a aum nading bepmin hiche thilsehi nabol uve,
target: “Now this is what the Lord God Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Why bring such great disaster on yourselves by cutting off from Judah the men and women, the children and infants, and so leave yourselves without a remnant?

source: chenna dinga nachenao Egypt gamsunga pathenho henga gimnamtui nahal uva, leiset chunga nam jouse lah-a sapsetle seiset nachan theinadiu le satlhah nahitheina diuva nakhutsoh tah uva neiphin lunghangu ham?
target: Why arouse my anger with what your hands have made, burning incense to other gods in Egypt, where you have come to live? You will destroy yourselves and make yourselves a curse and an object of reproach among all the nations on earth.

source: Judah gamsungle Jerusalem khosung lamlena napateu leh Judah lengte gitlouna, ajiteule nanghotah gitlouna, chule najiteuvin gitlouna anabolhou chu nasuhmilu hitam?
target: Have you forgotten the wickedness committed by your ancestors and by the kings and queens of Judah and the wickedness committed by you and your wives in the land of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem?

source: Amaho tuni geijin jong akineo sahdeh pouvin, akichadeh pouve, nanghole napateu masanga kakoijing keima danthu le chondan ho-a jong achon pouve.
target: To this day they have not humbled themselves or shown reverence, nor have they followed my law and the decrees I set before you and your ancestors.

source: Hijeh chun janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin ati, keiman nangho douna-a thilse dingle Judah te satlhahna dinga kamaingat diu ahi.
target: “Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I am determined to bring disaster on you and to destroy all Judah.

source: Egypt gamsunga pem dinga maingat Judah amoh umsun chu kamatna kasuh manghel soh ding, Egypt gama lhalut uva, chemjam le kela thigamhel diu, aneopena pat alenpen geija chemjam le kela thidiu, thet le datmoa, gaosap le seisetna umdiu ahi.
target: I will take away the remnant of Judah who were determined to go to Egypt to settle there. They will all perish in Egypt; they will fall by the sword or die from famine. From the least to the greatest, they will die by sword or famine. They will become a curse and an object of horror, a curse and an object of reproach.

source: Keiman Jerusalem chu chemjam'a, kela, chule hise-a talen kapeh banga Egypt gamsunga chengho chu talen kapeh ding ahin,
target: I will punish those who live in Egypt with the sword, famine and plague, as I punished Jerusalem.

source: Hitichun Egypt gamsunga cheng dinga che Judah mi a-umsun hochu, chenna dinga angaitun tunu Judah gama chu kilekit dinga khatcha ahoidoh le avaldoh umlou ding, aguh-a jamdoh ho tilou khatcha akilekit umlouhel dingu ahi.
target: None of the remnant of Judah who have gone to live in Egypt will escape or survive to return to the land of Judah, to which they long to return and live; none will return except a few fugitives.”

source: Chule pathen dangho henga ajiteuvin gimnamtui ahaluve ti he-a mijousen akoma ding numei jouse mihonpi atama tam, Egypt gama cheng mijouse, Pathros-a chun Jeremiah chu adonbutnun, aseijun,
target: Then all the men who knew that their wives were burning incense to other gods, along with all the women who were present—a large assembly—and all the people living in Lower and Upper Egypt, said to Jeremiah,

source: Pakai mina kahenguva nathusei chu ngaipou vinge, atiuve.
target: “We will not listen to the message you have spoken to us in the name of the Lord !

source: Keihole kapateu, kalengteo le kapipui houvin, Judah khopihole Jerusalem khopi lamlen dunga anabol banguva, van lengnu henga gimnamtui hal le, ahenga don thilpeh sunlhah ding kakamsung tah uva kaseinao bangcheh-a kaboltei teidiu ahi. Ajehchu hichelai chun nehding tamtah kaneijun, aphan, thilse imacha kamupouve.
target: We will certainly do everything we said we would: We will burn incense to the Queen of Heaven and will pour out drink offerings to her just as we and our ancestors, our kings and our officials did in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem. At that time we had plenty of food and were well off and suffered no harm.

source: Ahinla van lengnu henga gimnamtui halla don thilpeh sunlhah katan uva pat ijakai kalhasamun, chemjam le kelin eiki sumangun ahi.
target: But ever since we stopped burning incense to the Queen of Heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have had nothing and have been perishing by sword and famine.”

source: Chule van lengnu dinga gimnamtui kahal uva, don thilpeh kasunlhah laijuva chu, kapasalteu thu louva amanu houna dinga changlhah kasemuva, don thilpeh kasunlhah-u hibeh-em? atiuve.
target: The women added, “When we burned incense to the Queen of Heaven and poured out drink offerings to her, did not our husbands know that we were making cakes impressed with her image and pouring out drink offerings to her?”

source: Chujouvin Jeremiah chun mijouse hengale pasal ho, numei ho, ama donbutho jouse henga chun aseijin,
target: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, both men and women, who were answering him,

source: Judah khopihole Jerusalem khopi lamlen ho-a, nanghole napateu nalengteu chule gamsunga miten, gimnamtui nanahalu chu, Pakaiyin ahetlou hija alungsunga akhumlou hibeh-am?
target: “Did not the Lord remember and call to mind the incense burned in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem by you and your ancestors, your kings and your officials and the people of the land?

source: Nathilse boljeh-u le nathilbolu kidah um jeh-a, Pakaiyin athohjou tahlou ahin, hiche jeh-a chu, nagamu tu-a bangahi kamdela, datmo uma, sapset changa achenga umlouhel ahitai.
target: When the Lord could no longer endure your wicked actions and the detestable things you did, your land became a curse and a desolate waste without inhabitants, as it is today.

source: Gimnamtui nahal uva, Pakai douna-a nachonset uva, Pakai thu nangai daova, adan kisun thupeh le achondan najuilou jeh uva, hiche jeh-a chu tu-a bangahi nachung uva hiche thilsehi hungchua ahitai, ati.
target: Because you have burned incense and have sinned against the Lord and have not obeyed him or followed his law or his decrees or his stipulations, this disaster has come upon you, as you now see.”

source: Chukalvalin Jeremiah chun mijousele numei jouse jah-a aseijin, Egypt gama um Judah te jousen Pakai thuhi ngaijun.
target: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, including the women, “Hear the word of the Lord , all you people of Judah in Egypt.

source: Janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, nanghole najiteuvin van lengnu henga gimnamtui hal le don thilpeh sunlhah ding, kanakitepnao banga kabol teitei dingu ahi, tin nakamun naseijun, nakhut un namolso taove. Nakitepnao bulhitnun lang, nakitepnao molsouvin.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You and your wives have done what you said you would do when you promised, ‘We will certainly carry out the vows we made to burn incense and pour out drink offerings to the Queen of Heaven.’ “Go ahead then, do what you promised! Keep your vows!

source: Hijeh chun Egypt gama cheng Judah te jousen Pakai thu chu ngaijun, veuvin, Egypt gamsung pumpi-a Judah mi koimachan kamin aphahpoh tahlou ding ahi tia kamin thengtah pana kakitep ahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije, Pakai ahing jinge.
target: But hear the word of the Lord , all you Jews living in Egypt: ‘I swear by my great name,’ says the Lord , ‘that no one from Judah living anywhere in Egypt will ever again invoke my name or swear, “As surely as the Sovereign Lord lives.”

source: Veuvin, aphatna ding hilou, asetna dinga kachan jingding, Egypt gamsunga Judah mijouse akichai soh hel kahseuva chemjam le kel lhah-a kisumanghel ding ahiuve.
target: For I am watching over them for harm, not for good; the Jews in Egypt will perish by sword and famine until they are all destroyed.

source: Ahinla chemjam'a sohcha themcha khat Egypt gama konin Judah gama kileuvintin, Judah mi umsun jouse Egypt gama cheng dinga chesate chun, kei thuham, amaho thuham, koi thujoh atah ahiding hetaovinte.
target: Those who escape the sword and return to the land of Judah from Egypt will be very few. Then the whole remnant of Judah who came to live in Egypt will know whose word will stand—mine or theirs.

source: Hichehi nangho dinga melchihna hiding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, hiche munahi nangho talen kapeh uva, nanghon kathuhi nangho douna-a, aselama dingjing ding ahi ti nahet theidiu ahi.
target: “ ‘This will be the sign to you that I will punish you in this place,’ declares the Lord , ‘so that you will know that my threats of harm against you will surely stand.’

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, vetan, Judah leng Zedekiah chu ama thadinga holjing amelmapa, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar khutna kapeh banga, Egypt lengpa Pharaoh hophra jong amelmate, ama that dinga holjingho khutna kapehdoh ding ahi, ati.
target: This is what the Lord says: ‘I am going to deliver Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hands of his enemies who want to kill him, just as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the enemy who wanted to kill him.’ ”

source: Judah leng Josiah chapa Jehoiakim lengchankal kumli channa-a Jeremiah kama hiche thuho asutlaija Keriah chapa Baruch henga Jeremiah themgaovin asei thu chu,
target: When Baruch son of Neriah wrote on a scroll the words Jeremiah the prophet dictated in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, Jeremiah said this to Baruch:

source: Vo Baruch, Pakai Israel Pathen'in nahenga hitin aseije,
target: “This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch:

source: Nangman Ohe, tun ada kahitai, Pakaiyin kalungkhamna chunga lung gentheina eibelappeh-in, khoisatna-in kalhutan, choldona kaneipoi, nati-e.
target: You said, ‘Woe to me! The Lord has added sorrow to my pain; I am worn out with groaning and find no rest.’

source: Nangin ajah-a hiti ahi nasei ding ahi, Pakaiyin vetan, keiman kasah chu kaphelhan, kaphu chu hiche gam pumpi geijahi kabodoh ding ahi, ati.
target: But the Lord has told me to say to you, ‘This is what the Lord says: I will overthrow what I have built and uproot what I have planted, throughout the earth.

source: Nangin thil lenlen nachangseh dinga nahol ham? Bol hih-in, ajehchu mihing jouse chunga thilse kalhunsah ding ahi, Pakaiyin nahinkho hi nachena muntina nangma dinga anchah bepma bou kapeh ding nahi, ati.
target: Should you then seek great things for yourself? Do not seek them. For I will bring disaster on all people, declares the Lord , but wherever you go I will let you escape with your life.’ ”

source: Chidang namdangho chungchanga Jeremiah henga Pakai thu hunglhung chun;
target: This is the word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations:

source: Egypt chungchang Euphrates luipi kama Karchemish kho-a chun, Judah leng Josiah chapa Jehoiakim lengchankal kumli lhinna in Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar chun Egypt lengpa Pharaoh-Neko sepaiho chu anajoutan ahi.
target: Concerning Egypt: This is the message against the army of Pharaoh Necho king of Egypt, which was defeated at Carchemish on the Euphrates River by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:

source: Pho leh lum kigotnun lang, gal lam nailutnun.
target: “Prepare your shields, both large and small, and march out for battle!

source: Sakol phoho semtupmun lang, nangho sakol chungchongho kipatdoh-un, nathih lukhuh-u toh dingdoh uvin, tengcha kinol hemun lang, thih sangkhol ki-ah uvin.
target: Harness the horses, mount the steeds! Take your positions with helmets on! Polish your spears, put on your armor!

source: Ibola lungthoija anungjamu kamuham? Agal hatteu alhugamun, nunglam velouvin gangtah-in ajamuve. Avelu tijatnan alotai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: What do I see? They are terrified, they are retreating, their warriors are defeated. They flee in haste without looking back, and there is terror on every side,” declares the Lord .

source: Akaljanga jammang dahen, mihat jong sohcha hihhen, amaho Euphrates luipi kom sahlama kipat uva lhugam diu ahi.
target: “The swift cannot flee nor the strong escape. In the north by the River Euphrates they stumble and fall.

source: Vadung banga atwi pomtultula, twisoh banga hung kinong lullul khu koiham?
target: “Who is this that rises like the Nile, like rivers of surging waters?

source: Egypt hi twisoh atuiho pomtultul luipi abangin, kakhan touva leiset kalosoh ding, akhopile asunga chengho kasuhmang ding ahi, ati.
target: Egypt rises like the Nile, like rivers of surging waters. She says, ‘I will rise and cover the earth; I will destroy cities and their people.’

source: Sakol nangho hung touvun, kangtalai nangho kino uvin, mihat ho hungdoh-u hen, lum choija Ethiopia mite le Egypt mite, thalpi kaosa-a choija Lydia mite.
target: Charge, you horses! Drive furiously, you charioteers! March on, you warriors—men of Cush and Put who carry shields, men of Lydia who draw the bow.

source: Ajehchu hichehi janel Pakai Pathen nikho phulah nikho ahin, akidoupiho chunga phu chu alah theina ding ahin, chemjamin aneh chaija, lungnachima athisanu adonkham ding ahi. Ajehchu Euphrates luipi pang sahlam gamkaijah janel Pakai Pathen'in ganlhaina abolin ahi.
target: But that day belongs to the Lord, the Lord Almighty— a day of vengeance, for vengeance on his foes. The sword will devour till it is satisfied, till it has quenched its thirst with blood. For the Lord, the Lord Almighty, will offer sacrifice in the land of the north by the River Euphrates.

source: Vo Egypt chanu nungah theng, Gilead'a chetouvin, nuding thingnailou gakilah-in, ajehchu nadampi louding loule ai tampi naman ding ahi.
target: “Go up to Gilead and get balm, Virgin Daughter Egypt. But you try many medicines in vain; there is no healing for you.

source: Namtin vaipin najachatna ajauvin, nakana in gamsung alosohtai. Mihatle mihat atatton, tolla alhugel lhontai.
target: The nations will hear of your shame; your cries will fill the earth. One warrior will stumble over another; both will fall down together.”

source: Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar iti ahunga Egypt gam ajo ding thudol chu Pakai chun Jeremiah henga aseije.
target: This is the message the Lord spoke to Jeremiah the prophet about the coming of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to attack Egypt:

source: Egypt gama seichoijun lang, Migdol le Noph chule Tahpanhes ah phongjalun, dingdet unlang, kigal ginun, ajehchu chemjamin nakimvel uva miho ahinsatgam ding ahi.
target: “Announce this in Egypt, and proclaim it in Migdol; proclaim it also in Memphis and Tahpanhes: ‘Take your positions and get ready, for the sword devours those around you.’

source: Ipi jeh-a namihatteu kiphet manga hitaovam? Amaho Pakaiyin anojeh uva ding joulou ahiuve.
target: Why will your warriors be laid low? They cannot stand, for the Lord will push them down.

source: Aman mi tampi alhuhsah-in ahi, khat chunga khat alhuvin, amahon, kipat un, suhgentheina chemjam'a konin imiteu heng, igam lamuvah chekit taohite, atiuve.
target: They will stumble repeatedly; they will fall over each other. They will say, ‘Get up, let us go back to our own people and our native lands, away from the sword of the oppressor.’

source: Hia chun amahon asamun, Egypt lengpa Pharaoh vang ahu gin keubou ahin, phat kitepsa amoh suhmange, atiuve.
target: There they will exclaim, ‘Pharaoh king of Egypt is only a loud noise; he has missed his opportunity.’

source: Amin janel Pakai lengpa chun keima kahing jinge, tahbeh-in mol ho lah-a Tabor bangle luipi panga Karmel banga ama hung ding ahi.
target: “As surely as I live,” declares the King, whose name is the Lord Almighty, “one will come who is like Tabor among the mountains, like Carmel by the sea.

source: Vo Egypt'a cheng chanu, nangma sohchanga chedin kigojengtan, ajehchu Noph chu keuhela chenna louva kamhel ding ahi.
target: Pack your belongings for exile, you who live in Egypt, for Memphis will be laid waste and lie in ruins without inhabitant.

source: Egypt hi bongla hoitah abangin, ahinla manthah na ahungin, hichu sahlama kona hunga ahi.
target: “Egypt is a beautiful heifer, but a gadfly is coming against her from the north.

source: Bongchal thaotah bangin amithalah houjong chu alah uva aumin, ajehchu amaho jong akinung heijun, ajamkhom taove. Ajehchu amanthah nau nikhole atosetnao phat achunguva ahung lhun jeh-a ding joulou ahitaove.
target: The mercenaries in her ranks are like fattened calves. They too will turn and flee together, they will not stand their ground, for the day of disaster is coming upon them, the time for them to be punished.

source: Chua husa chu gul kitholgin abangin, amaho chu gammang thingtuho banga heicha kenga galmiho toh hungdiu ahi.
target: Egypt will hiss like a fleeing serpent as the enemy advances in force; they will come against her with axes, like men who cut down trees.

source: Amaho khaokhoho sanga tam ahiuvin, simjouhoi ahilou jehu'n, kholtoh hoi hihih jongleu agammang chu atuhchaihel diu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: They will chop down her forest,” declares the Lord , “dense though it be. They are more numerous than locusts, they cannot be counted.

source: Egypt chanu kijumso-a, sahlam gamkai mite khutna kipedoh ding ahi.
target: Daughter Egypt will be put to shame, given into the hands of the people of the north.”

source: Janel Pakai Israelte Pathen'in aseije, vetan, Amon mi No mihonpi, Pharaoh le Egypt chu a-pathenho le alengteu puma, Pharaoh amatah le ama tahsan jouse talen kapeh ding ahi.
target: The Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: “I am about to bring punishment on Amon god of Thebes, on Pharaoh, on Egypt and her gods and her kings, and on those who rely on Pharaoh.

source: Keiman amaho chu ahinnao holtele Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar le asohte khutna kapehdoh ding, chujou tengle masanga banga Egypt gama chu mi cheng ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will give them into the hands of those who want to kill them—Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and his officers. Later, however, Egypt will be inhabited as in times past,” declares the Lord .

source: Ahinla Vo kalhacha Jacob, nangma kicha hih-in, ajehchu vetan, nangma gamlatah-a kona chule nachilhahte asohchannau gama kona kahuhdoh ding, Jacob chu hung kinungle-a ongthol tah-a choldoa, koimachan akichatsah lou ding ahi.
target: “Do not be afraid, Jacob my servant; do not be dismayed, Israel. I will surely save you out of a distant place, your descendants from the land of their exile. Jacob will again have peace and security, and no one will make him afraid.

source: Kicha hih-in, Vo kalhacha Jacob, tin Pakaiyin ati, ajehchu keiman kaumpinai, keiman nangma kadel mangna namho jouse kichaina chu kabolpeh ding ahin, nangma kichaina vang kabolpeh lou ding, tena-a vang kasuhdih ding nahi, hijengjongle talen manlouva vang kakoi louhel ding nahi, ati.
target: Do not be afraid, Jacob my servant, for I am with you,” declares the Lord . “Though I completely destroy all the nations among which I scatter you, I will not completely destroy you. I will discipline you but only in due measure; I will not let you go entirely unpunished.”

source: Pharaoh'in Gaza ajo masangin Philistine te thudola themgao Jeremiah henga Pakai thu ahung lhunge.
target: This is the word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines before Pharaoh attacked Gaza:

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, vetan sahlama kona twisang hunglena, gamsungle asunga um jouse akhopile asunga chengho achup gamhel ding, chuteng miho chu kapmuva gamsunga chengho jouse pengdiu ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says: “See how the waters are rising in the north; they will become an overflowing torrent. They will overflow the land and everything in it, the towns and those who live in them. The people will cry out; all who dwell in the land will wail

source: Asakol hat hou kholhah ginin, akangtalai ho lhaiginle akangho kipei pohlahlah chun, pate khut ngoisah-in tin, achateu cheng nungvet pouvinte.
target: at the sound of the hooves of galloping steeds, at the noise of enemy chariots and the rumble of their wheels. Parents will not turn to help their children; their hands will hang limp.

source: Hichu Philistine te kisuhgamna le Tyre le Zidon'a panpi umsunho suhmanghel nikho ahijeh in, Pakaiyin Philistine te Caphtor gamsunga amoh umsun chu asuhmanghel ding ahi.
target: For the day has come to destroy all the Philistines and to remove all survivors who could help Tyre and Sidon. The Lord is about to destroy the Philistines, the remnant from the coasts of Caphtor.

source: Gaza chunga luchaina alhungin, Ashkelon chu phaicham amoh umsun pumin akisumang heltai. Itihchan naki-at chenchen ding hitam?
target: Gaza will shave her head in mourning; Ashkelon will be silenced. You remnant on the plain, how long will you cut yourselves?

source: Vo nangma Pakai chemjam, itihchan mong nathip dingham? Napaija kikhumlutnin lang, kicholdon lang thipchet tan.
target: “ ‘Alas, sword of the Lord , how long till you rest? Return to your sheath; cease and be still.’

source: Pakaiyin Ashkelon le twipi pamma ho sat dinga thu apeh-a, apansah ahile, iti umthim thei ding ham? ati.
target: But how can it rest when the Lord has commanded it, when he has ordered it to attack Ashkelon and the coast?”

source: Janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in Moab dounan hitin aseije; Ohe Nebo, ada ahi, ajehchu akisusea nahitai; Kiriathaim akijumson, akilatai; Misgab ajahchan, alungthoi tai.
target: Concerning Moab: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: “Woe to Nebo, for it will be ruined. Kiriathaim will be disgraced and captured; the stronghold will be disgraced and shattered.

source: Moab kivahchoina umta ponte, Heshbon dounan thilse agonguve, hungun, namkhat ahina-a konin sutanhel uhite. Vo Madmen namho, nangho jong kisatlha ding nahiuvin, chemjamin najuidiu ahi.
target: Moab will be praised no more; in Heshbon people will plot her downfall: ‘Come, let us put an end to that nation.’ You, the people of Madmen, will also be silenced; the sword will pursue you.

source: Horonaim'a kona chomna le suhmangna nasatah kana awgin sohdoh ding ahi.
target: Cries of anguish arise from Horonaim, cries of great havoc and destruction.

source: Moab akisumang tai, achasen hou ka-na akijan,
target: Moab will be broken; her little ones will cry out.

source: Ajehchu Luhith chetouna-a kap kapmin acheuvin, Horonaim kumsuh na-a melmaten asuhmangna jeh-a kana ajaove.
target: They go up the hill to Luhith, weeping bitterly as they go; on the road down to Horonaim anguished cries over the destruction are heard.

source: Jamun, nahinna kihuhhingun lang, gamthip hamhing bangin umun,
target: Flee! Run for your lives; become like a bush in the desert.

source: Ajehchu nathilbol le nahaona natahsan jeh-a, nangma jong kiman ding nahin, Chemosh chu athempuhou le apipuiho puma sohchanga chediu ahi.
target: Since you trust in your deeds and riches, you too will be taken captive, and Chemosh will go into exile, together with his priests and officials.

source: Khopi tina misumang hungintin, khopi khatcha hoilou ding, Pakaiyin asei banga damphai jong mangthah-a phaicham jong kisumang ding ahi.
target: The destroyer will come against every town, and not a town will escape. The valley will be ruined and the plateau destroyed, because the Lord has spoken.

source: Alenmang theina din Moab chu lhaving peuvin, ajehchu acheng beija akhopi chu kamhel ding ahi.
target: Put salt on Moab, for she will be laid waste; her towns will become desolate, with no one to live in them.

source: Jonchihtah-a Pakai na tonga chu sapset changhen, thisan sona dinga achemjam tuhkihpa jong chu sapset chenghen.
target: “A curse on anyone who is lax in doing the Lord ’s work! A curse on anyone who keeps their sword from bloodshed!

source: Moab hi aneuva pat nomsa ahin, ajuninga kivah-a, ajubel khatna khat jong keukhalou, ama jong sohchanga chekhalou ahi, hijeh achu atuina ama-a umden dena, anamtui jong kikhel lou ahi.
target: “Moab has been at rest from youth, like wine left on its dregs, not poured from one jar to another— she has not gone into exile. So she tastes as she did, and her aroma is unchanged.

source: Hijeh chun veuvin, nikho chu hunglhung ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, ahenga vahveiho kasola, amahon avaveisah dingu, chule jubelho avoh chippeh uva ahaihou asuhchippeh diu ahi.
target: But days are coming,” declares the Lord , “when I will send men who pour from pitchers, and they will pour her out; they will empty her pitchers and smash her jars.

source: Israel insungin atahsan Bethel ajachatpiu banga Moab miten Chemosh ajachatpi diu ahi.
target: Then Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as Israel was ashamed when they trusted in Bethel.

source: Keiho gal hat le mihang kahiuve, iti natiu ham?
target: “How can you say, ‘We are warriors, men valiant in battle’?

source: Moab akisumang tan, akhopiho-a konin abeidoh tai. Alhentum khangthah ho jong akithat ho lah-a apanggam taove, tin amin janel Pakai hija lengpa chun aseije.
target: Moab will be destroyed and her towns invaded; her finest young men will go down in the slaughter,” declares the King, whose name is the Lord Almighty.

source: Moab hamsetna chu hunglhung vah ding ahitai, chule athohgimna chu kinoloi chela ahitai.
target: “The fall of Moab is at hand; her calamity will come quickly.

source: Nangho avela um jousen lunghem piuvin, amin heho jousen, mol lhon hamtahle moltum hoitah chu iti boh-a hitam? tiuvin!
