target: Mourn for her, all who live around her, all who know her fame; say, ‘How broken is the mighty scepter, how broken the glorious staff!’

source: Dibon'a cheng chanu nangma, naloupi na-a konin hungsuh-in lang, dang chah-in touvin, ajehchu Moab sumanga chun nahin satna, nakulpi det ho asuhmang diu ahitai.
target: “Come down from your glory and sit on the parched ground, you inhabitants of Daughter Dibon, for the one who destroys Moab will come up against you and ruin your fortified cities.

source: Vo Aroer'a cheng lampia dingin lang velhin, ajampale ahoidoh nu chu ipi soh-a hitam? tin dongin lang seijin.
target: Stand by the road and watch, you who live in Aroer. Ask the man fleeing and the woman escaping, ask them, ‘What has happened?’

source: Moab chu achimlhah jeh-in ajahchatai. Pengchoi choijin kapmun, Moab akisumang tai tin Arnon hilleuvin.
target: Moab is disgraced, for she is shattered. Wail and cry out! Announce by the Arnon that Moab is destroyed.

source: Phaicham gama Holon le Jahazah chu chule Mephaath chunga, thutanlhahna aumin,
target: Judgment has come to the plateau— to Holon, Jahzah and Mephaath,

source: Dibon le Nebo, chule Beth-diblathaim chunga,
target: to Dibon, Nebo and Beth Diblathaim,

source: Kiriathaim le Beth-gamul, chule Beth-meon chunga,
target: to Kiriathaim, Beth Gamul and Beth Meon,

source: Kerioth le Bozrah chule Moab khopiho jouse naijale gamla-a chunga thutanna ahung lhungtai.
target: to Kerioth and Bozrah— to all the towns of Moab, far and near.

source: Moab ki akisatlhan, abanjang akihehbongtai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Moab’s horn is cut off; her arm is broken,” declares the Lord .

source: Pakai douna-a akiloupisah jeh-in, ama chu khamsah uvin, Moab jong alohlhahna-a kibola anuiho totna jong ahi.
target: “Make her drunk, for she has defied the Lord . Let Moab wallow in her vomit; let her be an object of ridicule.

source: Israel chu nang dinga nuijatna bep hilou ham? Ama gucha lah-a kimukha am? Ama thudol nasei poupoule kipah-in nakichom chomjin ahi.
target: Was not Israel the object of your ridicule? Was she caught among thieves, that you shake your head in scorn whenever you speak of her?

source: Vo Moab gama chengho, Khopiho dalhauvin, songkoa chengun, kohom panga bu kiset vakhu bangin umun.
target: Abandon your towns and dwell among the rocks, you who live in Moab. Be like a dove that makes its nest at the mouth of a cave.

source: Keihon Moab kiletsahna thu, ama akiletsah lheh-e; akichoisangin, ahoithoji-e, akiletsah jeh le alung hoithodan kamuvin ahi.
target: “We have heard of Moab’s pride— how great is her arrogance!— of her insolence, her pride, her conceit and the haughtiness of her heart.

source: Alungsatna chu kahei, tin Pakaiyin aseije; ahinla chutilou ding ahi, ajounaho chun ima sodoh ponte.
target: I know her insolence but it is futile,” declares the Lord , “and her boasts accomplish nothing.

source: Hijeh chun Moab din penging ting, Moab pumpi din kapdoh inge, Kirheres mite chu lunghem pinge.
target: Therefore I wail over Moab, for all Moab I cry out, I moan for the people of Kir Hareseth.

source: Vo Sibman lengpigui Jaazar ka-na in nangma dingin kapminge, naguiho twipi ajam galkaijin, Jaazar twipi chan geihel ajame, na nipitheile lengpiga sumangpa nachunga achutai.
target: I weep for you, as Jazer weeps, you vines of Sibmah. Your branches spread as far as the sea; they reached as far as Jazer. The destroyer has fallen on your ripened fruit and grapes.

source: Neh nenna le Moab gama konin thanopnale kipana akilamang tan, lengpiga chilna-a konin lengpiga kabeisahtai. Koimachan kipa awgin to tho-a achiltah louding, a-ao nau chu kipana hitalou ding ahi.
target: Joy and gladness are gone from the orchards and fields of Moab. I have stopped the flow of wine from the presses; no one treads them with shouts of joy. Although there are shouts, they are not shouts of joy.

source: Heshbon'a kona Elealeh gei peh-a kho kisam chu Jahaz gei peh-in a-awginu athongin, Zoar apat Horodnaim geijin kum thum bongla abangin, ajehchu Nimrim twiho jong kamhel ding ahi.
target: “The sound of their cry rises from Heshbon to Elealeh and Jahaz, from Zoar as far as Horonaim and Eglath Shelishiyah, for even the waters of Nimrim are dried up.

source: Chukalvalin Moab'a munsang ho-a thilto bolpale a-pathen hou henga gimnamtui halpa kasuhthip ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: In Moab I will put an end to those who make offerings on the high places and burn incense to their gods,” declares the Lord .

source: Hijeh chun kalunghi Moab te dingin thih bangin gingintin, kalunghi Hirheres mite dingin theile ho bangin ginginte, ajehchu aman anei haonaho beigama ahitai.
target: “So my heart laments for Moab like the music of a pipe; it laments like a pipe for the people of Kir Hareseth. The wealth they acquired is gone.

source: Ajehchu lu jouse chaija, khamul jouse kivou ding, khut jouse-a ki-at ding, kongho chunga khaopon akiveitai.
target: Every head is shaved and every beard cut off; every hand is slashed and every waist is covered with sackcloth.

source: Moab intingvum jousele khosung lamlen ho-a tanggola lunghemna jeng umding ahin, ajehchu asunga lunglhaina umlouhel bangin kavochiptai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: On all the roofs in Moab and in the public squares there is nothing but mourning, for I have broken Moab like a jar that no one wants,” declares the Lord .

source: Amaho penguva, iti hichu kisu chipma, Moab chu jahcha geuva iti kinungheija hitam atidiu ahi. Hitia chu Moab chu nuisat le akimvella umho dinga lungthoina hiding ahi.
target: “How shattered she is! How they wail! How Moab turns her back in shame! Moab has become an object of ridicule, an object of horror to all those around her.”

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Veuvin, ama mulaopi bangin hunglengin tin, Moab chunga alhaving ahinjah ding ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says: “Look! An eagle is swooping down, spreading its wings over Moab.

source: Kerioth chu akila ahitan, akuldet hou achim sohtan, chuche ni-a Moab mihangsan ho lungthim chu numei naonei pet lungthim tobang bep ahi.
target: Kerioth will be captured and the strongholds taken. In that day the hearts of Moab’s warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor.

source: Moab chu Pakai douna-a amale ama akichoisang jeh-a mite khat ahinaova kona kisumang ding ahitai.
target: Moab will be destroyed as a nation because she defied the Lord .

source: Vo Moab'a cheng, nachunga tijatna le kokhuh chule thang hungchu ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Terror and pit and snare await you, you people of Moab,” declares the Lord .

source: Tijatna-a kona jam-a chu kokhuh-a lhalutnin tin, kokhuh-a kona hungdoh-a chu thanga ohding ahi. Ajehchu achunga Moab chungtah-a talen kapeh kum kalhunsah ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Whoever flees from the terror will fall into a pit, whoever climbs out of the pit will be caught in a snare; for I will bring on Moab the year of her punishment,” declares the Lord .

source: Heshbon lim noija galmiho jeh-in ajamho adingden taovin; ahinla Heshbon'a konin mei chule Sihon'a konin meikong hungintin, Moab ningkoile samel mula umho lallukhuh akahvam ding ahi.
target: “In the shadow of Heshbon the fugitives stand helpless, for a fire has gone out from Heshbon, a blaze from the midst of Sihon; it burns the foreheads of Moab, the skulls of the noisy boasters.

source: Vo Moab ada nahitai! Chemosh mite amangthah taove. Ajehchu nachapate sohchangin akikaijin, nachanute asohchang taove.
target: Woe to you, Moab! The people of Chemosh are destroyed; your sons are taken into exile and your daughters into captivity.

source: Hijongle ninunung lamle Moab sohchangho chu kahinlepui kit ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Hichan geihi Moab thu kitanlha chu ahi.
target: “Yet I will restore the fortunes of Moab in days to come,” declares the Lord . Here ends the judgment on Moab.

source: Ammon mite thudol chu Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Israel'in chapa aneilou ham? Aman goulo aneilou ham? achutile ibola alengpauvin Gad alo-a, amite akhopiho-a chenguva ham?
target: Concerning the Ammonites: This is what the Lord says: “Has Israel no sons? Has Israel no heir? Why then has Molek taken possession of Gad? Why do his people live in its towns?

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin aseije, Vetan, nikho ahung lhunge, Ammon mite kho Kabbah a galkisat thuthang kajahsah ding, hichu agohkeo kisevum hija, achanuteu meija kigou ding; chuteng ama gouloho chu Israel ten alodiu ahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: But the days are coming,” declares the Lord , “when I will sound the battle cry against Rabbah of the Ammonites; it will become a mound of ruins, and its surrounding villages will be set on fire. Then Israel will drive out those who drove her out,” says the Lord .

source: Vo Heshbon, Ai kisuhmang jeh-in pengun, Rabbah chanute kapmun, khaodip pon kigah-un lang lunghemun, hamkhul lah-a suhle tungin lhaijun, ajehchu alengpaule athempuhou chule apipuiteu agoma sohchanga chediu ahitai.
target: “Wail, Heshbon, for Ai is destroyed! Cry out, you inhabitants of Rabbah! Put on sackcloth and mourn; rush here and there inside the walls, for Molek will go into exile, together with his priests and officials.

source: Vo chanu nungchonnu, ibola na phaichamm phalai chuleh phaicham ho-a nakiloupi sah-a nagoukhol ho-a nakisona, kahenga koi hung ding hija? nati ham?
target: Why do you boast of your valleys, boast of your valleys so fruitful? Unfaithful Daughter Ammon, you trust in your riches and say, ‘Who will attack me?’

source: Vetan, nachunga tijatna, navela umho jouse-a kona kahinlhunsah-a, nangho amitakip kinomang jeng ding, alamvaipa chu koimachan akhopkhom lou ding ahitai, tin janel Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: I will bring terror on you from all those around you,” declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty. “Every one of you will be driven away, and no one will gather the fugitives.

source: Khonungle Ammon chate sohchangho kalepui ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Yet afterward, I will restore the fortunes of the Ammonites,” declares the Lord .

source: Edom thudol chu janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Teman'a chihna beihela hitam? Milungchinga kona thumopna mangthah-a hitam? ahetkhen themnao mangdela hitam?
target: Concerning Edom: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “Is there no longer wisdom in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom decayed?

source: Vo Dedan'a chengte, jamun, kinung leuvin, chengdetnun, ajehchu keiman Esau chunga hamsetna kahinlhut ding, ama gotna kapeh ding phat kahin lhunsah ding ahi.
target: Turn and flee, hide in deep caves, you who live in Dedan, for I will bring disaster on Esau at the time when I punish him.

source: Lengpiga louho nahenga hungleu akhai themkhat dalha pouvintem? Jan-in guchaho hungu le achim kahseuva aneh mang loudiu ham?
target: If grape pickers came to you, would they not leave a few grapes? If thieves came during the night, would they not steal only as much as they wanted?

source: Ahinla Esau ahomkeovin kalhan, amunthip ho kahohdoh gamtan, kisel thei lou ding ahitai. Achilhahte leh asopiho, chule aheng akomho akisumang sohtan, ama abeihel tai.
target: But I will strip Esau bare; I will uncover his hiding places, so that he cannot conceal himself. His armed men are destroyed, also his allies and neighbors, so there is no one to say,

source: Paneilou nachateho chu dalhan, keiman hinso nange, chule nameithai hon eitahsanu hen.
target: ‘Leave your fatherless children; I will keep them alive. Your widows too can depend on me.’ ”

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin hitin ati, Vetan, khona kon adonlou dinga athu kitanlhah hon adonjeng tah-ule, talen manlou ding pa chu nangma nahim? Talen manlouvin chepon nate, ahinla hichea chu nadon tei ding ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says: “If those who do not deserve to drink the cup must drink it, why should you go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, but must drink it.

source: Keima kaki hahsel tai, tin Pakaiyin aseije, Bozrah chu kamhela, seisetna uma, keohela, sapsetna umding; chuche khopi jouse a-itih-a keohel ding ahi.
target: I swear by myself,” declares the Lord , “that Bozrah will become a ruin and a curse, an object of horror and reproach; and all its towns will be in ruins forever.”

source: Pakaiya konin thuthang khat kajan, Pathen helouho henga palai khat akisolin, kipun khomun, chule ama satnun, galbol din kipatdoh-un.
target: I have heard a message from the Lord ; an envoy was sent to the nations to say, “Assemble yourselves to attack it! Rise up for battle!”

source: Ajehchu vetan, keiman nangma Pathen helouho lah-a kaneosah-a, mite nahsahmo-a kasem ding nahi.
target: “Now I will make you small among the nations, despised by mankind.

source: Vo nang lhangsanga song khikah-a cheng, kichat umtah banga nakigelna le nalunga kiletsahna chun nalheplhah ahitai. Nangman muvanlai banga sangin nabu sepjongle chun, chua kona kaloilhah ding nahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: The terror you inspire and the pride of your heart have deceived you, you who live in the clefts of the rocks, who occupy the heights of the hill. Though you build your nest as high as the eagle’s, from there I will bring you down,” declares the Lord .

source: Edom jong kamhel intin, koi hile ajotpa chan atosetna jeh-a chehsa diu ahi.
target: “Edom will become an object of horror; all who pass by will be appalled and will scoff because of all its wounds.

source: Sodom le Gomorrah chule avela khopiho akisuhmang helbanga, chua koimacha umlou ding, mihem chapa jong cheng louhel ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin ati.
target: As Sodom and Gomorrah were overthrown, along with their neighboring towns,” says the Lord , “so no one will live there; no people will dwell in it.

source: Veuvin, Jordan twisoh akonin ama chu kuldet nokhum dingin keipibahkai bangin hungtouvintin, ahinla ama-a kona hetman louva kadelmang ding ahi, chule achunga vaipo dinga kalhenthei pasal lhentum koiham? Kei tobang koi umam? Koijin phat eiteppeh ding ham? Ka anga dingding kelngoi chingpa chu koi ham?
target: “Like a lion coming up from Jordan’s thickets to a rich pastureland, I will chase Edom from its land in an instant. Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this? Who is like me and who can challenge me? And what shepherd can stand against me?”

source: Hijeh chun Edom douna Pakai thumopte, Teman'a chengte chunga athilgon, bol dinga agot ho chu ngaijun, thonlouva ganhon neopen geija kilhoh manga amaho puma achennao akamhelsah tei ding ahi.
target: Therefore, hear what the Lord has planned against Edom, what he has purposed against those who live in Teman: The young of the flock will be dragged away; their pasture will be appalled at their fate.

source: Alhuh-u ginin leiset ahot lingin, aka ginu jong twipi geijin akijaphan ahi.
target: At the sound of their fall the earth will tremble; their cry will resound to the Red Sea.

source: Veuvin, mulaopi bangin ama hungleng touvintin, Bozrah chunga alha ajah ding ahin, hiche nikho chuleh mihat te lungthim jong numei jin naosonat athoh petna alungthim tobang hiding ahi.
target: Look! An eagle will soar and swoop down, spreading its wings over Bozrah. In that day the hearts of Edom’s warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor.

source: Damascus thudola chun Hamath le Arpad akisudongtai; amahon thuse ajah jeh-un alungu alha lhoptai; twipi chunga lungkhamna aumin, hichu athip thei tapoi.
target: Concerning Damascus: “Hamath and Arpad are dismayed, for they have heard bad news. They are disheartened, troubled like the restless sea.

source: Damascus hi angoilhatan, jam dingin kigon akiheijin, tijatna-in amanchomtai; lungkhamnale natnan numei naosonat bangin abomtai.
target: Damascus has become feeble, she has turned to flee and panic has gripped her; anguish and pain have seized her, pain like that of a woman in labor.

source: Kanopsahna khopi, vahchoina khopi chu iti kikhen louva ham?
target: Why has the city of renown not been abandoned, the town in which I delight?

source: Hijehchu agollhanghou khosung lamlena chu lhugama, hicheni chule agal hat hou jouse kithatgam hel ding ahiuve, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Surely, her young men will fall in the streets; all her soldiers will be silenced in that day,” declares the Lord Almighty.

source: Chule Damascus kulbanga mei kachokonga Benhadad leng inpi akahvam ding ahi.
target: “I will set fire to the walls of Damascus; it will consume the fortresses of Ben-Hadad.”

source: Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in asuhmang ding Kedar thudolle Hazor lenggam thudol chu Pakaiyin hitin ati. Kipat un Kedar a chetouvun lang, solama miho chu gachomun.
target: Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon attacked: This is what the Lord says: “Arise, and attack Kedar and destroy the people of the East.

source: Aponbuh houle agancha honnu atol manguva, apondal houle aumlebel jouseu, asangongsao ho akilah uva, amahon ajah uva, ningtina tijatna jeng ahi, tia ahenguva asap diu ahi.
target: Their tents and their flocks will be taken; their shelters will be carried off with all their goods and camels. People will shout to them, ‘Terror on every side!’

source: Vo Hazor a cheng mite, jamun, gamlatah-a umun lang, chengdetnun, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ajehchu Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in nachung thu agel lhutan, nangma douna-in ngaito aneitai.
target: “Flee quickly away! Stay in deep caves, you who live in Hazor,” declares the Lord . “Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has plotted against you; he has devised a plan against you.

source: Kipat un, khohsah louhela cheng kul kotpile thih kotgol jong neilouva achanguva cheng, nam haotah ho sat ding khun kontouvun, tin Pakaiyin aseijin ahi.
target: “Arise and attack a nation at ease, which lives in confidence,” declares the Lord , “a nation that has neither gates nor bars; its people live far from danger.

source: Asangongsao ho chu galthil chomding hija, aganchau tampi chu chomgam dingbep hintin, kolmong geija hui jouse-a amaho kathecheh-a, ningtina kona ahamsetnau kahinpoh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Their camels will become plunder, and their large herds will be spoils of war. I will scatter to the winds those who are in distant places and will bring disaster on them from every side,” declares the Lord .

source: Hazor chu dragon ho chenna hiding, a-itih-a kamhel ding ahin, chua mihem khatcha umlou ding, mihem chapa khatcha jong cheng lou ding ahi.
target: “Hazor will become a haunt of jackals, a desolate place forever. No one will live there; no people will dwell in it.”

source: Judah lengpa Zedekiah leng chantila Elam douna-a Jeremiah themgao henga Pakai thu hunglhung chun hitin aseije.
target: This is the word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, early in the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah:

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Veuvin, Elam thalpi athahatnao kona pen chu kaheboh ding ahi.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “See, I will break the bow of Elam, the mainstay of their might.

source: Elam dounan chua van ningli-a konin huilhi hinlhun sah ingting, chuche huiho lama chu kathecheh ding, akinodoh Elam mite lhunlouna nam umlou ding ahi.
target: I will bring against Elam the four winds from the four quarters of heaven; I will scatter them to the four winds, and there will not be a nation where Elam’s exiles do not go.

source: Ajehchu Elam mite chu amelmateu masangle ahinnao holte masanga kalungthoisah-a, achunguva thilse kalunghana, tijat umtah ngeichu kapohlutna, kasuh manghel kahse-a, anung nunguva chemjam kasol ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin ati.
target: I will shatter Elam before their foes, before those who want to kill them; I will bring disaster on them, even my fierce anger,” declares the Lord . “I will pursue them with the sword until I have made an end of them.

source: Chua kona lengpa le pipuiho kasuhmanga, Elam'a chu kalaltouna kado ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will set my throne in Elam and destroy her king and officials,” declares the Lord .

source: Ahinla ninunung lamle hung hiti ding ahi, Elam sohchangho chu kalepui kit ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Yet I will restore the fortunes of Elam in days to come,” declares the Lord .

source: Babylon le Chaldea te gam chungchanga Jeremiah themgaova kona Pakai thusei chu ahi.
target: This is the word the Lord spoke through Jeremiah the prophet concerning Babylon and the land of the Babylonians:

source: Namtin lah-a phongjalun lang thejah-un, ponlap domsangun, thejah-un, imhih-un, Babylon akilatai, Bel akisudongtai, Merodach ahal halin achiptai; asong milimhou ajahchatan, amilimhou ahal hallin achiptai, tiuvin.
target: “Announce and proclaim among the nations, lift up a banner and proclaim it; keep nothing back, but say, ‘Babylon will be captured; Bel will be put to shame, Marduk filled with terror. Her images will be put to shame and her idols filled with terror.’

source: Sahlama konin nam khatnin ahinsatnun, hichun agam akamhelsah-a, koimacha chua chenglou ding, mile sa agoma kichonuva adalhah diu ahi.
target: A nation from the north will attack her and lay waste her land. No one will live in it; both people and animals will flee away.

source: chuche nikhole chuche phatna chu, Israel chate, amahole Judah chate chu kappuma hungkhom uva, Pakai a-Pathen'u chu agahol diu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “In those days, at that time,” declares the Lord , “the people of Israel and the people of Judah together will go in tears to seek the Lord their God.

source: Zion lam amaingat uva alampi adoh dingu, hungun, suhmil kit louhel dingin tonsot thulhunna eihotah-in Pakai chu jomuhite, atidiu ahi.
target: They will ask the way to Zion and turn their faces toward it. They will come and bind themselves to the Lord in an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten.

source: Kamite chu kelngoi mang ahiuvin, achinghouvin alamvaisah-uvin, molchung ho-a akihei manguvin, mola konin lhang danga acheuvin, ahongsungu asumil taove.
target: “My people have been lost sheep; their shepherds have led them astray and caused them to roam on the mountains. They wandered over mountain and hill and forgot their own resting place.

source: Amuchanin amaho avallhumun, akidoupihouvin hitin aseijuve, keihon kasukhel pouve, ajehchu amaho thudihtah chenna Pakai, apateu kinepna Pakai ngei douna chun achonseuvin ahi.
target: Whoever found them devoured them; their enemies said, ‘We are not guilty, for they sinned against the Lord , their verdant pasture, the Lord , the hope of their ancestors.’

source: Babylon lailunga konin potdoh unlang, Chaldea te gama konin chedoh-un, chule kel hon lah-a kelchal bangin umun.
target: “Flee out of Babylon; leave the land of the Babylonians, and be like the goats that lead the flock.

source: Ajehchu, veuvin, Babylon satding sahlama konin namho loupitah-a kikhom khom chu choh thouving ting, ama dou dinga kigoltoh uva, chua patna alah diu ahin, athalchangu chu mihat galbol thema tobang hintin, khatcha kimohle lou ding ahi.
target: For I will stir up and bring against Babylon an alliance of great nations from the land of the north. They will take up their positions against her, and from the north she will be captured. Their arrows will be like skilled warriors who do not return empty-handed.

source: Chaldea chu kichom ding ahin, achom jouse chu lunglhaisel diu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: So Babylonia will be plundered; all who plunder her will have their fill,” declares the Lord .

source: Nakipa jeh-un, nathanop jeh-un, Vo kagoulo sumanga nangho, hamhing ne bongla banga hung thaodoh-in bongchal bangin naham lutlut jenge.
target: “Because you rejoice and are glad, you who pillage my inheritance, because you frolic like a heifer threshing grain and neigh like stallions,

source: Nanu chu hatah-a kijumsah ding ahi, nahingnu chu jahcha lheh ding ahi; Veuvin, namho lah-a anukhah pen chu gamthip gam, gamgo, chule neldi gam hiding ahitai.
target: your mother will be greatly ashamed; she who gave you birth will be disgraced. She will be the least of the nations— a wilderness, a dry land, a desert.

source: Pakai lunghan jeh-a chenna mun hilou ding, apuma kamhel joding, Babylon'a chechan asetnaho jouse jeh-a adatmouva chehsasa cheng ding ahiuve.
target: Because of the Lord ’s anger she will not be inhabited but will be completely desolate. All who pass Babylon will be appalled; they will scoff because of all her wounds.

source: Babylon kimvela kigolun lang, thalpi kamsa kichoi jousen ama chu kapmun, thalchang khatcha khen hih-un; ajehchu Pakai dounan achonsetai.
target: “Take up your positions around Babylon, all you who draw the bow. Shoot at her! Spare no arrows, for she has sinned against the Lord .

source: Akimvela hatah-in aovun, aman akhut apedohtai, akhopibul jouse alhutan, akulpihou achimlhatai, Pakai phulah ahijeh in achunga phu lauvin, aman abol bangin ama jong bolun.
target: Shout against her on every side! She surrenders, her towers fall, her walls are torn down. Since this is the vengeance of the Lord , take vengeance on her; do to her as she has done to others.

source: Babylon'a konin muchi thepa chule chang atlaija koite choipa sumang uvin, suhgentheina chemjam jeh-a amaho amitakip amite lamcheh-a kiheija, amitakip agamcheh-a jamdiu ahi.
target: Cut off from Babylon the sower, and the reaper with his sickle at harvest. Because of the sword of the oppressor let everyone return to their own people, let everyone flee to their own land.

source: Israel hi keipin adelmang kelngoi vahcheh chu ahin, Assyria lengpan abahgam masapenin, achainan Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in aguho asubongin ahi.
target: “Israel is a scattered flock that lions have chased away. The first to devour them was the king of Assyria; the last to crush their bones was Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.”

source: Hijeh chun janel Pakai Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, Veuvin, Babylon lengpa le agam chu Assyria lengpa talen kapeh banga talen kapeh ding ahi.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: “I will punish the king of Babylon and his land as I punished the king of Assyria.

source: Chule Israel chu aumna-a kapuikitna Karmel le Bashan'a kivah-a, Ephraim le Gilead mol chunga ahinnao lunglhaisel ding ahi.
target: But I will bring Israel back to their own pasture, and they will graze on Carmel and Bashan; their appetite will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and Gilead.

source: Pakaiyin, chuche nikhole chuche phat tengle Israel khansetna chu kikhola, khatcha kimu lou ding, Judah setna jong kimu lou ding ahi. Ajehchu keiman kakhehho chu kangaidam ding ahi, ati.
target: In those days, at that time,” declares the Lord , “search will be made for Israel’s guilt, but there will be none, and for the sins of Judah, but none will be found, for I will forgive the remnant I spare.

source: Merathaim le Pekod'a chengho tah chu doudin kontouvun, amaho chu thatnun, sumanghelun, kathupeh jouse bangin bolun, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Attack the land of Merathaim and those who live in Pekod. Pursue, kill and completely destroy them,” declares the Lord . “Do everything I have commanded you.

source: Chuche gama gal kisatle suhmangna nasatah husa aginge.
target: The noise of battle is in the land, the noise of great destruction!

source: Leiset pumpi sehtum iti kikehso-a, kisu bonga hitam? Namtinho lah-a Babylon iti hung kamhela hitam?
target: How broken and shattered is the hammer of the whole earth! How desolate is Babylon among the nations!

source: Vo Babylon thang kakampeh-in, na-ohtan, nangin nakihetpon; nangma nakiholdoh-in nakimantai. Ajehchu Pakai nakisatpin ahi.
target: I set a trap for you, Babylon, and you were caught before you knew it; you were found and captured because you opposed the Lord .

source: Pakaiyin agalvon kholna chu ahongin, alungsatna galvonho aladohtai. Ajehchu hichehi Chaldea te gamsunga janel Pakai Pathen natoh ahi.
target: The Lord has opened his arsenal and brought out the weapons of his wrath, for the Sovereign Lord Almighty has work to do in the land of the Babylonians.

source: Gamgi monglhapena konin adouvin hungun, athilkholna inho hongun, sepkhomun lang sumang helun, a-imacha khen hih-un.
target: Come against her from afar. Break open her granaries; pile her up like heaps of grain. Completely destroy her and leave her no remnant.

source: Abongchal jouse akisuhmang nao nikho ahunglhun jeh-in, Ohe adao ahi!
target: Kill all her young bulls; let them go down to the slaughter! Woe to them! For their day has come, the time for them to be punished.

source: Pakai i-Pathen'u phulahna, a-houin dinga phulahna Zion'a phongdoh dinga Babylon'a kona hungjamdohho awgin khu ngaijun.
target: Listen to the fugitives and refugees from Babylon declaring in Zion how the Lord our God has taken vengeance, vengeance for his temple.

source: Babylon doudin thalthem ho koukhom un; thalkap jousen akimvela ponbuh kisonun, koimacha hoidohsah hih-un; athilbol dungjuijun lethuh un, athilbol jouse dungjuijin achunga bolun, ajehchu ama Pakai dounale, Israel mithengpa douna-a ahoithon ahi.
target: “Summon archers against Babylon, all those who draw the bow. Encamp all around her; let no one escape. Repay her for her deeds; do to her as she has done. For she has defied the Lord , the Holy One of Israel.

source: Agollhanghou kholaija lhulhop diu, chuche nile agal hat jouseu kisumanghel ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Therefore, her young men will fall in the streets; all her soldiers will be silenced in that day,” declares the Lord .

source: Vetan, mihoitho penpa, kadou nahi, ajehchu nangma gotna kapeh ding phat, nanikho chu ahung lhungtai, tin janel Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: “See, I am against you, you arrogant one,” declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty, “for your day has come, the time for you to be punished.

source: Mihoitho pen chu kipala lhuding, koimachan akaithou lou ding ahi. Chule akhopi sunga mei kachokonga, akimvel jouse akahchai ding ahi.
target: The arrogant one will stumble and fall and no one will help her up; I will kindle a fire in her towns that will consume all who are around her.”

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Israel chate leh Judah chate suhgentheijin aumkhomun, sohchanga kaiho jousen atuhdetnun, lhadoh ding anompouve.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “The people of Israel are oppressed, and the people of Judah as well. All their captors hold them fast, refusing to let them go.

source: Alhatdohpao chu ahatnin, janel Pakai chu amin ahi. Gamsunga olna aumtheina dingle Babylon'a chengte asuhboi theina dinga, ama amaho lama pang ding ahi.
target: Yet their Redeemer is strong; the Lord Almighty is his name. He will vigorously defend their cause so that he may bring rest to their land, but unrest to those who live in Babylon.

source: Chaldea te chungle Babylon'a chengte chule apipuiteu, amichingteu chunga chemjam achutai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “A sword against the Babylonians!” declares the Lord — “against those who live in Babylon and against her officials and wise men!

source: Mijouho chunga chemjam achun, amaho lunglhom diu; amihatteu chunga chemjam achun, amaho lungthoi diu ahi.
target: A sword against her false prophets! They will become fools. A sword against her warriors! They will be filled with terror.

source: A sakol houle akangtalaihou, chule alah uva michoplop ho chunga chemjam achutan, amaho numei ho bang diu ahitai. Agoukhol hou chunga chemjam achun, chule hicheho chu kichom mang ding ahi.
target: A sword against her horses and chariots and all the foreigners in her ranks! They will become weaklings. A sword against her treasures! They will be plundered.

source: Atuiho chunga twikana alhungin, hichu kanghel ding ahi. Ajehchu milim semthu gam ahin, asong milimhouvah angolgam taove.
target: A drought on her waters! They will dry up. For it is a land of idols, idols that will go mad with terror.

source: Hijeh achu nelphai gamsahole twikol gamsaho chua chenguva, sumbupi jong cheng ding ahin, a-itih-a kilokit talou ding, akhang akhanga kilo talouhel ding ahitai.
target: “So desert creatures and hyenas will live there, and there the owl will dwell. It will never again be inhabited or lived in from generation to generation.

source: Pathen'in Sodom le Gomorrah chule nai vela khopi ho asuhmang banga, chuachu koimacha umlou ding, mihem chapa jong khatcha cheng louhel ding ahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: As I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah along with their neighboring towns,” declares the Lord , “so no one will live there; no people will dwell in it.

source: Veovin, sahlama kona mipi honkhat hunguntin, chule nam lentahle leng tamtah, leiset kolkimvela konin hung kitol touvunte.
target: “Look! An army is coming from the north; a great nation and many kings are being stirred up from the ends of the earth.

source: Amahon thalle teng apatdiu ahi. Engsetahle hepina beihel twipi kinong banga kitum lenglunga, sakola touvuva, mitin galbolmi banga kivona, Vo Babylon chanu, nahin satdiu ahitai.
target: They are armed with bows and spears; they are cruel and without mercy. They sound like the roaring sea as they ride on their horses; they come like men in battle formation to attack you, Daughter Babylon.

source: Babylon lengpan athulhutnu ajan, akhut tha angoilhatai. Numei naosonat bangin, hesohnale natna-in naman chomtai.
target: The king of Babylon has heard reports about them, and his hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped him, pain like that of a woman in labor.

source: Veuvin, ama Jordan twi kinonga kona mihat umna lama keipibahkai banga hungtou ding, ahinla keiman ama-a kona kajam mangsah paiding ahi. Achunga vaihomna katun ding pasal lhentum koiham? Keitobang koi umam? Koijin phat eiteppeh ding ham? Ka anga dingding kelngoichingpa chu koiham?
target: Like a lion coming up from Jordan’s thickets to a rich pastureland, I will chase Babylon from its land in an instant. Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this? Who is like me and who can challenge me? And what shepherd can stand against me?”

source: Hijeh chun Babylon douna-a Pakai thumop, Chaldea te douna-a alunggot, anangaito chu ngaijun, kelngoihon lah-a aneopen jong kikai manga, thonlou hella aumnao chu amaho toh kamhela alhatei ding ahi.
target: Therefore, hear what the Lord has planned against Babylon, what he has purposed against the land of the Babylonians: The young of the flock will be dragged away; their pasture will be appalled at their fate.

source: Babylon kilah dohna hu-ginin leiset ahot lingin, akanao namtin vaipi lah-a akijai.
target: At the sound of Babylon’s capture the earth will tremble; its cry will resound among the nations.

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Babylon chunga chule alah uva cheng Keima eidouva pangho chunga, suhmangna huipi katildoh ding ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says: “See, I will stir up the spirit of a destroyer against Babylon and the people of Leb Kamai.

source: Keiman Babylon'a chang jap ho kasola, amahon ajap childiu; ajehchu lungkham nile aveluva adouvuva pang ding ahi.
target: I will send foreigners to Babylon to winnow her and to devastate her land; they will oppose her on every side in the day of her disaster.

source: Ama douva thal choile ama douva janel lah-a kisong thal hemin athal lhahen; agolhanghou khen hih-un, ajanelpi chu sumangsoh helun.
target: Let not the archer string his bow, nor let him put on his armor. Do not spare her young men; completely destroy her army.

source: Hitia chu Chaldea gamsungle khosung lamlen ho-a akithatho lhuchap ding ahiuve.
target: They will fall down slain in Babylon, fatally wounded in her streets.

source: Ajehchu Israel mithengpa douna-in agamu chonsetnin dimjongle, Israel le Judah chu a-Pathen'u janel Pakaiyin adalhapoi.
target: For Israel and Judah have not been forsaken by their God, the Lord Almighty, though their land is full of guilt before the Holy One of Israel.

source: Babylon na konin jamdoh un lang, mitinin ahinna kihuh hinghen; akhangit lounao thipi hih-un, ajehchu hichehi Pakai phulah phat ahin, aman alethuh ding mong ahi.
target: “Flee from Babylon! Run for your lives! Do not be destroyed because of her sins. It is time for the Lord ’s vengeance; he will repay her what she deserves.

source: Babylon chu leiset pumpi khamsah, Pakai khutna sana khon chu ahi, namtin vaipin aju chu adon khamuva, hichea chu ngolgama ahitaove.
target: Babylon was a gold cup in the Lord ’s hand; she made the whole earth drunk. The nations drank her wine; therefore they have now gone mad.

source: Babylon chu alhu phungin akisumang tai; ama chu kouvin, ama chu damthei ding ahile, anatna nuding thingnailou lauvin.
target: Babylon will suddenly fall and be broken. Wail over her! Get balm for her pain; perhaps she can be healed.

source: Babylon chu kadamsah nom-in, ahinla adam chompoi; dalhauvin, igam cheh-a kicheo hite. Ajehchu athu kitan lhah na-in van asun, vandum gei sana kidomsang ahitai.
target: “ ‘We would have healed Babylon, but she cannot be healed; let us leave her and each go to our own land, for her judgment reaches to the skies, it rises as high as the heavens.’

source: Pakaiyin ichon phatnao aphongdoh tai. Hungun, Pakai i-Pathen'u thilbol Zion'a seichoi juhite.
target: “ ‘The Lord has vindicated us; come, let us tell in Zion what the Lord our God has done.’

source: Thalchang ho notvalun, lumho chom khomun, Pakaiyin Mede lengte lung asuthoutai. Ajehchu atup chu Babylon dinga suhmang ding chu ahi, ajehchu hichu Pakai phulah, a-houin phulahna ahi.
target: “Sharpen the arrows, take up the shields! The Lord has stirred up the kings of the Medes, because his purpose is to destroy Babylon. The Lord will take vengeance, vengeance for his temple.

source: Babylon kulbang vuma ponlap tungdoh-un, khongah hatsah-un, khongah ho tungdoh-un, ajehchu Babylon mite douna-a Pakaiyin asei chu agongtoh-in, atong chaitai.
target: Lift up a banner against the walls of Babylon! Reinforce the guard, station the watchmen, prepare an ambush! The Lord will carry out his purpose, his decree against the people of Babylon.

source: Vo nang twi tamtah chunga chenga, gou haotah pa, nakichainale nakiloset tetohna chu ahung lhungtai.
target: You who live by many waters and are rich in treasures, your end has come, the time for you to be destroyed.

source: Janel Pakai chu amatah akihahselin, aseije, khaokhoho tobang hela mihem'a kahindip teitei ding nahi, amahon nangma douna-a ahin aodiu ahi.
target: The Lord Almighty has sworn by himself: I will surely fill you with troops, as with a swarm of locusts, and they will shout in triumph over you.

source: Pathen'in athaneina-a leiset asema, achihna-a vannoi atundoh-a, ahetchetna-a kona jong aphajal ahitai.
target: “He made the earth by his power; he founded the world by his wisdom and stretched out the heavens by his understanding.

source: Aman a-aw asodoh teng, van ho-a twipi tamtahpi ahung umjin, kolmong ho-a konin twimei akaltou sahjin, kolphele go asemin, hui chu akikholna-a konin alhadoh jin ahi.
target: When he thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; he makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth. He sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.

source: Mitin ahetnaova ngola ahiuvin, thil podoh takip semthu milima kijumso ahiuve. Ajehchu amilim semthu uchu joubulom ahin, amaho-a haitheina hu aumpoi.
target: “Everyone is senseless and without knowledge; every goldsmith is shamed by his idols. The images he makes are a fraud; they have no breath in them.

source: Hicheho chu mohseh, thilbol dihlou ahin, gotna akipeh phat tengule mangthah cheh diu ahi.
target: They are worthless, the objects of mockery; when their judgment comes, they will perish.

source: Jacob chanvang hicheho tobang chu ahipoi, thil jouse kipatna ahi. Israel chu agoulo moljol ahin, amin chu janel Pakai ahi.
target: He who is the Portion of Jacob is not like these, for he is the Maker of all things, including the people of his inheritance— the Lord Almighty is his name.

source: Nangma kagal heichale kagalvonho chu nahi. Ajehchu namdangho chu nangma-a kasuhchipma, nangma-a lenggam ho kasuhmang ding ahi.
target: “You are my war club, my weapon for battle— with you I shatter nations, with you I destroy kingdoms,

source: Chule nangma-a sakolle achunga toupa kasuh chip ding, chule nangma-a kangtalai le achunga atoupa kasuhchip ding ahi.
target: with you I shatter horse and rider, with you I shatter chariot and driver,

source: Nangma-a pasal le numei kasuhchipma, tehse le khangthah kasuhchip ding ahi, chule nangma-a nungah le gollhang jong kasuhchip ding ahi.
target: with you I shatter man and woman, with you I shatter old man and youth, with you I shatter young man and young woman,

source: Nangma-a kelngoichingpa le akelngoihon jong kasuhchip ding, nangma-a loubolpa le abongchalho koljon, chule agal lamkaiho le vaihomho kasuhchip ding ahi.
target: with you I shatter shepherd and flock, with you I shatter farmer and oxen, with you I shatter governors and officials.

source: Chule nangma mitmu tah-a Zion chunga athilsebol jouseu chu Babylon'a le Chaldea te chunga kachuhsah ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Before your eyes I will repay Babylon and all who live in Babylonia for all the wrong they have done in Zion,” declares the Lord .

source: Leiset pumpi sumanga vo suhmangna mollen, vetan kadou nahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, nachunga kakhut kalhan doh-a, songpi ho-a kona kejel lhah-a, akavamsa mol kaso ding nahi.
target: “I am against you, you destroying mountain, you who destroy the whole earth,” declares the Lord . “I will stretch out my hand against you, roll you off the cliffs, and make you a burned-out mountain.

source: Nanga kona in-ning song dingle inbul song ding alah lou diu ahitan, ahinla a-itih-a kamhel ding nahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: No rock will be taken from you for a cornerstone, nor any stone for a foundation, for you will be desolate forever,” declares the Lord .

source: Gamsunga ponlap khat tahdoh-un lang, namtin vaipi lah-a sumkon mut un lang, ama doudin namho gongun lang, Ararat, Minni, chule Ashchenaz lenggam ho ama doudin gallamkai semun lang, khaokhoho bangin sakol ho hungtou sah-un.
target: “Lift up a banner in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations for battle against her; summon against her these kingdoms: Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz. Appoint a commander against her; send up horses like a swarm of locusts.

source: Ama doudin namho, Mede lengte, agal lamkaihou, avaihomho jouse, aloinehna gam jouse gonguvin.
target: Prepare the nations for battle against her— the kings of the Medes, their governors and all their officials, and all the countries they rule.

source: Chuche Babylon gam chu kihot hotna lungdong diu ahi. Ajehchu Babylon gam chu chenna louva akamhelna dinga Pakai thilgon jouse guilhung ding ahi.
target: The land trembles and writhes, for the Lord ’s purposes against Babylon stand— to lay waste the land of Babylon so that no one will live there.

source: Babylon gal hat ho galsat ahaijun, akul sunguva aumden taove. Ahatnau adailhatan, numei asohgam taove. Achendetnau ahal lha uvin, akotgol hou abong gamtai.
target: Babylon’s warriors have stopped fighting; they remain in their strongholds. Their strength is exhausted; they have become weaklings. Her dwellings are set on fire; the bars of her gates are broken.

source: Thusep khat chu achomto kisuto ding, thangkou khat chu achom khatto kisuto-a, akhopi chu among khatna konin akilatai ti hil dingin Babylon gama alhaijun ahi.
target: One courier follows another and messenger follows messenger to announce to the king of Babylon that his entire city is captured,

source: Lampiho atutanun, pumpeng aneihou meija akihal lhan, gal hat ho akichagam taove.
target: the river crossings seized, the marshes set on fire, and the soldiers terrified.”

source: Ajehchu janel Pakai, Israel Pathen'in hitin aseije, Babylon chanu chu phol tobang ahin, ama kivoh phat ahitai. Hijengjongle chomcha khat joule achang atphat hunglhung ding ahitai.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: “Daughter Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time it is trampled; the time to harvest her will soon come.”

source: Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in einechaijin, eisugoijin, belhomkeo eisotai, dragon bangin eival lhumin, kasa atuilai jouse anevasetnin, aman eipaidoh tai.
target: “Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has devoured us, he has thrown us into confusion, he has made us an empty jar. Like a serpent he has swallowed us and filled his stomach with our delicacies, and then has spewed us out.

source: Keile katahsa chunga hunama eikibol naho, Babylon chunga umhen tia Zion'a chengten aseijuva, Jerusalem in kathisan Chaldea te chunga chuhen, atidiu ahi.
target: May the violence done to our flesh be on Babylon,” say the inhabitants of Zion. “May our blood be on those who live in Babylonia,” says Jerusalem.

source: Hijeh-a chu Pakaiyin, Veovin, nangma lama pangin ting, naphu lahpeh inge, chule atuipi gotsah ingting, atuinah kansah inge, ati.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord says: “See, I will defend your cause and avenge you; I will dry up her sea and make her springs dry.

source: Babylon chu hung kilhu vuma, dragonho chenna mun, datmo umle chehsatna, mi chen louna hung hiding ahi.
target: Babylon will be a heap of ruins, a haunt of jackals, an object of horror and scorn, a place where no one lives.

source: Amaho keipiho banga kitum khomuva, keipibahkai nouho banga ngih ngihdiu ahi.
target: Her people all roar like young lions, they growl like lion cubs.

source: Akhampetnule agolvah-u kabolsah-a kakhamsah ding, hitia chu kipah thanomuva, a-itih-a ihmuva, thoukit talouhel ding ahiuve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: But while they are aroused, I will set out a feast for them and make them drunk, so that they shout with laughter— then sleep forever and not awake,” declares the Lord .

source: Athat dingpa henga kelngoinou kakaisah-a, kelngoi chalto kelchal kikai banga amaho chu kapuisuh ding ahi.
target: “I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams and goats.

source: Sheshach chu iti kimat ham? Leiset pumpi vahchoipa chu iti datmo um hitam? Babylon chu datmo um iti hungsoh hitam?
target: “How Sheshak will be captured, the boast of the whole earth seized! How desolate Babylon will be among the nations!

source: Babylon chu twipin achuptan, chuche twinong tamtah chun akhutai.
target: The sea will rise over Babylon; its roaring waves will cover her.

source: Akhopiho chu akamhelin, gamgo, gamthip, mi khatcha chenlouna gam, mihem chapa khatchan ajotpa louhel asohtai.
target: Her towns will be desolate, a dry and desert land, a land where no one lives, through which no one travels.

source: Chule Babylon sunga Bel chu talen kapeh-a, aval lhumsapa kamsunga kona kiloidoh ding; chule namtin vaipi chu ahenga hung kilhonlut khomkit talou ding ahiuve, Babylon kul chu chimlha ding ahitai.
target: I will punish Bel in Babylon and make him spew out what he has swallowed. The nations will no longer stream to him. And the wall of Babylon will fall.

source: Kamite, alah-a konin potdoh-un lang, Pakai lungsat tijat umtah-a konin nangma cheh hinna kihuhhingun.
target: “Come out of her, my people! Run for your lives! Run from the fierce anger of the Lord .

source: Ajole nalungu hopmintin, chuche gama kijading thuthang jeh in tijagetnun nate, kum khatle thuthang khat hung lhungin tin, chujou kum khatle thuthang khatma, chule gamsunga hunam patna, vaipole vaipo kidouna hunglhung ding ahi.
target: Do not lose heart or be afraid when rumors are heard in the land; one rumor comes this year, another the next, rumors of violence in the land and of ruler against ruler.

source: Hijeh chun veuvin, Babylon'a milim kikhengho thu katanna ding nikho ahung lhunge, agam pumpi jahcha-a, ami kithat jouse agamlaija lhuchap ding ahi.
target: For the time will surely come when I will punish the idols of Babylon; her whole land will be disgraced and her slain will all lie fallen within her.

source: Chuteng vanle lei, chule asunga umjousen Babylon jeh-a penga la asahdiu ahi. Ajehchu sahlama kona asumangho ahenga hung ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Then heaven and earth and all that is in them will shout for joy over Babylon, for out of the north destroyers will attack her,” declares the Lord .

source: Babylon'in Israel atha-a alhuhsah banga chu, leiset pumpi kithat chu Babylon'a chudiu ahi.
target: “Babylon must fall because of Israel’s slain, just as the slain in all the earth have fallen because of Babylon.

source: Nangho chemjam'a hoidohho chemangun, dingden hih-un, gamlatah-a konin Pakai galdoh un, nalunguva Jerusalem chu geldoh jingun.
target: You who have escaped the sword, leave and do not linger! Remember the Lord in a distant land, and call to mind Jerusalem.”

source: Houset kajah jeh-un kajum-un, jachatna-in kamaiju akhutai. Ajehchu Pakai ina muntheng sunga gamdang mi ahung lutnuve.
target: “We are disgraced, for we have been insulted and shame covers our faces, because foreigners have entered the holy places of the Lord ’s house.”

source: Hijeh chun veuvin, nikho alhunge, Pakaiyin aseije, amilimhou chunga thu katan ding, chule agam pumpi-a mapuho peng ding ahiuve.
target: “But days are coming,” declares the Lord , “when I will punish her idols, and throughout her land the wounded will groan.

source: Babylon chu van'a kaltouhen lang, akulsung chu detsah jengjongle, keija kona ahenga misumang ho hungnalai diu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Even if Babylon ascends to the heavens and fortifies her lofty stronghold, I will send destroyers against her,” declares the Lord .

source: Babylon'a kona kana le Chaldea gama kona suhmangna nasatah husa athongin,
target: “The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, the sound of great destruction from the land of the Babylonians.

source: Pakaiyin Babylon asim jeh-a, a-awginu nasatah chu athipsah-a, akinon ginu chu twi tamtah nasatah kinon gin tobang ahin, a-awginu chu a-ong jeju jengin ahi.
target: The Lord will destroy Babylon; he will silence her noisy din. Waves of enemies will rage like great waters; the roar of their voices will resound.

source: Ajehchu misugam ahenga ahungin, Babylon chungtah-a chun achun, amihatteu aman gamun athalpiu cheh-u abong gamtan, ajehchu lethuhji Pakaiyin alethuh tei ding ahitai.
target: A destroyer will come against Babylon; her warriors will be captured, and their bows will be broken. For the Lord is a God of retribution; he will repay in full.

source: Chule apipuitele amichingte, agal lamkaiho le avaihomte, chule amihatte kakhamsah gam ding ahi, amaho tonsot imutna ihmuva, thoukit talouhel ding ahiuve, tin lengpa amin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will make her officials and wise men drunk, her governors, officers and warriors as well; they will sleep forever and not awake,” declares the King, whose name is the Lord Almighty.

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Babylon kul nasatahho chu chimsoh hela, akotpi bangho kavamsoh ding ahi, miten mohseh-a atohgimuva, amahon mei dinga bou acholpi dingu ahi.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “Babylon’s thick wall will be leveled and her high gates set on fire; the peoples exhaust themselves for nothing, the nations’ labor is only fuel for the flames.”

source: Judah lengpa Zedekiah Alengchan kal kum lina-a Maaseiah chapa Neriah Chapa Seriah, Zedekiah to Babylon lama achepet lhona Jeremiah themgao'in athupeh; chule hiche Seriah hi lenga thil le lo ching pipuipen ahi.
target: This is the message Jeremiah the prophet gave to the staff officer Seraiah son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went to Babylon with Zedekiah king of Judah in the fourth year of his reign.

source: Hitichun Jeremiah chun Babylon chunga thilse hung chuding jouse, Babylon chungchang thu kisun jouse jong lekhabu khatna asunlutne.
target: Jeremiah had written on a scroll about all the disasters that would come upon Babylon—all that had been recorded concerning Babylon.

source: Chuin Jeremiah chun Seriah jah-a, Babylon'a nahunga, hiche thuho hi namu ding, chule aboncha nasimding ahi.
target: He said to Seraiah, “When you get to Babylon, see that you read all these words aloud.

source: Chuteng nangman nasei ding ahi, Vo Pakai, nangman, asunga mile sa khatcha jong umlouhel dinga kisumang hela, a-itih-a kamheljo ding ahi, tin hiche mun douna-a thu naseitan ahi.
target: Then say, ‘ Lord , you have said you will destroy this place, so that neither people nor animals will live in it; it will be desolate forever.’

source: Chule hiti ding ahi, lekhabu hi nasim joutengle, song khat toh nakanbeh-a, Euphrates lailunga naselut ding ahi:
target: When you finish reading this scroll, tie a stone to it and throw it into the Euphrates.

source: Achunga kahinpohlut ding thilse-a kona thoudoh lou dinga, hiti ahi Babylon lhalut ding ahitai, nati ding ahi. Chule amaho chollheh diu ahi. Hichanhi Jeremiah thuho chu ahi.
target: Then say, ‘So will Babylon sink to rise no more because of the disaster I will bring on her. And her people will fall.’ ” The words of Jeremiah end here.

source: Zedekiah chu leng ahung channin kum somni le khat ahin, Jerusalem'a kum somlekhat alengchange, anu min chu Hamutal ahin, Libnah kho-a Jeremiah chanu ahi.
target: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.

source: Chuin aman Jehoiakim boljouse bangin Pakai mitmun thilse abolin ahi.
target: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as Jehoiakim had done.

source: Hitichun Pakai lunghanna konin Jerusalem le Judah gamsung chu amasanga kona apaidohhel kahsen ahung hitin ahi, Zedekiah chu Babylon lengpa dounan akiphinin ahi.
target: It was because of the Lord ’s anger that all this happened to Jerusalem and Judah, and in the end he thrust them from his presence. Now Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

source: Chuin alengchan kumko lhinkum, lhasom channa, nisom na-a chun ahitin ahi, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar chu asepaite jouseto Jerusalem satdin ahungun, amaidon na chun ponbuh asongun, akhopi kimvela galkul akaikhum taove.
target: So in the ninth year of Zedekiah’s reign, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his whole army. They encamped outside the city and built siege works all around it.

source: Hitichun Zedekiah lengpa lengchankal kum somlekhat lhin geijin khopi chu aumchah taove.
target: The city was kept under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

source: Chuin lhalina niko nin khopi sunga chun kel akhohtan, gamsung mite din nehding abeitei.
target: By the ninth day of the fourth month the famine in the city had become so severe that there was no food for the people to eat.

source: Chuin khopi chu akehtan, galbol miho jouse chu khopi-a konin jan-in, kulbang ni kah-a lengpa hon lampi kotpi-a chun ajamdoh-un, (tun Chaldea te chu khopi pam kimvela panga ahiuvin) Phaicham lampi chu ajon taove.
target: Then the city wall was broken through, and the whole army fled. They left the city at night through the gate between the two walls near the king’s garden, though the Babylonians were surrounding the city. They fled toward the Arabah,

source: Ahinla Chaldea sepaiten lengpa chu anungdelun, Jericho phaichama Zedekiah chu aphapao vin, asepaite jouse ama-a konin akithecheh taove.
target: but the Babylonian army pursued King Zedekiah and overtook him in the plains of Jericho. All his soldiers were separated from him and scattered,

source: Chuin lengpa chu amanun, Hamath gama Riblah a Babylon lengpa henga apui taove. Hia chun achunga thu atanlhatai.
target: and he was captured. He was taken to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he pronounced sentence on him.

source: Chuin Babylon lengpan Zedekiah chapate chu amitmu tah-in athatnin, Judah pipuiho jouse jong Riblah a chun athat gamtai.
target: There at Riblah the king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes; he also killed all the officials of Judah.

source: Chujouvin Zedekiah mitchang teni chu akaldoh peh-in, Babylon lengpa chun thihkhaovin akanin, Babylon lama akaijin, athi nikho geijin songkul'a ahentai.
target: Then he put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him with bronze shackles and took him to Babylon, where he put him in prison till the day of his death.

source: Tun lhanga na, chuche lha nisom na-a chun, hichu Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar lengchan kum somleko lhinna ahin, Babylon lengpa kinbol, sepai gal lamkai Nebuzaradan chu Jerusalem'a ahungin,
target: On the tenth day of the fifth month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard, who served the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

source: Pakaiyin le lengpa in, chule Jerusalem'a in ho ahalin, milenho in jouse jong meijah ahalvam soh heltai.
target: He set fire to the temple of the Lord , the royal palace and all the houses of Jerusalem. Every important building he burned down.

source: Chuin sepai gal lamkai toh hung kilhon Chaldea sepai jouse chun Jerusalem kimvela kulbang jouse avochim soh hel taove.
target: The whole Babylonian army, under the commander of the imperial guard, broke down all the walls around Jerusalem.

source: Chujouvin sepai gal lamkai Nebuzaradan'in miho lah-a migenthei phabeple khopi sunga umnalai amohho, Babylon lengpa henga kipelut ho, chule mipi dangho chu sohchangin akaimangtai.
target: Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard carried into exile some of the poorest people and those who remained in the city, along with the rest of the craftsmen and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon.

source: Ahinla sepai lamkai Nebuzaradan'in gamsunga genthei phabep chu lengpilei lhoudingle ngahdin adalhatai.
target: But Nebuzaradan left behind the rest of the poorest people of the land to work the vineyards and fields.

source: Pakai insunga um sum-eng khompihole akitun naho, Pakai insunga sum-eng twikong jong chu Chaldea ten avoseovin, asum-eng jouse Babylon'a apotaove.
target: The Babylonians broke up the bronze pillars, the movable stands and the bronze Sea that were at the temple of the Lord and they carried all the bronze to Babylon.

source: Khangbel lenho jong, vutloho, chaicheho, kongtong ho, meivah khomho, thihkheho, akinbolnao sum-eng lheng, lhengkong ho apomangsoh taove.
target: They also took away the pots, shovels, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes and all the bronze articles used in the temple service.

source: Chule khon neoho le vutloho, kongtong ho, khangbel lenho, meivah khom ho, thihkhe ho, chule khon ho, sana-a kisem chu sana in, dangka-a kisem chu dangka-in, sepai lamkaipa chun akilah-in ahi.
target: The commander of the imperial guard took away the basins, censers, sprinkling bowls, pots, lampstands, dishes and bowls used for drink offerings—all that were made of pure gold or silver.

source: Khompi ni, twikong khat, atunna noija sum-eng bongchal somleni, hichu Solomon lengpan Pakai insunga asem ahin, hiche lheng le khonho jouse sum-eng chu te jouhoi ahipoi.
target: The bronze from the two pillars, the Sea and the twelve bronze bulls under it, and the movable stands, which King Solomon had made for the temple of the Lord , was more than could be weighed.

source: Khompi thudol; khompi khat chu asandan tong somleget, akimvel tong somlenin akol khumin, hichu bel li sa-a ahin, asung hom ahi.
target: Each pillar was eighteen cubits high and twelve cubits in circumference; each was four fingers thick, and hollow.

source: Achunga sum-eng luboh khat aumin, aluboh khat chu tong nga sanga, alubohho chung chu kolbuthei lima themneltah-a kijempah ahin, aboncha sum-eng jeng ahi. Sutpi nina jong chu hiche tobangahi kolbutheija kijempah ahi.
target: The bronze capital on top of one pillar was five cubits high and was decorated with a network and pomegranates of bronze all around. The other pillar, with its pomegranates, was similar.

source: Apang khatna kolbuthei somko le gup cheh aumin, themneltah-a kijem chunga chu kolbuthei jakhat-in akimvel ahi.
target: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; the total number of pomegranates above the surrounding network was a hundred.

source: Chuin sepai lamkaipan thempulen Seraiah le thempu ni channa Zephaniah chule kotngah thumho chu akaijin;
target: The commander of the guard took as prisoners Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the priest next in rank and the three doorkeepers.

source: Aman gal hat ho chunga vaipo nukiso pa, khopi sunga um lengpa koma umjing le akivoppi jing mi sagi, sepai janelho lekhasunpa, khopi lailunga kimudoh gamsung mi somgup jong khopi-a konin akaidoh in ahi.
target: Of those still in the city, he took the officer in charge of the fighting men, and seven royal advisers. He also took the secretary who was chief officer in charge of conscripting the people of the land, sixty of whom were found in the city.

source: Hitichun sepai lamkai Nebuzaradan'in amaho chu Babylon lengpa henga Riblah ah akaijin ahi.
target: Nebuzaradan the commander took them all and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.

source: Chuin Babylon lengpan amaho chu ajepmin, Hamath gama Riblah mun'a athatgamtai. Hitobang chun Judah chu amatah gama konin sohchangin akaimangtan ahi.
target: There at Riblah, in the land of Hamath, the king had them executed. So Judah went into captivity, away from her land.

source: Hichehi Nebuchadnezzar'in sohchanga akaimangho chu ahi. Alengchan kum sagina chun Judah te sangthum le somni le thum ahiuve.
target: This is the number of the people Nebuchadnezzar carried into exile: in the seventh year, 3,023 Jews;

source: Nebuchadnezzar lengchan kum somlegetna in Jerusalem'a konin mi jagetle somthumle ni akaimangin ahi.
target: in Nebuchadnezzar’s eighteenth year, 832 people from Jerusalem;

source: Nebuchadnezzar lengchan kum somni le thum lhinna in sepai lamkai Nebuzaradan'in Judah te jasagi le somli le nga akaimangin, abonun mi sangli le jagup ahiuve.
target: in his twenty-third year, 745 Jews taken into exile by Nebuzaradan the commander of the imperial guard. There were 4,600 people in all.

source: Judah lengpa Jehoiachin sohchan kum somthumle sagi lhinna, lha somlenina, chuche lha nisomni le nga nin ahitin ahi, Evil-Merodach Babylon lengpa chu alengchan kum khatna chun, Judah lengpa Jehoiachin lu chu adomsangin, sohchan na-a konin apuidoh-in ahi.
target: In the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the year Awel-Marduk became king of Babylon, on the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth month, he released Jehoiachin king of Judah and freed him from prison.

source: Ama chu lungset tah-in ahoupin, Babylon gamsunga alengchanpi ho laltouna vuma alaltouna adosangpeh penin,
target: He spoke kindly to him and gave him a seat of honor higher than those of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.

source: asohchanna vonho akhelpeh-in, ahinkho lhumkeijin amasangah changlhah anejom jingpehtan ahi.
target: So Jehoiachin put aside his prison clothes and for the rest of his life ate regularly at the king’s table.

source: Chule aneh le chah dingin, Babylon lengpan tahsa phatnading anpha ape jingin; ahinkho lhumkei, athini geijin tanglouvin niseh-in apejing tan ahi.
target: Day by day the king of Babylon gave Jehoiachin a regular allowance as long as he lived, till the day of his death.

source: I-ahungtile mipi dimsetna ana umna khopi chu thomhao tah-a hung uma hitam! I-atile amanu meithainu hung bangdoh-a hitam! namtin vaipi lah-a apipen chule gamkaiho lah-a leng chanu bang anahia chu i-ahungtile tu-a soh hungsoh-a hitam!
target: How deserted lies the city, once so full of people! How like a widow is she, who once was great among the nations! She who was queen among the provinces has now become a slave.

source: Amanu janteng hakan akapjin, abeng teni mitlhin achupjin, ama ngailuho lah jenga jong alhem lungmong ding khatcha aneijoupoi. Agolte jousen jong ama adoha bolun, amaho amanu melma asohgam taove.
target: Bitterly she weeps at night, tears are on her cheeks. Among all her lovers there is no one to comfort her. All her friends have betrayed her; they have become her enemies.

source: Judah chu hesoh gentheina jehle, bolgentheina jeh-in gal hingin kaimangin aumtai. Amanu Pathen helouho lah-a achengin, olna himhim amujou tapoi. Amanu bolgim hon alungdon pettah in aman taove.
target: After affliction and harsh labor, Judah has gone into exile. She dwells among the nations; she finds no resting place. All who pursue her have overtaken her in the midst of her distress.

source: Zion lampiho chu alhasetai, ajehchu kut loupitah mang dingin koimacha ahung tapouvin; akotpi phung jouseu akamheltai. Athempuhou akhoisan, anungah thenghou athohgimun, chule amanu jong lung gimin aumtai.
target: The roads to Zion mourn, for no one comes to her appointed festivals. All her gateways are desolate, her priests groan, her young women grieve, and she is in bitter anguish.

source: Amanu kidoupiho apipu ahitaovin, amelmate ahung lolhing taovin ahi; ajehchu asuhkhel nao tampiho jeh-a Pakaiyin amanu asuhgenthei ahi. Achateho jong amelmateu masanga gal hingin achegam taove.
target: Her foes have become her masters; her enemies are at ease. The Lord has brought her grief because of her many sins. Her children have gone into exile, captive before the foe.

source: Zion chanu-a konin ahoinaho jouse achemang tai. Amanu pipuiho jong sakhigol lhatna mun mujoulou abangtauvin, chule amaho adelpao masanga thabeijin achetauve.
target: All the splendor has departed from Daughter Zion. Her princes are like deer that find no pasture; in weakness they have fled before the pursuer.

source: Amelmate khutna amite alhuh-a, koimachan akithopi lou phatnin, akisuh gentheina nikhole avangsetna nikhoho chun Jerusalem'in masanglaija akut nopsahnahou chu ahingeldoh-e; akidoupihon amanu amuvin, acholngah nikho hou anuisat bepmui.
target: In the days of her affliction and wandering Jerusalem remembers all the treasures that were hers in days of old. When her people fell into enemy hands, there was no one to help her. Her enemies looked at her and laughed at her destruction.

source: Jerusalem melse tah-in achonsen; hijeh-a chu amanu kiladoh-a ahi. Amanu anajabolho jousen i-asahtapoi, ajehchu amahon amanu sagohkeo ahina chu amudoh taove. Ahi, amanu akhoisasan chule akinunghei kit tai.
target: Jerusalem has sinned greatly and so has become unclean. All who honored her despise her, for they have all seen her naked; she herself groans and turns away.

source: Amanu thenlounaho anih ho-a abeh-in; akhonung phat ding jong ageldoh poi. Hijeh chun kidang tah-in ama akemsuh-in, alhamonsah ding koimacha aneipoi. Vo Pakai, kahesoh gentheina hinven; ajehchu melma chu amale ama akiloupi sahtan ahi.
target: Her filthiness clung to her skirts; she did not consider her future. Her fall was astounding; there was none to comfort her. “Look, Lord , on my affliction, for the enemy has triumphed.”

source: Akidoupipan amanu thilpha neiho jouse chunga akhut ahinlhang doh-e, ajehchu nangman namite houkhom ho lah-a luttheilou dinga nanathupeh Pathen heloute chu, amanu muntheng mun'a alutnu amanun amutai.
target: The enemy laid hands on all her treasures; she saw pagan nations enter her sanctuary— those you had forbidden to enter your assembly.

source: Amite jouse akhoisa gamtaovin, neh akiholuvin; amahon akihinso theina diuvin thilpha aneijouseu chu akijoh doh gamtaove. Vetan, vo Pakai, chule ngaiton, ajehchu keima thet umtah kahung hitai.
target: All her people groan as they search for bread; they barter their treasures for food to keep themselves alive. “Look, Lord , and consider, for I am despised.”

source: Khola vahle ho hiche mun hinjotpaho dinga hichehi imacha hilouva ham? Veuvin, chule heuvin, keima chunga gim gentheina hunglhung, Pakaiyin alunghan khaotah nikho-a eisuhgentheina tobang gim gentheina aum khapoi.
target: “Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look around and see. Is any suffering like my suffering that was inflicted on me, that the Lord brought on me in the day of his fierce anger?

source: Chunga konin aman kaguho sunga mei ahinsol lutnin, hichun kaguho achansoh keijin ahi. Aman kakeng teni-a dingin len ajah-in, keima eikinung heisah kitnin ahi. Aman nilhumkeijin keima eilunglhah sah-in, chule eilhah lhopsah-e,
target: “From on high he sent fire, sent it down into my bones. He spread a net for my feet and turned me back. He made me desolate, faint all the day long.

source: kasuhkhelna namkoljon chu aman akhut tah-in atuh-in; hicheho chu aman khivuija athilin kangongchanga ei-o pehtai. Aman katha alhahsamsah-in, Pakaiyin amaho khutna keima eipedoh-in, amaho-a konin keima kathoudoh jou tapoi.
target: “My sins have been bound into a yoke; by his hands they were woven together. They have been hung on my neck, and the Lord has sapped my strength. He has given me into the hands of those I cannot withstand.

source: Keima angsung tah-a kamihat ho chu Pakaiyin achotpha tai. Aman keima douna-a kagollhang ho suhmang nadin mipi akhomin ahi. Judah chanu nungah theng chu Pakaiyin lengpiga chilna bangin achiltai.
target: “The Lord has rejected all the warriors in my midst; he has summoned an army against me to crush my young men. In his winepress the Lord has trampled Virgin Daughter Judah.

source: Hiche thilho jeh hin kakaptai; kamit ngeihi twijin along lhatai. Ajehchu kahinna kidosah kit thei ding lhamonsah chu keija konin gamlatah-a aumtan; galte ahattah jeh-un, kachate jong athomhaosoh taove.
target: “This is why I weep and my eyes overflow with tears. No one is near to comfort me, no one to restore my spirit. My children are destitute because the enemy has prevailed.”

source: Zion'in akhut teni ajahdoh-in, ahinla ama lhamonsah ding koimacha aumtapoi. Pakaiyin Jacob chungchanga chun akidoupiten aumkimvel diuvin thu anapen ahi. Amaho lah-a Jerusalem hi numei nihboh nei abang jengtai.
target: Zion stretches out her hands, but there is no one to comfort her. The Lord has decreed for Jacob that his neighbors become his foes; Jerusalem has become an unclean thing among them.

source: Pakai chu chonpha ahi, ajehchu keiman athupeh kanadouvin ahi. Ngaijun, katao ahi, mipite, chule kalung gimnahi veuvin, kanungah thengle gollhangho jong gal hingin akikai taove.
target: “The Lord is righteous, yet I rebelled against his command. Listen, all you peoples; look on my suffering. My young men and young women have gone into exile.

source: Keiman kangailut ho chu kakoujin, ahinla amahon eijoulhep taove. Kathempuhole ka-upahon khopi sunga ahinnao kidokitna dinga neh ahol nalam uvin alhagao alhagam taove.
target: “I called to my allies but they betrayed me. My priests and my elders perished in the city while they searched for food to keep themselves alive.

source: Vo Pakai neihin ven; keima lung genthei jin kaumtai; kasung akithing tai, kalung sung akipei jengtai. Ajehchu keiman nasatah-in kanadouve, polama chemjamin mihem athatnin, insung jong thina in tobang jeng ahitai.
target: “See, Lord , how distressed I am! I am in torment within, and in my heart I am disturbed, for I have been most rebellious. Outside, the sword bereaves; inside, there is only death.

source: Amahon kakhoisat ajauvin, koimacha eilhamon ding aumpoi. Kamelmate jousen kalunggentheina ajasohkei juvin, nangman naboldoh na-a hin amaho akipah uve; nangman naphon dohsa nikho hinlhun sah-in natin, chutengle amaho keima tobang hung hitaovinte.
target: “People have heard my groaning, but there is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my distress; they rejoice at what you have done. May you bring the day you have announced so they may become like me.

source: Amaho gitlouna jouse na-anga hunglhung hen; chule kasuhkhelna ho jouse jeh-a kachunga nabol bangin amaho chunga jong bolin, ajehchu kakhoisatna atame, chule kalung jong alha lhoptai.
target: “Let all their wickedness come before you; deal with them as you have dealt with me because of all my sins. My groans are many and my heart is faint.”

source: Itobang tah-a Pakaiyin Zion chanu chu alunghana meiloma akhu khuma, chule Israel hoinaho chu van'a kona leisetna ahin lelhah-a, chule alunghanlai nikho-a akeng ngapna jeng jong ageldoh lou hitam!
target: How the Lord has covered Daughter Zion with the cloud of his anger! He has hurled down the splendor of Israel from heaven to earth; he has not remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.

source: Pakaiyin Jacob chenna mun jouse aval lhumtai, chule khotona aneipoi, alunghana jeh-in aman Judah chanu kulpidet ho chu asonlhan, chule hicheho chu toltoh alhobehtai; aman agam sungle chuche sunga pipuiho jong asubohtai.
target: Without pity the Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob; in his wrath he has torn down the strongholds of Daughter Judah. He has brought her kingdom and its princes down to the ground in dishonor.

source: Aman tijat umtah alunghan na-in Israel ki jouse asubongin, amelmate maija konin akhut jetlam anung loidoh-in, chule akimvel dung meikong hattah bangin aman Jacob dounan mei akondoh sah-in ahi.
target: In fierce anger he has cut off every horn of Israel. He has withdrawn his right hand at the approach of the enemy. He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire that consumes everything around it.

source: Aman melma khat bangin athal akamsalin, kidoupi khat bangin akhut jetlamin apangin, Zion chanu ponbuh sunga chun mitvetna hoijouse chu athatgamtai; aman alunghana chu mei bangin asunglhatan ahi.
target: Like an enemy he has strung his bow; his right hand is ready. Like a foe he has slain all who were pleasing to the eye; he has poured out his wrath like fire on the tent of Daughter Zion.

source: Pakai chu melma bang ahin; aman Israel avallhum tan, aleng inho jouse jong aval lhumtai; aman amaho amundet jouseu jong asuhset peh-in, chule Judah chanu ka nale maona jong asupung cheh-in ahi.
target: The Lord is like an enemy; he has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation for Daughter Judah.

source: Aman honlei khat bangin ahoubuh chu pumhatnin alamang tai. Aman mipi akikhopnao munho jong asuhsetpeh tai, Pakaiyin kut loupitah hole cholngah nikho jong Zion sunga suhmilin aumsahtai, chule alunghana nasatah jeh-in lengle thempu jong i-asah tapon ahi.
target: He has laid waste his dwelling like a garden; he has destroyed his place of meeting. The Lord has made Zion forget her appointed festivals and her Sabbaths; in his fierce anger he has spurned both king and priest.

source: Pakaiyin amaicham apaidoh-in, amun theng jong akidahtai. Aman leng inpi bangho jong melma khutna alehdohtan ahi; hitichun kut loupitah kibol nikho bang helin amahon Pakai insunga chun husa asosah taovin ahi.
target: The Lord has rejected his altar and abandoned his sanctuary. He has given the walls of her palaces into the hands of the enemy; they have raised a shout in the house of the Lord as on the day of an appointed festival.

source: Pakaiyin Zion chanu kulbang suhset ding agongtai, Aman gamgi khat alhungdoh-in, akhut jong suhsetna lama konin akihsah tapon, hijeh chun aman kul vumle kulbangho chu lunghem na-in asemin amaho lhanguijin aumtaove.
target: The Lord determined to tear down the wall around Daughter Zion. He stretched out a measuring line and did not withhold his hand from destroying. He made ramparts and walls lament; together they wasted away.

source: Amanu kotpigolho leisetna alhalut tai, amanu thihlhonho chu asuhboh peh-in, asuhmangpeh-e. Alengpale apipuho chu chidang namdangte lah-a aumtaove. Dan thupeh jong aumtapoi, athemgaohon jong Pakaiya kona mu anei tapouve.
target: Her gates have sunk into the ground; their bars he has broken and destroyed. Her king and her princes are exiled among the nations, the law is no more, and her prophets no longer find visions from the Lord .

source: Zion chanu upate chu tolla atouvun, thipbeh-in aumtaove. Amahon alujang uvah leivui akinuvin, khaodip pon jengin akivon taove. Jerusalem nungah thenghon jong alu-u tolah asulutnun akuntaove.
target: The elders of Daughter Zion sit on the ground in silence; they have sprinkled dust on their heads and put on sackcloth. The young women of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.

source: Kamit lhi jeh-in kho kamuthei tapoi. Kasung akithingin, kamite chanuho kisuhmang jeh-in kalungthim jeng jong leiset chunga akisunglha tai. Chapanghole noichep laiho khopi lamlen ho-a anguilha gamtaovin ahi.
target: My eyes fail from weeping, I am in torment within; my heart is poured out on the ground because my people are destroyed, because children and infants faint in the streets of the city.

source: Khopi lamlen ho-a gala kisukhaho banga ahaisamuva, anuteo phei chunga ahinnao abuhlhah lhah laiju chun amahon anuteo jah-a, bule lengpitwi hoibaham? atiuve.
target: They say to their mothers, “Where is bread and wine?” as they faint like the wounded in the streets of the city, as their lives ebb away in their mothers’ arms.

source: Vo Jerusalem chanu nangma hettohsahna dinga ipi thil kamana, katekah ding nahim? Vo nungah theng Zion chanu, ipitoh nakibange kati ding ham? Ajehchu nasetna twikhanglen banga len ahi, koijin damsah theijin natem?
target: What can I say for you? With what can I compare you, Daughter Jerusalem? To what can I liken you, that I may comfort you, Virgin Daughter Zion? Your wound is as deep as the sea. Who can heal you?

source: Nathemgao hon nang dingin pannabei le ngolhoi ngen namudoh peh uve. Chule amahon nasohchanna-a kona nakitoldoh theina dinga nakhanset naho amudoh dinghou chu amudoh pouvin, ahinla nangma dingin pohgih dihloule kikai mangna bou namudoh peh-un ahi.
target: The visions of your prophets were false and worthless; they did not expose your sin to ward off your captivity. The prophecies they gave you were false and misleading.

source: Nahinjotpa jousen akhutnu nahin behkhumun, Jerusalem chanu chu anuisatnun, chule akhasuh-un, hiche khopihi hilouham, mihem ten hoina chamkimna, leiset pumpi kipana ahi atiu chu? atiuve.
target: All who pass your way clap their hands at you; they scoff and shake their heads at Daughter Jerusalem: “Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth?”

source: Namelmate jouse nangma dounan akam kauvin, amaho a-eng hamun, aha-u agoijun, meihon amanu aval lhum jou taove, adihtah-in inanga jingu nikho chu hichehi ahitan, eihon ihol doh-un, imudoh taove, atiuve.
target: All your enemies open their mouths wide against you; they scoff and gnash their teeth and say, “We have swallowed her up. This is the day we have waited for; we have lived to see it.”

source: Pakaiyin agon chu atungdohtai. Aman masang laija athupeh chu asubulhing tai. Aman aseplhan akhotopoi. Chule aman nachunga namelma kipana asosahtai, aman nakidoupi te ki chu atungdohtan ahi.
target: The Lord has done what he planned; he has fulfilled his word, which he decreed long ago. He has overthrown you without pity, he has let the enemy gloat over you, he has exalted the horn of your foes.

source: Alungsungu Pakai henga apengin, Vo Zion chanu kulbang, sunle jan-in mitlhi lui bangin longhen, kicholdo hihbeh-in, namit lhi lon banghih hen, atiuve.
target: The hearts of the people cry out to the Lord. You walls of Daughter Zion, let your tears flow like a river day and night; give yourself no relief, your eyes no rest.

source: Thouvin janle pengdoh jengin: Jan phat ahung kipatle Pakai maija nalungsung twi bangin sunglhan lang, khopi lamlhah bul tina nachate chapang khangdongho gilkela lhasamho hinna dingin nakhut teni domsangin, ama lam chu sang jengin.
