target: Arise, cry out in the night, as the watches of the night begin; pour out your heart like water in the presence of the Lord. Lift up your hands to him for the lives of your children, who faint from hunger at every street corner.

source: Vetan, vo Pakai, koi chunga hitobanghi nabol em, geltemin. Numei hon alaigilgau khap khat bep chapangho chu anehdiu hitam? Thempuho le themgaoho chu Pakai muntheng sunga kithattei ding hitaovem?
target: “Look, Lord , and consider: Whom have you ever treated like this? Should women eat their offspring, the children they have cared for? Should priest and prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?

source: Ateh akhang lamlen ho-a tolla alumtaove, nungah theng kanei hole gollhangho chemjamin alougam taove, nangman nalunghan niho-a amaho natha ahitai. Nangman nathatnin khotona naneitapon ahi.
target: “Young and old lie together in the dust of the streets; my young men and young women have fallen by the sword. You have slain them in the day of your anger; you have slaughtered them without pity.

source: Nangman nikho loupi ni-a bangin katijat naho nasam khomin, hitichun Pakai lunghanna nikhon koimacha ajamdoh theile aumden theija aumpoi. Keiman kahuiluma kavahdoh ho chu kamelma hon asumang heltai.
target: “As you summon to a feast day, so you summoned against me terrors on every side. In the day of the Lord ’s anger no one escaped or survived; those I cared for and reared my enemy has destroyed.”

source: Alungsatna tenggola hesohna ana mu-a chu keima kahi.
target: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of the Lord ’s wrath.

source: Aman vah hilouvin, muthima keima eipuilutnin ahi.
target: He has driven me away and made me walk in darkness rather than light;

source: Tahbeh-in aman keima eikidoupin, nilhum keijin kachunga akhut alamin ahi.
target: indeed, he has turned his hand against me again and again, all day long.

source: Aman kaphele kavun avoilhah sah-in, kaguho jong asubongtan ahi.
target: He has made my skin and my flesh grow old and has broken my bones.

source: Aman kei dounan kul agenin, thoh hahsa nasatahle gimna-in eiumkhum tan ahi.
target: He has besieged me and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.

source: Aman khanglui laipeh-a anathisaho bangin, munthim lah-a eiumsah-in ahi.
target: He has made me dwell in darkness like those long dead.

source: Aman keima tho eikai khumin, kapot thei tapoi. Aman kakihenna thihkhao agihsah-e.
target: He has walled me in so I cannot escape; he has weighed me down with chains.

source: Keima kapma kepen teng jongle aman kataona akhahchah jitai.
target: Even when I call out or cry for help, he shuts out my prayer.

source: Aman song kikheng ho-a ka lampiho akhah-in, kalampiho akonsah gam ahitai.
target: He has barred my way with blocks of stone; he has made my paths crooked.

source: Ama chu keidin vompile keipi bahkai muthim laija um abange.
target: Like a bear lying in wait, like a lion in hiding,

source: Aman kalampiho ahei mangin, chule eimaltel jengin; aman kamhellin eisotai.
target: he dragged me from the path and mangled me and left me without help.

source: Aman athal akamsalin, thalchang chuhna ding lama keima eikoitai.
target: He drew his bow and made me the target for his arrows.

source: Aman alivatheija thalchang ho chu kalung changa chudin akaplutsoh tai.
target: He pierced my heart with arrows from his quiver.

source: Keima kamite jouse henga totnopna bep kahitan, chule nilhum keija alasah-u kahitai.
target: I became the laughingstock of all my people; they mock me in song all day long.

source: Aman keima thil akhatna kha-in eidipmin, chule gamsai twijin eivahkham tai.
target: He has filled me with bitter herbs and given me gall to drink.

source: Aman songbong hemho mangcha-in kahaho eisuhboh peh-in, vutvaijin eivuhkhum tai.
target: He has broken my teeth with gravel; he has trampled me in the dust.

source: Chule chamna-a konin kahina gamla tah-in nachon mangin, phattheina jong kasumiltai.
target: I have been deprived of peace; I have forgotten what prosperity is.

source: Keiman Pakaiya konin kathahat nale kakinep naho amang heltai, kati.
target: So I say, “My splendor is gone and all that I had hoped from the Lord .”

source: Kahesoh nale gentheina chule kathohgimna, gamsaile gil kha chu kagel doh-in ahi.
target: I remember my affliction and my wandering, the bitterness and the gall.

source: Kahin nahin hicheho chu ageldoh-in, chule keima suhnemin kaumin ahi.
target: I well remember them, and my soul is downcast within me.

source: Hichehi kalungin kagah gelin, keiman hichea chun kinepna kaneitai.
target: Yet this I call to mind and therefore I have hope:

source: Pakai khoto them naho jala bou suhgama umlou ihiuve, ajehchu amihepina chu alhasam ngaipoi.
target: Because of the Lord ’s great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail.

source: Hicheho chu jingkah seh-in athah jingin, nakitahna chu alenin ahi.
target: They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.

source: Kachan ding chu Pakai ahi, hijeh-a chu ama-a kakinep ding ahi, tin kahinna hin aseije.
target: I say to myself, “The Lord is my portion; therefore I will wait for him.”

source: Pakai chu ama ngahjing tele, ama holjing mite dingin aphan ahi.
target: The Lord is good to those whose hope is in him, to the one who seeks him;

source: Mihem khat dinga Pakai mi huhhingna chu kinema thipbeh-a nga chu thilpha ahi.
target: it is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the Lord .

source: Mihem dingin akhandon laija namkoljon poh hi aphan ahi.
target: It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is young.

source: Ama achang seh-in thipbeh-in atouve, ajehchu aman hichu achunga apoh ahi.
target: Let him sit alone in silence, for the Lord has laid it on him.

source: Kinepna-a aumtheina dingin, aman leivui lah-a akam asulutnin ahi.
target: Let him bury his face in the dust— there may yet be hope.

source: Aman adengpa chu abengphe adopeh-in; housetna-a jong adimin ahi.
target: Let him offer his cheek to one who would strike him, and let him be filled with disgrace.

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin a-imatih-a apaidoh louhel ding ahi.
target: For no one is cast off by the Lord forever.

source: Amavang aman sugim jengjongle, amihepi themna tamtah jala chu hepina anei ding ahi.
target: Though he brings grief, he will show compassion, so great is his unfailing love.

source: Ajehchu aman, mihem chate chu aphat sah jeh-a asuhgentheija, ahiloule asuhgimji ahipoi.
target: For he does not willingly bring affliction or grief to anyone.

source: Leisetna sohchangho chu akengtoa chil goija umding ahiuvin,
target: To crush underfoot all prisoners in the land,

source: Chungnung pen masang tah-a mihem khat thaneina lahdohna dinga,
target: to deny people their rights before the Most High,

source: Mihem khat ama hina noisehi, Pakaiyin pha asapon ahi.
target: to deprive them of justice— would not the Lord see such things?

source: Pakai jin thu apeh louleh, athusei lhunsah theija chu koiham?
target: Who can speak and have it happen if the Lord has not decreed it?

source: Asele apha hungdoh nahi chungnung pen kama kon hilou ham?
target: Is it not from the mouth of the Most High that both calamities and good things come?

source: Mihem khatnin achonset jeh-a talen amat chu, mihing khatnin ipi dinga aphunpi ham?
target: Why should the living complain when punished for their sins?

source: Eihon ilampihou kiholu hitin, chule kipatepmu hitin Pakai lama kihei kitnu hite.
target: Let us examine our ways and test them, and let us return to the Lord .

source: Eihon ilungsung houle ikhut houvin van ho-a um Pathen lam sangu hite.
target: Let us lift up our hearts and our hands to God in heaven, and say:

source: Keihon kana sukhelun, chule kanadoutaove, nangman neingaidam tapouve.
target: “We have sinned and rebelled and you have not forgiven.

source: Nangma lunghan na-in nakikhu-in, chule neisugimun ahi. Nangman nathatnin, khotona naneipoi.
target: “You have covered yourself with anger and pursued us; you have slain without pity.

source: Nangman kataona hou ahunglutpai thei louna din nangle nang meilom'in nakitomin ahi.
target: You have covered yourself with a cloud so that no prayer can get through.

source: Nangman miho lah-a keiho deiloule bohnen bangin neisem taove,
target: You have made us scum and refuse among the nations.

source: Kamel mate jouseu keiho dounan akam kataovin ahi.
target: “All our enemies have opened their mouths wide against us.

source: Tijat nale thangkol chule suhgamna le kachunguva kamhelna chu ahung lhungtai.
target: We have suffered terror and pitfalls, ruin and destruction.”

source: Kamipite chanu kisuh gamna jeh-in kamitlhi luijin along jenge.
target: Streams of tears flow from my eyes because my people are destroyed.

source: Kamitlhi apulin, tanglou helin alongdoh doh jenge,
target: My eyes will flow unceasingly, without relief,

source: Pakaiyin van'a kona ahin suhvetna ahinmu kahsen,
target: until the Lord looks down from heaven and sees.

source: Kakhopi sunga chanute jouse jeh-in kamitnin kalung atong khatan ahi.
target: What I see brings grief to my soul because of all the women of my city.

source: Kamelma ten ajeh beijin vacha bangin nasatah-in eidel lele jeng taove.
target: Those who were my enemies without cause hunted me like a bird.

source: Amahon leinoi kotong sunga kahinkho asumangun, chule kachung song khatnin adelphaove.
target: They tried to end my life in a pit and threw stones at me;

source: Twiho kalu chunga alongin, hichun keiman amangthah-a kahitai, kati.
target: the waters closed over my head, and I thought I was about to perish.

source: Vo Pakai leinoi kotong thuhtah-a konin keiman namin kahinsamin ahi.
target: I called on your name, Lord , from the depths of the pit.

source: Nangman ka awgin najai, kakana le kahai ginna konin nanakhang heimang hih-in.
target: You heard my plea: “Do not close your ears to my cry for relief.”

source: Keiman nangma kahinhou nikhon nahung naijin: kicha hih-in, neitin ahi.
target: You came near when I called you, and you said, “Do not fear.”

source: Vo Pakai, kalung sunga thil umho neisei hun, nangman kahinkho neilhatdoh pehtai.
target: You, Lord, took up my case; you redeemed my life.

source: Vo Pakai, nangin kathemmona namutai, kathu neitan peh-in.
target: Lord , you have seen the wrong done to me. Uphold my cause!

source: Nangman kei douna-a alunggel houle aphulahnao jouse namutan ahi.
target: You have seen the depth of their vengeance, all their plots against me.

source: Vo Pakai, amahon eihouset naole eidehnaova alunggelu nangman najatai.
target: Lord , you have heard their insults, all their plots against me—

source: Keima douna-a hung kipandoh ho muhle, nilhum keija keima dehna-a agonu abonchan nangman najasoh tai.
target: what my enemies whisper and mutter against me all day long.

source: Amaho toulhahle kipatdoh khu vetan, alasah-u jong keima jontai nabep ahitai.
target: Look at them! Sitting or standing, they mock me in their songs.

source: Vo Pakai, akhutnuva athilbolu dungjuijin amaho lethuhna pen.
target: Pay them back what they deserve, Lord , for what their hands have done.

source: Nangin amaho nasapsetna le lungthim natna chu pen.
target: Put a veil over their hearts, and may your curse be on them!

source: Pakai vanho noija konin lunghanna in amaho bolgimin lang sumangin.
target: Pursue them in anger and destroy them from under the heavens of the Lord .

source: I-atile sana mol lha-a hitam! I-atile sana thengtah kikhel jenga hitam! Munthenga songho chu lamlhah tin chenga akisunglha tai.
target: How the gold has lost its luster, the fine gold become dull! The sacred gems are scattered at every street corner.

source: Manlutah Zion chapate chu sana thengtah toh tethei ahin, i-atile amaho beldengpan leibel aden bangbepma umu hitam!
target: How the precious children of Zion, once worth their weight in gold, are now considered as pots of clay, the work of a potter’s hands!

source: Twi saiho jengin jong anoi adon, anoute avah-in ahi. Kamite chanuho hi gamthipma vacha lengho bangin alungselun ahi.
target: Even jackals offer their breasts to nurse their young, but my people have become heartless like ostriches in the desert.

source: Noi cheplai naosen lei chu dang chah-in adanga abehden tai. Chapang khangdong laihon an athumun ahinla koiman apepouve.
target: Because of thirst the infant’s tongue sticks to the roof of its mouth; the children beg for bread, but no one gives it to them.

source: Annem ne-a hung kivahho chu khopi lamlen ho-a amahthah gamtaovin; ponsanthip silla hung kivahdohho chun eh kisungvum adeijuve.
target: Those who once ate delicacies are destitute in the streets. Those brought up in royal purple now lie on ash heaps.

source: Ajehchu kamite chanute khangitlouna talen chu mitphet kah louva kisumang Sodom chonsetna talen sangin alenjoi, chule amanu chunga chun koimacha khut achupoi.
target: The punishment of my people is greater than that of Sodom, which was overthrown in a moment without a hand turned to help her.

source: Amanu Nazire mi hina chu buhbang sangin atheng jon, bongnoi sangin abang jon, avouso chu songmantam sangin ahoijon, ahoidan chu Saphir song tobang ahi.
target: Their princes were brighter than snow and whiter than milk, their bodies more ruddy than rubies, their appearance like lapis lazuli.

source: Amaho mel chu meihol sangin avom jotan, lamlen ho-ah amaho hetphah-in aumtapouve. Avunhou chu aguhouva abeh-in, molkangto abang jengtai.
target: But now they are blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets. Their skin has shriveled on their bones; it has become as dry as a stick.

source: Chemjam'a kithat ho chu kela thiding hosangin aphajotai. Ajehchu hichehohi lou gasoh ngaichatnan anguijin amangthah jitauve.
target: Those killed by the sword are better off than those who die of famine; racked with hunger, they waste away for lack of food from the field.

source: Khotona nei numei ho khut chun achateu achul chulun, kamite kisuh mangna-a chun amaho chu a-an uvin apang taovin ahi.
target: With their own hands compassionate women have cooked their own children, who became their food when my people were destroyed.

source: Pakaiyin alungsatna chu amolso tan; aman alunghana nasatah chu ahin bunglhatai, chule Zion'a mei akongdoh tai, chule hichun thil bulho chu asumangtan ahi.
target: The Lord has given full vent to his wrath; he has poured out his fierce anger. He kindled a fire in Zion that consumed her foundations.

source: Leisetna lenghole vannoi'a chengho jousen, akidoupi amelmau chu Jerusalem kotpiho sunga alut jou taove ti anaginchat louhel dingu ahi.
target: The kings of the earth did not believe, nor did any of the peoples of the world, that enemies and foes could enter the gates of Jerusalem.

source: Ajehchu amanu lailung tah-a chu themgaoho chonsetna le thempuho khangitlou jeh-a chondihho thisan kiso-a ahi.
target: But it happened because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, who shed within her the blood of the righteous.

source: Amaho mitcho ho bangin khopi lamlen ho-a avah leuvin, mihon avonhou atohkhah nomlouna diuvin thisanin akisuboh-un ahi.
target: Now they grope through the streets as if they were blind. They are so defiled with blood that no one dares to touch their garments.

source: Amahon ajah uva, nangho chemangun, potdoh-un, potdoh-un, hiche hi tongkha hih-un, athengpoi tin asamui, amaho ajam manguva avalele phatnun, amahon Pathen heloute lah-a, amaho chua chun chele tapouvinte tin aseijuve.
target: “Go away! You are unclean!” people cry to them. “Away! Away! Don’t touch us!” When they flee and wander about, people among the nations say, “They can stay here no longer.”

source: Pakai lunghanna chun amaho asukhentan, aman amaho khohsah kit taponte, amahon thempuho ajabol tapouvin, chule upaho jong angaisah tapouvin ahi.
target: The Lord himself has scattered them; he no longer watches over them. The priests are shown no honor, the elders no favor.

source: Eiho dingin vang, kithopi pannabei ivetna lamun imitnu athontai, ivetvet naovahin eihuhdoh jou louvu nam khat ivedoh taove.
target: Moreover, our eyes failed, looking in vain for help; from our towers we watched for a nation that could not save us.

source: Amahon ikalson nao ahindel peh-un, ikhopi lamlen hou ijot thei tapouve, ikichainao anaijin, inikhohou alhingin, ajehchu ikichainao chu ahung lhungtai.
target: People stalked us at every step, so we could not walk in our streets. Our end was near, our days were numbered, for our end had come.

source: Eiho eisugenthei hou chu van'a mulaopi ho sangin agang jouvin, amahon lhangsang ho chunga eidelun, amahon gamthipma eiho eichang lhiuve.
target: Our pursuers were swifter than eagles in the sky; they chased us over the mountains and lay in wait for us in the desert.

source: In'ah homuva hu, Pakai thaonu, eihon ama lim noija Pathen heloute lah-a chenginge itiu chu, amahon akokhuh sunguva eikoi taove.
target: The Lord ’s anointed, our very life breath, was caught in their traps. We thought that under his shadow we would live among the nations.

source: Uz gama chenga, vo Edom chanu kipah-in lang thanomin; khon jong chun nangma nahinphah ding ahi. Nangma nakham ngoldel ding; ahi, chule nangle nang sagohkeo nakiso ding ahi.
target: Rejoice and be glad, Daughter Edom, you who live in the land of Uz. But to you also the cup will be passed; you will be drunk and stripped naked.

source: Vo Zion chanu, nakhangitlouna talen namu chu akimolso tai. Aman nangma gal hingin nakai kit taponte, aman nakhangit louna jeh-a gotna napehding ahin, Vo Edom chanu, aman nachonset naho ahung mudoh ding ahi.
target: Your punishment will end, Daughter Zion; he will not prolong your exile. But he will punish your sin, Daughter Edom, and expose your wickedness.

source: Hingel doh-in, vo Pakai, kachunguva ipi hung lhunga hitam, ngaiton, chule ven keiho kiphosalnahi.
target: Remember, Lord , what has happened to us; look, and see our disgrace.

source: Kagouhou le kainhou hetlou mite hengle gamdang miho heng lama akiheitai.
target: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our homes to foreigners.

source: Keiho naochaga le paneilou kahitaove, kanuteu jong meithaiho abang taove.
target: We have become fatherless, our mothers are widows.

source: Katwihou man neijin kadonun; kathinghou keiho henga akijoh-in ahi.
target: We must buy the water we drink; our wood can be had only at a price.

source: Kangonghou suhgentheina noija aumtan; katong gimun olna himhim kanei tapouve.
target: Those who pursue us are at our heels; we are weary and find no rest.

source: Keihon neh le chah lonan kakhutnu Egypt mite leh Assyria mite henga kapetaove.
target: We submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread.

source: Kapateu anachonseuvin, tun aum tapouve, chule keihon amaho khangitlouna kapouvin ahi.
target: Our ancestors sinned and are no more, and we bear their punishment.

source: Soh hon kachunguva vai ahomun, amaho khutna kona eihuhdoh uva koimacha aumpoi.
target: Slaves rule over us, and there is no one to free us from their hands.

source: Gamthipma chemjam jeh-in thina geijin neh kakilouvin ahi.
target: We get our bread at the risk of our lives because of the sword in the desert.

source: Kel hoisetah jeh-in kavunu jong lungthu bangin avom jeng tai.
target: Our skin is hot as an oven, feverish from hunger.

source: Amahon Zion'a numei ho le Judah khopiho-a nungah ho asuseuvin ahi.
target: Women have been violated in Zion, and virgins in the towns of Judah.

source: Leng chapate akhutnun akikhaisangin; upaho mai jong jana akipepoi.
target: Princes have been hung up by their hands; elders are shown no respect.

source: Amahon gollhangho sumhei hehdin apuijun, chule chapangho thing noija alhugam taove.
target: Young men toil at the millstones; boys stagger under loads of wood.

source: Kotpi phunga kon upaho, chule tumging theija konin gollhangho abangtauve.
target: The elders are gone from the city gate; the young men have stopped their music.

source: Kalung sunguva kipana abangtai, kalamnao jong lunghemna asohtai.
target: Joy is gone from our hearts; our dancing has turned to mourning.

source: Kalu uva konin lallukhuh alhatai; kanachonset jehu'n, Ohe ada kahiuve!
target: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!

source: Hichejeh hin kalungu alhamang tan; ajehchu hicheho jeh-a kamit hou thima ahitai.
target: Because of this our hearts are faint, because of these things our eyes grow dim

source: Zion molsang kamhela aumtah jeh-in, sial ho achunga avahleuvin ahi.
target: for Mount Zion, which lies desolate, with jackals prowling over it.

source: Vo Pakai, nangma a-imatih chana umjing nahi, nalaltouna chu akhang akhanga umjinga ahi.
target: You, Lord , reign forever; your throne endures from generation to generation.

source: Chutia chu nangman keiho imatih chana dinga neisuhmilu hija, chule hitihchan pihi neidalhah-u hitam?
target: Why do you always forget us? Why do you forsake us so long?

source: Vo Pakai, naheng lama keiho neiheijun, chutile hung kihei taovinge, malaija bangin kanikho hou neisemthah peh-un.
target: Restore us to yourself, Lord , that we may return; renew our days as of old

source: Ahinla nangman keiho neipaimang hel taovin; keiho dounan kachunguva nalung ahanglhehtan ahi.
target: unless you have utterly rejected us and are angry with us beyond measure.

source: Tun ahung hitin ahi, kum somthum lhinkum, lhali channa ani nga channin, sohchangho lah-a Chebar vadunglen panga kaumpet tah-in, vanho anakihongin chule keiman Pathen'a kon thilmuho kanamun ahi.
target: In my thirtieth year, in the fourth month on the fifth day, while I was among the exiles by the Kebar River, the heavens were opened and I saw visions of God.

source: Chuche lhasung ninga channi, leng Jehoiachin sohchan kal akum nga channa-in,
target: On the fifth of the month—it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin—

source: Pakai thu chu kilangtah-in, Buzi chapa Ezekiel thempu henga, Chaldea miho gamsung Chebar vadunglen panga ahung lhungin, Pakai khut chu ama chunga ahung kingame.
target: the word of the Lord came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, by the Kebar River in the land of the Babylonians. There the hand of the Lord was on him.

source: Chuin keiman kagahvetle, veuvin chimpei khat sahlama konin ahungdoh-in, meilom lentah khat achama vahjeng, akimvel vah pempum, chuche lailunga meilah-a kon chun a-eng dum banga vahjeng aumin ahi.
target: I looked, and I saw a windstorm coming out of the north—an immense cloud with flashing lightning and surrounded by brilliant light. The center of the fire looked like glowing metal,

source: Hicheho lailung tah-a kon chun ganhing toh kiloutah li ahungdoh-in, chule hichehi amaho melputdan chu ahi; amaho chun mihem melput tobang apuvin ahi.
target: and in the fire was what looked like four living creatures. In appearance their form was human,

source: Chule khatcheh-in mai li aneijuvin, chule khatcheh-in lhaving li aneijuve.
target: but each of them had four faces and four wings.

source: Chule amaho keng khophang chu ajangpetnin, akeng khophang hou chu bongnou keng khophang tobang ahin; chule hicheho chu sum-eng kinotval bangin avalsetnin ahi.
target: Their legs were straight; their feet were like those of a calf and gleamed like burnished bronze.

source: Chule amahon apang li uva alhaving hou noija chun mihem khut tobang aneicheh uvin; chule amaho li chun mai le lhaving aneicheh uve.
target: Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands. All four of them had faces and wings,

source: Alhaving hou chu khatle khat akisumat cheh-in, amaho chu ache tengule kiheile louvin, abonchauvin jang petnin angat nalang uva ache jiuve.
target: and the wings of one touched the wings of another. Each one went straight ahead; they did not turn as they moved.

source: Amaho li maiso melput dan chu, mihem maiso apucheh uvin, chule ajetlam panguva keipi bahkai maiso apu uvin; aveilam panguva bongchal maiso apu uvin; chule ali uvin mulaopi maiso jong apucheh uve.
target: Their faces looked like this: Each of the four had the face of a human being, and on the right side each had the face of a lion, and on the left the face of an ox; each also had the face of an eagle.

source: Amaho maiso chu hitobang hi ahin, alhavinghou chu chunglam ngan akijal touvin, lhaving ni chu khatle khat akisumatnin, chule ni chun amaho tahsapum akhu khume.
target: Such were their faces. They each had two wings spreading out upward, each wing touching that of the creature on either side; and each had two other wings covering its body.

source: Chule amaho abonchauvin jangpetnin malama acheuvin, lhagao chena ding lam lama chun amaho acheuve; chule amaho ache tengule akiheile pouve.
target: Each one went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they went.

source: Ganhingho chu hitobang ahiuve, alimso dan chu song meihol kou lenglung abangin, chule thaomei vah jong abange. Hiche thaomei vah chu ganhingho lah-a achesuh achetouvin; chule meikou chu avahsetnin, meikouva kon chun kolphe asohdoh-in ahi.
target: The appearance of the living creatures was like burning coals of fire or like torches. Fire moved back and forth among the creatures; it was bright, and lightning flashed out of it.

source: Chule ganhingho chu kolphe vah bangin alhaijun, chule ahung kileuve.
target: The creatures sped back and forth like flashes of lightning.

source: Tun keiman ganhingho kavet petchun, veuvin leiset chunga um mai li nei ganhingho kom cheh-a chun, kangtalai kang khat cheh ahung ume.
target: As I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces.

source: Hiche kangtalai kangho lim umdan le akisemdan chu khisong engdum abangin; chule amaho li hin kibahna khat aneijuve. Amaho limdan le amaho kisemdan chu, kangtalai kang lailung tah-a kangtalai kang um abange.
target: This was the appearance and structure of the wheels: They sparkled like topaz, and all four looked alike. Each appeared to be made like a wheel intersecting a wheel.

source: Amaho ache tengule, apangli uvah acheuvin; amaho ache tengule akiheile pouve.
target: As they moved, they would go in any one of the four directions the creatures faced; the wheels did not change direction as the creatures went.

source: Kangtalai kang kikol ho chu ahile, amaho chu asang behseh un tijatjat aum jengin; chule amaho li kimvela hiche kangtalai kang kol ho-a chun mit adimset jengin ahi.
target: Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around.

source: Chule ganhingho chu ache tengule Kangtalai kang ho chun ajuijin, chule ganhingho chu leisetna kona dopsanga aumtengle, kangtalai kang hojong dopsangin aum jiuve.
target: When the living creatures moved, the wheels beside them moved; and when the living creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.

source: Hoilam hile lhagao chenom nalam lama amaho acheuve; ajehchu chulam chu amaho lhagao chena ding chu ahin; chule amaho chutoh kangtalai kang chu dopsangin aume. Ijeh inem itile ganhingho lhagao chu kangtalai kang ho-a chu uma ahi.
target: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise along with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

source: Chucheho acheteng, hicheho acheuvin; chule chucheho adinteng, hicheho adinguvin; chule leisetna kona dopsanga aumteng, kangtalai kang ho chu amahotoh dopsangin aumuvin ahi. Ijeh inem itile ganhingho lhagao chu kangtalai kang ho-a chu uma ahi.
target: When the creatures moved, they also moved; when the creatures stood still, they also stood still; and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose along with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

source: Chule ganhingho luchunga vanthamjol banga umchu songval abangin, hichu alu chunguva akikhang jengin ahi.
target: Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was what looked something like a vault, sparkling like crystal, and awesome.

source: Chule hiche vanthamjol noija chun alhavinghou jangpetnin khatle khat akingat to uvin, atahsao pang khatlam chu lhaving nin akhu khumin, atahsao langkhat lampang chu lhaving ni ma-in akhu khumin ahi.
target: Under the vault their wings were stretched out one toward the other, and each had two wings covering its body.

source: Chule amaho ache tengule, alhavinghou hugin chu twipiho gin tobang, Hatchung nungpen awgin tobang, thukisei awgin tobangle, janel ho husa gin tobangin kajan ahi. Amaho adin tengule alhavinghou chu amahon akoilha jiuvin ahin.
target: When the creatures moved, I heard the sound of their wings, like the roar of rushing waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army. When they stood still, they lowered their wings.

source: Chule amaho adinuva, alhavinghou atimlhah tengule, alu vumuva um vantham jola kon chun awgin khat ahung gingdoh jin ahi.
target: Then there came a voice from above the vault over their heads as they stood with lowered wings.

source: Chule alu vumuva vanthamjol um chunga chun laltouna tobang khat aumin, khisong dumjet to abangin; chule hiche laltouna tobang chunga chun mihem tobang khat aume.
target: Above the vault over their heads was what looked like a throne of lapis lazuli, and high above on the throne was a figure like that of a man.

source: Chule keiman akong chunglamse chu a-engdum tobang, asung akimvelse chu meikou bang jengin kamun; chule akonga pat anoilamse chu meikou tobang, akimvelse vah lenglung bangin kamun ahi.
target: I saw that from what appeared to be his waist up he looked like glowing metal, as if full of fire, and that from there down he looked like fire; and brilliant light surrounded him.

source: Gojuh nikho-a meilhang lah-a lhagui lim kimu bang khun, akimvel chu avahpempum jengin ahi. Hiche chu Pakai loupi limso kilang chu ahi. Chuin hichu kamu phatnin, tolla kamai kasulut jengin, chule thu kisei awgin khat kajatan ahi.
target: Like the appearance of a rainbow in the clouds on a rainy day, so was the radiance around him. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord . When I saw it, I fell facedown, and I heard the voice of one speaking.

source: Chuin aman kajah-a, Mihem chapa, nakengin dingdoh-in, chule keiman nahenga thu kasei ding ahi, ati.
target: He said to me, “Son of man, stand up on your feet and I will speak to you.”

source: Aman kahenga thu asei phatnin lhagao chu kasunga ahung lutnin, chuin kahenga athusei chu kajah theina din, kakengin eidinsah-e.
target: As he spoke, the Spirit came into me and raised me to my feet, and I heard him speaking to me.

source: Chule aman kajah-a, Mihem chapa keima douna-a kiphinjing, thungailou Israel chate henga kasol nahi. Amahole apu apateuvin keima dounan tunikho geijin chonset abol jingun ahi.
target: He said: “Son of man, I am sending you to the Israelites, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against me; they and their ancestors have been in revolt against me to this very day.

source: Ajehchu amahohi jumle jalam helou lungtah chate ahiuve. Keiman nangma kasol nahin, Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije, tia amaho naseipeh ding ahi.
target: The people to whom I am sending you are obstinate and stubborn. Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says.’

source: Chule amahohin, ngaiju henlang ngaihih tajongleu, (ajehchu amahohi kiphin nom insung ahiuvin,) amaho lah-a themgao khat anaum nalaije ti ahet dingu ahi.
target: And whether they listen or fail to listen—for they are a rebellious people—they will know that a prophet has been among them.

source: Chule nangma mihem chapa, amaho chu kicha hih-in, athuseiju jong kicha hih-in; ling le khaovin nabom henlang, aipi lah-a cheng hijongle chun; amaho thungailou insung hijongleu, athuseijun kicha hih-in, chule amit vetnun jong lungthoi hih-in.
target: And you, son of man, do not be afraid of them or their words. Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns are all around you and you live among scorpions. Do not be afraid of what they say or be terrified by them, though they are a rebellious people.

source: Chule amahon ngaijuhen, ahiloule ngaihih jongleu, keima thuhi ahenguva naseitei ding ahi. Ijeh-inem itile amahohi mikiphin nomte mong ahiuve.
target: You must speak my words to them, whether they listen or fail to listen, for they are rebellious.

source: Ahin nangma mihem chapa, keiman nahenga kaseihi ngaijin; nangma chutobang thungailou insung bangin, thungailouvin umhih beh-in. Nakam hinkan, chule keiman kapehhi nen, ati.
target: But you, son of man, listen to what I say to you. Do not rebel like that rebellious people; open your mouth and eat what I give you.”

source: Hichun keiman kagahven ahile, veuvin, kahenga khut khat ahung kilhang doh-in, chule ven, hiche sunga chun lekhabu jol khat aume.
target: Then I looked, and I saw a hand stretched out to me. In it was a scroll,

source: Chuin aman hichu ka anga apha jal-in ahi, hichu asungle apoa kisun ahi. Hiche sunga chun kana le lunghemna chule dana thu akisune.
target: which he unrolled before me. On both sides of it were written words of lament and mourning and woe.

source: Chukal valin aman kahenga, Mihem chapa, namu chu nejengin; hiche lekhajol hi nen, chule chenlang Israel insung henga thu gaseijin, ati.
target: And he said to me, “Son of man, eat what is before you, eat this scroll; then go and speak to the people of Israel.”

source: Hitichun keiman kakam kakan, chule aman chuche lekhajol chu einehsah tai.
target: So I opened my mouth, and he gave me the scroll to eat.

source: Chuin aman kahenga, Mihem chapa na oisunga lutsah-in, chule keiman kapeh hiche lekhajol hin nasung dimsah in, tin aseije. Hichun keiman kanen ahile, kakam sunga khoiju lhumin alhumin ahi.
target: Then he said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll I am giving you and fill your stomach with it.” So I ate it, and it tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth.

source: Chuin aman kahenga aseije, Mihem chapa, chen, Israel insung henga gachen, chule keima thuho hi amaho henga gaseijin.
target: He then said to me: “Son of man, go now to the people of Israel and speak my words to them.

source: Ajehchu gamdang paole pao hahsa mite henga kisol nahipon, ahinla Israel insung heng joh-a nangma kisola nahibouve.
target: You are not being sent to a people of obscure speech and strange language, but to the people of Israel—

source: Ajehchu hetkhahlou paole ham tho nam mite leh pao hahsa nam mite henga kisola nahipoi. Tahbeh-in, amaho henga chun keiman nangma anasol leng, amaho chun nangma thu anangai diu ahi.
target: not to many peoples of obscure speech and strange language, whose words you cannot understand. Surely if I had sent you to them, they would have listened to you.

source: Ahinla Israel insungin vang nangma thu angailou dingu ahi; ajehchu amahon keima thusei jong angailou dingu ahi. Ijeh-inem itile Israel insung pumpihi jachat helou ahiuve.
target: But the people of Israel are not willing to listen to you because they are not willing to listen to me, for all the Israelites are hardened and obstinate.

source: Ven, keiman amaho maitoh kitatto dinga namai kasuhtah-a, chule amaho chalpang toh kitatto dinga nachalpang kasuhtah ahitai.
target: But I will make you as unyielding and hardened as they are.

source: Keiman meituh song sanga tahjo thiltah bangin nachalpang kasempehtai. Amaho ginghih beh-in, amaho thungailou insung khat hijeng jongleu, amelput aumdanhou jeh-in nangma lunglhalou jenin, ati.
target: I will make your forehead like the hardest stone, harder than flint. Do not be afraid of them or terrified by them, though they are a rebellious people.”

source: Chukal valin, aman kahenga hitin asei kitnin, Mihem chapa, keiman nahenga kahinsei ding kathuho abonchan nalung sunga kisan lutnin lang, nanakhangin ngaijin.
target: And he said to me, “Son of man, listen carefully and take to heart all the words I speak to you.

source: Chule chen, sohchanga um namite le achateu henga nangma galutnin lang, amahon ngaijuhen lang ngaihih jongleu, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, tin amaho henga gaseijin lang gahilin, tin aseije.
target: Go now to your people in exile and speak to them. Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says,’ whether they listen or fail to listen.”

source: Chuin lhagaovin eilatouvin, kanung lama chun aw sangtah-a kisei thu khat kajan, hiche aw chun, Amun thenga Pakai loupi chu vahchoijin umhen, ati.
target: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me a loud rumbling sound as the glory of the Lord rose from the place where it was standing.

source: Chujongle keiman ganhing ho lhavingho khatle khat akitoh khahto ginle, amaho koma um kangtalai kang ho kitol nasatah gin kajan ahi.
target: It was the sound of the wings of the living creatures brushing against each other and the sound of the wheels beside them, a loud rumbling sound.

source: Hiti chun lhagaovin keima eilatoutan, chule eipui mangtan, chuin lung nommo tahle ka lhagao lunggim tah-in kachetai; ahivangin kachunga Pakai khut chu ahatnin ahi.
target: The Spirit then lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness and in the anger of my spirit, with the strong hand of the Lord on me.

source: Chujouvin keiman Chebar vadunglen panga cheng, Tel-abib'a sohchanga umho heng kalhungtan, chule keima amaho touna-a katouvin, kidang satah in amaho lah-a ni sagi kaumin ahi.
target: I came to the exiles who lived at Tel Aviv near the Kebar River. And there, where they were living, I sat among them for seven days—deeply distressed.

source: Chuin ni sagi kichainin ahitin ahi, hitichun Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin,
target: At the end of seven days the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, keiman nangma Israel insung dinga avesui diuva kasem nahitai. Hijeh chun keima kamsunga kon thupot ngaijin, chule keima-a konin amaho gihsalin, ati.
target: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the people of Israel; so hear the word I speak and give them warning from me.

source: Keiman mi khang gilou henga, nangma thonlouva nathi teiding ahi kati-a; nangman ama chu gihna pelouva, ahiloule agilou chu agitlouna lampiho-a kona ahinkho akihuhdohna dinga thu imacha ama gihna-a naseipeh loule; chutobang agiloupa chu akhansetna-a chu thitei ding ahin; amavang ama thisan chu keiman nangma khutna kahin ngeh ding ahi.
target: When I say to a wicked person, ‘You will surely die,’ and you do not warn them or speak out to dissuade them from their evil ways in order to save their life, that wicked person will die for their sin, and I will hold you accountable for their blood.

source: Nangman agiloupa chu nanagih nah-a, ama agitlouna-a konle agitlouna lampia kona akiheidoh loule, akhansetna-a chu thitei ding ahin; amavang nangman nahinna nakihuh doh ahi.
target: But if you do warn the wicked person and they do not turn from their wickedness or from their evil ways, they will die for their sin; but you will have saved yourself.

source: Chukitle, michonpha chu, achonphatna-a kona kihei manga, gitlouna abolteng, keiman amasanga kipal lhuhna kakoija, ama thitei ding ahi; ajehchu nangman gihsalna nanapeh loujeh-a achonsetna-a thiding, chule achonphatna thilbolho chu kigeldoh lou ding ahitai; amavang ama thisan chu keiman nangma khutna kangeh ding ahi.
target: “Again, when a righteous person turns from their righteousness and does evil, and I put a stumbling block before them, they will die. Since you did not warn them, they will die for their sin. The righteous things that person did will not be remembered, and I will hold you accountable for their blood.

source: Hijeng jongle, nangman michonpha chu gihna napeh-a, chonphan chonset abolji poi nati-a, chonset bol louva aumle, thonlouva hingtei ding ahi; ajehchu ama chun kigihna asangin; nangman jong nahinna nakihuh doh ahi.
target: But if you do warn the righteous person not to sin and they do not sin, they will surely live because they took warning, and you will have saved yourself.”

source: Chukoma chun Pakai khut chu kachunga akingamin, chule aman kahenga, thoudoh inlang phaichama khun gachen, chule chukoma chu keiman nangma kakihoupi ding nahi, ati.
target: The hand of the Lord was on me there, and he said to me, “Get up and go out to the plain, and there I will speak to you.”

source: Chuin kakipatdoh-in, phaichama chun kachetai. Chuin veuvin, Chebar vadunglen panga kanamu loupina, Pakai loupina chu anadingin ahi. Hichun keiman tolla kamai kasulut tai.
target: So I got up and went out to the plain. And the glory of the Lord was standing there, like the glory I had seen by the Kebar River, and I fell facedown.

source: Hichun lhagao chu kasunga ahung lutnin, kakengin eidin sah-in, chule keima eikihoupin, kajah-a, Chen, na insunga gaum chahbeh-in, ati.
target: Then the Spirit came into me and raised me to my feet. He spoke to me and said: “Go, shut yourself inside your house.

source: Hijongle Vo nangma mihem chapan, vetan, amahon nachunga khaohol ho ahinkoi diu, hicheho-a chu nakandiu ahin, chule amaho lah-a nagache dohle louding ahi.
target: And you, son of man, they will tie with ropes; you will be bound so that you cannot go out among the people.

source: Chule keiman napaomona dingle amaho dinga aphohsalpao nahilouna dinga, nalei chu nadanga kabesah ding ahi. Ajehchu amaho thungailou insung ahiuve.
target: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be silent and unable to rebuke them, for they are a rebellious people.

source: Ahinla nahenga thu kasei tengle, keiman nakam kahona, chule nangman amaho henga, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, tia nagasei ding; angainom pan angaiding, chule angainomlou pan angaida ding ahi. Ajehchu amahohi thungailou insung ahiuve.
target: But when I speak to you, I will open your mouth and you shall say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says.’ Whoever will listen let them listen, and whoever will refuse let them refuse; for they are a rebellious people.

source: Mihem chapa, nangman leingan kigoutah khat lanlang, hichu namasanga koijin, chule hiche chunga chun khopi lim, Jerusalem lim chu semin.
target: “Now, son of man, take a block of clay, put it in front of you and draw the city of Jerusalem on it.

source: Chule hichu galmiho umkimvel sah inlang, hiche khopi dounan kulbang sah khumin, chule adounan molsang khat tundoh khumin lang, gebuh jong sah khumin, chule akimvela chun kulbang suhsetna manchah ho tung doh-in.
target: Then lay siege to it: Erect siege works against it, build a ramp up to it, set up camps against it and put battering rams around it.

source: Chukal valin nangman thihpheng tupeh khat lanlang, hichu nangmale hiche khopi kah-a chun thihbang kidal bangin dalin; chule hiche lam chu mai ngatnin, chule hichu ki-um kimvel ding, nangman naum kimvel ding ahi. Hichehi Israel insung dinga melchihna hiding ahi.
target: Then take an iron pan, place it as an iron wall between you and the city and turn your face toward it. It will be under siege, and you shall besiege it. This will be a sign to the people of Israel.

source: Naveilam pang delphan lumin, chule hiche chunga chun Israel insung khangitlouna ho chu koijin; chutobanga hiche chunga nalup nikho jat dungjuija chu nangman amaho khan gitlouna chu napohpeh ding ahi.
target: “Then lie on your left side and put the sin of the people of Israel upon yourself. You are to bear their sin for the number of days you lie on your side.

source: Ajehchu anikho jat dungjuija ni jathum le somko, keiman nachunga akhansetnao kumho chu kakoi ahitai. Hitia hi nangman Israel insung khan gitlouna chu napoh ding ahi.
target: I have assigned you the same number of days as the years of their sin. So for 390 days you will bear the sin of the people of Israel.

source: Chule nangman hiho chu nasuhbulhit tengle, nangma najetlam panga nalup kitna, chule Judah insung khan gitlouna chu nisomli napoh ding ahi. Keiman nangma dinga nikhat chu kum khatna kasimpeh nahi.
target: “After you have finished this, lie down again, this time on your right side, and bear the sin of the people of Judah. I have assigned you 40 days, a day for each year.

source: Hijeh-a chu nangman Jerusalem ki-um kimvel lam chu namai ngat ding, chule naban chu nahodoh-a, hiche khopi douna-a chu gaothu naseiding ahi.
target: Turn your face toward the siege of Jerusalem and with bared arm prophesy against her.

source: Chule ven, keiman khaohol ho-a kakanna, chule naki-um kimvelna nikhoho nasuhbei kahse-a, nangma langkhatna kona langkhatna kihei theilouva naum ding ahi.
target: I will tie you up with ropes so that you cannot turn from one side to the other until you have finished the days of your siege.

source: Chujongle nangman, suhlouchang le sakolchang, chule bepi le bepal, chule butun le lengmusel lan lang umbel khatna koijin, chule hicheho-a kon chun nasih-a nalup ding nikhoho dungjuijin changlhah kisemin, hichu nikho jathum le somko sunga chu nangman naneh ding ahi.
target: “Take wheat and barley, beans and lentils, millet and spelt; put them in a storage jar and use them to make bread for yourself. You are to eat it during the 390 days you lie on your side.

source: Chule nangman nikhatna nanehding anchu agihdan shekel somni hiding; chule aphat phatna hichu naneh ding ahi.
target: Weigh out twenty shekels of food to eat each day and eat it at set times.

source: Nangman twi jong teptena neija nadon ding, hin dimkhat hopgupma kihom hopkhat hiding; hichu aphat phatna nadon ding ahi.
target: Also measure out a sixth of a hin of water and drink it at set times.

source: Chule nangman amaho mitmu dinga mihem'a kona hungdoh eh chu changlhah-a nakana, hichu sakol changa kisem changlhah banga naneh ding ahi, ati.
target: Eat the food as you would a loaf of barley bread; bake it in the sight of the people, using human excrement for fuel.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin aseije, Hitobanga chu Israel chaten, keiman amaho kanodohna chidang namdangho lah-a chu suhbohsa changlhahho aneh dingu ahi, ati.
target: The Lord said, “In this way the people of Israel will eat defiled food among the nations where I will drive them.”

source: Hichun keiman, Pakai Pathen, vetan, kahinna suhboh-in ana um khapoi; ijeh inem itile kakhang dona pat tuchan geijin athikam, ahiloule akimaltelsa kiti kanehih laije; kakam sunga jong thet um saphe alutkha hih laijin ahi, tin kaseitai.
target: Then I said, “Not so, Sovereign Lord ! I have never defiled myself. From my youth until now I have never eaten anything found dead or torn by wild animals. No impure meat has ever entered my mouth.”

source: Chuin aman kahenga aseijin, Ven, mihem eh khelin bong eh kape-e, nangman hichea chu changlhah nakisem ding ahi.
target: “Very well,” he said, “I will let you bake your bread over cow dung instead of human excrement.”

source: Chukalvalin aman kahenga aseijin, Mihem chapa, vetan, keiman Jerusalem'a changlhah hung kipohlutna bul chu kasuhtan ding; chule amahon changlhah agih-a ateova chule itcha tah-a aneh dingu; chule amahon twi jong teptena neija chule kidang satah-a adon dingu ahi.
target: He then said to me: “Son of man, I am about to cut off the food supply in Jerusalem. The people will eat rationed food in anxiety and drink rationed water in despair,

source: Chutia chu amahon changlhah le twi ahin ngaichat uva, chule khatle khat kidatmoto diu, akhan gitlounao jeh-a mangthah diu ahi.
target: for food and water will be scarce. They will be appalled at the sight of each other and will waste away because of their sin.

source: Chule nangma, mihem chapa, chemcha hemthet khat kilah-in, samvoupa samchem kilah-in, chule hichun naluchang le nakhamul vouvin; chuteng atenadin khaikot lanlang, sam chu homkhenin.
target: “Now, son of man, take a sharp sword and use it as a barber’s razor to shave your head and your beard. Then take a set of scales and divide up the hair.

source: Khopi akiumna nikhoho chu alhin tengle, hop thuma hopkhat chu khopi lailung tah-a meija nahal ding; chule hopthum-a hopkhat nalah-a, hichu chemcha khatna nasat bong ding; chule hopthum-a hopkhat chu hui lah-a nathejal ding; chule anungu chemjam'a kajui ding ahi.
target: When the days of your siege come to an end, burn a third of the hair inside the city. Take a third and strike it with the sword all around the city. And scatter a third to the wind. For I will pursue them with drawn sword.

source: Nangman hicheho lah-a kona chu phabep khat nalah-a, chule hicheho chu naponsil monga nakhi ding ahi.
target: But take a few hairs and tuck them away in the folds of your garment.

source: Chuteng nangman hicheho chu nalahkit ding, chule hicheho chu meikong lailung tah-a naselutna, chule hicheho chu meisunga nahalvam ding ahi, ajehchu hichea kona chu meikou khat hungdoh-a, Israel insung pumpi sunga lutding ahi.
target: Again, take a few of these and throw them into the fire and burn them up. A fire will spread from there to all Israel.

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, Hichehi Jerusalem ahi; Keiman amanu hi akimvela um namho le gamho lailung tah-a katundoh ahi.
target: “This is what the Sovereign Lord says: This is Jerusalem, which I have set in the center of the nations, with countries all around her.

source: Chule amanun namdangho sangin kathutana hi gitlounan asodoh-in, chule akimvela um gamho sangin kadan kisunho chu gitlounan aha sodoh-in ahi. Ajehchu amahon kathutana hole kadan kisunho alapouvin, hicheho chu ajuipouvin ahi.
target: Yet in her wickedness she has rebelled against my laws and decrees more than the nations and countries around her. She has rejected my laws and has not followed my decrees.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, nangho nakimvel uva um namtin ho sanga napunjoh jeh-ule, kadan kisunho jong najui tahlou jeh-un; chule kathutanho jong nanit tahlou jeh-ule, nakimvel uva um namtin ho thutan ho dungjuija jong na natoh tahlou jeh-un;
target: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: You have been more unruly than the nations around you and have not followed my decrees or kept my laws. You have not even conformed to the standards of the nations around you.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, Ven, keima, keimatah ngeijong nangho douva pang kahitan, chule namtinho mitmu chang tah-a nalah uva thutanna kalhut ding ahi.
target: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I myself am against you, Jerusalem, and I will inflict punishment on you in the sight of the nations.

source: Chule keiman kanabol khahlou, chule atobang jong avela kabolkit louding chu, thet umtah nathilbol hou jeh-a nachung uva kabolding ahi.
target: Because of all your detestable idols, I will do to you what I have never done before and will never do again.

source: Hijeh-a chu nalah uva paten chapate ahin neh uva, chule chapaten apateu ahin neh dingu; chule keiman nachunga thutanna kalhunsah ding, chule nalah uva ahingdoh amoh chengse chu abonchauva hui lah-a kathecheh ding ahi.
target: Therefore in your midst parents will eat their children, and children will eat their parents. I will inflict punishment on you and will scatter all your survivors to the winds.

source: Hijeh chun, Pakai Pathen'in, keima hing jingjeng kahito lhonin, nangman kamun theng chu ningset umtahle, thilbohho jouse-a nasuhboh tah jeh-a, thonlouva keiman jong nangma ka kemsuh sah ding; kamitnin jong khen aneideh lou ding, khotona kiti imacha jong kaneilou ding ahitai.
target: Therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your vile images and detestable practices, I myself will shave you; I will not look on you with pity or spare you.

source: Nangma-a hopthum-a hopkhat chu hise-a thidingu, chule nalah tah-a amaho chu kella suhmanga umdiu; chule hopthum-a hopkhat chu nakimvela chemjam'a lou dingu; chule hopthum-a hopkhat chu keiman huija kathecheh ding, chule chemjam'a kanungdel ding ahi.
target: A third of your people will die of the plague or perish by famine inside you; a third will fall by the sword outside your walls; and a third I will scatter to the winds and pursue with drawn sword.

source: Chutia chu kalunghana chu kasuh bulhitna, kalungsatna achunguva chuding, chuteng kalungmon ding ahi, chutia chu kalungsatna achunguva kabulhit teng, Pakai kitipa keiman katom panna-a hichehi kasei ahi ahetdoh dingu ahi.
target: “Then my anger will cease and my wrath against them will subside, and I will be avenged. And when I have spent my wrath on them, they will know that I the Lord have spoken in my zeal.

source: Chukalvala keiman nakimvela um namho lah le achele jouse mitmu-a, khopi chimsa le noise umtah-a kasemdoh ding nahi.
target: “I will make you a ruin and a reproach among the nations around you, in the sight of all who pass by.

source: Keiman lunghanna le lungsat na-a, chule lungsa tah-a phona-a nachunga thutanna kahinnei tengle, nakimvela um namtin ho dinga noise umtah le isahlou, kihilna le datmo um nahiding ahi. Keima Pakaiyin kaseidoh ahitai.
target: You will be a reproach and a taunt, a warning and an object of horror to the nations around you when I inflict punishment on you in anger and in wrath and with stinging rebuke. I the Lord have spoken.

source: Keiman amaho dinga manthah na, chule nangma sumang dinga kel lhahna thalchang giloutah kahinsol tengle; keiman nachung uva kel lhahna kapunsah ding, nachang lhah-u hungkondohna chu kasuhtan ding ahi.
target: When I shoot at you with my deadly and destructive arrows of famine, I will shoot to destroy you. I will bring more and more famine upon you and cut off your supply of food.

source: Chutia chu keiman kel le gamsa gilou nachung uva kahinlan sah ding, hicheho chun nachateo ahinsuhmang ding; chule hisele thisanin nangma nahinphah ding; chule keiman chemjam chu nachunga kahinchuhsah ding ahi. Keima Pakai Pathen'in kaseidoh ahitai.
target: I will send famine and wild beasts against you, and they will leave you childless. Plague and bloodshed will sweep through you, and I will bring the sword against you. I the Lord have spoken.”

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin ati,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Israel molsang ho lam nganlang, amaho dounan gaothu seijin,
target: “Son of man, set your face against the mountains of Israel; prophesy against them

source: Nangho Israel molsang ho, Pakai Pathen thu ngaijun; Pakai Pathen'in molsang ho, lhangho, vadungho chule phaicham ho henga hitin aseije; Vetan keima, keimatah ngeijin nangho chunga chemjam kahin chuhsah ding, chule keiman namun sang hou chu kasuhmang ding ahi.
target: and say: ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Sovereign Lord . This is what the Sovereign Lord says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: I am about to bring a sword against you, and I will destroy your high places.

source: Chule namaicham hou chu hung kamhel ding, semthu milimho jong suhsetna umding; chule keiman akithatsa namite chu namilimhou masanga kaselhah ding ahi.
target: Your altars will be demolished and your incense altars will be smashed; and I will slay your people in front of your idols.

source: Chule keiman Israel chate thilongho chu alim semthuhou angsunga kalelhah ding; chule naguhou chu namaicham hou kimvela kathechap jeng ding ahi.
target: I will lay the dead bodies of the Israelites in front of their idols, and I will scatter your bones around your altars.

source: Namaicham hou akeohel le akamhela aumna ding, na pathen semthuhou suhkeh le suhmanga aum nading, namilim semthuhou satlhah-a auma, chule nanatoh hou suhmanga aum theina dinga; nangho chenna mun jouse-a khopiho chu ahom keuva kilha ding, chule munsang jouse chu kamhela umding ahi.
target: Wherever you live, the towns will be laid waste and the high places demolished, so that your altars will be laid waste and devastated, your idols smashed and ruined, your incense altars broken down, and what you have made wiped out.

source: Chule akithat ho chu nalah tah uva lhujeng ding ahiuvin, chuteng keima Pakai chu kahi nahetdoh dingu ahi.
target: Your people will fall slain among you, and you will know that I am the Lord .

source: Ahijeng vangin nangho gamho-a thecheh-a nahung umtengule, namtinho lah-a chemjam'a asohcha phabep nanghon nanei theina dinguva keiman ahingdoh amoh honkhat kadalhah ding ahi.
target: “ ‘But I will spare some, for some of you will escape the sword when you are scattered among the lands and nations.

source: Chule nalah uva asohchase vang chun gal hinga akikai lutna lam lamu namtinho lah-a chu keima eihin geldoh jing dingu ahi, ajehchu keija kona anapetmang jonlung poho lungsung, chule amit hou jonmit po-a alim semthuhou juiho chutoh kakikhen ahitai. Chule amaho akisuh bohnao jouse-a agilou anaboldoh jouseu jeh-a chu amahole amaho kikidah ding ahiuve.
target: Then in the nations where they have been carried captive, those who escape will remember me—how I have been grieved by their adulterous hearts, which have turned away from me, and by their eyes, which have lusted after their idols. They will loathe themselves for the evil they have done and for all their detestable practices.

source: Chule keima Pakai kahi leh, hiche thilse amaho chunga kahinbol ding chu moh-a kasei ahipoi ti amahon ahetdiu ahi.
target: And they will know that I am the Lord ; I did not threaten in vain to bring this calamity on them.

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije, Nakhutnin jepmin, chule nakengin lhonlang seijin, ohe, ada ahiuve! ijeh inem itile Israel insung gilou thet umtahho jeh-a, amaho chemjam'a, kella, chule hise-a lougam ding ahiuve.
target: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Strike your hands together and stamp your feet and cry out “Alas!” because of all the wicked and detestable practices of the people of Israel, for they will fall by the sword, famine and plague.

source: Koihileh gamlatah-a umchu hise-a thitei ding, chule koihile anaija uma chu chemjam'a loutei ding, chule koihile aumden le umkimvel khuma uma chu kella thitei ding ahiuve. Hiti ahi keiman kalungsatna chu amaho chunga kamolso ding ahi.
target: One who is far away will die of the plague, and one who is near will fall by the sword, and anyone who survives and is spared will die of famine. So will I pour out my wrath on them.

source: Chutengle amilimhou hou lah-a, amaichamu kimvela, lhangsung chung tina, molsang ho chungvum tina, chule thinghing phungnoi tina, gangpi phungnoi tina, amilimhou henga gimnamtui apehnao munho jouse-a chu akithat ho sechu ahung umtengle, nanghon keima Pakai kahi nahet dingu ahi.
target: And they will know that I am the Lord , when their people lie slain among their idols around their altars, on every high hill and on all the mountaintops, under every spreading tree and every leafy oak—places where they offered fragrant incense to all their idols.

source: Hiti ahi keiman achunguva kakhut kalhah-a, agamu kamhela kalha ding; chule Diblath lama gamthip sanga jong kamhel jo-a kalha ding ahi. Chule amahon keima Pakai kahi chu eihin hetdoh dingu ahi, ati.
target: And I will stretch out my hand against them and make the land a desolate waste from the desert to Diblah—wherever they live. Then they will know that I am the Lord .’ ”

source: Hiche chungchon chun Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Nangma mihem chapa, Pakai Pathen'in Israel gam henga hiti jonghin aseije; Achaina, achaina chu gam ningliho chunga ahung lhungtai.
target: “Son of man, this is what the Sovereign Lord says to the land of Israel: “ ‘The end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land!

source: Tuhin achaina chu nangma chunga hunglhunga ahitai, chule keiman nachunga kalunghana kahin lhunsah ding, chule nalam lhah dungjuija nathu katan ding ahi, chule thet umtah nahinaho jouse chu nachunga kalethuh ding ahi.
target: The end is now upon you, and I will unleash my anger against you. I will judge you according to your conduct and repay you for all your detestable practices.

source: Chule kamitnin nangma nakhehchah louding, khotona jong kaneilou ding ahi. Ahivangin nalam lhah ho keiman kalethuh cheh ding, chule thet umtah nahina ho chu nalah tah-a umding; chuteng nangman Pakai kahi chu nahetdoh ding ahi.
target: I will not look on you with pity; I will not spare you. I will surely repay you for your conduct and for the detestable practices among you. “ ‘Then you will know that I am the Lord .’

source: Hitihin Pakai Pathen'in aseije, Veuvin, thilgilou, thilgilou sehseh bou ahunge.
target: “This is what the Sovereign Lord says: “ ‘Disaster! Unheard-of disaster! See, it comes!

source: Achaina chu ahungin, achaina chu ahung lhungtan; hichun nangma navelhi jingin, ven, hichu ahung lhungtai.
target: The end has come! The end has come! It has roused itself against you. See, it comes!

source: Vo gamsunga cheng nangma, jingkah chun nahinphatan, phat chu ahung lhungtai; hamsetna nikho chu ahung naitai, molsang ho gin athongkit tapoi.
target: Doom has come upon you, upon you who dwell in the land. The time has come! The day is near! There is panic, not joy, on the mountains.

source: Tu-a chomlou kah-a nachunga kalungsatna kahinbuhlhah ding, chule kalunghana chu nachunga kamolso ding ahi. Chule keiman nalam lhah dungjuija nachunga thu katan ding, chule thet umtah nahinaho jouse jeh-a kalethuh ding nahi.
target: I am about to pour out my wrath on you and spend my anger against you. I will judge you according to your conduct and repay you for all your detestable practices.

source: Chule kamit nin nangma nakhehcha pontin, keiman khotona jong kanei louding ahi. Nalam lhah hole nalah tah uva thet umtah nahinaho dungjuija nangma kahinlethuh ding; chutengle nangman najepma chu Pakai keima kahi hi nahin hetding ahi.
target: I will not look on you with pity; I will not spare you. I will repay you for your conduct and for the detestable practices among you. “ ‘Then you will know that it is I the Lord who strikes you.

source: Vetan nikho chu, vetan ahunglhunga ahitai. Jingkah chu achemangtan; tenggol pahcha bangin apah lhatan, kiletsahna chu pahchamum bangin amum dohtai.
target: “ ‘See, the day! See, it comes! Doom has burst forth, the rod has budded, arrogance has blossomed!

source: Hunam nahi gitlouna tenggolin ahung umdoh tan; amaho khatcha umden loudiu, ahaona jouseu ahin, anei agou jouse jong khatcha umden louding; chujongle koiman amaho pul adou louding ahi.
target: Violence has arisen, a rod to punish the wicked. None of the people will be left, none of that crowd— none of their wealth, nothing of value.

source: Phat chu ahung lhungtan nikho chu ahung naitai. Thil chopa chu kipah hihhen, thil johpa jong lunghem hihhen; ajehchu amihonpiu chunga lunghanna chua ahitai.
target: The time has come! The day has arrived! Let not the buyer rejoice nor the seller grieve, for my wrath is on the whole crowd.

source: Ijeh-inem itile amaho hingnalai jongleu, ajohdohsao chu ahenguva hungkile kit louding ahi. Ajehchu gaothilmu hin amihonpiu jouse atongkha cheh-in, hichu kile kit louhel ding ahi; chujongle khan gitlouna-a hingjouse koima ama le ama thahat kipethei louding ahi.
target: The seller will not recover the property that was sold— as long as both buyer and seller live. For the vision concerning the whole crowd will not be reversed. Because of their sins, not one of them will preserve their life.

source: Amahon amijouse gotsa ahitheinan sumkon amut taovin; ahinla koimacha galmun jona chea aumpoi. Ajehchu kalunghana hi amihonpiu chunga chu chua ahitai.
target: “ ‘They have blown the trumpet, they have made all things ready, but no one will go into battle, for my wrath is on the whole crowd.

source: Chemjam chu polama aumin, natset le kellhah chu asunga aume; loujaova um chu chemjamin thintin, chule khopi sumga um chu kel le natsetna thiding ahi.
target: Outside is the sword; inside are plague and famine. Those in the country will die by the sword; those in the city will be devoured by famine and plague.

source: Ahinla alah uva kona jamdoh ho chu sohchao vintin, phaicham vakhuho banga molsang ho chunga umdiu, abonchauva amacheh khan gitlouna alunghempi diu ahi.
target: The fugitives who escape will flee to the mountains. Like doves of the valleys, they will all moan, each for their own sins.

source: Khut jouse chu ngoijin tin, chule khup jouse chu twi banga lhoplha ding ahi.
target: Every hand will go limp; every leg will be wet with urine.

source: Amahon khaodip pon jong akigah dingu, chule tijatnan atoma, amaiju jum-a, aluchanghou tolsoh ding ahi.
target: They will put on sackcloth and be clothed with terror. Every face will be covered with shame, and every head will be shaved.

source: Amahon adangka hou lamlena aselhah dingu, asana hou jong akiladoh dingu ahi. Pakai lunghanna nikho nile adangka houle asanahou chun amaho alhatdoh joulou dingu ahi. Hicheho chun ahinkhou jong alungkimsah joulou ding, a-oiju jong avasah joulou ding ahi. Ajehchu hicheho chu akhan gitlou naova akipalnao hija ahi.
target: “ ‘They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will be treated as a thing unclean. Their silver and gold will not be able to deliver them in the day of the Lord ’s wrath. It will not satisfy their hunger or fill their stomachs, for it has caused them to stumble into sin.

source: Akivona hoina dingun, amaho lultah in akijemun; ahinla hicheho-a chun akisuhboh nao amilimhou, chule kidah umtah thilho chu asemuve. Hijeh-a chu amaho-a kona kakoi gamlat ahi.
target: They took pride in their beautiful jewelry and used it to make their detestable idols. They made it into vile images; therefore I will make it a thing unclean for them.

source: Chule keiman hiche chu hetlou miho khutna kivahna dinga kapeh-a, chule leiset mikhang gilouho henga galthila kapeh ding; chule amahon hichu asuhboh dingu ahi.
target: I will give their wealth as plunder to foreigners and as loot to the wicked of the earth, who will defile it.

source: Kamai amaho-a kona kaheimang ding, chule amahon kamun theng chu ahinsuhboh dingu ahi. Ijeh inem itile gucha michomho hiche sunga chu lut uva, chule hichu asuhboh dingu ahi.
target: I will turn my face away from the people, and robbers will desecrate the place I treasure. They will enter it and will defile it.

source: Khaokol vuikhat semin, ijeh-inem itile gamsung chu thisan kisona gitlouna-in adiptan; chule khopi chu hunamin adiptai.
target: “ ‘Prepare chains! For the land is full of bloodshed, and the city is full of violence.

source: Hijeh-a chu keiman Pathen helou lah-a aphamopen chu kahinpui ding, amahon a-inhou chu alodiu, athahatnao kiloupisahna jong kasuhbei ding; chule amuntheng hou chu suhboh-a umding ahi.
target: I will bring the most wicked of nations to take possession of their houses. I will put an end to the pride of the mighty, and their sanctuaries will be desecrated.

source: Manthah na ahung lhungtai; amahon chamna ahinhol dingu, amavang chamna umlou helding ahi.
target: When terror comes, they will seek peace in vain.

source: Setna chunga setna hunglhung ding, chule thuthang chunga thuthang chuding; chuteng amahon themgao thilmu ahin holdingu; ahivanga danthu chu thempu-a kona, chule thumop chu upaho-a kona mangsoh ding ahitai.
target: Calamity upon calamity will come, and rumor upon rumor. They will go searching for a vision from the prophet, priestly instruction in the law will cease, the counsel of the elders will come to an end.

source: Lengpa chu lunghem ding, leng chapa jong manthah na-a kivon ding, chule gamsung mite khut ho chu ngoilha ding ahi. Keiman amaho achonnau dungjuija kabola, achan dinguva lom dungjuija athu-u katan ding; chuteng amahon keima Pakai kahi chu ahet dingu ahi.
target: The king will mourn, the prince will be clothed with despair, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. I will deal with them according to their conduct, and by their own standards I will judge them. “ ‘Then they will know that I am the Lord .’ ”

source: Chule kumgup channa, alhagup channa, chule hiche lhasung ninga nin, keima ka in sunga katouvin; chule Judah upaho ka-anga atou laijun, Pakai Pathen khut chu keima chunga ahung chun ahi.
target: In the sixth year, in the sixth month on the fifth day, while I was sitting in my house and the elders of Judah were sitting before me, the hand of the Sovereign Lord came on me there.

source: Hichun kaven ahile, veuvin, meikou limso bangjeng, akonga pat noilamse meikou; chule akonga pat chunglamse chu lhe lahlah-a a-engdum tobang vouso kamun ahi.
target: I looked, and I saw a figure like that of a man. From what appeared to be his waist down he was like fire, and from there up his appearance was as bright as glowing metal.

source: Chuin aman khutlim khat ahin lhahdoh-in, chule kaluchunga kasam lomkhatnin eimanin; chule lhagaovin leile van kah-a eidom touvin, Pathen gaothil musahna-a Jerusalem'a kotpi sungnungjo sahlam nga kotphung, thangthipna milim touna, thangthipna dinga lunghansahna touna chu eihin lhuttan ahi.
target: He stretched out what looked like a hand and took me by the hair of my head. The Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and in visions of God he took me to Jerusalem, to the entrance of the north gate of the inner court, where the idol that provokes to jealousy stood.

source: Chule veuvin, phaichama gaothilmu kamu dungjuijin, Israel Pathen loupi chamkimna chu hia chun anaume.
target: And there before me was the glory of the God of Israel, as in the vision I had seen in the plain.

source: Hichun aman kahenga, Mihem chapa, tun sahlam ngan gakhodah-in, eiti. Hitichun keima sahlam ngan kagakhodah-in ahile, veuvin, maicham kotpi sahlam pang lutna-a chun thangthipna milim aume.
target: Then he said to me, “Son of man, look toward the north.” So I looked, and in the entrance north of the gate of the altar I saw this idol of jealousy.

source: Aman kahenga aseibe kitnin, Mihem chapa, hiche hohin ipi abolu ahi namu em? Kamunthenga kona kagamlat nadinga Israel insungin nasatah-a thet um hilai mun'a aboluhi? Ahinla nangma gakihei kit nin, chutile nangman thet umcheh namukit ding ahi, ati.
target: And he said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they are doing—the utterly detestable things the Israelites are doing here, things that will drive me far from my sanctuary? But you will see things that are even more detestable.”

source: Chuin aman keima hongsung kotna chun eihin puijin, chuin keiman kagahven ahile, veuvin, banga chun ahom khat anaume.
target: Then he brought me to the entrance to the court. I looked, and I saw a hole in the wall.

source: Chujouvin aman kahenga, Mihem chapa, bang chu lai temin eitin; chuin bang chu kalaija ahile, kotkhah kamu doh-e.
target: He said to me, “Son of man, now dig into the wall.” So I dug into the wall and saw a doorway there.

source: Chuin aman kahenga, Lutnin, chule hikoma chun khangitlouna thet umtah abolu chu gaven eiti.
target: And he said to me, “Go in and see the wicked and detestable things they are doing here.”

source: Hitichun keima kalutnin ahile, a-opma kithol ganhing jouse, chule thet umtah gamsaho, Israel insung semthu milimho akimvela bangho-a jihtho-a aum chu kagamun ahi.
target: So I went in and looked, and I saw portrayed all over the walls all kinds of crawling things and unclean animals and all the idols of Israel.

source: Chule amaho anga chun malaija Israel insungmi pasal somsagi hochu adinguvin, chule amaho lailung tah-a chun Shaphan chapa Jaazaniah chu adingin, mitinin akhutna ama lhengcheh akichoijun; chule gimnamtui meikhulom satah chu chunglama akal touve.
target: In front of them stood seventy elders of Israel, and Jaazaniah son of Shaphan was standing among them. Each had a censer in his hand, and a fragrant cloud of incense was rising.

source: Chujouvin aman kahenga hitin seije, Mihem chapa, malaija Israel insung miten muthim lah-a ipi abol, chule mitinin ama ama lunggelna indan sunga ipi abolu namu em? Ajehchu amahon, Pakaiyin eimupouve, Pakaiyin leiset adalhatai atiuve.
target: He said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of Israel are doing in the darkness, each at the shrine of his own idol? They say, ‘The Lord does not see us; the Lord has forsaken the land.’ ”

source: Chule aman kahenga hitin jong aseije, Gah kiheikit tadin, chutile amaho thilbol thet umjocheh namu ding ahi, ati.
target: Again, he said, “You will see them doing things that are even more detestable.”

source: Chujouvin aman keima Pakai in kotpi sahlampang nga-ah kotna chun eihin puitan; chule veuvin, hia chun Tammuz dinga kap numei ho anatouvun ahi.
target: Then he brought me to the entrance of the north gate of the house of the Lord , and I saw women sitting there, mourning the god Tammuz.

source: Chujouvin aman kahenga aseijin, Vo mihem chapa, nangman hichehi namunah em? Nangma gakihei kitle chun hicheho sanga thet umjocheh namu ding ahi, ati.
target: He said to me, “Do you see this, son of man? You will see things that are even more detestable than this.”

source: Chuin aman Pakai indan sungnungjoa eipui lutnin ahile, veuvin, Pakai houin kotphung, hongcha le maicham kikah-a chun mi somni le nga, Pakai houin nung ngatna, amaiju solam ngacheh aumu vin; amahon solam ngan nisa ahouvun ahi.
target: He then brought me into the inner court of the house of the Lord , and there at the entrance to the temple, between the portico and the altar, were about twenty-five men. With their backs toward the temple of the Lord and their faces toward the east, they were bowing down to the sun in the east.

source: Chujouvin aman kahenga aseije, Vo mihem chapa, hichehi namutah em? Judah insungin hilai mun'a abolu thet umtahho hi thil neocha hintem? Ijeh inem itile amahon gamsung hi hunam adiptauvin, chule amaho keima phinse-a lunghansah din ahung kileuve. Ven, amahon abah chu anahkuiju toh asutouve.
target: He said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a trivial matter for the people of Judah to do the detestable things they are doing here? Must they also fill the land with violence and continually arouse my anger? Look at them putting the branch to their nose!

source: Hijeh-a chu kenjong lungsa tah-a kabol ding; kamitna jong kadeplou ding, hejong kahepi louding; chule amaho awsang tah-in kana benga kap jongleu, kangaipeh dehlou dingu ahi, ati.
target: Therefore I will deal with them in anger; I will not look on them with pity or spare them. Although they shout in my ears, I will not listen to them.”

source: Aman kana benga aw sangtah-in asamin, Khopi dunga thunei ho chu hinnailut sah-in, chule amitakipmin akhutna suhsetna amanchah cheh kichoihen, ati.
target: Then I heard him call out in a loud voice, “Bring near those who are appointed to execute judgment on the city, each with a weapon in his hand.”

source: Chule, veuvin, sahlam panga um kotpi sangjo lama konin mi gup ahunguvin, amitinin akhutnuva mithana manchah achoijun; chule amaho lah-a khat chu tupat ponin akivonin, chule apanga lekha jihho lekhatwi thei khat akikhaije. Chuin amaho achelutnun, sum eng maicham koma adingun ahi.
target: And I saw six men coming from the direction of the upper gate, which faces north, each with a deadly weapon in his hand. With them was a man clothed in linen who had a writing kit at his side. They came in and stood beside the bronze altar.

source: Chule Cherub chunga um Israel Pathen loupina chu kotphung geijin akitol toutan ahi. Chuin aman tupatpon kivon apanga lekha jihho lekhatwi thei khai mipa chu agah kouvin;
target: Now the glory of the God of Israel went up from above the cherubim, where it had been, and moved to the threshold of the temple. Then the Lord called to the man clothed in linen who had the writing kit at his side

source: Chuin Pakai chun ama henga hitin aseije, Khopi lailung, Jerusalem lailung jotpaijin lang, alah uva thet umtah kibol jeh-a khoisa-a kap ho dehpanga melchihna nata ding ahi, ati.
target: and said to him, “Go throughout the city of Jerusalem and put a mark on the foreheads of those who grieve and lament over all the detestable things that are done in it.”

source: Chule keima jah dingin adangho henga aseijin, khopi sunga chun amanung juijun lang, nakhut lha uvin, chule namitnun demchah hih-un, khotona jong neihih un, ati.
target: As I listened, he said to the others, “Follow him through the city and kill, without showing pity or compassion.

source: Ateh akhang, numei ho le chapang neoho, chule nupiho thatgam keijun, ahinla koihile achunga melchihna umchan chu ganai hih-un; chule kamunthenga konhin panjengun, ati. Hichun amahon inmaija um tehse ho-a chun apanpai jeng taove.
target: Slaughter the old men, the young men and women, the mothers and children, but do not touch anyone who has the mark. Begin at my sanctuary.” So they began with the old men who were in front of the temple.

source: Chuin aman amaho henga, In chu suboh unlang, hongsungho chu akithat ho-a chun dipmun; chule nangho kondoh-un, ati. Chuin amaho akondoh-un, khopi sunga miho chu athat taove.
target: Then he said to them, “Defile the temple and fill the courts with the slain. Go!” So they went out and began killing throughout the city.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, amahon amaho atha laitah-un, keima kahoidohtan, hitichun keima kaboh khupmin kalhun, kapengin, kaseije, O Pakai Pathen, Jerusalem chunga nalungsatna nasunlhah na-a hi, Israel lah-a amohho jouse jonghi nasuhmang sohding hitam? kati.
target: While they were killing and I was left alone, I fell facedown, crying out, “Alas, Sovereign Lord ! Are you going to destroy the entire remnant of Israel in this outpouring of your wrath on Jerusalem?”

source: Hichun aman kahenga, Israel le Judah insung khan gitlounahi alen valtai, chule gamsung thisan adimin, khopisung khelna-in adimtan ahi. Ajehchu amahon, Pakaiyin leiset adalhatai, chule Pakaiyin amutapoi, atiuve, tin aseije.
target: He answered me, “The sin of the people of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great; the land is full of bloodshed and the city is full of injustice. They say, ‘The Lord has forsaken the land; the Lord does not see.’

source: Kei hijong leng, kamitnin adepchah lou ding, khotona jong keiman kaneilou ding, akiman chahnao alu chunguva kalethuh ding ahi.
target: So I will not look on them with pity or spare them, but I will bring down on their own heads what they have done.”

source: Chule, veuvin, tupat pon kivon, apanga lekha jihho lakhatwi thei khai mipa chun, athu chu keima neithupeh bangin kaboltai, tin alhut tai.
target: Then the man in linen with the writing kit at his side brought back word, saying, “I have done as you commanded.”

source: Chujouvin keiman kagahven ahile, Cherub ho luchunga um vanthamjol lah-a chun, khisong dumjet laltouna lhehlheh khat aume.
target: I looked, and I saw the likeness of a throne of lapis lazuli above the vault that was over the heads of the cherubim.

source: Chule amapa chun tupat pona kivon mipa jah-a chun thu aseijin, chule hitin ati, Cherub noitah-a kangtalai kangho kikah-a chun chelutnin, chule Cherub ho kah-a konin songmeihol nakhut dimsetnin hamdoh-in lang, hicheho chu khopi chunga gathe jah-in, ati. Chuin amapa chu kamuta-in achelut tai.
target: The Lord said to the man clothed in linen, “Go in among the wheels beneath the cherubim. Fill your hands with burning coals from among the cherubim and scatter them over the city.” And as I watched, he went in.

source: Tun mipa achelut phatnin Cherub ho chu chuche in jetlam panga chun adingtauvin; chule inhong sungnung chu meilom'in adimtai.
target: Now the cherubim were standing on the south side of the temple when the man went in, and a cloud filled the inner court.

source: Chuin Pakai loupina chu Cherub'a kon chun akaltouvin, chule in lutna kotchunga chun adingtan; chule a-in chu meilom adimin, chule ahongsung chu Pakai loupina vah chun alosohtai.
