target: Then the glory of the Lord rose from above the cherubim and moved to the threshold of the temple. The cloud filled the temple, and the court was full of the radiance of the glory of the Lord .

source: Chule Cherub ho lhaving gin chu Hat chungnung Pathen'in thu aseitenga a-awgin bangin, in ponung geijin akijan ahi.
target: The sound of the wings of the cherubim could be heard as far away as the outer court, like the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.

source: Chule Cherub hole kangtalai kang kikah-a kona mei-am galan tia tupat ponnema kivonpa henga thu apeh chun ahitin ahi; chujouvin ama alutnin kangtalai kangho koma chun agadingtai.
target: When the Lord commanded the man in linen, “Take fire from among the wheels, from among the cherubim,” the man went in and stood beside a wheel.

source: Chuin Cherub khatnin, Cherub ho kahlah-a kon chun Cherub ho kahlah-a um meikou lama chun akhut ahinlhang doh-in, chuin hichu alan, chule tupat ponnema kivon mipa khutna akoijin ahile, amapan hichu alan achedohtai.
target: Then one of the cherubim reached out his hand to the fire that was among them. He took up some of it and put it into the hands of the man in linen, who took it and went out.

source: Chuin hiche Cherub ho lhaving noija chun mihem khut tobang khat ahungdohtan ahi.
target: (Under the wings of the cherubim could be seen what looked like human hands.)

source: Chule keiman kagahvet phatnin, veuvin, Cherub ho panga chun kangtalai kang li, Cherub khat panga kangtalai kang khat, chule Cherub dang khat panga kangtalai kang dang khat aume. Chule hiche kangtalai kang ho limdan chu khisong engdumtoh abangin ahi.
target: I looked, and I saw beside the cherubim four wheels, one beside each of the cherubim; the wheels sparkled like topaz.

source: Chule kangtalai kangho limso dan chu, aliuvin kibahna khat aneijuve, hichu kangtalai kang khat lailung tah-a kangtalai kang khat kibut abangin ahi.
target: As for their appearance, the four of them looked alike; each was like a wheel intersecting a wheel.

source: Amaho ache tengule amaho apang li in acheuvin; amaho achepumun akiheile pouve, amavang aluchangun avetna lama lamu amahon ajuijuvin; amaho achepumun akiheile pouve.
target: As they moved, they would go in any one of the four directions the cherubim faced; the wheels did not turn about as the cherubim went. The cherubim went in whatever direction the head faced, without turning as they went.

source: Chule amaho tahsa pumpi, atungtunhou, akhuthou, alhavinghou, chule kangtalai kang, chule ali uva aneiju kangtalai kangho geijin akimveluchu mitjeng adimsetnin ahi.
target: Their entire bodies, including their backs, their hands and their wings, were completely full of eyes, as were their four wheels.

source: Kangtalai kangho chu ahile, keima jah in, Vo kangtalai kang tin akisame.
target: I heard the wheels being called “the whirling wheels.”

source: Chule khatcheh in mai li aneijuvin; mai masa chu Cherub mai, mai nina chu mihem mai, chule athumna chu keipi bahkai mai ahin, chule alina chu mulaopi mai ahi.
target: Each of the cherubim had four faces: One face was that of a cherub, the second the face of a human being, the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

source: Chuin Cherub ho chu dopsangin aumtaove. Hiche ganhing hi Chebar vadunglen panga kanamu chu ahi.
target: Then the cherubim rose upward. These were the living creatures I had seen by the Kebar River.

source: Chule Cherub ho chu acheteng kangtalai kangho chun amaho ajuijuve; chule Cherub hon leisetna kon kaltouving tia alhavinghou adoptou tengule, hiche kangtalai kangho jonghi amaho panga konin akiheile pouve.
target: When the cherubim moved, the wheels beside them moved; and when the cherubim spread their wings to rise from the ground, the wheels did not leave their side.

source: Amaho adin tengule hicheho adinguvin, chule amaho dopsanga aum tengule, hicheho jonghi amahole amaho akidomsang jiuve. Ajehchu ganhing lhagao chu amaho sunga uma ahi.
target: When the cherubim stood still, they also stood still; and when the cherubim rose, they rose with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in them.

source: Chujouvin Pakai loupina chu chuche in kotphunga kon chun achemangin Cherub ho chunga agadingtai.
target: Then the glory of the Lord departed from over the threshold of the temple and stopped above the cherubim.

source: Chuin kamitmu tah-in Cherub hon alhavinghou adomsangun, leisetna konin akaltou taove. Amaho achedoh phat chun kangtalai kangho jong apanguva abeh-in, chule khatcheh chu Pakai in solam kotpi phunga adingcheh uvin; chule Israel Pathen loupina chu amaho chunga aume.
target: While I watched, the cherubim spread their wings and rose from the ground, and as they went, the wheels went with them. They stopped at the entrance of the east gate of the Lord ’s house, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.

source: Hichehi ganhing, Israel Pathen noija Chebar vadunglen panga keiman kanamu chu ahi. Chule amaho chu Cherubim ahi ti kahei.
target: These were the living creatures I had seen beneath the God of Israel by the Kebar River, and I realized that they were cherubim.

source: Khatcheh in mai li aneicheh uvin, chule khatcheh in lhaving li aneicheh-un, chule alhavinghou noija mihem khut tobang aumcheh-e.
target: Each had four faces and four wings, and under their wings was what looked like human hands.

source: Chule amaisou hung kilah chu Chebar vadunglen panga kamu tobang maiso mama chu ahin, chule amaho malama jangpetnin ache cheh uve.
target: Their faces had the same appearance as those I had seen by the Kebar River. Each one went straight ahead.

source: Chukalvalin lhagaovin keima eidom touvin, chule Pakai in solam kotpi, solam maingatna chun eilhuttai. Chule veuvin, kotpi kotphunga chun mi somni le nga aumin, amaho lah-a chun keiman mipi ho pipui Azur chapa Jaazaniah chule Benaiah chapa Pelatiah chu kamun ahi.
target: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the gate of the house of the Lord that faces east. There at the entrance of the gate were twenty-five men, and I saw among them Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.

source: Hichun aman kajah-a aseijin, Mihem chapa, amahohi thilphalou gong miho, chule hiche khopi sunga thil gilou thumop leho chu ahiuve.
target: The Lord said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who are plotting evil and giving wicked advice in this city.

source: Amahohin, phat chu anai hihlaije, eihon inho satadiu hite, hiche khopihi khangbel len chu ahin, chule eiho asaphe chu hiuhite, atiuve.
target: They say, ‘Haven’t our houses been recently rebuilt? This city is a pot, and we are the meat in it.’

source: Hijeh chun amaho dounan gaovin, Vo mihem chapa, gaovin, ati.
target: Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, son of man.”

source: Chuin Pakai lhagao chu kachunga ahungchun, chule kajah-a aseijin, Seijin; Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Vo Israel insung, nanghon hitihin naseitaove; ajehchu keiman nalung sunguva hunglut thil chu abonin kahesoh keijin ahi.
target: Then the Spirit of the Lord came on me, and he told me to say: “This is what the Lord says: That is what you are saying, you leaders in Israel, but I know what is going through your mind.

source: Nanghon khopi sunga mihem tampi nathat taovin, chule nanghon khosung lamlen jouse mithi nadip taove.
target: You have killed many people in this city and filled its streets with the dead.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; Nanghon namitha hou khopi lailung tah-a nalupsah hou chu sa chu ahiuvin, hiche khopi hi khangbel len chu ahi. Ahivangin keiman hiche lahtah-a kona nangho kapuidohtei ding nahiuve.
target: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: The bodies you have thrown there are the meat and this city is the pot, but I will drive you out of it.

source: Nanghon chemjam chu nakichaove; chule keiman nangho chunga chemjam khat kahin chuhsah ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: You fear the sword, and the sword is what I will bring against you, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Chule keiman hiche lailung tah-a kona nangho kapuidoh ding, chule nangho hetlou miho khutna kapeh doh-a, chule nalah uva thu katan ding ahi.
target: I will drive you out of the city and deliver you into the hands of foreigners and inflict punishment on you.

source: Nangho chemjam'a nalou dingu; keiman Israel gamgi-a nathu katan ding, chule nanghon keima Pakai chu kahi ti nahet dingu ahi.
target: You will fall by the sword, and I will execute judgment on you at the borders of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

source: Hiche khopihi nangho khangbel chu hilouhel ding, alailungtah-a sa jong chu nangho nahilouhel dingu ahi; amavang Israel gamgi-a nachung thu katan ding ahi.
target: This city will not be a pot for you, nor will you be the meat in it; I will execute judgment on you at the borders of Israel.

source: Chule nanghon keima Pakai chu kahi ti nahet dingu ahi. Ajehchu nangho kadan kisun ho-a nache tapouvin, kathutanho jong natongdih pouvin, ahinla Pathen helou nakimvel uva umho umdan bangin nanghon naboljo taove, ati.
target: And you will know that I am the Lord , for you have not followed my decrees or kept my laws but have conformed to the standards of the nations around you.”

source: Chuin ahung hitin ahi, keiman gaothu kasei petnin, Benaiah chapa Pelatiah chu athitai. Chuin kalhun kamai tolla kasulutnin, aw gingtah-in ka pengin, Ohe Pakai Pathen, nangman Israel ho lah-a ahingdoh amoh hohi nasuh manghel jeng ding hitam! tin kaseije.
target: Now as I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. Then I fell facedown and cried out in a loud voice, “Alas, Sovereign Lord ! Will you completely destroy the remnant of Israel?”

source: Pakai thu chu keima henga ahung kitnin, hitin ati,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, nasopi ho, nasopi ho mongmong, na-insung miho, chule Israel insung pumpi jouse chungchanga hi ahi Jerusalem'a cheng miten, Nangho Pakaiya konin gamlaovin: hiche gamhi keiho lodinga eikipeuva ahi, tia aseina chu ahi.
target: “Son of man, the people of Jerusalem have said of your fellow exiles and all the other Israelites, ‘They are far away from the Lord ; this land was given to us as our possession.’

source: Hijeh chun seijin, Pakai Pathen'in aseije; Keiman amaho gamlatah-a Pathen helou miho lah-a lehdoh jengjong leng, chule keiman amaho gamdang danga thecheh jengjong leng, alhunao gamho-a chu amaho dinga keima muntheng neokhat tobang kahiding ahi.
target: “Therefore say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Although I sent them far away among the nations and scattered them among the countries, yet for a little while I have been a sanctuary for them in the countries where they have gone.’

source: Hijeh chun seijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; keiman nangho mipi ho lah-a kona kachopkhom dingu, nakithe chehnao gamsungho-a kon kapuikhom dingu, chule keiman Israel gam chu nangho kapeh dingu ahi.
target: “Therefore say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will gather you from the nations and bring you back from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you back the land of Israel again.’

source: Chule amaho khulama hungdingu, chule amahon hichea kona chu, chua um ningset umtah thilho jousele thet umtahho chu alahdoh dingu ahi.
target: “They will return to it and remove all its vile images and detestable idols.

source: Chule keiman amaho chu lungthim khat kapeh ding, chule nasunguva lhagao thah khat kakoipeh dingu; chule keiman atahsaova kona song banga tah alungchangu chu kalah doh-a, chule amaho chu tahsa phe-a kasem lungchang kapeh ding ahi.
target: I will give them an undivided heart and put a new spirit in them; I will remove from them their heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh.

source: Chutia chu amahon kadan kisun ho ajuijuva, kachonna danho anitdiu, chule hicheho chu anatoh-a atohdoh dingu; chutengle amaho chu kamite hiuva, keima amaho Pathen kahi ding ahi.
target: Then they will follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

source: Ahinla ningset umtah le thet umtah thil ho lama alungu chesahho vang chu, keiman aluchung cheh uva achenau lampi chu kalethuh ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: But as for those whose hearts are devoted to their vile images and detestable idols, I will bring down on their own heads what they have done, declares the Sovereign Lord .”

source: Chujouvin Cherub ho chun alhavinghou ajah touvun, chule kangtalai kangho apanguva abeh-in; chule Israel Pathen loupina chu amaho chungvuma aume.
target: Then the cherubim, with the wheels beside them, spread their wings, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.

source: Chuin Pakai loupina chu khopi lailung tah-a kon chun achetouvin; chule khopi solama um molsang chunga chun adingtan ahi.
target: The glory of the Lord went up from within the city and stopped above the mountain east of it.

source: Hiche nunghin lhagao chun eilatouvin, chule gaothil muna-in Pathen lhagaovin Chaldea gama gal hinga kikaiho henga eipuitan ahi. Hitichun keiman thilmu kanamu chu keija konin achetoutai.
target: The Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the exiles in Babylonia in the vision given by the Spirit of God. Then the vision I had seen went up from me,

source: Chuin keiman Pakaiyin eimusah thilho jouse chu gal hinga kikaiho henga kaseisoh keijin ahi.
target: and I told the exiles everything the Lord had shown me.

source: Pakai thu jong kahenga ahungin, hitin aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, nangma kiphinjing insung lahtah-a chenga nahi; amahon mun'a ding mit aneijun, amuthei pouvin; jahna ding kol aneijun, ajathei pouve; ajehchu amaho kiphinjing insung ahiuve.
target: “Son of man, you are living among a rebellious people. They have eyes to see but do not see and ears to hear but do not hear, for they are a rebellious people.

source: Hijeh chun mihem chapa, nakichon doh nadingin nathilkeo kigon tupmin, chule amaho mitmun sunlai tah-in kichondoh-in; chule nangma naumna mun'a kona munchom dang khatna amaho mitmu-a nakichon doh ding ahi. Amaho thungailou insung hijongleu, angaito maithei dingu ahi.
target: “Therefore, son of man, pack your belongings for exile and in the daytime, as they watch, set out and go from where you are to another place. Perhaps they will understand, though they are a rebellious people.

source: Chujouteng nangman sunlai tah-a nathilkeuho chu amaho mitmu tah-a kichondohna thilkeu banga nahinpoh ding; chule nangma amaho mitmu tah-a nilhah tahle gal hinga kikailut ho che banga nachedoh ding ahi.
target: During the daytime, while they watch, bring out your belongings packed for exile. Then in the evening, while they are watching, go out like those who go into exile.

source: Nangman amaho mitmu tah-a bang chu natuh vang paiding, chule chutia chu napohdoh ding ahi.
target: While they watch, dig through the wall and take your belongings out through it.

source: Amaho mitmu tah-a nangman hichu nalengkou teni chunga napoh-a, chule hichu khomu chipchet tahle napohdoh ding, tol namuthei louna dinga nangman namai nakikhu ding ahi; ajehchu keiman Israel insung dinga melchihna khatna katun nahitai, ati.
target: Put them on your shoulder as they are watching and carry them out at dusk. Cover your face so that you cannot see the land, for I have made you a sign to the Israelites.”

source: Chuin keiman eikithupeh bangin kaboltai, keiman sunlaitah in kathilkeoho chu gal hinga kikaiho thilkeo bangin kahin podoh tan, chule nilhah lamin kakhut tah-in bang chu katuvang paijin, keiman hichu khomut chipchep nin kapodoh-in, amaho mitmu tah-in kalengkou chunga kapun ahi.
target: So I did as I was commanded. During the day I brought out my things packed for exile. Then in the evening I dug through the wall with my hands. I took my belongings out at dusk, carrying them on my shoulders while they watched.

source: Chuin jingkah in Pakai thu kahenga ahung lhungin, hitin ati,
target: In the morning the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Israel insung thungailou insung chun nahenga, Ipi nabol ham tia asei hilouham?
target: “Son of man, did not the Israelites, that rebellious people, ask you, ‘What are you doing?’

source: Amaho henga nangman hitin seijin, Hitihin Pakai Pathen'in aseije; hiche pohgih hi Jerusalem vaipopa le, amaho lah-a um Israel insung pumpi vetsahna ahi.
target: “Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: This prophecy concerns the prince in Jerusalem and all the Israelites who are there.’

source: Seijin, keima nangho dinga melchihna kahin; keiman kabol banga amaho henga jong kabolding ahi. Amaho chondoh-in umuntin, chule sohchang dinga cheding ahiuve.
target: Say to them, ‘I am a sign to you.’ “As I have done, so it will be done to them. They will go into exile as captives.

source: Chule alah uva leng chapa chun khomut chipchep tengle athilkeoho alengkouva aputna chedoh ding; amahon hicheho chu pohdohna dinga bang chu atuhvangpai dingu; ama chun amitna tol amu theilouna dinga amai akikhu ding ahi.
target: “The prince among them will put his things on his shoulder at dusk and leave, and a hole will be dug in the wall for him to go through. He will cover his face so that he cannot see the land.

source: Keiman kalen jong achunga kajal ding, chule ama chu kathangkola ohding; chule keiman ama chu Chaldea mite gam Babylon kalhut ding; chukoma chu ama thi ding, hijongle hichu amulou ding ahi.
target: I will spread my net for him, and he will be caught in my snare; I will bring him to Babylonia, the land of the Chaldeans, but he will not see it, and there he will die.

source: Chule keiman ama panpi dinga ama kimvela umho jousele, ama galsat mihon ho chu hui nunna channa kathecheh ding; chule keiman amaho chemjam'a kanungdel ding ahi.
target: I will scatter to the winds all those around him—his staff and all his troops—and I will pursue them with drawn sword.

source: Chule keiman amaho namtin lah-a kathecheh-a, chule gamsungho-a kasuhcheh tengle, amahon keima Pakai kahi chu akihet dingu ahi.
target: “They will know that I am the Lord , when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

source: Ahijeng vanga amahon agalhun nahou Pathen helouho lah-a thet umtah ahinahou akiphondoh theina dinguva, keiman amaho lah-a themkhat chemjam'a kona, kella kona, chule hise-a kona kakhendoh ding; chule amahon keima Pakai kahi ahin het dingu ahi.
target: But I will spare a few of them from the sword, famine and plague, so that in the nations where they go they may acknowledge all their detestable practices. Then they will know that I am the Lord .”

source: Chukalvalin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa na-anneh chu kihot pumpumin nenlang, natwi chu kithing thingpumin, chingthei tah-in donin;
target: “Son of man, tremble as you eat your food, and shudder in fear as you drink your water.

source: Chule gamsung mipi ho henga seijin, Jerusalem le Israel gamsunga chengho Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; agam sunguva chengho jouse hunam thilbol jeh-a, asunga chengjouse-a kona kamhela aumtheina dinguva; a-anneh-u chingthei tah-a aneh dingu, chule atuiju kidangsa tah-a adon dingu ahi.
target: Say to the people of the land: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says about those living in Jerusalem and in the land of Israel: They will eat their food in anxiety and drink their water in despair, for their land will be stripped of everything in it because of the violence of all who live there.

source: Chule mihem chenna khopiho chu manlou sohding, chule gamsung chu kamhel ding; chule nanghon keima Pakai kahi chu nahet dingu ahi.
target: The inhabited towns will be laid waste and the land will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the Lord .’ ”

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, nanghon Israel gamsunga naneiju thuchih, Nikhoho chu akisaosah-in, chule thilmu jouse athontai, tia kiseija chu ipi kiseina ham?
target: “Son of man, what is this proverb you have in the land of Israel: ‘The days go by and every vision comes to nothing’?

source: Hijeh chun amaho chu seipeh-in, Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; Keiman hiche thuchih hi kasuhbei ding, chule amahon hichehi Israel sunga thuchih-a amankit tah loudiu ahitai; amavang, Nikhoho ahung naijin, gaothilmu jouse ahung guilhungtai, tin amaho seipeh-in.
target: Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am going to put an end to this proverb, and they will no longer quote it in Israel.’ Say to them, ‘The days are near when every vision will be fulfilled.

source: Ajehchu pannabei gaothilmu le joule nala Pathen thu kisei kiti himhim chu Israel insunga umkit talou ding ahi.
target: For there will be no more false visions or flattering divinations among the people of Israel.

source: Ajehchu keima Pakai kahin; keiman kaseiding, chule keiman kaseidoh ding thuho chu hung guilhungtei ding; hichu geisang louding ahitai. Ajehchu vo kiphinhat insung, nangho nikho sunga hi keiman athu chu kaseiding, chule hichu katohdoh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: But I the Lord will speak what I will, and it shall be fulfilled without delay. For in your days, you rebellious people, I will fulfill whatever I say, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ ”

source: Pakai thu chu avelin kahenga ahungin, hitin ati,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, ven, Israel insung miten hitin aseijuve, Amapan gaova thil amuho ahunglhun nading nikho tampi avat nalaije, chule khonung peh-a hung guilhung ding thua gaothu aseimasah ahibouve, atiuve.
target: “Son of man, the Israelites are saying, ‘The vision he sees is for many years from now, and he prophesies about the distant future.’

source: Hijeh chun amaho henga seipeh-in, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, kathuho khatchabeh jong kisuhsaobe louding, amavang keiman kaseidoh thu chu tohdoh-a umding ahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: “Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: None of my words will be delayed any longer; whatever I say will be fulfilled, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ ”

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, hitin ati,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Gaothu seija Israel themgaoho, amaho lungdei deija gaothu seidoh ho dounan gaothu hitihin seijin, Nanghon Pakai thu chu ngaijun;
target: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who are now prophesying. Say to those who prophesy out of their own imagination: ‘Hear the word of the Lord !

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije, Ohe, ama lhagao lunggela chonna chule ima muneilou themgao ngol hochu ada nahiuve!
target: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own spirit and have seen nothing!

source: Vo Israel, nathemgao ho vang neldi gama sial ho bangbep ahiuve.
target: Your prophets, Israel, are like jackals among ruins.

source: Nangho a-onglaiho-a nachetou pouvin, chujongle Pakai nikho tengle galkisatna-a Israel insunga din theinadin tho nakai pouve.
target: You have not gone up to the breaches in the wall to repair it for the people of Israel so that it will stand firm in the battle on the day of the Lord .

source: Amahon pannabei amuvin, jouva aisan ahiuvin, Pakaiyin aseije, atiuve: ahinla Pakaiyin amaho asolpoi. Chule amahon athusei houchu kisudet ding ahi tin midangho akinepsah uve.
target: Their visions are false and their divinations a lie. Even though the Lord has not sent them, they say, “The Lord declares,” and expect him to fulfill their words.

source: Nanghon pannabei gaothil namu-u hilou ham? Chule nanghon jouva aisan nathu nanaseileu hilouham? Nanghon hichu Pakaiyin aseije nati uvin; ahinla keiman kanaseipoi.
target: Have you not seen false visions and uttered lying divinations when you say, “The Lord declares,” though I have not spoken?

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, nanghon pannabei nana seijuvin, chule jouthu jeng namu uve; veuvin, hijeh-a chu keima nang hotoh kidouva kahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because of your false words and lying visions, I am against you, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Chule kakhut hi pannabei jeng mu-a themgaoho chungle jouva aisanho chunga kachuhsah ding ahi. Amaho chu kamite kiloikhomna-a lhalou dingu, Israel insung kisutna-a jong amahohi kisun loudingu, chule Israel gamsunga jong lutlou dingu ahi; chutengle nanghon keima Pakai Pathen kahi nahetdoh dingu ahi.
target: My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and utter lying divinations. They will not belong to the council of my people or be listed in the records of Israel, nor will they enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Sovereign Lord .

source: Ajehchu amahon kamite chu chamna aume tin ajoulhep mun, ahin chamna aumpon; chule khatnin bang khat atungdoh-in, chule ven, adanghon hichu chilminlou leingan nin aloijol uve.
target: “ ‘Because they lead my people astray, saying, “Peace,” when there is no peace, and because, when a flimsy wall is built, they cover it with whitewash,

source: Chilminlou leingana loijol ho henga seipeh-in, Hichu lhutei ding ahi; gohong longlet hela hung juding; chule, O gelchanglen ho, nangho nahung lhah dingu; chule hichu huipi leh gopin asuhtel ding ahi.
target: therefore tell those who cover it with whitewash that it is going to fall. Rain will come in torrents, and I will send hailstones hurtling down, and violent winds will burst forth.

source: Ven, bang chu ahunglhuh tengle, chilminlou leingana naloi bang chu hoilamba hitam? tia kiseilou dingham?
target: When the wall collapses, will people not ask you, “Where is the whitewash you covered it with?”

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Keiman kalungsatna-a hichu gopi leh huipi-a kasuhchim ding ahin; hiche suhmangna dinga chu kalunghana gohong juh-a longlet hela juding; chule kalungsatna gelchang lentah ho-a juding ahi.
target: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: In my wrath I will unleash a violent wind, and in my anger hailstones and torrents of rain will fall with destructive fury.

source: Hitia chu nanghon chilminlou leingana naloijolu bang chu kasuhchim ding akitunna chu holdoh-a aumna dinga hichu toltoh kasuhmat ding, chule hichu lhutei ding, chule hicheho lah-a chu nangho suhmanga naum dingu ahi. Chutengle nanghon keima Pakai kahi nahet dingu ahi.
target: I will tear down the wall you have covered with whitewash and will level it to the ground so that its foundation will be laid bare. When it falls, you will be destroyed in it; and you will know that I am the Lord .

source: Chutia chu chuche bang chungle, chilminlou leingana loijol ho chunga chu kalunghana kasuhbulhit ding, chule nangho jah-a, Bang chu aumtapoi, chule chuche loijol ho jong chu aumtapoi, tia kasei ding ahi.
target: So I will pour out my wrath against the wall and against those who covered it with whitewash. I will say to you, “The wall is gone and so are those who whitewashed it,

source: Hicheho chu Jerusalem chung chang gaothu seija themgaoho le, chamna umlou petna amanu dinga chamna gaothil mupehho themgaoho ahiuve, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: those prophets of Israel who prophesied to Jerusalem and saw visions of peace for her when there was no peace, declares the Sovereign Lord .” ’

source: Chutobangma chun nangma mihem chapa, namite chanute lam nganlang amaho lungdei lama gaothu seiho dounan amaho chunga gaothu seijin,
target: “Now, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy out of their own imagination. Prophesy against them

source: Chule Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije tin seipeh-in, Sangkhol tinchenga mitpheldoi khao kikhuibeh ho, mihem hinna sumang dinga kisalel milen tahtah ho delkop khuipeh numei ho, ada nahiuve! Nangho kamite lhagao chu nadel lele uva, naheng uva hunga lhagaoho chu nahinghoi diuham?
target: and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Woe to the women who sew magic charms on all their wrists and make veils of various lengths for their heads in order to ensnare people. Will you ensnare the lives of my people but preserve your own?

source: Chule nanghon kamite lah-a sakolchang khutdim khat, chule changlhah pheng halkhatna athilouding hinnaho thana dingle, ahing louding hinnaho huhdohna dinga, kamiteho najouseiju jaho henga, najou thu-u seija suhboh ding neigot-u ham?
target: You have profaned me among my people for a few handfuls of barley and scraps of bread. By lying to my people, who listen to lies, you have killed those who should not have died and have spared those who should not live.

source: Chuti ahi jehchun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Veuvin, nanghon hinnaho lenmang sah nadinga namanu mitpheldoi ho chu kaki doupin, chule amaho chu keiman nakhut uva kona kamaltela, hinnaho kalhadoh ding, chule lensah dinga nadelu hinnaho jeng jong chu kalhadoh ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against your magic charms with which you ensnare people like birds and I will tear them from your arms; I will set free the people that you ensnare like birds.

source: Na ultheh pon hou jong keiman kabotela kamite nakhut uva kona kahuhdoh ding, chule amaho chu nangho khutna dellea umkit talou ding ahiuve; chule nanghon keima Pakai kahi nahet dingu ahi.
target: I will tear off your veils and save my people from your hands, and they will no longer fall prey to your power. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

source: Keiman kasuh gimlouho michonpha ho lungthim jong nanghon jouvin nasulung gimun, chule agitlounau lampia kona akilekit louna diuvin hinna anei dingun thutep nape-un, migilouho khut natha hatsah-un ahi.
target: Because you disheartened the righteous with your lies, when I had brought them no grief, and because you encouraged the wicked not to turn from their evil ways and so save their lives,

source: Nanghon pannabei mu nanei tahlou diu, doile ai nasan kitlou dingu ahitai. Ajehchu keiman kamite chu nakhut uva kona kahuhdoh ding; chule nanghon keima Pakai kahi chu nahet dingu ahi.
target: therefore you will no longer see false visions or practice divination. I will save my people from your hands. And then you will know that I am the Lord .’ ”

source: Chujouvin Israel mite upaho lah-a loikhat keima henga ahunguvin, ka-anga ahung touvun ahi.
target: Some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat down in front of me.

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin ati,
target: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, hiche miho hin asemthu-u milimho chu alungsung uva atundoh cheh uva, akhan gitlounao kipal lhuhna chu amasanguva akoiju ahitai. Keima amaho kholle ding kahim?
target: “Son of man, these men have set up idols in their hearts and put wicked stumbling blocks before their faces. Should I let them inquire of me at all?

source: Hijeh chun amaho henga hitihin thu seijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Israel insungmi amitakip alungsunga semthu milimho tungdoh-a, chule akhan gitlouna akipal lhuhna-a chu amaichanga koija, themgao henga hunga chu; Pakai keiman ahung penpen chu asemthu milimho tam dungjuija kadonbut ding ahi;
target: Therefore speak to them and tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: When any of the Israelites set up idols in their hearts and put a wicked stumbling block before their faces and then go to a prophet, I the Lord will answer them myself in keeping with their great idolatry.

source: Ajehchu Israel insung chu asemthu-u milimho jeh-a keija kona gamla ahitah jeh uva, keiman alunglam tah uva matding kati ahi.
target: I will do this to recapture the hearts of the people of Israel, who have all deserted me for their idols.’

source: Hijeh chun Israel insung henga seipeh-in, Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; nalung heijun, nasemthu-u thilho-a konin kihei mangun, chule nangho thet umtah nahinnaova konin namaiju heimangun.
target: “Therefore say to the people of Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Repent! Turn from your idols and renounce all your detestable practices!

source: Ajehchu Israel insung mitele gamdang mi Israel lah-a pemlut tapou, ama chama keija kona chom um, chule asemthu-u milimho alungsunga tungdoh-a, akhan gitlouna kipal lhuhna chu amaichanga koija, chule themgao khat henga keima thudol dong dinga hunga chu, Pakai keimatah-in ama chu kadonbut ding ahi.
target: “ ‘When any of the Israelites or any foreigner residing in Israel separate themselves from me and set up idols in their hearts and put a wicked stumbling block before their faces and then go to a prophet to inquire of me, I the Lord will answer them myself.

source: Chule keiman amapa chu kakimaitopi ding, chule amachu melchihna khatle thuchih khatna kasemding, chule amachu keiman kamiteho lah-a kona kasatlhah-a, chule nanghon keima Pakai kahi nahet dingu ahi.
target: I will set my face against them and make them an example and a byword. I will remove them from my people. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

source: Chule themgao chun thilkhat aseija lheplhah-a aumtahle, Pakai keiman themgao chu kalheplhah hiding; chule keiman ama chunga chu kakhut kajah-a, ama chu kami Israelte lah-a kona kasuhmang ding ahi.
target: “ ‘And if the prophet is enticed to utter a prophecy, I the Lord have enticed that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand against him and destroy him from among my people Israel.

source: Chule amahon akhan gitlounao talen chu akipohdoh dingu ahin; themgao talen chu ama gaholpa talen chutoh kibang ding ahi.
target: They will bear their guilt—the prophet will be as guilty as the one who consults him.

source: Chutia chu Israel insung chu keija kona petmang kit talou ding, chule asuhkhelnau jouse-a kona jong suhboh-a umkit talou dingu; ahivanga amaho kamite hitheijuva chule keima amaho Pathen kahiding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: Then the people of Israel will no longer stray from me, nor will they defile themselves anymore with all their sins. They will be my people, and I will be their God, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ ”

source: Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungkitnin, hitin ati,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, agam pumpi nasatah-a keima douna-a suhkhelna anei tengule, keiman achunguva kakhut kajah-a, changlhah hungkondohna chu kasuhtan ding, chule achunga kel kahin lhunsah-a, mihem le sahem agoma kasatlhah ding ahi.
target: “Son of man, if a country sins against me by being unfaithful and I stretch out my hand against it to cut off its food supply and send famine upon it and kill its people and their animals,

source: Chule hiche mi thumho, Noah, Daniel chule Job chu asunga umnama jongleu, amahohin achonphatnao jala amahon hinna akihuhdoh dingu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: even if these three men—Noah, Daniel and Job—were in it, they could save only themselves by their righteousness, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Keiman gamsunghi gimneitah sahemho kapal sah-a, amahon asuhsetnuva, sahemho jeh-a chu gamsung chu koiman apalthei lou dinga akamhela ahile;
target: “Or if I send wild beasts through that country and they leave it childless and it becomes desolate so that no one can pass through it because of the beasts,

source: Hiche mi thum hohi asunga umnama jongleu, keima kahinjing jeh-in, amahohin chapaho le chanuho ahuhdoh loudingu; amaho vang huhdoh-a umuva, gamsung chu kamhel ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , even if these three men were in it, they could not save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved, but the land would be desolate.

source: Ahiloule keiman mihemle sahem hichea kona chu kasuhmang nadinga, agam chunga chemjam kahin lhunsah-a, chule chemjam jah-a, agamsunghi satnin tia kaseija ahile;
target: “Or if I bring a sword against that country and say, ‘Let the sword pass throughout the land,’ and I kill its people and their animals,

source: Hiche mi thum hohi hiche sunga hin umnama jongleu, keima kahin jeh-in, amahohin chapaho hihen chanuho hijongle ahuhdoh loudingu, amavang amahole amaho bou kihuhdoh ding ahiuve, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , even if these three men were in it, they could not save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved.

source: Ahiloule keiman hiche gamsunga natset kahin lansah-a, hichea kona mihemle sahem sugam dinga kalungsatna chu thisana achunga kahin sunlhah-a ahile;
target: “Or if I send a plague into that land and pour out my wrath on it through bloodshed, killing its people and their animals,

source: Noah, Daniel chule Job, asunga anaum nama jongleu, keima kahinjing jeh-in, amaho chun chapaho le chanuho ahuhdoh loudingu, ahivangin amahon achonphatnao jala amaho hinna akihuhdoh dingu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , even if Noah, Daniel and Job were in it, they could save neither son nor daughter. They would save only themselves by their righteousness.

source: Ajehchu Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Mihemle sahem suhgamna dinga keiman Jerusalem chunga kathutana nasatah liho: chemjam, kel, hugingtah sahem chule natset kahinsol tengle, ichana nasading hitam?
target: “For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: How much worse will it be when I send against Jerusalem my four dreadful judgments—sword and famine and wild beasts and plague—to kill its men and their animals!

source: Hijeng jongle, veuvin, hiche sunga kona puidoh-a umding chapaho le chanuho, ahingdoh amoh hung umdingu ahi. Veuvin, amaho nangho henga hungdoh dingu, chule nanghon amaho lamlhah le anatoh-u namu dingu ahi. Chule keiman Jerusalem chunga kilhut thil gilou chung chang le, amaho chunga kalhunsah jouse chungchanga hi lungmon sah-a naum dingu ahi.
target: Yet there will be some survivors—sons and daughters who will be brought out of it. They will come to you, and when you see their conduct and their actions, you will be consoled regarding the disaster I have brought on Jerusalem—every disaster I have brought on it.

source: Chule nanghon amaho lamlhah le natoh ho namu tengule, amahon nangho nalhamon dingu ahi. Chule keiman asunga kabolho jousehi ajehbeija kahinbol ahipoi, ti nanghon nahet dingu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: You will be consoled when you see their conduct and their actions, for you will know that I have done nothing in it without cause, declares the Sovereign Lord .”

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin ati,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, lengpigui bah chu thingphung dang ahiloule gammanga um thingphung ho bah khat sanga, ipi hichom deh-a ham?
target: “Son of man, how is the wood of a vine different from that of a branch from any of the trees in the forest?

source: Chua kona chu thilkhat tou semna dinga thing kilatei ding ham? Ahiloule min chuche-a kona chu umle bel khattou khaina dinga alah ding ham?
target: Is wood ever taken from it to make anything useful? Do they make pegs from it to hang things on?

source: Veuvin, hiche hi meikou sunga mei tikong nadingin akiseplutnin; meijin amongteni akavamin, chule akimlai chu akan ahi. Hichu thilkhat tou semna dinga kiloma hinam?
target: And after it is thrown on the fire as fuel and the fire burns both ends and chars the middle, is it then useful for anything?

source: Veuvin, hichu apum ahi petna bon thilkhat tou semna dinga alhinlela ahile, meijin akahvam tengle ichanna lhinglel cheh ding hitam?
target: If it was not useful for anything when it was whole, how much less can it be made into something useful when the fire has burned it and it is charred?

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; gamlah thingphung ho lah-a kona meija tidinga lengpigui bah kapeh banga, Jerusalem'a chengho chu kapeh ding ahi.
target: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: As I have given the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest as fuel for the fire, so will I treat the people living in Jerusalem.

source: Chule keiman amaho douna kamai kaheiteng; amaho meikou khatna kona potnuva, ahivanga meikou dang khatnin amaho akahvam ding; chutia chu keiman amaho douna-a kamai kaheiteng, nanghon keima Pakai kahi neihet dingu ahi.
target: I will set my face against them. Although they have come out of the fire, the fire will yet consume them. And when I set my face against them, you will know that I am the Lord .

source: Chule amahon asuhkhel jeh uva, keiman agammu kamhela kalhading ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: I will make the land desolate because they have been unfaithful, declares the Sovereign Lord .”

source: Pakai thu chu avelin kahenga ahungin, hitin ati,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Jerusalem thet umtah ahinaho kihetdoh sah-in,
target: “Son of man, confront Jerusalem with her detestable practices

source: Chule Pakai Pathen'in Jerusalem henga hitihin aseije, tin seijin; Napenna le nagam mi hina chu Canaan gam ahin, napa chu Amor mi ahin chule nanu chu Hit mi ahi.
target: and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says to Jerusalem: Your ancestry and birth were in the land of the Canaanites; your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.

source: Chule napen dan chu ahile, nahung pen nikho chun nalaigui anakitanpon, twija jong silngimin nana-umpon; chi-in jong jutnin nana-umpon, chule ponin jong nana kitompon ahi.
target: On the day you were born your cord was not cut, nor were you washed with water to make you clean, nor were you rubbed with salt or wrapped in cloths.

source: Nachunga hitobang bolpehna dinga amitna khotona nei koima anaumpoi; ahin nahungpen nikho-a kidah umtah nahi jeh-in, nangma gam onga paidoh-in nana umtai.
target: No one looked on you with pity or had compassion enough to do any of these things for you. Rather, you were thrown out into the open field, for on the day you were born you were despised.

source: Chule keiman nakom kahin hopa chun, nangma nathisana nana kisuhboh kamun, nangman nathisan lah-a nana umpet chun keiman nahenga, Hingin, tin kanaseije. Henge, nangma nathisan lah-a nana umpet chun Hingin, kanatin ahi.
target: “ ‘Then I passed by and saw you kicking about in your blood, and as you lay there in your blood I said to you, “Live!”

source: Keiman nangma gama thil mumdoh khat bangin kapunsah-in; chuin, nangma nahung khangin, nahung pilhingin, chule melhoitah nahunghin ahi. Nanoi teni ahung kigongdoh-in, chule nasam ahung khangin, ahin nangma sagoh le ponbei nahi nalaije.
target: I made you grow like a plant of the field. You grew and developed and entered puberty. Your breasts had formed and your hair had grown, yet you were stark naked.

source: Tun keiman nangma kahinho pa-a, kahinvet chun, ven, nangma dei naum phat tah chu ahi; hijeh chun keiman kaponlha-a kahin khun, nasagoh hina kakhu khumpeh tai keima nahenga kaki hahsel in, chule nangma toh kitepna khatna kalutnin, chule nangma keija nahung hitai tin, Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: “ ‘Later I passed by, and when I looked at you and saw that you were old enough for love, I spread the corner of my garment over you and covered your naked body. I gave you my solemn oath and entered into a covenant with you, declares the Sovereign Lord , and you became mine.

source: Chuin nangma twijin kasilin, henge, keiman nangma-a konin nathisan chu hoitah-in kasop thengin, chule thao kanun ahi.
target: “ ‘I bathed you with water and washed the blood from you and put ointments on you.

source: Keiman nangma ajemneija kikhui ponin kana vonin, chule satuilut vun kengchot kasepeh-in, tupat ponnemin natai kagah-in, lungpon kasilpeh-in ahi.
target: I clothed you with an embroidered dress and put sandals of fine leather on you. I dressed you in fine linen and covered you with costly garments.

source: Keiman nangma kijepnaho-in jong kajemin, nakhut teni-a chaokol kabupeh-in, nagonga sumgui ka-o peh tai.
target: I adorned you with jewelry: I put bracelets on your arms and a necklace around your neck,

source: Chule keiman nanahkuija sumkol kabapeh-in, nabil teni-a bilba kabapeh-in, chule naluchunga lallukhuh hoitah khat kakhuh peh-in ahi.
target: and I put a ring on your nose, earrings on your ears and a beautiful crown on your head.

source: Hitichun nangma sanale dangka-a nakijemin, chule navon chu tupat ponnem, lungpon, chule ajem neija kikhui pona kon ahin; na anneh chu changbong neljet, khoiju, chule thao ahi. Chule nangma nahoi lheh jengin, chule lenggam khat bangin nakhang toutan ahi.
target: So you were adorned with gold and silver; your clothes were of fine linen and costly fabric and embroidered cloth. Your food was honey, olive oil and the finest flour. You became very beautiful and rose to be a queen.

source: Chule namelhoi chun Pathen heloute lah geija naminthan sahtai; ajehchu keima hoina nachunga kavonpeh jala chamkima nahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseijin ahi.
target: And your fame spread among the nations on account of your beauty, because the splendor I had given you made your beauty perfect, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Ahinla nahoina chu nakisonpin, naminthan jeh-in noti'n napangin, chule najon thanhoina jouse chu nahinjotpa jouse chunga nabung lhatan, hichu ama-a ahijitai.
target: “ ‘But you trusted in your beauty and used your fame to become a prostitute. You lavished your favors on anyone who passed by and your beauty became his.

source: Chule nangman von phabep nakilah-in, nangma-a dingin munsang ho najem polin, chule hicheho chunga chun noti'n napangin ahi. Hitobang chu hunglhung kittalou ding, chutobang chu hikit louhel ding ahitai.
target: You took some of your garments to make gaudy high places, where you carried on your prostitution. You went to him, and he possessed your beauty.

source: Keiman nangma kanapeh ka sanale dangka kijepna hoitahtah ho chu nakilah-in, chule nangma-a dingin semthu pasal ho lim nakisemin, hicheho tochun nangman jongthan hoi naboltan ahi.
target: You also took the fine jewelry I gave you, the jewelry made of my gold and silver, and you made for yourself male idols and engaged in prostitution with them.

source: Chule ajem kikhui navonho chu nalan, hicheho chu nakhu khumin; chule kathao le kagim namtui chu amaho anga nakoipeh tai.
target: And you took your embroidered clothes to put on them, and you offered my oil and incense before them.

source: Keima anneh nangma kapeh changbong neljet, thao, chule khoiju nangma vahna-a kanei jengjong chu, nangman amaho anga gimnamtuijin nakoipeh-in; hitichu anahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: Also the food I provided for you—the flour, olive oil and honey I gave you to eat—you offered as fragrant incense before them. That is what happened, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Chukalvalin nangman nachapate le nachanute, keima dinga nahinho chu, nakipuijin chule amaho chu nangman ganlhaina-in napedoh tai. Hiche najon thanhoinahi thilneo ham?
target: “ ‘And you took your sons and daughters whom you bore to me and sacrificed them as food to the idols. Was your prostitution not enough?

source: Nangman kachate nathat gamtan, chule amaho chu amaho dinga meikou palsah-a manchah dingin napedoh tai.
target: You slaughtered my children and sacrificed them to the idols.

source: Chule thet umtah nahinaho, najonnaho jouse-a, nangman nakhang donlai nikhoho, sagoh keole pon beija na-umlai, chule nathisana nangle nang suhboh nahilai chu nageldoh tapoi.
target: In all your detestable practices and your prostitution you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, kicking about in your blood.

source: Chule nakhan gitlouna jouse nungin ahung hitin ahi, (Ohe, ohe, ada nahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.)
target: “ ‘Woe! Woe to you, declares the Sovereign Lord . In addition to all your other wickedness,

source: Hitichun nangman nang dingin mun kilang khat nakisah doh-in, chule muntina munsang nakisemin ahi.
target: you built a mound for yourself and made a lofty shrine in every public square.

source: Nangman namun sangho chu lamthom tinna nakisah doh-in, chule namel hoina chu kidah umtah nason, koihile nahin hopa tapou henga nakeng teni nakah-in, chule najon thanhoinaho napunsah-in ahi.
target: At every street corner you built your lofty shrines and degraded your beauty, spreading your legs with increasing promiscuity to anyone who passed by.

source: Nangman na inheng Egypt miho tahsapum lentah ho toh nanajongtan, Keima phinsetna lunghansahna dingin, najon thanhoina nasuh tamben ahi.
target: You engaged in prostitution with the Egyptians, your neighbors with large genitals, and aroused my anger with your increasing promiscuity.

source: Vetan, hijeh-a chu keiman kakhut nachunga kajah-a, naneh ngai anneh kasuhlhom peh-a, jonthanhoi jeh-a jahcha-ah, naho-a Philistine chanute lunggot lama nangma kapehdoh nahitai.
target: So I stretched out my hand against you and reduced your territory; I gave you over to the greed of your enemies, the daughters of the Philistines, who were shocked by your lewd conduct.

source: Nangman najon thanhoina nakhoplou jeh-in, Assyria miteto jong najong khomin, henge, amaho dingin noti'n nakisan, ahinla nalungna achim joupoi.
target: You engaged in prostitution with the Assyrians too, because you were insatiable; and even after that, you still were not satisfied.

source: Nangma chukalvalin Canaan gamsunga Chaldea miteto najonben, ahijeng vangin chua jong chun nalunglhai dehpon ahi.
target: Then you increased your promiscuity to include Babylonia, a land of merchants, but even with this you were not satisfied.

source: Nangman hitiho thil jouse, jachat helouva numei jongthang hoi kimanchah bangin nakimangchan; ichana nalungthim lhasama hitam, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: “ ‘I am filled with fury against you, declares the Sovereign Lord , when you do all these things, acting like a brazen prostitute!

source: Nangman lamthom tina namun kichoiho, chule lamlhah tinna namun sangho nasadoh-in, ahin nangman aman iman nalah loujeh-in, nangma noti bangin na-umpon;
target: When you built your mounds at every street corner and made your lofty shrines in every public square, you were unlike a prostitute, because you scorned payment.

source: Amavang inneipi khat a-inneipu khela hetlou miho jonpia tobang nahi.
target: “ ‘You adulterous wife! You prefer strangers to your own husband!

source: Amahon numei notiho thilpeh apeuvin; ahinla nangman nakingaipiho jouse nathanhoi na-a nahenga ahung theina diuvin thilpeh napen nathalah-in ahi.
target: All prostitutes receive gifts, but you give gifts to all your lovers, bribing them to come to you from everywhere for your illicit favors.

source: Chule najon thanhoi na-a nangma numei danghotoh nakibahlouna aumin, amaho koimachan jonpi dingin nangman nahinjui pouve. Nangman tohman napehji-a, chule nangma peh-a na-umlouhi mitoh nakibahlouna ahi.
target: So in your prostitution you are the opposite of others; no one runs after you for your favors. You are the very opposite, for you give payment and none is given to you.

source: Hijeh chun, vo notinu, Pakai thu ngaijin,
target: “ ‘Therefore, you prostitute, hear the word of the Lord !

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; nangma bohna sunlhah-a ahung umjehle, nakingaipi ho le thet umtah namilim semthuho toh najon thanhoina jeh-a sagohkeo nahina hodoh-a ahung um jeh, chule amaho napeh nachateho thisan jeh-a;
target: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because you poured out your lust and exposed your naked body in your promiscuity with your lovers, and because of all your detestable idols, and because you gave them your children’s blood,

source: Ventan, keiman nakingaipiho jouse, nanopsah khompiho jouse toh, nangailut ho jouse toh, nana thet ho jouse chu kakhop khom ding; keiman amaho chu nakimvela kakhop khom ding, chule amahon nangma sagohkeo nahinaho amudoh theina dinguva, ahenguva sagohkeo nahina chu kahodoh ding ahi.
target: therefore I am going to gather all your lovers, with whom you found pleasure, those you loved as well as those you hated. I will gather them against you from all around and will strip you in front of them, and they will see you stark naked.

source: Chule keiman nachung thu chu numei kichen sukeh ho le thisanso ho chungthu akitan banga katan ding, chule keiman lungsatna le thangthip na-a thisan kapeh ding nahi.
target: I will sentence you to the punishment of women who commit adultery and who shed blood; I will bring on you the blood vengeance of my wrath and jealous anger.

source: Chule keiman nangma amaho khutna jong kapehdoh ding, chule amahon namun kichoilaiho chu asuhlhuh uva, chule namun sang laiho chu asuhchim dingu ahi. Chule amahon nangma naponho jouse naholhahpeh dingu, chule nasongmantam hoitahho chu nalahpeh uva, sagohkeo le pon beija nadalhah dingu ahi.
target: Then I will deliver you into the hands of your lovers, and they will tear down your mounds and destroy your lofty shrines. They will strip you of your clothes and take your fine jewelry and leave you stark naked.

source: Amahon nangma doudinga honkhat jong ahinpui dingu, chule amahon nangma songa naseuva, achemjamuva nasutpai dingu ahi.
target: They will bring a mob against you, who will stone you and hack you to pieces with their swords.

source: Chule na-inhou chu meija ahalvamuva, numei tampi mitmu-a nachung thu atandingu; chule keiman nangma noti'a napanna chu kasuhtana, nangman thalah nabol louding ahitai.
target: They will burn down your houses and inflict punishment on you in the sight of many women. I will put a stop to your prostitution, and you will no longer pay your lovers.

source: Hitia chu keiman nachunga kalungsatna chu ka kicholdo sah-a, chule kathangthipna chu nanga kona chemanga, kathipbeh ding; chule kalung hangkit talou ding ahi.
target: Then my wrath against you will subside and my jealous anger will turn away from you; I will be calm and no longer angry.

source: Nangman nakhangdon lai nikhoho geldoh louva, hiti thilho jouse-a neisuh lungjing jeh-a hi; vetan, hijeh-a chu keiman jong nachondan jouse naluchunga kalethuh ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije. Chutengle thet umtah nabolna jouse chungvuma jonthanhoi nabolkit louhel ding ahitai.
target: “ ‘Because you did not remember the days of your youth but enraged me with all these things, I will surely bring down on your head what you have done, declares the Sovereign Lord . Did you not add lewdness to all your other detestable practices?

source: Ven, koihile thuchih mangcha jouse chun nachunga hiche thuchih, anu hinabang banga, achanu jong hia ahi, kitihi amanchah dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘Everyone who quotes proverbs will quote this proverb about you: “Like mother, like daughter.”

source: Nangma nanu chanu, a-inneipu le achateho theida-a chu nahi, chule nangma a-inneipu teho le achateho theida nasopinu teho sopinu nahi; nanu chu Hit mi ahin, chule napa chu Amor mi ahi.
target: You are a true daughter of your mother, who despised her husband and her children; and you are a true sister of your sisters, who despised their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.

source: Chule nasopi alenjonu nakhut veilama amale achanute chenga chu Samaria ahin, chule nasopi aneojonu nakhut jetlama chenga chu Sodom le achanu teho ahiuve.
target: Your older sister was Samaria, who lived to the north of you with her daughters; and your younger sister, who lived to the south of you with her daughters, was Sodom.

source: Ahijeng vangin nangman amaho lampiho najuipon, amaho thet umtah ahinao jong nabolpoi. Ahivangin hichu thilneo khat bangin, nalam lhah ho jouse-a amaho sangin gamchengin suhboh-in na-ume.
target: You not only followed their ways and copied their detestable practices, but in all your ways you soon became more depraved than they.

source: Keima kahing jinge, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije, nanaonu Sodom le achanuten jong nangle nachanuten nabol tobang lomin abolpouve.
target: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , your sister Sodom and her daughters never did what you and your daughters have done.

source: Ven, hichehi nasopinu Sodom khangitlouna ahi, kiletsah, nehle chah ninglhing set, chule thasetna dimset chu amale achanuteu ho-a anaumin, chujongle vaichate le ngaichate khut chu anahatsah poi.
target: “ ‘Now this was the sin of your sister Sodom: She and her daughters were arrogant, overfed and unconcerned; they did not help the poor and needy.

source: Chule amaho akibolthei sah-un, ka-anga thil thet umtah anaboluve. Hijeh chun pha kasah dungjuijin amaho chu kalamangtan ahi.
target: They were haughty and did detestable things before me. Therefore I did away with them as you have seen.

source: Samaria jengin jong nangma chonset naho keh khat jong anabolpon; ahinla nangman thet umtah nahinaho chu amahoa sangin napunsahtan, chule natohdoh thet umtah nahinnaho jouse-a chun nangman nasopinute them nachan sah-in ahi.
target: Samaria did not commit half the sins you did. You have done more detestable things than they, and have made your sisters seem righteous by all these things you have done.

source: Nasopinuteho chunga thutan nangma tah-in jong, amaho-a sanga tamjo thet umtah thil nanabol nachonset naho jeh-a jum na chu nakipoh ahi. Amaho nangma sangin adihjouve; henge, nangma kisudongin jong uminlang, chule nasopinute nathemchansah na-a chun jum na kipohtan.
target: Bear your disgrace, for you have furnished some justification for your sisters. Because your sins were more vile than theirs, they appear more righteous than you. So then, be ashamed and bear your disgrace, for you have made your sisters appear righteous.

source: Keiman amaho asohchan naova, Sodom le achanute sohchana, chule Samaria le achanute sohchan na-a kon kahin lepui kit teng, keiman nasohchanghou chu asohchan naova kona amaho lah-a kahin lepui kit ding ahi.
target: “ ‘However, I will restore the fortunes of Sodom and her daughters and of Samaria and her daughters, and your fortunes along with them,

source: Chutia chu amaho dinga lhamona nahi tengle, nangman najachatna chu nakipoh ding, chule nanatoh ho jouse-a chu nakisuhdong ding ahi.
target: so that you may bear your disgrace and be ashamed of all you have done in giving them comfort.

source: Nasopinuteho, Sodom le achanu teho, malaija anachen nao munna ahung kilekit tenguva, chule Samaria le achanu teho malaija anachen nao munna ahung kile kit tengule, chutengle bou nangle nachanuteho malaija nanachen nao munna nakile kit diu ahi.
target: And your sisters, Sodom with her daughters and Samaria with her daughters, will return to what they were before; and you and your daughters will return to what you were before.

source: Ajehchu nasopinu Sodom chu nakiletsah nikho laitah chun nakamin jong nana phapoh pon;
target: You would not even mention your sister Sodom in the day of your pride,

source: Hichu Syria chanute le akimvela um jouse, nakimvela nangma nahsahlouva nabol Philistine chanuteho-a kon housetna natolai banga, nakhangitlouna kiphondoh masang chu ahi.
target: before your wickedness was uncovered. Even so, you are now scorned by the daughters of Edom and all her neighbors and the daughters of the Philistines—all those around you who despise you.

source: Nangman na jonthanhoina le thet naum naho chu nanakipoh tai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: You will bear the consequences of your lewdness and your detestable practices, declares the Lord .

source: Ajehchu Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; kihahselna nanahsah louva kitepna nasuhkeh jeh-a, nangin nabol bang banga ken jong kahinbol ding ahi.
target: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will deal with you as you deserve, because you have despised my oath by breaking the covenant.

source: Hijeng jongle keiman nakhangdon laija nangma toh kitepna kanei chu kahingeldoh ding, chule nangma-a dinga tonsot kitepna katundoh ding ahi.
target: Yet I will remember the covenant I made with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.

source: Chuteng nangman nachunga le nanoija nasopinuteho chu nakisan tengle, nachon danho chu nahin geldoh-a najachat ding ahi. Chule keiman amaho chu nachanute hidinga kapeh ding, nakitepna jeh-a vang hilou ding ahi.
target: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, both those who are older than you and those who are younger. I will give them to you as daughters, but not on the basis of my covenant with you.

source: Chule keiman nangma toh ka kitepna katundoh ding; chutengle nangman keima Pakai kahi nahinhet ding,
target: So I will establish my covenant with you, and you will know that I am the Lord .

source: Chutia chu keima nanatoh ho jouse jala kalungdam teng, nangman nageldoh-a najah chading, chule najachat jeh-a nakam nakahkit louhel ding ahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: Then, when I make atonement for you for all you have done, you will remember and be ashamed and never again open your mouth because of your humiliation, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ ”

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin ati,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, hetmo thu phongdoh-in, chule Israel insung henga thulem khat seipeh-in.
target: “Son of man, set forth an allegory and tell it to the Israelites as a parable.

source: Chule Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije tin seijin; Lhaving lentah nei muvanlai lentah, lhaving saotah, amul dimset, vouso tintang nei khat Lebanon'a ahungin, chule Cedar thing bah sangpena chun ahung toutai.
target: Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: A great eagle with powerful wings, long feathers and full plumage of varied colors came to Lebanon. Taking hold of the top of a cedar,

source: Aman hiche thingbah leh adonglai chu achu tanin, chule hichu sumkol veina gamsung khatna apolutnin; sumkolvei ho khopi khat sunga aphuttan ahi.
target: he broke off its topmost shoot and carried it away to a land of merchants, where he planted it in a city of traders.

source: Aman agamsoh muchi khat jong alan, chule hichu ga tamtah so na loulai khatna atu-in; aman hichu twipiho panga akoijin, chule huisum thing khat bangin aphutnin ahi.
target: “ ‘He took one of the seedlings of the land and put it in fertile soil. He planted it like a willow by abundant water,

source: Chuin hichu ahung khangin, abahho ama henglama kikho-a, chule ajungho ama noija jam lengpigui nemcha ahung hitan, hitichun lengpigui ahung hi-in, chule bahho ahin neijin, chule adonho ahin sodoh-in ahi.
target: and it sprouted and became a low, spreading vine. Its branches turned toward him, but its roots remained under it. So it became a vine and produced branches and put out leafy boughs.

source: Lhaving lentah le mul tamtah nei muvanlai lentah dang khat jong aumin, chule ven, akiphuna gamsung twilamho-a kon atuichap theina dingin, hiche lengpigui hin amapa lam ngan abahho aloi onin ajamlutsah-in, chule abahho jong amapa lam ngan akikhosuh-e.
target: “ ‘But there was another great eagle with powerful wings and full plumage. The vine now sent out its roots toward him from the plot where it was planted and stretched out its branches to him for water.

source: Hichu abahho ahungjam doh theina dingle, aga ahung umdoh theina ding, chule lengpigui pha ahunghi theina dinga, twipiho panga loumun phalaija kiphutna ahi.
target: It had been planted in good soil by abundant water so that it would produce branches, bear fruit and become a splendid vine.’

source: Nangman gaseijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; hichehi khangtou ding hinam? Aman hichu agopna dinga ajungho chu abodoh-a, chule aga jong chu apul lhahsah lou ding ham? Hiche ama-a dondoh anaho jouse chu goplha ding, ajung geija bodohna dinga, thaneina lentah le mi tamtah ngailou ding ahi.
target: “Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Will it thrive? Will it not be uprooted and stripped of its fruit so that it withers? All its new growth will wither. It will not take a strong arm or many people to pull it up by the roots.

source: Henge, vetan, kiphut jongle lolhing nantem? Solam huijin ahin semkhah teng gop lhahel jenglou ding ham? hichu akhandohna honsunga chu goplha ding ahi.
target: It has been planted, but will it thrive? Will it not wither completely when the east wind strikes it—wither away in the plot where it grew?’ ”

source: Chukal valin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin ati,
target: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Tun kiphinjing insung henga hitihin seijin; Hiti thil hohin ipi aseina ahi nanghon nahet uvem? Amaho seipeh in, veuvin, Babylon lengpa chu Jerusalem'a ahungin, chule chuche mun'a lengpa le pipuiho chu amanin, amato lhonin Babylon'a gal hingin akaitai.
target: “Say to this rebellious people, ‘Do you not know what these things mean?’ Say to them: ‘The king of Babylon went to Jerusalem and carried off her king and her nobles, bringing them back with him to Babylon.

source: Chule lengpa chilhah chu akaijin, amato kitepna asemin, ama chu akihahselsah-in, chule aman gam sunga thahat ho jong akai mangin ahi.
target: Then he took a member of the royal family and made a treaty with him, putting him under oath. He also carried away the leading men of the land,

source: Chutia chu lenggam chu kisunema, achama kiphong dingthei talou ding, aman kitepna anit jala bou dingthei ding ahi.
target: so that the kingdom would be brought low, unable to rise again, surviving only by keeping his treaty.

source: Ahinla aman, amahon sakol ho le mi tamtah apeh theina dingun apalaiho Egypt'a asol lutnin, ama chu adoutan ahi. Ama chu akhangtou nadem? chutobang thilho bola amachu hoidoh nantem? ahiloule huhdoh-a aumna dingin kitepna chu asukeh dem?
target: But the king rebelled against him by sending his envoys to Egypt to get horses and a large army. Will he succeed? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the treaty and yet escape?

source: Pakai Pathen'in aseije, Keima kahinjing bangin, tahbeh-in akihahselna nahsah louva akoija, akitepna asuhkehpa, ama lenga anasem lengpa chenna mun'a chu, amatah chutoh Babylon lailung tah-a chu thitei ding ahi.
target: “ ‘As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , he shall die in Babylon, in the land of the king who put him on the throne, whose oath he despised and whose treaty he broke.

source: Amahon mitha nadinga molsang banga kulbang asetnuva, pal akai tengule, Pharaoh'in agalsat sepai mihat hole mihonpi tamtah toh gal kisatna-a chu ima abolthei lou dingu ahi.
target: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great horde will be of no help to him in war, when ramps are built and siege works erected to destroy many lives.

source: Aman kihahselna i-sah louna-a kitepna asuhkeh-a, chule vetan, aman akhut alapma hitiho jouse abol jeh-a hi, ama hoidoh louhel ding ahi.
target: He despised the oath by breaking the covenant. Because he had given his hand in pledge and yet did all these things, he shall not escape.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Keima kahinjing bangin, tahbeh-in kaki hahsel na aman i-sah louva abola, kakitepna asuhkeh ahin, keiman amatah lujang kalethuh ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: As surely as I live, I will repay him for despising my oath and breaking my covenant.

source: Chule keiman achunga ka lenthang kajal-a, kathanga ohding, chule keiman ama Babylon kahinlhut ding; chuteng hia chu asuhkhelna, keima dehna-a asuhkhelna thua ama chu kakihoupi ding ahi.
target: I will spread my net for him, and he will be caught in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon and execute judgment on him there because he was unfaithful to me.

source: Chule amite jamleho jouse chu ama loiho chutoh chemjam'a loudingu, chule amaho aum nalaiho chengse chu hui nunna lam jouse-a kithecheh dingu; chutengle keima Pakaiyin kaseisa ahi ti nahet dingu ahi.
target: All his choice troops will fall by the sword, and the survivors will be scattered to the winds. Then you will know that I the Lord have spoken.

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Keiman Cedar thingphunga kon abah sangpen chu kalah-a, chule kaphu ding; ajih donho dongset khat kasilhah-a, hichu lhangsang akichoilai khatna kaphu ding ahi.
target: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I myself will take a shoot from the very top of a cedar and plant it; I will break off a tender sprig from its topmost shoots and plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

source: Israel molsang chunga hichu kaphu ding, hichun bahho hinsepdoh intin, ga ahin neija, Cedar hoitah hung hiding; chule anoija chu lhavingnei vacha namkim chenga, abahho lima chu cheng ding ahiuve.
target: On the mountain heights of Israel I will plant it; it will produce branches and bear fruit and become a splendid cedar. Birds of every kind will nest in it; they will find shelter in the shade of its branches.

source: Chule gama thingphung ho jouse chun, Pakai keiman thingphung sang chu kaloilhun, thingphung nem chu katung sangin, thingphung hing chu kagotlhahsah-in, chule thingphung go chu kahindohsah-e, ti ahin het dingu ahi. Pakai keiman kasei ahitan chule kabol ahitai.
target: All the trees of the forest will know that I the Lord bring down the tall tree and make the low tree grow tall. I dry up the green tree and make the dry tree flourish. “ ‘I the Lord have spoken, and I will do it.’ ”

source: Pakai thu chu avelin kahenga ahungin, hitin aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Nanghon Israel gamsung chungchanga naman chah-u thuchih, Paten lengpithei thuh aneovin, chate aha ajai kitihi ipi natinao ham?
target: “What do you people mean by quoting this proverb about the land of Israel: “ ‘The parents eat sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge’?

source: Keima hinjing kahijeh-in, nanghon Israel sunga, hiche thuchih manchahna phat naneikit louhel dingu ahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: “As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , you will no longer quote this proverb in Israel.

source: Veuvin, hinkho jouse chu keija ahi, mipa hinkho keija ahibanga, chapa hinkho jong keija ahi; chonset bolla hinna chu thitei ding ahi.
target: For everyone belongs to me, the parent as well as the child—both alike belong to me. The one who sins is the one who will die.

source: Ahinla mikhat chu achondih-a, chule thilpha le adih abola,
target: “Suppose there is a righteous man who does what is just and right.

source: Chule molsang ho chunga ima nelouva auma, Israel insung semthu limho jong amit teni-a khoda-a ve louva, a-inhengpa ji jong asuhboh louva, numei thichelai jong aganai louva,
target: He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor’s wife or have sexual relations with a woman during her period.

source: Koimacha sugenthei louva, amavang abatpa henga athiltun alepeh-a, hunama koima achom louva, gilkelte achanglhah apeh-a, chule sagohkeo chu pon akhu-a,
target: He does not oppress anyone, but returns what he took in pledge for a loan. He does not commit robbery but gives his food to the hungry and provides clothing for the naked.

source: Athoi dinga sumpa homlouva, apung jong lalouva, khangitlouna-a kona akhut atuhtanga, mihem le mihem kah-a thutan lhahna dihtah atohdoh-a,
target: He does not lend to them at interest or take a profit from them. He withholds his hand from doing wrong and judges fairly between two parties.

source: Kadan kisun ho ajuija, chule kathutanho adihtah bolna dinga anitna ahile; ama chu midih ahin, hingtei ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: He follows my decrees and faithfully keeps my laws. That man is righteous; he will surely live, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Amapa chun chapa khat ahina, achapa chu gucha michom, thisanso hat ahi-a, chule hicheho lah-a hitobang khat penpen abola ahile,
target: “Suppose he has a violent son, who sheds blood or does any of these other things

source: Chule chutobang tohding dolho khat chabeh tonglouva auma, amavang molsang chung dunga ima aneh-a, chule a-inhengpa ji asuhboh-a,
target: (though the father has done none of them): “He eats at the mountain shrines. He defiles his neighbor’s wife.

source: Vaicha le lhasamte asuhgentheija, hunama mi achoma, thil kitung lepehlouva, chule semthu limho chu amittah ngeija vea chun thet umtah chu abol ahin,
target: He oppresses the poor and needy. He commits robbery. He does not return what he took in pledge. He looks to the idols. He does detestable things.

source: Athoi dinga sumpa ahopma, apung akilah-a ahileh; ama chu ahing nadem? Hinglou helding ahi; aman hiche thet umtah ho jouse aboltan; ama thitei ding; ama thisan chu ama chunga chuding ahi.
target: He lends at interest and takes a profit. Will such a man live? He will not! Because he has done all these detestable things, he is to be put to death; his blood will be on his own head.

source: Tun, veuvin, aman chapa khat neihenlang, achapa chun apan abol chonsetna ho jouse muhen, hichu ngaitohen, chule chutobang chu bolda henlang,
target: “But suppose this son has a son who sees all the sins his father commits, and though he sees them, he does not do such things:

source: Molsang ho chung dunga ima nelou, amitna jong khodah-a Israel insung semthu limho velou, a-inhengpa jinu suboh lou,
target: “He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor’s wife.

source: Koima jong sugentheilou, thil kitung jong itcha lou, hunama jong mi chomlou, achanglhah gilkel le lhasamte pejo-a, sagohkeote ponsil pe-a,
target: He does not oppress anyone or require a pledge for a loan. He does not commit robbery but gives his food to the hungry and provides clothing for the naked.

source: Vaichate-a kon akhut tima, sumthoi homa chule apung jong lalouva, kathutan atohdoh-a, kadan kisunho ajopma ahile; ama chu apa khangitlou jeh-a thilou ding, ama chu tahbeh-a hing ding ahi.
target: He withholds his hand from mistreating the poor and takes no interest or profit from them. He keeps my laws and follows my decrees. He will not die for his father’s sin; he will surely live.

source: Apa thudol ahile, aman engsetah-a anasuh gentheija, asopipa hunama anachoma, chule amite lah-a aphalou anabol jeh-a chu veuvin, amatah chu akhangit louna-a thitei ding ahi.
target: But his father will die for his own sin, because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother and did what was wrong among his people.

source: Ahijengvangin nanghon, i-atile chapan apa khangitlouna apohlou ham? tin naseijuve. Chapa chun dandunguija adih chu abola, kadan kisemho jouse achintupma hicheho chu abolteng, ama tahbeh-a hing ding ahi.
target: “Yet you ask, ‘Why does the son not share the guilt of his father?’ Since the son has done what is just and right and has been careful to keep all my decrees, he will surely live.

source: Chonset bola hinna chu thitei ding ahi. Chapan apa khangitlouna apoh louhel ding, panjong chapa khangitlouna chu apoh louhel ding ahi. Chonphat nachu chonphapa chunga umding, chule agiloupa gitlouna chu ama chunga umding ahi.
target: The one who sins is the one who will die. The child will not share the guilt of the parent, nor will the parent share the guilt of the child. The righteousness of the righteous will be credited to them, and the wickedness of the wicked will be charged against them.

source: Ahivangin agiloupa chu aman anabol achonsetnaho jouse-a kona ahung kileheija, kadan kisun ho jouse anitna, thilpha le adih chu abola ahile, ama hing teitei ding, thilou ding ahi.
target: “But if a wicked person turns away from all the sins they have committed and keeps all my decrees and does what is just and right, that person will surely live; they will not die.

source: Chule aman anabolsa suhkhelna ho chu, ama henga kiphapoh louding ahin; aman anabolsa chonphatna-a chu hing ding ahi.
target: None of the offenses they have committed will be remembered against them. Because of the righteous things they have done, they will live.

source: Keiman migilou athi ding chu kakipapi dingham? amavang ahina dinga achena lampiho-a kona ahungkile kit ding johchu kakipana hilouham? tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: Do I take any pleasure in the death of the wicked? declares the Sovereign Lord . Rather, am I not pleased when they turn from their ways and live?

source: Amavang michonpha chu achonphatna-a kona akiheimanga, setna abola, agiloupa thilbol thet umtah ho jouse chu abola ahile, ama hingin tem? Aman anabolsa chonphatna ho jouse chu kiphapoh talou ding ahi. Suhkhelna-a anabol suhkhelna leh chonset na-a anabol chonsetna jeh-a, ama thitei ding ahi.
target: “But if a righteous person turns from their righteousness and commits sin and does the same detestable things the wicked person does, will they live? None of the righteous things that person has done will be remembered. Because of the unfaithfulness they are guilty of and because of the sins they have committed, they will die.

source: Achutijeng vangin nanghon, Pakai lampi chu akibangpoi, nati uve. Tun ngaijun, Vo Israel insung, Keima lampi kibanga hilou ham? nangho lampijoh hilouham akibang louva chu?
target: “Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ Hear, you Israelites: Is my way unjust? Is it not your ways that are unjust?

source: Chonpha khat chu achonphatna-a kona akihei manga, chule khangitlouna abola, chua chu athi dena ahile; khangitlouna anaboldoh jeh-a chu ama thia ahi.
target: If a righteous person turns from their righteousness and commits sin, they will die for it; because of the sin they have committed they will die.

source: Chujongle, migilou khatnin gitlou anabola kona ahung kihei manga, thildih le apha chu abola ahile, aman ahinna akihuhhing ding ahi.
target: But if a wicked person turns away from the wickedness they have committed and does what is just and right, they will save their life.

source: Ajehchu ama kingaito-a, anabolsa sukhelna ho jouse-a kona akiheimanga ahin, ama tahbeh-a hingtei ding, thilouhel ding ahi.
target: Because they consider all the offenses they have committed and turn away from them, that person will surely live; they will not die.

source: Achuti vangin Israel insung chun, Pakai lampi chu akibangpoi atiuve. Vo Israel insung, Keima lampiho kibanga hilouham? Nangho lampijoh hilouham akibang louva chu?
target: Yet the Israelites say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ Are my ways unjust, people of Israel? Is it not your ways that are unjust?

source: Hijeh-a chu, Vo Israel insung, mitin achonna dungjui cheh-a athu-u katan ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije. Nalung heijun, nakhangitlou naova konin nangho le nangho kihei mangun, chutile chu setna chu namanthah nao hilouding ahi.
target: “Therefore, you Israelites, I will judge each of you according to your own ways, declares the Sovereign Lord . Repent! Turn away from all your offenses; then sin will not be your downfall.

source: Khan gitlouna nabolho jouseu nangho-a konin paimangun; chule lungthah le lhagao thah kengun, ajeh chu ipidinga nathi jeng diuham? Vo Israel insung.
target: Rid yourselves of all the offenses you have committed, and get a new heart and a new spirit. Why will you die, people of Israel?

source: Ajehchu athipa thina-a chunga chun kipana kaneipoi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije. Hijeh chun kiheijun lang hinnan neijun.
target: For I take no pleasure in the death of anyone, declares the Sovereign Lord . Repent and live!

source: Chujongle nangman Israel pipuiho dingin ka la bolin lang,
target: “Take up a lament concerning the princes of Israel

source: Chule seijin, Nanu chu ipi ham? Keipi bahkai nu ahin; keipi bahkai ho lah-a akolin, keipi bahkai chalgol ho lah-a anoute avah-in ahi.
