target: and say: “ ‘What a lioness was your mother among the lions! She lay down among them and reared her cubs.

source: Aman anoute lah-a khat avahdoh-in; keipi bahkai chalgol ahung hitan, samatje ahinhetan, mihem ahin thattan ahi.
target: She brought up one of her cubs, and he became a strong lion. He learned to tear the prey and he became a man-eater.

source: Namtinin ama thu aja taovin; ama chu akokhuh uva matnin aumin, chule amahon akihena thihkhao pumin Egypt gam alhut taove.
target: The nations heard about him, and he was trapped in their pit. They led him with hooks to the land of Egypt.

source: Tun keipinu chun angah-in, akinepna abeitai ti amu phatnin, aman anouho lah-a achomkhat alakitnin, keipi bahkai chalgol-in asemtai.
target: “ ‘When she saw her hope unfulfilled, her expectation gone, she took another of her cubs and made him a strong lion.

source: Chuin ama chu keipiho lah-a atouche asuhchen, ama keipi bahkai chalgol ahung hitan, samatje ahung themin, chule mihem ahin that tan ahi.
target: He prowled among the lions, for he was now a strong lion. He learned to tear the prey and he became a man-eater.

source: Aman akamhel aleng inpihou chu ahen, aman akhopihou chu manlou asotan; chule gamsung le asunga cheng dimsetho chu akitum gina chun akamheltai.
target: He broke down their strongholds and devastated their towns. The land and all who were in it were terrified by his roaring.

source: Chujouvin namtin chun lam tina konin ama ahindouvun, alenthangu chu ama chunga ahinjah taovin, ama chu akokhuh uva amantaove.
target: Then the nations came against him, those from regions round about. They spread their net for him, and he was trapped in their pit.

source: Chule amahon thihkhaova akanun, ahentupmun, Babylon lengpa heng ahin lhutnun: a-awgin chu Israel molsang ho-a akijah kitlouna dingin, amahon ama chu kotong sunga ahentauve.
target: With hooks they pulled him into a cage and brought him to the king of Babylon. They put him in prison, so his roar was heard no longer on the mountains of Israel.

source: Nanu chu twi panga kiphut, nathisana um lengpigui tobang ahin, twi tamjeh-in amanu aga aphan, abah jong tamtah ahi.
target: “ ‘Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard planted by the water; it was fruitful and full of branches because of abundant water.

source: Chule amanun vaihomna leng tenggol dingin mol tahbet khat aneijin, chule amanu sanje chu thingbah tamtah lah-a dopsangin aumin, amanu sandan chu abah tamtah ho chuto ahung kilahdoh than ahi.
target: Its branches were strong, fit for a ruler’s scepter. It towered high above the thick foliage, conspicuous for its height and for its many branches.

source: Ahijeng vangin amanu chu lungsat na-a bodoh-in ahung umin, amanu chu tolla selhah-in ahung umtan, chule solam huipin aga chu agotlhah sahtai. Amanu mol tahbet chu akisu bongin, agoplhan meikouvin akavamtai.
target: But it was uprooted in fury and thrown to the ground. The east wind made it shrivel, it was stripped of its fruit; its strong branches withered and fire consumed them.

source: Tunvang amanu chu gamthipma, gamgole dangchah na gam leisetna akiphut tan ahi.
target: Now it is planted in the desert, in a dry and thirsty land.

source: Chule amanu bahho lah-a mol khatna konin meikou ahungdoh-in, hichun agaho akavamtan; chuti chun amanun vaihomna tenggol ding mol tahbet aneitapoi. Hichehi kala ahin, chule kala khat hung hiding ahitai.
target: Fire spread from one of its main branches and consumed its fruit. No strong branch is left on it fit for a ruler’s scepter.’ “This is a lament and is to be used as a lament.”

source: Chuin kumsagi lhinna alha ngana nisom lhinnin ahung hitin ahi, Israel upaho lah-a konin loikhat Pakai henga thudoh nei dingin ahunguvin, ka-anga atouvun ahi.
target: In the seventh year, in the fifth month on the tenth day, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the Lord , and they sat down in front of me.

source: Chujouvin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin aseije,
target: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa Israel upaho henga seipeh-in, chule amaho henga seijin, hitihin Pakai Pathen'in aseije; Nangho keima dongdinga nahungu ham? Keima kahinjing bangin, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije, nangho thudoh le-a kaumlou ding ahi.
target: “Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Have you come to inquire of me? As surely as I live, I will not let you inquire of me, declares the Sovereign Lord .’

source: Nangman amaho thu natan dingham, mihem chapa, nangman amaho thu natan dingham? Apu apateho thet umtah thilbolho chu amaho hetdohsah-in lang;
target: “Will you judge them? Will you judge them, son of man? Then confront them with the detestable practices of their ancestors

source: Chule amaho henga seijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Keiman Israel kalhena, Jacob insung chilhah henga kakhut kadopsanga, Egypt gama Keima amaho henga kakihetsah-a, ahenguva kakhut kadopsanga, keihi Pakai na Pathen'u kahi tia kasei nikho,
target: and say to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: On the day I chose Israel, I swore with uplifted hand to the descendants of Jacob and revealed myself to them in Egypt. With uplifted hand I said to them, “I am the Lord your God.”

source: Chuche Egypt gama kona hinpuidoh-a amaho dinga kavetpehna gam, khoiju le bongnoi lona gama, gamjouse loupina-a chu amaho puilut dingin ahenguva kakhut kadop sang nikho;
target: On that day I swore to them that I would bring them out of Egypt into a land I had searched out for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the most beautiful of all lands.

source: Hiche nikho chun keiman ahenguva, Mitinin namitmu uva thet umho paimang uvin, chule Egypt gam milim ho-ah kisuboh hih-un, keima Pakai na Pathen'u kahi, tin kanaseije.
target: And I said to them, “Each of you, get rid of the vile images you have set your eyes on, and do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.”

source: Ahinla amahon eina douvun, chule kathu angaipouve. Amaho mitinin amitmuva thet umho anapaimang pouvin, Egypt gam milimho jong adalhadeh pouve. Hichun keiman Egypt gam lailung tah-a, achunguva kalunghana kamolso nadingin achunguva kalungsatna bung lhange, tin kaseijin ahi.
target: “ ‘But they rebelled against me and would not listen to me; they did not get rid of the vile images they had set their eyes on, nor did they forsake the idols of Egypt. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and spend my anger against them in Egypt.

source: Ahinla aumpihou Pathen heloute, Egypt gama kon kahinpuidoh uva kona ahenguva kakihetsahna miho anga kamin suhboh-a aumlouna dinga, kamin jala kanabol ahi.
target: But for the sake of my name, I brought them out of Egypt. I did it to keep my name from being profaned in the eyes of the nations among whom they lived and in whose sight I had revealed myself to the Israelites.

source: Hijeh-a chu keiman amaho Egypt gama kona kapotdoh sah-a, gamthip sung kahinlhut ahi.
target: Therefore I led them out of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.

source: Chule keiman kadan kisunho amaho kanapen, chule kathutanho kanavetsah-in, hichu min abola ahile ama chu hingding ahi.
target: I gave them my decrees and made known to them my laws, by which the person who obeys them will live.

source: Chukalvalin, keiman amaho suthengpa Pakai kahi ahet theina dingun, keima le amaho kah-a melchihna khat hidingin kacholngah nikhoho kanapen ahi.
target: Also I gave them my Sabbaths as a sign between us, so they would know that I the Lord made them holy.

source: Ahinla Israel insung chun gamthipma keima einadouvun; mihemin hichu abola ahile, chuche-a chu ama hing ding ahi tia kanasei, kadan kisunho ajui pouvin, kathutanho angaisah pouvin; chule kacholngah nikhoho chu hatah-in asuboh-un ahi. Chuin keiman gamthipma amaho sugam dingin kalungsatna achunguva bung lhange kanatin ahi.
target: “ ‘Yet the people of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They did not follow my decrees but rejected my laws—by which the person who obeys them will live—and they utterly desecrated my Sabbaths. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and destroy them in the wilderness.

source: Alah uva kon kahin puidohna Pathen hephalou mite mitmu-a kamin suhboh-a aumlouna dinga, kamin jala na katoh ahi.
target: But for the sake of my name I did what would keep it from being profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.

source: Achuti vangin, keiman amaho kanapeh gam jouse lah-a gam loupi, khoijule bongnoi lonna gam chu kalhut louna din gamthipma kakhut kanadom sangin ahi.
target: Also with uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land I had given them—a land flowing with milk and honey, the most beautiful of all lands—

source: Ajehchu amahon kathutanho anahsah pouvin, chule kadanthu kisunho ajuipouvin, amavang kacholngah nikhoho asubohtauve. Ajehchu alungsungun amilimhou nung ajuitai.
target: because they rejected my laws and did not follow my decrees and desecrated my Sabbaths. For their hearts were devoted to their idols.

source: Hijeng jongle, kamitnin suhmangna dinga konin amaho anahoidoh-in, gamthip jenga jong chun kana subei pouve.
target: Yet I looked on them with pity and did not destroy them or put an end to them in the wilderness.

source: Amavang gamthipma chun achateu henga hitin kanaseije, Nanghon napu napateu dan kisunho chu juihih beh-un, athutanhou jong nit hih-un, asemthu milimhouva jong kisuboh hihbeh-un
target: I said to their children in the wilderness, “Do not follow the statutes of your parents or keep their laws or defile yourselves with their idols.

source: Keima Pakai na Pathen'u kahin, kadan kisunho-a chonun, kathutanho nitnun lang bolun,
target: I am the Lord your God; follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws.

source: Chule kacholngah nikhoho jabolun, hiho chu keima le nangho kah-a melchihna khat hiding, chutia chu nanghon keima Pakai le na Pathen'u kahi nahet dingu ahi, kanati.
target: Keep my Sabbaths holy, that they may be a sign between us. Then you will know that I am the Lord your God.”

source: Ahijeng vangin achateu keima dounan agolkeh-un; mihemin hichu abola ahile, chuche-a chu ama hing ding ahi tia kanasei kadan kisunho-a ajui pouvin, kathutanho angaisah pouvin; kacholngah nikhoho asuboh-un ahi. Hichun keima gamthipma achunguva kalunghana molsona din, amaho chunga kalungsatna bung lhange tin kana seijin ahi.
target: “ ‘But the children rebelled against me: They did not follow my decrees, they were not careful to keep my laws, of which I said, “The person who obeys them will live by them,” and they desecrated my Sabbaths. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and spend my anger against them in the wilderness.

source: Ahijeng vangin alah uva kon kahin puidohna Pathen hephalou mite mitmu-a kamin suhboh-a aumlouna dinga, kakhut kanatima, na kanatoh ahi.
target: But I withheld my hand, and for the sake of my name I did what would keep it from being profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.

source: Keiman amaho Pathen heloute lah-a kasuhcheh nadingle, gamtina kathecheh-na dingin gamthipma jong chun kakhut kanalam in ahi.
target: Also with uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries,

source: Ajehchu amahon kathutanho anatongdoh pouvin, kadan kisunho anahsah pouvin, kacholngah nikhoho asuboh-un, chule amit houchun apu apateu milimho ajuijun ahi.
target: because they had not obeyed my laws but had rejected my decrees and desecrated my Sabbaths, and their eyes lusted after their parents’ idols.

source: Hijeh chun keiman amaho apha loutah chondan kanapen, chule hinna-a aneilou diu thutan naho kanapen;
target: So I gave them other statutes that were not good and laws through which they could not live;

source: Chule keiman amaho kakamhel sah-a, akhonnale keima Pakai kahi ahetdoh theina dinguvin, naobu phukeh jouse meikou apal galkai sahnao, athilpeh uva chun amaho kasuboh-in ahi.
target: I defiled them through their gifts—the sacrifice of every firstborn—that I might fill them with horror so they would know that I am the Lord .’

source: Hijeh chun mihem chapa, Israel insung henga seijin, chule ahenguva, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Napu napa teovin hiche-a hin eina taitomun, khuche-a chun keima dounan suhkhel ananeijun ahi.
target: “Therefore, son of man, speak to the people of Israel and say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: In this also your ancestors blasphemed me by being unfaithful to me:

source: Ajehchu, keiman amaho pehdinga kakhut kadop sangna gamsunga kapuilut phatnun, amahon lhangsang jousele thingphung lentah ho jouse amuvin, chua chun athiltohou chu apeuvin, athilto houva chun eilunghan sah-un ahi. Chua chun amahon agimnamtui hou jong ahalun, chule hia chun donding thilpehho alhei lha uvin ahi.
target: When I brought them into the land I had sworn to give them and they saw any high hill or any leafy tree, there they offered their sacrifices, made offerings that aroused my anger, presented their fragrant incense and poured out their drink offerings.

source: Chuin keiman amaho henga, Nagachenao munsang chu ipiham? tin kaseijin, hiche munchu tuni geijin Bamah akiti nalaije.
target: Then I said to them: What is this high place you go to?’ ” (It is called Bamah to this day.)

source: Hijeh chun Israel insung jah-a seipeh-in, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Napu napateu chonna dungsuna nakisuh boh-u hitam? chule thet umtah athilbol hou banga jonthanhoi nabolu hitam?
target: “Therefore say to the Israelites: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Will you defile yourselves the way your ancestors did and lust after their vile images?

source: Ajehchu nathilpeh-u natouva, nachateo meikou napal galkaisah tengule, tuni changeija namilimho uva kisuboh nahiuve. Chuti ahile keima nangho gahdoh ding kahim, Vo Israel insung? Keima kahinjing bangin, tin Pakaiyin aseije, keima nangho dohding kahi louhel ding ahi.
target: When you offer your gifts—the sacrifice of your children in the fire—you continue to defile yourselves with all your idols to this day. Am I to let you inquire of me, you Israelites? As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , I will not let you inquire of me.

source: Chule nalungsunguva hunglut, Keiho Pathen heloute bang kahi dingu, gamsung miho insung tobang kahi dingu, thingle song kajendiu ahi, natiu chu guilhung louhel ding ahi.
target: “ ‘You say, “We want to be like the nations, like the peoples of the world, who serve wood and stone.” But what you have in mind will never happen.

source: Keima kahinjing bangin, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije; tahbeh-in khut thahat tahle, ban jahdoh-a, chule lungsatna sunlhah to tho-a, nachung uva vai kahomding ahi.
target: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , I will reign over you with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with outpoured wrath.

source: Chule keiman khut thahat tahle, ban jahdoh-a, chule lungsatna sunlhah totho-a, mipi ho-a kon le, nakithe chehnau gamho-a kona kahinkhop khom ding nahiuve.
target: I will bring you from the nations and gather you from the countries where you have been scattered—with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with outpoured wrath.

source: Chule mipi gamthip sunga nangho kahin puilutna, chukoma chu nangho kimaito-a kakihoupi ding ahi.
target: I will bring you into the wilderness of the nations and there, face to face, I will execute judgment upon you.

source: Egypt gamthip sunga napu napateu to kanakihou banga, keiman nangho kakihoupi ding nahiuve, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: As I judged your ancestors in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will judge you, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Chule keiman nangho mol lhon noi kapalsah uva, chule nangho kikankhomna kitepna sunga kahinpuilut ding nahiuve.
target: I will take note of you as you pass under my rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

source: Chule keiman nalah uva kona doumah bolho le keima douna-a suhkhel ho chu kasuhtheng ding, amaho chu agapemnau gamsunga kona kahin puidoh-a, Israel gam sunga lutlouhel ding ahiuve. Chutengle nanghon keima Pakai kahi chu nahet dingu ahi.
target: I will purge you of those who revolt and rebel against me. Although I will bring them out of the land where they are living, yet they will not enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

source: Nangho vang, vo Israel insung, Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; Cheovin, tunung jongle kasei nangaisah lou dinguva ahile, mitinin namilim cheh gakijenun; tukallin nathilpeh hou le namilim houva chun kamin theng suboh tahih-un.
target: “ ‘As for you, people of Israel, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Go and serve your idols, every one of you! But afterward you will surely listen to me and no longer profane my holy name with your gifts and idols.

source: Ajehchu kamolsang thengtah, Israel sanna molsanga chu, Israel insungho jouse, agamsunga um jousen chuachu eijen dingu ahi. Hia chu keiman amaho kasan ding, nathilpeh hou le nakipehdoh nau gamasapenho, chule nathil thenghou jouse kangeh ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: For on my holy mountain, the high mountain of Israel, declares the Sovereign Lord , there in the land all the people of Israel will serve me, and there I will accept them. There I will require your offerings and your choice gifts, along with all your holy sacrifices.

source: Keiman nangho mipi ho-a kona kahin puidoh-a, nakithe chehnau gamho-a kona kakhop khom teng, keiman nagim namtuiju puma kasan ding; chule Pathen heloute angsunga nangho-a suhthenga kaum ding ahi.
target: I will accept you as fragrant incense when I bring you out from the nations and gather you from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will be proved holy through you in the sight of the nations.

source: Chule keiman nangho Israel gamsung, napu napateu penge tia kakhut kanadop sangna gam chu kahinlut tengule, nanghon keima Pakai kahi neihin hetdoh dingu ahi.
target: Then you will know that I am the Lord , when I bring you into the land of Israel, the land I had sworn with uplifted hand to give to your ancestors.

source: Chule hia chu nana kisuhbohnao nalampi hou le nathilbol jouseu nahin geldoh dingu; chule thilgilou nanabol hou jouseu jeh-a nangho mitmu ngeija jong nanghole nangho jong nakikidah dingu ahi.
target: There you will remember your conduct and all the actions by which you have defiled yourselves, and you will loathe yourselves for all the evil you have done.

source: Chule keiman nakhangitlou nau dungjuija hilouva, nathilbol thenlou jeh-u jong hideh louva, kamin khohsahna jala nachung uva na katoh tengle, vo nangho Israel insung, keima Pakai kahi chu nahinhet dingu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: You will know that I am the Lord , when I deal with you for my name’s sake and not according to your evil ways and your corrupt practices, you people of Israel, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ ”

source: Chukalvalin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin aseije.
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, lhanglam maingatnin lang, nathu chu lhanglam sanga phongdoh-in, chule lhanglam gammang dounan gaothu seijin,
target: “Son of man, set your face toward the south; preach against the south and prophesy against the forest of the southland.

source: Chule lhanglam gammang henga chun seijin, Pakai thusei hi ngaijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Ven, keiman nasunga mei kachokonga, hichun nangma-a thingphung hing tinleh thingphung go tin chu ahalvam ding: meikou deojeju chu kiphelmit louding, lhanglama pat sahlam geija maichang jouse hichun akahvam sohding ahi.
target: Say to the southern forest: ‘Hear the word of the Lord . This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am about to set fire to you, and it will consume all your trees, both green and dry. The blazing flame will not be quenched, and every face from south to north will be scorched by it.

source: Chule tahsa-a hing jousen Pakai keiman hichu kachokou ahi ti amucheh dingu; hichu kiphelmit louhel ding ahi, ati.
target: Everyone will see that I the Lord have kindled it; it will not be quenched.’ ”

source: Chuin keiman, Vo Pakai Pathen, amahon keima thudol aseijun, Amapa khun thulem asei hilou ham? atiuve, kati.
target: Then I said, “Sovereign Lord , they are saying of me, ‘Isn’t he just telling parables?’ ”

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin ati,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Jerusalem lam maingatnin lang, nathu chu muntheng ho lama phongdoh-in lang, Israel leiset dounan gaothu seijin,
target: “Son of man, set your face against Jerusalem and preach against the sanctuary. Prophesy against the land of Israel

source: Chule Israel gamsung jah-a seijin, Pakaiyin hitihin aseije; Vetan, nangma kadou nahi, chule kachemjam apaija kona kasadoh ding, nangma-a kona michonpha le migilou kibanga kasatlhah ahi.
target: and say to her: ‘This is what the Lord says: I am against you. I will draw my sword from its sheath and cut off from you both the righteous and the wicked.

source: Keiman nanga kona michonpha le migilou kasuhbei ding ahitan, hijeh-a chu kachemjam chu apaija kona lhanglama pat sahlam geija tahsa-a hing jouse dou dinga kondoh ding ahi.
target: Because I am going to cut off the righteous and the wicked, my sword will be unsheathed against everyone from south to north.

source: Chutia chu tahsa-a hing jousen keima Pakaiyin kachemjam apaija konin kasatdohtai ti ahet dingu; hichu kilekit louhel ding ahi.
target: Then all people will know that I the Lord have drawn my sword from its sheath; it will not return again.’

source: Hijeh chun mihem chapa, nangma nakong bong pumin khoisan lang; amitmu uva lhasetah-in khoisan.
target: “Therefore groan, son of man! Groan before them with broken heart and bitter grief.

source: Chule hung hiteiding ahi, amahon nahenga ibola nakhoisat ham? ati tengule, nangman, thu jeh ahi, ajehchu hichu hunglhung kon ahitai: lungthim jouse junlha ding, khut jouse joilha ding, lhagao jouse lhasam ding, khup jouse twi banga lhasam ding ahi: ven, hichu ahunge, kimolso tei ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije, tia nadonbut ding ahi.
target: And when they ask you, ‘Why are you groaning?’ you shall say, ‘Because of the news that is coming. Every heart will melt with fear and every hand go limp; every spirit will become faint and every leg will be wet with urine.’ It is coming! It will surely take place, declares the Sovereign Lord .”

source: Pakai thu chu avelin kahenga ahungin, hitin aseije.
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, gaovinlang seijin, Pakaiyin hitin aseije; chemjam khat, chemjam khat akinol hemin, akinotval ahitai.
target: “Son of man, prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Lord says: “ ‘A sword, a sword, sharpened and polished—

source: Hichu nasatah-a thagamna dinga kinol hem ahin; aduljetna dinga kinotval ahi. Achutile eihon eltol ibol jing diuham? hichun kachapa tenggol chu thingphung ho bangin ima asahpoi.
target: sharpened for the slaughter, polished to flash like lightning! “ ‘Shall we rejoice in the scepter of my royal son? The sword despises every such stick.

source: Chule aman hichu choithei ahina dingin, notval dinga apen: hiche chemjam hi mithatpa khutna pehdinga, kinol hema, kinotval ahitai.
target: “ ‘The sword is appointed to be polished, to be grasped with the hand; it is sharpened and polished, made ready for the hand of the slayer.

source: Mihem chapa, kapmin lang peng lhuh lhuh-in, ajehchu hichu kamite chunga chuding ahin, Israel pipuiho jouse chunga chuding ahi. Chemjam le tijatnaho kamite chunga chuding ahin; hijeh chun naphei chung bengin.
target: Cry out and wail, son of man, for it is against my people; it is against all the princes of Israel. They are thrown to the sword along with my people. Therefore beat your breast.

source: Ajehchu hichehi patepna ahin, chemjam chun tenggol jengjong chu i-asah loule iti tantem? chemjam chu umlou ding ahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: “ ‘Testing will surely come. And what if even the scepter, which the sword despises, does not continue? declares the Sovereign Lord .’

source: Hijeh chun mihem chapa, gaovin, nakhut teni chu bengton, chule athumvei nan chemjam ajatni hisah-in, mithana chemjam chu: hichu akithat milenho chemjam ahin, achangvalu indan sunglama lut chu ahi.
target: “So then, son of man, prophesy and strike your hands together. Let the sword strike twice, even three times. It is a sword for slaughter— a sword for great slaughter, closing in on them from every side.

source: Keiman alungu lhahsamna dingle, amanthah nau punsahna dingin, chuche chemjam muhhemho chu akotpihou dou dingin kaphutne: O! hichu duljetna kisema, mithana dinga kichuntup ahitai.
target: So that hearts may melt with fear and the fallen be many, I have stationed the sword for slaughter at all their gates. Look! It is forged to strike like lightning, it is grasped for slaughter.

source: Nangma lampi khat ahiloule adang khatna, jet lam hihen vei hijongle, namaijin angatna lamlama chetan.
target: Slash to the right, you sword, then to the left, wherever your blade is turned.

source: Keijong kakhut votongting, kalungsatna kingahsah tange; Pakai keiman kasei ahitai.
target: I too will strike my hands together, and my wrath will subside. I the Lord have spoken.”

source: Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung kitnin, hitin aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, nangman Babylon lengpa chemjam ahunglhun theina dingin, lampi ni semdoh-in; hichu gamkhatna kona hungdoh hiding ahi; chule nangman lampi komuna khat semin, khopi sungjotna lambul tah-a chun semin.
target: “Son of man, mark out two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to take, both starting from the same country. Make a signpost where the road branches off to the city.

source: Ammon mite kho Rabbath, chule aki umkul Judah gam Jerusalem'a chemjam chu ahunglhun theinadin, lampi khat gongin.
target: Mark out one road for the sword to come against Rabbah of the Ammonites and another against Judah and fortified Jerusalem.

source: Ajehchu Babylon lengpa chu lampi kikhen nalaitah, lampi ni bomtah-a, aisan din anadinge. Aman athalchang ho anotvalin, milimho adongin, sathin chu avetan ahi.
target: For the king of Babylon will stop at the fork in the road, at the junction of the two roads, to seek an omen: He will cast lots with arrows, he will consult his idols, he will examine the liver.

source: Akhut jetlama chun gal lamkaiho pansahna ding, mithana-a kam katna ding, thong jeju-a ao na ding, kotpiho nolhuhnaho koina ding, kulbang setsangna ding, chule galkul khat sahdoh nadinga Jerusalem dinga aisan na aumin,
target: Into his right hand will come the lot for Jerusalem, where he is to set up battering rams, to give the command to slaughter, to sound the battle cry, to set battering rams against the gates, to build a ramp and to erect siege works.

source: Chule akihahsel ho dinga, amitmuva aisan lhem banga kilang ding; ahia amaho chu kaimanga aum theina dinguva, aman akhan gitlounao ageldoh ding ahi.
target: It will seem like a false omen to those who have sworn allegiance to him, but he will remind them of their guilt and take them captive.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; nanghon nathemmonao geldoh-a naumsah kit jeh uva, hiche-a chu nasuhkhel nahou kihedoh-a, nabol jouseuva nachonset nao kilanga ahitai: Nangho geldoh-a nahung umtah jeh-un, khutna kaija umding nahitaove, tia kasei ahi.
target: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: ‘Because you people have brought to mind your guilt by your open rebellion, revealing your sins in all that you do—because you have done this, you will be taken captive.

source: Chule nang miboh khanggilou Israelte pipuipa, khansetnan kingahna aneiphatna, nanikho hung lhunga ahitai.
target: “ ‘You profane and wicked prince of Israel, whose day has come, whose time of punishment has reached its climax,

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije, nalal delkop chu ladoh-in lang, nalal lukhuh hohdoh-in; hichehi angai banga umjing louding ahi: anema chu choisangin lang, asanga chu sunemin.
target: this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Take off the turban, remove the crown. It will not be as it was: The lowly will be exalted and the exalted will be brought low.

source: Keiman hichu kalekhup ding, kalekhup ding, kelekhu ding; achang dingdol hungkahsea umkit talou ding ahi, chule keiman hichu ama kapehdoh ding ahi, ati.
target: A ruin! A ruin! I will make it a ruin! The crown will not be restored until he to whom it rightfully belongs shall come; to him I will give it.’

source: Chule mihem chapa, nangma gaovinlang seijin, Pakai Pathen'in Ammon chilhah mite thudolle, amaho seisetna thudola hitihin aseije: Nangmatah in seijin, Chemjam, chemjam chu akisatdoh tai, suhmangna dinga kisuval ahin, hichu mithana dinga kinot duljet ahi.
target: “And you, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says about the Ammonites and their insults: “ ‘A sword, a sword, drawn for the slaughter, polished to consume and to flash like lightning!

source: Amahon pannabei namupeh uva, doi aithemhon jouva nalhep uva, agilou kithat ho ngonga chuhsah ding nagot laijun, akhansetna houvin kingahna phat ahinnei tan, anikhou chu hunglhunga ahitai.
target: Despite false visions concerning you and lying divinations about you, it will be laid on the necks of the wicked who are to be slain, whose day has come, whose time of punishment has reached its climax.

source: Keiman hichu apaija kakile sahkit dingham? Keiman nakisem dohna mun, napen nagama nathu katan ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Let the sword return to its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your ancestry, I will judge you.

source: Chule keiman nachunga kalunghimona kasunlhah-a, kalungsatna meikou chu nangma lama kamutkhum ding, chule nangma mi engseho le misumang themho khutna kapehdoh ding nahi.
target: I will pour out my wrath on you and breathe out my fiery anger against you; I will deliver you into the hands of brutal men, men skilled in destruction.

source: Nangma meikouna dinga kito thinga napan ding; gamsung lailung tah-a nathisan longding: nangma geldoh-a naum kit louding ahi: ajehchu keima Pakaiyin kaseidoh ahitai.
target: You will be fuel for the fire, your blood will be shed in your land, you will be remembered no more; for I the Lord have spoken.’ ”

source: Chukalvalin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Tun nangma mihem chapa, nangman thu natan ding hija, thisan lonna khopi thu natan ding ham? Henge, nangman amanu chu athet umnaho jouse namusah ding ahi.
target: “Son of man, will you judge her? Will you judge this city of bloodshed? Then confront her with all her detestable practices

source: Chule hitin seijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, Amanu phat ahunglhun nadingin khopi hin alailungtah-a thisan ason, amale ama kisuhbohna dingin amato kidouding semthu limho akisemtan ahi.
target: and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: You city that brings on herself doom by shedding blood in her midst and defiles herself by making idols,

source: Nangma nathisan nasona-a chu themmo chang nahitan, chule nasemthu limho-a chu kisuboh nahitai; chule nanikho ho jong nakisuh naijin, nakumho jengjong ahung lhungtai. Hijeh-a chu Pathen heloute henga seiset le gamsung jouse totnopna-a kasem nahitai.
target: you have become guilty because of the blood you have shed and have become defiled by the idols you have made. You have brought your days to a close, and the end of your years has come. Therefore I will make you an object of scorn to the nations and a laughingstock to all the countries.

source: Nangma kom naija umho le gamla umhon, aminse-a le hesohna-a dim banga nanuisat dingu ahi.
target: Those who are near and those who are far away will mock you, you infamous city, full of turmoil.

source: Vetan, Israel pipuho, thisan sona thahat neijouse chu nangma-a um ahiuve.
target: “ ‘See how each of the princes of Israel who are in you uses his power to shed blood.

source: Nangma-a chun amahon nu le pate anoiseuvin, nalailung tah-a maljinho asugentheijun, nangma-a chun pabei le meithai chu asulung gimun ahi.
target: In you they have treated father and mother with contempt; in you they have oppressed the foreigner and mistreated the fatherless and the widow.

source: Nangman kathil thengho nanahsahpon, kacholngah nikhoho nasuboh-in ahi.
target: You have despised my holy things and desecrated my Sabbaths.

source: Nangma-a chun thisan sona ding thupole ho aumun, nangma-a um molsang ho chunga chun aneuvin, nalailung tah-a chun jonthanhoi abolun ahi.
target: In you are slanderers who are bent on shedding blood; in you are those who eat at the mountain shrines and commit lewd acts.

source: Nangma-a chun apateu sagohkeo hina ahohdoh-un; nangma-a chun numei boh kikoidoh hojong asuboh taove.
target: In you are those who dishonor their father’s bed; in you are those who violate women during their period, when they are ceremonially unclean.

source: Chule khatnin a-inhengpa inneipito thet umtah abolun; adang khatnin jonthanhoi thet umtah-in amounu asuhboh tan; chule nangma-a chun adang khatnin asopinu, apa chanu asusen ahi.
target: In you one man commits a detestable offense with his neighbor’s wife, another shamefully defiles his daughter-in-law, and another violates his sister, his own father’s daughter.

source: Nangma-a amahon thisan sonadin thilpeh alauvin; nangman sumthoi nahomin apung nakilah-in, chule nangman papse tah-in suhgenthei tothon na inhengpa-a nalah peh-in, keima neisumil tai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: In you are people who accept bribes to shed blood; you take interest and make a profit from the poor. You extort unjust gain from your neighbors. And you have forgotten me, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Vetan, hijeh-a chu keiman lamdih louva nanalambe hole, nalailung tah-a thisan kisoho chu kakhut kajel khumin ahi.
target: “ ‘I will surely strike my hands together at the unjust gain you have made and at the blood you have shed in your midst.

source: Keiman nangma kabolchah nikho teng nalungsungin athoh jouva, nakhut teni chu hatjou ding hinam? Pakai keiman hichu kasei ahin, chule hichu katohdoh ding ahi.
target: Will your courage endure or your hands be strong in the day I deal with you? I the Lord have spoken, and I will do it.

source: Chule keiman nangma Pathen heloute lah-a kathecheh-a, gamsungho-a kacheh chao sah ding, chule nanga kona nathenlounaho chu kasuh mangding ahi.
target: I will disperse you among the nations and scatter you through the countries; and I will put an end to your uncleanness.

source: Chule nangmatah in nagou chu Pathen heloute mitmu-a nakilah ding, chule nangman keima Pakai chu kahi nahin hetdoh ding ahi.
target: When you have been defiled in the eyes of the nations, you will know that I am the Lord .’ ”

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin aseije,
target: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Israel insung chu keima dingin thih eh ahung hitai. Amaho abonchauvin lhum lailung tah-a um sum eng, langva, thih chule ngen ahitaove. Amaho chu dangka eh ahiuve.
target: “Son of man, the people of Israel have become dross to me; all of them are the copper, tin, iron and lead left inside a furnace. They are but the dross of silver.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; nangho nabon chaova thih eh nahitah jeh-un, veuvin, hijeh-a chu keiman Jerusalem lailung tah-a nangho kachopkhom ding nahiuve.
target: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: ‘Because you have all become dross, I will gather you into Jerusalem.

source: Amahon dangka, sum eng, thih, ngen chule langva, lhumsunga achunga mei amutnuva hichu suhjun dinga achopkhom banguva; chutia chu keiman kalunghan nale kalungsatna-a chu nangho kachopkhom dingu, chule keiman chua chu nangho kadalhah den dingu, kajunlhah sah dingu ahi.
target: As silver, copper, iron, lead and tin are gathered into a furnace to be melted with a fiery blast, so will I gather you in my anger and my wrath and put you inside the city and melt you.

source: Henge, keiman kachom khom dingu, nachung uva kalungsatna lhummei chu kamut am ding, chule hiche sunga chu nangho najunlhah dingu ahi.
target: I will gather you and I will blow on you with my fiery wrath, and you will be melted inside her.

source: Lhummei lailunga dangka ajunlhah banga, chuche lailunga chu nangho najunlhah dingu; chutengle nanghon Pakai keiman nachung uva kalungsatna kasunlhah ahi chu nahet dingu ahi.
target: As silver is melted in a furnace, so you will be melted inside her, and you will know that I the Lord have poured out my wrath on you.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin ati,
target: Again the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, amanu henga seijin, nangma lunghanna nikho-a achunga go jengjong julou, suhthenglou gam chu nahije.
target: “Son of man, say to the land, ‘You are a land that has not been cleansed or rained on in the day of wrath.’

source: Keipi bahkaijin anehding abotela akitum bangin, amanu lailunga themgaoho lah-a guhthim thilgon aumin; amahon hinna ho aval lhumun, haonaho le thil lutahho alauvin; chuin amahon amanu lailung tah-a meithai tamtah asemdoh uve.
target: There is a conspiracy of her princes within her like a roaring lion tearing its prey; they devour people, take treasures and precious things and make many widows within her.

source: Amanu thempuhon keima dan asukeh uvin, kathil thengho asuboh-un; amahon atheng le athenglou akhen pouvin, angim le anen jong akhen pouvin, chule kacholngah nikho ho-a konin amitnu aselmangun, alah uva suhboh-in kaumtai.
target: Her priests do violence to my law and profane my holy things; they do not distinguish between the holy and the common; they teach that there is no difference between the unclean and the clean; and they shut their eyes to the keeping of my Sabbaths, so that I am profaned among them.

source: Amanu lailunga pipuiho chu thisan sodingle, hinna ho sumang ding, chule alamlouva neibe nadingin, aneh dingu bottela ngeihon abangun ahi.
target: Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey; they shed blood and kill people to make unjust gain.

source: Chule amanu themgaoho chu chilminlou leinganin akijutnuvin, pannabei jeng amuvin, jouvin ai asanpeh uvin, Pakaiyin aseilou jongle, Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije, atiuve.
target: Her prophets whitewash these deeds for them by false visions and lying divinations. They say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says’—when the Lord has not spoken.

source: Gamsung mipi ho chun suhgentheina amang chaovin, guchat michom abolun, vaicha le lhasamho chu asugimun; henge, amahon dihlou tah-in gamchom miho asugenthei jiuvin ahi.
target: The people of the land practice extortion and commit robbery; they oppress the poor and needy and mistreat the foreigner, denying them justice.

source: Chule gamsung chu kasuhmang louna dingin, amaho lah-a khattou apal gending le, kamasanga gam huhna-a aonglaija dingding kanaholin, hinlah koima kana mujoupoi.
target: “I looked for someone among them who would build up the wall and stand before me in the gap on behalf of the land so I would not have to destroy it, but I found no one.

source: Hijeh chun kalung himona achunguva kasunglhan; kalunghana meikonga amaho kasumangin; achonnau dungjuija lethuh nachu achunguva kapeh ahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: So I will pour out my wrath on them and consume them with my fiery anger, bringing down on their own heads all they have done, declares the Sovereign Lord .”

source: Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung kitnin, hitin aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, numei ni aumin, minu khat chanu ahilhone.
target: “Son of man, there were two women, daughters of the same mother.

source: Amanin Egypt'a jonthanhoi anabol lhonin, akhangdonlai lhonin jonthanhoi anabol lhone; hia chun anoi lhon ameh peh-un, nungah theng ahilhona anoimuh hon chu ameh peh-un ahi.
target: They became prostitutes in Egypt, engaging in prostitution from their youth. In that land their breasts were fondled and their virgin bosoms caressed.

source: Chule amani min chu alenjonu Aholah ahin, chule asopinu chu Aholibah ahi; amani chu keija ahilhonin, amanin chapate le chanuteho anahing lhone. Amin lhon chu hitihi ahi; Samaria chu Aholah ahin, chule Jerusalem chu Aholibah ahi.
target: The older was named Oholah, and her sister was Oholibah. They were mine and gave birth to sons and daughters. Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem.

source: Chule Aholah hi keija ahi laijin noti'n anapangin, chule amanun aheng akom Assyria miho akingaipin;
target: “Oholah engaged in prostitution while she was still mine; and she lusted after her lovers, the Assyrians—warriors

source: Amaho ponduma kivon gal lamkaiho le vaihomho, deichat umtah gal hang sakol chunga tou, sakol touthemho sakol chunga tou ngen ahiuve.
target: clothed in blue, governors and commanders, all of them handsome young men, and mounted horsemen.

source: Hitichun amanu chu amaho, Assyria lhendoh tum miho, chule akhohsahho jouse chutoh jonthanhoi anabolin; Alim semthuhou jouse-a chun amanu ana kisuboh tai.
target: She gave herself as a prostitute to all the elite of the Assyrians and defiled herself with all the idols of everyone she lusted after.

source: Amanun Egypt'a ahin kondohpi ajonthanhoina chu apailhadeh poi: ijeh-inem itile amanu chu akhangdon laija amahon ana luppiuva, anungah theng hina anoi teni amehpeh uva, chule ajonthanhoinao chu amanu chunga ana buhlhah-u ahi.
target: She did not give up the prostitution she began in Egypt, when during her youth men slept with her, caressed her virgin bosom and poured out their lust on her.

source: Hijeh-a chu keiman amanu chu akingaipiho khutna kapehdoh ahitan, akhohsah Assyria mite khutna kapehdoh ahitai.
target: “Therefore I delivered her into the hands of her lovers, the Assyrians, for whom she lusted.

source: Hiteho hin amanu sagohkeo chu ahoh lha uvin; achapate le achanu teho chu akilah-un, amanu chu chemjamin athat taove. Chutichun amanu numei lah-a ahung minthang tai; ajehchu amanu chunga thutanlhahna aneiju ahitai.
target: They stripped her naked, took away her sons and daughters and killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women, and punishment was inflicted on her.

source: Chule asopinu Aholibah chun hichu amu nungin, amingaina chu asopinu-a sangin akhoh cheh-in, chule asopinu jonthanhoina sangin amanu jonthanhoina chu akhohcheh-in ahi.
target: “Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet in her lust and prostitution she was more depraved than her sister.

source: Amanun aheng akomho Assyria mite, vethoi tah-a kivon lamkaiho le vaihomho, sakol chunga tou sakol touthemho, deidei um gollhangho jouse chu angaichan ahi.
target: She too lusted after the Assyrians—governors and commanders, warriors in full dress, mounted horsemen, all handsome young men.

source: Chujouvin amanu suhboh-a auma, anilhona lampi khat ajuihon kanamui.
target: I saw that she too defiled herself; both of them went the same way.

source: Chuin amanun pasal ho lim banga kitah, Chaldea miho lim bangchunga sanpeh-a kijih-a amu phatnin, ajonthanhoi naho apunsahbe cheh-in,
target: “But she carried her prostitution still further. She saw men portrayed on a wall, figures of Chaldeans portrayed in red,

source: Amahon ataija konggah akigah cheh-un, alu-a delkop hoitah akikop cheh-un, apennau Chaldea gam Babylon miho umdan dungjuija amaho gahvet dinga pipuiho mel pucheh ahiuve.
target: with belts around their waists and flowing turbans on their heads; all of them looked like Babylonian chariot officers, natives of Chaldea.

source: Amanun amaho amit teni-a agahmu mu chun, achunguva ngaichatna aneipai jengin, chule Chaldea gamsunga amaho henga thupo ho asoltan ahi.
target: As soon as she saw them, she lusted after them and sent messengers to them in Chaldea.

source: Chule Babylon miho chu amanu henga ahungun kingailutna jalkhuna alut uvin, amahon amanu chu ajonthanhoinao vin asuboh uvin; chuin amanu chu amahoto suhboh-in aumin, chule amanu lunggel chu amaho-a konin khendoh ahitan ahi.
target: Then the Babylonians came to her, to the bed of love, and in their lust they defiled her. After she had been defiled by them, she turned away from them in disgust.

source: Hitichun amanun ajonthanhoina le sagohkeo ahina ahohdoh tan; hichun kalunggel asopinu-a kona khendoh-a anaum bang bangin, amanu-a konin khendoh-in aumtan ahi.
target: When she carried on her prostitution openly and exposed her naked body, I turned away from her in disgust, just as I had turned away from her sister.

source: Achutijeng vanginla, amanun akhangdonlai nikhoho, Egypt gama noti'a anakicheplai chu agahgeldoh kitnin, ajonthanhoina ho apunsah cheh-in ahi.
target: Yet she became more and more promiscuous as she recalled the days of her youth, when she was a prostitute in Egypt.

source: Ajehchu amanun adongmaho, atahsao jong sangan tahsa tobang, chule abotwi ujong sakol botwi tobang ho chu angaicha lheh jengin ahi.
target: There she lusted after her lovers, whose genitals were like those of donkeys and whose emission was like that of horses.

source: Hitichun nangman nakhangdon laija najon thanhoina le, nakhangdon laija nanoi teni Egypt miten ameh chu nageldoh-in ahi.
target: So you longed for the lewdness of your youth, when in Egypt your bosom was caressed and your young breasts fondled.

source: Hijeh chun, Vo Aholibah, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Ven, keiman nakingaipiho, nalunggel khendoh-a anaum naho chu nangma dou dinga katundoh ding, chule nangma dou dinga gamkai jouse-a kona kahinpui ding,
target: “Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will stir up your lovers against you, those you turned away from in disgust, and I will bring them against you from every side—

source: Babylon miho le Chaldea miho jouse, Pekod, Shoa, Koa, chule Assyria mite jouse toh; abonchauva son umtah gollhangho, gal lamkaiho chule vaihomho, milenho le mi minthangho, abonchauva sakol chunga tou ahiuve.
target: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, the men of Pekod and Shoa and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them, handsome young men, all of them governors and commanders, chariot officers and men of high rank, all mounted on horses.

source: Chule amaho nangma doudinga sakol kangtalai ho, thilpo kangtalai ho, kangtalai kangho toh, mihonpi kiloikhom toh hungkon uva, amaho chun lum le pho, chule thih lukhuh atho uva naum kimvel dingu; chule keiman amaho masanga thutanna kapeh ding, chule amahon amaho thutanlhah dungjuija nachung thu atan dingu ahi.
target: They will come against you with weapons, chariots and wagons and with a throng of people; they will take up positions against you on every side with large and small shields and with helmets. I will turn you over to them for punishment, and they will punish you according to their standards.

source: Chule keiman nangma chunga kathangthipna kachuh sah-a, amahon nangma lunghang tah-a nabol dingu; amahon nanah lhongle nabil teni aloilhah dingu, chule nangma-a ahingdoh umnalai chu chemjam'a louding ahi. Amahon nachapa te le nachanute akilahdiu; chule nangma-a ahingdoh amoh umchengse chu meikouvin avallhum dingu ahi.
target: I will direct my jealous anger against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will cut off your noses and your ears, and those of you who are left will fall by the sword. They will take away your sons and daughters, and those of you who are left will be consumed by fire.

source: Amahon naponho nahodohpeh uva, chule nasongmantam hoiho nalahpeh dingu ahi.
target: They will also strip you of your clothes and take your fine jewelry.

source: Chutia chu nangma amaho heng lama nakhodah louna dingle, Egypt mite jong nageldoh kit tahlou dinga; keiman najon thanhoina chule Egypt gama kona nahinpoh najon thanhoina chu nanga kona kasuhtang ding ahi.
target: So I will put a stop to the lewdness and prostitution you began in Egypt. You will not look on these things with longing or remember Egypt anymore.

source: Ijeh inem itile Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; ven, keiman nangman namuda ho khutna, amaho jeh-a nangma lungsung khendoh-a aumnaho khutna kapehlut ding nahi.
target: “For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am about to deliver you into the hands of those you hate, to those you turned away from in disgust.

source: Chule amaho chun nangma thet umtah-a nahinbol dingu, chule nalodoh jouse nalahpeh dingu, sagohkeo le keohela nahinlha uva: chule najon thanhoina le nahuhna chu agoma sagohkeova kihohdoh ding ahi.
target: They will deal with you in hatred and take away everything you have worked for. They will leave you stark naked, and the shame of your prostitution will be exposed. Your lewdness and promiscuity

source: Keiman hicheho hi nachunga kabol ding ahi, ajehchu nangma Pathen helouho bangin jonthanhoi nabolin, amaho semthu limho-a chun naki suhboh tai.
target: have brought this on you, because you lusted after the nations and defiled yourself with their idols.

source: Nangma nasopinu lampia nachetan, hijeh-a chu amanu khon chu nangma khutna kapeh ding ahi.
target: You have gone the way of your sister; so I will put her cup into your hand.

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije, Nangman nasopinu khon thuhtah le lentah chu nadonjou hel ding, nangma i-sah louva nuisatna chule nahsahmo-a naum ding ahi, hichun tamtah adol ahi.
target: “This is what the Sovereign Lord says: “You will drink your sister’s cup, a cup large and deep; it will bring scorn and derision, for it holds so much.

source: Nangma nasopinu Samaria khon, kidangsahna le thomhaona khona kon, lunggimna le lunghemna nadon ding ahi.
target: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, the cup of ruin and desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria.

source: Nangman hichu nadonna nachep kanghel ding, chule akhon chu teldeh-a nalha ding, chule na noi teni ngeijong chu naloidoh ding ahi. Ajehchu keiman kasei ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: You will drink it and drain it dry and chew on its pieces— and you will tear your breasts. I have spoken, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije, Nangman neisuhmila, nanung lama neipaitah jeh-in, nahuhna le najon thanhoi naho nangman kipohtan.
target: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Since you have forgotten me and turned your back on me, you must bear the consequences of your lewdness and prostitution.”

source: Pakaiyin kahenga aseibe kitnin, Mihem chapa, nangman Aholah chule Aholibah chunga thu natan ding ham? Henge, thet aumnalhon ho chu phondoh pehtan.
target: The Lord said to me: “Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then confront them with their detestable practices,

source: Amanin jon abol lhonin, akhut lhona thisan aumin, amilim hon hotoh ajonglhonin, chule amanin keima eihinpeh lhon achapatehou jong kahvam sahdin meikong apalsah lhone.
target: for they have committed adultery and blood is on their hands. They committed adultery with their idols; they even sacrificed their children, whom they bore to me, as food for them.

source: Chukalvalin amanin hiche jonghi kahenga abolhone: chule hiche nikho mama chun kamun theng asuboh lhonin, kacholngah nikhoho asuboh lhontai.
target: They have also done this to me: At that same time they defiled my sanctuary and desecrated my Sabbaths.

source: Ajehchu amanin achateu alim semthu henga athajou lhon chun, hiche nikho mama chun ahunglhonin ka-intheng asuboh lhonin ahi; chule veuvin, amanin ka-insung laitah-a hitichun abolhonin ahi.
target: On the very day they sacrificed their children to their idols, they entered my sanctuary and desecrated it. That is what they did in my house.

source: Chubanin jong, gamlatah-a kona pasal ho ahungna dingun, ahenguva thupole khat nasolhonin; chule veuvin, amaho ahunguvin ahi. Chuin amaho dingin nangma nakisil theng selin, namit teni najemin, chule jephoina-a nakijemin ahi.
target: “They even sent messengers for men who came from far away, and when they arrived you bathed yourself for them, applied eye makeup and put on your jewelry.

source: Chule jalkhun guntah khat chunga natouvin, hiche masanga chun dokhang khat nagongin, chule achunga chun nangman keima gimnamtui ho le thao chu natung doh-in ahi.
target: You sat on an elegant couch, with a table spread before it on which you had placed the incense and olive oil that belonged to me.

source: Chule khohsahna bei mipi honkhat awgin amanu koma aumuvin; chule akhutnuva chao kibuho chule aluchung uva lallukhuh hoitahtah-a kikhuh gamthipma kona Sebia mite chu milham pasal ho toh ahin puijuvin ahi.
target: “The noise of a carefree crowd was around her; drunkards were brought from the desert along with men from the rabble, and they put bracelets on the wrists of the woman and her sister and beautiful crowns on their heads.

source: Chujouvin keiman ajonthanhoi bolna-a tehtasa amanu chungchanga chun, Tun amahon amanu chutoh, amanun amaho chuto jonthanhoi aboldiu vem? kati.
target: Then I said about the one worn out by adultery, ‘Now let them use her as a prostitute, for that is all she is.’

source: Ahijeng vangin amaho chu noti numei khat henga lut bangin amanu henga alut taove. Hitichun amaho numei huh teni, Aholah le Aholibah henga alut taove.
target: And they slept with her. As men sleep with a prostitute, so they slept with those lewd women, Oholah and Oholibah.

source: Chule pasal chonphatah hon amanu chunga numei jongho chondan dungjui le, numei thisanso ho dungjuija athu-u atan dingu ahi; ajehchu amani numei jong ahilhonin, chule akhutlhona thisan abeh-in ahi.
target: But righteous judges will sentence them to the punishment of women who commit adultery and shed blood, because they are adulterous and blood is on their hands.

source: Ajehchu Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; keiman mi honkhat amani chunga kahinpui ding, chule amani chu toldoh dingle chomgam dinga kapehdoh ding ahi.
target: “This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Bring a mob against them and give them over to terror and plunder.

source: Chule hiche mihonpi chun amani songa ase dingu, chule chemjam'a atha dingu; amahon achapateu le achanuteu athagam dingu, chule a-inhou chu meija ahalvam dingu ahi.
target: The mob will stone them and cut them down with their swords; they will kill their sons and daughters and burn down their houses.

source: Hitia chu gamsunga jonthanhoina kasuh tanga, najon thanhoina lhon chu ajuilouna dinguva numei ho jouse kihilchah ding ahiuve.
target: “So I will put an end to lewdness in the land, that all women may take warning and not imitate you.

source: Chule amahon najon thanhoina lhon chu nachung lhona alethuh uva, nalim semthu lhonin chonset naho chu nakipoh lhon ding ahi; chutengle keima Pakai Pathen kahi nahet lhon ding ahi.
target: You will suffer the penalty for your lewdness and bear the consequences of your sins of idolatry. Then you will know that I am the Sovereign Lord .”

source: Avelin, kumko lhinna, alha somna sunga nisom lhinni chun Pakai thu kahenga ahungin, hitin aseije.
target: In the ninth year, in the tenth month on the tenth day, the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, nangman nikho min chu jihdoh-in, tuni nikho tah hin jih-in; hiche nikho-a hi Babylon lengpan Jerusalem adoupat ahi.
target: “Son of man, record this date, this very date, because the king of Babylon has laid siege to Jerusalem this very day.

source: Chule golkehjing insung henga thulem khat seipeh-in lang, ahenguva hitin seijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; Belkhat songin, hichu songdoh-in, chule asunga chun twi jong sunglutnin.
target: Tell this rebellious people a parable and say to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: “ ‘Put on the cooking pot; put it on and pour water into it.

source: Sa halho asunga chun henglutnin, ahal aphalai jouse, apheipi le adahbul ngei chu asunga chun henglutnin; hichu agu phaho-a chun bel chu dip dimin.
target: Put into it the pieces of meat, all the choice pieces—the leg and the shoulder. Fill it with the best of these bones;

source: Gancha hon lah-a konin deilhen ho chu lanlang, anoija chun aguho chu gouvin, chule hichu phatechan honin lang, hichun aguho chu honsouhen.
target: take the pick of the flock. Pile wood beneath it for the bones; bring it to a boil and cook the bones in it.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, thisanso khopi, beltonat asunga umnalai, chule beltonat asunga kona lheidoh loulai chu, ohe ada ahiuve! asunga konin khat khatnin ladoh-in, vang sanin lheng hih-in.
target: “ ‘For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: “ ‘Woe to the city of bloodshed, to the pot now encrusted, whose deposit will not go away! Take the meat out piece by piece in whatever order it comes.

source: Ijeh-inem itile amanu thisan chu amanu lailung tah-a aumin, hichu amanun songpi khat chunga atungdoh-in, leivuija khu dingin tollah alheilhapoi.
target: “ ‘For the blood she shed is in her midst: She poured it on the bare rock; she did not pour it on the ground, where the dust would cover it.

source: Chutia chu hichun phula dinga lungsatna ahinsodoh sahna ding, chule amanu thisan chu khukhum ahilouna dinga, keiman songpi chunga kalonsah ahitai.
target: To stir up wrath and take revenge I put her blood on the bare rock, so that it would not be covered.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; thisanso khopi chu ohe adana-e! keiman nasatah-a meikou ahina dinga thing kasetvum ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: “ ‘Woe to the city of bloodshed! I, too, will pile the wood high.

source: Thing sevumun, mei choh kongun, aphe chu phatechan honun, chule phatechan namtui sah-un, chule aguho chu gouvamun.
target: So heap on the wood and kindle the fire. Cook the meat well, mixing in the spices; and let the bones be charred.

source: Chutengle hiche sum-eng chu ahungsat doh-a akahtheina ding, chule asunga athenglou chu ajunlhah-a, atonat chu akahvam theina dingin, mei chunga chun belkeo chu songdoh-in.
target: Then set the empty pot on the coals till it becomes hot and its copper glows, so that its impurities may be melted and its deposit burned away.

source: Amanu jouvin akisuchol tan, chule amanu-a konin atonat nasatah chu apotdohpoi; atonat chu meikouva umden hen.
target: It has frustrated all efforts; its heavy deposit has not been removed, not even by fire.

source: Nathenlouna-a chun huhna aumin ahi; ajehchu nangma kasuh thengin, hinla nangma nathengpoi, kalungsatna nachunga kangap kahse-a, nathenlouna-a kona nathen kit louding nahitai.
target: “ ‘Now your impurity is lewdness. Because I tried to cleanse you but you would not be cleansed from your impurity, you will not be clean again until my wrath against you has subsided.

source: Pakai keiman hichehi kasei ahitai. Hichu hung guilhung ding, chule keiman hichu kaboltei ding, kakinungtol louding, khenjong kakhen louding, kisihjong kisih louding, nalampi ho dungjuile na natohho dungjuija amahon nachung thu atantei dingu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: “ ‘I the Lord have spoken. The time has come for me to act. I will not hold back; I will not have pity, nor will I relent. You will be judged according to your conduct and your actions, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ ”

source: Chujongle Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, ven, keiman namit tenin avetnom chu khatvei jepmin nangma-a konin kaladoh tai; hijeng jongle nangma lungjong nalunghem louding, ka jong naka louding, namitlhi jong nalonlhah sah louding ahi.
target: “Son of man, with one blow I am about to take away from you the delight of your eyes. Yet do not lament or weep or shed any tears.

source: Kap hih-in, athiho dingin lunghem jong bolhih-in, nalukop nalu-a kikopmin, nakengto teni-a nakengchot kisen, nane jong huphih-in, chule mihem anneh jong nehih-in, ati.
target: Groan quietly; do not mourn for the dead. Keep your turban fastened and your sandals on your feet; do not cover your mustache and beard or eat the customary food of mourners.”

source: Hitichun jingkah-in mipi ho henga thu kaseijin, nilhang kaijin ka-inneipi athitan; chule jingkah-in thu eikipeh bangin kaboltai.
target: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and in the evening my wife died. The next morning I did as I had been commanded.

source: Chuin mipi chun kahenga hitin aseijuve, hiche nathilbol hohi keiho dinga ipi ahiding neiseipehlou dingu ham? atiuve.
target: Then the people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things have to do with us? Why are you acting like this?”

source: Chuin keiman amaho kadonbut nin, Pakai thu chu kehenga ahungin, hitin aseije,
target: So I said to them, “The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Israel insung henga seipeh-in, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Veuvin, keiman kamun theng, nangho nathahat naloupi nao, namitnun avetnomhou, chule nahinnaovin akhoto chu kasuhboh ding, chule nadalhah-u nachapateo le nachanuteu chu chemjam'a loudingu ahi.
target: Say to the people of Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am about to desecrate my sanctuary—the stronghold in which you take pride, the delight of your eyes, the object of your affection. The sons and daughters you left behind will fall by the sword.

source: Chule keiman kabol bang nabol dingu, nanghon namuh-u nahup loudingu, mihem anneh jong naneh loudingu ahi.
target: And you will do as I have done. You will not cover your mustache and beard or eat the customary food of mourners.

source: Chule nalu chunguva delkop nakikop uva, chule nakenguva kengchot nakise uva, nalunghem loudiu kajong nakalou dingu; ahia nagitlounaova nalhahsuh uva khatle khat nakilunghem to diu ahi.
target: You will keep your turbans on your heads and your sandals on your feet. You will not mourn or weep but will waste away because of your sins and groan among yourselves.

source: Hitia chu Ezekiel hi nangho dinga melchihna ahi; aman abol hojouse dungjui cheh-a nanghon naboltei dingu ahin; chule hichehi ahunglhun teng, nanghon keima Pakai Pathen kahi nahet dingu ahi.
target: Ezekiel will be a sign to you; you will do just as he has done. When this happens, you will know that I am the Sovereign Lord .’

source: Chujongle nangma mihem chapa, keiman amaho-a kona athahatnao, aloupi naova akipanao, amit teniu deichat, chule amahon alunggelu kingapna-a aneihou, achapateu le chanuteu kalahmang nikho tengle,
target: “And you, son of man, on the day I take away their stronghold, their joy and glory, the delight of their eyes, their heart’s desire, and their sons and daughters as well—

source: Hiche nikho-a asohcha chapa chu hunga, nanakhanga nahung jahsah louding ham?
target: on that day a fugitive will come to tell you the news.

source: Hiche nikho chule ahung sohchapa henga nakam kihong ding, chule nangman thu naseidoh ding, chule paomo-a naum kit tahlou ding; chule nangma amaho dinga melchihna khat nahung hiding; amahon keima Pakai kahi ahinhet dingu ahi.
target: At that time your mouth will be opened; you will speak with him and will no longer be silent. So you will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am the Lord .”

source: Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung kitnin, hitin aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Ammon mite dounan namai ngatnin lang, amaho dounan gaothu seijin.
target: “Son of man, set your face against the Ammonites and prophesy against them.

source: Chule Ammon mite henga seijin, Pakai Pathen thuhi ngaijun; akisuhboh laija nangman kamun theng douna-a, chule akamhel laija Israel gamsung douna, chule gal hinga akikai mang laijuva Judah insung douna-a Aha, tia nasei jeh-in, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije,
target: Say to them, ‘Hear the word of the Sovereign Lord . This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because you said “Aha!” over my sanctuary when it was desecrated and over the land of Israel when it was laid waste and over the people of Judah when they went into exile,

source: Ven, hijeh chun keiman solam mite alo diuva nangma kapehdoh teiding, chule amahon nangma insunga aleng inpihou atundoh dingu; nangma insunga achendetna inhou akisah dingu, amahon naga chu aneh uva chule nanoitwi adontei dingu ahi.
target: therefore I am going to give you to the people of the East as a possession. They will set up their camps and pitch their tents among you; they will eat your fruit and drink your milk.

source: Chule keiman Rabbah chu sangongsang ho gena buh, chule Ammon mite ganchaho kolna munkhat kahinso ding ahin; chutengle nanghon keima Pakai chu kahi nahet dingu ahi.
target: I will turn Rabbah into a pasture for camels and Ammon into a resting place for sheep. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

source: Ajehchu Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Nangman Israel gam douna-a nakhut teni nabeh-a, nakeng teni-a nalho-a, chule nalungthima i-sah louna jousetoh nakipa jeh-in,
target: For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because you have clapped your hands and stamped your feet, rejoicing with all the malice of your heart against the land of Israel,

source: Vetan, hijeh-a chu keiman nangma chunga kakhut kajah-a, chule Pathen helouho henga galthil chom dinga kapehdoh ding; chule keiman mipi lah-a kona kasatlhah-a, gamjousea kona kamanthah sah ding; nangma kasuhmang ding; chutengle keima Pakai kahi nahin hetding ahi.
target: therefore I will stretch out my hand against you and give you as plunder to the nations. I will wipe you out from among the nations and exterminate you from the countries. I will destroy you, and you will know that I am the Lord .’ ”

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Veuvin, Moab le Seir jengin jong, Judah insung chu Pathen heloute jouse tobang ahi tia, asei jeh uvin,
target: “This is what the Sovereign Lord says: ‘Because Moab and Seir said, “Look, Judah has become like all the other nations,”

source: Hijeh chun, veuvin, keiman Moab khopi jet le vei jouse, khopi sunga gam nomcheh Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon chule Kiriathaim-a jong kamhela kalha ding ahi.
target: therefore I will expose the flank of Moab, beginning at its frontier towns—Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon and Kiriathaim—the glory of that land.

source: Ammon mite chu namtin lah-a geldoh-a aumkit louna dinguva, solam mite chu Ammon mite toh alo dinguva kapehdoh ding ahi.
target: I will give Moab along with the Ammonites to the people of the East as a possession, so that the Ammonites will not be remembered among the nations;

source: Chule keiman Moab chunga thu katan ding; chuteng amahon keima Pakai kahi akihet dingu ahi.
target: and I will inflict punishment on Moab. Then they will know that I am the Lord .’ ”

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; Edom'in phulah na-a Judah insung douna abola, hatah-a asuhmoa, ama tah-in achunguva phu alah jeh-in,
target: “This is what the Sovereign Lord says: ‘Because Edom took revenge on Judah and became very guilty by doing so,

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen chun hitin aseije; Kenjong Edom chunga kakhut kalapma, ama-a kona mi le sa katha gama, Teman kho-a patna kakamhelsah-a, Dedan'a miho chu chemjam'a louding ahiuve.
target: therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will stretch out my hand against Edom and kill both man and beast. I will lay it waste, and from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword.

source: Chule Edom chunga kaphulahna chu kami Israel khutna kangap ding ahin, chule amahon Edom chunga kalunghana le kalungsatna dungjuija aboldingu; chule kaphulahna chu amahon ahet dingu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: I will take vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel, and they will deal with Edom in accordance with my anger and my wrath; they will know my vengeance, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ ”

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije, Philistine ten phulahna anaboluva, chule taitomna lunggel totho-a malai kihotna jeh-a susehel khop dinga anakiphulah jeh-un,
target: “This is what the Sovereign Lord says: ‘Because the Philistines acted in vengeance and took revenge with malice in their hearts, and with ancient hostility sought to destroy Judah,

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Veuvin, keiman Philistine te chunga kakhut kajahdoh-a, Cherethim ho chu kasuhtana, twipi panga um amohho chu kasuhmang ding ahi.
target: therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am about to stretch out my hand against the Philistines, and I will wipe out the Kerethites and destroy those remaining along the coast.

source: Chule keiman lungsa tah-a phosalnaho toh tho-a amaho chunga nasatah-a phu kalah ding, keiman amaho chunga phulahna kachuhsah teng, amahon keima Pakai kahi chu ahet dingu ahi.
target: I will carry out great vengeance on them and punish them in my wrath. Then they will know that I am the Lord , when I take vengeance on them.’ ”

source: Chuin kum somle kum khatna, lhasunga ni masapen nin ahung hitin ahi, Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, hitin aseije,
target: In the eleventh month of the twelfth year, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Tyre'in Jerusalem douna-a, Aha, amanu mite kotpiho anahisa chu achimlhatai! amanun keilam ahin ngatai: tun amanu kitung thop ahitan, keima kapun theiding ahitai, ati.
target: “Son of man, because Tyre has said of Jerusalem, ‘Aha! The gate to the nations is broken, and its doors have swung open to me; now that she lies in ruins I will prosper,’

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Vo Tyre, ven keiman nangma kodou nahi, twipin twi akinon tousah banga, nangma kidoupi dinga nam tamtah kahin toltou ding ahi.
target: therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring many nations against you, like the sea casting up its waves.

source: Chule amahon Tyre kulbang jouse asuhsetnuva, amanu insangho asuhchim diu, keiman amanu-a kona vutvai kaphet thenga, chule amanu chu songpi chungvum tobang kaso ding ahi.
target: They will destroy the walls of Tyre and pull down her towers; I will scrape away her rubble and make her a bare rock.

source: Hichu twipi lailunga lenho kijalna ding mun hung hiding ahi. Ajehchu keiman kaseidohsa ahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije, chule hichu namtin dinga kivahna hung hiding ahi.
target: Out in the sea she will become a place to spread fishnets, for I have spoken, declares the Sovereign Lord . She will become plunder for the nations,

source: Chule amanu chanute loulaija umho chu chemjam'a kithat gamdiu, amahon keima Pakai kahi ahinhet dingu ahi.
target: and her settlements on the mainland will be ravaged by the sword. Then they will know that I am the Lord .

source: Ajehchu Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; veuvin, lengho leng, Babylon lengpa, Nabuchadnezzar chu sakol ho, kangtalai ho, chule sakolchung touho, chule loi tampile mipi tamtah toh lhona sahlam sanga kona Tyre chunga kahinchuhsah ding ahi.
target: “For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: From the north I am going to bring against Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, with horses and chariots, with horsemen and a great army.

source: Ama chun loulaija nachanute chu chemjam'a atha ding; nangma douna-a kulpi asahdoh-a, nangma douna-a molsang khat ase sang ding, chule nangma douna-a apho adop sang ding ahi.
target: He will ravage your settlements on the mainland with the sword; he will set up siege works against you, build a ramp up to your walls and raise his shields against you.

source: Chule aman nakul bangho douna-a gal manchah ho atundoh-a, chule aheichaho-a na insangho aphuh lhuh ding ahi.
target: He will direct the blows of his battering rams against your walls and demolish your towers with his weapons.

source: Ama sakol ho atambehseh jeh-a amaho vutvai chun nangma nakhu khum ding; mihon kohom akisemuva khopi sung alut banguva, ama nakelkot ahunglut tengleh sakol chungtou mihole, kangtalai kangho, chule sakol kangtalai ho hugin-a nakul bangho chu kihot ling ding ahi.
target: His horses will be so many that they will cover you with dust. Your walls will tremble at the noise of the warhorses, wagons and chariots when he enters your gates as men enter a city whose walls have been broken through.

source: Asakolho kengin nakhopi lamlenho achotpha ding; aman namiteho chemjam'a atha ding, chule nagalsat miho umna mun dettahho chu chimlha ding ahiuve.
target: The hooves of his horses will trample all your streets; he will kill your people with the sword, and your strong pillars will fall to the ground.

source: Chule amahon nahaonaho chu akichom diu, nakiveinaho anehmanguva, nakul bangho asuhchimdiu, na in nomtah ho chu asuhset dingu: amahon nasongho, nathingho, chule navutvai ho chu twi lailunga akoidiu ahi.
target: They will plunder your wealth and loot your merchandise; they will break down your walls and demolish your fine houses and throw your stones, timber and rubble into the sea.

source: Chuteng keiman nalasah ginho kasuhthip ding, chule naselangdah gin chu kijakit louding ahi.
target: I will put an end to your noisy songs, and the music of your harps will be heard no more.

source: Chule keiman nangman songpi chungvum banga kasemding; miho lenthang jalna mun nahiding, sahphatna naum lou ding ahitai; ajehchu Pakai keiman kaphohdoh ahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: I will make you a bare rock, and you will become a place to spread fishnets. You will never be rebuilt, for I the Lord have spoken, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Pakai Pathen'in Tyre henga hitin aseije; mahapuho apena, nalai lunga mithiho aumtengle, nangma lhuh ginna chu twikolho kihotlou dingu ham?
target: “This is what the Sovereign Lord says to Tyre: Will not the coastlands tremble at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan and the slaughter takes place in you?

source: Chuteng chule twikhanglen'a leng chapate jouse chu alaltounaova kona hung kumlha dingu, chule asangkhol hou akoidoh uva, akijephoinau avonhou chu asutlhah dingu ahi. Amaho chu kithing thinguva tol lhanga tou dingu, chule amaho tanglou hela kihot hot dingu, chule nangma nadatmo dingu ahi.
target: Then all the princes of the coast will step down from their thrones and lay aside their robes and take off their embroidered garments. Clothed with terror, they will sit on the ground, trembling every moment, appalled at you.

source: Chule amahon nangma dinga kala aboluva, hitia asei dingu ahi; Itidana twipi chunga lamlhale miho chenna mun, khopi minthang tah, twipi chunga hattah, amale asunga chengho, akimaitopi jouse tijatsah jeng nangma iti kisuhmang nahi hitam!
target: Then they will take up a lament concerning you and say to you: “ ‘How you are destroyed, city of renown, peopled by men of the sea! You were a power on the seas, you and your citizens; you put your terror on all who lived there.

source: Tu-a nangma lhuhna nikho-a hi twikolho chu kihot hot dingu; chule twipi sunga um twikolho chu nadalhah jeh-a lunggim lheh dingu ahi.
target: Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your fall; the islands in the sea are terrified at your collapse.’

source: Ajehchu Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; keiman nangma chennalou khopiho, akamhel khopi khatna kahinsem teng; keiman twithuh chu kahinlah touva nachunga kahinlhutna, twi lentah ho chun nahinchup teng;
target: “This is what the Sovereign Lord says: When I make you a desolate city, like cities no longer inhabited, and when I bring the ocean depths over you and its vast waters cover you,

source: Chule keiman nangma kokhuh sunga lhalut ho leh, malaija mipi ho toh kapuilhah khoma, kokhuh sunga chelut ho toh thakhatna nangma chenlouna mun nahina dinga, malaija patna anakamdel leiset mun nempena kakoiteng; mihing gama chu loupina kaumsah ding ahi.
target: then I will bring you down with those who go down to the pit, to the people of long ago. I will make you dwell in the earth below, as in ancient ruins, with those who go down to the pit, and you will not return or take your place in the land of the living.

source: Keiman nangma tijatna khatna kasemdoh ding, chule nangma naum kit tahlou ding ahi; nangma nahung kihol jeng jongle, kimukit louding nahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: I will bring you to a horrible end and you will be no more. You will be sought, but you will never again be found, declares the Sovereign Lord .”

source: Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung kitnin, hitin aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Tyre dingin kala gabolin,
target: “Son of man, take up a lament concerning Tyre.

source: Chule Tyre henga hitin gaseijin, O nangma twipi lutna laitah-a um, twikol tamtah-a chengho dinga kiveina, Vo Tyre, Pakai Pathen'in aseije; nangman, Keima melhoi chamkim kahi, tin naseije.
target: Say to Tyre, situated at the gateway to the sea, merchant of peoples on many coasts, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: “ ‘You say, Tyre, “I am perfect in beauty.”

source: Nangma gamgi chu twikhanglen lailunga aumin, nasadoh hon nangma melhoi asuchamkim taove.
target: Your domain was on the high seas; your builders brought your beauty to perfection.

source: Amahon nakong lhongho jouse chu Senir gamsung chahthingho ngenin asemun; amahon nangma ding kong khom kitung sangpen ho semna dingin Lebanon'a konin cedar thingho alauve.
target: They made all your timbers of juniper from Senir; they took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.

source: Nakong kheho chu Bashan gangpiho-a konin asemun, Ashur mi kiloikhom hon Chittim twikolho-a kona kipodoh saiha mangchan tongkham saoho nasempeh taove.
target: Of oaks from Bashan they made your oars; of cypress wood from the coasts of Cyprus they made your deck, adorned with ivory.

source: Egypt'a kona kijempah tupatpon neljet chu nangman nakong ponjal dinga namang chan, Elishah twikolho-a kon pondum le ponsandup chu nangma nakhu-a chu ahi.
target: Fine embroidered linen from Egypt was your sail and served as your banner; your awnings were of blue and purple from the coasts of Elishah.

source: Nakong tol ho chu Zidon le Arvad'a cheng miho ahiuvin, vo Tyre nangma sunga um na michingho chu nakong tolho ahiuve.
target: Men of Sidon and Arvad were your oarsmen; your skilled men, Tyre, were aboard as your sailors.

source: Gebal'a upalui hole amaho lah-a michingho chu nangma sunga kong thoibit ho ahiuvin; twipia um kong jousele atol ho jouse chu nasumkol veina thilho najohpeh dingin nanga aumuve.
target: Veteran craftsmen of Byblos were on board as shipwrights to caulk your seams. All the ships of the sea and their sailors came alongside to trade for your wares.

source: Persia le Lud chule Phut miho chu nasipai le nagalsat miho ahiuvin, amahon nangma lumle thih lukhuh navonpeh-un, amahon namel lomna atahlang uve.
target: “ ‘Men of Persia, Lydia and Put served as soldiers in your army. They hung their shields and helmets on your walls, bringing you splendor.

source: Arvad miho chu nagalsat miho toh nakul bangho chung kimvela aumuvin, chule Gammadim miho chu na insangho-a aumui; amahon alumhou nakul bangho kimvel chunga akhaijun, nangma mel hoina achamkimsah-un ahi.
target: Men of Arvad and Helek guarded your walls on every side; men of Gammad were in your towers. They hung their shields around your walls; they brought your beauty to perfection.

source: Haona tincheng; dangka, thih, langva chule ngen atam jal-in Tarshish chu nangma sumkolveina ahin; nangma kailhang-ah akiveijun ahi.
target: “ ‘Tarshish did business with you because of your great wealth of goods; they exchanged silver, iron, tin and lead for your merchandise.
