source: Javan, Tubal chule Meshech, amaho nasumkol vei miho ahiuvin; amahon nasumkol veina thilho toh mihem le sum-eng kongle bel ho alheh-un ahi.
target: “ ‘Greece, Tubal and Meshek did business with you; they traded human beings and articles of bronze for your wares.

source: Togarmah insunga kon amaho chu nakailhang munho-a sakol ho le sakol chung touho chule sangan hon akiveijun ahi.
target: “ ‘Men of Beth Togarmah exchanged chariot horses, cavalry horses and mules for your merchandise.

source: Dedan miho chu nasumkol veiho ahiuvin; twikul tamtah chu nangma khutna sumkolvei ahiuve. Amahon nangma saiha, sakiho le thinggai thilpeh-in nahinpohpeh-un ahi.
target: “ ‘The men of Rhodes traded with you, and many coastlands were your customers; they paid you with ivory tusks and ebony.

source: Syria chu nangma thilsemdoh tincheng jal-in nasumkol veipa anahin; amahon khisong eng, ponsandup, ponjem kikhuipah, tupat ponnem, song mantam jolsel le song san joh-in nakiveina munho alouve.
target: “ ‘Aram did business with you because of your many products; they exchanged turquoise, purple fabric, embroidered work, fine linen, coral and rubies for your merchandise.

source: Judah le Israel gam chu nangma sumkol veiho ahiuvin; amahon nangma kailhanga Minnith le Pannang suhlouchang, khoiju le thao, chule thingnailou namtuijin akiveijuve.
target: “ ‘Judah and Israel traded with you; they exchanged wheat from Minnith and confections, honey, olive oil and balm for your wares.

source: Nangma thilsem tam jal, Helbon'a ju le samul kang nahaona jouseho jal-in Damascus chu nangma sumkol veina ahitai.
target: “ ‘Damascus did business with you because of your many products and great wealth of goods. They offered wine from Helbon, wool from Zahar

source: Dan le Javan nakailhang munho lodingin achesuh achetou lhonin; thih valset, thingle aigeju nakailhanga akimue.
target: and casks of wine from Izal in exchange for your wares: wrought iron, cassia and calamus.

source: Dedan chu pon lutahho kangtalai ho-a dinga nasumkol vei ahi.
target: “ ‘Dedan traded in saddle blankets with you.

source: Arabia le Kedar pipuiho jouse chun kelngoiho, kelngoi chalho, chule keltah hon nakailhang alouvin; hiche thilho-a hi amaho nangma sumkol veiho hia ahiuve.
target: “ ‘Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your customers; they did business with you in lambs, rams and goats.

source: Sheba le Raamah'a sumkol veiho chu nangma sumkol veiho ahiuvin; amahon nakailhang ho chu song mantam jousele sana in nakailhang ho alotauve.
target: “ ‘The merchants of Sheba and Raamah traded with you; for your merchandise they exchanged the finest of all kinds of spices and precious stones, and gold.

source: Haran, Kanneh, Eden, chule Sheba sumkol veiho, Asshur chule Chilmad chu nasumkol veiho ahiuve.
target: “ ‘Harran, Kanneh and Eden and merchants of Sheba, Ashur and Kilmad traded with you.

source: Hichehohi thil namkim nasumkol veina thilho lah-a pang ahiuve, pondum ho-a, thil kijempah ho-a, cedar thinga kisem, khao hola kikhit, thingkhongho sunga um von lutahho ahi.
target: In your marketplace they traded with you beautiful garments, blue fabric, embroidered work and multicolored rugs with cords twisted and tightly knotted.

source: Tarshish konghon nakailhangah nalachoijun; chule twipiho lailunga nangma nadimset tan, loupitah-a jabolin na-umtai.
target: “ ‘The ships of Tarshish serve as carriers for your wares. You are filled with heavy cargo as you sail the sea.

source: Nakong tol hon twilen sung nahin lhuttan, solam huipin twipi lailunga nasukehtan ahi.
target: Your oarsmen take you out to the high seas. But the east wind will break you to pieces far out at sea.

source: Nahaonaho, nakailhang ho, nakiveinaho, nakong tolho le nakong jap ho, nakong thoibit ho, chule nasumkolveina thil le loho, nasepai gal hat nangma-a umho, nasunga nakiloipiho jousehi, nakisuhmang nikhoteng twipiho lailunga lhalut soh hel dingu ahi.
target: Your wealth, merchandise and wares, your mariners, sailors and shipwrights, your merchants and all your soldiers, and everyone else on board will sink into the heart of the sea on the day of your shipwreck.

source: Akimvela miho chu nakongtol ho pen hugin-a kithing thing ding ahiuve.
target: The shorelands will quake when your sailors cry out.

source: Chule kongkhe tuhho jouse, kong jap ho, chule twipi chunga kongtol ho jouse chu, akonghouva kona hung kumlha uva tolla ding ding ahiuve.
target: All who handle the oars will abandon their ships; the mariners and all the sailors will stand on the shore.

source: Chule amahon a-awginu nangma douna-a najahsah diu, lhasetah-a penguva, alu chungvum uva leivui athediu, chule leivui lah-a kilih lelediu ahi.
target: They will raise their voice and cry bitterly over you; they will sprinkle dust on their heads and roll in ashes.

source: Amaho nangma dinga kivou toluva, khaodip pon akigah diu, lungna tah le lhasetah-a nakapi diu ahi.
target: They will shave their heads because of you and will put on sackcloth. They will weep over you with anguish of soul and with bitter mourning.

source: Amahon kap puma nangma-a dinga kala ahin semuva, nama dinga kala asah dingu, twipi lailunga kisumang Tyre khopi tobang umkha am? tia aseidiu ahi.
target: As they wail and mourn over you, they will take up a lament concerning you: “Who was ever silenced like Tyre, surrounded by the sea?”

source: Nathil semdoh ho twipi ho-a kona akitoldoh teng, mi tamtah nadip dimjin; nahaonaho tamtah le nakiveina thilho chun leiset lengho nahaosahjin ahi.
target: When your merchandise went out on the seas, you satisfied many nations; with your great wealth and your wares you enriched the kings of the earth.

source: Twipihon twi thuhtah ho sunga nahinsuhset tengule, nasumkolveina thilho le nangma lailunga nakiloipiho jouse lhutei dingu ahi.
target: Now you are shattered by the sea in the depths of the waters; your wares and all your company have gone down with you.

source: Twikol gamho-a chengho jousen nadatmo dingu, alenghou kicha lheh jenguva, amaisouva jong lunggim maiso kilang ding ahi.
target: All who live in the coastlands are appalled at you; their kings shudder with horror and their faces are distorted with fear.

source: Mipi ho lah-a sumkol veihon nachehsat khum diu, nangma tijat umtah khat nahi-a, chule imatih-a umkit louhel ding nahitai.
target: The merchants among the nations scoff at you; you have come to a horrible end and will be no more.’ ”

source: Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhung kitnin, hitin aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Tyre pipuipa henga hitihin seipeh in, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Ajehchu nalungthim akichoi sangin, keima Pathen kahi, Pathen touna twipiho lailunga katouve tin naseije, ahin nalungthim Pathen Lungthim tobang hisah jongle chun, nangma mihem nahibouvin, Pathen nahipoi;
target: “Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: “ ‘In the pride of your heart you say, “I am a god; I sit on the throne of a god in the heart of the seas.” But you are a mere mortal and not a god, though you think you are as wise as a god.

source: Ven, nangma Daniel sangin nachingjon, amahon nangma-a kona aseljouvu thilguh khatcha aumpoi.
target: Are you wiser than Daniel? Is no secret hidden from you?

source: Nachihna le nahet themna-in nangman haonaho nakimutan, chule sanale dangka nagouho lah-a nakoitai.
target: By your wisdom and understanding you have gained wealth for yourself and amassed gold and silver in your treasuries.

source: Nachihna sangtah jal le nakiveina jal-in nahaonaho apungin, nahaonaho jeh-in nalungthim akichoisang tai.
target: By your great skill in trading you have increased your wealth, and because of your wealth your heart has grown proud.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Nangman nalungthim Pathen lungthim tobang nahisah jeh-in;
target: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: “ ‘Because you think you are wise, as wise as a god,

source: Ven, hijeh-a chu keiman nachunga gamchom mi namtin lah-a tijat umpenho kahin puilut ding: amahon nachihna melhoi kidoupi dinga achemjam asadoh uva, navah emsel chu asuhboh diu ahi.
target: I am going to bring foreigners against you, the most ruthless of nations; they will draw their swords against your beauty and wisdom and pierce your shining splendor.

source: Amahon nangma kokhuh sunga nasotlut diu, nangma twiho lailunga kithat ho thi banga nathitei ding ahi.
target: They will bring you down to the pit, and you will die a violent death in the heart of the seas.

source: Nathatpa anga chun, Pathen kahi tin seijin natem? ahinla nathatpa anga chu Pathen hilouva mihem bou nahi ding ahi.
target: Will you then say, “I am a god,” in the presence of those who kill you? You will be but a mortal, not a god, in the hands of those who slay you.

source: Gamdang miho khutna cheptan louho thia nathitei ding ahi: ajehchu keiman kaseidoh ahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: You will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hands of foreigners. I have spoken, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ ”

source: Chubanin jong Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Tyre lengpa chunga kala bolinlang, ahenga hitin seijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Nangma chamkimna mahor, chihna dimset, hoina chamkim chu nahi.
target: “Son of man, take up a lament concerning the king of Tyre and say to him: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: “ ‘You were the seal of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.

source: Nangma Pathen hon Eden'a nana umtan; song mantam jat jouse, songsan, song-eng, song mantam, song engdum, songgel, chule song sanpol, song dum, song engdang, song santhip chule sana in nakitomin; chule nakhongcha le natheile ho akisemdan chu nangma nakisem nikho-a nangma-a kigonga ahitai.
target: You were in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone adorned you: carnelian, chrysolite and emerald, topaz, onyx and jasper, lapis lazuli, turquoise and beryl. Your settings and mountings were made of gold; on the day you were created they were prepared.

source: Nangma akhukhuma pang thao kinu chu nahin; chutia chu katundoh nahi; nangma Pathen molsang theng chunga nana umin, meisong lah-a nachesuh nachetou vin ahi.
target: You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for so I ordained you. You were on the holy mount of God; you walked among the fiery stones.

source: Nangma nakisemdoh nikho-a pat, nangma-a themona akimudoh kahsen, nalampi ho-a chamkim nanahin ahi.
target: You were blameless in your ways from the day you were created till wickedness was found in you.

source: Nasumkol veina thilho tamjeh-in hicheho chun nasunggil chu hunamin adipmuvin, nangma nachonse tai. Hijeh-a chu, Vo akhukhuma pang Cherub, nangma thilboh banga Pathen molsanga kona kapai doh-a; keiman nangma meisongho lah-a kona kasuhmang ding nahi.
target: Through your widespread trade you were filled with violence, and you sinned. So I drove you in disgrace from the mount of God, and I expelled you, guardian cherub, from among the fiery stones.

source: Nahoi jeh-in, nalungthim akichoisang tan, navah emsel jeh-in nachihna nasuboh tai; keiman tolla kalelhah ding, lenghon navet theina dinguva, a-angsung uva kajam ding nahi.
target: Your heart became proud on account of your beauty, and you corrupted your wisdom because of your splendor. So I threw you to the earth; I made a spectacle of you before kings.

source: Nakiman chahna-a nakhangitlouna tamtah hole, nakiveina khang gilouho-in, namun thengho chu nasuboh tan; hijeh-a chu nalah-a kona mei kahin kondohsah-a, hichun nakahvam ding, chule naveho jouse mitmu-a, vutvai kahin sosah ding ahi.
target: By your many sins and dishonest trade you have desecrated your sanctuaries. So I made a fire come out from you, and it consumed you, and I reduced you to ashes on the ground in the sight of all who were watching.

source: Mipi lah-a nangma nanahesa jousen nadatmo dingu; nangma tijat umtah nahiding, a-itih-a naum kit louding ahitai.
target: All the nations who knew you are appalled at you; you have come to a horrible end and will be no more.’ ”

source: Avelin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, hitin aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Sidon lam chu maingatnin lang, adounan gaothu seijin,
target: “Son of man, set your face against Sidon; prophesy against her

source: Chule hitin seipeh-in, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Vetan, Vo Sidon, keiman kadou nahi, keima nalailung tah-a kaloupi ding ahi; chule keiman amanu chungthu katanna, amanu-a suhthenga kaum tengle, amahon keima Pakai kahi ahetdohdiu ahi.
target: and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: “ ‘I am against you, Sidon, and among you I will display my glory. You will know that I am the Lord , when I inflict punishment on you and within you am proved to be holy.

source: Ajehchu keiman amanu sunga hise, chule akhopi lamlen ho-a thisan kalhalut ding; chule maha puho chu amanu lailung tah-a chemjam'a lamjouse-a athu-u kitan ding; chutengle amahon keima Pakai kahi chu ahet dingu ahi.
target: I will send a plague upon you and make blood flow in your streets. The slain will fall within you, with the sword against you on every side. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

source: Chule Israel insung dinga misunthei lingboh, ahiloule akimvela um amaho isahlou jouse-a kona asunna theiju ling kiti khatcha umtalou ding ahi. Chule amahon keima Pakai Pathen kahi ahinhet dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘No longer will the people of Israel have malicious neighbors who are painful briers and sharp thorns. Then they will know that I am the Sovereign Lord .

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije, Keiman Israel insung chu ana kithecheh nau mipi ho-a kona kahin khopkhom tengle, Pathen hepha louho mitmu-a alah uva suhthenga kaumding; chutengle keiman kasoh Jacob kapeh amaho gamsunga chu chengding ahiuve.
target: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: When I gather the people of Israel from the nations where they have been scattered, I will be proved holy through them in the sight of the nations. Then they will live in their own land, which I gave to my servant Jacob.

source: Chule amaho hiche sunga chu bitkeija chengdio, inho akisahdoh uva, chule lengpi honho akibol dingu; henge, keiman akimveluva um amaho i-sah louva bolho jouse chunga thutannaho katohdoh tengle, amaho lung noma chengtei ding ahiuve, chule amahon keima Pakai amaho Pathen kahi ahin het dingu ahi.
target: They will live there in safety and will build houses and plant vineyards; they will live in safety when I inflict punishment on all their neighbors who maligned them. Then they will know that I am the Lord their God.’ ”

source: Kum som channa, alhasomna, nisomle nini lhinnin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, hitin aseije.
target: In the tenth year, in the tenth month on the twelfth day, the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Egypt lengpa Pharaoh lam maingatnin lang, amale Egypt pumpi dounan gaothu seijin,
target: “Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.

source: Seiphongin, chule seijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitin seijin; Ven, ama vadungho lailunga lum dragon len, Egypt lengpa Pharaoh, keiman nangma kadou nahi, nangman, Kavadung chu keima-a ahin, keima dinga kakisem ahi, tin naseije.
target: Speak to him and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: “ ‘I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, you great monster lying among your streams. You say, “The Nile belongs to me; I made it for myself.”

source: Ahin, keiman nakha teni-a ngakoi kabupeh-a, chule navadung ho-a nga jouse chu nalip ho-a kabedetsah ding, chule keiman nangma navadung ho lailunga kona kapuidoh-a, chule navadung ho-a nga jouse chu nalip sunga behden ding ahiuve.
target: But I will put hooks in your jaws and make the fish of your streams stick to your scales. I will pull you out from among your streams, with all the fish sticking to your scales.

source: Chule keiman nangmale navadung ho-a nga jouse chu, gamthipma kaselutna kadalhah ding; nangma gam ongho lah-a naga chuh-a, nangma nakiloh khom talou ding, nakichom khom talou ding ahi. Keiman nangma gamlah-a sahole, chunga leng vachaho henga a-anneh dinguva kapehdoh nahitai.
target: I will leave you in the desert, you and all the fish of your streams. You will fall on the open field and not be gathered or picked up. I will give you as food to the beasts of the earth and the birds of the sky.

source: Chule Egypt'a chengho jousen keima Pakai Pathen kahi chu ahetdoh dingu ahi, ajehchu amaho chu Israel insung dinga peng tenggol ana hiuva ahi.
target: Then all who live in Egypt will know that I am the Lord . “ ‘You have been a staff of reed for the people of Israel.

source: Amahon nangma nakhutna natuh uchun, nangman amaho dahbul jouse nasubongin, nabot telin; chule amaho nachunga akingaiju chun, nangman akongbuhhou jouse chu dingjang theilouvin nasubongin ahi.
target: When they grasped you with their hands, you splintered and you tore open their shoulders; when they leaned on you, you broke and their backs were wrenched.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; Ven, keiman nachunga chemjam kahin chuhsah ding, chule nangma-a kona mihem le sahem kasuhmang ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will bring a sword against you and kill both man and beast.

source: Chule Egypt gam chu kamhela agohkeo hung hiding; chule amahon keima Pakai kahina chu ahin het dingu ahi. Ajehchu aman, Vadung chu keija ahin, chule keiman kanasem ahi, tin anaseijin ahi.
target: Egypt will become a desolate wasteland. Then they will know that I am the Lord . “ ‘Because you said, “The Nile is mine; I made it,”

source: Ven, hijeh chun keiman nangmale navadung ho kadouvin, chule keiman Egypt gam chu Syene insanga pat Ethiopia gam pumpi geija kamhela agohkeohel kahisah ding ahi.
target: therefore I am against you and against your streams, and I will make the land of Egypt a ruin and a desolate waste from Migdol to Aswan, as far as the border of Cush.

source: Mihem koimachan akenga ajot tah louding, sahem kengin jong apaltahlou ding, kum somli sung koima cheng louding ahi.
target: The foot of neither man nor beast will pass through it; no one will live there for forty years.

source: Chule keiman Egypt gam chu agoh-a um gamho lailunga kakamhelsah-a, chule akhopiho chu ahomkeo lah-a kum somli kamhela umding ahi. Chule Egypt miho chu namtin lah-a kithecheh ding, gamho chansoh-a kathe thang ding ahi.
target: I will make the land of Egypt desolate among devastated lands, and her cities will lie desolate forty years among ruined cities. And I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

source: Ahijeng vangin Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije, Kum somli ahung beitengleh keiman Egypt miho chu thecheh-a aumnao miho lah-a kona kachopkhom ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Yet this is what the Sovereign Lord says: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were scattered.

source: Chule keiman Egypt sohchana chu kahin lepui kitna, chule amaho chu Pathros gamsung, amaho chenkhum gamsungtah ngeija kakile sahkit ding; chule amaho hichea chu lenggam nemcha hiding ahiuve.
target: I will bring them back from captivity and return them to Upper Egypt, the land of their ancestry. There they will be a lowly kingdom.

source: Hichu lenggam ho lah-a anempen hiding, ahiloule namho chunga jong ama kichoisang joukit talou ding ahi. Ajehchu keiman amaho chu kasuhnem ding, chutia chu amahon namtin chunga vai ahom kit tah lou dingu ahi.
target: It will be the lowliest of kingdoms and will never again exalt itself above the other nations. I will make it so weak that it will never again rule over the nations.

source: Chule amaho Israel insung dinga tahsanna umkit taloudiu, amavang amahon ajuigot tengule akhangit lounao geldohna bep hidingu ahitai. Chutengle amahon keima Pakai Pathen kahi ahet dingu ahi.
target: Egypt will no longer be a source of confidence for the people of Israel but will be a reminder of their sin in turning to her for help. Then they will know that I am the Sovereign Lord .’ ”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, kum somni le sagi lhinna lha masapen, alhasunga nimasa pen ni chun Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, hitin aseije,
target: In the twenty-seventh year, in the first month on the first day, the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in Tyre dounan agalmiho natoh lentah anatohdoh sah-in; Luchang takip chu veltolin aumtan, chule lengkou takip akoh-in ahi. Ahijeng vangin ama ahin, agalsat miho ahiuvin, Tyre'a konin hiche douna-a anatohnauva hin tohman asangpouvin ahi.
target: “Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon drove his army in a hard campaign against Tyre; every head was rubbed bare and every shoulder made raw. Yet he and his army got no reward from the campaign he led against Tyre.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; Ven, keiman Egypt gam chu Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar henga kapeh ding; aman ahaonaho jouse chu alahding, galthil achomding, chule achomgam helding; hicheho chu agalmiho dinga thaman hiding ahi.
target: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am going to give Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will carry off its wealth. He will loot and plunder the land as pay for his army.

source: Keiman atohman dinga Egypt gam chu ama kapeh ahitai, ajehchu keima dinga na eitoh peh-u ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: I have given him Egypt as a reward for his efforts because he and his army did it for me, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Chuche nikho tengchule keiman Israel insung ki chu kadondoh sah ding, nangma amaho lailung tah-a paodoh jouna kapeh ding; chule amahon keima Pakai kahi ahet dingu ahi.
target: “On that day I will make a horn grow for the Israelites, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am the Lord .”

source: Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung kitnin, hitin aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, gaovinlang seijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Ohe hiche nikho chu adana-e!
target: “Son of man, prophesy and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: “ ‘Wail and say, “Alas for that day!”

source: Nikho chu ahung naitai, Pakai nikho ngei chu ahung naitai, hichu meikai nikho hiding, Pathen helouho phat hiding ahi.
target: For the day is near, the day of the Lord is near— a day of clouds, a time of doom for the nations.

source: Chule Egypt chunga chemjam hung lhung ding, chule akithat ho Egypt'a alhuhgem phat teng, Ethiopia sunga thohnatna nasatah hung umdoh ding, chule amahon amanu mitampi ho chu alahmang uva, akibulphu naochu kisuchim ding ahi.
target: A sword will come against Egypt, and anguish will come upon Cush. When the slain fall in Egypt, her wealth will be carried away and her foundations torn down.

source: Ethiopia, Libya le Lydia, chule mipi choplopho jouse, Chub, chule gamsunga miho apangkhomho chu, amahotoh chemjam'a lhukhom dingu ahi.
target: Cush and Libya, Lydia and all Arabia, Kub and the people of the covenant land will fall by the sword along with Egypt.

source: Pakaiyin hitihin aseije, Egypt tuhdet hojong chu lhutei ding; chule amanu kiletsahna athaneina chu lhasuh ding ahi: Syene insanga kona amaho hia chu chemjam'a loudiu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: “ ‘This is what the Lord says: “ ‘The allies of Egypt will fall and her proud strength will fail. From Migdol to Aswan they will fall by the sword within her, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Chule akamhel gamho lailunga amaho kamhel diu, chule akhopihou chu agohkeosa khopiho lailunga umding ahiuve.
target: “ ‘They will be desolate among desolate lands, and their cities will lie among ruined cities.

source: Chule keiman Egypt gamsunga mei kati-a, chule apanpiho jouse kahin suhmang tengle; amahon keiman Pakai kahi ahet dingu ahi.
target: Then they will know that I am the Lord , when I set fire to Egypt and all her helpers are crushed.

source: Hiche nikho chule mikituplou Ethiopia mite kichatsahna dinga, keija kona thupole ho kong inneija chedoh diu, chule Egypt nikho-a banga, thohnatna nasatah hunglhung ding ahi; ajehchu ven, hunglhung ding ahitai.
target: “ ‘On that day messengers will go out from me in ships to frighten Cush out of her complacency. Anguish will take hold of them on the day of Egypt’s doom, for it is sure to come.

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, Keiman Egypt mihonpi jong chu, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar khutna katansah ding ahi.
target: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: “ ‘I will put an end to the hordes of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.

source: Amale aumpi mite, namtin lah-a kichat umtahho chu gamsung sumang dinga kapuilut ding, amahon Egypt douna-a achemjamu aloidoh uva, gamsung chu mithi adip dingu ahi.
target: He and his army—the most ruthless of nations— will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain.

source: Chule keiman vadungho kakansah-a, agam chu migilouho khutna kajohdoh ding ; chule agam chu asunga umho toh, gamdang miho khutna agoh-a kalha ding ahi; Pakai keiman hichu kaseidoh ahitai.
target: I will dry up the waters of the Nile and sell the land to an evil nation; by the hand of foreigners I will lay waste the land and everything in it. I the Lord have spoken.

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Keiman lim semthuho jong kasuhset ding, chule Noph gama amilimhou kasuhbei ding; chule Egypt gam pipui kiti chu umkit talou ding ahi. Chule Egypt gamsunga tijatna kachuhsah ding ahi.
target: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: “ ‘I will destroy the idols and put an end to the images in Memphis. No longer will there be a prince in Egypt, and I will spread fear throughout the land.

source: Pathros chu agoh-a kakoija, Zoan gamsung meija kahal ding, chule No khopi-a thu katan ding ahi.
target: I will lay waste Upper Egypt, set fire to Zoan and inflict punishment on Thebes.

source: Chule keiman kalungsatna chu Egypt thahatna Sin chunga kasunlhah-a; No mite tampiho chu kasuhbei ding ahi.
target: I will pour out my wrath on Pelusium, the stronghold of Egypt, and wipe out the hordes of Thebes.

source: Chule keiman Egypt meija kahal ding; Sin'in nat genthei athoh ding, No chu kehso-a umding, Noph'in nitina gimgenthei naho anei ding ahi.
target: I will set fire to Egypt; Pelusium will writhe in agony. Thebes will be taken by storm; Memphis will be in constant distress.

source: Aven le Pibeseth'a gollhangho chu chemjam'a lou dingu, hiche khopiho hi sohchanga cheding ahiuve.
target: The young men of Heliopolis and Bubastis will fall by the sword, and the cities themselves will go into captivity.

source: Egypt namkoljon ho kavohboh teng, Tehaphnehes'a jong nisa thim ding; chule alungtahna thahat chu kisubei ding; amanu vang chu meibolin tomintin, achanute sohchanga chediu ahi.
target: Dark will be the day at Tahpanhes when I break the yoke of Egypt; there her proud strength will come to an end. She will be covered with clouds, and her villages will go into captivity.

source: Hitia chu Egypt sunga thutanna kabol ding, chuteng amahon keima Pakai kahi ahet dingu ahi.
target: So I will inflict punishment on Egypt, and they will know that I am the Lord .’ ”

source: Chule kum somle kum khat lhinna, alha masapen nisagi nin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin aseije,
target: In the eleventh year, in the first month on the seventh day, the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Egypt lengpa Pharaoh khut chu kahehbong tai; chule ven, hichu adamdoh dinga kitom kitlou ding, akanjang nadinga molbong kimang louding, akhutchu chemjam tuhkit thei dinga kihatsah louding ahitai.
target: “Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. It has not been bound up to be healed or put in a splint so that it may become strong enough to hold a sword.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; Ven, keiman Egypt lengpa Pharaoh kadouvin, chule aban janga aban thahat kasuhboh kit ding; chule akhutna kona chemjam kalhah mangsah ding ahi.
target: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt. I will break both his arms, the good arm as well as the broken one, and make the sword fall from his hand.

source: Chule keiman Egypt miho chu namtin lah-a kathecheh-a, gam jouse-a kathe thang ding ahi.
target: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

source: Chule keiman Babylon lengpa ban teni kahatsah-a, kachemjam akhutna kakoi ding; amavang keiman Pharaoh ban teni kasuhboh-a, ama thina khopma mahapuho banga ama anga peng ding ahi.
target: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put my sword in his hand, but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before him like a mortally wounded man.

source: Ahinla keiman Babylon lengpa khut teni kahatsah-a, Pharaoh ban teni lhasuh ding; chule keiman kachemjam Babylon lengpa khutna kakoi teng, amahon keima Pakai kahi ahet dingu, chule aman hichu Egypt gam chunga ajah teng, Keima Pakai kahi ahetdingu ahi.
target: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall limp. Then they will know that I am the Lord , when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he brandishes it against Egypt.

source: Chule Egypt miho chu namtin lah-a kathecheh-a, gam jouse-a kathe thang ding, chule amahon keima Pakai kahi ahet dingu ahi.
target: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them through the countries. Then they will know that I am the Lord .”

source: Chule kum somle kum khat lhinna, lha thum channa, alhasunga nikho masapen nin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, aseije.
target: In the eleventh year, in the third month on the first day, the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Egypt lengpa Pharaoh le amihonpi henga seipeh-in, Nalet na-a hi koito nakibah em?
target: “Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his hordes: “ ‘Who can be compared with you in majesty?

source: Ven, Assyria chu Lebanon'a um cedar thing ahin, abahho ahoija hoi, gam manglah limsah jou, chule sangtah ahin; ajihhui chu abahho jouse sangin asangjon ahi.
target: Consider Assyria, once a cedar in Lebanon, with beautiful branches overshadowing the forest; it towered on high, its top above the thick foliage.

source: Twiho chun lentah ahisah ahin; leinoi'a twihon sangtah ahisah-a aphung kimvela chu avadung lenho longkimvela, chule gamlah thingphung jouse-a dinga avadung neoho alon sah ahi.
target: The waters nourished it, deep springs made it grow tall; their streams flowed all around its base and sent their channels to all the trees of the field.

source: Hijeh chun asan chu gama thingphung ho jouse chungvuma akitung sangin, chule abohho jong apungin, twi atam jeh-in abahho ahung kikapdoh phatnule asaotheijun ahi.
target: So it towered higher than all the trees of the field; its boughs increased and its branches grew long, spreading because of abundant waters.

source: Chunga leng vacha jouse aboh lah-a abusan; chule abahho noija chun gamsa jousen nou aneijun, chule alim noija chun namlenho jouse achenguve.
target: All the birds of the sky nested in its boughs, all the animals of the wild gave birth under its branches; all the great nations lived in its shade.

source: Abahho saona chun aloupina chu aletna-a amel lomsah-e: ajehchu ajung chu twilenho panga kikho ahi.
target: It was majestic in beauty, with its spreading boughs, for its roots went down to abundant waters.

source: Pathen hon sunga cedar thingphung hon ama aseljoupoi: chahthingho chu ama bahho tobang ahipon, belkanho jong ama bahho tobang ahipon; Pathen hon sunga thingphung khatcha jong ama tobanga hoi aumpoi.
target: The cedars in the garden of God could not rival it, nor could the junipers equal its boughs, nor could the plane trees compare with its branches— no tree in the garden of God could match its beauty.

source: Eden'a thingphung jouse, Pathen hona kehho chun ama athang thipna dingun, keiman abah tamtah-a chun thingphung chu kasem hoijin ahi.
target: I made it beautiful with abundant branches, the envy of all the trees of Eden in the garden of God.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Nangma sangtah-a nakidop sanga, abah bit lah-a alehhui akikhodoh-a, asanna-a chu alungsung akichoi sang jeh-a;
target: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because the great cedar towered over the thick foliage, and because it was proud of its height,

source: Hijeh-a chu keiman Pathen helou thaneitah khat khutna ama kapehdoh ahin; ama chun tahbeh-a ama abolset ding ahi. Keiman ama chu agitlouna jeh-a kadeldoh ahitai.
target: I gave it into the hands of the ruler of the nations, for him to deal with according to its wickedness. I cast it aside,

source: Chule gamdang miho, namtin lah-a tijat umchun ama asuhmanga, adalhah ahitai: molsang ho chungle phaicham jouse-a abahho jouse alhatan, chule abahkai hochu gamsung vadungho jousen asubongtan, chule leiset mite jouse alima konin apotdoh-un, adalha taove.
target: and the most ruthless of foreign nations cut it down and left it. Its boughs fell on the mountains and in all the valleys; its branches lay broken in all the ravines of the land. All the nations of the earth came out from under its shade and left it.

source: Ama manthah na chunga chu chungleng vacha jouse umden ding, chule gamsa jouse chu abahho chunga chu umding ahi.
target: All the birds settled on the fallen tree, and all the wild animals lived among its branches.

source: Khonung le twiho panga thingphung ho jouse atunu asan vanga akichoisang louna diu, alehhui ju abahhou chunga adodoh louna ding, twi dona thingphung jouse hichan geija chu asanlouna dinga chutia chu uma ahi. Amaho leiset noilama kumsuh-a mihem chate lah-a kokhuh-a kumlha ho toh abonuva thina-a thakhatna kipelutna ahitaove.
target: Therefore no other trees by the waters are ever to tower proudly on high, lifting their tops above the thick foliage. No other trees so well-watered are ever to reach such a height; they are all destined for death, for the earth below, among mortals who go down to the realm of the dead.

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Ama thikholkhul sunga akumlhah ni chun kalunghemin ahi. Amaho dingin twi thuhlai kanakhu khumin, twi sohlai kanatuh tangin, twilen tahtah ho akitingden tai. Chule keiman ama dingin Lebanon kalunghem sah-in, gama thingphung jouse ama dingin angoilha-un ahi.
target: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: On the day it was brought down to the realm of the dead I covered the deep springs with mourning for it; I held back its streams, and its abundant waters were restrained. Because of it I clothed Lebanon with gloom, and all the trees of the field withered away.

source: Keiman ama kokhuh sung lut ho toh thikholkhula kalelut tha phat chun, ama lhuh ginin nampiho kakithinsah-in; Eden'a thingphung jouse, Labanon'a thingphung pha jouse, chule twi don jouse chu, leiset noilam gambehho-a lhep lungmonga umding ahiuve.
target: I made the nations tremble at the sound of its fall when I brought it down to the realm of the dead to be with those who go down to the pit. Then all the trees of Eden, the choicest and best of Lebanon, the well-watered trees, were consoled in the earth below.

source: Amaho jong chu amatoh thakhatnin chemjam'a kithatsaho henga thikhol khul'a akumsuh-un; chule amaho chu ama khutna pangho, Pathen helou lah-a ama le-lima chengho ahiuve.
target: They too, like the great cedar, had gone down to the realm of the dead, to those killed by the sword, along with the armed men who lived in its shade among the nations.

source: Eden'a thingphung hoitah ho lah-a hoichepen tochu nangma loupi le letna toh kibang am? hijeng jongle nangma Eden'a thingphung ho toh leiset noilama pohlhah-a naum ding; nangma cheptan louho lailung tah-a chemjam'a kithat ho toh nalup ding ahi. Hichehi Pharaoh le amihonpi jouse chu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: “ ‘Which of the trees of Eden can be compared with you in splendor and majesty? Yet you, too, will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the earth below; you will lie among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword. “ ‘This is Pharaoh and all his hordes, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ ”

source: Chuin kum somle kumni, lha somle lhani channa, alhasunga nikho masapen nin ahitin ahi, Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, aseije.
target: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month on the first day, the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Egypt lengpa Pharaoh dingin kala bolin lang, ahenga seipeh-in, Nangma nampiho keipi bahkai chal donglai tobang nahin, twipi noija ngapi tobang nahi: nangma na vadunglen hotoh nahung doh-in, nakengin twiho chu nachoh lingin, chule avadunglen hou nasuneh-in ahi.
target: “Son of man, take up a lament concerning Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him: “ ‘You are like a lion among the nations; you are like a monster in the seas thrashing about in your streams, churning the water with your feet and muddying the streams.

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Hijeh-a chu keiman nangma chunga mihonpi toh kalen kahinkhu ding, amahon nangma kalen sunga nahin kaidoh dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: “ ‘With a great throng of people I will cast my net over you, and they will haul you up in my net.

source: Chuteng keiman nangma tolla kadalha-a, gam onga kapaidoh ding, chule keiman chungleng vacha jouse nachunga kachuh sah-a, leiset pumpi-a gamsa jouse vahna-a kanei ding nahi.
target: I will throw you on the land and hurl you on the open field. I will let all the birds of the sky settle on you and all the animals of the wild gorge themselves on you.

source: Chule keiman molsang chungho-a natahsa kalupsah ding, chule phaicham ho chu nalongin adip ding ahi.
target: I will spread your flesh on the mountains and fill the valleys with your remains.

source: Keiman natwi japna gamsung chu molsang ho geija nathisana kachap ding; chule vadungho chu nangma-a dim ding ahi.
target: I will drench the land with your flowing blood all the way to the mountains, and the ravines will be filled with your flesh.

source: Chule keiman nangma kapuidoh tengle, van chu kakhu khuma, ahsi ho chu kathimsah ding; nisa meiloma kakhu-a, lhathah-in jong avah asodohsah louding ahi.
target: When I snuff you out, I will cover the heavens and darken their stars; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.

source: Van'a vahho jousen nachunga thim ajinsah ding, nagamsunga thimjing ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: All the shining lights in the heavens I will darken over you; I will bring darkness over your land, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Keiman namtinho lah-a, nangman nanahet khahlou gamsungho-a nangma suhmangna kahin lhunsah teng, mihem tamtah kalungjin sah ding ahi.
target: I will trouble the hearts of many peoples when I bring about your destruction among the nations, among lands you have not known.

source: Henge, keiman mihem tamtah chu nangma kadatmosah-a, chule alenghou jong a-anguva kachemjam kapei tengle, nangma jeh-a hatah-a tija dingu; chule nalhuh nikhoteng chule amitakip ama amacheh hinkho dinga aphat tina kithing thing dingu ahi.
target: I will cause many peoples to be appalled at you, and their kings will shudder with horror because of you when I brandish my sword before them. On the day of your downfall each of them will tremble every moment for his life.

source: Ajehchu Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, Babylon lengpa chemjam chu nachunga hung chuding ahi.
target: “ ‘For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: “ ‘The sword of the king of Babylon will come against you.

source: Galhat ho chemjam'a namihonpi chu abonchauva, namtinin akichat penhou chu kalhuhsah gamdiu; amahon Egypt mite hoithona asuhbeijuva, chua mihonpi chu asuhmanghel diu ahi.
target: I will cause your hordes to fall by the swords of mighty men— the most ruthless of all nations. They will shatter the pride of Egypt, and all her hordes will be overthrown.

source: Keiman atuilen pangho-a sahem jouse kasuhmang ding; mihem kengton jong achotneh tahlou ding, sahem kengphangin jong achotneh tahlou ding ahi.
target: I will destroy all her cattle from beside abundant waters no longer to be stirred by the foot of man or muddied by the hooves of cattle.

source: Chuteng keiman atuiho kathuhsah-a, avadunghou chu thao banga kalonsah ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: Then I will let her waters settle and make her streams flow like oil, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Keiman Egypt gam chu agoh-a kahinlha-a, agam sunga dimsetna um thiljouse kalahdohpeh-a kasuh lamvaija, keiman chuche sunga chengho jouse kathagam tengle, amahon keima Pakai kahi ahet dingu ahi.
target: When I make Egypt desolate and strip the land of everything in it, when I strike down all who live there, then they will know that I am the Lord .’

source: Hichehi alunghempi dingu lunghemna chu ahi: namtin chanuten amanu alunghempi dingu: amaho amanu dinga lunghemdiu, Egypt dinga jong chule amanu mihonpi jouse dinga jong lunghemdiu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseijin ahi.
target: “This is the lament they will chant for her. The daughters of the nations will chant it; for Egypt and all her hordes they will chant it, declares the Sovereign Lord .”

source: Hitijong hin kum somle kumni lhinna, alhasunga nisom le ninga ni chun ahung hitin, Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, hitin aseije,
target: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Egypt mihonpi ho dingin pengin, chule amaho ahin, amanu tahngei jong, chule nampi minthangho chanute chutoh, kokhuh-a chelut ho toh, leinoi gamleiset lama seplut khomtan.
target: “Son of man, wail for the hordes of Egypt and consign to the earth below both her and the daughters of mighty nations, along with those who go down to the pit.

source: Melhoina-a nangman koi nakhokhel em? kumsuh-in lang, cheptan louho toh lumkhom tan.
target: Say to them, ‘Are you more favored than others? Go down and be laid among the uncircumcised.’

source: Amaho chu chemjam'a kithatsaho lah-a lhudiu, amanu chemjam'a kipedoh ahitai; amanu le amilhonpi jouse loilutnin.
target: They will fall among those killed by the sword. The sword is drawn; let her be dragged off with all her hordes.

source: Mihat ho lah-a mihatpa chun thikholkhul lailunga kona, ama anakithopiho chutoh ama thu aseidiu: amaho akumsuh-un, chemjam'a kithat cheptan louho toh alumtaove, atidiu ahi.
target: From within the realm of the dead the mighty leaders will say of Egypt and her allies, ‘They have come down and they lie with the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword.’

source: Asshur le amanu loiho hia chun aumun; amapa lhankhuh ho chu akimvela aumin; abonchauva akithatsa, chemjam'a lou ahiuve.
target: “Assyria is there with her whole army; she is surrounded by the graves of all her slain, all who have fallen by the sword.

source: Alhankhuhho kokhuh pangho-a aumin, chule amanu loiho chu amanu lhankhuh kimvela aumuve; abonchauva akithatsa, chemjam'a lou ahiuvin, mihing gama tijatna sosah ahiuve.
target: Their graves are in the depths of the pit and her army lies around her grave. All who had spread terror in the land of the living are slain, fallen by the sword.

source: Chuachun Elam aumin chule amihonpi chu alhankhuh kimvela aumun, abonchauva akithatsa, chemjam'a lou, leinoi gama cheptan louva kumsuh ho, mihing gama tijat sosah ho ahiuve: ahijengvangin amahon ajumnau chu kokhuh-a kumsuh ho toh apokhomun ahi.
target: “Elam is there, with all her hordes around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword. All who had spread terror in the land of the living went down uncircumcised to the earth below. They bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.

source: Amahon akithatsaho lailunga chun amihonpi toh amanu chu jalkhun adopeh-un ahi. Amanu lhankhuh ho chu akimvela aumin, amaho abonchauva cheptanlou, chemjam'a lou ahiuve: mihingho gama chu mi atijatsah jeng vangun, amahon ajumnau chu kokhuh sunga lhalutho chutoh apokhomun, amapa chu akithatsaho lailunga chun akoijun ahi.
target: A bed is made for her among the slain, with all her hordes around her grave. All of them are uncircumcised, killed by the sword. Because their terror had spread in the land of the living, they bear their shame with those who go down to the pit; they are laid among the slain.

source: Chuachun Meshech, Tubal chule amanu mihonpi chu aumin; amanu lhankhuh ho chu akimvela aumin, amahon atijatsahnau chu mihing gama asosah jeng vangun, amaho chu abonchauva cheptanlou, chemjam'a lou ahiuve.
target: “Meshek and Tubal are there, with all their hordes around their graves. All of them are uncircumcised, killed by the sword because they spread their terror in the land of the living.

source: Chule amaho chu agalmanchah hou toh thikholkhula kumsuh cheptanlou thaneitah ho toh lumkhom louding ahiuve. Amahon achemjamhou akikhap cheh-un, amaho mihingho gamsunga thahat tahho tijatsah hijeng jongleu, akhangit lounao chu aguhou chunga chuding ahi.
target: But they do not lie with the fallen warriors of old, who went down to the realm of the dead with their weapons of war—their swords placed under their heads and their shields resting on their bones—though these warriors also had terrorized the land of the living.

source: Henge, nangma cheptan louho lailunga suhgepma naum ding, chule chemjam'a kithatsaho toh nalupkhom ding ahi.
target: “You too, Pharaoh, will be broken and will lie among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword.

source: Chua chun Edom, amanu lengho le apipuiho jouse, athahat lheh vanguva chemjam'a kithatsaho alupsah naova chu lum ahiuve: amaho chu cheptan louho, chule kokhuh-a lhalut ho toh lumkhom dingu ahi.
target: “Edom is there, her kings and all her princes; despite their power, they are laid with those killed by the sword. They lie with the uncircumcised, with those who go down to the pit.

source: Sahlama pipuiho abonchauvin, chule Sidon mite jouse, akithatsaho toh kumsuh ho chu chua chun aumuvin; athahat jeh uva tijatna aboldoh-u chun amaho ajumso taove; chule amaho cheptan louvin chemjam'a kithatho toh alumkhomun, chua chun ajumnau chu kokhuh-a kumsuh ho toh athoh khomun ahi.
target: “All the princes of the north and all the Sidonians are there; they went down with the slain in disgrace despite the terror caused by their power. They lie uncircumcised with those killed by the sword and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.

source: Pharaoh chun amaho amuding, chule amihonpi jouse chunga Pharaoh tahngei le agalsatmi achemjama kithat ho jouse chu lhep lung monga umdingu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: “Pharaoh—he and all his army—will see them and he will be consoled for all his hordes that were killed by the sword, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Ajehchu keiman kasuh tijatna chu mihing gamsunga kalensahtan; chule ama Pharaoh tahngei jong chule amihonpi jouse chu cheptan louho lailunga, chemjam'a kithatsaho toh kilupkhomsah ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: Although I had him spread terror in the land of the living, Pharaoh and all his hordes will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword, declares the Sovereign Lord .”

source: Avelin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, hitin aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, namite chate henga seijin, Keiman gamkhat chunga chemjam kahin lansah-a, agam sunga mipite chun amaho gamkol sunga mikhat alhendoh uva, chule ama chu amaho ngahtupma atundoh tenguleh, ama chu seipeh in;
target: “Son of man, speak to your people and say to them: ‘When I bring the sword against a land, and the people of the land choose one of their men and make him their watchman,

source: Aman gam chunga chemjam ahunglan amu-a ahile, sumkon chu amutna, chule mipi ho chu akiginsah ding;
target: and he sees the sword coming against the land and blows the trumpet to warn the people,

source: Chutengle koi hileh sumkon gin chu jana-a, gihsalna donlou chu; chemjam chu ahung lhunna, ama chu alahmang tah-a ahile, ama thisan chu ama luchunga bou chuding ahi.
target: then if anyone hears the trumpet but does not heed the warning and the sword comes and takes their life, their blood will be on their own head.

source: Aman sumkon gin chu jahenlang, ahinla kigin ding anadon tahihle; ama thisan chu ama chunga bou chuding ahi. Ahinla gihsalna anakisanpa chun ahinna akihoidoh ding ahi.
target: Since they heard the sound of the trumpet but did not heed the warning, their blood will be on their own head. If they had heeded the warning, they would have saved themselves.

source: Ahinla ngahtuppa chun chemjam hunglang ding chu amua, ahia sumkon amutlouva, chule mipite chu gihsal louva auma: chemjam chu ahunglhun tah-a, amaho lah-a khatpen pen chu alahtah-a ahile, ama chu ama khangitlouna-a kilamanga ahitai; ahinla ama thisan chu keiman ngahtuppa khutna kangeh ding ahi.
target: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet to warn the people and the sword comes and takes someone’s life, that person’s life will be taken because of their sin, but I will hold the watchman accountable for their blood.’

source: Chuobang chun nangma, vo mihem chapa, keiman nangma Israel insung dinga ngahtup pa-a katundoh nahitan; hijeh-a chu nangman kakama thu chu najah ding, chule amaho chu keija kona nagihsal ding ahi.
target: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the people of Israel; so hear the word I speak and give them warning from me.

source: Keiman migiloupa henga, Vo migilou, nangma nathi teiding ahi, tia kasei teng; nangman migilou chu alampia kona akihei mangna dinga nagihsal louva ahile, ama chu akhangit louna-a chu thitei ding ahi; ahinla ama thisan chu nangma khutna kangeh ding ahi.
target: When I say to the wicked, ‘You wicked person, you will surely die,’ and you do not speak out to dissuade them from their ways, that wicked person will die for their sin, and I will hold you accountable for their blood.

source: Ahivanga nangman migilou chu alampia kona akihei mangna dinga nagihsala; ahivanga ama chu alampia kona akihei mang loule, ama chu akhangit louna-a chu thitei ding ahi; ahinla nangman nahinna nakihuh doh ahitai.
target: But if you do warn the wicked person to turn from their ways and they do not do so, they will die for their sin, though you yourself will be saved.

source: Hijeh chun, vo mihem chapa, nangman Israel insung henga seijin; nanghon, Keiho suhkhel naho le chonset naho chu kachung uva achuh-a, hicheho-a chu kichaipai ding kahiule, iti kahinjou dingu ham? tin naseijuve.
target: “Son of man, say to the Israelites, ‘This is what you are saying: “Our offenses and sins weigh us down, and we are wasting away because of them. How then can we live?” ’

source: Amaho henga chun seijin, Keima kahin bang ngeijin, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije; Keiman migilou thina-a hin lunglhaina kaneipon; migilou chu alampia kona ahung kiheija hina anei dingjoh chu kalungdei ahi. Vo Israel insung, nangho kiheijun, nangho nagitlounahou lampia kon chun kihei mangun, ajehchu ipi dinga nathi diuham?
target: Say to them, ‘As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that they turn from their ways and live. Turn! Turn from your evil ways! Why will you die, people of Israel?’

source: Hijeh chun nang mihem chapa, namite chate henga chun seijin, michonpha chonphatna chun suhkhel nikho-a ama alhatdoh lou ding ahi. Migilou gitlouna chu ahile, agitlouna-a kona ama akiheimang nikho-a chu chuche jala chu ama lhulou ding; michonpha chu ahung chonset nikhole achonphat vanga chu hing louding ahi.
target: “Therefore, son of man, say to your people, ‘If someone who is righteous disobeys, that person’s former righteousness will count for nothing. And if someone who is wicked repents, that person’s former wickedness will not bring condemnation. The righteous person who sins will not be allowed to live even though they were formerly righteous.’

source: Keiman michonpha henga ama hingtei ding ahi, tia kasei tengle; aman ama chonphatna akisonpi-a, khangit louna abola ahile, achonphatna jouse chu kigeldoh lou ding; ahinla khansetna abol jeh-a chu, ama thitei ding ahi.
target: If I tell a righteous person that they will surely live, but then they trust in their righteousness and do evil, none of the righteous things that person has done will be remembered; they will die for the evil they have done.

source: Chule keiman migilou henga, Nangma nathitei ding ahi, tia kaseipeh tengle; ama achonsetna-a kona akiheimanga, chule danin aphal le adih chu abola;
target: And if I say to a wicked person, ‘You will surely die,’ but they then turn away from their sin and do what is just and right—

source: Migilou chun thil kitung chu alepehkitna, achomdoh chu alepeh kitna, hinkho dan kisem ho-a chu achea, khangitlouna abolda le; ama tahbeh-a hingtei ding, thilou ding ahi.
target: if they give back what they took in pledge for a loan, return what they have stolen, follow the decrees that give life, and do no evil—that person will surely live; they will not die.

source: Chonset naho anabolho khatcha jong ahenga kiseipeh louding ahitai. Aman danin aphal le adih chu abol ahitan, ama tahbeh-a hingtei ding ahi.
target: None of the sins that person has committed will be remembered against them. They have done what is just and right; they will surely live.

source: Hijongle namite chaten, Pakai lampi chu akibangpoi atiuve, ahinla amaho-a dinga chu amaho lampi joh chu kibanglou ahi.
target: “Yet your people say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But it is their way that is not just.

source: Michonpha chu achonphatna-a kona akiheimanga, khansetna chu ahinbol le, hia chu ama thitei ding ahi.
target: If a righteous person turns from their righteousness and does evil, they will die for it.

source: Ahinla migilou chu agitlouna-a kona akiheimanga, chule danin aphal le adih chu abola ahile, ama hichea chu hingtei ding ahi.
target: And if a wicked person turns away from their wickedness and does what is just and right, they will live by doing so.

source: Ahijengvangin nanghon, Pakai lampi chu akibangpoi nati uve. Vo nangho Israel insung mite, keiman nangho nabon chaova khatcheh-a nachonnao dungjuija nathu-u katan ding ahi.
target: Yet you Israelites say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But I will judge each of you according to your own ways.”

source: Chuin kasoh channao kum somleni lhinna, lhasomna, chuche lha ani nga nin, Jerusalem'a kona hoidoh mi khat kahenga ahungin, Khopi chu achimtai, ati.
target: In the twelfth year of our exile, in the tenth month on the fifth day, a man who had escaped from Jerusalem came to me and said, “The city has fallen!”

source: Tun nilhah lamin ahung sohchapa hung masangin Pakai khut chu kachunga ahung kingamin, chule kakam akihon sahtai; chutichun jingkah-a sohchapa kahenga ahung chun, kakam akihongin, paomon kaum tapoi.
target: Now the evening before the man arrived, the hand of the Lord was on me, and he opened my mouth before the man came to me in the morning. So my mouth was opened and I was no longer silent.

source: Chujouvin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, hitin aseije,
target: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Israel gam agohkeosa loho chun aseijun, Abraham chu khat ahin, aman agam chu gouva analo ahin; ahinla keiho tampi kahiuvin, gamsung hi keihon gouva kalodiuva eikipeuva ahi, atiuve.
target: “Son of man, the people living in those ruins in the land of Israel are saying, ‘Abraham was only one man, yet he possessed the land. But we are many; surely the land has been given to us as our possession.’

source: Hijeh chun amaho henga seipeh-in, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Nanghon thisantoh naneh thaovin, chule namilim semthu-u henglam namitnun nagah veuvin, thisan nasouvin; achutile gam chu nalo dingu hinam?
target: Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Since you eat meat with the blood still in it and look to your idols and shed blood, should you then possess the land?

source: Nangho nachemjam chunguva nakisong un, thet umtah natong doh-un, chule amitakipmin a-inhengpa inneipi nasuboh-un; achutile gam chu nalo dingu hinam?
target: You rely on your sword, you do detestable things, and each of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. Should you then possess the land?’

source: Amaho henga nangman hitihin seijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Keima kahinjing bangin, tahbeh-in akisuse gamsungho-a umho chu chemjam'a lhutei dingu, chule koihile gam onga uma chu keiman gamsaho vallhum dinga kapeh ding, chule kulpihole song kohom sunga umho chu hise-a thitei ding ahiuve.
target: “Say this to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: As surely as I live, those who are left in the ruins will fall by the sword, those out in the country I will give to the wild animals to be devoured, and those in strongholds and caves will die of a plague.

source: Ajehchu keiman agam chu hatah-a kasuh kamhel ding, chule amanu hoithona chu kasuhtang ding; chule Israel molsang ho chu kamhel ding, koiman apalpa louding ahiuve.
target: I will make the land a desolate waste, and her proud strength will come to an end, and the mountains of Israel will become desolate so that no one will cross them.

source: Chutengle keiman amahon atohdoh-u thet umtahho jouse jeh-a, agam chu kamhela kalha teng; amahon keima Pakai kahi chu ahinhet dingu ahi.
target: Then they will know that I am the Lord , when I have made the land a desolate waste because of all the detestable things they have done.’

source: Chujongle, nangma mihem chapa, namite chate chun bang panghole in kot ho sunga nangma dounan akihoulimun, chule khatnin khat henga, amitakipmin asopipa henga, Hungin, nahenga katao ahi, Pakaiya kona hungsoh doh thu chu ipi ahi hung jatemin, akitiuvin ahi.
target: “As for you, son of man, your people are talking together about you by the walls and at the doors of the houses, saying to each other, ‘Come and hear the message that has come from the Lord .’

source: Chule amaho nahenga mipi ho hung bangin ahungun, chule amaho kamite bangin namasanga atouvun, chule nathuseidoh ho angaijun, ahinla amahon hicheho chu abol loudiu ahi. Ajehchu amahon akam sungun hatah-in ngailutna avetsah-un, ahinla alungsunghou chu apapsetnao lama achegam tan ahi.
target: My people come to you, as they usually do, and sit before you to hear your words, but they do not put them into practice. Their mouths speak of love, but their hearts are greedy for unjust gain.

source: Chule vetan, nangma amaho-a dingin aw ngeitah neija, la ngeitah sa-a, chule tumging phatah-a tumthei tobangbou nahije; ajehchu amahon nathuseiho angaijun, ahinla hicheho chu abol pouve.
target: Indeed, to them you are nothing more than one who sings love songs with a beautiful voice and plays an instrument well, for they hear your words but do not put them into practice.

source: Chule hichehi ahunglhun tengle, (ven hichehi hunglhung tei ding ahi,) chuteng amahon amaho lah-a themgao khat anaume ti ahet dingu ahi.
target: “When all this comes true—and it surely will—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, hitin aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Israel kelngoi chingho dounan gaothu seijin, gaovin lang amaho henga hitin seijin, Pakai Pathen'in kelngoi chingho henga hitihin aseije; Israel kelngoi chingho amahole amaho kivahho chu Ohe adau ahi! kelngoiching ho chun kelngoiho chu avah dingu hilouham?
target: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel; prophesy and say to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Woe to you shepherds of Israel who only take care of yourselves! Should not shepherds take care of the flock?

source: Nanghon athaothao nane uvin, chule amuluva chun nangho le nangho nakivon un, alah uva athao thao nathat uvin; hinlah kelngoi hon chu navah pouve.
target: You eat the curds, clothe yourselves with the wool and slaughter the choice animals, but you do not take care of the flock.

source: Veise-a nathahatsah pouvin, adamlouva nasudam pouvin, akisukhaho jong natompouvin, akinomangho jong nahin lepui kit pouvin, amanga jong nagahol pouvin; ahinla hunam le engsetnin vai nahomjiuve.
target: You have not strengthened the weak or healed the sick or bound up the injured. You have not brought back the strays or searched for the lost. You have ruled them harshly and brutally.

source: Chule amaho kelngoi ching umlou jeh-in achehchau uvin; achehchau phatnun, gama gamsaho jouse anneh ahunghi taove.
target: So they were scattered because there was no shepherd, and when they were scattered they became food for all the wild animals.

source: Kakelngoite molsang ho jouse le lhangsang tin chunga avahle taove: henge, ka kelgnoi hon chu leichung jouse-a akithe thangun, amaho chu gahol le-a gamudoh-a koimacha aumpoi.
target: My sheep wandered over all the mountains and on every high hill. They were scattered over the whole earth, and no one searched or looked for them.

source: Hijeh chun, nangho kelngoiching ho, Pakai thusei ngaijun;
target: “ ‘Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the Lord :

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije, Keima kahinjing bangin, Veuvin, kelngoi ching umlou jehle, kelngoi chinghon ka kelngoi ho ahol loujeh-u, chule kakelngoi honho vah tahsanga, amahole amaho akivahjoh jeh-un; kakelngoi honho gamsa tincheng anneh le anchah ahung hitaove;
target: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , because my flock lacks a shepherd and so has been plundered and has become food for all the wild animals, and because my shepherds did not search for my flock but cared for themselves rather than for my flock,

source: Hijeh chun, vo nangho kelngoi chingho, Pakai thu ngaijun;
target: therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the Lord :

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije, Keima kahinjing bangin; Veuvin, keiman kelngoi chingho chu kadou ahi; Keiman amaho khutna kakelngoi honho kangeh-a, kakelngoi hon avah naojong kasuhtang ding; kelngoi chingho chu amahole amaho kivahkit louding ahi; ajehchu, ka kelngoi ho chu amaho anneh ahilouna dinguva, kelngoihon chu akamuva kona kahuhdoh ding ahi.
target: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against the shepherds and will hold them accountable for my flock. I will remove them from tending the flock so that the shepherds can no longer feed themselves. I will rescue my flock from their mouths, and it will no longer be food for them.

source: Ajehchu Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; Veuvin, keima, keimatah-in, ka kelngoi ho chu kahol le-a, kamudoh ding ahi.
target: “ ‘For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I myself will search for my sheep and look after them.

source: Kelngoi chingpan akelngoiho chehchau nikho-a akelngoi honho aholdoh banga; keiman jong ka kelngoi ho kaholdoh-a, meijinle thimjin nikho-a jong acheh chaunau mun jouse-a kona kahuhdoh ding ahi.
target: As a shepherd looks after his scattered flock when he is with them, so will I look after my sheep. I will rescue them from all the places where they were scattered on a day of clouds and darkness.

source: Chule keiman amaho milah-a kona kahinpuidoh-a, gamkaiho-a kona kahin chopkhom ding; amaho gamsung ngeija kahin puilutna, amaho chu Israel molsang ho chung vadungho panga le, mi chenna gamsung mun jouse-a kavah ding ahi.
target: I will bring them out from the nations and gather them from the countries, and I will bring them into their own land. I will pasture them on the mountains of Israel, in the ravines and in all the settlements in the land.

source: Keiman amaho chu hamhing phalah-a kavah-a, Israel molsang ho chung chu amaho hongsung hiding ahi. Chuachu amaho hong phatah-a kol uva, Israel molsang ho chung hamhing phatna-a kivahding ahiuve.
target: I will tend them in a good pasture, and the mountain heights of Israel will be their grazing land. There they will lie down in good grazing land, and there they will feed in a rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.

source: Keiman kakelngoi honho vah ingting, chule amaho chu kakolsah ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: I myself will tend my sheep and have them lie down, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Keiman amangsa chu kahola, anakinomangsa chu kahin lepui kit ding, akeng anabongho chu katom kitna, chule ana-a chu kathahatsah ding ahi. Ahinla keiman athaoho le ahat ho chu kasuhmanga, amaho chu thutan na-a kavah ding ahi.
target: I will search for the lost and bring back the strays. I will bind up the injured and strengthen the weak, but the sleek and the strong I will destroy. I will shepherd the flock with justice.

source: Chule, Vo ka kelngoi ho, nangho chungthua Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; Veuvin, keiman ganchaho le ganchaho kikah, chule kelngoi chalho le keltah chalho kah-a thu katane.
target: “ ‘As for you, my flock, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will judge between one sheep and another, and between rams and goats.

source: Hamhing phatah gah nehchai jenga, hamhing pha nanehmoh chengse nakengtouva nachil dingu chu thil neocha-a nangaitouva, chule twi thuhtah ho-a kona nadon uva, amoh chu nakengtouva nasuhneh dingu chu thil neocha-a nangaitou ham?
target: Is it not enough for you to feed on the good pasture? Must you also trample the rest of your pasture with your feet? Is it not enough for you to drink clear water? Must you also muddy the rest with your feet?

source: Keima kelngoihon vang, nakengtouva nachilu hamhing chu aneh-u ahin, nanghon nakengtouva nasuhneh-u twi chu adonu ahi.
target: Must my flock feed on what you have trampled and drink what you have muddied with your feet?

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in amaho henga hitihin aseije; Veuvin, keima, keima tah-in, gancha athaoho le agongho kah-a thu katan ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says to them: See, I myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

source: Nanghon napang hou le nalengkou uva nano uva, chule adamlou jouse gamtina achehchau kah seuva naki houva nata jeh-un;
target: Because you shove with flank and shoulder, butting all the weak sheep with your horns until you have driven them away,

source: Hijeh chun keiman kakelngoi honho kahuh doh-a, anchah-a pangkit talou dingu; chule keiman gancha le ganchakah-a thu katan ding ahi.
target: I will save my flock, and they will no longer be plundered. I will judge between one sheep and another.

source: Chule keiman amaho chunga kelngoiching khat katundoh ding, aman amaho chu avah-a, kasoh David ngei jong avah ding; chule aman amaho chu avah ding, chule ama amaho chingpa hiding ahi.
target: I will place over them one shepherd, my servant David, and he will tend them; he will tend them and be their shepherd.

source: Chule Pakai keima hi amaho Pathen kahia, chule kasohpa David chu amaho lah-a pipui hiding ahi; Pakai keiman hichehi kaseidoh ahitai.
target: I the Lord will be their God, and my servant David will be prince among them. I the Lord have spoken.

source: Chule keiman amahotoh chamna thulhun khat kasem ding, chule agamsunga kona sahem gilouho kasuhthip ding; chule amaho gammang sunga ihmuva, gamthip sunga bitkeija cheng dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘I will make a covenant of peace with them and rid the land of savage beasts so that they may live in the wilderness and sleep in the forests in safety.

source: Chule keiman amahole kalhangho kimvela munho chu phattheina khatna kasem ding; chule keiman gohong chu aphatcha kajuh lhah sah-a, phattheina gohong hungju ding ahi.
target: I will make them and the places surrounding my hill a blessing. I will send down showers in season; there will be showers of blessing.

source: Chule gama thingphungin aga ahinsosah ding, chule leisetnin aga ahinsosah-a, agam sunguva bitkei diu; keiman anamkoljon khaovu kasuhtana, soh-a bolho khutna kona kahuhdoh tengle, keima Pakai kahi chu ahet dingu ahi.
target: The trees will yield their fruit and the ground will yield its crops; the people will be secure in their land. They will know that I am the Lord , when I break the bars of their yoke and rescue them from the hands of those who enslaved them.

source: Chule amaho Pathen heloute anchah hikit taloudiu, ahiloule gamsung sahon jong amaho abahgam kit tahlou dingu; amavang bitkeija chenguva, koimachan amaho asuh tijat lou dingu ahitai.
target: They will no longer be plundered by the nations, nor will wild animals devour them. They will live in safety, and no one will make them afraid.

source: Chule keiman amaho dinga thingnou minthang tah khat katundoh ding, chule amaho chu gamsunga kelin athagam lou dingu; chule Pathen hephaloute khutna kon jum le ja athohkit lou dingu ahitai.
target: I will provide for them a land renowned for its crops, and they will no longer be victims of famine in the land or bear the scorn of the nations.

source: Chutia chu amahon keima Pakai amaho Pathen kahin, amaho kaumpi ji-e ti ahet dingu, chule amaho, Israel insung ngei jonghi keima mite ahiuve, ti akihetdoh dingu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: Then they will know that I, the Lord their God, am with them and that they, the Israelites, are my people, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Chule ka kelngoihon, ka hamhing lah-a kelngoihon chu mihem ahiuvin, chule keima nangho Pathen kahi tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: You are my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, and I am your God, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ ”

source: Chukalvalin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin ati,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Seir molsang chu maingatnin lang, ama dounan gaothu seijin;
target: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir; prophesy against it

source: Chule hitihin seijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; Ven, Vo Seir molsang, keiman nangma kadouvin, chule nangma douna kakhut jah-a, nangma kakamhelsah ding nahi.
target: and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you and make you a desolate waste.

source: Keiman nakhopihou agohkeova kalha-a, nangma nakamhel ding, chule nangman keima Pakai kahi chu nahet ding ahi.
target: I will turn your towns into ruins and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

source: Ajehchu nangman kumkho-a mudana naneijin, ahamset nikho laijun, chule akhangit lounao kichai phatnin jong nangman chemjam thahatnin Israel chate thisan nason ahi.
target: “ ‘Because you harbored an ancient hostility and delivered the Israelites over to the sword at the time of their calamity, the time their punishment reached its climax,

source: Hijeh chun, keima kahinjing bangin tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije, nangma thisan sona lama kagontei ding nahin, thisanin nanungdel peh ding; nangman thisan jong nahot tahlou jeh-in, thisan ngeijin nanung delpeh ding ahi.
target: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , I will give you over to bloodshed and it will pursue you. Since you did not hate bloodshed, bloodshed will pursue you.

source: Hitia chu keiman Seir molsang chu kasuhkamhela, ama-a kona potdohpa le ahung kilekitpa chu kasuhbei ding ahi.
target: I will make Mount Seir a desolate waste and cut off from it all who come and go.

source: Chule keiman ama molsang ho chu ami kithat ho-a kadip ding; nalhangho le na phaicham ho, chule vadungho jouse sunga chemjam'a kithat ho chu lhudingu ahiuve.
target: I will fill your mountains with the slain; those killed by the sword will fall on your hills and in your valleys and in all your ravines.

source: Keiman nangma kumkho-a kamhela kalha-a, chule nakhopiho chu hungkile kit louding; chutengle nangman keima Pakai kahi chu nahetdoh ding ahi.
target: I will make you desolate forever; your towns will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

source: Ajehchu nangman, hiche nam teni le hiche gam tenihi keija hiding ahin, chule chua Pakai umnaho chu keihon kalo diu ahi, tin naseije.
target: “ ‘Because you have said, “These two nations and countries will be ours and we will take possession of them,” even though I the Lord was there,

source: Hijeh chun, keima kahing jinge, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije, nangma amaho hotna-a namanchah nalunghan dungjuile nathangthipna dungjuija nachunga kaboltei ding ahin; chule keiman nathu katan tengle, alah uva keile kei kakihetsah ding ahi.
target: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , I will treat you in accordance with the anger and jealousy you showed in your hatred of them and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.

source: Chule nangman keima Pakai kahi chu nahet ding ahi. Chule Israel molsang ho douna-a, amaho agoh-a um ahitai, amaho suhmang dinga eiho eipeh-u ahitai, tia taitomna thu nanasei jouse chu kanajah ahitai.
target: Then you will know that I the Lord have heard all the contemptible things you have said against the mountains of Israel. You said, “They have been laid waste and have been given over to us to devour.”

source: Hiti chun nakam sungin keima dounan nahoithon, chule keima dounan nathusei napunsah-in, hicheho chu kajasohtai.
target: You boasted against me and spoke against me without restraint, and I heard it.

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; Leiset pumpi ahung kipa tengle, keiman nangma kamhela kalha ding nahi.
target: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: While the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.

source: Israel insung goulo akamhel jeh-a nakipa banga, nangjong kamhela kalha ding nahi. Vo Seir molsang, chule Edom mite jouse, nabon uva kamhel ding nahiuve; chutengle amahon Pakai kahi chu ahetdoh dingu ahi.
target: Because you rejoiced when the inheritance of Israel became desolate, that is how I will treat you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, you and all of Edom. Then they will know that I am the Lord .’ ”

source: Chujongle nangma mihem chapa, nangman Israel molsang ho henga chun gaothu seijin lang, chule hitin seijin, Nangho molsang hon Pakai thu chu ngaijun:
target: “Son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say, ‘Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord .

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Namelma ten nangma douna-a, Aha, khanglui laija mun sangho jeng jong eiho loding ahitai tin aseijun ahi.
target: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: The enemy said of you, “Aha! The ancient heights have become our possession.” ’

source: Hijeh chun, gaovinlang seijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Ajehchu Pathen heloute neile gouva pangdingle, thusei ho kam nopna le japi seithanga naum theina dinguva, amahon nangho kamhela nalhauva, chule muntin-ah naval lhum jeh-un;
target: Therefore prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because they ravaged and crushed you from every side so that you became the possession of the rest of the nations and the object of people’s malicious talk and slander,

source: Hijeh chun Israel molsang ho nanghon Pakai Pathen thuseihi ngaijun; Pakai Pathen'in molsang ho henga, lhangho henga, vadungho henga, phaicham ho henga, ahomkeova moh-umho henga, akidalhasa khopiho henga, akimvela Pathen helouho anchah le nuisat bep hiho henga hitihin aseije.
target: therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Sovereign Lord : This is what the Sovereign Lord says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys, to the desolate ruins and the deserted towns that have been plundered and ridiculed by the rest of the nations around you—

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; tahbeh-a lungthim kipahtah le hatah-a noisena lungthim puma kagam agoulo dinguva amahole amaho chanvou akihoma Pathen helou chidang namdangho le Edom mite jouse douna-a kathangthipna meikonga kasei ahi.
target: this is what the Sovereign Lord says: In my burning zeal I have spoken against the rest of the nations, and against all Edom, for with glee and with malice in their hearts they made my land their own possession so that they might plunder its pastureland.’

source: Hijeh chun Israel gamsung chungchanga gaovinlang, molsang ho henga, lhangho henga, vadungho henga, chule phaicham ho henga seipeh-in, Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; vetan, nanghon Pathen heloute jum na chu napoh jeh uva, keiman kathangthipna le kalungsatna-a kasei ahi:
target: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel and say to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I speak in my jealous wrath because you have suffered the scorn of the nations.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Keiman kakhut kadomsangtan, tahbeh-a nakimvel uva um Pathen helouten ajumnau akipoh dingu ahi.
target: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I swear with uplifted hand that the nations around you will also suffer scorn.

source: Ahivangin nangho, vo Israel molsang ho, nanghon nabah hou chu nahin jam dohsah uva, nagao chu kami Israelte henga nasosah dingu ahi; ajehchu amaho ahung ding koncha ahitaove.
target: “ ‘But you, mountains of Israel, will produce branches and fruit for my people Israel, for they will soon come home.

source: Ijeh inem itile, veuvin, keima nangho ding kahin, chule naheng lamuva hungkile heijing ting, chule nangho kaibot le tu-a umding nahitaove:
target: I am concerned for you and will look on you with favor; you will be plowed and sown,

source: Chule Israel insung pumpile nabonchao chunga mihem kapunsah ding; chule khopiho chenna hikitna, achimsaho chu kisadoh kit ding ahi.
target: and I will cause many people to live on you—yes, all of Israel. The towns will be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt.

source: Chule keiman nachunga mihem le sahem kapunsah-a, amaho punguva ga ahinsosah dingu; chule keiman nachenna mun lui dungjuija kachensah-a, chule nahung kipat tila sanga phajoa kabol ding: chutengle keima Pakai kahi chu nahet ding ahi.
target: I will increase the number of people and animals living on you, and they will be fruitful and become numerous. I will settle people on you as in the past and will make you prosper more than before. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

source: Henge, keiman mihemte nachunga kachele sah ding, kami Israelte ngei chu nachung uva kachelesah ding; amahon nangma nahin lo dingu, nangma amaho goulo nahi ding, tua patna achate nasuhmang louding ahitai.
target: I will cause people, my people Israel, to live on you. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance; you will never again deprive them of their children.

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; amahon nangma henga, Gamsung nangman mihem naval lhumin, nanam mihemho chate jouse nasumang tai, tia asei jeh-un;
target: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because some say to you, “You devour people and deprive your nation of its children,”

source: Hijeh chun nangman mihemho naval lhum kit louding, chule nanam mite chate jong nasuhmang kit louding ahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: therefore you will no longer devour people or make your nation childless, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Keiman Pathen heloute jum na chu nangma-a um mite kajahdohsah louding, mipi ho seiset jong napoh kit louding, chule nanam mite lhuhna nasodohsah kit louding ahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: No longer will I make you hear the taunts of the nations, and no longer will you suffer the scorn of the peoples or cause your nation to fall, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ ”

source: Chukal valin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, hitin aseije,
target: Again the word of the Lord came to me:
