source: Mihem chapa, Israel insung chu amaho gamsunga anachen laiju chun, amaho le amaho deija achonnau le athilbolun hichu anasuboh-un: achonnau chu kamasanga numei athinei laija thenglou bangin anaumuve.
target: “Son of man, when the people of Israel were living in their own land, they defiled it by their conduct and their actions. Their conduct was like a woman’s monthly uncleanness in my sight.

source: Hijeh-a chu gamsunga thisan aso jeh-ule, semthu milim jeh-a gamsung asuhboh jeh uva, achunguva kalungsatna kasunlhah ahin;
target: So I poured out my wrath on them because they had shed blood in the land and because they had defiled it with their idols.

source: Chule keiman amaho Pathen heloute lah-a kathecheh-in, chuin gamdangho-a anakithe thangun ahi. Achonnau dungjuile anatoh-u dungjuija athu-u katan ding ahi.
target: I dispersed them among the nations, and they were scattered through the countries; I judged them according to their conduct and their actions.

source: Chule amaho achenna lamu, Pathen helouho gamsunga alut phatnun, chumuna miho chun amaho henga, Amahohi Pakai mite ahiuvin, ahivangin ama gamsunga kona potdoh ahitaove, ati tengule kamin theng asuboh-un ahi.
target: And wherever they went among the nations they profaned my holy name, for it was said of them, ‘These are the Lord ’s people, and yet they had to leave his land.’

source: Ahinla achena lam jouseuva, Pathen heloute lah-a asuhboh-u kamintheng chu khotona kaneijin ahi.
target: I had concern for my holy name, which the people of Israel profaned among the nations where they had gone.

source: Hijeh chun Israel insung henga seijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Hichehi nangho jala kabol ahipoi, ahinla vo Israel insung, nangho Pathen helouho lah-a nache nalam channuva nasuh boh-u kamintheng jala kabol ahi.
target: “Therefore say to the Israelites, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: It is not for your sake, people of Israel, that I am going to do these things, but for the sake of my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you have gone.

source: Chule Pathen helou lah-a kisuboh, nanghon amaho lah-a nasuhboh-u, kamin loupitah chu kasuhtheng ding; chule Pathen helouho mitmu-a keima nangho-a suhtheng kahi tengle, Pathen hephalouhon Pakai Pathen kahi ahet dingu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: I will show the holiness of my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, the name you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the Lord , declares the Sovereign Lord , when I am proved holy through you before their eyes.

source: Ajehchu, keiman nangho Pathen helouho lah-a kona kapuidoh-a, gamjouse-a kona kakhop khom ding, chule nagam uva kapuilut ding nahiuve.
target: “ ‘For I will take you out of the nations; I will gather you from all the countries and bring you back into your own land.

source: Chutengle keiman nachung uva twitheng kachap khuma, nangho nangim dingu ahi. Nathen lounao jouse-a konle namilim semthu-u jouse-a kona keiman nangho kasuhngim ding nahiuve.
target: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean; I will cleanse you from all your impurities and from all your idols.

source: Lungthim thah kapeh uva, lhagao thah nasunguva kakhum peh ding; chule keiman natahsaova kona song banga tah lungthim chu kalah doh-a, tahsaphe lungthim kapeh ding nahiuve.
target: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you; I will remove from you your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.

source: Chule keiman kalhagao nasunguva kakhuma, kadan kisunho-a kachonsah dingu, chule nanghon kathutanho nanit uva, hichu nabol dingu ahi.
target: And I will put my Spirit in you and move you to follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws.

source: Chule napu napateu kanapeh gamsunga nachen dingu; nangho kamite nahiuva, chule keima na Pathen'u kahi ding ahi.
target: Then you will live in the land I gave your ancestors; you will be my people, and I will be your God.

source: Keiman nangho nathenlounao jouse-a kona jong kahuhdoh dingu: chule changle mim kakouva kapunsah ding, chule nachung uva kel kachuhsah louding ahitai.
target: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and make it plentiful and will not bring famine upon you.

source: Chule Pathen heloute lah-a kellhah jeh-a jum na nato kitlouna dinguva, keiman thingphung ga le lousoh ga kapunsah ding ahi.
target: I will increase the fruit of the trees and the crops of the field, so that you will no longer suffer disgrace among the nations because of famine.

source: Chutengle nanghon nagitlou nao lampiho, chule nanatoh-u phalouho chu nahin kigeldoh uva, chule nakhan gitlounao hole thet umtah nahinahou jouse jeh-a nangho le nangho mitmu jenga jong nakikidah dingu ahi.
target: Then you will remember your evil ways and wicked deeds, and you will loathe yourselves for your sins and detestable practices.

source: Nangho jala hichehi kabol ahipoi, nanghon kihet un, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije, Vo Israel insung, nachonnahou jeh-in jahchaovin chule kisudongun.
target: I want you to know that I am not doing this for your sake, declares the Sovereign Lord . Be ashamed and disgraced for your conduct, people of Israel!

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Keiman nangho nachonkhelna hou jouse-a kona kasuhtheng nikho tengle, keiman nangho khopi sungho-a jong kachensah uva, chule achimsaho jong kisadoh kit ding ahi.
target: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: On the day I cleanse you from all your sins, I will resettle your towns, and the ruins will be rebuilt.

source: Chule apal leho jouse mitmu-a kamhel, akamhela um gam chu kilhou kit ding ahi.
target: The desolate land will be cultivated instead of lying desolate in the sight of all who pass through it.

source: Chule amahon, Hiche akamhel anahisa gam chu Eden hon abang jeng tan; chule agoh-a um le anakamhel chule anakisusesa khopiho chu kul kikai khum le chenna ahung hitai, tia asei dingu ahi.
target: They will say, “This land that was laid waste has become like the garden of Eden; the cities that were lying in ruins, desolate and destroyed, are now fortified and inhabited.”

source: Chutengle nakimvela um akidalha Pathen hephaloute chun, Pakai keiman akisuse munho chu kasemphatna, akamhelsa chu kaphudoh ahi ti ahet dingu ahi. Keima Pakaiyin kaseidoh ahin, chule hichu kaboltei ding ahi.
target: Then the nations around you that remain will know that I the Lord have rebuilt what was destroyed and have replanted what was desolate. I the Lord have spoken, and I will do it.’

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; keima hiche dingle, hiche hi amaho dinga tohdohpeh ahina dinga Israel insungin eidoh nahlai dingu ahi; keiman amaho chu kelngoihon banga mihem'a kapunsah ding ahiuve.
target: “This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Once again I will yield to Israel’s plea and do this for them: I will make their people as numerous as sheep,

source: Kelngoihon theng tobanga, kut thupi laija Jerusalem'a kelngoihon tobanga; chutia chu agoh-a umsa khopiho chu mihem ahon honna kisudim ding; chutengle amahon keima Pakai kahi chu ahet dingu ahi.
target: as numerous as the flocks for offerings at Jerusalem during her appointed festivals. So will the ruined cities be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the Lord .”

source: Pakai khut chu kachunga ahung chun, chuin Pakai Lhagaovin eipuidoh-in, chule guho dimsetna aumna phaicham lailunga eikoijin,
target: The hand of the Lord was on me, and he brought me out by the Spirit of the Lord and set me in the middle of a valley; it was full of bones.

source: Chuin alah uva chun eiche kimvelsah len; chule veuvin, chuche phaichama chun gu atama tam aumin, chule veuvin, agoset jenguvin ahi.
target: He led me back and forth among them, and I saw a great many bones on the floor of the valley, bones that were very dry.

source: Chuin aman kahenga, mihem chapa, hiche guhohi ahingthei diuvem? ati. Chuin keiman, Vo Pakai Pathen nangman nahenai, tin kadonbutne.
target: He asked me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I said, “Sovereign Lord , you alone know.”

source: Avelin kahenga hitin aseije, hiche guho henga hin gaovinlang, ajah uva seijin, Vo nangho gu gosaho, Pakai thuhi ngaijuvin.
target: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to these bones and say to them, ‘Dry bones, hear the word of the Lord !

source: Pakai Pathen'in hiche guho henga hitihin aseije; veuvin, keiman nasunguva haitheina hu kalutsah ding, chule nangho nahin dingu ahi.
target: This is what the Sovereign Lord says to these bones: I will make breath enter you, and you will come to life.

source: Chule keiman nachung uva thagui ho kalhuna, phe kahin besah ding, chule nangho vunna kahintoma, nasunguva haitheina hu kakhum ding; chule nangho nahung hin uva, keima Pakai Pathen kahi chu nahet dingu ahi.
target: I will attach tendons to you and make flesh come upon you and cover you with skin; I will put breath in you, and you will come to life. Then you will know that I am the Lord .’ ”

source: Hitichun keima eikithupeh dungjuijin gaothu kaseitan ahi. Chuin keiman gaothu kasei chun, husa khat ahung gingin, chule veuvin ahung gingpoh sotsotnin, chuin guho chu ama ama gucheh-a ahung kisuto uvin ahi.
target: So I prophesied as I was commanded. And as I was prophesying, there was a noise, a rattling sound, and the bones came together, bone to bone.

source: Chuin keiman kaven ahile, veuvin, thajung ho le phe chu achunguva ahung umin, chule vunin amaho chung chu ahin tomtan: ahinla amaho sunga chun haitheina hu aumpon ahi.
target: I looked, and tendons and flesh appeared on them and skin covered them, but there was no breath in them.

source: Chujouvin aman kajah-a, mihem chapa, hui jah-a chun gaothu seijin, gaovin, hui jah-a chun seijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Kolning li-a konin hungin, vo haitheina hu, hiche thilongho hi ahin theina dingun hai khumin, ati.
target: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, son of man, and say to it, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Come, breath, from the four winds and breathe into these slain, that they may live.’ ”

source: Hitichun aman eithupeh bangin gaothu kaseitai, haitheina hu chu amaho sunga ahung lutnin, amaho ahung hingdoh taovin, ahung dingdoh uvin ahile, sepaihon tamtah ahiuvin ahi.
target: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and breath entered them; they came to life and stood up on their feet—a vast army.

source: Chuin aman kahenga, Mihem chapa, hiche guhohi Israel insung pumpi chu ahiuve; Ven, amahon, kaguhou agolhan, chule kakinepnao amangtai, keiho ahal halla sattel kahitaove, tin aseijuve.
target: Then he said to me: “Son of man, these bones are the people of Israel. They say, ‘Our bones are dried up and our hope is gone; we are cut off.’

source: Hijeh chun gaovinlang ahenguva hitin seijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; Veuvin, Vo kamite, keiman nalhankhuh hou chu kahona, chule nalhanhouva kona nangho kahung dohsah dingu, chule nangho Israel gamsunga kahin puilut dingu nahiuve.
target: Therefore prophesy and say to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: My people, I am going to open your graves and bring you up from them; I will bring you back to the land of Israel.

source: Chule keiman nalhankhuh hou kahin honna, Vo kamiteho, nalhankhuh houva kona kahin puidoh tengule, keima Pakai kahi nahetdingu ahi.
target: Then you, my people, will know that I am the Lord , when I open your graves and bring you up from them.

source: Chule kalhagao nasunguva kakhuma, nahin dingu, keiman nangho nagamsung tah uva kakoi dingu; chuteng nanghon, Pakai keiman hichu kasei ahitan, chule hichu kabol ahitai, ti nahet dingu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will put my Spirit in you and you will live, and I will settle you in your own land. Then you will know that I the Lord have spoken, and I have done it, declares the Lord .’ ”

source: Pakai thu chu avelin kahenga ahung lhungin, hitin aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Chukalvallin, mihem chapa, tenggol khat lanlang, achunga chun Judah le akiloipi Israel chate ding tin sunin; chujou tengle tenggol chomkhat lanlang, achunga chun, Joseph ding, Ephraim tenggol, chule akiloipi Israel insung pumpi ding, tin sunnin.
target: “Son of man, take a stick of wood and write on it, ‘Belonging to Judah and the Israelites associated with him.’ Then take another stick of wood, and write on it, ‘Belonging to Joseph (that is, to Ephraim) and all the Israelites associated with him.’

source: Chule hiteni chu khatle khat jopmin lang, tenggol khat hisah-in, chule hiteni chu nakhutna khat hungsoh lhon ding ahi.
target: Join them together into one stick so that they will become one in your hand.

source: Chule namite chatehon nahenga, Hichehi ipi natina ahi keiho neivetsah lou dingu ham? ati tengule,
target: “When your people ask you, ‘Won’t you tell us what you mean by this?’

source: Ahenguva seipeh-in, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Veuvin, keiman Ephraim le agolho Israel phungho khutna um Joseph tenggol chu kalah-a, hiho chu Judah tenggol ngei chutoh kakoikhom ding, hiche teni chu tenggol khat kasoa, hiteni chu kakhutna khat hiding ahi.
target: say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am going to take the stick of Joseph—which is in Ephraim’s hand—and of the Israelite tribes associated with him, and join it to Judah’s stick. I will make them into a single stick of wood, and they will become one in my hand.’

source: Chule nangman achung najih tenggol teni chu amaho mitmu tah-a nangma khutna umding ahi.
target: Hold before their eyes the sticks you have written on

source: Chule amaho jah-a seijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Veuvin, keiman Israel chate chu Pathen heloute lah-a agachenau munho-a kona kalahdoh ding, chule amaho ningtina kachom khoma, chule amaho chu amaho gamsung ngeija kalhut ding ahi.
target: and say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will take the Israelites out of the nations where they have gone. I will gather them from all around and bring them back into their own land.

source: Chule keiman gamsunga chu, Israel molsang ho chunga amaho chu nam khatna kasema, leng khat chu amaho jouse dinga alengpau hiding; chule amaho chu nam ni hitalou ding, chule lenggam ni-a a-itih-a kikhen kit talouhel ding ahiuve.
target: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. There will be one king over all of them and they will never again be two nations or be divided into two kingdoms.

source: Ahiloujongle amaho chu asemthu-u milimho ningset umtah thilho le achonkhelna houva jong amahole amaho kisuboh talou dingu; anachon setnaova achennao munho-a kona keiman amaho kahuh doh-a, kasuhtheng dingu ahi. Chutia chu amaho kamite hiuva, keima a-Pathen'u kahi ding ahi.
target: They will no longer defile themselves with their idols and vile images or with any of their offenses, for I will save them from all their sinful backsliding, and I will cleanse them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

source: Chule kasoh David chu amaho chunga leng hiding; abonchauva kelngoiching khat anei dingu ahi. Amaho chu keima thutan danho-a chonuva, kadan kisunho anitdiu, chule hiho chu atohdoh dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘My servant David will be king over them, and they will all have one shepherd. They will follow my laws and be careful to keep my decrees.

source: Chule amaho chu keiman kalhacha Jacob kanapehna, napu napateu anachenau gama chu cheng diu; chule hia chu amaho, amahotah chule achateu, chule achateu chate a-itih-a chenguva, kasoh David chu a-itih-a apipu-u hiding ahitai.
target: They will live in the land I gave to my servant Jacob, the land where your ancestors lived. They and their children and their children’s children will live there forever, and David my servant will be their prince forever.

source: Chukalvalla keiman amahotoh chamna thulhun kasema, hichu amahotoh a-itih-a thulhun hiding; chule amaho kachensah-a, chule kapunsah-a, alah uva atonsotna kamun theng katundoh ding ahi.
target: I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be an everlasting covenant. I will establish them and increase their numbers, and I will put my sanctuary among them forever.

source: Kahoubuh jong amahotoh umkhom ding; henge, keima amaho Pathen kahia, amaho kamite hidingu ahi.
target: My dwelling place will be with them; I will be their God, and they will be my people.

source: Chule kamun theng chu amaho lahtah-a a-imatih chana aumtengle, Pathen helouhon Pakai keiman Israel kasuhtheng ahi ahet dingu ahitai.
target: Then the nations will know that I the Lord make Israel holy, when my sanctuary is among them forever.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, hitin aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Mihem chapa, Meshech le Tubal vaipo pipen Magog gama Gog lam chu maingatnin lang, ama dounan gaothu seijin,
target: “Son of man, set your face against Gog, of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshek and Tubal; prophesy against him

source: Chule seipeh-in, Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; Vo Gog, Meshech le Tubal pipu, ven, keiman nangma kadou nahi.
target: and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshek and Tubal.

source: Chule keima nangma ka nungchon kitding, chule nakhalhang teni-a ngakoi kakoija, nangma galsat mihon jouse, sakol ho le sakol chungtouho, galvon jat kima kivonho jouse, lum le pho tho-a chemjam kichoija mihonpi ho chu aboncha keijuva kahin puidoh ding ahi.
target: I will turn you around, put hooks in your jaws and bring you out with your whole army—your horses, your horsemen fully armed, and a great horde with large and small shields, all of them brandishing their swords.

source: Persia, Ethiopia chule Libya toh pangkhom, abonchauva lumle thih lukhuh tho cheh;
target: Persia, Cush and Put will be with them, all with shields and helmets,

source: Gomer le aloiho jouse, sahlam sanga Togarmah insungmite le apankhom piho; chule mipi tampi tah-in aumpiho.
target: also Gomer with all its troops, and Beth Togarmah from the far north with all its troops—the many nations with you.

source: Kigosan umin, nangle nang, nangmale nahenga kikhom naloiho jouse kigochaisan umun, chule nangma amaho ngahtupmin pangin.
target: “ ‘Get ready; be prepared, you and all the hordes gathered about you, and take command of them.

source: Ni tampi joule nakivil ding; ninunung lamle, chemjam'a kona kinung puidoh-a, mipi tampiho lah-a kona kichom khom ho chenna mun, sottah kamhela anaum Israel molsang ho dou dinga nahung kon ding ahi; amaho chu namtin lah-a kona kihin puidoh ahin, amaho abonchauvin bitkeichan achengun ahi.
target: After many days you will be called to arms. In future years you will invade a land that has recovered from war, whose people were gathered from many nations to the mountains of Israel, which had long been desolate. They had been brought out from the nations, and now all of them live in safety.

source: Nangma huipi le gopi banga nakal touva nahung ding, nangmale naloiho jouse, chule nangma toh um mihonpi chu agam khujouhel ding meilompi tobang nahidingu ahi.
target: You and all your troops and the many nations with you will go up, advancing like a storm; you will be like a cloud covering the land.

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; chule hung hitiding ahi, hiche nikhotah chule nalungsunga lunggel tamtah hungsoh doh ding, hiche phat mama chule lunggel gilou khat nahin gelding ahi.
target: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: On that day thoughts will come into your mind and you will devise an evil scheme.

source: Chuteng nangman seijin natin, Keima kulpibei khoho-a chetou vingting; mongtah-a uma, bitkeija chengho, aboncha keijuva kulbang bei, kotgolhole kotpiho jong neilouho henga chengting;
target: You will say, “I will invade a land of unwalled villages; I will attack a peaceful and unsuspecting people—all of them living without walls and without gates and bars.

source: Galthil kichomdoh ho ladingle, anchah lading; chule agoh-a anaumsa tu-a mi chenna mun, namtin lah-a kona kichom khom mite chenna mun, gam lailung tah-a cheng, ganchale thilkeo haotahho, chunga kakhut kalap ding ahi nati.
target: I will plunder and loot and turn my hand against the resettled ruins and the people gathered from the nations, rich in livestock and goods, living at the center of the land.”

source: Sheba le Dedan chule Tarshish sumkolvei ho, amaho keipi bahkai chal donglai jouse chun nahenga, Galthil chom dinga hung nahim? mihonpi chu thilkeo podinga nakou khom ham? sanale dangka pomang dinga, ganchale thilkeo pomang dinga, thilchom tamtah podinga nahung ham? atidiu ahi.
target: Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish and all her villages will say to you, “Have you come to plunder? Have you gathered your hordes to loot, to carry off silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods and to seize much plunder?” ’

source: Hijeh chun mihem chapa, gaovinlang Gog henga hitihin seijin, Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Kami Israelte bitkeija achen nikho tengule, nangman nahetlou dingham?
target: “Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say to Gog: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: In that day, when my people Israel are living in safety, will you not take notice of it?

source: Chule nangma naumna sahlam gamho-a kona, nangle naumpi mipi tamtah, sakol chungtou cheh, mipi tamtah le galmi hattahho toh kilhona nahungdoh ding ahin,
target: You will come from your place in the far north, you and many nations with you, all of them riding on horses, a great horde, a mighty army.

source: Chule nangma kami Israelte kidoupi dinga, meilhangin gamsung akhu banga nahung kon ding; ninunung lamle hiti ding ahi, Vo Gog, kagam doudinga nangma kahinpui ding, Pathen heloute mitmu-a nangma-a kona suhthenga kaumteng, amahon Pathen kahi ahet dingu ahi.
target: You will advance against my people Israel like a cloud that covers the land. In days to come, Gog, I will bring you against my land, so that the nations may know me when I am proved holy through you before their eyes.

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; malaija keiman kasoh Israelte themgaoho kama kanaseisa, amahon kum tampi nikhoho sunga gaothu anaseiju, amaho kidoupi ding kahinpui ding ahi tia kanaseipa chu nangma nahi louham?
target: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: You are the one I spoke of in former days by my servants the prophets of Israel. At that time they prophesied for years that I would bring you against them.

source: Chule Israel gamsung doupi dinga Gog ahungtengle, chuche phattahchule hung hitiding ahi, kalungsatna chu kamaija hung kilangdoh ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: This is what will happen in that day: When Gog attacks the land of Israel, my hot anger will be aroused, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Ajehchu kathangthipna le kalunghana meikouva kasei ahi, tahbeh-in hiche nikho chule Israel gamsunga nasatah-a tijat umtah ling kihot ding ahin;
target: In my zeal and fiery wrath I declare that at that time there shall be a great earthquake in the land of Israel.

source: Chutia chu twipia ngaho, chunga leng vachaho, gama gamsaho, a-opma tolla kithol ganhing jouse, leiset chunga um mihem kiti jouse chu kamai koh-a kihot hot dingu, molsang ho kisunema, kolho lhanem suh ding, chule kulbang jouse chimlha ding ahi.
target: The fish in the sea, the birds in the sky, the beasts of the field, every creature that moves along the ground, and all the people on the face of the earth will tremble at my presence. The mountains will be overturned, the cliffs will crumble and every wall will fall to the ground.

source: Chule keiman Gog kidoupi dinga kamolsangho jouse-a kona chemjam kakou ding, mijousen asopi chunga chemjam alap ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: I will summon a sword against Gog on all my mountains, declares the Sovereign Lord . Every man’s sword will be against his brother.

source: Chule hise le thisanna athu katan ding; amale ahonho, chule aumpi tamtah ho chunga alonglet jeng gotwi, song lentah ho, meikou, chule kat kajuhsah ding ahi.
target: I will execute judgment on him with plague and bloodshed; I will pour down torrents of rain, hailstones and burning sulfur on him and on his troops and on the many nations with him.

source: Chutia chu keima kei le kei kakichoisanga, chule kakisuhtheng ding; namtin vaipi mitmu-a het kahi ding, chule amahon keima Pakai kahi chu ahet dingu ahi.
target: And so I will show my greatness and my holiness, and I will make myself known in the sight of many nations. Then they will know that I am the Lord .’

source: Hijeh chun, nangma mihem chapa, Gog dounan gaothu seijin, chule hitihin seijin, Pakai Pathen'in aseije; Meshech le Tubal pipu pen O Gog, ven, keiman nangma kadou nahi.
target: “Son of man, prophesy against Gog and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshek and Tubal.

source: Keiman nangma kanungno kitna, nangma-a um hop gupma hopkhat kadalhah sah-a, sahlam gambehho-a kona nangma nahungtouva, Israel molsang ho chunga kahinpuiding nahi.
target: I will turn you around and drag you along. I will bring you from the far north and send you against the mountains of Israel.

source: Chule keiman nakhut veilama um nathalpi chu kajepset peh-a, nathal changho chu nakhut jetna kona kakhehlhah sah ding ahi.
target: Then I will strike your bow from your left hand and make your arrows drop from your right hand.

source: Nangma Israel molsang ho chunga nalhuh-a, nangma le naloiho jouse, chule naumpi mipite jouse nalhuh dingu; keiman nangma sahingne vacha namkim le gama saho valhum dinga kapeh ding nahi.
target: On the mountains of Israel you will fall, you and all your troops and the nations with you. I will give you as food to all kinds of carrion birds and to the wild animals.

source: Nangma gam ong laija nalhuh ding ahi: ajehchu keiman kasei ahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: You will fall in the open field, for I have spoken, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Chule Magog chungle twikol sunga olmo louva chengho lah-a meikou kasol ding; amahon keima Pakai kahihi ahet dingu ahi.
target: I will send fire on Magog and on those who live in safety in the coastlands, and they will know that I am the Lord .

source: Chutia chu keiman kamin thenghi kami Israelte hetna kaumsah-a; kamintheng chu amaho kasuhboh sah kit louding ahitai. Chule Pathen helou ten keima Pakai, Israel mithengpa kahi chu ahet dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘I will make known my holy name among my people Israel. I will no longer let my holy name be profaned, and the nations will know that I the Lord am the Holy One in Israel.

source: Veuvin, hichehi aguilhungin, akitong dohtai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije, hichehi keiman kanaseidohna nikho chu ahi.
target: It is coming! It will surely take place, declares the Sovereign Lord . This is the day I have spoken of.

source: Israel khopiho sunga chengho chu potdoh uva, gal manchah ho, lum le phoho, thalpi le thalchang ho, chule tengpaineiho le tengcha ho chu meija ahaluva, hiho chu kum sagi meija akiti dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘Then those who live in the towns of Israel will go out and use the weapons for fuel and burn them up—the small and large shields, the bows and arrows, the war clubs and spears. For seven years they will use them for fuel.

source: Chutia chu gama kona thing achomlou dingu, gamanga kona jong thing khatcha atuhlhuhtah loudingu ahi: ajehchu amahon gal manchah ho chu meija akiti dingu; amaho sumangho chu amahon asuhmang dingu, amahon asuhsethou chu achomgam dingu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: They will not need to gather wood from the fields or cut it from the forests, because they will use the weapons for fuel. And they will plunder those who plundered them and loot those who looted them, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Chule hiche niteng chule hung hiti ding ahi, keiman Israel gamsung, twipi solama vahle ho phaicham kiti chu, Gog lhankhuh mundinga kapeh ding; hichun vahle ho lampi ahuh ding, chule chuachu amahon Gog le amihonpi jouse avui dingu: hiche mun chu Hamon-Gog phaicham asah dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘On that day I will give Gog a burial place in Israel, in the valley of those who travel east of the Sea. It will block the way of travelers, because Gog and all his hordes will be buried there. So it will be called the Valley of Hamon Gog.

source: Chule gamsung chu suhtheng ahina dinga, lhasagi jen Israel insung chun amaho chu avui dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘For seven months the Israelites will be burying them in order to cleanse the land.

source: Henge, agama mipite jousen amaho avui dingu; keima choisanga kaumna dinga hichu amaho dinga minthana nikho khat hiding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: All the people of the land will bury them, and the day I display my glory will be a memorable day for them, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Chule gamsung suhtheng nadinga, vahle ho to kitho-a gamsung chonchaija leichunga umnalai thilongho holdoh-a vuidinga, natoh-a neiding mi alhendoh diu; lha sagi joule akholpat diu ahi.
target: People will be continually employed in cleansing the land. They will spread out across the land and, along with others, they will bury any bodies that are lying on the ground. “ ‘After the seven months they will carry out a more detailed search.

source: Chule gamsunga vahle ho mi khat touvin mihem gu amuteng, avui dinghon Hamon-Gog phaichama avui kahseuva melchihna khat atundoh dingu ahi.
target: As they go through the land, anyone who sees a human bone will leave a marker beside it until the gravediggers bury it in the Valley of Hamon Gog,

source: Chujongle chuche khopi min chu Hamonah hiding ahi. Hiti achu amahon gamchu asuhtheng dingu ahi.
target: near a town called Hamonah. And so they will cleanse the land.’

source: Chule nangma mihem chapa, nangman chungleng vachate jouse le gama gamsaho jouse henga hitin seijin, Nangho kikhom khomun lang hunguvin; kaganlhaina, nangho ding katodoh ganlhaina, Israel molsang ho chunga ganlhaina lentah kabolna-a, saphe naneh uva, thisan nadon theina dingun, nangho ningtina konin hung kikhom khomun, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: “Son of man, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Call out to every kind of bird and all the wild animals: ‘Assemble and come together from all around to the sacrifice I am preparing for you, the great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel. There you will eat flesh and drink blood.

source: Nanghon mihat ho sa naneh uva, chule leiset vaipipo ho thisan, abonchauva Bashan'a kivah thaochet kelngoichalho, kelngoinou ho, keltahho, bongchalho thisan nadon dingu ahi.
target: You will eat the flesh of mighty men and drink the blood of the princes of the earth as if they were rams and lambs, goats and bulls—all of them fattened animals from Bashan.

source: Chule nangho dinga ganlhaina-a katodoh ganlhaina chu nanghon navaset kahseuva athao naneh dingu, chule nakhamset kahseuva thisan chu nadon dingu ahi.
target: At the sacrifice I am preparing for you, you will eat fat till you are glutted and drink blood till you are drunk.

source: Chutia chu nangho kadokhang chunga sakolhole sakol kangtalai ho, mihat ho le gal hat ho sa naneh vaset dingu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: At my table you will eat your fill of horses and riders, mighty men and soldiers of every kind,’ declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Chule kaloupina chu Pathen helouho lah-a katundoh ding; chuteng Pathen heloute jousen kathutana kamolso le achunguva kakhut kalhah chu amu dingu ahi.
target: “I will display my glory among the nations, and all the nations will see the punishment I inflict and the hand I lay on them.

source: Hiti achu Israel insungin chunikho-a patle akalsea chu Keima Pakai, amaho Pathen kahi chu ahet dingu ahi.
target: From that day forward the people of Israel will know that I am the Lord their God.

source: Chule Pathen heloute chun Israel insung chu akhangit lounao jeh-a gal hinga kikai anahiuve ti ahet dingu ahi. Ajehchu amahon keima dounan asukhelun, hijeh-a chu amaho-a kona kamai kasela, chule amaho chu amelmateu khutna kanapehdoh ahin; chutiachu amaho chemjam'a louva ahiuve.
target: And the nations will know that the people of Israel went into exile for their sin, because they were unfaithful to me. So I hid my face from them and handed them over to their enemies, and they all fell by the sword.

source: Athenlou nao le asuhkhel nao dungjuija kanabola, amaho-a kona kamai kanasel ahi.
target: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and their offenses, and I hid my face from them.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in aseije; tuahi keiman Jacob chu asohchanna-a kona kahinlepui kitna, Israel insung pumpi chunga hepina kanei ding, chule kamintheng dinga katompan ding ahi;
target: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will now restore the fortunes of Jacob and will have compassion on all the people of Israel, and I will be zealous for my holy name.

source: Amahon ajachatnau, keima douna-a suhkhelna-a asuhkhelna hou jouse akipohjou uva, aleisetnuva bitkeija achen tengule, koimachan akichatsah lou dingu ahitai.
target: They will forget their shame and all the unfaithfulness they showed toward me when they lived in safety in their land with no one to make them afraid.

source: Keiman amaho mipite-a kona kahin puikitna, amelmateu gama kona kahin chopkhoma, chule nam tamtah mitmu-a amaho-a keima kahung umtengle,
target: When I have brought them back from the nations and have gathered them from the countries of their enemies, I will be proved holy through them in the sight of many nations.

source: Chuteng amahon keimahi Pathen heloute lah-a amaho sohchang dinga pedohpa, ahivanga agamsung tah ngeijuva hin chomkhom kit, khatcha sohchanga dalhah-a umdensah loupa Pakai amaho Pathen kahi chu ahet dingu ahi.
target: Then they will know that I am the Lord their God, for though I sent them into exile among the nations, I will gather them to their own land, not leaving any behind.

source: Keiman amaho-a kona kamai jong kaselkit tahlou ding ahi: ajehchu keiman kalhagao chu Israel insunga kabuh lhah ahitai, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: I will no longer hide my face from them, for I will pour out my Spirit on the people of Israel, declares the Sovereign Lord .”

source: Kasoh channau kum somni le kum nga, alha sunga nisom lhin nikho, khopi suhsetna ahung umjoukal kum somle kum li lhin nikho tah-in, Pakai khut chu kachunga ahung kingamin, chule keima khulama eipuitai.
target: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after the fall of the city—on that very day the hand of the Lord was on me and he took me there.

source: Chuin Pathen'a kon muneinaho-a chun, aman keima Israel gamsunga eihin puitan, chule lhanglam sanga khopi khat bang jeng molsangtah khat chunga eitousahtan ahi.
target: In visions of God he took me to the land of Israel and set me on a very high mountain, on whose south side were some buildings that looked like a city.

source: Chuin aman keima chumun chu eilhuttan, veuvin, chuachun alimso sum-eng bang jeng, akhutna tupat khaojang khatle thil tena penglhon khat choi mipa khat anaumin, kotpi-a chun anadinge.
target: He took me there, and I saw a man whose appearance was like bronze; he was standing in the gateway with a linen cord and a measuring rod in his hand.

source: Chuin mipa chun kahenga, Mihem chapa, keiman nangma kavetsah dingho jousehi namit tenin ve-inlang, nanakhang tenin ja-in, chule kavetsah ding jousehi nalung gilin ngaiton; ajehchu hicheho chu nangma vetsah ding ngaitona-a nangma hilama kipui nahin; nangman namuho jouse chu Israel insung henga naphondoh ding ahi, tin aseije.
target: The man said to me, “Son of man, look carefully and listen closely and pay attention to everything I am going to show you, for that is why you have been brought here. Tell the people of Israel everything you see.”

source: Chule veuvin, a-in kimvela chun bang khat aumin; chule mipa chun akhutna thil tena pengmol tong gupma sao achoijin, khatcheh chu tongkhat cheh mihem khut chan chet ahin; hitichun aman in bang sadan chu aten ahile pengmol khat ahin, chule asandan jong pengmol khat ahije.
target: I saw a wall completely surrounding the temple area. The length of the measuring rod in the man’s hand was six long cubits, each of which was a cubit and a handbreadth. He measured the wall; it was one measuring rod thick and one rod high.

source: Chujouvin ama solam maingat kotpi-a chun ahungin, chuche kalbiho chu ajot touvin, kotpi phung chu aten ahile, tena pengmol khatnin alenin, chule kotpi phung dang chu pengmol khatma-in alenin ahi.
target: Then he went to the east gate. He climbed its steps and measured the threshold of the gate; it was one rod deep.

source: Chule indan neo jouse chu pengmol khat asao cheh-in, pengmol khat alen cheh-in; chule indan neoho kikah chu tong nga ahicheh-in, chule kotpi sungnung hongcha-a kotpi phung chu pengmol khat ahi.
target: The alcoves for the guards were one rod long and one rod wide, and the projecting walls between the alcoves were five cubits thick. And the threshold of the gate next to the portico facing the temple was one rod deep.

source: Aman kotpi sungnung hongcha jong agaten, pengmol khat ahi.
target: Then he measured the portico of the gateway;

source: Chujouvin aman kotpi hongcha chu aten, tong get ahin; chule hichea akhomho chu tong ni ahi. Kotpi hongcha chu sunglama aume.
target: it was eight cubits deep and its jambs were two cubits thick. The portico of the gateway faced the temple.

source: Chule solam kotpi indan neoho chu hilam panga thum aumin, chule khulam panga thum aume. Hiche thumho chu akibang cheh uvin; chule akhomho chu alangto-in akibang cheh-in ahi.
target: Inside the east gate were three alcoves on each side; the three had the same measurements, and the faces of the projecting walls on each side had the same measurements.

source: Chule aman galutna lai kotpi chu availam aten ahile tong som ahin, chule kotpi dunglam chu tong somlethum ahi.
target: Then he measured the width of the entrance of the gateway; it was ten cubits and its length was thirteen cubits.

source: Indan neoho maija chun mun ong aumin, hiche chu hilam panga tong khat, chule khulam panga tong khat ahi; chule indan neoho chu hilam pang tong gup, khulam pang tong gup cheh ahi.
target: In front of each alcove was a wall one cubit high, and the alcoves were six cubits square.

source: Chujouvin aman kotpi chu indan neo khat tingvuma patnin adang khat tingvum chan geijin aten ahile, kotle kot kikah letdan chu tong somni le tong nga ahi.
target: Then he measured the gateway from the top of the rear wall of one alcove to the top of the opposite one; the distance was twenty-five cubits from one parapet opening to the opposite one.

source: Aman kotpi kimvela inhongsung khom gei tah-a chun khom tong somgup jong asemin ahi.
target: He measured along the faces of the projecting walls all around the inside of the gateway—sixty cubits. The measurement was up to the portico facing the courtyard.

source: Chule galutna kotpi maitah-a kipat, kotpi sungung hongcha mai gei chu tong somnga ahi.
target: The distance from the entrance of the gateway to the far end of its portico was fifty cubits.

source: Kotpi sunglam kimvela khomho geijin indan neoho-a chun bangkot neoho aumpeh-in, kemho-a jong hitobangma chu ahi; asunglam kivela jong bangkot ho aumin, khom khat cheh chunga chu tumthing aum cheh-in ahi.
target: The alcoves and the projecting walls inside the gateway were surmounted by narrow parapet openings all around, as was the portico; the openings all around faced inward. The faces of the projecting walls were decorated with palm trees.

source: Chujouvin inhong ponung lama eipuitan; veuvin hia chun indanho, chule inhongsung kimvel dinga kisem keng lampi aumim; indan somthumin keng lampi chu amaingatnin ahi.
target: Then he brought me into the outer court. There I saw some rooms and a pavement that had been constructed all around the court; there were thirty rooms along the pavement.

source: Chule keng lampi kotpiho panga um ahin, kotpi sao dung juija kilhunga, hichu keng lampi noinung hija ahi.
target: It abutted the sides of the gateways and was as wide as they were long; this was the lower pavement.

source: Chujouvin aman kotpi noinung masang lama patnin sunglam inhong ponung geijin avai chu aten, solam pangle sahlam pang gei chu tong jakhat ahi.
target: Then he measured the distance from the inside of the lower gateway to the outside of the inner court; it was a hundred cubits on the east side as well as on the north.

source: Chule inhong ponung sahlam nga-a kotpi khat aumin, aman adung le avai aten ahi.
target: Then he measured the length and width of the north gate, leading into the outer court.

source: Chule chuche indan neochaho chu hilam panga thum, khulam panga thum aumim, chule chuche akhomhole kem kidoho chu adung avai kotpi masapena toh akibangin; hichu adung tong somnga, chule avai tong somni le nga ahi.
target: Its alcoves—three on each side—its projecting walls and its portico had the same measurements as those of the first gateway. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

source: Chule abang kot ho, kem kidoho, atumthingho chu solamsang nga-a kotpiho to kibang ahi; hichu kalbi sagi-a kaltou ahin, chule kem kidoho chu amasanga chun aume.
target: Its openings, its portico and its palm tree decorations had the same measurements as those of the gate facing east. Seven steps led up to it, with its portico opposite them.

source: Chule inhong sungnung kotpi chu solam kotpi banga, sahlam ngat kotpi toh kimai ngat ahin, chule aman kotpile kotpi kah aten ahile, tong jakhat ahi.
target: There was a gate to the inner court facing the north gate, just as there was on the east. He measured from one gate to the opposite one; it was a hundred cubits.

source: Chujou phatnin aman lhanglam sanga eipuitan; chule veuvin, chukoma chun kotpi khat aumin lhanglam sanga angan ahi. Chuin aman chuche-a akhomhole kem kidoho chu hiche tenaho dungjui chun aten ahi.
target: Then he led me to the south side and I saw the south gate. He measured its jambs and its portico, and they had the same measurements as the others.

source: Chule hiche sunga chun bangkot ho aumin, chule chuche bangkot ho tobang chun kemkidoho chu akimvela aume; adunglam chu tong somnga ahin chule avai tong somni le tong nga ahi.
target: The gateway and its portico had narrow openings all around, like the openings of the others. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

source: Chule chua chetouna ding chun kalbi sagi aumin, chule kem kidoho chu hicheho masanga chun aume. Chule chuche-a khomho chunga chun tumphungho aumin, hilam panga khat chule khulam panga khat aume.
target: Seven steps led up to it, with its portico opposite them; it had palm tree decorations on the faces of the projecting walls on each side.

source: Chule inhong sungnunga chun lhanglam sang nga-a kotpi khat aumin; chule aman lhanglam sang kotpi phunga pat kotpi phung chu aten ahile, tong jakhat ahi.
target: The inner court also had a gate facing south, and he measured from this gate to the outer gate on the south side; it was a hundred cubits.

source: Chuin aman keima lhanglam kotpi-a inhong sungnunga eipuijin; chuin aman lhanglam sang kotpi chu hiche tenaho dungjui chun aten ahi.
target: Then he brought me into the inner court through the south gate, and he measured the south gate; it had the same measurements as the others.

source: Chule indan neoho le akhompiho, chule kem kidoho chu hiche tenaho dungjuijin aten; hiche-a chun bangkot ho aumin, chule akimvela kem kidosangho-a jong chun bangkot aumin ahi; hichu tong somnga asaovin, chule tong somni le tong nga alenin ahi.
target: Its alcoves, its projecting walls and its portico had the same measurements as the others. The gateway and its portico had openings all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

source: Akimvela chun kem kidosang aumin, tong somni le tong nga asaovin, tong nga alenin ahi.
target: (The porticoes of the gateways around the inner court were twenty-five cubits wide and five cubits deep.)

source: Chuche kem kidosangho chun inhong ponung lam chu amaingatnin, chule akhompiho chunga chun tumthingho aumin, chule chua gakaltouna chun kalbi get aneije.
target: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated its jambs, and eight steps led up to it.

source: Chule aman keima solamsang nga-a inhong sungnung lama eihin puijin; chule aman hiche tenaho dungjuijin kotpi chu aten ahi.
target: Then he brought me to the inner court on the east side, and he measured the gateway; it had the same measurements as the others.

source: Chule indan neoho le akhompiho, chule kem kidosangho chu hiche tenaho dungjuijin aten ahi. Chule hiche-a chun bangkotho aumin, chule akimvela kem kidosangho-a jong chun bangkot aumin ahi; hichu tong somnga asaovin chule tong somni le tong nga alenin ahi.
target: Its alcoves, its projecting walls and its portico had the same measurements as the others. The gateway and its portico had openings all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

source: Chule chuche kem kidosangho chun inhong ponung lam amaingatnin, chule akhompiho chunga chun tumthingho hilam pangle alangkhat panga aume; chule chua gakaltouna chun kalbi get aneije.
target: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated the jambs on either side, and eight steps led up to it.

source: Chuin aman keima sahlam kotpi-a eipuijin, chule hichu hiche tena ho dungjuija chun aten,
target: Then he brought me to the north gate and measured it. It had the same measurements as the others,

source: Chule indan neoho le akhompiho, chule kem kidosangho jongchu aten ahi. Akimvela chun bangkot ho aumin, asaodan chu tong somnga ahin avai tong somni le tong nga ahi.
target: as did its alcoves, its projecting walls and its portico, and it had openings all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

source: Chule khompiho chun inhong ponung lam amaingatnin, chule chuche khompiho chunga chun tumphungho hilam pangle khulam panga aume; chule chua gakaltouna chun kalbi get aneije.
target: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated the jambs on either side, and eight steps led up to it.

source: Chule indanhole chuche-a lutnaho chu kotpi khomho panga chun aumin, hia chun amahon govam thilto asop uvin agou jiuvin ahi.
target: A room with a doorway was by the portico in each of the inner gateways, where the burnt offerings were washed.

source: Chule kotpi hongcha-a chun hilam panga dokhang ni, khulam panga dokhang ni, halvam thilto le suhkhel thilpeh chule suhkhel thilpehho thana ding aumin ahi.
target: In the portico of the gateway were two tables on each side, on which the burnt offerings, sin offerings and guilt offerings were slaughtered.

source: Chule khattou sahlam kot galutna geija achetoule, polam panga chun dokhang ni aumin, chule kotpi hongcha lang khat panga dokhang ni aumin ahi.
target: By the outside wall of the portico of the gateway, near the steps at the entrance of the north gateway were two tables, and on the other side of the steps were two tables.

source: Kotpi pang hilam sanga dokhang li, chule khulam sanga dokhang li aumin; hiche dokhang getho chunga chun amahon aganlhaina hou athat jiuvin ahi.
target: So there were four tables on one side of the gateway and four on the other—eight tables in all—on which the sacrifices were slaughtered.

source: Chua chun govam thiltona ding songa kikheng dokhang li aumin, dokhangho chu tong khatle akeh asaovin, tong khatle akeh alenin, tong khat asangin; chuche chunga chun amahon govam thilto le ganlhaina athanajiu manchah ho chu akoijun ahi.
target: There were also four tables of dressed stone for the burnt offerings, each a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide and a cubit high. On them were placed the utensils for slaughtering the burnt offerings and the other sacrifices.

source: Chule asung kimvela chun khutpeh tebep koikaho akilbeh kimvelun, chule dokhangho chunga chun thilto sa chu aumin ahi.
target: And double-pronged hooks, each a handbreadth long, were attached to the wall all around. The tables were for the flesh of the offerings.

source: Chuche kotpi sungnung polama chun inhong sungnunga lasaho dingin indanho aumin, khatchu sahlam kotpi panga umin lhanglam angan, chule khat chu lhanglam kotpi panga aumin sahlam angan ahi.
target: Outside the inner gate, within the inner court, were two rooms, one at the side of the north gate and facing south, and another at the side of the south gate and facing north.

source: Chuin aman kahenga, hiche indan lhanglam maingat hi, hiche in ngahtupma pang thempu ho-a ahin;
target: He said to me, “The room facing south is for the priests who guard the temple,

source: Chule indan sahlam maingat hi maicham ngahtup thempu ho-a ding ahi; amahochu Levi chapateho lah-a Zadok chapate, Pakai jen dinga aheng hin nailut ho chu ahiuve, tin aseije.
target: and the room facing north is for the priests who guard the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who are the only Levites who may draw near to the Lord to minister before him.”

source: Hitichun aman inhong chu aten, ningli ahin, tong jakhat asaovin, tong jakhat alenin ahi. Chule maicham chu in maija chun aumin ahi.
target: Then he measured the court: It was square—a hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits wide. And the altar was in front of the temple.

source: Chuin aman keima houin hongcha-a chun eipuijin, chuin hongcha khom jouse chu aten, hilam sang tong nga chule khulam sang tong nga ahin; chule kotpi chu avai hilam sang tong thum, khulam sang tong thum ahi.
target: He brought me to the portico of the temple and measured the jambs of the portico; they were five cubits wide on either side. The width of the entrance was fourteen cubits and its projecting walls were three cubits wide on either side.

source: Hongcha chu adung tong somni ahin, chule availam chu tong somle tong khat ahi. Chule aman amaho agakaltouna jiu kalbiho-a chun eihin puijin, chule khomho panga chun khompiho hilam panga khat chule khulam panga khat aumin ahi.
target: The portico was twenty cubits wide, and twelve cubits from front to back. It was reached by a flight of stairs, and there were pillars on each side of the jambs.

source: Chujouvin aman keima houin'a eihin puijin; chule khomho chu aten ahile, hilam pang tong gupmin alenin, chule alang khat pang tong gupma-in alene; hichu houbuh letdan chu ahi.
target: Then the man brought me to the main hall and measured the jambs; the width of the jambs was six cubits on each side.

source: Chule kotvai chu tong som ahin, chule kot pangho chu hilam sang tong nga, chule khulam sang tong nga ahi. Chule aman adung aten tong somli ahin chule avai tong somni ahi.
target: The entrance was ten cubits wide, and the projecting walls on each side of it were five cubits wide. He also measured the main hall; it was forty cubits long and twenty cubits wide.

source: Chuin ama asunga alutnin, kotkhom chu aten, tong ni ahin; chule kotkhah chu tong gup ahin, chule kot vailam chu tong sagi ahi.
target: Then he went into the inner sanctuary and measured the jambs of the entrance; each was two cubits wide. The entrance was six cubits wide, and the projecting walls on each side of it were seven cubits wide.

source: Chuin aman adunglam aten ahile, tong somni ahin; chule avai lam chu tong somni ahi. Chule aman kahenga, hichehi muntheng chungnung pen chu ahi, ati.
target: And he measured the length of the inner sanctuary; it was twenty cubits, and its width was twenty cubits across the end of the main hall. He said to me, “This is the Most Holy Place.”

source: Chujouvin aman houin bang chu aten, tong gup ahin; chule indan pang jouse vailam, inpang jouse kimvel chu tong li cheh ahi.
target: Then he measured the wall of the temple; it was six cubits thick, and each side room around the temple was four cubits wide.

source: Chule apanga indanho chu songthum ahin, khat chunga khat kisa, songkhat cheh-a chun dan somthum aumin ahi. Chule hicheho chu adet theina dingin in kolkhum soh-a panga indanho bang chutoh akisumatne; ahivangin a-in bangto vang akisumat pon ahi.
target: The side rooms were on three levels, one above another, thirty on each level. There were ledges all around the wall of the temple to serve as supports for the side rooms, so that the supports were not inserted into the wall of the temple.

source: Chule hiche indanho chu asancheh cheh phatchun apanga indanho chu akisulenin ahi; ajehchu inpanga lampi kihehtou chu achunglam peh geija a-in kimvela achedoh peh-in, hijeh chun a-in letdan chu asancheh chehle alet beben indan noinung pena patnin indan lailha le indan chungnung pen geijin alet beben ahi.
target: The side rooms all around the temple were wider at each successive level. The structure surrounding the temple was built in ascending stages, so that the rooms widened as one went upward. A stairway went up from the lowest floor to the top floor through the middle floor.

source: Chule keiman a-in sandan jong chu kamun; indanho pang inbulho chu pengmol lhon tong gup lhingset ahi.
target: I saw that the temple had a raised base all around it, forming the foundation of the side rooms. It was the length of the rod, six long cubits.

source: Indan ponung panga bang sadan chu tong nga ahin, chule akidalha chu sunglama um indanho panga mun chu ahi.
target: The outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits thick. The open area between the side rooms of the temple

source: Chule a-in kimvel jousele indanho kikah-a chun mun ong tong somni-a len aume.
target: and the priests’ rooms was twenty cubits wide all around the temple.

source: Chule indan pang kot ho chun akisei mun onglai chu amaingatnin, kotkhat nin sahlam, kot dang khatnin lhanglam angan ahi. Chule akidalha mun availam chu akimvel tong nga ahi.
target: There were entrances to the side rooms from the open area, one on the north and another on the south; and the base adjoining the open area was five cubits wide all around.

source: Tun mun kikhendoh masanga, lhumlam pang maingatna in kisa chu aletdan tong somsagi ahin, chule a-in bang kimvel chu tong nga-in asan, chule adung chu tong somko ahi.
target: The building facing the temple courtyard on the west side was seventy cubits wide. The wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length was ninety cubits.

source: Hitichun aman houin chu aten, tong jakhat asaovin, chule mun kikhendoh le in kisa abangho jong tong jakhat asaovin;
target: Then he measured the temple; it was a hundred cubits long, and the temple courtyard and the building with its walls were also a hundred cubits long.

source: Chujongle houin mailam letdanle, solam sanga mun kikhendoh letdan chu tong jakhat ahi.
target: The width of the temple courtyard on the east, including the front of the temple, was a hundred cubits.

source: Chuin aman innung lama um, mun kikhendoh jonna in kisa chu adunglam aten, hilam pang le khulam panga indanho kem kidosangho, houin sungnung le ahongsunga kempum,
target: Then he measured the length of the building facing the courtyard at the rear of the temple, including its galleries on each side; it was a hundred cubits. The main hall, the inner sanctuary and the portico facing the court,

source: Kot khomho le bangkot neoho chan gei chu tong jakhat ahi. Chule kot jonna um kem kidosang dan thum chu tolla pat bangkot ho geijin thingpeh-in akikhenbeh-in; bangkot ho chu,
target: as well as the thresholds and the narrow windows and galleries around the three of them—everything beyond and including the threshold was covered with wood. The floor, the wall up to the windows, and the windows were covered.

source: Kot chunglama pat indan sungnung le ponung changei, chule akimvela bang jouse apolam le asunglam abona kite-a ahi.
target: In the space above the outside of the entrance to the inner sanctuary and on the walls at regular intervals all around the inner and outer sanctuary

source: Chule hiche chu Cherub hole tumthinga kisem ahin, Cherub le cherub kikah-a tumthing umah ahi. Cherub jouse chun mai ni cheh aneijun,
target: were carved cherubim and palm trees. Palm trees alternated with cherubim. Each cherub had two faces:

source: Chutichun mihem maiso pu-a chun tumthing lampang amaingatnin chule keipi bahkai chal khangdong maiso pu-a chun achom langkhatna tumthing lam chu amaingatnin ahi; chutia chu houin pumpi kimvel chu kisema ahi.
target: the face of a human being toward the palm tree on one side and the face of a lion toward the palm tree on the other. They were carved all around the whole temple.

source: Houin bang chung chu, tolla patna kotchung geija Cherub ho le tumthingho lim kisema ahi.
target: From the floor to the area above the entrance, cherubim and palm trees were carved on the wall of the main hall.

source: Houin khomho chu ningli kitohchet ahin, chule muntheng mai chu khat limso chu adang khat limso tobang cheh ahi.
target: The main hall had a rectangular doorframe, and the one at the front of the Most Holy Place was similar.

source: Maicham chu thinga kisem ahin, tong thum asangin, chule adunglam chu tong ni ahi. Chuche-a aninghole adung chule abangho chu thinga kisem cheh ahi; chuin aman kahenga, Tonsot Pakai anga kido dokhang chu hichehi ahi, ati.
target: There was a wooden altar three cubits high and two cubits square; its corners, its base and its sides were of wood. The man said to me, “This is the table that is before the Lord .”

source: Chule houin le muntheng chun kot ni aneije.
target: Both the main hall and the Most Holy Place had double doors.

source: Chule kot ho chun pehni cheh, akiheithei pehni, pehni kot khatna ding, chule pehni ma kotchom khatna ding, aneicheh-in ahi.
target: Each door had two leaves—two hinged leaves for each door.

source: Chule banga kisem banga chun, hicheho chungle houin kot ho chunga chun Cherub hole tumthingho akisem cheh-e. Chule hongcha ponung chunga chun thingpeh satah akibeh-e.
target: And on the doors of the main hall were carved cherubim and palm trees like those carved on the walls, and there was a wooden overhang on the front of the portico.

source: Chule tumthingho hongcha pangho hilam pangle khulam panga chun bangkot neochaho aumin, chule hongcha panghole, insung danho pang chunga chun thingpeh satah ho akibeh-in ahi.
target: On the sidewalls of the portico were narrow windows with palm trees carved on each side. The side rooms of the temple also had overhangs.

source: Chujouvin aman keima sahlam sanga patnin inhong ponunga eipui doh-in; chule aman keima in kisa maitoh kigalsai sahlam sanga mun kikhendoh indanho sunga eipuilut tai.
target: Then the man led me northward into the outer court and brought me to the rooms opposite the temple courtyard and opposite the outer wall on the north side.

source: Tong jakhatna sao masanga chun sahlam sang kotpi chu aumin, chule availam chu tong somnga ahi.
target: The building whose door faced north was a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide.

source: Inhong sungnung tong somni maingat, chule inhongsung ponung keng lampi-a chun kempumle kempum kimai ngatnin dan thum cheh-in aumin ahi.
target: Both in the section twenty cubits from the inner court and in the section opposite the pavement of the outer court, gallery faced gallery at the three levels.

source: Indanho masanga, sunglam jotna-a chun lampi availam tong soma len le, adunglam tong khatna len aumin, chule akot ho chun sahlam angan ahi.
target: In front of the rooms was an inner passageway ten cubits wide and a hundred cubits long. Their doors were on the north.

source: Tun indan chungnung joho chu anemjep uve, ajehchu kem kidosangho chu in kisa anoinung le alailha penho sangin asangjon ahi.
target: Now the upper rooms were narrower, for the galleries took more space from them than from the rooms on the lower and middle floors of the building.

source: Ajehchu amaho dan thuma um ahiuvin, ahinla inhongsung khompiho bangin khomho aneipouve; hijeh chun in kisa indan chungnung pen chu tolla patna anoinungpen le alailha penho sangin ajum jouve.
target: The rooms on the top floor had no pillars, as the courts had; so they were smaller in floor space than those on the lower and middle floors.

source: Chule indanho toh kingatto chule indanho maija inhongsung ponung lam sanga bang ponung chu, adung tong somnga ahi.
target: There was an outer wall parallel to the rooms and the outer court; it extended in front of the rooms for fifty cubits.

source: Ajehchu inhong ponung sunga indanho adung tong somnga ahi, chule veuvin houin mai chu tong jakhat ahi.
target: While the row of rooms on the side next to the outer court was fifty cubits long, the row on the side nearest the sanctuary was a hundred cubits long.

source: Inhon ponunga kona mihem dia aban chelutna ding hiche indan noiho-a kon chun solam sanga lutna chu aume.
target: The lower rooms had an entrance on the east side as one enters them from the outer court.

source: Indanho chu mun kikhen doh jonna, chule in kisa masanga solam sanga inhong dung bang satah-a chun aume.
target: On the south side along the length of the wall of the outer court, adjoining the temple courtyard and opposite the outer wall, were rooms

source: Chule amaho masanga lampi chu sahlam sanga indanho asaojedan le aletdan limso bangin akilange, chule potdohna ho chu akot ho dungjui le alimsoho dungjuija um ahi.
target: with a passageway in front of them. These were like the rooms on the north; they had the same length and width, with similar exits and dimensions. Similar to the doorways on the north

source: Chule indanho-a kot ho dungjui chun, lhanglam sanga lamlhongpia chun kot khat aumin, khattou chuche sunga agalut tengle solam sanga bang maitah-a chun lamlhah khat aume.
target: were the doorways of the rooms on the south. There was a doorway at the beginning of the passageway that was parallel to the corresponding wall extending eastward, by which one enters the rooms.

source: Chujouvin aman kahenga, sahlam sanga indanho le lhanglam sang indanho, mun kikhen doh toh kingatto chu indan thengho, Pakai heng jotlutna thempu hon thiltheng chung nungho anehna dingu mun chu ahi; chuachu amahon thilthengpen, chule anneh thilpeh, chonset thilpeh, chule suhkhelna thilpeh chu akoi dingu ahi. Ajehchu amun chu muntheng ahi.
target: Then he said to me, “The north and south rooms facing the temple courtyard are the priests’ rooms, where the priests who approach the Lord will eat the most holy offerings. There they will put the most holy offerings—the grain offerings, the sin offerings and the guilt offerings—for the place is holy.

source: Chule hiche sunga chu thempuho alut tengule, amaho chu munthenga kona inhong ponung sunga potdoh lou dingu, amavang hiche laija chu amahon anaman chah-u avonhou chu akoilhah dingu ahi; ajehchu hicheho chu atheng ahin: chule amaho mipi anga ache masang uva amahon von dangho akivontei dingu ahi, ati.
target: Once the priests enter the holy precincts, they are not to go into the outer court until they leave behind the garments in which they minister, for these are holy. They are to put on other clothes before they go near the places that are for the people.”

source: Tun aman insung atejou phatnin, keima solamsang ngat kotpi lama chun eihin puijin, chule aning jouse chu aten ahi.
target: When he had finished measuring what was inside the temple area, he led me out by the east gate and measured the area all around:

source: Aman thil tena pengmolin solamsang aten ahile, pengmol janga alhinge.
target: He measured the east side with the measuring rod; it was five hundred cubits.

source: Aman sahlam sang aten ahile, pengmol janga ahi.
target: He measured the north side; it was five hundred cubits by the measuring rod.

source: Aman lhanglam sang chu aten ahile, pengmol janga ahi.
target: He measured the south side; it was five hundred cubits by the measuring rod.

source: Ama lhumlam sanga agakihei kimvelin, pengmol kitena-a chun aten ahile, pengmol janga ahi.
target: Then he turned to the west side and measured; it was five hundred cubits by the measuring rod.

source: Hitichun aman hichu aning li in aten ahi; hichun akimvela bang aneijin, munthengle milham umna mun kikah sekhena dingin, pengmol janga saole janga len aumin ahi.
target: So he measured the area on all four sides. It had a wall around it, five hundred cubits long and five hundred cubits wide, to separate the holy from the common.

source: Chujouvin aman keima kotpi phunga solamsang ngat kotpi phung gei chun eipuijin,
target: Then the man brought me to the gate facing east,

source: Chuin veuvin, Israel Pathen loupina chu solamsang lampia konin ahung kilah-in, a-awgin chu twi tamtah gin abangin, aloupina chun leiset asalvah-in ahi.
target: and I saw the glory of the God of Israel coming from the east. His voice was like the roar of rushing waters, and the land was radiant with his glory.

source: Chule hichu keiman kanamu gao thilmu tobangle, hiche khopi sumang dinga kahunglaija kanamu gao thilmu dungjui ngeijin akilangin ahi. Chule gaothil muho chu Chebar vadunglen panga kanamu toh akibangin; chuin tolla kamai kasulut tai.
target: The vision I saw was like the vision I had seen when he came to destroy the city and like the visions I had seen by the Kebar River, and I fell facedown.

source: Chuin Pakai loupina chu solam sanga kotpi-a konin inpi sunga ahung luttai.
target: The glory of the Lord entered the temple through the gate facing east.

source: Hitichun lhagaovin keima eiphong dingin, chule inhong sung lama chun eipui lutnin; chule vetan, insung chu Pakai loupina adimtan ahi.
target: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner court, and the glory of the Lord filled the temple.

source: Chuin keiman insunga kon chun kahenga thu kisei kajan, chule mipa chu kakoma anadingin ahi.
target: While the man was standing beside me, I heard someone speaking to me from inside the temple.

source: Chuin aman kahenga, Mihem chapa, kalaltouna munle kakengto ngapna mun, a-itih-a Israel chate lah-a kachenna ding mun, chule Israel insung mite, amaho ahiuvin, alengtehou ahin, ajonthanhoi naova, ahilouleh amunsang houva alengtehou longin jong kamintheng asuhboh kitlou dingu ahitai.
target: He said: “Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place for the soles of my feet. This is where I will live among the Israelites forever. The people of Israel will never again defile my holy name—neither they nor their kings—by their prostitution and the funeral offerings for their kings at their death.

source: Akotbulu kakotbul ho koma aboluva, akhomu kakhomho koma atunuva, chule keimale amaho kah-a bang akigen tanin, amahon thet umtah abolu chun kamintheng asubohtauve; hijeh-a chu kalung hanna-a amaho kasuhmang ahitai.
target: When they placed their threshold next to my threshold and their doorposts beside my doorposts, with only a wall between me and them, they defiled my holy name by their detestable practices. So I destroyed them in my anger.

source: Tun ajonthanhoi naole, alengtehou thilongho chu keija konin gamla tah-a koidoh taohen, chutengle a-itih-a akomuva kachen jing ding ahi.
target: Now let them put away from me their prostitution and the funeral offerings for their kings, and I will live among them forever.

source: Mihem chapa, nangman akhanset naova ajachat theina dingun, in chu Israel insung vetsah-in, chule a-inlim chu amaho tesah-in.
target: “Son of man, describe the temple to the people of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their sins. Let them consider its perfection,

source: Amahon athilbol jouseu chu ajachat piuva ahile, amaho chu in limle agong, chule apotdohna hole achelutnaho, chule alimpoh jousele amandan jouse, chule alimpoh jousele adanthu jouse vetsah-in; alimpoh pumpileh adanthu jouse anitnuva abolna dingun amitmuva hichu sunin.
target: and if they are ashamed of all they have done, make known to them the design of the temple—its arrangement, its exits and entrances—its whole design and all its regulations and laws. Write these down before them so that they may be faithful to its design and follow all its regulations.

source: Hichehi in'a dinga dan ahin; molchung vum kimvel pumpi hop chu atheng chungnung hiding ahi. Veuvin hichehi in'a dinga dan chu ahi.
target: “This is the law of the temple: All the surrounding area on top of the mountain will be most holy. Such is the law of the temple.

source: Hichehohi thil tena tong ho dungjuija maicham tena ahi; tong khat chu tong khatle khutpeh khat, atodop ngei jong chu tong khat hiding, aveilam tong khat, agei pumpi mong kimvel chu khap khat hiding, chule hichehi maicham sangjo mun chu hiding ahi.
target: “These are the measurements of the altar in long cubits, that cubit being a cubit and a handbreadth: Its gutter is a cubit deep and a cubit wide, with a rim of one span around the edge. And this is the height of the altar:

source: Atodop tol chunga akitunna noinunga pat tong ni hiding, availam tong khat hiding, atodop neopa-a pat atodop lenpa gei chu tong li hiding, chule asalam pang tong khat hiding ahi.
target: From the gutter on the ground up to the lower ledge that goes around the altar it is two cubits high, and the ledge is a cubit wide. From this lower ledge to the upper ledge that goes around the altar it is four cubits high, and that ledge is also a cubit wide.

source: Hiti achu maicham chu tong li hiding, maichama pat chunglam chu aki li umding ahi.
target: Above that, the altar hearth is four cubits high, and four horns project upward from the hearth.

source: Chule maicham chu tong somleni sao, somleni len, aning li kibang hiding ahi.
target: The altar hearth is square, twelve cubits long and twelve cubits wide.

source: Chule atodop chu tong somle tongli hiding, aninglia aletdan chu tong somle tongli hiding; akimvel geisihho chu tong kehkhat hiding, chule atodop kimvel chu tong khat hiding; chule akalbiho chun solam angat dingu ahi.
target: The upper ledge also is square, fourteen cubits long and fourteen cubits wide. All around the altar is a gutter of one cubit with a rim of half a cubit. The steps of the altar face east.”

source: Chuin aman kajah-a, mihem chapa, Pakai Pathen'in hitihin aseije; amahon govam thilpehho achunga chu aboluva, thisan athin khumni tengule, hichehohi maicham boldan thupeh hiding ahi.
target: Then he said to me, “Son of man, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: These will be the regulations for sacrificing burnt offerings and splashing blood against the altar when it is built:

source: Nahenga kalhacha kinbol dinga eihin naija Zadok chilhah, Levi thempuho henga, chonset thilto dinga bongchal gol khat nangman napeh ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: You are to give a young bull as a sin offering to the Levitical priests of the family of Zadok, who come near to minister before me, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Chule nangman hiche thisan chu nalah-a, hiche aki liho chungle atodop ning liho chunga, chule ageisih kimvela nakoi ding; hiti achu maicham chu nasuh thenga nathenso ding ahi.
target: You are to take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar and on the four corners of the upper ledge and all around the rim, and so purify the altar and make atonement for it.

source: Nangman chonset thilpeh bongchal jong chu nalah ding, aman hichu muntheng polam, lhendoh sa-a kikoi in'a chu agovam ding ahi.
target: You are to take the bull for the sin offering and burn it in the designated part of the temple area outside the sanctuary.

source: Chule nini chan nileh nangman kelcha nou nolnabei khat, chonset thilto dinga nato ding; amahon maicham chu bongchala asuhtheng banguva, asuhtheng dingu ahi.
target: “On the second day you are to offer a male goat without defect for a sin offering, and the altar is to be purified as it was purified with the bull.

source: Nangman hiche suhthengna chu nachai tengle, nolnabei bongchalgol khatle, ahonlah-a nolnabei kelngoichal khat natodoh ding ahi.
target: When you have finished purifying it, you are to offer a young bull and a ram from the flock, both without defect.

source: Nangman hiho chu Pakai masanga natodoh-a, thempuhon achunguva chi atheova, Pakai henga govam thilto atodoh dingu ahi.
target: You are to offer them before the Lord , and the priests are to sprinkle salt on them and sacrifice them as a burnt offering to the Lord .

source: Ni sagi sunga chonset thilto ding niseh-a kelcha khat nagon ding; amahon jong bongchalgol khatle ahon lah-a nolnabei kelngoichal khat akigon dingu ahi.
target: “For seven days you are to provide a male goat daily for a sin offering; you are also to provide a young bull and a ram from the flock, both without defect.

source: Amahon maicham chu ni sagi asopthenguva asuhtheng diu; chule amaho jong kithenso dingu ahi.
target: For seven days they are to make atonement for the altar and cleanse it; thus they will dedicate it.

source: Chule hiche nikhoho kichai tengle, hiti ding ahi, niget channi chule aban banna thempuhon maicham chunga chu govam thiltoho le chamna thiltoho atodiu, chuteng keiman kasanpeh ding nahiuve, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: At the end of these days, from the eighth day on, the priests are to present your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings on the altar. Then I will accept you, declares the Sovereign Lord .”

source: Chuin solam ngatna muntheng ponung kotpi lama chun eilepui kitnin; hichu anakikhah-in ahi.
target: Then the man brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary, the one facing east, and it was shut.

source: Chuin Pakai chun kajah-a, hiche kotpihi kikhah ding kihong louhel ding, koimacha hichea lutlouhel ding ahi; ajehchu Israel Pakai Pathen chu hiche-a hi hung lutna ahin, hijeh-a chu hichehi kikhah jing ding ahitai.
target: The Lord said to me, “This gate is to remain shut. It must not be opened; no one may enter through it. It is to remain shut because the Lord , the God of Israel, has entered through it.

source: Hichehi leng chapa ding ahin, leng chapa chu Pakai anga an nedinga asunga tou ding; chuche kotpi hongcha lampia chu ama lutding, chule chuche lampi mama-a chu potdoh ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: The prince himself is the only one who may sit inside the gateway to eat in the presence of the Lord . He is to enter by way of the portico of the gateway and go out the same way.”

source: Chuin aman keima sahlam kot lampi inmaija chun eipuijin; chuin kavetle, veuvin, Pakai in chu Pathen loupinan adimsetnin, chuin kamai tolla kasulutai.
target: Then the man brought me by way of the north gate to the front of the temple. I looked and saw the glory of the Lord filling the temple of the Lord , and I fell facedown.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin kajah-a, mihem chapa, melchih phan lang, namitnin ven, Pakai insunga kimanchah ding dan jouse chungchang nahenga kasei jousele, dan jouse chu nanan ngaiphan; chule in'a lut jousele munthenga pot jouse chu phaten melchih in.
target: The Lord said to me, “Son of man, look carefully, listen closely and give attention to everything I tell you concerning all the regulations and instructions regarding the temple of the Lord . Give attention to the entrance to the temple and all the exits of the sanctuary.

source: Chule nangman thungailou ho, Israel mite ngei henga naseipeh ding ahi; vo Israel insung mite, thet um nabol jouseu chu ngataovin, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: Say to rebellious Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Enough of your detestable practices, people of Israel!

source: Nanghon kamun theng sunga gamdang mi, atahsao le alungsunga cheptan louho, kamunthenga nahinpuilut tengule ka in jengjong nasuboh-un, nanghon ka changlhah, thao, chule thisan nato tengule amahon kakitepna asukeh un ahi.
target: In addition to all your other detestable practices, you brought foreigners uncircumcised in heart and flesh into my sanctuary, desecrating my temple while you offered me food, fat and blood, and you broke my covenant.

source: Nanghon kathil theng thupeh ho nachingtup pouvin; ahinla nanghon nangho khelin kathupeh nitding midang kamuntheng sunga nakoijo taove.
target: Instead of carrying out your duty in regard to my holy things, you put others in charge of my sanctuary.

source: Pakai Pathen'in, gamdang mi, lungsunga cheptanlou ahilouleh tahsa-a cheptanlou, Israel chate lah-a gamdang mi cheptanlou khatcha kamun theng lutlou dingu ahi, tin aseije.
target: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: No foreigner uncircumcised in heart and flesh is to enter my sanctuary, not even the foreigners who live among the Israelites.

source: Chule Israel avaveija, keija kona amilim semthu nung ajuijuva avamang laijuva, keija kona gamla tah-a anavahmang Levi ho chun, akhangit lounao akipoh teidiu ahi.
target: “ ‘The Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray and who wandered from me after their idols must bear the consequences of their sin.

source: Hijeng jongle amahon kamun theng sunga kin aboluva, inpi kotpiho ngah-a pang diu, inpia chu kin aboldiu; mipi ho dinga govam thilto ganlhainaho chu athaova, akinu bol dinga amasanguva dingdiu ahi.
target: They may serve in my sanctuary, having charge of the gates of the temple and serving in it; they may slaughter the burnt offerings and sacrifices for the people and stand before the people and serve them.

source: Ajehchu amaho amilimhou masanga amaho dinga lhachana atoh uva, Israel insung khansetna achuhsah jeh uva; hijeh-a chu amaho douna-a kakhut kalhah ahin, akhangit lounao chu akipoh dingu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: But because they served them in the presence of their idols and made the people of Israel fall into sin, therefore I have sworn with uplifted hand that they must bear the consequences of their sin, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Amaho kahenga thempu natoh tong dinga, kahenga hungnailut lou dingu, ahilouleh muntheng chungnung sunga kathil thengho khatcha anailut thei loudiu; amavang ajumnau leh thet umtah abolu chu akipohjoh dingu ahi.
target: They are not to come near to serve me as priests or come near any of my holy things or my most holy offerings; they must bear the shame of their detestable practices.

source: Ahinla in'a bolding jousele asunga tohding jouse vetup dinga amaho chu kapansah ding ahi.
target: And I will appoint them to guard the temple for all the work that is to be done in it.

source: Ahinla Israel chate keija kona avavei laijuva, kamun theng vetupma anapang thempuho, Levi ho, Zadok chapate amaho chu kahenga kakinbol dinga hungnaijuva, thaole thisan tohdoh dinga kamasanga ding diu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: “ ‘But the Levitical priests, who are descendants of Zadok and who guarded my sanctuary when the Israelites went astray from me, are to come near to minister before me; they are to stand before me to offer sacrifices of fat and blood, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Amaho kakinbol dinga kamunthenga lutnuva, kakin bol dinga kadokhang phung anailut diu, kathupeh achintup diu ahi.
target: They alone are to enter my sanctuary; they alone are to come near my table to minister before me and serve me as guards.

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, amaho inhong sungnung kotpi ho-a alut tengule, tupat ponnem ho-a kivon diu; inhong sungnungle asung lama kin abol sunguva achunguva samul himhim kailou ding ahi.
target: “ ‘When they enter the gates of the inner court, they are to wear linen clothes; they must not wear any woolen garment while ministering at the gates of the inner court or inside the temple.

source: Alu uva tupat delnem akikopmuva, ataijuva tupat ponchol akichen diu; ulsa sona thei imacha akigah loudiu ahi.
