target: They are to wear linen turbans on their heads and linen undergarments around their waists. They must not wear anything that makes them perspire.

source: Chule inhong ponung, japi inhon ponunga ahungdoh tengule, akin bolnao vonho chu asutlhah uva dantheng sunga akoidiu, vondang akivon diu; mipi ho chu avonuva asuhtheng loudiu ahi.
target: When they go out into the outer court where the people are, they are to take off the clothes they have been ministering in and are to leave them in the sacred rooms, and put on other clothes, so that the people are not consecrated through contact with their garments.

source: Amahon asamu akivotol loudiu, ajangtelu jong ahoisao loudiu, alu-u akisemtup jing diu ahi.
target: “ ‘They must not shave their heads or let their hair grow long, but they are to keep the hair of their heads trimmed.

source: Inhong sungnunga alut tengu jongle, thempu koimachan lengpitwi adon loudiu ahi.
target: No priest is to drink wine when he enters the inner court.

source: Amahon meithai ahilouleh akidasa ji-a anei loudiu; Israel insung chilhah nungah, ahilouleh thempun ji-a ananeisa meithai akichenpi dingu ahi.
target: They must not marry widows or divorced women; they may marry only virgins of Israelite descent or widows of priests.

source: Chule amahon kamite chu athengle akisuboh akibah louna chu ahildiu, chule athengle athenglou akibah louna ahetkhen sahdiu ahi.
target: They are to teach my people the difference between the holy and the common and show them how to distinguish between the unclean and the clean.

source: Chule kinelna aumteng, thutan na-a dinguva, kathutan dungjuija thu atan dingu; chule keima mina kikhop khomna jouse-a kadan thupeh le kadan kisunho anitdiu, kacholngah ni ajabol dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘In any dispute, the priests are to serve as judges and decide it according to my ordinances. They are to keep my laws and my decrees for all my appointed festivals, and they are to keep my Sabbaths holy.

source: Kisuhbohna dinga thilong phunga hung lou dingu; ahinla apa, ahiloule anu, ahiloule chapa, ahiloule chanu, ahiloule sopipa, ahiloule jinei loulai asopinu dinga vang kisuboh theiju ahi.
target: “ ‘A priest must not defile himself by going near a dead person; however, if the dead person was his father or mother, son or daughter, brother or unmarried sister, then he may defile himself.

source: Ama akisuhtheng jouteng, ama dinga nisagi asimdohpeh diu ahi.
target: After he is cleansed, he must wait seven days.

source: Chule inhong sungnung, muntheng sunga kinbol dinga alut nikho tengle ama dinga chonset thilto ato ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: On the day he goes into the inner court of the sanctuary to minister in the sanctuary, he is to offer a sin offering for himself, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Chule amaho agoulo dingdolu chu hiti ding ahi: Keimahi agoulou kahi; Israel insunga amaho gou napeh lou dingu ahi; Keimahi agouvu kahi.
target: “ ‘I am to be the only inheritance the priests have. You are to give them no possession in Israel; I will be their possession.

source: Amahon neh thilto, chonset thilto, suhkhelna thilto aneh diu ahin; Israel sunga Pathen'a dinga kitohho jouse chu amaho-a hiding ahi.
target: They will eat the grain offerings, the sin offerings and the guilt offerings; and everything in Israel devoted to the Lord will belong to them.

source: Thil jouse aga masapen lah-a gamasapen le thilto jouse lah-a nathiltou takip chu thempu ho-a ding ahi: aman na insunguva phatthei na aumdensah theina dinga, thempu chu nachanglhah lum masapenu jong napeh dingu ahi.
target: The best of all the firstfruits and of all your special gifts will belong to the priests. You are to give them the first portion of your ground meal so that a blessing may rest on your household.

source: Thempuhon sa hihen lang vacha hijongle, akihehtel le achama thikam anehlou dingu ahi.
target: The priests must not eat anything, whether bird or animal, found dead or torn by wild animals.

source: Chukalvalin nanghon vang vetna-a gamlo ding nakihop tengule, Pakai henga gambih theng khat natodoh dingu ahi. Adunglam chu pengmol sangsomni le sangnga hiding, availam chu sangsom hiding; hichehi gamsung kimvel jouse-a atheng hiding ahi.
target: “ ‘When you allot the land as an inheritance, you are to present to the Lord a portion of the land as a sacred district, 25,000 cubits long and 20,000 cubits wide; the entire area will be holy.

source: Hichehi muntheng dinga adunglam janga, availam janga kimvel hiding, chule akimvela gam ong tong somnga umding ahi.
target: Of this, a section 500 cubits square is to be for the sanctuary, with 50 cubits around it for open land.

source: Chule hiche tena-a hi adunglam sangsomni le sangnga, chule availam sangsom natedoh-a, hiche sunga chu munthengle muntheng chungnung umding ahi.
target: In the sacred district, measure off a section 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide. In it will be the sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.

source: Gambih theng chu muntheng kinbol, Pakai kinbol dinga hungnai thempuho chanding hiding; hichu a-inhou sahna ding mun hiding, chule munthenga dinga atheng hiding ahi.
target: It will be the sacred portion of the land for the priests, who minister in the sanctuary and who draw near to minister before the Lord . It will be a place for their houses as well as a holy place for the sanctuary.

source: Chule adunglam sangsomni le sangnga, vailam sangsom jong chu in'a kinbola Levi mite chang diu, indan somni dinga alodiu ahi.
target: An area 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide will belong to the Levites, who serve in the temple, as their possession for towns to live in.

source: Gambih theng kipedoh chu khopi dinga adunglam sangsomni le sangnga, availam sangnga hiding, hichu Israel insung pumpi-a ding ahi.
target: “ ‘You are to give the city as its property an area 5,000 cubits wide and 25,000 cubits long, adjoining the sacred portion; it will belong to all Israel.

source: Leng chapa chanding chu gamtheng kitohdoh-a kona hilamle khulam panga umding ahin, chule khopi chanding chu, gamtheng kipedoh masanga aumin, chule khopi sungle lhum lama kon chu lhum lama, solama kon solama kijompeh ding; chule adunglam chu lhum lama pat solam gamgi ngahna, gambehho lah-a khattoh kigalsai chan gei chu ahi.
target: “ ‘The prince will have the land bordering each side of the area formed by the sacred district and the property of the city. It will extend westward from the west side and eastward from the east side, running lengthwise from the western to the eastern border parallel to one of the tribal portions.

source: Hichu Israel gamsunga ama chanding ahi; kapipui hon kamite asuhgimbe tahlou diu, chule gam amoh chu aphungu dungjuija Israel insung apeh dingu ahi.
target: This land will be his possession in Israel. And my princes will no longer oppress my people but will allow the people of Israel to possess the land according to their tribes.

source: Hitihin Pakai Pathen'in aseije; vo Israel Leng chapaho, phaset tahen; hunamle thilchom haijun lang, thudihle thutanna pandoh-un, kamiteho-a konin hunam haijun tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: You have gone far enough, princes of Israel! Give up your violence and oppression and do what is just and right. Stop dispossessing my people, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Nanghon khaikot dihho, ephah dihtah, bath dihtah naman diu ahi.
target: You are to use accurate scales, an accurate ephah and an accurate bath.

source: Ephah le bath chu tena kibang hiding, bath chun homer hop soma hop khat adolding, chule ephah chun homer hop soma hop khat adolding, thil tena chu homer dungjuija teding ahi.
target: The ephah and the bath are to be the same size, the bath containing a tenth of a homer and the ephah a tenth of a homer; the homer is to be the standard measure for both.

source: Shekel chu gerah somni hiding, shekel somni, shekel somni le nga, shekel somlenga chu nangho dinga mina khat hiding ahi.
target: The shekel is to consist of twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels equal one mina.

source: Hichehi Pathen'a thilto napehdiu chu ahi, suhlou chang homer khat le ephah hop gupma hop khat, sakol chang homer khat le ephah hop gupma hop khat napeh diu ahi.
target: “ ‘This is the special gift you are to offer: a sixth of an ephah from each homer of wheat and a sixth of an ephah from each homer of barley.

source: Thaotwi chungchang dan thupeh chu ahile, thaotwi bath khat chu cor a kona bath hop soma hop khat ahin; cor khat chu homer ahiloule bath som ahi. Ajehchu bath som chu homer khat ahi.
target: The prescribed portion of olive oil, measured by the bath, is a tenth of a bath from each cor (which consists of ten baths or one homer, for ten baths are equivalent to a homer).

source: Anneh thilto dingle govam thilto ding, chamna thilto dingle miho kichamna semna dinga Israel hamhing phatna ho-a kon, kelngoihon lah-a kon khat, jani lah-a kona kelngoinou khat napeh diu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseijin ahi.
target: Also one sheep is to be taken from every flock of two hundred from the well-watered pastures of Israel. These will be used for the grain offerings, burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to make atonement for the people, declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Gamsunga mi jousen Israel sunga leng chapa-a dinga hiche thilpeh hi apehcheh diu ahi.
target: All the people of the land will be required to give this special offering to the prince in Israel.

source: Chule hichehi leng chapa kin ding chu; lhathah nikho-a, cholngah nikho-a, Israel insunga lhentum kut jouse-a govam thilpeh, anneh thilpeh, don thilpeh, govam thilpeh, chule chamna thilpeh, Israelte insung dinga chamna thilpeh agon ding ahi.
target: It will be the duty of the prince to provide the burnt offerings, grain offerings and drink offerings at the festivals, the New Moons and the Sabbaths—at all the appointed festivals of Israel. He will provide the sin offerings, grain offerings, burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to make atonement for the Israelites.

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, lhamasa alhasunga nimasa nileh, bongchal gol nolnabei khatna muntheng chu nasuhtheng diu ahi.
target: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: In the first month on the first day you are to take a young bull without defect and purify the sanctuary.

source: Chule thempu chun chonset thilto thisan chu alah-a, inkhom chunga, maicham kitunna ningli chunga, chule inhong sungnung kotpi khom chungchu anu ding ahi.
target: The priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the doorposts of the temple, on the four corners of the upper ledge of the altar and on the gateposts of the inner court.

source: Chule chuche lha nisagi ni chule suhkhel neitapou dingle milham dinga nabol ding; chutiachu insung nasuhcham diu ahi.
target: You are to do the same on the seventh day of the month for anyone who sins unintentionally or through ignorance; so you are to make atonement for the temple.

source: Lha masapen-a chuche lha nisomle nili tengchule, nanghon kalchuh kut naman uva, nisagi golvah naboldiu, cholsolou changlhah naneh dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘In the first month on the fourteenth day you are to observe the Passover, a festival lasting seven days, during which you shall eat bread made without yeast.

source: Hicheni chule lengchapan ama dingle gamsunga mipi jouse dinga chonset thilto dinga bongchal khat agon ding ahi.
target: On that day the prince is to provide a bull as a sin offering for himself and for all the people of the land.

source: Chule nisagi kut sunga chu Pakai henga govam thilto dinga aman nolnabei cheh bongchal sagile kelngoichal sagi niseh-a anisagi-a dinga chu agon ding, chule chonset thilto dinga kelchaho lah-a anou khat atoding ahi.
target: Every day during the seven days of the festival he is to provide seven bulls and seven rams without defect as a burnt offering to the Lord , and a male goat for a sin offering.

source: Chule aman anneh thilto dinga, bongchal khat dinga ephah khat, kelngoichal khat dinga ephah khat, ephah khat dinga thaotwi hin dimkhat agon ding ahi.
target: He is to provide as a grain offering an ephah for each bull and an ephah for each ram, along with a hin of olive oil for each ephah.

source: Lha sagi lhinna, alha sunga nisomle ninga nikho teng, nisagi kut kiman bang banga chu abolding, chonset thilto, govam thilto le, anneh thilpeh, chule thaotwi agon ding ahi.
target: “ ‘During the seven days of the festival, which begins in the seventh month on the fifteenth day, he is to make the same provision for sin offerings, burnt offerings, grain offerings and oil.

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije, solam ngat inhong sungnung kotpi chu nigup sunga kikhah jing ding, cholngah nikho le vang kihong ding, chule lhathah nikho nile jong kihong ding ahi.
target: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: The gate of the inner court facing east is to be shut on the six working days, but on the Sabbath day and on the day of the New Moon it is to be opened.

source: Leng chapa chu apolama hongcha kotpi-a chu hunglutna, kotpi khom phunga chu ding dena, ama govam thilto le chamna thilto ding chu thempu chun agonpeh ding; ama kotpi bula chu chibai aboh-a, chuteng potdoh ding, nilhah kahse-a kotpi chu kikhah lou ding ahi.
target: The prince is to enter from the outside through the portico of the gateway and stand by the gatepost. The priests are to sacrifice his burnt offering and his fellowship offerings. He is to bow down in worship at the threshold of the gateway and then go out, but the gate will not be shut until evening.

source: Hiche banga chu gamsung miten hiche kotpi phunga hi choldo nile lhathah nikho ni-a Pakai anga chibai abohdiu ahi.
target: On the Sabbaths and New Moons the people of the land are to worship in the presence of the Lord at the entrance of that gateway.

source: Chule choldoni-a Pakai anga lengchapan atoding govam thilto chu, nolnabei kelngoinou gup le kelngoichal nolnabei khat hiding ahi.
target: The burnt offering the prince brings to the Lord on the Sabbath day is to be six male lambs and a ram, all without defect.

source: Chule kelngoichal khat dinga anneh thilpehho chu ephah khat hintin, kelngoinou ho ding chu apehjou kham cheh, chule ephah khatna dinga thaotwi hin khat hiding ahi.
target: The grain offering given with the ram is to be an ephah, and the grain offering with the lambs is to be as much as he pleases, along with a hin of olive oil for each ephah.

source: Chule lhathah nikho nileh nolnabei bongchalgol khat, chule kelngoinou gup, kelngoichal khat hiding, nolnabei cheh hiding ahi.
target: On the day of the New Moon he is to offer a young bull, six lambs and a ram, all without defect.

source: Aman anneh thilpeh apehding, bongchal khat dinga ephah khat, kelngoichal khat dinga ephah khat, kelngoinou ho ding vang atamto theichan hiding, chule ephah khat dinga thaotwi hin khat hiding ahi.
target: He is to provide as a grain offering one ephah with the bull, one ephah with the ram, and with the lambs as much as he wants to give, along with a hin of oil for each ephah.

source: Leng chapa alut dingteng, hongcha kotpi lama chu lutna, hiche lampia chu potkit ding ahi.
target: When the prince enters, he is to go in through the portico of the gateway, and he is to come out the same way.

source: Ahin Kutpi nikho-a gamsung mite Pakai anga ahung tengule, sahlam kotpi-a lutna chu lhanglam kotpi-a pot ding; lhanglam kotpi-a lutna chu sahlam kotpi-a pot ding, ahunglutna kotpi lama kilelouva, amalama chepaipai joding ahi.
target: “ ‘When the people of the land come before the Lord at the appointed festivals, whoever enters by the north gate to worship is to go out the south gate; and whoever enters by the south gate is to go out the north gate. No one is to return through the gate by which they entered, but each is to go out the opposite gate.

source: Alah uva leng chapa chu, amaho alut tengule lutna; amaho achedoh tengule chedoh ding ahi.
target: The prince is to be among them, going in when they go in and going out when they go out.

source: Chule kut sungle anipi niho-a anneh thilpeh chu bongchal khatna ephah khat, kelngoichal khatna ephah khat, chule kelngoinou ho dinga apehjou khambep, chule ephah khatna thaotwi hin khat hiding ahi.
target: At the feasts and the appointed festivals, the grain offering is to be an ephah with a bull, an ephah with a ram, and with the lambs as much as he pleases, along with a hin of oil for each ephah.

source: Tun leng chapan ama chama govam thilpeh abola, ahiloule Pakai dinga ama chama thilpeh agon tengle, solam nga-a kotpi chu mikhatnin ahonpeh ding, cholngah nikho-a abol banga, aman agovam thilto le achamna thilpeh akigon ding; chuteng ama potdoh ding, ama potdoh joule kotpi khatnin akhading ahi.
target: “ ‘When the prince provides a freewill offering to the Lord —whether a burnt offering or fellowship offerings—the gate facing east is to be opened for him. He shall offer his burnt offering or his fellowship offerings as he does on the Sabbath day. Then he shall go out, and after he has gone out, the gate will be shut.

source: Nangman nolnabei kum khat lhingbep kelngoinou khat niseh-a Pakai dinga govam thilpeh nagon ding ahi. Hichu jingkah seh-a nagon ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Every day you are to provide a year-old lamb without defect for a burnt offering to the Lord ; morning by morning you shall provide it.

source: Hiche dinga hi jingkah seh-a anneh thilpeh nagon ding, ephah hop gupma hop khat le thaotwi hin khat hop thuma hopkhat chu changbongnel toh namehtha ding; Pakaiya dinga kumkho-a houdan anneh thilpeh jomjing chu hiding ahi.
target: You are also to provide with it morning by morning a grain offering, consisting of a sixth of an ephah with a third of a hin of oil to moisten the flour. The presenting of this grain offering to the Lord is a lasting ordinance.

source: Hiti achu amahon kelngoinou le anneh thilpeh, chule thaotwi chu jingseh-a tanglouva govam thilto dinga agon jing dingu ahi.
target: So the lamb and the grain offering and the oil shall be provided morning by morning for a regular burnt offering.

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; lengchapan achapate khattou thilpeh apehle, chuche goulo chu achapatea hiding ahi; hichu agoulou thilkeo hiding ahitai.
target: “ ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: If the prince makes a gift from his inheritance to one of his sons, it will also belong to his descendants; it is to be their property by inheritance.

source: Aman agouloa kona asohte khattou thilpeh apeh ahilevang, achamlhat kum geija ama-a hintin; chuchejou tengle lengpa chapa kilepeh kitding ahi. Ahinla agoulo chu achapate bou changding ahi.
target: If, however, he makes a gift from his inheritance to one of his servants, the servant may keep it until the year of freedom; then it will revert to the prince. His inheritance belongs to his sons only; it is theirs.

source: Chukalvalin leng chapa chun mipi ho chu aneijuva kona nodoh nadinga, hunama agoulo-u chu alahpeh louding; amavang aman achapate chu aneija kona alahdoh-a agoulo dingu apeh dingjoh ahi. Chutile kamite jouse aneijuva kona kithecheh loudiu ahi.
target: The prince must not take any of the inheritance of the people, driving them off their property. He is to give his sons their inheritance out of his own property, so that not one of my people will be separated from their property.’ ”

source: Chujouvin aman kotpi panga um, lutna-a chun, sahlam sang nga-a thempuho indan theng sunga chun eipuilutin; chuin veuvin, lhumlam sihtenia chun mun khat kamun ahi.
target: Then the man brought me through the entrance at the side of the gate to the sacred rooms facing north, which belonged to the priests, and showed me a place at the western end.

source: Chuin aman kajah-a, hichehi thempuhon suhkhel thilto le chonset thiltoho ahon nadiu mun chu ahin, hia chu amahon anneh thilto chu akandiu; chutiachu amahon inhongsung ponunga, mipi ho thensona dinga ahinpoh doh loudiu ahi.
target: He said to me, “This is the place where the priests are to cook the guilt offering and the sin offering and bake the grain offering, to avoid bringing them into the outer court and consecrating the people.”

source: Chujouvin aman inhong ponung sunga chun eipuidoh-in, inhongsung ning li-a chun eipuilen; chuin veuvin, inhongsung ning tina chun inhongsung khat cheh aumin ahi.
target: He then brought me to the outer court and led me around to its four corners, and I saw in each corner another court.

source: Inhongsung ning li-a chun tong somli sao, tong somthum len, inhongsung kijopmat aumin, hiche ning li hohi tena kibang ahi.
target: In the four corners of the outer court were enclosed courts, forty cubits long and thirty cubits wide; each of the courts in the four corners was the same size.

source: Asungu kimvel, amaho li kimvela chun agola kisa in aumin, atogola chun mei tina thuhho akisemin ahi.
target: Around the inside of each of the four courts was a ledge of stone, with places for fire built all around under the ledge.

source: Chuin aman kajah-a, hichehohi anhonho dinga munho ahin, hia chu houin'a lhachahon mipite kilhainaho chu ahondiu ahi, ati.
target: He said to me, “These are the kitchens where those who minister at the temple are to cook the sacrifices of the people.”

source: Chujouchun aman inkot phung lama eipui kitnin; chuin, veuvin, solam ngat kotbul noija konchun twiho ahung longdoh-in ahi. Ajehchu inmai chun solam angat ahin, twiho chu maicham lhanglam sang, in jetlam sanga noija kon hung longlha ahi.
target: The man brought me back to the entrance to the temple, and I saw water coming out from under the threshold of the temple toward the east (for the temple faced east). The water was coming down from under the south side of the temple, south of the altar.

source: Chuphatnin aman sahlam kotpi-a chun eipuidoh-in, polang lampia, kotpi ponung, pamlam solam ngat lampia chun eipuijin, chule veuvin, jetlam sanga chun twiho ahung longdoh-in ahi.
target: He then brought me out through the north gate and led me around the outside to the outer gate facing east, and the water was trickling from the south side.

source: Chuin akhutna khao choipa chu solam nga-a achedoh phatnin, tong sangkhat atedoh-in, twilah-a chun eipuijin ahile, twi chun kakeng khochong aphan ahi.
target: As the man went eastward with a measuring line in his hand, he measured off a thousand cubits and then led me through water that was ankle-deep.

source: Chuin tong sangkhat atedoh kitnin, twilah-a chun eipuijin ahile, twi chun kakhup aphan ahi. Chuin aman tong sangkhat atedoh kitnin, twilah-a chun eipuidoh kitnin ahile, twi chun kakong aphan ahi.
target: He measured off another thousand cubits and led me through water that was knee-deep. He measured off another thousand and led me through water that was up to the waist.

source: Chujouchun tong sangkhat atedoh kitnin ahile; kapal galkai joulou vadung anahitai. Ijeh inem itile twi chu akhangin, ajapma japtho ding ahitan, palgalkai joulou ding vadung ahitai.
target: He measured off another thousand, but now it was a river that I could not cross, because the water had risen and was deep enough to swim in—a river that no one could cross.

source: Chuin aman kajah-a, mihem chapa, hichehi namu-em? eiti. Chuin aman eipuijin, vadung panga chun eikinung lesah tai.
target: He asked me, “Son of man, do you see this?” Then he led me back to the bank of the river.

source: Tun keima kakinungle phatnin, veuvin, vadung apang teni-a chun alangto-in thingphung tampitah akeh-in ahi.
target: When I arrived there, I saw a great number of trees on each side of the river.

source: Chuin aman kajah-a, hiche twihohi solam gama longlha-a, nelgam lama longsuh-a, twipia longlut ahin; twi hin twipi aphah phahle, twi chu damding ahi.
target: He said to me, “This water flows toward the eastern region and goes down into the Arabah, where it enters the Dead Sea. When it empties into the sea, the salty water there becomes fresh.

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, vadung lonna lamjousea, ahing theija chatloh thei jouse chu hing dingu ahi. Ajehchu twiho chu khulama ahunglon jeh-a, nga atama tam umding ahi; ijeh inem itile amaho kisudam dingu, chule vadung lon nalam jouse-a chu imajouse hingding ahi.
target: Swarms of living creatures will live wherever the river flows. There will be large numbers of fish, because this water flows there and makes the salt water fresh; so where the river flows everything will live.

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, Engedi apat Eneglaim chan geija ngamanho chu kipatdoh dingu, hiche munho chu len sena mun hung hiding; angahou chu amaho jat dungjuija twipi lenho-a nga banga hatama hung tamdiu ahi.
target: Fishermen will stand along the shore; from En Gedi to En Eglaim there will be places for spreading nets. The fish will be of many kinds—like the fish of the Mediterranean Sea.

source: Ahinla chua bonnganle bonlhoh munchu damlou ding ahi, amaho chi henga kipedoh ding ahiuve.
target: But the swamps and marshes will not become fresh; they will be left for salt.

source: Chule chua vadung pang, hilam pangle khulam panga chu, nehdinga thingphung jouse kehding, anaho pullou ding, agao jong beithei louding; atwi chu munthenga kona hunglong doh ahijeh-a, lhathah dungjuija gathah ahin sepdoh ding; atheiga chu anneh hija, athingna chu damna hiding ahi.
target: Fruit trees of all kinds will grow on both banks of the river. Their leaves will not wither, nor will their fruit fail. Every month they will bear fruit, because the water from the sanctuary flows to them. Their fruit will serve for food and their leaves for healing.”

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Israel phung somle phung ni dungjuija agam lo dingu gamtum chu hichehi hiding ahi: Joseph chu chan ni chang ding ahi.
target: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: “These are the boundaries of the land that you will divide among the twelve tribes of Israel as their inheritance, with two portions for Joseph.

source: Nanghon hichu, khat cheh-in kibang cheh-a nalodiu; hiche thudol chu napu napateu pehdinga kakhut kanadopsa ahitan, hiche gamhi nangho goulo dinga hungum ding ahi.
target: You are to divide it equally among them. Because I swore with uplifted hand to give it to your ancestors, this land will become your inheritance.

source: Hichehi sahlam sanga gamgi chu hiding ahi: twipilen'a pat Hethlon lampia, Zedad'a mi chena gei,
target: “This is to be the boundary of the land: “On the north side it will run from the Mediterranean Sea by the Hethlon road past Lebo Hamath to Zedad,

source: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, hichu Damascus le Hamath kikah-a gamgi ahin, Hazarhatticon, hichu Hauran gamkol kom ahi.
target: Berothah and Sibraim (which lies on the border between Damascus and Hamath), as far as Hazer Hattikon, which is on the border of Hauran.

source: Chule twipia patna gamgi chu Hazarenan gei Damascus gamsung hintin, chunglam sahlam sanga um chule Hamath gamsung gei hiding ahi. Hichehi sahlam sang gamgi ahi.
target: The boundary will extend from the sea to Hazar Enan, along the northern border of Damascus, with the border of Hamath to the north. This will be the northern boundary.

source: Chule solamsang chu nanghon Hauran'a pat Damascus apat, Gilead'a pat chule Jordan solam twipi gamgia pat le Israel gamgia pat nate diu ahi. Chule hichehi Solamsang ahi.
target: “On the east side the boundary will run between Hauran and Damascus, along the Jordan between Gilead and the land of Israel, to the Dead Sea and as far as Tamar. This will be the eastern boundary.

source: Chule lhanglam sanga lhanglam chu, Tamar apat Kadesh a twiho, twipilen vadung gei ngei chu hiding ahi. Chule hichehi lhanglam sanga lhanglam ngat chu ahi.
target: “On the south side it will run from Tamar as far as the waters of Meribah Kadesh, then along the Wadi of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea. This will be the southern boundary.

source: Lhumlam sang chu gamgia pat twipilen, Hamath a mi hung galkai theina gei chu hiding ahi. Hichehi lhumlam sang ahi.
target: “On the west side, the Mediterranean Sea will be the boundary to a point opposite Lebo Hamath. This will be the western boundary.

source: Hiti-a hi Israel phungho dungjuija gam chu nakihop diu ahi.
target: “You are to distribute this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, hiti achu vang vetna nangho goulo dingle nalah uva hung pemlut gamdang mi, nalah uva chate hinhing dingho chu nakihop diu ahi. Chule amaho Israel chate lah-a gamsunga pengden nalah uva um tobang hidiu ahin, amahon Israel phung lah-a nang hotoh gou alokhom dingu ahi.
target: You are to allot it as an inheritance for yourselves and for the foreigners residing among you and who have children. You are to consider them as native-born Israelites; along with you they are to be allotted an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, gamdang mi ipi phung sunga hung pemlut hijongle, nanghon ama chu chua agoulo ding napeh diu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen chun aseije.
target: In whatever tribe a foreigner resides, there you are to give them their inheritance,” declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Tun hichehohi phung minho chu ahiuve. Sahlam mong Hethlon gamkol lampi, Hamath'a chena, Hazarenan, sahlam sang Damascus gamsung le Hamath gamkol chan hiding ahi, ajehchu hichehohi solam le lhumlama ama gamkai ahin, Dan chanvou chu ahi.
target: “These are the tribes, listed by name: At the northern frontier, Dan will have one portion; it will follow the Hethlon road to Lebo Hamath; Hazar Enan and the northern border of Damascus next to Hamath will be part of its border from the east side to the west side.

source: Chule Dan gamsung, solama pat lhumlam gei chu, Asher chan ahi.
target: “Asher will have one portion; it will border the territory of Dan from east to west.

source: Chule Asher gamsung, solama pat lhumlam gei chu, Naphtali chan ahi.
target: “Naphtali will have one portion; it will border the territory of Asher from east to west.

source: Chule Naphtali gamsung, solama pat lhumlam gei chu, Manasseh chan ahi.
target: “Manasseh will have one portion; it will border the territory of Naphtali from east to west.

source: Chule Manasseh gamsung, solama pat lhumlam gei chu, Ephraim chan ahi.
target: “Ephraim will have one portion; it will border the territory of Manasseh from east to west.

source: Chule Ephraim gamsung, solama pat lhumlam gei chu, Reuben chan ahi.
target: “Reuben will have one portion; it will border the territory of Ephraim from east to west.

source: Chule Reuben gamsung, solama pat lhumlam gei chu, Judah chan ahi.
target: “Judah will have one portion; it will border the territory of Reuben from east to west.

source: Chule Judah gamsung, solama pat lhumlam gei chu, avai pengmol sangsomni le sangnga, gamchan dangho khat banga sao, solama pat lhumlam gei chu natodoh dinguva um natodoh-u chu hiding ahi. Hiche lailunga chu muntheng chu umding ahi.
target: “Bordering the territory of Judah from east to west will be the portion you are to present as a special gift. It will be 25,000 cubits wide, and its length from east to west will equal one of the tribal portions; the sanctuary will be in the center of it.

source: Pakai houna dinga natodoh dingu chu adung sangsomni le sangnga, avai sangsom hiding ahi.
target: “The special portion you are to offer to the Lord will be 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide.

source: Chule amaho ding, thempuho ding ngei chu, hiche kipedoh theng chu hiding; sahlam sang sangsomni le sangnga sao, chule solamsang sangsoma len, chule lhanglam chu sangsomni le sangnga sao hiding ahi. Chule Pakai muntheng chu alailunga chu umding ahi.
target: This will be the sacred portion for the priests. It will be 25,000 cubits long on the north side, 10,000 cubits wide on the west side, 10,000 cubits wide on the east side and 25,000 cubits long on the south side. In the center of it will be the sanctuary of the Lord .

source: Hichehi Israel chate anavavei laijuva, Levi miho anavavei banguva anavah veilou, kathupeh anaching tupma ana kisuthengsa Zadok chapate thempu ho-a hiding ahi.
target: This will be for the consecrated priests, the Zadokites, who were faithful in serving me and did not go astray as the Levites did when the Israelites went astray.

source: Chule hiche akipedoh gam chu, amaho dinga Levi mite gamsung thiltheng chungnung hiding ahi.
target: It will be a special gift to them from the sacred portion of the land, a most holy portion, bordering the territory of the Levites.

source: Chule thempuho gamsung jonna chu Levi miten gam adung sangsomni le sangnga, avai sangsom anei dingu ahi, adung jouse chu sangsomni le sangnga hiding, chule avai chu sangsom hiding ahi.
target: “Alongside the territory of the priests, the Levites will have an allotment 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide. Its total length will be 25,000 cubits and its width 10,000 cubits.

source: Chule amahon hichehi ajoh loudiu, ahiloule alhet loudiu, gamga masaho jong midang apeh loudiu ahi; ajehchu hichehi Pakai dinga atheng ahi.
target: They must not sell or exchange any of it. This is the best of the land and must not pass into other hands, because it is holy to the Lord .

source: Chule sangsomni le sangnga jonna avai sanga kidalha chu khopi dinga manchah thei hiding, chule mipi dinga chenna dingle khovel hiding ahi. Chule hiche alailunga chu khopi umding ahi.
target: “The remaining area, 5,000 cubits wide and 25,000 cubits long, will be for the common use of the city, for houses and for pastureland. The city will be in the center of it

source: Chule hichehi akite dan hiding ahi: sahlam sang chu sangli le janga, lhanglam sang sangli le janga, solamsang sangli le janga, chule lhumlam sang sangli le janga hiding ahi.
target: and will have these measurements: the north side 4,500 cubits, the south side 4,500 cubits, the east side 4,500 cubits, and the west side 4,500 cubits.

source: Chule khopivel chu sahlam sangjani le somnga, lhanglam sangjani le somnga, solam sangjani le somnga, lhumlam sang chu jani le somnga hiding ahi.
target: The pastureland for the city will be 250 cubits on the north, 250 cubits on the south, 250 cubits on the east, and 250 cubits on the west.

source: Chule akipedoh gambih theng jona avalchu adunglam chu solamsang sangsom, lhumlam sang sangsom hiding ahi. Chule hichu akipedoh gambih theng jona umding ahin, chule chua aga sohdoh chu khopi kinbolho kivahna hiding ahi.
target: What remains of the area, bordering on the sacred portion and running the length of it, will be 10,000 cubits on the east side and 10,000 cubits on the west side. Its produce will supply food for the workers of the city.

source: Khopi kinbol ho chu Israel phungho-a kona bou aboldiu ahi.
target: The workers from the city who farm it will come from all the tribes of Israel.

source: Akipedoh pumpi adung avai chu sangsomni le sangnga cheh hiding ahi, khopi chan puma aningli kibanga akipedoh theng chu natodoh thadingu ahi.
target: The entire portion will be a square, 25,000 cubits on each side. As a special gift you will set aside the sacred portion, along with the property of the city.

source: Chule amoh akipedoh theng pang jetle vei chu lengchapa-a hiding, akipedoh sangsomni le sangnga solam gamsung jona, chule lhumlam sang gamsung jona sangsomni le sangnga, hiche chanho jongchu lengchapa-a ahi. Chule hichehi akipedoh theng chu hiding ahi. Chule hiche lailunga chu houin muntheng chu umding ahi.
target: “What remains on both sides of the area formed by the sacred portion and the property of the city will belong to the prince. It will extend eastward from the 25,000 cubits of the sacred portion to the eastern border, and westward from the 25,000 cubits to the western border. Both these areas running the length of the tribal portions will belong to the prince, and the sacred portion with the temple sanctuary will be in the center of them.

source: Hiche chungchona chu Levi mite chanvouho le khopi chanvouho-a pat alailunggei lengchapa-a hija, Benjamin gamsungle Judah gamsung kikah chu lengchapa-a ding ahi.
target: So the property of the Levites and the property of the city will lie in the center of the area that belongs to the prince. The area belonging to the prince will lie between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin.

source: Aumnalai phungho thudol chu, solam sanga pat lhumlam gei chu, Benjamin phungin chan khat aneiding ahi.
target: “As for the rest of the tribes: Benjamin will have one portion; it will extend from the east side to the west side.

source: Chule Benjamin gamsung, solama pat lhumlam geija Simeon'in chan khat aneiding ahi.
target: “Simeon will have one portion; it will border the territory of Benjamin from east to west.

source: Chule Simeon gamsung, solama pat lhumlam gei chu Issachar chan ahi.
target: “Issachar will have one portion; it will border the territory of Simeon from east to west.

source: Chule Issachar gamsung, solama pat lhumlam gei chu Zebulun chan ahi.
target: “Zebulun will have one portion; it will border the territory of Issachar from east to west.

source: Chule Zebulun gamsung, solama pat lhumlam gei chu Gad chan ahi.
target: “Gad will have one portion; it will border the territory of Zebulun from east to west.

source: Chule Gad gamsung chu, lhumlam sanga lhanglam panga gamgi chu Tamar'a pat Kadesh'a longlut twiho geile twipilen lama long vadung gei chu ahi.
target: “The southern boundary of Gad will run south from Tamar to the waters of Meribah Kadesh, then along the Wadi of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea.

source: Hichehi nanghon Israel phung mite goulo dinga vangvetna nahoppeh dingu gamchu ahin, chule hiche hohi achanvou uchu ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: “This is the land you are to allot as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel, and these will be their portions,” declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Hichehohi khopi-a kona sahlam panga gamgi ngahna kilhungdoh ahin, tenaho-a sangli le janga ahi.
target: “These will be the exits of the city: Beginning on the north side, which is 4,500 cubits long,

source: Khopi kotpiho chu Israel phungho min dungjuija sah ding ahin, sahlam panga kotpi thum aumin, Reuben kotpi khat, Judah kotpi khat, Levi kotpi khat ahi.
target: the gates of the city will be named after the tribes of Israel. The three gates on the north side will be the gate of Reuben, the gate of Judah and the gate of Levi.

source: Chule solam sanga sangli le janga, chule kotpi thum, Joseph kotpi khat, Benjamin kotpi khat, Dan kotpi khat ahi.
target: “On the east side, which is 4,500 cubits long, will be three gates: the gate of Joseph, the gate of Benjamin and the gate of Dan.

source: Chule lhanglam sanga sangli le janga, chule kotpi thum, Simeon kotpi khat, Issachar kotpi khat, Zebulun kotpi khat ahi.
target: “On the south side, which measures 4,500 cubits, will be three gates: the gate of Simeon, the gate of Issachar and the gate of Zebulun.

source: Lhumlam sanga sangli le janga, akotpiu thum toh, Gad kotpi khat, Asher kotpi khat, Naphtali kotpi khat ahi.
target: “On the west side, which is 4,500 cubits long, will be three gates: the gate of Gad, the gate of Asher and the gate of Naphtali.

source: Akimvel chu tena sangsom le sangget ahin, chuche ni-a patna chuche khopi min chu, chumuna Pakai aume, hiding ahi.
target: “The distance all around will be 18,000 cubits. “And the name of the city from that time on will be: the Lord is there.”

source: Judah lengpa Jehoiakim leng chan kal kum thum lhinna-in, Babylon lengpa Nebuchadnezzar chu Jerusalem lama ahungin, ahung umkimvel tan ahi.
target: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.

source: Pakaiyin Judah lengpa Jehoiakim chu ama khutna, Pathen insunga kongle bel phabep toh apehdohthan; hichu aman Shinar gamsunga a-pathen insunga apolutnin; chule aman kongle bel ho chu a-pathen'u thillu koina insung alhut tan ahi.
target: And the Lord delivered Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, along with some of the articles from the temple of God. These he carried off to the temple of his god in Babylonia and put in the treasure house of his god.

source: Chuin lengpa chun nukiso ho lamkaipa Ashpenaz jah-a chun Israel chate, leng chilhah, leng chapate lah-a kon mi phabep ahinpui dingin ahetsah-in,
target: Then the king ordered Ashpenaz, chief of his court officials, to bring into the king’s service some of the Israelites from the royal family and the nobility—

source: Amaho chu, ama-a nolna kimulou golhang, ahivanga melhoi, chihna lam jouse-a bulhing, hetna giltah nei, ijakai hethem bai, lengpa insunga dingthei ding, Chaldea mite themna le pao hilthei dingho ahiuve.
target: young men without any physical defect, handsome, showing aptitude for every kind of learning, well informed, quick to understand, and qualified to serve in the king’s palace. He was to teach them the language and literature of the Babylonians.

source: Chule lengpan amaho chu lengpa anneh le adonji ju chu nitina achan diuvin agotpeh-in: chutia chu kum thum khoukhah-a aumjou tengule lengpa anga akilah diuvin agongtan ahi.
target: The king assigned them a daily amount of food and wine from the king’s table. They were to be trained for three years, and after that they were to enter the king’s service.

source: Tun hiche miho lah-a hin Judah chate, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael chule Azariah apanguve.
target: Among those who were chosen were some from Judah: Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah.

source: Amaho chu nukiso pipupa chun aminvon: hitichun aman Daniel chu Belteshazzar, Hananiah chu Shadrach, Mishael chu Meshach, chule Azariah chu Abednego asahtai.
target: The chief official gave them new names: to Daniel, the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.

source: Ahivangin Daniel'in lengpa anneh le adonji ju-a akisuhboh lou dingin alungsunga kigel lhahna aneijin: hijeh chun aman akisohboh louna dingin nukiso pipu henga chun ataotan ahi.
target: But Daniel resolved not to defile himself with the royal food and wine, and he asked the chief official for permission not to defile himself this way.

source: Tun Pathen'in Daniel chu nukiso pipupa mitmu-a khohsahna le ngailutna giltah ahin chansah tai.
target: Now God had caused the official to show favor and compassion to Daniel,

source: Chuin nukiso pipupa chun Daniel henga, Nangho dinga nehding le donding hinteppeh ka pakai lengpa chu keiman kaginge. Ajehchu ibola nakhangol golhangho maiso sanga nangho maiso phamo jo-a amu ding ham? Chuti taleh nanghon lengpa henga kaluchanghi tijat um nasodiu ahi, tin aseitai.
target: but the official told Daniel, “I am afraid of my lord the king, who has assigned your food and drink. Why should he see you looking worse than the other young men your age? The king would then have my head because of you.”

source: Chujouvin Daniel'in nukiso pipupan Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael chule Azariah vesui dinga akoipa Melzar henga aseitai;
target: Daniel then said to the guard whom the chief official had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah,

source: Nisom sungin nasohte neipatep un tia kangeh nahi, chule amahon keiho neh dingin anche, chule don dingin twisih eipeuhen.
target: “Please test your servants for ten days: Give us nothing but vegetables to eat and water to drink.

source: Chujou tengle nangma angsunga keiho mel leh lengpa an neh ne-a golhangho mel vet kah-in umhen; chule namu dungjuijin nasohte chunga hin boljengin, ati.
target: Then compare our appearance with that of the young men who eat the royal food, and treat your servants in accordance with what you see.”

source: Hitichun hiche thua hin amapan aseiju chu anoppehtan, chule amaho chu nisom sung apatep tai.
target: So he agreed to this and tested them for ten days.

source: Chuin nisom ahung kichaijin, lengpa an neh ne-a golhangho jouse sangin amaho chu mel hoijo le tahsa phajon ahung kilangtan ahi.
target: At the end of the ten days they looked healthier and better nourished than any of the young men who ate the royal food.

source: Hitichun Melzar'in achan dinguva kipe, aneh diu an le adon diu ju chu alamangin; chule amaho chu anche apejotan ahi.
target: So the guard took away their choice food and the wine they were to drink and gave them vegetables instead.

source: Hiche golhang liho vangchu, Pathen'in themna jouse le chihna lam jouse-a hetna le boltheina apen; chule Daniel'in gaothilmu le mangho jouse lama hetthem theina ananeijin ahi.
target: To these four young men God gave knowledge and understanding of all kinds of literature and learning. And Daniel could understand visions and dreams of all kinds.

source: Tun lengpan amaho nahinpuilut ding ahi tia asei nikho alhun phatnin, nukiso pipupan amaho jouse chu Nebuchadnezzar anga apuilut tan ahi.
target: At the end of the time set by the king to bring them into his service, the chief official presented them to Nebuchadnezzar.

source: Chuin lengpan amaho chu akihoupin, chule amaho lah-a chun Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael chule Azariah tobang akimupon ahi. Hijeh chun amaho lengpa anga ading taovin ahi.
target: The king talked with them, and he found none equal to Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah; so they entered the king’s service.

source: Chule chihnale hetthem theina lam jouse-a lengpan amaho chu adongin ahile, alengvai pohna gam pumpi-a mitpheldoi choiho le ahsi lekhathem ho jouse sanga chan soma sangjon amutan ahi.
target: In every matter of wisdom and understanding about which the king questioned them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters in his whole kingdom.

source: Hitichun Daniel chu Cyrus lengpa lengchan kum masapen geijin ahung umpeh tan ahi.
target: And Daniel remained there until the first year of King Cyrus.

source: Nebuchadnezzar lengchan kum ni alhin na-in, Nebuchadnezzar'in mangho aneijin, hichun alung asugimin, a-imut asuboitan ahi.
target: In the second year of his reign, Nebuchadnezzar had dreams; his mind was troubled and he could not sleep.

source: Chujouvin lengpan doithemho, ahsi lekhathem ho, aisanho chule Chaldea miho chu amangho hilchen dinga kou dingin thu khau tah-in apetai. Hitichun amaho ahungun lengpa anga ahung ding taove.
target: So the king summoned the magicians, enchanters, sorcerers and astrologers to tell him what he had dreamed. When they came in and stood before the king,

source: Chuin lengpan ajah uva, Keiman mang khat kaneijin, hichu hetdohna dingin kalung agimlheh tai, ati.
target: he said to them, “I have had a dream that troubles me and I want to know what it means.”

source: Chuin Chaldea mihon Syrian paovin lengpa henga, Vo lengpa, hing jingin: mang chu nasohte neisei peh-un, chutile keihon aledohna navetsah naovinge, atiuve.
target: Then the astrologers answered the king, “May the king live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and we will interpret it.”

source: Chuin lengpan adonbutnin Chaldea miho henga chun, Athil chu keija kona chemanga ahitai: nanghon mangle aledohna chu keima neihetsah louvule, nangho ahal hala tanboh-a naum dingu, chule na-inhou jong eh kikholna kasosah ding ahi.
target: The king replied to the astrologers, “This is what I have firmly decided: If you do not tell me what my dream was and interpret it, I will have you cut into pieces and your houses turned into piles of rubble.

source: Ahinla nanghon mang le aledohna chu nahilchet thei vangule, keija kona manbeija thilpeh le kipaman chule jana lentah namu dingu ahi. Hijeh chun mangle aledohna chu neimusah-un, ati.
target: But if you tell me the dream and explain it, you will receive from me gifts and rewards and great honor. So tell me the dream and interpret it for me.”

source: Amahon adonbut kitnun hitin aseijuve, Lengpan amang chu asohte eiseipeh uhen, chule keihon hiche aledohna chu vetsah-ung kate, atiuve.
target: Once more they replied, “Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will interpret it.”

source: Lengpan adonbutnin, Nanghon thil chu keija kona achemang namu jeh uva, phat mube theina ding bouva naseiju ahi, ti keiman kahechentai, ati.
target: Then the king answered, “I am certain that you are trying to gain time, because you realize that this is what I have firmly decided:

source: Ahin nanghon mang chu keima neihetsah louvule, nangho dingin dan thupeh khat bou uma ahi: ajehchu aphat akikhel theina dinga ka-anga jou le thudihlou sei dinga nakigotnu ahi. Hijeh chun mang chu neisei peh-un, chule keiman hiche aledohna chu neimusah theidingu ahi ti kahet ding ahi, ati.
target: If you do not tell me the dream, there is only one penalty for you. You have conspired to tell me misleading and wicked things, hoping the situation will change. So then, tell me the dream, and I will know that you can interpret it for me.”

source: Chaldea miho chun lengpa anga adonbutnun, hitihin aseijuve, Leiset chunga lengpa thu musahthei mihem khatcha aumpoi: hijeh-a chu chutobang thilchu mitphel doithem, ahiloule ahsi lekhathem, chule Chaldea mi anadongjia leng, pakai, ahiloule thuneija khatcha ana um khalou ahi.
target: The astrologers answered the king, “There is no one on earth who can do what the king asks! No king, however great and mighty, has ever asked such a thing of any magician or enchanter or astrologer.

source: Chule lengpan angaichat hi thil kikhat ahin, lengpa anga hichu tahlang jou ding tahsa-a hing hilou pathen ho tailou adang koimacha aumpoi, atiuve.
target: What the king asks is too difficult. No one can reveal it to the king except the gods, and they do not live among humans.”

source: Hichejeh hin lengpa alunghangin chule alungsalheh tan, chule Babylon'a miching jouse suhmang dingin thupeh apetan ahi.
target: This made the king so angry and furious that he ordered the execution of all the wise men of Babylon.

source: Chuin michingho thagam dinga dan thupeh kipe chu hopjalin aumtan; chule amaho Daniel le aloiho chu tha dingin aholtauve.
target: So the decree was issued to put the wise men to death, and men were sent to look for Daniel and his friends to put them to death.

source: Chujouvin Daniel'in thumop le chihna to thon lengpa ngahtupho lamkaipa, Babylon michingho that dinga chedohpa Arioch chu adonbutnin ahi.
target: When Arioch, the commander of the king’s guard, had gone out to put to death the wise men of Babylon, Daniel spoke to him with wisdom and tact.

source: Aman lengpa sepai lamkaipa Arioch chu adonbutnin, ipi dinga lengpa-a kona hiche dan thupeh hi hung hiti ganna ham? ati. Hichun Arioch-in athil umchan chu Daniel ahetsah tai.
target: He asked the king’s officer, “Why did the king issue such a harsh decree?” Arioch then explained the matter to Daniel.

source: Chujouvin Daniel alutjelin, aledohna chu lengpa amusah theina dinga, lengpan ama phat apehna dingin agathum tai.
target: At this, Daniel went in to the king and asked for time, so that he might interpret the dream for him.

source: Chuin Daniel a-in'a achen, athil umdol chu aloiho Hananiah, Mishael chule Azariah henga ahetsah-in ahi;
target: Then Daniel returned to his house and explained the matter to his friends Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah.

source: Hiche thuguh chungchang thua hi Babylon michingho jouse toh thakhatna Daniel le aloiho chu suhmanga aumlouna dinguva van Pathen hepina athum theina dingun ahetsah-in ahi.
target: He urged them to plead for mercy from the God of heaven concerning this mystery, so that he and his friends might not be executed with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.

source: Chujouvin thuguh chu jan-in gao thilmu in Daniel henga phondoh-in ahung umtan ahi. Chujouvin Daniel'in van Pathen chu athangvah tan ahi.
target: During the night the mystery was revealed to Daniel in a vision. Then Daniel praised the God of heaven

source: Daniel'in adonbutnin, Atonsot atonsotnin Pathen min chu vahchoijin umhen, ajehchu chihna le thahatna chu ama-a ahi.
target: and said: “Praise be to the name of God for ever and ever; wisdom and power are his.

source: Chule aman phat hole kum kiheichinho akheljin; aman lengho aladoh-in, lengho atungdoh-in, aman achingho henga chihna apen; chule hetthem theina neiho hetna apei.
target: He changes times and seasons; he deposes kings and raises up others. He gives wisdom to the wise and knowledge to the discerning.

source: Aman thugille thuguhho aphongdoh-in; muthima ipi aum aman ahen, chule vah chu amatoh aum khomin ahi.
target: He reveals deep and hidden things; he knows what lies in darkness, and light dwells with him.

source: Chihna le hatna eipe-ah, chule keihon nangma-a kona kangeh-u keima eihin hetsah-a, Vo Nangma kapate Pathen, keiman nangma kathangvah-in, kavah choije: ajehchu nangman tun lengpa ngaichat chu keiho neihin hetsah taove, ati.
target: I thank and praise you, God of my ancestors: You have given me wisdom and power, you have made known to me what we asked of you, you have made known to us the dream of the king.”

source: Hijeh chun lengpan Babylon michingho thatgam dinga athupehsa Arioch henga chun Daniel achelutnin: ahenga, Babylon michingho sumang hih-in; lengpa anga keima neipuilut nin, chule keiman aledohna chu lengpa vetsah ingkate, tin agaseije.
target: Then Daniel went to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to execute the wise men of Babylon, and said to him, “Do not execute the wise men of Babylon. Take me to the king, and I will interpret his dream for him.”

source: Chuin Arioch-in Daniel chu lengpa anga kintah-in apuilutnin, ajah-a, Keiman lengpa henga ledohna pe-a hilchen ding mi khat Judah sohchangho lah-a konin kamutai, agati.
target: Arioch took Daniel to the king at once and said, “I have found a man among the exiles from Judah who can tell the king what his dream means.”

source: Lengpan adonbutnin, Belteshazzar tia kiminvo Daniel chu adonbutnin, Keiman kananei mang le aledohna chu neihetsah thei ding ham? ati.
target: The king asked Daniel (also called Belteshazzar), “Are you able to tell me what I saw in my dream and interpret it?”

source: Lengpa angsunga Daniel'in adonbutnin, hitin aseije, Lengpan na-ngeh khoh thuguh chu michingho, ahsi lekhathem ho, mitpheldoi choiho, chule khonung thusei ho chun lengpa avetsah thei pouve.
target: Daniel replied, “No wise man, enchanter, magician or diviner can explain to the king the mystery he has asked about,

source: Ahinla thuguhho phongdoh jia van'a Pathen khat aumin, ama chun ninunung lamle ipi hungsoh dingham tichu Nebuchadnezzar lengpa ahin hetsah ahi. Namang le najalkhun chunga naluchang nangapma na gaothilmu chu hichehohi ahi:
target: but there is a God in heaven who reveals mysteries. He has shown King Nebuchadnezzar what will happen in days to come. Your dream and the visions that passed through your mind as you were lying in bed are these:

source: Nangma vang, vo lengpa, najalkhun chunga naum chun, tunungle ipi hunglhung ding ham ti ngaitona nalungthima ahung umin ahi. Chule thuguhho phongdoh ji-a ama chun ipi hunglhung ding ham ti nangma nahin hetsah ahi.
target: “As Your Majesty was lying there, your mind turned to things to come, and the revealer of mysteries showed you what is going to happen.

source: Ahinla keima hina-in vang, hiche thuguhhi keiman midang jouse sanga chihna kaneitam jeh-a kahenga kiphonga ahipon, amavang lengpa henga aledohna hetsah dingho jal leh, chutia chu nangman nalungsunga nalunggel chu nahetdohna ding joh ahibouve.
target: As for me, this mystery has been revealed to me, not because I have greater wisdom than anyone else alive, but so that Your Majesty may know the interpretation and that you may understand what went through your mind.

source: Vo lengpa, nangman milim lentah khat nanamun chule nanaven ahi. Hiche milim lentah avah-a vah pempum jeng chu na-angsunga adingin; chule alimdan chu tijat umtah ahi.
target: “Your Majesty looked, and there before you stood a large statue—an enormous, dazzling statue, awesome in appearance.

source: Hiche milim luchang chu sana thengsel ahin, a-ople abanho chu dangka, a-oile apheiho chu sum-eng,
target: The head of the statue was made of pure gold, its chest and arms of silver, its belly and thighs of bronze,

source: Akeng teni chu thih, akengphang teni chu thih le leiset kihala kisem ahi.
target: its legs of iron, its feet partly of iron and partly of baked clay.

source: Nangman mihem khutna kisem hilou song khat ahungdoh-a, hichun milim chu akengphang teni thih le leiset kihala kisem laitah ase khah-a, hiho chu ahal hala achipsoh nanamun ahi.
target: While you were watching, a rock was cut out, but not by human hands. It struck the statue on its feet of iron and clay and smashed them.

source: Hichun thih, lei, sum-eng, dangka chule sana chu abonin thakhatnin ahal halin achiplhan, chule nipi laija phola changsiho bang ahunghitai; chule huijin hicheho chu amut mangin, agei nalamu akihe tapoi. Chule milim sepma song chu mol lentah ahung soh-in, chule leiset pumpi alodim tai.
target: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver and the gold were all broken to pieces and became like chaff on a threshing floor in the summer. The wind swept them away without leaving a trace. But the rock that struck the statue became a huge mountain and filled the whole earth.

source: Hichehi mang chu ahin; chule chuche ledohna chu lengpa masanga keihon seijung kate.
target: “This was the dream, and now we will interpret it to the king.

source: Vo lengpa, nangma lengho leng nahi; ajehchu van Pathen'in lenggam, thaneina, thahat, chule loupina nangma napen ahi.
target: Your Majesty, you are the king of kings. The God of heaven has given you dominion and power and might and glory;

source: Chule aman mihem chate chenna jouse, gama saho chule chunga leng vachaho nangma khutna napedoh-in, chule amaho jouse chunga thuneijin nasemtai. Nangma hiche sana luchang chu nahi.
target: in your hands he has placed all mankind and the beasts of the field and the birds in the sky. Wherever they live, he has made you ruler over them all. You are that head of gold.

source: Chule nangma nungtengle nangma sanga hatmojo lenggam khat, chule athum channa sum-eng lenggam adang khat hung umdoh ding, hichun leiset pumpi hi vai apoh ding ahi.
target: “After you, another kingdom will arise, inferior to yours. Next, a third kingdom, one of bronze, will rule over the whole earth.

source: Chule lenggam lina chu thih banga hat ding; thih in thil jouse ahal hala asuhgema anoija akoi banga; chule thih-in hitiho asuhngem banga, hichun asuhngema asuhchip ding ahi.
target: Finally, there will be a fourth kingdom, strong as iron—for iron breaks and smashes everything—and as iron breaks things to pieces, so it will crush and break all the others.

source: Chule nangman akengphangho le kengjungho, akehkhat beldengpa lei abang thih-a namu bang ngeija hi, lenggam chu hung kikhen ding; ahinla nangman thihle leingan kihal namu bang ngeija, hiche chun thih tha aken ding ahi.
target: Just as you saw that the feet and toes were partly of baked clay and partly of iron, so this will be a divided kingdom; yet it will have some of the strength of iron in it, even as you saw iron mixed with clay.

source: Chule keng jungho chu abang thih-a chule abang leija ahibanga, hiche lenggam chu akeh khat hatnintin, akeh khat chu lhasam ding ahi.
target: As the toes were partly iron and partly clay, so this kingdom will be partly strong and partly brittle.

source: Chule nangman thihle leingan kihal namu banga, amaho mihem chilhah ho toh kichoh hal dingu; ahivanga thihle lei akihalthei lou banga, amaho khatle khat kitimat thei lou diu ahi.
target: And just as you saw the iron mixed with baked clay, so the people will be a mixture and will not remain united, any more than iron mixes with clay.

source: Chule hiche lengho nikholai tengchule van Pathen'in lenggam khat atundoh ding, hiche chu a-imatih chana suhmanga umlou ding ahitai. Chule hiche leggam chu midangho kidalhah peh lou ding, amavang hichechun hiche lenggam ho jousehi ahal hala asuhngema chule asuhmang ding, chule hichu a-itih-a ding jing ding ahitai.
target: “In the time of those kings, the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that will never be destroyed, nor will it be left to another people. It will crush all those kingdoms and bring them to an end, but it will itself endure forever.

source: Nangman khutna hilou molsanga kona khendoh-a song manu-a, chule hichun thih, sum-eng, lei, dangka chule sana ahal hala asuhngem namu banga; loupi Pathen'in tununga ipi ahungso ding lengpa ahinhetsah ahi. Chule mang chu atahbeh ahi, chule aledohna chu thonlou ahi, ati.
target: This is the meaning of the vision of the rock cut out of a mountain, but not by human hands—a rock that broke the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver and the gold to pieces. “The great God has shown the king what will take place in the future. The dream is true and its interpretation is trustworthy.”

source: Chuin Nebuchadnezzar lengpan tolla amai asulutnin, Daniel chu chibai aboh-in, chule amahon ama henga thilto le gimnamtui apeh diuvin thu apetan ahi.
target: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell prostrate before Daniel and paid him honor and ordered that an offering and incense be presented to him.

source: Lengpan Daniel chu adonbutnin, Hichehi thutah ahimonge, hitichun nangma Pathen hi pathen ho Pathen le lengho Pakai ahin, chule nangman hiche thil kisel guhho naphondoh thei jal-in, thil kisel guhho phongdoh-a chu ahi, ati.
target: The king said to Daniel, “Surely your God is the God of gods and the Lord of kings and a revealer of mysteries, for you were able to reveal this mystery.”

source: Chuin lengpan Daniel chu miloupi tah-in asemin, chule thilpeh tamtah ho chu apen, chule Babylon gam pumpi chunga thuneile, Babylon'a michingho jouse chunga vaihomho pipui ahisah tai.
target: Then the king placed Daniel in a high position and lavished many gifts on him. He made him ruler over the entire province of Babylon and placed him in charge of all its wise men.

source: Chujouvin Daniel'in lengpa henga ngehna aneijin, hitichun aman Shadrach, Meshach chule Abednego chu Babylon gamkaiho chunga vaibolin apansahtai. Ahinla Daniel vang chu lengpa kotpi phunga atouvin ahi.
target: Moreover, at Daniel’s request the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego administrators over the province of Babylon, while Daniel himself remained at the royal court.

source: Nebuchadnezzar lengpan sana milim khat asemin, hichu tong somgup asangin, chule availam chu tong gup ahi. Aman hichu Babylon gamkai sunga Dura phaichama chun atungdoh-in ahi.
target: King Nebuchadnezzar made an image of gold, sixty cubits high and six cubits wide, and set it up on the plain of Dura in the province of Babylon.

source: Chujouvin Nebuchadnezzar lengpan pipuiho, gamvaipoho, chule gal lamkaiho, thutan ho, gouchingho, thumopthem ho, kho vesuiho, chule gamsungho-a thunei ho jouse chu khopkhoma, Nebuchadnezzar lengpan atundoh milim thensona-a hunglha cheh dingin thu athot tai.
target: He then summoned the satraps, prefects, governors, advisers, treasurers, judges, magistrates and all the other provincial officials to come to the dedication of the image he had set up.

source: Hitichun pipuiho, gamvaipoho, chule gal lamkaiho, thutan ho, gouchingho, thumopthem ho, kho vesuiho, chule gamsungho-a thunei ho jouse chu Nebuchadnezzar lengpan atundoh milim thensona-a ding chun khopkhomin ahung um taovin; chule Nebuchadnezzar'in atundoh milim maija chun adingun ahi.
target: So the satraps, prefects, governors, advisers, treasurers, judges, magistrates and all the other provincial officials assembled for the dedication of the image that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up, and they stood before it.

source: Chujouvin khosam khatnin gingtah-in ahinsamin, Vo mipiteho, namtin, chule paotin paotangho, hichehi naheng uva thupeh ahi.
target: Then the herald loudly proclaimed, “Nations and peoples of every language, this is what you are commanded to do:

source: Hitia chu nanghon sumkon binei, theile, selangdah, sumkonsao, tumging, chule agingthei jouse gin najah phatnule, nabohkhup uva Nebuchadnezzar lengpan atundoh milimhi nahou dingu ahi.
target: As soon as you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe and all kinds of music, you must fall down and worship the image of gold that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.

source: Chule koihile bohkhupma hou louva chu chuche nidan mama chu meilhum sunga kiseplut ding ahi, ati.
target: Whoever does not fall down and worship will immediately be thrown into a blazing furnace.”

source: Hijeh chun mipi ho jouse chun sumkon binei, theile, selangdah, sumkonsao, tumging, chule agingthei jouse gin ajah jah-un, mipi ho jouse, namtin, chule paotin paotangho chu aboh khupmun, chule Nebuchadnezzar lengpan atundoh sana milim chu ahou taovin ahi.
target: Therefore, as soon as they heard the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp and all kinds of music, all the nations and peoples of every language fell down and worshiped the image of gold that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

source: Chuti ahin chuche pettah chun Chaldea mi phabep ahung naijun, chule Judah miho chu ahung hehseuvin ahi.
target: At this time some astrologers came forward and denounced the Jews.

source: Amahon Nebuchadnezzar lengpa henga, Vo lengpa, hingjingin.
target: They said to King Nebuchadnezzar, “May the king live forever!

source: Vo lengpa, nangman mitinin sumkon, theile, selangdah, sumkonsao, tumging, chule agingthei jouse gin ajah tengule bohkhup cheh uva, chule sana milim chu ahou diuvin thupeh nanapen ahi.
target: Your Majesty has issued a decree that everyone who hears the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe and all kinds of music must fall down and worship the image of gold,

source: Chule koihile bohkhupma houlou chan chu meilhum deujeju sunga kiseplut ding ahi, natin ahi.
target: and that whoever does not fall down and worship will be thrown into a blazing furnace.

source: Nangman Judah mi phabep Babylon gamkai sunga vaipo-a natun aumun, amaho chu Shadrach, Meshach chule Abednego ahiuvin; vo lengpa, hiche miho hin nangma nahsah-in nanei pouvin ahi. Amahon nangma pathen ho ajen pouvin, chule nangman natundoh sana milim jong ahou pouvin ahi, atiuve.
target: But there are some Jews whom you have set over the affairs of the province of Babylon—Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego—who pay no attention to you, Your Majesty. They neither serve your gods nor worship the image of gold you have set up.”

source: Chuin Nebuchadnezzar'in lungsatah le lunghang tah-in, Shadrach, Meshach chule Abednego ahinpui diuvin thupeh aneitai. Chuin amahon hiche miho chu lengpa anga ahinpui taovin ahi.
target: Furious with rage, Nebuchadnezzar summoned Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego. So these men were brought before the king,

source: Nebuchadnezzar'in ahenguva, Vo Shadrach, Meshach chule Abednego, nanghon keima pathen ho najen pouvin, chule keiman katundoh sana milim jong nahou pouve, kitihi tahbeh ham?
target: and Nebuchadnezzar said to them, “Is it true, Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, that you do not serve my gods or worship the image of gold I have set up?

source: Tu-a hi nanghon sumkon binei, theile, selangdah, sumkonsao, tumging, chule agingthei jouse gin najah phatnule nabohkhup uva chule keiman katundoh milim chu hou dinga kigosa um nahi vangule, aphai: ahinla nanghon nahou louvule vang, apetpetna nangho meilhum deujeju sunga kiseplut ding nahiuvin; chule kakhut teni-a kona nahuhdoh thei diu Pathen chu koi ham? tin aseitan ahi.
target: Now when you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe and all kinds of music, if you are ready to fall down and worship the image I made, very good. But if you do not worship it, you will be thrown immediately into a blazing furnace. Then what god will be able to rescue you from my hand?”

source: Shadrach, Meshach chule Abednego'n lengpa adonbutnun, ajah-a, Vo Nebuchadnezzar hiche thua hin keihon nangma donbut ding ngaikhoh kasapouve.
target: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego replied to him, “King Nebuchadnezzar, we do not need to defend ourselves before you in this matter.

source: Hitichu ahi tah-a ahi jongle, Vo lengpa, kajenpao keiho Pathen hin keiho meilhum deujejua kona eihuhdoh theiju ahin, chule nangma khutna kona jong eihuhdoh dingu ahi.
target: If we are thrown into the blazing furnace, the God we serve is able to deliver us from it, and he will deliver us from Your Majesty’s hand.

source: Ahinla achutilou jongle, Vo lengpa nangman hichehi he-in, keihon nangma pathen ho kajenlou diu, chule nangman natundoh sana milim jong kahoulou dingu ahi, atiuve.
target: But even if he does not, we want you to know, Your Majesty, that we will not serve your gods or worship the image of gold you have set up.”

source: Chutahchun Nebuchadnezzar chu lungsatnan adimtan, chule Shadrach, Meshach, chule Abednego dounan amel akikhel jengtai. Hijeh chun aman meilhum chu asatdan ajat sagi-a sajo-a satsah bena dingin thu apetai.
target: Then Nebuchadnezzar was furious with Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, and his attitude toward them changed. He ordered the furnace heated seven times hotter than usual

source: Chuin aman agalsat miho lah-a hatdang lhadeh ho chun Shadrach, Meshach, chule Abednego akantumuva, chule meilhum deujeju sunga alelut diuvin thu apetai.
target: and commanded some of the strongest soldiers in his army to tie up Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego and throw them into the blazing furnace.

source: Chuin hiche miho chu asangkholchol hou, asangkhol sungnung, alukhuhhou, chule avonu adang dangin akantumun, meilhum deujeju sunga chun aseplut taovin ahi.
target: So these men, wearing their robes, trousers, turbans and other clothes, were bound and thrown into the blazing furnace.

source: Hitichun Lengpa thupeh chu mangang tah ahi jehle, lhum chu asat behseh jeh-in, chuche meikong chun Shadrach, Meshach, chule Abednego seplutna miho chu akalihtan ahi.
target: The king’s command was so urgent and the furnace so hot that the flames of the fire killed the soldiers who took up Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego,

source: Chule hiche pasal thumho Shadrach, Meshach, chule Abednego chu, meilhum deujeju lailunga chun kantum san alhalut taove.
target: and these three men, firmly tied, fell into the blazing furnace.

source: Chujou chun Nebuchadnezzar lengpan kidang asan, gangtah-in akipatdoh-in, chule athumop themho henga chun, Eihon meilhum sunga chu pasal thum ikantum uva iselutnu hilou ham? ati. Amahon adonbutnun, lengpa jah-a, Ahinai lengpa, atiuve.
target: Then King Nebuchadnezzar leaped to his feet in amazement and asked his advisers, “Weren’t there three men that we tied up and threw into the fire?” They replied, “Certainly, Your Majesty.”

source: Aman adonbutnin, Veuvin keiman pasal li kilhamlha-a mei lailunga avaleu kamun, chule amaho ima ati pouve; chule ali channapa lim khu Pathen chapa abangin ahi, ati.
target: He said, “Look! I see four men walking around in the fire, unbound and unharmed, and the fourth looks like a son of the gods.”

source: Chujouvin Nebuchadnezzar chu meilhum deujeju kot koma chun ahungin, ajah uva, Nangho chungnung pen Pathen sohte, Shadrach, Meshach chule Abednego, hungdoh-un, chule hilama hungun, ati. Chuin Shadrach, Meshach chule Abednego chu mei lailunga konin ahungpotdoh taove.
target: Nebuchadnezzar then approached the opening of the blazing furnace and shouted, “Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, servants of the Most High God, come out! Come here!” So Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego came out of the fire,

source: Chuin pipuiho, gamvaipoho, gal lamkai, chule lengpa thumopthem ho, khopkhoma umho chun hiche pasal ho meikouvin atahsao chunga tha aneijou lou, asamu jang khat jengjong kinlouva, asangkholhou jong kikhel dehlou, chule meikhu gim himhim jong achunguva anamlou chu amutaove.
target: and the satraps, prefects, governors and royal advisers crowded around them. They saw that the fire had not harmed their bodies, nor was a hair of their heads singed; their robes were not scorched, and there was no smell of fire on them.

source: Chuin Nebuchadnezzar'in hitin aseitai, Avantil ahinsola, ama tahsan-ah asohte ahuhdoh-a Shadrach, Meshach chule Abednego Pathen chu nunnom hen: amahon amaho Pathen tailou pathen adang anei loudiu le ahoulouna dinguvin lengpa thupeh jengjong apalkeh-un, atahsao apedoh jengun ahi.
target: Then Nebuchadnezzar said, “Praise be to the God of Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, who has sent his angel and rescued his servants! They trusted in him and defied the king’s command and were willing to give up their lives rather than serve or worship any god except their own God.

source: Hijeh-a chu keiman thupeh kapeh ahi, amitakip, namtin, chule paotin paotangin Shadrach, Meshach chule Abednego Pathen douna-a seikhel khat neija chu, ahal hala kichenna, chule a-inhou jong chu eh kholna kiso ding ahi. Ajehchu hitobanga huhdoh jou Pathen adang aumpon ahi, ati.
target: Therefore I decree that the people of any nation or language who say anything against the God of Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego be cut into pieces and their houses be turned into piles of rubble, for no other god can save in this way.”

source: Chujouvin lengpan Shadrach, Meshach, chule Abednego chu Babylon gam sunga chun atohmunu adomsangtan ahi.
target: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the province of Babylon.

source: Nebuchadnezzar lengpan, Mipi, namtinho, chule paotin paotang, leiset pumpi sunga chengho henga; nachung uva lungmona punghen.
target: King Nebuchadnezzar, To the nations and peoples of every language, who live in all the earth: May you prosper greatly!

source: Chungnung pen Pathen'in kachunga melchihna le thilkidang atohdohho phondoh ding pha dingin kagelin ahi.
target: It is my pleasure to tell you about the miraculous signs and wonders that the Most High God has performed for me.

source: Amelchihnaho iti loupia hitam! chule athilbol kidangho itobanga thaneija hitam! alenggam chu tonsot lenggam ahin, chule avaihomna chu akhang akhanga umjing ahi.
target: How great are his signs, how mighty his wonders! His kingdom is an eternal kingdom; his dominion endures from generation to generation.

source: Keima Nebuchadnezzar hi ka-in sunga kakicholdon, chule kaleng inpia sunga khangtou tah-in kaumin ahi.
target: I, Nebuchadnezzar, was at home in my palace, contented and prosperous.

source: Keiman mang khat kananeijin, hichun eikichat sah-e, chule kajalkhun chunga kalunggelho le kathilmu chun eilungkham sah lheh-in ahi.
target: I had a dream that made me afraid. As I was lying in bed, the images and visions that passed through my mind terrified me.

source: Hijeh chun keiman ka-anga Babylon michingho jouse puilutna aumuva, amahon kamang ledohna eihetsah diuvin thupeh khat kaneitai.
target: So I commanded that all the wise men of Babylon be brought before me to interpret the dream for me.

source: Hichun mitpheldoi themho, ahsi lekhathem ho, Chaldea miho, chule khonung thusei ho ahunguvin: keiman amaho anga kamang chu kanaseijin, ahinla amahon kamang aledohna chu eihetsah thei pouve.
target: When the magicians, enchanters, astrologers and diviners came, I told them the dream, but they could not interpret it for me.

source: Ahinla akhonna-in Daniel keima anga ahunglutnin, ama min chu ka-pathen min dungjuijin Belteshazzar kisah ahin, chule ama-a hi pathen thengho lhagao chu uma ahin; chule ama anga keiman kamang chu kaseijin,
target: Finally, Daniel came into my presence and I told him the dream. (He is called Belteshazzar, after the name of my god, and the spirit of the holy gods is in him.)

source: Vo Belteshazzar, mitpheldoi themho pipui, keiman nangma-ah pathen thengho lhagao aume, chule thuguh imachan nangma nasulung jingpoi ti kahet jeh-in, kamanga kathilmuho chule hiche aledohna chu keima neisei peh-in kati ahi.
target: I said, “Belteshazzar, chief of the magicians, I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you, and no mystery is too difficult for you. Here is my dream; interpret it for me.

source: Hicheho hi kajalkhuna mu kananeiho chu ahi; Keiman leiset lailung tah-a thingphung khat kanamun, chule asanlam chu asang tangei jenge.
target: These are the visions I saw while lying in bed: I looked, and there before me stood a tree in the middle of the land. Its height was enormous.

source: Thingphung chu ahung khangin, ahung det lheh-in; chule asan chu van aphan, leiset mong jouse-a konin hichu akimu phan ahi.
target: The tree grew large and strong and its top touched the sky; it was visible to the ends of the earth.

source: Ado ho chu ahoijin, chule aga atam lheh-in, chule hichu ahingthei jouse dinga an ahi: gama saho alim noija aumun, chule chungleng vachaho abahho-a achengun, chule tahsa hing jouse hichea kon chun khoukhah-in anaumin ahi.
target: Its leaves were beautiful, its fruit abundant, and on it was food for all. Under it the wild animals found shelter, and the birds lived in its branches; from it every creature was fed.

source: Keiman kajalkhuna kalupma mu kanei chun, veuvin, angahpa, mitheng khat van'a kona hungkumlha kanamun;
target: “In the visions I saw while lying in bed, I looked, and there before me was a holy one, a messenger, coming down from heaven.

source: Ama chun gingtah-in asamin, thingphung chu phuhlhu uvin, chule abahho jong tanbongun; anaho malngim un, chule aga chu thecheh-un: anoija konchun gamsaho chu chedoh uhen, chule abahho-a konin vachaho chu lengdoh uhen.
target: He called in a loud voice: ‘Cut down the tree and trim off its branches; strip off its leaves and scatter its fruit. Let the animals flee from under it and the birds from its branches.

source: Hijengjongle abul le ajung chu leija thihle sum-eng khaovin kanunlang, gamlah-a hamdongho lah-a dalhauvin; chule hichu van daituijin chapkot hen, chule ama chan chu hampa lah-a saho chan toh umtha hen.
target: But let the stump and its roots, bound with iron and bronze, remain in the ground, in the grass of the field. “ ‘Let him be drenched with the dew of heaven, and let him live with the animals among the plants of the earth.

source: Alungthim chu mihem lungthima konin kikhel henlang, sahem lungthim kipehen: chule achung chu phat sagin lhunkhum hen.
target: Let his mind be changed from that of a man and let him be given the mind of an animal, till seven times pass by for him.

source: Hiche thuhi angahho thupeh jal leh, mithengho thun angehkhoh jal ahi: mihemte lenggam sunga hin Chungnung pennin vai ahomin, chule hichu koihile alung lhainapa chu apen, chule mihemte lah-a anoinungpen jong chu hiche chunga chun atungdohjin ahi, ti mihing hon ahet theina dinguva kibol ahi.
target: “ ‘The decision is announced by messengers, the holy ones declare the verdict, so that the living may know that the Most High is sovereign over all kingdoms on earth and gives them to anyone he wishes and sets over them the lowliest of people.’

source: Hiche manghi keima lengpa Nebuchadnezzar'in kanamat ahi. Tun nangma, Vo Belteshazzar, aledohna phongdoh-in, kalenggam sunga michingho jousen aledohna keima eihetsah jou pouve: amavang nangman naledoh theiding ahi; ajehchu nangma-a pathen thengho lhagao aumin ahi.
target: “This is the dream that I, King Nebuchadnezzar, had. Now, Belteshazzar, tell me what it means, for none of the wise men in my kingdom can interpret it for me. But you can, because the spirit of the holy gods is in you.”

source: Hichun Belteshazzar kitipa Daniel chu nidan khat jen kidang satah-in aumin, chule aluggel chun asulung gimin ahi. Hichun lengpan, Belteshazzar, mang le aledohna chun nasulunggim hihhen, tin aseije. Belteshazzar'in adonbutnin, Ka pakai mang hi nahot te-a hihen, chule aledohna jonghi namelmate ho-a ding hijo hileh!
