target: Then Daniel (also called Belteshazzar) was greatly perplexed for a time, and his thoughts terrified him. So the king said, “Belteshazzar, do not let the dream or its meaning alarm you.” Belteshazzar answered, “My lord, if only the dream applied to your enemies and its meaning to your adversaries!

source: Thingphung nanamu-a, khang cheh cheh, hung kiphutdet, asan van gei phajeng, chule kolmong geija kimupha;
target: The tree you saw, which grew large and strong, with its top touching the sky, visible to the whole earth,

source: Chuche thingdo hoisel ho, ga tamtah nei, chua ahingthei jouse dinga an aumna, anoija gamsaho achen na, chule abahho-a chungleng vachaho achen nachu:
target: with beautiful leaves and abundant fruit, providing food for all, giving shelter to the wild animals, and having nesting places in its branches for the birds—

source: Vo lengpa, hiche hung khang cheh cheh-a chule kiphut detna chu nangma nahi. Ajehchu naletna ahung khangin, chule van aphan, chule navaihom nan leiset mong aphatan ahi.
target: Your Majesty, you are that tree! You have become great and strong; your greatness has grown until it reaches the sky, and your dominion extends to distant parts of the earth.

source: Chule lengpan angah-a mitheng khat van'a kona ahung nanamu-a, Thingphung chu phuhlhu uvin, chule sumangun, ahinla leija abul chu thihle sum-eng khaovin kanun lang, gamlah-a hamnou lah-a dalhauvin, chule hichu van'a daitwi chapkotnin umhen lang, chule achung chu phat sagin alhunkhum masangsen, ama chan chu gamlah-a saho chan hithahen, tia asei chu ahile,
target: “Your Majesty saw a holy one, a messenger, coming down from heaven and saying, ‘Cut down the tree and destroy it, but leave the stump, bound with iron and bronze, in the grass of the field, while its roots remain in the ground. Let him be drenched with the dew of heaven; let him live with the wild animals, until seven times pass by for him.’

source: Hichehi aledohna ahi, Vo lengpa, hichehi chungnung pen thupeh, ka lengpa pakai chunga hunglhung thupeh chu ahi.
target: “This is the interpretation, Your Majesty, and this is the decree the Most High has issued against my lord the king:

source: Hitia chu amahon nangma mihem lah-a kona nadel mang dingu, chule nachenna mun chu gamlah-a gamsaho toh hitha ding, chule amahon bongchalho banga nangma hampa nanehsah dingu, chule amahon nangma van daitwija nasuhchet dingu, chule hiti achu nachunga phat sagi lhungding; nangman chungnung penin mihemte lenggama vai ahomin, chule hichu aman apehnompa chu apen ahi ti nahet masangse-a chuti ding ahi.
target: You will be driven away from people and will live with the wild animals; you will eat grass like the ox and be drenched with the dew of heaven. Seven times will pass by for you until you acknowledge that the Most High is sovereign over all kingdoms on earth and gives them to anyone he wishes.

source: Chule amahon hiche thingbul chu hoidenun tia athupeh chu, vanhon vai ahomna aneijui ti nahetdoh jou tengle nalenggam chu nangma-a hikit tei ding ahi.
target: The command to leave the stump of the tree with its roots means that your kingdom will be restored to you when you acknowledge that Heaven rules.

source: Hijeh chun, Vo lengpa, kathumop nahi nangma dingin santhei hihen; chonphat na-in nachonset naho subeijin, chule vaichate hepina-in nakhan gitlou naho subeijin. Chuti henlang hile nalung olna suhsaova umthei maithei ahi, ati.
target: Therefore, Your Majesty, be pleased to accept my advice: Renounce your sins by doing what is right, and your wickedness by being kind to the oppressed. It may be that then your prosperity will continue.”

source: Hicheho jousehi leng Nebuchadnezzar chunga ahung lhungtan ahi.
target: All this happened to King Nebuchadnezzar.

source: Lha somle lhani ahung kichaijin ama Babylon lenggam leng inpia avahlen ahi.
target: Twelve months later, as the king was walking on the roof of the royal palace of Babylon,

source: Lengpan thu aseijin, Hiche Babylon loupitah hi, kalenggam in dinga keiman kathahat kathaneina-a, chule kalalna hi jabola aumna dinga kasahdoh hilouham? ati.
target: he said, “Is not this the great Babylon I have built as the royal residence, by my mighty power and for the glory of my majesty?”

source: Lengpan thu asei nalaijin, van'a konin aw khat ahung gingin, Vo Nebuchadnezzar lengpa, hichehi nangma henga kisei ahi; lenggam hi nangma-a kona kitol manga ahitai.
target: Even as the words were on his lips, a voice came from heaven, “This is what is decreed for you, King Nebuchadnezzar: Your royal authority has been taken from you.

source: Chule amahon nangma miho lah-a kona nadeldoh dingu, chule nachenna chu gamsaho lah hiding, amahon bongchalho banga nangma hampa nanehsah dingu, chule mihemho lenggam-ah Chungnung penin vai ahomin, chule hichu aman apehnompa chu koihile apejie, ti nahet tokahse-a phat sagi nachunga lhung ding ahi, ati.
target: You will be driven away from people and will live with the wild animals; you will eat grass like the ox. Seven times will pass by for you until you acknowledge that the Most High is sovereign over all kingdoms on earth and gives them to anyone he wishes.”

source: Hiche nidan mama chun hichu Nebuchadnezzar chunga aguilhungin ahi. Chule ama chu mihem lah-a konin delmangin aumin, chule bongchalho bangin hampa anen, chule amulho muvanlai mul abah-a, chule atinho vachaho tin banga akhan geijin, atahsa chu van'a daitwi suhchetnin aumtan ahi.
target: Immediately what had been said about Nebuchadnezzar was fulfilled. He was driven away from people and ate grass like the ox. His body was drenched with the dew of heaven until his hair grew like the feathers of an eagle and his nails like the claws of a bird.

source: Chuin nikhoho chu ahungbei phatnin, keima Nebuchadnezzar van lama kakhodah-in, chule kahetthem theina chu keima-a ahung kilekit tan, keiman chungnung pen chu kathangvah-in, chule keiman a-imatih chana hingjing, alengvai homna tonsotna lengvai homna hia, chule alenggam chu akhang akhanga hijingpa chu kavah choijin, jana kapen ahi.
target: At the end of that time, I, Nebuchadnezzar, raised my eyes toward heaven, and my sanity was restored. Then I praised the Most High; I honored and glorified him who lives forever. His dominion is an eternal dominion; his kingdom endures from generation to generation.

source: Chule leisetna chengho jouse chu imacha hilouva sim ahiuvin; Chule aman van'a galsat miho lahle, leisetna chengho lah-a alung deilam abolin: chule koimachan ama khut akhamtang joupon, chule ama henga, ipi nabol ham? jong ati theipon ahi.
target: All the peoples of the earth are regarded as nothing. He does as he pleases with the powers of heaven and the peoples of the earth. No one can hold back his hand or say to him: “What have you done?”

source: Hiche phat mama chun kalunggel theina chu kahenga ahung kilekitnin, chule kalenggam loupina dingin, jabol kahinale kaloupina chu kahenga ahung kilekitnin: chule kathumop themho le kapipui hon keima eihung holdoh-un; chule nasatah-a jabolna chu keima-a eikibe peh-in ahi.
target: At the same time that my sanity was restored, my honor and splendor were returned to me for the glory of my kingdom. My advisers and nobles sought me out, and I was restored to my throne and became even greater than before.

source: Tunvang keima Nebuchadnezzar'in van lengpa chu kavah choijin, kachoisangin, chule jana kapetai, Ama natoh jouse thutah ahin, chule alampiho jouse thudih ahi. Chule koihile kiletsahna-a kalsongho chu, aman asunem theijin ahi.
target: Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and exalt and glorify the King of heaven, because everything he does is right and all his ways are just. And those who walk in pride he is able to humble.

source: Belshazzar lengpan semang sangkhat ho din golvah lentah khat anabolin, chule chuche sangkhat maija chun ju adonin ahi.
target: King Belshazzar gave a great banquet for a thousand of his nobles and drank wine with them.

source: Belshazzar'in ju atep pumchun, apa Nebuchadnezzar'in Jerusalem houin'a kona anapohdoh sana le dangka khonho chu; lengpa, chule apipuiho, a-inneipiho, chule athaikemhon ju adonna diuva agalahdoh diuvin thu apetan ahi.
target: While Belshazzar was drinking his wine, he gave orders to bring in the gold and silver goblets that Nebuchadnezzar his father had taken from the temple in Jerusalem, so that the king and his nobles, his wives and his concubines might drink from them.

source: Chuin amahon Jerusalem'a um Pathen houin'a kona anakiladoh sana khonho chu ahinpodoh taovin; chule hicheho-a chun lengpa, chule apipuiho, ajite le athaikemho chun ju adon taovin ahi.
target: So they brought in the gold goblets that had been taken from the temple of God in Jerusalem, and the king and his nobles, his wives and his concubines drank from them.

source: Amahon ju adonun, chule sana, dangka, sum-eng, thih, thing chule songa kisem pathenho chu avahchoi taovin ahi.
target: As they drank the wine, they praised the gods of gold and silver, of bronze, iron, wood and stone.

source: Hiche pettah chun mihem khutjungho ahung kilah-in, lengpa inpi bang kiloijol meivah gahsalna laitah chu ahin jihtan; chule lengpan bang hin jih-a khut keuseh chu amutan ahi.
target: Suddenly the fingers of a human hand appeared and wrote on the plaster of the wall, near the lampstand in the royal palace. The king watched the hand as it wrote.

source: Chuin lengpa maiso akikhel jengtan, chule alung gimlheh jengtan ahile, akong kisuhtonaho akilong gamin, chule akhup teni khatle khat akitatto jengtan ahi.
target: His face turned pale and he was so frightened that his legs became weak and his knees were knocking.

source: Lengpan ahsi lekhathem ho, Chaldea miho, chule khonung thuseidoh ho chu ahinpuilut nadiuvin awging tah-in asamtan ahi. Chule lengpan thu aseijin, Babylon michingho jah-a chu, koihile hiche akijih simdoh-a, chule aledohna eivetsah theija chu, ponsandupma kivon ding, chule angonga sana vui ki o-peh ding, chule lenggam sunga thunei thum channa-a kipansah ding ahi, ati.
target: The king summoned the enchanters, astrologers and diviners. Then he said to these wise men of Babylon, “Whoever reads this writing and tells me what it means will be clothed in purple and have a gold chain placed around his neck, and he will be made the third highest ruler in the kingdom.”

source: Chuin lengpa michingho jouse chu ahunglut taove. Ahinla amahon akijih chu asimdohthei pouvin, chule aledohna jong lengpa ahetsah thei tapouvin ahi.
target: Then all the king’s wise men came in, but they could not read the writing or tell the king what it meant.

source: Hichun Belshazzar lengpa chu hatah-in alungkham chehtan, ama-a chun amaiso akikhehtan, chule asemanghon kidang asataovin ahi.
target: So King Belshazzar became even more terrified and his face grew more pale. His nobles were baffled.

source: Tun lengnu chu lengpa le asemangho thusei ho jeh-in golvah insunga ahunglutnin, chuin lengnun hitin aseije; Vo lengpa, hing jingin: nalunggel ho chun nangma nagimsah hihhen, chule namaiso jong kikhelsah hih-in:
target: The queen, hearing the voices of the king and his nobles, came into the banquet hall. “May the king live forever!” she said. “Don’t be alarmed! Don’t look so pale!

source: Nalenggam sunga hin pathen thengho lhagaoho umna pasal khat aumin ahi. Chule napa nikho laijin ama-a chun pathenho chihna tobang, salvahna, hetthem theina, chule chihna akimudoh-in; kaseipeh nahi, amachu Nebuchadnezzar lengpa, napa lengpa chun mitpheldoi choiho, ahsi lekhathem ho, Chaldea miho chule khonung thusei ho pipuija anapansah ahi.
target: There is a man in your kingdom who has the spirit of the holy gods in him. In the time of your father he was found to have insight and intelligence and wisdom like that of the gods. Your father, King Nebuchadnezzar, appointed him chief of the magicians, enchanters, astrologers and diviners.

source: Ajehchu lhagao kidangtah, hetna, hetthem theina, mangho ledohna, thulhuh hahtahho mudohsahna, chule lung opkai naho suhbeina chu, lengpan amin Belteshazzar anasah Daniel'a chun ana kimudoh-in ahi: tun Daniel chu kousah-in, chule aman aledohna navetsah ding ahi, ati.
target: He did this because Daniel, whom the king called Belteshazzar, was found to have a keen mind and knowledge and understanding, and also the ability to interpret dreams, explain riddles and solve difficult problems. Call for Daniel, and he will tell you what the writing means.”

source: Chuin Daniel chu lengpa anga puilutnin aumtai. Chuin lengpan Daniel henga aseijin, Judah gama kona kapan ahinpuidoh, Judah sohchangho chate lah-a Daniel kiti chu nangma nahim?
target: So Daniel was brought before the king, and the king said to him, “Are you Daniel, one of the exiles my father the king brought from Judah?

source: Keima nangma-a pathenho lhagao nangma-a aumin, vah le hetthem theina chule chihna nasatah nangma-a akimue, ti kanajan ahi.
target: I have heard that the spirit of the gods is in you and that you have insight, intelligence and outstanding wisdom.

source: Chule tutah chun michingho le ahsi lekhathem ho chu hiche akijih simdoh dingle, aledohna keima eihetsah dingin ka-angsunga ahung kipuilut un; ahinla amahon hiche thil ledohna chu avetsah thei pouve.
target: The wise men and enchanters were brought before me to read this writing and tell me what it means, but they could not explain it.

source: Chule nangman ledohnaho nabol theijin, chule lung opkai naho jong nasubei theije, ti nachung chang thu keiman kanajan ahi. Tun nangman hiche akijihhi nasimdoh theija, chule hiche aledohna chu neihetsah theija ahile, nangma ponsandup naki silpeh ding, nangonga sana khivui naki-o pehding, chule lenggam sunga thunei thum na-a nakipansah ding ahi, ati.
target: Now I have heard that you are able to give interpretations and to solve difficult problems. If you can read this writing and tell me what it means, you will be clothed in purple and have a gold chain placed around your neck, and you will be made the third highest ruler in the kingdom.”

source: Chujouvin Daniel'in lengpa adonbutnin, lengpa angsunga hitin aseije, Nathilpeh ho chu nangma-a hihen, chule nakipaman ho chu midang khat pejon; hijeng jongle lengpa henga keiman akijih chu kasimdoh ding, chule akoma aledohna kahetsah ding ahi.
target: Then Daniel answered the king, “You may keep your gifts for yourself and give your rewards to someone else. Nevertheless, I will read the writing for the king and tell him what it means.

source: Vo nangma lengpa, Chungnung pen Pathen'in napa Nebuchadnezzar chu lenggam, lalna, loupina, chule jana anapen ahi.
target: “Your Majesty, the Most High God gave your father Nebuchadnezzar sovereignty and greatness and glory and splendor.

source: Chule aman lalna anapeh jalchun, mipi ho, namtin, chule paotin paotang jouse amasanga anakithing thingun, chule anakichauvin ahi. Aman athanom athatnin, chule ahinghoinom ahinghoijin, chule atundoh nom atungdoh-in, chule asuhlhuh nom asulhun ahi.
target: Because of the high position he gave him, all the nations and peoples of every language dreaded and feared him. Those the king wanted to put to death, he put to death; those he wanted to spare, he spared; those he wanted to promote, he promoted; and those he wanted to humble, he humbled.

source: Ahivangin ama alungsung ahung kichoi sanga, chule kiletsahna-in alungthim atahsah phatnin, ama aleng laltouna-a konin sotlhah-in ana umin, chule amahon ama-a konchun loupina ana lahdoh peh-un ahi.
target: But when his heart became arrogant and hardened with pride, he was deposed from his royal throne and stripped of his glory.

source: Chule ama chu mihem chate lah-a konin deldoh-in ana umin; chule ama lungthim chu gamsaho lungthim tobangin akisemtan, chule achenna jong gam sanganho chenna chu anahi. Chule Chungnung pen Pathen'in mihem lenggam chunga hin vai ahomin, chule aman koi hile alunggot chanchu chuche chunga thunei dingchun atungdohjin ahi ti ahetdoh kahsen, amahon ama chu bongchalho bangin hampan avah-un, atahsa chu van'a kon daitwi suhchetnin aumin ahi.
target: He was driven away from people and given the mind of an animal; he lived with the wild donkeys and ate grass like the ox; and his body was drenched with the dew of heaven, until he acknowledged that the Most High God is sovereign over all kingdoms on earth and sets over them anyone he wishes.

source: Chule achapa, vo Belshazzar, nangman hitiho jousehi nahet jeng vangin, nalungsung nasunempoi;
target: “But you, Belshazzar, his son, have not humbled yourself, though you knew all this.

source: Nangma van Pakai dounan nakichoi sangin, chule amahon Pathen in'a khonho chu namasanga ahinchoijun, hicheho-a chun nangma le nasemangho, najite le nathaikem hon jun adonun; chule nangman khomulou, khojalou, chule, khohelou, dangka, sana, sum-eng, thih, thing, chule song pathen ho chu navahchoi jin: chule nahaina hu akhutna choipa, chule nalampi jouse neipa Pathen chu loupina napepon ahi.
target: Instead, you have set yourself up against the Lord of heaven. You had the goblets from his temple brought to you, and you and your nobles, your wives and your concubines drank wine from them. You praised the gods of silver and gold, of bronze, iron, wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or understand. But you did not honor the God who holds in his hand your life and all your ways.

source: Chuin Pathen'a konin khut khat ahung kisolin, chule akijihhi ahinjih-in ahi.
target: Therefore he sent the hand that wrote the inscription.

source: Chule hiche hi akijih ahung kisundoh chu ahi, MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.
target: “This is the inscription that was written: mene, mene, tekel, parsin

source: Hichehi athil ledohna ahi: MENE; Pathen'in nalenggam chu asimin, chule akichai sahtai.
target: “Here is what these words mean: Mene : God has numbered the days of your reign and brought it to an end.

source: TEKEL; khaikot ho-a nangma nakilep in, nalhahsamna akimudoh tai.
target: Tekel : You have been weighed on the scales and found wanting.

source: PERES; nalenggam akihom khenin, chule Medes te leh Persia te akipetai, ati.
target: Peres : Your kingdom is divided and given to the Medes and Persians.”

source: Hichun Belshazzar'in thupeh apen, chule amahon Daniel chu ponsandup asilpeh-un, chule sana khivui angonga a-opeh-un, chule ama chu lenggam chunga chu thunei thumna hiding ahi tin ama chungchang chu aphongjal taovin ahi.
target: Then at Belshazzar’s command, Daniel was clothed in purple, a gold chain was placed around his neck, and he was proclaimed the third highest ruler in the kingdom.

source: Hiche jan tahchun Chaldea mite lengpa Belshazzar chu akithat tai.
target: That very night Belshazzar, king of the Babylonians, was slain,

source: Chule Media mi Darius chun kum somgup le kumni vel ahi-in lenggam chu alatai.
target: and Darius the Mede took over the kingdom, at the age of sixty-two.

source: Darius'in lenggam pumpi hopsoh-a, lenggam chunga chu pipui jakhatle somni koiding pha asan ahi.
target: It pleased Darius to appoint 120 satraps to rule throughout the kingdom,

source: Lengpa chun kisuhmona aneilouna dingle, pipuiho chun suhtohna apeh theina dingun, hicheho chunga chun vaipipo thum akoijin, amaho lah-a chun Daniel hi akhatna ahi.
target: with three administrators over them, one of whom was Daniel. The satraps were made accountable to them so that the king might not suffer loss.

source: Chuin ama-a chu Pakai lhagao dihtah aum jeh-in, hiche Daniel hi vaipipo hole pipuiho jouse chunga deitumin ahung umtan; chule lengpan ama chu gam pumpi chunga tundoh ding tia agel ahi.
target: Now Daniel so distinguished himself among the administrators and the satraps by his exceptional qualities that the king planned to set him over the whole kingdom.

source: Chuphatnin vaipipo hole pipuiho chun lenggam chungchanga Daniel themona mudohna dingin agomkom aholtauvin; ahinla amahon phat gomkomle amona amujou pouve; ajehchu ama tahsan umtah ahin, suhkhel le mona jong ama-a akimulou ahi.
target: At this, the administrators and the satraps tried to find grounds for charges against Daniel in his conduct of government affairs, but they were unable to do so. They could find no corruption in him, because he was trustworthy and neither corrupt nor negligent.

source: Chuin hiche miho hin, a-Pathen danthu chungchanga ama douna-a athemmo nading imulou ngalule, eihon Daniel douna-a athemona imulou dingu ahi, atiuve.
target: Finally these men said, “We will never find any basis for charges against this man Daniel unless it has something to do with the law of his God.”

source: Chuin hiche vaipipo hole pipu ho chengse chu lengpa henga ahung kikhomun, chule ahenga hitin aseijuve, Darius lengpa, hing jingin.
target: So these administrators and satraps went as a group to the king and said: “May King Darius live forever!

source: Lenggam sunga vaipipo ho, gamvai poho, chule pipuiho, thumopthem ho, chule gal lamkai ho jousen, Vo lengpa, koihile nisomthum sunga lengpa nangma heng tailou Pathen le mihem dang henga taona neichan chu, keipi bahkai hong sunga selut jeng dingin, leng thupeh khat phudoh-a, thugahna dettah semdingin kihoukhomna kaneijun ahi.
target: The royal administrators, prefects, satraps, advisers and governors have all agreed that the king should issue an edict and enforce the decree that anyone who prays to any god or human being during the next thirty days, except to you, Your Majesty, shall be thrown into the lions’ den.

source: Tun, Vo lengpa, thupeh chu phutdoh-in, chule kikhel ngailou Mede le Persia mite thupeh dungjuija khela aum louna dingin, akijih chu soi kai khumin, atiuve.
target: Now, Your Majesty, issue the decree and put it in writing so that it cannot be altered—in accordance with the law of the Medes and Persians, which cannot be repealed.”

source: Hitichun Darius lengpan akijih le thupeh chu soi akai khum tan ahi.
target: So King Darius put the decree in writing.

source: Tun Daniel'in akijih chu soi akikai khumtai ti ahet phatnin, ama a-insunga alutnin; chule aumna indan bang kot ho chu Jerusalem lam nga-a kihong ahito lhonin, nikhatnin thumvei akhupma adilsun, ataovin, chule masanga abolji bangin, aman Pathen anga thangvahna aneijin ahi.
target: Now when Daniel learned that the decree had been published, he went home to his upstairs room where the windows opened toward Jerusalem. Three times a day he got down on his knees and prayed, giving thanks to his God, just as he had done before.

source: Chuin hiche mihem hohi ahung kikhomun, chule a-Pathen ang sunga Daniel'in taona le thumna anei chu amudoh taove.
target: Then these men went as a group and found Daniel praying and asking God for help.

source: Chuin amaho ahung naijun, chule lengpa angsunga chun lengpa thupeh chung changthu aseitaovin; Vo lengpa, nangman koihile nisomthum sunga nangma heng tailouva, Pathen le mihem dang koma taona neichan chu, keipi bahkaiho kosunga selutna umding ahi, tia na soi nakai hitalou ham? atiuve. Lengpan adonbutnin, kikhel ngailou Mede le Persia mite dan dungjuijin, akisei chu adih-e, ati.
target: So they went to the king and spoke to him about his royal decree: “Did you not publish a decree that during the next thirty days anyone who prays to any god or human being except to you, Your Majesty, would be thrown into the lions’ den?” The king answered, “The decree stands—in accordance with the law of the Medes and Persians, which cannot be repealed.”

source: Hichun amahon adonbutnun, lengpa anga chun, Vo lengpa, Judah sohchang chateho lah-a Daniel'in nangma, chule soi nakaikhum nathupeh chu nahsah-in aneipon, amavang nikhatnin thumvei taona anei jinge, atiuve.
target: Then they said to the king, “Daniel, who is one of the exiles from Judah, pays no attention to you, Your Majesty, or to the decree you put in writing. He still prays three times a day.”

source: Chuin lengpan hiche thuho hi ajah phatnin, amale ama aki oimo lheh jengin, chule Daniel huhdoh tei nading lungthim angaiton; chule nilhum kahsen ama huhdohna dingin athohgim lheh-in ahi.
target: When the king heard this, he was greatly distressed; he was determined to rescue Daniel and made every effort until sundown to save him.

source: Chuin hiche mihohi lengpa henga ahung kikhomun, lengpa henga, Vo lengpa, thupeh hile dankisun hile lengpan aphudoh chu kikhel thei lou ahi tia Mede mite le Persia miten dan anei ahi, tihi he-in, atiuve.
target: Then the men went as a group to King Darius and said to him, “Remember, Your Majesty, that according to the law of the Medes and Persians no decree or edict that the king issues can be changed.”

source: Hichun lengpan thu apen, amahon Daniel chu ahinpuijun, keipi bahkaiho hong sunga aseplut taovin ahi. Tun lengpan Daniel jah-a, Tantih neilouva najen jing na-Pathen chun nahuhdoh hen, ati.
target: So the king gave the order, and they brought Daniel and threw him into the lions’ den. The king said to Daniel, “May your God, whom you serve continually, rescue you!”

source: Chuin song khat ahin domun, keipi bahkai hongsung akama chun akoijun; Daniel chungchanga tohgon chu akikhel thei louna dingin, lengpa amatah-in akhutjema sinkhana le asemangho khutjema sinkhana chu anam khum tan ahi.
target: A stone was brought and placed over the mouth of the den, and the king sealed it with his own signet ring and with the rings of his nobles, so that Daniel’s situation might not be changed.

source: Chujouvin lengpa chu aleng inpia achen, chuche jan chu an ngolna-in amangtan; tumging thei manchah ho jong ama anga akipolut thei tapon; chule a-imu tapon ahi.
target: Then the king returned to his palace and spent the night without eating and without any entertainment being brought to him. And he could not sleep.

source: Chuin lengpa chu jingkah matah-in athoudoh-in, chule keipi bahkaiho hong sung lam jonin gangtah-in achetai.
target: At the first light of dawn, the king got up and hurried to the lions’ den.

source: Chule keipi bahkai hong chu agah phah phah-in, Daniel henga lunghemtah aw chengin agahsamin, Daniel henga, Vo Daniel, hingjing Pathen sohpa, nahinjen jing na-Pathen chun keipi bahkai ho-a kona nahuhdoh jou hinam? ati.
target: When he came near the den, he called to Daniel in an anguished voice, “Daniel, servant of the living God, has your God, whom you serve continually, been able to rescue you from the lions?”

source: Chuin Daniel'in lengpa henga, Vo lengpa, hing jingin.
target: Daniel answered, “May the king live forever!

source: Ka Pathen'in avantil ahinsolin, amahon keima eisukhah louna dingun, keipi bahkaiho kam asip peh-in ahi: Ama angsunga monabei kahi akimu bangin, vo lengpa nangma angsunga jong keiman thilse kabolpon ahi, ati.
target: My God sent his angel, and he shut the mouths of the lions. They have not hurt me, because I was found innocent in his sight. Nor have I ever done any wrong before you, Your Majesty.”

source: Hichun lengpa chu akipah tangeijin, chule Daniel chu keipi hongsunga kona agalahdoh dingun thupeh apetai. Hitichun Daniel chu keipi hongsunga kon chun aladoh-un, chule aman a-Pathen atahsan jeh-in, achunga kisuhkhahna imacha akimupoi.
target: The king was overjoyed and gave orders to lift Daniel out of the den. And when Daniel was lifted from the den, no wound was found on him, because he had trusted in his God.

source: Chuin lengpan thupeh apen, amahon Daniel hehseho chu agapuijun, amaho toh, achateu toh, chule a-inneipi teo chu keipi bahkai hongsunga aseplut taovin; chuin keipi bahkai hon amaho chunga thanei tah-in, aguho jouseu tol chuman louvin asungemsel taove.
target: At the king’s command, the men who had falsely accused Daniel were brought in and thrown into the lions’ den, along with their wives and children. And before they reached the floor of the den, the lions overpowered them and crushed all their bones.

source: Chujouvin Darius lengpan leiset pumpi-a cheng mipite, namtinho, chule paotin paotangho henga hitihin lekha ajihtan ahi; nachung uva lungmonna punghen.
target: Then King Darius wrote to all the nations and peoples of every language in all the earth: “May you prosper greatly!

source: Keiman thulhah khat kanei ahitai, kalenggam le kalalna gamsungse-a mihemte jouse Daniel Pathen anga kithing thingle ging geh-a naum dingu ahi. Ajehchu ama hingjing Pathen ahin, chule tonsotna longlou, alenggam chu suhmanga umlou ding lenggam ahin, chule alalna jong akhonna geija umjing ding ahi.
target: “I issue a decree that in every part of my kingdom people must fear and reverence the God of Daniel. “For he is the living God and he endures forever; his kingdom will not be destroyed, his dominion will never end.

source: Aman alhatdoh-in ahuhdoh-in, chule vanle leiset chunga melchihna ho le thil kidangho abolin, keipi bahkaiho thanei na-a konin Daniel ahuhdoh-in ahi.
target: He rescues and he saves; he performs signs and wonders in the heavens and on the earth. He has rescued Daniel from the power of the lions.”

source: Hitichun hiche Daniel hi Darius lallai sungse, chule Persia mipa Cyrus lal laijin anaphatouvin ahi.
target: So Daniel prospered during the reign of Darius and the reign of Cyrus the Persian.

source: Babylon lengpa Belshazzar kum masapenin, Daniel'in ajalkhun chunga alupna-a mang le gaothilmu ho aneijin: chuin aman amang chu ajihdoh-in, chule athilho umdol chu aseijin ahi.
target: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream, and visions passed through his mind as he was lying in bed. He wrote down the substance of his dream.

source: Daniel'in hitihin aseije, jana gaothilmu kamu chun jan ahin, chule veuvin, van'a kon hui li chu twipilen chun achoh thouvin ahi.
target: Daniel said: “In my vision at night I looked, and there before me were the four winds of heaven churning up the great sea.

source: Chuin twipia kon chun sahem len tahtah jatchom cheh li ahungdoh-in ahi.
target: Four great beasts, each different from the others, came up out of the sea.

source: Amasapen chu keipi bahkai toh abangin, chule muvanlai lhavingho aneijin; alhavingho chu bodoh-a auma, chule ama chu leisetna kona dopsanga auma, mihem khat banga akenga akidinsah, chule mihem lungchang akipeh gei chu kanaven ahi.
target: “The first was like a lion, and it had the wings of an eagle. I watched until its wings were torn off and it was lifted from the ground so that it stood on two feet like a human being, and the mind of a human was given to it.

source: Chule veuvin sahem chomkhat, anichanna chu vompi toh abangin, chule amale ama alang khatna ahung kidom sangin, chule akam sunga ahakah-a chun nahgu thum aumin ahi: chule amaho chun chuche henga, thouvin lang saphe tamtah nen, atiuvin ahi.
target: “And there before me was a second beast, which looked like a bear. It was raised up on one of its sides, and it had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth. It was told, ‘Get up and eat your fill of flesh!’

source: Hiche jouchun keiman kaven, veuvin atungtuna vacha lhaving li neija lutnu tobang achomkhat kamui; hiche sahem chun luchang li jong aneijin, chule thuneina chu ama akipen ahi.
target: “After that, I looked, and there before me was another beast, one that looked like a leopard. And on its back it had four wings like those of a bird. This beast had four heads, and it was given authority to rule.

source: Hiche jouchun jana kathilmuho-a chun, Veuvin, sahem lina, tijat le kichat umtah, nasatah-a hat kamun; hichun thih-a kisem ha lentah aneijin; hichun anen ahalhalin achip bongin, chule amoh chu akengton achilin: hiche sahem chu amasa-a sahemho sangin achombeh-in, chule ki som aneijin ahi.
target: “After that, in my vision at night I looked, and there before me was a fourth beast—terrifying and frightening and very powerful. It had large iron teeth; it crushed and devoured its victims and trampled underfoot whatever was left. It was different from all the former beasts, and it had ten horns.

source: Keiman akiho chu kangaiton ahile, veuvin, alah uva chun kineo chom khat ahung mum doh-in, chuche masanga chun ki masa thumho chu ajunga konin bodoh-in aumin: chule veuvin, hiche ki-a chun mihem mit ho tobang aumin, chule thulen tahtah seidohna kam jong aume.
target: “While I was thinking about the horns, there before me was another horn, a little one, which came up among them; and three of the first horns were uprooted before it. This horn had eyes like the eyes of a human being and a mouth that spoke boastfully.

source: Keiman laltounaho tundoh-a auma, chule khanglui laija patna umpehpa, avon buhbang banga bang, chule aluchang sam jong samul thengseh bang jengpa ahungtou geijin kagahmun ahi. Ama laltouna chu meikou deujeju, chule akang kolho jong chu mei-al tah toh abangin ahi.
target: “As I looked, “thrones were set in place, and the Ancient of Days took his seat. His clothing was as white as snow; the hair of his head was white like wool. His throne was flaming with fire, and its wheels were all ablaze.

source: Meikou luidung bangin ahung longdoh-in chule ama angsunga konin ahungdoh-in ahi. Asang asangin ama ajenun, chule sangsom jat sangsom ama anga adingun: thutanna chu gonsa ahitan, chule lekhabu ho chu akiphong kehtai.
target: A river of fire was flowing, coming out from before him. Thousands upon thousands attended him; ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him. The court was seated, and the books were opened.

source: Chujouvin keiman hiche ki chun thu len tahtah aseiho jeh-in kagahven: chule sahem akitha-a, atahsa suhmanga, meikou deujeju henga akipehdoh geijin kaven ahi.
target: “Then I continued to watch because of the boastful words the horn was speaking. I kept looking until the beast was slain and its body destroyed and thrown into the blazing fire.

source: Sahem dangho sechu ahile, amaho thuneina chu lahdoh-in aumin; ahijeng vangin ahinkhou vang chu phatbihle phat khatna dingin akisusaovin ahi.
target: (The other beasts had been stripped of their authority, but were allowed to live for a period of time.)

source: Keiman jana thilmuho kaneija chun, veuvin, mihem chapa tobang khat van meilomho toh ahungin, chule khanglui laija patna umpehpa koma ahungin, chule amahon ama chu ama anga ahinpui naijun ahi.
target: “In my vision at night I looked, and there before me was one like a son of man, coming with the clouds of heaven. He approached the Ancient of Days and was led into his presence.

source: Chuin mitin, namtin, chule paotin paotang jousen ajen theina dingin, ama chu thuneina le loupina chule lenggam khat akipei: ama thuneina chu tonsot thuneina ahin, chule hiche chu mangtalou ding, chule alenggam chu suhmanga umlou ding ahitai.
target: He was given authority, glory and sovereign power; all nations and peoples of every language worshiped him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion that will not pass away, and his kingdom is one that will never be destroyed.

source: Keima Daniel hi katahsa lunggila lunggimin kaumtai, chule kalupna-a thilmu kaneiho hin eisugenthei jin ahi.
target: “I, Daniel, was troubled in spirit, and the visions that passed through my mind disturbed me.

source: Keiman adingho lah-a khat chu kagahnaijin, hicheho thudol jouse-a thutah chu ama kadongtan ahi. Hichun aman keima eiseipeh-in, chule thil ho ledohna chu keima eihetsahtan ahi.
target: I approached one of those standing there and asked him the meaning of all this. “So he told me and gave me the interpretation of these things:

source: Hiche sahem lentah lihohi, leisetna kona hung umdoh ding, leng liho ahiuve.
target: ‘The four great beasts are four kings that will rise from the earth.

source: Ahinla chungnung penpa mithengte chun lenggam chu alahpeh ding, chule amahon lenggam chu tonsot, atonsot chule tonsot geija alo dingu ahi.
target: But the holy people of the Most High will receive the kingdom and will possess it forever—yes, for ever and ever.’

source: Chujouvin keiman sahem lina, adang jouse sanga chomdeh-a, tijat umtah, aha thih-a kisem, chule atinho sum-enga kisem; ahal halla chipgoija, chule amoh akengho-a chila;
target: “Then I wanted to know the meaning of the fourth beast, which was different from all the others and most terrifying, with its iron teeth and bronze claws—the beast that crushed and devoured its victims and trampled underfoot whatever was left.

source: Chule alua ki som umho, chule adang khat hungkeh doh-a, chule amasanga thum lhu-a; chule aki mitnei, chule akama thulen tahtah seidoh, akibahpiho sanga thahatjo thudola thutah chu het kanomin ahi.
target: I also wanted to know about the ten horns on its head and about the other horn that came up, before which three of them fell—the horn that looked more imposing than the others and that had eyes and a mouth that spoke boastfully.

source: Keiman kaven ahile, hiche kimama chu mithengte toh akisatna, chule amaho chu ajoa,
target: As I watched, this horn was waging war against the holy people and defeating them,

source: Khanglui laija pat ana umpa ahunga, chule chungnung penpa mithengho themchan na-a thutanna akibol masangse chu kaven; chule mithengten hiche lenggam chu alo phatnu ahung lhungtan ahi.
target: until the Ancient of Days came and pronounced judgment in favor of the holy people of the Most High, and the time came when they possessed the kingdom.

source: Chuin aman hitihin aseije, sahem lina chu leiset chunga lenggam lina chu hiding ahin, hichu lenggam ho jouse sanga achombeh hintin, chule leiset pumpi avallhum ding, chule achotnem ding, chule ahalhalla asuhngem ding ahi.
target: “He gave me this explanation: ‘The fourth beast is a fourth kingdom that will appear on earth. It will be different from all the other kingdoms and will devour the whole earth, trampling it down and crushing it.

source: Hiche lenggama kona ki som hung umdoh chu leng li hung umdoh dingho ahiuve: chule amaho nunga chu adang khat hung umdoh ding, hichu amasapa toh banglouva achombeh hiding, chule aman leng thumho chu asuhlhuh ding ahi.
target: The ten horns are ten kings who will come from this kingdom. After them another king will arise, different from the earlier ones; he will subdue three kings.

source: Chule ama chun chungnung pen douna-a thu len tahtah aseidoh ding, chungnung pen mithengho chu asuhgenthei ding, chule phathole danho khelding ahinngaito ding ahi. Chule mithengho chu ama khutna phat khat, phat ho, chule phat kehkhat sunga kipedoh ding ahiuve.
target: He will speak against the Most High and oppress his holy people and try to change the set times and the laws. The holy people will be delivered into his hands for a time, times and half a time.

source: Ahinla thutanna chu toutei ding ahin, chule amahon athuneina chu akhonna geija suhgam dingle suhmanghel dinga alahpeh dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘But the court will sit, and his power will be taken away and completely destroyed forever.

source: Chuche lenggam le thuneina, vannoi pumpi-a lenggam loupina chu chungnung penpa mithengte hochu kipe ding, chuche lenggam chu tonsot lenggam ahin, chule lenggam jousen ama ajenuva athu angai dingu ahi.
target: Then the sovereignty, power and greatness of all the kingdoms under heaven will be handed over to the holy people of the Most High. His kingdom will be an everlasting kingdom, and all rulers will worship and obey him.’

source: Hichanhi athu kichaina ahitai. Ahin keima Daniel vang, kalunggel hin eisugim lheh-in, chule kamel jong akikhel jengin ahi; hijongle athuhi keiman kalunggil sunga kakichin tupmin ahi.
target: “This is the end of the matter. I, Daniel, was deeply troubled by my thoughts, and my face turned pale, but I kept the matter to myself.”

source: Belshazzar lengpa lengchan kal kum thum lhinna-in, keima Daniel, keima tah henga thilmu khat, amasa hung kilangdohpa nungin, ahung kilangdoh kitnin ahi.
target: In the third year of King Belshazzar’s reign, I, Daniel, had a vision, after the one that had already appeared to me.

source: Chuin keiman gaothilmu-a chun: chule ahitin ahi, keiman kamu-a chun, keima Elam gamkai sunga um Shushan leng inpia kana umin; chule keiman gaothilmu-a chun, keima Ulai vadung kama kanaum kamun ahi.
target: In my vision I saw myself in the citadel of Susa in the province of Elam; in the vision I was beside the Ulai Canal.

source: Chuin keima kakhodah-in, chule veuvin, vadung panga chun aki ni nei kelngoi chal khat anading kanamun: chule chuche ki teni chu asangin; ahin khat chu khat sang chun asangjon, chule asangjopa chu ahungdoh nunung jon ahi.
target: I looked up, and there before me was a ram with two horns, standing beside the canal, and the horns were long. One of the horns was longer than the other but grew up later.

source: Chuin kelngoi chal ama anga gamsaho khatcha ading thei aumlouna dinga lhumlam, sahlam, lhanglama, ano-a; imacha ama khutna kona huhdoh jou aumlou; ahivanga aman alung deilam lam abola, ahung letdoh lheh jengchu kamun ahi.
target: I watched the ram as it charged toward the west and the north and the south. No animal could stand against it, and none could rescue from its power. It did as it pleased and became great.

source: Chule keiman kalung kagel laitah-in, veuvin, lhumlama konin keltah chal khat leiset pumpi chunga ahungin, chule amachun tol atongkha pon: chule hiche keltah hin amit teni kah-a ki kilangtah khat aneije.
target: As I was thinking about this, suddenly a goat with a prominent horn between its eyes came from the west, crossing the whole earth without touching the ground.

source: Chule ama chu keiman kamu aki ni nei kelngoi, vadung panga anading heng lama chun ahungin, chule aman athaneina pumpin ama chu adel jengin ahi.
target: It came toward the two-horned ram I had seen standing beside the canal and charged at it in great rage.

source: Chule aman kelngoi chal henglam ahinnai kamun, chule achunga alunghang lheh jengin, kelngoi chal chu atatnin, aki teni asuhbohpeh tan ahi. Chule kelngoi chal chun ama anga din jouna ding thaneina aneipon, ahinla aman ama chu tolla asulhun, achungu chu achilin: chule ama khutna kona kelngoi chal huhdoh ding koima aumpoi.
target: I saw it attack the ram furiously, striking the ram and shattering its two horns. The ram was powerless to stand against it; the goat knocked it to the ground and trampled on it, and none could rescue the ram from its power.

source: Hitichun keltah chal chu ahung loupi lhehtan: chuin ama ahunghat phatnin, aki lentah chu abongtan; chule akhelin kilangtah ki li van'a hui li nunna lam ngan ahung kehdoh-in ahi.
target: The goat became very great, but at the height of its power the large horn was broken off, and in its place four prominent horns grew up toward the four winds of heaven.

source: Chule amaho lah-a khatna konin kineo khat ahungdoh-in, hichu lhanglam, solam, chule gam nomtah lam ngan hatah-in ahung lenin ahi.
target: Out of one of them came another horn, which started small but grew in power to the south and to the east and toward the Beautiful Land.

source: Chuin hichu van janel ho lah geijin ahung lenin; chule hichun janel phabep le ahsi phabep tolla ahin pailhan, achungu chu achilin ahi.
target: It grew until it reached the host of the heavens, and it threw some of the starry host down to the earth and trampled on them.

source: Henge, amale ama chu janel ho pipupa toh kibang khopmin akichoi anin, chule aman nitin ganlhaina thilpeh chu alamangin, chule Ama muntheng umna jong chu asulhun ahi.
target: It set itself up to be as great as the commander of the army of the Lord ; it took away the daily sacrifice from the Lord , and his sanctuary was thrown down.

source: Chule ama chu, suhkhel jeh-a nitin ganlhaina thilpeh douna dingin janel khat akipen, chule hichun thutah chu tolla aseplhan: aman hichu abolin, chule aphatouvin ahi.
target: Because of rebellion, the Lord ’s people and the daily sacrifice were given over to it. It prospered in everything it did, and truth was thrown to the ground.

source: Chujouvin keiman mitheng khatnin thu asei kajan, chule mitheng dang khatnin mitheng thuseipa henga chun, nitin ganlhaina, suhkhelna jeh-a manthaina, muntheng le galmi janel agoma kenga chotpha-a umdinga pehdohna phat chungchanga gaothilmu hi itihchan hiding ham? ati.
target: Then I heard a holy one speaking, and another holy one said to him, “How long will it take for the vision to be fulfilled—the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, the rebellion that causes desolation, the surrender of the sanctuary and the trampling underfoot of the Lord ’s people?”

source: Chuin aman kahenga, ni sangni le ni jathum gei hiding; chujouteng muntheng chu kisutheng ding ahi, tin aseije.
target: He said to me, “It will take 2,300 evenings and mornings; then the sanctuary will be reconsecrated.”

source: Chuin ahung hitin ahi, kei, Daniel keimatah ngeijin thilmu chu kanamua, chule ipi kiseina ahi kahol chun, hichun veuvin, ka-ansunga mihem melput tobang pu khat anadingin ahi.
target: While I, Daniel, was watching the vision and trying to understand it, there before me stood one who looked like a man.

source: Chule keiman Ulai vakam chekah-a mihem khat awgin kajan, awgin chun akouvin, ahenga, Gabriel, hiche gaothilmu hi hiche mipahi hetthem sah-in, ati.
target: And I heard a man’s voice from the Ulai calling, “Gabriel, tell this man the meaning of the vision.”

source: Hitichun ama kadinna mun koma ahungin ahi: chuin ama ahung phatnin kakichatan, kalhun tolla kamai kasulut tai. Ahinla aman keima henga, Vo mihem chapa, hethemin: ijeh inem itileh gaothilmu hi phat kichai tenga ding ahi, ati.
target: As he came near the place where I was standing, I was terrified and fell prostrate. “Son of man,” he said to me, “understand that the vision concerns the time of the end.”

source: Tun aman eihoupi laijin, keima kamai tollam ngan nomtah-in ka-imun ahi. Ahinla aman eihin tongkhan, chule eidindoh sah-in ahi.
target: While he was speaking to me, I was in a deep sleep, with my face to the ground. Then he touched me and raised me to my feet.

source: Chuin aman kahenga, ven, keiman nangma lungdamlouna akichaina lamle ipi hunglhung ding ham ti kahetsah ding nahi: ajehchu akitep phatna chu achaina hunglhung ding ahi.
target: He said: “I am going to tell you what will happen later in the time of wrath, because the vision concerns the appointed time of the end.

source: Kelngoi chal ki ni nei namu chu Media le Persia lengte ni ahiuve.
target: The two-horned ram that you saw represents the kings of Media and Persia.

source: Chule keltah sousetah chu Greek lengpa chu ahi: chule amit teni kah-a ki lentah um chu leng masapenpa ahi.
target: The shaggy goat is the king of Greece, and the large horn between its eyes is the first king.

source: Tun hiche ki kisuhbong le akhela li hung dondoh chu, hiche nam'a kona chu lenggam li hung umdoh ding; ahivang ama thahatna vanga hilou ding ahi.
target: The four horns that replaced the one that was broken off represent four kingdoms that will emerge from his nation but will not have the same power.

source: Chule amaho lenggam kichailam, suhkhelna neiho ahung pilhin teng, amel tijatjat umtah le thuguh hetthemna nei leng khat hung dingdoh ding ahi.
target: “In the latter part of their reign, when rebels have become completely wicked, a fierce-looking king, a master of intrigue, will arise.

source: Chule ama thaneina chu lenlheh ding ahin, ahinla amatah thaneina jal ahipoi. Chule aman kidangtah-a asuhmanga, chule khangtou ding, chule hitia chu abola thahat hole mithengho asuhmang ding ahi.
target: He will become very strong, but not by his own power. He will cause astounding devastation and will succeed in whatever he does. He will destroy those who are mighty, the holy people.

source: Chule ama thilgon jala jong akhut noija doha le joule nal apunsah ding; chule alunggil sunga amale ama kichoi-an ding, chule chamna-a kona mi tamtah asuhmang ding ahi. Ama chu pipuiho pipuipa douna-a hung dingdoh ding, ahivanga ama chu khut panglouva kisubong ding ahi.
target: He will cause deceit to prosper, and he will consider himself superior. When they feel secure, he will destroy many and take his stand against the Prince of princes. Yet he will be destroyed, but not by human power.

source: Chule nilhah le jingkah gaothilmu-a kimu kisei chu atahbeh ahi. Hijeh chun nangman gaothilmu hi imchah-in, ajehchu nikho tamtah nunga hunglhung ding ahi.
target: “The vision of the evenings and mornings that has been given you is true, but seal up the vision, for it concerns the distant future.”

source: Hichun Daniel keima lhasamin kalhu-in, ni ijat ham damlouvin kaumtan; chujouvin keima kathoudoh-in, chule lengpa na chu katong kit tai. Chule hiche gaothil muhi kidang kasan, ahinla koimachan ahethempoi.
target: I, Daniel, was worn out. I lay exhausted for several days. Then I got up and went about the king’s business. I was appalled by the vision; it was beyond understanding.

source: Chaldea gam pumpi chunga lenga kipansah, Medes chilhah Ahasuras chapa Darius lengchankal kum khatna-in,
target: In the first year of Darius son of Xerxes (a Mede by descent), who was made ruler over the Babylonian kingdom—

source: Aman lengvai apoh akum khatna-in, Daniel keiman Pakai thu Jeremiah themgao henga ahunga, Jerusalem manthah na-a kum somsagi aman asuhbulhit ding ahi tia aseina lekhabu ho-a akumho jat chu kahechentan ahi.
target: in the first year of his reign, I, Daniel, understood from the Scriptures, according to the word of the Lord given to Jeremiah the prophet, that the desolation of Jerusalem would last seventy years.

source: Chuin keiman an kangol-in, khaodip pon kakisil in, vut kakinun, taona le thumna neidingin Pakai Pathen lam kangatnin ahi.
target: So I turned to the Lord God and pleaded with him in prayer and petition, in fasting, and in sackcloth and ashes.

source: Chuin keima Pakai ka Pathen henga kataovin, chule kamona kaphongin, kaseije; Vo Pakai, loupitah le tijat umtah Pathen, ama ngailuho le athupeh ho nit te-a dinga kitepna le hepina koipa;
target: I prayed to the Lord my God and confessed: “Lord, the great and awesome God, who keeps his covenant of love with those who love him and keep his commandments,

source: Keiho kachonse taovin, kachonkhel taovin, giloutah-in na katongun, chule kakiphin un, nadan thupeh ho le nathutan naho geijin kajamsan taove:
target: we have sinned and done wrong. We have been wicked and have rebelled; we have turned away from your commands and laws.

source: Nangma mina kaleng hou, kavaipo hou, kapate hou, chule gamsunga miteho jouse henga thu hinsei nalhacha themgaoho thusei jong ngaisah-in kaneipeh pouvin ahi.
target: We have not listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes and our ancestors, and to all the people of the land.

source: Vo Pakai, chonphatna chu nangma-a ahin, hinla keiho, Judah mite, Jerusalem'a cheng miho, chule Israel pumpi naija hihen gamla-a hijongle, amahon nangma douna-a dan asuhkeh uva, adan suhkehna hou jeh uva nangman nana nodohna gam jouse-a umho dingin vang, kachanu hi tunikho-a banghin mai jum na ahi.
target: “Lord, you are righteous, but this day we are covered with shame—the people of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem and all Israel, both near and far, in all the countries where you have scattered us because of our unfaithfulness to you.

source: Vo Pakai, nangma douna-a kachonset jeh uvin, keiho, kalenghou, kavaipohou chule kapu kapatehou ahin, mai jum na kachang taove.
target: We and our kings, our princes and our ancestors are covered with shame, Lord , because we have sinned against you.

source: Ama kadou jeng vanguvin, hepinaho le ngaidamna chu ka Pakai Pathen uva ahin;
target: The Lord our God is merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against him;

source: Aman alhacha athemgaoho-a kona kamasanguva akoi dan thupeh ho-a kalamlha pouvin, ka Pakai Pathen'u aw jong chu kanangai pouvin ahi.
target: we have not obeyed the Lord our God or kept the laws he gave us through his servants the prophets.

source: Ahi, Israelte jousen na aw angailouna dingun nadan thupeh apalkeh-un, achemangun; hijeh-a chu sapsetna le Pathen soh Mosi dan thupeh-a kisun hahselna chu kachunguva kisunglha ahitai, ajehchu ama dounan kachonse taove.
target: All Israel has transgressed your law and turned away, refusing to obey you. “Therefore the curses and sworn judgments written in the Law of Moses, the servant of God, have been poured out on us, because we have sinned against you.

source: Chule aman kachunguva thilse nasatah alhunsah-in, keiho le kathu-u tana kathutan hou douna-a athusei dohho chu kachunguva asuhdetnin ahi; ajehchu Jerusalem chunga kibol tobanghi vannoi pumpi-a anakibol khapon ahi.
target: You have fulfilled the words spoken against us and against our rulers by bringing on us great disaster. Under the whole heaven nothing has ever been done like what has been done to Jerusalem.

source: Mosi danthupeh-a kisun bang ngeija, hiche thilse jousehi keiho chunga lhunga ahitai. Ahijeng vangin kakhan gitlouna houva kona kakiheidoh theina dingule, nangma thutah kahetthem theina dingun, Pakai ka-Pathen'u anga keiho kanatao pouvin ahi.
target: Just as it is written in the Law of Moses, all this disaster has come on us, yet we have not sought the favor of the Lord our God by turning from our sins and giving attention to your truth.

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin thilse chu aven, kachunguva alhunsahtai. Ajehchu Pakai ka-Pathen'u chu aman atohdoh thil jouse-a chonphatah ahi: keihon athu kangailou jeh-u ahibouve.
target: The Lord did not hesitate to bring the disaster on us, for the Lord our God is righteous in everything he does; yet we have not obeyed him.

source: Chule tun, Vo Pakai ka-Pathen'u, khut thahat tah-a namite Egypt gama kona hinpuidoh-a, chule tunia banga amin ana kithangpa; keiho kachonse taovin, chule giloutah-in na katong taove.
target: “Now, Lord our God, who brought your people out of Egypt with a mighty hand and who made for yourself a name that endures to this day, we have sinned, we have done wrong.

source: Vo Pakai, nachon phatna ho jouse dungjuija kangeh nahi, nalunghanna le nalungsatna chu nalhang theng, Jerusalem khopi-a konin kiheidoh tahen: ajehchu keiho chonset jehle kapu kapateu khan gitlou jeh-in, Jerusalem le namite hi kaveluva umho jouse i-sah louvin kaum taove.
target: Lord, in keeping with all your righteous acts, turn away your anger and your wrath from Jerusalem, your city, your holy hill. Our sins and the iniquities of our ancestors have made Jerusalem and your people an object of scorn to all those around us.

source: Hijeh chun tun, Vo ka Pathen'u, nasoh taona le athumna hi ngaipeh-in, chule amangthahsa namun theng lama hin Pakai jal-in namaiso chu hinvah sah-in.
target: “Now, our God, hear the prayers and petitions of your servant. For your sake, Lord, look with favor on your desolate sanctuary.

source: Vo ka Pathen, nana hinsungin lang ngaijin; namit teni hin hasah inlang, kaman thainao le namina kivo khopi hi hinven: ajehchu kachon phatnao jeh-a na-anga kathumna hou hi hinlhutna kahipouve; ahinla nami hepina haotah jaljoh ahibouve.
target: Give ear, our God, and hear; open your eyes and see the desolation of the city that bears your Name. We do not make requests of you because we are righteous, but because of your great mercy.

source: Vo Pakai, ngaitemin; vo Pakai, ngaidamin; vo Pakai, ngaijin lang tongdoh-in; Vo ka Pathen nangma jal-in geisang hih-in, ajehchu nakhopile namitehi namina kivo kahiuve.
target: Lord, listen! Lord, forgive! Lord, hear and act! For your sake, my God, do not delay, because your city and your people bear your Name.”

source: Chuin keiman thu kaseija, kataova, chule keima chonsetna le kami Israelte chonsetna kaphona, chule ka Pathen lhangthenga dinga kathumnaho Pakai ka Pathen ang kalhut petchun;
target: While I was speaking and praying, confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel and making my request to the Lord my God for his holy hill—

source: Ahi, keiman taona-a thu kasei petnin, keiman gaothilmu kanei tila kipatna kamu mikhat Gabriel chu gangtah-in ahung lengin, nilhah ganlhaina phat velin keima eihung thamin ahi.
target: while I was still in prayer, Gabriel, the man I had seen in the earlier vision, came to me in swift flight about the time of the evening sacrifice.

source: Chuin aman keima eihetsah-in, eiki houlimpin, aseije, Vo Daniel, tuahi keima nangma hetgilnale hetthem theina pedinga kahungdoh ahi.
target: He instructed me and said to me, “Daniel, I have now come to give you insight and understanding.

source: Nangman thumna naneipat tila chu thupeh chu hung kipedoh-a, chule nangma hetsah dinga keima hunga kahi; ajehchu nangma ngailut umtah nahi. Hijeh chun thil umdan hi hethemin lang, na gaothilmu chu ngaitophan.
target: As soon as you began to pray, a word went out, which I have come to tell you, for you are highly esteemed. Therefore, consider the word and understand the vision:

source: Suhkhelna kichaina ding, chonset suhbeina ding, khan gitlou jeh-a kichamna kisem nading, tonsot chonphatna hinpohlutna ding, gaothilmu le gaothu kisei sinkhana ding, chule theng chungnung pen thao kinuna dinga, namite chungle nakhopi theng chunga hapta somsagi kiteppeh ahitai.
target: “Seventy ‘sevens’ are decreed for your people and your holy city to finish transgression, to put an end to sin, to atone for wickedness, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy and to anoint the Most Holy Place.

source: Hijeh chun henlang chule hethemin, Jerusalem sahphatna aumkit dingle akiledoh kitna dinga thupeh ahungdoh-a patna leng chapa Messiah gei chu, hapta sagile hapta somgupleni hiding ahi. Khopi lamlen le kulbang chu phat hahsa sunga kisadoh kit ding ahi.
target: “Know and understand this: From the time the word goes out to restore and rebuild Jerusalem until the Anointed One, the ruler, comes, there will be seven ‘sevens,’ and sixty-two ‘sevens.’ It will be rebuilt with streets and a trench, but in times of trouble.

source: Chule hapta somgupleni jouteng Messiah chu kisatlha ding, ahinla ama le ama ding ahipoi: chule ahung umding mipiteho leng chapa chun khopile muntheng chu asuhbei ding; chule hichu twisangletna hung kichai ding, chule gal hungkichaina geija dinga manthaina kiteppeh ahitai.
target: After the sixty-two ‘sevens,’ the Anointed One will be put to death and will have nothing. The people of the ruler who will come will destroy the city and the sanctuary. The end will come like a flood: War will continue until the end, and desolations have been decreed.

source: Chule aman kitepna chu mi tampi toh hapta khatna dinga asudet ding, chule chuche hapta kimtuhtah chule aman ganlhaina le thilpeh asuh haiding, chule thet umtahho akithejal behseh jeh-a aman akhonna geija suhmanga aumsah ding, chule hiche gotsa suhmangna chu amanthainao chunga kisunlhah beding ahi.
target: He will confirm a covenant with many for one ‘seven.’ In the middle of the ‘seven’ he will put an end to sacrifice and offering. And at the temple he will set up an abomination that causes desolation, until the end that is decreed is poured out on him.”

source: Persia lengpa, Cyrus lengchan kal kum thum na-in thilkhat Daniel, Belteshazzar tia kimin vopa henga phondoh-in ahung umin; chule athil chu tahbeh ahin, ahinla aphat kitep vang chu asaove. Chule aman athil chu ahethemin, chule athilmu chunga chun hetthem theina aneije.
target: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia, a revelation was given to Daniel (who was called Belteshazzar). Its message was true and it concerned a great war. The understanding of the message came to him in a vision.

source: Chuche laichun keima Daniel'in hapta thum lhingset kana lunghemin ahi.
target: At that time I, Daniel, mourned for three weeks.

source: Keiman hapta thum alhin kahsen, anneh tuijong kanepon, jule sa jong kakama alutpon, chule hapta thum alhin kahsen thao jong kakinu khapoi.
target: I ate no choice food; no meat or wine touched my lips; and I used no lotions at all until the three weeks were over.

source: Chule lha masapen nisomni le nili nin keima Hiddekel kite vadung lentah panga kana ume.
target: On the twenty-fourth day of the first month, as I was standing on the bank of the great river, the Tigris,

source: Chuin kagakhoda-a, kagahvetle, pasal khat tupat pona kivona, uphaz sana thengsetna atai kigeh khat kamun ahi.
target: I looked up and there before me was a man dressed in linen, with a belt of fine gold from Uphaz around his waist.

source: Atahsa chu songmantam engdum abangin, chule amaiso chu kolphe abangin, amit teni chu meikou kide abangin, abanho le akengphangho chu sum-eng kinot valset abangin, chule apaodoh gin jong mipi tamtah awgin abang jengin ahi.
target: His body was like topaz, his face like lightning, his eyes like flaming torches, his arms and legs like the gleam of burnished bronze, and his voice like the sound of a multitude.

source: Keima Daniel'in bou thilmuhi kamun; kana umpi pasal hon thilmuhi amupouve; ahinla kichatna nasatah achunguva achun, chutichun amaho gakisel dingin ajammang gam taove.
target: I, Daniel, was the only one who saw the vision; those who were with me did not see it, but such terror overwhelmed them that they fled and hid themselves.

source: Hitichun kachangin eikidalhan, chule hiche thilmu loupitah hi kamun, tha himhim kanei tapoi; ajeh chu kamel lomna jouse asesoh-in, katha jouse jong abeiheltan ahi.
target: So I was left alone, gazing at this great vision; I had no strength left, my face turned deathly pale and I was helpless.

source: Achutijeng vang chun keiman ama thusei awgin chu kajan; chule ama thusei awgin kajah petchun keima nomtah-in ka-imun, kamai tolla kasulutnin ahi.
target: Then I heard him speaking, and as I listened to him, I fell into a deep sleep, my face to the ground.

source: Chuin veuvin, khut khatnin eihin thamin, hichun kakhup teni le kakhut phang teni kingamin eidindoh sah-in ahi.
target: A hand touched me and set me trembling on my hands and knees.

source: Chule aman kahenga, ngailut umtah, vo Daniel, nahenga kathuseiho hethemin, chule ding jangin: ajehchu nangma henga keima eihin kisol ahi, tin aseije. Aman hichu asei phatnin, keima kithing pumpumin kadingin ahi.
target: He said, “Daniel, you who are highly esteemed, consider carefully the words I am about to speak to you, and stand up, for I have now been sent to you.” And when he said this to me, I stood up trembling.

source: Chujouvin aman kahenga, Daniel kicha hih-in: ajehchu nalunga nahet them theina dinga chule na Pathen angsunga kisehgim dinga nalung napehpat nikho-a patna chu nathuseiho kingaipeh-a nahitan, chule nathuseiho jala chu keima hunga kahi.
target: Then he continued, “Do not be afraid, Daniel. Since the first day that you set your mind to gain understanding and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard, and I have come in response to them.

source: Ahinla Persia lenggam pipuipan nisomni le nikhat eina lamtine; ahinla veuvin, pipuiho lah-a khat Michael eipanpi dingin ahungin, chule chua chun Persia lengho toh kanaum khome.
target: But the prince of the Persian kingdom resisted me twenty-one days. Then Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me, because I was detained there with the king of Persia.

source: Tuahi phat nunung lama namite chunga ipi hunglhung ding ham ti nangma hetsah dinga keima hunga kahi: ajehchu gaothilmu chu nikho tamtah nunga ding ahinalaije, ati.
target: Now I have come to explain to you what will happen to your people in the future, for the vision concerns a time yet to come.”

source: Aman hiche thuho kahenga asei chun, kamai tollam kangan, chule keima paomon kaumtan ahi.
target: While he was saying this to me, I bowed with my face toward the ground and was speechless.

source: Chule veuvin, mihem chapate kilopi khatnin kamuh ahin thamin ahi: chuin keima kakam kan, ka-anga dingpa henga chun, Vo ka Pakai, thilmu hin kachunga lunggimnaho eihinlhut peh-in, tha himhim jong kanei tapoi.
target: Then one who looked like a man touched my lips, and I opened my mouth and began to speak. I said to the one standing before me, “I am overcome with anguish because of the vision, my lord, and I feel very weak.

source: Ajehchu hiche ka pakai sohpa hin ka pakai hi iti akihoupi theiding ham? Keima kahile vang, hiche pettah chun keima-a tha le haina thei himhim aumtapoi, katitai.
target: How can I, your servant, talk with you, my lord? My strength is gone and I can hardly breathe.”

source: Chuin mihem melput tobang pu-a khat ahung kitnin, eithamin, eihatsah-in,
target: Again the one who looked like a man touched me and gave me strength.

source: Chule kajah-a, Vo ngailut umtah mihem, kicha hih-in; nachunga lungmon umhen, hatnin, henge, hatnin ati. Aman kahenga thu ahinsei phatnin kahung hatdohtan, chule ahenga, nangman neisuh hattah jeh-in, ka Pakaiyin seitan, kati.
target: “Do not be afraid, you who are highly esteemed,” he said. “Peace! Be strong now; be strong.” When he spoke to me, I was strengthened and said, “Speak, my lord, since you have given me strength.”

source: Chujouvin aman kahenga, nahenga kahung lona ajeh nahet em? Chule tuahi keima Persia pipuipa toh kisat dinga kakile kit ding ahi: chule keima kachedoh nungle, veuvin, Greek pipuipa hung ding ahi.
target: So he said, “Do you know why I have come to you? Soon I will return to fight against the prince of Persia, and when I go, the prince of Greece will come;

source: Ahinla thutah thutheng bu-a kijihlutsa anaum chu keiman nangma kavetsah ding nahi. Chule hiche thilho-a hin napipui pao Michael tailou keima eipanpi koima aumpon ahi, ati.
target: but first I will tell you what is written in the Book of Truth. (No one supports me against them except Michael, your prince.

source: Mede mipa Darius lengchan kum masapa sungin, keima ngei jong ama sudet dingle suhat dingin kanadingin ahi.
target: And in the first year of Darius the Mede, I took my stand to support and protect him.)

source: Chule tu-a hi keiman thutah chu nangma kahin vetsah ding ahi. Veuvin, Persia gama leng thum hung dingdoh kit nalai ding; chule amaho jouse sanga alina chu gam chenga hung haosajo ding ahi. Chule aman ahaonaho le athahatna jala Greek lenggam doudinga mijouse achothou ding ahi.
target: “Now then, I tell you the truth: Three more kings will arise in Persia, and then a fourth, who will be far richer than all the others. When he has gained power by his wealth, he will stir up everyone against the kingdom of Greece.

source: Chule leng thahat tah hung dingdoh-in tin, ama chun thaneina lentah toh tho-a vai ahinhoma, aman alungdei dungjuija abolding ahi.
target: Then a mighty king will arise, who will rule with great power and do as he pleases.

source: Chule ama ahung dindoh teng, alenggam chu hung kehding, leiset kolningli-a hopkhena umding; ama sonle pahho henga hilou ding, chule ama vaihomna gamkai dungjuija jong hilou ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile hicheho chengse tilouva adangho dinga jong ama lenggam chu suhlhah-a umding ahi.
target: After he has arisen, his empire will be broken up and parceled out toward the four winds of heaven. It will not go to his descendants, nor will it have the power he exercised, because his empire will be uprooted and given to others.

source: Chule lhanglam lengpa chu hung hatdoh ding, chule apipuiho lah-a khat toh; chule ama chu amapa sanga hung hatjoa, lenggam anei ding; alenggam chu lenggam lentah hung hiding ahi.
target: “The king of the South will become strong, but one of his commanders will become even stronger than he and will rule his own kingdom with great power.

source: Chule kumho ahung kichai lamteng amahole amaho hungkigom khom ding ahi; ajehchu lhanglam lengpa chanu chu sahlam lengpa henga kinoptona sem dinga hung ding; hijongle amanu chun ban thahatna chu atuhden lou ding; amapa ahia, chule amapa ban ahia ding lou ding ahi. Amavang amanu chu amanu hinpuiho, amanu hingpa, chule hicheho phat laija amanu ana suhatpa toh pehdoh-a umding ahiuve.
target: After some years, they will become allies. The daughter of the king of the South will go to the king of the North to make an alliance, but she will not retain her power, and he and his power will not last. In those days she will be betrayed, together with her royal escort and her father and the one who supported her.

source: Hijongle amanu jungho bahkhatna kona amapa mun lo ding khat hung dingdoh intin, ama chun galmi hon khat ahin kilhonpia, chule sahlam lengpa kulpi sunga hunglut uva, amaho akidoupi dingu, chule ajo dingu ahi.
target: “One from her family line will arise to take her place. He will attack the forces of the king of the North and enter his fortress; he will fight against them and be victorious.

source: Chule Egypt gama sohchang dinga a-pathen hou, apipuihou toh, sana le dangka-a kisem akong le belu manlutah ho chu apohlut ding; chule amapa chu sahlam lengpa sanga kum tamjo umpeh nalai ding ahi.
target: He will also seize their gods, their metal images and their valuable articles of silver and gold and carry them off to Egypt. For some years he will leave the king of the North alone.

source: Chutia chu lhanglam lengpa chu amapa lenggama chu hunglut ding, chule ama agama kilekit ding ahi.
target: Then the king of the North will invade the realm of the king of the South but will retreat to his own country.

source: Ahinla achapate chu suh thouvin hung umuntin, chule galsatmi mihonpi nasatah ahin khopkhom dingu: chule khat chu thonlouva hunga, ahinlonvuh ding, chule ajotpai peh ding: chuteng akulpi-a hungkile kitna, kitomona asuhthou ding ahi.
target: His sons will prepare for war and assemble a great army, which will sweep on like an irresistible flood and carry the battle as far as his fortress.

source: Chuteng lhanglam lengpa chu alaigil kisun bangin tin, chule hungkon doh-a sahlam lengpa chu akisatpi ding: aman mihon tamtah ahintoldoh ding, hijongle mihonpi chu ama khutna kipelut ding ahiuve.
target: “Then the king of the South will march out in a rage and fight against the king of the North, who will raise a large army, but it will be defeated.

source: Aman mihonpi chu apuimang teng, alungsung hung kichoisang ding; chule aman sangsom tamtah asuhlhuh ding: hijongle hichun ama asuhhat chom louding ahi.
target: When the army is carried off, the king of the South will be filled with pride and will slaughter many thousands, yet he will not remain triumphant.

source: Ijeh-inem itile sahlam lengpa chu hung kile kitnin tin, chule amasa-a sanga mihonpi tamjocheh ahintoldoh ding, chule thonlouva kum phabep joutengle galsat mi nasatah le haona tamcheh toh hungtei ding ahi.
target: For the king of the North will muster another army, larger than the first; and after several years, he will advance with a huge army fully equipped.

source: Hiche phatlai teng chule mi tamtah lhanglam lengpa kidoupi ding dingdoh dingu ahi. Namite lah-a gucha michomho jong agaothilmu-u guilhunsah dinga hung kichoisang dingu; hijongle amaho lhuding ahiuve.
target: “In those times many will rise against the king of the South. Those who are violent among your own people will rebel in fulfillment of the vision, but without success.

source: Hitichun sahlam lengpa chu hungintin, chule molsang khat atundoh ding, chule kulpi kikai khum dettah khopiho chu alah ding: chule lhanglam mite hatna ananjou louding, alhentum mihon jong anan joulou dingu, nanjouna tha himhim aneilou dingu ahi.
target: Then the king of the North will come and build up siege ramps and will capture a fortified city. The forces of the South will be powerless to resist; even their best troops will not have the strength to stand.

source: Hijongle ama kidoupi dinga hungpa chun alungdei deija abolding, chule koimacha ama anga dingjou umlou ding ahi. Chule ama gam loupitah sunga chu hung ding ding, hichu akhut ngeija asuhmang ding ahi.
target: The invader will do as he pleases; no one will be able to stand against him. He will establish himself in the Beautiful Land and will have the power to destroy it.

source: Ama chun alenggam pumpi thahatna le chondihho toh kitho-a hung lutding agot ding, hitia chu ahinbol ding ahi. Chule aman hiche sumang dinga chu numei ho chanu chu amapa apehding; ahivanga amanu amapa langa panglou ding, chule amapa-a ding jong hilou ding ahi.
target: He will determine to come with the might of his entire kingdom and will make an alliance with the king of the South. And he will give him a daughter in marriage in order to overthrow the kingdom, but his plans will not succeed or help him.

source: Hichejou tengle aman twikolho lam ahin maingat ding, chule tamtah ahinlah ding ahi. Ahivanga pipui khatnin ama kihousetna chu asuhtang ding; ama kihousetna umlouva hichu amapa chunga chukit ding ahi.
target: Then he will turn his attention to the coastlands and will take many of them, but a commander will put an end to his insolence and will turn his insolence back on him.

source: Chutengle amapan amatah gamsung kulpilam chu ahin maingat ding: ahivanga ama chu kipal lhuding, chule kimu lou ding ahitai.
target: After this, he will turn back toward the fortresses of his own country but will stumble and fall, to be seen no more.

source: Chujou tengle amapa mun'a chu lenggam loupina-a kai dong khat hung dingdoh ding ahi. Hijongle ni phabep sunga lunghanna jeh le gal kisatna jeh-a jong hilouva, ama chu suhmanga umding ahi.
target: “His successor will send out a tax collector to maintain the royal splendor. In a few years, however, he will be destroyed, yet not in anger or in battle.

source: Chule ama mun'a chu thet umtah mi khat hung dingdoh ding, lenggam jana chu amahon ama apeh lou dingu ahi: ahinla ama chu chamna choijin hungintin, chule lenggam chu aman phatlhem na-a akimu ding ahi.
target: “He will be succeeded by a contemptible person who has not been given the honor of royalty. He will invade the kingdom when its people feel secure, and he will seize it through intrigue.

source: Chule amaho chu a-angsunga kona twisanglen thahatnin alonvuh uva, chule suhsetna umding ahiuve; henge, kitepna pipuipa jong chutiding ahi.
target: Then an overwhelming army will be swept away before him; both it and a prince of the covenant will be destroyed.

source: Chule amato kiloikhomna akisem joujoule aman jonchihtah-a na ahintoh ding ahi. Ajehchu ama hung kipandoh-in tin, mi phabep khat toh hunghat dohding ahi.
target: After coming to an agreement with him, he will act deceitfully, and with only a few people he will rise to power.

source: Ama chu gamkai sunga mun phatah ho-a chu chamna ahin choija hungding; chule ama chun apate, chule apate pateuvin jong anabolkhah louvu chu ahinbol ding ahi. Aman galthil kilaho, galthil kichomdoh ho, chule haonaho chu amaho lah-a ahinthejal ding ahi. Henge, phat khat sunga dinga mundet ho douna dinga thilgonho angaito ding ahi.
target: When the richest provinces feel secure, he will invade them and will achieve what neither his fathers nor his forefathers did. He will distribute plunder, loot and wealth among his followers. He will plot the overthrow of fortresses—but only for a time.

source: Aman lhanglam lengpa kidoupi dinga galsat mihonpi nasatah toh kitho-a athaneinale ahansanna chu ahinsuhthou ding; chule galsat mihonpi nasatah le thahat tah toh kidou dinga lhanglam lengpa chu suhthouva hungum ding; hijongle ama dingjou lou ding ahi. Ajehchu amahon ama douna-a thilgon tampi ahinnei dingu ahi.
target: “With a large army he will stir up his strength and courage against the king of the South. The king of the South will wage war with a large and very powerful army, but he will not be able to stand because of the plots devised against him.

source: Henge, ama chan anneh neho chun ama asuhmang dingu, chule agalsat miho chu lonvuh-a hungum uva, chule tamtah tha-a umding ahi.
target: Those who eat from the king’s provisions will try to destroy him; his army will be swept away, and many will fall in battle.

source: Chule hiche leng teni lungthim chu setna bolna dinga hung kipeding, chule amanin dokhang khatna jouthu aseilhon ding; ahivanga hichu lolhing lou ding ahi. Ajehchu akichaina chu phat kitep alhun teng guilhung ding bou ahi.
target: The two kings, with their hearts bent on evil, will sit at the same table and lie to each other, but to no avail, because an end will still come at the appointed time.

source: Chujou tengle ama haona thil tamtah toh agamsunga kile kitnin tin; chule alungsung chu kitepna theng douna hung hiding; chule aman suhsetna na atoh-a, ama gamsung ngeija kile ding ahi.
target: The king of the North will return to his own country with great wealth, but his heart will be set against the holy covenant. He will take action against it and then return to his own country.

source: Phat kitepsa ahunglhun tengle ama hung kilentin, chule lhanglam jonna hung ding; ahivanga hichu amasa ahiloule anunungjo tobang hilou ding ahi.
target: “At the appointed time he will invade the South again, but this time the outcome will be different from what it was before.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Chittim kong inneiho chu ama toh kidou dinga hungding ahiuve. Hijeh-a chu ama lungphamo ding, hungkile kit ding, chule kitepna theng douna-a thangtom lhehding; chutia chu abolding ahi. Ama hungkile kitna, chule kitepna theng jamsanho khohsahna ahinnei ding ahi.
target: Ships of the western coastlands will oppose him, and he will lose heart. Then he will turn back and vent his fury against the holy covenant. He will return and show favor to those who forsake the holy covenant.

source: Chule galsat miho chu ama lama hung dingdoh uva, chule amahon thahatna muntheng chu ahin suhboh dingu, nitin ganlhaina chu alahmang uva, chule chumuna chu suhgamna boldoh-a thet umtah chu akoi dingu ahi.
target: “His armed forces will rise up to desecrate the temple fortress and will abolish the daily sacrifice. Then they will set up the abomination that causes desolation.

source: Chule kitepna douna-a gilou tah-a thilbol hochu aman pachat lhem-a asuhboh ding: amavang a-Pathen he-a mipi hochu hatdoh uva, chule natoh lentah ho atohdoh dingu ahi.
target: With flattery he will corrupt those who have violated the covenant, but the people who know their God will firmly resist him.

source: Chule mipi lah-a ahethemho chun mi tamtah ahilchet dingu: ahijeng vanga amaho nikho tamtah chemjam'a, meikouva, sohchan na-a, chule galthil kichomna-a lhuding ahiuve.
target: “Those who are wise will instruct many, though for a time they will fall by the sword or be burned or captured or plundered.

source: Chule amaho ahunglhuh tengule kithopina themcha bou amu dingu: ahivanga mi tamtah chu pachatlhema amaho-a beh dingu ahi.
target: When they fall, they will receive a little help, and many who are not sincere will join them.

source: Chule hetthem theina neiho lah-a phabep chu akichaina phatchan geija lhitchil, suhtheng, soptheng, chule bansah ahi nadinguva lhuding ahiuve; ajehchu aphat kitepsa chu ngah jinga umnalai ahi.
target: Some of the wise will stumble, so that they may be refined, purified and made spotless until the time of the end, for it will still come at the appointed time.

source: Chule lengpa chun ama lunglam lamin thil ahinbol ding; chule ama chu amale ama hung kidomsanga, chule amale ama pathenho jouse sanga hung kichoisang ding, chule pathen ho Pathen douna-a thil kidang dang ahinseidoh ding, chule thangtomna chu suhbulhit ahi kahse-a phatou ding ahi. Ajehchu ahidinga kigel lhusa chu kitongdoh tei ding ahi.
target: “The king will do as he pleases. He will exalt and magnify himself above every god and will say unheard-of things against the God of gods. He will be successful until the time of wrath is completed, for what has been determined must take place.

source: Ama chun apu apa teho Pathen ahin, numei ho lungdeilam ahin, chule ipi pathen hijongle ngaisah-a aneilou ding ahi. Ajehchu imajouse chunga amale ama kichoisang ding ahi.
