target: He will show no regard for the gods of his ancestors or for the one desired by women, nor will he regard any god, but will exalt himself above them all.

source: Ahivanga aman aumna mun'a hatna Pathen chu jana apeh ding; chule apu apa tehon anahet khah louvu pathen khat chu aman sana, dangka, chule songmantam ho chule dei umtah thilho-a jana apeh ding ahi.
target: Instead of them, he will honor a god of fortresses; a god unknown to his ancestors he will honor with gold and silver, with precious stones and costly gifts.

source: Chutia chu aman gamdang pathen toh kitho-a kulpidet ho douna-a na atohding, aman hichu ahetpeh-a chule aloupina aphatou sah ding: chule aman amaho chu tampi chunga thuneina aneisah-a, chule leiset chu man neija ahopkhen ding ahi.
target: He will attack the mightiest fortresses with the help of a foreign god and will greatly honor those who acknowledge him. He will make them rulers over many people and will distribute the land at a price.

source: Chule akichaina phat teng lhanglam lengpan ama chu ahin nokhum ding: chule sahlam lengpa chu ama doudinga chimpei banga, sakol kangtalai ho toh, sakol chung chongho toh, kong innei hotoh hung dingu; chule ama chu gamsungho-a hunglut ding, chule alonvuh khuma, chepai ding ahi.
target: “At the time of the end the king of the South will engage him in battle, and the king of the North will storm out against him with chariots and cavalry and a great fleet of ships. He will invade many countries and sweep through them like a flood.

source: Ama gam loupi sunga jong hunglut ding, chule gam tamtah suhlhuh-a umding ahi. Ahinla hiche Edom, Moab chule Ammon chateho bulpi ngeihi ama khutna kona hoidoh ding ahiuve.
target: He will also invade the Beautiful Land. Many countries will fall, but Edom, Moab and the leaders of Ammon will be delivered from his hand.

source: Aman gamho chunga jong aban ahinjah ding: chule Egypt gam hoidoh lou ding ahi.
target: He will extend his power over many countries; Egypt will not escape.

source: Aman Egypt gam thil manlutah ho, sana le dangka gouho jouse chunga tha aneiding; chule Libya mitele Ethiopia mite chu ama kalsona channa umding ahiuve.
target: He will gain control of the treasures of gold and silver and all the riches of Egypt, with the Libyans and Cushites in submission.

source: Hijongle solamle sahlama kona thusoh ho chun ama alungkhamsah ding: hijeh achu ama lungsa tah-a asumang dingle mihem tampi gamsahhel dinga kipandoh ding ahi.
target: But reports from the east and the north will alarm him, and he will set out in a great rage to destroy and annihilate many.

source: Chule aman aleng inpi houbuhho chu twipiho le loupitah molsang theng kikah-a ahin tundoh ding: ahijeng vanga ama akichaina hunglhung ding, chule koimachan ama akithopi lou ding ahi.
target: He will pitch his royal tents between the seas at the beautiful holy mountain. Yet he will come to his end, and no one will help him.

source: Chule chuche phat teng chule namite chate-a dinga dingjing pipui lentah Michael chu hung dingdoh ding; chule nam khat ahung umdoh-a patna chuche phat changeija ana umkhalou gim hesohna phat khat hungum ding ahi. Chule chuche phat teng chule namite chuche lekhabua amin kijih kimuse chu huhdoh-a umding ahi.
target: “At that time Michael, the great prince who protects your people, will arise. There will be a time of distress such as has not happened from the beginning of nations until then. But at that time your people—everyone whose name is found written in the book—will be delivered.

source: Chule leivui lah-a imuho chu, kimkhat tonsot hinna, chule kimkhat jachatna le tonsot themmo na-a hung thoudoh dingu ahi.
target: Multitudes who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake: some to everlasting life, others to shame and everlasting contempt.

source: Chule michingho chu vanthamjol vah banga vah ding ahiuvin; chule mi tamtah chonphatna lama lepuite hochu atonsot atonsotna ahsi ho toh bangdiu ahi.
target: Those who are wise will shine like the brightness of the heavens, and those who lead many to righteousness, like the stars for ever and ever.

source: Ahinla Vo Daniel, nangman phat kichai tokah-a din thuho hi khah chah-in, chule lekhabu chu sinkha khumin: mi tamtah hung suhlhai hungtou lhaijuntin, chule hetna hung khangtou ding ahi, ati.
target: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.”

source: Chujouvin keima Daniel'in kaven ahile, veuvin, achomdang ni ana dingin, khat chu vadung pang hilam sanga aumin, chule khat chu vadung pang khulam sanga aumin ahi.
target: Then I, Daniel, looked, and there before me stood two others, one on this bank of the river and one on the opposite bank.

source: Chuin khat chun tupat pona kivona vadung twiho chunga umpa henga chun, hiche thil kidangho kichaina ding chu ichan sot nalai dingham? ati.
target: One of them said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long will it be before these astonishing things are fulfilled?”

source: Chuin keiman tupat ponna kivon vadung twiho chunga umpa chun akhut jetlam le veilam chu van lama adop sanga, atonsotna hingjingpa mina akihahsela, Hiche thilho jouse kichaina dingle, aman mithengho thahat asuhcheh nading phat lhina ding chu phat khat, phat ho, chule phat keh hiding ahi, tia asei kajan ahi.
target: The man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, lifted his right hand and his left hand toward heaven, and I heard him swear by him who lives forever, saying, “It will be for a time, times and half a time. When the power of the holy people has been finally broken, all these things will be completed.”

source: Chuin keiman thu kisei chu kajan, ahinla kahetheipon ahi: chujouvin keiman, Vo ka pakai, hiche thilho kichaina dinghi ipi hintem? kati.
target: I heard, but I did not understand. So I asked, “My lord, what will the outcome of all this be?”

source: Chuin aman, Daniel nachena dinga chetan: ajehchu phat kichai kah-a dinga thuho hi kikhah-a, kisinkha-a ahitai.
target: He replied, “Go your way, Daniel, because the words are rolled up and sealed until the time of the end.

source: Mitamtah kisuhthenga, bangsetna ki-umsah-a, chule kisuchil ding ahi; hijongle khanggilou chu gilou jing ding: khanggilou koimachan ahetthem louding; amavang michingin ahetthem ding ahi.
target: Many will be purified, made spotless and refined, but the wicked will continue to be wicked. None of the wicked will understand, but those who are wise will understand.

source: Chule nitin ganlhaina lahmanga ahung uma, chule suhgamna thet umtah ahung kitundoh-a patna chu ni sangkhat le nijani le somko umding ahi.
target: “From the time that the daily sacrifice is abolished and the abomination that causes desolation is set up, there will be 1,290 days.

source: Ni sangkhat le ni jathum le somthumle nga ngah jinga, chua hunglutna michu anunnom ahi.
target: Blessed is the one who waits for and reaches the end of the 1,335 days.

source: Ahinla akhonna ni ahikah-in nangma nachena dinga chetan; ajehchu nangma nakichol do-a, chule nikhoho kichaini leh navang channa-a nadin ding ahi, ati.
target: “As for you, go your way till the end. You will rest, and then at the end of the days you will rise to receive your allotted inheritance.”

source: Israel lengpa Joash chapa Jeroboam nikho laile, Judah lengte ho Hezekiah, Ahaz, Jothan, Uzziah nikho laijin, Beeri chapa Hosea henga Pakai thu ahung lhungin ahi.
target: The word of the Lord that came to Hosea son of Beeri during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and during the reign of Jeroboam son of Jehoash king of Israel:

source: Hosea henga Pakai thu hung lhung kipatna chu ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin Hosea henga, chenlang numei noti ho chate lah-a konin noti numei khat naji dingin gakipuijin; ajehchu gamsung hi Pakaiya kona petmanga, noti'a pang gamma ahitai, ati.
target: When the Lord began to speak through Hosea, the Lord said to him, “Go, marry a promiscuous woman and have children with her, for like an adulterous wife this land is guilty of unfaithfulness to the Lord .”

source: Hitichun ama achen, Diblaim chanu Gomer chu aga kipuijin; amanu agaijin, chapa khat ahinpeh-in ahi.
target: So he married Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore him a son.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin ahenga, amin Jezreel sah-in; ajehchu chomkhat joule keiman Jehu insunga Jezreel phu kalahna ding ahin, chule keiman Israel insung leng gam hi kasuhbei ding ahi.
target: Then the Lord said to Hosea, “Call him Jezreel, because I will soon punish the house of Jehu for the massacre at Jezreel, and I will put an end to the kingdom of Israel.

source: Chuche nikhole hung hiti ding ahi, Israel thalpi chu Jezreel phaichama kaheboh ding ahi, ati.
target: In that day I will break Israel’s bow in the Valley of Jezreel.”

source: Chuin amanu agaikitnin, chanu khat ahingin ahi. Hichun Pathen'in ahenga, amanu min chu Lo-ruhamah sah-in; ajehchu keiman Israel insung chunga hi hepina kaneilou hel ding ahitai; keiman amaho aboncha kalahmang hel ding ahitai.
target: Gomer conceived again and gave birth to a daughter. Then the Lord said to Hosea, “Call her Lo-Ruhamah (which means “not loved”), for I will no longer show love to Israel, that I should at all forgive them.

source: Ahin keiman Judah insung chunga vang hepina neijing ting, Pakai a-Pathen'un amaho chu ahuhhing ding ahin, chule amaho chu thalpi, chemjam, gal, sakol ho, chule sakol chunga tou miho mangcha-a ahuhdoh louding ahi, ati.
target: Yet I will show love to Judah; and I will save them—not by bow, sword or battle, or by horses and horsemen, but I, the Lord their God, will save them.”

source: Tun Lo-ruhamah'in anoichep aban phatnin, amanu agaijin, chapa khat ahingin ahi.
target: After she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, Gomer had another son.

source: Chujouvin Pathen'in ajah-a, amin Lo-ammi sah-in; ajehchu nangho kamite nahi tapouvin, keima na Pathen'u kahitapoi.
target: Then the Lord said, “Call him Lo-Ammi (which means “not my people”), for you are not my people, and I am not your God.

source: Ahivangin Israel chate chu twikhanglen'a neldi jat, tejoulou le simsenglou hung hidiu; chule hung hiti ding ahi, amaho kamite nahitapouve tia ana kiseipehnao mun'a chu, nangho Pathen hing chapate nahiuve tia kiseipeh ding ahiuve.
target: “Yet the Israelites will be like the sand on the seashore, which cannot be measured or counted. In the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ they will be called ‘children of the living God.’

source: Chutengle Judah chatele Israel chate chu kigom khom ding, alamkaidiu khat apansah diu, chule amaho gamsunga kona chu hungpotdoh ding ahiuve: ajehchu Jezreel nikho chu loupitah hiding ahi.
target: The people of Judah and the people of Israel will come together; they will appoint one leader and will come up out of the land, for great will be the day of Jezreel.

source: Nasopipa Ammi le nasopinu Ruhamah jah-a seijin,
target: “Say of your brothers, ‘My people,’ and of your sisters, ‘My loved one.’

source: Nanu henga ngehna neijun, ngehna neijun; ajehchu amanu kaji ahipoi, keijong ama inneipu kahipoi: amanun amitmua konin akijohnaho, chule anoi teni kah-a konin ajonthanhoina chu paimang hen.
target: “Rebuke your mother, rebuke her, for she is not my wife, and I am not her husband. Let her remove the adulterous look from her face and the unfaithfulness from between her breasts.

source: Achuti loule amanu sagoh kahodoh ding, apenlhah nikho banga kakoiding, chule amanu gamthip banga kasema, gamgo banga kakoiding, chule dangchah-a katha ding ahi.
target: Otherwise I will strip her naked and make her as bare as on the day she was born; I will make her like a desert, turn her into a parched land, and slay her with thirst.

source: Chule keiman amanu chate chunga hepina kanei louding ahi; ajehchu amaho kijohnu chate ahiuve.
target: I will not show my love to her children, because they are the children of adultery.

source: Ajehchu anu-u chu noti'n apangtan: amaho oisunga vopnu chu jachat umtah in achontai: Ajehchu amanun, ka changlhah le ka twi, ka samulpon le ka ponnem, ka thaotwi le ka donding eipe-a kakideipi ho nung juijinge, tin aseije.
target: Their mother has been unfaithful and has conceived them in disgrace. She said, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me my food and my water, my wool and my linen, my olive oil and my drink.’

source: Hijeh chun, veuvin, keiman nalampi-a ling tho kagetding, chule amanun kenglampi ho amuthei louna dinga pal kaget ding ahi.
target: Therefore I will block her path with thornbushes; I will wall her in so that she cannot find her way.

source: Chule amanun adeiho nungjui jintin, hijongle amaho chu aphah jou louding; chule amanun amaho chu holintin, hijongle amu louding ahi. Chutahle, amanun, Chengting kaji masapa koma kile kittange; ajehchu hiche phatlai chu keija dingin tu sangin aphajoe, ati ding ahi.
target: She will chase after her lovers but not catch them; she will look for them but not find them. Then she will say, ‘I will go back to my husband as at first, for then I was better off than now.’

source: Ajehchu amanun Baal houna dinga agot chang, ju, chule thaotwi chu keima peh ahi ahepon, chule adangka le sana chu keiman kapunsah ahilam ahepon ahi.
target: She has not acknowledged that I was the one who gave her the grain, the new wine and oil, who lavished on her the silver and gold— which they used for Baal.

source: Hijeh-a chu keima kaki nungle-a, ka chang chu a-at phat tengle kanung lah-a, ka ju jong alhophat tengle kanung lah ding, chule asagoh selna dinga kapeh kasamulpon, chule ponnem jong kanung lahpeh ding ahi.
target: “Therefore I will take away my grain when it ripens, and my new wine when it is ready. I will take back my wool and my linen, intended to cover her naked body.

source: Chule akideipiho mitmu-a amanu jamo kahodoh pehding, chule koimachan kakhutna kona amanu ahuhdohlou ding ahi.
target: So now I will expose her lewdness before the eyes of her lovers; no one will take her out of my hands.

source: Keiman anopsahna jouse, akut nikhoho, alhathah niho, acholngah nikhoho, chule akut thupi ho jouse kasuhbei ding ahi.
target: I will stop all her celebrations: her yearly festivals, her New Moons, her Sabbath days—all her appointed festivals.

source: Chule amanun, Kakideipi hon katohman dinga eipeh-u ahi tia asei alengpiguiho le atheichang phungho chu keiman kasuhmang ding: keiman hicheho chu gammang kasosah-a, chule gamsa hon anehdiu ahi.
target: I will ruin her vines and her fig trees, which she said were her pay from her lovers; I will make them a thicket, and wild animals will devour them.

source: Chule keiman Baal doi houna-a gimnamtui ahal nikhoho jeh, bilba le sana jempah-a akijepma akideipiho nung ajuija, keima eisuh mil jeh-a amanu chunga gotna kapeh ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will punish her for the days she burned incense to the Baals; she decked herself with rings and jewelry, and went after her lovers, but me she forgot,” declares the Lord .

source: Hijeh chun, veovin, keiman amanu chu jolingting, gamthipma kapuiding, chule lungdam sella akoma thu kasei ding ahi.
target: “Therefore I am now going to allure her; I will lead her into the wilderness and speak tenderly to her.

source: Chule keiman chukoma chu amanu alengpileiho kapeh-a, chule akinepna kot dinga Achor phaicham kapeh ding ahi: chule chumuna chu amanun akhangdon laile Egypt gama kona ahung potdoh nikholai banga la asah ding ahi.
target: There I will give her back her vineyards, and will make the Valley of Achor a door of hope. There she will respond as in the days of her youth, as in the day she came up out of Egypt.

source: Chuche nikho chule hitiding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije; Nangman Ishi tia neikou ding, Baali tia neikou tahlou ding ahi.
target: “In that day,” declares the Lord , “you will call me ‘my husband’; you will no longer call me ‘my master.’

source: Ajehchu keiman amanu kamsunga kona Baal doi minho chu kalah dohding, chule aminhou chu geldoh-a umkit louding ahitai.
target: I will remove the names of the Baals from her lips; no longer will their names be invoked.

source: Hiche nikho chule keiman amaho dinga gamsaho, chungleng vacha ho, chule leiset chunga akithol thoho toh kitepna kasemding; chule thalpi, chemjam, chule gal kisat leisetna kona kasuhmang ding, chule amahochu bitkeicha kaumsah dingu ahi.
target: In that day I will make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, the birds in the sky and the creatures that move along the ground. Bow and sword and battle I will abolish from the land, so that all may lie down in safety.

source: Chule keiman nangma a-itih chana keima-a dinga kajihol ding; keiman nangho chonphatna-a, thutan dih-a, ngailut phatna-a, chule hepina-a keima-a dinga kajihol ding nahi.
target: I will betroth you to me forever; I will betroth you in righteousness and justice, in love and compassion.

source: Keiman nangma kitah tah-a keima-a dinga kajihol ding; chule nangman Pakai chu nahet ding ahitai.
target: I will betroth you in faithfulness, and you will acknowledge the Lord .

source: Chule hicheni chule hung hitiding ahi, keiman kangai pehding ahi tin Pakaiyin aseije, keiman vanho thu kangaipeh-a, chule amahon leiset thu angaipeh diu ahi;
target: “In that day I will respond,” declares the Lord — “I will respond to the skies, and they will respond to the earth;

source: Chule leisetnin changle mimho thu, lengpitwi thu chule athaotwi thu angaija, chule amahon Jezreel thu angaidiu ahi.
target: and the earth will respond to the grain, the new wine and the olive oil, and they will respond to Jezreel.

source: Chule amanu chu keimadin leisetna tu-ingting, hepina changlou amanu chu kahepiding, chule keima mite anahilou ho jah-a, nangho kamite nahitaove katiding; chule amahon, Nangma ka Pathen nahi, eitidiu ahi.
target: I will plant her for myself in the land; I will show my love to the one I called ‘Not my loved one.’ I will say to those called ‘Not my people,’ ‘You are my people’; and they will say, ‘You are my God.’ ”

source: Chujouvin Pakaiyin kahenga aseijin, Pathen dangho velhijinga, lengpiga changlhah ho ngailujing Israel chate Pakaiyin angailut jing bangin, chekitnin lang angailu pan angailut mongmong numei jonthan hoija kichem khat ga ngailun, ati.
target: The Lord said to me, “Go, show your love to your wife again, though she is loved by another man and is an adulteress. Love her as the Lord loves the Israelites, though they turn to other gods and love the sacred raisin cakes.”

source: Chutichun keiman amanu chu keija dingin dangka somlenga, suhlou chang homer khatle akeh manin kakichoh tan ahi.
target: So I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver and about a homer and a lethek of barley.

source: Chuin keiman amanu jah-a chun, nitamtah keima dinga naum ding, noti'a napan louding, chule pasal danga ding nahilou ding; chutima-a chu keima jong nangma-a kahiding ahi, kati.
target: Then I told her, “You are to live with me many days; you must not be a prostitute or be intimate with any man, and I will behave the same way toward you.”

source: Ajehchu Israel chate chu nikho tamtah leng le pipui beija, gan lhaina neilouva, milim neilouva, thempu boitong sangkhol le milim houna beija umding ahiuve.
target: For the Israelites will live many days without king or prince, without sacrifice or sacred stones, without ephod or household gods.

source: Khonung tengle Israel chate chu hung kilehei juntin, Pakai a-Pathen'ule David alengpau ahinhol dingu; chule ninunung tengleh Pakai le aphatna chu ahin gin dingu ahi.
target: Afterward the Israelites will return and seek the Lord their God and David their king. They will come trembling to the Lord and to his blessings in the last days.

source: Nangho Israel chaten Pakai thuhi ngaijun; ajehchu gamsunga chu thutah, hepina, chule Pathen hetna aumtahlou jeh-in, Pakai chun chuche gama chengte toh kinelkalna aneitai.
target: Hear the word of the Lord , you Israelites, because the Lord has a charge to bring against you who live in the land: “There is no faithfulness, no love, no acknowledgment of God in the land.

source: Amaho akihahselun, ajouvun, athatnun, aguvin, chule jon apanun, achonkhel taovin, chule thisanin thisan asouvin ahi.
target: There is only cursing, lying and murder, stealing and adultery; they break all bounds, and bloodshed follows bloodshed.

source: Hijeh achu gamsung chu lunghem ding, chua cheng jouse gamsaho le chungleng vachaho puma lhasam ding; chule twipia ngaho tolmanga umding ahiuve.
target: Because of this the land dries up, and all who live in it waste away; the beasts of the field, the birds in the sky and the fish in the sea are swept away.

source: Ahinla mi koima kinah dahen, khatnin khat phosal dahen; ajehchu namiteu chu thempu kinahpijiho tobang ahiuve.
target: “But let no one bring a charge, let no one accuse another, for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.

source: Hijeh-a chu nangho sunlaija nalhuh diu, themgao jong chu nangho toh janle lhuhtha diu; chule keiman nanu chu kasuhmang ding ahi.
target: You stumble day and night, and the prophets stumble with you. So I will destroy your mother—

source: Kamite hetna alhahsam jehu'n suhmangin aumtaove: ajehchu nanghon hetna chu napampai tahjeh uva, keiman jong nangho kapampai ding, chutia chu nangho keima thempu nahilou diu; nanghon na Pathen'u danthu peh nasuhmil tah jeh uva, keiman jong nachateo kasuhmil ding ahi.
target: my people are destroyed from lack of knowledge. “Because you have rejected knowledge, I also reject you as my priests; because you have ignored the law of your God, I also will ignore your children.

source: Amaho apuncheh cheh ule, keima dounan achonse chehcheh-un; hijeh-a chu keiman jong aloupi nao chu jachatna-a kakhel pehding ahi.
target: The more priests there were, the more they sinned against me; they exchanged their glorious God for something disgraceful.

source: Amahon kamite chonsetna anechai helun, chule amahon akhangitlou nao chunga alungthimu akoijun ahi.
target: They feed on the sins of my people and relish their wickedness.

source: Chule hitiding ahi, mipi le thempu kibang diu, keiman alamlhah hou jeh-a talen kapeh ding, chule atohmanu kasansah ding ahi.
target: And it will be: Like people, like priests. I will punish both of them for their ways and repay them for their deeds.

source: Ajehchu amahon neovintin, valoudiu; amahon jonthanhoi boluntin, punglou ding ahiuve: ajehchu amahon Pakai ngaisah ding chu adalha taovin ahi.
target: “They will eat but not have enough; they will engage in prostitution but not flourish, because they have deserted the Lord to give themselves

source: Kijohnale lengpitwi chule lengpitwi thah-in alungu alamangtai.
target: to prostitution; old wine and new wine take away their understanding.

source: Kamite chun amilim hou koma thumop angeh jiuvin, chule atenggolun amaho henga aphongdoh jie: ajehchu kijoh lungput chun amaho achonkhel sah taovin, chule a-Pathen'u thunoija konin apotnun kijoh-in apang taovin ahi.
target: My people consult a wooden idol, and a diviner’s rod speaks to them. A spirit of prostitution leads them astray; they are unfaithful to their God.

source: Amahon molchung ho-a ganlhaina aneijun, chule lhangvum ho-a gangpi phung, belkan phung, chule penal thingphung noiho chu alim anop jeh-in, gimnamtui ahaluvin ahi: hijeh chun nachanuteu kijoh dingu, chule naji teovin jonthanhoi aboldiu ahi.
target: They sacrifice on the mountaintops and burn offerings on the hills, under oak, poplar and terebinth, where the shade is pleasant. Therefore your daughters turn to prostitution and your daughters-in-law to adultery.

source: Nachanu teo akijoh uva, chule naji teovin jonthanhoi abol tengule, keiman talen kapeh louding ahi: ajehchu amaho kijoho-a konin akikhin doh-un, chule mijongho toh ganlhaina anei khomuvin ahi: hijeh-a chu ahethemlou mite chu lhuding ahiuve.
target: “I will not punish your daughters when they turn to prostitution, nor your daughters-in-law when they commit adultery, because the men themselves consort with harlots and sacrifice with shrine prostitutes— a people without understanding will come to ruin!

source: Israel nangman jonthanhoi panjong lechun, Judah kipal lhuhsah hih-in; chule nangho Gigal'a hunghih-un, Beth-aven'a jong chetouhih-un, chule Pakai ahing jinge tin jong kihahsel hih-un.
target: “Though you, Israel, commit adultery, do not let Judah become guilty. “Do not go to Gilgal; do not go up to Beth Aven. And do not swear, ‘As surely as the Lord lives!’

source: Ajehchu, bongla nungkih bangin Israel anungkih tai: Pakaiyin tuahi amaho chu munlen khatna kelngoinou banga avahding ahi.
target: The Israelites are stubborn, like a stubborn heifer. How then can the Lord pasture them like lambs in a meadow?

source: Ephraim'in milimho ajoptai: aum umin umsah-un.
target: Ephraim is joined to idols; leave him alone!

source: Amahon adonu chu athuh-in; amahon kijoh hinkho amang jingun ahi: avaihomhou vin jong jachat umtah-in angaichaove, nanghon peovin.
target: Even when their drinks are gone, they continue their prostitution; their rulers dearly love shameful ways.

source: Huijin alhaving teni-a amaho achepchah-in, chule akithoi nahou jeh-a jahcha ding ahiuve.
target: A whirlwind will sweep them away, and their sacrifices will bring them shame.

source: Vo thempuho, hichehi ngaijun; chule nangho Israel insung mite, ngaijun; vo leng insung mite, nanau hin sungun; ijeh inem itile thupi tanna chu nachung uva chuding ahi: ajehchu nangho Mizpah chunga thang nahiuvin, Tabor chunga lenthang kijah chu nahiuve.
target: “Hear this, you priests! Pay attention, you Israelites! Listen, royal house! This judgment is against you: You have been a snare at Mizpah, a net spread out on Tabor.

source: Keima amaho jouse phoh-a kahung panpeh vangin, thununglou ho chu tolthat hattah ahigam taove.
target: The rebels are knee-deep in slaughter. I will discipline all of them.

source: Keiman Ephraim kahenai, chule Israel chu kakoma konin akiseldehpoi; ajehchu tun, vo Ephraim nangma kijoh-in napangin, chule Israel suhboh-in aume.
target: I know all about Ephraim; Israel is not hidden from me. Ephraim, you have now turned to prostitution; Israel is corrupt.

source: Amahon a-Pathen'u heng lama kihei lutna dinga anatoh jouseu chu asemphat lou diu ahi: ajehchu noti hina chu amaho lah-a aumin, chule amahon Pakai chu ahepouve.
target: “Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God. A spirit of prostitution is in their heart; they do not acknowledge the Lord .

source: Chule Israel kiletsahna chun amaikoh-a ahettoh sah-in: hijeh-a chu Israel le Ephraim chu akhangitlou naova lhuding; Judah jong amani toh lhuhtha ding ahi.
target: Israel’s arrogance testifies against them; the Israelites, even Ephraim, stumble in their sin; Judah also stumbles with them.

source: Amaho aganchahou le akelngoi honhou toh Pakai holdinga chediu; hijongle amulou dingu ahi: Ama chu amaho-a konin akichon dohtai.
target: When they go with their flocks and herds to seek the Lord , they will not find him; he has withdrawn himself from them.

source: Amahon Pakai chunga kitahlou tah-in achon taove: ajehchu amahon gamchom chate ahing taovin ahi; tu-a hi amaho chu anei agou houtoh lhakhat sunga vallhuma umding ahiuve.
target: They are unfaithful to the Lord ; they give birth to illegitimate children. When they celebrate their New Moon feasts, he will devour their fields.

source: Nanghon Gibeah'a sumkon binei mut un, Ramah'a sumkon mut un: chule Beth-aven-a hasapmin samun, nanunglam ven, Vo Benjamin.
target: “Sound the trumpet in Gibeah, the horn in Ramah. Raise the battle cry in Beth Aven; lead on, Benjamin.

source: Kiphona nikhole Ephraim chu kamhel ding ahin; ahung umtei ding thilchu Israel phungho lah-a kahetsah ahitai.
target: Ephraim will be laid waste on the day of reckoning. Among the tribes of Israel I proclaim what is certain.

source: Judah pipuiho chu gamgi chon mang hotoh abangun ahi: hijeh achu achunguva kalung hana twibanga kabuh lhah ding ahi.
target: Judah’s leaders are like those who move boundary stones. I will pour out my wrath on them like a flood of water.

source: Lung thanom tah-a danthupeh ajui jeh-in; Ephraim aki suhgentheijin, thutan na-a suhsetnin aumtai.
target: Ephraim is oppressed, trampled in judgment, intent on pursuing idols.

source: Hijeh achu keima Ephraim dinga nget kabah ding, chule Judah insung dinga lung kabahding ahi.
target: I am like a moth to Ephraim, like rot to the people of Judah.

source: Ephraim'in anatna amua, Judah'in amaputna amuphatnin, Ephraim chu Assyria te koma ache-in, chule leng Jareb koma akisolin ahi: ahinla aman nadamsah joupon, chule namaha hojong asudam joupon ahi.
target: “When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his sores, then Ephraim turned to Assyria, and sent to the great king for help. But he is not able to cure you, not able to heal your sores.

source: Ajehchu keima Ephraim dinga keipi bahkai tobang kahia, Judah insung dinga keipi bahkai khangdong tobang kahiding ahi: Keima, keima tah-in kabotela kache mang ding; kalah manga, koiman ahuhdoh louding ahi.
target: For I will be like a lion to Ephraim, like a great lion to Judah. I will tear them to pieces and go away; I will carry them off, with no one to rescue them.

source: Amahon agitlounau akihetdoh uva chule kamai ahinhol tokah seuva, keima kache-a kaumna mun'a kakile kitding ahi: agenthei naova keima eihin hol paidiu ahi.
target: Then I will return to my lair until they have borne their guilt and seek my face— in their misery they will earnestly seek me.”

source: Hunguvo, Pakai koma kile taohite, ajehchu aman abotel ahin, aman eidamsah dingu ahi; aman eijepmu ahin, aman eitompeh diu ahi.
target: “Come, let us return to the Lord . He has torn us to pieces but he will heal us; he has injured us but he will bind up our wounds.

source: Nini joule aman eisuhhal diu ahi; nithum nile eikai thoudiu, chule eiho ama mitmu-a ihindiu ahi.
target: After two days he will revive us; on the third day he will restore us, that we may live in his presence.

source: Eihon Pakai chu het dinga ijuijuva ahile ihet diu ahi; ama vaikon doh chu jingkah banga gontupsa ahin; leisetna go masale go nunung ajuh banga, ama ichunguva go banga hung juding ahi.
target: Let us acknowledge the Lord ; let us press on to acknowledge him. As surely as the sun rises, he will appear; he will come to us like the winter rains, like the spring rains that water the earth.”

source: Vo Ephraim, keiman nangma i-kalo ding nahim? Vo Judah, keiman nangma i-kalo ding nahim? Ajehchu naphatna chu jingkah meibol tobang ahin, chule jing daitwi bangin achemang jitai.
target: “What can I do with you, Ephraim? What can I do with you, Judah? Your love is like the morning mist, like the early dew that disappears.

source: Hijeh achu keiman amahochu themgaoho mangcha-a kalhamlhah ahitan; kakamsung thuchenga amahochu katha ahitai: chule nathu tanhou chu khovah kikhodoh tobang ahi.
target: Therefore I cut you in pieces with my prophets, I killed you with the words of my mouth— then my judgments go forth like the sun.

source: Ajehchu keiman ganlhaina sangin hepina kadei jon; govam thilto sangin Pathen hetna chu kadeijon ahi.
target: For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and acknowledgment of God rather than burnt offerings.

source: Ahivangin amahon mihemte bangin kitepna apalkeh-un; keiman dounan kitahlou tah-in achonuvin ahi.
target: As at Adam, they have broken the covenant; they were unfaithful to me there.

source: Gilead chu khangitlou bolho khopi ahin, chule thisanin akisuhboh-in ahi.
target: Gilead is a city of evildoers, stained with footprints of blood.

source: Gucha michom hon mi angailhih bangun, hiti chun thempu hon Shechem lampia athatnun ahi: ajehchu amahon jonthanhoina abolun ahi.
target: As marauders lie in ambush for a victim, so do bands of priests; they murder on the road to Shechem, carrying out their wicked schemes.

source: Keiman Israel insunga tijat umtah thil kamui; chua chun Ephraim kijohna aumin, Israel suhboh-in aume.
target: I have seen a horrible thing in Israel: There Ephraim is given to prostitution, Israel is defiled.

source: Chujongle, Vo Judah, keiman kamite sohchan na-a kona kahin lepui kit phatle, aman nangma dinga chang atding nakoipeh ding ahi.
target: “Also for you, Judah, a harvest is appointed. “Whenever I would restore the fortunes of my people,

source: Keiman Israel kasuhdam phat tengle, Ephraim khangit louna le Samaria gitlouna chu kimudoh ding ahi: ajehchu amahon jou abolun; chule gucha alutnin, chule michom hon polama achomun ahi.
target: whenever I would heal Israel, the sins of Ephraim are exposed and the crimes of Samaria revealed. They practice deceit, thieves break into houses, bandits rob in the streets;

source: Chule keiman akhansetnao abonchan kahei tihi alungun ageldoh pouve; tun athilbol houchun amaho aumchah-u ahitai; amaho kamai koh-a akilange.
target: but they do not realize that I remember all their evil deeds. Their sins engulf them; they are always before me.

source: Amahon akhansetna houvin lengho akipa sah-un; chule pipuiho chu ajousei uvin akipasah uvin ahi.
target: “They delight the king with their wickedness, the princes with their lies.

source: Amaho abonchauva mijong ahiuvin, changlhah kangpan achangbong ameh jouva, chol achansoh masangse-a, thingkho chumlouva thuhsung ahulsat tobang ahiuvin ahi.
target: They are all adulterers, burning like an oven whose fire the baker need not stir from the kneading of the dough till it rises.

source: Kalengpao nikholaijin pipuihon amachu juhaijin ana natsah-un; aman mijontai ho toh akhut ajahkhomin ahi.
target: On the day of the festival of our king the princes become inflamed with wine, and he joins hands with the mockers.

source: Ajehchu amahon alupmuva mi angailhih sungun, alungsungu chu thuhsung bangin kigosa demin akoijun: achanglhah kangpao chu jankhovah-in a-imun; jingkah-in meikong bangin ana ka-in ahi.
target: Their hearts are like an oven; they approach him with intrigue. Their passion smolders all night; in the morning it blazes like a flaming fire.

source: Amaho abonchauvin thuhsung bangin asa-un, athutanhou aval lhumun; alenghou alhu gam taovin: amaholah-a keima eikouva khatcha aumpon ahi.
target: All of them are hot as an oven; they devour their rulers. All their kings fall, and none of them calls on me.

source: Ephraim amatah miho toh akichohhal tai; Ephraim chu changlhah kilehlou ahi.
target: “Ephraim mixes with the nations; Ephraim is a flat loaf not turned over.

source: Gamchom mihon athahatna aval lhumpeh-un, ahin aman hichu ahepon ahi: henge, achunga samho adon donna akhangtan, ahinla aman ahedoh dehpon ahi.
target: Foreigners sap his strength, but he does not realize it. His hair is sprinkled with gray, but he does not notice.

source: Israel akiletsahna chun amai koh-a ahettohsah-in; ahin Pakai a-Pathen'u henga chun akile pouvin, chule hicheng jeh hin holjong aholdeh pon ahi.
target: Israel’s arrogance testifies against him, but despite all this he does not return to the Lord his God or search for him.

source: Ephraim jonghi lungthimbei vakhu ngoltah tobang ahi: amahon Egypt akouvun, Assyria henga acheuve.
target: “Ephraim is like a dove, easily deceived and senseless— now calling to Egypt, now turning to Assyria.

source: Amaho ache phatnule, achunguva kalen kajahkhum ding; amaho chu chungleng vachaho banga kahin puilhah ding, chule houkhom hon ana jahsao banga, amaho chu kasehgim ding ahi.
target: When they go, I will throw my net over them; I will pull them down like the birds in the sky. When I hear them flocking together, I will catch them.

source: Ohe amaho ada ahiuve! ajehchu amaho keija konin ajam mangun ahi. Manthah na chu amaho-a ahi! ajehchu keima dounan asukhelun: keiman amaho kalhatdoh vangin, amahon keima dounan jouthuho aseijun ahi.
target: Woe to them, because they have strayed from me! Destruction to them, because they have rebelled against me! I long to redeem them but they speak about me falsely.

source: Amaho ajalkhun chunguva apenu chun, alungsung tah-un keima eikou pouvin; amaho nehle chah le ju ngaitonan akikhomun, chule keima dounan akiphinun ahi.
target: They do not cry out to me from their hearts but wail on their beds. They slash themselves, appealing to their gods for grain and new wine, but they turn away from me.

source: Keiman amaho gotna kapeh-a abanthau kahatsah vangin, amahon keima dounan thilphalou lungin agelun ahi.
target: I trained them and strengthened their arms, but they plot evil against me.

source: Amaho ahung kiheijun, ahivangin hat chungnung pa lam ahipoi; amaho lheplhahna dim thalchang tobang ahiuve. Apipui houchu aham hoithou jeh-a chemjam'a lhuding ahiuve. Hichehi Egypt gamsunga amaho kinuisatna hiding ahi.
target: They do not turn to the Most High; they are like a faulty bow. Their leaders will fall by the sword because of their insolent words. For this they will be ridiculed in the land of Egypt.

source: Sumkon chu namuhto suton. Ama Pakai insung douna-a muvanlai banga hungding ahi; ajehchu amahon kakitepna apalkeh-un, chule ka danthu dounan asukhel taove.
target: “Put the trumpet to your lips! An eagle is over the house of the Lord because the people have broken my covenant and rebelled against my law.

source: Ka Pathen, keihon nangma kaheuve, tia Israel chu kaheng lama hung pengding ahi.
target: Israel cries out to me, ‘Our God, we acknowledge you!’

source: Israel'in thilpha chu alemang ahitan; melma chun ama anungdel ding ahi.
target: But Israel has rejected what is good; an enemy will pursue him.

source: Keima-a kon hilouvin, amahon lengho akitundoh uvin; amahon apipuiho akisemun, hichu keiman kahepha poi; paidoh-a aum nadiuvin, adangka le sana houvin milim akisemun ahi.
target: They set up kings without my consent; they choose princes without my approval. With their silver and gold they make idols for themselves to their own destruction.

source: Vo Samaria, nabongnou vin nangma napampai ahitan; kalung hana nangma douna-a koudoh ahitai: monabei ahina dingu chu itih chan hinalai dingham?
target: Samaria, throw out your calf-idol! My anger burns against them. How long will they be incapable of purity?

source: Ajehchu Israel'a kona jong chuti ahi: khutthem miho thilsem ahin, hijeh chun Pathen ahipoi: ahin Samaria bongnou chu ahal hala kisu chipding ahi.
target: They are from Israel! This calf—a metalworker has made it; it is not God. It will be broken in pieces, that calf of Samaria.

source: Ajehchu amahon hui chu muchi tu-a atu-u ahin, chimpei aki-at diu ahi: hichun kung aneipon, adonjong chun nehding agadoh sah louding ahi: hung gadoh nama jongle, hichu gamdang mihon avalhum ding ahi.
target: “They sow the wind and reap the whirlwind. The stalk has no head; it will produce no flour. Were it to yield grain, foreigners would swallow it up.

source: Israel vallhumin aumtai; tun amaho chu vannoi'a chidang namdangho lah-a lunglhaina umlou bel tobang hiding ahiuve.
target: Israel is swallowed up; now she is among the nations like something no one wants.

source: Ajehchu amaho gamlah-a sangan changlhat bangin, Assyria heng lama achetouvun ahi: Ephraim'in kideipi ding akithalah-e.
target: For they have gone up to Assyria like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has sold herself to lovers.

source: Henge, amaho namtinna kon thalah lajongleu, tu-a hi keiman amaho kapuikhom ding, chule leng le pipuiho pohgih jeh-a phat chomkhat lunghem ding ahiuve.
target: Although they have sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them together. They will begin to waste away under the oppression of the mighty king.

source: Ephraim'in chonsetna dinga maicham tamtah asem jeh-in, maicham hochu amadinga chonsetna ding ahung hitai.
target: “Though Ephraim built many altars for sin offerings, these have become altars for sinning.

source: Keiman ama henga kadan thu lentah ho chu kasut ahitan, hijongle hicheho chu hetphahlou bangin akingaito tai.
target: I wrote for them the many things of my law, but they regarded them as something foreign.

source: Amahon kahenga ganlhai thilto dingin sa atoh-un, chule hichu amahon aneuvin; ahinla Pakaiyin hihochu asanpeh pon ahi. Tun aman amaho khangitlouna ageldoh-a, chule achonset nau chunga thu atanding ahi. Amaho Egypt'a kinung leding ahiuve.
target: Though they offer sacrifices as gifts to me, and though they eat the meat, the Lord is not pleased with them. Now he will remember their wickedness and punish their sins: They will return to Egypt.

source: Ajehchu Israel'in asempa sumilin, houin ho asan; chule Juda'in kulpi nei khopi apunsah-in ahi; hijongle keiman akhopihou chunga mei kasol ding, hichun chua aleng inpihou akahchai ding ahi.
target: Israel has forgotten their Maker and built palaces; Judah has fortified many towns. But I will send fire on their cities that will consume their fortresses.”

source: Vo Israel, midangte kipa bangin kipah hih-in; ajehchu nangma na Pathen'a konin napotdoh-in nakijoh-in, changphol takip chunga tohman nangai chan ahi.
target: Do not rejoice, Israel; do not be jubilant like the other nations. For you have been unfaithful to your God; you love the wages of a prostitute at every threshing floor.

source: Changphol le lengpitwi chilna chun amaho avasah louding, chule amanu-a chu lengpitwi thah thonding ahi.
target: Threshing floors and winepresses will not feed the people; the new wine will fail them.

source: Amahochu Pakai gamsunga cheng louding ahiuvin; Ephraim vangchu Egypt gama kile ding, chule Assyria gamsunga thilthenglou anehdiu ahi.
target: They will not remain in the Lord ’s land; Ephraim will return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Assyria.

source: Amahon Pakaiya dinga lengpitwi thilto atoloudiu, chujongle amaho ama-a dinga lunglhaina hideh loudingu ahi. Aganlhaina hou jong amaho dinga lunghemho changlhah bangding; anejouseu suhboh-a umding ahi: ajehchu achanglhah-u chu ahinna dingu maimai hiding, hichu Pakai insung hunglut louding ahi.
target: They will not pour out wine offerings to the Lord , nor will their sacrifices please him. Such sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat them will be unclean. This food will be for themselves; it will not come into the temple of the Lord .

source: Nanghon chuche niloupi, Pakai kut loupi nikho chule ipi boltauvin natem?
target: What will you do on the day of your appointed festivals, on the feast days of the Lord ?

source: Ajehchu, veovin, amaho kisuhgamna jeh-a chemang ahitaove: Egypt'in akhop khomuva, Memphis in avuidingu ahi. Adangka kholnau mun nomho chu sachah ling dimding, chule ahoubuh sung houva lingho kehding ahi.
target: Even if they escape from destruction, Egypt will gather them, and Memphis will bury them. Their treasures of silver will be taken over by briers, and thorns will overrun their tents.

source: Gotna kipeh nading nikhoho ahung lhungtan, kilethuhna nikhoho ahung lhungtai; Israel'in hichu ahet ding ahi: nakhan gitlounao dimset jehle, hotna lentah umho jeh chun, themgao chu mingol ahin, lhagaomi chu angol ahi.
target: The days of punishment are coming, the days of reckoning are at hand. Let Israel know this. Because your sins are so many and your hostility so great, the prophet is considered a fool, the inspired person a maniac.

source: Ephraim khongahpa chu ka-Pathen toh umkhom ahin, amavang themgao chu alampi jouse-a vachathang kampa thang ahin, chule kihot bolna a-Pathen insunga aume.
target: The prophet, along with my God, is the watchman over Ephraim, yet snares await him on all his paths, and hostility in the house of his God.

source: Sibeah nikholaia bangin amahole amaho akisuseuvin: hijeh-a chu aman akhan gitlounao amelchih ding, chule achonsetnao chunga gotna apeh ding ahi.
target: They have sunk deep into corruption, as in the days of Gibeah. God will remember their wickedness and punish them for their sins.

source: Keiman Israel chu lengpithei ga banga gamthipma kanamu ahin; napateu chu theichang phunga ga min masa banga kakimudoh ahi. Ahivangin amaho Baal-peor lama acheuvin, chule hiche jachat umtah mun'a chun akikhinlut taove; amaho thet umtah ahinao chu adeichat banguva umdoh ahitai.
target: “When I found Israel, it was like finding grapes in the desert; when I saw your ancestors, it was like seeing the early fruit on the fig tree. But when they came to Baal Peor, they consecrated themselves to that shameful idol and became as vile as the thing they loved.

source: Ephraim dinga vang, apen napat, naobu sunga pat, chule akijila pat, aloupina hochu vacha banga lengmang ding ahi.
target: Ephraim’s glory will fly away like a bird— no birth, no pregnancy, no conception.

source: Amahon achateu lentah-in vahdoh jongleu, keiman amaho chu kalahmang ding, hitia chu mikhat jengjong kidalha lou ding ahi: henge, keima amaho-a kona kapotdoh tengle, ohe amahochu ada ahiuve!
target: Even if they rear children, I will bereave them of every one. Woe to them when I turn away from them!

source: Tyre kanamu banga, Ephriam chu leimun nom laija kiphut ahin; ahinla Ephraim'in achate chu tolthatpa koma apuiding ahi.
target: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place. But Ephraim will bring out their children to the slayer.”

source: Vo Pakai amaho chu pen; nangin napeh ding chu ipiham? amaho chu naojul lhahna naobu le noitwi kanna chu pen.
target: Give them, Lord — what will you give them? Give them wombs that miscarry and breasts that are dry.

source: Agitlouna jouseu chu Gilgal'a aume: ajehchu hiche mun'a chu keiman amaho kanathet ahi. Agitlounau jeh-a keiman amaho ka-in'a kona kanodoh ding, kangailut kit tah louding ahi: apipuihou abonuva thununglou ahiuve.
target: “Because of all their wickedness in Gilgal, I hated them there. Because of their sinful deeds, I will drive them out of my house. I will no longer love them; all their leaders are rebellious.

source: Ephraim chu akivon, ajungu jong agolhatai, amahon ga aneilou diu ahi: henge, hinsepdoh jongleu, angailut alaigilgau jengjong kathading ahi.
target: Ephraim is blighted, their root is withered, they yield no fruit. Even if they bear children, I will slay their cherished offspring.”

source: Amahon athu angailou jeh uva, ka Pathen'in amaho apaidoh ding ahi: chule amaho namtin lah-a vahvei dingu ahi.
target: My God will reject them because they have not obeyed him; they will be wanderers among the nations.

source: Israel chu agabei lengpigui ahi, aman agachu ama dingseh-in asosah-in ahi. Aga atam dungjuijin maicham ho apunsah-in; agamsung phatna dungjuijin milim hoitahtah akisemuve.
target: Israel was a spreading vine; he brought forth fruit for himself. As his fruit increased, he built more altars; as his land prospered, he adorned his sacred stones.

source: Alungthimu akikhen tai; tu-a hi adihlouna kimudoh ding ahi. Aman amaicham hou asuhkeh ding, amilim semthuhou asuhmang ding ahi.
target: Their heart is deceitful, and now they must bear their guilt. The Lord will demolish their altars and destroy their sacred stones.

source: Ajehchu tu-a hi amahon, Pakai chu igin tahlou jeh-un eiho leng bei ihiuve, achutile lengchun eiho ipi eibol pehdiu ham? tia asei dingu ahi.
target: Then they will say, “We have no king because we did not revere the Lord . But even if we had a king, what could he do for us?”

source: Amahon thu aseijun, kitepna asemun jouvin akihahselun ahi. Hijeh chun thutanna chu lou kikaina nunga kehdoh hampa gunei bangin, ahung kehdoh-in ahi.
target: They make many promises, take false oaths and make agreements; therefore lawsuits spring up like poisonous weeds in a plowed field.

source: Samaria chengho chu Beth-aven'a bongnouho jeh-a kicha ding ahiuve. Ajehchu chuche-a kona loupina kitoldoh jeh-a chu, mipi ho lunghemuva, thempuhon hichu akipapi dingu ahi.
target: The people who live in Samaria fear for the calf-idol of Beth Aven. Its people will mourn over it, and so will its idolatrous priests, those who had rejoiced over its splendor, because it is taken from them into exile.

source: Hichu leng Jareb pehdinga Assyria henga kipuiding; Ephraim jachat changding, chule Israel jong amatah thumop jeh-a jahchading ahi.
target: It will be carried to Assyria as tribute for the great king. Ephraim will be disgraced; Israel will be ashamed of its foreign alliances.

source: Samaria ahile, alengpa chu twi chunga twiphon banga kisat lhading ahi.
target: Samaria’s king will be destroyed, swept away like a twig on the surface of the waters.

source: Israel chonsetna, Aven munsang ho jong chu kisumang ding: amaicham hou chunga lingle meithai sel tholing hung kehdoh ding; chule amahon molsangho jah-a, neikhu khumun; chule lhangho jah-a, neilhuh khumun, ati dingu ahi.
target: The high places of wickedness will be destroyed— it is the sin of Israel. Thorns and thistles will grow up and cover their altars. Then they will say to the mountains, “Cover us!” and to the hills, “Fall on us!”

source: Vo Israel, nangho Gibeah nikholai japat chonsea nahitaovin; amaho chuachun ading jingun ahi. Khanggilou chate douna-a Gibeah mun'a gal kisat chun amaho anaphapon ahi.
target: “Since the days of Gibeah, you have sinned, Israel, and there you have remained. Will not war again overtake the evildoers in Gibeah?

source: Amaho sehgim dingchu keima lungdei ahi; chule amaho achonkhelnao thil ni jeh-a akikan tengule, amaho doudinga mipi hung kikhom ding ahiuve.
target: When I please, I will punish them; nations will be gathered against them to put them in bonds for their double sin.

source: Chule Ephraim bongla lahsa tobang ahin, chang childing atha anomin ahi; ahinla keiman amanu ngong hoitah chung chu kapal galkaijin ahi: Ephraim chu achunga touna dinga kasema; Judah'in lou akaiding, chule Jacob'in aleilhangho asuhbong ding ahi.
target: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh; so I will put a yoke on her fair neck. I will drive Ephraim, Judah must plow, and Jacob must break up the ground.

source: Nangma nangma-a dingin chonphatna muchi tun kitun, hepina in at-nin; naleiset khoikeh louchu khoikeh-in: ajehchu ama ahunga chonphatna nachunga gojuh-a ajuhsah masangse-a, tuhi Pakai holphat tah chu ahi.
target: Sow righteousness for yourselves, reap the fruit of unfailing love, and break up your unplowed ground; for it is time to seek the Lord , until he comes and showers his righteousness on you.

source: Nanghon gitlouna lou kaijin nakaijun, khangit louna na-at nun; lepche ga naneuve: ajehchu nanghon nangho lampi sehsehle, namihat tamtah hou bou natahsanun ahi.
target: But you have planted wickedness, you have reaped evil, you have eaten the fruit of deception. Because you have depended on your own strength and on your many warriors,

source: Hijeh-a chu namite lah-a lungling laona khat hung sohding, Shalman'in galsat nikho-a Beth-arbel asuhmang banga, nakulpiu det jouse kisuseding ahi: Minu chu achate chunga ahal halin akitat kehtai.
target: the roar of battle will rise against your people, so that all your fortresses will be devastated— as Shalman devastated Beth Arbel on the day of battle, when mothers were dashed to the ground with their children.

source: Hiche banga chu nakhan gitlouna aletjeh-a Bethel'in nachunga na atoh ding ahi; jingkah lamle Israel lengpa chu kisumang helding ahi.
target: So will it happen to you, Bethel, because your wickedness is great. When that day dawns, the king of Israel will be completely destroyed.

source: Israel chu chapang cha ahilaijin, keiman kana ngailun, chule Egypt gama konin kachapa kakou doh-in ahi.
target: “When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.

source: Amahon akou bangun, chutichun amaho-a konin achemangun; Baal henga ganlhaina anabolun, chule semthu limho henga gimnamtui ahalun ahi.
target: But the more they were called, the more they went away from me. They sacrificed to the Baals and they burned incense to images.

source: Keiman Ephraim jong akhut uvin katuh-in, cheje dan kana hilin; ahivangin keiman kadamsah-u ahilam ahepouve.
target: It was I who taught Ephraim to walk, taking them by the arms; but they did not realize it was I who healed them.

source: Keiman amaho pasal khaohol le, ngailutna khaoguijin kanakaije: keima amaho dinga angong uva kona anamkoljon'u lahdoh pehpa tobang kanahin, chule anehdiu kana luipeh-in ahi.
target: I led them with cords of human kindness, with ties of love. To them I was like one who lifts a little child to the cheek, and I bent down to feed them.

source: Ama Egypt gama kinungle louding, amaho hung kile ding ada jeh uva, Assyria te chu alengpa hiding ahi.
target: “Will they not return to Egypt and will not Assyria rule over them because they refuse to repent?

source: Chule akhopihou chunga chemjam umding, amaho le amaho kithumopna jeh-a, abahho jouse akahvama, asuhmang ding ahi.
target: A sword will flash in their cities; it will devour their false prophets and put an end to their plans.

source: Chule kamite keija kona kinungtol kitdin akonsuh uvin: amahon amaho chu hat chungnung penpa koma dinga akou vangun, khatchan jong achoisang pouvin ahi.
target: My people are determined to turn from me. Even though they call me God Most High, I will by no means exalt them.

source: Ephraim, keiman nangma iti kadonda dingham? Israel, keiman nangma iti kapehdoh dingham? keiman nangma iti Admah tobang kasosah dingham? keiman nangma iti Zeboiim tobanga kakoi dingham? Kasunga kalungthim akileh-in, kakisih naho meijin akonge.
target: “How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I treat you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboyim? My heart is changed within me; all my compassion is aroused.

source: Keiman kalungsat tijat umtah chu sodohsah pongting, Ephraim sumang dingin hung kinungle ponge: ajehchu keima Pathen kahin, mihem kahipoi; nalah uva Atheng chu kahi: chule khopi sunga lutponge.
target: I will not carry out my fierce anger, nor will I devastate Ephraim again. For I am God, and not a man— the Holy One among you. I will not come against their cities.

source: Amaho Pakai deija chonding ahiuvin: ama keipi bahkai banga kitumding ahi. Ama akitum phatle, lhumlama kona achate kithing puma hungding ahiuve.
target: They will follow the Lord ; he will roar like a lion. When he roars, his children will come trembling from the west.

source: Amaho Egypt gama kona vacha bangle, Assyria gama kon vakhu banga kithing puma hungding ahiuve. Chule keiman a-incheh uva kachensah ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: They will come from Egypt, trembling like sparrows, from Assyria, fluttering like doves. I will settle them in their homes,” declares the Lord .

source: Ephraim chun joule nalin, chule Israel insungin lepchenan eikim velun ahi. Ahin Judah vang Pathen toh avaihom khomin, chule mitheng hoto tahsana-in aumin ahi.
target: Ephraim has surrounded me with lies, Israel with deceit. And Judah is unruly against God, even against the faithful Holy One.

source: Ephraim huijin akivah-in, chule solam huichu anung ajuije: aman niseh-in joule gamna apunsah-in, amahon Assyria te toh kitepna asemun, chule thaotwi Egypt gama apolut uve.
target: Ephraim feeds on the wind; he pursues the east wind all day and multiplies lies and violence. He makes a treaty with Assyria and sends olive oil to Egypt.

source: Pakaiyin Judah to jong kinel kalna aneijin, chule Jacob chu achonnaho dungjuija talen apehding; atoh dungjuija alethuhding ahi.
target: The Lord has a charge to bring against Judah; he will punish Jacob according to his ways and repay him according to his deeds.

source: Aman naobu sunga aumpetnin asopipa khotaljum atuh-in, chule athahatna-in Pathen toh akibonin ahi.
target: In the womb he grasped his brother’s heel; as a man he struggled with God.

source: Henge, aman vantil toh akibonin, ajouvin; ama akapmin, ahenga ngehna ananeije: aman amachu Bethel'a amudoh-in, chule aman hia chun eiho henga thu aseije.
target: He struggled with the angel and overcame him; he wept and begged for his favor. He found him at Bethel and talked with him there—

source: Janel ho Pakai Pathen ngeichu, Pakai kiti chu ama hetjingna min ahi.
target: the Lord God Almighty, the Lord is his name!

source: Hijeh chun, na-Pathen heng lama kiheijin; hepina le thutana nitnin, chule na-Pathen ngahjing jengin.
target: But you must return to your God; maintain love and justice, and wait for your God always.

source: Amachu sumkolvei ahin, lepchena khaikot akhutna aume; aman mi suhgenthei ding adeijin ahi.
target: The merchant uses dishonest scales and loves to defraud.

source: Chule Ephraim'in hitin aseije, keima kahaotan, thilpha kakimu dohtai; chule katoh naho jouse-a amahon keima-a chonset kiti khangitlouna amudoh loudingu ahi, ati.
target: Ephraim boasts, “I am very rich; I have become wealthy. With all my wealth they will not find in me any iniquity or sin.”

source: Egypt gama kipatna keima Pakai na-Pathen hia kahin, kut loupi nikho laiho banga, houbuh sunga kachensah ding nahi.
target: “I have been the Lord your God ever since you came out of Egypt; I will make you live in tents again, as in the days of your appointed festivals.

source: Keiman themgao ho-a konin jong thu kaseijin, chule themgao thilmuho kapunsah-in, chule themgaoho lhacha natoh na-a konin, limle mel kibahpiho kamangchan ahi.
target: I spoke to the prophets, gave them many visions and told parables through them.”

source: Gilead gamsunga khangitlouna umem? tahbeh-in amaho ahomkeo ahiuve. Amahon Gilgal'a bongchalin ganlhaina aboluvin; henge, amaicham semhou chu louva leilhang kisetoh abanguve.
target: Is Gilead wicked? Its people are worthless! Do they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal? Their altars will be like piles of stones on a plowed field.

source: Chule Jacob Syria thinglhang lama ajamlutnin, Israel jiding lonan sohna atongin, chule jiding lonan kelngoi chingin apange.
target: Jacob fled to the country of Aram; Israel served to get a wife, and to pay for her he tended sheep.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin themgao amangchan Israel chu Egypt gama konin apuidoh-in, chule themgao mangchan venbitnin aume.
target: The Lord used a prophet to bring Israel up from Egypt, by a prophet he cared for him.

source: Ephraim'in amachu nasatah-in alunghan sah-in: hijeh-a chu athisan chu amachunga adalhah ding, chule ami phosalna chu Pakaiyin ama alepeh ding ahi.
target: But Ephraim has aroused his bitter anger; his Lord will leave on him the guilt of his bloodshed and will repay him for his contempt.

source: Ephraim'in kithing pumpuma thu asei laijin, amale ama Israel sunga akidomsangin; ahivangin Baal houna-a akipal phatnin, athi tan ahi.
target: When Ephraim spoke, people trembled; he was exalted in Israel. But he became guilty of Baal worship and died.

source: Chule tun amaho achonse chehcheh-un, adangka hou milim din akisemun, chule ahetnao dungjuijin alim semthu akisemun, aboncha chu khut themhon asemu ahi: chule amahon, ganlhaina neihochun hiche bongnou limho chu chophen, tin aseijun ahi.
target: Now they sin more and more; they make idols for themselves from their silver, cleverly fashioned images, all of them the work of craftsmen. It is said of these people, “They offer human sacrifices! They kiss calf-idols!”

source: Hijeh-a chu amaho jingkah meibol, amangloi chelji matah-a um daitwi, changphola kona chimpeijin alhohmangji changsi, chule thuhsunga kona potdoh meikhu tobang hiding ahiuve.
target: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the early dew that disappears, like chaff swirling from a threshing floor, like smoke escaping through a window.

source: Ahinla keima Egypt gama kona Pakai le na-Pathen'u hunghipeh kahin, chule nanghon keima tailou Pathen dang nahetlou dingu ahi. Ajehchu keima tailou huhhingpu dang aumpoi.
target: “But I have been the Lord your God ever since you came out of Egypt. You shall acknowledge no God but me, no Savior except me.

source: Keiman nangho gamthip gam, nasatah-a gojuh louna gama kanahetsa nahiuve.
target: I cared for you in the wilderness, in the land of burning heat.

source: Agamuva hamhingho dungjuijin, amaho a-oiva uvin, amaho a-oiva uvin, alungthimun akichoisangun; hijeh chun keima eisumil taove.
target: When I fed them, they were satisfied; when they were satisfied, they became proud; then they forgot me.

source: Hijeh-a chu keima amaho dinga keipi bahkai toh kabah ding, chule lampi-a lutnu banga kavet lhihdiu ahi.
target: So I will be like a lion to them, like a leopard I will lurk by the path.

source: Keiman anou kilahpeh vompi banga amaho kakimaito piding, anahgu bomlah-u kabo jalding; chule chumuna chu keipi bahkai banga amaho kabah gamding: gamsa hon abotel dingu ahi.
target: Like a bear robbed of her cubs, I will attack them and rip them open; like a lion I will devour them— a wild animal will tear them apart.

source: Vo Israel, nangmale nangma kisumang nahi; ahivangin keima-a nangma panpi ding aume.
target: “You are destroyed, Israel, because you are against me, against your helper.

source: Keima nalengpau kahiding: nakhopiu pumpi sungahi nahuhhing theidiuva koidang hoija umem? chule, lengpa le pipuiho neipeuvin, tia naseinao navaipo hou chu hoija um hiuvem?
target: Where is your king, that he may save you? Where are your rulers in all your towns, of whom you said, ‘Give me a king and princes’?

source: Keiman kalunghana-in nangho lengkhat kapeuvin, chule kalungsatna-in amachu kalahmang peh uve.
target: So in my anger I gave you a king, and in my wrath I took him away.

source: Ephraim khansetna chu kanchah-in aumin; achonsetna chu selin aumin ahi.
target: The guilt of Ephraim is stored up, his sins are kept on record.

source: Numei naovop hesohnaho chu amachunga hung lhungding ahi. Ama chapa chinglou ahi; ajehchu ama chate hungpen dohna mun'a chu umsot louding ahi.
target: Pains as of a woman in childbirth come to him, but he is a child without wisdom; when the time arrives, he doesn’t have the sense to come out of the womb.

source: Keiman amahochu lhankhuh thanei na-a kona man kapeh-a kachoh dohding; keiman thina-a kona kalhatdoh dingu ahi. Vo thina, keima nanatna kahiding, Vo thikholkhul keima nakisuh manga kahiding ahi! kamit mu-a kona lungheina chu kiselmang ding ahi.
target: “I will deliver this people from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death. Where, O death, are your plagues? Where, O grave, is your destruction? “I will have no compassion,

source: Ama asopite lah-a ga phatah hijongle, solam hui hungnung ding, gamthip gama kon Pakai hui chu hungnung ding, chule atuisam putna hung kanga, chule atuibul hung kangding: aman agou kholnau bel hoitahho jouse asuhset ding ahi.
target: even though he thrives among his brothers. An east wind from the Lord will come, blowing in from the desert; his spring will fail and his well dry up. His storehouse will be plundered of all its treasures.

source: Samaria kamhel ding ahi; ajehchu amanun a-Pathen adouvin ahi. Amaho chemjam'a lhudiu, achasen hou ahal hala kitat chipding, chule anumei naovop hou chu kikhejal ding ahi.
target: The people of Samaria must bear their guilt, because they have rebelled against their God. They will fall by the sword; their little ones will be dashed to the ground, their pregnant women ripped open.”

source: Vo Israel, Pakai na-Pathen koma kile kitnin, ajehchu nangma nakhan gitlouna-a lhu nahitai.
target: Return, Israel, to the Lord your God. Your sins have been your downfall!

source: Thuho chu ponlang, Pakai henga kile kitnin. Ahenga, Khangitlouna jouse lamangin, lungset tah-in nei sangun: hitia chu keihon kakamuva kilhaina kapeh dingu ahi.
target: Take words with you and return to the Lord . Say to him: “Forgive all our sins and receive us graciously, that we may offer the fruit of our lips.

source: Asshur in eihuhhing pouvintin; keiho sakol ho chunga tou pouvinge: chule kakhutsoh hou henga chun, nangho ka-pathen'u nahiuve tinjong seitapou vinge. Ajehchu nangma-a bou panei louten hepina amuvin ahi, tin seijun.
target: Assyria cannot save us; we will not mount warhorses. We will never again say ‘Our gods’ to what our own hands have made, for in you the fatherless find compassion.”

source: Keiman akinung tolnao chu kasuhgampeh-a, manbeija amaho kangailut dingu ahi; ajehchu kalungsatna amaho-a konin akihei mangtai.
target: “I will heal their waywardness and love them freely, for my anger has turned away from them.

source: Keima Israel dingin daitwi tobang hing ting; ama lily pahcha banga khang tou ding, chule ajungho chu Lebanon banga jamdoh ding ahi.
target: I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like a lily. Like a cedar of Lebanon he will send down his roots;

source: Abahho chu jamdoh-in tin, ahoina chu olive thingphung bang hiding, chule Lebanon banga namtui ding ahi.
target: his young shoots will grow. His splendor will be like an olive tree, his fragrance like a cedar of Lebanon.

source: Ama lhalim noija chengte chu hung kileuvintin; chang banga kidodoh kitnuva, lengpitwi banga khang dingu ahi. Chule chu-a anamtui chu Lebanon'a lengpitwi tobang hiding ahi.
target: People will dwell again in his shade; they will flourish like the grain, they will blossom like the vine— Israel’s fame will be like the wine of Lebanon.

source: Ephraim'in, alim semthu ho-a hi ipi-a kapansah nahlai ding ham? Keiman athusei kajan, chule ama kamutai. Keima theichang phung adohing tobang kahi, atiding ahi. Keima-a kona naga kimu-a ahi.
target: Ephraim, what more have I to do with idols? I will answer him and care for him. I am like a flourishing juniper; your fruitfulness comes from me.”

source: Koiham miching? chule hiche thil ho hi hethem hen. Koiham milungching? hicheho chu hehen; ajehchu Pakai lampi ho chu adih ahin, chule midih chu hiho-a chu lamlha ding ahi. Ahinla suhkhelna neihochu hiche-a chu lhuding ahiuve.
target: Who is wise? Let them realize these things. Who is discerning? Let them understand. The ways of the Lord are right; the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.

source: Pathuel chapa Joel henga Pakai thu hung lhung chu ahi.
target: The word of the Lord that came to Joel son of Pethuel.

source: Nangho tehse hon hichehi ngaijun, chule gamsunga cheng miten nabonun nanakol sungun. Hichehi nangho nikholai, ahiloule napu napateu nikho laijenga jong anasoh khamong nam?
target: Hear this, you elders; listen, all who live in the land. Has anything like this ever happened in your days or in the days of your ancestors?

source: Hichehi nachateo seipeh unlang, nacha teovin jong amaho chate seipehson uhen; chule amaho chun khangkitna achateu chu seipehson kit uhen.
target: Tell it to your children, and let your children tell it to their children, and their children to the next generation.

source: Lusu lung hon anehmoh-u chu khaokhohon anen, khaokho ho nehmoh chu thinglungin anen, thinglung nehmoh chu lungmulin aneh ahi.
target: What the locust swarm has left the great locusts have eaten; what the great locusts have left the young locusts have eaten; what the young locusts have left other locusts have eaten.

source: Jukham nangho thouvun lang kapmun, chule lengpitwi thah jeh-in, lengpitwi don jouse pengun, ajehchu hichu nakam uva kona kisatlha ahitai.
target: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine; wail because of the new wine, for it has been snatched from your lips.

source: Ajehchu thahat tah namkhat, amijat simjoulou, kagamsunga ahung umdoh-in; ahaho keipi bahkai ha tobang ahin, chule keipi bahkai lentah khalhang aneijin ahi
target: A nation has invaded my land, a mighty army without number; it has the teeth of a lion, the fangs of a lioness.

source: Aman kalengpigui asumangin, kathei chang phung thinghoh akhoh doh-e, aman hichu akhohtheng selin, chule apaimange, hitichun abahho jong agotsahtai.
target: It has laid waste my vines and ruined my fig trees. It has stripped off their bark and thrown it away, leaving their branches white.

source: Akhang donlai a-inneipu dinga khaodip pon kisila nungah theng bangin kapmin.
target: Mourn like a virgin in sackcloth grieving for the betrothed of her youth.

source: Neh thilpeh le don thilpeh chu Pakai ina konin akipaidoh tan, Pakai lhachaho, thempuho alunghemuve.
target: Grain offerings and drink offerings are cut off from the house of the Lord . The priests are in mourning, those who minister before the Lord .

source: Loujao manlou ahitan, gamsungin pul adou tan ahi; ajehchu chang agamtai, lengpitwi thah akangin, chule thaotwi alhasam tai.
target: The fields are ruined, the ground is dried up; the grain is destroyed, the new wine is dried up, the olive oil fails.

source: Vo loulhouho, nangho jahchaovin; vo lengpilei malngim ho, suhlou changle sakolchang jehchun maovun; ajehchu louva chang atding chu abeiheltan ahi.
target: Despair, you farmers, wail, you vine growers; grieve for the wheat and the barley, because the harvest of the field is destroyed.

source: Lengpigui chu agoptan, theichang phung chu agatapoi; kolbuthei phung, lusuphung, theithup phung, chule loulaija thingphung jouse geijin agop gamtai; ajeh chu mihem chate-a konin kipana kitichu abeitan ahi.
target: The vine is dried up and the fig tree is withered; the pomegranate, the palm and the apple tree— all the trees of the field—are dried up. Surely the people’s joy is withered away.

source: Nangho thempuho, nakong kigah-un chule kapmun; maicham phunga natongho maovun; hungun, Pathen natong nangho khaodip pon kisilun lang jan khovah in lumun; ajehchu nehledon thilpeh chu na Pathen in'a kona kiladoh ahitai.
target: Put on sackcloth, you priests, and mourn; wail, you who minister before the altar. Come, spend the night in sackcloth, you who minister before my God; for the grain offerings and drink offerings are withheld from the house of your God.

source: Nangho, an ngolin kisuthengun, khoppi theng khat kouvun, Pakai na Pathen insunga upaho chule gamsung mi abonchan khomun lang Pakai henga taovun.
target: Declare a holy fast; call a sacred assembly. Summon the elders and all who live in the land to the house of the Lord your God, and cry out to the Lord .

source: Ohe, chuche nikho chu da aume! ajehchu Pakai nikho chu ahung naitai, chule Hat chungnung Pakaiya kona suhmangna khat hunglhung ding ahi.
target: Alas for that day! For the day of the Lord is near; it will come like destruction from the Almighty.

source: Imaikoh laitah uva anneh kisatlha hitalou ham, henge, kipa thanopna chu Pakai i-Pathen'u insunga kona kiladoh-a hitalou ham?
target: Has not the food been cut off before our very eyes— joy and gladness from the house of our God?

source: Muchi chu leilhang noija amontan, chang kholna ahomkeo ahitan,chule changsal ho asegamtai; ajehchu changchu goplha-a ahitai.
target: The seeds are shriveled beneath the clods. The storehouses are in ruins, the granaries have been broken down, for the grain has dried up.

source: Gamsaho chu iti penpen jeng hitaovam! ganchaho le ganhonho hamhing umlou jeh-in alung dongun; henge, kelngoi honho jong kinepna bei ahitaove.
target: How the cattle moan! The herds mill about because they have no pasture; even the flocks of sheep are suffering.

source: O Pakai, nahenga katao ahi; ajehchu gamthipma hamhing jong meijin akan, chule loujaova thingphung jouse jong meikongin akachai tan ahi.
target: To you, Lord , I call, for fire has devoured the pastures in the wilderness and flames have burned up all the trees of the field.

source: Vadung twiho akan gamtah jehle, gamthipma hamhingho meijin akahgam tahjeh-un, loulaija gamsaho jengjong nangma kounan apengun ahi.
target: Even the wild animals pant for you; the streams of water have dried up and fire has devoured the pastures in the wilderness.

source: Nanghon Zion'a sumkon chu mut un, chule keima moltheng chunga kiginan hasapmin samleuvin, gamsung mite jouse kihot hen, ajehchu Pakai nikho chu anaitai, hichu hung lhung ding ahitai.
target: Blow the trumpet in Zion; sound the alarm on my holy hill. Let all who live in the land tremble, for the day of the Lord is coming. It is close at hand—

source: Muthim nikhole lungjina nikho, meibol kai nikhole satah-a thimjina nikho chu, jingkho vah-in molchung ho ahinsal banga hunglhung ding ahi; tumasanga ana umlou, tunungteng jongle akhang akhanga hungum kit louhel ding, mipi nasatah le hattah khat hung kisepdoh ding ahi.
target: a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness. Like dawn spreading across the mountains a large and mighty army comes, such as never was in ancient times nor ever will be in ages to come.

source: Amaho masang chu meijin ahalvam peh-in, anunguva mei akongin; amasanguva gamsung chu Eden hon abangin, anunguva manthah na neldi gam abange; amaho-a kona chu koimacha jamdoh theilou ding ahi.
target: Before them fire devours, behind them a flame blazes. Before them the land is like the garden of Eden, behind them, a desert waste— nothing escapes them.

source: Amelu chu sakol ho melso tobang ding, chule sakol chung toumi bangin alhaijun ahi.
target: They have the appearance of horses; they gallop along like cavalry.

source: Amaho chu molsang chunga sakol kangtalai lhaigin banga kichom dingu, changpol mei kahgin banga gingthethu le, mihat tah galvon kivona galsat dingkon bangding ahiuve.
target: With a noise like that of chariots they leap over the mountaintops, like a crackling fire consuming stubble, like a mighty army drawn up for battle.

source: Amaho masanga mite chu thohgim lheh dingu; chule mihem maijouse thimlha ding ahi.
target: At the sight of them, nations are in anguish; every face turns pale.

source: Amaho chu mihattah ho banga lhaidingu, galsat miho banga kul chunga jong kaldoh dingu; chule amaho ama ama lampi cheh-a chediu, adinmunhou asuhkhel lou diu ahi.
target: They charge like warriors; they scale walls like soldiers. They all march in line, not swerving from their course.

source: Amaho khatle khat kisatto lou dingu, ama lamlhongpi cheh-a chediu; chule chemjam achunguva achuh tengle, amaho kisukhalou dingu ahi.
target: They do not jostle each other; each marches straight ahead. They plunge through defenses without breaking ranks.

source: Amaho khopisunga suhlhai toulhai juntin, kulbang chunga lhaidiu, amaho in chung ho-a kaldoh uva, bangkot ho-a gucha banga lutdingu ahi.
target: They rush upon the city; they run along the wall. They climb into the houses; like thieves they enter through the windows.

source: Amaho masanga leiset kihotling ding; vanho kithing ding, nile lha thim ding; chule ahsi ho vahdoh talou ding ahiuve.
target: Before them the earth shakes, the heavens tremble, the sun and moon are darkened, and the stars no longer shine.

source: Chule Pakai chun agalmite anga thu aseiding ahi: ajehchu agebuh chu loupitah ahin, athu tong molsoji ama jong hattah ahi; ajehchu Pakai nikho chu loupitah le tijat umtah ahin chule koi ham ading jou dinga?
target: The Lord thunders at the head of his army; his forces are beyond number, and mighty is the army that obeys his command. The day of the Lord is great; it is dreadful. Who can endure it?

source: Hijeh chun tun, nangho nalungthim pumpiuvin, an ngol pumin, kaple lhasepum in keima henglama hung kiheijun, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Even now,” declares the Lord , “return to me with all your heart, with fasting and weeping and mourning.”

source: Navonhou hilouvin nalung sungu botkeh unlang, Pakai na Pathen'u henga kileuvin, ajehchu ama khotonale hepina-a dimset, lunghang vahjilou, lungsetna lentah nei ahin, chule thilphalou aboldinga kona alung aheiji ahi.
target: Rend your heart and not your garments. Return to the Lord your God, for he is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in love, and he relents from sending calamity.

source: Ama ahung kileheija alung ahinhei kitna, Pakai Pathen dinga an neh thilto le don thilto, itobang phattheiboh nadalhah pehding kon ija ahetnem?
target: Who knows? He may turn and relent and leave behind a blessing— grain offerings and drink offerings for the Lord your God.

source: Zion sumkon chu mut un, an ngolin kisuthengun, khoppi loupi khat kouvun.
target: Blow the trumpet in Zion, declare a holy fast, call a sacred assembly.

source: Mipi khomuvin lang, houkhom ho suthengun, upaho khom khomuvin lang, chapanghole naosen noichep nalaiho geijin khomun; moulang chu a-indan sunga konin chedohhen, chule mounu jong alupna dana konin hungpotdoh hen.
target: Gather the people, consecrate the assembly; bring together the elders, gather the children, those nursing at the breast. Let the bridegroom leave his room and the bride her chamber.

source: Thempuho, Pakai lhachaho chu maicham phungle hongcha kah-a kapmuhen, chule amahon, Vo Pakai namite hinghoijin, chule Pathen hephalouten nagoulo mite chunga i-sah louvin vai hom daohen, ipi jeh-a amaho chun miho lah-a a-Pathen'u hoija uma ham ati dingu ham; tin seiju hen
target: Let the priests, who minister before the Lord , weep between the portico and the altar. Let them say, “Spare your people, Lord . Do not make your inheritance an object of scorn, a byword among the nations. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’ ”

source: Chutengle Pakai chu agamsung dinga hung thang thipma, chule amite chu alungset ding ahi.
target: Then the Lord was jealous for his land and took pity on his people.

source: Henge, Pakai chun adonbutna amite jah-a, veuvin, keiman nangho dinga chang, lengpitwi chule thaotwi kahinsol ding, chule nangho hicheho-a chu nalunglhai diu, chule keiman nangho Pathen heloute lah-a i-sah louva kabolkit louding nahiuve, tin aseije.
target: The Lord replied to them: “I am sending you grain, new wine and olive oil, enough to satisfy you fully; never again will I make you an object of scorn to the nations.

source: Hinla keiman sahlam galmiho chu nangho-a kona gamlatah-a kachondoh ding, gam galou le manthah na gama kanolut ding, amai chu solam twipi lama, chule anunga hochu lhumlam twipi lama kanolut ding, chule auile anamset hung kikhodoh ding ahi; ajeh chu aman thil lentah anaboltan ahi.
target: “I will drive the northern horde far from you, pushing it into a parched and barren land; its eastern ranks will drown in the Dead Sea and its western ranks in the Mediterranean Sea. And its stench will go up; its smell will rise.” Surely he has done great things!

source: Kicha hih in, vo leiset, kipah inlang thanomin, ajeh chu Pakai in thil loupitah abolding ahi.
target: Do not be afraid, land of Judah; be glad and rejoice. Surely the Lord has done great things!

source: Nangho gama um gamsaho kicha hih-un, ajehchu gamthip gama hampaho chu hungdon doh ding, thingphungin aga ahin sepding, lengpi guile theichang phung jong agathei chana hung gading ahi.
target: Do not be afraid, you wild animals, for the pastures in the wilderness are becoming green. The trees are bearing their fruit; the fig tree and the vine yield their riches.

source: Chuti ahile, nangho Zion chate kipah-un, chule Pakai na Pathen'a thanomun, ajehchu aman nangho dinga gomasa chu ahin juhlhah sah ding, aphabep seuva napeh diu; go nunung jong lhamasa sunga ahin juhlhah sah ding ahi.
target: Be glad, people of Zion, rejoice in the Lord your God, for he has given you the autumn rains because he is faithful. He sends you abundant showers, both autumn and spring rains, as before.

source: Ajehchu changphol chu sakolchang dimset ding, chule bel jouse jong lengpitwi le thaotwi letsoh ding ahi
target: The threshing floors will be filled with grain; the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.

source: Chule keiman ka sepai nasatah chu nalah uva kahin sole, thinglung, lungmul chule tum lungle khaokhohon, kum tamtah-a ananeh jouse-a chu kakile dohsah kitding ahi.
