target: “I will repay you for the years the locusts have eaten— the great locust and the young locust, the other locusts and the locust swarm— my great army that I sent among you.

source: Chule nanghon ninglhing tah-a naneh uva, nalungu lhaisel ding, chule kidangtah-a nanabol pau Pakai na Pathen'u min navahchoi diu ahi: chutia chu kamiten jachatna tohtalou helding ahiuve.
target: You will have plenty to eat, until you are full, and you will praise the name of the Lord your God, who has worked wonders for you; never again will my people be shamed.

source: Chule nanghon keima Israelte lah-a um, koima dang hilou Pakai na Pathen'u kahi nahet diu, chutia chu kamite jachatna-a chuta louhel ding ahiuve.
target: Then you will know that I am in Israel, that I am the Lord your God, and that there is no other; never again will my people be shamed.

source: Chule khonungle hung hiti ding ahi, Keiman tahsa hing jouse chunga kalhagao kabuh lhah ding, nachapateo le nachanu teovin gaothu aseidoh dingu, na-upa houvin mang amatdiu, chule nakhang dong houvin mu aneidingu ahi.
target: “And afterward, I will pour out my Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your old men will dream dreams, your young men will see visions.

source: Chule hiche niteng chule soh pasalhole, soh numei ho chunga jong kalhagao kabuh lhah ding ahi.
target: Even on my servants, both men and women, I will pour out my Spirit in those days.

source: Chule keiman vanho le leiset chung, thisan, mei chule meikhu khompiho chunga thil kidang kavetsah ding ahi.
target: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth, blood and fire and billows of smoke.

source: Loupitahle tijat umtah Pakai nikho hunglhun masanga chu, nisa thimsoh-a, lha thisan sohding ahi.
target: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the Lord .

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, Pakai min pana tao chan chu koi hijongle huhhing-a umding ahi. Ajeh chu Zion molsang le Jerusalem'a huhdohna umding, Pakaiyin asei banga, akou amoh moh ho lah-a hoidohna lhung ding ahi.
target: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the Lord has said, even among the survivors whom the Lord calls.

source: Ajehchu, veuvin, chuche nikhole, hiche phat sung, keiman Judah le Jerusalem sohchana-a kon kahin lepui teng,
target: “In those days and at that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,

source: Ken jong nam jouse kakhopma, Jehoshaphat phaichama kapuisuh ding, chule kagou, kami Israelte vannoi namtin holah-a athecheh uva, kagam asuhkeh jeh uva athu-u katan ding ahi.
target: I will gather all nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will put them on trial for what they did to my inheritance, my people Israel, because they scattered my people among the nations and divided up my land.

source: Amahon kamite-a dingin vang ave-un, pasal chapang chu noti mandin apedoh-un, judon nadin numei chapang chu ajoh-un ahi.
target: They cast lots for my people and traded boys for prostitutes; they sold girls for wine to drink.

source: Ahi, keima dinga ipi nabol dingu ham, Vo Tyre, Zidon chule Palestine gamkol sunga umho, nanghon keima neilethuh dingu ham? neilethuh ule, neilethuh naochu, kintah-a naluchung cheh uva kalethuh kitding nahiuve.
target: “Now what have you against me, Tyre and Sidon and all you regions of Philistia? Are you repaying me for something I have done? If you are paying me back, I will swiftly and speedily return on your own heads what you have done.

source: Ajeh chu nanghon keima dangkale sana nakilah-un, chule kathil manluho chu nahouin sunguva napolutnun ahi.
target: For you took my silver and my gold and carried off my finest treasures to your temples.

source: Nanghon agamgiuva kona gamlatah-a natolmang thei nadiuvin, Judah chatele Jerusalem chate chu Greek mite henga najoh doh-un ahi.
target: You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, that you might send them far from their homeland.

source: Veovin, keiman najohdohnao mun laitah-a chu amaho kadindohsah ding, chule achunga nachonnao chu keiman nalu chunguva kalethuh ding nahiuve.
target: “See, I am going to rouse them out of the places to which you sold them, and I will return on your own heads what you have done.

source: Chule keiman nachapateo le nachanuteu chu Judah chate khutna kajoh ding, chule amahon gamlatah-a Shebea mite henga ajohson diu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will sell your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, a nation far away.” The Lord has spoken.

source: Chidang namdangho lah-a hichehi phongjalun, gal din kigouvin, mihat hochu thou uhen, galsat mi jouse hungnai juhen lang, hungdoh-u hen.
target: Proclaim this among the nations: Prepare for war! Rouse the warriors! Let all the fighting men draw near and attack.

source: Nalangkon hou chu chemjamin khengun, nahampa chetannao chu tengchan semun, hatmohon keima kahatne tiuhen.
target: Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weakling say, “I am strong!”

source: Nangho Pathen hephalouho, kikhomun lang, hungun, chule hungkikhom kimvelun, Vo Pakai, chua chun nangman namihat ho chu hungsuh sah-in.
target: Come quickly, all you nations from every side, and assemble there. Bring down your warriors, Lord !

source: Pathen hephalouho thou uhen lang Jehoshaphat phaichama hungdoh uhen, ajehchu chua chu keima katouva akimvela um Pathen hephalouho thu katanding ahi.
target: “Let the nations be roused; let them advance into the Valley of Jehoshaphat, for there I will sit to judge all the nations on every side.

source: Nakoiteu pannun, ajehchu chang amintan; hungin, hungkum lhan; lengpitwi hehna chu adimtan, athaoho alonglet tai; gitlouna chu alenlheh tai.
target: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full and the vats overflow— so great is their wickedness!”

source: Mipi tamtah, kigel lhuhna phaichama chun mipi tamtah aumtaove; ajehchu kigel lhuhna phaichama chun Pakai nikho ahung naitai.
target: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.

source: Nisale lhathah thimsoh intin, chule ahsi ho vahlou ding ahiuve.
target: The sun and moon will be darkened, and the stars no longer shine.

source: Pakai chu Zion'a kon hung kitumintin, chule Jerusalem'a kona aw hunging ding; chule vanho le leiset kihot ding; ahivanga Pakai chu amite kinepna hintin chule Israel chate thahat kona hiding ahi.
target: The Lord will roar from Zion and thunder from Jerusalem; the earth and the heavens will tremble. But the Lord will be a refuge for his people, a stronghold for the people of Israel.

source: Hiti achu keimahi Pakai na Pathen'u, kamolsang theng Zion'a chengpa kahichu neihet dingu ahi: chutengle Jerusalem chu athenga uma, chule amaho lah-a chu jindangho vahle louding ahitai.
target: “Then you will know that I, the Lord your God, dwell in Zion, my holy hill. Jerusalem will be holy; never again will foreigners invade her.

source: Chule hiche nikho chule hung hiti ding ahi, molsang dunga lengpitwi thah hunglong lhading, chule lhang dunga kona jong bongnoi hunglong ding; Judah gamsunga vadung long jouse-a twi longdima, Pakai insunga kona twinah khat hunglong doh-a, hichun Shittim phaicham dung twi achapnou ding ahi.
target: “In that day the mountains will drip new wine, and the hills will flow with milk; all the ravines of Judah will run with water. A fountain will flow out of the Lord ’s house and will water the valley of acacias.

source: Juda chate chunga akhanset jeh ule, agamsung uva monabei thisan asosahjeh uva, Egypt chu hakamna mun hiding, chule Edom chu hakamna gamthip sohding ahi.
target: But Egypt will be desolate, Edom a desert waste, because of violence done to the people of Judah, in whose land they shed innocent blood.

source: Hijongle Judah chu a-imatih-a chenna mun hiding, chule Jerusalem chu akhang akhanga chendenna mun hiding ahitai.
target: Judah will be inhabited forever and Jerusalem through all generations.

source: Ajehchu keiman kana suhtheng loulai athisan chu kasuhtheng ding ahi: ajehchu Pakai chu Zion'a chengah ahi.
target: Shall I leave their innocent blood unavenged? No, I will not.” The Lord dwells in Zion!

source: Ling kiho kumni masang, Israel leng Joash chapa Jeroboam nikholai, chule Judah leng Uzziah nikho laija Israel chungchang thu; Tekoa mi, kelngoi ching holah-a pang Amos'in anamu thuho chu ahi.
target: The words of Amos, one of the shepherds of Tekoa—the vision he saw concerning Israel two years before the earthquake, when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel.

source: Chule aman aseije, Pakai chu Zion'a kona hung kitumding, Jerusalem'a kona aw ginga thu aseiding; kelngoi chingho chenna chu lunghem ding, chule Carmel molvum chu golha ding ahi.
target: He said: “The Lord roars from Zion and thunders from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds dry up, and the top of Carmel withers.”

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Damascus suhkhelna thumle liho jeh-a, Keiman achunguva chuding talen chu kalahdoh lou ding ahi; ajehchu amahon Gilead chu changchilna thih manchah-in achilun ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says: “For three sins of Damascus, even for four, I will not relent. Because she threshed Gilead with sledges having iron teeth,

source: Ahinla keiman Hazael insunga meikong kahinsol ding, hichun Ben-hadad leng inpiho ahalvam ding ahi.
target: I will send fire on the house of Hazael that will consume the fortresses of Ben-Hadad.

source: Keiman Damascus jol jong kaheboh ding, Aven phaichama chengho le, Eden insunga kon leng tenggol tuhpa chu kasat lhah ding ahi. Chule Syria mite chu Kir chana gal hinga kikaidiu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will break down the gate of Damascus; I will destroy the king who is in the Valley of Aven and the one who holds the scepter in Beth Eden. The people of Aram will go into exile to Kir,” says the Lord .

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Gaza suhkhelna thumle liho jeh-a, Keiman achunguva chuding talen chu kalahdoh lou ding ahi; ajehchu amahon Edom mite pehdoh dingin, sohchangho chun abonun gal hingin akaijun ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says: “For three sins of Gaza, even for four, I will not relent. Because she took captive whole communities and sold them to Edom,

source: Ahivangin keiman Gaza bang chunga meikong kahinlelhah ding, hichun leng inpiho chu ahalvam ding ahi.
target: I will send fire on the walls of Gaza that will consume her fortresses.

source: Chule keiman Ashdoh kho-a chengho le Ashkolon'a kon leng tenggol choipa chu kakaidoh ding, chule keiman Ekron chunga kakhut kalhah ding ahi: chule Philistine mite ahingdoh amoh chengse chu mangthah ding ahiuve, tin Pakai chun aseije.
target: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the one who holds the scepter in Ashkelon. I will turn my hand against Ekron, till the last of the Philistines are dead,” says the Sovereign Lord .

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Tyre suhkhelna thumle liho jeh-a, Keiman achunguva chuding talen chu kalahdoh lou ding ahi; ajehchu amahon gal hinga kimanho jouse chu Edom apetan; hiti chun sopi hina-a kitepna chu ageldoh tapouve.
target: This is what the Lord says: “For three sins of Tyre, even for four, I will not relent. Because she sold whole communities of captives to Edom, disregarding a treaty of brotherhood,

source: Ahinla keiman Tyre bang chungna meikong kahin lelhah ding, hichun leng inpi chu ahalvam ding ahi.
target: I will send fire on the walls of Tyre that will consume her fortresses.”

source: Pakaiyin hitihin aseije; Edom suhkhelna thumle liho jeh-a, Keiman achunguva chuding talen chu kalahdoh lou ding ahi; ajehchu aman asopipa chu chemjamin adelin, khotona kiti himhim adontapoi, hitichun alunghana-a chun suhset aneijingin, chule alungsatna chu a-itih in avopjingin ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says: “For three sins of Edom, even for four, I will not relent. Because he pursued his brother with a sword and slaughtered the women of the land, because his anger raged continually and his fury flamed unchecked,

source: Ahinla keiman Taman chunga meikong kahinlelhah ding, hichun Edom sunga um Bozrah leng inpi chu akahvam ding ahi.
target: I will send fire on Teman that will consume the fortresses of Bozrah.”

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Ammon chate suhkhelna thumle liho jeh-a, Keiman achunguva chuding talen chu kalahdoh lou ding ahi; ajehchu amahon gamsung kehlet ding deinan Gilead'a um numei ho naovop lai ho chu akhe jalun ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says: “For three sins of Ammon, even for four, I will not relent. Because he ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead in order to extend his borders,

source: Ahivangin keiman Rabbah bang chunga mei kakonsah ding, galsat nikho-a kisen awgin toh, chimpei kipei nikho-a huipi toh tho-a, aleng inpi hou ahalvam ding ahi.
target: I will set fire to the walls of Rabbah that will consume her fortresses amid war cries on the day of battle, amid violent winds on a stormy day.

source: Chule alengpau chu gal hinga kikai mangding, ama le apipuihou puma kaimanga umding ahiuve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Her king will go into exile, he and his officials together,” says the Lord .

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Moab suhkhelna thumle liho jeh-a, Keiman achunguva chuding talen chu kalahdoh lou ding ahi; ajehchu aman Edom lengpa guho chu lungngou vin ahal vamin ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says: “For three sins of Moab, even for four, I will not relent. Because he burned to ashes the bones of Edom’s king,

source: Hijongle keiman Moab chunga meikong kahin sollhah ding, hichun Kerioth leng inpiho ahalvam ding, chule Moab chu boina le kisen awgin chule sumkon ginna thiding ahi.
target: I will send fire on Moab that will consume the fortresses of Kerioth. Moab will go down in great tumult amid war cries and the blast of the trumpet.

source: Chule keiman chua kona thutanpa chu kasatlhah ding, chule pipuiho jouse ama puma kathading ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will destroy her ruler and kill all her officials with him,” says the Lord .

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Judah suhkhelna thumle liho jeh-a, Keiman achunguva chuding talen chu kalahdoh lou ding ahi; ajehchu amahon Pakai dan thu anahsah pouvin, adan thupeh anit pouve, chule apu apateu dung asunnun, ajouseinao chun atohkhel sah-un ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says: “For three sins of Judah, even for four, I will not relent. Because they have rejected the law of the Lord and have not kept his decrees, because they have been led astray by false gods, the gods their ancestors followed,

source: Hijongle keiman Judah chunga meikong kalelhah ding, chule Jerusalem'a leng inpiho chu ahalvam ding ahi.
target: I will send fire on Judah that will consume the fortresses of Jerusalem.”

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Israel suhkhelnaho thumle li ho jeh-a, Keiman achunguva chuding talen chu kalahdoh lou ding ahi; ajehchu amahon chonphat chu dangka manin ajoh-un, chule vaichat kengchot to khatnin ajoh un ahi;
target: This is what the Lord says: “For three sins of Israel, even for four, I will not relent. They sell the innocent for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals.

source: Amahon vaichaho luchanga leivui chu amutnun, milungneng lampi akihei mang sanun ahi: chule keima mintheng asubohna dingin, pale chapa numei khat akikopmun ahi.
target: They trample on the heads of the poor as on the dust of the ground and deny justice to the oppressed. Father and son use the same girl and so profane my holy name.

source: Amaho maicham takipma kitepna-a kipha ponho chunga chun nomtah in alumlhaovin, chule themmo channa ju chu a-pathen'u insunga adonun ahi.
target: They lie down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge. In the house of their god they drink wine taken as fines.

source: Ahin Cedar thingphung banga sangtah, gangpi phung banga dettah Amor mite chu amaho maikoh-a kasumangin; aga chu chunglama konin kasumangin, ajung chu noilama patnin kasumangin ahi.
target: “Yet I destroyed the Amorites before them, though they were tall as the cedars and strong as the oaks. I destroyed their fruit above and their roots below.

source: Chujongle keiman nangho Egypt gama konin kapuidoh-un, chule Amor mite gam nalo theina dingun, gamthip laija kum somli kahin puileu vin ahi.
target: I brought you up out of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness to give you the land of the Amorites.

source: Chule keiman nachapateo chu themgao dingin, chule nakhang dong hou chu Nazir mi hidingin kakhou khah-in ahi. Vo Israel chate, hichehi dih hina louham? tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “I also raised up prophets from among your children and Nazirites from among your youths. Is this not true, people of Israel?” declares the Lord .

source: Ahivangin nanghon Nazir miho don dingin lengpitwi napeuvin, chule themgaoho chu gaothu seihih-un tin thu napeuvin ahi.
target: “But you made the Nazirites drink wine and commanded the prophets not to prophesy.

source: Veovin, changphal dimsetnin bongkang adelpha bangin, keima nangho noija delphan kaume.
target: “Now then, I will crush you as a cart crushes when loaded with grain.

source: Hijeh-a chu ajama chu akikinsah-a kona mangthah ding, chule athahatnin jong athaneina asuhhat louding, chule mihat tah jong ama kihuhdoh joulou ding;
target: The swift will not escape, the strong will not muster their strength, and the warrior will not save his life.

source: Thalpi choipa jong chu dingjou dehlou ding, mikaljang jong amale ama kihuhdoh jou louding; chule sakol chunga touva jong ama le ama kihuhdoh joudeh louding ahi.
target: The archer will not stand his ground, the fleet-footed soldier will not get away, and the horseman will not save his life.

source: Chule hiche nikho chule hatchung nungho lah-a ahangsan pa jong sagoh-a jam mangding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Even the bravest warriors will flee naked on that day,” declares the Lord .

source: Vo, Israel chate, Egypt gama kona kapuidoh insung pumpi, Pakaiyin nangho douna-a thu aseihi ngaijun;
target: Hear this word, people of Israel, the word the Lord has spoken against you—against the whole family I brought up out of Egypt:

source: Leiset chunga um insung jouse lah-a hi keiman nangho sehbou kahet nahiuve; hijeh-a chu nakhan gitlounao jouse jeh-a keiman nangho talen kamatsah ding nahiuve.
target: “You only have I chosen of all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your sins.”

source: Kinopto louva mini chekhomthei lhonem?
target: Do two walk together unless they have agreed to do so?

source: Keipi bahkai khun sa nehding aneilouteng, gammang sunga akitumdem? Keipi bahkai donglai khun nehding aneiloule, akulsunga kona hungham ji-em?
target: Does a lion roar in the thicket when it has no prey? Does it growl in its den when it has caught nothing?

source: Tolla thang anchah umlouva, vacha thanga oh theijem? Thang chu asupel beija, tolla kona kipel theijem?
target: Does a bird swoop down to a trap on the ground when no bait is there? Does a trap spring up from the ground if it has not caught anything?

source: Khopisunga sumkon akimutle, miho kichalou ding ham? Khopi sunga thilse alhuna ahile, hichu Pakaiyin abollou hilou dingham?
target: When a trumpet sounds in a city, do not the people tremble? When disaster comes to a city, has not the Lord caused it?

source: Tahbeh-in Pakai Pathen'in athuguh asoh themgaoho koma phongdoh masalouvin ima abolpoi.
target: Surely the Sovereign Lord does nothing without revealing his plan to his servants the prophets.

source: Keipi bahkai akitum tai, koiham akichalou ding? Pakaiyin thu aseitai, koijin aphondoh da thei dingham?
target: The lion has roared— who will not fear? The Sovereign Lord has spoken— who can but prophesy?

source: Ashdoh leng inpiho le Egypt gamsung leng inpiho-a chun phongle uvin, chule nangho Samaria molsang ho chunga kikhomun lang, alailunga mipi linglaoho le suhgentheija umho khu veuvin.
target: Proclaim to the fortresses of Ashdod and to the fortresses of Egypt: “Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria; see the great unrest within her and the oppression among her people.”

source: Aleng inpihou sunga hunamle gucha michom akholkhom jeh-un, amahon thildih bolje ahetapouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “They do not know how to do right,” declares the Lord , “who store up in their fortresses what they have plundered and looted.”

source: Hijeh chun Pakai Pathen'in aseije; gamsungle akimvel chu melmaten aumkimvel ding, aman nahatna chu nanga kona aloilhah ding, chule naleng inpihou chu suhchatvaija umding ahi.
target: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: “An enemy will overrun your land, pull down your strongholds and plunder your fortresses.”

source: Kelngoi chingpan keipibahkai kamsunga kona akelngoi kengni ahiloule abil hal beh hijongle asalhah tei banga, Samaria gamsunga cheng Israel chate, jalkhun ningchonga umho le, Damascus'a umho chu alupnaova kona kiladoh ding ahiuve, tin Pakaiyin ati.
target: This is what the Lord says: “As a shepherd rescues from the lion’s mouth only two leg bones or a piece of an ear, so will the Israelites living in Samaria be rescued, with only the head of a bed and a piece of fabric from a couch.”

source: Pakai Pathen, janel Pathen chun, nanghon ngaijunlang hichehi Jacob insunga hettohsah un, tin aseije.
target: “Hear this and testify against the descendants of Jacob,” declares the Lord, the Lord God Almighty.

source: Israel chunga asuhkhelna hou jala gotna kapeh nikho chuleh Bethel maicham ho jong gotna kapeh ding, chule maicham ki hochu kisatlha ding, tolla lhading ahiuve.
target: “On the day I punish Israel for her sins, I will destroy the altars of Bethel; the horns of the altar will be cut off and fall to the ground.

source: Chule keiman phalbi in le nipi lai in chu kavoh lhuh-a, sai mola kisa inho chu mangthah ding, chule inloupiho chun kichai dingu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will tear down the winter house along with the summer house; the houses adorned with ivory will be destroyed and the mansions will be demolished,” declares the Lord .

source: Vaichate bolse-a, panpi ngaite sugentheija, a-pakai teo henga hinchoijun donu hite tijia, Samaria molsanga um Bashan bongpi hi, hiche thuhi ngaijun.
target: Hear this word, you cows of Bashan on Mount Samaria, you women who oppress the poor and crush the needy and say to your husbands, “Bring us some drinks!”

source: Pakai Pathen chu athenna-a kitep ahitai, Veovin, aman nangho thihkoija, chule nason napah hou ngakoija akaimang diu nikho chu nachung uva hunglhung ding ahi.
target: The Sovereign Lord has sworn by his holiness: “The time will surely come when you will be taken away with hooks, the last of you with fishhooks.

source: Nangho ahomlai ho-a kona napotdoh diu, mijouse ama ama mailam cheh-a cheding, chule nanghon amaho chu leng inpi sunga nalelut dingu ahi, tin Pakai chun aseije.
target: You will each go straight out through breaches in the wall, and you will be cast out toward Harmon,” declares the Lord .

source: Bethel'a hungun, chule sukhelun; Gilgal'a hungun lang suhkhelna punsah-un; na ganlhaina houchu jingkah sehle hinchoijunlang, nahopsom ho kum thum jou sehle hinchoijun.
target: “Go to Bethel and sin; go to Gilgal and sin yet more. Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three years.

source: Chol panna-in thangvahna ganlhaina peuvin, chule manbei thilpehho phongdoh unlang samphong leuvin: ajehchu chutia bolding chu vo Israel chate, nangho deilam ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije.
target: Burn leavened bread as a thank offering and brag about your freewill offerings— boast about them, you Israelites, for this is what you love to do,” declares the Sovereign Lord .

source: Chule Keiman nakhopi jouseuva kel kalhahsah ding, na-umnao jouse-a changlhah kalhah samsah-in, Ahivangin kahenga nahung kiledeh pouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “I gave you empty stomachs in every city and lack of bread in every town, yet you have not returned to me,” declares the Lord .

source: Chule keiman chang atding phat lha thum masangin, nangho-a konin gotwi katuh tangin; khopi khat chunga go kajuhsah-in, khopi danghoa kajuh sahpon; gambih khat chunga go ajun, chule gojuh louna munho chu agojin ahi.
target: “I also withheld rain from you when the harvest was still three months away. I sent rain on one town, but withheld it from another. One field had rain; another had none and dried up.

source: Hijeh chun khopi ni ahiloule thumho chu khopi khatna twi dondin acheleuvin, ahinla adang chah-u achimdeh pon; ahivangin kahenga nahung kiledeh pouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: People staggered from town to town for water but did not get enough to drink, yet you have not returned to me,” declares the Lord .

source: Keiman nangho huise le daitwi jin jepna kape-in, nahon leihou, nalengpi leihou, natheichang phung hou, chule na olive phung hou apun laitah-in, lungmul lenhon anechaijun; ahivangin kahenga nahung kile deh pouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Many times I struck your gardens and vineyards, destroying them with blight and mildew. Locusts devoured your fig and olive trees, yet you have not returned to me,” declares the Lord .

source: Keiman Egypt'a kabolna bangin nalah uva hise kalansah-in; nakhang donghou chemjamin kasatlih-in, nasakol hou katolmangin; chule nagebuh sungu namse chu kanah sah-un; ahivang kahenga nahung kiledeh pouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “I sent plagues among you as I did to Egypt. I killed your young men with the sword, along with your captured horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camps, yet you have not returned to me,” declares the Lord .

source: Pathen'in Sodom le Gomorrah anasuhmang bangin, keiman nangho lah-a phabep kasumangin; chule nangho meikong lah-a meisel kiladoh kongnalai nabangun; ahivangin kahenga nahung kiledeh pouve, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “I overthrew some of you as I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. You were like a burning stick snatched from the fire, yet you have not returned to me,” declares the Lord .

source: Hijeh-a chu, Vo Israel, keiman hitia hi kabolding ahi: chule hitia kabol ding jehchun, Vo Israel, na Pathen toh kimutodin kigon.
target: “Therefore this is what I will do to you, Israel, and because I will do this to you, Israel, prepare to meet your God.”

source: Ajehchu, ven, mol le lhangho ana tungdoh-a, chule hui sempa, mihemte henga alunggel phongdoh-a, jingkah jong muthim sosahji chule leiset chung munsang ho chunga dingpa, Pakai, janelho Pathen, kiti chu amin ahi.
target: He who forms the mountains, who creates the wind, and who reveals his thoughts to mankind, who turns dawn to darkness, and treads on the heights of the earth— the Lord God Almighty is his name.

source: Vo Israel insung, nangma douna-a kathusei, kacham hela nachung chang thu kaseihi ngaiphan.
target: Hear this word, Israel, this lament I take up concerning you:

source: Israel nungah theng chu alhutan, thoudoh joulou ding ahitai: amanu agamsunga kidalha ahitan, chule amanu kaithou ding koimacha aumtapoi.
target: “Fallen is Virgin Israel, never to rise again, deserted in her own land, with no one to lift her up.”

source: Ajehchu Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Israel insunga dinga, khopi mi sangkhat kitoldoh lah-a chu jakhat bou kida lhah pehding; chule mi jakhat kitoldoh nalah-a som bou kida lhah pehding ahi.
target: This is what the Sovereign Lord says to Israel: “Your city that marches out a thousand strong will have only a hundred left; your town that marches out a hundred strong will have only ten left.”

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin Israel insung mite jah-a hitin aseije, Keima neiholun chutile nahin dingu ahi;
target: This is what the Lord says to Israel: “Seek me and live;

source: Ahin Bethel hol hih-un, Gilgal'a jong lut hih-un, chule Beersheba hopa hih un; ajehchu thonlouva Gilgal chu sohchang teiding, chule Bethel chu imalou hungsoh ding ahi.
target: do not seek Bethel, do not go to Gilgal, do not journey to Beersheba. For Gilgal will surely go into exile, and Bethel will be reduced to nothing.”

source: Pakai chu holun, chutile nahin dungu ahi; achuti loule Joseph insung chunga ama meikong banga hungchu ding, akahvam ding, Bethel'a aphelmit ding umlou ding ahi.
target: Seek the Lord and live, or he will sweep through the tribes of Joseph like a fire; it will devour them, and Bethel will have no one to quench it.

source: Nangho thutanna gamsai sosah-a, chule chonphatna leisetna dalha jenghon,
target: There are those who turn justice into bitterness and cast righteousness to the ground.

source: Ahsi sagi hole bombel sempa, thina le-lim jingkah sosah-a, sunlai jengjong jan banga thimsahpa: huipi twiho kou khoma, chule leiset chunga sunglha pa Pakai chu holun.
target: He who made the Pleiades and Orion, who turns midnight into dawn and darkens day into night, who calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out over the face of the land— the Lord is his name.

source: Aman kulpidet chunga gamna achuhsah nadingin, ahat chunga manthah na achuhsah-in ahi.
target: With a blinding flash he destroys the stronghold and brings the fortified city to ruin.

source: Amahon kotpi phunga miphohho athet bolun, chule dihtah-a thusei ho chu ahot bolun ahi.
target: There are those who hate the one who upholds justice in court and detest the one who tells the truth.

source: Nanghon vaicha chu nachotpha jeh-u le, ama-a kona suhlou chang pohgih nalahpeh jeh-un; nanghon songa kikhengin in sajong leuchun, asunga nachenlou diu, lengpilei hoitah neijuna tin, hijongle lengpitwiho chu nadonlou dingu ahi.
target: You levy a straw tax on the poor and impose a tax on their grain. Therefore, though you have built stone mansions, you will not live in them; though you have planted lush vineyards, you will not drink their wine.

source: Ajehchu keiman nasuhkhelnao tamtah le na chonsetnao aletje chu kahei: amahon mikitah ho asugentheijun, sum nehguh abolun, chule kotpi phunga vaichate chu achanvou-u aheimang peh-un ahi.
target: For I know how many are your offenses and how great your sins. There are those who oppress the innocent and take bribes and deprive the poor of justice in the courts.

source: Hijeh-a chu milungchingho chu chuche nikho chule thipding ahiuve: ajehchu hichu phat phalou hiding ahi.
target: Therefore the prudent keep quiet in such times, for the times are evil.

source: Nahin theina dingun, thilse hilouvin thilpha holun; chutile nanghon nasei banguva, Pakai Pathen chun naumpi dingu ahi.
target: Seek good, not evil, that you may live. Then the Lord God Almighty will be with you, just as you say he is.

source: Janel Pakai Pathen'in Joseph insung amohho chunga lungsetna anei theinadin; thilse chu hotbolun, thilpha chu ngailuvin, chule kotpi phunga thutana dih phutdoh-un.
target: Hate evil, love good; maintain justice in the courts. Perhaps the Lord God Almighty will have mercy on the remnant of Joseph.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai, janel ho Pathen, Pakai chun hitihin aseije; khopi lamlen jouse-a kalemao umding; lamlhongpi jouse-a Ohe! Ohe! atidingu, amahon loulhoupa chu lunghem dinga, chule kapthemho chu kapdinga akoudiu ahi.
target: Therefore this is what the Lord, the Lord God Almighty, says: “There will be wailing in all the streets and cries of anguish in every public square. The farmers will be summoned to weep and the mourners to wail.

source: Chule lengpilei jouse-a kana umding ahi: ajehchu naheng kahin jotpa ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: There will be wailing in all the vineyards, for I will pass through your midst,” says the Lord .

source: Pakai nikho ngaicha-a nangho ada nahiuve! hiche nikho chu ipiding natiu ham? Pakai nikho chu muthim ahin, vah ahipoi.
target: Woe to you who long for the day of the Lord ! Why do you long for the day of the Lord ? That day will be darkness, not light.

source: Mihem chu keipi bahkai kicha-a ajamle, vompi toh kitoh ding; insunga lutna, akhut banga angaile, gul'in achuh ding ahi.
target: It will be as though a man fled from a lion only to meet a bear, as though he entered his house and rested his hand on the wall only to have a snake bite him.

source: Pakai nikho chu khovah hilouva muthim joh hilouham? hichu hathima thim asunga vah beihel hilou ham?
target: Will not the day of the Lord be darkness, not light— pitch-dark, without a ray of brightness?

source: Keiman nakut nikho hou chu kakidah-in, kahoi, chule nakhoppi len houva jong kakipa louding ahi.
target: “I hate, I despise your religious festivals; your assemblies are a stench to me.

source: Nanghon govam thilto le neh thiltoho neipe jongleu chun, keiman hicheho chu kasan lou ding: chule chamna thilto-a dinga gancha thaotah tah nato houjong, nahsah-a kanei louding ahi.
target: Even though you bring me burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. Though you bring choice fellowship offerings, I will have no regard for them.

source: Kakoma nalasah-u awginho jong chu chon mangun, ajehchu keiman natumging ngeitah hou jong chu kangailou ding ahi.
target: Away with the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.

source: Ahinla dihtah-a thutanna chu twiho bangin longlhahen, chule chonphatna chu luidung hattahto banghen.
target: But let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!

source: Vo Israel insung mite, nanghon gamthip gama kum somli sunga chu ganlhainaho le thiltoho neinapeh uvem?
target: “Did you bring me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, people of Israel?

source: Ahinla nanghon nangho dinga nakisemu na pathen hou ahsi, Moloch ponbuh le namilim semthu-u Chiun chu napo leuvin ahi.
target: You have lifted up the shrine of your king, the pedestal of your idols, the star of your god— which you made for yourselves.

source: Hijeh chun Pakai, amin janelho Pathen chun, keiman nangho Damascus khellam peh-a, gal hinga kache sah ding nahiuve, tin aseije.
target: Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Damascus,” says the Lord , whose name is God Almighty.

source: Zion'a nomsa tah-a umho, chule Samaria molsanga atahsan ngamho, namtinho lah-a pipua kiminvo, Israel insung mite hungkon dohna, ohe ada-a ahiuve!
target: Woe to you who are complacent in Zion, and to you who feel secure on Mount Samaria, you notable men of the foremost nation, to whom the people of Israel come!

source: Nangho Calneh-a cheovin lang veuvin; chule chua kon chun Hamath loupi-a chun cheovin; chujoule Philistinte khopi Gath'a chun chesuh-un; amaho chu hiche lenggam ho sanga phajonam? ahiloule agamgiu chu nangho gamgi sanga lenjonam?
target: Go to Kalneh and look at it; go from there to great Hamath, and then go down to Gath in Philistia. Are they better off than your two kingdoms? Is their land larger than yours?

source: Nangho nikho phalou gamlatah-a koidoh-a, chule hunama thuneina naicha-a loilut ho;
target: You put off the day of disaster and bring near a reign of terror.

source: Saiha-a kisem jalkhun chunga luma, chule atouna nomtah chunga kithaljam ho, kelngoi nou ahonlah-a kon mandoh-a, chule bongnou ho akula alah uva kona mandoh-a nejia nangho;
target: You lie on beds adorned with ivory and lounge on your couches. You dine on choice lambs and fattened calves.

source: Selangdah-a la manthei louva sa-a, chule David tumging banga tumgingthei kisemthu-a nangho;
target: You strum away on your harps like David and improvise on musical instruments.

source: Lhengkonga judon ji-a, amaho le amaho thao hoipen pen kinuji; ahivanga Joseph kisuh gentheina-a lunghempi louho.
target: You drink wine by the bowlful and use the finest lotions, but you do not grieve over the ruin of Joseph.

source: Hijeh-a chu tu-a hi amaho gal-hinga kikai masa hotoh gal hinga chekhom diu, chule nomsa tah-a kithaljamho golvah jong kisubei ding ahi.
target: Therefore you will be among the first to go into exile; your feasting and lounging will end.

source: Pakai Pathen amatah akihahselin, janel Pakai Pathen'in hitin aseije; Jacob kiletsahna chu kakidah-in, aleng inpiho chu kathe-e: hijeh-a chu akhopi chu asunga umho jouse puma kapehdoh ding ahi.
target: The Sovereign Lord has sworn by himself—the Lord God Almighty declares: “I abhor the pride of Jacob and detest his fortresses; I will deliver up the city and everything in it.”

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi, insung khatna mi som auma ahileh, amaho chu thiding ahiuve.
target: If ten people are left in one house, they too will die.

source: Chule agu chu haldinga apa-ngah pa leh athiho hal pa chun alah-a, insunga kona ahinpoh doh ding, chule insunga um mikhat henga chu, khattou nangma toh umkhoma umnalai em? tia aseiding; chule ama chun, koima aumtapoi, atiding ahi. Chutengle aman, nakam kihupmin; ajehchu eihon Pakai minchu iphahpoh theilou diu ahi, tia asei ding ahi.
target: And if the relative who comes to carry the bodies out of the house to burn them asks anyone who might be hiding there, “Is anyone else with you?” and he says, “No,” then he will go on to say, “Hush! We must not mention the name of the Lord .”

source: Ajehchu veuvin, Pakai chun thu apeh ahi: chule aman inpi chu avohsetna asuhchip ding, chule inneoho chu ahal hala asoding ahi.
target: For the Lord has given the command, and he will smash the great house into pieces and the small house into bits.

source: Sakol ho chu songpi chunga lhainao vin tem? Mihon chumun chu bongchalin kainao vin tem? Ajehchu nanghon thutandih chu thinkha naso-un, chule chonphatna ga chu thing gunei nasosah taove.
target: Do horses run on the rocky crags? Does one plow the sea with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness—

source: Nangho imacha hilou thil khatna kipah jia, chule sakiho chu ithahat naova ikilah-u hilou ham? tia seijiho.
target: you who rejoice in the conquest of Lo Debar and say, “Did we not take Karnaim by our own strength?”

source: Hijongle, veuvin, vo Israel insung, keiman nangho douva nam khat katun dohding ahi, tin janel Pakai Pathen'in aseije; chule amahon Hamath lutna-a pat, gamthip vapidung geija nangho nasuhgenthei dingu ahi.
target: For the Lord God Almighty declares, “I will stir up a nation against you, Israel, that will oppress you all the way from Lebo Hamath to the valley of the Arabah.”

source: Pakai Pathen'in keima hitihin eina musah-e: veuvin, aman hamhing kehdoh nunung ho ahung kedoh kipat tilin khaokho tamtah asemin, veuvin, hichu lengpa-a hamhing at dan dungjuija akehdoh nunung ho ahi.
target: This is what the Sovereign Lord showed me: He was preparing swarms of locusts after the king’s share had been harvested and just as the late crops were coming up.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, amahon gamsunga hampaho anehchai phatnun, keiman, Vo Pakai Pathen nahenga katao ahi, ngaidamin, Koi jala Jacob chu dingdoh kit ding ham? Ajehchu ama neocha ahi, tin kaseijin ahi.
target: When they had stripped the land clean, I cried out, “Sovereign Lord , forgive! How can Jacob survive? He is so small!”

source: Hijeh hin Pakaiyin alung aheijin; chuti taponte, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: So the Lord relented. “This will not happen,” the Lord said.

source: Pakai Pathen'in keima hitihin eimu sah-e: veuvin, Pakai Pathen'in engbolna din mei akouvin, hichun twipi lentah akagon, chule tolgo phabep jong akavamin ahi.
target: This is what the Sovereign Lord showed me: The Sovereign Lord was calling for judgment by fire; it dried up the great deep and devoured the land.

source: Chuin keiman, Vo Pakai Pathen, khongaijin tia nahenga katao ahi; Koi jala Jacob chu dingdoh kit ding ham? Ajehchu, ama neocha ahi, tin kaseije.
target: Then I cried out, “Sovereign Lord , I beg you, stop! How can Jacob survive? He is so small!”

source: Hichun Pakai lung akisihsah tan, hiche jonghi chuti taponte, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: So the Lord relented. “This will not happen either,” the Sovereign Lord said.

source: Hitihin aman eimusah-e, chule veuvin, Pakai chu tetohna khao akhutna achoijin, tetohna-a kisem bang chung khatna adingin ahi.
target: This is what he showed me: The Lord was standing by a wall that had been built true to plumb, with a plumb line in his hand.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin kajah-a, Amos, nangin ipi namu em? eiti. Chuin keiman, tetohna khao kamui katin ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Ven, keiman kami Israelte lah-a tetohna khao kakoiding, keiman amaho lah kapal kit tahlou ding ahi.
target: And the Lord asked me, “What do you see, Amos?” “A plumb line,” I replied. Then the Lord said, “Look, I am setting a plumb line among my people Israel; I will spare them no longer.

source: Chule Isaac munsang ho chu kamhel ding, Israel muntheng ho chu kisumang ding; chule keiman Jeroboam insung douna-a chemjam kapat ding ahi, ati.
target: “The high places of Isaac will be destroyed and the sanctuaries of Israel will be ruined; with my sword I will rise against the house of Jeroboam.”

source: Chuin Bethel'a thempu Amaziah chu Israel leng Jeroboam henga thu athotnin, hitin aseije; Israel insung mite lah-a nangma dounan Amos'in guhthim thilgon aneije. Athusei jouse chu gamsung mite pohjou ahipoi.
target: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent a message to Jeroboam king of Israel: “Amos is raising a conspiracy against you in the very heart of Israel. The land cannot bear all his words.

source: Ajehchu Amos'in hitin ati, Jeroboam chemjam'a thiding, chule Israelte hi agam sunguva kona sohchang dinga kitolmang ding ahiuve, tin aseijin ahi.
target: For this is what Amos is saying: “ ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel will surely go into exile, away from their native land.’ ”

source: Amaziah jong chun Amos jah-a, vo nangma mitvahnei, chenlang Judah gama jamlut-in, chumuna chun changlhah nenlang gaothu seijin.
target: Then Amaziah said to Amos, “Get out, you seer! Go back to the land of Judah. Earn your bread there and do your prophesying there.

source: Ahin Bethel'a hin gaothu seikit tahih-in: ajehchu hikom hi lengpa houin le lengpa leitol ahi, ati.
target: Don’t prophesy anymore at Bethel, because this is the king’s sanctuary and the temple of the kingdom.”

source: Chuin Amos'in adonbutnin, Amaziah jah-a, keima themgao kahipoi, themgao chapa jong kahipoi; ahinla keima kelngoi vah-a le theiba ga lohkhom bou kahi.
target: Amos answered Amaziah, “I was neither a prophet nor the son of a prophet, but I was a shepherd, and I also took care of sycamore-fig trees.

source: Chule kelngoi hon nung kajui petnin, Pakaiyin eipuijin, kajah-a, Chen, kami Israelte lah-a gao thu gaseijin eitin ahi.
target: But the Lord took me from tending the flock and said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to my people Israel.’

source: Hijeh chun, tun nangin Pakai thusei hi ngaijin; nangman kajah-a, Israel dounan gaothu seihih-in, chule Isaac insung dounan thu seihih-in tin naseije.
target: Now then, hear the word of the Lord . You say, “ ‘Do not prophesy against Israel, and stop preaching against the descendants of Isaac.’

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije; najinu chu khopi sunga noti'a pangding, nachapate le nachanute chu chemjam'a lou dingu, nagam leiset chu tena khaova kihomtel ding; chule nangma gam thenglou mun'a nathi ding ahi: chule thonlouva Israel chu agamsunga kona munchoma sohchanga cheding ahi.
target: “Therefore this is what the Lord says: “ ‘Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, and your sons and daughters will fall by the sword. Your land will be measured and divided up, and you yourself will die in a pagan country. And Israel will surely go into exile, away from their native land.’ ”

source: Pakai Pathen'in hitihin eimusah-e; veuvin, nipilai thei paipeh khat aumin ahi.
target: This is what the Sovereign Lord showed me: a basket of ripe fruit.

source: Chuin aman, Amos ipi namu em? eiti. Chuin keiman, nipilai thei paipeh khat kamui kati. Chuin Pakai chun kajah-a, Kami Israelte chunga achaina chu ahunglhung tai; Keiman amaho lah kajotpa kit tahlou ding ahi.
target: “What do you see, Amos?” he asked. “A basket of ripe fruit,” I answered. Then the Lord said to me, “The time is ripe for my people Israel; I will spare them no longer.

source: Chule chuche nikhole houin'a laho chu kale maon'a hiding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije. Muntina thilong tamtah umding; amahon amaho chu thipbeh-a apaidoh dingu ahi.
target: “In that day,” declares the Sovereign Lord , “the songs in the temple will turn to wailing. Many, many bodies—flung everywhere! Silence!”

source: Hichehi ngaijun, Vo nangho, panpi ngaite vallhumjia, gamsunga vaichate losamsah jiho,
target: Hear this, you who trample the needy and do away with the poor of the land,

source: Nanghon, Itihle lhathah akichaijin, chang le mim ijohthei diuvem? chule cholngah ni akichaijin, ephah isuneovun, shekel iletsah-un, chule jouvin khaikot ilepmun, sakolchang joh din ikipanthei diuvem?
target: saying, “When will the New Moon be over that we may sell grain, and the Sabbath be ended that we may market wheat?”— skimping on the measure, boosting the price and cheating with dishonest scales,

source: Chuti chun vaicha chu dangka khatnin, panpi ngaichu kengchot tokhatnin icho uvin; chule sakolchang vaiho jengjong ijoh thei diuvem? nati uve.
target: buying the poor with silver and the needy for a pair of sandals, selling even the sweepings with the wheat.

source: Pakai chu Jacob chungnunna-a chun akihahselin aseije, keiman, anatohhou khatcha jong kasuhmil louhel ding ahi.
target: The Lord has sworn by himself, the Pride of Jacob: “I will never forget anything they have done.

source: Hiche jeh-ahi, gamsung kihotling louding hija, chua cheng amitakip chu lunghem louding ham? Hichu twisoh banga apumchanga hungsoh doh ding; Egypt'a twiso banga chu, paidoh le lhohsah-a umding ahi.
target: “Will not the land tremble for this, and all who live in it mourn? The whole land will rise like the Nile; it will be stirred up and then sink like the river of Egypt.

source: Chuche nikho chule hung hiti ding ahi, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije, keiman sunlaile nisa kalhum sah ding, chule khovah laitahle thim kajin sah ding ahi.
target: “In that day,” declares the Sovereign Lord , “I will make the sun go down at noon and darken the earth in broad daylight.

source: Chule keiman na kut hou lunghemna kasosah ding, chule nala hou jouse kala kaso ding; taijol jouse chunga khaodip pon kahin lhun sah ding, chule luchang jouse kachaisah ding; chapa changkhat chunga lunghemna tobang chu kalhun sah-a, chule achaina chu lungnatna nikho hiding ahi.
target: I will turn your religious festivals into mourning and all your singing into weeping. I will make all of you wear sackcloth and shave your heads. I will make that time like mourning for an only son and the end of it like a bitter day.

source: Veovin, nikhoho chu ahung lhunge, tin Pakai Pathen'in aseije, hitia chu keiman gamsunga kel kahin lansah ding, changlhah ngaichatna jeh-a kel hilou, twi ngaichatna jeh-a dangchah jong hilou ding, amavang Pakai thujah nomna kel hiding ahi.
target: “The days are coming,” declares the Sovereign Lord , “when I will send a famine through the land— not a famine of food or a thirst for water, but a famine of hearing the words of the Lord .

source: Chule amaho twilen khatna kona twilen khat, chule sahlama pat solam gei, amaho Pakai thu holna suhle tunga lhaile diu, ahivanga amujoulou dingu ahi.
target: People will stagger from sea to sea and wander from north to east, searching for the word of the Lord , but they will not find it.

source: Hiche nikho chule nungah theng hoitahho le gollhang ho chu dangchah jeh-a lhalhop diu ahi.
target: “In that day “the lovely young women and strong young men will faint because of thirst.

source: Samaria chonset na-a kihahsela, Vo Dan, na Pathen ahinge; Chule Beersheba umdan ahingin; tia seiho jengjong chu lhu uva, thoudoh kit talouhel dingu ahitai.
target: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria— who say, ‘As surely as your god lives, Dan,’ or, ‘As surely as the god of Beersheba lives’— they will fall, never to rise again.”

source: Keiman Pakai chu maicham chunga adin kanamui; chule hitin aseije, akhom ho chu akilon theina din kotbeng chu jepmin; chule alu-u chu ban sattanin, alah uva anukhahpen chu Keiman chemjam'a kasatlhuh ding; alah uva jam-a chu jammang theilou ding, chule ahoidoh-a kihuhdoh louding ahi.
target: I saw the Lord standing by the altar, and he said: “Strike the tops of the pillars so that the thresholds shake. Bring them down on the heads of all the people; those who are left I will kill with the sword. Not one will get away, none will escape.

source: Amahon thikhol khul'a leiko laijongleu, hia kona chu kakhutna kaloidoh ding; amaho van'a kaltou jongleu, hia kona chu kapuilhah kit ding ahi.
target: Though they dig down to the depths below, from there my hand will take them. Though they climb up to the heavens above, from there I will bring them down.

source: Chule amaho chu Carmel molvum'a kisel jongleu, kahol doh-a hia kona chu kakaidoh ding; chule amaho kamitmu-a konin twikhanglen todopma kisel jongleu, chumuna chu keiman gul thu kapeh-a, aman amaho chu achuh ding ahi.
target: Though they hide themselves on the top of Carmel, there I will hunt them down and seize them. Though they hide from my eyes at the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent to bite them.

source: Chule amaho amelmateu masanga gal hingin kitol jongleu, chumuna chu Keiman chemjam thu kapeh-a, hichun amaho athagam ding; Chule Keiman amaho thilpha-a ding hilouva, thilse-a dinga kavetlhih jing dingu ahi.
target: Though they are driven into exile by their enemies, there I will command the sword to slay them. “I will keep my eye on them for harm and not for good.”

source: Chule gamsung sukha jia chu janel ho Pakai Pathen ahin, hichu junlha-a, chua chengho jousen alung hempi diu: Hichu twisoh banga apumchanga hungsoh doh ding; Egypt'a twiso banga chu, paidoh le lhohsah-a umding ahi.
target: The Lord, the Lord Almighty— he touches the earth and it melts, and all who live in it mourn; the whole land rises like the Nile, then sinks like the river of Egypt;

source: Vanchunga indanho kisah-a, leisetna galmihon kisemdoh-a chu ama ahin; twipia twiho kou khoma, hihochu leiset chunga hinsung lha-a chu ama ahi. Pakai kiti chu amin ahi.
target: he builds his lofty palace in the heavens and sets its foundation on the earth; he calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out over the face of the land— the Lord is his name.

source: Vo Israel chate, nangho Keima dinga Ethopia chateho tobang nahiu hilou ham? tin Pakaiyin aseije. Keiman Israel chu Egypt gama kona kapuidoh hilou ham? Philistine te chu Caphtor-a kona, chule Syria techu Kir'a kona kapuidoh hilou ham?
target: “Are not you Israelites the same to me as the Cushites?” declares the Lord . “Did I not bring Israel up from Egypt, the Philistines from Caphtor and the Arameans from Kir?

source: Veovin, Pakai Pathen mit teni chu chonsetna dim lenggam chunga achujin, chule keiman hiche leiset chunga kona kasuhmang helding; Jacob insung vang kasuhmang hel louding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Surely the eyes of the Sovereign Lord are on the sinful kingdom. I will destroy it from the face of the earth. Yet I will not totally destroy the descendants of Jacob,” declares the Lord .

source: Ajehchu, veuvin, Keiman thu kapeh ding, godalla chang akisep banga, Keiman namtinho lah-a Israel chu kasep chil ding ahin, achang neopen jeng jong tolla lhalou ding ahi.
target: “For I will give the command, and I will shake the people of Israel among all the nations as grain is shaken in a sieve, and not a pebble will reach the ground.

source: Setna-in eiphapou vintin, mai jong eikimaitopi pouvinte tia sei Kami chonseteho jouse chu abonuva chemjam'a louding ahiuve.
target: All the sinners among my people will die by the sword, all those who say, ‘Disaster will not overtake or meet us.’

source: Hiche nikho teng chule keiman David houbuh lhusa chu kaphoh ding kitna, aselai ho kasemphat kitding; chule achimsa chu katundoh kitna, gollui laija banga kasah doh kit ding ahi.
target: “In that day “I will restore David’s fallen shelter— I will repair its broken walls and restore its ruins— and will rebuild it as it used to be,

source: Chutiachu Edom mite amoh chengse le, Pathen hephaloute kamina kikou chengse chun alo theidiu ahi, tin hiche tongdoh-a Pakai chun aseije.
target: so that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations that bear my name,” declares the Lord , who will do these things.

source: Veovin, nikhoho chu ahung lhunge, tin Pakaiyin aseije, loukaija pangpan chang atpa ahinphah ding, lengpithei chilpan muchi tupa ahinphah ding; molsang hon lengpitwi lhumtah ahinvat lhahsah-a, chule lhangho jouse junlha dingu ahi.
target: “The days are coming,” declares the Lord , “when the reaper will be overtaken by the plowman and the planter by the one treading grapes. New wine will drip from the mountains and flow from all the hills,

source: Chule keiman kami Israelte chu asohchan naova kona kahin lepui kit ding, amahon akamhelsa khopiho asahdoh kitnuva, hiho chu chenna-a aneidiu; chule lengpitheiho aphu uva, chuche-a lengpitwi chu adondiu; chule honho jong abolluva, chuche-a agaho chu anehdiu ahi.
target: and I will bring my people Israel back from exile. “They will rebuild the ruined cities and live in them. They will plant vineyards and drink their wine; they will make gardens and eat their fruit.

source: Chule keiman amaho chu agamuva kaphulut dingu, keiman kapehsao gamsunga kona chu amaho kibotdoh kit louding ahitaove, tin Pakai na Pathen'un aseije.
target: I will plant Israel in their own land, never again to be uprooted from the land I have given them,” says the Lord your God.

source: Obadiah gao thilmu chu ahi. Edom chung changa Pakai Pathen'in hitin ati; keihon Pakaiya konin thuthang khat kajaovin, palai khat Pathen hephaloute henga akisolin: Nangho thoudoh-un, chule amanu douva galla satdin kipatdoh-u hite.
target: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Sovereign Lord says about Edom— We have heard a message from the Lord : An envoy was sent to the nations to say, “Rise, let us go against her for battle”—

source: Ven, keiman nangma Pathen hephalou ho lah-a neocha kasem nahin; nangma isahlou tah-a kibol ding nahi.
target: “See, I will make you small among the nations; you will be utterly despised.

source: Nalung sunga kiletsahna chun nalhemlhatan, nangma song khikeh kah-a chenga, mun sangtah lo-a chu nahin; nangman nalungin, koijin tolla eiloilhah thei ding ham? tin naseijin ahi.
target: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who live in the clefts of the rocks and make your home on the heights, you who say to yourself, ‘Who can bring me down to the ground?’

source: Nangma muvanlai bangin kichoisangin lang, ahsi ho lah-a nabuh gase jongle chun, hia kona chu nangma kaloi lhah ding nahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Though you soar like the eagle and make your nest among the stars, from there I will bring you down,” declares the Lord .

source: Gucha ho nahenga hungu henglang, michom ho jan-in hungleu, (ichana suhmanga naum ding hitam!) amaho aninglhin tokah uva thil chu akichom lou diu ham? lengpi ga loujiho chu nahenga hungleu, amahon lengpiga phabap beh adalhah lou dingu ham?
target: “If thieves came to you, if robbers in the night— oh, what a disaster awaits you!— would they not steal only as much as they wanted? If grape pickers came to you, would they not leave a few grapes?

source: Esau thil ho chu iti kiholdoh theija, athil akisel ho chu iti kikhol doh ding ham?
target: But how Esau will be ransacked, his hidden treasures pillaged!

source: Nangman nakiloipi miho chun nangma gamgi chan geija nahin lhutnu ahitan; nakichampi miho chun nalhep lhah-u ahitan, jojong najou ahitai. Nachanglhah neho tah jong chun nanoija mahaput theina akoijun; ama-a het themna aumpoi.
target: All your allies will force you to the border; your friends will deceive and overpower you; those who eat your bread will set a trap for you, but you will not detect it.

source: Edom'a kona miching ho kasuhmang louding hija, Esau molsanga kona hetthemna kasuhmang louding ham? tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “In that day,” declares the Lord , “will I not destroy the wise men of Edom, those of understanding in the mountains of Esau?

source: Vo Teman, Edom molla amitin chu tolthatna pang hon akhona channa athagam theina diuva, nami thahat tahtah hochu lunglha diu ahi.
target: Your warriors, Teman, will be terrified, and everyone in Esau’s mountains will be cut down in the slaughter.

source: Ajehchu nasopipa Jacob douna-a pumhat tah-a nathilbol jeh-a jum nan nahinkhu ding, chule a-imatih channa dinga nangma sat lhah-a naum ding ahi.
target: Because of the violence against your brother Jacob, you will be covered with shame; you will be destroyed forever.

source: Nangma agal lang khatna nadin nikho, gamchom mihon agalmiteu gal hinga akaimangu nikho, chule gamdang miho chu akotpi ho-a alutnuva, Jerusalem chunga vang asanuva chun, amaho lah-a khat bangin nangma napangin ahi.
target: On the day you stood aloof while strangers carried off his wealth and foreigners entered his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, you were like one of them.

source: Ahinla nasopipa gamchom mi akiso nikho chu, nangman navet louding; chujongle Juda chate kisuhmang nikho-a chu nakipa lou ding; chule hahsatna nikho-a chu kiletsah tah-a thu jong nasei louding ahi.
target: You should not gloat over your brother in the day of his misfortune, nor rejoice over the people of Judah in the day of their destruction, nor boast so much in the day of their trouble.

source: Amaho vangsetna nikho-a chu nangma kamite kotpi-a nalut lou ding; chule amaho hamsetna nikho-a chu nangman akibol gentheinao navet lou ding, avangsetnao nikho-a chu athilkeu hou chunga jong nakhut nasuhnat lou ding ahi;
target: You should not march through the gates of my people in the day of their disaster, nor gloat over them in their calamity in the day of their disaster, nor seize their wealth in the day of their disaster.

source: Nangma ajamdoh-a miho suhmang dinga lamthom ho-a jong nanadin lou ding; hahsatna nikho-a hoidoh-a umden ho chu peh jong nanapeh doh louding ahi.
target: You should not wait at the crossroads to cut down their fugitives, nor hand over their survivors in the day of their trouble.

source: Ajehchu Pakai nikho chu Pathen hephaloute chunga chu din ahung naije; nangman nabol bang banga nachunga hung kibol ding; natohman chu nangma tah luchunga hungkile ding ahi.
target: “The day of the Lord is near for all nations. As you have done, it will be done to you; your deeds will return upon your own head.

source: Ajehchu nangman keima molsang theng chunga nana don banga, chutobanga chu Pathen hephalouten adon jing jengdiu; chule amahon adonuva, avallut diu, chule a-itih-a ana umkhalou banga umdiu ahi.
target: Just as you drank on my holy hill, so all the nations will drink continually; they will drink and drink and be as if they had never been.

source: Ahinla Zion molsang chunga chun kihuh dohna umintin, chule hia chu thenna umding, chule Jacob insungin agouvu chu akilo kitdiu ahi.
target: But on Mount Zion will be deliverance; it will be holy, and Jacob will possess his inheritance.

source: Chule Jacob insung chu mei hunghi ding, Joseph insung chu meikou hunghia, Esau insung vang polkung hungsoh ding, amahon amaho chu meija ahal dingu, Esau insunga chu amoh ahinga khatcha umlou ding ahi; ajehchu hiche hi Pakaiyin asei ahi.
target: Jacob will be a fire and Joseph a flame; Esau will be stubble, and they will set him on fire and destroy him. There will be no survivors from Esau.” The Lord has spoken.

source: Chule lhanglam sang miho chun Esau molsang chu ahin lodiu; chule phaicham mihon Philistine alodiu; amaho chun Ephraim phaileiho le Samaria phaileiho ahinlouva, chule Benjamin'in Gilead ahinlo ding ahi.
target: People from the Negev will occupy the mountains of Esau, and people from the foothills will possess the land of the Philistines. They will occupy the fields of Ephraim and Samaria, and Benjamin will possess Gilead.

source: Chule sohchanga hiche janel Israel chate hin Kanaan gam alodiu, Zarephath chan gei ngeija ahinlo diu ahin; chule Sepharad'a um gal hinga kikai Jerusalem mite chun, lhanglam sang khopi ho chu alodiu ahi.
target: This company of Israelite exiles who are in Canaan will possess the land as far as Zarephath; the exiles from Jerusalem who are in Sepharad will possess the towns of the Negev.

source: Esau molsang chunga thutan dinga huhhingpu chu Zion molsanga kon hungdoh ding; chule lenggam chu Pakaiya hiding ahi.
target: Deliverers will go up on Mount Zion to govern the mountains of Esau. And the kingdom will be the Lord ’s.

source: Tun Amittai chapa Jonah henga Pakai thu ahung lhungin, aseije,
target: The word of the Lord came to Jonah son of Amittai:

source: Kipat in lang, khuche khopi lentah Nineveh'a khun chen, chule ama dounan hiche thuhi gasam phongin; ajehchu akhansetnao chu kahenga ahung lhung touve.
target: “Go to the great city of Nineveh and preach against it, because its wickedness has come up before me.”

source: Ahin Jonah akipatdoh-in Pakai angsunga konin Tarshish lama jam dingin Joppa-a achesuh tan ahi; chuin aman kong khat Tarshish lam cheding amun: hitichun touna man chu apen, Pakai angsunga konin Tarshish lama chedingho toh chekhom din, asunga akumsuh tan ahi.
target: But Jonah ran away from the Lord and headed for Tarshish. He went down to Joppa, where he found a ship bound for that port. After paying the fare, he went aboard and sailed for Tarshish to flee from the Lord .

source: Ahin Pakaiyin twikhanglen'a chun hui hattah ahinsoltan, huile go kitho nasatah ahung chutan, hitichun chuche kong chu keh dingin aumtan ahi.
target: Then the Lord sent a great wind on the sea, and such a violent storm arose that the ship threatened to break up.

source: Chujouvin kong tol ho chu akicha taovin, amitin chu a pathen heng cheh uva ataovun, chule kong sunga um thil ho chu kong ajankhai theina din alauvin, twikhanglen'a aseplha taovin ahi. Ahin Jonah vangchu kong sung ning khatna ana kumsuh-in; hia chun alumin, a-imumil deltan ahi.
target: All the sailors were afraid and each cried out to his own god. And they threw the cargo into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone below deck, where he lay down and fell into a deep sleep.

source: Hitichun kong pipuipa chu ahenga ahungin, ajah-a, Vo ihmumil delpa, nangma ipi ngaito nahim? thoudoh-in lang eiho imanthah louna diule Pathen'in ichunguva lunggel ahin neitheina din, na Pathen henga taovin ati.
target: The captain went to him and said, “How can you sleep? Get up and call on your god! Maybe he will take notice of us so that we will not perish.”

source: Chuin amaho amitakipmin aloi agol kom cheh-a chun, Hungun, koipen jeh-a hiche thilse hi ichunguva chua ham ti ihetdoh theina diuvin vang sannu hite atiovin ahi. Hitichun amahon vang chu asantaovin ahile, Jonah chunga achutan ahi.
target: Then the sailors said to each other, “Come, let us cast lots to find out who is responsible for this calamity.” They cast lots and the lot fell on Jonah.

source: Hichun amahon ajah-a, Nahenga kangeh-u ahi, neisei peh-un, koijeh-a hiche thilse hi ichunguva chua ham; ipi natonga nahim? hoija hungkon nahim? ipi gam mi nahi ham? chule ipi nam mi nahim? atiuvin ahi.
target: So they asked him, “Tell us, who is responsible for making all this trouble for us? What kind of work do you do? Where do you come from? What is your country? From what people are you?”

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Keima Hebrew mi kahin, twikhanglen le leiset sempa Pakai van Pathen chu kakichan ahi, ati.
target: He answered, “I am a Hebrew and I worship the Lord , the God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.”

source: Chuin miho chu nasatah-in akicha cheh taovin, ahenga, Ipi dinga hitobang hi nabol hitam? atiuvin ahi. Ajehchu amaho aseipeh jeh chun, Pakai angsunga kona jama mi ahi ti chu amahon ahetauvin ahi.
target: This terrified them and they asked, “What have you done?” (They knew he was running away from the Lord , because he had already told them so.)

source: Chuin amahon ajah-a, Twipi hi kadinguva athip theina dinga nachunga hi ipi kaboldiu hitam? atiovin ahi, ajehchu twipi chu akinongin hui leh go akithotai.
target: The sea was getting rougher and rougher. So they asked him, “What should we do to you to make the sea calm down for us?”

source: Chuin aman ahenguva, Neidom uvin lang twipia chun neiseplha taovin; chutile nangho dinga twipi hi thipding ahitai: ajehchu keima jeh-a hiche huipi gopihi nachung uva chua ahi ti keiman kahei, ati.
target: “Pick me up and throw me into the sea,” he replied, “and it will become calm. I know that it is my fault that this great storm has come upon you.”

source: Ahijeng vangin miho chun kong chu tolgo lam lhutna teidin hatah-in atolun, ahinla ajoutapouvin ahi. Ajehchu twipi chu akinongin, huipi leh gopi chu amaho chunga akhoh cheh-in ahi.
target: Instead, the men did their best to row back to land. But they could not, for the sea grew even wilder than before.

source: Hijeh chun amaho Pakai henga ataovun, Nahenga kataovu ahi, Vo Pakai, nahenga kahung taovu ahi; hiche mihempa hinkho jeh hin neimanthah sah hih-un, chule themona bei thisan chu kachunguva kikoi hihhen; ajehchu Vo Pakai, nangin nalungdei banga nabol ahi, atiuve.
target: Then they cried out to the Lord , “Please, Lord , do not let us die for taking this man’s life. Do not hold us accountable for killing an innocent man, for you, Lord , have done as you pleased.”

source: Hitichun amahon Jonah chu adomun, twipia aseplha taovin ahi: chutah-in twipi chu akinon na-a konin athiptan ahi.
target: Then they took Jonah and threw him overboard, and the raging sea grew calm.

source: Chuin amahon Pakai chu kichat mainan akicha tapouvin, Pakai henga ganlhaina abolun, chule kitepna aneijun ahi.
target: At this the men greatly feared the Lord , and they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made vows to him.

source: Tun Pakaiyin Jonah val dingin ngapi lentah khat gotsan anakoijin ahi. Chuin Jonah chu ngapi oisunga ni thumle jan thum aumin ahi.
target: Now the Lord provided a huge fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

source: Chujouvin Jonah ngapi oisunga konin Pakai a-Pathen henga ataovin,
target: From inside the fish Jonah prayed to the Lord his God.

source: Hitin aseije, Eikibol gimna jeh-in Pakai henga kataovin ahile, aman eingaipeh-in; keima thikholkhul tobang ngapi oisunga konin kataovin ahile, nangman ka aw neingaipeh-in ahi.
target: He said: “In my distress I called to the Lord , and he answered me. From deep in the realm of the dead I called for help, and you listened to my cry.

source: Ajehchu nangman twithuh tah, twipi lailunga neiseplut nin; twisoh ho chun eium kimveltan: natwi kidil hole twikinong ho chun eichuptan ahi.
target: You hurled me into the depths, into the very heart of the seas, and the currents swirled about me; all your waves and breakers swept over me.

source: Chujouvin keiman, Namitmu-a kona keima kipaimanga um kahitan; hijongle nahouin theng lam chu kahin galdot kit ding ahi, kati.
target: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’

source: Twihon keima eiumkimvelin, kahinna chan geijin; twithuh-in kakimvel akhah chah-in, hamdong hon kalu kimvel atomin ahi.
target: The engulfing waters threatened me, the deep surrounded me; seaweed was wrapped around my head.

source: Keima molsang ho bul geijin kakumsuh-in, leiset le agol kijam ho chu a-imatih-a dingin kakimvela aume; hijongle Vo Pakai ka Pathen, nangman kahinkho hi thina kokhuh-a konin napui dohtan ahi.
target: To the roots of the mountains I sank down; the earth beneath barred me in forever. But you, Lord my God, brought my life up from the pit.

source: Kasungila kahinna hi alhahlhop tengle Pakai kageldohjin; chule kataona hi nangma heng, nahouin theng sunga ahung lhungjin ahi.
target: “When my life was ebbing away, I remembered you, Lord , and my prayer rose to you, to your holy temple.

source: Pannabei jouthu kisei nitna miho chun akihepinao chu adalhah-u ahitai.
target: “Those who cling to worthless idols turn away from God’s love for them.

source: Ahinla keiman vang thangvahna awging puma nahenga kilhaina kaneiding, chule kakitepna jong chu kapeh ding ahi. Huhhingna hi Pakaiya kon ahi.
target: But I, with shouts of grateful praise, will sacrifice to you. What I have vowed I will make good. I will say, ‘Salvation comes from the Lord .’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Ngapi henga thu aseijin ahile, Jonah chu vapam leigo chunga ahin lodoh tan ahi.
target: And the Lord commanded the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto dry land.

source: Chuin anivei channan Pakai thu chu Jonah henga ahungin, aseije,
target: Then the word of the Lord came to Jonah a second time:

source: Kipatdoh-in, khuche khopi lentah Nineveh'a khun chen, chule keiman seiphong dinga kapeh thuhi gaseiphongin, ati.
target: “Go to the great city of Nineveh and proclaim to it the message I give you.”

source: Hitichun Jonah akipatdoh-in, Pakai thu dungjuijin Nineveh'a chun achetan ahi. Tun Nineveh chu khopi lentah ahin, ni thum sung kijot ahi.
target: Jonah obeyed the word of the Lord and went to Nineveh. Now Nineveh was a very large city; it took three days to go through it.

source: Chuin Jonah chu khopi sung alutnin, ni khat lampi ajot panin, aman, Tua pat nisomli joule Nineveh kisumang ding ahi, tin asamin ahi.
target: Jonah began by going a day’s journey into the city, proclaiming, “Forty more days and Nineveh will be overthrown.”

source: Hitichun Nineveh miten Pathen chu atahsan taovin, an ngolna ding aphongun, amaho alenpenna pat aneopen chan geijin khaodip pon akisilun ahi.
target: The Ninevites believed God. A fast was proclaimed, and all of them, from the greatest to the least, put on sackcloth.

source: Chule thu chu Nineveh lengpa henga ahung lhungtan, chuin ama alaltouna-a konin akipatdoh-in, alalvon chu akoilhan, khaodip pon akikhun, vut lah-a atoutan ahi.
target: When Jonah’s warning reached the king of Nineveh, he rose from his throne, took off his royal robes, covered himself with sackcloth and sat down in the dust.

source: Chuin aman lengpa le amilalte minna Nineveh khopi pumpi-a phonjala sapphong dingin thupeh aneijin, hitin ati, Mihem hihen sahem hijongle, bonghon hihen kelngoihon hijongle imacha atep louhel diu ahi: amahon an jong anehlou diu, twi jong adonlou diu ahi.
target: This is the proclamation he issued in Nineveh: “By the decree of the king and his nobles: Do not let people or animals, herds or flocks, taste anything; do not let them eat or drink.

source: Ahin mihem le ganchaho chun khaodip pon kikhu-u henlang, Pathen henga nasatah-in taovuhen. Ahi, amitin athilse bolna lampile akhutnuva pumhat thilbol ho-a konin hung kilekitnuhen.
target: But let people and animals be covered with sackcloth. Let everyone call urgently on God. Let them give up their evil ways and their violence.

source: Eiho imanthah louna dinguva, ijemtia Pathen ahung kihei kitna alung aheija, alungsatna khohtah-a kona akiheimang kit thei ding kon aseithei ding ham? ati.
target: Who knows? God may yet relent and with compassion turn from his fierce anger so that we will not perish.”

source: Chuin Pathen'in anatoh hou, athilse bolnao lampi ho-a kona ahung kilehei kitnu chu amun; chule Pathen'in achunguva kabol ding ahi tia asei thilse-a kon chun alung aheijin, aboltapon ahi.
target: When God saw what they did and how they turned from their evil ways, he relented and did not bring on them the destruction he had threatened.

source: Ahinla hiche hin Jonah chu hatah-in alunglhaisah tapon, ama alunghang lheh jengtan ahi.
target: But to Jonah this seemed very wrong, and he became angry.

source: Chuin ama Pakai henga ataovin, Vo Pakai, nahenga katao ahi, kachenna gamsunga kaum petna kanasei chu hiche hi ana hilouham? Hijeh-a chu namasanga kona Tarshish lama kanajam ahi. Ajehchu nangma lungsetna dim Pathen, hepina dim, lunghang vahlou, khotona lentah nei, thilse-a kona lungheiji Pathen nahi kahet ahi.
target: He prayed to the Lord , “Isn’t this what I said, Lord , when I was still at home? That is what I tried to forestall by fleeing to Tarshish. I knew that you are a gracious and compassionate God, slow to anger and abounding in love, a God who relents from sending calamity.

source: Hijeh chun tun Vo Pakai, nahenga katao ahi, keima-a konin kahinkho hi latan; ajehchu keima dingin hinsangin thi aphajoi, ati.
target: Now, Lord , take away my life, for it is better for me to die than to live.”

source: Hichun Pakaiyin, Nalunghan hi pha nasah ham? ati.
target: But the Lord replied, “Is it right for you to be angry?”

source: Hitichun Jonah khopi-a konin apotdoh-in, khopi solam sanga atouvin, hia chun buhkhat asongin, khopi chunga chu ipi hung lhungem ti amutheina din buhlim noija chun atouvin ahi.
target: Jonah had gone out and sat down at a place east of the city. There he made himself a shelter, sat in its shade and waited to see what would happen to the city.

source: Chuin Pakai Pathen'in umgui khat ahin kedohsah-in, alung hesohna-a kona huhdoh-a aumna dingle, aluchunga nilima pang dingin, Jonah chungvuma akhandoh sah-in ahi. Hitichun umgui jal chun Jonah akipah lheh jengin ahi.
target: Then the Lord God provided a leafy plant and made it grow up over Jonah to give shade for his head to ease his discomfort, and Jonah was very happy about the plant.

source: Ahinla akit nikho jingkah ahunghi phatnin, Pathen'in lung khat ahinsolin, hichun umgui chu anegamin ahile agolhatai.
target: But at dawn the next day God provided a worm, which chewed the plant so that it withered.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, nisa ahungso phatnin, Pathen'in solam hui gimsetah-a sa chu ahin nunsah-in; chule nisan Jonah luchung chu ahinkhon ahile ama alha lhoptan, chuin aman thiding alhangai tan, Keima dingin hinsangin thi ding aphajoi, ati.
target: When the sun rose, God provided a scorching east wind, and the sun blazed on Jonah’s head so that he grew faint. He wanted to die, and said, “It would be better for me to die than to live.”

source: Chuin Pathen'in Jonah henga, Umgui jeh-a nalunghan hi dih nasah ham? ati. Chuin aman, Thina chan geija dinga kalunghan hi dih kasai, ati.
target: But God said to Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about the plant?” “It is,” he said. “And I’m so angry I wish I were dead.”

source: Hichun Pakaiyin, Nangman natohgim jong hilou, nakhansah jong hilou, jankah-a hungkeh doh-a jankah-a mangthah-a umgui chunga bon hepina naneija ahile;
target: But the Lord said, “You have been concerned about this plant, though you did not tend it or make it grow. It sprang up overnight and died overnight.

source: Achutile chuche Nineveh khopi lentah, asunga akhut jetlamu le akhut veilamu jong hekhen theilou mihem sangjakhat le sangsomni hole, gancha tamtah ho khu keiman khendoh louva kakoi ding ham? ati.
target: And should I not have concern for the great city of Nineveh, in which there are more than a hundred and twenty thousand people who cannot tell their right hand from their left—and also many animals?”

source: Judah lengho Jotham, Ahaz chule Hezekiah nikholaijin Moresheth mi Micah henga Pakai thu hunglhung, Samaria le Jerusalem chung chang thudolla athilmu.
target: The word of the Lord that came to Micah of Moresheth during the reigns of Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah—the vision he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

source: Ngaijun nangho mijousen; Vo leisetle asunga um jousen, ngaitemun; Pakai Pathen chu nangho douna-a ahetoh hihen, a-houin thenga kona Pakai chu ahetoh chu hihen.
target: Hear, you peoples, all of you, listen, earth and all who live in it, that the Sovereign Lord may bear witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

source: Ajehchu veuvin, Pakai chu aumna munna kona hung potdoh-a, leiset munsang ho chu achotpha ding ahi.
target: Look! The Lord is coming from his dwelling place; he comes down and treads on the heights of the earth.

source: Chule mei koma khoilu jun bangle, twiho mun nema akisunlhah bang hella, phaicham ho chu khikeh-a, molsangho chu anoija junlha ding ahi
target: The mountains melt beneath him and the valleys split apart, like wax before the fire, like water rushing down a slope.

source: Hicheho jousehi Jacob khan gitlou jehle, Israel insung chonset jeh ahi. Jacob suhkhelna ipi ham? Samaria chu hilou ham? Chule Judah munsang ho chu ipi ham? Jerusalem chu hilou ham?
target: All this is because of Jacob’s transgression, because of the sins of the people of Israel. What is Jacob’s transgression? Is it not Samaria? What is Judah’s high place? Is it not Jerusalem?

source: Hijeh-a chu keiman Samaria chu gamlah-a thilnen kisekhom banga kasema, chule lengpi leija kibol ding; Chule chua songho chu damphaija kasunlhah-a, abul ho chu kadosah ding ahi.
target: “Therefore I will make Samaria a heap of rubble, a place for planting vineyards. I will pour her stones into the valley and lay bare her foundations.

source: Chule alim semthu milim jouse chu kavohchip gam hella, noti mana amu jouse chu meija kahal vam gamhel ding, chule milim jouse chu kasuh manghel ding ahi; ajehchu amanun noti mana kon alokhom ahijeh-in, hicheho chu noti man mama-a kilekit ding ahi.
target: All her idols will be broken to pieces; all her temple gifts will be burned with fire; I will destroy all her images. Since she gathered her gifts from the wages of prostitutes, as the wages of prostitutes they will again be used.”

source: Hijeh-a chu kaka-a kapen ding, kakisut lha-a sagoh keova kaumding ahi. Dragon ho bangin penging ting, sumbupi bangin haminge.
target: Because of this I will weep and wail; I will go about barefoot and naked. I will howl like a jackal and moan like an owl.

source: Ajehchu amanu maput chu damkit theilou ahi: ajehchu hichehi Judah gam alhungtan, kamite kotpi phung ahung lhungtan, Jerusalem jengjong ahung lhungtai.
target: For Samaria’s plague is incurable; it has spread to Judah. It has reached the very gate of my people, even to Jerusalem itself.

source: Hichehi Gath kho-a seiphong hih-un, kapjong kaphih hellun; Aphrah insunga leivui lah-a chun kitangle leovin.
target: Tell it not in Gath; weep not at all. In Beth Ophrah roll in the dust.

source: Vo Shaphir'a chengpa nangma, sagoh keovin jahcha tah-in chemangtan, Zaanan miho chu Bethe-zel miho lunghemna-a dingin apotdoh pouvin, aman nangma-a kona dinmun akimuding ahi.
target: Pass by naked and in shame, you who live in Shaphir. Those who live in Zaanan will not come out. Beth Ezel is in mourning; it no longer protects you.

source: Maroth mihon chingthei tah-in chanpha angahuvin, ahinla Pakaiya konin thilse chu Jerusalem kotpi phung ahunglhung suhtai.
target: Those who live in Maroth writhe in pain, waiting for relief, because disaster has come from the Lord , even to the gate of Jerusalem.

source: Vo, nangho Lachish mite, kangtalai chu gamsa hattah toh sutouvin; amanu hi Zion chanute chonset kipatna ahin, ajehchu Israel suhkhelna chu nanga akimudoh-in ahi.
target: You who live in Lachish, harness fast horses to the chariot. You are where the sin of Daughter Zion began, for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.

source: Hijeh-a chu nangin Moresheth-gath henga thilpeh napeh ding, Achzib inho chu Israel lengho dinga lheplhahna hiding ahi.
target: Therefore you will give parting gifts to Moresheth Gath. The town of Akzib will prove deceptive to the kings of Israel.

source: Ahinla vo Mareshah mi, nangma goulo ding khat nahenga kahin puiding; Israel loupi nachu Adullam geija hung ding ahi.
