target: I will bring a conqueror against you who live in Mareshah. The nobles of Israel will flee to Adullam.

source: Nasam kivel tollin, nacha ngaitahho jallin kivel tollin; mulaopi lumui bangin kivou muijin, ajehchu amaho nanga kona gal hinga che ahitaove.
target: Shave your head in mourning for the children in whom you delight; make yourself as bald as the vulture, for they will go from you into exile.

source: Khangitlouna thilgongho, ajalkhun chunga thilse bolho chu ohe adao ahi! akhutnuva boltheina umma ahijeh-in, jingkah kho hungvah teng hichu aboljiuve.
target: Woe to those who plan iniquity, to those who plot evil on their beds! At morning’s light they carry it out because it is in their power to do it.

source: Chule amahon mi lou athang setnun, pumhatnin alahpeh-un; chule inho athangset nun, alahpeh-un; chutichun amahon mihem le a-in, amihem le anei agouho asugenthei jin ahi.
target: They covet fields and seize them, and houses, and take them. They defraud people of their homes, they rob them of their inheritance.

source: Hijeh chun veuvin, hiche insung douna dingin thil gilou kagongin; hiche phat hi phat phalou ahijeh-a chua kona chu nangongu naheithei lou dingu, hoitho tah-a naumthei lou dingu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Therefore, the Lord says: “I am planning disaster against this people, from which you cannot save yourselves. You will no longer walk proudly, for it will be a time of calamity.

source: Hicheni chule mikhatnin nangho douna-a thulem khat aseija, lunghem tah-a ka la-a nakacham uva; eikisumang theng helluva ahitai, kamite gouchan chu akheldoh tai; Aman hichu keija kona iti ana chon mang ahitadem! aman kagam hou chu akaleh in eihop khenpeh taove, tia aseidiu ahi.
target: In that day people will ridicule you; they will taunt you with this mournful song: ‘We are utterly ruined; my people’s possession is divided up. He takes it from me! He assigns our fields to traitors.’ ”

source: Hijeh-a chu nangin Pakai houkhom na-a khaova vang kisanna chan homding koima naneilou dingu ahi.
target: Therefore you will have no one in the assembly of the Lord to divide the land by lot.

source: Gao hih-un, tin gao thusei ho henga seijuvin; amaho henga chu amahon gaothu aseiloudiu, chule amahon jachatna atoloudiu ahi.
target: “Do not prophesy,” their prophets say. “Do not prophesy about these things; disgrace will not overtake us.”

source: Vo nangho Jacob insung tia kiminvote, Pakai lhagao chu nahsah mo-a uma ham? hichehi ama natoh hi jaham? Kitah-a chonpha chunga chu kathu hohin thilpha abolji hilou ham?
target: You descendants of Jacob, should it be said, “Does the Lord become impatient? Does he do such things?” “Do not my words do good to the one whose ways are upright?

source: Ahinla tumapan louvin kamitehi melma bangin nabolun; nangman gal deilou mongtah-a vahle ho chu galmuna kon hung kileho bangin avonu le asangkhol cholu nasutlhah peh-in ahi.
target: Lately my people have risen up like an enemy. You strip off the rich robe from those who pass by without a care, like men returning from battle.

source: Kamite numei ho chu a-in'u nomtah ho-a konin nanodoh un, kaloupina chu achateuva konin a-itih-a dingin naladoh taove.
target: You drive the women of my people from their pleasant homes. You take away my blessing from their children forever.

source: Hikom munhi nakicholdo nao mun ahilou jeh-in, kipat un lang potdoh-un; ajehchu hichehi akisuboh ahin, hichun nangho nasuhmanguva, melse tah-a nasuh gamheldiu ahi.
target: Get up, go away! For this is not your resting place, because it is defiled, it is ruined, beyond all remedy.

source: Mikhat chun lhagaovin vahle hen adihlouvin jou bol henlang, keiman lengpitwi le ju thu-in naheng uva gaothu seijinge, tile, ama chu hiche mite themgao hiding ahi.
target: If a liar and deceiver comes and says, ‘I will prophesy for you plenty of wine and beer,’ that would be just the prophet for this people!

source: Vo Jacob, keiman nabon chaova kakhop khom teidingu ahi. Keiman thonlouva Israel amoh chengse chu kakhop khom ding, keiman amaho Bozrah kelngoi banga kakoi khoma, hongsunga kelngoihon banga kakoi khomding; amaho mipi tamtah jeh-a husan nasatah aso dingu ahi.
target: “I will surely gather all of you, Jacob; I will surely bring together the remnant of Israel. I will bring them together like sheep in a pen, like a flock in its pasture; the place will throng with people.

source: Asusepa chu amasanguva ahungdoh-e; amahon asuseuvin, chule kotpi chu ajotpaijun, chua chun achedoh taove; chule alengpao chu amasanguva chea, Pakai chu amaho luchang hiding ahi.
target: The One who breaks open the way will go up before them; they will break through the gate and go out. Their King will pass through before them, the Lord at their head.”

source: Chuin keiman, Vo Jacob luchangho, chule Israel insunga pipuiho, ngai phaovin, naheng uva katao ahi, nanghon thutandih nahet dingdolu hilou ham? kati.
target: Then I said, “Listen, you leaders of Jacob, you rulers of Israel. Should you not embrace justice,

source: Nangho apha hot bolla ase ngailuho, amaho-a kon avunu naleolhah peh-un, aguhouva konin atahsapheo nakhoh lha uvin;
target: you who hate good and love evil; who tear the skin from my people and the flesh from their bones;

source: Kamite sajong nane uvin, amaho-a kon avunu naliplhauvin; chule bella lhah ding bangle belpi sunga lhahding bangin aguhou navochip un, aphe-u nachen bong selun ahi.
target: who eat my people’s flesh, strip off their skin and break their bones in pieces; who chop them up like meat for the pan, like flesh for the pot?”

source: Chuteng amaho Pakai henga penguntin, hijongleh aman amaho angaipeh lou ding; athil bollule amaho tah chonna phatlou jeh-a, aman amaho-a kona amai jengjong aselding ahi.
target: Then they will cry out to the Lord , but he will not answer them. At that time he will hide his face from them because of the evil they have done.

source: Kamite lamvai sah-a, chamna umhen tia samma, aha uva pet; akamuva ima henglouva pa douna-a galsat dinga kigo themgaoho thudolla; Pakaiyin hitin aseije.
target: This is what the Lord says: “As for the prophets who lead my people astray, they proclaim ‘peace’ if they have something to eat, but prepare to wage war against anyone who refuses to feed them.

source: Hijeh chun mu naneilou helna diuva nangho dinga jan hunglhung ding, chule ai nasan theilouna dinguva nachung uva mu thim ding, chule themgaoho chunga nisa lhumma, amaho chunga chu sun jong thim ding ahi.
target: Therefore night will come over you, without visions, and darkness, without divination. The sun will set for the prophets, and the day will go dark for them.

source: Chutengle themgaoho chu jahchao vintin, Ai themho chu maimoh dingu; henge, Pathen'a kona donbutna aumtah loujeh-a, amahon akamu akisipdiu ahitai.
target: The seers will be ashamed and the diviners disgraced. They will all cover their faces because there is no answer from God.”

source: Ahinla Jacob henga asuhkhelna, Israel henga achonsetna phonpeh dingin, Pakai lhagaova konin tahbeh-in thilboltheina, thutanna chule hatna-in kadimset tan ahi.
target: But as for me, I am filled with power, with the Spirit of the Lord , and with justice and might, to declare to Jacob his transgression, to Israel his sin.

source: Nangho Jacob insung luchangho leh Israel insung pipuho, thutanna hotbola, thudih akaleh-a heiho, naheng uva katao ahi, hichehi ngai phaovin.
target: Hear this, you leaders of Jacob, you rulers of Israel, who despise justice and distort all that is right;

source: Amahon Zion chu thisan aso uvin, Jerusalem chu khangitlouna asouve.
target: who build Zion with bloodshed, and Jerusalem with wickedness.

source: Chukoma vaipoho chun thilpeh kineppi na-in thu atannun, chule thempuhon tohman mun'a dingin ahilun, themgaoho chun sum deinan agaovui. Achutijeng vangin, Pakai chu eiho lah-a uma hilou ham? Ichunguva thilphalou hunglhung ponte, atiuvin Pakaiya akingaijun ahi.
target: Her leaders judge for a bribe, her priests teach for a price, and her prophets tell fortunes for money. Yet they look for the Lord ’s support and say, “Is not the Lord among us? No disaster will come upon us.”

source: Hijeh-a chu Zion chu nangho jala lou banga kikaija, Jerusalem chu thilboh kisevum hung hiding, houin umna molsang chu gamlah-a munsang ho bangding ahi.
target: Therefore because of you, Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, the temple hill a mound overgrown with thickets.

source: Ahinla ninunung lamleh hunghiti ding ahi, Pakai in umna molsang chu molsang ho chung vuma hung kisadoh ding, lhangvum hoa choisanga hung umding; chule hia chu mipi ho twilona longlut dingu ahiuve.
target: In the last days the mountain of the Lord ’s temple will be established as the highest of the mountains; it will be exalted above the hills, and peoples will stream to it.

source: Chule namtinho chu hunguvin tin, hungun, Pakai molsanga kaltouvu hitin, Jacob Pathen in'a chun kaltouvu hite; aman alampiho chu eihil untin, eiho alampia chu ichediu ahi; Zion'a kon chun danthupeh potdoh intin, Pakai thu chu Jerusalem'a kona hungpotdoh ding ahi.
target: Many nations will come and say, “Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord , to the temple of the God of Jacob. He will teach us his ways, so that we may walk in his paths.” The law will go out from Zion, the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

source: Chule aman mitamtah thu atana, chule gamla tah-a nam hattahho chu aphosal ding; chuleh achemjamu chu lou kaina ha-a akhendiu, chule atengcha hou chu kangkuija akhendiu ahi; nam khatnin nam khat chunga chemjam lamtapontin, galsat jejong kithemchuh tapouvinte.
target: He will judge between many peoples and will settle disputes for strong nations far and wide. They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not take up sword against nation, nor will they train for war anymore.

source: Ahivangin mi jouse ama ama lengpi theile theichang phung noija touvuntin, koima chan kichatsah tapou vinte; ajehchu janel Pakaiyin akamcheng tah-a aphondoh ahi.
target: Everyone will sit under their own vine and under their own fig tree, and no one will make them afraid, for the Lord Almighty has spoken.

source: Ajehchu mi jouse ama Pathen min cheh-a chonuntin, chule eiho Pakai i-Pathen'u mina atonsot atonsotna ichon lediu ahitai.
target: All the nations may walk in the name of their gods, but we will walk in the name of the Lord our God for ever and ever.

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije, hicheni chuleh keiman elbaiho khom ingting, akinomang saho kakhopkhoma, chule kasuhgentheiho chu kakhop khom ding ahi;
target: “In that day,” declares the Lord , “I will gather the lame; I will assemble the exiles and those I have brought to grief.

source: Chule elbaiho chu ahingdoh amoh-a kasemding, gamla tah-a kipaidoh ho chu nam hattah khatna kasem ding ahi; tua patna Pakaiyin Zion molsanga tonsotna achunguva vai ahomding ahi.
target: I will make the lame my remnant, those driven away a strong nation. The Lord will rule over them in Mount Zion from that day and forever.

source: Chule Vo nangma, ganchaho insang, Zion chanu umna kuldet, nahenga hunglhung ding ahi, navaihom na masa jongchu hunglhung ding ahi; lenggam chu Jerusalem chanute henga hunglhung ding ahi.
target: As for you, watchtower of the flock, stronghold of Daughter Zion, the former dominion will be restored to you; kingship will come to Daughter Jerusalem.”

source: Tu-a ibolla awthong jeju-a naka ham? nalah uva leng umlou ham? nangma nathumop ji-a chu mang thah-a hitam? ajehchu numei naosonat banga natna-in naphah ahitai.
target: Why do you now cry aloud— have you no king? Has your ruler perished, that pain seizes you like that of a woman in labor?

source: Vo Zion chanu, naonei dingin chanei dinga naosonat thohgim bangin thohgimin; ajehchu khopi-a kona tu-a napotdoh-a, loujaova nachen ding, chule Babylon geipeh-a nache ding ahi. Chukoma chu huhdoh-a naum ding; chukoma chu namelmaho khutna kona Pakaiyin nahuhdoh ding ahi.
target: Writhe in agony, Daughter Zion, like a woman in labor, for now you must leave the city to camp in the open field. You will go to Babylon; there you will be rescued. There the Lord will redeem you out of the hand of your enemies.

source: Tunjong nangma doudin nam tamtah akikhom taovin, amanu suhboh-in umhen lang, imitnu hin Zion vehen, atiuve.
target: But now many nations are gathered against you. They say, “Let her be defiled, let our eyes gloat over Zion!”

source: Ahinla amahon Pakai lunggel ho chu ahepouvin, athumopna jong ahethem pouve; ajehchu pholla changphal ho banga amaho chu akhop khomding ahi.
target: But they do not know the thoughts of the Lord ; they do not understand his plan, that he has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor.

source: Vo Zion chanu, thouvin lang chillin, naki chu thih banga kasem ding, natin chu sum-eng banga kasem ding ahi; chule mi atama tam ahalhalla nasuhchip ding; chule ahamphatnao Pakaiya dinga kakatdoh ding, chule athilluhou chu leiset pumpi Pakaiya dinga kakatdoh ding ahi.
target: “Rise and thresh, Daughter Zion, for I will give you horns of iron; I will give you hooves of bronze, and you will break to pieces many nations.” You will devote their ill-gotten gains to the Lord , their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.

source: Vo galsat mihonpi chanu, tun nangman galsatmi ahona din kigom khomin; aman eiho dounan kulpi eikaikhum taovin; amahon Israel thutanpa chu molla angeiphe avohdiu ahi.
target: Marshal your troops now, city of troops, for a siege is laid against us. They will strike Israel’s ruler on the cheek with a rod.

source: Ahinla nangma, Bethlehem Ephrathah, nangma Judah gam sang tamtah lah-a neocha hijongle chun, nangma-a kona kami Israelte lah-a vaipo ding khat hungsoh doh ding; ahung kipatna chu masanglaipeh, tonsotna pat ahitai.
target: “But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, though you are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come for me one who will be ruler over Israel, whose origins are from of old, from ancient times.”

source: Hijeh-a chu aman naosonat thohnun cha ahindoh kahse-a, amaho chu donlouva akoija adalhah ding ahitai; chutengle asopite ahingdoh amoh chengse chu Israel chate henga hung kile kit dingu ahi.
target: Therefore Israel will be abandoned until the time when she who is in labor bears a son, and the rest of his brothers return to join the Israelites.

source: Chule ama chu dingin tin Pakai thahat na-a chu kivah ding; Pakai a-Pathen loupina-a minna chu kivah ding; chule amaho umjing dingu ahitai; ajehchu tu-a ama chu leiset kolmong geija loupi ding ahitai.
target: He will stand and shepherd his flock in the strength of the Lord , in the majesty of the name of the Lord his God. And they will live securely, for then his greatness will reach to the ends of the earth.

source: Chule Assyria miho chu igam sunguva hi ahunglut tengule, hiche mipahi kichamna chu hintin; chule aman ileng inpihou ahin chotpha tengleh, eihon ama doudinga kelngoi ching sagi le pipui get itun dohdiu ahi.
target: And he will be our peace when the Assyrians invade our land and march through our fortresses. We will raise against them seven shepherds, even eight commanders,

source: Chule amahon Assyria gam chu chemjam'a asuhgamuva, Nimrod gam chu ahunglut na-a asuhgam diu; chutia chu ama igam sunguva ahunglutna, igamgisung hou achotpha tengle, Assyria mite-a kona eihuhdoh dingu ahi.
target: who will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, the land of Nimrod with drawn sword. He will deliver us from the Assyrians when they invade our land and march across our borders.

source: Chule Jacob'a ahingdoh amoh chengse chu, mipi tamtah lah-a Pakaiya kon daitwi le hamhing chunga goju banga umding ahiuve; hichun mihem angahpon, chule mihem chapate jong angah pon ahi.
target: The remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the Lord , like showers on the grass, which do not wait for anyone or depend on man.

source: Chule Jacob'a ahingdoh amoh chengse chu mipi tamtah lah chidang namdangte lah-a gammang lah gamsaho lah-a keipi bahkai tobang hidiu, chule kelngoi hon lah-a keipi bahkai khangdong tobang hi ding ahi; Amachu avahlen ahile, achonlhun chule abottelin, koima ahuhdoh jou aumpoi.
target: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, which mauls and mangles as it goes, and no one can rescue.

source: Nakhut chu nakidoupi te chunga kidomsang ding, chule namelmaho chu kisatlha ding ahi.
target: Your hand will be lifted up in triumph over your enemies, and all your foes will be destroyed.

source: Chule hiche ni chule hunghiti ding ahi, Keiman nalah uva kona nasakol hou chu kasat chapma, chule nakangtalai hou chu kasuhmang ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “In that day,” declares the Lord , “I will destroy your horses from among you and demolish your chariots.

source: Chule keiman nagam uva khopiho chu kasat gama, chule nakhopi det jouseu kasuhchim ding ahi.
target: I will destroy the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.

source: Chule keiman nakhutna mitpheldoi themho chu kasatlhah ding, chuleh nangman phunsan ho naneilou ding ahitai.
target: I will destroy your witchcraft and you will no longer cast spells.

source: Nalah uva kona namilim semthu hou kasatlhah ding, chule namilimu dinglaiho kasat lhah ding ahi; chule nanghon nakhutsemhou chu nahou kit tahlou heldiu ahi.
target: I will destroy your idols and your sacred stones from among you; you will no longer bow down to the work of your hands.

source: Nalah uva kona nathing milimhou chu kabodoh ding, chutiachu nakhopihou chu kasuhmang ding ahi.
target: I will uproot from among you your Asherah poles when I demolish your cities.

source: Chule Pathen hephalouho chunga, anajahkhah louvu lunghang tah-a phulahna le lungsatna kalhunsah ding ahi.
target: I will take vengeance in anger and wrath on the nations that have not obeyed me.”

source: Tun nanghon Pakai thuseihi ngaijun; kipat doh unlang molsang ho masanga nachung thu galhutnun, lhangho chun na aw-u ngaijuhen.
target: Listen to what the Lord says: “Stand up, plead my case before the mountains; let the hills hear what you have to say.

source: Vo nangho, molsang jousen, Pakai nelkalna chu ngaijun, chule nangho leibul dettahhon ngaijuvin, ajehchu Pakai chun ami Israelte toh kinel kalna aneijin, chule ama Israelte toh kinel ding ahi.
target: “Hear, you mountains, the Lord ’s accusation; listen, you everlasting foundations of the earth. For the Lord has a case against his people; he is lodging a charge against Israel.

source: Vo kamiteho, nangho-a dinga ipi kanabolem? chule hoilaija kana suhchol khah uvem? neihin donbutnun.
target: “My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me.

source: Ajehchu keiman Egypt gamma konin nangma kahin puidoh-in, chule soh hina insunga konin kalhat doh-in, namasanguva Mosi, Aaron chule Miriam kasole.
target: I brought you up out of Egypt and redeemed you from the land of slavery. I sent Moses to lead you, also Aaron and Miriam.

source: Vo, kamiteho, Pakai chonphatna chu nahet theina dinguva, Moab lengpa Balak thumop le, Beor chapa Balam'in Shittim'a kona Gilgal geija adonbut dan chu, tuhin geldoh uvin.
target: My people, remember what Balak king of Moab plotted and what Balaam son of Beor answered. Remember your journey from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of the Lord .”

source: Pakai anga chu ipitoh kahunga, Pathen chungnung anga chu kakunding ham? kum khatbep bongnou leh govam thilto toh ama anga chu kahung ding ham?
target: With what shall I come before the Lord and bow down before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?

source: Pakai chu kelngoichal sang tamtah jeh-a lunglhaija, ahiloule thaotwija long vadung sangsoma lunglhai dingham? Kasuhkhel jeh-a kacha masapen chu kapeh-a, kahinna chonset jeh-a kalaigil ga chu kapeh ding ham?
target: Will the Lord be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousand rivers of olive oil? Shall I offer my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

source: Vo mihem, aman apha chu navetsahsa ahitan; Pakaiyin nangma-a kona angeh chu navetsah ahitai; dihtah-a na natoh-a, hepina nakhoh sah-a, chule kineosah tah-a na-Pathen toh lam najotkhom ding chu hilou ham?
target: He has shown you, O mortal, what is good. And what does the Lord require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.

source: Pakai aw chu khopi heng lama akisamin, chihna nei mihon namin amu dingu ahi; Nanghon tenggol le alheng dohpa thu ngaijuvin.
target: Listen! The Lord is calling to the city— and to fear your name is wisdom— “Heed the rod and the One who appointed it.

source: Migiloupa ina chu gitlouna goubom um nalaija, thil tena dihlou thet umtah chu um nalaijem?
target: Am I still to forget your ill-gotten treasures, you wicked house, and the short ephah, which is accursed?

source: Khaikot dihlou pumle lheplhahna khaodip gihtah puma chu amaho athenga kasim ding ham?
target: Shall I acquit someone with dishonest scales, with a bag of false weights?

source: Ajehchu chukoma mihaoho chu hunam dimset ahiuvin, chule chua chengho chun jou thu aseijun, akamuva aleiju chu lheplhah na dimset ahi.
target: Your rich people are violent; your inhabitants are liars and their tongues speak deceitfully.

source: Hijeh-a chu kenjong nang kavoh-a kanatsah ding, nachonset naho jeh-a agohkeova kalha ding nahi.
target: Therefore, I have begun to destroy you, to ruin you because of your sins.

source: Nangman nen natin, ahivanga nava louding; chule lhahsamna chu nalai lunga umding ahi; nangman tuhdet ding somin natin, ahivanga nahuhdoh jou louding ahi; nahuhhing chasun jongchu keiman chemjam henga kapeh doh ding ahi.
target: You will eat but not be satisfied; your stomach will still be empty. You will store up but save nothing, because what you save I will give to the sword.

source: Nangman tun natin, ahivanga na-at louding, olive gaho chu chillin natin, ahivanga athao chu nakinu lou ding, lengpitwi lhumkeija nasemding, ahivanga nadon lou ding ahi.
target: You will plant but not harvest; you will press olives but not use the oil, you will crush grapes but not drink the wine.

source: Ajehchu Omri dan kisunho akinit jingin, Ahab insung miho thilbol jouse chu akibol jingin, chule athumop houva nachon jingin ahi; hijeh-a chu keiman nangma ahomkeova kasema, chule chua chengho chu nuijat nopna bep kahisah ding, chutia chu kamite ikisah louna chu napohdiu ahi.
target: You have observed the statutes of Omri and all the practices of Ahab’s house; you have followed their traditions. Therefore I will give you over to ruin and your people to derision; you will bear the scorn of the nations.”

source: Ohe ada kahi! ajehchu keima nipilai theiga ho kilohkhom bangle, lengpiga kilo lhahna nung bangin kaumtai; nehding thei bohla aumtapon, ka hinna'in theiga min masapen angaichan ahi.
target: What misery is mine! I am like one who gathers summer fruit at the gleaning of the vineyard; there is no cluster of grapes to eat, none of the early figs that I crave.

source: Mipha chu leisetna konin amangthah tan; mihemte lah-a kitah khatcha aumtapoi: abonchauvin thisanso ding ngahin aumun, mitin asopi mandin lenthang toh anung delen ahi.
target: The faithful have been swept from the land; not one upright person remains. Everyone lies in wait to shed blood; they hunt each other with nets.

source: Lung luttah-a akhut niuva thilse aboltheina dingu vin, pipuihon thilpeh angeh-un; Thutan hon nehguh angeh-un chule milenpa chun alung ngaichat dihlou chu aseidoh-in, chutichun amaho akithutoh soh uve.
target: Both hands are skilled in doing evil; the ruler demands gifts, the judge accepts bribes, the powerful dictate what they desire— they all conspire together.

source: Alah uva miphapen chu khaogui lingnei bang ahin, mikitahpen jong chu meithai seltholing sangin ahemjoi; nakinga tup nikho leh nakivilna nikho chu ahung lhunge, tuhi amaho dinga lungdona hiding ahi.
target: The best of them is like a brier, the most upright worse than a thorn hedge. The day God visits you has come, the day your watchmen sound the alarm. Now is the time of your confusion.

source: Loi legol chunga natahsan ngam hih-in, lamhil chunga jong kingai hih-in, na-anga lumnu henga jong namuh kihupmin.
target: Do not trust a neighbor; put no confidence in a friend. Even with the woman who lies in your embrace guard the words of your lips.

source: Ajehchu chapan apa ajatapon, chanu anu doudin akipan tan, mouvin atehpi adouvin, mihem dinga amelmaho chu ama insung miho tah ahitai.
target: For a son dishonors his father, a daughter rises up against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law— a man’s enemies are the members of his own household.

source: Hijeh chun keiman Pakai henglam vengting, eihuh hingpa Pathen chu kanga ding ahi; ka Pathen'in kataona eingaipeh ding ahi.
target: But as for me, I watch in hope for the Lord , I wait for God my Savior; my God will hear me.

source: Vo kamelma, kachunga kipah hih-in, keima kalhuh teng thou kitding kahi; muthima katouteng, Pakai chu keija dinga vah hiding ahi,
target: Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will rise. Though I sit in darkness, the Lord will be my light.

source: Ama douna kachonset jeh-in, kathu eiseipeh-a, kadinga thu atan masangsen, Pakai lunghana chu potange; aman khovah-a eipuidoh intin, achonphatna chu kamuding ahi.
target: Because I have sinned against him, I will bear the Lord ’s wrath, until he pleads my case and upholds my cause. He will bring me out into the light; I will see his righteousness.

source: Pakai na Pathen chu koiham? tia sei kamelma nun amu ding, jachat na-in amanu akhuding ahi; kamit tenin amanu chu avetding, lamlena bonlhoh banga amanu chotpha-a umding ahitai.
target: Then my enemy will see it and will be covered with shame, she who said to me, “Where is the Lord your God?” My eyes will see her downfall; even now she will be trampled underfoot like mire in the streets.

source: Nabangho kisahna ding nikho, hiche nikho chule thupeh chu gamla tah-a kichondoh ding ahi.
target: The day for building your walls will come, the day for extending your boundaries.

source: Hiche nikho chule ama Assyria gama konle khopi det ho-a kon, chule kulpi-a pat vadung gei, twipi apat twipi gei, amol alhanga kona nahenga hungding ahi.
target: In that day people will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, even from Egypt to the Euphrates and from sea to sea and from mountain to mountain.

source: Ahijeng vangin, chuche gam chu asunga chengho jehle, athilbol ga hou jeh-a agohkeova umding ahi.
target: The earth will become desolate because of its inhabitants, as the result of their deeds.

source: Carmel gammang lailunga, lunghem tah-a achanga cheng nagoulo kelngoihonho, chule namite chu namoltumin vah-in; masang laija bang chun, Bashan le Gilead na kivah uhen.
target: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your inheritance, which lives by itself in a forest, in fertile pasturelands. Let them feed in Bashan and Gilead as in days long ago.

source: Egypt gama kona nahung potdoh laija banga chu ahenga thil kidangtah kavetsah ding ahi.
target: “As in the days when you came out of Egypt, I will show them my wonders.”

source: Namtinin hichu muvintin, athahatna jouseu chu ajachat pidiu; amahon akhutnuva akamu akisip diu, anao ngong ding ahi.
target: Nations will see and be ashamed, deprived of all their power. They will put their hands over their mouths and their ears will become deaf.

source: Amahon gul bangin leivui leh untin, leija ganhingho banga akohouva kona hung kitholdoh diu; amahon Pakai i-Pathen'u chu akichatnuva, nangma jeh-a agindiu ahi.
target: They will lick dust like a snake, like creatures that crawl on the ground. They will come trembling out of their dens; they will turn in fear to the Lord our God and will be afraid of you.

source: Nang banga khangitlouna ngaidama Pathen koi uma, chule agoulo amoh chengse suhkhelna chelep sah-a koi umam? hepina akipapi jeh-in, alunghana a-itih-in aching jingpoi.
target: Who is a God like you, who pardons sin and forgives the transgression of the remnant of his inheritance? You do not stay angry forever but delight to show mercy.

source: Ama hungkilekit nintin, ichunguva khotona aneiding, ikhangit lounao hochu anemse ding; chule nangman achonset nahou jouse twipi thuh tah-a nalelut ding ahi.
target: You will again have compassion on us; you will tread our sins underfoot and hurl all our iniquities into the depths of the sea.

source: Nangman khanglui laija kapu kapateu henga nathu tepsa, Jacob henga thutah le Abraham henga hepina chu namolso ding ahi.
target: You will be faithful to Jacob, and show love to Abraham, as you pledged on oath to our ancestors in days long ago.

source: Nineveh khopi pohgih. Elkosh mi Nahum themgao thilmu lekhabu.
target: A prophecy concerning Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

source: Pathen hi thangthip tah le phulaji Pakai ahin; Pakaiyin phu alanjin, chule alungsajin ahi; Pakaiyin akidoupite chunga phu alahding, chule amelmate din alunghana akholin ahi.
target: The Lord is a jealous and avenging God; the Lord takes vengeance and is filled with wrath. The Lord takes vengeance on his foes and vents his wrath against his enemies.

source: Pakai hi lunghang vahlou, thahat nasatah nei ahin, chule mi khangilou chu talen pelouva akoilouhel ding ahi. Pakaiyin chimpei le khopi hui lah-a lampi aneijin, chule meilhang hohi akeng phang dinga leivui tobang ahi.
target: The Lord is slow to anger but great in power; the Lord will not leave the guilty unpunished. His way is in the whirlwind and the storm, and clouds are the dust of his feet.

source: Aman twipi aphoh-in, akansahjin, vadung jouse akansah jin ahi; Bashan le Karmel agolhatan, Lebanon pahcha amol gamtai.
target: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; he makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither and the blossoms of Lebanon fade.

source: Amasanga molsang ho akihotnin, lhangho ajunlha tan, chule a-angsunga leiset akalhan, vannoi leiset le asunga cheng jouse jong ahi.
target: The mountains quake before him and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, the world and all who live in it.

source: Alunghana masanga ding thei dinga koiham? chule alungsatna khoh tah-a um thei dinga koiham? alungsatna chu meikong bangin ahung kibung lhan, chule songpi ho chu aman asonlha jin ahi.
target: Who can withstand his indignation? Who can endure his fierce anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; the rocks are shattered before him.

source: Pakai hi apha ahin, lungkham nikho-a kulpidet ahi; ama tahsanna mite chu aman ahejingin ahi.
target: The Lord is good, a refuge in times of trouble. He cares for those who trust in him,

source: Ahinla twisoh longlet lhaleova amun chu akichaihel sah ding, chule muthimin ama melmate chu adelding ahi.
target: but with an overwhelming flood he will make an end of Nineveh; he will pursue his foes into the realm of darkness.

source: Nanghon Pakai douna-a ipi nagelu ham? Aman akhonna hela achaina asemding; anivei chana dinga kisuh gentheina sohdoh kit lou ding ahitai.
target: Whatever they plot against the Lord he will bring to an end; trouble will not come a second time.

source: Ajehchu ling banga amaho thakhatna akihelkop laijule, jukham ho banga ju akham laijuva, changkong gosel banga amaho mahthah ding ahiuve.
target: They will be entangled among thorns and drunk from their wine; they will be consumed like dry stubble.

source: Pakai douna-a thilse ngaito jing, mi khanggilou thumopthem khat, nanga kona hung peng doh ding ahi.
target: From you, Nineveh, has one come forth who plots evil against the Lord and devises wicked plans.

source: Pakaiyin hitin ati; amaho lung mongin umu hen, chutobang chun tamtah hijongleu, aman alah-u ahinjotpa tengle chutobang ma-a chu suhmanga umding ahiuve. Keiman nangma nanasulunggim jongleng, kasuh lunggim kit louding nahitai.
target: This is what the Lord says: “Although they have allies and are numerous, they will be destroyed and pass away. Although I have afflicted you, Judah, I will afflict you no more.

source: Ajehchu tu-a hi keiman ama namkoljon chu nanga kona kaheboh ding, chule nakihena chu kasa tanding ahi.
target: Now I will break their yoke from your neck and tear your shackles away.”

source: Chule namin hi a-itih-a akiphah pohkit louhelna dingin, Pakaiyin nachung changa hin thupeh apen ahi. Na pathen ho insunga kona akikhentho le akilhahtho milim ho chu kasuhmang helding; nangma thet umtah mi nahijeh-a, nalhan kasempeh ding nahi.
target: The Lord has given a command concerning you, Nineveh: “You will have no descendants to bear your name. I will destroy the images and idols that are in the temple of your gods. I will prepare your grave, for you are vile.”

source: Vetan molsang chung ho-a chamna thu phonglea, kipana thupha polepa keng chu! Vo Judah, na kut thupi ho chu phaten nitnin lang, nakitepna ho chu tong doh-in. Ajehchu mikhang gilou chu nahenga hung louhel ding ahitai; ama chu mit hella kisumanga ahitai.
target: Look, there on the mountains, the feet of one who brings good news, who proclaims peace! Celebrate your festivals, Judah, and fulfill your vows. No more will the wicked invade you; they will be completely destroyed.

source: Ahal halla suchipjipa chu namasanga ahungtai: kulpi chu kiven phatnin, nalampi vephan, natai kigah detnin, nathahatna chu nasatah-in kisem phatnin.
target: An attacker advances against you, Nineveh. Guard the fortress, watch the road, brace yourselves, marshal all your strength!

source: Ajehchu Pakaiyin Israel chungnunna alahmang banga, Jacob chungnunna jong alahmang ahitai: ajehchu michom gam hon amaho achomgamu ahitan, chule alengpigui bahhou chu suhmanga uma ahitai.
target: The Lord will restore the splendor of Jacob like the splendor of Israel, though destroyers have laid them waste and have ruined their vines.

source: Amihat hou lum chu aki susan gamtan, mihangsan ho von chu asanthip tan ahi; akigot nikho le asakol kangtalai hou chu meikou vahleng lung tobang hiding, chule chah thingphung ho chu tijat umtah-a kihot ling ding ahi.
target: The shields of the soldiers are red; the warriors are clad in scarlet. The metal on the chariots flashes on the day they are made ready; the spears of juniper are brandished.

source: Sakol kangtalai ho chu khopi lamlen ho-a lung hang tah-a lhaile diu, amaho khatle khat lam lhongpi ho-a kineh todiu: amaho meivah lengle bangdiu, chule kolphe banga lhaile diu ahi.
target: The chariots storm through the streets, rushing back and forth through the squares. They look like flaming torches; they dart about like lightning.

source: Aman amilen ho chu ahetdoh ding; amaho alamjot naova kipal lhudiu; amaho kulbang lam jona chu kino tah-a chediu, kivenbitna chu kisemtup ding ahi.
target: Nineveh summons her picked troops, yet they stumble on their way. They dash to the city wall; the protective shield is put in place.

source: Vadung ho-a kotpi ho hondoh-a hung umding, leng inpi chu suhmanga umding ahi.
target: The river gates are thrown open and the palace collapses.

source: Chule Huzzab chu gal hinga kipui mang ding, khoukhah-a hung umding, chule asoh numeiten a-op achup dingu, vakhu aw banga maopuma apuilediu ahi.
target: It is decreed that Nineveh be exiled and carried away. Her female slaves moan like doves and beat on their breasts.

source: Ahinla Nineveh hi masang laija chu twikul tobang anahin, hijongle amaho jam mang ding ahiuve. Dingun, dingun tia amahon asapdio, hijongle koiman anungvet lou ding ahi.
target: Nineveh is like a pool whose water is draining away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one turns back.

source: Nanghon akichom doh dangkale sana chu kilah-un; ajehchu neile gou hin beitih aneipon, Thil manlut tahtah honjong beitih aneipon ahi.
target: Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold! The supply is endless, the wealth from all its treasures!

source: Ama ahomkeo, pannabei le man theilou chu ahitai: Chule lungthim ajunlha tan, khup teni akitatton, tai jouse-a natna khohtah achun, chule amaiju abonchan adup gamtan ahi.
target: She is pillaged, plundered, stripped! Hearts melt, knees give way, bodies tremble, every face grows pale.

source: Koimachan asuh linglaolou keipi bahkai, keipi teh, chule anou valena mun, Keipi bahkai ho chenna mun le keipi donglai ho kivahna mun chu hoilai hitam?
target: Where now is the lions’ den, the place where they fed their young, where the lion and lioness went, and the cubs, with nothing to fear?

source: Keipi bahkaijin anoute ding khambep-in ahal hallin asat telin, chule keipi nu-a din alolla apet lih-in, akosungho chu asamat ho-a adipmin, chule akulsung chu sa adimin ahi.
target: The lion killed enough for his cubs and strangled the prey for his mate, filling his lairs with the kill and his dens with the prey.

source: Ven, keiman nangma kadouve tin janel ho Pakai chun aseije, keiman asakol kangtalai ho chu meikhu-a kahal lhah ding, chemjamin na keipi bahkai donglai ho chu asat chapding: chule leisetna kona nasamat ho chu kasuhmanga, nathupolepa awgin chu kijakit louhel ding ahitai.
target: “I am against you,” declares the Lord Almighty. “I will burn up your chariots in smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions. I will leave you no prey on the earth. The voices of your messengers will no longer be heard.”

source: Thisan sona dim khopi chu ohe adana-e! hiche-a chun mijoule michom ho adimsetnin, thil kichom ho abei khapon;
target: Woe to the city of blood, full of lies, full of plunder, never without victims!

source: Molla kijepna husa, kangtalai kang lhaigin, sakol ho lhaigin le sakol kangtalai ho kichop gin atangpon ahi.
target: The crack of whips, the clatter of wheels, galloping horses and jolting chariots!

source: Sakol chunga tou mihon achemjamu val lahlah le atengcha hou pahlahlah chu adomsangun; akithatna mihem tamtah aumin, mihem thisa long simjoulou akijamin; alongu kiphong chu abeitih aumpon, amithi long hou chunga chun akipalun;
target: Charging cavalry, flashing swords and glittering spears! Many casualties, piles of dead, bodies without number, people stumbling over the corpses—

source: Hichu kihoisah-a jonthanhoi bol simjoulou notiho, ajonthanhoi bolna-a namtin johmanga doichoi nu, chule adoi choina-a a-insung johmangnu jeh ahi.
target: all because of the wanton lust of a prostitute, alluring, the mistress of sorceries, who enslaved nations by her prostitution and peoples by her witchcraft.

source: Ven, keima nangma douva kahi tin janel ho Pakai chun aseije; keiman nanih chu namaikoh chunga kahodoh pehding; chule nasagohkeo hina chu namtin kamusah ding chule najumna chu lenggam ho kamusah ding ahi.
target: “I am against you,” declares the Lord Almighty. “I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness and the kingdoms your shame.

source: Chule keiman kidah umtah thilboh nachunga kahin selhah-a, jachat umtah-a kasoding, chule nangma vetset umtah-a kakoiding ahi.
target: I will pelt you with filth, I will treat you with contempt and make you a spectacle.

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, mihem namu jouse chu nanga konin jamuntin, chule Nineveh ahomkeovin akijamtai atidiu ahi: chutengle koijin ama akapi ding hitam? Nangma nalhamon dinga chu hoija kahol ding hitam?
target: All who see you will flee from you and say, ‘Nineveh is in ruins—who will mourn for her?’ Where can I find anyone to comfort you?”

source: Vadungho lah-a ana chengah, akimvel twijin aumkol, twipilen chu akulpia panga, chule akulbang twipilen'a kona umdoh miminthang No-amon mite sanga nangma phajo nahim?
target: Are you better than Thebes, situated on the Nile, with water around her? The river was her defense, the waters her wall.

source: Ethiopia le Egypt chu amanu thahatna ahin, hichu akhonna bei ahi; Put le Lubim chu napanpi-a ahilhone.
target: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength; Put and Libya were among her allies.

source: Hijongle amanu puimangin aumin, gal hinga kaimangin aumtan ahi. Achate donglai hojong chu khopi lamlen ho chungvuma ahal halla chilngemin aumtaove; chule amahon ja um miho-a din vang asanun, chule amilen hou chu thihkhaovin akanun ahi.
target: Yet she was taken captive and went into exile. Her infants were dashed to pieces at every street corner. Lots were cast for her nobles, and all her great men were put in chains.

source: Nang jong ju nakham ding; nangma sela naum ding, melma jeh-a jong nangman thahatna nahol ding ahi.
target: You too will become drunk; you will go into hiding and seek refuge from the enemy.

source: Namundet ho jouse chu theichang phunga amin masapen theichang ho tobang hiding; hicheho chu akiholinga ahile, anedingpa kamsunga chu khelut dingu ahi.
target: All your fortresses are like fig trees with their first ripe fruit; when they are shaken, the figs fall into the mouth of the eater.

source: Vetan, nalah-a um namite hi numei ngen ahiuvin; nagamsunga um kotpi ho chu namelmate ho-a dinga lentah-a hung kihong ding; nabanggol ho meijin akahvam ding ahitai.
target: Look at your troops— they are all weaklings. The gates of your land are wide open to your enemies; fire has consumed the bars of your gates.

source: Umkhuma naum nikho-a dingin twi kithalin, namundet ho chu khodetnin, leingan umna-a chenlang bon ngan chilin, chule cheh kiseho chu sudetnin.
target: Draw water for the siege, strengthen your defenses! Work the clay, tread the mortar, repair the brickwork!

source: Chua chu meijin nakahvama, chemjamin nasat tanding, hichun nangma thinglung banga naneh chaiding ahi. Nangma thinglung banga tamin kisemin, khaokhote banga tamin kisemin.
target: There the fire will consume you; the sword will cut you down— they will devour you like a swarm of locusts. Multiply like grasshoppers, multiply like locusts!

source: Nangman nasum kolvei ho chu van'a ahsi ho sanga tamjon nasupung tan; thinglungin anesen, aleng mangtai.
target: You have increased the number of your merchants till they are more numerous than the stars in the sky, but like locusts they strip the land and then fly away.

source: Napipui hou jong khaokhote bangbep ahiuvin, nagal lamkaite chu nilhah nidaija honpal chunga umji-a khaokhopi ho abangun ahi. Ahin nisa ahungso tengle alengmangun, hoilaija aumu akiheji tapoi.
target: Your guards are like locusts, your officials like swarms of locusts that settle in the walls on a cold day— but when the sun appears they fly away, and no one knows where.

source: Vo Assyria lengpa, nakelngoi ching ho a-imulhu gamtaove: namilen namilalte chu vutvai lah-a cheng ding ahiuve: namite hi molle lhang chung dungho-a akithecheh gam taovin, chule amaho koiman apui khom pouvin ahi.
target: King of Assyria, your shepherds slumber; your nobles lie down to rest. Your people are scattered on the mountains with no one to gather them.

source: Nakisuh khah na hin damna aneipon, namaput hi asesoh tan; nakisuh khah thu jajousen nachunga akhut abehdiu ahi. Ajehchu nakhangitlou boljingna koichunga alhun khah louna umem?
target: Nothing can heal you; your wound is fatal. All who hear the news about you clap their hands at your fall, for who has not felt your endless cruelty?

source: Habakkuk themgaovin anamu pohgih.
target: The prophecy that Habakkuk the prophet received.

source: Vo Pakai, itihchan kakouva, ngaipeh louva neikoi ding ham! hunam-a natoh chungchanga nangma kakouva, nangman huhdoh louva nakoi dingham!
target: How long, Lord , must I call for help, but you do not listen? Or cry out to you, “Violence!” but you do not save?

source: Ipi dinga khangitlouna neimusah-a, gentheinaho neivetsah ham? Ajehchu gamna le hunama natoh kamasanga aumin, kinah nale kidouna ahung sohdoh tai.
target: Why do you make me look at injustice? Why do you tolerate wrongdoing? Destruction and violence are before me; there is strife, and conflict abounds.

source: Hijeh chun danthu athahat jou tapon, chule thutana dih himhim aum tapoi: ajehchu migilou hon michonpha chu aumchah taovin; hijeh chun thutan dihlou amachaltan ahi.
target: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.

source: Nanghon Pathen hephalou lah khu veovin, ngaitouvin lang, kidang satah-in datmouvin; ajehchu nanikho hou sunga na khat katohding, hichu nangho nakiseipeh jongleu, natahsan lou diu ahi.
target: “Look at the nations and watch— and be utterly amazed. For I am going to do something in your days that you would not believe, even if you were told.

source: Ajehchu, veuvin, keiman nam gangtah le engsetah, Chaldea mite katungdoh-e, amaho chun leiset chung achot leova, amaho-a hilou chena munho chu alo dingu ahi.
target: I am raising up the Babylonians, that ruthless and impetuous people, who sweep across the whole earth to seize dwellings not their own.

source: Amaho chu kichat umtahle tijat umtah ahiuvin; athutan nule aja-umnao chu amahole amaho-a kona sohdoh ahi.
target: They are a feared and dreaded people; they are a law to themselves and promote their own honor.

source: Asakolhou jong lutnuho sangin akaljang jouvin, nilhah lam ngeiho sangin gin aumjouve; asakol chung touhou chu kithejal uva, asakol chung touhou chu gamlatah-a kona hungdiu; amaho chu an nedinga kinotah-a leng muvanlai banga leng dingu ahi.
target: Their horses are swifter than leopards, fiercer than wolves at dusk. Their cavalry gallops headlong; their horsemen come from afar. They fly like an eagle swooping to devour;

source: Abonchauva hunam-a natong dinga hungkon diu; amaiju chu solam hui banga hungdoh ding, chule amahon sohchangho chu neldi banga akhopkhom diu ahi.
target: they all come intent on violence. Their hordes advance like a desert wind and gather prisoners like sand.

source: Amahon lengho chu nahsahmon neijuntin, pipuiho chu amaho totnopna hidingu: amahon kuldet jouse chu anuisat diu; ajehchu leivui avuh khumuva alahjeng diu ahi.
target: They mock kings and scoff at rulers. They laugh at all fortified cities; by building earthen ramps they capture them.

source: Chuteng alungthim kikhel ding, apal galkal paipai ding, asuh lungjing ding athahatna chu a-pathen'a kona angaito ding ahi.
target: Then they sweep past like the wind and go on— guilty people, whose own strength is their god.”

source: Vo Pakai ka Pathen, keija athengpen, nangma atonsotna pat umjing nahilou ham? keiho thipou vinge. Vo Pakai, nangman amaho chu thutan dingin nana sudetnin; chule vo hat chungnung Pathen, nangman suhdih nadingin amaho natungdoh tan ahi.
target: Lord , are you not from everlasting? My God, my Holy One, you will never die. You, Lord , have appointed them to execute judgment; you, my Rock, have ordained them to punish.

source: Nangma thilse vethei louhel mit thengpen, chule khansetna vetheilou nahin; iti danna dihlou tah-a chonho navetthima, mikhang gilouvin amasanga chonphajo michu suhmang ding atiteng thipbeh-a naum ham?
target: Your eyes are too pure to look on evil; you cannot tolerate wrongdoing. Why then do you tolerate the treacherous? Why are you silent while the wicked swallow up those more righteous than themselves?

source: Chule iti dana mihemte hi twikhanglen'a ngaho, achunguva vaihom neilouho a-opma kithol thoho, bangbepma nasem ham?
target: You have made people like the fish in the sea, like the sea creatures that have no ruler.

source: Amahon amaho chu abonchan ngakoijin akoidoh-un, alennuva amanun, alen khon houva ahuikhomun; hijeh chun amaho akipah-un athanomun ahi.
target: The wicked foe pulls all of them up with hooks, he catches them in his net, he gathers them up in his dragnet; and so he rejoices and is glad.

source: Hijeh chun amahon alennu henga ganlhaina abollun, alen khonhou henga gimnamtui ahaljiuve; ajehchu hiche ho-a kona chu haodoh uva, anneh nenga ahiuve.
target: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, for by his net he lives in luxury and enjoys the choicest food.

source: Hijeh-a chu amahon alennu chu asuhthenguva, namtin vaipi chu khenlou hella athajom jingdiu ham?
target: Is he to keep on emptying his net, destroying nations without mercy?

source: Keima galvena mun'a kadina, insang chunga kapansat ding, aman kahenga ipi ahinseija, chule suhdih-a kaumteng, iti kadonbut dingham gavenge.
target: I will stand at my watch and station myself on the ramparts; I will look to see what he will say to me, and what answer I am to give to this complaint.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin eidonbutnin, hitin ati, gaothilmu chu asimpan lhaipuma asimthei nadin, songpheng chunga kichehtah-in sunin.
target: Then the Lord replied: “Write down the revelation and make it plain on tablets so that a herald may run with it.

source: Ajehchu gaothilmu chu phat kitepsa sunga ding ahin, hijongle achainale thu asei ding, jou louding ahi; geijep jongleh ngah tadin; ajehchu hunglhung teiding ahin, geisang louding ahi.
target: For the revelation awaits an appointed time; it speaks of the end and will not prove false. Though it linger, wait for it; it will certainly come and will not delay.

source: Veovin, ama kichoisanga chu, ahinna ama-a achondih poi; Ahinla midih chu atahsan vanga hing ding ahi.
target: “See, the enemy is puffed up; his desires are not upright— but the righteous person will live by his faithfulness—

source: Chukitmale ama ju-a suhkhelna anei jeh-in, mikiletsah ahin, chule in'a jong aum pon, angaichat chu thilkholkhul bangin akehlenin, chule athi tobang ahin, chimtheilou ahi, ahinla nam jouse ahenga akhom khomin, mijouse chu ahenga asekhomin ahi.
target: indeed, wine betrays him; he is arrogant and never at rest. Because he is as greedy as the grave and like death is never satisfied, he gathers to himself all the nations and takes captive all the peoples.

source: Hicheho jousehin ama douna-a thulem aseijuva, ama douna-a jontaina thuchih, ama-a hilou kholkhompa chule bonlhoh satah-a pohding kisempa chu ohe ada na-e! itih chanpi ahiti theidem? tia aseilou dingu ham?
target: “Will not all of them taunt him with ridicule and scorn, saying, “ ‘Woe to him who piles up stolen goods and makes himself wealthy by extortion! How long must this go on?’

source: Nangma napet dingho chu kipatdoh phunguva, nasugenthei dingho chu thoudoh uva, nangma amaho dinga gal thila kichomdoh nahilou ding ham?
target: Will not your creditors suddenly arise? Will they not wake up and make you tremble? Then you will become their prey.

source: Nangman nam tamtah nachomgam jehle, miho thisan naso-a, gamsung, khopi le asunga cheng jouse chunga hunam namanchah jeh-a, mihem ahingdoh amoh chengsen nangma nachom dingu ahi.
target: Because you have plundered many nations, the peoples who are left will plunder you. For you have shed human blood; you have destroyed lands and cities and everyone in them.

source: Thaneina dihlouva kona akihuhdoh theina dingle, abu sangtah-a akisah theina dinga, kilosetna phalouva a-insung dinga kilosepa chu ohe ada ahi!
target: “Woe to him who builds his house by unjust gain, setting his nest on high to escape the clutches of ruin!

source: Mitamtah nasuhgama konin na-insung najumsah-in, chule nahinna dounan chonsea nahitai.
target: You have plotted the ruin of many peoples, shaming your own house and forfeiting your life.

source: Ajehchu banga kona song chu pengdoh ding, thinga kon inkam chun ahindonbut ding ahi.
target: The stones of the wall will cry out, and the beams of the woodwork will echo it.

source: Thisanna khopi sahdoh-a, khan gitlouna-a khopi tungdohpa chu ohe ada ahi!
target: “Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed and establishes a town by injustice!

source: Veovin, mihon meikong vahna dinga atohgimu chu, janel Pakaiya ding ahipoi; mipi ho chu pannabei dinga kisulung gim dingu ham?
target: Has not the Lord Almighty determined that the people’s labor is only fuel for the fire, that the nations exhaust themselves for nothing?

source: Ajehchu twijin twipi akhubanga, Pakai loupi hetna chun leiset hi alodim ding ahi.
target: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord as the waters cover the sea.

source: Aheng akom asagoh keovu mutheina dinga ju pe-a, juhai tunpeh-a, kham jong khamsah-a michu, ohe ada ahi!
target: “Woe to him who gives drink to his neighbors, pouring it from the wineskin till they are drunk, so that he can gaze on their naked bodies!

source: Loupina khelin jachatnan nadimtai: nangman jong don inlang, nachep jong chu kihohdoh hen; Pakai khut jetlam khon chu nangma douna-a hungkihei ding, naloupina chunga jachatna sangtah chu ding ahi.
target: You will be filled with shame instead of glory. Now it is your turn! Drink and let your nakedness be exposed! The cup from the Lord ’s right hand is coming around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.

source: Gamsung, khopi sung, chule asunga cheng jouse chunga pumhat naman jeh-a, Lebanon chunga pumhat thilbol, chule miho thisan kiso jeh-a gamsaho kichatsah suhgamna chun nangma nakhu khum ding ahi.
target: The violence you have done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and your destruction of animals will terrify you. For you have shed human blood; you have destroyed lands and cities and everyone in them.

source: Asempan asemthu milim, chule akilhah tho milim, jouthu hila pang, asemtengle asempa chun hichu atahsan, chuche paomo milim chu ipi-a phachom em?
target: “Of what value is an idol carved by a craftsman? Or an image that teaches lies? For the one who makes it trusts in his own creation; he makes idols that cannot speak.

source: Thingjah-a thouvin, song paotheilou jah-a kipat in, hichun ahilding ahi, tipa chu ohe ada ahi! Veovin, hichu sanale dangka-a kiloijol ahin, asunga haitheina hu umlouhel ahi.
target: Woe to him who says to wood, ‘Come to life!’ Or to lifeless stone, ‘Wake up!’ Can it give guidance? It is covered with gold and silver; there is no breath in it.”

source: Ahinla Pakai vang chu a-houin theng sunga um ahin, leiset pumpi a-anga thipchet hen.
target: The Lord is in his holy temple; let all the earth be silent before him.

source: Shigionoth chunga Habakkuk themgao taona ahi.
target: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet. On shigionoth .

source: Pakai, nathusei kajan, kakicha lheh-e: O Pakai, kumho sunga hin nanatoh hinsuhalin, kumho sungin kihetdohsah in; lunghan na-a hepina geldoh in.
target: Lord , I have heard of your fame; I stand in awe of your deeds, Lord . Repeat them in our day, in our time make them known; in wrath remember mercy.

source: Pathen chu Teman'a konin ahungin, chule Athengpa chu Paran molsanga konin ahunge. Selah Aloupinan vanho atomin, leiset hi avahchoi na-in adime.
target: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. His glory covered the heavens and his praise filled the earth.

source: Chule ama vahdan chu nisa vah abangin; akhutna konin vahgui akikhodoh in, chule hichea chun athahat akiselin ahi.
target: His splendor was like the sunrise; rays flashed from his hand, where his power was hidden.

source: Amasanga hise achen, akengtoa natset khohsetah apohdoh-in ahi.
target: Plague went before him; pestilence followed his steps.

source: Ama adingin leiset chu aten; aman aven, chule namtin chu anocheh-in; tonsot molsang ho chu akithe cheh-un, tonsot lhangho chu abohkhupmuve. Alampiho chu tonsotna ahi.
target: He stood, and shook the earth; he looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains crumbled and the age-old hills collapsed— but he marches on forever.

source: Keiman Cushan ponbuh gimthoh-a aum kamun, Midian gama ponjal ho chu akithingin ahi.
target: I saw the tents of Cushan in distress, the dwellings of Midian in anguish.

source: Pakai chu vadungho chunga lunglhailou ham? Nalunghanna chu vadungho chunga uma hitam? Nalungsatna chu twikhanglen chung, nasakol ho, nahuhhingna sakol ho chunga natouna chunga chu uma hitam?
target: Were you angry with the rivers, Lord ? Was your wrath against the streams? Did you rage against the sea when you rode your horses and your chariots to victory?

source: Nathu dungjui, phungho kihahselna dungjuijin nathalpi chu akeoseh-in aumtai. Selah Nangman leiset hi vadungho-in nahomkhene.
target: You uncovered your bow, you called for many arrows. You split the earth with rivers;

source: Molsang ho chun nangma namun, akihot jenguve: twi longlet chu ahin jotpan ahi. Twi thuh chun a-aw ahinsodoh sah-in, chule akhut chunglama adomtouvin ahi.
target: the mountains saw you and writhed. Torrents of water swept by; the deep roared and lifted its waves on high.

source: Nisa le Lhathah chu aumna-a adingden honin; athalpi chang vah leh, natengcha phelitlet vah-a chun ache honin ahi.
target: Sun and moon stood still in the heavens at the glint of your flying arrows, at the lightning of your flashing spear.

source: Lungphamo pumin gamsung najotsoh-in, nalunghana-in Pathen hephalou mite nachilgoi tai.
target: In wrath you strode through the earth and in anger you threshed the nations.

source: Namite huhhingna dingin nakon doh-in, nathao nusapa huhhing dingin nakondoh tai; abula pat angong geijin nahodoh peh-in, migiloupa inna konin alu namaputsah tai. Selah
target: You came out to deliver your people, to save your anointed one. You crushed the leader of the land of wickedness, you stripped him from head to foot.

source: Nangman ama tenggol ho-a chun akhosung lamkaiteo luchang navohpeh-in; keima sucheh dingin chimpei bangin ahungdoh uve: amaho kipana chu guhthima mivaichaho bahgam dingbou chu ahi.
target: With his own spear you pierced his head when his warriors stormed out to scatter us, gloating as though about to devour the wretched who were in hiding.

source: Nangman nasakol'in twikhanglen napal galkaijin, twipi kinong nasatah lah chu napal galkaije.
target: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning the great waters.

source: Keiman kajah phat chun ka-oipi akithingin; awgin chun kaneteni akihotnin; kagusunga monna alutnin, lungkhamna nikho-a kakicholdo theina dingin keima kakithingtai. Mipi ho henga ama ahungtou tengle, aman agalsat miho toh amaho chu asat ding ahi.
target: I heard and my heart pounded, my lips quivered at the sound; decay crept into my bones, and my legs trembled. Yet I will wait patiently for the day of calamity to come on the nation invading us.

source: Theichang phung pahhih henlang, lengpi gui aga umhih jongle; olive kibolna tohgimna chu thon henlang, phaileijin anneh sodoh hih jongle; ganhonga konin ganchaho kisugamhel henlang, gan inho-a gancha umhih jongleh;
target: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though there are no sheep in the pen and no cattle in the stalls,

source: Keivang Pakaiyah kipah jing inting, eihuh hingpa ka Pathen'a kathanop ding ahi.
target: yet I will rejoice in the Lord , I will be joyful in God my Savior.

source: Pakai Pathen chu kathahatna ahin, aman kakeng hi sajuhpi keng banga asemding; chule aman kamun sangho-a eivale sah ding ahi. La lamkaipa henga, ka tumgingthei akhaonei mangcha-a sah ding.
target: The Sovereign Lord is my strength; he makes my feet like the feet of a deer, he enables me to tread on the heights. For the director of music. On my stringed instruments.

source: Judah lengpa, Amon chapa Josiah nikho laija Hizekiah chapa, Amariah chapa, Gedaliah chapa, Kushi chapa Zephaniah henga Pakai thu hunglhung chu.
target: The word of the Lord that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, during the reign of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah:

source: Leiset na kon thil jouse kasuhmang ding ahi tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “I will sweep away everything from the face of the earth,” declares the Lord .

source: Mihem le gamsaho kasuhmanga; chungleng vachaho, twipia nga ho, chule kipal lhuhna chu migiloute toh kasuhmang ding; chule leisetna kona mihem kasuhgam ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “I will sweep away both man and beast; I will sweep away the birds in the sky and the fish in the sea— and the idols that cause the wicked to stumble.” “When I destroy all mankind on the face of the earth,” declares the Lord ,

source: Keiman Judah chung le Jerusalem'a chengho jouse chunga kakhut kajahdoh ding; chule hiche mun'a kona hi Baal hou amoh chengsele, Chemarim ho min chu thempuho puma kapaidoh ding;
target: “I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all who live in Jerusalem. I will destroy every remnant of Baal worship in this place, the very names of the idolatrous priests—

source: Chule in chung vum ho-a van janel ho chibai bohho; Pakai houva amin panna kihahsel ho, chule Malcham min pana kihahsel ho;
target: those who bow down on the roofs to worship the starry host, those who bow down and swear by the Lord and who also swear by Molek,

source: chule Pakaiya kona kinung heiho; chule Pakai hollouho le ama dong louho chu kapaidoh ding ahi.
target: those who turn back from following the Lord and neither seek the Lord nor inquire of him.”

source: Pakai Pathen anga chun thip chetnin umun, ajehchu Pakai nikho chu anaitai. Ajehchu Pakaiyin ganlhaina agongin, ajinho chu akoutai.
target: Be silent before the Sovereign Lord , for the day of the Lord is near. The Lord has prepared a sacrifice; he has consecrated those he has invited.

source: Chule Pakai ganlhaina nikhole hung hiti ding ahi, keiman pipuiho le lengpa chateho, chule gamchom miho vona kivonho jouse chu talen kapeh ding ahi.
target: “On the day of the Lord ’s sacrifice I will punish the officials and the king’s sons and all those clad in foreign clothes.

source: Hiche ni mama chule chang phola kichom ho, apupao in pumhat le lheplhah na-a dipho chu talen kapeh ding ahi.
target: On that day I will punish all who avoid stepping on the threshold, who fill the temple of their gods with violence and deceit.

source: Chule hiche nikho chule hunghiti ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije, nga kotpi-a kona ka awgin, kotpi nichana-a kona ka awgin, chule lhang ho-a kona thil kisukeh gin nasatah kijading ahi.
target: “On that day,” declares the Lord , “a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, wailing from the New Quarter, and a loud crash from the hills.

source: Maktesh'a chenga nangho penguvin, ajehchu kivei miho jouse akisugamin; chule dangka choiho jouse akisugam tai.
target: Wail, you who live in the market district; all your merchants will be wiped out, all who trade with silver will be destroyed.

source: Chuche phat chule hung hiti ding ahi, keiman Jerusalem chu thaomei mangcha-a kahol ding, juheh-a hingho, alunguva Pakai chun thilpha jong thilse jong bolponte tia seiho chu talen kapeh ding ahi.
target: At that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those who are complacent, who are like wine left on its dregs, who think, ‘The Lord will do nothing, either good or bad.’

source: Hijeh chun athil hou chu thil kichomdoh soh intin, a-inhou chu kamhel ding: amahon in jong saovintin, alolou dingu, chule amahon lengpilei ho boluntin, hia kona chu lengpitwi adonlou diu ahi.
target: Their wealth will be plundered, their houses demolished. Though they build houses, they will not live in them; though they plant vineyards, they will not drink the wine.”

source: Pakai niloupi tah chu ahung naijin, ahung naijin, akikino lheh-in, chule Pakai nikho husa gin jengjong chu akinolheh-e; chuche nikho chule mihatpa jong chu haka-a kapding ahi.
target: The great day of the Lord is near— near and coming quickly. The cry on the day of the Lord is bitter; the Mighty Warrior shouts his battle cry.

source: Chuche nikho chu lungsat nikho, lungkham nikho le lung hesoh nikho, manthah na le kisuh kamhelna nikho, muthim le genthei nikho, chule meibol le muthim lhangkhal kiheh nikho ahin,
target: That day will be a day of wrath— a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness—

source: Chule kulpi kikai khum khopi hole, insangho douna-a, sumkon kimut nikho le gal kisap phongna nikho ahi.
target: a day of trumpet and battle cry against the fortified cities and against the corner towers.

source: Chule keiman mihemte chunga hesohna kapohlut ding, amahon Pakai douna-a achonset jeh uva, mitcho banga lam ajotdiu: chule athisanu chu leivui banga kisunglha-a, atahsao chu eh banga kisunglha ding ahi.
target: “I will bring such distress on all people that they will grope about like those who are blind, because they have sinned against the Lord . Their blood will be poured out like dust and their entrails like dung.

source: Pakai lunghan nikho lechun asana hou le adangka houvin alhatdoh theilou diu; amavang agam pumpi chu athang thipna meikongin ahalvam ding ahi. Ajehchu aman chuche gama cheng jouse gangtah-a asuhmang ding ahi.
target: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to save them on the day of the Lord ’s wrath.” In the fire of his jealousy the whole earth will be consumed, for he will make a sudden end of all who live on the earth.

source: Nangho kikhom khomun, henge, nangho kikhom khomun, vo dei umlou nampi mite;
target: Gather together, gather yourselves together, you shameful nation,

source: Thupeh ahung kipohdoh masang, nikho chu changsi banga alen mang masang, Pakai lunghanna nasatah nachung uva ahunglhun masangin, nachung uva Pakai lunghanna nikho ahunglhun masangin, kikhom khomun.
target: before the decree takes effect and that day passes like windblown chaff, before the Lord ’s fierce anger comes upon you, before the day of the Lord ’s wrath comes upon you.

source: Nangho leisetna mikineosah jousen, athutan dihna domsanga Pakai chu hollun; chonphatna holun, kineosahna hollun: chuti henlang hile Pakai lunghan nikho le sella naumthei dingu ahi.
target: Seek the Lord , all you humble of the land, you who do what he commands. Seek righteousness, seek humility; perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of the Lord ’s anger.

source: Ajehchu Gaza chu dalhah-a uma, Ashkelon kamhel ding: amahon sunchang laija Ashdod anodoh diu, chule Ekron chu bodoh-a umding ahi.
target: Gaza will be abandoned and Ashkelon left in ruins. At midday Ashdod will be emptied and Ekron uprooted.

source: Twikhanglen panga cheng Chereth nam miteho, ohe ada nahiuve ahi! Pakai thun nangho nadouvun ahi; Vo Canaan, Philistine te gam, koimacha achenga aumlouna dinga, keiman nangma jengjong kasuhmang ding nahi.
target: Woe to you who live by the sea, you Kerethite people; the word of the Lord is against you, Canaan, land of the Philistines. He says, “I will destroy you, and none will be left.”

source: Twikhanglen pang chu kelngoi chingho dinga chenna inle, kelngoi honho dinga hong hiding ahi.
target: The land by the sea will become pastures having wells for shepherds and pens for flocks.

source: Luipang chu Judah insung amohho ding ahin; chua chu amahon akelngoi honhou avahdiu: amaho Ashkelon inho-a chu nilhahle lumjidiu ahi. Ajehchu Pakai a-Pathen uvin aviluva asohchan nao aheimang ding ahi.
target: That land will belong to the remnant of the people of Judah; there they will find pasture. In the evening they will lie down in the houses of Ashkelon. The Lord their God will care for them; he will restore their fortunes.

source: Keiman kamite i-sah louva abolnao, Moab mite i-sah louna leh, Ammon mite housetna kajan, chule agamgiu douna-in akichoisangun ahi.
target: “I have heard the insults of Moab and the taunts of the Ammonites, who insulted my people and made threats against their land.

source: Hijeh chun Israel janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, keima kahin jing bangin, thonlouva Moab chu Sodom bang ding, Ammon chate chu Gomorrah bangdiu, ling nangbohle chi khuhlah hiuva, a-itih-a kamhela umdiu ahi. Kamite kim khat hon amaho chu achomuva, kami amoh chengsen amaho chu alodingu ahi.
target: Therefore, as surely as I live,” declares the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, “surely Moab will become like Sodom, the Ammonites like Gomorrah— a place of weeds and salt pits, a wasteland forever. The remnant of my people will plunder them; the survivors of my nation will inherit their land.”

source: Hichehohi ahoitho jeh uva aneidiu ahi, ajehchu amaho janel Pakai mite dounale i-sah louna-in akichoi sangun ahi.
target: This is what they will get in return for their pride, for insulting and mocking the people of the Lord Almighty.

source: Pakai chu amaho dinga tijat umtah hiding ahi: ajehchu Aman leiset pathen jouse asuhmanga, chule mihem ten ama ahou dingu, mitinin ama mun cheh-a konle twikol gam ho-a milim houho sanin ahoudiu ahi.
target: The Lord will be awesome to them when he destroys all the gods of the earth. Distant nations will bow down to him, all of them in their own lands.

source: Nangho Ethiopia mite jong, kachemjama kithat ding nahiuve.
target: “You Cushites, too, will be slain by my sword.”

source: Aman sahlam douna-a akhut alhana, Assyria asuhmang ding, chule Nineveh mite chu, gamthip gamgo banga akamhel sah ding ahi.
target: He will stretch out his hand against the north and destroy Assyria, leaving Nineveh utterly desolate and dry as the desert.

source: Chule amanu lailunga chu kelngoi honle namtina kon gamsa jouse kol dingu ahi. Twikhanglen vacha hole twivamuhsao ho a-inkam chunga chenguntin; bangkot ho-a a-aw uvin la asahding; kotsangkil jong chu agohkeo hiding ahi; ajehchu aman Cedar thinga kisa jouse ahodoh ding ahi.
target: Flocks and herds will lie down there, creatures of every kind. The desert owl and the screech owl will roost on her columns. Their hooting will echo through the windows, rubble will fill the doorways, the beams of cedar will be exposed.

source: Hichehi alung sunga, keibou kahi, koima dang aumpoi, tia sei khohsahna neilou tah-a cheng kipahjing khopi ahi: iti dana ama ahomkeova hung uma, ganhingho kolnabep hungsoh-a ahitadem! ajotpa jousen ahuisat khumuva, akhut ajapkhum dingu ahi.
target: This is the city of revelry that lived in safety. She said to herself, “I am the one! And there is none besides me.” What a ruin she has become, a lair for wild beasts! All who pass by her scoff and shake their fists.

source: Mi sugenthei khopi, athengloule akisuboh nu chu ohe ada ahi!
target: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!

source: Amanun aw chu angaipon; suhdihna chu asangpon; Pakai chu atahsanpon; a-Pathen chu anaipon ahi.
target: She obeys no one, she accepts no correction. She does not trust in the Lord , she does not draw near to her God.

source: Amanu sunga um pipuiho chu keipi bahkai kitum tobang ahiuvin; athutanhou chu nilhah ngeiho jingkah geijin saguho nehmoh koilou tobang ahiuve.
target: Her officials within her are roaring lions; her rulers are evening wolves, who leave nothing for the morning.

source: Amanu themgaoho chu imacha hiloule tahsan umlou mi jeng ahiuvin; Athempuho chun muntheng asuhboh-un, amahon danthupeh chunga pumhat abolun ahi.
target: Her prophets are unprincipled; they are treacherous people. Her priests profane the sanctuary and do violence to the law.

source: Chondih Pakai chu alah uva aumin; aman khangitlouna abol louding ahi. Jingkah sehle athutana vah-a apodoh jin, ahinla midih lou chun jumlam ahepon ahi.
target: The Lord within her is righteous; he does no wrong. Morning by morning he dispenses his justice, and every new day he does not fail, yet the unrighteous know no shame.

source: Keiman namtinho kasugamin, a-insanghou akamhel tai: akhosung lamlenhou agoh-in kakoijin, koimachan ahotapoi, akhopihou kasumangin, koimacha aumtapon, acheng jong aumtapoi.
target: “I have destroyed nations; their strongholds are demolished. I have left their streets deserted, with no one passing through. Their cities are laid waste; they are deserted and empty.

source: Keiman, Tahbeh-in nangman neiging teijin natin, nangman hilna sangin nate; chutichun itobangin amaho talen pejongleng, achennao kisumang ponte, kati ahin; ahinla amaho jingpin athouvun, anatoh jouseu asuboh-un ahi.
target: Of Jerusalem I thought, ‘Surely you will fear me and accept correction!’ Then her place of refuge would not be destroyed, nor all my punishments come upon her. But they were still eager to act corruptly in all they did.

source: Hijeh chun achom gam dinga kahungkondoh nikho kahsen neingah-un, tin Pakaiyin aseije; ajehchu namtinho gop khoma, leng gamho khopkhom ding, chuleh kalung hanna le kalung satna jouse geija achunguva sunlhah dinghi kalung got ahi; ajehchu leiset pumpihi kathang thipna meija kahal vam ding ahi.
target: Therefore wait for me,” declares the Lord , “for the day I will stand up to testify. I have decided to assemble the nations, to gather the kingdoms and to pour out my wrath on them— all my fierce anger. The whole world will be consumed by the fire of my jealous anger.

source: Ajehchu amahon Pakai min chu akouvuva, lung khat tah-a ama ajentheina diuvin, mipi ho chu paotheng ka pehding ahi.
target: “Then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that all of them may call on the name of the Lord and serve him shoulder to shoulder.

source: Ethiopia vadung ho gallama kona kahenga tao hole, anavah chehsa kachanu ngeijin jong, kahenga thilto ahinchoi ding ahi.
target: From beyond the rivers of Cush my worshipers, my scattered people, will bring me offerings.

source: Hiche nikho chuleh keima douna nasuhkhelna, nathilbol jouse jeh-a najachat louding ahi: ajehchu chuteng chule keiman nakiletsah na-a kipahho chu nalah uva kona kalahdoh ding, chule kamolsang theng jeh-a chu nangma nakihoitho sahkit louding ahitai.
target: On that day you, Jerusalem, will not be put to shame for all the wrongs you have done to me, because I will remove from you your arrogant boasters. Never again will you be haughty on my holy hill.

source: Keiman nalah uva migenthei le mivaichaho jong kadalhah ding, amahon Pakai minchu atahsan dingu ahi.
target: But I will leave within you the meek and humble. The remnant of Israel will trust in the name of the Lord .

source: Israel amohho chun khangitlou abol loudiu, jou aseilou diu, akamuva kona lheplhah kimulou ding ahi: Ajehchu amahon akelngoi hou avah uva lum diu ahin, chule koimachan akichat sah loudiu ahi.
target: They will do no wrong; they will tell no lies. A deceitful tongue will not be found in their mouths. They will eat and lie down and no one will make them afraid.”

source: Vo Zion chanu, La san; Vo Israel, kho hasapmin samin; Vo Jerusalem chanu, nalungthim pumpin kipah inlang thanomin.
target: Sing, Daughter Zion; shout aloud, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, Daughter Jerusalem!

source: Pakai chun nachung thu kitana ding chu aladohtan, namelmate anodoh tai: Israelte lengpa Pathen tahchu nalah uva aume; nangman thilse namukit louding ahitai.
target: The Lord has taken away your punishment, he has turned back your enemy. The Lord , the King of Israel, is with you; never again will you fear any harm.

source: Hicheni chule Jerusalem henga, Kicha hih-in, tia kisei ding; chule Zion henga, nakhut ngoisah hih-in, kiti ding ahi.
target: On that day they will say to Jerusalem, “Do not fear, Zion; do not let your hands hang limp.

source: Nalah-a um Pakai na-Pathen chu tha neitah ahin; aman ahuhhinga, nachunga kipah tah-a thanom ding; aman angailutna-a nacholdohsah intin, aman nachunga la asah-a kipah ding ahi
target: The Lord your God is with you, the Mighty Warrior who saves. He will take great delight in you; in his love he will no longer rebuke you, but will rejoice over you with singing.”

source: Keiman nalah-a um, i-sah louva akibolna chu ama dinga pohgih hia, kikhopna loupitah-a dinga lunghemho chu, kakhop khom ding ahi.
target: “I will remove from you all who mourn over the loss of your appointed festivals, which is a burden and reproach for you.

source: Veovin, chuche phatteng chule nasugenthei ho jouse chu kalahdoh ding; elbai chu kahuh hinga, akidel mangho kachopkhom ding; jahcha tah-a akikoinao gamtina amaho vahchoina le minthana kamusah ding ahi.
target: At that time I will deal with all who oppressed you. I will rescue the lame; I will gather the exiles. I will give them praise and honor in every land where they have suffered shame.

source: Keiman kachopkhom phat tengu chule, nanho kalepuikit ding nahiuve; ijeh inem itile namitmu tah uva nasohchan naova kona kalepui kitteng, keiman leisetna mijouse lah-a minthana le vahchoina kabolpeh dingu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: At that time I will gather you; at that time I will bring you home. I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your very eyes,” says the Lord .

source: Darius lengchan kal kum nina, alhagup channa, nimasa nin Judah gamvaipo Shealtiel chapa Jerubbabel hengle, Josedech chapa thempu chungnung Joshua henga, Haggai themgaova konin Pakai thu ahung lhungin, aseije,
target: In the second year of King Darius, on the first day of the sixth month, the word of the Lord came through the prophet Haggai to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest:

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Hiche mite hin, Pakai houin sahna ding phat chu ahung lhunghih laije, atiuve.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “These people say, ‘The time has not yet come to rebuild the Lord ’s house.’ ”

source: Chuin Haggai themgaova konin Pakai thu chu ahung lhungin, hitin aseije,
target: Then the word of the Lord came through the prophet Haggai:

source: Vo nangho, Hiche houin ahomkeova auma, nangho siling in'a nachenu chu, nangho dinga aphat hinam?
target: “Is it a time for you yourselves to be living in your paneled houses, while this house remains a ruin?”

source: Hijeh chun tun janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; nalampi hou ngaito temun.
target: Now this is what the Lord Almighty says: “Give careful thought to your ways.

source: Nanghon tamtah natu uvin, themcha nahin polutnun; naneovin, ahinla na oiva pouvin; nadonun, ahinla nadang nou pouve; pon nakisilun, ahinla lum nasa dehpouve; atha paija lopan sumdip tovanga khum dinga alo ahi.
target: You have planted much, but harvested little. You eat, but never have enough. You drink, but never have your fill. You put on clothes, but are not warm. You earn wages, only to put them in a purse with holes in it.”

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; nalampi hou ngaito temun.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “Give careful thought to your ways.

source: Molsang chunga kaldoh-unlang thing hinpuvin, chule houin chu saovin; chutile hichea chun lunglhai jing ting, choisanga kaumding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Go up into the mountains and bring down timber and build my house, so that I may take pleasure in it and be honored,” says the Lord .

source: Nanghon tamtahdin nakinem un, ahinla veuvin, themchan bou ahunge; nanghon in nahinlhut tenguleh achung chu kamutji ahi. Ipi din-em? tin janel Pakaiyin aseije. Ajehchu ka-in agohkeova uma, nangho amitakipmin na-in lamcheh nadel jeh-u ahi.
target: “You expected much, but see, it turned out to be little. What you brought home, I blew away. Why?” declares the Lord Almighty. “Because of my house, which remains a ruin, while each of you is busy with your own house.

source: Hijeh-a chu nachung uva van chun daitwi atuhtanga, chule leiset chun aga atuhtang ahi.
target: Therefore, because of you the heavens have withheld their dew and the earth its crops.

source: Chule keiman gamsung chunga, molsang ho chunga, changle min chunga, lengpigui thah ho chunga, thao chunga, chule aga sodohji leiset chunga, mihem chunga, gancha chunga, chule khutna tonggim ho jouse chunga gamna kakou ahi.
