target: I called for a drought on the fields and the mountains, on the grain, the new wine, the olive oil and everything else the ground produces, on people and livestock, and on all the labor of your hands.”

source: Chujouvin Shealtiel chapa Jerubbabel le Josedech chapa thempu chungnung Joshua, chule mipi amoh chengse chun Pakai a-Pathen'u aw le, Pakai a-Pathen'un ahinsol Haggai themgao thuho chu angaijun, chule mipi chu Pakai angsunga akicha lheh-un ahi.
target: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and the whole remnant of the people obeyed the voice of the Lord their God and the message of the prophet Haggai, because the Lord their God had sent him. And the people feared the Lord .

source: Chuin Pakai thupole Haggai chun miho henga Pakai thulhah chu aseijin, Keiman nangho kaumpi naove tin Pakaiyin aseije, ati.
target: Then Haggai, the Lord ’s messenger, gave this message of the Lord to the people: “I am with you,” declares the Lord .

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Judah vaipo Shealtiel chapa Jerubbabel lungthim le, Josedech chapa thempu chungnung Joshua lungthim, chule miho lah-a amoh umho jouse lungthim chu asuthouvin; chule amaho ahungun a-Pathen'u, janel Pakai in'a chun na ahung tongun ahi;
target: So the Lord stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of the whole remnant of the people. They came and began to work on the house of the Lord Almighty, their God,

source: Hichu Darius lengchan kal kum nina, lhagup channa, nisomni le nili ni ahi.
target: on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month. In the second year of King Darius,

source: Lha sagina, chuche lha nisomni le ni khatnin, Haggai themgaova konin Pakai thu ahung lhungin, hitin aseije,
target: on the twenty-first day of the seventh month, the word of the Lord came through the prophet Haggai:

source: Tun Judah gamvaipo, Shealtiel chapa Jerubbabel, Josedech chapa thempu chungnung Joshua, chule mipi amoh aumsun henga seijin,
target: “Speak to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, to Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people. Ask them,

source: Masang laija hiche houin loupina masa mukha-a nalah uva koi umem? chule tu-a hi itobanga namu uvem? Hichu akitekah-a ahile namitmuva dinga imachalou hilouham?
target: ‘Who of you is left who saw this house in its former glory? How does it look to you now? Does it not seem to you like nothing?

source: Hijongle tun Vo Jerubbabel, hatnin, tin Pakaiyin aseije; chule Josedech chapa, Vo thempu chungnung Joshua, hatnin; chuleh gamsunga mi jousen jong hatnunlang na tongun, tin Pakaiyin aseije; ajehchu keiman kaumpi naove tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: But now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ declares the Lord . ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ declares the Lord , ‘and work. For I am with you,’ declares the Lord Almighty.

source: Egypt gama kona nahungdoh laijuva kakitepna thu dungjuijin, nalah uva kalhagao acheng jinge, nangho kicha hih-un.
target: ‘This is what I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt. And my Spirit remains among you. Do not fear.’

source: Ajehchu janel Pakaiyin hitin ati; Khatvei, chomkah louva, keiman van le leiset, chule twipi le gamgo hi kaholing ding ahi;
target: “This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘In a little while I will once more shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.

source: Chule nam jouse kaholinga, nam jouse ngaichat chu hunglhung ding; chule keiman hiche inhi loupi na-a kadip ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will shake all nations, and what is desired by all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory,’ says the Lord Almighty.

source: Dangka chu keija ahin, sana jong keija ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: ‘The silver is mine and the gold is mine,’ declares the Lord Almighty.

source: Hiche in nunung hi amasa sanga lujo ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije: chuleh hiche mun'a hi chamna kapeh ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: ‘The glory of this present house will be greater than the glory of the former house,’ says the Lord Almighty. ‘And in this place I will grant peace,’ declares the Lord Almighty.”

source: Darius lengchan kal kum nina, alha ko channa, nisomni le nili nin Pakai thu chu Haggai themgao heng ahung lhungin, aseije,
target: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to the prophet Haggai:

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Tun thempuho chu danthupeh thudol dongin lang, seijin,
target: “This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘Ask the priests what the law says:

source: Mi khattouvin asangkhol chola satheng chun henlang, asangkholchol chun changlhah ham, meham, lengpitwi ham, thao ham, nehthei poupou ham tongkha taleh, hiche atohkhah thilho chu atheng hintem? tin ati. Chuin thempuho chun adonbutnun, Thengponte, atiuve.
target: If someone carries consecrated meat in the fold of their garment, and that fold touches some bread or stew, some wine, olive oil or other food, does it become consecrated?’ ” The priests answered, “No.”

source: Chuin Haggai'in, Khattou thilonga kisuhboh hen, hicheho khat hi tongkha taleh, hichu boh intem? ati. Chuin thempuho chun adondutnun, Boh ding ahi atiuve.
target: Then Haggai said, “If a person defiled by contact with a dead body touches one of these things, does it become defiled?” “Yes,” the priests replied, “it becomes defiled.”

source: Chuin Haggai'in adonbutnin aseije, Hiche mite leh hiche namhi kamasanga chuto bang chu ahiuve, tin Pakaiyin aseije; chule chutobang machu akhutnuva atoh jouseu, chule chua athilto hou chu thenglou ahi.
target: Then Haggai said, “ ‘So it is with this people and this nation in my sight,’ declares the Lord . ‘Whatever they do and whatever they offer there is defiled.

source: Chule tun, naheng uva katao ahi, Pakai houin'a song khat chunga song khat akiset thop masangin, tunia kipat khonung changei ding ngaitouvin.
target: “ ‘Now give careful thought to this from this day on—consider how things were before one stone was laid on another in the Lord ’s temple.

source: Chuche nikho laija patchun, mikhat thil tena somni kite dinga ahungleh, sombou anaumin; mikhat lengpithei chilna-a bel somnga thaldoh dinga ahungleh, somni bou anaumin ahi.
target: When anyone came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When anyone went to a wine vat to draw fifty measures, there were only twenty.

source: Nakhut soh natoh gimna jouseova lungle nget chule gelchangin kabol gimmun, ahinla keima lama nahung kile deh pouve tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I struck all the work of your hands with blight, mildew and hail, yet you did not return to me,’ declares the Lord .

source: Tuni hiche lhako chana, nisomni le nili ni-a kipat khonung geiding ngaitouvin, houin bul kiphudoh ni-a pat jengjong hin ngaitouvin.
target: ‘From this day on, from this twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, give careful thought to the day when the foundation of the Lord ’s temple was laid. Give careful thought:

source: Changsalla chu changchi um nalaijem? Lengpigui le theichang phung chule kolbu theiphung galou hiuva, chule olive thingin aga asodoh loulai ham? Tunia pat nangma phatthei kabohding nahi ati.
target: Is there yet any seed left in the barn? Until now, the vine and the fig tree, the pomegranate and the olive tree have not borne fruit. “ ‘From this day on I will bless you.’ ”

source: Chule chuche lha nisomni le nili nin, Haggai henga Pakai thu chu ahunglhung kitnin, aseije.
target: The word of the Lord came to Haggai a second time on the twenty-fourth day of the month:

source: Judah gam vaipo Jerubbabel henga hitin seijin, Keiman vanle lei kaholing ding ahi;
target: “Tell Zerubbabel governor of Judah that I am going to shake the heavens and the earth.

source: Chule keiman lenggam ho laltouna chu kalekhup ding, chule keiman Pathen hephalou lenggam thahatna hochu kasuhmang ding; akangtalai hou le achunga touho kale khupding; chule sakol holeh achunga touho hungkum lhadiu, mitin asopiho chemjam'a lou dingu ahi.
target: I will overturn royal thrones and shatter the power of the foreign kingdoms. I will overthrow chariots and their drivers; horses and their riders will fall, each by the sword of his brother.

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije, Hiche ni chule, Vo Shealtiel chapa Kasoh Jerubbabel, keiman kalahding nahi tin Pakaiyin aseije; chule mahor banga kasem ding nahi, ajehchu kalhen nahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “ ‘On that day,’ declares the Lord Almighty, ‘I will take you, my servant Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel,’ declares the Lord , ‘and I will make you like my signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ declares the Lord Almighty.”

source: Darius lengchan kal kum nina, lhaget lhina-in, Iddo themgao chapa Berechiah chapa Zechariah themgao henga Pakai thu ahung lhungin, aseije:
target: In the eighth month of the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berekiah, the son of Iddo:

source: Pakai chu napu napateu chunga chun alungnom mo lheh jengin ahi.
target: “The Lord was very angry with your ancestors.

source: Hijeh chun nangman ahenguva, Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; keima lam hin ngauvin tin janel Pakaiyin aseije, chutileh kenjong nangho lam kahin ngat ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Therefore tell the people: This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘Return to me,’ declares the Lord Almighty, ‘and I will return to you,’ says the Lord Almighty.

source: Napu napateu toh banghih-un, amaho henga chun themgao masahon anasamuvin, Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; lamdih louva kon le natoh phalouva konin hung kiheijun, tin aseijun ahi: ahinla amahon angai pouvin, kathu jong alapouve tin, Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Do not be like your ancestors, to whom the earlier prophets proclaimed: This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘Turn from your evil ways and your evil practices.’ But they would not listen or pay attention to me, declares the Lord .

source: Napu napateu hoiba hitam? chule themgaoho chu tonsotna hinguvam?
target: Where are your ancestors now? And the prophets, do they live forever?

source: Ahinla kasoh themgaoho kana thupeh, kathule kadan kisunho chun napu napateu chu atuhtang louham? Chule amaho ahung kileuvin, janel Pakaiyin ichunguva bolding agot bangin, ilampiu dungjuile, itoh-u dungjuijin ichunguva atong chaitai atiuve.
target: But did not my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, overtake your ancestors? “Then they repented and said, ‘The Lord Almighty has done to us what our ways and practices deserve, just as he determined to do.’ ”

source: Darius lengchan kal kum nina, lha somlekhat channa, hichu Sebat lha ahin, nisomni le nili nin, Iddo chapa Berechiah chapa Zechariah themgao henga, Pakai thu ahung lhungin, aseije:
target: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, the month of Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berekiah, the son of Iddo.

source: Keiman jan-in, sakol san chunga mikhat touva, amachu noilama huisum thing lah-a adina; anunga sakol sanho, apolchetchut, chule akang aum kamun ahi.
target: During the night I had a vision, and there before me was a man mounted on a red horse. He was standing among the myrtle trees in a ravine. Behind him were red, brown and white horses.

source: Chuin keiman, Vo Ka Pakai, hichehohi ipiham? kati. Hichun vantil eikihoupi chun kahenga, hichehohi ipi ahiu vetsah inge, ati.
target: I asked, “What are these, my lord?” The angel who was talking with me answered, “I will show you what they are.”

source: Chuin huisum thing lah-a ding mipa chun adonbutnin aseije, hicheho hi leiset pumpi suhle tunga chonle dinga Pakaiyin ahinsol ho ahiuve ati.
target: Then the man standing among the myrtle trees explained, “They are the ones the Lord has sent to go throughout the earth.”

source: Chuin amahon thingphung lah-a ding Pakai vantil chun adonbutnun, keihon leiset hi suhle tungin kachonun, veuvin, lei pumpi chu atouthip beh-in, akicholdon ahi, atiuve.
target: And they reported to the angel of the Lord who was standing among the myrtle trees, “We have gone throughout the earth and found the whole world at rest and in peace.”

source: Chujouvin Pakai vantil chun adonbutnin aseije, Vo janel Pakai, kum somsagi jen adouna-a nalunghan khum Jerusalem le Judah khopiho chunga itihchan hepina beija naum ding hitam?
target: Then the angel of the Lord said, “ Lord Almighty, how long will you withhold mercy from Jerusalem and from the towns of Judah, which you have been angry with these seventy years?”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin eikihoupi vantil chu thupha le lhamona thun adonbutnin ahi.
target: So the Lord spoke kind and comforting words to the angel who talked with me.

source: Chuti chun kajah-a thusei vantil chun kahenga, hitihin samphongin, janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; keima Jerusalem le Zion din thangthipna lentah in kathang thipmin ahi.
target: Then the angel who was speaking to me said, “Proclaim this word: This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘I am very jealous for Jerusalem and Zion,

source: Chule nomtah-a uma Pathen hephalou ho chunga kalung phamolheh jengin ahi: ajehchu keima themkhat bou kalung phamo ahin, ahinla amahon suhgimna chu amasot uvin ahi.
target: and I am very angry with the nations that feel secure. I was only a little angry, but they went too far with the punishment.’

source: Hijeh chun Pakaiyin hitin aseije; keima Jerusalem henga hepina toh kahungkile kit tai: asunga chu ka-in kisading ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije, chule Jerusalem chunga tetohna khao kijan ding ahi.
target: “Therefore this is what the Lord says: ‘I will return to Jerusalem with mercy, and there my house will be rebuilt. And the measuring line will be stretched out over Jerusalem,’ declares the Lord Almighty.

source: Samphong nalaijin, Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije tin aseijin; kakhopiho phattheina vanga kikehbe nalai ding; Pakaiyin Zion alhamon nalaiding, chule Jerusalem adeilhen nahlai ding ahi.
target: “Proclaim further: This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘My towns will again overflow with prosperity, and the Lord will again comfort Zion and choose Jerusalem.’ ”

source: Chujouvin kakhodah-in ahile, veuvin saki li kamun ahi.
target: Then I looked up, and there before me were four horns.

source: Chuin keima eikihoupi vantil jah-a chun, hihohi ipi tina ham? kati. Hichun aman, hichehohi Judah, Israel chule Jerusalem thecheh-ah aki li neiho chu ahi tin eidonbutne.
target: I asked the angel who was speaking to me, “What are these?” He answered me, “These are the horns that scattered Judah, Israel and Jerusalem.”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin thingthem bol mili eimusah-in ahi.
target: Then the Lord showed me four craftsmen.

source: Chuin keiman, hichehohi ipi bol dinga hung hiuvam? kati. Hichun aman, hiche ki li hohi Judah thecheh-a, koimacha alu dahdoh ngamlou hela lhaho chu ahiuve: ahinla hiche thingthem bol hohi amaho jamsah dingle, akithecheh na dinguva Judah gam chunga aki-u domsanga chidang namdangho ki hochu suhlhahpeh dinga hunga ahiuve, tin aseije.
target: I asked, “What are these coming to do?” He answered, “These are the horns that scattered Judah so that no one could raise their head, but the craftsmen have come to terrify them and throw down these horns of the nations who lifted up their horns against the land of Judah to scatter its people.”

source: Keima kakhodah kitnin, kaven, chule akhutna tena khao kichoi khat kamun ahi.
target: Then I looked up, and there before me was a man with a measuring line in his hand.

source: Chuin kenjong, hoija che nahim? kati. Hichun aman kahenga, Jerusalem avai ite hija, adung ite ahi hetna dinga ate dinga che kahi, ati.
target: I asked, “Where are you going?” He answered me, “To measure Jerusalem, to find out how wide and how long it is.”

source: Chuin veuvin, eikihoupi vantil chu achedoh-in, chule vantil chom khat ama kimupi dingin apotdoh-in,
target: While the angel who was speaking to me was leaving, another angel came to meet him

source: Chule ahenga hitin aseije, lhaijin, hiche gollhangpa henga khun, Jerusalem chu asunga mihemle gancha atamval jeh-a kulbang neilou khopiho banga chenna hiding ahi, tin gaseijin.
target: and said to him: “Run, tell that young man, ‘Jerusalem will be a city without walls because of the great number of people and animals in it.

source: Ajehchu keima ama dinga akimvela mei kulbang banga kauma, chule asunga loupina kahi ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: And I myself will be a wall of fire around it,’ declares the Lord , ‘and I will be its glory within.’

source: Hei, hung doh-un, chule sahlam gama konin jamdoh uvin tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ajehchu kol ningli-a hui bangin kathejao taove tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,” declares the Lord , “for I have scattered you to the four winds of heaven,” declares the Lord .

source: Babylon chanutoh chengkhom Vo Zion, nangma kihuh doh-in.
target: “Come, Zion! Escape, you who live in Daughter Babylon!”

source: Ajehchu, janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; loupina jou chun, nachom gamuva namho henga chun keima eisolin ahi. Ajehchu nangho tongkha-a chun amit laivom atohkhah ahi.
target: For this is what the Lord Almighty says: “After the Glorious One has sent me against the nations that have plundered you—for whoever touches you touches the apple of his eye—

source: Ajehchu veuvin, keiman achunguva kakhut kathin ding, chule amaho asohteu dinga galthil kichom hidiu ahi: chutengle nanghon keimahi janel Pakai hinsol kahi nahetna dingu ahi.
target: I will surely raise my hand against them so that their slaves will plunder them. Then you will know that the Lord Almighty has sent me.

source: Vo Zion chanute, la saovin lang kipah-un: ajehchu veuvin, kahunge, chule nalah uva kachen ding ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Shout and be glad, Daughter Zion. For I am coming, and I will live among you,” declares the Lord .

source: Hiche ni chule nam tamtah-in Pakai chu jop untin, kamite hidiu: chule keima nalah uva kachen ding, chutengle keimahi janel Pakaiyin naheng uva eihinsol ahi nahet dingu ahi.
target: “Many nations will be joined with the Lord in that day and will become my people. I will live among you and you will know that the Lord Almighty has sent me to you.

source: Chule Pakaiyin gamtheng sunga achanvou dinga Juda chu alo ding, chule Jerusalem adeilhen kitding ahi.
target: The Lord will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land and will again choose Jerusalem.

source: Vo tahsa hing jouse, Pakai anga thipchetnun: ajehchu ama amunthenga konin akithou doh-in ahi.
target: Be still before the Lord , all mankind, because he has roused himself from his holy dwelling.”

source: Chuin aman, Pakai vantil anga ding thempu chungnung Joshua chule ama doudal ding go-a ajetlama Satan adin chu eivetsah-e.
target: Then he showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the Lord , and Satan standing at his right side to accuse him.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin Satan henga, Vo Satan, Pakaiyin naphoh-e; Pakai Jerusalem kilhenpa tahchun naphoh-e: hichehi meija kona meikho kiloidoh hilou ham? atin ahi.
target: The Lord said to Satan, “The Lord rebuke you, Satan! The Lord , who has chosen Jerusalem, rebuke you! Is not this man a burning stick snatched from the fire?”

source: Tun Joshua chu ponsil nentah kivonin, vantil anga chun adinge.
target: Now Joshua was dressed in filthy clothes as he stood before the angel.

source: Aman amasanga dingho chu adonbutnin, ajah uva chun, ponsil nen chu ama-a konin ladoh-un, tin aseije. Chule ama jah-a chun, ven, nakhan gitlouna nanga kona kabeisah tan, chule keiman ponsil hoitah kavonpeh ding nahi, ati.
target: The angel said to those who were standing before him, “Take off his filthy clothes.” Then he said to Joshua, “See, I have taken away your sin, and I will put fine garments on you.”

source: Chuin keiman, aluchunga lukhuh hoitah khuhpeh uhen, kati. Chutichun alua lukhuh hoitah akhuh peh-un, ponsil avonpeh taove. Chule Pakai vantil chu akoma adinge.
target: Then I said, “Put a clean turban on his head.” So they put a clean turban on his head and clothed him, while the angel of the Lord stood by.

source: Chuin Pakai vantil chun Joshua henga aphongdoh-in, aseije.
target: The angel of the Lord gave this charge to Joshua:

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; kalampi najotna, kathupeh nanit leh, ka-in sunga vai nahom ding, kahong sung jong navetsui ding, chule hikoma dingho lah-a hi vahle theina mun kapeh ding nahi.
target: “This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘If you will walk in obedience to me and keep my requirements, then you will govern my house and have charge of my courts, and I will give you a place among these standing here.

source: Vo Joshua thempu chungnung, nangma le na-anga touhon, tun ngaijun; ajehchu amaho datmo umtah miho ahiuve: ajehchu veuvin, keiman kalhacha ABAH chu kahin puidoh ding ahi.
target: “ ‘Listen, High Priest Joshua, you and your associates seated before you, who are men symbolic of things to come: I am going to bring my servant, the Branch.

source: Ajehchu Joshua masanga kasong set chu veuvin, song khat chunga mit sagi umding ahi: veuvin, keiman hia chu thucheng kajih ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije, chule keiman nikhat tengle chuche gam khangitlouna chu katolmang ding ahi.
target: See, the stone I have set in front of Joshua! There are seven eyes on that one stone, and I will engrave an inscription on it,’ says the Lord Almighty, ‘and I will remove the sin of this land in a single day.

source: Hiche nikho chule mitinin alengpigui le atheichang phung noija, aheng akomcheh akou dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘In that day each of you will invite your neighbor to sit under your vine and fig tree,’ declares the Lord Almighty.”

source: Chuin vantil eina kihoupi chu ahungkitnin, mi khat a-ihmutna kona kisuthou bangin eisuthouvin,
target: Then the angel who talked with me returned and woke me up, like someone awakened from sleep.

source: kajah-a, ipi namu em? eiti. Hichun keiman kadonbutnin, kavei, chule vetan, achungvuma sumlheng um, chule akhoma thaomei sagi nei, chuche thaomei sagi-a chu akam sagi um, sana jenga kisem meivah khom:
target: He asked me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a solid gold lampstand with a bowl at the top and seven lamps on it, with seven channels to the lamps.

source: Chule akoma Olive thingphung ni, sumlheng jetlama khat chule aveilama khat um kamui, kati.
target: Also there are two olive trees by it, one on the right of the bowl and the other on its left.”

source: Chuti chun, kadonbut nin, eina kihoupi vantil jah-a chun, ka pakai hichehohi ipi ham? katin ahi.
target: I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these, my lord?”

source: Chuin eina kihoupi vantil chun eidonbutnin, hichehohi ipi ahi nahetlou ham? ati. Hichun keiman kahepoi ka Pakai, katin ahi.
target: He answered, “Do you not know what these are?” “No, my lord,” I replied.

source: Chuin aman eidonbutnin kahenga aseije, Hichehi Zerubbabel henga Pakai thusei ahi: thahat jeh hilou, thilboltheina jeh jong hilou, kalhagao vang jeh ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: So he said to me, “This is the word of the Lord to Zerubbabel: ‘Not by might nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the Lord Almighty.

source: Vo molsang lenpitah, nangma koi nahim? Zerubbabel masanga phaicham naso jeng ding ahi: chule aman a-aw puma songpi athupipen chu lungsetna, lungsetna tia sampuma ahintoldoh ding ahi.
target: “What are you, mighty mountain? Before Zerubbabel you will become level ground. Then he will bring out the capstone to shouts of ‘God bless it! God bless it!’ ”

source: Chukal valin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahungin, aseije,
target: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

source: Zerubbabel khutnin hiche in bul hi ana phudoh ahin, ama khut maman ajoding ahi: chutengle nanghon keimahi janel Pakaiyin naheng uva eisol ahi nahetdingu ahi.
target: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this temple; his hands will also complete it. Then you will know that the Lord Almighty has sent me to you.

source: Ajehchu koijin thilneocha nikho i-sah louva akoijem? ajehchu amaho kipah-un tin, Zerubbabel khutna ngentum chu hiche sagiho chutoh amuthadiu ahi; hiche sagiho chu leiset pumpi-a suhle tunga lhaile Pakai mit ahiuve.
target: “Who dares despise the day of small things, since the seven eyes of the Lord that range throughout the earth will rejoice when they see the chosen capstone in the hand of Zerubbabel?”

source: Chule keiman kadonbut nin, ajah-a, hiche meivah khom jetle veija olive thingphung teni hi ipi hetna ham? katin ahi.
target: Then I asked the angel, “What are these two olive trees on the right and the left of the lampstand?”

source: Chuin keiman kadonbut kitnin, ahenga kaseijin, sana long tenin amani le amani-a kon sana thaotwi alhitkang lhona olive thingbah teni khu ipi hetna ham? kati.
target: Again I asked him, “What are these two olive branches beside the two gold pipes that pour out golden oil?”

source: Aman eidonbut nin, kajah-a, hichehohi ipi hetna ahi nahetlou ham? eiti. Chuin keiman, kahepoi ka pakai kati.
target: He replied, “Do you not know what these are?” “No, my lord,” I said.

source: Chuin aman aseijin, hitenihi thao kinusa, leiset pumpi Pakai koma ding teni ahi lhone ati.
target: So he said, “These are the two who are anointed to serve the Lord of all the earth.”

source: Chujouvin kakiheijin, kakhodah-in, chule kaven ahile, lekhajol leng lele khat kamun ahi.
target: I looked again, and there before me was a flying scroll.

source: Chule aman kahenga, ipi namu em? eiti. Chuin keiman, lekhajol khat kamun, adung chu tong somni ahin, chule avai chu tong som ahi, tin kadonbutne.
target: He asked me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll, twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide.”

source: Chuin aman kajah-a, hichehi leiset pumpi chunga dinga potdoh-a gaosapna chu ahi: ajehchu gucha tapou chu lekhajol hiche lampang dungjuija kisumanga, chule akihahsel tapou chu lekhajol khuche lampang dungjuija kisumang ding ahi, ati.
target: And he said to me, “This is the curse that is going out over the whole land; for according to what it says on one side, every thief will be banished, and according to what it says on the other, everyone who swears falsely will be banished.

source: Keiman kahin puidoh ding ahi tin Janel Pakaiyin aseije, chule hiche guchapa insung le jouva kamina kihahselpa insunga chu lutding; hichu a-insunga chu umdena, chua uma thingpeh le songho puma chu asuhmanghel ding ahi.
target: The Lord Almighty declares, ‘I will send it out, and it will enter the house of the thief and the house of anyone who swears falsely by my name. It will remain in that house and destroy it completely, both its timbers and its stones.’ ”

source: Chujouvin keima eina houpi vantil chu ahung potdoh-in, kajah-a, tun khodah inlang apotdoh khu ipiham vetemin, ati.
target: Then the angel who was speaking to me came forward and said to me, “Look up and see what is appearing.”

source: Chuin keiman, ipiham? kati. Chuin aman aseijin, hiche hi apotdoh-a ephah chu ahi. Aman aseibe kitnin, hiche hi leiset pumpi-a akhan gitlounao chu ahi, ati.
target: I asked, “What is it?” He replied, “It is a basket.” And he added, “This is the iniquity of the people throughout the land.”

source: Chuin veuvin, ngen talen khat akidom sangin; chule hichehi numei khat ephah sunga tou chu ahi.
target: Then the cover of lead was raised, and there in the basket sat a woman!

source: Chuin aman aseijin, hichehi khan gitlouna ahi. Chuin aman ephah sunga aseplutnin, chule aman ngen gih-a chun chuche kam chu asingtan ahi, ati.
target: He said, “This is wickedness,” and he pushed her back into the basket and pushed its lead cover down on it.

source: Chujouvin keiman kakhodah-in, kaven ahileh, veuvin, numei ni ahungdoh in, alhaving hona chun hui aumin ahi; ajehchu amanin twilungva bangin lhaving aneilhonin ahi. Chuin amanin ephah chu leile van kikah-a adomsang lhonin ahi.
target: Then I looked up—and there before me were two women, with the wind in their wings! They had wings like those of a stork, and they lifted up the basket between heaven and earth.

source: Chujouvin keiman einaki houpi-a vantil jah-a chun, hiche ephah hi hoilama adoplhon dingham kati?
target: “Where are they taking the basket?” I asked the angel who was speaking to me.

source: Chuin aman kahenga, Shinar gama a-in sahpeh nading lama: chule hichu kisadoh intin, amanu mun ngeija kitungdoh ding ahi, ati.
target: He replied, “To the country of Babylonia to build a house for it. When the house is ready, the basket will be set there in its place.”

source: Chule keima kakiheijin, kakhodah-in, kaven ahileh, veuvin, molsang ni kikah-a sakol kangtalai li ahungdoh-in; chule hiche molsang teni chu sum-eng molsang ahi.
target: I looked up again, and there before me were four chariots coming out from between two mountains—mountains of bronze.

source: Sakol kangtalai masa-a sakol ho chu asan ahin, sakol kangtalai nina-a sakol ho chu avom ahi;
target: The first chariot had red horses, the second black,

source: Chule sakol kangtalai thum na-a sakol ho chu akangin, chule sakol kangtalai lina-a sakol ho chu abongpol jeng ahiuve.
target: the third white, and the fourth dappled—all of them powerful.

source: Chujouvin keiman kadonbut nin eihoupi-a vantil jah-a chun, ka pakai, hichehohi ipiham? kati.
target: I asked the angel who was speaking to me, “What are these, my lord?”

source: Chuin vantil chun kajah-a, hichehohi van lhagao liho, leiset pumpi Pakai anga adin naova kona chedohho ahiuve.
target: The angel answered me, “These are the four spirits of heaven, going out from standing in the presence of the Lord of the whole world.

source: Chua um sakol vomho chu sahlam gama akitolun; akangho chun amaho chu ajuijun; abongpol ho chu lhang lam gama akitolui.
target: The one with the black horses is going toward the north country, the one with the white horses toward the west, and the one with the dappled horses toward the south.”

source: Asan pengho jong apotdoh-un, leiset pumpi-a suhle tunga vale ding agouvin ahi: chuin aman ajah uva, nangho hia konin cheovinlang, leipumpi suhle tungin gakhol taovin, ati. Hitichun amaho leiset pumpi-a suhle tunga avahle taove.
target: When the powerful horses went out, they were straining to go throughout the earth. And he said, “Go throughout the earth!” So they went throughout the earth.

source: Chujouvin aman kachunga apeng jah-in, chule kahenga aseije, ven, hiche sahlang gama cheho khun sahlang gama kalhagao acholdo sah uve, ati.
target: Then he called to me, “Look, those going toward the north country have given my Spirit rest in the land of the north.”

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, aseije;
target: The word of the Lord came to me:

source: Sohchang Babylon'a kona hungho lah-a, Heldai, Tobijah, chule Jedaiah'a kon thilpeh chu la inlang, chuche ni mama chule hungin lang, Zephaniah chapa Josiah ina chun lutnin;
target: “Take silver and gold from the exiles Heldai, Tobijah and Jedaiah, who have arrived from Babylon. Go the same day to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.

source: Chujouteng dangkale sana lanlang lallukhuh khat semin, chule hichu thempu chungnung Josedech chapa Joshua luchunga khuhpeh-in;
target: Take the silver and gold and make a crown, and set it on the head of the high priest, Joshua son of Jozadak.

source: Chule ajah-a hitin seijin, Janel Pakaiyin aseijin, hitin aseije, ven Mi amin ABAH kitipa chu: Ama aumna mun'a konin khangtouvin tin, chule aman Pakai houin asahdoh ding ahi.
target: Tell him this is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘Here is the man whose name is the Branch, and he will branch out from his place and build the temple of the Lord .

source: Aman Pakai houin geija asahdoh-a, loupina chu chang ding, chule ama touva alaltouna chunga vai ahomding; alaltouna chunga chu thempu'a pang ding ahi: chule chamna thumopna chu akikah lhona umding ahi.
target: It is he who will build the temple of the Lord , and he will be clothed with majesty and will sit and rule on his throne. And he will be a priest on his throne. And there will be harmony between the two.’

source: Chule lallukhuh ho chu Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, chule Zephaniah chapa hetna dinga Pakai houin sunga umding ahi.
target: The crown will be given to Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah and Hen son of Zephaniah as a memorial in the temple of the Lord .

source: Chule gamlatah-a umho hunguva Pakai houin chu asahdiu, chutengle nanghon keimahi janel Pakaiyin naheng uva eisol ahichu nahetdiu ahi. Hichehi nanghon genngai tah-a Pakai na Pathen'u aw chu nangai ule bou hung guilhung ding ahi.
target: Those who are far away will come and help to build the temple of the Lord , and you will know that the Lord Almighty has sent me to you. This will happen if you diligently obey the Lord your God.”

source: Chule ahitin ahi, Darius lengchan kal kum lina, Chisleu kiti alhakoh chana, ni li chanin, Zekeriah henga Pakai thu chu ahung lhungin ahi.
target: In the fourth year of King Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Kislev.

source: Hichu amahon Pathen in'a Sherezer le Regem-Melek le amiteu chu Pakai anga taodingin asol uvin,
target: The people of Bethel had sent Sharezer and Regem-Melek, together with their men, to entreat the Lord

source: Chule janel Pakai in'a um thempuho le themgaoho henga, kum tamtah kahin bolngai banga, kachom uma, lha nga channa-a chu kaka ding ham? tia aga dohsah petnu ahi.
target: by asking the priests of the house of the Lord Almighty and the prophets, “Should I mourn and fast in the fifth month, as I have done for so many years?”

source: Chuin janel Pakai thu chu kahenga ahung lhungin, aseije,
target: Then the word of the Lord Almighty came to me:

source: Gamsunga um miho jousele, thempuho jouse jah-a chun seijin, nanghon lha nga nale lha sagina-a an nangol uva chule nalunghem tengule, chuche kum somsagi sung jenga jongchu kahenga, keima henga an ngolla nahibeh um?
target: “Ask all the people of the land and the priests, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months for the past seventy years, was it really for me that you fasted?

source: Chule nanghon naneh uva nadon tengu jongleh, nangho dinga bou naneh uva nadonu hilou ham?
target: And when you were eating and drinking, were you not just feasting for yourselves?

source: Jerusalem le akimvel khopiho mihon alo dimsetnuva aphattou laile, mihon lhanglam le phaicham alodimlai juva themgao masaho-a Pakai thusei ho chu nangaidiu hilou ham? ati.
target: Are these not the words the Lord proclaimed through the earlier prophets when Jerusalem and its surrounding towns were at rest and prosperous, and the Negev and the western foothills were settled?’ ”

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu Zekeriah henga ahung lhungin, aseije.
target: And the word of the Lord came again to Zechariah:

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Thutan dih mangun lang, mitinin asopi henga hepina le khotona musah hen.
target: “This is what the Lord Almighty said: ‘Administer true justice; show mercy and compassion to one another.

source: Chule meithai le pa neilou, kholjin mi le migenthei ho chu bolgim hih-un, koima chan asopi dounan alungthimin aphalou ngaito hihhen, ati.
target: Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless, the foreigner or the poor. Do not plot evil against each other.’

source: Ahinla amahon angainom pouvin, chule alengkouvu aheimangun, ajahlouna dingun akol asimuvin ahi.
target: “But they refused to pay attention; stubbornly they turned their backs and covered their ears.

source: Henge, amahon janel Pakaiyin themgao masaho lhagaova ahin thuseidoh ho le adan thupeh ho chu kijakhante tin alungu song bangin atahsah-un ahi. Hijeh chun janel Pakaiya konin alunghana nasatah ahung lhungin ahi.
target: They made their hearts as hard as flint and would not listen to the law or to the words that the Lord Almighty had sent by his Spirit through the earlier prophets. So the Lord Almighty was very angry.

source: Hijeh chun, ahitin ahi, aman akouva, amahon angailou banguvin; amahon eikouvu keiman kangai lou ding ahi tin, janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “ ‘When I called, they did not listen; so when they called, I would not listen,’ says the Lord Almighty.

source: Ahinla keiman amaho ahetkhah louvu namtin lah-a chimpeijin kathecheh taove. Hijeh chun amaho nungin agamu chu akamheltan, koima ajotpa le akinungle aumpoi: ajehchu gam nomtah chu kamhela akoiju ahitai.
target: ‘I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations, where they were strangers. The land they left behind them was so desolate that no one traveled through it. This is how they made the pleasant land desolate.’ ”

source: Janel Pakai thu kahenga ahunglhung kitnin, aseije;
target: The word of the Lord Almighty came to me.

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Keima Zion din thangthipna nasatah-in kathangthipmin, amadin lunghan chungnungin kathangthipme.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “I am very jealous for Zion; I am burning with jealousy for her.”

source: Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Keima Zion henga kahung kilekitna, Jerusalem lailunga kachen ding ahi. Chule Jerusalem chu thutah khopi kitiding, janel ho Pakai molsang chu molsang theng kitiding ahi.
target: This is what the Lord says: “I will return to Zion and dwell in Jerusalem. Then Jerusalem will be called the Faithful City, and the mountain of the Lord Almighty will be called the Holy Mountain.”

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Jerusalem lamlena chu tehse numei le tehse pasal cheng nalai ding ahin, chule akum tambehseh jeh-a mitinin akhutna tenggol akiphu dingu ahi.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “Once again men and women of ripe old age will sit in the streets of Jerusalem, each of them with cane in hand because of their age.

source: Chule khopi lamlena chu pasal chapang le numei chapang dimset ding, akhopi lamlena chu kichem dingu ahi.
target: The city streets will be filled with boys and girls playing there.”

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; hiche nikho-a hiche mite amohho mitmu-a hichu datmo aumin, chule keima mitmu-a jong datmo aumdem? tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “It may seem marvelous to the remnant of this people at that time, but will it seem marvelous to me?” declares the Lord Almighty.

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; veuvin, keiman kamite chu solam le lhumlam gama kona kahuhdoh ding;
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “I will save my people from the countries of the east and the west.

source: Chule amaho chu kahin puija, Jerusalem lailunga cheng ding ahiuve. Chule amaho kamite hiuva, thutah le chonphatna-a keima a-Pathen'u kahiding ahi.
target: I will bring them back to live in Jerusalem; they will be my people, and I will be faithful and righteous to them as their God.”

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; Houin kisahdoh theina ding, janel Pakai houin bul kiphudoh nikho-a themgaoho kama thu kisei cheng, tukhanga anakola jajousen naban thau hatsah-un.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “Now hear these words, ‘Let your hands be strong so that the temple may be built.’ This is also what the prophets said who were present when the foundation was laid for the house of the Lord Almighty.

source: Ajehchu tumasangin mihem kithalah manle, gancha kigoi man jong akipepoi; hesohna jeh-in alutle apotle dingin jong chamna aumpoi: ajehchu mijouse aheng akomtoh kana kidou sah-in ahi.
target: Before that time there were no wages for people or hire for animals. No one could go about their business safely because of their enemies, since I had turned everyone against their neighbor.

source: Ahinla tunvang, hiche miho amoh cheng henga hin, masang laija chutoh bang taponge tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: But now I will not deal with the remnant of this people as I did in the past,” declares the Lord Almighty.

source: Ajehchu muchi chu pha theijin tin, lengpiguijin aga pentin, leijin aga sepdoh intin, vanhon adaitwi hou apehdingu ahi; chule keiman hiche mite amohho chu hicheho jousehi kalosah ding ahi.
target: “The seed will grow well, the vine will yield its fruit, the ground will produce its crops, and the heavens will drop their dew. I will give all these things as an inheritance to the remnant of this people.

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi, Pathen helouho lah-a sapsetna nachan jeh uvin, Vo Judah le Israel insung miteho; hijeh-a chu kahuhdoh uva phatthei channa nahidiu ahi. Kicha hih-un, ahin nabantha hatsah jouvin.
target: Just as you, Judah and Israel, have been a curse among the nations, so I will save you, and you will be a blessing. Do not be afraid, but let your hands be strong.”

source: Ajehchu janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; napateu vin eilung hansah uva, nangho engbol dinga kana gotlai bangin, kalung kaheipoi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “Just as I had determined to bring disaster on you and showed no pity when your ancestors angered me,” says the Lord Almighty,

source: Chuti chun tulai nikhon vang Jerusalem le Judah insung mite chunga thipha bolding kangaito kit tai: nangho kicha hih-un.
target: “so now I have determined to do good again to Jerusalem and Judah. Do not be afraid.

source: Hichehi nanghon naboldiu chu ahi; mitinin aheng akom jah-a thutah jeng seijun; nakotpi phunguva thutah le chamna-in thu tanun.
target: These are the things you are to do: Speak the truth to each other, and render true and sound judgment in your courts;

source: Koimachan aheng akom chunga lungse ngaito hihhen, jouva kihahselna ngailu hih-un. Ajehchu hicheho jousehi keiman kahot ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: do not plot evil against each other, and do not love to swear falsely. I hate all this,” declares the Lord .

source: Chule janel Pakai thu chu kahenga hungin, aseije;
target: The word of the Lord Almighty came to me.

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; lha lina an ngol, lha ngana an ngol, lha sagina an ngol, chule lhasom na-an ngol chu Judah insung mite dinga akipanale thanopna, chule nopsahna kut hiding ahi; hijeh chun thutah le chamna ngailuvin.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh and tenth months will become joyful and glad occasions and happy festivals for Judah. Therefore love truth and peace.”

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; hung hiti ding ahi, mipi ho, khopi tamtah-a chengho chu hungding ahiuve.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come,

source: Khopi khatna chenga miho chu achom khatna cheovintin, ajah uva, Pakai henga tao dingle, janel Pakai holdingin cheloiju hite: keijong kache ding ahi, ati dingu ahi.
target: and the inhabitants of one city will go to another and say, ‘Let us go at once to entreat the Lord and seek the Lord Almighty. I myself am going.’

source: Henge, mi tamtah le nam hat ho chu Jerusalem'a janel Pakai holding le Pakai henga taodinga hung diu ahi.
target: And many peoples and powerful nations will come to Jerusalem to seek the Lord Almighty and to entreat him.”

source: Janel Pakaiyin hitin aseije; hiche nikho chule hung hitiding ahi, namtinle paotin jouse-a kona misomin Judah mi khat pon atuh uva, keiho jong nangtoh kilhona kachediu ahi; ajehchu Pathen'in na-umpiuve ti kajauve, atidingu ahi ati.
target: This is what the Lord Almighty says: “In those days ten people from all languages and nations will take firm hold of one Jew by the hem of his robe and say, ‘Let us go with you, because we have heard that God is with you.’ ”

source: Israel phungho jouse banga mihemte mit ho chun Pakai lam ahin ngat tengle; Hadrach gamsunga Pakai thua pohgih, chule Damascus chu akicholdona hiding ahi.
target: A prophecy: The word of the Lord is against the land of Hadrak and will come to rest on Damascus— for the eyes of all people and all the tribes of Israel are on the Lord —

source: Chule Tyrus le Zidon chu chinglheh jongle, Hamath'in jong hichu agamgit ding ahi.
target: and on Hamath too, which borders on it, and on Tyre and Sidon, though they are very skillful.

source: Chule Tyrus'in ama dingin kuldet akisemin, dangka chu leivui bangin asevumin, sana thengsel jong khopi lamlena bonlhoh bangin asevume.
target: Tyre has built herself a stronghold; she has heaped up silver like dust, and gold like the dirt of the streets.

source: Veovin, Pakaiyin amanu apaidoh ding, chule athahatna chu twipia alehlut ding; chule meijin akahvam ding ahi.
target: But the Lord will take away her possessions and destroy her power on the sea, and she will be consumed by fire.

source: Ashkelon'in hichu amua kicha ding; Gaza'n jong amua lunggim lheh ding, chule Ekron'in jong; ajehchu akinepna chu kijumso ding; lengpa chu Gaza-a kona mangthah ding, Ashkelon chu chenna lou hiding ahitai.
target: Ashkelon will see it and fear; Gaza will writhe in agony, and Ekron too, for her hope will wither. Gaza will lose her king and Ashkelon will be deserted.

source: Chule Ashdod'a chu jaocha khat cheng ding; keiman Philistine hoithona chu kasuhtan ding ahi.
target: A mongrel people will occupy Ashdod, and I will put an end to the pride of the Philistines.

source: Chule akamsunga kon athisan kalahmanga, chule aha kah-a kona thet umtah ahina chu kalahmang ding ahi. Ahinla aumdenpa, ama tah jengjong chu i-Pathen uva ding hintin, Judah gamsunga chu vaipipo banga umding ahin, Ekron chu Jebus mite tobang hiding ahi.
target: I will take the blood from their mouths, the forbidden food from between their teeth. Those who are left will belong to our God and become a clan in Judah, and Ekron will be like the Jebusites.

source: Galmiho jehle, ajotpa jeh le ahung kilepa jeh-a, ka-in hi kaum kimvel ding; chule misugenthei koiman ahin jotpa lou ding ahitai; ajehchu tun kamit tah-in kamutai.
target: But I will encamp at my temple to guard it against marauding forces. Never again will an oppressor overrun my people, for now I am keeping watch.

source: Vo Zion chanu, hapan kipah-in; Jerusalem chanu, aovin: ven nalengpa nahenga ahunge: ama chondihtah ahin, chule huhhingna aneije; kineosah tah-in sangan chunga, sangan nou chunga atouvin ahi.
target: Rejoice greatly, Daughter Zion! Shout, Daughter Jerusalem! See, your king comes to you, righteous and victorious, lowly and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

source: Chule keiman Ephraim'a kona sakol kangtalai kasuhmanga, Jerusalem'a kona sakol ho chu kasuh mangding, chule gal thalpi jong kisat bongding ahi. Chule aman Pathen hephalou ho jah-a chamna thu aseiding, alenggam chu twipia pat twipi gei, chule vadunga pat kolmong gei hiding ahi.
target: I will take away the chariots from Ephraim and the warhorses from Jerusalem, and the battle bow will be broken. He will proclaim peace to the nations. His rule will extend from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth.

source: Nangma dingin jong, nathisana kitepna vangin, twi beina kokhuh-a konin nasohchangho chu kasoldohtai.
target: As for you, because of the blood of my covenant with you, I will free your prisoners from the waterless pit.

source: Kinepna nei sohchang nangho kuldet lama kileuvin; tuni tah-a hi ajatnia kapehdiu ahi tia kaphondoh ahi.
target: Return to your fortress, you prisoners of hope; even now I announce that I will restore twice as much to you.

source: Keiman kathalpi Judah kajebongin, Ephraim chu thalchang bangin thal'a kadipme, nachapate chu thoudoh-in, vo Zion, nachapate doudingin, vo Greek, nangma mihat ho chemjam bangin kaseme.
target: I will bend Judah as I bend my bow and fill it with Ephraim. I will rouse your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and make you like a warrior’s sword.

source: Pakai chu achunguva kimuntin; athalchang ho chu kolphe banga leng ding ahi: Pakai Pathen'in sumkon mut intin, lhanglam chimpeitoh kilhonding ahi.
target: Then the Lord will appear over them; his arrow will flash like lightning. The Sovereign Lord will sound the trumpet; he will march in the storms of the south,

source: Janel Pakaiyin amaho ahonbit dingu; chule amahon abahgamuva, ah songse songa ajodiu ahi, amahon adondiu, chule lengpitwi kham banga pohchei choidiu; amaho sumlheng ho banga dimuva, maicham ningho bang dimdiu ahi.
target: and the Lord Almighty will shield them. They will destroy and overcome with slingstones. They will drink and roar as with wine; they will be full like a bowl used for sprinkling the corners of the altar.

source: Chule hiche nikho chule a-Pathen'un amite ganchahon banga ahuhdoh ding ahi: ajehchu amaho alua lallukhuh chunga songho bang dingu, agamsunga ponlap banga choisanga umdiu ahi.
target: The Lord their God will save his people on that day as a shepherd saves his flock. They will sparkle in his land like jewels in a crown.

source: Ajehchu aphatna hi ichana lenna, ahoina hi ichana len hitam? changin gollhangho athanopsah ding, lengpitwi thah-in nungah ho akipasah ding ahi.
target: How attractive and beautiful they will be! Grain will make the young men thrive, and new wine the young women.

source: Goju nunung laihin nanghon Pakai henga go thumin; chutile Pakaiyin meilom vahsah intin, loulaija hampa tin cheng chu gotwi apehding ahi.
target: Ask the Lord for rain in the springtime; it is the Lord who sends the thunderstorms. He gives showers of rain to all people, and plants of the field to everyone.

source: Ajehchu semthu milimhon pannabei thu aseijun, doi-aithem hon jouthu amuvin, mang dihlou aseijuvin; amahon ahomkeovin alhamonun ahi. Hijeh chun kelngoihon bangin ama ama lampia acheuvin, kelngoi chingpa umlou jeh-in, amaho alungkham taove.
target: The idols speak deceitfully, diviners see visions that lie; they tell dreams that are false, they give comfort in vain. Therefore the people wander like sheep oppressed for lack of a shepherd.

source: Kelngoi chingho chunga chun kalung hang behsehnin, kelchaho chu ka-engbol tai. Ajehchu janel Pakaiyin akelngoihon Judah insung avilin, galbolna sakol phatah bangin aseme.
target: “My anger burns against the shepherds, and I will punish the leaders; for the Lord Almighty will care for his flock, the people of Judah, and make them like a proud horse in battle.

source: Ama-a konin inning songpi ahungdoh-in, ama-a konin thihkil, ama-a konin galkapna thalpi, ama-a konin misuh gentheina ho jouse chu ahungdoh-e.
target: From Judah will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler.

source: Amaho chu gal kisatna-a amelmate lamlena bonlhoh toh chotbeh-a mihat tah tobang hunghidiu ahi. Chule Pakaiyin aumpi jeh uva gal asatnuva, sakol chung chongho chu kijumso diu ahi.
target: Together they will be like warriors in battle trampling their enemy into the mud of the streets. They will fight because the Lord is with them, and they will put the enemy horsemen to shame.

source: Keiman Judah insung kahatsah-a, Joseph insung kahuhhing ding: keiman amaho chensah dinga kahin lepui kitding ahi; ajehchu keiman amaho kakhoto-in ahi. Amaho kanapai manglou tobang hidiu ah; ajehchu keima Pakai a-Pathen'u kahin, chule kangaipeh dingu ahi.
target: “I will strengthen Judah and save the tribes of Joseph. I will restore them because I have compassion on them. They will be as though I had not rejected them, for I am the Lord their God and I will answer them.

source: Ephraim miho chu mi hattah banguntin, alungu chu lengpitwi kham tobanga thanom ding: achateu vin hichu amuva, kipah dingu; Pakaiya alungu kipah ding ahi.
target: The Ephraimites will become like warriors, and their hearts will be glad as with wine. Their children will see it and be joyful; their hearts will rejoice in the Lord .

source: Keiman amaho dinga huisatding, chule kakhop khomding ahi; ajehchu keiman amaho kalhatdoh ahitan: anapunthei banguva chu pungthei diu ahi.
target: I will signal for them and gather them in. Surely I will redeem them; they will be as numerous as before.

source: Chule keiman amaho chu mite lah-a katulut ding: amahon gamlatah-a eihin geldoh dingu ahi; chule achateutoh cheng khomuva, hung kilekit dingu ahi.
target: Though I scatter them among the peoples, yet in distant lands they will remember me. They and their children will survive, and they will return.

source: Keiman amaho Egypt gama konin jong hinle puidoh kitning ting, Assyria'a kona kakhop khom ding; Chule Gilead le Lebanon gama kona kapuilutna, amaho dinga mun akimulou geija kapuilut ding ahi.
target: I will bring them back from Egypt and gather them from Assyria. I will bring them to Gilead and Lebanon, and there will not be room enough for them.

source: Chule ama gimbolna pumin twipi chu galkaijin tin, twipi kinong chu avoh ding, luipi thuhtah jouse kanggam helding ahi: Chule Assyria hoithona kisunema, Egypt te leng tenggol jong kitolmang ding ahi.
target: They will pass through the sea of trouble; the surging sea will be subdued and all the depths of the Nile will dry up. Assyria’s pride will be brought down and Egypt’s scepter will pass away.

source: Chule ken amaho chu Pakaiya hatsah ingting, ama minna chesuh chetoudiu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will strengthen them in the Lord and in his name they will live securely,” declares the Lord .

source: Vo Lebanon, meijin na Cedar thingho akahvam theina ding, nakot ho hongin.
target: Open your doors, Lebanon, so that fire may devour your cedars!

source: Vo chahthing, pengin; ajehchu cedar thingho alhugamtai; ajehchu thing thupi tahtah ho akisuse gamtai: Vo Bashan gangpiho, nangho pengun; ajehchu gammang thingho alhugamtai.
target: Wail, you juniper, for the cedar has fallen; the stately trees are ruined! Wail, oaks of Bashan; the dense forest has been cut down!

source: Kelngoi chingho pen awgin akijai, ajehchu aloupinao akisuhmang tai: keipi bahkai donglai kitumgin akijai, ajehchu Jordan kiletsahna suhsetnin aumtai.
target: Listen to the wail of the shepherds; their rich pastures are destroyed! Listen to the roar of the lions; the lush thicket of the Jordan is ruined!

source: Pakai ka Pathen'in hitin aseije; tha ding kelngoihon ho chu vah-in.
target: This is what the Lord my God says: “Shepherd the flock marked for slaughter.

source: Aneiho tah-in amaho athatjiuvin, themmo akisaji pouve: chule amaho joh-a panghon, Pakai chu nunnom hen; ajehchu keima kahao tai, atijiuve. Amaho achinga pangho tah-in jong akhotoji pouve.
target: Their buyers slaughter them and go unpunished. Those who sell them say, ‘Praise the Lord , I am rich!’ Their own shepherds do not spare them.

source: Ajehchu gamsunga chengho chu khoto taponge, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ahinla veuvin, keiman mitin chu aheng akom khut le alengpau khutna kapehdoh ding ahi. Amahon gamsung chu asat dingu, akhutnuva kona kahuh dohlou ding ahi.
target: For I will no longer have pity on the people of the land,” declares the Lord . “I will give everyone into the hands of their neighbors and their king. They will devastate the land, and I will not rescue anyone from their hands.”

source: Chule thading kelngoihon ho chu kavahding, vo kelngoihon lah-a genthei, nangma tahjong kavah ding nahi. Chuin keiman keima dingin tenggol ni kalan, khat chu Ahoi kasah-in, khat chu Kikan khom kasah-in; chuin kelngoihon chu kavahtai.
target: So I shepherded the flock marked for slaughter, particularly the oppressed of the flock. Then I took two staffs and called one Favor and the other Union, and I shepherded the flock.

source: Lha khat sungin kelngoi ching thum jong kasumangin; chule kahinna-in amaho athetnin, amaho hinna-in jong keima eihouve.
target: In one month I got rid of the three shepherds. The flock detested me, and I grew weary of them

source: Chujouvin ken kaseijin, ken nangho vahponge, athi ding chu thi hen; akisumang ding chu kisumang hen; adang chu amahole amaho sa kinetohen, katitai.
target: and said, “I will not be your shepherd. Let the dying die, and the perishing perish. Let those who are left eat one another’s flesh.”

source: Chuin katengol Ahoi kiti chu kalan, mijousetoh kitepna kananei chu kasuhkeh nadingin, katan bonghel tai.
target: Then I took my staff called Favor and broke it, revoking the covenant I had made with all the nations.

source: Chule hiche ni chun hichu abongtai: chule ganhon lah-a agenthei keima eina ngahho chun, hichu Pakai thu ahi, ti ahetauve.
target: It was revoked on that day, and so the oppressed of the flock who were watching me knew it was the word of the Lord .

source: Chuin keiman ahenguva, pha nasah ule, kalo neipeu vinlang; pha nasah lou uleh neipeh daovin, kati. Hichun amahon kalo dingin dangka somthum eitedoh peh taove.
target: I told them, “If you think it best, give me my pay; but if not, keep it.” So they paid me thirty pieces of silver.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga, kaman dinga manpha tah amahon eipeh-u chu, beldengpa henga petan eiti. Chuin dangka somthum chu kalan, Pakai in'a beldengpa chu kapetai.
target: And the Lord said to me, “Throw it to the potter”—the handsome price at which they valued me! So I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter at the house of the Lord .

source: Chujouvin Judah le Israel kah-a kisopitna chu kasuhkehthei nadingin, katengol dang Kikan khom kiti chu kalan, kasu bongheltai.
target: Then I broke my second staff called Union, breaking the family bond between Judah and Israel.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin kahenga, kelngoiching mingolpa manchah chu lakit nalai jin eiti.
target: Then the Lord said to me, “Take again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.

source: Ajehchu vetan, keiman gamsunga kelngoiching khat kahin tundoh ding, amachun akisumang dingho avil lou ding, anouho jong ahol lou ding, agu bongho jong aboldam lou ding, adinglaiho jong avahlou ding ahi. Ahivanga aman athaoho phe chu anehding, chule atinho chu ahal hala asat telding ahi.
target: For I am going to raise up a shepherd over the land who will not care for the lost, or seek the young, or heal the injured, or feed the healthy, but will eat the meat of the choice sheep, tearing off their hooves.

source: Phatchomna bei kelngoiching kelngoihon dalha-a chu ohe ada ahi! aban le amit jetlama chemjam chuding: abanchu gotheng hela, chule amit jetlam jong thimdel ding ahi.
target: “Woe to the worthless shepherd, who deserts the flock! May the sword strike his arm and his right eye! May his arm be completely withered, his right eye totally blinded!”

source: Israel dinga Pakai thu pohgih chu, vanho jahdoh-a leiset bulpi phutdeh-a, mihem sunga lhagao umsah-a Pakai chun aseije,
target: A prophecy: The word of the Lord concerning Israel. The Lord , who stretches out the heavens, who lays the foundation of the earth, and who forms the human spirit within a person, declares:

source: Judah le Jerusalem agoma douna dinga aki-um tengle, veovin, Jerusalem chu akimvela mijouse dinga lungvaina khonna kasem ding ahi.
target: “I am going to make Jerusalem a cup that sends all the surrounding peoples reeling. Judah will be besieged as well as Jerusalem.

source: Chule hiche nikho chule Jerusalem chu mijouse dinga pohgih tah songa kasem ding; chuche douna-in leiset mijouse kikhom jongleh, chuche pohgih domkang dinga kigo jouse chu ahal hala kisat telding ahi.
target: On that day, when all the nations of the earth are gathered against her, I will make Jerusalem an immovable rock for all the nations. All who try to move it will injure themselves.

source: Pakaiyin aseije, hiche nikho chule sakol jouse kidangsah na-a, chule achunga touho chu ngolna-a kajep ding; chule Judah insung chunga kamit kaha sah-a, miho sakol jouse mit chotna-a kajep ding ahi.
target: On that day I will strike every horse with panic and its rider with madness,” declares the Lord . “I will keep a watchful eye over Judah, but I will blind all the horses of the nations.

source: Chule Judah vaipoho chun alungthim uva, Jerusalem'a chengho chu janel Pakai a-Pathen'u jala kathahatnao ahi, atidiu ahi.
target: Then the clans of Judah will say in their hearts, ‘The people of Jerusalem are strong, because the Lord Almighty is their God.’

source: Chuche nikho chule Judah vaipoho chu thing lah-a meithuh bangle, changphal lah-a meisel banga kasem ding; amahon akimvela mijouse jetle veija akahvam ding ahi. Jerusalem vang chu ama mun Jerusalem ngeija chu chenna kinei kitding ahi.
target: “On that day I will make the clans of Judah like a firepot in a woodpile, like a flaming torch among sheaves. They will consume all the surrounding peoples right and left, but Jerusalem will remain intact in her place.

source: David insung loupina le Jerusalem'a chengho loupina chu Judah chunga akichoisang louna dinga, Pakaiyin Judah ponbuh ho chu ahuhdoh masah ding ahi.
target: “The Lord will save the dwellings of Judah first, so that the honor of the house of David and of Jerusalem’s inhabitants may not be greater than that of Judah.

source: Chuche nikho chule Jerusalem'a chengho chu Pakaiyin hongin tin, alah uva chuche nikho-a alhasampen jong chu David bang ding; chule David insung chu Pathen tobang hiding, a-angsung uva Pakai vantil um banghel hidiu ahi.
target: On that day the Lord will shield those who live in Jerusalem, so that the feeblest among them will be like David, and the house of David will be like God, like the angel of the Lord going before them.

source: Chule hiche nikho chule hunghiti ding ahi, Jerusalem douva hungkon nam jouse chu suhmang dinga kahol ding ahi.
target: On that day I will set out to destroy all the nations that attack Jerusalem.

source: Chule David insung chungle Jerusalem'a chengte ho chunga lungsetna lhagao le taona lhagao kahin buhlhah ding ahi. Chule amahon tenga anasutpao keima eivet diu, chule mi achapa changkhat jeh-a alunghem banga amaho lunghemdiu, mikhat acha pengmasa pen chunga lhasetah-a aka banga ama jala kana nasatah umding ahi.
target: “And I will pour out on the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and supplication. They will look on me, the one they have pierced, and they will mourn for him as one mourns for an only child, and grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for a firstborn son.

source: Hiche nikho teng chule Megiddo phaichama Hadad-rimmon pul kidou banga, Jerusalem'a puldouna lentah umding ahi.
target: On that day the weeping in Jerusalem will be as great as the weeping of Hadad Rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.

source: Chule gamsungin pul adouding, insung jousen atuma; David insungin mitin atuma, ajiteuvin atuma; Nathan insunga miten atuma, chule ajiteuvin atuma;
target: The land will mourn, each clan by itself, with their wives by themselves: the clan of the house of David and their wives, the clan of the house of Nathan and their wives,

source: Levi insunga mite atuma, chule ajiteuvin atuma; Shimei insungin atuma, chule ajiteuvin atuma;
target: the clan of the house of Levi and their wives, the clan of Shimei and their wives,

source: Amoh umnalai insung jousen, insung jousen atuma, chule ajiteuvin atuma pul adou chehdiu ahi.
target: and all the rest of the clans and their wives.

source: Chuche nikho teng chule chonsetna le thenlouna jeh-a David insung dingle Jerusalem'a chengteho-a dinga twinah khat hung putdoh ding ahi.
target: “On that day a fountain will be opened to the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and impurity.

source: Hiche nikho chule hunghiti ding ahi, gamsunga kona alim semthuho min chu kasuhbeija, geldoh-a umkit talouhel ding ahi. Chule athemgao houle lhagao bohho chu gamsunga kona kapotdoh sah ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “On that day, I will banish the names of the idols from the land, and they will be remembered no more,” declares the Lord Almighty. “I will remove both the prophets and the spirit of impurity from the land.

source: Chule hung hitiding ahi, mi khattou gao thusei aumle, ama hinga anule apa chun ahenga, Pakai mina jou nasei jeh-a nahinlou ding ahi, atilhon ding ahi. Chule ahinga anule apan agao thusei petna chu paihela asutlhon ding ahi.
target: And if anyone still prophesies, their father and mother, to whom they were born, will say to them, ‘You must die, because you have told lies in the Lord ’s name.’ Then their own parents will stab the one who prophesies.

source: Chule hiche nikho chule hunghiti ding ahi, themgaoho chu gaothu aseitengule agaothilmu jeh uva jahcha dingu; mi lheplhahna dinga ponham jong akisil tahloudiu;
target: “On that day every prophet will be ashamed of their prophetic vision. They will not put on a prophet’s garment of hair in order to deceive.

source: Amavang, Keima themgao kahipoi, loubol mi kahi; ajehchu kakhangdon apatna gancha chinje min einahil ahitai, atijoh ding ahi.
target: Each will say, ‘I am not a prophet. I am a farmer; the land has been my livelihood since my youth.’

source: Chule khat touvin, nakhut ho-a maha hohi ipi itiham? atile, aman, kagol ho in'a kona machang kahi, atiding ahi.
target: If someone asks, ‘What are these wounds on your body?’ they will answer, ‘The wounds I was given at the house of my friends.’

source: Vo chemjam, kakelngoi chingpa dounan, kakiloipi pa dounan hung thouvin, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije. Kelngoiho jamchehna dingin, achingpa chu volhun: chule keiman anoute chunga kakhut kalhah ding ahi.
target: “Awake, sword, against my shepherd, against the man who is close to me!” declares the Lord Almighty. “Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered, and I will turn my hand against the little ones.

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, gamsung jouse-a hopthum-a hopni kisumanga thidiu, hopthum-a hopkhat bou kikhen ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: In the whole land,” declares the Lord , “two-thirds will be struck down and perish; yet one-third will be left in it.

source: Chule hopthum na chu meija kahin pui galkai ding, dangka kilhatheng banga kalhahthenga, sana kipatep banga kapatep ding ahi. Amahon kamin kou untin, ken kadonbut ding ahi. Keiman, hichehi kamite ahi, katiding, amahon, Pakai chu ka Pathen ahi, atidiu ahi.
target: This third I will put into the fire; I will refine them like silver and test them like gold. They will call on my name and I will answer them; I will say, ‘They are my people,’ and they will say, ‘The Lord is our God.’ ”

source: Veovin, Pakai nikho chu hunglhung ding ahitai, chule nathil chomdoh chu nalah uva kihomjal ding ahi.
target: A day of the Lord is coming, Jerusalem, when your possessions will be plundered and divided up within your very walls.

source: Ajehchu Jerusalem galla dou dinga kigo nam jouse kakhop ding; khopi chu kila-a, inho chu kichoma, numei ho kisuse ding; khopi kehkhat chu sohchanga potdoh diu, mipi amohho chu khopi-a kona kisumang louding ahiuve.
target: I will gather all the nations to Jerusalem to fight against it; the city will be captured, the houses ransacked, and the women raped. Half of the city will go into exile, but the rest of the people will not be taken from the city.

source: Chutengle Pakai chu potdoh intin, galsat nikho-a gal asat banga, chuche namho douna-a gal asatding ahi.
target: Then the Lord will go out and fight against those nations, as he fights on a day of battle.

source: Chule chuche nikho chule Jerusalem mai solama um Olive molsanga chu akenga hung ding ding, chule Olive molsang chu solam le lhumlama alaitah-a kehlha-a phaicham lentah hungsoh ding; mol kehkhat chu sahlama, chule kehkhat chu lhanglama kichondoh ding ahi.
target: On that day his feet will stand on the Mount of Olives, east of Jerusalem, and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west, forming a great valley, with half of the mountain moving north and half moving south.

source: Chule nangho molsang phaicham lama najam diu ahi; ajehchu molsang Phaicham chun Azal gei aphah ding ahi. Henge, Judah lengpa Uzziah nikho laija inling kihot masanga najam banguva najam diu ahi: chule Pakai ka Pathen chu hungding, chule mitheng jouse chu nangma toh hungdingu ahi.
target: You will flee by my mountain valley, for it will extend to Azel. You will flee as you fled from the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Then the Lord my God will come, and all the holy ones with him.

source: Chule hiche nikho chule hunghiti ding ahi, vah chu thenglou ding, thimjong thimlou ding ahi.
target: On that day there will be neither sunlight nor cold, frosty darkness.

source: Ahinla hichehi Pakai kihetna nikho khat chu hiding, sunjong hilou janjong hilouding ahi: ahinla hunghiti ding ahi, nilhah phatle vah umding ahi.
target: It will be a unique day—a day known only to the Lord —with no distinction between day and night. When evening comes, there will be light.

source: Chule hiche nikho chule hiti ding ahi, Jerusalem'a konin hintwi longdoh ding; akeh khat chu solam twipi lama longa, akeh khat lhumlam twipi lama longding, hichu chuhle khala long ding ahi.
target: On that day living water will flow out from Jerusalem, half of it east to the Dead Sea and half of it west to the Mediterranean Sea, in summer and in winter.

source: Chule leiset pumpi chunga Pakai chu leng chang ding ahi. Hiche nikho chule Pakai khat hintin, amin chu khat hiding ahi.
target: The Lord will be king over the whole earth. On that day there will be one Lord , and his name the only name.

source: Gam jouse Geba'a pat Jerusalem lhanglam Rimmon gei chu phaicham tobang hungsoh ding ahi. Jerusalem chu kidom sanga, Benjamin kotpi-a pat kotpi masagei le kotpi ningchong gei; chule Hananeel insanga pat lengpa lengpitwi chilna geija chenna hiding ahi.
target: The whole land, from Geba to Rimmon, south of Jerusalem, will become like the Arabah. But Jerusalem will be raised up high from the Benjamin Gate to the site of the First Gate, to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the royal winepresses, and will remain in its place.

source: Chule asunga chu miho chenga; avela suhmang hela umkit talou ding, Jerusalem chu bitkeija chenna joh hiding ahitai.
target: It will be inhabited; never again will it be destroyed. Jerusalem will be secure.

source: Chule hichehi Jerusalem douna-a gal hinbol mipi jouse chunga Pakaiyin hise alansah chu hiding ahi; Akenga adin laijule apheu junmang ding, amitko sunguva amitnu junmang ding, chule aleiju akam sunguva junmang ding ahi.
target: This is the plague with which the Lord will strike all the nations that fought against Jerusalem: Their flesh will rot while they are still standing on their feet, their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongues will rot in their mouths.

source: Chule hiche nikho chule hung hitiding ahi, Pakaiya kona thunoh lentah alah uva umding; amaho mitinin aheng akom khut amatna, chule akhut chu aheng akom khut douna alap ding ahi.
target: On that day people will be stricken by the Lord with great panic. They will seize each other by the hand and attack one another.

source: Chule Judah ten jong Jerusalem asatdiu; chule akimveluva Pathen helouho haona sana, dangka, chule ponsil nengtah-a kichom khom ding ahi.
target: Judah too will fight at Jerusalem. The wealth of all the surrounding nations will be collected—great quantities of gold and silver and clothing.

source: Chule chutobang ma chu sakol natna hise, sangan hise, sangongsang hise, sanganchal hise, chule ponbuh ho sunga ganchaho jouse chunga, hitobanga chu natna hise umding ahi.
target: A similar plague will strike the horses and mules, the camels and donkeys, and all the animals in those camps.

source: Chule hung hiti ding ahi, nam jouse Jerusalem doudinga hungho lah-a panglouse chu, kumseh-a lengpa, janel Pakai houdinga cheova, chule houbuh kut mang dinga chejidiu ahi.
target: Then the survivors from all the nations that have attacked Jerusalem will go up year after year to worship the King, the Lord Almighty, and to celebrate the Festival of Tabernacles.

source: Chule hitiding ahi, leiset chunga inko jouse, lengpa Janel Pakai hou dinga Jerusalem'a hungtou lou chan chunga chu go julou ding ahi.
target: If any of the peoples of the earth do not go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord Almighty, they will have no rain.

source: Chule Egypt gam inko achetou lou uva, ahung daoleh, amahon go amu loudingu; houbuh kut mang dinga chetoulou Pathen houlou ho kijepna ding hise chu chang dingu ahi.
target: If the Egyptian people do not go up and take part, they will have no rain. The Lord will bring on them the plague he inflicts on the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Festival of Tabernacles.

source: Hichu Egypt mite engbolnale, houbuh kut manga hunglou nam jouse engbolna hiding ahi.
target: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Festival of Tabernacles.

source: Hiche nikho chule sakol ho ki-o long chunga chu PAKAIYA DINGA ATHENG tia kijih ding; chule Pakai houin sunga bel ho jong maicham angsunga um sumlheng ho tobang hidiu ahi.
target: On that day Holy to the Lord will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, and the cooking pots in the Lord ’s house will be like the sacred bowls in front of the altar.

source: Henge, Jerusalem le Judah gama bel ho jouse chu janel Pakai dinga atheng hiding ahitai. Chule ganlhaina neijouse chun hung laovintin, an hona-a aman diu ahi. Chule hicheni chule janel Pakai in'a chu Canaan mi himhim umtalou ding ahi.
target: Every pot in Jerusalem and Judah will be holy to the Lord Almighty, and all who come to sacrifice will take some of the pots and cook in them. And on that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of the Lord Almighty.

source: Israelte henga Malachi'a kona kiseidoh Pakai thu pohgih.
target: A prophecy: The word of the Lord to Israel through Malachi.

source: Keiman nangho kangailui tin Pakaiyin aseije, ahin nanghon iti neingailut nuham? nati uve. Esau chu Jacob sopi hilouham? tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ahinla keiman Jacob kangailun,
target: “I have loved you,” says the Lord . “But you ask, ‘How have you loved us?’ “Was not Esau Jacob’s brother?” declares the Lord . “Yet I have loved Jacob,

source: Esau vang kahon, amolsangho le agou chanho chu kasusen gamthipma dragonho dingin kakoitai.
target: but Esau I have hated, and I have turned his hill country into a wasteland and left his inheritance to the desert jackals.”

source: Edom chun, keiho suhmangin umjong leuveng, kahung kilekit uva, agemsaho chu kasahphat kit diu ahi ati; ahinla janel Pakai chun hitin ati, amahon saovintin, hijongle keiman kasuhchim ding; mihon amaho chu khangitlouna gamgi, tonsotna Pakai lung hanna miteho atidiu ahi.
target: Edom may say, “Though we have been crushed, we will rebuild the ruins.” But this is what the Lord Almighty says: “They may build, but I will demolish. They will be called the Wicked Land, a people always under the wrath of the Lord .

source: Chule namit tah-un mu uvin natin, Israel gamgi-a kona Pakai chu choi-atna umding ahi, natidiu ahi.
target: You will see it with your own eyes and say, ‘Great is the Lord —even beyond the borders of Israel!’

source: Chapan apa ajaboljin, chule soh-in a pakai ajaboljin ahi. Chutia chu keijong pa kahia ahile, eiki jabolna hoiba ham? Chule Pakai kahile eikiginna hoibaham? tin Janel Pakaiyin nangho jah-a aseije, Vo kamin nahsahlou thempuho. Ahinla nanghon hoija chu kanahsah mouvem? nati uve.
target: “A son honors his father, and a slave his master. If I am a father, where is the honor due me? If I am a master, where is the respect due me?” says the Lord Almighty. “It is you priests who show contempt for my name. “But you ask, ‘How have we shown contempt for your name?’

source: Ka-maicham chunga changlhah thenglou natoh-un, ahinla nanghon, hoilaija nangma kasuhboh uvem? nati uve. Pakai dokhang chu nahsahmo-a bolthei ahi tia nasei naova chu nasuh boh-u ahi.
target: “By offering defiled food on my altar. “But you ask, ‘How have we defiled you?’ “By saying that the Lord ’s table is contemptible.

source: Nanghon ganlhaina dinga amitcho natoule, hichu ase hilouham? chule nanghon a-elbai le adamlou natoule, hichu ase hilou ham? tun nagam vaipopao chu hichu gapeuvin, nachunga alung lhaidem, ahiloule nangma nanasang nadem? tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: When you offer blind animals for sacrifice, is that not wrong? When you sacrifice lame or diseased animals, is that not wrong? Try offering them to your governor! Would he be pleased with you? Would he accept you?” says the Lord Almighty.

source: Eilungset theina diuvin, tun Pathen henga taovun tia kangeh nahiuve. Hichehi nangho themo ahin, aman nangma nana khohsah nadem? tin janelho Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Now plead with God to be gracious to us. With such offerings from your hands, will he accept you?”—says the Lord Almighty.

source: Ka maichama moh jenseh-a mei natilou nadinguva, nangho lah ngeija moh jenseh-a kot khah ding koi nahiuvem? Nangho-a lunglhaina kaneipon, nakhut uva nathil peh-u jong laponge tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Oh, that one of you would shut the temple doors, so that you would not light useless fires on my altar! I am not pleased with you,” says the Lord Almighty, “and I will accept no offering from your hands.

source: Ajehchu nisa sona-a kipatna alhumna changeija, chidang namdangte lah-a kamin kithang ding ahin, amun tina gimnamtui le thilpeh theng kamina kitoh ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile Pathen heloute lah-a kamin kithang ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: My name will be great among the nations, from where the sun rises to where it sets. In every place incense and pure offerings will be brought to me, because my name will be great among the nations,” says the Lord Almighty.

source: Ahin nanghon hichu nasuboh-un, hia chun nanghon, Pakai dokhang chu suhboh ahitai; chukoma aga hole asaho sanin nahsahmon aumtai, tin naseijuve.
target: “But you profane it by saying, ‘The Lord’s table is defiled,’ and, ‘Its food is contemptible.’

source: Chujongle nanghon, veuvin, iti ningkitel um hitam! nati uvin, nanah nakhon khumuve, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije; chule nanghon akibot telsa, elbai, chule adamlou chu thilto dingin nahin choijiuve; hichehi nakhut uva kona kasan dingham? tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: And you say, ‘What a burden!’ and you sniff at it contemptuously,” says the Lord Almighty. “When you bring injured, lame or diseased animals and offer them as sacrifices, should I accept them from your hands?” says the Lord .

source: Ahinla aganhon lah-a achal umjena, chule kihahsela, Pakaiya dinga nol-um toh-a chu gaosap changhen! ajehchu keima leng lentah kahin, chule kaminhi Pathen helouho lah-a kichat umtah ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Cursed is the cheat who has an acceptable male in his flock and vows to give it, but then sacrifices a blemished animal to the Lord. For I am a great king,” says the Lord Almighty, “and my name is to be feared among the nations.

source: Chule tun, vo thempuho, hiche thupeh hi nangho ding ahi.
target: “And now, you priests, this warning is for you.

source: Hichehi nangai lou uva, kamin loupi sahna dinga, nalunga nachin louvule, Janel Pakaiyin aseije, nachung uva gaosapna kahin solding, naphatthei nahou chu kagaosap ding ahi. Nanghon nalunguva nachinlou jeh uva, amaho chu kagaosap sajong ahitai.
target: If you do not listen, and if you do not resolve to honor my name,” says the Lord Almighty, “I will send a curse on you, and I will curse your blessings. Yes, I have already cursed them, because you have not resolved to honor me.

source: Veuvin, keiman nachilhah-u kasuhboh-a, namai uva eh kanu ding, na kut loupi houva eh ngeijong chu kanu diu; chule khatnin hiche puma chu napuimang diu ahi.
target: “Because of you I will rebuke your descendants; I will smear on your faces the dung from your festival sacrifices, and you will be carried off with it.
