source: Kakitepna Levi mite henga aumjing theina dinga, hiche thupeh hi naheng uva kahinsol ahi ti nahetdiu ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: And you will know that I have sent you this warning so that my covenant with Levi may continue,” says the Lord Almighty.

source: Kakitepna hinna le chamna chu amatoh anaumin; aman eigin theina dingin hicheho chu ama kapen, chule kamin masanga akichan ahi.
target: “My covenant was with him, a covenant of life and peace, and I gave them to him; this called for reverence and he revered me and stood in awe of my name.

source: Thutah danthu chu akama aumin, amuh-a khangitlouna akimupoi. Lung mongtah le lungdih tah-in keima toh alhon khomin, mi tamtah akhan gitlou naova konin aleheije.
target: True instruction was in his mouth and nothing false was found on his lips. He walked with me in peace and uprightness, and turned many from sin.

source: Ijeh inem itile thempu muh chun hetna achintup ding, akama danthu aholding dol ahi. Ajehchu ama janel Pakai thupole ahi.
target: “For the lips of a priest ought to preserve knowledge, because he is the messenger of the Lord Almighty and people seek instruction from his mouth.

source: Ahivangin nangho lampia konin nakihei doh-un; mi tamtah dan thua nakipal lhuh sah-un, Levi toh kitepna chu nasuboh uve, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: But you have turned from the way and by your teaching have caused many to stumble; you have violated the covenant with Levi,” says the Lord Almighty.

source: Hijeh-a chu nanghon kalampi najotlou dungjuiju le dan thua nalangneiju dungjuija, keiman jong nangho mi jouse anga nahsah mole noise umtah-a kasemu nahi.
target: “So I have caused you to be despised and humiliated before all the people, because you have not followed my ways but have shown partiality in matters of the law.”

source: Ibonuva Pa khatbou ineiju hilou ham? Pathen khatnin eisem cheh-u hilouham? Ipi dinga ami takipmin asopi kitahlou tah-a iboluva, ipu ipateu kitepna isuhboh-u ham?
target: Do we not all have one Father? Did not one God create us? Why do we profane the covenant of our ancestors by being unfaithful to one another?

source: Judah'in kitahlouna ana mangin, Israel le Jerusalem'a thet umtah ana kibole; ajehchu Judah'in Pakaiyin angailut athen nachu asuboh-in, hetkhahlou pathen chanu ana kichenpin ahi.
target: Judah has been unfaithful. A detestable thing has been committed in Israel and in Jerusalem: Judah has desecrated the sanctuary the Lord loves by marrying women who worship a foreign god.

source: Hitobang bolpa chu, mihilpa chule ajilpa hihen, janel Pakai henga thilto boljipa hijongle, Jacob houbuh-a kona Pakaiyin asatlhah ding ahi.
target: As for the man who does this, whoever he may be, may the Lord remove him from the tents of Jacob—even though he brings an offering to the Lord Almighty.

source: Chule hiche jonghi nabolkit uve: Pakai maicham chu mitlhiho chule kana le pen na-in nakhu khum taovin, hijeh-a chu thilto chu aman ima agel da-a, nakhut uva chu kipah tah-a asanlou ahi.
target: Another thing you do: You flood the Lord ’s altar with tears. You weep and wail because he no longer looks with favor on your offerings or accepts them with pleasure from your hands.

source: Ahinla nanghon ipijeh inem? nati uve. Ajehchu Pakai chu kitah loutah-a nabol, nakhangdon laija na-inneipi le nangma kikah-a ahetoh ahijeh ahi. Hijongle ama chu nakiloipi, chule kitepna-a na-inneipi hija ahi.
target: You ask, “Why?” It is because the Lord is the witness between you and the wife of your youth. You have been unfaithful to her, though she is your partner, the wife of your marriage covenant.

source: Chule Lhagao chu achunga aumsah-a, Aman amani chu khatna anasem hilouham? Ipijeh-a khat hijaham? Pathen ngaisah ding chilhah aholna ahi. Hijeh-a chu asenji chunga koimacha kitahlou tah-a aumlouna dingin, nalhagaovin ching theijun.
target: Has not the one God made you? You belong to him in body and spirit. And what does the one God seek? Godly offspring. So be on your guard, and do not be unfaithful to the wife of your youth.

source: Ajehchu Pakai, Israelte Pathen'in kida kaho-e tin aseije; ajehchu mihem khatnin aponsilin pumhat akhukhumin ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije. Hijeh chun kitahlou tah-a nachon louna diuvin, nalhagaovin chingthei jun.
target: “The man who hates and divorces his wife,” says the Lord , the God of Israel, “does violence to the one he should protect,” says the Lord Almighty. So be on your guard, and do not be unfaithful.

source: Nanghon nathuseijun Pakai chu nathachol sah uvin ahi. Hinla hoija kathachol sah-um? nati uve; nanghon, thilse bolchan chu Pakai mitmu-a apha ahin, ama hiche ho-a chun akipah jie nati uva, ahiloule thutan Pathen chu hoija umam? nati tengule nathachol sah-u ahi.
target: You have wearied the Lord with your words. “How have we wearied him?” you ask. By saying, “All who do evil are good in the eyes of the Lord , and he is pleased with them” or “Where is the God of justice?”

source: Veovin, keiman kasottol soling ting, aman kamasanga kalampi asem ding; nanghon naholu Pakai, achunga nakipanao kitepna thupole pa ngei chu, photlot louva a-houin'a hung ding ahi. Veovin, hungding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “I will send my messenger, who will prepare the way before me. Then suddenly the Lord you are seeking will come to his temple; the messenger of the covenant, whom you desire, will come,” says the Lord Almighty.

source: Ahivangin ahung ni chu koiham athohjou ding, ahungkilah teng koiham adingthei dinga? ama chu suhthengna meile sopthengna savon tobang ahi.
target: But who can endure the day of his coming? Who can stand when he appears? For he will be like a refiner’s fire or a launderer’s soap.

source: Ama dangka lhahtheng le suthengpa banga touding; Levi chate chun chonphatna-a Pakai henga thilto atotheina diuva asuhthenga, sana dangka banga alhahtheng dingu ahi.
target: He will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver; he will purify the Levites and refine them like gold and silver. Then the Lord will have men who will bring offerings in righteousness,

source: Chuteng khangluilai le kum masaho banga, Judah le Jerusalem ganlhaina chu Pakai dinga lunglhaina hikit ding ahitai.
target: and the offerings of Judah and Jerusalem will be acceptable to the Lord , as in days gone by, as in former years.

source: Chule keiman thutan dinga naheng kahin naiding: doichoiho, jon panho, jouva kihahsel ho, sum thalo ho le meithaiho chule pabeiho bolgimho, maljinho kiheimang khumho, chule keima eiging louho douna-a hettohsah gangtah kahi ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “So I will come to put you on trial. I will be quick to testify against sorcerers, adulterers and perjurers, against those who defraud laborers of their wages, who oppress the widows and the fatherless, and deprive the foreigners among you of justice, but do not fear me,” says the Lord Almighty.

source: Ajehchu keima kikhel lou Pathen kahin; vo Jacob chateho, hijeh-a chu nangho suhmanga umlou nahiuve.
target: “I the Lord do not change. So you, the descendants of Jacob, are not destroyed.

source: Napu napateu nikholaija patnin kahoudan thupeh ho-a konin nache mangun, hicheho chu nitjong nanitpouvin ahi, kahenga hung kileovin, keima jong naheng uva hungkilenge, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije. Ahinla nanghon iti kahungkile diuham? nati uve.
target: Ever since the time of your ancestors you have turned away from my decrees and have not kept them. Return to me, and I will return to you,” says the Lord Almighty. “But you ask, ‘How are we to return?’

source: Mihem'in Pathen achom ngaijem? Ahin nanghon keima neichom uve. Ahinla nanghon hoija nang kachomun? nati uve. Hopsom le thilto-a neichomun ahi.
target: “Will a mere mortal rob God? Yet you rob me. “But you ask, ‘How are we robbing you?’ “In tithes and offerings.

source: Nanghon neichom jeh-u leh, hiche nam pumpi jeng jonghin eichom jeh uva, gaosapna-a gaosap chang nahitaove.
target: You are under a curse—your whole nation—because you are robbing me.

source: Ka-in'a nehle chah aumna dingin, hopsom jouse thilkholna insung hinlhutnun, van kot ho kahona asunga akoina ding indan aumlou geija phattheina kahin buhlhah hih-em, tun hiche-a hin neipatep untin, janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house. Test me in this,” says the Lord Almighty, “and see if I will not throw open the floodgates of heaven and pour out so much blessing that there will not be room enough to store it.

source: Chule nangho khohsahna jala bahgampa chu kaphosal ding, aman naleisetna gahou chu asuhmang tahlou ding; loulaija lengpiga injong aphat masanga aga apulsah louding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: I will prevent pests from devouring your crops, and the vines in your fields will not drop their fruit before it is ripe,” says the Lord Almighty.

source: Chule nangma kipa umtah gam nahitah ding jeh-a, nam jousen anunnom nati diu ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Then all the nations will call you blessed, for yours will be a delightful land,” says the Lord Almighty.

source: Nathu houchu kachunga akhouthei lheh-e, tin Pakaiyin aseije. Ahin nanghon nangma douna-a chutiloma ipi kaseibeh uvem? nati uvin ahi.
target: “You have spoken arrogantly against me,” says the Lord . “Yet you ask, ‘What have we said against you?’

source: Nanghon, Pathen kinbol hi pannabei ahi: eihon ahoudan thupeh initnuva, chule lunghem tah-a janel Pakai anga ivaleova ipi phachomam? nati uve.
target: “You have said, ‘It is futile to serve God. What do we gain by carrying out his requirements and going about like mourners before the Lord Almighty?

source: Chule tun nanghon mikiletsah ho chu akipah-e natiuvin; henge, khangilou tah-a lamlha ho chu choisangin aumin; Pathen lhem patep ho jengjong ahoidoh-un ahi.
target: But now we call the arrogant blessed. Certainly evildoers prosper, and even when they put God to the test, they get away with it.’ ”

source: Chuin Pakai gingho chu khatle khat akihouvun; Pakaiyin angaijin ajatan; Pakai ginga, amin geldoh jingho dingin, a-angsunga geldoh jingna lekhabu khat akisunin ahi.
target: Then those who feared the Lord talked with each other, and the Lord listened and heard. A scroll of remembrance was written in his presence concerning those who feared the Lord and honored his name.

source: Kasongmantam ho kasemdoh nikho leh, amaho keima-a hidiu ahi tin janel Pakaiyin aseije; chuteng mipa khatnin alhacha-a pang achapa akhendoh banga, keiman jong amaho chu kakhendoh ding ahi.
target: “On the day when I act,” says the Lord Almighty, “they will be my treasured possession. I will spare them, just as a father has compassion and spares his son who serves him.

source: Chutengleh hungkile heijun natin, michonpha le mikhangilou nahet khendiu, Pathen jen le ajenlouho nahekhen diu ahitai.
target: And you will again see the distinction between the righteous and the wicked, between those who serve God and those who do not.

source: Ajehchu, veuvin, meilhumpi banga kading nikho chu ahung lhunge; chule mi hoitho jouse le thilse bol ho jouse kipallhudiu ahi; hiche nikho hunglhung ding chun amaho akahvam heldiu, hichun ajungjong abah jong akhenlou ding ahi, tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: “Surely the day is coming; it will burn like a furnace. All the arrogant and every evildoer will be stubble, and the day that is coming will set them on fire,” says the Lord Almighty. “Not a root or a branch will be left to them.

source: Ahinla kamin ginga nangho din vang chonphatna nisa chu alhaving teni-a damna puma hungsoh ding; chule nangho bongkula bongnou kivah ho banga napotdoh uva, nakhandoh diu ahi.
target: But for you who revere my name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its rays. And you will go out and frolic like well-fed calves.

source: Hiche kabol ding nikho chule, mikhangilou ho chu nachot phaova, amaho chu nakengto noijuva leivui hidiu, ahi tin janel Pakaiyin aseije.
target: Then you will trample on the wicked; they will be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day when I act,” says the Lord Almighty.

source: Kasohpa Mosi dan, Horeb mun'a Israel mite jouse dinga ahenga kathupeh, dan kisunho le thutanna chu geldoh jingun.
target: “Remember the law of my servant Moses, the decrees and laws I gave him at Horeb for all Israel.

source: Veovin, Pakai nikho loupi le kichat umtah ahunglhun masanga Elijah themgao kahin solpeh ding nahiuve.
target: “See, I will send the prophet Elijah to you before that great and dreadful day of the Lord comes.

source: Ama chun pate lungsung chate lama, chate lungsung pate lama alehei ding ahi, achuti loule keima hungin ting leiset hi gaosap na-a kajep ding ahi.
target: He will turn the hearts of the parents to their children, and the hearts of the children to their parents; or else I will come and strike the land with total destruction.”

source: Abraham chapa, David chapa, Jesu Christa khangui thubu.
target: This is the genealogy of Jesus the Messiah the son of David, the son of Abraham:

source: Abraham'in Isaac ahingin; Isaac'in Jacob ahingin; Jacob'in Juda le asopiteho ahingin;
target: Abraham was the father of Isaac, Isaac the father of Jacob, Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers,

source: Juda'in Tamar toh Pharez le Zera ahingin; Pharez'in Esrom ahingin; Esrom'in Aram ahingin;
target: Judah the father of Perez and Zerah, whose mother was Tamar, Perez the father of Hezron, Hezron the father of Ram,

source: Aram'in Aminadab ahingin; Aminadab'in Nahson ahingin; Nahson'in Salmon ahingin;
target: Ram the father of Amminadab, Amminadab the father of Nahshon, Nahshon the father of Salmon,

source: Salmon'in Rahab toh Boaz ahingin; Boaz'in Ruth toh Obed ahingin; Obed chun Jesse ahingin;
target: Salmon the father of Boaz, whose mother was Rahab, Boaz the father of Obed, whose mother was Ruth, Obed the father of Jesse,

source: Jesse'in David lengpa ahingin ahi.
target: and Jesse the father of King David. David was the father of Solomon, whose mother had been Uriah’s wife,

source: Chuin David'in Uriah inneipi toh Solomon ahingin; Solomon'in Rehoboam ahingin; Rehoboam'in Abijah ahingin; Abijah'in Asa ahingin;
target: Solomon the father of Rehoboam, Rehoboam the father of Abijah, Abijah the father of Asa,

source: Asa'in Josaphat ahingin; Josaphat'in Joram ahingin; Joram'in Uzziah ahingin;
target: Asa the father of Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat the father of Jehoram, Jehoram the father of Uzziah,

source: Uzziah'n Jotham ahingin; Jotham'in Ahaz ahingin; Ahaz'in Hezekiah ahingin;
target: Uzziah the father of Jotham, Jotham the father of Ahaz, Ahaz the father of Hezekiah,

source: Hezekiah'in Manasseh ahingin; Manasseh'in Amon ahingin; Amon'in Josiah ahingin;
target: Hezekiah the father of Manasseh, Manasseh the father of Amon, Amon the father of Josiah,

source: Josiah'in Jechoniah le asopiho Babylon gama atolmang laijun ahingin ahi.
target: and Josiah the father of Jeconiah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

source: Chuin Babylon'a atolmang nungun, Jekoniah'in Shealtiel ahingin; Shealtiel'in Zerubbabel ahingin;
target: After the exile to Babylon: Jeconiah was the father of Shealtiel, Shealtiel the father of Zerubbabel,

source: Zerubbabel'in Abiud ahingin; Abiud'in Eliakim ahingin; Eliakim'in Azor ahingin;
target: Zerubbabel the father of Abihud, Abihud the father of Eliakim, Eliakim the father of Azor,

source: Azor'in Sadoc ahingin; Sadoc'in Akim ahingin; Akim'in Elihud ahingin;
target: Azor the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Akim, Akim the father of Elihud,

source: Elihud'in Eleazer ahingin; Eleazer'in Mathan ahingin; Mathan'in Jacob ahingin;
target: Elihud the father of Eleazar, Eleazar the father of Matthan, Matthan the father of Jacob,

source: Chuin, Jacob'in Joseph ahingin, ama chu Christa kiti Jesu penna nu Mariam inneipu ahi.
target: and Jacob the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, and Mary was the mother of Jesus who is called the Messiah.

source: Hitichun khang agomin Abraham'a pat David geijin khang somle khang li ahin, David'a pat Babylon gama atolmang geijin khang somle khang li, chule Babylon gama atolmanguva pat Christa pen gei khang somle khang li ahi.
target: Thus there were fourteen generations in all from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the exile to Babylon, and fourteen from the exile to the Messiah.

source: Jesu Christa pen umchan chu hiti ahi. Anu Mariam chu Joseph'in aji dinga ahol ahin, akigop masang lhonin amanu chu Lhagao Thenga kona agai akihedohtan ahi.
target: This is how the birth of Jesus the Messiah came about: His mother Mary was pledged to be married to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be pregnant through the Holy Spirit.

source: Ahivangin a-inneipu Joseph chu michonpha tah ahi jeh-in, lhang phonga japi seithangin aumsah nom hih-in, guhthima kikhenpi ding lung angai totan ahi.
target: Because Joseph her husband was faithful to the law, and yet did not want to expose her to public disgrace, he had in mind to divorce her quietly.

source: Aman lung achuti ngaito laitah-in, veuvin, Pakai vantil khatnin amangin akimusah-in, ajah-a, David chapa Joseph, na-inneipi Mariam gakipuilut ding olmo hih-in; ijeh-inem itile ama Lhagao Thenga kona gaija ahi.
target: But after he had considered this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary home as your wife, because what is conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.

source: Amanu soh intin chapa khat ahin ding ahi, chule amin Jesu nasah ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile amatah chun amite achonsetnuva kona ahuhhing ding ahi.
target: She will give birth to a son, and you are to give him the name Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.”

source: Pakaiyin Themgao kama asei thu,
target: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had said through the prophet:

source: Veuvin, nungah theng chu hung gaijintin, chapa khat ahin ding ahi, Chule amin Immanuel asah ding ahi, ati, (Hichu Pathen'in eiumpiuve tina ahi) tia asei chu guilhuna dinga thu hicheng chu soh-a ahi.
target: “The virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and they will call him Immanuel” (which means “God with us”).

source: Chuin Joseph a-imut akhangin, akipat in Pakai vantil'in thu apeh bang chun abolin, a-inneipi chu akichenpin ahi;
target: When Joseph woke up, he did what the angel of the Lord had commanded him and took Mary home as his wife.

source: Ahivangin amanun chapa peng masapen anei kahsen kitohkhahpi louhelin aumin; chuin acha chu amin Jesu asahtai.
target: But he did not consummate their marriage until she gave birth to a son. And he gave him the name Jesus.

source: Herod lengpa lal laijin Judah gama Bethlehem khopi-ah Jesu apengtan ahile, veuvin, niso lama konin ahsi lekhathem ho phabep Jerusalem'a ahungun, Judah te lengpa apengin ahi, ama chu hoilamham?
target: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the time of King Herod, Magi from the east came to Jerusalem

source: Keihon niso lamah ahsi kamuvin, chibai bola hung kahiuve, atiuvin ahi.
target: and asked, “Where is the one who has been born king of the Jews? We saw his star when it rose and have come to worship him.”

source: Herod lengpan chuche thu ajah phatnin, amati Jerusalem miteti alungu ajingtan ahi.
target: When King Herod heard this he was disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.

source: Chuphatnin thempu pipuiho leh miho danthu sunho chu akhomin, Christa hoija peng dingham, tin adongin ahi.
target: When he had called together all the people’s chief priests and teachers of the law, he asked them where the Messiah was to be born.

source: Amahon ajah-a, Judah gam Bethlehem'a peng ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile,
target: “In Bethlehem in Judea,” they replied, “for this is what the prophet has written:

source: Vo Judah gama um Bethlehem, Judah vaipote lah-a nangma iti nama jongle aneopen nahipoi; Ijeh-inem itile nalah-a kona vaipo khat, Kamite Israelte ching ding chu pengdoh ding ahi; tin themgao seija konin akisune, atiuvin ahi.
target: “ ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah; for out of you will come a ruler who will shepherd my people Israel.’”

source: Chuin Herod in ahsi lekhathem ho chu guhthimin akouvin, ahsi so phat chu kichentah-in ahetoh tan ahi.
target: Then Herod called the Magi secretly and found out from them the exact time the star had appeared.

source: Chuin amaho chu Bethlehem'a asolin, Cheovinlang naosen chungchang thudol chu chentah-in gadongtoh uvin; chule namudoh tengule keima jong kache-a chibai kagaboh theina dingin thu hinpo kit uvin, ati.
target: He sent them to Bethlehem and said, “Go and search carefully for the child. As soon as you find him, report to me, so that I too may go and worship him.”

source: Lengpa thu ajah phatnun amaho akipatdoh taovin ahi; chule, veuvin, niso lama amu-u ahsi chu amasanguva achepeh-in, naosen umna chunga chun akingan ahi.
target: After they had heard the king, they went on their way, and the star they had seen when it rose went ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.

source: Ahsi chu amu phat uvin athao anomin, hapan akipah-un ahi.
target: When they saw the star, they were overjoyed.

source: Chuin amaho in sunga alutnun ahile naosen chu anu Mariam toh amu thaovin, aboh khupmun ama chu ahou taovin ahi; chuin athil lu bom cheh-u asolhaovin, kipamanin, sana, bego, myrrh ama chu apetaovin ahi.
target: On coming to the house, they saw the child with his mother Mary, and they bowed down and worshiped him. Then they opened their treasures and presented him with gifts of gold, frankincense and myrrh.

source: Chujouvin amanguva Herod heng lama akile kit louna dinguva Pathen'in ahilchah jeh uvin, lam chom ahovin agam lamuva achemang taovin ahi.
target: And having been warned in a dream not to go back to Herod, they returned to their country by another route.

source: Chuin amaho chedoh nungin, veuvin, Joseph amangin Pakai vantil khatnin, Thouvin, naosen leh anu puijin lang Egypt gama jam lutpitan, chule thu kapeh kahsen chua chun um jingin; ijeh-inem itile Herod'in naosen chu suhmang dinga ahol ding ahi, ati.
target: When they had gone, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream. “Get up,” he said, “take the child and his mother and escape to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod is going to search for the child to kill him.”

source: Chuin ama athoudoh-in, jan-in naosen leh anu akipuijin, Egypt gam ajontan ahi.
target: So he got up, took the child and his mother during the night and left for Egypt,

source: Chule Herod thi kahsen hia chun aumin ahi: Pakaiyin themgao kama asei, Egypt gama konin ka-Chapa kakouve, ati chu guilhuna dinga chuti ahi.
target: where he stayed until the death of Herod. And so was fulfilled what the Lord had said through the prophet: “Out of Egypt I called my son.”

source: Chuin ahsi lekhathem hon alhim lhah-u ahi akihetdoh phatnin, Herod alunghang behseh-in, mi asolin, ahsi lekhathem ho-a kona aphat ahetchen dungjui chun, Bethlehem le akimvel sese-a pasal chapang kum ni-a lhah noilamse athattan ahi.
target: When Herod realized that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was furious, and he gave orders to kill all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under, in accordance with the time he had learned from the Magi.

source: Hichun themgao Jeremiah thusei,
target: Then what was said through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled:

source: Ramah-a akaple amao aw akijai; Rachel'in achate aka akan, Aum lou jeh uvin lhepbi ding anomtapon ahi; ati chu guilhunga ahitai.
target: “A voice is heard in Ramah, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.”

source: Ahivangin Herod athi phatnin, veuvin, Pakai vantil khatnin Egypt gamah Joseph mangin akimusah-in,
target: After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt

source: Thouvin lang naosen leh anu kipuijin, Israel gam lama chetan; naosen tha dinga goteho chu athitaove, ati.
target: and said, “Get up, take the child and his mother and go to the land of Israel, for those who were trying to take the child’s life are dead.”

source: Chuin ama kipatdoh-in, naosen leh anu akipuijin, Israel gam lama ahung kit tai.
target: So he got up, took the child and his mother and went to the land of Israel.

source: Ahivangin Judah gamah Archelaus apa Herod khelin vai apoi ti ajah phatnin, chulama ache ngamta hih-in; amanga akihilchah jeh-in, akipatnin Galilee gamah akileheitai.
target: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning in Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. Having been warned in a dream, he withdrew to the district of Galilee,

source: Chule ama chu Nazareth mi kiti ding ahi, tia themgao hon asei chu guilhun theinan, achen Nazareth khopi-ah achengtan ahi.
target: and he went and lived in a town called Nazareth. So was fulfilled what was said through the prophets, that he would be called a Nazarene.

source: Chulai chun John Baptist chu ahungin,
target: In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea

source: Nalung heijun; van lenggam anaitai, tin Judah gam gamthipmah thu alhang samlen ahi.
target: and saying, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near.”

source: Isaiah themgaovin, Gamthipma khosam aw khatnin, Pakai lamlen semtohsan koijun, Alampi semjangun, tin aseije, tia asei chu ama hi ahi.
target: This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.’ ”

source: John chu apon-ah sangongsang mul ahin, akongah savun konggah akigah-in, chule a-anneh chu khaokho le gam khoiju ahi.
target: John’s clothes were made of camel’s hair, and he had a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

source: Chuphatnin Jerusalem le Judah gam jouse-a mi, chule Jordan vel gamkol sung jouse-a mi ahenga ache acheuvin,
target: People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea and the whole region of the Jordan.

source: Achonsetnao cheh aphongun, Jordan luidunga chun ama khutna baptize achang taovin ahi.
target: Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.

source: Ahin Pharisaiho le Saddukai ho mi tamtah ama khutna baptize chang dinga ahungu amun phatnin, ajah uva, Vo gulse sonho, Khonunga lunghanna hung lhung dinga kona jamna ding lungthim koiham napeuva?
target: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to where he was baptizing, he said to them: “You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?

source: Hijeh chun lunghei toh kilomin gadoh-un;
target: Produce fruit in keeping with repentance.

source: Chule nalah uva, Abraham kapului'u aumnai, tin ngaito hih-un; ijeh-inem itile tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, hiche songho-a kona hi Pathen'in Abraham chate asodohsah thei ahi.
target: And do not think you can say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.

source: Chule tu jenga jong thing bultina heicha kikoija ahitai. Chutiachu thingphung aga phalou chengse chu kiphuh lhu-a, meija kisep lutji ahi.
target: The ax is already at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.

source: Lungheina dinga keiman twija baptize kachansah bou ahi; amavang kanunga hungpa keima sanga chungnungjo ahi; keima akengchot choi dinga jong kilom kahipoi. Amatah chun nangho Lhagao Theng le meija baptize nachansah dingu ahi.
target: “I baptize you with water for repentance. But after me comes one who is more powerful than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.

source: Aman akhutna godal achoije; aman aphol jap ngimsel intin, achang apang sunga akhum ding; asi vang chu mit theilou meija agovam ding ahi, ati.
target: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will clear his threshing floor, gathering his wheat into the barn and burning up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

source: Hiche pet chun Jesu John khutna baptize chang dingin, Galilee'a konin John hengah Jordan lamah ahungin ahi.
target: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.

source: Ahivangin John anathuphan, Nangma khutna kachan ding johsih-a, nangma kahenga hung nahim? ati.
target: But John tried to deter him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and do you come to me?”

source: Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, Tun hisah poupoutan; ijeh-inem itile chonphatna jouse abancha hitia hi ibulhit dingdol ahi, ati.
target: Jesus replied, “Let it be so now; it is proper for us to do this to fulfill all righteousness.” Then John consented.

source: Chuin Jesu baptize achan jouvin, twilah-a konin apotdoh paitan ahi; chuin, veuvin, ama dingin van kot akihongin, chule Pathen Lhagao vakhu banga ahung lenlhah-a achunga ahungchuh amun;
target: As soon as Jesus was baptized, he went up out of the water. At that moment heaven was opened, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and alighting on him.

source: chuin, Ama hi ka-Chapa deitah ahi, achunga kalung alhai tangeije, tin van'a konin aw ahung gingin ahi.
target: And a voice from heaven said, “This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased.”

source: Hichun Jesu diabol lhep patepma umdingin gamthipmah Lhagao puitouvin aumtan ahi.
target: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

source: Chuin nisomli le jansomli an ngola aum jouvin, agil keltan ahi.
target: After fasting forty days and forty nights, he was hungry.

source: Chuin alhempa chu ahenga ahungin, ajah-a, Nangma Pathen Chapa nahile, hiche songho hi changlhah asona dingin thu pen, ati.
target: The tempter came to him and said, “If you are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.”

source: Ahin aman adonbut-in, Mihem changlhah jenga hing lou ding ahi, Pathen kam sunga kona thu pot chengsea bou hing ding ahi, hitichun akisune, ati.
target: Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’”

source: Chuphatnin diabol'in ama chu khopi theng lama apuijin, Pathen houin tingvuma chun adinsah-in, ajah-a,
target: Then the devil took him to the holy city and had him stand on the highest point of the temple.

source: Pathen Chapa nahile, nangma kichomlha jengin; ijeh-inem itile hitihin akisune, Aman nangma chung changah avantilho thu pentin, Amahon akhutnuva nadop dingu ahi; Achuti louleh songah nakeng sukhan nate, ati.
target: “If you are the Son of God,” he said, “throw yourself down. For it is written: “ ‘He will command his angels concerning you, and they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.’”

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, Hiti jonghin akisune, Nangman Pakai na-Pathen lhem patep hih-in, ati.
target: Jesus answered him, “It is also written: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”

source: Diabol'in ama mol sangtah chunga apuikitnin, vannoi leiset gamle aloupina jouse jong avetsah-in; chuin ajah-a,
target: Again, the devil took him to a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their splendor.

source: Nakhupboh-a nalhuh-a neihouva ahile, hichengse hi penge, ati.
target: “All this I will give you,” he said, “if you will bow down and worship me.”

source: Chutah-in Jesu'n ajah-a, Chemangin, Satan; ijeh-inem itile hitin akisune, Pakai na-Pathen chu houvin lang ama jengbou jenin, ati.
target: Jesus said to him, “Away from me, Satan! For it is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God, and serve him only.’”

source: Chuphatnin diabol in ama adalhatai; chuin, veuvin, vantil ho ahungun ama chu ahung jenle taovin ahi.
target: Then the devil left him, and angels came and attended him.

source: Chuin Jesu'n John amantaove ti ajah phatnin, Galilee gam lama achen;
target: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he withdrew to Galilee.

source: Chuin Nazareth adalhan, Zebulun le Naphtali gamkai sunga dillen panga, Capernaum kho-a achen agachengin ahi;
target: Leaving Nazareth, he went and lived in Capernaum, which was by the lake in the area of Zebulun and Naphtali—

source: Isaiah themgaovin asei,
target: to fulfill what was said through the prophet Isaiah:

source: Zebulun gam le Naphtali gam, Jordan gal lang khat gamkol dillen panga cheng, Chidang namdangte Galilee;
target: “Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles—

source: Muthim lah-a touho chun vah loupitah amutaove, Chule thina gamle alima touho chunguva kho avahtai, ati chu guilhuna dinga chuti ahitai.
target: the people living in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death a light has dawned.”

source: Hiche laija pat chun Jesu'n thu ahil lhanglen, Nalung heijun; vangam anaitai, ati.
target: From that time on Jesus began to preach, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near.”

source: Chujouvin Jesu Galilee dillen panga avale petnin, Peter kiti Simon le anaopa Andrew dillena len ase lhon amun; amani chu nga man mi ahi lhone.
target: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon called Peter and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the lake, for they were fishermen.

source: Chuin aman amani jah-a, kanung hinjui lhonin, keiman nangni mi man len sepmin sem lhoninge, ati.
target: “Come, follow me,” Jesus said, “and I will send you out to fish for people.”

source: Chuin amanin apet petnin alen adalha lhonin, anung ajui lhontai.
target: At once they left their nets and followed him.

source: Chuin ama chukoma konchun achepaijin ahile, midang ucha nima, Zebedee chapa Jacob le anaopa John apau Zebedee toh kong sunga alennu anakhui phatnu amun; amanima chu akouvin ahi.
target: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat with their father Zebedee, preparing their nets. Jesus called them,

source: Chuin amanin apet petnin akongle apalhon adalha lhonin, anung ajui lhontai.
target: and immediately they left the boat and their father and followed him.

source: Chuin Jesu Galilee gamse se-a avahle avahlen, akikhopnao in tinah thu ahillen, Pathen lenggam Kipana Thupha ahil lhanglen, miho ahivei jouseu chule adamlou jouse adamsahtan ahi.
target: Jesus went throughout Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, proclaiming the good news of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people.

source: Hichun Syria gama amin akithangin; thilhavop, abuhthi, langthi, ima hivei chomchom veija anat thohlel jouse ahenga ahinpuijun, aman amaho chu aboldam sohkeijin ahi.
target: News about him spread all over Syria, and people brought to him all who were ill with various diseases, those suffering severe pain, the demon-possessed, those having seizures, and the paralyzed; and he healed them.

source: Chuin Galilee, Dicapoli, Jerusalem, chule Judah gama konle Jordan gal lang khat lama konin mihon tamtah-in anung ajuitan ahi.
target: Large crowds from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and the region across the Jordan followed him.

source: Aman mipi chengse chu amun, molvum chungah akaltouvin; chuin ama atouvin ahile aseijuite chu ahengah ahungun;
target: Now when Jesus saw the crowds, he went up on a mountainside and sat down. His disciples came to him,

source: Chuin ama apaodoh-in, amaho chu hiche thuhi ahil pantan ahi.
target: and he began to teach them. He said:

source: Lhagaova vaichaho anunnom ahiuve; ijeh inem itile van lenggam chu amaho-a ahi.
target: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

source: Alhaseteho anunnom ahiuve; ijeh inem itile lhep lungmonga umding ahiuve.
target: Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.

source: Mi lungnengteho anunnom ahiuve; ijeh inem itile amahon leiset chung alo dingu ahi.
target: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.

source: Chonphatna lama gilkel le dangchah ho anunnom ahiuve; ijeh inem itile amaho chu vading ahiuve.
target: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.

source: Milungset teho anunnom ahiuve; ijeh inem itile amaho chu kilungset ding ahiuve.
target: Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy.

source: Milungthengho anunnom ahiuve; ijeh inem itile amahon Pathen amu dingu ahi.
target: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.

source: Misucham ho anunnom ahiuve; ijeh inem itile amaho chu Pathen chate kiti ding ahiuve.
target: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.

source: Chonphat jala bolsetna thohho anunnom ahiuve; ijeh inem itile van lenggam chu amaho-a ahi.
target: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

source: Keima jala mihon nahouset uva, nabolset uva, chule nachung uva jouthu-a thugilou asei tengule anunnom nahiuve.
target: “Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of me.

source: Kipah-un, hapan kipah-un; ijeh inem itile van'a nasan dingu kipaman atame; ijeh inem itile nangho masanga anaum themgaoho jong chu mihon chutobangma chun abolseuvin ahi.
target: Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

source: Nangho leiset chi nahiuve: ahin chi khu tam tahenlang hile, ipi-a ki-al sah dingham? Chukalle apanna umtapontin, paidohle mihemte chotpha dingbou ahitai.
target: “You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled underfoot.

source: Nangho vannoi vah nahiuve. Lhang vuma khopi chu akisel theipoi.
target: “You are the light of the world. A town built on a hill cannot be hidden.

source: Min meivah avah-in, lo akhukhum ngaipoi, atunna chunga akoijin; chuteng in sunga um chengse chu asalvah bouvin ahi.
target: Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a bowl. Instead they put it on its stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.

source: Hiche bang chun navah-u chu miho angah kilanghen, chuteng amahon nachon phatnao chu mu theijuntin, chule van'a um na-Pau chu avahchoi dingu ahi.
target: In the same way, let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.

source: Keima danthu le themgaoho thu sumang dinga hungin neingaito hih-un; asumanga hung hilouvin, asubulhit dingjoh-a hung kahibouve.
target: “Do not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets; I have not come to abolish them but to fulfill them.

source: Ijeh-inem itile tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Vanle lei aman kahse-a, danthu chu jemsipah penle ajem halsicha jong aboncha abulhin masangse-a mang lou ding ahi.
target: For truly I tell you, until heaven and earth disappear, not the smallest letter, not the least stroke of a pen, will by any means disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.

source: Hijeh chun koi hijongle hiche thupeh neopen lah-a khat suse-a, chule chutobanga bol ding hila chu, van lenggama aneopena kisei ding ahi; chule koi hijongle anitna, chule chutobanga hila vang chu, van lenggama alenpena kisei ding ahi.
target: Therefore anyone who sets aside one of the least of these commands and teaches others accordingly will be called least in the kingdom of heaven, but whoever practices and teaches these commands will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

source: Ijeh-inem itile kaseipeh nahiuve, Nangho danthu sunho le Pharisai ho sanga nachon phatnao achung nunjoh louva ahile, van gama nalut louhel dingu ahi.
target: For I tell you that unless your righteousness surpasses that of the Pharisees and the teachers of the law, you will certainly not enter the kingdom of heaven.

source: Tolthat hih-un; koi hijongle tolthat chu thupi tanna-a dinga kicha jinga umding ahi, tia malai mite jah-a kisei thu chu najataove.
target: “You have heard that it was said to the people long ago, ‘You shall not murder, and anyone who murders will be subject to judgment.’

source: Ahivangin keiman nangho jah-a kasei ahi, Koi hijongle ajeh beija asopi lunghan khuma chu thupi tanna-a dinga kicha jinga umding ahi; chule, koi hijongle asopi, Raca, tia chu houvaipoloi kikhopna-a dinga kicha jinga umding ahi. Chule koi hijongle asopi, Mingol, tia chu damun meidila dinga kicha jinga umding ahi.
target: But I tell you that anyone who is angry with a brother or sister will be subject to judgment. Again, anyone who says to a brother or sister, ‘ Raca ,’ is answerable to the court. And anyone who says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of hell.

source: Hiche jeh chun maicham mun'a thil to ding nachoija nahunga, nasopi nachunga alung himona nahetdoh-a ahile,
target: “Therefore, if you are offering your gift at the altar and there remember that your brother or sister has something against you,

source: Nathil to ding chu maicham koma chun dalhanlang, chen, nasopi chutoh gakicham masan, chujoule hungin nathil to ding chu toh-in.
target: leave your gift there in front of the altar. First go and be reconciled to them; then come and offer your gift.

source: Nahehpa chu lampia naum petnin kichampin, achuti loule nahehpan thutan vaihom henga leh lutnin natin, thutan vaihom chun sottolle khutnah pedoh-in natin, chuteng aman songkul'a nakhum ding ahi.
target: “Settle matters quickly with your adversary who is taking you to court. Do it while you are still together on the way, or your adversary may hand you over to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and you may be thrown into prison.

source: Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahi, Nangman achai nakei paisa keh khat geija nasahsoh masangse-a, iti jongle chua kona napotdoh louhel ding ahi.
target: Truly I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny.

source: Jonthanhoi bol hih-in, tia malaija kisei chu nanghon najataove;
target: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery.’

source: Ahivangin keiman nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, koi hijongle numei jonlunga vea chu amanu chutoh alunga jonga ahitai.
target: But I tell you that anyone who looks at a woman lustfully has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

source: Chule namit jetlamin nasuhmo le, kaldoh inlang paimangin; ijeh-inem itile natahsa pumpi damuna lelutna aum sangin, natibah khat aman ding nang dingin aphajoi.
target: If your right eye causes you to stumble, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.

source: Chule nakhut jetlamin nasuhmo le, hi jong chu satlhan lang paimangin; natahsa pumpi-a damuna nachuh sangin, natibah khat aman dinga nang dinga phajo ahi.
target: And if your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to go into hell.

source: Chule, Koi hijongle aji da-a chun, dana lekha pehen, kitisa ahi;
target: “It has been said, ‘Anyone who divorces his wife must give her a certificate of divorce.’

source: Ahivangin keiman najah uva kasei ahi, Ajon jeh tailouva thu dang jeh-a aji da-a chun, ajinu chu ajonsah ahi; chule koi hile akidasa numei chu akichenpia jong chu ajonga ahi.
target: But I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, makes her the victim of adultery, and anyone who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.

source: Chukitle, jouvin Kihahsel hih-un, naki hahselna chu Pakai henga molson, tia malai mite jah-a kiseisa chu najataove;
target: “Again, you have heard that it was said to the people long ago, ‘Do not break your oath, but fulfill to the Lord the vows you have made.’

source: Ahivangin keiman najah uva kasei ahi; Imachan kihahsel hih-un, van min panin kihah sel hih-un, Pathen touna ahi jeh-in;
target: But I tell you, do not swear an oath at all: either by heaven, for it is God’s throne;

source: Chule lei min panin kihahsel hih-un, ijeh-inem itile hichu akengto ngapna ahi. Jerusalem min panin kihahsel hih-un; ijeh-inem itile hichu Leng chungnung khopi ahi.
target: or by the earth, for it is his footstool; or by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the Great King.

source: Naluchang panin kihahsel hih-un; ijeh-inem itile nangman nasam jang khat jengcha jong nakansah navomsah theipon ahi.
target: And do not swear by your head, for you cannot make even one hair white or black.

source: Ahin nasei chu ahile ahi, ahiloule ahilou hijenghen; hicheng kalval chu agilouva kona bou ahitai.
target: All you need to say is simply ‘Yes’ or ‘No’; anything beyond this comes from the evil one.

source: Mit khela mit, ha khela ha, tia kisei chu najataove;
target: “You have heard that it was said, ‘Eye for eye, and tooth for tooth.’

source: Ahivangin keiman nangho jah-a kasei ahi, Migilou thuh hih-un; amavang koi hile nangeiphe jetlam benga chu, lang khat jong dopeh-in.
target: But I tell you, do not resist an evil person. If anyone slaps you on the right cheek, turn to them the other cheek also.

source: Koi hile heh dinga nago-a nasangkhol sungnung lah dinga go-a chu, naponlen jong chu pe jengin.
target: And if anyone wants to sue you and take your shirt, hand over your coat as well.

source: Koi hile apoh po dinga nacham louva bola mile khat napuija chu, mile ni chepin.
target: If anyone forces you to go one mile, go with them two miles.

source: Nahenga thuma chu pen, nahenga thilpa thuma chu kihei mangsan hih-in.
target: Give to the one who asks you, and do not turn away from the one who wants to borrow from you.

source: Naheng nakom ngailunlang, chule namelma teu hotbolun, tia kisei chu najataove;
target: “You have heard that it was said, ‘Love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’

source: Ahivangin, keiman nangho jah-a kasei ahi, namelma teu ngailuvin, nagaosap teo chu phatthei boh-un, nahoteu chu phatbolun, chule nadangdat teole nabolseteu dingin taopeh-un;
target: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,

source: Chutilebou van'a na-Pau chate nahithei dingu ahi. Ijeh-inem itile aman migiloule mipha chunga anisa asosah gelin, chule michonpha le michonse chunga go ajuhsah gelin ahi.
target: that you may be children of your Father in heaven. He causes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.

source: Ijeh-inem itile nanghon nangailu teo jeng chu nangailut uva ahile, ipi kipaman nasan dinguham? Kaidonghon jong chutima chu abolu hilouham?
target: If you love those who love you, what reward will you get? Are not even the tax collectors doing that?

source: Chule nasopiu jengmai salam naboh uva ahile, midang ipi-a nakhelnao umam? Kaidonghon jong chutia chu abol louham?
target: And if you greet only your own people, what are you doing more than others? Do not even pagans do that?

source: Hijeh chun van'a um na-Pau aphat chamkimsoh bangin, nangho jong chamkimun.
target: Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.

source: Nathilphabolu chu mihon amuna dinguva amasanguva nabol louna dinguvin chingtheijun; chutia nabol ule van'a na-Pau koma san ding kipaman nei lou nahiuve.
target: “Be careful not to practice your righteousness in front of others to be seen by them. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.

source: Hijeh chun mi thil napeh tengule, mi pachat ding ngaitonan miphalhem ho bangin kikhopna in tinleh lam dungah namasang sang uva sumkon mut hih-un; tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Amaho chun kipaman akisanu ahitai.
target: “So when you give to the needy, do not announce it with trumpets, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by others. Truly I tell you, they have received their reward in full.

source: Nangma vangin mi thil napeh teng, nakhut jetlamin abol chu nakhut veilam hetsah hih-in,
target: But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,

source: Chutilebou nathilpeh chu guhthim hintin, guhthima mu-a na-Pan phongtah-a nangma nasah ding ahi.
target: so that your giving may be in secret. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

source: Nangho Pathen henga natao tengule miphalhem hotoh bang hih-un, amahon mi mu dingin kikhopna intina le lamkontina dina tao adeijun ahi. Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Amaho chun kipaman akisanu ahitai.
target: “And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites, for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by others. Truly I tell you, they have received their reward in full.

source: Nang vang natao tengle, na-insung dana lutnin lang chule kot khah-in, guhthima um na Pa henga taovin; chuteng guhthima mu-a na-Pan nangma phongtah-a nasah ding ahi.
target: But when you pray, go into your room, close the door and pray to your Father, who is unseen. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

source: Amavang chidang namdangte bangin naseisa velsei kit hih-un, ijeh-inem itile amahon thu tamtah asei jeh uva chu jahpeh-a umdinga angaitou ahi.
target: And when you pray, do not keep on babbling like pagans, for they think they will be heard because of their many words.

source: Hijeh chun amahotoh bang hih-un; ijeh-inem itile nathum masangun, nadei nangai chanu chu na-Pau vin ahenai.
target: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask him.

source: Hijeh chun hitihin taovun; Van'a um ka-Pau, namin kijahen.
target: “This, then, is how you should pray: “ ‘Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name,

source: Nagam hung lhunghen. Van'a nalungchan akim bangin, leija jong nalungchan kimhen.
target: your kingdom come, your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.

source: Tunin kaneh khop dingu anneh neipeuvin.
target: Give us today our daily bread.

source: Kalei bateu kangaidam bangun, keiho bat jong ngaidamin.
target: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.

source: Chule lhepna-a neipui hih-un, agilouva konin neihuhdoh jouvin: ajehchu lenggam, thahat, chule loupina atonsotna nanga ahi, Amen.
target: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. ’

source: Ijeh-inem itile nanghon mi suhkhel nangaidam uva ahile, van'a na-Pau vin jong nangho suhkhel angaidam ding ahi.
target: For if you forgive other people when they sin against you, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

source: Amavang nanghon mi suhkhel nangaidam lou vangule, na-Pau vin jong nangho suhkhel angaidam lou ding ahi.
target: But if you do not forgive others their sins, your Father will not forgive your sins.

source: Nanghon an nangol tengule, miphalhem ho bangin kinguisah hih-un; ijeh-inem itile amahon an angolu min ahetna dingin, amaiso achom ahisah jiuvin ahi. Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Amahon kipaman akisanu ahitai.
target: “When you fast, do not look somber as the hypocrites do, for they disfigure their faces to show others they are fasting. Truly I tell you, they have received their reward in full.

source: Nangma vangin an nangol tengle, nalu thao kinunlang, namai jong kiphet in.
target: But when you fast, put oil on your head and wash your face,

source: Chutile mihem mitmu hilouva, guhthima um na-Pa mitmu-a an ngol nabah ding ahin; chuteng guhthima mu-a na-Pan phongtah-a kipaman napeh ding ahi.
target: so that it will not be obvious to others that you are fasting, but only to your Father, who is unseen; and your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

source: Ngetle twi eh-in asuhmang theina, guchan aphet vanga chule aguhmang theina leiset chungah gou khol hih-un;
target: “Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moths and vermin destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.

source: Amavang ngetle twi eh-in asuhmang thei louna, guchan jong aphetvang theilou nale aguhmang thei louna van'ah nagou kholun;
target: But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where moths and vermin do not destroy, and where thieves do not break in and steal.

source: Ijeh-inem itile nagou umna-a chu nalung jong umding ahi.
target: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

source: Mit hi natahsa meivah ahi; hijeh chun namit achima ahile, nati pumpi vah ding ahi.
target: “The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are healthy, your whole body will be full of light.

source: Amavang namit phata hihle, nati apumpi thim ding ahitai. Hijeh chun nasunga um vah chu athima ahile, hiche thim chu ichana thimding hitam!
target: But if your eyes are unhealthy, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light within you is darkness, how great is that darkness!

source: Koima pakai ni soh ahi theipoi; ijeh-inem itile aman khat hotbolintin, khatjoh angailut ding ahi; ahiloule khatna hakai jintin, khatjoh anahsahmo ding ahi. Nangho Pathen le sum soh nahikop thei lou dingu ahi.
target: “No one can serve two masters. Either you will hate the one and love the other, or you will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.

source: Hijeh-a chu nangho jah-a kasei ahi, i-kaneh ding hitam, i-kadon ding hitam, tin na hinna dingun; ahiloule, i-kasila kachen ding hitam, tin natahsa dingun lungkham hih-un. Anneh sanga hinkho, chule nihchen ponsil sanga tahsa thupijo hilouham?
target: “Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?

source: Chunga leng vacha khu ngaitouvin, amahon tula atupouvin, atla a-at pouvin, ahinla van'a um na-Pau vin amaho khu avahnai. Nangho khuteho sanga lujo nahi lou uham?
target: Look at the birds of the air; they do not sow or reap or store away in barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?

source: Nangho lah-a lungkham hatna ahinkho tong khat jopsaobe thei koi nahiuvem?
target: Can any one of you by worrying add a single hour to your life?

source: Chule nihchen ponsil jeh-a ibola nalung kham uham? Jaova molhoipah khu iti khanham ngaitouvin. Hicheho khun tongla atonggim pouvin, patla akhehpouve;
target: “And why do you worry about clothes? See how the flowers of the field grow. They do not labor or spin.

source: Ahivanginla keiman najah uva kaseipeh nahiuve, Solomon jeng jong aloupina jouse-a akivon chun, hiche molhoi khattoh kibangin akijem hoipon ahi.
target: Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his splendor was dressed like one of these.

source: Chule jaova hampa tunia uma, jinga lhum sunga kileh lutta ding jengbon Pathen'in achuti jeple, vo tahsan lhomho, chu sanga chu Aman nangho najepjoh lou dinguham?
target: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the fire, will he not much more clothe you—you of little faith?

source: Hijeh chun, I-kaneh dinguham? I kadon dinguham? I kasil dinguham, tin lungkham hih-un;
target: So do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’

source: Ijeh-inem itile chidang namdang ten hitiho chu aholu ahin; chule nanghon jong hicheng chu nangaichaove ti van'a na-Pau vin ahenai.
target: For the pagans run after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.

source: Ahivangin amasatah-in Pathen lenggam le chonphatna hol masaovin; chuteng hichengse jong chu naki pehbe dingu ahi.
target: But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.

source: Hijeh chun jinga dingin lungkham hih-un; jing chun aman hinki ngaito nante. Ni khat hesohna chu ni khatna dingin atohbepmin ahi.
target: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.

source: Oimo-a naum louna dinguvin, mi oimo hih-un.
target: “Do not judge, or you too will be judged.

source: Na-oimo bang cheh-a chu oimo-a naum dingu ahin; chule nanghon nate bang banguva chu nangho kitepeh dinga nahiuve.
target: For in the same way you judge others, you will be judged, and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.

source: Nangma mitna thingtum uma chu ngaito louva, ibola nasopi mitna bohthem chu navet ham?
target: “Why do you look at the speck of sawdust in your brother’s eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own eye?

source: Chule ven, nangma mitna thingtum uma, nasopi jah-a, namitna bohthem umchu neilahdoh sah-in nati theiham?
target: How can you say to your brother, ‘Let me take the speck out of your eye,’ when all the time there is a plank in your own eye?

source: Vo miphalhem, nangma mitna um thingtum chu kilahdoh masatnin; chutengle nasopi mitna bohthem chu lahdoh dinga namuchen dingbou ahi.
target: You hypocrite, first take the plank out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.

source: Uichaho khu thiltheng pe hih-un, vohcha anga natwikoh changu seplha hih-un; amahon hitiho chu akengun chonuntin, chule hungkile heijuntin nangho jengjong nalhehtel dingu ahi.
target: “Do not give dogs what is sacred; do not throw your pearls to pigs. If you do, they may trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.

source: Thumun, kipe ding nahiuve; holun, namu dingu ahi; kiuvun, kihon peh ding nahiuve;
target: “Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.

source: Ijeh-inem itile athumchan achangin; aholan amun; chule akiuva chu kot kihon peh ding ahi.
target: For everyone who asks receives; the one who seeks finds; and to the one who knocks, the door will be opened.

source: Achapan changlhah athumle song pe-a,
target: “Which of you, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone?

source: Nga athumle gul pe dinga, nalah uva koi naum uvem?
target: Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?

source: Hijeh chun nanghobon migiloutah hiuva, nachateo thilpha pehje nahet ule, hiche sanga chu gamchenga van'a na-Pau vin ahenga thumte chu thilpha apeh lou dingham?
target: If you, then, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good gifts to those who ask him!

source: Hijeh chun ima jouse-a min nangho iti nabolle nadeijum, nanghon jong chutobang chun bolun; ijeh-inem itile hichu dan thupeh le themgaoho thu ahi.
target: So in everything, do to others what you would have them do to you, for this sums up the Law and the Prophets.

source: Kot jima lutnun; ijeh-inem itile manna lam chu akot jatah ahin, alampi jong lentah ahi, chule chua lut chu tamtah ahi.
target: “Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the road that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.

source: Hinna lam chu akot jong ajimin, alampi akichin, chule hichu amua alhome.
target: But small is the gate and narrow the road that leads to life, and only a few find it.

source: Kelngoi von kivona asunglamla ngei hangtah hia themgao lhem, naheng uva hungjiho-a konchun kichih theijun.
target: “Watch out for false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ferocious wolves.

source: Amaho chu agauva nahet jeng dingu ahi. Mihemin lingphunga lengpiga aloa, ahiloule meithai seltho linga theichang alo ngaijem?
target: By their fruit you will recognize them. Do people pick grapes from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?

source: Hiche bang chun thingphung pha jouse aga aphan, thingphung lungvei chun ga phalou asepdoh jin ahi.
target: Likewise, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit.

source: Thingphung pha-a aphalou gathei lou; chule thingphung phalouva jong apha gathei lou ahi.
target: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit.

source: Thingphung aga phalou chengse chu kiphuh lhu-a meija kisep lutji ahi.
target: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

source: Hijeh chun nanghon amaho chu agauva nahet dingu ahi.
target: Thus, by their fruit you will recognize them.

source: Pakai, Pakai, eiti chan chu van lenggama lut ding ahipoi; koi hileh van'a um ka Pa lunglam bolpabou chu lut ding ahi.
target: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.

source: Hiche ni chule mi tamtah-in kajah-a, Pakai, Pakai, keihon nangma mina thu kasei lou uham? Chule nangma mina thilha kanodoh lou uham? Chule nangma mina bolmo kidang kabol lou uham, ati dingu ahi.
target: Many will say to me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in your name and in your name drive out demons and in your name perform many miracles?’

source: Hiteng chule keiman amaho chu phongtah-a kaseipeh-a, Keiman nangho imatihchanin kahekhapouve; vo chonset bolteho, kakoma konin chemangun, kati ding ahi.
target: Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you. Away from me, you evildoers!’

source: Hijeh chun koi hijongle kathu hicheng hi ja-a, bola chu, song chunga in sa milungthim phatah toh kitekah ding ahi.
target: “Therefore everyone who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.

source: Chuin go ahung jun, twi ahungsoh-in, hui ahung nungin, chuche in'a chun achun; ahin song chunga kibulphu ahi jeh-in alhupon ahi.
target: The rain came down, the streams rose, and the winds blew and beat against that house; yet it did not fall, because it had its foundation on the rock.

source: Chule koi hijongle kathu hicheng hi ja-a, bol lou chu, nellei chunga in sa milungthim bei toh kitekah ding ahi.
target: But everyone who hears these words of mine and does not put them into practice is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.

source: Chuin go ahung jun, twi ahungsoh-in, hui ahung nungin, chuche in chu ahin nuhtan ahile alhutai; chule alhuh chu nasatah ahi, ati.
target: The rain came down, the streams rose, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell with a great crash.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n thu chucheng asei jouvin, mihonpi chun athuhil chu kidang asa lheh-un ahi,
target: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the crowds were amazed at his teaching,

source: Ijeh inem itile Aman amaho danthu lekha sunho mihil banga hil louva, thuneitah banga amaho chu thu ahil ahi.
target: because he taught as one who had authority, and not as their teachers of the law.

source: Chujouvin ama molsang chunga konin akumsuh-in ahile, mipi tamtah-in anung ajuijun ahi.
target: When Jesus came down from the mountainside, large crowds followed him.

source: Chuin, veuvin, miphah khat ahenga ahungin, chibai ahung boh-in, Pakai, nangma nalung ahile keima eingimsah thei nahi, ahungtin ahi.
target: A man with leprosy came and knelt before him and said, “Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n akhut alhangin, athamin, Kalung ahi: ngimtan, ati. Chupet tah chun aphah chu adamtai.
target: Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” he said. “Be clean!” Immediately he was cleansed of his leprosy.

source: Chuin Jesu'n amapa jah-a chun, Ven, hiche thuhi koima jah-a sei hih-in, amavang chenlang thempu gakimu sahtan, chule amaho hettohsahna dingin Mosi thupehsa thilto ding chu gatohtan, ati.
target: Then Jesus said to him, “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”

source: Chuin Jesu Capernaum alutnin ahile, sepai jalamkai khat ahenga ahungin, ngehna aneijin,
target: When Jesus had entered Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking for help.

source: Pakai, kasohpa alangthin in'a alumin, anat athohlel lheh jenge, atin ahi.
target: “Lord,” he said, “my servant lies at home paralyzed, suffering terribly.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah-a, Hunging ting hung damsah nange ati.
target: Jesus said to him, “Shall I come and heal him?”

source: Chuin hiche sepai jalamkai chun adonbutnin, Pakai, nangma ka-in sunga nahung lut ding chu, keima chutia kilom kahipoi; nangman thuchengcha khat seile chun, kasohpa dam jeng ding ahi.
target: The centurion replied, “Lord, I do not deserve to have you come under my roof. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

source: Ijeh-inem itile keima jong mi thuneina noija um kahin, keima noija sepaiho aumun; chule keiman khatpenpen chu, Chen, katile, achen; achomkhat, Hungin, katile, ahungin; chule kasoh jah-a, Hiche bolin, katile, aboljin ahi, ati.
target: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and that one, ‘Come,’ and he comes. I say to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

source: Jesu'n chuche thu ajah phatnin, kidang asan, anunga hungho jah-a chun, Keiman tahbeh-a nangho jah-a kasei ahi, Israel lah jenga jong hitobang tahsan len khatcha jong kamu khapoi.
target: When Jesus heard this, he was amazed and said to those following him, “Truly I tell you, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.

source: Chule keiman nangho jah-a kasei ahi, Niso lama konle nilhum lama konin mi tamtah hungintin, Abraham, Isaac, chule Jacob toh van lenggama toukhom ding ahiuve;
target: I say to you that many will come from the east and the west, and will take their places at the feast with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.

source: Amavang lenggam chate polam muthim lah-a kipaidoh ding ahiuve; hikoma chu kale hagel umding ahi, ati.
target: But the subjects of the kingdom will be thrown outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n sepai jalamkai jah-a, Nangma chetan, natahsan bangin nachunga lhunghen, ati. Chuphattah chun achapang chu adamtai.
target: Then Jesus said to the centurion, “Go! Let it be done just as you believed it would.” And his servant was healed at that moment.

source: Chujouvin Jesu Peter in'a alutna ahile, anupanu khosih veija na analup amun;
target: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw Peter’s mother-in-law lying in bed with a fever.

source: Chuin aman amanu khut agah thamin ahile, akhosih chu adalhatai. Chuin ahung thouvin, amaho jenlen apangtai.
target: He touched her hand and the fever left her, and she got up and began to wait on him.

source: Chuin nilhah-in mihon thilha vop mi tamtah ahenga ahinpuijun; aman thilhaho chu anodoh-in, chule ana jouse adamsah tai.
target: When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to him, and he drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.

source: Isaiah themgaovin, Amatah-in ihatmonau alan, inat jouseu apomangtai, tia asei chu guilhuna dinga chuti ahi.
target: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: “He took up our infirmities and bore our diseases.”

source: Chujouvin Jesu'n akimvela mipi tamtah chu amun, gal lang khat lama che din thu apetai.
target: When Jesus saw the crowd around him, he gave orders to cross to the other side of the lake.

source: Hiche pet chun danthu sunho khat ahenga ahungin, Houhil, nachena chan-ah juijinge, ati.
target: Then a teacher of the law came to him and said, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”

source: Jesu'n amapa jah-a, Sial hon ko aneijun, chunga leng vachaten jong buh aneijun, Mihem Chapa vangin alu ngapna ding mun aneipoi, ati.
target: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”

source: Chuin aseijui dangho lah-a khatnin ajah-a, Pakai, amasa kache-a kapa kagavuina din thu neipen, ati.
target: Another disciple said to him, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”

source: Jesu'n ama jah-a, Nangman kanung hinjuitan: mithihon amithiu kivui naovinte, ati.
target: But Jesus told him, “Follow me, and let the dead bury their own dead.”

source: Chujouvin ama kong'a atouvin ahile, aseijuite chun anung ajuijun ahi.
target: Then he got into the boat and his disciples followed him.

source: Hichun, veuvin, dillen'a chun khopihui hanunin anungin, twi kinongin kong chu ahin khu jengtan ahi; ahivangin ama a-imun ahi.
target: Suddenly a furious storm came up on the lake, so that the waves swept over the boat. But Jesus was sleeping.

source: Chuin aseijuiho ahenga ahungun, asukhangun, Pakai, neihuhhing un: athigam ding kahitaove, atiuvin ahi.
target: The disciples went and woke him, saying, “Lord, save us! We’re going to drown!”

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Vo tahsan lhomho, ibola kicha-a nahiuvem? ati. Chutah-in ama athouvin, huipi le dillen chu aphoh-in ahile, athip heltai.
target: He replied, “You of little faith, why are you so afraid?” Then he got up and rebuked the winds and the waves, and it was completely calm.

source: Chuin miho chun adatmo lheh jengun, Ama hi iti mi hingana, huipi le dillen sanin athu angaije, atiuvin ahi.
target: The men were amazed and asked, “What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the waves obey him!”

source: Chuin ama agalkaija Gargesenes gam alhunin, thilhavop mi ni lhankhuh-a konin amatoh kitoh dingin ahung lhonin; amani chu khohtah ahi lhonin hilam chu koimachan ahothei louhel ahi.
target: When he arrived at the other side in the region of the Gadarenes, two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs met him. They were so violent that no one could pass that way.

source: Hichun, veuvin, amani chu a-ao jah lhonin, nangma Pathen Chapa, Jesu, Nangle keiho ipi ikimatnao umam? Ni kitep lhin masanga eibolgim dinga hunga nahim? ati lhone.
target: “What do you want with us, Son of God?” they shouted. “Have you come here to torture us before the appointed time?”

source: Hipet chun aumnao gallampeh-a chun vohcha hon khat alhan ahi.
target: Some distance from them a large herd of pigs was feeding.

source: Hichun thilhaho chun Jesu henga, Keiho neikaidoh ule, khuche vohcha hon lah-a khun neisol uvin, tin angeh taovin ahi.
target: The demons begged Jesus, “If you drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs.”

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Cheovin, ati. Chuin apotdoh-un, vohchaho sunga chun alut taovin ahi; chuin, veuvin, ahonchangpin halhaijin alhaijun, kolah alhai lhauvin, dillenah alha lutnun, twijah athigam taovin ahi.
target: He said to them, “Go!” So they came out and went into the pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and died in the water.

source: Chuin achingho chu khopi sung lama ajamlutnun, thu umchan jouse le thilhavop miteni thu chu agaseijun ahi.
target: Those tending the pigs ran off, went into the town and reported all this, including what had happened to the demon-possessed men.

source: Chuin, veuvin, khosunga mi jouse Jesu toh kimuto dingin ahungdoh-un; chuin ama amu phatnun, agam sunguva kona chedoh dingin angeh taovin ahi.
target: Then the whole town went out to meet Jesus. And when they saw him, they pleaded with him to leave their region.

source: Chujouvin kong'a atouvin, agalkaijin, akhopi ah alut tai.
target: Jesus stepped into a boat, crossed over and came to his own town.

source: Chuin, veuvin, mihon alupna khun pumin langthi khat ahenga ahinpu uvin; Jesu'n atahsanjeu chu amun, langthipa jah-a chun, Chapa, lungmong tah-in umin, nachonset kingaidam ahitai, ati.
target: Some men brought to him a paralyzed man, lying on a mat. When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the man, “Take heart, son; your sins are forgiven.”

source: Hichun, veuvin, danthu sunho kimkhatnin alungthimun, Hipa hin Pathen ataitome, atiuvin ahi.
target: At this, some of the teachers of the law said to themselves, “This fellow is blaspheming!”

source: Hichun Jesu'n alung gelu chu ahen, Nanghon nalunguva ibola lungilou navopmu ham?
target: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said, “Why do you entertain evil thoughts in your hearts?

source: Nachonset naho kingaidama ahitai, tileh thouvin lamjotnin, ti, hoijoh seibaijo-am?
target: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?

source: Ahoi hita jongle Mihem Chapan leiset chunga mihemte chonset ngaidam theina thahat aneije ti nahetna dingu ahi atin, hichun alangthipa jah-a, Thouvin, nalupna kilah-inlang na-in'a chetan, ati.
target: But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.” So he said to the paralyzed man, “Get up, take your mat and go home.”

source: Chuin amapa athouvin, a-in lama achetai.
target: Then the man got up and went home.

source: Ahin mipin hichu amu phatnun, kidang asauvin, hitobang thuneina mihemte pe-a Pathen chu avahchoi taovin ahi.
target: When the crowd saw this, they were filled with awe; and they praised God, who had given such authority to man.

source: Chuin Jesu chua konin achen ahile, mi khat amin Matthew kiti, akaidonna mun'a atou amun, ajah-a, Kanung hinjuijin, ati. Chuin ama akipatdoh-in, anung ajuitai.
target: As Jesus went on from there, he saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax collector’s booth. “Follow me,” he told him, and Matthew got up and followed him.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Jesu chuche in'a an nedingin atouvin ahile, veuvin, kaidongho le michonseho tamtah ahungun, Jesu le aseijuiteho chutoh ankong aum khomun ahi.
target: While Jesus was having dinner at Matthew’s house, many tax collectors and sinners came and ate with him and his disciples.

source: Chuin Pharisai hon chuche amu phatnun, aseijuite henga, Nahilpauvin ibola kaidongho le michonsehotoh an aneh khomham? atiuvin ahi.
target: When the Pharisees saw this, they asked his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”

source: Ahin Jesu'n chuche ajan, Atidamten louthem angaipouve; adamlouten bou angaijui.
target: On hearing this, Jesus said, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.

source: Keiman kithoina kangehpoi, kikhoto nabou kangeh-e, ti hi ipi kiseina ahi gakihilun; ijeh-inem itile keima michonpha te kou-a hung kahipoi, alungheina diuva michonse te kou-a hungjoh kahibouve, ati.
target: But go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice.’ For I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”

source: Chupettah chun John seijuite ahenga ahungun, ajah-a, Keiho le Pharisai honla an kangol matchet jiuvin, ibola nangma seijuiten an angolji louvu ham? atiuvin ahi.
target: Then John’s disciples came and asked him, “How is it that we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples do not fast?”

source: Chuin Jesu'n amaho jah-a, Moulang chun aloite aumpilai sungse-a aloite chu kingaise thei ngaijuvem? Amavang moulang chu akomuva kona kipuimang ni hung lhung ding ahin, chuteng chule amahon an angol dingu ahi.
target: Jesus answered, “How can the guests of the bridegroom mourn while he is with them? The time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.

source: Koiman ponthah halin pon lui abeh ngaipoi, ijeh inem itile abehna chun apon chu loisentin, secheh joding ahi.
target: “No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, for the patch will pull away from the garment, making the tear worse.

source: Chule mihemin lengpitwi thah savun peng luija akhum ngaipoi; achuti loule apeng chu tumkeh intin, atwi longjal ding, apeng jong mahthah ding ahi: amavang lengpitwi thah chu peng thah-a akhum jiuvin, chule anin akihuh bitjin ahi, ati.
target: Neither do people pour new wine into old wineskins. If they do, the skins will burst; the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined. No, they pour new wine into new wineskins, and both are preserved.”

source: Hicheng thu chu asei pettah-in, veuvin, vaipo khat ahungin, ama chibai ahung boh-in, Kachanu tutah chun athin ahi; ahivangin nangma hungin lang achunga nakhut hung ngamle chun amanu hing jeng ding ahi, ahungtin ahi.
target: While he was saying this, a synagogue leader came and knelt before him and said, “My daughter has just died. But come and put your hand on her, and she will live.”

source: Chuin Jesu akipatdoh-in, anung ajuijin, chutichun aseijuiten jong ajuijun ahi.
target: Jesus got up and went with him, and so did his disciples.

source: Chuin veuvin, kum somle kum ni athi longa na-a numei khat anung lama ahungin, apon mongkai chu ahung thamtan ahi.
target: Just then a woman who had been subject to bleeding for twelve years came up behind him and touched the edge of his cloak.

source: Ijeh inem itile amanun alungthima, Apon jengcha hi thamkha jongleng kadam ding ahi, ati ahi.
target: She said to herself, “If I only touch his cloak, I will be healed.”

source: Chuin Jesu akiheijin, amanu chu amun, Chanu, lungmong tah-in umin; natahsanin nadamsah ahitai, ati. Chua pat chun amanu adamheltai.
target: Jesus turned and saw her. “Take heart, daughter,” he said, “your faith has healed you.” And the woman was healed at that moment.

source: Chujouvin Jesu vaipopa in ahung lut phatnin, sumkuli mut teho leh mipi poh vengvung chu amun,
target: When Jesus entered the synagogue leader’s house and saw the noisy crowd and people playing pipes,

source: Amaho jah-a chun, Potdoh-un; ijeh-inem itile chapangnu chu athi ahipoi, a-ihmu ahibouve, ati. Chuin amahon anuisat taovin ahi.
target: he said, “Go away. The girl is not dead but asleep.” But they laughed at him.

source: Ahivangin miho chu akisoldoh phatnin, in sunga alutnin, chapangnu khut atuh-in ahile amanu athoutai.
target: After the crowd had been put outside, he went in and took the girl by the hand, and she got up.

source: Hichun hiche gamsesea chun hiche thu chu akithang sohtai.
target: News of this spread through all that region.

source: Chuin Jesu chua konin achedoh-in ahile, mitcho ni anung nunga ache lhonin, Vo David chapa, neilungset in, tin asam lhonin ahi.
target: As Jesus went on from there, two blind men followed him, calling out, “Have mercy on us, Son of David!”

source: Chuin ama in sung alut phatnin, hiche mitcho teni chu ahenga ahung lhonin; Jesu'n ajah lhonah, Kei hin hichu bolthei jinte ti natahsan lhonem? tin adongin ahi. Amanin, Henge, Pakai, ati lhonin ahi.
target: When he had gone indoors, the blind men came to him, and he asked them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” “Yes, Lord,” they replied.

source: Chutah-in aman amit lhonchu akhoijin, Nathsan bang lhonin nachung lhonah chutahen, ati.
target: Then he touched their eyes and said, “According to your faith let it be done to you”;

source: Hichun amit lhon ahahtai. Chuin Jesu'n amani chu hakhamin akhamin, Chingthei lhonin, koima hetsah lhon hih-in, ati.
target: and their sight was restored. Jesus warned them sternly, “See that no one knows about this.”

source: Ahivangin amani apot lhonin, chuche gamsese-a chun ama min chu aphongjal lhontai.
target: But they went out and spread the news about him all over that region.

source: Chuin acheuvin ahile, veuvin, lampia thilhavop mi paomo khat ahengah ahinpuijun ahi.
target: While they were going out, a man who was demon-possessed and could not talk was brought to Jesus.

source: Thilha chu akideldoh phatnin, paomopa chu apaotai. Hichun mipi chun kidang asauvin, Israel lah-a hitobang akimukha hih-e, atiuvin ahi.
target: And when the demon was driven out, the man who had been mute spoke. The crowd was amazed and said, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel.”

source: Pharisaiho vangin, Thilha ho lengpa mina thilhaho adeldoh hichu, atiuve.
target: But the Pharisees said, “It is by the prince of demons that he drives out demons.”

source: Chujouvin Jesu khotinle vengtina avahle avahlen, akikhopnao intin-ah thu ahillen, lenggam Kipana Thupha ahil lhanglen, hivei namkimle nat namkim adamsahtan ahi.
