source: Chutobang chun hiche aneochaho lah-a khattou amanthah ding hi van'a um na-Pau lunglam ahipoi.
target: In the same way your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should perish.

source: Chule nasopi nachunga achonset tah-a ahile, chenlang nangle ama changseh hetnin asetna chu phoh-in; chua angaija ahile sopi chu nanei ahitai.
target: “If your brother or sister sins, go and point out their fault, just between the two of you. If they listen to you, you have won them over.

source: Angai lou vangle, ahetoh dingin mi nile thum kama thu jouse akichetna dingin, ni hile thum hile kipuijin.
target: But if they will not listen, take one or two others along, so that ‘every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.’

source: Chule chucheng sei jong angai loulaija ahile, houbung henga lhutnin; chua houbung thu jong angaisam louva ahile, ama chu nangho dingin chidang namdangle kaidongho banghen.
target: If they still refuse to listen, tell it to the church; and if they refuse to listen even to the church, treat them as you would a pagan or a tax collector.

source: Tahbeh-a kasei ahi, itobang hijongle leiset chunga nakha-u chu van'a jong kikhah ding, leiset chunga nahonu chu van'a jong kihong ding ahi.
target: “Truly I tell you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.

source: Tahbeh-a kaseipeh kit nahiuve, Leiset chunga nalah uva mi nin kilungthoh tah-a thilthum neija atao lhonle, van'a um ka Pan abulhitpeh lhon ding ahi.
target: “Again, truly I tell you that if two of you on earth agree about anything they ask for, it will be done for them by my Father in heaven.

source: Ijeh-inem itile hoikom hijongle mi ni hile thum hile kamina akikhopnao chana chun, alah uva kei kaumnai, ati.
target: For where two or three gather in my name, there am I with them.”

source: Chupettah chun Peter ahenga ahungin, ajah-a, Pakai, kasopin kachunga ijatvei achonsetle kangaidam dingham? Sagivei geijinem? ati.
target: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, “Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother or sister who sins against me? Up to seven times?”

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, Najah-a sagivei geijin katipoi; amavang sagi munsom sagivei geijin katijo bouve.
target: Jesus answered, “I tell you, not seven times, but seventy-seven times.

source: Hijeh chun van lenggam thuhi lengpa khat asohtetoh sum sutoh dinga kigo-a toh kitekah thei ahi.
target: “Therefore, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

source: Asuto pantan ahile, alah uva mikhat ama talent sangsom batpa chu ahenga ahinkai taovin ahi.
target: As he began the settlement, a man who owed him ten thousand bags of gold was brought to him.

source: Apeh ding ima anei lou jeh-in a-pakaipa chun amatoh, aji achate toh, anei chengse joh-a chule dit dingin thu apetan ahi.
target: Since he was not able to pay, the master ordered that he and his wife and his children and all that he had be sold to repay the debt.

source: Achuti phatnin asohpa chun aboh khupmin, chibai aboh-in, Pakai, neikhongai tadin, abonin sadoh nange, ati.
target: “At this the servant fell on his knees before him. ‘Be patient with me,’ he begged, ‘and I will pay back everything.’

source: Hichun a-pakai pan alungsetnin, alhadoh-in, asumbat jong chu abeisah-in angaidam tai.
target: The servant’s master took pity on him, canceled the debt and let him go.

source: Ahin chuche sohpa chu apotdoh phatnin, asohchanpi khat dangka somnga bat amun; amanin alol ameh-in, ajah-a, Neipeh ding chengse chu neipen, ati.
target: “But when that servant went out, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred silver coins. He grabbed him and began to choke him. ‘Pay back what you owe me!’ he demanded.

source: Achuti phatnin asohchanpipa kengbula aboh khupmin, ahenga ataovin, Neikhongai tadin, keiman nang abonchan sanange, ati.
target: “His fellow servant fell to his knees and begged him, ‘Be patient with me, and I will pay it back.’

source: Ahivangin ama anom hih-in, apeh ding chengse chu apeh kahsen songkul'a agakhumtan ahi.
target: “But he refused. Instead, he went off and had the man thrown into prison until he could pay the debt.

source: Chuin asoh chanpihon achuti umchan chu amuvin, alung phamo lheh-un, a-pakai pau henga ahungun thu umchan jouse chu ahung hiltaovin ahi.
target: When the other servants saw what had happened, they were outraged and went and told their master everything that had happened.

source: Chuphatnin a-pakai pan akoma akou lutnin ajah-a, Vo soh nunse, kahenga natao jeh-a kangaidam ahitai.
target: “Then the master called the servant in. ‘You wicked servant,’ he said, ‘I canceled all that debt of yours because you begged me to.

source: Achutile keiman nang kalungset banga, nangin jong nasohchanpi nalungset ding thu hilouham? ati.
target: Shouldn’t you have had mercy on your fellow servant just as I had on you?’

source: Chuin a-pakaipa alunghangin, abat chengse asah chaisoh kahse-a dingin, mi bol gentheiho khutna apedohtai.
target: In anger his master handed him over to the jailers to be tortured, until he should pay back all he owed.

source: Nanghon nasopiteu suhkhelna chu lunggiltah cheh-a nangaidam louvule, van'a um ka Pan nangho chutobanga chu nabol dingu ahi, ati.
target: “This is how my heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother or sister from your heart.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Jesu'n thu hicheng chu asei jouvin, Galilee'a patnin akipatdoh-in, Jordan gal Juda gamkai lamah ahungin;
target: When Jesus had finished saying these things, he left Galilee and went into the region of Judea to the other side of the Jordan.

source: Chule mi tamtah-in ajuijin, hikoma chun amaho chu aboldamin ahi.
target: Large crowds followed him, and he healed them there.

source: Chuin Pharisaiho ahenga ahungun, apatepnan, Ima jouse-a jeh-a min aji ada dan ngai hinam? tin adongun ahi.
target: Some Pharisees came to him to test him. They asked, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any and every reason?”

source: Chuin aman adonbutnin, Asempan asemtila amaho numei le pasal'a asemsa ahitai, ti thu chu nanghon nasimkhah lou uham?
target: “Haven’t you read,” he replied, “that at the beginning the Creator ‘made them male and female,’

source: Chule hiche jeh-a chu pasal'in anu apa adalhah-a, ajia beh ding ahi; chule amani chu ti khat hi lhon ding ahi.
target: and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh’?

source: Hiti chu ahin amani pumni mi ni hita louva, ti khat hilhona ahitai. Hiche jeh chun Pathen gopsa chu mihemin sukhen hihhen, ati.
target: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.”

source: Amahon ajah-a, Ahile ibola Mosi'n kidana lekha peh-a da ding tia thu apeh ham? atiuve.
target: “Why then,” they asked, “did Moses command that a man give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away?”

source: Chuin aman, ajah uva, Nalungtah jeh uva Mosi'n naji da dingu aphal ahibouve; ahivangin atilin chuti chu ahipoi.
target: Jesus replied, “Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because your hearts were hard. But it was not this way from the beginning.

source: Keivangin kasei ahi, Koi hijongle mitoh ajon jeh tailouva aji ada-a ji dang nei chan chu ajonga ahi, chule akidasa kichenpi kitna jong chu ajonga ahi, ati.
target: I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman commits adultery.”

source: Hichun aseijuiten ajah-a, Chutia numei le pasal kiloimat dolthua pasal chunga chutobang thu ahile, jinei hi aphapoi, atiuvin ahi.
target: The disciples said to him, “If this is the situation between a husband and wife, it is better not to marry.”

source: Ahin aman ajah uva, Hiche hi mi jouse jop thei ahipoi, akipete bouvin ajop thei ahi.
target: Jesus replied, “Not everyone can accept this word, but only those to whom it has been given.

source: Mi anu sunga nukiso sa-a penga aumin, abang mihem semthu-a nukiso aumin, adang van lenggam khosahna jala amaho le amaho nukiso-a jong aume; ajop theipan jophen, ati.
target: For there are eunuchs who were born that way, and there are eunuchs who have been made eunuchs by others—and there are those who choose to live like eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. The one who can accept this should accept it.”

source: Chujouvin achunguva akhut angap-a ataopeh dingin chapangho ahenga ahinpuijun, hinla aseijuiten anaphoh-un ahi.
target: Then people brought little children to Jesus for him to place his hands on them and pray for them. But the disciples rebuked them.

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah uva, Chapangho chu kahenga hung sah-un, jada hih-un; ijeh-inem itile van lenggam chu hitobang tehoa bou ahi, ati.
target: Jesus said, “Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.”

source: Chutichun Aman achunguvah akhut angamin, chukom mun'a kon chun akipatdoh tai.
target: When he had placed his hands on them, he went on from there.

source: Chuin veuvin, mi khat ahenga ahungin, ajah-a, houhilpha, tonsot hinkemlou kanei theina dinga thilpha ipi kabol dingham, tin adongin ahi.
target: Just then a man came up to Jesus and asked, “Teacher, what good thing must I do to get eternal life?”

source: Chuin Aman ajah-a, ibolla apha neiti ham? Apha koima aumpoi, khat sehbou aume, ama chu Pathen ahi: ahinla nangma hinna-a chu nalut nomle thupeh chengse nitnin ati.
target: “Why do you ask me about what is good?” Jesus replied. “There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, keep the commandments.”

source: Mipa chun, Thupeh hoihoi chu-em? ati. Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah-a, Tolthat hih-in, Jon bol hih-in; Gucha hih-in, Thu jouvin mi heh hih-in.
target: “Which ones?” he inquired. Jesus replied, “ ‘You shall not murder, you shall not commit adultery, you shall not steal, you shall not give false testimony,

source: Nanu napa jabolin, Nangma naki ngailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun, ati.
target: honor your father and mother,’ and ‘love your neighbor as yourself.’”

source: Gollhangpa chun adonbutnin, Hichengse chu kachapan laija patna kanitsa ahitai; ipi kabatnah laijem, ati.
target: “All these I have kept,” the young man said. “What do I still lack?”

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, Nangman chamkimsoh ing natile, chenlang nanei chengse gajoh inlang mivaicha gentheiho petan, chutile van'a gou nanei ding ahi: chule hungin lang kanung hinjuijin, ati.
target: Jesus answered, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.”

source: Ahivangin gollhangpa chun chuche thuhil ajah phat chun, gou haotah ahi jeh-in lungnom mo tah-in achemang tan ahi.
target: When the young man heard this, he went away sad, because he had great wealth.

source: Hijeh chun Jesu'n aseijuite jah-a, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Mihao dingin van lenggama lut ahahsai.
target: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “Truly I tell you, it is hard for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of heaven.

source: Kaseipeh kit nahiuve, Mihao Pathen gama alut sangin, heubil homa sangongsang lut abaijoi, ati.
target: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of God.”

source: Chuin chuche ajah phatnun, aseijuiten kidang asabehseh jengun, Chuti ahile, koi huhhing-a um jou dingham? atiuvin ahi.
target: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished and asked, “Who then can be saved?”

source: Hichun Jesu'n amaho chu aven, ajah uva, Mihem dingin vang hitheihoi ahipoi, ahin Pathen dingin ijakai ahitheije, ati.
target: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

source: Chuphatnin Peter'in adonbutnin, Jesu jah-a, Vetemin, keihon ka-ima jouseu kadalhaovin, nanung kahinjui taove; achutile keihon ipi kasan dinguham? ati.
target: Peter answered him, “We have left everything to follow you! What then will there be for us?”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah uva, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Ijakai akisemthah-a Mihem Chapa aloupina laltouna-a atou tengle, nangho eijui chengse jong hi laltouna somlenia natou uva, Israel phung somle phung ni thu natan dingu ahi.
target: Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, at the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on his glorious throne, you who have followed me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

source: Chule Keima min jala, a-in, asopipate, asopinute, anu, apa, achate chule agam leiset hindalha chan chun, ajatja tamtah amube ding, chule tonsot hinkemlou chang ding ahi.
target: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for my sake will receive a hundred times as much and will inherit eternal life.

source: Amavang amasa cheng tamtah nukhah intin, anukhah cheng masa ding ahi.
target: But many who are first will be last, and many who are last will be first.

source: Ijeh-inem itile van lenggam chu inneipu khat jingpitah-a alengpi leija goi ding natong ding hola che tobang ahi.
target: “For the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire workers for his vineyard.

source: Chuin ama chun natong dingho chutoh ni khatna seki ni lo dinga akihoutoh phatnun, alengpi leija asoltai.
target: He agreed to pay them a denarius for the day and sent them into his vineyard.

source: Vai nungin apotdoh-in, kaithela mohseh-a dingho amun,
target: “About nine in the morning he went out and saw others standing in the marketplace doing nothing.

source: Ajah uva, Nangho jong lengpi leija konun; adoldolin napenao ving kate, ati. Chuin amaho chu achetauvin ahi.
target: He told them, ‘You also go and work in my vineyard, and I will pay you whatever is right.’

source: Chuin sunkimvel le ni kiheijin apotdoh-in chutobangma chu abol kitnin ahi.
target: So they went. “He went out again about noon and about three in the afternoon and did the same thing.

source: Chuin vaiche phattah-in ama apotdoh-in ahile, midang dingleho chu amun, ajah uva, Ibola sun nilhumkeija mohseh-a nadinu ham? ati.
target: About five in the afternoon he went out and found still others standing around. He asked them, ‘Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?’

source: Amahon adonbutnun, Koima eigoijuva aumpoi, atiuve. Aman ajah uva, Kalengpi leija konun, adol dola nakisan diu ahi, ati.
target: “ ‘Because no one has hired us,’ they answered. “He said to them, ‘You also go and work in my vineyard.’

source: Nilhah ahi phatnin, lengpilei neipa chun asum chingpa jah-a, Natongho kou inlang athamanu pen, goi nukhahpena patnin goi masahpena chaijin, ati.
target: “When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to his foreman, ‘Call the workers and pay them their wages, beginning with the last ones hired and going on to the first.’

source: Chuin vaiche phatna kigoipanho chu ahung phatnun, seki ni cheh asangtaovin ahi.
target: “The workers who were hired about five in the afternoon came and each received a denarius.

source: Chuin goi masahpenho chu ahung phatnun, kisangtam cheh-inte tin angaito uvin; amala amahon jong seki ni bou asang taovin ahi.
target: So when those came who were hired first, they expected to receive more. But each one of them also received a denarius.

source: Chuin hichu akilah nungun, inneipu chunga chun aphun taovin,
target: When they received it, they began to grumble against the landowner.

source: Anununghon nidan kah khatbou na atongun, nangman keiho nisa hahlai thoh-a tonggim chengtoh neikibah sah-un ahi, atiuvin ahi.
target: ‘These who were hired last worked only one hour,’ they said, ‘and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the work and the heat of the day.’

source: Ahin aman alah uva khatpa chu adonbutnin, Kajol, nachungah kakhelna aumpoi; seki ni dinga ikihou hilouham?
target: “But he answered one of them, ‘I am not being unfair to you, friend. Didn’t you agree to work for a denarius?

source: Nathaman sum kilah-in chetan, anunung penpa hi nang kapeh jatma chu kapeh nom-in ahi.
target: Take your pay and go. I want to give the one who was hired last the same as I gave you.

source: Kanei nahnah kanopnopma kabol chu kadih louham? Ole kaphat jeh-a hi neimit thip hitam?
target: Don’t I have the right to do what I want with my own money? Or are you envious because I am generous?’

source: Chutobang chun anukhah masan tin, amasa nukhah ding ahi, ati.
target: “So the last will be first, and the first will be last.”

source: Chuin Jesu Jerusalem lama achetou konin, somleni ho chu atumin gam choma apuijin, lam dungah ajah uva,
target: Now Jesus was going up to Jerusalem. On the way, he took the Twelve aside and said to them,

source: Veuvin, Jerusalem jonin ichetouvui; chule Mihem Chapa hi thempu pipuiho le danthu sunho khutna pehdoh-a umding; chule amaho chun athina dinga themmo achansah dingu ahi.
target: “We are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and the teachers of the law. They will condemn him to death

source: Chule a-el ela aboluva, ajepmuva, thingpel'a khetbeh dinga chidang namdangte khutna apehdoh dingu ahi; chule ni thum nile ama kaithouva umding ahi, ati.
target: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and flogged and crucified. On the third day he will be raised to life!”

source: Hiche petah chun Zebedee chapate anuvin achateni chu ahin kipuijin, Jesu henga ahungun, chibai aboh-in, ahenga ikhat thumnan ataovin ahi.
target: Then the mother of Zebedee’s sons came to Jesus with her sons and, kneeling down, asked a favor of him.

source: Aman amanu jah-a, ipi nangaichat ham? ati. Chuin amanun, Nagam sunga kachate ni hi khat najetna, khat naveija atou theina lhon ding thu pen, ati.
target: “What is it you want?” he asked. She said, “Grant that one of these two sons of mine may sit at your right and the other at your left in your kingdom.”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Nanghon nathumu chu nahet louvu ahi. Kadon ding khonna hi nadon lhona, chule baptize kachan ding hi nachan ngam lhon ding hinam? ati. Chuin amanin, Kangame, ati lhonin ahi.
target: “You don’t know what you are asking,” Jesus said to them. “Can you drink the cup I am going to drink?” “We can,” they answered.

source: Chuin aman, Kadona ding khonna vang chu nadon lhona, chule ka baptize chan banga hi nachan theihon ahinan; kajetle kaveija tousah ding vang chu keima peh dol ahipoi; ka-Pan adinguva agotsaho bou chu kipe ding ahi, ati.
target: Jesus said to them, “You will indeed drink from my cup, but to sit at my right or left is not for me to grant. These places belong to those for whom they have been prepared by my Father.”

source: Hichun somho chun hichu ajauvin, uchateni chunga chun alung phamo taovin ahi.
target: When the ten heard about this, they were indignant with the two brothers.

source: Ahinla Jesu'n amaho chu akouvin, ajah uva, Nanghon naheuve, chidang namdangte chunga vaipoho khu a-pakaiyu vin apangun, chule milen milaltehon achunguva athuneinau apanjiuve.
target: Jesus called them together and said, “You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.

source: Nangho lah-a vang chuti chu ahipoi; ahin koi hile nangho lah-a alen hi noma chu, nalhachaova pang ding;
target: Not so with you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,

source: Chule nalah uva apipuipen hi noma chu, nasoh-u hi ding ahi.
target: and whoever wants to be first must be your slave—

source: Chutobanga chu Mihem Chapatah jong chu jen dinga hung hilouvin, ajenle dingle mi tamtah lhatdoh na-a ahinna toh dingjoh-a hung ahi, ati.
target: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

source: Chuin Jericho khopi-a kona akipatdoh-in, mipi tamtah-in anung ajuijun ahi.
target: As Jesus and his disciples were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed him.

source: Chule, veuvin, mitcho ni lampamah atou lhonin, amani chun lampi chu Jesu'n ajotne ti ahet phat lhonin, Pakai, David chapa, neilungset lhonin, tin asam lhonin ahi.
target: Two blind men were sitting by the roadside, and when they heard that Jesus was going by, they shouted, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”

source: Chuin mipi chun, Thipbeh-in um lhonin, tin aphoh-un ahi; ahivangin amanin ahasapcheh lhonin, Pakai, David chapa, neilungset lhonin, ati lhonin ahi.
target: The crowd rebuked them and told them to be quiet, but they shouted all the louder, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”

source: Chuin Jesu adingin, amani chu akouvin, I-lolhon leng nalung lhonham? ati.
target: Jesus stopped and called them. “What do you want me to do for you?” he asked.

source: Amanin, Pakai, kamit lhon hasah-in, ati lhone.
target: “Lord,” they answered, “we want our sight.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n alung asen, amit lhon akhoipeh-in ahile amanin kho amupai jeng lhonin, chule anung ajui lhontai.
target: Jesus had compassion on them and touched their eyes. Immediately they received their sight and followed him.

source: Chuin Jerusalem ahung naijuva, Olive molsanga um Bethphage ageitah-un, Jesu'n aseijuite mi ni asolin,
target: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage on the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two disciples,

source: Ajah lhona, Namasang jon lhona kho sunga khun lut lhonin, chule sangan anoutoh kihen namu paijen lhon ding ahi; hiteni chu sut lhoninlang kahenga hinkai lhonin.
target: saying to them, “Go to the village ahead of you, and at once you will find a donkey tied there, with her colt by her. Untie them and bring them to me.

source: Mi khattou ikhat sei aumle, Pakaiyin hiche teni hi manna nom aneije ti lhonle chun, aman ahinsolpai jeng ding ahi, ati.
target: If anyone says anything to you, say that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away.”

source: Themgaovin anasei guilhuna dinga hiche ho jouse hi soh-a ahi,
target: This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet:

source: Nanghon Zion chanu jah-a, Ven, nalengpa lungnem tah-in sangan chungah, sangan nou chungah atouvin naheng-ah ahunge.
target: “Say to Daughter Zion, ‘See, your king comes to you, gentle and riding on a donkey, and on a colt, the foal of a donkey.’ ”

source: Chuti chun aseijuite ni chu ache lhonin, Jesu'n asei bangbang chun abol lhonin;
target: The disciples went and did as Jesus had instructed them.

source: Sangan le sangan nou chu ahinpuijun, achunga aponu aphaovin; achunga chun Jesu atousah-un ahi.
target: They brought the donkey and the colt and placed their cloaks on them for Jesus to sit on.

source: Chuin mipi lah-a atamjon lam dunga aponu aphaovin, adangsen theoboh alhamun, lam dunga aphaovin ahi.
target: A very large crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

source: Chule mipi amasang lama che chengsele anungjui chengse chun, David chapa, Hosanna, Pakai mina hungpa chu anunnome; Chungnung pena Hosanna! atiuvin asam asamun ahi.
target: The crowds that went ahead of him and those that followed shouted, “Hosanna to the Son of David!” “Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Hosanna in the highest heaven!”

source: Chuin Jerusalem alut phatnun, Hiche hi koiham? tin khopi pumpin akilohsoh jengun ahi.
target: When Jesus entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, “Who is this?”

source: Chuin mipi chun adonbutnun, Hiche hi Galilee gam Nazareth kho-a kon themgao Jesu ahi, atiuvin ahi.
target: The crowds answered, “This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee.”

source: Chuin Jesu Pathen houin'ah alutnin, houin sunga thil johho le thil choho abonchan anodoh-in, chule sumlheng ho dokhangle vakhu johho touna chu alekhup peh-in,
target: Jesus entered the temple courts and drove out all who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves.

source: Ajah uva, Ka-in chu taona in kiti ding ahi, tin akisune; ahin nanghon gucha michom kokhuh-in nasem uve, ati.
target: “It is written,” he said to them, “ ‘My house will be called a house of prayer,’ but you are making it ‘a den of robbers.’”

source: Chuin houin'a chun mitcho le elbaiho ahungun, aman amaho chu aboldamin ahi.
target: The blind and the lame came to him at the temple, and he healed them.

source: Ahin thempu pipuiho le danthu sunhon athilbol kidangle houin'a chapanghon Hosanna, David chapa, tia asap chu amuvin, alungphamo lheh jengtaovin,
target: But when the chief priests and the teachers of the law saw the wonderful things he did and the children shouting in the temple courts, “Hosanna to the Son of David,” they were indignant.

source: Amahon ajah-a, Hiteho hin ipi aseiju najah nah-em? atiuvin ahi. Chuin Jesu'n, Kajanai; Naosen leh chapang noi cheplai kamin jong vahchoina nachamkim sahtai, ti chu nasimdoh lou uham? ati.
target: “Do you hear what these children are saying?” they asked him. “Yes,” replied Jesus, “have you never read, “ ‘From the lips of children and infants you, Lord, have called forth your praise’ ?”

source: Chutichun aman amaho chu adalhan, khopi-a konin apotdoh-in Bethany'a achen; chua chun agehtai.
target: And he left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where he spent the night.

source: Chuin jingkah-in khopi lam ahinjon kitnin ahile, agil akeltan ahi.
target: Early in the morning, as Jesus was on his way back to the city, he was hungry.

source: Chuin Aman lamkenga theichang phung khat amun, aphunga achen ahile ana tailou imacha aga mupoi; Chuin Aman, Imatih chanin naga gakit tahih hen, ati. Chuin chupettah chun theichang phung chu agoppai jengtai.
target: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he went up to it but found nothing on it except leaves. Then he said to it, “May you never bear fruit again!” Immediately the tree withered.

source: Hichu aseijuiten amu phatnun, alungdong jengun, I-atile theichang phung chu goppai jenga hitante! atiuvin ahi.
target: When the disciples saw this, they were amazed. “How did the fig tree wither so quickly?” they asked.

source: Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah uva, Keiman tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Nanghon gingchalel louhela tahsan naneijule, hiche theichang phung hitia bolseh hilouvin, hiche molsang jong hi, Hikoma konin kichondoh inlang twikhanglen'a kileh luttan, ti jongleu chun hi thei ding ahi.
target: Jesus replied, “Truly I tell you, if you have faith and do not doubt, not only can you do what was done to the fig tree, but also you can say to this mountain, ‘Go, throw yourself into the sea,’ and it will be done.

source: Chule ipi hijongle tahsan tah-a taona-a nathum chanu chu aboncha namusoh dingu ahi, ati.
target: If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.”

source: Chujouvin Houin'a alutna thu ahil petnin, thempu pipuiho le upaho ahenga ahungun, ajah-a, Ipi thunei na-a hitiho hi nabolham? Kon hiche thuneina hi napeh ham? atiuvin ahi.
target: Jesus entered the temple courts, and, while he was teaching, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him. “By what authority are you doing these things?” they asked. “And who gave you this authority?”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Kenjong nangho thu khat donging kate; hichu naseijule kenjong ipi thuneija hicheng kabol ahi seipeh naovinge:
target: Jesus replied, “I will also ask you one question. If you answer me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.

source: John baptize bol chu hoija konham? van'a konha ahiloule mihem'a konham? ati. Chuin amaho akingai touvin, Van'a kon ahi, tileu henla, chuti ahile, Ibola ama natahsan lou uham? tintin;
target: John’s baptism—where did it come from? Was it from heaven, or of human origin?” They discussed it among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask, ‘Then why didn’t you believe him?’

source: Mihem'a kon ahi ti dingla, mipi jousen John chu themgao ahi tia angaito jeh-un ikichaovin, akitiuvin ahi.
target: But if we say, ‘Of human origin’—we are afraid of the people, for they all hold that John was a prophet.”

source: Chutichun amahon Jesu adonbutnun, Kahepouve, atitaove. Chuin Aman jong amaho jah-a, Achutile ipi thuneija hicheng kabol ham keiman jong naseipeh deh pouvinge, ati.
target: So they answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Then he said, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.

source: Ahivangin iti nangai touvem? Mi koiham khatnin chapa ni aneijin, khatpa henga achen ajah-a, Chapa, tunin lengpi leija konin lang na gatongin, ati.
target: “What do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first and said, ‘Son, go and work today in the vineyard.’

source: Aman, Kanompoi; chepong-e, tin adonbutnin, ahivangin khonungin alung aheijin, achetan ahi.
target: “ ‘I will not,’ he answered, but later he changed his mind and went.

source: Chuin khatjopa henga achen, ajah-a chutobangma chun agaseijin ahi. Aman, Hepa, chenange, tin adonbutnin; chela achetapon ahi.
target: “Then the father went to the other son and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I will, sir,’ but he did not go.

source: Hite ni chu koijoh chu apa lunga chonham? ati. Amahon, Amasajoh chu, atiuvin ahi. Chuin Jesu'n ajah uva, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Nangho sanga kaidongho le notiho Pathen lenggam sunga lut masajo ding ahiuve.
target: “Which of the two did what his father wanted?” “The first,” they answered. Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God ahead of you.

source: Ijeh-inem itile John chu chonphatna lampia naheng uva ahungin, nanghonla nanatahsan pouve; kaidongho le notihon bou anatahsan uvin ahi. Nangho vangin chuche namu-u jong chun, ama chu natahsan theina dingun, khonungin nalung naheichom dehpouvin ahi.
target: For John came to you to show you the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes did. And even after you saw this, you did not repent and believe him.

source: Thulem chom khat jong ngaikitnun: inneipa khat hin lengpilei abolin, palin aum kimvelin, lengpiga chil lhahna pum alaijin, insang asan, chuin alei lhouho khutna apedoh-in, gamdanga achemang tai.
target: “Listen to another parable: There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it and built a watchtower. Then he rented the vineyard to some farmers and moved to another place.

source: Chuin aga phat anai phatnin, atheiga la dingin aleilhouho henga asohte asoltan ahi.
target: When the harvest time approached, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his fruit.

source: Ahin aleilhouho chun anamanun, khat avovin, khat athatnun, athum napa songin asepmun ahi.
target: “The tenants seized his servants; they beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.

source: Asohte dang amasaho sanga tamjo asol kitnin ahile, amahon angaina bepmin anabolun ahi.
target: Then he sent other servants to them, more than the first time, and the tenants treated them the same way.

source: Akhonna-in aman, Kachapa hi anaja domunte, atin achapa ahenguva asoltai.
target: Last of all, he sent his son to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.

source: Ahinla lengpi leilhou hon achapa chu amu phatnun, amahole amaho akihouvun, Ama hi agou lo dinga ahi; hungun, thatnu hitin, agou lo ding eiho changuhite, akitiuvin ahi.
target: “But when the tenants saw the son, they said to each other, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and take his inheritance.’

source: Chuin ama chu amanun, lengpilei polamah akaidoh-un, athat taovin ahi.
target: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.

source: Hijeh chun lengpilei neipa chu ahung teng, chuche aleilhouho chu i-lontem? ati.
target: “Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants?”

source: Amahon ajah-a, Chuche migilouho chu aman engsanin sugamintin, aga phatseh-a atheiga ape ding leilhou dang khutna alengpi lei chu pedoh tante, atiuvin ahi.
target: “He will bring those wretches to a wretched end,” they replied, “and he will rent the vineyard to other tenants, who will give him his share of the crop at harvest time.”

source: Jesu'n ajah uva, In sahon adeimoa apaiju song chu aninga songpi penin apangtai; Hiche hi Pakaiya kon ahin, chule imitmuvin akidange, ti Pathen lekhabua thuhi nasimdoh khah lou uham?
target: Jesus said to them, “Have you never read in the Scriptures: “ ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone; the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes’ ?

source: Hiche jeh-a chu keiman nangho jah-a kasei ahi, Nangho-a kona Pathen lenggam kilamanga, agadohsah namdang mite kipe ding ahi.
target: “Therefore I tell you that the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce its fruit.

source: Koi hijongle hiche song chunga lhu-a chu ahal hala chip ding; chule koi hile achunga chuche song chua chu leivui banga kithejal ding ahi, ati.
target: Anyone who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces; anyone on whom it falls will be crushed.”

source: Chuin thempu pipuiho le Pharisai hon hiche athulem sei chu ajah phatnun, amaho chunga thusei ahi chu ahedoh taovin ahi.
target: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard Jesus’ parables, they knew he was talking about them.

source: Chuin ama chu mat dingin agouvin, ahivangin themgao ahi tia angaito jeh-un, mipi chu akichauvin ahi.
target: They looked for a way to arrest him, but they were afraid of the crowd because the people held that he was a prophet.

source: Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah uva thulemin asei kitnin,
target: Jesus spoke to them again in parables, saying:

source: Pathen lenggam chu Lengpa khat achapa jineina dinga golvah bol tobang ahi;
target: “The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son.

source: Aman agolvahna-a dinga kouna changho chu hungtaovin tia kou dingin asohte asolin; ahinla amaho chu ahung nompouvin ahi.
target: He sent his servants to those who had been invited to the banquet to tell them to come, but they refused to come.

source: Chuin aman asohte asol kitnin, Akikouho henga cheovin lang, Veuvin, golvahna an aphasadema kagot ahitai: kabongchal le kagancha thao ho akithat tan, chule abonchan phasademin gotsan aumsohtai; nangho moupui golvahna-a hunguvin, tin gaseijun, ati.
target: “Then he sent some more servants and said, ‘Tell those who have been invited that I have prepared my dinner: My oxen and fattened cattle have been butchered, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding banquet.’

source: Ahivangin amahon dona neipeh louvin, achemang gamuvin, khat alouva achen, khat sumkol veijin achen;
target: “But they paid no attention and went off—one to his field, another to his business.

source: Adangsen asohte chu amanun, nahsahmo tah-in abolun, athat taovin ahi.
target: The rest seized his servants, mistreated them and killed them.

source: Ahin lengpan hichu ajah phatnin, alunghang tan; asepaite chengse asolin, chuche tolthat ho chu asumanghelun, akhou jong ahalpeh taovin ahi.
target: The king was enraged. He sent his army and destroyed those murderers and burned their city.

source: Chutah-in asohte jah-a, Golvahna an gotsa ahitai, ane dinga kakou tehola anehoi ahipouve.
target: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited did not deserve to come.

source: Hijeh chun lamka lamthoma cheovinlang, mi namu chanu golvah an nedingin gakouvun, ati.
target: So go to the street corners and invite to the banquet anyone you find.’

source: Chutichun asohte chu apot-un lampi dunga acheuvin amu chanu mipha mise apui khomun ahile, golvahna indan chu jin adimset tan ahi.
target: So the servants went out into the streets and gathered all the people they could find, the bad as well as the good, and the wedding hall was filled with guests.

source: Chuin lengpa chu jinho velen ahungin ahile, moupuina vona kivon lou mi khat amudohtan ahi.
target: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he noticed a man there who was not wearing wedding clothes.

source: Aman, Kajol, moupuina vona kivon louva hikoma iti nahung lutham? tin adongin ahile, amapa sei ding helouvin aumtan ahi.
target: He asked, ‘How did you get in here without wedding clothes, friend?’ The man was speechless.

source: Chuphatnin lengpan asottolleho jah-a, Akhut akeng kanun lang, kaidoh-un, chule polam muthim lah-a paidoh taovin; hikoma chu kale hagel umding ahi.
target: “Then the king told the attendants, ‘Tie him hand and foot, and throw him outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

source: Akikou vang tamtah ahin lhendoh vang lhomcha bou ahi, ati.
target: “For many are invited, but few are chosen.”

source: Chuin Pharisai hon athuseija kona mat theina ding doha abolun akihou taovin ahi.
target: Then the Pharisees went out and laid plans to trap him in his words.

source: Chuin aseijuiteu chu Herod miho toh asolun, amaho chun ajah-a, Houhil, nangma mi dihtah nahi, dihtah-a Pathen lampi chu nahil ahin, chule koima gin naneipoi ti kaheuve; nangman mimai navepoi.
target: They sent their disciples to him along with the Herodians. “Teacher,” they said, “we know that you are a man of integrity and that you teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. You aren’t swayed by others, because you pay no attention to who they are.

source: Hijeh chun Caesar kai kapeh-u hi, dan ngai ham, hilouham? iti nagelem? neisei peh-un, atiuvin ahi.
target: Tell us then, what is your opinion? Is it right to pay the imperial tax to Caesar or not?”

source: Jesu'n alunggilou vop-u chu ahen, ajah uva, Vo miphalhem ho, ibola neilunglah uham?
target: But Jesus, knowing their evil intent, said, “You hypocrites, why are you trying to trap me?

source: Kai kidon na-a sum kipeji chu neivet sah-un, ati. Chuin amahon dinarii khat ahinchoi jun ahi.
target: Show me the coin used for paying the tax.” They brought him a denarius,

source: Chuin Aman, Hiche hi koi lim le koi minham? tin adonge.
target: and he asked them, “Whose image is this? And whose inscription?”

source: Amahon, Caesar'a ahi, tin adonbutnuve. Chuphatnin Aman, Caesar'a chu Caesar peuvinlang, Pathen'a chu Pathen peuvin, ati.
target: “Caesar’s,” they replied. Then he said to them, “So give back to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”

source: Chuche ajah phatnun, adatmouvin, ama adalhauvin, achemang taovin ahi.
target: When they heard this, they were amazed. So they left him and went away.

source: Chuche nimama chun, Mithi thokitna aumpoi ti Saddukai ho ahenga ahungun, thu ahung dongun,
target: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.

source: Houhil, mi khatcha nei louva athile, asopipan anumeinu chu akichenpia, asopipa dinga chu chi akhaipeh ding ahi, tin Mosi'n eihilun ahi.
target: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses told us that if a man dies without having children, his brother must marry the widow and raise up offspring for him.

source: Ahile tun kalah uva ucha pasal sagi aumun; amasapenpa chun ji aneijin athitai; ahin ama chu chikhai lou ahitah jeh chun, a-inneipi chu asopipa adalhah pehtai.
target: Now there were seven brothers among us. The first one married and died, and since he had no children, he left his wife to his brother.

source: Chuti chun abanapa jong, athumnapa jong, asaginapa geijin chutima chun aumtan ahi.
target: The same thing happened to the second and third brother, right on down to the seventh.

source: Akhonna-in anumeinu chu athitai.
target: Finally, the woman died.

source: Ahile thokitna-a amanu chu sagi lah-a koipen ji hitantem? Amahonla ji-a anei sohkeiju ahin, atiuvin ahi.
target: Now then, at the resurrection, whose wife will she be of the seven, since all of them were married to her?”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Pathen lekhabua thu le Pathen thahatna nahetlou jeh uva nakheljiu ahi.
target: Jesus replied, “You are in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.

source: Thokitna-a chun amaho akicheng tapouvin, chen jong akichensah tapouve; van'a Pathen vantilte tobang ahiuve.
target: At the resurrection people will neither marry nor be given in marriage; they will be like the angels in heaven.

source: Ahinla mithi thokit dol thu Pathen'in najah uva asei,
target: But about the resurrection of the dead—have you not read what God said to you,

source: Keima Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, chule Jacob Pathen kahi, ati chu simkha lou nahiuvem? Ama athiho Pathen hilouvin, ahingho Pathen ahijo bouve, ati.
target: ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? He is not the God of the dead but of the living.”

source: Mipi chun hichu ajauvin, athuhil chu kidang asa lheh jengun ahi.
target: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at his teaching.

source: Aman Saddukai ho anelkhup hel jeng chu ajah phatnun, Pharisai ho akikhomun ahi.
target: Hearing that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, the Pharisees got together.

source: Chule alah uva danthuthem khatnin apatepnan thu adongin,
target: One of them, an expert in the law, tested him with this question:

source: Houhil, chondan thupeh lah-a apipen hoiche ham? ati.
target: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the Law?”

source: Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, Nangman nalung pumpin, nalhagao pumpin Pakai na-Pathen chu ngailun.
target: Jesus replied: “ ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’

source: Hichu thupeh pipen le amasapen ahi.
target: This is the first and greatest commandment.

source: Chule chutobanga chu anina hiche ahi, Nangma naki ngailut bangin naheng nakoma ngailun.
target: And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’

source: Thupeh hichete ni-a hin thupeh jouse le themgaoho thu kikhai cheh ahi ati.
target: All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments.”

source: Chuin Pharisai ho akikhop petnun, Jesu'n amaho thu adongin, ajah uva,
target: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,

source: Messiah thudol hi iti nagel uvem? Ama koi chapaham? atin ahile amahon, David chapa, atiuvin ahi.
target: “What do you think about the Messiah? Whose son is he?” “The son of David,” they replied.

source: Chuin Aman ajah uva, Chuti ahile,
target: He said to them, “How is it then that David, speaking by the Spirit, calls him ‘Lord’? For he says,

source: Pakaiyin ka Pakai jah-a, Keiman namelmate chengse nakeng chotpha kaneisah masangsen, kajetlama tou jingin, ati tia David chun Lhagaova ama chu Pakai iti atiham?
target: “ ‘The Lord said to my Lord: “Sit at my right hand until I put your enemies under your feet.” ’

source: Chutia David'in ama Pakai asahle, achapa iti hi dingham? ati.
target: If then David calls him ‘Lord,’ how can he be his son?”

source: Chuin koimachan cheng khatchan jong adonbut thei tapouvin, chuche ni-a pat chun koimachan thudang khatcha jong adong ngam tapouvin ahi.
target: No one could say a word in reply, and from that day on no one dared to ask him any more questions.

source: Hichun Jesu'n mipi jahle aseijuite jah-a,
target: Then Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples:

source: Danthu sunho le Pharisai ho Mosi touna mun'a tou ahiuve.
target: “The teachers of the law and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat.

source: Hiche jeh chun athupeh chengseu abonchan bolunlang nit sohkeijun; ahin athilbol bangun vang bol hih-un; ijeh-inem itile amahon asei chu aseijun abolji pouve.
target: So you must be careful to do everything they tell you. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.

source: Amahon doutheilou pohgih akanun miho lengkouvah asep-un, amahonla akhutjung khatchan jong thamloh ding anompouve.
target: They tie up heavy, cumbersome loads and put them on other people’s shoulders, but they themselves are not willing to lift a finger to move them.

source: Ahin amahon athilbol jouseu khu mi mu dingabou abolu ahi; ijeh-inem itile amahon thuchinbom akibu ule akibehho chengu khu apeh aletsah-un; chule aponmongu acholsah-un,
target: “Everything they do is done for people to see: They make their phylacteries wide and the tassels on their garments long;

source: Golvahna-a mun pipen chule kikhopna in'a touna pipen,
target: they love the place of honor at banquets and the most important seats in the synagogues;

source: Kai lhanga min chibai aboh dingule, min Rabbi, Rabbi, ati dingu adeijun ahi.
target: they love to be greeted with respect in the marketplaces and to be called ‘Rabbi’ by others.

source: Nanghon vang mi Rabbi kitisah hih-un; ijeh-inem itile nangho nahiluva khat, Christa jengtah chu aumnai. Chule nangho nabonchaovin sopikhat cheh nahiuve.
target: “But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers.

source: Vannoi leiset chunga koima pa sah hih-un; ijeh-inem itile van'ah na-Pau khat aume.
target: And do not call anyone on earth ‘father,’ for you have one Father, and he is in heaven.

source: Chule nanghon mi lamkai kitisah hih-un; ijeh-inem itile nalamkaija khat, Christa jengbou ahi.
target: Nor are you to be called instructors, for you have one Instructor, the Messiah.

source: Nalah uva alenpen chu najenleuva pang ding ahibouve.
target: The greatest among you will be your servant.

source: Koi hile ama kichoi sang chu kisunem ding; chule koi hile akineosah-a chu kichoi sang ding ahi.
target: For those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.

source: Ahinla ohe, Danthu sun le Pharisai miphalhem ho, nadau ahi! Ijeh-inem itile nanghon miho masanga van lenggam nakhah-un; nanghola nalutpouvin, chule lut dinga kigoho jong nalutsah pouvin ahi.
target: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You shut the door of the kingdom of heaven in people’s faces. You yourselves do not enter, nor will you let those enter who are trying to.

source: Ohe, Danthusun le Pharisai miphalhem ho, nadau ahi! Ijeh-inem itile mi khat Juda hou housahna dingin twikhanglen le leiset chunga nache kimvel leuvin, chule koi hile najopjop chu nangho sanga ajat ni-a damun mi nahisah jiuvin ahi.
target: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You travel over land and sea to win a single convert, and when you have succeeded, you make them twice as much a child of hell as you are.

source: Ohe, lamhil mitcho ho, nadau ahi! Ijeh-inem itile nanghon koi hile houin pana kihahsel imathu aumpoi; koi hile houin'a um sana pana kihahsel bou chu leiba ahi, nati uve.
target: “Woe to you, blind guides! You say, ‘If anyone swears by the temple, it means nothing; but anyone who swears by the gold of the temple is bound by that oath.’

source: Vo lungthimbei le mitcho ho, sana suthenga houin le sana chu hoijoh chungnung-jo-a ham?
target: You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes the gold sacred?

source: Chule nanghon, Koi hile maicham pana kihahsel imathu aumpoi, maicham chunga um thilto pana kihahsel bou chu leiba ahi, nati uve.
target: You also say, ‘If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing; but anyone who swears by the gift on the altar is bound by that oath.’

source: Vo mitcho ho, thilto suthenga maicham le thilto chu hoijoh chungnung-jo-a ham?
target: You blind men! Which is greater: the gift, or the altar that makes the gift sacred?

source: Hijeh chun koi hile maicham pana kihahsela chun, maicham le achunga um thilto aboncha apatna kihahsela ahi.
target: Therefore, anyone who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.

source: Chule koi hile houin pana kihahsela chun, houin le achengpa chu agoma apatna kihahsela ahi.
target: And anyone who swears by the temple swears by it and by the one who dwells in it.

source: Chule koi hile van pana kihahsela chun, Pathen touna le achunga Toupa agoma apatna kihahsel ahi.
target: And anyone who swears by heaven swears by God’s throne and by the one who sits on it.

source: Ohe, Danthu sun le Pharisai miphalhem ho, nadau ahi! Ijeh-inem itile nanghon pudina le pathikhom, chule jira hicheng chu somakhat natohji uvin, danthupeh lah-a alupen, thu adih-a tan, milungset, chule tahsan hicheng chu nalhadah-un ahi. Ahin hicheho hi naman uva, hitiho jong chu nalha lou dingu ahi.
target: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You give a tenth of your spices—mint, dill and cumin. But you have neglected the more important matters of the law—justice, mercy and faithfulness. You should have practiced the latter, without neglecting the former.

source: Vo lamhil mitcho ho, nanghon thouvaisi nalhiuvin, sagongsang napumval-ui!
target: You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.

source: Ohe, Danthu sun le Pharisai miphalhem ho, nadau ahi! Ijeh-inem itile nanghon khonle lheng apolam nasil ngimun, asunglam hunama lah le kitimlouna adimsetnin ahi.
target: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.

source: Vo Pharisai mitcho, khonle lheng chu asunglam silngim masale chun, apolam jong ngim dingbou ahi.
target: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, and then the outside also will be clean.

source: Ohe, Danthusun le Pharisai miphalhem ho, nadau ahi! Ijeh-inem itile nangho lhan bangleh-a kiloi tobang nahiuve; hitiho chu apolam hoilheh-in akimun, asunglam mithi gu le imanen aboh jouse adimsetnin ahi.
target: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of the bones of the dead and everything unclean.

source: Chutobang chun nangho jong napolamu mi mu dingin chonphatah nahiuve; ahin nasunglamu vang phatlhemna le khangitlouna adimsetnin ahi.
target: In the same way, on the outside you appear to people as righteous but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.

source: Ohe, Danthu sun le Pharisai miphalhem ho, nadau ahi! Ijeh-inem itile nanghon themgaoho lhan nasemun, chule michonpha ho lhan najemun,
target: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the graves of the righteous.

source: Chule, Kapu kapateu hinlaija chu keiho uma hileuveng, themgaoho thisan sona-a chu pan kalahlou dingu ahi, nati uve.
target: And you say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our ancestors, we would not have taken part with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’

source: Chutichun nangho themgaoho that teho son nahiuve ti chu, nangho le nangho ahetoh-a nahiu ahi.
target: So you testify against yourselves that you are the descendants of those who murdered the prophets.

source: Napu napateu thil tena dan chu bulhit pai ngaltaovin.
target: Go ahead, then, and complete what your ancestors started!

source: Vo gulteho, gulse sonho, nangho hi damun thutan na-a kona iti nahoi thei dinguham?
target: “You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape being condemned to hell?

source: Veuvin, keiman naheng uva themgao, miching, chonna danthuhil kahinsole; amaho lah-a chu abang nathauva thingpel'a nakhetbeh uva, abang kikhopna ina najep uva, chule khotina nabolset dingu ahi.
target: Therefore I am sending you prophets and sages and teachers. Some of them you will kill and crucify; others you will flog in your synagogues and pursue from town to town.

source: Hichu michonpha Abel thisan kiso-a pat, houin le maicham kikah-a natha-u Barachiah chapa Zekariah thisan kiso geija, leiset chunga michonphateho thisan kiso themona jouse aboncha nangho chunga achuh theina dinga ahi.
target: And so upon you will come all the righteous blood that has been shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berekiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.

source: Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Hicheng chu aboncha tulai mite chunga chu ding ahi.
target: Truly I tell you, all this will come on this generation.

source: Vo Jerusalem, Jerusalem, themgaoho that le ahenga kisol teho songa seplih, ahpin anoute alha noija a-opkhum banga keiman jong nachate ijatvei opkhum dinga kagot hitam! Ahin nangho nanompouve.
target: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you were not willing.

source: Veuvin, na-in'u chu akamhel dinga nangho kidalhah peh nahitaove.
target: Look, your house is left to you desolate.

source: Ijeh-inem itile kaseipeh nahiuve, Pakai mina hungpa chu anunnome, nati masangseuva, tukala keima neimu lou dingu ahi, ati.
target: For I tell you, you will not see me again until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.’”

source: Chuin Jesu houin'a kona apotdoh-a achele; houin kisahdan ho chu vetsah dingin aseijuite ahenga ahungun ahi.
target: Jesus left the temple and was walking away when his disciples came up to him to call his attention to its buildings.

source: Ahin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah uva, Nanghon hicheng hi namu lou uham? Keiman tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Hikoma hi song suhchim louva khat chunga khat kisethop himhim umlou helding ahi, ati.
target: “Do you see all these things?” he asked. “Truly I tell you, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”

source: Chuin Olive mol chunga atou petnin aseijuite guhthimin ahenga ahungun, Hicheng chu itihle hi dingham? Chule nangma hung kit ding phatle vannoi leiset kichai ni ding melchihna ipi hi dingham? neisei peh-un, atiuvin ahi.
target: As Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately. “Tell us,” they said, “when will this happen, and what will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the age?”

source: Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah uva hitin aseije, Koiman nangho nalheplhah louna dingun kichih theijun,
target: Jesus answered: “Watch out that no one deceives you.

source: Ijeh-inem itile mi tamtah keima minin hunguntin, Keima Christa kahi tiuvintin, mi tamtah alheplhah dingu ahi.
target: For many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am the Messiah,’ and will deceive many.

source: Chule nanghon gal kisatle kidou thuthang najah dingu ahi; chingtheijun, lungdong hih-un; ijeh-inem itile hicheng chu hungsoh tei ding ahi; ahivangin achaina hiloulai ding ahi.
target: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is still to come.

source: Ijeh-inem itile vai khatle vai khat, gam khat le gam khat hung kidouvintin, mun chom choma kel lhantin, nat set lengin tin, ling kihot ding ahi.
target: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.

source: Hitiho jouse chu naosonat kipan ahi.
target: All these are the beginning of birth pains.

source: Hiche phat teng chule genthei hesoh thoh dinga mihon nangho nahinpehdoh dingu ahi; chule keima min jala nangho namtin jouse hotna nahung umdingu ahi.
target: “Then you will be handed over to be persecuted and put to death, and you will be hated by all nations because of me.

source: Hiteng chule mi tamtah lunglha ding ahi, chule khatle khat kipedoh tontin, chule khat le khat kihoto ding ahi.
target: At that time many will turn away from the faith and will betray and hate each other,

source: Chule themgao lhem tamtah sohdoh-a, mi tamtah alheplhah dingu ahi.
target: and many false prophets will appear and deceive many people.

source: Chule chonset puncheh cheh jeh-a, mi tamtah ngailutna-a lhadai dingu ahi.
target: Because of the increase of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold,

source: Ahinla akhon ni geija thoh lhumkeija pangdetpa bou chu huhhing-a umding ahi.
target: but the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.

source: Chule namtin jouse hetsahna dinga hiche gamsung thupha hi vannoi leiset pumpi-a kihil lhang ding ahi; chutahle kichai dingbou ahi.
target: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in the whole world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.

source: Chuti ahijeh chun mi sumang thet umtah thil thudol Daniel themgao sei chu mun thenga adin namu tengule, (asim siman hehen,)
target: “So when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination that causes desolation,’ spoken of through the prophet Daniel—let the reader understand—

source: Chutengle Juda gama um chengse thinglhang lamah jamuhen;
target: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

source: In chunga uma jong a-in'a athilkeo kilah dingin kumdahen;
target: Let no one on the housetop go down to take anything out of the house.

source: Chule louva um jong apon kilah dingin kile kitdahen.
target: Let no one in the field go back to get their cloak.

source: Ahin ohe, hiche lai chule naovop hole nao noichepsah ho ada nadinguve!
target: How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers!

source: Chule najamnao chu phalbilai ahiloule cholngah ni ahi louna dingin taovun.
target: Pray that your flight will not take place in winter or on the Sabbath.

source: Ijeh-inem itile hiche teng chule hesoh genthei khoh chungnung umding ahi; chutobang hesoh gentheina chu leiset umtilla pat tu geijin aumkha hihlaije, um jong umlou ding ahi.
target: For then there will be great distress, unequaled from the beginning of the world until now—and never to be equaled again.

source: Chule hiche nikho chu kisuchom lou hileh, mihem himhim ahinga sohcha umlou dinga ahi; ahinla lhenchomte jala anikho chu kisuchom ding ahi.
target: “If those days had not been cut short, no one would survive, but for the sake of the elect those days will be shortened.

source: Chutengle, khat touvin najah uva, Ven, Christa hikoma aume, ahiloule, khukomah, tijongle tahsan hih-un.
target: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Messiah!’ or, ‘There he is!’ do not believe it.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Christa lhemho le themgao lhemho hung sohdoh untin, melchihna loupi tahtah le mu kidang ahinvetsah dingu ahi; ahitheile lhenchomte tah jeng jong ahinlheplhah dingu ahi.
target: For false messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.

source: Veuvin, Keiman kahil masah dem nahitaove.
target: See, I have told you ahead of time.

source: Hijeh chun mihon najah uva, Ven, gamthipmah aume atiuva ahile, chedoh hih-un, ahiloule, Ven, indan sungnunga aume, atiu jongle tahsan hih-un.
target: “So if anyone tells you, ‘There he is, out in the wilderness,’ do not go out; or, ‘Here he is, in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.

source: Ijeh-inem itile kolphe niso lama ahung phetdohle, nilhum lam geijin asalvah-in; Mihem Chapa hung kit jong chutobang ding ahi.
target: For as lightning that comes from the east is visible even in the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.

source: Thilong um umna-a bou muthong kikhom ding ahi.
target: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.

source: Ahivangin chutenga hesoh genthei joutah chule nisa thimintin, lha jong vahta lou ding, vanlaijola ahsi ho pullhantin, chule van thahatna ho chengse kihot lingsoh ding ahi.
target: “Immediately after the distress of those days “ ‘the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from the sky, and the heavenly bodies will be shaken.’

source: Chutahle vanlaijola Mihem Chapa melchihna hung kilang ding; chuteng tahle vannoi leiset phungtin-in a-op achupchup dingu ahi, chule vanlaijola Mihem Chapa thuneitah le loupi chungnung tah-a meilom lah-a ahung amu dingu ahi.
target: “Then will appear the sign of the Son of Man in heaven. And then all the peoples of the earth will mourn when they see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory.

source: Chule aman avantilte sumkon gin nasatahtoh asoldoh ding; chule amahon van mong khatna patna van mong khat geija, kolkimvel li-a kona alhen chomte alon khom dingu ahi.
target: And he will send his angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather his elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.

source: Theichang phung hin thulem kihilun. Abah adona ana ahungnou tengle, nipi anaitai ti nanghon naheuve.
target: “Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its twigs get tender and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.

source: Chutobang chun nangho jong hichengse chu aboncha namusoh tengule, anai tai, kotbul hungeija ahitai ti heuvin.
target: Even so, when you see all these things, you know that it is near, right at the door.

source: Keiman nangho tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Hichengse chu aboncha aguilhun masangse-a, hiche khangguija mite hi mang lou ding ahi.
target: Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.

source: Vanle lei mang ding ahin; keima thu vang mang lou ding ahi.
target: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.

source: Ahivangin ka Pa changseh tilou van'a vantilte jong, koimachan anikho le anidan tah chu ahepoi.
target: “But about that day or hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

source: Ahinla Noah nikho tobang chu Mihem Chapa hungkit nijong hiding ahi.
target: As it was in the days of Noah, so it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.

source: Ijeh-inem itile twisanglet masangin, Noah kong'a alut ni geijin, mihon aneuvin adonun, akichengun, akichensah-un,
target: For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark;

source: Chule twisang ahung letna abonchauva alhohmang gam kahse chun ima hepha louvin aumun ahi; Mihem Chapa hung ni jongle chutobang ding ahi.
target: and they knew nothing about what would happen until the flood came and took them all away. That is how it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.

source: Chutengle mi ni louva um, khat kila-a khat kidalha ding ahi.
target: Two men will be in the field; one will be taken and the other left.

source: Numei ni sumheija chang goikhoma, khat kila-a khat kidalha ding ahi.
target: Two women will be grinding with a hand mill; one will be taken and the other left.

source: Hijeh chun kiging jingin umum; ijeh-inem itile na-Pakaiyu ipi nikho le nidana ahung ding nanghon nahepouve.
target: “Therefore keep watch, because you do not know on what day your Lord will come.

source: Itih phatna gucha ahung ding inneipun ahet hile, kiging jingintin, a-in aphetvangsah lou ding ahi; hichu nanghon heuvin
target: But understand this: If the owner of the house had known at what time of night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.

source: Hijeh chun nangho phasademin umun; ijeh-inem itile nagel lou pettah-ule Mihem Chapa chu hung ding ahi.
target: So you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him.

source: Ahile, a-pakaiyin aphat phatcha achan dingu an hoppeh ding a-in sunga jouse chunga apipua apansah, soh tahsan umtah chingtah koiham?
target: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of the servants in his household to give them their food at the proper time?

source: A-pakai ahung tenga chutia bol ahungto soh chu anunnom ahi.
target: It will be good for that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.

source: Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, aman ama chu anei jouse chunga apipua apansah ding ahi.
target: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.

source: Amavang soh gilou chun alungthimin, Ka pakai ahung geije, tihen,
target: But suppose that servant is wicked and says to himself, ‘My master is staying away a long time,’

source: Asoh chanpiho dengpan tahen, chule ju khamho toh ne khom don khomtale,
target: and he then begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.

source: Hiche sohpa chun aginchat lou nitahle ahetlou pettah-a a-pakaipa chu hunga;
target: The master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he is not aware of.

source: Ama chu tum ni asoa, achan miphalhem ho lah-a akoi ding ahi; hikoma chu kale hagel umding ahi.
target: He will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

source: Hiteng chule van lenggam chu thaomei kikenna mou in neipu lamto dinga potdoh nungah somtoh kitekah ding ahi.
target: “At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

source: Alah uva nga chu lungthim bei ahiuvin, nga chu lungthim pha ahiuve.
target: Five of them were foolish and five were wise.

source: Ijeh-inem itile lungthim bei chengse chun, thaomei akikenu chun thaotwi akentha pouvin ahi.
target: The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take any oil with them.

source: Ahin lungthim pha chengse vang chun, thaomei akenu chun atheija thaotwi akentha uvin ahi.
target: The wise ones, however, took oil in jars along with their lamps.

source: Chuin mou inneipu chu ahung gei jeh-in abonchauvin alulhuvin, a-imulhu gam taovin ahi.
target: The bridegroom was a long time in coming, and they all became drowsy and fell asleep.

source: Ahin jan khang kimim, Veuvin, mou inneipu ahunge! Alamto dingin potdoh-un, tin akisamtan ahi.
target: “At midnight the cry rang out: ‘Here’s the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!’

source: Chutah-in hiche nungah ho chu athouvun, athaomei cheh-u akigot taovin ahi.
target: “Then all the virgins woke up and trimmed their lamps.

source: Hichun lungthim beiho chun lungthim phaho jah-a chun, Nathao twi'u themkhat neipeuvin; ijeh-inem itile keiho thaomei mit ding kon ahitai, atiuvin ahi.
target: The foolish ones said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil; our lamps are going out.’

source: Ahivangin lungthim phaho chun adonbutnun, Keihole nangho igomuva dingin lhingponte; chusangin ajohho henga cheovinlang nangho ding gakichoh taovin, atiuvin ahi.
target: “ ‘No,’ they replied, ‘there may not be enough for both us and you. Instead, go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.’

source: Ahinla acho dinga ache kah-un mou inneipu chu ahungtan; chule kigosa dema umho chu amatoh mou puina in'ah thakhatnin alut taovin; chule kot akikhah tan ahi.
target: “But while they were on their way to buy the oil, the bridegroom arrived. The virgins who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet. And the door was shut.

source: Chujouvin nungah dangho chu ahungun, Pakai, Pakai, kot neihonun, atiuvin ahi.
target: “Later the others also came. ‘Lord, Lord,’ they said, ‘open the door for us!’

source: Ahinla aman adonbutnin, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Keiman nangho kahepouve, atitai.
target: “But he replied, ‘Truly I tell you, I don’t know you.’

source: Hijeh chun kiging jingin umun, ijeh-inem itile Mihem Chapa hung nading anikhole anidan tah chu nanghon nahepouve.
target: “Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour.

source: Ijeh-inem itile van lenggam chu asohte kou khoma anei chengse amaho khutna pedoh-a, khol gama chemang mi khat tobang ahi.
target: “Again, it will be like a man going on a journey, who called his servants and entrusted his wealth to them.

source: Aman khat chu talent nga apen, khat talent ni apen, khat talent khat apen, athan ajokhop cheh-in sum apen, akipat dohtai.
target: To one he gave five bags of gold, to another two bags, and to another one bag, each according to his ability. Then he went on his journey.

source: Chuin talent nga sangpa chun chupettah chun achen hiche chun akiveijin, talent ngama aveikanben ahi.
target: The man who had received five bags of gold went at once and put his money to work and gained five bags more.

source: Chutobangma chun talent ni sangpa chun talent nima aveikanben ahi.
target: So also, the one with two bags of gold gained two more.

source: Ahin talent khat sangpa vang chun achen, leiko alaijin, a-pakaipa sum chu agasel mangtan ahi.
target: But the man who had received one bag went off, dug a hole in the ground and hid his master’s money.

source: Chuin phatsot tah nungin hiche soh ho pakaipa chu ahungin, amaho chutoh sum asutoh taovin ahi.
target: “After a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them.

source: Chuin talent nga sangpa chun talent nga ahinchoiben, Pakai, nangman talent nga neipeh ahin; ven keiman talent nga kaveikan ben ahi, ati.
target: The man who had received five bags of gold brought the other five. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘you entrusted me with five bags of gold. See, I have gained five more.’

source: Chuin apakai pan ajah-a, Soh pha tahsan umtah, nabol aphatave; nangma themcha khat chunga tahsan umtah nahin, keiman nangma tamtah chunga kapansah ding nahi; nangma na pakai kipana-ah luttan, ati.
target: “His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Come and share your master’s happiness!’

source: Chuin talent ni sangpa jong chu ahungin, Pakai, nangman keima talent ni neipeh ahin; ven keiman talent ni kaveikan ben ahi, ati.
target: “The man with two bags of gold also came. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘you entrusted me with two bags of gold; see, I have gained two more.’

source: Chuin a-pakaipan ajah-a, Soh pha tahsan umtah, nabol aphatave; nangma themcha khat chunga tahsan umtah nahin, keiman nangma tamtah chunga kapansah ding nahi; nangma napakai kipana-ah luttan, ati.
target: “His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Come and share your master’s happiness!’

source: Chujouvin talent khat sangpa chu ahungin, Pakai, nangma hi mikhel nahin, natuna louvah na-atjin, nathejalna lou pouvah nahuikhomjin ahi; hichu kahen;
target: “Then the man who had received one bag of gold came. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘I knew that you are a hard man, harvesting where you have not sown and gathering where you have not scattered seed.

source: Nangma kakichan, kachen nasum talent chu leiah kaseltan ahi: ven, nangma-a ma chu nakimu ahi, ati.
target: So I was afraid and went out and hid your gold in the ground. See, here is what belongs to you.’

source: Ahin a-pakaipan adonbutnin ajah-a, Soh giloule thase, katuna louva ka-atjia, kathe jalna louva kahui khomji nahet ahi.
target: “His master replied, ‘You wicked, lazy servant! So you knew that I harvest where I have not sown and gather where I have not scattered seed?

source: Chuti an kasum chu sum veipung na-a anakoi tangem, chutile kei kahung phatna asumthoi puma keiman kasum muta dinga.
target: Well then, you should have put my money on deposit with the bankers, so that when I returned I would have received it back with interest.

source: Hijeh chun hiche talent chu lahpeh-un lang, talent som neipa chu petaovin,
target: “ ‘So take the bag of gold from him and give it to the one who has ten bags.

source: Ijeh-inem itile anei chana chu kipehbe-a, aneiletset ding ahi; anei lou vang chu aneichasun chu ama-a kona kilah mangpeh ding ahi.
target: For whoever has will be given more, and they will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them.

source: Hiche soh pannabei hi polam muthim-ah gapaimang-un; hikoma chu kale hagel umding ahi, ati.
target: And throw that worthless servant outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

source: Mihem Chapa vantil thengte jousetoh aloupina-a ahung tengtah le, Ama aloupina lal touna-a tou ding ahi;
target: “When the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the angels with him, he will sit on his glorious throne.

source: Chule namtin vai jouse Ama anga chu kikhom ding; chule kelngoi chingpan keltah-a kona kelngoi achomkhen banga, aman khatna kona khat achomkhena,
target: All the nations will be gathered before him, and he will separate the people one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

source: Aman kelngoi chengse ajet lama akoija, keltah chengse vei lama akoi ding ahi.
target: He will put the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.

source: Chutengle lengpa chun ajet lama umteho jah-a chu, Hungun, ka Pa phattheiboh changho, vannoi leiset kiphudoh tila patna nangho dinga gotsa kikoi lenggama hung lotaovin.
target: “Then the King will say to those on his right, ‘Come, you who are blessed by my Father; take your inheritance, the kingdom prepared for you since the creation of the world.

source: Ijeh-inem itile kagil akelin ahile, nanghon neh ding neinapeuvin; kadang achah-in, donding neinapeuvin; kamaljinin ahile neilhun sah-un;
target: For I was hungry and you gave me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me something to drink, I was a stranger and you invited me in,

source: Kasagoh keova kaumin, pon neinasilpeh-un; kadam mon ahile, eiven nahungun; chule kasoh changin ahile, hikoma jong chun kahenga nahungun ahi, ati ding ahi.
target: I needed clothes and you clothed me, I was sick and you looked after me, I was in prison and you came to visit me.’

source: Chutengle michonpha te chun, keihon itih-a nagilkel kamuva, an nehding kapeh khah-um? Ahiloule itih-a nadangchah kamuva, kadon sah-um?
target: “Then the righteous will answer him, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you something to drink?

source: Keihon itih-a namaljin kamuva, kalhunsah-um? Ahiloule nasagoh keova naum kamuva, pon kasil pehkhah-um?
target: When did we see you a stranger and invite you in, or needing clothes and clothe you?

source: Chule keihon itih-a nadamo kamuva kahung vetnuva; nasohchan kamuva nahenga kahung uvem? ati dingu ahi.
target: When did we see you sick or in prison and go to visit you?’

source: Chule lengpan amaho jah-a, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Hiche kasopite ho lah-a aneopen khat nabolna chanseu chu, keima neibolnao ahi, tia adonbut ding ahi.
target: “The King will reply, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.’

source: Chutengle aman avei lama umho jah-a chu, Vo gaosap changho, kakoma konin chemangun, diabol le avantilte dinga kikoi meilhum sunga lut taovin;
target: “Then he will say to those on his left, ‘Depart from me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.

source: Ijeh-inem itile kagil kelin, nanghon neh ding neipe pouvin; kadang chah-in, don ding neipepouvin;
target: For I was hungry and you gave me nothing to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me nothing to drink,

source: Kamaljinin, neilhunsah pouvin; sagoh keovin kaumin, pon neinasilpeh pouvin; kadammole kasoh chanin, neihungve pouvin ahi, ati ding ahi.
target: I was a stranger and you did not invite me in, I needed clothes and you did not clothe me, I was sick and in prison and you did not look after me.’

source: Chutengle amahon jong, Pakai, keihon nangma itih-a nagilkel, nadangchah, namaljin, sagoh keova naum, nadammo le nasohchan kamu uva kajenle daovem? tia ama adonbut dingu ahi.
target: “They also will answer, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or needing clothes or sick or in prison, and did not help you?’

source: Chutengle Aman amaho jah-a, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Nanghon hiche aneochaho lah-a khat nabol louvu chu, keima neibol louvu ahi, tia adonbut ding ahi.
target: “He will reply, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did not do for one of the least of these, you did not do for me.’

source: Chule amaho chu tonsot kemlou talent man dinga cheova, michonpha ho chu kemlou tonsot hinna-a che ding ahiuve.
target: “Then they will go away to eternal punishment, but the righteous to eternal life.”

source: Chutichun Jesu'n hichengse chu asei jouvin, aseijuite jah-a,
target: When Jesus had finished saying all these things, he said to his disciples,

source: Nini joule kalchuhkut hi ding ahi; chule Mihem Chapa hi thingpel'a khetbeh dinga melmate khutna kipedoh ding ahi, ti chu nanghon naheuve, ati.
target: “As you know, the Passover is two days away—and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified.”

source: Chutah chun thempu pipuiho le danthusunho, upaho chu thempu chungnung Caiaphas atiu inpia chun akikhomun,
target: Then the chief priests and the elders of the people assembled in the palace of the high priest, whose name was Caiaphas,

source: Jesu chu doha bola matna, thana dingin akihou khomtaovin ahi;
target: and they schemed to arrest Jesus secretly and kill him.

source: Amavang, Kut sung chun hidahen, ajole mipi lah-a thunoh umgetninte, atiuvin ahi.
target: “But not during the festival,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.”

source: Chujouvin Jesu Bethany kho-a Simon miphahpa in'a aumpetnin,
target: While Jesus was in Bethany in the home of Simon the Leper,

source: Numei khatnin songval bomin thao namtui manlutah ahinchoijin, ahenga ahungin, a-ankong um pettah-in alu chunga asunglhan anun ahi.
target: a woman came to him with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfume, which she poured on his head as he was reclining at the table.

source: Ahin aseijuiten hichu amuvin, alungnom mo uvin, Ibola hitia amoh suhmang jeng hitam?
target: When the disciples saw this, they were indignant. “Why this waste?” they asked.

source: Ijeh-inem itile hiche thao hi aman tamtah-a joh-a, mivaicha gentheiho peh thei ahi, atiuvin ahi.
target: “This perfume could have been sold at a high price and the money given to the poor.”

source: Ahin Jesu'n hichu ahetdoh phatnin, Ibola numeinu hi nasuh lunggimu ham? Kachunga hi thil phatah abol ahi.
target: Aware of this, Jesus said to them, “Why are you bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful thing to me.

source: Ijeh-inem itile mivaicha gentheite chu nakom uva aum jingnauve, keimavang nangho koma um jinga kahipoi.
target: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have me.

source: Hiche thao namtui eisunkhum hi, eikivui nikho-a dinga chu eigot ahi.
target: When she poured this perfume on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

source: Keiman nangho tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Vannoi leiset gam pumpi-a hiche Kipana Thupha kihil lhang nachana, hiche numeinu thilbol jong hi, amanu het jingna-a kiseipeh ding ahi, ati.
target: Truly I tell you, wherever this gospel is preached throughout the world, what she has done will also be told, in memory of her.”

source: Chuphatnin somleni lah-a khat, Juda Iscariot atiu chu, thempu pipuiho koma achen,
target: Then one of the Twelve—the one called Judas Iscariot—went to the chief priests

source: Ajah uva, Ama khu matsah leuveng ipi neipeh diuham? ati. Chuin amahon ama chu dangka somthum ateppeh taovin ahi.
target: and asked, “What are you willing to give me if I deliver him over to you?” So they counted out for him thirty pieces of silver.

source: Chupet tah-a pat chun aman ama chu pedoh-a matsahna thei dingje agomkom aholtan ahi.
target: From then on Judas watched for an opportunity to hand him over.

source: Chuin cholsolou changlhah kut ni masa nin aseijuite Jesu hengah ahungun, Kalchuhkut nanehna ding hoikoma goleuveng nalungham, atiuvin ahi.
target: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Where do you want us to make preparations for you to eat the Passover?”
