source: Chuin Aman ajah uva, Khopi sunga cheovinlang mi khat jah-a, Houhilin, Kaphat anaitai; kaseijuite toh nangma in'a kalchuhkut an kanehkhom dingu ahi, ati, tin gaseijun, ati.
target: He replied, “Go into the city to a certain man and tell him, ‘The Teacher says: My appointed time is near. I am going to celebrate the Passover with my disciples at your house.’ ”

source: Chuin Jesu'n ahil bangbangu chun abolun, aseijuiten kalchuhkut chu agago taovin ahi.
target: So the disciples did as Jesus had directed them and prepared the Passover.

source: Chuin nilhah ahi phatnin, aseijuite somleni chutoh atou taovin;
target: When evening came, Jesus was reclining at the table with the Twelve.

source: Chuin a-anneh laitah-un aman ajah uva, Tahbeh-a kasei ahi, nalah uva khatnin eipehdoh-a eimatsah ding ahi, ati.
target: And while they were eating, he said, “Truly I tell you, one of you will betray me.”

source: Chuin alungdong lheh jengtaovin, ajah-a, Pakai, kei kahim? aticheh taovin ahi.
target: They were very sad and began to say to him one after the other, “Surely you don’t mean me, Lord?”

source: Aman adonbutnin, Lhenga kaso khompipa tah chu eimatsah dinga ahi.
target: Jesus replied, “The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with me will betray me.

source: Mihem Chapa achonchan ding thu kisun bangtah-a chu cheding mong ahi, ahivangin Mihem Chapa pedoh-a matsah dingpa chu ohe adana-e! Ama chu apena peng lou hile ama dinga phajota ding ahi, ati.
target: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about him. But woe to that man who betrays the Son of Man! It would be better for him if he had not been born.”

source: Hichun apedoh-a pang ding Juda Iscariot chun adonbutnin, Pakai, kei kahim? ati. Chuin aman, Nakisei khai, ati.
target: Then Judas, the one who would betray him, said, “Surely you don’t mean me, Rabbi?” Jesus answered, “You have said so.”

source: Chuin an aneh laitah-un, Jesu'n changlhah alan, phatthei aboh jouvin ahehbal balin, aseijuite apen, Kilah-un, neuvin; hiche hi katahsa ahi, ati.
target: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it and gave it to his disciples, saying, “Take and eat; this is my body.”

source: Chuin khon alan, athangvah jouvin amaho chu apen, ajah uva, Nabonchaovin don sohkeijun;
target: Then he took a cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them, saying, “Drink from it, all of you.

source: Ijeh-inem itile hiche hi chonset suhbeina dinga mi tamtah dinga kisodoh kitepna thah kathisan ahi.
target: This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.

source: Chule keiman nangho jah-a kasei ahi, Ka Pa lenggam sunga nang hotoh athah-a kadonkhom ni ahunglhun kahse-a, tu kala hiche lengpiga twi hi kadon kit lou ding ahitai, ati.
target: I tell you, I will not drink from this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom.”

source: Chuin amahon la asah jouvun apotdoh-un, Olive molsang lama achetauvin ahi.
target: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

source: Chutah chun Jesu'n ajah uva, Tujana hi nangho nabon chaova kachunga lungthoi sohkei ding nahiuve; ijeh-inem itile, Keiman kelngoi chingpa kavoh lhuh ding, chutengle kelngoihon chu chehgam ding ahi, tin akisune.
target: Then Jesus told them, “This very night you will all fall away on account of me, for it is written: “ ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’

source: Ahin kathodoh nungle, Galilee gam lam namasang sang uva kache ding ahi, ati.
target: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”

source: Ahin Peter'in adonbutnin, ajah-a, Abonchauvin nachungah lungthoi jongleu, keima vang itihchan hijongle lungthoi ponge, ati.
target: Peter replied, “Even if all fall away on account of you, I never will.”

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahi, tujan ah khon masanga thumvei neiseilep ding ahi, ati.
target: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus answered, “this very night, before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times.”

source: Pater'in ajah-a, Nangma toh thitha ding mong hijongleng, keiman nangma seilep hihhel ing kate, ati. Aseijuite jousen jong chuti chun asei sohkeijun ahi.
target: But Peter declared, “Even if I have to die with you, I will never disown you.” And all the other disciples said the same.

source: Hichun Jesu amaho chutoh Gethsemane atiu mun khat alhunun, aman aseijuite jah-a, Keima khukoma khu kache-a kagatao sungsen, nangho hikoma hin anatou jingun, ati.
target: Then Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and he said to them, “Sit here while I go over there and pray.”

source: Chuin Peter le Zebedai chapate ni chu akipuijin; chule alunghem lheh jengin alungkham pantan ahi.
target: He took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee along with him, and he began to be sorrowful and troubled.

source: Chutah chun aman amaho jah-a, Thina khophelin kalung hesoh behseh jengtai; hikoma umunlang neikigin piuvin, ati.
target: Then he said to them, “My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with me.”

source: Chuin amasang lama phabep khat ache chonin, akhupbon alhun tolah amai asulutnin, ataovin, Ka Pa, ahi theile, hiche khon hi keija konin kitolmang jenghen; ahivangin keima lunggot bang hilouvin, nangma lunggot bang hijohen, ati.
target: Going a little farther, he fell with his face to the ground and prayed, “My Father, if it is possible, may this cup be taken from me. Yet not as I will, but as you will.”

source: Chuin aseijuite henga ahungin ahile, amaho chu ana-imut lhuh gamu ahungtoh-in, Peter jah-a, Nanghon nidan khat jengjong nei kiginpi jou lou uham?
target: Then he returned to his disciples and found them sleeping. “Couldn’t you men keep watch with me for one hour?” he asked Peter.

source: Lhepna-a nalhah louna dingun kigingun, taovun; lhagao vangin agonan tahsan ajoupoi, ati.
target: “Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

source: Chuin aniveina-in ache kitnin, ataovin, Ka Pa, hiche khona kadon louva kitolmang thei lou ahile, nangma thuthu hihen, ati.
target: He went away a second time and prayed, “My Father, if it is not possible for this cup to be taken away unless I drink it, may your will be done.”

source: Chuin ahung kitnin ahile, amaho chu a-imut lhuh-u ahungtoh-in ahi; ijeh-inem itile amaho chu a-imutsoh lheh jengun ahi.
target: When he came back, he again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy.

source: Chutichun amaho chu adalhan, athumvei na-in ache kitnin, ataovin, aseingai bangma chu asei kitnin ahi.
target: So he left them and went away once more and prayed the third time, saying the same thing.

source: Chutah-in aseijuite hengah ahungin, ajah uva, Ahile, tun imuvinlang kitha ol taovin; veuvin, phat alhingtai, chule Mihem Chapa hi michonse te khutna kipedoh-a ahitai.
target: Then he returned to the disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Look, the hour has come, and the Son of Man is delivered into the hands of sinners.

source: Kipat un, chetao hite; veuvin, eipedohpa ahungnai tai, ati.
target: Rise! Let us go! Here comes my betrayer!”

source: Chuin hichu asei nalajin, veuvin, somleni lah-a Juda Iscariot chu thempu pipuiho le upaho koma kona chemjam le moltum hintho-a hungkon mipi nasatah chutoh ahung kilhonin ahungtan ahi.
target: While he was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived. With him was a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests and the elders of the people.

source: Ama pedoh-a pangpa chun amaho chu melchihna ahil masan, Keiman kachop penpen chu ama ahi, ama chu man-un, ati ahi.
target: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The one I kiss is the man; arrest him.”

source: Chuin aman Jesu heng ajon paijin, Rabbi, chibai, atin achoptan ahi.
target: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah-a, Kajol, Ibola hunga nahim? ati. Chutah-in amaho chun akom ahin naijun, Jesu chungah akhut alhaovin, amantaovin ahi.
target: Jesus replied, “Do what you came for, friend.” Then the men stepped forward, seized Jesus and arrested him.

source: Chuin, veuvin, Jesu loiho khatnin akhut alamin, achemjam asatdoh-in, thempu chungnung sohpa asatle abilkol lang khat asatlhan ahi.
target: With that, one of Jesus’ companions reached for his sword, drew it out and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.

source: Chuphatnin Jesu'n ajah-a, Nachemjam chu akoina-a koi kitnin; ijeh-inem itile chemjam panteho chu chemjam'a lou ding ahi.
target: “Put your sword back in its place,” Jesus said to him, “for all who draw the sword will die by the sword.

source: Ole tutah jenga jong hi ka Pan avantil janel somleni sanga tamjo eihin solpehna dinga kathum thei louva nangaito ham?
target: Do you think I cannot call on my Father, and he will at once put at my disposal more than twelve legions of angels?

source: Ahinla chutin kibole hitia hi thu soh tei ding ahi, tia Pathen lekhabua kisun chu iti guilhun thei dingham? ati.
target: But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen in this way?”

source: Hichepet chun Jesu'n mipi chengse jah-a chun, Gucha michom man dinga kon banga chemjamle moltum nahinthova, keima man dinga nahung kon uham? Keima houin'ah niseh-in katouvin thu kahil jingin, chulaijinla neiman pouvin ahi.
target: In that hour Jesus said to the crowd, “Am I leading a rebellion, that you have come out with swords and clubs to capture me? Every day I sat in the temple courts teaching, and you did not arrest me.

source: Amavang themgaoho lekha sut thu guilhuna dinga, hichengse hi aboncha soh-a ahitai, ati. Chutah chun aseijuite jousen ama adalhauvin, ajamgam taovin ahi.
target: But this has all taken place that the writings of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples deserted him and fled.

source: Chuin Jesu manho chun danthu sunho le upaho kikhopna, Caiaphas atiu thempu chungnung henga chun akaijun ahi.
target: Those who had arrested Jesus took him to Caiaphas the high priest, where the teachers of the law and the elders had assembled.

source: Peter vang chun galkanga ajuipeh-in, thempu chungnung inpi leitol geijin ajuijin, hikoma chun alutnin, Achaina munge, tin sottolho lah-a chun atouvin ahi.
target: But Peter followed him at a distance, right up to the courtyard of the high priest. He entered and sat down with the guards to see the outcome.

source: Hichun thempu pipuiho le houvaipoloi chengsen Jesu thana dingin achungah hettohsah jouthu aholun;
target: The chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for false evidence against Jesus so that they could put him to death.

source: Jouthu hettohsah tamtah ahung vangun, amupouvin ahi. Akhonnan mi ni ahungin,
target: But they did not find any, though many false witnesses came forward. Finally two came forward

source: Hichepa hin, Keima Pathen houin suse-a ni thum sunga sadoh kit thei kahi ati, ahung ti lhonin ahi.
target: and declared, “This fellow said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.’ ”

source: Chuin thempu chungnung chu adingdoh-in, ajah-a, Nadonbut lou dingham? Hitehon nahehsetna-a thu aseiju hi ipiham? ati.
target: Then the high priest stood up and said to Jesus, “Are you not going to answer? What is this testimony that these men are bringing against you?”

source: Ahivangin Jesu thipbeh-in aumin ahi. Chuin thempu chungnung chun ajah-a, Keiman nangma Pathen hing mina kahahsela kasol nahi, nangma Pathen Chapa Christa chu nahim? Neisei peh-un, ati.
target: But Jesus remained silent. The high priest said to him, “I charge you under oath by the living God: Tell us if you are the Messiah, the Son of God.”

source: Hichun Jesu'n ajah-a, Naseikhai, chukalvala kaseipeh nahiuve, Tunung kalle nanghon Mihem Chapa thahatna jet lama atoule, meilom chunga ahung namu dingu ahi, ati.
target: “You have said so,” Jesus replied. “But I say to all of you: From now on you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Mighty One and coming on the clouds of heaven.”

source: Chutah-in thempu chungnung chun apon abotkeh-in, Hiche hi Pathen ataitom ahi; eihon thu hettohsah dang iding iti tah dinguham? Veuvin, nanghon tun Pathen ataitomna najataovin ahi.
target: Then the high priest tore his clothes and said, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Look, now you have heard the blasphemy.

source: Nanghon iti nagel uvem? ati. Amahon, Thi dinga lom ahi, tin adonbutnun ahi.
target: What do you think?” “He is worthy of death,” they answered.

source: Chutah-in amahon amaijah chil asetnun, akhut tumun akhenun; chule kimkhatnin abengun,
target: Then they spit in his face and struck him with their fists. Others slapped him

source: Vo Khrista, gaovinlang seijin, koiham nabenga chu, atiuvin ahi.
target: and said, “Prophesy to us, Messiah. Who hit you?”

source: Hichepet chun Peter polamah leitolah atouvin ahi; hichun sohnu khat ahenga ahungin ajah-a, Nangma jong Galilee mi Jesu toh kiloi chu nahi, ati.
target: Now Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, and a servant girl came to him. “You also were with Jesus of Galilee,” she said.

source: Ahivangin aman japi angsungah aseilepmin, Nathusei chu kahepoi, atitan ahi.
target: But he denied it before them all. “I don’t know what you’re talking about,” he said.

source: Chuin kelkot phung lamah apotnin ahile, sohnu achom khatnin ama chu amun, chukoma umho jah-a chun, Hichepa jong hi Nazareth Jesu koma uma chu ahi, ati.
target: Then he went out to the gateway, where another servant girl saw him and said to the people there, “This fellow was with Jesus of Nazareth.”

source: Chuin aman aseilep kitnin, Hiche mipa chu kahepoi, tin akihahseltan ahi.
target: He denied it again, with an oath: “I don’t know the man!”

source: Chujou phabepmin chukoma um miho chu ahenga ahungun, Peter jah-a, Tahbeh-in nangma jong amaho lah-a khat mongmong nahi; ijeh-inem itile napao chun nangma naphong doh-e, atiuvin ahi.
target: After a little while, those standing there went up to Peter and said, “Surely you are one of them; your accent gives you away.”

source: Hiphat chun aman, Hiche mihempa chu kahe hih hele tin kigaosaple kihahsel athopantan ahi. Chupettah chun ahchal akhongtan ahi.
target: Then he began to call down curses, and he swore to them, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately a rooster crowed.

source: Hichun, Ahchal khon masanga thumvei neiseilep ding ahi, tia Jesu thusei chu Peter'in ageldoh-in; chuin polamah apotdoh-in, lhasetah-in hakan akaptan ahi.
target: Then Peter remembered the word Jesus had spoken: “Before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times.” And he went outside and wept bitterly.

source: Chuin jingkah ahi phatnin, thempu pipuiho chengsele upaho jouse Jesu thana dingin akihoutoh taovin ahi;
target: Early in the morning, all the chief priests and the elders of the people made their plans how to have Jesus executed.

source: Chuin Ama chu akanun, akaijun, gamvaipo Pontius Pilate khutnah apedoh taovin ahi.
target: So they bound him, led him away and handed him over to Pilate the governor.

source: Chutah-in apedoh-a panga Juda Iscariot chun athi dinga themmo achansah-u chu amun ahile akisih-in, dangka somthum chu thempu pipuiho le upaho alepeh kitnin,
target: When Judas, who had betrayed him, saw that Jesus was condemned, he was seized with remorse and returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and the elders.

source: Themona neilou thisan kapehdoh chu kachon kheltai, ati. Ahinla amahon, Hichu keiho ka ithu-u umam? Nangman nalo nomnom lotan, ati taovin ahi.
target: “I have sinned,” he said, “for I have betrayed innocent blood.” “What is that to us?” they replied. “That’s your responsibility.”

source: Hichun aman dangka chu houin sunga asep lhan, chukoma kon chun achemangin, ama akikhai lihtan ahi.
target: So Judas threw the money into the temple and left. Then he went away and hanged himself.

source: Chuin thempu pipuihon hiche dangka chu alauvin, Hiche hi thisan man ahi jeh-in, housum kholna-a koi angai ahipoi, atiuvin ahi.
target: The chief priests picked up the coins and said, “It is against the law to put this into the treasury, since it is blood money.”

source: Hichun amaho akihoutoh-un, gamdang miho vuina dingin, hichun beldengpa leiset achou vin ahi.
target: So they decided to use the money to buy the potter’s field as a burial place for foreigners.

source: Hiche jeh chun tugeijin hiche leiset chu thisan leiset akitin ahi.
target: That is why it has been called the Field of Blood to this day.

source: Hichu themgao Jeremiah thusei, Israel chate lah-a kona aman asahsao, aman kisahpa man chu dangka somthum alauvin ahi;
target: Then what was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled: “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price set on him by the people of Israel,

source: Chule, Pakaiyin eithupeh dungjuijin, beldengpa leiset manin apetaovin ahi, ati chu guilhunga ahitai.
target: and they used them to buy the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”

source: Chujouvin Jesu chu gamvaipo angah adingtan ahi: chuin gamvaipo chun adongin, Nangma Juda te lengpa nahim? atin ahile, Jesu'n ajah-a, Naseikhai, ati.
target: Meanwhile Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor asked him, “Are you the king of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.

source: Ahin thempu pipuiho le upahon ahehsetna thu ijat asei vangun, aman imachan adonbutpon ahi.
target: When he was accused by the chief priests and the elders, he gave no answer.

source: Chutah-in Pilate'in ajah-a, Hitehon nangma douna hettohsahna asei chengseu hi najah louham? ati.
target: Then Pilate asked him, “Don’t you hear the testimony they are bringing against you?”

source: Ahin Aman cheng khatcha jong adonbut lou jeh chun, gamvaipo chun adatmo lheh jengin ahi.
target: But Jesus made no reply, not even to a single charge—to the great amazement of the governor.

source: Hiche kut sunga chu sohchang koi hile mihon agotpen penu chu gamvaipo chun alhadohji angai ahi.
target: Now it was the governor’s custom at the festival to release a prisoner chosen by the crowd.

source: Hichepet chun sohchang amin Barabbas atiu, sohchang minthang tah khat aumin ahi.
target: At that time they had a well-known prisoner whose name was Jesus Barabbas.

source: Hijeh chun amaho akikhop phatnun, Pilate'in amaho chu adongin, Koijoh lhadoh pehleng nalungu ham? Barabbas ha, Christa kiti Jesu joh ham? ati.
target: So when the crowd had gathered, Pilate asked them, “Which one do you want me to release to you: Jesus Barabbas, or Jesus who is called the Messiah?”

source: Ijeh-inem itile thangset suma apehdoh-u ahi chu aman ahen ahi.
target: For he knew it was out of self-interest that they had handed Jesus over to him.

source: Chuin ama thutanna mun'a atoupetnin, a-inneipin thu ahin thotnin, Hiche michonpha pa chu limsah hih-in; ijeh-inem itile Ama jeh chun tunin kamangin kathohgim lheh jengin ahi, ati.
target: While Pilate was sitting on the judge’s seat, his wife sent him this message: “Don’t have anything to do with that innocent man, for I have suffered a great deal today in a dream because of him.”

source: Ahinla thempu pipuiho le upahon Barabbas chu angeh uva, chule Jesu chu asuhmangsah dingin mipi chu atilse taovin ahi.
target: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowd to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus executed.

source: Chuin gamvaipo chun adonbutnin, Hichete ni hi koijoh lhadoh pehleng nalungu ham? atin ahile; amahon, Barabbas, atiuvin ahi.
target: “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” asked the governor. “Barabbas,” they answered.

source: Chuin Pilate'in ajah uva, Achutile Christa kiti Jesu hi i-kalo dingba hitam? ati. Chuin amahon, Thingpel'a kikhenbeh hen, atiuvin ahi.
target: “What shall I do, then, with Jesus who is called the Messiah?” Pilate asked. They all answered, “Crucify him!”

source: Chuin aman, Ibolinem, ipi suhset aneiham? ati. Ahivangin amahon hasaptah-in asamun, Thingpelah kikhenbeh hen, atiuvin ahi.
target: “Why? What crime has he committed?” asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify him!”

source: Chuin Pilate'in ananlela abol ima phatsahna ahilou, thunoh baotam asojoh chu amu phatnin, twi alan, mipi angsungah akhut asillhan, Hiche michonpha pa thisan kisona-a themona nei lou kahi; nanghon nalolo lotaovin, ati.
target: When Pilate saw that he was getting nowhere, but that instead an uproar was starting, he took water and washed his hands in front of the crowd. “I am innocent of this man’s blood,” he said. “It is your responsibility!”

source: Chuin mihon abonchauvin adonbutnun, Ama thisan phu chu keiho le kachateu chungah chuhen, atiuvin ahi.
target: All the people answered, “His blood is on us and on our children!”

source: Chutah-in aman amaho chu Barabbas alhadohpeh-un; Jesu vang chu ajepmin, thingpel'a khetbeh dingin apedohtan ahi.
target: Then he released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.

source: Chutah-in gamvaipo sepai ho chun Jesu chu Pretorium sungah apui lutnun, akomah sepaiho jouse akikhom sohkeijun;
target: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company of soldiers around him.

source: Chule aponsil chu ahoh lha uvin, ponsandup asilpeh taovin ahi.
target: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him,

source: Chule ling lukhuh aphanun, alu-a akhuhpeh-un, chule akhut jet lamah pengtenggol khat achoisah-un, a-angah adilsuvin, Vo Juda te Lengpa, Chibai, atiuvin, totnopnan ael-elin abolun ahi.
target: and then twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on his head. They put a staff in his right hand. Then they knelt in front of him and mocked him. “Hail, king of the Jews!” they said.

source: Chuin chil asetkhumun, apumpeng choi chu alauvin, alu avoh naovin ahi.
target: They spit on him, and took the staff and struck him on the head again and again.

source: Chutia chu totnopna-a a-el ela abol jouvun, pon san chu ahoh lha uvin, ama pon asilpeh-un thingpel'a khetbeh dingin apuitaovin ahi.
target: After they had mocked him, they took off the robe and put his own clothes on him. Then they led him away to crucify him.

source: Chujouvin apotdoh uva acheule, amin Simon atiu, Cyrene gam mi khat amuvin, ama athingpel puding chun acham louvin amanun ahi.
target: As they were going out, they met a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross.

source: Chuin Golgotha (Hichu lugumun tina ahi) atiu mun chu alhunun,
target: They came to a place called Golgotha (which means “the place of the skull”).

source: Amahon Jesu chu gilkhatoh kihal lengpitwi thuh adonsah-un ahile, aman atepmin adon nomtapon ahi.
target: There they offered Jesus wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, he refused to drink it.

source: Chujouvin amachu thingpel'a akhenbeh-un; themgao thusei, kapon akihom taovin, chule kasangkhol chol vang vetnan amang taove, atichu guilhun nan, apon chu akihomun, chule vang avetaove.
target: When they had crucified him, they divided up his clothes by casting lots.

source: Chule hikoma chun atouvun, ama chu angah taovin ahi.
target: And sitting down, they kept watch over him there.

source: Chule HICHEPA HI JESU JUDA TE LENGPA AHI, tin ahehnau hetsahna asunun, alu chungah atah-un ahi.
target: Above his head they placed the written charge against him: this is jesus, the king of the jews .

source: Hiche pet chun amatoh thakhatnin gucha michom ni, khat ajet lamah khat avei lamah thingpelah akhen beh-un ahi.
target: Two rebels were crucified with him, one on his right and one on his left.

source: Chuin achele avahle jousen akhasuh khumun, a-el elin ahouvun,
target: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads

source: Nang houin suse-a ni thuma sadoh kit, nangma kihuh hing tangem! nangma Pathen Chapa nahile, thingpel'a konin hung kumlhan, atiuvin ahi.
target: and saying, “You who are going to destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! Come down from the cross, if you are the Son of God!”

source: Thempu pipuihon jong, danthu sunho le upaho toh chutima chun totnopnan abolun,
target: In the same way the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders mocked him.

source: Aman midang ahuhhingjin; ama akihuhhing theipoi. Ama Israelte Lengpa ahileh, tun thingpel'a konin hung kumlha temhen, achutile tahsanunge.
target: “He saved others,” they said, “but he can’t save himself! He’s the king of Israel! Let him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in him.

source: Aman Pathen asongin; Pathen'in adei ahile tun huhhing hen; ijeh-inem itile aman, Pathen Chapa kahi ati, atiuvin ahi.
target: He trusts in God. Let God rescue him now if he wants him, for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’ ”

source: Chule amatoh thingpel'a kikhetbeh tha gucha michomte ni jong chun, chutobangma chun ahouse lhonin ahi.
target: In the same way the rebels who were crucified with him also heaped insults on him.

source: Chuin nidan gupma pat Nidan ko geijin, gam jouse chungah mu athim tan ahi.
target: From noon until three in the afternoon darkness came over all the land.

source: Chuin nidan ko donin Jesu'n, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani, tin hapenin apengin ahi. Hichu, Ka Pathen, ka Pathen, ibola neidalhah ham, tina ahi.
target: About three in the afternoon Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?” (which means “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?” ).

source: Chukoma dingho lah-a abang bangin chutia ati chu ajauvin, Hichepan Elijah akouve, atiuvin ahi.
target: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, “He’s calling Elijah.”

source: Chupettah chun alah uva khat alhaijelin, twichop phon khat alan, lengpitwi thuh adelhopmin, pengtenggol leh-a atah-in, agahdonsah-in ahi.
target: Immediately one of them ran and got a sponge. He filled it with wine vinegar, put it on a staff, and offered it to Jesus to drink.

source: Ahin adangho chun, Limsah hih-in; Elijah ahuhhinga hunga hung hih-am, veohite, atiuvin ahi.
target: The rest said, “Now leave him alone. Let’s see if Elijah comes to save him.”

source: Chuin Jesu hapenin apengin, alhagao alhadohtan ahi.
target: And when Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, he gave up his spirit.

source: Chuin, veuvin, houin'a pondal len chu achunga pat anoi geijin a-ehlha paijin keh ni akison; chule ling akihotnin, songpiho akeh-in ahi.
target: At that moment the curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook, the rocks split

source: Chule lhankhuh ho akihongin, a-imu mithengho long tamtah kaithouvin aumin ahi;
target: and the tombs broke open. The bodies of many holy people who had died were raised to life.

source: Chule ama thokit nung chun amaho chu lhankhuh-a konin apotdoh-un, khopi thenga ache lutnun, mi tamtah akimusah uvin ahi.
target: They came out of the tombs after Jesus’ resurrection and went into the holy city and appeared to many people.

source: Chuin sepai jalamkai le aumpi Jesu ngah-a pangho chun ling kihot le thilsoh umchanje chu amuvin, akicha lheh jengun, Hichepa hi Pathen Chapa tahbeh mong ahi, ati taovin ahi.
target: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that had happened, they were terrified, and exclaimed, “Surely he was the Son of God!”

source: Chule Galilee gama kona Jesu nung hinjuija ajenlea pang numei tamtah aumun, amaho chun galkanga pangin ave jingun ahi.
target: Many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to care for his needs.

source: Alah uva chun Magdalene Mariam, Jacob le Joses nu Mariam, chule Zebedee chapate ni nu aumun ahi.
target: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedee’s sons.

source: Chuin nilhah ahi phatnin, Jesu seijuija pang Arimathea kho-a amin Joseph atiu mihaotah khat Pilate henga ahungin, Jesu long chu athumin ahi.
target: As evening approached, there came a rich man from Arimathea, named Joseph, who had himself become a disciple of Jesus.

source: Hichun Pilate chun apeh dingin thu apetan ahi.
target: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus’ body, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.

source: Chuin Joseph chun along chu alan, tupat ponnem ngimseh chan atomin, song alaihom ama lhan thah sunga chun alupsah-in,
target: Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

source: Lhan kotna chun song lentah khat atanglutnin, achemang tan ahi.
target: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut out of the rock. He rolled a big stone in front of the entrance to the tomb and went away.

source: Chule Magdalene Mariam le Mariam chom nu chu hikoma chun aumun, lhan maija chun atou jingun ahi.
target: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.

source: Ajingin, hichu kigot ni ahin, thempu pipuiho le Pharisai ho Pilate hengah akikhomun,
target: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees went to Pilate.

source: Ajah-a, Kapu, hiche milhemlhapa chun ahinlaijin, Ni thum joule thoukit ding kahi, ati chu tun kalunguva alange.
target: “Sir,” they said, “we remember that while he was still alive that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise again.’

source: Hijeh chun ni thum geija alhan ngah ding thu pen; ajole jannin aseijuite hunguntin, gumang untin, miho jah-a, Athi lah-a konin athoukit tai tiget nunte; chutile suhkhel masah sanga suhkhel nunung chu setchehna hi ding ahi, atiuvin ahi.
target: So give the order for the tomb to be made secure until the third day. Otherwise, his disciples may come and steal the body and tell the people that he has been raised from the dead. This last deception will be worse than the first.”

source: Pilate'in ajah uva, Nanghon santri hon khat naneiju chu; cheovinlang nanga thei theijun ganga phatsah taovin, ati.
target: “Take a guard,” Pilate answered. “Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how.”

source: Chuin amaho angah ding santri hon chutoh alhonun, song chunga chun mohor anamun, lhan chu phatah-in angasah taovin ahi.
target: So they went and made the tomb secure by putting a seal on the stone and posting the guard.

source: Chuin cholngah ni kichaija Hapta kipat ni masa ni khovah thenthenin, Magdalene Mariam le Mariam chom nu chu lhan ve ding chun ahung lhonin ahi.
target: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to look at the tomb.

source: Chule, veuvin, ling hahon akihot tan ahi; ijeh-inem itile Pakai vantil van'a konin ahung kumlhan, song chu akotna konin atangdoh-in, achungah atouvin ahi.
target: There was a violent earthquake, for an angel of the Lord came down from heaven and, going to the tomb, rolled back the stone and sat on it.

source: Avouso chu kolphetoh abangin, aponsil chu buhbang bangin abangin;
target: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.

source: Chule ama akichat jeh-un angah ho akihot akihotnun, athi-a toh abang jengun ahi.
target: The guards were so afraid of him that they shook and became like dead men.

source: Ahin hiche vantil chun numei ho chu ahin houvin, ajah uva, Nangho kicha hih-un, ijeh-inem itile thingpel'a kithat Jesu chu naholu ahi kahenai.
target: The angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.

source: Ama hikoma aumtapoi; ijeh-inem itile aman asei bang chun athoudohtai. Hungun lang Pakai lupna hung vetaovin.
target: He is not here; he has risen, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay.

source: Chule nangho cheloijun lang aseijuiteho jah-a hiche hi gaseijun, Ama athi lah-a konin athoudohtai; chule, veuvin, Galilee gam lamah namasanguvah achei; chukoma chu nanghon ama namu dingu ahi, gatiuvin; veuvin, najah uva kaseitai, ati.
target: Then go quickly and tell his disciples: ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him.’ Now I have told you.”

source: Chuin amaho kichat toh gomin hapan akipah-un, lhan phunga kon chun achedoh loijun, aseijuite henga thulhut ding chun alhaijel taovin ahi.
target: So the women hurried away from the tomb, afraid yet filled with joy, and ran to tell his disciples.

source: Chuin amaho aseijuite seipeh dinga acheule, veuvin, Jesu'n amaho chu akimupin, ajah uva, Damselun, ati. Hichun amahon aheng ajonun, akeng atuh-un chibai abohtauvin ahi.
target: Suddenly Jesus met them. “Greetings,” he said. They came to him, clasped his feet and worshiped him.

source: Hichun Jesu'n ajah uva, Kicha hih-un, cheovin, kasopite jah-a gaseijun, amaho Galilee gam lama cheohen, chukoma chu amahon eimu dingu ahi, ati.
target: Then Jesus said to them, “Do not be afraid. Go and tell my brothers to go to Galilee; there they will see me.”

source: Chujouvin amaho acheu chun, santri'a dingho phabep khopi sunga ahungun, thusoh umchan jouse ahung lhutnun ahi.
target: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests everything that had happened.

source: Chuin amaho upaho toh akikhomun, akihoutoh jouvun, sepaiho chu sum tamtah apeuvin, ajah uva,
target: When the chief priests had met with the elders and devised a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money,

source: Ka-imut kah-un aseijuite ahungun, agumang taove, tiuvin.
target: telling them, “You are to say, ‘His disciples came during the night and stole him away while we were asleep.’

source: Hiche thuhi gamvaipon ajah-a ahile, keihon ama hou lungdam ungting, nangho lung olmosah pouvinge, atiuvin ahi.
target: If this report gets to the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.”

source: Hichun amahon sum chu akilah-un, ahil bangu chun aboltauvin ahi; chule hiche thu chu Juda miho lah-a akiseison sonin tugeijin aumin ahi.
target: So the soldiers took the money and did as they were instructed. And this story has been widely circulated among the Jews to this very day.

source: Chujouvin seijui somlekhat chu Galilee gama Jesu'n atepnao mola chun achetauvun ahi.
target: Then the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had told them to go.

source: Chuin Ama amu phatnun, chibai aboh-un; ahivangin abang bangin agingcha pouvin ahi.
target: When they saw him, they worshiped him; but some doubted.

source: Chuin Jesu ahenguva ahungin amaho chu ahoupin, ajah uva, Van'a le leija thuneina jouse keima eikipea ahitai.
target: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.

source: Hiche jeh chun nangho cheovin, namtina mi jouse seijuijin gasemun, a-Pa, a-Cha chule Lhagao Theng minin amaho chu baptize gabolun;
target: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

source: Chule keiman nangho kapeh thu jouse hi aboncha anit dinguvin gahilun; chule, veuvin vannoi leiset kichaini geijin keiman nangho kaumpi jing naove, ati. Amen.
target: and teaching them to obey everything I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age.”

source: Pathen Chapa Jesu Christa Kipana Thupha kipatna;
target: The beginning of the good news about Jesus the Messiah, the Son of God,

source: Themgaoho lekhabua kisun bangin, Ven, keiman kasottol namasang sang-ah kasole; Ama chun nalampi anasem ding ahi;
target: as it is written in Isaiah the prophet: “I will send my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way”—

source: Gamthipma khosam aw khatnin, Pakai lamlen semtohsan koijun, Alampi semjangun, tia kisun bang chun,
target: “a voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.’ ”

source: John Baptist chun gamthipmah twi alutsah-in, chonset suhmangna dinga lungheija baptize chan ding thu lhangsamin ahi.
target: And so John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.

source: Chuin Juda gama mi jouse le Jerusalem'a mi jouse ama henga acheuvin, achonsetnu aphongun, Jordan luija ama khutna abonun baptize achang taove.
target: The whole Judean countryside and all the people of Jerusalem went out to him. Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.

source: Chule John chu sangongsang mul ponin akivonin, savun konggah-in akong akigeh-in, chule a-anneh chu khaokho le gam khoiju ahi.
target: John wore clothing made of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.

source: Chule thu ahil lhanglen, Kanungah keima sanga hat chungnungjo ahunge, keima hi kuna akengchot khao sutlham dinga jong kilom kahipoi.
target: And this was his message: “After me comes the one more powerful than I, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.

source: Keiman nangho twija baptize kachansah nahiuvin; amavang Ama chun nangho Lhagao Thenga baptize nachansah dingu ahi, ati.
target: I baptize you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.”

source: Hilai chun ahitin ahi, Galilee gam sunga Nazareth kho-a konin Jesu ahungin, Jordan luija John khutna baptize achangtan ahi.
target: At that time Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

source: Chuin twi lah-a kona ahungdoh doh-in, van akikehso-a, Lhagao vakhu bang achunga ahung kumlhah amun:
target: Just as Jesus was coming up out of the water, he saw heaven being torn open and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

source: Van'a konin aw khat ahung gingin, Nangma ka-Chapa deitah nahi, nachungah kalung alhai tangeije, ati.
target: And a voice came from heaven: “You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased.”

source: Chuin Lhagao chun gamthipma apui mang paijin,
target: At once the Spirit sent him out into the wilderness,

source: Chua chun nisomli Satan lhep patepmin aumin, gamsa lah-a aumin; chuin vantil hon ahung jenleuvin ahi.
target: and he was in the wilderness forty days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and angels attended him.

source: Chujouvin John songkul'a akikhum jouvin, Jesu Galilee gama ahungin, Pathen lenggam Kipana Thupha ahil lhanglen,
target: After John was put in prison, Jesus went into Galilee, proclaiming the good news of God.

source: Phat alhingtai, chule Pathen lenggam jong anaitai; nalung heijun, Kipana Thupha hi tahsanun tin alhangsamin ahi.
target: “The time has come,” he said. “The kingdom of God has come near. Repent and believe the good news!”

source: Chuin Galilee dillen pang ajotpa na-a, Simon le asopipa Andrew dillena lensep amun; amani chu ngaman mi ahi lhone.
target: As Jesus walked beside the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and his brother Andrew casting a net into the lake, for they were fishermen.

source: Chuin Jesu'n amani jah-a chun, Kanung hinjui lhonin; keiman nangni mi man lensep hisah lhoninge, ati.
target: “Come, follow me,” Jesus said, “and I will send you out to fish for people.”

source: Chuin amanin alen adalha lhonin, anung ajui pai jeng lhontai.
target: At once they left their nets and followed him.

source: Chuin themkhat achechon jeple, Zebedee chapate ni Jacob leh anaopa John amani jong chu kong sunga len anakhui phat pet lhon amun;
target: When he had gone a little farther, he saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John in a boat, preparing their nets.

source: Chuin amani chu akou paileuvin ahile, amanin apa lhon Zebedee chu athalah soh ho toh kong sunga chun adalha lhonin, ajui lhontai.
target: Without delay he called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed him.

source: Chuin amaho Capernaum'a achelutnun; cholngah nin kikhopna in'ah alutnin, thu ahil paijenin ahi.
target: They went to Capernaum, and when the Sabbath came, Jesus went into the synagogue and began to teach.

source: Aman danthu sunho banga hil louva, thuneitah banga ahil jeh-in miho chun athuhil chu kidang asa lheh-un ahi.
target: The people were amazed at his teaching, because he taught them as one who had authority, not as the teachers of the law.

source: Chuin akikhopnao in'a chun lhagao boh vop mi khat anaumin, chule ama chun ahinsam paijenin,
target: Just then a man in their synagogue who was possessed by an impure spirit cried out,

source: Nazareth Jesu, nangle keiho ikimatnao i-um em? Eisumang uva hunga nahim? Nangma koi nahi kahenai, Pathen'a kon Atheng chu nahi, ati.
target: “What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God!”

source: Chuin Jesu'n ama chu aphoh-in, Thipmin, ama-a kon chun hung doh-in, ati.
target: “Be quiet!” said Jesus sternly. “Come out of him!”

source: Chuin lhagao boh chun mipa chu aheh-in, hapenin apengin, ahung potdoh tai.
target: The impure spirit shook the man violently and came out of him with a shriek.

source: Chuin mi jousen kidang asan alungdong lheh jengun; chutichun khatle khat akidongun, Hiche hi iti hintem? Hiche hi thuhil thah ahi! Aman thunei tah-in lhagao bohho thu apen, chule amaho jong athun anung jenguve, atiuvin ahi.
target: The people were all so amazed that they asked each other, “What is this? A new teaching—and with authority! He even gives orders to impure spirits and they obey him.”

source: Chuin Galilee gam kimvel chengse-a amin akithang pai jengtan ahi.
target: News about him spread quickly over the whole region of Galilee.

source: Chule kikhopna in'a kona ahungdoh doh-in, Simon le Andrew insunga chun Jacob le John toh alut paijun ahi.
target: As soon as they left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.

source: Ahin Simon nupanu chu khosih-in anan analumin; chuin amahon anat thu chu Jesu ahetsah paijun ahi.
target: Simon’s mother-in-law was in bed with a fever, and they immediately told Jesus about her.

source: Chutichun amanu koma chun achen, akhutnin atuh-in, akaithou tai; hichun akhosih chun alha jengin, chuin amanu chu amaho jenlen apangtai.
target: So he went to her, took her hand and helped her up. The fever left her and she began to wait on them.

source: Chuin nilhah ahia, nisa alhum jouvin, mihon ana damlou jouse le thilhavop ho ahin puijun;
target: That evening after sunset the people brought to Jesus all the sick and demon-possessed.

source: Chule khopi sunga mi jouse kotpi phung-ah akikhomun ahi.
target: The whole town gathered at the door,

source: Chuin Aman hiveichom chom veija damlou mi tamtah adamsah-in, chule thilha tamtahma adeldoh-in; ama Christa ahi chu ahet jeh-un thilhaho chu apao sahpon ahi.
target: and Jesus healed many who had various diseases. He also drove out many demons, but he would not let the demons speak because they knew who he was.

source: Chuin jing khovah lhah masang peh-in athouvin, apotdoh-in gamthip munah achen, chua chun agataovin ahi.
target: Very early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up, left the house and went off to a solitary place, where he prayed.

source: Chuin Simon le agoldangho chun anung ajuijun,
target: Simon and his companions went to look for him,

source: Amudoh phatnun ajah-a, Mi jouse hinla nang nahol cheh-un, atiuve.
target: and when they found him, they exclaimed: “Everyone is looking for you!”

source: Chuin Aman, Naidunga khopi dang danga jong kahil lhangle theina dingin cheohite; hiche dinga chu hung kahi, ati.
target: Jesus replied, “Let us go somewhere else—to the nearby villages—so I can preach there also. That is why I have come.”

source: Chuin ama Galilee gamsese-ah achelen, akikhopnao in tinah thu ahil lhanglen, chule thilha adeldoh peh-in ahi.
target: So he traveled throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.

source: Chuin miphah khat Jesu henga ahungin, ajah-a, Nalung ahile neidam thengsah thei ahi tin a-angah adilsun ataotan ahi.
target: A man with leprosy came to him and begged him on his knees, “If you are willing, you can make me clean.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n alungset behseh-in, akhut alhangin, athamin, Kalung ahi; dam thengtan, ati.
target: Jesus was indignant. He reached out his hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” he said. “Be clean!”

source: Chuin hiche thu chu aseijou jouvin, chupettah chun aphah chun adalha paijin, athengsel tai.
target: Immediately the leprosy left him and he was cleansed.

source: Chuin Aman amapa chu akhamchah kheh-in, asolmang paijin;
target: Jesus sent him away at once with a strong warning:

source: Ajah-a, Ven, koima jah-a sei hihbeh-in, ahin chenlang thempu gakimusah-in, chule nadam theng thu dol chu amaho hettohsahnan Mosi thupehsa thilpeh ding chu gapetan, ati.
target: “See that you don’t tell this to anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”

source: Ahivangin amapa apotdoh-in, hiche thu chu asamlen, aha phonjal cheh tan; achuti jehchun chukalin Jesu lhangphong in koima khopi sungah alut theita hih-in, gamthip thipma aumjotai: chule muntina konin ahengah miho ahungjiuve.
target: Instead he went out and began to talk freely, spreading the news. As a result, Jesus could no longer enter a town openly but stayed outside in lonely places. Yet the people still came to him from everywhere.

source: Ni chomkhat jouvin Capernaum'a alut kitnin ahile, in'a aume ti akithang soh jengtan ahi.
target: A few days later, when Jesus again entered Capernaum, the people heard that he had come home.

source: Hiche pettah chun mipi tamtah ahung khomun ahile, aumna dingu mun kotphung jeng jong a-ong tapon; aman amaho chu thu ahiltan ahi.
target: They gathered in such large numbers that there was no room left, not even outside the door, and he preached the word to them.

source: Chuin langthi khat mi lin ajongun ahengah ahinpuijui.
target: Some men came, bringing to him a paralyzed man, carried by four of them.

source: Chuin mipi jeh-a akom naija ahung lut theilou jeh-un, in chung chu Ama umna dontah aphet vangun, langthipa chu alupna pumin a-ang sungah agah khailha suh-un ahi.
target: Since they could not get him to Jesus because of the crowd, they made an opening in the roof above Jesus by digging through it and then lowered the mat the man was lying on.

source: Chuin Jesu'n atahsanjeu chu amun, langthipa jah-a chun, Chapa, nachonset naho kingaidam ahitai, ati.
target: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralyzed man, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”

source: Ahinla danthu sunho phabep khat hia chu tou ahiuvin, alungthim uva,
target: Now some teachers of the law were sitting there, thinking to themselves,

source: Hichepa hin ibola Pathen taitom na-a hitobang thu aseiham? Pathen tailou chonset koiham angaidam thei ding? atiuve.
target: “Why does this fellow talk like that? He’s blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

source: Chuin achuti gelu chu Jesu'n alungin ahepai jenin, ajah uva, Ibola nalunguva hicheng chu nagelu ham?
target: Immediately Jesus knew in his spirit that this was what they were thinking in their hearts, and he said to them, “Why are you thinking these things?

source: Langthipa jah-a hi, Nachonset naho kingaidama ahitai, kiti le; Thouvin, nalupna kilah-inlang lam jotnin, ti chu hoijoh seibai jo-em?
target: Which is easier: to say to this paralyzed man, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, take your mat and walk’?

source: Hijongle leiset chunga Mihem Chapan chonset ngaidamna thahat aneije ti nahetna dingun, atin,
target: But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.” So he said to the man,

source: Langthipa jah-a, Thouvin, nalupna kilah-in lang na-in'a chetan kati ahi, ati.
target: “I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home.”

source: Chuin ama chu athoudoh pai jengin, alupna akilah-in, japi mitmutah chun achedohtan; chuphatnin ajapiuvin kidang asa lheh jengun, Hitobang himhim kamukha pouve, atiuvin Pathen avahchoi taove.
target: He got up, took his mat and walked out in full view of them all. This amazed everyone and they praised God, saying, “We have never seen anything like this!”

source: Chuin apotnin dillen pangah achekit tai; chuin mihonpi chu ahenga acheuvin ahile aman thu ahile.
target: Once again Jesus went out beside the lake. A large crowd came to him, and he began to teach them.

source: Chuin achena-a Alphaeus chapa Levi kaidonna mun'a atou amun, ajah-a, Kanung hinjuijin, ati. Chuin ama akipatdoh-in anung ajuitai.
target: As he walked along, he saw Levi son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax collector’s booth. “Follow me,” Jesus told him, and Levi got up and followed him.

source: Chuti chun Levi in'a ankong aumpet chun, kaidongho le michonseho tamtah-in Jesu le aseijuiteho chengse chutoh ankong aum khomun ahi. Ijeh-inem itile amaho tamtah ahiuvin, ama nungjui cheh ahiuve.
target: While Jesus was having dinner at Levi’s house, many tax collectors and sinners were eating with him and his disciples, for there were many who followed him.

source: Chuin Pharisai ho le danthusun hon michonseho le kaidongho toh an aneh khom chu amu phatnun, aseijuite jah-a, Iti dana kaidongho le michonseho toh an aneh khomham? atiuvin ahi.
target: When the teachers of the law who were Pharisees saw him eating with the sinners and tax collectors, they asked his disciples: “Why does he eat with tax collectors and sinners?”

source: Hichu Jesu'n ajah phatnin, ajah uva, atidamten louthem angaipouve, adamlouten bou angaijui; michonpha te kou-a hung kahipoi; lungheidia michonse te kou-a hungjoh kahibouve, ati.
target: On hearing this, Jesus said to them, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”

source: Chule John seijuite le Pharisai hon an angoljiu ahin; amaho ahungun Jesu jah-a, I-atile John seijuite le Pharisai hon an angol jiuva, nangma seijuiten an angolji louham? atiuve.
target: Now John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting. Some people came and asked Jesus, “How is it that John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees are fasting, but yours are not?”

source: Chuin Jesu'n amaho jah-a, Aloite chu moulang chun aumpi laise-a an angol thei ngaijum? Moulang chun aumpi laiseuva an angol thei louvu ahi.
target: Jesus answered, “How can the guests of the bridegroom fast while he is with them? They cannot, so long as they have him with them.

source: Amavang moulang chu akomuva kona kipuimang ni hung lhung ding ahi, chuche nile an angol dingu ahi.
target: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them, and on that day they will fast.

source: Koiman pon sopnem loulai halin ponlui abeh ngaipoi; chuti bolle athahjoh chun alui chu akaiset ding, akehlai chu kehcheh joding ahi.
target: “No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. Otherwise, the new piece will pull away from the old, making the tear worse.

source: Chule koiman lengpitwi thah savun peng luija akhum ngaipoi; ichuti bolle alengpitwi chun asavun peng chu tumkeh intin, lengpitwi savun peng akopma mang ding ahi. Lengpitwi thah chu peng thah-a akhumji bouvui, ati.
target: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. No, they pour new wine into new wineskins.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, cholngah nin Jesu'n changlei lai ajotnin ahile, aseijuiten ache pumun changvui chu asih pantaovin ahi.
target: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and as his disciples walked along, they began to pick some heads of grain.

source: Chuin Pharisai hon ajah-a, Vetan, ibola cholngah ni-a bol ngailou aboluham? atiuvin ahi.
target: The Pharisees said to him, “Look, why are they doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, David le aloiho alhahsamuva, agilkel petnuva chu ipi abolu nasimkhah louvu ham?
target: He answered, “Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry and in need?

source: Abiathar thempu chungnung ahi laijin Pathen in'a alutnin, thempu tailou adangin aneh ngailou vetsahna changlhah chu anen, aloiho jong apen ahi.
target: In the days of Abiathar the high priest, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah uva, Cholngah ni chu mihem dinga kisem ahi, cholngah ni dinga mihem kisemjoh ahipoi.
target: Then he said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

source: Chuti chu ahin Mihem Chapa chu cholngah ni Pakai jong ahi, ati.
target: So the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.”

source: Chuin kikhopna in'a alut kitnin ahile, chuachun mi khutlang ngoi khat aumin ahi.
target: Another time Jesus went into the synagogue, and a man with a shriveled hand was there.

source: Chuin ama chu ahehset theina dingun, cholngah ni-a aboldame aboldam hih-em, tin achang lhiuvin ahi.
target: Some of them were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal him on the Sabbath.

source: Chuin Aman khutlang ngoipa jah-a chun, Alaija hung dingdoh-in, ati.
target: Jesus said to the man with the shriveled hand, “Stand up in front of everyone.”

source: Chuin ajah uva, Cholngah ni-a apha bol angaiha, ase bol angaiham? Lhagao huhhing angaiha, suhmang angaiham? atin ahile, amaho athip chetchut jengun ahi.
target: Then Jesus asked them, “Which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to kill?” But they remained silent.

source: Chuin Aman alungtah jeh-u chun alungphamon, lungsatenin amaho chu ave kimvelin, chuin mipa jah-a chun, Nakhut lhangin, ati. Chuin alhangin ahile, akhut chu alangkhat bangin adamtan ahi.
target: He looked around at them in anger and, deeply distressed at their stubborn hearts, said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was completely restored.

source: Chuin Pharisai ho chu apotdoh-un, amachu iti suhmang dingham ngaiton, Herod miho chutoh akihoutoh paitaove.
target: Then the Pharisees went out and began to plot with the Herodians how they might kill Jesus.

source: Chuin Jesu aseijuite toh dillen lama chun achetauve. Chule mipi tamtah-in ajuijin, Galilee gama kon, Juda gama kon,
target: Jesus withdrew with his disciples to the lake, and a large crowd from Galilee followed.

source: Jerusalem khopi-a kon, Idumia gama kon, Jordan gala kon, Tyre le Sidon gam kimvela kon chule mihonpi tamtah ahiuvin, athilbol loupitah ho ajah phatnun, ahengah ahungun ahi.
target: When they heard about all he was doing, many people came to him from Judea, Jerusalem, Idumea, and the regions across the Jordan and around Tyre and Sidon.

source: Mipi jeh chun kongneo gotsa koijin aseijuite asolin, achuti loule eineh khauvinte, ati.
target: Because of the crowd he told his disciples to have a small boat ready for him, to keep the people from crowding him.

source: Mi tamtah adamsah ahitah jeh chun, natna nei jousen ama atohkhah theina dingun Ama aumchah jengun;
target: For he had healed many, so that those with diseases were pushing forward to touch him.

source: Lhagao boh chengse jong chun ama amuchanun a-angah aboh khupmun, Nang Pathen Chapa chu nahi, tin asamjiuvin ahi.
target: Whenever the impure spirits saw him, they fell down before him and cried out, “You are the Son of God.”

source: Ahin Aman ama chu aphondoh louna dingun amaho chu akhamchah-in ahi.
target: But he gave them strict orders not to tell others about him.

source: Chuin mol chunga akaltouvin, aman angaichat chengse chu akouvin, amaho ahenga ahungun ahi.
target: Jesus went up on a mountainside and called to him those he wanted, and they came to him.

source: Chuin akoma um dingle, thuhil lhangle-a asol dingin, somleni alheng doh-in,
target: He appointed twelve that they might be with him and that he might send them out to preach

source: Damlou ho damsah theina thahat neidingle, thilhaho nodoh theina thunei dingin:
target: and to have authority to drive out demons.

source: Simon aman Peter asah-in;
target: These are the twelve he appointed: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter),

source: Zebedee chapa Jacob, chule anaopa John, amani chu amin Boanerges asah-in; hichu van gin chate, tina ahi;
target: James son of Zebedee and his brother John (to them he gave the name Boanerges , which means “sons of thunder”),

source: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, Alphaeus chapa Jacob, Thaddaeus, Canaan mi Simon,
target: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot

source: Chule Ama matsah-a pang Judas Iscariot ahiuve. Chuin amaho insunga alut taovin ahi.
target: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed him.

source: Chuin mihonpi ahung kikhom kit taovin ahile, an tahbah jong anethei tapouvin ahi.
target: Then Jesus entered a house, and again a crowd gathered, so that he and his disciples were not even able to eat.

source: Hichu a-inkoten ajahdoh phatnun, angola hitakhu atiuvin, ahung konun thahatsana mat dingin ahung gouvin ahi.
target: When his family heard about this, they went to take charge of him, for they said, “He is out of his mind.”

source: Chule Jerusalem'a kona hungsuh danthu sunho jong chun, Beelzabul vop ahi, chule thilha anodoh jong hi thilhaho lengpa vanga anodoh hija hi, atiuvin ahi.
target: And the teachers of the law who came down from Jerusalem said, “He is possessed by Beelzebul! By the prince of demons he is driving out demons.”

source: Chuin Aman amaho chu akouvin, thulemin aseijin ajah uva, Satan'in Satan iti anodoh thei dingham?
target: So Jesus called them over to him and began to speak to them in parables: “How can Satan drive out Satan?

source: Gamsung khat amale ama kidouto hen kikhenle, hiche gam chu dingdoh thei louding ahi.
target: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

source: Insung khat amale ama kidouto henlang hileh, hite insung chu dingdoh thei pouvinte.
target: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

source: Satan jong amale ama kidouto henlang kisep khenle, dingdoh thei louva mangthahjo ding ahi.
target: And if Satan opposes himself and is divided, he cannot stand; his end has come.

source: Koiman mihat chu kanchom masa louvin, a-in'a alutnin athilkeu achompeh theipoi; akanchom masatna chutengle achom dingbou ahi.
target: In fact, no one can enter a strong man’s house without first tying him up. Then he can plunder the strong man’s house.

source: Chule tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Mihem chate hi achonsetnao itobang hijongle, Pathen ataitom nao hijongle, taitomna jouseu chu kingaidam ding ahi.
target: Truly I tell you, people can be forgiven all their sins and every slander they utter,

source: Amavang koi hileh Lhagao Theng taitom vang chun imatih chana ngaidam amulou ding; tonsot themo channa-a chua ahitai, ati.
target: but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; they are guilty of an eternal sin.”

source: Lhagao boh vop ahi, ati jeh uva chutia chu asei ahi.
target: He said this because they were saying, “He has an impure spirit.”

source: Chuin anu le asopite ahungun, inpoa adingun, ama kouvin mi asolun ahi.
target: Then Jesus’ mother and brothers arrived. Standing outside, they sent someone in to call him.

source: Chule avela chu mihonpi touchah khet ahin, amahon ajah-a chun, Ven, inpoa khun nanu le nasopiten nahol uve atiuve.
target: A crowd was sitting around him, and they told him, “Your mother and brothers are outside looking for you.”

source: Chuin Aman ajah uva, Kanu le kasopite koi koi hiuvem? tin adonbutne.
target: “Who are my mother and my brothers?” he asked.

source: Chuin akimvela touho chu ave golin, Hiteho hi kanu le kasopite ahiuve.
target: Then he looked at those seated in a circle around him and said, “Here are my mother and my brothers!

source: Ijeh-inem itile Pathen lunglama chonpatah chu kasopipa le kasopinu chule kanu ahi, ati.
target: Whoever does God’s will is my brother and sister and mother.”

source: Chuin dillen pangah thu ahilpan kittan ahile mihon tamtah akomah ahung kikhomun, chuin dillen chunga kong-ah alutnin atouvin; chule mipi chengse chu vapamah tolah aumuvin ahi.
target: Again Jesus began to teach by the lake. The crowd that gathered around him was so large that he got into a boat and sat in it out on the lake, while all the people were along the shore at the water’s edge.

source: Chule amaho chu thulemin thu tamtah ahilin, athuhil lah-a chun aseije,
target: He taught them many things by parables, and in his teaching said:

source: Ngaijun, muchi thepa muchi then achen:
target: “Listen! A farmer went out to sow his seed.

source: chuin ahitin ahi, athe atheleh abang lamsih-a achun, chunga leng vachaten ahung lohgam taove.
target: As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path, and the birds came and ate it up.

source: Chule abang songlheo chunga leipatna-ah achun, alei asalou jeh-in akehdoh pai jengin:
target: Some fell on rocky places, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly, because the soil was shallow.

source: Ahivangin nisa ahung soh-in ahile asanggon, jung anei lou jeh-in, agoptan ahi.
target: But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.

source: Chule abang ling lah-a achun, aling chu ahung khangin adeplihtan, aga himhim aumtapoi.
target: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the plants, so that they did not bear grain.

source: Chuin adangho chu leipha laijah achun, akehdoh-in ahung khangin chule agatan; abang somthum cheng, abang somgup cheng, abang ja khat cheng apungtan ahi, ati.
target: Still other seed fell on good soil. It came up, grew and produced a crop, some multiplying thirty, some sixty, some a hundred times.”

source: Chuin Aman ajah uva, Angaina ding na neijan ngaihen, ati.
target: Then Jesus said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear.”

source: Chuin achanga aum petnin, akimvela umho le somleni chun athulem seiho chu adongun ahi.
target: When he was alone, the Twelve and the others around him asked him about the parables.

source: Chuin Aman amaho jah-a, Pathen lenggam thuguh chu nangho kipe-a nahitaove; polama um mite jah dinga vang ijakai thulema kisei ahi.
target: He told them, “The secret of the kingdom of God has been given to you. But to those on the outside everything is said in parables

source: Chutia chu amahon muvang chu amudingu, ahetdoh lou dingu, jah vang chu ajah dingu, ahetkhen lou dingu ahi; achuti loule hung kihei kitnuntin, chule achonsetnao ngaidamin umgetninte, ati.
target: so that, “ ‘they may be ever seeing but never perceiving, and ever hearing but never understanding; otherwise they might turn and be forgiven!’ ”

source: Chuin Aman ajah uva, Nanghon hiche thulem hi nahet lou mongu ham? Achutile thulem dang jouse iti nahet dinguham?
target: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How then will you understand any parable?

source: Muchi thepa chun thu athe ahi.
target: The farmer sows the word.

source: Chule hicheho hi thu kithena lamsih-a chuho chu ahi; amahon thu ajah jah-un, Satan ahung paijin, alung sunguva thu kithe chu alah mang peh tan ahi.
target: Some people are like seed along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.

source: Chutobangma chun songlheo chung leipatna-a chua chu hicheho hi ahi; amaho chu thu ajah jah-a thanom tah-a joppai jengho hi ahi;
target: Others, like seed sown on rocky places, hear the word and at once receive it with joy.

source: Ahivangin amaho chu jung nei lou ahiuvin, chomcha khat aumjiuvin ahi: chujoule thu jeh-a hesohna ahiloule bolsetna ahung umtengle, alhupaiji taove.
target: But since they have no root, they last only a short time. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.

source: Chule hicheho hi linglah-a muchi kithe ho chu ahiuve; amaho chun thu ajauvin,
target: Still others, like seed sown among thorns, hear the word;

source: Ahivangin leiset hinkho lungkhamna, lheplhahna dimset haosatna, chule ngaichatna dangdang alutnin, hichun thu chu adeplih jin, ga louvin aumjitai.
target: but the worries of this life, the deceitfulness of wealth and the desires for other things come in and choke the word, making it unfruitful.

source: Chule lei pha laija chua chu; athu ja-a, jopteho chu ahiuvin, abang ajat som thumin, abang ajat som gupmin, chule abang ajat ja-in agapungin ahi, ati.
target: Others, like seed sown on good soil, hear the word, accept it, and produce a crop—some thirty, some sixty, some a hundred times what was sown.”

source: Chuin Aman ajah uva, meivah khu lo noi, ahiloule jalkhun noija tun dinga kihinchoi ngaijem? Akhom chunga tunding chu angaina hilouham?
target: He said to them, “Do you bring in a lamp to put it under a bowl or a bed? Instead, don’t you put it on its stand?

source: Ijeh-inem itile kiphong lou ding imacha ki-ima aumpoi; kilangdoh lou ding imacha akiselguh aumpoi.
target: For whatever is hidden is meant to be disclosed, and whatever is concealed is meant to be brought out into the open.

source: Koi hileh angaina ding na neijan ngaihen, ati.
target: If anyone has ears to hear, let them hear.”

source: Chuin ajah uva, Najah chengseu hi ipiham, kichihtheijun. Nanghon natebang banguva nangho jong kitepeh ding nahiuve; chule nangho aja chengse hi kipehbe dingbon nahiuve.
target: “Consider carefully what you hear,” he continued. “With the measure you use, it will be measured to you—and even more.

source: Ijeh-inem itile aneija chu kipehbentin; chule anei louva chu aneichasun jong chu ama-a kona kilahpeh ding ahi, ati.
target: Whoever has will be given more; whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them.”

source: Aman ajah uva, Pathen gam umchan chu, mikhatnin amuchi leija athe-a:
target: He also said, “This is what the kingdom of God is like. A man scatters seed on the ground.

source: Amachu sunteng imuji, janteng thouji, muchi chu hung kehdoh-a hung khangdoh, amatah-inla ajeh ahetlou tobang chu ahi
target: Night and day, whether he sleeps or gets up, the seed sprouts and grows, though he does not know how.

source: Ijeh inem itile leisetnin achamin ama-a konin ahin ga sahjin, amasan akung, abanle ado, chujoule avui, chujou kitle avuija aga achanglhing jitai.
target: All by itself the soil produces grain—first the stalk, then the head, then the full kernel in the head.

source: Ahin aga chu amin phatle, a-at phat ahitah jeh-in, aman koiten a-atpan jitai, ati.
target: As soon as the grain is ripe, he puts the sickle to it, because the harvest has come.”

source: Chuin hitin asei kitne, Pathen gam hi ipitoh kitekah ding hitam? ahiloule ipi thulema kisei ding hitam?
target: Again he said, “What shall we say the kingdom of God is like, or what parable shall we use to describe it?

source: Ankam mu chang khat tobang ahi, hichu leija akithe-a ahile, vannoi leisetna muchi jouse lah-a aneopen ahin;
target: It is like a mustard seed, which is the smallest of all seeds on earth.

source: Ahivangin akithe joule ahung kedoh-a, hung khanga, hampa dang jouse sanga hung lenjo; abah len tahtah hinso-a, chutia chu chunga leng vachate aboh lim noija age theiju tobang ahi, ati.
target: Yet when planted, it grows and becomes the largest of all garden plants, with such big branches that the birds can perch in its shade.”

source: Chuin chutobang thulem tamtah-in amahon ahetthei kham khamun thu ahilin ahi.
target: With many similar parables Jesus spoke the word to them, as much as they could understand.

source: Chule thulem louvin ajah uva imacha aseikhapoi: ahin aseijuite chengse vang chu achanguva aumtengule ijakai ahilchen jin ahi.
target: He did not say anything to them without using a parable. But when he was alone with his own disciples, he explained everything.

source: Chuin nilhah-in Aman amaho jah-a, Agal lang khatna galkaiju hite, ati.
target: That day when evening came, he said to his disciples, “Let us go over to the other side.”

source: Chutichun mihonpi chu asoldoh jouvun, ama aum bang bang chun kong'a akitolpi taovin, kong dang dangto jong alhonun ahi.
target: Leaving the crowd behind, they took him along, just as he was, in the boat. There were also other boats with him.

source: Chuin khopihui ahung nungin ahile, twikinong chu kong sunga ahung kinong lut matchet jengtan, chuti ahi jeh chun kong chu dimpai ding ahitan ahi.
target: A furious squall came up, and the waves broke over the boat, so that it was nearly swamped.

source: Amala kong mei lamah lukhap akhapmin a-imun ahi: chuin asukhangun, ajah-a, Rabbi, kathigam dingu hi na ima lou louham? atiuvin ahi.
target: Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on a cushion. The disciples woke him and said to him, “Teacher, don’t you care if we drown?”

source: Akhah phatnin huipi chu aphoh-in, dillen jah-a, Umthimin, thipbeh chan umin, ati. Chuin hui chu ahaijin, athip heltai.
target: He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, “Quiet! Be still!” Then the wind died down and it was completely calm.

source: Chuin Aman ajah uva, Ibola chuti kichat nahiuvem? Iti dana tahsanna himhim nanei louvu ham? ati.
target: He said to his disciples, “Why are you so afraid? Do you still have no faith?”

source: Chuphatnin Ama chu kichat mainan akichata pouvin, Hichepa hi itobang mi hija, huipi leh dillen kinong sanin athu angaiham? tin akihouchut chut taovin ahi.
target: They were terrified and asked each other, “Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him!”

source: Chutichun dillen gal langkhat agalkaijun, Garesene miho gama alhung taovin ahi.
target: They went across the lake to the region of the Gerasenes.

source: Chuin kong'a kona apotdoh doh-in, lhan lah-a kona hung lhagaoboh vop mikhatnin atoh paijenin ahi.
target: When Jesus got out of the boat, a man with an impure spirit came from the tombs to meet him.

source: Ama chu lhan lah jenga chu cheng ahin, koimachan thihkhaova jong akan joulou ahi;
target: This man lived in the tombs, and no one could bind him anymore, not even with a chain.

source: Ajehchu bul atuh jiuva, thihkhao vajong akanjiu ahin; ahivanga thihkhao chu asat tanjin, bul chu atumkehjin, koimachan abol ngoi jou louhel ahitai.
target: For he had often been chained hand and foot, but he tore the chains apart and broke the irons on his feet. No one was strong enough to subdue him.

source: Chule sunle jan-in lhan lah le molchunga aumjin, chule a-aole a-ao lejin, songin ama le ama aki-at chenjin ahi.
target: Night and day among the tombs and in the hills he would cry out and cut himself with stones.

source: Ahin gamlatah-a kona Jesu ahinmu phatnin, ahung lhaijelin a-anga aboh khupmin chibai aboh-in;
target: When he saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees in front of him.

source: Chuin hatah-in asamin, Pathen chungnung pen Chapa Jesu, nangle kei ipi ikimatna umam? Pathen mina nahenga katao ahi, neibolgim hih-in; ati.
target: He shouted at the top of his voice, “What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? In God’s name don’t torture me!”

source: Ajehchu Aman ajah-a, Nangma lhagao boh, hiche mipa-a kon chun hung potdoh-in, ati ahi.
target: For Jesus had said to him, “Come out of this man, you impure spirit!”

source: Chuin Aman, Namin ipiham? tin adonge. Chuin aman, Tamtah kahi jeh-un kamin Janel ahi, ati.
target: Then Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”

source: Chuin chuche gamkai sunga kona asoldoh louna dingun Jesu hengah hataovin ataotan ahi.
target: And he begged Jesus again and again not to send them out of the area.

source: Tun akoma molsang panga chu vohcha hon tamtah lha-a ahi.
target: A large herd of pigs was feeding on the nearby hillside.

source: Chuin lhagaoboh jouse chu ahenga ataovun, Vohcha hon lah-a kalut theina dingun neisolun, ati taove.
target: The demons begged Jesus, “Send us among the pigs; allow us to go into them.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n phalna apetai. Chuin lhagao bohho chu apotdoh-un, vohchaho sunga chun alut taovin ahile, vohcha hon chu halhaijin alhaijun, kola alhai lhauvin, dillena chun alhalutnun, (voh honho chu sangni tobang hiuva ahin,) athigam taovin ahi.
target: He gave them permission, and the impure spirits came out and went into the pigs. The herd, about two thousand in number, rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.

source: Chuin vohcha chingho chu ajamun, khopi sung le loujaovah agaseile taovin ahi. Chuin Ipi iti hitam, tia ve dingin ahungun ahi.
target: Those tending the pigs ran off and reported this in the town and countryside, and the people went out to see what had happened.

source: Chuin Jesu kom ahung lhunun, thilha janel voppa chun pon akisila chule lung lima anatou chu amuvin, akicha lheh jengun ahi.
target: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons, sitting there, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

source: Chuin thilha voppa le vohchaho umchan achen achaija mu-a hetohhon ajah uva aseijun ahi.
target: Those who had seen it told the people what had happened to the demon-possessed man—and told about the pigs as well.

source: Hichun amahon agam sunguva kona potdoh dingin ahenga atao pantaovin ahi.
target: Then the people began to plead with Jesus to leave their region.

source: Chuin kong'a alut phatnin, masanga thilha voppa chun amatoh thakhatna umna dingin ataotai.
target: As Jesus was getting into the boat, the man who had been demon-possessed begged to go with him.

source: Ahivangin Jesu'n ajahdan, ajah-a, Na-in'a chenlang na-in kote hengah Pakaiyin itobang thil loupi nabolpeh-a, iti nakhoto hitam abonchan gaseitan, atijotai.
target: Jesus did not let him, but said, “Go home to your own people and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and how he has had mercy on you.”

source: Chuin akipat doh-in, Decapolis kho jouse-a Jesu'n thil lentah abolpeh chu lhang phongtah-in asamle pantai; chuin mi jousen kidang asa lheh jengun ahi.
target: So the man went away and began to tell in the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him. And all the people were amazed.

source: Chuin Jesu kong'a akitola agal lang khat pang akaidoh-in, mihon tamtah ahung kikhomum; ama dillen pangah aumin ahi.
target: When Jesus had again crossed over by boat to the other side of the lake, a large crowd gathered around him while he was by the lake.

source: Chuin kikhopna in'a vaipoho lah-a mi khat amin Jairus chu ahungin, Jesu amu phatnin akhomuh-ah aboh khupmin;
target: Then one of the synagogue leaders, named Jairus, came, and when he saw Jesus, he fell at his feet.

source: Chule ajah-a, Kachanu chapang neocha khat thi dingin alume; katao ahi, adamdoh nadingin hungin lang achunga nakhut hung ngamin tia katao ahi, tin hangeh-in angehtan ahi.
target: He pleaded earnestly with him, “My little daughter is dying. Please come and put your hands on her so that she will be healed and live.”

source: Chuin Jesu ama chutoh alhonin achetai, chule mihonpi nasatah-in ajuijun atom lellul jengun ahi.
target: So Jesus went with him. A large crowd followed and pressed around him.

source: Chuin numei khat kum somle kum ni athi longa damlou ahin,
target: And a woman was there who had been subject to bleeding for twelve years.

source: Louthem tamtah-a kona thohgimna tamtah anatoh-a, anei jouse asuhmang ahitan, imala aphachom pon, ahin akhohcheh cheh jon ahi.
target: She had suffered a great deal under the care of many doctors and had spent all she had, yet instead of getting better she grew worse.

source: Amanun Jesu thudol ajah phatnin, anunga mihonpi lah-a chun ahungin, apon chu athamtan ahi.
target: When she heard about Jesus, she came up behind him in the crowd and touched his cloak,

source: Amanu chun, Apon jeng jong hi thamleng kadam ding ahi, ati ahi.
target: because she thought, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be healed.”

source: Chuin chupetah chun athiput chu akangin atangtan; chule amanun kanat thoh lela konin kadamtai ti chu ati chunga akihet tan ahi.
target: Immediately her bleeding stopped and she felt in her body that she was freed from her suffering.

source: Chupettah chun Jesu'n ati chunga kona thilboltheina apot chu ahen, mipi lah-a chun akihei kimvelin, Kapon thama chu koiham? atin adong tan ahi.
target: At once Jesus realized that power had gone out from him. He turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”

source: Chuin aseijuite chun ajah-a, Mipi hijatnin naneh chinto mu jinga, iti dana Koiham eithama, natiham? atiuve.
target: “You see the people crowding against you,” his disciples answered, “and yet you can ask, ‘Who touched me?’ ”

source: Chuin Aman chuche bola chu muleng tin avelelen ahi.
target: But Jesus kept looking around to see who had done it.

source: Ahin amanu chun achunga thilsoh chu ahen, akichasasan akihot pumpumin ahungin, a-angah aboh khupmin, ajah-a thutah jouse chu aseidoh tan ahi.
target: Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell at his feet and, trembling with fear, told him the whole truth.

source: Chuin Aman ajah-a, Chanu, natahsanin nadamsah ahitai, lung mongin chenlang nanatna-a kon chun damtan, ati.
target: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be freed from your suffering.”

source: Aman hiche thu chu aseina laijin, kikhopna in vaihompa in'a kon chun mi ahungun, ajah-a, Nachanu athitai; ibola houhil hi nacholsah nahlai dingham? ahung ti.
target: While Jesus was still speaking, some people came from the house of Jairus, the synagogue leader. “Your daughter is dead,” they said. “Why bother the teacher anymore?”

source: Jesu'n thukisei chu ajah jah-in, kikhopna in vaihompa jah-a chun, kicha hih-in, tahsana bou neijin, ati.
target: Overhearing what they said, Jesus told him, “Don’t be afraid; just believe.”

source: Chuin Peter, Jacob, chule Jacob naopa John hicheng tailou chu, midang koiman ajui ding aphalpon ahi.
target: He did not let anyone follow him except Peter, James and John the brother of James.

source: Chuin kikhopna in vaihompa in'a chun ahungun ahile, anaboi cheichoi jengu le mihonpi aka le maovu chu amun ahi.
target: When they came to the home of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw a commotion, with people crying and wailing loudly.

source: Chuin Ama insunga alutnin, ajah uva, Ibola poh cheichoi nahiuva chule kapma nahiuvem? Chapangnu chu athi ahipoi, a-imu ahibouve, ati.
target: He went in and said to them, “Why all this commotion and wailing? The child is not dead but asleep.”

source: Chuin amahon anuisat taovin ahi. Ahivangin abonchauvin anodohsoh-in, chapangnu nule pa toh, chule ama hinkilhonpi chengse toh, chapangnu umna-a chun alutnun ahi.
target: But they laughed at him. After he put them all out, he took the child’s father and mother and the disciples who were with him, and went in where the child was.

source: Chuin Aman chapangnu khut chu atuh-in, ajah-a, Talitha cumi, ati: hichu, boinu thouvin tina ahi.
target: He took her by the hand and said to her, “Talitha koum!” (which means “Little girl, I say to you, get up!” ).

source: Chupettah chun chapangnu chu ahung thouvin, adingin lam ajotpai jengin ahi; ajehchu amanu chu kum somle kum ni hia ahitai. Chutah chun amaho chun kidang mainan kidang asapouve.
target: Immediately the girl stood up and began to walk around (she was twelve years old). At this they were completely astonished.

source: Ahin Aman hiche thuhi koima hetsah hih-un tin thupeh khaotah aneijin; chule amanu chu neh ding an apehna diuvin thu apen ahi.
target: He gave strict orders not to let anyone know about this, and told them to give her something to eat.
