source: Chuin chua konin achedoh-in, Ama gam lamah ahungin; chule aseijuiten ajuijun ahi.
target: Jesus left there and went to his hometown, accompanied by his disciples.

source: Chuin cholngah ni ahung hi phatnin, kikhopna in'a thu ahil pantan ahi. Chuin athuhil chu mi tamtah ajaho chun kidang asauvin, Hichepa hin hoija kona hichengpi hi akilah hingana? Ama kipe-a chihna hi ipi chihna hija, akhutnin hitobang bolmo kidang dang abol jeng hitam?
target: When the Sabbath came, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many who heard him were amazed. “Where did this man get these things?” they asked. “What’s this wisdom that has been given him? What are these remarkable miracles he is performing?

source: Ama hi thingthem bol Jacob, Joses, Juda chule Simon sopi, Mariam chapa chu hilou ham? Asopinute jong hikoma ilah uva um hilou hiuvam? atiuvin, chule achunga alung himo taovin ahi.
target: Isn’t this the carpenter? Isn’t this Mary’s son and the brother of James, Joseph, Judas and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” And they took offense at him.

source: Ahivangin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah uva, Themgao ama gamsungle ama inkote lah, chule ama insung tailouvah jabol louvin aum ngaipoi, ati.
target: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor except in his own town, among his relatives and in his own home.”

source: Chukoma chun ana adamlou phabep khat chunga akhut angapma adamsah tailou chu, thil kidang imacha abol tapoi.
target: He could not do any miracles there, except lay his hands on a few sick people and heal them.

source: Chule atahsan lou jeh-u chun adatmo lheh jengin ahi. Chuin khonainai dunga ache lelen thu ahil leletai.
target: He was amazed at their lack of faith. Then Jesus went around teaching from village to village.

source: Chuin somleni ho chu akouvin, mini nin asoldoh-in; chule lhagaoboh chunga thuneina apen;
target: Calling the Twelve to him, he began to send them out two by two and gave them authority over impure spirits.

source: Chule ajin naova dingin tenggol tailou ima, changlhah jong, sakhao jong, dangka dip sunga jong sumthem aken louhel dingun thu apen;
target: These were his instructions: “Take nothing for the journey except a staff—no bread, no bag, no money in your belts.

source: Kengchot vang kiseuvin; sangkhol thoni ki-ah hih-un, ati.
target: Wear sandals but not an extra shirt.

source: Chuin ajah uva, Hoikom hijongle nalhun lhunnau in'a chun, chua kona napotdoh kahseuvin umun.
target: Whenever you enter a house, stay there until you leave that town.

source: Chule koi hile nalhunsah louvu le nathu seiju ngailou chu, chuche-a kona napotdoh tengule ahettohsah nan nakeng phanguva leivui sanin thinglhau vin. Keiman nangho jah-a tahbeh-a kasei ahi, thupi kitan nile chuche kho thohding sanga chu Sodom le Gomorrah gam thohding chu baijo ding ahi, ati.
target: And if any place will not welcome you or listen to you, leave that place and shake the dust off your feet as a testimony against them.”

source: Chutichun akipat doh-un, mihem ten lung ahei nadiuvin ahil lhangle uvin;
target: They went out and preached that people should repent.

source: Thilha tamtah anodoh-un, ana damlou tamtah thao anuvin, aboldamun ahi.
target: They drove out many demons and anointed many sick people with oil and healed them.

source: Chuin Herod lengpan athu chu ajatan, (Ijeh inem itile athu chu gamtina kithanga ahitai.) Chuin aman, John Baptist athia kona thoudoh kit ahi, chuche jeh-a chu chuti thil kidang boltheina chu ama-a uma abol ahi, ati.
target: King Herod heard about this, for Jesus’ name had become well known. Some were saying, “John the Baptist has been raised from the dead, and that is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”

source: Akim khatnin, Elijah ahi, atiuvin; adangin, ama hi themgao khat, ahiloule, Themgaoho lah-a khat ahi, atiuve.
target: Others said, “He is Elijah.” And still others claimed, “He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of long ago.”

source: Herod vang chun chuche thu chu ajah phatnin, Alol katansa John ngei chu ahi: ama athi lah-a kona thou kit ahi, ati.
target: But when Herod heard this, he said, “John, whom I beheaded, has been raised from the dead!”

source: Ijeh-inem itile Herod'in asopipa Philip jinu Herodias chu akichenpi ahin; amanu jala chu amatah-in mi asola John chu amatsah-a, akana songkul'a akhum ahi.
target: For Herod himself had given orders to have John arrested, and he had him bound and put in prison. He did this because of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, whom he had married.

source: Ijeh inem itile John'in Herod jah-a, Nasopipa jinu ji-a naneija nakichenpi hi dan ngai ahipoi, ati jeh ahi.
target: For John had been saying to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”

source: Chuche jeh-a chu Herodias chun ama chu hahot tah-a ahotna, tha ding atup ahin; ahivanginla abol theipon ahi.
target: So Herodias nursed a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But she was not able to,

source: Ijeh-inem itile Herod chun John chu michondih tah le mithengtah ahi ti chu ahen, akichan, avenbit ahi; chule athuhil ajah teng alung dongjin, hinlah kipahtah-in angaijin ahi.
target: because Herod feared John and protected him, knowing him to be a righteous and holy man. When Herod heard John, he was greatly puzzled; yet he liked to listen to him.

source: Chuin nikho agomkom cha khat ahung umin, Herod'in apen nikho ahung hi phatnin agam vaihomte, sepai lamkaite, chule Galilee gama milen milal chengse vahnan golvah abolin ahi.
target: Finally the opportune time came. On his birthday Herod gave a banquet for his high officials and military commanders and the leading men of Galilee.

source: Chuin Herodias chanutah chu ahung lutnin alamin ahile, Herod le atoukhompi chengse chu alung lhaisah sohtan ahi; chuphatnin lengpan nungahnu jah-a chun, Nagotchan kahengah thumin peng kate, atitai.
target: When the daughter of Herodias came in and danced, she pleased Herod and his dinner guests. The king said to the girl, “Ask me for anything you want, and I’ll give it to you.”

source: Chuin akihahselin, Nathum chan kagamsung kehkhat geijin peng kate, ati.
target: And he promised her with an oath, “Whatever you ask I will give you, up to half my kingdom.”

source: Chuin amanu apotdoh-in anu agadongin, Ipipen kathum dingham? ati. Anun ajah-a, John Baptist luchang thumin, ati.
target: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask for?” “The head of John the Baptist,” she answered.

source: Chuphatnin amanu mangang tah-in lengpa hengah ahungloijin, John Baptist luchang tutah-in kong khatnin neipele chun kati, tin athumtai.
target: At once the girl hurried in to the king with the request: “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptist on a platter.”

source: Chuin lengpa alunggimta lheh jengin, ahivanginla athuteple akihahselna, chule a-ankong umpiho jal chun amanu athutepsa chu asukeh nom pon ahi.
target: The king was greatly distressed, but because of his oaths and his dinner guests, he did not want to refuse her.

source: Chupettah chun lengpa chun ama ngah sepai khat John luchang la dingin asoltai. Chuin ama achen, songkul sunga alol agatan dentan ahi.
target: So he immediately sent an executioner with orders to bring John’s head. The man went, beheaded John in the prison,

source: Chuin aluchang chu kong khatnin ahindomin nungahnu chu apen, amanun anu agapetai.
target: and brought back his head on a platter. He presented it to the girl, and she gave it to her mother.

source: Chuin aseijuiten ajah phatnun, ahungun along chu ahung lauvin, lhana avuitaove.
target: On hearing of this, John’s disciples came and took his body and laid it in a tomb.

source: Chuin solchah ho Jesu henga ahung kikhomun, athilbol jouseule ami hilu umchan jouse aseijun ahi.
target: The apostles gathered around Jesus and reported to him all they had done and taught.

source: Chuin Aman ajah uva, Nangho chang hungdoh-unlang, munthip mah chomkhat hung kicholngah-un, ati; ijeh-inem itile ahungleh achele mi atambehseh jengin, an nehna ding jeng jong ong man lou ahiuve.
target: Then, because so many people were coming and going that they did not even have a chance to eat, he said to them, “Come with me by yourselves to a quiet place and get some rest.”

source: Chuin amaho kongin akitolun, gamthipma achomin achedoh taovin ahi.
target: So they went away by themselves in a boat to a solitary place.

source: Chule mipichun acheu chu amun, tamtah-in Ama chu aheuvin, khopi ho-a kon chun kengin ahung lhaijun, akhelpauvin, chule ahenga ahung kikhomun ahi.
target: But many who saw them leaving recognized them and ran on foot from all the towns and got there ahead of them.

source: Chuin Jesu ahung potdohle mipi tamtah amun, achingbei kelngoi hontoh abah jeh-u chun alung asen, amaho chu thu tamtah ahil pantan ahi.
target: When Jesus landed and saw a large crowd, he had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd. So he began teaching them many things.

source: Hichun nilhangkai lam ahitan ahile, aseijuite chu ahungun ahengah, hikom hi gamthip ahin, khomala agei lhehtan ahi;
target: By this time it was late in the day, so his disciples came to him. “This is a remote place,” they said, “and it’s already very late.

source: Hiteho hi ikimvel uva loujao le kho ho-a acheuva neh ding imathem agakichoh theina dingun soltan, ajehchu amahon nehding imacha aneitapouve, atiuvin ahi.
target: Send the people away so that they can go to the surrounding countryside and villages and buy themselves something to eat.”

source: Ahin Aman adonbutnin amaho jah-a, Nanghon neh ding peuvin, ati. Amahon ama jah-a, Kacheuva changlhah dangka jakhat man kagachoh uva kapeh dinguham? atiuve.
target: But he answered, “You give them something to eat.” They said to him, “That would take more than half a year’s wages! Are we to go and spend that much on bread and give it to them to eat?”

source: Aman ajah uva, Changlhah pheng ijat naneijum? gave temun, ati. Chuin anei jatnu ahet phatnun, pheng nga leh nga ni aume, atiuvin ahi.
target: “How many loaves do you have?” he asked. “Go and see.” When they found out, they said, “Five—and two fish.”

source: Chuin amaho chu abonchauvin hamhing chungah aloiloijin atousah dingun thu apen;
target: Then Jesus directed them to have all the people sit down in groups on the green grass.

source: Chule amaho agol agolin ja khat cheng, somnga chengin atoutaovin ahi.
target: So they sat down in groups of hundreds and fifties.

source: Chuin changlhah pheng ngale nga ni chu alan, vanlam aven, phatthei aboh-in, changlhah chu ahehbal balin, mipi anga aluipeh dingun aseijuite apen; nga ni jong chu ahoppeh sohkeijin ahi.
target: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke the loaves. Then he gave them to his disciples to distribute to the people. He also divided the two fish among them all.

source: Chuin amahon abonchauvin aneuvin, ava sohkeijun ahi.
target: They all ate and were satisfied,

source: Chuin changlhah-a kon le nga-a kon chun aneh valu paipeh somle paipeh ni aloh dimun ahi.
target: and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces of bread and fish.

source: Changlhah ne-a chu mi pasal cheh sangnga tobang ahiuvin ahi.
target: The number of the men who had eaten was five thousand.

source: Chuin Aman mihonpi chu alhadoh lai sung chun, aseijuite chu gal lang khat lama Bethsaida anagalkai masa dingin kong'a chun alutsah-in, asolpaitan ahi.
target: Immediately Jesus made his disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of him to Bethsaida, while he dismissed the crowd.

source: Chuin amaho chu alhah dohsoh phatnin, tao dingin mol chunga akaltoutai.
target: After leaving them, he went up on a mountainside to pray.

source: Chuin nilhah ahung hi phatnin, kong chu dillen lailunga aumin, Ama achang seh-in tolla aumin ahi.
target: Later that night, the boat was in the middle of the lake, and he was alone on land.

source: Chuin huijin ale lama anuh jeh uva, amaho dillena alungdonu chu amun; khovah ding kon lamin akengin twi chunga lam ahinjotnin, amaho henglam ahinjonin, amaho chu kheldin agon ahi.
target: He saw the disciples straining at the oars, because the wind was against them. Shortly before dawn he went out to them, walking on the lake. He was about to pass by them,

source: Ahin amahon twi chunga kenga lam ajotna aheng lamuva ahung amu phatnun, Joumi hinte, atiuvin, a-aosot jengun ahi.
target: but when they saw him walking on the lake, they thought he was a ghost. They cried out,

source: Ijeh-inem itile abonchauva Ama chu amu soh keiju ahin, atija lheh jengun ahi. Ahivangin Aman amaho chu ahinhou paijin, ajah uva, Lungmong tah-in umun; keima kahi, kicha hih-un, ati.
target: because they all saw him and were terrified. Immediately he spoke to them and said, “Take courage! It is I. Don’t be afraid.”

source: Chuin kong sunga amaho henga akalin ahile, hui chu athip jengtan ahi. Hichun amahon seitheilou khophelin kidang asalheh jengun ahi.
target: Then he climbed into the boat with them, and the wind died down. They were completely amazed,

source: Ajeh chu changlhah thudol jong chu hephata louva, lungtah chehjoa ahitaove.
target: for they had not understood about the loaves; their hearts were hardened.

source: Chuin agalkaijun Ganesaret gamsung alhungun, kong chu twipam chinah angataovin ahi.
target: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret and anchored there.

source: Chuin kong'a kona apotdoh doh-un ahile, miho chun anahe paitaovin,
target: As soon as they got out of the boat, people recognized Jesus.

source: Agam sunguva alhai kimvel leuvin, chua aume ti ahetna chanuva ana damlouho chu alupna pumin ahinpuvin ahi.
target: They ran throughout that whole region and carried the sick on mats to wherever they heard he was.

source: Akho akhoa, khopiho-a, chule loujaovah alutna chan-ah, ana adamlou ho chu lamlena alupsah-un, apon mongkai beh atham dinguvin ahenga ataovun ahi. Chuin athamkha chan chu adam jengun ahi.
target: And wherever he went—into villages, towns or countryside—they placed the sick in the marketplaces. They begged him to let them touch even the edge of his cloak, and all who touched it were healed.

source: Chuin Jerusalem'a kona hunga Pharisaiho le danthu sunho lah-a phabep khat akoma ahung kikhomun ahi.
target: The Pharisees and some of the teachers of the law who had come from Jerusalem gathered around Jesus

source: Chule hiteho chun aseijuite kimkhatnin khutboh puma, khut sil louva, changlhah aneh-u amutauvin ahile themo achanun ahi.
target: and saw some of his disciples eating food with hands that were defiled, that is, unwashed.

source: Ijeh inem itile Pharisaiho le Juda te jousen upate khanga ahung chonna dan amangun, khut phatecha silngim louva an ne louhel ahiuve.
target: (The Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat unless they give their hands a ceremonial washing, holding to the tradition of the elders.

source: Kailhang mun'a kona ahung tengu jongle kisil louvin an aneji pouve. Chule khonho, belho, sum-eng belho, chule dokhang ho sopding thudol le adang tamtah jong aneijun, atuhchah kheh-un ahi.
target: When they come from the marketplace they do not eat unless they wash. And they observe many other traditions, such as the washing of cups, pitchers and kettles.)

source: Chuin Pharisai ho le danthu sunhon adongun, Ibola naseijuite hi upate akhang akhanga ahung chonna dan manglouva, khutboh puma changlhah anehjiuham? atiuvin ahi.
target: So the Pharisees and teachers of the law asked Jesus, “Why don’t your disciples live according to the tradition of the elders instead of eating their food with defiled hands?”

source: Aman amaho chu adonbutnin, ajah uva, Isaiah themgaovin miphalhem nangho thudol aseije, Hiche phung mite hin akam sunguvin eichoi-anun, alungthimula keija konin gamlatah ahi.
target: He replied, “Isaiah was right when he prophesied about you hypocrites; as it is written: “ ‘These people honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me.

source: Ahoi hitaleh amahon athu hilu hi mihem thupeh jeng ahilu ahi jeh-in, eihouvu hi moh ahi, tia kisun chu atahbeh ahi.
target: They worship me in vain; their teachings are merely human rules.’

source: Ajehchu nanghon Pathen thupeh tahbeh chu nakoi doh-un, mihem akhang akhanga ahung chonnao bel le khonho not theng danjoh naha tuh jouvin, chule hitobang thil adang tamtah nabolun, ahi, ati.
target: You have let go of the commands of God and are holding on to human traditions.”

source: Aman ajah uva, Nanghon nangho akhang akhanga nahung chonnao dan namandet theina dingun, Pathen thupeh chu kichentah-in napai uvin ahi.
target: And he continued, “You have a fine way of setting aside the commands of God in order to observe your own traditions!

source: Ijeh-inem itile Mosi'n, Nanu le napa jabolun; chule anu le apa hou se-a chu thihel hen, ati ahi.
target: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and mother,’ and, ‘Anyone who curses their father or mother is to be put to death.’

source: Ahinla nanghon nahiti seijiuve, Koi hileh anule apa jah-a, Kavanga naphatchomna dingu jouse chu Corban ahitai, (hichu Pathen henga peh ahitai tina ahi,) atile,
target: But you say that if anyone declares that what might have been used to help their father or mother is Corban (that is, devoted to God)—

source: Anu dinga ahin, apa dinga ahin jong ima atohpeh ding najada jiuve.
target: then you no longer let them do anything for their father or mother.

source: Nangho chonna thu mi napehsonu chun, Pathen thupeh imalou nasouvin; hitobang thil chu tamtah naboljiuve, ati.
target: Thus you nullify the word of God by your tradition that you have handed down. And you do many things like that.”

source: Chuin mihonpi chu ahenga akoukitnin, ajah uva, Nabonchaovin kathusei ngai phauvin lang hetoh-un;
target: Again Jesus called the crowd to him and said, “Listen to me, everyone, and understand this.

source: Mihem polama kona asunga lutna ama suboh thei imacha aumpoi. Asunga kona hungpotdoh chengse chun asuboh joh ahibouve.
target: Nothing outside a person can defile them by going into them. Rather, it is what comes out of a person that defiles them.”

source: Chuin Aman mipi adalhah-a insunga alutjouvin, aseijuite chun thulem chu adongchen taovin ahi.
target: After he had left the crowd and entered the house, his disciples asked him about this parable.

source: Chuin Aman ajah uva, nangho jong hitobang loma hetna neilou nahinah laiju ham? Itobang hijongle pama kona mihem sunga lut chun ama asuhboh theipoi.
target: “Are you so dull?” he asked. “Don’t you see that nothing that enters a person from the outside can defile them?

source: Ijeh-inem itile alungsunga lut louva a-oisunga lutna, hitia chu a-anneh jouse asuthengji-a, aposona ah ahungdoh ji ahi nahet louvu ham?
target: For it doesn’t go into their heart but into their stomach, and then out of the body.” (In saying this, Jesus declared all foods clean.)

source: Chuin Aman, Mihem lung sunga kon hungpot chun, hichetah chun mi asuboh ahi.
target: He went on: “What comes out of a person is what defiles them.

source: Ijeh inem itile mihem sung, alung sunga kon lung gilou, jonthanhoi, guchat, toltha,
target: For it is from within, out of a person’s heart, that evil thoughts come—sexual immorality, theft, murder,

source: Miji toh jon, papsetna, gitlou engsetna, mi dohabol, huhna, kimit thipna, kitaitom, hoitho, ngolna;
target: adultery, greed, malice, deceit, lewdness, envy, slander, arrogance and folly.

source: hicheng thilphalou hi mi sunga kona hungpot doh-a, mihem asubohji ahi, ati.
target: All these evils come from inside and defile a person.”

source: Chuin akipatdoh-in chukom mun chu adalhan, Tyre le Sidon gamkol sunga achen, hikoma chun in khatna alutnin, koima ahetsah nompon, ahinla akisel theitapon ahi.
target: Jesus left that place and went to the vicinity of Tyre. He entered a house and did not want anyone to know it; yet he could not keep his presence secret.

source: Chutichun numei khat achanu lhagao boh vop ahin, ama chungchang thu chu ajan, ahenga ahungin, akeng khopimuh-a abohkhup paijenin ahi.
target: In fact, as soon as she heard about him, a woman whose little daughter was possessed by an impure spirit came and fell at his feet.

source: Numeinu chu Greek mi ahin, anam lama chun Syro-Phoinicia mi ahi. Amanu chun achanu sunga kona thilha deldoh dingin ataovin ahi.
target: The woman was a Greek, born in Syrian Phoenicia. She begged Jesus to drive the demon out of her daughter.

source: Ahin Jesu'n amanu jah-a, Chate cheng vamasa tadihen; chate changlhah lahpeh-a uichate koma selhah aphapoi, ati.
target: “First let the children eat all they want,” he told her, “for it is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”

source: Ahin amanun ajah-a, Ahinai, Pakai, hijongle dokhang noija um uichan jong, chate changlhah neh hal anehkhahji khula-em, tin adonbutnin ahi.
target: “Lord,” she replied, “even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”

source: Chuin Aman ajah-a, Nathusei jeh chun chetan; thilha chu nachanu sunga konin apotdohtai, ati.
target: Then he told her, “For such a reply, you may go; the demon has left your daughter.”

source: Chuin amanu a-in lamah achen ahile, thilha anapot doh-a, achanu jalkhuna analup agatoh-in ahi.
target: She went home and found her child lying on the bed, and the demon gone.

source: Chuin Tyre gamkol sung chu adalhan, Sidon ajotnin, Decapolis gam ajotpeh-in, Galilee dillen alhungtai.
target: Then Jesus left the vicinity of Tyre and went through Sidon, down to the Sea of Galilee and into the region of the Decapolis.

source: Chuin mi na-ngong pao jong paochen thei lou khat hi ahenga ahinpuijun, achunga akhut angap dingin ataovun ahi.
target: There some people brought to him a man who was deaf and could hardly talk, and they begged Jesus to place his hand on him.

source: Chuin Aman mipi lah-a konin achangin apuidoh-in, akhutchalin anasung akhoijin; chuin achil asetnin, alei athamin;
target: After he took him aside, away from the crowd, Jesus put his fingers into the man’s ears. Then he spit and touched the man’s tongue.

source: Chuin vanlam aven akhoisan, ajah-a, Ephphatha, ati. Hichu, Kihongin, tina ahi.
target: He looked up to heaven and with a deep sigh said to him, “Ephphatha!” (which means “Be opened!” ).

source: Chuphatnin ana avangin, aleigui jong akilhamtan, kichentah-in apao theitai.
target: At this, the man’s ears were opened, his tongue was loosened and he began to speak plainly.

source: Chuin Aman amaho chun koima jah-a asei louna dingun akhamin ahi; ahinla Aman ahakham chehle, amahon ahaseiphong cheh-un;
target: Jesus commanded them not to tell anyone. But the more he did so, the more they kept talking about it.

source: Chule kidang asabeh seh-un, Aman ijakai abolpha sohtai: na-ngongla kho ajahsah-in, paomola apaosah theije, atiuvin ahi.
target: People were overwhelmed with amazement. “He has done everything well,” they said. “He even makes the deaf hear and the mute speak.”

source: Hichelai chun mihonpi chu atamlheh jengtan, chule nehding ima aneilou jeh-un, Jesu'n aseijuite chu ahenga akouvin, ajah uva;
target: During those days another large crowd gathered. Since they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to him and said,

source: Mihonpi hi kakoma aumnao ni thum alhingtan, neh dingla anei hih-un, kalung ase lheh-e;
target: “I have compassion for these people; they have already been with me three days and have nothing to eat.

source: Chule an ne louvin a-inlam cheh uva sollengla lhasampa ding ahiuve; ajehchu akimkhat hi gamlatah-a kona hung ahiuve, ati.
target: If I send them home hungry, they will collapse on the way, because some of them have come a long distance.”

source: Chuin aseijuiten adonbutnun, ajah-a, Hiche kom gamthip laija mi hichengpi ninglhinga vahna ding changlhah kon hoija kona alah dingham? atiuvin ahi.
target: His disciples answered, “But where in this remote place can anyone get enough bread to feed them?”

source: Chuin Aman mipi chu adongin, ajah uva, Changlhah pheng ijat naneijum? ati. Chuin amahon, Pheng sagi, atiuve.
target: “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied.

source: Chuin Aman mipi chu tolla tou dingin thu ape-in; chuin Aman changlhah pheng sagi chu alan, athangvah in, chujouvin ahehbal balin, a-anguva luipeh dingin aseijuite chu apen, amahon mipi anga chun aluipeh-un ahi.
target: He told the crowd to sit down on the ground. When he had taken the seven loaves and given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to distribute to the people, and they did so.

source: Chule nga neocha cha phabep khat jong aneijun; hi jong chu phatthei aboh-in, a-anguva luipeh dingin asoltan ahi.
target: They had a few small fish as well; he gave thanks for them also and told the disciples to distribute them.

source: Chuin amahon aneuvin, ava sohkeijun, aneh moh-u ahal chu longkai sagi alohdoh-un ahi.
target: The people ate and were satisfied. Afterward the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

source: Chule hiche an neho chu mi sangli tobang ahiuvin ahi. Chuin amaho chu asol tan ahi.
target: About four thousand were present. After he had sent them away,

source: Chule Ama aseijuite toh kong'a alutpaijun, Dalmanutha gam alhung taovin ahi.
target: he got into the boat with his disciples and went to the region of Dalmanutha.

source: Chuin Pharisai ho chu ahungdoh-un, apatepnan thu adongun, van'a kona melchihna aholtauvin ahi.
target: The Pharisees came and began to question Jesus. To test him, they asked him for a sign from heaven.

source: Chuin Ama alung sunga akhoisan, Tukhang mite hin ibola melchihna aholuham? Tahbeh-a kasei ahi, Hiche tukhang mite hi imacha melchihna kipe lou ding ahi, ati.
target: He sighed deeply and said, “Why does this generation ask for a sign? Truly I tell you, no sign will be given to it.”

source: Chuin amaho chu adalhan, kong'a alut kitnin, lang khat panga dingin akipatdoh tai.
target: Then he left them, got back into the boat and crossed to the other side.

source: Chuin amahon changlhah akeng haijun; kong'a chunla pheng khat tailou adang aumhih helin ahi.
target: The disciples had forgotten to bring bread, except for one loaf they had with them in the boat.

source: Chuin Aman amaho chu ahilchah-in, ajah uva, Chingtheijun; Pharisai ho chol le Herod chol lah-a kihong phaovin, ati.
target: “Be careful,” Jesus warned them. “Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and that of Herod.”

source: Chuin amahon, Hiche hi changlhah ineilou jeh-u ahi, tin akihou lhiuvin ahi.
target: They discussed this with one another and said, “It is because we have no bread.”

source: Hichu Jesu'n ahetdoh phatnin, ajah uva, Changlhah nanei loujeh uva ibola kihouhou nahiuvem? Tugeija nalunguva hedoh loulai nahiuvem? Nalungu tahsah jing nalai nahiuvem?
target: Aware of their discussion, Jesus asked them: “Why are you talking about having no bread? Do you still not see or understand? Are your hearts hardened?

source: Mit neijuva mu theilou nahiuva, nakhang neijuva ja thei lou nahiuvem? Gel jong nagel doh lou mongu ham?
target: Do you have eyes but fail to see, and ears but fail to hear? And don’t you remember?

source: Mi sangnga lah-a changlhah pheng nga kahop peh-a chu nehmoh ahal longkai ijat nalo dimum? atile, amahon, Somleni, atiuvin ahi.
target: When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many basketfuls of pieces did you pick up?” “Twelve,” they replied.

source: Mi sangli lah-a pheng sagi kahop peh-a chu nehmoh hal longkai ijat nalo dimum? atile, amahon, Longkai sagi atiuve.
target: “And when I broke the seven loaves for the four thousand, how many basketfuls of pieces did you pick up?” They answered, “Seven.”

source: Chuin Aman ajah uva, Iti dana tu-a jong hedoh loulai nahiuvem? ati.
target: He said to them, “Do you still not understand?”

source: Chuin Bethsaida'a ahungin; hikoma chun mitcho khat ahenga ahinpuijun, atham dingin Ama henga ataovun ahi.
target: They came to Bethsaida, and some people brought a blind man and begged Jesus to touch him.

source: Chuin Aman mitchopa chu akhutnin atuh-in, khosunga kon chun apuidoh-in; chuin amitna achil asetnin, achunga khut angamin, Kho namu-em, tin adongin ahi.
target: He took the blind man by the hand and led him outside the village. When he had spit on the man’s eyes and put his hands on him, Jesus asked, “Do you see anything?”

source: Ama adahdoh-in, Mihem chu thing tobangin kamun, avahleuve, ati.
target: He looked up and said, “I see people; they look like trees walking around.”

source: Chujouvin amit akhutnin atham kitnin, chuin adadoh sah-in ahile adamhel jengin, chule mi jouse kichentah-in amu theitan ahi.
target: Once more Jesus put his hands on the man’s eyes. Then his eyes were opened, his sight was restored, and he saw everything clearly.

source: Chuin Aman ajah-a, khopisunga jong lut hih-in, khopi sunga koima cha jong hetsah hih-in, tin a-in lama asolmang tai.
target: Jesus sent him home, saying, “Don’t even go into the village.”

source: Chuin Jesu le aseijuite apotdoh-un, Caesaria Philippi'a khoneo dunga acheuvin; lam dunga aseijuite jah-a, Mihon keima hi koi ahi eitiuvem? tin adongin ahi.
target: Jesus and his disciples went on to the villages around Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked them, “Who do people say I am?”

source: Chuin amahon, John Baptist ahi atiuvin; ahin abangin Elijah ahi atiuvin; adangsen Themgaoho lah-a khat ahi atiuve, tin aseijun ahi.
target: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, one of the prophets.”

source: Chuin Aman amaho adongin, Nanghonla koi ahi neitiuvem? ati. Chuin Peter'in adonbutnin, Nangma Christa chu nahi, ati.
target: “But what about you?” he asked. “Who do you say I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Messiah.”

source: Chuin Aman ama thudol koimacha jah-a asei louna dingun hakhamin akhamin ahi.
target: Jesus warned them not to tell anyone about him.

source: Chuin Aman amaho chu, Mihem Chapan thil tamtah athoh-a, vaipo upa hole thempu pipuiho chule danthu sunho pampaija umding, kithatna chule ni thum joule thoudoh kit tei ding ahichu ahil pantan ahi.
target: He then began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, and that he must be killed and after three days rise again.

source: Aman hichu phongtah-a asei ahi. Hiche chun Peter'in ama apuidoh-in ahousetan ahi.
target: He spoke plainly about this, and Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him.

source: Ahin Ama akiheijin, aseijuite aven, Peter chu aphoh-in, Kanung lama chen, Satan; nangman Pathen thulam gel louvin, mihem thulam jeng nagele, ati.
target: But when Jesus turned and looked at his disciples, he rebuked Peter. “Get behind me, Satan!” he said. “You do not have in mind the concerns of God, but merely human concerns.”

source: Chuin Aman aseijuite le mihonpi chu ahenga akouvin, ajah uva, Koi hile kanung eijui noma chun ama kingaitom henlang athingpel kiput hen chule kanung hinjuihen.
target: Then he called the crowd to him along with his disciples and said: “Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me.

source: Ijeh-inem itile koi hile ahinna huhhing noma chun achan ding; amavang koi hile keima jal leh Kipana Thupha jala ahinna chana chun ahuhhing ding ahi.
target: For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me and for the gospel will save it.

source: Ijeh-inem itile mihemin vannoi leiset apumpin neihenlang ahinna chantale, ipi phatchomna anei dingham?
target: What good is it for someone to gain the whole world, yet forfeit their soul?

source: Min ahinna khela ipi apeh dingham?
target: Or what can anyone give in exchange for their soul?

source: Koi hijongle tulai khang jonthanhoina le chonsetpan lah-a keima le kathu jachat chan chu, Mihem Chapan jong a-Pa loupina-a avantil thengtetoh ahung nile ama chu ajachatpi ding ahi, ati.
target: If anyone is ashamed of me and my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will be ashamed of them when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”

source: Chuin Aman ajah uva, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Hikoma dingho kimkhat hi Pathen lenggam thanei tah-a ahung lhun amu kahseuva thina tepkha lou ding aumuve, ati.
target: And he said to them, “Truly I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see that the kingdom of God has come with power.”

source: Chuin ni gup jouvin Jesu'n Peter toh, Jacob toh, chule John atumin apuijin, molsang chung khatna apuitouvin, chuin Ama amaho ang sungah avou akikhelin ahi.
target: After six days Jesus took Peter, James and John with him and led them up a high mountain, where they were all alone. There he was transfigured before them.

source: Chule aponsil chu koimachan chutobang tah-a asopbang joulou ding khopmin abanglah lah jengin, buhbang sangin jong abangjon ahi.
target: His clothes became dazzling white, whiter than anyone in the world could bleach them.

source: Chuin Elijah leh Mosi ahengah ahung kilah lhonin, Jesu toh akihouvun ahi.
target: And there appeared before them Elijah and Moses, who were talking with Jesus.

source: Chuin Peter'in Jesu jah-a, Rabbi, hikoma i-umu hi eiho dingin anome; lhambuh thum songung kate, khat nangma ding, khat Mosi ding, chule khat Elijah ding, ati.
target: Peter said to Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah.”

source: Ajehchu akichat behseh jeh-a seiding hetmoa asei ahi.
target: (He did not know what to say, they were so frightened.)

source: Chuin meilhang khatnin amaho chu ahinlekhun; mei lah-a kon chun aw ahung gingin, Hiche hi Ka-Chapa deitah ahi; athu ngaijun, ati.
target: Then a cloud appeared and covered them, and a voice came from the cloud: “This is my Son, whom I love. Listen to him!”

source: Chuin phulou helouvin akimvelu avetnuva ahile, koimacha amuta hih-un, Jesu changsehle amaho changbou aumtaovin ahi.
target: Suddenly, when they looked around, they no longer saw anyone with them except Jesus.

source: Chuin molsanga kona ahung kumsuh phatnun, amaho chu hakhamin akhamin, Mihem Chapa athia kona athodoh kit kahsen koima jah-a seidoh hih-un, ati.
target: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus gave them orders not to tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

source: Athusei chu alunguvah aching jingun, athia kona athodoh kit chu ipi aseina ahidem, tin akidongto jiuvin ahi.
target: They kept the matter to themselves, discussing what “rising from the dead” meant.

source: Chuin amahon adongun, Ibola danthu sunhon Elijah hung masa ding ahi atiuham? atiuve.
target: And they asked him, “Why do the teachers of the law say that Elijah must come first?”

source: Aman adonbutnin, Elijah chu tahbeh-a hung masa-a, ijakai ahung semphat dingmong ahi; chule itidana Mihem Chapa thudol, Aman hesoh genthei tintang athoh-a chule mi nahsahmo-a aumding ahi, tia kisuna ham.
target: Jesus replied, “To be sure, Elijah does come first, and restores all things. Why then is it written that the Son of Man must suffer much and be rejected?

source: Hijongle keiman nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, Elijah chu ahungsa ahitai, chule akhanchan dingthu asut bangtah-u chun achunga anopnop aboltauvin ahi, ati.
target: But I tell you, Elijah has come, and they have done to him everything they wished, just as it is written about him.”

source: Chuin aseijuite henga ahungin ahile akimveluva mi tamtah auma, chule danthu sunho chun thu adoh uva anakinelpiu amun ahi.
target: When they came to the other disciples, they saw a large crowd around them and the teachers of the law arguing with them.

source: Chuin mipi chun Ama amu mu-un kidang asa lheh-un, aheng lamah ahung lhaipaijun Ama chu alamtouvin ahi.
target: As soon as all the people saw Jesus, they were overwhelmed with wonder and ran to greet him.

source: Chuin Aman danthu sunho jah-a, Amaho khutoh ipi kinela nahiuvem? tin adonge.
target: “What are you arguing with them about?” he asked.

source: Chuin mipi lah-a khatnin ahindonbut nin, Pakai, kachapa nahenga kahinpui ahi, ama lhagao paomon avopmin;
target: A man in the crowd answered, “Teacher, I brought you my son, who is possessed by a spirit that has robbed him of speech.

source: Chule hoikom hijongle aman amat matna-a aheh lhujin; chule achilphon alhan, aha ageljin, chule apumin akangjin; chule einodohpeh nadiuvin naseijuite henga kaseijin; amahon ajou pouvin ahi, ati.
target: Whenever it seizes him, it throws him to the ground. He foams at the mouth, gnashes his teeth and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to drive out the spirit, but they could not.”

source: Chuin Aman adonbutnin, ajah uva, Vo tahsanna neilou khang mite, nakom uva itihchan kaumpi ding nahiuvem? Itihchan kakhongai ding nahiuvem? kahenga hinpuijun, ati.
target: “You unbelieving generation,” Jesus replied, “how long shall I stay with you? How long shall I put up with you? Bring the boy to me.”

source: Chuin amahon ahenga ahinpuijun ahi. Chuin Aman ama chu amu phatnin, lhagaoboh chun amapa chu nasatah-in aveingoi paijenin ahile tolla alhun, achilphon alhalet lutnin akilihlelen ahi.
target: So they brought him. When the spirit saw Jesus, it immediately threw the boy into a convulsion. He fell to the ground and rolled around, foaming at the mouth.

source: Chuin Jesu'n apa jah-a, Ahiti nahi itihchan hitam? ati. Hichun aman, Achapan laija pat ahitai.
target: Jesus asked the boy’s father, “How long has he been like this?” “From childhood,” he answered.

source: Chule suhmang dingin abangle meijah, abangle twijah aleh lut lhoijin ahi: hijongle nangman alonaje nahetle, neilungset in neihutan, ati.
target: “It has often thrown him into fire or water to kill him. But if you can do anything, take pity on us and help us.”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Natahsan photle! Atahsan ding chun ijakai ahi thei sohkeije, ati.
target: “ ‘If you can’?” said Jesus. “Everything is possible for one who believes.”

source: Chutah chun chapangpa pa chun, amitlhi pumin, Pakai, katahsane; katahsan lelna-a neihun, tin asamtai.
target: Immediately the boy’s father exclaimed, “I do believe; help me overcome my unbelief!”

source: Chuin Jesu'n mihonpi hung lhaikhom chu amun, lhagao boh chu aphoh-in, ajah-a, Nang lhagao paomole na-ngong, thu kapeh nahi, asunga kon chun hung potdoh-in, chule lutkit tahih-in, ati.
target: When Jesus saw that a crowd was running to the scene, he rebuked the impure spirit. “You deaf and mute spirit,” he said, “I command you, come out of him and never enter him again.”

source: Hichun lhagao chu apengin, hatah-in avei ngoijin, ama-a konchun ahung pottan ahi. Hichun chapangpa chu athi bangin aumtan, chuphatnin mi atamjopi chun, Athi hita khu, atiuve.
target: The spirit shrieked, convulsed him violently and came out. The boy looked so much like a corpse that many said, “He’s dead.”

source: Ahin Jesu'n akhutnin amanin, akaithouvin ahile, ahung thoudoh jengtan ahi.
target: But Jesus took him by the hand and lifted him to his feet, and he stood up.

source: Chuin Jesu insung agalut phatnin, aseijuiten guhthimin, I-atile keihon kanodohjou louvu ham? tin adongun ahi.
target: After Jesus had gone indoors, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we drive it out?”

source: Aman adonbut-in, Hitobang hi an ngola taona tailouvin akinodoh theipoi, ati.
target: He replied, “This kind can come out only by prayer.”

source: Chuin chua kon chun achedoh-un, Galilee gam ajotnun, hichu min ahet ding Ama anompon ahi.
target: They left that place and passed through Galilee. Jesus did not want anyone to know where they were,

source: Ijeh-inem itile Aman aseijuite ahilpeh jin, ajah uva, Mihem Chapa chu mihemte khutna kipedoh ahitan, amahon atha dingu; chule akitha jouteng, ni thum nile Ama hingdoh kit ding ahi, ati.
target: because he was teaching his disciples. He said to them, “The Son of Man is going to be delivered into the hands of men. They will kill him, and after three days he will rise.”

source: Ahivangin athusei chu ahethei pouvin, Ama doh dingla akichauvin ahi.
target: But they did not understand what he meant and were afraid to ask him about it.

source: Chutichun Ama Capernaum ahung lhungtan ahi. Chuin in sunga aumpetnin amaho chu adongin, Lampi'a chu ipi nakinel piu ham? ati.
target: They came to Capernaum. When he was in the house, he asked them, “What were you arguing about on the road?”

source: Ahivangin amaho lampi'a chu, Ilah uva hin koi hi alenpen ahidem? tia akinel jeh-u chun athipchet jengun ahi.
target: But they kept quiet because on the way they had argued about who was the greatest.

source: Hichun atouvin, somleni ho chu akouvin ajah uva, Koi hijongle amasapen hinom chu nukhah pen ding ahi, chule mi jouse jenlea pang hi ding ahi, ati.
target: Sitting down, Jesus called the Twelve and said, “Anyone who wants to be first must be the very last, and the servant of all.”

source: Chuin chapang neocha khat akouvin, alaijuva adinsah-in; chuin apomin, ajah uva,
target: He took a little child whom he placed among them. Taking the child in his arms, he said to them,

source: Koi hijongle keima mina hitobang chapangcha khat sanga chun keima eisan ahi; chule koi hileh keima eisang chan chun keima eisan hilouvin, eihinsolpa asanjoh ahi, ati.
target: “Whoever welcomes one of these little children in my name welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me does not welcome me but the one who sent me.”

source: John'in adonbutnin ajah-a, houhil namina thilha nodoh mikhat kamuvin, eijui pouvin ahi: chule eijuilou jeh uvin kakham taove, ati.
target: “Teacher,” said John, “we saw someone driving out demons in your name and we told him to stop, because he was not one of us.”

source: Ahin Jesu'n, Kham hih-un; kamina thil kidang bola, keima eiseiseloi theija koima aumpoi.
target: “Do not stop him,” Jesus said. “For no one who does a miracle in my name can in the next moment say anything bad about me,

source: Ijeh-inem itile koi hijongle eiho eidou lou tapou chu eiho lama pang ahi.
target: for whoever is not against us is for us.

source: Koi hijongle Christa mi ahi tia ama mina twi khon khat don ding napechanu chu, tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, iti nama jongle kipaman asan ding chu achanlou ding ahi.
target: Truly I tell you, anyone who gives you a cup of water in my name because you belong to the Messiah will certainly not lose their reward.

source: Chule koi hijongle keima eitahsanna hiche aneochaho lah-a khat kipal lhuhsah chan chu, angonga sumhei song lentah kikhai henlang, twikhanglen'a kileh lutle ama dingin aphajoi.
target: “If anyone causes one of these little ones—those who believe in me—to stumble, it would be better for them if a large millstone were hung around their neck and they were thrown into the sea.

source: Chule nakhutnin nakipal lhuhsah-a ahile tanbong jengin, khut ni neija damun meikong mitthei louva nache sangin, tibukim louva hinna-a lut nangma dingin aphajoi.
target: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life maimed than with two hands to go into hell, where the fire never goes out.

source: Chule nakengin nakipal lhuhsah-a ahile, tanbong jengin; keng ni neija imatih-a mittheilou damun meikonga nakilelut sangin, kengbaija hinna-a lut nangma dingin aphajoi.
target: And if your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life crippled than to have two feet and be thrown into hell.

source: Chule namitnin nakipal lhuhsah-a ahile kaldoh jengin; mit ni neija damuna nakilelut sangin, mitlang cho-a Pathen lenggama lut nangma dingin aphajoi.
target: And if your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out. It is better for you to enter the kingdom of God with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell,

source: Damun chu alungla thimo ameikongla mitmo ahi.
target: where “ ‘the worms that eat them do not die, and the fire is not quenched.’

source: Ijeh-inem itile mijouse meija chisoa kiso ding, chule ganlhaina jouse chi kiso-al ding ahi.
target: Everyone will be salted with fire.

source: Chi hi aphai: ahivangin chi jong hi a-al hi tamtahen lang hileh ipi-a na-alsah kit dinguham? Nasunguva chi neicheh-un, khat le khat kichamdel cheh-in umuvin, ati.
target: “Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can you make it salty again? Have salt among yourselves, and be at peace with each other.”

source: Chuin Ama chua konin akipatdoh-in, Jordan gal lama konin Juda gamkol sung ahungtan ahi. Chuin mihonpi chu ahenga ahung kikhom kit taovin, chutichun Aman angaijin amaho chu ahil kittan ahi.
target: Jesus then left that place and went into the region of Judea and across the Jordan. Again crowds of people came to him, and as was his custom, he taught them.

source: Chuin Pharisai ho ahenga ahungun, apatepnan thu adongun, ajah-a, Min aji ada hi dan ngai hinam? atiuvin ahi.
target: Some Pharisees came and tested him by asking, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

source: Jesu'n amaho adonbutnin, Mosi'n nangho thu iti napeh-um? ati.
target: “What did Moses command you?” he replied.

source: Chuin amahon, Mosi'n kidana lekha sutna, chule da ding aphasah ahi, atiuvin ahi.
target: They said, “Moses permitted a man to write a certificate of divorce and send her away.”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin ajah uva, Nangho lungtah jeh-a aman hiche thupeh chu nangho dinga asut ahibouve.
target: “It was because your hearts were hard that Moses wrote you this law,” Jesus replied.

source: Ahivangin leiset kisemtila patna Pathen'in amani chu numei le pasal'a asemsa ahitai.
target: “But at the beginning of creation God ‘made them male and female.’

source: Hiche jeh-a chu pasal'in anu apa adalhah-a ajia beh ding ahi;
target: ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife,

source: Chule amani chu ti khat hilhon ding ahi. Hiti chu ahin amani pumni mi ni hita louvin ti khat ahi lhontai.
target: and the two will become one flesh.’ So they are no longer two, but one flesh.

source: Hijeh chun Pathen gopsa chu mihemin sukhen hihen, ati.
target: Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.”

source: Chuin in sungah aseijuiten hiche thudol chu adong kitnun ahi.
target: When they were in the house again, the disciples asked Jesus about this.

source: Aman ajah uva, Koi hileh aji da-a ji dang neichan chun ajinu chu ajonsan ahi.
target: He answered, “Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.

source: Numei jin jong apasal ada-a mi dangtoh akichenle, ama jong chu ajonga ahi ati.
target: And if she divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.”

source: Chuin atham dingin chapang neochaho ahenga ahinpuijun ahile aseijuiten anaphoh-un ahi.
target: People were bringing little children to Jesus for him to place his hands on them, but the disciples rebuked them.

source: Ahin hichu Jesu'n amun, alung phamon, ajah uva, Chapang neochaho chu kahenga hung sah-un, jada hih-un; ijeh-inem itile Pathen lenggam chu hitobang tehoa bou ahi.
target: When Jesus saw this, he was indignant. He said to them, “Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

source: Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Koi hile chapang neo tobanga Pathen lenggam sang lou chu, iti nama jongle chua lut louhel ding ahi, ati.
target: Truly I tell you, anyone who will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”

source: Chuin amaho chu apomin, achunguva akhut angamin, phatthei aboh tan ahi.
target: And he took the children in his arms, placed his hands on them and blessed them.

source: Chuin Ama lampi dunga che dinga apotdoh pettah-in, mi khat ahung lhaijelin, a-angah adilsun, Houhil pha, itileng tonsot hin kemlou kachan thei dingham? tin adongin ahi.
target: As Jesus started on his way, a man ran up to him and fell on his knees before him. “Good teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to inherit eternal life?”

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah-a, Ibola apha neitiham? Pathen khatseh tailou koimacha apha aumpoi.
target: “Why do you call me good?” Jesus answered. “No one is good—except God alone.

source: Thupeh chengse, Tolthat hih-in, Jon bol hih-in, Gucha hih-in, Dohan mi bol hih-in, Nanu napa jabolin, ti chu nahenai, ati.
target: You know the commandments: ‘You shall not murder, you shall not commit adultery, you shall not steal, you shall not give false testimony, you shall not defraud, honor your father and mother.’”

source: Ahin amapan adonbutnin, ajah-a, Houhil, hichengse chu kachapan laija patna kahin nitpeh ahitai, ati.
target: “Teacher,” he declared, “all these I have kept since I was a boy.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n ama chu aven ahile angailun, ajah-a, Khat nabat nalaije; chenlang nanei chengse gajoh inlang mivaicha gentheiho petan, chutile van'a gou nanei ding ahi; chule cross kiput inlang kanung hinjuijin, ati.
target: Jesus looked at him and loved him. “One thing you lack,” he said. “Go, sell everything you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.”

source: Chucheng asei ajah phat chun amai athimkot jengtan, chuin gou haotah ahi jeh-in lungnom mo tah-in achemang tan ahi.
target: At this the man’s face fell. He went away sad, because he had great wealth.

source: Chuphatnin Jesu'n aseijuite ave kimvelin, Mihaoho hi Pathen gama alut dingu iti hahsat hitam! ati.
target: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!”

source: Chutia ati chu aseijuiten adatmo lheh-un, ahivangin Jesu'n aseikitnin, Chapangho, haona-a kingai miho Pathen lenggama alut dingu iti hahsat hitam!
target: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus said again, “Children, how hard it is to enter the kingdom of God!

source: Mihao Pathen gama alut sangin heubil homa sangongsang lut abaijoi, ati.
target: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of God.”

source: Chuin amahon kidang asabehseh jengun, ajah-a, Chuti ahile, koi huhhing-a um jou dingham? atiuvin ahi.
target: The disciples were even more amazed, and said to each other, “Who then can be saved?”

source: Chuin Jesu'n amaho chu aven, Mihem dingin hitheihoi ahipon, Pathen dingin vang ahimopoi; ijeh-inem itile Pathen dingin ijakai ahitheije, ati.
target: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but not with God; all things are possible with God.”

source: Peter'in ajah-a, Vetemin, keihon ka-ima jouseu kadalhaovin, nanung kahinjui taove, ati.
target: Then Peter spoke up, “We have left everything to follow you!”

source: Jesu'n, tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Keima jal leh Kipana Thupha jala, a-in, asopipate, asopinute, anu, apa, aji, achate, chule agam leiset hindalha-a chu,
target: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “no one who has left home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for me and the gospel

source: Tu ahinlai sungahi bolsetna thoh pumpuma ajat ja-a in, sopipate, sopinute, nu, pa, ji, chate, gam leiset changlou ding aumpon; chule ahung lhung ding khonung hinkho-a chu tonsot hin kemlou chang lou ding koima aumpoi.
target: will fail to receive a hundred times as much in this present age: homes, brothers, sisters, mothers, children and fields—along with persecutions—and in the age to come eternal life.

source: Amavang amasa cheng tamtah nukhah intin, anukhah cheng masa ding ahi, ati.
target: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.”

source: Chuin Jerusalem chetou dingin acheuvin, lamdung ageijun Jesu amasan ahile adatmo lheh jengun; chule anunga cheho chu akicha taovin ahi. Chuin Aman somleni ho chu ahenga akou kitnin, ajah uva achunga ipi ahung lhun ding hichu aseipanin,
target: They were on their way up to Jerusalem, with Jesus leading the way, and the disciples were astonished, while those who followed were afraid. Again he took the Twelve aside and told them what was going to happen to him.

source: Veuvin, Jerusalem jonin ichetouvui; chukoma chu Mihem Chapa hi thempu pipui le danthu sunho khutna pehdoh-a umding, amahon themmo achansah uva chidang namdangte khutna apehdoh dingu;
target: “We are going up to Jerusalem,” he said, “and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and the teachers of the law. They will condemn him to death and will hand him over to the Gentiles,

source: Chule amaho chun a-el ela aboldiu, avoh diu, achil asetkhum dingu, chule atha dingu ahi: chule nithum ni le ama thoudoh kit ding ahi, ati.
target: who will mock him and spit on him, flog him and kill him. Three days later he will rise.”

source: Chuin Zebedee chapate ni Jacob le John ahenga ahung lhonin, ajah-a, Houhil, nahenga kathum chan lhonhi neibolpeh lhonle chun kalung lhon ahi ati lhone.
target: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to him. “Teacher,” they said, “we want you to do for us whatever we ask.”

source: Hichun Aman, Ipi bolpeh lhonleng nagot lhonem? tin adongin ahi.
target: “What do you want me to do for you?” he asked.

source: Amanin adonbut lhonin, ajah-a, Naloupi na-a chun khat najetnah, khat naveijah neitousah lhonin, ati lhonin ahi.
target: They replied, “Let one of us sit at your right and the other at your left in your glory.”

source: Ahin Jesu'n ajah lhonah, Nathum lhon chu nahe lhonpoi: kadona ding khonna hi nadon ngam lhona chule kachan ding baptize hi nachan ngam lhon ding hinam? ati.
target: “You don’t know what you are asking,” Jesus said. “Can you drink the cup I drink or be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with?”

source: Hichun amanin ajah-a, Kangame, ati lhonin ahi. Chuin Jesu'n, Kadon ding khonna vang nadon lhon ding ahin, chule ka baptize channa-a jong baptize nachan lhon ding ahinai.
target: “We can,” they answered. Jesus said to them, “You will drink the cup I drink and be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with,

source: Ahivangin kajetle kaveija tousah ding vang chu keima peh dol ahipoi, gotsa kikoipehho kipe ding ahibouve, ati.
target: but to sit at my right or left is not for me to grant. These places belong to those for whom they have been prepared.”

source: Hichun somho chun hichu ajauvin, Jacob le John chunga alung phamo pantaovin ahi.
target: When the ten heard about this, they became indignant with James and John.

source: Ahinla Jesu'n amaho chu akouvin, ajah uva, Chidang namdangte chunga vaipo tia kiseiho khu a-pakaiyun laltah-in aumun, chule amilen milaltehon achunguva athu neinao apanjiuve ti nanghon naheuve.
target: Jesus called them together and said, “You know that those who are regarded as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.

source: Nangho lah-a vang chu tichu ahipoi: ahin koi hile nangho lah-a alen hi noma chu nalhachaova pang ding;
target: Not so with you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,

source: Chule nalah uva apipuipen hi noma chu mi jouse soh hi ding ahi.
target: and whoever wants to be first must be slave of all.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Mihem Chapa tah jongchu jen dinga hung hilouvin, ajenle dingle mi tamtah lhatdoh nadinga ahinna toh dingjoh-a hung ahibouve, ati.
target: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

source: Chuin Jericho khopi ahung lhung taovin ahi. Chuin aseijuitele mihonpi toh Jericho khopi-a kona akipat doh-un ahile, Timaeus chapa Bartimaeus kiti mitchopa chu lamkenga khutdon anatouvin ahi.
target: Then they came to Jericho. As Jesus and his disciples, together with a large crowd, were leaving the city, a blind man, Bartimaeus (which means “son of Timaeus”), was sitting by the roadside begging.

source: Nazareth Jesu ahi ti ahet phatnin, Vo David Chapa Jesu, neilungset in, tin asampantan ahi.
target: When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to shout, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”

source: Mitam tah-in ama chu thipbeh-a umdingin aphoh-un; ahivangin ama chun, David Chapa, neilungset in, tin ahasap chehtan ahi.
target: Many rebuked him and told him to be quiet, but he shouted all the more, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”

source: Chuin Jesu adingin, agahkou dingun thu apen ahi. Amahon mitchopa akouvun, ajah-a, Lung mongin umin, kipatdoh-in, nakouve, atiuvin ahi.
target: Jesus stopped and said, “Call him.” So they called to the blind man, “Cheer up! On your feet! He’s calling you.”

source: Chuin ama chun apon aleh lhan, akipatdoh-in, Jesu henga achetai.
target: Throwing his cloak aside, he jumped to his feet and came to Jesus.

source: Chuin Jesu'n ama chu ahouvin, Keiman nangma iloleng nalungham? ati. Chuin mitchopa chun ajah-a, Rabbi, kho muleng kati, ati.
target: “What do you want me to do for you?” Jesus asked him. The blind man said, “Rabbi, I want to see.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah-a, Chetan, natahsanin nadamsah ahitai, ati. Chupettah chun kho amupai jengin, lamdung lhung chun Jesu ajuitan ahi.
target: “Go,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus along the road.

source: Jerusalem kho koma Olivet mola Bethphage le Bethany ageijun, aseijuite lah-a mi ni asolin,
target: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two of his disciples,

source: Ajah lhona, Namasang jon lhona kho sunga khun lut lhonin: kho sung nalut lut lhonle, sangan nou kihen koima touna khah loulai namu paijen lhon ding ahi, hichu sut lhoninlang hinkai lhonin.
target: saying to them, “Go to the village ahead of you, and just as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, which no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.

source: Chule mi khattouvin, Ibola nasut lhonham? tia donga aumle, Pakaiyin manna nom aneije, ajole hinthah vah kit paitante ti lhonin, ati.
target: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs it and will send it back here shortly.’ ”

source: Amani ache lhonin ahile, khopi sung lam lena inpoa kotphunga sangan nou kihen khat amu lhonin, hichu asut lhonin ahi.
target: They went and found a colt outside in the street, tied at a doorway. As they untied it,

source: Chukoma dingho kimkhatnin, Ibola sangan nou chu nasut lhon ham? ati.
target: some people standing there asked, “What are you doing, untying that colt?”

source: Chuin amanin Jesu'n ahilna lhon bangin amaho jah-a asei lhonin ahile, ahinlha taovin ahi.
target: They answered as Jesus had told them to, and the people let them go.

source: Amanin sangan nou chu Jesu henga ahinkai lhonin, chuin aponu achunga aphaovin, achunga Ama atouvin;
target: When they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their cloaks over it, he sat on it.

source: Chuin mi tamtah-in lampia aponu aphaovin, abangin loulaija theoboh asatnun aphaovin ahi.
target: Many people spread their cloaks on the road, while others spread branches they had cut in the fields.

source: Chuin amasa chengsele anungjui chengsen, Hosanna; Pakai mina hungpa chu anunnome;
target: Those who went ahead and those who followed shouted, “Hosanna!” “Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!”

source: I-pau David lenggam hung lhung ding chu anunnome; Chungnung pena Hosanna, tin asam asamun ahi.
target: “Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!” “Hosanna in the highest heaven!”

source: Chuin Jesu Jerusalem khopi-a houin'a chun agalutnin; chuin ijakai avetle soh phatnin, nilhah lam jong ahitan apotnin somleni ho chutoh Bethany'a achetan ahi.
target: Jesus entered Jerusalem and went into the temple courts. He looked around at everything, but since it was already late, he went out to Bethany with the Twelve.

source: Chuin ajingin, Bethany'a kona ahung potdohle agil akeltan;
target: The next day as they were leaving Bethany, Jesus was hungry.

source: Chuin gamlatah-a hin theichang donei amun, aga kamu khatle tin achele ado tailou ima agamu tapoi; ijeh-inem itile theichang chu aga phat mong jong hilou ahi.
target: Seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, he went to find out if it had any fruit. When he reached it, he found nothing but leaves, because it was not the season for figs.

source: Chuin Jesu'n thingphung jah-a chun, Tukallin a-imatih chanin koiman naga ne hihhen, ati. Chutia ati chu aseijuiten ajauvin ahi.
target: Then he said to the tree, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again.” And his disciples heard him say it.

source: Chuin Jerusalem ahung lhunun, Jesu houin'a alutnin, houin sunga thil johho le thil choho anodoh panin, chule sum lhengho dokhangle vakhu johho touna chu alekhup peh-in;
target: On reaching Jerusalem, Jesus entered the temple courts and began driving out those who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves,

source: Chule houin sunga chun koiman thilkeo apohle ding aja nomtapoi.
target: and would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple courts.

source: Chuin ajah uva, Ka-in chu namtin dinga taona in kiti ding ahi, tia kisun hilouham? Ahin nanghon gucha michom kokhuh-in nasemtaove, tin aseitan ahi.
target: And as he taught them, he said, “Is it not written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations’? But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’”

source: Chuin thempu pipuiho le danthu sunhon hichu ajauvin ahile Ama suhmangna dingje chu aholtauve; ijeh-inem itile mipin athuhil chu kidang asah cheh jeh-u chun, Ama chu akichauvin ahi.
target: The chief priests and the teachers of the law heard this and began looking for a way to kill him, for they feared him, because the whole crowd was amazed at his teaching.

source: Chuin nilhah ahi phatnin, khopi sunga konin apotdohtan ahi.
target: When evening came, Jesus and his disciples went out of the city.

source: Chuin jingkah-in ahopauvin ahile, theichang phung chu ajung geija ana goptah chu amuvin ahi.
target: In the morning, as they went along, they saw the fig tree withered from the roots.

source: Chuin Peter'in ageldoh-in, ajah-a, Vetan, Rabbi, theichang phung nagaosap chu agopjoutai, ati.
target: Peter remembered and said to Jesus, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree you cursed has withered!”

source: Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah-a, Pathen tahsanun.
target: “Have faith in God,” Jesus answered.

source: Tahbeh-a kasei ahi, Koi hile hiche molsang jah-a, Kichondoh inlang twikhanglen'a kilehluttan tia; chule alunga tahsan lelna beihela, atiti hijeng ding ahi tia tahsan chu, atiti hi thei ding ahi.
target: “Truly I tell you, if anyone says to this mountain, ‘Go, throw yourself into the sea,’ and does not doubt in their heart but believes that what they say will happen, it will be done for them.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu kati ahi, nataova thil nathum chanu chu namusan ngaitoleu chun namu dingu ahi.
target: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.

source: Chule atao dinga nadin petle, van'a na-Pau jongin nasuhkhelnao angaidam theinan, koi itobang hijongle nalungdou chu ngaidamun.
target: And when you stand praying, if you hold anything against anyone, forgive them, so that your Father in heaven may forgive you your sins.”

source: Chuin Jerusalem'a ahung kitnun; chuin Houin sunga avahlelen ahile thempu pipuiho le danthu sunho chule upaho ahenga ahungun;
target: They arrived again in Jerusalem, and while Jesus was walking in the temple courts, the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders came to him.

source: Chule amaho chun, Ipi thunei na-a hitiho hi nabolham? Hiti bol dinga hiche thuneina nape-a koiham? atiuvin ahi.
target: “By what authority are you doing these things?” they asked. “And who gave you authority to do this?”

source: Ahin Jesu'n ajah uva, Keiman nangho thu khat donging kate, neidonbut un; chule keiman ipi thuneija hicheng kabol ahi seipehnao vinge.
target: Jesus replied, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.

source: John baptize bol chu van'a konha, ole mihem'a konham? Neidonbut un, ati.
target: John’s baptism—was it from heaven, or of human origin? Tell me!”

source: Chuin amaho akingai touvin, Van'a kon ahi tileuhenla chuti ahile, Ibola ama natahsan lou uham? tintin;
target: They discussed it among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask, ‘Then why didn’t you believe him?’

source: Mihem'a kon ahi tileu henla; mi jousen John chu themgao tahbeh-a angaito cheh ahi jeh chun, mipi chu akichauvin ahi.
target: But if we say, ‘Of human origin’ …” (They feared the people, for everyone held that John really was a prophet.)

source: Chuti chun amahon Jesu chu adonbutnun, Kaseithei pouve, atiuvin ahi. Hichun Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah uva, Achutile ipi thuneija hicheng kabol ahi, keiman jong seipeh deh pouvinge, ati.
target: So they answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.”

source: Chuin Aman ajah uva thulemin thu aseipanin, Mikhatnin lengpilei abolin, palin aumkimvelin, lengpiga chil lhahna pum alaijin, insang asan, chuin aleilhouho khutna apedoh-in, migam danga achemang tai.
target: Jesus then began to speak to them in parables: “A man planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a pit for the winepress and built a watchtower. Then he rented the vineyard to some farmers and moved to another place.

source: Chuin aga lhun phatnin, ama chanding aga chu la dingin aleilhouho henga asoh khat asolin ahi.
target: At harvest time he sent a servant to the tenants to collect from them some of the fruit of the vineyard.

source: Hichun alei lhouhon amapa chu amanun, avovin, agoh-in akilesah taovin ahi.
target: But they seized him, beat him and sent him away empty-handed.

source: Chuin aman asoh chomkhat asol kitnin ahile, ama chu songin asepmun, alu anamavo uvin, chule jachat umtah-in abolun asolmang taove.
target: Then he sent another servant to them; they struck this man on the head and treated him shamefully.

source: Chuin achomkhat asol kitleuvin ahile, ama chu anathatnun, chule adang tamtah jong abang avovin, abang athatnun ahi.
target: He sent still another, and that one they killed. He sent many others; some of them they beat, others they killed.

source: Aman chapa deitah khat anei nalaijin, anunung penin, Kachapa hi anajabolunte, tin ama chu asoltai.
target: “He had one left to send, a son, whom he loved. He sent him last of all, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

source: Ahinla chuche leilhouho chu akihoutoh-un, Ama hi agou lo ding chu ahi, khaije that uhite, chutile agou lo ding eiho ichan dingu ahi, atiuvin ahi.
target: “But the tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

source: Chuin amanun athatnun, chuin lengpilei polama alehdoh taovin ahi.
target: So they took him and killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.

source: Lengpilei neipa chun i-alo tadem? Ama hungintin aleilhouho chu sugamintin, lengpilei chu midang apeh ding ahi.
target: “What then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.

source: Hiche Pathen lekhabua thuhi nasimkhah hih-um; In sahon adeimoa apaiju song chu Aninga songpipenin apangtai;
target: Haven’t you read this passage of Scripture: “ ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone;

source: Hiche hi Pakai thilbol ahin, Chule imitmuvin akidang lheh jenge, ati.
target: the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes’ ?”

source: Chuin chuche thulem asei chu amaho gotna-a asei ahi ti aheuvin, ahinla mipi chu akichauvin ahi; chuin Ama adalhauvin achemang taove.
target: Then the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders looked for a way to arrest him because they knew he had spoken the parable against them. But they were afraid of the crowd; so they left him and went away.

source: Hichun athuseija kon man dingin, Pharisai ho phabep le Herod loi phabep ahenga asolun ahi.
target: Later they sent some of the Pharisees and Herodians to Jesus to catch him in his words.

source: Chuin amaho chu ahengah ahungun, ajah-a, Houhil, nangma mi dihtah nahin, koima gin naneipoi; nangman mimai navepon, dihtah-a Pathen lampi chu nahile ti kaheuve: Caesar kai kapeh-u hi dan ngai hina, hilouham?
target: They came to him and said, “Teacher, we know that you are a man of integrity. You aren’t swayed by others, because you pay no attention to who they are; but you teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. Is it right to pay the imperial tax to Caesar or not?

source: Kapeh dinguha, kapehlou dinguham? atiuve. Amanla aphatlhem bolu chu ahen, adonbutnin, Ibola neilung lah-uham? Denarius khat hinchoijun, neivet sah-un, ati.
target: Should we pay or shouldn’t we?” But Jesus knew their hypocrisy. “Why are you trying to trap me?” he asked. “Bring me a denarius and let me look at it.”

source: Chuin ahinchoijun ahile Aman ajah uva, Hiche hi koilim le koimin ham? ati. Amahon, Caesar'a ahi, atiuvin ahi.
target: They brought the coin, and he asked them, “Whose image is this? And whose inscription?” “Caesar’s,” they replied.

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah uva, Caesar'a chu Caesar peuvinlang, Pathen'a chu Pathen petangu, ati. Hiphat chun amahon adatmo lheh jengun ahi.
target: Then Jesus said to them, “Give back to Caesar what is Caesar’s and to God what is God’s.” And they were amazed at him.

source: Chuin Saddukai ho, Mithi thokitna aumpoi tiho chu ahenga ahungun, ajah-a thudoh aneijun,
target: Then the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.

source: Houhil, koi hile sopinei khattouvin cha nei louva aji athisana ahile, asopipa chun ajinu chu jin neihenlang, asopipa ding chun chi khaipehhen, tia Mosi'n lekha eisutpeh-u ahi.
target: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man must marry the widow and raise up offspring for his brother.

source: Ucha pasal sagite khat aumun: amasapenpa chun ji aneijin chikhai louvin athitan ahi.
target: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married and died without leaving any children.

source: Abanapan amanu chu jin aneijin, chikhai louman athin, athumnapa jong chutima chu ahi.
target: The second one married the widow, but he also died, leaving no child. It was the same with the third.

source: Chutichun pasal sagi chun jin aneijun, chikhai lou ahitaovin; akhonna-in anumeinu chu athitai.
target: In fact, none of the seven left any children. Last of all, the woman died too.

source: Ahile thokitna-a amanu chu alah uva koipen ji hitantem? Ijeh-inem itile asagiuva amanu chu ji-a anei sohkeiju ahi, atiuve.
target: At the resurrection whose wife will she be, since the seven were married to her?”

source: Jesu'n amaho adonbutnin, ajah uva, Pathen lekhabu thu le Pathen thahatna nahetjoh sangu aum lou jeh-a nakheljiu hilouham?
target: Jesus replied, “Are you not in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God?

source: Ajehchu mithiho athia kona athodoh tengule akicheng tapouvin, chen jong akichensah tapouve; ahin van'a vantilte tobang ahiuve.
target: When the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage; they will be like the angels in heaven.

source: Mithiho kaithouvin aumui ti thudola, Pathen'in, Keima Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, Jacob Pathen kahi tia hamboh lah-a kona Mosi akihoupi chu Mosi lekhabua simkha lou nahiuvem?
target: Now about the dead rising—have you not read in the Book of Moses, in the account of the burning bush, how God said to him, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?

source: Ama athiho Pathen hilouvin, ahingho Pathen ahijo bouve; hakhela nakhelu ahi, ati.
target: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are badly mistaken!”

source: Chuin danthu sunho khatnin akinelnao chu ahung jan, chule Jesu'n amaho kichehtah-a adonbut chu ahen, Thupeh jouse lah-a hoipen hi thupipen ham? tin adongin ahi.
target: One of the teachers of the law came and heard them debating. Noticing that Jesus had given them a good answer, he asked him, “Of all the commandments, which is the most important?”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Apipen chu hiche ahi, Vo Israel chateho, ngaijun, Pakai i-Pathen'u chu Pakai khatsehbou ahi.
target: “The most important one,” answered Jesus, “is this: ‘Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one.

source: Nangman nalung pumpin, nalhagao pumpin, nalungthim pumpin, chule nathaneina apumpin, Pakai na-Pathen chu ngailun. Hichehi thupeh masapen ahi.
target: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.’

source: Anina hiche hi ahi, Nangma naki ngailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun. Hiteni sanga thupeh lenjo aumpoi, ati.
target: The second is this: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no commandment greater than these.”

source: Chuin danthu sunpa chun, Houhil, nasei dih tangeije, nangman thutah nasei ahi: Ajehchu ama khatsehbou ahi, ama ti lou adang aumpoi.
target: “Well said, teacher,” the man replied. “You are right in saying that God is one and there is no other but him.

source: Chule, Ama chu lung pumpi-a, hetna pumpi-a, hinna pumpi-a, thanei pumpi-a ngailut ding, chule eima ikingailut banga iheng ikom te ngailut chu pumgo thilto le ganlhaina jouse sanga gamchenga phajo ahi, ati.
target: To love him with all your heart, with all your understanding and with all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself is more important than all burnt offerings and sacrifices.”

source: Danthu sunpan hechentah-a adonbut ajah phatnin Jesu'n, Nangma Pathen lenggam toh nakilatpoi, ati. Chukal chun koiman thu adong ngamtapoi.
target: When Jesus saw that he had answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from the kingdom of God.” And from then on no one dared ask him any more questions.

source: Chuin Houin sunga athuhil petnin, Jesu'n adonbut-in, Danthu sunhon Christa chu David chapa ahi atiu hi itidana aseiju ham?
target: While Jesus was teaching in the temple courts, he asked, “Why do the teachers of the law say that the Messiah is the son of David?

source: Ajeh chu Lhagao Thengin ahila konin David ama tah-in, Pakaiyin ka Pakai jah-a, Keiman namelmate chengse nakeng chotpha-a kaneisah masangsen, Kajet lamah tou jingin, tin aseije.
target: David himself, speaking by the Holy Spirit, declared: “ ‘The Lord said to my Lord: “Sit at my right hand until I put your enemies under your feet.” ’

source: David amatah-in Pakai asah-in, achutile achapa iti hi thei dingham? ati. Milhamho chun Jesu thusei chu thanom tah-in angaijun ahi.
target: David himself calls him ‘Lord.’ How then can he be his son?” The large crowd listened to him with delight.

source: Chuin Aman athuhilna-a chun ajah uva, Sangkhol choltah kiah-a kholai len noma, chule kailhanga min chibai aboh ding deiho,
target: As he taught, Jesus said, “Watch out for the teachers of the law. They like to walk around in flowing robes and be greeted with respect in the marketplaces,

source: Kikhopna in le golvahna-a touna pipen deiho,
target: and have the most important seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.

source: Chule meithaiho in bahgama, chule alhema sot tahtah taojia danthu sunho-a konin kihongphauvin; amaho chu themmo chungnung changding ahiuve, ati.
target: They devour widows’ houses and for a show make lengthy prayers. These men will be punished most severely.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n sumdolna bom jona atouvin, mipin sumdolna boma sum alelut chu aven ahile, mihao tamtah-in tamtah aleh lutnun ahi.
target: Jesus sat down opposite the place where the offerings were put and watched the crowd putting their money into the temple treasury. Many rich people threw in large amounts.

source: Chuin meithai vaichatah khat ahungin, sumsan nongsi pehni aleh lutnin ahi, hichu paisa khattoh kikot ahi.
target: But a poor widow came and put in two very small copper coins, worth only a few cents.

source: Chuin seijuite akouvin ajah uva, Tahbeh-a kasei ahi, Hiche meithai vaichanu hin adang jouse sangin sumdolna-a atam lelutpen'e.
target: Calling his disciples to him, Jesus said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow has put more into the treasury than all the others.

source: Ijeh-inem itile adangho jouse chun aneival atou ahin, amanu vang hin aneichasun ahinpi chengse alelut jeng ahi, ati.
target: They all gave out of their wealth; but she, out of her poverty, put in everything—all she had to live on.”

source: Chuin Houin'a kona apotdoh-in aseijuite khatnin ajah-a, Houhil, vetan, asongho itobang song hija chule in kisah ho hi itobanga kisalul hitam, ati.
target: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Look, Teacher! What massive stones! What magnificent buildings!”

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, Nangman hiche in loupitah hi namu-em? Hikoma hi song suhchim louva khat chunga khat kisethop himhim umlou helding ahi, ati.
target: “Do you see all these great buildings?” replied Jesus. “Not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”

source: Chuin Pathen Houin jontah Olivet molsanga chun atouvin ahile Peter, Jacob, John, Andrew teho chun atumbeh-in ajah-a,
target: As Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John and Andrew asked him privately,

source: Hicheng chu itihle hi dingham? Chule hitiho chu ahung guilhun phat ding chu amelchihna ipi hintem? Neisei peh-un tin adong lhiuvin ahi.
target: “Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are all about to be fulfilled?”

source: Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin hitin aseije, Koiman nangho nalheplhah louna dingun kichih theijun.
target: Jesus said to them: “Watch out that no one deceives you.

source: Mi tamtah keima minin hunguntin, Keima Christa kahi tiuvintin, mi tamtah alheplhah dingu ahi.
target: Many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am he,’ and will deceive many.

source: Chule nanghon gal kisatle kidou thuthang najah tengule, lungdong hih-un; hicheng chu hung soh tei ding ahi; ahivangin achaina hiloulai ding ahi.
target: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is still to come.

source: Ijeh-inem itile vai khatle vai khat, gam khatle gam khat hung kidouvintin, mun chom mun choma ling hung kihot intin, kel hunglha-a gentheina hung lhung ding ahi; hicheng chu hahsatna kipatna ahi.
target: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, and famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.

source: Amavang kichih theijun; ajehchu vaihom upate khutna pehdoh-a nahung umdingu, kikhopna in'a nakivo dingu, chule keima mina vaipoho le lengho anga amaho douna-a hettohsah dinga nahung din dingu ahinalaije.
target: “You must be on your guard. You will be handed over to the local councils and flogged in the synagogues. On account of me you will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them.

source: Kipana Thupha hi namtin vaipi lah-a hillhanga um masa tei ding ahi.
target: And the gospel must first be preached to all nations.

source: Chule nakaijuva napehdoh tengule, ipi iti kasei dingham tin amasangin lungkham hih-un; ahin aphattahle nakipeh chanu chu seibouvun; ijeh inem itile aseija chu nangho hilouvin, Lhagao Theng joh ahi.
target: Whenever you are arrested and brought to trial, do not worry beforehand about what to say. Just say whatever is given you at the time, for it is not you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.

source: Chule asopin asopi, pan acha tha dinga ahinpehdoh ding; chate kipatdoh uva anule apa adoudiu, amaho chu ahin thasah dingu ahi.
