target: “Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rebel against their parents and have them put to death.

source: Chule keima min jala nangho mi jouse hotna nahung umdingu ahi; ahinla akhon ni geija thoh lhumkeija pangdetpabou chu huhhing-a umding ahi.
target: Everyone will hate you because of me, but the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.

source: Amavang themgao Daniel seibangin, misumang thet umtah chu adinna dol louva adin namu tengule (asim siman hehen), chutengle Judah gama um chengse thinglhang lamah jamuhen:
target: “When you see ‘the abomination that causes desolation’ standing where it does not belong—let the reader understand—then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

source: In chunga uma jong hung kumlha hihhen, athilkeo kilah dingin in sunga lut hihhen:
target: Let no one on the housetop go down or enter the house to take anything out.

source: Loujaova uma jong apon kilah dingin kilekit dahen.
target: Let no one in the field go back to get their cloak.

source: Ahin ohe, hiche lai chule agaija le naonoi chepsahho ada nadinguve!
target: How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers!

source: Chule najam nadingu phat chu phalbi ahi louna dingin taovun.
target: Pray that this will not take place in winter,

source: Chuche nikho chu hesoh gentheina nikho hi ding ahi, chutobanga hesohna nasatah chu Pathen'in lei asema patnin tu geijin aumkha hihlaije, chule um jong umlou ding ahi.
target: because those will be days of distress unequaled from the beginning, when God created the world, until now—and never to be equaled again.

source: Chule Pakaiyin chuche nikho chu asuhchom lou hileh, mihem himhim asohcha umlou ding ahi; ahivangin alhendohsa alhen chomte jala anikho chu asuhchom ahitai.
target: “If the Lord had not cut short those days, no one would survive. But for the sake of the elect, whom he has chosen, he has shortened them.

source: Chutengle najah uva khattouvin, Ven, hikomah Christa aume, atia; ahiloule, Ven, khukoma aume, atile tahsan hih-un.
target: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Messiah!’ or, ‘Look, there he is!’ do not believe it.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Christa lhemho le themgao lhemho hung sohdoh untin, melchihna le mu kidang dang ahin vetsah dingu; ahitheile lhenchomte jeng jong ahinlheplhah dingu ahi.
target: For false messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.

source: Nangho vang kichihtheijun; veuvin, ijakai kahil masah dem nahitaove.
target: So be on your guard; I have told you everything ahead of time.

source: Ahivangin chucheng nikholai, hesoh genthei joule, nisa thimintin, chule lha jong vahta lou ding,
target: “But in those days, following that distress, “ ‘the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light;

source: vanlaijola konin ahsi ho hung pullhantin, chule van'a hatnaho chengse kihot lingsoh ding ahi.
target: the stars will fall from the sky, and the heavenly bodies will be shaken.’

source: Chutahle vanlaijola Mihem Chapa thunei Chungnung tah le loupitah-a meibola ahung amu dingu ahi.
target: “At that time people will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

source: Chutah chule aman vantil ho asola, leiset monga pat van mong geija kolkimvel li-a kona alhen chomte alon khom ding ahi.
target: And he will send his angels and gather his elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the heavens.

source: Theichang phung hin thulem kihilun; abah adona ajih akilhap tengle nipi anaitai ti naheuve.
target: “Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its twigs get tender and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.

source: Chutobang chun nangho jong hicheng chu aguilhun namu tengule, anaitai, kotbul hung geija ahitai, ti heuvin.
target: Even so, when you see these things happening, you know that it is near, right at the door.

source: Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Hichengse chu aboncha aguilhun masangse-a, hiche tulai khanga mite hi mang lou ding ahi.
target: Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.

source: Vanle lei mang ding ahin, keima thu vang mang lou ding ahi.
target: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.

source: Ahivangin Pa tailou van'a vantilte jong, Chapa jong, koimachan anikhole ani dantah chu ahepoi.
target: “But about that day or hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

source: Chingtheijun, kiging jingin umunlang tao jingun: ijeh inem itile aphat chu itih ahi ding nahepouve.
target: Be on guard! Be alert! You do not know when that time will come.

source: Ajehchu mihem Chapa hi mi khat asohte thuneina pedoh, abonchauva atoh ding cheh-u pe-a, chule kotngah kiging jinga umdinga thu apeh nunga, a-in dalha-a migam danga chemanga tobang ahi.
target: It’s like a man going away: He leaves his house and puts his servants in charge, each with their assigned task, and tells the one at the door to keep watch.

source: Hiche jeh chun kiging jingin umun, ijeh-inem itile inneipu chu itih-a ahung ding nahepouve, nilhah lam ahim, jan khangkim ahim, ahkhonphat ahim, jingkah ahim, ahung ding phat nahepouve.
target: “Therefore keep watch because you do not know when the owner of the house will come back—whether in the evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or at dawn.

source: Hetman louvin hungjeng tale na-imut petnu hungtoh khante.
target: If he comes suddenly, do not let him find you sleeping.

source: Nangho jah-a kasei hi mi jouse jah-a kasei ahi, Kiging jingin umun, ati.
target: What I say to you, I say to everyone: ‘Watch!’ ”

source: Chuin nini jou chun kalchuh kut le cholsolou changlhah kut hiding ahin; thempu pipuiho le danthu sunhon iti doha-a bola matna, chule tha dingham tin ahol aholun ahi.
target: Now the Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread were only two days away, and the chief priests and the teachers of the law were scheming to arrest Jesus secretly and kill him.

source: Ahin amahon, Kut kiman sung hidahen, achutiloule mipi lah-a thunoh umget inte, atiuvin ahi.
target: “But not during the festival,” they said, “or the people may riot.”

source: Chuin Bethany'a Simon miphahpa in'a aman ankong aumpetnin, numei khatnin songval bomin nard thao namtui theng mantam tah ahinchoijin, abom chu asukeh-in alua abunglhan ahi.
target: While he was in Bethany, reclining at the table in the home of Simon the Leper, a woman came with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfume, made of pure nard. She broke the jar and poured the perfume on his head.

source: Ahin alah uva akimkhat chu alungphamo uvin, Ibola thao hitia amoh suhmang jeng hitam?
target: Some of those present were saying indignantly to one another, “Why this waste of perfume?

source: Ijeh-inem itile hiche thao hi kijoh henlang hile dangka jale somnga kikhong dinga, chutile asum chu mivaicha gentheiho peh thei ahi, atiuvin; chule numeinu chu aphoh taovin ahi.
target: It could have been sold for more than a year’s wages and the money given to the poor.” And they rebuked her harshly.

source: Ahin Jesu'n amaho jah-a, Amanu chu limsah hih-un; amanu chu ibola nasuh lunggim uham? Amanu hin keima dinga thil phatah abol ahi.
target: “Leave her alone,” said Jesus. “Why are you bothering her? She has done a beautiful thing to me.

source: Ijeh-inem itile mivaicha gentheite nakom uva aum jingnauve, nagotlai chanua nanghon nahu thei dingu ahi; keima vang nangho koma umjing ding kahipoi.
target: The poor you will always have with you, and you can help them any time you want. But you will not always have me.

source: Amanu hin aboltheichan abol ahi; kalong hi vuidinga chu eihung nu masah ahi.
target: She did what she could. She poured perfume on my body beforehand to prepare for my burial.

source: Ahin keiman nangho tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Vannoi leiset gam pumpi-a Kipana Thupha kihil lhangna chana, hiche numeinu thilbol jong hi amanu het jingna-a kiseipeh dinga ahi, ati.
target: Truly I tell you, wherever the gospel is preached throughout the world, what she has done will also be told, in memory of her.”

source: Chuin Judas Iscariot, somleni lah-a mi khat chun, Jesu chu amaho amatsah theinan thempu pipuiho henga agachen ahi.
target: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Jesus to them.

source: Chuin amahon hichu ajah phatnun akipah-un, ama chu sumpeh dingin ateptaovin ahi. Chuin aman Ama chu pehdoh-a matsah theina agomkom aholtan ahi.
target: They were delighted to hear this and promised to give him money. So he watched for an opportunity to hand him over.

source: Chule cholsolou changlhah kut kipatni, kalchuh kut kelngoi atha niuvin, aseijuiten ajah-a, Kalchuh kut naneh theina dinga hoikoma gagoleu veng nalungham? atiuvin ahi.
target: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, when it was customary to sacrifice the Passover lamb, Jesus’ disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and make preparations for you to eat the Passover?”

source: Chuin Aman aseijuite mi ni asolin, ajah lhona, Khopi sunga khun che lut lhonin, chule twibel pu-a mi khat nato lhon ding ahin; ama chu jui lhonin.
target: So he sent two of his disciples, telling them, “Go into the city, and a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him.

source: Chule alutna in'a inneipa jah-a chun, Houhilin, kaseijuite toh kalchuh kut kanehna ding kajin indan chu hoilaiham? ati, gati lhonin.
target: Say to the owner of the house he enters, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is my guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?’

source: Chule amatah-in indan chungnung lentah gotsademle phasadem khat navetsah lhon ding ahi; hikoma chun ineh dingun anago lhontan, ati.
target: He will show you a large room upstairs, furnished and ready. Make preparations for us there.”

source: Chuin seijui teni chu akipatdoh lhonin, khopi sunga alut lhonin, ajahlhona aseibang bang chun agatoh lhonin: kalchuh kut chu agago lhontan ahi.
target: The disciples left, went into the city and found things just as Jesus had told them. So they prepared the Passover.

source: Chuin nilhah ahi phatnin somleni ho chutoh ahungtai.
target: When evening came, Jesus arrived with the Twelve.

source: Chuin atou uva an aneh laitah-un, Jesu'n ajah uva, Tahbeh-a kasei ahi, Nalah uva kaneh khompi mikhat hin eipehdoh-a eimatsah ding ahi, ati.
target: While they were reclining at the table eating, he said, “Truly I tell you, one of you will betray me—one who is eating with me.”

source: Chuin alungkham pantaovin, khat khatnin, Kei kahim? tin aban banin adong taovin ahi.
target: They were saddened, and one by one they said to him, “Surely you don’t mean me?”

source: Chuin Aman amaho chu adonbutnin, Lhenga kasokhompi, Somleni lah-a mi khat ahi.
target: “It is one of the Twelve,” he replied, “one who dips bread into the bowl with me.

source: Mihem Chapa achonchan ding thu kisun bangtah-a chu cheding mong ahi; ahivangin Mihem Chapa pedoh-a matsah dingpa chu ohe, adana-e! Ama chu apena peng lou hile ama dinga phajo ding ahi, ati.
target: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about him. But woe to that man who betrays the Son of Man! It would be better for him if he had not been born.”

source: Chuin an aneh laitah-un, Jesu'n changlhah alan, phatthei aboh jouvin ahehbal balin amaho chu apen, ajah uva, Kilah-un, neuvin; hiche hi katahsa ahi, ati.
target: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it and gave it to his disciples, saying, “Take it; this is my body.”

source: Chuin khon alan athangvah jouvin amaho chu apen, chutichun abonchauvin adon sohkei taovin ahi.
target: Then he took a cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them, and they all drank from it.

source: Chuin Aman ajah uva, Hiche hi mi tamtah dinga kisodoh kitepna thah kathisan ahi.
target: “This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many,” he said to them.

source: Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Keiman Pathen lenggam sunga athah kadon ni ahung lhun kahse-a, lengpiga twi hi kadon lou ding ahitai, ati.
target: “Truly I tell you, I will not drink again from the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it new in the kingdom of God.”

source: Chuin amahon la asah jouvun, apotdoh-un Olivet molsang lama ache taovin ahi.
target: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah uva, Nangho nabon chaova tujana keima jeh-a lungthoi sohkei ding nahiuve: ijeh-inem itile, Keiman kelngoi chingpa kavoh lhuh ding ahi, chutengle akelngoite chu jamcheh gamding ahi, tin akisune.
target: “You will all fall away,” Jesus told them, “for it is written: “ ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’

source: Ahivangin kathodoh nungle Galilee gam lama namasang sang uva kache ding ahi, ati.
target: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”

source: Ahin Peter'in ajah-a, Abonchauvin lungthoi jongleu, keivang lungthoi pong kate, ati.
target: Peter declared, “Even if all fall away, I will not.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah-a, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahi, Nangman tuni, tujan mama-a hi ahchal nivei akhon kah-a thumvei neiseilep ding ahi, ati.
target: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus answered, “today—yes, tonight—before the rooster crows twice you yourself will disown me three times.”

source: Peter vang chun, Nangma toh thitha tei ding mong hijongleng, keiman nangma seilep hihhel ing kate, atichang melin ahi. Chule adangho jouse jongchun achuti sei cheh-un ahi.
target: But Peter insisted emphatically, “Even if I have to die with you, I will never disown you.” And all the others said the same.

source: Chuin Getsemane atiu mun'a chun ahungun, chuin Aman aseijuite jah-a, Keima katao sungsen nangho hikoma hin anatou jingun, ati.
target: They went to a place called Gethsemane, and Jesus said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”

source: Chuin Peter le Jacob, chule John hicheng chu apuijin, chuin alung hesoh behseh jengin, halung hemin alunghem pantan ahi.
target: He took Peter, James and John along with him, and he began to be deeply distressed and troubled.

source: Chuin amaho jah-a, Thina khophelin kalung ahesoh behseh jengtai: hikoma hin umunlang kiging jingun, ati.
target: “My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death,” he said to them. “Stay here and keep watch.”

source: Chuin amasang lama phabep khat achechonin, tolah akhupbon alhun, ahitheile hiche phat chu ama-a kona akitolmang theina dingin ataovin,
target: Going a little farther, he fell to the ground and prayed that if possible the hour might pass from him.

source: Abba, ka Pa, nangma dinga ijakai hithei sohkei ahi; hiche khon hi kakoma konin chon mangin: ahivangin keima thu hilouvin, nangma thu thu hijohen, ati.
target: “Abba, Father,” he said, “everything is possible for you. Take this cup from me. Yet not what I will, but what you will.”

source: Chuin ahungleh khatteho chu a-imut lhuh-u ahungtoh-in, Peter jah-a, Simon, na-imut hitam? Nidan khat jeng jong kiginga um jou lou nahim?
target: Then he returned to his disciples and found them sleeping. “Simon,” he said to Peter, “are you asleep? Couldn’t you keep watch for one hour?

source: Lhepna-a nalhah louna dingun kigingun, taovun. Lhagao vangin ago tahbeh nan, ahin tahsa hi alhasamin ahi, ati.
target: Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

source: Chuin achemang kitnin, ataovin, aseingai bangman aseijin ahi.
target: Once more he went away and prayed the same thing.

source: Chuin ahung kitnin ahile, amaho chu ana-imutlhuh-u ahungtoh kitnin, a-imutso behseh jeh-un, adonbutje ahe tapouve.
target: When he came back, he again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy. They did not know what to say to him.

source: Chuin thumvei channa-a ahungin, ajah uva, Tun imuvinlang kitha ol taovin: aphasettai, phat alhingtai; Veuvin, Mihem Chapa hi michonse te khutna kipedoh ahitai.
target: Returning the third time, he said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Enough! The hour has come. Look, the Son of Man is delivered into the hands of sinners.

source: Kipat un, chetao hite; veuvin, eipedohpa ahung naitai, ati.
target: Rise! Let us go! Here comes my betrayer!”

source: Chuin hichu aseina laijin, somleni lah-a Judas chu thempu pipuiho, danthu sunho, chule upate koma kona chemjamle moltum toh hintho-a hungkonho mihonpi chutoh ahung kilhonin ahung paitan ahi.
target: Just as he was speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, appeared. With him was a crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests, the teachers of the law, and the elders.

source: Ama pedoh-a pangpa chun melchihna ahilmasan, Kachop penpen chu ama ahi; man unlang kitup keichan puimang taovin, ati ahi.
target: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The one I kiss is the man; arrest him and lead him away under guard.”

source: Chuin ahung lhun lhunin, ama ajonpai jenin, Rabbi, Rabbi, atin, achop tan ahi.
target: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, “Rabbi!” and kissed him.

source: Chuin amahon akhut alhaovin amantaovin ahi.
target: The men seized Jesus and arrested him.

source: Hichun akoma dingho khatnin achemjam asatdoh-in, thempu chungnung sohpa asatjengle, abilkol langkhat asatlhan ahi.
target: Then one of those standing near drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.

source: Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin ajah uva, Gucha michom man dinga kon banga chemjamle moltum tho-a keima man dinga nahung kon uham?
target: “Am I leading a rebellion,” said Jesus, “that you have come out with swords and clubs to capture me?

source: Niseh-in houin'ah i-um khomun thu kahiljin, chulaijinla neimanpouvin ahi: amavang Pathen lekhabua thu guilhun na-a hiti ahi, ati.
target: Every day I was with you, teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest me. But the Scriptures must be fulfilled.”

source: Chutah chun aloi chengsen ama adalhauvin, ajamgam taovin ahi.
target: Then everyone deserted him and fled.

source: Gollhang khat vangin asagoh keo chunga chu tupatpon akisila ama chu ajui ahin; khangdongho chun amanun ahile;
target: A young man, wearing nothing but a linen garment, was following Jesus. When they seized him,

source: Aman aponsil chu adalhan, asagoh keovin amaho-a konin ajam mangtai.
target: he fled naked, leaving his garment behind.

source: Chuin Jesu chu thempu chungnung hengah akaijun; chule ama chutoh thempu pipui chengsele, vaipo upaho, chule danthu sunho ahung kikhomun ahi.
target: They took Jesus to the high priest, and all the chief priests, the elders and the teachers of the law came together.

source: Peter'in galkanga ajuipeh-in, thempu chungnung inpi leitol sungnung geijin ajui lutpeh-in, chuachun sottolho lah-a atouvin mei a-oijin ahi.
target: Peter followed him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest. There he sat with the guards and warmed himself at the fire.

source: Chuin thempu pipuiho leh houvaipoloi chengsen Jesu chu tha theina ding achungah ahehsetnan hettohsah aholun; amu joupouvin ahi.
target: The chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for evidence against Jesus so that they could put him to death, but they did not find any.

source: Ajehchu mi tamtah-in jouthun ahehseuvin, ahivangin aseiju akitoh pon ahi.
target: Many testified falsely against him, but their statements did not agree.

source: Chuin mi phabep khat akipat doh-un, jouthun ahehseuvin,
target: Then some stood up and gave this false testimony against him:

source: Ama hin hiche khutna kisa houin theng hi suseng ting, nithum sungin khutna sahlou achomkhat kasahdoh kitding ahi, ati kajaove, atiuvin ahi.
target: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple made with human hands and in three days will build another, not made with hands.’ ”

source: Ahivangin hiche ahehset naova jongchun akitoh kit pouvin ahi.
target: Yet even then their testimony did not agree.

source: Chuphatnin thempu chungnung chu alah uva adingdoh-in, Jesu chu adongin, Nadonbut lou dingham? Hitehon nahehsetna-a thu aseiju hi ipiham? ati.
target: Then the high priest stood up before them and asked Jesus, “Are you not going to answer? What is this testimony that these men are bringing against you?”

source: Ahivangin Aman donbut louhelin thipbeh-in aumin ahi. Thempu chungnung chun adong kitnin, ajah-a, Nangma Nunnom Chapa, Christa chu nahim? ati.
target: But Jesus remained silent and gave no answer. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Messiah, the Son of the Blessed One?”

source: Chuin Jesu'n, Kahi: chule nanghon Mihem Chapa hi Thilbolthei jet lama atou le van meilah-a ahung namu dingu ahinalaije, ati.
target: “I am,” said Jesus. “And you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Mighty One and coming on the clouds of heaven.”

source: Chuphatnin thempu chungnung chun apon abot eh-in, Thu hettohsah dang iding iti tah dinguham?
target: The high priest tore his clothes. “Why do we need any more witnesses?” he asked.

source: Pathen ataitomna chu najataovin ahi; nanghon iti nagel uvem? ati. Chuphatnin abonchauvin athina theijin athemosah taovin ahi.
target: “You have heard the blasphemy. What do you think?” They all condemned him as worthy of death.

source: Chuin abangin achil aset khumun, chule amai atomun, achumun, ajah-a, Gaovinlang seijin, atiuvin; chule sottolleho chun akhut phanguva angeiphe abengun ahi.
target: Then some began to spit at him; they blindfolded him, struck him with their fists, and said, “Prophesy!” And the guards took him and beat him.

source: Chuin Peter noilama leitola aum petnin, thempu chungnung sohnuho khat ahungin;
target: While Peter was below in the courtyard, one of the servant girls of the high priest came by.

source: Peter'in mei ana-oi chu amuphatnin, amanu chun aven, ajah-a, Nang jong Nazareth Jesu toh kiloi nahi, ati.
target: When she saw Peter warming himself, she looked closely at him. “You also were with that Nazarene, Jesus,” she said.

source: Ahinla aman aseilepmin, Kahepoi, chule ipi nasei ahijong kahepoi, atitai. Chuin tol maijah apotdoh-in ahile ahchal akhongtai.
target: But he denied it. “I don’t know or understand what you’re talking about,” he said, and went out into the entryway.

source: Chuin soh numei khatnin amun, akoma dingho jah-a chun, Hichepa hi amaho lah-a khat ahi, ati kittan ahi.
target: When the servant girl saw him there, she said again to those standing around, “This fellow is one of them.”

source: Aniveina in aseilep kittan ahi. Chujou phabepin akoma dingho chun Peter jah-a, Amaho lah-a khat mong mong nahi; ijeh-inem itile nangma Galilee mi nahi hi nathuseijin aphongdoh-e, atiuve.
target: Again he denied it. After a little while, those standing near said to Peter, “Surely you are one of them, for you are a Galilean.”

source: Ahivangin aman kigaosap le kihahsel athon, Keiman naseipao chu kahephapoi, atitai.
target: He began to call down curses, and he swore to them, “I don’t know this man you’re talking about.”

source: Chupettah chun aniveina-in ahchal akhongpaitan ahi. Chuphatnin, Jesu'n ahchal nivei akhon kah-a thumvei neiseilep ding ahi, atia ajah-a asei chu Peter'in ageldoh-in ahi. Chuin hichu ageldoh phatnin, akaptai.
target: Immediately the rooster crowed the second time. Then Peter remembered the word Jesus had spoken to him: “Before the rooster crows twice you will disown me three times.” And he broke down and wept.

source: Jingkah ahiphatnin thempu pipuiho, vaipo upaho, danthu sunho, chule houvaipoloi chengse akihoutoh paijun, Jesu chu akanun, akaijun Pilate khutna apedoh taovin ahi.
target: Very early in the morning, the chief priests, with the elders, the teachers of the law and the whole Sanhedrin, made their plans. So they bound Jesus, led him away and handed him over to Pilate.

source: Chuin Pilate'in, Nangma Juda te Lengpa nahim? tin adongin ahi. Chuin Aman adonbutnin ajah-a, Naseikhai, ati.
target: “Are you the king of the Jews?” asked Pilate. “You have said so,” Jesus replied.

source: Chuin thempu pipuihon thu tamtah-in ahehseuvin; ahin aman imachan adonbutpoi.
target: The chief priests accused him of many things.

source: Pilate'in adong kitnin, Nadonbut lou dingham? Ve tang, hijatna naheh-u hi, ati.
target: So again Pilate asked him, “Aren’t you going to answer? See how many things they are accusing you of.”

source: Ahin Jesu'n adonbut hihhelin ahile Pilate'in adatmo lheh jengin ahi.
target: But Jesus still made no reply, and Pilate was amazed.

source: Tun Kut sunga chu amahon athum penpen chu sohchang khat alhadohji angai ahi.
target: Now it was the custom at the festival to release a prisoner whom the people requested.

source: Chuin mi khat amin Barabbas atiu, khosung chohnoh hotoh kihen khom, khosung achonohna lamuva tol atha khah ahi.
target: A man called Barabbas was in prison with the insurrectionists who had committed murder in the uprising.

source: Chutichun achonna ngaibang uva abolpehna dingun mipi chun hatah-in asamun angeh pantaovin ahi.
target: The crowd came up and asked Pilate to do for them what he usually did.

source: Chuin Pilate'in adonbutnin, ajah uva, Juda te lengpa hi lhadohpehleng nalungu ham? ati.
target: “Do you want me to release to you the king of the Jews?” asked Pilate,

source: Ama chun thempu pipuihon thangset suma apehdoh-u ahi ti chu ahet ahi.
target: knowing it was out of self-interest that the chief priests had handed Jesus over to him.

source: Ahivangin thempu pipuihon Barabbas chu alhadoh pehna dingu joh-in mipi chu atilseuvin ahi.
target: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have Pilate release Barabbas instead.

source: Chuin Pilate'in ajah uva, Achutile Juda te Lengpa ahi natipao hi i-kalo dingba hitam? tin adong kittan ahi.
target: “What shall I do, then, with the one you call the king of the Jews?” Pilate asked them.

source: Chuin amahon, Thingpel'a khenbeh-in, tin asam kit taovin ahi.
target: “Crucify him!” they shouted.

source: Chuin Pilate'in ajah uva, Ibolinem? Ipi suhset aneijam? ati. Ahin amahon, Thingpel'a khenbeh tan, tin hasaptah-in asamuvin ahi.
target: “Why? What crime has he committed?” asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify him!”

source: Chuphatnin Pilate'in mipi lunglhaina ding chu angaiton, Barabbas alhadohpeh-in, Jesu chu ajep jouvin thingpel'a khetbeh dingin apedohtan ahi.
target: Wanting to satisfy the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them. He had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.

source: Chuin sepaihon ama chu Pretorium atiu inpi sunga chun apuilutnun, sepaiho jouse akoukhom sohkeijun ahi.
target: The soldiers led Jesus away into the palace (that is, the Praetorium) and called together the whole company of soldiers.

source: Chuin Jesu chu ponsandup asilpeh-un, ling lukhuh aphanun, alu-a chun akhuhpeh-un ahi.
target: They put a purple robe on him, then twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on him.

source: Chuin, Vo Juda te Lengpa, tin chibai aboh pantaovin ahi.
target: And they began to call out to him, “Hail, king of the Jews!”

source: Chuin amaho chun peng tenggolin alu avo avovin, chule chil asetkhumun, chule adilsuvin chibai aboh-un ahi.
target: Again and again they struck him on the head with a staff and spit on him. Falling on their knees, they paid homage to him.

source: Chutia chu totnopna-a a-el ela abol jouvun, ponsandup chu ahoh lha uvin ama pon asilpeh-un, thingpel'a khetbeh dingin apuimang taovin ahi.
target: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple robe and put his own clothes on him. Then they led him out to crucify him.

source: Chuin amahon kholjin hiche mun hinjotpa Cyrene gam mi Alexander le Rufus pa Simon chu acham louvin athingpel puding chun amanun ahi.
target: A certain man from Cyrene, Simon, the father of Alexander and Rufus, was passing by on his way in from the country, and they forced him to carry the cross.

source: Chutichun Golgotha atiu mun'a chun apuitaove, hichu lugu mun tina ahi.
target: They brought Jesus to the place called Golgotha (which means “the place of the skull”).

source: Chuin myrrh toh kihal lengpi theitwi apeuvin, ahinla Ama anom pon ahi.
target: Then they offered him wine mixed with myrrh, but he did not take it.

source: Chuin thingpel'a akhenbeh jouvun, aponsil hochu abonchauva achan cheh nadingun vang aveovin, akihomtaove.
target: And they crucified him. Dividing up his clothes, they cast lots to see what each would get.

source: Jesu akhetbehnao chu nidan thum don ahi.
target: It was nine in the morning when they crucified him.

source: Achunga chun ahehnau hetsahna, JUDA TE LENGPA tia kisun aumin ahi.
target: The written notice of the charge against him read: the king of the jews .

source: Chuin amatoh thakhatnin gucha michom mi ni, khat ajetlamah, khat aveilamah, thingpelah akhenbeh-un ahi.
target: They crucified two rebels with him, one on his right and one on his left.

source: Chuin achele, avahle jousen akhasuh khumun, ajah-a, Aha! Nang houin suse-a ni thuma sadohkit,
target: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads and saying, “So! You who are going to destroy the temple and build it in three days,

source: Nangma kihuh hingin lang thingpel'a kon chun hung kumlha tangem, atiuvin a-el elin ahouvun ahi.
target: come down from the cross and save yourself!”

source: Chutobangma chun thempu pipuiho jong chun totnopnan abolun, danthu sunho chutoh, Aman midang ahuhhingjin Ama akihuhhing theipoi.
target: In the same way the chief priests and the teachers of the law mocked him among themselves. “He saved others,” they said, “but he can’t save himself!

source: Kamuva katahsan theina dingun, Israelte Lengpa Christa chu tutah hin thingpel chunga konin hung kumlha temhen, atiuvin ahi. Chule amatoh thingpel'a kikhetbeh tha teni jong chun ama ahouse lhonin ahi.
target: Let this Messiah, this king of Israel, come down now from the cross, that we may see and believe.” Those crucified with him also heaped insults on him.

source: Chuin nidan gup tah-in gam jouse chunga thim ajingin, nidan ko geijin mu athimtan ahi.
target: At noon, darkness came over the whole land until three in the afternoon.

source: Chuin nidan koh lhintah-in Jesu hapenin apengin, Eloi, Eloi lama sabachthani? ati. Hichu, ka Pathen, ka Pathen, ibola neidalhah hitam? tina ahi.
target: And at three in the afternoon Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?” (which means “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?” ).

source: Chule avela dingho lah-a abang bangin chutia ati chu ajauvin, Ngaijun, Elijah akouve, atiuvin ahi.
target: When some of those standing near heard this, they said, “Listen, he’s calling Elijah.”

source: Chuphatnin mi khat alhaijelin lengpitwi thuh-a twichop phon adelhopmin pengtenggol leh-a atah-in, agah donsah-in, Limsah hih-un; adomlha dinga Elijah hunga hung hih-am veohite, ati.
target: Someone ran, filled a sponge with wine vinegar, put it on a staff, and offered it to Jesus to drink. “Now leave him alone. Let’s see if Elijah comes to take him down,” he said.

source: Chuin Jesu chu hapenin apengin, alhagao alhatai.
target: With a loud cry, Jesus breathed his last.

source: Chuin houin'a pondal len chu achunga pat anoi geijin a-ehlha paijin keh ni akisotan ahi.
target: The curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.

source: Chuin Ama jona ding sepai jalamkai chun chutia apenna alhagao alha chu amutah-in, Hichepa hi Pathen Chapa tahbeh mong ahi, atitai.
target: And when the centurion, who stood there in front of Jesus, saw how he died, he said, “Surely this man was the Son of God!”

source: Chukoma chun galkanga pangin numei hon khatnin jong ave jingun ahi; alah uva chun Magdalene Mariam, Jacob neojo le Joses nu Mariam, chule Salome; hiteho cheng chu aumun ahi.
target: Some women were watching from a distance. Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James the younger and of Joseph, and Salome.

source: Amaho cheng chu Galilee gama aumlaija ajuija ama jenlea pangho chu ahiuve. Chule numei tamtah Jerusalem'a ahinlhon toupiho jong chu ahiuve.
target: In Galilee these women had followed him and cared for his needs. Many other women who had come up with him to Jerusalem were also there.

source: Nilhah ahi phatnin, kigot ni ahi jeh-in, hichu cholngahni masang ni ahin,
target: It was Preparation Day (that is, the day before the Sabbath). So as evening approached,

source: Arimathea kho-a mi Pathen lenggam ngah jinga um, vaipo ginle ja umtah Joseph chu ahungin, ngampelin Pilate henga achelutnin, Jesu long chu agathumtan ahi.
target: Joseph of Arimathea, a prominent member of the Council, who was himself waiting for the kingdom of God, went boldly to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body.

source: Pilate'in chutia athivah jeng chu adatmo lheh jengin; chuin aman sepai jalamkai chu akouvin, Athina sottam, tin adongin ahi.
target: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead. Summoning the centurion, he asked him if Jesus had already died.

source: Chuin sepai jalamkaija kona ahetchen phatnin, along chu Joseph apetai.
target: When he learned from the centurion that it was so, he gave the body to Joseph.

source: Chuin tupat ponnem ahin choijin, along chu alalhan, tupat ponnema chun atomin, song kilai lhan sunga chun alupsah-in, chujouvin lhan kotna chun song len khat atanglutnin ahi.
target: So Joseph bought some linen cloth, took down the body, wrapped it in the linen, and placed it in a tomb cut out of rock. Then he rolled a stone against the entrance of the tomb.

source: Chule Magdalene Mariam le Joses nu Mariam chun akoinau chu avejing lhonin ahi.
target: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph saw where he was laid.

source: Chuin cholngah ni kichai phatnin Magdalene Mariam, Jacob nu Mariam, chule Salome hicheng chun ahunguva thao anu theina dingun, thao namtui ahin choijun ahi.
target: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so that they might go to anoint Jesus’ body.

source: Chuin hapta ni masa ni jingpitah-in niso jou jouvin lhan lama chun ahunguvin ahi.
target: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they were on their way to the tomb

source: Chuin amahole amaho akihouvun, Lhankotna song chu kon eitahdoh peh taovinte? akitiuvin ahi.
target: and they asked each other, “Who will roll the stone away from the entrance of the tomb?”

source: Ahinla agah vetnule song chu tahdohsa anaum amutaove; asong chu lentah hija ahi.
target: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone, which was very large, had been rolled away.

source: Chuin lhan sunga alutnun ahile gollhang khat ponbangleh choltah kisila jetlam sanga tou amuvin; chuin amaho chu atija lheh jengun ahi.
target: As they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.

source: Ahivangin ama chun amaho jah-a, Tija hih-un; thingpel'a kithat Nazareth Jesu chu naholu ahi: ama athoudohtai; hikoma aumtapoi: alupna hi hung vetaovin.
target: “Don’t be alarmed,” he said. “You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him.

source: Amavang cheovinlang aseijuite le Peter jah-a gaseijun, Aman najah uva aseibangin Galilee gam lamah namasanguva achei; chukom chu nanghon Ama namu dingu ahi, ati.
target: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him, just as he told you.’ ”

source: Chutichun kidang satah-in akihot hot jengun; gangtah-in ahung potdoh-un, lhanphunga kon chun ajamtaove. Akichat jeh-un, koima jah-a aseipouvin ahi.
target: Trembling and bewildered, the women went out and fled from the tomb. They said nothing to anyone, because they were afraid. [The earliest manuscripts and some other ancient witnesses do not have verses 9–20.]

source: Chuin hapta ni masapen ni jingpi-a athodoh jou chun, Magdalene Mariam, asunga kona thilha sagi anodohnu henga chun akilah masapenin ahi.
target: When Jesus rose early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had driven seven demons.

source: Chuin amanu chun Jesu umpiji teho, ama thi jeh-a kapkaple kingaisese teho henga chun achen agaseijin ahi.
target: She went and told those who had been with him and who were mourning and weeping.

source: Ahin athoudoh-in, amanu chun amui ti ajah vanguvin atahsan pouvin ahi.
target: When they heard that Jesus was alive and that she had seen him, they did not believe it.

source: Chujouvin Aman alah uva mi ni gamlam jona achena lhona limchom beh-in akimusah-in ahi.
target: Afterward Jesus appeared in a different form to two of them while they were walking in the country.

source: Chuin amani ache lhonin seijui dangho agahil lhonle, amahonla amani sei jong chu anatahsan dehpouvin ahi.
target: These returned and reported it to the rest; but they did not believe them either.

source: Chuin chujou kitman ankong aum laitah-un, somlekhat ho hengtah-a akilah-in; athodoh kit nunga amuho thusei atahsan lou jeh-u chun, atahsan louvule alungtah-u chu asosalin ahi.
target: Later Jesus appeared to the Eleven as they were eating; he rebuked them for their lack of faith and their stubborn refusal to believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

source: Chuin Aman ajah uva, Nangho vannoi leiset gam jouse-a cheovinlang, thilsem namkim jah-a hiche Kipana Thupha hi gahil lhang leuvin.
target: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation.

source: Atahsana baptize chang chu sohcha ding ahi; atahsan lou vang chu themmo changa umding ahi.
target: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.

source: Chule atahsante chu melchihna hicheng hin ajuipeh dingu ahi; keima mina thilha anodoh dingu, paothah paothah-a pao dingu,
target: And these signs will accompany those who believe: In my name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues;

source: Gul akhutna adop dingu; thina thei ima donjong leu ima ti lou dingu; chule ana damlou chunga akhut angap diu, ana chu dam ding ahi, ati.
target: they will pick up snakes with their hands; and when they drink deadly poison, it will not hurt them at all; they will place their hands on sick people, and they will get well.”

source: Chuin Pakai Jesu'n ajah uva chucheng asei jouvin, van'ah lahtouvin aumin, Pathen jet lamah atoutai.
target: After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, he was taken up into heaven and he sat at the right hand of God.

source: Chuin amaho achedoh-un, muntin-ah ahillhang leuvin, anatohna chanuvah Pakaiyin akitho piuvin, chule melchihna-in ajuisah-in athu chu aphut detpeh-in ahi. Amen.
target: Then the disciples went out and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked with them and confirmed his word by the signs that accompanied it.

source: I-lah uva tahsan umtah-a guilhung hiche thilho chu adungjui tah-a sun dinga mi tahtah-in akhut apat tah banguvin,
target: Many have undertaken to draw up an account of the things that have been fulfilled among us,

source: Atil abula patna amit tah-a muho le athu seiphonga panghon eihil bangun,
target: just as they were handed down to us by those who from the first were eyewitnesses and servants of the word.

source: Michung nung Theophilus, ijakai abula patna chamkim keija hetna kaneito lhonin, nangma henga adungjui tah-a hin sutding pha kasan ahi;
target: With this in mind, since I myself have carefully investigated everything from the beginning, I too decided to write an orderly account for you, most excellent Theophilus,

source: Nangma nakihilsa thilho chengse chu adihtah ahi ti nahetna dingin.
target: so that you may know the certainty of the things you have been taught.

source: Judah gam lengpa Herod lal laijin, Abia loi lah-a thempu khat amin Zachariah kiti aumin; chule a-inneipi chu Aaron chilhah ahin, amin Elizabeth ahi.
target: In the time of Herod king of Judea there was a priest named Zechariah, who belonged to the priestly division of Abijah; his wife Elizabeth was also a descendant of Aaron.

source: Ani lhona Pathen mitmu-a chonphatah, themona neilou Pakai thupeh jousele chonna danthu jouse jui kimkeija ahi lhone.
target: Both of them were righteous in the sight of God, observing all the Lord’s commands and decrees blamelessly.

source: Hinlah Elizabeth chu achiin jeh-in cha aneilhon pon, chule ani lhonin hateh-in ateh gel lhontan ahi.
target: But they were childless because Elizabeth was not able to conceive, and they were both very old.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, aloite aban bana akilhah dungjuija Pathen anga thempu na atoh petnin,
target: Once when Zechariah’s division was on duty and he was serving as priest before God,

source: Thempu chonna ngaija Pakai houin'a alutchun thil namtui halding chu achang khatan ahi.
target: he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to go into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

source: Chule thil namtui ahal pet chun mipi chu polama ataovun ahi.
target: And when the time for the burning of incense came, all the assembled worshipers were praying outside.

source: Hiche pettah chun Pakai vantil khat ahengah ahung kilah in, thil namtui kihalna maicham jet lama chun ahung dingin ahi.
target: Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing at the right side of the altar of incense.

source: Zachariah'in ama chu amu phatnin, alungkhamin, chule ki jong akichan ahi.
target: When Zechariah saw him, he was startled and was gripped with fear.

source: Amavang vantil chun ama jah-a, Zachariah, kicha hih-in, nataona akisangtai; chule na-inneipi Elizabeth chun chapa khat ahin ding, chule nangman amin John nasah ding ahi.
target: But the angel said to him: “Do not be afraid, Zechariah; your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to call him John.

source: Chule nangma dingin thanopna le hapa kipana hintin, ama pena chu mi tamtah kipah ding ahi.
target: He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice because of his birth,

source: Ijeh-inem itile ama chu Pakai mitmu-a lentah hiding ahin, chule ama chun lengpiga twile ju adon louhel ding ahi; chule anu oisunga auma patna Lhagao Theng dimset ding ahi.
target: for he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He is never to take wine or other fermented drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even before he is born.

source: Chule aman Israel chate tamtah a-Pakai Pathen'u henga alehei ding ahi.
target: He will bring back many of the people of Israel to the Lord their God.

source: Chule kigosa dema umho chu Pakaiya dinga kigotsah dinga, apate lung achate lama heija, michonpha ho chihna thua nungloute chonsah dinga, aman Elijah lhagao le thahat akena ama masang sanga che ding ahi, ati.
target: And he will go on before the Lord, in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the parents to their children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous—to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.”

source: Chuin Zachariah'in vantil jah achun, Keila katehtan, kaji jongla atehtan, hiche thuhi iti kahet them thei dingham? tin adongin ahi.
target: Zechariah asked the angel, “How can I be sure of this? I am an old man and my wife is well along in years.”

source: Chuin vantil chun adonbutnin, Keima Pathen anga ding jing Gabriel chu kahi, nangma jah-a thusei dingle hiche thupha hi seipeh dinga hungkisol kahi.
target: The angel said to him, “I am Gabriel. I stand in the presence of God, and I have been sent to speak to you and to tell you this good news.

source: Chule ven, aphatcha guilhung ding kasei thu natahsan lou jeh-a, athu guilhun ni kahse-a thusei thei louva paomo-a naum ding ahi, ati.
target: And now you will be silent and not able to speak until the day this happens, because you did not believe my words, which will come true at their appointed time.”

source: Chule miho chun Zachariah chu angah-un, Pathen houin sunga aum sotden chu adatmo lheh jengun ahi.
target: Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah and wondering why he stayed so long in the temple.

source: Chuin ahungdoh phatnin ajah uva thu asei theitapon ahi; hichun amahon intheng sunga mu khat anei ahi ti ahetauve; ijeh inem itile amaho chu akhutnin ahoupi thon, paolouvin aumin ahi.
target: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They realized he had seen a vision in the temple, for he kept making signs to them but remained unable to speak.

source: Chuin athempu kin natohna nikho achai phatnin, a-in lama achetan ahi.
target: When his time of service was completed, he returned home.

source: Hiche jou chun a-inneipi Elizabeth agaitan, chule amanu lha nga akiselin,
target: After this his wife Elizabeth became pregnant and for five months remained in seclusion.

source: Aman mi lah-a mi i-sah lou kachan hi suhmangna dinga, Pakaiyin keima eivetna hitia hi eibol ahi, ati.
target: “The Lord has done this for me,” she said. “In these days he has shown his favor and taken away my disgrace among the people.”

source: Chuin alha gupna-in Pathen'a konin Gabriel vantil chu Galilee gama khopi khat Nazareth atiuva chun,
target: In the sixth month of Elizabeth’s pregnancy, God sent the angel Gabriel to Nazareth, a town in Galilee,

source: David son amin Joseph kitipa jihol nungah theng khat henga akisolin; nungah theng min chu Mariam ahi.
target: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man named Joseph, a descendant of David. The virgin’s name was Mary.

source: Chuin vantil chu amanu hengah alut-in, Chibai, sah chungnungnu, Pakaiyin naumpi; numei lah-a anunnoma nahi, ati.
target: The angel went to her and said, “Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you.”

source: Chuin amanun ama amuphatnin, alunggim lheh jengin, alungthimin, Itobang phatthei bohna ahitadem, atin ahi.
target: Mary was greatly troubled at his words and wondered what kind of greeting this might be.

source: Chuin vantil chun amanu jah-a, Kicha hih-in, Mariam, ijeh-inem itile Pathen lungdeilam nahi.
target: But the angel said to her, “Do not be afraid, Mary; you have found favor with God.

source: Chule ven, gaijin natin, chapa khat nahin ding, chule amin JESU nasah ding ahi.
target: You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to call him Jesus.

source: Ama chu hung len ding, chule Chungnung pen Chapa kiti ding ahi: chule Pakai Pathen'in ama chu apu David laltouna apeh ding ahi.
target: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,

source: Ama Jacob sonho chunga leng changa, atonsot atonsot geija vai apoh ding, agamin itihchan hijongle kichaitih anei lou ding ahi, ati.
target: and he will reign over Jacob’s descendants forever; his kingdom will never end.”

source: Chuin Mariam'in vantil jah-a chun, Hichu iti hi dingham, Pasal la kaneipon? ati.
target: “How will this be,” Mary asked the angel, “since I am a virgin?”

source: Chuin vantil chun adonbutnin, ajah-a, Lhagao Theng nachungah hung chuntin, chule Chungnung pen thilbol theinan nahin lekhu ding ahi: chule hiche jeh-a chu ahung peng ding athenga chu Pathen Chapa kiti ding ahi.
target: The angel answered, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. So the holy one to be born will be called the Son of God.

source: Chule, ven, nasopinu Elizabeth'in jong ateh nungin chapa khat avoptai; achinga aseinu-u chu agaijin, tun lha gup ahitai.
target: Even Elizabeth your relative is going to have a child in her old age, and she who was said to be unable to conceive is in her sixth month.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Pathen na dinga ahitheilou imacha umlou ding ahi, ati.
target: For no word from God will ever fail.”

source: Hichun Mariam'in, Ven, keima Pakai sohnu kahi, kachungah nasei bangbang chun lhunghen, ati. Chuphatnin vantil chu amanu koma konin achemang tan ahi.
target: “I am the Lord’s servant,” Mary answered. “May your word to me be fulfilled.” Then the angel left her.

source: Hiche jou chun Mariam akipatnin, thinglhang gama Juda khopi khatnah acheloitan ahi.
target: At that time Mary got ready and hurried to a town in the hill country of Judea,

source: Chuin Zachariah in'a alutnin, Elizabeth chibai aboh tan ahi.
target: where she entered Zechariah’s home and greeted Elizabeth.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Elizabet'in Mariam'in achibai boh ajah phatnin, a-oi sunga naocha chu ahung kichomin, chule Elizabeth amatah Lhagao Theng adimin;
target: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

source: Chule aw sangtah-in asamin, Numei lah-a nunnoma nahin, nalai gil ga jong nunnoma ahi.
target: In a loud voice she exclaimed: “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the child you will bear!

source: Chule ka pakai nu kahenga ahung hi, hoilam ipi thu hitam?
target: But why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

source: Ijeh-inem itile ven, nei chibai boh aw gin kanakhangin ajahjah-in, ka-oi sunga naocha athanomin ahung kichomin ahi.
target: As soon as the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy.

source: Chule atahsan nu chu anunnom ahi; ijeh inem itile Pakaiyin ajah-a thu asei chengse chu hung guilhun ding ahi, ati.
target: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord would fulfill his promises to her!”

source: Chuin Mariam'in, Kalungin Pakai achoi-anin,
target: And Mary said: “My soul glorifies the Lord

source: Chule kalhagao jong eihuh hinga Pathen'ah akipah-in ahi.
target: and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior,

source: Ijeh-inem itile aman asohnu dinmun nemcha hi akhohsah-in; Hijeh chun vetan, tu-a lhah-a akhang akhanga mi jousen anunnom eiti dingu ahi.
target: for he has been mindful of the humble state of his servant. From now on all generations will call me blessed,

source: Ijeh-inem itile Hatchung nungin keima thil loupitah eibol pehtan; Amin jong athenge.
target: for the Mighty One has done great things for me— holy is his name.

source: Chule Ama gingte chunga akhang akhangin Alungset aumpeh jinge.
target: His mercy extends to those who fear him, from generation to generation.

source: Aman abanin athahatje avetsahtan; Aman ama lungela kiletsah hoithoteho asuchehtai.
target: He has performed mighty deeds with his arm; he has scattered those who are proud in their inmost thoughts.

source: Aman ahat apaoho atouna mun uva kon in asonlhan, namchom chagate atungdohtai.
target: He has brought down rulers from their thrones but has lifted up the humble.

source: Agilkelteho thil phaphan avahvan, mihaote ho khut gohkeovin asolmangtai.
target: He has filled the hungry with good things but has sent the rich away empty.

source: Alungsetje chu ahetdoh jingnan, asoh Israel akithopin,
target: He has helped his servant Israel, remembering to be merciful

source: Tonsotna dingin Ipu ipateu Abraham, chule achilhahte henga athutep bang chun, ati.
target: to Abraham and his descendants forever, just as he promised our ancestors.”

source: Chuin Mariam amanu koma chun lha thum jen aumin, a-in lamah akiletan ahi.
target: Mary stayed with Elizabeth for about three months and then returned home.

source: Chuin Elizabeth aso phat ahung lhingtan ahile, chapa khat ahingin ahi.
target: When it was time for Elizabeth to have her baby, she gave birth to a son.

source: Chuin a-inhengho le a-inkoho chengsen Pakaiyin aha lungset behseh jeng chu ajah phatnun, amanu chu akipa athanop piuvin ahi.
target: Her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had shown her great mercy, and they shared her joy.

source: Chuin ani get nin naosen cheptan ding chun ahungun; amaho chun apa min bangin Zachariah sah dingin agouvin ahi.
target: On the eighth day they came to circumcise the child, and they were going to name him after his father Zechariah,

source: Ahin naosen nu chun, Ahipoi, naosen min hi John sah ding ahi, tin amaho jah-a aseijin ahi.
target: but his mother spoke up and said, “No! He is to be called John.”

source: Chuin amahon, Naphung lah uva koima min chutobang um louva, atiuvin ahi.
target: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who has that name.”

source: Chuphatnin amahon, Amin ipi nasah nom em tin mit heijin apa adongun ahi.
target: Then they made signs to his father, to find out what he would like to name the child.

source: Chuin aman lekhasutna pheng athumin, Amin John ahi, tin asuntan ahi. Hichun ami jouse chun adatmo lheh jengun ahi.
target: He asked for a writing tablet, and to everyone’s astonishment he wrote, “His name is John.”

source: Chuin chupettah chun akam akihongin, alei akilhamin, Pathen avahchoi tan ahi.
target: Immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue set free, and he began to speak, praising God.

source: Hichun akimvela cheng chengse chungah kichat achutan, chule Juda gam thinglhang jouse-ah hicheng thusoh thu chu akiseithang tan ahi.
target: All the neighbors were filled with awe, and throughout the hill country of Judea people were talking about all these things.

source: Chule aja jousen hichu alungin aching cheh-un, Hiche chapang hi ipi ahungsoh tadem! atiuvin ahi. Chule Pakai khutnin ama aumpin ahi.
target: Everyone who heard this wondered about it, asking, “What then is this child going to be?” For the Lord’s hand was with him.

source: Chule apa Zachariah chu Lhagao Theng adimsetnin, gaothu aseijin, hitin ahi;
target: His father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied:

source: Pakai Israel Pathen chu vahchoijin umhen; Ijeh-inem itile Aman amite avilin, alhatdoh tan,
target: “Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel, because he has come to his people and redeemed them.

source: Chule asoh David insung mite lah-a, Eiho dingin huhhingna ki khat eitun dohpeh taove;
target: He has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

source: Leiset kisemtila pat Aman athemgao thengho kama anasei bangin;
target: (as he said through his holy prophets of long ago),

source: Imelma teova konle, eihoteu khutna kona huhdoh-a i-um theina diuvin;
target: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us—

source: Iputeu ipateu henga anatep akhotona chu tohdohna dingle, akitepna theng chu geldoh nadingin;
target: to show mercy to our ancestors and to remember his holy covenant,

source: Ipuluiju Abraham jah-a akihahselna bangtah-in,
target: the oath he swore to our father Abraham:

source: Igalteu khutna kona huhdoh-a i-umuto lhona, kichalou hela ama kin iboluva,
target: to rescue us from the hand of our enemies, and to enable us to serve him without fear

source: Thengtah le chonphatah-a, Ihinlai sungseuva a-angsunga akin ibolna diuvin.
target: in holiness and righteousness before him all our days.

source: Chule nangma, naosen, chungnung pen themgao kiti ding nahi; ajeh chu alampi sem dinga nangma Pakai masang sanga che ding nahin;
target: And you, my child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go on before the Lord to prepare the way for him,

source: achonsetnao suhbeija auma kona, amite chu huhhingna hetna pedingin,
target: to give his people the knowledge of salvation through the forgiveness of their sins,

source: I-Pathen'u nemheuva mikhotona vangin, chungnunga kona nisa soh chun ihungvil taovin;
target: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the rising sun will come to us from heaven

source: Muthim le thina lima touho salvah dingle, Ikengu lungmonna lampia chesah dingin, ati.
target: to shine on those living in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the path of peace.”

source: Chuin chapang chu ahung seilenin, lhagaova hattah ahitan; chule Israelte henga akiphondoh ni gei chun gamthipmah aumin ahi.
target: And the child grew and became strong in spirit; and he lived in the wilderness until he appeared publicly to Israel.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, hiche nikholai chun Caesar Augustus'in leiset chunga cheng jouse min sut ding thu apen ahi.
target: In those days Caesar Augustus issued a decree that a census should be taken of the entire Roman world.

source: Hichu Syria gama Cyrenius gamvaipo ahilaija min kisutna amasapen ahi.
target: (This was the first census that took place while Quirinius was governor of Syria.)

source: Hichun mi jouse chu amin sun dingin ama ama khopi cheh-a acheuvin ahi.
target: And everyone went to their own town to register.

source: Chule Joseph jong chu David inko le aphung ahi jeh chun, Galilee gama Nazareth kho-a konin, Juda gama David khopi Bethlehem atiuva chun,
target: So Joseph also went up from the town of Nazareth in Galilee to Judea, to Bethlehem the town of David, because he belonged to the house and line of David.

source: Ajihol Mariam gaihamset chutoh amin sun dingin achetan ahi.
target: He went there to register with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him and was expecting a child.

source: Chuin amani chukoma aumpet lhonin, Mariam aso phat alhingtan ahi.
target: While they were there, the time came for the baby to be born,

source: Hichun achapa masapen ahingin; chuin ponin ajelin, jinlhun ina mun a-on lou jeh chun, gan ankong sunga alupsahtan ahi.
target: and she gave birth to her firstborn, a son. She wrapped him in cloths and placed him in a manger, because there was no guest room available for them.

source: Chule hiche gama chun lou jaova tol lhanga geh kelngoi chingho aumun, jan-in akelngoi honu angah-un ahi.
target: And there were shepherds living out in the fields nearby, keeping watch over their flocks at night.

source: Chuin, veuvin, Pakai vantil khat akomuvah ahung dingin, chule Pakai loupi chun akimvelu asalvah jengtan ahi: hichun amaho akichatangei jengun ahi.
target: An angel of the Lord appeared to them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

source: Chuin vantil chun ajah uva, Kicha hih-un, ijeh-inem itile, veuvin, keiman mijouse-a dinga hachangpa kipana thupha chu nangho kahin pohpeh nahiuve.
target: But the angel said to them, “Do not be afraid. I bring you good news that will cause great joy for all the people.

source: Ajeh chu tunin nangho dingin David khopi-ah Huhhing-a khat apengtai, ama chu Pakai Christa ahi.
target: Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; he is the Messiah, the Lord.

source: Chule hiche hi nangho dinga amelchihna ding ahi: Nanghon naosen pona kijela gan ankong sunga lum nagamu dingu ahi, ati.
target: This will be a sign to you: You will find a baby wrapped in cloths and lying in a manger.”

source: Chuin phulou helouvin vantil chutoh vanmi janel honpi ahung umun, Pathen avahchoijun,
target: Suddenly a great company of the heavenly host appeared with the angel, praising God and saying,

source: Chungnung pena Pathen loupi hen, chule leichunga miholah-a chamna le alunglhaina umhen, atiuvin ahi.
target: “Glory to God in the highest heaven, and on earth peace to those on whom his favor rests.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, vantil ho chu amaho koma kona van'a achemang phatnun, kelngoi chingho chun, Cheovin, Bethlehem'a cheohitin, tu-a Pakaiyin eihetsah-u thusoh hi gaveo hite, akitiuvin ahi.
target: When the angels had left them and gone into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has told us about.”

source: Chuin amaho acheloijun ahile, Mariam le Joseph toh gan ankong sunga lum naosen chu agamudoh taovin ahi.
target: So they hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and the baby, who was lying in the manger.

source: Chuin hichu amu phatnun, hiche naosen thudol ajah uva kisei chu ahetsah sonle taovin ahi.
target: When they had seen him, they spread the word concerning what had been told them about this child,

source: Chuin ajah uva kelngoi chingho thusei chu ajapha jousen kidang asauvin ahi.
target: and all who heard it were amazed at what the shepherds said to them.

source: Mariam vang chun thu kisei jouse chu alungin angaiton, aching jingin ahi.
target: But Mary treasured up all these things and pondered them in her heart.

source: Chuin kelngoi chingho chun ajah uva kisei bang banga thil amu chengseu le athil jah chengseu jal chun, Pathen choi-at le vahchoi tothon akiletaove.
target: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things they had heard and seen, which were just as they had been told.

source: Chuin ani get nin cheptan ding nikho alhingtan, amin Jesu asahtaove, hichu naobu-a aum masanga vantil chun asahsa ahi.
target: On the eighth day, when it was time to circumcise the child, he was named Jesus, the name the angel had given him before he was conceived.

source: Chuin Mosi thupeh dungjuija akisuhtheng nikho alhin phatnin, ama chu Pakai henga peh dingin Jerusalem'a ahin puijun,
target: When the time came for the purification rites required by the Law of Moses, Joseph and Mary took him to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord

source: (Pakai danthu bu-a, Naobu phukeh-a hung pengdoh pasal jouse chu, Pakaiya dinga atheng kiti ding ahi; ati banga chu;)
target: (as it is written in the Law of the Lord, “Every firstborn male is to be consecrated to the Lord”),

source: Chule Pakai danthua, vakhu kop khat hijongle vapal nou ni hijongle tia kisei bangin, ganlhaina toh dingin ahungun ahi.
target: and to offer a sacrifice in keeping with what is said in the Law of the Lord: “a pair of doves or two young pigeons.”

source: Chuin, veuvin, Jerusalem'a chun amin Simeon kiti mi khat aumin; amapa chu chonpha tahle Pathen ngaisahtah, Israelte lungmon nading chu ngah jinga ahin; achunga Lhagao Theng uma ahi.
target: Now there was a man in Jerusalem called Simeon, who was righteous and devout. He was waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

source: Chule Pakai thaonu Christa chu amu masanga ama athi lou ding chu, Lhagao Thengin ahetsah-a aphondoh ahi.
target: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he would not die before he had seen the Lord’s Messiah.

source: Chuin ama chun Lhagao puijin houin sunga chun ahung lutnin; chuin achung changa chonna dan ngaija bol dinga anule apan naosen Jesu chu apui phatnun,
target: Moved by the Spirit, he went into the temple courts. When the parents brought in the child Jesus to do for him what the custom of the Law required,

source: Amapan naosen chu akhutnin alan, chule Pathen avahchoijin,
target: Simeon took him in his arms and praised God, saying:

source: Pakai, tun nangma thu dungjuija Nasoh hi lungmonga neilhahdoh ahi.
target: “Sovereign Lord, as you have promised, you may now dismiss your servant in peace.

source: Ijeh-inem itile nami huhhingna kamit nin amutai,
target: For my eyes have seen your salvation,

source: Miho jouse mitmu-a Nangman nagot
target: which you have prepared in the sight of all nations:

source: Chidang namdangte henga vah kilangdoh dingle, Nami Israelte loupina ding chu, ati.
target: a light for revelation to the Gentiles, and the glory of your people Israel.”

source: Chuin naosen umchan ding thudol kisei chu anu le Joseph'in kidang asa lheh lhonin ahi.
target: The child’s father and mother marveled at what was said about him.

source: Chuin Simeon chun phatthei achunguva aboh-in, anu Mariam jah-a, Ven, hiche chapang hi Israelte lah-a mi tamtah lhuhna le dindohna hung hiding, chule seiset kihetna melchih na-a kitung ahi.
target: Then Simeon blessed them and said to Mary, his mother: “This child is destined to cause the falling and rising of many in Israel, and to be a sign that will be spoken against,

source: Henge, mi tamtah lunggel kiphon dohna dinga, nangma lung jong chemjamin asutpai ding ahi, ati.
target: so that the thoughts of many hearts will be revealed. And a sword will pierce your own soul too.”

source: Chule Asher phung mi Phanuel chanu Hanna kiti themgao numei khat aumin, amanu chu hatah-a teh ahitan, anungah jineija patna ajitoh kum sagi chengkhom ahin,
target: There was also a prophet, Anna, the daughter of Penuel, of the tribe of Asher. She was very old; she had lived with her husband seven years after her marriage,

source: Chule amanu chu kum somget le kumli geija meithaija uma ahin, amanu chu houin'a kona potdoh louhela, an ngol le taona puma Pathen houva asun ajana um ahi.
target: and then was a widow until she was eighty-four. She never left the temple but worshiped night and day, fasting and praying.

source: Chuin hiche nidan tah chun ahungin Pathen athangvah-in, Jerusalem lhatdoh ding kat jinga umteho jouse jah-a chun Jesu umchan thu aseijin ahi.
target: Coming up to them at that very moment, she gave thanks to God and spoke about the child to all who were looking forward to the redemption of Jerusalem.

source: Chuin Pakai danthu dungjuija thil abol chaisoh phatnun, Galilee gama akhopiu Nazareth kho-a akilekit taovin ahi.
target: When Joseph and Mary had done everything required by the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee to their own town of Nazareth.

source: Chuin chapang chu akhangin, chule lhagaovin ahatdoh-in, chihna adimset tan; chule Pathen lungsetna achunga aumtan ahi.
target: And the child grew and became strong; he was filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was on him.

source: Chuin anule apa chu kumseh-in kalchuh kut tengle Jerusalem'a acheji lhonin ahi.
target: Every year Jesus’ parents went to Jerusalem for the Festival of the Passover.

source: Chuin ama kum somle kum ni ahi-in, kalchuh kut chonna ngaijin Jerusalem'a achetouvun;
target: When he was twelve years old, they went up to the festival, according to the custom.

source: Chuin kut achaijuva akile kit phatnun chapang Jesu anunguvah Jerusalem'ah aumdentan; chule hichu anule Joseph'in ahelhon hih-in;
target: After the festival was over, while his parents were returning home, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem, but they were unaware of it.

source: Mihon lah-a chu uma ahi tin angaito lhonin, ni khat lam achetauvin; chuin amanin a-inkoteho le akihetpiho lah ahol lhonin ahi.
target: Thinking he was in their company, they traveled on for a day. Then they began looking for him among their relatives and friends.

source: Chuin amudoh lhonlou phatnin, Jerusalem lamah akile kit lhonin, aholpeh lhontan ahi.
target: When they did not find him, they went back to Jerusalem to look for him.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, ni thum jouvin ama chu houin sungah agamudoh lhonin, houhil ho lah-a anatouvin, thu anangaijin dong jong ana dongin;
target: After three days they found him in the temple courts, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.

source: Chule athu jachan chun ahetjele athu donbut chu kidang asa lheh jengun ahi.
target: Everyone who heard him was amazed at his understanding and his answers.

source: Chuin amu phat lhonin alungdongleu lhonin; chuin anun ajah-a, Chapa, ibola neihiti bol lhonham? Vetan napale keiman lungdong tah-in kahol lhone, ati.
target: When his parents saw him, they were astonished. His mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us like this? Your father and I have been anxiously searching for you.”

source: Chuin aman amani jah-a, Ibola neihol lhonham? Keima ka-Pa in'a akin bola umding mong kahi helhon lou nahim? ati.
target: “Why were you searching for me?” he asked. “Didn’t you know I had to be in my Father’s house?”

source: Ahin ajah uva athusei chu amahon ipi kiseina ham ahepouvin ahi.
target: But they did not understand what he was saying to them.

source: Chuin amanitoh alhonin, Nazareth kho-ah achesuh-un; athu thu lhonin anungin; chule anun hicheng thu kisei jouse chu alungin achingtan ahi.
target: Then he went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. But his mother treasured all these things in her heart.

source: Chuin Jesu chihna le tahsa-a akhangtou touvin; chule Pathen le mihem deisah-in aumtan ahi.
target: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.

source: Chuin Tiberius Caesar lengchan kal kum somle ngana-in, Pontius Pilate Juda gamvaipo ahia, chule Herod Galilee gam vaipo ahia, asopipa Philip Ituria le Trachonitis gamkai vaipo ahia, chule Lysanias Abilene gam vaipo ahi lai,
target: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar—when Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, Herod tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and Traconitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene—

source: Anna le Caiaphas thempulen ahilhon laijin, Pathen thu chu gamthipma Zachariah chapa John hengah ahung lhungtan ahi.
target: during the high-priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the wilderness.

source: Chuin ama chu Jordan luipang jui kimvela gam jouse-a ahungin, chonset suhbeina dinga lungheija baptize chan thu alhangsam len;
target: He went into all the country around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.

source: Isaiah themgao lekhabua kisunbang chun, Gamthipma khosam aw khatnin, Pakai lamlen semtohsan koijun, alampi semjangun.
target: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.

source: Damkom chengse kidip chama, molsang jousele lhang jouse kisunem ding; chule lamkon chu kisujanga, aphon nachu kisunam ding;
target: Every valley shall be filled in, every mountain and hill made low. The crooked roads shall become straight, the rough ways smooth.

source: Chule mi jousen Pathen mi huhhingna amu ding ahi.
target: And all people will see God’s salvation.’ ”

source: Hiti chun aman, ama khutna baptize chang dinga ahenga hunga mihonpi jah-a chun, Vo gulse sonho, khonunga lunghan hung lhung dinga kona jam ding lungthim koiham napeuvah?
target: John said to the crowds coming out to be baptized by him, “You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?

source: Hiche jeh chun lungheitoh kilomin gadoh-un; chule nalah uva, Abraham kapu luiju aumnai titahih-un; ijeh-inem itile kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathen'in hiche songho-a kona hi Abraham son asodoh sah thei ahi.
target: Produce fruit in keeping with repentance. And do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.

source: Chule tu jeng jongin thing bultinah heicha kikoija ahitai; chutiachu thingphung aga phalou chengse chu kiphuh lhu-a, meija kisep lutji ahi, ati.
target: The ax is already at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.”

source: Chuin mihonpi chun, Achutile keihon ipi kabol dinguham? tin ama adongui.
target: “What should we do then?” the crowd asked.

source: Chuin aman adonbutnin, amaho jah-a, Sangkhol ni neijan anei louva chu kihoppi hen; chule anneh neijan jong chutima chun bolhen, ati.
target: John answered, “Anyone who has two shirts should share with the one who has none, and anyone who has food should do the same.”

source: Chuin kaidongho jong chu baptize chang dingin ahenga ahungun ajah-a, Mihil, keihonla ipi kabol dinguham? atiuve.
target: Even tax collectors came to be baptized. “Teacher,” they asked, “what should we do?”

source: Aman amaho jah-a, Nanghon nakiteppeh kalvalun mi-a lahbe hih-un, ati.
target: “Don’t collect any more than you are required to,” he told them.

source: Sepaiho injong adongun, Keihon jong ipi kabol dinguham? atiuvin. Aman amaho jah-a, Alam louvin koimacha acham louvin lahpeh hih-un; jouvin jong mi heh hih-un; chule nalo jat jat uvah lung lhaijun.
target: Then some soldiers asked him, “And what should we do?” He replied, “Don’t extort money and don’t accuse people falsely—be content with your pay.”

source: Chuin mihon agaldot jingu ahito lhona, Hiche John hi Christa ahi khat tadem, tia lungthima angaito laitah-un,
target: The people were waiting expectantly and were all wondering in their hearts if John might possibly be the Messiah.

source: John'in adonbutnin, abonchauva jah-a, Keima vangin twija baptize kachansah nahiuve; ahivangin keima sanga hat chungnungjo ahunge, keima akeng chot khao sutlham dinga jong kilom kahipoi; amatah chun nangho Lhagao Thenga le meija baptize nachansah dingu ahi.
target: John answered them all, “I baptize you with water. But one who is more powerful than I will come, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.

source: Aman akhutna godal akichoijin, aphol ajapngim sela, chule achang pang sunga akhum ding; asi vang chu mit theilou meija agovam ding ahi, ati.
target: His winnowing fork is in his hand to clear his threshing floor and to gather the wheat into his barn, but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

source: Hiti chun aman tilkhouna thudang tamtah aseijin, amaho jah-a chun Kipana Thupha ahil lhanglen ahi.
target: And with many other words John exhorted the people and proclaimed the good news to them.

source: Ahin John'in Herod lengpa chu asopipa Philip inneipi Herodia jal leh athilbol phalouho jala apho jeh-in,
target: But when John rebuked Herod the tetrarch because of his marriage to Herodias, his brother’s wife, and all the other evil things he had done,

source: John chu songkul'a akhumin, chonset chunga chonset abolbetai.
target: Herod added this to them all: He locked John up in prison.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, miho jouse baptize achanuva, Jesu jong baptize achan jouvin, ataovin ahile van akihongin,
target: When all the people were being baptized, Jesus was baptized too. And as he was praying, heaven was opened

source: Chule Lhagao Theng tahsa vouvin vakhu bangin ahung kumlhan achunga achun, chule van'a konin aw ahung gingin, Nangma ka-Chapa deitah nahi; nachungah kalung alhai tangeije, ati.
target: and the Holy Spirit descended on him in bodily form like a dove. And a voice came from heaven: “You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased.”

source: Jesu amihil kipat chun ama kum somthum vel alhingin, mi ngaiton ama chu Joseph chapa ahin, Joseph chu Heli chapa ahin,
target: Now Jesus himself was about thirty years old when he began his ministry. He was the son, so it was thought, of Joseph, the son of Heli,

source: Heli chu Matthat chapa ahin, Matthat chu Levi chapa ahin, Levi chu Melchi chapa ahin, Melchi chu Janna chapa ahin, Janna chu Joseph chapa ahin,
target: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melki, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

source: Joseph chu Mattathias chapa ahin, Mattathias chu Amos chapa ahin, Amos chu Nahum chapa ahin, Nahum chu Esli chapa ahin, Esli chu Nagge chapa ahin,
target: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

source: Nagge chu Maath chapa ahin, Maath chu Mattathias chapa ahin, Mattathia chu Semei chapa ahin, Semei chu Joseph chapa ahin, Joseph chu Juda chapa ahin,
target: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Josek, the son of Joda,

source: Juda chu Joanna chapa ahin, Joanna chu Rhesa chapa ahin, Rhesa chu Zerubbabel chapa ahin, Zerubbabel chu Shealtiel chapa ahin, Shealtiel chu Neri chapa ahin,
target: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

source: Neri chu Melchi chapa ahin, Melchi chu Addi chapa ahin, Addi chu Cosam chapa ahin, Cosam chu Elmodam chapa ahin, Elmodam chu Er chapa ahin,
target: the son of Melki, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmadam, the son of Er,

source: Er chu Jose chapa ahin, Jose chu Eleazer chapa ahin, Eleazer chu Jorim chapa ahin, Jorim chu Matthat chapa ahin, Matthat chu Levi chapa ahin,
target: the son of Joshua, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

source: Levi chu Simeon chapa ahin, Simeon chu Juda chapa ahin, Juda chu Joseph chapa ahin, Joseph chu Jonam chapa ahin, Jonam chu Eliakim chapa ahin,
target: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonam, the son of Eliakim,

source: Eliakim chu Melea chapa ahin, Melea chu Mennan chapa ahin, Mennan chu Mattatha chapa ahin, Mattatha chu Nathan chapa ahin, Nathan chu David chapa ahin,
target: the son of Melea, the son of Menna, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

source: David chu Jesse chapa ahin, Jesse chu Obed chapa ahin, Obed chu Boaz chapa ahin, Boaz chun Salmon chapa ahin, Salmon chu Nahson chapa ahin,
target: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

source: Nahson chu Aminadab chapa ahin, Aminadab chu Aram chapa ahin, Aram chu Hezron chapa ahin, Hezron chu Peres chapa ahin, Peres chu Judah chapa ahin,
target: the son of Amminadab, the son of Ram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

source: Judah chu Jacob chapa ahin, Jacob chu Isaac chapa ahin, Isaac chu Abraham chapa ahin, Abraham chu Terah chapa ahin, Terah chun Nahor chapa ahin,
target: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

source: Nahor chun Seruch chapa ahin, Seruch chu Reu chapa ahin, Reu chu Peleg chapa ahin, Peleg chun Eber chapa ahin, Eber chu Shelah chapa ahin,
target: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

source: Shela chu Cainan chapa ahin, Cainan chu Arphaxad chapa ahin, Arphaxad chu Shem chapa ahin, Shem chu Noah chapa ahin, Noah chu Lamech chapa ahin,
target: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

source: Lamech chu Mathusala chapa ahin, Mathusala chu Enoch chapa ahin, Enoch chu Jared chapa ahin, Jared chu Mahalalel chapa ahin, Mahalalel chu Cainan chapa ahin,
target: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalalel, the son of Kenan,

source: Cainan chu Enos chapa ahin, Enos chu Seth chapa ahin, Seth chu Adam chapa ahin, Adam chu Pathen chapa ahi.
target: the son of Enosh, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

source: Chuin Jesu Lhagao Theng dimsetnin Jordan'a konin akilen, chule Lhagaovin gamthipmah apuijin,
target: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, left the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,

source: Nisomli diabol lhep patepmin aumin ahi. Chule hiche phat sunga chu imacha ne lou ahin; chule chuche alhin phatnin agil akeltan ahi.
target: where for forty days he was tempted by the devil. He ate nothing during those days, and at the end of them he was hungry.

source: Hichun diabol'in ajah-a, Nangma Pathen Chapa nahile, hiche song hi changlhah asona dingin thu pen, ati.
target: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah-a, hitin akisune, mihem changlhah jenga hing louding ahi, Pathen thu chengsea joh hingding ahi, ati.
target: Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone.’”

source: Chuin diabol'in molsang tah chunga apuitouvin, mitphet kah louvin vannoi leiset gam jouse avetsahtan ahi.
target: The devil led him up to a high place and showed him in an instant all the kingdoms of the world.

source: Chuin diabol chun ajah-a, hicheng jouse chunga thuneina le aloupina nangma penge; ijeh-inem itile keima eikipedoh-a ahitan; kapeh nomnom kapeh ahi.
target: And he said to him, “I will give you all their authority and splendor; it has been given to me, and I can give it to anyone I want to.

source: Hijeh chun neihouva ahile aboncha nanga hi ding ahi, ati.
target: If you worship me, it will all be yours.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah-a, kanunglama chen, Satan: ijeh-inem itile, hitin akisune, nangman napakai, na-Pathen chu houvinlang ama jengbou jennin, ati.
target: Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve him only.’”
