source: Chuin Jerusalem'a apuijin chule houin tingvuma adinsah-in; chuin ajah-a, Pathen Chapa nahile, hichea konhin nangma kichomlha jengin.
target: The devil led him to Jerusalem and had him stand on the highest point of the temple. “If you are the Son of God,” he said, “throw yourself down from here.

source: Ijeh-inem itile, Aman nangma chungchanga avantilho nachang dingin thu pentin,
target: For it is written: “ ‘He will command his angels concerning you to guard you carefully;

source: Chule amahon akhutnuva nadop dingu ahi, achutiloule songah nakeng kisuh khah-in nate, tin akisune ati.
target: they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.’”

source: Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah-a, Nangman Pakai na-Pathen chu lhem patep hih-in, tin akiseije, ati.
target: Jesus answered, “It is said: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”

source: Chuin diabol'in alhep patepna chengse achaisoh phatnin, chomkhat dingin ama chu adalhatan ahi.
target: When the devil had finished all this tempting, he left him until an opportune time.

source: Chuin Jesu Lhagao thahatnin Galilee'a akilekit tan; hichun akimvel gamtina chun athu akithangtan ahi.
target: Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and news about him spread through the whole countryside.

source: Chuin akikhopnao in tinah ahillen, mi jouse pachat-in aumtan ahi.
target: He was teaching in their synagogues, and everyone praised him.

source: Chuin aseilet dohna Nazareth kho-a ahungin; chuin achon ngaibangin cholngah nin kikhopna in'ah alutnin, sim dingin adingtan ahi.
target: He went to Nazareth, where he had been brought up, and on the Sabbath day he went into the synagogue, as was his custom. He stood up to read,

source: Chuin Isaiah themgao lekhabu apeuvin ahi. Chuin aman lekhabu chu aphongin ahile, hitia kisun laitah amudoh-in ahi:
target: and the scroll of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. Unrolling it, he found the place where it is written:

source: Pakai Lhagao chu kachunga aume, ajehchu aman keima mivaichaho jah-a kipana Thupha hillhang ding, alung naho damsah ding, sohchangho jah-a lhadohna thu phongdoh ding, mitcho ho khomusah dinga, suhnemna umho lhadoh dinga,
target: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent me to proclaim freedom for the prisoners and recovery of sight for the blind, to set the oppressed free,

source: Pakai lahthei kum seiphong dinga, thao einu ahi.
target: to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor.”

source: Chuin aman lekhabu chu akhupmin, lhachale khutna ape kitnin, atoutan ahi. Hichun kikhopna in'a mi jousen ama jeng amit lhuh chehtauvin ahi.
target: Then he rolled up the scroll, gave it back to the attendant and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fastened on him.

source: Chuin ajah uva, Hiche Pathen lekhabu thuhi tuni hin nanakhang sunguvah aguilhung tai, tin asei pantan ahi.
target: He began by saying to them, “Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.”

source: Hichun abonchauvin ama chu aseiphaovin, chule akam sunga soh lungsetna thu chu kidang asa lheh jengun; Hiche hi Joseph chapa hilouham? atiuvin ahi.
target: All spoke well of him and were amazed at the gracious words that came from his lips. “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?” they asked.

source: Chuin aman amaho jah-a, Nanghon, Louthem nangma kiboldamin: Capernaum'a nathilbol kajah chengseu chu hikomah nangma gama jong hin bolin, ti thuchih hi kajah-a nasei tei dingu hina hi, ati.
target: Jesus said to them, “Surely you will quote this proverb to me: ‘Physician, heal yourself!’ And you will tell me, ‘Do here in your hometown what we have heard that you did in Capernaum.’ ”

source: Chuin aman aseikitnin, Tahbeh-a najah uva kasei ahi, Themgao koima ama gam sungah min ajop ngaipoi.
target: “Truly I tell you,” he continued, “no prophet is accepted in his hometown.

source: Ahivangin tahbeh-a najah uva kasei ahi, Elijah nikho laija van akikha-a, kum thumle lha gup gam jouse-a kel alhah chun, Israel lah-a meithai tamtah aumin ahi;
target: I assure you that there were many widows in Israel in Elijah’s time, when the sky was shut for three and a half years and there was a severe famine throughout the land.

source: Ahin adang koima henga Elijah kisol louvin, Sidon gama Zerapath kho-a meithainu henga akisol bouvin ahi.
target: Yet Elijah was not sent to any of them, but to a widow in Zarephath in the region of Sidon.

source: Chule Elisha'n themgao phatlai chun, Israel lah-a aphah tamtah aum nan; ahinla Syria mi Naaman tilou, adang koima kiboldamtheng aumpoi, ati.
target: And there were many in Israel with leprosy in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed—only Naaman the Syrian.”

source: Chuin amahon thu chucheng ajah phatnun, kikhopna in sunga mi jouse chu alunghang behseh jengun,
target: All the people in the synagogue were furious when they heard this.

source: Akipat doh-un, khosunga kon chun asondoh-un, abungbua sotlhah dingin akho chennao koldeh lama chun apuitaovin ahi.
target: They got up, drove him out of the town, and took him to the brow of the hill on which the town was built, in order to throw him off the cliff.

source: Ahivangin akah uva akihehdoh-in achemang tan ahi.
target: But he walked right through the crowd and went on his way.

source: Chuin ama Galilee gama khopi khat Capernaum'a achesuh-in, chule cholngah nin miho ahiltan ahi.
target: Then he went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and on the Sabbath he taught the people.

source: Chule thunei tah-a thu asei jeh chun, athuhil chu kidang asa lheh jengun ahi.
target: They were amazed at his teaching, because his words had authority.

source: Chuin kikhopna in'a chun lhagao boh vop mikhat aumin; chuin ama chun aw sangtah-in asamin,
target: In the synagogue there was a man possessed by a demon, an impure spirit. He cried out at the top of his voice,

source: Neidalhao vin! Vo Nazareth Jesu, nangle keiho ikimatnao i-um em? Eisumang uva hunga nahim? Nangma koi nahi kahenai; Pathen Mitheng chu nahi, ati.
target: “Go away! What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God!”

source: Chuin Jesu'n ama chu aphoh-in, Thipmin, ama-a kon chun hung doh-in, ati. Chuin thilha chun ama chu alaijuvah ahehlhun, suna louvin asunga konin ahung potdoh tan ahi.
target: “Be quiet!” Jesus said sternly. “Come out of him!” Then the demon threw the man down before them all and came out without injuring him.

source: Hichun abonchauvin kidang asa lheh jengun, amahole amaho akihouvun, hiche hi ipi thuham? Ijeh-inem itile thuneitah le thahat tah-a lhagao bohho thu apehle, amaho ahung potdoh jenguve, atiuvin ahi.
target: All the people were amazed and said to each other, “What words these are! With authority and power he gives orders to impure spirits and they come out!”

source: Chuin chuche vel gama khotinah athu athangtan ahi.
target: And the news about him spread throughout the surrounding area.

source: Chuin akipatnin, kikhopna ina kon chun apotnin, Simon in'a aluttai. Chuin Simon nupanu chu hatah-a khosih-a na ahin; amanu ding chun athumpeh taovin ahi.
target: Jesus left the synagogue and went to the home of Simon. Now Simon’s mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever, and they asked Jesus to help her.

source: Chuin ama akomah adingin, akhosih chu aphoh-in ahile, alhatan ahi. Chuin amanu athoudoh paijenin, amaho jenlen apangtan ahi.
target: So he bent over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. She got up at once and began to wait on them.

source: Chuin nisalhum konin, hivei chomchom veija ana damlou neiho chun amaho chu akoma ahin puijun; chule aman achung cheh uva akhut angamin, aboldam gamtan ahi.
target: At sunset, the people brought to Jesus all who had various kinds of sickness, and laying his hands on each one, he healed them.

source: Chule thilhaho jong chu mi tamtah-a konin apotdoh-un, Nangma Pathen Chapa Christa nahi, tin asamun ahi. Chuin aman amaho chu aphoh thipmin, amahon ama Christa ahi chu ahet jeh-un, thu aseisah tapon ahi.
target: Moreover, demons came out of many people, shouting, “You are the Son of God!” But he rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew he was the Messiah.

source: Chuin kho avah, phatnin apotdoh-in gamthip munah achetan; chule mipi chun aholun, ahenga chun ahungun, amaho adalhah louna dingin alho taovin ahi.
target: At daybreak, Jesus went out to a solitary place. The people were looking for him and when they came to where he was, they tried to keep him from leaving them.

source: Ahivangin aman amaho jah-a, Keiman kho dang danga jong Pathen lenggam Kipana Thupha kahil lhangle ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile hiche dinga chu hinkisol kahi, ati.
target: But he said, “I must proclaim the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns also, because that is why I was sent.”

source: Hichun Galilee gama kikhopna in tinah thu ahilhanglen ahi.
target: And he kept on preaching in the synagogues of Judea.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, mipin Pathen thu ngaidinga aneh chinto jeh-un, ama Genesaret dillen panga adingin ahi.
target: One day as Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret, the people were crowding around him and listening to the word of God.

source: Hichun aman dillen vaokama chun kong ni amun; ahivangin nga manho chu anapotdoh uva, alennu anasopmu ahi.
target: He saw at the water’s edge two boats, left there by the fishermen, who were washing their nets.

source: Chuin ama Simon kong joh-a chun alutnin, kong chu vaokama kona themkhat atollut din asolin, chuin atouvin, kong'a chun apangin mipi chu thu ahiltan ahi.
target: He got into one of the boats, the one belonging to Simon, and asked him to put out a little from shore. Then he sat down and taught the people from the boat.

source: Chuin athusei angah phatnin Simon jah-a, lithuhlam jonin, nga man dingin nalen seplhan, ati.
target: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into deep water, and let down the nets for a catch.”

source: Chuin Simon'in adonbutnin, Pipu, jan khovah keijin kabolun, imacha man louhel kahiuve; ahivangin nangma thusah-in len gahsep lhange, ati.
target: Simon answered, “Master, we’ve worked hard all night and haven’t caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets.”

source: Chuin chutia abol phat chun, nga atama tam akhukha taovin; alennu chu akeh jengin ahi.
target: When they had done so, they caught such a large number of fish that their nets began to break.

source: Chuin amahon kong choma um akikoppiho chu hunga ahung hu dingun agahjap taovin ahi. Chuin ahungun akong nin asung dimun ahile alhalut dehdeh jengin ahi.
target: So they signaled their partners in the other boat to come and help them, and they came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.

source: Ahin Simon Peter'in hichu amun, Jesu khophang bula aboh khupmin, Vo Pakai, kakoma konin chedoh-in; ijeh-inem itile keima mi chonse kahi, ati.
target: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees and said, “Go away from me, Lord; I am a sinful man!”

source: Hiche anga matnu chu amale aloiten kidang asah behseh jeh-u ahi;
target: For he and all his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken,

source: Chule Simon kikoppi Zebedai chapate ni Jacob le John jong chun kidang asa lhonin ahi. Chuin Jesu'n Simon jah-a, Kicha hih-in; tua pat mihem mana napan ding ahitai, ati.
target: and so were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, Simon’s partners. Then Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid; from now on you will fish for people.”

source: Chuin amahon akongu vaokama ahintoldoh phatnun, abonchan adalhauvin anung ajuitaovin ahi.
target: So they pulled their boats up on shore, left everything and followed him.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, ama khopi khatna aumpetnin, veuvin, mi khat apumchanga phah aumin; chuin Jesu amu phatnin tolla aboh khupmin, Pakai, nalung ahile neidam thengsah thei ahi, tin ataotan ahi.
target: While Jesus was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell with his face to the ground and begged him, “Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean.”

source: Chuin aman akhut alhangin, athamin, Kalung ahi, damthengtan, ati. Chupettah chun aphah chu apha paihel jengtan ahi.
target: Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” he said. “Be clean!” And immediately the leprosy left him.

source: Chuin aman koima jah-a asei louna dingin akhamchah-in, Chenlang thempu gakimusah-in, chule nakibol damtheng thu dol chu amaho hettohsahnan, Mosi thupeh dungjuijin thilpeh ding dol chu gapetan, ati.
target: Then Jesus ordered him, “Don’t tell anyone, but go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”

source: Achuti jeng vangin ama thu dol akithang chehjengin; mipi atama tam athu ngai dingle anat kiboldam dingin ahung kikhomun ahi.
target: Yet the news about him spread all the more, so that crowds of people came to hear him and to be healed of their sicknesses.

source: Ahin ama chang gamthip muntin-ah achomin achedoh-in, agataovin ahi.
target: But Jesus often withdrew to lonely places and prayed.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, hichelai chun nikhat thu ahil petnin, Galilee gama khoho le Juda gama khoho-a kon, chule Jerusalem'a kona hung Pharisai ho le danthu hilteho chu akoma atouvun ahi; chule mi boldam dingin Pakai thilboltheina chun ama aumpi ahi.
target: One day Jesus was teaching, and Pharisees and teachers of the law were sitting there. They had come from every village of Galilee and from Judea and Jerusalem. And the power of the Lord was with Jesus to heal the sick.

source: Chuin veuvin, mihon mi langthi khat ajalkhun pumin ahinpuvin; amahon ama chu put lutna, a-anga koi dingin agouvin ahi.
target: Some men came carrying a paralyzed man on a mat and tried to take him into the house to lay him before Jesus.

source: Chuin mipi jeh-a aput lutna ding kom amu lou phatnun, in chunga akaldoh-un, in chungkhu chehpheng vangkah-a chun alupna pumin alailunguva Jesu ang sungah agah khailhauvin ahi.
target: When they could not find a way to do this because of the crowd, they went up on the roof and lowered him on his mat through the tiles into the middle of the crowd, right in front of Jesus.

source: Chuin atahsanjeu chu amun, aman, Mipa nachonset naho kingaidam nahitai, ati.
target: When Jesus saw their faith, he said, “Friend, your sins are forgiven.”

source: Chuin danthu sunhole Pharisai hon, Taitomna thuseipa hi hoi koiham? Pathen tailou chonset ngaidam thei koiham? tin agel pantaovin ahi.
target: The Pharisees and the teachers of the law began thinking to themselves, “Who is this fellow who speaks blasphemy? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

source: Ahin agelu chu Jesu'n ahen, adonbutnin, ajah uva, Nalunguva ipi nagelu ham?
target: Jesus knew what they were thinking and asked, “Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?

source: Nachonset naho kingaidama ahitai kitile, Thouvin lamjotnin ti hoijoh seibai jo-am?
target: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?

source: Ahoi hita jongle leiset chungah Mihem Chapan chonset ngaidamna thahat aneije ti nahetna dingun,(langthipa jah-a chun,) Thou vin; nalupna kilah inlang, na-in'a chetan kati nahi, ati.
target: But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.” So he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home.”

source: Chuin hiche pettah chun ama a-angsung uva athoudoh paijin, alupna chu akilah-in, Pathen vahchoi pumin a-in lama achetan ahi.
target: Immediately he stood up in front of them, took what he had been lying on and went home praising God.

source: Hichun kidang asa lheh jengun, Pathen avahchoijun, Tunin thil kidangtah imuve, atiuvin akicha behseh jengtaovin ahi.
target: Everyone was amazed and gave praise to God. They were filled with awe and said, “We have seen remarkable things today.”

source: Chuin hiche jou chun ama apotdoh-in ahile, amin Levi atiu kaidong khat, kaidonna mun'a atou amun, ajah-a, Kanung hinjuijin, ati.
target: After this, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector by the name of Levi sitting at his tax booth. “Follow me,” Jesus said to him,

source: Chuin aman ijakai adalhan akipatdoh-in ajuitan ahi.
target: and Levi got up, left everything and followed him.

source: Chuin Levi chun ama vahnan a-in'ah golvah loupitah abolin; chule hia chun kaidongho le midang tamtah-in amaho chu ankong aumpiuvin ahi.
target: Then Levi held a great banquet for Jesus at his house, and a large crowd of tax collectors and others were eating with them.

source: Chuin Pharisai ho le alekha sunteu aseijuiteho chunga aphunun, Ibola kaidongho le chonse hotoh nanehkhom nadon khomuham? atitaove.
target: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law who belonged to their sect complained to his disciples, “Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?”

source: Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, Ati damten louthem angaipouve; a damlouten bou angaijui.
target: Jesus answered them, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.

source: Michonpha te kou-a hung kahipoi; alung heina dinguva michonse te kou-a hungjoh kahibouve, ati.
target: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

source: Chuin amahon ajah-a, Ipidinga John seijuiten an angol matchet jiuva, tao jong taojiuva chule Pharisai hon jong chuti boljiuva, nangma nungjui hon aneh uva adonjiu ham? atiuvin ahi.
target: They said to him, “John’s disciples often fast and pray, and so do the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours go on eating and drinking.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n amaho jah-a, Moulang chun aumpi laiseuva, aloite chu an na ngolsah thei ngaijum?
target: Jesus answered, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while he is with them?

source: Amavang moulang chu akomuva kona akipuimang ni hung lhung ding ahi, chuche nile an angol dingu ahi, ati.
target: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; in those days they will fast.”

source: Chuin aman ajah uva thulem khatma aseijin, Koiman ponthah halchu ponluija abeh ngaipoi; chuti bolle athah chun asuhset ding; chule athah-a kona alah ahal jong chu alui chutoh kitoh lou ding ahi.
target: He told them this parable: “No one tears a piece out of a new garment to patch an old one. Otherwise, they will have torn the new garment, and the patch from the new will not match the old.

source: Chule koiman lengpitwi thah savun peng luija akhum ngaipoi; ichuti bolle, atwi thah chun apeng chu tumkeh intin, atwi jong long jalintin, peng jong mang ding ahi.
target: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the new wine will burst the skins; the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined.

source: Lengpitwi thah chu peng thah-a khum ding ahibouve; chutile ania kikhehtup jia ahi.
target: No, new wine must be poured into new wineskins.

source: Lengpitwi lui dona chun koiman athah don ding agopoi; ijeh-inem itile, Aluibou atuije, ati.
target: And no one after drinking old wine wants the new, for they say, ‘The old is better.’ ”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, amasa kichaijou anichanna cholngah nin changlei lai ajotnin ahile, aseijuiten changvui asih-un, akhutnun anoijun aneuvin ahi.
target: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and his disciples began to pick some heads of grain, rub them in their hands and eat the kernels.

source: Chuin Pharisai ho kimkhatnin, Cholngah ni-a bol ngailou ibola nabol uham? ati.
target: Some of the Pharisees asked, “Why are you doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”

source: Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah uva, Nanghon David le aloihon agil akel phat uva abolu chu nasim khah louvu ham?
target: Jesus answered them, “Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?

source: Ama Pathen in'a alutnin, thempu tailou adangin aneh ngailou vetsahna changlhah chu alan, anen, chule aloiho jong apen ahi, ati.
target: He entered the house of God, and taking the consecrated bread, he ate what is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions.”

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Mihem Chapa chu cholngah ni Pakai ahi, ati.
target: Then Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, cholngah ni chom khatnin ama kikhopna in'ah alutnin thu ahilin; chule hia chun akhut jet lang ngoi mi khat aumin ahi.
target: On another Sabbath he went into the synagogue and was teaching, and a man was there whose right hand was shriveled.

source: Chuin danthu sunho le Pharisai ho chun ahehsetna ding amu theina dingun, cholngah ni-a aboldam em, aboldam hih em tin achang lhiuvin ahi.
target: The Pharisees and the teachers of the law were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal on the Sabbath.

source: Ahivangin aman alungthimu chu ahen, akhut langngoipa jah-a chun, Kipatdoh-in alaija hung dingdoh-in, ati.
target: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said to the man with the shriveled hand, “Get up and stand in front of everyone.” So he got up and stood there.

source: Chuin Jesu'n amaho jah-a, Keiman thudoh khat neijung kate; cholngah ni-a apha bol angaiha, ase bol angaiham? Lhagao huhhing angaiha, suhmang angaiham? ati.
target: Then Jesus said to them, “I ask you, which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?”

source: Chuin aman amaho chu abonchauvin ave kimvelin, akhut lang ngoipa jah-a chun, Nakhut lhangin, ati. Chuin aman alhangin ahile akhut chu alangkhat bangin adamtan ahi.
target: He looked around at them all, and then said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did so, and his hand was completely restored.

source: Ahin amaho athangtom tuntun jengun, Jesu chunga ipi bolding ham akihoutoh pantaovin ahi.
target: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were furious and began to discuss with one another what they might do to Jesus.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, hiche lai chun ama taona mang dingin molchunga akaldoh-in; jan khovah-in Pathen henga tang louvin ataovin ahi.
target: One of those days Jesus went out to a mountainside to pray, and spent the night praying to God.

source: Chuin khovah phatnin aseijuite akouvin; chuin alah uva somleni alhengdoh-in, amaho chu aminu jong solchah asahtan ahi.
target: When morning came, he called his disciples to him and chose twelve of them, whom he also designated apostles:

source: Peter asah Simon, chule asopipa Andrew, Jacob le John, Philip le Bartholomew,
target: Simon (whom he named Peter), his brother Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew,

source: Mathew le Thomas, Alphaeus chapa Jacob, Zealot atiu Simon,
target: Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Simon who was called the Zealot,

source: Jacob naopa Juda, chule ama matsah-a pang Judas Iscariot, hicheng chu ahiuve.
target: Judas son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.

source: Chuin amaho chutoh ahung kumlhan, jangcham-ah adingun, aseijui honkhat toh, Juda gam jousele Jerusalem'a kon, Tyre le Sidon gama twikhanglen panga kon mipi atama tam, athu ngai dingle ahiveiju kiboldam dinga hungho;
target: He went down with them and stood on a level place. A large crowd of his disciples was there and a great number of people from all over Judea, from Jerusalem, and from the coastal region around Tyre and Sidon,

source: Chuin lhagao boh suhgentheina aumnaova kona boldama umho toh ahin ahi.
target: who had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases. Those troubled by impure spirits were cured,

source: Chuin ama-a kona thilboltheina ahung potna abonchauva aboldam jeh chun, mipi chun abonchauvin ama chu tohkhah agouvin ahi.
target: and the people all tried to touch him, because power was coming from him and healing them all.

source: Chuin ama akhodah-in aseijuite aven, Mivaichateho anunnom nahiuve; ijeh-inem itile Pathen lenggam chu nangho-a ahi.
target: Looking at his disciples, he said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.

source: Tu-a gilkelteho anunnom nahiuve; ijeh-inem itile nangho nava dingu ahi. Tu-a kapteho anunnom nahiuve; ijeh-inem itile nanui dingu ahi.
target: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be satisfied. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

source: Mihem Chapa jala min nahotbol uva, chule nachom khenuva, nahou setnuva, chule michonse tia naminu apaidoh tengule anunnom nahiuve.
target: Blessed are you when people hate you, when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil, because of the Son of Man.

source: Hiche ni chule thanomun, kipah-in kichomum; ijeh-inem itile veuvin, van'a nasan dingu kipaman atame; ijeh-inem itile apu apateuvin jong themgaoho chutobang ma-a chu anabolu ahi.
target: “Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, because great is your reward in heaven. For that is how their ancestors treated the prophets.

source: Amavang mihaosa ho, ada nahiuve! Ijeh inem itile nanghon lungmonna alhinga naneiju ahitai.
target: “But woe to you who are rich, for you have already received your comfort.

source: Nangho tu-a oivaho ada nahiuve! ijeh-inem nangho nagil keldiu ahi. Nangho tu-a nuiho ada nahiuve! ijeh inem itile nangho nalunghem dingu chule naka dingu ahi.
target: Woe to you who are well fed now, for you will go hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

source: Mi jousen na-ochat uva naseiphat tengule ada nahiuve! ijeh-inem itile apu apateuvin chutima-a chu themgao lhemho anabolu ahi.
target: Woe to you when everyone speaks well of you, for that is how their ancestors treated the false prophets.

source: Amavang keiman kathu ngaiho jah-a kasei ahi, Nanghon namelma teu chu ngailuvin; nahoteu chu phatbolun;
target: “But to you who are listening I say: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

source: Nagaosapteu chu phatthei boh-un; nataitom teo dingin taovun.
target: bless those who curse you, pray for those who mistreat you.

source: Nabengphe langkhat benga chu langkhat jong dopeh-in; chule naponlen min nalahpehle nasangkhol jong alah ding it hih-in.
target: If someone slaps you on one cheek, turn to them the other also. If someone takes your coat, do not withhold your shirt from them.

source: Nahenga thumchan chu pen; chule nanei nalah peh-a chu thum kit ta hih-in.
target: Give to everyone who asks you, and if anyone takes what belongs to you, do not demand it back.

source: Min nangho iti nabol leu nadeijum, nanghon jong chuti chun bolun.
target: Do to others as you would have them do to you.

source: Nanghon nangailu teo jeng nangailut uva ahile, ipi pachat nachan dinguham? Ijeh-inem itile michonseho jengin jong angailuva chu amahon angailuvin ahi.
target: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners love those who love them.

source: Chule nanghon nadinguva phaho jengseh phatna ding bolleu chun, ipi pachat nachan dinguham? Ijeh-inem itile michonse hon jong achuti bolun ahi.
target: And if you do good to those who are good to you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners do that.

source: Chule lemu kit dinga nakinepna hou jengseh henga peleuchun ipi pachatna nachan dinguham? Ijeh-inem itile michonse hon jong michonseho hengah ajatma mu kit dingin apejiuvin ahi.
target: And if you lend to those from whom you expect repayment, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, expecting to be repaid in full.

source: Nangho vangin namelma teu chu ngailuvin, aphatna dingu bolun, chule mu kit ding kinemlel louvin peuvin; chutile tohphat man nasan dingu len ding, chule Chungnung pen chate nahi dingu ahi. Ijeh inem itile ama kipaje helou le miphalouho ahepin ahi.
target: But love your enemies, do good to them, and lend to them without expecting to get anything back. Then your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High, because he is kind to the ungrateful and wicked.

source: Hijeh chun na-Pau mikhoto bangin, nanghon jong mi khotouvin.
target: Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.

source: Chule mi oimo hih-un, chutile nangho oimo-a naum lou dingu ahi; mi themmo chansah hih-un, chutile nangho jong themmo nakichan lou dingu ahi; mi ngaidamun, chutile nangho jong naki ngaidam dingu ahi.
target: “Do not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.

source: Nanghon peuvin, chutile nangho jong nakipe dingu ahi; phatah-in tentin, sonchahkheh intin, lohchah kheh-in tin, letsetna na-op uva nasunpeh dingu ahi; ijeh-inem itile nanghon nate bang banguva chu nangho kitepeh ding nahiuve, ati.
target: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.”

source: Chuin aman amaho jah-a thulem khat aseijin, Mitchon mitcho apui thei ngaijem? Ani lhona kokhuh-a lhalut lhonta lou dingham?
target: He also told them this parable: “Can the blind lead the blind? Will they not both fall into a pit?

source: Ahilpa sangin aseijui achungnung jopoi. Athep chamkim teng vangle ahilpa toh akibang bouve.
target: The student is not above the teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like their teacher.

source: Chule ibola nasopi mitna bohthem um chu navetna, nangma mitna thingtum umchu hedoh louva nahim?
target: “Why do you look at the speck of sawdust in your brother’s eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own eye?

source: Chule nangman nangma mitna um thingtum chu mu louva, nasopi jah-a, Sopi, namitna bohthem um chu neilahdoh sah-in, iti nati theiham? Vo miphalhem, nangma mitna um thingtum chu kilahdoh masah-in, chutengle nasopi mitna um bohthem lahdoh ding chu namuchen ding ahi.
target: How can you say to your brother, ‘Brother, let me take the speck out of your eye,’ when you yourself fail to see the plank in your own eye? You hypocrite, first take the plank out of your eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.

source: Ijeh-inem itile thingphung pha-a aga phalou agajipoi, thingphung phalouva jong aga pha agajipoi.
target: “No good tree bears bad fruit, nor does a bad tree bear good fruit.

source: Thingphung jouse aga-a kihe-a ahi. Ijeh-inem itile min ling phung-ah theichang aloujipoi, lingboh-a jong lengpiga aloujipoi.
target: Each tree is recognized by its own fruit. People do not pick figs from thornbushes, or grapes from briers.

source: Miphan alung sung thilkholna pha-a konin thilpha asodoh-in; chule miphalouvin alung sung thil kholna phalouva konin aphalou asodohjin ahi; ijeh-inem itile alung sunga aletset teng akamin aphondohji ahi.
target: A good man brings good things out of the good stored up in his heart, and an evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in his heart. For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.

source: Chule nangho kasei thua la chon louva ibola Pakai, Pakai, neitiu ham?
target: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and do not do what I say?

source: Koi hijongle kahenga hunga, kathusei ngaija, chule bola chu, ama chu koi tobang ham keiman nangho vetsah-unge.
target: As for everyone who comes to me and hears my words and puts them into practice, I will show you what they are like.

source: Ama chu in sa-a, thuhtah-a lei laija, chule abul songpi chunga phut tobang ahi: chuin twisang ahung lenin, chule luidung asoh-in, in chu hasuh-in asun ahile, guntah-a kisa ahi jeh chun asulhu joutapon ahi.
target: They are like a man building a house, who dug down deep and laid the foundation on rock. When a flood came, the torrent struck that house but could not shake it, because it was well built.

source: Ahin ja chu jana-a ahia bol louva vang chu, abul beija lei chunga in sa tobang ahi; luidung asoh-in, hasuh-in asun ahile hiche in chu alhupai jengtan ahi; hiche in chu aset anasa lheh jengin ahi.
target: But the one who hears my words and does not put them into practice is like a man who built a house on the ground without a foundation. The moment the torrent struck that house, it collapsed and its destruction was complete.”

source: Chujouvin aman miho jah-a asei ding thu jouse aseisoh phatnin, Capernaum'a aluttan ahi.
target: When Jesus had finished saying all this to the people who were listening, he entered Capernaum.

source: Chuin sepai jalamkai khat asohpa deitah hatah-in anan, athikon ahitai.
target: There a centurion’s servant, whom his master valued highly, was sick and about to die.

source: Chuin aman Jesu thu umchan ajah phatnin, ahengah Juda mi upaho asolin, ahunga asohpa chu ahung damsah dingin angehtan ahi.
target: The centurion heard of Jesus and sent some elders of the Jews to him, asking him to come and heal his servant.

source: Chuin amaho chu Jesu heng alhunun, pontho tah-in ataovun, Ama hi hiche hi nabolpeh-a lomtah ahi;
target: When they came to Jesus, they pleaded earnestly with him, “This man deserves to have you do this,

source: Ijeh-inem itile aman ivaipiu hi angailu lheh jengin, amatah-in kaki khopnao in jong hi eisahpeh-u ahi, atiuvin ahi.
target: because he loves our nation and has built our synagogue.”

source: Chuin Jesu amaho chutoh alhontai. Chuin inkom ageijin jalamkai javaipo chun agolho asolin, Jesu jah-a, Pakai, nangma hung kisugim hih-in: ijeh-inem itile nangma ka-in sunga nahung lut ding chu keima chutia kilom kahipoi.
target: So Jesus went with them. He was not far from the house when the centurion sent friends to say to him: “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I do not deserve to have you come under my roof.

source: Chutichu ahin keima jong nangma henga hung dinga kilomim kakingaito poi; thu chengkhat jengcha seijin, chutile kasohpa dam jeng ding ahi.
target: That is why I did not even consider myself worthy to come to you. But say the word, and my servant will be healed.

source: Ijeh-inem itile keima jong mi thuneina noija um kahin, keima noija sepaiho aumin; chule keiman khatpenpen chu, Chen, katile, achen; achom khat, Hungin, katile ahungin: chule kasoh jah-a, Hiche bolin, katile, aboljin ahi, ati.
target: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and that one, ‘Come,’ and he comes. I say to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n thu chucheng ajah phatnin, ama chu kidang asan adatmon, anungjui mipi jah-a chun, Keiman nangho jah-a kasei ahi, Israel lah jenga jong hitobang tahsan len kamukhapoi, ati.
target: When Jesus heard this, he was amazed at him, and turning to the crowd following him, he said, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith even in Israel.”

source: Chuin asolteho chu a-in'a akile kitnun ahile, adammoa um sohpa chu damin amutauvin ahi.
target: Then the men who had been sent returned to the house and found the servant well.

source: Chujou jou chun Nain atiu kho khatna achen, aseijuite le mipi nasatah khattoh alhonin ahi.
target: Soon afterward, Jesus went to a town called Nain, and his disciples and a large crowd went along with him.

source: Chuche kho kotpi phung ageijun, veuvin, mithi khat ahung kipun, ama chu anu chapa changkhatseh ahin, amanula meithai ahin; akhoho mi tamtah-in alhonpiuvin ahi.
target: As he approached the town gate, a dead person was being carried out—the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. And a large crowd from the town was with her.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin amanu chu amu phatnin, alung ase behseh jengin, Kap hih-in, ati.
target: When the Lord saw her, his heart went out to her and he said, “Don’t cry.”

source: Chuin aman anaijin thilong kong chu athamin ahile, apuho chu adingtauvin ahi. Chuin aman, Gollhang, thouvin kati nahi, ati.
target: Then he went up and touched the bier they were carrying him on, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I say to you, get up!”

source: Chuin athipa chu atou doh-in, thu asei pantan ahi. Chuin aman amapa chu anu apetan ahi.
target: The dead man sat up and began to talk, and Jesus gave him back to his mother.

source: Chuin abonchau chunga kichatna alhung tan; Ilah uva themgao chungnung khat asohdoh-e; chule Pathen'in amite aviltai, atiuvin Pathen avahchoi taovin ahi.
target: They were all filled with awe and praised God. “A great prophet has appeared among us,” they said. “God has come to help his people.”

source: Chuin Judah gam jouse-a le akimvel gam jouse-ah achungchang thu chu athangdoh sohtan ahi.
target: This news about Jesus spread throughout Judea and the surrounding country.

source: Chuin John seijuiten chuti thu jouse chu ajah-a aseijiuvin ahi.
target: John’s disciples told him about all these things. Calling two of them,

source: Chuin John'in aseijuite mi ni akouvin, Jesu hengah asolin, Ahung dinga chu nang nahi mong hinam? Ole achom dang khat kanga dinguham? agati sah-e.
target: he sent them to the Lord to ask, “Are you the one who is to come, or should we expect someone else?”

source: Chuin mite ni akom alhun lhonin, John Baptist-in, Ahung dinga chu nangma nahi mong hinam? Ole achom dang khat kanga dinguham? tia nahenga eihinsol lhon ahi, ati lhone.
target: When the men came to Jesus, they said, “John the Baptist sent us to you to ask, ‘Are you the one who is to come, or should we expect someone else?’ ”

source: Hiche pettah-a chu Jesu'n anaho, hiseveiho, chule lhagao gilou vop tamtah aboldama, chule mitcho tamtah lungset tah-a kho amusah ahi.
target: At that very time Jesus cured many who had diseases, sicknesses and evil spirits, and gave sight to many who were blind.

source: Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah lhonah, Che lhoninlang nathilmu chengse lhon le nathujah chengse; Iti dana mitchon kho amu-a, elbaijin lam ajotna, miphah damtheng sah-a auma, chule na-ngongin kho ajah-a, mithisa kaithouva auma, chule mivaichate Kipana Thupha kiseipeh-a hitam John jah-a gasei lhonin.
target: So he replied to the messengers, “Go back and report to John what you have seen and heard: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, those who have leprosy are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is proclaimed to the poor.

source: Chule koi hijongle keija kipal lhuhna kom nei lou chu anunnom ahi, ati.
target: Blessed is anyone who does not stumble on account of me.”

source: Chuin John thupo ho chu apotdoh phatnun, aman mipi jah-a chun John thudol asei panin, Ipi ve dinga gamthipma chu nachedoh-uham? Huijin peng amut lingham?
target: After John’s messengers left, Jesus began to speak to the crowd about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swayed by the wind?

source: Achutile, ipi ve dinga ba chedoh nahiuvem? Ponnem kisil miham? Veuvin, lultah-a kivonhole nomsa tah-a umho khu lengho inpi-a um ahiuve.
target: If not, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? No, those who wear expensive clothes and indulge in luxury are in palaces.

source: Ahile, ipi ve dingaba nachedoh-uham? Themgao ham? Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, themgao sanga chungnungjo ahi.
target: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.

source: Keiman kasottol nama sang-ah kasole, aman namasanga sang nalampi asem ding ahi, tia kisun chu ama hi ahi.
target: This is the one about whom it is written: “ ‘I will send my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way before you.’

source: Nangho jah-a kasei ahi, Numei sunga peng lah-a John Baptist sanga lenjo aumpoi; ahinla Pathen lenggama aneojo chu ama sangin alenjoi, ati.
target: I tell you, among those born of women there is no one greater than John; yet the one who is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.”

source: Chuin athusei ja-a mi jouse le kaidongho, John baptize chansah-a baptize changho chun, Pathen chu them achanun adihsahtauve.
target: (All the people, even the tax collectors, when they heard Jesus’ words, acknowledged that God’s way was right, because they had been baptized by John.

source: Ahin Pharisai ho le danthu themho vang chun, ama chansah-a baptize chang louvin, Pathen'in amaho chunga alunggot chu apaidoh taovin ahi.
target: But the Pharisees and the experts in the law rejected God’s purpose for themselves, because they had not been baptized by John.)

source: Chule Pakaiyin, Tukhanga miho hi ipitoh katekah tadem? chule ipi toh kilou uvam? ati.
target: Jesus went on to say, “To what, then, can I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?

source: Amaho chu chapang kaithel tolla touva, khatnin khat kou-a, ajah-a, Kuli kamutpeh ule nalam hih-un; kakau lela nakap pouve, tiho tobang ahiuve.
target: They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling out to each other: “ ‘We played the pipe for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not cry.’

source: Ijeh-inem itile John Baptist ahungin, changlhah ne lou lengpitwi donlou ahin; nanghon, Ama chu thilhavop ahi, nati uve.
target: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’

source: Mihem Chapa ahungin, anen chule adonin ahile, nanghon, Veuvin, nehhat le ju lop, kaidongho le mi chonseho jol le gol, nati uve.
target: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Here is a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners.’

source: Ahinla chihna chu achate jousen athem chansah uvin ahi, ati.
target: But wisdom is proved right by all her children.”

source: Chuin Pharisai ho khatnin ama chu an nehpi dingin akouvin; chuin ama Pharisai pa in'a chun alutnin, an nedingin atoutan ahi.
target: When one of the Pharisees invited Jesus to have dinner with him, he went to the Pharisee’s house and reclined at the table.

source: Chuin veuvin, hiche khopi sunga um numei chonse khatnin Pharisai pa in'ah annen atouve ti ahet phatnin, songval bom khat thao namtui ahin choijin;
target: A woman in that town who lived a sinful life learned that Jesus was eating at the Pharisee’s house, so she came there with an alabaster jar of perfume.

source: Anungah akengphang bulah adingin akapmin, akengphang chu amitlhin akotsah-in, aluchanga asam chun atheh ngim pantan, chuin akengphang chu achopmin thao chu anutan ahi.
target: As she stood behind him at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears. Then she wiped them with her hair, kissed them and poured perfume on them.

source: Chuin an ne-a kou-a Pharisai pa chun hichu amun, alungthima, Hiche mipa hi themgao ahin, hiche atongkha nu hi koi ahi le itobang numei ahi hetahta, amanula chonse ahin, ati.
target: When the Pharisee who had invited him saw this, he said to himself, “If this man were a prophet, he would know who is touching him and what kind of woman she is—that she is a sinner.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n ama chu adonbutnin, ajah-a, Simon najah-a sei ding thukhat kaneije ati.
target: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” “Tell me, teacher,” he said.

source: Aman, Houhil seijin, ati. Sumpahom mikhatnin sumba mi ni aneijin; khatpan dangka ja nile somnga abatnin, khatjopan somni le nga abat ahi.
target: “Two people owed money to a certain moneylender. One owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

source: Chuin amanin asahna ding anei lhon lou phatnin, ani lhonin angaidam tai. Chuti ahileh koijoh chun ama ha ngailutjoh lhonintem? ati.
target: Neither of them had the money to pay him back, so he forgave the debts of both. Now which of them will love him more?”

source: Simon'in adonbutnin, Kei ngaiton atam ngaidamjoh chun, ati. Chuin aman, natan dih-e, ati.
target: Simon replied, “I suppose the one who had the bigger debt forgiven.” “You have judged correctly,” Jesus said.

source: Chuin numeinu lama chun akiheijin, Simon jah-a, Numeinu hi namu-em? Na-in'ah kahung lutnin nangman kakeng silna ding twi neipepoi, amanu vang hin amitlhin ka kengphang asukotnin, asamin atheh ngime.
target: Then he turned toward the woman and said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I came into your house. You did not give me any water for my feet, but she wet my feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.

source: Nangman chopjong neichop poi, amanu vang hin kahung lut tila pat ka kengphang chop atangpoi.
target: You did not give me a kiss, but this woman, from the time I entered, has not stopped kissing my feet.

source: Nangman kalu thao neinu pehpoi, amanu vang hin ka kengphang thao namtui anui.
target: You did not put oil on my head, but she has poured perfume on my feet.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu kasei ahi, Amanu chonsetna tamtah akingaidam jeh-a hatah-a angailut ahi; amavang ngaidam lhom chun angailu lhomjin ahi, ati.
target: Therefore, I tell you, her many sins have been forgiven—as her great love has shown. But whoever has been forgiven little loves little.”

source: Chuin numeinu jah-a chun, Nachonset ngaidam ahitai, ati.
target: Then Jesus said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”

source: Hichun a-ankong um piho chun, Chonset ngaidam ama hi koi hingana? akitiuvin ahi.
target: The other guests began to say among themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”

source: Chuin aman numeinu jah-a chun, Natahsanin nahuhhing ahitai; lungmong tah-in chetan, ati.
target: Jesus said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you; go in peace.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, hiche joujou chun, ama khopile khoneo tinah avahlen, Pathen gam Kipana Thupha apolen ahillhanglen; somleni ho chu akomah aumun;
target: After this, Jesus traveled about from one town and village to another, proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God. The Twelve were with him,

source: chule numei phabep, lhagao gilou vop kiboldam le anat kiboldamho toh ahiuve. Amaho chu Magdalene atiu Mariam thilha sagi potdohnanu toh,
target: and also some women who had been cured of evil spirits and diseases: Mary (called Magdalene) from whom seven demons had come out;

source: chule Herod neiching Chuza inneipi Joanna toh, Susanna toh, chule numei dang tamtah toh ahiuvin; amaho chun amaho neija konin ama ajenun ahi.
target: Joanna the wife of Chuza, the manager of Herod’s household; Susanna; and many others. These women were helping to support them out of their own means.

source: Chuin mipi tamtah ahung kikhom khomun, khotina konin miho ahenga ahung ahungun, aman thulemin thu aseijin;
target: While a large crowd was gathering and people were coming to Jesus from town after town, he told this parable:

source: Muchi thepa muchi then achen, athe atheleh abang lamsih-a achun ahile min kengin achotphan, chule chunga leng vachaten alohgamtan ahi.
target: “A farmer went out to sow his seed. As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path; it was trampled on, and the birds ate it up.

source: Abang songlheo chungah achun; chuin akedoh doh-in, jung akholou jeh-in agop paitan ahi.
target: Some fell on rocky ground, and when it came up, the plants withered because they had no moisture.

source: Chule abang ling lah-a achun; chuin lingho chutoh akhanthan adeplih taovin ahi.
target: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up with it and choked the plants.

source: Chule adang leipha laijah achun, akhangin, ajat jakhat agatan ahi ati. Chuin thu chucheng aseijin, Angaina ding nakhang neijan ngaihen tin asamin ahi.
target: Still other seed fell on good soil. It came up and yielded a crop, a hundred times more than was sown.” When he said this, he called out, “Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear.”

source: Chuin aseijuiten, Hiche thulem chu i-kiseina ham? tin adongun ahi.
target: His disciples asked him what this parable meant.

source: Chuin aman, Pathen lenggam thuguh chu nahet dinguva kipe-a nahitaove; midangho dinga vang, vet chu avetnuva amuloudiu, jah chu ajah uva ahet louna dinguva thulema kisei ahi.
target: He said, “The knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to others I speak in parables, so that, “ ‘though seeing, they may not see; though hearing, they may not understand.’

source: Thulem chu athu hiche ahi: Muchi chu Pathen thu ahi.
target: “This is the meaning of the parable: The seed is the word of God.

source: Chule lamsih-a ho chu, athu jaho ahiuve, chutengle amahon atahsan daova chule asochat louna dingun diabol ahungin, alung sunguva thu chu alahmang pehjin ahi.
target: Those along the path are the ones who hear, and then the devil comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not believe and be saved.

source: Chule songlheo chungaho chu athu ajah-a, thanom tah-a joppaiho ahiuve; amahon jung aneipouvin, chomkhat atahsanun, chule lhepna aum tengle apul lhagamji taove.
target: Those on the rocky ground are the ones who receive the word with joy when they hear it, but they have no root. They believe for a while, but in the time of testing they fall away.

source: Chule ling lah-a chuho chu hiche ahi, athu ajah nungle acheuvin, hinlai khankho lungkhamna, haona, nopsahna chun adeplihjin, aga bulhingji tapouve.
target: The seed that fell among thorns stands for those who hear, but as they go on their way they are choked by life’s worries, riches and pleasures, and they do not mature.

source: Chule leipha laija chua chu, thu chu ja-a, lung kituptah le phatah-a tuh detna, thohhat na-a ga sohdoh jiho chu ahi.
target: But the seed on good soil stands for those with a noble and good heart, who hear the word, retain it, and by persevering produce a crop.

source: Chule koiman meivah avah-in belin akhukhum jipoi; jalkhun noija jong akikoi jipoi; alut chanin vah amu theina dingun atunna chungah atungji bouve.
target: “No one lights a lamp and hides it in a clay jar or puts it under a bed. Instead, they put it on a stand, so that those who come in can see the light.

source: Ijeh-inem itile kiphong lou dinga imacha ki-ima aumpoi, chule hetdoh lou ding le kilangdoh lou ding akiselguh imacha aumpoi.
target: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be known or brought out into the open.

source: Hijeh chun iti nangaijum chingtheijun; ijeh-inem itile koi hijongle aneija chu kipehbe ding; chule koi hijongle anei louva chu aneija angaito chasun jong chu ama-a kona kilahpeh ding ahi, ati.
target: Therefore consider carefully how you listen. Whoever has will be given more; whoever does not have, even what they think they have will be taken from them.”

source: Chuin anu le asopite ahungun, ahinla mipi jeh chun akom alhung theipouvin.
target: Now Jesus’ mother and brothers came to see him, but they were not able to get near him because of the crowd.

source: Chuin ajah-a, Nanule nasopite inpoa adingun, nangma namu nomui, tin aseipeh-un ahi.
target: Someone told him, “Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to see you.”

source: Ahin aman adonbutnin, amaho jah-a, Kanule kasopite hicheho, Pathen thu ngaija bolteho hi ahiuve, ati.
target: He replied, “My mother and brothers are those who hear God’s word and put it into practice.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, chulai chun ni khat aseijuite toh kong-ah atouvin; chuin aman amaho jah-a, dil gallang khatna galkaiju hite, ati. Chuin kong alhaovin akitol taovin ahi.
target: One day Jesus said to his disciples, “Let us go over to the other side of the lake.” So they got into a boat and set out.

source: Ahin akitol petnun ama a-imutan; chuin dila chun khopihui ahung nungin ahile akongu chu twi adim dehdeh jengtan, amaho setto kichatah-in aumtaovin ahi.
target: As they sailed, he fell asleep. A squall came down on the lake, so that the boat was being swamped, and they were in great danger.

source: Chuin amaho ahenga acheuvin, asukhangun, Pipu, Pipu, athigam kahitaove, atiuve. Chuin ama ahung khangin huipi le twikinong chu aphoh-in; hichun hiteni chu atanghel gelin, athiphel tan ahi.
target: The disciples went and woke him, saying, “Master, Master, we’re going to drown!” He got up and rebuked the wind and the raging waters; the storm subsided, and all was calm.

source: Chuin aman ajah uvah, hoibaham natahsanu? ati. Chuin amaho akichauvin, kidang asauvin, khatnin khat jah-a, Hichepa hi itobang mi ham! Huile twi thu apen ahile, athun anung jeng lhone, akitiuvin ahi.
target: “Where is your faith?” he asked his disciples. In fear and amazement they asked one another, “Who is this? He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him.”

source: Chuin Galilee gal ajontah-a um, Gerasene gam alhungun ahi.
target: They sailed to the region of the Gerasenes, which is across the lake from Galilee.

source: Chuin ama kong'a kona leichung agah chot chotnin, khopi-a kon mikhatnin atoh-in; ama chu sottah thilha vop, apon apona sil lou, in'a jong umlou, lhankhuh lah jenga um ahi.
target: When Jesus stepped ashore, he was met by a demon-possessed man from the town. For a long time this man had not worn clothes or lived in a house, but had lived in the tombs.

source: Ama chun Jesu amu mun, a-ao san, a-angah aboh khupmin, aw sangtah-in, Vo Jesu, Chungnung pen Pathen Chapa, nangle kei ipi ikimatna umam? Nahenga katao ahi, keima neibolgim hih-in, ati.
target: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell at his feet, shouting at the top of his voice, “What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torture me!”

source: (Ajehchu aman mipa-a kon chun hung doh-in tia lhagao boh chu thu apeh ahi. Ijeh-inem itile ama chu tamtah vei amat matchetji ahi: chule ama chu thihkhao le bula ahenjiu ahin, ahivangin aman akihennaho chu aphutanjia, thilhan gamthipmah apuimangji ahi).
target: For Jesus had commanded the impure spirit to come out of the man. Many times it had seized him, and though he was chained hand and foot and kept under guard, he had broken his chains and had been driven by the demon into solitary places.

source: Chuin Jesu'n ama chu adongin, Namin ipiham? ati. Chuin aman, Janel kahi, ati; ijeh-inem itile asunga chu thilha tamtah lut ahi.
target: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” “Legion,” he replied, because many demons had gone into him.

source: Chule Aman amaho chu leinoi lama asol lounadin thilhaho chun Jesu henga angeh taovin ahi.
target: And they begged Jesus repeatedly not to order them to go into the Abyss.

source: Chule chukom molsang dunga chu vohcha hon atama tam lha-a ahin; thilhaho chun chucheho lah-a alut theina dingun angeh-un ahile; aman alutdiu aphalpeh tan ahi.
target: A large herd of pigs was feeding there on the hillside. The demons begged Jesus to let them go into the pigs, and he gave them permission.

source: Chuin thilhaho mipa-a kon chun ahung potdoh-un, vohchaho sunga chun alut taovin ahile, vohhon chu halhaijin alhaijun, kolah alhai lhauvin, dil'a alha lutnun athigam taovin ahi.
target: When the demons came out of the man, they went into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned.

source: Chuin vohcha vah hon hiche thusoh umchan chu amu phatnun ajamun, khopi sunga le loujaovah agaseijun ahi.
target: When those tending the pigs saw what had happened, they ran off and reported this in the town and countryside,

source: Chuin ipi thusoh hitam tia ve dingin ahung potdoh-un; chuin Jesu kom ahung lhungun, thilha potdohna mipa chun pon akisila, chule lunglima Jesu kengphang koma atou amuvin, akicha lheh jengun ahi.
target: and the people went out to see what had happened. When they came to Jesus, they found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

source: Chuin amuho chun thilha voppa chu iti kihuhdoh ahi chu amaho jah-a aseijun ahi.
target: Those who had seen it told the people how the demon-possessed man had been cured.

source: Chuin Gerasene gam vela miho jousen, akomuva kona achedohna dingin ahenga ataotauvin ahi; ijeh-inem itile amaho chu kicha behseh jenguva ahi.
target: Then all the people of the region of the Gerasenes asked Jesus to leave them, because they were overcome with fear. So he got into the boat and left.

source: Chuin ama kong'a alutnin, akile kittan ahi. Ahin thilhaho potdohnapa vang chun ama koma umding athumin;
target: The man from whom the demons had gone out begged to go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

source: Ahivangin Jesu'n, Na-in lama chenlang Pathen'in nangma itobang thil loupi nabol peh-em, hichu gaseilen, tin asolin ahi. Chuin akipatdoh-in, Jesu'n thil lentah abolpeh chu khopumpi jah-a lhang phongtah-in asamletai.
target: “Return home and tell how much God has done for you.” So the man went away and told all over town how much Jesus had done for him.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Jesu akile kit chun, mipin kipah tah-in ana lamtouvin ahi; ijeh-inem itile amaho abonchauva ama ngah jinga anaum ahiuve.
target: Now when Jesus returned, a crowd welcomed him, for they were all expecting him.

source: Chuin veuvin, amin Jairus kiti mi khat ahungin, chule ama chu kikhopna in vaihom ahi; chuin ama chu Jesu kengphang bulah alhun, a-in'a hung dingin ataotan ahi;
target: Then a man named Jairus, a synagogue leader, came and fell at Jesus’ feet, pleading with him to come to his house

source: Ijeh inem itile ama chun chanu changkhatseh aneijin, kum somle kum nibep ahin, amanu chu athi koncha ahi. Ahin achen ahile mipi chun atom lellul jengun ahi.
target: because his only daughter, a girl of about twelve, was dying. As Jesus was on his way, the crowds almost crushed him.

source: Chuin numei khat kum somle kum ni athi long, louthem ho kijensah na-a anei jouse sumang, khatchan jong aboldam jou lounu chu,
target: And a woman was there who had been subject to bleeding for twelve years, but no one could heal her.

source: anung lama ahungin, apon mongkai athamin ahi: chuin chupettah chun athi lon chu atangpai jengtan ahi.
target: She came up behind him and touched the edge of his cloak, and immediately her bleeding stopped.

source: Chuin Jesu'n, koiham eithama? ati. Chuin koimachan kei kahi atilou phatnin, Peter le akoma umhon, Pipu, mipin natoma chule naneh chintouva, iti dana koiham eithama? natiham, atiuve.
target: “Who touched me?” Jesus asked. When they all denied it, Peter said, “Master, the people are crowding and pressing against you.”

source: Ahivangin Jesu'n, Koiham khatnin eithame; ijeh-inem itile keija kona thilboltheina thahat potdoh-a chu keiman kahei, ati.
target: But Jesus said, “Someone touched me; I know that power has gone out from me.”

source: Chuin numeinu chun, Ki-imthei kahipoi ti ahen, kihot pumpumin ahungin, a-angah aboh khupmin, ijeh-a ama atham ahi chule chupet tah-a adampaihel chu mi jouse ang sungah aseitan ahi.
target: Then the woman, seeing that she could not go unnoticed, came trembling and fell at his feet. In the presence of all the people, she told why she had touched him and how she had been instantly healed.

source: Chuin aman amanu jah-a, Chanu, lhamong tah-in umin, natahsanin nadamsah ahitai; lung mongin chetan, ati.
target: Then he said to her, “Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace.”

source: Aman hiche thu chu aseina laijin, kikhopna in vaihompa in'a kon chun mi khat ahungin, ajah-a, nachanu athitai; houhil chu cholsah hih-in, ati.
target: While Jesus was still speaking, someone came from the house of Jairus, the synagogue leader. “Your daughter is dead,” he said. “Don’t bother the teacher anymore.”

source: Ahivangin Jesu'n hichu ajan, adonbutnin olmo hih-in, tahsanpou poutan; chutile amanu hingdoh ding ahi, ati.
target: Hearing this, Jesus said to Jairus, “Don’t be afraid; just believe, and she will be healed.”

source: Chuin in alhun phatnun aman Peter, John, Jacob chule chapangnu nule pa tailou adang koima alutsahpon ahi.
target: When he arrived at the house of Jairus, he did not let anyone go in with him except Peter, John and James, and the child’s father and mother.

source: Chule miho jouse chun amanu chu akauvin, a-op abeng bengun ahi; ahin aman, nangho kap hih-un; ama athia ahipoi, a-imu ahibouve, ati.
target: Meanwhile, all the people were wailing and mourning for her. “Stop wailing,” Jesus said. “She is not dead but asleep.”

source: Chuin athitai ti ahet jeh-u chun, ama chu anuisat taovin ahi.
target: They laughed at him, knowing that she was dead.

source: Ahinla aman amaho chu apotdoh sah-in, amanu chu akhutnin atuh-in akouvin, Boinu, thouvin ati.
target: But he took her by the hand and said, “My child, get up!”

source: Chuin alhagao ahung kile kitnin, chupettah chun athoudohpai jengtan ahi; chuin aman amanu chu neh ding peuvin, tin thu apetai.
target: Her spirit returned, and at once she stood up. Then Jesus told them to give her something to eat.

source: Hichun anu le apa chun kidang asa lheh lhonin; ahivangin aman hiche thil kibol chu koima jah-a aseilhon louna dingin akham chahtan ahi.
target: Her parents were astonished, but he ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened.

source: Chuin aman somleni ho chu akou khomin, thilhaho jouse chunga thuneina le nat boldamna thahat apen,
target: When Jesus had called the Twelve together, he gave them power and authority to drive out all demons and to cure diseases,

source: Pathen lenggam thu hil lhangle dingle adamlouho boldam dingin asolin,
target: and he sent them out to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.

source: Ajah uva, Nakhol jinnauva dingin imacha keng hih-un, tenggol hihen, sakhao hihen, changlhah hihen, chule sum hijongle kiken hih-un; sangkhol thoni jong nei hih-un;
target: He told them: “Take nothing for the journey—no staff, no bag, no bread, no money, no extra shirt.

source: Nalut lutnau in'a chun umun, chule chua kon chun potdoh-un.
target: Whatever house you enter, stay there until you leave that town.

source: Chule nalhunsah lounao chanuva chu, chuche kho-a kona napotdoh tengule, amaho douna hettohsahnan nakengphang uva leivui thinglhau vin, ati.
target: If people do not welcome you, leave their town and shake the dust off your feet as a testimony against them.”

source: Chuin amaho acheuvin, akho kho-a Kipana Thupha ahillhangun, adamlou aboldampeh taovin ahi.
target: So they set out and went from village to village, proclaiming the good news and healing people everywhere.

source: Hichun Herod gamvaipopan thil kibol jouse chu ajan, alunggim lhehtan ahi. Ajeh chu mi abangin, John athia kona thoudoh kit ahi, atiuvin;
target: Now Herod the tetrarch heard about all that was going on. And he was perplexed because some were saying that John had been raised from the dead,

source: Abangin, Elijah hung kilah ahi, atiuvin; adangse vang chun, Malaija themgaoho lah-a khat thoudoh kit ahi, atiuvin ahi.
target: others that Elijah had appeared, and still others that one of the prophets of long ago had come back to life.

source: Herod'in, Keiman John lu katantan, ahinla hiche athu kajah hi hoi koiham? ati. Hichun ama mu atuptan ahi.
target: But Herod said, “I beheaded John. Who, then, is this I hear such things about?” And he tried to see him.

source: Chuin solchah ho chu ahung kile kitnun, athilbol chengseu chu ama jah-a aseijun ahi. Chuin aman amaho chu apuijin, Bethsaida atiu khopi mun thip khatna amaho changseh apotdoh taovin ahi.
target: When the apostles returned, they reported to Jesus what they had done. Then he took them with him and they withdrew by themselves to a town called Bethsaida,

source: Ahivangin mipin hichu ahet phat uvin, anung ajuijun; chuin aman amaho chu anasangin, chuin ajah uva Pathen gam thu aseijin, chule boldam ngaiho chu aboldamtan ahi.
target: but the crowds learned about it and followed him. He welcomed them and spoke to them about the kingdom of God, and healed those who needed healing.

source: Chuin nilhum kon ahitan; hichun somleni ho chu ahungun ajah-a, Mipi hi acheuva khoho le loujao dunga genale anneh agakihol theina dingun soltan; ijeh-inem itile hikoma eiho gamthipma um ihiuve, atiuvin ahi.
target: Late in the afternoon the Twelve came to him and said, “Send the crowd away so they can go to the surrounding villages and countryside and find food and lodging, because we are in a remote place here.”

source: Ahin aman amaho ajah-a, Nanghon nehding peuvin ati. Chuin amahon jah-a, Kacheuva hiche miho jouse dinga hi neh kagachoh ngal louvule, keihon changlhah pheng nga le nga ni kalval kaneipouve, atiuvin ahi
target: He replied, “You give them something to eat.” They answered, “We have only five loaves of bread and two fish—unless we go and buy food for all this crowd.”

source: Ijeh-inem itile amaho chu mi sangnga jen hiuva ahi. Chuin aman aseijuite jah-a, Amaho chu somnga cheng chengin aloi loijin tousah-un, ati.
target: (About five thousand men were there.) But he said to his disciples, “Have them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”

source: Chuin amahon achuti bolun, abonchauvin atousah-un ahi.
target: The disciples did so, and everyone sat down.

source: Chuin changlhah pheng nga chule nga chu alan, van lam aven, hiteho chu phatthei aboh-in, ahehbal balin; chuin mipi anga chu luipeh dingin aseijuite thu apen ahi.
target: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke them. Then he gave them to the disciples to distribute to the people.

source: Chuin amahon aneuvin, abonchauvin avasoh keijun, chuin anehmoh-u anong chengse paipeh somle paipeh ni alohdoh-un ahi.
target: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, ama achanga atao petnin, aseijuiho akomah aumun; hichun aman amaho chu adongin, Mipi ho hin keima hi koi ahi eitiuvem? ati.
target: Once when Jesus was praying in private and his disciples were with him, he asked them, “Who do the crowds say I am?”

source: Chuin amahon adonbutnun, John Baptist ahi atiuve; abang vangin Elijah ahi atiuvin; chule adangsen, Malaija themgaoho lah-a khat thoudoh ahi tin aseijuve atiuvin ahi.
target: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, that one of the prophets of long ago has come back to life.”

source: Chuin aman amaho jah-a, Nanghonla koi ahi neitiuvem? ati. Chuin Peter'in adonbutnin, Pathen Khrista chu, ati.
target: “But what about you?” he asked. “Who do you say I am?” Peter answered, “God’s Messiah.”

source: Ahivangin aman amaho chu hichu koima jah-a asei louna dingun hakhamin akhamchah-in;
target: Jesus strictly warned them not to tell this to anyone.

source: Ajah uva, Mihem Chapa chun thil tamtah athoh-a, chule vaipo upaho le thempu pipuiho, chule danthu sunho pampaija uma, chule kithat tei ding, chule ni thum nile kaithouva umtei ding ahi, ati.
target: And he said, “The Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, and he must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.”

source: Chuin aman abonchau jah-a, Koi hile kanung eijui noma chu ama kingaitom hen, niseh-in athingpel kiput hen lang kanung hinjuihen.
target: Then he said to them all: “Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross daily and follow me.

source: Ijeh-inem itile koi hile ahinna huhhing noma chun achan ding; amavang koi hile keima jala ahinna chana chun ahuhhing ding ahi.
target: For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me will save it.

source: Ijeh-inem itile min vannoi leiset apumpin neihenlang, ama kisumanghen ahiloule paidoh-in umtale, ama dinga ipi phachom dingham?
target: What good is it for someone to gain the whole world, and yet lose or forfeit their very self?

source: Ijeh-inem itile koi hijongle keima le kathu jachat chanchu, Mihem Chapan ama loupinale, Pa loupina, chule vantil thengteho loupina-a ahung tengle, amapa chu ajachatpi ding ahi.
target: Whoever is ashamed of me and my words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of them when he comes in his glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.

source: Amavang tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Hikoma dingho kimkhat hi, Pathen lenggam amu kahseuva, thina tepkha lou ding aumuve, ati.
target: “Truly I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, chucheng aseikal ni get jen jouvin Peter toh, John toh, chule Jacob toh apuijin, atao dingin mol chunga akaltouvun ahi.
target: About eight days after Jesus said this, he took Peter, John and James with him and went up onto a mountain to pray.

source: Chuin ama ataopetnin, amaiso akikhelin, chule aponsil abanin abangin, aval lahlah jengin ahi.
target: As he was praying, the appearance of his face changed, and his clothes became as bright as a flash of lightning.

source: Chuin veuvin, mi nin akihoupin; amani chu Mosi le Elijah ahi lhonin,
target: Two men, Moses and Elijah, appeared in glorious splendor, talking with Jesus.

source: Loupia hung kilah lhona, Jerusalem'a thina athoh chai ding thu chu asei lhonin ahi.
target: They spoke about his departure, which he was about to bring to fulfillment at Jerusalem.

source: Hichun Peter le aumpiho chu a-imutsoh ngui ngui jengun, ahivangin hah jengin aumun, aloupije le akoma ding miteni chu amuvin ahi.
target: Peter and his companions were very sleepy, but when they became fully awake, they saw his glory and the two men standing with him.

source: Chuin akikhenpi lhona akoma kona achedoh pet lhonin, Peter'in Jesu jah-a, Pipu, hikoma i-umu hi eiho dingin anome; chule lhambuh thum songung kate, khat nangma ding, khat Mosi ding, chule khat Elijah ding, atin; ipi asei ahijong ahepon ahi.
target: As the men were leaving Jesus, Peter said to him, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah.” (He did not know what he was saying.)

source: Chuin aman chucheng asei pet chun, mei lhang khatnin amaho chu ahinlekhun; chuin amaho mei lah-a alutnu chun akichauvin ahi.
target: While he was speaking, a cloud appeared and covered them, and they were afraid as they entered the cloud.

source: Chuin mei lah-a kon chun aw ahung gingdoh-in, Hiche hi ka-Chapa deitah ahi; athu ngaijun, ati.
target: A voice came from the cloud, saying, “This is my Son, whom I have chosen; listen to him.”

source: Chuin awgin akichai phat chun, Jesu achangin akimutan ahi. Chuin athipbeh-un, chulai chun athilmu-u chu koima jah-a asei pouvin ahi.
target: When the voice had spoken, they found that Jesus was alone. The disciples kept this to themselves and did not tell anyone at that time what they had seen.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, akit ni-a mol chunga kona akumsuh phatnun, mipi atama tamin analam touvin ahi.
target: The next day, when they came down from the mountain, a large crowd met him.

source: Chuin veuvin, mipi lah-a kon chun mikhatnin ahin samin, Houhil, nahenga katao ahi, kachapa hi ven; ama hi kachapa changkhatseh ahi;
target: A man in the crowd called out, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only child.

source: Chule vetan, lhagaovin amanjin, phulou helouvin apengjahjin, chule aheh lhujin ahile achilphon akaijin, asuheh jin, lhakang manlouvin amavo jingin ahi.
target: A spirit seizes him and he suddenly screams; it throws him into convulsions so that he foams at the mouth. It scarcely ever leaves him and is destroying him.

source: Chule anodoh dinga naseijuite henga kataole, amahonla anodoh joupouvin ahi, ati.
target: I begged your disciples to drive it out, but they could not.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, Vo tahsanna nei lou khanglamvai mite, nakom uva itihchan kauma, chule kakhongai ding nahiuvem? Nachapa chu hilama hinpuijin, ati.
target: “You unbelieving and perverse generation,” Jesus replied, “how long shall I stay with you and put up with you? Bring your son here.”

source: Chuin ahung petnin thilha chun ahehlhun, nasatah-in aveingoi jengin ahi. Ahivangin Jesu'n lhagao boh chu aphoh-in, chuin chapang chu aboldamin apa apetan ahi.
target: Even while the boy was coming, the demon threw him to the ground in a convulsion. But Jesus rebuked the impure spirit, healed the boy and gave him back to his father.

source: Chuin miho jouse chun Pathen thilboltheina loupije chu kidang asa lheh jengun ahi. Chutia chu athilbol jouse chu kidang asah pettah-un Jesu'n aseijuite jah-a chun,
target: And they were all amazed at the greatness of God. While everyone was marveling at all that Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

source: Hicheng thuhi nana sunguvah lutsah-un, ijeh-inem itile Mihem Chapa chu mihemte khutna kipedoh dingkon ahi, ati.
target: “Listen carefully to what I am about to tell you: The Son of Man is going to be delivered into the hands of men.”

source: Ahivangin hiche athusei chu ahedoh pouve; ijeh-inem itile amahon ahetdoh louna dinguva, amaho-a kona ki-ima ahin; chule hiche athusei chu ipi aseina ham doh dingla akichauvin ahi.
target: But they did not understand what this meant. It was hidden from them, so that they did not grasp it, and they were afraid to ask him about it.

source: Chuin alah uva koipen chu alenpen ahidem tin kinelna aumtan ahi.
target: An argument started among the disciples as to which of them would be the greatest.

source: Ahivangin Jesu'n alunguva chuche angaitou chu ahen, chapang neocha khat alan, akoma adinsah-in,
target: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, took a little child and had him stand beside him.

source: Ajah uva, Koi hijongle hiche chapang neocha hi keima mina sanga chun keima eisan ahi; chule koi hijongle keima eisanga chun eihinsolpa asan ahi. Ijeh-inem itile nalah uva aneopen chu alen ahi, ati.
target: Then he said to them, “Whoever welcomes this little child in my name welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me welcomes the one who sent me. For it is the one who is least among you all who is the greatest.”

source: Chuin John'in adonbutnin, Pipu, mi khat namina thilha nodoh kamuvin, chuin nangma kajuiju eijuipi lou jeh-un kakham taove, ati.
target: “Master,” said John, “we saw someone driving out demons in your name and we tried to stop him, because he is not one of us.”

source: Ahin Jesu'n amaho jah-a, kham hih-un, ijeh-inem itile koi hijongle eidoulou tapouvu chu eiho lamma pang ahi.
target: “Do not stop him,” Jesus said, “for whoever is not against you is for you.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi; ama lahtouva aum ding phat alhin konin, Jerusalem'a che dingin amai angat changmelin,
target: As the time approached for him to be taken up to heaven, Jesus resolutely set out for Jerusalem.

source: Amasangah thangkou asol masan; chule amaho acheuvin ama dinga gotsa anakoipeh dingin, Samaria miho kho khatnah aluttaovin ahi.
target: And he sent messengers on ahead, who went into a Samaritan village to get things ready for him;

source: Ahivangin ama Jerusalem'a che dinga amai angat jeh chun, amahon anasang tapouvin ahi.
target: but the people there did not welcome him, because he was heading for Jerusalem.

source: Chule asolchah teni, Jacob le John nin hichu amulhon phatnin, Pakai, Elijah'in anabol banga, van'a kona meikong ahung lhah-a amaho hi akahvamna dingu thu peleuveng nalung ham, ati lhone.
target: When the disciples James and John saw this, they asked, “Lord, do you want us to call fire down from heaven to destroy them?”

source: Ahivangin ama akiheijin amani chu aphoh-in, ajah lhonna, Itobang lhagao neija nahi nakihet lhonpoi;
target: But Jesus turned and rebuked them.

source: Ajeh chu Mihem Chapa hi mihemho hinkho sumang dia hung ahipon, ahuhhing diuva hunga joh ahibouve, ati. Chuin kho choma ache taovin ahi.
target: Then he and his disciples went to another village.

source: Chuin lampia ache petnun mikhatnin ajah-a, Pakai, Nachena chan-ah juijinge, ati.
target: As they were walking along the road, a man said to him, “I will follow you wherever you go.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah-a, Sial hon ko aneijun, chunga leng vachaten jong buh aneijun, Mihem Chapa vangin alu ngapna mun aneipoi, ati.
target: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”

source: Chuin aman achom khat jah-a, neijuijin, ati. Ahin aman, Pakai, amasan kache-a kapa kagavuina ding thu neipen, ati.
target: He said to another man, “Follow me.” But he replied, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”

source: Hichun Jesu'n ajah-a, mithihon amithiu kivuinao vinte; nangma chenlang Pathen gam thupha gahil lhang letan ati.
target: Jesus said to him, “Let the dead bury their own dead, but you go and proclaim the kingdom of God.”

source: Achom khatman jong, Pakai, keiman nanung juijinge, amavang amasan ka-inkote kaga lhahna dingin neilhan, ati.
target: Still another said, “I will follow you, Lord; but first let me go back and say goodbye to my family.”

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, Mi koi hile langkon tuhta-a, kiheija anunglam vea chu Pathen lenggama hoi ahipoi, ati.
target: Jesus replied, “No one who puts a hand to the plow and looks back is fit for service in the kingdom of God.”

source: Chucheng jou chun Pakaiyin midang somsagi alhendoh ben, ama chena ding khopi chengsele muntina chun amasang sang-ah mi ninin asolin ahi.
target: After this the Lord appointed seventy-two others and sent them two by two ahead of him to every town and place where he was about to go.

source: Chuin ajah uva, Chang at ding atam lheh-in, ahivangin natonga alhome; hiche jeh chun achang atna-a dinga natongho ahinsoldohna dingin, chang neipu henga taovun.
target: He told them, “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into his harvest field.

source: Cheovin; veuvin, ngeihon lah-a kelngoi nou banga nangho kasol nahiuve.
target: Go! I am sending you out like lambs among wolves.

source: Nanghon sumbom ahin, sakhao ahin, kengchot ahin, keng hih-un; chule lampia koima chibai boh hih-un.
target: Do not take a purse or bag or sandals; and do not greet anyone on the road.

source: Chule in nalutna ding chanuva, amasatah-in, hiche in'a hin lungmon lhunghen, tiuvin.
target: “When you enter a house, first say, ‘Peace to this house.’

source: Chukoma chu lungmon umtah mi auma ahile, nalungmon chu achunga umding ahi; aum lou vangle nangho henga hung kile kit ding ahi.
target: If someone who promotes peace is there, your peace will rest on them; if not, it will return to you.

source: Chule ipi hijongle amahon napeh peh-u chu neuvin donun, hiche in'a chun umun; ijeh-inem itile natongan athaman asana lom ahi. In khatna konin in khatna kichon hih-un.
target: Stay there, eating and drinking whatever they give you, for the worker deserves his wages. Do not move around from house to house.

source: Chule ipi kho hijongle nalutnaova chu min nanasan uva ahile, na-ang uva akoi chanu chu neuvin.
target: “When you enter a town and are welcomed, eat what is offered to you.

source: Chukoma um anaho chu boldamun; chule amaho jah-a chun, Pathen gam chu nakomu alhungtai, tiuvin.
target: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘The kingdom of God has come near to you.’

source: Amavang ipi kho hijongle nalutna uva chu min nana lhunsah louvangule, chedoh-unlang akho sung lamlenuvah,
target: But when you enter a town and are not welcomed, go into its streets and say,

source: Kakeng phanguva beh nakho sunguva leivui sana katheh lhah khum nahiuve; hijongle Pathen gam ahung naitai ti hi heuvin, tin seijun.
target: ‘Even the dust of your town we wipe from our feet as a warning to you. Yet be sure of this: The kingdom of God has come near.’

source: Najah uva kasei ahi, chunileh chuche khopi thoh sanga chu Sodom thoh oljo ding ahi.
target: I tell you, it will be more bearable on that day for Sodom than for that town.

source: Ohe Chorazin! nada ahi, ohe Bethsaida! nada ahi; ijeh-inem itile nalah uva thilbol thahatna kidang kibol chengse chu, Tyre le Sidon khopi-a kibol hile, sotna pat chun achenghon khaodip pon kisilin vut lah-a touvuntin, alungu heitauvinte.
target: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
