source: Ahinla thupi tan nile nangni thoh sanga Tyre le Sidon thoh oljo ding ahi.
target: But it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.

source: Chule vangeija choisanga uma nang Capernaum, damuna sotlhah-a umding nahi jobouve.
target: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted to the heavens? No, you will go down to Hades.

source: Koi hile nangho thu ngai chan chun keima thu jong angai ahi; koi hile nangho pampaija chun keima jong eipampai ahi; chule keima eipampaija chun eisolpa jong apampai ahi, ati.
target: “Whoever listens to you listens to me; whoever rejects you rejects me; but whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”

source: Chuin chuche somsagi ho chu kipahtah-in ahung kileuvin, Pakai, nangma minin thilhaho jong kathu-uvin anunge, atiuvin ahi.
target: The seventy-two returned with joy and said, “Lord, even the demons submit to us in your name.”

source: Aman amaho jah-a, Van'a kona kolphe banga Satan ahunglhah kamui.
target: He replied, “I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.

source: Veuvin, gulle aipi chonpeh dingle, melmapa thilboltheina jouse chunga chu thuneina kapeh nahiuve; hitia chu imachan nangho nasuhset lou dingu ahi.
target: I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy; nothing will harm you.

source: Ahivangin lhagaoho nathuva anun jeh chun kipah hih-un, amavang naminu van'a akisut jeh chun kipah jouvin ati.
target: However, do not rejoice that the spirits submit to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”

source: Chuin hiche pettah chun Jesu Lhagao Thengah hapan akipah-in, hitin ati, Ka Pa, vanle lei Pakai, nangman mi chingtele lungthim themho henga hicheng thuhi na-ima, naocha ho henga naphon doh jeh hin nangma kathangvah-e; Pa, hiti chu nangma lunglhaina lam ahi.
target: At that time Jesus, full of joy through the Holy Spirit, said, “I praise you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for this is what you were pleased to do.

source: Imajouse ka Pan keima eipehdohsoh ahitai, chule Chapa chu koi ahi Pa tailouvin ahepoi; chule Pa chu koi ahi Chapa le Chapan Ama aphondoh aphondohna miho tailou koiman ahepoi, ati.
target: “All things have been committed to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him.”

source: Chuin seijuiteho lama chun akiheijin atumbeh-in ahenguva, Nathilmu chengseu namunao mit chu avangphai:
target: Then he turned to his disciples and said privately, “Blessed are the eyes that see what you see.

source: ijeh-inem itile kaseipeh nahiuve, nangho thil mu hi themgaoho tamtah le lenghon mu atup lheh-u ahin, ahivangin amupouvin ahi; chule nathu jah chengseu hi jah atupmun, ahinla ajapouvin ahi, ati.
target: For I tell you that many prophets and kings wanted to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.”

source: Chuin veuvin, danthu them khat adingdoh-in, apatep-in, Houhil, tonsot hin kemlou kanei theina dinga ipi kabol dingham, ati.
target: On one occasion an expert in the law stood up to test Jesus. “Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to inherit eternal life?”

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, danthua ipi kisunem? Nangman iti nasimem? ati.
target: “What is written in the Law?” he replied. “How do you read it?”

source: Chuin aman adonbutnin, Nangman nalung pumpin, nalhagao pumpin, nathanei apumpin, chule nalungthim pumpin Pakai na-Pathen chu ngailun; chule nangma naki ngailut bangin naheng nakoma ngailun, ati.
target: He answered, “ ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind’; and, ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’”

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, Nadonbut dih tangeije; hiti chun bolin, chutile nahin ding ahi, ati.
target: “You have answered correctly,” Jesus replied. “Do this and you will live.”

source: Ahivangin ama them kichan agon, Jesu jah-a, Ahile kaheng kakom chu koiham? ati.
target: But he wanted to justify himself, so he asked Jesus, “And who is my neighbor?”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Mi koiham khat Jerusalem'a konin Jericho'a achesuh-in, gucha michomho lah atohkhatan, amaho chun apon alahpeh-un, avovin, athi konin adalha taovin ahi.
target: In reply Jesus said: “A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, when he was attacked by robbers. They stripped him of his clothes, beat him and went away, leaving him half dead.

source: Chuin thempu khat chuche lampia chun achesuh-in; chuin amachu amu phatnin, lamsih lang khatna apeltan ahi.
target: A priest happened to be going down the same road, and when he saw the man, he passed by on the other side.

source: Chuin chutima chun Levi mi khatma chukom mun chu aphah phatnin, ahungin ama chu aven, lamsih lang khatna apeltai.
target: So too, a Levite, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

source: Ahin Samaria mi khat vang chu akholchena lamah aumna mun chu ahinphan; chuin ama chu amun ahile alung asen,
target: But a Samaritan, as he traveled, came where the man was; and when he saw him, he took pity on him.

source: Akoma achen, avohnao mahaho chu thaole lengpitwi asunkhumin, amahaho chu atomin, chuin amatah gancha chungah atousah-in, jinlhun in'ah apuilutnin, ajentan ahi.
target: He went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. Then he put the man on his own donkey, brought him to an inn and took care of him.

source: Chuin ajingin apotdoh ding konin, sumnong ni aladoh-in, inneipu chu apen, Ama hi phatechan anajenin, hiche kalval ijat hijongle nasuhmang jat chu keima kahung kile kit teng nangma sanange, ati.
target: The next day he took out two denarii and gave them to the innkeeper. ‘Look after him,’ he said, ‘and when I return, I will reimburse you for any extra expense you may have.’

source: Hicheng thum lah-a koipen chu gucha michom lah tohkhapa hengle kom nahisah-em? ati.
target: “Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers?”

source: Chuin aman, ama akhotopa chu, ati. Chuin Jesu'n ajah-a, Chenlang nangman jong chutobang chun gabolin, ati.
target: The expert in the law replied, “The one who had mercy on him.” Jesus told him, “Go and do likewise.”

source: Chuin acheuva ahile ama kho khatna alutnin; chuin amin Martha atiu numei khatnin a-in'a alhunsah-in ahi.
target: As Jesus and his disciples were on their way, he came to a village where a woman named Martha opened her home to him.

source: Chule amanu chun Mariam kiti sopi khat aneijin, amanu jong chu Pakai keng khophang bulah atouvin, athu angaijin ahi.
target: She had a sister called Mary, who sat at the Lord’s feet listening to what he said.

source: Martha vang chu lhachalen apangin akisalel lheh jengin, chuin ama henga ahungin, Pakai, kasopi nun keima jeng lhachale-a eichanglha hi ima nagel louham? Hijeh chun eikithopi dingin solin, ati.
target: But Martha was distracted by all the preparations that had to be made. She came to him and asked, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister has left me to do the work by myself? Tell her to help me!”

source: Ahin Jesu'n adonbutnin, amanu jah-a, Martha, Martha, nangma thil tamtah ngaito-a lungkhama lunggim nahi;
target: “Martha, Martha,” the Lord answered, “you are worried and upset about many things,

source: Ahinla ngaichat akhoh chu khatsehbou ahin, chule Mariam'in chuche aphalai chu akilhen ahitai; hichu ama-a kona kilahpeh lou ding ahi, ati.
target: but few things are needed—or indeed only one. Mary has chosen what is better, and it will not be taken away from her.”

source: Chuin ama mun khatnah ataovin, ajo phatnin aseijuiteho khatnin ajah-a, Pakai, John'in aseijuite taoje ahil bang chun nangman jong keiho neihilun, ati.
target: One day Jesus was praying in a certain place. When he finished, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples.”

source: Chuin aman amaho jah-a, nangho natao tengule, Van'a um ka Pau, namin kijahen, nagam hunglhung hen, van'a nalung chan akim bangin, leija jong nalungchan kimhen,
target: He said to them, “When you pray, say: “ ‘Father, hallowed be your name, your kingdom come.

source: Tunin kaneh khop dingu anneh neipeuvin.
target: Give us each day our daily bread.

source: Kalei bateu kangaidam bangun, keiho batjong ngaidamin. Chule lhepna-a neipuilut hih-un, agilouva konin neihuh doh jouvin; tiuvin ati.
target: Forgive us our sins, for we also forgive everyone who sins against us. And lead us not into temptation. ’ ”

source: Chuin aman amaho jah-a, Nalah uva, koipen nahiuvem khatnin jol neihen, chule jankhang kimin ahenga chehen ajah-a, Jol, changlhah pheng thum apan neipen;
target: Then Jesus said to them, “Suppose you have a friend, and you go to him at midnight and say, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread;

source: Ijeh-inem itile kajol khat kholjin kahenga ahung lhunge; ahin keiman a-anga luipeh ding imacha kaneipoi, gatile:
target: a friend of mine on a journey has come to me, and I have no food to offer him.’

source: Insunga pangin, Neisugim hih-in; tun kot akikhahtai, chule kachatetoh jalkhuna kalum khomui; nangma pe dingin kathou theipoi, tia donbut dinga?
target: And suppose the one inside answers, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is already locked, and my children and I are in bed. I can’t get up and give you anything.’

source: Keiman nangho jah-a kasei ahi, ajol ahi jeh chun thouhen gape hih jongle, athum lunlun jeh chun thouvintin adei jat chu gapente.
target: I tell you, even though he will not get up and give you the bread because of friendship, yet because of your shameless audacity he will surely get up and give you as much as you need.

source: Chule keiman nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, Thumun, kipe ding nahiuve; holun, namu dingu ahi; kiuvun, kihonpeh ding nahiuve.
target: “So I say to you: Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.

source: Ijeh-inem itile athumchan achangin; chule aholan amun; chule akiuva chu kihonpeh ding ahi.
target: For everyone who asks receives; the one who seeks finds; and to the one who knocks, the door will be opened.

source: Chule nalah uva koipen nahiuvem, mipa hija achapan changlhah athumle song pe dinga? Ahiloule nga athumle nga khela gul pe dinga?
target: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?

source: Ahiloule ahtui athumle aipi pe dinga?
target: Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?

source: Hijeh chun nanghobon migiloutah hiuva, nachateo thilpha pehje nahet ule; hiche sanga chu gam chenga van'a Pa chun ahenga thumte chu Lhagao Theng apeh lou ding ham? ati.
target: If you then, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him!”

source: Chuin aman thilha paomo khat anodoh-in, chuin thilha chu apotdoh phatnin, mipaomopa chun thu aseitan ahi; hichun mipi ho chun kidang asa lheh jengun ahi.
target: Jesus was driving out a demon that was mute. When the demon left, the man who had been mute spoke, and the crowd was amazed.

source: Ahivangin alah uva mi kimkhat chun, thilhaho lengpa Beelzabul vanga thilhaho anodoh ahi, atiuve.
target: But some of them said, “By Beelzebul, the prince of demons, he is driving out demons.”

source: Adang kimkhatsen ama patepnan van'a kona melchihna athumun ahi.
target: Others tested him by asking for a sign from heaven.

source: Ahivangin aman amaho lung ngaito chu ahen, amaho jah-a, Gamsung khat amale ama kidoutoa kichom khen chan chu amang thahjin, insung khat kidou chu alhujin ahi.
target: Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them: “Any kingdom divided against itself will be ruined, and a house divided against itself will fall.

source: Satan jong amale ama akidoule agam iti dindoh ding ham? Beelzabul vanga thilhaho anodoh ahi neitiula ahin,
target: If Satan is divided against himself, how can his kingdom stand? I say this because you claim that I drive out demons by Beelzebul.

source: Keima Beelzabul vanga thilhaho nodoh kahile, nachateovin koi vanga anodohjiu hintem? Hijeh-a chu amaho cheng chu nangho thutana pang ding ahiuve.
target: Now if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your followers drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.

source: Ahin keima Pathen khutjunga thilhaho nodohji-a kahi vangle, Pathen gam chu nahengu hung lhunga ahitai.
target: But if I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.

source: Mihat in manchah kimkeija akipatna a-in angalai chansen, anei bitkeijin aumji;
target: “When a strong man, fully armed, guards his own house, his possessions are safe.

source: Amavang ama sang hatjon abulu-a, ajo tengle, akigina agalvon chu asutlhah pehjin, anei alahpeh chu ahomcheh jitan ati.
target: But when someone stronger attacks and overpowers him, he takes away the armor in which the man trusted and divides up his plunder.

source: Koi hile keima lama pang lou chu eidouva ahi; chule eikhop khompi lou chu athecheh ahi.
target: “Whoever is not with me is against me, and whoever does not gather with me scatters.

source: Lhagao boh chu mi sunga kona apotdoh tengle, twi beina muntin-ah avahle avahlen, cholngahna aholin; chule amu jou hih-in, Kahung potdohna ka-in mama-a chun chekit tange, ati.
target: “When an impure spirit comes out of a person, it goes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it. Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’

source: Chuin ahungleh akitheh ngim le akijephoi amun,
target: When it arrives, it finds the house swept clean and put in order.

source: Chutengle achen ama sanga giloujo lhagao dang sagi agapuijin; chule amaho chua chun alutnun achengji taove; chule mipa umchan chu amasa sangin anununga akhohjoji tan ahi, ati.
target: Then it goes and takes seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and live there. And the final condition of that person is worse than the first.”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, aman thu chucheng asei chun, numei khat mipi lah-a kon chun aw sangtah-in ajah-a, Navopma naobu le nangman nachep noi chu anunnoma ahiuve, ati.
target: As Jesus was saying these things, a woman in the crowd called out, “Blessed is the mother who gave you birth and nursed you.”

source: Ahinla aman, Ahinai, ahivangin Pathen thu ja-a jopteho chu anunnomjo ahiuve, ati.
target: He replied, “Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.”

source: Chuin mipi ho ahenga ahung kikhopkhop phatnun, aman, Tulai hiche khang hi khanggilou ahin; melchihna aholun, ahinla Jonah themgao melchihna tailou adang kipe lou ding ahi.
target: As the crowds increased, Jesus said, “This is a wicked generation. It asks for a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Jonah Nineveh mite dinga melchihna ahi banga chu, Mihem Chapa jong tulai khanga ding ahi.
target: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so also will the Son of Man be to this generation.

source: Lhanglam gam lengnun thupi tanna-a hiche tulai khang mite toh hung thoudoh khoma, amaho hi themmo ahinchan ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile aman kolmonga konin Solomon chih thu ngai dingin ahungin ahi; ahin, veuvin, Solomon sanga chungnungjo hikoma aume.
target: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with the people of this generation and condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to listen to Solomon’s wisdom; and now something greater than Solomon is here.

source: Nineveh khopi-a miho chun thupi tanna-a tulai khang mite toh hung ding khoma, tulai khang hi themmo ahinchansah dingu ahi; ijeh-inem itile amahon Jonah thuhil chun alung aheijun ahi; ahin, veuvin, Jonah sanga chungnungjo hikoma aume.
target: The men of Nineveh will stand up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and now something greater than Jonah is here.

source: Mi koiman meivah avah-in ningchonga guhthimin akoi ngaipoi, lo jong akhukhum ngaipoi, mi aluttehon avah amu theina dingun atunna chunga atungji bouvui.
target: “No one lights a lamp and puts it in a place where it will be hidden, or under a bowl. Instead they put it on its stand, so that those who come in may see the light.

source: Namit chu natahsa vah ahi; namit achima ahile, nati apumpia vah ahi; aphat lou vangle nati pumpi-a thima ahi.
target: Your eye is the lamp of your body. When your eyes are healthy, your whole body also is full of light. But when they are unhealthy, your body also is full of darkness.

source: Hijeh chun nasunga vah um chu athim louna dingin kivet phatnin.
target: See to it, then, that the light within you is not darkness.

source: Hiche jeh chun natahsa apumpia avah sohkeija, athimkom aum louva ahile, meivah vahtah-in nasalvah banga vah sohkei ding ahi, ati.
target: Therefore, if your whole body is full of light, and no part of it dark, it will be just as full of light as when a lamp shines its light on you.”

source: Chuin thu aseipet chun Pharisai khatnin an nehpi dingin akouvin; chuin ama alutnin, an nedingin atoutan ahi.
target: When Jesus had finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him to eat with him; so he went in and reclined at the table.

source: Chuin Pharisai pa chun an aneh masanga akisil lou chu amun adatmo lheh jengin ahi.
target: But the Pharisee was surprised when he noticed that Jesus did not first wash before the meal.

source: Chuin Pakai chun ajah-a, Tun Pharisai ho, nanghon khonle lheng apolam nasil ngim naovin; ahin nasung lamu vang hunama lahle kiloset adimsetne.
target: Then the Lord said to him, “Now then, you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside you are full of greed and wickedness.

source: Vo lungthim beiho, apolam sema chun asung lam jong asem hilou ham?
target: You foolish people! Did not the one who made the outside make the inside also?

source: Hijongle thil nanei kham khamu chu vaicha gentheite tona dingin peuvin: chutile, veuvin; nangho dinga imajouse athenga ahi.
target: But now as for what is inside you—be generous to the poor, and everything will be clean for you.

source: Ahinla, ohe Pharisai ho nadau ahi! ijeh-inem itile nanghon pudina le lounakha chule anche louhing jouse somakhat natoh jiuvin; ahinla vaihom dihle Pathen ngailut nadonpouve; ahinla chutiho jong chu donda deh louva hicheng hi nabol dingu ahi.
target: “Woe to you Pharisees, because you give God a tenth of your mint, rue and all other kinds of garden herbs, but you neglect justice and the love of God. You should have practiced the latter without leaving the former undone.

source: Ohe Pharisai ho nangho nadau ahi! ijeh-inem itile nanghon kikhopna in'a touna pipenle, kailhanga min chibai naboh dingu nadeijun ahi.
target: “Woe to you Pharisees, because you love the most important seats in the synagogues and respectful greetings in the marketplaces.

source: Ohe, danthusun ho, Pharisai ho le miphalhem ho nadau ahi! ijeh-inem itile nangho buikhuh kimu lou, mihon he louva achung ajotlejiu tobang nahiuve ati.
target: “Woe to you, because you are like unmarked graves, which people walk over without knowing it.”

source: Chuin danthu them ho khatnin adonbutnin ajah-a, Houhil, nangman chutia nasei chu keiho jong neihoutomu ahi, ati.
target: One of the experts in the law answered him, “Teacher, when you say these things, you insult us also.”

source: Chuin aman, Ohe, danthu themho nangho jong nadau ahi! ijeh-inem itile nanghon poh-a kilom lou pohgih mi napohsah-un, nanghonla pohgih chu nakhut jung khatchan jong nakhoiji pouve.
target: Jesus replied, “And you experts in the law, woe to you, because you load people down with burdens they can hardly carry, and you yourselves will not lift one finger to help them.

source: Nangho nadau ahi! ijeh-inem itile naputeu napateu vin themgaoho athatnun, nanghon alhanu nasempeh jiuvin ahi.
target: “Woe to you, because you build tombs for the prophets, and it was your ancestors who killed them.

source: Chutichu ahi jeh-in hichu ahetoh nangho nahiuvin, napu napateu thilbol chu naphasah uve; ijeh-inem itile amahon amaho chu athatnun, nanghon alhan natungun ahi.
target: So you testify that you approve of what your ancestors did; they killed the prophets, and you build their tombs.

source: Hijeh chun Pathen chihna-in jong ahiti seije, Keiman ahenguva themgaoho le solchah ho soling ting; chule amahon abang athaova abang abolset dingu ahi;
target: Because of this, God in his wisdom said, ‘I will send them prophets and apostles, some of whom they will kill and others they will persecute.’

source: Chutia chu Abel thisan kiso-a pat, maicham le Pathen houin kikah-a Zachariah athaova athisan kisogei, vannoi leiset bul kiphu tila patna themgaoho jouse thisan kiso chu, hiche tulai khang mite chunga aphu kila ding ahi.
target: Therefore this generation will be held responsible for the blood of all the prophets that has been shed since the beginning of the world,

source: Ahi, nangho jah-a kasei ahi, tulai mite chungabou kila ding ahi.
target: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary. Yes, I tell you, this generation will be held responsible for it all.

source: Ohe, danthu themho nadau ahi! ijeh-inem itile nanghon hetna kot-heh nalamangun, nanghola nalutpouvin, mi alut dingla nakhamun ahi, ati.
target: “Woe to you experts in the law, because you have taken away the key to knowledge. You yourselves have not entered, and you have hindered those who were entering.”

source: Chuin ajah uva thu chucheng asei phat chun, danthu sunho le Pharisai hon lunghan sah-a thu tamtah seisah din, hachang phinin aphin pan taovin ahi.
target: When Jesus went outside, the Pharisees and the teachers of the law began to oppose him fiercely and to besiege him with questions,

source: Amoso theina diuvin akama kona phabep khat jahdingin aholun, chule achangun ahi.
target: waiting to catch him in something he might say.

source: Hiche pet chun mipi atama tam, khat chunga khat kal leuva ahung kikhop phat chun, aman amasa penin aseijuite jah-a, Pharisai ho chola chun kihong phaovin; hichu phatlhem ahi.
target: Meanwhile, when a crowd of many thousands had gathered, so that they were trampling on one another, Jesus began to speak first to his disciples, saying: “Be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

source: Ahinla akiphongdoh lou ding akisela imacha aumpoi, chule hetdoh lou ding imacha aki-ima jong aumpoi.
target: There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, or hidden that will not be made known.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu muthima naseichanu chu khovah-a kija ding ahi; chule indan sungnunga nabenga guhthima naseiju chu, in chunga kisam ding ahi.
target: What you have said in the dark will be heard in the daylight, and what you have whispered in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed from the roofs.

source: Chule kajol kagol nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, tahsa thattheija akal ima lo thei lou chu kicha hih-un.
target: “I tell you, my friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that can do no more.

source: Keiman nakichat dingu hilunge; atha nunga damuna lelutna ding thaneina neija ama chu kichauvin, najah uva kasei ahi; ama chu kichauvin.
target: But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear him who, after your body has been killed, has authority to throw you into hell. Yes, I tell you, fear him.

source: Vasilih nga khu paisa ni manna kilhaji louham? Ahin, alah uva khat jengcha jong Pathen angah suhmilin aumkhapon ahi.
target: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten by God.

source: Ahin nalu chunguva nasamjang jouseu sana kisim sohkeija ahi. Kicha hih-un; vasilih tamtah sanga nangho lujo nahiuve.
target: Indeed, the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Don’t be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.

source: Chule najah uva kasei ahi, Koi hile miho anga keima eiseidoh chan chu, Mihem Chapan jong ama chu Pathen vantil teho anga aseidoh ding ahi:
target: “I tell you, whoever publicly acknowledges me before others, the Son of Man will also acknowledge before the angels of God.

source: Amavang miho anga keima eiseileppa vang chu, Pathen vantil teho anga ama jong kiseilep ding ahi.
target: But whoever disowns me before others will be disowned before the angels of God.

source: Chule Mihem Chapa chunga thuse sei jouse chu kingaidam ding ahi; Lhagao Theng taitoma vang chu kingaidam lou ding ahi.
target: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but anyone who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

source: Chule amahon nangho kikhopna-a vaipoho hengle thunei ho henga nakai tengule, Ipi-a iti kadonbut dingham, ipi kasei dingham tin lungkham hih-un;
target: “When you are brought before synagogues, rulers and authorities, do not worry about how you will defend yourselves or what you will say,

source: Ijeh-inem itile apettah chule Lhagao Thengin nasei dingu nahil dingu ahinai, ati.
target: for the Holy Spirit will teach you at that time what you should say.”

source: Chuin mipi lah-a kon chun mikhatnin, Mihil, nei le gou eikihoppi dingin ka-u jah-a seijin, ati.
target: Someone in the crowd said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”

source: Ahivangin aman ajah-a, Mihem, kon nangho chunga vaihomle neile gou hoppeh-a eisemem? ati.
target: Jesus replied, “Man, who appointed me a judge or an arbiter between you?”

source: Chuin ajah uvah, Ching theijun, neipap kiloset jouse-a konin kikangseuvin; ijeh-inem itile mihem khat hinkho hi anei le gou haona-a chu uma ahipoi, ati.
target: Then he said to them, “Watch out! Be on your guard against all kinds of greed; life does not consist in an abundance of possessions.”

source: Chuin aman ajah uva thulem khat aseijin, Mihao khat gam sungah neh aput behseh jengin;
target: And he told them this parable: “The ground of a certain rich man yielded an abundant harvest.

source: Hichun aman alungthimin, Kalousoh chengse kakoikhomna ding munla aumpon; i-kalo ding hitam? ati.
target: He thought to himself, ‘What shall I do? I have no place to store my crops.’

source: Chuin aman, hitin bolinge: kachangsal chengse phelhang ting, asanga lenjo cheh-in sangkate; chule kalousoh jousele kathil jouse chua chun koikhom inge.
target: “Then he said, ‘This is what I’ll do. I will tear down my barns and build bigger ones, and there I will store my surplus grain.

source: Chutengle kalhagao jah-a, Lhagao, nangman kum sottah-a dinga thil tamtah nakikhol khom ahitai; kicholdon, nenlang donin, nomsa tah-in umin tinge, ati.
target: And I’ll say to myself, “You have plenty of grain laid up for many years. Take life easy; eat, drink and be merry.” ’

source: Ahinla Pathen'in ama jah-a, Vo lungthimbei, tujana hi nahinna nanga kona kiladoh ding ahitai; chule nathil kholkhom chengse chu koija hitantem? ati.
target: “But God said to him, ‘You fool! This very night your life will be demanded from you. Then who will get what you have prepared for yourself?’

source: Pathen'a dinga haolouva ama dinga sum kikhola chu chutobang chu ahi, ati.
target: “This is how it will be with whoever stores up things for themselves but is not rich toward God.”

source: Chuin aman aseijuite jah-a, Hijeh-a chu nangho jah-a kasei ahi, I-kaneh ding hitam tin nahinna dingule, i-kasila kachen ding hitam tin natahsa dingun lungkham hih-un.
target: Then Jesus said to his disciples: “Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat; or about your body, what you will wear.

source: Ijeh-inem itile anneh sanga hinkho, nihchen ponsil sanga tahsa thupijo ahi.
target: For life is more than food, and the body more than clothes.

source: Va-ah hokhu ngaitouvin; amahon tula atupouvin, atla a-at pouvin; pang le changsal la aneipouvin; ahivangin Pathen'in amaho khu avahnai. Nangho vacha sanga iti nalutjoh-u hitam?
target: Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storeroom or barn; yet God feeds them. And how much more valuable you are than birds!

source: Chule nangho lah-a lungkham hatna ahinkho tongkhat jopsaobe thei koi nahiuvem?
target: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to your life?

source: Hijeh chun nanghon aneopenbon nabol thei louvule, adangdang dinga ibola lungkhama nahiuvem?
target: Since you cannot do this very little thing, why do you worry about the rest?

source: Molhoipah khu iti khanham ngaitouvin: hiche ho khun tongla atonggim pouvin, patla akheh pouvin; ahivanginla keiman kaseipeh nahiuve, Solomon jeng jong aloupina jouse-a akivon chun, hiche molhoipah khattoh kibangin akijem hoi pon ahi.
target: “Consider how the wild flowers grow. They do not labor or spin. Yet I tell you, not even Solomon in all his splendor was dressed like one of these.

source: Chule jaova hampa tunia uma jinga lhum sunga kileh lutta ding jengbon Pathen'in achuti jeple, Vo tahsan lhomho, chusanga chu aman nangho najepjoh lou dinguham?
target: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today, and tomorrow is thrown into the fire, how much more will he clothe you—you of little faith!

source: Chule ipi naneh dingu, ipi nadon dingu, hichu hol hih-un, chule lung dongin jong um hih-un.
target: And do not set your heart on what you will eat or drink; do not worry about it.

source: Ijeh-inem itile vannoi namtinin hitiho jouse chu aholjiuve: ahin hitiho chu nanghon nangai chaove ti na-Pau vin ahenai.
target: For the pagan world runs after all such things, and your Father knows that you need them.

source: Ahivangin nanghon Pathen lenggam joh chu holun, chutengle hicheng jouse hi naki pehbe dingu ahi.
target: But seek his kingdom, and these things will be given to you as well.

source: Hon lhomho, kicha hih-un; ijeh-inem itile nangho lenggam pehding hi na-Pau lungdei ahi lheh jenge.
target: “Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father has been pleased to give you the kingdom.

source: Naneichan-u joh-unlang mivaicha gentheiho peuvin; chule guchan amaiphah louna, nget nin jong anehset louna, van'ah sumbom lui thei lou kisemun, kemlou sum kikholun.
target: Sell your possessions and give to the poor. Provide purses for yourselves that will not wear out, a treasure in heaven that will never fail, where no thief comes near and no moth destroys.

source: Ijeh-inem itile nagou umna-a chu nalungu jong umding ahi.
target: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

source: Natai kigeh-un, chule nathaomei vahsah jingun;
target: “Be dressed ready for service and keep your lamps burning,

source: Chule moupui na-a kona ahunga, kot ahin kiu phat phatle hongpai jeng dinga a-pakai lam kat jinga um mitoh bangun.
target: like servants waiting for their master to return from a wedding banquet, so that when he comes and knocks they can immediately open the door for him.

source: Pakai ahunga soh kiging jinga um ahungtoho chu anunnom ahiuve; keiman nangho tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Aman atai akigeh-a, amaho chu ankong aumsah-a, ahenguva hunga amatah ajenleuva pang ding ahi.
target: It will be good for those servants whose master finds them watching when he comes. Truly I tell you, he will dress himself to serve, will have them recline at the table and will come and wait on them.

source: Chule ama jan dan nina ahim, jan dan thumna ahima ahunga, chuto banga chu ahung to-a ahile, hitobang soh ho chu anunnom ahiuve.
target: It will be good for those servants whose master finds them ready, even if he comes in the middle of the night or toward daybreak.

source: Chule itih phatna gucha ahung ding inneipun ahet hile, kiging jingintin, phetvang dinga a-in chu adalhah louhel ding ahi, hichu nanghon heuvin.
target: But understand this: If the owner of the house had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have let his house be broken into.

source: Nangho phasademin umum; ijeh-inem itile nagel lou pettah-ule Mihem Chapa chu hung ding ahi, ati.
target: You also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him.”

source: Chuin Peter'in, Pakai, hiche thulem chu keiho chang dinga naseiha, mi jouse dinga naseiham? ati.
target: Peter asked, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everyone?”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin, Neiching tahsan umtah le chingtah, aphatcha achan cheh-u an hoppeh dinga a-pakaipan a-insunga jouse chunga apipua apansah ding chu koiham?
target: The Lord answered, “Who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their food allowance at the proper time?

source: Apakai ahung tenga chutia bol ahungto soh chu anunnom ahi.
target: It will be good for that servant whom the master finds doing so when he returns.

source: Nangho tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Ama chu anei jouse chunga apipua apansah ding ahi.
target: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.

source: Amavang sohpa chun, Ka pakai ahung geije tihen, soh numei ho le soh pasal ho deng pan tahen, chule nehen, donhen khamtale,
target: But suppose the servant says to himself, ‘My master is taking a long time in coming,’ and he then begins to beat the other servants, both men and women, and to eat and drink and get drunk.

source: Hiche sohpa chun aginchat lou nitahle, ahetlou pettah-a a-pakaipa chu hunga; ama chu tum ni asoa, achan chu tahsan louho lah-a akoi ding ahi.
target: The master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he is not aware of. He will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the unbelievers.

source: Chule soh a-pakai lung lam he-a, phasadema umlou, chule alunggot banga bol lou chu tamtah vei kivo ding ahi:
target: “The servant who knows the master’s will and does not get ready or does not do what the master wants will be beaten with many blows.

source: Ahin hetlouva voh ding dola thilbola vang chu kivo lhom ding ahi. Ijeh inem itile tamtah kipe henga chu tamtah kibeng ding; chule koi hile atamjocheh kivopsah henga chu atamjo cheh kingeh ding ahi.
target: But the one who does not know and does things deserving punishment will be beaten with few blows. From everyone who has been given much, much will be demanded; and from the one who has been entrusted with much, much more will be asked.

source: Keima vannoi leiset chunga mei lehlha dinga hunga kahi; tutah jeng jong hin kadohtale katinave!
target: “I have come to bring fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!

source: Ahivangin baptize chan ding kaneijin, chuche kamolso masangse-a iti kaningnoh hitam!
target: But I have a baptism to undergo, and what constraint I am under until it is completed!

source: Lei chunga chamna lensah dinga hunga neingai touvem? Ahipoi, kaseipeh nahiuve, asukhen dingjoh-a hung kahibouve:
target: Do you think I came to bring peace on earth? No, I tell you, but division.

source: Ijeh-inem itile tukal insung khatna mi nga umchu ni-a kikhen diu, nin thum adouva, thumin ni adou ding ahi.
target: From now on there will be five in one family divided against each other, three against two and two against three.

source: Pan achapa adou ding, chapan apa adou ding, nun achanu adou ding; chanun anu adouding, teh-in amounu adou ding, mouvin atehpi adouva kikhento diu ahi, ati.
target: They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.”

source: Chuin aman mipi ho jah-a jong chun, Nanghon lhum lama mei soh namu tengule, go ju ding ahi nati paijen jiuvin; chule ahitahbeh jin ahi.
target: He said to the crowd: “When you see a cloud rising in the west, immediately you say, ‘It’s going to rain,’ and it does.

source: Chule lhang lama kona hui anunle, sa lheh ding ahi natiji uvin; hi jong chu achutijin ahi.
target: And when the south wind blows, you say, ‘It’s going to be hot,’ and it is.

source: Nangho miphalhem ho, nanghon leiset chungle van umjela nasuto thei naovin, tulai hiti thil umchan iti nasuhto thei lou uham?
target: Hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky. How is it that you don’t know how to interpret this present time?

source: Chule ibola nanghon adihlam chu nakingaito lou uham?
target: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?

source: Ijeh-inem itile naheh patoh thutan vaipo henga nache tengule, lampia ama-a kona kiteldohna dingin kihabolin, achuti loule aman nang thutan vaipo henga nacham louva nakai ding ahi; chule thutan vaihom chun sottol miman khutna pen natin, sottol miman chun songkul'a nakhum ding ahi.
target: As you are going with your adversary to the magistrate, try hard to be reconciled on the way, or your adversary may drag you off to the judge, and the judge turn you over to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

source: Kaseipeh nahi, nangman paisa san khat geija nasahsoh masangse-a, iti jongle chua kona napotdoh louhel ding ahi.
target: I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny.”

source: Hiche pettah chun akoma um phabepmin, Pilate'in Galilee miho atha-a, athisanu a-Pathen hou nahou toh achopel thu chu ajah-a aseijun ahi.
target: Now there were some present at that time who told Jesus about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

source: Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin, ajah uva, Chutobang athoh jeh uva chu amaho chu Galilee miho jouse sanga chonse deh ahiuve, tia nangaitou vem?
target: Jesus answered, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans because they suffered this way?

source: Kaseipeh nahiuve, ahipoi: nangho jong lung nahei louvule chutobangma chu namanthah dingu ahi.
target: I tell you, no! But unless you repent, you too will all perish.

source: Chule Siloam insang achima mi somleget adel lihho jong chu Jerusalem'a cheng jouse sanga suhkhel neideh-a nangaitou vem?
target: Or those eighteen who died when the tower in Siloam fell on them—do you think they were more guilty than all the others living in Jerusalem?

source: Kaseipeh nahiuve, ahipoi: nangho jong lung nahei louvule chutobangma chu namanthah dingu ahi, ati.
target: I tell you, no! But unless you repent, you too will all perish.”

source: Chuin aman thulem hiche hi aseijin ahi: Mikhat hin alengpi leijah theichang phung khat kiphut aneijin; chuin aga ahung holin ahile, khatcha jong amupon ahi.
target: Then he told this parable: “A man had a fig tree growing in his vineyard, and he went to look for fruit on it but did not find any.

source: Chuin aman lengpilei lhoupa jah-a, Ven, hiche kum thum sung hin kahungin, theichang phunga aga kahung holjin khatchala kamupoi; phuh lhutan; hiche hin idinga alei manmo aso dingham? ati.
target: So he said to the man who took care of the vineyard, ‘For three years now I’ve been coming to look for fruit on this fig tree and haven’t found any. Cut it down! Why should it use up the soil?’

source: Chuin aman adonbutnin ajah-a, Pakai, tu kum-in jong hoitadin; keiman akimvel lai jingting, bong-eh sunginge;
target: “ ‘Sir,’ the man replied, ‘leave it alone for one more year, and I’ll dig around it and fertilize it.

source: Chukala agale apha; aga lou vangle phuhtan, ati.
target: If it bears fruit next year, fine! If not, then cut it down.’ ”

source: Chuin cholngah nin kikhopna in khatnah thu ahilin ahi.
target: On a Sabbath Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues,

source: Hia chun veuvin, kum somle kum get chamona lhagao vop numei khat aumin; amanu chu atingbonga, achama dingjang thei louhel ahi.
target: and a woman was there who had been crippled by a spirit for eighteen years. She was bent over and could not straighten up at all.

source: Chuin Jesu'n amanu chu amu phatnin, akouvin, ajah-a, Numei, nachamona-a kona kilhadoh nahitai, ati.
target: When Jesus saw her, he called her forward and said to her, “Woman, you are set free from your infirmity.”

source: Chuin amanu chungah akhut angamin ahile chupettah chun ajangpaihel jengin, Pathen avahchoitan ahi.
target: Then he put his hands on her, and immediately she straightened up and praised God.

source: Chuin cholngah ni-a Jesu'n adamsah jeh chun, kikhopna in vaipopa chun lunghang tah-in adonbutnin, miho jah-a, Mihemin na atohna ding ni gup uma ahin; hiche sung chun hungun lang kibol damuvin; cholngah ni vangle hungji hih-un, ati.
target: Indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, the synagogue leader said to the people, “There are six days for work. So come and be healed on those days, not on the Sabbath.”

source: Ahinla Pakaiyin ama chu adonbutnin, Nangho mi miphalhem ho, nanghon nabongchalu hijongle, nasangan'u hi jongle cholngah ni-a a-ankonga kona nasutlhah uva twi dona napui chehji hih-um?
target: The Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each of you on the Sabbath untie your ox or donkey from the stall and lead it out to give it water?

source: Achutile Abraham son hiche numeinu hi, veuvin, kum somle kum get Satan'in ahen na-a kona cholngah ni-a sutlhah angai hilouham? ati.
target: Then should not this woman, a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has kept bound for eighteen long years, be set free on the Sabbath day from what bound her?”

source: Thu chucheng asei phatnin adouho chu ajahcha taovin; mipi chengse vang chu athilbol loupi jouse jeh chun akipah sohkeijun ahi.
target: When he said this, all his opponents were humiliated, but the people were delighted with all the wonderful things he was doing.

source: Hijeh chun aman hitin seije, Pathen lenggam chu itobang ham? Ipitoh katekah ding ham?
target: Then Jesus asked, “What is the kingdom of God like? What shall I compare it to?

source: Ankam mu chang khat mikhatnin alah-a ahona athea, akhandoh-a thingphung asoa, abah lah-a chunga leng vachaho age tobang ahi, ati.
target: It is like a mustard seed, which a man took and planted in his garden. It grew and became a tree, and the birds perched in its branches.”

source: Chuin aman aseiben, Pathen lenggam chu ipitoh katekah ding ham?
target: Again he asked, “What shall I compare the kingdom of God to?

source: Numei khatnin chol alah-a, changbong dan thum lah-a aboncha apomsoh kahse-a avui tobang ahi, ati.
target: It is like yeast that a woman took and mixed into about sixty pounds of flour until it worked all through the dough.”

source: Chutichun aman khopihole khoneoho ajotnin, thu ahilpeh-in, Jerusalem ajonin ahi.
target: Then Jesus went through the towns and villages, teaching as he made his way to Jerusalem.

source: Chuin mikhatnin ajah-a, Pakai, huhhing-a umding hohi lhom uvam? ati.
target: Someone asked him, “Lord, are only a few people going to be saved?” He said to them,

source: Chuin aman amaho jah-a, Kot jima lut ding kichu-uvin: ijeh-inem itile keiman nangho kaseipeh nahiuve, mi tamtah lut kigo ding, ahivanga lut thei lou ding ahi.
target: “Make every effort to enter through the narrow door, because many, I tell you, will try to enter and will not be able to.

source: Ahivangin a-inneipu akipatdoh-a kot akha nungle nangho polama nadin uva, Pakai, Pakai, kot neihonun, tia kot nakiu tengule; aman, Hoilam kon mi nahiu kahepoi ati ding;
target: Once the owner of the house gets up and closes the door, you will stand outside knocking and pleading, ‘Sir, open the door for us.’ “But he will answer, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’

source: Chutengle nanghon, Na-ang sungtah-a jong kaneuvin kadonun, chule kakhosung lamlenuva jong neihilui nati dingu;
target: “Then you will say, ‘We ate and drank with you, and you taught in our streets.’

source: Chule aman, Keiman nangho hoilam kon nahiu kahepoi; kakoma konin chemangun, nangho chonset bolteho, ati ding ahi.
target: “But he will reply, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from. Away from me, all you evildoers!’

source: Abraham, Isaac, Jacob chule themgaoho jouse Pathen lenggama a-umu namuva, nangho pama nakiledoh-u namu tengule, hikoma chu kale hagel umding ahi.
target: “There will be weeping there, and gnashing of teeth, when you see Abraham, Isaac and Jacob and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but you yourselves thrown out.

source: Chule amaho solamle lhum lama kon, sahlam le lhanglama kona hunguva, Pathen lenggama tou ding ahiuve.
target: People will come from east and west and north and south, and will take their places at the feast in the kingdom of God.

source: Chule, veuvin, anukhahho chu masa ding, chule amasaho chu nukhah ding ahi, ati.
target: Indeed there are those who are last who will be first, and first who will be last.”

source: Hiche pettah chun Pharisai ho phabep ahungun, ajah-a, Hikoma konin potdoh-in; chemangtan, ijeh-inem itile Herod'in tha dingin natupme, atiuve.
target: At that time some Pharisees came to Jesus and said to him, “Leave this place and go somewhere else. Herod wants to kill you.”

source: Chuin aman amaho jah-a, Cheovinlang chuche Sial jah-a chun gaseijun, Ven, keiman tunile jinga thilhaho kanodoh-a, anaho kadamsah ahin, athum ni leh kachaisoh ding ahi.
target: He replied, “Go tell that fox, ‘I will keep on driving out demons and healing people today and tomorrow, and on the third day I will reach my goal.’

source: Ahoi hijongle tunile jinga, chule akitni leh kachena dinga kachepeh ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile Jerusalem louva themgao thi thei ahipoi.
target: In any case, I must press on today and tomorrow and the next day—for surely no prophet can die outside Jerusalem!

source: Vo Jerusalem, Jerusalem, themgaoho that le ahenga kisol teho songa seplih; ahpin anoute alha noija a-opkhum banga, keiman jong nachate ijatvei opkhum dinga kagot hitam! Ahin nangho nanompouve.
target: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you were not willing.

source: Veuvin, na-in chu akamhel dinga nangho kidalhah peh nahiuve; chule tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Pakai mina hungpa chu anunnome nati masang seuva, keima neimu lou dingu ahi, ati.
target: Look, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me again until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.’”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, cholngah nin Pharisai ho pipu khat in'a an nedingin achen, amahon avelhi jingun ahi.
target: One Sabbath, when Jesus went to eat in the house of a prominent Pharisee, he was being carefully watched.

source: Chuin veuvin, amasanga chun akhut akeng pom khat aumin.
target: There in front of him was a man suffering from abnormal swelling of his body.

source: Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin danthu themho le Pharisai ho jah-a thu aseijin, Cholngah ni-a boldam danngai ham? ati.
target: Jesus asked the Pharisees and experts in the law, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath or not?”

source: Amahola athipbeh-un ahi. Chuin aman ama chu alan aboldamin, chuin achesahtan ahi.
target: But they remained silent. So taking hold of the man, he healed him and sent him on his way.

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Nalah uva koi nahiuvem, asangan ahim abongchal ahim twikul'a lhalut tale, cholngah ni-a agaloidoh paijeng lou dinga? ati.
target: Then he asked them, “If one of you has a child or an ox that falls into a well on the Sabbath day, will you not immediately pull it out?”

source: Chuin amahon hicheng chu adonbut thei kit tapouve.
target: And they had nothing to say.

source: Chuin akikouhon touna phapha alhenu amu phatnin, thulem khat aseijin ajah uva,
target: When he noticed how the guests picked the places of honor at the table, he told them this parable:

source: Nangho mi khattouvin moupui golvahna-a nakou tengule touna pipen-ah tou hih-un; ajole nangho sanga ja umjo akou umkhantin;
target: “When someone invites you to a wedding feast, do not take the place of honor, for a person more distinguished than you may have been invited.

source: Akoupa le ahungpa chu anilhonin hungintin najah-a, Hichepa hi mun otnin ati ding; chutengle nangma jahcha puma anoinung pena natou ding ahi.
target: If so, the host who invited both of you will come and say to you, ‘Give this person your seat.’ Then, humiliated, you will have to take the least important place.

source: Amavang nangma nakikou tengle, chenlang anempena touvin; hitichu hile nakoupa ahung tengle najah-a, Jol, sangjep-ah toutango tikhat nintin; hiteng chule ankonga natoupi jouse maija chu choi-atna naum ding ahi.
target: But when you are invited, take the lowest place, so that when your host comes, he will say to you, ‘Friend, move up to a better place.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all the other guests.

source: Ijeh-inem itile ama kichoisang jouse chu kisunem ding; chule ama kineosah-a chu choisanga umding ahi, ati.
target: For all those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.”

source: Chuin aman akoupa jah-a, Nangman sun hijongle jan hijongle golvah nabol tengle, najol, nagol jong, nasopi ho jong kou hih-in, nainkote le naheng nakom mihaoho jong kou hih-in; ajole amahon jong nangma kouvin natin sadoh getnun nate.
target: Then Jesus said to his host, “When you give a luncheon or dinner, do not invite your friends, your brothers or sisters, your relatives, or your rich neighbors; if you do, they may invite you back and so you will be repaid.

source: Ahin golvah nabol tengle, mivaicha, mi tikimlou, elbai, mitcho koujo bouvin;
target: But when you give a banquet, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, the blind,

source: Chule nangma nanun nom ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile amaho chun lesahna ding ima aneipouve: ajeh chu mi chondihho tho kit tengle nangma nakisa ding ahi, ati.
target: and you will be blessed. Although they cannot repay you, you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.”

source: Chuin ankonga atoupiho khatnin hitiho chu ajan, ajah uva, Pathen lenggama changlhah ne dingpa chu anunnoma ahi, ati.
target: When one of those at the table with him heard this, he said to Jesus, “Blessed is the one who will eat at the feast in the kingdom of God.”

source: Ahin aman ajah-a, Mi koiham khatnin jan golvah loupitah abolin; chule mi tamtah akouvin;
target: Jesus replied: “A certain man was preparing a great banquet and invited many guests.

source: Chuin anneh phatnin aman akouho chu, Hungun, tun ijakai aphasadem cheh ahitai ti dingin asohpa asolin ahi.
target: At the time of the banquet he sent his servant to tell those who had been invited, ‘Come, for everything is now ready.’

source: Chuin amaho chu thakhat tah-in ana thuphaove. Amasapenpan ajah-a, Keiman lou kachon, kache-a kagavet lou akhoh-e; katao ahi, neilha ongin, ati.
target: “But they all alike began to make excuses. The first said, ‘I have just bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please excuse me.’

source: Chuin khatpan, Keiman bongchal to nga kachon, aphat aset patep dinga che ding kahi; katao ahi, neilha ongin, ati.
target: “Another said, ‘I have just bought five yoke of oxen, and I’m on my way to try them out. Please excuse me.’

source: Chuin khatpan, Keiman ji kaneijin, hijeh chun hung theiponge, ati.
target: “Still another said, ‘I just got married, so I can’t come.’

source: Hijeh chun sohpa chu ahungin hitiho chu a-pakaipa henga alhutnin ahi. Chutah-in inneipu chu alunghangin asohpa jah-a chun, Chedoh loijin khosung lamlen le khopi sung thokah juija gachen, chule mi vaicha, mi tibukimlou, chule mitcho, elbai hikoma gapuilutnin ati.
target: “The servant came back and reported this to his master. Then the owner of the house became angry and ordered his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and alleys of the town and bring in the poor, the crippled, the blind and the lame.’

source: Chuin sohpa chun, Pakai, neithupeh bangin kabolin, ahivangin mun a-ong nalaije, ati.
target: “ ‘Sir,’ the servant said, ‘what you ordered has been done, but there is still room.’

source: Chuin pakai chun sohpa jah-a chun, Nangma lamlhongle daipamah chen, chule ka-in adimna dingin, miho gajollut teiteijin.
target: “Then the master told his servant, ‘Go out to the roads and country lanes and compel them to come in, so that my house will be full.

source: Kaseipeh nahi, Kami kouho chu khatchan jong kagolvah an atepkhahlou dingu ahi, ati.
target: I tell you, not one of those who were invited will get a taste of my banquet.’ ”

source: Hichun mipi hon tamtah amatoh alhonun; chuin ama akiheijin ajah uva,
target: Large crowds were traveling with Jesus, and turning to them he said:

source: Koi hijongle kahenga hunga apa, anu, aji, achate, asopipaho, asopinuho chule ama hinkho jeng jong itcha louhela bollou chu kaseijui hi thei lou ding ahi.
target: “If anyone comes to me and does not hate father and mother, wife and children, brothers and sisters—yes, even their own life—such a person cannot be my disciple.

source: Koi hile athingpel kiputle-a kanung hin jui lou chu kaseijui hi thei lou ding ahi.
target: And whoever does not carry their cross and follow me cannot be my disciple.

source: Ijeh-inem itile insang sah ding go-an touva ijat lut dingham, chule ajojou ding hina ajo joulou dingham, tia sutoh masa lou nalah uva koi nahiuvem?
target: “Suppose one of you wants to build a tower. Won’t you first sit down and estimate the cost to see if you have enough money to complete it?

source: Ama chun abul phutdoh hen jouta hihle, ija kihe-am, amuho jousen ama chu nuisat untin,
target: For if you lay the foundation and are not able to finish it, everyone who sees it will ridicule you,

source: Hichepan asapanin, ajou joutapoi, ti getnunte.
target: saying, ‘This person began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’

source: Ahiloule leng khat leng chom khattoh kisatto dingan, asat dinga hung mi sangsomni chu mi sang soma ajo ding hina ajolou dingham, ti touva geltoh masa lou dinga koiham?
target: “Or suppose a king is about to go to war against another king. Won’t he first sit down and consider whether he is able with ten thousand men to oppose the one coming against him with twenty thousand?

source: Ajo lou dinga ahile, khat chu gamla tah-a aum petna kichamna thutep thum dinga palai asol ding ahi.
target: If he is not able, he will send a delegation while the other is still a long way off and will ask for terms of peace.

source: Hitobanga chu nangho lah-a jong anei chengse dalha louva chu kaseijui hi thei lou ding ahi.
target: In the same way, those of you who do not give up everything you have cannot be my disciples.

source: Chi hi aphai, ahivangin chi jeng jong tamta henlang hile ipi-a ki-alsah dingham?
target: “Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again?

source: Leining dinla aphapon, bong-eh din jongla aphatna umlou ahitan; min hichu pam lama apaidohjin ahi. Angaina ding na neijan ngaihen, ati.
target: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile; it is thrown out. “Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear.”

source: Hichun kaidongho jousele michonseho jouse athu ngai dingin ahengah ahung naijun ahi.
target: Now the tax collectors and sinners were all gathering around to hear Jesus.

source: Chuin Pharisaiho le danthu sunhon, Hichepan michonseho aloijin, amahotoh an ane khome atiuvin aphun gel taovin ahi.
target: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law muttered, “This man welcomes sinners and eats with them.”

source: Chuin aman amaho jah-a thulem hiche hi aseije,
target: Then Jesus told them this parable:

source: Nangho lah-a koi nahiuvem, kelngoi jakhat neija, alah-a khat amanle amanglou somko le ko chu gama dalha-a, avahmang khat chu amudoh kahse-a hol louva?
target: “Suppose one of you has a hundred sheep and loses one of them. Doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine in the open country and go after the lost sheep until he finds it?

source: Chule amudoh tengle kipahtah-in alengkouva apujin;
target: And when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders

source: Chule in ahung lhun tengle agolho le a-inhengho akou khomin, ajah uva, Neikipa piuvin; ijeh-inem itile kakelngoi manga chu kamutai, ati.
target: and goes home. Then he calls his friends and neighbors together and says, ‘Rejoice with me; I have found my lost sheep.’

source: Kaseipeh nahiuve, chutobang chun alung hei ding khoh lou michonpha somko le ko chunga sanga, michonse khat lungheija van'a kipana umding ahi.
target: I tell you that in the same way there will be more rejoicing in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous persons who do not need to repent.

source: Ahiloule numei koiham dangka som neija, khat amansahle meivah dea, chule in theh-a amudoh kahse-a gunchu tah-a hol lou dinga?
target: “Or suppose a woman has ten silver coins and loses one. Doesn’t she light a lamp, sweep the house and search carefully until she finds it?

source: Chule amanun amudoh tengle agolhole a-inhengho akou khomin, Neikipa piuvin; ijeh-inem itile kadangka mansah chu kamutai, atijin ahi.
target: And when she finds it, she calls her friends and neighbors together and says, ‘Rejoice with me; I have found my lost coin.’

source: Kaseipeh nahiuve, chutobang chun Pathen vantilte angah michonse khat lunghei chungah kipana aumjin ahi, ati.
target: In the same way, I tell you, there is rejoicing in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents.”

source: Chuin aman, Mikhatnin chapa ni aneijin:
target: Jesus continued: “There was a man who had two sons.

source: Chule aneojopa chun apa jah-a, Hepa, kagou chan ding chu neipen, ati. Chuin aman anei chu ahop pehtan ahi.
target: The younger one said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of the estate.’ So he divided his property between them.

source: Chuin ni chomkhat jouvin aneojopa chun abonchan achom khomin, khol gamlatah khatnah achen; chuin aman chukoma chun anei chengse chu kinomsahnan asumang sohtan ahi.
target: “Not long after that, the younger son got together all he had, set off for a distant country and there squandered his wealth in wild living.

source: Chuin aboncha asuhmang phatnin, chuche gama chun kel nasatah alhatan ahile, hichun ama chu alhasam pantan ahi.
target: After he had spent everything, there was a severe famine in that whole country, and he began to be in need.

source: Chuin ama achen, chuche gam miho khat agabelin; chuin amapa chun avoh vah dingin alou lama asolin ahi.
target: So he went and hired himself out to a citizen of that country, who sent him to his fields to feed pigs.

source: Chuin voh neh imahoh hochu neh-a oiva ding ago lheh jengin, koimanla apepon ahi.
target: He longed to fill his stomach with the pods that the pigs were eating, but no one gave him anything.

source: Chuin akhahdoh phatnin, Kapa in'a asoh thalah ho khujatpi nehkhop le nehval changlhah neija, keimala gilkela thiding kahi!
target: “When he came to his senses, he said, ‘How many of my father’s hired servants have food to spare, and here I am starving to death!

source: Keima kipat ingting kapa henga chengting, ajah-a, Pa, van douna le nangma mitmun kachonse tai;
target: I will set out and go back to my father and say to him: Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.

source: Kei nachapa tihoi kahitapoi; nasoh thalah ho khat bangin neisemin gatitange, ati.
target: I am no longer worthy to be called your son; make me like one of your hired servants.’

source: Chuin ama akipatnin, apa henga ahungtai. Ahin ama gamlatah agei nalaijin, apan amun, alung asen, alhaijelin, angonga achun, achopchuh chuh jengin ahi.
target: So he got up and went to his father. “But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion for him; he ran to his son, threw his arms around him and kissed him.

source: Chuin achapa chun ajah-a, Hepa, keima van douna le nangma mitmun kachonse tai: nachapa tihoi kahitapoi; nasoh thalah ho khat bangin neisemin, ati.
target: “The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’

source: Ahivangin apan asohho jah-a, Pon phapentah galadoh loijunlang silpeh-un, chule khutjem akhutna bupeh-un, chule kengchot sepeh-un.
target: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Quick! Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.

source: Chule bongnou kivah thao chu hinlaovin lang thatnun, chule neuhitin, nomsa tah-in umu hite:
target: Bring the fattened calf and kill it. Let’s have a feast and celebrate.

source: Ijeh-inem itile hiche kachapa hi athisa hing kit ahin; chule amangsa kimu kit ahi, ati. Hitichun nop abol pantaove.
target: For this son of mine was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.’ So they began to celebrate.

source: Hiche petna chun achapa lenjo chu louva um ahin; chuin ahunga in kom ahung naijin, ima kitum ginle lam gin ajan;
target: “Meanwhile, the older son was in the field. When he came near the house, he heard music and dancing.

source: Chuin aman asohho khat akouvin, Hikhu ipi bola hiuvam? tin adongin ahi.
target: So he called one of the servants and asked him what was going on.

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, Nanaopa hunga ahile napan damsela amu kit jeh-a bongnou kivah thao chu atha ahi, ati.
target: ‘Your brother has come,’ he replied, ‘and your father has killed the fattened calf because he has him back safe and sound.’

source: Hichun ama alunghangin, in'a che ding anomtapon ahi. Hijeh chun apa apotdoh-in, agajolin ahi.
target: “The older brother became angry and refused to go in. So his father went out and pleaded with him.

source: Ahivangin aman apa adonbutnin, Ven, keiman kum hijat hi nangma kajenin, khatveicha jong nathu kapal lhahna aumpoi; ahivanginla kagol hotoh golnop kabolna dingin kelnou khatcha jong imatih-in neipekhapoi.
target: But he answered his father, ‘Look! All these years I’ve been slaving for you and never disobeyed your orders. Yet you never gave me even a young goat so I could celebrate with my friends.

source: Ahin hiche nachapa notiho koma nanei chengse nemanga sumanghela hi ahung hungin bongnou kivah thao nathapeh-e, ati.
target: But when this son of yours who has squandered your property with prostitutes comes home, you kill the fattened calf for him!’

source: Chuin apan ajah-a, Chapa, nangma kakoma umjing nahin, chule kanei jouse nanga ahi.
target: “ ‘My son,’ the father said, ‘you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.

source: Hiche nanaopa vanghi athisa hing kit ahin; amangsa kimu kit ahi; hijeh-a chu nom satah leh kipahtah-a i-um dingu ahi, ati.
target: But we had to celebrate and be glad, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.’ ”

source: Chuin aman aseijuite jah-a jong hiche hi aseije, Mihaotah khatnin neiching aneijin; ama chun anei asumange tin ahenga aheh taovin ahi.
target: Jesus told his disciples: “There was a rich man whose manager was accused of wasting his possessions.

source: Chuin aman ama chu akouvin, ajah-a, Hiche nachunga thu kajah hi iti thuham? Naneichin sutoh sohkeijin lang neipen; ijeh-inem itile tukala neichinga napanthei louding ahitai, ati.
target: So he called him in and asked him, ‘What is this I hear about you? Give an account of your management, because you cannot be manager any longer.’

source: Chuin neichingpa chun ama changin, Ka pakaipan neichinga kapan eihaisah ahitan; ipi i-kati ding hitam? Lei lai dingla katha ahatpon; thum dingla kajah achan.
target: “The manager said to himself, ‘What shall I do now? My master is taking away my job. I’m not strong enough to dig, and I’m ashamed to beg—

source: Neichinga kapan eihaisah tengle mihon a-in'a eilhunsahna dingun, kabol ding tun kahetai, ati.
target: I know what I’ll do so that, when I lose my job here, people will welcome me into their houses.’

source: Chuin aman a-pakaipa sumbaho chengse chu akouvin, amasapenpa jah-a, Nangman ka pakaipa ijat nabat em? ati.
target: “So he called in each one of his master’s debtors. He asked the first, ‘How much do you owe my master?’

source: Chuin amapan, Thao tena jakhat thao, ati. Hichun neiching chun ajah-a, Nalekha sut hin lanlang tou loijin, somnga sunin, ati.
target: “ ‘Nine hundred gallons of olive oil,’ he replied. “The manager told him, ‘Take your bill, sit down quickly, and make it four hundred and fifty.’

source: Chuin adang khat jah-a, Nangin ijat nabat em? ati. Chuin aman, suhlouchang tena jakhat, ati. Chuin aman ajah-a, Nalekha sut hin lanlang somget sunin, ati.
target: “Then he asked the second, ‘And how much do you owe?’ “ ‘A thousand bushels of wheat,’ he replied. “He told him, ‘Take your bill and make it eight hundred.’

source: Chuche chondihlou neiching chun chingtheitah-a abol jeh chun a-pakaipan apahchatan ahi: ijeh-inem itile hiche vannoi leiset chate hi amaho khang mite dingin khovah chate sangin aching jouve.
target: “The master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly. For the people of this world are more shrewd in dealing with their own kind than are the people of the light.

source: Chule kaseipeh nahiuve, Chonphat louna sumin jolle gol kisemun; na lhinlel tengle amahon tonsotna chenna in'a chu nachensah na dingu ahi.
target: I tell you, use worldly wealth to gain friends for yourselves, so that when it is gone, you will be welcomed into eternal dwellings.

source: Koi hijongle themcha chunga tahsan umchu, tamtah chunga jong tahsan aumjin; themcha chunga chondihlou chu, tamtah chunga jong chondihji lou ahi.
target: “Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.

source: Chonphat louna sum chunga bon tahsan naum louvule, sumtah kon nanganseuva nachinsah dinguham?
target: So if you have not been trustworthy in handling worldly wealth, who will trust you with true riches?

source: Mi dang chunga bon tahsan naum louvule, nangho-a chu kon napeh dingu ham?
target: And if you have not been trustworthy with someone else’s property, who will give you property of your own?

source: Soh khatnin pakai ni na atongkop theipoi. Ijeh-inem itile khat hotbolintin, khat angailut ding ahi; ahiloule khatna hakai jintin, khatjoh anahsahmo ding ahi. Nangho Pathen le sum soh nahikop thei lou dingu ahi.
target: “No one can serve two masters. Either you will hate the one and love the other, or you will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.”

source: Chuin sum ngailu-a Pharisai hon hicheng chu ajauvin, ama chu anelpeh-un ahi.
target: The Pharisees, who loved money, heard all this and were sneering at Jesus.

source: Chuin aman amaho jah-a, Nangho mi mitmu-a kichonphat sahbou nahiuve; ahivangin Pathen'in nalungu ahenai; ijeh inem itile milah-a choi-atna um chu, Pathen mitmu-a thet umtah ahi.
target: He said to them, “You are the ones who justify yourselves in the eyes of others, but God knows your hearts. What people value highly is detestable in God’s sight.

source: Danthu le themgaoho thu chu John phat geija ding ahi. Chuche kala chu Pathen lenggam thuhi kihil lhanga ahin, mitin chua chun thahatsanin alut cheh-ui.
target: “The Law and the Prophets were proclaimed until John. Since that time, the good news of the kingdom of God is being preached, and everyone is forcing their way into it.

source: Ahivangin danthu halsicha khat manthah sangin, vanle lei kitolmang abaijoi.
target: It is easier for heaven and earth to disappear than for the least stroke of a pen to drop out of the Law.

source: Aji da-a achom dang kichenpi chan chu ajonga ahi; chule a-inneipun ada numei kichenpia jong chu ajonga ahi.
target: “Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery, and the man who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.

source: Tun mihaotah khat aumin, ama chun ponsandup le tupat ponnem akisilin, loupitah-in niseh-in nomsa tah-in aumjin.
target: “There was a rich man who was dressed in purple and fine linen and lived in luxury every day.

source: Chule ati pumpi-a tina veija amin Lazarus atiu khat akotbulah alupsah-un,
target: At his gate was laid a beggar named Lazarus, covered with sores

source: Chuche mihaopa dokhanga kona lhajah anmal chu neh-a oiva anomlheh jengin ahi. Achung chonin uicha hon atinaho chu ahung leh jiuvin ahi.
target: and longing to eat what fell from the rich man’s table. Even the dogs came and licked his sores.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, khutdopa chu athitan ahile vantil hon Abraham anga din ahung potaove: chuin mihaopa jong chu athitan ahile avuitaove.
target: “The time came when the beggar died and the angels carried him to Abraham’s side. The rich man also died and was buried.

source: Chuin damuna ama genthei theija akibol athohlelin, akhodale gamlatah-a Abraham le a-anga tou Lazarus chu amutan ahi.
target: In Hades, where he was in torment, he looked up and saw Abraham far away, with Lazarus by his side.

source: Chuin aman agahsamin, Kapa Abraham, neilungset in, Lazarus chu akhutjung muh twija dekot henlang kalei dedap dingin hinsolin; ijeh-inem itile keima hiche meikongah gimthoh-in kaume, ati.
target: So he called to him, ‘Father Abraham, have pity on me and send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, because I am in agony in this fire.’

source: Ahivangin Abraham'in, Kachapa, nangin nahinkho lhumkeija thil pha namu-a, hiche banga chu Lazarus'in thilphalou amu chu geldoh temin: tu vanga ama lungmong tah-a uma, chule nangma gimthoh-a um nahitai.
target: “But Abraham replied, ‘Son, remember that in your lifetime you received your good things, while Lazarus received bad things, but now he is comforted here and you are in agony.

source: Chucheng kalvalin jong keiho le nangho umna kah-a hi onghom lentah kikoidet ahin, chenom jongle hikoma kona nangho umna lama koima che thei lou; chule chua kona jong keiho lama koima hung galkai thei lou ahi, ati.
target: And besides all this, between us and you a great chasm has been set in place, so that those who want to go from here to you cannot, nor can anyone cross over from there to us.’

source: Hichun aman, Hijeh-a chu katao ahi, hepa, ama chu kapa in'a solin,
target: “He answered, ‘Then I beg you, father, send Lazarus to my family,

source: Ijeh inem itile sopi pasal nga kaneijin, amaho khu gahet tohsah hen, achuti loule amaho jong hikom nat thohgimna mun'a hi hung dingu ahi, ati.
target: for I have five brothers. Let him warn them, so that they will not also come to this place of torment.’

source: Ahinla Abraham'in, Amahon Mosi le themgaoho anei naove; amaho thu chu ngaijuhen, ati.
target: “Abraham replied, ‘They have Moses and the Prophets; let them listen to them.’

source: Chuin aman, Ahipoi, kapa Abraham; mithi lah-a mi khatmong ahenguva gachele bou alung ahei dingu ahi, ati.
target: “ ‘No, father Abraham,’ he said, ‘but if someone from the dead goes to them, they will repent.’

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, Amahon Mosi le themgaoho thu angai louvule, mithi lah-a mi khat thoudoh jongle tahsandeh pouvinte, ati.
target: “He said to him, ‘If they do not listen to Moses and the Prophets, they will not be convinced even if someone rises from the dead.’ ”

source: Chuin aman aseijuite jah-a, kipal lhuh umlou thei ahipoi, ahinla kipal lhuh sahpa chu ada ahi!
target: Jesus said to his disciples: “Things that cause people to stumble are bound to come, but woe to anyone through whom they come.

source: Hichepa chun hiche aneochaho lah-a khat akipal lhuhsah sangin, angonga sumhei song kikhaihen, twikhanglen'ah kileh lutle ama dinga phajo ahi.
target: It would be better for them to be thrown into the sea with a millstone tied around their neck than to cause one of these little ones to stumble.

source: Nangho kichih theijun, nasopi nangdouna-a achonsetle phoh-un; chua alung aheija ahile ngaidamun.
target: So watch yourselves. “If your brother or sister sins against you, rebuke them; and if they repent, forgive them.

source: Chule ama nachunga ni khat sunga sagivei achonsetna, chule sagivei nahenga ahung kiheija, Kakisih-e, atile, ngaidamin ati.
target: Even if they sin against you seven times in a day and seven times come back to you saying ‘I repent,’ you must forgive them.”

source: Chuin solchah hon Pakai jah-a chun, Pakai, katahsanu khansahben atiuve.
target: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith!”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin, Nanghon tahsan na ankam-mu te beh nanei uva ahile, hiche thingtheimi phung jah-a hin, Kibotdoh inlang twikhanglen'a kiphut in tileu chun, nathuva nung ding ahi.
target: He replied, “If you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and planted in the sea,’ and it will obey you.

source: Ahinla nangho lah-a koi nahiuvem, asohpan lou kaija, ahiloule gan chinga louva kona ahungleh henga, tule tuhin hungin, an nedingin touvin tia sei dinga?
target: “Suppose one of you has a servant plowing or looking after the sheep. Will he say to the servant when he comes in from the field, ‘Come along now and sit down to eat’?

source: Chutia titah sanga, Kaneh ding an neigot peh-in, keiman kaneh jou kadon jou kahsen natai kigeh-inlang neijenin; chujoule nangin naneh-a nadon dingbou ahi, atijoh lou dingham?
target: Won’t he rather say, ‘Prepare my supper, get yourself ready and wait on me while I eat and drink; after that you may eat and drink’?

source: Chuche sohpa chun thupeh dungjuija abol jeh-a chu a-pakaipan apachat ngaijem? Katahsanpoi.
target: Will he thank the servant because he did what he was told to do?

source: Chutobanga chu nanghon jong nakithupeh chengseu nabol jousoh tengule, Soh phachom lou kahiuve, kabol dingdol bep kabolu ahi, tiuvin, ati.
target: So you also, when you have done everything you were told to do, should say, ‘We are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty.’ ”

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Jerusalem jonin achen ahile, Samaria le Galilee gam ajotpan ahi.
target: Now on his way to Jerusalem, Jesus traveled along the border between Samaria and Galilee.

source: Chuin ama kho khatna alutnin ahile, miphah somin anakimutopin, amaho chu gamlata-a adingun,
target: As he was going into a village, ten men who had leprosy met him. They stood at a distance

source: Pipu Jesu, neilungsetnun, tin hasaptah-in asamun ahi.
target: and called out in a loud voice, “Jesus, Master, have pity on us!”

source: Chuin aman amaho chu amu phatnin, ajah uvah, Cheovinlang thempuho gakivetsah uvin, ati. Chuin ahitin ahi, acheuva ahile adam thengpa taove.
target: When he saw them, he said, “Go, show yourselves to the priests.” And as they went, they were cleansed.

source: Chuin alah uva khat chun adamthengtah chu ahet phatnin, akinunglen, aw sangtah-in Pathen avahchoijin;
target: One of them, when he saw he was healed, came back, praising God in a loud voice.

source: Chuin akengphang bulah aboh khupmin, athangvah tai; ama chu Samaria mi ahi.
target: He threw himself at Jesus’ feet and thanked him—and he was a Samaritan.

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Som kisutheng hi louham? Mi ko hoibaham?
target: Jesus asked, “Were not all ten cleansed? Where are the other nine?

source: Hiche chidang namdangpa tailou adangho Pathen vahchoi dinga hung kinungle-a akimupoi, ati.
target: Has no one returned to give praise to God except this foreigner?”

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, Thouvin, chetan; natahsanin nadamsah ahitai, ati.
target: Then he said to him, “Rise and go; your faith has made you well.”

source: Chuin, Pathen lenggam itih-a ahung lhun ding Pharisai hon adongun ahile, aman adonbutnin, Pathen lenggam chu mu theijin ahungpoi.
target: Once, on being asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, Jesus replied, “The coming of the kingdom of God is not something that can be observed,

source: Veuvin, hikomah, ahiloule khukomah kiti lou ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile veuvin, Pathen lenggam nalah uva aume, ati.
target: nor will people say, ‘Here it is,’ or ‘There it is,’ because the kingdom of God is in your midst.”

source: Chuin aman aseijuite jah-a, Nanghon Mihem Chapa hinlai nikhoho khat beh namu nom dingu, ahivanga namu lou dingu nikho chu hung lhung ding ahi.
target: Then he said to his disciples, “The time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it.

source: Chutengle, veuvin, khukomah; veuvin, hikomah tia najah uva asei dingu ahi; ahivangin nangho che hih-un, amaho nung jong jui hih-un;
target: People will tell you, ‘There he is!’ or ‘Here he is!’ Do not go running off after them.

source: Ijeh-inem itile kolphe vannoi kolmong lang khat lama aphetna, kolmong lang khat geija asalvahji banga, Mihem Chapa hung ni jong chutobang ding ahi.
target: For the Son of Man in his day will be like the lightning, which flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other.

source: Ahivangin hiche masanga chu thil tamtah athoh ding, chule hiche khang mite paija umtei ding ahi.
target: But first he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

source: Chule Noah hinlai thilsoh umchan bang chu, Mihem Chapa nikho jongle hi ding ahi.
target: “Just as it was in the days of Noah, so also will it be in the days of the Son of Man.

source: Noah kong'a alut ni gei chun amahon aneuvin, adonun, akichengun, chule akichensah-un; chuin twisang ahung lenin, abonchauvin asumang heltan ahi.
target: People were eating, drinking, marrying and being given in marriage up to the day Noah entered the ark. Then the flood came and destroyed them all.

source: Chutobangma chun Lot hin laijin jong asoh-in: mihon aneuvin, adonun, thil ajoh-un, thil achouvin, aphutnun, chule in asauvin;
target: “It was the same in the days of Lot. People were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.

source: Ahivangin Sodom kho-a kona Lot apotdoh nitah-in van'a konin mei le kath ahung lhan, abonchauvin asumanghel tan ahi.
target: But the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.

source: Hiche tobanga chu Mihem Chapa hung kiphondoh ni jongle hi ding ahi.
target: “It will be just like this on the day the Son of Man is revealed.

source: Hiche ni chule in chunga uma chu insunga athil um kilah dingin hungkum hihhen; chutima chun loujaova uma jong hung kinungle kit dahen.
target: On that day no one who is on the housetop, with possessions inside, should go down to get them. Likewise, no one in the field should go back for anything.

source: Lot inneipi chu geldoh-un.
target: Remember Lot’s wife!

source: Koihile ahinna huhdoh nading hola chun achan ding ahi; chule ahinna chana chun akihuhbit ding ahi.
target: Whoever tries to keep their life will lose it, and whoever loses their life will preserve it.

source: Kaseipeh nahiuve, chuche jan chule mi ni jalkhun khatna lumding; khat chu kila-a, khat chu kidalha ding ahi.
target: I tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed; one will be taken and the other left.

source: Numei nin sumhei khatna agoi khom ding; khat kila-a, khat kidalha ding ahi.
target: Two women will be grinding grain together; one will be taken and the other left.”

source: Chuin amahon adonbutnun, ajah-a, Hoija-em, Pakai? atiuve. Chuin aman, Thilong umna-a chu muthong kikhom ding ahi, ati.
target: “Where, Lord?” they asked. He replied, “Where there is a dead body, there the vultures will gather.”

source: Chuin mihem chu lhadah louhela tao jing jeng ding ahi ti hetsahnan, ajah uva thulem khat aseijin:
target: Then Jesus told his disciples a parable to show them that they should always pray and not give up.

source: Khopi khatna Pathen ging lou, mihem jong ja lou thutan vaihom khat aumin;
target: He said: “In a certain town there was a judge who neither feared God nor cared what people thought.
