source: Chuche khopi-a chun meithainu khat jong aumin; chuin amanu chu thutan vaihompa henga chun ahungjin, kakilung doupi chunga phu neilah peh-in tin ahung seijin ahi.
target: And there was a widow in that town who kept coming to him with the plea, ‘Grant me justice against my adversary.’

source: Chuin amapa chom khat chu anom hih-in; ahivangin ajo phasah-in ama changin akihouvin, keiman Pathen kagin louva, mihem jong kaja lou vangin;
target: “For some time he refused. But finally he said to himself, ‘Even though I don’t fear God or care what people think,

source: Hiche meithai nun eisuh lunggim jing jeh hin, aphu lahpeh maitange, achuti loule ahung jingjeng hin eisu lungvai jinte, ati.
target: yet because this widow keeps bothering me, I will see that she gets justice, so that she won’t eventually come and attack me!’ ”

source: Chuin Pakaiyin, thutan vaihom chondih loupa chun ipi aseijem, ngaijun.
target: And the Lord said, “Listen to what the unjust judge says.

source: Chule achunguva lungdesot jeng jongle, sunle jana ama akou koujeng ami lhendoh ho phu chu Pathen'in alah lou dingham?
target: And will not God bring about justice for his chosen ones, who cry out to him day and night? Will he keep putting them off?

source: Kaseipeh nahiuve, aman gangtah-a phu alah ding ahi. Ahivanginla Mihem Chapa ahung tengle, vannoi'a hin tahsan ahung mun'a dingem? ati.
target: I tell you, he will see that they get justice, and quickly. However, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”

source: Chuin michonpha kingaito-a ama kitahsana midang imacha sah louho jah-a jong, thulem hiche hi aseije.
target: To some who were confident of their own righteousness and looked down on everyone else, Jesus told this parable:

source: Mi ni houin'a Pathen lhai dingin ache lhonin; khat chu Pharisai ahin, chule khat chu kaidong ahi.
target: “Two men went up to the temple to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.

source: Pharisai pa chu adingin achangin hitin ataovin ahi, Vo Pathen, keiman nangma kathangvah-e, keima midangho banga hunama la-a, chondihlou, jonga, chule hiche kaidongpa tobang jong hi kahipoi.
target: The Pharisee stood by himself and prayed: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like other people—robbers, evildoers, adulterers—or even like this tax collector.

source: Keiman hapta khat sungin nivei an kangoljin; kamu jouse hop soma hop khat kapejin ahi, ati.
target: I fast twice a week and give a tenth of all I get.’

source: Kaidongpa vang chu gamlatah-a adingin, amit jong vandah nom louvin, Vo Pathen, michonse keima hi neilungset in tin a-op achum achumin ahi.
target: “But the tax collector stood at a distance. He would not even look up to heaven, but beat his breast and said, ‘God, have mercy on me, a sinner.’

source: Kaseipeh nahiuve, khatjopa sang chun hichepa chu themchangin aumin a-in'a achesuhtai; ijeh-inem itile koi hile ama kichoisang chan chu kisunem ding; ama kineosah bou chu choisanga umding ahi, ati.
target: “I tell you that this man, rather than the other, went home justified before God. For all those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.”

source: Chuin mi phabepmin aman atham dingin anaosenho jong ahengah ahinpuijun; ahin seijuiten amu phatnun, amaho chu ana phoh-un ahi.
target: People were also bringing babies to Jesus for him to place his hands on them. When the disciples saw this, they rebuked them.

source: Ahivangin Jesu'n amaho chu ahenga akouvin, Chapangho chu kahenga hung sah-un; jada hih-un: ijeh-inem itile Pathen gam chu hitobang teho-a bou ahi.
target: But Jesus called the children to him and said, “Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

source: Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Koi hile chapangneo tobanga Pathen gam sang lou chu, iti nama jongle chua lut louhel ding ahi, ati.
target: Truly I tell you, anyone who will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”

source: Chuin vaipo khatnin adongin, Houhilpha, tonsot hin kemlou channa dinga ipi kabol dingham? ati.
target: A certain ruler asked him, “Good teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?”

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah-a, Ibola apha neitiham? Pathen khatseh tailou koimacha apha aumpoi.
target: “Why do you call me good?” Jesus answered. “No one is good—except God alone.

source: Thupeh chengse, jon bol hih-in, tolthat hih-in, gucha hih-in, thujouvin mi heh hih-in, nanu napa jabolin, ti chu nahenai, ati.
target: You know the commandments: ‘You shall not commit adultery, you shall not murder, you shall not steal, you shall not give false testimony, honor your father and mother.’”

source: Chuin aman, hichengse chu kachapan laija patna kahin nitpeh ahitai, ati.
target: “All these I have kept since I was a boy,” he said.

source: Chuin Jesu'n hichu ajah phatnin ajah-a, Nalhin lelna khat aum nalaije; nanei chengse joh-inlang mivaicha gentheiho hoppeh-in, chutile van'a gou nanei ding ahi; chule hungin lang kanung hinjuijin, ati.
target: When Jesus heard this, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell everything you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.”

source: Ahin aman chucheng ajah phat chun, mihaotah ahi jeh chun alungnommo lheh jengtan ahi.
target: When he heard this, he became very sad, because he was very wealthy.

source: Chuin Jesu'n ama chu amun, Mihaoho hi Pathen gama alut-u iti hahsat hitam!
target: Jesus looked at him and said, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!

source: Ijeh-inem itile mihao Pathen gama alut sangin, heubil homa sangongsang lut abaijoi, ati.
target: Indeed, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of God.”

source: Chuin chuche asei jaho chun, Chuti ahile koi huhhing-a um jou dingham? atiuvin ahi.
target: Those who heard this asked, “Who then can be saved?”

source: Ahivangin aman, Mihem dinga hithei lou chu Pathen dinga hithei ahi, ati.
target: Jesus replied, “What is impossible with man is possible with God.”

source: Chuin Peter'in, Vetemin, keihon kaneiju kadalhaovin nanung kahinjui taove, ati.
target: Peter said to him, “We have left all we had to follow you!”

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathen lenggam jala a-in, anu, apate, asopite, aji le achate hin dalha-a chu,
target: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus said to them, “no one who has left home or wife or brothers or sisters or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God

source: Tu hinlai sunga ajat tamtah mube loule, khonung hinkho-a tonsot hin kemlou chang lou dinga koima aumpoi, ati.
target: will fail to receive many times as much in this age, and in the age to come eternal life.”

source: Chuin aman somleni ho chu apuijin, ajah uva, Veuvin, Jerusalem jonin iche touvui, chule themgaoho-a kona thu kisun jouse chu Mihem Chapa chunga kichai soh ding ahi.
target: Jesus took the Twelve aside and told them, “We are going up to Jerusalem, and everything that is written by the prophets about the Son of Man will be fulfilled.

source: Ijeh-inem itile ama chidang namdangho khutna pehdoh-a umding, chule totnopna aneijuva, jachat umtah-a aboldingu, chule chil aset khum dingu;
target: He will be delivered over to the Gentiles. They will mock him, insult him and spit on him;

source: Chule avoh uva, atha dingu ahi. Chule ani thum nile thoudoh kit ding ahi, ati.
target: they will flog him and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”

source: Ahivangin amaho dinga ki-ima ahi jeh-in, hitiho chu khatcha jong angainaje ahepouvin, ipi kiseija ahi jong ahepouve.
target: The disciples did not understand any of this. Its meaning was hidden from them, and they did not know what he was talking about.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Jericho anaijin mitcho khat lam pama touva khutdo aumin ahi.
target: As Jesus approached Jericho, a blind man was sitting by the roadside begging.

source: Chuin lampia mipi ache chu ajan, Hichu ipiham, tin adongin ahi.
target: When he heard the crowd going by, he asked what was happening.

source: Chuin, Nazareth Jesu chulama chu chea ahi, tin aseipeh-un ahi.
target: They told him, “Jesus of Nazareth is passing by.”

source: Chuin aman, Jesu, David chapa, keima neilungset in tin asamtan ahi.
target: He called out, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”

source: Chuin amasanga cheho chun thipbeh-a umdingin aphoh-un; ahivangin ama chun, David chapa, neilungset in, tin ahasapcheh tan ahi.
target: Those who led the way rebuked him and told him to be quiet, but he shouted all the more, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”

source: Chuin Jesu adingin, ama chu ahenga pui dingin thu apen ahi: chuin ama akom ahung gei phatnin, adongin,
target: Jesus stopped and ordered the man to be brought to him. When he came near, Jesus asked him,

source: Keiman nangma iloleng nalungham? ati. Chuin aman, Pakai, kho muleng kati, ati.
target: “What do you want me to do for you?” “Lord, I want to see,” he replied.

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah-a, kho mutan; natahsanin nadamsah ahitai, ati.
target: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight; your faith has healed you.”

source: Chuin chupettah chun kho amupai jengin, anung ajuijin, Pathen avahchoi avahchoijin: chuin miho jouse chun amu phatnun Pathen avahchoi taovin ahi.
target: Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus, praising God. When all the people saw it, they also praised God.

source: Chuin Jesu alutnin Jericho lailung ajotnin ahi.
target: Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through.

source: Hichun veuvin, amin Zacchaeus atiu mi khat aumin; chule ama chu kaidong pipu ahin, mihao ahi.
target: A man was there by the name of Zacchaeus; he was a chief tax collector and was wealthy.

source: Ama chun hoipen khu Jesu ahidem tin mu tei agon, ahivangin ama minem ahi jeh-in mipi jeh chun amu theipon ahi.
target: He wanted to see who Jesus was, but because he was short he could not see over the crowd.

source: Chuin ama masang lama analhai jel-in, ama anave dingin theiba chungah anakale; ijeh-inem itile aman hilam chu aho ding ahi.
target: So he ran ahead and climbed a sycamore-fig tree to see him, since Jesus was coming that way.

source: Chuin Jesu chukom mun chu ageijin, chunglam agahven ahile ama chu amun, ajah-a, Zacchaeus, hung kum loijin; ijeh inem itile tunia na-in'a kalhun ding ahi, ati.
target: When Jesus reached the spot, he looked up and said to him, “Zacchaeus, come down immediately. I must stay at your house today.”

source: Chuin ama ahung kum loijin, kipahtah-in a-in'a alhunsah tan ahi.
target: So he came down at once and welcomed him gladly.

source: Chuin hichu amu phatnun, Michonse in'a lhungin acheta getne atiuvin, abonchauvin aphuntaove.
target: All the people saw this and began to mutter, “He has gone to be the guest of a sinner.”

source: Chuin Zacchaeus adingdoh-in, Pakai jah-a chun, Ven, Pakai, kanei jouse akeh khat mivaicha genthei pengkate; mi koija hile lepthol-a kalah aumle ajat li-in lenge, ati.
target: But Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, “Look, Lord! Here and now I give half of my possessions to the poor, and if I have cheated anybody out of anything, I will pay back four times the amount.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah-a, Tunin hiche in'a hin huhhingna alhungtai, ijeh-inem itile ama jong hi Abraham son ahi.
target: Jesus said to him, “Today salvation has come to this house, because this man, too, is a son of Abraham.

source: Ijeh-inem itile amangsa chu holdoh-a huhhing dinga Mihem Chapa hung ahi, ati.
target: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.”

source: Chuin mihon hicheng thu chu angai pettah-u chun, Jerusalem anaitah jeh-ule Pathen lenggam chu chupet tah-a chu kilangdoh paijeng dinga angaito jeh-u chun, aman aseibeben thulem khat aseijin.
target: While they were listening to this, he went on to tell them a parable, because he was near Jerusalem and the people thought that the kingdom of God was going to appear at once.

source: Hijeh chun aman ahiti seije, Miluntah khat lenggam gakilah-a chule hung kile kit dingin khol gamlatah-a achen ahi.
target: He said: “A man of noble birth went to a distant country to have himself appointed king and then to return.

source: Chule ache kon chun asohte mi som akou khomin, talent som apen ajah uva, Kahung kahsen hiche-a hin ana kiveijun, ati.
target: So he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas. ‘Put this money to work,’ he said, ‘until I come back.’

source: Ahivangin agam miten ama ahotbolun, anunga palai asolun, kachunguva leng changa vaipo dingin hichepa hi kanompouve, agah ti sahtaove.
target: “But his subjects hated him and sent a delegation after him to say, ‘We don’t want this man to be our king.’

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, ama alengchana ahung kit phatnin, sum apeh asohteho chun ipipi ijat aveikan um ti hetna dingin, amaho kouna ding thu apetan ahi.
target: “He was made king, however, and returned home. Then he sent for the servants to whom he had given the money, in order to find out what they had gained with it.

source: Chuin amasapa chu ahungin a-angah, Pakai, na sana sum chun talent som kaveikane, ati.
target: “The first one came and said, ‘Sir, your mina has earned ten more.’

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, Nabol aphai, sohpha; nangma themcha khat chunga tahsan naum jeh chun, kho som chungah vaipon pangin, ati.
target: “ ‘Well done, my good servant!’ his master replied. ‘Because you have been trustworthy in a very small matter, take charge of ten cities.’

source: Chuin abanapa chu ahungin ajah-a, Pakai, na sana sum chun talent nga kaveikane, ati.
target: “The second came and said, ‘Sir, your mina has earned five more.’

source: Ama jah-a jong chun, Nang jong kho nga chunga vaipon pangin, ati.
target: “His master answered, ‘You take charge of five cities.’

source: Chuin khatpa ahungin, Pakai, ven, na sana sumchu hiche hi ahi, ultheh pona kachuna, kakoihe ahi:
target: “Then another servant came and said, ‘Sir, here is your mina; I have kept it laid away in a piece of cloth.

source: Ajeh chu nangma mikhel nahin, nakoina lou pouvah naladoh jin, natuna lou pouvah na-atjin ahile nang kakichan ahi, ati.
target: I was afraid of you, because you are a hard man. You take out what you did not put in and reap what you did not sow.’

source: Aman, Vo nang soh gilou, nakama thupot dungjuija nathu katan ding ahi: kakoina louva kalahjia, katuna louva ka-atji nahet ahi.
target: “His master replied, ‘I will judge you by your own words, you wicked servant! You knew, did you, that I am a hard man, taking out what I did not put in, and reaping what I did not sow?

source: Chuti an kasum chu ibola sumkhol pungna-a nanakoida ham? Chutile keiman kasum athoitoh kilahtha tadinga, ati.
target: Why then didn’t you put my money on deposit, so that when I came back, I could have collected it with interest?’

source: Chuin aman akoma dingho jah-a chun, Talent chu lahpeh unlang talent som neipa chu petaovin.
target: “Then he said to those standing by, ‘Take his mina away from him and give it to the one who has ten minas.’

source: (Chuin amahon ajah-a, Pakai, aman talent som aneinai, atiuve.)
target: “ ‘Sir,’ they said, ‘he already has ten!’

source: Najah uva kasei ahi, aneichana chu kipe ding ahi; anei lou vang chu aneichasun jong chu ama-a kona kilahmang pehding ahi.
target: “He replied, ‘I tell you that to everyone who has, more will be given, but as for the one who has nothing, even what they have will be taken away.

source: Hiche achunguva kavaipoh ding nomlou ho eimelmaho vanghi hikoma hinpuijun, ka-ang sunga thatnun, ati.
target: But those enemies of mine who did not want me to be king over them—bring them here and kill them in front of me.’ ”

source: Chuin chucheng asei jou chun, Jerusalem lam jonin ama alamkaijin achetou taove.
target: After Jesus had said this, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Olivet atiu molsang Bethphage le Bethany ahungnai phatnin, aseijuiho mi ni asolin,
target: As he approached Bethphage and Bethany at the hill called the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples, saying to them,

source: Namasang jon lhona khosunga khun lut lhonin; nalut lut lhonle sangan nou kihen koima touna khahlou laihel namu paijen lhon ding ahi; hichu sut lhonin lang hinkai lhonin.
target: “Go to the village ahead of you, and as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, which no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.

source: Chule, Ibola nasut lhonham tia khattou nadong lhona aumle, Pakaiyin manna nom aneije, ti lhonin, ati.
target: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say, ‘The Lord needs it.’ ”

source: Chuin akisolte ni chu ache lhonin ahile, ajah lhona aseibang bang chun agamu lhonin.
target: Those who were sent ahead went and found it just as he had told them.

source: Chuin asut lhonle aneiten ajah lhona, Sangan nou chu ibola nasut lhonham? ati.
target: As they were untying the colt, its owners asked them, “Why are you untying the colt?”

source: Chuin amanin, Pakaiyin manna nom aneije, ati lhone.
target: They replied, “The Lord needs it.”

source: Hichun Jesu henga ahinkai lhonin; chuin amahon aponu sangan nou chunga chun aphaovin, achunga Jesu atousah-un ahi.
target: They brought it to Jesus, threw their cloaks on the colt and put Jesus on it.

source: Chuin achen ahile, amahon aponu lam dunga aphaovin ahi.
target: As he went along, people spread their cloaks on the road.

source: Chuin ama ahung naija, Olive molsang kumlhahna ageijin, aseijuite mipi chu hapan akipah athanom un, thilbol kidang dang abol amu chengseu jal chun aw sangtah-in Pathen avahchoijun,
target: When he came near the place where the road goes down the Mount of Olives, the whole crowd of disciples began joyfully to praise God in loud voices for all the miracles they had seen:

source: Pakai mina hunga lengpa anun nome, van'ah cham lenghen, chungnung penah loupina hihen, atiuvin ahi.
target: “Blessed is the king who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!”

source: Chuin mipi lah-a kon chun Pharisai ho kimkhatnin ajah-a, Houhil, naseijuite phoh-in, ati.
target: Some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to Jesus, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”

source: Chuin aman adonbutnin; Najah uvah kasei ahi, Hiteho thipleu, songho ao doh ding ahi, ati.
target: “I tell you,” he replied, “if they keep quiet, the stones will cry out.”

source: Chuin ahung naija khopi chu amu phatnin, akachamin,
target: As he approached Jerusalem and saw the city, he wept over it

source: Ohe, nangma tah-in tuni hin lungmonna thuhi kihet tave le chun! Tunla nahet louna dinga ki-ima ahitai.
target: and said, “If you, even you, had only known on this day what would bring you peace—but now it is hidden from your eyes.

source: Ijeh inem itile nagalteuvin nakimvela kul aset sanga, naum kimvela, naum chah dingu nikho hunglhung ding ahi,
target: The days will come upon you when your enemies will build an embankment against you and encircle you and hem you in on every side.

source: Nasunga nachatetoh nangma leiset toh kibanga abola, nalah-a song khat chunga khat um louhela alha dingu ahi; hichu nakivil laiju nahet lou jeh ahi, ati.
target: They will dash you to the ground, you and the children within your walls. They will not leave one stone on another, because you did not recognize the time of God’s coming to you.”

source: Chuin ama houin'ah alutnin, chuche sunga thil johho le thilchoho chu anodoh panin,
target: When Jesus entered the temple courts, he began to drive out those who were selling.

source: Ajah uva, Ka-in chu taona in hi ding ahi, tin akisune; ahin nanghon gucha michom kokhuh-in nasemtaove, ati.
target: “It is written,” he said to them, “ ‘My house will be a house of prayer’; but you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’”

source: Chuin nisehle houin'a chun ahiljin ahi. Ahin thempu pipuiho le danthu sunho, chule miho pipuho chun ama suhmangna ding aholun;
target: Every day he was teaching at the temple. But the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the leaders among the people were trying to kill him.

source: Ahivangin mipi chengse chun aboncha ama thu angaijuva, ama jenga akai jing jeh-u chun alonaje ding aholmovin ahi.
target: Yet they could not find any way to do it, because all the people hung on his words.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, chulai chun ni khat aman houin'a thupha ahil lhanga, miho thu ahil petnin, thempu pipuiho le danthu sunho toh upaho ahenga ahungun,
target: One day as Jesus was teaching the people in the temple courts and proclaiming the good news, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, together with the elders, came up to him.

source: Ajah-a, Ipi thunei na-a hitiho hi nabolham? Koiham hiche thuneina nape-a hi? neisei peh-un, atiuve.
target: “Tell us by what authority you are doing these things,” they said. “Who gave you this authority?”

source: Chuin aman adonbutnin, ajah uva, Keiman jong nangho thu khat donging kate; neisei peh-un;
target: He replied, “I will also ask you a question. Tell me:

source: John baptize chansah chu van'a konham, mihem'a konham? ati.
target: John’s baptism—was it from heaven, or of human origin?”

source: Chuin amaho akingai touvin, Van'a kon ahi tileuhenla, ibola ama natahsan lou uham tintin;
target: They discussed it among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’

source: Mihem'a kon ahi tileuhenla, miho jousen songa eise dingu ahin; ijeh-inem itile amahon John chu themgao ahi tia ajopsoh-u ahi, akitiuvin ahi.
target: But if we say, ‘Of human origin,’ all the people will stone us, because they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”

source: Chuin amahon, Hoija konham kahepouve, tin adonbut taove.
target: So they answered, “We don’t know where it was from.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n amaho jah-a achutile ipi thuneija hicheng kabol ahi, keiman jong seipehdeh pouvinge, ati.
target: Jesus said, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.”

source: Chuin aman miho jah-a hiche thulem hi asei pantan ahi. Mikhatnin lengpilei abolin, leilhouho khutna apedoh-in, sottah gatham dingin mi gam danga achetan ahi.
target: He went on to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard, rented it to some farmers and went away for a long time.

source: Chuin aga lhun phatnin aman asoh khat aleilhouho henga, amahon lengpi leija ga chu ama ahinpeh dingun asolin; ahinla leilhouho chun ama chu avovin, khutgoh keuvin akilesah taovin ahi.
target: At harvest time he sent a servant to the tenants so they would give him some of the fruit of the vineyard. But the tenants beat him and sent him away empty-handed.

source: Chuin aman soh khat asol nalaijin, ama jong chu avovin jachat umtah-in abolun, agoh keuvin asolmang taove.
target: He sent another servant, but that one also they beat and treated shamefully and sent away empty-handed.

source: Chuin athumna asol kittan ahile, ama jong chu ana vovin, po lama apaidoh taovin ahi.
target: He sent still a third, and they wounded him and threw him out.

source: Chuin lengpilei neipa chun, I kalo ding hitam? Kachapa deitah hi solinge: ama hi anajabol khatnunte, ati.
target: “Then the owner of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my son, whom I love; perhaps they will respect him.’

source: Ahivangin leilhou hon amu phatnun, amahole amaho akihouvun, Ama hi agou lo dinga chu ahi; hungun agou lo ding chu eihoa ahina dingin, ama hi thatnu hite, akitiuvin.
target: “But when the tenants saw him, they talked the matter over. ‘This is the heir,’ they said. ‘Let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

source: Chuin lengpilei po lama akaidoh-un, athat taovin ahi. Hijeh chun lengpilei neipa chun amaho chu ilontem?
target: So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. “What then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?

source: Ama hungintin aleilhouho chu sugamintin, lengpilei chu mi dang petante, ati. Chuin amahon hichu ajah phatnun, Chuti hihhen, atiuve.
target: He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.” When the people heard this, they said, “God forbid!”

source: Ahin aman amaho chu aven, Achutile, Insahon adeimoa apaiju song chu Aninga songpipenin apangtai, tia kisun hi ibaham?
target: Jesus looked directly at them and asked, “Then what is the meaning of that which is written: “ ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone’ ?

source: Koi hijongle chuche song chunga lhu chan chu ahal hala chip ding ahi; chule koi hile achunga chuche song chua chu leivui banga kithejal ding ahi, ati.
target: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces; anyone on whom it falls will be crushed.”

source: Chuin danthu sunho le thempu pipuihon, hiche thulem asei chu amaho gotna-a asei ahi chu aheuvin, chupet tah-a chu achunga khut lhah ding agouvin; ahinla miho chu akichauvin ahi.
target: The teachers of the law and the chief priests looked for a way to arrest him immediately, because they knew he had spoken this parable against them. But they were afraid of the people.

source: Chuin amahon achanglhi jingun, athuseija themmo chana gam vaipo thuneina le thunoija pehdoh theina dingin, chonpha limlhemin changlhi phabep khat asolun ahi.
target: Keeping a close watch on him, they sent spies, who pretended to be sincere. They hoped to catch Jesus in something he said, so that they might hand him over to the power and authority of the governor.

source: Chuin amahon ajah-a, Houhil, nangman dihtah-a naseija mi nahil ahi, chule koima mai ve louhela dihtah-a Pathen lampi chu nahil ahi, hichu kaheuve.
target: So the spies questioned him: “Teacher, we know that you speak and teach what is right, and that you do not show partiality but teach the way of God in accordance with the truth.

source: Caesar kai kapeh-u hi dan ngai hina, hilouham? tin adongun ahi.
target: Is it right for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?”

source: Ahivangin aman alungthim bolu chu ahen, amaho jah-a, Ibola neipatepmu ham?
target: He saw through their duplicity and said to them,

source: Denarius khat neivet sah-un. Koi lim le koi min chongam? ati. Amahon adonbutnun, Ceasar'a, atiuve.
target: “Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” “Caesar’s,” they replied.

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, achutile Caesar'a chu Caesar peuvinlang, Pathen'a chu Pathen petangu, ati.
target: He said to them, “Then give back to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”

source: Chuin amahon miho ang sunga athu seijin aman theita pouvin, athu donbut chu adatmo lheh jengun, athipbeh taovin ahi.
target: They were unable to trap him in what he had said there in public. And astonished by his answer, they became silent.

source: Chuin, mithi thokitna aumpoi tia Saddukai ho phabep ahenga ahungun ajah-a,
target: Some of the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus with a question.

source: Houhil, koi hile sopi nei khattouvin ji aneija cha nei louva athile, asopipa chun ajinu chu kichenpi henlang asopipa ding chun chi khaipehhen tin Mosi'n lekha eisutpeh-un ahi.
target: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man must marry the widow and raise up offspring for his brother.

source: Aphai, ucha pasal sagite khat aumun, amasa penpa chun ji aneijin chabeijin athitai.
target: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married a woman and died childless.

source: Chuin ani channapan amanu chu jin aneijin, amapa chabeijin athitai. Chuin athumnapan numeinu chu jin aneijin; chuti chun asagi uvin aneijun, chabeijin athi taovin ahi.
target: The second

source: Akhonna-in numeinu jong chu athitan ahi.
target: and then the third married her, and in the same way the seven died, leaving no children.

source: Ahile thokitna-a amanu chu alah uva koipen ji hitantem?
target: Finally, the woman died too.

source: Ijeh-inem itile asagiuva amanu chu ji-a anei sohkeiju ahi, atiuve.
target: Now then, at the resurrection whose wife will she be, since the seven were married to her?”

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah uva, Hiche vannoi leiset chate hi akichengun, chule chen jong akichensah-un;
target: Jesus replied, “The people of this age marry and are given in marriage.

source: Ahin chuche gam lodinga kilomho le athia kona thoudoh ho vang chu akicheng tapouve, chen jong akichensah tapouve.
target: But those who are considered worthy of taking part in the age to come and in the resurrection from the dead will neither marry nor be given in marriage,

source: Chule amaho thi kit thei talou ahiuve; ijeh-inem itile amaho chu vantilte tobang ahiuvin; chule thoukit chate ahi jeh-u chun Pathen chate ahiuve.
target: and they can no longer die; for they are like the angels. They are God’s children, since they are children of the resurrection.

source: Mosi'n jong hamboh thua chun, Pakai chu Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, chule Jacob Pathen, ati chun mithiho kaithouvin aumui ti aphongdoh-e.
target: But in the account of the burning bush, even Moses showed that the dead rise, for he calls the Lord ‘the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’

source: Ama athiho Pathen hilouvin, ahingho Pathen ahijo bouve; ijeh-inem itile mi jouse ama mitmu-a ahing ahicheh-e, ati.
target: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for to him all are alive.”

source: Hichun danthu sunho abang bangin adonbutnun, Houhil, nasei apha lheh jenge, atiuve.
target: Some of the teachers of the law responded, “Well said, teacher!”

source: Ijeh-inem itile amahon ama hiche kal chu ima adong ngam tapouvin ahi.
target: And no one dared to ask him any more questions.

source: Chuin aman amaho jah-a, Christa chu David chapa ahi iti kitiham?
target: Then Jesus said to them, “Why is it said that the Messiah is the son of David?

source: Ijeh-inem itile David amatah-in a-Labua, Pakaiyin ka Pakai jah-a, Nangma kajet lamah touvin,
target: David himself declares in the Book of Psalms: “ ‘The Lord said to my Lord: “Sit at my right hand

source: Keiman namelmate chengse nakeng chotpha-a kaneisah masangsen, ati.
target: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.” ’

source: Hitichun David'in ama chu Pakai ati; achutile achapa iti hi thei dingham? ati.
target: David calls him ‘Lord.’ How then can he be his son?”

source: Chuin mi jouse jah dingin aseijuite jah-a,
target: While all the people were listening, Jesus said to his disciples,

source: Sangkhol choltah kiah-a vale noma, chule kailhanga min chibai aboh ding deija, chule kikhopna in le golvahna-a touna pipen deija danthu sunho-a konin kihong phaovin;
target: “Beware of the teachers of the law. They like to walk around in flowing robes and love to be greeted with respect in the marketplaces and have the most important seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.

source: Amahon Meithaiho in abahgamun, chule alhema sot tahtah taojia ahiuve; amaho chu themmo chang chungnung ding ahiuve, ati.
target: They devour widows’ houses and for a show make lengthy prayers. These men will be punished most severely.”

source: Chuin ama akhodah-in ahile, mihao hon sumdolna boma athilto alelutnu amun.
target: As Jesus looked up, he saw the rich putting their gifts into the temple treasury.

source: Chule hia chun meithai vaicha khatman jong sumsan nongsi peh ni alelut amun ahi.
target: He also saw a poor widow put in two very small copper coins.

source: Chuin aman, Nangho jah-a tahbeh-a kasei ahi, amaho dang jouse sangin hiche meithai vaichanun atam lelut pene;
target: “Truly I tell you,” he said, “this poor widow has put in more than all the others.

source: Ijeh-inem itile amahon aneivalu Pathen'a atouva alelutnu ahin, amanu vang hin ahinpi aneisun alelut jeng ahi, ati.
target: All these people gave their gifts out of their wealth; but she out of her poverty put in all she had to live on.”

source: Chuin mi phabep khatnin houin chu song phatahtah le thilto khomho-a akijephoi chu aseijun ahile, aman,
target: Some of his disciples were remarking about how the temple was adorned with beautiful stones and with gifts dedicated to God. But Jesus said,

source: Nanghon namu-u hicheng hi kisusuchim louva song khat chunga khat kisethop himhim aum louhel ding nikhoho chu hunglhung ding ahi, ati.
target: “As for what you see here, the time will come when not one stone will be left on another; every one of them will be thrown down.”

source: Chuin amahon adongun, Ahile, houhil, hicheng chu itihle hi dingham? Chule hiho chu ahung sodoh ding phat amelchihna ipi hintem? atiuve.
target: “Teacher,” they asked, “when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to take place?”

source: Chuin aman hitin aseije, Lheplhah-a puimanga naum louna dingun kichih theijun; ijeh-inem itile mi tamtah keima minin hunguntin, keima Christa kahi; chule phat anaije, ahung ti dingu ahi; hijongle amaho nung chu jui hih-un.
target: He replied: “Watch out that you are not deceived. For many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is near.’ Do not follow them.

source: Chule nanghon gal kisatle thunoh najah tengule tija hih-un; ijeh-inem itile hicheng chu hungsoh masa tei ding ahi; hijongle akichaina chu hunglhung pai louding ahi, ati.
target: When you hear of wars and uprisings, do not be frightened. These things must happen first, but the end will not come right away.”

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Vai khatle vai khat, gam khatle gam khat hung kidou vintin;
target: Then he said to them: “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

source: Chule mun chom mun choma ling nasatahtah hung kihot intin, kel lhantin, gamna hise leng ding, chule van'a kona kichat tijat umtahle melchihna nasatah hung umding ahi.
target: There will be great earthquakes, famines and pestilences in various places, and fearful events and great signs from heaven.

source: Amavang thil hicheng chu ahung sodoh masanga amahon nachung uva akhut alhah uva, nabolset dingu, akikhopnao le songkul'a dinga napehdoh dingu, chule keima min jala lengho le gamvaipoho anga nahin kailut dingu ahi.
target: “But before all this, they will seize you and persecute you. They will hand you over to synagogues and put you in prison, and you will be brought before kings and governors, and all on account of my name.

source: Hettohsahna naneina dinguva hicheng chu hung sohdoh ding ahi.
target: And so you will bear testimony to me.

source: Hiche jeh chun iti donbut ding nagel masah louna dingun nalunguvah kisetnun.
target: But make up your mind not to worry beforehand how you will defend yourselves.

source: Ijeh-inem itile namelmaho jouseuvin nadoudal thei lounaole, nanel lhah thei louna dingu kamle lungthim themna kapeh dingu nahiuve.
target: For I will give you words and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.

source: Ahivangin nanu napau, nasopiu, na-inko, chule najol nagolu chu napedoh uva hung pang ding ahi; chule nalah uva abang bang ahin thasah dingu ahi.
target: You will be betrayed even by parents, brothers and sisters, relatives and friends, and they will put some of you to death.

source: Chule keima min jala nangho mi jouse hotna nahung umdingu ahi.
target: Everyone will hate you because of me.

source: Ahivangin nalu chunguva nasamjang khatchao jong mangthah lou ding ahi.
target: But not a hair of your head will perish.

source: Nanghon thohhatna nahinnao nakihuh doh dingu ahi.
target: Stand firm, and you will win life.

source: Amavang Jerusalem galmin aum kimvel teng vangle, amanthah nading anaitai ti heuvin.
target: “When you see Jerusalem being surrounded by armies, you will know that its desolation is near.

source: Chutengle Juda gama um chengse thinglhang lamah jamuhen; chule khopi sunga uma chu potdoh hen; chule gama umho chu asunga lutdauhen.
target: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those in the city get out, and let those in the country not enter the city.

source: Ijeh-inem itile thu kisun jouse guilhun sohna dinga, hichu phulah nikho hija ahi.
target: For this is the time of punishment in fulfillment of all that has been written.

source: Ahin, ohe, hichelai chule agaija le naonoi chepsahho ada nadinguve! Ijeh-inem itile gam leiset chunga hesoh genthei khohtah le hiche mite chunga hi lunghanna chu ding ahi.
target: How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers! There will be great distress in the land and wrath against this people.

source: Chule amaho chemhema lou ding, chule chitin namtin lah-a gal hinga kikaimang gam dingu; chule chidang namdangte nikho lhin kahse-a Jerusalem hi chidang namdangte chotpha-a umding ahi.
target: They will fall by the sword and will be taken as prisoners to all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled on by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

source: Chule nisa, lhathah, chule ahsihoa melchihna hung umding; chule twikhanglen kitum le kinon jeh-a lei chunga namtin lungdonga umteho chunga hesohna hung umding;
target: “There will be signs in the sun, moon and stars. On the earth, nations will be in anguish and perplexity at the roaring and tossing of the sea.

source: Mihemte chu kichatna jehle vannoi leiset chunga thil soh dingho ngaitona jeh-a haisam dingu ahi: ijeh-inem itile van thahatna ho chengse kihotling soh ding ahi.
target: People will faint from terror, apprehensive of what is coming on the world, for the heavenly bodies will be shaken.

source: Chutahle Mihem Chapa chu thuneitah le loupi chungnung tah-a meibola ahung amu dingu ahi.
target: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

source: Ahivangin thil chucheng ahung so kipat tengle, khodah unlang chunglam veuvin; ijeh-inem itile nakilhatdoh nadingu anaije, ati.
target: When these things begin to take place, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.”

source: Chuin aman amaho jah-a thulem khat aseijin: Theichang le thing dang jouse khu veuvin;
target: He told them this parable: “Look at the fig tree and all the trees.

source: Ajih adotdoh namu tengule, nipi anaitai ti naheuve.
target: When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.

source: Chutobang chun nanghon jong hicheng chu aguilhun namu tengule, Pathen lenggam anaitai ti heuvin.
target: Even so, when you see these things happening, you know that the kingdom of God is near.

source: Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, aboncha aguilhun masangse-a, hiche khangguija mite hi mang lou dingu ahi.
target: “Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.

source: Vanle lei mang ding ahin; keima thu vang mang lou ding ahi.
target: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.

source: Amavang kihong phaovin, achuti loule an mohneh nehle jukham, chule hinlai khankho ding thu ngaitonan nalungu lontin, chuche ni chu thang bangin phulou helouvin nachung uva hung chu phung getninte.
target: “Be careful, or your hearts will be weighed down with carousing, drunkenness and the anxieties of life, and that day will close on you suddenly like a trap.

source: Chuche ni chu thang banga vannoi leiset gam jouse-a cheng mi jouse chunga chu ding ahi.
target: For it will come on all those who live on the face of the whole earth.

source: Hijongle thil hung soh ding jouse-a kona sohcha dinga lom le Mihem Chapa anga ding dinga lom nahina dingun, imatih chanin kiging jingin umun, chule tao jingun, ati.
target: Be always on the watch, and pray that you may be able to escape all that is about to happen, and that you may be able to stand before the Son of Man.”

source: Hichelai chun aman sun tengle houin'a thu ahiljin; chule janle apotdoh jin Olivet atiu molsanga agageh jin ahi.
target: Each day Jesus was teaching at the temple, and each evening he went out to spend the night on the hill called the Mount of Olives,

source: Chule miho jouse chu athu ngai dingin jingkah matah le houin'a ahung hungjiuvin ahi.
target: and all the people came early in the morning to hear him at the temple.

source: Chuin kalchuh kut atiu cholsolou changlhah kut chu anaitan ahi.
target: Now the Festival of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, was approaching,

source: Chuin thempu pipuiho le danthu sunhon ama chu atha theina dingje aholtauvin ahi; ijeh-inem itile miho chu akichauvin ahi.
target: and the chief priests and the teachers of the law were looking for some way to get rid of Jesus, for they were afraid of the people.

source: Chuin somleni lah-a Iscariot atiu Judas sunga chun Satan aluttan ahi.
target: Then Satan entered Judas, called Iscariot, one of the Twelve.

source: Ama chu achen thempu pipuiho le houvaipoho toh ama chu amaho amatsah theina dingje chu akihou taovin ahi.
target: And Judas went to the chief priests and the officers of the temple guard and discussed with them how he might betray Jesus.

source: Chuin amaho akipah-un, ama chu sum peh dingin atep taove.
target: They were delighted and agreed to give him money.

source: Hichea chun ama anomin, chule mipi umlou petcha aman ama chu amaho henga pehdoh-a matsahna thei ding agomkom aholtan ahi.
target: He consented, and watched for an opportunity to hand Jesus over to them when no crowd was present.

source: Chuin kalchuh kutna kelngoi thana ding, cholsolou changlhah nikho chu ahung lhungtan.
target: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb had to be sacrificed.

source: Chuin aman Peter le John asolin, Chelhonin lang kalchuh kut ineh dingu gago lhonin, ati.
target: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and make preparations for us to eat the Passover.”

source: Chuin amanin, Hoikoma gago lhonleng nalungham? ati lhone.
target: “Where do you want us to prepare for it?” they asked.

source: Aman ajah lhona, Ve lhonin, nangni khopi sung nalut lut lhonle twibel pu-a mi khattoh nakisuhto lhon ding ahi; ama nung chu jui lhonin, alutna in'ah lut lhonin.
target: He replied, “As you enter the city, a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him to the house that he enters,

source: Chule hiche in neipa jah-a chun, Houhilin nangma henga hitin aseije, Kaseijuite toh kalchuh kut an kanehna ding indan chu hoilaiham? ati, gati lhonin.
target: and say to the owner of the house, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?’

source: Chule amapa chun in dan chungnung lentah gotsadem khat navetsah lhon ding ahi; hikoma chun anago lhontan, ati.
target: He will show you a large room upstairs, all furnished. Make preparations there.”

source: Chuin amani ache lhonin, aman ajah lhona aseibang bang chun agatoh lhonin, kalchuh kut agagong lhontan ahi.
target: They left and found things just as Jesus had told them. So they prepared the Passover.

source: Chuin aphat alhinin, ankong aumtan, chule solchah somleni ho chun aum piuvin ahi.
target: When the hour came, Jesus and his apostles reclined at the table.

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Kathohgim masanga nang hotoh kalchuh kut an nehkhom ding hi katup lheh jenge.
target: And he said to them, “I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.

source: Ijeh-inem itile nangho jah-a kasei ahi, Pathen lenggama hiche hi aguilhun masangse-a kaneh lou ding ahitai, ati.
target: For I tell you, I will not eat it again until it finds fulfillment in the kingdom of God.”

source: Chuin aman khon chu alan, athangvah-in, Hiche hi kilah unlang kihom-un;
target: After taking the cup, he gave thanks and said, “Take this and divide it among you.

source: Ijeh-inem itile kaseipeh nahiuve, Pathen lenggam hung lhun kahse-a, keiman tukala lengpiga twi kadon lou ding ahitai, ati.
target: For I tell you I will not drink again from the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes.”

source: Chuin changlhah alan, athangvah-in, ahehbal balin, amaho chu apen, Hiche hi nangho dinga kipe-a katahsa ahi; keima neihet jingna dingun hiche hi bolun, ati.
target: And he took bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body given for you; do this in remembrance of me.”

source: Chuin chutima chun khon chu alan a-anneh jouvun, Hiche khon hi kathisana kitepna thah, nangho dinga kisodoh chu ahi.
target: In the same way, after the supper he took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

source: Ahivanginla, veuvin, eipedoh-a pang dingpa khut chu dokhanga hin keitoh kaum khome.
target: But the hand of him who is going to betray me is with mine on the table.

source: Mihem Chapa chu akigon banga chonpeh ding ahi; ahivangin apedoh-a pang mipa chu adana-e! ati.
target: The Son of Man will go as it has been decreed. But woe to that man who betrays him!”

source: Chuin amahon alah uva chutobang thilbol ding chu koipen ahi dingu akidongto taovin ahi.
target: They began to question among themselves which of them it might be who would do this.

source: Chuin alah uva koipen chu achungnung penin akiseidem tia kinelna asohdoh tan ahi.
target: A dispute also arose among them as to which of them was considered to be greatest.

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Chidang namdangho lengho khu achunguva alal lheh-un; chule achunguva thunei ho khu phatna bol akitiuve.
target: Jesus said to them, “The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them; and those who exercise authority over them call themselves Benefactors.

source: Nangho vang nachuti lou dingu ahi; ahin nalah uva alenjo chu aneojo bangin umhen, chule apipen chu lhachale bangin umhen.
target: But you are not to be like that. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who rules like the one who serves.

source: Ijeh-inem itile ankonga toule alhachale koijoh lenjo-em? Ankonga toujoh chu hilouham? Ahinla keima nangho lah-a lhachale bangin kaume.
target: For who is greater, the one who is at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who is at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.

source: Ahivangin eiki patepna-a eiumpi jingpeh nangho nahiuve.
target: You are those who have stood by me in my trials.

source: Chule ka Pan keima eigotpeh banga, keiman nangho lenggam khat kagotpeh nahiuve;
target: And I confer on you a kingdom, just as my Father conferred one on me,

source: Chutia chu kagam sunga kadokhang chunga naneh-a nadon uva, chule nangho lal touna-a natou uva Israel phung somle phung ni thu natan dingu ahi.
target: so that you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin aseijin, Simon, Simon, ven, chang kilhichil banga lhitchil dingin Satan'in nathume;
target: “Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift all of you as wheat.

source: Ahivangin natahsan alosam louna dingin kataopeh-e: chule nangman nalung nahei kit nungle nasopiteho jong naphudet ding ahi, ati.
target: But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith may not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.”

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, Pakai, nangma toh songkul le thina-a chetha dinga kigosa dema umjing kahi, ati.
target: But he replied, “Lord, I am ready to go with you to prison and to death.”

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, Peter, kaseipeh nahi, nangman keima neihet hi thumvei naseilep masangse-a tunia ahchal khong lou ding ahi, ati.
target: Jesus answered, “I tell you, Peter, before the rooster crows today, you will deny three times that you know me.”

source: Chuin aman amaho jah-a, Keiman nangho kengchot selou, sumbom keng lou, chule sakhao keng louva kasoluva chu ima nalhahsam nao umji-am? ati. Chuin amahon, Aumjipoi, atiuve.
target: Then Jesus asked them, “When I sent you without purse, bag or sandals, did you lack anything?” “Nothing,” they answered.

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Tu vangin sumbom nei neijan kiken hen; chutima chun sakhao jong kiken hen; chule chemjam nei lou louvan asangkhol johhen, chemjam khat kichoh hen.
target: He said to them, “But now if you have a purse, take it, and also a bag; and if you don’t have a sword, sell your cloak and buy one.

source: Ijeh-inem itile kaseipeh nahiuve, Ama michonseho toh kisimtha ahitai, tia thu kisun chu kachunga guilhung sohkei ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile keima chungchang thudol chengse kichaisoh ding ahitai, ati.
target: It is written: ‘And he was numbered with the transgressors’; and I tell you that this must be fulfilled in me. Yes, what is written about me is reaching its fulfillment.”

source: Chuin amahon, Pakai, hikoma chemjam ni aume, atiuve. Aman, Hichu aphasetne, ati.
target: The disciples said, “See, Lord, here are two swords.” “That’s enough!” he replied.

source: Chuin ama achonna ngai bangin apotdoh-in, Olivet molsanga achetan; aseijuiten jong anungnung ajuijun ahi.
target: Jesus went out as usual to the Mount of Olives, and his disciples followed him.

source: Chukom mun chu alhun phatnun, ajah uva, Lhepma nalhah louna dingun taovun, ati.
target: On reaching the place, he said to them, “Pray that you will not fall into temptation.”

source: Chuin ama songse phahna chan khat ache chonin, adilsun ataovin,
target: He withdrew about a stone’s throw beyond them, knelt down and prayed,

source: Hepa, naphatsahle hiche khon hi kakoma konin chon mangin; ahivangin keima lunggot bang hi louvin nangma lunggot bangjoh hihen, ati.
target: “Father, if you are willing, take this cup from me; yet not my will, but yours be done.”

source: Chuin van'a konin vantil khat ahung kilah-in, thahat ahungpen ahi.
target: An angel from heaven appeared to him and strengthened him.

source: Chuin aman na asa behseh jengin, guntah-in atao kittan; chule thisan aloma tolla valha bangin, a-ul thisanin along jengtan ahi.
target: And being in anguish, he prayed more earnestly, and his sweat was like drops of blood falling to the ground.

source: Chuin atao jouvin athoudoh-in aseijuite henga ahungin ahile, amaho lungkhama ana-imutlhuh-u ahungtoh-in,
target: When he rose from prayer and went back to the disciples, he found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.

source: Ajah uva, Nangho ibola ihmua nahiuvem? Lhepna-a nalhah louna dingun thouvun lang taovun, ati.
target: “Why are you sleeping?” he asked them. “Get up and pray so that you will not fall into temptation.”

source: Aman chutia asei pettah chun, veuvin, mipi hon khat ahungin, solchah somleni lah-a Judas atiu chu ahung lamkaijin; chuin ama chun Jesu chop dingin akom ahin naijin ahi.
target: While he was still speaking a crowd came up, and the man who was called Judas, one of the Twelve, was leading them. He approached Jesus to kiss him,

source: Ahin Jesu'n ajah-a, Vo Judas, Mihem Chapa hi chopma matsah nagot ham? ati.
target: but Jesus asked him, “Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?”

source: Chuin akimvela umho chun ipi aso ding chu amuvin, ajah-a, Pakai, chemjam'a kasat dingu hitam? atiuve.
target: When Jesus’ followers saw what was going to happen, they said, “Lord, should we strike with our swords?”

source: Chuin alah uva khatnin thempu chungnung sohpa asatle, abilkol jetlam asatlhatan ahi.
target: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah-a, Hichan beh hi phalun, ati. Chuin abilkol chu athamin aboldamtan ahi.
target: But Jesus answered, “No more of this!” And he touched the man’s ear and healed him.

source: Chuin aman dinga hung thempu pipuiho, houin ngah vaipoho, chule upaho jah-a chun, Gucha michom man dinga kon banga chemjamle moltum tho-a nahung konu ham?
target: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, the officers of the temple guard, and the elders, who had come for him, “Am I leading a rebellion, that you have come with swords and clubs?

source: Nang hotoh niseh-a houin'a kaum lai chunla keima matnan nakhut nalha pouvin; amavang tu hi nangho phat le muthim thahat ahi, ati.
target: Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on me. But this is your hour—when darkness reigns.”

source: Chuin amahon ama amanun, thempu chungnung in lama akaitaove; chuin Peter'in galkanga ajuipeh-in ahi.
target: Then seizing him, they led him away and took him into the house of the high priest. Peter followed at a distance.

source: Chuin amahon inpi leitol lailunga mei akitiuva atoukhom petnun, Peter jong amaho lah-a chun atouvin ahi.
target: And when some there had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat down with them.

source: Ama meikoma atou pet chun soh nungah khatnin amun, hoitah-in aven, Hichepa jong hi akiloipi ahi, ati.
target: A servant girl saw him seated there in the firelight. She looked closely at him and said, “This man was with him.”

source: Ahivangin aman ama chu aseilepmin, Numei ama chu kahepoi, ati.
target: But he denied it. “Woman, I don’t know him,” he said.

source: Ajo chomkhat jouvin, mi adang khatnin amun, ajah-a, Nang jong alah uva khat nahi, ati. Ahivangin, Peter'in, Mipa, keima kahipoi, ati.
target: A little later someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them.” “Man, I am not!” Peter replied.

source: Chuin nidan khat jouvin michom dang khatnin atahti tenin, Tahbeh-in ama jong hi aloiho khat mong mong ahi; ijeh-inem itile ama hi Galilee mi ahi, ati.
target: About an hour later another asserted, “Certainly this fellow was with him, for he is a Galilean.”

source: Ahivangin Peter'in, Mipa, nasei chu keiman kahehih hele, ati. Hichu asei nalaijin, hiche pettah chun ahchal akhongtan ahi.
target: Peter replied, “Man, I don’t know what you’re talking about!” Just as he was speaking, the rooster crowed.

source: Chuin Pakai chu akiheijin, Peter lam aven ahi. Chuin Peter'in, Tunia ahchal khon masanga thumvei neiseilep ding ahi, tia Pakaiyin asei chu ageldoh-in,
target: The Lord turned and looked straight at Peter. Then Peter remembered the word the Lord had spoken to him: “Before the rooster crows today, you will disown me three times.”

source: Chuin Peter polama apotnin lhasetah-in hakan akaptan ahi.
target: And he went outside and wept bitterly.

source: Chuin Jesu manna tuhho chun ama chu totnopnan abolun, chule avovin ahi.
target: The men who were guarding Jesus began mocking and beating him.

source: Chuin ponin amit atomun, amai abehpeh-un, koiham nadenga chu gaovinlang seijin? atiuve.
target: They blindfolded him and demanded, “Prophesy! Who hit you?”

source: Chule ataitom ataitomun ama gotnan thu tamtah aseijun ahi.
target: And they said many other insulting things to him.

source: Chuin jing khovah vah-in, miho upaho chengse, thempu pipuiho, chule danthu sunho chu ahung khomun, houvaipoloi kikhopna-a chun akaijun;
target: At daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and the teachers of the law, met together, and Jesus was led before them.

source: Nangma Christa chu nahim? neisei peh-un, atiuve. Ahivangin aman amaho jah-a, Keiman nangho seipeh jongleu veng, natahsan lou dingu;
target: “If you are the Messiah,” they said, “tell us.” Jesus answered, “If I tell you, you will not believe me,

source: Chule nadong jongleu veng, neidonbut lou dingu, lha jong neilhalou diu ahi.
target: and if I asked you, you would not answer.

source: Ahivangin tua pat Mihem Chapa hi Pathen thilbolthei khut jet lama tou ding ahitai, ati.
target: But from now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the mighty God.”

source: Chuin amahon abonchauvin adongun, Achutile nangma Pathen Chapa nahim? atiuve. Chuin aman ajah uva, Naseiju chu kahi, ati.
target: They all asked, “Are you then the Son of God?” He replied, “You say that I am.”

source: Chuin amahon, Thu hettohsah dang iding iti tah dinguham? Ijeh inem itile eihotah-in aman akamcheng tah-a asei ijataove, atiuve.
target: Then they said, “Why do we need any more testimony? We have heard it from his own lips.”

source: Chuin mipi kikhom chengse chu akipat doh-un, ama chu Pilate henga akaitaovin ahi.
target: Then the whole assembly rose and led him off to Pilate.

source: Chuin ahehse panun, Hichepa hin, Keima Christa leng kahi atia, Caesar kai peh ding akhama, kanampiu apuiset kamu uve, atiuve.
target: And they began to accuse him, saying, “We have found this man subverting our nation. He opposes payment of taxes to Caesar and claims to be Messiah, a king.”

source: Chuin Pilate'in adongin, Nangma Judah te Lengpa nahim? ati. Chuin aman adonbutnin, Naseikhai, ati.
target: So Pilate asked Jesus, “Are you the king of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.

source: Chuin Pilate'in thempu pipuiho le mipi jah-a, Hichepa chunga khansetna imacha kamupoi, ati.
target: Then Pilate announced to the chief priests and the crowd, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”

source: Chuin amaho ahapan cheh-un, Hichepa hin Galilee gama kipanin hiche kom geijin Juda gam khotinah ahille ahillen, mi jouse achohnoh jin ahi, atitaovin ahi.
target: But they insisted, “He stirs up the people all over Judea by his teaching. He started in Galilee and has come all the way here.”

source: Chuin Pilate'in Galilee thu ajah phah chun, Ama hi Galilee mi ham? tin adonge.
target: On hearing this, Pilate asked if the man was a Galilean.

source: Chuin ama chu Herod thuneina gam mi ahi ahet phatnin, Herod hengah asoltan ahi; ijeh-inem itile hiche laija chu ama Jerusalem'a uma ahi.
target: When he learned that Jesus was under Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem at that time.

source: Chuin Jesu amu phat chun Herod akipah lheh jengin ahi. Ijeh-inem itile aman athu ajah jeh-a sotna pat ama chu mu atup ahitan; chule thil kidang abol khattou mu ding kinem lheh ahi.
target: When Herod saw Jesus, he was greatly pleased, because for a long time he had been wanting to see him. From what he had heard about him, he hoped to see him perform a sign of some sort.

source: Chuin Herod chun thu tamtah adongin, ahivangin aman imachan adonbutpoi.
target: He plied him with many questions, but Jesus gave him no answer.

source: Chuin thempu pipuiho le danthu sunho adingun, ama chu ahehheh jengun ahi.
target: The chief priests and the teachers of the law were standing there, vehemently accusing him.

source: Chuin Herod le asepaiten nahsahmon abolun, totnopnan aneijun, pon loupi asilpeh-un, chuin Pilate heng lama ahin solkit taove.
target: Then Herod and his soldiers ridiculed and mocked him. Dressing him in an elegant robe, they sent him back to Pilate.

source: Hiche nitah chun Herod le Pilate akihou thei lhontan ahi; ijeh-inem itile chuche masanga chu kidou jing ahi lhone.
target: That day Herod and Pilate became friends—before this they had been enemies.

source: Chuin Pilate'in thempu pipuiho le vaipoho chule miho chu akou khomin,
target: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers and the people,

source: Ajah uva, Miho apuisei tia hichepa hi kahenga nahinkaiju ahin; veuvin, keiman amo amolou phatechan na-ang sunguvah kapatepmin, nanghon nahehnao thudola chun achungah themona kamupon;
target: and said to them, “You brought me this man as one who was inciting the people to rebellion. I have examined him in your presence and have found no basis for your charges against him.

source: Chule Herod jengin jong amupoi: ijeh-inem itile aman ihenguva ahinsol kit tai; chule veuvin, aman athina theilom imacha abolpoi.
target: Neither has Herod, for he sent him back to us; as you can see, he has done nothing to deserve death.

source: Hijeh chun keiman bolgim ingting, lhadohtange, ati.
target: Therefore, I will punish him and then release him.”

source: Ahivangin amahon thakhat tah-in asamun, Hichepa hi sumangin, Barabbas neilhadoh peh-un, atiuve.
target: But the whole crowd shouted, “Away with this man! Release Barabbas to us!”

source: Ama chu khopi sung chonoh jehle atoltha jeh-a songkul'a kikhuma ahi.
target: (Barabbas had been thrown into prison for an insurrection in the city, and for murder.)

source: Chuin Jesu chu alhadoh nom jeh-in, Pilate'in ajah uva thu asei kitnin;
target: Wanting to release Jesus, Pilate appealed to them again.

source: Ahivangin amahon, Ama chu thingpel'a khenbeh-in, thingpel'a khenbeh-in, tin asamtauve.
target: But they kept shouting, “Crucify him! Crucify him!”

source: Chuin aman athumvei na-in, Ibolin-em? Hichepan ipi suhset aneijem? Keiman thina theilom ama chunga ima kamupoi; hijeh chun bolgim ingting lhadoh tange, ati.
target: For the third time he spoke to them: “Why? What crime has this man committed? I have found in him no grounds for the death penalty. Therefore I will have him punished and then release him.”

source: Ahivangin amahon aw sangtah-in ahasapcheh-un, thingpel'a akhetbeh teina dingin athumun ahi. Chuin amahole thempu pipui aw chun anehjou jotai.
target: But with loud shouts they insistently demanded that he be crucified, and their shouts prevailed.

source: Chuin athum banguva bol dingin Pilate'in thu alhuh sahtan ahi.
target: So Pilate decided to grant their demand.

source: Chuin aman khosung chonoh le tolthat songkul'a kikhum athumpau chu alhadohpeh-in; Jesu vang chu amaho lunggot banga dingin apedohtan ahi.
target: He released the man who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, the one they asked for, and surrendered Jesus to their will.

source: Chuin akaimang phatnun, gama kona hung Cyrene gam mi Simon chu amanun, Jesu nung lama pu dingin achungah thingpel chu angamun ahi.
target: As the soldiers led him away, they seized Simon from Cyrene, who was on his way in from the country, and put the cross on him and made him carry it behind Jesus.

source: Chule mihonpi atamatam le a-op chum chuma kap numei mipi nasatah-in anung ajuijun ahi.
target: A large number of people followed him, including women who mourned and wailed for him.

source: Ahin Jesu akiheijin ajah uva, Jerusalem chanute, keima neika hih-un, nangho le nachateo dingjoh-in kapmun.
target: Jesus turned and said to them, “Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for me; weep for yourselves and for your children.

source: Ijeh-inem itile, veuvin, Achingho le chavop khalou naobu, chule naonoi chepsah khalouho anun nomui ati nadingu hitobang nikho chu hung lhung ding ahi.
target: For the time will come when you will say, ‘Blessed are the childless women, the wombs that never bore and the breasts that never nursed!’

source: Chutengle amahon molsang jah-a, Neilhuh khumun, atiuva lhang jah-a, Neikhu khumun neiselun, ati dingu ahi.
target: Then “ ‘they will say to the mountains, “Fall on us!” and to the hills, “Cover us!” ’

source: Ijeh-inem itile amahon thing hing bon hitia abolule, thing go i-aloda dinguham? ati.
target: For if people do these things when the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?”

source: Hichea chun amatoh thatha ding akhang gilou adang mi ni jong apuijun ahi.
target: Two other men, both criminals, were also led out with him to be executed.

source: Chuin Calvary atiu mun chu alhun phatnun, ama chu thingpelah akhenbeh-un, chule akhang giloute ni jong chu khat ajet lamah, khat avei lamah akhenbeh-un ahi.
target: When they came to the place called the Skull, they crucified him there, along with the criminals—one on his right, the other on his left.

source: Chuin Jesu'n, Pa, amaho hi ngaidamin; ijeh-inem itile amahon abolu hi ahepouve, ati. Chuin avangphapha changhen tin vang akiveuvin aponsil chu akihom taove.
target: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.” And they divided up his clothes by casting lots.

source: Chule miho chu adingun ave jingun ahi. Chuin alah uva um vaipohon chun anelpeh-un, Midang bon huhhing-a chu; Pathen lhen Christa chu ahile, ama kihuh hinghen, atiuve.
target: The people stood watching, and the rulers even sneered at him. They said, “He saved others; let him save himself if he is God’s Messiah, the Chosen One.”

source: Chuin sepaiho jong chun totnop nan aneijun, akoma ahungun, lengpiga twi thuh apeuvin;
target: The soldiers also came up and mocked him. They offered him wine vinegar

source: Juda te lengpa nahile kihuh hingin, atiuvin ahi.
target: and said, “If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself.”

source: Chule ama hi JUDA TE LENGPA AHI, tia Greek, Latin, chule Hebrew paova kisun hetsahna achung vumah aumin ahi.
target: There was a written notice above him, which read: this is the king of the jews .

source: Chuin akikhaija khang gilou teni khat chun ajonhouvin, Nangma Christa chu nahile nangma kihuh hingin lang keini jong neihuhhing lhontang, ati.
target: One of the criminals who hung there hurled insults at him: “Aren’t you the Messiah? Save yourself and us!”

source: Ahivangin khatpa chun ama chu adonbutnin aphoh-in, Talent thakhat namat khom jenga jong, nangman Pathen jeng jong nagin louham?
target: But the other criminal rebuked him. “Don’t you fear God,” he said, “since you are under the same sentence?

source: Eini hi talent man ding dol mong ihi; ajehchu ithilbol manbou ikisan ahi: hichepa vanghi ima suhset neilou ahi, ati.
target: We are punished justly, for we are getting what our deeds deserve. But this man has done nothing wrong.”

source: Chuin aman Jesu henga, Pakai nalenggam ma nalhun teng neihe jingin, ati.
target: Then he said, “Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n amapa jah-a, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahi, Tunia gam loupi-a keimatoh i-um khom ding ahi, ati.
target: Jesus answered him, “Truly I tell you, today you will be with me in paradise.”

source: Hichu nidan gup don ahin, chua pat chun nidan ko geijin gam jouse chunga thim ahung jingin;
target: It was now about noon, and darkness came over the whole land until three in the afternoon,

source: Nisa athimtan, chule houin'a pondal len chu alailunga akeh lhan ahi.
target: for the sun stopped shining. And the curtain of the temple was torn in two.

source: Chuin Jesu'n aw gingtah-in asamin, Pa, nakhutna kalhagao kapedoh-e, atin atantai.
target: Jesus called out with a loud voice, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit.” When he had said this, he breathed his last.

source: Chuin sepai jalamkai chun thil soh umchan chu amun phatnin, Pathen avahchoijin, Hichepa hi michonpha tahbeh mong ahi, ati.
target: The centurion, seeing what had happened, praised God and said, “Surely this was a righteous man.”

source: Chuin vetchah chu ve dinga hung khom mipi ho chun thilsoh umchan chengse chu amuvin, a-op beng bengin akinungle taovin ahi.
target: When all the people who had gathered to witness this sight saw what took place, they beat their breasts and went away.

source: Chule akihetpiho le Galilee gama kona ahin kilhonpi numei ho jong chu galkanga adingun, chuti thilsoh hochu amu jingun ahi.
target: But all those who knew him, including the women who had followed him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.

source: Chuin, veuvin, houvai poloi lah-a chun amin Joseph atiu mikhat aumin; amachu miphatah le chonphatah ahi.
target: Now there was a man named Joseph, a member of the Council, a good and upright man,

source: Aman amaho kihousomna le thilbol chu ajop pon ahi. Amahi Judah ho khopi Arimathea kho-a kon ahin, chule Pathen gam ngah jinga um ahi.
target: who had not consented to their decision and action. He came from the Judean town of Arimathea, and he himself was waiting for the kingdom of God.

source: Hiche mipa hi Pilate henga ahungin, Jesu long chu athumtai.
target: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus’ body.

source: Chuin along chu alalhan, tupat pon nemin atomin, amasanga koimacha koikhahna lou song kilai lhan sunga chun alupsahtan ahi.
target: Then he took it down, wrapped it in linen cloth and placed it in a tomb cut in the rock, one in which no one had yet been laid.

source: Hiche ni chu kigot ni ahin, chule cholngah nikho jong anaitan ahi.
target: It was Preparation Day, and the Sabbath was about to begin.

source: Chuin Galilee'a kona ahinlhonpi numei ho chun anung ajuijun, lhanle along chu iti akoiju agaveuvin ahi.
target: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed Joseph and saw the tomb and how his body was laid in it.

source: Chuin amaho kinungle uvin, lounam le thao namtui akigot uvin; chule danthupeh dungjuijin cholngah nin akicholngah-un, ahi.
target: Then they went home and prepared spices and perfumes. But they rested on the Sabbath in obedience to the commandment.

source: Tun hapta nikho masapen jingpi matah-in agotsao thil namtui chu akichoijun, lhan lama chun midang phabep khat to lhonin ahungun, ahi.
target: On the first day of the week, very early in the morning, the women took the spices they had prepared and went to the tomb.

source: Ahin lhankotna kona song chu tahdohsa anaum agamuve.
target: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb,

source: Chuin asunga alutnun ahile, Pakai Jesu long chu agamu tapouve.
target: but when they entered, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, chuche jeh-a alungdon pettah-un, veuvin, pon avala val lahlah kisil mi ni akomuvah ahung ding lhonin;
target: While they were wondering about this, suddenly two men in clothes that gleamed like lightning stood beside them.

source: Hichun amaho tijatah a akunchah pettah-un, chuche mite ni chun ajah uvah, Athiho lah-a ibola ahinga nahol uham?
target: In their fright the women bowed down with their faces to the ground, but the men said to them, “Why do you look for the living among the dead?

source: Ama hikoma aumtapoi, athoudohtai. Aman Galilee gama aum laija najah uva asei,
target: He is not here; he has risen! Remember how he told you, while he was still with you in Galilee:

source: Mihem Chapa hi michonseho khutna pehdoh-a umtei ding, chule thingpel'a kikhenbeh ding, chule nithum nileh thoudoh kit tei ding ahi, ati chu geldoh-un, ati lhone.
target: ‘The Son of Man must be delivered over to the hands of sinners, be crucified and on the third day be raised again.’ ”

source: Hichun amahon athuseiho chu ageldoh-un,
target: Then they remembered his words.

source: Chuin lhana kon chun akileuvin, thu chucheng chu somlekhat le adangho jah-a agaseijun ahi.
target: When they came back from the tomb, they told all these things to the Eleven and to all the others.

source: Hicheng thu chu solchah ho jah-a gaseija chu Magdalene Mariam, Joanna, Jacob nu Mariam, chule numei danghotoh ahiuvin ahi.
target: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the others with them who told this to the apostles.

source: Ahivangin athuseiju chu amahon moh thu maimaijin anangaitou vin, ana tahsan pouve.
target: But they did not believe the women, because their words seemed to them like nonsense.

source: Ahivangin Peter akipatdoh-in, lhan lama chun alhai jel-in; chuin akunsuh-in, agahven ahile tupat ponho sehseh aum chu amun, thilsoh umchan chu kidang sapumin akile tan ahi.
target: Peter, however, got up and ran to the tomb. Bending over, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he went away, wondering to himself what had happened.

source: Chuin, veuvin hiche nitah chun alah uva mi ni Emmaus kho-a ache lhonin; hichu Jerusalem'a kona ching somgup ahi.
target: Now that same day two of them were going to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.

source: Amani chu chuche thilsoh umchan jouse thudol akihoulim lhonin ahi.
target: They were talking with each other about everything that had happened.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, amani akihoulim lhona akidohto pet lhonin, Jesu tah-in ahinnai lhonin, amani chutoh alhonin ahi.
target: As they talked and discussed these things with each other, Jesus himself came up and walked along with them;

source: Amavang amanin ahet lhon louna dinga amit lhon kiphel-a ahi.
target: but they were kept from recognizing him.

source: Chuin aman ajah lhona, Nalamjot pum lhona khat le khat ipi thu kihoulim nahi lhona, nguichet nahi lhonham? ati.
target: He asked them, “What are you discussing together as you walk along?” They stood still, their faces downcast.

source: Chuin khatjoh amin Cleopas atiu chun adonbutnin, Jerusalem'a kholjin tulai thusoh umchan helou nangma changsehbou nahim? ati.
target: One of them, named Cleopas, asked him, “Are you the only one visiting Jerusalem who does not know the things that have happened there in these days?”

source: Chuin aman amani jah-a, Ipi thu ham? ati. Chuin amanin, Pathen le miho jouse mitmu-a athu-a le athilbola themgao thahat neitah Nazareth Jesu chungchang,
target: “What things?” he asked. “About Jesus of Nazareth,” they replied. “He was a prophet, powerful in word and deed before God and all the people.

source: Thempu pipuiho le kavaipo houvin tha dinga thu alhuhsah dinga apehdoh uva, thingpel'a athau thudol ahi.
target: The chief priests and our rulers handed him over to be sentenced to death, and they crucified him;

source: Keihonla ama chu Israelte lhatdoh dinga kakineppiu ahi: ahin hicheng tailou chun, chuti thilso-a pat tuni hi anithum ni ahitai.
target: but we had hoped that he was the one who was going to redeem Israel. And what is more, it is the third day since all this took place.

source: Chujongle kaloi lah uva jingpi matah-a alhan lama gache-a numei phabep khatnin eilungdon sah-ui;
target: In addition, some of our women amazed us. They went to the tomb early this morning

source: Amahon along agoholmo phatnun, ahung kileuvin, Keihon vantil kamuvin, ama chun, Ama ahing kit tai atie, ahung tiuve.
target: but didn’t find his body. They came and told us that they had seen a vision of angels, who said he was alive.

source: Chuin kaloi lah uva phabep khat lhan lama agacheule, numei ho sei bangbang chun agamuvin; ama agamu pouvin ahi, ati lhone.
target: Then some of our companions went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said, but they did not see Jesus.”

source: Chuin aman ajah lhonah, Vo lungthimbei, themgaoho thusei jouse tahsan ding lung ngongkai ho:
target: He said to them, “How foolish you are, and how slow to believe all that the prophets have spoken!

source: Christa chun hicheng gim genthei chu athoh sohkeija, chule aloupina-a lut ding mong hilouham? ati.
target: Did not the Messiah have to suffer these things and then enter his glory?”

source: Chuin Mosi'a patle themgaoho jouse-a patnin Pathen lekhabu pumpi-a ama thudol kisun jouse chu amani ahilchentan ahi.
target: And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, he explained to them what was said in all the Scriptures concerning himself.

source: Chuin achena dingu khokom ageijun, ama akala chepai ding bang akisai.
target: As they approached the village to which they were going, Jesus continued on as if he were going farther.

source: Chuin amanin alho lhonin, Keinitoh umnao hite; ni asaujo achetan; nilhahkon jong ahitai, ati lhone. Chuin ama amanitoh umdingin aluttan ahi.
target: But they urged him strongly, “Stay with us, for it is nearly evening; the day is almost over.” So he went in to stay with them.

source: Chuin amanitoh an nedingin atouvin, aman changlhah alan phatthei aboh-in, chuin aheh balbalin amani chu apei.
target: When he was at the table with them, he took bread, gave thanks, broke it and began to give it to them.

source: Hitah chun amit lhon avah-in, ama chu ahedoh lhontan; chuin ama amitmu lhona konin amangtan ahi.
target: Then their eyes were opened and they recognized him, and he disappeared from their sight.

source: Chuin amani chun khatnin khat jah-a, Lampi dunga eiki houlimpi lhona Pathen lekhabu thu eihilchen lhona chu ilung soulahlah jeng hih-am? akitito lhone.
target: They asked each other, “Were not our hearts burning within us while he talked with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?”

source: Hiche pettah chun akipat lhonin, Jerusalem lama akile lhonin, chule chukoma somlekhat le aumpiho mun khatna anaum khomu agatoh lhonin;
target: They got up and returned at once to Jerusalem. There they found the Eleven and those with them, assembled together

source: Amahon, Pakai athoudoh tahbeh mongtai; chule Simon akimusah-e, anatiuve.
target: and saying, “It is true! The Lord has risen and has appeared to Simon.”

source: Chuin lam dunga thu umchan le changlhah ahebala amanin ahetdoh lhon, imajouse chu amanin jong asei lhonin ahi.
target: Then the two told what had happened on the way, and how Jesus was recognized by them when he broke the bread.

source: Thu chucheng asei pettah-un, Jesu alailung uvah ahung dingin, Nachung uvah lungmon umhen, ati.
target: While they were still talking about this, Jesus himself stood among them and said to them, “Peace be with you.”

source: Ahivangin amahon thilha kamu ahi tin angaitouvin, akichauvin atija lheh jengui.
target: They were startled and frightened, thinking they saw a ghost.

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Ibola lung olmoa nahiuvem? Chule ibola nalunguva ginchatlel sohham?
target: He said to them, “Why are you troubled, and why do doubts rise in your minds?

source: Kakhut kakeng veuvin lang heuvin, keima kahibouve; neithamun lang veuvin; ijeh-inem itile keima neimu bangu hin lhagaovin gu le phe aneipoi, ati.
target: Look at my hands and my feet. It is I myself! Touch me and see; a ghost does not have flesh and bones, as you see I have.”

source: Hitichun aseijin, akhut akeng avetsahtan ahi.
target: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and feet.

source: Ahivangin akipa jeh uva chuche-a jong atahsan lou laijuva alungdon pettah-un, aman ajah uva, Hikoma hi nehding ima them naneijum? ati.
target: And while they still did not believe it because of joy and amazement, he asked them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”

source: Chuin amahon nga kikang halkhat le khoibal khat apeuvin ahi.
target: They gave him a piece of broiled fish,

source: Chuin aman alan a-ang sunguvah anetai.
target: and he took it and ate it in their presence.

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Keima nang hotoh iumkhom laijuva Mosi danthua, themgaoho lekhabua, chule Labu-a, keima thudol kisun jouse guilhung sohkei ding ahi tia najah uva kasei chu hiche ahi, ati.
target: He said to them, “This is what I told you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets and the Psalms.”

source: Chutah chun Pathen lekhabua chu ahetdoh theina dingun alungu ahonpeh-in,
target: Then he opened their minds so they could understand the Scriptures.

source: Chule ajah uva, Hitin akisune, Christa chun gimle genthei athoh-a, anithum nileh athi lah-a kona athodoh kit ngai ahi:
target: He told them, “This is what is written: The Messiah will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,

source: Chule Jerusalem'a kipan chitin namtin jah jouse-a ama mina lungheija chonset suhbeina kihil lhang ding ahi.
target: and repentance for the forgiveness of sins will be preached in his name to all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

source: Hichengse chu aboncha ahetoh nangho nahiuve.
target: You are witnesses of these things.

source: Chule, veuvin, ka Pa thutep chu keiman nangho chunga kahinsol lhah ding ahi; amavang chunga kona thahat na-a nakivon masangseuvin, Jerusalem khopi-a hin um jengun, ati.
target: I am going to send you what my Father has promised; but stay in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high.”

source: Chuin aman amaho chu Bethany khokeng geijin apuidoh-in, akhut ajahdoh-in, amaho chu phatthei aboh-in ahi.
target: When he had led them out to the vicinity of Bethany, he lifted up his hands and blessed them.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, chutia phatthei aboh pettah chun, amaho chu akikhenpin, chuin van'a lahtouvin aumtai.
target: While he was blessing them, he left them and was taken up into heaven.

source: Chuin amahon ama chu ahouvun, kipah thanom tah-in Jerusalem'a ahung kile taovin;
target: Then they worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy.

source: Chule houin'a Pathen vahchoi le vangboh-in aum jomjing taovin ahi. Amen.
