target: And they stayed continually at the temple, praising God.

source: Atila chu Thu uma ahin, Thu chu Pathen toh uma ahi, chule Thu chu Pathen ahi.
target: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

source: Hichu atila Pathen toh uma ahi.
target: He was with God in the beginning.

source: Thil jouse Ama vanga um ahi; aum jouse hi ama louva um khatcha jong aumpoi.
target: Through him all things were made; without him nothing was made that has been made.

source: Ama-a chun hinna aumin, chule hinna chu mihem vah ahi.
target: In him was life, and that life was the light of all mankind.

source: Chuin vah chun muthim lah ahinsalin, ahin muthimin anahepoi.
target: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.

source: Pathen'a kona hinkisol mi khat ahungin, ama chu amin John ahi.
target: There was a man sent from God whose name was John.

source: Ama vanga mi jousen atahsan theina dinga vah thudol chu hettohsah dinga, ama chu hunga ahi.
target: He came as a witness to testify concerning that light, so that through him all might believe.

source: Ama chu vah chu ahipon, vah thudol chu hettohsah dinga hung kisol joh ahibouve.
target: He himself was not the light; he came only as a witness to the light.

source: Vannoi'a hungah mitin salvah chu vah tahbeh ahi.
target: The true light that gives light to everyone was coming into the world.

source: Ama chu vannoi'a ahung umin, chule vannoi hi ama sem ahi, ahin vannoi'in ama anahepoi.
target: He was in the world, and though the world was made through him, the world did not recognize him.

source: Ama ama-ate henga hunga ahin, ama-aten anasang pouve.
target: He came to that which was his own, but his own did not receive him.

source: Ahivangin aman anasanga, ama mina tahsan chan chu, Pathen chate ahi theina dingu thaneina apetai,
target: Yet to all who did receive him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God—

source: chuteho chu thisana kona peng hilou, tahsaphe lunglama kona peng jong hilou, mihem lunglama kona peng jong hilouvin, Pathen'a kona peng ahibouvui.
target: children born not of natural descent, nor of human decision or a husband’s will, but born of God.

source: Chuin Thu chu tahsaphe ahung soh-in, ilah uva ahung chengin, keihon aloupina, Pa-a kona chapa changkhatseh loupi chu, lungset le thutah dimsetnin kamutaove.
target: The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth.

source: John'in ama thudol chu ahettohsah len, Kanunga hunga chu keima sangin amasa jotai; ama keima masang peh-a um jingsa ahi jeh-in, tia kasei chu ama hi ahi, tin asame.
target: (John testified concerning him. He cried out, saying, “This is the one I spoke about when I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.’ ”)

source: Ajeh chu ama aletsetna kon chun, eiho lungset chunga lungset ichang taove.
target: Out of his fullness we have all received grace in place of grace already given.

source: Ajeh iham itile danthu chu Mosi peh ahin; lungset le thutah chu Christa vanga hung umdoh ahi.
target: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.

source: Koiman imatih chanin Pathen amukhapoi; Pa oma beh jing Chapa changkhat chun aphondoh ahitai.
target: No one has ever seen God, but the one and only Son, who is himself God and is in closest relationship with the Father, has made him known.

source: Jerusalem'a kona Juda hon thempuho le danthu sunho John henga, Koi nahim? tia dong dinga asoluva, John thu hettohsah chu hiche ahi.
target: Now this was John’s testimony when the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him who he was.

source: Aman aseidoh jenge, aseileppoi; Keima Christa kahipoi, tin aseidoh jenge.
target: He did not fail to confess, but confessed freely, “I am not the Messiah.”

source: Chuin amahon adongun, Koiba nahim? Elijah nahim? atiule aman, Kahipoi, ati. Themgao chu nahim, atiule, Kahipoi, ati.
target: They asked him, “Then who are you? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the Prophet?” He answered, “No.”

source: Hijeh chun amahon ajah-a, Koi nahim? Eihinsol teho kadonbut theina dinguva, koi kahi nakitim? atiuve.
target: Finally they said, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

source: Aman, Keima Isaiah themgao sei, Pakai lampi sem jangun tia, gamthipma khosam-a mi khat aw gin chu kahi, ati.
target: John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet, “I am the voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way for the Lord.’ ”

source: Ahung kisol miho chu Pharisai ho hinsol ahiuve.
target: Now the Pharisees who had been sent

source: Chuin amahon adongun ajah-a, Christa nahi louva, chule Elijah la nahi louva, themgao chula nahi loule, ibola baptize nachansah jiham, atiuve.
target: questioned him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Messiah, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?”

source: John'in adonbutnin ajah uva, Keiman twija baptize kachansah ji ahin, nalah uva nanghon nahet louvu mi khat adinge.
target: “I baptize with water,” John replied, “but among you stands one you do not know.

source: Ama chu ahi kanunga hunga, keisanga chungnungjo katichu, keima akengchot khao sutlham hoi jong kahipoi, ati.
target: He is the one who comes after me, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.”

source: Hicheng chu John'in baptize abolna, Jordan galla Bethabara mun'a kibola ahi.
target: This all happened at Bethany on the other side of the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

source: Ajingin ahenga Jesu ahung amun, hichun, Veuvin, vannoi chonset pomang, Pathen Kelngoinou khu!
target: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, “Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

source: Ama hi ahi, kanunga hunga keima sanga chungnungjo tia kasei chu, ijeh-inem itile ama keima masang peh-a anaumsa ahitai.
target: This is the one I meant when I said, ‘A man who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.’

source: Keiman ama kanahepoi; ahivangin Israel lah-a ama phondohna dinga, twija baptize chansah-a kahung ahi, ati.
target: I myself did not know him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that he might be revealed to Israel.”

source: Chuin John'in ahettohsah-in, Keiman vakhu banga Lhagao chu van'a kona ahung kumlhah-a achunga achuh kamun, achungah aumdentai.
target: Then John gave this testimony: “I saw the Spirit come down from heaven as a dove and remain on him.

source: Chule keiman ama kanahepoi, ahivangin twi'a baptize chansah-a eisola chun kajah-a, Nangman Lhagao ahung kum-a achunga aum namu chu, ama chu Lhagao Thenga baptize chansah ding chu ahi, eiti.
target: And I myself did not know him, but the one who sent me to baptize with water told me, ‘The man on whom you see the Spirit come down and remain is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’

source: Chule keiman kamua, Ama hi Pathen Chapa ahi tia kahettohsah ahitai, ati.
target: I have seen and I testify that this is God’s Chosen One.”

source: Ajing nikhon John aseijui mini toh ana dingin;
target: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.

source: Jesu avale chu agahven, Veuvin, Pathen Kelngoi nou khu! ati.
target: When he saw Jesus passing by, he said, “Look, the Lamb of God!”

source: Chuin aseijuite ni chun athusei chu aja lhonin, Jesu nung ajui lhontai.
target: When the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.

source: Chuin Jesu akiheijin, amanin anung ajui lhon chu amun, Ipi nahol lhonham, ati. Hichun amanin Rabbi (hichu houhil tina ahi) hoija na-umjim? ati lhone.
target: Turning around, Jesus saw them following and asked, “What do you want?” They said, “Rabbi” (which means “Teacher”), “where are you staying?”

source: Chuin Aman, hung lhonin hung ve lhontan ati. Chuin ache lhonin aumna chu agamu lhonin, chuin hiche ni chun amatoh aum lhontai, hichu nidan som don ahi.
target: “Come,” he replied, “and you will see.” So they went and saw where he was staying, and they spent that day with him. It was about four in the afternoon.

source: John thusei ja-a anung juite ni khatjoh chu Simon Peter sopipa Andrew ahi.
target: Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, was one of the two who heard what John had said and who had followed Jesus.

source: Ama chun amasa penin asopipa Simon chu amun ajah-a, Messiah kamutaove, ati; hichu Christa tina ahi.
target: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother Simon and tell him, “We have found the Messiah” (that is, the Christ).

source: Hitichun Jesu hengah ahinpuijin ahi. Jesu'n ama chu aven, Jona chapa Simon nahi; Kepha nakisah ding ahi, ati (Hichu Peter tina ahi).
target: And he brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas” (which, when translated, is Peter).

source: Chuin ajingin Jesu'n Galilee gam lama che agon ahile, Philip amun ajah-a, neijuijin ati.
target: The next day Jesus decided to leave for Galilee. Finding Philip, he said to him, “Follow me.”

source: Philip chu Bethsaida khomi ahin, Andrew le Peter chenna khomama chu ahi.
target: Philip, like Andrew and Peter, was from the town of Bethsaida.

source: Philip chun Nathanael amun ajah-a, Athudol Mosi'n danthu bu-a asut le themgaoho asutnu, Nazareth Jesu, Joseph chapa chu kamutaove, ati.
target: Philip found Nathanael and told him, “We have found the one Moses wrote about in the Law, and about whom the prophets also wrote—Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”

source: Chuin Nathanael chun ajah-a, Nazareth kho-a kona thil pha soh thei ngaijem, ati. Philip'in ajah-a, hungin lang hung vetan, ati.
target: “Nazareth! Can anything good come from there?” Nathanael asked. “Come and see,” said Philip.

source: Jesu'n Nathanael ahenga ahung amun, athudol aseijin; veuvin, Israel mitahbeh, phatlhemna nei louhel khu ati.
target: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, he said of him, “Here truly is an Israelite in whom there is no deceit.”

source: Nathanael'in ajah-a, Hoija kona iti neihet ham? ati. Jesu'n adonbutnin ajah-a, Philip'in nakou masanga theichang phung noija na-uma chu kamu ahitai, ati.
target: “How do you know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, “I saw you while you were still under the fig tree before Philip called you.”

source: Chuin Nathanael'in adonbutnin, Rabbi, nangma Pathen Chapa nahi; nangma Israelte lengpa nahi, ati.
target: Then Nathanael declared, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God; you are the king of Israel.”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Keiman najah-a, Theichang phung noija na-uma kamu ahitai, tia kasei jeh-a chu natahsan ham? Hiche sanga chu chungnungjo namu ding ahi, ati.
target: Jesus said, “You believe because I told you I saw you under the fig tree. You will see greater things than that.”

source: Chuin aman ajah-a, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahi, tunungle van akihona, Mihem Chapa chunga Pathen vantil ho akumsuh akaltou namu ding ahi, ati.
target: He then added, “Very truly I tell you, you will see ‘heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending on’ the Son of Man.”

source: Chuin ani thum nin Galilee gama Cana kho-ah moupui golvah aumin; chua chun Jesu nu aumin ahi.
target: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there,

source: Chule moupui golvahna-a chu Jesu le aseijuiho jong akouvu ahi.
target: and Jesus and his disciples had also been invited to the wedding.

source: Chuin lengpitwi alhahsam phatnin, anun Jesu jah-a, Lengpitwi aneitapouve, ati.
target: When the wine was gone, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no more wine.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah-a, Numei, eini i-ikin umam? Keima kaphat lhung loulai hi, ati.
target: “Woman, why do you involve me?” Jesus replied. “My hour has not yet come.”

source: Anun lhachaho jah-a, Najah uva asei chan bolun, ati.
target: His mother said to the servants, “Do whatever he tells you.”

source: Chukoma chu Juda te dana kisuhthengna, mon ni mon thum ket cheh songbel gup uma ahin,
target: Nearby stood six stone water jars, the kind used by the Jews for ceremonial washing, each holding from twenty to thirty gallons.

source: Jesu'n ajah uva, twibel hochu twi sung dimun, ati. Chuin amahon hicheng chu twi asung dimset taove.
target: Jesus said to the servants, “Fill the jars with water” ; so they filled them to the brim.

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Tun thalunlang golvah vaihompa henga choijun, ati. Chuin amahon achoitauve.
target: Then he told them, “Now draw some out and take it to the master of the banquet.” They did so,

source: Chuin golvah vaihompa chun twisih lengpitwi kisosah chu atepkhah phat chun, Hoija kon ahi ahepoi (lhachaho athala pangho vang chun ahenauve), chuin golvah vaihompa chun moulang chu akouvin, ajah-a,
target: and the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine. He did not realize where it had come from, though the servants who had drawn the water knew. Then he called the bridegroom aside

source: Mitinin lengpitwi achih atungdoh masa ngaijin; chule min adon khop tengle adaojep apejin; nangman tu geijin lengpitwi chih nakoi nalaije, ati.
target: and said, “Everyone brings out the choice wine first and then the cheaper wine after the guests have had too much to drink; but you have saved the best till now.”

source: Jesu'n hiche melchihna kidang chu Galilee gama Cana kho-a abolpat ahin, aloupina aphongdoh tan; chule aseijuihon atahsan taove.
target: What Jesus did here in Cana of Galilee was the first of the signs through which he revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

source: Chuin chuche jou chun Capernaum'a agachesuh-in, amatoh anutoh chule asopiho le aseijuiho toh ahiuvin, chukoma chun ni sotpi aumpouve.
target: After this he went down to Capernaum with his mother and brothers and his disciples. There they stayed for a few days.

source: Chuin Juda ho kalchuh kut anaitan ahile, Jesu Jerusalem'a ache toutai.
target: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

source: Chuin aman houin sungah bongle kelngoi chule vapal johho, chule sum lhengho atouvu agamu-in;
target: In the temple courts he found people selling cattle, sheep and doves, and others sitting at tables exchanging money.

source: Chuin aman khao kiholin jepna asemin, abonchauvin, kelngoi pum le bongchal pumin houin'a konin anodoh-in, sumlheng ho sum aboh lhahpeh-in, adokhangu chu alekhup peh-in;
target: So he made a whip out of cords, and drove all from the temple courts, both sheep and cattle; he scattered the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables.

source: Chuin vapal johho jah-a chun, Hitehohi hia konin podoh un; ka Pa-in hi sumkolveina in'in bol hih-un, ati.
target: To those who sold doves he said, “Get these out of here! Stop turning my Father’s house into a market!”

source: Hichun, na-in'a katom pana-in eine chaije, tia kisun chu aseijuihon ageldoh taove.
target: His disciples remembered that it is written: “Zeal for your house will consume me.”

source: Hijeh chun Juda hon adonbutnun ajah-a, Thil hicheng nabol hi amelchihna ipi neimusah-um, atiuve.
target: The Jews then responded to him, “What sign can you show us to prove your authority to do all this?”

source: Chuin Jesu'n adonbutnin ajah uva, Hiche houin hi suchimun, keiman ni thumin tungdoh inge, ati.
target: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and I will raise it again in three days.”

source: Hijeh chun Juda hon, Hiche houin sahna-a kum somli le kum gup jen lut chu nangman ni thuma natundoh ding ong, atiuve.
target: They replied, “It has taken forty-six years to build this temple, and you are going to raise it in three days?”

source: Amanla ama tahsa houin aseina ahibouve.
target: But the temple he had spoken of was his body.

source: Hijeh chun ama athi lah-a kona kaithouva aum phat chun, aseijuiten ajah uva hiche asei chu ageldoh-un, Pathen lekhabua thule Jesu thusei chu atahsan taove.
target: After he was raised from the dead, his disciples recalled what he had said. Then they believed the scripture and the words that Jesus had spoken.

source: Kalchuh kut laija ama Jerusalem'a aum pet chun, athilbol melchihna ho chu amuvin mi tamtah-in ama minah atahsan taove.
target: Now while he was in Jerusalem at the Passover Festival, many people saw the signs he was performing and believed in his name.

source: Ahivangin Jesu'n amaho chu angampipoi; ajeh chu aman mi jouse ahetsoh ahin;
target: But Jesus would not entrust himself to them, for he knew all people.

source: Chule mi thudol min ahetsah ding chu angaipoi; ijeh-inem itile mi lung sunga ipi aum aman ahet sohkei ahi.
target: He did not need any testimony about mankind, for he knew what was in each person.

source: Pharisai ho lah-a mi amin Nicodemus atiu Juda ho vaipo khat aumin,
target: Now there was a Pharisee, a man named Nicodemus who was a member of the Jewish ruling council.

source: Ama chu jan-in Jesu hengah ahungin ajah-a, Rabbi, Pathen'a kona hung houhil khat nahi ti, keihon kaheuve. Ajeh chu Pathen toh kivop louvan melchihna kidang nabol chengse hi koiman abol theipoi, ati.
target: He came to Jesus at night and said, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs you are doing if God were not with him.”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin ajah-a, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahi, Koi hijongle chunga kona thahpen kit lou chu koiman Pathen lenggam amu theipoi, ati.
target: Jesus replied, “Very truly I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless they are born again.”

source: Nicodemus'in ajah-a, Mi ateh tengle iti pen thah thei dingham? Aniveina-a anu oisunga lutna peng kit theijam, ati.
target: “How can someone be born when they are old?” Nicodemus asked. “Surely they cannot enter a second time into their mother’s womb to be born!”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahi, Mi koi hijongle twi leh Lhagaova apen loule Pathen lenggam alut theipoi.
target: Jesus answered, “Very truly I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless they are born of water and the Spirit.

source: Tahsaphe-a kona penga chu tahsephe ahin, Lhagaova kona penga chu lhagao ahi.
target: Flesh gives birth to flesh, but the Spirit gives birth to spirit.

source: Chunga kona nathahpen kit dingu ahi tia najah-a kasei chu datmo hih-in.
target: You should not be surprised at my saying, ‘You must be born again.’

source: Hui khu anun nomna lam lamah anungjin, nangman agin najanan hoija hung kona hoi lama acheji nahepoi: Lhagaova pengho chengse jong chuti chu ahiuve, ati.
target: The wind blows wherever it pleases. You hear its sound, but you cannot tell where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”

source: Nicodemus'in adonbutnin ajah-a, Hicheng chu iti hi thei dingham, ati.
target: “How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin ajah-a, Nangla Juda te houhil nahin, hitiho chu nahet louham?
target: “You are Israel’s teacher,” said Jesus, “and do you not understand these things?

source: Keiman tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahi, Keihon kahet kaseijuva, kamu kahetsah-u ahi, ahivangin kahet tohsah-u hi nanghon nasang pouve.
target: Very truly I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, but still you people do not accept our testimony.

source: Keiman nangho jah-a leiset thu kaseija nanghon natahsan louvule, van thuho seileng iti natahsan dingu ham?
target: I have spoken to you of earthly things and you do not believe; how then will you believe if I speak of heavenly things?

source: Van'a uma, van'a kona hung kumlha Mihem Chapa tailou, koima van'a akal khapoi.
target: No one has ever gone into heaven except the one who came from heaven—the Son of Man.

source: Chule gamthipma Mosi'n gul adop sang bang banga chu Mihem Chapa hi kidomsang ding ahi.
target: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,

source: Koi hile Ama tahsan chan chu mangthah louva, tonsot hinkemlou anei ahitai.
target: that everyone who believes may have eternal life in him.”

source: Ajeh chu Pathen'in hibanga hi vannoi angailut jeh-in, Achapa changkhat chu apetan ahi; koi hijongle Ama tahsan chan chun mangthah louva tonsot hinkemlou anei ahitai.
target: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.

source: Ajeh chu Pathen'in Chapa chu vannoi themmo chansah dinga hilouvin, vannoi mite ama vanga huhhinga aum theina dinguva vannoi'a ahinsol joh ahibouve.
target: For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through him.

source: Ama tahsan chu themmo chang louva ahitai; atahsan lou vang chu themmo changsa um ahitai, aman Pathen Chapa changkhat mina atahsan lou jeh chun.
target: Whoever believes in him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe stands condemned already because they have not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son.

source: Chule themmo achanau chu hiche ahi, vannoi'ah vah ahungin ahivangin achonnau phatlou jeh-in, mihon vah sangin muthim adeijouvin ahi.
target: This is the verdict: Light has come into the world, but people loved darkness instead of light because their deeds were evil.

source: Ijeh-inem itile achon phalou jousen vah ahotbole, achon phatlou chu kisosal khante tin, vah-a chun hung jong ahungjipoi.
target: Everyone who does evil hates the light, and will not come into the light for fear that their deeds will be exposed.

source: Thutah bola vang chu, athilpha bol chu Pathen vanga ahi ti phondohnan vah-a ahungjin ahi, ati.
target: But whoever lives by the truth comes into the light, so that it may be seen plainly that what they have done has been done in the sight of God.

source: Chucheng nung chun Jesu aseijuite toh Judea gamah ahungun, chuin chukoma chun amahotoh aumin, baptize achansah jin ahi.
target: After this, Jesus and his disciples went out into the Judean countryside, where he spent some time with them, and baptized.

source: Chule John'in jong Salim kenga Ainon kho-a chun twi atam jeh chun baptize achansah-in; miho chu ahungun baptize ahung changjiuvin ahi.
target: Now John also was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there was plenty of water, and people were coming and being baptized.

source: Ijeh-inem itile John songkulla kikhum loilai ahi.
target: (This was before John was put in prison.)

source: Hia chun John seijui ho le Juda miho kisuhtheng thudollin akineltauvin ahi.
target: An argument developed between some of John’s disciples and a certain Jew over the matter of ceremonial washing.

source: Chuin amaho John henga ahungun ajah-a, Rabbi, ven, Jordan gala naumpi athu nahettohsah, ama chun baptize achansah jin, mi jouse ahenga ahungjiuve, atiuve.
target: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, that man who was with you on the other side of the Jordan—the one you testified about—look, he is baptizing, and everyone is going to him.”

source: John'in adonbutnin, Mi van'a kona kipe lou chu ima achang theipoi.
target: To this John replied, “A person can receive only what is given them from heaven.

source: Nanghotah keima thu hettohsah nahiuve, Keiman, Keima Christa kahipoi, ama masanga hinkisol kahibouve, kati chu.
target: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Messiah but am sent ahead of him.’

source: Mou kichenpia chu moulang ahi; moulang jol akoma dinga athusei ja-a chu, moulang aw gina chu hapa kipahji ahi; hijeh-a chu keima kipana chu kibulhit ahitai.
target: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend who attends the bridegroom waits and listens for him, and is full of joy when he hears the bridegroom’s voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.

source: Ama chu khangtou tou ding ahin, keima kemsuh suh ding kahi.
target: He must become greater; I must become less.”

source: Chunga kona hung chu mi jouse chunga chungnung pen ahi. Leija kona chu leija mi ahin, leiset thubou asei ahi; van'a kona hunga chu chungnung pen ahi.
target: The one who comes from above is above all; the one who is from the earth belongs to the earth, and speaks as one from the earth. The one who comes from heaven is above all.

source: Aman amu chanle ajahchan ahettohsah ahin; ahettohsah chu koiman asangpoi.
target: He testifies to what he has seen and heard, but no one accepts his testimony.

source: Athu hettohsah sanga chun, Pathen chu dihtah ahi tia mohor anamdet ahi
target: Whoever has accepted it has certified that God is truthful.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Pathen sol chun Pathen thubou aseijin; Pathen'in tepten Lhagao apepoi.
target: For the one whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.

source: Pa chun Chapa chu angailun, thil jouse akhutna apetai.
target: The Father loves the Son and has placed everything in his hands.

source: Chapa tahsana chun tonsot hinna anei ahitai; Chapa tahsanlou vang chun hinna mulou ding; amavang Pathen lunghan achunga umjo ahitai, ati.
target: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life, but whoever rejects the Son will not see life, for God’s wrath remains on them.

source: Chuin Pakai chun John sangin Jesu'n seijui tamjo asemin baptize achan tamsahjoi ti Pharisai hon ajataove ti ahet phatnin,
target: Now Jesus learned that the Pharisees had heard that he was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John—

source: (Jesu'n aman baptize chansah louva aseijuiho abolsah ahi jeng vangin)
target: although in fact it was not Jesus who baptized, but his disciples.

source: Judea gam adalhan Galilee gam lama akiletan ahi.
target: So he left Judea and went back once more to Galilee.

source: Chule Samaria gam ajot tei ding ahi.
target: Now he had to go through Samaria.

source: Chuti chun Samaria kho khat Sychar atiuva chun ahung lhungtan, hichu Jacob'in achapa Joseph apeh mun kom chu ahi.
target: So he came to a town in Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground Jacob had given to his son Joseph.

source: Chukoma chu Jacob twikul uma ahi. Jesu alamjot thacholin twikul panga chun atouvin; hichu nidan gup don ahi.
target: Jacob’s well was there, and Jesus, tired as he was from the journey, sat down by the well. It was about noon.

source: Chukoma chun Samaria numei khat twi thalin ahungin, Jesu'n amanu jah-a chun: Twi don ding neipen, ati.
target: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, “Will you give me a drink?”

source: (Ijeh-inem itile aseijuite chu neh ding cho-a khopi sunga chu lut anahitaove).
target: (His disciples had gone into the town to buy food.)

source: Hitichu ahi jeh chun, Samaria numeinu chun ajah-a, Nangmala Juda mi nahin, Samaria numei keima henga twi don ding nathum chu iti danham? ati. Ajehchu Juda miten Samaria mite thilkeu amanji louvu ahi.
target: The Samaritan woman said to him, “You are a Jew and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink?” (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.)

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin amanu jah-a, Pathen thilpeh henlang chule, twi don ding neipen tia nahenga thuma chu koi ahi helechun; nangman ama henga nathumjoh ding ahin, chutile aman nangma hinna twi peta dinga, ati.
target: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God and who it is that asks you for a drink, you would have asked him and he would have given you living water.”

source: Numeinu chun ajah-a, Pu, nangman athalna ding imala naneipon, twikul'a athuh-in, hintwi chu hoija nalah ham?
target: “Sir,” the woman said, “you have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where can you get this living water?

source: Twikul hi eipeuva, aman jong dona, achateu le aganchaho donsah-a kapau Jacob sanga chungnungjo nahim? ati.
target: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did also his sons and his livestock?”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin amanu jah-a, Koi hijongle hiche twi don chengse chu dangchah kit ding ahi.
target: Jesus answered, “Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again,

source: Ahin koi hijongle keiman kapeh ding twi vang chu adon jouse dangchah kit talou ding ahi; chule keiman kapeh ding twi chun asunga tonsot kemlou hintwi putna twinah sohdoh ding ahi, ati.
target: but whoever drinks the water I give them will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give them will become in them a spring of water welling up to eternal life.”

source: Numeinu chun ajah-a, Pu, hiche twi chu neipen, kadangchah kit louna dingle hikoma gam hichana hi twi thala kahungji louna dingin, ati.
target: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water so that I won’t get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water.”

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, Chen na-inneipu gakouvin, hikoma hung lhonin, ati.
target: He told her, “Go, call your husband and come back.”

source: Numeinu chun adonbutnin ajah-a, Keiman inneipu kaneipoi, ati. Jesu'n amanu jah-a, Inneipu kaneipoi, nati chu nasei dih lheh-e;
target: “I have no husband,” she replied. Jesus said to her, “You are right when you say you have no husband.

source: ijeh-inem itile nangman ji nga nanei ahitai, tu-a nanei khu nangma ji ahipoi; hiche nasei chu adih lheh-e, ati.
target: The fact is, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. What you have just said is quite true.”

source: Numeinu chun ajah-a, Pu, nangma hi themgao nahi, ti kahedoh tai.
target: “Sir,” the woman said, “I can see that you are a prophet.

source: Kapute kapateuvin hiche mola hi Pathen ahoujiu ahi; ahin nanghon, Min Pathen ahouna ding mun chu Jerusalem ahi, nati uve, ati.
target: Our ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews claim that the place where we must worship is in Jerusalem.”

source: Jesu'n amanu jah-a, Numei, neitahsanin, nanghon Pa chu nahouna dingu hiche mola jong hilou, Jerusalem'a jong hilou, hitobang phat chu ahung lhunge.
target: “Woman,” Jesus replied, “believe me, a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.

source: Nanghon nahet louhelu nahouvu ahin, keihon kahouvu hi kaheuve; ijeh-inem itile huhhingna chu Juda te lah-a konbou ahi.
target: You Samaritans worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.

source: Ahivangin phat ahung lhunge, tu hi ahi, chutengle ahou tahbeh hon Pa chu lhagaole thutah-a ahou dingu ahi; ijeh-inem itile Pa chun chutobangho bou chu ahou dinga ahol ahi.
target: Yet a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in the Spirit and in truth, for they are the kind of worshipers the Father seeks.

source: Pathen chu Lhagao ahi, chule ahouten lhagaole thutah-a hou ding mong ahi, ati.
target: God is spirit, and his worshipers must worship in the Spirit and in truth.”

source: Numeinu chun ajah-a, Keiman Messiah, Christa atiu chu, hung ding ahi, ti kahei; Ama chu ahung tengle aman ijakai eihil sohkei dingu ahinai, ati.
target: The woman said, “I know that Messiah” (called Christ) “is coming. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”

source: Jesu'n amanu jah-a, Nakihoupi keima hi ama chu kahi, ati.
target: Then Jesus declared, “I, the one speaking to you—I am he.”

source: Chuin hiche pettah chun aseijuite ahungun, numeinu toh anakihou chu, adatmo lheh jengui; ahivanginla, Ipi thuma nahim? ahiloule, amanu chutoh ibola kihou nahim, tia khatcha jong aumpouve.
target: Just then his disciples returned and were surprised to find him talking with a woman. But no one asked, “What do you want?” or “Why are you talking with her?”

source: Chutichun numeinu chun atwi bel adalhan, khopi sunga chun achen, miho jah-a chun,
target: Then, leaving her water jar, the woman went back to the town and said to the people,

source: Hungun, mi khat, hung veuvin, kathilbol kachonna jouse eiseidohpeh sohkeije; hiche hi Christa hikhat ding ham? ati.
target: “Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Messiah?”

source: Amaho khopi-a kon chun apotdoh-un, ama henga ahungui,
target: They came out of the town and made their way toward him.

source: Hiche pet chun aseijuite ahenga ataovun, Rabbi, an nen, atiuve.
target: Meanwhile his disciples urged him, “Rabbi, eat something.”

source: Ahivangin aman ajah uva, Nangho het lou an neh ding kaneije, ati.
target: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you know nothing about.”

source: Hijeh chun aseijuite khatle khat akihouvun, Khattouvin neh ding an ahinchoipeh ham? akitiuve.
target: Then his disciples said to each other, “Could someone have brought him food?”

source: Jesu'n amaho jah-a, Eisolpa lung gotlam bol, chule akin suhbulhit chu keima an ahi.
target: “My food,” said Jesus, “is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work.

source: Nanghon, Chang atna ding lha li aumnalaije, natiji hih-um? Veuvin, keiman nangho jah-a kasei ahi, Khodah uvin, loujao khu gahveovin, tun a-at phat ahi, aminin agusohtai.
target: Don’t you have a saying, ‘It’s still four months until harvest’? I tell you, open your eyes and look at the fields! They are ripe for harvest.

source: A-at chun athaman asangjin, chule aga chu tonsot hin kemlouvah akholjin ahi; chuti chun atupale a-atpa thakhat tah-in akipah thanom khomji lhone.
target: Even now the one who reaps draws a wage and harvests a crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may be glad together.

source: Chuti chu ahin hichea hin, Khatnin atun achom khatnin a-atji, ti thuhi tahbeh ahi.
target: Thus the saying ‘One sows and another reaps’ is true.

source: Natohgim lounao atna kasol nahiuve; michom dangin atohgim ahin, nangho amaho tohsa-a lut nahiuve, ati.
target: I sent you to reap what you have not worked for. Others have done the hard work, and you have reaped the benefits of their labor.”

source: Chuin, Kathilbol kachonna chengse eisei dohpeh-e, tia hettohsah numeinu thusei jal chun, chuche khopi-a Samaria mi tamtah-in atahsan taove.
target: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in him because of the woman’s testimony, “He told me everything I ever did.”

source: Hijeh chun Samaria miho chu ama henga ahungun, amaho chu aumpina dingun angeh taovin ahile; ama chukoma nini anichongin ahi.
target: So when the Samaritans came to him, they urged him to stay with them, and he stayed two days.

source: Ama thusei jal-in mi tamtah-in atahsanbe taovin;
target: And because of his words many more became believers.

source: Hichun amahon numeinu jah-a, Tun nangma thusei jala katahsanu ahipoi; ijeh-inem itile keihotah-in kajauvin, ama hi vannoi huhhingpa Christa tahchu ahi, ti kahetauve, atiuve.
target: They said to the woman, “We no longer believe just because of what you said; now we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this man really is the Savior of the world.”

source: Chuche nini jou chun, ama chukoma kon chun Galilee lama achetai.
target: After the two days he left for Galilee.

source: Ijeh-inem itile ama gam sunga themgao ja achang poi, ti Jesu amatah-in ahettoh sahsa ahi.
target: (Now Jesus himself had pointed out that a prophet has no honor in his own country.)

source: Hijeh chun Galilee alhun phatnin, Galilee mihon anasangui; ajeh chu Jerusalem'a kut laija athilbol imaho chu amahon aboncha amu sohkeiju ahi; ajehchu amaho jong kut na chu chea ahiuve.
target: When he arrived in Galilee, the Galileans welcomed him. They had seen all that he had done in Jerusalem at the Passover Festival, for they also had been there.

source: Hitichun Galilee gama twisih lengpitwi asosahna Cana kho-a chun Jesu ahungkit tan ahi. Chuin hikoma chun milal khat aumin, achapa chu damlouva Capernaum'a um ahi.
target: Once more he visited Cana in Galilee, where he had turned the water into wine. And there was a certain royal official whose son lay sick at Capernaum.

source: Chuin ama chun Jesu Judah gama konin Galilee gamah ahungtai, ti ajah phatnin, ahenga achen, achesuh-a achapa chu agabol dam dingin angehtan ahi; ajehchu ama chu athikoncha ahitai.
target: When this man heard that Jesus had arrived in Galilee from Judea, he went to him and begged him to come and heal his son, who was close to death.

source: Hijeh chun Jesu'n ajah-a, Melchihna le thil kidang namu lousen tahsanpon nate, ati.
target: “Unless you people see signs and wonders,” Jesus told him, “you will never believe.”

source: Milalpa chun ajah-a, Pu, kachapa chu athi kah-in hungsuh-in, ati.
target: The royal official said, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, Nachena dinga kichetan; nachapa ahinge, ati. Mipa chun ajah-a Jesu thusei ho chu atahsanin achetai.
target: “Go,” Jesus replied, “your son will live.” The man took Jesus at his word and departed.

source: Chuin achesuh-in ahile, asohhon ahung lamtouvin, achapa chu adamtai, ahung tiuve.
target: While he was still on the way, his servants met him with the news that his boy was living.

source: Chuti chun aman, Itih-a dam pan hitam, tin adongin ahile amahon, Janhi nidan sagi dontah chun akhosih-in alhatai, atiuve.
target: When he inquired as to the time when his son got better, they said to him, “Yesterday, at one in the afternoon, the fever left him.”

source: Hichun Jesu'n ajah-a, Nachapa ahinge tia asei nidan tah ahi chu apan ahedoh tan; chuin amatah le a-insung mi chengsen atahsan taovin ahi.
target: Then the father realized that this was the exact time at which Jesus had said to him, “Your son will live.” So he and his whole household believed.

source: Hiche hi Jesu'n Juda gam adalhah-a Galilee gama ahunga melchihna abolkit anina ahi.
target: This was the second sign Jesus performed after coming from Judea to Galilee.

source: Hicheng nung chun Juda miho kut khat aumin, chule Jesu Jerusalem'a agache touvin ahi.
target: Some time later, Jesus went up to Jerusalem for one of the Jewish festivals.

source: Hia chun kelngoi kot phunga twikul khat uma ahin, amin chu Hebrew paova Bethesda kisah ahin, aleibuh nga ahi.
target: Now there is in Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool, which in Aramaic is called Bethesda and which is surrounded by five covered colonnades.

source: Hichenga chun ana, mitcho, elbai, nakong chatmo, mihon tamtah twi chaloh ngahjinga luma ahiuve.
target: Here a great number of disabled people used to lie—the blind, the lame, the paralyzed.

source: Hia chun mi khat kum somthum le kum get jen chatmoa ahin;
target: One who was there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.

source: Jesu'n ama chu analup amun kum sottah na-a ahi chu ahen ajah-a, Nadam nom em, ati.
target: When Jesus saw him lying there and learned that he had been in this condition for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to get well?”

source: Anapa chun adonbutnin, Pu, twi ahung kicholoh tengle twikul'a eikoi lha ding mi koimala kaneipon; kachele kalhun kahle mi dangin eikhelin achejitai, ati.
target: “Sir,” the invalid replied, “I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am trying to get in, someone else goes down ahead of me.”

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, Kipatdoh-in, nalupna kichoijin lam jottan, ati.
target: Then Jesus said to him, “Get up! Pick up your mat and walk.”

source: Chuin mipa chu adam paihel jengtan, alupna akichoijin, lam ajottan ahi. Hiche ni chu Cholngah ni ahi.
target: At once the man was cured; he picked up his mat and walked. The day on which this took place was a Sabbath,

source: Hiche jeh chun Juda hon mi akiboldampa jah-a chun, Cholngah ni ahi, nangman nalupna nakichoi chu dan ngai ahipoi, atiuve.
target: and so the Jewish leaders said to the man who had been healed, “It is the Sabbath; the law forbids you to carry your mat.”

source: Ahin aman amaho chu adonbutnin, Eiboldampa tah-in kajah-a, Nalupna kichoijin, lam jottan eiti chu, ati.
target: But he replied, “The man who made me well said to me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’ ”

source: Amahon adongun, Najah-a, Nalupna kichoijin, lam jottan tia chu koiham? atiuve.
target: So they asked him, “Who is this fellow who told you to pick it up and walk?”

source: Akiboldampa chunla chukoma mipi tam jeh chun, Jesu la guhthima anavah manga ahitan, aboldama chu koi ahi ahepon ahi.
target: The man who was healed had no idea who it was, for Jesus had slipped away into the crowd that was there.

source: Khonungin Jesu'n ama chu houin'ah amun, ajah-a, Ven, akiboldama nahitai; chonse kit tahih-in, ajole akhohjo cheh nachunga chugetninte, ati.
target: Later Jesus found him at the temple and said to him, “See, you are well again. Stop sinning or something worse may happen to you.”

source: Mipa chu achemangin, Juda ho jah-a, Aboldama chu Jesu ahi tin agaseitan ahi.
target: The man went away and told the Jewish leaders that it was Jesus who had made him well.

source: Chuin hiche jeh chun Juda hon Jesu abolse taovin, chule cholngah ni-a chucheng aboljeh chun, thadin aholtauve.
target: So, because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jewish leaders began to persecute him.

source: Ahivangin Jesu'n amaho chu adonbutnin, Ka Pan tu gei hin na atongin, keiman jong katonge, ati.
target: In his defense Jesus said to them, “My Father is always at his work to this very day, and I too am working.”

source: Hiche jeh chun Juda hon ama thadin ahabol cheh taove; ajeh chu aman cholngah ni apal lhahkeo hilouvin, Pathen apa ahisah-a, Pathen toh kibanga akisei jeh jong chu ahi.
target: For this reason they tried all the more to kill him; not only was he breaking the Sabbath, but he was even calling God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

source: Hijeh chun Jesu'n adonbutnin ajah uva, Tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Chapa chun ama chamin ima abol theipoi, a-Pan abol amu chachabou chu ahi; ijeh-inem itile aman abolchan chu, atobang banga chu Chapan jong abol ahi.
target: Jesus gave them this answer: “Very truly I tell you, the Son can do nothing by himself; he can do only what he sees his Father doing, because whatever the Father does the Son also does.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Pa chun Chapa chu angailun, athil bol jouse chu avetsahji ahi; kidang nasahna dinguva, aman hicheho sanga hi chungnungjo thil avetsah ding ahi.
target: For the Father loves the Son and shows him all he does. Yes, and he will show him even greater works than these, so that you will be amazed.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Pan mithiho akaithouva ahinsah banga, Chapan jong ahinsah nomnom ahinsah ahi.
target: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son gives life to whom he is pleased to give it.

source: Pa chun mi koima thu atanpoi, thutan ding jouse Chapa apehdoh ahitai;
target: Moreover, the Father judges no one, but has entrusted all judgment to the Son,

source: Chutia chu mi jousen Pa ajabol banga, Chapa chu ajabol theina dingu ahi. Chapa jabol lou chun ahinsola Pa chu ajabol lou ahi.
target: that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father, who sent him.

source: Tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Kathusei ngaija chule eisolpa tahsan chun tonsot hinna anei ahitai, chule thupi tanna geita louva, thina-a kona hinna-a galkaija ahitai.
target: “Very truly I tell you, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life and will not be judged but has crossed over from death to life.

source: Tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, phat ahung lhunge, tu hi ahi, mithihon Pathen Chapa aw ajah dingu; chule ajaho chengse chu hing ding ahiuve.
target: Very truly I tell you, a time is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God and those who hear will live.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Pan amatah-in hinna anei bang chun, Chapan jong amatah-in hinna aneina dingin apen;
target: For as the Father has life in himself, so he has granted the Son also to have life in himself.

source: Chule Mihem Chapa ahi jehchun, thutan chaina thuneina chu apen ahi.
target: And he has given him authority to judge because he is the Son of Man.

source: Hiche hi datmo hih-un; ijeh-inem itile phat ahung lhunge, hichea chu lhan khuh-a umho jousen a-aw ajah dingu,
target: “Do not be amazed at this, for a time is coming when all who are in their graves will hear his voice

source: Chule hungdoh ding ahiuve; thilpha bolteho chengse hinna-a thoudoh dingu, chule thilphalou bolteho chengse themmo changa thoudoh ding ahiuve.
target: and come out—those who have done what is good will rise to live, and those who have done what is evil will rise to be condemned.

source: Ajehchu keiman kachamin ima kabol theipoi, kajah bang banga thu katan ahin; kathutan chu dihtah ahi; keiman lunggot lam hol louva, eisola Pa lung got lam chu kaholjoh jeh-in.
target: By myself I can do nothing; I judge only as I hear, and my judgment is just, for I seek not to please myself but him who sent me.

source: Keiman keima le keima chungchang kaki hettohsah hile, ka hettohsah chu dih lou ding ahi.
target: “If I testify about myself, my testimony is not true.

source: Ka chungchang hettohsah-a michom khat aumin; chule aman ka chungchang ahettohsah chu hettohsahna dihtah ahi ti kahei.
target: There is another who testifies in my favor, and I know that his testimony about me is true.

source: Nanghon John henga mi nasolun ahile, aman thutah chu ahettohsah-e.
target: “You have sent to John and he has testified to the truth.

source: Ahin Keiman hettohsah nahi mihem'a kona kalah ahipoi; hijongle nangho huhhing-a naumna dinguva, hiche hohi kasei ahi.
target: Not that I accept human testimony; but I mention it that you may be saved.

source: Ama chu thaomei kong'a le salvah-a tobang ahin; chule nanghon ama vah-a chu chomcha khat nomsah nanom un ahi.
target: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you chose for a time to enjoy his light.

source: Ahinla hettohsahna keiman kanei hi John'a sanga chu chungnungjo ahi; ijeh-inem itile toh molso dinga eipeh natoh, ka natoh chengsetah hin, Pa sol kahi chu ahettohsah ahi.
target: “I have testimony weightier than that of John. For the works that the Father has given me to finish—the very works that I am doing—testify that the Father has sent me.

source: Chule Pa eisolpa tah chun, keima thudol ahettohsah tai. Nanghon imatih-in ama aw najakhapouve, amel jong namukha pouve;
target: And the Father who sent me has himself testified concerning me. You have never heard his voice nor seen his form,

source: Chule athu jong nasunguva achengpoi; ijeh-inem itile nanghon asolpa chu natahsan pouve.
target: nor does his word dwell in you, for you do not believe the one he sent.

source: Nanghon Pathen lekhabua thu naholtoh jiuve, ajehchu asunga chu tonsot hinna nanei uva nangaito jeh-un; ahin hicheho chu keima thudol hettohsah ahiuve.
target: You study the Scriptures diligently because you think that in them you have eternal life. These are the very Scriptures that testify about me,

source: Ahin hinna nanei theina dingun, kahenga nahung nompouve.
target: yet you refuse to come to me to have life.

source: Keiman mihem choiat kasangpoi.
target: “I do not accept glory from human beings,

source: Ahivangin keiman nangho kahenaove, nangho sungah Pathen ngailutna nanei pouve.
target: but I know you. I know that you do not have the love of God in your hearts.

source: Keima ka Pa mina hunga kahin, nanghon neisang pouve; achom dang khat ama minin hungle, ama chu anasang naovin nate.
target: I have come in my Father’s name, and you do not accept me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will accept him.

source: Pathen na hungkon choi-atna bou chu hol louva, nangho khatin khat choiat kisang touva chu iti natahsan thei dinguham?
target: How can you believe since you accept glory from one another but do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?

source: Keiman nangho Pa henga kaheh dingin ngaito hih-un; naheh jiuva mi khat aumin, nanghon natahsanu Mosi ngei chu ahi.
target: “But do not think I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, on whom your hopes are set.

source: Nanghon Mosi chu tahsanleu chun keima neitahsan dingu ahi; ajeh chu aman keima thudol asut ahi.
target: If you believed Moses, you would believe me, for he wrote about me.

source: Ama sut natahsan lou vangule, keima thu iti natahsan dinguham?
target: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how are you going to believe what I say?”

source: Hicheng jou chun Galilee dillen, Tiberia dillen kiti, gal lang khat lama chun ache tai.
target: Some time after this, Jesus crossed to the far shore of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias),

source: Chuin natna neiho chunga melchihna kidang abol ho amu jeh-u chun, mipi atama tamin anung ajuijui.
target: and a great crowd of people followed him because they saw the signs he had performed by healing the sick.

source: Chuin Jesu mol chunga akaltouvin, aseijuiho toh atou taovin ahi.
target: Then Jesus went up on a mountainside and sat down with his disciples.

source: Chule kalchuh kut, Juda te golvah chu naija ahitai.
target: The Jewish Passover Festival was near.

source: Chuin Jesu adahdoh-in ahile, mipi atama tam ahenga ahung amun, Philip jah-a, Hiteho neh ding hi changlhah hoija ichoh dinguham? ati.
target: When Jesus looked up and saw a great crowd coming toward him, he said to Philip, “Where shall we buy bread for these people to eat?”

source: Hichu aman apatepna ati ahibouve, ijeh-inem itile abolding chu aman akihetnan ahi.
target: He asked this only to test him, for he already had in mind what he was going to do.

source: Philip'in adon butnin, Themcha khat chenga chang ding hi jeng jongleu, changlhah makhai jani manin tohponte, ati.
target: Philip answered him, “It would take more than half a year’s wages to buy enough bread for each one to have a bite!”

source: Aseijuite lah-a khat Simon Peter, sopipa Andrew'in, ajah-a,
target: Another of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, spoke up,

source: Hikoma chapang khat aumin, ama hin sap changa kisem changlhah pheng ngale nga ni aneije; ahinla mi hijatpi lah-a hichu ikham hi dingham, ati.
target: “Here is a boy with five small barley loaves and two small fish, but how far will they go among so many?”

source: Jesu'n, Miho chu tousah-un, ati. Hikoma chu hamhing tamtah um ahin, chuin mi sangnga jen chu atou taove.
target: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” There was plenty of grass in that place, and they sat down (about five thousand men were there).

source: Chuin Jesu'n changlhah alan; thangvahna aneijouvin aseijuiho ahoppeh-in, chule seijui hon atouho chu ahoppeh-un; chutobang chun nga jong chu, agot chanun apeuvin ahi.
target: Jesus then took the loaves, gave thanks, and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted. He did the same with the fish.

source: Chuin amaho avasoh phatnun, aman aseijuite jah-a, Hitiho chu amangthah um louhelin, amoh anong chengse chu lohkhomun, ati.
target: When they had all had enough to eat, he said to his disciples, “Gather the pieces that are left over. Let nothing be wasted.”

source: Chuin amahon alohkhomun ahile, sap changa kisem changlhah pheng nga-a kon chun, anehmoh nongu paipeh somle paipeh ni aloh dimui.
target: So they gathered them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten.

source: Hijeh chun Jesu'n chuche melchihna kidang avetsah chu amuvin, miho chu akihouvun, Themgao vannoi'a hung dinga chu ama mongmong hi ahi, atiuve.
target: After the people saw the sign Jesus performed, they began to say, “Surely this is the Prophet who is to come into the world.”

source: Chuin leng achansah dinga, acham louva ahung mat dingu ahi, ti Jesu'n ahet phatnin, achangin mol chunga akaltou kittan ahi.
target: Jesus, knowing that they intended to come and make him king by force, withdrew again to a mountain by himself.

source: Chuin nilhah ahi phatnin, aseijuite dila chun achesuh-un,
target: When evening came, his disciples went down to the lake,

source: Chule kong'a alutnun, Capernahum lam panga galkai dingin akitol taove. Hichun khola athimtan, ahivangin Jesu ahenguvah ahung hih laijin ahi.
target: where they got into a boat and set off across the lake for Capernaum. By now it was dark, and Jesus had not yet joined them.

source: Chuin huipi nasatah anun jeh-in twi akinong sang tultul jengin ahi.
target: A strong wind was blowing and the waters grew rough.

source: Hitichun ching somni le ching nga ahim ching somthum ahim ajap lhungun, Jesu'n twi chunga lam ajotna kong lam ahinjot amuvin ahile, akichataove.
target: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus approaching the boat, walking on the water; and they were frightened.

source: Ahin aman amaho jah-a, Keima kahibouve, kicha hih-un, ati.
target: But he said to them, “It is I; don’t be afraid.”

source: Hichun amahon kipah tah-in ama chu kong'a alalut nun: chule hiche pettah chun kong chu ajotnau mun alhungpai tan ahi.
target: Then they were willing to take him into the boat, and immediately the boat reached the shore where they were heading.

source: Ajingin dillen gallang khat lama mipi dingho chun, chukoma chu aseijuite lutna tailou chu kong dang aumlou amuva, chule Jesu chula aseijuite toh chuche kong'a lutlouva, aseijuite amaho changbou ahiu chu aheuvin;
target: The next day the crowd that had stayed on the opposite shore of the lake realized that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus had not entered it with his disciples, but that they had gone away alone.

source: (Ahivangin Pakaiyin thangvahna aneija mihon changlhah anehnau komcha, Tiberia'a kon kong dang dang ahungin ahi).
target: Then some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

source: Chuti chun mipi ho chun Jesu ahin, aseijuite ahiuvin aumtapouve ti ahet phatnun, amaho chu kong'a akalun, Jesu holin Capernahum'a ahung taove.
target: Once the crowd realized that neither Jesus nor his disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum in search of Jesus.

source: Chuin amahon dillen gal lang khat panga ama amuvin, Rabbi, itih-a hilam nalhun ham? atiuvin ahile,
target: When they found him on the other side of the lake, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”

source: Jesu'n amaho chu adon butnin, Keiman nangho tahbeh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Melchihna kidang namu jeh-u hilouvin changlhah nanehva jeh uva bou keima neiholu ahi.
target: Jesus answered, “Very truly I tell you, you are looking for me, not because you saw the signs I performed but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.

source: Amang thahji an holnan thohgim hih-un, tonsot hinkemlouva umjing ding an holnan thohgim jouvin, hiche an chu Mihem Chapan napeh dingu ahi; ajeh chu Pa Pathen'in ama chu mohor anamdet ahitai, ati.
target: Do not work for food that spoils, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on him God the Father has placed his seal of approval.”

source: Hichun amahon ajah-a, Pathen na katoh theina dinguva ipi kabol dingu ham? atiuve.
target: Then they asked him, “What must we do to do the works God requires?”

source: Jesu'n adon butnin ajah uvah, Ahinsol hi tahsan leuchun hichu Pathen natoh ahi, ati.
target: Jesus answered, “The work of God is this: to believe in the one he has sent.”

source: Hijeh chun amahon ajah-a, Kamuva katahsan theina dinguva melchihna ipi nabol em? Itobang na natoh nganem?
target: So they asked him, “What sign then will you give that we may see it and believe you? What will you do?

source: Aman van'a konin aneh dingu changlhah apei, tia kisun bang chun; Kapute kapateuvin gamthipmah manna aneuvin ahi, atiuve.
target: Our ancestors ate the manna in the wilderness; as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’”

source: Hichun Jesu'n ajah uva, Tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Van'a kona changlhah napeuva chu Mosi ahipoi; van'a kona changlhah tahbeh chu ka-Pan bou napeuve.
target: Jesus said to them, “Very truly I tell you, it is not Moses who has given you the bread from heaven, but it is my Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Pathen changlhah chu, van'a kona hung kumlha vannoi hinna pepa chu ahi, ati.
target: For the bread of God is the bread that comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”

source: Hiche chun amahon ajah-a, Pakai, hiche changlhah chu a-imatih chanin neipeuvin atiuve.
target: “Sir,” they said, “always give us this bread.”

source: Jesu'n ajah uva, Keima hi hinna changlhah kahi; kahenga hunga chu gilkel talou ding, chule keima eitahsana chu dangchah talouhel ding ahi.
target: Then Jesus declared, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

source: Ahin kaseipeh nahiuve, Nanghon keima neimu vangun, neitahsan pouve.
target: But as I told you, you have seen me and still you do not believe.

source: Ka Pan keima eipeh chengse chu kahenga hung ding; chule kahenga hunga chu iti jongle kaledoh lou ding ahi.
target: All those the Father gives me will come to me, and whoever comes to me I will never drive away.

source: Ijeh-inem itile keima van'a kona kahung kumlhah hi, keima lunggot bol dinga hilouvin eisolpa lunggot bol dingjoh-a hung kahi bouve.
target: For I have come down from heaven not to do my will but to do the will of him who sent me.

source: Eisolpa Pa lunggot chu hiche ahi, Aman eipeh chengse hi mansah neilou hela, ni nunung nileh aboncha kakai thou ding ahi.
target: And this is the will of him who sent me, that I shall lose none of all those he has given me, but raise them up at the last day.

source: Chule eisolpa lunggot chu hiche ahi, koi hile Chapa mu-a, Ama tahsan chan chun, tonsot hinna anei ding ahi; chule keiman ninunung nileh ama kakaithou ding ahi, ati.
target: For my Father’s will is that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in him shall have eternal life, and I will raise them up at the last day.”

source: Aman van'a kona hung kumlha changlhah chu keima kahi ati jeh chun, Juda ho achungah aphunun,
target: At this the Jews there began to grumble about him because he said, “I am the bread that came down from heaven.”

source: Amahi Joseph chapa Jesu, anu apa eihon ihetnu chu hilouham? achutile, iti dana van'a kona hung kumlha kahi atiham? atiuve.
target: They said, “Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How can he now say, ‘I came down from heaven’ ?”

source: Hijeh chun Jesu'n amaho adonbutnin, ajah uva, Nangho khatle khat kihouvin phun hih-un.
target: “Stop grumbling among yourselves,” Jesus answered.

source: Eisola ka Pan aloilut loule koima kahenga ahung theipoi; chule ni nunung nileh keiman ama chu kakaithou ding ahi.
target: “No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws them, and I will raise them up at the last day.

source: Amaho chu Pathen'in ahil hicheh dingu ahi, tin themgaoho lekhabua akisune. Chuti ahijeh chun Pa-a kona ja-a, kihilna neichacha chu, kahenga hungji ahiuve.
target: It is written in the Prophets: ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from him comes to me.

source: Pathen koma kona hung potdohpa tailou chu, koiman Pa chu amukhapoi; amabou chun Pa chu amu ahi.
target: No one has seen the Father except the one who is from God; only he has seen the Father.

source: Tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Koi hijongle keima eitahsana chun tonsot hinna anei ahitai.
target: Very truly I tell you, the one who believes has eternal life.

source: Keima hinna changlhah chu kahi.
target: I am the bread of life.

source: Naputeu napateu vin gamthipmah manna aneuvin, chule athi gamtaove.
target: Your ancestors ate the manna in the wilderness, yet they died.

source: Hiche hi min aneh-a athi louna ding, van'a hung kon changlhah ahi.
target: But here is the bread that comes down from heaven, which anyone may eat and not die.

source: Keima hi van'a hungkon changlhah hing chu kahi; koi hijongle hiche changlhah ne-a chu, tonsot geija hing jing ding ahi; chule kapeh ding changlhah chu kaphe hi ahi; hichu vannoi mite hinna dinga kapeh ding ahi.
target: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. Whoever eats this bread will live forever. This bread is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.”

source: Hichun Juda ho amaho le amaho akinelun, Hichepa hin ineh dinguva asa iti eipeh thei dinguham? atiuve.
target: Then the Jews began to argue sharply among themselves, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah uva, Tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Nanghon Mihem Chapa sa naneh lou uva, athi nadon louvule, nangmaho sunga hinna nei lou nahiuve.
target: Jesus said to them, “Very truly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you have no life in you.

source: Kasa ne-a kathi dona chun tonsot hinna anei ahitai, chule ni nunung nileh keiman ama chu kakaithou ding ahi.
target: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise them up at the last day.

source: Ijeh-inem itile kasa hi an neh tahbeh ahin, kathi hi don ding tahbeh ahi.
target: For my flesh is real food and my blood is real drink.

source: Kasa ne-a, kathi dona chu, keijah aum jingjin, keima ama-ah kaum jingjie.
target: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood remains in me, and I in them.

source: Pa hing chun eisola, Pa vanga kahin banga hi, koi hijongle keima eine-a chu, ama jong chu keima vanga hing ding ahi.
target: Just as the living Father sent me and I live because of the Father, so the one who feeds on me will live because of me.

source: Van'a kona hung kumlha changlhah chu hiche hi ahi; napu napa teovin aneh uva athipiu manna tobang ahipoi; hiche changlhah ne-a vang chu a-imatih chana hing jing ding ahi, ati.
target: This is the bread that came down from heaven. Your ancestors ate manna and died, but whoever feeds on this bread will live forever.”

source: Hiche hi Capernahum'a thu ahil petna, kikhopna in'a asei ahi.
target: He said this while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.

source: Hiche chun aseijuiho lah-a tamtah-in hiche thu chu ajauvin, Ahahsa behseh jenge; kon angai thei dingham? atiuve.
target: On hearing it, many of his disciples said, “This is a hard teaching. Who can accept it?”

source: Hichun chuche thua aseijuite phun chu Jesu'n alung sungin ahen, ajah uvah, Hiche chun nakipal lhuhsah-u hitam?
target: Aware that his disciples were grumbling about this, Jesus said to them, “Does this offend you?

source: Achutile Mihem Chapa hi masanga aumna mun'a akaltou muleu chun i-nati dinguham?
target: Then what if you see the Son of Man ascend to where he was before!

source: Hinna pe-a lhagaobou ahi, tahsaphen imacha aphatchom sahpoi; najah uva kathusei chengse hi, lhagao ahin chule hinna ahi.
target: The Spirit gives life; the flesh counts for nothing. The words I have spoken to you—they are full of the Spirit and life.

source: Ahivangin nalah uva abang bang atahsan lou na-umui, ati. Ajeh chu Jesu'n atila pat atahsan lou koikoi ahi, chule ama matsah dinga chu koi ahi anahet jingsa ahi.
target: Yet there are some of you who do not believe.” For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray him.

source: Chuin aman, Hiche jeh-a chu najah uva, Pa peh louvin koima kahenga ahung theipoi, kati ahi, ati.
target: He went on to say, “This is why I told you that no one can come to me unless the Father has enabled them.”

source: Hichea pat chun aseijuiho tamtah akinung leuvin, amatoh achele ahungleh tapouve.
target: From this time many of his disciples turned back and no longer followed him.

source: Chuin Jesu'n Somleni ho jah-a, Nangho jong nache nomum? ati.
target: “You do not want to leave too, do you?” Jesus asked the Twelve.

source: Chuin Simon Peter'in adonbutnin, Pakai, keiho koi henga kache dinguham? Nangman Tonsot hinna thuho nanei ahi.
target: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life.

source: Chule nangma Pathen hing chapa Christa nahi chu keihon katahsanun, chule kaheuve, ati.
target: We have come to believe and to know that you are the Holy One of God.”

source: Jesu'n amaho adonbutnin, Keiman nangho somleni kalhendoh-u hilouham? Ahinla nangho lah-a diabol khat aume, ati.
target: Then Jesus replied, “Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil!”

source: Simon chapa Juda Iscariot chungchang thudola hichu asei ahi; ijeh-inem itile somleni lah-a ajao vang, melmaho khutna pehdoh dinga chu amachu ahi.
target: (He meant Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, who, though one of the Twelve, was later to betray him.)

source: Hicheng jou chun Juda hon tha ding agot jeh-un, Jesu Judah gama vale anomta hih-in, Galilee gama avahle tai.
target: After this, Jesus went around in Galilee. He did not want to go about in Judea because the Jewish leaders there were looking for a way to kill him.

source: Hiche pet chun Juda ho lhambuh kut anaitan ahi.
target: But when the Jewish Festival of Tabernacles was near,

source: Hijeh chun asopihon ajah-a, Nathil bol chengse hi naseijui hon jong amuna dingun, hikom mun dalhanlang, Juda gama chen.
target: Jesus’ brothers said to him, “Leave Galilee and go to Judea, so that your disciples there may see the works you do.

source: Ijeh-inem itile, minthan go-an koiman guhthimin thil abol ngaipoi. Thil hicheng hi nabol ahi ngalleh, vannoi kimusah-in, atiuve.
target: No one who wants to become a public figure acts in secret. Since you are doing these things, show yourself to the world.”

source: Ijeh ham itile asopiho jengin jong ama atahsan louvu ahi.
target: For even his own brothers did not believe in him.

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah uva, Keima tun kaphat alhing hih laije, nangho phat vang alhing jinge.
target: Therefore Jesus told them, “My time is not yet here; for you any time will do.

source: Vannoi'in nangho naho theipouve; keibou eihouve; ijeh ham itile athilbolu aphapoi tia keiman amaho thudol ka hettohsah ji ahi.
target: The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I testify that its works are evil.

source: Hiche kut nachun nangho cheovin; keima vang tun hiche kutna chehih laijinge, kaphat alhing hihlaije, ati.
target: You go to the festival. I am not going up to this festival, because my time has not yet fully come.”

source: Amaho jah-a chun thu hicheng chu aseijin ama Galilee'a aumden tan ahi.
target: After he had said this, he stayed in Galilee.

source: Ahivangin asopite hi kutna dinga ache nungun, ama jong lhang phonga hilouvin, guhthimin achen ahi.
target: However, after his brothers had left for the festival, he went also, not publicly, but in secret.

source: Hiche chun Judah hon kut nachun ama chu aholun, Hoija umham? atiuve.
target: Now at the festival the Jewish leaders were watching for Jesus and asking, “Where is he?”

source: Chule mipi lah-a miho chu ama thudola aphun melmul jengui; ajehchu abangin, Ama chu mipha ahi, atiuvin abangin, Ahipoi, mipi lam hilouva apuimang bouve, atiuve.
target: Among the crowds there was widespread whispering about him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others replied, “No, he deceives the people.”

source: Ahivangin Juda ho ginan ama thudol chu lhang phonga seija koima aumpouve.
target: But no one would say anything publicly about him for fear of the leaders.

source: Chuin kut kim dontah ahi-in, Jesu houin'a achetouvin, thu agahil tan ahi.
target: Not until halfway through the festival did Jesus go up to the temple courts and begin to teach.

source: Chuin Juda hon adatmo lheh jengun, Hichepan kihilna neikha louva, lekha iti ahet ham? atiuve.
target: The Jews there were amazed and asked, “How did this man get such learning without having been taught?”

source: Jesu'n amaho chu adonbutnin, Kathuhil hi kei thu ahipoi, eisolpa-a ahibouve.
target: Jesus answered, “My teaching is not my own. It comes from the one who sent me.

source: Koi hijongle ama lunggot lam bol nom-an, kathuhil hi Pathen'a kon ahi, keima chama kasei ahi, ahet ding ahi.
target: Anyone who chooses to do the will of God will find out whether my teaching comes from God or whether I speak on my own.

source: Ama chama thuseija chun ama kichoi-at ding agot ahin, asolpa choiat ding go-a vang chu, ama chu dihtah ahin, ama-a chu chonphat louna aumpoi.
target: Whoever speaks on their own does so to gain personal glory, but he who seeks the glory of the one who sent him is a man of truth; there is nothing false about him.

source: Mosi'n nangho chonna dan napeh lou uham? Nangho khatchan jong chonna dan bang chun nachonpouve. Ibola tha dinga eigo-a nahiuvem, ati.
target: Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps the law. Why are you trying to kill me?”

source: Chuin mipi chun adonbutnun, Nangma thilha vop nahi; koiham tha dinga nago-a, atiuve.
target: “You are demon-possessed,” the crowd answered. “Who is trying to kill you?”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin ajah uva, Keiman na khat katongin ahile nabonchaovin hichu kidang nasauve.
target: Jesus said to them, “I did one miracle, and you are all amazed.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu, Mosi'n cheptan thu napeh-u ahin; (Mosi'a kon ahijeh hilouvin, puluiho-a kon joh ahin) chule nanghon cholngah nin mi chep natan jiuve.
target: Yet, because Moses gave you circumcision (though actually it did not come from Moses, but from the patriarchs), you circumcise a boy on the Sabbath.

source: Mosi thupeh suhkeh louna dinga cholngah ni-a mi khat chep akitanle, cholngah ni-a mi khat kadamsah hel jeh-a kachunga nalunghanu ham?
target: Now if a boy can be circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses may not be broken, why are you angry with me for healing a man’s whole body on the Sabbath?

source: Alimsoa thu tan louvin, dihtah-in thu tan jouvin, ati.
target: Stop judging by mere appearances, but instead judge correctly.”

source: Hichun Jerusalem'a kon mi kimkhatnin, Tha dinga agotpau chu ama hi hilouham?
target: At that point some of the people of Jerusalem began to ask, “Isn’t this the man they are trying to kill?

source: Ahivangin, veuvin, phongtah-in thu aseijin, amahonla ajah-a ima aseipouve. Vaipohon ama hi Christa tah chu ahi ti ahet tahbeh mongu hita ham?
target: Here he is, speaking publicly, and they are not saying a word to him. Have the authorities really concluded that he is the Messiah?

source: Ahinla ama hi hoija hung kon ahi keihon kaheuve; Christa vang chu akonna koima ahea umlou ding ahi, atiuve.
target: But we know where this man is from; when the Messiah comes, no one will know where he is from.”

source: Hijeh chun Jesu'n houin'a thu ahil tolhonin, hatah-in asamin, nanghon keima jong neiheovin, chule hoija kon kahi jong naheuve; ahin keima kachama hunga kahipoi, ahinla eisolpa chu dihtah ahi, ama chu nanghon nahepouve.
target: Then Jesus, still teaching in the temple courts, cried out, “Yes, you know me, and you know where I am from. I am not here on my own authority, but he who sent me is true. You do not know him,

source: Amavang keiman ama chu kahei; ijeh-inem itile keima ama-a kon kahi, chule ama sol kahi, ati.
target: but I know him because I am from him and he sent me.”

source: Hiche chun amahon mat dingin agouvin, ahin aphat alhin loulai jeh chun, koiman achungah khut alhapon ahi.
target: At this they tried to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

source: Chule mipi lah-a mi tamtah-in ama chu atahsan taovin, chule Christa chu ahung tengle, hichepan abol melchihna ho sanga tamjo abolnah dingham? atiuve.
target: Still, many in the crowd believed in him. They said, “When the Messiah comes, will he perform more signs than this man?”

source: Mipin chutia ama thudola chuche aseijuva aphun melmulu chu Pharisai hon ajauvin; chuin thempu pipuiho le Pharisai hon ama man ding chu sottolho asolui.
target: The Pharisees heard the crowd whispering such things about him. Then the chief priests and the Pharisees sent temple guards to arrest him.

source: Chuin Jesu'n, ajah uva aseijin, Chomcha khat nalah uva umtadi nalai ding kahi, chujou tengle eihin solpa henga kache ding ahi.
target: Jesus said, “I am with you for only a short time, and then I am going to the one who sent me.

source: Nanghon neiholun natin, neimu lou dingu; chule kaumna-a chu nahung thei lou dingu ahi, ati.
target: You will look for me, but you will not find me; and where I am, you cannot come.”

source: Hichun Juda ho khatle khat akidongun, Eihon ama iholuva imu lou dingu chu, ama hoijabep che ding hintem? Ole Greek mi lah-a cheng chehho henga chea Greek miho agahil ding khattou ham?
target: The Jews said to one another, “Where does this man intend to go that we cannot find him? Will he go where our people live scattered among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?

source: Nanghon neiholun natin neimu lou dingu, kaumna dinga jong nahung thei lou dingu ahi, ati hi ipi aseina ahidem? atiuve.
target: What did he mean when he said, ‘You will look for me, but you will not find me,’ and ‘Where I am, you cannot come’ ?”

source: Chuin kut kichai nin, hichu nipi ni ahin, Jesu adingin hatah-in asamin, Koi hijongle adangchah-a chu kahenga hunghen, hung donhen.
target: On the last and greatest day of the festival, Jesus stood and said in a loud voice, “Let anyone who is thirsty come to me and drink.

source: Keima eitahsana chu, Pathen lekhabun asei bang banga, asunga kon twihing putdoh-a luija long ding ahi, ati.
target: Whoever believes in me, as Scripture has said, rivers of living water will flow from within them.”

source: Hichu ama tahsan hon anei dingu, Lhagao Theng chu aseina ahi; ijeh-inem itile Jesu choi-atna aum loulai jeh-a, Lhagao theng chu kipe loulai ahi.
target: By this he meant the Spirit, whom those who believed in him were later to receive. Up to that time the Spirit had not been given, since Jesus had not yet been glorified.

source: Thu hicheng chu ajauvin mipi lah-a abang bangin, Tahbeh-a ama hi themgao mongmong chu ahi, atiuvin;
target: On hearing his words, some of the people said, “Surely this man is the Prophet.”

source: Akimkhatnin, Ama hi Christa ahi, atiuve. Akimkhat vang chun Christa Galilee'a kona sohdoh ngaijem?
target: Others said, “He is the Messiah.” Still others asked, “How can the Messiah come from Galilee?

source: Christa chu David son hi ding, David chenna khopi Bethlehem'a kon hungdoh ding ahi, tia Pathen lekhabun asei hilouham? atiuve.
target: Does not Scripture say that the Messiah will come from David’s descendants and from Bethlehem, the town where David lived?”

source: Chuti chun ama thudola chun mipi chu abung bungin akikhentaove.
target: Thus the people were divided because of Jesus.

source: Chule abangho chun ama chu mat ding agouvin; ahivangin koiman achungah khut alhapouve.
target: Some wanted to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him.

source: Chuin sottol mimanho chu thempu pipuiho le Pharisai ho henga ahungun ahile, amahon anadongun, Ibola nahinpui daoham? atiuve.
target: Finally the temple guards went back to the chief priests and the Pharisees, who asked them, “Why didn’t you bring him in?”

source: Chuin sottol mimanho chun adonbutnun, Khuchepa thusei tobang khun mi koiman thu aseikhapoi, atiuve.
target: “No one ever spoke the way this man does,” the guards replied.

source: Chuin Pharisai hon adonbutnun, ajah uva, Nangho jong doha lha-a nahiu hitam?
target: “You mean he has deceived you also?” the Pharisees retorted.

source: Vaipoho le Pharisai ho lah-a khatbeh-in ama chu atahsanem?
target: “Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed in him?

source: Ahin danthu helou mipi ho hi sapset changjia ahi, atiuve.
target: No! But this mob that knows nothing of the law—there is a curse on them.”

source: Nicodemus (Amaho lah-a khat, janna Jesu henga gachepa) chun ajah uva,
target: Nicodemus, who had gone to Jesus earlier and who was one of their own number, asked,

source: Idan uvin mi chu athu ajah masang le athilbol ahet masanga themmo achansah ngaijem? ati.
target: “Does our law condemn a man without first hearing him to find out what he has been doing?”

source: Chuin amahon adonbutnun, ajah-a, Nang jong Galilee mi nahim? Holin lang, ven; ajehchu Galilee'a konin themgao asohdoh ngaipoi, atiuve.
target: They replied, “Are you from Galilee, too? Look into it, and you will find that a prophet does not come out of Galilee.” [The earliest manuscripts and many other ancient witnesses do not have . A few manuscripts include these verses, wholly or in part, after , , or .]

source: Hichun amaho a-in cheh-a ache taovin ahi.
target: Then they all went home,

source: Jesu vang chu Olivet lhang lama achetan ahi.
target: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

source: Chuin jingpitah-in houin'a ahung kittan ahile miho jouse ahenga ahungun, chuin ama atouvin, amaho chu thu ahilin ahi.
target: At dawn he appeared again in the temple courts, where all the people gathered around him, and he sat down to teach them.

source: Hichun danthu sunho le Pharisai hon ajon pettah-a kiman numei khat ahinkaijun, alai lungah adinsah-un,
target: The teachers of the law and the Pharisees brought in a woman caught in adultery. They made her stand before the group

source: Jesu jah-a, Houhil, hiche numeinu hi ajon jeh-a kiman ahin, ajon pettah-a kimandoh ahi.
target: and said to Jesus, “Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.

source: Hitobang hi songa selih ding Mosi'n danthua eipeh-u ahin, hijongle nangman iti nagelem? atiuve.
target: In the Law Moses commanded us to stone such women. Now what do you say?”

source: Ama hehset theina amu nadinguva, apatepna-a hitia chu atiu ahi. Ahin athuseiju chu jalou bangin, Jesu akunin, akhut jungin tol ajihtai.
target: They were using this question as a trap, in order to have a basis for accusing him. But Jesus bent down and started to write on the ground with his finger.

source: Ahivangin amahon adong tei adong teijun ahile, ama adahdoh-in, ajah uva, Nalah uva chonsetna neilou penin amanu chu songin sep masapen hen, ati.
target: When they kept on questioning him, he straightened up and said to them, “Let any one of you who is without sin be the first to throw a stone at her.”

source: Chuin akun kitnin, tol ajih kit tai.
target: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground.

source: Chule chuche jahose chu, ase apha ahetnao vin mo achanun, alenpena pat alhumpen geijin, khat khatnin apotdoh gamtaovin; Jesu changseh le alailunga um numei bou chu aumtan ahi.
target: At this, those who heard began to go away one at a time, the older ones first, until only Jesus was left, with the woman still standing there.

source: Chuin Jesu adatdoh phatnin, numeinu tailou adang amutapon, amanu jah-a, numei themo nachanho hoilam hitaovam? Koiman themmo nachan lou hitam? ati.
target: Jesus straightened up and asked her, “Woman, where are they? Has no one condemned you?”

source: Amanun, Pakai, koiman themmo eichantapoi, ati. Chuin Jesu'n ajah-a, keiman jong themmo kachanpoi; chetan, tukallin chonsekit tahih-in, ati.
target: “No one, sir,” she said. “Then neither do I condemn you,” Jesus declared. “Go now and leave your life of sin.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah uva thu asei kitnin, Keima vannoi vah kahi; kanung eijuija chu muthima chu vahle louva, hinna vah chu anei ding ahi, ati.
target: When Jesus spoke again to the people, he said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.”

source: Hichun Pharisai hon, Nangman nangma thudol nahettohsah ahin, nathu hettohsah adihpoi, atiuve.
target: The Pharisees challenged him, “Here you are, appearing as your own witness; your testimony is not valid.”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin ajah uva, Keiman keima thudol kahettohsah hijongle, kathu hettohsah adih ahi; ajeh chu keiman hoija hung kon kahile, hoi lama che ding kahi kahenai; nangho vangin hoija kona hung kahi, chule hoi lama che ding kahi nahepouve.
