target: Jesus answered, “Even if I testify on my own behalf, my testimony is valid, for I know where I came from and where I am going. But you have no idea where I come from or where I am going.

source: Nanghon tahsa dungjuija thu natanjiu ahi, keiman koima thu katanpoi.
target: You judge by human standards; I pass judgment on no one.

source: Ahin keiman thu tan jeng jongleng, kathutan dihtah ahi; ajeh chu keima kachang kahipoi, keima kahin chule eihinsolpa ka Pa chu ahi.
target: But if I do judge, my decisions are true, because I am not alone. I stand with the Father, who sent me.

source: Nadan lekha uva, mi ni thu hettohsah chu adih ahi, tin akisune.
target: In your own Law it is written that the testimony of two witnesses is true.

source: Keima thudol hettohsah kahin, chule ka Pa eihinsolpa chu keima thudol hettohsah ahi, ati.
target: I am one who testifies for myself; my other witness is the Father, who sent me.”

source: Hijeh chun amahon ajah-a, Napa hoija umham? atiuve. Jesu'n adonbutnin, Nanghon keima jong neihepouvin, ka Pa jong nahepouve; nanghon keima neiheleu chun, ka Pa jong nahet dingu ahi, ati.
target: Then they asked him, “Where is your father?” “You do not know me or my Father,” Jesus replied. “If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”

source: Hicheng hi Jesu'n houin'a athuhil petna, sum kholna mun'a asei ahi; aphat alhin loulai jeh chun, koiman amanpouve.
target: He spoke these words while teaching in the temple courts near the place where the offerings were put. Yet no one seized him, because his hour had not yet come.

source: Hijeh chun Jesu'n ajah uva asei kitnin, Kache mang ding, chule nanghon neihol dingu, chule nachonset naova nathi dingu ahi. Kachena lama nangho hung thei pouvin nate, ati.
target: Once more Jesus said to them, “I am going away, and you will look for me, and you will die in your sin. Where I go, you cannot come.”

source: Hijeh chun Juda ho chun, Kachena lama nangho hung thei pouvin nate atin, ole ama kithat ding hikhat ham? atiuve.
target: This made the Jews ask, “Will he kill himself? Is that why he says, ‘Where I go, you cannot come’ ?”

source: Chuin aman amaho jah-a, Nangho noija kon nahiuvin, keima chunga kon kahi; nangho hiche vannoi'a mi nahiuve, keima hiche vannoi'a mi kahipoi.
target: But he continued, “You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu najah uva, Nachonset naova nathi dingu, kati ahi: kei hi ama chu kahi hi, natahsan louseuva nachonset naova nathi dingu ahi, ati.
target: I told you that you would die in your sins; if you do not believe that I am he, you will indeed die in your sins.”

source: Hijeh chun amahon ama jah-a, Nangma koi nahim? atiuve. Jesu'n amaho chu adonbutnin, Atila patna najah uva kaseiji chu ahi.
target: “Who are you?” they asked. “Just what I have been telling you from the beginning,” Jesus replied.

source: Thu nangho chungchang thudola seiding tamtah le thutan ding tamtah kaneije; ahinla eihinsolpa chu dihtah ahi; chule ama-a kona kajah chengse chu keiman vannoi jah-a kasei ahi, ati.
target: “I have much to say in judgment of you. But he who sent me is trustworthy, and what I have heard from him I tell the world.”

source: Aman Pa thudola asei ahi chu amahon ahedoh pouvin ahi.
target: They did not understand that he was telling them about his Father.

source: Hijeh chun Jesu'n ajah uva, Nanghon Mihem Chapa hi nadop sang tengule, keima hi ama chu kahi, chule kachama ima kabol lou; ahivanga Pa'n eihil bang banga, hicheng kasei ahi hi nahet dingu ahi.
target: So Jesus said, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he and that I do nothing on my own but speak just what the Father has taught me.

source: Chule keima eisolpa chun eiumpi nai; Pa chun ka changin eilhapoi; ajeh chu keiman alunglhaina lam jengbou kabol jingin ahi, ati.
target: The one who sent me is with me; he has not left me alone, for I always do what pleases him.”

source: Hiche thu chu asei phat chun mi tamtah-in atahsantai.
target: Even as he spoke, many believed in him.

source: Chuin Jesu'n Juda mi atahsanho jah-a chun, Nangho kathua hi naum jom jinguva ahile, kaseijui tahbeh nahiuve;
target: To the Jews who had believed him, Jesus said, “If you hold to my teaching, you are really my disciples.

source: chule thutah chu heuvin natin, thutah chun nalhadoh dingu ahi, ati.
target: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”

source: Amahon adonbutnun ajah-a, Keiho Abraham son kahiuvin, chule imatih chanin koima soh-in kalut khapouve; ahin nakilhadoh dingu ahi, nati chu iti natiham? atiuve.
target: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s descendants and have never been slaves of anyone. How can you say that we shall be set free?”

source: Jesu'n amaho chu adonbutnin, Tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Koi hijongle achonse chan chu chonset soh ahi.
target: Jesus replied, “Very truly I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.

source: Chule soh chu a-imatih chanin ina achengjipoi; chapa vang chu a-imatih chanin in'ah achengji.
target: Now a slave has no permanent place in the family, but a son belongs to it forever.

source: Hijeh-a chu Chapa chun nalhadoh vangule, chamlhat tahbeh ding nahiuve.
target: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.

source: Abraham son nahiu chu kahenai; ahinla keima tha dingin neigouve, ajeh chu nalung sunguva kathun mun amupoi.
target: I know that you are Abraham’s descendants. Yet you are looking for a way to kill me, because you have no room for my word.

source: Keima ka Pa koma kamu chengse kasei ahi; nanghon na-pauva kona namu-u chengseu nabolu ahi, ati.
target: I am telling you what I have seen in the Father’s presence, and you are doing what you have heard from your father.”

source: Amahon adonbutnun, ajah-a, Abraham kapau ahi, atiuve. Jesu'n amaho jah uva, Nangho Abraham chate hileu chun, Abraham thilbol nabol dingu ahi.
target: “Abraham is our father,” they answered. “If you were Abraham’s children,” said Jesus, “then you would do what Abraham did.

source: Ahinla tun keima, Pathen'a kona kajah thutah naheng uva seipa hi, tha ding nangai touve. Abraham hitihin achonpoi.
target: As it is, you are looking for a way to kill me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham did not do such things.

source: Nanghon napau thilbol nabolu ahi, ati. Amahon ajah-a, Keiho jaocha kahipouve; Pa khat sehbou kaneijui, hichu Pathen ahi, atiuve.
target: You are doing the works of your own father.” “We are not illegitimate children,” they protested. “The only Father we have is God himself.”

source: Jesu'n amaho jah-a, Pathen napau hile keima neingailut dingu ahi; ijeh-inem itile keima Pathen'a kon hungdoh-a hunga kahi; keima kachama hung kahipoi; aman eisol ahibouve.
target: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love me, for I have come here from God. I have not come on my own; God sent me.

source: Nanghon ibola kathu nahet lou uham? Kathu hi nangai thei lou jeh-u ahi.
target: Why is my language not clear to you? Because you are unable to hear what I say.

source: Nangho napau diabol'a kon nahibouvun, chule chuche napau lunggot chu suhbulhit dingbou nanomui. Ama chu atila patna tolthat ahin, chule thutah-a ding lou ahi; ajeh iham itile ama-a chu thutah umlou ahi. Aman thujou asei komle, ama chama aseiji ahi; ajeh chu ama mijou ahin, chule jou pa ahi.
target: You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out your father’s desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, not holding to the truth, for there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, for he is a liar and the father of lies.

source: Keima vangin thutah kasei jeh-a, neitahsan louvu ahi.
target: Yet because I tell the truth, you do not believe me!

source: Keima hi michonse ahi tia photchetna pethei dinga nalah uva koi nahiuvem? Chule thutah kasei ahile ibola neitahsan lou uham?
target: Can any of you prove me guilty of sin? If I am telling the truth, why don’t you believe me?

source: Pathen'a kon chun Pathen thu angaije; hijeh-a chu nanghon nangai louvu ahi, ajehchu nangho Pathen'a kon nahi pouve, ati.
target: Whoever belongs to God hears what God says. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God.”

source: Chuin Juda hon adonbutnun, ajah-a, Nangma Samaria mi nahin, chule thilha vop nahi, katiu hi dih louham? atiuve.
target: The Jews answered him, “Aren’t we right in saying that you are a Samaritan and demon-possessed?”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Keima thilha vop kahipoi; hinlah ka Pa kajabol ahin, nanghon keima neijabol pouve.
target: “I am not possessed by a demon,” said Jesus, “but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.

source: Chule keiman keima loupina ding kaholpoi; ahola leh thutan khat aumnai.
target: I am not seeking glory for myself; but there is one who seeks it, and he is the judge.

source: Keiman nangho tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Kathu nit chun itihchan hijongle thina amu lou ding ahi, ati.
target: Very truly I tell you, whoever obeys my word will never see death.”

source: Chuin Juda hon ajah-a, Thilha vop nahi tun kahe taove. Abraham athitan, chule themgaoho jongla athigam taovin; nangman, Kathu nit chun itihchan hijongle thina atepkhah lou ding ahi, nati.
target: At this they exclaimed, “Now we know that you are demon-possessed! Abraham died and so did the prophets, yet you say that whoever obeys your word will never taste death.

source: Nangma athi tasa kapului'u Abraham sanga chungnungjo nahim? Chule themgaoho jongla athigam taovin; nangman koi kahi nakiti ham? atiuve.
target: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Keima chang kichoi-an kahile, kaki choi-atna chu imacha hilou ahi; ahinla nanghon ka Pathen ahi natiu, hiche ka Pa chun keima eichoi-at ahibouve.
target: Jesus replied, “If I glorify myself, my glory means nothing. My Father, whom you claim as your God, is the one who glorifies me.

source: Ahin nanghon ama nahepouve; hinlah Keiman vang ama kahei; keiman ama chu kahepoi tileng nangho banga mijou kahi ding ahi. Ahinla keiman ama kahei, chule athu jong kangaije.
target: Though you do not know him, I know him. If I said I did not, I would be a liar like you, but I do know him and obey his word.

source: Napuluiju Abraham chu keima nikho mu ding athanomin; chuin amun, akipah lheh jengin ahi, ati.
target: Your father Abraham rejoiced at the thought of seeing my day; he saw it and was glad.”

source: Chuin Judah hon ajah-a, Nakum kum somnga bon lhing lou laija, Abraham namu khah ham? atiuve.
target: “You are not yet fifty years old,” they said to him, “and you have seen Abraham!”

source: Jesu'n ajah uva, Keiman nangho tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Keima Abraham masang peh-a, Keima ana umsa kahi, ati.
target: “Very truly I tell you,” Jesus answered, “before Abraham was born, I am!”

source: Chuin Judah hon asena dingin song akilo taove; ahivangin Jesu akiselin, houin'a kon chun apot doh-in, alah tah-u ajotnin, chule achemang tai.
target: At this, they picked up stones to stone him, but Jesus hid himself, slipping away from the temple grounds.

source: Chuin ache achele apena patna mi mitcho khat amun;
target: As he went along, he saw a man blind from birth.

source: Chuin aseijuihon adongun, Rabbi, hichepa apena mitcho-a apen hi, ama chonse-a ham, ole anu apa chonse-a ham? atiuve.
target: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Ama chonse-a ahipoi, anule apa chonse-a jong ahipoi, hichea hi Pathen natoh kiphonna dinga ahibouve.
target: “Neither this man nor his parents sinned,” said Jesus, “but this happened so that the works of God might be displayed in him.

source: Sun ahi petcha hi eisolpa na katoh ding hivehta. Koiman na atoh thei louna jan hung lhung ding hitahi.
target: As long as it is day, we must do the works of him who sent me. Night is coming, when no one can work.

source: Vannoi'a kaum laise-a hi vannoi vah kahi, ati.
target: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

source: Hiche chu asei jouvin, tolah achil asetlhan, achil chun bonlhoh asemin, bonlhoh chu mitchopa mitna chun aloijin,
target: After saying this, he spit on the ground, made some mud with the saliva, and put it on the man’s eyes.

source: Ajah-a, Chen, Siloam (sol tina ahin) twi kul-a gakiphet lhahtan, ati. Chuin ama achen, agaphet lhan ahile kho amun ahungtai.
target: “Go,” he told him, “wash in the Pool of Siloam” (this word means “Sent”). So the man went and washed, and came home seeing.

source: Chuin aheng akoma chengsele masanga amitchot musaho chun, Touva khutdojia chu ama hi hilouham? akiti taove;
target: His neighbors and those who had formerly seen him begging asked, “Isn’t this the same man who used to sit and beg?”

source: Abangin, Ama hi ahi, atiuvin; adang kimkhatsen, Ahipoi, ama chutoh abange, atiuvin; chuin aman, Ama chu kahinai, ati.
target: Some claimed that he was. Others said, “No, he only looks like him.” But he himself insisted, “I am the man.”

source: Hijeh chun amahon ama chu adongun, Achutile i-atile namit hah hitam? atiuve.
target: “How then were your eyes opened?” they asked.

source: Amapan adonbutnin, Jesu atipau khun bonlhoh asema kamitna aloija, Chenlang Siloam twikul'a gaphet lhan, eitia; chua kache-a kagaphet lhahle kho kamu ahitai, ati.
target: He replied, “The man they call Jesus made some mud and put it on my eyes. He told me to go to Siloam and wash. So I went and washed, and then I could see.”

source: Chuin amahon ama chu adongun, Ama chu hoija umtam? atiule, aman, Kahepoi, ati.
target: “Where is this man?” they asked him. “I don’t know,” he said.

source: Chuin amahon masanga mitchopa chu Pharisai ho henga apuitaovin ahi.
target: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had been blind.

source: Jesu'n bonlhoh asema amit ahasah ni chu cholngah ni ahi.
target: Now the day on which Jesus had made the mud and opened the man’s eyes was a Sabbath.

source: Hijeh chun Pharisai hon jong, Kho iti namu kit-ham, tin adongun ahile, aman ajah uva, aman bonlhoh kamitna anun, hichu kaphet lhahle kho kamu jenge, ati.
target: Therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. “He put mud on my eyes,” the man replied, “and I washed, and now I see.”

source: Hichun Pharisai ho kimkhatnin, Hichepa chu Pathen'a kon ahipoi, ijeh-inem itile cholngah ni anitpoi, atiuvin; kimkhat vang chun, Michonsen hitobang thil kidang abol thei ngaijem? atiuvin; hiti chun amaho lah-a chun akibung khentauve.
target: Some of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, for he does not keep the Sabbath.” But others asked, “How can a sinner perform such signs?” So they were divided.

source: Chuin amahon mitchopa chu adong kit leuvin, Aman namit hasahpa chu nangman ama chu koi ahi natim? atiule, aman, Themgao, ati.
target: Then they turned again to the blind man, “What have you to say about him? It was your eyes he opened.” The man replied, “He is a prophet.”

source: Ama mitcho ahia, kho amu kit thudol chu Juda hon, khomupa nule pa agakou masangseuvin, atahsan pouvin ahi.
target: They still did not believe that he had been blind and had received his sight until they sent for the man’s parents.

source: Chuin amahon amani chu adongun, Apena pat mitcho-a penga natiu nachapa lhon chu ama hi hinam? Ahile tu-a kho iti amuham? atiuve.
target: “Is this your son?” they asked. “Is this the one you say was born blind? How is it that now he can see?”

source: Anule apan adonbut lhonin, Ama hi kachapa lhon ahinai, apena mitcho-a penga ahi chu kahe lhone;
target: “We know he is our son,” the parents answered, “and we know he was born blind.

source: Tu-a iti kho amuham vang kahe lhonpoi; chule kon amit ahasah ham jong kahe lhonpoi; ama dongun, upatah ahi, aman achungchang thu kisei nante, ati lhone.
target: But how he can see now, or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. Ask him. He is of age; he will speak for himself.”

source: Juda ho gina anule apan achuti sei lhon ahi; ajeh chu, Koi koi hijongle, Ama Christa ahi, tia seidoh chu kikhopna in'a kona nodoh ding, tia Juda ho amasanga dettah-a kihoulhua ahiuve.
target: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders, who already had decided that anyone who acknowledged that Jesus was the Messiah would be put out of the synagogue.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu anule apan, Ama upatah ahi, ama dongun, ati lhon ahi.
target: That was why his parents said, “He is of age; ask him.”

source: Chuin amahon masanga mitchopa chu aniveina-in akouvun, Pathen bou vahchoijin, hichepa chu michonse ahi, ti keihon kaheuve, atiuvin ahi.
target: A second time they summoned the man who had been blind. “Give glory to God by telling the truth,” they said. “We know this man is a sinner.”

source: Chuin aman adonbutnin, Michonse ahi ahilou kahepoi; masang chun kamit achon tun kho kamui, hiche bou hi kahei, ati.
target: He replied, “Whether he is a sinner or not, I don’t know. One thing I do know. I was blind but now I see!”

source: Amahon adong kitleuvin, Ama chun inalom? I aloa namit aboldam ham? atiuvin ahi.
target: Then they asked him, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”

source: Aman amaho chu adonbutnin, Ajouvin kaseitame, nangai hih-un; ibola najah nom kitleuvu ham? Nangho jong ama seijui nahi nom uham? ati.
target: He answered, “I have told you already and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you want to become his disciples too?”

source: Chuin amahon amapa chu ahouseuvin, Nangbou ama seijui nahi; keiho vang Mosi seijui kahibovui.
target: Then they hurled insults at him and said, “You are this fellow’s disciple! We are disciples of Moses!

source: Pathen'in Mosi jah-a thu asei chu kaheuvin; hichepa vanghi hoilam kon ahi kahepouve, atiuvin ahi.
target: We know that God spoke to Moses, but as for this fellow, we don’t even know where he comes from.”

source: Amapa chun adonbutnin ajah uva, Hichu datmo aume, kamit hasahta-a ahivanga hoilam kon ahi nahet louvu chu.
target: The man answered, “Now that is remarkable! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

source: Pathen'in michonseho thu angaijipoi; Pathen houva le alunggot lama chonpa thubou angaije, ti iheuve.
target: We know that God does not listen to sinners. He listens to the godly person who does his will.

source: Koiham khatnin apena mitcho-a penga amit ahasah-e, ti vannoi leiset um tila pat akijakha hihhele.
target: Nobody has ever heard of opening the eyes of a man born blind.

source: Ama Pathen'a kon hilou hile imacha abol thei louhel ding ahi, ati.
target: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”

source: Amahon adonbutnun ajah-a, Nang napum changa chonsetna penga keiho neihilum? atiuvin anodoh taove.
target: To this they replied, “You were steeped in sin at birth; how dare you lecture us!” And they threw him out.

source: Amahon ama chu anodoh taove ti thu Jesu'n ajan, chuin ama chu amun ajah-a, Nangman Pathen Chapa chu natahsan em? ati.
target: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and when he found him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of Man?”

source: Aman adonbutnin Pakai, ama chu koiham, katahsan ding chu, ati.
target: “Who is he, sir?” the man asked. “Tell me so that I may believe in him.”

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, Nangman ama namutai, chule najah-a thu seija hi, ama chu ahi, ati.
target: Jesus said, “You have now seen him; in fact, he is the one speaking with you.”

source: Chutah-in, Pakai, katahsane, atin ama chu chibai aboh tan ahi.
target: Then the man said, “Lord, I believe,” and he worshiped him.

source: Chuin Jesu'n khomu louhon kho amuva, chule khomuho amitchohna dinguva, thutan dinga vannoi'a hi hunga kahi, ati.
target: Jesus said, “For judgment I have come into this world, so that the blind will see and those who see will become blind.”

source: Avela um Pharisai phabep hon chechu ajaovin, ajah-a, Keiho jong mitcho kahiuvem? atiuve.
target: Some Pharisees who were with him heard him say this and asked, “What? Are we blind too?”

source: Jesu'n ajah uva, Mitcho hileu chun nachonset nao umlou ding ahin; tu vangin, kho kamui, nati jeh-u chun nachonset nao uma ahitai, ati.
target: Jesus said, “If you were blind, you would not be guilty of sin; but now that you claim you can see, your guilt remains.

source: Keiman nangho tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Koihile kotna lut louva, mun choma kala kelngoi hong sunga lutna chu guchale michom ahi.
target: “Very truly I tell you Pharisees, anyone who does not enter the sheep pen by the gate, but climbs in by some other way, is a thief and a robber.

source: Kotna lut vang chu kelngoiho chinga ahi.
target: The one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.

source: Ama chu kotngahpan kot ahonjin, chule kelngoite chun a-aw aheuvin; chule aman akelngoiho chu amin cheh-in akouvin, apuidohjin ahi.
target: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

source: Chule akelngoiho chu ahoidoh soh tengle, amasanguva achejin, kelngoiho chun anung ajuijiuve; ajeh chu amahon ama aw chu aheuve.
target: When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.

source: Midang nung vang jui louhel ding ahiuve, akoma kona jammangjo ding ahibouvui; ajeh chu amahon midangho aw ahepouve, ati.
target: But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will run away from him because they do not recognize a stranger’s voice.”

source: Hiche thulem chu Jesu'n ajah uva aseijin; ahivangin athusei chu ipi aseina ahi ahepouve.
target: Jesus used this figure of speech, but the Pharisees did not understand what he was telling them.

source: Hijeh chun Jesu'n ajah uva asei kitleuvin, Keiman nangho tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Keima hi kelngoi hong kot kahi.
target: Therefore Jesus said again, “Very truly I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.

source: Keima masanga hungho jouse chu guchale michom ahi sohkeijui; ahinla kelngoihon athu-u anangai pouve.
target: All who have come before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep have not listened to them.

source: Keima hi kot chu kahi; mi keija lut chu huhhing-a umding ahi, chule lutle potle-a, chule hamhing amu ding ahi.
target: I am the gate; whoever enters through me will be saved. They will come in and go out, and find pasture.

source: Gucha chu agu dingle athat ding chule asumang dingabou hung ahi. Keima vang amahon hinna anei theina dinguva, chule aneibe chehna dinguva hunga kahi.
target: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full.

source: Keima kelngoi chingpha kahi. Kelngoi chingpha chun kelngoiho dingin ahinna apejie.
target: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

source: Kelngoi chingtah tah hilou, kelngoiho ama-a hilou, thalah vang chun, ngei hung amu tengle kelngoiho chu adalhan ajamjitai; chutengle ngei chun amanin, kelngoiho chu asuchehji tai.
target: The hired hand is not the shepherd and does not own the sheep. So when he sees the wolf coming, he abandons the sheep and runs away. Then the wolf attacks the flock and scatters it.

source: Ijeh-inem itile ama thalah ahibouvin, kelngoiho ding chu imacha agelpoi.
target: The man runs away because he is a hired hand and cares nothing for the sheep.

source: Keima kelngoi chingpha kahi, chule ka kelngoiho kahen, amahon jong keima eiheuve.
target: “I am the good shepherd; I know my sheep and my sheep know me—

source: Pan keima eihet bangin keiman Pa chu kahei; chule kelngoiho dingin kahinna kapei.
target: just as the Father knows me and I know the Father—and I lay down my life for the sheep.

source: Hiche honga hilou jong kakelngoi kanei nalaije; keiman hiche ho jong chu kagahoilut ding, chule amahon ka aw ahetdingu ahi; chule hong khat, aching khat hung hidoh ding ahi.
target: I have other sheep that are not of this sheep pen. I must bring them also. They too will listen to my voice, and there shall be one flock and one shepherd.

source: Keiman kahinna chu kakilah kit dinga kapeh ding ahin; hiche jeh-a chu Pan keima eingailut ahi.
target: The reason my Father loves me is that I lay down my life—only to take it up again.

source: Khat touvin eilahpeh ding thu ahipoi, keiman kachama kapeh ding ahibouve. Keiman pehna ding thaneina kaneijin, chule kilah kit theina thaneina jong kaneije. Hiche thupeh hi ka Pa-a kona kamu ahi, ati.
target: No one takes it from me, but I lay it down of my own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. This command I received from my Father.”

source: Thu chucheng jeh chun Judah ho abung bungin akikhen kit taove.
target: The Jews who heard these words were again divided.

source: Alah uva tamtah-in, Hichepa hi thilha vop le mingol ahi; ibola athu nangaiju ham? atiuvin;
target: Many of them said, “He is demon-possessed and raving mad. Why listen to him?”

source: Adangsen, Thu hitobang hi thilha vop thusei ahipoi. Thilhan mi mitcho ho amit ahasah thei ngaijem? atiuve.
target: But others said, “These are not the sayings of a man possessed by a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?”

source: Chuin Jerusalem'a houin thensona kut aumin, hichu phalbilai ahi.
target: Then came the Festival of Dedication at Jerusalem. It was winter,

source: Chuin Jesu houin'a Solomon hongcha-a chun avahlelen ahi.
target: and Jesus was in the temple courts walking in Solomon’s Colonnade.

source: Hichun Judah hon aum kimvelun, Itihchan nei lunggim sah dinguham? Christa nahile kichentah-in neisei peh-un, atiuve.
target: The Jews who were there gathered around him, saying, “How long will you keep us in suspense? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly.”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Keiman najah uva kaseitan, ahivangin nanghon natahsan pouve. Ka Pa mina thil kabol chengse hi kathudol hettohsah ahi.
target: Jesus answered, “I did tell you, but you do not believe. The works I do in my Father’s name testify about me,

source: Ahivangin, najah uva kasei bangin, nangho kakelngoi lah-a nahilou jeh-un, natahsan pouve.
target: but you do not believe because you are not my sheep.

source: Keima kelngoiho vangin ka-aw aheuvin, keiman jong amaho kahei, chule amahon kanung eijui jiuve;
target: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.

source: Chule keiman amaho chu tonsot hinna kapeji; chutia chu amaho itih chana mangthah lou ding ahiuvin, chujongle koiman kakhutna kona amaho chu eilahpeh lou ding ahi.
target: I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish; no one will snatch them out of my hand.

source: Ka Pa amaho keima eipe-a chu, ima jouse chunga chungnung pen ahin; chule ka Pa-a kona chu koiman alahpeh thei lou ding ahi.
target: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all; no one can snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

source: Keimale Pa chu pum khat kahi lhone, ati.
target: I and the Father are one.”

source: Chuin Judah hon asena ding song akilo kit taove.
target: Again his Jewish opponents picked up stones to stone him,

source: Jesu'n amaho chu adonbutnin, ka Pa-a kona chu natohpha tamtah kavetsah nahitaove; chuche na kitongho hoipen jeh-a chu keima songa neiseu ham? ati.
target: but Jesus said to them, “I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these do you stone me?”

source: Judah hon adonbutnun, Naphatoh jeh-a songa kaseu ahipoi, Pathen nataitom jeh ahibouve; chujongle mihem nahinasa-a Pathen nakihisah jeh ahi, atiuve.
target: “We are not stoning you for any good work,” they replied, “but for blasphemy, because you, a mere man, claim to be God.”

source: Jesu'n amaho adonbutnin, Nangho hi pathenho nahiuve, kati ahi, tia nadan lekhabu uva kisun hih-am?
target: Jesus answered them, “Is it not written in your Law, ‘I have said you are “gods” ’?

source: Pathen thu lhunnaho bon pathenho atia ahile, Pathen lekhabu thu chu keh thei ahipoi,
target: If he called them ‘gods,’ to whom the word of God came—and Scripture cannot be set aside—

source: Pan asuhthenga vannoi'a asol chun, Pathen Chapa kahi, kati jeh-a ibola Pathen nataitome, neitiu ham?
target: what about the one whom the Father set apart as his very own and sent into the world? Why then do you accuse me of blasphemy because I said, ‘I am God’s Son’?

source: Ka Pa na tonglou kahia ahile, neitahsan daovin.
target: Do not believe me unless I do the works of my Father.

source: Katoh ahivangle, Pa chu keija uma, chule keima Pa-a kaum hi nahet theijuva, natahsan theina dingun; keima neitahsan hih jongleu chun, na kitongho chengse behhi tahsan nun, ati.
target: But if I do them, even though you do not believe me, believe the works, that you may know and understand that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”

source: Chuin amahon ama chu mat dingin ago kit taovin, ahinla ama akhutnuva konin apotdoh-in achemang tan ahi.
target: Again they tried to seize him, but he escaped their grasp.

source: Chuin Jordan gala, John'in amasa baptize achansahna lama chun achen; chukoma chun aga umtai.
target: Then Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had been baptizing in the early days. There he stayed,

source: Chuin mi tamtah ahenga ahungun, amaho chun, John'in melchihna kidang ima avetsahpoi; ahin hichepa thudol John'in asei jouse tahbeh ahi sohkeije, atiuve.
target: and many people came to him. They said, “Though John never performed a sign, all that John said about this man was true.”

source: Hiche koma chun mi tamtah-in atahsan taovin ahi.
target: And in that place many believed in Jesus.

source: Chuin Mariam le asopinu Martha chenna Bethany kho-a chun, mi khat amin Lazarus atiu chu ati anan ahi.
target: Now a man named Lazarus was sick. He was from Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.

source: Chule ana-a chu Pakai thao nua, asama akeng theh ngima Mariam sopi pa Lazarus chu ahi.
target: (This Mary, whose brother Lazarus now lay sick, was the same one who poured perfume on the Lord and wiped his feet with her hair.)

source: Hijeh chun asopi numei tenin Jesu henga mi asol lhonin, ajah-a, Pakai, ven, nangman nangailut pa chu anai, agati sah lhone.
target: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, “Lord, the one you love is sick.”

source: Jesu'n hichu ajah phatnin, Hiche nat hi thina ding ahipoi; hichea chu Pathen Chapa choi-atna aumna dinga Pathen loupina dingbou ahi, ati.
target: When he heard this, Jesus said, “This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for God’s glory so that God’s Son may be glorified through it.”

source: Jesu'n Martha le asopinu chule Lazarus chu angailut ahi.
target: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.

source: Hiti chun anai ti ajah chun, aumna-a chun nini aumna laijin ahi.
target: So when he heard that Lazarus was sick, he stayed where he was two more days,

source: Chuin hiche nung chun aseijuiho jah-a, Judah gama che kit taohite, ati.
target: and then he said to his disciples, “Let us go back to Judea.”

source: Aseijuihon ajah-a, Rabbi, Judah ho chunla songa seding nagouvin; khu lama nache kit dingham? atiuve.
target: “But Rabbi,” they said, “a short while ago the Jews there tried to stone you, and yet you are going back?”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Ni khat sunga hi nidan somleni um louham? Mi khat sunlaija vahlea chu, vannoi vah amu jeh-in aki pal ngaipoi.
target: Jesus answered, “Are there not twelve hours of daylight? Anyone who walks in the daytime will not stumble, for they see by this world’s light.

source: Ahin jana vahlea vang chu, ama sunga vah aum lou jeh-in akipal jin ahi, ati.
target: It is when a person walks at night that they stumble, for they have no light.”

source: Hicheng chu aseijin; chujouvin ajah uva, Igolpao Lazarus a-imutai; ahin a-imut sukhang dinga kache ding ahi, ati.
target: After he had said this, he went on to tell them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep; but I am going there to wake him up.”

source: Chuin aseijuihon ajah-a, Pakai, a-imut tah-a ahile damta vehta, atiuve.
target: His disciples replied, “Lord, if he sleeps, he will get better.”

source: Jesu'n hichu athi aseina ahin, ahivangin amahon kicholdo dinga a-imut aseijin angaitouve.
target: Jesus had been speaking of his death, but his disciples thought he meant natural sleep.

source: Hijeh chun Jesu'n ajah uva asei chenin, Lazarus athia ahitai;
target: So then he told them plainly, “Lazarus is dead,

source: Nanghon natahsan theina dingun, chukoma kaum lou chu nangho dingin kakipah-e; hijongle tun hungun ahenga cheohite, ati.
target: and for your sake I am glad I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him.”

source: Hichun Didymus atiu, Thomas chun aseijui chankhompi ho jah-a, Cheovin, eiho jong amatoh thitha dingin cheohite, ati.
target: Then Thomas (also known as Didymus) said to the rest of the disciples, “Let us also go, that we may die with him.”

source: Chuin Jesu ahung lhunin, lhana akoiju ni li ahitai ti ahetai.
target: On his arrival, Jesus found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb for four days.

source: Bethany chu Jerusalem kom ahin, ching somle ching nga vela gamlha ahi.
target: Now Bethany was less than two miles from Jerusalem,

source: Chule asopipa lhon chungchanga lungmonsah dingin, Judah ho tamtah Martha le Mariam henga chun ahungun ahi.
target: and many Jews had come to Martha and Mary to comfort them in the loss of their brother.

source: Chuin Martha'n, Jesu ahunge ti ajah jah-in, apotdoh-in aga kimutopin; Mariam vang chu in'a chun atouna laije.
target: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed at home.

source: Chuin Martha'n Jesu jah-a, Pakai, nangma hikoma um hile chun, kasopipa thi lou dinga.
target: “Lord,” Martha said to Jesus, “if you had been here, my brother would not have died.

source: Tu jengin jong, nangman Pathen henga nathum chan chu, Pathen'in napeh ding kahei, ati.
target: But I know that even now God will give you whatever you ask.”

source: Jesu'n amanu ajah-a, Nasopipa thoudoh kit ding ahi, ati.
target: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”

source: Martha'n ajah-a, Ni nunung ni-a thokit ni-a athodoh ding chu kahenai, ati.
target: Martha answered, “I know he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”

source: Jesu'n amanu jah-a, Keima hi thokitna le hinna kahi; keima eitahsana chu, thi jongle, hing ding;
target: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die;

source: Chule koi hijongle ahinga keima eitahsana chu, itih hijongle thi lou ding ahi. Hiche hi natahsan em? ati.
target: and whoever lives by believing in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

source: Amanun ajah-a, Henge, Pakai, Nangma vannoi'a hung ding, Pathen Chapa, Christa chu nahi katahsane, ati.
target: “Yes, Lord,” she replied, “I believe that you are the Messiah, the Son of God, who is to come into the world.”

source: Chuin amanun hiche chu asei jouvin, achen, asopinu Mariam guhthimin akouvin, Houhil chu hikoma aumin, nakouve, ati.
target: After she had said this, she went back and called her sister Mary aside. “The Teacher is here,” she said, “and is asking for you.”

source: Chuin amanun hichu ajah jah-in, akipatdoh loijin, ahenga achetai.
target: When Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to him.

source: Jesu chu khosung hung lut lou laija, Martha'n akimutopina mun'a chu umnalai ahi.
target: Now Jesus had not yet entered the village, but was still at the place where Martha had met him.

source: Hichun Judah ho a-in'a aumpia alhembi ho chun, Mariam akipatdoh loija apotdoh chu amuvin, lhana kap dinga che ahi atiuvin, ajuijun ahi.
target: When the Jews who had been with Mary in the house, comforting her, noticed how quickly she got up and went out, they followed her, supposing she was going to the tomb to mourn there.

source: Chuin Mariam Jesu umna alhun phatnin, ama chu amun, akengphang bulah abohkhup jengin, ajah-a, Pakai, nangma hikoma um hile chun kasopipa thi lou dinga, ati.
target: When Mary reached the place where Jesus was and saw him, she fell at his feet and said, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.”

source: Jesu'n hitia chu amanu aka amu-a, Judah ho ahin lhonpiho jong chu aka-u amu phatnin, alung sunga ahimsan, atinaje akimah jengin,
target: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come along with her also weeping, he was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.

source: Hoija nakoijum, atin ahile; amahon, Pakai, hungin, hung vetan, atiuvin ahi.
target: “Where have you laid him?” he asked. “Come and see, Lord,” they replied.

source: Jesu akaptai.
target: Jesus wept.

source: Hijeh chun Judah hon, Veuvin, iti angailut hitam! atiuve.
target: Then the Jews said, “See how he loved him!”

source: Ahivangin alah uva abang bang chun, Mi mitcho mit hasah thei hiche mipa hin, hichepa jonghi athi sahda thei hilouham? atiuve.
target: But some of them said, “Could not he who opened the eyes of the blind man have kept this man from dying?”

source: Chuin Jesu asung gila ahimsa kitleuvin, lhan lama chun achetai. Alhan chu kohom khat ahin, akot chu song khatna kising ahi.
target: Jesus, once more deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone laid across the entrance.

source: Jesu'n, Song chu tangdoh-un, ati. Athipa sopinu Martha chun, ajah-a, Pakai, tun a-uitai; ijeh-inem itile athina ni li ahitai, ati.
target: “Take away the stone,” he said. “But, Lord,” said Martha, the sister of the dead man, “by this time there is a bad odor, for he has been there four days.”

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, Natahsan le Pathen loupina namu ding ahi, tia kasei louham? ati.
target: Then Jesus said, “Did I not tell you that if you believe, you will see the glory of God?”

source: Hichun amahon mithi lupna-a konchun songchu aladoh un ahi. Chuin Jesu avandah-in, Pa, nangman kataona nangai jeh-in, kathangvah-e;
target: So they took away the stone. Then Jesus looked up and said, “Father, I thank you that you have heard me.

source: Chule nangman kataona nangai jinge ti keiman kahei; ahivangin hiche mipi kakimvela dingho hin nangma sol kahi hi atahsan theina dinguva, kati ahibouve, ati.
target: I knew that you always hear me, but I said this for the benefit of the people standing here, that they may believe that you sent me.”

source: Chuin hichu asei jouvin, hasaptah-in asamin, Lazarus, hung doh-in, ati.
target: When he had said this, Jesus called in a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

source: Hichun athipa chu akhut le akeng lhanpona kitom pumin; amai ultheh pona kitom pumin ahungdoh tan ahi. Jesu'n ajah uva, Lhamun lang che sah-un, ati.
target: The dead man came out, his hands and feet wrapped with strips of linen, and a cloth around his face. Jesus said to them, “Take off the grave clothes and let him go.”

source: Chuin Mariam henga hung Judah ho tamtah-in Jesu thibol hochu amuvin, atahsan taove.
target: Therefore many of the Jews who had come to visit Mary, and had seen what Jesus did, believed in him.

source: Ahivangin abang kimkhat Pharisai ho henga acheuvin, Jesu thilbol chengse chu aga sei taove.
target: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.

source: Hijeh chun thempu pipuiho le Pharisai ho chu akikhomun, Eihon ipi iboluham? Hichepa khunla melchihna tamtah abol jing jengin ahi.
target: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees called a meeting of the Sanhedrin. “What are we accomplishing?” they asked. “Here is this man performing many signs.

source: Hiti mohlha leuhen, mi jousen ama tahsanun tin, chule Rome mite hunguva, imunu le ivaiju eilah mangpeh dingu ahi, atiuve.
target: If we let him go on like this, everyone will believe in him, and then the Romans will come and take away both our temple and our nation.”

source: Chuin alah uva khat, Caiaphas, chuche kum-a chu thempu chungnunga pang ahin, amachun ajah uva, Nanghon imacha nahehih heluve,
target: Then one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, spoke up, “You know nothing at all!

source: Chujongle vaipi aboncha amanthah louna dinga, miho dinga mi khat athi nangho dinga phajo ahi, ti jong nagelpouve, ati.
target: You do not realize that it is better for you that one man die for the people than that the whole nation perish.”

source: Hiche chu aman ama chama asei ahipoi; chuche kum-a chu thempu chungnunga panga ahito lhona, vaipi dinga Jesu athi ding chu, gaova asei masah ahibouve.
target: He did not say this on his own, but as high priest that year he prophesied that Jesus would die for the Jewish nation,

source: Chule avaipiu chang ding hilouva, vannoi'a chehsa Pathen chate akhop khoma, pum khat ahidohna ding jong ahi.
target: and not only for that nation but also for the scattered children of God, to bring them together and make them one.

source: Chuin chuche ni-a pat chun atha theina dingu lung angaitouvin akihousom taove.
target: So from that day on they plotted to take his life.

source: Hijeh chun Jesu Judah ho lah-a lhang phongin avahle tapoi; ahin chua kon chun gamthip dep lama Ephraim atiu kho-a chun achen, aseijuite toh chua chun aum jing taove.
target: Therefore Jesus no longer moved about publicly among the people of Judea. Instead he withdrew to a region near the wilderness, to a village called Ephraim, where he stayed with his disciples.

source: Chuin Judah ho kalchuh kut anaitan; agam agama konin mi tamtah kut masanga ana kisutheng dingin Jerusalem'a acheuvin ahi.
target: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, many went up from the country to Jerusalem for their ceremonial cleansing before the Passover.

source: Chuin amaho chun Jesu aholun, houin'a chun adingun, khatle khat akihouvun, Ipi nangai touvem? Ama chu kut na hi hung lou dingham? akitiuve.
target: They kept looking for Jesus, and as they stood in the temple courts they asked one another, “What do you think? Isn’t he coming to the festival at all?”

source: Thempu pipuiho le Pharisai hochun, Koi hijongle aumna he-a chun, amat theina dinguva avetsah dinguva, thupeh aneisao ahitai.
target: But the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that anyone who found out where Jesus was should report it so that they might arrest him.

source: Chuin kalchuh kut masang ni gup in, anathisa athodoh kit Lazarus umna Bethany'a chun Jesu ahungin ahi.
target: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus lived, whom Jesus had raised from the dead.

source: Chukoma chun ama dingin jan an asemun; chule Martha'n ajenlen, Lazarus vang chu ankonga amatoh touho lah-a chu panga ahi.
target: Here a dinner was given in Jesus’ honor. Martha served, while Lazarus was among those reclining at the table with him.

source: Chuin Mariam'in halpibei spikenard kiti thao namtui, man tamtah ser keh ahin choijin, Jesu keng anun, asamin atheh ngimin ahile, agimnam chun insung chu alosoh jengin ahi.
target: Then Mary took about a pint of pure nard, an expensive perfume; she poured it on Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. And the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.

source: Chuin aseijuiho lah-a khat, Simon chapa Juda Iscariot, amatsah-a pang dingpa chun,
target: But one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, who was later to betray him, objected,

source: Ibola hiche thao hi dangka jakhat le somnga mana kijoh-a, mivaicha gentheite kipe louham? ati.
target: “Why wasn’t this perfume sold and the money given to the poor? It was worth a year’s wages.”

source: Aman hiche ati chu, vaicha genthei akhohsah-a asei ahipoi; ama chu gucha ahin, chule sumdip avop ahin, asunga kikoi chu akilahji jeh-a asei ahi.
target: He did not say this because he cared about the poor but because he was a thief; as keeper of the money bag, he used to help himself to what was put into it.

source: Chuin Jesu'n, amanu limsah hih-un; amanun kakivui ni-a dinga hiche hi akoi ahi.
target: “Leave her alone,” Jesus replied. “It was intended that she should save this perfume for the day of my burial.

source: Ijeh-inem itile vaichaho chu nang hotoh naum khom jing naove; ahin keima vang nang hotoh umjing ding kahipoi, ati.
target: You will always have the poor among you, but you will not always have me.”

source: Chuin Jesu chukoma chun aume, ti aheuvin, Judah ho mi tamtah ama chungchang jeng hilouvin, athi lah-a kona athodoh Lazarus jong chu vet nom-in ahenga ahungtaove.
target: Meanwhile a large crowd of Jews found out that Jesus was there and came, not only because of him but also to see Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead.

source: Ahin thempu pipuihon Lazarus sana chu tha dingin akihousom taove.
target: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus as well,

source: Ajehchu ama jala Judah ho tamtah chemanguva, Jesu atahsanu ahi.
target: for on account of him many of the Jews were going over to Jesus and believing in him.

source: Ajingin kutna dinga hung mipi atama tamin, Jesu Jerusalem'a dingin ahunge ti ajah phatnun,
target: The next day the great crowd that had come for the festival heard that Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem.

source: Lusu na akidopmun, aga lamtouvin, Hosanna: Pakai mina hunga Israelte Lengpa chu anun nome; tin asam asamun ahi.
target: They took palm branches and went out to meet him, shouting, “Hosanna!” “Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Blessed is the king of Israel!”

source: Chuin Jesu'n sangan chalgol khat amun, achunga atouvin;
target: Jesus found a young donkey and sat on it, as it is written:

source: Vo, Sion chanu, kicha hih-in; ven, na Lengpa sangan nou chunga achongin, ahunge, tia kisun bang chu ahi.
target: “Do not be afraid, Daughter Zion; see, your king is coming, seated on a donkey’s colt.”

source: Hicheng thu chu amasan aseijuiten ahedoh pouve; ahin Jesu choi-atna aumdoh phat chun, hiche thu chu ama thudola kisunsa ahin, amahon hitia chu ama chunga abolu ahi, ti chu ageldoh taove.
target: At first his disciples did not understand all this. Only after Jesus was glorified did they realize that these things had been written about him and that these things had been done to him.

source: Aman Lazarus lhana kon akouva, athi lah-a kona athodoh pettah-a aumpi mipi chengse chu, athu hettohsah-a pang ahiuve.
target: Now the crowd that was with him when he called Lazarus from the tomb and raised him from the dead continued to spread the word.

source: Hiche melchihna kidang abol ajah jehtah uva jong chu mipi chun alamtou ahi.
target: Many people, because they had heard that he had performed this sign, went out to meet him.

source: Hijeh chun Pharisai ho amahole amaho akihouvun, Ima nalo thei louvu namuve; veuvin, vannoi'in anung ajuitai, atiuve.
target: So the Pharisees said to one another, “See, this is getting us nowhere. Look how the whole world has gone after him!”

source: Hiche kut na Pathen hou dinga hungho lah-a chun Greek mi phabep ajaovin;
target: Now there were some Greeks among those who went up to worship at the festival.

source: Amaho chu Galilee gama Bethsaida kho-a mi Philip henga ahungun, ajah-a, Pu, Jesu chu kamu nomui, ahung tiuve.
target: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, with a request. “Sir,” they said, “we would like to see Jesus.”

source: Philip ahungin Andrew jah-a ahung seijin, chuin Andrew Philip toh ahungin, Jesu jah-a asei lhone.
target: Philip went to tell Andrew; Andrew and Philip in turn told Jesus.

source: Chuin Jesu'n amaho chu adonbutnin, Mihem Chapa choi-at na aum ding phat ahung lhunge.
target: Jesus replied, “The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

source: Keiman nangho tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Chang chang khat tolla alhah-a athi loule achangin aum jingji bouve; athi vangle tamtah aga jin ahi.
target: Very truly I tell you, unless a kernel of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains only a single seed. But if it dies, it produces many seeds.

source: Ahinna ngailu-a chun achan ding; chule hiche vannoi leiset chunga ahinna ho-a chun tonsot hinna-a dinga akikoi ahi.
target: Anyone who loves their life will lose it, while anyone who hates their life in this world will keep it for eternal life.

source: Koi hijongle kalhacha panga chun kanung eijuihen; keima umna-a chu, kalhacha jong umding ahi; mi koi hile kalhacha panga chu, Pa chun ajabol ding ahi.
target: Whoever serves me must follow me; and where I am, my servant also will be. My Father will honor the one who serves me.

source: Tun kalung adongtai; ipi kasei dingham? Pa, hiche nidana kon hin neihuh doh-in. Ahivangin hiche dinga hi tu nidan geija hi hung kahi.
target: “Now my soul is troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this hour’? No, it was for this very reason I came to this hour.

source: Pa, namin choi-anin, ati. Chuin van'a konin aw ahung gingin, Kachoi-antai, chule choi-an kit nalai ding kahi, ati.
target: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came from heaven, “I have glorified it, and will glorify it again.”

source: Hichun akimvela dinga mipi chun hichu ajauvin, Van aginge, atiuvin; adangsen, Vantil'in ajah-a thu asei ahi, atiuve.
target: The crowd that was there and heard it said it had thundered; others said an angel had spoken to him.

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Hiche aw hi keima jeh-a hung ahipoi; nangho dingjoh ahibouve.
target: Jesus said, “This voice was for your benefit, not mine.

source: Tu-a hi hiche vannoi hi athu kitan ahi; vannoi'a vaihompa chu kipaidoh ding ahitai.
target: Now is the time for judgment on this world; now the prince of this world will be driven out.

source: Chule keima leija kona dop sanga kauma ahile, mi jouse kahenga kaloi khom ding ahi, ati.
target: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”

source: Hichu iti thia athi ding seina-a hitia chu asei ahi.
target: He said this to show the kind of death he was going to die.

source: Hichun mipi chun adonbutnun, Keihonla Christa chu a-imatih chana umjing ahi, ti danthua kajauvin; Mihem Chapa dop sanga umding iti natiham? Hiche Mihem Chapa chu koiham? atiuvin ahi.
target: The crowd spoke up, “We have heard from the Law that the Messiah will remain forever, so how can you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’ ? Who is this ‘Son of Man’?”

source: Chuin Jesu'n ajah uva, Vah hi nalah uva chomcha khat umnalai ding ahi; muthimin nahinphah ma-un vah aumpet hin vahleu vin; ijeh inem itile muthima vahlea chun achena ding ahepoi.
target: Then Jesus told them, “You are going to have the light just a little while longer. Walk while you have the light, before darkness overtakes you. Whoever walks in the dark does not know where they are going.

source: Vah chate nahi theina dingun, Vah chu nanei petchao hin, vah chu tahsanun, ati. Thu hicheng hi Jesu'n aseijin, apotdoh-in amaho-a kon chun akiseltai.
target: Believe in the light while you have the light, so that you may become children of light.” When he had finished speaking, Jesus left and hid himself from them.

source: Ahin alah uva melchihna kidang tamtah abol vangin, amahon atahsan pouve.
target: Even after Jesus had performed so many signs in their presence, they still would not believe in him.

source: Hiche hi Isaiah themgaovin, Pakai, kathuseiju kon atahsanem? Chule Pakai ban thahat koi henga kilangam? tia asei chu guilhun theina ding ahi.
target: This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet: “Lord, who has believed our message and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”

source: Hiche thua hin Isaiah'in asei kitleuvin,
target: For this reason they could not believe, because, as Isaiah says elsewhere:

source: Aman amitnu asuchon, alungu asutah tai; Achuti loule amitnun muvintin, chule alungun heuvintin, chule hung kihei kitnun tin, Keiman boldam get inge, ati; hiche jeh-a hi amahon atahsan thei louvu ahi.
target: “He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, so they can neither see with their eyes, nor understand with their hearts, nor turn—and I would heal them.”

source: Hiche hi Isaiah'in ama loupina chu ana mu-a, ama thudol aseina-a kona, asei ahi.
target: Isaiah said this because he saw Jesus’ glory and spoke about him.

source: Achuti vangin vaipoho jeng jong tamtah-in atahsan taove; ahinla Pharisai ho jeh chun, kikhopna-a konin eikikaidoh khante tin aphongdoh aumpouve;
target: Yet at the same time many even among the leaders believed in him. But because of the Pharisees they would not openly acknowledge their faith for fear they would be put out of the synagogue;

source: Ajeh chu amahon Pathen choiat sanga mihem choiat adeijoh-u ahi.
target: for they loved human praise more than praise from God.

source: Jesu'n aw sangtah-in asamin, Koi hijongle keima eitahsan chun, keima hilouva, eisolpajoh atahsan ahibouve.
target: Then Jesus cried out, “Whoever believes in me does not believe in me only, but in the one who sent me.

source: Chule keima eimu-a chun eisolpa amu ahi.
target: The one who looks at me is seeing the one who sent me.

source: Koi hijongle keima eitahsana chu muthima aum louna dinga, keima vah kahia vannoi'a kahung ahi.
target: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in me should stay in darkness.

source: Mi khattouvin kathu jahen, tahsan hih jongle athu katanpoi; ijeh-inem itile keima vannoi thutana hung kahipoi, vannoi huhhing ding joh-a hung kahibouve.
target: “If anyone hears my words but does not keep them, I do not judge that person. For I did not come to judge the world, but to save the world.

source: Koi hijongle keima eidei louva, kathu jong jop lou chu, athutanna khat aumnai; kathusei hochun ni nunung nile athu atan ding ahi;
target: There is a judge for the one who rejects me and does not accept my words; the very words I have spoken will condemn them at the last day.

source: ijeh-inem itile keiman kathuneina-a kasei ahipoi; ahin eisola Pa chun kasei dingle kahil dinga thupeh eipeh ahibouve.
target: For I did not speak on my own, but the Father who sent me commanded me to say all that I have spoken.

source: Ama thupeh chu tonsot hinna ahi, ti kahei; hiche jeh-a chu kathusei hi Pan eihil bang banga kasei ahi, ati.
target: I know that his command leads to eternal life. So whatever I say is just what the Father has told me to say.”

source: Kalchuh kut masangin, Jesu'n hiche vannoi'a kona a-Pa henga ache ding phat ahung lhungtai, ti ahen, Vannoi'a um ama-a ho chu angailun akhon ni geijin angailu lhumkeije.
target: It was just before the Passover Festival. Jesus knew that the hour had come for him to leave this world and go to the Father. Having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

source: Chuin jan anneh kichaijin, diabol chun Simon chapa Judas Iscariot lung sunga ama matsahna ding lungthim akhumpeh tai.
target: The evening meal was in progress, and the devil had already prompted Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.

source: Jesu'n, Pan thil jouse ama khutna apeh, chule ama Pathen'a kona hungdoh ahia, Pathen henga chea ahi chu ahen;
target: Jesus knew that the Father had put all things under his power, and that he had come from God and was returning to God;

source: Ajan anneh ankonga konin akipatdoh-in, chuin aposil akoijin, tinotpon alan, akong akigah-in ahi.
target: so he got up from the meal, took off his outer clothing, and wrapped a towel around his waist.

source: Chuin aman kisilna kong-ah twi alheijin, aseijuiho keng asilin, akong gahna tinotpon chun atheh pantan ahi.
target: After that, he poured water into a basin and began to wash his disciples’ feet, drying them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

source: Chuin ama Simon Peter koma ahungin ahile aman ajah-a, Pakai, nangman kakeng neisilpeh dingham? atin ahile,
target: He came to Simon Peter, who said to him, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin ajah-a, Kabol hi nangman tun nahepoi; ajole henan nate, ati.
target: Jesus replied, “You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”

source: Chuin Peter'in ajah-a, Nangman itih hijongle kakeng nasil louhel ding ahi, ati. Jesu'n adonbutnin ajah-a, Keiman nangma kasil loule keija nangman chan nanei lou ahi, ati.
target: “No,” said Peter, “you shall never wash my feet.” Jesus answered, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with me.”

source: Simon Peter'in ajah-a, Pakai, kakeng keojeng hilouvin kakhut le kalu jonge, ati.
target: “Then, Lord,” Simon Peter replied, “not just my feet but my hands and my head as well!”

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, Akisil jousa chu akeng tailou adang sil lou akhohpoi, apumpin angimsoh nai; chule nangho nangim naove, ahivangin nabonchao nahipouve, ati.
target: Jesus answered, “Those who have had a bath need only to wash their feet; their whole body is clean. And you are clean, though not every one of you.”

source: Ijeh ham itile ama matsah-a pang dingpa chu aman ahetsa ahin; hiche jeh-a chu, aman, Nabonchaovin nangimpouve, ati ahi.
target: For he knew who was going to betray him, and that was why he said not every one was clean.

source: Aman akengu asil jouvin, apon akilah-in atou kitnin, amaho jah-a chun, Nachung uva ipi bola kahi chu nahetnah-um?
target: When he had finished washing their feet, he put on his clothes and returned to his place. “Do you understand what I have done for you?” he asked them.

source: Nanghon keima Houhil le Pakai neitiuve; hiche natiu chu aphai, ijeh-inem itile keima hichu kahi.
target: “You call me ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord,’ and rightly so, for that is what I am.

source: Hijeh chun keima Pakai le Houhil bonin nangho keng kasil leh, nanghon jong khatnin khat keng naki silpeh to dingu thu ahi.
target: Now that I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.

source: Ajeh chu keiman nangho kabol banga chu nanghon jong nabolna dinguva, vetsahna-a kabol ahi.
target: I have set you an example that you should do as I have done for you.

source: Keiman nangho tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Pakai sangin soh achungnung jopoi, asola sangin solchah jong achungnung jopoi.
target: Very truly I tell you, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.

source: Hitiho hi nahetdoh uva nabol ule nangho anun noma nahiuve.
target: Now that you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.

source: Nangho nabon chaova thudola kasei ahipoi; keiman kalhendohho chengse chu kahenai; Ahivangin changlhah eineh khompi pan kachunga akengto alamtai, ti Pathen lekhabua thu guilhun theina dinga ahi.
target: “I am not referring to all of you; I know those I have chosen. But this is to fulfill this passage of Scripture: ‘He who shared my bread has turned against me.’

source: Tu-a kala ahung guilhun tengle, keima hi ama chu kahi nahetna dinguva, ahung guilhun masanga kaseipeh nahiuve.
target: “I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe that I am who I am.

source: Tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Koi hijongle kamisol sang chan chun keima eisan ahi; chule keima eisang chan chun eisolpa asan ahi, ati.
target: Very truly I tell you, whoever accepts anyone I send accepts me; and whoever accepts me accepts the one who sent me.”

source: Chuin Jesu'n hiche chu aseijin, alungdong lheh jengin, ajah uva, Tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, nalah uva khat eipedoh-a pang ding ahi, tin aphongdoh tan ahi.
target: After he had said this, Jesus was troubled in spirit and testified, “Very truly I tell you, one of you is going to betray me.”

source: Seijui ho chu khatle khat akive touvin, koipen asei ahi agelmove.
target: His disciples stared at one another, at a loss to know which of them he meant.

source: Hichea chu aseijuiho lah-a khat, Jesu'n angailut chu a-anga kingai ahin;
target: One of them, the disciple whom Jesus loved, was reclining next to him.

source: Simon Peter'in Koi pen aseina ham dongin tin amitnin agah houpin ahi.
target: Simon Peter motioned to this disciple and said, “Ask him which one he means.”

source: Hichun ama akingai bang chun akingaijin, Pakai, hiche chu koiham? tin adongin ahi.
target: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked him, “Lord, who is it?”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Hiche changlhah hal hi kade-a kapeh dingpentah chu ama chu ahi, ati. Chuin aman changlhah hal chu adekot jouvin alan, Simon chapa Judas Iscariot chu apetai.
target: Jesus answered, “It is the one to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it in the dish.” Then, dipping the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

source: Chuche changlhah hal akisan joutah chun Satan asungah alut tan; chuphat chun Jesu'n ajah-a, Nabol ding chu bol loijin, ati.
target: As soon as Judas took the bread, Satan entered into him. So Jesus told him, “What you are about to do, do quickly.”

source: Ahivangin aman ipi dola achuti sei ahi ankonga touho khatchan jong ahedoh pouve.
target: But no one at the meal understood why Jesus said this to him.

source: Ijeh-inem itile kimkhatnin, Judas khutna sumbom aum jeh-a chu, kutna dinga imanchah dingu gacho-in atiham; ahiloule, vaichaho ikhattou pe dinga Jesu'n asolin angaitouvin ahi.
target: Since Judas had charge of the money, some thought Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the festival, or to give something to the poor.

source: Chuin aman changlhah hal chu akisan jouvin hiche pettah chun apotdoh paijeng tai. Chule hichu jan ahi.
target: As soon as Judas had taken the bread, he went out. And it was night.

source: Chutichun amapa apotdoh jouvin Jesu'n, Tun Mihem Chapa choi-atnin aumtai, ama-ah Pathen jong choi-atnin aumtai.
target: When he was gone, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man is glorified and God is glorified in him.

source: Ama-a Pathen choi-atna aumle, Pathen'in jong amatah-a ama chu achoi-at ding ahi, chule achoi-at pai jeng ding ahi.
target: If God is glorified in him, God will glorify the Son in himself, and will glorify him at once.

source: Chapang neochaho, nang hotoh chomcha khat kaum nahlai ding ahi. Nanghon neihol dingu; ahivanga Judah ho jah-a kasei banga, tu-a nangho jah-a jong kasei ahi, Keima chena-a chu nangho nahung thei lou dingu ahi.
target: “My children, I will be with you only a little longer. You will look for me, and just as I told the Jews, so I tell you now: Where I am going, you cannot come.

source: Keiman nangho thupeh thah kapeh nahiuve, Nangho khatle khat kingailuto cheh-un; keiman nangho kangailut bangu hin nangho jong khat le khat kingailuvin.
target: “A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.

source: Nangho nangho lah-a naki ngailut tocheh uva nahiule, nangho chu keima seijui nahiu hichea chu mi jousen ahet ding ahi, ati.
target: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another.”

source: Simon Peter'in adongin, Pakai, nangma hoilama nache dingham? ati. Jesu'n adonbutnin, Tun nangma kachena-a kanung nunga hungthei pon nate, ajo vangle kanung nunga nahung ding ahi, ati.
target: Simon Peter asked him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus replied, “Where I am going, you cannot follow now, but you will follow later.”

source: Peter'in ajah-a, Pakai, ibola tu-a nanung nunga kahung thei lou dingham? Nangma jala kahinna jong kapeh ding ahi, ati.
target: Peter asked, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Keima jala nahinna napeh dingham? Keiman nangma tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahi, thumvei nei seilep masangse-a ahchal khong lou ding ahi, ati.
target: Then Jesus answered, “Will you really lay down your life for me? Very truly I tell you, before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times!

source: Nangho lungkham hih-un; Pathen tahsanun, keima jong neitahsanun.
target: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God ; believe also in me.

source: Ka Pa in'ah chenna in nom tamtah aume; umlou hile najah uva kaseitah hih dingham; ajeh chu keima nangho ding mun sema che ding kahi.
target: My Father’s house has many rooms; if that were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?

source: Chule nangho ding mun sema kache-a ahile, keima umna-a chu nangho jong naum theina dinguvin, keima hung kitning ting, kahenga dinga kahung puiding nahiuve.
target: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and take you to be with me that you also may be where I am.

source: Kachena ding nanghon naheuvin, chule alampi nahenaove, ati.
target: You know the way to the place where I am going.”

source: Thomas'in ajah-a, Pakai, nachena dingbon kihe lou uva, alampi iti kahet dingu ham? ati.
target: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going, so how can we know the way?”

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, Keima hi lampi, thutah, chule hinna chu kahi; keija che lou chu koima Pa kom alhungpoi.
target: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.

source: Nanghon keima neiheleu chun, ka Pa jong chu nahet dingu ahitai; tu-a kal vang he jong naheuvin, mu jong namutaove, ati.
target: If you really know me, you will know my Father as well. From now on, you do know him and have seen him.”

source: Philip'in ajah-a, Pakai, Pa chu neimusah-un, hichu keiho dinga phaset ahi, ati.
target: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father and that will be enough for us.”

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, Vo Philip, keima hitihchan nang hotoh kauma jong neihet loulaiham? Keima eimu-a chun ka Pa amu ahitai; achutile Pa chu neimusah-un, iti natiham?
target: Jesus answered: “Don’t you know me, Philip, even after I have been among you such a long time? Anyone who has seen me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

source: Keima Pa-a kaum chule Pa jong keija aum hi natahsan louham? Keiman nangho jah-a thu kasei chengse hi keima chama kasei ahipoi; Pa chu keija uma na atoh ahibouve.
target: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and that the Father is in me? The words I say to you I do not speak on my own authority. Rather, it is the Father, living in me, who is doing his work.

source: Keima Pa-a kaumin chule Pa jong keija aume kati hi tahsanun; ahilou jongle na kitong chengse jehtah hin tahsanun.
target: Believe me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; or at least believe on the evidence of the works themselves.

source: Keiman tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, keima eitahsana chun, kathilbol chengse hi aman jong abolding ahi; chule asanga lenjojo abolding ahi, ajehchu keima ka Pa henga kache ding ahitai.
target: Very truly I tell you, whoever believes in me will do the works I have been doing, and they will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.

source: Chule Pa chu Chapa-a choi-atna aumna dinga, ipi hijongle keima mina nathum chanu chu kabolpeh ding nahiuve.
target: And I will do whatever you ask in my name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

source: Keima mina ipi hijongle nathum chanu chu, kabolpeh ding nahiuve.
target: You may ask me for anything in my name, and I will do it.

source: Keima neingailut ule, kathupeh ho nitnun.
target: “If you love me, keep my commands.

source: Keima Pa henga taoving ting, chule Aman nangho a-imatih chana naumpi jing dingu, Lhamonsah achom dang khat napeh dingu;
target: And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another advocate to help you and be with you forever—

source: Thutah Lhagao ngeichu napeh dingu ahi; amachu vannoi'in asang thei pouve, ajehchu mu jong amupouvin, he jong ahepouve; nanghon vang naheuve; ajeh chu ama nangho sunga chenga ahi, um jong hung umding ahi.
target: the Spirit of truth. The world cannot accept him, because it neither sees him nor knows him. But you know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.

source: Keiman nangho kaihoi beijin dalha pouvinge; naheng uva kahung kit ding ahi.
target: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.

source: Chomkhat joule vannoi min eimu lou ding ahitai, nanghon vang neimu dingu ahinai; ajehchu keima kahin jeh-a, nangho jong nahin dingu ahi.
target: Before long, the world will not see me anymore, but you will see me. Because I live, you also will live.

source: Hiche ni chule keima Pa-a kaum, nangho keija na-umu, chule keima nangho-a kaum hi nahet dingu ahi.
target: On that day you will realize that I am in my Father, and you are in me, and I am in you.

source: Kathupeh ho neija chule nitna chu, eingailua ahi; chule keima eingailua chu ka Pan angailut ding, chule keiman ama chu kangailut na, ahenga kakiphon ding ahi, ati.
target: Whoever has my commands and keeps them is the one who loves me. The one who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I too will love them and show myself to them.”

source: Judas (Iscariot hilou) in ajah-a, Pakai, nangma keiho henga nakiphona vannoi mi henga nakiphon lou ding chu itidan ham? ati.
target: Then Judas (not Judas Iscariot) said, “But, Lord, why do you intend to show yourself to us and not to the world?”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin ajah-a, Mi eingailua chun kathu anit ding, chule ka Pan ama chu angailut ding, chule ahenga chu kahunguva, ama chu kachenpi dingu ahi.
target: Jesus replied, “Anyone who loves me will obey my teaching. My Father will love them, and we will come to them and make our home with them.

source: Keima eingailu lou chun kathu jong anitpoi; chule nathu jah-u keija ahipoi, eisola Pa-a chu ahibouve.
target: Anyone who does not love me will not obey my teaching. These words you hear are not my own; they belong to the Father who sent me.

source: Keiman nangho kaumpi petna thu hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve.
target: “All this I have spoken while still with you.

source: Ahinla Pan kamina ahinsol ding Lhamonsah, Lhagao Theng chun, imajouse nahil sohkei dingu, chule najah uva kathusei chengse hi nageldohsah dingu ahi.
target: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have said to you.

source: Lungmon kadalhahpeh nahiuve; kalungmon kapeh nahiuve; kapeh hi vannoi mi peh bang ahipoi; nalungu donsah hih-un, kicha jong kicha hih-un.
target: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid.

source: Keima kachemanga, chule naheng uva kahung kit ding ahi kati chu najataove. Neingailut ule Pa henga kache ding ahi tia najah uva kasei jeh-a hi nakipa nathanop dingu ahi; ijeh-inem itile Pa chu kei sanga chungnungjo ahi.
target: “You heard me say, ‘I am going away and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved me, you would be glad that I am going to the Father, for the Father is greater than I.

source: Ahung guilhun tengle natahsan theina dinguva, tu-a aguilhun masanga najah uva kasei masah dem ahi.
target: I have told you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe.

source: Najah uva thu tamsei taponge; ijeh-inem itile vannoi lengpa hung ding ahitai; chule aman keijah imacha aneipoi;
target: I will not say much more to you, for the prince of this world is coming. He has no hold over me,

source: Ahinla keiman Pa chu kangailut na, chule Pa chun eithupeh bang banga na katoh ahi hi, vannoi miten ahetna ding ahi. Kipatdoh-un, hikoma konin chetao hite.
target: but he comes so that the world may learn that I love the Father and do exactly what my Father has commanded me. “Come now; let us leave.

source: Keima lengpigui tahtah kahi; chule ka Pa aleilhou ahi.
target: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.

source: Keija um abah aga lou lou chu aman apaidohjin; aga chengse chu aha ga chehna dingin amal ngimjin ahi.
target: He cuts off every branch in me that bears no fruit, while every branch that does bear fruit he prunes so that it will be even more fruitful.

source: Nangho jah-a kathusei vanga chu nangho angimsa nahitaove.
target: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.

source: Keijah um jingun, kei jong nangho-a uminge. Abah lengpiguija aum loule achanga aga thei lou banga chu, nangho jong keija naum louvule naga thei lou dingu ahi.
target: Remain in me, as I also remain in you. No branch can bear fruit by itself; it must remain in the vine. Neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in me.

source: Keima lengpigui kahi, nangho abah nahiuve. Ama keija uma, Keima ama-a kaum mi chu hagan agaji; ajeh chu kei louvin nanghon ima nabol theipouve.
target: “I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit; apart from me you can do nothing.

source: Mi keija umlou chu, abah bangin paidoh-in aumjin, chule agopjin; chule min hicheho chu achom khomun mei sungah asep lutjiuvin ahile akavamjitai.
target: If you do not remain in me, you are like a branch that is thrown away and withers; such branches are picked up, thrown into the fire and burned.

source: Nangho keija naum uva, chule ka thu nangho-a aum jinga ahileh, nagotchan thumun, kibolpeh ding nahiuve.
target: If you remain in me and my words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.

source: Hichea hin nangho haga nagau hin ka Pa choi-at nin aumji; chule hitia chu nangho kaseijui nahi dingu ahi.
target: This is to my Father’s glory, that you bear much fruit, showing yourselves to be my disciples.

source: Pan keima eingailut bang banga, keiman jong nangho kangailut nahiuve; kangailutna-a hin um jingun.
target: “As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you. Now remain in my love.

source: Keiman ka Pa thupeh ho kanit sohkeija, angailutna kaum bang hin; nanghon kathupeh ho nitleu chun, kangailutna-a naum jing dingu ahi.
target: If you keep my commands, you will remain in my love, just as I have kept my Father’s commands and remain in his love.

source: Kakipana nangho-a aum jingna dingle, nakipanao akimna dinga, hicheng thuhi najah uva kasei ahi.
target: I have told you this so that my joy may be in you and that your joy may be complete.

source: Kathupeh hiche hi ahi, keiman kangailut bangu hin, nangho khatle khat kingailuto cheh-un.
target: My command is this: Love each other as I have loved you.

source: Min ajol agol dinga ahinna apeh sanga ngailut chungnungjo koiman aneipoi.
target: Greater love has no one than this: to lay down one’s life for one’s friends.

source: Kathupeh nabol uva ahile, nangho hi kajol kagol nahiuve.
target: You are my friends if you do what I command.

source: Tukal keiman nangho soh kati lou ding nahitaove; ijeh-inem itile soh chun apakai thilbol ahepoi. Golte kati nahitaove; ijeh-inem itile ka Pa-a kona kajahho jouse aboncha nangho kahetsah soh nahitaove.
target: I no longer call you servants, because a servant does not know his master’s business. Instead, I have called you friends, for everything that I learned from my Father I have made known to you.

source: Nanghon keima neilhenu ahipoi, keima joh-in nangho kalhen doh-a, nacheuva haga nagauva chule nagau aumna dinga kapansah nahiuve; chutia chu ipi hijongle Pa henga kamina nathum chanu chu, aman napeh dingu ahi.
target: You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you so that you might go and bear fruit—fruit that will last—and so that whatever you ask in my name the Father will give you.

source: Nangho khatle khat naki ngailut to chehna dinguva, thupeh hicheng hi kapeh nahiuve.
target: This is my command: Love each other.

source: Vannoi'in nahot ule, nangho nahot masang uva keima eihot chu naheuve.
target: “If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated me first.

source: Nangho vannoi'a hileu chun vannoi'in ama-a chu angailut ding ahi; hinlah tun nangho vannoi'a nahi louvu, vannoi'a kona keiman kalhendoh nahiuvin, hiche jeh-a chu vannoi'in nahotnu ahi.
target: If you belonged to the world, it would love you as its own. As it is, you do not belong to the world, but I have chosen you out of the world. That is why the world hates you.

source: Najah uva, Soh apakai sangin achungnung jopoi, tia kathusei chu geldoh-un. Amahon keima eibolset nule, nangho jong nabolset dingu ahi; kathu nitleu, nangho thu jong anit dingu ahi.
target: Remember what I told you: ‘A servant is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted me, they will persecute you also. If they obeyed my teaching, they will obey yours also.

source: Ahin amahon eisolpa ahetlou jeh uva chu, thil hicheng hi keima min jala nachung uva ahinbol dingu ahi, .
target: They will treat you this way because of my name, for they do not know the one who sent me.

source: Keima kahunga ajah uva thu kahung sei lou hile, chonset anei lou dingu ahin; tuvangin achonset apaomea akilepna dingu aumtapoi.
target: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

source: Keima eihoa chun ka Pa jong ahot ahi.
target: Whoever hates me hates my Father as well.

source: Keiman alah uva mi koima dangin abol khah lou thil kabol lou hile, chonset anei lou dingu ahin; tuvangin amahon keima le ka Pa kakop lhonin eimutaovin, ho jong eiho taove.
target: If I had not done among them the works no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin. As it is, they have seen, and yet they have hated both me and my Father.

source: Ahoi hijongle adanthubu uva, Ajeh beijin eihove, tia kisun chu guilhuna dinga abolu ahi.
target: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated me without reason.’

source: Ahin keiman Pa koma kona kahinsol ding Lhamonsah, Pa-a kona hungpotdoh Lhagao Theng chu ahungteng, Ama chun keima thudol ahettohsah ding;
target: “When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who goes out from the Father—he will testify about me.

source: Chule nangho jong atila pat kaumpi jing nahi jeh uva chu, kathu hettohsah-a napan dingu ahi.
target: And you also must testify, for you have been with me from the beginning.

source: Nakipal lhuh louna dinguva, thu hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve.
target: “All this I have told you so that you will not fall away.

source: Amahon kikhopna-a kona nahin kaidoh dingu; koihile nathat chanu chu Pathen dinga napha tonga kingaito ding phat chu hung lhung ding ahi.
target: They will put you out of the synagogue; in fact, the time is coming when anyone who kills you will think they are offering a service to God.

source: Amahon Pa le keima eihet loujeh uva, thil hicheng chu nangho chunga aboldingu ahi.
target: They will do such things because they have not known the Father or me.

source: Ahivangin hitiho phat chu ahung lhun tengle, keimatah-in kaseipehsa chengseu hi nageldohna dinguva, thu hicheng hi kaseipeh nahiuve. Keiman nangho kaumpi jeh uva, atila chu kanasei lou ahi.
target: I have told you this, so that when their time comes you will remember that I warned you about them. I did not tell you this from the beginning because I was with you,

source: Tuvanga eihinsolpa henga kache ding ahitai; ahivangin, Hoija nache dingham? tin koiman neidong pouve.
target: but now I am going to him who sent me. None of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’

source: Ahin thu hicheng chu kasei jeh-in, nalungu lunghem adimjotai.
target: Rather, you are filled with grief because I have said these things.

source: Hijongle keiman nangho thutahbeh kaseipeh nahiuve; kache dinghi nangho dinga phajo ahi; ijeh-inem itile keima kache loule Lhamonsah chu naheng uva hung lou ding ahi; kache vangle, keiman ama chu naheng uva kahinsol ding ahi.
target: But very truly I tell you, it is for your good that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.

source: Chule Ama chu ahung teng, vannoi mitehi chonset thudol, chonphat thudol, chule thutan thudola themmo achan aphotchet ding ahi:
target: When he comes, he will prove the world to be in the wrong about sin and righteousness and judgment:
