source: Chonset thudola athemo naochu, ajehchu amahon keima eitahsan pouve;
target: about sin, because people do not believe in me;

source: Chonphat thudola athemo naochu, ajehchu keima ka Pa henga che ding kahin, chule nanghon keima neimulou dingu ahitai;
target: about righteousness, because I am going to the Father, where you can see me no longer;

source: Chule thutan thudola athemo naochu, ajehchu hiche vannoi pipupa thu kitana ahitai.
target: and about judgment, because the prince of this world now stands condemned.

source: Nangho jah-a sei ding thu tamtah kaneije, hijongle tun nadol joupouve.
target: “I have much more to say to you, more than you can now bear.

source: Thutah Lhagao chu ahung teng vangle, ama chun thutah lam jouse-a nangho napuihoi dingu ahi; ijeh-inem itile aman achama asei lou ding, ajah chan asei dingbou ahi; chule aman khonung thil hunglhung dingho namusah dingu ahi.
target: But when he, the Spirit of truth, comes, he will guide you into all the truth. He will not speak on his own; he will speak only what he hears, and he will tell you what is yet to come.

source: Ama chun keima eichoi-at ding ahi; ijeh inem itile aman keima-a um chengse chu alah-a, chule nangho nahetsah dingu ahi.
target: He will glorify me because it is from me that he will receive what he will make known to you.

source: Pa nei chengse chu aboncha keija ahin; hiche jeh-a chu, Aman keima-a um chengse chu alah-a, nangho nahetsah dingu ahi, tia kasei ahi.
target: All that belongs to the Father is mine. That is why I said the Spirit will receive from me what he will make known to you.”

source: Chomkhat joule nanghon keima neimulou dingu ahitai; chule chomcha khat joule neimukit dingu ahi, ajeh chu Pa koma cheding kahi, ati.
target: Jesus went on to say, “In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me.”

source: Hichea chun aseijuiho khatle khat akihouvun, Chomkhat joule neimu lou dingu; chule chomcha khat joule neimu kit dingu; chule, ijeh-inem itile keima Pa henga che ding kahi ati hi ipi eiseipeh-u hintem? akitiuve.
target: At this, some of his disciples said to one another, “What does he mean by saying, ‘In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me,’ and ‘Because I am going to the Father’ ?”

source: Hijeh chun amahon, Chomcha khat jou, ati hiche hi ipi ati naham? ipi asei ahi ihepouve, atiuve.
target: They kept asking, “What does he mean by ‘a little while’ ? We don’t understand what he is saying.”

source: Adoh nomu chu Jesu'n ahen, ajah uva, Chomcha khat joule neimu lou dingu, chomcha khat joule neimu kit dingu, kati chu itidol ahi khatle khat kidongtoa nahiuvem?
target: Jesus saw that they wanted to ask him about this, so he said to them, “Are you asking one another what I meant when I said, ‘In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me’?

source: Keiman nangho tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Nangho nakauva chule namao dingu, vannoi mite vang kipah ding ahiuve; nangho nalunghem dingu, ahivanga nalunghemnau chu kipana hung sohdoh ding ahi.
target: Very truly I tell you, you will weep and mourn while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.

source: Numei naoso natnin aphah tengle alunghem lhehji-e, ajeh chu aphat hunglhunga ahitai: ahin acha chu asolhah teng vangle, vannoi'a mihem khat apen jeh chun akipahjin, alungdon hesoh chu aheji tapoi.
target: A woman giving birth to a child has pain because her time has come; but when her baby is born she forgets the anguish because of her joy that a child is born into the world.

source: Hiche banga chu nangho jong tu-a nalunghemu ahi; ahivangin keiman nangho kamukit ding nahiuve, chutengle nalungu kipah ding, chule hiche nakipanao chu koiman nalahpeh lou dingu ahi.
target: So with you: Now is your time of grief, but I will see you again and you will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.

source: Hiche nikho chule keima imacha neidoh lou dingu ahi. Keiman nangho tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Pa henga ipihile keima mina nathum channu chu, aman napeh dingu ahi.
target: In that day you will no longer ask me anything. Very truly I tell you, my Father will give you whatever you ask in my name.

source: Tu geihin nanghon kaminin ima nathum hihlai juve; nakipanao suhchamkima aumna dingin, thumun chutile namu dingu ahi.
target: Until now you have not asked for anything in my name. Ask and you will receive, and your joy will be complete.

source: Thu hicheng hi keiman nangho jah-a alema kasei ahi; alema sei louva, phongtah-a nangho Pa thu kahetsahna dingu phat hung lhung ding ahi.
target: “Though I have been speaking figuratively, a time is coming when I will no longer use this kind of language but will tell you plainly about my Father.

source: Hiche ni chule kamina nathum dingu ahi; chule nangho dingin keima Pa henga taovinge, kati ahipoi;
target: In that day you will ask in my name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Pa amatah-in nangho nangailu uve, ajehchu nanghon keima neingailuvin, chule keima Pathen na kona hung kahi natahsan taovin ahi.
target: No, the Father himself loves you because you have loved me and have believed that I came from God.

source: Keima Pa koma kona vannoi'a hunga kahin; avela, vannoi kadalhah-a Pa henga che kit ding kahi, ati.
target: I came from the Father and entered the world; now I am leaving the world and going back to the Father.”

source: Chutah-in aseijuiten, Ven, nangman tun thu alema seita louvin, phongtah-in naseije.
target: Then Jesus’ disciples said, “Now you are speaking clearly and without figures of speech.

source: Nangman ijakai nahesoh-in, chule mi koimachan nangma nadoh ding chu nangaipoi, ti tun kahe taove. Hichea kon hin nangma Pathen koma kona hung nahi ti katahsanui, atiuve.
target: Now we can see that you know all things and that you do not even need to have anyone ask you questions. This makes us believe that you came from God.”

source: Jesu'n amaho chu adonbutnin, Tuabou natahsan um?
target: “Do you now believe?” Jesus replied.

source: Veuvin, nangho nangma nangma-a cheh-a navacheh sohkeijuva, keima kachanga neidalhah dingu phat ahung lhunge, henge, ahung lhungtai; ahivangin keima kachang kahipoi, ijeh-inem itile Pan keima eiumpinai.
target: “A time is coming and in fact has come when you will be scattered, each to your own home. You will leave me all alone. Yet I am not alone, for my Father is with me.

source: Nanghon keija lungmonna namu theina dinguva, thu hicheng hi najah uva kasei ahi. Vannoi'a hesoh gentheina nanei dingu ahi; ahivangin kipah-un; keiman vannoi kajoutai, ati.
target: “I have told you these things, so that in me you may have peace. In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.”

source: Jesu'n thu hiche chu aseijin, van lam ave, Pa, phat chu ahung lhungtai; Na Chapan jong nangma nachoi-at theina dingin, na chapa choi-anin;
target: After Jesus said this, he looked toward heaven and prayed: “Father, the hour has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may glorify you.

source: Nangman ama napeh ho jouse chu, aboncha aman tonsot hinna apeh dinga, nangman ama chu mi jouse chunga thuneina napeh ahi.
target: For you granted him authority over all people that he might give eternal life to all those you have given him.

source: Pathen tahbeh khatseh nangma, chule nangman nasol Jesu Khrista ahetdoh dingu hi, tonsot hinna ahi.
target: Now this is eternal life: that they know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom you have sent.

source: Nangman bol dinga thil neipeh chu kajouvin, leiset chungah nangma kachoi-an tai.
target: I have brought you glory on earth by finishing the work you gave me to do.

source: Chule tun, Pa, vannoi um masanga nangma toh kaneikhom loupina-a chun, nangma tahtoh kigomin neichoi-anin.
target: And now, Father, glorify me in your presence with the glory I had with you before the world began.

source: Nangman vannoi'a kona neipeh miho jah-a namin kaphon ahitai; amaho nanga ahiuvin, nangin amaho chu keima neipeh ahi; chule amahon nathu anit taove.
target: “I have revealed you to those whom you gave me out of the world. They were yours; you gave them to me and they have obeyed your word.

source: Tun amahon nangman keima neipeh thil chengse hi nanga kon ahi ahetauve.
target: Now they know that everything you have given me comes from you.

source: Ijeh-inem itile nangman keima neipeh thuho chu keiman amaho kapen; chule amahon hitiho chu asangun, chule keima nanga kona hung kahi kichenin aheuvin, chule nangma sol kahi atahsan taove.
target: For I gave them the words you gave me and they accepted them. They knew with certainty that I came from you, and they believed that you sent me.

source: Amaho dinga katao ahi. Vannoi dinga katao ahipoi, ahin nangman keima neipeh ho dinga bou katao ahi, ijeh-inem itile amaho nanga ahiuve.
target: I pray for them. I am not praying for the world, but for those you have given me, for they are yours.

source: Chule keija jouse chu nanga ahin, nanga chu keija ahi; chule amaho-a hin choi-atnin kaume.
target: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine. And glory has come to me through them.

source: Chule tu-a hi keima vannoi'a hi umlouva kahitai, amaho vanghi vannoi'a aumna laijuve, chule keima nahenga hung kahitai. Ka Pa Theng, eini pumkhat ihi banga, amaho jong pumkhat ahi theina dingun, nangman neipeh chengse hi, naminin hongin.
target: I will remain in the world no longer, but they are still in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, protect them by the power of your name, the name you gave me, so that they may be one as we are one.

source: Keima amahotoh vannoi'a kaum lai chun, namina amaho chu kanahon ahi; nangman neipeh chengse chu kahong bitnin, khatcha jong amangthah aumpoi; Pathen lekhabua thu guilhunan, mangthah chapa bouchu amangthah tai.
target: While I was with them, I protected them and kept them safe by that name you gave me. None has been lost except the one doomed to destruction so that Scripture would be fulfilled.

source: Tu vangin nahenga hung kahitai; chule kakipana amahon aneikim nadinguva, vannoi'a hiche thuhi kasei ahi.
target: “I am coming to you now, but I say these things while I am still in the world, so that they may have the full measure of my joy within them.

source: Keiman nathu amaho kapetai; chule keima vannoi'a kahilou banga amaho jong vannoi'a ahilou jeh-un, vannoi miten ahotauve.
target: I have given them your word and the world has hated them, for they are not of the world any more than I am of the world.

source: Nangman amaho hi vannoi'a konin ladoh-in tia katao ahipoi, agilouva kona nahuhdoh nadinga katao joh ahibouve.
target: My prayer is not that you take them out of the world but that you protect them from the evil one.

source: Keima vannoi'a kahilou bangin, amaho jong vannoi'a ahipouve.
target: They are not of the world, even as I am not of it.

source: Na Thutah chun amaho hi suthengin; nangma thu chu thutah ahi.
target: Sanctify them by the truth; your word is truth.

source: Nangman keima vannoi'a neisol banga, keiman jong amaho hi vannoi'a kasol ahi.
target: As you sent me into the world, I have sent them into the world.

source: Chule amaho hi thutah-a suhthenga aum theina dinguva, amaho jala keima kakisuhtheng ahi.
target: For them I sanctify myself, that they too may be truly sanctified.

source: Hitiho chang jeng dinga tao kahipoi, amaho thua kona keima eihin tahsan ding ho jouse dinga jong katao ahi;
target: “My prayer is not for them alone. I pray also for those who will believe in me through their message,

source: Pa, keima nangma sol kahi hi vannoi miten atahsan theina dinguva; nangma keija na-uma, keima nanga kaum banga hi, amaho jong eini-a aum theina dinga katao ahi.
target: that all of them may be one, Father, just as you are in me and I am in you. May they also be in us so that the world may believe that you have sent me.

source: Chule eini pumkhat ihi banga, amaho jong pumkhat ahi nadingun; nangman keima neipeh loupina chu, keiman amaho kapetai.
target: I have given them the glory that you gave me, that they may be one as we are one—

source: Amaho chamkimtah-a pumkhat ahina dinguva, Keima amaho-a kauma, chule nangma keima-a na-uma; chule keima hi nangman neisola, keima nei nangailut banga amaho jong nangailut ahi ti vannoi'in ahetna dinga katao ahi.
target: I in them and you in me—so that they may be brought to complete unity. Then the world will know that you sent me and have loved them even as you have loved me.

source: Pa, nangman neipeh loupina chu, nangin neipehho hin amu theina dingun, keima umna-a chun kakoma amaho jong umleu kati ahi; ijeh inem itile vannoi bul kiphudoh masanga nangman neingailut ahitai.
target: “Father, I want those you have given me to be with me where I am, and to see my glory, the glory you have given me because you loved me before the creation of the world.

source: Vo ka Pa chondihtah, vannoi miten nangma nahepouvin, kei vangin nangma kahen; chule nangman keima neisol hi, hiteho hin ahetauve.
target: “Righteous Father, though the world does not know you, I know you, and they know that you have sent me.

source: Nangman kei neingailutna ngailut chu amaho-a auma, chule keima jong amaho-a kaumna dinga; namin amaho hi kahetsah ahitan, chule kahetsah kit jing ding ahi, ati.
target: I have made you known to them, and will continue to make you known in order that the love you have for me may be in them and that I myself may be in them.”

source: Jesu'n thu hicheng chu asei jouvin, aseijuiho toh apotdoh-in, Kidron vadung gal lama hon umna-a chun agalkaijun, chuin hon sunga chun amale aseijuiho alut taove.
target: When he had finished praying, Jesus left with his disciples and crossed the Kidron Valley. On the other side there was a garden, and he and his disciples went into it.

source: Ama matsah-a pang Judas jong chun hiche kom mun chu ahet ahi; ijeh-inem itile Jesu'n aseijuite apuijia hikoma chu tamtah vei chejiuva ahi.
target: Now Judas, who betrayed him, knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with his disciples.

source: Chutah-in Judas'in sepaihon chule thempu pipuiho leh Pharisai ho-a kona sottolleho aloijin, meivah, meisel, chule hem manchah athouvin, hiche kom mun chu alhung taove.
target: So Judas came to the garden, guiding a detachment of soldiers and some officials from the chief priests and the Pharisees. They were carrying torches, lanterns and weapons.

source: Hichun achunga ipi ahung so ding Jesu'n abonchan ahen, apotdoh-in, amaho jah-a chun, Koi naholu ham? tin agadongin ahi.
target: Jesus, knowing all that was going to happen to him, went out and asked them, “Who is it you want?”

source: Amahon adonbutnun, Nazareth Jesu atiuve. Jesu'n ajah uva, Keima hi kahi, ati. Ama matsah-a pang Judas jong chu amaho lah-a chu dinga ahi.
target: “Jesus of Nazareth,” they replied. “I am he,” Jesus said. (And Judas the traitor was standing there with them.)

source: Hitia chu aman ajah uva, Keima hi kahi, ati chun, amaho anung chonun tolah alhu jengun ahi.
target: When Jesus said, “I am he,” they drew back and fell to the ground.

source: Chuin aman adong kitleuvin, Nanghon koi naholu ham? ati. Amahon, Nazareth Jesu, atiuve.
target: Again he asked them, “Who is it you want?” “Jesus of Nazareth,” they said.

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Keima hi kahi, tia najah uva kaseitah chula em; hijeh chun keima neiholu ahile hiteho hi chesah-un, ati.
target: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If you are looking for me, then let these men go.”

source: Nangman keima neipeh chengse khatcha jong kamansahpoi, tia asei chu guilhuna dinga chutia ahi.
target: This happened so that the words he had spoken would be fulfilled: “I have not lost one of those you gave me.”

source: Hichun Simon Peter'in chemjam khat anei ahin, asatdoh-in, thempu chungnung sohpa asatnin ahile, ajetlam bilkol asatlhan ahi. Sohpa min chu Malchus ahi.
target: Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, drew it and struck the high priest’s servant, cutting off his right ear. (The servant’s name was Malchus.)

source: Chuin Jesu'n Peter jah-a, Chemjam chu apaija khumin. Pan eipeh khona chu kadon lou dingham? ati.
target: Jesus commanded Peter, “Put your sword away! Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given me?”

source: Chuin sepaihon le apipuipau toh chule Judah ho sottollehon Jesu amanun akanun,
target: Then the detachment of soldiers with its commander and the Jewish officials arrested Jesus. They bound him

source: Anna henga apui masaove; ijeh-inem itile chuche kum-a thempu chungnunga pang Caiaphas nupapa ahi.
target: and brought him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.

source: Miho jouse dinga mi khat athi aphajoi, tia Judah ho thumop chu hiche Caiaphas hi ahi.
target: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jewish leaders that it would be good if one man died for the people.

source: Chuin Simon Peter'in Jesu nung ajuijin, chutobang chun aseijui dang khatnin jong ajuije. Chuche seijui chu thempu chungnung chutoh kihe-a ahin, Jesu toh thakhatnin thempu chungnung inpi tolah alut lhontan ahi.
target: Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. Because this disciple was known to the high priest, he went with Jesus into the high priest’s courtyard,

source: Peter vang chu kotpo lama adingin ahi. Chuin thempu chungnung toh kihe-a seijui chu ahung potnin, kot ngahnu jah-a chun aseijin, Peter chu asungah apuilut tai.
target: but Peter had to wait outside at the door. The other disciple, who was known to the high priest, came back, spoke to the servant girl on duty there and brought Peter in.

source: Hichun hiche kot ngah nungahnu chun Peter jah-a, Nang jong hichepa seijui ho lah-a khat nahi hilouham? atile aman, Kahipoi, atitai.
target: “You aren’t one of this man’s disciples too, are you?” she asked Peter. He replied, “I am not.”

source: Chule hiche koma chu soh ho le sottolleho chu dinguva, adap jeh-a meihol akitiuva, kisang lumu ahi; Chuin Peter jong amaho to adingin, mei chu a-oijin ahi.
target: It was cold, and the servants and officials stood around a fire they had made to keep warm. Peter also was standing with them, warming himself.

source: Hichun thempu chungnung chun Jesu chu aseijuiho le athuhil thudol adongtan ahi.
target: Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and his teaching.

source: Jesu'n ama adonbutnin, Keiman vannoi mite anga phongtah-a kasei anahitan; keiman Judah ho kikhop khomji namun kikhopna inho le houin'a jenga jong kanahil jingpeh ahi; guhthima kasei aumpoi.
target: “I have spoken openly to the world,” Jesus replied. “I always taught in synagogues or at the temple, where all the Jews come together. I said nothing in secret.

source: Ibola keima neidoh ham? Ajah uva ipi kasei aja-a amaho chu dongtan; ven, ipi thu kasei amahon ahenauve, ati.
target: Why question me? Ask those who heard me. Surely they know what I said.”

source: Aman thu hicheng chu aseijouvin, akoma ding sottolleho lah-a khatnin Jesu chu akhutphanga angeiphe abengin, Thempu chungnung hitia chu kidonbut ngaijem? ati.
target: When Jesus said this, one of the officials nearby slapped him in the face. “Is this the way you answer the high priest?” he demanded.

source: Jesu'n ama chu adonbutnin, Thu gilou kasei ahile, kathusei gilou aphotchenna neihetsah-in; thupha kasei ahile, ibola neiden ham? ati.
target: “If I said something wrong,” Jesus replied, “testify as to what is wrong. But if I spoke the truth, why did you strike me?”

source: Chuin Annan ama chu akikan pumin Caiaphas thempu chungnung hengah asoltai.
target: Then Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.

source: Hichea chu Simon Peter'in dinmuna mei a-oi ahin; chuin amahon, Nangma jong aseijuiho lah-a khat nahim? tin adongun ahile, ama akilepmin, Kahipoi, ati.
target: Meanwhile, Simon Peter was still standing there warming himself. So they asked him, “You aren’t one of his disciples too, are you?” He denied it, saying, “I am not.”

source: Thempu chungnung soh ho lah-a mikhat, Peter'in abilkol asatlhah pehpa inko khatnin ajah-a, Keiman hona chu nangma amatoh kamu hilou nahim? ati.
target: One of the high priest’s servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, challenged him, “Didn’t I see you with him in the garden?”

source: Peter akilep kit tai. Chuin chupet tah chun ahchal akhongtan ahi.
target: Again Peter denied it, and at that moment a rooster began to crow.

source: Chuin amahon Jesu chu Caiaphas in'a konin thutanna in lama akaitaove; hichu jingkah matah ahin; ahivangin kalchuh kut an aneh theina dinguva, akisuhboh louna dingun, thutanna in'a chun amaho alutpouve.
target: Then the Jewish leaders took Jesus from Caiaphas to the palace of the Roman governor. By now it was early morning, and to avoid ceremonial uncleanness they did not enter the palace, because they wanted to be able to eat the Passover.

source: Hijeh chun Pilate apotdoh-in, amaho chu adongin, Hichepa hehna-a achunga ipi thu naneijum? ati.
target: So Pilate came out to them and asked, “What charges are you bringing against this man?”

source: Amahon adonbutnun, ajah-a, Ama hi khangse lou hile nangma khutna pedoh pouvinge, atiuve.
target: “If he were not a criminal,” they replied, “we would not have handed him over to you.”

source: Chuin Pilate'in ajah uva, Nanghon ama hi puijun lang, nangho dan ngaijin athu tantaovin, ati. Judah hon adonbutnun, Keiho dinga mi thading chu dan ngai ahipoi, atiuve.
target: Pilate said, “Take him yourselves and judge him by your own law.” “But we have no right to execute anyone,” they objected.

source: Ama iti thia athi ding thudol Jesu'n asei chu guilhuna dinga chutia ahi.
target: This took place to fulfill what Jesus had said about the kind of death he was going to die.

source: Hiche chun Pilate thutanna in sungah alut kitnin, Jesu akouvin ajah-a, Nangma Judah te lengpa nahim? ati.
target: Pilate then went back inside the palace, summoned Jesus and asked him, “Are you the king of the Jews?”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Hichu nangman nachama naseiha, ole mi khattouvin keima thudol naseipeh ham? ati.
target: “Is that your own idea,” Jesus asked, “or did others talk to you about me?”

source: Pilate'in adonbutnin, Keima Judah mi kahim? Nanam mite le thempu pipuihon kakhutna eipehdoh nahi chu; ipi nabolset baham? ati.
target: “Am I a Jew?” Pilate replied. “Your own people and chief priests handed you over to me. What is it you have done?”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Keima kagam hiche vannoi hi ahipoi; ka lenggam hiche vannoi hi hile, Judah ho khutna eikipehdoh louna dinga kasohten asat dingu ahi; ahinla tun kalenggam hi hichea kon ahipoi, ati.
target: Jesus said, “My kingdom is not of this world. If it were, my servants would fight to prevent my arrest by the Jewish leaders. But now my kingdom is from another place.”

source: Chuin Pilate'in, Ahile nangma leng nahim? ati. Jesu'n adonbutnin, Leng kahi chu naseikhai. Thutah thu hettohsah dinga hiche dinga hi hung penga, hiche dinga hi vannoi'a hunga kahi. Thutah he chan chun ka-aw angaije, ati.
target: “You are a king, then!” said Pilate. Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. In fact, the reason I was born and came into the world is to testify to the truth. Everyone on the side of truth listens to me.”

source: Pilate'in ajah-a, Ipiham thutah chu, ati. Chuin hiche chu aseijin, Judah ho henga chun agapotdoh kitnin, ajah uva, Achungah themona kamudoh hihhele.
target: “What is truth?” retorted Pilate. With this he went out again to the Jews gathered there and said, “I find no basis for a charge against him.

source: Ahivangin nanghon kalchuh kut tengle mikhat kalhadohpeh dingu chonna ngai khat naneijui; hijeh chun Judah Lengpa hi lhadohpeh leuveng nalungu ham? ati.
target: But it is your custom for me to release to you one prisoner at the time of the Passover. Do you want me to release ‘the king of the Jews’?”

source: Chutah chun amahon, Hichepa hihih hen, Barabbas joh hihen, tin asamtauve. Barabbas chu gucha michom ahi.
target: They shouted back, “No, not him! Give us Barabbas!” Now Barabbas had taken part in an uprising.

source: Chutah-in Pilate'in Jesu alan, ajeptai.
target: Then Pilate took Jesus and had him flogged.

source: Chuin sepaihon ling lukhuh aphanun, alua akhuhpeh-un, chule ponsandup asilpeh-un,
target: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on his head. They clothed him in a purple robe

source: Chuin akoma ahungun, Chibai, Judah te Lengpa! atiuvin akhutnuva adengpan taovin ahi.
target: and went up to him again and again, saying, “Hail, king of the Jews!” And they slapped him in the face.

source: Chuin Pilate agapot kitleuvin, ajah uva, Veuvin, akhan gitlouna ima kamu lou nahetna dinguva, ama naheng uva kahin puidoh ahi, ati.
target: Once more Pilate came out and said to the Jews gathered there, “Look, I am bringing him out to you to let you know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”

source: Hiche chun Jesu ling lukhuh khuhle, ponsandup sil pum chun ahung potdoh-in ahi. Chuin Pilate'in ajah uvah, Veuvin mihem hi! ati.
target: When Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, “Here is the man!”

source: Chuin thempu pipuiho le sottolle hon ama chu amutah-un, Thingpel'a khenbeh-in, thingpel'a khenbeh-in! tin asamtauve. Pilate'in, Nanghon kaijun lang thingpel'a khenbeh taovin; ajeh chu keiman akhan gitlouna kamupoi, ati.
target: As soon as the chief priests and their officials saw him, they shouted, “Crucify! Crucify!” But Pilate answered, “You take him and crucify him. As for me, I find no basis for a charge against him.”

source: Judah hon adonbutnun, Keihon dan khat kaneijun, hiche dan dungjuija chu thi dingdol ahi, ajehchu ama Pathen Chapa akihisah-e, atiuve.
target: The Jewish leaders insisted, “We have a law, and according to that law he must die, because he claimed to be the Son of God.”

source: Pilate'in hiche aseiju chu ajah phat chun, akicha cheh jengtan;
target: When Pilate heard this, he was even more afraid,

source: Thutanna in sungah alut kitnin, Jesu jah-a, Nangma hoija kon nahim? ati. Ahivangin Jesu'n iman adonbutpoi.
target: and he went back inside the palace. “Where do you come from?” he asked Jesus, but Jesus gave him no answer.

source: Hijeh chun Pilate'in ajah-a, Neihou lou dingham? Nangma lhadohna ding jong chule thingpel'a khetbehna ding jong thu kanei hi nahet louham? ati.
target: “Do you refuse to speak to me?” Pilate said. “Don’t you realize I have power either to free you or to crucify you?”

source: Jesu'n adonbutnin, Chunga kona kipe lou hile chun, nangman kachunga thuneina himhim nanei lou ahi; hijeh chun nakhutna eipedohpa chonsetna achung nunge, ati.
target: Jesus answered, “You would have no power over me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed me over to you is guilty of a greater sin.”

source: Hichea pat chun Pilate'in ama chu lhadoh ding agotan ahi. Ahinla Judah hon asamun, Nangman mipa hi nalhadohle Caesar jol nahilou ahi; amale ama lenga kisem chan chu Caesar douna thusei ahi, atiuve.
target: From then on, Pilate tried to set Jesus free, but the Jewish leaders kept shouting, “If you let this man go, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who claims to be a king opposes Caesar.”

source: Pilate'in thu chucheng ajah phat chun, Jesu chu ahin puidoh-in, chuin Songlhongnal atiu Hebrai paova Gabatha, atiu thutanna mun'a chun atoutan ahi.
target: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judge’s seat at a place known as the Stone Pavement (which in Aramaic is Gabbatha).

source: Hichu kalchuh kut dinga kigot ni, nidan gup dontah ahi. Chuin Judah ho jah-a, Veuvin, Nalengpau hi! ati.
target: It was the day of Preparation of the Passover; it was about noon. “Here is your king,” Pilate said to the Jews.

source: Ahivangin amahon asamuvin, Sumangin, sumangin thingpelah khenbeh-in! atiuvin ahi. Pilate'in ajah uva, Nalengpau thingpel'a kakhetbeh dingham? ati. Hichun thempu pipuihon adonbutnun, Keihon, Caesar tailou leng kaneipouve, atiuvin ahi.
target: But they shouted, “Take him away! Take him away! Crucify him!” “Shall I crucify your king?” Pilate asked. “We have no king but Caesar,” the chief priests answered.

source: Chutah-in aman ama chu thingpel'a khetbeh dingin akhutnuvah apedohtai. Chule amahon Jesu chu akaijun apuimang taovin ahi.
target: Finally Pilate handed him over to them to be crucified. So the soldiers took charge of Jesus.

source: Chuin athingpel akiputnin Lugu mun atiu, Hebrai paova Golgotha atiu, mun chu jonin achedoh tan ahi.
target: Carrying his own cross, he went out to the place of the Skull (which in Aramaic is called Golgotha).

source: Hikoma chun ama thingpelah akhenbeh-un, chule mi ni asih langto gelah amatoh akhetbeh thaovin, Jesu chu alailhai.
target: There they crucified him, and with him two others—one on each side and Jesus in the middle.

source: Chuin Pilate'in aminchan lekhan asunin, thingpel leh-a chun atah-in ahi. Chule akisun chu, NAZARETH JESU, JUDAH TE LENGPA ti ahi.
target: Pilate had a notice prepared and fastened to the cross. It read: jesus of nazareth, the king of the jews .

source: Jesu thingpel'a kikhetbeh na mun chu khopi nai ahi jeh chun, hiche min kisun chu Judah ho tamtah-in asimun; hichu Hebrew paotoh, Latin paotoh, chule Greek paova kisun ahi.
target: Many of the Jews read this sign, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and the sign was written in Aramaic, Latin and Greek.

source: Hijeh chun Judah thempu pipuihon Pilate jah-a, Judah te Lengpa tin sun hih-in, Aman, Keima Judah te lengpa kahi ati, tin sunbovin atiuve.
target: The chief priests of the Jews protested to Pilate, “Do not write ‘The King of the Jews,’ but that this man claimed to be king of the Jews.”

source: Pilate'in adonbutnin, Kasutsa chu kasutsa ahitai, ati.
target: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”

source: Chuin sepaihon Jesu chu thingpel'a akhetbeh jouvun, aponsil alauvin, hal li asouvin, sepai khat chu khat hal khat cheh achangui; chule asangkhol jong chu alauvin ahi. Asangkhol chu khui lou ahin, alua pat ato geija kikhong lhungkei ahi.
target: When the soldiers crucified Jesus, they took his clothes, dividing them into four shares, one for each of them, with the undergarment remaining. This garment was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.

source: Hijeh chun khatle khat akihouvun, Hiche hi botsepou hite, koipen changam vang kiveuhite, akitiuve. Pathen lekha bu thua kisei, Kaponsil akihomun, Kasangkhol avangpha pha changhen tin vang asantauve, ti chu guilhuna dinga, sepaihon hitia chu abolu ahi.
target: “Let’s not tear it,” they said to one another. “Let’s decide by lot who will get it.” This happened that the scripture might be fulfilled that said, “They divided my clothes among them and cast lots for my garment.” So this is what the soldiers did.

source: Tun Jesu thingpel koma chun anutoh anu sopinu, Cleopas inneipi Mariam, chule Mariam Magdalene adingun ahi.
target: Near the cross of Jesus stood his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

source: Chuin Jesu'n anu le aman angailut aseijui chu akoma adin amu phat chun, anu jah-a, Numei, ven, nachapa chu, ati.
target: When Jesus saw his mother there, and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to her, “Woman, here is your son,”

source: Chuin aseijui jah-a ma chun, Ven, nanu chu, ati. Chuin hiche-a pat chun seijui chun anu chu ama in'ah apuitai.
target: and to the disciple, “Here is your mother.” From that time on, this disciple took her into his home.

source: Hiche jou chun Jesu'n thil ijakai akichai soh chu ahen, Pathen lekhabua thu chu guilhunsoh theinan, Kadang achah-e, ati.
target: Later, knowing that everything had now been finished, and so that Scripture would be fulfilled, Jesus said, “I am thirsty.”

source: Chukoma chu bel khatna theitwi thuh kitung ahin, chuin twichop pon theitwi thuh dimsetnin, hyssop mol leh-a atah-un, akamtoh agah sutouvin ahi.
target: A jar of wine vinegar was there, so they soaked a sponge in it, put the sponge on a stalk of the hyssop plant, and lifted it to Jesus’ lips.

source: Chuin Jesu'n theitwi thuh chu adonin, Akichaitai, ati. Chuin akaikun alhagao alhadohtan ahi.
target: When he had received the drink, Jesus said, “It is finished.” With that, he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

source: Chuin kigin ni ahi jeh chun, cholngah ni-a thilongho chu thingpel'a aumden louna dingin, (ijeh inem itile hiche cholngah ni chu niloupi ni ahi,) Judah hon Pilate henga akeng gaheboh dingle, along galah mangna dingin athumun ahi.
target: Now it was the day of Preparation, and the next day was to be a special Sabbath. Because the Jewish leaders did not want the bodies left on the crosses during the Sabbath, they asked Pilate to have the legs broken and the bodies taken down.

source: Hichun sepaiho chu ahungun, akikhet behpi amasapa kengle khatpa keng chu aheh bongui.
target: The soldiers therefore came and broke the legs of the first man who had been crucified with Jesus, and then those of the other.

source: Ahin Jesu kom ahung geijun, athisa anahitah chu amuvin, akeng ahehbong tapouve.
target: But when they came to Jesus and found that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.

source: Ahi vangin sepaiho lah-a tengcha choi khat chun atengin anah agahsunin ahile, chua chun thisan le twisih ahung longlha paijen jengin ahi.
target: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced Jesus’ side with a spear, bringing a sudden flow of blood and water.

source: Chule amupa tah chun ahettohsah ahin, chule ama thu hettohsah chu tahbeh ahi: chule aman atahbeh asei ahi chu ahei; nanghon jong natahsan theina dinguva, ahi.
target: The man who saw it has given testimony, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, and he testifies so that you also may believe.

source: Pathen lekhabua, Agu khatcha jong kihehbong lou ding, ati chu guilhuna dinga, thil hicheng chu soh-a ahitai.
target: These things happened so that the scripture would be fulfilled: “Not one of his bones will be broken,”

source: Pathen lekhabu thu dangman, Amahon asutpao chu avet dingu ahi, ati.
target: and, as another scripture says, “They will look on the one they have pierced.”

source: Chuin hicheng jou chun Arimathea khomi Joseph, Judah ho gina guhthima Jesu seijui hia chun, Jesu long chu pohdoh dingin Pilate henga agathumin ahile, Pilate'in anaphal pehtai. Hijeh chun ama ahungin, Jesu long chu ahung ladohtai.
target: Later, Joseph of Arimathea asked Pilate for the body of Jesus. Now Joseph was a disciple of Jesus, but secretly because he feared the Jewish leaders. With Pilate’s permission, he came and took the body away.

source: Chuin Nicodemus, atila jana Jesu henga hunga chun, myrrh le aloes kihal ser somnga tobang ahinchoijin ahungin ahi.
target: He was accompanied by Nicodemus, the man who earlier had visited Jesus at night. Nicodemus brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.

source: Chuti chun amahon Jesu long chu alauvin, Judah ho kivui ngai bangin, lounamtui toh tupat ponnemin atomtaovin ahi.
target: Taking Jesus’ body, the two of them wrapped it, with the spices, in strips of linen. This was in accordance with Jewish burial customs.

source: Chule thingpel'a akhetbehnao mun'a chu hon khat uma ahin; hona chu koima lupsahna khah louhel lhan thah khat uma ahi.
target: At the place where Jesus was crucified, there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb, in which no one had ever been laid.

source: Hijeh chun Judah ho kigin ni ahi jeh chun, chukoma chun Jesu chu alupsah taove; ijeh inem itile lhan chu akomcha-a uma ahi.
target: Because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and since the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus there.

source: Chuin hapta nikho masa ni jingpin, kho athimna laijin, Mariam Magdalene chu lhana chun agachen ahile, song chu lhana kona tahdohsa aum agamui.
target: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.

source: Hiche chun amanu Simon Peter le seijui dang, Jesu'n angailut henga chun, alhaijelin, ajah lhona, Pakai chu lhana konin apomang taove, chule hoija alupsah-u kahepouve, ati.
target: So she came running to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one Jesus loved, and said, “They have taken the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have put him!”

source: Hiche jeh chun Peter achedoh-in, seijui dangpa jong chu ahi lhonin, lhan lama chun ache lhone.
target: So Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.

source: Hitichun thakhatnin alhai lhonin ahile seijui dang chun Peter akhelin, lhan phung chu alhung masatai.
target: Both were running, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.

source: Chuin akunin asung agahvetle, tupat ponnem ho um chu amun, ahivangin asungah alutpoi.
target: He bent over and looked in at the strips of linen lying there but did not go in.

source: Simon Peter jong hiche chun anung nungah ahungin, chuin lhan sunga chun alutnin, chule tupat ponnem ho aum chu amun,
target: Then Simon Peter came along behind him and went straight into the tomb. He saw the strips of linen lying there,

source: Alu chunga um ultheh pon chu tupat ponnem ho chutoh umtha louva, akijela atuma anaum agamun ahi.
target: as well as the cloth that had been wrapped around Jesus’ head. The cloth was still lying in its place, separate from the linen.

source: Chutah chun seijui dang lhan phung lhung masajopa jong chu alutnin, amun, atahsan tai.
target: Finally the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went inside. He saw and believed.

source: Ajeh iham itile athia kona thoudoh kit ding tia asei, Pathen lekhabu thu chu ahet loulaiju ahi.
target: (They still did not understand from Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead.)

source: Chutichun seijuite ni chu a-in lam gela achemang lhontan ahi.
target: Then the disciples went back to where they were staying.

source: Mariam vang chu lhan pama chun adingin akap kapmin; aka pum chun akunin lhan sung chu agahven ahile,
target: Now Mary stood outside the tomb crying. As she wept, she bent over to look into the tomb

source: Abana bang vantil ni Jesu long alupsah naova chu khat alulhuna atouva, khat akeng todopma atou amui.
target: and saw two angels in white, seated where Jesus’ body had been, one at the head and the other at the foot.

source: Chuin amani chun ajah-a, Numei, ibola nakaham? ati lhonin ahile, amanun ajah lhonah, Ajeh chu ka Pakai apomangun, hoija akoiju kahepoi, ati.
target: They asked her, “Woman, why are you crying?” “They have taken my Lord away,” she said, “and I don’t know where they have put him.”

source: Chutia ati jou chun, akinung heijin ahile Jesu adin amun, Jesu ahi chu ahepoi.
target: At this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, but she did not realize that it was Jesus.

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, Numei, ibola nakaham? koiham nahol? ati. Amanun honbol chun angaiton ajah-a, Pu, hikoma kona napohdoh ahile hoija nakoijem seijin, pomanging kate, ati.
target: He asked her, “Woman, why are you crying? Who is it you are looking for?” Thinking he was the gardener, she said, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have put him, and I will get him.”

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, Mariam ati. Amanu akiheijin, ajah-a, Rabboni ati; hichu houhil tina ahi.
target: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned toward him and cried out in Aramaic, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, Neitongkha hih-in; ijeh-inem itile keima Pa henga chun kakaltou hih laije; ahin chenlang kasopiho jah-a gaseijin, ka Pa, nangho Pa, ka Pathen, nangho Pathen henga kakaltouve, ati.
target: Jesus said, “Do not hold on to me, for I have not yet ascended to the Father. Go instead to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’ ”

source: Mariam Magdalene chu achen, aseijuiho jah-a chun, Pakai chu kamutai, atin, chule ajah-a hiche thu asei jong chu agaseije.
target: Mary Magdalene went to the disciples with the news: “I have seen the Lord!” And she told them that he had said these things to her.

source: Chuin hiche nikho mama nilhah lamin, hapta kipat ni ahito lhonin, aseijuite chu Judah ho gina kot akikha khum petnuvin, Jesu ahungin alah uva ahung dingin, ajah uva, Nachung uvah lungmon umhen, ati.
target: On the evening of that first day of the week, when the disciples were together, with the doors locked for fear of the Jewish leaders, Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you!”

source: Aman hiche chu asei jouvin, amaho chu akhut le anah avetsahtan ahi. Chuin Pakai amu-u chu seijuite chu akipah lheh jengun ahi.
target: After he said this, he showed them his hands and side. The disciples were overjoyed when they saw the Lord.

source: Hijeh chun Jesu'n ajah uva, Nachung uvah lungmon umhen, Pan keima eisol banga keiman nangho kasol nahiuve, ati.
target: Again Jesus said, “Peace be with you! As the Father has sent me, I am sending you.”

source: Chuin aman hiche chu asei jouvin, amaho chu ahu alha khumin, Lhagao Theng changun;
target: And with that he breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.

source: Koi hile achonset nasuhbeiju chu, kisubeija ahi; achonset na-umsah-u chu, akiumsah ahi, ati.
target: If you forgive anyone’s sins, their sins are forgiven; if you do not forgive them, they are not forgiven.”

source: Somleni lah-a khat, Thomas Didymus atiu, vang chu Jesu hunga chu amaho lah-a chu umlou ahi.
target: Now Thomas (also known as Didymus), one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.

source: Hiche chun seijui dangho chun ajah-a, Keihon Pakai chu kamutaove, atiuvin ahi. Ahivangin aman ajah uva, akhutphang thingkil maha kamua, kakhut junga kakhoija, anah kakhutna katham lousen tahsan ponge, ati.
target: So the other disciples told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see the nail marks in his hands and put my finger where the nails were, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

source: Chuin ni get jouman seijuite in sunga aum pettah-un, chule Thomas jong amaho toh uma ahin; kot kikhah sohkeija ahin, Jesu ahung kitnin alah uva ahung dingin, Nachung uva lungmon umhen, ati.
target: A week later his disciples were in the house again, and Thomas was with them. Though the doors were locked, Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you!”

source: Chuin Thomas jah-a, Nakhut jungin hinkhoijin, kakhut teni hi ven; nakhut hin lhangin lang kanah thamin; chule gingchalel louvin tahsanin, ati.
target: Then he said to Thomas, “Put your finger here; see my hands. Reach out your hand and put it into my side. Stop doubting and believe.”

source: Thomas'in adonbutnin ajah-a, ka Pakai le ka Pathen, ati.
target: Thomas said to him, “My Lord and my God!”

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, Thomas, Neimu jeh-a natahsan ahi, mu louva tahsan ho anun nomui, ati.
target: Then Jesus told him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”

source: Tahbeh-a Jesu'n aseijuite angsunga melchihna kidang tamtah abol ahin, hitiho chu hiche lekhabu sunga hin akisunpoi.
target: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not recorded in this book.

source: Jesu chu Pathen Chapa Christa ahi chu natahsan uva, natahsan vanguva ama mina hinna nanei thei nadinguva, hichengse hi kisuna ahibouve.
target: But these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in his name.

source: Hiche jou chun Tiberia dillen pangah Jesu aseijuite henga akilah kitleuvin; chule akilah chu hiti hi ahi.
target: Afterward Jesus appeared again to his disciples, by the Sea of Galilee. It happened this way:

source: Simon Peter le Didymus atiu Thomas chutoh, Galilee gam Canna kho-a mi Nathanael toh, Zebedai chapa teni toh, chule seijui dang ni toh um khoma ahiuve.
target: Simon Peter, Thomas (also known as Didymus), Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.

source: Simon Peter'in amaho henga, keima nga manin chenge ati. Amahon ajah-a, Keiho jong kahungdiu ahi, atiuvin ahi. Chuin acheuvin kong khatna gangtah-in alutpai taove. Chule hiche jan chun imacha amanpouvin ahi.
target: “I’m going out to fish,” Simon Peter told them, and they said, “We’ll go with you.” So they went out and got into the boat, but that night they caught nothing.

source: Ahin jingkah ahunghi phatnin, Jesu vaokamah adingin; ahivangin seijui ho chun Jesu ahi chu ahepouve.
target: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize that it was Jesus.

source: Hichun Jesu'n ajah uva, Chate, neh ding ima naneijum? ati. Amahon, Kanei pouve, atiuve.
target: He called out to them, “Friends, haven’t you any fish?” “No,” they answered.

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Kong sih jet lama chun len sepleu chun namat dingu ahi, ati. Hijeh chun amahon asepmuvin ahile, nga atama atam jeh chun akaijou tapouve.
target: He said, “Throw your net on the right side of the boat and you will find some.” When they did, they were unable to haul the net in because of the large number of fish.

source: Hichun Jesu'n angailut seijui chun Peter jah-a, Pakai ahi, ati. Peter'in, Pakai ahi, ti chu ajah phat chun, sangkhol aki-ah loijin (ijeh inem itile asagoh keova um ahin) dillena chun achomlhan ahi.
target: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It is the Lord!” As soon as Simon Peter heard him say, “It is the Lord,” he wrapped his outer garment around him (for he had taken it off) and jumped into the water.

source: Ahin seijui dangse vang chu nga dimset len akaijun, kongneo khatna ahung kitolun ahi; (ijeh-inem itile amaho chu tolla kona gamla lou ahiuvin, tong ja ni tobang bou kikah ahiuve).
target: The other disciples followed in the boat, towing the net full of fish, for they were not far from shore, about a hundred yards.

source: Chutichun tolgo agei phatnun, chukoma chu songmeihol meija kitihle, achunga nga kikoi, chule changlhah amuvin ahi.
target: When they landed, they saw a fire of burning coals there with fish on it, and some bread.

source: Jesu'n ajah uva, Tu tahtah-a namatnu nga chu phabep galaovin, ati.
target: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”

source: Hiche chun Simon Peter kong'a akaldoh-in, nga len ja khatle somnga le thum dimset len chu agakaijin; nga achuti tam vang chun alen chu a-ehpon ahi.
target: So Simon Peter climbed back into the boat and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many the net was not torn.

source: Jesu'n ajah uva, Hungun jing an hung neuvin, ati. Chule Pakai ahi chu aheuvin, seijui ho khatcha jong, Koi nahim? tia dong ngama aumpouve.
target: Jesus said to them, “Come and have breakfast.” None of the disciples dared ask him, “Who are you?” They knew it was the Lord.

source: Chuin Jesu ahungin, changlhah chu alan, amaho chu apen, chutobang machun nga jongchu apei.
target: Jesus came, took the bread and gave it to them, and did the same with the fish.

source: Hiche chu athia kona athodoh nunga aseijuite henga akilah athumveina ahi.
target: This was now the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from the dead.

source: Chuin ajing anneh-u achaijun, Jesu'n Simon Peter jah-a, Jonah chapa, Simon, nangman hicheho sanga hi neingailut joh-em? ati. Aman ajah-a, Henge Pakai; kangailut nangin nahenai, ati. Aman ajah-a, Ka kelngoi nouho vah-in, ati.
target: When they had finished eating, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon son of John, do you love me more than these?” “Yes, Lord,” he said, “you know that I love you.” Jesus said, “Feed my lambs.”

source: Ani veinan ajah-a, Jonah chapa, Simon, nangman neingailut em? ati. Aman ajah-a, Henge Pakai; kangailut nangman nahenai, ati. Aman ajah-a, Ka kelngoiho chingin ati.
target: Again Jesus said, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” He answered, “Yes, Lord, you know that I love you.” Jesus said, “Take care of my sheep.”

source: Chuin athum veinan ajah-a, Jonah chapa, Simon, nangin neingailut em? ati. Aman thum veijen, Neingailut em? ati jeh chun Peter alungnom motan, ajah-a, Pakai, nangman ijakai nahenai; keiman nangma kangailut nangman nahenai ati. Jesu'n ajah-a, Ka kelngoi ho vah-in.
target: The third time he said to him, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter was hurt because Jesus asked him the third time, “Do you love me?” He said, “Lord, you know all things; you know that I love you.” Jesus said, “Feed my sheep.

source: Tahbeh beh-a kaseipeh nahi, nachapan laija chu nangman natai nakigah-a, nachena nom noma nacheji ahi; na-upat teng vangle, nakhut najah-a midangin natai nagahpeh ding, chule nache nom louna lam lama napui ding ahi, ati.
target: Very truly I tell you, when you were younger you dressed yourself and went where you wanted; but when you are old you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go.”

source: Hichu ama iti thia athi-a, Pathen achoi-at ding chu hetsahna-a, asei ahi. Chuin hiche chu asei jouvin ajah-a, Neijuijin, ati.
target: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. Then he said to him, “Follow me!”

source: Chuin Peter akiheijin ahile, ajan anneh uva a-anga kingaija, Napedoh-a pang dinga chu koiham? tia donga, Jesu'n angailut seijui chun ajui amui.
target: Peter turned and saw that the disciple whom Jesus loved was following them. (This was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper and had said, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”)

source: Peter'in amachu amuphatnin, Jesu jah-a, Pakai, hichepa hi iti dingham? ati.
target: When Peter saw him, he asked, “Lord, what about him?”

source: Jesu'n ajah-a, Kahung kahse-a ama hi aumden ding deileng, nang dinga hichu ipidi hiding ham? Nangman kanung juijin, ati.
target: Jesus answered, “If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you? You must follow me.”

source: Chuin hiche seijui chu thi lou ding ahi tin sopite lah-a athangtan ahi; ahinla Jesu'n ama jah-a chu, Ama chu thi lou ding ahi, ati ahipon, Kahung kahse-a ama hi aumden ding deileng, nang dinga hichu ipidi hiding ham? ati ahibouve.
target: Because of this, the rumor spread among the believers that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say that he would not die; he only said, “If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you?”

source: Hicheng thu hettohsah-a, chule hicheng thu suna hi hiche seijui chu ahin; chule ama thu hettohsah chu tahbeh ahi ti kaheuve.
target: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who wrote them down. We know that his testimony is true.

source: Chule hicheng tailouvin jong Jesu thilbol tamtah aumin, hitiho chu abonchan kisun sohkeile, kei ngaiton, lekhabu kisun chengse chu vannoi leiset hin dolponte. Amen.
target: Jesus did many other things as well. If every one of them were written down, I suppose that even the whole world would not have room for the books that would be written.

source: Vo Theophilus, lekha masa-a chun Jesu thilbol le athuhil kipattil thudol jouse,
target: In my former book, Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach

source: Asolchah lhenho Lhagao Thenga thu apeh jouva lahtouva aum ni geija thu chu kanasunin ahi:
target: until the day he was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles he had chosen.

source: Gim genthei athoh jouvin, chuche solchah ho chu thontheilou hetphotna tamtah toh thon ahingin akimusah in, nisomli geijin ahenguva akilah jin, Pathen lenggam thudol aseijin:
target: After his suffering, he presented himself to them and gave many convincing proofs that he was alive. He appeared to them over a period of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.

source: Chule amahotoh aum khomin, amaho chu hiche thuhi apen, Nanghon Jerusalem dalha hih-un; Pa thutep keija kona najah-u chu ngah jingun.
target: On one occasion, while he was eating with them, he gave them this command: “Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift my Father promised, which you have heard me speak about.

source: Ijeh-inem itile John chun twija baptize achansah ahin, nangho vang tukal ni phabep joule Lhagao Thenga baptize nachan dingu ahi, ati.
target: For John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”

source: Hichun amaho ahung kikhomun ajah-a, Pakai tu-a hi Israelte gam nakiledoh sah kit dingham? tin adongui.
target: Then they gathered around him and asked him, “Lord, are you at this time going to restore the kingdom to Israel?”

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Pan athuneina-a angaitoa agot phat le nikho chu nangho het dingdol ahipoi.
target: He said to them: “It is not for you to know the times or dates the Father has set by his own authority.

source: Amavang Lhagao Theng nachung uva ahung lhun tengle nanghon thahat nanei dingu ahi; chule nangho Jerusalem'a jong, Juda gamsung le, Samaria gamsung, chule leiset chung gam jouse-a, kolmong geija kathu hettohsah-a napan dingu ahi, ati.
target: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you; and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”

source: Chuin thu hicheng chu asei jouvin, amahon avet vet pettah-un ama lahtouvin aumin; amitmuva konin meilhang khatnin atolmangtan ahi.
target: After he said this, he was taken up before their very eyes, and a cloud hid him from their sight.

source: Chuin akaltouva van lam avet vet pettah-un, veuvin, ponbang sil mi ni akenguvah ahung dingin;
target: They were looking intently up into the sky as he was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.

source: Miteni chun, Nangho Galilee gam miho, ibola nadin uva van lam navet jinguham? Hiche Jesu nangho koma kona van'a kilatou hi, van'a akaltou namu bang banguva hi hung ding ahi, ati lhone.
target: “Men of Galilee,” they said, “why do you stand here looking into the sky? This same Jesus, who has been taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way you have seen him go into heaven.”

source: Chutah-in Olivet molsanga kon chun Jerusalem'a akiletaove; hichu Jerusalem komcha ahin cholngah ni lampi bou ahi.
target: Then the apostles returned to Jerusalem from the hill called the Mount of Olives, a Sabbath day’s walk from the city.

source: Chuin alhunun, aumnao indan chungnunga chun aluttou taove. Peter, le Jacob, John le Andrew, Philip le Thomas, Bartholomew le Matthew, Alphaeus chapa Jacob le Zealot Simon, chule Jacob chapa Judas; hicheng chu ahiuve.
target: When they arrived, they went upstairs to the room where they were staying. Those present were Peter, John, James and Andrew; Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew; James son of Alphaeus and Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James.

source: Hiteho chengse chu numei phabep toh, Jesu nu Mariam toh, asopiteho toh, lungkhat tah-in taona le ngehna ajomjing taove.
target: They all joined together constantly in prayer, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

source: Hiche nikho lai chun Peter seijui ho lah-a adingdoh-in (mipi akikhoma chu mi jale somni jen ahiuve,)
target: In those days Peter stood up among the believers (a group numbering about a hundred and twenty)

source: Sopiteho, Jesu manho lamkaija pang Judas chungchang thudol, Lhagao Thengin David kama aseisah Pathen lekhabua thu chu guilhung ding mong ahi;
target: and said, “Brothers and sisters, the Scripture had to be fulfilled in which the Holy Spirit spoke long ago through David concerning Judas, who served as guide for those who arrested Jesus.

source: Ijeh-inem itile ama chu eiho lah-a kisimtha ahin, chule hiche lhacha natohna mun jonghi changa ahi.
target: He was one of our number and shared in our ministry.”

source: Tun heche mipa hin khan gitlou man sumin leimun khat alamin, akhupbon achun, atumpi apohkeh-in, chule agil jouse ahungdoh tan ahi.
target: (With the payment he received for his wickedness, Judas bought a field; there he fell headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines spilled out.

source: Hiche thuhi Jerusalem'a cheng jousen ahesoh keije; hiti chun amaho paovin chuche leimun min chu Aceldama asahtaove; hichu thisan lei tina ahi.
target: Everyone in Jerusalem heard about this, so they called that field in their language Akeldama, that is, Field of Blood.)

source: Ijeh-inem itile Labu-a, Ama chenna mun chu agoh keuvin umhen, chua chun koima cheng hihhen; chule apanmun chu midang changhen, tin akisune.
target: “For,” said Peter, “it is written in the Book of Psalms: “ ‘May his place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in it,’ and, “ ‘May another take his place of leadership.’

source: Hijeh chun, Pakai Jesu eiho lah-a achele ahungleh phatlai sungse,
target: Therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have been with us the whole time the Lord Jesus was living among us,

source: John'in baptize achansah-a pat, Pakai Jesu eihoa kona lahtouva aum ni geija ikiloi khompiu hiche miho lah-a khat hi, ama thodoh kit hettohsah-a eipanhu diuva lhentei ngaiding ahi, ati.
target: beginning from John’s baptism to the time when Jesus was taken up from us. For one of these must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”

source: Chuin mi ni, Barsabas atiu Joseph (amin chom Justus), le Matthias chu alheng doh-un ahi.
target: So they nominated two men: Joseph called Barsabbas (also known as Justus) and Matthias.

source: Chuin amaho ataovun, Vo mijouse lung hesoh Pakai, hiteni koijoh hi
target: Then they prayed, “Lord, you know everyone’s heart. Show us which of these two you have chosen

source: Chonset jala Judas'in ama mun'a achena dinga alha hiche lhacha na le solchah panmun chu lo dinga nalhenem neivet sah-un, atiuve.
target: to take over this apostolic ministry, which Judas left to go where he belongs.”

source: Chuin amahon vang asanun ahile, avang sanu chu Mathias chunga achutan; hitichun ama chu solchah somlekhat chutoh akisimtha tai.
target: Then they cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias; so he was added to the eleven apostles.

source: Chule Pentecost ni lhingkeija ahunglhun phatnin, abonchauvin lungkhat tah-in munkhatna ana umkhomun ahi;
target: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.

source: Chuin phulou helouvin van'a konin hui hattah nung gin tobang ahung gingin, atounau in chu adimsoh jengin ahi.
target: Suddenly a sound like the blowing of a violent wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting.

source: Chuin meikong bangin lei ahung kilah-in, akikhen jal-in, alu chung cheh uva achongin ahi.
target: They saw what seemed to be tongues of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.

source: Chuin amaho abonun Lhagao Theng adimset taovin, Lhagaovin aseidohsah bangun paochom paochomin thu asei pantaovin ahi.
target: All of them were filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.

source: Hichea chu vannoi leiset gamtina chitin namtin lah-a kona hou gut Juda miho Jerusalem'a umuva ahi.
target: Now there were staying in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.

source: Chuin chuche thu akiseithang phat chun mipi ahung kikhomun, amitakipmin ama ama pao cheh-a thukisei ajah jeh-u chun, alung kichih lah jengun ahi.
target: When they heard this sound, a crowd came together in bewilderment, because each one heard their own language being spoken.

source: Chuin amaho chun adatmouvin kidang asauvin, khatle khat akihouvun, Veuvin, thu seiho hi abonchauva Galilee gam mi hilou hiuvem?
target: Utterly amazed, they asked: “Aren’t all these who are speaking Galileans?

source: Chule i-atile eihon amikipmin ipenna gam cheh paova thu kisei ijah-uham?
target: Then how is it that each of us hears them in our native language?

source: Eihola abang Parthia mi, Media mi, Elam mi ihiuvin, abang Mesopotamia gama cheng, Juda gamale Cappadocia gama cheng, Pontus gamale Asia gama cheng,
target: Parthians, Medes and Elamites; residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,

source: Phrygia le Pamphylia gama cheng, Egypt gama cheng, chule Cyrene gam vela Libya gama cheng ihiuvin; abang Rome'a kona hung kholjin, Juda ho le Juda chona chonho,
target: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome

source: Crete mile Arabia gam mi ihiuvin: ahivangin eima pao cheh-a Pathen thilbol loupi thu aseiju thakhat jah-in ijauvin, atiuvin ahi.
target: (both Jews and converts to Judaism); Cretans and Arabs—we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues!”

source: Chuin abonchau chun kidang asauvin adatmo lheh jengun, Itina ahidem, tin khatle khat akidongto taovin ahi.
target: Amazed and perplexed, they asked one another, “What does this mean?”

source: Ahivangin adangho chun ajontaijun, Hiteho lengpiga twithah khama hiuva hi, atiuve.
target: Some, however, made fun of them and said, “They have had too much wine.”

source: Ahin Peter somlekhat chutoh adingin, aw sangtah-in asamin, ajah uva, Juda gam mite le Jerusalem'a chengho, nanghon nabon chaovin hiche hi heuvin, chule kathusei lungna changin ngaijun.
target: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, raised his voice and addressed the crowd: “Fellow Jews and all of you who live in Jerusalem, let me explain this to you; listen carefully to what I say.

source: Ijeh-inem itile hiteho hi nangho ngaito banga lengpitwi khama ahipouve; tu hi vai ahinalai bouve;
target: These people are not drunk, as you suppose. It’s only nine in the morning!

source: Ahin hiche hi Joel themgaovin anasei;
target: No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:

source: Ni nunungle hiti ding ahi, tin Pathen'in aseije Mi jouse chunga kalhagao kabuh lhah ding; nachapa teo le nachanu teo vin gaothu aseidoh dingu, nakhangdong houvin mu aneijuva, na-upa houvin mang amat dingu ahi.
target: “ ‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out my Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.

source: Ahi, hiche niteng chule kasoh pasal hole kasoh numei ho chunga jong Kalhagao kabuh lhah ding, chule amahon lhagao thu aseidoh dingu ahi.
target: Even on my servants, both men and women, I will pour out my Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.

source: Chule van'a thil kidang dang, noi leisetna melchihna ho; thisan, mei, meikhu kamusah ding;
target: I will show wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and billows of smoke.

source: Pakai nikho loupitah le min thangtah chu ahunglhun masanga; Nisa chu muthim soh-a, Lha thisan soh ding ahi.
target: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and glorious day of the Lord.

source: Chule hiti ding ahi, Koi hijongle Pakai mina tao chan chu huhhing-a umding ahi, tia aseichu guilhunga ahibouve.
target: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.’

source: Nangho Israel mite, hiche thuhi ngaijun: Nazareth Jesu, Pathen'in amanchah-a nalah uva, bolmo kidang, datmo umho, chule melchihna ho abola kona chu Pathen'in nangho henga aphotchet ahin, hichu nanghon naheuve.
target: “Fellow Israelites, listen to this: Jesus of Nazareth was a man accredited by God to you by miracles, wonders and signs, which God did among you through him, as you yourselves know.

source: Ama chu Pathen'in ageltohsa le ahet masahsa bangin pehdoh-in aumtan ahile, nanghon namanun, lungsetna beihel khutho chun thingpellah nakhen beh-un, nathat taove.
target: This man was handed over to you by God’s deliberate plan and foreknowledge; and you, with the help of wicked men, put him to death by nailing him to the cross.

source: Ahin thina-in ama chu atuhden hoi ahilou jeh chun, Pathen'in thina-in akan chu asutlhap peh-in, akai thoutai.
target: But God raised him from the dead, freeing him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for death to keep its hold on him.

source: Ijeh-inem itile David'in ama thudola chun, Keiman Pakai chu kamaikoh-a kamu jinge, Ajeh chu keima kalon louna dingin, kakhut jet lamah aume.
target: David said about him: “ ‘I saw the Lord always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

source: Hijeh chun kalung akipah-in, chule kalei athanome; chuche kalval chun katahsa jong kinema cholnga ding ahi;
target: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will rest in hope,

source: Ajeh chu nangman kalhagao damuna nadalhah lou ding, namitheng jong mon mangna namusah louding ahi.
target: because you will not abandon me to the realm of the dead, you will not let your holy one see decay.

source: Nangman keima hinna lampi neihetsah ahitan, namaiso-a kipana neidip ding ahi, tin anaseijin ahi.
target: You have made known to me the paths of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence.’

source: Sopiteho, iphung bulpiu David thuhi olmo louhelin najah uva kasei theije, ama chu athin, akivuijin abuikhuh tu geijin ilah uva aum jinge.
target: “Fellow Israelites, I can tell you confidently that the patriarch David died and was buried, and his tomb is here to this day.

source: Ama chu themgao ahijeh-in, tahsalam dola ataiguija kona alaltouna-a toudinga Christa chu ahin tundoh ding ahi tia, Pathen kihahsela athutep chu ahen;
target: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that he would place one of his descendants on his throne.

source: Chutia chu khonung thu ahet masah jeh chun Christa thokit ding thu aseijin, thikhol khul'a dalhah denin aumpoi, alongin jong mon mangna amupoi, tia asei ahi.
target: Seeing what was to come, he spoke of the resurrection of the Messiah, that he was not abandoned to the realm of the dead, nor did his body see decay.

source: Hiche Jesu chu Pathen'in akaithou kittan, ahetoh-a keiho kabonchao kahiuve.
target: God has raised this Jesus to life, and we are all witnesses of it.

source: Hijeh chun Pathen khut jet lamah choisangin aumin, athutepsa Lhagao Theng chu a-Pa-a konin amun, hichu ahin buhlhah-a, tu-a namu-u najah-uhi ahi.
target: Exalted to the right hand of God, he has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear.

source: David chu van'ah akalpoi, ahivangin amatah-in hiti hin aseije, Pakai chun ka Pakai jah-a, Kakhut jet lamah tou jingin,
target: For David did not ascend to heaven, and yet he said, “ ‘The Lord said to my Lord: “Sit at my right hand

source: Keiman namelmaho nakeng chotpha kaneisah masangsen, ati.
target: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.” ’

source: Hijeh chun Israel insung mi jousen kichentah-in heuhen, hiche Jesu nanghon thingpel'a nakhetbeh-u chu, Pathen'in Pakai le Christa-a atun ahitai, ati.
target: “Therefore let all Israel be assured of this: God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Messiah.”

source: Amahon thu hicheng chu ajah phatnun, alungu hema kisun abangin, Peter le solchah dangho jah-a, Miho chule sopite, keihon ipi kabol dingu ham? atiuve.
target: When the people heard this, they were cut to the heart and said to Peter and the other apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”

source: Chuin Peter'in ajah uvah, Nalung heijun, chule chonset suhbeinan Jesu Christa minin nabonchaovin baptize changcheh-un, chule Lhagao Theng kipe-a hi nachan dingu ahi.
target: Peter replied, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins. And you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

source: Ijeh-inem itile thutep chu nangho dingle nachateo ding, chule gamlatah-a umho, Pakai i-Pathen'un ama henga akou dingho jouse dinga ahi, ati.
target: The promise is for you and your children and for all who are far off—for all whom the Lord our God will call.”

source: Chule thu dang dang tamtah ahettohsah-in, chule amaho chu atilkhouvin, Tulai khang lung gilou ho-a konhin kihuh doh-un, ati.
target: With many other words he warned them; and he pleaded with them, “Save yourselves from this corrupt generation.”

source: Chutah chun kipahtah-a athu jop chanchu baptize achang taove; chule hiche nilele chun amaho chu mi sangthum jenin abetauve.
target: Those who accepted his message were baptized, and about three thousand were added to their number that day.

source: Chuin amaho chu solchah ho thuhila jong, kithokhomin jong, changlhah semkeh-in jong, chule taovin jong gunchu tah-in apang det jingtaove.
target: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.

source: Hichun mitin chunga kichatna ahungchun; chule solchah ho chun thil kidang tamtah le, melchihna aboltauve.
target: Everyone was filled with awe at the many wonders and signs performed by the apostles.

source: Chule atahsan jouse chu aum khomun, thil jouse neilhangin aneijun:
target: All the believers were together and had everything in common.

source: Chule anei agouhou le athilkeovu ajoh-un, abonchauvin angaichat akin tohkhambep cheh-in akihom jiuvin ahi.
target: They sold property and possessions to give to anyone who had need.

source: Chule niseh-in lung khattah-in houin'ah gunchu tah-in aumdet jingun, in tina changlhah asemkeh-un, kipahle lung khatseh pun an anejiuvin,
target: Every day they continued to meet together in the temple courts. They broke bread in their homes and ate together with glad and sincere hearts,

source: Pathen avahchoijun, chule mi jouse lungdeijin aumun ahi. Chuin Pakaiyin huhhing-a umho chu niseh-in houbung'a chun abe jingtan ahi.
target: praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people. And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.

source: Ni khat Peter le John tao phatnin, hichu ni kihei ahin, houin'a achetou lhonin ahi.
target: One day Peter and John were going up to the temple at the time of prayer—at three in the afternoon.

source: Chuin mi khat anu sunga apena elbaija peng ahinpouvin, houin alut jouse henga khut adoa thil akithum dinga, houin'a kotkhah hoi atiuva chu nisehle akoijiu ahi;
target: Now a man who was lame from birth was being carried to the temple gate called Beautiful, where he was put every day to beg from those going into the temple courts.

source: Ama chun Peter le John houin'a alut ding lhon amu phatnin, thil eikipele tin anathumin ahi.
target: When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he asked them for money.

source: Chuin Peter'in ama chu ave changmelin John toh ahin, Keini neive lhonin, ati.
target: Peter looked straight at him, as did John. Then Peter said, “Look at us!”

source: Hichun aman ikhat mu akinemin lung lut tah-in avetan ahi.
target: So the man gave them his attention, expecting to get something from them.

source: Ahin, Peter'in, Dangka sana kaneipoi; ahivangin kaneisun penge: Nazareth Jesu Christa minin thoudoh-in lang lam jottan, ati.
target: Then Peter said, “Silver or gold I do not have, but what I do have I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, walk.”

source: Chuin aman akhut jetnin amanin, akai dingin ahile, chupettah chun akengphang le a-ah khomit guho ahatdohtai.
target: Taking him by the right hand, he helped him up, and instantly the man’s feet and ankles became strong.

source: Hichun amapa chu akichomin adingin, lam ajotnin, amani chutoh houin'ah alutnin; avahlen, akichom akichomin, Pathen avahchoijin ahi.
target: He jumped to his feet and began to walk. Then he went with them into the temple courts, walking and jumping, and praising God.

source: Chuin mi jousen avalea Pathen avahchoi chu amuvin;
target: When all the people saw him walking and praising God,

source: Chule houin Kotkhah hoi phunga touva khut dopa chu ahi aheuvin; chule achunga thil soh chu kidangle datmo um asa lheh jengun ahi.
target: they recognized him as the same man who used to sit begging at the temple gate called Beautiful, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

source: Chuin elbai akidamsah pan Peter le John atuhpet chun, miho jouse chun kidang asa behseh-un, Solomon kempum atiuva chun ahenguva ahung lhai khomun ahi.
target: While the man held on to Peter and John, all the people were astonished and came running to them in the place called Solomon’s Colonnade.

source: Chuin hichu Peter'in amu phatnin miho chu adonbutnin, Vo nangho Israel mite, ibola hichepa chunga hi kidang sa-a nahiuvem? Ole keihon keiho thahat le houdih vanga ama hi lam kajotsah theijuva nangaitouva, neivet vet jenguham?
target: When Peter saw this, he said to them: “Fellow Israelites, why does this surprise you? Why do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?

source: Abraham, Isaac, Jacob Pathen, ipu ipateu Pathen'in achapa Jesu chu achoi-at ahi; ama chu nanghon napedoh-un, Pilate angsung tah-a aman lhadoh dinga agotsan jongin napedoh jengui.
target: The God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his servant Jesus. You handed him over to be killed, and you disowned him before Pilate, though he had decided to let him go.

source: Ahi, nanghon Athengpa le Chondihpa chu naleh doh-un, tolthat joh chu nalhadoh pehna dingun nathumun,
target: You disowned the Holy and Righteous One and asked that a murderer be released to you.

source: Hinna Bulpi chu nathat taove; ahinla ama chu Pathen'in athiho lah-a konin akaithou kittan; ahetoh keiho hi kahiuve.
target: You killed the author of life, but God raised him from the dead. We are witnesses of this.

source: Chule ama min tahsan vanga amin chun nanghon nahet jingule namu jingu hichepa hi ahatsah ahitai: ahi, Ama-a kona tahsan chun hichepa hi nangho jouse mitmu-a adamsah hel ahitai.
target: By faith in the name of Jesus, this man whom you see and know was made strong. It is Jesus’ name and the faith that comes through him that has completely healed him, as you can all see.

source: Chule tun, sopite, hichu nahetlou jeh uva nangho le navaipo pipuhovin nabolu ahi kahei.
target: “Now, fellow Israelites, I know that you acted in ignorance, as did your leaders.

source: Ahivangin Pathen'in athemgaoho jouse kama aseisah, Christa chun gim genthei athoh ding ahi, ati chu hitia hi aguilhunsah ahibouve.
target: But this is how God fulfilled what he had foretold through all the prophets, saying that his Messiah would suffer.

source: Hijeh chun nachonset nao chulmanga aum theina dingin nalung heijun, hung kilehei kitnun, chutile Pakai anga konin haldohna kiledohna phat chu hung lhung theijin tin;
target: Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out, that times of refreshing may come from the Lord,

source: Chule naheng uva aphondohsa Christa Jesu chu naheng uva ahinsol thei ding ahi.
target: and that he may send the Messiah, who has been appointed for you—even Jesus.

source: Amavang imajouse akiledohsah kit phat kahse-a chu, van'in ama chu alahlut tahdi ding mong thu ahi; hiche thuhi Pathen'in atil abula patna athemgao thengho kama ahin seisahpeh ahi.
target: Heaven must receive him until the time comes for God to restore everything, as he promised long ago through his holy prophets.

source: Mosi'n apu apateu jah-a, Pakai Pathen'in keima eitundoh banga hi, nangho dinga nasopiteu lah-a khat themgaova atundoh ding ahi; ama chun najah uva thu asei jouse chu nangai dingu ahi.
target: For Moses said, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own people; you must listen to everything he tells you.

source: Chule hiti ding ahi, koi hijongle chuche themgao thusei ngailou lou chu miho lah-a kona kisumanghel ding ahi, ati.
target: Anyone who does not listen to him will be completely cut off from their people.’

source: Ahi, themgaoho jousen, Samuel'a pat anunga abanjom chengsen jong, thusei jousen tulai thusoh umchan ding hi anasei masatnu ahi.
target: “Indeed, beginning with Samuel, all the prophets who have spoken have foretold these days.

source: Nangho themgaoho le Pathen'in napu napateu atepna thutep chate chu nahiuve, Pathen'in Abraham jah-a, Nangma chilhah-a kona vannoi leiset phung jouse phatthei chang ding ahi, tia atep chu.
target: And you are heirs of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers. He said to Abraham, ‘Through your offspring all peoples on earth will be blessed.’

source: Pathen'in achapa Jesu chu akaithouvin, nagitlou nao chengseova kona lehei dingle, phatthei chansah dingin, nangho henga ahinsol masapenin ahi, ati.
target: When God raised up his servant, he sent him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways.”

source: Chuin miho jah-a athusei pet lhonin, thempuho, houin vaipopa, chule Saddukai ho chu achung lhonah achuvin,
target: The priests and the captain of the temple guard and the Sadducees came up to Peter and John while they were speaking to the people.

source: Mi thu ahilhon le, Jesu vanga athi lah-a kona thokit thu ahil lhon jeh chun, alungphamo lheh jengui.
target: They were greatly disturbed because the apostles were teaching the people, proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection of the dead.

source: Chuin amani chu amanun, nilhah ahitah jeh chun, ajinga dingin mihenna in'ah akhumtaove.
target: They seized Peter and John and, because it was evening, they put them in jail until the next day.

source: Ahivangin athu jaho mi tamtah-in atahsanun; chule amijat chu sangnga jen ahiuve.
target: But many who heard the message believed; so the number of men who believed grew to about five thousand.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, ajingin avaipoho chengseutoh, a-upaho chengseu, chule danthu sunho,
target: The next day the rulers, the elders and the teachers of the law met in Jerusalem.

source: Anna thempu chungnung toh, Caiaphas, John, Alexander, chule thempu chungnung inkote chengse toh Jerusalem'a akikhom khomun ahi.
target: Annas the high priest was there, and so were Caiaphas, John, Alexander and others of the high priest’s family.

source: Chuin alailung uvah amani chu atungun, Ipi thuneina le koi mina hiche hi nabol lhonham, tin adongui.
target: They had Peter and John brought before them and began to question them: “By what power or what name did you do this?”

source: Chutah-in Peter Lhagao Thengin adimsetnin ajah uva, Nangho, miho chunga vaipoho le Israel upaho,
target: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them: “Rulers and elders of the people!

source: Tunia hiche michatmo pa phatna dinga thilpa kibol thua, hichepa ipi-a iti kiboldam hela hitam, tia eikidonga ahitah-a ahile,
target: If we are being called to account today for an act of kindness shown to a man who was lame and are being asked how he was healed,

source: Nabonchaovin kihet cheh-un, chule Israel mi jousen hecheh hen, nanghon thingpel'a nakhetbeh-u Nazareth Jesu Christa, Pathen'in athiho lah-a kona akaithou, ama mina chu ama hi na-ang uva dama dinga ahitai.
target: then know this, you and all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands before you healed.

source: Nangho insahon nadei mouva napaiju song, aninga apipena panga chu, ama hi ahi.
target: Jesus is “ ‘the stone you builders rejected, which has become the cornerstone.’

source: Chule koima dangah huhhingna aumpoi; ijeh-inem itile vannoi'a mihemte lah-a huhhing-a iumna dinguva kipe-a min dang aumpoi, ati.
target: Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to mankind by which we must be saved.”
