source: Chuin Peter le John hakatje chu amu phatnun, lekha themlou ahi lhonle mimol ahi lhon chu aheuvin, adatmo lheh jengui; chule amani chu Jesu toh kivopsa ahi lhon chu ahedoh taove.
target: When they saw the courage of Peter and John and realized that they were unschooled, ordinary men, they were astonished and they took note that these men had been with Jesus.

source: Chule mi akiboldampa chu amahotoh adin khom jing chu amuvin, adounan imacha aseithei tapouve.
target: But since they could see the man who had been healed standing there with them, there was nothing they could say.

source: Ahivangin amaho chu akikhop naova kona chu achoma gaumdoh dingin asoldoh-un, amahole amaho akihouvun,
target: So they ordered them to withdraw from the Sanhedrin and then conferred together.

source: Hiche miho hi iba ilo dinguham? Amahon thil bolmo kidang datmotah abolu hila Jerusalem'a cheng mi jouse hetnin akiphong dohtan; eihon jongla ahipoi tin inel theipouve.
target: “What are we going to do with these men?” they asked. “Everyone living in Jerusalem knows they have performed a notable sign, and we cannot deny it.

source: Hijongle hiche hi miho lah-a achal cheh cheh louna dingin, tukala Jesu mina hi thu asei kit louhelna dingun hagih-in gihsal uhite, akitiuve.
target: But to stop this thing from spreading any further among the people, we must warn them to speak no longer to anyone in this name.”

source: Chuin amani chu akouvun, Jesu mina thu aseija asei louhelna dingule, mi ahil louhelna dingun akhamchah taove.
target: Then they called them in again and commanded them not to speak or teach at all in the name of Jesus.

source: Ahivangin Peter le Johan in adonbut lhonin ajah uva, Pathen thu sanga nangho thu ngaijoh chu Pathen mitmu-a dihnam, nanghon geltoh-un.
target: But Peter and John replied, “Which is right in God’s eyes: to listen to you, or to him? You be the judges!

source: Keiho vang thil kamu chengseu le kajah chengseu sei louvin kaum theipouve, ati lhone.
target: As for us, we cannot help speaking about what we have seen and heard.”

source: Chuin amahon agihsal kitleuvun alhadoh taove, mipi jeh chun talent pehnaje ahepouve; ijeh-inem itile thil kibol jeh chun mi jousen Pathen avahchoijun ahi.
target: After further threats they let them go. They could not decide how to punish them, because all the people were praising God for what had happened.

source: Ajeh iham itile bolmo kidangtah kibolna-a kiboldam mipa chu kum somli chunga mi ahi.
target: For the man who was miraculously healed was over forty years old.

source: Chuin akilhadoh phat lhonin, aloiho henga ahung lhonin, ajah uva thempu pipuiho le upaho thusei chu alhut lhonin ahi.
target: On their release, Peter and John went back to their own people and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.

source: Chuin amahon hichu ajahtah-un, aw sangtah-in, lungkhat tah-in Pathen asamun, Vo Pakai, nangma vanle lei chule twikhanglen, chule asunga um jouse sema Pathen nahi;
target: When they heard this, they raised their voices together in prayer to God. “Sovereign Lord,” they said, “you made the heavens and the earth and the sea, and everything in them.

source: Nangman nalhacha David kamsunga, Namtin vaipi ibola lunghanga hiuvam? chule ibola mihon mohthil angaitou ham?
target: You spoke by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of your servant, our father David: “ ‘Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?

source: Pakai le a-Christa chunga chun, Leiset chunga lengho apang golun, Chule avaipoteu akikhomui; tia nasei dohsah ahi.
target: The kings of the earth rise up and the rulers band together against the Lord and against his anointed one.’

source: Atahbeh-in, nangma thaonu nalhacha Theng Jesu dounan, Herod le Pontius Pilate, chidang namdangte toh Israel miho toh,
target: Indeed Herod and Pontius Pilate met together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel in this city to conspire against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed.

source: Hung guilhung dinga nakhutle nalung thimin agonmasah chengse chu boldingin akikhomun ahi.
target: They did what your power and will had decided beforehand should happen.

source: Tun, Pakai, ami gihsalnao hi vetan; chule nasohte hin hakat tah-a nathu aseina dingun;
target: Now, Lord, consider their threats and enable your servants to speak your word with great boldness.

source: Nalhacha Theng Jesu mina melchihna le bolmo kidang dang abolna dingun, mi damsahna dingin nakhut lhangin atiuve.
target: Stretch out your hand to heal and perform signs and wonders through the name of your holy servant Jesus.”

source: Chuin amaho atao jouvun, akikhopnao chu ahung kilingin, abonchauvin Lhagao Thengin adimun, hakattah-in Pathen thu aseitaove.
target: After they prayed, the place where they were meeting was shaken. And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.

source: Chuin mipi atahsan chengse chu lungkhatle thakhat ahiuvin; khatchan jong anei chu keija tum ahi tilouvin; thil jouse abonchan neilhangin aneitauve.
target: All the believers were one in heart and mind. No one claimed that any of their possessions was their own, but they shared everything they had.

source: Chuin solchah ho chun thahat chungnung tah-in Pakai Jesu thokit thu ahettohsah jiuvin; abonchauva chungah lungsetna nasatah aumtan ahi.
target: With great power the apostles continued to testify to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. And God’s grace was so powerfully at work in them all

source: Alah uva jong koima alhasama aumpouve; ajeh chu gam ahiloule in nei jouse chun ajoh-un, chule athil joh manhou chu achoijun,
target: that there were no needy persons among them. For from time to time those who owned land or houses sold them, brought the money from the sales

source: Solchah ho keng bulah ahung koijiuvin, akin toh khambep cheh-in akihom jiuvin ahi.
target: and put it at the apostles’ feet, and it was distributed to anyone who had need.

source: Chuin Levi phung mi, Cyprus twikol gam mi Joseph, solchah hon Barnabas asah-u (hichu lungmonna chapa tina ahi) chun,
target: Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas (which means “son of encouragement”),

source: Lou ching khat anei chu ajoh-in, sum chu achoijin solchah ho keng bulah ahung koijin ahi.
target: sold a field he owned and brought the money and put it at the apostles’ feet.

source: Ahin mi khat amin Anania kitipa chun a-inneipi Sapphira toh anei khat ajoh lhonin,
target: Now a man named Ananias, together with his wife Sapphira, also sold a piece of property.

source: Aman alang akikoijin, hichu a-inneipin jong ahet ahin, alang chu ahin choijin solchah ho keng bulah ahung koijin ahi.
target: With his wife’s full knowledge he kept back part of the money for himself, but brought the rest and put it at the apostles’ feet.

source: Ahinla Peter'in, Anania, ibola gam man chu alang kikoija, Lhagao Theng najoulhep dinga Satan'in nalung sung alodim hitam?
target: Then Peter said, “Ananias, how is it that Satan has so filled your heart that you have lied to the Holy Spirit and have kept for yourself some of the money you received for the land?

source: Aum laija chu nanga tum hilouham? Chule najoh nunga jong chu nangma thu neina-a um hilouham? Ibola hitobang hi lunga vop nahim? Nangman mi najoulhep ahipon, Pathen najoulhep ahibouve, ati.
target: Didn’t it belong to you before it was sold? And after it was sold, wasn’t the money at your disposal? What made you think of doing such a thing? You have not lied just to human beings but to God.”

source: Chuin thu chucheng chu ajah jah chun Anania chu alhun athitai. Chuin aja jouse chunga chun kichatna nasatah achutan ahi.
target: When Ananias heard this, he fell down and died. And great fear seized all who heard what had happened.

source: Chuin gollhangho akipat doh-un atomun, apudoh-un, agavui taove.
target: Then some young men came forward, wrapped up his body, and carried him out and buried him.

source: Chuin chuche jou nidan thum tobang nungin a-inneipi chu thilsoh umchan hepha louvin, ahung lutjelin ahi.
target: About three hours later his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.

source: Chuin Peter'in adonbutnin, ajah-a, Hijat manseh bouva hi gam chu najoh lhonham? atile amanun, Ahi, hijatbou chu ahi, ati.
target: Peter asked her, “Tell me, is this the price you and Ananias got for the land?” “Yes,” she said, “that is the price.”

source: Ahinla Peter'in amanu jah-a, I-atile Pakai Lhagao patep dinga naki thukop lhon hitam? Ven, na-inneipu vuiho kot bul ahung geitaove; amahon nang jong naputdoh dingu ahi, ati.
target: Peter said to her, “How could you conspire to test the Spirit of the Lord? Listen! The feet of the men who buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out also.”

source: Chuin amanu chu chupettah chun akeng bulah alhun athipaitai. Chuin gollhangho chu ahung lut ule amanu athi chu ahung mu uvin, apudoh kitnun, a-inneipu komah agavui taove.
target: At that moment she fell down at his feet and died. Then the young men came in and, finding her dead, carried her out and buried her beside her husband.

source: Chuin houbung pumpi chungle chucheng thu jaho jouse chungah kichatna nasatah achutan ahi.
target: Great fear seized the whole church and all who heard about these events.

source: Chule mipi ho lah-a melchihna le thil kidang tamtah solchah ho khutna konin akibol jengtan ahi. Amaho chu lungkhat tah-in Solomon kempum'a chun aumun ahi.
target: The apostles performed many signs and wonders among the people. And all the believers used to meet together in Solomon’s Colonnade.

source: Ahin midang koimachan amaho lah-a lhah ding chu angapchapon ahi: ahinla mipin amaho chu avesang lheh-ui.
target: No one else dared join them, even though they were highly regarded by the people.

source: Chule atahsana numei le pasal Pakai henga akibelap jengun;
target: Nevertheless, more and more men and women believed in the Lord and were added to their number.

source: Chutitah chun Peter avale komle ale beh mi phabep chunga achuhna dingin, damlouho khosung lamlenah ahinpouvin jalkhun le talaijah alupsah jiuvin ahi.
target: As a result, people brought the sick into the streets and laid them on beds and mats so that at least Peter’s shadow might fall on some of them as he passed by.

source: Chule Jerusalem kimvela khopiho-a konin mipi chu ahung khomun, adamlouho le lhagaoboh bolgimho ahinpuijun ahile, abonchau chun boldamin aumjitaove.
target: Crowds gathered also from the towns around Jerusalem, bringing their sick and those tormented by impure spirits, and all of them were healed.

source: Ahin thempu chungnungle aloiho jouse (amaho chu Saddukai loi ahiuvin), lunghan nan adimun,
target: Then the high priest and all his associates, who were members of the party of the Sadducees, were filled with jealousy.

source: Akipat doh-un, solchah ho chu amanun, jalhang henna-a ahentauve.
target: They arrested the apostles and put them in the public jail.

source: Ahinla jan-in Pakai vantil'in kot ahongin, amaho pamah apuidoh-in, ajah uva,
target: But during the night an angel of the Lord opened the doors of the jail and brought them out.

source: Cheovinlang houin'ah gadingun, hiche hinna thu jouse hi miho gahilun, ati.
target: “Go, stand in the temple courts,” he said, “and tell the people all about this new life.”

source: Chuin hichu ajah phatnun, ajing khovah matah-in houin'a alut paijun athu ahiltaove. Ahin thempu chungnung chu aumpi aloihotoh ahungin, houvaipoloile Israel chate a-upaho chengseu akou khomin, khatteho chu gapui dingin songkul in'a chun mi asoltan ahi.
target: At daybreak they entered the temple courts, as they had been told, and began to teach the people. When the high priest and his associates arrived, they called together the Sanhedrin—the full assembly of the elders of Israel—and sent to the jail for the apostles.

source: Ahinla sottol hochu ahunguva songkul sunga ahung mulou phatnun, amaho akileuvin ahenguva,
target: But on arriving at the jail, the officers did not find them there. So they went back and reported,

source: Songkul inla bitkeijin akikhahchahnan, angahho jong kotphunga adin jingu kagatoh-un, kot kahonule asungah koima kamutapouve, agatiuve.
target: “We found the jail securely locked, with the guards standing at the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside.”

source: Chuin thempu chungnungle houin vaipo, chule thempu pipuihon thu hicheng chu ajah phatnun, hichea kon chun ipi ahung sohdoh tadem, tin achung changuvah alung dong lheh jeng taovin ahi.
target: On hearing this report, the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests were at a loss, wondering what this might lead to.

source: Chuin mi khat ahungin ajah uva, Veuvin songkul'a nahenhou chu houin'ah adingun miho thu ahilui, ahung ti.
target: Then someone came and said, “Look! The men you put in jail are standing in the temple courts teaching the people.”

source: Chutah-in vaipo chu sottol hotoh akonun kangchan agapuijui; ajehchu miho chun songin eisep getnunte ti akichatnu ahi.
target: At that, the captain went with his officers and brought the apostles. They did not use force, because they feared that the people would stone them.

source: Chuin apuilut phatnun, amaho chu houvaipoloi ang sungah adinsah-un: chule thempu chungnung chun amaho chu adongin,
target: The apostles were brought in and made to appear before the Sanhedrin to be questioned by the high priest.

source: Hiche min hin mi hildaovin, tia hachang khama kakhamu nahiu hilouham? ahin veuvin, nathuhilu Jerusalem nadipsoh taove; chule hichepa thisan phu hi keiho chunga chuhsah dingin nagouve, ati.
target: “We gave you strict orders not to teach in this name,” he said. “Yet you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and are determined to make us guilty of this man’s blood.”

source: Ahivangin Peter le solchah ho chun adonbutnun, Mihem thu sanga Pathen thua kanunjoh dingu ahi.
target: Peter and the other apostles replied: “We must obey God rather than human beings!

source: Ipu ipateu Pathen'in nanghon thinga nakhai uva natha-u Jesu chu akaithou tan ahi.
target: The God of our ancestors raised Jesus from the dead—whom you killed by hanging him on a cross.

source: Ama chu Pathen'in Israelte lungheina dingle chonset ngaidamna dinga, Pipui le Huhhingpu hidinga akhut jetna achoisang ahitai.
target: God exalted him to his own right hand as Prince and Savior that he might bring Israel to repentance and forgive their sins.

source: Chule hitiho-a hi Ama dinga ahetoh-a keiho kahiuve; chule athua nungho dinga Pathen'in apeh Lhagao Theng jong chu ahi, atiuve.
target: We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”

source: Ahivangin amahon hichu ajahtah-u chun alungchang kikaldoh abang jengun, tha dingin agotauvin ahi.
target: When they heard this, they were furious and wanted to put them to death.

source: Ahivangin houvaipoloi lah-a mi khat, Pharisai mi, amin Gamaliel, danthuhil, mijousen ajalheh ahin, adingdoh in, solchah ho chu chom chakhat soldoh dingin thu apetan ahi.
target: But a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, who was honored by all the people, stood up in the Sanhedrin and ordered that the men be put outside for a little while.

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Nangho Israel mite, hiteho chunga nathil bol gotnu hi chingthei jun.
target: Then he addressed the Sanhedrin: “Men of Israel, consider carefully what you intend to do to these men.

source: Ijeh-inem itile tumasang lai chun Theudas kiti mi khat asohdoh-in, ama chun milen kahi atin; ama henga chun mi ja li jen akaijin; chuin ama chu athat taovin ahile, athua nungho jouse chu acheh gamun, ima hilou asohtaove.
target: Some time ago Theudas appeared, claiming to be somebody, and about four hundred men rallied to him. He was killed, all his followers were dispersed, and it all came to nothing.

source: Hichepa jouma chun, min kisut laijin, Galilee gama Judas aumdoh kitleuvin, ahenga mi kimkhat aloimangin; ama jong chu amangthah-in, athua nungho jouse jong acheh gamtaovin ahi.
target: After him, Judas the Galilean appeared in the days of the census and led a band of people in revolt. He too was killed, and all his followers were scattered.

source: Chule tu-a kaseipeh nahiuve, Hiche miho-a kon khun kikhin dalun, limsah daovin; ijeh-inem itile hiche thil kingaito le thil kibola hi mihem phudoh ahile, suhmangin hung umnante.
target: Therefore, in the present case I advise you: Leave these men alone! Let them go! For if their purpose or activity is of human origin, it will fail.

source: Ahivangin Pathen'a kon ahile, sumangjou pouvin nate; ajole Pathen kidoupi hikha getnun nate, ati.
target: But if it is from God, you will not be able to stop these men; you will only find yourselves fighting against God.”

source: Chuin ama sei chu aphatsah-un, solchah ho chu akouvun, avovin, Jesu minin thu sei kit hihhelun tin akhamun, alhataove.
target: His speech persuaded them. They called the apostles in and had them flogged. Then they ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

source: Hitichun houvaipoloi anga kon chun achedoh-un, Amin jala jachatna thoh dinga kiloma sim ahi jeh-un, akipah lheh-un ahi.
target: The apostles left the Sanhedrin, rejoicing because they had been counted worthy of suffering disgrace for the Name.

source: Chuin niseh-in houin le in tinah Jesu Christa thuhil le seiphong atangdeh pouve.
target: Day after day, in the temple courts and from house to house, they never stopped teaching and proclaiming the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.

source: Hiche lai chun seijui ho amijat apunbe cheh cheh phatnun, niseh thil kihoma ameithaiteu adon lou jeh-un, Hebrew ho chunga Greek gam Juda ho aphun taovin ahi.
target: In those days when the number of disciples was increasing, the Hellenistic Jews among them complained against the Hebraic Jews because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution of food.

source: Chuin somleni ho chun seijui mipi chu akou khomun, Keihon Pathen thu pailhah-a anneh thulam jeng kangaito dingu chu adol ahipoi.
target: So the Twelve gathered all the disciples together and said, “It would not be right for us to neglect the ministry of the word of God in order to wait on tables.

source: Hijeh chun, sopite, hiche kina hi kapansah thei dingu, nalah uva konin seiphat chang, Lhagao Theng le chihna dimset mi sagi lhengdoh-un;
target: Brothers and sisters, choose seven men from among you who are known to be full of the Spirit and wisdom. We will turn this responsibility over to them

source: Ahin keiho vang taona le thu lhacha-a kapandet jing jeng dingu ahi, atiuve.
target: and will give our attention to prayer and the ministry of the word.”

source: Hiche thua chun mi jouse chu alunglhaijun, tahsan le Lhagao Thenga dimset Stephen toh, Philip toh, Prochorus toh, Nicanor toh, Timon toh, Parmenas, chule Juda chona chon Antioch kho-a Nicolas, hicheng chu alheng doh-un,
target: This proposal pleased the whole group. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit; also Philip, Procorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.

source: Solchah ho angah adinsah-un; chuin atao jouvun, achunguvah akhut angam taove.
target: They presented these men to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.

source: Chuin Pathen thu chu ahung chaljal tan, chule Jerusalem'a seijui ho amijat hapunin apung lhehjeng taovin; thempuho jong tamtah tahsan thun anung taovin ahi.
target: So the word of God spread. The number of disciples in Jerusalem increased rapidly, and a large number of priests became obedient to the faith.

source: Chuin Stephen chu tahsanna le thilboltheina dimin, mi lah-a thil kidang le melchihna loupitah aboljin ahi.
target: Now Stephen, a man full of God’s grace and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

source: Ahivangin Libertine kikhopna atiu kikhopna-a miho phabep, (Cyrene mi, Alexandria mi, chule Cilicia mihole Asia gam miho) akipat doh-un, Stephen chu akinelpi taove.
target: Opposition arose, however, from members of the Synagogue of the Freedmen (as it was called)—Jews of Cyrene and Alexandria as well as the provinces of Cilicia and Asia—who began to argue with Stephen.

source: Ahivangin aman Lhagao le chihna-a athusei chu anelthei tapouvin ahi.
target: But they could not stand up against the wisdom the Spirit gave him as he spoke.

source: Chuin amahon mi atilgu uvin, Hichepa hin Mosi le Pathen ataitom kajauve ati sah-un ahi.
target: Then they secretly persuaded some men to say, “We have heard Stephen speak blasphemous words against Moses and against God.”

source: Chuin amahon mipi ho, upaho, chule danthu sunho chu atilseuvin, Stephen chunga achuvin, amanun, houvaipoloi henga akaijun ahi.
target: So they stirred up the people and the elders and the teachers of the law. They seized Stephen and brought him before the Sanhedrin.

source: Amahon hettohsah lhem asemun, hicheho chun, Hichepa hin hiche Intheng hile dan hi tanglouva ataitomjia;
target: They produced false witnesses, who testified, “This fellow never stops speaking against this holy place and against the law.

source: Hiche Nazareth Jesu hin hiche Intheng hi aphet lhah-a, Mosi danthu peh hi abol lamdang ding ahitai, tia asei kajauve, atiuvin ahi.
target: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses handed down to us.”

source: Chuin vaihom na-a touho jouse chun, amachu ave veuvin ahile, amaiso vantil maiso bangin amuvin ahi.
target: All who were sitting in the Sanhedrin looked intently at Stephen, and they saw that his face was like the face of an angel.

source: Chuin Thempu chungnung chun, Hiche thuho hi atahbeh ham? ati.
target: Then the high priest asked Stephen, “Are these charges true?”

source: Chuin Stephen'in, Sopite le pate, ngaijun: Ipuluiju Abraham Haran kho-a achen masanga Mesopotamia gama aum laijin, loupi Pathen ahenga akilah-in ajah-a,
target: To this he replied: “Brothers and fathers, listen to me! The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Harran.

source: Nagam sunga kon le na-insung mite lah-a konin kipatdoh-in, chule keiman kavetsah ding gama hungin, ati.
target: ‘Leave your country and your people,’ God said, ‘and go to the land I will show you.’

source: Chutah-in ama Chaldia gama konin ahungdoh-in, Haran'ah achengtan ahi; chuin hia kon chun apa thi nungin, Pathen'in, tu-a nachennao, hiche gama hin achenlut sahtai.
target: “So he left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Harran. After the death of his father, God sent him to this land where you are now living.

source: Ahin chua chun Pathen'in akengto ngapna kham jong mun alo ding apepoi. Ahivang chun amale anunga asonho geijin alo dinguva kapeh ding ahi tin, chapa anei loulai peh chun athutep tan ahi.
target: He gave him no inheritance here, not even enough ground to set his foot on. But God promised him that he and his descendants after him would possess the land, even though at that time Abraham had no child.

source: Chuin Pathen'in, asonho chu hetlou gama pem ding, chule amahon soh-a aloilut dingu, chule kum jali jen kinomsahna anei dingu ahi, tin anaseijin ahi.
target: God spoke to him in this way: ‘For four hundred years your descendants will be strangers in a country not their own, and they will be enslaved and mistreated.

source: Chule asohchan nateu vaipi chu keiman athu-u katan ding; chuche joule hung potdoh uva, hiche kom mun'a hi keima eijen dingu ahi, ati.
target: But I will punish the nation they serve as slaves,’ God said, ‘and afterward they will come out of that country and worship me in this place.’

source: Chuin kitepna cheptan thu apen; chutichun Abraham'in Isaac ahingin, aniget nin achep atanin; chuin Isaac chun Jacob ahingin, Jacob'in pului somleni chu ahingin ahi.
target: Then he gave Abraham the covenant of circumcision. And Abraham became the father of Isaac and circumcised him eight days after his birth. Later Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.

source: Chuin puluiho chun Joseph chunga thangset abolun, Egypt gama ajoh mangun; ahinla Pathen'in ama chu aumpin,
target: “Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph, they sold him as a slave into Egypt. But God was with him

source: Agim agentheina jouse-a konin ahuhdoh-in, Egypt lengpa Pharaoh ang sungah khotonale chihna apen, chuin aman Egypt gam chungale, ama insung jouse chunga gamvaipon apansahtai.
target: and rescued him from all his troubles. He gave Joseph wisdom and enabled him to gain the goodwill of Pharaoh king of Egypt. So Pharaoh made him ruler over Egypt and all his palace.

source: Chuin Egypt gam sung jousele Canaan gama kel alhan, gentheina chungnung tah alhungin ahile; ipului teovin neh ding amu tapouvin ahi.
target: “Then a famine struck all Egypt and Canaan, bringing great suffering, and our ancestors could not find food.

source: Ahivangin Jacob chun, Egypt gama anneh aume ti ajah jah-in, ipu ipateu chu amasa penin agah soldoh-e.
target: When Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our forefathers on their first visit.

source: Chuin aniveina-in Joseph chun asopite chu akihetdoh sahtan ahile, Joseph insungmi chu Pharaoh hetchenin aumtai.
target: On their second visit, Joseph told his brothers who he was, and Pharaoh learned about Joseph’s family.

source: Chuin Joseph'in mi asolin, apale a-inkote abonchan mi somsagi le nga chu ama heng lamah agakou sahtai.
target: After this, Joseph sent for his father Jacob and his whole family, seventy-five in all.

source: Chuin Jacob Egypt lama achesuh-in; chuin athitan, ipu ipateu jong athi taove;
target: Then Jacob went down to Egypt, where he and our ancestors died.

source: Chuin alongu chu Shechem'a apo galkaijun, Abraham'in Shechem'a Hamor chapatehoa kona dangka-a achoh lhana chun alupsah taove.
target: Their bodies were brought back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor at Shechem for a certain sum of money.

source: Chuin Pathen'in Abraham athutep chu aguilhun aphat alhin konin, miho chu Egypt gama apungun atamcheh atamcheh jengun,
target: “As the time drew near for God to fulfill his promise to Abraham, the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.

source: Joseph hephalou leng chom khat Egypt gam chunga avaipoh gei chun.
target: Then ‘a new king, to whom Joseph meant nothing, came to power in Egypt.’

source: Hichepa chun ivaiju dohathemin abolin, ipu ipateu chu abol gentheijin, achasen hou chu ahin louna dingin apaidoh sah jin ahi.
target: He dealt treacherously with our people and oppressed our ancestors by forcing them to throw out their newborn babies so that they would die.

source: Hiche lai chun Mosi apengin ahile, Pathen'a dingin ahoi lheh jengin; apa in'ah lha thum avah-un;
target: “At that time Moses was born, and he was no ordinary child. For three months he was cared for by his family.

source: Chuin ama akoidoh phatnun, Pharao chanun akilahdoh-in, achapa dingin akivahtan ahi.
target: When he was placed outside, Pharaoh’s daughter took him and brought him up as her own son.

source: Chuin Mosi chu Egypt miho chihna le themna jouse ahilun; chuin ama chu thu le thilbolin thahat tah ahitai.
target: Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action.

source: Chuin ama chu kum somli alhin phatnin, asopiho Israelte chu gavil ding alunga aumtan ahi.
target: “When Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his own people, the Israelites.

source: Chuin alah uva khat alam louhela bolgenthei thoh amun ahile ahuh-in, bolgenthei thohpa phu chu alan Egypt mipa chu avolih tai;
target: He saw one of them being mistreated by an Egyptian, so he went to his defense and avenged him by killing the Egyptian.

source: Aman, Pathen'in ama khutna amaho chu ahuhdoh ding ahi chu asopiho chun henaovinte ati ahin; hinla amahon ahepouve.
target: Moses thought that his own people would realize that God was using him to rescue them, but they did not.

source: Chuin ajingin alah uva mi ni akidelin ahile ama ahenguva agachen, suhcham ding agon; Vo miteni, nangni sopicha nahiuve; ibola nanghole nangho ahilouva nakiboltou ham? ati.
target: The next day Moses came upon two Israelites who were fighting. He tried to reconcile them by saying, ‘Men, you are brothers; why do you want to hurt each other?’

source: Ahivangin aheng akom ahilouva bolpa chun ama chu asondoh-in, Keiho chunga vaipole thutana koiham natunga?
target: “But the man who was mistreating the other pushed Moses aside and said, ‘Who made you ruler and judge over us?

source: Jani-a Egypt mipa natha banga chu tha dinga neigot ham? ati.
target: Are you thinking of killing me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’

source: Hiche aseija chun Mosi ajamin, Media gama apemin, chukoma chun chapa ni ahinge.
target: When Moses heard this, he fled to Midian, where he settled as a foreigner and had two sons.

source: Chuin kum somli alhin phatnin, Sinai mol gamthipmah, Pakai vantil'in hamboh-a meikongin akimusah-in;
target: “After forty years had passed, an angel appeared to Moses in the flames of a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.

source: Chuin Mosi'n hichu amu phatnin, athilmu chu kidang asan; chuin agavechen dingin agache naijin ahile, chua chun Pakai aw ahung gingin,
target: When he saw this, he was amazed at the sight. As he went over to get a closer look, he heard the Lord say:

source: Keima napu napate Pathen, Abraham Pathen, Isaac Pathen, Jacob Pathen kahi, ati. Hichun Mosi akihot hot jengin ave ngam tapoi.
target: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.’ Moses trembled with fear and did not dare to look.

source: Chuin Pakai chun ajah-a, Nakenga konin nakengchot chu sutlhan; ijeh-inem itile nadinna mun chu mun theng ahi.
target: “Then the Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.

source: Egypt gama um kamite hesoh genthei chentah-in kamun, apenu kajan, ahuhdoh dinguva hung kumlha kahi; tun hungin nangma Egypt gamah solinge, ati.
target: I have indeed seen the oppression of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groaning and have come down to set them free. Now come, I will send you back to Egypt.’

source: Hiche Mosi, Keiho chunga vaipole thutana koiham natunga, tia aledohpa tah-u chu, Pathen'in hamboh-a akimusah vantil chu akithopin asemin, vaipo le huhdoh hikop dingin asoltan ahi.
target: “This is the same Moses they had rejected with the words, ‘Who made you ruler and judge?’ He was sent to be their ruler and deliverer by God himself, through the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

source: Ama chun Egypt gamah, chule twikhanglen san le gamthipmah kum somli sungin thil kidang dangle melchihna abolin, amaho chu apuidohtai.
target: He led them out of Egypt and performed wonders and signs in Egypt, at the Red Sea and for forty years in the wilderness.

source: Pakai na Pathen'un nangho dinga, nasopiteu lah-a kona keima tobang themgao khat asodoh sah ding, athu nangaidiu ahi, tia Israel chate jah-a seija hiche Mosi chu ahi.
target: “This is the Moses who told the Israelites, ‘God will raise up for you a prophet like me from your own people.’

source: Sinai molsanga ajah-a thuseija vantil le ipu ipateu toh gamthip gama houbung'a umkhoma, chule eiho pehson ding hinna thu mu-a ama chu ahi.
target: He was in the assembly in the wilderness, with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our ancestors; and he received living words to pass on to us.

source: Ipu ipateovin ama thua nun ding chu anom hih-un, ama asondoh-un, Egypt lama alungu aheijun,
target: “But our ancestors refused to obey him. Instead, they rejected him and in their hearts turned back to Egypt.

source: Aaron jah-a, eilamkai dingu pathenho neisem peh-un; ijeh-inem itile Egypt gama kona eipuidoh uva Mosi la hoija itia ahi kahepouve, atiuve.
target: They told Aaron, ‘Make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who led us out of Egypt—we don’t know what has happened to him!’

source: Chuin amahon hiche pet chun bongnou lim asemun, milim houna ding chun gan athatnun, amaho khut sema chun athanomun ahi.
target: That was the time they made an idol in the form of a calf. They brought sacrifices to it and reveled in what their own hands had made.

source: Hijeh chun Pathen'in akiheimang sanin, van janelpi hou dingin amaho chu alhatai. Themgaoho lekhabua, Vo Israelte, gamthip gama chu kum somli sunga sa kithat le ganlha-a keima neihou jiuvem?
target: But God turned away from them and gave them over to the worship of the sun, moon and stars. This agrees with what is written in the book of the prophets: “ ‘Did you bring me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, people of Israel?

source: Nanghon Molok Ponbuh le pathen Rephan ahsi hou dinga alim nasemu napoleji bouvui. Hijeh-a chu keiman nangho Babylon kal lampeh-a Katol mang ding nahiuve, tia kisei bang chu ahi.
target: You have taken up the tabernacle of Molek and the star of your god Rephan, the idols you made to worship. Therefore I will send you into exile’ beyond Babylon.

source: Alim kigon namu bang bang chun houbuh san, tia Mosi hilpa thupeh dungjuija kisa hettohsahna houbuh chu, gamthip gama chu ipu ipateovin ananeiju ahi.
target: “Our ancestors had the tabernacle of the covenant law with them in the wilderness. It had been made as God directed Moses, according to the pattern he had seen.

source: Chujouvin ipu ipateu le Joshua'in hichu aneisonpeh-un, ipu ipateu masang sanga Pathen'in anodohho vaipiho gam alo laiju chun apo lutpeh-un, David nikho lai geijin aumin;
target: After receiving the tabernacle, our ancestors under Joshua brought it with them when they took the land from the nations God drove out before them. It remained in the land until the time of David,

source: Ama chun Pathen mitmu-a deisahna amun, Jacob Pathen umna ding athumin;
target: who enjoyed God’s favor and asked that he might provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.

source: Ahinla in chu Solomon'in asahpeh jobove.
target: But it was Solomon who built a house for him.

source: Ahi jeng vangin, Chungnung pen chu khutna kisa houin'a chun achengpoi; themgaovin,
target: “However, the Most High does not live in houses made by human hands. As the prophet says:

source: Pakaiyin, Van katouna ahin, lei ka kengphang ngapna ahi; itobang in neisahpeh dingham? Kacholngahna mun hoikom ham?
target: “ ‘Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? says the Lord. Or where will my resting place be?

source: Thil jouse hi aboncha kakhut sem hilouham? ati, tia asei banga chu.
target: Has not my hand made all these things?’

source: Nangho milouchal teho, lungsung le nakhanga chep tanlou teho, nanghon a-imatih chanin Lhagao Theng nadoudal jingui; napu napateu bol bang chu nanghon nabolui.
target: “You stiff-necked people! Your hearts and ears are still uncircumcised. You are just like your ancestors: You always resist the Holy Spirit!

source: Themgao koipen chu napu napateu vin abolset lou umam? Chondihtah hung ding thu sei masaho athatgamun; tun amatah chu amatsah le athatnin nangho napangui;
target: Was there ever a prophet your ancestors did not persecute? They even killed those who predicted the coming of the Righteous One. And now you have betrayed and murdered him—

source: chule vantil thupeh ahi tia nalah sonu danthu chu nanitpouve, ati.
target: you who have received the law that was given through angels but have not obeyed it.”

source: Chuin thu chucheng ajahtah-un, alungchang kikaldoh abang jengun, aha agoi khumun ahi.
target: When the members of the Sanhedrin heard this, they were furious and gnashed their teeth at him.

source: Ahivangin ama Lhagao Theng adimsetnin, van lam ave aven ahile, Pathen loupile, Pathen khut jet lama Jesu adin chu amun,
target: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked up to heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.

source: Veuvin, vanho akihona Pathen khut jet lama Mihem Chapa adin kamui, ati.
target: “Look,” he said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God.”

source: Ahivangin amaho hatah-in a-aosot jengun, akol asimun, thakhat tah-in anovin;
target: At this they covered their ears and, yelling at the top of their voices, they all rushed at him,

source: Chuin khopam lama anodoh-un, songin asep aseptaove. Ahetohho chun Saul atiu gollhang khat keng khophang koma apon chengseu akoijun ahi.
target: dragged him out of the city and began to stone him. Meanwhile, the witnesses laid their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.

source: Chutia chu amahon Stephen songa ase pettah-u chun ama ataovin, Pakai Jesu, kalhagao lan, ati.
target: While they were stoning him, Stephen prayed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.”

source: Chuin adilsun hatah-in asamin, Pakai, hiche chonsetna hi amaho minin sun hih-in, ati. Chuin hiche chu aseijin a-imu damdel tai.
target: Then he fell on his knees and cried out, “Lord, do not hold this sin against them.” When he had said this, he fell asleep.

source: Saul jong chun athao chu aphatsah ahi. Chuche ni-a pat chun Jerusalem'a um houbung suhmangna dinga bolsetna khohtah aum pantan ahile, solchah ho chengse tailou adang chengse, Juda gamle Samaria gamah avahcheh taovin ahi.
target: And Saul approved of their killing him. On that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria.

source: Pathen'a kipetum ho chun Stephen chu avuijun hakan akauve.
target: Godly men buried Stephen and mourned deeply for him.

source: Saul vang chun houbung suhmangna habolin abolin, intin-ah alutnin anumei apasal'in ajandoh-in, songkul'a akhum akhumin ahi.
target: But Saul began to destroy the church. Going from house to house, he dragged off both men and women and put them in prison.

source: Hijeh chun avahchehho chu gamtinah avahleuvin, thu chu ahille taove.
target: Those who had been scattered preached the word wherever they went.

source: Chuin Philip Samaria khopi-a achesuh-in, ajah uva Christa chu aphongjal letai.
target: Philip went down to a city in Samaria and proclaimed the Messiah there.

source: Chuin melchihna abol ho chu amuva athuseiho ajah phatnun, mipi chengse chun Philip thusei ho chu lungkhat tahle lunglut tah-in angaitaove.
target: When the crowds heard Philip and saw the signs he performed, they all paid close attention to what he said.

source: Ajehchu lhagao boh vop mi tamtah-a konin lhagao bohho chu hapen nin apengun, ahung potdoh-un; chule langthi le elbai jong tamtah boldama um ahi.
target: For with shrieks, impure spirits came out of many, and many who were paralyzed or lame were healed.

source: Chuin chuche khopi sunga chun kipa thanop nasatah aumtan ahi.
target: So there was great joy in that city.

source: Ahivangin hiche khopi-a chun amin Simon kiti mitpheldoi choi khat anaumin, ama chun milen khat kahi tia Samaria miho chu kidang satah-a anaumsah ahi:
target: Now for some time a man named Simon had practiced sorcery in the city and amazed all the people of Samaria. He boasted that he was someone great,

source: Amahon ama thu chu anangai lheh jengun, aneopena pat alenpen geijin, Hichepa hi Pathen thahat chungnung chu ahi, atiu ahi.
target: and all the people, both high and low, gave him their attention and exclaimed, “This man is rightly called the Great Power of God.”

source: Sotpeh-a pat aman amitpheldoija amaho chu kidang satah-a aumsahsa ahi jeh-a, athu angai lheh jengu ahi.
target: They followed him because he had amazed them for a long time with his sorcery.

source: Ahivangin Philip'in Pathen lenggam thu le Jesu Christa min ahillhang atahsan phatnun, anumei apasal'in baptize achang taove.
target: But when they believed Philip as he proclaimed the good news of the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

source: Chule Simon, amatah jongin atahsantan, baptize achan jouvin Philip toh aum khomjom lhonin, melchihna le bolmo thil kidang kibolho chu amun, kidang asa lheh jengin ahi.
target: Simon himself believed and was baptized. And he followed Philip everywhere, astonished by the great signs and miracles he saw.

source: Chuin Jerusalem'a um solchah hon Samaria mihon Pathen thu ajoptaove ti ajah phatnun, Peter le John agahsol taove.
target: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had accepted the word of God, they sent Peter and John to Samaria.

source: Amani chu alhunsuh phat lhonin, Lhagao Theng achan theina dingun amaho ding chun ataopeh lhone;
target: When they arrived, they prayed for the new believers there that they might receive the Holy Spirit,

source: Ajehchu hiche geija chu alah uva khatchabeh chunga chu loulai ahin; Pakai Jesu mina baptize changmai maibou anahiuve.
target: because the Holy Spirit had not yet come on any of them; they had simply been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

source: Chutah chun alu chunguva akhut angam lhonin ahile, Lhagao Theng achang taove.
target: Then Peter and John placed their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

source: Chuin Simon'in solchah ho khut ngap vanga Lhagao Theng kipeh chu amun, amani chu sum peh agon,
target: When Simon saw that the Spirit was given at the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money

source: Koi chung koi chung hijongle kakhut kangaple ama chu Lhagao Theng achan jeng jengna dingin, keima jong hiche thilboltheina hi neipeuvin, ati.
target: and said, “Give me also this ability so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit.”

source: Ahivangin Peter'in ajah-a, Nangman Pathen thilpeh suma choh dinga nangaito jeh chun, nasum chu nangtoh manthan!
target: Peter answered: “May your money perish with you, because you thought you could buy the gift of God with money!

source: Pathen mitmu-a nalungput adih lou jeh chun, hiche thua hin lhahna naneipoi, chan jong naneipoi.
target: You have no part or share in this ministry, because your heart is not right before God.

source: Hijeh chun hiche nagitlouna-a konhin nalung heijin, nalung sunga gitlou natup chu angaidam theikhat le Pathen henga taovin.
target: Repent of this wickedness and pray to the Lord in the hope that he may forgive you for having such a thought in your heart.

source: Ajehchu Chonsetna khatveng vungna thinkha-a lhalutna, chule gitlouna-a kikan nahi chu kahedohtai, ati.
target: For I see that you are full of bitterness and captive to sin.”

source: Chuin Simon'in adonbutnin ajah-a, Nathuseiho chu khatcha jong kachunga alhun louna dingin, Pakai henga neitao peh-un, ati.
target: Then Simon answered, “Pray to the Lord for me so that nothing you have said may happen to me.”

source: Hiche chun amanin Pakai thu ahettohsah lhona asei jou lhonin, Jerusalem lama akile kit lhonin, Samaria kho tamtah-ah Kipana Thupha chu ahil lhangpeh lhontai.
target: After they had further proclaimed the word of the Lord and testified about Jesus, Peter and John returned to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel in many Samaritan villages.

source: Chuin Pakai vantil khatnin Philip jah-a thu aseijin, Kipatdoh inlang lhang lama Jerusalem'a kona Gaza jotna lampi-a khun chesuh-in; chumun chu gamthip ahi, ati.
target: Now an angel of the Lord said to Philip, “Go south to the road—the desert road—that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza.”

source: Chuin ama akipatdoh-in achetai; chule veuvin, Ethiopia gama mi khat nukiso, Ethiopia lengnu Candace noija thunei chungnung tah, agou jouse chunga vaihom, Jerusalem'a Pathen hou dinga chea ahin;
target: So he started out, and on his way he met an Ethiopian eunuch, an important official in charge of all the treasury of the Kandake (which means “queen of the Ethiopians”). This man had gone to Jerusalem to worship,

source: Akile kit lama kangtalai ja akitol puma themgao Isaiah lekhabu chu asim ahi.
target: and on his way home was sitting in his chariot reading the Book of Isaiah the prophet.

source: Chuin Lhagaovin Philip jah-a, Khuche kangtalai khu naijin lang kiloipin, ati.
target: The Spirit told Philip, “Go to that chariot and stay near it.”

source: Chuin Philip ahenga alhaijin ahile, Isaiah themgao lekha chu asim ajan, ahengah, Nasim chu nahet nah-em? ati.
target: Then Philip ran up to the chariot and heard the man reading Isaiah the prophet. “Do you understand what you are reading?” Philip asked.

source: Chuin aman, Mi khattouvin eihilchet loule iti kahet thei dingham? ati. Chuin Philip chu kangtalai chunga kaldoh-a akoma tou dingin akoutai.
target: “How can I,” he said, “unless someone explains it to me?” So he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.

source: Amapan Pathen lekhabu anasim asimmun lai chu hiche hi ahi: Ama chu tha dinga kikai kelngoi bangin akaijun; kelngoi nou amul vouho anga hampoh louhela aum bangin, Ama jong akam kapoi.
target: This is the passage of Scripture the eunuch was reading: “He was led like a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before its shearer is silent, so he did not open his mouth.

source: Akineosah nalamin achunga thutan dih aki subeijin; akhang thu koiham aseiphong dinga? ijeh-inem itile leisetna kona ahinna asuhmangu ahi.
target: In his humiliation he was deprived of justice. Who can speak of his descendants? For his life was taken from the earth.”

source: Chuin nukiso chun Philip adonbutnin, Themgao chun hiche hi koi thudola aseiham? Ama thudola aseiha, midang thudola aseiham? ati.
target: The eunuch asked Philip, “Tell me, please, who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?”

source: Chuin Philip akamkan, chuche Pathen lekhabua thua chun apanin, Jesu thu aseitan ahi.
target: Then Philip began with that very passage of Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.

source: Chuti chun lampi-a chu ache che lhonle, twi umna mun khat agei lhonin; chuin nukiso chun, Ven, hikoma twi aume; baptize kachanmona ding ipi umam ati.
target: As they traveled along the road, they came to some water and the eunuch said, “Look, here is water. What can stand in the way of my being baptized?”

source: Chuin akangtalai chu angahsah-in, Philip le nukiso chu ani lhonin twijah akumlha lhonin, chuin Philip'in ama chu baptize achansah tai.
target: And he gave orders to stop the chariot. Then both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water and Philip baptized him.

source: Chuin twija kona ahungdoh lhon phatnin, Pakai Lhagaovin Philip chu alhohmang tan ahile nukiso chun amukit tapon, kipah thanom tah-a achena dinga achepaitan ahi.
target: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord suddenly took Philip away, and the eunuch did not see him again, but went on his way rejoicing.

source: Philip vang chu Azotus khopi-a amudoh-ui. Chuin aman ajotpaijin, Caesaria alhun kahsen khopitinah Kipana Thupha chu ahillhang pehtan ahi.
target: Philip, however, appeared at Azotus and traveled about, preaching the gospel in all the towns until he reached Caesarea.

source: Saul vang chu Pakai seijui ho gihsal le that dingin ahai haina laijin, thempu chungnung henga achen,
target: Meanwhile, Saul was still breathing out murderous threats against the Lord’s disciples. He went to the high priest

source: Chuche lampi tahsan chan chu koi hijongle amu mu numei jong pasal jong akana Jerusalem'a ahinkai theina dingin, Damascus-a kikhopnaho-a dingin lekha agathume.
target: and asked him for letters to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any there who belonged to the Way, whether men or women, he might take them as prisoners to Jerusalem.

source: Hichun achele Damascus kho alhun ding konin, phulou helouvin van'a kon vah khatnin avel asalvah soh jenge.
target: As he neared Damascus on his journey, suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.

source: Chuin ama tolah alhun, chule ajah-a, Saul, Saul, nangin ibola suhmang dinga neibolset jingham? tia kisei aw ajan ahi.
target: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”

source: Chuin aman, Pakai, nang koi nahim? ati. Chuin Pakai chun, Suhmang dinga nabolset Jesu chu kahi, nang dingin thihtul monghem lho ahahsai;
target: “Who are you, Lord?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,” he replied.

source: Chule aman kithing pumle lungdong tah-in, Pakai ipi neibolsah nom em? atin ahi. Chuin Pakai chun ajah-a, Thouvin lang khopi sunga luttan; chule nabol ding nakiseipeh ding ahi, ati.
target: “Now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do.”

source: Chule alhonpiho chu pao louvin adingun, aw vang chu ajauvin mi koima amupouve.
target: The men traveling with Saul stood there speechless; they heard the sound but did not see anyone.

source: Chuin Saul tolla kon chun athouvin, chuin amit ahasahle ima amutapoi. Hichun akhutnin akaijun Damascus'a chun apuilut taove.
target: Saul got up from the ground, but when he opened his eyes he could see nothing. So they led him by the hand into Damascus.

source: Chuin khomu lou leh an ne lou twi don louvin ni thum aumin ahi.
target: For three days he was blind, and did not eat or drink anything.

source: Tun Damascus-a chu amin Ananias atiu seijui khat uma ahin; Pakai chun gaovin akimusah-in ajah-a, Vo Ananias, atin ahile, aman, Ven, Pakai, hikoma kaumnai, ati.
target: In Damascus there was a disciple named Ananias. The Lord called to him in a vision, “Ananias!” “Yes, Lord,” he answered.

source: Chuin Pakaiyin ajah-a, Kipatdoh-in, Lamjang atiu khosung lamlena khun gachenlang, Judas in'ah Tarsus kho-a mi amin Saul atiu chu gaholin; ijeh-inem itile ven, ama atao pettah ahi;
target: The Lord told him, “Go to the house of Judas on Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul, for he is praying.

source: Chule aman mi khat amin Ananias ahunga, kho amu theina dinga alu chunga akhut angap amui, ati.
target: In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come and place his hands on him to restore his sight.”

source: Ahivangin Ananias'in adonbutnin, Pakai, keiman chuche mipa umchan, Jerusalem'a nangma mithengho itobanga khoh-a abolsetje thu chu mi tamtah-a kona kajah ahitai;
target: “Lord,” Ananias answered, “I have heard many reports about this man and all the harm he has done to your holy people in Jerusalem.

source: Chule hikoma jong nangma min pan jouse kan dinga thempu pipuiho-a kona thu anei ahi, ati.
target: And he has come here with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on your name.”

source: Ahivangin Pakaiyin ajah-a, Chen: amakhu chidang namdangho henga, lengho henga, chule Israel chate henga kamin polutle dinga kamanchah lhen hija ahi.
target: But the Lord said to Ananias, “Go! This man is my chosen instrument to proclaim my name to the Gentiles and their kings and to the people of Israel.

source: Ijeh-inem itile aman keima min jala ichana genthei hesoh athoh ding ham kavetsah ding ahi, ati.
target: I will show him how much he must suffer for my name.”

source: Chuin Ananias chu agachen, in'a chun alutnin, chuin alu chungah akhut angamin; Sopi Saul, nahunga lampia nakimusah Pakai Jesu chun kho namu theina dingle Lhagao Thenga nadimna dinga eihinsol ahi, ati.
target: Then Ananias went to the house and entered it. Placing his hands on Saul, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord—Jesus, who appeared to you on the road as you were coming here—has sent me so that you may see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”

source: Chuin chupettah chun amitna konin lip tobang ahung pullhan ahile kho amutai; chuin ama akipatdoh-in baptize achangtai.
target: Immediately, something like scales fell from Saul’s eyes, and he could see again. He got up and was baptized,

source: Chuin an anen, atha ahattai. Chujouvin ni ijat-ham Damascus-a seijui ho toh aum khomtaove.
target: and after taking some food, he regained his strength. Saul spent several days with the disciples in Damascus.

source: Chuin kikhopna intin-ah Christa chu Pathen Chapa ahi thudol ahillhang paitan ahi.
target: At once he began to preach in the synagogues that Jesus is the Son of God.

source: Chuin athusei ja jouse chun kidang asa lheh jengun, Jerusalem'a hiche min panho jouse sucheh-a chu ama hi hilou hija, Chule amaho chu kanchoma thempu pipuiho henga kailut dinga hikoma hunga hilou ham? atiuve.
target: All those who heard him were astonished and asked, “Isn’t he the man who raised havoc in Jerusalem among those who call on this name? And hasn’t he come here to take them as prisoners to the chief priests?”

source: Saul chula athahat akhang cheh cheh-in, hiche Jesu hi Christa ahi mong monge ti photchena aseijin, Damascus-a um Juda ho chu anel khupjin akisuh dongsah jitan ahi.
target: Yet Saul grew more and more powerful and baffled the Jews living in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Messiah.

source: Chuin ni tamtah jouvin, Juda ho chu Saul that dingin akihousom taove.
target: After many days had gone by, there was a conspiracy among the Jews to kill him,

source: Ahivangin agutuhnau chu Saul'in ahedohtai. Chuin amahon ama chu atha theina dingun sunle jan-in kotpiho jong chu angahjiuvin ahi;
target: but Saul learned of their plan. Day and night they kept close watch on the city gates in order to kill him.

source: Ahinla aseijuihon jan-in apuijun, bomin kul pangah akhailha taovin ahi.
target: But his followers took him by night and lowered him in a basket through an opening in the wall.

source: Chuin ama Jerusalem alhunin, seijuiho toh kiloi ding agon ahile, amahon ama chu seijui khat ahi ti atahsan lou jeh-un, akichao vin ahi.
target: When he came to Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he really was a disciple.

source: Ahin Barnabas'in apuijin solchah ho henga apui lutnin, ajah uva, Lampia Pakai amua, ajah-a thu asei, chule Damascus-a hakat tah-a Jesu min ahillhangle chu aseitan ahi.
target: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles. He told them how Saul on his journey had seen the Lord and that the Lord had spoken to him, and how in Damascus he had preached fearlessly in the name of Jesus.

source: Chuin ama amaho chutoh Jerusalem'a alutle apotleuvin,
target: So Saul stayed with them and moved about freely in Jerusalem, speaking boldly in the name of the Lord.

source: Pakai Jesu minin hakattah-in ahillhanglen, chule Greek gam Juda ho chu anelkalin; ahinla amahon ama tha dingin agotauvin ahi.
target: He talked and debated with the Hellenistic Jews, but they tried to kill him.

source: Chuin sopiten hichu ahet phatnun, Caesaria-a apuilhasuh-un, Tarsus kho-a asolmang taove.
target: When the believers learned of this, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

source: Chutichun Judah gam sungse-a, Galilee gam sungse-a, chule Samaria gam sungse-a houbung chu adet chehcheh-un, mongtah-in aumtaove; chule Pakai gingpuma hinkho mangin, Lhagao Theng lungmonsahna achangun, amaho apung tultul taovin ahi.
target: Then the church throughout Judea, Galilee and Samaria enjoyed a time of peace and was strengthened. Living in the fear of the Lord and encouraged by the Holy Spirit, it increased in numbers.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Peter gamtina avahle avahlen, Lydda'a um mitheng ho heng geijin agalhung suh tai.
target: As Peter traveled about the country, he went to visit the Lord’s people who lived in Lydda.

source: Chukoma chun, mi khat amin Aeneas atiu, alangthi jeh-a kum get ajalkhuna lum agamudoh-in ahi.
target: There he found a man named Aeneas, who was paralyzed and had been bedridden for eight years.

source: Chuin Peter'in ajah-a, Aeneas, Jesu Christan nadamsah ahitai: thouvin lang nalupna kisemin, ati. Chuin chupettah chun ama athoudoh paijenge.
target: “Aeneas,” Peter said to him, “Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and roll up your mat.” Immediately Aeneas got up.

source: Chuin Lydda'a cheng jousele Sharon'a cheng jousen ama chu amuvin, Pakai lamah akihei taove.
target: All those who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.

source: Joppa-a chu seijui khat amin Tabitha atiu aumin, hichu Dorcas tina ahin, amanu chu thilphabol le mi thilpeh-a bulhingtah ahi.
target: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha (in Greek her name is Dorcas); she was always doing good and helping the poor.

source: Chule ahitin ahi, hiche laichun ama chu anan ahile athitai; chuin amahon asilun, indan chungnunga alupsah taove.
target: About that time she became sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.

source: Chuin Lydda chu Joppa kom nai ahi jeh chun, seijui hon chua chun Peter aume ti ajauvin, geisang louva ahenguva ahung nadingin, ahenga mi ni asolun ahi.
target: Lydda was near Joppa; so when the disciples heard that Peter was in Lydda, they sent two men to him and urged him, “Please come at once!”

source: Chuin Peter akipatdoh-in amani chutoh alhontai. Chuin alhunin amahon indan chungnunga chun apuijun; meithaiho jouse chu akimvela adingun kap pumin, Dorcas'in ahin laija abolpeh-u sangkhol le ponsil hochu avetsah-un ahi.
target: Peter went with them, and when he arrived he was taken upstairs to the room. All the widows stood around him, crying and showing him the robes and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was still with them.

source: Ahivangin Peter'in amaho chu abonchauvin apotdoh sah-in, adilsun ataotai. Chuin along lama chun akiheijin, Tabitha, thouvin, ati. Chuin aman un amit ahinha sah-in; chuin Peter amu phat chun atoudoh tai.
target: Peter sent them all out of the room; then he got down on his knees and prayed. Turning toward the dead woman, he said, “Tabitha, get up.” She opened her eyes, and seeing Peter she sat up.

source: Chuin aman akhut apen akaithou tai; chuin mithengho le meithaiho akouvin, amanu chu ahingin apetai.
target: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Then he called for the believers, especially the widows, and presented her to them alive.

source: Chuin hichu Joppa kho-a jouse chun ahesoh taovin, mi tamtah-in Pakai chu atahsan taove.
target: This became known all over Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Peter chu Joppa kho-a savun sem Simon in'ah ni tamtah aumin ahi.
target: Peter stayed in Joppa for some time with a tanner named Simon.

source: Caesaria-ah mi khat amin Cornelius atiu aumin, Italy loi atiu sepai jalamkai ahin;
target: At Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, a centurion in what was known as the Italian Regiment.

source: Pathen ngaisahtah le a-insung mi jousetoh Pathen gingtah, miho ngailut thilpeh tamtah peji-a, chule Pathen henga tao jingjia ahi.
target: He and all his family were devout and God-fearing; he gave generously to those in need and prayed to God regularly.

source: Ni khat kolbunoi hon phat donin, Pathen vantil khat ahenga kichen tah-a gaova ahunga, Cornelius, ahung ti amun ahi.
target: One day at about three in the afternoon he had a vision. He distinctly saw an angel of God, who came to him and said, “Cornelius!”

source: Chuin aman ama chu ave aven, akichan, Ipiham, Pakai, ati. Chuin ama chun ajah-a, Nataonaho le nami thilpehho chu geldoh jing dingin Pathen angah alhung toutai.
target: Cornelius stared at him in fear. “What is it, Lord?” he asked. The angel answered, “Your prayers and gifts to the poor have come up as a memorial offering before God.

source: Chule tun nangman Joppa-a mi solinlang, Simon amin chom Peter asah-u chu gakousah-in;
target: Now send men to Joppa to bring back a man named Simon who is called Peter.

source: Ama twikhanglen panga Simon atiu savun sem mi khat in'ah alhunge; aman ipi nabol ding nahil nan nate, ati.
target: He is staying with Simon the tanner, whose house is by the sea.”

source: Chuin Cornelius jah-a thusei vantil chu achedoh phatnin, a-insung lhachaho lah-a mi nile ajenlea pang jingho lah-a Pathen ngaisahtah sepai khat akouvin,
target: When the angel who spoke to him had gone, Cornelius called two of his servants and a devout soldier who was one of his attendants.

source: Thu jouse chu abonchan ajah uva aseisoh phatnin, Joppa-a asoltan ahi.
target: He told them everything that had happened and sent them to Joppa.

source: Ajingin amaho ache acheuva khopi chu alhun ding konun, Peter chu tao dingin sunkim donin in chungah akaltouve.
target: About noon the following day as they were on their journey and approaching the city, Peter went up on the roof to pray.

source: Chuin hatah-in agilkeltan an aneh nom-in ahi; ahinla aneh ding agotpeh laitah-un agaochangin;
target: He became hungry and wanted something to eat, and while the meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.

source: Van akihona bom khat ponlhe lentah banga aning li-a kikhit, tolla ahung kikhai lhah amun;
target: He saw heaven opened and something like a large sheet being let down to earth by its four corners.

source: Asunga chun leiset chunga akengli sa namkim, tolla vah ganhing namkim, chule chunga leng vacha namkim aumin ahi.
target: It contained all kinds of four-footed animals, as well as reptiles and birds.

source: Chuin ahenga aw khat ahungin, Thouvin, Peter; kithanlang nen, ati.
target: Then a voice told him, “Get up, Peter. Kill and eat.”

source: Ahivangin Peter'in, Chutiponte Pakai! ajeh chu keiman imatih chanin thilboh le athenglou kanekhapoi, ati.
target: “Surely not, Lord!” Peter replied. “I have never eaten anything impure or unclean.”

source: Chuin aniveina-in aw khat ahung kitnin, Pathen'in asuhthengsa chu nangman aboh ti hih-in, ati.
target: The voice spoke to him a second time, “Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.”

source: Chuin hitichun thumvei ahung umin, bom chu van'ah akikhaitou kittan ahi.
target: This happened three times, and immediately the sheet was taken back to heaven.

source: Chuin Peter'in agaochana amu chu ipi tina ahidem tia alunggim pettah chun, veuvin, Cornelius mi sol hochun Simon in ahin holun, kelkot phunga adingun;
target: While Peter was wondering about the meaning of the vision, the men sent by Cornelius found out where Simon’s house was and stopped at the gate.

source: Chule akouvun, Simon amin chom Peter chu hikoma chu lhungam tin adongui.
target: They called out, asking if Simon who was known as Peter was staying there.

source: Chuin Peter'in agaochanna amu chu angaito pettah-in Lhagaovin ajah-a, Ven, mi thumin nahole.
target: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Simon, three men are looking for you.

source: Hijeh chun thouvin lang kumlha suh-in, lung sa-ih louhelin amaho khutoh lhonin; ijeh-inem itile amaho khu keima sol ahiuve, ati.
target: So get up and go downstairs. Do not hesitate to go with them, for I have sent them.”

source: Chuin Peter Cornelius-a kona ama henga hungkisol miho henga chun akumlha suh-in, Veuvin, naholu chu keima hi kahi; ibola hunga nahiuvem? ati.
target: Peter went down and said to the men, “I’m the one you’re looking for. Why have you come?”

source: Chuin amahon, Mi chondihtah, Pathen ging, Juda vaipin aseiphat, Cornelius sepai jalamkai chu nangma hung kousah-a a-in'a nathusei ngai dingin, Pathen'a konin vantil theng khatnin ahilin ahi, atiuve.
target: The men replied, “We have come from Cornelius the centurion. He is a righteous and God-fearing man, who is respected by all the Jewish people. A holy angel told him to ask you to come to his house so that he could hear what you have to say.”

source: Chuin aman amaho chu akou lutnin alhunsahtai. Ajingin Peter amaho chutoh alhondoh-in, chule Joppa-a konin sopiho koi koihamin alhonpiuvin ahi.
target: Then Peter invited the men into the house to be his guests. The next day Peter started out with them, and some of the believers from Joppa went along.

source: Chuin ajingin Caesaria aluttaovin, chule Cornelius chun a-inkote le ajol agol chengse anakou khomin, amaho chu anangah jingun ahi.
target: The following day he arrived in Caesarea. Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.

source: Chuin Peter agalutnin ahile Cornelius'in agalamton, akengphang bulah aboh khupmin, ahoutan ahi.
target: As Peter entered the house, Cornelius met him and fell at his feet in reverence.

source: Ahivangin Peter'in akaithouvin, Dingdoh-in, keima jong mihem kahibouve ati.
target: But Peter made him get up. “Stand up,” he said, “I am only a man myself.”

source: Chuin ama chutoh ahoulim lim pumin agalutnin ahile mi tamtah kikhom agamun ahi.
target: While talking with him, Peter went inside and found a large gathering of people.

source: Chuin aman ajah uva, Juda min jat dang mi khat akiloipia, chule namdang henga ache chu dan ngai ahilou chu nanghon naheuve; ahinla Pathen'in keiman mi koima aboh le athenglou kati louna dinga eimusah ahitai:
target: He said to them: “You are well aware that it is against our law for a Jew to associate with or visit a Gentile. But God has shown me that I should not call anyone impure or unclean.

source: Hijeh-a chu keima jong thupha louhela eikou nahinsolle kahung jeng ahi. Hijeh chun ipi dinga neihung kousah ham? tia kadoh nahi, ati.
target: So when I was sent for, I came without raising any objection. May I ask why you sent for me?”

source: Chuin Cornelius'in, Ni li masangin tuphat gei hin an kangol-in, chule kolbunoi honphat donin ka-insunga kataovin ahile, ven, ka-anga pon bang kisil mi khat ahung dingin;
target: Cornelius answered: “Three days ago I was in my house praying at this hour, at three in the afternoon. Suddenly a man in shining clothes stood before me

source: Chuin kajah-a, Cornelius, nataonaho kisanga ahitai, chule nami thilpehho jong Pathen mitmu-a geldoh jinga kineija ahitai.
target: and said, ‘Cornelius, God has heard your prayer and remembered your gifts to the poor.

source: Hijeh chun Joppa-a mi solinlang Simon amin chom Peter chu gakousah-in; ama twikhanglen panga savun sem Simon in'ah alhunge, ama chu ahungtengle nahil tante, eiti.
target: Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter. He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner, who lives by the sea.’

source: Hiche jeh-a chu nakou kahinsol pai jeng ahin, tun nangma nahungin aphalheh jenge. Hijeh chun tun Pathen nin nangma thu napeh ho chengse chu ngai dinga, Pathen mitmu-a kabon chaova hikoma kikhoma kahiuve, ati.
target: So I sent for you immediately, and it was good of you to come. Now we are all here in the presence of God to listen to everything the Lord has commanded you to tell us.”

source: Chuin Peter akamkan Tahbeh mongin, Pathen'in mi dat aneipoi, ti kahei;
target: Then Peter began to speak: “I now realize how true it is that God does not show favoritism

source: Ahin namtin lah jouse-a mi koi hijongle ama ginga, chule chonphat bola chu ama dinga lah thei ahi.
target: but accepts from every nation the one who fears him and does what is right.

source: Pathen'in Israel chate henga thu athot, Jesu Christa'a chamna thu alhangsap, (ama chu mi jouse Pakai ahi);
target: You know the message God sent to the people of Israel, announcing the good news of peace through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of all.

source: John'in alhangsap baptize chan nunga, Galilee'a kipanin Juda gam pumpi-a chalsoh thuhi nanghon naheuve.
target: You know what has happened throughout the province of Judea, beginning in Galilee after the baptism that John preached—

source: Hichu hiti hi ahi, Pathen'in Nazareth Jesu chu Lhagao Theng le loupina-a thao anu ahin, ama muntin-ah avahlen, thilpha abollen, Satan bolgenthei hesohho abonchan aboldamin ahi; hichu Pathen'in aumpi jeh ahi.
target: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and power, and how he went around doing good and healing all who were under the power of the devil, because God was with him.

source: Chule Juda ho khotin le Jerusalem'a athilbol jouse hetoh keiho kahiuve; ama chu thinga akhaijun athat taove.
target: “We are witnesses of everything he did in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem. They killed him by hanging him on a cross,

source: Ama chu Pathen'in anithum nin akaithouvin, lhangphong tah-in akimusah tai;
target: but God raised him from the dead on the third day and caused him to be seen.

source: Mi jouse heng hilouvin, amasanga Pathen'in alhendoh ahetohho, athodoh nunga amatoh nekhoma donkhom keiho heng ahibouve.
target: He was not seen by all the people, but by witnesses whom God had already chosen—by us who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

source: Chuin, Ama chu ahingle athi thutan dinga Pathen'in atun ahi ti thu miho hille-a hetsah dingin eithupeh uve.
target: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that he is the one whom God appointed as judge of the living and the dead.

source: Ama min vanga, ama tahsan chan chu achonset suhbeija umding ahi, tia ama thudol chu themgaoho jousen ahettoh sah sohkeiju ahi, ati.
target: All the prophets testify about him that everyone who believes in him receives forgiveness of sins through his name.”

source: Chuin Peter'in thu chucheng asei pettah chun, athu jaho jouse chunga chun Lhagao Theng ahung chutan ahi.
target: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit came on all who heard the message.

source: Chuin cheptanho lah-a atahsanho Peter hinlhonpi chengse chun, Lhagao Theng kipe chu chidang namdangho chunga jong akibuh lhah jeh chun adatmo lheh jengui.
target: The circumcised believers who had come with Peter were astonished that the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out even on Gentiles.

source: Ajehchu amahon paochom choma thu aseijuva, Pathen avahchoiju chu ajah-u ahi. Hichun Peter'in adonbutnin,
target: For they heard them speaking in tongues and praising God. Then Peter said,

source: Eiho banga Lhagao Theng changa hiteho baptize chan louna dinga twi kham theija koi umam, ati.
target: “Surely no one can stand in the way of their being baptized with water. They have received the Holy Spirit just as we have.”

source: Chuin aman Pakai mina baptize chang dingin amaho chu thu apetai. Chuin ni ijat-ham nichong dingin alhotauve.
target: So he ordered that they be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked Peter to stay with them for a few days.

source: Chuin solchah ho le Juda gama um sopihon chidang namdang hon jong Pathen thu ajoptaove, ti ajataove.
target: The apostles and the believers throughout Judea heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.

source: Chuin Peter Jerusalem agalhun touvin, cheptanhon ana-oimovin,
target: So when Peter went up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers criticized him

source: Cheptan louho in'a nalutnin amahotoh nane khome, atiuve.
target: and said, “You went into the house of uncircumcised men and ate with them.”

source: Ahinla Peter'in abula panin abanchan ajah uva ahilchenin, hitin ati:
target: Starting from the beginning, Peter told them the whole story:

source: Joppa kaumin kataovin, chuin gaochanin mu kaneijin, ponlhe lentah tobang bom aning li-a kikhit van'a konin ahung kikhailhan, keima komlele ahung geijin;
target: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision. I saw something like a large sheet being let down from heaven by its four corners, and it came down to where I was.

source: Chuin keiman hichu hoitah-a kavetna kangaitoa ahile, leiset chunga akengli saho, gamsaho, tolla vah akhupbo-a kithol, chule vanlaijola lengle vachaho kamui.
target: I looked into it and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles and birds.

source: Chuin kajah-a thusei aw khat kajan, Thouvin, Peter; kithanlang nen, eiti.
target: Then I heard a voice telling me, ‘Get up, Peter. Kill and eat.’

source: Ahivangin keiman, Ahipoi, chutiponte Pakai; keiman imatih chanin thilbohle athenglou kanekhapoi, kati.
target: “I replied, ‘Surely not, Lord! Nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’

source: Ahin aniveina-in aw chun van'a konin eidonbutnin, Pathen'in asuhthengsa chu nangman athenglou ti hih-in, ati.
target: “The voice spoke from heaven a second time, ‘Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.’

source: Chuin hitichun thumvei akibolin, abonchan van'ah akikhaitou kit tai.
target: This happened three times, and then it was all pulled up to heaven again.

source: Chuin veuvin, Caesaria kona kahenga hinkisol mi thum chu, kaumnao in kot maija anading jinga ahitaove.
target: “Right then three men who had been sent to me from Caesarea stopped at the house where I was staying.

source: Chuin Lhagaovin koima dat bih nei louva amaho chutoh lhon dingin eisole. Hiche sopiho gup jong hin eilhonpiuvin, chuin mipa ina chun kalutnun ahi.
target: The Spirit told me to have no hesitation about going with them. These six brothers also went with me, and we entered the man’s house.

source: Chuin amachun a-in'a vantil adin amua ajah-a, Joppa-a mi solinlang, Simon amin chom Peter chu gapuisah-in;
target: He told us how he had seen an angel appear in his house and say, ‘Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter.

source: Ama chun nangmale na-insung mi jouse huhhing-a naumna dingu thu naseipeh ding ahi, tia asei umchan chu kajah uva, aseije.
target: He will bring you a message through which you and all your household will be saved.’

source: Chuin thu kagah sei patna ahile, atila eiho chunga achuh bang chun Lhagao Theng achunguvah ahung chutai.
target: “As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit came on them as he had come on us at the beginning.

source: Chuin keiman Pakai thusei, John'in twija baptize achansahji ahin, nangho vang Lhagao Thenga baptize nachan dingu ahi, ati chu kagel doh-e.
target: Then I remembered what the Lord had said: ‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’

source: Chutichu ahin, Pakai Jesu Christa itahsan uva eiho eithilpeh banguva chu amaho Pathen'in apehtah-a ahile, kei koi kahia Pathen kakham thei dingham, ati.
target: So if God gave them the same gift he gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to think that I could stand in God’s way?”

source: Chuin amahon thu chucheng ajah phatnun athip taovin, Pathen avahchoijun, chuti ahile Pathen'in chidang namdangho jong hinna dinga lungheina aphalpeh ahitai, atiuve.
target: When they heard this, they had no further objections and praised God, saying, “So then, even to Gentiles God has granted repentance that leads to life.”

source: Hijeh chun Stephen chunga hesoh genthei ana sohdoh jeh-a vahcheh hochu Phoenicia, Cyprus chule Antioch geijin acheuvin, koima dang henga sei louhelin Juda ho heng jenga thu chu aseiletaovin ahi.
target: Now those who had been scattered by the persecution that broke out when Stephen was killed traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus and Antioch, spreading the word only among Jews.

source: Ahivangin alah uva mi abang chu Cyprus le Cyrene gam mi ahiuvin, Antioch alhunun Greek miho henga jong thu aseijun, Pakai Jesu asei phongle taove.
target: Some of them, however, men from Cyprus and Cyrene, went to Antioch and began to speak to Greeks also, telling them the good news about the Lord Jesus.

source: Chule Pakai khut chun akithopiuvin; chuin atahsana mi atama tam Pakai henglama akihei taove.
target: The Lord’s hand was with them, and a great number of people believed and turned to the Lord.

source: Chuin amaho umchan thu chu Jerusalem'a um houbung mihon ajataovin; chuin amahon Barnabas chu Antioch geija che dingin asolun ahi.
target: News of this reached the church in Jerusalem, and they sent Barnabas to Antioch.

source: Chuin ama chu alhunin, Pathen milungset chu amun ahile akipah-in; chuin amaho chu Pakaiya abechah jingna dingu lung ngaiton, abonchauvin atilkhouvin ahi;
target: When he arrived and saw what the grace of God had done, he was glad and encouraged them all to remain true to the Lord with all their hearts.

source: Ijeh-inem itile ama chu mipha ahin, Lhagao Theng le tahsanna-a dimset ahi; chuin miho atama tam Pakaiyah alutbe taove.
target: He was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and faith, and a great number of people were brought to the Lord.

source: Chuin ama Saul hol dingin Tarsus kho-a achen;
target: Then Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul,

source: Chuin amudoh phatnin, Antioch-a chun ahinpuitai. Chuin ahitin ahi, kum khatjen houbung ho chutoh akikhomji lhonin, mi tamtah ahilji lhonin ahi. Chule Antioch-a chu seijui ho Christian tia kikou masapen ahi.
target: and when he found him, he brought him to Antioch. So for a whole year Barnabas and Saul met with the church and taught great numbers of people. The disciples were called Christians first at Antioch.

source: Chuin hiche lai chun themgao koi koiham Jerusalem'a konin Antioch-a ahungun ahi.
target: During this time some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

source: Chuin alah uva khat amin Agabus chu adingdoh-in, Lhagaovin aphondoh-a konin vannoi gam jouse chunga kel lha ding ahi, ati; hichu Claudius Ceasar nikho laijin aguilhungin ahi.
target: One of them, named Agabus, stood up and through the Spirit predicted that a severe famine would spread over the entire Roman world. (This happened during the reign of Claudius.)

source: Chuin seijui ho chun ajokham cheh-a Judea gama cheng sopiho chu huna thot dingin akilol taovin;
target: The disciples, as each one was able, decided to provide help for the brothers and sisters living in Judea.

source: Hichun boljong abolun, Barnabas le Saul khutna upaho agahthot taove.
target: This they did, sending their gift to the elders by Barnabas and Saul.

source: Chuin hiche lai vel chun Herod lengpan houbung ho lah-a phabep bolset dingin agon, akhut alamtan ahi.
target: It was about this time that King Herod arrested some who belonged to the church, intending to persecute them.

source: Chuin John upa Jacob chu chemjamin athat tai.
target: He had James, the brother of John, put to death with the sword.

source: Hiche abolchun Judah ho alunglhaisah chu amun, Peter jong chu amatbetan ahi. (Hiche lai chu cholsolou changlhah kut lai ahi).
target: When he saw that this met with approval among the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This happened during the Festival of Unleavened Bread.

source: Chuin ama chu amanin, songkul'a akhumin, angah dingin sepai loi li hochu apedoh-in; kalchuh kut joule miho henga puidoh ding alung got ahi.
target: After arresting him, he put him in prison, handing him over to be guarded by four squads of four soldiers each. Herod intended to bring him out for public trial after the Passover.

source: Hiti chun Peter chu songkul'a akhumun angahtauve: ahin houbung min ama ding chun Pathen henga lunglut tah-in ataopeh-un ahi.
target: So Peter was kept in prison, but the church was earnestly praying to God for him.

source: Chuin Herod chun kaidoh dinga agot jantah chun, Peter sepai ni kah-a thihkhao ni-a kihena imua ahin; angahho jong chu kotbula dinga songkul chu ngah jinga ahiuve.
target: The night before Herod was to bring him to trial, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, and sentries stood guard at the entrance.

source: Chuin veuvin, Pakai vantil khat akoma ahung dingin, chule vah khatnin aumna mun chu asalvah-in; chuin ama chun Peter chu apang abengin, asukhangin, Thoudoh loijin, ati. Chuin akhutna konin akihena thihkhaoho chu akhelha tan ahi.
target: Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up. “Quick, get up!” he said, and the chains fell off Peter’s wrists.

source: Chuin vantil chun ajah-a, Nakong kigeh-inlang, nakengchot kisen, ati. Chuin aman hitichun aboltai. Chuin ama chun ajah-a, Napon kisilin kanung hinjuijin, ati.
target: Then the angel said to him, “Put on your clothes and sandals.” And Peter did so. “Wrap your cloak around you and follow me,” the angel told him.
