source: Chuin ama apotdoh-in ajuitai; hichu vantil'in abol tahbeh ahi chu he louvin, gaochana mu nei jin akingaiton ahi.
target: Peter followed him out of the prison, but he had no idea that what the angel was doing was really happening; he thought he was seeing a vision.

source: Chuin amanin kot ngah masale anina akhel lhona, khopi sunglam jotna-a thih kot phung chu agei lhon phatnin, kot chu amani ding chun achamin akihong jenge: chuin achedoh lhonin khosung lamlen khat ajot lhung lhonin; chule chua konchun vantil chun ama adalha tan ahi.
target: They passed the first and second guards and came to the iron gate leading to the city. It opened for them by itself, and they went through it. When they had walked the length of one street, suddenly the angel left him.

source: Chuin Peter akhahdoh phat chun, Pakaiyin avantil ahinsola, Herod khutna konle Juda mite kinepna jouse-a kona eihuhdoh ahi ti tun chentah-in kahetai, ati.
target: Then Peter came to himself and said, “Now I know without a doubt that the Lord has sent his angel and rescued me from Herod’s clutches and from everything the Jewish people were hoping would happen.”

source: Chuin akingaito jouvin mi tamtah akikhop uva ataonao Mark atiu John nu Mariam in'a chun agachen ahi.
target: When this had dawned on him, he went to the house of Mary the mother of John, also called Mark, where many people had gathered and were praying.

source: Chuin Peter'in hongcha kot akiuvin ahile, nungah khat amin Rhoda atiu chu adonbut dingin ahunge.
target: Peter knocked at the outer entrance, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer the door.

source: Chuin aman Peter aw ahi ahet phatnin, akipa manin kot hongta louvin alhai lutjelin, Peter kot phunga adin chu aga seije.
target: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she was so overjoyed she ran back without opening it and exclaimed, “Peter is at the door!”

source: Chuin amahon amanu jah-a, angola nahi, atiuve. Ahivangin, Aman ahimonge, ati changsalin ahi. Chuin amahon, a-vantil hichu, atiuve.
target: “You’re out of your mind,” they told her. When she kept insisting that it was so, they said, “It must be his angel.”

source: Ahivangin Peter'in akiu akiuvin; amahon kot chu ahonule ama amuvin, adatmo lheh jengui.
target: But Peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astonished.

source: Ahivangin aman athipbehna dingun akhutnin ajapmin, Pakaiyin songkul'a kona ahin puidohje umchan chu aseitan ahi. Chuin, hiche thuho hi jacob le sopiho seipeh-un, ati. Chuin ama apotdoh-in mun danga achetai.
target: Peter motioned with his hand for them to be quiet and described how the Lord had brought him out of prison. “Tell James and the other brothers and sisters about this,” he said, and then he left for another place.

source: Chuin khovah vah-in, sepaiho chu, Peter hoija um hitam, atiuvin lungjin mainah-in alung jing pouve.
target: In the morning, there was no small commotion among the soldiers as to what had become of Peter.

source: Chuin Herod chun aholin amutapon ahile, angahho chu achunguva thu atanin, amaho chu tha dingin thu apetai. Chuin ama Juda gama konin Caesaria ache suh-in, chukoma chun aumdentai.
target: After Herod had a thorough search made for him and did not find him, he cross-examined the guards and ordered that they be executed. Then Herod went from Judea to Caesarea and stayed there.

source: Hiche laija chu Herod Tyre le Sidon miho chunga ha lunghana lunghanga ahin; ahivangin amaho thu khat akisauvin, ahenga acheuvin, lengpa insung vaihom amin Blastus chu akihouthei piuvin, kichamna ding athumui; ajeh chu lengpa gama kona amaho gama anneh hungji-a ahi.
target: He had been quarreling with the people of Tyre and Sidon; they now joined together and sought an audience with him. After securing the support of Blastus, a trusted personal servant of the king, they asked for peace, because they depended on the king’s country for their food supply.

source: Chuin akinitep niuvin, Herod chu leng vonin akivonin, alal touna-a atouvin ajah uva chun thu aseijin ahi.
target: On the appointed day Herod, wearing his royal robes, sat on his throne and delivered a public address to the people.

source: Chuin miho chun, Mihem awso ahipoi, pathen awso ahi, tin asamui.
target: They shouted, “This is the voice of a god, not of a man.”

source: Chuin aman loupina chu Pathen apeh lou jeh chun, Pakai vantil'in chupettah chun adengin ahile, lungin anen athi tai.
target: Immediately, because Herod did not give praise to God, an angel of the Lord struck him down, and he was eaten by worms and died.

source: Pathen thu vang chu achal jal-in, akhangtou chehchehtai.
target: But the word of God continued to spread and flourish.

source: Chuin Barnabas le Saul akin lhon achai phat lhonin, Jerusalem'a konin akile lhonin, John amin chom Mark chu apui lhone.
target: When Barnabas and Saul had finished their mission, they returned from Jerusalem, taking with them John, also called Mark.

source: Chuin Antioch houbung'a chun themgaole mihil phabep aumun, amahochu: Barnabas, Niger atiu Simeon, Cyrene mi Lucius, Herod lengpa toh kivahdoh tha Manahen, chule Saul ahiuve.
target: Now in the church at Antioch there were prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen (who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch) and Saul.

source: Chuin amaho chu Pakai lhachale-a apanuva an angol laijun Lhagao Thengin, Kakouna natong dingin Barnabas le Saul neise khenpeh-un, ati.
target: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, “Set apart for me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.”

source: Chuin an ngola atao jouvun, achung lhona akhut angamun asoldoh taove.
target: So after they had fasted and prayed, they placed their hands on them and sent them off.

source: Chutichun Lhagao Theng soldoh-in amani Seleucia achesuh lhonin; chuin chua kon chun Cyprus lama akitol lhontai.
target: The two of them, sent on their way by the Holy Spirit, went down to Seleucia and sailed from there to Cyprus.

source: Chuin Salamis kho alhun phat lhonin, Juda ho kikhopna inho-a chun Pathen thu ahillhangle lhontai. Amanin akithopi lhon dingin John jong akipui lhone.
target: When they arrived at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. John was with them as their helper.

source: Chutichun twikol gam sung chu Paphos geijin achonsoh lhonin, Bar-Jesu atiu Juda mi, mitpheldoi choile, themgao lhem khat amudoh lhone.
target: They traveled through the whole island until they came to Paphos. There they met a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet named Bar-Jesus,

source: Ama chu milung ching, twikol gamvaipo Sergius Paulus chutoh uma ahi. Gamvaipo chun Saul le Barnabas akouvin Pathen thu chu ngai ding agotan ahi.
target: who was an attendant of the proconsul, Sergius Paulus. The proconsul, an intelligent man, sent for Barnabas and Saul because he wanted to hear the word of God.

source: Ahivangin mitpheldoi choipa Elymas chun (hichu amin kiledohna ahi) gamvaipo chun atahsan louna dingin, amani chu adoudalin ahi.
target: But Elymas the sorcerer (for that is what his name means) opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul from the faith.

source: Chuin Saul'in, (Paul jong akitin,) Lhagao Thenga dim pumin ama chu ave aven,
target: Then Saul, who was also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, looked straight at Elymas and said,

source: Vo nangma jouva lheplhah le minambol dimset diabol chapa, chonphatna jouse melmahpa, nangin Pakai lampi dihho akaleh-a hei natat lou ding ham?
target: “You are a child of the devil and an enemy of everything that is right! You are full of all kinds of deceit and trickery. Will you never stop perverting the right ways of the Lord?

source: Chule tun, ven, Pakai khut nachunga achui; chule phat chomkhat sung nisa mu louva mitcho-a naum ding ahi, ati. Chupettah chun meijinle muthim achunga ahung chupai jengin; chuin aman akhutna kai ding mi ahol letai.
target: Now the hand of the Lord is against you. You are going to be blind for a time, not even able to see the light of the sun.” Immediately mist and darkness came over him, and he groped about, seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

source: Chutah-in gamvaipo chun thil kibol umchan chu amu phat chun, Pakai thuhil chu kidang asa lheh jengin atahsantai.
target: When the proconsul saw what had happened, he believed, for he was amazed at the teaching about the Lord.

source: Chuin Paul aloihotoh Paphos'a konin akitolun, Pamphylia gama Perga alhung taove; chuin John'in amani adalhan Jerusalem lama akile kit tai.
target: From Paphos, Paul and his companions sailed to Perga in Pamphylia, where John left them to return to Jerusalem.

source: Amani vang chu Perga'a konin achepeh lhonin, Pisidia gama um Antioch alhung lhonin; chuin cholngah nin kikhopna in'ah alut lhonin atou lhontai.
target: From Perga they went on to Pisidian Antioch. On the Sabbath they entered the synagogue and sat down.

source: Chuin danthu le themgaoho thu asim jouvin, kikhopna in vaihomhon akom lhona mi asolun, agahseijun, Sopiteni, miho-a dinga tilkhouna thu ima nanei lhonle sei lhonin, atiuve.
target: After the reading from the Law and the Prophets, the leaders of the synagogue sent word to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have a word of exhortation for the people, please speak.”

source: Chuin Paul adingin akhut ajah-in thu aseijin, Vo Israel miho, chule vo Pathen gingho, ngaijun:
target: Standing up, Paul motioned with his hand and said: “Fellow Israelites and you Gentiles who worship God, listen to me!

source: Hiche Israelte Pathen hin ipu ipateu alhengin, amaho Egypt gama apem laiju chun amite chu achoisangin, chuin aban thahat chungnungin amaho chu ahin puidohtan ahi.
target: The God of the people of Israel chose our ancestors; he made the people prosper during their stay in Egypt; with mighty power he led them out of that country;

source: Chuin kum somli jen gamthipma achonnau chu ana thoh hamhamin;
target: for about forty years he endured their conduct in the wilderness;

source: Chuin Canaan gama vaipi sagi asumangin, amaho gam chu alo dingun ahop pehtan ahi.
target: and he overthrew seven nations in Canaan, giving their land to his people as their inheritance.

source: Chuin hiche jou chun kum ja lile kum somnga sungin, Samuel themgao nikho lai gei chun thutan vaihomho apejin ahi.
target: All this took about 450 years. “After this, God gave them judges until the time of Samuel the prophet.

source: Chuin amahon leng athumun ahile Pathen'in amaho chu Benjamin phunga Kish chapa Saul apen, kum somli geijin akoije.
target: Then the people asked for a king, and he gave them Saul son of Kish, of the tribe of Benjamin, who ruled forty years.

source: Chuin aman ama chu achon mangin, aleng dingun David atungdohtai; ama thudol chu ahettohsah-in, Keiman keima lungdoltah mi khat, Jesse chapa David kamudohtai; ama khun kalunggot jouse abol bulhit ding ahi, ati.
target: After removing Saul, he made David their king. God testified concerning him: ‘I have found David son of Jesse, a man after my own heart; he will do everything I want him to do.’

source: Chuchepa sonho lah-a chun Pathen'in thutep dungjuijin Israelte hengah Huhhing-a khat, Jesu chu ahinlhut tai.
target: “From this man’s descendants God has brought to Israel the Savior Jesus, as he promised.

source: Ama hung masangin John'in Israel miho jah-a lungheija baptize chan ding thu ahillhang tan ahi.
target: Before the coming of Jesus, John preached repentance and baptism to all the people of Israel.

source: John'in anatoh achaiding konin, Nanghon keima koi kahia neingai touvem? Keima ama chu kahipoi. Ahin, kanunga mi khat ahunge; keima akengchot sutlham dinga jong kilom kahipoi, ati.
target: As John was completing his work, he said: ‘Who do you suppose I am? I am not the one you are looking for. But there is one coming after me whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.’

source: Vo miho chule sopiteho, Abraham chateho, chule nalah uva Pathen gingho, hiche huhhingna thuhi nangho henga hinkithot ahi.
target: “Fellow children of Abraham and you God-fearing Gentiles, it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Jerusalem'a chengho le avaipoteuvin ama chu ahetlou jeh-ule, cholngah niseh-a kisimji themgaoho thu ahettoh lou jeh-un, hiche thu chu bulhitnan ama chu themmo achansah taove.
target: The people of Jerusalem and their rulers did not recognize Jesus, yet in condemning him they fulfilled the words of the prophets that are read every Sabbath.

source: Chule athina thei ajeh aholmosan jongun, Pilate henga athana ding athumui.
target: Though they found no proper ground for a death sentence, they asked Pilate to have him executed.

source: Chuin aumchan ding thudol kisun masa jouse chu asuh bulhit sohkei phatnun, thing chunga konin alalhauvin, lhanah alupsah taove.
target: When they had carried out all that was written about him, they took him down from the cross and laid him in a tomb.

source: Ahivangin Pathen'in ama chu athi lah-a konin akaithou tai.
target: But God raised him from the dead,

source: Chuin Galilee'a kona Jerusalem geija alhonpiho chun ni tamtah geijin amu jingjiuvin, amaho tulaija miho henga athu hettohsah-a pangho hi ahiuve.
target: and for many days he was seen by those who had traveled with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now his witnesses to our people.

source: Chule ipu ipateu henga thutep thudola Kipana Thupha chu keihon nangho kahung hetsah nahiuve;
target: “We tell you the good news: What God promised our ancestors

source: Pathen'in Jesu akaithouva kona achateu eiho dinga thutep chu amolso ahitai. Chujongle hiche thudol hi Labu bung nina-a jong, Nangma ka-Chapa nahi, tunia hi kahin nahi, tin akisune.
target: he has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising up Jesus. As it is written in the second Psalm: “ ‘You are my son; today I have become your father.’

source: Aman monmang na-a kilekit talou dinga athi lah-a kona akaithou ding thudol chu, hitin aseije, David phattheina thon loule athenga chu keiman nangho kapeh dingu nahiuve, ati.
target: God raised him from the dead so that he will never be subject to decay. As God has said, “ ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings promised to David.’

source: Hijeh chun aman Labu mun danga, Namitheng chu mon mangna namusah lou ding ahi, ati kitleuve.
target: So it is also stated elsewhere: “ ‘You will not let your holy one see decay.’

source: Ijeh-inem itile David chun Pathen lungdei bangin ama khanga miho ding na atoh jouvin, a-imu miltan; chuin apu apate koma alupsah-un ahile mon mangna chu amutai.
target: “Now when David had served God’s purpose in his own generation, he fell asleep; he was buried with his ancestors and his body decayed.

source: Ahin Pathen'in akaithoupa vang chun mon mangna amupoi.
target: But the one whom God raised from the dead did not see decay.

source: Hijeh chun hiche hi heuvin, miho chule sopiteho, Ama vanga chu chonset ngaidamna thu najah uva kiseija ahi.
target: “Therefore, my friends, I want you to know that through Jesus the forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you.

source: Koi hijongle atahsan chan chu Mosi danthua them nachan jou lounao imajousea kona, ama vanga chu them changa ahi.
target: Through him everyone who believes is set free from every sin, a justification you were not able to obtain under the law of Moses.

source: Hijeh chun chingtheijun, achuti loule ajole themgao thusei ho chu nachung uva lhungkha getninte;
target: Take care that what the prophets have said does not happen to you:

source: Vo nahsahmoho, nanghon veuvin. Kidang saovinlang mangthah-un; nanikho laijun thilkhat kabole, hiche thil chu min seipeh jongleu chun natahsan louhel dingu ahi, ti hi, ati.
target: “ ‘Look, you scoffers, wonder and perish, for I am going to do something in your days that you would never believe, even if someone told you.’”

source: Chuin Juda ho chu kikhopna in'a kona apotdoh phatnun, chidang namdangho chun cholngah nikit jongle chuche thuchu aseipeh kit diuvin ajolun ahi.
target: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people invited them to speak further about these things on the next Sabbath.

source: Chuin akikhomho chu akikhen phatnun, Juda mi tamtah le Juda houva lut Pathen ngaisahho lah-a mi tamtah-in Paul le Barnaba nung ajuitaove; chuin amanin amaho chu ahoulimpi lhonin, Pathen lungsetna-a umdet jing dingin atilkhou lhontai.
target: When the congregation was dismissed, many of the Jews and devout converts to Judaism followed Paul and Barnabas, who talked with them and urged them to continue in the grace of God.

source: Cholngah ni kitnin akhopi pumpiuvin Pathen thu ngai dingin akikhom taove.
target: On the next Sabbath almost the whole city gathered to hear the word of the Lord.

source: Ahivangin Juda hon mipi chu amu phatnun athangseuvin, Paul thusei chu adoudalun, ataitomun, chule anelkal taove.
target: When the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy. They began to contradict what Paul was saying and heaped abuse on him.

source: Chuin Paul le Barnaban hakattah-in, Pathen thuhi nangho henga sei masah ding dol mong ahin; ahivangin nanghon napam paijuva, tonsot hin kemlou changa kilom louva nakigot jeh-u chun, veuvin, chidang namdangho henga kakiheiju ahitai.
target: Then Paul and Barnabas answered them boldly: “We had to speak the word of God to you first. Since you reject it and do not consider yourselves worthy of eternal life, we now turn to the Gentiles.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Pakaiyin hiti hin keiho thu eipeuve, Vannoi leiset kolmong geija sochatna hi dinga, Keiman nangma chidang namdangho salvah-a kapansah nahi, ati tin asei lhontai.
target: For this is what the Lord has commanded us: “ ‘I have made you a light for the Gentiles, that you may bring salvation to the ends of the earth.’”

source: Chidang namdang hon hichu ajah phat uvin akipah athanomun, Pakai thu chu achoi-an taove, chule tonsot hinkemlou chang dinga gotsa um chengse chun atahsan taove.
target: When the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and honored the word of the Lord; and all who were appointed for eternal life believed.

source: Chuin Pakai thu chu chuche gamkol sungse-a chun achalsohtai.
target: The word of the Lord spread through the whole region.

source: Ahivangin Juda hon Pathen ngaisah numei lal hole, khopi sunga pipuiho atilseuvin, Paul le Barnaba chu abolsetsah-un, agamgi sunguva konin adelmang taove.
target: But the Jewish leaders incited the God-fearing women of high standing and the leading men of the city. They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them from their region.

source: Chuin amanin amaho douna-in akengphang lhona leivui athinglha lhonin, Iconium kho lama ache lhontai.
target: So they shook the dust off their feet as a warning to them and went to Iconium.

source: Chuin seijui ho chu kipana le Lhagao Thengin adimset taove.
target: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

source: Chuin Iconium kho-a chun ahitin ahi, amani Juda ho kikhopna in'a alut lhonin, thu asei lhonin ahile, Juda miho le Greek mi atama tamin atahsan jengtan ahi.
target: At Iconium Paul and Barnabas went as usual into the Jewish synagogue. There they spoke so effectively that a great number of Jews and Greeks believed.

source: Ahivangin thua nunglou Juda hochun chidang namdangho atilseuvin, sopiho chu amuda sah taove.
target: But the Jews who refused to believe stirred up the other Gentiles and poisoned their minds against the brothers.

source: Hijeh chun sottah aum lhonin, alungsetna hettohsah-a akhut lhona thil kidangle melchihna bolsah Pakaiya chun hakattah-in thu aseiji lhonin ahi.
target: So Paul and Barnabas spent considerable time there, speaking boldly for the Lord, who confirmed the message of his grace by enabling them to perform signs and wonders.

source: Hichun khopi-a mipi chu akikeh khenun, akimkhat Juda ho lama, akimkhat solchah ho lama apangtauve.
target: The people of the city were divided; some sided with the Jews, others with the apostles.

source: Chuin chidang namdangho le Juda hon avaipohou to kitho-a amani chu nahsahmo-a bola songa seding agouvin ahile,
target: There was a plot afoot among both Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, to mistreat them and stone them.

source: Hichu amanin ahedoh lhonin, Lycaonia gama Lystra le Derbe kho, chule akimvelah-a ajam lut lhonin,
target: But they found out about it and fled to the Lycaonian cities of Lystra and Derbe and to the surrounding country,

source: Chua chun Kipana Thupha agahil lhangle lhontai.
target: where they continued to preach the gospel.

source: Lystra kho-a chun imatih chana lamjot lou, akenga tha himhim umlou, apena elbaija peng khat atouvin, Paul thusei angai jingin ahi.
target: In Lystra there sat a man who was lame. He had been that way from birth and had never walked.

source: Chuin aman ama chu ave aven, boldama aum ding atahsan chu ahen,
target: He listened to Paul as he was speaking. Paul looked directly at him, saw that he had faith to be healed

source: Hatah-in asamin, Nakengin pansan ding jangin, ati. Chuin ama akichomin adingin lam ajottai.
target: and called out, “Stand up on your feet!” At that, the man jumped up and began to walk.

source: Chutah chun mipi chun Paul thilbol chu amu phatnun, Lycaonia paovin, pathenho mihem lima ihenguva hung kumlha ahiuve, atitaove.
target: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they shouted in the Lycaonian language, “The gods have come down to us in human form!”

source: Chuin amahon Barnaba chu Jupiter asah-un, chule Paul chu thuseija apipui ahi jeh chun Mercury asah taove.
target: Barnabas they called Zeus, and Paul they called Hermes because he was the chief speaker.

source: Chuin khopi kotmaija a-houin uma Jupiter hou thempupa chun bongchal le pahchavui kotpi phunga ahin choijin, mipi chutoh amani houna-a chu tha dingin agotauvin ahi.
target: The priest of Zeus, whose temple was just outside the city, brought bulls and wreaths to the city gates because he and the crowd wanted to offer sacrifices to them.

source: Ahivangin solchah teni, Barnabas le Paul chun hichu ajah lhon phatnin, apon asat-eh lhonin, mipi heng lama chun alhaijel lhonin, asam lhonin,
target: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul heard of this, they tore their clothes and rushed out into the crowd, shouting:

source: Vo miho, ibola hitobang hi nabol uham? Keini jong nang hotoh kithakhat mihem kahilhon bouve; chule hiti mohthil ho-a kona hi vanle lei twikhanglen chule asunga thil um jouse sema Pathen hing henga nakiheina dinguva, Kipana Thupha kahung lhutpeh nahiuve.
target: “Friends, why are you doing this? We too are only human, like you. We are bringing you good news, telling you to turn from these worthless things to the living God, who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and everything in them.

source: Hiche Pathen chun malaija chu namtin vaipi jouse hi aningnop cheh-a analhatsah ahi.
target: In the past, he let all nations go their own way.

source: Ahivangin ama hettohsahna beijin anaumpoi, Hitichun phatna abol jingin, van'a kon gotwi le ima ga phatle anneh eipeuvin, ilungthimu kipa thanop na-in adimsahjin ahi, ati lhone.
target: Yet he has not left himself without testimony: He has shown kindness by giving you rain from heaven and crops in their seasons; he provides you with plenty of food and fills your hearts with joy.”

source: Thu hicheng chu asei lhona konchun, nah nah-in amani houna-a gan tha ding go-a mipi chu akham jou lhonin ahi.
target: Even with these words, they had difficulty keeping the crowd from sacrificing to them.

source: Chuin Antioch le Iconium'a konin Juda mi phabep hilama chun ahungun, mipi ho chu atilseuvin, Paul chu songin asesah-un, athi ahitai tin, khopi pam lama akaidoh taove.
target: Then some Jews came from Antioch and Iconium and won the crowd over. They stoned Paul and dragged him outside the city, thinking he was dead.

source: Ahivangin seijui ho akimvela adin pettah-un, ama athoudoh-in, khopi sungah aluttai. Chuin ajing nikhon Barnabas toh Derbe jondin akipatdoh lhontai.
target: But after the disciples had gathered around him, he got up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas left for Derbe.

source: Chuin amanin chuche khopi-a chu Kipana Thupha ahillhangle lhona, mi tamtah ahil lhon jouvin, Lystra, Iconium, chule Antioch lama akile kit lhonin,
target: They preached the gospel in that city and won a large number of disciples. Then they returned to Lystra, Iconium and Antioch,

source: Genthei hesoh tamtah thoh-a Pathen lenggama ilut dingu ahi tin seijui ho chu tahsana aumdet jing dingun thu ahil lhonin, alungu aphut detpeh lhontai.
target: strengthening the disciples and encouraging them to remain true to the faith. “We must go through many hardships to enter the kingdom of God,” they said.

source: Chule amanin houbung tina upaho apansah lhona, an angola atao jouvun, atahsanpao Pakai henga chun amahochu apedoh lhontai.
target: Paul and Barnabas appointed elders for them in each church and, with prayer and fasting, committed them to the Lord, in whom they had put their trust.

source: Chuin Pisidia gam achonsoh lhon phatnin, Pamphylia'a ache lhonin,
target: After going through Pisidia, they came into Pamphylia,

source: Perga-a thu ahil lhon jouvin, Attalia lama ache lhontai.
target: and when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.

source: Chuin chua kon chun kongin akitol lhonin, ahin tohchai lhon chu tong dinga Pathen lungsetna-a akipehdohna lhon Antioch kho-a chun ache lhontan ahi.
target: From Attalia they sailed back to Antioch, where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work they had now completed.

source: Chukom alhun lhon phatnin, houbung miho akhom lhonin, Pathen'in amani mangcha-a athilbol jouse le chidang namdangho dinga tahsan kot ahonpeh umchanje chu ahetsah lhontan ahi.
target: On arriving there, they gathered the church together and reported all that God had done through them and how he had opened a door of faith to the Gentiles.

source: Chuin amani chu seijui ho toh sottah aumkhom lhontai.
target: And they stayed there a long time with the disciples.

source: Chuin Juda gama konin mi phabep ahungsuh-un, Mosi chonna danthu peh dungjuija chep natan louvule huhhing-a naumthei lou dingu ahi, atin sopiho ahung hilun ahi.
target: Certain people came down from Judea to Antioch and were teaching the believers: “Unless you are circumcised, according to the custom taught by Moses, you cannot be saved.”

source: Hijeh chun Paul le Barnabas chu amahotoh hatah-in akinel baotam jingtaovin ahile, hiche thudola chun Paul le Barnabas chu alah uva mi phabep toh Jerusalem'a solchah ho le upaho henga gacheuhen tin thu alhuhsah taove.
target: This brought Paul and Barnabas into sharp dispute and debate with them. So Paul and Barnabas were appointed, along with some other believers, to go up to Jerusalem to see the apostles and elders about this question.

source: Chuin houbung mihon amaho chu agathah-un ahile, amahon Phoenicia le Samaria gam ajotpeh-un, chidang namdangho lunghei thu chu aseijun, sopite jouse abonchauvin hapan akipasah taove.
target: The church sent them on their way, and as they traveled through Phoenicia and Samaria, they told how the Gentiles had been converted. This news made all the believers very glad.

source: Chuin Jerusalem alhunun, houbung le solchah ho, chule upaho chengsen amaho chu anasangui; chuin Pathen'in amani mangcha-a thil abol umchan chu asei lhontan ahi.
target: When they came to Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church and the apostles and elders, to whom they reported everything God had done through them.

source: Ahivangin atahsana Pharisai loi koi koiham akipat doh-un, hiche miho chu thonmo-a cheptana, chule Mosi danthu peh nitsah ding ahi, atiuve.
target: Then some of the believers who belonged to the party of the Pharisees stood up and said, “The Gentiles must be circumcised and required to keep the law of Moses.”

source: Chuin solchah ho le upaho hiche thu ngaito ding chun akikhom taove.
target: The apostles and elders met to consider this question.

source: Chuin tamtah-in akinelun ahile, Peter akipatdoh-in ajah uvah, Miho chule sopiteho, chidang namdang hon keima kama kona kipana thupha ajah uva atahsanna dingun, masangpeh chun Pathen'in eiho lah-a keima eilhengdoh chu nanghon naheuve.
target: After much discussion, Peter got up and addressed them: “Brothers, you know that some time ago God made a choice among you that the Gentiles might hear from my lips the message of the gospel and believe.

source: Chule milungsung he-a Pathen'in eiho eipeh bangun, amaho jong chu Lhagao Theng apen, amaho chu ahettoh sahtan;
target: God, who knows the heart, showed that he accepted them by giving the Holy Spirit to them, just as he did to us.

source: Chule eihole amaho kah-a dat nei louvin, tahsan vangin alungsungu asuthengin ahi.
target: He did not discriminate between us and them, for he purified their hearts by faith.

source: Chutichu ahile ipi dinga ipu ipateovin jong, eiho jengin jong nipoh jou louvu namkoljon chu seijui ho lenga naseuva Pathen napatepmu ham?
target: Now then, why do you try to test God by putting on the necks of Gentiles a yoke that neither we nor our ancestors have been able to bear?

source: Ahin amaho bang chun eihon jong Pakai Jesu Christa lungset vanga huhhing-a umding itahsan ui, ati.
target: No! We believe it is through the grace of our Lord Jesus that we are saved, just as they are.”

source: Chuphat chun mipi chu athipbeh-un, Barnabas le Paul'in Pathen'in amani amanchah-a, chidang namdangho lah-a melchihna le thil kidang dang abol thu asei lhon chu angaijun ahi.
target: The whole assembly became silent as they listened to Barnabas and Paul telling about the signs and wonders God had done among the Gentiles through them.

source: Chuin athusei athiplhon phatnin Jacob'in adonbutnin, Miho chule sopiteho, kathusei ngaijun;
target: When they finished, James spoke up. “Brothers,” he said, “listen to me.

source: Pathen'in amasa-a chidang namdangho avila, alah uva kona ama min pudin mi alhendoh thu Simon'in aseitai.
target: Simon has described to us how God first intervened to choose a people for his name from the Gentiles.

source: Chule hiche hi themgaoho thuhotoh akitoh-e,
target: The words of the prophets are in agreement with this, as it is written:

source: Hicheng nung chule keima kakinungle kitna, David houbuh alhusa chu kasahphat ding, Asekom jouse kasah phat kitna, Chule katundoh ding ahi.
target: “ ‘After this I will return and rebuild David’s fallen tent. Its ruins I will rebuild, and I will restore it,

source: Mi amoh chengse, chule chidang namdang kamina kikouho jousen Pakai chu ahol ding ahi, tin, hicheho jouse bolla Pakai chun aseije.
target: that the rest of mankind may seek the Lord, even all the Gentiles who bear my name, says the Lord, who does these things’—

source: Leiset kisem tilla patna anatohho jouse Pathen hetnin aumme.
target: things known from long ago.

source: Hijeh chun hitin kangaitoi, chidang namdangho lah-a Pathen henga kiheiho chu bol genthei pouhite;
target: “It is my judgment, therefore, that we should not make it difficult for the Gentiles who are turning to God.

source: Ahin milim houna thilboh neh, jonthanhoi, chule alol kimeh-a kithat saneh, chule thisan neh, hichenga kona chu akikangsena dingun sunjo leuhen kati.
target: Instead we should write to them, telling them to abstain from food polluted by idols, from sexual immorality, from the meat of strangled animals and from blood.

source: Ajehchu masang laija patnin Mosi'n khotinah athu hillhangle aneijin, cholngah niseh-in houin'a asimji naove, ati.
target: For the law of Moses has been preached in every city from the earliest times and is read in the synagogues on every Sabbath.”

source: Chuin solchah ho le upahon houbung pumpi chutoh, alah uva mi lhendoh-a Paul le Barnabas toh Antioch-a sol ding pha asauvin, sopite lah-a apipu Barsabas atiu Juda le silas alheng doh-un;
target: Then the apostles and elders, with the whole church, decided to choose some of their own men and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Judas (called Barsabbas) and Silas, men who were leaders among the believers.

source: Chuin hiti hin lekha asunun, amaho khutna chun athot taove: Solchah ho, upaho, chule sopite jousen, Antioch, Syria, chule Cilicia gama um chidang namdang sopiho kasalamui.
target: With them they sent the following letter: The apostles and elders, your brothers, To the Gentile believers in Antioch, Syria and Cilicia: Greetings.

source: Kalah uva konin koi koiham ahungun, chep natandiu chule dan ho nanit teidiu ahi, ahungtiuvin; thun nahung sulung jingun, nalungu asuchavaijui ti kanajaove; amaho chu keihon thu kapepouve;
target: We have heard that some went out from us without our authorization and disturbed you, troubling your minds by what they said.

source: Hijeh chun lungkhat pu-a kaki khopmu tolhonin, mi lhendoh-a, ideitah-u Barnabas le Paul,
target: So we all agreed to choose some men and send them to you with our dear friends Barnabas and Paul—

source: Pakai Jesu Christa min jala ahinkho settoh jinga um teni toh naheng uva hinsol ding pha kasaovin ahi.
target: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

source: Hijeh chun Judas le Silas kahinsol uvin; amanin jong hiche thu mama hi kamcheng tah-a nahil dingu ahi.
target: Therefore we are sending Judas and Silas to confirm by word of mouth what we are writing.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Lhagao Thengin pha asan, keihon jong pha kasauve, hicheng akhohlai chengse tailou hi pohgihsa dang pohsah lou ding katiuve;
target: It seemed good to the Holy Spirit and to us not to burden you with anything beyond the following requirements:

source: Nangho milim houna sa neh, thisan neh, alol kimeh-a kithat sa neh, chule jonthanhoi, hichenga kon hin kikangseleu chun katiuve; hichenga kon chun kikangseleu chun nangho dinga phading ahi. Anadamselun.
target: You are to abstain from food sacrificed to idols, from blood, from the meat of strangled animals and from sexual immorality. You will do well to avoid these things. Farewell.

source: Chuin amaho chu asoldoh phatnun, Antioch'a ahungsuh-un ahi: chuin mipi chu akhopkhom phatnun, lekhathot chu apedoh taovin ahi.
target: So the men were sent off and went down to Antioch, where they gathered the church together and delivered the letter.

source: Chuin amahon hichu asim jouvun, lungmonsahna thu jeh chun akipah taove.
target: The people read it and were glad for its encouraging message.

source: Chuin Judas le silas chun, (amani jong themgao ahi lhonin,) amanin jong thu tamtah-in sopiho chu alungmonsah lhonin, aphutdet lhonin ahi.
target: Judas and Silas, who themselves were prophets, said much to encourage and strengthen the believers.

source: Chuin chua chu chom khatset aum jou lhonin, solchah ho henga ding chun sopihon lung mongin alhadoh taove.
target: After spending some time there, they were sent off by the believers with the blessing of peace to return to those who had sent them.

source: Paul le Barnaba jong chu Antioch kho-a chun aumden lhonin, mi tamtah toh, Pakai thu chu ahil lhonin aseiphong lhontai.
target: But Paul and Barnabas remained in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached the word of the Lord.

source: Chuin ni phabep jouvin Paul'in Barnabas jah-a, Chen, Pakai thu ihilna khopiho chenga chun chehitin sopite gakimutopi hitin, iti um naovam gavehite, ati.
target: Some time later Paul said to Barnabas, “Let us go back and visit the believers in all the towns where we preached the word of the Lord and see how they are doing.”

source: Chuin Barnabas'in Mark atiu John jong chu puiding lung angaiton ahi.
target: Barnabas wanted to take John, also called Mark, with them,

source: Ahivangin Paul'in Pamphylia'a amani dalha-a, chule amanitoh lhona natonga cheta lou chu puiding pha asapon ahi.
target: but Paul did not think it wise to take him, because he had deserted them in Pamphylia and had not continued with them in the work.

source: Chuin akihanel ten taovin ahile, khat le khat akikhenlo taovin ahi; chuin Barnabas'in Mark chu akipuijin kongin kitolin Cyprus lama achetai.
target: They had such a sharp disagreement that they parted company. Barnabas took Mark and sailed for Cyprus,

source: Chule Paul'in silas akilhen doh-in, Pathen lungsetna-a sopite phatseina to thon akipatdoh tai.
target: but Paul chose Silas and left, commended by the believers to the grace of the Lord.

source: Chuin Syria gam le Cilicia gam ajotpeh-in, houbung ho aphutdet pehtai.
target: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches.

source: Chuin ama Derbe le Lystra alhungin; chuin veuvin, chu koma chun seijui khat amin Timothy kiti khat aumin, amachu atahsana Juda numei khat chapa ahin, apa vang chu Greek ahi.
target: Paul came to Derbe and then to Lystra, where a disciple named Timothy lived, whose mother was Jewish and a believer but whose father was a Greek.

source: Ama chu Lystra le Iconium'a um sopihon aseiphat lhehjengu ahi.
target: The believers at Lystra and Iconium spoke well of him.

source: Paul'in ama chutoh lhondoh ding lung angaito jehchun, apuijin chuche dunga um Juda ho jeh chun achep atanin ahi; ijeh-inem itile apa Greek ahi chu abonchauva ahetsoh keiju ahi.
target: Paul wanted to take him along on the journey, so he circumcised him because of the Jews who lived in that area, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.

source: Chuin amaho akho akhoa avahle avahleuvin, Jerusalem'a um solchah ho le upaho phudoh thupeh chu anit dingun asei phongle taove.
target: As they traveled from town to town, they delivered the decisions reached by the apostles and elders in Jerusalem for the people to obey.

source: Chutichun houbung ho chu tahsana-a akiphut detnun, niseh-in amijat apung chehcheh tan ahi.
target: So the churches were strengthened in the faith and grew daily in numbers.

source: Chuin Phrygia le Galatia gam achotsoh phatnun, Lhagao Thengin Asia gama thu agalhangsap dingu akhamin,
target: Paul and his companions traveled throughout the region of Phrygia and Galatia, having been kept by the Holy Spirit from preaching the word in the province of Asia.

source: Chuin Mysia kom ageijun Bithynia lut akigouvin, ahinla lhagaovin ajahnom pouvin ahi.
target: When they came to the border of Mysia, they tried to enter Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not allow them to.

source: Chuin chutichun Mysia ajotpaijun, Troas kho ajonsuh taove.
target: So they passed by Mysia and went down to Troas.

source: Chuin jan-in Paul'in mu aneijin, Macedonia mi khat adingin ahenga ataovin, Macedonia hung galkaijin lang neihung panpiuvin, ati.
target: During the night Paul had a vision of a man of Macedonia standing and begging him, “Come over to Macedonia and help us.”

source: Chutichun aman mu anei phat chun, Pakaiyin amaho chu Kipana Thupha hil dinga eikouvu ahi ti kaheuvin, chupettah chun Macedonia gama che ding kasompai taove.
target: After Paul had seen the vision, we got ready at once to leave for Macedonia, concluding that God had called us to preach the gospel to them.

source: Hijeh chun Troas'a konin kongin kakitolun, jangkeijin Samothrace kajon-un, chuin ajingin Neapolis kalhungun,
target: From Troas we put out to sea and sailed straight for Samothrace, and the next day we went on to Neapolis.

source: Chuin chua kon chun Philippi kalhungui; hichu Macedonia gamkol sunga khopi lenpen ahin, Rome miten alo-u khopi ahi. Chuche khopi-a chun ni ijat-jen ham kaumui.
target: From there we traveled to Philippi, a Roman colony and the leading city of that district of Macedonia. And we stayed there several days.

source: Chuin cholngah nin kulpi kot polama lui pangah, angaija taona kiman jina mun'a chun kacheuve; chuin kataovun, numei hung kikhomho jah-a chun thu kaseitaove.
target: On the Sabbath we went outside the city gate to the river, where we expected to find a place of prayer. We sat down and began to speak to the women who had gathered there.

source: Chuin amin Lydia atiu, ponsandup joh numei khat, Thyatira khopi-a kon, mi Pathen hou ahin, amanu chun kathuseiju ajatan; chuin Paul thusei ho chu lunglut tah-a angaina dingin Pakaiyin alung kot ahonpehtan ahi.
target: One of those listening was a woman from the city of Thyatira named Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth. She was a worshiper of God. The Lord opened her heart to respond to Paul’s message.

source: Chuin amale a-insung mite baptize achan jouvun, Pakai tahsan tahbeh-a neingaitou ahile, ka-in'ah hung lhungun, tin eijolun, kacham louhelun eilhunsah taove.
target: When she and the members of her household were baptized, she invited us to her home. “If you consider me a believer in the Lord,” she said, “come and stay at my house.” And she persuaded us.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, taona mun'a chu kacheuva ahile lhagao vop soh nungah khatnin eikito piuvin; ama chun khonung thusoh ding aseija, a-pakaite chu aphatchom sah lheh jeng ahi.
target: Once when we were going to the place of prayer, we were met by a female slave who had a spirit by which she predicted the future. She earned a great deal of money for her owners by fortune-telling.

source: Ama chun Paul le keiho eijuile eijuileuvin, Hiteho hi chungnung pen Pathen sohte ahiuvin, sochatna lampi nahung hilu ahi, atin asam asamjin ahi.
target: She followed Paul and the rest of us, shouting, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who are telling you the way to be saved.”

source: Amanu chun chutia chu ni tamtah abol ahi. Ahin Paul alung phamon, akiheijin lhagao jah-a chun, Jesu Khrista mina amanu sunga kona chu hungdoh dinga kathupeh nahi, ati. Chuin chupettah chun apotdohpai jengtan ahi.
target: She kept this up for many days. Finally Paul became so annoyed that he turned around and said to the spirit, “In the name of Jesus Christ I command you to come out of her!” At that moment the spirit left her.

source: Chuin apakaite chun phatchom ding akinepnao abeitai ti ahetdoh doh-un, Paul le Silas chu amanun, kailhang-ah vaipoho hengah akaijun,
target: When her owners realized that their hope of making money was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace to face the authorities.

source: Chuin thutan vaihomho henga ahin puijun, Hiteni hi Juda mi ahi lhonin, ikho sungu achohnoh lheh jeng lhonin,
target: They brought them before the magistrates and said, “These men are Jews, and are throwing our city into an uproar

source: Eiho Rome miten isandiu le ijop dinguva dan ngai hilou chonna dan sodoh ago lhone, atiuve.
target: by advocating customs unlawful for us Romans to accept or practice.”

source: Chuin mipi chu thakhat tah-in amani dounan akipatdoh taove: chuin thutan vaihomho chun apon lhon ahoh lha uvin, chule mola jep dingin thu apetaove.
target: The crowd joined in the attack against Paul and Silas, and the magistrates ordered them to be stripped and beaten with rods.

source: Chuin tamtah vei ajep jouvun songkul'a akhumun, songkul ngahpa chun bitkeija angana dingin thupeh anei taove.
target: After they had been severely flogged, they were thrown into prison, and the jailer was commanded to guard them carefully.

source: Chutitah-a thupeh amu jehchun, aman kihenna sungnunga akhumin, akenguva bul atuhtai.
target: When he received these orders, he put them in the inner cell and fastened their feet in the stocks.

source: Ahin jan khangkimin Paul le Silas Pathen henga atao lhonin, la asa lhonin ahile, sohchangho chun angai ngaijun ahi.
target: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening to them.

source: Chuin phulou helouvin ling hatah-in ahung kihot in, chutichun songkul chu abul ahot longgamin; kotkhah jouse akihong paijin, chule akihennao bul akilhamlha gamtan ahi.
target: Suddenly there was such a violent earthquake that the foundations of the prison were shaken. At once all the prison doors flew open, and everyone’s chains came loose.

source: Chuin songkul ngahpa chu a-imut ahung khangin, songkul kotkhah ho akihon amuphatnin, sohchangho ajama ahitai atin, chemjam alan ama kithat akigotai.
target: The jailer woke up, and when he saw the prison doors open, he drew his sword and was about to kill himself because he thought the prisoners had escaped.

source: Ahivangin Paul'in, hasapmin asamin, Nangma kisuse hih-in, keiho kabon chaovin hikoma kaum naove, ati.
target: But Paul shouted, “Don’t harm yourself! We are all here!”

source: Chuin aman meivah athumin, songkul sungah alhailut jel-in, kithing thing pumin, Paul le Silas angah alhu jengin,
target: The jailer called for lights, rushed in and fell trembling before Paul and Silas.

source: Chuin amani chu apuidoh-in, Puteni, huhhing-a umna dinga ipi kabol dingham, ati.
target: He then brought them out and asked, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”

source: Chuin amanin, Pakai Jesu Christa tahsanin, chutile huhhing-a naum ding ahi, nangma le na-insunga chengsetoh, ati lhone.
target: They replied, “Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved—you and your household.”

source: Chuin amanin amale a-insunga umho chengse jah-a Pakai thu asei lhontai.
target: Then they spoke the word of the Lord to him and to all the others in his house.

source: Chuin aman hiche pettah chun jan laijin amani chu apuijin, ajepnau maha chu asoppeh-in; chule a-insunga chengsetoh hiche pettah chun baptize achangpai taove.
target: At that hour of the night the jailer took them and washed their wounds; then immediately he and all his household were baptized.

source: Chuin amani chu a-in'a apuitouvin, a-ang lhonah nehding aluipeh-in; Pathen atahsan jeh chun ama chu a-insunga chengsetoh akipah lheh jengun ahi.
target: The jailer brought them into his house and set a meal before them; he was filled with joy because he had come to believe in God—he and his whole household.

source: Chuin ni aso phatnin thutan vaihomhon sottol mimanho chu asolun; Miho chu lhatauvin, agatisah-ui.
target: When it was daylight, the magistrates sent their officers to the jailer with the order: “Release those men.”

source: Chuin songkul ngahpa chun hiche thu chu Paul jah-a aseijin, Thutan vaihomhon nangni lhadohna ding thu ahin petaove; hijeh chun lung mongin che lhontan, ati.
target: The jailer told Paul, “The magistrates have ordered that you and Silas be released. Now you can leave. Go in peace.”

source: Ahivangin Paul'in amaho jah-a chun, Keini Rome mi kihia, themna themona photoh louva japi ang sunga eivoh uva, songkul'a eikhumu ahin; tu-a guhthima lhadoh ding eigotnu ham? Chuti theiponte; amaho mong hunguhen, amahotah-in eihung lhauhen, ati.
target: But Paul said to the officers: “They beat us publicly without a trial, even though we are Roman citizens, and threw us into prison. And now do they want to get rid of us quietly? No! Let them come themselves and escort us out.”

source: Chuin sottol mimanho chun thutan vaihomho hengah hiche thu chu agalhut taove; hichun amani Rome mi ahi lhon chu ahetdoh phatnun akicha taove.
target: The officers reported this to the magistrates, and when they heard that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens, they were alarmed.

source: Chuin amaho ahungun amani chu ahung jolun, khopi-a kona chedoh dingin ajoltauve.
target: They came to appease them and escorted them from the prison, requesting them to leave the city.

source: Hitichun songkul'a konin apotdoh-un, Lydia in'a chun alut taove; chuin sopiho chu amulhon phatnin, amaho chu alungmonsah lhonin, akipatdoh lhontai.
target: After Paul and Silas came out of the prison, they went to Lydia’s house, where they met with the brothers and sisters and encouraged them. Then they left.

source: Chuin Amphipolis le Apollonia ajotpaijun, Juda ho kikhopna in umna Thessalonica alhungun;
target: When Paul and his companions had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.

source: Chuin Paul achon ngai bangin ahenguva achen, cholngah ni thum Pathen lekhabua konin akihoulimpin,
target: As was his custom, Paul went into the synagogue, and on three Sabbath days he reasoned with them from the Scriptures,

source: Christa chun gim genthei athoh-a athi lah-a kona thoudoh kit ding mong ahi tin aphongdoh-in, avetsah-in chule ahilchenin; chuin, Najah uva kasei Jesu hi hiche Christa chu ahi, ati.
target: explaining and proving that the Messiah had to suffer and rise from the dead. “This Jesus I am proclaiming to you is the Messiah,” he said.

source: Chuin alah uva mi kimkhat le, Pathen ngaisah Greek miho, chule numei pipuiho tamtah-in ajoptaovin, Paul le Silas lama akaitaove.
target: Some of the Jews were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, as did a large number of God-fearing Greeks and quite a few prominent women.

source: Ahivangin Juda atahsanlou hon thangset lungin kailhanga migilou thasehon koi koiham akipuijun, mipi hon khat akhomun, khopi sung chu achohnoh-un, Jason in abuluvin, amani chu miho henga hinkaidoh dingin aholtauve.
target: But other Jews were jealous; so they rounded up some bad characters from the marketplace, formed a mob and started a riot in the city. They rushed to Jason’s house in search of Paul and Silas in order to bring them out to the crowd.

source: Ahivangin amani chu amulou phatnun, Jason le sopite koi koiham chu khopi sung vaipoho henga akaijun, kho asamun, Vannoi chohseho chu hikoma jong ahung lhungtaove;
target: But when they did not find them, they dragged Jason and some other believers before the city officials, shouting: “These men who have caused trouble all over the world have now come here,

source: Chule hiche Jason hin a-in'a alhunsah-in, chule Jesu atiu leng chom khat aume atiuvin, Ceasar thupeh nelkal lenan achon sohkeijui, atiuve.
target: and Jason has welcomed them into his house. They are all defying Caesar’s decrees, saying that there is another king, one called Jesus.”

source: Hicheng thu chu ajah phatnun, mipi chengsele khopi sung vaipoho jong chu aboi lheh jengtaove.
target: When they heard this, the crowd and the city officials were thrown into turmoil.

source: Chuin Jason le adang danghoa kon chun amaho khelin jamin alauvin alhadoh taove.
target: Then they made Jason and the others post bond and let them go.

source: Chuin sopihon geisang louvin ajan jan-in Paul le Silas chu Beria khopi lama asoltaove. Amani chukom alhun lhonin Juda ho kikhopna-a ache lhonin ahi.
target: As soon as it was night, the believers sent Paul and Silas away to Berea. On arriving there, they went to the Jewish synagogue.

source: Amaho chu Thessalonica miho sang chun aphajovin, lung kipahtah-in thu chu asangun, hichu hinam hilouham ti hetna dingin, niseh-in Pathen lekhabu-ah aholjiuve.
target: Now the Berean Jews were of more noble character than those in Thessalonica, for they received the message with great eagerness and examined the Scriptures every day to see if what Paul said was true.

source: Hijeh chun alah uva tamtah-in atahsan taovin, Greek miho lah-a ja-um numei le pasal tamtah-in jong atahsan taovin ahi.
target: As a result, many of them believed, as did also a number of prominent Greek women and many Greek men.

source: Ahin Beria-a jong Paul'in Pathen thu ahiltai ti Thessalonica Juda hon ajauvin, chukom gei chun ahungun, mipi chu ahung tilseuvin achohnoh kit taove.
target: But when the Jews in Thessalonica learned that Paul was preaching the word of God at Berea, some of them went there too, agitating the crowds and stirring them up.

source: Hiche pettah chun sopihon geisang louvin Paul twikhanglen lama che dingin asolpai taove; Silas le Timothy vang chu chukoma chun aumden lhone.
target: The believers immediately sent Paul to the coast, but Silas and Timothy stayed at Berea.

source: Chuin Paul gathahho chun Athen geijin apuijun; chuin Silas le Timothy chu agan nathei pena kahenga ahungloi lhon nading thupeh apouvin, akile kit taove.
target: Those who escorted Paul brought him to Athens and then left with instructions for Silas and Timothy to join him as soon as possible.

source: Chuin Paul'in Athen kho-a amani chu anga sungin, khopi-a chu semthu milim adimset amun, alung asoujahtai.
target: While Paul was waiting for them in Athens, he was greatly distressed to see that the city was full of idols.

source: Hijeh chun kikhopna in'ah Juda hole Pathen ngaisahho akinelpijin, kailhang mun'a jong amuchan chu aneljin ahi.
target: So he reasoned in the synagogue with both Jews and God-fearing Greeks, as well as in the marketplace day by day with those who happened to be there.

source: Chuin Epicurean mile Stoic mi lah-a mithem miching koi koihamin jong ama chu akinelpi jiuvin; chule abangin, hiche kamtam belbul hin ipi sei ding agot hinganai, atiuvin; adang kimkhat chun, Jesu thule thokit thu aseile jeh chun, gamdang houho thuhil hile akilome, atiuve;
target: A group of Epicurean and Stoic philosophers began to debate with him. Some of them asked, “What is this babbler trying to say?” Others remarked, “He seems to be advocating foreign gods.” They said this because Paul was preaching the good news about Jesus and the resurrection.

source: Chuin ama chu apuijun, Areopagus'ah ahin puilutnun, ajah-a, Hiche thuhil thah thu nasei hi, kahet thei dinguham?
target: Then they took him and brought him to a meeting of the Areopagus, where they said to him, “May we know what this new teaching is that you are presenting?

source: Ijeh-inem itile nangman datmo thil kidang dang kana uvah neijah sah-ui; hiche thil hi ipi tina ahi aumje chu kahet nomui, atiuve.
target: You are bringing some strange ideas to our ears, and we would like to know what they mean.”

source: (Ajehchu chuche Athen miho chule chua cheng gamdang miho jouse chu akiman chanuva imadang bol louva, thu thah seina ahiloule ngaina-a aphat amanjiu ahi).
target: (All the Athenians and the foreigners who lived there spent their time doing nothing but talking about and listening to the latest ideas.)

source: Chuin Paul Areopagus lailunga adingin, hiche thuhi aseije, Nangho Athen miho, imalam jouse-ah nangho hi hou ngaisahtah nahiuve ti kahedoh-e.
target: Paul then stood up in the meeting of the Areopagus and said: “People of Athens! I see that in every way you are very religious.

source: Ijeh-inem itile nahouho chengseu kavetle-a ahile, HETPHAHLOU PATHEN DING tia kisun maicham khat kamui. Hijeh-a chu nanghon het louva nahoujiu chu keiman nangho kaseidohpeh nahiuve.
target: For as I walked around and looked carefully at your objects of worship, I even found an altar with this inscription: to an unknown god . So you are ignorant of the very thing you worship—and this is what I am going to proclaim to you.

source: Vannoi leiset le asunga thil um jouse sema Pathen chu van le lei Pakai ahin, khutna kisa houin'ah achengpoi;
target: “The God who made the world and everything in it is the Lord of heaven and earth and does not live in temples built by human hands.

source: Chule ngaichat neija banga, mihem khutna jenle ding jong ahipoi; ajehchu amatah imajouse hinna, haina, chule ijakai pe-a joh ahibouve;
target: And he is not served by human hands, as if he needed anything. Rather, he himself gives everyone life and breath and everything else.

source: Chule leiset chung jouse losoh-a cheng dingin, thisan khatna konin vannoi mi chitin namtin asemin, amaho chu phat ateppeh-in, achennao jong gamgi asepeh-e,
target: From one man he made all the nations, that they should inhabit the whole earth; and he marked out their appointed times in history and the boundaries of their lands.

source: Amahon Pakai chu aholuva, amai amaijuva ijem tia amudoh theina dinguva chutia chu abol ahin; ama chu eiho koimacha-a kona gamlat umlou ahi:
target: God did this so that they would seek him and perhaps reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from any one of us.

source: Ijeh-inem itile eiho ama-a hinga, chatloh-a, chule uma ihiuve; nangho lah-a thuchih chom sun themho lah-a koi koiham jengin jong, Eiho jong ama son ihiuve, tin aseijuve.
target: ‘For in him we live and move and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘We are his offspring.’

source: Hijeh chun eiho Pathen son ihi jeh-u chun, Pathen chu mihem lung suhto-a sana, dangka, song kikheng milim tobanga ingaito ding dolu ahipoi.
target: “Therefore since we are God’s offspring, we should not think that the divine being is like gold or silver or stone—an image made by human design and skill.

source: Ihet lou laiju chu Pathen'in einavet thimu ahin; tu vangin gam jouse-a mi jousen alung aheina dinga thu apeh ahitai:
target: In the past God overlooked such ignorance, but now he commands all people everywhere to repent.

source: Aman nikho khat atep ahin, hiche ni chule ami tun chun chonphatna-a vannoi hi athu atan ding ahi; Ama chu athia kona akaithouva kona mi jouse ahet kichensah ahitai, ati.
target: For he has set a day when he will judge the world with justice by the man he has appointed. He has given proof of this to everyone by raising him from the dead.”

source: Athi thokit thudol ajah phatnun, abangin anuisat taovin, chule adangho vang chun, hiche thudol hi nanga konin ngai kitnaovinge, atiuvin ahi.
target: When they heard about the resurrection of the dead, some of them sneered, but others said, “We want to hear you again on this subject.”

source: Hitichun Paul amaho lah-a kon chun apotdohtai.
target: At that, Paul left the Council.

source: Ahinla mi kimkhat ama henga akaijun atahsan taove. Amaho lah-a chun Areopagus mi Dionysius le numei khat amin Damaris atiutoh, chule adang dangho jong ahiuve.
target: Some of the people became followers of Paul and believed. Among them was Dionysius, a member of the Areopagus, also a woman named Damaris, and a number of others.

source: Chuche nung chun Paul Athen'a konin apotdoh-in, Corinth-a achetai.
target: After this, Paul left Athens and went to Corinth.

source: Hiche lai chun Aquila kiti Pontus gama peng Juda mi khat, a-inneipi Priscilla to Italy gama kona hunglut til chu amun, (ajehchu Claudius'in Juda ho jouse aboncha Rome'a kona potdoh dinga thu apeh ahi): chuin amani henga chun achen ahi.
target: There he met a Jew named Aquila, a native of Pontus, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had ordered all Jews to leave Rome. Paul went to see them,

source: Amani chutoh akhut them natoh-u thakhat ahi jeh chun, amani koma chun alhungin, na atong khomjiuve; anatoh-u chu pon in sem ahi.
target: and because he was a tentmaker as they were, he stayed and worked with them.

source: Chule cholngah nisehle kikhop na-ah thu asuhtopin, Juda ho le Greek miho chu atahsan dingin ajoljin ahi.
target: Every Sabbath he reasoned in the synagogue, trying to persuade Jews and Greeks.

source: Chuin Silas le Timothy Macedonia gama kona ahung lhunsuh lhon phat chun, Paul chu lhagaovin apanpin, Jesu chu Christa ahi ti Juda ho henga chun ahettohsah tan ahi.
target: When Silas and Timothy came from Macedonia, Paul devoted himself exclusively to preaching, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Messiah.

source: Ahivangin amahon adoudaluva, ataitom phatnun, Paul'in apon athingin ajah uva, Nangho thisan nangho lu chungah chuhen; kei kangime; tu kalin chidang namdangho henga chetange, ati.
target: But when they opposed Paul and became abusive, he shook out his clothes in protest and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am innocent of it. From now on I will go to the Gentiles.”

source: Chuin chua kon chun achen, Pathen ngaisahtah amin Titius Justus atiu in'a chun alut tai; ama in chu kikhopna in kom cha ahi.
target: Then Paul left the synagogue and went next door to the house of Titius Justus, a worshiper of God.

source: Chuin kikhopna in vaipo pipu Crispus chun a-insung mi jousetoh Pakai atahsantai; chuin Corinth miho lah-a mi atama tamin ajauvin, atahsanun, baptize achang taove.
target: Crispus, the synagogue leader, and his entire household believed in the Lord; and many of the Corinthians who heard Paul believed and were baptized.

source: Chuin jan-in Pakaiyin Paul gaovin akimusah-in, Kicha hih-in; thu sei jing jengin; umthim hih-in;
target: One night the Lord spoke to Paul in a vision: “Do not be afraid; keep on speaking, do not be silent.

source: Ajehchu keiman nangma kaumpi jingnai, chule suhset dinga koiman nabulu lou ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile hiche khopi sunga hin mi tamtah kaneije, ati.
target: For I am with you, and no one is going to attack and harm you, because I have many people in this city.”

source: Chuin ama hikoma chun kum khatle lhagup aumin, amaho lah-a chun Pathen thu ahilin ahi.
target: So Paul stayed in Corinth for a year and a half, teaching them the word of God.

source: Ahin Gallio Achaia gam vaipo ahi laijin, Juda ho lungkhat akisauvin Paul dounan akipat doh-un, thutanna munah akaijun,
target: While Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews of Corinth made a united attack on Paul and brought him to the place of judgment.

source: Hichepa hin chonna dan ngailouva Pathen hou dingin miho ajol lhai, atiuve.
target: “This man,” they charged, “is persuading the people to worship God in ways contrary to the law.”

source: Chuin Paul pao ding akigotle Gallio chun Juda ho jah-a, Vo Juda ho, hiche hi suhkhel ahiloule khan gitlou thu hile, keiman namihehnau kangaipeh ding nahiuvin;
target: Just as Paul was about to speak, Gallio said to them, “If you Jews were making a complaint about some misdemeanor or serious crime, it would be reasonable for me to listen to you.

source: Ahin thu mai mai, min mai mai ahiloule, nangho chonna dan thu kibaona mai mai ahivangle nanghon kitan un, ajehchu keiman chutobang thu chu katan nompoi, ati.
target: But since it involves questions about words and names and your own law—settle the matter yourselves. I will not be a judge of such things.”

source: Chuin amaho chu thutanna mun'a kon chun anodohtai.
target: So he drove them off.

source: Hichun Greek ho chun kikhopna in vaipo pipui Sosthenes chu amanun, thutanna maitah-a avotaove. Ahivangin hitiho chu Gallio chun donin aneipoi.
target: Then the crowd there turned on Sosthenes the synagogue leader and beat him in front of the proconsul; and Gallio showed no concern whatever.

source: Chuin Paul chukoma chun sottah aum jouvin, sopitetoh akilhan, Priscilla le Aquila toh kilhonin Syria gam lama kongin akitoltai. Paul'in kitepna anei jeh-in Cenchria'a asam avouvin ahi.
target: Paul stayed on in Corinth for some time. Then he left the brothers and sisters and sailed for Syria, accompanied by Priscilla and Aquila. Before he sailed, he had his hair cut off at Cenchreae because of a vow he had taken.

source: Chuin Ephesia khopi alhunun, amani chu chukoma chun adalhatai: ahivangin ama chang kikhopna in'a alutnin Juda ho chu thu asuhtopin ahi.
target: They arrived at Ephesus, where Paul left Priscilla and Aquila. He himself went into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.

source: Chuin chukoma chu um sot jep dingin alhovin ahile ama anom hih-in,
target: When they asked him to spend more time with them, he declined.

source: Amaho chu alhan, Iti jongle kut ahunglhung dingpa hi Jerusalem'a kaman tei ding ahi; Pathen lunggot lam ahile naheng uva hung kitnange atin, Ephesia kho adalhan, kongin akitoltai.
target: But as he left, he promised, “I will come back if it is God’s will.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.

source: Chuin Ceasarea-a akumin, achetouvin houbung chu salam agapen, Antioch-a ahung kilesuh kit tai.
target: When he landed at Caesarea, he went up to Jerusalem and greeted the church and then went down to Antioch.

source: Chukoma chun chom khat aumin, chua kon chun Galatia le Phrygia gam ajotpeh-in, seijui ho jouse aphutdetle tai.
target: After spending some time in Antioch, Paul set out from there and traveled from place to place throughout the region of Galatia and Phrygia, strengthening all the disciples.

source: Hiche lai chun amin Apollos atiu Juda mi, Alexandria-a peng ahin, thuseija themtah le Pathen lekhabua thua hattah, Ephesia'a ahungin;
target: Meanwhile a Jew named Apollos, a native of Alexandria, came to Ephesus. He was a learned man, with a thorough knowledge of the Scriptures.

source: Ama chu Pakai lampi thu kihila ahin, alungin agunchu lheh jengin, Pakai umchan thudol kichehtah-in aseijin, ahivangin aman John baptize chan thu bouchu ahen ahi.
target: He had been instructed in the way of the Lord, and he spoke with great fervor and taught about Jesus accurately, though he knew only the baptism of John.

source: Chuin kikhopna in'ah hakattah-in thu asei pantan ahi; chuin Priscilla le Aquila'n athuhil chu aja lhonin, a-in'a apui lhonin, Pathen lampi thu chu dihtah-in ahilchen lhontai.
target: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. When Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they invited him to their home and explained to him the way of God more adequately.

source: Chuin ama chu Achaia gama ache nomtan ahile sopihon atilkhouvun, chuin ama chu anasanna dingun seijui ho hengah lekha asuntaove. Chukom alhunin lungsetna vanga atahsanho chu nasatah-in akitopin ahi.
target: When Apollos wanted to go to Achaia, the brothers and sisters encouraged him and wrote to the disciples there to welcome him. When he arrived, he was a great help to those who by grace had believed.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Jesu chu Christa ahi, ti chu aman Pathen lekhabua konin aphot tohna avetsah-in, hakattah-in japi ang sungah Juda ho anel khup jengtan ahi.
target: For he vigorously refuted his Jewish opponents in public debate, proving from the Scriptures that Jesus was the Messiah.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Apollos Corinth khopi-a aum pet chun Paul'in sahgam lam achonlen, Ephesia ahung lhungin ahile seijui phabep amun ajah uva,
target: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul took the road through the interior and arrived at Ephesus. There he found some disciples

source: Natahsan uva chu Lhagao Theng nachannah-uvem? tin adongin ahi. Hichun amahon ajah-a, Lhagao Theng aume ti jong kajapouve, atiuve.
target: and asked them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They answered, “No, we have not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”

source: Chuin aman, Ahile ipiaba baptize changa nahiuvem, atile, amahon, John baptize chanin, atiuve.
target: So Paul asked, “Then what baptism did you receive?” “John’s baptism,” they replied.

source: Chuin Paul'in John chun miho jah-a chu, kanunga hunga Christa Jesu chu tahsanun atia lung heina dinga baptize achansah ahibouve, ati.
target: Paul said, “John’s baptism was a baptism of repentance. He told the people to believe in the one coming after him, that is, in Jesus.”

source: Chuin thu hiche chu ajah phatnun, Pakai Jesu minah baptize achang taove.
target: On hearing this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

source: Chuin Paul'in achunguvah akhut angamin ahile Lhagao Theng achunguva achutai; chutichun paotin pao tangin thu aseijun, lhagao thu jong aseidoh taovin ahi.
target: When Paul placed his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them, and they spoke in tongues and prophesied.

source: Amaho chu abonchauvin mi somleni ahiuve.
target: There were about twelve men in all.

source: Chutah chun Paul kikhopna in'ah alutnin, hangsan tah-in lha thum sungin thu ahilin, amaho chu Pathen gam thudol asuhtopin ajol lutnin ahi.
target: Paul entered the synagogue and spoke boldly there for three months, arguing persuasively about the kingdom of God.

source: Ahivangin mi kimkhat alouchala, tahsan louva, mipi angsunga chuche lam chu aseiset joh phatnun, amaho chu adalhan, seijui ho atum huijin, tyrannus school-ah niseh-in akihoulim pitai.
target: But some of them became obstinate; they refused to believe and publicly maligned the Way. So Paul left them. He took the disciples with him and had discussions daily in the lecture hall of Tyrannus.

source: Hitichun kum ni aumin ahile Asia gama chengho Juda hole Greek hon jong Pakai Jesu thu chu aja sohkei taove.
target: This went on for two years, so that all the Jews and Greeks who lived in the province of Asia heard the word of the Lord.

source: Pathen'in Paul khutnin thil kidang mainah abolsahpoi:
target: God did extraordinary miracles through Paul,

source: Chutichun ati chunga konin ultheh hijongle pon hijongle alauvin adamlou henga achoi jiuvin ahile, ahiveijun adalha jengun, lhagao bohho jong chu apotdoh jengji taove.
target: so that even handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched him were taken to the sick, and their illnesses were cured and the evil spirits left them.

source: Chuin Juda vahvei doithema kivei koi koihamin lhagao boh vopteho chunga Jesu min apanun, Paul'in athu ahil Jesu mina thu kapeh nahi, atiuve.
target: Some Jews who went around driving out evil spirits tried to invoke the name of the Lord Jesus over those who were demon-possessed. They would say, “In the name of the Jesus whom Paul preaches, I command you to come out.”

source: Chule Juda thempu pipui Sceva chate pasal sagi ho jongchun chutobang chun aboluve.
target: Seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, were doing this.

source: Ahivangin lhagao boh chun adonbutnin, Keiman Jesu kahenai chule Paul jong kahenai, nangho koi nahiuvem? ati.
target: One day the evil spirit answered them, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know about, but who are you?”

source: Chuin lhagao boh voppa chu achomin, amaho chunga achun, ajouvin, achunguva athanei jotan ahile, amaho chu chuche in'a kon chun asagoh keole mahapun ajamdoh taove.
target: Then the man who had the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all. He gave them such a beating that they ran out of the house naked and bleeding.

source: Chuin hichu Ephesia cheng mi jouse Juda min jong, Greek min jong ahesohkei taove; chule abonchauva chungah kichat achutan, Pakai Jesu min choisangin aumtan ahi.
target: When this became known to the Jews and Greeks living in Ephesus, they were all seized with fear, and the name of the Lord Jesus was held in high honor.

source: Atahsanho jong tamtah ahungun, athilbolu aseidoh-un aphongdoh taove.
target: Many of those who believed now came and openly confessed what they had done.

source: Chule doichoiho tamtah-in jong alekhabu chengseu ahinchoi khomun, mi jouse mitmun agouvam taove. Chuche agolhah hou chu asuhtoule dangka sangsomnga man ahi.
target: A number who had practiced sorcery brought their scrolls together and burned them publicly. When they calculated the value of the scrolls, the total came to fifty thousand drachmas.

source: Chutichun Pathen thu chu thahat tah-in akhangtouvin, athanei jotai.
target: In this way the word of the Lord spread widely and grew in power.

source: Chuin chucheng thu kichai jou chun, Macedonia le Achaia gam chu chotsoh-a Jerusalem'a che ding lung angaiton, Chua kache jou chule Rome jong kagaphah teiding ahi, ati.
target: After all this had happened, Paul decided to go to Jerusalem, passing through Macedonia and Achaia. “After I have been there,” he said, “I must visit Rome also.”

source: Chutichun alhachateni Timothy le Erastus chu Macedonia gama asolin, ama Asia gamah chomkhat aumdene.
target: He sent two of his helpers, Timothy and Erastus, to Macedonia, while he stayed in the province of Asia a little longer.

source: Hiche lai vel chun chuche lampi thudola chun thunoh mainah asohpoi.
target: About that time there arose a great disturbance about the Way.

source: Ajeh chu amin Demetrius atiu dangka kheng mi khat aumin, ama chun dangka'in Diana lim akhengin, khutthemho ding chun kiveina phabepcha aumdoh sahpoi.
target: A silversmith named Demetrius, who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought in a lot of business for the craftsmen there.

source: Chuin hiche mipa chun amaho chu amaho tobang natongho chengsetoh akou khomin, ajah uva: Miho, hiche ikiveiju hi ihao dohnao ahi, nanghon naheuve.
target: He called them together, along with the workers in related trades, and said: “You know, my friends, that we receive a good income from this business.

source: Chule Ephesia goh hilouva, Asia gam pumpi-a hiche mihempa Paul hin, miho khutna kisemho chu Pathen ahihih hele tia ajola, miho tamtah aheimang gamhi mu jong namuvin, he jong naheuve.
target: And you see and hear how this fellow Paul has convinced and led astray large numbers of people here in Ephesus and in practically the whole province of Asia. He says that gods made by human hands are no gods at all.

source: Hichea hin ikhut themu manlou ahung so ding kichat um jenggoh ahipoi; pathen lennu Diana houin jong hi nahsahmo-a hung kibola, chule Asia gam pumpile vannoi'in ahou amanu jeng jong hi, alet aloupina-a kona hung kiloilha khong ding ahi, ati.
target: There is danger not only that our trade will lose its good name, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be discredited; and the goddess herself, who is worshiped throughout the province of Asia and the world, will be robbed of her divine majesty.”

source: Chuin chuche thu ajahtah-un, alunghang behseh jengun, Ephesia mite Diana alene! tin asam asam jengun ahi.
target: When they heard this, they were furious and began shouting: “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

source: Chutichun akho thingin akilohsoh jengun, Macedonia gam mi Gaius le Aristarchus, Paul'in akholjin na-a alhonpi teni chu amanun, thakhat tah-in tot bolna in'ah alhailutpi jengui.
target: Soon the whole city was in an uproar. The people seized Gaius and Aristarchus, Paul’s traveling companions from Macedonia, and all of them rushed into the theater together.

source: Chuin Paul miho lah-a chu lut ding akigon ahile seijui hon achesah pouve.
target: Paul wanted to appear before the crowd, but the disciples would not let him.

source: Chuin Asia gamma hou lamkai Paul kiloipi khenkhatnin mi ahinsolun, tot bolna ina chu gakilulah louhel dingin akham chah kheh jengun ahi.
target: Even some of the officials of the province, friends of Paul, sent him a message begging him not to venture into the theater.

source: Chuin akikhomho chu aboilahlah jengun, mi atamjon akikhopmu chu ajeh ahepouve; hijeh chun kimkhatnin thu khat asamun, kimkhatnin thu chom asamun ahi.
target: The assembly was in confusion: Some were shouting one thing, some another. Most of the people did not even know why they were there.

source: Chuin mipi lah-a kon chun Alexander ahinkai doh-un ahile Juda hon malama asonui. Chuin Alexander'in mipi lama chun akhut ajah-in, akihona thu sei akigon ahi.
target: The Jews in the crowd pushed Alexander to the front, and they shouted instructions to him. He motioned for silence in order to make a defense before the people.

source: Ahivangin ama chu Juda mi ahi aheuvin, Ephesia te Diana alene! atiuvin; hichu nidan ni geijenin asam asam jengun ahi.
target: But when they realized he was a Jew, they all shouted in unison for about two hours: “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

source: Chuin khosung thusunpa chun mipi chu aphoh thipmin, Vo Ephesia mite, Ephesia mite khopi hi Jupiter-a kona hunglha pathen nu Diana le alim hou ahihi ahelou koi ummam?
target: The city clerk quieted the crowd and said: “Fellow Ephesians, doesn’t all the world know that the city of Ephesus is the guardian of the temple of the great Artemis and of her image, which fell from heaven?

source: Chuti chu ahin hichenghi seilep thei ahilou jeh hin, thipbeh-a naum uva, chule thu doptoh louva ima nabol dingu ahipoi.
target: Therefore, since these facts are undeniable, you ought to calm down and not do anything rash.

source: Ijeh-inem itile nanghon nahinkaiju miho hi houin chomma jong ahipouvin, eiho pathen nu seise-a taitoma jong ahipouve.
target: You have brought these men here, though they have neither robbed temples nor blasphemed our goddess.

source: Hijeh chun Demetrius le atohpi khut themhon mi koiham chunga thu aneijule, kihehna in honsan aume, chule gamvaipoho jong aumnaove; hikoma khun gakiheh taohen.
target: If, then, Demetrius and his fellow craftsmen have a grievance against anybody, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. They can press charges.

source: Thu dang ima naholu ahivangle, angaija kikhopna-a seitoh ding ahi.
target: If there is anything further you want to bring up, it must be settled in a legal assembly.

source: Tunia thunoh so thua hi ichunguva thu ahung umding kichat aume; hiche ikikhop lona penu chu hiche hi ahi tia idonbut thei nadiu aumlou jeh-in, ati.
target: As it is, we are in danger of being charged with rioting because of what happened today. In that case we would not be able to account for this commotion, since there is no reason for it.”

source: Chuin hichu aseijin, mipi ho chu alhadohtai.
target: After he had said this, he dismissed the assembly.

source: Chuin thunoh chu akichai jouvin Paul'in seijui ho chu agakou sah-in, amaho chu akoijin, Macedonia gama chedin akipat doh tai.
target: When the uproar had ended, Paul sent for the disciples and, after encouraging them, said goodbye and set out for Macedonia.

source: Chuin chuche gamkai sungse chu achonsoh-in, amaho chu thu tamtah-in atilkhouvin, Greek gam alhungtai.
target: He traveled through that area, speaking many words of encouragement to the people, and finally arrived in Greece,

source: Chuin chukoma chu lha thum acham jouvin, Syria gam lama kong'a kitola che ding agotle Juda hon achanlhih jeh-un, Macedonia jotpai ago kittan ahi.
target: where he stayed three months. Because some Jews had plotted against him just as he was about to sail for Syria, he decided to go back through Macedonia.

source: Chuin Asia gam geijin Beria kho-a Sopater, Thessalonica'a Aristarchus le Secundus, Derbe kho-a Gaius le Timothy, Asia gama Tychicus le Trophimus, hicheng chun alhonpiuve.
target: He was accompanied by Sopater son of Pyrrhus from Berea, Aristarchus and Secundus from Thessalonica, Gaius from Derbe, Timothy also, and Tychicus and Trophimus from the province of Asia.

source: Hiteho chu keiho masang-ah anacheuvin, Troas kho'ah eina ngah jingui.
target: These men went on ahead and waited for us at Troas.

source: Keiho vang chu cholsolou changlhah kut jouvin Philippi'a konin kongin kakitolun, ni nga nin Troas kho'ah ahengu kalhungui. Chua chun ni sagi kanichongui.
target: But we sailed from Philippi after the Festival of Unleavened Bread, and five days later joined the others at Troas, where we stayed seven days.

source: Chuin hapta kipat nikho masa ni changlhah hehbal dinga solchah ho ahung kikhop phatnun, Paul ajinga cheding akigot jehchun amaho chu akihoulimpin, khangkim geijin sottah thu aseije.
target: On the first day of the week we came together to break bread. Paul spoke to the people and, because he intended to leave the next day, kept on talking until midnight.

source: Akikhopnao indan chungnunga chu meivah tamtah uma ahi.
target: There were many lamps in the upstairs room where we were meeting.

source: Chuin bangkotna tou gollhang khat amin Eutychus kitipa chu ana-imu lhutai; Paul'in athusei aseisot jeh chun ana-imulhun, chung dan thum na-a konin noi lamah alhatan ahile athisan agaphongdoh-ui.
target: Seated in a window was a young man named Eutychus, who was sinking into a deep sleep as Paul talked on and on. When he was sound asleep, he fell to the ground from the third story and was picked up dead.

source: Ahivangin Paul akumlhan achungah aboh-in, apomin, Lungdong hih-un, anuhkai nalainai, ati.
target: Paul went down, threw himself on the young man and put his arms around him. “Don’t be alarmed,” he said. “He’s alive!”

source: Chuin Paul akaltou kitnin, changlhah ahehbalin, anen, sottah ahoulimin, khovah geijin ajah uva thu aseijin, chutichun akipat dohtai.
target: Then he went upstairs again and broke bread and ate. After talking until daylight, he left.

source: Chuin amahon gollhangpa chu ahingin ahinpuijun, lungmon mainah-in alungmong tapouve.
