target: The people took the young man home alive and were greatly comforted.

source: Chuin keiho kong lama chun kanache masaovin, Paul lalutpa dingin Assos jonin kongin kakitol taove; aman akenga che agot jeh-a aman chutia chu agontohsa ahi.
target: We went on ahead to the ship and sailed for Assos, where we were going to take Paul aboard. He had made this arrangement because he was going there on foot.

source: Chuin Assos kho-a eikisuhtopi phatnun, kong'a kalalutnun, Mitylene kahunglhung taove.
target: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and went on to Mitylene.

source: Chuin chua kon chun kakitolun, akit nin Chios jon kalhungun, anikit nin Samos kalhungun, Tragyllium'a kakichol paovin, akit nin Miletus kalhungtaove.
target: The next day we set sail from there and arrived off Chios. The day after that we crossed over to Samos, and on the following day arrived at Miletus.

source: Ajeh chu Paul'in Asia gama umsot ding anop lou jeh-a, kong'a kitola Ephesia khopi chu jotpai ding lunga agot jingsa mong ahin, ahitheile Jerusalem'a Pentecost mang dinga, kin loija che kigo-a ahi.
target: Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus to avoid spending time in the province of Asia, for he was in a hurry to reach Jerusalem, if possible, by the day of Pentecost.

source: Chuin Miletus-a kon chun Ephesia'a mi asolin, houbung upaho agakousah-e.
target: From Miletus, Paul sent to Ephesus for the elders of the church.

source: Chuin aheng ahung lhun phatnun ajah uva: Keima Asia gama kahungtila pat, nangho koma kaum lai sungse-a kaumchan chu naheuve.
target: When they arrived, he said to them: “You know how I lived the whole time I was with you, from the first day I came into the province of Asia.

source: Lungnem tah le mitlhi pumin, chule Juda hon eichanlhih jinguva kona kachunga chua thohhesoh pumin, Pakai lhacha na katongin;
target: I served the Lord with great humility and with tears and in the midst of severe testing by the plots of my Jewish opponents.

source: Chule phatchomna ding thil imacha nangho dinga ka-im beihelin kavetsah sohkeijun, jalhang le a-in tinah kahiljiuvin,
target: You know that I have not hesitated to preach anything that would be helpful to you but have taught you publicly and from house to house.

source: Juda ho hengle Greek miho henga jong, Pathen lama lunghei thule, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa lam tahsan dingdol kahetsahjin ahi.
target: I have declared to both Jews and Greeks that they must turn to God in repentance and have faith in our Lord Jesus.

source: Chule tun, veuvin, lhagaova kisoma Jerusalem'a che ding kahi, chua chu kachunga ipi alhun ding kahepoi;
target: “And now, compelled by the Spirit, I am going to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there.

source: Kikan le hesoh gentheijin eingah jinge ti Lhagao Thengin khotina eihetsah jingbou hi kahei.
target: I only know that in every city the Holy Spirit warns me that prison and hardships are facing me.

source: Ahivangin Pakai Jesu'a kona kanamu lhacha natoh, Pathen lungset kipana thupha hettohsah ding, chule ka tohding hi kipah tah-a kachai molso thei ding poule hiche hohin eisulinglao pouvin, chule kahinkho jonghi ka-itchapoi.
target: However, I consider my life worth nothing to me; my only aim is to finish the race and complete the task the Lord Jesus has given me—the task of testifying to the good news of God’s grace.

source: Chule Pathen lenggam thu kaseilea kavale kavalena nangho hin, kamai namu kit lou dingu ahi, ti hi kahei.
target: “Now I know that none of you among whom I have gone about preaching the kingdom will ever see me again.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu mi jouse thisana kona ngima kahi, ti tunia kahetsah nahiuve;
target: Therefore, I declare to you today that I am innocent of the blood of any of you.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Pathen thil ngaito jouse najah uva im kanei aumpoi.
target: For I have not hesitated to proclaim to you the whole will of God.

source: Hijeh chun Pathen'in athisana achohsa houbung vesui dingle ching dinga Lhagao Thengin napan sah-u, kelngoi hon chengse chungle nangmaho chung changah chingtheijun.
target: Keep watch over yourselves and all the flock of which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers. Be shepherds of the church of God, which he bought with his own blood.

source: Kache nungle ngei gilou nalah uva alutna, ahon hi ahoi lou ding kahei.
target: I know that after I leave, savage wolves will come in among you and will not spare the flock.

source: Chule nangho lah-a kona jong abang bang hung kipatdoh-a, amaho nung jui dinga seijui ho chu thu akaleh-a hila hung umding ahi.
target: Even from your own number men will arise and distort the truth in order to draw away disciples after them.

source: Hijeh chun nangho kigingpha jingun; chule keiman kum thum sunga mitlhi puma asun ajan nangho nabon chaova tilkhou kahai louhel chu geldoh jingun,
target: So be on your guard! Remember that for three years I never stopped warning each of you night and day with tears.

source: Chule tun, sopiteho, nangho sadoh-a khantousah theija, chule mi akisuthengho lah-a nangho gou chansah theija, Pathen le alungsetna thu henga kakhumu nahiuve.
target: “Now I commit you to God and to the word of his grace, which can build you up and give you an inheritance among all those who are sanctified.

source: Koimacha dangka, sana, nihchen ponsil kadei chapoi.
target: I have not coveted anyone’s silver or gold or clothing.

source: Ahi, kakhutteni hin keimale kaloiho ngaichat chan kaboldoh ji-e ti nanghon naheuve.
target: You yourselves know that these hands of mine have supplied my own needs and the needs of my companions.

source: Keiman ijakaija navettoh uva natho dingu kavetsah sohkeije; nanghon chutobanga chu natohgim uva ahatmoho phatna nabol dingu thu ahi. Lah sangin peh ochat aumjoi, tia Pakai tah-in asei jong chu geldoh jingun, ati.
target: In everything I did, I showed you that by this kind of hard work we must help the weak, remembering the words the Lord Jesus himself said: ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ ”

source: Thu hicheng chu aseijin adilsun, abonchauvin atao khomun ahi.
target: When Paul had finished speaking, he knelt down with all of them and prayed.

source: Chuin abonchauvin hakan akapmun, Paul angong koijun, achopmun,
target: They all wept as they embraced him and kissed him.

source: Kamai namu kit lou dingu ahi, atijeh tahchun alungse deh-un; kong mun geijin agathah taove.
target: What grieved them most was his statement that they would never see his face again. Then they accompanied him to the ship.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, keiho amahotoh kakikhen jouvun kongin kakitolun, jangkeijin Coos twikol kalhungun, akit nin Rhodes twikol kalhungun, chua konin kache paijun Patara kho kalhungui.
target: After we had torn ourselves away from them, we put out to sea and sailed straight to Kos. The next day we went to Rhodes and from there to Patara.

source: Chuin Phoenicia gama jonding kong khat kamuvin, achunga katouvun, kakitol taove.
target: We found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, went on board and set sail.

source: Chuin Cyprus twikol akimu phatnin, veilam ngan kapelun, Syria gama kache paijun, kong'a thil solhah ding aum jeh-in Tyre kho-a kaki ngaove.
target: After sighting Cyprus and passing to the south of it, we sailed on to Syria. We landed at Tyre, where our ship was to unload its cargo.

source: Chukom mun'a um seijui ho kaholdoh-un, chukomah ni sagi kanichongui. Lhagaovin ahetsah dungjuijun, amahon Paul chu Jerusalem'a che hihhen, atiuve.
target: We sought out the disciples there and stayed with them seven days. Through the Spirit they urged Paul not to go on to Jerusalem.

source: Chuin ni hijat chu kaum jouvun, kakipatdoh-un kachena dingu kamasot taove; chuin amaho abonchauvin ajiteu le achateu pumin khopi kulpam geijin eihung thah-ui; chuin twikhanglen kama kadilsuvin kataovun ahi.
target: When it was time to leave, we left and continued on our way. All of them, including wives and children, accompanied us out of the city, and there on the beach we knelt to pray.

source: Chuin khat le khat kakilhah jouvun keiho kong'a kakal taovin, amaho vang a-in lamuva akilekit taove,
target: After saying goodbye to each other, we went aboard the ship, and they returned home.

source: Chuin keiho Tyre'a kona twija kakholjinu kachai phatnun, Ptolemais kalhungun, twija kacheu kachaijui; chuin sopiho salam kaboh-un, amaho komah ni khat kaumui.
target: We continued our voyage from Tyre and landed at Ptolemais, where we greeted the brothers and sisters and stayed with them for a day.

source: Ajingin keiho Paul to kiloise chua kon chun kakipatdoh-un, Ceasaria kahung lhungun; sagiho lah-a kipana thupha seile-a khat, Philip in'a kalhungun, amato kaum taove.
target: Leaving the next day, we reached Caesarea and stayed at the house of Philip the evangelist, one of the Seven.

source: Ama chun chanu li aneijin, nungah theng ahiuvin, Pathen thu seiphonga pang ahiuve.
target: He had four unmarried daughters who prophesied.

source: Chukoma chu ni ijat-ham kaum petnun, Juda gama konin amin Agabus atiu themgao khat ahungin ahi.
target: After we had been there a number of days, a prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.

source: Ama chu kahenguva ahung lhun phatnin, Paul konggah chu alan akhut akeng akikanin, Lhagao Thengin hiti hin aseije, Hiche konggah neipa hi Jerusalem'a Juda hon hitia hi akanuva, chidang namdangho khutna apehdoh dingu ahi, ahung ti.
target: Coming over to us, he took Paul’s belt, tied his own hands and feet with it and said, “The Holy Spirit says, ‘In this way the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem will bind the owner of this belt and will hand him over to the Gentiles.’ ”

source: Chuin hiche thu chu kajah phat uvin, chukoma umhole keihon Paul Jerusalem'a che lou dingin kajol taove.
target: When we heard this, we and the people there pleaded with Paul not to go up to Jerusalem.

source: Chuin aman eidon butnun, nanghon ibola neika ka-uva kalung nasuhset nuham? Ijeh-inem itile Jerusalem'a kikan ding keogoh hilouva, Pakai Jesu min jala thi dinga jong kigosa dema um kahi, ati.
target: Then Paul answered, “Why are you weeping and breaking my heart? I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”

source: Aman keiho thu alah lou jeh-in Pakai lunggot got hihen katiuvin, kathip taovin ahi.
target: When he would not be dissuaded, we gave up and said, “The Lord’s will be done.”

source: Chujouvin kathilkeovu kakigot un, Jerusalem'a kachetou taove.
target: After this, we started on our way up to Jerusalem.

source: Chule Ceasaria'a konin seijui koi koihamin eijuijun; amaho chun amin Mnason atiu Cyprus twikol'a seijui lui, lhunna-a kanei dingpao chu ahinpuijui.
target: Some of the disciples from Caesarea accompanied us and brought us to the home of Mnason, where we were to stay. He was a man from Cyprus and one of the early disciples.

source: Chuin Jerusalem kagalhunun, sopihon kipahtah-in einasangui.
target: When we arrived at Jerusalem, the brothers and sisters received us warmly.

source: Akit nin Paul keihotoh Jacob henga kalutnui; chua chun houbung upaho jouse jong abonchauvin aumui.
target: The next day Paul and the rest of us went to see James, and all the elders were present.

source: Chuin Paul'in amaho chu salam aboh jouvin, alhacha natoh-a kona Pathen'in chidang namdangho lah-a thil abolsah jouse chu abanchan aseitai.
target: Paul greeted them and reported in detail what God had done among the Gentiles through his ministry.

source: Chuin amahon thu hicheng chu ajah phatnun Pakai avahchoi jun; chuin ajah-a, Sopi, Juda ho lah-a atahsan sang tamtah ahihi namui; chule amaho khu danthu lama gunchutah ahiuve.
target: When they heard this, they praised God. Then they said to Paul: “You see, brother, how many thousands of Jews have believed, and all of them are zealous for the law.

source: Ahin amahon nangma thudol, nangma hin chidang namdangho lah-a Juda ho chu Mosi dan thu pailhah ding thu nahilin, chapang chep atan lou dingu, chule chonna dan ngaija chon lou ding tin, nahil lei ti ajaove.
target: They have been informed that you teach all the Jews who live among the Gentiles to turn away from Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children or live according to our customs.

source: Hijeh-a chu iti ding hitam? Nangma hung ajah-ule mipi hung kikhom teidiu ahi.
target: What shall we do? They will certainly hear that you have come,

source: Hijeh chun thu khat seipeh-unge, hichu bolin; kitepna neija mi li hikoma hin kaneijui;
target: so do what we tell you. There are four men with us who have made a vow.

source: Amaho chu puijin lang nangma toh kisuthengun, chule asam vona dingu nangman sum toh-in; chutile nangma thudola athu jah-u chu ima hilou ahi, nangmatah chonna dan ngaija nachon chu amahon ahetsoh dingu ahi.
target: Take these men, join in their purification rites and pay their expenses, so that they can have their heads shaved. Then everyone will know there is no truth in these reports about you, but that you yourself are living in obedience to the law.

source: Chidang namdang atahsanho thudol vang, chutobang thil chu nitlouva, milim houna thil neh, thineh, akimeh lihtho sa neh chule jonthanhoi ja kona akikangse nadiuva kasut nuva kathotsao ahitai.
target: As for the Gentile believers, we have written to them our decision that they should abstain from food sacrificed to idols, from blood, from the meat of strangled animals and from sexual immorality.”

source: Chutah-in Paul'in miho chu apuijin, akit nin amaho chutoh akisuthengun, amaho khat cheh-a dinga thilto akito kahse-a akisuh thengna dingu nikho kichaina ding chu thempu gahetsah dingin houin'a alutnin ahi.
target: The next day Paul took the men and purified himself along with them. Then he went to the temple to give notice of the date when the days of purification would end and the offering would be made for each of them.

source: Chuin ni sagi alhin ding konchan Asia gama Juda ho chun houin sunga Paul amu phatnun, mipi chu abonchan atilseuvin ama chu amanun,
target: When the seven days were nearly over, some Jews from the province of Asia saw Paul at the temple. They stirred up the whole crowd and seized him,

source: Israel miho, neihuvin; hichepa hi ahi gamtina mi jouse henga, Juda mite le danthu, chule hiche mun seisele-a chu: chule chuche jeng hilouvin, houin'a Greek mi alutpin, hiche intheng hi asuboh-e, tin asamtauve.
target: shouting, “Fellow Israelites, help us! This is the man who teaches everyone everywhere against our people and our law and this place. And besides, he has brought Greeks into the temple and defiled this holy place.”

source: (Hichu masanga khopi sunga Ephesia mi Trophimus toh amuva ahile, Paul'in ama chu houin'a alutpia angaitou ahi).
target: (They had previously seen Trophimus the Ephesian in the city with Paul and assumed that Paul had brought him into the temple.)

source: Chuin akhothingin akiloh jengun, miho chu alhai khomun; Paul chu amanun, houin'a konin akaidoh-un; kotkhah ho chu akhahpai jengui.
target: The whole city was aroused, and the people came running from all directions. Seizing Paul, they dragged him from the temple, and immediately the gates were shut.

source: Chuin ama chu tha dinga agot laijun, Jerusalem khopi-a mi jouse aboije ti thu sepai vaipipo heng alhungtai.
target: While they were trying to kill him, news reached the commander of the Roman troops that the whole city of Jerusalem was in an uproar.

source: Chuin ama chun sepaiho le sepai ja lamkaiho apuijin, ahenguva alhaisuh taove. Chuin amahon sepai vaipipo le sepaiho chu amu phatnun, Paul avoh-u chu atangui.
target: He at once took some officers and soldiers and ran down to the crowd. When the rioters saw the commander and his soldiers, they stopped beating Paul.

source: Chuin sepai vaipipo chun ahin naijin, Paul chu atuh-in, thihkhao ni-a kan dingin thu apen; amahi koi hija chule ipi asuhset ham, tin adongtai.
target: The commander came up and arrested him and ordered him to be bound with two chains. Then he asked who he was and what he had done.

source: Chuin mipi lah-a chun akimkhatnin thuchom asamin, adang kimkhatnin thuchom asamun ahi. Chuin husan jeh-a thutah chu ahetdoh theilou phatnin, kulpi sunga pui lut ding thu apetai.
target: Some in the crowd shouted one thing and some another, and since the commander could not get at the truth because of the uproar, he ordered that Paul be taken into the barracks.

source: Chuin Paul leikalbi ageijin, mipi asousang behseh jeh chun sepaihon ama chu adoptho taove.
target: When Paul reached the steps, the violence of the mob was so great he had to be carried by the soldiers.

source: Ajeh chu mihonpi chun, sumangin, sumangin, tia asapmuva ajui lellul jengu ahi.
target: The crowd that followed kept shouting, “Get rid of him!”

source: Chuin Paul kulpi sunga apui lut ding konun aman sepai vaipipo jah-a chun, najah-a thu kaseithei dingham? ati. Chuin vaipo chun, Greek pao nahet em?
target: As the soldiers were about to take Paul into the barracks, he asked the commander, “May I say something to you?” “Do you speak Greek?” he replied.

source: Masang laija miho tilsea, mithat mi sangli gamthipma puidoh-a, Egypt gam mi chu nahilouham? ati.
target: “Aren’t you the Egyptian who started a revolt and led four thousand terrorists out into the wilderness some time ago?”

source: Ahinla Paul'in, Keima Cilicia gama Tarsus khopi-a Juda mi kahi, khopi maimaija mi kahipoi: chule nahenga katao ahi, miho jah-a thu kaseina dingin phalna neipen, ati.
target: Paul answered, “I am a Jew, from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no ordinary city. Please let me speak to the people.”

source: Chuin aman athusei ding aphalpeh phat-in, Paul leikalbi chunga chun adingin miho chu akhutnin ajapmin ahi. Chuin athipchet phatnun, ajah uva chun Hebrew paovin thu aseijin:
target: After receiving the commander’s permission, Paul stood on the steps and motioned to the crowd. When they were all silent, he said to them in Aramaic:

source: Miho, Sopitele Pateho, tu-a kakihona thu kasei ding hi ngaijun, ati.
target: “Brothers and fathers, listen now to my defense.”

source: (Chuin aman ajah uva Hebrew paova thu asei ajah phatnun, ahathip chehtauvin ahi).
target: When they heard him speak to them in Aramaic, they became very quiet. Then Paul said:

source: Keima Juda mi, Cilicia gama Tarsus khopi-a penga, hiche khopi sunga hi Gamaliel khophang bula seilena, iputeu ipateu chonna dan kikheltah dungjuija kihildoh-a, tunia nangho banga hi Pathen lama gunchutah kahi;
target: “I am a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city. I studied under Gamaliel and was thoroughly trained in the law of our ancestors. I was just as zealous for God as any of you are today.

source: Chule hiche Lampi mihohi thina geijin kabolsen, anumei apasal'in kakanin songkul'a kakhum jin ahi.
target: I persecuted the followers of this Way to their death, arresting both men and women and throwing them into prison,

source: Chujongle thempu chungnungle gamsung upaho jousen jong hiche thu chu eihetpiuvin; amaho-a kon chun sopiho henga dingin lekha kalan, Damascus-a um jouse talent peh dinga hinkana Jerusalem'a hintol dingin kachen ahi.
target: as the high priest and all the Council can themselves testify. I even obtained letters from them to their associates in Damascus, and went there to bring these people as prisoners to Jerusalem to be punished.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, kachele Damascus khokom kageijin sun kim dontah-in, phulou helouvin van'a kon vah nasatah khatnin kavel ahinsalvah soh jenge.
target: “About noon as I came near Damascus, suddenly a bright light from heaven flashed around me.

source: Hichun keima tolah kalhutai, chuin kajah-a, Saul, Saul, nangin ibola keima eibolsea nahim? tia seija aw khat kajai.
target: I fell to the ground and heard a voice say to me, ‘Saul! Saul! Why do you persecute me?’

source: Chuin keiman kadonbut nin, Pakai, Nang koi nahim? kati. Chuin aman kajah-a, Keima nabolset jing Nazareth Jesu kahi, ati.
target: “ ‘Who are you, Lord?’ I asked. “ ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you are persecuting,’ he replied.

source: Chuin kalhonpi ho chun vah chu amuvin, chule akichauvin, kajah-a thusei aw vangchu ajapouve.
target: My companions saw the light, but they did not understand the voice of him who was speaking to me.

source: Chuin keiman, Pakai, ipi kabol dingham? kati. Chuin Pakai chun kajah-a, thoudoh-in Damascus kho-a lutnin; chukoma chu nabol dinga kigo jouse aboncha kiseipeh ding nahi, eiti.
target: “ ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ I asked. “ ‘Get up,’ the Lord said, ‘and go into Damascus. There you will be told all that you have been assigned to do.’

source: Chuin vah loupi jeh-a chu kho kamu lou phatnin, kalhonpihon khutnin eikaijun, Damascus kaluttai.
target: My companions led me by the hand into Damascus, because the brilliance of the light had blinded me.

source: Chuin mi khat Anania, danthu dungjuija Pathen ngaisah, chule chukoma cheng Juda ho jouse seiphat chu kahenga ahungin, kakoma adingin kajah-a,
target: “A man named Ananias came to see me. He was a devout observer of the law and highly respected by all the Jews living there.

source: Sopi Saul, kho mutan, eiti. Chuin hiche pettah chun ama chu kamutan ahi.
target: He stood beside me and said, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ And at that very moment I was able to see him.

source: Chuin aman, Ipu ipateu Pathen'in ama lunggot lam he dingle, Michondih tah chu mu-a, Akam sunga kon sohdoh a-aw ja dinga napansah ahitai.
target: “Then he said: ‘The God of our ancestors has chosen you to know his will and to see the Righteous One and to hear words from his mouth.

source: Ijeh-inem itile nangman namule najah thua chu mi jouse hettohsah-a napan ding ahi.
target: You will be his witness to all people of what you have seen and heard.

source: Chule ipi dinga khongai nalai nahim? Kipatdoh inlang baptize changin, Pakai minin taovin, nachonset kisop lhah-in, eiti.
target: And now what are you waiting for? Get up, be baptized and wash your sins away, calling on his name.’

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, Jerusalem'a kakile kit phatnin, houin sunga kataole kagaochang tai.
target: “When I returned to Jerusalem and was praying at the temple, I fell into a trance

source: Chuin, kino-in, chule Jerusalem'a konin potdoh loijin: ijeh-inem itile amahon keima thudola nangma thuhil alah lou dingu ahi, tia kajah-a thuseija chu kamun ahi.
target: and saw the Lord speaking to me. ‘Quick!’ he said. ‘Leave Jerusalem immediately, because the people here will not accept your testimony about me.’

source: Chuin keiman, Pakai amahotah-in nangma tahsan ho songkul'a kakhuma kikhopna intina kavohji chu aheuve,
target: “ ‘Lord,’ I replied, ‘these people know that I went from one synagogue to another to imprison and beat those who believe in you.

source: Chule nathu hettohsah Stephen thisan aso pettah uva jong akoma kadina, thadia kaphatsah-a athat teho ponho kanachin ahi, kati.
target: And when the blood of your martyr Stephen was shed, I stood there giving my approval and guarding the clothes of those who were killing him.’

source: Chuin aman kajah-a, Kipatdoh-in, Keiman nangma gamlatah-a chidang namdangho henga kasoljoh ding nahi, eititai, ati.
target: “Then the Lord said to me, ‘Go; I will send you far away to the Gentiles.’ ”

source: Chuin chuche thu gei chun angaijun, chuin aw sangtah-in, Hitobang mi hi vannoi leisetna konin sumangin, ahinga umhoi ahipoi, atitaove.
target: The crowd listened to Paul until he said this. Then they raised their voices and shouted, “Rid the earth of him! He’s not fit to live!”

source: Chuin kho asamun, apon alehlhauvin, van lama leivui atheuvin ahile,
target: As they were shouting and throwing off their cloaks and flinging dust into the air,

source: Sepai vaipipo chun ama chu kulpi sunga pui lut ding thu apen, achunga chutobang tah-a akhosapmu chu ajeh hetdohna dingin, jepma patep dingin asoltai.
target: the commander ordered that Paul be taken into the barracks. He directed that he be flogged and interrogated in order to find out why the people were shouting at him like this.

source: Chuin savun khaova akantah phatnun, Paul'in akoma ding sepai jalamkai jah-a chun, Themmo sahna bei Rome mi jepding chu nangma dinga dan ngai hinam? ati.
target: As they stretched him out to flog him, Paul said to the centurion standing there, “Is it legal for you to flog a Roman citizen who hasn’t even been found guilty?”

source: Sepai jalamkai chun thu hichu ajah phatnin, sepai vaipipo henga chun agachen, Nathil bolgot nahin chigtheijin; ajehchu mipa khu Rome mi ahi, ati.
target: When the centurion heard this, he went to the commander and reported it. “What are you going to do?” he asked. “This man is a Roman citizen.”

source: Chuin sepai vaipipo chu ahungin ajah-a, Rome mi nahim? neisei peh-in, ati. Hivhun aman, Kahi, ati.
target: The commander went to Paul and asked, “Tell me, are you a Roman citizen?” “Yes, I am,” he answered.

source: Chuin sepai vaipipo chun, Keiman sum tamtah kapeh-a chamlhatna hi kachan ahibouve, ati. Chuin Paul'in, keivang ahisa penga kahi, ati.
target: Then the commander said, “I had to pay a lot of money for my citizenship.” “But I was born a citizen,” Paul replied.

source: Chutah-in athem amo hetdohna-a bolgim dinga kigosadem hochu hiche pettah chun akoma konin achemang taove; chule sepai vaipipo chun Rome mi ahi ahedoh-in, amatah-in akansah jeh chun akichatai.
target: Those who were about to interrogate him withdrew immediately. The commander himself was alarmed when he realized that he had put Paul, a Roman citizen, in chains.

source: Akit nin Juda hon Paul ahehnau thu chu hetchenna dingin sepai vaipipo chun ama chu alhamin, thempu pipuiho leh houvaipoloi aboncha kikhom dingin thu apen, Paul ahinpuilhan a-anguvah adinsahtai.
target: The commander wanted to find out exactly why Paul was being accused by the Jews. So the next day he released him and ordered the chief priests and all the members of the Sanhedrin to assemble. Then he brought Paul and had him stand before them.

source: Chuin Paul'in houvaipoloi chu ave changmelin, Sopiteho, tuni geija hi imalam jouse-a ase apha hekah sohkeija Pathen anga lung thengsela um kahi, ati.
target: Paul looked straight at the Sanhedrin and said, “My brothers, I have fulfilled my duty to God in all good conscience to this day.”

source: Anania thempu chungnungin akoma dingpa chu akam bengin asole.
target: At this the high priest Ananias ordered those standing near Paul to strike him on the mouth.

source: Chutah-in Paul'in ajah-a, Vo bang kiloibang, Pathen'in nang nadenjoh ding ahi; nangma dan ngaitah-a kathu tan dinga touva chuche dan chu napal lhah-a kei deng dinga mi nasol ham? ati.
target: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! You sit there to judge me according to the law, yet you yourself violate the law by commanding that I be struck!”

source: Chuin akoma dinghon, Nangman Pathen thempu chungnung chutia chu nahouset ong, atiuve.
target: Those who were standing near Paul said, “How dare you insult God’s high priest!”

source: Chuin Paul'in, sopite, thempu chungnung ahilam kahet lou ahi, ijeh-inem itile, nangin namite chunga vaipo chunga thuse sei hih-in, tin akisune, ati.
target: Paul replied, “Brothers, I did not realize that he was the high priest; for it is written: ‘Do not speak evil about the ruler of your people.’”

source: Ahivangin Paul'in amaho chu keh khat Saddukai ahia, keh khat Pharasai ahi ahet phatnin, houvaipoloi lah-a chun asamin, sopite, keima Pharasai chapa, Pharasai kahi; athiho thodoh kit kinep thua kathu kitana ahi, ati.
target: Then Paul, knowing that some of them were Sadducees and the others Pharisees, called out in the Sanhedrin, “My brothers, I am a Pharisee, descended from Pharisees. I stand on trial because of the hope of the resurrection of the dead.”

source: Chuin thu hiche chu asei phat chun Pharasai hole Saddukai ho akinelun, mipi chu akilangkhen taove.
target: When he said this, a dispute broke out between the Pharisees and the Sadducees, and the assembly was divided.

source: Ajeh chu Saddukai hochun thokit, vantil, chule lhagao hicheng chu aumpoi, atiu ahin, Pharasai hovang chun hicheng chu aume tia a-oiju ahi.
target: (The Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, and that there are neither angels nor spirits, but the Pharisees believe all these things.)

source: Hitichun apoh vengvung jengun; chuin Pharasai mi danthu sunho phabep adingdoh-un, anelun, Keihon hichepa agitlouna imacha kamupouve; lhagaovin ahim, vantil ahimin, ajah-a thu asei hikhat hihdem, Pathen to kidoupou hite, atiuve.
target: There was a great uproar, and some of the teachers of the law who were Pharisees stood up and argued vigorously. “We find nothing wrong with this man,” they said. “What if a spirit or an angel has spoken to him?”

source: Chuin hachang nela akinel phatnun, amaho chun Paul chu sattel unte tin sepai vaipipo chu akichan, kumlha suh-a alah uva kona lahpeh-a kulpi sunga pui lut dingin sepaiho chu asoltai.
target: The dispute became so violent that the commander was afraid Paul would be torn to pieces by them. He ordered the troops to go down and take him away from them by force and bring him into the barracks.

source: Chuin hiche jan chun Pakai akoma adingin, kicha hih-in Paul; ijeh-inem itile Jerusalem'a keima thudol nahettohsah banga hi Rome khopi-a jong nahettohsah ding ahi, ati.
target: The following night the Lord stood near Paul and said, “Take courage! As you have testified about me in Jerusalem, so you must also testify in Rome.”

source: Chuin khovah phatnin Juda ho akihou somun Paul itha masangseuvin anneh twidon bolpouhite, tin kihahsel in akihanlho taove.
target: The next morning some Jews formed a conspiracy and bound themselves with an oath not to eat or drink until they had killed Paul.

source: Chutia miphil dinga ki hou soma chu mi somli val hiuve.
target: More than forty men were involved in this plot.

source: Chuin amaho chu thempu pipuiho le upaho henga acheuvin, Keiho kihahsel khohtah-a kaki hahsel uva, Paul katha masangseuva imacha tep louhel dinga kihan lho-a kahitaove.
target: They went to the chief priests and the elders and said, “We have taken a solemn oath not to eat anything until we have killed Paul.

source: Hiche jeh chun tun nangho houvaipoloi toh athudol chu kichen cheh-a hettoh-a bolphat ding ngaitobeh kisao vinlang, jingle naheng uva ahinpuina dingin sepai vaipipo henga seijun; aman nangho kom ahinphah kah-a that dinga kigosa dema um kahiuve, agatiuve.
target: Now then, you and the Sanhedrin petition the commander to bring him before you on the pretext of wanting more accurate information about his case. We are ready to kill him before he gets here.”

source: Chuin achanlhih-u thu chu Paul sopinu chapan ajan, ahungin kulpi sunga chun alutnin Paul jah-a ahung seitai.
target: But when the son of Paul’s sister heard of this plot, he went into the barracks and told Paul.

source: Chuin Paul'in sepai ja lamkaiho khat ahenga akouvin, hiche gollhang hi sepai vaipipo henga puijin; ajehchu seinom khat aneije, ati.
target: Then Paul called one of the centurions and said, “Take this young man to the commander; he has something to tell him.”

source: Chuin aman apuijin sepai vaipipo henga achen, Hiche gollhang hin najah-a seinom aneije tin, sohchang Paul'in eikouvin nangma henga hin puijin eiti, tin agaseije.
target: So he took him to the commander. The centurion said, “Paul, the prisoner, sent for me and asked me to bring this young man to you because he has something to tell you.”

source: Chutichun aman akhutnin atuh-in achoma apuidoh-in guhthimin adongin, Kajah-a sei ding ipi thu naneijem, ati.
target: The commander took the young man by the hand, drew him aside and asked, “What is it you want to tell me?”

source: Chuin aman, Paul thudol hi kichen cheh-a dongtoh ding ngaito banga, jingle houvaipoloi kikhopna-a napuina dinga nahenga thum dingin Juda ho akilol taovin ahi.
target: He said: “Some Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul before the Sanhedrin tomorrow on the pretext of wanting more accurate information about him.

source: Ahin nangman amaho thu la hih-in; ijeh-inem itile mi somli valin, Paul itha masang seuvin anneh twidon bolpouhite, tin akihahselun, achanglhi jingui, chule tu-a hi kigosa dema uma, nangma thupeh mai ngah jinga um ahiuve, ati.
target: Don’t give in to them, because more than forty of them are waiting in ambush for him. They have taken an oath not to eat or drink until they have killed him. They are ready now, waiting for your consent to their request.”

source: Chutichun sepai vaipipo chun gollhangpa chu ahilchah-in, Kajah-a naphondoh thu hicheng hi koima jah-a sei hih-in, atin alhadohtai.
target: The commander dismissed the young man with this warning: “Don’t tell anyone that you have reported this to me.”

source: Chuin aman sepai jalamkai ni ahenga akouvin, hiche thuhi apei: Jan nidan ko-a Ceasaria che ding akenga che sepai jani, sakol sepai somsagi chule tengchoi sepai jani gotsan koijun;
target: Then he called two of his centurions and ordered them, “Get ready a detachment of two hundred soldiers, seventy horsemen and two hundred spearmen to go to Caesarea at nine tonight.

source: Chule Paul Felix gamvaipo heng bitkeija pui lhungna dingin, ama tousahna ding sa jong gotsademin koijun, ati.
target: Provide horses for Paul so that he may be taken safely to Governor Felix.”

source: Chuin hitihin lekha asune;
target: He wrote a letter as follows:

source: Claudius Lysias'in Lal chungnung pen Felix gamvaipo henga: Salam.
target: Claudius Lysias, To His Excellency, Governor Felix: Greetings.

source: Juda hon hiche mipa hi amanun, atha ding konun keima sepaihotoh kakonin, ama hi Rome mi ahi ti kahen kahuhdoh tai.
target: This man was seized by the Jews and they were about to kill him, but I came with my troops and rescued him, for I had learned that he is a Roman citizen.

source: Chuin ipi jeh-a aheh-u ahi ahehnao hetdohna dingin houvaipoloi kikhopna-a kapuije.
target: I wanted to know why they were accusing him, so I brought him to their Sanhedrin.

source: Hia chun thina theihoi le kikanna theihoi thudolin ahehpouve, amaho chonna dan thua asuhkhel amatdoh-u ahitoh-e.
target: I found that the accusation had to do with questions about their law, but there was no charge against him that deserved death or imprisonment.

source: Juda hon ama hi thadinga agot uva achanlhih-u kahetdoh phatna, khongai louhela apettah-a nangma henga kahinsol pai jeng ahi, chule ahehho jong nangma ang sunga ahehnau thu sei dingin thu kapei. Damtan.
target: When I was informed of a plot to be carried out against the man, I sent him to you at once. I also ordered his accusers to present to you their case against him.

source: Chuin sepaihon thupeh dungjui chun ajan jan-in Paul chu apuijun, Antipatris lama achepi taove.
target: So the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul with them during the night and brought him as far as Antipatris.

source: Ahin ajingin sakol sepaiho chu amatoh alhonsah-un, amaho kulpi lama akiletaove.
target: The next day they let the cavalry go on with him, while they returned to the barracks.

source: Chuin amaho Ceasaria alhunun, lekha chu gamvaipo chu apeuvin, Paul jong chu adinsah taove.
target: When the cavalry arrived in Caesarea, they delivered the letter to the governor and handed Paul over to him.

source: Chuin aman lekha chu asimin, hoi gampoh mi nahim, tin adongin, chuin Cilicia gam mi ahi ahetdoh phatnin,
target: The governor read the letter and asked what province he was from. Learning that he was from Cilicia,

source: Naheh ho jong ahung tengule nathu ngainange, ati. Chuin Herod inpia koi dingin thu apetan ahi.
target: he said, “I will hear your case when your accusers get here.” Then he ordered that Paul be kept under guard in Herod’s palace.

source: Chuin ni nga jouvin thempu chungnung Anania chu upaho phabep toh, chule Tertullus atiu thukalthem khattoh acheuvin, Paul ahehnau thu chu gamvaipo jah-a chun aseijui.
target: Five days later the high priest Ananias went down to Caesarea with some of the elders and a lawyer named Tertullus, and they brought their charges against Paul before the governor.

source: Chuin Paul agakouvun ahile Tertullus'in ahehnan achunga thu aseipanin, Nangma vanga lungmon chungnunga kalung monuva, chule nangma vaihom them vanga hiche nam mite hi imalam jouse-a phatdoh sah-a aumu kamu jeh-in,
target: When Paul was called in, Tertullus presented his case before Felix: “We have enjoyed a long period of peace under you, and your foresight has brought about reforms in this nation.

source: Vo lal chungnung pen Felix, a-imatih chanin hoikom hoikoma jong lung kipahtah-in kasangui.
target: Everywhere and in every way, most excellent Felix, we acknowledge this with profound gratitude.

source: Ahivangin nangma dinga theida um hiding kanompoi, kathu-u themcha kasei dingu hi nami lungsetna-a neingaipeh dinguva kataovu ahi.
target: But in order not to weary you further, I would request that you be kind enough to hear us briefly.

source: Ijeh-inem itile keihon hichepa hi mi sugam, chule vannoi leiset chung jouse-a Juda ho lah-a vaipi chohsea, chule Nazareth chona chonho lamkai pipu ahi kaman doh-un:
target: “We have found this man to be a troublemaker, stirring up riots among the Jews all over the world. He is a ringleader of the Nazarene sect

source: Chumale houin suhboh dinga jong agot jeh-a kamatnu ahin, kadannu dung juija athu katan diu dol ahi.
target: and even tried to desecrate the temple; so we seized him.

source: Ahehho nahenga hung dingin thu apen ahi. Amatah chu nangman dongtohle chun kahehnao hi adih adihlou abonchan hesoh keinan nate, ati.
target: By examining him yourself you will be able to learn the truth about all these charges we are bringing against him.”

source: Chuin Juda ho jong chun ajomun, hicheng chu ahicheh-e, atiuve.
target: The other Jews joined in the accusation, asserting that these things were true.

source: Chuin gamvaipo chun thu sei dinga Paul akhasuh phatnin, Paul'in adonbutnin: Kum sottah nangma hiche nam mite thutana panga nahitai ti kahen, lung kipahtah-in kakihona thu seijinge;
target: When the governor motioned for him to speak, Paul replied: “I know that for a number of years you have been a judge over this nation; so I gladly make my defense.

source: Nangman henan natin, Pathen hou dinga Jerusalem'a kachehi ni somle nini aval hihlaije:
target: You can easily verify that no more than twelve days ago I went up to Jerusalem to worship.

source: Houin sunga mi khattoutoh kakinel, ahiloule kikhopnale kho sunga mihonpi katilsetna imacha eimupouve.
target: My accusers did not find me arguing with anyone at the temple, or stirring up a crowd in the synagogues or anywhere else in the city.

source: Tu-a eihehnao chengse jong chu aphotchenna hiche ahi ati theipouve.
target: And they cannot prove to you the charges they are now making against me.

source: Ahin keiman nangma jah-a kaseidoh hiche hi ahi, Amahon houdan chom asah-u lam dungjuija keiman kaputeu kapateu Pathen chu kahouva, danthua le themgaoho lekhabua kisun dungjuija chu thil jouse katahsana,
target: However, I admit that I worship the God of our ancestors as a follower of the Way, which they call a sect. I believe everything that is in accordance with the Law and that is written in the Prophets,

source: Amaho jongin michondih jong michondih lou jong athi thokit umding ahi tia akat jingu, hitiho chu keiman Pathen lama kinepna kanei ahi;
target: and I have the same hope in God as these men themselves have, that there will be a resurrection of both the righteous and the wicked.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu Pathen le mihem lama suhkhel beija, ase apha hetkahna neija umdinga a-imatih chana kihabol jing kahi.
target: So I strive always to keep my conscience clear before God and man.

source: Chuin kum tamtah nunga kanam vaipiu min ahunau thilpeh le thilto hinpo-a hunga kahin;
target: “After an absence of several years, I came to Jerusalem to bring my people gifts for the poor and to present offerings.

source: Hichea chun Asia gama Juda hon houin'a kakisuh theng chu eimuve; mihonpi toh kaumpoi, chule thunoh baotam imacha jong aumpoi.
target: I was ceremonially clean when they found me in the temple courts doing this. There was no crowd with me, nor was I involved in any disturbance.

source: Amaho chu hikoma nangma anga hin umuhen, kachunga thu eihehna ding aneijule seijule hi ding ahi.
target: But there are some Jews from the province of Asia, who ought to be here before you and bring charges if they have anything against me.

source: Ahiloule hiteho hin seijuhen, houvaipoloi anga kadina chu kasuhkhel ipi amatdoh-um,
target: Or these who are here should state what crime they found in me when I stood before the Sanhedrin—

source: Alah uva kadina kho kasapma, athiho thokit thua tunia na-ang sunguva eikikouva eikidonga ahitai, tia kasei tailou chu, ati.
target: unless it was this one thing I shouted as I stood in their presence: ‘It is concerning the resurrection of the dead that I am on trial before you today.’ ”

source: Ahivangin Felix'in chuche Lam thudol chu ahetchet jeh-in, athu tan ding chu akhongaijin, Lysias sepai vaipipo ahung tengle nathu-u ngaito chen nange, ati.
target: Then Felix, who was well acquainted with the Way, adjourned the proceedings. “When Lysias the commander comes,” he said, “I will decide your case.”

source: Chuin aman Paul chu sepai jalamkai khat anga sah-in, chamlhat tah-a aumsah-a, ahenga hung ajenle dingle agol apaiho jong akham lou dingin athupeh-in ahi.
target: He ordered the centurion to keep Paul under guard but to give him some freedom and permit his friends to take care of his needs.

source: Chuin ni ijat-ham jouvin Felix chu a-inneipi Juda numei Drusilla toh ahungin, Paul agakou sah-in, Christa tahsan thudol asei chu angaijin ahi.
target: Several days later Felix came with his wife Drusilla, who was Jewish. He sent for Paul and listened to him as he spoke about faith in Christ Jesus.

source: Chuin aman chonphatna, kitim them, chule khonunga hung lhung ding thupi kitan thudol asei phatnin, Felix atija jahtan, adonbut nin, Tun chetan; keiman ka-on phatle nangma hungkousah nange, ati.
target: As Paul talked about righteousness, self-control and the judgment to come, Felix was afraid and said, “That’s enough for now! You may leave. When I find it convenient, I will send for you.”

source: Chujongle Paul chun sum eipentin kilhadoh tante tijong akinem min, phiveng vungin akousah-in ahoulim pijin ahi.
target: At the same time he was hoping that Paul would offer him a bribe, so he sent for him frequently and talked with him.

source: Ahivangin kum ni nungin, Porcius Festus'in Felix panmun chu ahinkhel tai; hichun Felix chun Juda ho deija umding ngaitonan, Paul chu akanin adalhatai.
target: When two years had passed, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus, but because Felix wanted to grant a favor to the Jews, he left Paul in prison.

source: Festus chuche gamkai sunga ahunglhun, ni thum jouvin Ceasaria'a konin Jerusalem'a achetouvin ahi.
target: Three days after arriving in the province, Festus went up from Caesarea to Jerusalem,

source: Chuin thempu pipuiho le Juda miho pipuhon ajah-a Paul chungchang thu ahilou lamin anaseijun;
target: where the chief priests and the Jewish leaders appeared before him and presented the charges against Paul.

source: Chule lampia anachanlhih uva anatha theina dingu lungthim ngaiton, ama chunga chu amaho alungsetnuva Paul chu Jerusalem'a ahinpuina dingin ataovun ahi.
target: They requested Festus, as a favor to them, to have Paul transferred to Jerusalem, for they were preparing an ambush to kill him along the way.

source: Ahivangin Festus'in adonbutnin, Paul Ceasaria kikoija ahi, chule keima khu lama chevah ding kahi.
target: Festus answered, “Paul is being held at Caesarea, and I myself am going there soon.

source: Hijeh chun ama khun suhkhel anei ahile, nalah uva thunei chengse keimatoh kilhonin hungsuh-uhen, hung heh-u hen, ati.
target: Let some of your leaders come with me, and if the man has done anything wrong, they can press charges against him there.”

source: Chuin amaho lah-a ni som val anichon nungin Ceasaria achesuh paijin, akit nin thutan na-a atouvin, Paul gapui dingin thu apetai.
target: After spending eight or ten days with them, Festus went down to Caesarea. The next day he convened the court and ordered that Paul be brought before him.

source: Chuin ama ahung lhun phatnin, Jerusalem'a kona hungsuh Juda ho akimvela adingun, Paul dounan thu gilou tamtah-in aheh-un, ahivanginla aphotchenna avetsah theipouve.
target: When Paul came in, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him. They brought many serious charges against him, but they could not prove them.

source: Chuin Paul'in ama kihonna thu aseijin, Juda ho danthu ahin, houin ahin, ahiloule Ceasar douna ahin, keiman imacha kasuhset kasuhkhel aumpoi, ati.
target: Then Paul made his defense: “I have done nothing wrong against the Jewish law or against the temple or against Caesar.”

source: Ahivangin Festus chun Juda ho deija umding angaiton, adonbutnin, Paul jah-a, Nangma Jerusalem'a chetouva khukoma keima ang sunga hicheng thudol hi ngaito-a umding nanop em, ati.
target: Festus, wishing to do the Jews a favor, said to Paul, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem and stand trial before me there on these charges?”

source: Ahinla Paul'in, Keima kathu kitanna dingdol Ceasar thutanna anga dinga kahi. Keiman Juda ho ima kasusepoi, nangman jong nahe sohkeinai.
target: Paul answered: “I am now standing before Caesar’s court, where I ought to be tried. I have not done any wrong to the Jews, as you yourself know very well.

source: Chutia akhang gilou kahia, thina theiloma suhset nei kahile, thi ding kadapoi; amavang hicheng eihehna chengseu hi tahbeh ahiloule koiman amaho khutna eipedoh thei ponte, Ceasar henga ngehna kabole, ati.
target: If, however, I am guilty of doing anything deserving death, I do not refuse to die. But if the charges brought against me by these Jews are not true, no one has the right to hand me over to them. I appeal to Caesar!”

source: Chutah-in Festus vaibol chengsetoh akihoutoh phatnin adonbutnin, Nangman Ceasar henga ngehna nabol ahitan, Ceasar heng nache ding ahi, ati.
target: After Festus had conferred with his council, he declared: “You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you will go!”

source: Chuin ni ijat-ham jouvin Agrippa lengpa le Bernice chu Ceasaria ahung lhung lhonin, Festus chu salam ahung boh lhone.
target: A few days later King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea to pay their respects to Festus.

source: Chuin chua sottah anichong lhonin ahile, Festus'in lengpa jah-a chun Paul thu umchan aseijin, Felix dalhah sohchang kihen khat aumin,
target: Since they were spending many days there, Festus discussed Paul’s case with the king. He said: “There is a man here whom Felix left as a prisoner.

source: Ama chun Jerusalem'a kaum petnin thempu pipuiho le Juda upahon athu eihetsah-un, athu tana chai dingin kahenga athumui.
target: When I went to Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews brought charges against him and asked that he be condemned.

source: Akihehpale ahehho kimaito-a akihona thule ahehnau thudol seina neisah masanga mi koi hile thidinga pehdoh chu Rome mi chonna ngai ahipoi tia, amaho chu kana donbut ahi;
target: “I told them that it is not the Roman custom to hand over anyone before they have faced their accusers and have had an opportunity to defend themselves against the charges.

source: Chuin amaho hikoma ahung kikhomun ahile, keima jong chom khatcha geisang louvin akit ni maman thutan na-a katouvin, amapa chu kagakou sahtai.
target: When they came here with me, I did not delay the case, but convened the court the next day and ordered the man to be brought in.

source: Chuin ahehho chu akim vela adingun, akhan gitlouna thun heh-unte, tia kaginchat bang chu achunga thukhoh imacha aseipouve;
target: When his accusers got up to speak, they did not charge him with any of the crimes I had expected.

source: Amaho hou thudol leh Jesu atiu mithisa khat Paul'in ahing kitne ati thudola kinel ahibouvui.
target: Instead, they had some points of dispute with him about their own religion and about a dead man named Jesus who Paul claimed was alive.

source: Chuin chutobang thu chu atannaje kahevah hih-in, Jerusalem'a chea chuche athu chu tan ding anop anop lou kadongin ahi.
target: I was at a loss how to investigate such matters; so I asked if he would be willing to go to Jerusalem and stand trial there on these charges.

source: Ahinla Paul'in ama chung changthu Leng chungnung tandinga ngehna aneiphatnin, Ceasar henga kasol thei ding kahse-a koi dingin thu kapetai, ati.
target: But when Paul made his appeal to be held over for the Emperor’s decision, I ordered him held until I could send him to Caesar.”

source: Chuin Agrippa'in Festus jah-a, kei jong keimatah-in hichepa thu chu jaleng kalung ahi, ati. Aman, Jingle janavehta chun, ati.
target: Then Agrippa said to Festus, “I would like to hear this man myself.” He replied, “Tomorrow you will hear him.”

source: Chutichun ajingin Agrippa Bernice toh loupitah-a ahunga, thu ngaina inpia sepai Vaipipo hotoh khopi sunga miho pipu chengsetoh ahung lut phat lhonin, Festus thusah-in Paul chu ahin puilut taove.
target: The next day Agrippa and Bernice came with great pomp and entered the audience room with the high-ranking military officers and the prominent men of the city. At the command of Festus, Paul was brought in.

source: Chuin Festus'in, Lengpa Agrippa chule hikoma kaumpi mi jousen hichepa hi namuve, ama hi Juda mihonpin Jerusalem'a jong, hikoma jong kahenga aheh-un, ahinga umhoi ahitapoi, tin asamui.
target: Festus said: “King Agrippa, and all who are present with us, you see this man! The whole Jewish community has petitioned me about him in Jerusalem and here in Caesarea, shouting that he ought not to live any longer.

source: Ahivangin athina theilom ima akhan gitlouna keiman kamudohpoi; chule aman leng chungnung henga ngehna abol jeh-in sol dinga kagot ahi.
target: I found he had done nothing deserving of death, but because he made his appeal to the Emperor I decided to send him to Rome.

source: Ahin achungchang thudol ka pakai henga gahsut ding thu kichentah ima kaneipoi. Hiche jeh-a chu na-ang uva, Vo Agrippa lengpa, nangma ang sungtah-a kahinpuidoh ahi, ijem tia athu dohtoh nunga sutding themkat kanei theina dingin:
target: But I have nothing definite to write to His Majesty about him. Therefore I have brought him before all of you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, so that as a result of this investigation I may have something to write.

source: Ijeh-inem itile akihehna thu sun louva sohchang gahsol chu kitoh kasapoi, ati.
target: For I think it is unreasonable to send a prisoner on to Rome without specifying the charges against him.”

source: Chuin Agrippa'in Paul jah-a, nakihonna thu seitheijin nate, ati. Chutah-in Paul'in aban ajah-in, akihona thu aseijin,
target: Then Agrippa said to Paul, “You have permission to speak for yourself.” So Paul motioned with his hand and began his defense:

source: Lengpa Agrippa, Juda hon eihehna jouseu thua tunia nangma anga kakihona thu sei dinga kaum hi lungnom kaki salheh jenge,
target: “King Agrippa, I consider myself fortunate to stand before you today as I make my defense against all the accusations of the Jews,

source: Ajehpen chu nangman Juda ho lah-a chonna danle kinelna thunoh jouse nahet sohkeija, nathemsoh jeh chu ahi. Hijeh chun khongai themin kathu ngaijin tia katao ahi.
target: and especially so because you are well acquainted with all the Jewish customs and controversies. Therefore, I beg you to listen to me patiently.

source: Kachapan laija patna kanam mite lah-a, chule Jerusalem'a kanunchan kakhanchan chu Juda hon ahe sohkeijui;
target: “The Jewish people all know the way I have lived ever since I was a child, from the beginning of my life in my own country, and also in Jerusalem.

source: Atila patna ahet sohkeisao ahi jeh chun, kahou danuva chondan khelpentah dungjuija kachona Pharisai chona kachon chu sei nomleu asei thei dingu ahi.
target: They have known me for a long time and can testify, if they are willing, that I conformed to the strictest sect of our religion, living as a Pharisee.

source: Chule tu-a hi kapu kapateu Pathen'in athutep chu kineppi jeh-a athu kitan dinga hikoma ding kahi:
target: And now it is because of my hope in what God has promised our ancestors that I am on trial today.

source: Hiche thutep chu mu ding kinema, phung somle phung ni hin gunchu tah-a asun ajana Pathen ahouvu ahi; hiche kinepna jeh-a chu, Lengpa Agrippa, Juda hon eiheh-u ahi.
target: This is the promise our twelve tribes are hoping to see fulfilled as they earnestly serve God day and night. King Agrippa, it is because of this hope that these Jews are accusing me.

source: Pathen'in athiho akaithouve ti ibola nanghon tahsan umlouva nangaitou ham?
target: Why should any of you consider it incredible that God raises the dead?

source: Keiman jong Nazareth Jesu min douna hin thil tamtah akaleh-a bol ding ahi tin kangaiton ahi.
target: “I too was convinced that I ought to do all that was possible to oppose the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

source: Chule hichu Jerusalem'a bol jong kabolin, chule thempu pipuiho-a konin thuneina kamun, mithengho tamtah songkul'a kakhumin, chule athao jong chun kaphasah-in ahi.
target: And that is just what I did in Jerusalem. On the authority of the chief priests I put many of the Lord’s people in prison, and when they were put to death, I cast my vote against them.

source: Chule kikhopna in jouse-a talent kape jingjin, engsanin kataitomsah-in, achunguva chun kalungsa tuntun jengin, migam dang khopi gei sanin kabolsen ahi.
target: Many a time I went from one synagogue to another to have them punished, and I tried to force them to blaspheme. I was so obsessed with persecuting them that I even hunted them down in foreign cities.

source: Hitichun thempu pipuiho-a konin thuneina le eisolnao lekha kamun, Damascus lama kachen ahi.
target: “On one of these journeys I was going to Damascus with the authority and commission of the chief priests.

source: Hichun, vo lengpa, sunkim tah-in lampia chun van'a kon vah khat nisa sanga vahjo kamun, hichun kakimvel le kalhonpiho chengse asalvahsoh jenge.
target: About noon, King Agrippa, as I was on the road, I saw a light from heaven, brighter than the sun, blazing around me and my companions.

source: Chuin tolla kalhuh gam phatnun, keiman Hebrew paova kajah-a, Saul, Saul, ibola nangin neibolset jingham? nang dingin thihtul monghem lho ahahsai, eitia aw khat kajai.
target: We all fell to the ground, and I heard a voice saying to me in Aramaic, ‘Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’

source: Chuin keiman, Pakai, nang koi nahim? katile Pakai chun, Keima nabolset jing Jesu kahi.
target: “Then I asked, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ “ ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,’ the Lord replied.

source: Ahivangin thouvin chule nakengin pansan dingin; nangman thil namusa chengse le khonunga nahenga kaphondoh ding chengsea kathu hettohsah dingle kalhacha-a pansah dinga, hiche dinga chu nahenga kahung kilah ahi;
target: ‘Now get up and stand on your feet. I have appeared to you to appoint you as a servant and as a witness of what you have seen and will see of me.

source: Kamiteho-a konle, tu-a kasolna chidang namdang ho-a kona kahuhdoh ding nahi;
target: I will rescue you from your own people and from the Gentiles. I am sending you to them

source: Amitnu hadohsah dingle muthim lah-a kona khovah-a, chule Satan thuneina noija aumuva kona Pathen henga akihei theina dingule, achonsetnao akisuhbeija, keima eitahsan vanga kisuthengho lah-a gou alo theina dinguva ahenguva kasol ding nahi, eiti.
target: to open their eyes and turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan to God, so that they may receive forgiveness of sins and a place among those who are sanctified by faith in me.’

source: Hijeh chun, vo lengpa Agrippa, keima vanthil kamu thua chu nung louvin kaumpoi;
target: “So then, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the vision from heaven.

source: Ahin amasan Damascus-a umho jah-a, chuin Jerusalem le Juda gam pumpi, chule chidang namdangho henga jong lung aheijuva Pathen lama akiheijuva, lungheitoh kilom thil abolna dingun kaseiphong letan ahi.
target: First to those in Damascus, then to those in Jerusalem and in all Judea, and then to the Gentiles, I preached that they should repent and turn to God and demonstrate their repentance by their deeds.

source: Hijeh-a chu Juda hon houin sunga eimat uva tha dinga eigotnu ahi.
target: That is why some Jews seized me in the temple courts and tried to kill me.

source: Pathen'a kona panpina kanei jeh-a tuni geija kadina, alen aneo kahetsah ahi, thu dang ima kaseipoi, themgaoho le Mosi'n hung ding ahi tia aseiju,
target: But God has helped me to this very day; so I stand here and testify to small and great alike. I am saying nothing beyond what the prophets and Moses said would happen—

source: Christa chun gim genthei athoh tei dingje, athiho lah-a thoudoh kit amasapen ahia; amite le chidang namdangho henga vah aphondoh dingje kaseibou chu ahi, ati.
target: that the Messiah would suffer and, as the first to rise from the dead, would bring the message of light to his own people and to the Gentiles.”

source: Aman chutia akihona thu aseija adonbut chun, Festus chun aw sangtah-in, Vo Paul, angola nahi; nalekha them sangin nasuhngol ahitai, ati.
target: At this point Festus interrupted Paul’s defense. “You are out of your mind, Paul!” he shouted. “Your great learning is driving you insane.”

source: Ahin Paul'in, Vo michung nung Festus, angola kahipoi; thudihtah le chihna thu kaseijoh ahibouve.
target: “I am not insane, most excellent Festus,” Paul replied. “What I am saying is true and reasonable.

source: Ijeh-inem itile lengpan jong hiche thudol hi ahei; hijeh-a chu ama ang sunga ngamtah-a kasei ahi; ajeh chu hiche hi ningkoija kibol ahilou jeh-in, ama jah-a ki-ima imacha aumpoi ti chentah-in kahei.
target: The king is familiar with these things, and I can speak freely to him. I am convinced that none of this has escaped his notice, because it was not done in a corner.

source: Leng Agrippa, nangman themgaoho thuhi natahsan em? Natahsane ti kahei, ati.
target: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know you do.”

source: Chuin Agrippa'in Paul jah-a, thu themcha-a jollhah-a Christian hisah ding neigoi, ati.
target: Then Agrippa said to Paul, “Do you think that in such a short time you can persuade me to be a Christian?”

source: Chuin Paul'in thu themchan hihen thu tampin hile, nangma chang hilouvin, tunia kathusei ja jouse hi kakikan naho tailou hin, abonchan keimatoh bangleu tin Pathen henga kathume, ati.
target: Paul replied, “Short time or long—I pray to God that not only you but all who are listening to me today may become what I am, except for these chains.”

source: Chuin aman chutia aseiphat chun, lengpa, gamvaipo, Bernice chule atoukhompi ho setoh akipat doh-un,
target: The king rose, and with him the governor and Bernice and those sitting with them.

source: Chuin achoma acheuvin akihouvun, Hichepa hin thina hoile kanna dingdol thil ima asuhkhel aumpoi, atiuve.
target: After they left the room, they began saying to one another, “This man is not doing anything that deserves death or imprisonment.”

source: Chuin Agrippa'n Festus jah-a, Hichepa hin Ceasar henga ngehna abolou hile, lhadoh thei ahi, ati.
target: Agrippa said to Festus, “This man could have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar.”

source: Chuin kong'a kitola Italy gama kache dingu thu akichet phatnin, Augustus sepai loi lah-a Julius atiu sepai jalamkai khutnah Paul le sohchang dangho apedoh taove.
target: When it was decided that we would sail for Italy, Paul and some other prisoners were handed over to a centurion named Julius, who belonged to the Imperial Regiment.

source: Chuin Asia gamkolvel muntina kitol dinga kigo Adramyttium kong'a kalutnun kakitol taove; chule Macedonia gama Thessalonica mi Aristarchus toh kalhonui.
target: We boarded a ship from Adramyttium about to sail for ports along the coast of the province of Asia, and we put out to sea. Aristarchus, a Macedonian from Thessalonica, was with us.

source: Akit nin Sidon kho-ah kong kangaove. Chule Julius'in Paul alungsetnin, agol apaiho henga chea gakithado dingin asole.
target: The next day we landed at Sidon; and Julius, in kindness to Paul, allowed him to go to his friends so they might provide for his needs.

source: Chuin chua kon chun twi chunga kacheuvin, hui akaleh lama anun jeh-in Cyprus twikol le lam lamah kakitol taove.
target: From there we put out to sea again and passed to the lee of Cyprus because the winds were against us.

source: Chuin Cilicia le Pamphylia depma twikhanglen kakhelun, Lucia gama Myra khopi kalhungui.
target: When we had sailed across the open sea off the coast of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we landed at Myra in Lycia.

source: Chukoma chun sepai jalamkai chun Italy gam jon ding Alexandria kong khat amudoh-in, hi chun eikhum taove.
target: There the centurion found an Alexandrian ship sailing for Italy and put us on board.

source: Chuin sottah olchachan kakitolun, hahsa tah-in Cnidus jon kagei hamhamui, huijin einan jeh-un Salmone gam Crete twikol le-a kakitolui.
target: We made slow headway for many days and had difficulty arriving off Cnidus. When the wind did not allow us to hold our course, we sailed to the lee of Crete, opposite Salmone.

source: Hitichun nahnah-in Lasea khopi kom Kaimunhoi atiu mun khat kalhungun ahi.
target: We moved along the coast with difficulty and came to a place called Fair Havens, near the town of Lasea.

source: Chuin akisot behseh tahjeh le kong'a kitol setto kichat aum jeh chun (hichu an ngol kichai jou ahitan), Paul'in amaho chu akhamin,
target: Much time had been lost, and sailing had already become dangerous because by now it was after the Day of Atonement. So Paul warned them,

source: Vo miho, hiche twi chunga icheuva hin setto hakamna inei dingu ahi kamui; hichu thilkeole kong keo jeng hilouvin, eiho ding jengin jong setto kichat aume, ati.
target: “Men, I can see that our voyage is going to be disastrous and bring great loss to ship and cargo, and to our own lives also.”

source: Ahivangin sepai jalamkai chun Paul thu sangin kong pipu thule akong neipa thu ahajop jotan ahi.
target: But the centurion, instead of listening to what Paul said, followed the advice of the pilot and of the owner of the ship.

source: Chuin phalbi-a umna dinga kongkai mun chu akijen lou jeh-in, mi atam jon hikoma kona chu kitoldoh-a Phoenicia lhun teiteija, chukoma chu phalbi sunga umding asomtaovin ahi. Phoenicia chu Crete twikol gama kongkai mun khat ahin, lhumsah le lhumlhang angatto ahi.
target: Since the harbor was unsuitable to winter in, the majority decided that we should sail on, hoping to reach Phoenix and winter there. This was a harbor in Crete, facing both southwest and northwest.

source: Chuin lhang hui olchachan ahung nungin ahile, alunggot bangu hin angaitouvin, kong chu alhaovin Crete pam chin chinah atoltauve.
target: When a gentle south wind began to blow, they saw their opportunity; so they weighed anchor and sailed along the shore of Crete.

source: Ahivangin chujou chomkhat jouvin, chua kon chun Euroclydon atiu huipi hattah ahung nungsuh tai.
target: Before very long, a wind of hurricane force, called the Northeaster, swept down from the island.

source: Chuin kong'a chun ahung chutan ahile malama atoljou tapouvin, kamoh lhatauvin ahile eilhoh eilhoh jengtaove.
target: The ship was caught by the storm and could not head into the wind; so we gave way to it and were driven along.

source: Chuin amin Clauda atiu twikol neocha khat-ah kalhaijun, hahsa tah-in kongneo chu kahuhbit nahnah-un ahi.
target: As we passed to the lee of a small island called Cauda, we were hardly able to make the lifeboat secure,

source: Chuin hichu akhaidoh-un ahunan amangun, khaovin kong noi lamah akanbeh taove. Chuin ajole Syrtis nel lah-a kileng lut getninte ti akichauvin, pondal kikhainaho alalhauvin ahile eimoh lhoh lhohtaove.
target: so the men hoisted it aboard. Then they passed ropes under the ship itself to hold it together. Because they were afraid they would run aground on the sandbars of Syrtis, they lowered the sea anchor and let the ship be driven along.

source: Chuin huipi chun eisuhgim behseh jeh-u chun, akit nin thil apaidoh pantaove.
target: We took such a violent battering from the storm that the next day they began to throw the cargo overboard.

source: Anithum nin keihotah-in kakhut tah-un kong manchah ho chu kapai taovin ahi.
target: On the third day, they threw the ship’s tackle overboard with their own hands.

source: Chuin ni tamtah nisa chule ahsi ho eisalvah-u beihela huipi hat nasatah tang louhela anun anun phat chun, hichea pat chun kisohcha inte ti kinepna aumtapon ahi.
target: When neither sun nor stars appeared for many days and the storm continued raging, we finally gave up all hope of being saved.

source: Chuin ni tamtah an nelouva aum phatnun, Paul alah uva adingin: Vo miho, nanghon hiche settole hakamna hi to louna dinga kathu nangai uva, Crete'a kona chu kong hi nalha lou dingu thu ahi.
target: After they had gone a long time without food, Paul stood up before them and said: “Men, you should have taken my advice not to sail from Crete; then you would have spared yourselves this damage and loss.

source: Ahivangin tu-a jong lungmong tah-a umdinga katil nahiuve; nalah uva koiman nahinnao nachan lou dingu ahi, kong vanghi mang ding ahi.
target: But now I urge you to keep up your courage, because not one of you will be lost; only the ship will be destroyed.

source: Ajeh chu Ama-a kahia, alhacha kapan Pathen chu a-vantil tujan chun kakoma adingin,
target: Last night an angel of the God to whom I belong and whom I serve stood beside me

source: Vo Paul, kicha hih-in; Ceasar anga nadin tei ding ahi; chule ven, nalhonpi ho chengse hi abonchauva Pathen'in nangma napehdoh ahitai, eiti.
target: and said, ‘Do not be afraid, Paul. You must stand trial before Caesar; and God has graciously given you the lives of all who sail with you.’

source: Hiche jeh chun, vo miho, nangho lungmongun; ijeh-inem itile Pathen katahsanin, kajah-a asei bang banga chu hung soh tei ding ahi.
target: So keep up your courage, men, for I have faith in God that it will happen just as he told me.

source: Amavang twikol khatna ichuh tei dingu ahi, ati.
target: Nevertheless, we must run aground on some island.”

source: Chuin Adria twikhanglen'a huijin eisuhtol eitoutolu ajan somle ajanli jan-in, khangkimin kong mihon gamlei kinaija hitante ti agingchauvin,
target: On the fourteenth night we were still being driven across the Adriatic Sea, when about midnight the sailors sensed they were approaching land.

source: Hichun twi athuh chu ateule lam somni atedoh-ui; chuin phabep ache chonun ate kitleuvun ahile lam somle lam nga atedoh-un,
target: They took soundings and found that the water was a hundred and twenty feet deep. A short time later they took soundings again and found it was ninety feet deep.

source: Song lah-a kikisunte ti akichauvin, kong tom lamah thihhat li aseplhaovin, khovah angahtauve.
target: Fearing that we would be dashed against the rocks, they dropped four anchors from the stern and prayed for daylight.

source: Ahivangin kong miho chu kong mai lama thihhat seplha ding beh akisauvin, kongneo twikhanglen'a adomlhauvin, jam ding lungthim angaito taovin ahile,
target: In an attempt to escape from the ship, the sailors let the lifeboat down into the sea, pretending they were going to lower some anchors from the bow.

source: Paul'in sepai jalamkai le sepaiho jah-a, amaho khu kong'a aum louvule nangho changin sohchathei pouvin nate, ati.
target: Then Paul said to the centurion and the soldiers, “Unless these men stay with the ship, you cannot be saved.”

source: Chutah-in sepaihon kongneo ho khao chu asattan un, twi lah-a alhataove.
target: So the soldiers cut the ropes that held the lifeboat and let it drift away.

source: Chuin jing khovah konin Paul'in miho chu annen asolin, nanga nangaova an ngola imacha ne louhela na-umnao tuni nisom le nili ahitai,
target: Just before dawn Paul urged them all to eat. “For the last fourteen days,” he said, “you have been in constant suspense and have gone without food—you haven’t eaten anything.

source: Hijeh-a chu an ne-a kasol nahiuve, hichu nakihinsona dinguva phachom ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile nalu chunguva nasamjangu khatcha jong lou louding ahi, ati.
target: Now I urge you to take some food. You need it to survive. Not one of you will lose a single hair from his head.”

source: Hitia chu asei jouvin, aman changlhah alan mi jouse ang sungah Pathen alhaijin, changlhah ahehbalin ane pantai.
target: After he said this, he took some bread and gave thanks to God in front of them all. Then he broke it and began to eat.

source: Chutah chun miho jouse chu abonchauvin alung ngamun, an anecheh taove.
target: They were all encouraged and ate some food themselves.

source: Kong'a uma chu mihing jani le somsagi le gup kahiuve.
target: Altogether there were 276 of us on board.

source: Chuin miho chun an anehva phatnun, suhlouchang chu twi lah-a apaijun, kong chu asujangkhai taove.
target: When they had eaten as much as they wanted, they lightened the ship by throwing the grain into the sea.

source: Chuin khovah phatnin agamlei chu ahetapouve; ahivangin twipang kong ngahna thei khat amudoh-un, ahitheile kong chu chukoma tol lut ding tin akihousom taove.
target: When daylight came, they did not recognize the land, but they saw a bay with a sandy beach, where they decided to run the ship aground if they could.

source: Chuin thihhat ho alhalhaovin, twikhanglen'a adalha taove; chuin hichutoh thakhatnin kongkhe kanna chu alham lha uvin, hui chena lama kong ponjal chu atungdoh-un, twipang lam chu ajon taove.
target: Cutting loose the anchors, they left them in the sea and at the same time untied the ropes that held the rudders. Then they hoisted the foresail to the wind and made for the beach.

source: Chuin twikinong ni kisuhto na-a kalut khataovin ahile, kong monghem chu leija akiphut dentai; chuin kong mai lam chu long louhelin a-ohdentan, kong meilam chu twikinong chun hasuh-a asuhle akeh pantai.
target: But the ship struck a sandbar and ran aground. The bow stuck fast and would not move, and the stern was broken to pieces by the pounding of the surf.

source: Chuin sepaihon sohchangho chu twi jap gal kaija ajama umget inte atiuvin, tha dingin agotauve.
target: The soldiers planned to kill the prisoners to prevent any of them from swimming away and escaping.

source: Ahivangin sepai jalamkai chun Paul chu huhhing agon bol dinga alung gotnu chu akhamin, twi jap thei theijan twi jap galkaihen, vapam anakai masahen;
target: But the centurion wanted to spare Paul’s life and kept them from carrying out their plan. He ordered those who could swim to jump overboard first and get to land.

source: Adang amohse kong'a um khunpehle thil dang dangin kitol galkaihen, tin thu apetai. Chutichun abonchauvin bitkeijin asohchaovin, tolgo alhung taove.
target: The rest were to get there on planks or on other pieces of the ship. In this way everyone reached land safely.

source: Chuin kasochat phatnu chun twikol chu Malta kiti ahi ahedoh taove.
target: Once safely on shore, we found out that the island was called Malta.

source: Chule paomah hammah ho chun khoto mainah-in eikhoto pouve; hiche pet chu gojuh lai ahin adap jeh chun mei eitipeh-un eilhunsah sohkeijui.
target: The islanders showed us unusual kindness. They built a fire and welcomed us all because it was raining and cold.

source: Ahin Paul'in thing lom khat achoma meija chu agahtoleh, meisahula kon chun gulse khat ahungdoh-in, akhut achun akikhaiden jengin ahi.
target: Paul gathered a pile of brushwood and, as he put it on the fire, a viper, driven out by the heat, fastened itself on his hand.

source: Chuin paomah hammah hochun gul akhutna akikhaiden jeng chu amuvin, khatle khat akihouvun, Hichepa hi tolthat mong ahi, twikhanglen'a asochat jeng vanga hi, thudih tannan ahinghoi dehlou ahi, atiuve.
target: When the islanders saw the snake hanging from his hand, they said to each other, “This man must be a murderer; for though he escaped from the sea, the goddess Justice has not allowed him to live.”

source: Chuin aman gul chu mei sunga chun athinglhan, a-ima aloupoi.
target: But Paul shook the snake off into the fire and suffered no ill effects.

source: Ahivangin amaho chun hung pomintin, ahiloule phulou helouvin lhuntin, thi ding ahi, tin angah jingun ahi. Ahinla sottah angauva avet jouvun a-ima alou lou chu amuvin, alung gelu akhelun, ama chu pathen ahi atitaove.
target: The people expected him to swell up or suddenly fall dead; but after waiting a long time and seeing nothing unusual happen to him, they changed their minds and said he was a god.

source: Hiche mun koma chu twikol gam pipu amin Publius atiu chun gam anei ahin; ama chun eila lutnun, khotona nei tah-in ni thum a-in'a eilhun sah-un ahi.
target: There was an estate nearby that belonged to Publius, the chief official of the island. He welcomed us to his home and showed us generous hospitality for three days.

source: Chuin Publius pa chu khosih le ehthit veija luma ahin; chuin Paul akoma agalutnin, achunga akhut angamin ataovin adamsahtai.
target: His father was sick in bed, suffering from fever and dysentery. Paul went in to see him and, after prayer, placed his hands on him and healed him.

source: Chutia abol jou chun, chuche twikol gam sunga midang ana nei jouse ahungun ahile adam gamtaove.
target: When this had happened, the rest of the sick on the island came and were cured.

source: Amaho chun lamchom chomin eijabol lheh jengun, kong'a kakitol phatnun thil kangaichat ding dolchanu kong-ah eihung koipeh-ui.
target: They honored us in many ways; and when we were ready to sail, they furnished us with the supplies we needed.

source: Chuin lha thum jouvin phalbi sungse-a twikol'a chu cham, amelchihna Ucha Sohkop atiu Alexandria kong'a chun kakitoldoh taove.
target: After three months we put out to sea in a ship that had wintered in the island—it was an Alexandrian ship with the figurehead of the twin gods Castor and Pollux.

source: Chuin Syrakuse'a kakingaovin, chukoma chun ni thum kaumui.
target: We put in at Syracuse and stayed there three days.

source: Chuin chua kon chun kache velkolun Rhegium kalhungui; chuin ni khat jouvin lhanghui anungin ahile akit nin Puteoli kalhung taove.
target: From there we set sail and arrived at Rhegium. The next day the south wind came up, and on the following day we reached Puteoli.

source: Hikoma chun sopiho kamudoh-un, akomuva ni sagi nichong dingin eijolui. Chuin chutichun Rome lam ngan kachetauve.
target: There we found some brothers and sisters who invited us to spend a week with them. And so we came to Rome.

source: Chuin chua kon chun sopihon keiho thu ajah phatnun Appii kailhang le Jinlhun In Thum geijin eilamto diuvin ahungui. Chuin Paul'in amaho chu amu phatnin Pathen athangvah-in alung ngamtan ahi.
target: The brothers and sisters there had heard that we were coming, and they traveled as far as the Forum of Appius and the Three Taverns to meet us. At the sight of these people Paul thanked God and was encouraged.

source: Chuin Rome khopi kahunglhun phatnun, sepai jalamkai chun sohchang ho chu angahho jalamkai khutna apedoh-in, ahin Paul chu achanga sepai angahpa chuto umdingin thu apetaove.
target: When we got to Rome, Paul was allowed to live by himself, with a soldier to guard him.

source: Chuin ahitin ahi, ni thum jouvin Juda ho lah-a apipuho chu akou khomin; chuin amaho ahung kikhop phatnun ajah uva: Sopiteho, keima inam miteu dounale ipu ipateu dan douna-a ima kasuhset aum lou vangin, Jerusalem'a kona Rome mite khutna sohchanga pehdoh-a um kahitai.
target: Three days later he called together the local Jewish leaders. When they had assembled, Paul said to them: “My brothers, although I have done nothing against our people or against the customs of our ancestors, I was arrested in Jerusalem and handed over to the Romans.

source: Kathem kathemlou aholtoh-un, thina hoi ima kachunga amudoh lou jeh-un, lhadoh dingin eigotaovin ahi.
target: They examined me and wanted to release me, because I was not guilty of any crime deserving death.

source: Ahivangin Juda hon hichu anel jeh-un, kacham louvin Ceasar henga ngehna kaboltan ahi; hichu kanam mite hehna dinga ahipoi.
target: The Jews objected, so I was compelled to make an appeal to Caesar. I certainly did not intend to bring any charge against my own people.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu nang hotoh kimuto-a kihoulim dinga kakou nahiuve, ijeh-inem itile Israelte kinepna jeh-a thihkhaova hi kihen kahibouve, ati.
target: For this reason I have asked to see you and talk with you. It is because of the hope of Israel that I am bound with this chain.”

source: Chuin amahon ajah-a, Keihon nangma thudol Juda gama konin lekha kamupouve; chule sopiho lah-a jong koima hikoma ahungin nangma chung changa khan gitlouna thu hung lhut aumpoi.
target: They replied, “We have not received any letters from Judea concerning you, and none of our people who have come from there has reported or said anything bad about you.

source: Ahivangin nangma lung ngaito thudol hi nanga konin kajah nomui: ijeh-inem itile hiche houchom thudol hi gamtina seisetna aum kaheuve, atiuve.
target: But we want to hear what your views are, for we know that people everywhere are talking against this sect.”

source: Chuin nikho ateppeh-un, aumna-a chun ahenga atama tam ahungun, aman jingkah-a pat nilhah geijin Mosi danthu le themgaoho lekhabua konin thu asodoh asodoh-in, Pathen lenggam thu ahettohsah-in, Jesu thudola ajoltan ahi.
target: They arranged to meet Paul on a certain day, and came in even larger numbers to the place where he was staying. He witnessed to them from morning till evening, explaining about the kingdom of God, and from the Law of Moses and from the Prophets he tried to persuade them about Jesus.

source: Chuin athuseiho chu abangin atahsanun, abangin atahsan pouve.
target: Some were convinced by what he said, but others would not believe.

source: Chuin amahole amaho akilol thei lou phatnun, Paul'in thu khat asei jouvin apotdoh taove; athusei chu hiche hi ahi. Lhagao Thengin themgao Isaiah kama napu napateu jah-a, asei chu adih lheh jenge,
target: They disagreed among themselves and began to leave after Paul had made this final statement: “The Holy Spirit spoke the truth to your ancestors when he said through Isaiah the prophet:

source: Hiche mite henga hin chenlang gaseijin: nanghon ja vang ja naovin natin, nahet them lou dingu; muvang munao vin natin, nahetdoh lou dingu ahi;
target: “ ‘Go to this people and say, “You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving.”

source: Ajehchu hiche mite lungthim hi thaova kitom ahin; ana khangun kho ajathei pon, amitnu asingun ahi, chutilou hile amitnun muvintin, anakhangun ja-intin, alunguvin hetdoh untin hung kilekit khaleu, Keiman amaho chu kadamsah khahding ahi; tia, asei chu ahi.
target: For this people’s heart has become calloused; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts and turn, and I would heal them.’
