source: Hiche jeh chun hiche hi kihet un, hiche Pathen mihuhhing na hi chidang namdangho henga kisola ahitai; amahon ngai jong angai dingu ahi, ati.
target: “Therefore I want you to know that God’s salvation has been sent to the Gentiles, and they will listen!”

source: Chuin aman inman apeh-a achenna-a chun kum ni lhingset aumin, ahenga hung jouse chu anasangjin,
target: For two whole years Paul stayed there in his own rented house and welcomed all who came to see him.

source: Pathen gam thu ahil lhangjin, hakattah-in Pakai Jesu Christa thudol ahiljin, koimachan akhampon ahi.
target: He proclaimed the kingdom of God and taught about the Lord Jesus Christ—with all boldness and without hindrance!

source: Paul, Jesu Christa soh khat, solchah khat hidia kikou, Pathen thupha seiphong ledia kisepdoh chun:
target: Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus, called to be an apostle and set apart for the gospel of God—

source: Malaija alekhabu thenga athemgaoho kama athutepsa,
target: the gospel he promised beforehand through his prophets in the Holy Scriptures

source: Tahsa lam dolla David chilhah-a kisim, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa, a Chapa thudol,
target: regarding his Son, who as to his earthly life was a descendant of David,

source: Thenna lhagao lama vanga chu athi-a kona athodoh kit chun Pathen Chapa chu thunei tah-a atun ahi chu aphongdoh tai.
target: and who through the Spirit of holiness was appointed the Son of God in power by his resurrection from the dead: Jesus Christ our Lord.

source: Chidang namdangte jouse lah-a mi tahsan thua nunsah dinga ama vangle ama min jala lungsetnale solchah mun changa kahitai;
target: Through him we received grace and apostleship to call all the Gentiles to the obedience that comes from faith for his name’s sake.

source: Nangho jong amaho lah-a chu Jesu Christa kouna changho nahiuve;
target: And you also are among those Gentiles who are called to belong to Jesus Christ.

source: Rome'a cheng mithenga kikou Pathen deite jouse hengah, i-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa-a konin lungsetna le lungmon nalah uva umjing hen.
target: To all in Rome who are loved by God and called to be his holy people: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

source: Natahsanu vannoi jouse-a akithan jeh-in, nabon chaova chungah Jesu Christa vangin ka-Pathen kathangvah masan ahi.
target: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, because your faith is being reported all over the world.

source: Katao chanin tang louvin naminu kapha jingin, Achapa Thupha thua lhagaova alhacha kapan Pathen chu ahetoh ahi.
target: God, whom I serve in my spirit in preaching the gospel of his Son, is my witness how constantly I remember you

source: Tubeh-a hi naheng uva kahungna dingin, Pathen thusah-a phat kijen kom khat kato-a kahungjin teiteina dingin kathum jingjin ahi.
target: in my prayers at all times; and I pray that now at last by God’s will the way may be opened for me to come to you.

source: Nadetna dinguva lhagao lam thilpeh phabep nangho kapeh theina dingun, nangho mu kangah lel lheh jengin ahi.
target: I long to see you so that I may impart to you some spiritual gift to make you strong—

source: Hichu nangho jong keima jong khat tahsana kona khat le khat ikitil khou touva, nangho lah-a lunghalna kanei theina dinga kati ahi.
target: that is, that you and I may be mutually encouraged by each other’s faith.

source: Chule sopite, chidang namdangte lah-a katohgim ga kamutah banga nangho lah-a jong kamu theina dinga, tamtahvei naheng uva hung ding kakigotji chu nahet louvu kanompoi, ahivangin tu masangsen eisumo aum jingjin ahi.
target: I do not want you to be unaware, brothers and sisters, that I planned many times to come to you (but have been prevented from doing so until now) in order that I might have a harvest among you, just as I have had among the other Gentiles.

source: Greek mitele paomah ham mahte ahin, mithemle mimol ahin, abonchauva kabat ahi.
target: I am obligated both to Greeks and non-Greeks, both to the wise and the foolish.

source: Chutichu ahin, nangho Rome khopi-a um chengse jong Kipana Thupha kahil theichan hil dinga kigosa dema umjing kahi.
target: That is why I am so eager to preach the gospel also to you who are in Rome.

source: Ajehchu Christa Kipana Thupha hi kajachatpi hihhele, ajehchu koi hile atahsan chan chu huhhing na dinga Pathen thahat ahin, amasan Juda mi ahin, chule Greek mi jong ahunghi.
target: For I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God that brings salvation to everyone who believes: first to the Jew, then to the Gentile.

source: Ajeh iham itile asunga tahsan le tahsana kona Pathen chonphatna kilanga ahi; hiche thudol chu, Michonpha vang chu atahsan vanga hing ding ahi, tin akisune.
target: For in the gospel the righteousness of God is revealed—a righteousness that is by faith from first to last, just as it is written: “The righteous will live by faith.”

source: Ajehchu chonphat louna-a thutah doudal ho, mihemte Pathen ngaisah louna le chonphat louna jouse chunga van'a konin Pathen lunghanna ahung kilangin ahi;
target: The wrath of God is being revealed from heaven against all the godlessness and wickedness of people, who suppress the truth by their wickedness,

source: Ajeh chu Pathen lam thudol het theina chu amaho-a akilangnai; ajeh chu Pathen'in hichu ahenguva amusah ahitai.
target: since what may be known about God is plain to them, because God has made it plain to them.

source: Ijeh ham itile leiset semtila pat Pathen athahat kemloule Pathen ahije mutheilou thilteho chu athilsema kihedoh-a, kichentah-a kimu ahi jeh chun, amaho athuphatna dingu aumpoi.
target: For since the creation of the world God’s invisible qualities—his eternal power and divine nature—have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made, so that people are without excuse.

source: Ajeh chu Pathen lah ahenauvin, Pathen bangin avahchoi pouvin, thang jong athangvahji pouve; athil ngaitou ahomkeo ahin, angol lungu athimtan ahi.
target: For although they knew God, they neither glorified him as God nor gave thanks to him, but their thinking became futile and their foolish hearts were darkened.

source: Akichihsah nau lamah angoljo taove.
target: Although they claimed to be wise, they became fools

source: Chule kemtheilou Pathen loupina chu, kemthei mihem le alha-a leng vachaho, akeng li nei gamsaho le a-opma kitholtho ganhing limin akhelun, ahou taove.
target: and exchanged the glory of the immortal God for images made to look like a mortal human being and birds and animals and reptiles.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu alah uva atiu ja umloutah-a bol dinga, amaho lunggot lam then louna lama, Pathen'in apehdoh ahitai.
target: Therefore God gave them over in the sinful desires of their hearts to sexual impurity for the degrading of their bodies with one another.

source: Amahon Pathen thutah chu jouvin alhengun, chule asempau khelin thilsemjoh ahouvun ajenleuvin ahi. Hiche Sempa chu tonsot geija nunnom jing ahi. Amen.
target: They exchanged the truth about God for a lie, and worshiped and served created things rather than the Creator—who is forever praised. Amen.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu Pathen'in amaho jachat umtah huhna lama apehdoh ahitai, anumeiho jongun apenpiu angai monga achonnau apaijun akaleh lamin achonun ahi.
target: Because of this, God gave them over to shameful lusts. Even their women exchanged natural sexual relations for unnatural ones.

source: Apasal-hou jong angai monga numeitoh achonnau apaijun, huh lama alipmun, pasal le pasal jachat umtah-in akibolun, achon gitlounao chu amahon ati chunguva akisan taovin ahi.
target: In the same way the men also abandoned natural relations with women and were inflamed with lust for one another. Men committed shameful acts with other men, and received in themselves the due penalty for their error.

source: Alunguva Pathen hetding amaho nom lou ahiuvin, hiche bangtah-a chu Pathen'in jong amaho lung chatvaina lama apehdoh ahitai.
target: Furthermore, just as they did not think it worthwhile to retain the knowledge of God, so God gave them over to a depraved mind, so that they do what ought not to be done.

source: Amaho chonphat louna jouse; jonthanhoi, engset, papset, mi kisuhmo sah, thangset, toltha, minelnoh, dohabol, doulung poh, kihou lhih adimset nun ahi.
target: They have become filled with every kind of wickedness, evil, greed and depravity. They are full of envy, murder, strife, deceit and malice. They are gossips,

source: Guhthima miseise, mihoutom, Pathen hotlam, chonval, hoitho, kithang-at, chonset thah boldoh, nulepa thua nunglou,
target: slanderers, God-haters, insolent, arrogant and boastful; they invent ways of doing evil; they disobey their parents;

source: Hetna neilou, thutep palkeh, hepina neilou, lhep lung damo, lungsetna neilou ahiuve.
target: they have no understanding, no fidelity, no love, no mercy.

source: Hitobanga chonho chu athi dinga lom mong ahiuve, hiche Pathen thutansa chu ahena saovin achuti chonun ahi, amaho chang jong hilouvin, chutia chonho chu aphasah-un ahi.
target: Although they know God’s righteous decree that those who do such things deserve death, they not only continue to do these very things but also approve of those who practice them.

source: Hiche jeh chun, Mi oimo-a pang, vo mihem, koi hile chun nangman jong nadonbutna ding aumpoi; ajeh iham itile nangman mi na-oimona lama nangma themmo kichanbou nahi, ajeh chu mi oimo-a pang, nangmatah jongin chutobang chu naboljin ahi.
target: You, therefore, have no excuse, you who pass judgment on someone else, for at whatever point you judge another, you are condemning yourself, because you who pass judgment do the same things.

source: Chutobanga chonho chunga chu Pathen'in thutah dungjuija athu-u atan ahi, ti iheuvin ahi.
target: Now we know that God’s judgment against those who do such things is based on truth.

source: Vo mihem, chutobanga chonte oimo-a pang nangman chutobang chu nabolji-a ahile, Pathen thutan na-a chun hoinange, tia nakiginchat mong hinam?
target: So when you, a mere human being, pass judgment on them and yet do the same things, do you think you will escape God’s judgment?

source: Ole Pathen phatna-in nalung heina dinga nangma napui chu helouva phatna, lungdehat, khongaisot ahao hi nahsah louva nahim?
target: Or do you show contempt for the riches of his kindness, forbearance and patience, not realizing that God’s kindness is intended to lead you to repentance?

source: Nalungtahle lungheilou dungjuija chu, Pathen'in thudih atan ni hung kiphonle alunghan ni-a dinga chu nachunga lunghanna nakikhol khom ahi.
target: But because of your stubbornness and your unrepentant heart, you are storing up wrath against yourself for the day of God’s wrath, when his righteous judgment will be revealed.

source: Pathen'in mi jouse atoh dungjui cheh-a asansah ding ahi.
target: God “will repay each person according to what they have done.”

source: Thilpha bola pontho-a lungdesot hatna, loupina, jana, chule kemlou holte chu hin kemlou apeh ding ahi;
target: To those who by persistence in doing good seek glory, honor and immortality, he will give eternal life.

source: Kichangchuna kichamsah, thutah thua nung louva chonphatlou thua nungho vang chu achunguva lungsatle lunghan chua,
target: But for those who are self-seeking and who reject the truth and follow evil, there will be wrath and anger.

source: Setna bol miho jouse lhagao chunga, amasa Juda mi chule abana Greek mite lhagao chunga, hesoh gentheile lungdonna khohtah chu ding ahi.
target: There will be trouble and distress for every human being who does evil: first for the Jew, then for the Gentile;

source: Thilpha bol chengse vang chun loupina, choi-atna, chule lungmonna kipe ding ahi, Juda mi masan tin chule Greek mi hi ding ahi.
target: but glory, honor and peace for everyone who does good: first for the Jew, then for the Gentile.

source: Ajeh chu Pathen'in mi dat aneipoi.
target: For God does not show favoritism.

source: Ajeh chu danthu neilouva chonseteho jouse chu danthu beija manghel ding ahiuvin; chule danthu noija chonseteho jouse chu danthua athu kitan ding ahi.
target: All who sin apart from the law will also perish apart from the law, and all who sin under the law will be judged by the law.

source: Ajeh iham itile Pathen mitmu-a michonpha ho chu danthu ngaija jaho ahipouve; danthu dungjuija bolteho bouchu chonpha-a kisim ding ahi.
target: For it is not those who hear the law who are righteous in God’s sight, but it is those who obey the law who will be declared righteous.

source: Danthu neilou chidang namdangte jengbonin, apenpi lungpoh-in danthun anungun, danthu aneilou vangun amahole amaho danthun akisemun ahi.
target: (Indeed, when Gentiles, who do not have the law, do by nature things required by the law, they are a law for themselves, even though they do not have the law.

source: Alung sunguva danthu natoh kisun ahi ti chu atahlangun, hiche ase apha ahetnao chun ahettohsah-un, chule alunggel uva chun themosah ahiloule khat le khat themmo kichan aumsah jiuvin ahi.
target: They show that the requirements of the law are written on their hearts, their consciences also bearing witness, and their thoughts sometimes accusing them and at other times even defending them.)

source: Hicheng chu kathupha seiphongle dungjuija, Pathen'in Jesu Christa amanchah-a mihemte guhthim thu atan nikho leh chuti ding ahi.
target: This will take place on the day when God judges people’s secrets through Jesus Christ, as my gospel declares.

source: Nangma Juda mi-a kisei nahi-a, danthua kinem nahi-a, Pathen'a kisong nahi-a,
target: Now you, if you call yourself a Jew; if you rely on the law and boast in God;

source: Alungdei he-a, thilpha chu pha sa-a, danthua kona kihila het neija,
target: if you know his will and approve of what is superior because you are instructed by the law;

source: Chule danthua hetna le thutah umdan neija nakiginchat jeh-a, mitcho ho kaihoile leh muthim lah-a umho salvah-a,
target: if you are convinced that you are a guide for the blind, a light for those who are in the dark,

source: Michinglou ho chihsah-a, naosen ho hila nakingaito ahin;
target: an instructor of the foolish, a teacher of little children, because you have in the law the embodiment of knowledge and truth—

source: Chuti ahile mihil-a panga nang, nangma jong nachanga kihil jilou nahim? Guchat louna dinga thu hila pang, nangman naguhji hilou ham?
target: you, then, who teach others, do you not teach yourself? You who preach against stealing, do you steal?

source: Jonthanhoi bol louna dinga thuseija, nangman jon nabolji hilou ham? Milim hou ho-a nangma, nangman milim houna in'a thil nachomji hilou ham?
target: You who say that people should not commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

source: Danthu-a kisong nangman, danthu nasuhkeh-a kona Pathen nahsah mo-a nabolji hilouham?
target: You who boast in the law, do you dishonor God by breaking the law?

source: Akisun bang bangin, nangho jeh-in Pathen min chidang namgdangte lah-a taitomin aumin ahi.
target: As it is written: “God’s name is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you.”

source: Nangma danthua nanunle nacheptan chu phatchomna nanei ding ahin, danthua nanun lou vangle nacheptan chu tan lou ahitai.
target: Circumcision has value if you observe the law, but if you break the law, you have become as though you had not been circumcised.

source: Chuti ahi jeh-a chu cheptanlou chun danthua chonphatna thudol chu nit taleh, achep tanlou chu cheptana kisim lou dingham?
target: So then, if those who are not circumcised keep the law’s requirements, will they not be regarded as though they were circumcised?

source: Apena cheptanlou mong danthu nit soh chun, lekhajem'a thule cheptan dan neija jong danthu sukeh-a nangma, nathemmosah lou dingham?
target: The one who is not circumcised physically and yet obeys the law will condemn you who, even though you have the written code and circumcision, are a lawbreaker.

source: Apolama mi mu-a Juda mi hichu Juda mitah ahipoi, apolam ati chunga cheptan jong chu cheptan ahipoi.
target: A person is not a Jew who is one only outwardly, nor is circumcision merely outward and physical.

source: Asunggila Juda mi hibou chu Juda mi ahin, chule lekhajem'a hilouva lhagaova lunggil lam cheptanho chu cheptan ahi; ama chu mihem pachat lo-a hilouvin Pathen pachat alojoh ahi.
target: No, a person is a Jew who is one inwardly; and circumcision is circumcision of the heart, by the Spirit, not by the written code. Such a person’s praise is not from other people, but from God.

source: Chuti ahile Juda mi hi ipi phachomam? Chule cheptan jong iham aphatna?
target: What advantage, then, is there in being a Jew, or what value is there in circumcision?

source: Imalam jouse-a phachom tah ahi, abulpen chu, Pathen thu chengse amaho kipedoh-a kichinsah anahi.
target: Much in every way! First of all, the Jews have been entrusted with the very words of God.

source: Khat touvin tahsan hih jongleu i-hiding ham? Amaho tahsan lou chun Pathen tahsan umje hi manlou asochom em?
target: What if some were unfaithful? Will their unfaithfulness nullify God’s faithfulness?

source: Chuti hihhen; Pathen chu dihtah hihen lang, mi jouse chu ajou hihen; hiche thudol hi, Nangma, nangma thuseija chonpha tia nakisima, Thupitan na-a jong najo theinan, tin akisunin ahi.
target: Not at all! Let God be true, and every human being a liar. As it is written: “So that you may be proved right when you speak and prevail when you judge.”

source: Ahivangin ichonphat lounao hin Pathen chonphatna chu akichetsah cheh-a ahile, ipi isei dingu ham? Lunghanga talen peji-a Pathen dihlou ham? (Mihem dan banga kasei ahi).
target: But if our unrighteousness brings out God’s righteousness more clearly, what shall we say? That God is unjust in bringing his wrath on us? (I am using a human argument.)

source: Chuti ahipoi, chuti ahile Pathen'in vannoi leiset thupi iti atan dingham?
target: Certainly not! If that were so, how could God judge the world?

source: Keima jousei jeh-a Pathen dihje chu ama loupina khopma letset tah-a akihaphon cheh-a ahile, michonse tia themmo changa iti ka umnah lai dingham?
target: Someone might argue, “If my falsehood enhances God’s truthfulness and so increases his glory, why am I still condemned as a sinner?”

source: Chule keiho neihehset uva, kimkhatnin kasei loubeh-u; phatna ahung umna dingin setna bolu hite, tin aseijuve, tia neingoh-u bangchun, eihonjong hiti chun seiju hite natijiu hilouham? Chutobang thusei ho themmo achanu chu dihtah ahi.
target: Why not say—as some slanderously claim that we say—“Let us do evil that good may result”? Their condemnation is just!

source: Chuti ahile, keiho Juda mi hi midang sanga phajo kahiuvem? Iti nama jongle kaphajo pouve. Ajehchu Juda mi chule Greek mi abona chonset noija um cheh ahi, tia kahilchah sa cheh-u ahitai.
target: What shall we conclude then? Do we have any advantage? Not at all! For we have already made the charge that Jews and Gentiles alike are all under the power of sin.

source: Hiti jong hin akisune, Chonpha koima aumpoi, khatcha jong aumpoi.
target: As it is written: “There is no one righteous, not even one;

source: Koima ahetoh thema aumpoi, Koima Pathen hola aumpoi,
target: there is no one who understands; there is no one who seeks God.

source: Lam hilouva akihei sohkei taovin, abon chaovin manlou asohgam taove. Apha lama chona aumpoi, khatcha jong aumpoi.
target: All have turned away, they have together become worthless; there is no one who does good, not even one.”

source: Alol homu lhan kihong ahin; Aleijun lheplhahna thu jeng aseijun, Anel noijuvah gulse gu aumin;
target: “Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.” “The poison of vipers is on their lips.”

source: Akam sungula sapsetna le thugilouvin adimin;
target: “Their mouths are full of cursing and bitterness.”

source: Akengu thisona ding lamah ajangin;
target: “Their feet are swift to shed blood;

source: Alampi jouseu-ah man naleh hesohna aumin;
target: ruin and misery mark their ways,

source: Lungmonna lampi aheta pouve;
target: and the way of peace they do not know.”

source: Amitmuvah Pathen gin aumpoi.
target: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”

source: Mi jouse kam binna dingle vannoi leiset pumpi Pathen thutana-a aum theina dinguva, danthun asei chengse hi danthu thua nungho jah-a kisei ahi, ti iheuve.
target: Now we know that whatever the law says, it says to those who are under the law, so that every mouth may be silenced and the whole world held accountable to God.

source: Danthu juija thilbola mi koima a-angsunga them changa umlou ding ahi, ajehchu danthua kona chonsetna kihedoh ahi.
target: Therefore no one will be declared righteous in God’s sight by the works of the law; rather, through the law we become conscious of our sin.

source: Ahin tu vangin danthua hilouhelin, danthule themgaoho thuhetsah Pathen chonphatna chu akilang dohtan ahi.
target: But now apart from the law the righteousness of God has been made known, to which the Law and the Prophets testify.

source: Chuche Pathen'a kon chonphatna chu Jesu Khrista tahsan vanga mijousele atahsante jouse chunga kilanga ahi: koima imachom aumpoi:
target: This righteousness is given through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe. There is no difference between Jew and Gentile,

source: Ajeh chu mi jouse hi chonsea ahitan, Pathen loupina chu changlela ahiuve;
target: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,

source: Khrista Jesu'a kilhatdohna aum jeh-a, Pathen lungset vanga chonphat moh chonbou ahiuve.
target: and all are justified freely by his grace through the redemption that came by Christ Jesus.

source: Pathen'in alungdesot vanga masanga chonsetna kichaisaho talen pelouva aum jeh-in, achonphat vetsahna dinga tahsan vanga athisan chu kithoidamna hidinga apehdoh ahin;
target: God presented Christ as a sacrifice of atonement, through the shedding of his blood—to be received by faith. He did this to demonstrate his righteousness, because in his forbearance he had left the sins committed beforehand unpunished—

source: Ama chonpha ahina dingle, Jesu tahsan chan chu chonpha-a asim theina dinga, tulaija hi achonphatna avetsah ahi.
target: he did it to demonstrate his righteousness at the present time, so as to be just and the one who justifies those who have faith in Jesus.

source: Chuti ahile kisonna hoithona hoibaham? Kinotdoh-a ahitai. Itobang danthua ham? Danthu juija natoh naham? Ahipoi, tahsanna danthu-a joh ahibouve.
target: Where, then, is boasting? It is excluded. Because of what law? The law that requires works? No, because of the law that requires faith.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun danthu juija natoh vang hilouva, tahsan vanga mi chonpha kisim ahi, tia kangaitou ahi.
target: For we maintain that a person is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

source: Pathen chu Juda mite changseh Pathen ham? Chidang namdangte Pathen jong hilou ham? Chidang namdang te-a jong ahi.
target: Or is God the God of Jews only? Is he not the God of Gentiles too? Yes, of Gentiles too,

source: Ahin Pathen khatseh ahi jeh chun, cheptanho chu tahsana kona chonpha asima, chule cheptan louho chu tahsan vanga chonpha asim ding ahi.
target: since there is only one God, who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith.

source: Chuti ahile itahsan jeh uva hi danthu kisumanga ham? Ahipoi; danthu kiphudetjoh ahibouve.
target: Do we, then, nullify the law by this faith? Not at all! Rather, we uphold the law.

source: Chuti ahile tahsa lama ipuluiju Abraham'in amu chu ipi isei dingu ham?
target: What then shall we say that Abraham, our forefather according to the flesh, discovered in this matter?

source: Ajeh iham itile ama chu natoh vanga chonpha kisim ahile kisonna anei ahi, ahinla Pathen lamah aneipon ahi.
target: If, in fact, Abraham was justified by works, he had something to boast about—but not before God.

source: Ajeh chu Pathen lekhabun ipi aseijem? Abraham'in Pathen atahsan jal-in atahsan chu ama dingin chonphatnin akisimtai.
target: What does Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.”

source: Natongte sum san hi lungsetman kiti louvin, asan ding abatnin akiseijon ahi.
target: Now to the one who works, wages are not credited as a gift but as an obligation.

source: Ahinla Pathen helou natoh beija chonpha chansahpa tahsana chu, atahsan chu chonphatna kisima ahi.
target: However, to the one who does not work but trusts God who justifies the ungodly, their faith is credited as righteousness.

source: Natong louva Pathen'in michon pha-a asimho chu phatthei achan dingjeu chu, David'in jong aseijin,
target: David says the same thing when he speaks of the blessedness of the one to whom God credits righteousness apart from works:

source: Asuhkhelnau kingaidama, Chule achonsetna kikhu khumho chu anun nomui.
target: “Blessed are those whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

source: Pakaiyin achonsetna asimlou dingpa chu anun nome, ati.
target: Blessed is the one whose sin the Lord will never count against them.”

source: Chuti ahile chuche phattheina chu cheptante chung jenga ham, cheptan louho chunga jongham? Ajeh chu eihon Abraham atahsan chu ama dinga chonphatna-a kisim ahitai, itiu ahi.
target: Is this blessedness only for the circumcised, or also for the uncircumcised? We have been saying that Abraham’s faith was credited to him as righteousness.

source: Achutile iti aum petna chonpha kisim ham? Acheptan jouha, cheptan louva aum laija ham? Cheptana aum jou hilouvin, cheptan louva aum lai ahi:
target: Under what circumstances was it credited? Was it after he was circumcised, or before? It was not after, but before!

source: Chule cheptan louva uma atahsanho jouse pa ahi theina dingle, amaho dinga chu chonphatna-a akisim theina dinga, chule cheptan jeng jong hilouva ipuluiju Abraham cheptan louva aum laija atahsan chu,
target: And he received circumcision as a sign, a seal of the righteousness that he had by faith while he was still uncircumcised. So then, he is the father of all who believe but have not been circumcised, in order that righteousness might be credited to them.

source: Hiche tahsan nungjuija cheptanho pa jong ahi theina dinga, cheptan louva uma tahsan vanga chonphat chu hetna-a melchih na-a cheptan chu amu ahi.
target: And he is then also the father of the circumcised who not only are circumcised but who also follow in the footsteps of the faith that our father Abraham had before he was circumcised.

source: Ajeh chu Abraham le achilhah chu, vannoi goulo ding ahi tia thutep chu danthua kon hilouvin, tahsana kona chonphat vanga joh ahibouve.
target: It was not through the law that Abraham and his offspring received the promise that he would be heir of the world, but through the righteousness that comes by faith.

source: Ajeh iham itile danthua kona chonpha kisimhon alouva ahile, tahsan chu ahomkeo ahitai, chule thutep jong chu pannabei ahitai.
target: For if those who depend on the law are heirs, faith means nothing and the promise is worthless,

source: Ajeh chu danthun lunghan akonsah ahi; danthu beina-a chun suhkhel jong aumpoi.
target: because the law brings wrath. And where there is no law there is no transgression.

source: Hijeh-a chu lungsetna-a ahi theina-a, danthu noija umho chang jeng hilouva Abraham tahsan noija um achilhahte jousen, hiche thutep alo dingu chu adet theina dinga, amahon alo dingu chu tahsan vanga alo dingu ahibouve.
target: Therefore, the promise comes by faith, so that it may be by grace and may be guaranteed to all Abraham’s offspring—not only to those who are of the law but also to those who have the faith of Abraham. He is the father of us all.

source: Mithiho hinsah theija, aum louho auma banga kou Pathen, Abraham'in atahsan chu, ama angsunga Abraham chu ibon chaova ikonnao ipuluiju ahi; chule hitin jong akisune, Keiman nangma vai tamtah kona puluija kasem ahitai, ati.
target: As it is written: “I have made you a father of many nations.” He is our father in the sight of God, in whom he believed—the God who gives life to the dead and calls into being things that were not.

source: Chule kiholna neilou ahivangin, nachilhah hijatpi khu hi ding ahi tia, asei thucheng dungjuija, khonungle vai tamtah pului ahung hi ding chu kiholin atahsanin ahi.
target: Against all hope, Abraham in hope believed and so became the father of many nations, just as it had been said to him, “So shall your offspring be.”

source: Chule kum jakhat jen alhina, athisa tobang atahsa le Sarah chin jong chu ngaiton, atahsan daideh louhelin aumin,
target: Without weakening in his faith, he faced the fact that his body was as good as dead—since he was about a hundred years old—and that Sarah’s womb was also dead.

source: Pathen thutep chu tahsan lellin aumpon ahi.
target: Yet he did not waver through unbelief regarding the promise of God, but was strengthened in his faith and gave glory to God,

source: Pathen'in athutep chu bol jong bol thei ahi ti ahechenin, Pathen avahchoijin atahsan ahat chehjotan ahi.
target: being fully persuaded that God had power to do what he had promised.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu atahsan chu ama dinga chonphatna kisima ahitai.
target: This is why “it was credited to him as righteousness.”

source: Tahsan chu ama ding jenga chonphatna-a kisima kisun ahipoi; eiho dinga jong kisun ahi.
target: The words “it was credited to him” were written not for him alone,

source: Pakai Jesu Khrista athia kona kaithoupa tahsana eiho, eiho dinga jong chonphatna-a kisim ding ahi.
target: but also for us, to whom God will credit righteousness—for us who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead.

source: Hiche Jesu chu eiho suhkhel jeh-a kipedoh ahitai; chule eiho chonpha ikisimna dinguva kaithouva uma ahitai.
target: He was delivered over to death for our sins and was raised to life for our justification.

source: Chuti ahin tahsan vanga eiho chonpha kisim ihitah jeh-un, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa vanga Pathen toh kichamdela um ihitaove.
target: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,

source: Chujongle ama vanga chu hiche lungsetna idin detnaova hi tahsan vanga lut ihitaove, chule Pathen loupina-a chu kinema kipah jinga um ihitaove.
target: through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we now stand. And we boast in the hope of the glory of God.

source: Chule chuti jengseh hilouvin, hesohna chun thohhat asosahji ihetbangun, ihesoh gentheinao jenga jong iloupi jiuve;
target: Not only so, but we also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance;

source: Thohhat chun aphat photchena asosahjin, photchena chun kinepna asosahjin ahi, ti iheuve.
target: perseverance, character; and character, hope.

source: Chule hiche kinepna chun eijumso pouve, ajeh chu eipeh-u Lhagao Theng vanga chu ilung sunguva Pathen ngailutna long lut ahitai.
target: And hope does not put us to shame, because God’s love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, who has been given to us.

source: Ihatmo laijuvin aphatchan michonseho khelin anathitan ahi.
target: You see, at just the right time, when we were still powerless, Christ died for the ungodly.

source: Michonpha chung changah koima pouvin ahinna tohponte; mipha chungchanga ahinna toh ngam jong mi khattou umkhat nante.
target: Very rarely will anyone die for a righteous person, though for a good person someone might possibly dare to die.

source: Ahin Pathen'in eingailutnau photchena eimusah-un ahi; ajeh iham itile eiho chonsetna i-um laitah-un Christa eiho khelin athitan ahi.
target: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun eiho tun, Christa thisan vanga chonpha kisim ihitah jeh-u chun, achungchona ama vanga Pathen lunghan na-a kona huhhing-a umtei ding ihiuve.
target: Since we have now been justified by his blood, how much more shall we be saved from God’s wrath through him!

source: Ajeh chu adouva ipan laitah uva Pathen Chapa thi chun Pathen toh eisuhchamu ahitah-a ahile, akicham jeh-a chu achungchona ama hinna vanga huhhing-a umtei ding ihiuve.
target: For if, while we were God’s enemies, we were reconciled to him through the death of his Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through his life!

source: Chuti jeng jong hilouvin, tun Pathen toh eisuhcham uva, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa vanga Pathen'a pa jong ikipao ahi.
target: Not only is this so, but we also boast in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation.

source: Hiti chu ahin, mi khat jeh-a vannoi'a chonset lut, chule chonset jeh-a thina lut ahi; chutima chu mi jouse chonset jeh-a thina chu mi jouse chunga lhungsoh ahitai.
target: Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death through sin, and in this way death came to all people, because all sinned—

source: Ajeh chu danthu kipeh masang peh-a chu vannoi leisetna chonset anaumsa ahin; ahivangin danthu um louna-a chu chonset jong kisim lou ahi.
target: To be sure, sin was in the world before the law was given, but sin is not charged against anyone’s account where there is no law.

source: Ahivangin Adam'a pat Mosi geijin Adam suhkhel banga sukhel louho chunga jong, thina chun vai analosa ahi. Adam chu ahung dingpa lim banga um ahi.
target: Nevertheless, death reigned from the time of Adam to the time of Moses, even over those who did not sin by breaking a command, as did Adam, who is a pattern of the one to come.

source: Ahivangin manbeija thilpeh chu suhkhela toh kibang ahipoi; ajeh chu mi khat suhkhel jeh-a midang jouse athia ahile, achungchon cheh-a Pathen lungset le mi khat, Jesu Christa lungset vanga thilpeh chu mi tamtah chunga letsetna chua ahitai.
target: But the gift is not like the trespass. For if the many died by the trespass of the one man, how much more did God’s grace and the gift that came by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, overflow to the many!

source: Chule thilpeh chu, achonsea mi khat jeh-a chutoh akibangpoi; ajeh chu mi khatna kona chu themmo channa lama thu kitan ahin, manbeija thilpeh vang chu suhkhelna tamtah-a kona them changa kisima ahi.
target: Nor can the gift of God be compared with the result of one man’s sin: The judgment followed one sin and brought condemnation, but the gift followed many trespasses and brought justification.

source: Ajeh chu mi khat suhkhel jeh-a, mi khat vanga chu thina-in vai alotah-a ahile, lungsetna le chonphat thilpeh letset changho chu achungchon cheh-a, mi khat, Jesu Christa vanga hinna-a vai alo dingu ahi.
target: For if, by the trespass of the one man, death reigned through that one man, how much more will those who receive God’s abundant provision of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man, Jesus Christ!

source: Chutichu ahin suhkhelna khat jeh-a mi jouse themmo chansahna thutana um ahi; chutima chu chonphatna thilbol khat vanga hinna lama them chansahna manbeija thilpeh chu mi jouse chunga hung uma ahitai.
target: Consequently, just as one trespass resulted in condemnation for all people, so also one righteous act resulted in justification and life for all people.

source: Ajeh chu mikhatnin thupeh apallhah jeh-a mi tamtah chonse kisosah ahitan; chutima chu mikhatnin thupeh anit jeh-a chu mi tamtah chonpha kiso ding ahi.
target: For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous.

source: Amavang suhkhel punna dinga danthu hung lutbe ahi. Ahinla chonset punna chana chu lungsetna hapun cheh-a ahi.
target: The law was brought in so that the trespass might increase. But where sin increased, grace increased all the more,

source: Chutia chu chonsetnin thina-a vai alo bangtah-a chu, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa vanga tonsot hinkemlou geija dinga chonphat vanga lungsetna-in vai alo theina ding ahi.
target: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

source: Achutile ipi isei dingu hitam? Lungsetna apun chehna dinga ichonset jing dingu ham?
target: What shall we say, then? Shall we go on sinning so that grace may increase?

source: Chutiponte! chonset lama athisa eiho, chonsetna iti ihin jing nahlai dingu ham?
target: By no means! We are those who have died to sin; how can we live in it any longer?

source: Eiho Christa Jesu'a baptize chang chengse hi athina-a baptize changa ihiu hi nahet lou uham?
target: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

source: Hiche jeh-a chu Pa loupina vanga Christa athi lah-a kona akaithou banga chu, eiho jong hinkho thah lam chu ijot theina dinguva, baptize chana hi athina-a amatoh kivuitha-a ihi taovin ahi.
target: We were therefore buried with him through baptism into death in order that, just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, we too may live a new life.

source: Ajeh chu ama thi lim banga ithiuva amatoh thikhom ihiule, atho kit lim banga jong itho kit dingu ahi;
target: For if we have been united with him in a death like his, we will certainly also be united with him in a resurrection like his.

source: Tu nung kalsea eiho chonset soh-a i-um louna dinguva, chonset po tahsapum suhmanga aum theina dinga, imi luiju chu amatoh thingpel'a kikhetbeh tha-a ahitai, ti chu iheuve;
target: For we know that our old self was crucified with him so that the body ruled by sin might be done away with, that we should no longer be slaves to sin—

source: Ijeh ham itile athia chu chonsetna kona ongthola ahitai.
target: because anyone who has died has been set free from sin.

source: Chule eiho Christa toh ithiu ahitah-a ahile, amatoh ihin dingu jong ahi, ti chu itahsan un ahi;
target: Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him.

source: Ajeh chu athi lah-a kona kikaithou Christa chu imatihchanna thi lou ding ahi, thina-in achungah thu aneitapoi, ti iheuve.
target: For we know that since Christ was raised from the dead, he cannot die again; death no longer has mastery over him.

source: Athi chu chonset lama tonsot geija dinga khatvei thia ahitai; ahin vang chu Pathen lama hinga ahi.
target: The death he died, he died to sin once for all; but the life he lives, he lives to God.

source: Hiche bang chun nangho jong chonsetna lamah athisan kigel unlang, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa jal-in Pathen lamah ahingin kigelun.
target: In the same way, count yourselves dead to sin but alive to God in Christ Jesus.

source: Hijeh chun natahsa lung got lama chonna dingin, natahsa thithei chunga chun chonset vaipohsah hihhelun.
target: Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body so that you obey its evil desires.

source: Chujongle natibah chengseu chonphat louna manchah-in chonsetna lamah pedoh hihhelun, ahin athi lah-a kona hingdoh kahi tin, Pathen'ah kipeuvin, natibah chengseu jong chu chonphatna manchah din Pathen'ah pedoh jovin.
target: Do not offer any part of yourself to sin as an instrument of wickedness, but rather offer yourselves to God as those who have been brought from death to life; and offer every part of yourself to him as an instrument of righteousness.

source: Ajeh chu chonset chun nachung uva thu neitalou ding ahi, ijeh ham itile danthu noija um nahitapouvin, lungsetna noija umjoh nahiuve.
target: For sin shall no longer be your master, because you are not under the law, but under grace.

source: Iti tantem ahile? Danthu noija um louva lungsetna noija um ihi jeh uva chu, ichonset dinguham? Chutiponte.
target: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under the law but under grace? By no means!

source: Koi heng koi heng hijongle athua nung dinga asoh-a nalutna chu; thina dinga chonsetna lam hijongle, chonphatna dinga thua nunna hijongle, athua naumpa soh chu nahi, hichu nahet louvu ham?
target: Don’t you know that when you offer yourselves to someone as obedient slaves, you are slaves of the one you obey—whether you are slaves to sin, which leads to death, or to obedience, which leads to righteousness?

source: Masangin nangho chonset soh nanahiu ahin, ahivangin lunggiltah-a chutobang thu kihil chu nit dinga kipedoh-a athu noija um nahitaovin,
target: But thanks be to God that, though you used to be slaves to sin, you have come to obey from your heart the pattern of teaching that has now claimed your allegiance.

source: Chule chonsetna kona kichoidoh-a chonphat soh nahiu ahitan, hiche jeh chun Pathen thangvah-in umhen.
target: You have been set free from sin and have become slaves to righteousness.

source: Natahsa pheu hatmo jeh-a keiman mihem thu banga kasei ahi; ajeh chu nanghon masang laija natibah chengu then louna dinga chonset chunga chonsetna lama soh banga napehdoh jiu ahin, hiche bangtah chun tun natibah chengseu chu thenna dingin chonphatna lamah soh bangin pedoh jengun.
target: I am using an example from everyday life because of your human limitations. Just as you used to offer yourselves as slaves to impurity and to ever-increasing wickedness, so now offer yourselves as slaves to righteousness leading to holiness.

source: Nangho chonset soh nahi laijun chonphatna lam dola onga nahiuvin ahi.
target: When you were slaves to sin, you were free from the control of righteousness.

source: Chutichu ahin tu-a najachat piu thulam dola hi hiche laija chu aga ipi namuji uvem? Ajeh chu hitiho chu achaina thina ahibouve.
target: What benefit did you reap at that time from the things you are now ashamed of? Those things result in death!

source: Tu vangin nangho chonsetna kona onga Pathen soh nahitah jeh-un, thenna lamah ga naneitaove, chule aleh chu tonsot hin kemlou ahi.
target: But now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves of God, the benefit you reap leads to holiness, and the result is eternal life.

source: Ijeh ham itile chonset man thina ahi, Pathen thil mohpeh vanghi Pakai Christa Jesu vanga tonsot hinna ahi.
target: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

source: Ole sopite, mihem ahinlai chansebovin danthun achungah thu aneije, ti nahet louvu ham? Danthu themho kahouna ahi.
target: Do you not know, brothers and sisters—for I am speaking to those who know the law—that the law has authority over someone only as long as that person lives?

source: Numei jineija chu a-inneipu ahinlai chansea danthun a-inneipu toh akanbeh jing ahin, ajipa athi vangle, a-inneipu danthua kona chu ongdoh jia ahi.
target: For example, by law a married woman is bound to her husband as long as he is alive, but if her husband dies, she is released from the law that binds her to him.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun a-inneipu hinpetnin midang ji hitahen hile, chutengle amanu chu ajonga kiti ding ahi. A-inneipu thi teng vangle, danthua kona onga ahitan, pasal dang ji hijongle ajonga hita lou ahi.
target: So then, if she has sexual relations with another man while her husband is still alive, she is called an adulteress. But if her husband dies, she is released from that law and is not an adulteress if she marries another man.

source: Nangho chungchang thua jong chutima chu ahi, sopite, Pathen lama iga theina dingule achom khat, athi lah-a kona thoudohpa-a nahi theina dinguva, Christa tahsa vanga danthu lama thisah-a um nahitaove.
target: So, my brothers and sisters, you also died to the law through the body of Christ, that you might belong to another, to him who was raised from the dead, in order that we might bear fruit for God.

source: Ajeh chu tahsaphe-a i-um laiseu chun danthua kona chonsetna lama chalohna chun thina lama iga theina dinguva, itibah chunguva na anatohji ahi.
target: For when we were in the realm of the flesh, the sinful passions aroused by the law were at work in us, so that we bore fruit for death.

source: Ahin tu vangin lekhajem luija hilouva, lhagao thah-a ijen theina dinguva ithiuva, eikituhnao danthua kona kilhadoh ihiuve.
target: But now, by dying to what once bound us, we have been released from the law so that we serve in the new way of the Spirit, and not in the old way of the written code.

source: Achutile ipi isei dinguham? Danthu hi chonsetna ham? Ahipoi; chonset chu ipi ahi anahe lou kahi, danthua kona kahetdoh ahibouve; ajeh chu, Papset bol hih-in, ti hi danthun asei lou hile, ipi ahi kanahet lou ding ahi.
target: What shall we say, then? Is the law sinful? Certainly not! Nevertheless, I would not have known what sin was had it not been for the law. For I would not have known what coveting really was if the law had not said, “You shall not covet.”

source: Ahinla chonset chun agomkomcha atohkhan, chuche thupeh-a kon chun kalunga papset imajouse asosahtan ahi; ajeh chu danthu beija chonset chu athi ahi.
target: But sin, seizing the opportunity afforded by the commandment, produced in me every kind of coveting. For apart from the law, sin was dead.

source: Masanglai chun danthu um louva anahing jing kahin, chuche thupeh ahung um phat chun chonset chu ahingdoh kitnin keima kathitai.
target: Once I was alive apart from the law; but when the commandment came, sin sprang to life and I died.

source: Chule hinna dinga thupeh chu thinajoh-in kananeitan ahi;
target: I found that the very commandment that was intended to bring life actually brought death.

source: Ijeh ham itile chonset chun agomkomcha atokhahjia, thupeh-a chu eilheplhah-a, hiche chun eitha ahi.
target: For sin, seizing the opportunity afforded by the commandment, deceived me, and through the commandment put me to death.

source: Chutichu ahin danthu athenge, thupeh jong athenge, adih lheh jengin aphai;
target: So then, the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, righteous and good.

source: Ahile apha chu keima dinga thina mongham? Ahipoi. Apha chu amanchah-a chonset chun kachunga thina asodoh-a kona chu, hichu chonset ahi tia akiphon dohna dinga chule thupeh vanga chonset chu setna chungnung tah ahi chu, akichetna dinga chonset jeh joh-a ahibouve.
target: Did that which is good, then, become death to me? By no means! Nevertheless, in order that sin might be recognized as sin, it used what is good to bring about my death, so that through the commandment sin might become utterly sinful.

source: Ajeh chu danthu chu lhagao lam thil ahi ti iheuve, keima vang tahsa lam mi chonset soh-a kijoh-a kahi.
target: We know that the law is spiritual; but I am unspiritual, sold as a slave to sin.

source: Ajeh chu keiman ipi kaboldoh kahepoi, ajeh iham itile kalunggot lou lam jeng kaboljin; kahot lam jengbou kabol jin ahi.
target: I do not understand what I do. For what I want to do I do not do, but what I hate I do.

source: Kalunggot lou lam kabola ahile, danthu chu apha ahi tia oija kahi.
target: And if I do what I do not want to do, I agree that the law is good.

source: Ahivangin tun abola keima hita louva keija cheng chonset chun abol ahitabouve.
target: As it is, it is no longer I myself who do it, but it is sin living in me.

source: Ajeh chu keima sunga kasa chunga hin phat achengpoi, ti kahei, ajeh chu lunggotna vang chu aumin thilpha boldoh najohbou umlou ahi.
target: For I know that good itself does not dwell in me, that is, in my sinful nature. For I have the desire to do what is good, but I cannot carry it out.

source: Ajeh iham itile apha kalunggot lam chu kaboljipon, aphalou kalunggot lou lambou chun kachon jingjitan ahi.
target: For I do not do the good I want to do, but the evil I do not want to do—this I keep on doing.

source: Kalunggot lou lam kabolji ahile, abola chu keima hilouva keija um chonsetjoh chu ahibouve.
target: Now if I do what I do not want to do, it is no longer I who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.

source: Chutichun thilpha bol kagot komle, setna chu kakoma ahung umjin, hiche umdanje hi kahetan ahi.
target: So I find this law at work: Although I want to do good, evil is right there with me.

source: Kami sungnungin Pathen danthua kathanom lhehji nan,
target: For in my inner being I delight in God’s law;

source: Ahivangin kalung lam danthu douva katibah chunga um, chonset danthu, soh-a eipui lutji-a katibah chunga hin danthu chom khat aum kamujin ahi.
target: but I see another law at work in me, waging war against the law of my mind and making me a prisoner of the law of sin at work within me.

source: Ohe! mi gentheitah chu kanahi! Hiche thina tahsa-a kon hin koijin eihuhdoh tantem?
target: What a wretched man I am! Who will rescue me from this body that is subject to death?

source: I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa vangin Pathen kathangvah-e. Chutichu ahi jeh-a keiman kalungtah-a Pathen danthu noija kauma, kasa-a chonset danthu soh na katoh ahi.
target: Thanks be to God, who delivers me through Jesus Christ our Lord! So then, I myself in my mind am a slave to God’s law, but in my sinful nature a slave to the law of sin.

source: Hitichun tuvangin, Christa Jesu'a umho, tahsa thua chonlouva lhagao thua chonho dinga themmo channa himhim umlou ahitai.
target: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus,

source: Ijeh ham itile Christa Jesu'a um hinna Lhagao danthu chun chonsetle, thina danthua kona eilhatdoh-a onga kahitai.
target: because through Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit who gives life has set you free from the law of sin and death.

source: Ajeh chu tahsaphen asuh hatmo jeh-a danthun abol joulou chu, Pathen'in Achapa chu chonset jeh-a chonset po tahsaphe lim pu-a ahinsola; tahsaphe-a chonsetna chu themmo achan ahitan,
target: For what the law was powerless to do because it was weakened by the flesh, God did by sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh to be a sin offering. And so he condemned sin in the flesh,

source: Hichu tahsaphe lam hilouva Lhagao lama chon eiho chunga, danthun angeh chonphatna chu aguilhun theina ding ahi.
target: in order that the righteous requirement of the law might be fully met in us, who do not live according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.

source: Ajeh iham itile tahsaphe lam dana chonteho chun tahsaphe lam thudol agelun; Lhagao lam dana chonho chun Lhagao lam thudol bou agelun ahi.
target: Those who live according to the flesh have their minds set on what the flesh desires; but those who live in accordance with the Spirit have their minds set on what the Spirit desires.

source: Tahsa lam lunggel chu thina ahin, Lhagao lam lunggel chu hinna le lungmonna ahi.
target: The mind governed by the flesh is death, but the mind governed by the Spirit is life and peace.

source: Ajeh chu tahsa lam lunggel chu Pathen toh kidou ahi; ajehchu Pathen danthu noija um ahipon, umjong umthei louding ahi.
target: The mind governed by the flesh is hostile to God; it does not submit to God’s law, nor can it do so.

source: Hijeh chun tahsa lama chonho chun Pathen alunglhai theipouve.
target: Those who are in the realm of the flesh cannot please God.

source: Pathen Lhagao nasunguva achen vangle, tahsa lama chon hilouva Lhagao lama chon nahiu ahi. Christa Lhagao neilou vang chu Christa-a ahipoi.
target: You, however, are not in the realm of the flesh but are in the realm of the Spirit, if indeed the Spirit of God lives in you. And if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, they do not belong to Christ.

source: Chule Christa chu nangho sunga auma ahile, chonset vanga tahsa chu athia ahin, lhagao vang chu chonphat vanga hinna ahi.
target: But if Christ is in you, then even though your body is subject to death because of sin, the Spirit gives life because of righteousness.

source: Chule athi lah-a kona Jesu kaithoupa Lhagao chu nangho sunga achenle, Christa Jesu mithi lah-a kona kaithoupa tah chun nangho sunga cheng ama lhagao vanga chu, natahsao thi thei jong chu ahinsah ding ahi.
target: And if the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, he who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies because of his Spirit who lives in you.

source: Hijeh chun, sopite, eihon bat ineijuve, amavang tahsa henga, tahsa lama chonna dinga neija ihipouve.
target: Therefore, brothers and sisters, we have an obligation—but it is not to the flesh, to live according to it.

source: Ajeh chu nangho tahsa lam dana nachonule, iti jongle nathi tei dingu ahi; Lhagaova tahsa natoh chengse chu natha vangule, nahin dingu ahi.
target: For if you live according to the flesh, you will die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the misdeeds of the body, you will live.

source: Ajeh chu Pathen Lhagao kaihoija umho chengse chu, Pathen chate ahiuve.
target: For those who are led by the Spirit of God are the children of God.

source: Ajeh iham itile kichat kitna dinga sohchana lhagao hilouva, cha hina lhagao changjoh nahibouvui; hiche lhagao vanga chu, Abba, Hepa, tia ikoujiu ahi.
target: The Spirit you received does not make you slaves, so that you live in fear again; rather, the Spirit you received brought about your adoption to sonship. And by him we cry, “ Abba, Father.”

source: Lhagao chun amatah-in eiho lhagaotoh kitho-a Pathen chate ihiu eihetsah-u ahi.
target: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are God’s children.

source: Chule chate ihiule gou lo ding ihiuvin, Pathen gou lo ding, chule Christa toh lo khom ding ihiuve; amatoh ithoh khomule, amatoh choi-atna iumkhom dingu ahi.
target: Now if we are children, then we are heirs—heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ, if indeed we share in his sufferings in order that we may also share in his glory.

source: Tulaija ithohnao hi khonunga ichan dingu loupina hung kilang ding chutoh kikot hoi themin kangaito poi.
target: I consider that our present sufferings are not worth comparing with the glory that will be revealed in us.

source: Thilsem chengse kinem ngui nguitah-a Pathen chate hung kilah ding chu angalel lheh jengu ahi.
target: For the creation waits in eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

source: Ijeh ham itile thilsem chengse ahomkeo thu noija aumu hi ama chama um ahipoi, kinepna-a aumsahpa thusah-a um ahibouvui.
target: For the creation was subjected to frustration, not by its own choice, but by the will of the one who subjected it, in hope

source: Ajeh chu thilsem chengse hin amahotah jong kemthei soh-a auma kona lhadoh-a aumuva, Pathen chate loupitah-a noma alenaova chu alut diu ahi.
target: that the creation itself will be liberated from its bondage to decay and brought into the freedom and glory of the children of God.

source: Ahin tugei hin thilsem jouse naosonat thoh banga gim thoh-a peng penga umkhom ahi ti iheuve.
target: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.

source: Amaho jengseh ahipoi, Lhagao ga masa changa eihotah jeng jong, cha hina, itahsao lhatdoh-a umding chu ngah jinga, ilung sungu peng penga um ihiuve.
target: Not only so, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for our adoption to sonship, the redemption of our bodies.

source: Ajeh chu kinepna in eihuhhingu ahin; ahinla mu-a kinep chu kinep ahipoi; ajehchu mihemin amusa chu ipi dinga akineppi nahlai ding ham?
target: For in this hope we were saved. But hope that is seen is no hope at all. Who hopes for what they already have?

source: Mu louva kinem ihiu vangle, lungdet tah-a ngah jinga ihiuve.
target: But if we hope for what we do not yet have, we wait for it patiently.

source: Chutichun Lhagao jongin ihatmonauvah eikaihoijun eihu jingjiuve; ajeh chu eihon adol lamtah-a ipi-a dinga itao diuham ihepouve; ahivangin Lhagaovin eiho dingin seidoh thei louvin peng pengin eitaopeh jiuve.
target: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. We do not know what we ought to pray for, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us through wordless groans.

source: Chule Pathen lunglam doltah-a mithengte dinga ataopeh jeh chun, lungthimgil kholtoh-a Pathen chun Lhagao lunglam chu ahejin ahi.
target: And he who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for God’s people in accordance with the will of God.

source: Ahin Pathen ngailuho chengse, ama lunggot lam doltah-a kikouho ding vang chun, thiljouse hin aphat nadingu atongkhom sohkeije, ti chu iheuve.
target: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.

source: Ijeh ham itile sopihon tamtah lah-a Pathen Chapa chu apeng masapen ahina dinga, Pathen'in ahet masah ho chu Achapa lim banga agot masahsa ahitai;
target: For those God foreknew he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers and sisters.

source: Chule agot masahsaho chu kou jong akou ahi; chule akouho chu them jong achansah ahitai: chule them achansahho chu choi jong achoi-at ahitai.
target: And those he predestined, he also called; those he called, he also justified; those he justified, he also glorified.

source: Chuti ahile hicheng thua hi ipi isei dingu ham? Pathen eiho lama apanle, koiham eidou thei dinguva?
target: What, then, shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

source: Achapa khen louhela eiho jouse dinga pedoh jengpa chun, eiho lungset mana ama chutoh thakhatna ijakai eipeh khom lou dingu ham?
target: He who did not spare his own Son, but gave him up for us all—how will he not also, along with him, graciously give us all things?

source: Pathen lhenchomteho chu koiham ahehse dinga? Them chansah-a Pathen ahibouve.
target: Who will bring any charge against those whom God has chosen? It is God who justifies.

source: Themmo chansah-a koiham? Athia, achungchon cheh-a athi lah-a kona kaithouva um Christa chu ahi; ama Pathen jet lama atouvin eiho dingin eitaopeh jinguve.
target: Who then is the one who condemns? No one. Christ Jesus who died—more than that, who was raised to life—is at the right hand of God and is also interceding for us.

source: Christa ngailutna-a kona koiham eikhen dinguva? Hesoh gentheile, lungdonna, bolsetna, gilkel, pon beija um, settona, chemjam, hicheng chun eikhen thei dingham?
target: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall trouble or hardship or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?

source: Hiche dol jong hi akisune, Keiho nangma jeh-in nilhum keijin eikithat jingui; Tha dinga kigo kelngoi bangin eikisim taove.
target: As it is written: “For your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.”

source: Ahinla eingailupau vangin hicheng thua hin eiho galjou sanga galjou ihiuve.
target: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

source: Ajeh chu I-Pakaiyu Christa Jesu'a um Pathen ngailutna kon chun thina ahin, hinna ahin, vantil ahin, vaipo pipu ahin, thuneina ahin, tulai thudol le khonung ding thu ahin,
target: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor demons, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers,

source: Chungsang ahin, noilam thuhtah hijongle, thilsem adang imachan eikhen thei lou dingu ahi, tia dettah-a katahsan ahitai.
target: neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

source: Keiman Christa-a thutahbeh kasei ahi, kajoupoi;
target: I speak the truth in Christ—I am not lying, my conscience confirms it through the Holy Spirit—

source: Kalunga lunghesohna nasatahle thohlel tang louhela aum hi, ase apha kahetna kalungin Lhagao Thengah eihettohpin ahi.
target: I have great sorrow and unceasing anguish in my heart.

source: Ajeh chu keimatah-in tahsa lama kanam mite, kasopite khela Christa-a kona manna lama dinga sedoh-a uma, sapset lhunna-a umhel jeng ding kanagot ahi.
target: For I could wish that I myself were cursed and cut off from Christ for the sake of my people, those of my own race,

source: Israelte ahiuvin; cha hina chu amauva ahin, loupina, thulhun jouse, danthu peh, Pathen houna, chule thutep jouse la amaho-a ahin;
target: the people of Israel. Theirs is the adoption to sonship; theirs the divine glory, the covenants, the receiving of the law, the temple worship and the promises.

source: Pute pate jong amaho-a bou ahin, tahsaphe lama Christa jongla amaho lah-a kon ahibouvin, ama chu imajouse chunga chungnung pen Pathen ahin, akhang akhanga pachat tohtah ahi. Amen.
target: Theirs are the patriarchs, and from them is traced the human ancestry of the Messiah, who is God over all, forever praised! Amen.

source: Ahivangin Pathen thu chu imacha hilouva um ahipoi. Ajeh chu Israel lah-a kon jouse Israel ahipoi.
target: It is not as though God’s word had failed. For not all who are descended from Israel are Israel.

source: Chule Abraham chilhah ahisohkei vangun aboncha keijun achate ahipouve; Isaac'a kona bou nachilhah tia kisei ding ahi, tia asei ahi.
target: Nor because they are his descendants are they all Abraham’s children. On the contrary, “It is through Isaac that your offspring will be reckoned.”

source: Hichu hiti hi ahi, tahsa-a chate chu Pathen chate ahipoi; thutep chatebou chu chilhah tia kisim ahi.
target: In other words, it is not the children by physical descent who are God’s children, but it is the children of the promise who are regarded as Abraham’s offspring.

source: Thutep chu hiche hi ahi, Hiti phattah hile kahung ding ahin, chutengle Sara'in chapa khat ahin ding ahi.
target: For this was how the promise was stated: “At the appointed time I will return, and Sarah will have a son.”

source: Chucheng jeng ahipoi, ahin Rebecca jong chu mi khatna kona, ipuluiju Isaac'a kona agai laijin,
target: Not only that, but Rebekah’s children were conceived at the same time by our father Isaac.

source: Achateni so masangin chule apha ase imacha abol masangin, toh vanga hilouva akoupa lunglam le Pathen'in alhen dungjuija, lunggotsa chu adetna dinga,
target: Yet, before the twins were born or had done anything good or bad—in order that God’s purpose in election might stand:

source: Amanu jah-a, A-upajo chun anaopa soh na atoh ding ahi, tia kiseija anahi.
target: not by works but by him who calls—she was told, “The older will serve the younger.”

source: Hiche thudola hin, Keiman Jacob kana ngailun, Esau vang kanahot ahi, tin akisune.
target: Just as it is written: “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”

source: Achutile ipi isei dingu ham? Pathen'ah chonphat louna aume iti dingu ham? Ahipoi.
target: What then shall we say? Is God unjust? Not at all!

source: Aman Mosi jah-a, Keiman kalungsetpa chu lungset ningting, kahepipa chu kahepi ding ahi, ati.
target: For he says to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun hiche hi alunga tuppa vang jong hilouva, adelpa vang jong hilouva, alungsetpa Pathen vanga konjoh ahibouve.
target: It does not, therefore, depend on human desire or effort, but on God’s mercy.

source: Pathen lekhabu thun Pharaoh jah-a, Nachunga kathilbol theina kavetsah theina dingle, vannoi leisetna kamin kiphon jalna ding monga nangma katundoh nahi, ati.
target: For Scripture says to Pharaoh: “I raised you up for this very purpose, that I might display my power in you and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”

source: Chutichu ahin Pathen'in ahepi nomchan ahepijia, alunggot chan chu alung asuhtahji ahi.
target: Therefore God has mercy on whom he wants to have mercy, and he hardens whom he wants to harden.

source: Hichea hin nangman kei jah-a, Achutile ibola eithem mosah jiham, neitin nate. Ajeh chu alunggot chu koiham akham theija?
target: One of you will say to me: “Then why does God still blame us? For who is able to resist his will?”

source: Ahipoi, vo mihem, Pathen douna-a donbut nang koi nahim? Thilsem chun asempa jah-a, Ibola hitia neisem ham, tintem?
target: But who are you, a human being, to talk back to God? “Shall what is formed say to the one who formed it, ‘Why did you make me like this?’ ”

source: Bellei lhang khatna bel khat lutah-a dena, khat lulouva den ding, abel lei chunga chu beldengpan thu anei hilouham?
target: Does not the potter have the right to make out of the same lump of clay some pottery for special purposes and some for common use?

source: Ahin, Pathen'in alungsat vetsahnale athil bolthei hetsahna ding lung ngaito-a, mangthah dinga gotsa um lungsatna belho chunga alung adesotle;
target: What if God, although choosing to show his wrath and make his power known, bore with great patience the objects of his wrath—prepared for destruction?

source: Chule loupi nikho-a dinga masanga patna agotsa, ahepi belho chunga aloupina hao chu hetsah dinga,
target: What if he did this to make the riches of his glory known to the objects of his mercy, whom he prepared in advance for glory—

source: Aman eiho jengjong, Juda lah-a kon jengseh hilouva, chidang namdangte lah-a kon jonga eikouvu hilouham?
target: even us, whom he also called, not only from the Jews but also from the Gentiles?

source: Chutobang chun Hosea lekhabua, Kamite hikhalouho chu keiman kamite kati ding, kadeilounu chu kadeinu kati ding ahi.
target: As he says in Hosea: “I will call them ‘my people’ who are not my people; and I will call her ‘my loved one’ who is not my loved one,”

source: Nangho keima mite nahipouve tia ajah uva kiseina laitah-a chu, Amaho Pathen hing chate kiti ding ahiuve, tia kisei bang chu ahi.
target: and, “In the very place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’ ”

source: Israelte thudol Isaiah'in asamlen, Israel chate twikhanglen kama neldi jatnin tam jongleu, amoh thembou sohcha ding ahi.
target: Isaiah cries out concerning Israel: “Though the number of the Israelites be like the sand by the sea, only the remnant will be saved.

source: Ajehchu aman natoh chu achaija chule chonphatna-a phat asuh chom ding ahi; ajehchu Pakaiyin leisetna hi chomcha khat bou na atoh ding ahi.
target: For the Lord will carry out his sentence on earth with speed and finality.”

source: Hiche thudol hi Isaiah'in masangin aseije, Janel Pakaiyin chikhai ding einakhen louvu hile, Sodom dung isun diu ahin, Gomorrah toh ibah dingu ahi, ati.
target: It is just as Isaiah said previously: “Unless the Lord Almighty had left us descendants, we would have become like Sodom, we would have been like Gomorrah.”

source: Achutile ipi isei dingu ham? Chonphatna del louhel chidang namdang ten chonphatna chu aphah-u ahitai; hichu tahsan vanga chonphatna ahi.
target: What then shall we say? That the Gentiles, who did not pursue righteousness, have obtained it, a righteousness that is by faith;

source: Ahin Chonphatna danthu dela Israel ten, hiche chonphatna dan chu aphajou pouve.
target: but the people of Israel, who pursued the law as the way of righteousness, have not attained their goal.

source: Ijeh ham? amahon tahsana hollouva, dan thilbolla ahol jeh-u ahi. Kipal lhuhna songa kipal lhu-a ahitaove.
target: Why not? Because they pursued it not by faith but as if it were by works. They stumbled over the stumbling stone.

source: Hiche thudol jong hi akisune, Veuvin, keiman Sion'ah kipalna song le lung lhahna songpi kakoije; koihile ama tahsan chan chu jachatna-a chulou ding ahi.
target: As it is written: “See, I lay in Zion a stone that causes people to stumble and a rock that makes them fall, and the one who believes in him will never be put to shame.”

source: Sopite, lunga kagotle Israelte dia Pathen henga katao nomna chu, huhhing-a ahung umtheina dingu hi, ahipene.
target: Brothers and sisters, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for the Israelites is that they may be saved.

source: Pathen lama agunchuve ti chu keiman kahetsah ahi; ahivangin hichu hetna neija gunchu ahipoi.
target: For I can testify about them that they are zealous for God, but their zeal is not based on knowledge.

source: Ajeh chu amahon Pathen chonphatna ahetlou jeh-ule, amaho chonphatna phudoh ding agot jeh-un, Pathen chonphat na-ah alut tapouve.
target: Since they did not know the righteousness of God and sought to establish their own, they did not submit to God’s righteousness.

source: Christa chu atahsan jouse dinga, chonphatna amu theina dinguva danthu chaina ahi.
target: Christ is the culmination of the law so that there may be righteousness for everyone who believes.

source: Ajehchu Mosi'n chonphatna danthu anahilchet na-a, chonphatna nitpa bou chuche achonphat vanga chu hing ding ahi, anatin ahi.
target: Moses writes this about the righteousness that is by the law: “The person who does these things will live by them.”

source: Tahsana chonphat vang chun hitin aseije, Nangman nalung thimin, Koiham van'a kal ding? (hichu Christa gapuilhah ding aseina ahi);
target: But the righteousness that is by faith says: “Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ ” (that is, to bring Christ down)

source: ahiloule, Koiham lei onga kumlha ding? (hichu athi lah-a kona Christa kaithou ding aseina ahi), ti hih-in.
target: “or ‘Who will descend into the deep?’ ” (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead).

source: Ahin ipi aseijem? hiche thu chu nakomah aume, nakam sungle nalung sungah aume; (hichu kasei phongleu tahsan thu chu ahi).
target: But what does it say? “The word is near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart,” that is, the message concerning faith that we proclaim:

source: Hitia chu nangman nakama Pakai Jesu chu naphon doha, chule Pathen nin ama chu athilah-a konin akaithouve ti nalunga natahsan le, asohcha ding nahi.
target: If you declare with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord,” and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

source: Ajeh chu chonphatna dinga lunga tahsan ahin, sochatna dinga kama phondoh ahi.
target: For it is with your heart that you believe and are justified, and it is with your mouth that you profess your faith and are saved.

source: Pathen lekhabu thun, Koi hileh ama tahsan chan chu jachatna-a chulou ding ahi, ati.
target: As Scripture says, “Anyone who believes in him will never be put to shame.”

source: Ijeh-inem itile Juda mitele Greek mite chu imacha chom ahipouve; abonchauva chungah Pakai khatsehbou aume, ahenga tao jouse dinga phatna haotah ahi.
target: For there is no difference between Jew and Gentile—the same Lord is Lord of all and richly blesses all who call on him,

source: Koi hile Pakai mina tao chan chu huhhing-a umding ahi.
target: for, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.”

source: Achutile atahsan louvu chu iti akou dinguham? Athu ajahkhah louvu chu iti atahsan dinguham? Thusei phongle beija iti ajah dinguham?
target: How, then, can they call on the one they have not believed in? And how can they believe in the one of whom they have not heard? And how can they hear without someone preaching to them?

source: Chule akisol louvule iti asei phongle dinguham? hitijong hin akisune, chamna kipana thupha seiphong leho, thilphaho thudola kipana thu poleho keng iti hoi hitam!
target: And how can anyone preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!”

source: Ahivangin mi jousen Kipana Thupha angaipouve. Ajeh chu Isaiah'in jong, Pakai, kathuphonle-u koiham atahsana, ati.
target: But not all the Israelites accepted the good news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our message?”

source: Chuti ahijeh chun, jah-a kona tahsan umdoh, chule jah chu Pathen thua kona hung umdoh ahi.
target: Consequently, faith comes from hearing the message, and the message is heard through the word about Christ.

source: Ahileh amahon ajah lou uham? Ajanauve. A-awginu gamtina athangin, Chule athu uvin kolkimvel achansoh tai.
target: But I ask: Did they not hear? Of course they did: “Their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”

source: Ahivanga kasei ahi, Israel miten ahetlou uham? Amasan Mosi'n aseijin, Keiman nangho vai neilou vai khat thangset sah-uving ting, Lungthim neilou vai khatna kona kalunghansah ding nahiuve, ati.
target: Again I ask: Did Israel not understand? First, Moses says, “I will make you envious by those who are not a nation; I will make you angry by a nation that has no understanding.”

source: Isaiah'in jong hakattah-in aseijin, Eihol louten eimudoh-un, Eidong loute hengah kakiphongtai, ati.
target: And Isaiah boldly says, “I was found by those who did not seek me; I revealed myself to those who did not ask for me.”

source: Ahin Israel jah-a, thua nungloute le nel hatte chunga kakhut kajah nilhum keije, tin aseije.
target: But concerning Israel he says, “All day long I have held out my hands to a disobedient and obstinate people.”

source: Achutile Pathen'in amite chu apailhah hitam? Ahipoi. Ajeh chu kei jong Abraham chilhah-a Benjamin phunga Israel mi khat kahi.
target: I ask then: Did God reject his people? By no means! I am an Israelite myself, a descendant of Abraham, from the tribe of Benjamin.

source: Pathen'in ahet masatsa amite chu apailhapoi. Pathen lekhabu thun Elijah thu asei hi nahet lou uham? Aman Israelte chungchang thu Pathen henga alhutnin,
target: God did not reject his people, whom he foreknew. Don’t you know what Scripture says in the passage about Elijah—how he appealed to God against Israel:

source: Pakai, amahon nangma themgaoho athatgamun, nang houna maicham asuchimun, keima changseh kaumtai, kei jong tha dingin eitup jingui, ati.
target: “Lord, they have killed your prophets and torn down your altars; I am the only one left, and they are trying to kill me”?

source: Ahivangin Pathen'in adonbutna chu ipi aseijem? Keiman keija dingin Baal anga dilsu louhel mi sangsagi kakikhen nai, ati.
target: And what was God’s answer to him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”

source: Chutobangma chun tulaijin jong lungsetna kilheng amoh moh aumnai.
target: So too, at the present time there is a remnant chosen by grace.

source: Amavang hichu lungset man ahile, thilbol vanga ahipoi; chuti ahiloule lungsetna hi lungsetna hita lou ahi. Ahinla, hichu natoh vang ahile lungset vang ahitapoi, chuti ahiloule natoh hi natoh hitalou ahi.
target: And if by grace, then it cannot be based on works; if it were, grace would no longer be grace.

source: Iti hitante ahile? Israel miten aholu chu amu louvu ahin, Pathen lhentehon bou amu ahi; adang chengse chu alung tahcheh taovin ahi.
target: What then? What the people of Israel sought so earnestly they did not obtain. The elect among them did, but the others were hardened,

source: Pathen lekhabua hitin akisune, Pathen'in tuni gei hin amaho khu imutsetna lhagao apen, amu thei louna dingun mit apen, jah thei louna nakhang apen ahi.
target: as it is written: “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that could not see and ears that could not hear, to this very day.”

source: David jongin, A-an nehnao dokhang chu amaho dingin thangle pel hihen, Chule akipalnao le akiditnao hihen.
target: And David says: “May their table become a snare and a trap, a stumbling block and a retribution for them.

source: Amu mona dingun amitnu thimhen, Chule nangman atingu bonsah jingin, tin aseijin ahi.
target: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.”

source: Keiman, ahile alhuhna dinguva kipala hiuvam, kati. Ahinaisaipoi. Amavang amaho thangset sahna dinga, amaho suhkhel vanga chu chidang namdangte dinga sochatna ahitai.
target: Again I ask: Did they stumble so as to fall beyond recovery? Not at all! Rather, because of their transgression, salvation has come to the Gentiles to make Israel envious.

source: Chule amaho suhkhel chu vannoi'in haona-a aneija, chule amaho hakam chu chidang namdang ten haona-a aneija ahile, abulhin nau chu chusanga ijatna chungnung cheh ding hitam!
target: But if their transgression means riches for the world, and their loss means riches for the Gentiles, how much greater riches will their full inclusion bring!

source: Keiman chidang namdang mi nangho jah-a kasei ahi, keima chidang namdangte dinga solchah-a kapan jeh hin,
target: I am talking to you Gentiles. Inasmuch as I am the apostle to the Gentiles, I take pride in my ministry

source: Ijem tia kanam chanpite kathangsetsah-a alah uva abang bang asochat theina dingun katin, lhacha kapana hi kaloupisah lheh jeng ahi.
target: in the hope that I may somehow arouse my own people to envy and save some of them.

source: Ajeh chu amaho kipaidoh vannoi'in kichamna-a aneija ahile, amaho kilah kit chu athia kona hinna ding tailou, adang ipi hi dingham?
target: For if their rejection brought reconciliation to the world, what will their acceptance be but life from the dead?

source: Chule changbong lum amasa athena ahile, changlhah tum jouse apumpia atheng ahi; chule ajung athenle, abah chengse jong athenga ahi.
target: If the part of the dough offered as firstfruits is holy, then the whole batch is holy; if the root is holy, so are the branches.

source: Ahinla abah abang bang akiheboh-a ahile, nangho gam olive bou nahiuvin, abah lah-a kijoma nahiuve, Olive thingphung ajunga kona phattheina changkha nahitah-a nahile,
target: If some of the branches have been broken off, and you, though a wild olive shoot, have been grafted in among the others and now share in the nourishing sap from the olive root,

source: Abahho chungah kithang-at hih-in. Kithang-at jongle chun, ajung vah-a nang nahipoi, ajungbou chun nang navahjoh ahibouve.
target: do not consider yourself to be superior to those other branches. If you do, consider this: You do not support the root, but the root supports you.

source: Hichea hin nangman, Keima kijopna dinga abahho kisubonga ahitai, tin nate.
target: You will say then, “Branches were broken off so that I could be grafted in.”

source: Aphai, atahsan lou jeh-a hicheho chu kisubonga ahin, nangma natahsan jala nadindet ahi. Hoitho hih-in, kichajon;
target: Granted. But they were broken off because of unbelief, and you stand by faith. Do not be arrogant, but tremble.

source: Ajeh chu Pathen'in abah tahbeh bon akhen loule, nangma jong khenpon nate.
target: For if God did not spare the natural branches, he will not spare you either.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun Pathen phatjele lungkhohje chu veuvin; alhuho dinga chu lungkhoh tah ahin, nangma ding vanga phatah ahi. Aphatna-ah um jingin, achuti loule nang jong naki satlha ding ahi.
target: Consider therefore the kindness and sternness of God: sternness to those who fell, but kindness to you, provided that you continue in his kindness. Otherwise, you also will be cut off.

source: Amaho chu tahsan louva aum jing louvule, kijom kit ding ahiuve, Pathen'in amaho chu ajop kit thei ahi.
target: And if they do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

source: Ajeh iham itile apena patna gam Olive phunga kona kisatlha-a nangma, angai louva Olive phung phatoh kijop nahile, apena patna abah tahbeh ho chu olive toh iti kiha jopmat cheh ding hitam!
target: After all, if you were cut out of an olive tree that is wild by nature, and contrary to nature were grafted into a cultivated olive tree, how much more readily will these, the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree!

source: Sopite, hiche thuguh hi helouva naum dingu kanompoi, ajole hung kichihsah khauvinate; chidang namdangte akimsoh kahse-a Israel mite kimkhat chunga lungtahna chua ahi.
