target: I do not want you to be ignorant of this mystery, brothers and sisters, so that you may not be conceited: Israel has experienced a hardening in part until the full number of the Gentiles has come in,

source: Chutichu ahin Israelte jouse huhhing-a um cheh ding ahi. Hiche thudol hi, Sion'a kona Huhhing-a hung ding ahin, chule Aman Jacob phunga kona Pathen ngaisah louna asuhmang ding ahi,
target: and in this way all Israel will be saved. As it is written: “The deliverer will come from Zion; he will turn godlessness away from Jacob.

source: Achonsetnao kalahmang tengle, Hiche hi amahotoh kakitepnao hi ding ahi, tin akisune.
target: And this is my covenant with them when I take away their sins.”

source: Kipana Thupha thudola amaho khu nangho jala melmate ahiuvin, lhenchom lam thudola apu apateu jala deitahte ahiuve.
target: As far as the gospel is concerned, they are enemies for your sake; but as far as election is concerned, they are loved on account of the patriarchs,

source: Ijeh ham itile Pathen'in manbeija athilpehho le akouho chu akhelkit theihoi ahipoi.
target: for God’s gifts and his call are irrevocable.

source: Masangin Pathen thua nunglou nahiuvin, tu vangin amaho louchal jeh-a lungsetna mu-a nahitaove.
target: Just as you who were at one time disobedient to God have now received mercy as a result of their disobedience,

source: Chule chutobangma chu amahon jong, lungsetna namu jaluva hi lungsetna amu theina dinguva, tu-a louchala ahiuve.
target: so they too have now become disobedient in order that they too may now receive mercy as a result of God’s mercy to you.

source: Ijeh ham itile Pathen'in mi jouse alungset theina dinga thua nunlou na-a akhumchah ahitai.
target: For God has bound everyone over to disobedience so that he may have mercy on them all.

source: Pathen chihna le hetna haoje hi athuh lheh jenge! Avaihom athutan hetphah hoi ahipoi, chule alampiho holdoh theihoi ahipoi!
target: Oh, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable his judgments, and his paths beyond tracing out!

source: Ajeh chu Pakai lungthim chu koiham ahea? Chujongle lungthim pe-a anapanga koiham?
target: “Who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”

source: Alepeh kit dinga thilpha anape masa koiham?
target: “Who has ever given to God, that God should repay them?”

source: Ajeh chu ama-a konle, ama vanga, chule ama dinga thil jouse ana uma ahi. Loupina jouse atonsot geijin ama-a hi jinghen. Amen.
target: For from him and through him and for him are all things. To him be the glory forever! Amen.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun, sopite, Pathen lungset vang hin natipum piu chu longlhen thengtah gan kihinglha bangin Pathen lah thei doltah-in Pathen'ah kipeuvin tia kangeh nahiuve, hichu natoh dinguva kilom tah chu ahi.
target: Therefore, I urge you, brothers and sisters, in view of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God—this is your true and proper worship.

source: Chule nangho tulai vannoi leiset chon hin chon hih-un; Pathen lungdeilam, hichu apha, lah theile phat chamkim hi ipi ahi nahetdoh theina dingun, lung thah keng-unlang lim chom puvin.
target: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will.

source: Hijeh chun eipeh lungsetna vang hin nalah uva mi chengse jah-a kasei ahi, agel dingdol kalvalin koiman kalena ti gel hihhen, amavang Pathen'in apeh kham kham tahsanna dungjuijin kituptah-in ngaito henlang lung geltohhen.
target: For by the grace given me I say to every one of you: Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought, but rather think of yourself with sober judgment, in accordance with the faith God has distributed to each of you.

source: Tipum khatnah tibah tamtah ineijui, tibah jouse thakhat ahipoi, apanna akibangpon ahi.
target: For just as each of us has one body with many members, and these members do not all have the same function,

source: Hibang chun eiho jong tamtah ihiuvin, Christa-a ti khat ihiuve; khat chu khat tibah ihi cheh-un ahi.
target: so in Christ we, though many, form one body, and each member belongs to all the others.

source: Lungsetna eipeh bang cheh-un eithil peh-u achom cheh ineijun ahi. Thusei phongna apehpan atahsan dungjuijin seihen;
target: We have different gifts, according to the grace given to each of us. If your gift is prophesying, then prophesy in accordance with your faith;

source: Sottola pang chu sottolin umhen; mihil chun mihil lamah;
target: if it is serving, then serve; if it is teaching, then teach;

source: Mitilkhou chun mitilkhouna lamah kipehen; thil homan it louhelin homhen; vaipo-a pang chun gunchu tah-in vai pohen; milungsetnan kipahtah-in lungset hen.
target: if it is to encourage, then give encouragement; if it is giving, then give generously; if it is to lead, do it diligently; if it is to show mercy, do it cheerfully.

source: Ngailutna alem beihel hihen. Ase lam thet bolunlang apha chu kolchah jingun.
target: Love must be sincere. Hate what is evil; cling to what is good.

source: Kisopi ngailutna lamah kideito kisato cheh-in umun; kiginle kijana lamah amasajo ding kichu-uvin;
target: Be devoted to one another in love. Honor one another above yourselves.

source: Gunchuna lamah thase hih-un; lhagao lamah al jingun; Pakai lhachan pangun;
target: Never be lacking in zeal, but keep your spiritual fervor, serving the Lord.

source: Kinepna-ah thanomun; genthei hesohna-a thohhatnun; taona lamah pontho jingun;
target: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, faithful in prayer.

source: Mithengho lhahsam huna-in kithopiuvin; jindot themun.
target: Share with the Lord’s people who are in need. Practice hospitality.

source: Nabolseteu chu phatthei boh-un; samse louvin phatthei bohjouvin.
target: Bless those who persecute you; bless and do not curse.

source: Kipah thanomte chu kipa thanop piuvin; akapte chu kapiuvin.
target: Rejoice with those who rejoice; mourn with those who mourn.

source: Kitohdelin lungkhat nin chon cheh-un. Letna lam lung gel louvin aneo neotoh kiloijun. Nangma chang kichihsah hih-in.
target: Live in harmony with one another. Do not be proud, but be willing to associate with people of low position. Do not be conceited.

source: Mi setna chu setna-in thuh hih-un; mi jouse mitvetna apha chu bol ding gojouvin.
target: Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Be careful to do what is right in the eyes of everyone.

source: Chule ahi theija ahile, najochanun, mi jousetoh kihoutheijun kichamdelin umun.
target: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.

source: Vo deitahte, kiphulah hih-un, Pathen lunghanna chu otdoh jovin; ajeh chu Pakaiyin, Phulah chu keima kinbou ahi, keiman lethuh nange, ati, tin akisune.
target: Do not take revenge, my dear friends, but leave room for God’s wrath, for it is written: “It is mine to avenge; I will repay,” says the Lord.

source: Ahin, namelmao chu agil akela ahile, an nehsah-un; adang achahle twi donsah-un; chuti bolleu chun alu chunga mei-am setkhompeh nahi dingu ahi.
target: On the contrary: “If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him something to drink. In doing this, you will heap burning coals on his head.”

source: Setna kijosah hihhelun, setna chu phatna-in joujovin.
target: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

source: Thunei chungnungte thu thun mi jouse nungcheh hen; ajeh chu Pathen thusah louva thuneija aumpoi, chule aum chengse hi Pathen pansah cheh ahiuve.
target: Let everyone be subject to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which God has established. The authorities that exist have been established by God.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun chuche thuneite douva chu Pathen thu douva ahi, chule adouho chun achunguva thutanna akiloikhum dingu ahi.
target: Consequently, whoever rebels against the authority is rebelling against what God has instituted, and those who do so will bring judgment on themselves.

source: Ajeh iham itile vaipoho chu thilpha bolpa dinga kichat um hilouvin, ase bolpa dingabou kichat uma ahi. Thunei ho kicha louhelin umleng ti nagotnem? Thilpha bolin, chutile apachat nachan ding ahi;
target: For rulers hold no terror for those who do right, but for those who do wrong. Do you want to be free from fear of the one in authority? Then do what is right and you will be commended.

source: Ajeh chu nangma phattheina dinga ama Pathen sottola pang ahi. Ase nabol vangle kichan, aman chemjam adop khu moh-a adop ahipoi; ajeh chu ama Pathen sottol ahin, ase bolpa chunga lunghanga phula-a pang ahi.
target: For the one in authority is God’s servant for your good. But if you do wrong, be afraid, for rulers do not bear the sword for no reason. They are God’s servants, agents of wrath to bring punishment on the wrongdoer.

source: Hijeh chun lunghanna ding ahipon, ase apha hetna jala jong athua nun ding ahi.
target: Therefore, it is necessary to submit to the authorities, not only because of possible punishment but also as a matter of conscience.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu kai jong napehjiu ahi; ajeh chu amaho Pathen sottol hiuva hiti chu abol jing jengu ahi.
target: This is also why you pay taxes, for the authorities are God’s servants, who give their full time to governing.

source: Peh dingdol jouse chu peuvin; kai pehdol kai peuvin; se choina dolah se choijun; gin dingdol chu ginun; ja dingdol chu jauvin.
target: Give to everyone what you owe them: If you owe taxes, pay taxes; if revenue, then revenue; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

source: Khatle khat kingailutto cheh tailouvin koima imacha bat hih-un; ajeh chu michom dang ngailu-a chun Pathen danthupeh chu asuhbulhit ahitai.
target: Let no debt remain outstanding, except the continuing debt to love one another, for whoever loves others has fulfilled the law.

source: Ajeh iham itile, Jon bol hih-in, Tol that hih-in, Gucha hih-in, hetphotna dihlou mang hih-in, Papse hih-in, ti thupeh dang um jongle, Nangman nangma naki ngailut bangin naheng nakoma ngailun, tia hin akai khom sohkeijin ahi.
target: The commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other command there may be, are summed up in this one command: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”

source: Ngailutna-in hengle kom setna abolpoi; hijeh chun ngailut hi danthu bukipna ahi.
target: Love does no harm to a neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.

source: Chule chuche ti louvin phat umchan hi naheuve; tu hi nangho dingin imutna kona khah phat ahitai; ajeh chu eihon itahsan tiluva sang chun tu hin isochatnao anaitan ahi.
target: And do this, understanding the present time: The hour has already come for you to wake up from your slumber, because our salvation is nearer now than when we first believed.

source: Jan asotjo achetai, sun ahung naitai; hiche jeh chun khaije, muthim natoh pailhau hitin khovah vonin kivonuhite.
target: The night is nearly over; the day is almost here. So let us put aside the deeds of darkness and put on the armor of light.

source: Suna bangin hoitah-in umu hite; juneh motchonle jukhama um louvin, huhle jonthanhoi nei louvin, kinahnale kithangset beihelin umu hite.
target: Let us behave decently, as in the daytime, not in carousing and drunkenness, not in sexual immorality and debauchery, not in dissension and jealousy.

source: Pakai Jesu Christa chu kivonjoh bouvun, naphe phatna dingu tahsa lam ngaichat suhbulhit ding imacha go hih-un.
target: Rather, clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus Christ, and do not think about how to gratify the desires of the flesh.

source: Tahsana hat louva chu nalah uva lauvin, amavang atahsan bukim louna chu oimo-a nol ding ahipoi.
target: Accept the one whose faith is weak, without quarreling over disputable matters.

source: Mikhatnin imajouse neh theijin atahsanin, ahatmoa chun anche jengbou anei.
target: One person’s faith allows them to eat anything, but another, whose faith is weak, eats only vegetables.

source: Anea chun anelou chu musit dahen; chule anelouvan anea chu oimo hihhen; ijeh ham itile ama chu Pathen'in alahsa ahi.
target: The one who eats everything must not treat with contempt the one who does not, and the one who does not eat everything must not judge the one who does, for God has accepted them.

source: Mi insung soh oimo-a nang koi nahim? Adinle alhuh a-pakaipa-a bou ahi. Ahi, Pathen chun adinsah thei ahijeh-a chu ama chu adinsah ding ahi.
target: Who are you to judge someone else’s servant? To their own master, servants stand or fall. And they will stand, for the Lord is able to make them stand.

source: Mi abang khatnin nikho khat nikho dang dang sangin ajabol tumin, abang kimkhatnin nikho jouse kibangin ajabolin ahi. Mi jousen ama lung sunga kihetchen chehhen.
target: One person considers one day more sacred than another; another considers every day alike. Each of them should be fully convinced in their own mind.

source: Nikho jabola chun Pakai choi-atna-a ajabol ahin; nikho jabollou chun Pakai dinga ajabollou ahi. Chule ima ne-a jong chun Pathen alhai jeh chun Pakai choi-atna-a aneh ahi; anelou jong chun Pathen athangvah-a Pakai dinga anehda ahi.
target: Whoever regards one day as special does so to the Lord. Whoever eats meat does so to the Lord, for they give thanks to God; and whoever abstains does so to the Lord and gives thanks to God.

source: Ijeh ham itile eiho koima ama dinga hinga ihipouve, chule koima ama dinga thia ihipouve.
target: For none of us lives for ourselves alone, and none of us dies for ourselves alone.

source: Ihinle Pakai dinga hing ihiuvin, ithiu jongle Pakai dinga thia ihibovui; hijeh chun hing jong leuhen Pakai dinga hing ihiuvin, thi jong leuhen Pakai dinga thia ihiuve.
target: If we live, we live for the Lord; and if we die, we die for the Lord. So, whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.

source: Ajeh chu athi le ahing Pakai ahikop theina dinga, Khrista thia, chua thoudoh kitna, chule hing kitna ahi.
target: For this very reason, Christ died and returned to life so that he might be the Lord of both the dead and the living.

source: Ahin ibola nangin nasopi na-oimo ham? Chujongle nangin nasopi ibola musit nahim? Ajeh chu Khrista laltouna anga ibon chaova idin dingu ahinalaije.
target: You, then, why do you judge your brother or sister? Or why do you treat them with contempt? For we will all stand before God’s judgment seat.

source: Ajehchu, Pakaiyin aseije, Keima hingjing kahito lhonna, khup jouse ka anga dilsu cheh ding, chule lei jousen Pathen henga aphondoh ding ahi; tin akisune.
target: It is written: “ ‘As surely as I live,’ says the Lord, ‘every knee will bow before me; every tongue will acknowledge God.’ ”

source: Chuti ahi jeh-a chu ibon chaova Pathen henga eima chonchan cheh ikisei dingu ahi.
target: So then, each of us will give an account of ourselves to God.

source: Hijeh chun tukal ki-oimoto tapou hite; hiche sang chun hiche hi ngaito jovin, sopi anga lung lhahna le kipal lhuhna koi lou ding ahi.
target: Therefore let us stop passing judgment on one another. Instead, make up your mind not to put any stumbling block or obstacle in the way of a brother or sister.

source: Thil angai monga thenglou aumpoi, ti hi Pakai Jesu'ah kahechenin katahsan lheh jengin ahi; amavang mi khattouvin thilboh ahi tia angaito chu, ama dinga hichu athenglou ahiji.
target: I am convinced, being fully persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean in itself. But if anyone regards something as unclean, then for that person it is unclean.

source: Na nehle chah chunga nasopi alung phatmole, ngailutna thua chonta lou nahi. Adinga Khrista thia ahitan, ama chu nangman naneh nachah-in sumang hih-in.
target: If your brother or sister is distressed because of what you eat, you are no longer acting in love. Do not by your eating destroy someone for whom Christ died.

source: Hijeh chun naphatnao chu seisetnin um hihhen;
target: Therefore do not let what you know is good be spoken of as evil.

source: Ajeh chu Pathen lenggam chu anneh twidon thua ahipoi; chonphatna, lungmonna, Lhagao Thenga kipana joh bou chu Pathen gam thupi ahi.
target: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking, but of righteousness, peace and joy in the Holy Spirit,

source: Ajeh iham itile koi hileh chuti thua Khrista lhacha-a pang chu Pathen lung lamtah ahin, mihemin jong, Aphai, tia aphot chen ahi.
target: because anyone who serves Christ in this way is pleasing to God and receives human approval.

source: Hijeh chun kichamdela umna dingle khantou theina kibolpehto lam juiju hite.
target: Let us therefore make every effort to do what leads to peace and to mutual edification.

source: Nehle chah jeh-in Pathen natoh suse hihhelun. Thil jouse athengnai, ahinla ikhat neh-a lung lhahna chu anepa dinga setna ahi.
target: Do not destroy the work of God for the sake of food. All food is clean, but it is wrong for a person to eat anything that causes someone else to stumble.

source: Sa neh hijongle, lengpitwi don hijongle, adang ipi hijongle, nasopi kipal lhuhna ahiloule lhasetna, ahiloule thalhomna chu bolda hela pha ahi.
target: It is better not to eat meat or drink wine or to do anything else that will cause your brother or sister to fall.

source: Tahsana nanei jem? Nanei chu Pathen angah nangman hetnin nei jingin; aphalam ahi ti ngaito-a themo-a kingaito loupa chu mi nunnom ahi.
target: So whatever you believe about these things keep between yourself and God. Blessed is the one who does not condemn himself by what he approves.

source: Amavang lungsa-ih puma nepa chu themmo changa ahitai; ajeh iham itile tahsanna neija aneh ahipoi; chule ipi hijongle tahsanna nei louva bol chu chonset ahi.
target: But whoever has doubts is condemned if they eat, because their eating is not from faith; and everything that does not come from faith is sin.

source: Chuti ahin eiho ahat cheng hin eima lunglhaina hol louva, ahatmote hatmona chu ipohhu joh dingu ahi.
target: We who are strong ought to bear with the failings of the weak and not to please ourselves.

source: Eiho khat cheh-in iheng ikoma houthu lama khantousahna dinga aphatna dingu ngaito-a, lunglhaisah ding ahi.
target: Each of us should please our neighbors for their good, to build them up.

source: Ajeh chu Christa jeng jong ama kilunglhai lou ahi; ahin, Nahouse hon nahouset nao chu keima chungah achutai, tia kisun bangjoh chu ahibouve.
target: For even Christ did not please himself but, as it is written: “The insults of those who insult you have fallen on me.”

source: Ajeh chu nidang laija thu kisun chengse chu, lekha kisun Pathen thua kona thohhat le lungmonna imuva kinepna inei theina dinguva, eiho kihilna dinga kisun ahi.
target: For everything that was written in the past was written to teach us, so that through the endurance taught in the Scriptures and the encouragement they provide we might have hope.

source: Thohhat le lungmon kona Pathen'in, Christa lunglam doltah-in khatle khat lungkhat naputsah cheh-uhen;
target: May the God who gives endurance and encouragement give you the same attitude of mind toward each other that Christ Jesus had,

source: Chutia chu nanghon lungkhat le kam khatna I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Pa Pathen nachoi-at theina dingun.
target: so that with one mind and one voice you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

source: Hichena ding chun Pathen loupi choi-atna dinga Christan nangho nalah bangu chun, khatle khat kilatouvin.
target: Accept one another, then, just as Christ accepted you, in order to bring praise to God.

source: Ijeh-inem itile keiman hiche kisei hi, Iputeu ipateu athutep chu phutdet dingle Pathen lungset jala chidang namdang ten Pathen achoi-at theina dinguva, Pathen thu adih chu hetsah dinga, Jesu Christa chu cheptanho lhacha-a hung panga ahitai.
target: For I tell you that Christ has become a servant of the Jews on behalf of God’s truth, so that the promises made to the patriarchs might be confirmed

source: Hiti jong hin akisune, Hiche jeh chun keiman chidang namgdangte lah-a Nangma kipah-in phonging ting, Chule nangma minin la jong sange.
target: and, moreover, that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written: “Therefore I will praise you among the Gentiles; I will sing the praises of your name.”

source: Hitin ati kitleuve, Vo chidang namdangte, amitetoh kipah thanom khomun.
target: Again, it says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”

source: Chukitle, Vo chidang namdangte, nabonchaovin Pakai chu vahchoijun, Chule mi jousen ama vahchoi uhen, ati.
target: And again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles; let all the peoples extol him.”

source: Chule Isaiah'in jong, Jesse jung chu umding ahin, Chule chidang namdangte chunga vaipo dinga hung sohdoh ding ahi; Ama chu chidang namdang ten kinepna-a anei dingu ahi, ati.
target: And again, Isaiah says, “The Root of Jesse will spring up, one who will arise to rule over the nations; in him the Gentiles will hope.”

source: Lhagao Theng thahat vanga kinepna nanei letset theina dingun, kinepna Pathen'in natahsan naochu kipa thanop le chamna lungmon na-in dip letset tahen.
target: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

source: Kasopite ho, nangho chungchang thua chun, nangmahotah phatna dimset le hetna bukip sohkei nahiuvin, khatle khat kitilkhouto thei nahiuve, ti keimatah-in kahetchen ahi.
target: I myself am convinced, my brothers and sisters, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with knowledge and competent to instruct one another.

source: Ahivangin Sopite, chidang namdangte lah-a Christa Jesu lhacha-a kapan theina dinga Pathen'in eipeh lungsetna vanga hi nangho geldohsahna dinga, akah lahlah-a hakat cheh-a naheng uva kahinsut ahi.
target: Yet I have written you quite boldly on some points to remind you of them again, because of the grace God gave me

source: Chutia chu chidang namdangte dinga Jesu Christa lhacha kahia; chidang namdangte kilhaina chu lahthei ahia, Lhagao Theng suhtheng ahina dinguva, Pathen Thupha lhacha-a kapan ahi.
target: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles. He gave me the priestly duty of proclaiming the gospel of God, so that the Gentiles might become an offering acceptable to God, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

source: Hijeh chun tun Pathen dinga natohna lama hin Christa Jesu'ah kisonna kaneije.
target: Therefore I glory in Christ Jesus in my service to God.

source: Ajeh chu chidang namdangte Pathen thua nunsahna dinga Christan keima eimanchah-a, thu le natoh-a abol chengse tailou chu imadang kasei ngam poi;
target: I will not venture to speak of anything except what Christ has accomplished through me in leading the Gentiles to obey God by what I have said and done—

source: Hichu Pathen Lhagao thahat na-a melchihna thaneitah le thilbol kidanga kon ahi; hitichun Jerusalem le akimvela kipat Ilyricum geijin Christa Thupha kaphongjal tan ahi.
target: by the power of signs and wonders, through the power of the Spirit of God. So from Jerusalem all the way around to Illyricum, I have fully proclaimed the gospel of Christ.

source: Ahi, hijeh-a chu Christa min kiphah poh louna mun'a kipana thupha lhangsap dinghi kalungtup ahi, achuti loule midang bulphusa chunga insa kahi khah ding ahi:
target: It has always been my ambition to preach the gospel where Christ was not known, so that I would not be building on someone else’s foundation.

source: Ahin Ama thudol kiseipoh khah lounate chun amu dingu: chule ajakhalou ten ahet dingu ahi, tia kisun bang ahi nading joh ahi.
target: Rather, as it is written: “Those who were not told about him will see, and those who have not heard will understand.”

source: Hiche jehtah-a jong chu hijatvei naheng uva kahung dinga kon, hiche chun eisuhmo jingji ahi.
target: This is why I have often been hindered from coming to you.

source: Tu vangin hiche gamkai sungah kanatohna ding mun aumtapoi; kum sotna patna nangho henga hung ding kagot jingma ahin,
target: But now that there is no more place for me to work in these regions, and since I have been longing for many years to visit you,

source: Spain gam lama kache phat phatle naheng uva kahung ding ahi. Ajehchu nangho mupa ding kakinemin, chule amasan nang hotoh chomkhat kivop khom ingting, chule kache teng jongle nanghon neihung thahleu chun kati.
target: I plan to do so when I go to Spain. I hope to see you while passing through and to have you assist me on my journey there, after I have enjoyed your company for a while.

source: Tu vang hin mithengte gahu dinga Jerusalem'a chetadi ding kahi.
target: Now, however, I am on my way to Jerusalem in the service of the Lord’s people there.

source: Ajeh chu Macedonia le Achaia gama mihon Jerusalem'a um mithengte lah-a migenthei vaichaho huna-a sumto ding aphasah uvin ahi.
target: For Macedonia and Achaia were pleased to make a contribution for the poor among the Lord’s people in Jerusalem.

source: Ahi, pha asah tahbeh-u ahin, chule abatnu jong hija ahi; ajeh chu lhagao lama chidang namdangte akikop piuva ahile, leiset thil lama jong amahon abatnu ahin, ahu dingdol mongu ahi.
target: They were pleased to do it, and indeed they owe it to them. For if the Gentiles have shared in the Jews’ spiritual blessings, they owe it to the Jews to share with them their material blessings.

source: Chuche jeh chun chuche kin chu kachai tengle asumdonu chu phatecha kapehdoh joule, nangho kom hinjot pangting Spain gam lama kachepai peh ding ahi.
target: So after I have completed this task and have made sure that they have received this contribution, I will go to Spain and visit you on the way.

source: Chule naheng uva kahung tengle chun, Christa Kipana thupha-a kon phattheina chamkim keija hinpo-a hung ding kahi, ti kahei.
target: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the full measure of the blessing of Christ.

source: Sopite, Juda gama cheng sei ngailouho khutna kona kahoi theija, Jerusalem'a kin neija kachena hi,
target: I urge you, brothers and sisters, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, to join me in my struggle by praying to God for me.

source: Mithengten analah theina dingun, chule Pathen phatsah-a kipahtah-a nangho heng lama kahunga nang hotoh kakicholdo theina dingin,
target: Pray that I may be kept safe from the unbelievers in Judea and that the contribution I take to Jerusalem may be favorably received by the Lord’s people there,

source: Pathen henga taona-a hahun neihuvin tia Pakai Jesu Christa le Lhagao Thengin eipeh-u ngailutna vanga, nangho kahin ngeh nahiuve.
target: so that I may come to you with joy, by God’s will, and in your company be refreshed.

source: Chamnale lungmon kona Pathen'in nabonchaovin umpiuvin. Amen.
target: The God of peace be with you all. Amen.

source: Isopinu-u Phoebe, Cenchria houbung lhachanu hi Pakai minin mithengte chonna-in lomtah-a analauvin;
target: I commend to you our sister Phoebe, a deacon of the church in Cenchreae.

source: Chule nahunao angaichatna chan-ah anahuvin tia nangho amanu hitoh kakihettosah nahiuve; ajeh iham itile amanu hin mi tamtah ahun chule keimatah jeng jong eihun ahi.
target: I ask you to receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of his people and to give her any help she may need from you, for she has been the benefactor of many people, including me.

source: Jesu Christa-a katoh khompi kahinkho huhna-a alol do-a Priscilla le Aquila kasalam anapeuvin;
target: Greet Priscilla and Aquila, my co-workers in Christ Jesus.

source: Kei chang hilouvin chidang namdangte lah-a houbung mi jousen jong apahchauvin ahi.
target: They risked their lives for me. Not only I but all the churches of the Gentiles are grateful to them.

source: Chule a-in'a kikhom houbung mite jong chu salam anapeuvin. Kasahtah Epaenetus Asia gama Christa tahsan masapen chu salam anapeuvin.
target: Greet also the church that meets at their house. Greet my dear friend Epenetus, who was the first convert to Christ in the province of Asia.

source: Nangho dinga na hatoh-a tonggim Mariam jong kasalam anapeuvin.
target: Greet Mary, who worked very hard for you.

source: Ka-inkote kasoh chanpi Andronicus le Junia solchah ho lah-a minchepen keima sanga Christa-a lut masa amani jong chu kasalam anapeuvin.
target: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my fellow Jews who have been in prison with me. They are outstanding among the apostles, and they were in Christ before I was.

source: Pakaiya kasahtah Amplias chu kasalam anapeuvin.
target: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend in the Lord.

source: Christa-a itoh gimpiu Urbane le kasahtah Stachys salam anapeuvin.
target: Greet Urbanus, our co-worker in Christ, and my dear friend Stachys.

source: Christa-a mi kitah kichen Apelles salam peuvin. Aristobulus te insung miho jong salam peuvin.
target: Greet Apelles, whose fidelity to Christ has stood the test. Greet those who belong to the household of Aristobulus.

source: Ka-inko Herodion kasalam anapeuvin. Narcissus te inko Pakaiya um cheng chu kasalam anapeuvin.
target: Greet Herodion, my fellow Jew. Greet those in the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord.

source: Pakaiya na hatohgim Typhene le Tryphosa salam anapeuvin. Dei umtah Persis Pakaiya na ahatoh lheh jengin, ama chu kasalam anapeuvin.
target: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, those women who work hard in the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis, another woman who has worked very hard in the Lord.

source: Pakaiya lhen Rufus le kanu tobang anu chu salam anapeuvin.
target: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother, who has been a mother to me, too.

source: Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patroba, Hermes, hicheng chule aumpiu sopite chengse salam anapeuvin.
target: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas and the other brothers and sisters with them.

source: Philologus le Julia, Nereus le asopinu, Olympus, chule amahotoh kikhom mithengte chengse salam anapeuvin.
target: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas and all the Lord’s people who are with them.

source: Khatle khat salam kiboh tovinlang thengtah-in kichopmun, Christa houbung mite jousen salam napeuve.
target: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ send greetings.

source: Vo sopite, kangehnao ahi, thu nakihil chengu chu akaleh-a, kikhen chehna dingle kipal lhuhna semteho chu anamelgel unlang, amaho-a konin anachom umun.
target: I urge you, brothers and sisters, to watch out for those who cause divisions and put obstacles in your way that are contrary to the teaching you have learned. Keep away from them.

source: Ijeh-inem itile chutobang miho chun I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa lhacha na tong louvin, a-oisung dingu lhacha na tong jengbou ahiuve; chule kamthemle thungei ngeijin suhset neilouho lung dohan alhemlha jiuvin ahi.
target: For such people are not serving our Lord Christ, but their own appetites. By smooth talk and flattery they deceive the minds of naive people.

source: Nasei ngaijeu chu vannoi'ah akithang dohtan ahi. Hiche jeh chun nachung uvah kakipah lheh jenge; amavang nangho apha lama chingunlang ase lamah lunglhom leu chun kalung ahi.
target: Everyone has heard about your obedience, so I rejoice because of you; but I want you to be wise about what is good, and innocent about what is evil.

source: Chule chamna lungmonna Pathen'in Satan chu nakengto noijuva achil ngemvah ding ahinai. Pakai Jesu Christa lungset chu nalah uva umjing hen, Amen.
target: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.

source: Katoh khompi Timothy chule ka-inko Lucius, Jason chule Sosipater hiteho chun salam nahinpeuve.
target: Timothy, my co-worker, sends his greetings to you, as do Lucius, Jason and Sosipater, my fellow Jews.

source: Chule hiche lekhasun Tertius, keiman Pakaiyah nangho salam nahinpeuve.
target: I, Tertius, who wrote down this letter, greet you in the Lord.

source: Keimale houbung mite jouse lhunna Gaius chun salam napeuve. Hiche khopi-a sumdol Erastus le sopi Quartus'in salam napeuve.
target: Gaius, whose hospitality I and the whole church here enjoy, sends you his greetings. Erastus, who is the city’s director of public works, and our brother Quartus send you their greetings.

source: Kathupha hille Jesu Christa thuphon bangtah-a, tonsotna patna ki-im thuguh chu tu-a akiphondoh bangtah-a,
target: Now to him who is able to establish you in accordance with my gospel, the message I proclaim about Jesus Christ, in keeping with the revelation of the mystery hidden for long ages past,

source: Tahsan thua ahung nunna dinguva tonsotna Pathen thupeh dungjuitah-a, themgaoho lekhabun aphondoh-a, chitin le namtin jouse ahetsah ahitan;
target: but now revealed and made known through the prophetic writings by the command of the eternal God, so that all the Gentiles might come to the obedience that comes from faith—

source: Nangho sudet thei Pathen chinga khatseh chu Jesu Christa vangin tonsot geijin loupi jinghen, Amen.
target: to the only wise God be glory forever through Jesus Christ! Amen.

source: Pathen phasah-a Christa solchah dinga kikou Paul leh sopi Sosthenes,
target: Paul, called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

source: Corinth-a um Pathen houbung, Christa Jesu'a kisuthenga, mitheng dinga kikoute henga, gamtina I-Pakaiyu (amahole eiho Pakai) Jesu Christa min pan chengsetoh;
target: To the church of God in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be his holy people, together with all those everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ—their Lord and ours:

source: I-Pau Pathen le Jesu Christa-a konin lungsetna leh lungmon naheng uvah umhen.
target: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

source: Christa Jesu'a Pathen lungset nangho henga kipeh jeh chun nangho chungchang thuah Pathen kathangvah jinge.
target: I always thank my God for you because of his grace given you in Christ Jesus.

source: Ijakai-ah, thuseina tincheng leh, hetna tichenga aman nahaosah-u ahitai.
target: For in him you have been enriched in every way—with all kinds of speech and with all knowledge—

source: Nangho lah-a Christa thu kahettohsah chu kiphut det ahitai.
target: God thus confirming our testimony about Christ among you.

source: Chutia chu nangho thilpeh lhasam louhela, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hung kit ngah-a umjing nahiuve.
target: Therefore you do not lack any spiritual gift as you eagerly wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to be revealed.

source: Chule aman nangho akhon ni geija nakoidet jing dingu, chutengle nangho I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa nikho ni chuleh themona beihela naum dingu ahi.
target: He will also keep you firm to the end, so that you will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

source: Pathen tahsan umtah ahi, aman Achapa I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa kithopi dinga nakoulut-u ahitai.
target: God is faithful, who has called you into fellowship with his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

source: Tun sopite, nangho thukhat kisaovin, nalah uva kikhen telna umlouvin, lungkhat le lung ngaito khat na lolhing tah-in kipunkhom mun, tia I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa mina katem nahiuve,
target: I appeal to you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree with one another in what you say and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfectly united in mind and thought.

source: Ijeh-inem itile, kasopite ho, nachung chang thu-u nalah uva kinel noh baotam aume, ti Chloe te inko seinan kajai.
target: My brothers and sisters, some from Chloe’s household have informed me that there are quarrels among you.

source: Tu-a kasei chu hiche ahi, nangho amilipmin, Keima Paul'a kahi, keima Apollo'a kahi, keima Cephas'a kahi, keima Christa'a kahi, nati sohkeijun ahi.
target: What I mean is this: One of you says, “I follow Paul”; another, “I follow Apollos”; another, “I follow Cephas”; still another, “I follow Christ.”

source: Christa chu nahop khen khenu hitam? Paul chu nangho dinga thingpel'a kikhenbeh mongam? Ole Paul mina baptize nachan mongum?
target: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Were you baptized in the name of Paul?

source: Crispus leh Gaius tailou, adang koimacha baptize kachansah lou jeh chun Pathen kathangvah-e;
target: I thank God that I did not baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius,

source: Achuti loule keiman keima mina baptize kachan ahi, tia sei umkha ding ahi.
target: so no one can say that you were baptized in my name.

source: Chule keiman Stephanas insung mite chu baptize kachansah ahin, chuche tailou chu adang koima baptize kachansah kahepoi.
target: (Yes, I also baptized the household of Stephanas; beyond that, I don’t remember if I baptized anyone else.)

source: Baptize chansah dinga hilouva, Kipana Thupha hille dinga bou Christan eisol ahi; chihna thua seiding hilouvin, achuti loule Christa thingpel chu imacha hilou sohkha ding ahi.
target: For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel—not with wisdom and eloquence, lest the cross of Christ be emptied of its power.

source: Thingpel thu chu amangthai dingho dingin ngolna ahi; asohcha eiho ding vangin Pathen thahat ahi.
target: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

source: Hiti jong hin akisune, Keiman michingho chih chu kasuhmanga, Lungthim themho lungthim moh kahisah ding ahi.
target: For it is written: “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise; the intelligence of the intelligent I will frustrate.”

source: Miching hoiham? Lekha sun mihil hoiham? Tukhanga minel kala hoibaham? Vannoi leiset chihna chu Pathen'in asuh ngol hilouham?
target: Where is the wise person? Where is the teacher of the law? Where is the philosopher of this age? Has not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?

source: Ajehchu Pathen chihna-in, leiset mihem ten amaho chihna-a Pathen ahetlou phatnuva, ngolhoi thu hila atahsanho huhhing chu Pathen'in pha asah ahi.
target: For since in the wisdom of God the world through its wisdom did not know him, God was pleased through the foolishness of what was preached to save those who believe.

source: Juda ten melchihna angeh jiuvin, chule Greek miten chihna aholjiuve;
target: Jews demand signs and Greeks look for wisdom,

source: Keihon vang thingpel chunga Christa kikhetbeh thu kahilleu ahin, hichu Juda te dingin kipal lhuhna ahin, chule Greek te dingin ngolna ahi;
target: but we preach Christ crucified: a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles,

source: Amavang Juda hihen Greek hileh, akikouho ding vangin Christa chu Pathen hatna le Pathen chihna ahi.
target: but to those whom God has called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Pathen ngolna chu mihem sanga gamchenga chingjo ahin, chule Pathen hatmona chu mihem sanga gamchenga hatjo ahi.
target: For the foolishness of God is wiser than human wisdom, and the weakness of God is stronger than human strength.

source: Ijeh-inem itile, sopite, nanghon nakikou dolu hi ngaito temun, leiset tahsa phe lama miching tamtah, thanei tamtah, chule milun tamtah akikou pon ahi.
target: Brothers and sisters, think of what you were when you were called. Not many of you were wise by human standards; not many were influential; not many were of noble birth.

source: Ahivangin Pathen'in michingho jachat sahna dinga, vannoi'a angolteho alhena; ahat apaoho jachat sahna dinga, vannoi'a hatmoteho alhen ahi.
target: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.

source: Vannoi leisetna thil kidah um le thil noinung cheng chu Pathen'in alhena, chule aumlou jong chu aumsaho imacha hilou sona dinga alhen ahi;
target: God chose the lowly things of this world and the despised things—and the things that are not—to nullify the things that are,

source: Hichu ama angsunga leiset mihem akisonga koima aum louhelna ding ahi.
target: so that no one may boast before him.

source: Nangho vang chu ama vanga Christa Jesu'a um nahiuve, amachu Pathen'a kona eiho dinga chihna, chonphatna, kithensona, kilhatdohna-a kisem ahi.
target: It is because of him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God—that is, our righteousness, holiness and redemption.

source: A kisun dung juijin, Koi hile akisonga chu Pakaiya kisonghen, ati.
target: Therefore, as it is written: “Let the one who boasts boast in the Lord.”

source: Chule, sopite, keima vang naheng uva Pathen thu hettohsah seiphonga kahung chun, thusei themna le chihna toh thon kahungpoi.
target: And so it was with me, brothers and sisters. When I came to you, I did not come with eloquence or human wisdom as I proclaimed to you the testimony about God.

source: Jesu Christa thu le thingpel chunga akikhetbeh thu tailou, nalah uva thudang hehih helinge tia kangaito ahi.
target: For I resolved to know nothing while I was with you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.

source: Chule keima nalah uva hatmotah, kichatah, chule kihot hot jinga kana um ahi.
target: I came to you in weakness with great fear and trembling.

source: Kathusei le kathu lhangsap chu mihem chihna-a jollhah themna ahipon, amavang Lhagao le athahatna-a phot tohna ahijon ahi:
target: My message and my preaching were not with wise and persuasive words, but with a demonstration of the Spirit’s power,

source: Chutia chu natahsan naochu mihem chihna-a dinga hilouva, Pathen thahatna joh-a ding ahina ding ahi.
target: so that your faith might not rest on human wisdom, but on God’s power.

source: Amavang apilhing saho jah-a vang chihna thun jong kaseiji naove, ahivangin hiche vannoi leiset chihna thu ahipoi, hiche vannoi leiset vaipo mangthah dingho chih thu jong ahipoi.
target: We do, however, speak a message of wisdom among the mature, but not the wisdom of this age or of the rulers of this age, who are coming to nothing.

source: Ahin Pathen chihna thuguh, iloupina dinguva Pathen'in vannoi leiset um masanga agot masah chihna thu ki-im chu, kaseijoh-u ahi.
target: No, we declare God’s wisdom, a mystery that has been hidden and that God destined for our glory before time began.

source: Hichu hiche vannoi leiset vaipoho him himin ahetoh pouve, heleu loupina Pakai chu thingpel'a akhetbeh louhel dingu ahi. Hijongle,
target: None of the rulers of this age understood it, for if they had, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.

source: Ahin mit mukhah lou, na jahkhah lou, Mihem lunga lutkha lou, Pathen'in angailuho dinga agotsa chengse chu, tin akisune.
target: However, as it is written: “What no eye has seen, what no ear has heard, and what no human mind has conceived”— the things God has prepared for those who love him—

source: Ahivangin Pathen'in eiho hengah Lhagaovin aphongdoh tai, Ajehchu Lhagaovin imajouse akholdoh jia, Pathen thuguh jong akholdohji ahi.
target: these are the things God has revealed to us by his Spirit. The Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God.

source: Mi lung sunga thu um mihem'a um lhagao tailou adang mihem koiham ahea? Chuche bang chun Pathen thu jong Pathen Lhagao tailou koima dangin ahepoi.
target: For who knows a person’s thoughts except their own spirit within them? In the same way no one knows the thoughts of God except the Spirit of God.

source: Tun Pathen'in manbeija eipeh chengseu hi hetna dinga, eiho vannoi leiset lhagao changa hilouva Pathen'a hungkon Lhagao changa ihiuve.
target: What we have received is not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, so that we may understand what God has freely given us.

source: Hitiho chu mihem chihna-in ahil thua sei louva, Lhagao Thengin ahil thu chu, lhagao le lhagao tekah-a kahilu ahi.
target: This is what we speak, not in words taught us by human wisdom but in words taught by the Spirit, explaining spiritual realities with Spirit-taught words.

source: Tahsa lam mihem ten Pathen Lhagao thuhi alajipouve; ajehchu amaho dinga ngol thu ahi, chule hichu lhagaova hetkhenbou ahi jeh chun athudol chu ahekhen thei himhim pouve.
target: The person without the Spirit does not accept the things that come from the Spirit of God but considers them foolishness, and cannot understand them because they are discerned only through the Spirit.

source: Lhagao mi vang chun thil ijakai ahekhenjin, ama chula koiman ahekhen jipoi.
target: The person with the Spirit makes judgments about all things, but such a person is not subject to merely human judgments,

source: Ajehchu Pakai lungthim he-a, ama hil thei dinga koiham? Eiho vang chu Christa lung pu-a ihiuve.
target: for, “Who has known the mind of the Lord so as to instruct him?” But we have the mind of Christ.

source: Sopite, keiman lhagao lam mite henga sei bangin nangho henga kasei theipon, tahsa lam mite henga sei banga, Christa lama naosen ho jah-a seibanga kasei ahi.
target: Brothers and sisters, I could not address you as people who live by the Spirit but as people who are still worldly—mere infants in Christ.

source: Keiman nangho an guma vah louva noitwija kavah-bou nahiuve, ajehchu tuchan hin nane thei hih-un, tu jengin jong nane thei hih laijuve;
target: I gave you milk, not solid food, for you were not yet ready for it. Indeed, you are still not ready.

source: Nangho tu geijin tahsa mi nahi nalaijui. Ijeh-inem itile nalah uva kithangset to, kinah kiphun kikhentel aum nalaije; ahile, natahsa chonu hilouham? chule mi chon chona chon nahi lou uham?
target: You are still worldly. For since there is jealousy and quarreling among you, are you not worldly? Are you not acting like mere humans?

source: Ijeh inem itile khatnin, Keima Paul'a kahi, nati uva; adang khatnin, Keima Apollo'a kahi, nati laiseuva chu; tahsa-a nahi lou uham?
target: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” are you not mere human beings?

source: Apollos chu koiham? Chule Paul chu koiham? Pakaiyin mijouse apeh dungjuija, alhacha-a pang, amani-a kona nanghon natahsanu ahibouve.
target: What, after all, is Apollos? And what is Paul? Only servants, through whom you came to believe—as the Lord has assigned to each his task.

source: Keiman kaphu ahin, Apollon twi achap ahi, Pathen bouvin akhansah ahi.
target: I planted the seed, Apollos watered it, but God has been making it grow.

source: Chuti ahin aphutpa jong ima ahipon, atwi chappa jong ima ahidehpoi; akhansah-a Pathen chubou ahipen ahi.
target: So neither the one who plants nor the one who waters is anything, but only God, who makes things grow.

source: Tun aphutpa le atwi chappa chu thakhat ahi lhone, ahivangin atohgim lhon dungjui juija tohman asan gel lhon ding ahi.
target: The one who plants and the one who waters have one purpose, and they will each be rewarded according to their own labor.

source: Ajehchu keini Pathen tohkhompi kahi lhonin, nangho Pathen lou nahiuve, Pathen in-sah nahiuve.
target: For we are co-workers in God’s service; you are God’s field, God’s building.

source: Pathen lungset vanga eikipeh dungjuija insa themtah banga abul kaphu ahitai, achunga chu midangin asah ahi. Amavang chuche chunga sa ding chengsen asah danje ding chu chingthei chehhen.
target: By the grace God has given me, I laid a foundation as a wise builder, and someone else is building on it. But each one should build with care.

source: Ijeh inem itile abul phudohsa tailou chu abul dang koiman aphutdoh theitapoi, chuche abul kiphut chu Jesu Christa ahi.
target: For no one can lay any foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ.

source: Chuche bul kiphut chunga chun koi hijongle sana-a sanoman sahen, dangka-a sanoman sahen, song mantama sanoman sahen, thinga sanoman sahen, bi-a sanoman sahen, pola sanoman sahen;
target: If anyone builds on this foundation using gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay or straw,

source: Atoh cheh-u chu hung kiphongdoh cheh ding ahi; ijeh-inem itile nikho chun aphondoh ding, hiche ni chule meija kiphongdoh ding ahijeh chun, meijin mijouse anatoh aset aphat apatep ding ahi.
target: their work will be shown for what it is, because the Day will bring it to light. It will be revealed with fire, and the fire will test the quality of each person’s work.

source: Achunga insaho chu koi koi hile a-insah chu adin jinga ahile, ama chun toh phatman asan ding ahi.
target: If what has been built survives, the builder will receive a reward.

source: Chule koi hile a-insah akahvama ahile, ama chu hakam ding; amatah vang huhhing-a umding ahi, ahivangin meikong lah pal galkaija bang ding ahi.
target: If it is burned up, the builder will suffer loss but yet will be saved—even though only as one escaping through the flames.

source: Pathen in theng nahiuva chule nasunguva Pathen Lhagao achen chu nahet lou uham?
target: Don’t you know that you yourselves are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit dwells in your midst?

source: Pathen in theng suhboh-a chu Pathen'in ama chu asuhmang ding ahi. Ijeh-inem itile Pathen in chu thengtah ahi, nangho jong chutichu nahiuve.
target: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy that person; for God’s temple is sacred, and you together are that temple.

source: Koimacha amale ama kilhemlha hihhen. Nalah uva khattou, tulai khang thua hi kachinge, ti aumle, ama chu achihna ding chun ngol hen.
target: Do not deceive yourselves. If any of you think you are wise by the standards of this age, you should become “fools” so that you may become wise.

source: Ajeh chu hiche vannoi leiset chihna hi Pathen dinga ngolna ahi. Ajehchu, aman michingho chu ajonchih naovah amanjie, tin akisune.
target: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness in God’s sight. As it is written: “He catches the wise in their craftiness”;

source: Chujongle, Pakaiyin michingho lunggel le thil ngaito chu moh ahi ahenai, ati kitleuve.
target: and again, “The Lord knows that the thoughts of the wise are futile.”

source: Hijeh chun koima mihem'a kisong hihhen. Ijeh-inem itile thiljouse nangho-a ahi;
target: So then, no more boasting about human leaders! All things are yours,

source: Paul hihen, Apollos hihen, Cephas hihen, vannoi leiset hijongle, hinna hihen, thina hihen, tupetle khonung hijongle, aboncha nangho-a ahi;
target: whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas or the world or life or death or the present or the future—all are yours,

source: Nangho jong Christa-a nahiuve, Christa chu Pathen'a ahi.
target: and you are of Christ, and Christ is of God.

source: Keiho hi Christa lhacha le Pathen thuguh chingin min eingaitou hen.
target: This, then, is how you ought to regard us: as servants of Christ and as those entrusted with the mysteries God has revealed.

source: Gou ching jenga jonghi, tahsan umtah mi ngaija ahi.
target: Now it is required that those who have been given a trust must prove faithful.

source: Ahivangin, nanghon kaumchan nakhol diu, ahiloule mihem thutan na-in akhol ding chu keima dinga thilneocha bou ahi. Henge keiman jong kaumchan kaki kholpoi.
target: I care very little if I am judged by you or by any human court; indeed, I do not even judge myself.

source: Ajeh chu keiman kachungah imacha kakihetpoi, ahinla hichea hin them eichanpoi; ajeh chu kaumchan khola Pakai joh ahibouve.
target: My conscience is clear, but that does not make me innocent. It is the Lord who judges me.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun Pakai hung kahsen aphat masangin thu tanloi hih-un; aman muthima thilsel chu khovah-a ahinphondoh ding, chule mihem lung sungin ipi agelem hi jong chu aphondoh ding ahinai. Hiche teng chule amitakipmin pachatna achan ding dol cheh Pathen'a kona asan ding ahi.
target: Therefore judge nothing before the appointed time; wait until the Lord comes. He will bring to light what is hidden in darkness and will expose the motives of the heart. At that time each will receive their praise from God.

source: Sopite, akisun chengse kalvala koiman angaito louding; chutia chu nalah uva khatnin khat asona, achomkhat chunga hoithona aneilou ding ti thuhil hi keinia kona nahetdoh nadiuva, keima le Apollos hi tekah na-a kahinsei ahi.
target: Now, brothers and sisters, I have applied these things to myself and Apollos for your benefit, so that you may learn from us the meaning of the saying, “Do not go beyond what is written.” Then you will not be puffed up in being a follower of one of us over against the other.

source: Ajeh chu koiham midanga kon nachom khenuva? chule nakisan louvu thil ipi nanei juvem? Nasan uva ahile ibola asang lou banga hoithoa nahiu vem?
target: For who makes you different from anyone else? What do you have that you did not receive? And if you did receive it, why do you boast as though you did not?

source: Nangho tun nava taove, tun nahautaove, keiho beija lengho banga vai nahomu ahitai. Keiho jong nang hotoh thakhatna vai ihomkhom theina dinguvin, vai hom tahtah hileu chun kati.
target: Already you have all you want! Already you have become rich! You have begun to reign—and that without us! How I wish that you really had begun to reign so that we also might reign with you!

source: Pathen'in keiho solchah ho hi, athi dinga kigo-a banga anukhah pena eikoiju hinte tin kangaitoi; hijeh-a chu vannoi le, vantil teho, chule mihem vetchah-a um kahiuve.
target: For it seems to me that God has put us apostles on display at the end of the procession, like those condemned to die in the arena. We have been made a spectacle to the whole universe, to angels as well as to human beings.

source: Keiho vang Christa jala angola kahiuvin, nangho vang Christa-a achinga nahiuve; keiho kadoijun, nangho vang nahatnui; nangho mi jatah nahiuvin, keiho vang mi nahsahmo kahiuve.
target: We are fools for Christ, but you are so wise in Christ! We are weak, but you are strong! You are honored, we are dishonored!

source: Tugei jong hin kagilkel, kadang chah-un, ponsil nihchen bei kahiuvin, jepmin ka-umuvin, chennabih neilou kahiuvin;
target: To this very hour we go hungry and thirsty, we are in rags, we are brutally treated, we are homeless.

source: Kakhut uvin na kakitoh uvin; eihouseuva phatthei kabohjiuvin, eikibolset tengule kathoh hamhamun;
target: We work hard with our own hands. When we are cursed, we bless; when we are persecuted, we endure it;

source: Eikihehset tengule kalhem lungdamjiuvin ahi; keiho vannoi bohsele thil jouse nen bangin tu geijin kaum nalai uve.
target: when we are slandered, we answer kindly. We have become the scum of the earth, the garbage of the world—right up to this moment.

source: Nangho jachat sahna dinga hicheng thuhi kahinsut ahipoi, kacha deitahte banga hilchahnajoh-a kasut ahibouve.
target: I am writing this not to shame you but to warn you as my dear children.

source: Ajeh chu nanghon Christa-a chun nahiluva sangsom nei jeng jongleu chun, pa khat kal naneipouve; ajeh chu Kipana Thupha vanga Christa Jesu'a kahinsa kachate nahiuve.
target: Even if you had ten thousand guardians in Christ, you do not have many fathers, for in Christ Jesus I became your father through the gospel.

source: Hijeh chun kangeh nahiuve, keima dungsun hiuvin.
target: Therefore I urge you to imitate me.

source: Hiche dinga chu Pakaiya tahsantah kachapa deitah Timothy naheng uva kahinsol ahi; keiman muntina houbung tina kahil banga, Christa-a kaum thudol aman nangho nageldohsah dingu ahi.
target: For this reason I have sent to you Timothy, my son whom I love, who is faithful in the Lord. He will remind you of my way of life in Christ Jesus, which agrees with what I teach everywhere in every church.

source: Tun nangho lah-a kimkhat keima hi naheng uva hungponte, tin nahoitho taovin ahi.
target: Some of you have become arrogant, as if I were not coming to you.

source: Ahivangin Pakai lunglam ahile naheng uva hung vahnange; chutengle chuche ahoitho cheng thu hilouvin athaneinao henang kate.
target: But I will come to you very soon, if the Lord is willing, and then I will find out not only how these arrogant people are talking, but what power they have.

source: Pathen lenggam chu thua hilouvin, thanei na-a ahibouve.
target: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of talk but of power.

source: Hoiche ham nadeijoh-u? Naheng uva mol kachoija kahung dingha, ngailut neija lungnempu-a lhagaova kahung dingham?
target: What do you prefer? Shall I come to you with a rod of discipline, or shall I come in love and with a gentle spirit?

source: Nalah uva jon thanhoi aume, ti kichentah-in akijan ahi, chidang namdangte lah jenga jong kiminphah khalou jon thanhoi aume; mikhatnin apa ji jin aneije.
target: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and of a kind that even pagans do not tolerate: A man is sleeping with his father’s wife.

source: Chutobanga chonpa chu nalah uva kona nodoh-a aum ding lhadaina-a neitah sangin, hoithonan naneijo taove.
target: And you are proud! Shouldn’t you rather have gone into mourning and have put out of your fellowship the man who has been doing this?

source: Keimatah katahsa alhah lou vangin kalhagao nalah uva alhan, chutobanga chonpa thu chu katanin, hitihin kaki chaisah tai;
target: For my part, even though I am not physically present, I am with you in spirit. As one who is present with you in this way, I have already passed judgment in the name of our Lord Jesus on the one who has been doing this.

source: I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa mina, keima lhagaotoh, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa thaneina toh nakikhop tengule,
target: So when you are assembled and I am with you in spirit, and the power of our Lord Jesus is present,

source: Chutia chon mi chu atahsa manna dinga Satan khutna pedoh-un, I-Pakaiyu Jesu nikho nileh alhagao huhhing-a aum theina dingin.
target: hand this man over to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that his spirit may be saved on the day of the Lord.

source: Nangho nakisonnao chu aphapoi; chol themchan changbong lum apumpin achansohjin ahi ti nahet lou uham?
target: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole batch of dough?

source: Tu-a nangho cholsolou nahi bangu chun, changbong lum thah nahina dingun chol lui chu then ngimun paidoh-un. Ijeh-inem itile ikalchuh kut satha dingun Christa tah chu akithat tan ahi.
target: Get rid of the old yeast, so that you may be a new unleavened batch—as you really are. For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.

source: Hijeh chun chol lui mang louvin kut boluhite, engsetle khan gitlou chola kut bol louvin lung thengselle kitahna-in cholsolou changlhah-in kut boluhite.
target: Therefore let us keep the Festival, not with the old bread leavened with malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

source: Keiman nangho kahinthot lekha-a chun jon panhotoh kivopkhom hih-un, tin kahin suntan ahi.
target: I wrote to you in my letter not to associate with sexually immoral people—

source: Achutinai tin vannoi'a jon panho neipap kiloseho, misumang ho, thilha houho toh nakivop khom louhel dingu ahipoi, chutile vannoi leiset hi nachanhel dingu ahitai.
target: not at all meaning the people of this world who are immoral, or the greedy and swindlers, or idolaters. In that case you would have to leave this world.

source: Amavang sopi-a kisimsa khattou ajona, neipap kiloset abola, thilha ahouva, ataitoma, ju akhama, mi anam bola ahile, ama chu kivoppi hih-un, hitobang mi chu an jeng jong neh khompi hih-un, tia kahinsut ahibouve.
target: But now I am writing to you that you must not associate with anyone who claims to be a brother or sister but is sexually immoral or greedy, an idolater or slanderer, a drunkard or swindler. Do not even eat with such people.

source: Polamaho thu tanding ka-ikin tahham? Houbung sunga mite thu natanji hih-um?
target: What business is it of mine to judge those outside the church? Are you not to judge those inside?

source: Polama miho thu vang chu Pathen'in bou atan ahi. Hijeh chun nalah uva konin chuche michonse chu paidoh-un.
target: God will judge those outside. “Expel the wicked person from among you.”

source: Nangho khatnin khat chunga boina thu naneijule, mithengho anga hehta louva michonpha lou anga gaheh ji nangam um?
target: If any of you has a dispute with another, do you dare to take it before the ungodly for judgment instead of before the Lord’s people?

source: Mithengten vannoi thu atan dingu hi nahet louvu ham? Chule vannoi thu nangho tanding ahile, thu neopen tan dinga kilom lou nahiu ham?
target: Or do you not know that the Lord’s people will judge the world? And if you are to judge the world, are you not competent to judge trivial cases?

source: Eiho hin vantil teho thu kisan itan dingu ahi hi helou nahiuvem? Achutile tulai hinkho chungchang thuhi itanda dingu ham?
target: Do you not know that we will judge angels? How much more the things of this life!

source: Chutia chu tu hinlai thudola thu tan ding nahiule, houbung in imacha-a asimlouho chu thutan na mun'a itousah dinguham?
target: Therefore, if you have disputes about such matters, do you ask for a ruling from those whose way of life is scorned in the church?

source: Najachatna dinguva hiche thuhi kahinsei ahi. Sopicha kah-a thu tanlha thei nalah uva miching khatcha beh jong umlou hellaham?
target: I say this to shame you. Is it possible that there is nobody among you wise enough to judge a dispute between believers?

source: Ahinla nangho asopin asopi chunga thuboi neija heh-an jong atahsan louho angabou nahehjiuve.
target: But instead, one brother takes another to court—and this in front of unbelievers!

source: Nangho khatle khat nakiheh tou chu nangho dingin losamna lentah ahitai. Themmo nakichan joh jenguva pha hilouham? Lheplhah-a naum joh jenguva phajo hilouham?
target: The very fact that you have lawsuits among you means you have been completely defeated already. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be cheated?

source: Achutipoi, nangho mama-in aphalou nabolun chule mi nalhem uvin, chule hicheho chu nasopi hou chunga nabol uve.
target: Instead, you yourselves cheat and do wrong, and you do this to your brothers and sisters.

source: Ole michonpha lou hon Pathen lenggam alo lou dingu ahi, ti hi nahet lou uham? Nangho lheplhah-in um hih-un; mijong, milim hou, mijigem, mihuh, palepa kikoi,
target: Or do you not know that wrongdoers will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived: Neither the sexually immoral nor idolaters nor adulterers nor men who have sex with men

source: Gucha, neipap kilose, jukham, mihanse, minambol; hiteho chun Pathen lenggam alo louhel dingu ahi.
target: nor thieves nor the greedy nor drunkards nor slanderers nor swindlers will inherit the kingdom of God.

source: Nangho abang hiti chu nahiuvin, ahivangin Pakai Jesu Christa minle Pathen Lhagaova kisil ngim nahitaovin, akisuthenga, them changa nahitaove.
target: And that is what some of you were. But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.

source: Keima dingin ijakai bol ngai ahi, ahivangin ijakai aphasohkei poi; imajouse keima dingin bolngai ahi, ahivangin imacha noija umponge.
target: “I have the right to do anything,” you say—but not everything is beneficial. “I have the right to do anything”—but I will not be mastered by anything.

source: Oisung dinga an, an dinga oisung ahi; ahivangin Pathen'in agoma beihela ahinlha ding ahi. Chule itahsao hi jonna ding ahipoi, Pakaiya ding joh ahin, chule Pakai jong tahsa-a ding ahi;
target: You say, “Food for the stomach and the stomach for food, and God will destroy them both.” The body, however, is not meant for sexual immorality but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

source: Chule Pathen'in athahatna-a Pakai chu akaithou ahin, eiho jong eikaithou dingu ahi.
target: By his power God raised the Lord from the dead, and he will raise us also.

source: Natahsao chu Christa tibah ahi ti nahet lou uham? Chuti chu ahile Christa tibah ho chu kalah manga noti tibah ho-a kasem dingham? Chutiponte.
target: Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ himself? Shall I then take the members of Christ and unite them with a prostitute? Never!

source: Chule noti'a beh chu amanu chutoh ti khat ahi ti hi nahet lou uham? ajehchu Pathen'in, amani chu tikhat hilhon ding ahi, ati ahi.
target: Do you not know that he who unites himself with a prostitute is one with her in body? For it is said, “The two will become one flesh.”

source: Ahin Pakaiya beh-a vang chu amatoh lhagaova khat hia ahitai.
target: But whoever is united with the Lord is one with him in spirit.

source: Jon thanhoija konin jamun. Mihem chonsetna jouse hi atahsa polama ahi; jonthanhoi bol vang chu koi hile ama tahsa chunga chonsea ahi.
target: Flee from sexual immorality. All other sins a person commits are outside the body, but whoever sins sexually, sins against their own body.

source: Ahilou jongle Pathen'a kona naneiju Lhagao Theng nalung sunguva chenga chu natahsao hi a-in theng ahi ti nahet lou uham? Nangho nangho-a tum nahipouve;
target: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own;

source: Nangho man kipe-a kicho dohsa nahitaove, hijeh chun natahsao le na lhagao un Pathen choi-an nun, hichu Pathen na ahi.
target: you were bought at a price. Therefore honor God with your bodies.

source: Tun imama thudola kahenga dinga nahin lekha sutnu chu kahindon butna hiche ahi, Pasal'in numei atohkhah louvin aphai;
target: Now for the matters you wrote about: “It is good for a man not to have sexual relations with a woman.”

source: Ahivangin jon louna dingin pasal'in numei khat cheh jin neihen, chule numei khatcheh injong pasal khatcheh jin neihen.
target: But since sexual immorality is occurring, each man should have sexual relations with his own wife, and each woman with her own husband.

source: Ajipan ajinu chu achan dingdol chansahhen, chutobang machun ajinun jong ajipa chansah hen.
target: The husband should fulfill his marital duty to his wife, and likewise the wife to her husband.

source: Numei chun ama tahsa chunga imacha thu aneipoi, apasal'in bou aneije; chutobangma chun pasal jong ama tahsa chunga thu aneipoi, anumeijin bou anei ahi.
target: The wife does not have authority over her own body but yields it to her husband. In the same way, the husband does not have authority over his own body but yields it to his wife.

source: An ngolla taona-a nakipeh theina dinguva, chomcha khat kikhena chule kivop khomloi kit dinga nakiphasah geluva ahi tailouvin, kikhen kah hih-un; achuti loule kitimlel jeh-in Satan'in lhemlha getnun nate.
target: Do not deprive each other except perhaps by mutual consent and for a time, so that you may devote yourselves to prayer. Then come together again so that Satan will not tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

source: Ahivangin hiche hi thupeh bangtah-a kasei ahipoi, kaphatsah thua kaseijoh ahibouve.
target: I say this as a concession, not as a command.

source: Mi jouse keima tobang cheh hile kati; ahivangin mikhatnin achom, khatnin achom dang, hitobanga chu min Pathen'a kona Phattheina chom cheh anei ahi.
target: I wish that all of you were as I am. But each of you has your own gift from God; one has this gift, another has that.

source: Jinei louva umho dingle, meithaiho dinga hiche hi kahinsei ahi, amaho chu keima banghin umleu phante.
target: Now to the unmarried and the widows I say: It is good for them to stay unmarried, as I do.

source: Amavang akitim jou lou ule ji neiju hen; ajehchu huh-a jon sangin jinei aphajoi.
target: But if they cannot control themselves, they should marry, for it is better to marry than to burn with passion.

source: Ji neisaho vang hiche thuhi kapeh ahi, keima kahipon Pakaiyin apeh ahi, numei jin ajipa dalha hihhen.
target: To the married I give this command (not I, but the Lord): A wife must not separate from her husband.

source: Adalhah tahjongle jinei louvin umhen, ahiloule ajipatoh kihoucham kit hen. Chule pasal'in ajinu da hihhen.
target: But if she does, she must remain unmarried or else be reconciled to her husband. And a husband must not divorce his wife.

source: Chule adangho thu dingdol vang chu Pakai hilouvin, keima sei ahi: Sopi khat touvin numei atahsanlou ji aneija, a-inneipu chutoh umkhom anople, ama chu a-inneipun da hihhen;
target: To the rest I say this (I, not the Lord): If any brother has a wife who is not a believer and she is willing to live with him, he must not divorce her.

source: Chule numei khattouvin pasal atahsanlou aneija, ajipan amanutoh chenkhom ding anople, ama chun a-inneipu chu da hihhen.
target: And if a woman has a husband who is not a believer and he is willing to live with her, she must not divorce him.

source: Ijeh-inem itile chuche tahsanlou pasal chu ajinu jala chu kisuthenga ahitai; chule numei tahsanlou jong chu ajipa jala chu kisuthenga ahi; chutilou hile nachateo jong aboh ding ahiuve, tunla amaho athenguve.
target: For the unbelieving husband has been sanctified through his wife, and the unbelieving wife has been sanctified through her believing husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but as it is, they are holy.

source: Hijongle atahsanlou chun adalhahtah-a ahile achele chetante; sopipa ahin ahiloule sopinu ahin hitobang thudola hin kikana aumtapoi; hijongle Pathen'in lungmonga umdinga eikouvu ahi.
target: But if the unbeliever leaves, let it be so. The brother or the sister is not bound in such circumstances; God has called us to live in peace.

source: Ajehchu, Vo numei, nangman na-inneipu huhhing-a naumsah jou ding iti nahetnam? Ahiloule pasal, nangman jong na-inneipi huhhing-a naumsah jou ding iti nahetnam?
target: How do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or, how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

source: Ahivangin Pathen'in mijouse ahoppeh bangle, Pakaiyin mijouse akou bang cheh-in, chon cheh-u hen. Chule hitobanga chu houbung jouse-a kathupeh ahi.
target: Nevertheless, each person should live as a believer in whatever situation the Lord has assigned to them, just as God has called them. This is the rule I lay down in all the churches.

source: Cheptansa kikou umam? cheptan chun chuti umhen. Cheptan louva kikou umam? Cheptan louvin chuti umhen.
target: Was a man already circumcised when he was called? He should not become uncircumcised. Was a man uncircumcised when he was called? He should not be circumcised.

source: Cheptan chu imacha ahipon chule cheptanlou jong ima ahidehpoi; Pathen thupeh nitbou hi thupipen ahi.
target: Circumcision is nothing and uncircumcision is nothing. Keeping God’s commands is what counts.

source: Mijouse akikouva aum bang bang cheh-in um chehhen.
target: Each person should remain in the situation they were in when God called them.

source: Soh nahi puma kikou nahim? hichu khohsa hih-in; amavang ongthol nahung hithei ding vangle, hichu mangchajon.
target: Were you a slave when you were called? Don’t let it trouble you—although if you can gain your freedom, do so.

source: Ijeh inem itile soh hipuma Pakaiya kikou chu, Pakaiya dinga ongthol ahi; chutobang chun a-ongthola kikou chu Christa soh ahi.
target: For the one who was a slave when called to faith in the Lord is the Lord’s freed person; similarly, the one who was free when called is Christ’s slave.

source: Nangho aman kipe-a kichoa nahitaove; miho soh hihih-un.
target: You were bought at a price; do not become slaves of human beings.

source: Sopite, mijouse akikou uva aum bang cheh-un, Pathen to umkhom cheh uhen.
target: Brothers and sisters, each person, as responsible to God, should remain in the situation they were in when God called them.

source: Nungah thengho thudol vang, keiman Pakaiya kon thupeh mong kaneipoi; hijongle tahsan umtah hidinga Pakaiya kona lungsetna mu-a kahi dungjuija, kangaito danje kasei ahi.
target: Now about virgins: I have no command from the Lord, but I give a judgment as one who by the Lord’s mercy is trustworthy.

source: Chutichu ahin tu laija hesohna jeh hin, hiche hi phante tin kagingchai, mi aum ngaijin um chehhen.
target: Because of the present crisis, I think that it is good for a man to remain as he is.

source: Numeitoh kicheng nahim? Ondoh ding ngaito hih-in. Numeija kona ongdoh nahim? Jinei lung gul hih-in.
target: Are you pledged to a woman? Do not seek to be released. Are you free from such a commitment? Do not look for a wife.

source: Ahivangin jinei jongle chun achonsea nahipoi, nungah theng jong chun ji neijongle achonsea ahipoi. Amavang chutobang miho chu tahsa lama hesoh genthei athoh dingu ahi; hijongleh thohda leuchun kati ahi.
target: But if you do marry, you have not sinned; and if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. But those who marry will face many troubles in this life, and I want to spare you this.

source: Ahivangin, sopite, hiche phat chu kisuchoma ahitai; tu-a kalin jineija chu jineilou bangin,
target: What I mean, brothers and sisters, is that the time is short. From now on those who have wives should live as if they do not;

source: Akapte akap lou bangin, akipahte akipah lou bangin, thil cho-a anei lou bangin umuhen,
target: those who mourn, as if they did not; those who are happy, as if they were not; those who buy something, as if it were not theirs to keep;

source: Chule leiset chonna mangcha-a chun avala mang lou bangin umuhen. Ijeh-inem itile hiche leiset umchan danhi achemang jinge.
target: those who use the things of the world, as if not engrossed in them. For this world in its present form is passing away.

source: Ahin ima khohsah louhelin umleu chun kalung ahi. Jineilou chun itile Pakai chu kalung lhaidem tin, Pakai lam thil jengbou akhohsah-in ahi.
target: I would like you to be free from concern. An unmarried man is concerned about the Lord’s affairs—how he can please the Lord.

source: Ahin jineija vang chun hiche leiset thil, itile ka-inneipi kalunglhai theidem, ti jengbou akhohsah-in ahi.
target: But a married man is concerned about the affairs of this world—how he can please his wife—

source: Numei jinei le nungah theng kikah-a jong akikhehna aume. Numei jineilou chun tahsale lhagao agoma thengsela um theina dingin Pakai lam thil jengbou akhohsah jin ahi; jinei vang chun leiset lam thil, itile ka-inneipu kalunglhai sah theidem, ti jengbou ageljin ahi.
target: and his interests are divided. An unmarried woman or virgin is concerned about the Lord’s affairs: Her aim is to be devoted to the Lord in both body and spirit. But a married woman is concerned about the affairs of this world—how she can please her husband.

source: Hichu nangho thangkola khina dinga kasei hilouvin, naphatchomna dinguva kaseijoh ahi, umchan phakeicha naum uva, baotamna beija Pakai kin nabol theinajoh dinguva kasei ahi.
target: I am saying this for your own good, not to restrict you, but that you may live in a right way in undivided devotion to the Lord.

source: Amavang mi khat touvin acha nungah theng khat kathilbol hi adihpoi tia agela, amanu chu akul ahitah-a, aji neilou akhohsah-a ahile, alung got gotnin bol jenghen; hichea chun setna aumpoi; jineisah jeng hen.
target: If anyone is worried that he might not be acting honorably toward the virgin he is engaged to, and if his passions are too strong and he feels he ought to marry, he should do as he wants. He is not sinning. They should get married.

source: Amavang koi hile lung dettah po-a, khohsahna neilouva, alungthim aki thunun jouva, achanu thenna tuhdet peh jingdinga gelha-a chun, thilpha abol ahi.
target: But the man who has settled the matter in his own mind, who is under no compulsion but has control over his own will, and who has made up his mind not to marry the virgin—this man also does the right thing.

source: Hijeh chun achanu jineisah-a chun apha abol ahin; ahivangin jineisah loujo chun aphajo cheh abol ahi.
target: So then, he who marries the virgin does right, but he who does not marry her does better.

source: A-inneipu ahin lai chansea a-inneipi chu danna kihen jinga ahi, a-inneipu athi teng vangle amanu a-onga ahitan, Pakai tahsan ahipou le anop nop napa chutoh kicheng thei ahi.
target: A woman is bound to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, but he must belong to the Lord.

source: Amavang keima ngaito danin, achuti um jeng theija ahile, amanu chu minun nomjo ahi, kei jong Pathen Lhagao changin kakingaitoi.
target: In my judgment, she is happier if she stays as she is—and I think that I too have the Spirit of God.

source: Milim houna-a kikatdoh thilho thudola chun: ibon chaovin hetna inei cheh uve ti iheuve. Hetna-in mi ahoitho sahjin, ngailutna hin mi akhantou sahjin ahi.
target: Now about food sacrificed to idols: We know that “We all possess knowledge.” But knowledge puffs up while love builds up.

source: Mi khat tou, ijakai he-a akingaitoa ahileh, ama chun ahet ding dol imacha ahetlou ahi.
target: Those who think they know something do not yet know as they ought to know.

source: Amavang khat touvin Pathen angailut le, amatah chu Pathen het ahi.
target: But whoever loves God is known by God.

source: Milim houna-a kikatdoh thil nehding thudol vang chu, vannoi'a hin milim hi imacha ahipon, chule Pathen khatseh tailou chu Pathen dang aumpoi, ti iheuve.
target: So then, about eating food sacrificed to idols: We know that “An idol is nothing at all in the world” and that “There is no God but one.”

source: Ijeh-inem itile vanlaijola jong, leiset chunga jong, Pathen tia kiminvoho uma ahi, (chutia chu pathen tamtah uma, pakai tamtah uma ahi;)
target: For even if there are so-called gods, whether in heaven or on earth (as indeed there are many “gods” and many “lords”),

source: Eiho ding vangin thil jouse kona, eiho jong ama-a ihiu, Pa, Pathen khatbou aumin, chule thil jouse kona, chule eiho jong ama vanga ihinu, Pakai Jesu Christa khat bou aume.
target: yet for us there is but one God, the Father, from whom all things came and for whom we live; and there is but one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom all things came and through whom we live.

source: Ahivangin mi jousen chuche hetna chu aneipoi, chuti chun akimkhatnin tu geija masanga achonnau milim hou thu chu achin jeh-un, amaho chun milim houna-a kitohdoh thil ahi tin anejiuvin; chua chun ase apha hetkhenna alungu ahat lou jeh chun, akisubohji taove.
target: But not everyone possesses this knowledge. Some people are still so accustomed to idols that when they eat sacrificial food they think of it as having been sacrificed to a god, and since their conscience is weak, it is defiled.

source: Ahin an neh hin Pathen to eikinaisah dingu ahipoi; eihon ineh uleh aphajep ihi pouvin, ineh louvule jong aphamopen ihideh pouve.
target: But food does not bring us near to God; we are no worse if we do not eat, and no better if we do.

source: Ahivangin chingtheijun, nachamlhatnao hi ijem itile ahatmo ding chun kipal lhuhna higet ninte.
target: Be careful, however, that the exercise of your rights does not become a stumbling block to the weak.

source: Hetna neija nangma milim houna-a ankong naum chu khat touvin muhen lang hileh, sele pha hetkhenna-a lhasam ama chun milim houna-a kikatdoh thilchu neh ngam nadinga hansanna aneilo louding ham?
target: For if someone with a weak conscience sees you, with all your knowledge, eating in an idol’s temple, won’t that person be emboldened to eat what is sacrificed to idols?

source: Chutile ajala Christa thia chuche sopi hatmo chu, nangma hetna nei jeh-a manthah lo louding ham?
target: So this weak brother or sister, for whom Christ died, is destroyed by your knowledge.
