source: Ahinla sopite chunga nangho chutia nachonset uva, ase le pha hetkhennau hatmo chu namavo tengule, nangho Christa douna-a chonse nahiuve.
target: When you sin against them in this way and wound their weak conscience, you sin against Christ.

source: Hijeh chun an neh-in kasopi akipal lhuhsah-a ahile, kasopi lhuh louna dingin, a-imatih chanin sa-a san nehdange.
target: Therefore, if what I eat causes my brother or sister to fall into sin, I will never eat meat again, so that I will not cause them to fall.

source: Solchah khat hilou kahim? Chamlhat hilou kahim? I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa mulou kahim? Nangho jong Pakaiya kanatoh nahi lou uham?
target: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are you not the result of my work in the Lord?

source: Adang dangin solchah hilou jongleng, nangho dingbeh-in kahi; Pakaiya solchah kahi het kichetna mohor nangho nahiuve.
target: Even though I may not be an apostle to others, surely I am to you! For you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

source: Hiche hi kathem kathemlou eikholtohho lekalna kihonna-a kasei ahi.
target: This is my defense to those who sit in judgment on me.

source: Nehna ding le donna dinga thuneina neilou kahiuvem?
target: Don’t we have the right to food and drink?

source: Solchah danghole, Pakai sopite, chule Cephas banga khu sopinu khattou ji-a neija kipuile mo kahiuvem?
target: Don’t we have the right to take a believing wife along with us, as do the other apostles and the Lord’s brothers and Cephas?

source: Ahiloule Barnabas le kei bouhi kanatoh lhonna-a kon haimo kahi lhonem?
target: Or is it only I and Barnabas who lack the right to not work for a living?

source: Koiham ama sum kineh-a sepai na tonga? Lengpithei hon sema aga nelou koiham? Gancha honpi vula anoi ne lou koiham?
target: Who serves as a soldier at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat its grapes? Who tends a flock and does not drink the milk?

source: Chucheng chu mihem ngaidan jenga kasei ham? Danthun jong hicheng chu asei hilouham?
target: Do I say this merely on human authority? Doesn’t the Law say the same thing?

source: Mosi danthua, Bongchal chang chil pet amuh kan hih-un, tin akisune. Pathen'in bongchalho ding jengbou agel ham?
target: For it is written in the Law of Moses: “Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain.” Is it about oxen that God is concerned?

source: Ahiloule eiho dinga jong asei ham? Eiho ding monga hiche thuhi kisuna ahi; lou kaija chun kinepna neija akai ding; chule kinepna neija chang vo-a chun akinepna banga amu ding ahi.
target: Surely he says this for us, doesn’t he? Yes, this was written for us, because whoever plows and threshes should be able to do so in the hope of sharing in the harvest.

source: Keihon nangho dinga lhagao muchi katu uva ahile, na tahsalam thilu ga kalo dingu chu thil lentah hajaham?
target: If we have sown spiritual seed among you, is it too much if we reap a material harvest from you?

source: Midanghon nachung uva thuneina chu aneija ahile, keihon kahanei chehjoh lou uham? Hijongle hiche thuneina chu kamang pouve; Christa Kipana Thupha thu kadoudal louna dingun, ijakai abonchan kathoh hamham jovin ahi.
target: If others have this right of support from you, shouldn’t we have it all the more? But we did not use this right. On the contrary, we put up with anything rather than hinder the gospel of Christ.

source: Thiltheng lhacha-a panghon houin'a thilho chu anehjiuva, chule maichama lhachahon maichama kitoh chan aneijiu khu nahet lou uham?
target: Don’t you know that those who serve in the temple get their food from the temple, and that those who serve at the altar share in what is offered on the altar?

source: Chutobangma chu, Kipana Thupha lhangsama panghon, Kipana Thupha-a kona aneh dingu ahi, tia Pakaiyin chonnadan asem ahi.
target: In the same way, the Lord has commanded that those who preach the gospel should receive their living from the gospel.

source: Ahivangin keiman hicheng chu khatcha jong kamangchapoi; chule chutia chu eikibolna dinga hicheng thuhi kahinsut jong ahipoi; kakisonna hi khattouvin ahomkeo asosah sangin, keima thimaleng keima dingin aphajoi.
target: But I have not used any of these rights. And I am not writing this in the hope that you will do such things for me, for I would rather die than allow anyone to deprive me of this boast.

source: Keiman Kipana Thupha thu kahille vangin kisonna ding ima kaneipoi; bollou theilou kinkhoh kachunga eikisekhum ahijeh-in; Kipana Thupha lhangsamle lou hileng kachung gih ding ahi.
target: For when I preach the gospel, I cannot boast, since I am compelled to preach. Woe to me if I do not preach the gospel!

source: Keima lungchama bola kahile tohphat man kasan ding ahi; keima lungchama bola kahilou vangle, Kipana Thupha gouchinga eikipansah hinte.
target: If I preach voluntarily, I have a reward; if not voluntarily, I am simply discharging the trust committed to me.

source: Achutile tohphat man kasan ding chu iham? Kipana Thupha kalhangsap leteng Kipana Thupha-a hi kathuneina kamanchah khel louna dinga, Christa Kipana Thupha man beija kahopjal hi ahi.
target: What then is my reward? Just this: that in preaching the gospel I may offer it free of charge, and so not make full use of my rights as a preacher of the gospel.

source: Keima mi jouse-a kona ongthola kahi vangin, mi tamcheh kalah lut theina dinga, mi jouse soh-a kakisem ahi.
target: Though I am free and belong to no one, I have made myself a slave to everyone, to win as many as possible.

source: Chutichun Juda te kalah lut theinan, Juda te henga Juda mi um bangin kaumjin: danthu noijate kaloi lut theinan, danthu noija umte hengah, danthu noija um bangin kaumjin ahi.
target: To the Jews I became like a Jew, to win the Jews. To those under the law I became like one under the law (though I myself am not under the law), so as to win those under the law.

source: Dan neiloute kaloi lut theinan, dan neiloute hengah, dan neilou bangin kaumjin, ahin Pathen dan mang louva um kahipoi, Christa danthu noija um kahi.
target: To those not having the law I became like one not having the law (though I am not free from God’s law but am under Christ’s law), so as to win those not having the law.

source: Ahatmote kaloi lut theina dingin, ahatmote henga ahatmo kahi: itilam hijongle themkhat beh kahuhhing thei teina dinga, mi jouse dinga ijakai kasoji ahi.
target: To the weak I became weak, to win the weak. I have become all things to all people so that by all possible means I might save some.

source: Kabolchan hi Kipana Thupha khohsah na-a kabol ahin, nangho toh chan kaneikhom theina ding ahi.
target: I do all this for the sake of the gospel, that I may share in its blessings.

source: Lhaitet golsehna-a khu mi jouse lhaicheh ji-a ahi, ahivangin khatbouvin hatman asangjin ahi, hichu nanghon nahet lou uham? Nasan theina dingun lhaijun.
target: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.

source: Chule koi hijongle golseh jouving tia guttena chu, ijakaija akitim hatjin ahi. Amaho chun lallukhuh kem mangthei lona-a abolu ahin, eihovang kemmang theilou lallukhuh lo-a ihiuve.
target: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.

source: Hijeh-a chu hitia chu lhaija kahi, abidoi kichen nei louva lhaija kahipoi; hitia chu chuma kahi, onghom lai chuma kahipoi,
target: Therefore I do not run like someone running aimlessly; I do not fight like a boxer beating the air.

source: Kati hi kachup kachupjia kathua kanunsah ahi; achuti loule midangho thu kahille nungin, keimatah ijemtin paidoh-in um khange.
target: No, I strike a blow to my body and make it my slave so that after I have preached to others, I myself will not be disqualified for the prize.

source: Vo sopite, hiche hi helouva naum dingu kalung anompoi, Ipute Ipateu chu abonchauva meibol noija ana umuva, chule twikhanglen apal galkaiju ahi.
target: For I do not want you to be ignorant of the fact, brothers and sisters, that our ancestors were all under the cloud and that they all passed through the sea.

source: Abon chaovin Mosi-a chun meibol le twikhanglen'ah baptize achangun,
target: They were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea.

source: Chule abon chaovin lhagao an thakhat aneuvin;
target: They all ate the same spiritual food

source: Abonchauvin lhagao twi thakhat anadonun ahi. Hichu anungsang chenguva chea lhagao songpi-a kona chu amahon adonu ahi; chule hiche songpi chu Christa ahi.
target: and drank the same spiritual drink; for they drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was Christ.

source: Ahivangin amaho atamjo chunga chun Pathen alunglhaipon ahi; ajeh chu gamthip gama chun alhukam gamtaovin ahi.
target: Nevertheless, God was not pleased with most of them; their bodies were scattered in the wilderness.

source: Thilphalou alunggot banguva chu eihon jong thilphalou ilunggot louna dinguva, chuti chu eivetsah nau ahi.
target: Now these things occurred as examples to keep us from setting our hearts on evil things as they did.

source: Chule amaho lah-a kimkhat milim hou ahi bangu chun nangho um hih-un; hiche thudol chu hitin akisune, Miho chu an neding le don dingin atouvun, chuin alam dingin akipatdoh taovin ahi.
target: Do not be idolaters, as some of them were; as it is written: “The people sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in revelry.”

source: Chule amaho lah-a kimkhatnin jon apat uva, nikhat sunga sangsomni le sangthum athilo bangu chun, eihon jong jon pan pouhite.
target: We should not commit sexual immorality, as some of them did—and in one day twenty-three thousand of them died.

source: Chule amaho lah-a kimkhatnin apatep jeh uva gul'in asumang bangun; eihon jong Christa patep pouhite.
target: We should not test Christ, as some of them did—and were killed by snakes.

source: Alah uva kimkhat aphunchel jeh-un, suhmang na-in asumangun ahi; chutobang chun phunchel hih-un.
target: And do not grumble, as some of them did—and were killed by the destroying angel.

source: Tu-a thil hicheng hi avetsahna dinga achunguva soh-a ahi; chule vannoi leiset kichaina hung lhun nading eiho, kithuhilna dinga kisuna ahi.
target: These things happened to them as examples and were written down as warnings for us, on whom the culmination of the ages has come.

source: Hiche jeh chun koi hile adinga kingaito-a chu alhuh louna dingin chingtheihen.
target: So, if you think you are standing firm, be careful that you don’t fall!

source: Mihem dou thei kalval lhepna nachung uva achukhapoi; Pathen tahsan umtah ahin, nathan adou jou kalvalin lhepna nachung uva chuhsah ponte; hijeh chun nathoh jouna dingun, lhepna chutoh kilhona nakihuhdohna dingu lampi jong nasempeh dingu ahi.
target: No temptation has overtaken you except what is common to mankind. And God is faithful; he will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, he will also provide a way out so that you can endure it.

source: Hijeh chun, kasopi ngaiteho, milim hou jamsanun.
target: Therefore, my dear friends, flee from idolatry.

source: Keiman nangho mi lungching nahiu kahetna kasei ahi, kathusei hi nanghon kikhollun.
target: I speak to sensible people; judge for yourselves what I say.

source: Phatthei channa khon phatthei iboh-u khu, Christa thisan ikiloi khompi nau hilouham? Chule changlhah ihebaljiu khu Christa tahsa ikiloi khompi nau hilouham?
target: Is not the cup of thanksgiving for which we give thanks a participation in the blood of Christ? And is not the bread that we break a participation in the body of Christ?

source: Ijeh-inem itile eiho mi tamtah hi changlhah lum khat ihiuvin, ti khat ihiuve; ajeh chu changlhah lum khatna chu ibon chaova chan ineiju ahi.
target: Because there is one loaf, we, who are many, are one body, for we all share the one loaf.

source: Tahsa lama Israelte khu veuvin, kithoina sa neho khu maicham toh chan neikhom hilouham?
target: Consider the people of Israel: Do not those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

source: Achutile ipi kaseijem? Milim houna an chu ikhat ahi, ahiloule milim hou jong hi ikhat ahi, katim?
target: Do I mean then that food sacrificed to an idol is anything, or that an idol is anything?

source: Chuti ahipoi, chidang namdang ten akithoinao chu Pathen lama atou hilouvin, thilha dingjoh-a atou ahibouve; nangho thilha toh nakiloikhom dingu chu kalung nahipeh pouve.
target: No, but the sacrifices of pagans are offered to demons, not to God, and I do not want you to be participants with demons.

source: Nanghon Pakai khon le thilha khona nadonkop thei lou dingu ahi, Pakai ankong le thilha ankong na-umkop thei lou dingu ahi.
target: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons too; you cannot have a part in both the Lord’s table and the table of demons.

source: Ole thangset sahna dinga Pakai chu isuh lunghangu ham? Ama sanga hatjobeh ihiuvem?
target: Are we trying to arouse the Lord’s jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

source: Thil ijakai keima din bol ngai ahin, ahivangin ijakai phatna ahipoi; ijakai keima din bol ngai ahin, ahivangin ijakai phattouna ahipoi.
target: “I have the right to do anything,” you say—but not everything is beneficial. “I have the right to do anything”—but not everything is constructive.

source: Koiman ama chang phatna hol louvin, aheng akoma dingjoh hol-hen.
target: No one should seek their own good, but the good of others.

source: Kailhanga kijoh thiljouse chu ne jengun, sele pha hetna jeh-in ima dong hih-un;
target: Eat anything sold in the meat market without raising questions of conscience,

source: Ijeh-inem itile leiset le asunga umjouse hi aboncha Pakaiya ahi.
target: for, “The earth is the Lord’s, and everything in it.”

source: Atahsan louho khattouvin an ne-a nakouva nache nomle, sele pha hetna jeh-in ima dong hih-un, na-anga alui chan chu ne jengun.
target: If an unbeliever invites you to a meal and you want to go, eat whatever is put before you without raising questions of conscience.

source: Amavang khattouvin, hiche hi milimho henga kithoina kitoh ahi, tia naseipeh-a ahivangle, ahetsahpa jeh le sele pha hetna jeh chun nehdaovin, ijeh-inem itile leiset le asunga thil um jouse hi Pakaiya ahi.
target: But if someone says to you, “This has been offered in sacrifice,” then do not eat it, both for the sake of the one who told you and for the sake of conscience.

source: Nangma sele pha hetna kati hilouvin ama-a joh chu kati ahi. Kacham lhatna chu midang sele pha hetna-in ibola ei-oimo dingham?
target: I am referring to the other person’s conscience, not yours. For why is my freedom being judged by another’s conscience?

source: Ajehchu thangvahna neija kaneh leh, ibola thangvahna kanei chunga chu oimo-a um kahim?
target: If I take part in the meal with thankfulness, why am I denounced because of something I thank God for?

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun naneh jongule, nadon jongule, nabol jouseu Pathen loupina ding jengin bolun.
target: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God.

source: Juda mi hihen, Greek mi hitale, Pathen houbung mite hitale, akipal lhuhna dingun ima bolhih helun,
target: Do not cause anyone to stumble, whether Jews, Greeks or the church of God—

source: Keiman keichang phatchomna ding hol louva, huhhing-a aum theina dinguva mi tamtah phatchomna holnajoh-a, thil jouse-a mi jouse kalung lhaisah banghin, nanghon jong bollun.
target: even as I try to please everyone in every way. For I am not seeking my own good but the good of many, so that they may be saved.

source: Keima Christa dungsuna kaum bang hin nangho keima dungsuna umun.
target: Follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ.

source: Tun sopite, nanghon imajousea keima neigeldoh jinguva, chonna ding thugou kapeh bang banga dettah-a nachin uva nanit jeh-un kapahchauve.
target: I praise you for remembering me in everything and for holding to the traditions just as I passed them on to you.

source: Ahivangin Christa chu pasal jouse luchang ahia, pasal chengse numei luchang ahi, chule Christa luchang Pathen ahi chu, heleu chun kalung ahi.
target: But I want you to realize that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

source: Koi hile pasal lukhuh khuhpuma taova ahim, lhagaova thu seidoh ahim chun alu ajabol lou ahi.
target: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head.

source: Ahin numei lukhuh khuh louva taole lhagaova thu seidoh chun alu ajabol lou ahin, alu chu akiveltol tobang ahi.
target: But every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head—it is the same as having her head shaved.

source: Numei lukhuh khuh lou aumle kivomui ngal hen; alu veltol le asam kivomui chu numei dinga jachatna ahile, lukhuh kikhuh hen.
target: For if a woman does not cover her head, she might as well have her hair cut off; but if it is a disgrace for a woman to have her hair cut off or her head shaved, then she should cover her head.

source: Pasal vang chu Pathen lim bangle aloupina ahi jeh chun lukhuh khuh lou dingdol mong ahi. Numei vang chu pasal loupina ahi.
target: A man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God; but woman is the glory of man.

source: Ajeh chu pasal hi numeija kona ahipoi; numei joh hi pasal'a kona jo ahibouve.
target: For man did not come from woman, but woman from man;

source: Chujongle pasal hi numei dinga kisem ahipoi; numei bou pasal dinga kisemjoh ahi.
target: neither was man created for woman, but woman for man.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun vantil teho jala numei jin thaneina alua achin ding dol thu ahi.
target: It is for this reason that a woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.

source: Ahivangin Pakaiyah pasal beijin numei aumpon, numei beijin pasal aumpoi.
target: Nevertheless, in the Lord woman is not independent of man, nor is man independent of woman.

source: Pasal'a kona numei ahi banga chu numeija kona pasal uma ahi; ahivangin thil jouse Pathen'a kon ahi.
target: For as woman came from man, so also man is born of woman. But everything comes from God.

source: Nalungin gelunlang ngaitouvin, numei jin lukhuh khuh louva Pathen henga atao hi kilomnam?
target: Judge for yourselves: Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?

source: Pasal'in asam akihoisaova ahile, ama dingin minah sahmo aume, ti hi chonna ngaimong jongin nahil lou uham?
target: Does not the very nature of things teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a disgrace to him,

source: Numei vang asam asaole ama dingin hichu aloupina ahi; ajehchu asam chu akhu dinga kipe-a ahi.
target: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For long hair is given to her as a covering.

source: Ahivangin anela aumle, eihon hitobang dan mong chu ineipouve; Pathen houbung miten jong aneipoi.
target: If anyone wants to be contentious about this, we have no other practice—nor do the churches of God.

source: Amavang hiche thu kahilchah naova hin kapahcha pouve; nangho phatcheh nadinga kikhomji nahipouvin setna cheh joh dinga kikhomji nahiuve.
target: In the following directives I have no praise for you, for your meetings do more harm than good.

source: Ajeh chu amasa penin, nangho houbung'a nahung kikhop tengule, nalah uva loitum tumin nakikhen jiuve ti kajan, chule tah jong katahsan thim thime.
target: In the first place, I hear that when you come together as a church, there are divisions among you, and to some extent I believe it.

source: Nalah uva mikitahtah ho ahung kiphondoh theina dinga, ginchat chom chom nei jong umding mong ahi.
target: No doubt there have to be differences among you to show which of you have God’s approval.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun nangho mun khatna nakikhop tengule, Pakai jan anjon nehna hoi ahijipoi;
target: So then, when you come together, it is not the Lord’s Supper you eat,

source: Amikipmin adang neh masangin ajan an akineh masahjiuvin, chule khat gilkelin aumin, khat ju akhamjin ahi.
target: for when you are eating, some of you go ahead with your own private suppers. As a result, one person remains hungry and another gets drunk.

source: Nanehna dingule nadonna dingu na-in'u um louham? Ole Pathen houbung chu nahsahmo-a bola chule ima neiloute chu jachatsah nahiuvem? Ipi kaseipeh ding nahiuvem? Hiche thua hin nangho pahchau vingem? Pahcha pong kate.
target: Don’t you have homes to eat and drink in? Or do you despise the church of God by humiliating those who have nothing? What shall I say to you? Shall I praise you? Certainly not in this matter!

source: Pakaiya kona kalah nangho kapehsonu thuhil chu hiche ahi, Pakai Jesu amatsah ding jan-u chun, hiche janlele chun aman changlhah alan,
target: For I received from the Lord what I also passed on to you: The Lord Jesus, on the night he was betrayed, took bread,

source: Athangvah jouvin ahehbal balin, kilah-un, neuvin, Hiche hi katahsa nangho dinga kihehbal chu ahi; keima neigeldoh jingna dingun hichehi bolun, ati.
target: and when he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is for you; do this in remembrance of me.”

source: Chutima chun, a-anneh jouvun khon jong chu alan, Hiche khon hi kathisana kitepna thah ahi; nanghon nadon chanuva keima neigeldoh na dingun bolun, ati.
target: In the same way, after supper he took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood; do this, whenever you drink it, in remembrance of me.”

source: Ajehchu hiche changlhah naneh uva, hiche khona nadon lai chanuva, ahung kit kahse-a Pakai thina chu naphondoh jingu ahi.
target: For whenever you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.

source: Hijeh chun koi hile anehoi hilouva changlhah chu ne-a ahim, khona chu dona ahim chu, ama chu Pakai tahsale athisana themmo chang ding ahi.
target: So then, whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord.

source: Amavang mi ama kikholtoh chehhen, chule changlhah chu nehen, khona jong chun donhen.
target: Everyone ought to examine themselves before they eat of the bread and drink from the cup.

source: Chuche Pakai tahsa chu geltoh lou hella, chule lomlou hella ne-a donna chun, oimo achana dinga adonna, aneh ahi.
target: For those who eat and drink without discerning the body of Christ eat and drink judgment on themselves.

source: Hiche jeh chu ahi, nalah uva mi tamtah lhasama chule veise-a ahin, chule nena nen a-imumil tapouve.
target: That is why many among you are weak and sick, and a number of you have fallen asleep.

source: Eimale eima kikholtoh cheh vangleu hen oimo ichan lou dingu ahi.
target: But if we were more discerning with regard to ourselves, we would not come under such judgment.

source: Oimo ichan tengule, vannoi toh themmo ichantha louna dingun, Pakaiya konin engbolin iumjiuve,
target: Nevertheless, when we are judged in this way by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be finally condemned with the world.

source: Hiche jeh chun, kasopite, ane dinga nahung kikhop tengule khatle khat kingah kimun.
target: So then, my brothers and sisters, when you gather to eat, you should all eat together.

source: Nahung kikhopnau chu oimo-a aum louna dingin, khattou agilkela aumle a-in'a hin nehen. Adang chengse vang kahung tengle sujang soh nange.
target: Anyone who is hungry should eat something at home, so that when you meet together it may not result in judgment. And when I come I will give further directions.

source: Chule, sopite, lhagaolam thilpeh thuho chu nahet lou dingu kanompoi.
target: Now about the gifts of the Spirit, brothers and sisters, I do not want you to be uninformed.

source: Chidang namdang nahi laiju chun, puilea naumna chanuva milim pao theilou anga chu puimanga na-umjiu ahin, hichu naheuve.
target: You know that when you were pagans, somehow or other you were influenced and led astray to mute idols.

source: Hiche jeh chun nangho kahetsah nahiuve, Pathen Lhagao thuseija chun koiman Jesu chu sapset chang ahi, atipoi, chule Lhagao Thenga kon louvin, koiman, Jesu chu Pakai, ati theipoi.
target: Therefore I want you to know that no one who is speaking by the Spirit of God says, “Jesus be cursed,” and no one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” except by the Holy Spirit.

source: Thilpeh chan gotchom chom tamtah ahi, ahivangin Lhagao khatsehbou ahi;
target: There are different kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit distributes them.

source: Chule lhacha gotchom chom tamtah ahin, ahivangin Pakai khatsehbou ahi;
target: There are different kinds of service, but the same Lord.

source: Chule natoh gotchom chom aumin, ahivangin ijakaija ijakai bola chu Pathen khat jengbou ahi.
target: There are different kinds of working, but in all of them and in everyone it is the same God at work.

source: Ahivangin mijousen aphattoupina dinga, mi khatcheh chu Lhagao phondohna khat cheh kipe-a ahi.
target: Now to each one the manifestation of the Spirit is given for the common good.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Lhagaova kona mikhat chu chihna thu kipe-a, chuche Lhagao mama-a chu khat hetnanei thu kipe-a ahi;
target: To one there is given through the Spirit a message of wisdom, to another a message of knowledge by means of the same Spirit,

source: hiche Lhagaoma-a chu khat tahsan kipe-a; chule chuche Lhagaoma-a chu achom khat mi damsah theina thilpeh kipe-a;
target: to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healing by that one Spirit,

source: Achom khat bolmo kidang bol theina kipe-a; chule achom khat lhagao thusei dohna; chule achom khat Lhagaoho hetkhen theina; chule achom dang khat paotin paotang tho theina; chule achom dang khat pao ledoh theina kipe-a ahi.
target: to another miraculous powers, to another prophecy, to another distinguishing between spirits, to another speaking in different kinds of tongues, and to still another the interpretation of tongues.

source: Ahivangin hicheng na kitong jouse chu, Lhagao khatmama chun abolsah ahi; aman ama lunglam dola achom choma miho khat khatna ahoppeh cheh ahi.
target: All these are the work of one and the same Spirit, and he distributes them to each one, just as he determines.

source: Tipum khatseh ahin, tibah tamtah ahi, tipum khatna tibah tamtah aum vangin, tipum khatbou ahi; Christa jong chutobang ahi.
target: Just as a body, though one, has many parts, but all its many parts form one body, so it is with Christ.

source: Ajeh chu eiho Juda mi ahin, Greek mi hijongle, soh hihen, chamlhat hi jongle, ibon chaova tipum khat ihi theina dinguva, ibon chaova tahsapum khat sunga umdinga Lhagao khatna iki baptize-u ahi; chule ibon chaova Lhagao khat eiki don khom sah-u ahitai.
target: For we were all baptized by one Spirit so as to form one body—whether Jews or Gentiles, slave or free—and we were all given the one Spirit to drink.

source: Ajehchu tipum hi ti khatseh ahipoi, bah tamtah ahi.
target: Even so the body is not made up of one part but of many.

source: Kengphang hin, Keima khut kahi lou jeh-in tipuma kahipoi, tile hiche jeh-a chu tipuma hida dingham?
target: Now if the foot should say, “Because I am not a hand, I do not belong to the body,” it would not for that reason stop being part of the body.

source: Chule bilkol jong hin, Keima mit kahi lou jeh-in tipuma kahipoi, tile hiche jeh-a chu tipuma hida ding ham?
target: And if the ear should say, “Because I am not an eye, I do not belong to the body,” it would not for that reason stop being part of the body.

source: Tipumpi abonchan mit hisohkei tale, hoija khojahna umta dingham? Tipumpi khojahna hisohkeile hoija gimnam jahna umta dingham?
target: If the whole body were an eye, where would the sense of hearing be? If the whole body were an ear, where would the sense of smell be?

source: Ahinla Pathen'in tibah chengse hi, alung deilam cheh-a tipuma akoi ahi.
target: But in fact God has placed the parts in the body, every one of them, just as he wanted them to be.

source: Chule aboncha hin tibah khatseh hitale, tipum hoija umtantem?
target: If they were all one part, where would the body be?

source: Tun vang tibah tamtah, ahivangin tipum khatsehbou ahi.
target: As it is, there are many parts, but one body.

source: Chule mit hin khut jah-a, Imacha kangaichatna na-umpoi, ti theilou ahi; luchangin jong kengteni jah-a, Imacha kangaichatna naum lhonpoi, ti thei lou ahi.
target: The eye cannot say to the hand, “I don’t need you!” And the head cannot say to the feet, “I don’t need you!”

source: Titah sangin, tibah hatmoa kigel chengse hi, akhohpena pang cheh ahi.
target: On the contrary, those parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable,

source: Chule nahsahmo-a igelu tibah ho chengse hi gamchengin ijabolun; chule itibah hoilouho chengse hi gamchengin ahoijoji tai.
target: and the parts that we think are less honorable we treat with special honor. And the parts that are unpresentable are treated with special modesty,

source: Chule itibah hoiho chengseu hin hicheng chu angaipoi, ahinla Pathen'in tipum hi asuhto khoma alhing lou alhasama chu gamchenga jabola aumsah ahi;
target: while our presentable parts need no special treatment. But God has put the body together, giving greater honor to the parts that lacked it,

source: Hitia chu tipum sunga hi akitumkhen um louhela, kitumkhen tah sanga tibah ho chengse hi thakhat tah-a akikhohsah to sohkei dingjoh ahi.
target: so that there should be no division in the body, but that its parts should have equal concern for each other.

source: Chutia chu tibah khatnin athohgima ahile, tibah dang chengsen jong athoh gimpi jiu ahi; chule tibah khat choi-at achanle, tibah dang chengsen akipapi jiu ahi.
target: If one part suffers, every part suffers with it; if one part is honored, every part rejoices with it.

source: Nangho Christa tipum nahiuvin, mi khat khat chu atibah khat cheh nahiuve.
target: Now you are the body of Christ, and each one of you is a part of it.

source: Chule Pathen'in houbung-ah amasatah-a solchah ho, anina themgaoho, athumna thuhil ho, abana bolmo kidang bolthei, chua mi damsah theina thilpeh, kithopina, vaipohna, chule paochom paochom thona apeh ahi.
target: And God has placed in the church first of all apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracles, then gifts of healing, of helping, of guidance, and of different kinds of tongues.

source: Aboncha solchah hiuvam? Aboncha themgao hiuvam? Aboncha thuhil hiuvam? Aboncha bolmo kidang bola hiuvam?
target: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?

source: Abonchauva midamsah thilpeh chang hiuvam? Abonchauva paochom tho hiuvam? Abonchauva pao hilchena pang uvam?
target: Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret?

source: Ahin thilpeh pha chungnung deho chana dingin kihabolun. Chule akalvala pha chungnung lampi kavetsah ding nahiuve.
target: Now eagerly desire the greater gifts. And yet I will show you the most excellent way.

source: Keiman mihemho paole vantil ho paovin thu sei jeng jongleng, ngailutna kanei loule, sum-eng kivogingle khutbeh kibeng bangbou kahi ding ahi.
target: If I speak in the tongues of men or of angels, but do not have love, I am only a resounding gong or a clanging cymbal.

source: Lhagao thu seidoh theina thilpeh neijingting, thugil jouse hettohna le hetna jouse nei jongleng, chule mol tolmang theina tahsan nei jongleng, ngailutna kanei loule imacha kahilou ahi.
target: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have a faith that can move mountains, but do not have love, I am nothing.

source: Chule mivaicha gentheiho vahna dingin kanei jouse toh jeng jongleng, govam jeng dingin katahsa pumpi toh jeng jongleng, ngailutna kanei loule imacha phatchomna aumpoi.
target: If I give all I possess to the poor and give over my body to hardship that I may boast, but do not have love, I gain nothing.

source: Ngailutna hin ni sottah athohjin, he jong ahepin ahi; ngailutna hin thangset abolpoi; ngailutna hin kichang vahchoi abolpoi, hoi jong ahoithopoi,
target: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.

source: Nunset abolpoi, amachang phatchomna abolpoi, alungsa baipoi, setna agelpoi;
target: It does not dishonor others, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no record of wrongs.

source: Chonsetna kipah louhelin thutah akipapiji;
target: Love does not delight in evil but rejoices with the truth.

source: Ima jouse-a athoh hatnin, imajouse atahsanin, imajousea akinemin, imajouse athoh hatjin ahi.
target: It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres.

source: Ngailutna hi imatih chana mangthah lou ding ahi; lhagao thu seidoh vang chu mangthah ding ahi; paochom het jong chu mang ding ahi; hetthemna jong chu mang ding ahi.
target: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be stilled; where there is knowledge, it will pass away.

source: Ijeh-inem itile eihon kim louva ihetnu ahin, kim louma lhagao thu iseidohjiu ahi.
target: For we know in part and we prophesy in part,

source: Abulhing chamkim ahung tengle, akim lou chengse hi kisubeisoh ding ahitai.
target: but when completeness comes, what is in part disappears.

source: Kachapan laijin chapang paovin kapaojin, chapang lunggelin kageljin, chapang thu ngaiton kangaiton ahi; kakhanlhit phat vangin chapang thu jouse chu kapailhatai.
target: When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I put the ways of childhood behind me.

source: Ijeh-inem itile tu-a hi eihon phatvet sunga kichen louva imu-u ahi; chuteng vangle kimaito-a imu dingu ahi. Tunvang kahet akimpoi, chuteng vangle eihet kimsoh banga hi kahet kimsoh ding ahi.
target: For now we see only a reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.

source: Tun tahsan, kinep, ngailut hicheng thum hi aumin; ahin hicheng lah-a hin ngailut achungnung pene.
target: And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love.

source: Ngailut chu delun; ahin lhagaolam thilpehho chengse chan ding ponpanun, adeh setnin lhagao thu naseidoh theina dingun.
target: Follow the way of love and eagerly desire gifts of the Spirit, especially prophecy.

source: Paochom dangkhat tho-a thuseija chu mi jah-a seidoh hilouva, Pathen jah-a seijoh ahi; ajeh chu koiman ahetpehpoi, ahinla aman lhagaova thugil chengse chu asei ahi.
target: For anyone who speaks in a tongue does not speak to people but to God. Indeed, no one understands them; they utter mysteries by the Spirit.

source: Lhagao thu seidoh vang chun miho khan tousah nale, tilkhouna, chule lungmon sahna thu asei ahi.
target: But the one who prophesies speaks to people for their strengthening, encouraging and comfort.

source: Paochom dangkhat tho-a thuseija vang chu ama changa khantouna-a anei ahi; lhagao thu seidoh vang chun houbung chu akhantou sah ahi.
target: Anyone who speaks in a tongue edifies themselves, but the one who prophesies edifies the church.

source: Nanghon nabon chaovin paochomin thu seileu chun kalung ahi; ahivangin chusang jong chun lhagao thu seidohleu chun kalung ahijoi; chule paochom tho-a thuseija chun houbung khantou sahna dinga, athusei chu aledoh louva ahile, chusanga chu lhagao thu seidoh chu chungnungjo ahi.
target: I would like every one of you to speak in tongues, but I would rather have you prophesy. The one who prophesies is greater than the one who speaks in tongues, unless someone interprets, so that the church may be edified.

source: Tun, sopite, keiman naheng uvah hunging ting paochom hung tholeng; thu phondoh ahim, hetna ahim, lhagao thu seidoh ahim, thuhilna lam ahim, kasei loule ipi phatchomna nanei ding uham?
target: Now, brothers and sisters, if I come to you and speak in tongues, what good will I be to you, unless I bring you some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or word of instruction?

source: Thil gingthei lah jenga jong kuli ahim, selangdah ahim, aginteng a-aw akikhel loule; kuli ahi, selangdah ahi kon ahetkhen dingham?
target: Even in the case of lifeless things that make sounds, such as the pipe or harp, how will anyone know what tune is being played unless there is a distinction in the notes?

source: Ahiloule sumkon gin akichet loule, koiham gal kon dinga kigothei dinga?
target: Again, if the trumpet does not sound a clear call, who will get ready for battle?

source: Chutobangma chun nanghon mihet bai ding pao natho louvule, ipi naseiju ahi iti kihet dingham? Nangho huijah-a thu sei tobang nahiu ahi.
target: So it is with you. Unless you speak intelligible words with your tongue, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.

source: Ija kihem, vannoi'a hin paochom paochom tamtah aume, ahivangin ikhat kiseina hilou khatcha jong aumpoi.
target: Undoubtedly there are all sorts of languages in the world, yet none of them is without meaning.

source: Chuti ahijeh chun chuche pao chu ipi kiseina ahi kahet louva ahile, athusei ngaija keima chu ama dinga paomah kahiding, thuseipa jongchu keima dinga paomah tobang hiding ahi.
target: If then I do not grasp the meaning of what someone is saying, I am a foreigner to the speaker, and the speaker is a foreigner to me.

source: Chuti chun nangho jong, lhagao thilpeh chan chom chom nei ding naha lunggulu ahin, hichu houbung in khantou na-a aneina dingin aletsetna nanei theina dingun holun.
target: So it is with you. Since you are eager for gifts of the Spirit, try to excel in those that build up the church.

source: Hiche jeh chun paochom tho-a chun athu jong ale theina dingin taohen.
target: For this reason the one who speaks in a tongue should pray that they may interpret what they say.

source: Paochomin taoleng, kalhagao chu taova ahinan, ahinla kahetna hin ga aso jipon ahi.
target: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.

source: Chuti ahile apipen iham? Keima lhagaovin taovingting, hetna-a jong taovinge; lhagaovin jong la sangting hetna-in jong la sange.
target: So what shall I do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my understanding; I will sing with my spirit, but I will also sing with my understanding.

source: Achuti loule nangman lhagaovin thangvahna seile chun, amuna tou ima he loulaiho chun nathang vahna chu, Amen, iti ati thei dingham? Nathusei chengla he louva?
target: Otherwise when you are praising God in the Spirit, how can someone else, who is now put in the position of an inquirer, say “Amen” to your thanksgiving, since they do not know what you are saying?

source: Nangma vang chun phate tah-a thangvahna nanei ahin, ahivangin midang akhantou sahpoi.
target: You are giving thanks well enough, but no one else is edified.

source: Nangho nabonchao sanga paochoma thu kasei tamjoh jeh hin, Pathen kathangvah-e;
target: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.

source: Ahivangin houbung sunga midangho kahil theina dingin, paochoma thu cheng sangsom kasei sangin, hetna-a thu cheng nga seidoh ding kadeijoi.
target: But in the church I would rather speak five intelligible words to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue.

source: Sopite, nangho hetna-a chapang hihih-un; amavang nunsetna lama chapang hiuvinlang, hetna lama pilhingun.
target: Brothers and sisters, stop thinking like children. In regard to evil be infants, but in your thinking be adults.

source: Dan lekhabua hitin akisune, keiman hetphah lou paochom thohole gamdang miho kama, hiche mite jah-a hi thu kasei ding ahi, hiti chun bol jongleng amahon kathu angaideh lou dingu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: In the Law it is written: “With other tongues and through the lips of foreigners I will speak to this people, but even then they will not listen to me, says the Lord.”

source: Hiche jeh chun paochom tho hi atahsan dinga hilouvin, atahsan louho dinga melchihna ahi; lhagao thu seidoh ho vang chu atahsan louho dinga hilouvin, atahsanho dinga melchihna ahi.
target: Tongues, then, are a sign, not for believers but for unbelievers; prophecy, however, is not for unbelievers but for believers.

source: Hiche jeh chun houbung chengse kikhom henlang, chule ami takipmin paochom thohen, chu-a chun mi maimaile tahsanna neilouho khattou hung lutle, Nangho chu angola ahi, ati lou dinguham?
target: So if the whole church comes together and everyone speaks in tongues, and inquirers or unbelievers come in, will they not say that you are out of your mind?

source: Amavang nabonchaovin lhagao thu seidoh sohkeileu chun, atahsanlou ahim, milham ima helou khattou hung lutle, hichengpi chun asetna sosal intin, hichengpi chun oimo achan ding;
target: But if an unbeliever or an inquirer comes in while everyone is prophesying, they are convicted of sin and are brought under judgment by all,

source: Chule chutia chun alunggila thuguh jouse chu kiphong doh sohkei ding; chule chutia chu akhupbo-a lhu-a Pathen ahou ding, nangho lah-a Pathen aum chu aphonjal ding ahi.
target: as the secrets of their hearts are laid bare. So they will fall down and worship God, exclaiming, “God is really among you!”

source: Achutile, sopite, iti danham? Nangho nakikhop tengule khat cheh-in la ahim, thuhil ahim, thuphondoh khat ahim, paochom tho ahim, chule khatnin athu aledoh ding nanei chehjiove. Hitiho jouse chu khantouna dinga kibol hihen.
target: What then shall we say, brothers and sisters? When you come together, each of you has a hymn, or a word of instruction, a revelation, a tongue or an interpretation. Everything must be done so that the church may be built up.

source: Khattouvin paochoma thu aseija ahile, ni hijongle atampena thumin, kilhah lhah-in seijuhen, chule khatnin athu ledoh hen.
target: If anyone speaks in a tongue, two—or at the most three—should speak, one at a time, and someone must interpret.

source: Athu ledoh ding aum lou vangle, ama chu houbung'a thipbeh chan umhen, ama chang jahle Pathen jah ding maijin thu seihen.
target: If there is no interpreter, the speaker should keep quiet in the church and speak to himself and to God.

source: Lhagao thu seidoh nile thumin thu seihen, chule adang chengse ngaitohen;
target: Two or three prophets should speak, and the others should weigh carefully what is said.

source: Ahivangin akoma touho khatpen pen henga thu kiphong aumle, amasapa chu umthim hen.
target: And if a revelation comes to someone who is sitting down, the first speaker should stop.

source: Ijeh-inem itile mi jouse athep theina dingle mi jouse alungmon theina dinga, khatchenga kilha kilha-a lhagao thu naseidoh theiju ahi.
target: For you can all prophesy in turn so that everyone may be instructed and encouraged.

source: Themgaoho lhagao chu themgaohobou thua nung ahi.
target: The spirits of prophets are subject to the control of prophets.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Pathen chu thunoh lungjin kona ahipoi, mithengte houbung ho jouse-a ahi banga, lungmon kona ahibouve.
target: For God is not a God of disorder but of peace—as in all the congregations of the Lord’s people.

source: Na numei hou chu houbung kikhop na-ah thipbeh chan umthim uhen; ijeh-inem itile amaho chu thusei kipe-a ahipouve, chusang chun danthua kisei bangin, thu noija umuhen.
target: Women should remain silent in the churches. They are not allowed to speak, but must be in submission, as the law says.

source: Amahon ikhat het nom aneijule, a-inmun uvah ajite cheh kidoh uhen, ajeh chu houbung kikhopna-a numei dinga thusei hi jachat umtah ahi.
target: If they want to inquire about something, they should ask their own husbands at home; for it is disgraceful for a woman to speak in the church.

source: Iham? Pathen thuhi nangho-a kona hung sohdoh ham? Ahiloule nangho changseh heng jengabou hungaham?
target: Or did the word of God originate with you? Or are you the only people it has reached?

source: Khattou ama themgaova akingaitoa ahiloule lhagao mi-a kingaito aumle, naheng uva kalekhasut chengse chu Pakai thupeh ahi ti hehen.
target: If anyone thinks they are a prophet or otherwise gifted by the Spirit, let them acknowledge that what I am writing to you is the Lord’s command.

source: Amavang khattouvin ahet loutah-a ahile, ahe louvin um jenghen.
target: But if anyone ignores this, they will themselves be ignored.

source: Hiche jeh chun, kasopite, Pathen lhagao thu seidoh guttenin ponpanun, paochoma thusei jong kham hih-un.
target: Therefore, my brothers and sisters, be eager to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.

source: Amavang imajouse hoitahle kituptah-in bolcheh-un.
target: But everything should be done in a fitting and orderly way.

source: Vo sopite, kahetsah nahiuve, najah uva kalhangsap Kipana Thupha chu san jong nasanu ahitan, chujongle hia chu nadinu ahitai;
target: Now, brothers and sisters, I want to remind you of the gospel I preached to you, which you received and on which you have taken your stand.

source: Najah uva kathu lhangsap chu nachin jingule, hichea chu huhhing-a um nahitaove; chuti ahi lou vangle natahsanu chu moh ahi.
target: By this gospel you are saved, if you hold firmly to the word I preached to you. Otherwise, you have believed in vain.

source: Ajeh chu amasapena Pathen lekhabu dungjuija eiho chonset jala Christa thia ahitai, ti thuhil pipen kamu chu nangho kapehdoh ahitai;
target: For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

source: Chule ama avuijun, ani thumnin Pathen lekhabua kisei dungjuijin athoudoh kittan ahi.
target: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

source: Chuin ama Cephas henga akilah masapenin, chuin somleni ho henga.
target: and that he appeared to Cephas, and then to the Twelve.

source: Chujouvin mi janga valjen sopiteho henga khatvei lah-in akilah-in ahi; amaho atamjo tu gei hin aum nalaijui, akimkhat vang a-imu taove.
target: After that, he appeared to more than five hundred of the brothers and sisters at the same time, most of whom are still living, though some have fallen asleep.

source: Chuin Jacob henga akilah-in, chujouvin solchah ho chengse henga akilah-in ahi.
target: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

source: Akhonna-in aphat louva peng tobang keima henga ahung kilah-in ahi.
target: and last of all he appeared to me also, as to one abnormally born.

source: Keima solchah ho lah-a alhumpen kahin, chule Pathen houbung kabolset jeh chun solchah min pu dinga jong kilom kahipoi.
target: For I am the least of the apostles and do not even deserve to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

source: Ahivangin Pathen lungset vangin kahibep chu kahinai; chule ama lungsetna eitona chu moh-in aumpoi, amaho chengse sangin katong gim jon ahi; ahivangin keima kahipoi eiumpia, Pathen lungsetna chu ahibouve.
target: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and his grace to me was not without effect. No, I worked harder than all of them—yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.

source: Ahinla keima kahin, amaho ahiuvin, hitia chu thupha chu samphong cheh kahiuvin, nanghon chutia chu natahsanu ahitai.
target: Whether, then, it is I or they, this is what we preach, and this is what you believed.

source: Ahin tu-a, Christa chu athi lah-a konin kaithouvin aumtai tia kilhangsama ahile, nalah uva mi kimkhat chun, athi thokit himhim aumpoi, iti nati uham?
target: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

source: Athi thokitna himhim aum loule, Christa jong chu kaithouva umlou hinte;
target: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised.

source: Chule Christa chu kaithouva umlou ahile, kathu hil lhangleu jong hi moh ahin, natahsanu jong moh ahi.
target: And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is useless and so is your faith.

source: Mithi thokitna umlou ahileh, keiho hi Pathen lama jouthu hettohsah-in kakilangui; ajehchu keihon Pathen'in akaithoulou Christa chu akaithouve tin, kahettoh sah-un ahi.
target: More than that, we are then found to be false witnesses about God, for we have testified about God that he raised Christ from the dead. But he did not raise him if in fact the dead are not raised.

source: Ijeh-inem itile mithi thoukit lou ahile, Christa jong chu thoukitlou ahi;
target: For if the dead are not raised, then Christ has not been raised either.

source: Christa chu thoukit lou ahile, nanghon natahsanu jong moh ahi; nangho tu-a jong chonsetna umjing nalai nahi dingu ahi;
target: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.

source: Chuti chu ahile Christa-a imu milteho chu amangthahgam ahitaove.
target: Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ are lost.

source: Tu hinlai sung ding jenga Christa chu kinepna ineiju ahile, mi jouse sanga khoto umpentah ihi dingu ahi.
target: If only for this life we have hope in Christ, we are of all people most to be pitied.

source: Ahivangin tun Christa chu a-imuho lah-a aga masapenin apangin, athiho lah-a konin athoudoh tan ahi.
target: But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.

source: Mihem'a kona thina aum jeh chun, Mihem'a kon maman thokitna aumtan ahi.
target: For since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead comes also through a man.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Adam'a mi jouse athi banga chu, Christa-a mi jouse hinsah-a umding ahi.
target: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.

source: Ahivangin, mijouse ama phatdol cheh-a umding ahi, Christa agamasa hintin, chu joule Christa ahung teng amite hidiu ahi.
target: But each in turn: Christ, the firstfruits; then, when he comes, those who belong to him.

source: Chujoutah chule kichai ding ahi; chutengle aman vaipoh, thuneina, thahatna jouse asuhmang sohkeija, Pa Pathen khutna gam apehdoh ding ahi.
target: Then the end will come, when he hands over the kingdom to God the Father after he has destroyed all dominion, authority and power.

source: Aman agalte jouse akengto noija akoi masangse-a, aman vai apoh ding ahi.
target: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

source: Gal nukhah pen thina ahi, hi jong chu asuhmang ding ahi.
target: The last enemy to be destroyed is death.

source: Ajeh chu aman, imajouse akengto noija akoi ahitai. Ahin, imajouse athu noijah akoije, atia hin, athu noija koipa chu chucheho lah-a chu kisimthalou ahi, ti kichenin akilange.
target: For he “has put everything under his feet.” Now when it says that “everything” has been put under him, it is clear that this does not include God himself, who put everything under Christ.

source: Imajouse ama thu noija aum phat chule, Pathen chu ijakaija ijakai ahi theina dinga, ijakai athu noija umsahpa thu noija chu Chapa jong umding ahi.
target: When he has done this, then the Son himself will be made subject to him who put everything under him, so that God may be all in all.

source: Chutobang chu ahiloule athiho dinga baptize changho iti taovintem? Athiho kaithouva aum louhel uva ahile, chuteho chu amaho dinga ibola baptize changji hiuvintem?
target: Now if there is no resurrection, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized for them?

source: Chule keiho jeng jong ibola nidan takipma settoh-a kaum jinguham?
target: And as for us, why do we endanger ourselves every hour?

source: Sopite, Pakai Jesu Christa-a nangho chungchanga kakisonna kapatna kanela kasei ahi, keima niseh-in kathi jinge.
target: I face death every day—yes, just as surely as I boast about you in Christ Jesus our Lord.

source: Keiman mihem ngai banga Ephesia gamsaho toh kisat kahile, phat chomna-a kanei dingham? Athiho kaithouva aum loule, hungun, neuhite donuhite; jingle kithita dingan.
target: If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus with no more than human hopes, what have I gained? If the dead are not raised, “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

source: Lheplhah-in um hih-un: kivoppi phalouvin mi nunphat asusen ahi.
target: Do not be misled: “Bad company corrupts good character.”

source: Chonphatna lama khangun lang, chonse hih-un; ijeh-inem itile abang khat Pathen hetna nei lou ahi. Hiche hi jahcha naovin nate tia kasei ahi.
target: Come back to your senses as you ought, and stop sinning; for there are some who are ignorant of God—I say this to your shame.

source: Ahin mi khat touvin, Athiho kaithouva iti umham? Itobang tahsa vou po-a hungji aham, tinte.
target: But someone will ask, “How are the dead raised? With what kind of body will they come?”

source: Vo lungthimbei, nangman muchi natu chu athi loule akehpoi;
target: How foolish! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.

source: Khonunga akung abah ahung umding chu nangma tu ahipoi; kolbu hihen, chang dang hijongle, nangman achangbou natu ahi.
target: When you sow, you do not plant the body that will be, but just a seed, perhaps of wheat or of something else.

source: Pathen'in alung chama tahsa apeh ahibouve; achang takip chu ama dol cheh tahsa apehji ahi.
target: But God gives it a body as he has determined, and to each kind of seed he gives its own body.

source: Amavang sa jouse akithakhat poi, mi-a hihen, sa-a hijongle, vachale nga-a hijongle, got chomcheh ahi.
target: Not all flesh is the same: People have one kind of flesh, animals have another, birds another and fish another.

source: Van vou aumin, leiset vou jong aume; ahivangin van tipum loupina achom ahin, leiset vou loupina achom ahi.
target: There are also heavenly bodies and there are earthly bodies; but the splendor of the heavenly bodies is one kind, and the splendor of the earthly bodies is another.

source: Nisa loupina achom ahin, lhathah loupina achom ahi; chule ahsi loupina jong achom ahi, ahsi le ahsi jong aloupina achom chom ahi.
target: The sun has one kind of splendor, the moon another and the stars another; and star differs from star in splendor.

source: Chutobangma chu athiho thokit jong hi ding ahi. Monmang theija kitu-a ahin, monmang thei louva kikaithou ahi;
target: So will it be with the resurrection of the dead. The body that is sown is perishable, it is raised imperishable;

source: Manmo-a kitu-a ahin, loupia kikaithou ahi, hatmoa kitu-a ahin, thahat tah-a kikaithou ahi;
target: it is sown in dishonor, it is raised in glory; it is sown in weakness, it is raised in power;

source: Tahsa vou kitu-a ahin, lhagao vou kikaithou ahi. Tahsa vou uma, lhagao vou jong uma ahi.
target: it is sown a natural body, it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.

source: Chule hitihin akisune, mi masa Adam chu mi hing anahi; Adam nunung joh vang chu hinna pe-a lhagao ahi.
target: So it is written: “The first man Adam became a living being”; the last Adam, a life-giving spirit.

source: Ahivangin lhagao lam chu amasajopoi, mihing joh chubou aum masai; chujouvin bou lhagao lam chu aume.
target: The spiritual did not come first, but the natural, and after that the spiritual.

source: Mihem masa chu leija kisem leija kon ahin, mihem nina vang chu van'a hungkon Pakai ahi.
target: The first man was of the dust of the earth; the second man is of heaven.

source: Leija kisem mite jong hi leija kisem mipa chutoh bang cheh ahi; van mite chu van'a Pa tobang cheh ahiuve.
target: As was the earthly man, so are those who are of the earth; and as is the heavenly man, so also are those who are of heaven.

source: Chule leija kisempa lim ilo banguva chu, van'a Pa lim jong ilo dingu ahi.
target: And just as we have borne the image of the earthly man, so shall we bear the image of the heavenly man.

source: Ahivangin, sopite, Tahsale thisan hin Pathen lenggam alo theipoi, monmang thei hin monmang thei lou chu alo theipoi, tia kasei ahi.
target: I declare to you, brothers and sisters, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God, nor does the perishable inherit the imperishable.

source: Veuvin, keiman nangho thugil khat kaseipeh nahiuve, ibon chaova ina-imut lou dingu ahi;
target: Listen, I tell you a mystery: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed—

source: Ahinla sumkon gin nunung pena chu, hai khat sunga, mitphet kah louva, ibon chaova ikikhel sohkei dingu ahi; ajeh chu sumkon hung ging ding, chule athiho chu monmang thei louva kaithouva umding, chule eiho ikikhel dingu ahi.
target: in a flash, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.

source: Ijeh-inem itile hiche monmang thei hin monmang thei lou chu akivona, thi thei hin thi thei lou chu akivon ding ahi.
target: For the perishable must clothe itself with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality.

source: Chutia chu monmang theijin monmang thei lou chu akivona, thi theijin thi thei lou chu akivon tengtah chule, jona-in thina chu aval lhumtai, tia kisun thu chu guilhung ding ahi.
target: When the perishable has been clothed with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality, then the saying that is written will come true: “Death has been swallowed up in victory.”

source: Vo thina, namidena hoiham? Vo lhankhuh, na jona hoiham?
target: “Where, O death, is your victory? Where, O death, is your sting?”

source: Thina mide-na chu chonset ahi, chonset thaneina chu dan thupeh ahi.
target: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

source: Ahinla I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa vanga jona eipeuva Pathen chu thangvah-in umhen.
target: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

source: Hijeh chun, sopi deitahte, dettah-in suhlong hoi hilouhelin pangun, gunchu tah-in Pakai na tong jingun; natohgimnao chu Pakaiya moh ahipoi ti naheuve.
target: Therefore, my dear brothers and sisters, stand firm. Let nothing move you. Always give yourselves fully to the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.

source: Chule mithengte dinga tolom thudol vang chu, Galatia houbung ho thu kapeh bang chun, nanghon jong bolun.
target: Now about the collection for the Lord’s people: Do what I told the Galatian churches to do.

source: Chule kahung teng tolom donna aumlouna dingin, hapta nimasa ni leh Pathen'in phatthei aboh dungjuijin, amitakipmin atojoukham chehi-in dong khomun, anakhol khomun.
target: On the first day of every week, each one of you should set aside a sum of money in keeping with your income, saving it up, so that when I come no collections will have to be made.

source: Keima kahung phatle, koihijeng jongle pha nasah penpenu chu nathilpeh hou gathah dingin, nalekha thot utoh Jerusalem'ah solnange.
target: Then, when I arrive, I will give letters of introduction to the men you approve and send them with your gift to Jerusalem.

source: Keima chea alom jongle, amaho chu keitoh lhonnao vinge.
target: If it seems advisable for me to go also, they will accompany me.

source: Chule Macedonia kachotsoh phatle, naheng uva hung ding kahi; ajeh chu Macedonia gam chonle ding kigo-a kahi.
target: After I go through Macedonia, I will come to you—for I will be going through Macedonia.

source: Kachena channa neithah le thei na diuva naheng uva phat chomkhat kacham ding, ijem itile phalbi sungse-a bon kacham den ding ahi.
target: Perhaps I will stay with you for a while, or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey, wherever I go.

source: Tu chunga palama kimuto kanompoi; Pakai phatsah ahile, nangho koma chomkhat chamleng ti kakineme.
target: For I do not want to see you now and make only a passing visit; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.

source: Ahivangin Pentecost geijin Ephesia kho-a hin chaming kate.
target: But I will stay on at Ephesus until Pentecost,

source: Ajeh chu kadingin kot lentah toh machal theina tah akihonge, chule eidouva atame.
target: because a great door for effective work has opened to me, and there are many who oppose me.

source: Chule Timothy chu ahunga ahile, kicha louhela nalah uva aum theina ding ana ngaito uvin; ajeh chu ama keima toh bang banga Pakai na tonga ahi;
target: When Timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is carrying on the work of the Lord, just as I am.

source: Hijeh chun koiman nahsahmon bol hihhen. Kaheng ahung lhun theina dingin, achena-a lungmonga avalena dingin thahleuvin; ijeh-inem itile sopite toh ahungna ding lam kat jinga um kahiuve.
target: No one, then, should treat him with contempt. Send him on his way in peace so that he may return to me. I am expecting him along with the brothers.

source: Chule sopi Apollos thu vang chu, sopite toh kilhona naheng uva hung dinga katem jing ahi; ahin tupettah-a hung ding vang anompoi, ahivangin ahung thei phat phatle hung ding ahi.
target: Now about our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to go to you with the brothers. He was quite unwilling to go now, but he will go when he has the opportunity.

source: Kihongun, tahsanna-a dingdet jingun, pasal pha bangtah-in pangun hatnun.
target: Be on your guard; stand firm in the faith; be courageous; be strong.

source: Nabol jouseu chu ngailutna-a kibol hihen.
target: Do everything in love.

source: Sopiteho, Stephanas inkote sung hi Achaia gama Pathen thua ga masapen ahiuvin, mithengte jennan akipeuvin ahi, ti naheuve;
target: You know that the household of Stephanas were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the Lord’s people. I urge you, brothers and sisters,

source: Nangho jong hitobangho le keiho natoh huna-a tong gimho chengse thu noija umun, tia naheng uva katao ahi.
target: to submit to such people and to everyone who joins in the work and labors at it.

source: Stephanas, Fortunatus, chule Achaicus teho hilama ahungu hi kakipah lheh jenge; ajeh chu amahon nangho lhinlelna chu asubulhit taovin ahi.
target: I was glad when Stephanas, Fortunatus and Achaicus arrived, because they have supplied what was lacking from you.

source: Amahon keima lung jong, nangho lung jong akidosah ahi. Hitobang mite hi hethemuvin.
target: For they refreshed my spirit and yours also. Such men deserve recognition.

source: Asia gama houbung hon salam naboh-ui, Aquila le Priscilla le a-in lhona kikhom chengsen Pakaiya salam tamtah naboh-uve.
target: The churches in the province of Asia send you greetings. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, and so does the church that meets at their house.

source: Sopite jousen Salam naboh-uve. Kichop thengin khat le khat kisalam to cheh-un.
target: All the brothers and sisters here send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

source: Kasalam bohna hiche hi keima Paul'in kakhut tah-a kasut ahi.
target: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand.

source: Khattou Pakai Jesu Christa ngailu lou aumle, ama chu Anathema hihen, Maranatha .
target: If anyone does not love the Lord, let that person be cursed! Come, Lord!

source: Pakai Jesu Christa lungsetna chun umpiuvin.
target: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.

source: Jesu Christa-a kangailut nao chu nabon chaova chunga umhen. Amen.
target: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

source: Pathen lungcham tah-a Jesu Christa solchah-a pang Paul leh, sopi Timothy'in Corinth-a um Pathen houbung te, chule Achaia gam sunga um mithengte jouse henga,
target: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, To the church of God in Corinth, together with all his holy people throughout Achaia:

source: i-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa-a konin, lungsetnale lungmonna chun umpiuvin.
target: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

source: Pathen, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Pa chu vahchoijin umhen, Ama lungsetnaho Pa leh lungmonna jouse Pathen ahi.
target: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,

source: Keihon Pathen'a kona lungmonna kaneiju, hiche lungmon na-a chu hesoh gentheija umteho kalungmonsah theina dingun, hesoh gentheina lah-a jong aman eilung monsah jingjiuve.
target: who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves receive from God.

source: Ajehchu Christa thohgimna chengse keiho-a adimset bangin, Christa vangin lungmon na-a kadimset jingui.
target: For just as we share abundantly in the sufferings of Christ, so also our comfort abounds through Christ.

source: Ahin keihon hesoh genthei kathoh-u aumle, hichu nangho lungmonna dingle huhhing-a naumna dingu ahi; lungmonga kaumu jongle, hichu nangho lungmonna dingle huhhing-a naumna dingu ahi; hichu keiho thohjiho tobang hesoh gentheina lungneng tah-a nathoh naova kona nahetdoh-u ahi.
target: If we are distressed, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you patient endurance of the same sufferings we suffer.

source: Chule nanghon hesoh genthei thohna lama chan naneiju banga, lungmonna lama jong chan nanei jingu chu kahen, kakineppi nau adet jinge.
target: And our hope for you is firm, because we know that just as you share in our sufferings, so also you share in our comfort.

source: Sopite, Asia gama kachunguva hesoh genthei chua chu nahet lou dingu kanompoi, thohjouhoi hilou kathauvin ajo kalvalin nasatah-a eidelpha jengu ahin, hing dinga jong kakihol louvu ahitan ahi.
target: We do not want you to be uninformed, brothers and sisters, about the troubles we experienced in the province of Asia. We were under great pressure, far beyond our ability to endure, so that we despaired of life itself.

source: Ahin keihon kalung sungun, keihole keiho-a kitahsan louva athiho kaithouva Pathen chu katahsan johna dingun, kathina dingu ahung lhunge, katiu ahitai.
target: Indeed, we felt we had received the sentence of death. But this happened that we might not rely on ourselves but on God, who raises the dead.

source: Ama chun chutobanga len thina-a kona chu eina huhdoh-u ahin, chujongle eihuhdoh dingu ahi; ama chun tu-a jong eihuhdoh dingu ahinalaije, tia ama-a chu kakinepnao phutdet kahiuve.
target: He has delivered us from such a deadly peril, and he will deliver us again. On him we have set our hope that he will continue to deliver us,

source: Mi tamtah vanga lungsetna thilpeh eikipeh jeh uva hi, mi tamtah-in keiho chungchanga athangvah theina dinga, nangho jong nataonaova eikithopia nahiuve.
target: as you help us by your prayers. Then many will give thanks on our behalf for the gracious favor granted us in answer to the prayers of many.

source: Ijeh-inem itile kakisonnao chu hiche hi ahi, kalung sunguva ase apha hetnan eihettohsah-u chu, vannoi mite hengah, chule atamjo cheh-a nangho lamah, tahsaphe lam chihna hilouva, Pathen lungset vanga Pathen thenna le kitahna-a kanachon jingu ahi.
target: Now this is our boast: Our conscience testifies that we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially in our relations with you, with integrity and godly sincerity. We have done so, relying not on worldly wisdom but on God’s grace.

source: Nanghon sim jong nasim uva, het jong nahetchet sao thu tailou chu keihon nangho henga thu dang ima kasunpouve. Chule akhon ni geijin heuvin nate tin kakineme.
target: For we do not write you anything you cannot read or understand. And I hope that,

source: Nanghon keiho neihet phot thimu banga chu, Pakai Jesu nikho nileh nangho kisonna ding keiho kahiu banga, nangho jong keiho keisonna ding nahiuve.
target: as you have understood us in part, you will come to understand fully that you can boast of us just as we will boast of you in the day of the Lord Jesus.

source: Chule hiche tahsanna-a hi, nivei phatchomna nanei theina dinguvin, nangho henga hung masaleng kati ahi;
target: Because I was confident of this, I wanted to visit you first so that you might benefit twice.

source: Macedonia kacheteng nangho kom hin hopangting, Macedonia'a konin nangho henga hungkit ingting, chule nanghon Juda gam lama neithah leuchun kati.
target: I wanted to visit you on my way to Macedonia and to come back to you from Macedonia, and then to have you send me on my way to Judea.

source: Hijeh-a chu, hitia lung kaput hi, thil neocha dana kalahham? ahiloule kalunggot chengse hi, tahsaphe dungjuija, ahile ahi, ahi loule ahilou, tia kahim?
target: Was I fickle when I intended to do this? Or do I make my plans in a worldly manner so that in the same breath I say both “Yes, yes” and “No, no”?

source: Ahinla Pathen athutah bangin, nangho lama kathu-u chu, ahile ahi, ahi loule ahilou, ahipoi.
target: But as surely as God is faithful, our message to you is not “Yes” and “No.”

source: Ajeh iham itile nalah uva keihon, keimatah le Silvanus chule Timothy'n, kalhangsap leu Pathen Chapa Jesu Christa-a chun, ahi leh ahilou, aumpoi, ama-a chun Ahi aumbouve.
target: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me and Silas and Timothy—was not “Yes” and “No,” but in him it has always been “Yes.”

source: Ajeh chu Pathen thutep jouse chu Ama-a chu Ahi chu uma ahi; hijeh-a chu keiho-a kona Pathen loupina dinga, ama vanga Amen hijia ahi.
target: For no matter how many promises God has made, they are “Yes” in Christ. And so through him the “Amen” is spoken by us to the glory of God.

source: Chule Christa-a nang hotoh eiphutdoh, chule thao einua chu Pathen ahi.
target: Now it is God who makes both us and you stand firm in Christ. He anointed us,

source: Ama chun namdet einam khumuva, chule ilung sunguva Lhagao khamgah na-a eipeh-u ahi.
target: set his seal of ownership on us, and put his Spirit in our hearts as a deposit, guaranteeing what is to come.

source: Nangho hoidohna dinga tu geija Corinth-a hung louva kahitai, hiche thua hin kahinna chunga ahetoh dingin Pathen kakouvin ahi.
target: I call God as my witness—and I stake my life on it—that it was in order to spare you that I did not return to Corinth.

source: Keiho nangho tahsanna chunga vaipo-a kahipouve, nakipanao chu hujoa kahibovui. Ijeh-inem itile nangho tahsana-a nading detnaove.
target: Not that we lord it over your faith, but we work with you for your joy, because it is by faith you stand firm.

source: Ahin keima changtumin hiti hin kangaitoi, tukallin lungphamon naheng uva hungtaponge.
target: So I made up my mind that I would not make another painful visit to you.

source: Ajeh chu keiman nangho lung phatmo sahleng, kalung phatmo sahte tailou chu keima eikipasah dinga koiham?
target: For if I grieve you, who is left to make me glad but you whom I have grieved?

source: Keima kipana-a nangho kipah uvin nate ti kagingchan, eikipasah dingho chengse chun kahungteng eilung phatmosah khante tia, hiche thu chu kahinsut ahitai.
target: I wrote as I did, so that when I came I would not be distressed by those who should have made me rejoice. I had confidence in all of you, that you would all share my joy.

source: Chule nalung phatmona dinguva hilouvin, keiman nangho kangailut jeu hi nahetdohna dinguva, lunghesoh, lungkham chule mitlhi tamtah puma hiche thu chu kahinsut ahi.
target: For I wrote you out of great distress and anguish of heart and with many tears, not to grieve you but to let you know the depth of my love for you.

source: Ahinla, lung phatmo sah-a mi khattou auma ahile, keima eilung phatmosah ahipoi, kahabol khoh behseh louna dinguva, ichanham khatna nabon uva nalung phatmo sah-u ahi.
target: If anyone has caused grief, he has not so much grieved me as he has grieved all of you to some extent—not to put it too severely.

source: Mi atamjoa kona chutobang mihemin talent amuchu, ama dinga phaset ahi.
target: The punishment inflicted on him by the majority is sufficient.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun nanghon nangaidam uva, nalungmonsah joh uva pha ahi; ajole chutobang mi chu lungphatmo behseh-in val lhum getninte.
target: Now instead, you ought to forgive and comfort him, so that he will not be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.

source: Hijeh-a chu naheng uva katao ahi, nanghon ama nangailut nao chu sudetnun.
target: I urge you, therefore, to reaffirm your love for him.

source: Nangho imalam jouse-a thungai nahiule, nahilouvu photchetna dinga jong kahinsut ahi.
target: Another reason I wrote you was to see if you would stand the test and be obedient in everything.

source: Nanghon nangaidamu chu keiman jong kangaidam ahi. Keiman kangaidam-a ahile, Christa maikoh-a nangho jala kangaidam ahi;
target: Anyone you forgive, I also forgive. And what I have forgiven—if there was anything to forgive—I have forgiven in the sight of Christ for your sake,

source: Hichu Satan'in ichunguva machalna thei agomkom atokhah louna ding ahi; ajeh chu eihon ama doha lungthim ihaiju ahipoi.
target: in order that Satan might not outwit us. For we are not unaware of his schemes.

source: Christa Kipana Thupha hila Troas'a kahunga, chule Pakaiyin keima dinga kot khat ahon chun,
target: Now when I went to Troas to preach the gospel of Christ and found that the Lord had opened a door for me,

source: Kasopi Titus chu kamudoh lou jeh-in, lung olna kaneipon ahi; ahin amaho-a konin kakilha doh-in, Macedonia gam lama kachetan ahi.
target: I still had no peace of mind, because I did not find my brother Titus there. So I said goodbye to them and went on to Macedonia.

source: Ahin a-imatih chana keiho Christa-a galjona-a eipuile jinguva, Pathen chu thangvah-in umjing hen; aman keiho eimangun ama hetna gimnam chu muntin-ah aphong jallen ahi.
target: But thanks be to God, who always leads us as captives in Christ’s triumphal procession and uses us to spread the aroma of the knowledge of him everywhere.

source: Huhhing-a umhole amangthahho dingin, Pathen lama Christa gimnamtui kahiuve;
target: For we are to God the pleasing aroma of Christ among those who are being saved and those who are perishing.

source: Loi khat dinga thina-a kona thina gimnam kahiuvin, loi khatte dingin hinna-a kona hinna gimnam kahiuve. Chule hicheng dinga lhinga koiham?
target: To the one we are an aroma that brings death; to the other, an aroma that brings life. And who is equal to such a task?

source: Mi tamtah-in Pathen thuhi miho doha bola sumkolveinan amang chaovin, keiho vang chutobang kahi pouve; kitahtah-a Pathen thupeh bangbanga, Christa-a Pathen mitmu-a thu kaseiju ahi.
target: Unlike so many, we do not peddle the word of God for profit. On the contrary, in Christ we speak before God with sincerity, as those sent from God.

source: Keiho kiseipha pan kit kahiuvem? Ahiloule midangho banga, nangho henga ahim, nangho-a kon ahima, seiphatna lekha ngaija kahiuvem?
target: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or do we need, like some people, letters of recommendation to you or from you?

source: Nanghotah chu kalung sunguva kisun kalekha thotnu, mi jouse het le sim nahiu ahi;
target: You yourselves are our letter, written on our hearts, known and read by everyone.

source: Nangho Christa lekha thot nahiuve, keiho lhacha natoh-a kon; lekha twija kisun hilouva, Pathen hing Lhagaova kisun; songphenga hilouva, lungthim tahsa phenga kisunjoh nahiuve ti kichentah-in akilange.
target: You show that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.

source: Chule Christa vanga Pathen lama hitobang tahsan hi kaneiju ahi.
target: Such confidence we have through Christ before God.

source: Hichehi keiho-a kona ahi ti dingin keiho chang kalhingjou pouve, kabulhinnao hi Pathen'a kon ahibouve;
target: Not that we are competent in ourselves to claim anything for ourselves, but our competence comes from God.

source: Amatah-in kitepna thah lhachale-a eibulhin sah-u ahi; lekhajem'a hilouvin lhagao kitepna lhachajoh ahi. Ajehchu lekha jem chun athatjin, lhagao vang chun ahinsahji ahi.
target: He has made us competent as ministers of a new covenant—not of the letter but of the Spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

source: Ahin thina lhacha-a panna, songa kikhena kisun jengbon chubang tah-a chu aloupi-a, avah kemsuhsuh ding Mosi mai chu avahpempum jeh-a Israel chatehon hoitah-a avet thei lou uva ahileh;
target: Now if the ministry that brought death, which was engraved in letters on stone, came with glory, so that the Israelites could not look steadily at the face of Moses because of its glory, transitory though it was,

source: Achutile Lhagao lhacha natoh chu iti haloupi johcheh louding ham?
target: will not the ministry of the Spirit be even more glorious?

source: Ijeh-inem itile themmo channa lhacha natoh bon aloupi-a ahile, chonphatna lhacha natoh chu nasajo cheh-a loupia ahi.
target: If the ministry that brought condemnation was glorious, how much more glorious is the ministry that brings righteousness!

source: Ijeh-inem itile loupi kisa-a chu loupina nasajo chun akhokheltah jeh chun, hichea hin loupina aneitapon ahi.
target: For what was glorious has no glory now in comparison with the surpassing glory.

source: Amang theija bon chutia aloupi-a ahile, imatih chana umjing ding chu gamchenga loupijo cheh ahi.
target: And if what was transitory came with glory, how much greater is the glory of that which lasts!

source: Chutobang kinepna kanei jeh uva, hakat tah-a thu kaseijiu ahi.
target: Therefore, since we have such a hope, we are very bold.

source: Akemsuhsuh chu Israel chaten avet lhumkei louna dinguva ponlu kikhua, Mosi tobang chu kahipouve;
target: We are not like Moses, who would put a veil over his face to prevent the Israelites from seeing the end of what was passing away.

source: Ahinla amaho chu alungu atahjo chehtan ahi: ajeh chu tulai gei jong hin Kitepna lui chu asimlai chanun chuche ponlukhuh chu hodoh louvin aumjing nalaije; ajehchu hiche ponlukhuh chu Christa-a lahdoh-a uma ahitai.
target: But their minds were made dull, for to this day the same veil remains when the old covenant is read. It has not been removed, because only in Christ is it taken away.

source: Ahin tuni gei hin Mosi lekhabu asimlai chanun, alunguva chuche ponlukhuh chu aum jinge.
target: Even to this day when Moses is read, a veil covers their hearts.

source: Ahivangin mihem khat chu Pakai heng lama akihei teng, aponlukhu chu kilamangji ahi.
target: But whenever anyone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

source: Tun Pakai chu Lhagao ahi; chule Pakai Lhagao umna chana chu, chamlhatna uma ahi.
target: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.

source: Eiho chengse vang, maikhu louva phatvet sunga kive-a banga, Pakai loupina chu ivet jinguva, Pakai Lhagaova kon, loupina-a kona loupina lima kikhela ihiuve.
target: And we all, who with unveiled faces contemplate the Lord’s glory, are being transformed into his image with ever-increasing glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu keiho hepina kachan uva, hiche lhacha-a panna kaneiju hi, keiho kalhadah hihhelui;
target: Therefore, since through God’s mercy we have this ministry, we do not lose heart.

source: Ahin jachatna thil kisel chengse kapai lhaovin, doha lungthimin kachonpouvin, chule Pathen thu chu mi lhep lhahnan kamangpouve; ahin thutah chu kaphongjalun, Pathen mitmu-a amitakip sele pha hetna henga kaum chanu photchena musah kahiuve.
