target: Rather, we have renounced secret and shameful ways; we do not use deception, nor do we distort the word of God. On the contrary, by setting forth the truth plainly we commend ourselves to everyone’s conscience in the sight of God.

source: Chule kakipana Thupha jong hi maikhu kikhua ahile, amangthahho dinga maikhu kikhua ahin;
target: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.

source: Pathen lima um Christa Kipana Thupha loupitah chun amaho chu asalvah louna dinga, amaho sunga chu hiche vannoi pathen'in atahsan louho lungmit asuhchot ahi.
target: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers, so that they cannot see the light of the gospel that displays the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.

source: Ajeh chu keihon keiho hilouva, Christa Jesu chu Pakai ahi tia, chule keiho Jesu jala nangho soh kahiu chu kalhang sapleu ahibouve.
target: For what we preach is not ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake.

source: Ajehchu, Muthim lah-a kona vah hung vahdoh dinga thupeh neijachu Pathen ahin, Jesu Christa maija Pathen loupi hetna chu avahdohna dinga, ama chun kalungu asalvah ahi.
target: For God, who said, “Let light shine out of darkness,” made his light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of God’s glory displayed in the face of Christ.

source: Ahivangin thilboltheina chungnung tah chu keiho-a kon hilouva, Pathen'a konjoh ahina dinga, hiche gou chu keihon leibela kachinu ahi.
target: But we have this treasure in jars of clay to show that this all-surpassing power is from God and not from us.

source: Hoima lam jouse-a nehchinton kaum un, ahinla kisudongin kaumpouve; lungdongin kaumuvin, ahinla kalunglha pouve;
target: We are hard pressed on every side, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;

source: Suh gentheijin kaumun, ahivangin dalhah-in kaumpouve; eikivolhu vin, ahivangin suhset helin kaumpouve.
target: persecuted, but not abandoned; struck down, but not destroyed.

source: Kavalena chanuva katichung uva Jesu hinna chu akiphon theinan, katichungu vah Pakai Jesu thina chu kapole jingui.
target: We always carry around in our body the death of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

source: Ijeh-inem itile keiho ahing chengse hi katahsao thi theija hi Jesu hinna akiphondoh theina dinga, Jesu jala athi dinga pehdoh jinga um kahiuve.
target: For we who are alive are always being given over to death for Jesus’ sake, so that his life may also be revealed in our mortal body.

source: Chutia chu keiho-a hi thinan na atoh ahin, nangho-a hinnan atoh ahi.
target: So then, death is at work in us, but life is at work in you.

source: Katahsan jeh-a thu kasei ahi, tia kisun banga chu, hiche tahsanna lhagao mama chu kaneijuva, keihon jong katahsan jeh uva thu kaseiju ahi.
target: It is written: “I believed; therefore I have spoken.” Since we have that same spirit of faith, we also believe and therefore speak,

source: Pakai Jesu kaithouva chun, keiho jong Jesu toh thakhatna eikaithou dingu, chule nang hotoh a-anga eidinsah dingu ahi chu kaheuve.
target: because we know that the one who raised the Lord Jesus from the dead will also raise us with Jesus and present us with you to himself.

source: Ajehchu mi tamtah thangvahna jala Lungsetna ahapuna, Pathen choi-atna-a aumna dinga, imajouse nangho jala kibol ahi.
target: All this is for your benefit, so that the grace that is reaching more and more people may cause thanksgiving to overflow to the glory of God.

source: Hijeh chun kalhadah hihhelui; kami ponungu akem jing jeng vangin, kami sungnungu aniseh-in athah cheh athah cheh jon ahi.
target: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though outwardly we are wasting away, yet inwardly we are being renewed day by day.

source: Ijeh-inem itile chomkhat jengcha dinga kathohjiu hesoh gentheina jangkhai hin, tonsot kemlou loupina chu hasema eisempehbe jing jengu ahi;
target: For our light and momentary troubles are achieving for us an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.

source: Muthei thilho ve louvin, mulou thilho chu kave jouve; muthei thil chu chomcha khat dinga ahin, mulou thil vang chu tonsotna dinga ahi.
target: So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen, since what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.

source: Hiche pon in tobang kaleiset inu hi kiphelha jongle, khutna kisa hilou tonsot in, Pathen'a kona kisa indet chu van'ah kaneijuve, ti kaheuve.
target: For we know that if the earthly tent we live in is destroyed, we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.

source: Keihon van'a kachenna dingu in chu kivon ding ngai tun tuna, hiche sunga hi peng penga um kahiuve.
target: Meanwhile we groan, longing to be clothed instead with our heavenly dwelling,

source: Chuche-a kakivon tengule, sagoh keova kaum lou dingu ahi.
target: because when we are clothed, we will not be found naked.

source: Ajehchu pon in'a kachen uva pohgih kapoh jeh uva peng penga kahiuve; hichu pon beija kaum nom jeh-u hilouva, athoa kakisil uva, thi theina hi hinna chun aval lhumna dinga peng penga joh kahiuve.
target: For while we are in this tent, we groan and are burdened, because we do not wish to be unclothed but to be clothed instead with our heavenly dwelling, so that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

source: Chule hiche dinga eigo uva chu Pathen ahin; khamgah na-a Lhagao eipeuva jong ahi.
target: Now the one who has fashioned us for this very purpose is God, who has given us the Spirit as a deposit, guaranteeing what is to come.

source: Hijeh-a chu lungngama kaum jingu ahi, chule hiche tahsa ina kachen laiseuva hi Pakaiya kona gamla kahiuve, ti kaheuve.
target: Therefore we are always confident and know that as long as we are at home in the body we are away from the Lord.

source: (Ajeh chu keiho polam mu theija chon hilouva, tahsan vanga chona joh kahiuve);
target: For we live by faith, not by sight.

source: Lungngama kaumu ahi, tahsa-a um louva Pakai koma um kanomjouve.
target: We are confident, I say, and would prefer to be away from the body and at home with the Lord.

source: Hijeh-a chu umu jongleng, umhih jongu leng, kadoiju chu ama lunglhai na-a um kahatup tenu ahi.
target: So we make it our goal to please him, whether we are at home in the body or away from it.

source: Mitinin tahsa-a athilbol apha hile, ase hile, athilbol dungjui cheh-a atohman asan cheh theina dinga, eiho ibon chaova Christa thupi tanna anga chu ikilah cheh dingu ahi.
target: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each of us may receive what is due us for the things done while in the body, whether good or bad.

source: Hijeh-a chu Pakai kichat umje kahet jeh uva miho kajolleu ahi; ahivangin Pathen anga kilang jingin kaum naove; chule nangho sele pha hetna-a jong kakilang jingui, tin kakinemui.
target: Since, then, we know what it is to fear the Lord, we try to persuade others. What we are is plain to God, and I hope it is also plain to your conscience.

source: Ajehchu nangho henga keiho kichang vahchoi kit kahipouve; lungthim thua hilouva kamsung lama kisongte chu nadonbut theina dinguva, keiho lama kisonna naneina dingu phat kapehjoh nahiuve.
target: We are not trying to commend ourselves to you again, but are giving you an opportunity to take pride in us, so that you can answer those who take pride in what is seen rather than in what is in the heart.

source: Ajehchu kangol-ule Pathen'a ding ahin, kachih-ule nangho-a ding ahi.
target: If we are “out of our mind,” as some say, it is for God; if we are in our right mind, it is for you.

source: Christa ngailutna chun kachamlou uva eisolu ahi, hiti hin kagelui: mi jouse thi khela khat athia ahile, mi jouse chu athia ahitai;
target: For Christ’s love compels us, because we are convinced that one died for all, and therefore all died.

source: Chule ahingho chu amaho dinga hing hitalouva, athi kheluva thia thoukitpa ding joh-a hing ahi theina dinguva, mi jouse thi khela thia ahi.
target: And he died for all, that those who live should no longer live for themselves but for him who died for them and was raised again.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun tukala lhah-in, tahsa lam dola koima kahetapouve; chuti chu ahin masangin Christa chu tahsa lam dolin he jonguleng, tunvang hitobang chun kahetapouve.
target: So from now on we regard no one from a worldly point of view. Though we once regarded Christ in this way, we do so no longer.

source: Hijeh chun koi hile Christa-a um chu akisemthah ahi; alui chengse chu amang gama ahitai; veuvin, athah ahitai.
target: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!

source: Chule thil jouse hi Pathen'a kon ahin, Aman Jesu Christa jala eikicham piuva, chule kichamna thu lhachale-a chu eipansah-u ahi.
target: All this is from God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:

source: Hitia chu Pathen chu Christa-a uma, vannoi leiset mite themona-a sun louva, amatoh kichamna aboljoh ahi; chule chuche kichamna thu chu keiho eipehdoh-u ahi.
target: that God was reconciling the world to himself in Christ, not counting people’s sins against them. And he has committed to us the message of reconciliation.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu Keiho Christa palai kahiu ahin, Pathen'in keiho-a kona naheng uva angeh banga, Pathen toh kichamun tia, Christa thalhenga naheng uva kangeh-u ahi.
target: We are therefore Christ’s ambassadors, as though God were making his appeal through us. We implore you on Christ’s behalf: Be reconciled to God.

source: Ama-a chu Pathen chonphatna ichan theina dinguva, chonset helouhelpa chu eiho khela chonsea asem ahitai.
target: God made him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

source: Chule Christa toh natong khom kahiuvin, Pathen lungsetna chu phatchomna beija mu-a nahi louna dinguva kajolu nahiuve;
target: As God’s co-workers we urge you not to receive God’s grace in vain.

source: (ijeh-inem itile aman hitin ati, Keiman san phatchan, nataona kasange; Chule huhhing nikho nin nangma kahun ahi. Veovin, tuhi lahphat tah ahi; tuhi huhhingna nikho ahi).
target: For he says, “In the time of my favor I heard you, and in the day of salvation I helped you.” I tell you, now is the time of God’s favor, now is the day of salvation.

source: Hiche lhachale-a kapannau hi nolna aum louna dingin, keihon ilam ilam thu hile kipal lhuhna ding kaumsah pouvin ahi.
target: We put no stumbling block in anyone’s path, so that our ministry will not be discredited.

source: Ahin imalam jouse-a Pathen lhacha kahiu hi, hatah-a lungdehat nin, hesoh gentheina thoh-in, lhasama umin, setto lungkhamna toh-in.
target: Rather, as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way: in great endurance; in troubles, hardships and distresses;

source: Kijepna thoh-in, songkul'a kihenin, thunoh lungjinna thoh-in, thohgimna thoh-in, imulouva umin, an ngola umin,
target: in beatings, imprisonments and riots; in hard work, sleepless nights and hunger;

source: Thenin, hetna in, thohhat sotnin, hepina neijin, Lhagao Thengin, alhem hilouhel ngailutna-in,
target: in purity, understanding, patience and kindness; in the Holy Spirit and in sincere love;

source: Thutah thun, Pathen thahatnin, jetle veija chondihna galvon kivonin,
target: in truthful speech and in the power of God; with weapons of righteousness in the right hand and in the left;

source: Gunchuna le jalouna-in, seisetle seiphat chanin, aphot chenna kavetsah jingui; mi lhemlha ho kabangun ahinla kitahtah kahiuve;
target: through glory and dishonor, bad report and good report; genuine, yet regarded as impostors;

source: Hetkhamlouho kabangun ahinla minchetah kahiuve; athikon kabangun ahinla, veuvin, kahingnaove; engbolin kaumun ahinla eikithat pouve;
target: known, yet regarded as unknown; dying, and yet we live on; beaten, and yet not killed;

source: Lunghemtah kabangun, ahinla kipah thanom jing kahiuve; vaichatah kabangun, ahinla tamtah kahaosah taove; imacha neilouhel kabangun, ahinla imajouse kanei kimui.
target: sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; poor, yet making many rich; having nothing, and yet possessing everything.

source: Vo Corinth miteho, nangho dingin kakamu akan kalungu akihonglene.
target: We have spoken freely to you, Corinthians, and opened wide our hearts to you.

source: Nangho keiho-a nehchinto-a uma nahipouve, nangho kichang lunggela nehchinto-a na-umu ahibouve.
target: We are not withholding our affection from you, but you are withholding yours from us.

source: Chuti chu ahin kapeh bang neipeh theina dingun (chate jah-a sei banga kasei ahi) nangho jong kihong lennun.
target: As a fair exchange—I speak as to my children—open wide your hearts also.

source: Atahsan louho toh kitoh louvin namkoljon pokhom hih-un; chonphat le chonset akikopna ipi umam? Muthimle khovah akibahna ipi umam?
target: Do not be yoked together with unbelievers. For what do righteousness and wickedness have in common? Or what fellowship can light have with darkness?

source: Belial le Christa akitona ipi umam? ahiloule atahsanan atahsanlou toh ipi chan anei khomem?
target: What harmony is there between Christ and Belial? Or what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?

source: Chule Pathen intheng le milimho kihoutohna ipi umam? Ijeh-inem itile nangho Pathen hing intheng nahiuve. Chutichun Pathen'in jong hitin aseije, Keima amaho lah-a kachena chule kavale ding ahi; chule keima amaho Pathen kahi ding, amaho kamite hi ding ahi.
target: What agreement is there between the temple of God and idols? For we are the temple of the living God. As God has said: “I will live with them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they will be my people.”

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun Nangho amaho lah-a kon chun hung potdoh-un, chule achomin umun, tin Pakaiyin aseije; Thilboh tongkha hih-un; Chule keiman nangho kasan ding nahiuve,
target: Therefore, “Come out from them and be separate, says the Lord. Touch no unclean thing, and I will receive you.”

source: Chule keima napau hingting, chule nangho kachapate le kachanute nahi dingu ahi, tin hat chungnung Pakai chun aseije.
target: And, “I will be a Father to you, and you will be my sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.”

source: Hijeh chun, sopi ngaite, thutep hicheng chu ineiju ahi jeh chun, lhagao le tahsa kisuh bohna jouse-a konin kisuthengu hitin, Pathen gingin thenna-a chamkimin umu hite.
target: Therefore, since we have these promises, dear friends, let us purify ourselves from everything that contaminates body and spirit, perfecting holiness out of reverence for God.

source: Keiho-a dingin nalungthimu hongun; keihon koimacha alam louvin kabolpouve, koima kasuse pouve, koima dohan kalhemlha pouve.
target: Make room for us in your hearts. We have wronged no one, we have corrupted no one, we have exploited no one.

source: Nangho themmo sahna dinga hiche hi kasei ahipoi; ithile thikhomsap, ihinle hingkhom dingin kalungsung uva nacheng uve tia, masanga kaseisa ahitai.
target: I do not say this to condemn you; I have said before that you have such a place in our hearts that we would live or die with you.

source: Nangho lama kahakat lheh jenge, chule nangho lama kakisonna jong anasai; chuti chun kahesohna jouseuva lungmonna kadimsetnin, chule kipana-in kaletset jingin ahi.
target: I have spoken to you with great frankness; I take great pride in you. I am greatly encouraged; in all our troubles my joy knows no bounds.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Macedonia gama kahungu jong chun, tahsa-a choldona neilou kahiuve; hoima lam jouse-a hesoh genthei toh jinga umjing jeng kahiu ahi; polama eidouva, lung sunga kichat kanei jing jengjiu ahi.
target: For when we came into Macedonia, we had no rest, but we were harassed at every turn—conflicts on the outside, fears within.

source: Ahinla mi kisunemte lungmonsah Pathen'in, Tita hung lhun vang chun eilung monsah taove;
target: But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

source: Chule ama hung vang jenggoh jong hilouvin, aman nangho-a lungmonna anei, hiche lungmonna chun eilung monsah taovin ahi; nanghon neingaichat jeu, neilhaset piu, kei dinga nagunchujeu, thu ahung seijin ahile, hichea chun hatah-in kakipah kathanom lheh jengtan ahi.
target: and not only by his coming but also by the comfort you had given him. He told us about your longing for me, your deep sorrow, your ardent concern for me, so that my joy was greater than ever.

source: Ajeh chu keiman kahin lekhathotna chu nangho kasuh lunghem jeng vangun kakisihpoi; kana kisih jeng vangin; ajehchu kalekhathot chun nangho chomkhat kahsung hijongle, nalunghemsah lheh jengun ahi;
target: Even if I caused you sorrow by my letter, I do not regret it. Though I did regret it—I see that my letter hurt you, but only for a little while—

source: Keima tun kakipah kathanome, nangho suhlunghema naum jeh-u chu hilouvin, nalunghem nao chun lungheina aso jeh chu ahi. Ijeh inem itile nanghon keiho-a hakamna imacha nanei louhelna dinguva, Pathen lam dola kisu lunghema nahiu ahi.
target: yet now I am happy, not because you were made sorry, but because your sorrow led you to repentance. For you became sorrowful as God intended and so were not harmed in any way by us.

source: Ajeh chu Pathen lam dola lunghem chun huhhing-a umna dinga lungheina asoji ahi; hichun kisihna asojipoi; vannoi leiset lam dola lunghem chun thina asojin ahi.
target: Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation and leaves no regret, but worldly sorrow brings death.

source: Ajeh chu, veuvin, Nalunghem nao chu Pathen lunglam dol ahi; nangho-a itobanga kihatup chehna asodoh hitam! nangho dingin: nakisuh thengnao, lungsouna, kichatna, ngaichatna, gunchuna, chule phulahna, asodoh-in; hiche thiljouse-a hi nangho thengsoh nahiu chu naphot chetnu ahitai.
target: See what this godly sorrow has produced in you: what earnestness, what eagerness to clear yourselves, what indignation, what alarm, what longing, what concern, what readiness to see justice done. At every point you have proved yourselves to be innocent in this matter.

source: Hiche naheng uva kahinsut jeng vang chun, alam louva bolpa jeh-a kahinsut ahipon, alam louva kibolpa jeh-a jong kahinsut ahidehpoi; Pathen mitmu-a nachunga kagun chujeu chu naheng uva akiphon dohna dinga, kahinsut joh ahibouve.
target: So even though I wrote to you, it was neither on account of the one who did the wrong nor on account of the injured party, but rather that before God you could see for yourselves how devoted to us you are.

source: Hijeh chun nalungmon naova lung mongin kaum taove. Chule Titus kipana-a kaha kipa cheh-un ahi; nanghon nabon chaova alung nakidosah jeh-u chun.
target: By all this we are encouraged. In addition to our own encouragement, we were especially delighted to see how happy Titus was, because his spirit has been refreshed by all of you.

source: Ajeh chu ama komah nangho-a kakisonna ima a-umtah jeng jongle, jachatnan kaneitapoi; ahin nangho henga kathu sei jouseu thutah ahi banga chu, Titus anga kakisonao jong chu thutah mong ahi.
target: I had boasted to him about you, and you have not embarrassed me. But just as everything we said to you was true, so our boasting about you to Titus has proved to be true as well.

source: Chule nangho nathu nunnao, itobanga kichatah le kithing thinga nanalem jengu hitam, ti ageldohjile nangho nakhoto nao anasacheh cheh jengin ahi.
target: And his affection for you is all the greater when he remembers that you were all obedient, receiving him with fear and trembling.

source: Hijeh chun thiljouse-a nangho chunga tahsana kanei hi kakipah thanomin ahi.
target: I am glad I can have complete confidence in you.

source: Sopiteho, Macedonia houbung ho kipe-a Pathen lungsetna chu nangho kahetsah nahiuve.
target: And now, brothers and sisters, we want you to know about the grace that God has given the Macedonian churches.

source: Ajeh chu hesoh gentheija kipatepna nasatah lah jenga jong akipanao adimin, avaichat thuhlheh jeng vangun, athilphal uva kon aletset jengtaovin ahi.
target: In the midst of a very severe trial, their overflowing joy and their extreme poverty welled up in rich generosity.

source: Keiman kahet tohsah-a kasei ahi, amahon athao toh kithuh-in, athaovin ajokalvalin jong, amaho lungcham tah-in apeuvin;
target: For I testify that they gave as much as they were able, and even beyond their ability. Entirely on their own,

source: Athilto-u chu kasan nadingu leh, mithengte lhachakin bolna-a akithokhom theina dingun eino gangun ahi
target: they urgently pleaded with us for the privilege of sharing in this service to the Lord’s people.

source: Chule hichu kakinepna bangu hilouvin, Pathen lunglamin amaho-a Pakaiyah akipe masaovin, chuin keiho henga akipeuvin ahi.
target: And they exceeded our expectations: They gave themselves first of all to the Lord, and then by the will of God also to us.

source: Chutichun Titus'in masanga abol pat banga chu, tu-a jong chuche lungsetna chu nangho lah-a abulhit sohna dingin katiltil jiuvin ahi.
target: So we urged Titus, just as he had earlier made a beginning, to bring also to completion this act of grace on your part.

source: Amavang, tahsanna, seidohna, hetna, gunchuna jouse le keiho ngailutna nanei letset banguva chu, hiche lungsetna jong hi nanei letsetna dingu gelun.
target: But since you excel in everything—in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in complete earnestness and in the love we have kindled in you—see that you also excel in this grace of giving.

source: Hiche hi thupeh bangtah-a kasei hilouvin, midangho kihabolna-a kona, nanghon ngailutna tahbeh naneiju chu patepna-a kasei ahibouve.
target: I am not commanding you, but I want to test the sincerity of your love by comparing it with the earnestness of others.

source: Ajeh chu ama vaichat vanga nangho nahaodoh theina dinguva, ahaonasa nangho jala vaicha jenga, hiche Pakai Jesu Christa lungset chu nanghon naheuve.
target: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sake he became poor, so that you through his poverty might become rich.

source: Hiche thudola hi lungthim kapehbou nahiuve; achuti chu nangho dinga apha ahi; kum khat masanga bol pan masa nangho nahiuve, nabol pat jenggoh-u hilouva bol jong nabolphat nomu ahi.
target: And here is my judgment about what is best for you in this matter. Last year you were the first not only to give but also to have the desire to do so.

source: Ahin bol ding nalung got bangu chun, than ajochanin bulhit sohkeija aum theinan, tun jong bol bulhingun.
target: Now finish the work, so that your eager willingness to do it may be matched by your completion of it, according to your means.

source: Ajeh chu lung got masah auma ahile, aneija chu anei dungjuija, chule aneilou chu aneilou dungjuija kilajia ahi.
target: For if the willingness is there, the gift is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what one does not have.

source: Mi dang noma aumuva nangho hesoh-a naum dingu katina ahipoi;
target: Our desire is not that others might be relieved while you are hard pressed, but that there might be equality.

source: Chamgola umna ding ahi, amaho nei letset chu nangho lhahsam bulhitna-a ahung hi theina dinga; tu-a nangho neiletset hi amaho lhahsam bulhitna-a chamgola umna dinga kitoh ahibouve;
target: At the present time your plenty will supply what they need, so that in turn their plenty will supply what you need. The goal is equality,

source: Hitia chu, atam lokhoma chu aval aum chomdehpon, chule alhom lokhoma jong chu alhasampoi, tia kisun bang chu ahi.
target: as it is written: “The one who gathered much did not have too much, and the one who gathered little did not have too little.”

source: Ahin Tius lungsunga chutobanga gunchu tah-a nangho khotona neisah Pathen chu thangvah-in umhen.
target: Thanks be to God, who put into the heart of Titus the same concern I have for you.

source: Ajeh chu keiho tilkhouna jop chu ahinan, ahinla amatah mong lunggut tena ama lung chama nangho henga hunga ahi.
target: For Titus not only welcomed our appeal, but he is coming to you with much enthusiasm and on his own initiative.

source: Chule Kipana Thupha lama houbung ho jouse lah-a akipachatna kithangsoh chu, amatoh lhon dingin kahinsol thaove.
target: And we are sending along with him the brother who is praised by all the churches for his service to the gospel.

source: Chuti jenggoh chu hilouvin; Pakai loupina dingle, kalunggot tenjiu hi vetsahna-a alhachalea kapanu, hiche lungsetna thu lamdola hi kalhonpile dinguva, houbung in agotsa mongu jong ahi.
target: What is more, he was chosen by the churches to accompany us as we carry the offering, which we administer in order to honor the Lord himself and to show our eagerness to help.

source: Alhachalea kapanu hiche thilpeh letset thudola hi koiman eidem louna dinguva, chingtheitah-a chona kahiuve;
target: We want to avoid any criticism of the way we administer this liberal gift.

source: Pakai mitmu jenga hilouva mihem mitmu-a jong thil ja umdol chu kangaitou ahi.
target: For we are taking pains to do what is right, not only in the eyes of the Lord but also in the eyes of man.

source: Chule keihon tamtah vei thil tamtah-a agunchuje kaphottohsao isopipao chu, amaho toh kahinsol thaovin ahi, ahin tun nangho-a tahsan dettah anei jeh-in ahagunchu cheh jengtan ahi.
target: In addition, we are sending with them our brother who has often proved to us in many ways that he is zealous, and now even more so because of his great confidence in you.

source: Titus thudol hi kiseile, ama hi nangho chungchanga kakivopi le katoh khompi ahi; chule sopi niteni vanghi, houbung ho solchah chule Christa loupina ahi lhone.
target: As for Titus, he is my partner and co-worker among you; as for our brothers, they are representatives of the churches and an honor to Christ.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun nangailut nao le nangho jeh-a kisonna kaneiju photchetna chu, amaho kom le houbung ho angsunga amaho chu kivetsah-un.
target: Therefore show these men the proof of your love and the reason for our pride in you, so that the churches can see it.

source: Mithengte kinbol thudol vang naheng uva kahinsutlo angaipoi;
target: There is no need for me to write to you about this service to the Lord’s people.

source: Ijeh-inem itile nalunggot danu chu kahenai, hiche dol chu, Achaia kigosa aumna kumkhat ahitai, tia Macedonia mite anga nangho kapaopi ahi; chule hiche nagunchu nau chun mi tamtah achoh thouvin, agunchu sahtan ahi.
target: For I know your eagerness to help, and I have been boasting about it to the Macedonians, telling them that since last year you in Achaia were ready to give; and your enthusiasm has stirred most of them to action.

source: Hitilam thudola nangho kakisonpinao chu ahomkeo ahi louna dinga, kasei banga chu kigosa dema naumna dingun, tia sopiho phabep khat kahinsolu ahitai.
target: But I am sending the brothers in order that our boasting about you in this matter should not prove hollow, but that you may be ready, as I said you would be.

source: Achuti loule ajole Macedonia mi khattou kei lhonpi dingin hunghen, kigo louva na-umu hungtoh tale, keiho chang jenggoh hilouva, kinep pitah nangho dinga jong jachat umding ahi.
target: For if any Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we—not to say anything about you—would be ashamed of having been so confident.

source: Hijeh-a chu masanga pat nakitep nasao thilpeh kitoh chu cham louva lah hilouva, hongphal tah-a peh ahia, gotsadema nakoina dinguva; aphat masanga naheng uva hung dinga sopiho chu tilkhou angaije tia kageltoh ahi.
target: So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to visit you in advance and finish the arrangements for the generous gift you had promised. Then it will be ready as a generous gift, not as one grudgingly given.

source: Ahivangin hiche thudola hin alhom tu-a chun alhom at ding, chule atam tu-a chun atam at ding ahi.
target: Remember this: Whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows generously will also reap generously.

source: Lung phatmo pumpumle peh louva, phamo tia pe louvin, nalung got bangtah cheh-in peuvin; ijeh-inem itile lunglhai sela pe-a chu Pathen'in angailui.
target: Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

source: Chule imalam jouse-a imatih chana ijakaija bulhingsoh nahiuva, natohpha tintang natoh theina dinguva, Pathen'in lungsetna letset nangho napeh theiju ahi.
target: And God is able to bless you abundantly, so that in all things at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.

source: Hiche thudol chu hitihin akisune, Aman athejalin, mivaichate atoi; Achonphatna chu a-imatih chana umjing ahi.
target: As it is written: “They have freely scattered their gifts to the poor; their righteousness endures forever.”

source: Chule muchi tu-a chu muchi pe-a chule anneh dinga changlhah pepa chun, nangho muchi napeuvintin apunsah ding, chule nachon phatnao ga chu akhantou sah ding ahi.
target: Now he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will also supply and increase your store of seed and will enlarge the harvest of your righteousness.

source: Thil phal dinga imalam jouse-a haodoh-a nahitaovin, alhacha-a keiho vangin Pathen vahchoijin aume;
target: You will be enriched in every way so that you can be generous on every occasion, and through us your generosity will result in thanksgiving to God.

source: Ajeh chu hiche phatna dingbol lhachale-a panna vanga hi, mithengte lhahsamna bulhinsah jenggoh hilouva, thangvahna tamtah-a kona, Pathen lama jong letset jenga ahitai.
target: This service that you perform is not only supplying the needs of the Lord’s people but is also overflowing in many expressions of thanks to God.

source: Hiche lhacha kin kibola kon, nangho Christa Kipana Thupha phondohna dinga nathu man-ule, amahole adangho jouse tona-a nathilpeh-u jehchun amahon Pathen avahchoijui.
target: Because of the service by which you have proved yourselves, others will praise God for the obedience that accompanies your confession of the gospel of Christ, and for your generosity in sharing with them and with everyone else.

source: Amahotah jong nangho dingin Pathen henga atao ataovun, nachung uva Pathen lungset lentah chuh jeh chun nangai lheh jengui.
target: And in their prayers for you their hearts will go out to you, because of the surpassing grace God has given you.

source: Athilpeh sei theilou jeh hin Pathen thangvah-in umhen.
target: Thanks be to God for his indescribable gift!

source: Keima, Paul, naum naova lungnem chule naum lounaova nangho lama hakat chun, Christa chonnemna le nunnem na-a keimatah-in katem nahiuve.
target: By the humility and gentleness of Christ, I appeal to you—I, Paul, who am “timid” when face to face with you, but “bold” toward you when away!

source: Hijongle keiho hi tahsa lam thua chon ahi tia eingaitoho mi koi koiham chunga, hakat tah-a chon dingdol ahi tia kageltoh chu, kaum tengle hiche hakat chu kamanchah louna dinga, naheng uva katao ahi.
target: I beg you that when I come I may not have to be as bold as I expect to be toward some people who think that we live by the standards of this world.

source: Ijeh-inem itile keiho tahsa-a chonle kahivangun, tahsa lam thudolin gal kasatpouve;
target: For though we live in the world, we do not wage war as the world does.

source: (Ajeh chu kagalsatnau manchah hi tahsa-a ahipoi, ahivanga, kulpi suhjalna dinga Pathen lama hattah);
target: The weapons we fight with are not the weapons of the world. On the contrary, they have divine power to demolish strongholds.

source: Keihon, lungsuhto-a mi nel na, chule Pathen lam hetna douna-a kigel thil sangtah tah kasuh chim jiuva, lungthim ngaito jouse gal hinga kamat jiuva, Christa thua kanunsah jiu ahi.
target: We demolish arguments and every pretension that sets itself up against the knowledge of God, and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.

source: Chule nangho thua nanun bulhin tengule, thua nunglouho phula dinga jong kigosa jing kahiuve.
target: And we will be ready to punish every act of disobedience, once your obedience is complete.

source: Nanghon namaikoh uva um thil chu navet uvam? Koi hile mi khattou ama, Christa-a kahi tia amachang kitahsana aumle, ama chun hiche hi ngaito kit-hen; ama Christa-a ahi bang chun keiho jong kahiuve.
target: You are judging by appearances. If anyone is confident that they belong to Christ, they should consider again that we belong to Christ just as much as they do.

source: Ajeh chu nangho phet lhahna hilouva sahphatna dingjoh-a Pakaiyin eipeh-u kathuneinao hi hatah-in song jongleng, kajachat lou ding ahi.
target: So even if I boast somewhat freely about the authority the Lord gave us for building you up rather than tearing you down, I will not be ashamed of it.

source: Lekhaho-a chun nangho tijatsah tobang hidange.
target: I do not want to seem to be trying to frighten you with my letters.

source: Ajeh chu alekhaho athu agihsan, hat jong ahat ngeije, ahinla amunah atahsa ahatmon, athusei taimo aume, atiuve.
target: For some say, “His letters are weighty and forceful, but in person he is unimpressive and his speaking amounts to nothing.”

source: Chutobang miho chun heuhen, keiho kaum lou tenguva lekha-a thu banga chu, kaumu jongle thilbola chutima chu kahiuve.
target: Such people should realize that what we are in our letters when we are absent, we will be in our actions when we are present.

source: Ajeh iham itile amachang kivahchoi mi abang khattouho toh kisimtha dingle kitekah ding kangampouve; amaho vang chu amahole amaho akitekah jiuvin, imacha helou helin aumui.
target: We do not dare to classify or compare ourselves with some who commend themselves. When they measure themselves by themselves and compare themselves with themselves, they are not wise.

source: Keiho vang eikitepeh kalvalun kisong pouvinge, Pathen'in gamkol eitepeh bang bangabou kisong ding kahiuve, gamkol chun nangho jong nahomui.
target: We, however, will not boast beyond proper limits, but will confine our boasting to the sphere of service God himself has assigned to us, a sphere that also includes you.

source: Ajeh chu keiho nangho kom hung lhunglou toh kabah jeng vangun, eikitepeh kalvala kilhonsao kahipouve, ajeh chu Christa Kipana Thupha hille-a, nangho kom geipeh jong kahung lhunu ahi;
target: We are not going too far in our boasting, as would be the case if we had not come to you, for we did get as far as you with the gospel of Christ.

source: Eikitepeh kalvaluva midang tohnasa-a kisonga kahipouve; natahsanu akhantoule kavai hom dungjuiju hin nangho vangin hatah-a keh let cheh-in umunge, ti kakineme.
target: Neither do we go beyond our limits by boasting of work done by others. Our hope is that, as your faith continues to grow, our sphere of activity among you will greatly expand,

source: Nangho gam kalpeh geija Kipana Thupha hi kaseiphongle theina dinguva, kakhut uva dinga gotsa um thil dola hi mi gamkol sung kason louna dingu, katiu ahi.
target: so that we can preach the gospel in the regions beyond you. For we do not want to boast about work already done in someone else’s territory.

source: Ahin khattou akisonga aumle Pakaiyah kisonghen.
target: But, “Let the one who boasts boast in the Lord.”

source: Ajeh chu ama kiseipha-a chu hilouvin, Pakai seiphat chubou apha tia kisei ahi.
target: For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.

source: Kangolna themthema neinangai themleu chun kalung ahi; ahin neinangai themsam naove.
target: I hope you will put up with me in a little foolishness. Yes, please put up with me!

source: Pathen tomlah na-a nachung uva katomlah ahi, nungah theng banga Christa khutna kapeh theina dinguva, nangho inneipu khatseh Christa dinga kaholsa nahiuve.
target: I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy. I promised you to one husband, to Christ, so that I might present you as a pure virgin to him.

source: Ahivangin gul chun alepthol doha-a Evi alheplhah bangchun, Christa lama nalungput dihnauva nalung gelu chu ijemtin suchavai getnun nate ti kakichai.
target: But I am afraid that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent’s cunning, your minds may somehow be led astray from your sincere and pure devotion to Christ.

source: Ajehchu keihon athu kasei louvu Jesu chom dang khat thu ahung seija auma, ahiloule nachankhah ngai louvu lhagao chomdang changa auma, ahiloule najop khah ngai louvu Kipana Thupha jop auma, ahile ama chu angai themleu chun aphai.
target: For if someone comes to you and preaches a Jesus other than the Jesus we preached, or if you receive a different spirit from the Spirit you received, or a different gospel from the one you accepted, you put up with it easily enough.

source: Ijeh-inem itile solchah pipui chung nungho sanga neokhat chajong neojo-a kingaito lou kahi.
target: I do not think I am in the least inferior to those “super-apostles.”

source: Ahinla thuseija kalhahchom vangin hetna lama chun kalhachom poi. Ahin imalam jouse-a nangho henga tahlangin kaumun ahi.
target: I may indeed be untrained as a speaker, but I do have knowledge. We have made this perfectly clear to you in every way.

source: Ole, nangho choisanga naumna dinguva, keima kaki suhnema, lo beija nangho Pathen Thupha kahilu hi achonsea kahim?
target: Was it a sin for me to lower myself in order to elevate you by preaching the gospel of God to you free of charge?

source: Nangho kinbolna dinga, houbung dangdang kachoma, amaho-a kona lo kasan ahi;
target: I robbed other churches by receiving support from them so as to serve you.

source: Chule nangho koma kaum laisen kalhahsamna aum jongle, koima dinga gihsatna hilouhel kahi; ajeh chu Macedonia konin sopiho ahungun, kangaichat chengse ahung subulhittaove; chule imalam jouse-a nangho gihsatsah louna dinga kihongdoh jing kahin, kihongdoh jing ding kahi.
target: And when I was with you and needed something, I was not a burden to anyone, for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied what I needed. I have kept myself from being a burden to you in any way, and will continue to do so.

source: Christa thutah jouse keima-a aum jehchun, Achaia gamkol sunga kakisonna chu koiman eikhahtan thei ponte.
target: As surely as the truth of Christ is in me, nobody in the regions of Achaia will stop this boasting of mine.

source: Ipi jehham? nangho kangailut lou jehham? Pathen'in ahenai.
target: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows I do!

source: Ahinla agomkom holteho chu, akisonao chu keiho tobangbang ahung hi theina dinguva, agomkom atokhah dingu chu kasuhhai theina dinga, kabol hi kaboljom jing ding ahi.
target: And I will keep on doing what I am doing in order to cut the ground from under those who want an opportunity to be considered equal with us in the things they boast about.

source: Ijeh-inem itile chutobang miho chu solchah lhem ahiuve; doha bola milhemlha natong ahiuve; amaho Christa solchah ho lima kisema ahiuve.
target: For such people are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as apostles of Christ.

source: Hichu thu kidang ahipoi, ajeh chu Satan'in amatah jengin jong avah-a vah vantil mel aputji ahi.
target: And no wonder, for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.

source: Chuti chu ahin, alhachahon chonphat lhachaho mel aput chu thupi ahipoi; ahivanga akichainiu chu athilbol dungjui cheh-u hiding ahi.
target: It is not surprising, then, if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness. Their end will be what their actions deserve.

source: Keiman kasei kit ahi, koiman angolin eingaito hihhen; ahin neingaito ujongleh, themkhat beh kakison theina dingin mingol bangin neisangun.
target: I repeat: Let no one take me for a fool. But if you do, then tolerate me just as you would a fool, so that I may do a little boasting.

source: Hicheng kasei hi Pakai thuseija kasei hilouva, hiche kisonna-a hi kisonga, mingol thusei banga kasei ahibouve.
target: In this self-confident boasting I am not talking as the Lord would, but as a fool.

source: Mi tamtah tahsaphe lama akison jeh-a, kei jong kakison ding ahi.
target: Since many are boasting in the way the world does, I too will boast.

source: Nangho achinga nahi jeh uva, mingol ho chu kipahtah-a nangaithem-u ahi.
target: You gladly put up with fools since you are so wise!

source: Nasohchan sah uva jong, nabah gamuva jong, gal hinga naman uva jong, ama le ama kichoisanga jong, chule nangeipheu benga jong, nangai themu ahi.
target: In fact, you even put up with anyone who enslaves you or exploits you or takes advantage of you or puts on airs or slaps you in the face.

source: Keiho hichea ding chun kalhasamui tia jahcha puma kasei ahi! Ahivangin ilam ilam thua hile, midang ngamna-a chun (Mingol thuseija kasei ahi)kei jong kangame.
target: To my shame I admit that we were too weak for that! Whatever anyone else dares to boast about—I am speaking as a fool—I also dare to boast about.

source: Amaho Hebrew mi hiuvam? kei jong kahi. Amaho Israel mite hiuvam? kei jong kahi. Amaho Abraham chilhah hiuvam? kei jong kahi.
target: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they Abraham’s descendants? So am I.

source: Amaho Christa lhacha hiuvam? (Mingol thuseija kasei ahi) keima kaha hidehjoi, na hatohgimin, songkul lut tamin, teptena kalvala kivoh tamin, thina thei setto tamin;
target: Are they servants of Christ? (I am out of my mind to talk like this.) I am more. I have worked much harder, been in prison more frequently, been flogged more severely, and been exposed to death again and again.

source: Ngavei Judah ho-a konin somli-a khat lhan eiki jepmin;
target: Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.

source: Thumveina molin eikivon; khatvei songin eikisepmin, thumveina kongke kathoh, jan khatle sunkhat twi thuh laija kaumin;
target: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was pelted with stones, three times I was shipwrecked, I spent a night and a day in the open sea,

source: Kakholjin lena-a, tamtahvei luipi-a setto, gucha michoma setto, kanam chanpite-a kona setto, chidang namdang ho-a kona setto, khopi sunga setto, gamthip dunga setto, twikhanglen'a setto, sopi lhemho lah-a setto;
target: I have been constantly on the move. I have been in danger from rivers, in danger from bandits, in danger from my fellow Jews, in danger from Gentiles; in danger in the city, in danger in the country, in danger at sea; and in danger from false believers.

source: Tohgimle hesoh gentheijin, hah jinga imu louva umin, gilkel dangchah thoh-in, an ngola umin, khosih thoh-a pon sillouva umin, hicheng chu kaha hidehna ahi.
target: I have labored and toiled and have often gone without sleep; I have known hunger and thirst and have often gone without food; I have been cold and naked.

source: Hicheng vang chu chutitante, ahivangin apipenin houbung chengse kakhohsah hi niseh-a eidelpha-a ahi.
target: Besides everything else, I face daily the pressure of my concern for all the churches.

source: Koi hatmona kahatmopi lou umam? koi kiselhuh na-a katompi lou umam?
target: Who is weak, and I do not feel weak? Who is led into sin, and I do not inwardly burn?

source: Kithang-at go-a hileng, kahatmona tamtah-a hi kakithang-at ding ahi.
target: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness.

source: Jou sei lou kahi, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Pa-le Pathen tonsot nunnoma chun ahenai.
target: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is to be praised forever, knows that I am not lying.

source: Damascus-a Aretas lengpa noija gamvaipopan, keima man dingin Damascus miho khopi chu angasah jeng ahi;
target: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas had the city of the Damascenes guarded in order to arrest me.

source: Ahivangin bangkot homa bomin kulpanga eikhai lha uvin, akhutna konin kasohchatan ahi.
target: But I was lowered in a basket from a window in the wall and slipped through his hands.

source: Keima dingin kiletsahhi ima phachom hihjongle, gaothilmu le Pakai kilahna thuho seijinge.
target: I must go on boasting. Although there is nothing to be gained, I will go on to visions and revelations from the Lord.

source: Keiman Christa-a mi khat kahei, kum somle kum li ahitai (tahsa pumaham kahepoi, tahsa puma hilouham kahepoi, Pathen'in ahei) van athumna geijin lahtouvin aumin ahi.
target: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven. Whether it was in the body or out of the body I do not know—God knows.

source: Keiman hitobang mi chu kahei (tahsa pumaha, atahsa pum hilouham, hi chu kahepoi, Pathen'in ahei).
target: And I know that this man—whether in the body or apart from the body I do not know, but God knows—

source: Ama chu gam loupi-a lahtouvin aumin, tho thei louhel paochengho agajai, hichu mihem dinga thodoh hoi dan hilouhel ahi.
target: was caught up to paradise and heard inexpressible things, things that no one is permitted to tell.

source: Chutobang mi dinga chu kisong ding kahi; keima chang thua vang, kahatmo naho tailouvah kisongponge.
target: I will boast about a man like that, but I will not boast about myself, except about my weaknesses.

source: Kison ding lung go jongleng angolla hiponge, keiman thutahbeh kasei ding ahi; min keima eimu-a chule kathu ajah-a itobanga eingaitom, hi sanga chu chungnung-jo-a eingaito louna dinga, kakitim ahi.
target: Even if I should choose to boast, I would not be a fool, because I would be speaking the truth. But I refrain, so no one will think more of me than is warranted by what I do or say,

source: Chule thil kilahho anatsat behseh jeh-a chu kakichoisang behseh louna dingin, Satan thangkou khat eichum dingin, kakichoisang louhelna dingin, kati chungah ling khat eikipen ahi.
target: or because of these surpassingly great revelations. Therefore, in order to keep me from becoming conceited, I was given a thorn in my flesh, a messenger of Satan, to torment me.

source: Keija kona achemangna dingin Pakai anga thumvei kataotan ahi.
target: Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.

source: Chutah chun aman, Kalungsetna hi nangma dinga lhingset ahi; ajehchu hatmona-a kathahat kisucham kimjia ahi, ati. Hijeh-a chu Christa thahat keija achen theina dinga, kahatmona-a hi kipahtah-a kakison johding ahi.
target: But he said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly about my weaknesses, so that Christ’s power may rest on me.

source: Chuti ahi jeh-a chu Christa jala hatmona tincheng, suhlema umna, vaichatna, bolsetna, settona hichenga hi lunglhaija um kahi; ajeh chu kahatmo komle kahatjin ahi.
target: That is why, for Christ’s sake, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.

source: Kison na-a ngol kanahi ahitai; nanghon ngollou theijin neilhapouve; ajeh chu nangho choi-at dingjoh kahi; ijeh inem itile keima solchah pipuiho sanga imacha-a nunung jolou kahi.
target: I have made a fool of myself, but you drove me to it. I ought to have been commended by you, for I am not in the least inferior to the “super-apostles,” even though I am nothing.

source: Tahtah-a seijin, solchah hina melchihna ho jouse nangho lah-a thohhattoh kitho-a, melchihna tintang kibola, mu kidang dang chule thilbol theina-a kiboldoh ahi.
target: I persevered in demonstrating among you the marks of a true apostle, including signs, wonders and miracles.

source: Ahile houbung dangho sanga noinungjo-a na-umnao ipi umam, keiman nangho gihsatsah louva kaum ti lou chu? Hiche kasuhkhel chu neingaidam un.
target: How were you inferior to the other churches, except that I was never a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

source: Veuvin, nangho henga hung kakigot hiche hi athumveina ahi; chule nangho gihsatsah lou ding kahi; ajeh chu keima nangho-a ima hola hilouvin, nangho bou kahol ahi; ajeh chu anule apa dinga chatehon sum akhol chu adol ahipoi, anule apanbou chate dinga akhol ding dol ahi.
target: Now I am ready to visit you for the third time, and I will not be a burden to you, because what I want is not your possessions but you. After all, children should not have to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.

source: Chule keiman kipahtah-a nangho hinna dinga kakiman ding, chule kakiman jouhel ding ahi. Keiman nangho kangai lutnao asanlheh jeh-a, nangho neingailut nao lhasam dingham.
target: So I will very gladly spend for you everything I have and expend myself as well. If I love you more, will you love me less?

source: Ahoi hitale ahihi hitante, keiman nangho pohgihsa kapoh sahpoi; ahin lungthim thema doha kamat nahiuve.
target: Be that as it may, I have not been a burden to you. Yet, crafty fellow that I am, I caught you by trickery!

source: Naheng uva kahinsol teho lah-a khattou nangho doha bolna-a kaman chah umam?
target: Did I exploit you through any of the men I sent to you?

source: Titus chu keiman kajola, sopiho chu amatoh kahin soltha ahi; ole Titus'in doha nabolnao umam? Keiho lhagao khat hilou kahiuvem? kalson kibanga sepkhom hilou kahiuvem?
target: I urged Titus to go to you and I sent our brother with him. Titus did not exploit you, did he? Did we not walk in the same footsteps by the same Spirit?

source: Tuchan geija hi keiho kithenhon na-a najah uva thuseija neingaito nahlaiju ham? Keiho Pathen maikoh-a Christa thu seija kahiuve. Chule, ngaitahte, imajouse hi nangho sadoh-a phattou sahna-a kabollu ahi.
target: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? We have been speaking in the sight of God as those in Christ; and everything we do, dear friends, is for your strengthening.

source: Ajeh chu nakomu kahung lhun tengle, ajole kamu nom bangin muhih khau vingting, chule nanghon jong neimu nom bangin neimu hih khauvinate, ti kagingmoi; ijem itile nalah uva, kibaotam, kithangset, lunghan, kilungdou, kiseiset, kihou lhih, hamhoitho, thunoh lungjin umkhante kati;
target: For I am afraid that when I come I may not find you as I want you to be, and you may not find me as you want me to be. I fear that there may be discord, jealousy, fits of rage, selfish ambition, slander, gossip, arrogance and disorder.

source: Chule ajole kahung kit tengle, ka-Pathen'in keima nangho angah eisunem khantin; chule tu masanga chonsea, thenlouna, jonthanhoi, huh aboluva kon lungheilou mitamtah hochu lhasetpi khagetning kate.
target: I am afraid that when I come again my God will humble me before you, and I will be grieved over many who have sinned earlier and have not repented of the impurity, sexual sin and debauchery in which they have indulged.

source: Nangho henga kahung tu chunga hi athum veina ahi. Ahetoh ni ahim, thum ahim, kama thu ijakai tun dinga umding ahi.
target: This will be my third visit to you. “Every matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.”

source: Amasanga kanaseisa ahi, chule aniveina-a kaum petna kanaseisa banga chu, tu-a kaum louva jong, tu masanga chonse hole adang dangho jouse henga kasut ahi, kahung kit tengle, khen nei lou ding kahi;
target: I already gave you a warning when I was with you the second time. I now repeat it while absent: On my return I will not spare those who sinned earlier or any of the others,

source: Nanghon Christan keima-a thu asei photchena nahol jeh-u chun; ama chu nangho lama hatmoa ahipoi, nangho-a hattah ahi.
target: since you are demanding proof that Christ is speaking through me. He is not weak in dealing with you, but is powerful among you.

source: Ijeh-inem itile hatmona jeh-a thingpel'a akikhetbeh jeng vangin, Pathen thahat vangin ahing jinge. Ajeh chu keiho jong ama-a hatmoa kahiuve; ahinla Pathen thahat vanga nangho lama amatoh hingkhom ding kahiuve.
target: For to be sure, he was crucified in weakness, yet he lives by God’s power. Likewise, we are weak in him, yet by God’s power we will live with him in our dealing with you.

source: Tahsana um nahiu nahi louvu nangho kikholun; photchena dingin nangho kikholun. Ahiloule Jesu Christa nangho-a aum chu nangho tah-in helou nahiuvem? aphai tia lah hilou nahilou ngaluleh.
target: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Do you not realize that Christ Jesus is in you—unless, of course, you fail the test?

source: Ahinla keiho hi aphai tia lah hilou kahilou hi nanghon nahet dingu kakineme.
target: And I trust that you will discover that we have not failed the test.

source: Ahivangin nangho thilphalou nabol louna dingun Pathen henga kataojiuve; hiche aphai tia lah kahiu chu kilahdohna ding hilouva, keiho aphai tia lah hiloutoh kabah jeng vangun, nanghon thil ja um chu nabolna dingu ahijoi.
target: Now we pray to God that you will not do anything wrong—not so that people will see that we have stood the test but so that you will do what is right even though we may seem to have failed.

source: Ajeh chu keiho thutah-a ding tilou, thutah dounan ima kabol thei pouve.
target: For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.

source: Ijeh-inem itile keiho kahatmo uva nangho nahat tengule kathanom jiuve, chule nachamkim na dingun jong, kataojiuve.
target: We are glad whenever we are weak but you are strong; and our prayer is that you may be fully restored.

source: Hiche jeh chun asuse ding hilouvin, houthu lama khantou sahna dinga Pakaiyin thuneina eipeh hi, kathunei bangtah-a kahung tengle, kabol khoh louna ding lungthima kahung masanga hicheng hi kahinsut ahi.
target: This is why I write these things when I am absent, that when I come I may not have to be harsh in my use of authority—the authority the Lord gave me for building you up, not for tearing you down.

source: Achaina keijin, sopite, nangho kipah thanomun, chamkim keijun, lungmongun, lungkhat hiuvin, kitohdelin umun; chutile ngailutle lungmon kona Pathen'in naumpi dingu ahi.
target: Finally, brothers and sisters, rejoice! Strive for full restoration, encourage one another, be of one mind, live in peace. And the God of love and peace will be with you.

source: Thengtah-a kibeng chop cheh-in khatle khat kisalam un.
target: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

source: Mitheng jousen nasalamui.
target: All God’s people here send their greetings.

source: Pakai Jesu Christa lungsetnale, Pathen ngailutna, chule Lhagao Theng kithopina chun nabonchaovin umpiuvin. Amen.
target: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.

source: Mihem'a kon hilou, mihem vanga jong hilou, Jesu Christa le athi lah-a kona kaithouva Pa Pathen pansah solchah keima Paul,
target: Paul, an apostle—sent not from men nor by a man, but by Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

source: Chule kaumpi sopite chengsen Galatia'a um houbung ho hengah.
target: and all the brothers and sisters with me, To the churches in Galatia:

source: Pa Pathen le I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa-a konin lungset le lungmon nachung uva umhen;
target: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,

source: Ama chu i-Pathen'u le i-Pau lunggot bangtah-in, tulai vannoi phat louva kona hi eiho eihuh dohna dingun, eiho chonset manin ama akipetan ahi;
target: who gave himself for our sins to rescue us from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,

source: Loupina chu a-imatih chanin ama-a hijinghen. Amen.
target: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

source: Tule tu kahseh-a Christa milungsetna-a nakou paova kona thupha chombeh lama nakai jengu chu kidang kasa lheh jenge.
target: I am astonished that you are so quickly deserting the one who called you to live in the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel—

source: Hichu thupha chomdang jong ahisampoi; ahinla mi phabep khat aumun, amaho chun nangho nasuh boijuva chule Christa Thupha hi akaleh-a hei ding agotnu ahi.
target: which is really no gospel at all. Evidently some people are throwing you into confusion and are trying to pervert the gospel of Christ.

source: Ahin keihon nangho henga kahung seiju Kipana Thupha hilou, akalvala thupha chomdang hung seija aumle, keiho hiuving, van'a hungkon vantil khattou hijeng jongle, ama chu sapset chang hen.
target: But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel other than the one we preached to you, let them be under God’s curse!

source: Masanga kasei banguva kasei kit ahi, nanghon najopsao kipana Thupha chu hilouva, thupha chomdang naheng uva hung seija aumle, ama chu sapset changhen.
target: As we have already said, so now I say again: If anybody is preaching to you a gospel other than what you accepted, let them be under God’s curse!

source: Keima tu-a hi mihem jola kahim, Pathen jola kahim? Ole mihem lunglhaisah ding go-a kihabol kahim? Mihem lunglhaina ding holnalai kahile, Christa soh hilou kahi ding ahi.
target: Am I now trying to win the approval of human beings, or of God? Or am I trying to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a servant of Christ.

source: Chuti chu ahin, sopite, keiman kahil Thupha thudol hi kahetsah nahiuve, hiche hi mihem lam dol thu ahipoi.
target: I want you to know, brothers and sisters, that the gospel I preached is not of human origin.

source: Mihem'a kona kamu jong ahipoi, min eihil jong ahipoi, Jesu Christan aphondoh-a kona kamu ahibouve.
target: I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it; rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ.

source: Malaija Juda mite houdan-a kachon laija kanunchan kakhanchan thu chu najakhataove, Pathen houbung chu teptena kalvala bolsea sumang dinga bola kahi;
target: For you have heard of my previous way of life in Judaism, how intensely I persecuted the church of God and tried to destroy it.

source: Chule kapu kapate hou lama katompan behseh jeh-a, Juda te hou danthu lama kanam sunga kakhang golpi tamtah kakho khel ahi.
target: I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my own age among my people and was extremely zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

source: Ahivangin kanu oisunga kaum laija pat eisepkhena leh amilungsetna-a eikou Pathen'in,
target: But when God, who set me apart from my mother’s womb and called me by his grace, was pleased

source: Kipana Thupha chidang namdangho lah-a kaphon jal ding adeija, achapa keija phondoh ding agotchun, keiman tahsaphe le thisan kadongpai jengpon,
target: to reveal his Son in me so that I might preach him among the Gentiles, my immediate response was not to consult any human being.

source: Jerusalem'a keima sanga solchah himasaho henga jong kachepoi; ahin Arabia gama kachen, chuin Damascus'a kahung kile kittan ahi.
target: I did not go up to Jerusalem to see those who were apostles before I was, but I went into Arabia. Later I returned to Damascus.

source: Chujou kum thum nungin Jerusalem'a Peter toh kimuto dingin kagache touvin, chule nisom le ninga akomah kaga ume.
target: Then after three years, I went up to Jerusalem to get acquainted with Cephas and stayed with him fifteen days.

source: Ahivangin solchah ho lah-a khatcha kamupoi, Pakai naopa Jacob bou kamui.
target: I saw none of the other apostles—only James, the Lord’s brother.

source: Thu hicheng naheng uva kahinsut hi, veuvin, Pathen maikoh-a kasei ahi, jou seija kahipoi.
target: I assure you before God that what I am writing you is no lie.

source: Chuche jou chun keima Syria le Cilicia gamkol sunga kachetan ahi.
target: Then I went to Syria and Cilicia.

source: Chule hiche geija chu Juda gama Christa-a um houbung ho mel het louva umnalai kahi;
target: I was personally unknown to the churches of Judea that are in Christ.

source: Masanga eiho eibol sepao chun, tun khatvei suhmang dinga anagotsa tahsan thu chu alhang samlei, tibou chu ajah-u ahi;
target: They only heard the report: “The man who formerly persecuted us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy.”

source: Chule keima jeh-a Pathen achoi-atnu ahi.
target: And they praised God because of me.

source: Chujou kum somle kum li jouvin Titus jong kapuijin Barnabas toh Jerusalem'a kagachetou kit lhonin ahi.
target: Then after fourteen years, I went up again to Jerusalem, this time with Barnabas. I took Titus along also.

source: Chule akilangdoh dungjuija gachetouva kahi; chuin Kipana thupha chidang namdangho lah-a kaseiphongle hi, chua um miho jah-a chun kakhelhan kaseitan ahi, ahinla ginle ja umho jah-a vang chun atum beh-in kaseijin ahi, hichu ajole kalhai hi ijem tia moh lhaija hikhange tia kahi.
target: I went in response to a revelation and, meeting privately with those esteemed as leaders, I presented to them the gospel that I preach among the Gentiles. I wanted to be sure I was not running and had not been running my race in vain.

source: Ahin kalhonpi Titus chu Greek mi ahi jeng vang chun, cheptansah ding agokhoh pouve;
target: Yet not even Titus, who was with me, was compelled to be circumcised, even though he was a Greek.

source: chule hichu eisoh chansah theina dinguva, Christa Jesu'a ontholna ineiju velhiho dinga guhthima sopi lhemho hinpoh lut ahibouve.
target: This matter arose because some false believers had infiltrated our ranks to spy on the freedom we have in Christ Jesus and to make us slaves.

source: Kipana thupha thutah hi nangho-a aum jom jing theina dingin, nidan kah khat jengcha jong athu noijuva anakikhum lut louhel kahiuve.
target: We did not give in to them for a moment, so that the truth of the gospel might be preserved for you.

source: Ahivangin ginle ja uma kiseiho lah-a chun (itobang hijongleu, kei kakin akhohpoi; Pathen'in mi koima adatpoi), ginle ja uma kiseiho chun imacha eiseipehbe chompouve;
target: As for those who were held in high esteem—whatever they were makes no difference to me; God does not show favoritism—they added nothing to my message.

source: Seipehbe tah sangin cheptanho dinga Peter ahi banga, cheptan louho dinga keima kahia, Kipana Thupha chu ginchat tah-a eikipeh-a eikinganse chu aheuvin.
target: On the contrary, they recognized that I had been entrusted with the task of preaching the gospel to the uncircumcised, just as Peter had been to the circumcised.

source: (Cheptanho solchah-a pang dinga Peter dinga thilbola chun, chidang namdangho solchah-a pang dinga keima dinga thil eibolpeh ahin);
target: For God, who was at work in Peter as an apostle to the circumcised, was also at work in me as an apostle to the Gentiles.

source: Lungsetna eikipeh chu ahettoh phatnun, Jacob, Cephas, chule John aminche houbung khomho chengsen keimale Barnabas amaho kithopi tin, amaho cheptanho henga acheuve, keini cheptan louho henga kache lhonna dingin, akhut jet lamin eisangjovin ahi;
target: James, Cephas and John, those esteemed as pillars, gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship when they recognized the grace given to me. They agreed that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcised.

source: Mivaichate geldoh jingna ding thu themkhat eiseipeh-un, hichu kei jong abolding kalunggot lheh ahinai.
target: All they asked was that we should continue to remember the poor, the very thing I had been eager to do all along.

source: Ahivangin Antioch kho-a Peter ahung chun themona anei jeh-in kanapho lon ahi.
target: When Cephas came to Antioch, I opposed him to his face, because he stood condemned.

source: Ajeh chu aman Jacob koma kona mi koi koiham phabep ahung masangun, chidang namdangho toh an anekhomjin; amaho hung phatnin, cheptanho akichan akinung khinin akitum sahtan ahi.
target: For before certain men came from James, he used to eat with the Gentiles. But when they arrived, he began to draw back and separate himself from the Gentiles because he was afraid of those who belonged to the circumcision group.

source: Chule Juda mi dangho chengse jong amatoh hitobangtah chun aphalhemun, aphat lhemnao chun Barnabas kisan jong amaho lamah akai tan ahi.
target: The other Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that by their hypocrisy even Barnabas was led astray.

source: Ahivangin amaho Kipana Thupha thutah dola chu lungkitah-a achon louvu chu kamun, mi jouse maikoh-a Peter kasosalin, Nangma bon Juda mi hija Juda mi chona chon louva chidang namdangho chona chona chu, ibola chidang namdangho Juda mi chona chonsahtei go-a nahim? katin ahi.
target: When I saw that they were not acting in line with the truth of the gospel, I said to Cephas in front of them all, “You are a Jew, yet you live like a Gentile and not like a Jew. How is it, then, that you force Gentiles to follow Jewish customs?

source: Eiho apena Juda mi ihiuve, eiho chidang namdang michonseho ihipouve;
target: “We who are Jews by birth and not sinful Gentiles

source: Ahinla eihon danthu lam thilbol vanga hilouva, Jesu Christa-a tahsan vangabou michonpha tia kisim ahi, ti iheuve; hiche jeh-a chu eiho jong Jesu Christa itahsanu ahi, chutia chu danthu lam thilbol vanga hilouva, Christa tahsan vanga chonpha tia ikisim dingu ahi; ajeh chu danthu lam thilbol vanga koima chonpha tia kisim lou ding ahi.
target: know that a person is not justified by the works of the law, but by faith in Jesus Christ. So we, too, have put our faith in Christ Jesus that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because by the works of the law no one will be justified.

source: Ahin Christa vanga chonpha-a kisimna dinga ikihabol vanguva jong chonset na-a ilhahjiu ahin, ahile Christa chu chonset lhachaham? Ahipoi.
target: “But if, in seeking to be justified in Christ, we Jews find ourselves also among the sinners, doesn’t that mean that Christ promotes sin? Absolutely not!

source: Keiman kaphetsa chu sapha kitleng asukhela kahi, ti chu photchen sah kahi.
target: If I rebuild what I destroyed, then I really would be a lawbreaker.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Pathen lama kahinna dinga, danthu dola danthu lama athia kahitai.
target: “For through the law I died to the law so that I might live for God.

source: Keima Christa toh thingpel'a kikhetbeh tha-a kahitai; keima ahinga kahitapoi, Christa chu keija hinga ahibouve; tu-a tahsaphe-a kahin hi keima eingailua, keima dinga kipedoh Pathen Chapa tahsan vanga chu hinga kahibouve.
target: I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I now live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.

source: Pathen milungset moh kahisahpoi; ijeh-inem itile chonphatna chu danthu lam thilbol vanga ahile, Christa chu ajeh beija moh thia ahitai, kati.
target: I do not set aside the grace of God, for if righteousness could be gained through the law, Christ died for nothing!”

source: Vo lungthimbei Galatia miho, namitmu tah uva Jesu Christa thingpel'a akikhetbeh chu kichentah-a nalah uva kiphongdoh ahitai; thutah-a nunlou nadia koiham najol lha uva?
target: You foolish Galatians! Who has bewitched you? Before your very eyes Jesus Christ was clearly portrayed as crucified.

source: Keiman nangho-a konin hiche thu maicha hi kahet nome, Lhagao nachanu chu danthua chona konham, tahsan thu najah uva konham?
target: I would like to learn just one thing from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by believing what you heard?

source: Nangho chutobang loma chu lungthimbeija nahiuvem? Lhagaova kipanna tahsa phe-a kichaija nahiu hitam?
target: Are you so foolish? After beginning by means of the Spirit, are you now trying to finish by means of the flesh?

source: Nanghon mohjen seh-a hesoh genthei nathoh-u hitam? hitichu ahile, moh jenseh tahbeh ahi.
target: Have you experienced so much in vain—if it really was in vain?

source: Lhagao napeuva chule nalah uva thilbol kidang boljia chun, danthua nachon jeh uva abol jiha, tahsan thujah jeh-a abolji ham?
target: So again I ask, does God give you his Spirit and work miracles among you by the works of the law, or by your believing what you heard?

source: Chutia chu, Abraham'in Pathen atahsana ahile, hichu ama dinga chonphat tia kisuna ahitai.
target: So also Abraham “believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.”

source: Hiche jeh chun atahsanho chengse chu Abraham chate ahiuve, ti heuvin.
target: Understand, then, that those who have faith are children of Abraham.

source: Pathen'in chidang namdangho chu tahsan vanga them achansah ding ahi ti chu ahemasan, Pathen lekhabun, Nangma-a kona chitinle namtin phattheina chang ding ahi, tia masang peh-a hiche thupha hi Abraham ana hetsahsa ahitai.
target: Scripture foresaw that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, and announced the gospel in advance to Abraham: “All nations will be blessed through you.”

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun tahsana kon chengse chu mi tahsan umtah Abraham chutoh phattheina chang khoma ahitaove.
target: So those who rely on faith are blessed along with Abraham, the man of faith.

source: Ajeh chu danthua chon chengse chu sapset changa ahiuve; ajeh chu hitin akisune, Koi hile danthubua kisun chengse nitjom jinglou chu sapset chang ding ahi.
target: For all who rely on the works of the law are under a curse, as it is written: “Cursed is everyone who does not continue to do everything written in the Book of the Law.”

source: Ahivangin danthua chonin Pathen anga koima them achangpoi, ti akichene; ajeh chu, Michonpha chu atahsan vanga hing ding ahi, kitia ahi;
target: Clearly no one who relies on the law is justified before God, because “the righteous will live by faith.”

source: Chule danthu chu tahsana kon ahipoi; ahinla danthu-a chona chu hichea chu hing ding ahi.
target: The law is not based on faith; on the contrary, it says, “The person who does these things will live by them.”

source: Christa chun danthu sapset chana-a kona eiho eihung lhatdoh-u ahitai, ajeh chu ama eiho khela sapset hung changa ahi; ijeh-inem itile, Thinga kikhai sang tapou chu sapset chang ahi, tin akisune;
target: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us, for it is written: “Cursed is everyone who is hung on a pole.”

source: Hichu Abraham phatthei chu Christa Jesu'a chidang namdangho heng alhuna, eihon tahsan vanga Lhagao chu ichan theina dinguva ahi.
target: He redeemed us in order that the blessing given to Abraham might come to the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, so that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit.

source: Sopite, keiman mihem thu seija kasei ahi; mihem kitepna mai mai ahivangin, min aphudet nungle koiman moh ahisah jipoi, chule koiman jong abelap jipoi.
target: Brothers and sisters, let me take an example from everyday life. Just as no one can set aside or add to a human covenant that has been duly established, so it is in this case.

source: Chuti ahi, thutep ho chu Abraham le achilhah kipe-a ahi. Aman tamtah seina bangin, Chule nachilhah ho, atipoi; khatseh seina bangin, chule nachilhah, atibouve; hichu Christa ahi.
target: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. Scripture does not say “and to seeds,” meaning many people, but “and to your seed,” meaning one person, who is Christ.

source: Tun hiche hi kasei ahi, Pathen'in amasanga kitepna khat Christa-a aphudetsa ahin, hichu kum jali le kum somthum nunga umdoh danthu chun kitepna chu moh ahi louna dingin, ason mangpon ahi.
target: What I mean is this: The law, introduced 430 years later, does not set aside the covenant previously established by God and thus do away with the promise.

source: Goulo ding chu danthu vanga ahile, thutep vanga hilouhela hi ding ahi; ahinla Pathen'in thutep vangin Abraham apetan ahi.
target: For if the inheritance depends on the law, then it no longer depends on the promise; but God in his grace gave it to Abraham through a promise.

source: Chuti ahile danthu hi ipi phatchomna ham? Thutepna chilhah chu ahung kahse-a dinga, suhkhel jeh-a hichu kibelap ahi; hichu vantil teho kimanga palai khat khutna kitungdoh ahitai.
target: Why, then, was the law given at all? It was added because of transgressions until the Seed to whom the promise referred had come. The law was given through angels and entrusted to a mediator.

source: Palai chu khat changa dinga palai ahipoi, Pathen vang khatsehbou ahi.
target: A mediator, however, implies more than one party; but God is one.

source: Chuti ahile, danthu hi Pathen thutep douvaham? Chuti ahipoi. Hinna pethei danthu kipe-a hile, dih tah-a chonphatna chu danthua kon hitei ding ahi.
target: Is the law, therefore, opposed to the promises of God? Absolutely not! For if a law had been given that could impart life, then righteousness would certainly have come by the law.

source: Ahin Jesu Christa tahsan vanga thutep chu atahsanho akipeh theina dinga, Pathen lekhabu thu chun ijakai chonset noija akhachah ahitai.
target: But Scripture has locked up everything under the control of sin, so that what was promised, being given through faith in Jesus Christ, might be given to those who believe.

source: Tahsan thu hung lhun masanga chu danthu noija eina kikoijuve, ahung kilang dinga um tahsan chu ngana-a kikha khuma inahiu ahi.
target: Before the coming of this faith, we were held in custody under the law, locked up until the faith that was to come would be revealed.

source: Hitia chu tahsan vanga chonphat ichan theina dinguva, Christa henga eipui dinguva, danthu chu eikaihoi juva anapanga ahibouve.
target: So the law was our guardian until Christ came that we might be justified by faith.

source: Tahsan thu hunglhun kal vang hin, chuche eikaihoi juva noija chu ihi tapouve.
target: Now that this faith has come, we are no longer under a guardian.

source: Christa Jesu'a natahsan uva kona chu nangho nabon chaova Pathen chate nahiu ahi.
target: So in Christ Jesus you are all children of God through faith,

source: Nangho Christa-a baptize chang chengse chun nabon chaova Christa chu nakivonu ahitai.
target: for all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.

source: Hichea chun Juda mi Greek mi aumtapoi, soh leh sohlou aumtapoi, chule numei le pasal jong aumtapoi; Christa Jesu'a chun nabon chaovin pumkhat nahitaove.
target: There is neither Jew nor Gentile, neither slave nor free, nor is there male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

source: Chule nangho Christa-a nahiule Abraham son nahiuve, thutep bangtah-a chu gou lo ding nahiuve.
target: If you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.

source: Ahin keiman kasei chu, goulo ding chu chapang ahi laisen, imajouse pakai ahi jeng vangin, ama chu sohtoh imachom ahipoi;
target: What I am saying is that as long as an heir is underage, he is no different from a slave, although he owns the whole estate.

source: Ahin apan athutep alhin phat kahsen, akaihoile a-inngahho thu noija aumjin ahi.
target: The heir is subject to guardians and trustees until the time set by his father.

source: Eiho jong chutobanga chu ichapan laijuva, vannoi leiset lekhajem bul noija sohchanga ina-umu ahi;
target: So also, when we were underage, we were in slavery under the elemental spiritual forces of the world.

source: Ahivangin phat ahung lhintah-in, Pathen'in achapa chu numei sunga soh, danthu noija peng dingin ahin soltan;
target: But when the set time had fully come, God sent his Son, born of a woman, born under the law,

source: Chapate hina ichan theina dinguva, danthu noija umho lhatdoh dingin.
target: to redeem those under the law, that we might receive adoption to sonship.

source: Chule nangho chate nahi jeh uva chu, Abba, Hepa, tia kouji Achapa Lhagao chu Pathen'in nalung sunguva ahinsol ahi.
target: Because you are his sons, God sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, the Spirit who calls out, “ Abba, Father.”

source: Hiche jeh-a chu nangma soh hita louva, chapa nahi ahitai; chule chapa nahile, Christa vanga Pathen goulo ding jong nahi.
target: So you are no longer a slave, but God’s child; and since you are his child, God has made you also an heir.

source: Ahi jeng vangin Pathen nahet lou laijuva chu, apen umchana pathen hilouho soh nanahiu ahi.
target: Formerly, when you did not know God, you were slaves to those who by nature are not gods.

source: Ahin tun Pathen nahet nunguva, ahiloule Pathen hetjong nahi nunguva, i-atileh lekhajem bul hatmotah soh-a lutkit dinga nakihei kit jenguham?
target: But now that you know God—or rather are known by God—how is it that you are turning back to those weak and miserable forces? Do you wish to be enslaved by them all over again?

source: Nanghon ni, lha, kum kihei, kum nanit jiuvin ahi.
target: You are observing special days and months and seasons and years!

source: Nangho dinga katohgimna ijem tin moh hinte, ti nangho dingin katijan ahi.
target: I fear for you, that somehow I have wasted my efforts on you.

source: Sopite, keima nangho banga kaumtah banghin, nangho keima bang hin umun tia kangeh nahiuve. Nanghon ahilouvin neibol pouvin ahi.
target: I plead with you, brothers and sisters, become like me, for I became like you. You did me no wrong.

source: Ahin katahsaphe hatmo jeh-a amasa-a Kipana Thupha nangho kahil chu nanghon naheuve.
target: As you know, it was because of an illness that I first preached the gospel to you,

source: Kasa chunga nangho dinga lhepna um chu nahsahmon nabolpouvin, the jong nathe pouve; Pathen vantil khat bangle, Christa Jesu bang helin neinalem jouvin ahi.
target: and even though my illness was a trial to you, you did not treat me with contempt or scorn. Instead, you welcomed me as if I were an angel of God, as if I were Christ Jesus himself.

source: Chuti ahile chuche laija naseiju vangpha nakisah nao chu hoilam hitam? Na-umchan dol thu-u kahettohsah-a kasei ahi, hi theile namitchang sanu nakaldoh uva neipeh dingu ahi.
target: Where, then, is your blessing of me now? I can testify that, if you could have done so, you would have torn out your eyes and given them to me.

source: Chuti ahile keiman najah uva thutah kasei jeh-a hi, nagalu kahi hitam?
target: Have I now become your enemy by telling you the truth?

source: Amahon apha lama tompan tah-a nangho naholu ahipoi; nanghon amaho nahol theina dinguva, nangho chu polama kha khumden ding angaitou ahibouve.
target: Those people are zealous to win you over, but for no good. What they want is to alienate you from us, so that you may have zeal for them.

source: Ahin a-imatih chana apha lam hola tompan hi aphai; nakom uva kaum pet jenga hilouvin, imatih chanin aphai.
target: It is fine to be zealous, provided the purpose is good, and to be so always, not just when I am with you.

source: Kanaote, nangho-a Christa lim asodoh kahse-a, keiman nangho dinga naosonat kathoh kit ahi;
target: My dear children, for whom I am again in the pains of childbirth until Christ is formed in you,

source: Chule tun nangho koma hunga aw chombeh-a thusei kanom ngeijin ahi; ajeh chu nangho chungchang thu kadatmoi.
target: how I wish I could be with you now and change my tone, because I am perplexed about you!

source: Vo danthu noija umnom teho, seijun, nanghon danthu hi najah khah lou uham?
target: Tell me, you who want to be under the law, are you not aware of what the law says?

source: Hitin akisune, Abraham'in chapa ni aneijin, asohnu sunga peng khat ahin, khat chu soh hilounu sunga peng ahi.
target: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and the other by the free woman.

source: Sohnu-a chu tahsaphe lam dola peng ahin, chamlhatnu-a vang chu thutep vanga penga ahi.
target: His son by the slave woman was born according to the flesh, but his son by the free woman was born as the result of a divine promise.
