target: Now I rejoice in what I am suffering for you, and I fill up in my flesh what is still lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions, for the sake of his body, which is the church.

source: Pathen thu subulhit dinga, nangho-a dinga keima eikipe Pathen gouchin dungjui bangtah-a, chuche lhachale-a chu eikipansah ahi;
target: I have become its servant by the commission God gave me to present to you the word of God in its fullness—

source: Chuche thugil chu akhang akhanga ki-ima thuguh chu ahin, tu-a vang amithengte henga kiphong jala ahitai.
target: the mystery that has been kept hidden for ages and generations, but is now disclosed to the Lord’s people.

source: Chidang namdangho lah-a chuche thuguh gou loupi chu ipiham ti chu Pathen'in amaho henga hetsah nom ahi; hiche gou loupi chu nangho-a um Christa chu ahi, ama chu kinepna loupi ahi.
target: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

source: Ama thu chu kahilu ahi, mi jouse hi Christa Jesu'a aphat chamkima Pathen anga kadinsah theina dinguva, kachihna jouseuva amitakip kapholeuva ami jouse kahilu ahi:
target: He is the one we proclaim, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom, so that we may present everyone fully mature in Christ.

source: Chutia chu keima-a nasatah-a athilbol thei thahat dungjuija chu, keima jong thohgima hatah-a kiseh kahi.
target: To this end I strenuously contend with all the energy Christ so powerfully works in me.

source: Ajeh chu nangho le Laodicea umho, chule tahsa-a kamel muloulai ho chengse dinga keima nasatah-a kaki habol hi heleu chun kalung ahi;
target: I want you to know how hard I am contending for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not met me personally.

source: Chutia chu alungu lhep lungmonga aumuva, ngailutna-a akikhi gom theijuva, hetchenna dimset gouva chu ahaodoh theijuva, Pathen thugil, Pa le Christa chu ahetdoh theina dingun;
target: My goal is that they may be encouraged in heart and united in love, so that they may have the full riches of complete understanding, in order that they may know the mystery of God, namely, Christ,

source: Ama-a chu chihnale hetna gou jouse kisela ahi.
target: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

source: Hiche hi koiman seithema nalhep lhah louna dinguva kasei ahi.
target: I tell you this so that no one may deceive you by fine-sounding arguments.

source: Tahsa-a nalah uva kaum lou jeng vangin lhagaovin kaume, kipahtah-in nachondih jeule Christa-a natahsan detjeu kamu jinge.
target: For though I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit and delight to see how disciplined you are and how firm your faith in Christ is.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun nanghon Christa Jesu, Pakai chu, nalah bangu chun, ama jengah chonun;
target: So then, just as you received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to live your lives in him,

source: Ama-a chun jungkhovin chule kisadoh-un, chule natahsan naova chun kiphut doh-un, nakihilu bang chun, hichea chun thangvahna dimin umun.
target: rooted and built up in him, strengthened in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.

source: Chingtheijun, achuti louva ahile khat touvin Christa thua tobang hilouvin, mihem thugouchin le vannoi leiset lekhajem bul ho-a kon chihgut lekha themna le doha lhahna moh thua nasuse getnunte.
target: See to it that no one takes you captive through hollow and deceptive philosophy, which depends on human tradition and the elemental spiritual forces of this world rather than on Christ.

source: Ajeh chu Ama-a chu Pathen hina jouse chamkimna tahsa-a banga cheng ahi;
target: For in Christ all the fullness of the Deity lives in bodily form,

source: Chule nangho hichea chu kisuchamkima nahiuve, ama chu piputle thuneina jouse luchang ahi.
target: and in Christ you have been brought to fullness. He is the head over every power and authority.

source: Ama-a chu nangho khutna cheptan hilouva cheptan nahiu ahi, tahsaphe chonset naho tahsa chu ponsil pailhah banga kipai lha-a, Christa-a cheptan nahiu ahitai.
target: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not performed by human hands. Your whole self ruled by the flesh was put off when you were circumcised by Christ,

source: Na baptize chanuva chu amatoh lhana kivuitha-a nahitaove, chuche baptize chan vang mama-a chu athi lah-a kona ama kaithouva Pathen thilbol tahsan vanga amatoh kaithoutha-a um nahitaove.
target: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through your faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

source: Chule suhkhelna leh tahsa-a cheptan louva thia nangho chu, Pathen'in nathemmonao jouse angaidama, thakhat tah-a ama chutoh nahinsah thau ahitai.
target: When you were dead in your sins and in the uncircumcision of your flesh, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our sins,

source: Chule eidoudal uva ichunguva batna lekhasut danthua kisun chu anoimanga, athingpela thingkila akhetbehtha-a asuhbei ahitai;
target: having canceled the charge of our legal indebtedness, which stood against us and condemned us; he has taken it away, nailing it to the cross.

source: Chule piputna le thu neina jouse alelhah-a, hichengse chu ajoa, amaho chengse chu kilangtah-a avetsah ahitai.
target: And having disarmed the powers and authorities, he made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them by the cross.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun anneh thua ahim, don thua ahim, kut nikho thua ahim, lhathah nikho thua ahim, chule cholngah ni thua ahimin, koiman nangho na-oimo daohen.
target: Therefore do not let anyone judge you by what you eat or drink, or with regard to a religious festival, a New Moon celebration or a Sabbath day.

source: Hitiho jouse chu khonunga hunglhung ding thudol lim ahibouve: ahin tahsa chu Christa-a ahi.
target: These are a shadow of the things that were to come; the reality, however, is found in Christ.

source: Nasan dingu tohphat man chu chonnemna lhem le vantil ho hou, athil mulou houva chengdena, atahsa lungu ahomkeova kimoh choisang,
target: Do not let anyone who delights in false humility and the worship of angels disqualify you. Such a person also goes into great detail about what they have seen; they are puffed up with idle notions by their unspiritual mind.

source: Atahsa pumpi kivah khangna, agu kisuhto na-a kikilmat tona, Pathen khansah-a akhana aluchang chu atuhdet louva mihem koimacha chom mangsah hihhelun.
target: They have lost connection with the head, from whom the whole body, supported and held together by its ligaments and sinews, grows as God causes it to grow.

source: Chutia chu vannoi leiset lekhajembula kona chu Christa toh thitha nahitah uva ahile, leiset hinna-a hingnalai banga ibola danthu noija lutna,
target: Since you died with Christ to the elemental spiritual forces of this world, why, as though you still belonged to the world, do you submit to its rules:

source: (Tham hih-in, tep hih-in, tongkha hih-in tiho;
target: “Do not handle! Do not taste! Do not touch!”?

source: Hichengse chu imanchah laija mangthah jeng ahi;) mihem thuhil hole thupeh noija um nalai nahiuvem?
target: These rules, which have to do with things that are all destined to perish with use, are based on merely human commands and teachings.

source: Hiche thilho hin lungchama hou, chonnemna, chule tahsa khoto louna thilbola chihna aneijin; ahinla tahsa ngaichat kitimna lama imacha phatchomna aneipoi.
target: Such regulations indeed have an appearance of wisdom, with their self-imposed worship, their false humility and their harsh treatment of the body, but they lack any value in restraining sensual indulgence.

source: Hijeh chun nangho Christa toh kaithoutha-a um nahiule, Pathen jet lama tou jinga Christa umna chung lam thu jengbou chu ha holun.
target: Since, then, you have been raised with Christ, set your hearts on things above, where Christ is, seated at the right hand of God.

source: Leiset thu geldaovin, chung lam thu jengbou gelun.
target: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.

source: Nangho athisa nahiu ahin, nahinnao chu Christa toh Pathen'a kisela ahi.
target: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.

source: Ihinnao Christa ahung kilah tengle, amatoh thakhat tah-a nangho jong loupitah-a kilangdoh ding nahiuve.
target: When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with him in glory.

source: Hijeh chun nanghon leiset chunga natibah chengseu: jon, thenlou, huh, gitlou lungtup, papset, hichu milim hou ahin, hicheng chu thisah gamun.
target: Put to death, therefore, whatever belongs to your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires and greed, which is idolatry.

source: Hicheng jeh chun thua nunglou chate chunga Pathen lungsat achujin ahi.
target: Because of these, the wrath of God is coming.

source: Masanga nangho chuchenga nahin laijuva chu, nangho jong chutihoa chu anachonjia nahiu ahi.
target: You used to walk in these ways, in the life you once lived.

source: Ahin tun lungsat, lunghan, mitthip, houset, taitom, kam sunga kona thujahmo sei, hicheng jong chu paimangun.
target: But now you must also rid yourselves of all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.

source: Khatle khat thujouvin kihou hih-un; ajeh chu nanghon hicheng chu anatoh puma mi lui chu ponse lelhah banga nalelhahsao ahitai.
target: Do not lie to each other, since you have taken off your old self with its practices

source: Chule nasempao lim banga hetna-a kona kisemthah mithah chu nakivonu ahitai.
target: and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.

source: Hichea chu Greek mi le Juda mi, cheptan le cheptanlou, paomah hammah, Scythia mi, soh le ongthol umlouva ahitai; Christa chu ijakaija ijakai ahi.
target: Here there is no Gentile or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave or free, but Christ is all, and is in all.

source: Hiche jeh chun Pathen lhenchom mithengte le deitahte bangtah-in, khotona, hepina, kineosah, nunnem na, thohhat, hicheng chun kivonun;
target: Therefore, as God’s chosen people, holy and dearly loved, clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience.

source: Nangho khatle khat kidemdaito cheh-un; khatnin khat chunga themosahna ding thu naneijule kingaidam touvin; Christan nangho nangaidam bangu chun nanghon jong ngaidamun;
target: Bear with each other and forgive one another if any of you has a grievance against someone. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

source: Hicheng jouse chunga chun ngailutna kivonun; hichu kikankhomna chamkimpen ahi.
target: And over all these virtues put on love, which binds them all together in perfect unity.

source: Chule Pathen lungmonna chu nalunguva vaihom hen; hiche dinga chu nangho tipum khatna kikou nahiuve; chule thangvahna dimin um jingun.
target: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, since as members of one body you were called to peace. And be thankful.

source: Chihna jouse-a Christa thu chu nasunguva cheng dimset jinghen; tumgingtoh tho lan, hou lan, chule lhagao lan khatle khat kihilun kitilkhou touvin, lungsetna thua nalung gilun Pakai choiatnan la saovin.
target: Let the message of Christ dwell among you richly as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom through psalms, hymns, and songs from the Spirit, singing to God with gratitude in your hearts.

source: Chule thu lam ahin, natoh lam ahin, nabol chanu Pakai Jesu minin bolun; chule ama vangin Pa le Pathen thangvah jingin umun.
target: And whatever you do, whether in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

source: Numei ho, Pakaiya lomtah-in napasal teo thunoija umun.
target: Wives, submit yourselves to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

source: Pasal ho, na-inneipiteu ngailuvin, chule nunbol hih-un.
target: Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.

source: Chateho, nangho imalam jouse-a nulepa thun nungun; hichu Pakai lunglam ahi.
target: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this pleases the Lord.

source: Pateho, nanghon nachate chengu phin lunghang hih-un, ajole lunglhah nan neiget unte.
target: Fathers, do not embitter your children, or they will become discouraged.

source: Sohteho, nangho mitvet soh banga mihem lunglhaina hilouvin, lung thengsel le Pathen ging pumin, tahsa lam thudol ijakaija napakai te chengu thun nungun:
target: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything; and do it, not only when their eye is on you and to curry their favor, but with sincerity of heart and reverence for the Lord.

source: nabol chanu chu mihem dinga bol tobang hilouvin, Pakai dinga bol bangin lung gilin tah-in bolun;
target: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord, not for human masters,

source: Pakaiya kona goulona thilpeh nachan dingu chu heuvin; ajehchu Pakai natong nahiuve.
target: since you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as a reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.

source: Amavang koi hijongle thil dihlou bola chun athilbol dihlou man chu asan ding ahi: hichea hin maiphavet na aumpoi.
target: Anyone who does wrong will be repaid for their wrongs, and there is no favoritism.

source: Pakai teho, nanghon jong van'a Pakai khat naneiju chu heuvin lang, nasohteu dihkeicha le hoikeichan bolun.
target: Masters, provide your slaves with what is right and fair, because you know that you also have a Master in heaven.

source: Nangho taona-a pangdet jom jingin, thangvah toh thon kiging jingin umun.
target: Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful and thankful.

source: Chujongle ajeh-a henna kaumna Christa thugil hi kaseiphong theina diuva Pathen'in kot eihonpeh nadingun keiho dingin jong neitaokop jingun;
target: And pray for us, too, that God may open a door for our message, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ, for which I am in chains.

source: Chutile kaseiding bangtah-a kaphonjal thei ding ahi.
target: Pray that I may proclaim it clearly, as I should.

source: Chule phat kijenpet chu kichoh unlang, polama um miho lama chun chingtheijin chonun.
target: Be wise in the way you act toward outsiders; make the most of every opportunity.

source: Chule mijouse chu iti donbut ding ahi chu nahet theina dingun, nakihounao chu lungset thu beh jinghen, chi altoh bang jinghen.
target: Let your conversation be always full of grace, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone.

source: Pakaiya sopi deitah chule lhacha tahsan umtah le kasoh hikhompi Tychicus hin kaumchan jouse nangho hetsah naovin nate:
target: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He is a dear brother, a faithful minister and fellow servant in the Lord.

source: Kaumchan thu nahetna dinguva, chule ama hin nalungu amonsah theina dinga, hichena dinga chu ama hi naheng uva kahinsol ahi;
target: I am sending him to you for the express purpose that you may know about our circumstances and that he may encourage your hearts.

source: Nangho lah-a khat, tahsan umtah le sopi deitah Onesimus toh kahin solthan ahi. Amanin hikom thu umchan ijakai nahetsah naovinte.
target: He is coming with Onesimus, our faithful and dear brother, who is one of you. They will tell you everything that is happening here.

source: Kasoh chanpi Aristarchus'in salam napeuve, chule Barnabas tupa Mark jongin salam napeuve, (ama chungchang thua thupeh namutaovin; ama naheng uva ahunga ahile analemun;)
target: My fellow prisoner Aristarchus sends you his greetings, as does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. (You have received instructions about him; if he comes to you, welcome him.)

source: Chule Justus kiti Jesu'n jong salam napeuve, amaho hi cheptanho lah-a kon ahiuve. Hiteho bouhi Pathen gam chalna dinga kakithopi ahiuve; kalung monna amaho hi ahiuve.
target: Jesus, who is called Justus, also sends greetings. These are the only Jews among my co-workers for the kingdom of God, and they have proved a comfort to me.

source: Nangho lah-a khat Christa soh Epaphras'in salam napeuve; nangho Pathen lunglam jouse-a bukimle tahsan kichenna napandet theina dinguva, ama nangho dinga taona-a ponpan tah ahi.
target: Epaphras, who is one of you and a servant of Christ Jesus, sends greetings. He is always wrestling in prayer for you, that you may stand firm in all the will of God, mature and fully assured.

source: Ajeh chu nangho dingle Laodicea chule Hierapolis'a umho dinga ama hi gunchu lheh jeng ahi, ama thudol kahettohsahna hichu ahi.
target: I vouch for him that he is working hard for you and for those at Laodicea and Hierapolis.

source: Louthem deitah Luke le Demas'in jong salam napeuve.
target: Our dear friend Luke, the doctor, and Demas send greetings.

source: Laodicea um sopiteho, chule Nymphas le a-in'a kikhom houbung chu salam anapeuvin.
target: Give my greetings to the brothers and sisters at Laodicea, and to Nympha and the church in her house.

source: Chule nangho koma hiche lekha nasimjou tengule, Laodicea-a um houbung jong anasim sah-un; chutobang chun nanghon jong Laodicea'a kona lekha jong chu anasimun.
target: After this letter has been read to you, see that it is also read in the church of the Laodiceans and that you in turn read the letter from Laodicea.

source: Chule Archippus jah-a, Nangman Pakaiya namu lhacha natoh chu namolsona dingin chingtheijin, tin ana seijun.
target: Tell Archippus: “See to it that you complete the ministry you have received in the Lord.”

source: Kasalam bohna hiche lekha hi keima Paul'in kakhut tah-a kasut ahi. Nanghon kabulput hi geldoh jingun. Lungsetna-in na-umpiu hen. Amen.
target: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you.

source: Paul, Silvanus chule Timothy'n, Pa Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa-a um Thessalonica houbung mite hengah: i-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa-a kon lungsetna le chamna naheng uva umhen.
target: Paul, Silas and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.

source: Katao chanun nangho kamin phah uvin, nangho nabon chaova dingin Pathen kathangvah jingjiuve;
target: We always thank God for all of you and continually mention you in our prayers.

source: Keihon tahsana nathilbolu, ngailutna-a nathohgimu, chule I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa-a kinepna neija nathohhatnau chu i-Pathen'u le i-Pau anga sumil louhelin kageldoh jingui.
target: We remember before our God and Father your work produced by faith, your labor prompted by love, and your endurance inspired by hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.

source: Pathen'a sopi deitahho, lhendoh nahiu chu kaheuvin,
target: For we know, brothers and sisters loved by God, that he has chosen you,

source: Kathu hilu Kinepna Thupha hi thu keo jenga nahengu hung lhunga hilouvin, thilbol thei thahat le Lhagao Thenga hetna kichentah-a hungjoh ahi, keiho nangho dinga itobang mi kahiu nanghon nahenaove.
target: because our gospel came to you not simply with words but also with power, with the Holy Spirit and deep conviction. You know how we lived among you for your sake.

source: Chule nangho hesoh gentheina nasatah lah-a Lhagao Theng Kipana-a thu chu anasanga, keihole Pakai umchan tho-a nahitaove.
target: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, for you welcomed the message in the midst of severe suffering with the joy given by the Holy Spirit.

source: Chutia chu Macedonia le Achaia gama um atahsanho dinga vettoh-a jui dinga uma nahitaove.
target: And so you became a model to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.

source: Ajeh chu nangho-a kona Macedonia leh Achaia gam sunga Pakai thu chu jaldoh ahi, chule hiche jeng chu hilouvin, Pathen lama natahsan jeu chu gamtinah akithangtan ahi; keiho seisei angaipoi.
target: The Lord’s message rang out from you not only in Macedonia and Achaia—your faith in God has become known everywhere. Therefore we do not need to say anything about it,

source: Ajeh chu amahotah-in keiho umchan thudol nangho kom kahung lutjeu umchan, chule nangho Pathen hingle dihtah chu hou dinga,
target: for they themselves report what kind of reception you gave us. They tell how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God,

source: chule khonunga hung lhung ding lunghana kona eihuhdoh uva Achapa Jesu, athia kona akaithou chu, van'a kona ahung ding ngah dinga, milim houva kona Pathen lama nakiheijiu chu ahillhangleu ahi.
target: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead—Jesus, who rescues us from the coming wrath.

source: Chuti chu ahin, sopiteho, naheng uva kahungu chu moh ahipoi, ti nangho tah-in nahenaove;
target: You know, brothers and sisters, that our visit to you was not without results.

source: Ahin amasanga Philippi khopi-a hesoh genthei kathoh-a chule jachat umtah-a eikibol jenga jong, hichu nahetsao ahi; hangsana no-a Pathen Thupha chu nangho jah-a sei dinga ka Pathen uva hangtah-a kanapan-u ahi.
target: We had previously suffered and been treated outrageously in Philippi, as you know, but with the help of our God we dared to tell you his gospel in the face of strong opposition.

source: Ajeh chu kathu hilu hi suhkhela kon ahipoi, thenlouva kon jong ahipoi, doha-a jong ahipoi:
target: For the appeal we make does not spring from error or impure motives, nor are we trying to trick you.

source: Ahin Pathen'in aphai tia eitahsan jeh-a thupha vopsah dinga eigot bangtah-a thu kaseiju ahibouve; mihem lunglhaisah louva kalung sungu photoh Pathen lunglhaina kaseiju ahi.
target: On the contrary, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel. We are not trying to please people but God, who tests our hearts.

source: Imatih chana pachat lhem pan lou kahiuve, hichu nanghon naheuve, papset khuna-a jong mangji lou kahiuve, Pathen ahetoh ahi;
target: You know we never used flattery, nor did we put on a mask to cover up greed—God is our witness.

source: Christa solchah kahiu hi, thu neitah hiding kahiuvin, ahivangin nangho nahiuvin, mi dang ahin koimacha-a konin ginle ja kahol pouve.
target: We were not looking for praise from people, not from you or anyone else, even though as apostles of Christ we could have asserted our authority.

source: Nalah uva nunnem tah numei anaonoi pelaijin achate akhoukhah banga,
target: Instead, we were like young children among you. Just as a nursing mother cares for her children,

source: nangho kakhoto jeh uva Pathen Thupha jeng hilouva, nangho kadeitah-u nahitah jeh uva, keihon kahinna chengu kisana nangho peh ding kalungu ahi.
target: so we cared for you. Because we loved you so much, we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God but our lives as well.

source: Ajeh chu, sopiteho, katohgimle kagun chunao nalunguva aumnai; nangho koima chunga pohgih pohsah louna dinga, asun ajana na katoh jiuva najah uva Pathen Thupha kaseijiu ahi.
target: Surely you remember, brothers and sisters, our toil and hardship; we worked night and day in order not to be a burden to anyone while we preached the gospel of God to you.

source: Chule atahsan nangho lah-a thengtah-a, chonphatah-a, themona beija iti kachonum, ahetoh-a nangho nahiuvin, Pathen jong ahi;
target: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous and blameless we were among you who believed.

source: Chule Pathen gama dingle aloupina-a dinga nakou paova dinga lomtah-a nachonna dingu tia apan achate ahil banga,
target: For you know that we dealt with each of you as a father deals with his own children,

source: Keihon jong nangho amichangkima thu kahiluva, katilkhoujiuva, chule kahet tohsahjiu nahiuve, hichu nanghon naheuve.
target: encouraging, comforting and urging you to live lives worthy of God, who calls you into his kingdom and glory.

source: Chule hiche jeh jong hin tang louhelin Pathen kathangvah jingui, nanghon keiho-a kona thu, Pathen thu najah uva chu, mihem thu ahi tia hilouva, Pathen thu tia nalah-u ahibouve; hichu tahmong ahi, chujongle hiche chun atahsan nangho lah-a na atonge.
target: And we also thank God continually because, when you received the word of God, which you heard from us, you accepted it not as a human word, but as it actually is, the word of God, which is indeed at work in you who believe.

source: Ajeh chu, sopiteho, nangho Juda gama Christa-a um Pathen houbung ho umchan joma nahitaove; amahon Juda miho-a kona athoh banguva nanghon jong nagam miteuva kona chuto bangma chu nathoh-u ahitai:
target: For you, brothers and sisters, became imitators of God’s churches in Judea, which are in Christ Jesus: You suffered from your own people the same things those churches suffered from the Jews

source: Amaho chun Pakai Jesu jong athemgaohou jong athaova, chule keiho jong einomangu ahin, Pathen alunglhaisah louvu ahi, chule mi jousetoh kilekal ahiuve:
target: who killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets and also drove us out. They displease God and are hostile to everyone

source: Amahon keiho chidang namdangho huhhing-a aumna dinguva, thu kaseipeh dingu eikhamui; achonsetnao bukip molso jing ahiuve; ahinla lunghan khonna achunguvah achunai.
target: in their effort to keep us from speaking to the Gentiles so that they may be saved. In this way they always heap up their sins to the limit. The wrath of God has come upon them at last.

source: Ahin, sopiteho, lunga hilouva tahsa lama nang hotoh kikhena kaum tahdi jeh hin, kangai lutnun namaiju mu ding kaki habol chehjin ahi.
target: But, brothers and sisters, when we were orphaned by being separated from you for a short time (in person, not in thought), out of our intense longing we made every effort to see you.

source: Hichena ding chun, keiho ahideh chu keima, Paul, khatvei, nivei nangho heng lama hung ding kakigot ahitai, ahin Satan'in eisumojin ahi.
target: For we wanted to come to you—certainly I, Paul, did, again and again—but Satan blocked our way.

source: Ajehchu I-Pakaiyu Jesu ahung tengle a-angsunga kakinepnao, ahiloule kakipanao, ahiloule loupina lallukhuh chu ipi hiding ham? nangho nahi lou uham?
target: For what is our hope, our joy, or the crown in which we will glory in the presence of our Lord Jesus when he comes? Is it not you?

source: Ijeh inem itile tahbeh-in kaloupinaole kakipana dingu nangho nahiuve.
target: Indeed, you are our glory and joy.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu kathoh jou loutah phatnuva, Athen kho-a kachanga eikida lhah pha kasa taovin ahi;
target: So when we could stand it no longer, we thought it best to be left by ourselves in Athens.

source: hiche hesoh thoh jeh-a chu koima alunglao naum louna dinguva, nangho phutdet dingle tahsan thu lama nalungmon sah dinguva, Christa Thupha lama Pathen lhacha le isopiu chule itoh khompiu Timothy naheng uva kahinsolu ahi.
target: We sent Timothy, who is our brother and co-worker in God’s service in spreading the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you in your faith,

source: Ajeh chu hesoh thoh dinga pang kahiuve, hichu nanghon nahenaove.
target: so that no one would be unsettled by these trials. For you know quite well that we are destined for them.

source: Hesoh thoh ding ihiuve, tia masanga nangho koma kaum laijuva kaseisao ahi; chujouvin kati bang chun asohtan ahi, chule hichu nanghon naheuvin ahi.
target: In fact, when we were with you, we kept telling you that we would be persecuted. And it turned out that way, as you well know.

source: Hiche jehtah chun keiman jong kathoh theilou phatna, ajole lhem chun nangho lhemlha taleu chun katohgim nau moh hikhante, tia hiche jeh-a chu natahsan jeu chu he dinga kahinsolu ahi.
target: For this reason, when I could stand it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith. I was afraid that in some way the tempter had tempted you and that our labors might have been in vain.

source: Ahin tun Timothy nangho koma konin ahungin, Kipana Thupha, natahsan jeule nangailut jeu, chule nangho mu katup banga nanghon neimu nomu phatecha neigel doh jingu thu ahinpoh phat hin,
target: But Timothy has just now come to us from you and has brought good news about your faith and love. He has told us that you always have pleasant memories of us and that you long to see us, just as we also long to see you.

source: sopiteho, nangho tahsan thudola keiho kahesoh genthei naova kalung mongui;
target: Therefore, brothers and sisters, in all our distress and persecution we were encouraged about you because of your faith.

source: Ajeh chu tu-a nangho Pakaiya na-umdet jingule, keiho ahinga kahitaove.
target: For now we really live, since you are standing firm in the Lord.

source: Ajehchu i-Pathen'u anga nachung uva kakipanao jouse jeh-a hi, nangho chungchanga Pathen itobang tah-a kathang vah dingu hitam?
target: How can we thank God enough for you in return for all the joy we have in the presence of our God because of you?

source: Namaiju kamu theina dingu le natahsan bulhin lounao kasuhbulhit theina dingun, asun ajanin kaha tao dehset jengui.
target: Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you again and supply what is lacking in your faith.

source: Tun i-Pau Pathen'in chule I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christan nangho heng lama eipuijuhen.
target: Now may our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus clear the way for us to come to you.

source: Chule nangho kangailut bangu hin, Pakaiyin nangho khatle khat kingailutna le mi jouse ngailutna-a nabelap uhen lang, naletset sah-u hen.
target: May the Lord make your love increase and overflow for each other and for everyone else, just as ours does for you.

source: Chutile I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa amithengte jousetoh ahung tengle, i-Pau Pathen anga nalungthimu thenna lama themona beija aphudet ding ahi.
target: May he strengthen your hearts so that you will be blameless and holy in the presence of our God and Father when our Lord Jesus comes with all his holy ones.

source: Chuti ahile, sopite, achaina keijin, keihon Pakai Jesu'a nangho chu kajoluva katilkhou nahiuve, chutia chu Pathen lunglhaisah nadinga iti chon dingham ti thudol chu keiho-a kona nalah bangu chun chon jom jingun, neiletset jing jengun.
target: As for other matters, brothers and sisters, we instructed you how to live in order to please God, as in fact you are living. Now we ask you and urge you in the Lord Jesus to do this more and more.

source: Ajeh chu Pakai Jesu'a nangho ipi thupeh kapeh-u nanghon nahenaove.
target: For you know what instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.

source: Nangho jon na-a kona nakikangse uva naki suhtheng dingu chu Pathen lunglam ahi:
target: It is God’s will that you should be sanctified: that you should avoid sexual immorality;

source: Nangho amitakipmin thengsel le jabolin nabel cheh-u phatea kivopje heleu chun ahi;
target: that each of you should learn to control your own body in a way that is holy and honorable,

source: Pathen helou chidang namdangho banga huh pan louvin:
target: not in passionate lust like the pagans, who do not know God;

source: Chutichun chonvalin koiman hiche lamdola hin asopi dohan boldahen; ajeh chu masanga nangho kaseipehsao, kahettohsahsao banga chu, hitiho phula-a chu Pakai ahi.
target: and that in this matter no one should wrong or take advantage of a brother or sister. The Lord will punish all those who commit such sins, as we told you and warned you before.

source: Pathen'in eiho aboh dinga hilouva, atheng ding joh-a eikouvu ahibouve.
target: For God did not call us to be impure, but to live a holy life.

source: Hijeh chun ajop lou chun mihem ajop lou hita louvin, A-Lhagao Theng napepao Pathen chu ajop lou ahi.
target: Therefore, anyone who rejects this instruction does not reject a human being but God, the very God who gives you his Holy Spirit.

source: Kisopi ngailut thudola vang hinsun hih jong leng akhoh poi; ajeh chu khatle khat kingailut dingje Pathen'a kona kihilsate nahiuve.
target: Now about your love for one another we do not need to write to you, for you yourselves have been taught by God to love each other.

source: Chule Macedonia gama cheng sopite chunga hichu nabolu ahi. Ahivangin, sopite, katil nahiuve, haletnin neilet chehleu chun kati;
target: And in fact, you do love all of God’s family throughout Macedonia. Yet we urge you, brothers and sisters, to do so more and more,

source: Chule kathu peh bangu chun kangkhen cha umje kichuh-un, nangma kincheh kibolun chule nakhut tah-a nakitoh kihabol leuchun kati,
target: and to make it your ambition to lead a quiet life: You should mind your own business and work with your hands, just as we told you,

source: Chutile polama um miho chunga ngeikeicha naumthei dingu ahi, chule lhahsamna nanei louhel dingu ahi.
target: so that your daily life may win the respect of outsiders and so that you will not be dependent on anybody.

source: Sopiteho, kinepna bei midangho banga nangho lungkhama naum louna dingun, a-imumil teho thudol helouva naum dingu kanompoi.
target: Brothers and sisters, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you do not grieve like the rest of mankind, who have no hope.

source: Jesu athin athoudoh kit tai, ti hi itahsan uva ahile, Pathen'in Jesu'a ihmumil teho jong chu amatoh thakhatna ahinpui ding ahi, ti iheuve.
target: For we believe that Jesus died and rose again, and so we believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in him.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu Pakai thua kona hiche thuhi kaseipeh nahiuve, eiho Pakai hung geija anahing nalai chengse hi, a-imusaho sanga iti nama jongle masajo lou ding ihiuve.
target: According to the Lord’s word, we tell you that we who are still alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will certainly not precede those who have fallen asleep.

source: Ajeh chu Pakai chu amatah a-awtoh, vantil pipui awgintoh, chule Pathen sumkon gintoh kitho-a van'a kona hung kumlha ding ahi; chule Christa-a thisaho chengse thoudoh ding ahiuve;
target: For the Lord himself will come down from heaven, with a loud command, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet call of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first.

source: Chujoule eiho ahingnalai amoh chengse hi, amaho chengse chutoh vanlaijola Pakai lamto dinga mei kong'a toltouva i-um khom dingu; chule chutia chu a-imatih chana Pakai toh i-um khom jing dingu ahi.
target: After that, we who are still alive and are left will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will be with the Lord forever.

source: Hiche jeh chun hiti thu hin nangho khatle khat kilhamon touvin.
target: Therefore encourage one another with these words.

source: Ahivangin, sopiteho, hiche chu anikhole aphat thudol naheng uva hinsut ding angaipoi;
target: Now, brothers and sisters, about times and dates we do not need to write to you,

source: Ajeh chu jana gucha ahung banga, Pakai nikho chu hung ding ahi, hichu nanghon kichenin naheuve.
target: for you know very well that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.

source: Mihon, Chamnale lungmon, chule bitna aume, tia asei laitah-ule, numei naoso nat banga, phulou helouva manthah na chu achunguva hung chu phung jeng ding ahi; hitia chu amaho chu iti nama jongle sohcha louding ahiuve.
target: While people are saying, “Peace and safety,” destruction will come on them suddenly, as labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.

source: Ahivangin, sopiteho, gucha banga hiche nikho chu nachung uva ahung lhun ding chu, nangho muthima uma nahipouve;
target: But you, brothers and sisters, are not in darkness so that this day should surprise you like a thief.

source: Nangho nabonchaovin khovahle sunlai chate nahiuve; eiho janle muthim mi ihipouve.
target: You are all children of the light and children of the day. We do not belong to the night or to the darkness.

source: Hiche jeh chun, sopiteho, midangho banga imu louvin, limgehchan kihongpha jingin umu hite.
target: So then, let us not be like others, who are asleep, but let us be awake and sober.

source: A-imuho khu janlebou imujia ahiuve; chule jukhamho jong janlebou akhamjiuve.
target: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.

source: Eiho vang sunlai chate ihi jeh-un, tahsan leh ngailut ompho kivon thou hite, chule huhhinga um kinepna chu lukhuh-a neijin limgehchan hah jingin umu hite.
target: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on faith and love as a breastplate, and the hope of salvation as a helmet.

source: Ajeh chu eiho lungsat chuhna dinga hilouva, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa vanga huhhing chu ichan theina dinguva, Pathen'in eipansah-u ahi;
target: For God did not appoint us to suffer wrath but to receive salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.

source: Eiho hah jing jongleu hen imu jongleu hen, Christa toh ihinkhomna dinguva, ama eiho dinga thia ahitai.
target: He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with him.

source: Hijeh chun nabol bangu chun khatle khat kitilkhou touvin, kisadohton umun.
target: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.

source: Sopiteho, naheng uva kahung tao ahi, nalah uva natong gima, chule pakaiya nachung uva kitunga nangho natilkhou ho chu heuvin.
target: Now we ask you, brothers and sisters, to acknowledge those who work hard among you, who care for you in the Lord and who admonish you.

source: Amaho chu anatoh jal-u chun ngailutna-in hajan jabolun. Nangho kitohdel chehchan umun.
target: Hold them in the highest regard in love because of their work. Live in peace with each other.

source: Chule, sopiteho, kahintil nahiuve, angai dol louva chonho chu phohsalun, hilchah-un, alung doija tilkhou vun, ahatmo athadoi huvin lang, mijouse koma kido hatnun.
target: And we urge you, brothers and sisters, warn those who are idle and disruptive, encourage the disheartened, help the weak, be patient with everyone.

source: Chingtheijun, koiman setna chu setnan thuh hihhen; ahin khatle khat chule mijouse phatna ding bolnan kihabol cheh-un.
target: Make sure that nobody pays back wrong for wrong, but always strive to do what is good for each other and for everyone else.

source: Kipah thanom jingun;
target: Rejoice always,

source: tantih neilouvin taojingun;
target: pray continually,

source: imajousea thangvah jingin umun; hichu Jesu Christa-a nangho chunga Pathen lunglam ahi.
target: give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

source: Lhagao Theng chu sumit hih-un.
target: Do not quench the Spirit.

source: Lhagao thu seidoh ho chu musit hih-un.
target: Do not treat prophecies with contempt

source: Imalam jouse patep cheh-unlang apha chu tuhdet jingun:
target: but test them all; hold on to what is good,

source: aphalou jouse-a konin kikhin mangun.
target: reject every kind of evil.

source: Chule cham kona Pathen'in nangho kimkeijin thensah-un; chule I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hung tengle nangho chengse lhagao, nahinnao chule natahsao themona beijin koihen.
target: May God himself, the God of peace, sanctify you through and through. May your whole spirit, soul and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

source: Nangho nakoupao chu tahsan umtah ahi, ama chun hichu bolpeh naovin nate.
target: The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.

source: Sopiteho, keiho dingin neitao peh-un.
target: Brothers and sisters, pray for us.

source: Kibengchop thengin sopite jouse salam-un.
target: Greet all God’s people with a holy kiss.

source: Keiman nangho Pakaiya kahahsela hiche thuhi kapeh nahiuve, hiche lekha hi sopithengte jouse angah anasimun.
target: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers and sisters.

source: I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa milungsetnan umpiuvin, amen.
target: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

source: Paul, Silvanus, chule Timothy'n i-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Khrista-a um Thessalonica houbung mite hengah:
target: Paul, Silas and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

source: Pa Pathen le Pakai Jesu Khrista-a konin naheng uva lungsetna le lungmonna umhen.
target: Grace and peace to you from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

source: Sopiteho, natahsanu hakhana akhantouva chule nangho khatle khat kingailutna aletset tahjeh hin, nangho chungchanga Pathen kathangvah dingu hi kabol ding dolu ahin, kakin mongu ahi.
target: We ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters, and rightly so, because your faith is growing more and more, and the love all of you have for one another is increasing.

source: Hichea chun nanghon bolsetnale bol hesohna nathoh chengseova nathoh hatnaule natahsan jeh-u chun, keihon Pathen houbung ho chengsea nangho paopin kaneijui.
target: Therefore, among God’s churches we boast about your perseverance and faith in all the persecutions and trials you are enduring.

source: Pathen lenggama dinga lomma sim nahitheina dinguva, Pathen gam jeh-a nanghon hesoh genthei nathoh-u ahin, hichu Pathen chonphatna thutan dihtah kiphon dohna melchihna ahi.
target: All this is evidence that God’s judgment is right, and as a result you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.

source: Nahin sugenthei hochu gimhesoh na-a lethuh ding chu Pathen'a dinga thil dihtah mong ahi:
target: God is just: He will pay back trouble to those who trouble you

source: Chule nangho suhgentheija umho chu, Pakai Jesu athahat loupina vantil chengsetoh van'a kona ahung kilah teng, keiho toh thakhatna icholdo khom dingu;
target: and give relief to you who are troubled, and to us as well. This will happen when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven in blazing fire with his powerful angels.

source: Pathen helouhole I-Pakaiyu Jesu Khrista Thupha joplou chengse chunga meikong deujeju-a phu alah ding,
target: He will punish those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.

source: Pakai ang sunga konle athahat aloupina-a kona amaho chun tonsot manthah na talent athohgim dingu ahi.
target: They will be punished with everlasting destruction and shut out from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of his might

source: Hiche nikho chule ama amithengte-a loupi dingle atahsanho chengsea (Keiho thu hettohsah natahsanu ahitan) kidangtah-a choi-atna umdinga hungding ahi.
target: on the day he comes to be glorified in his holy people and to be marveled at among all those who have believed. This includes you, because you believed our testimony to you.

source: Hichejeh chun i-Pathen'un nangho nakikou nao toh kilom ahi tia ataija, chule thilpha jousele tahsan natohho jouse athahat athilbol theina-a alolhinsah theina dingin, keihon nangho dingin kataopeh jingui;
target: With this in mind, we constantly pray for you, that our God may make you worthy of his calling, and that by his power he may bring to fruition your every desire for goodness and your every deed prompted by faith.

source: chule i-Pathen'ule I-Pakaiyu Jesu Khrista milungsetna dungjuija, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Khrista min chu nangho-a choi-atna auma, chule nangho jong ama-a choi-atna naum theina dingu, katiu ahi.
target: We pray this so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

source: Sopiteho, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hung dingle ama koma ikikhop dingu thudola hichea hi naheng uva kangeh ahi,
target: Concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered to him, we ask you, brothers and sisters,

source: lhagao khattou sei ahiloule, keiho sei hi ahi, tia thu kiseija konin hijongle, keiho sut hi ahi, tia kei lekhathot khattou ahima kon hijongle, lunglinglao loi hih-un; Christa nikho chu ahung lhunga ahitai ti gel loujenun; lung jong lunggim hihhelun.
target: not to become easily unsettled or alarmed by the teaching allegedly from us—whether by a prophecy or by word of mouth or by letter—asserting that the day of the Lord has already come.

source: Koima imachan kilhep lhahsah hih-un; ajeh chu lhahmang na hung lhung masa ding, chule dan suse-a chonsepa, mangthah chapa chu, hung kiphongdoh ding,
target: Don’t let anyone deceive you in any way, for that day will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the man doomed to destruction.

source: ama chun dou apat ding, Pathen minpu jousele hou jouse chunga ama kichoi sanga, Pathen houin kisana jong hung touva hung ki pathen sah ding ahinalaije.
target: He will oppose and will exalt himself over everything that is called God or is worshiped, so that he sets himself up in God’s temple, proclaiming himself to be God.

source: Nakom uva kaum laija hiti thuho kasei jouse chu nageldoh lou uham?
target: Don’t you remember that when I was with you I used to tell you these things?

source: Chule ama chu ama phattah-a akiphondoh ding, ipin akham ahi nanghon naheuve.
target: And now you know what is holding him back, so that he may be revealed at the proper time.

source: Ajeh chu dan suhsetna thuguh chun tu-a jong hi na atoh jingsa ahi; lahmanga aum kahse-a hi atuhtanga khat uma ahibouve.
target: For the secret power of lawlessness is already at work; but the one who now holds it back will continue to do so till he is taken out of the way.

source: Chule hiche teng chule dan suse-a chu hung kiphongdoh ding ahi; ahinla Pakai kama kon lhagao chun ahalvam ma chule ama hung kilah-a chu asuhmang ding ahi.
target: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will overthrow with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the splendor of his coming.

source: Hichepa hung chu Satan natoh dungjuija thilbolthei thahat le melchihna chule jouthil kidang bol chengsetoh hung kitho ding ahi,
target: The coming of the lawless one will be in accordance with how Satan works. He will use all sorts of displays of power through signs and wonders that serve the lie,

source: chule amangthahho chengse chu chonphat louna jouse-a doha lhep lhah-a um ahiuve; hichu amahon huhhing-a aumna dinguva, ngailutna thutah chu alah lou jeh-u ahi.
target: and all the ways that wickedness deceives those who are perishing. They perish because they refused to love the truth and so be saved.

source: Chule hichena dinga hi Pathen'in amaho chunga chu suhkhel lamvaina natoh alhunsah ahi; chutia chu amahon thujou chu atahsan dingu;
target: For this reason God sends them a powerful delusion so that they will believe the lie

source: thutah tahsan louva chonset alunglam hijoho jouse thu kitan ding ahi.
target: and so that all will be condemned who have not believed the truth but have delighted in wickedness.

source: Amavang, Pakai ngailut sopiteho, nangho chungchanga imatihchana Pathen thangvah hi kakinu kabol ding dolu ahi; ajeh chu Lhagaova kona thenna-a chule thutah chu tahsan vanga atil abula pat Pathen'in huhhing-a umdinga nangho nalhenu ahi;
target: But we ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord, because God chose you as firstfruits to be saved through the sanctifying work of the Spirit and through belief in the truth.

source: Chule chuche lung ngaito-a chu I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa loupina chu chang thei dinga kathuhil-u Kipana Thupha-a nakouvu ahi.
target: He called you to this through our gospel, that you might share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

source: Hijeh chun, sopiteho, pangdet jingun, kathuseiju hijongle, lekha thot hijongle, kahilna chengseu hi abonchan tuhdet jingun.
target: So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold fast to the teachings we passed on to you, whether by word of mouth or by letter.

source: Tun I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa amatah-in, chule eingailua tonsot lungmonnale kinepna phatah lungset tah-a eipe-a, Pa Pathen chun nalungu monsah hen,
target: May our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and by his grace gave us eternal encouragement and good hope,

source: chule thilpha bolna lam jouse-ale thupha seijah nalungu chu phutdet jingun.
target: encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good deed and word.

source: Ajona-in, sopiteho, nangho lah-a banga chu Pathen thu gangtah-a achala aloupidohna dingin,
target: As for other matters, brothers and sisters, pray for us that the message of the Lord may spread rapidly and be honored, just as it was with you.

source: michonsehole migilouho khutna kona kasochat theina dingun, keiho dingin neitaopeh jiuvin; ajeh chu koijakai jousen tahsan na aneipoi.
target: And pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil people, for not everyone has faith.

source: Ahivangin Pakai chu tahsan umtah ahi; amatah chun naphudet dingu chule agilouva kona chu nahuhdoh dingu ahi.
target: But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.

source: Chule kathupeh chengseu chu nanit jingui, chule nit jong nit jingunate, ti Pakaiyah nangho thudol ginchat kaneijui.
target: We have confidence in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do the things we command.

source: Chule Pakai chun nalungu Pathen ngailutna lamale Christa thohhatna lama kaihoihen.
target: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.

source: Sopite, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa mina nangho hiche thuhi kapeh nahiuve, sopi koi hile dan ngailouva chona, chule keiho-a kona nakihilnao banga chon lou chu kivoppi hih-un.
target: In the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, we command you, brothers and sisters, to keep away from every believer who is idle and disruptive and does not live according to the teaching you received from us.

source: Nanghon keiho umchan natho dingu adol ahi chu nanghon nakihet naove; ajeh chu keiho nangho lah-a dan ngailouvin kachonpouve;
target: For you yourselves know how you ought to follow our example. We were not idle when we were with you,

source: Chule aman beijin koimacha an kanepouvin ahi; ahin nangho koima chunga poh gih pohsah louna dingin, sunle jan-in katong gimun pontho tah-in na katongun ahi;
target: nor did we eat anyone’s food without paying for it. On the contrary, we worked night and day, laboring and toiling so that we would not be a burden to any of you.

source: Hichu kahi thei lou jeh-u ahipoi; nanghon keiho umchan nathona dingu, nangho anga vettoh-a tho dinga kachuti chonu ahi.
target: We did this, not because we do not have the right to such help, but in order to offer ourselves as a model for you to imitate.

source: Natong nom lou chun an jong nehdahen, tia nalah uva kaum laija nangho thu kapehsa nahiuve.
target: For even when we were with you, we gave you this rule: “The one who is unwilling to work shall not eat.”

source: Ajeh chu nangho lah-a abang khat dan ngailouvin achonun, natong louvin mi natoh sinmon avahlen ahi, ti kajauve.
target: We hear that some among you are idle and disruptive. They are not busy; they are busybodies.

source: Hitobang mi chu Pakai Jesu Christa mina thu kapeh-a katil nahiuve, thipkhen chan na tonghen lang ama an kinehhen.
target: Such people we command and urge in the Lord Jesus Christ to settle down and earn the food they eat.

source: Sopiteho, nangho vang thilpha bol chimtih nei hih-un.
target: And as for you, brothers and sisters, never tire of doing what is good.

source: Chule hiche kalekha thot sunga kisun keiho thu ngailou chu nanghon ama chu melgelun, ama chu kivoppi, kiloipi daovin, ajachatna dingin;
target: Take special note of anyone who does not obey our instruction in this letter. Do not associate with them, in order that they may feel ashamed.

source: ahivangin melmah lungin gel hih-un; sopi tin tilkhoujovin.
target: Yet do not regard them as an enemy, but warn them as you would a fellow believer.

source: Tun chamle lungmon kona Pakai amatah-in imajousea nangho chamle lungmon pe jingun. Pakai chun nabonchaovin umpi jingun.
target: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.

source: Kasalamna hiche lekha hi keima Paul'in kakhut tah-a kasut ahi; lekha thot jouse amelchihna ahi, hitia hi kasutji ahi.
target: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand, which is the distinguishing mark in all my letters. This is how I write.

source: I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa milungset chun nabonchaovin umpi jingun, Amen.
target: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.

source: Eihuh hinguva Pathen le kinepna Pakai Christa Jesu thupeh dungjuija, Christa Jesu solchah, Paul'in,
target: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,

source: tahsana kachapa tahbeh Timothy hengah, i-Pau Pathen le Christa Jesu'a konin lungsetle khotona chule lungmon nachunga umhen.
target: To Timothy my true son in the faith: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

source: Macedonia gama kache kona, mi abang khatnin thuhil lamdang ahil louna dingule, moh thusim chule tan thei lou khanggui thu, hichun tahsanna Pathen gou chinna lama phatchomsah tahsih-a kinelna akonsahjoh ahi.
target: As I urged you when I went into Macedonia, stay there in Ephesus so that you may command certain people not to teach false doctrines any longer

source: Angaisah louna dinguva, nahilchah theina dinga, Ephesus kho-a umin, tia kangeh banga chu, tu-a jong kati ahi.
target: or to devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies. Such things promote controversial speculations rather than advancing God’s work—which is by faith.

source: Ahivangin thu kipeh lona pen chu lungthengle ase apha hetna pha chule tahsan kichen tah-a kon ngailut chu anei theina dinguva ahi.
target: The goal of this command is love, which comes from a pure heart and a good conscience and a sincere faith.

source: Hichenga kon chun mi kimkhat akihei mangin moh houlimna lama avah koitaove.
target: Some have departed from these and have turned to meaningless talk.

source: Athuseijula adih ahimonge tia atahtinao jong chu he louhelin, danthuhil ahi nomui.
target: They want to be teachers of the law, but they do not know what they are talking about or what they so confidently affirm.

source: Ahin dan hi adoltah-a nitpa ding chun aphai ti iheuve;
target: We know that the law is good if one uses it properly.

source: Ahinla dan hi michonpha dinga hilouva, dan sukeh thua nunglou, Pathen ngaisahlou chonseho, abohho athenglou, pathat, nuthat, mithat;
target: We also know that the law is made not for the righteous but for lawbreakers and rebels, the ungodly and sinful, the unholy and irreligious, for those who kill their fathers or mothers, for murderers,

source: mijong, palepa kikoi, mihem gu, mijou, chule jouva kihahsel; hiteho chengse dinga chule adang thuhilpha kicheh kaleh-a chon aumle, amaho chengse dinga chu kiphut ahi;
target: for the sexually immoral, for those practicing homosexuality, for slave traders and liars and perjurers—and for whatever else is contrary to the sound doctrine

source: Hiche hi pachat umtah Pathen loupina Kipana Thupha keima eikivopsah dungjuija ahi.
target: that conforms to the gospel concerning the glory of the blessed God, which he entrusted to me.

source: Keima thahat eipe-a I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa chu kathangvah jinge, ajeh chu Aman keima ginchat uma eingaitoa, alhacha-a eipansah ahitai;
target: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me strength, that he considered me trustworthy, appointing me to his service.

source: Tu masanga hou taitom kanahia, abolsea kanapana, susehat kanahi ahin: hinla tahsanlou jeh-a hettoh louva kanabol ahi jeh chun hepina kamutan ahi.
target: Even though I was once a blasphemer and a persecutor and a violent man, I was shown mercy because I acted in ignorance and unbelief.

source: Chule Christa Jesu'a tahsanna le ngailuttoh kitho-a I-Pakaiyu milungset chu hadima dimlet ahitai.
target: The grace of our Lord was poured out on me abundantly, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.

source: Michonseho huhhing-a Jesu Christa vannoi leisetna hunga ahi, ti tahsan umtah hi mi jousen san cheh ding doltah ahi; hicheho lah-a chu keima apipen kahi;
target: Here is a trustworthy saying that deserves full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners—of whom I am the worst.

source: Ahin tonsotna hinna dinga Ama hintahsan dingho chun avettoh-a ajom dinguva, Jesu Christa'n athohhatna chengse chu apipen keija hi alahdoh theina dinga eihepi ahi.
target: But for that very reason I was shown mercy so that in me, the worst of sinners, Christ Jesus might display his immense patience as an example for those who would believe in him and receive eternal life.

source: Tun tonsot Leng kem theilou, mu theilou, chule Pathen chingtah khatseh, ginnale jana chule aloupina chu atonsot atonsot khangin umjinghen. Amen.
target: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honor and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

source: Kachapa Timothy, nangma tahsan neitahle ase apha hetna phatah neija, nangma umchan ding thudol masanga kiseisa chengse chu, hiche dungjuija chu phatah-a gal nasat theina dinga, hiche thupeh chu nangma kapeh nahi;
target: Timothy, my son, I am giving you this command in keeping with the prophecies once made about you, so that by recalling them you may fight the battle well,

source: Abang bangin chuche tahsan leh ase apha hetna chu apailhah jeh-un atahsan kong-u akehgamtai.
target: holding on to faith and a good conscience, which some have rejected and so have suffered shipwreck with regard to the faith.

source: Amaho lah-a Hymenaeus le Alexander chu taitomna akisin lhon louna dinga, keiman Satan khutna kapehdoh ahitai.
target: Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan to be taught not to blaspheme.

source: Hijeh-a chu amasapena katilkhou nahiuve, mijouse-a dingin taona, thumna, chule taopehna toh thon thangvah jingin umu hite;
target: I urge, then, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercession and thanksgiving be made for all people—

source: Lengho dingin, chule panmun len tuhho dingin; chutia chu eiho Pathen ngaisahna le jabolna lam jouse-a chamdel le lungmong ikhosah theina dingun.
target: for kings and all those in authority, that we may live peaceful and quiet lives in all godliness and holiness.

source: Hichu eihuh hinguva Pathen mitmu-a phatah le lahthei ahi;
target: This is good, and pleases God our Savior,

source: Aman mijouse huhhing-a aumding le thutah hetna lama ahungcheh diu adei ahi.
target: who wants all people to be saved and to come to a knowledge of the truth.

source: Pathen khatsehbou ahin, chule Pathen le mihem kah-a palai jong khatsehbou ahi; ama chu mihem, Christa Jesu chu ahi;
target: For there is one God and one mediator between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus,

source: Ama chu aphat cha-a hettohsah hidinga, mi jouse lhatdoh na-a hung kipe-a ahi.
target: who gave himself as a ransom for all people. This has now been witnessed to at the proper time.

source: Hiche dinga chu aseiphongle dingle solchah, (Christa-a thutah kasei ahi; jou kaseipoi); tahsa le thutah-a chidang namdangho hil dinga eikipansah ahi.
target: And for this purpose I was appointed a herald and an apostle—I am telling the truth, I am not lying—and a true and faithful teacher of the Gentiles.

source: Hijeh chun pasal hon lunghang louhel le kinel baotam beihelin, muntin-ah khut theng domuhen lang taovuhen, hichu kalunggot ahi.
target: Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands without anger or disputing.

source: Chutobangma chun numei ho adol bepchan kijem uhen, kiphalam khenchan ging gehchan umuhen; sampheh jeppah, sana twikohchanga chule thil man tama kijem louvin,
target: I also want the women to dress modestly, with decency and propriety, adorning themselves, not with elaborate hairstyles or gold or pearls or expensive clothes,

source: thilpha bolin kijemleu kati; hichu Pathen gin phonga numei chonna doltah ahi.
target: but with good deeds, appropriate for women who profess to worship God.

source: Imalam jouse-a numei chu thu noija umhen, gingkhen chan thu kihiljohen.
target: A woman should learn in quietness and full submission.

source: Mi hil dingle pasal chunga thunei dingin numei thu kapepoi; thipkhenin umthim ngetnget johen katibouve.
target: I do not permit a woman to teach or to assume authority over a man; she must be quiet.

source: Ajeh chu amasa Adam kisema, chujouva bou Eve kisema ahi;
target: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

source: chule Adam chu lheplhah-a um hilouva, numeinu johchu bou lheplhah-a uma, suhkhelna-a lhalhut ahi.
target: And Adam was not the one deceived; it was the woman who was deceived and became a sinner.

source: Hijeng jongle tahsana, ngailutna, thenna, chule umchan phatah-a aum jom jinguva ahile, amanu chu acha neina-a sohcha ding ahi.
target: But women will be saved through childbearing—if they continue in faith, love and holiness with propriety.

source: Koi hile houbung lam kaija pan nom chun natoh pha alunggot ahi, tia kisei hi thudih tah ahi.
target: Here is a trustworthy saying: Whoever aspires to be an overseer desires a noble task.

source: Hijeh-a chu houbung lamkai chu nolna bei, numei khat ji-a nei, kitimthei, lunglimtah, kituptah, jindot them, mi hil them,
target: Now the overseer is to be above reproach, faithful to his wife, temperate, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,

source: Juheh lou, miden mang lou; alamlouva phatchomna ding ngaito-a kilose mi hilou, mi nunnem hi ding, dou hollou, sum ngailu lou;
target: not given to drunkenness, not violent but gentle, not quarrelsome, not a lover of money.

source: Ama insung phatecha potup thei, jana neitah-a achate athua nunsah thei mi hi ding ahi.
target: He must manage his own family well and see that his children obey him, and he must do so in a manner worthy of full respect.

source: (Ama insung chunga vaipohje he lou chun Pathen houbung ho chu iti avetsuija akaitup thei dingham?)
target: (If anyone does not know how to manage his own family, how can he take care of God’s church?)

source: Atahsan thah hilou ding ahi, ajole kiletsah hoithontin Diabol themmo sahna-a chu getninte;
target: He must not be a recent convert, or he may become conceited and fall under the same judgment as the devil.

source: Chulou jong chu, polama mite seiphat jong hiding ahi; achuti loule seisetnin umintin Diabol thangah oh khante.
target: He must also have a good reputation with outsiders, so that he will not fall into disgrace and into the devil’s trap.

source: Chutobangma chu houbung lhacha-a pang ding jong chu migun ja-umtah hiding, mi kamtam hilou ding, ju-a lop hilou ding, alam louva sum veikan lung go mi hilou ding;
target: In the same way, deacons are to be worthy of respect, sincere, not indulging in much wine, and not pursuing dishonest gain.

source: Chule sele pha hetna thenga tahsanna thuguh tuh mi hi ding ahi.
target: They must keep hold of the deep truths of the faith with a clear conscience.

source: Amaho chu kipatep masahen, chujoule nolna bei ahiu lebou, lhacha na tonguhen.
target: They must first be tested; and then if there is nothing against them, let them serve as deacons.

source: Chutobangma chu aji teo jong migun ja umtah, mihehse hatlou, kitim them, chule ijakaija tahsan um hiding ahi.
target: In the same way, the women are to be worthy of respect, not malicious talkers but temperate and trustworthy in everything.

source: Lhachaho chu numei khatseh ji hicheh hen, achate chengule a-insungu phatecha potup them cheh hiuhen.
target: A deacon must be faithful to his wife and must manage his children and his household well.

source: Ajeh chu houbung lhacha na phatecha tongho chun amaho dinga Christa Jesu'a um tahsan na-a chun dinmun pha le hansana nasatah akilodoh jiuvin ahi.
target: Those who have served well gain an excellent standing and great assurance in their faith in Christ Jesus.

source: Chomkhat joule naheng lama hung ding kinema, hiche hi kahinsut ahi;
target: Although I hope to come to you soon, I am writing you these instructions so that,

source: Ahinla kahung gei khatle, thutah khom le abul Pathen hing houbung, Pathen insunga chu mi itobanga iti umchan dingdol ahi nahetna dinga kahin sut ahi.
target: if I am delayed, you will know how people ought to conduct themselves in God’s household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.

source: Pathen ngaisahna thuguh chu nelkalna beihela lena ahi; Pathen chu tahsa-a ahung kiphongin, Lhagaova them changin, Vantil ten amuvin, Chidang namdang lah-a seiphongin aumin, Vannoi'a tahsanin aumin, Loupia lahtouvin aumtan ahi.
target: Beyond all question, the mystery from which true godliness springs is great: He appeared in the flesh, was vindicated by the Spirit, was seen by angels, was preached among the nations, was believed on in the world, was taken up in glory.

source: Ahin Lhagao Thengin kichentah-in aseije, ni nunung lamle mi kimkhat tahsana kona pul lha-a, lhagaoho misuh lamvaina doha leh thilhaho thuhila hung lunglut diu;
target: The Spirit clearly says that in later times some will abandon the faith and follow deceiving spirits and things taught by demons.

source: Hichu ama sele pha hetna thisa kidep tobang miphalhem thujou seiho-a kona sohdoh ding ahi;
target: Such teachings come through hypocritical liars, whose consciences have been seared as with a hot iron.

source: Amaho chun kichen akhamun; atahsanale thutah hetohhon thangvah puma aneh dingu, tia Pathen thilsemho chu neh ding ajadauve.
target: They forbid people to marry and order them to abstain from certain foods, which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and who know the truth.

source: Ajeh chu Pathen thilsem jouse chu phasoh keija ahin, pai ding imacha umlou ahi, thangvah puma ikisanle;
target: For everything God created is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving,

source: Ajeh chu Pathen thua konle taona-a kisuthenga ahi.
target: because it is consecrated by the word of God and prayer.

source: Hicheng thu chu sopiho lunga nakhuma ahile, Christa Jesu lhacha phatah nahi-a, tu geija nahinjuipeh tahsanna thu le thuhilpha-a chu kivah khang ding nahi;
target: If you point these things out to the brothers and sisters, you will be a good minister of Christ Jesus, nourished on the truths of the faith and of the good teaching that you have followed.

source: Amavang hou seisetnale nupi tehse ho houlimna moh thusim chu la hih-in, Pathen ngaisahna lama them kiha sinin.
target: Have nothing to do with godless myths and old wives’ tales; rather, train yourself to be godly.

source: Ajehchu tahsa lam thil kisin hi phatchomna themcha khatcha ahin; Pathen ngaisahna lama kisin hi imajousea phatna ahi; ajeh chu hichu tu hinkho-a dinga jong, khonunga hinkho dinga jong thutep uma ahi.
target: For physical training is of some value, but godliness has value for all things, holding promise for both the present life and the life to come.

source: Hiche thu kiseihi tahsan umtahle jop sohkei ding doltah ahi.
target: This is a trustworthy saying that deserves full acceptance.

source: Ajeh chu eiho tu chana hi Pathen hinga ikinep jeh uva tonggima kiseh ihiuve; ama chu mi jouse huhhing-a ahin, ahideh-a chu atahsanho huhhing-a ahi.
target: That is why we labor and strive, because we have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of all people, and especially of those who believe.

source: Nangman hicheho hi thupeh-in lang chule hilin.
target: Command and teach these things.

source: Nakum lhom nachapan chu koima nahsahmon umsah hih-in; ahin nangman thu lamin, houlim na lamin, mikhoto lamin, lhagao lamin, tahsanna lamin chule thenna lamin atahsanho vetjui dingin umin.
target: Don’t let anyone look down on you because you are young, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith and in purity.

source: Keima kahung kahsen, nangma lekha simin, mi suhhalin, mi hilin anaponthon.
target: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to preaching and to teaching.

source: Upahon akhut angapma kiphongdoh dungjuija nakipeh thilpeh nanga um chu lhadoh loujenin.
target: Do not neglect your gift, which was given you through prophecy when the body of elders laid their hands on you.

source: Nangma hichenga hin gen ngaijin ponthon, chule hichenga chun umjing jengin; mi jouse henga nakhantou akiphondoh theinan.
target: Be diligent in these matters; give yourself wholly to them, so that everyone may see your progress.

source: Nangmale nathuhila chun kigingphan chingtheijin; chule hichenga chun umin; hiti chun bolle chun nangmale nathuhil ngaiho agoma nahuhhing ding ahi.
target: Watch your life and doctrine closely. Persevere in them, because if you do, you will save both yourself and your hearers.

source: Upa tehse phohsal hih-in, napa tobangin jolthon; khangdongho nasopi bangin;
target: Do not rebuke an older man harshly, but exhort him as if he were your father. Treat younger men as brothers,

source: Nupi tehse ho nanu tobangin, chule numei khangdongho chu nanaonu teho tobangin lung thengselin ngaiton.
target: older women as mothers, and younger women as sisters, with absolute purity.

source: Meithai kichehtah ho chu jabolin.
target: Give proper recognition to those widows who are really in need.

source: Amavang meithai achate ahiloule atute uma chu amaho chun amasan a-insunguva ngailut vetsahje heuhen, chule ahinguva nule pate phatna-a lethuhje kisinu hen; hichu Pathen anga aphale lah theitah ahi.
target: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, these should learn first of all to put their religion into practice by caring for their own family and so repaying their parents and grandparents, for this is pleasing to God.

source: Ahin meithai kichehtah achanga uma vang chu Pathen'a kinema, sunle jana thumle taona jenga beh jingji ahi.
target: The widow who is really in need and left all alone puts her hope in God and continues night and day to pray and to ask God for help.

source: Amavang atahsa nomsahna lam jenga kipenu vangchu ahinpet jenga jong athisa ahi.
target: But the widow who lives for pleasure is dead even while she lives.

source: Amaho chu seiset achan louna dingun thupeh hicheng hi pen.
target: Give the people these instructions, so that no one may be open to blame.

source: Ahivangin koi hijongle ama mite ding ngaito lou, ahideh chu ama insung mite ding ngaito lou chun, tahsan chu aledoh ahitai, atahsanlou sanga chonsejo ahi.
target: Anyone who does not provide for their relatives, and especially for their own household, has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

source: Kum somgup noija mi hilou, pasal khat ji hisa,
target: No widow may be put on the list of widows unless she is over sixty, has been faithful to her husband,

source: thilpha bolnatina seiphat changsa, chate khoukhahsa, jindot themsa, mithengte keng silpehsa, ahesoh gentheiho phatna bolsa, chonphatna jouse nungjuisa hitobang louse chu meithaijin sun hih-in.
target: and is well known for her good deeds, such as bringing up children, showing hospitality, washing the feet of the Lord’s people, helping those in trouble and devoting herself to all kinds of good deeds.

source: Ahin nutil meithai vang chu meithaijin sun hih-in; amaho chun Christa douna-in atahsa nomsahna dingu angaito jeh-un jinei ding agojiuve;
target: As for younger widows, do not put them on such a list. For when their sensual desires overcome their dedication to Christ, they want to marry.

source: chule akipehnao masa apailhah jeh-un themmo achangjiuve.
target: Thus they bring judgment on themselves, because they have broken their first pledge.

source: Chule chuche tailou jong chun, intina alengleuvin, thaset apanjiuve; chutigoh jong hilouvin, amuhthem akamjaovun, minatoh taimon, seilou ding ding aseijiuve.
target: Besides, they get into the habit of being idle and going about from house to house. And not only do they become idlers, but also busybodies who talk nonsense, saying things they ought not to.

source: Hijeh chun, chutobang nutil meithai chun ji neihen, cha hinghen, inneinu na tonghen, melma chun aseisetna dingu kom beihelin umleu kati.
target: So I counsel younger widows to marry, to have children, to manage their homes and to give the enemy no opportunity for slander.

source: Ajeh chu tu jengin jong mi kimkhat Satan nungjui jin akihei mangtaove.
target: Some have in fact already turned away to follow Satan.

source: Atahsana pasal ahiloule numei khattou meithai neija aumle, ama chun kithopi hen; houbung pohgihsah hihhen; houbung chun meithai kichentah chu akithoipi theina dingin.
target: If any woman who is a believer has widows in her care, she should continue to help them and not let the church be burdened with them, so that the church can help those widows who are really in need.

source: Upa vaihom themho, thusei lamle mihil lama ponpana gunchuho chu, ajat ni-a ginle jan umuhen.
target: The elders who direct the affairs of the church well are worthy of double honor, especially those whose work is preaching and teaching.

source: Ajeh chu Pathen lekhabun, bongchal chang chil pet amuh som hih-un; chule Natongan athaman asanding chu adol ahi, ati.
target: For Scripture says, “Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain,” and “The worker deserves his wages.”

source: Upadol hehna chu ahetoh nile thum ahi loule, la hih-in.
target: Do not entertain an accusation against an elder unless it is brought by two or three witnesses.

source: Adangin kichatna anei theina dingin, achonseho chu japi angsung tah-a sosalin.
target: But those elders who are sinning you are to reprove before everyone, so that the others may take warning.

source: Pathen toh, Pakai Jesu Christa, chule vantil kilhengho mitmu-a hiche thuhi kapeh nahi, kichentah-a hetoh loule jachen louva thu tan louvin kathupeh cheng hi mangin; langneijin imacha bol hihhelin.
target: I charge you, in the sight of God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels, to keep these instructions without partiality, and to do nothing out of favoritism.

source: Koima chunga nakhut ngampai jeng hih-in; chule midang chonset chan khompi hih-in; chule kisutheng jingin.
target: Do not be hasty in the laying on of hands, and do not share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.

source: Na-oisung jehle nadammo jing jeh chun twisihkeo jeng don louvin, lengpitwi themkhat khat anamangjitan.
target: Stop drinking only water, and use a little wine because of your stomach and your frequent illnesses.

source: Khattou chonsetna kilangtah ahin, thutan na-a lhung masa jengji ahi; chule abang khattou setna vangin amaho nung ajuijon ahi;
target: The sins of some are obvious, reaching the place of judgment ahead of them; the sins of others trail behind them.

source: Chonphat najong chutobangma chu kilangtah ahi; chule chutobang dang dang chu im thei imacha aumpoi.
target: In the same way, good deeds are obvious, and even those that are not obvious cannot remain hidden forever.

source: Pathen min chule athuhil chu taitoma aum louna dingin, namkoljon poh noija um soh ho chengsen a-pakaite chengu chu jabolna changdinga lom ahiubang tah-in bulhing setnin jaboluhen.
target: All who are under the yoke of slavery should consider their masters worthy of full respect, so that God’s name and our teaching may not be slandered.

source: Chule atahsana pakai neihon amaho chu sopi ahi jeh chun nahsahmon boldao hen; chusangin hajen chehjohen, ajeh chu anatoh naova kon phatchomna muho chu atahsana le amaho dinga dei umtah ho ahiuve. Hitiho thuhi hil inlang tilkhouvin.
target: Those who have believing masters should not show them disrespect just because they are fellow believers. Instead, they should serve them even better because their masters are dear to them as fellow believers and are devoted to the welfare of their slaves. These are the things you are to teach and insist on.

source: Mi khattou thuhil chomdang hila auma, thupha kicheh, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa thu leh Pathen ngaisahna lam thuhilpha chu asan louleh;
target: If anyone teaches otherwise and does not agree to the sound instruction of our Lord Jesus Christ and to godly teaching,

source: Ama chu ahoithojin, imachala ahejipoi; hettah sangin kinelna, thu nelkalna hivei aveijin, hia kon chun kithangset, kinah, kiseisetto, kiginmo, nelhatna asohjin ahi;
target: they are conceited and understand nothing. They have an unhealthy interest in controversies and quarrels about words that result in envy, strife, malicious talk, evil suspicions

source: chutobang miho lung chu sesohjia ahin, thutah neilou ahiuvin, Pathen ngaisahna hi sumlam phatchomnan angaito jiuve, hitobanga kon chun kikangsen.
target: and constant friction between people of corrupt mind, who have been robbed of the truth and who think that godliness is a means to financial gain.

source: Ahin lunglhaisela Pathen ngaisah hi phatchomna tah chu ahi;
target: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

source: Ajeh chu eihon vannoi'a hin imacha ihinpo lutpouve, chule atahbeh-in hichea kona jong imacha ipohdoh thei dingu ahipoi;
target: For we brought nothing into the world, and we can take nothing out of it.

source: Ahinla eihon anneh chule nihchen ponsil ineijule hichea chu ilunglhai jeng dingu ahi.
target: But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with that.

source: Hao lung goho vang chu lhepna-a leh thangkola chule ngolna tintangle suhset nomna lam tamtah-a alha lutjiuvin, miho suhgamnale manthah na-a alhah lhumsah jiuve.
target: Those who want to get rich fall into temptation and a trap and into many foolish and harmful desires that plunge people into ruin and destruction.

source: Ajeh chu sum ngailut hi setna jouse bul ahi; hichu mu ding akihabolna lama mi kimkhat tahsana-a konin avah mangun, amahole amaho lunghemna tamtah-in akisun jiuve.
target: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some people, eager for money, have wandered from the faith and pierced themselves with many griefs.

source: Ahin, Pathen mi, nangma vang hichenga kon chun jamin; chule chonphatna, Pathen ngaisahna, tahsan, ngailutna, thohhatna, nunnem na, hicheng chu delin.
target: But you, man of God, flee from all this, and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, endurance and gentleness.

source: Tahsan kisehna pha-a kihaseh-in ponpanin, tonsot hin kemlou chu tuh jingin; hiche dinga chu kikou nahi; chule ahetoh tamtah ang sunga phondohna phatah chu naphondoh ahitai.
target: Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you made your good confession in the presence of many witnesses.

source: Imajouse hinsah Pathen leh Pontius Pilate ang sunga phondoh phatah phongdoh-ah Christa Jesu mitmu-a, hiche thupeh hi kapeh nahi,
target: In the sight of God, who gives life to everything, and of Christ Jesus, who while testifying before Pontius Pilate made the good confession, I charge you

source: I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hung kilah kahsen, nangman thupeh hi boh beh louhelle seisetna um louhelin chingin.
target: to keep this command without spot or blame until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

source: Thunei khatseh, lengho Leng leh pakaiho Pakai, pachat umtah chu aphatcha hung kilah ding ahi;
target: which God will bring about in his own time—God, the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords,

source: Ama changsehbou chu thilouna neija ahin, nailut theihoi hilou vah-a chenga ahi; ama chu koiman mukha lou chule mu jong mu thei lou ahi, ama jenga chun choi-at le tonsot thilbol thei thahat chu umjing hen. Amen.
target: who alone is immortal and who lives in unapproachable light, whom no one has seen or can see. To him be honor and might forever. Amen.
