source: Tu hinkho-a vannoi leiset thila haoho chu ahoitho louna dingun hilchah-in, kichetna bei suma kingai louvin, thil jouse imanchah dinga eipeuva Pathen joh-a kingaijuhen;
target: Command those who are rich in this present world not to be arrogant nor to put their hope in wealth, which is so uncertain, but to put their hope in God, who richly provides us with everything for our enjoyment.

source: Amahon thilpha boluhen, thilpha bola chun hao uhen; hop ding jong phaluhen, mi tonan jong thanomuhen;
target: Command them to do good, to be rich in good deeds, and to be generous and willing to share.

source: Tonsot hinna chu atuhchah theina dingun, khonung hinkho-a dinga bulpha neija akikhol theina dingun hilin.
target: In this way they will lay up treasure for themselves as a firm foundation for the coming age, so that they may take hold of the life that is truly life.

source: Vo Timothy, nangma nakichin sah chengse hi hongphan; chule hou seisetna thumotsei amahon chihna atiu, alam loutah-a kinelna-a kon chun kihei mangin;
target: Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to your care. Turn away from godless chatter and the opposing ideas of what is falsely called knowledge,

source: Mi kimkhat hiche chihna chu ahoitho piuvin, tahsan nalama abidoiju akheltaove. Lungsetna chu nachunga umhen, Amen.
target: which some have professed and in so doing have departed from the faith. Grace be with you all.

source: Christa Jesu'a um hinna thutep dungjuija Pathen lunggot tah-a kipansah Jesu Christa solchah, Paul'in,
target: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, in keeping with the promise of life that is in Christ Jesus,

source: kacha ngaitah Timothy hengah; Pa Pathen le I-Pakaiyu Christa Jesu'a konin lungset, hepi chule lungmon nachungah umhen.
target: To Timothy, my dear son: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

source: Kapute kapatea kona sele pha hetna thenga kahou Pathen chu thangvah jia katao lai chana nangma geldoh jinga um kahi;
target: I thank God, whom I serve, as my ancestors did, with a clear conscience, as night and day I constantly remember you in my prayers.

source: Namit lhi lon chu kageldoh jingin, kipana kadim theina dinga, nangma mu noma asun ajana tao jing jeng kahi.
target: Recalling your tears, I long to see you, so that I may be filled with joy.

source: Tahsan kijentah nanga aum chu kageldoh jinge, masanga napi Lois lung sungle nanu Eunice lung sunga chenga chu, nang lung sunga jong achen kagingchai.
target: I am reminded of your sincere faith, which first lived in your grandmother Lois and in your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, now lives in you also.

source: Hijeh-a chu keima khut ngap vanga Pathen thilpeh nanga umchu nakonsah jing theina dinga, kahin geldohsah kit nahi.
target: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

source: Ajeh chu Pathen'in eiho kichatsetna lhagao eipepouve, thilbolthei thahat le ngailut, chule lungthim themna lhagaobou eipeh-u ahi.
target: For the Spirit God gave us does not make us timid, but gives us power, love and self-discipline.

source: Hijeh chun I-Pakaiyu thu hettohsah thulam dolle asohchang keima chungchang thudola jong jahcha hih helin; ahin Pathen thilbolthei thahat dungjuijin Kipana Thupha jala thoh hahsa hi neithohpin;
target: So do not be ashamed of the testimony about our Lord or of me his prisoner. Rather, join with me in suffering for the gospel, by the power of God.

source: Amatah chun eihuhhingu ahi, chule kouna thenga eikouvu ahi; eiho natoh dungjuija ahipoi, ama lunggotle amilungset dungjui-a bou ahi; hiche lungsetna chu tonsot tonsot masang peh-a Christa Jesu'a eiho eina pehsao ahi;
target: He has saved us and called us to a holy life—not because of anything we have done but because of his own purpose and grace. This grace was given us in Christ Jesus before the beginning of time,

source: Ahin tu-a vang Eihuh hinga Christa Jesu hung kilah-a kona kilangdoh ahitai, aman thina asubeijin Kipana Thupha-a hinna le thilouna chu vah-a ahinpoh ahi;
target: but it has now been revealed through the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who has destroyed death and has brought life and immortality to light through the gospel.

source: Hiche Kipana Thupha lama chu keima chidang namdang te henga lhangsamle solchah chule houhila panga kahi.
target: And of this gospel I was appointed a herald and an apostle and a teacher.

source: Hijeh-a chu hesoh genthei hichengpi hi kathoh ahi; ahinla kajahchapoi; ajeh chu katahsan chu keiman kahei; chule avop dinga akhutna kapehdoh chengse chu chuche nikho-a dinga chu voppha-a hongbit thei ahi, ti katahsan kichene.
target: That is why I am suffering as I am. Yet this is no cause for shame, because I know whom I have believed, and am convinced that he is able to guard what I have entrusted to him until that day.

source: Keima-a kona najah thupha kichehho vettoh-a jui ding dol chengse chu Christa Jesu'a um ginchatnale ngailutna chun tuh jingin.
target: What you heard from me, keep as the pattern of sound teaching, with faith and love in Christ Jesus.

source: Nangma kipe-a thilpha chu eihoa chenga Lhagao Theng chun hongphan.
target: Guard the good deposit that was entrusted to you—guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit who lives in us.

source: Phygellus le Hermogenes teho Asia gama um chengsen einung ngatsoh taove, hichu nangin nahenai.
target: You know that everyone in the province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.

source: Onesiphorus insung mite chu Pakaiyin hepihen; ajeh chu aman kalung asuhal matchet jingjin ahi; chule kabulput jong ajachat pipoi;
target: May the Lord show mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he often refreshed me and was not ashamed of my chains.

source: Ahin Rome kho-a ahungin jong gunchu tah-in eiholin eihung holdoh jengin ahi.
target: On the contrary, when he was in Rome, he searched hard for me until he found me.

source: Pakaiyin ama chu hiche phattheina hi pehen, hiche nikho ni chule Pakai koma hepina changhen; chule Ephesus kho-a alhacha natoh nasatje chu nangman nahenai.
target: May the Lord grant that he will find mercy from the Lord on that day! You know very well in how many ways he helped me in Ephesus.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun, kacha, nangma Christa Jesu'a uma lungsetna-a chun thilboltheina thahat neijin umin.
target: You then, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

source: Chule ahetoh tamtah ang sunga keima-a kona najah chengse chu ginchat um miho chu pedoh-in, amaho jong chun midangho ahil thei dingu ahi.
target: And the things you have heard me say in the presence of many witnesses entrust to reliable people who will also be qualified to teach others.

source: Nangman Christa Jesu sepai phatah bangin ahahsa kathohgim hi neithohpin.
target: Join with me in suffering, like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

source: Sepai galsat pet koima tu hinkho-a khankho ding gelnan akisunoh jipoi, pha sa-a sepaija apansahpa lunglhaisah dingbou alung ahi.
target: No one serving as a soldier gets entangled in civilian affairs, but rather tries to please his commanding officer.

source: Chule golseh kitetna jenga jong khattouvin gol jona dingin kihabol nama jeng jongle, dan ngaitah-a abol loule, lal lukhuh akhuhjipoi.
target: Similarly, anyone who competes as an athlete does not receive the victor’s crown except by competing according to the rules.

source: Loubol mi natongima chu agam ga chang masapen dingdol ahi.
target: The hardworking farmer should be the first to receive a share of the crops.

source: Kasei hi ipi ahi geltohin; ajeh chu Pakaiyin imalam jouse-a lungthim napeh ding ahi.
target: Reflect on what I am saying, for the Lord will give you insight into all this.

source: Kathuhil Kipana Thupha dungjuija, athi lah-a kona thoudoh kit, David chilhah Jesu Christa chu geldoh jing jengin;
target: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David. This is my gospel,

source: Hiche Kipana Thupha jeh-a chu keima akhanggilou banga bulput geija hesoh genthei kathoh ahi; ahivangin Pathen thu chu akihentang dehpoi.
target: for which I am suffering even to the point of being chained like a criminal. But God’s word is not chained.

source: Hijeh-a chu keiman lhenchom ho dinga, amaho Christa Jesu'a um huhhingna chu achan theijuva tonsot loupina chutoh anei theina dinguva, hichengpi hi kathohgim ahi.
target: Therefore I endure everything for the sake of the elect, that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.

source: Hiche kisei hi ginchat umtah kisei ahi, Athina-a ithiule ahinna-a jong ihin dingu;
target: Here is a trustworthy saying: If we died with him, we will also live with him;

source: Athoh chu ithohpiule avaipoh jong ipohpi dingu ahi; eihon ama seilepleu hen, aman jong eiseilep dingu ahi;
target: if we endure, we will also reign with him. If we disown him, he will also disown us;

source: Eiho ginchatna bei ihiule, ama chu ginchat umtah hijing ahi; ajeh chu ama kiseilep thei lou ahi.
target: if we are faithless, he remains faithful, for he cannot disown himself.

source: Nangman thu hicheng hi geldohsah jingin; phatchomna bei moh thu pouva akinel baotam louna dingun, Pakai anga hilchahjin; amaho dinga mansuhna ahibouve.
target: Keep reminding God’s people of these things. Warn them before God against quarreling about words; it is of no value, and only ruins those who listen.

source: Nangma kipatep themchang banga Pathen'a kipehna dingin, gunchun ponpanin, jachatna beihel natong mi hin, thutah thu chu jangkeichan homjallin.
target: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who does not need to be ashamed and who correctly handles the word of truth.

source: Amavang Pathen jalouna, hou seisetna, moh thu mai maija konin kihei mangin; ajeh chu chutobang deiho chu Pathen ngaisahmo na lama chal tou cheh cheh ding ahiuve;
target: Avoid godless chatter, because those who indulge in it will become more and more ungodly.

source: Chule athu-u jong chun masemon nehkem banga aneh dingu ahi: alah uva lha-a chu Hymenaeus le Philetus ahilhone;
target: Their teaching will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,

source: Amaho chu thutah lampia kona petmanga ahiuvin, amahon Thokitna chu kichaisa ahitai atiuvin, mi kimkhat tahsanna alehei taove.
target: who have departed from the truth. They say that the resurrection has already taken place, and they destroy the faith of some.

source: Ahinla Pathen khombul phu dettah chu ading jingnai; achunga hiche thuhi Kinama ahin, koi koi ama-a ahi Pakaiyin ahenai. Chule, koi hile Christa min pana chu chonphat louva konin kikhin manghen.
target: Nevertheless, God’s solid foundation stands firm, sealed with this inscription: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Everyone who confesses the name of the Lord must turn away from wickedness.”

source: Amavang inpi sunga khun sanale dangka bel jeng uma ahipoi, thingle leibel jong aumin, hicheho chu abang sahlut dol aumin, abang sahlut lou dol aume.
target: In a large house there are articles not only of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay; some are for special purposes and some for common use.

source: Hichenga kona kithensodoh chu ama chu sahlut doltah ahi, akisutheng ahin, Pakai natonga lomtah ahin, chule thilpha bolna lam jouse-a dinga kigosa ahi.
target: Those who cleanse themselves from the latter will be instruments for special purposes, made holy, useful to the Master and prepared to do any good work.

source: Nangma vang gollhanlai lungtup lungngaija konin jamin; chule chonphatna, tahsan, ngailut, lungmon, chule lungthengsela Pakai henga taoho toh pumkhat hina hicheng chu hadelin,
target: Flee the evil desires of youth and pursue righteousness, faith, love and peace, along with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

source: Ahin ngolkaile lungthimbeiho kinelna-a lhah ding nom hihhelin; hichea kon chun kinahna asohjin ahi, nahei.
target: Don’t have anything to do with foolish and stupid arguments, because you know they produce quarrels.

source: Pakai soh chun doubol angai ahipoi; chusanga chu mi jouse dinga nunnema, mihil thema, lungdehat ding,
target: And the Lord’s servant must not be quarrelsome but must be kind to everyone, able to teach, not resentful.

source: Chule lungnema adouho chu apuijang dingjoh ahibouve; chutia chu Pathen'in ijem tia thutah hetna lama lungheina apeh khatle;
target: Opponents must be gently instructed, in the hope that God will grant them repentance leading them to a knowledge of the truth,

source: Ama lunggot lama Diabol'in gal hinga amatnao thangkola kon chun kiteldoh thei khat nunte.
target: and that they will come to their senses and escape from the trap of the devil, who has taken them captive to do his will.

source: Amavang hiche hi heuvin, ni nunung lamle phat hahsa khohtah hung lhung ding ahi.
target: But mark this: There will be terrible times in the last days.

source: Hiche teng chule mi amachangmai kingailua, sum ngailut, nomham, huset le hoitho, taitomhat, nu thu pa thu ngailou, phatna ngaisah lou, then louna,
target: People will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, proud, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,

source: Lungsetna neilou, kihou champi mohel, hehset hat, ti kitimlou, kichat um, phatna ho-a,
target: without love, unforgiving, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, not lovers of the good,

source: Tahsan pailha, kichamsah,kiletsah, chule Pathen ngailut sanga nopsah ngailut johna;
target: treacherous, rash, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God—

source: Pathen ngaisah lhem-a athahat athilbol thei janom lou, hicheng chu hung umding ahi; hichenga kon jong chun kihei mangin.
target: having a form of godliness but denying its power. Have nothing to do with such people.

source: Amaho lah-a kimkhat doha lungthimin mi ina alutjiuvin, chonset pohgih po-a, lung ngaichat tamtah puilonle,
target: They are the kind who worm their way into homes and gain control over gullible women, who are loaded down with sins and are swayed by all kinds of evil desires,

source: Chule akihil jing vanga thutah hetheilou numei lungthimbeiho chu alhem lhaovin, gal hingin amanjiovin ahi.
target: always learning but never able to come to a knowledge of the truth.

source: Chule Jannes le Jambres in Mosi adoudal lhon bang banga chu hiteho jong hin thutah chu adoudalu ahi; lungput sesa, tahsan lam thua Pathen deimo mi ahiuve.
target: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these teachers oppose the truth. They are men of depraved minds, who, as far as the faith is concerned, are rejected.

source: Ahivangin amaho chu gamlatah mason lou ding ahiuve; khatteni banga chu amaho jong angolnao chu mi jouse jah-a kisei phongle ding ahi.
target: But they will not get very far because, as in the case of those men, their folly will be clear to everyone.

source: Nangma vang kathuhil, kanun kakhan, kalunggot, tahsan, thohhat, ngailut, lungdehat, bolsetna tintangle, hesoh genthei kathoh nungjuija nahi tai.
target: You, however, know all about my teaching, my way of life, my purpose, faith, patience, love, endurance,

source: Antioch kho-a, Iconium'a chule Lystra kho chengsea kachunga itobang thu sohtam, bolsetna ijat kathoh hitam, ahin Pakaiyin chutiho jouse-a kon chun eihuhdoh tai.
target: persecutions, sufferings—what kinds of things happened to me in Antioch, Iconium and Lystra, the persecutions I endured. Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.

source: Chule koi hile Pathen ngaisah kijentah-a Christa Jesu'a hinding lung go chan chun bolsetna athoh ding ahi.
target: In fact, everyone who wants to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,

source: Ahin migilouho chule milhemlhaho vang chu setna lama khangtou cheh cheh ding ahiuve; amaho doha kilhemlha ahiuvin, doha alheplhah dingu ahi.
target: while evildoers and impostors will go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.

source: Ahin nangma vang nakihilsa chengsele naphotchensa chengsea chun dingdet jingin; koi koija kona kihila nahi nangman nahenai.
target: But as for you, continue in what you have learned and have become convinced of, because you know those from whom you learned it,

source: Chule huhhing-a umna dinga nachihsah thei Pathen lekhabu theng chu nachapan laija patna nahin hetsapeh ahitai.
target: and how from infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

source: Pathen'in ahaikhum Pathen lekhabua thu kisun chengse chu kihilna-a, kiphona-a, kipuijangna-a, chonphat kisinsahna dinga phatah ahi;
target: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting and training in righteousness,

source: chutia chu Pathen mi chu pha chamkim keija, thilpha bolna lama chamkim keija kigosa dema um thei ding ahi.
target: so that the servant of God may be thoroughly equipped for every good work.

source: Hijeh-a chu keiman Pathen anga ahingle athiho thu tan dinga Pakai Jesu Christa anga, ama hung kilahna le alenggam chu pana guntah-a kahilchah nahi;
target: In the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of his appearing and his kingdom, I give you this charge:

source: Thu chu hil lhanglen; aphatle aphat louva jong kigosan umjing jengin; lungnengin hiltoh thonlang, athemo nao hetsahjinlang, sosaljin chule tilkhoujin.
target: Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; correct, rebuke and encourage—with great patience and careful instruction.

source: Ajeh chu hitobang phat hi hung lhung ding ahi, mihon thuhilpha kicheh chu angai thei lou ding, akolu thah tuntuna ama ama lung ngaichat dungjuija, mihil akikhop khom dingu ahi;
target: For the time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, to suit their own desires, they will gather around them a great number of teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear.

source: Chule thutah-a kona anau ahei manguva, moh thusim lama lamvai dingu ahi.
target: They will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.

source: Ahin nangma vang imalam jouse-a limgehchan um jingin; thohhahsa thoh-in, evangelist na chu tongin; nalhacha natoh chu bulhit molson.
target: But you, keep your head in all situations, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, discharge all the duties of your ministry.

source: Ajeh chu tu-a hi keima eikipedohsa ahitai, kapotdoh phat hung lhunga ahitai.
target: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time for my departure is near.

source: Golseh phatah chu kaseh joutai, kalhaitetna kachaitai, tahsan chu kamolsoi,
target: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.

source: tu-a kipat hi keima dinga chonphatna lal lukhuh chu koisa uma ahitai; chondih-a thutan Pakai chun hiche nikho ni chule eipeh ding ahi; keima chang jenggoh hilouva, ama hung kilah ngailu chengse jong chu apeh ding ahi.
target: Now there is in store for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day—and not only to me, but also to all who have longed for his appearing.

source: Kaheng lama hungvahna dingin hung kihabolin;
target: Do your best to come to me quickly,

source: Demas'in tulai vannoi leiset angailut jeh-in, keima eidalhan Thessalonica'a achetai; Crescen Galatia lama achen, chule Titus Dalmatia lama achei;
target: for Demas, because he loved this world, has deserted me and has gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.

source: Luke changseh keimatoh kaume. Mark hinpuijin hung lhonin; ama chu lhacha natohna-a kadinga phachom tah ahi.
target: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is helpful to me in my ministry.

source: Tychicus vang Ephesus lama kasoltai.
target: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

source: Troas khopi-a Carpus khutna kasangkhol len kadalhah chule lekhabu ho, ahideh-a savun lekhabu ho chu, nahung tengle hinpon.
target: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.

source: Alexander sumsan kheng chu kachunga akhang gilou lheh jenge; athilbol dungjuijin Pakaiyin lethuh nante.
target: Alexander the metalworker did me a great deal of harm. The Lord will repay him for what he has done.

source: Nangjong ama lama chun hung kihongphan; ama chun ithu-u hi hadouvin adoudalin ahi.
target: You too should be on your guard against him, because he strongly opposed our message.

source: Keima kakihona thu kasei masahpen chun koimacha eipanpi aumpon, mijousen eidalha sohkeijun ahi; hichu amaho themon kisim hihhen tia Pathen henga katao ahi.
target: At my first defense, no one came to my support, but everyone deserted me. May it not be held against them.

source: Achuti vangin keima vanga thu chu hillhanga aum sohkeija, chidang namdangho jousen ahet theina dingun, Pakai chun eidinpin eihat sahtai; hichun keipi kam sunga kon chun kasohchatan ahi.
target: But the Lord stood at my side and gave me strength, so that through me the message might be fully proclaimed and all the Gentiles might hear it. And I was delivered from the lion’s mouth.

source: Pakai chun gitlou thilbol jouse-a konin eihuh doh-intin, avan gama dingin eihuhhing nante; Minlet loupi chu tonsot tonsot geijin ama-a hi jinghen. Amen.
target: The Lord will rescue me from every evil attack and will bring me safely to his heavenly kingdom. To him be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

source: Priscilla le Aquila chule Onesiphorus insung mite chu salam'in.
target: Greet Priscilla and Aquila and the household of Onesiphorus.

source: Erastus Corinth-a aumdentai; Trophimus vang anat jeh-in Miletus-a kadalhatai.
target: Erastus stayed in Corinth, and I left Trophimus sick in Miletus.

source: Nangma phalbi kah-a hung dingin hung kihabolin. Eubulus teho, Puden teho, Linus teho, chule sopite jousen nasalamui.
target: Do your best to get here before winter. Eubulus greets you, and so do Pudens, Linus, Claudia and all the brothers and sisters.

source: Pakai Jesu Christa'n nalhagao umpihen. Nabonchao chunga Pathen lungsetna umhen, Amen.
target: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you all.

source: Paul, Pathen soh, Pathen milhen tahsana dungjui le Pathen ngaisahna tolhona thutah hetna lama Jesu Christa solchah;
target: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ to further the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness—

source: Tonsot hinna kinepna-a chu jou sei theilou Pathen chun tonsot tonsot masanga atepsa ahitai;
target: in the hope of eternal life, which God, who does not lie, promised before the beginning of time,

source: Ahinla aphatcha athu chu kihil lhanga kiphongdoh ahi; Eihuh hinguva Pathen thupeh dungjuija chuche hillhangna chu eikichinsah ahitai.
target: and which now at his appointed season he has brought to light through the preaching entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior,

source: Tahsan lhangpi thudola kacha tahtah Titus henga: Pa Pathen le Eihuh hinguva Pakai Jesu Christa-a konin lungset, khoto chule lungmon lhunghen.
target: To Titus, my true son in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.

source: Thil kibol bulhing lou chengse chu naboltup sohkeija chule khopi tinchenga upaho napansah ding, hiche dinga chu Crete'a kadalhah nahi.
target: The reason I left you in Crete was that you might put in order what was left unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.

source: Mi chu koi hile nolna bei, numei khatseh ji-a neija, chule achate chu Pathen tahsan hia chon chatvaina lamle thua nun louna lama seiset changlou hi ding ahi.
target: An elder must be blameless, faithful to his wife, a man whose children believe and are not open to the charge of being wild and disobedient.

source: Ajeh chu iham itile houbung lamkai chu Pathen gou chinga ahi jeh-a chu nolna bei hi dingdol ahi; kichamsah, lungsabai, ju-a lop, mideng-ah, alam louva phatchomna ding ngaito-a kilose mi hilou ding;
target: Since an overseer manages God’s household, he must be blameless—not overbearing, not quick-tempered, not given to drunkenness, not violent, not pursuing dishonest gain.

source: Amavang jindot them, phat ngailu-a, lung limgeh, chondih, atheng, ama chang kitimthei mibou hi ding ahi;
target: Rather, he must be hospitable, one who loves what is good, who is self-controlled, upright, holy and disciplined.

source: Chule thuhilpha kicheh-a chu mi thuhil athepma, mi nelkal hat teho chu athemo nao ahetsah theina dinga, akihil dungjuija tahsan umtah thu chu tuhchah mi hiding ahi.
target: He must hold firmly to the trustworthy message as it has been taught, so that he can encourage others by sound doctrine and refute those who oppose it.

source: Thua nung louva thumot seile dohapan mi tamtah aume, ahideh-a chu cheptanho lah-a mi ahiuve;
target: For there are many rebellious people, full of meaningless talk and deception, especially those of the circumcision group.

source: Amaho chu akamu huhbing ding ahi; alam louva phatchomna ding gutnan ahildol louhelu thu ahilun, mi kimkhat insung achoh chavaitaove.
target: They must be silenced, because they are disrupting whole households by teaching things they ought not to teach—and that for the sake of dishonest gain.

source: Amaho thudol mi themgao khatnin ahiti seije, Crete miho chu a-imatih chana jou jing sahang ahiuvin, thasea annehhat ahiuve, ati.
target: One of Crete’s own prophets has said it: “Cretans are always liars, evil brutes, lazy gluttons.”

source: Hiche het tohsahna hi adihtah mong ahi. Chuti ahi jeh chun amaho tahsan kicheh mi ahina dingun nasatah-in phohsalin,
target: This saying is true. Therefore rebuke them sharply, so that they will be sound in the faith

source: Thutah-a kona mi heimanga Juda miho moh thusimle miho thupeh-a lunglut daohen.
target: and will pay no attention to Jewish myths or to the merely human commands of those who reject the truth.

source: Atheng dinga imajouse thengsoh ahi, ahin akisuboh atahsan louho ding vanga athenga khatcha umlou ahi, thentah sanga alungule ase apha hetnau agoma bohjia ahi.
target: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are corrupted and do not believe, nothing is pure. In fact, both their minds and consciences are corrupted.

source: Pathen kahei, tin akam sungun aseidoh naovin, anatoh lama ajanom pouve; amaho chu thet umtah, thu ngailou ahiuvin, thilpha bolna lama pannabei ahiuve.
target: They claim to know God, but by their actions they deny him. They are detestable, disobedient and unfit for doing anything good.

source: Nangma vangin thuhilpha kicheh chutoh kitoh thu seijin;
target: You, however, must teach what is appropriate to sound doctrine.

source: Upaho chu kitim thei, ja umtah, lunglimtah, chule ngailutna le ginchat, chule lungdehat kichehtah mi ahi theina dingun, hilin;
target: Teach the older men to be temperate, worthy of respect, self-controlled, and sound in faith, in love and in endurance.

source: Chutima chun nupi tehse ho jong chu mi ja um gingkhen hiuhen, mi hehsehat le lengpitwi tamtah sohnu hilouva, thilpha lama mihil hiuhen;
target: Likewise, teach the older women to be reverent in the way they live, not to be slanderers or addicted to much wine, but to teach what is good.

source: Chutia chu amaho chun nutil khangdongho chu a-inneipute chengu ngailutle achateu ngailutje kisinsah uhen;
target: Then they can urge the younger women to love their husbands and children,

source: Alung limgeh, chon thengtah, inmun natong mi ahiuva, mihepi them ahiuva, a-inneipute chengu thu amanuva, chutia chu Pathen thu chu taitoma aum louna dingin, hilin.
target: to be self-controlled and pure, to be busy at home, to be kind, and to be subject to their husbands, so that no one will malign the word of God.

source: Chutobangma chun gollhangho chu lunglim gehcha aumna dingun tilkhouvin;
target: Similarly, encourage the young men to be self-controlled.

source: Imalam jouse-a amahon thilpha bolna lama avettoh-a ajui dingun umin; nathuhila chun bohbehlou nahidan, nabukim dan, nakitahje dan musah-in,
target: In everything set them an example by doing what is good. In your teaching show integrity, seriousness

source: Seiset oimo-a aum louna dingin, chutia chu akaleh lama panga chu ichunguva thuse sei ding nei louva ajachat theina dingin.
target: and soundness of speech that cannot be condemned, so that those who oppose you may be ashamed because they have nothing bad to say about us.

source: Soh ho chu a-pakai ho chengu thu noija aumna dingule imalam jouse-a amaho lunglhaina lama aumna dingun tilkhouvin; nelkal louhel hiuhen;
target: Teach slaves to be subject to their masters in everything, to try to please them, not to talk back to them,

source: Imacha kiseldoh nei louvin tahsanpha kichehtah musah hiuhen; chutia chu imalam jouse-a Eihuh hinguva Pathen thuhil chu ajephoi theina dingun.
target: and not to steal from them, but to show that they can be fully trusted, so that in every way they will make the teaching about God our Savior attractive.

source: Ajeh chu Pathen milungset hung kilah-a mi jouse huhhingna chu ahinlhut ahitai;
target: For the grace of God has appeared that offers salvation to all people.

source: Hitia chu eiho, Pathen ngaisah lounale vannoi leiset lung ngaichat jouse pumpaija, lunglima chondih-a chule Pathen ngaisahna neija tu khanga hi ikhosah dingu ahi,
target: It teaches us to say “No” to ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live self-controlled, upright and godly lives in this present age,

source: Chule kinepna thanop um tah chule Pathen loupi chungnungle Eihuh hinguva Jesu Christa loupina hung kilah dinga chu kat jinga i-um dingu ahi chu, eihilu ahitai;
target: while we wait for the blessed hope—the appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

source: Chonphat louna jouse-a kona aman apeh-a eiho eilhatdoh theina dingule, ama-a hi dinga thilpha bola tompan mi vai khat ama dinga akisuhtheng theina dinga, ama chu eiho dinga kipedoh ahitai.
target: who gave himself for us to redeem us from all wickedness and to purify for himself a people that are his very own, eager to do what is good.

source: Nangman thu hicheng hi seijin, thunei kimkei tah-in tilkhouvin, phohsalin; koimacha kinahsahmosah hihhelin.
target: These, then, are the things you should teach. Encourage and rebuke with all authority. Do not let anyone despise you.

source: Nangman amaho chu vaipoho le thunei ho thu noija umdingin, sei ngaija thua nung dingin, thilpha bol lam jouse-a kigosa dema umdingin,
target: Remind the people to be subject to rulers and authorities, to be obedient, to be ready to do whatever is good,

source: chule mi koima seise louhela, mi koima setna hol louva, chonnema, mi jouse chunga nunnema chon dingin jong hilphan.
target: to slander no one, to be peaceable and considerate, and always to be gentle toward everyone.

source: Ajeh chu eiho jong masanga chu lungthimbei, sei ngailou, thua nunglou, lheplhah, lungngai chatle nomsahna tamtah soh anahia, kimitthiple kithangset to-a uma, hot hattah-a khatle khat kihoto-a inahiu ahi.
target: At one time we too were foolish, disobedient, deceived and enslaved by all kinds of passions and pleasures. We lived in malice and envy, being hated and hating one another.

source: Ahinla Eihuh hinguva Pathen mihepile mihem angailutna ahung kilahdoh phat hin,
target: But when the kindness and love of God our Savior appeared,

source: Eihon eiho chama ibolu chonphat thilbol vanga hilouva, aman amilungset dungjuija eihuhdoh uva, penthahna-a asila, lhagao thenga athah sema;
target: he saved us, not because of righteous things we had done, but because of his mercy. He saved us through the washing of rebirth and renewal by the Holy Spirit,

source: Eihuh hinguva Jesu Christa-a kona ichunguva letset tah-a asunlhah-a eihuhhingu ahi;
target: whom he poured out on us generously through Jesus Christ our Savior,

source: Hichu amilungset vanga themchanga i-um uva, tonsot hin kemlou kinepna dungjuija gouloa eikisem theina dingu ahi.
target: so that, having been justified by his grace, we might become heirs having the hope of eternal life.

source: Hiche thu kiseija hi ginchat umtah ahi; chule nangman hiti thu dola hin thu akichetje chu seijin; Pathen tahsan ho chun thilpha bol jing leu kalung ahi. Hitiho hi miho dinga aphale phatchomna ahi.
target: This is a trustworthy saying. And I want you to stress these things, so that those who have trusted in God may be careful to devote themselves to doing what is good. These things are excellent and profitable for everyone.

source: Amavang ngolhoi thudohhole khanggui thu kinel baotam, danthu dola kinah, hichenga kon chun nangma kiheimangin; hicheng chu phatchomna ahipoi, mohseh ahibouve.
target: But avoid foolish controversies and genealogies and arguments and quarrels about the law, because these are unprofitable and useless.

source: Loitumbol mi chu khatvei nivei nahilchah kalin lata hih-in;
target: Warn a divisive person once, and then warn them a second time. After that, have nothing to do with them.

source: Hitobang mi chu lamvaija chule chonsejia ahi ti nahei, amale ama themlou kichan ahi.
target: You may be sure that such people are warped and sinful; they are self-condemned.

source: Keiman naheng lama Artimas ahiloule Tychicus kahinsola ahile, Nicopolis'a kahenga hung dingin hung kihabolin; chukoma chu phalbi sungse-a umding kagel lhuh ahitai;
target: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, do your best to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.

source: Dan thusun Zenas le Apollos ima alhahsam lhon louna dingin, lungthim themtah-in hinlha doh-in.
target: Do everything you can to help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their way and see that they have everything they need.

source: Imiteu jong chu aboithei louna dingle thil ngaichat lhahsam louna dinga, thilpha bolna-a amakai theina dingun kisin uhen.
target: Our people must learn to devote themselves to doing what is good, in order to provide for urgent needs and not live unproductive lives.

source: Kaumpi chengsen abonchauvin nasalamui. Tahsan na-a eingailuho chengse salam'in. Nabon chaova chunga lungsetna umhen, Amen.
target: Everyone with me sends you greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with you all.

source: Christa Jesu jala sohchang Paul le sopi Timothy'n katoh khompiu kadeitah Philemon,
target: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, To Philemon our dear friend and fellow worker—

source: chule ingailutnu Appia chule kasepai chanpi Arkhippa, chule na ina kikhom houbung hichengse henga chun;
target: also to Apphia our sister and Archippus our fellow soldier—and to the church that meets in your home:

source: i-Pau Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa-a konin nachung uva lungsetle lungmon umhen.
target: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

source: Keiman kataona-a namin kaphan ka Pathen kathangvah jingin ahi;
target: I always thank my God as I remember you in my prayers,

source: Ajeh chu Pakai Jesu le mithengho jouse nangailut le tahsan thu chu kanajan ahi;
target: because I hear about your love for all his holy people and your faith in the Lord Jesus.

source: Nangma-a um chule Christa Jesu'a um thilpha jouse hetsahna hin natahsan chu thilpha bolthei asona din katao jinge.
target: I pray that your partnership with us in the faith may be effective in deepening your understanding of every good thing we share for the sake of Christ.

source: Ajeh chu nangma ngailut chu hapan kakipapin kalungmonge; ajeh chu, sopi, nangma vangin mithengho alunghalui.
target: Your love has given me great joy and encouragement, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the Lord’s people.

source: Hijeh-a chu angai doltah-a bol dinga nangma thu peh ding Christa-a kangam jeng vangin,
target: Therefore, although in Christ I could be bold and order you to do what you ought to do,

source: ngailutna jala, tehse keima Paul Christa Jesu jala sohchang hi kahung taothojoh ahi;
target: yet I prefer to appeal to you on the basis of love. It is as none other than Paul—an old man and now also a prisoner of Christ Jesus—

source: Kakihen na sunga kahin kachapa Onesimus dinga kahung tao ahi;
target: that I appeal to you for my son Onesimus, who became my son while I was in chains.

source: Ama hi khatvei chu nadinga phachom lou ahin, tu vangin nangma dinga jong, keima dinga jong, phachom ahitai.
target: Formerly he was useless to you, but now he has become useful both to you and to me.

source: Amatah chu kalungtohtah ahin, nangma henga kahin solkit tai; hijeh chun ama anasangin.
target: I am sending him—who is my very heart—back to you.

source: Kipana Thupha jala kakihenna-a hi nangma thakhela eijenlea apantheina dinga keima kina dinga lhoden kagot ahin;
target: I would have liked to keep him with me so that he could take your place in helping me while I am in chains for the gospel.

source: Ahivangin nangma lung hina louvin ima kabol nompoi; naphatna chu khoh bola kon hilouva, nangma chamchama ahinajoh dinga kati ahi.
target: But I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that any favor you do would not seem forced but would be voluntary.

source: Amapa hi tonsot geija nanei theina dinga, chomkhat dinga nakoidoh hikhat hinte;
target: Perhaps the reason he was separated from you for a little while was that you might have him back forever—

source: Soh bang hita louva, soh sanga chungnungjo, sopi deitah bang hijohen, kei dingtah-a bon ahile, nangma dinga tahsa-a le Pakaiya gamchenga ha hicheh ahi.
target: no longer as a slave, but better than a slave, as a dear brother. He is very dear to me but even dearer to you, both as a fellow man and as a brother in the Lord.

source: Chuti chu ahile nangman keima hi tohkhompi tia neigela ahile, ama hi keima neilem ding khelin analemin.
target: So if you consider me a partner, welcome him as you would welcome me.

source: Chule ama nangma chunga suhkhel nei ahi jongle, ahilouva nabat aum jongle, hichu keijan simjengin,
target: If he has done you any wrong or owes you anything, charge it to me.

source: Keima Paul'in kakhut tah-a kasut ahi, keiman sanange: hichu, nangma tah-in keima neibat chu neisan, tia kasei ahipoi.
target: I, Paul, am writing this with my own hand. I will pay it back—not to mention that you owe me your very self.

source: Ahi, sopi, nanga konin keima Pakaiyah phatchomna neineisah-in; nangman keima Christa-a neisulung halin.
target: I do wish, brother, that I may have some benefit from you in the Lord; refresh my heart in Christ.

source: Naseingai gingcha tah-a kahinsut ahi, kathusei chu akalvala phajon bolinate, ti kahei.
target: Confident of your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even more than I ask.

source: Chujongle kalhunna ding mun gotsan anakoijin; ajeh chu nangho taona vangin nangho henga peh-in uminge ti kakineme.
target: And one thing more: Prepare a guest room for me, because I hope to be restored to you in answer to your prayers.

source: Christa Jesu'a kasohchanpi Epaphras'in nasalame;
target: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greetings.

source: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas chule Luke, kakithopiho hicheng hin nasalamui.
target: And so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas and Luke, my fellow workers.

source: I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa milungsetna chun nalhagaovu umpihen. Amen.
target: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.

source: Masang laijin Pathen'in abung abungin got chom got chomin themgaoho kamin iputeu ipateu hengah thu aseijin,
target: In the past God spoke to our ancestors through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

source: tulai ni nununga hin Achapan eiho hengah thu aseitai; hiche Achapatah chu imajouse gouloa atun ahitai, chule thilsem jouse jong hi ama khutna asemsah ahi.
target: but in these last days he has spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, and through whom also he made the universe.

source: Hiche Chapa chu aloupina vah le aumje kibahpi ama limtah ahin, athahatna thua ijakai tuh dinga ahin, amatah chun chonsetna asuthengin chungnunga Lal Chungnung pen jet lamah atoutai.
target: The Son is the radiance of God’s glory and the exact representation of his being, sustaining all things by his powerful word. After he had provided purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the Majesty in heaven.

source: Chule aman vantil ho sanga min phajo gou alo bangtah-in amaho sangin achungnung jotai.
target: So he became as much superior to the angels as the name he has inherited is superior to theirs.

source: Ijeh-inem itile vantil ho koipen jah-a itih pena, Nangma ka-Chapa nahi, Tunia keiman kahin nahitai? chujongle, Keima a-Pa kahi ding ahin, Ama ka-Chapa hi ding ahi tia aseikhah-em?
target: For to which of the angels did God ever say, “You are my Son; today I have become your Father”? Or again, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son”?

source: Ahin hiche apeng masapen chu vannoi leisetna ahinpui kit ding tenga ding chun, Pathen vantilte jousen ama chu chibai bohhen, ati.
target: And again, when God brings his firstborn into the world, he says, “Let all God’s angels worship him.”

source: Chule vantilte chungchang thua hitin aseije, Aman avantilho lhagao asosahjin, Alhachate chu meikong asosahjin ahi.
target: In speaking of the angels he says, “He makes his angels spirits, and his servants flames of fire.”

source: Chapa chungchang thua vang chun hiti hin aseije, Vo Pathen, nalaltouna chu tonsot tonsot geija umjing jeng ahi; Chule chondihna tengdop chu nagam tengdop ahi.
target: But about the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, will last for ever and ever; a scepter of justice will be the scepter of your kingdom.

source: Nangman chonphat nangailun, khan gitlou nahon ahi; Hijeh chun Pathen'in, na-Pathen'in, naloite chengse chungvumah kipana thao nanutan ahi.
target: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has set you above your companions by anointing you with the oil of joy.”

source: Chule, Pakai, atil abula nangman vannoi leiset bul naphudoh ahi; Chule vanho jong nangma khutsoh ahi.
target: He also says, “In the beginning, Lord, you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.

source: Hiteho chu mangthah ding ahi, nangma vang umjing jeng nahi; Hichengse chu ponsil banga lui ding ahi;
target: They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment.

source: Hiteho chu nangman ponlhe banga najel lom ding ahi; Hichengse chu ponsil banga kikhel ding ahi; Nangma vang nabang nahi jinge; Nakum jong bei lou ding ahi.
target: You will roll them up like a robe; like a garment they will be changed. But you remain the same, and your years will never end.”

source: Ahivangin keiman, Namelmate nakeng chotpha kaneisah masangsen, Kajet lamah tou jingin, tia vantil ho koipen jah-a aseikhah-em?
target: To which of the angels did God ever say, “Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet”?

source: Amaho chengse chu lhachale lhagao, sochatna gouloding teho jenle ding hinkisoldoh hilouham?
target: Are not all angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?

source: Hijeh-a chu ithu jah chengseu hi lunglut tah-a igut cheh dingu ahi; achuti loule ajole chucheng chu kitolmang sah khau hite.
target: We must pay the most careful attention, therefore, to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away.

source: Ijeh-inem itile vantil ho kama asei thu chu dettah-a, chule suhkhelnale thua nunlouna jouse man adoltah cheh-a asanuva ahile,
target: For since the message spoken through angels was binding, and every violation and disobedience received its just punishment,

source: huhhingna loupi hi nahsahmo leuhen eiho iti isochat dinguham? Hiche huhhingna hi amasa Pakai kama asei, ajahon eiho dinga aphudet ahin,
target: how shall we escape if we ignore so great a salvation? This salvation, which was first announced by the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard him.

source: melchihna le thilmu kidang chule bolmo kidang got tamtah toh tho-a, alunggot doltah-a Lhagao Theng phathei kihoma chu Pathen'in jong ahettoh sahpiu ahi.
target: God also testified to it by signs, wonders and various miracles, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit distributed according to his will.

source: Ijeh ham itile khonunga hung umding vannoi leiset thu iseiju chu aman vantil ho noijah akoipoi.
target: It is not to angels that he has subjected the world to come, about which we are speaking.

source: Ahinla khatnin mun khatnah ahettohsah-in, Mihem chu ipiham, nangman nalung viltenin? Chujongle Mihem Chapa chu ipiham, nangman navil jingin?
target: But there is a place where someone has testified: “What is mankind that you are mindful of them, a son of man that you care for him?

source: Nangman ama chu vantil ho sangin themcha khatbou nanoinun sah-in ahi; Loupitah-in gunchena lal lukhuh-in najemin ahi; Nakhutsoh jouse chunga vaipon natungin,
target: You made them a little lower than the angels; you crowned them with glory and honor

source: Chule imajouse abonchan akengphang noija nakoijin anoija na-umsahtai, tin aseijin ahi. Chutichun ijakai aboncha anoija akoi jeh chun, aman anoija akoi lou imacha aumtapoi. Ahivangin tu geijin eihon imajouse anoija alutsoh imu hih laijuve.
target: and put everything under their feet.” In putting everything under them, God left nothing that is not subject to them. Yet at present we do not see everything subject to them.

source: Ahin vantil ho sanga themcha khat anoinunsah Jesu vang chu imutaove, Pathen lungset vanga mi jouse dinga thina atepkhah tei ding mong ahin, thina athoh jeh chun choi-at nale loupina lukhuh-in akijemtan ahi.
target: But we do see Jesus, who was made lower than the angels for a little while, now crowned with glory and honor because he suffered death, so that by the grace of God he might taste death for everyone.

source: Ijeh-inem itile ama dinga thil ijakai uma, ama vanga thil ijakai um, ama dinga chu chate tamtah loupina-a apuilut jouse-a chu, ahuhhingnau lamkaipa chun athohgima asuhchamkim ding thu ahi.
target: In bringing many sons and daughters to glory, it was fitting that God, for whom and through whom everything exists, should make the pioneer of their salvation perfect through what he suffered.

source: Ijeh-inem itile asuthengpale asuhthengho chu aboncha khatna konbou ahiuve. Hijeh chun aman amaho chu sopi sah ding jahcha louvin,
target: Both the one who makes people holy and those who are made holy are of the same family. So Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers and sisters.

source: Keiman kasopite henga namin seiphong lengting, Houbung ho lah-a navahchoi la sange, atin;
target: He says, “I will declare your name to my brothers and sisters; in the assembly I will sing your praises.”

source: mun chom khatna, Kagin chatna ama jenga kangah ding ahi, atin; chukitman, Ven, keimale Pathen'in eipeh chapangte hi, ati.
target: And again, “I will put my trust in him.” And again he says, “Here am I, and the children God has given me.”

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun chapangteho chu thisanle tahsa chang khom ahi jeh-u chun, thina-a thina thu neipa, hichu diabol ahi, asuhpoi theina dingle,
target: Since the children have flesh and blood, he too shared in their humanity so that by his death he might break the power of him who holds the power of death—that is, the devil—

source: thi kichatmana hinlai sungse-a soh-a umteho jouse chu ahuhdoh theina dinga, amatah jong hichu changa ahitai.
target: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.

source: Atahbeh-in aman vantil ho umchan tho louvin Abraham chilhahte umchan athojotan ahi.
target: For surely it is not angels he helps, but Abraham’s descendants.

source: Hiche jeh chun miho chonset thensona dinga, ama Pathen lama dinga thempu chungnung mi khototah le tahsan umtah ahina dinga chu, ijakaija asopite bangbanga ahung umding chu adoltah ahi.
target: For this reason he had to be made like them, fully human in every way, in order that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God, and that he might make atonement for the sins of the people.

source: Ajeh chu aman lhepna atoa hesoh genthei athoh jeh chun, lhepna tohho phatna bola hu thei ahi.
target: Because he himself suffered when he was tempted, he is able to help those who are being tempted.

source: Hijeh chun, van kouna changkha sopi thengteho, itahsanu Solchah le Thempulen Chungnung Christa Jesu lam chu ha ngaitouvin.
target: Therefore, holy brothers and sisters, who share in the heavenly calling, fix your thoughts on Jesus, whom we acknowledge as our apostle and high priest.

source: Pathen insung jouse lah-a Mosi tahsan umtah ahi bang chun ama jong apansahpa lama tahsan umtah ahi.
target: He was faithful to the one who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in all God’s house.

source: Ajeh chu in sanga in sapa achoi-at joh bangtah-a chu, ama chu Mosi sanga gamchenga loupijo cheh dingdol ahi, tia kisima ahitai.
target: Jesus has been found worthy of greater honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house has greater honor than the house itself.

source: In jouse chu mi khat sahdoh ahi cheh-in, ahin imajouse sadohpa chu Pathen ahi.
target: For every house is built by someone, but God is the builder of everything.

source: Chuin khonunga thu hung kisei dingho hettohsahna dinga, Mosi chu Pathen insung jouse lah-a lhacha panga tahsan umtah ahi;
target: “Moses was faithful as a servant in all God’s house,” bearing witness to what would be spoken by God in the future.

source: Christa vang chu chapa ahin, ama insung chunga tahsan umtah ahi. Akhon ni geija iha kat naole kinepna ikisonao hi ituhdet pou ule, eiho hi a-insung mite ihiuve.
target: But Christ is faithful as the Son over God’s house. And we are his house, if indeed we hold firmly to our confidence and the hope in which we glory.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun Lhagao Thengin asei bangin, Tunia nanghon a-awgin najah uva ahile,
target: So, as the Holy Spirit says: “Today, if you hear his voice,

source: Lunghansah na-a bang chun nalungu tahsah hih-un, Gamthipma kipatep laija bang chu bol hih-un.
target: do not harden your hearts as you did in the rebellion, during the time of testing in the wilderness,

source: Chukoma chun naputeu napateu vin patepnan eideh-un ahi, Chule kathilbolho kum somli amuvin ahi.
target: where your ancestors tested and tried me, though for forty years they saw what I did.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu hiche phung mite chunga hi kalung lhai lou ahi, Amaho hi imatihchana lungchavai te mong ahiuve; Ahinla amahon kalampi ahepouve;
target: That is why I was angry with that generation; I said, ‘Their hearts are always going astray, and they have not known my ways.’

source: Chua kalung hanga kahahsel ahi, Hiteho kacholngah na-a lut lou ding ahiuve, kati ahitai.
target: So I declared on oath in my anger, ‘They shall never enter my rest.’ ”

source: Vo sopiteho, chingtheijun, ajole ijemtin Pathen hinga kona pul lhahna dingin, nangho lah-a jong tahsanlou lung giloupo um khauvinate.
target: See to it, brothers and sisters, that none of you has a sinful, unbelieving heart that turns away from the living God.

source: Ahin chonset lheplhah-a khattou lungtah chehcheh nalah uva aum louna dingin, Tuni kiti phat chu aumlai sungin khatle khat niseh-in kitilkhoutouvin.
target: But encourage one another daily, as long as it is called “Today,” so that none of you may be hardened by sin’s deceitfulness.

source: Ijeh-inem itile eihon ikinepnao tahbeh kipana hi akhon ni geija ituhdet jinguva ihipouvule, Christa kikoppi ihiu ahitai.
target: We have come to share in Christ, if indeed we hold our original conviction firmly to the very end.

source: Tunia a-awgin najah uva ahile, Lunghansahna-a bang chun nalungu tahsah hih-un, akitin ahi.
target: As has just been said: “Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts as you did in the rebellion.”

source: Hiche ati hi, athu ajah jouva lunghansah chu koi koiham? Egypt gama kona Mosi khutna ahinpuidohho chengse chu hilouham?
target: Who were they who heard and rebelled? Were they not all those Moses led out of Egypt?

source: Chule kum somli sunga alung himona koi chungham? Gamthip laija along lum, hiche chonseho chunga chu hilouham?
target: And with whom was he angry for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies perished in the wilderness?

source: Chule hiteho kacholngah na-a lut lou ding ahiuve, tia ahahselna chu koi chungchang thua aseiham? Thu ngailouho chungchang thua hilouham?
target: And to whom did God swear that they would never enter his rest if not to those who disobeyed?

source: Hichea hin amahon atahsan loujeh uva lut thei lou ahitaove, ti chu imuvin ahi.
target: So we see that they were not able to enter, because of their unbelief.

source: Hiche jeh chun eiho kichau hite, achuti loule ajole ama cholngahna-a lut theina ding thutepsa aum jeng vangin, nalah uva khattou chua lut dinga kona athona umle akilome.
target: Therefore, since the promise of entering his rest still stands, let us be careful that none of you be found to have fallen short of it.

source: Ijeh-inem itile Kipana Thupha ijah uva akisei chu eihon ijah mong mongu ahitan, amaho jong chutobangma chu ahi; ahivangin athu jahotoh tahsana akigop lou jeh-u chun, athujah-u chu amahon phatchomnan anei tapouve.
target: For we also have had the good news proclaimed to us, just as they did; but the message they heard was of no value to them, because they did not share the faith of those who obeyed.

source: Ajeh chu atahsan eiho chengse vanghi cholngahna-a chu ilut laiju ahi; Kalunghana kahahsel banga chu, Kacholngah na-a lut lou ding ahiuve, tia, asei bang chu ahi: vannoi leiset bul aphudoh tila aman anatoh ajosohsa ahitah vangin.
target: Now we who have believed enter that rest, just as God has said, “So I declared on oath in my anger, ‘They shall never enter my rest.’ ” And yet his works have been finished since the creation of the world.

source: Mun khatna aman ni sagini thudol aseijin, Chuin ni sagi nin Pathen anatoh jouse-a konin akicholngah tan ahi, ati.
target: For somewhere he has spoken about the seventh day in these words: “On the seventh day God rested from all his works.”

source: Chukitman hikoma chun ahiti sei kitleuve, Hiteho kacholngah na-a lut lou ding ahiuve,
target: And again in the passage above he says, “They shall never enter my rest.”

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun mi kimkhat cholngahna-a alut dingu aumnahlai jeh chun chule masanga Kipana Thupha kisei jasa hon ajoplou jeh uva alut lou jeh-u chun,
target: Therefore since it still remains for some to enter that rest, and since those who formerly had the good news proclaimed to them did not go in because of their disobedience,

source: khonung sottah nungin, Tuni tin nikho khat atep kittan, David kama masanga kisei bangma chun, Tunia nanghon a-aw najah uva ahile, Nalung tahsah hih-un, ati kitnin ahi.
target: God again set a certain day, calling it “Today.” This he did when a long time later he spoke through David, as in the passage already quoted: “Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts.”

source: Joshua'n amaho chu acholngahsah hitahenlang hile, khonunga nikho chom thu chu asei lou ding ahi.
target: For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day.

source: Hiche jeh chun Pathen mite dingin cholngah ni-a kicholngahna aumnalai jinge.
target: There remains, then, a Sabbath-rest for the people of God;

source: Ajeh chu Pathen anatoh-a kona akicholngah banga chu acholngahna-a lut jong chu anatoh-a kona kicholngah ahitai.
target: for anyone who enters God’s rest also rests from their works, just as God did from his.

source: Hijeh chun koiman chuche thua nunlou umchan chu athoa alhua aum louna dingin, cholngahna-a chu lutna dingin ponpanu hite.
target: Let us, therefore, make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one will perish by following their example of disobedience.

source: Ajeh chu Pathen thuhi hing jingle natonghat jing ahi, chule hemto chemjam jouse sanga jong hemjo ahi, hinna le lhagao gu kisuhtohna le lhin hichengse chu sukhen theihela sunthei ahi, chule lunggel le lungthim ngaito hetoh paijen jeng thei ahi.
target: For the word of God is alive and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it penetrates even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow; it judges the thoughts and attitudes of the heart.

source: Chule thilsem ama mitmu-a langlou imacha aumpoi; ichon nao isuhtouva ilhutna dingpao mitmu-a chu imajouse asagohkeo le kihongsa ahi.
target: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight. Everything is uncovered and laid bare before the eyes of him to whom we must give account.

source: Vanho chengse jotpaija chea Pathen Chapa Jesu thempulen chungnunga inei jeh-u chun, itahsan iphonu hi ha tuh det jinguhite.
target: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has ascended into heaven, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to the faith we profess.

source: Ajeh chu ihatmonau eihetpia eithohpi phah lou thempu chungnung neija ihipouve, eibanga imalam jouse-a lhepnale patepna tohkha-a thohkha-a, ahi jenga jong chonsetna nei louheljoh ineiju ahi.
target: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to empathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who has been tempted in every way, just as we are—yet he did not sin.

source: Hiche jeh chun hepina ichan theina dingule, panpina ingaichat phat ule lungset nale panpina imu theina dingun, hakattah-in lungsetna laltouna chu neijuhite.
target: Let us then approach God’s throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

source: Ijeh ham itile thempu chungnung jouse chu chonset thensona-a thilto le gan kithat alhakop theina dinguva, mi lah-a kona kilachoma mihemte dinga Pathen lam thila chu kipansah ahiuve.
target: Every high priest is selected from among the people and is appointed to represent the people in matters related to God, to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins.

source: Amaho chu ima helouho le sukhelteho chunga nemheocha lungde thei ahiuve; ajeh chu amahotah jeng jong hatmona-in aum kimvel chehjiu ahi;
target: He is able to deal gently with those who are ignorant and are going astray, since he himself is subject to weakness.

source: chuti chu ahin miho dinga abol banga chu, amahotah dinga jong chonset thensona dinga kilhaina abol louthei ahipoi.
target: This is why he has to offer sacrifices for his own sins, as well as for the sins of the people.

source: Chule hiche choi-atna chu Aaron banga Pathen'in akoulousen koiman ama chamin akilahpoi.
target: And no one takes this honor on himself, but he receives it when called by God, just as Aaron was.

source: Hiche bang chun Christa jongin thempu chungnung hi dingin amale ama akichoi anpoi; ajah-a, Nangma ka-Chapa nahi, Tunia kahin nahi, tipajoh chun achoi-at ahibouve.
target: In the same way, Christ did not take on himself the glory of becoming a high priest. But God said to him, “You are my Son; today I have become your Father.”

source: Chutima chun mun chom khatnah, Melchizedec umdan banga Tonsot thempu nahi, tin aseije.
target: And he says in another place, “You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek.”

source: Ama chun tahsaphe-a aumlai ni chun thina-a kona ama huhdoh theipa hengah hapena pengle mitlhi lha-a taona le thumna atoh-in, chule a-Pathen gin jeh chun ngaipeh-in aumtan ahi;
target: During the days of Jesus’ life on earth, he offered up prayers and petitions with fervent cries and tears to the one who could save him from death, and he was heard because of his reverent submission.

source: Chapatah ahi jeng vangin athohna chengsea chu thua nunje kisinna ahitai.
target: Son though he was, he learned obedience from what he suffered

source: Chuin ama chamkimsah sohkeijin aumin, athua nungho jouse dingin tonsot sochatna bulpi asohtan ahi.
target: and, once made perfect, he became the source of eternal salvation for all who obey him

source: Chule Melchizedec umchan banga thempu chungnung ahi, tin Pathen'in asahtai.
target: and was designated by God to be high priest in the order of Melchizedek.

source: Ama thudol chu thu tamtah sei ding kaneijun, nakolsehtah jeh-un ahilchet jong ahahsai.
target: We have much to say about this, but it is hard to make it clear to you because you no longer try to understand.

source: Hitih chanpia hi, nangho mihil thei nahi dingu thu ahitan chutitah sangin, khat touvin Pathen thubul kipatna jemho nahildiu nangai chaovin ahi; chule anham hilouva, bongnoi ngainalai mitoh nabangtaove.
target: In fact, though by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to teach you the elementary truths of God’s word all over again. You need milk, not solid food!

source: Bongnoi anna neija chun, naosen ahi jeh-in, chonphatna lam thu hetna imacha ineipoi.
target: Anyone who lives on milk, being still an infant, is not acquainted with the teaching about righteousness.

source: Anham vang chu mi kikhan lhitho dingbou ahi, chuteho chun ahet theinao chu aman jing jeh-un, ase apha hetkhenin athem lhehtauve.
target: But solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained themselves to distinguish good from evil.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun Christa thuhil kipatna api lam donta louvin; chule natoh thisa-a kona lung heile, Pathen tahsan,
target: Therefore let us move beyond the elementary teachings about Christ and be taken forward to maturity, not laying again the foundation of repentance from acts that lead to death, and of faith in God,

source: Baptize chan gotchom chom, chule khut ngap, athisaho hindoh kit, chule tonsot thutan vaihom thudol lam thuhilna bulphut kit ta louvin, pilhina lam dela masotna dingin kihaboluhite.
target: instruction about cleansing rites, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.

source: Chule Pathen'in eiphat sah uva ahile, hicheho chu ibol dingu ahi.
target: And God permitting, we will do so.

source: Ajeh chu khatvei khovah changsaho chun van thilpeh chu atep khataovin, Lhagao Theng changa ahitaovin,
target: It is impossible for those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, who have shared in the Holy Spirit,

source: chule Pathen thupha le khonunga hung soh ding thilboltheina chu tepkhasa ahitaovin;
target: who have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the coming age

source: Amaho chu alhuhtah uva ahile, alung heina dinguva semphat thah theihoi ahipouve; ajeh chu amahon Pathen Chapa chu amaho tuma thingpel'a khenbeh kit ahiuvin, chule lhangphong tah-ah taipongin aumsah jiuve.
target: and who have fallen away, to be brought back to repentance. To their loss they are crucifying the Son of God all over again and subjecting him to public disgrace.

source: Ajeh chu leisetnin, achunga ju jing go twi tintang anadona, adinga lei kigitpehho dinga nehdol anche louhing apensah ahin, hiche leiset chu Pathen'a konin phattheina achangin ahi.
target: Land that drinks in the rain often falling on it and that produces a crop useful to those for whom it is farmed receives the blessing of God.

source: Ahin ling phungle ham lingnei apendoh vangle, hichu pannabei ahin, chule sapset anaijin, akhonna chu meija govam ahi.
target: But land that produces thorns and thistles is worthless and is in danger of being cursed. In the end it will be burned.

source: Ahin, deitahteho, chutia kasei vangun, nangho umchan chu hiche sanga phajo leh huhhing-a umnatoh kithokhom thilho nabol dingu kagingcha lheh jengui.
target: Even though we speak like this, dear friends, we are convinced of better things in your case—the things that have to do with salvation.

source: Ijeh ham itile nanghon mithengte nanajenleu ahitan; tun jong najenleuvin, hiche Pathen min lama natohgimnao le ngailutna kilanga nalhanao Pathen'in asuhmil ding chu, ama chutobanga chondihlou ahipoi.
target: God is not unjust; he will not forget your work and the love you have shown him as you have helped his people and continue to help them.

source: Chule akhon ni geija kinepna chamkim kichentah chu mu dingin, nahapan ngai bangu chun hapan cheh-un,
target: We want each of you to show this same diligence to the very end, so that what you hope for may be fully realized.

source: Thase louvin tahsan leh thohhat vanga thutep mun loho chu, amaho chonnung chu jui chehleu chun, kalungu ahi.
target: We do not want you to become lazy, but to imitate those who through faith and patience inherit what has been promised.

source: Pathen'in Abraham athutep chun kihahselna ding ama sanga lenjo aum lou jeh-in, ama changin akihahselin,
target: When God made his promise to Abraham, since there was no one greater for him to swear by, he swore by himself,

source: Thon louva keiman nangma phatthei kaboh ding nahi, chule pun jong kapunsah ding nahi, ati.
target: saying, “I will surely bless you and give you many descendants.”

source: Hiti chun aman angahat, athohhat jeh-in thutep ga chu amutan ahi.
target: And so after waiting patiently, Abraham received what was promised.

source: Ijeh-inem itile mihon ama sanga chungnungjo chu kihahsel na-a aneijiu ahi, chule thu kichetna dinga akihahselu chu akinelnao jouse kichaina ahi.
target: People swear by someone greater than themselves, and the oath confirms what is said and puts an end to all argument.

source: Chutobanga chu Pathen'in athutep gou lo dingho chu, alung ngaito long lou ahi chu nasacheh tah-a vetsah ding lung agotna, kihahselna chu asuhdet ahi.
target: Because God wanted to make the unchanging nature of his purpose very clear to the heirs of what was promised, he confirmed it with an oath.

source: Pathen jou ahi louna kikhel lou thil ni vanga, eiho kihuh dohna dinga ima sang uva um kinepna kikoi chu tuh dinga lhaija eihon kitilkhou na nasatah ineina dinguva, abol ahi.
target: God did this so that, by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be greatly encouraged.

source: Hiche kinepna chu hinna thihhat-aija ineiju ahi; hichu kichentah, dettah ahin, chule pondal sung lam geija lut ahi;
target: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. It enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain,

source: Hikom mun'a chu Jesu anamasa-a Melchizedec umchan dungjuija tonsot thempu chungnung hia, eiho dinga analut masa-a ahitai.
target: where our forerunner, Jesus, has entered on our behalf. He has become a high priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek.

source: Hiche Melchizedec, Salem lengpa chu, Chungnung pen Pathen thempu ahin, chule Abraham'in lengho agatha jouva ahung kile kit chun lampia agalamton phatthei agaboh-in ahi.
target: This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He met Abraham returning from the defeat of the kings and blessed him,

source: Ama chu Abraham'in thil jouse hopsom-a hopkhat apen ahi. Amin chu amasa chonphat Leng kitina ahin, chuin Salem Lengpa ahi, hichu chamna lungmonna Lengpa kitina ahi.
target: and Abraham gave him a tenth of everything. First, the name Melchizedek means “king of righteousness”; then also, “king of Salem” means “king of peace.”

source: Ama chu nu neilou, pa neilou, chilhah guilhah neilou, ahinkho kipatle ahinkho lhinna bei ahin, Pathen Chapa banga kisem ahin, hiche Melchizedec chu a-imatih chana thempu-a umjing ahi.
target: Without father or mother, without genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life, resembling the Son of God, he remains a priest forever.

source: Lung gelun ngaitouvin: ipului bulpiu Abraham'in athilchom aphalai chengse hopsom-a hopkhat apehpa chu itobanga len hitam!
target: Just think how great he was: Even the patriarch Abraham gave him a tenth of the plunder!

source: Chule Levi chate lah-a thempu dinmun changho chun, danthu nungjuija miho lah-a kona, Abraham taiguija peng ahi jeng vangin asopitehoa kona, hopsom-a hopkhat lahna ding thu aneiju ahi;
target: Now the law requires the descendants of Levi who become priests to collect a tenth from the people—that is, from their fellow Israelites—even though they also are descended from Abraham.

source: Amaho phung guija kona akhanggui thu kisimtha loupa vang chun Abraham'a konin hop soma hop khat akilah-in, thutep neipatah chu phatthei aboh tan ahi.
target: This man, however, did not trace his descent from Levi, yet he collected a tenth from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.

source: Chule mineojon achunga mi-a kona bou phatthei boh amu chu kinelna bei ahi.
target: And without doubt the lesser is blessed by the greater.

source: Hiche hin hopsom-a hopkhat muho vang chu thina thu noija um ahiuve; khat joh hopsom-a hopkhat mupa vang chu hing jing jeng ahi, ti hettohna kineija ahitai.
target: In the one case, the tenth is collected by people who die; but in the other case, by him who is declared to be living.

source: Chule hopsom-a hopkhat mupa Levi chun amatah-in Abraham'a konin hopsom-a hopkhat apei tilehen ti thei ahi;
target: One might even say that Levi, who collects the tenth, paid the tenth through Abraham,

source: Ajeh iham itile Melchizedec chun apu agalamtoa chu Levi atai sunga umnalai ahi.
target: because when Melchizedek met Abraham, Levi was still in the body of his ancestor.

source: Chuti chu ahin, Levi ho themputna chu chamkim sohkei thei hile (ajeh chu chua kona chu mihon chonna danthu amu-u ahi), Aaron umdan banga kisei louva, Melchizedec umdan banga ding thempu got chom khat umdoh lou i-khohta dingham?
target: If perfection could have been attained through the Levitical priesthood—and indeed the law given to the people established that priesthood—why was there still need for another priest to come, one in the order of Melchizedek, not in the order of Aaron?

source: Ajeh chu thempu akikhele danthu jong khel tei ding thu ahi.
target: For when the priesthood is changed, the law must be changed also.

source: Aumchan thu kiseipa chu phung chom mi ahi; chuche phunga mi koimacha maicham mun'a natonga aumpoi.
target: He of whom these things are said belonged to a different tribe, and no one from that tribe has ever served at the altar.

source: Ijeh ham itile I-Pakaiyu chu Juda phunga penga ahi chu kichentah-in akilange; ahin hiche phung thua chun Mosi'n thempuho thudol ima aseipoi.
target: For it is clear that our Lord descended from Judah, and in regard to that tribe Moses said nothing about priests.

source: Chule tahsaphe thupeh danthu dungjuija hilouvin, mantih neilou hinna thahat dungjuijoh ahin,
target: And what we have said is even more clear if another priest like Melchizedek appears,

source: Melchizedec lim banga thempu chombeh khat hung uma ahile, kathu seiju hi kichen cheh ahi.
target: one who has become a priest not on the basis of a regulation as to his ancestry but on the basis of the power of an indestructible life.

source: Ajeh iham itile hichu hettohsahna chun, Melchizedec umdan dungjuijin, Nangma tonsot thempu nahi, ati.
target: For it is declared: “You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek.”

source: Ajeh chu ahatmole phatchomna bei ahi jeh-in chonna dan thupeh amasa chu amangthah tai.
target: The former regulation is set aside because it was weak and useless

source: Ajeh iham itile chonna dan thupeh chun imacha asucham kimpon ahi; ama mun'a chu kinepna pha chungnungjo kipolut ahitai; hiche chu eihon Pathen kom inailutnao ahi.
target: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a better hope is introduced, by which we draw near to God.

source: Chule achuti jeng vang chun ama chu hahsel louva thempu-a kipansah ahipoi,
target: And it was not without an oath! Others became priests without any oath,

source: (ijeh-inem itile amaho chu hahsel louva thempu-a kisema anahitauvin; hijongle ama vang ajah-a, Pakai chun akihahsele alung hei kit lou ding ahi, Melchizedec umdan bangin nangma tonsot thempu nahi).
target: but he became a priest with an oath when God said to him: “The Lord has sworn and will not change his mind: ‘You are a priest forever.’ ”

source: Chuti chu ahi jeh-in Jesu chu kitepna chungnungjo-a panga ahitai.
target: Because of this oath, Jesus has become the guarantor of a better covenant.

source: Chule amaho chu thina-in asuhmo uva apan jing thei lou jeh-un, thempu chu ana tamlheh-un ahi;
target: Now there have been many of those priests, since death prevented them from continuing in office;

source: Ama vang chu tonsot geija umjing ahi jeh chun khel louhel thempu mun changa ahitai.
target: but because Jesus lives forever, he has a permanent priesthood.

source: Hijeh chun ama vanga Pathen kom nai lut teho chu, taopeh dinga ama hing jing jeng ahi jeh-a chu, amaho chu huhhing chamkimsoh thei ahi.
target: Therefore he is able to save completely those who come to God through him, because he always lives to intercede for them.

source: Ijeh ham itile chutobang thempu chungnung athena theng, lepthol neilou, boh behlou, chonsete lah-a kona kisepdoh, vanho sanga chungnung-jo-a kisema chu eiho dinga kilom mong ahi.
target: Such a high priest truly meets our need—one who is holy, blameless, pure, set apart from sinners, exalted above the heavens.

source: Ama chun aniseh-a thempu chung nungho banga chu, amasa ama chonset thensona-a, gan kithat alha masah ding chu akin akhohpon ahi; ijeh ham itile aman hichu amatah akilha jeng jeh chun khat veijin aseibulhit sohkeitan ahi.
target: Unlike the other high priests, he does not need to offer sacrifices day after day, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. He sacrificed for their sins once for all when he offered himself.

source: Ajeh chu danthun apansah thempu chung nungho chu hatmona nei mihem ahiuve; danthu nunga um hahselna thu chun tonsot geija dinga kisucham kimsoh Chapa chu apansah ahi.
target: For the law appoints as high priests men in all their weakness; but the oath, which came after the law, appointed the Son, who has been made perfect forever.

source: Chunga thu kisei chengse lah-a athupipen hiche ahi, Van'a Chungnung pen laltouna jet lama tou,
target: Now the main point of what we are saying is this: We do have such a high priest, who sat down at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in heaven,

source: Chule mihem tundoh hilouva, Pakai tundoh houbuh tahbeh le mun theng lhachale-a pang Thempu Chungnung ineijun ahi.
target: and who serves in the sanctuary, the true tabernacle set up by the Lord, not by a mere human being.

source: Thempu chungnung jouse chu thilto le kithensona ganlha dinga kitung cheh ahiuve; chuti ahi jeh chun hiche Thempu Chungnung jong hin ikhat khat todoh anei tei ding thu ahi.
target: Every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices, and so it was necessary for this one also to have something to offer.

source: Ama vannoi leiset chunga anaum hile, thempu hilouhel ding ahi; ijeh ham itile danthu dungjuija thilto tohdoh dinga chu aum naovin ahi.
target: If he were on earth, he would not be a priest, for there are already priests who offer the gifts prescribed by the law.

source: Amaho lhachale-a apannau chu, Mosi'n houbuh sah dinga agot laija, Pathen'in ahilchah-a ajah-a, Chingtheijin, vetkah dinga mol chunga nakivetsah lim bang bang chun bol sohkeijin, tia asei banga chu van'a thil limdanle ale ahibouve.
target: They serve at a sanctuary that is a copy and shadow of what is in heaven. This is why Moses was warned when he was about to build the tabernacle: “See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.”

source: Tu vangin kitepna phajo cheh palaija apan dungjuija, kitepna chu thutep phajo chunga ahisah-a, lhacha mun phachung nung jo-a panga ahitai.
target: But in fact the ministry Jesus has received is as superior to theirs as the covenant of which he is mediator is superior to the old one, since the new covenant is established on better promises.

source: Ajeh chu kitepna masah chu themona beihel hile, aninapa mun ding chu kingaito lou ding ahi;
target: For if there had been nothing wrong with that first covenant, no place would have been sought for another.

source: ajeh iham itile amaho chu a-oimon, Veuvin, Pakaiyin hitin aseije keiman Israel phung mite leh Juda phung mite dinga, Kitepna thah kasemdoh ding nikho hung lhung ding ahitai,
target: But God found fault with the people and said: “The days are coming, declares the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the people of Israel and with the people of Judah.

source: Aputeo apateu Egypt gama kona puidoh ding ni-a akhutnuva katuh-a, Amahotoh kitepna kasemdoh, hiche kitepna tobang chu ahitapoi, Ajeh chu amaho kakitep naovah aum jompouvin ahi; Chuti ahi jeh-a chu keiman jong amaho kadon lou ahitai, tin Pakaiyin aseije.
target: It will not be like the covenant I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand to lead them out of Egypt, because they did not remain faithful to my covenant, and I turned away from them, declares the Lord.

source: Hiche nikhoho nunga Israelte toh kitepna kaphudoh ding chu Hiche hi ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseije; Alungthim uva kachondan thupeh pengting, Chule alung sunguva kasut ding ahi; Chule keima amaho Pathen hingting, amaho jong kamite hi ding ahiuve;
target: This is the covenant I will establish with the people of Israel after that time, declares the Lord. I will put my laws in their minds and write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

source: Chule amitakipmin aheng akom le asopite chengu, Pakai chu heuvin, tia ahil lou dingu ahitai; Ajeh chu aneopena pat alenpen geija eihetsohkei dingu ahitai.
target: No longer will they teach their neighbor, or say to one another, ‘Know the Lord,’ because they will all know me, from the least of them to the greatest.

source: Asuhkhelnauva jong kahepi ding ahi, Achonsetnao le akhangitlou nau jong geldohta lou ding kahi, ati.
target: For I will forgive their wickedness and will remember their sins no more.”

source: Hiche kitepna hi aman athah ahi atia ahile, amasa chu aluisah ahitai. Chutichu ahin aluija le atehta-a chu, amang ding kon ahitai.
target: By calling this covenant “new,” he has made the first one obsolete; and what is obsolete and outdated will soon disappear.

source: Chule kitepna masa-a jong chu Pathen lhachale-a pandanle mun theng, hiche vannoi leisetna mun theng ana uma ahi.
target: Now the first covenant had regulations for worship and also an earthly sanctuary.

source: Ahoubuh semu chu adan masapena chu meivah tunna, dokhang, vetsahna changlhah to uma ahin, hichu Mun Theng atiu ahi.
target: A tabernacle was set up. In its first room were the lampstand and the table with its consecrated bread; this was called the Holy Place.

source: Chule pondal nina dan sunga chu houbuh Mun Theng Chungnung atiu chu uma ahin;
target: Behind the second curtain was a room called the Most Holy Place,

source: Hikoma chu gimnam twi halna sana maichamle, kitepna thingkhong sana kilonkhum chu uma ahin, kitepna thingkhong sunga chu manna umna sana bel leh, Aaron tenggol pahmum, chule kitepna songpheng ni chu uma ahi;
target: which had the golden altar of incense and the gold-covered ark of the covenant. This ark contained the gold jar of manna, Aaron’s staff that had budded, and the stone tablets of the covenant.

source: chule achung vuma chu hepi touna lekhu-a Cherub loupitah ni uma ahin; hitiho thu chu tun akip akoijin sei joupouhite.
target: Above the ark were the cherubim of the Glory, overshadowing the atonement cover. But we cannot discuss these things in detail now.
