source: Chuti chun thil hicheng chu akisemin, thempuho Pathen houna lhachale dingin houbuh masa sunga chun alut jingjiuvin ahi;
target: When everything had been arranged like this, the priests entered regularly into the outer room to carry on their ministry.

source: Adan nina sungnunga vang chun thempu chungnung changsehbou kum khat sungin khatvei alutjin ahi; ahivangin ama dingle miho-a ding, het louva achonsetnao thensona ding, thisan chu choi louvin alutjipoi.
target: But only the high priest entered the inner room, and that only once a year, and never without blood, which he offered for himself and for the sins the people had committed in ignorance.

source: Houbuh masa chu aumlai chansea mun theng sunga lutna lam chu kilangsoh lou ahi, tin Lhagao Thengin aphonge.
target: The Holy Spirit was showing by this that the way into the Most Holy Place had not yet been disclosed as long as the first tabernacle was still functioning.

source: Chule hichu tu laija dinga tekahna ahibouve; hiche dungjuija chu thilto le kithensona jong alhajiu ahin, hitiho chun ase apha hetna lama ahouho chu achamkimsah thei lou ahi;
target: This is an illustration for the present time, indicating that the gifts and sacrifices being offered were not able to clear the conscience of the worshiper.

source: Neh dan, don dan, kisil gotchom chomtoh tahsa polam thudan jeng ahin, semphat kah-a dinga anakingaitoa ahibouve.
target: They are only a matter of food and drink and various ceremonial washings—external regulations applying until the time of the new order.

source: Christa vang chu khonunga hung umding thilpha thempu chungnunga hung panga khutna sah lou, hiche thilsem lah-a hilou, alen chungnung jole gamchenga chamkimjo houbuh-a chu lut ahin,
target: But when Christ came as high priest of the good things that are now already here, he went through the greater and more perfect tabernacle that is not made with human hands, that is to say, is not a part of this creation.

source: Kelchale bongnou thisana hilouva, ama thisana Mun Thenga khatveiseh lutna, eiho dinga tonsot geija lhatdohna kemlou eipeh-u ahitai.
target: He did not enter by means of the blood of goats and calves; but he entered the Most Holy Place once for all by his own blood, thus obtaining eternal redemption.

source: Ijeh ham itile kelchale bongchal thisan chule bongla vutvam kithe khuminbon akisuboho atahsa polamu athensah-a ahile:
target: The blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a heifer sprinkled on those who are ceremonially unclean sanctify them so that they are outwardly clean.

source: Christa tonsot kemlou Lhagaova, nolna beihela, ama Pathen'a kipedoh jenga thisan chun Pathen hing lhachale-a pang dinga, thina natoh-a kona ase apha nahetnao chu gamchenga asuhtheng cheh ding ahi.
target: How much more, then, will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself unblemished to God, cleanse our consciences from acts that lead to death, so that we may serve the living God!

source: Chule hiche jeh-a ama chu kitepna thah palai hija, kitepna masa noija suhkhel neija themoho lhatdoh na-a athitah jeh-a chu, akikouho chu tonsot kemlou gou lo ding ahitaove.
target: For this reason Christ is the mediator of a new covenant, that those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance—now that he has died as a ransom to set them free from the sins committed under the first covenant.

source: Ajeh chu kitepna umna-a chu kitepna sempa chu athi lounaje umlou ahi.
target: In the case of a will, it is necessary to prove the death of the one who made it,

source: Ajeh chu thi nunglebou thulhun chu hatjia ahi: athuteppa hinlaise vangin ahatjipoi.
target: because a will is in force only when somebody has died; it never takes effect while the one who made it is living.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu kitepna masa jong chu thisan beija kiphut det lou ahi.
target: This is why even the first covenant was not put into effect without blood.

source: Mosi'n danthu dungjuija thupeh miho jah-a aseichai phatnin, bongnoule kelcha thisan chu twitoh ponsan toh hyssop toh alan, lekhabule miho jouse chu athekhumin,
target: When Moses had proclaimed every command of the law to all the people, he took the blood of calves, together with water, scarlet wool and branches of hyssop, and sprinkled the scroll and all the people.

source: Hiche hi Pathen'in nangho napeh-u thupeh kitepna thisan chu ahi, ati.
target: He said, “This is the blood of the covenant, which God has commanded you to keep.”

source: Chucheng kalval jongin houbuh chule lhachaleho manchah chengse jong chu chutima chun thisan chu athekhumin ahi.
target: In the same way, he sprinkled with the blood both the tabernacle and everything used in its ceremonies.

source: Danthu dungjuija chu imajouse aboncha thisana suhtheng soh himaija ahi, chule thisanso louva ngaidamna umlou ahi.
target: In fact, the law requires that nearly everything be cleansed with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.

source: Hiche jeh chun hichenga chu van'a thil lima um chu hitia hi suhtheng dingdol mong ahi, van thil tahtah ho vang chu chucheng sanga longlhenna phajo cheh-a suhtheng dingdol thu ahi.
target: It was necessary, then, for the copies of the heavenly things to be purified with these sacrifices, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

source: Atabbeh lima um khutna kisa mun thenga Christa alutpon ahi; ahin tun eiho jala Pathen anga ding dingin van'a alutjotan ahi.
target: For Christ did not enter a sanctuary made with human hands that was only a copy of the true one; he entered heaven itself, now to appear for us in God’s presence.

source: Thempu chungnungin kumtina ama thisan hilou achoija, Mun Thenga alutji banga chu, ama thensona gan lha dinga lut matchet ahipoi;
target: Nor did he enter heaven to offer himself again and again, the way the high priest enters the Most Holy Place every year with blood that is not his own.

source: Chuti chu hile vannoi kisemtila patna aman tamtahvei athohgim ding ahitai; ahivangin tun aman amatah longlhengin akitoh jengin chonset suhbeina dingin tu khang nunungpen hin khatveiseh ahung kilahtan ahi.
target: Otherwise Christ would have had to suffer many times since the creation of the world. But he has appeared once for all at the culmination of the ages to do away with sin by the sacrifice of himself.

source: Chule mihemte dinga khatvei thia chujoule thutanna hung umding chu gotsa ahin;
target: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment,

source: Hiche banga chu Christa jong mi tamtah chonset pomang dinga kitoh ahitan, aniveina-a chonsetna beihela ama ngah jingho huhhing dinga hung kilang ding ahi.
target: so Christ was sacrificed once to take away the sins of many; and he will appear a second time, not to bear sin, but to bring salvation to those who are waiting for him.

source: Danthu chu khonunga thilpha hung umding lima hi umbou ahin, alim tahbeh ahi lou jeh chun, akumtina longlhenna alhajiu chun ahin naiho chu achamkimsah joupouvin ahi.
target: The law is only a shadow of the good things that are coming—not the realities themselves. For this reason it can never, by the same sacrifices repeated endlessly year after year, make perfect those who draw near to worship.

source: Chuti lou hile longlhenna alhajiu chu tangta lou dingham? Ahouho chu khatveija kisutheng hileu setna ahetnao chu umtalou ding ahi.
target: Otherwise, would they not have stopped being offered? For the worshipers would have been cleansed once for all, and would no longer have felt guilty for their sins.

source: Ahinla hicheng chun kumtin in achonsetnao ageldohsah jotaovin ahi.
target: But those sacrifices are an annual reminder of sins.

source: Ajeh iham itile bongchal le kelcha thisana chonset suhbeihoi hilou ahi.
target: It is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.

source: Hijeh chun Christan vannoi leisetna ahung lut laijin, Nangman longlhenle thilto nanadeipon, Ahin keima dingin tahsa neigot pehtan ahi;
target: Therefore, when Christ came into the world, he said: “Sacrifice and offering you did not desire, but a body you prepared for me;

source: Ganpumgo thilto le chonset thensona longlhenna chun nana lunglhai tapon ahi;
target: with burnt offerings and sin offerings you were not pleased.

source: Chuin keiman, Ven, keima kahungtai (Lekhabua keima thudola hitin akisune). Vo Pathen, keiman nangma lungdeilam bol dinga hung kahi kati, tin aseije.
target: Then I said, ‘Here I am—it is written about me in the scroll— I have come to do your will, my God.’ ”

source: Aman hicheng chu aseijin, Nangman longlhenna le thilto chule ganpumgo thilto chule chonset thensona longlhen chu nanadeitapon, hichenga chun lung jong nana lunglhai pon ahi, (hichu danthu dungjuija kitoh ahi jeh-in):
target: First he said, “Sacrifices and offerings, burnt offerings and sin offerings you did not desire, nor were you pleased with them”—though they were offered in accordance with the law.

source: Chujouvin, o Pathen Ven, keima nangma lungdeilam bol dinga hung kahi, ati. Hiche anunungjo hi aphudohna dinga amasajo alahdoh ahitai.
target: Then he said, “Here I am, I have come to do your will.” He sets aside the first to establish the second.

source: Hiche lungdei lama chu Jesu Christa tahsa akitoa a-imatih chana dinga khatveija akitodoh jeng vanga chu eiho suhthenga uma ihitaove.
target: And by that will, we have been made holy through the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

source: Chule thempuho chengse adingun niseh-in hou lhachalen apangun, imatih chana chonset sumang theilou longlhen chu avel avelin atohdoh jiuvin ahi.
target: Day after day every priest stands and performs his religious duties; again and again he offers the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.

source: Ama vangin chonset thensona longlhen khatseh chu tonsot geija dingin atohdoh-in, Pathen khut jet lama atouvin,
target: But when this priest had offered for all time one sacrifice for sins, he sat down at the right hand of God,

source: Hiche kalse chun amelmaho akeng chotpha akisem masang seuvin angah jingin ahi.
target: and since that time he waits for his enemies to be made his footstool.

source: Ijeh-inem itile suhthenga umho chu thilto khatseh-in tonsot geija dinga achamkimsah ahitai.
target: For by one sacrifice he has made perfect forever those who are being made holy.

source: Chule Lhagao Theng jongin eihet tohsah naove;
target: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us about this. First he says:

source: ajeh iham itile Chuteng chuche ninung le chun amahotoh kitepna Kaphudoh ding chu hiche ahi, tin Pakai chun aseije: Keiman alung sunguva kachondan thupeh pengting, Chule alunguva kasut ding ahi, tia aseijouvin, hiche aseijouma chun,
target: “This is the covenant I will make with them after that time, says the Lord. I will put my laws in their hearts, and I will write them on their minds.”

source: Chule achonsetnao le asuhkhelnau geldoh taponge, ati kitleuve.
target: Then he adds: “Their sins and lawless acts I will remember no more.”

source: Chutia chu chonsetna chengse ngaidama um ahitan, chonset thensona thilto umtalou ahi.
target: And where these have been forgiven, sacrifice for sin is no longer necessary.

source: Hiche jeh chun, sopiteho, Jesu'n pondal ajotpaija atahsa puma hinna lam thah eisempeh uva chu,
target: Therefore, brothers and sisters, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,

source: Jesu thisan vanga Mun Thenga lut ngamna ineiju ahin,
target: by a new and living way opened for us through the curtain, that is, his body,

source: Pathen insung chunga kitung thempulen chungnung ineiju ahin,
target: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,

source: Chule ase apha ihetnao ilung sunguva aphalou chengse atheh ngima, itahsao twi thenga kisilngima ahitah jeh chun, lung dihtah pun tahsan kichentah-in Pathen kom naiju hitin,
target: let us draw near to God with a sincere heart and with the full assurance that faith brings, having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and having our bodies washed with pure water.

source: Itahsan, ikinepnao hi long louhelin tuh det jinguhite; (ajeh chu thutep pa chu tahsan umtah ahi.)
target: Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, for he who promised is faithful.

source: Chule ngailutna le thilpha bolna lama lungsoudohna dingin kingaitopeh chehjiu hite;
target: And let us consider how we may spur one another on toward love and good deeds,

source: Abang khattou chonna bangin ikikhop hai louvin, nikho chu ahungnai tultulle ti ihet chanun, khatle khat kitilkhouto chehjiuhite.
target: not giving up meeting together, as some are in the habit of doing, but encouraging one another—and all the more as you see the Day approaching.

source: Ajeh chu eihon thutah hetna inei nungun, ihenasale ijanasan chonset bol leuhen, chonset jala longlhenna akikheh umtalou ahin;
target: If we deliberately keep on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no sacrifice for sins is left,

source: Thutanna kichat umtah ngah jinga chule adouho kavam gam dingkon lungsatna meikong bou uma ahi.
target: but only a fearful expectation of judgment and of raging fire that will consume the enemies of God.

source: Koi hile Mosi danthu nahsahmo-a chu ahetoh mi ni le thum kam sung thua kona hepina beihela thia ahi.
target: Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.

source: Chuti ahile Pathen Chapa akengtoa chotpha, chule akisuh thengna kitepna thisan chu atheng louva ngaito-a, chule lungsetna Lhagao nahsahmo-a bola chu nangho lunggela, hiche sanga chu ichana khoh chungchon talent man ding dola nakilomsah um?
target: How much more severely do you think someone deserves to be punished who has trampled the Son of God underfoot, who has treated as an unholy thing the blood of the covenant that sanctified them, and who has insulted the Spirit of grace?

source: Ajeh iham itile, Phulah ding chu keija ahi; keimanbou phuba chu kasah ding ahi tin Pakaiyin aseije; chukitle, Pakai chun amite thu atan ding ahi, tia hicheng seija chu keihon kaheuve.
target: For we know him who said, “It is mine to avenge; I will repay,” and again, “The Lord will judge his people.”

source: Pathen hing khutna chuh chu kichat umtah ahi.
target: It is a dreadful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

source: Ahi vangin nanghon masanga khovah namu nunguva hesoh genthei thoh hahsa nathoh laiju chu geldoh jingun.
target: Remember those earlier days after you had received the light, when you endured in a great conflict full of suffering.

source: Langkhatna housetle hesoh genthei thoh hahsa thoh laiju, chule alangkhatna hesoh genthei thoh lah-a nahung pannu chu geldoh jingun.
target: Sometimes you were publicly exposed to insult and persecution; at other times you stood side by side with those who were so treated.

source: Ajeh chu nanghon kakihenna ho-a jong neina khotouvin, chule gamchenga phajole imatih chana umjing van'a gou naneiju chu naheuvin, naneiju kichom chu kipahtah-in nanatoh jengtaovin ahi.
target: You suffered along with those in prison and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, because you knew that you yourselves had better and lasting possessions.

source: Hiche jeh chun chonphatman lentah nei dinga nahakat nao chu pailha hihhelun.
target: So do not throw away your confidence; it will be richly rewarded.

source: Ajeh iham itile nanghon thutep chu nasan theina dinguva, Pathen lung deilam nabol uva pontho tah-a nathohhat dingu angaije.
target: You need to persevere so that when you have done the will of God, you will receive what he has promised.

source: Ajeh iham itile chomcha khat joule Ahung dinga chu hung ding ahi, Hung geisang lou ding ahi.
target: For, “In just a little while, he who is coming will come and will not delay.”

source: Michonpha vang chu atahsan vanga hing ding ahi; Chule anungchon vangle achunga kalung lhai lou ding ahi, ati.
target: And, “But my righteous one will live by faith. And I take no pleasure in the one who shrinks back.”

source: Ahin eiho vang manthah na lama nungchon ho lah-a mi ihipouvin, lhagao huhhing-a umna dinga tahsan ho lah-a joh ihibovui.
target: But we do not belong to those who shrink back and are destroyed, but to those who have faith and are saved.

source: Tahsan hi kinepna thilho hetchetna, mu lou thil aum monge ti photchena ahi.
target: Now faith is confidence in what we hope for and assurance about what we do not see.

source: Ajeh chu hiche thua hi upahon hettohsahna ananeiju ahi.
target: This is what the ancients were commended for.

source: Tahsan vangin vannoi leiset hi Pathen thua kisuto-a kisema ahi ti iheuve; chuti chu ahin, thil kimuho chengse hi thil kilanghoa kona kisem ahipoi.
target: By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible.

source: Tahsan vangin Abel'in Cain sangin thensona longlhen phajo alhan, ama chu michonpha ahi ti hettohsahna ananeijin, athilpeh thudol Pathen'in ahettohsah-in: chule hiche vang chun ama athisa ahivangin thu aseije.
target: By faith Abel brought God a better offering than Cain did. By faith he was commended as righteous, when God spoke well of his offerings. And by faith Abel still speaks, even though he is dead.

source: Tahsan vangin thina amu louna dingin Enoch chu lah mangin aumtan; Pathen'in alah mangtah jeh chun ama chu akimutapon ahi; lah manga aum masangin Pathen lungtoh mitah ahi ti hettohsahna ananeijin ahi.
target: By faith Enoch was taken from this life, so that he did not experience death: “He could not be found, because God had taken him away.” For before he was taken, he was commended as one who pleased God.

source: Ahin tahsan beija vang Pathen lung tohoi ahipoi; ajeh chu Pathen aume chule ama holte chu tohphat man apei ti chu ama kom naijan atahsan dingdol thu ahi.
target: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who comes to him must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who earnestly seek him.

source: Tahsan vangin Noah'in mu loulai thilsoh ding thuah hilchahna thu amun, Pathen ngaisahna neijin akichan, ama insung mi huhhingna dingin kong innei khat asan ahi; chule hiche vang chun vannoi themmo achansah-in ama tahsana chonphat chu achangtan ahi.
target: By faith Noah, when warned about things not yet seen, in holy fear built an ark to save his family. By his faith he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness that is in keeping with faith.

source: Tahsan vangin Abraham, akikou chun, alo dinga um mun'a chu lut dingin potdohna ding thun anungin ahi; chule hoilama ache ding jong helouvin akipatnin achedoh jengtan anahi.
target: By faith Abraham, when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, even though he did not know where he was going.

source: Tahsan vangin gamtep gama chun mi gama pem bangin apem jengtan ahi; chuche gamtep chu alopi ding Isaac le Jacob toh pon in'ah acheng khomin anahi.
target: By faith he made his home in the promised land like a stranger in a foreign country; he lived in tents, as did Isaac and Jacob, who were heirs with him of the same promise.

source: Ajeh iham itile aman, abul nei khopi, asemtohle asadoh Pathen, hichu anga jing ahi.
target: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.

source: Tahsan vangin Sara'in jong ateh nungin, athuteppa chu tahsan umtah-a angaito jeh chun nao vop theina aneitan, chule chapang khat apengtan ahi.
target: And by faith even Sarah, who was past childbearing age, was enabled to bear children because she considered him faithful who had made the promise.

source: Hiche jeh chun athikon khatna konin van'a ahsi jatle twikhanglen kama neldi jatna tam, simsenlou apengdoh jengtan ahi.
target: And so from this one man, and he as good as dead, came descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore.

source: Hiteho chengse chu tahsan neijin athigam taovin ahi, thutep thilteho chu achang lou ahitaove, ahivangin hiteho chu gamlatah-a pangin amuvin, akolchah-un, chule amaho chu leiset chunga kholjinle gamdang mi ahiu chu aseidoh uvin ahi.
target: All these people were still living by faith when they died. They did not receive the things promised; they only saw them and welcomed them from a distance, admitting that they were foreigners and strangers on earth.

source: Ijeh ham itile chutobanga thusei ho chun amaho gamtum ding aholu ahi ti chu aphondoh-u ahi.
target: People who say such things show that they are looking for a country of their own.

source: Amahon ahung kondohnao gam chu lunga agel jingleu, akile kitna dingu phat gomkom anei dingu ahi.
target: If they had been thinking of the country they had left, they would have had opportunity to return.

source: Ahin tun amahon chuche sanga phajo nomjo khat atupmu ahin, hichu vangam ahi. Hiche jeh-a chu amaho Pathen tia kisei ding chu Pathen kijapi lou ahi; ajeh iham itile amaho dinga chu khopi khat gotsa akoi ahi.
target: Instead, they were longing for a better country—a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

source: Abraham patepmin aumin ahile, tahsan vangin Isaac atoh jengtan ahi; chule kipahtah-a thutep changpa chun, ajah-a,
target: By faith Abraham, when God tested him, offered Isaac as a sacrifice. He who had embraced the promises was about to sacrifice his one and only son,

source: Isaac'a kona nachilhah kisei ding ahi, tia kisei achapa changkhatseh chu peh dingin ago jengin ahi;
target: even though God had said to him, “It is through Isaac that your offspring will be reckoned.”

source: Ajeh chu Pathen'in athi lah-a kona jong akaithou thei ahi ti agel ahi; chule tekahnan ama chu achang kittan ahi.
target: Abraham reasoned that God could even raise the dead, and so in a manner of speaking he did receive Isaac back from death.

source: Tahsan vangin Isaac'in khonunga hung lhung ding thuah Jacob le Esau phatthei aboh-in ahi.
target: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau in regard to their future.

source: Tahsan vangin Jacob chun athi konin Joseph chapateni phatthei aboh gelin ahi; atenggol chunga akingamin Pathen alhaijin ahi.
target: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of Joseph’s sons, and worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.

source: Tahsan vangin Joseph'in khonunga Israel chate Egypt gama kona apotdoh dingu thu aseijin ama gu thudolah thu apen ahi.
target: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, spoke about the exodus of the Israelites from Egypt and gave instructions concerning the burial of his bones.

source: Mosi apenin, naosen chu hoi asa lhonin tahsan vangin anule apan lha thum asel lhonin; chule lengpa thupeh jong akicha lhonpon ahi.
target: By faith Moses’ parents hid him for three months after he was born, because they saw he was no ordinary child, and they were not afraid of the king’s edict.

source: Chuin Mosi akikhanlhit phatnin, tahsan vangin Pharaoh chanu chapa tia kiminvo ding adan;
target: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be known as the son of Pharaoh’s daughter.

source: Aman chomkhat chonsetna nomsah sangin Pathen mite toh bol hesoh thoh khom ding chu alhengjotan ahi.
target: He chose to be mistreated along with the people of God rather than to enjoy the fleeting pleasures of sin.

source: Egypt gama gou jouse sangin Christa ahousetnau chu chung nungjon agelin ahi; ajeh chu aman tohphat man asan ding lam jeng chu avet ahi.
target: He regarded disgrace for the sake of Christ as of greater value than the treasures of Egypt, because he was looking ahead to his reward.

source: Tahsan vangin aman lengpa lungsat ding chu kicha louvin Egypt gam adalhan ahi; ajeh iham itile aman mu theiloupa chu amu bangin athoh lhumkei jengin ahi.
target: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the king’s anger; he persevered because he saw him who is invisible.

source: Chule asoh masa chengse that chun amaho asuhkhah louna dingin, tahsan vangin kalchuh kut asemin, chule thisan thekhum abolin ahi.
target: By faith he kept the Passover and the application of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch the firstborn of Israel.

source: Tahsan vangin amahon tolgo bangin twikhanglen San chu ajot gal kaijun, Egypt miten chutia bol ding chu agouvin ahile, twijin achuplih gamtaovin ahi.
target: By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land; but when the Egyptians tried to do so, they were drowned.

source: Tahsan vangin Jeriko khopi kul, ni sagi avelun ahile, akulpi chu achimtai.
target: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the army had marched around them for seven days.

source: Tahsan vangin Rahab notinun gam velhiho lungmong tah-in a-in'a alhunsah-in ahile, thua nunglouho toh amantha tapon ahi.
target: By faith the prostitute Rahab, because she welcomed the spies, was not killed with those who were disobedient.

source: Akal ipi kasei dingham? Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, chule themgaoho, hiteho thu umchan seisohkei leng phatnin ato lou ding ahi.
target: And what more shall I say? I do not have time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson and Jephthah, about David and Samuel and the prophets,

source: Amaho chun tahsan vangin gamtin loinemin alauvin, chonphat abolun, thutep ga achangun, keipi bahkai kam ahuh uvin,
target: who through faith conquered kingdoms, administered justice, and gained what was promised; who shut the mouths of lions,

source: Meihat achen daijun, chemhema konin asohchaovin, hatmoa konin ahat taovin, galsatnin hattah ahitaovin, apang khom agalteu anojam gamun ahi.
target: quenched the fury of the flames, and escaped the edge of the sword; whose weakness was turned to strength; and who became powerful in battle and routed foreign armies.

source: Numei hon amithisa chengu hingdoh kit akimu kit taovin ahi; chule adangho chu thokitna phajo chungnung aneina dinguva, ahuhdoh dingu chu anom pouvin ahile, bol gentheijin aumtaovin ahi.
target: Women received back their dead, raised to life again. There were others who were tortured, refusing to be released so that they might gain an even better resurrection.

source: Abang kimkhatman engbol le jep athoh-un, bulputle songkul'a khumin patepmin aumun ahi.
target: Some faced jeers and flogging, and even chains and imprisonment.

source: Amaho chu songin asepjiuvin, thing atnin a-at tanun, patepmin aumun, chemjamin athatnun, kelngoi vunle kelvuna kivonin avahleuvin, lhasamle hesoh gentheijin bolsetnin anaumun
target: They were put to death by stoning; they were sawed in two; they were killed by the sword. They went about in sheepskins and goatskins, destitute, persecuted and mistreated—

source: (vannoi leiset amaho umnahoi ahipon), gamthip laija, molle lhang-ah, songko ho-a, chule leiko homa avahleuvin ahi.
target: the world was not worthy of them. They wandered in deserts and mountains, living in caves and in holes in the ground.

source: Hicheteho chun tahsan vanga hettohsahna anei vangun thutep ga achang tapouvin ahi:
target: These were all commended for their faith, yet none of them received what had been promised,

source: Ajeh chu eiho beija amaho chu suhchamkima aum louna dinguva Pathen'in eiho dinga thilphajo khat gotsa akoi ahi.
target: since God had planned something better for us so that only together with us would they be made perfect.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun eihon jong hettohsahna meipi nasatah-in eium kimvel jeh-u hin einoh phahsah jouseule ichunguva kai jing chonsetna hi pailhau hitin imasanguva um kilhaitetna lampia hin thohhat tah-in lhaijuhite;
target: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off everything that hinders and the sin that so easily entangles. And let us run with perseverance the race marked out for us,

source: Chule itahsan suhchamkim leh lamkai pipuipen Jesu lam kat jingu hite; aman amasanga thanopna aum jeh chun jumle maimohna nahsah louvin, thingpel geijin athoh lhumkeijin Pathen laltouna jet lamah atoutan ahi.
target: fixing our eyes on Jesus, the pioneer and perfecter of faith. For the joy set before him he endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

source: Hijeh chun lhagao lama nalel uva nalhahdah louna dingun, chonse hon ama douna-a nelkalna thu aseiju thoh lhumpa chu gelun.
target: Consider him who endured such opposition from sinners, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.

source: Nangho chonset douna-in thisan sohleuvin napang hih laijuve;
target: In your struggle against sin, you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.

source: chule, tilkhouna dinga nangho chapate dolla nakiseipeh nao nasuhmilu ahitai. Kachapa, Pakai gimbolna ngaisah louvin bol lou jenin, Chule aman nasosal tengle lhahdah nan neihih helin,
target: And have you completely forgotten this word of encouragement that addresses you as a father addresses his son? It says, “My son, do not make light of the Lord’s discipline, and do not lose heart when he rebukes you,

source: Ajeh chu Pakaiyin angailut chu agimbolji ahi, Chule aman alah chapa chengse chu ajepjin ahi, tia chapa houva nahounao tilkhouna chu nanghon nasumil taovin ahi.
target: because the Lord disciplines the one he loves, and he chastens everyone he accepts as his son.”

source: Nanghon nathoh-u chu nakisungse nao ahi; Pathen'in achapate bola nabolu ahi; ajeh iham itile apa sungse lou chapa koiham?
target: Endure hardship as discipline; God is treating you as his children. For what children are not disciplined by their father?

source: Chate jousen athoh cheh sungsena-a chu naum louvule, nangho jaocha nahiu ahi, chatetah hilou nahiuve.
target: If you are not disciplined—and everyone undergoes discipline—then you are not legitimate, not true sons and daughters at all.

source: Chuche kalvalin, eihon tahsa lama eisungse dingu pate inaneijun, amaho chu inaging lhehji uvin ahi: chuche sanga chu ihinna dinguva, lhagaoho Pa thua chu ihanun cheh lou dinguham?
target: Moreover, we have all had human fathers who disciplined us and we respected them for it. How much more should we submit to the Father of spirits and live!

source: amaho chun ni chomcha khat dinga amaho phasah sah-a eina sungse tahbehjiu ahin, ama vang chun eiho phatchomna dinga, ama thenna chu ichan theina dinguva eigimboljiu ahi.
target: They disciplined us for a little while as they thought best; but God disciplines us for our good, in order that we may share in his holiness.

source: Gimbolna jouse hi apetle lungnopna ahipoi, lhasetnan akigelbove; ahivangin khonungle hichea kon chun chutia gimbolna umho ding chun aga lungmon umtah chonphat asohjin ahi.
target: No discipline seems pleasant at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it produces a harvest of righteousness and peace for those who have been trained by it.

source: Hiche jeh chun nanghon khut kikhailha leh khup ngoite chu je jangun;
target: Therefore, strengthen your feeble arms and weak knees.

source: chule elbai lamvaite lampia kona nodoh-a um louva, boldama aumjohna dingun, nakho lhahna diu lampi kisem jangun.
target: “Make level paths for your feet,” so that the lame may not be disabled, but rather healed.

source: Mi jousetoh kichamdela umnale thenna chu delun, hiche thenna tailouva chu koiman Pakai chu amu lou ding ahi.
target: Make every effort to live in peace with everyone and to be holy; without holiness no one will see the Lord.

source: Kihong phaovin, ajole mikhat tou Pathen lungset changlel umkhantin; thilkha jung hungdon doh-in sumovin natin, mi tamtah suh boh-in umget inte;
target: See to it that no one falls short of the grace of God and that no bitter root grows up to cause trouble and defile many.

source: Ahi loule khatvei neh mana apenpi agou lo ding joh-a Esau banga Pathen ja loule akideija, ajonga, umget inte.
target: See that no one is sexually immoral, or is godless like Esau, who for a single meal sold his inheritance rights as the oldest son.

source: Ajeh chu Esau chun khonungin phattheina gou chu lo ding alunggot tena mitlhi puma gunchu tah-a ahol vangin, lungheina gomkom amu lou jeh-in, paijin aumtan ahi, ti naheuve.
target: Afterward, as you know, when he wanted to inherit this blessing, he was rejected. Even though he sought the blessing with tears, he could not change what he had done.

source: Nangho molsang tohkhah theile meija ka, meivom, muthim, khopihui,
target: You have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire; to darkness, gloom and storm;

source: sumkon gin chule thu kisei awginna-a hung nahipouve. Hiche awgin jateho chun ajah uva thu dang kiseibe louna dingin ataovun ahi:
target: to a trumpet blast or to such a voice speaking words that those who heard it begged that no further word be spoken to them,

source: Ajeh chu ganhing jengin jong mol chu atohkhah-a ahile, songa selih jeng ding ahi loule tenga sutlih jeng ding ahi tia thupeh chu amahon athoh thei louhelu ahi;
target: because they could not bear what was commanded: “If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned to death.”

source: Chule hiche thilmu chu kichat um behseh jeng ahin, Mosi'n, keima kakicha behseh jengin kakihot hot jengin ahi, ati.
target: The sight was so terrifying that Moses said, “I am trembling with fear.”

source: Ahivangin nangho vang Sion mol, Pathen hing khopi, van Jerusalem, vantil sangsom sangja umna mun'a hunga nahiuvin,
target: But you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem. You have come to thousands upon thousands of angels in joyful assembly,

source: Van'a amin kisun apeng masaho khoppi len le houbung heng, mi jouse thutan Pathen heng, chule michonpha lhagao suhchamkima umho henga,
target: to the church of the firstborn, whose names are written in heaven. You have come to God, the Judge of all, to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,

source: Kitepna thah palai Jesu henga, chule Abel'a sanga phatna chungnungjo thusei thisan thekhum henga hungjoh nahibouvui.
target: to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.

source: Chingtheijun, thuseipa chu jopda khauvinate. Ajeh chu leiset chunga thupepa jop loubon asochat louva ahile, van'a kona van thupepa akon chun kiheimang leuhen, sohcha louhel ding ihiuve.
target: See to it that you do not refuse him who speaks. If they did not escape when they refused him who warned them on earth, how much less will we, if we turn away from him who warns us from heaven?

source: Hichea chu a-aw ginin vannoi leiset aho ling jeng ahi; tu vangin aman thu atepmin, Keiman khatvei vannoi leiset jengseh hilouvin, van jong kaho ling kit ding ahi, ati.
target: At that time his voice shook the earth, but now he has promised, “Once more I will shake not only the earth but also the heavens.”

source: Hichea, Khatvei kaho ling kit ding ati hin, long lou thilteho chu aum jingna dinga; thil kisem, thil longho chonmanga umding ahi, ti hetsahna ahi.
target: The words “once more” indicate the removing of what can be shaken—that is, created things—so that what cannot be shaken may remain.

source: Hijeh hin eiho long lou gam changa ihitah jeh-u hin, lungsetna neijuhite, hiche vanga chu eihon ginle ja tho-a Pathen lunglhaina lhacha ipan theiju ahi;
target: Therefore, since we are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us be thankful, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe,

source: Ajeh chu eiho Pathen chu kavamthei mei ahi.
target: for our “God is a consuming fire.”

source: Sopi kingailutna hi umjompeh jinghen.
target: Keep on loving one another as brothers and sisters.

source: Nanghon maljin phatbol ding chu sumil hih helun; ijeh-inem itile chuti bola konin mi kimkhatnin het louhelin vantil alhunsah-un ahi.
target: Do not forget to show hospitality to strangers, for by so doing some people have shown hospitality to angels without knowing it.

source: Akihenteho chu nakihenpin gel unlang he jingun; nangho jong tahsa-a um nahiu heuvin lang hesoh genthei thohte chu he jingun.
target: Continue to remember those in prison as if you were together with them in prison, and those who are mistreated as if you yourselves were suffering.

source: Mi jouse lah-a kichen hi ja umhen, chule ajalkhun jong suhboh-in umdahen; jonpanle miji toh jongho thu Pathen'in achung thu atan ding ahi.
target: Marriage should be honored by all, and the marriage bed kept pure, for God will judge the adulterer and all the sexually immoral.

source: Sum ngailut lung po hih helun; nanei sunuva chun lunglhaijun; ajeh chu amatah-in, Keiman nangma iti nama jongle lhaponge, changlha jong changlha pong-e, ati.
target: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, because God has said, “Never will I leave you; never will I forsake you.”

source: Hijeh chun eihon, hakat tah-a, Pakai chu eipanpi ahi, keima kichaponge, Mihemin keima i-eilo dingham? iti thei dingu ahi.
target: So we say with confidence, “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?”

source: Pathen thu nahiluva nachung uva navaipo teo chu geldoh jingun; chule amaho nunle khana kona sohdoh gelunlang, amaho tahsan umchan chu thovin.
target: Remember your leaders, who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.

source: Jesu Christa chu janhi, tuni, chule atonsotnin abang ahi jingin ahi.
target: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

source: Thuhil kidang got chomchom kilhoh mangsah loujenun; lung hi lungsetna-a phudet aphai; anneh-a phudet ding ahipoi, hiti anneh thua chonna lungkhamteho chun phatchomnan aneidehpouve.
target: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings. It is good for our hearts to be strengthened by grace, not by eating ceremonial foods, which is of no benefit to those who do so.

source: Houbuh sunga lhachalehon aneh thei lounao, maicham ineijun ahi.
target: We have an altar from which those who minister at the tabernacle have no right to eat.

source: Thempu chungnungin chonset thensona-a Mun Theng sunga achoi lutji ganchaho long chu kulpi polama agouvam jiuvin ahi.
target: The high priest carries the blood of animals into the Most Holy Place as a sin offering, but the bodies are burned outside the camp.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu Jesu'n jong ama thisan mihemte suhthengna dinga khopi kotpi polama thina athoh ahitai.
target: And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate to make the people holy through his own blood.

source: Hijeh chun hungun, ama ahousetnau chu pou hitin, kulpi polamah ama hengah cheohite.
target: Let us, then, go to him outside the camp, bearing the disgrace he bore.

source: Ajeh iham itile hikoma hin khomundet ineipouve, khonunga khopijoh chu iholu ahibouve.
target: For here we do not have an enduring city, but we are looking for the city that is to come.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun ama vangin vahchoina kithoina chu Pathen henga pe jinguhite, hichu amin jala kipathu iphon dohnao ikamuva kona aga chu ahi.
target: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise—the fruit of lips that openly profess his name.

source: Ahin phatna bolle thilpeh phala kihomdela thilbol chu sumil loujenun; ijeh-inem itile chutobang kithoina chunga chun Pathen alunglhai behsehjin ahi.
target: And do not forget to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.

source: Nachung uva vaipoho thun nungun, anoijuvah lutnun; amaho chu umchan thu seitoh-a pang ding ahi jeh-u chun, hichu lung nommo-a bol louva lunglhaisela abol theina dinguva, nangho lhagao ahon jingu ahi; lungnom mon nachung uvah thu seileu, nangho dinga khoh ding ahi.
target: Have confidence in your leaders and submit to their authority, because they keep watch over you as those who must give an account. Do this so that their work will be a joy, not a burden, for that would be of no benefit to you.

source: Keiho neitao peh-un; ajeh chu keihon ase apha hetna thengtahle ijakaija kituptah-a chondih tup lung kaneijui, ti kakihet chenun ahi.
target: Pray for us. We are sure that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.

source: Chule nangho heng lama eiki lhadoh vah chehna dinga eitaopeh dinga, nangho atumbeh-a kahin ha ngehdeh nahiuve.
target: I particularly urge you to pray so that I may be restored to you soon.

source: Chamna Pathen tonsot geija umjing kitepna thisana kelngoi ching pipu I-Pakaiyu Jesu chu athi lah-a kona puidoh kit chun, ama lunggot lam bol dingin,
target: Now may the God of peace, who through the blood of the eternal covenant brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep,

source: nangho phatna lam jouse-a sucham kimun; ama mitvetna alunglhaina lam jouse-a Jesu Christa vang chun nangho-ah molsohen; loupina atonsot atonsot geijin umjing hen, Amen.
target: equip you with everything good for doing his will, and may he work in us what is pleasing to him, through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

source: Sopite, naheng uva kahungtao ahi, kitilkhou na thuhi angai themun; ijeh-inem itile keiman nangho henga paltana kahinsut ahi.
target: Brothers and sisters, I urge you to bear with my word of exhortation, for in fact I have written to you quite briefly.

source: Isopiu Timothy alhadoh taove, hichu anaheuvin; ama ahung vah-a ahile, keima amatoh hung lhoningting nangho mutange.
target: I want you to know that our brother Timothy has been released. If he arrives soon, I will come with him to see you.

source: Nachung uva vaipoho le mithengho chengse chu kasalam anapeuvin. Italy gam mihon salam napeuve.
target: Greet all your leaders and all the Lord’s people. Those from Italy send you their greetings.

source: Nabon chaova chungah lungsetna umhen. Amen.
target: Grace be with you all.

source: Pathen le Pakai Jesu Christa soh Jacob'in, akithe cheh-a phung somle phung ni henga, salam.
target: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes scattered among the nations: Greetings.

source: Kasopiho, nangho patepna tintanga nachuh tengule, hichu kipanan gelun;
target: Consider it pure joy, my brothers and sisters, whenever you face trials of many kinds,

source: Natahsanu kipatep chun thohhat asosah chu heuvin.
target: because you know that the testing of your faith produces perseverance.

source: Ahin nangho lhahsamna beihela nacham kimuva, napum lhin theina dingun, thohhatna chun anatoh tong chamkim molsohen.
target: Let perseverance finish its work so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.

source: Nalah uva khattou chihna-a lhasama aumle, it louhel le house louhela peji-a Pathen henga thumhen; chuteng kipe ding ahi.
target: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to you.

source: Amavang ginchat lelna neilouhelin, tahsanna neitah-in thumhen; agingcha lela chu twikhanglen kinong hui mut lonle tobang ahi.
target: But when you ask, you must believe and not doubt, because the one who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.

source: Chutobang mi chun Pakaiya konin ima mu neijinge tin kinepda hen.
target: That person should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.

source: Lungtho nei michu achonna lam jouse-a detna nei lou ahi.
target: Such a person is double-minded and unstable in all they do.

source: Dinmun nemcha neija sopi chun choisanga aum jehchun kipah hen;
target: Believers in humble circumstances ought to take pride in their high position.

source: Ahin mihao chun suhnema aum jehchun kipah hen: ajeh chu hampa pah banga ama chu mangthah ding ahi.
target: But the rich should take pride in their humiliation—since they will pass away like a wild flower.

source: Ajehchu nisa satah-a ahung soteng, asat chun hampa louhing asanggojin, chule apah apul lhan, alimso hoi jong chu amangthah jitan ahi; chutobanga chu mihao jong alamlhah tinchenga molmang diu ahi.
target: For the sun rises with scorching heat and withers the plant; its blossom falls and its beauty is destroyed. In the same way, the rich will fade away even while they go about their business.

source: Lhepna thoh ham hama chu anunnom ahi; ajeh chu lhep patepna chu ajoa them achan jouva ahile Pakaiyin ama ngailuho peh dinga athutepsa hinna lallukhuh chu apeh ding ahi.
target: Blessed is the one who perseveres under trial because, having stood the test, that person will receive the crown of life that the Lord has promised to those who love him.

source: Ahin lhepna-a nachuh tengule, Pathen'in eilhep ahi tin koiman seida hen: ajehchu Pathen chu ase lama kilhem patep theilou ahin, chule amanjong koimacha alhep patep lou ahi.
target: When tempted, no one should say, “God is tempting me.” For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does he tempt anyone;

source: Mi ama ama lung ngaichat thillin ajol lhah-a, aloi lutji-a, lhepna-a chujia ahibouvui.
target: but each person is tempted when they are dragged away by their own evil desire and enticed.

source: Chule alung ngaichat phalou chu naovop banga avopji teng chonset ahinji ahi; chule chonset chu apilhin tengle thina sohjia ahi.
target: Then, after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.

source: Kasopi ngaiteho dohan lhalou jenun.
target: Don’t be deceived, my dear brothers and sisters.

source: Thilpeh pha jousele phattheina chamkim chu chunga kon ahi, chule kikhelna le le-lim banga kihei jilou vahho Pa-a kona hung kumlhaji ahi.
target: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, who does not change like shifting shadows.

source: Athilsemho lah-a eiho hi aga masa loi khat ihi theina dinguva, aman ama lunggot doltah-a thutah-a chu eihinu ahi.
target: He chose to give us birth through the word of truth, that we might be a kind of firstfruits of all he created.

source: Hijeh chun, kasopi ngaitahho, amitakip angaina lama gang cheh hen, thu sei lama ngaikham cheh hen, chule lungsatna lama jong ngaikham cheh hen;
target: My dear brothers and sisters, take note of this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak and slow to become angry,

source: Mihem lunghanin Pathen chonphatna asodoh sahpoi.
target: because human anger does not produce the righteousness that God desires.

source: Hiche jeh chun nanghon thenlouna jousele chon gitlouna long let chu puilhau vinlang, nalhagao huhhing theija thu kiphutsa chu lungnemin sangun.
target: Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and the evil that is so prevalent and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save you.

source: Ahin nangho nangmale nangma kilhem lha-a thu chu angai mai jeng hilouvin, thu chu abolajoh hiuvin.
target: Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says.

source: Ijeh ham itile thu angai mai mai hia abola hilou mi khattou aumle, ama chu phatvet maija apenpi alim vea mi tobang ahi:
target: Anyone who listens to the word but does not do what it says is like someone who looks at his face in a mirror

source: Ajeh chu ama akiven achemangjin, chule ama chun alim itobang ahi apettah chule asumil jitan ahi.
target: and, after looking at himself, goes away and immediately forgets what he looks like.

source: Ahin chamkimkei chamlenna danthu chu vea, chua aum jom jinga, athu chu ngaija sumil mi hilouva, abola pang mi vang chu, hiche mipa chu athilbola chu nunnom ding ahi.
target: But whoever looks intently into the perfect law that gives freedom, and continues in it—not forgetting what they have heard, but doing it—they will be blessed in what they do.

source: Nalah uva mi khattou ama hou ngaisah mi-a kingaito-a, alei tuhtang louva, ama lungthim kilheplhah-a aumle, hiche mipa chun ahou chu moh ahi.
target: Those who consider themselves religious and yet do not keep a tight rein on their tongues deceive themselves, and their religion is worthless.

source: Pa le Pathen anga houdan thengle kisuhboh lou chu: Nulou palouho le meithaiho agenthei ahesoh naova vila, chule vannoi leisetna kona boh beh louhela kithenso chu ahi.
target: Religion that God our Father accepts as pure and faultless is this: to look after orphans and widows in their distress and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.

source: Kasopite ho, loupi Pakai, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa tahsanna chu mi dat neilou jennun.
target: My brothers and sisters, believers in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ must not show favoritism.

source: Ajehchu naki khopnao in'a mi khat sana khutjem kibua, ponhoi lul kisil hunghen lang; chule pon sedihdeh kisil mivaicha khat jong hunghen lang;
target: Suppose a man comes into your meeting wearing a gold ring and fine clothes, and a poor man in filthy old clothes also comes in.

source: Nanghon ponhoi lul silpa chu jabolun lang, Nangma hilaija hin nomtah-in touvin, tiuvinlang, mivaichapa jah-a chun, Nangma khukoma khun gadingin, ahiloule, kakeng todopma hin touvin, tileu chun:
target: If you show special attention to the man wearing fine clothes and say, “Here’s a good seat for you,” but say to the poor man, “You stand there” or “Sit on the floor by my feet,”

source: Nangho nanghole nangho lah-a mi dat nanei uva, lung gilou pu-a vai nahomu hilou dingham?
target: have you not discriminated among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts?

source: Kasopi ngaiteho, ngai phaovin, vannoi leisetna mi vaichaho chu Pathen'in tahsan na-a hao dingle, ama ngailuho peh dinga atepsa gam chu lo dinga alhendoh hilouham?
target: Listen, my dear brothers and sisters: Has not God chosen those who are poor in the eyes of the world to be rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom he promised those who love him?

source: Ahinla nanghon mivaicha chu noise tah-in nabol uvin ahi. Mihaoho chun nabolset jiuva, thutan na-a nakai lutjiu hilou ham?
target: But you have dishonored the poor. Is it not the rich who are exploiting you? Are they not the ones who are dragging you into court?

source: Chule amaho chun nakikou nao min ja umtah chu ataitomu hilouham?
target: Are they not the ones who are blaspheming the noble name of him to whom you belong?

source: Pathen lekhabu dan thu dungjuija, Naheng nakoma chu nangma naki ngailut bangin ngailun, ti Leng dan chu subulhit nahiu vangle, nabolu apha lheh jenge;
target: If you really keep the royal law found in Scripture, “Love your neighbor as yourself,” you are doing right.

source: Ahin dat naneiju vangle achonsea nahiuvin, chule dan sukhel tia danthu dungjuija themmo changa nahiuve.
target: But if you show favoritism, you sin and are convicted by the law as lawbreakers.

source: Ahin mikhatnin dan thupeh chengse nitsoh hen, khatpenah kisumo taleh, aboncha chunga themmo changa ahitai.
target: For whoever keeps the whole law and yet stumbles at just one point is guilty of breaking all of it.

source: Ajehchu, Jon pan hih-in tia seipa chun, Tolthat hih-in, tia jong asei ahi. Hijeh chun tun nangman jon panhih-in lang, ahin tolthat lechun, nangma danthu suhkeh chu nahi ahitai.
target: For he who said, “You shall not commit adultery,” also said, “You shall not murder.” If you do not commit adultery but do commit murder, you have become a lawbreaker.

source: Chamlenna danthu-a athu kitan dingho thusei bangin thu seijun lang, chutima chun bolun.
target: Speak and act as those who are going to be judged by the law that gives freedom,

source: Mi chunga hepina neilou chu, hepina neilou hela athu kitan ahi; hepina chun thutanna chunga jona anei ahi.
target: because judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not been merciful. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

source: Kasopite ho, mi khattouvin katahsan aume tihen lang, anatohla um hihhen hile, hichu ipi-a phachom dingham? Hiche atahsan chun huhhing theijintem?
target: What good is it, my brothers and sisters, if someone claims to have faith but has no deeds? Can such faith save them?

source: Sopipa khat ahim, sopinu khat ahim pon beijin umhen, chule anikho anneh lhasamin umhen,
target: Suppose a brother or a sister is without clothes and daily food.

source: Nangho khatnin amaho jah-a chun, Lung mongin chen, lum sanlang vaset tan, tiuvin; amaho chu tahsa ngaichat thil pe louvin umleu chun, hichu ipi-a phachom dingham?
target: If one of you says to them, “Go in peace; keep warm and well fed,” but does nothing about their physical needs, what good is it?

source: Hiche banga chu tahsan jong anatoh beija chu achanga athisa ahi.
target: In the same way, faith by itself, if it is not accompanied by action, is dead.

source: Ahin mi khattouvin, Nangma natahsan aumin, keima kanatoh aume tinte: nanatoh beijin natahsan chu neivetsah temin, chule keiman natoh-a konin katahsan vetsah inge.
target: But someone will say, “You have faith; I have deeds.” Show me your faith without deeds, and I will show you my faith by my deeds.

source: Nangman Pathen khatseh aumme ti natahsane; nabol hoije: thilhahon jong atahsanui, agina kihot hot ahiuve.
target: You believe that there is one God. Good! Even the demons believe that—and shudder.

source: Ahin, vo mi gichanglou, nangman anatoh beija tahsan athisa ahi chu nahet nom em?
target: You foolish person, do you want evidence that faith without deeds is useless?

source: Ipuluiju Abraham'in achapa Isaac maicham chunga atodoh-a chu, hiche anatoh chu ama dinga chonphatna-a kisima hilou ham?
target: Was not our father Abraham considered righteous for what he did when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?

source: Itobanga tahsan chun anatoh chu ahua, chule natoh vanga tahsan chu kisu chamkima ahi ti namuvem?
target: You see that his faith and his actions were working together, and his faith was made complete by what he did.

source: Hichea chu, Abraham'in Pathen atahsanin, chule ama dingin hichu chonphatnan akisimtan ahi, ti Pathen lekhabua thu chu guilhunga ahi; chule ama chu Pathen jol tia kikou ahi.
target: And the scripture was fulfilled that says, “Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness,” and he was called God’s friend.

source: Tahsan jengseh vang hilouva, natoh vanga mi chonpha tia kisim ahi chu namuvin ahi.
target: You see that a person is considered righteous by what they do and not by faith alone.

source: Chule chutobangma chu Rahab notinu jong chun thupole ho chu a-in'a alhunsah-a, chua lam chom danga asolmanga ahile, hiche anatoh vanga chu amanu chu achonpha-a kisima hilouham?
target: In the same way, was not even Rahab the prostitute considered righteous for what she did when she gave lodging to the spies and sent them off in a different direction?

source: Lhagao beija tahsa athisa ahi banga, tahsan jong natoh beija athisa ahi.
target: As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.

source: Kasopite ho, midangho sanga eiho gihsajoa mo ichan dingu chu heuvin lang, tamtah mihil-in pang hih-un.
target: Not many of you should become teachers, my fellow believers, because you know that we who teach will be judged more strictly.

source: Ajeh chu eiho ibon chaovin thil tamtah-a ikipaljiuve. Thua kipalna neilou chu mipha chamkim ahi; ama chu ati apumpia jong tuhtanga athua hei thei ahi.
target: We all stumble in many ways. Anyone who is never at fault in what they say is perfect, able to keep their whole body in check.

source: Veuvin, sakol khu ithu nun theina dinga akama kamdal ivo-u ahi; chuteng apumpia igot gotna-a kihei thei ahi.
target: When we put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us, we can turn the whole animal.

source: Kong-innei jong khu veuvin, lentah ahia, hui hat nasatah-in atol ahivangin, hichengpi chu ahehna neocha-a chu aheh heipan agotna lam lama aheile ahi.
target: Or take ships as an example. Although they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are steered by a very small rudder wherever the pilot wants to go.

source: Chutobanga chu lei jong hi tibah neocha khat ahi jeng vangin, hoithona thu nasatah aseijin ahi. Veuvin, mei themhal chan gam lentah iti akahsetji hitam!
target: Likewise, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it makes great boasts. Consider what a great forest is set on fire by a small spark.

source: Lei hi mei ahi; tibah lah-a lei hi chonsetna dim vannoi leiset ahi; hichun ti pumpi hi asuhbohjia, penpi hinkho lampi chevelkolna hi akahsetjia, chule amatah damun meija kaji-a ahi.
target: The tongue also is a fire, a world of evil among the parts of the body. It corrupts the whole body, sets the whole course of one’s life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.

source: Sa namkim, alha leng vacha namkim, ganhing namkim, gul namkim, twija cheng ganhing namkim vahngoi thei ahi sohkeijun, mihem vahngoi jin aumun ahi:
target: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles and sea creatures are being tamed and have been tamed by mankind,

source: Ahin lei vanghi koiman avahngoi theipoi; ama hi umthim thei lou gitlouna le thina gu dimset ahi.
target: but no human being can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

source: Hichea chun Pathen le Pa chu ivahchoi jiuvin; hiche mama chun Pathen lima kisema mihemho isamse jiuve.
target: With the tongue we praise our Lord and Father, and with it we curse human beings, who have been made in God’s likeness.

source: Kamsung khatseh-a kon chun pachatna le sapsetna asoh khomjin ahi. Kasopite ho, hichu chuti dingdol ahipoi.
target: Out of the same mouth come praise and cursing. My brothers and sisters, this should not be.

source: Twinah kohom khatseh-a khu twi atwi le akha put khomji am?
target: Can both fresh water and salt water flow from the same spring?

source: Kasopite ho, theichang phunga Olive ga theijam? lengpi guija theichang ga theijam? hitichun twinah khat na konin chitui le twitheng aput khom theipoi.
target: My brothers and sisters, can a fig tree bear olives, or a grapevine bear figs? Neither can a salt spring produce fresh water.

source: Nalah uva michingle hetthem theina nei koiham? Ama chun umchan themin anatoh chu nunnem na le chihna-in vetsahhen.
target: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let them show it by their good life, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.

source: Ahinla nalung sunguva kithangset hat le kilungdou naneiju vangle, kithang-at loujenun, chule thutah douna jou seihih-un.
target: But if you harbor bitter envy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast about it or deny the truth.

source: Chutobang chihna chu chunga kona hung kumlha-a ahipoi; amavang leiset le tahsa-a chule Diabol'a kon ahibouve.
target: Such “wisdom” does not come down from heaven but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.

source: Kithangset le kilungdou umna-a chu kinahna le gitlouna um tei ahi.
target: For where you have envy and selfish ambition, there you find disorder and every evil practice.

source: Chunga kona hung kumlha-a chihna vang chu amasapena atheng ahin, chule abana kichamdel, lungnem, houlung dambai, hepina-a dim, chule ga pha, dat neilou le, phatlhemna umlou ahi.
target: But the wisdom that comes from heaven is first of all pure; then peace-loving, considerate, submissive, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial and sincere.

source: Chule chonphatna ga chu chambolteho chunga kichamdela kitu-a ahi.
target: Peacemakers who sow in peace reap a harvest of righteousness.

source: Nalah uva gal kisatle kinahna hi hoija konham? Natibah lah uva nomsah ngaichatnaho kisatto-a kon chu hilouham?
target: What causes fights and quarrels among you? Don’t they come from your desires that battle within you?

source: Nanghon nangaichauvin ahinla naneiji pouve; tol nathat jiuvin, neiding nagojiuvin, nanei theiji pouve; nakinaovin nakisatto jiuvin, ahinla nathumji lou jeh-un naneipouve.
target: You desire but do not have, so you kill. You covet but you cannot get what you want, so you quarrel and fight. You do not have because you do not ask God.

source: Nathumun ahinla namu pouve; nangma nangma nomsah-a manchah nagotji jeh uva, nathumu nakhel jiu ahi.
target: When you ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may spend what you get on your pleasures.

source: Vo numei le pasal jongho, vannoi toh kihouthei hi Pathen to kigalna ahi ti helou nahiuvem? Hijeh chun koihile vannoi toh kihouthei go-a chu Pathen melma ahi.
target: You adulterous people, don’t you know that friendship with the world means enmity against God? Therefore, anyone who chooses to be a friend of the world becomes an enemy of God.

source: Isunguva cheng Lhagao hin thangthipna angaichat ahi, tia Pathen lekhabua kisei khu kimohsei hija nangaitou ham?
target: Or do you think Scripture says without reason that he jealously longs for the spirit he has caused to dwell in us?

source: Chuti sangin lungsetna eipehbe jobovui. Hijeh-a chu aman, Pathen'in mi kiletsahho chu alethuhjin, mi kineosah ho lungsetna apei, tia asei ahi.
target: But he gives us more grace. That is why Scripture says: “God opposes the proud but shows favor to the humble.”

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun nangho Pathen henga kipelut un. Diabol vang chu lethuh-un, chutile nakom uva konin jammang tante.
target: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

source: Pathen kom naijun, chutile Ama nangho kom hung nai ding ahi. Vo michonseho, nakhut suthengun; chule lungtho neihon, nalung sungu suthengun.
target: Come near to God and he will come near to you. Wash your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

source: Kisih-un, lunghemun, chule kapmun; nanuiju chu kana chule nakipao chu lungkhamna soh hen.
target: Grieve, mourn and wail. Change your laughter to mourning and your joy to gloom.

source: Pakai mitmu-a kisunem mun, chutile aman nachoi sang dingu ahi.
target: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up.

source: Kasopite ho, kiseiseto hih-un. Koi hile asopi seise-a chule asopi thu khola oimo-a chu, dan thupeh seise-a, dan thupeh khola oimo-a ahi: ahin nangman danthu chu nakhola na-oimo vangle athu nit hilouva athu tanjoh nahi.
target: Brothers and sisters, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against a brother or sister or judges them speaks against the law and judges it. When you judge the law, you are not keeping it, but sitting in judgment on it.

source: Danthu pe-a khatsehbou aume, Ama chu huhhing thei jong sumang thei jong ahi. Ahin nangma koi nahi-a, midang thu natan ham?
target: There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the one who is able to save and destroy. But you—who are you to judge your neighbor?

source: Tun veuvin, nangho mi kimkhatsen, Tunin ahim, jing ahimle, hiche khopi-a khun cheohitin kum khat gathamu hitin, kiveiju hitin, kivei kanu hite, nati uve.
target: Now listen, you who say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to this or that city, spend a year there, carry on business and make money.”

source: Jinga ipi ahung so ding nanghon nahepouve. Nahinkhou chu ipiham? Twimei chomkhat kimu-a chujoule kimujita lou tobang khu nahiuve.
target: Why, you do not even know what will happen tomorrow. What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.

source: Chusangin, Pakai lunglam ahile, hingjing ungting, hiche na hi, khuche na khu tonging kate, tijovin.
target: Instead, you ought to say, “If it is the Lord’s will, we will live and do this or that.”

source: Ahinla tun nanghon naham hoithonao chu naki thang-at piuve; hiche kithang-at naho chu phalou ahi.
target: As it is, you boast in your arrogant schemes. All such boasting is evil.

source: Hiche jeh chun mi koi hile thilpha bolje hena-a bol lou chu achonse ahi.
target: If anyone, then, knows the good they ought to do and doesn’t do it, it is sin for them.

source: Tun, veuvin, mihaoho, nangho chunga hesoh gentheina hung chu ding chengpi jeh hin kapmun lang pengun.
target: Now listen, you rich people, weep and wail because of the misery that is coming on you.

source: Nanei chengseu amon mangtai, naponu lungin anese joutai.
target: Your wealth has rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.

source: Nasana nadangkau thih-eh souvin aneheng gamtan; chule chuche thih-eh chu nathemmonao hettohsah-a hungpanga, chule mei banga nasao aneh ding ahi. Nanghon ni nununga dinga gou nakholu ahi.
target: Your gold and silver are corroded. Their corrosion will testify against you and eat your flesh like fire. You have hoarded wealth in the last days.

source: Veuvin, nalouva chang at sum thalo ho thaman, doha nabol uva napeh dahou chun kho asamun; chule chuche sum thalo chang at teho khosap chu Janel Pakai nabeng sunga aluttai
target: Look! The wages you failed to pay the workers who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the Lord Almighty.

source: Nangho vannoi leiset chunga nomsa le ninglhinga nachengun; kitha nikho-a bangin nalungu nasuthao vun ahi.
target: You have lived on earth in luxury and self-indulgence. You have fattened yourselves in the day of slaughter.

source: Nanghon michonpha chu themmo nachanun nathatnun; chule aman nangho nadou thuhpouve.
target: You have condemned and murdered the innocent one, who was not opposing you.

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun, sopiteho, Pakai hung masangsen lungdehat jingun. Veuvin, loulhou mi khun aleiset ga lutah chu angahjin, gotwi lha masale gotwi lha nunung amu kahsen alungdehat jin ahi.
target: Be patient, then, brothers and sisters, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer waits for the land to yield its valuable crop, patiently waiting for the autumn and spring rains.

source: Nangho jong lungdehat jingun; nalungu detsah jingun: ajeh chu Pakai hungna ding anaitai.
target: You too, be patient and stand firm, because the Lord’s coming is near.

source: Vo sopiteho, oimo nachan louna dingun khatle khat kiphun loujenun; veuvin, thutanpa chu kot bula ading jinge.
target: Don’t grumble against one another, brothers and sisters, or you will be judged. The Judge is standing at the door!

source: Vo sopiteho, Pakai mina thu seidoh themgaoho chu hesoh genthei thoh le lungdehatna lama vettonin neijun.
target: Brothers and sisters, as an example of patience in the face of suffering, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

source: Veuvin, dingdet jinga thoh lhumho khu eihon anunnom itiuve. Nanghon Job thohhat thu chu najaove; chule Pakaiya achaina umchan jong namu taove; Pakai chu khotonale mihepina-a dimset ahi.
target: As you know, we count as blessed those who have persevered. You have heard of Job’s perseverance and have seen what the Lord finally brought about. The Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

source: Ahin, sopiteho, imajouse lah-a apipen chu hiche ahi, kihahsel hih-un, van panin hijongle, leiset panin hijongle, kihahsel hih-un; chusang chun ahi natiu chu ahi hihen, hilou natiu chu hilou hijenghen; achuti loule themmo changin umkhaovin nate.
target: Above all, my brothers and sisters, do not swear—not by heaven or by earth or by anything else. All you need to say is a simple “Yes” or “No.” Otherwise you will be condemned.

source: Nalah uva athohgima umam? Ama chu taohen. Kipah thanoma umam? Vahchoina la Sahen.
target: Is anyone among you in trouble? Let them pray. Is anyone happy? Let them sing songs of praise.

source: Nalah uva ana damlou umam? Ama chun houbung upaho kouhen; chule amahon Pakai minin ama chu thao nu-uhen, achunga taovuhen;
target: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them and anoint them with oil in the name of the Lord.

source: Chutile tahsana taona chun anapa chu damsah-intin, chule Pakaiyin ama chu akaithou ding; chule achonse ahi jongle, hichu suhbeija umding ahi.
target: And the prayer offered in faith will make the sick person well; the Lord will raise them up. If they have sinned, they will be forgiven.

source: Hijeh chun nadam theina dingun, khatnin khat komah nasuhkhelnao phongun, khatle khat kitaopeh jiuvin. Michonpha mi taopehna chu thil nasatah bol thei ahi.
target: Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous person is powerful and effective.

source: Elijah chu eiho penpi ngai banga hesoh genthei thoh mi ahivangin, gojuh louna dinga lunglut tah-a ataole, leiset chunga kum thumle lha gup gam sung go ajutapon ahi.
target: Elijah was a human being, even as we are. He prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the land for three and a half years.

source: Chuin atao kitnin ahile, van'a konin go ahin juhsah-in, leijin aga asodohtan ahi.
target: Again he prayed, and the heavens gave rain, and the earth produced its crops.

source: Kasopite nalah uva khattou thudih-a kona lamvaija auma, ama chu khattou ahinlepui lut kit aumle,
target: My brothers and sisters, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring that person back,

source: Michonse alamvaina-a kona hinlepui kitchun thina-a kona lhagao khat ahuhhing ding ahin; chule chonset tamtah akhu ding ahi, ti kihet hen.
target: remember this: Whoever turns a sinner from the error of their way will save them from death and cover over a multitude of sins.

source: Jesu Christa solchah Peter'in; Pontus gam, Galatia gam, Cappadocia gam, Asia gam, chule Bithynia gama kithecheh khopemho,
target: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To God’s elect, exiles scattered throughout the provinces of Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia and Bithynia,

source: Thua nung dingle Jesu Christa thisan thekhuma umdinga, Pa Pathen lunggot masah dungjuija, Lhagao suhtheng na-a kilhengdohho hengah: nachung uva lungsetnale lungmonna punghen.
target: who have been chosen according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through the sanctifying work of the Spirit, to be obedient to Jesus Christ and sprinkled with his blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance.

source: I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa Pa Pathen chu vahchoijin umhen; Jesu Christa athia kona athokit vanga amihepina chungnung dungjuija kinepna hing chang dinga eihinu ahin,
target: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! In his great mercy he has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

source: Gou setheilou, thengsel, chule toi theilou nangho chan dinga van'a kikheh khola,
target: and into an inheritance that can never perish, spoil or fade. This inheritance is kept in heaven for you,

source: Huhhing-a umdinga tahsan vanga Pathen thahat na-in achintup, phat nunung lamle hung kilangdoh dinga gotsa nahiuve.
target: who through faith are shielded by God’s power until the coming of the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.

source: Tu chomcha khat dinga, akhoh dungjuija, lhepna tintang jeh-a nalunghem jeng vangun, hiche-a hin hatah-in nakipah-un ahi:
target: In all this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in all kinds of trials.

source: Meija akipatep jeng vanga jong mang thei sana sanga manlujo, natahsan nao kipatepna chu, Jesu Christa hung kilah teng vahchoina, choi-atna, chule loupina-a akimu theina ding ahi.
target: These have come so that the proven genuineness of your faith—of greater worth than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire—may result in praise, glory and honor when Jesus Christ is revealed.

source: Ama chu mukha louhela ngailu-a nahiuve; tun jong ama chu namu louhel vangun natahsanun, kipana seitheilou le loupina-in nadimun ahi;
target: Though you have not seen him, you love him; and even though you do not see him now, you believe in him and are filled with an inexpressible and glorious joy,

source: Natahsan nao bulhina, nalhagaovu huhhingna ngeichu namu jeh-un.
target: for you are receiving the end result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

source: Nachung uva lungsetna hung chuding hiche huhhingna thudol hi, gaova anaseidoh themgaoho chun akholuva, chule gunchu tena anaholuva;
target: Concerning this salvation, the prophets, who spoke of the grace that was to come to you, searched intently and with the greatest care,

source: Christa thohgim dingje le nungle loupina-in ajom ding thudol Christa Lhagao amaho lung sunga uma chun aseipeh masah laijuva chu, itobang mi ahiloule itobang phat ahi ding anakholu ahitai.
target: trying to find out the time and circumstances to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when he predicted the sufferings of the Messiah and the glories that would follow.

source: Hiche chu amaho henga kiphong doh-a ahin, amaho le amaho changa dinga hilouva, tu-a van'a kona hinkisol Lhagao Thenga kona Kipana Thupha hillhang lehon najah uva aseiju thil chengsea hi amaho eiho lhachale-a pangjo-a ahiuve; thil hitiho hi vantil ten jong vet atupmu ahi.
target: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves but you, when they spoke of the things that have now been told you by those who have preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Even angels long to look into these things.

source: Hijeh chun nalung kong kigah-unlang lung limgehchan umun, Jesu Christa ahung kilah tengle nachung uva lungsetna hung kilhut ding chunga chun nakinepnao ngaichamkimun.
target: Therefore, with minds that are alert and fully sober, set your hope on the grace to be brought to you when Jesus Christ is revealed at his coming.

source: Malai nangol laijuva nalung ngaichat dungjuija nachonjiu banga chu chon louvin; sei ngaija thua nung chate chon doltah-in chonun;
target: As obedient children, do not conform to the evil desires you had when you lived in ignorance.

source: Ahin nakoupa athen bangin, nangho jong nunle khan jouse-a thengun;
target: But just as he who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do;

source: Ajeh chu, Keima kathen jeh hin nangho thengun, tin akisune.
target: for it is written: “Be holy, because I am holy.”

source: Chule dat nei louhela mi jouse ama ama natoh dungjui cheh-a thutana chu Pa tia nakouvu ahile, hiche mun'a nakholjin lai sungseu hin ging khenchan hinkho mangun;
target: Since you call on a Father who judges each person’s work impartially, live out your time as foreigners here in reverent fear.

source: Napute napateuva kona kilason chonna homkeova kona namu-u mangthei thil, sana le dangka-a kilhatdoh nahipouve;
target: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life handed down to you from your ancestors,

source: Amavang boh beh louhel le nolna beihel kelngoinou, Christa thisan lutah-a chu kilhatdoh jo-a nahi bouvui:
target: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or defect.

source: Ama chu leiset kiphudoh masanga gotmasah sa anahin, amavang hiche phat kichai kona hi nangho dinga hung kilah ahi,
target: He was chosen before the creation of the world, but was revealed in these last times for your sake.

source: Ama vanga chu nangho athi lah-a kona ama kaithou le loupina pe-a Pathen tahsan mite nahiu ahi; hichu natahsanu le nakinepnao chu Pathen'a aum theina ding ahi.
target: Through him you believe in God, who raised him from the dead and glorified him, and so your faith and hope are in God.

source: Lhagao jala sopi ngailutna daithei lou dinga, thutah thua nanun uva kona nahinnao nasuhthengu ahitah jehchun; khohsahna neitah-in khatle khat lungtheng selin kingailuto cheh-un;
target: Now that you have purified yourselves by obeying the truth so that you have sincere love for each other, love one another deeply, from the heart.

source: Ajeh chu nangho kem mang thei chia kon hilouva, kem mang theilou chi, tonsotna hingjing le umjing Pathen thua kona thah penkit nahiu ahi.
target: For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.

source: Ajeh chu, Mihem jouse hampa tobang ahi, Aloupina jouseu jong hampapah tobang bep ahi. Hampa agopjin, apah jong apuljitai;
target: For, “All people are like grass, and all their glory is like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,

source: Pakai thu vang tonsot geija umjing jeng ahi. Najah uva kihil lhangle-a Kipana Thupha chu hiche hi ahi.
target: but the word of the Lord endures forever.” And this is the word that was preached to you.

source: Hijeh chun gitlouna jouse, doha lheplhahna jouse, phatlhemna, thangset, chule kiseisetna jouse pailhauvin,
target: Therefore, rid yourselves of all malice and all deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander of every kind.

source: Naosen sohthah bangin, thua kon bongnoi thengset chu ngaijin umun, hichea chu nakhan tou theina dingun;
target: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,

source: Nanghon Pakai chu milungset them ahi chu natep khah-u ahitah-a ahivangle.
target: now that you have tasted that the Lord is good.

source: Mihem paija um hijongle, Pathen dinga lhentum le manlutah ahin, Ama henga chu songpi henga hung banga nahungu ahi,
target: As you come to him, the living Stone—rejected by humans but chosen by God and precious to him—

source: Nangho jong songhing ho banga, Jesu Christa vanga Pathen san thei doltah-a lhagao ganlhaina tohdoh-ah thempu theng hidinga, lhagao in'a kisadoh nahitaove.
target: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

source: Hijeh chun Pathen lekhabua hitin akisune, Veuvin, Sion'ah inning song pipen, lhentum, man lutah chu kadoi; Ama tahsana chu iti nama jongle jachatna-a chu lou ding ahi, ati.
target: For in Scripture it says: “See, I lay a stone in Zion, a chosen and precious cornerstone, and the one who trusts in him will never be put to shame.”

source: Hichu atahsana nangho dinga man lutah ahi; atahsan louho ding vanga hiti hi ahi, Insahon apaiju song chu Aninga apipena panga ahitai;
target: Now to you who believe, this stone is precious. But to those who do not believe, “The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”

source: chule, kipalna songle suhkhelna songpi soh-a ahitai; amahon thu chu angai loujeh uva kipala ahiuve; hiche dinga chu amaho gotsa jong ahiuve.
target: and, “A stone that causes people to stumble and a rock that makes them fall.” They stumble because they disobey the message—which is also what they were destined for.

source: Ahin muthima kona ama vah kidangtah sunga lut dinga nakoudohpao phatna chu naphondoh theina dinguva, nangho nam lhenchom, leng thempu, vaipi theng, chule ama-a tum hi dinga Pathen mite nahiu ahitai:
target: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God’s special possession, that you may declare the praises of him who called you out of darkness into his wonderful light.

source: Masanga chu mite hilou nahiu ahin, tu vangin Pathen mite nahitaove; hepina changlou nahiu ahin, tu vangin hepina changa nahitaove.
target: Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.

source: Ngaitah teho, nangho mi gama cheng le kholjin tobang nahijeh uva naheng uva kahungtao ahi, tahsa ngaichat thil chengsea konin kikangseuvin; hitiho chu lhagaotoh kidou ahi.
target: Dear friends, I urge you, as foreigners and exiles, to abstain from sinful desires, which wage war against your soul.

source: Chule chidang namdangho lah-a nanun nakhanu phatsah-un; chutile akhang gilou tia amahon nangho naseisetnao chu amittah-in nathilpha bolu chu muvintin, hiche thudol chu vettoh-a aum nile Pathen avahchoi dingu ahi.
