target: Live such good lives among the pagans that, though they accuse you of doing wrong, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day he visits us.

source: Pakai jal-in mihem phudoh chondan thun nungun: mijouse chunga vaipo ahito lhonin, Lengpa thu ahin;
target: Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human authority: whether to the emperor, as the supreme authority,

source: Ahiloule mikhang gilouho chunga phula dingle, mi thilpha bolho pachatna pedinga ama hinsol gamvaipoho thun nungun.
target: or to governors, who are sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to commend those who do right.

source: Ajeh chu nanghon nathilpha boluva konin lungthim beiho ngolna chu thiphelin lhaleu chun, hichu Pathen lunglam ahi:
target: For it is God’s will that by doing good you should silence the ignorant talk of foolish people.

source: Nangho chamlen chonin chonun, ahivangin hiche nacham len nao chu gitlou khunan nei hih-un; ahin Pathen sohte um doltah-in umjouvin.
target: Live as free people, but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil; live as God’s slaves.

source: Mi jouse jabol sohkeijun. Sopi tapou chu ngailuvin. Pathen gingun. Lengpa chu jabolun.
target: Show proper respect to everyone, love the family of believers, fear God, honor the emperor.

source: Sohteho, nangho gingkhen chan napakai te chengseu thunoija umun; apha le anunnemho heng jenga hilouvin, lunggilou puho thunoija jong umun.
target: Slaves, in reverent fear of God submit yourselves to your masters, not only to those who are good and considerate, but also to those who are harsh.

source: Mi khattou Pathen ahet jeh-in thohdol louhel thohgimhen, dihlou tah-a akibolna thohham hamle, Hichu pachat umtah ahi.
target: For it is commendable if someone bears up under the pain of unjust suffering because they are conscious of God.

source: Nathemmona jeh-in min navo henlang, lungneng tah-in thohle chun, ipi pachatna nachan dingham? ahin thilpha nabola, hiche jeh-a chu nahesoh gentheija, lungneng tah-a nathoh-a ahile, hichu Pathen deilam ahi.
target: But how is it to your credit if you receive a beating for doing wrong and endure it? But if you suffer for doing good and you endure it, this is commendable before God.

source: Ajehchu hiche-a dinga chu kikou nahiuve: ijeh inem itile Christan jong eiho dinga hesoh genthei athoh ahin, nangho akhonung jui nahina dinguva, hichu vettoh-a jui ding akoija adalhah ahi.
target: To this you were called, because Christ suffered for you, leaving you an example, that you should follow in his steps.

source: Ama chu achonsepon, akam sunga jong doha lheplhahna kimulou ahi:
target: “He committed no sin, and no deceit was found in his mouth.”

source: Houset achanin ahouse thuhpon; athohgim pet jong chun koima agihsalpon; ahin chonpha tah-a thutanpa khutna akingaijon ahi.
target: When they hurled their insults at him, he did not retaliate; when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he entrusted himself to him who judges justly.

source: Eiho chonset lama ithiuva chonphat lama ihinna dingun, Aman eiho chonset jouse atahsa chunga apon, thingleh geijin apodohtan ahi: ama kijepna maha-a chu nangho kiboldama nahitaove.
target: “He himself bore our sins” in his body on the cross, so that we might die to sins and live for righteousness; “by his wounds you have been healed.”

source: Ajeh chu nangho kelngoi hon banga lamvaija nahiu ahin, tu vanga hi nalhagao chingpao le nakaihoipao henga hung kile kit nahitaove.
target: For “you were like sheep going astray,” but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

source: Hiche bang chun, inneipiho jouse na-inneipute cheh-u thunoija kipelut un; amaho abang khattou thua nunglou hijongleu, thua hilouva, a-inneipite chengu khanthem vanga akijo theina dingun;
target: Wives, in the same way submit yourselves to your own husbands so that, if any of them do not believe the word, they may be won over without words by the behavior of their wives,

source: Nangho ging gehcha na-umu nanun nakhannu thengsel chu amit tah-a mu-u hen.
target: when they see the purity and reverence of your lives.

source: Sampheh hoi, sana khi-o, nihchen ponsil got chomchom tho-a polam jem-a kijem louvin,
target: Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as elaborate hairstyles and the wearing of gold jewelry or fine clothes.

source: Lung sunga guhthim mi, nunnem le lungnem kem theilou jem chun kijem jouhen; hichu Pathen mitvetna man lutah ahi.
target: Rather, it should be that of your inner self, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is of great worth in God’s sight.

source: Ajeh chu malaija numei theng Pathen'a kingaiho jong chu chutia chu kijema, a-inneipute chengu thunoija kipelutnu ahiuve:
target: For this is the way the holy women of the past who put their hope in God used to adorn themselves. They submitted themselves to their own husbands,

source: Hitia chu Sara'in Abraham chu pakai asah-a athua ananun banga; nanghon kichase louhela thilpha nabol uva ahile, ama chanuteho nahiu ahi.
target: like Sarah, who obeyed Abraham and called him her lord. You are her daughters if you do what is right and do not give way to fear.

source: Chutobangma chun, inneipu teho, natao nao daltana aumlouna dingin, hinna lungsetna nachankhompiu ahiuto lhonin, numei chu belkehbai bangin jabolun lang, hetna dungjuijin amaho chu chenkhom piuvin.
target: Husbands, in the same way be considerate as you live with your wives, and treat them with respect as the weaker partner and as heirs with you of the gracious gift of life, so that nothing will hinder your prayers.

source: Achainan, nangho nabonchaovin lungkhat hiuvin, kilainatto cheh-un, sopi khat bangin kingailuvin, kilungsetto themun, nunnem tah hiuvin.
target: Finally, all of you, be like-minded, be sympathetic, love one another, be compassionate and humble.

source: Set phu lahnan set bolhih helun; chule houset phu lahnan house thuh hih-un: chusangin phatthei bohjouvin; ajeh chu phattheina chu lo dinga nangho kikouva nahiuve ti heuvin.
target: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult. On the contrary, repay evil with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.

source: Ajeh chu Mi koi hile hinkho ngailut ding noma, nikho phaho mu noma chun Gitlouna-a konin alei, chule milhep lhahna thu seija konin amuh tuhtanghen;
target: For, “Whoever would love life and see good days must keep their tongue from evil and their lips from deceitful speech.

source: Ama chu gitlouna konin kileheihen, thilpha bolhen; Chamna hol henlang, hichu nungdel peh hen.
target: They must turn from evil and do good; they must seek peace and pursue it.

source: Ajehchu Pakai mit chu michonpha ho chunga aumin, Ataonao ngaina-a ana asungin ahi; Ahin Pakai mai chun thil gilou bolho lam angat jingin ahi.
target: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous and his ears are attentive to their prayer, but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

source: Nangho apha chu juija nahi vangule, koiham nabol engse dinguva?
target: Who is going to harm you if you are eager to do good?

source: Ahinla chonphat jala hesoh genthei thoh nahi vangule, anunnom nahiuve: chule amahon nasuh kichatnao chu kicha loujenun, lung jong lungdong hih-un;
target: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. “Do not fear their threats; do not be frightened.”

source: Chusangin nalunggil uvah Pakai Pathen chu sutheng jouvin: khattou nasunguva um kinepna thudol chu adonga auma ahile, amaho chu lungnemle ging gehcha donbut dingin phasademin um jingun:
target: But in your hearts revere Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give an answer to everyone who asks you to give the reason for the hope that you have. But do this with gentleness and respect,

source: Sele pha hetna pha neijun; chutile Christa-a nahinkho manu adihlou tah-a seisehon thilphalou bol banga nachung uva athuseiju chu jahchatna anei dingu ahi.
target: keeping a clear conscience, so that those who speak maliciously against your good behavior in Christ may be ashamed of their slander.

source: Ajeh chu thilphalou nabol jeh uva genthei hesoh thoh sangin, Pathen lunggot lam ahile, thilpha nabol jeh uva nathoh gimu chu gamchenga phajo ahi.
target: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.

source: Ajeh chu Christa'n jong chonsetna chengse jeh-a, chonphatah chun chonpha louho dinga, eiho chengse hi Pathen kom eilhut theina dinguva, khatvei hesoh genthei athohgim ahi; ama chu tahsa-a kithat ahin, amavang lhagaova hinga ahi:
target: For Christ also suffered once for sins, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in the body but made alive in the Spirit.

source: Chujongle lhagaova chea kul-a kihen lhagaoho henga thu agasei ahi;
target: After being made alive, he went and made proclamation to the imprisoned spirits—

source: Amaho chu phatkhat lai, Noah nikho laija kong kisem lai sungse-a, Pathen lungdehatna-in anga laija chu thua nunglou anahiuva ahin, hiche kong'a chu mi themcha khat, miget sehbou twija anasohcha-a ahi.
target: to those who were disobedient long ago when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ark was being built. In it only a few people, eight in all, were saved through water,

source: Hichu Jesu Christa thokit vanga isochatnao baptize channa lima kibol (hichu tahsa nen pailhah hilouva, Pathen heng lama sele pha hetna pha donbutna ahi;)
target: and this water symbolizes baptism that now saves you also—not the removal of dirt from the body but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God. It saves you by the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

source: Ama van'a akaltouvin Pathen jet lama aumtai; vantil chengsele, thuneina, chule thilboltheina thahat jouse ama thu noija uma ahitai.
target: who has gone into heaven and is at God’s right hand—with angels, authorities and powers in submission to him.

source: Chuti chu ahin, Christa'n tahsa-a eihodia athohgim jeh chun, nangho jong chutobang lungput chun kivonun; ajeh chu tahsa-a thohgima chun chonsetna adalhah ahin;
target: Therefore, since Christ suffered in his body, arm yourselves also with the same attitude, because whoever suffers in the body is done with sin.

source: Chutia chu aphat umnalai chengse chu mihem lung ngaichat lama tahsa-a hing talouva, Pathen lunggot lama ahin johna ding ahi.
target: As a result, they do not live the rest of their earthly lives for evil human desires, but rather for the will of God.

source: Ajehchu nomsahna lung ngaichat, huh, juneh hat, julhang neh, nehkhom, thet umtah milim houna-a i-um laijuva chu, chidang namdangho lunggot lam bolna dinga iphatnu tamtah inamanu ahitan;
target: For you have spent enough time in the past doing what pagans choose to do—living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing and detestable idolatry.

source: Nanghon setna lama amaho chu nachon khompitah loujeh uva kidang asah uva, nahouset jiu ahi.
target: They are surprised that you do not join them in their reckless, wild living, and they heap abuse on you.

source: Ahingle athi thutan dinga kigopa anga chu amahon achonnau asuhtoa apeh cheh dingu ahi.
target: But they will have to give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu amaho mihem dola tahsa-a athu-u akitana, lhagaova Pathen lungdeija ahin nadinguva, athisaho jahdinga jong Kipana Thupha chu kiseija ahitai.
target: For this is the reason the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged according to human standards in regard to the body, but live according to God in regard to the spirit.

source: Ahinla thil jouse hi abeina ding nikho anaitai; hiche jeh chun lunglim gehchan umun lang taojing dingin chingtheijun.
target: The end of all things is near. Therefore be alert and of sober mind so that you may pray.

source: Imajouse chungvuma gunchu tah-in khatle khat kingailutto nalah uva habolun; ajeh chu ngailutna hin chonset tamtah akhujin ahi;
target: Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.

source: Phunchel louhelin khatle khat kilhun sahton umun:
target: Offer hospitality to one another without grumbling.

source: Amitakip lungsetna thilpeh achan dungjui cheh-in, Pathen milungsetna gotchom chom tamtah gouching phaho bangin, khatle khat kijento jingin umun.
target: Each of you should use whatever gift you have received to serve others, as faithful stewards of God’s grace in its various forms.

source: Thuseija aumle, ama chun Pathen kamsoh seijin seihen; chule mi jenlea aumle, Pathen'in apeh thahat dungjuijin jenlehen: chutia chu thil imajousea Jesu Christa vanga Pathen vahchoija aum theina dingin; Vahchoina le thuneina tonsot geija ama-a ahi. Amen.
target: If anyone speaks, they should do so as one who speaks the very words of God. If anyone serves, they should do so with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be praised through Jesus Christ. To him be the glory and the power for ever and ever. Amen.

source: Ngaiteho, nangho patepna ding patepna meikong chu thil kidang nachung uva hung chua bangin kidang sahih-un;
target: Dear friends, do not be surprised at the fiery ordeal that has come on you to test you, as though something strange were happening to you.

source: Nangho Christa hesoh genthei thohgim thoh khompi-a nahiu bangtah chun kipahjo uvin; chutia chu aloupina hung kilah tengle, kipana nasatah-a nakipa theina dingun.
target: But rejoice inasmuch as you participate in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed when his glory is revealed.

source: Nangho Christa min jala houset nachanuva ahile, anunnom nahiuve; ajeh chu loupina Lhagao chule Pathen Lhagao chu nachung uva aume: amaho jal-in Ama seiset nin aumin, nangho jallin Ama choiat nin aume.
target: If you are insulted because of the name of Christ, you are blessed, for the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.

source: Nalah uva koiman toltha jeh ahim, guchat jeh ahim, khan gitlou jeh ahim, midang tohna chunga khut lha jeh ahimin, hesoh genthei thoh hihhen;
target: If you suffer, it should not be as a murderer or thief or any other kind of criminal, or even as a meddler.

source: Christian hi jeh-a hesoh genthei thohgima aum vangle, ama chun jachatnan nei hihhen; ahin hiche min jehchun Pathen choi-an johen.
target: However, if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but praise God that you bear that name.

source: Ajeh chu Pathen insunga kona thutanna ahung kipat nading phat chu ahitai: chule hichu eihoa akipatna ahile, Pathen Kipana Thupha thua nunglouho kichaina chu iti tantem?
target: For it is time for judgment to begin with God’s household; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who do not obey the gospel of God?

source: Michonpha bon huhhing-a aum ahahsatna ahile, Pathen ngaisah louho le michonse hon hoija amaiju alahdoh dingu hitam?
target: And, “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?”

source: Chuti ahi jeh chun Pathen lunglam dola hesoh genthei thohgimho chun thilpha bolin alhagaovu chu tahsan umtah asempa henga bangin ama henga pedoh-u hen.
target: So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should commit themselves to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.

source: Nalah uva um upaho chengse chu, Christa hesoh gentheina hettohsah-a, chule loupina hung kilang ding chankhompi, na-upat chankhompiu keiman kahin til nahiuve:
target: To the elders among you, I appeal as a fellow elder and a witness of Christ’s sufferings who also will share in the glory to be revealed:

source: Nalah uva Pathen kelngoi hon umho chu phaten chingphaovin, bollou phamo tia bol louvin, lung chamin bolun; alam louva phatchom ngaichatna-a jong hilouvin, lung guttenin bolun;
target: Be shepherds of God’s flock that is under your care, watching over them—not because you must, but because you are willing, as God wants you to be; not pursuing dishonest gain, but eager to serve;

source: Chule Pathen gouloho chunga kipipuisah louvin, ahon chun avettoh-a ajui dingu joh-in umun, kaihoijun.
target: not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.

source: Chutile Aching pipupa hung kilah tengle, nanghon chul theilou loupina lallukhuh chu nasan dingu ahi.
target: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.

source: Chutobangma chun khangdong ho, nangho upaho thunoija kipelut un. Chule nangho nabonun khatle khat kithununto cheh-un lang, kineosah na-in kivonun: ajeh chu Pathen'in mikiletsah ho adoudalin, mi kineosah ho lungsetna achanjin ahi.
target: In the same way, you who are younger, submit yourselves to your elders. All of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud but shows favor to the humble.”

source: Hijeh chun Aman aphatcha nangho nachoisang theina dingun, Pathen khut thahat tah noija chun nem heochan umun:
target: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, that he may lift you up in due time.

source: Nalungkham najouseu ama chunga sep lha uvin; ajeh chu aman nakhankho dingu agelnai.
target: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.

source: Limgehchan umun, kihongphauvin, ajehchu nakidou piu diabol chu keipi bahkai kituma banga, koi kaval lhum theidem, tia hollea vahlea ahi;
target: Be alert and of sober mind. Your enemy the devil prowls around like a roaring lion looking for someone to devour.

source: Tahsan dettah-in ama chu douvun; vannoi leiset chunga um nasopi ho chengseu chunga jong chutobang thohgim chu chusohkeija ahi chu heuvin.
target: Resist him, standing firm in the faith, because you know that the family of believers throughout the world is undergoing the same kind of sufferings.

source: Chule lungsetna jouse Pathen, tonsot tonsot geija um aloupina-a dinga Christa Jesu jala nakoupao tahchun, chomkhat nathohgim jou tengule, nasuh chamkimuva, naphudet uva, nahatsah uva, chule nachendet sah dingu ahi.
target: And the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory in Christ, after you have suffered a little while, will himself restore you and make you strong, firm and steadfast.

source: Tonsot atonsot geijin loupinale thuneina chu ama-a hijinghen, Amen.
target: To him be the power for ever and ever. Amen.

source: Tahsantah sopi-a kangaito Silvanus khutna, nangho tilkhouna le hiche idin naohi Pathen lungset dihtah ahi ti jong hettohsah na-a, chomcha kahinsut ahi.
target: With the help of Silas, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand fast in it.

source: Nakilhen khompiu Babylon'a um houbung le, kachapa Mark'in nasalamui.
target: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you her greetings, and so does my son Mark.

source: Kingailut na-a kichopton khatle khat kisalam un. Christa Jesu'a um nangho, nabonchaova chungah lungmona umhen. Amen.
target: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.

source: Jesu Christa soh le solchah Simon Peter'in, Pathen le eihuh hinguva Jesu Christa chonphat vanga tahsan lutah kachan bang changho hengah:
target: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ have received a faith as precious as ours:

source: Pathen le I-Pakaiyu Jesu hetna-a konin nachung uva lungsetle lungmon hapunin punghen.
target: Grace and peace be yours in abundance through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.

source: Aloupina le aphatna-a eikoupau hetna vanga Pathen thahat chun hinna le Pathen ngaisahna lam thudolla thil jouse eipeh-u ahitai:
target: His divine power has given us everything we need for a godly life through our knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and goodness.

source: Chule hicheng vanga chu thutep lentah le manlutah chu eipeh jengu ahitai; hitia chu ngaichatna jeh-a vannoi leisetna um suhbohna-a kona chu nahoidoh uva, Pathen nunle khan chankhompi nahina dingu ahi.
target: Through these he has given us his very great and precious promises, so that through them you may participate in the divine nature, having escaped the corruption in the world caused by evil desires.

source: Hiche jehtah chun nanghon potthona kimkei pandoh-un, natahsanu chun phatna, naphatnao chun hetna;
target: For this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith goodness; and to goodness, knowledge;

source: Nahetna-u chun tibah timthem, natibah timthemu chun thohhat, chule thohhat chun Pathen ngaisahna;
target: and to knowledge, self-control; and to self-control, perseverance; and to perseverance, godliness;

source: Pathen ngaisahna chun sopi hepina, chule sopi hepina chun ngailutna sodoh hen.
target: and to godliness, mutual affection; and to mutual affection, love.

source: Ajeh chu hichengse chu nangho-a auma, aum dimset jinga ahile, I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa hetna thudolla nangho hatmo le ga beija naumsah lou dingu ahi.
target: For if you possess these qualities in increasing measure, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

source: Ahin hicheng neilou chu amitchoa ahin, gamla mulou ahin, masanga achonset luiho chengse-a kona kisu ngim ahi chu asuhmil ahitai.
target: But whoever does not have them is nearsighted and blind, forgetting that they have been cleansed from their past sins.

source: Hijeh chun, sopiteho, nangho nakikou nao le naki lhennao chu kichetsahna dingin kihabolun; nanghon hichu nabol uva ahile, a-imatih chana nalhuh lou dingu ahi:
target: Therefore, my brothers and sisters, make every effort to confirm your calling and election. For if you do these things, you will never stumble,

source: Chutia chu I-Pakaiyu le eihuh hingpao Jesu Christa tonsot lenggama chu lut theina thu letset tah-a nakipe dingu ahi.
target: and you will receive a rich welcome into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

source: Hiche jeh chun nanghon hichenghi hejongleu chun, chule tu-a nangho-a uma thutah-a chun umdet jing jongleu chun, hicheng thudol hi nangho geldohsah jing ding ngaisah louva kaum louhel ding ahi.
target: So I will always remind you of these things, even though you know them and are firmly established in the truth you now have.

source: Chule hiche pon in'a hi kaum laichanse-a, nangho chu geldohsah jinga hah jinga umsah dinghi adihlam in kagele.
target: I think it is right to refresh your memory as long as I live in the tent of this body,

source: Ajeh chu I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christan eihetsah banga, hiche pon in hi kadalhah vah ding ahi ti kahei.
target: because I know that I will soon put it aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.

source: Chule kadalhah nung tengle hicheng thudol hi nageldoh jing theina dinguva jong kihabol kahi.
target: And I will make every effort to see that after my departure you will always be able to remember these things.

source: Keiman Pakai Jesu Christa thuneina le ahung ding thu nangho kahetsah laija chu, lungthim thema suhto-a semthu thusim juija hilou kahipouve, Leng Chungnung loupitah ahije mittah-a mu-a hettohsahjoa kahibouve.
target: For we did not follow cleverly devised stories when we told you about the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ in power, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

source: Ama hi ka-Chapa deitah ahi, achunga kalung alhai tangeije, tia Leng Chungnung loupina-a ahenga aw ahung lhuna chu, Pa Pathen'a kona choi-atle jabol changa ahi.
target: He received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, saying, “This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased.”

source: Van'a kon hiche aw hung ging chu molsang theng chunga ama toh kaumuva kajah-u ahi.
target: We ourselves heard this voice that came from heaven when we were with him on the sacred mountain.

source: Chule themgaoho thu chu kichet chehna-a kahengu hung lhunga ahi; nangho chuche thua lunglut tah-a na-umu hi apha lheh jenge; jingkho ahung vah-a nalung sunguva jing niso ahung sodoh masangse-a, muthim lah salvah jing vah tobanga chingthei tah-a na-umu chu nabol hoi lheh jengun ahi.
target: We also have the prophetic message as something completely reliable, and you will do well to pay attention to it, as to a light shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.

source: Pathen lekhabua gaothu kisei jouse hi koiman ama chang tuma ahilchet ahipoi ti hemasao vin.
target: Above all, you must understand that no prophecy of Scripture came about by the prophet’s own interpretation of things.

source: Ajeh chu malaija gaothu kiseidoh hochu mihem lungchama kona sohdoh-a ahipoi: ahin Pathen mitheng hon Lhagao Thengin amanchah dung juijuva aseiju ahibouve.
target: For prophecy never had its origin in the human will, but prophets, though human, spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.

source: Ahin miho lah-a themgao lhem asodohtah banga chu, nangho lah-a jong mihil lhem hung sohdoh-a, guhthima misumang thei thuhil ki dang ahinpoh lut dingu, amaho achopau Pakai tah jeng jong chu ajahda uva, chule poh phunga achunguva manthah na akiloi khum dingu ahi.
target: But there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the sovereign Lord who bought them—bringing swift destruction on themselves.

source: Chule mi tamtah-in amanthah nao lampi chu ahinjui dingu; amaho jeh-a chu thutah lampi hi seisetna hung umding ahi.
target: Many will follow their depraved conduct and will bring the way of truth into disrepute.

source: Chule kilosetna-a jou thua ki sumkol veina-a nahinnei dingu ahi; ahinla malaija patna achunguva thu kitan chu khongai sot lou, chule amanthah nau jong chu lulhu lou ahi.
target: In their greed these teachers will exploit you with fabricated stories. Their condemnation has long been hanging over them, and their destruction has not been sleeping.

source: Ajeh chu Pathen'in vantil chonseho jengbon chu khen louhela, damuna ale lut jenga, athu-u kitan ding ngah-a kokhuh thima akhum jenga;
target: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but sent them to hell, putting them in chains of darkness to be held for judgment;

source: Chule Pathen ngaisah lou vannoi chunga twisang aletsah-a chu vannoi lui chu khen louhela, adang sagitoh chonphat thu seile-a Noah chubou akhena;
target: if he did not spare the ancient world when he brought the flood on its ungodly people, but protected Noah, a preacher of righteousness, and seven others;

source: Chule Sodom le Gomorrah khopi teni chu vutvai asosah-a, themmo chan na-a alekhupma, chule Pathen ngaisah louho chunga itobang ahung chuh ding vetsahna-a asema;
target: if he condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and made them an example of what is going to happen to the ungodly;

source: Chule mi engseho khan gitlouna-a kona thoh gentheija michonpha Lot chu ahuhhinga ahile:
target: and if he rescued Lot, a righteous man, who was distressed by the depraved conduct of the lawless

source: (Ajehchu hiche michonpha chu amaho lah-a chenga, achonsetnao chu amua ajah-a, achonset jeh uva chu ama chonphat lung sunga chu niseh-a lungphamo lhehji-a ahi);
target: (for that righteous man, living among them day after day, was tormented in his righteous soul by the lawless deeds he saw and heard)—

source: Pakaiyin Pathen ngaisahho chu lhepna-a kona huhdohje ahen, chonpha louho chu thupi kitan ni kahse-a dinga talen matsah-a koije ahei:
target: if this is so, then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials and to hold the unrighteous for punishment on the day of judgment.

source: Ahideh-a kisuhbohna lam ngaicha-a tahsa lama chonteho le, gamvaipo nahsahmoho. Amaho chu ngol hanle ama lungchama chon ahiuvin, amahon loupina changho jengsan jong houset ding atijapouve.
target: This is especially true of those who follow the corrupt desire of the flesh and despise authority. Bold and arrogant, they are not afraid to heap abuse on celestial beings;

source: Vantil ho chu thahat le thilbol theija chungnungjo ahi jeng vangun, amaho dounan oimona thu Pakai anga alhut pouvin ahi.
target: yet even angels, although they are stronger and more powerful, do not heap abuse on such beings when bringing judgment on them from the Lord.

source: Ahin hiteho vanghi lungel neilou sahemho tobanga achonnau dungjuija kimana kisumang ding ahiuvin, ahet phah louhelu thu chu aseiseu vin ahi; chule amaho asetnaova chu mangthah ding ahiuvin;
target: But these people blaspheme in matters they do not understand. They are like unreasoning animals, creatures of instinct, born only to be caught and destroyed, and like animals they too will perish.

source: Chule amahon suna kivah nehnop hi nomsah na-a angaito jeh uva, chonphat louna tohman chu asan dingu ahi. Amaho chu boh beh le nol uma ahiuvin, nangho toh kivahna-a ankong aumkhom ji tengule adoha lungthim uva akisuboh jiuvin;
target: They will be paid back with harm for the harm they have done. Their idea of pleasure is to carouse in broad daylight. They are blots and blemishes, reveling in their pleasures while they feast with you.

source: Jon thanhoina dimset mit aneijun, chonsetna ngathei lou ahiuvin; mi lungdet louho ajol lhajiuve: alungu chu thangset bolna lama kichuh ahin, sapset chang chate ahiuve:
target: With eyes full of adultery, they never stop sinning; they seduce the unstable; they are experts in greed—an accursed brood!

source: Amahon lamdih adalhaovin, lam hilouva avahmangun, chonphat louna thaman ngailu-a Beor chapa Baalam lampi chu ajuijun ahi;
target: They have left the straight way and wandered off to follow the way of Balaam son of Bezer, who loved the wages of wickedness.

source: Ahin ama chu achonkhel jeh chun pho sal-in aumin; pao theilou sangan chu mihem paova apaodoh-in themgaopa ngolna chu akhamtangin ahi.
target: But he was rebuked for his wrongdoing by a donkey—an animal without speech—who spoke with a human voice and restrained the prophet’s madness.

source: Hitiho hi twi umlou twikul ahiuvin, khopi huijin asemmang meilhang ahiuve; muthim lhangkhal kiheh chu amaho dinga a-imatih chana dinga kikheh khol ahi.
target: These people are springs without water and mists driven by a storm. Blackest darkness is reserved for them.

source: Ajeh chu amahon hamhoi thona thumanlou asei tengule, lamvaina-a umho lah-a kona hung jamdoh ho chu tahsa lam ngaichat huhna lama ajol lha jiuvin ahi.
target: For they mouth empty, boastful words and, by appealing to the lustful desires of the flesh, they entice people who are just escaping from those who live in error.

source: Amahon chamlen athutep jiuvin, ahinla amahotah kemmang soh ho ahiuve: ajeh chu mi jo-a aumna-a chun, soh-a akailut jiuvin ahi.
target: They promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves of depravity—for “people are slaves to whatever has mastered them.”

source: Pakai le huhhing-a Jesu Christa het vanga, vannoi leiset kisuhbohna tincheng ajamsan nunguva, chuche thenlouna-a akikhi oh kitnuva, jo-a aum kitnuva ahile, aumchan amasa sanga anunung chu sejocheh ahi.
target: If they have escaped the corruption of the world by knowing our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ and are again entangled in it and are overcome, they are worse off at the end than they were at the beginning.

source: Ajeh chu ahet nunguva, amaho kipe-a thupeh thenga kona akiheimang sangun, chonphat lampi chu ahet louhelu hile, amaho dinga phajoa ahi.
target: It would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than to have known it and then to turn their backs on the sacred command that was passed on to them.

source: Ui jin aloh lhahsa ajon kitjin, vohpi kisilngimsa jong bonlhoh lah-a kibolin akilejie, ti paochamtuh hi amaho chunga lhung ahitai.
target: Of them the proverbs are true: “A dog returns to its vomit,” and, “A sow that is washed returns to her wallowing in the mud.”

source: Ngaitahteho, keiman nangho lekha kahinthot hiche hi anina ahi; anigela chu nangho geldohsah na-a kona nalung thengu chu kahinsuh thou ahi;
target: Dear friends, this is now my second letter to you. I have written both of them as reminders to stimulate you to wholesome thinking.

source: Nanghon malaija themgao thengho thusei chengsele, Pakai le Huhhingpa solchah keiho thupeh najahsao chu nageldoh jingna dinguva kahinsut ahi.
target: I want you to recall the words spoken in the past by the holy prophets and the command given by our Lord and Savior through your apostles.

source: Amasan nanghon hiche hi heuvin, ni nunungle jontaina manga jontai hatteho hung umdoh ding ahiuve, amaho chu ama tahsa ngaichat lama chonuntin,
target: Above all, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own evil desires.

source: Ahung dinga thutepna chu hoibaham? Iputeu ipateu athiuva kipat tu gei hin, thilsem jouse hila semtila aum ngai bangbangin aumnan, atiuva nahin jontai dingu ahi.
target: They will say, “Where is this ‘coming’ he promised? Ever since our ancestors died, everything goes on as it has since the beginning of creation.”

source: Ajeh chu amaho hicheho-a hi kihetmo sah uva ahin, malaipeh-a patna Pathen thusah-a vanho chengse le twi chunga le twinoija um leiset hohi um ahi.
target: But they deliberately forget that long ago by God’s word the heavens came into being and the earth was formed out of water and by water.

source: Chuche laija vannoi leiset chu twisanglen'in asuhmang ahitai:
target: By these waters also the world of that time was deluged and destroyed.

source: Hiche thuma ma-a chu tulai van le leiset hi Pathen ngaisah louho thu kitanle akisuhmang niu geija dinga meija dinga kikheh kholla ahi ti hi,
target: By the same word the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of the ungodly.

source: ahin, sopi ngaiteho, nanghon hiche thuhi sumil loujenun, Pakai dingin ni khat chu kum sangkhat tobang ahin, kum sangkhat chu ni khat tobang ahi.
target: But do not forget this one thing, dear friends: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.

source: Mi khattouvin geisang asah chu Pakai athutep lam dola geisang ahipoi, koima amangthah um louva mi jousen lung aheiman nading angaitoa, eiho jala khongai sot ahibouve.
target: The Lord is not slow in keeping his promise, as some understand slowness. Instead he is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish, but everyone to come to repentance.

source: Amavang Pakai nikho chu janna gucha banga hung ding ahi; hiche ni chule vanho chengse ha gina ginglul lula manghel ding ahi, chule thilbul chengse meijin akah jola kavam gamhel ding ahi; chule vannoi leisetle asunga thil um jouse aboncha kavam sohkei ding ahi.
target: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a roar; the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and everything done in it will be laid bare.

source: Chu chengse chu chutia mang ding ahile, nunle khan then lamle Pathen ngaisahna lama itobang mi nahi ding dol uham!
target: Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? You ought to live holy and godly lives

source: Pathen nikho hung lhung ding chu pontho tah-a kat jinga kinema umding dol ahi; hiche ni chu ahung lhun jeh-a vanho meija kong'a kavamhel ding, chule thilbul chengse meisa-a jolmang sohding ahi.
target: as you look forward to the day of God and speed its coming. That day will bring about the destruction of the heavens by fire, and the elements will melt in the heat.

source: Ahinla eihon vang ama thutep dungjuija vanthah hole leithah kinema ingau ahi; hichea chu chonphatna chenga ahi.
target: But in keeping with his promise we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells.

source: Hijeh chun, sopi ngaiteho, hicheng chu kat jinga nangho ama anga boh beh louhel le nolna beihela lungmonga nakimudoh theina dingun kihabolun.
target: So then, dear friends, since you are looking forward to this, make every effort to be found spotless, blameless and at peace with him.

source: Chule Pakai mi khongaisot hi huhhinga umna ahi ti gelun; isopiu deitah Paul'in jong ama kipe-a hetna dungjuija, chutobangma chu nangho henga ahinsutsa ahitai;
target: Bear in mind that our Lord’s patience means salvation, just as our dear brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom that God gave him.

source: Alekhathot chengsea chu hiche thu chu aseija, chutobangma chu asut ahi, hichenga chun het hahsatahtah thu aume; hichu mi lunglhomho le lungdet louhon Pathen lekhabua thu dang dang angai koiji bangun, angai koijiuvin amale ama akisumang jiuve.
target: He writes the same way in all his letters, speaking in them of these matters. His letters contain some things that are hard to understand, which ignorant and unstable people distort, as they do the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

source: Hijeh chun, ngaiteho, hichengse chu nahet masatsao bangin, kihongphauvin, achuti loule nangho jengjong michonseho lamvaina lama puimangin umun natin, napandet phapet lhaso khauvin nate.
target: Therefore, dear friends, since you have been forewarned, be on your guard so that you may not be carried away by the error of the lawless and fall from your secure position.

source: Ahin I-Pakaiyu le Huhhing-a Jesu Christa milungset le hetna-a khangtou jingun. Ama-a chun tu le tonsot geijin loupina umhen. Amen.
target: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and forever! Amen.

source: Atil abula patna umsa jing, kana-a kajah-u, kamittah uva kanamu-u, kanavetnu, chule kakhut tah uva kathamu, hinna thu chu;
target: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked at and our hands have touched—this we proclaim concerning the Word of life.

source: (Ajehchu hiche hinna chu hung kiphonga ahin, chule keihon kamuvin, kahettohsah-un, chule chuche tonsot hin kemlou, Pa koma um, keiho henga hung kiphonga chu nangho kamusah nahiuve);
target: The life appeared; we have seen it and testify to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life, which was with the Father and has appeared to us.

source: Henge, keihon kamusa chengseole kajahsa chengseu chu, nangho jong keihotoh ikiloi theina dinguva nangho henga kaphondoh-u ahi; chule tahbeh-a keiho kiloikhomna hi Pa toh, chule Achapa Jesu Christa toh kiloikhomna hija ahi.
target: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

source: Chule nakipanao achamkim theina dinga hicheng hi kahinsut ahi.
target: We write this to make our joy complete.

source: Keihon ama-a kona kajah-u nangho kahilsonu chu hiche hi ahi, Pathen chu vah ahi, ama-a chu muthim himhim um louhel ahi.
target: This is the message we have heard from him and declare to you: God is light; in him there is no darkness at all.

source: Amatoh kiloi kahi itiuva muthima ivaleu vangle, thujou sei ihiu ahin, chule thutah chu nit lou ihiuve;
target: If we claim to have fellowship with him and yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not live out the truth.

source: Ama vah-a aum banga eiho jong vah-a chu ivaleu vangle, khat le khat kiloikhom ihiu ahin, chule Achapa Jesu Christa thisan chun chonsetna jouse-a kona eisilngimu ahi.
target: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.

source: Eihon chonsetna kaneipoi itiuva ahile, eimale eima kilhem lha-a ihiu ahi, chule thutah chu isunguva umlou ahi.
target: If we claim to be without sin, we deceive ourselves and the truth is not in us.

source: Eihon ichonsetnao iphon vangule, ama chu eiho chonsetna chengse ngaidam dingle chonphat louna jouse siltheng dinga tahsan umtah chule chonphatah ahi.
target: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and purify us from all unrighteousness.

source: Eihon chonsetna kaneipoi itiuva ahile, ama chu ijousah-u ahin, chule athu chu isunguva umlou ahi.
target: If we claim we have not sinned, we make him out to be a liar and his word is not in us.

source: Kachateho, nachonset louna dinguva hicheng hi naheng uva kahinsut ahi. Chule khattou chonse jeng tajongle, Pa anga eihuva eisei champeh chonphatah Jesu Christa chu ineinaove.
target: My dear children, I write this to you so that you will not sin. But if anybody does sin, we have an advocate with the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.

source: Ama chu eiho chonset thoidamna ahi; eihoa ding jengseh hilouva, vannoi chonset jouse-a ding jong ahi.
target: He is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.

source: Chule eiho ama thu nit ihiule, hichu ama ihetaove ti hetna ahi.
target: We know that we have come to know him if we keep his commands.

source: Keiman ama chu kahetaila tia athupeh nit lou chu mijou ahin, asunga thutah umlou ahi.
target: Whoever says, “I know him,” but does not do what he commands is a liar, and the truth is not in that person.

source: Ama thu nit vang chu Pathen ngailutna chu asunga tahbeh-a chamkima ahitan: hichea kon chun ama-a um kahi ti iheuve.
target: But if anyone obeys his word, love for God is truly made complete in them. This is how we know we are in him:

source: Keima ama-a um kahi tia chu, ama chon bang banga ama jong chon ding dol ahi.
target: Whoever claims to live in him must live as Jesus did.

source: Sopiteho, keiman nangho henga thupeh thah kahinsut ahipoi, atil abula nanghon najahsao thupeh lui chu kahinsut joh ahibouve; atil abula kona najah-u chu hiche thupeh lui hi ahi.
target: Dear friends, I am not writing you a new command but an old one, which you have had since the beginning. This old command is the message you have heard.

source: Chule thupeh thah jong kahinsune, hiche hi ama-a chule nangho-a jong thutah ahi; ajeh chu muthim abeikon ahitai; khovah dihtah chu hung vah pan ahitai.
target: Yet I am writing you a new command; its truth is seen in him and in you, because the darkness is passing and the true light is already shining.

source: Keima khovah-a uma kahi tia asopi ho-a chu muthima umnalai ahi.
target: Anyone who claims to be in the light but hates a brother or sister is still in the darkness.

source: Asopi ngailu-a chu khovah-a uma ahi, ama sunga chu kipal lhuhna imacha umlou ahi.
target: Anyone who loves their brother and sister lives in the light, and there is nothing in them to make them stumble.

source: Asopi ho-a vang chu muthima uma ahin, muthima vahlea ahin, chule achena ding hoilam ahi ahepoi; ajeh chu muthim chun amitchohsah ahitai.
target: But anyone who hates a brother or sister is in the darkness and walks around in the darkness. They do not know where they are going, because the darkness has blinded them.

source: Kachateho, ama min vanga chu nachonset nao ngaidama uma ahitai; hiche jeh-a chu naheng uva kahinsut ahi.
target: I am writing to you, dear children, because your sins have been forgiven on account of his name.

source: Vo Pateho, nanghon atil abula patna anaumpa chu nahet jeh uva naheng uva kahinsut ahi. Khangdongho, nangho agilouva chu nanehjou jeh uva kahinsut ahi. Chapangho, nanghon Pa chu nahet tah jeh uva naheng uva kahinsut ahi.
target: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one.

source: Pateho, nanghon atil abula patna anaumpa chu nahet jeh uva naheng uva kahinsut ahi. Khangdongho, nangho athahat nahiuvin, nasunguva Pathen thu chu chenga ahin, chule nanghon agilou chu nanehjou tah jeh uva naheng uva kahinsut ahi.
target: I write to you, dear children, because you know the Father. I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God lives in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

source: Nanghon vannoi leiset le vannoi leiset lam dol thil chengse ngailu hihhelun. Koi hile vannoi leiset ngailu-a chu alung sunga Pa ngailutna cheng lou ahi.
target: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, love for the Father is not in them.

source: Ajeh chu vannoi'a umho jouse: tahsa lam ngaichat, mitvet deichat, hinkho kiletsah, hicheng hi Pa-a kona ahipoi, vannoi'a kona ahibouve.
target: For everything in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—comes not from the Father but from the world.

source: Vannoi leiset le athil ngaichat mangthah ding kon ahitai; ahin Pathen lung lama chonpa chu imatih chana umjing ding ahi.
target: The world and its desires pass away, but whoever does the will of God lives forever.

source: Chapangneoho, ni nunung lam ahitai; Christa dou hung dingkon ahitai tia kisei najah bangu chun, tutah jeng jong hin Christa dou tamtah asohdohtai; hichea kon hin ni nunung ahitai ti iheuve.
target: Dear children, this is the last hour; and as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have come. This is how we know it is the last hour.

source: Amaho chu eiho lah-a konin apotdoh taove, ahin eihotoh ikimatnao aumpoi; eihotoh kimatna neija hileu eiho koma umding ahiuve: ahinla eihotoh kimatna anei louvu chu kiphon dohna dinga, amaho chu potdoh ahitaove.
target: They went out from us, but they did not really belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us; but their going showed that none of them belonged to us.

source: Ahin nangho vang Athengpa thao nu chu nahiuvin, ijakai hesohkei nahiuve.
target: But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.

source: Nanghon thutah chu nahepouve tia naheng uva kahinsut ahipoi; thutah nahet jeh uva, thujou chu thutah-a kon ahipoi tina-a kahinsut joh ahi.
target: I do not write to you because you do not know the truth, but because you do know it and because no lie comes from the truth.

source: Chule Jesu chu Christa ahi ti janom louva seilep kalvala jou seija koiham? Pa le Chapa janom louva chu Christa dou ahi.
target: Who is the liar? It is whoever denies that Jesus is the Christ. Such a person is the antichrist—denying the Father and the Son.

source: Chapa jada-a chun Pa chu anei loulai ahi; Chapa janoma vang chun Pa jong chu anei ahitai.
target: No one who denies the Son has the Father; whoever acknowledges the Son has the Father also.

source: Atil abula nanghon thu najahsa chengseu chu nalung sunguvah chenghen. Atil abula patna nathu jahsa chengseu chu nalung sunguva achena ahile, nangho jong Pa leh Chapa-a chu um jinga nahi dingu ahi.
target: As for you, see that what you have heard from the beginning remains in you. If it does, you also will remain in the Son and in the Father.

source: Hichu amatah-in eiho eithu tepnao athutep tonsot hin kemlou chu ahi.
target: And this is what he promised us—eternal life.

source: Nangho nalhem lhaji hou thudola keiman hicheng hi kahinsut ahi.
target: I am writing these things to you about those who are trying to lead you astray.

source: Nangho vang ama-a kona thao nu nachanu chu nasunguva achengin; min nahil dingu nangai pouve: ahin hiche thaonu mama chun imalam jouse thudol, thujou hilouva thutah nahil jeh-u chun, aman nahil dungjuijun, nangho ama-ah umdet jingun.
target: As for you, the anointing you received from him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you about all things and as that anointing is real, not counterfeit—just as it has taught you, remain in him.

source: Chule tun, kachateho, ama ahung kilah teng kisonna ineijuva, chule ama ahung tengle amasanga ijachat louna dingun, ama-a um jingun.
target: And now, dear children, continue in him, so that when he appears we may be confident and unashamed before him at his coming.

source: Ama chonphatah ahi chu nahetnuva ahile, koi hile chonphatna lama chonpa chu ama-a kona pengdoh ahi ti naheuve.
target: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who does what is right has been born of him.

source: Veuvin, Pan eingailutjeu hi itobang hitam, Pathen chapate tia kikou dinga i-um jenguhi! hiche jeh-a chu vannoi'in eiho eihet louvu ahi, hichu ama ahetlou jeh-u ahi.
target: See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know him.

source: Ngaiteho, tun eiho Pathen chate ihiuve; chule ipi ihung hi dingu tun akiphongdoh hih laije. Ama ahung kilah tengle, eiho ama bangbang ihi dingu ahi ti chu eihon iheuve; ajeh chu ama aum bangbanga chu imu dingu ahi.
target: Dear friends, now we are children of God, and what we will be has not yet been made known. But we know that when Christ appears, we shall be like him, for we shall see him as he is.

source: Chule koi hile ama-a kinem chu ama athen banga ama jong chu kisuthenga ahi.
target: All who have this hope in him purify themselves, just as he is pure.

source: Koi hile achonsea chu danthu sukeh ahi; ajehchu danthu suhkeh chu chonset ahi.
target: Everyone who sins breaks the law; in fact, sin is lawlessness.

source: Chule chonset pomang dinga ama hung kilahdoh ahi ti nanghon naheuve; chule ama-a chu chonset beihel ahi.
target: But you know that he appeared so that he might take away our sins. And in him is no sin.

source: Koi hile ama-a uma chun chonset abolji poi: koi hile achonsejia chu ama mu loulai, chule he loulai ahi.
target: No one who lives in him keeps on sinning. No one who continues to sin has either seen him or known him.

source: Kachateho, koima dohan lha hihhelun; ama chonpha ahibanga koi hile chonphat bola chu chonpha ahi.
target: Dear children, do not let anyone lead you astray. The one who does what is right is righteous, just as he is righteous.

source: Chonset bola chu diabol'a ahi; ajeh chu diabol chun atil abula pat chonset abol ahi. Diabol natohho jouse sumang dinga Pathen Chapa hung kilah ahi.
target: The one who does what is sinful is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The reason the Son of God appeared was to destroy the devil’s work.

source: Koi hile Pathen'a kona penga chun chonset abolji poi, ajehchu amuchi asunga uma ahi: chujongle ama chu Pathen'a kona peng ahi jeh chun achonse thei poi.
target: No one who is born of God will continue to sin, because God’s seed remains in them; they cannot go on sinning, because they have been born of God.

source: Hichea kon hin Pathen chate le diabol chate akilangdoh jin ahi: koi hile chonphat bollou chu Pathen'a kon ahipon, chule asopi ngailulou jongchu Pathen'a kon ahipoi.
target: This is how we know who the children of God are and who the children of the devil are: Anyone who does not do what is right is not God’s child, nor is anyone who does not love their brother and sister.

source: Ajehchu atil abula nathu jahsao chu hiche hi ahi, Eiho khatle khat ikingailutto cheh dingdolu ahi;
target: For this is the message you heard from the beginning: We should love one another.

source: Agiloupa-a kon hungkondoh asopipa thatna Cain tobanga chu hilouvin. Ama chu ipi jeh-a athaham? Ama thilbol chengse aphalou jeng ahia, asopipa thilbol chengse chonphatna ahi jeh ahi.
target: Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did he murder him? Because his own actions were evil and his brother’s were righteous.

source: Sopiteho, vannoi'in nahot uva ahile hichu kidang sahih-un.
target: Do not be surprised, my brothers and sisters, if the world hates you.

source: Ijeh inem itile isopi teu ingailut jeh-uva thina-a kona hinna-a galkaija ihitaove ti iheuve. Asopi ngailu lou chu thina-a umjing nalai ahi.
target: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love each other. Anyone who does not love remains in death.

source: Koi hile asopi ho-a chu tolthat ahi; tolthat lungsunga tonsot hin kemlou achengpoi ti naheuve.
target: Anyone who hates a brother or sister is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life residing in him.

source: Aman eiho dinga ahinna apeh jenga kona hi eihon Pathen ngailutna ihetnu ahi; chule eihon jong isopiho dinga ihinnao ipeh dingdolu ahi.
target: This is how we know what love is: Jesus Christ laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers and sisters.

source: Ahin mi khattou leiset thilin ninglhing hen, ama chun asopi lhahsam muhen, khoto louvin umle, ama lung sunga chu Pathen ngailutna iti umding ham?
target: If anyone has material possessions and sees a brother or sister in need but has no pity on them, how can the love of God be in that person?

source: Kachateho, khaije, eihon thu jengle kamsung keo jenga hilouvin, natohle thutah-in ngailu uhite.
target: Dear children, let us not love with words or speech but with actions and in truth.

source: Hichea kona chu eiho thutah-a kon iheu ihet dingu ahin, chujongle ama angsunga ilungu kinem jinga umding ahi.
target: This is how we know that we belong to the truth and how we set our hearts at rest in his presence:

source: Ajeh chu ilungun eiho eithemmo sah uva ahi jongle, Pathen chu eiho lung sanga chungnungjo ahin, chule ijakai ahesoh-in ahi.
target: If our hearts condemn us, we know that God is greater than our hearts, and he knows everything.

source: Ngaiteho, ilungun eiho eithemmosah lou uva ahile, eihon Pathen lama lung ngamna ineiju ahi.
target: Dear friends, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God

source: Chule eihon athupeh initnuva, amitmua alung deilam jeng ibol jeh uve, ipi hijongle ithumu chu ama-a kona imu-u ahi.
target: and receive from him anything we ask, because we keep his commands and do what pleases him.

source: Athupeh chu hiche hi ahi, eiho Achapa Jesu Christa min itahsan uva, chule aman eiho eithupeh banguva khatle khat ikingailut dingu hi ahi.
target: And this is his command: to believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and to love one another as he commanded us.

source: Chule koi hile ama thupeh nit chu ama-a uma, chule ama jong ama-a chu uma ahi. Chule aman eipeh-u Lhagaova chun ama eiho-a aume ti iheuve.
target: The one who keeps God’s commands lives in him, and he in them. And this is how we know that he lives in us: We know it by the Spirit he gave us.

source: Ngaiteho, nanghon lhagao tapou tahsan hih-un; ahin amaho chu Pathen'a kon ahi ahilou hettohna dingin, lhagaoho chu kholtoh-in patep jiuvin; ajeh chu vannoi leiset chungah themgao lhem tamtah asohdoh tan ahi.
target: Dear friends, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

source: Hichea hi nanghon Pathen Lhagao chu nahet dingu ahi; Jesu Christa chu tahsa-a hunga ahi ti janoma lhagao chu Pathen'a kon ahi:
target: This is how you can recognize the Spirit of God: Every spirit that acknowledges that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,

source: Chule Jesu chu tahsa-a hunga ahi ti janomlou jouse chu Pathen'a kon hilou ahi: hichu hungding ahi tia najahsao Christa dou lhagao ahi; chule tu-a jonghi vannoi'a uma ahitai.
target: but every spirit that does not acknowledge Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and even now is already in the world.

source: Kachateho, nangho Pathen'a kon nahiu ahin, chule hitiho chu nanehjouvu ahitai; ajeh chu nangho-a umpa chu vannoi'a umpa sanga chungnungjo ahi.
target: You, dear children, are from God and have overcome them, because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.

source: Amaho chu vannoi'a kon ahiuve: hijeh-a chu vannoi thu aseiju ahin, chule vannoi'in amaho thu chu angaiju ahi.
target: They are from the world and therefore speak from the viewpoint of the world, and the world listens to them.

source: Eiho Pathen'a kon ihiuve: Pathen he-a chun eiho thu angai ahi; Pathen'a kon hilou chun eiho thu angailou ahi. Hichea konahi eihon lhagao dihle lhagao dihlou ihet khen theiju ahi.
target: We are from God, and whoever knows God listens to us; but whoever is not from God does not listen to us. This is how we recognize the Spirit of truth and the spirit of falsehood.

source: Ngaiteho, eiho khatle khat kingailutou hite: ijeh inem itile ngailut chu Pathen'a kon ahi; koi hile ngailutna neichan chu Pathen'a kona peng ahin, chule Pathen ahet ahi.
target: Dear friends, let us love one another, for love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

source: Ngailutna neilou chun Pathen ahetlou ahi; ajeh iham itile Pathen chu ngailut ahi.
target: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.

source: Hichea konahi Pathen mingailut eihoa kiphonga ahi, ama vanga eiho ihin theina dinguva, Pathen'in Achapa changkhat chu vannoi'a ahinsol ahi.
target: This is how God showed his love among us: He sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him.

source: Hichea hi ngailut uma ahi, eihon Pathen chu ingailutnu ahipon, ama joh-in eingailut uva, chule Achapa chu eiho chonset thoidamna dinga ahinsol ahi.
target: This is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as an atoning sacrifice for our sins.

source: Ngaiteho, Pathen'in chutia chu eingailut uva ahile, eiho jong khatle khat ikingailut ding dolu ahi.
target: Dear friends, since God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

source: Pathen chu koiman imatih chanin amukhapoi. Eiho khatle khat ikingailut touva ahile, Pathen eihoa uma ahin, chule angailutna chu eihoa chamkima ahi.
target: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God lives in us and his love is made complete in us.

source: Hichea kona hi eihon eiho ama-a um ihiu, chule ama eihoa um ahi chu ihetnu ahi; Aman ama Lhagao eipeh tah jeh-u chun.
target: This is how we know that we live in him and he in us: He has given us of his Spirit.

source: Chule Pa chun Chapa chu vannoi huhhing-a ahinsol ahi ti keihon kamuva kahettoh sah-u ahi.
target: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent his Son to be the Savior of the world.

source: Koi hijongle Jesu chu Pathen Chapa ahi ti phongdoh-a chu, Pathen ama-a chu uma, ama Pathen'a uma ahi.
target: If anyone acknowledges that Jesus is the Son of God, God lives in them and they in God.

source: Pathen'in eiho-a ngailutna anei hi eihon ihetnuva chule itahsanu ahitai. Pathen chu ngailut ahi; chule ngailutna-a uma chu Pathen'a uma ahin, chule Pathen ama-a chu uma ahi.
target: And so we know and rely on the love God has for us. God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in them.

source: Thupi tan nile eiho ihakat theina dinguva, hichea kona hi ingailutnao kisuchamkim ahi: ajeh chu ama um banga, eiho hiche vannoi'a hi i-umu ahi.
target: This is how love is made complete among us so that we will have confidence on the day of judgment: In this world we are like Jesus.

source: Ngailutna-a kichatna aumpoi; amavang ngailut chamkim chun kichat anodohjin ahi: ajehchu kichatna chun talen matding anei ahi. Akicha-a chu ngailutna-a chamkim lou ahi.
target: There is no fear in love. But perfect love drives out fear, because fear has to do with punishment. The one who fears is not made perfect in love.

source: Aman eingailut masah jeh uva eihon ama ingailutnu ahi.
target: We love because he first loved us.

source: Khattouvin, Keiman Pathen kangailui tihen asopi hotale, ama chu mijou ahi: ajeh chu amusa jing asopi bon ngailu lou chun, amukhah louhel Pathen chu iti angailut dingham?
target: Whoever claims to love God yet hates a brother or sister is a liar. For whoever does not love their brother and sister, whom they have seen, cannot love God, whom they have not seen.

source: Chule hiche thupeh hi ama-a kona ineiju ahi, Pathen ngailu-a chun asopi jong ngailuhen.
target: And he has given us this command: Anyone who loves God must also love their brother and sister.

source: Koi hile Jesu chu Christa ahi tia tahsan chu Pathen'a kona penga ahi; chule koi hile ahinga ngailu-a chun ahin jong chu angailut ahi.
target: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God, and everyone who loves the father loves his child as well.

source: Eihon Pathen ingailut uva, athupeh init tengule, hichea kona hi Pathen chate ingailutnu ihet dingu ahi.
target: This is how we know that we love the children of God: by loving God and carrying out his commands.

source: Ijeh inem itile athupeh initnu chu Pathen ingailutnao ahi; chule athupeh chengse jong chu pohgihsa ahipoi.
target: In fact, this is love for God: to keep his commands. And his commands are not burdensome,

source: Ajeh chu koi hile Pathen'a kona penga chun vannoi hi ajo ahitai. Chule vannoi jouva chu itahsanu hi ahi.
target: for everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.

source: Jesu chu Pathen Chapa ahi tia tahsan kala vannoi jouva koiham?
target: Who is it that overcomes the world? Only the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.

source: Twisih le thisana hunga chu Jesu Christa tahchu ahi; twi sehseh hilouva, twisih le thisana kon ahi. Chule Lhagao chu hettohsah ahi; ajeh iham itile Lhagao chu thutah ahi.
target: This is the one who came by water and blood—Jesus Christ. He did not come by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

source: Ajeh chu van'a ahettohsah thum aumin ahi, Pa, Thu, chule Lhagao Theng: chule hicheng thum chu pumkhat ahi.
target: For there are three that testify:

source: Chule leisetna ahettohsah thum aumin ahi, Lhagao, twisih, chule thisan: chule hicheng thum chu khatna akitoh-un ahi.
target: the Spirit, the water and the blood; and the three are in agreement.

source: Eihon mihemte thu hettohsah ilah uva ahile, Pathen hettohsah chu chusanga chungnungjo ahi; Aman Achapa thudol chu ahettohsah chu Pathen thu hettohsah ahi.
target: We accept human testimony, but God’s testimony is greater because it is the testimony of God, which he has given about his Son.

source: Pathen Chapa tahsana chu alung sunga hiche hettohsahna chu chenga ahi: Pathen tahsan loupa chun ama chu ajousah ahitai; ajeh iham itile aman Pathen'in Achapa thudol ahettohsah chu atahsanpoi.
target: Whoever believes in the Son of God accepts this testimony. Whoever does not believe God has made him out to be a liar, because they have not believed the testimony God has given about his Son.

source: Chule hiche hettohsahna chu hiche ahi, Pathen'in eiho hin kemlou eipetaove, chule hiche hinna chu Achapa-a um ahi.
target: And this is the testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

source: Chapa neija chun hinna anei ahitai; chule Pathen Chapa nei lou chun hinna anei lou ahi.
target: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.

source: Nanghon hin kemlou naneiju nahet nadingule, Pathen chapa mina natahsan theina dinguva, thu hicheng hi Pathen Chapa mina tahsan nangho henga kahinsut ahi.
target: I write these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God so that you may know that you have eternal life.

source: Chule ama-a kisonna ineiju chu hiche hi ahi, ipi ipi hijongle ama lung deilam dola ithumuva ahile, aman eingaipeh jiuvin ahi.
target: This is the confidence we have in approaching God: that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us.

source: Chule eihon ithum chanu eingaipeh jiuve ti ihetnuva ahile, eihon ama henga ingaichatnu chu imu-u ahitai ti iheuve.
target: And if we know that he hears us—whatever we ask—we know that we have what we asked of him.

source: Mi khattouvin asopi chonsea amua achonset chu thina khop chonset ahi louva ahile, ama chun thumhen, chutile aman thina khop hilouva chonseho chu hinna apeh ding ahi. Thina khop chonset aume; hiche chu thumhen tia kasei ahipoi.
target: If you see any brother or sister commit a sin that does not lead to death, you should pray and God will give them life. I refer to those whose sin does not lead to death. There is a sin that leads to death. I am not saying that you should pray about that.

source: Chonphat louna jouse chu chonset ahi: chule thina khop hilou chonset aume.
target: All wrongdoing is sin, and there is sin that does not lead to death.

source: Koi hile Pathen'a kona penga chu achonseji poi ti iheuve; ahin Pathen'a kona penga chu ama akihongdohjin, chule agilou chun atongkhajipoi.
target: We know that anyone born of God does not continue to sin; the One who was born of God keeps them safe, and the evil one cannot harm them.

source: Eiho Pathen'a kon ihiu le, vannoi pumpi hi gitlouna-a uma ahi ti iheuve.
target: We know that we are children of God, and that the whole world is under the control of the evil one.

source: Chule Pathen Chapa chu ahungin, hiche adihtah pa chu ihet theina dingun lungthim eihung petaovin, chule eiho adihtah pa, Achapa Jesu Christa-a chun i-umuve ti iheuve. Ama chu Pathen dihtah le tonsot hinna ahi.
target: We know also that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know him who is true. And we are in him who is true by being in his Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.

source: Kachateho, milimho lah-a konin kihong phaovin. Amen.
target: Dear children, keep yourselves from idols.

source: Upa keiman thutah-a kangailut numei kilhengnule achateho; keima changseh hilouva, thutah heho chengse jong;
target: The elder, To the lady chosen by God and to her children, whom I love in the truth—and not I only, but also all who know the truth—

source: Eiho sunga uma, chule eiho toh tonsot geija umjing ding thutah jala chu.
target: because of the truth, which lives in us and will be with us forever:

source: Pa Pathen le Pa Chapa Pakai Jesu Christa-a konin lungsetna, hepina, chule lungmona chun, thutah le ngailutna-in naumpi jing taohen.
target: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Father’s Son, will be with us in truth and love.

source: Pa-a kona eihon imu-u thupeh bangtah-a, nachateho lah-a kimkhat thutah-a achonu kamun kakipah tangei jenge.
target: It has given me great joy to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father commanded us.

source: Chule tu-a hi, numei pha, keiman nahenga thupeh thah hinsun tobang hilouva, atil abula ineisao, khatle khat ikingailut tocheh dinguva nahenga kahung tao ahi.
target: And now, dear lady, I am not writing you a new command but one we have had from the beginning. I ask that we love one another.

source: Chule hiche hi ngailut ahi, eiho athupeh dungjuija ichon dingu ahi. Chule hiche hi thupeh ahi, nangho atil abula najahsao banga chu, hichea chu nachon dingu ahi.
target: And this is love: that we walk in obedience to his commands. As you have heard from the beginning, his command is that you walk in love.

source: Ajehchu Jesu Christa chu tahsa-a hunga ahi ti janomlou vannoi'a hin doha milhem lha-a tamtah ahung sohdoh tai. Hiche hi milhem lha-a le Christa dou chu ahi.
target: I say this because many deceivers, who do not acknowledge Jesus Christ as coming in the flesh, have gone out into the world. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.

source: Iboldohsa chengseu chu mansah louhela tohphat man isan bukimna dingun, kive phaovin.
target: Watch out that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be rewarded fully.

source: Koi hile dan palkeh-a le Christa thuhila um louva chun Pathen aneilou ahi. Christa thuhila uma vang chun Pa le Chapa chu ania aneikop ahi.
target: Anyone who runs ahead and does not continue in the teaching of Christ does not have God; whoever continues in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

source: Koi hile hiche thuhil hinpolouva naheng uva hunga aumle, amachu na-in uvah lhunsah hih-un, chule kamphan jong lem hih-un:
target: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not take them into your house or welcome them.

source: Ajeh chu koi hile kampha-a lema chun achon gitlou ho jouse achan khompi ahi.
target: Anyone who welcomes them shares in their wicked work.

source: Naheng uva hinsut ding thu tamtah kaneije, ahivangin lekhapheng le lekha twija sut kanompoi; ahin ikipanao achamkim theina dingin, naheng uva hunging ting kimaiton kihoulim naohite ti kakineme.
target: I have much to write to you, but I do not want to use paper and ink. Instead, I hope to visit you and talk with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.

source: Nalhen tumtah nasopinu chaten salam napeuve. Amen.
target: The children of your sister, who is chosen by God, send their greetings.

source: Upa keiman thutah-a kangailut, kangai Gaius hengah.
target: The elder, To my dear friend Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

source: Ngai, thildang jouse sangin, nalhagao akhantou banga nakhantouva chule nadam nadingin kataovin ahi.
target: Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well.

source: Sopiteho ahunguva nanga um thutah ahung hettohsah-u chun nasatah-in kakipah-in ahi.
target: It gave me great joy when some believers came and testified about your faithfulness to the truth, telling how you continue to walk in it.

source: Kachate thutah-a achon thu kajah-a kakipa sanga chungnungjo kakipana dang aumpoi.
target: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.

source: Ngai, nangman sopiho le hetphahlou maljin chunga nabol jouse chu kitah tah-in nabolin ahi;
target: Dear friend, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers and sisters, even though they are strangers to you.

source: Amahon nangma ngailutna thudol chu houbung-ah ahetsah-un ahi. Nangman amaho chu akholjin naova Pathen'a doltah-a nanathah ji-a ahile, nabol phat lheh ding ahi.
target: They have told the church about your love. Please send them on their way in a manner that honors God.

source: Ijeh-inem itile amaho chidang namdang ho-a kona imacha kilah louva, ama min jala chu kalsongdoh ahiuve.
target: It was for the sake of the Name that they went out, receiving no help from the pagans.

source: Hijeh-a chu thutah-a dinga kithopi ho ihi theina dinguva, hiteho tobang mi chu eihotah-in ilhunsah dingu thu ahi.
target: We ought therefore to show hospitality to such people so that we may work together for the truth.

source: Keiman houbung henga kahin sutsa ahitai: ahinla alah uva piput ngailu-a Diotrephes chun kaseiju alapon ahi.
target: I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will not welcome us.

source: Hiche jeh-a chu keima kahunga ahile, thu gilou tamtah kachunguva aseija eiseisetnao athilbol achonna chengse kageldohsah ding ahi: chua jong chu lunglhai loulaijin, sopiho chu amanla alhunsahpon, lhunsah dinga goho jong ajahdan, houbung'a konin anodoh jengin ahi.
target: So when I come, I will call attention to what he is doing, spreading malicious nonsense about us. Not satisfied with that, he even refuses to welcome other believers. He also stops those who want to do so and puts them out of the church.

source: Ngai, nangma vangin ase chu jom louvin, apha chu jomin. Apha bola chu Pathen'a kon ahi; ase bola vang chun Pathen amu loulai ahi.
target: Dear friend, do not imitate what is evil but what is good. Anyone who does what is good is from God. Anyone who does what is evil has not seen God.

source: Demetrius chu mijousen aseiphan, thutah-a konin hettohsahna pha achangin, henge, keihon jong kahettohsah uvin; chule keiho hettohsah chu thutah ahi ti nangman nahei.
target: Demetrius is well spoken of by everyone—and even by the truth itself. We also speak well of him, and you know that our testimony is true.

source: Nangma henga hinsut ding thil tamtah kaneije, ahinla lekha twi le lekha mola hinsut ding kanompoi:
target: I have much to write you, but I do not want to do so with pen and ink.

source: Ahin chomkhat joule nangma kamua chule kimaito-a ikihoulim ding kakineme.
target: I hope to see you soon, and we will talk face to face.

source: Nachungah lungmon umhen. Golle paihon nasalamui. Golle paiho chu amin cheh phan salam'in.
target: Peace to you. The friends here send their greetings. Greet the friends there by name.

source: Jesu Christa soh, Jacob naopa Juda'n, Pa Pathen suhtheng chang teho chengse, chule Jesu Christa-a kikheh le kikouho chengse hengah,
target: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James, To those who have been called, who are loved in God the Father and kept for Jesus Christ:

source: Hepina, chamna, chule ngailutna nachung uva hapunin punghen.
target: Mercy, peace and love be yours in abundance.

source: Ngaiteho, lhangpi huhhingna thudola naheng uva lekha hinsut kagot laijin, masanga mithengho anakipedohsa tahsan lama chu ponpan dinga nangho tilkhou na-a naheng uva hinsut ding khoh kasatan ahi.
target: Dear friends, although I was very eager to write to you about the salvation we share, I felt compelled to write and urge you to contend for the faith that was once for all entrusted to God’s holy people.

source: Ajeh chu mi koi koiham guhthima hung kithol lut aumui; amaho chu hiche themona hi chang dingdol ahiuve tia masanga patna gotsa, Pathen ngaisah lou, i-Pathen'u milungset chu huhna lama sodoh ho, Pakai Pathen khatseh leh I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa janomlou ahiuve.
target: For certain individuals whose condemnation was written about long ago have secretly slipped in among you. They are ungodly people, who pervert the grace of our God into a license for immorality and deny Jesus Christ our only Sovereign and Lord.

source: Pakaiyin Egypt gama kona amite ahuhdoh-a, chuche nunga atahsan louho asuhmang jeng thudol hi khatvei nahetsao hita jongle kahin geldohsah kit nomui.
target: Though you already know all this, I want to remind you that the Lord at one time delivered his people out of Egypt, but later destroyed those who did not believe.

source: Chule achanvou masa-u kolchah louva achennao dalha-a vantil ho chu, aman niloupi chungnung ni-a athu tan dinga tonsot muthim noija henna-a ahen ahi.
target: And the angels who did not keep their positions of authority but abandoned their proper dwelling—these he has kept in darkness, bound with everlasting chains for judgment on the great Day.

source: Sodom le Gomorrah, chule akimvela amaho tobang khopiho chengse, huhle jon thanhoi patna lama kipumpeh-a, chule tahsa lamdanna nung juiho chun vetton dinga phulahna tonsot meisa athohgim bangu chun.
target: In a similar way, Sodom and Gomorrah and the surrounding towns gave themselves up to sexual immorality and perversion. They serve as an example of those who suffer the punishment of eternal fire.

source: Chutobangma chun hiche mang kidah um manho jonghin tahsaphe asuboh-un, thuneina nahsahmon abolun, loupinaho chu aseiseuvin ahi.
target: In the very same way, on the strength of their dreams these ungodly people pollute their own bodies, reject authority and heap abuse on celestial beings.

source: Ahinla Mosi long chungchang thudola vantil pipuipen Michael diabol toh akinel chun, oimo-a houset ding angampon, ahin, Pakaiyin nahouse hen, atin ahi.
target: But even the archangel Michael, when he was disputing with the devil about the body of Moses, did not himself dare to condemn him for slander but said, “The Lord rebuke you!”

source: Hinla hiteho vang hin ahettoh louhelu aseiseuvin ahi: ahin lungthim neilou gamsaho bangin, angaija ahetsao hitiho-a chun amaho le amaho akisuboh-un ahi.
target: Yet these people slander whatever they do not understand, and the very things they do understand by instinct—as irrational animals do—will destroy them.

source: Amaho chu ada ahiuve! ajeh iham itile amahon Cain lampi chu ahovin, kipaman duchatnan Baalam lamvaina lama loptah-in alhaijun, chule Korah golkehna-a chu amangthah taovin ahi.
target: Woe to them! They have taken the way of Cain; they have rushed for profit into Balaam’s error; they have been destroyed in Korah’s rebellion.

source: Amaho chu nangho toh an naneh khom komu le nakidei vahnauva chu twi noija kisel songpi ahiuvin, kichatna neilou ama kivah kelngoi ching ahiuve; amaho twi ko lou meilhang, hui mut lonle; chavang kichai kona thingphung ga lou, nivei thi, ajunga kibotdoh ahiuve;
target: These people are blemishes at your love feasts, eating with you without the slightest qualm—shepherds who feed only themselves. They are clouds without rain, blown along by the wind; autumn trees, without fruit and uprooted—twice dead.

source: Twikhanglen kinong, ajachatnau twiphon sodoh; ahsi vahle ho ahiuvin, amaho dinga chu muthim lhangkhal tonsot geija dinga kikheh ahi.
target: They are wild waves of the sea, foaming up their shame; wandering stars, for whom blackest darkness has been reserved forever.

source: Chule Adam'a pat khang sagina Enoch jong chun hiteho chungchang thudola hi gaothu anaseidoh-in, Veuvin, Pakai chu amitheng sangsom sangja toh,
target: Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied about them: “See, the Lord is coming with thousands upon thousands of his holy ones

source: Mijouse chunga thutan dingle, alah uva Pathen ngaisah louho jousen Pathen angaisah lounao thudola a-Pathen ngaisah louna thilbolu, chule Pathen ngaisah lou chonse hon ama chunga thu hamtahtah aseiju chungchanga themmo chan dingin ahunge, ati.
target: to judge everyone, and to convict all of them of all the ungodly acts they have committed in their ungodliness, and of all the defiant words ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”

source: Amaho chu phunchel hat, oimo-a seiset hat, ama lung ngaichat lam cheh-a chona ahiuve; chule akam sungun hamhoitho thu aseijun, phatchom ngainan kam sungin mi ajabolun ahi.
target: These people are grumblers and faultfinders; they follow their own evil desires; they boast about themselves and flatter others for their own advantage.

source: Ahin, ngaiteho, masanga Pakai Jesu Christa solchah hon aseisao thuho chengse chu nanghon geldoh jingun;
target: But, dear friends, remember what the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ foretold.

source: Amahon, Ni nunung lamle mi nuisat nelpeh hat, Pathen ngaisah louva ama ama lung ngaichat dungjui cheh-a chonteho hung umdoh dingu ahi, tia asei bangu chun:
target: They said to you, “In the last times there will be scoffers who will follow their own ungodly desires.”

source: Amaho chu loitum sem, tahsahing, Lhagao neilou ahiuve.
target: These are the people who divide you, who follow mere natural instincts and do not have the Spirit.

source: Ahin, ngaiteho, nangho vang natahsanu theng chungnung chunga chun nangmaho kisadoh-un, Lhagao Thengah tao taovun,
target: But you, dear friends, by building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit,

source: Pathen ngailutna-a chun kihongun, chule tonsot hin kemlouna dingin I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa mihepina-a kinemin kat jingin umun.
target: keep yourselves in God’s love as you wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you to eternal life.

source: Chule mi abang agingchalela chu hepiuvin,
target: Be merciful to those who doubt;

source: Abang meija konin loidoh-un; tahsaphen asuboh nihchen ponsil sana thetbol pumin, kicha gehchan huhhingun.
target: save others by snatching them from the fire; to others show mercy, mixed with fear—hating even the clothing stained by corrupted flesh.

source: Tun nakipal lhuh louna dinguva nangho hongbit theile, ama loupina ang sunga themona beihela kipahtah-a lhut theija,
