target: To him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you before his glorious presence without fault and with great joy—

source: Eihuhhing pau Pathen ching khatseh henga chun, loupina, chungnunna, thahat thuneina, tu le atonsot geijin umjing tahen. Amen.
target: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, power and authority, through Jesus Christ our Lord, before all ages, now and forevermore! Amen.

source: Jesu Christa thuphondoh, Pathen'in asohte hetsah dinga apeh, thil hung sohvah dingho chu; aman avantil asola asoh John ahetsah ahi.
target: The revelation from Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show his servants what must soon take place. He made it known by sending his angel to his servant John,

source: Ama chu Pathen thudol le Jesu Christa hettohsah thudola athil muho jouse thu umchan chu ahettohsah ahi.
target: who testifies to everything he saw—that is, the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

source: Hiche lhagao thuseidoh ho sima, chule ja-a, chule asunga kisun thuho chengse nitna chu anunnoma ahi; phat anai jeh hin.
target: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear it and take to heart what is written in it, because the time is near.

source: John'in Asia gama um houbung sagiho hengah: Auma, Aumsa, chule Ahung umdinga konin; chule alal touna anga kona Lhagao sagi-a konin; chule athiho lah-a kona peng masapen, leiset lengho jouse vaipo;
target: John, To the seven churches in the province of Asia: Grace and peace to you from him who is, and who was, and who is to come, and from the seven spirits before his throne,

source: athu hettohsah ginchat umtah Jesu Christa-a kon chun lungsetle lungmonin umpiuvin. Eiho eingailua athisana ichonset chengseova kona eisoptheng uva,
target: and from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us and has freed us from our sins by his blood,

source: chule avaipohna gammi le a-Pathen le a-Pa thempu-a eisemuva chu, loupinale vaipoh thuneina atonsot atonsot geijin ama-a hi jinghen, Amen.
target: and has made us to be a kingdom and priests to serve his God and Father—to him be glory and power for ever and ever! Amen.

source: Veuvin, ama meihotoh kilhonin ahunge; chule mit jousen, asunhotah jong chun amu dingu ahi; chule leiset namtinle phungtin-in a-op achupchup dingu ahi. Chuti chu ahi, Amen.
target: “Look, he is coming with the clouds,” and “every eye will see him, even those who pierced him”; and all peoples on earth “will mourn because of him.” So shall it be! Amen.

source: Auma, Aumsa, chule Ahung umdinga, Hat chungnung Pakai chun, Keima Alpha le Omega, apatna le achaina kahi, ati.
target: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is, and who was, and who is to come, the Almighty.”

source: Jesu'a um thohhatle leng gam chule hesoh genthei nathoh khompiu nasopiu, John, keima Pathen thule Jesu Christa thu hettohsah jeh-a Patmos twi twikol'a chu um kanahi.
target: I, John, your brother and companion in the suffering and kingdom and patient endurance that are ours in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.

source: Pakai nikho ni-a chu keima Lhagaova kaum ahi; chule sumkon gin tobang awgin nasatah khat kanung lama kajan,
target: On the Lord’s Day I was in the Spirit, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,

source: Keima Alpha le Omega, amasa le anunung, kahi: Nathil mu chengse lekhabu-ah sunin lang, hichu Asia sunga um houbung sagi-a: Ephesia, Smyrna, Pergamos, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia chule Laodicea-a gahthotnin, ati.
target: which said: “Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia and Laodicea.”

source: Chuin kajah-a thuseija aw chu ve dingin, keima kakiheijin ahi. Chuin kakiheitan ahile, sana meivah khom sagi kamui;
target: I turned around to see the voice that was speaking to me. And when I turned I saw seven golden lampstands,

source: chule meivah khomho lah-a chun khat mihem chapa tobang, aponsil akhophanga lenglha, sana konggah a-opkonga kigah;
target: and among the lampstands was someone like a son of man, dressed in a robe reaching down to his feet and with a golden sash around his chest.

source: aluchangle asam kelngoi mul banna banga, buhbang tobang ahin; amit meikong tobang ahi;
target: The hair on his head was white like wool, as white as snow, and his eyes were like blazing fire.

source: akengho chu lhum sunga kigoujol sum-eng kinotval tobang jeng, chule a-awgin chu twi tamtah gin tobang jeng ahi.
target: His feet were like bronze glowing in a furnace, and his voice was like the sound of rushing waters.

source: Chule akhut jet lama ahsi sagi achoijin, akam sunga konin hemto chemjam ahema hem ni ahungdoh-in ahi; chule ama melso chu nisa hasattah-a asat pettoh abangin ahi.
target: In his right hand he held seven stars, and coming out of his mouth was a sharp, double-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining in all its brilliance.

source: Chuin ama kamu phat chun keima athitoh kabang jengin akhophang bulah kalhu jengin ahi. Hichun aman akhut jet lamin eithamin, kajah-a, Kicha hih-in; keima hi amasale anukhah kahi, ati.
target: When I saw him, I fell at his feet as though dead. Then he placed his right hand on me and said: “Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last.

source: Chule ahing jinga chu kahi; keima athisa kahi; ahinla, ven, a-imatih chana dingin kahinge, amen; chule thinale damun kot-heh kaneije.
target: I am the Living One; I was dead, and now look, I am alive for ever and ever! And I hold the keys of death and Hades.

source: Hijeh chun nathilmu chengsele aum chengse chule ahung umding chengse abonchan sunin;
target: “Write, therefore, what you have seen, what is now and what will take place later.

source: kakhut jetna ahsi sagi namuho chule sana meivah khom thuguh hi sunin. Ahsi sagi chu houbung sagi solchah ahin, meivah khom sagi chu houbung sagi ahi, ati.
target: The mystery of the seven stars that you saw in my right hand and of the seven golden lampstands is this: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.

source: Ephesia'a um houbung solchah hengah hiti hin sunin: Akhut jet lama ahsi sagi choija sana meivah khomho lah-a vahlea chun hitin aseije:
target: “To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These are the words of him who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands.

source: Keiman nanatoh ho jouse, chule nathohgimle nathohhat chu kahei; chule, Solchah kahi, tia solchahla hilou, amaho jong chu napatep-in, nakholjin ajou namandoh jengin ahi;
target: I know your deeds, your hard work and your perseverance. I know that you cannot tolerate wicked people, that you have tested those who claim to be apostles but are not, and have found them false.

source: chule thohhat tah-a kamin jala thoh thoh-a lhadah lou nahi.
target: You have persevered and have endured hardships for my name, and have not grown weary.

source: Ahivangin nachunga demna kaneije: nangman nangailut masa chu nalhatai.
target: Yet I hold this against you: You have forsaken the love you had at first.

source: Hiche jeh chun nangma hoija kona nalhuh ham; hichu geldoh-in, chule nalung heijin, nanatoh masah ho chu tongin; achuti louva nalung nahei loule, nahenga gangtah-a kahunga nameivah khom chu aumna-a kona kachon mang ding ahi.
target: Consider how far you have fallen! Repent and do the things you did at first. If you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.

source: Ahinla Nicolaitan ho chon keiman kahot chu, hicheho chu nangman jong nahon ahi, hiche phatna chu naneije.
target: But you have this in your favor: You hate the practices of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

source: Nakhang nei chanin houbung ho jah-a Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen. Ajouva chu keiman Pathen ollim daija um hin thingga kanehsah ding ahi.
target: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who is victorious, I will give the right to eat from the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God.

source: Chule Smyrna-a um houbung solchah hengah hitin sunin: Amasale anukhah, thitasa hing kit chun hitin aseije:
target: “To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of him who is the First and the Last, who died and came to life again.

source: Keiman na natoh nagenthei, nahesoh chule navaichat kahenai (ahin nangma nahaonai), Juda mi kahi, tia Juda mi hilou, Satan vaipi kikhopnajoh ahiuva, hou thu ataitomu jong chu kahenai.
target: I know your afflictions and your poverty—yet you are rich! I know about the slander of those who say they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

source: Thil nahinthoh dingho hi kicha hihhelin; ven, napatep na-a nalah uva mi abang bang chu diabolin songkul'a akhum ding koncha ahi; chule hesoh genthei ni som nathoh dingu ahi. Nangman nathi geijin tahsanin; chule keiman nangma hinna lallukhuh kapeh ding ahi.
target: Do not be afraid of what you are about to suffer. I tell you, the devil will put some of you in prison to test you, and you will suffer persecution for ten days. Be faithful, even to the point of death, and I will give you life as your victor’s crown.

source: Nakhang nei chanin houbung ho jah-a Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen. Ajouva chu thi nina chun asuhnat lou ding ahi.
target: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who is victorious will not be hurt at all by the second death.

source: Chule Pergamos'a um houbung solchah henga hitin sunin: Hemto chemjam ahema hem nei Pan thu hicheng hi aseije:
target: “To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These are the words of him who has the sharp, double-edged sword.

source: Nangma na natoh chule hoi laija cheng nahi kahenai, Satan laltouna muntah chu ahi; chule nangman kamin natuh det jinga, chule Satan chenna nangho lah-a ginchat umtah, kathu hettohsah Antipas, atha laiju sana jong keima tahsana seilep lou nahi.
target: I know where you live—where Satan has his throne. Yet you remain true to my name. You did not renounce your faith in me, not even in the days of Antipas, my faithful witness, who was put to death in your city—where Satan lives.

source: Ahivangin nachunga demna thil themkhat kaneije, ajeh chu Israel chate masanga kipal lhuhna koija, milim houna sa nehsah dingle jonsahna dinga, Baalak lungthim pe-a hila, Baalam thuhil choija hikoma chun naneijui.
target: Nevertheless, I have a few things against you: There are some among you who hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to entice the Israelites to sin so that they ate food sacrificed to idols and committed sexual immorality.

source: Chutobangma chun kathil ki-dah pen Nicolaitan ho thuhil choija jong naneijui.
target: Likewise, you also have those who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

source: Hijeh chun nalung heijin; achuti loule nahenga gangtah-a hung ding kahi; chule kakam sung chamjama amaho chu gala kasat ding ahi.
target: Repent therefore! Otherwise, I will soon come to you and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.

source: Nakhang nei chanin houbung ho jah-a Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen. Ajouva chu guhthim manna kapeh ding ahi; chule songkang khat jong kapeh ding; hiche songa chu min thah khat kisuna ahi; asangpa tailou koimacha dangin hiche min chu ahepoi.
target: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who is victorious, I will give some of the hidden manna. I will also give that person a white stone with a new name written on it, known only to the one who receives it.

source: Thyatira-a um houbung solchah hengah hitin sunin: Amit meikong tobanga, akhophang sum-eng kinotval bangah Pathen Chapa chun hitin aseije:
target: “To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like blazing fire and whose feet are like burnished bronze.

source: Nathilbol jousele, nangailut chule natahsanje, chule nalhacha natoh hole, nathoh hatje, chule nathilbol masah sanga nathilbol nunung anasatjoh chu kahenai.
target: I know your deeds, your love and faith, your service and perseverance, and that you are now doing more than you did at first.

source: Ahivangin nachungah demna kaneije, nangman Jezebel kithemgaosahnu chu navethim in naum sah-in ahi, ama chun jonthanhoi dingle milim houna sa neh din thu ahilin, kasohte alhemlhan asulamvaijin ahi.
target: Nevertheless, I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophet. By her teaching she misleads my servants into sexual immorality and the eating of food sacrificed to idols.

source: Keiman hinu chu alung heina ding phat kapeh ahi; ahinla aman ajon thanhoija konin alung ahei nompoi.
target: I have given her time to repent of her immorality, but she is unwilling.

source: Veuvin, keiman amanu chu ajalkhuna kajamhel ding ahi; chule ajonpiho chengsen jong amanu chonna-a kona atanuva alung ahei louvule, hesoh gentheina chungnung tah-a kalelut ding ahi.
target: So I will cast her on a bed of suffering, and I will make those who commit adultery with her suffer intensely, unless they repent of her ways.

source: Chule thi gamna-a achateho katha gam ding ahi; chuteng chule houbung jousen keima lungthim gille lungsung kholtoh soh kahi, hi ahet dingu ahi; chule keiman nangho nathilbol dungjui uva kapeh cheh ding nahiuve.
target: I will strike her children dead. Then all the churches will know that I am he who searches hearts and minds, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.

source: Ahivangin Thyatira-a amoh nalah uva um, hiche thuhil chu jop lou aumin, mi abanghon thugil atiu, Satan thugil chu helouho chengse chu, najah uva kasei ahi, nangho chunga pohgih imacha dang belap ponge.
target: Now I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, to you who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned Satan’s so-called deep secrets, ‘I will not impose any other burden on you,

source: Ahin nanei sun-u chu kahung kahsen tuh det jingun.
target: except to hold on to what you have until I come.’

source: Chule ajouva akhon ni geija kathilbol chengse nit chu, keima pa-a kona kamu banga, ama chu namtin vaipiho chunga thuneina kapeh ding ahi;
target: To the one who is victorious and does my will to the end, I will give authority over the nations—

source: Chutengle ama chun thih tenggola vai ahoma beldengho bel akea ahal hala aum banga, abolding ahi;
target: that one ‘will rule them with an iron scepter and will dash them to pieces like pottery’—just as I have received authority from my Father.

source: Chule keiman ama chu Jing Valpa kapeh ding ahi.
target: I will also give that one the morning star.

source: Nakhang nei chanin houbung ho jah-a Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen.
target: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

source: Chule Sardis'a um houbung solchah henga hitin sunin: Pathen Lhagao sagile ahsi sagi neija chun hitin thu aseije: Keiman nathilbol kahenai, nangma amina ahinga nahin, hinla athisa nahibouve.
target: “To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of him who holds the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds; you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.

source: Khangin lang hah jingin umin; chule adang athikonho chengse chu suhalin din detsah-in; ajeh chu Pathen mitmu-a nathilbol achamkimsa imacha kamupoi.
target: Wake up! Strengthen what remains and is about to die, for I have found your deeds unfinished in the sight of my God.

source: Hijeh chun nangman atila iti natahsana, iti najah ham, hichu geldoh-in, hichu nitphan, chule nalung heijin. Hah jinga naum louva ahile, gucha banga nahenga kahung ding ahi, chule itih phatle naheng kahinsuh nahet louhel ding ahi.
target: Remember, therefore, what you have received and heard; hold it fast, and repent. But if you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what time I will come to you.

source: Ahinla apon kisuhnen lou mi phabep khat Sardis'a aumui; amaho chu ponbang vamleh silla keimatoh kavale dingu ahi; ajeh chu amaho hiche dinga chu kilomtah ahiuve.
target: Yet you have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their clothes. They will walk with me, dressed in white, for they are worthy.

source: Ajouva chu ama jong chutia chu ponbanga kijem ding ahi; chule keiman ahing lekhabua kona ama min chu kathaimang louhel ding ahi; ahin ka Pa angsungle avantil chengse angsunga ama min chu kaseidoh ding ahi.
target: The one who is victorious will, like them, be dressed in white. I will never blot out the name of that person from the book of life, but will acknowledge that name before my Father and his angels.

source: Nakhang nei chanin houbung ho jah-a Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen.
target: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

source: Chule Philadelphia'a um houbung solchah henga hitin sunin: Athengale adihtah, David kanglong heh neija, aman ahonle koiman khah thei lou, chule aman akhale koiman hong thei lou, ama chun hitin thu aseije:
target: “To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These are the words of him who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.

source: Keiman nathilbol chu kahenai; ven, koiman akha thei lou kot honsan na-anga kakoije; natha vang alhome, chule kathu nanit jingin kamin naseilep poi.
target: I know your deeds. See, I have placed before you an open door that no one can shut. I know that you have little strength, yet you have kept my word and have not denied my name.

source: Ven, Satan loi kihou khomna-a miho chu, Juda mi kahi tia Juda mi hilou, thu jou sei ahiuve; ven, chutobang miho chu abang bang nakhophang bula kalhuhsah-a chibai kabohsah dingu ahi; chutile keiman nangma kangailut chu amahon ahetdoh thei dingu ahi.
target: I will make those who are of the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews though they are not, but are liars—I will make them come and fall down at your feet and acknowledge that I have loved you.

source: Nangman keima thohhat thu chu natuh det jeh-a hi, vannoi leiset chung cheng miho patep kholchilna-a vannoi leiset chunga hung lhung dingkon, hiche phatna kona chu keiman jong nangma kahuhdoh ding ahi.
target: Since you have kept my command to endure patiently, I will also keep you from the hour of trial that is going to come on the whole world to test the inhabitants of the earth.

source: Ven, Hung vahjet ding kahi; nalal lukhuh chu koiman nalahpeh louna dingin nanei sun chu tuh det jingin.
target: I am coming soon. Hold on to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.

source: Ajouva chu ka Pathen houin khoma kasem ding, chule chua kona chu potdohta louhel ding ahi; chule achunga, ka Pathen min, chule ka Pathen khopi Jerusalem khopi thah, van'a kona ka Pathen koma kona hung kumlha ding, hiche min chutoh keima min thah kasut ding ahi.
target: The one who is victorious I will make a pillar in the temple of my God. Never again will they leave it. I will write on them the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which is coming down out of heaven from my God; and I will also write on them my new name.

source: Nakhang nei chanin houbung ho jah-a Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen.
target: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

source: Chule Laodicea-a um houbung solchah henga hitin sunin: Amen, tahsan umtah chule hettohsah dihtah, Pathen thilsemho bul chun hitin thu aseije:
target: “To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the ruler of God’s creation.

source: Keiman nathilbol kahenai, nangma votla navotpon, sala nasapoi; navotle votngalin, nasatle sangal lechun pha kasah ahi.
target: I know your deeds, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were either one or the other!

source: Hiti chun sala nasapon, votla navotpon, alum dapdap bep nahi, hiche jeh-a chu kakama kona kakhondoh dingkon nahi.
target: So, because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to spit you out of my mouth.

source: Nangman, Kahaove, sum kakholle, imachan kalhasampoi, natin ahi; ahinla nangmatah ada pen, khoto umtah, vaichatah, mitcho chule sagohkeu nahi chu nakihetpoi.
target: You say, ‘I am rich; I have acquired wealth and do not need a thing.’ But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind and naked.

source: Hijeh chun nahaona dingin, meija kisong jola kilhatheng sana, chule sagohkeu nahi najachat kiphon louna dingin, ponbang sil ding nanei theina dingin, mit nu ding mitlou, hicheng chu keija konin kichoh-in, tia kathu mop nahi.
target: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined in the fire, so you can become rich; and white clothes to wear, so you can cover your shameful nakedness; and salve to put on your eyes, so you can see.

source: Keiman kangailut chan chu kaphosala kasehgimji ahi; hijeh chun nangma tompanin lung heijin.
target: Those whom I love I rebuke and discipline. So be earnest and repent.

source: Ven, keima kotkhah bulah kadingin kot kakiu jinge, mi khattouvin ka-awgin ajah-a kot ahona ahile, keima kasunglhah-a ama chu an kaneh khompi ding ahi; chule aman jong keima an eineh khompi ding ahi.
target: Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with that person, and they with me.

source: Keiman kajo-a ka Pa koma alaltouna-a katou banga hi ajouva chu kakoma kalaltouna-a katousah ding ahi, ati.
target: To the one who is victorious, I will give the right to sit with me on my throne, just as I was victorious and sat down with my Father on his throne.

source: Nakhang nei chanin houbung ho jah-a Lhagao thusei hi ngaihen.
target: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.”

source: Hiche jou chun keiman kaven ahile, veuvin, van'a kot khat akihon kamun ahi, chule keima eikihoupia sumkon gin tobang aw amasa kajah, aw khat chun, Hiche lama hin hung kaltouvin, tu nunga thil hung soh tei dingho chengse chu kavetsah ding nahi, ati.
target: After this I looked, and there before me was a door standing open in heaven. And the voice I had first heard speaking to me like a trumpet said, “Come up here, and I will show you what must take place after this.”

source: Hichetah chun Lhagaovin kaumtan ahi; chuin, veuvin, van'ah laltouna khat akidon ahi, chule hiche laltouna-a chun mi khat atouvin;
target: At once I was in the Spirit, and there before me was a throne in heaven with someone sitting on it.

source: Hiche-a toupa chu jasper songle sardion song bangin alange; chule laltouna kimvela chun lhagui aumin, emerald songtoh abangin ahi.
target: And the one who sat there had the appearance of jasper and ruby. A rainbow that shone like an emerald encircled the throne.

source: Chule laltouna kimvela chun laltouna somnileli aumin; hiche laltounaho chunga chun ponbang kisila alua sana lukhuh kikhuh upa somnileli atouvui.
target: Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and seated on them were twenty-four elders. They were dressed in white and had crowns of gold on their heads.

source: Chule chuche laltouna-a kon chun kolphe, aw, chule van gin ahung sohdohjin ahi; chule laltouna maija chun meija kong jing jeng meivah sagi aumin, hichu Pathen Lhagao sagi chu ahi;
target: From the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblings and peals of thunder. In front of the throne, seven lamps were blazing. These are the seven spirits of God.

source: chule laltouna maija chun crystal songvala val phatvet twikhanglen tobang khat akimui; chule hiche laltouna ningtin le laltouna kimvela chun ganhing li aume; amaho chu amalam anunglam amit jeng amit jeng dimset ahi.
target: Also in front of the throne there was what looked like a sea of glass, clear as crystal. In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, and they were covered with eyes, in front and in back.

source: Ganhing amasapen chu keipitoh abangin, anina chu bongnou toh abangin, athumna chun mihem mai apui, alina chu alengle mulaopi tobang ahi.
target: The first living creature was like a lion, the second was like an ox, the third had a face like a man, the fourth was like a flying eagle.

source: Hiche ganhing liho chun lhaving gup cheh aneijui; akimvel le asunglam amit jeng amit jeng dimset ahi; chule amaho chun, Athenge, athenge, athenge, Pakai Pathen, hat chungnung, aumsa auma, chule ahung umdinga chu, tin asun ajanin cholnga louhelin, ati, atiuvin ahi.
target: Each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around, even under its wings. Day and night they never stop saying: “ ‘Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty,’ who was, and is, and is to come.”

source: Chule hiche ganhingho chun a-imatih chana hing jing, laltouna-a toupa chu, avahchoi juva, ajaboluva, athangvah tengule,
target: Whenever the living creatures give glory, honor and thanks to him who sits on the throne and who lives for ever and ever,

source: upa somni le liho chun laltouna-a toupa anga chu lhujiuva, a-imatih chana hing jingpa anga chu, alallukhuh aselhah jiuva chibai abohjiuva,
target: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives for ever and ever. They lay their crowns before the throne and say:

source: Vo Pakai, nangma bou vahchoile choi-at chule thilbol thei thahat changa lom nahi. Ajeh chu imajouse nangma sem ahi; chule nangma phatsah-a hicheng chu uma chule kisema ahi, atiji dingu ahi.
target: “You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for you created all things, and by your will they were created and have their being.”

source: Chujouvin laltouna-a toupa khut jet lama chun, asunglam apolam alangtoa kisuna, sinkhana sagi-a kisinkha lekhabu khat kamun ahi.
target: Then I saw in the right hand of him who sat on the throne a scroll with writing on both sides and sealed with seven seals.

source: Chuin vantil hattah khat kamun ama chun, Hiche lekhabu hi phonga asinkhana lhamlha dinga lom koiham, tin hasap tah-in asamlen ahi.
target: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, “Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?”

source: Ahin van'ah, leijah, lei noijah lekhabu chu aphong theile ave theija koimacha aumtapon ahi.
target: But no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth could open the scroll or even look inside it.

source: Chuin lekhabu chu aphong dingle asim dinga khatcha jong akiholmo jeh chun hakan kakaptan ahi.
target: I wept and wept because no one was found who was worthy to open the scroll or look inside.

source: Hichun upaho lah-a khat chun, Nangma kap hih-in; ven, Juda phung Keipi chule David Jung chu hiche lekhabu phong dingle asinkhana sagi chu honglha dinga ajosohsa ahitai, ati.
target: Then one of the elders said to me, “Do not weep! See, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed. He is able to open the scroll and its seven seals.”

source: Chuin keiman kaven ahile, veuvin, laltounale ganhing liho lailung-ah chule upaho lailunga chun Kelngoinou kithatsa lheh lheh khat adin kamui; ama chu aki sagile amit sagi ahi; hichu vannoi leiset pumpi-a kisol Pathen Lhagao sagi ahi.
target: Then I saw a Lamb, looking as if it had been slain, standing at the center of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth.

source: Ama chu ahungin laltouna-a toupa khut jet lama lekhabu chu alan ahi.
target: He went and took the scroll from the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

source: Hichu alah phat chun ganhing liho chule upa somni le liho chu Kelngoinou anga chun abohkhup taovin ahi; amaho chun akhutna selangdah khat chehle sana sumlheng, mithengho taona, gimnam twi dimset akichoi cheh-un ahi.
target: And when he had taken it, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of God’s people.

source: Amaho chun la thah khat asauvin, Lekhabu chu ala dingle asinkhana lhamlha dinga lom nangma bou nahi; ajeh chu nangma kithattasa nahi; phungtin leh chitin namtina mi, paotin paotanga mi, gamvaipi nam jouse-a mi Pathen'a dinga nangman nathisana nachoh doh ahitai.
target: And they sang a new song, saying: “You are worthy to take the scroll and to open its seals, because you were slain, and with your blood you purchased for God persons from every tribe and language and people and nation.

source: Pathen dinga amaho chu gamsung mile thempu-a napansah ahitai; chutia chu amaho chun vannoi leiset chunga vai apoh dingu ahi, atiuvin ahi.
target: You have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our God, and they will reign on the earth.”

source: Chujouvin kagahvetle, chuche laltounale ganhingho chule upaho kimvela chun vantil asang aja aw kajan ahi; amaho chu sangsom tamtah jat sangsom, sang tamtah jat sang tamtah ahiuve.
target: Then I looked and heard the voice of many angels, numbering thousands upon thousands, and ten thousand times ten thousand. They encircled the throne and the living creatures and the elders.

source: Amaho chun aw sangtah-in, Akithatsa Kelngoinou chu thahatna, haona, chihna, thaneina, choi-atna, loupina, chule pachatna chang dinga lom ahi, atiuve.
target: In a loud voice they were saying: “Worthy is the Lamb, who was slain, to receive power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and praise!”

source: Chuin van'a, leija, lei noija, chule twikhanglen'a thilsem jousen, chule chucheho lah-a um chengsen ahiti seiju aw hi kajai, Laltouna-a toupale Kelngoinou chu pachatle choiat, chule loupinale thunei vaipoh atonsot atonsot geijin chang jinghen, atiuve.
target: Then I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and on the sea, and all that is in them, saying: “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power, for ever and ever!”

source: Chuin ganhing liho chun, Amen, atiuvin ahi. Chule li ho le upa somni ho chengse chu aboh khupmun a-itih-a hingjing chu chibai abohtauvin ahi.
target: The four living creatures said, “Amen,” and the elders fell down and worshiped.

source: Chuin Kelngoinou chun asinkhana sagi lah-a khat chu ahon kamui, chule ganhing liho lah-a khat chun van ginga bangin, Hungven, ati kajan ahi.
target: I watched as the Lamb opened the first of the seven seals. Then I heard one of the four living creatures say in a voice like thunder, “Come!”

source: Hijeh-a chu kagah vetle, veuvin, sakol kang khat ka mun, achunga toupa chun gophel achoije; ama chu lukhuh khat apeuvin ahi; chule ama chu ajoupehle ajoupeh dinga hung kondoh ahi.
target: I looked, and there before me was a white horse! Its rider held a bow, and he was given a crown, and he rode out as a conqueror bent on conquest.

source: Chuin sinkhana anina ahonle, ganhing nina chun, Hungven, ati chu kajan ahi.
target: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come!”

source: Hichun sakol chom khat ahungdoh-in, hichu asan ahi; chuin miho chu amahole amaho akithatona dinga, achunga toupa chu, leisetna kon chamna lah mangna kipe-a ahi; chule ama chu chemjam lentah khat jong kipe-a ahi.
target: Then another horse came out, a fiery red one. Its rider was given power to take peace from the earth and to make people kill each other. To him was given a large sword.

source: Chuin aman sinkhana athumna ahon phat chun ganhing athumna chun, Hungven, ati kajan ahi. Chuin, veuvin, sakol vom khat kamun ahi; chule achunga toupa chun khaikot achoijin ahi.
target: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come!” I looked, and there before me was a black horse! Its rider was holding a pair of scales in his hand.

source: Chuin ganhing liho lah-a kon chun, suhlouchang khai khat man makhai, chule sakolchang khai thuma makhai ahi; chule nangman thaole lengpitwi vang chu sumang hih-in, ti aw kajan ahi.
target: Then I heard what sounded like a voice among the four living creatures, saying, “Two pounds of wheat for a day’s wages, and six pounds of barley for a day’s wages, and do not damage the oil and the wine!”

source: Chuin aman sinkhana alina ahon phat chun, Hungven, ti ganhing alina aw kajan ahi.
target: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come!”

source: Hichun kavetle, veuvin, sakol engdang khat kamun; chule achunga toupa chu amin Thina ahi; chule damunin anungnung ajuijin ahi. Chule chemhema, gilkela, thina-a, chule gamsa-a atha dinguva amaho chu vannoi leiset hop li-a hop khat chunga thuneina kipe-a ahiuve.
target: I looked, and there before me was a pale horse! Its rider was named Death, and Hades was following close behind him. They were given power over a fourth of the earth to kill by sword, famine and plague, and by the wild beasts of the earth.

source: Chuin sinkhana angana chu ahon phat chun, Pathen thu jalle hettohsahna aneiju jala kithatteho lhagao hing chu maicham phung noijah kamun ahi.
target: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain because of the word of God and the testimony they had maintained.

source: Amaho chun aw sangtah-in asamun, Vo Pakai thengle kitah, thu tanna chule leiset chung chengho chunga keiho thisan asou phulah ding chu itihchan nakhongai dingham, atiuvin ahi.
target: They called out in a loud voice, “How long, Sovereign Lord, holy and true, until you judge the inhabitants of the earth and avenge our blood?”

source: Hichun amaho chu ponbang ape chehtauvin ahi; chule amaho chu, asohchanpiho chengseole asopite chengseu amaho banga atha dingu chu akim masangse-a, chomkhat anga tahdi dingu ahi, tin ajah uva aseijun ahi.
target: Then each of them was given a white robe, and they were told to wait a little longer, until the full number of their fellow servants, their brothers and sisters, were killed just as they had been.

source: Chunin sinkhana gupna chu ahon phat chun, veuvin, ling nasatah ahung kiho kamun; chule nisa chu samul khaodip pon bangin adumtan, chule lhathah pumpi thisan abang jengtan ahi;
target: I watched as he opened the sixth seal. There was a great earthquake. The sun turned black like sackcloth made of goat hair, the whole moon turned blood red,

source: chule van'a ahsi ho chu hui hattah-in, theichang amut linga ahut apul lhah bangin, leijah apul lhagamtan ahi.
target: and the stars in the sky fell to earth, as figs drop from a fig tree when shaken by a strong wind.

source: Chule van chu lekha kijel bangin akijelin amangheltan ahi; chule molle lhang jousele twikol gam jong ama ama mun'a konin akichon mang gamtan ahi.
target: The heavens receded like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was removed from its place.

source: Chule leiset lengho, milenho, sepai lamkai pipuiho, chule mihaoho, chule ahatteho, chule soh ho chengsele soh hilou ongthol chengse, kokhuh sunga le molsanga songpiho a chun akiselun;
target: Then the kings of the earth, the princes, the generals, the rich, the mighty, and everyone else, both slave and free, hid in caves and among the rocks of the mountains.

source: chule molsang ho le songpiho jah-a chun, Kachung uvah hunglhun lang laltouna-a toupa maikoh-a konle Kelngoinou lunghan na-a konin neiselun;
target: They called to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb!

source: ajeh chu alunghan nikho chungnung chu ahung lhungtai; koiham ading thei ding, atiuvin ahi.
target: For the great day of their wrath has come, and who can withstand it?”

source: Chujou chun vannoi leiset ning li-a vantil li dinga, vannoi leiset chungle twikhanglen chunga chule thing chunga hui anun louna dinga, vannoi leiset hui li tuhtanga kamun ahi.
target: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth to prevent any wind from blowing on the land or on the sea or on any tree.

source: Chuin Pathen hing melchihna choija, niso lama kona hung kaltou vantil chomdang khat kamun; ama chun hatah-in asamin, leisetle twikhanglen suhsetna ding thu kipe-a vantil liho jah-a chun,
target: Then I saw another angel coming up from the east, having the seal of the living God. He called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea:

source: I-Pathen sohteho chala melchihna kanam masangseuvin, nanghon leisetle twikhanglen chule thingho suse hihtadiuvin, ati.
target: “Do not harm the land or the sea or the trees until we put a seal on the foreheads of the servants of our God.”

source: Chuin melchihna kinama chu amijat kajan; Israel phung chengsea melchihna kinama sang ja khatle sangsomli le sangli ahi;
target: Then I heard the number of those who were sealed: 144,000 from all the tribes of Israel.

source: Juda phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni; Reuben phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni; Gad phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni;
target: From the tribe of Judah 12,000 were sealed, from the tribe of Reuben 12,000, from the tribe of Gad 12,000,

source: Asher phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni; Naphtali phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni; Manasseh phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni;
target: from the tribe of Asher 12,000, from the tribe of Naphtali 12,000, from the tribe of Manasseh 12,000,

source: Simeon phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni; Levi phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni; Issachar phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni;
target: from the tribe of Simeon 12,000, from the tribe of Levi 12,000, from the tribe of Issachar 12,000,

source: Zebulun phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni; Benjamin phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni; Joseph phunga melchihna kinam sangsom le sangni ahin;
target: from the tribe of Zebulun 12,000, from the tribe of Joseph 12,000, from the tribe of Benjamin 12,000.

source: Hicheng jou chun kavetle, chitin namtina kon, phungtina kon, chule mite tinchenga konle paotin paotanga kon, koima simsen lou mipi atama tam abang jenga kivon, lusuna kichoija laltouna angle Kelngoinou anga dinga kamun;
target: After this I looked, and there before me was a great multitude that no one could count, from every nation, tribe, people and language, standing before the throne and before the Lamb. They were wearing white robes and were holding palm branches in their hands.

source: chule amaho chun, Huhhingna chu laltouna-a tou i-Pathen'ule, Kelngoinouva ahi, tin aw sangtah-in asamui.
target: And they cried out in a loud voice: “Salvation belongs to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb.”

source: Chule vantil jouse chu, laltounale upaho, chule ganhing liho kimvela chu ding jinga ahiuve; amaho chu laltouna anga aboh khupmun Pathen alhaijun,
target: All the angels were standing around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures. They fell down on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,

source: Amen: pachatna, loupina, hetna, chihna, thangvahna, choi-atle thuneina, chule thahat atonsot atonsot geijin i-Pathen'uva hi jinghen. Amen, atiuvin ahi.
target: saying: “Amen! Praise and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our God for ever and ever. Amen!”

source: Chuin upaho lah-a khat chun eihin houvin kajah-a, Hiche ponbang jenga kivonho hi koi hiuva chule hoija hung kon hiuvam, ti eidongin ahi.
target: Then one of the elders asked me, “These in white robes—who are they, and where did they come from?”

source: Keiman ama jah-a, Ka pakai, nangman bou nahei, kati. Hichun aman kajah-a, Hiteho hi bolgim hesoh genthei chungnunga kona chu hung ahiuve; amahon Kelngoinou thisana chu avonu akisop bangu ahitai.
target: I answered, “Sir, you know.” And he said, “These are they who have come out of the great tribulation; they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

source: Hijeh-a chu amahohi Pathen laltouna anga umuva, asun ajana a-houin'a chu ama lhachale-a panga ahiuve: chule laltouna-a toupa khu amaho lah-a cheng ding ahi;
target: Therefore, “they are before the throne of God and serve him day and night in his temple; and he who sits on the throne will shelter them with his presence.

source: amaho hi itihchan hijongle gilkel, dangchah kit talou ding ahiuve; nisan jong sangta lou ding, sat jong thohta louhel ding ahiuve;
target: ‘Never again will they hunger; never again will they thirst. The sun will not beat down on them,’ nor any scorching heat.

source: ajeh chu laltouna lailunga um Kelngoinou khun avah diu, chule hin twinah dunga chu apuihoile ding ahi; chule Pathen'in amitlhi jouseu athehhul ding ahi, ati.
target: For the Lamb at the center of the throne will be their shepherd; ‘he will lead them to springs of living water.’ ‘And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’”

source: Chuin aman sinkhana sagina ahon pat chun van'ah nidan keh khat kahset athipchet jengtan ahi.
target: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

source: Chuin Pathen anga ding jing vantil sagi kamun; chule amaho chu sumkon sagi chu apeuvin ahi.
target: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

source: Chujouvin gimnamtui halna sanabom choija vantil khat ahungin maichama chun ahung dingin; laltouna maija um sana maicham chunga chu mithengho jouse taona abelap peh dingin gimnamtui tamtah apeuvin ahi.
target: Another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense to offer, with the prayers of all God’s people, on the golden altar in front of the throne.

source: Hichun mithengho taonatoh thakhatnin vantil khut chunga kon chun gimnamtui khu chu Pathen angsung geijin akikhodohtan ahi.
target: The smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God’s people, went up before God from the angel’s hand.

source: Hichun vantil chun gimnamtui halnabom chu alan, maichama mei chu akhumin leiset chunga agah seplhatan ahi. Chutah chun van agingin, aw agingin, kol aphen, chule ling akihotan ahi.
target: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it on the earth; and there came peals of thunder, rumblings, flashes of lightning and an earthquake.

source: Chujouvin sumkon sagi choija vantil sagi chu sumkon mut dingin kigosa demin aumtaovin ahi.
target: Then the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.

source: Chuin amasapenpan amutle, thisantoh kihal gel le mei ahung umpaijen jengin ahi; chuin hichengse chu leiset chungah agah seplhaovin ahile, chutah chun thingho hop thuma hop khat akavamin, chule hamhing jouse jong akavamtan ahi.
target: The first angel sounded his trumpet, and there came hail and fire mixed with blood, and it was hurled down on the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, a third of the trees were burned up, and all the green grass was burned up.

source: Chujou chun vantil nina chun amutle, meija ka mol lentah tobang khat twikhanglen'ah asep lut taovin ahile, chutah chun twikhanglen chu hop thuma hop khat thisan asohtan ahi;
target: The second angel sounded his trumpet, and something like a huge mountain, all ablaze, was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned into blood,

source: chule twikhanglen'a cheng thilsem lah-a ganhing hop thuma hop khat agamtan ahi, chule kongho jong hop thuma hop khat suhmangin aumtan ahi.
target: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.

source: Chuin vantil athumna chun amutle, meisel banga al-lenglung ahsi lenpi khat van'a konin ahung lhan, luiho hop thuma ho khat chungle twinahho chungah achun ahi;
target: The third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star, blazing like a torch, fell from the sky on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water—

source: chule ahsi amin chu Gamsai akiti; chule twi hop thuma hop khat chu gamsai asohtan ahi; akibol khat jeh chun twija kon chun mi tamtah athi.
target: the name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters turned bitter, and many people died from the waters that had become bitter.

source: Chuin vantil lina chun amutle, nisa hop thuma hop khat, lha thah hop thuma hop khat, ahsi ho hop thuma hop khat athimna dingin akivosen, athima khovah beihelna dingin sun hop thuma hop khat akivosen ahi; jan jong chutima chu ahi.
target: The fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and a third of the sun was struck, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them turned dark. A third of the day was without light, and also a third of the night.

source: Chujouvin kavet jingle, vantil khat vanlaijola lengle-a hiche hi hasaptah-a sama aw kajan ahi, Khuche vantil thum sumkon mut dinga kigoho khun asumkon mut banu amut tengule, leiset chung chengho chu adanauve, adanauve, adanauve, ati.
target: As I watched, I heard an eagle that was flying in midair call out in a loud voice: “Woe! Woe! Woe to the inhabitants of the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the other three angels!”

source: Chujouvin vantil ngana chun amutle, ahsi khat van'a kona lha-a leija chua kamun ahi; chule ama chu lei-ong kokhuh hehna chu kipe-a ahi.
target: The fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from the sky to the earth. The star was given the key to the shaft of the Abyss.

source: Chuin aman lei-ong kokhuh chu aheh hongin ahile, kokhuh sunga kon chun pummei nasatah-a bangin meikhu ahung khudohtan ahi; chule kokhuh sunga kona hung khudoh meikhu chun nisale van athimsahtan ahi.
target: When he opened the Abyss, smoke rose from it like the smoke from a gigantic furnace. The sun and sky were darkened by the smoke from the Abyss.

source: Chule meikhu-a kon chun khaokhote lei chunga ahung sohdohtaovin ahi; amaho chu leiset chunga aipi thanei tobang thaneina kipe-a ahiuve.
target: And out of the smoke locusts came down on the earth and were given power like that of scorpions of the earth.

source: Chule leiset chunga hampa louhing, anche dong chule thing khatcha suse louhela, achala Pathen mi melchihna kinamlou mihobou chu nasuhset dingu ahi, tia kiseipeh ahiuve.
target: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those people who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.

source: Chule amahon hiteho chu tha chu atha lou dingu, lha nga geija agenthei agentheija agimbol dinguva bou kipe-a ahiuve; chule amibolgimu chu aipin mi ape tenga bolgimna tobang bolgimna ahi.
target: They were not allowed to kill them but only to torture them for five months. And the agony they suffered was like that of the sting of a scorpion when it strikes.

source: Hiche lai teng chule mihon thina ahol dingu, chule iti hol jongleu amu lou dingu ahi; chule thi alung ngai dingu chule thina chu amaho-a kona jammang ding ahi.
target: During those days people will seek death but will not find it; they will long to die, but death will elude them.

source: Hiche khaokhoho limso chu galsat dinga gotsadem sakol abangin ahi, chule alu chunguva chu sana tobang lukhuh aumin, chule amaiju chu mihem maitoh abangin ahi.
target: The locusts looked like horses prepared for battle. On their heads they wore something like crowns of gold, and their faces resembled human faces.

source: Chule asamu chu numei samtoh abangin; chule ahau chu keipi hatoh abange.
target: Their hair was like women’s hair, and their teeth were like lions’ teeth.

source: Chule a-omphou chu thih ompho tobang ahin, alhaiju gin galsat dinga lhaija sakol kangtalai tamtah lhai gintoh abangin ahi.
target: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the thundering of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.

source: Aipi mei bangin ameiju aumin, amidena ajang jong aumin ahi; chule amaijuva chu lha nga geija mihemte agenthei theija gimbolna athao uma ahi.
target: They had tails with stingers, like scorpions, and in their tails they had power to torment people for five months.

source: Lei-ong solchah chu alengpao ahi; amin chu Hebrai paovin Abaddon ahin, Greek paovin Apollyuon ahi.
target: They had as king over them the angel of the Abyss, whose name in Hebrew is Abaddon and in Greek is Apollyon (that is, Destroyer).

source: Dana masa kichaija ahitai; veuvin, tu nunga hi dana ni hung lhung ding ahina laije.
target: The first woe is past; two other woes are yet to come.

source: Chuin vantil gupna chun amutle, Pathen anga um sana maicham saki ho-a kon chun aw kajan ahi;
target: The sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice coming from the four horns of the golden altar that is before God.

source: khat chun sumkon choija vantil gupna pa jah-a chun, Euphrates luipi-a vantil li kihenho chu lhan, ati.
target: It said to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.”

source: Hichun mihem hop thuma hop khat that dinga, anidan, anikho, alha, akum phasadema kigotpeh vantil liho chu akilhadoh taovin ahi.
target: And the four angels who had been kept ready for this very hour and day and month and year were released to kill a third of mankind.

source: Chule sakol chungchong galmiho chu ami jat sangsom jat ni sangsom jat ahiuve; ami jat chu kajan ahi.
target: The number of the mounted troops was twice ten thousand times ten thousand. I heard their number.

source: Chule kathil mu-a chun, sakol chengsele achunga chongho chu hiti hin kamui; a-omphou chu kamsan sung abangin, a-engdumin, chule sakol ho chu alu keipi lutoh abangin ahi; amaho kamsunga kon chun mei, meikhu, chule kath ahung sohdohjin ahi.
target: The horses and riders I saw in my vision looked like this: Their breastplates were fiery red, dark blue, and yellow as sulfur. The heads of the horses resembled the heads of lions, and out of their mouths came fire, smoke and sulfur.

source: Chuteho kamsunga sohdoh mei, meikhu, chule kath chucheng thum chun mihem hop thuma hop khat akithat gamtan ahi.
target: A third of mankind was killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke and sulfur that came out of their mouths.

source: Akam sungule ameijuva chu athaneinao uma ahi; ameiju chu gul lheh lheh abangin, alu aumin; hichea chu mi agimbolu ahi.
target: The power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails; for their tails were like snakes, having heads with which they inflict injury.

source: Suhgamna chuchenga kithat moh ho chengse chu akhut tham athilbol uva konin alungu aheipouvin ahi; hichu amahon thilhahole khomu theilou, khoja theilou, vahle theilou, sana, dangka, sum-eng, song chule thinga asemu milimho hou atang pouvin ahi.
target: The rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the work of their hands; they did not stop worshiping demons, and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone and wood—idols that cannot see or hear or walk.

source: Chule amahon toltha mitphel doi choi, jon thanhoi, guchat, hichenga kon chun alungu aheipouvin ahi.
target: Nor did they repent of their murders, their magic arts, their sexual immorality or their thefts.

source: Chuin vantil chomdang hattah khat meija kitom, van'a kona ahung kumlhah kamun, alu chunga chun lhagui akiveijin; amai chu nisatoh abangin, chule akeng chu meikong khomtoh abange;
target: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven. He was robed in a cloud, with a rainbow above his head; his face was like the sun, and his legs were like fiery pillars.

source: chule akhutna chun lekhabu neocha kiphonga khat achoijin ahi, ama chun akeng jet lamin twikhanglen achonin, vei lamin leiset chun achonin ahi;
target: He was holding a little scroll, which lay open in his hand. He planted his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land,

source: chule keipi kitum banghelin hatah-in kho asamin ahi; akhosap chu van gin sagin ahindongin ahi.
target: and he gave a loud shout like the roar of a lion. When he shouted, the voices of the seven thunders spoke.

source: Chule van gin sagi chun thu asei phat chun lekha-a sun ding kakigo tan ahi; chuin van'a aw ahung gingin hitia hi kajah-a asei kajan ahi. Van gin sagi thusei chu imchah-in sun hih-in, ati.
target: And when the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from heaven say, “Seal up what the seven thunders have said and do not write it down.”

source: Chule twikhanglen le leiset chunga dinga vantil kamu chun van lama akhut jetlam adom sangin,
target: Then the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to heaven.

source: vanle vanlaijola thil um chengsele, leiset chule asunga um chengse, chule twikhanglen le asunga um chengse, aboncha sema a-imatih chana hing jing, ama min chu apanin ahahselin, Sotta lou ding ahi;
target: And he swore by him who lives for ever and ever, who created the heavens and all that is in them, the earth and all that is in it, and the sea and all that is in it, and said, “There will be no more delay!

source: ahin vantil sagina chu sumkon mut akigot tengle, hichu agin phat phatle, Pathen thuguh, asoh themgaoho henga anaphondoh banga chu guilhung ding ahitai, ati.
target: But in the days when the seventh angel is about to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be accomplished, just as he announced to his servants the prophets.”

source: Hichun van aw kajah chu kaja kitleuvin eihouvin kajah-a, Khuche twikhanglen khule lei chunga dinga vantil khutna um lekhabu neo kiphonga khu chenlang galan, eitin ahi.
target: Then the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me once more: “Go, take the scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and on the land.”

source: Chuin keiman vantil henga chun kachen ajah-a, Lekhabu neocha chu neipen, kati. Chuin aman kajah-a, Lanlang nejou jengin; hichun na-oisung akhatsah ding ahi; ahin nakama vang khoiju banga lhum ding ahi, ati.
target: So I went to the angel and asked him to give me the little scroll. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will turn your stomach sour, but ‘in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.’”

source: Hichun keiman vantil khut chunga kon chun lekhabu neocha chu kalan, chuin kanetan ahi; hichun kakamah khoiju lhumin alhumin ahi; ahin kaneh jou phat chun ka-oisung akhatan ahi.
target: I took the little scroll from the angel’s hand and ate it. It tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth, but when I had eaten it, my stomach turned sour.

source: Chuin amaho chun kajah-a, Miho, chule chitin namtinle, paotin paotang, chule lengho tamtah chungchang thu naseidoh kit tei ding ahi, ati.
target: Then I was told, “You must prophesy again about many peoples, nations, languages and kings.”

source: Hichun tenggol lheh lheh pengmol khat keima eipeuvin, vantil chu adingin kajah-a, hitin aseije, Kipat inlang nangman Pathen houin le, amaicham, chule asunga um ahouho chengse khu gaten.
target: I was given a reed like a measuring rod and was told, “Go and measure the temple of God and the altar, with its worshipers.

source: Houin polam aleitol chu khendoh-in te hih-in; ajeh chu chidang namdangte kipedoh ahitai; chule amahon lha somli le lhani geija khopi theng chu achotpha dingu ahi.
target: But exclude the outer court; do not measure it, because it has been given to the Gentiles. They will trample on the holy city for 42 months.

source: Chule keiman kathu hettohsah ni thuneina kapeh ding, chule amani chun khaodip pon akisil lhona ni sangkhat le ni jani toh ni somgup sunga thu aseidoh lhon ding ahi.
target: And I will appoint my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth.”

source: Amani chu vannoi leiset Pathen anga dinga Olive thingphung ni chule meivah khom ni chu ahi lhone;
target: They are “the two olive trees” and the two lampstands, and “they stand before the Lord of the earth.”

source: hiteni chu mi khattouvin bolgim dinga agot jouse-a, akamsung lhona kona mei potna amelma chengseu chu akah vam jengji ahi; chule hitia chu koi hile amani chu bolset go-a chu kithat jeng ding ahi.
target: If anyone tries to harm them, fire comes from their mouths and devours their enemies. This is how anyone who wants to harm them must die.

source: Amani chu athu seidoh lai lhona chu go ajuh louna dinga, van khahchah thei ahi lhone; chule amanin suhgamna tintanga leiset asuhgam lhona, twi thisan asosah nomchan lhona, asosah lhon dinga twi chunga thuneina anei lhon ahi.
target: They have power to shut up the heavens so that it will not rain during the time they are prophesying; and they have power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they want.

source: Amani chun athu hettohsah achai lhon tengle, lei-onga kona hung pot sahem chun amani chu akisatpia amani chu ajoa atha ding ahi.
target: Now when they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up from the Abyss will attack them, and overpower and kill them.

source: Chuteng Sodom le Egypt, hiche lhagao lam min umna khopi, a-pakaiyu thingpel'a akhetbehnao, khopi sung lamlena chu along lhon kijam ding ahi.
target: Their bodies will lie in the public square of the great city—which is figuratively called Sodom and Egypt—where also their Lord was crucified.

source: Mitehon, chitin namtinle phungtina min, paotin paotanga min, chule namtin vaipin ni thumle akeh geija along lhon chu avet avet jeng dingu ahi, chule along lhon chu vuiding thu apeh lou dingu ahi.
target: For three and a half days some from every people, tribe, language and nation will gaze on their bodies and refuse them burial.

source: Chule vannoi leiset mite, amani chungchanga chu kipah thanom ding ahiuve, khatle khat kipaman kithotto ding ahiuve; ajeh chu hiche themgao teni chun leiset chung chengho agimbol lhon ahi.
target: The inhabitants of the earth will gloat over them and will celebrate by sending each other gifts, because these two prophets had tormented those who live on the earth.

source: Chuin ni thumle akeh jou chun asung lhona Pathen'a kona hinna lhagao alut jeh chun, amani akengin ading gel lhontan ahi; chuphat chun ave veho chu akichata lheh jengtaovin ahi.
target: But after the three and a half days the breath of life from God entered them, and they stood on their feet, and terror struck those who saw them.

source: Chuin, Hilama hung kaltou lhonin, tia van awgin nasatah aja lhonin ahi. Chutah chun amani chu mei kangtalai jin van'a akaltou lhontan ahi. Chule amelmateu chun amu jingu ahi lhone.
target: Then they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here.” And they went up to heaven in a cloud, while their enemies looked on.

source: Hiche pettah chun ling nasatah ahung kihottan ahi, hichun khopi chu hop soma hop khat achimtan ahi; hiche ling kiho chun mi sangsagi athin, chule athimoh chengse chu atijatlot jeh-un van Pathen chu avahchoi taovin ahi.
target: At that very hour there was a severe earthquake and a tenth of the city collapsed. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the survivors were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

source: Dana nina chu kichaija ahitai; dana thumna chu hung lhung vahjet ding ahi.
target: The second woe has passed; the third woe is coming soon.

source: Chuin vantil sagina chun amuttan ahi, chule van'ah aw nasatah atama tamin ahinjomin, Vannoi gamvaipoh hi I-Pakaiyu le a-Christa-a ahitai; chule aman atonsot atonsot geija vai apoh ding ahi, atiuve.
target: The seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and there were loud voices in heaven, which said: “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Messiah, and he will reign for ever and ever.”

source: Chuin upa somni le liho Pathen anga alaltouna cheh-a touho chu akhupbon alhuvin Pathen chibai aboh-un,
target: And the twenty-four elders, who were seated on their thrones before God, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

source: Vo Pakai Pathen Hat chungnung, Auma, Aumsa, Ahungding nangma kathangvah-ui; ajeh chu nangman nathuneina chungnung chu nakilah-a vai napoh ahitai.
target: saying: “We give thanks to you, Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and have begun to reign.

source: Namtin vaipi lunghanga ahiuvin, chuin nangma lunghanle, athiho thutan phat, chule nasoh themgaoho le, mithengho, nangma min gingho alen aneo, tohphat man peh phat, chule leiset sumangho suhmang phat chu, hung lhunga ahitai, atiuve.
target: The nations were angry, and your wrath has come. The time has come for judging the dead, and for rewarding your servants the prophets and your people who revere your name, both great and small— and for destroying those who destroy the earth.”

source: Chuin van'a um Pathen houin mun theng chu akihongin, chule a-houin Mun Theng sunga chun kitepna thu thingkhong chu akimun ahi; chule kol aphen, aw agingin, van agingin, ling akihottan ahi, chule gel len nasatah alhan ahi.
target: Then God’s temple in heaven was opened, and within his temple was seen the ark of his covenant. And there came flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, an earthquake and a severe hailstorm.

source: Chuin van'ah melchihna chungnung khat akimun ahi; numei khat nisa-a kijema, akengto noija lhathah uma, chule alu chunga ahsi somle ni-a kijem lallukhuh kikhuh ahi:
target: A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.

source: chule amanu chu naovop ahi; chule naoso nat thohgima ham hama ahi.
target: She was pregnant and cried out in pain as she was about to give birth.

source: Chuin van'ah melchihna kidangtah achom khat akimu kittan ahi; veuvin, dragon san lentah, alu sagi, chule aki som chule aluho-a chu lallukhuh sagi kikhuh, khat ahung umin ahi.
target: Then another sign appeared in heaven: an enormous red dragon with seven heads and ten horns and seven crowns on its heads.

source: Chule amei chun van'a ahsi ho hop thuma hop khat aloilhan leiset chunga aseplhan ahi; chule dragon chu asoh dingkon numeinu anga chun asolhah tihtih acha chu aval lhum jeng theina dingin ading jing jengin ahi.
target: Its tail swept a third of the stars out of the sky and flung them to the earth. The dragon stood in front of the woman who was about to give birth, so that it might devour her child the moment he was born.

source: Chuin amanun chapa khat ahingtan ahi; ama chun namtin vaipi jouse chunga thih tenggola vai apoh ding ahi; chuin acha chu Pathen hengle alaltouna-ah lahtouvin aumtan ahi.
target: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who “will rule all the nations with an iron scepter.” And her child was snatched up to God and to his throne.

source: Chuin numeinu chu gamthip lama ajam mangtan ahi; hikoma chu ni sang khatle ni jani leh ni somgup geija akivahna dinga, amanu chu Pathen'in mun agotpehsa ahi.
target: The woman fled into the wilderness to a place prepared for her by God, where she might be taken care of for 1,260 days.

source: Chuin van'ah gal akisattan ahi; Michael le avantil ho chengsen dragon chu asat taovin ahi; hi chun dragon le asolchah ho jong chun asat thuhtaove;
target: Then war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.

source: ahivangin ajoutapouve; chujongle van'ah amaho mun akimu kittapon ahi.
target: But he was not strong enough, and they lost their place in heaven.

source: Chuin dragon len chu gul lui, Diabol le Satan kiti vannoi pumpi lhemlha-a chu, ama chu leijah lelhah-in aumtan ahi; chule asolchahho jong chu amatoh lelhah than aumtaove.
target: The great dragon was hurled down—that ancient serpent called the devil, or Satan, who leads the whole world astray. He was hurled to the earth, and his angels with him.

source: Hichun keiman van'ah aw nasatah khat kajan ahi; Hichun, Tun huhhing, thahat lenggam i-Pathen'uva, chule thuneina chu a-Christa-a ahitai; ajeh chu isopiteu hehsea chu akilehlha-a ahitai, ama chun i-Pathen henguva amaho chu asun ajana ahehset jingji ahi.
target: Then I heard a loud voice in heaven say: “Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Messiah. For the accuser of our brothers and sisters, who accuses them before our God day and night, has been hurled down.

source: Chule amahon Kelngoinou thisan vangle ahettohsah thu-u vanga ama chu ajokhup dingu ahitai; chule amahon thi geija ahinkho itcha louhel ahiuve.
target: They triumphed over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony; they did not love their lives so much as to shrink from death.

source: Hijeh chun, Vo vanho chule asunga cheng chengse, kipah thanomun; leisetle twikhanglen chu ada naove; ajeh chu diabol nahengu hung geisuh ahitai, phat chom chabou anei chu ahen, lunghan chungnunga lunghanga ahi, ati.
target: Therefore rejoice, you heavens and you who dwell in them! But woe to the earth and the sea, because the devil has gone down to you! He is filled with fury, because he knows that his time is short.”

source: Chuin dragon chun leija akilelhah chu amun, hichun acha soh-a chapa khat hinga numeinu chu abolsetan ahi.
target: When the dragon saw that he had been hurled to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.

source: Chuin numeinu chu ama mun gamthip lama chu gul chun amu phah louna-a alenmang theina dingin, mulaopi lhaving ni akipen ahi; hikoma chu phat khat, phat ni chule phat keh khat geija kivahdoh ahi.
target: The woman was given the two wings of a great eagle, so that she might fly to the place prepared for her in the wilderness, where she would be taken care of for a time, times and half a time, out of the serpent’s reach.

source: Hichun gul chun twi lhohsah theina dingin akamsunga konin numeinu nungsanga chun luipidung tobang leuvin twi aphidoh tan ahi.
target: Then from his mouth the serpent spewed water like a river, to overtake the woman and sweep her away with the torrent.

source: Ahinla vannoi leisetnin numeinu chu anahun, chuleh leiset in akam anakahomin, gul'in akamsunga kona aphidoh twi luipidung chu anaval jouhel tan ahi.
target: But the earth helped the woman by opening its mouth and swallowing the river that the dragon had spewed out of his mouth.

source: Chutah chun gul chu numeinu chunga chun alunghangin, amanu chilhah ho Pathen thupeh nitle Jesu Christa thu hettohsah jop amoh chengse chutoh kisat dingin akondohtan ahi.
target: Then the dragon was enraged at the woman and went off to wage war against the rest of her offspring—those who keep God’s commands and hold fast their testimony about Jesus.

source: Chutia keima twikhanglen neldi lah-a kadin chun twikhanglen'a kona sahem khat ahung kipatdoh kamui; ama chu aki som ahin, alu sagi ahi; akihoa chun lallukhuh som aume, chule aluho-a chun Pathen taitomna minho aume.
target: The dragon stood on the shore of the sea. And I saw a beast coming out of the sea. It had ten horns and seven heads, with ten crowns on its horns, and on each head a blasphemous name.

source: Hiche sahem kamu chu lutnu toh abangin, akengho chu vompi kengtoh abangin, chule akam chu keipi kamtoh abange; chule dragon chun athahatle alaltouna chule athuneina chungnung ama chu apetan ahi.
target: The beast I saw resembled a leopard, but had feet like those of a bear and a mouth like that of a lion. The dragon gave the beast his power and his throne and great authority.

source: Chujou chun keiman kamui, chuche aluho lah-a khat chu thihela kisat lheh lheh ahi, ahin thihela akisatna chu kiledoh ahitai; chule vannoi pumpin kidangin amuvin ajuitaove;
target: One of the heads of the beast seemed to have had a fatal wound, but the fatal wound had been healed. The whole world was filled with wonder and followed the beast.

source: chule sahem chu athuneina apeh jeh chun mihon dragon chu ahouvun, Hiche sahem tobang koiham? Koiham amatoh kisat thei dinga, atiuvin ahi.
target: People worshiped the dragon because he had given authority to the beast, and they also worshiped the beast and asked, “Who is like the beast? Who can wage war against it?”

source: Hitichun hamhoithonale Pathen taitom na-a thuseina kam apeuvin; chule lha som lile lha ni geija thilbol dingin thahat thuneina apetaovin ahi.
target: The beast was given a mouth to utter proud words and blasphemies and to exercise its authority for forty-two months.

source: Chutah chun Pathen taitom na-in akamkatan ahi, aminle, achenna, chule van'a chengho jouse ataitomtan ahi.
target: It opened its mouth to blaspheme God, and to slander his name and his dwelling place and those who live in heaven.

source: Chule mithengho toh kisat dingle amaho chu jou dinga ama chu thahat kipe-a ahi; chule ama chu phungtin leh mite tincheng chule paotin paotangle chitin namtin chunga thuneina kipe-a ahitai.
target: It was given power to wage war against God’s holy people and to conquer them. And it was given authority over every tribe, people, language and nation.

source: Chule leiset chunga chenga mi jousen ama chu ahou dingu ahi; leiset bul kiphudoh tila patna akithatsa Kelngoinou hinna lekhabu sunga amin kisun louho chengse chun.
target: All inhabitants of the earth will worship the beast—all whose names have not been written in the Lamb’s book of life, the Lamb who was slain from the creation of the world.

source: Nakhang neija aumle ngaihen.
target: Whoever has ears, let them hear.

source: Gal hinga kaidol gal-hinga kikai ding; chemhema mithat aumle chemhema lou ding ahi. Hichea hi mithengho thohhatle tahsan kilanga ahi.
target: “If anyone is to go into captivity, into captivity they will go. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, with the sword they will be killed.” This calls for patient endurance and faithfulness on the part of God’s people.

source: Chuin sahem chom khatma leisetna kona ahungdoh kamun ahi; ama chu kelngoinouva tobang aki ni ahin, chule dragon bang bangin thu aseije.
target: Then I saw a second beast, coming out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb, but it spoke like a dragon.

source: Chule ama chun sahem masapa thuneina jouse chu ama angsunga amangchan ahi. Chule ama chun vannoi leisetle asunga chengho jouse, thihela akisat kiledoh kit sahem masa chu ahousah tan ahi.
target: It exercised all the authority of the first beast on its behalf, and made the earth and its inhabitants worship the first beast, whose fatal wound had been healed.

source: Chuin ama chun melchihna thil nasatahtah abolin, miho mitmun van'a kona leija mei lhahsah geijin abolin ahi.
target: And it performed great signs, even causing fire to come down from heaven to the earth in full view of the people.

source: Chutia chu sahem mitmu-a chu melchihna tintang bolna ding thahat ama chu kipe-a ahi, hichea chu aman vannoi leiset chung chengho asuhlamvai ahi; ama chun leiset chung chengho jah-a, Chemjam'a kisat lem kiledoh kit sahem chu alim khat semun, ati.
target: Because of the signs it was given power to perform on behalf of the first beast, it deceived the inhabitants of the earth. It ordered them to set up an image in honor of the beast who was wounded by the sword and yet lived.

source: Chule sahem lim chun thu asei theina dinga, chule chuche sahem lim chu ahou lou jouse akitha theina dinga, ama chun sahem lim sunga chu hinna hu akhum ding, hichan geija chu thaneina kipe-a ahi.
target: The second beast was given power to give breath to the image of the first beast, so that the image could speak and cause all who refused to worship the image to be killed.

source: Chule ama chun aneo alen, ahao avai, chamlenle soh, hicheng jouse chu akhut jet lamu ahim, achaluva ahima, melchihna chu aban neisah ahi;
target: It also forced all people, great and small, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hands or on their foreheads,

source: chule chuche sahem melchihna, amin chu ahiloule, amin number neilou chun, cho theita lou, joh theita lou ahi.
target: so that they could not buy or sell unless they had the mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of its name.

source: Hichea hin hetna chihna akilange; lungthim theman hiche sahem number chu simhen; ajeh chu hichu mihem number ahi; chule hiche number chu Ja gup le somgup le gup ahi.
target: This calls for wisdom. Let the person who has insight calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. That number is 666.

source: Chujou chun, veuvin, Kelngoinou chu Sion mol chunga chu adin kamun, mi sang ja khatle sangsomli le sangli toh ahi; amaho chu achaluva ama minle a-Pa min kisuna ahi.
target: Then I looked, and there before me was the Lamb, standing on Mount Zion, and with him 144,000 who had his name and his Father’s name written on their foreheads.

source: Chuin van'a konin twi tamtah gin lheh lheh le van gin lheh lheh aw kajan; ka-aw jah chu selangdah tumhon aselangdah cheh atumu gingtoh abangin ahi.
target: And I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of rushing waters and like a loud peal of thunder. The sound I heard was like that of harpists playing their harps.

source: Chule amaho chun laltouna ang le ganhing liho chule upaho anga chun la thah khat asauvin ahi; chule vannoi leisetna kona achohdoh mi sang ja khatle sangsomli le sang liho tailou chu, adang koimacha hiche la chu kichuh them thei lou ahi.
target: And they sang a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.

source: Amaho chu numei chunga kisuboh louhel ahiuve; amaho chu suhkhah loulaihel nungah thengsel ahiuve. Amaho chu kelngoinou chena chana anung nung juileho chu ahiuve. Pathen'a dingle Kelngoinou dinga aga masa tia, amaho chu mihemte lah-a kona kichodoh ahitaove;
target: These are those who did not defile themselves with women, for they remained virgins. They follow the Lamb wherever he goes. They were purchased from among mankind and offered as firstfruits to God and the Lamb.

source: chule amaho chu akam sunguva thujou pot kihekha louhel ahiuvin; Pathen laltouna anga monabei ahiuve.
target: No lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.

source: Chujouvin keiman vanlaijola vantil leng lele khat kamui; ama chun leiset chunga cheng, chitin namtinle, phungtin, chule paotin paotangle, miteho henga seiphongle dinga tantih neilou Kipana Thupha anei ahin,
target: Then I saw another angel flying in midair, and he had the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who live on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language and people.

source: ama chun aw nasatah-in asamin, Pathen gingun, aloupije chu vahchoijun; ajeh chu athutan avaihom phat ahung lhungtan ahi; chule vanle, lei, twikhanglen, twinah jouse, hichengse sema chu houvun chibaijun, ati.
target: He said in a loud voice, “Fear God and give him glory, because the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heavens, the earth, the sea and the springs of water.”

source: Chuin vantil anina achom khat ama nung nunga chun achelen, Ajonthanhoi jeh-a lunghanna lengpi ju chitin namtinle phungtin donsah-a Babylon khopi chungnung tah chu achimtai, achimtai, ati.
target: A second angel followed and said, “ ‘Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the Great,’ which made all the nations drink the maddening wine of her adulteries.”

source: Chuche jou chun vantil thumna chun amani nung nung chu ajuijin hatah-in asamin, Koi hile sahem chule alim chu houva chibai boh-a, chule achala ahim, akhut ahima, amelchihna kinamdoh chu kilah-ah aumle,
target: A third angel followed them and said in a loud voice: “If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives its mark on their forehead or on their hand,

source: ama jong chun Pathen lunghanna khona chu alunghana lengpi ju imatoh hal louhel gotsa kikoi chu adon tei ding ahi; chule vantil thengho mitmule Kelngoinou mitmu-a chu meile kath kah nat athoh gim dingu ahi;
target: they, too, will drink the wine of God’s fury, which has been poured full strength into the cup of his wrath. They will be tormented with burning sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and of the Lamb.

source: amaho nat thohgim meikhu chu a-imatih chana kitungdoh jing jenga ahi; chule chuche sahem chule alim chu houva chibai boh-a chule koi hile amin melchihna kilah chan chu, asun ajana oltih nei louhel ahiuve.
target: And the smoke of their torment will rise for ever and ever. There will be no rest day or night for those who worship the beast and its image, or for anyone who receives the mark of its name.”

source: Hichea hin Pathen thupeh hole Jesu tahsan thu nit mithengho thohhatje thu akilangin ahi.
target: This calls for patient endurance on the part of the people of God who keep his commands and remain faithful to Jesus.

source: Chuin van'a aw ahung gingin, Sunin, tukala Pakai mina thiho chengse chu anunnoma ahiuve; ahi, amaho chu atohgim naova kona cholnga ding ahiuvin, anatoh chengun anungu ajui ahi jeh chun, tia Lhagaovin kajah-a asei chu kajan ahi.
target: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Write this: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “they will rest from their labor, for their deeds will follow them.”

source: Chuin kavetle, veuvin, meibang khat chule achunga chu mihem chapa lheh lheh, alua sana lukhuh kikhuh-a, akhutna koite hemtah khat kichoija tou kamun ahi.
target: I looked, and there before me was a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was one like a son of man with a crown of gold on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.

source: Chuin houin sunga kon chun vantil chom dang khat ahung potdoh-in meibang chunga toupa jah-a chun aw sangtah-in asamin, Nakoite paninlang chang attan, nang dingin a-at phat ahitai; vannoi leiset chang aminin akoitai, ati.
target: Then another angel came out of the temple and called in a loud voice to him who was sitting on the cloud, “Take your sickle and reap, because the time to reap has come, for the harvest of the earth is ripe.”

source: Chuin meibang chunga toupa chun vannoi leiset chungah akoite alamtan ahile, hichun vannoi leiset chang aki-at tan ahi.
target: So he who was seated on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.

source: Chuin van'a houin sunga kon chun vantil chom khat ahung potdoh kitleuvin; ama jong chun koite hemtah khat aneijin ahi.
target: Another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharp sickle.

source: Chuin vantil chomdang khat mei chunga thuneija chu maichama konin ahung potdoh-in, koite hemtah choipa jah-a chun aw sangtah-in asamin, Nakoite hemtah chu paninlang vannoi leiset lengpiga abohho at khomtan; aminsoh ahitah jeh khun, ati.
target: Still another angel, who had charge of the fire, came from the altar and called in a loud voice to him who had the sharp sickle, “Take your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the earth’s vine, because its grapes are ripe.”

source: Chuphat chun vantil chun akoite apanin vannoi leiset lengpiga abohho chu a-at khomin, Pathen lunghanna lengpiga hehna len chungnung khuh sunga chun asep luttan ahi.
target: The angel swung his sickle on the earth, gathered its grapes and threw them into the great winepress of God’s wrath.

source: Chule khopi polama lengpiga hehna khuh sunga chun achilun ahile, lengpiga hehna khuh sunga kon chun thisan ahung sohdoh-in, ching sang khatle ching ja gup geijin sakol kamdal chan gei aphan ahi.
target: They were trampled in the winepress outside the city, and blood flowed out of the press, rising as high as the horses’ bridles for a distance of 1,600 stadia.
