source: Chujou chun keiman van'ah melchihna thil kidang chungnung tah achom khat suhgentheina nukhah sagi neija vantil sagi kamun; hicheng chu suhgentheina kichaina ahi; ajeh chu Pathen lunghan hichenga chu kichaisoh ahi.
target: I saw in heaven another great and marvelous sign: seven angels with the seven last plagues—last, because with them God’s wrath is completed.

source: Chuin meitoh kichoh hal phatvet twikhanglen tobang khat kamun; sahem chule alim chule amelchihna chule amin Number chu neh jouva, chuchenga kona kihuh dohho chengse chu Pathen selangdah akichoijuva, phatvet tobang twikhanglen panga chu adin jingu kamun ahi.
target: And I saw what looked like a sea of glass glowing with fire and, standing beside the sea, those who had been victorious over the beast and its image and over the number of its name. They held harps given them by God

source: Amaho chun Pathen soh Mosi la chule Kelngoinou la chu asauvin, Vo ijakai, bol thei Pakai Pathen, nangma thilbol hi aloupin akidange; Vo mithengte Lengpa, nangma lampi adih-in akitah-e.
target: and sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: “Great and marvelous are your deeds, Lord God Almighty. Just and true are your ways, King of the nations.

source: Pakai, koiham nakicha lou dinga? Chule nangma min vahchoi lou dinga koiham? Ajeh chu nangma jengbou atheng nahi; ajeh chu nangma chonphat thilbol kiphon jeh-a hi chitin namtin nangma anga hung kun cheh ding ahi, atiuve.
target: Who will not fear you, Lord, and bring glory to your name? For you alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before you, for your righteous acts have been revealed.”

source: Hiche jou chun, veuvin, van'a hettohsahna houin dan sungnung Mun Theng chu akihon kamun;
target: After this I looked, and I saw in heaven the temple—that is, the tabernacle of the covenant law—and it was opened.

source: chule houin'a kon chun suhgentheina sagi chunga thuneija vantil sagi chu ahung potdoh-un, tonjih ponnem manlutah athena thengin akivonun, sana konggah a-om uvah akikouvin ahi.
target: Out of the temple came the seven angels with the seven plagues. They were dressed in clean, shining linen and wore golden sashes around their chests.

source: Chuin ganhing liho lah-a khat chun vantil sagiho chu a-imatih chana hing jing Pathen lunghanna dimset sana sumlheng sagi apetan ahi.
target: Then one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls filled with the wrath of God, who lives for ever and ever.

source: Hichun Pathen loupinale thunei na-a kon meikhu chu houin sung chu adimset jengtan ahi; chule vantil sagi chun suhgentheina sagi chu abulhit masangseu chun koimacha houin sunga chun alut theipon ahi.
target: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.

source: Chujouvin houin sunga kon chun vantil sagiho jah-a, Nangho cheovinlang Pathen lunghanna sumlheng sagi chu vannoi leiset chungah gabung lha uvin, tia hasaptah-a kisam aw kajan ahi.
target: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, “Go, pour out the seven bowls of God’s wrath on the earth.”

source: Hichun vantil amasapen chu achen vannoi leiset chunga asumlheng chu abunglhatan ahi; hichun sahem melchihna neile alim houva chibai boh miho tichunga chun anat hoisetah tina achutan ahi.
target: The first angel went and poured out his bowl on the land, and ugly, festering sores broke out on the people who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image.

source: Chuin vantil anina chun twikhanglen'a asumlheng abunglhan ahile; hichu mithi thisan bangin thisan asohtan ahi; chule ganhing jouse abonchan athigamtan ahi.
target: The second angel poured out his bowl on the sea, and it turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.

source: Chuin vantil athumna chun luidungle twinahho jouse-a asumlheng abunglhan ahile; hichun hichu thisan asohtan ahi.
target: The third angel poured out his bowl on the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.

source: Chuphat chun twi vantil chun hitia asei kajai, Vo Pakai, Nang Auma, Aumsa, chule Thengtah, Dihtah nahi; hicheng jeh-a chu nangman hitia hi thu natan ahitai;
target: Then I heard the angel in charge of the waters say: “You are just in these judgments, O Holy One, you who are and who were;

source: Ajeh chu amaho mithenghole themgaoho thisan anasou ahi; hijeh-a chu nangman jong amahon adon dinguva thisan napeh ahitai; hichu amaho chandia lomtah ahi, ati.
target: for they have shed the blood of your holy people and your prophets, and you have given them blood to drink as they deserve.”

source: Chujou chun maichama kona hitia kisei chomkhat kajan ahi, Ahi, Pakai Pathen, Hat chungnung, nangma thutan vaihom chengse hi akitah-in chule adihsoh keije, ati.
target: And I heard the altar respond: “Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are your judgments.”

source: Chuin vantil alina chun nisa chunga asumlheng abunglhan ahile; hichun miho chu meija asahgop dingin thuneina apetaovin ahi.
target: The fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and the sun was allowed to scorch people with fire.

source: Chuin miho chu asajapjappi chun asanggoptan ahile, hiche suhgentheina sagi chunga thunei Pathen min chu ataitomun, aloupina chu vahchoi dingin alungu aheipouvin ahi.
target: They were seared by the intense heat and they cursed the name of God, who had control over these plagues, but they refused to repent and glorify him.

source: Chuin vantil angana chun sahem laltouna chunga asumlheng abunglhan ahile; hichun agamsung mu athimsohtan; chule amaho chun anat thohlel jeh-un alei apettaovin ahi;
target: The fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into darkness. People gnawed their tongues in agony

source: chule anat thohgim ule atina thohlel jeh-u chun van'a Pathen ataitomun, achonnau athilbol uva konin alung aheipouvin ahi.
target: and cursed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, but they refused to repent of what they had done.

source: Chuin vantil agupna chun Euphrates luipi-a asumlheng abunglhan ahile; hichun nisona lama kona hung ding lengho dinga lampi gotsa aum theina dingin, chuche luipi dung twi chu akangtan ahi.
target: The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up to prepare the way for the kings from the East.

source: Chuphat chun dragon kam sunga konle sahem kam sunga kon chun, chule themgao lhem kam sunga kon chun uphoh tobang lhagao boh thum ahungdoh kamun ahi.
target: Then I saw three impure spirits that looked like frogs; they came out of the mouth of the dragon, out of the mouth of the beast and out of the mouth of the false prophet.

source: Hitiho chu thilhaho lhagao ahiuvin, melchihna kidang dang, vetsah ahiuve; amaho chun imajouse bolthei Hat chungnung Pathen, nikho loupi chungnung ni-a galsat dinga vannoi leiset pumpi-a lengho kikhopsah dinga, amaho henga chu chea ahiuve.
target: They are demonic spirits that perform signs, and they go out to the kings of the whole world, to gather them for the battle on the great day of God Almighty.

source: Veuvin, keima gucha bangin kahunge. Koi hile kihong jinga sagoh-a auma ajachat kiphon louna dinga aponsil kivetphat jing mi chu anunnom ahi.
target: “Look, I come like a thief! Blessed is the one who stays awake and remains clothed, so as not to go naked and be shamefully exposed.”

source: Chuin amaho chun Hebrai paova Armageddon atiu mun laija chun amaho chu akikhopsah taovin ahi.
target: Then they gathered the kings together to the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.

source: Chuin vantil asagina chun vanlaijola asumlheng abunglhan ahile, hichun van houin'a konle laltouna-a konin, Akichaitai, tin aw sangtah ahung soh-in ahi.
target: The seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and out of the temple came a loud voice from the throne, saying, “It is done!”

source: Hichun kol aphen, aw agingin, van agingin ahitai, chule vannoi leiset chunga mihem umtilla patna chutobang lingpi kihotkha louhel, hitobangtah chun ling akihottan ahi.
target: Then there came flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder and a severe earthquake. No earthquake like it has ever occurred since mankind has been on earth, so tremendous was the quake.

source: Hichun khopi chung nung chu hop thum akisotai, chule chidang namdangte khopi chengse chu achim lhagamtan ahi; chule Pathen lunghan chung nungna lengpiga ju khon chu peh dingin, Babylon khopi chungnung chu Pathen anga geldoh jingin aumtan ahi.
target: The great city split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed. God remembered Babylon the Great and gave her the cup filled with the wine of the fury of his wrath.

source: Chule twikol gam jouse ajam manggam tan, molle lhangho jong akiholmotan ahi.
target: Every island fled away and the mountains could not be found.

source: Chuin mihemte chunga, van'a konin agih talent khat toh kikot gel len nasatah alhan; hiche gelpi chun asuhgam jeh-u chun mihem ten Pathen ataitom taovin ahi; ijeh ham itile hichu nasa behseh jenga ahi.
target: From the sky huge hailstones, each weighing about a hundred pounds, fell on people. And they cursed God on account of the plague of hail, because the plague was so terrible.

source: Chujouvin sumlheng sagi choija vantil sagiho lah-a khat chu kahenga ahungin, eikihoupin, kajah-a, Hungin, twi tamtah chunga tou notinu matding talen chu vetsah ingkate;
target: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute, who sits by many waters.

source: Amanu chutoh leiset lengho ajong taovin, chule ajonthanhoina lengpiga ju-a vannoi leiset chung chengho akham ngolsah soh gamtan ahi.
target: With her the kings of the earth committed adultery, and the inhabitants of the earth were intoxicated with the wine of her adulteries.”

source: Hiche chun ama chun, Lhagaovin gamthip lama eipuitan ahi. Hichun, Pathen taitomna min dimset, chule alu sagi, aki som nei, sahem santhip chunga tou numei khat kamun ahi.
target: Then the angel carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. There I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was covered with blasphemous names and had seven heads and ten horns.

source: Hiche numeinu chun pon sanduple ponsanthip asilin, sana, khisong mantam jengle twikohchangin akijemin; chule akhutna chun thil thet umtahle ajonthanhoina bohnen dimset sana khon khat akichoijin ahi;
target: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and was glittering with gold, precious stones and pearls. She held a golden cup in her hand, filled with abominable things and the filth of her adulteries.

source: chule achala chun hiche min hi akisune, THUGIL, BABYLON KHOPI CHUNGNUNG, VANNOI LEISET NOTI HO LE THILTHET UMTAHHO NU.
target: The name written on her forehead was a mystery: babylon the great the mother of prostitutes and of the abominations of the earth.

source: Chule numeinu chu mithengho thisanle Jesu thu hettohsah ho thisana kham ngolin kamun ahi. Amanu chu kamun kidang kasa behseh jengin ahi.
target: I saw that the woman was drunk with the blood of God’s holy people, the blood of those who bore testimony to Jesus. When I saw her, I was greatly astonished.

source: Hichun vantil chun kajah-a, Ibola kidang nasah ham? Khuche numeinu le apuilea, alu sagi, aki som nei, sahem thuguh khu seipeh-inge.
target: Then the angel said to me: “Why are you astonished? I will explain to you the mystery of the woman and of the beast she rides, which has the seven heads and ten horns.

source: Sahem namu khu aumsa ahin, umtalou ahi, ama lei-onga kona hung kaltouna manthah na-a che ding ahi. Chule vannoi leiset kisem tila patna hinna lekhabua amin kisun lou, leiset chung chenghon aumsa, tu-a umtalou, khonunga hung umding sahem chu amu tengule, ama chu adatmo lheh dingu ahi.
target: The beast, which you saw, once was, now is not, and yet will come up out of the Abyss and go to its destruction. The inhabitants of the earth whose names have not been written in the book of life from the creation of the world will be astonished when they see the beast, because it once was, now is not, and yet will come.

source: Hichea hin chihna lungthim them thu aume. Alu sagi chu mol sagi ahi; hicheng chunga chu hiche numeinu chu touva ahi;
target: “This calls for a mind with wisdom. The seven heads are seven hills on which the woman sits.

source: chule hicheng chu leng sagi jong ahiuve; amaho lah-a nga chu alhusa ahitan, khat aumpet ahi, chule khat vang chu um loulai ahi; ama chu um jongle chomcha khatbou umding ahi.
target: They are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, the other has not yet come; but when he does come, he must remain for only a little while.

source: Chule chuche sahem, aumsa, umtalou chu, amatah chu agetna ahi, chule sagiho loija mi mama khat ahi; ama chu manthah na lama che ding ahi.
target: The beast who once was, and now is not, is an eighth king. He belongs to the seven and is going to his destruction.

source: Chule nangman aki som namu chu leng som ahi; amaho chu tua gam nei loulaiho ahiuve; ahinla nidan kah khat sunga dinga sahem chutoh thakhat tah-a gam vaipohna thu anei khom dingu ahi.
target: “The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but who for one hour will receive authority as kings along with the beast.

source: Amaho chu thu khat akisauvin athahat naole athuneinau hiche sahem chu apeuve.
target: They have one purpose and will give their power and authority to the beast.

source: Amaho chu Kelngoinou chutoh kisat ding ahiuve; hintin Kelngoinou chun amaho chu ajo ding; ajeh chu ama pakaiho Pakai le lengho Leng ahi, chule aumpiho chengse jong akikoule lhenchom chule tahsantah cheh ahiuve, ati.
target: They will wage war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will triumph over them because he is Lord of lords and King of kings—and with him will be his called, chosen and faithful followers.”

source: Chuin ama mama chun kajah-a, Nangman namu twi tamtah notinu touna chu twiho chu mitehole mipi chule namtin vaipi, chule paotin paotangho ahiuve.
target: Then the angel said to me, “The waters you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations and languages.

source: Chule namu ki som chule sahem chun notinu chu ahot dingu, chule imacha nei louhel le sagohkeova alha dingu, chule meija agovam dingu ahi.
target: The beast and the ten horns you saw will hate the prostitute. They will bring her to ruin and leave her naked; they will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.

source: Ajeh chu Pathen thu guilhun kahse-a alunggot suhbukimna dinga amaho chu lung khat ahiuve, agam cheh-u sahem chu apehna dinguva, Pathen'in alungu achothou ahi.
target: For God has put it into their hearts to accomplish his purpose by agreeing to hand over to the beast their royal authority, until God’s words are fulfilled.

source: Chule nangman namu numeinu chu, vannoi leiset leng jouse chunga vaipo, khopi chungnung chu ahi, ati.
target: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.”

source: Hiche jou chun vantil thuneitah achom khat van'a kona ahung kumlhah kamun; aloupi chun vanle leiset asalvah soh jengin ahi.
target: After this I saw another angel coming down from heaven. He had great authority, and the earth was illuminated by his splendor.

source: Ama chun aw sang chungnung tah-in, Babylon khopi chungnung chu achimtai, achimtai; thilhaho chennale lhagao bohho jouse kihen khomna, chule vacha boh thet umtahho kihenna bom asohtai.
target: With a mighty voice he shouted: “ ‘Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the Great!’ She has become a dwelling for demons and a haunt for every impure spirit, a haunt for every unclean bird, a haunt for every unclean and detestable animal.

source: Ajeh iham itile amanu ajon thanhoija kona lung hanna lengpiga ju-a chu chitin namtin kisep lhu gama ahi; vannoi leiset lengho amanu chutoh ajong thanghoi jun, chule amanu nomsah vala kona vannoi leiset sumkolvei ho haodoh gama ahiuve; tin asamin ahi.
target: For all the nations have drunk the maddening wine of her adulteries. The kings of the earth committed adultery with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from her excessive luxuries.”

source: Chujou chun van'a kona hitia kisei hi aw achom khat kajan ahi, Vo kamite, nangho amanu chonsetna chu nachan khah louna dingule, amanutoh nakisuh gamtha louna dingun, amanu-a kon chun hungdoh-un.
target: Then I heard another voice from heaven say: “ ‘Come out of her, my people,’ so that you will not share in her sins, so that you will not receive any of her plagues;

source: Ajeh chu amanu chonset van'ah akidong heltan ahi; athemona chengse Pathen'in ageldoh ahitai.
target: for her sins are piled up to heaven, and God has remembered her crimes.

source: Amanun napeh bang bangu chun nanghon jong amanu chu lethuh-un; chule ama thilbol dungjui jin ajat ni-a ajat nin phulah-un; achopolna khona chun ajat nin chopol peh-un.
target: Give back to her as she has given; pay her back double for what she has done. Pour her a double portion from her own cup.

source: Akiloupi sahle akinomsah val bang bangin sugenthei jun, sulunghemun; ajeh iham itile amanun alungthimin, Keima lengnu-a tou kahin, meithai kahipoi; itihchan hijongle lunghem ni mu lou ding kahi, ati.
target: Give her as much torment and grief as the glory and luxury she gave herself. In her heart she boasts, ‘I sit enthroned as queen. I am not a widow; I will never mourn.’

source: Hijeh-a chu thina, lunghem, chule gilkel, hicheng chun asuhgentheina-a amanu chunga ni khat lhuna lhung ding ahi; chule amanu chu meija kigouvam ding ahi; ajeh iham itile amanu chunga thutana Pakai Pathen chu chungnung tah ahi.
target: Therefore in one day her plagues will overtake her: death, mourning and famine. She will be consumed by fire, for mighty is the Lord God who judges her.

source: Chule vannoi leiset lengho, amanu jonpiho chengsele nomsahpi ho chengse chun, amanu kigona meikhu chu amu tengule, amanu chu kacham-untin a-op achup chup jeng dingu ahi;
target: “When the kings of the earth who committed adultery with her and shared her luxury see the smoke of her burning, they will weep and mourn over her.

source: chule amanu nat thoh gim chu kicha-a gamlatah-a dinga, Ohe! Ohe! Babylon khopi chungnung, khopi dettah, nadanave! Nidan kah khat sungin nachunga thu kitanna alhungmai jengtai, ati dingu ahi.
target: Terrified at her torment, they will stand far off and cry: “ ‘Woe! Woe to you, great city, you mighty city of Babylon! In one hour your doom has come!’

source: Chule vannoi leiset sumkolvei ho jousen amanu akauvin, alhasetpi lheh jengun ahi; ajeh chu amaho kiveina thil:
target: “The merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her because no one buys their cargoes anymore—

source: sana, dangka, khisong mantam, twikohchang, tonjih pon, ponsandup, lungpon, ponsanthip, thing namtui mantam jouse, chule thing kongle bel jouse, chule thing manlu-a, sum-enga, thihle, songvala kisem kongle bel jouse;
target: cargoes of gold, silver, precious stones and pearls; fine linen, purple, silk and scarlet cloth; every sort of citron wood, and articles of every kind made of ivory, costly wood, bronze, iron and marble;

source: thingthal, aisaga, thingnai gimnamtui, kinu ding thao namtui, bego, lengpiga ju, Olive thao, changbong, suhlou chang, bongle kelngoi, sakol, kangtalai, soh, chule mihem hinkho hichengse chu koiman achohpeh tahlou jeh chun.
target: cargoes of cinnamon and spice, of incense, myrrh and frankincense, of wine and olive oil, of fine flour and wheat; cattle and sheep; horses and carriages; and human beings sold as slaves.

source: Chule nangaichat nalhangai gaho chengse chu nanga kona chemang gama chule ahoile thilval chengse kisuhmangpeh nahitai; mi koiman hitiho chu itihchan hijongle amu lou ding ahitai.
target: “They will say, ‘The fruit you longed for is gone from you. All your luxury and splendor have vanished, never to be recovered.’

source: Thil chuchenga amanu haova kona haodoh sumkolvei ho chengsen amanu nat thohgim chu kichan, gamlatah-a adingun amanu chu akachamun alhaset piuvin,
target: The merchants who sold these things and gained their wealth from her will stand far off, terrified at her torment. They will weep and mourn

source: Ohe! Ohe! tonjih ponnemle ponsandup chule ponsanthip kisila, chule sana khisong mantam chule twikohchanga kijem, khopi chungnung nadanave!
target: and cry out: “ ‘Woe! Woe to you, great city, dressed in fine linen, purple and scarlet, and glittering with gold, precious stones and pearls!

source: Nidan khat sungin nei le gou hijatpi amanghel jengtan ahi, atiuve. Chule kongtol miho jouse, kong'a kitolla muntina vahlehole kong khao lhaleho chule twikhanglen'a kilonho chengse, hiteho chengse chu gamlatah-a adingun,
target: In one hour such great wealth has been brought to ruin!’ “Every sea captain, and all who travel by ship, the sailors, and all who earn their living from the sea, will stand far off.

source: amanu kigona meikhu chu amuvin, Hiche khopi chungnung toh kibang hoija ipi khopi umam, tin asamun ahi.
target: When they see the smoke of her burning, they will exclaim, ‘Was there ever a city like this great city?’

source: Chule amaho chun alu chunguva leivui akithe khumun kapkaple lhasetah-in, Ohe! Ohe! khuche khopi sum hao vanga twikhanglen'a um kong neoho haodohna khopi chungnung chu adanave! Nidan khat sungin amangdel jengtan ahi, tin asamui.
target: They will throw dust on their heads, and with weeping and mourning cry out: “ ‘Woe! Woe to you, great city, where all who had ships on the sea became rich through her wealth! In one hour she has been brought to ruin!’

source: Vo nangho, vanle mithengho chule solchah ho le themgaoho, nangho amanu chungchanga khun kipah thanomun; ajeh chu nangho chunga thu kitan chu Pathen'in amanu chunga thu atan ahitai.
target: “Rejoice over her, you heavens! Rejoice, you people of God! Rejoice, apostles and prophets! For God has judged her with the judgment she imposed on you.”

source: Chujouvin vantil hat chungnung tah khatnin sumhei lheh lheh song lentah khat adomin twikhanglen'ah aseplhan, Hiche banga hi Babylon khopi chungnung chu hase-a kiseplha ding ahi; khonungle itihchan hijongle kimu kit talouhel ding ahi.
target: Then a mighty angel picked up a boulder the size of a large millstone and threw it into the sea, and said: “With such violence the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to be found again.

source: Chule selangdah tumho selangdah tumgin, lathemho lasah, sumkuli mut teho mutgin, chule sumkon mut teho sumkon gin a-imatih chana nalah uva kijata louhel ding ahi; chule khut thema khut them nalah uva kimuta louhel ding ahitai; sumhei gin jong nalah uva kijata lou ding ahi;
target: The music of harpists and musicians, pipers and trumpeters, will never be heard in you again. No worker of any trade will ever be found in you again. The sound of a millstone will never be heard in you again.

source: a-imatih chana nalah-a meivah kivahta louhel ding ahi, chule nalah-a mounule moulang aw kijadohta louhel ding ahi; hichu nasumkolveiho chu vannoi leiset pipuho milen milal ahiuva, chule nangma doi choija namtin vaipi alamvai jeh ahi.
target: The light of a lamp will never shine in you again. The voice of bridegroom and bride will never be heard in you again. Your merchants were the world’s important people. By your magic spell all the nations were led astray.

source: Chule themgaoho le mithengho thisan chule leiset chunga kithat jouse thisan aboncha hiche sunga hi kimudoh ahi.
target: In her was found the blood of prophets and of God’s holy people, of all who have been slaughtered on the earth.”

source: Hicheng jou chun van'ah mipi atama tam aw gin lheh lheh nasatah kajan, Halleluijah; huhhingnale loupina chule thahat thuneina Pakai i-Pathen'uva ahi;
target: After this I heard what sounded like the roar of a great multitude in heaven shouting: “Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God,

source: ama thutan vaihom akitah jehle adih jeh ahi; ajeh chu ajon thanhoija leiset suchavaija noti lennu chu aman athu atanin, amanu khutna atanin, amanu khutna kon asohte phu chu alatan ahi, atiuve.
target: for true and just are his judgments. He has condemned the great prostitute who corrupted the earth by her adulteries. He has avenged on her the blood of his servants.”

source: Chuin avel velin, halleluijah, atiuve. Chule amanu khu chu tonsot geija kitungdoh jing jeng ding ahitai.
target: And again they shouted: “Hallelujah! The smoke from her goes up for ever and ever.”

source: Chujou chun upa somni le liho chule ganhing liho chun laltouna-a tou Pathen chu ahouvun, Amen, Halleluijah, atiuvin ahi.
target: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God, who was seated on the throne. And they cried: “Amen, Hallelujah!”

source: Chuin laltouna-a kon chun aw khat ahung sohdoh-in, Vo Pathen sohteho, ama ginga nangho chengse alen aneo nabonchaovin, Pathen chibaijun vahchoijun, ati.
target: Then a voice came from the throne, saying: “Praise our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, both great and small!”

source: Chujou chun mipi atama tam aw gin tobangle twi tamtah lon gin tobang, chule van gin tobangin kajan, Halleluijah; I-Pakaiyu Pathen, Hatchung nungin, vai apohtah jeh hin.
target: Then I heard what sounded like a great multitude, like the roar of rushing waters and like loud peals of thunder, shouting: “Hallelujah! For our Lord God Almighty reigns.

source: Hungun, kipa thanop boluhitin, aloupina vahchoi uhite; ajeh chu Kelngoinou chu ajineina ding aphat ahitai; aji dingnu chu kigosa dema uma ahitai.
target: Let us rejoice and be glad and give him glory! For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his bride has made herself ready.

source: Chule aji dingnu chu akijepna ding tonjih ponbang, ngimsel val lailai, kipe-a ahitai; hiche tonjih ponnem chu mithengho chonphatna ahi.
target: Fine linen, bright and clean, was given her to wear.” (Fine linen stands for the righteous acts of God’s holy people.)

source: Chuin ama chun kajah-a Kelngoinou ji kipuina golvahna-a kikouho chu anunnom ahiuve, tin sunin, eiti. Chuin ama mama chun kajah-a, Hicheng hi Pathen thu dihtah ahi, ati.
target: Then the angel said to me, “Write this: Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb!” And he added, “These are the true words of God.”

source: Hichun keima ama chu hou dingin akho bulah kaboh khuptan ahi. Chuin aman, Chingtheijin, hitobang chu bol hih-in; keima nasoh chanpi chule Jesu thu hettohsah nasopiteho soh chanpi kahibouve; Pathen jengbou nahou ding ahi, ajeh chu Jesu thu hettohsah chu gao thu seidoh lhagao ahi, ati.
target: At this I fell at his feet to worship him. But he said to me, “Don’t do that! I am a fellow servant with you and with your brothers and sisters who hold to the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For it is the Spirit of prophecy who bears testimony to Jesus.”

source: Chuin keiman van kot kihon kamun ahi; chule, veuvin, achunga toupa chu amin Tahsan umle Dihtah akitin ahi; ama chu chon dihtah-a thutan vaihoma chule galsat ahi.
target: I saw heaven standing open and there before me was a white horse, whose rider is called Faithful and True. With justice he judges and wages war.

source: Ama chu amit meikong ahin, alua lallukhuh tamtah kikhuh ahi, chule amin khat akisunin, amin chu ama tailou koimacha dangin ahepoi.
target: His eyes are like blazing fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has a name written on him that no one knows but he himself.

source: Chule aponsil chu thisan kithe khuma ahi; chule amin chu Pathen Thu kitia ahi.
target: He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and his name is the Word of God.

source: Chule van sepaiho chengse tonjih ponneljet vamleng le ngimsel akisilun, sakol kang chunga anung ajuijun ahi.
target: The armies of heaven were following him, riding on white horses and dressed in fine linen, white and clean.

source: Chuin namtin vaipi asatna dingin akam sunga konin chemjam hemtah khat ahungdohtan ahi; ama chun achunguva thih tenggola vai apoh ding ahi; chule Hat chungnung, Pathen lunghanna kichat umtah lengpiga hehna-a jong chu aman achilji ahi.
target: Coming out of his mouth is a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations. “He will rule them with an iron scepter.” He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God Almighty.

source: Chule aponsil chungle amalbuh laija, LENGHO LENGLE PAKAI HO PAKAI, tia min kisun khat aume.
target: On his robe and on his thigh he has this name written: king of kings and lord of lords.

source: Chuin keiman nisa chunga dinga vantil khat kamun; chule ama chun vanlaijola lengle-a vachate jouse jah-a,
target: And I saw an angel standing in the sun, who cried in a loud voice to all the birds flying in midair, “Come, gather together for the great supper of God,

source: Hungun, nanghon lengho sa, sepai lamkaiho sa, ahat apaoho sa, sakolhole achunga touho sa, chamlenle soh ho sa, aneole alenho jouse sa, nedingin Pathen golvahna chungnungah hung kikhomun, tin asamin ahi.
target: so that you may eat the flesh of kings, generals, and the mighty, of horses and their riders, and the flesh of all people, free and slave, great and small.”

source: Chuin sakol chunga toupale asepaiho chutoh kisat dingin, sahem chule leiset lengho chule asepaite chengseutoh akikhomun kamui.
target: Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies gathered together to wage war against the rider on the horse and his army.

source: Chuin sahem chu amantaovin; chule themgao lhem, amitmua melchihna kidang dang bola sahem melchihna kilahhole alim chibai bohho lhemlha-a sulamvaija chutoh amattha taovin ahi; chuin kath meika al-lenglung jing jeng mei dilah ahingin alehlut taovin ahi.
target: But the beast was captured, and with it the false prophet who had performed the signs on its behalf. With these signs he had deluded those who had received the mark of the beast and worshiped its image. The two of them were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur.

source: Chule adang amoh chengse chu sakol chunga toupa kam sunga kona hung potdoh chemjam chun athat gamtan ahi; chuin vachate jouse ahungun asao chu ahung neuvin avaset taovin ahi.
target: The rest were killed with the sword coming out of the mouth of the rider on the horse, and all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.

source: Chuin lei-ong hehnale thihkhao khat choija vantil khat van'a kona ahung kumlhah kamun ahi.
target: And I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key to the Abyss and holding in his hand a great chain.

source: Chuin ama chun dragon, gul lui chu, hichu Diabol le Satan ahin, amanin, chuin akanin kum sangkhat geija dingin lei-onga chun asep luttan ahi;
target: He seized the dragon, that ancient serpent, who is the devil, or Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.

source: chule chuche kum sangkhat chu alhin kahse-a, namtin mite alheplhah thei louna dingin akhachah khumin, asinkhana anam khumtan ahi; chujoule chomkhat dinga kilhadoh ding ahi.
target: He threw him into the Abyss, and locked and sealed it over him, to keep him from deceiving the nations anymore until the thousand years were ended. After that, he must be set free for a short time.

source: Chuin keiman laltouna phabep khat kamun; achunga touho chu thutan vaihom apedoh-un ahi; chule Jesu thu hettohsah jalle Pathen thu jala alu kitanho, chule sahem chule alim chibai boh lou, achal le akhutnuva melchihna kilah-a kichin lou amaho chengse lhagao hing chu kamun ahi; amaho chu ahinga ahitaove, chule kum sangkhat Christa toh vai apo khomui;
target: I saw thrones on which were seated those who had been given authority to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded because of their testimony about Jesus and because of the word of God. They had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received its mark on their foreheads or their hands. They came to life and reigned with Christ a thousand years.

source: hiche kum sangkhat chu alhin masangse-a chu mithiho amoh chengse chu hingdoh lou ahiuve, hichu thokit masa ahi.
target: (The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were ended.) This is the first resurrection.

source: Koi hile hiche thokit masa changkha chu minunnomle atheng ahi; amaho chunga chu thi nina chun thu aneilou ahitai; ahin amaho chu Pathen le Christa thempu hiuva amatoh kum sangkhat vai apoh dingu ahi.
target: Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection. The second death has no power over them, but they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with him for a thousand years.

source: Chule kum sangkhat chu alhin tengle, Satan chu akihena-a kona kilhadoh-a,
target: When the thousand years are over, Satan will be released from his prison

source: vannoi leiset ning li-a cheng namtin, vaipi, twikhanglen'a neldi jat, Gog le Magog chu, doha lhemlha-a galsat dinga, kikhopsah dinga hungdoh ding ahi.
target: and will go out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth—Gog and Magog—and to gather them for battle. In number they are like the sand on the seashore.

source: Chuin amaho chu leivai khahtanin aleilimin akonun mithengho ngahphol le khopi deitah chu aum kimvel taove; hichun van'a Pathen na konin mei ahung lhan amaho chu akavam gamtan ahi.
target: They marched across the breadth of the earth and surrounded the camp of God’s people, the city he loves. But fire came down from heaven and devoured them.

source: Chule amaho lhemlha-a diabol chu meile kath meika dil sunga chun asep lut taove; hiche koma chun sahem chule themgao lhem jong chu aumui; chule amaho cheng chun tonsot tonsot geija asun ajana thohgim nasatah athoh jing dingu ahi.
target: And the devil, who deceived them, was thrown into the lake of burning sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet had been thrown. They will be tormented day and night for ever and ever.

source: Chuin laltouna len chungnung abana bang khatle achunga toupa chu kamun; ama angsunga kon chun vannoi leisetle van ajam mangtan ahi; hiteni ding chun mun akimutapon ahi.
target: Then I saw a great white throne and him who was seated on it. The earth and the heavens fled from his presence, and there was no place for them.

source: Pathen anga chun mithiho jouse alen aneo adin kamun; chujouvin lekhabu phabep khat aphongui; chuin hinna lekhabu atiuvin achom khat jong aphongun ahi; chuin chuche lekhabua kisun dungjui chun mithiho chu ama ama thilbol dungjui cheh-in athu atantaovin ahi.
target: And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne, and books were opened. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged according to what they had done as recorded in the books.

source: Chuphat chun twikhanglen'in ama-a um mithiho jouse chu ahinleh doh-in; chule thinale damunin jong amithiho chengse ahinlehdoh sohkeitaove; chuin athilbol dungjui cheh-in athu atan taovin ahi.
target: The sea gave up the dead that were in it, and death and Hades gave up the dead that were in them, and each person was judged according to what they had done.

source: Chuin thinale damun chu mei dil sunga chun aleh lut taove, hiche chu, thi nina ahi.
target: Then death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. The lake of fire is the second death.

source: Chule hinna lekhabu sunga amin kiholdoh louse chu mei dil sunga chun aleh lut taove. Hiche chu, thi nina ahi.
target: Anyone whose name was not found written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.

source: Chujou chun keiman van thah lei thah kamun ahi; ajeh chu van masale lei masa chu kitol manga ahitai; twikhanglen jong aumtapoi.
target: Then I saw “a new heaven and a new earth,” for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and there was no longer any sea.

source: Chule a-inneipu henga dinga kijema kigosadem mounu banga khopi theng, Jerusalem thah chu, Pathen kom van'a kona ahung kumlhah keima John nin kamun ahi.
target: I saw the Holy City, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride beautifully dressed for her husband.

source: Chuin keiman van'a kon chun, aw sangtah-a thu kisei kajan, Veuvin, Pathen chenna chu mihem lah ahung hitai, chule ama amahotoh cheng khom ding; amaho chu ama mite hi ding ahiuve; chule Pathen amatah mongin aumpi dingu, chule a-Pathen'u hi ding ahi;
target: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying, “Look! God’s dwelling place is now among the people, and he will dwell with them. They will be his people, and God himself will be with them and be their God.

source: chule amit uva amitlhi chengseu atheh ngim ding; chule thina umta louhel ding; chule lhasetnale kana chule nat thohgim umtalou ahi; thil masaho chengse chu kitol mangsoh ahitai, ati.
target: ‘He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death’ or mourning or crying or pain, for the old order of things has passed away.”

source: Chuin laltouna-a toupa chun, Veuvin, keiman ijakai kathahsem sohkeije, ati. Chuin ama chun, kajah-a, sunnin; ajeh chu hicheng hi tahsan umle thutah ahi, ati.
target: He who was seated on the throne said, “I am making everything new!” Then he said, “Write this down, for these words are trustworthy and true.”

source: Chuin ama chun kajah-a, Hichengse chu kichaija ahitai! Keima Alpha leh Omega, akipatna leh akichaina kahi. Adangchah-a chu hinna twinah-a twi chu manbeijin penge.
target: He said to me: “It is done. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To the thirsty I will give water without cost from the spring of the water of life.

source: Ajou chanin hicheng hi alo ding ahi; keima a-pathen hingting, ama kachapa hi ding ahi.
target: Those who are victorious will inherit all this, and I will be their God and they will be my children.

source: Ahin mi kichaseho, tahsan neilouho, thet umho, tolthat teho, jon panho, doi choiho, milim houho, chule mijouho jouse meile kath meika al-lenglung jing jeng mei dila chu achan dingdol cheh chang ding ahiuve; hiche thi nina ahi, ati.
target: But the cowardly, the unbelieving, the vile, the murderers, the sexually immoral, those who practice magic arts, the idolaters and all liars—they will be consigned to the fiery lake of burning sulfur. This is the second death.”

source: Chuin suhgamna nukhah dimset sumlheng sagi nei vantil sagiho lah-a khat chu kahenga ahungin, kajah-a thu aseijin, Hilama hin hungin; keiman nangma Kelngoinou inneipi ding mou chu vetsah inge, ati.
target: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.”

source: Chuin ama chun keima Lhagaovin molsang lentah chungah eilhoh touvin, Pathen kom van'a kona hung kumlha-a, Pathen loupina nei khopi len, Jerusalem theng chu, eimusahtan ahi.
target: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a mountain great and high, and showed me the Holy City, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God.

source: Avahje dan chu khisong man tamtah abangin, jasper song lheh lheh ahin, songval valin avalin;
target: It shone with the glory of God, and its brilliance was like that of a very precious jewel, like a jasper, clear as crystal.

source: akul chu lentah chule sangtah ahin, akot somleni ahi; kot somle ni-a chun vantil somleni aumin; chule min phabep khat chua chun akisunin; hichu Israel chate phung somle phung ni min ahi.
target: It had a great, high wall with twelve gates, and with twelve angels at the gates. On the gates were written the names of the twelve tribes of Israel.

source: Akot chu thumin niso lam angan, thumin sah lam angan, thumin lhang lam angan chule thumin nilhum lam angan ahi.
target: There were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south and three on the west.

source: Chule khopi kul chu akhombul somleni ahin; hicheho chunga chu Kelngoinou solchah somleni ho min chu kisuna ahi.
target: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them were the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

source: Chule khopi chule akotle akul chu tena dingin, kajah-a thuseipa chun gamtena sana tenglhon achoijin ahi.
target: The angel who talked with me had a measuring rod of gold to measure the city, its gates and its walls.

source: Khopi chu aning li kitoh, adung avai kibang ahin ahi. Chuin gamtena tenglhona khopi chu atele, mail sang khatle mail ja nga ahi; adung, avai, atun kibang sohkei ahi.
target: The city was laid out like a square, as long as it was wide. He measured the city with the rod and found it to be 12,000 stadia in length, and as wide and high as it is long.

source: Chujouvin kul chu aten ahile, tong ja khatle tong som lile li ahi; vantil thiltena chu, mihem thil tena jong ahi.
target: The angel measured the wall using human measurement, and it was 144 cubits thick.

source: Chule kul kiget chu jaspi songa kigen ahi, chule khopi chu phatvet thengtah tobang sana thenga kisa-a ahi.
target: The wall was made of jasper, and the city of pure gold, as pure as glass.

source: Khopi khombul song chu khisong mantam jat chom jat choma kijema ahi. Khombul masapen chu jasper khisonga kijem ahin, abana chu sapphir khisong ahin, athumna Chalcedon khisong ahin, alina emerald khisong ahin;
target: The foundations of the city walls were decorated with every kind of precious stone. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third agate, the fourth emerald,

source: Angana sardonyx khisong ahin, agupna sardius khisong ahin, asagina chu chrysol khisong ahin, agetna beryl khisong ahin, akona chu topaz khisong ahin, asomna chu chrysopras khisong ahin, somlekhatna jacinth khisong ahin, somle nina chu amythyst khisong ahi.
target: the fifth onyx, the sixth ruby, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth turquoise, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.

source: Akot somleni chu twikohchang khat khatna kisem ahi. Chule akho sung lamlen chu phatvet thengsel tobang sana theng ahi.
target: The twelve gates were twelve pearls, each gate made of a single pearl. The great street of the city was of gold, as pure as transparent glass.

source: Chule asunga chun houin kamupoi; Pakai Pathen Hat chungnung chule Kelngoinou chu a-houin ahi jeng jeh chun.
target: I did not see a temple in the city, because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.

source: Chule khopi chun asalvah dinga nisa jong ngaita lou, lhathah jong ngaita lou ahi; ajeh chu Pathen loupi chun avahsah jeng ahin, chule Kelngoinou chu ameivah hi jenga ahi.
target: The city does not need the sun or the moon to shine on it, for the glory of God gives it light, and the Lamb is its lamp.

source: Chule huhhingsa namtin vaipi avah-a chu vahle ding, chule leiset lenghon aloupinao asunga chu ahinpoh lut dingu ahi.
target: The nations will walk by its light, and the kings of the earth will bring their splendor into it.

source: Chule akotkhahho chu a-imatih chana suna kikhah lou ding ahi (chua jan umtalou ding ahi jeh chun);
target: On no day will its gates ever be shut, for there will be no night there.

source: chule namtin vaipin loupinale jabolna asunga chu apoh lut dingu ahi.
target: The glory and honor of the nations will be brought into it.

source: Chule iti nama jongle thil aboh pou poule thet um thil bola chule jou pana lut louhel ahi: Kelngoinou hinna lekhabua amin kisunho chengsebou chu lut ding ahi.
target: Nothing impure will ever enter it, nor will anyone who does what is shameful or deceitful, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s book of life.

source: Chuin ama chun Pathen le Kelngoinou laltouna-a kona put hintwi theng luidung crystal songvala val, khosung lamlen lailunga chu eivetsah tan ahi.
target: Then the angel showed me the river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb

source: Chule luidung chu apang langto-a hinthing keh ahin aga jat chom chom somleni ga-a, alha seh-a ga jing jeng ahi; chule thingnaho chu namtin vaipi boldamna ahi.
target: down the middle of the great street of the city. On each side of the river stood the tree of life, bearing twelve crops of fruit, yielding its fruit every month. And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.

source: Chule sapset umta louhel ding ahi. Chule Pathen le Kelngoinou laltouna chu asunga chu umding ahin, chule asohten ama chu ajen dingu;
target: No longer will there be any curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in the city, and his servants will serve him.

source: Chule amahon amai amu dingu, chule achaluva amin umding ahi.
target: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

source: Chule jan umta louhel ding ahi; chule amahon thaomei vahle nisa vah ngaita louhel ahiuve; Pakai Pathen'in amaho asalvah ding ahi jeh chun; chule amaho chun atonsot atonsot geija vai apoh dingu ahi.
target: There will be no more night. They will not need the light of a lamp or the light of the sun, for the Lord God will give them light. And they will reign for ever and ever.

source: Chuin aman kajah-a, Thu hicheng hi tahsan umle dihtah ahi; chomkhat joule hung soh ding hichengse chu themgao thengho Pakai Pathen'in asohte vetsah dinga avantil asol ahi.
target: The angel said to me, “These words are trustworthy and true. The Lord, the God who inspires the prophets, sent his angel to show his servants the things that must soon take place.”

source: Chule, ven, kahungvah ding ahi; hiche lekhabua lhagao thuseidoh ho chengse nitpa chu anunnom ahi, ati.
target: “Look, I am coming soon! Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy written in this scroll.”

source: Kei John tah-in hichengse hi kajah chule kamu ahi. Kajah-a chule kamu phat chun hichengsepi eivetsahpa vantil anga chun, ama chu chibai boh dingin kaboh khuptan ahi.
target: I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. And when I had heard and seen them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had been showing them to me.

source: Hichun aman kajah-a, Chingtheijin, hitobang chu bol hih-in, keima nangma soh chanpile nasopi themgaoho sohchanpi chule hiche lekhabua thu nit teho sohchanpi kahibouve; Pathen joh chibai bohtan, ati.
target: But he said to me, “Don’t do that! I am a fellow servant with you and with your fellow prophets and with all who keep the words of this scroll. Worship God!”

source: Chuin aman kajah-a, hiche lekhabua lhagao thu kiseidohho hi imchah hihhelin; phat anaitah jeh hin.
target: Then he told me, “Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this scroll, because the time is near.

source: Achonpha lou chun chonphat lou bol jinghen; aboh chu boh jinghen; chule achonpha chun chonphat bol jinghen; athenga chu athengin umjing hen.
target: Let the one who does wrong continue to do wrong; let the vile person continue to be vile; let the one who does right continue to do right; and let the holy person continue to be holy.”

source: Veuvin, keima kahungvah ding ahi; chule athilbol achonna dungjui cheh-a lethuhna kapeh ding tohman kakoma aume.
target: “Look, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, and I will give to each person according to what they have done.

source: Keima Alphale Omega kahin, amasale anukhah kahi, chule abul leh aleh kahi.
target: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.

source: Hinthing chu lo theina dingle kotpi-a lutna khopi sunga lut theina dinga, athupeh nit ho chu anunnom ahiuve.
target: “Blessed are those who wash their robes, that they may have the right to the tree of life and may go through the gates into the city.

source: Uicha hole doi choiho, chule jon thanhoi panhole tolthat teho, chule milim houho, chule thujou sei ngailu-a semdoh ho pamah aumui.
target: Outside are the dogs, those who practice magic arts, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.

source: Kei, Jesu'n, houbung ho-a dinga hicheng thuhi nangho hettohsah dinga kavantil kahinsol ahi. Keima David jungpile achilhah, Jing Valpa vahtah chu kahi.
target: “I, Jesus, have sent my angel to give you this testimony for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, and the bright Morning Star.”

source: Lhagao le mouvin, Hungin, ati lhone; ajachanin, hungin, tihen; chule adangchah chan hunghen; ago chanin manbeijin hintwi chu kilahhen.
target: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” And let the one who hears say, “Come!” Let the one who is thirsty come; and let the one who wishes take the free gift of the water of life.

source: Hiche lekhabua lhagao thuseidoh hi ajachan kahet tohsah-a kaseipeh ahi, Koi hile hicheng hi abelap aumle, Pathen'in hiche lekhabua kisun suhgam naho chengse hi achunga abelap ding ahi.
target: I warn everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this scroll: If anyone adds anything to them, God will add to that person the plagues described in this scroll.

source: Chule koi hile lhagao thuseidoh hiche lekhabua thuho lamanga aumle, Pathen'in hiche hinna lekhabua kisun hinthinga konle khopi thenga kona chule hiche lekhabu sunga kisun thilho-a kona hi achan alahmang ding ahi.
target: And if anyone takes words away from this scroll of prophecy, God will take away from that person any share in the tree of life and in the Holy City, which are described in this scroll.

source: Hicheng thu hettohsah chun, Ahi, kahungvah ding ahi, ati. Amen, hitichun Pakai Jesu, hungin.
target: He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.

source: I-Pakaiyu Jesu Christa milungset nachun, mithengte nabon chaovin umpiuvin, Amen.
target: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with God’s people. Amen.
